title_en: Methods of generating microparticles and porous hydrogels using microfluidics
abstract_en: Provided herein are methods utilizing microfluidics for the oxygen-controlled generation of microparticles and hydrogels having controlled microparticle sizes and size distributions and products from provided methods. The included methods provide the generation of microparticles by polymerizing an aqueous solution dispersed in a non-aqueous continuous phase in an oxygen-controlled environment. The process allows for control of size of the size of the aqueous droplets and, thus, control of the size of the generated microparticles which may be used in biological applications.

title_en: Camera optical element having tactile indicator
abstract_en: An apparatus including a camera optical element and a tactile indicator associated with the camera optical element for indicating a property of the camera optical element.

title_en: Compact polarization-based multi-pass optical architectures
abstract_en: Optical systems that can produce digitally switchable optical power, optical pathlength, or both. It can apply to reconfigurable wide-angle optical systems that are compact, light-weight, and light-efficient. Architectures that increase pathlength can utilize polarization splitters to produce an additional round- trip of one or more optical cavities. Changing the focus distance of synthetic imagery in augmented/virtual reality systems is an example of an application where the techniques taught herein are particularly well suited. Passive double-cavity systems can be used to increase the throughput and decrease the stray-light/ghosts in polarization-based compact wide-angle lenses.

title_en: Tandem vision window and media display
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are systems, apparatuses, methods, and non-transitory computer readable media related to a display construct (1, 2, 3) coupled to a structure (e.g., a vision window (123)). The structure can be a supportive structure such as a fixture. The display construct (1, 2, 3) is configured to facilitate media display and is at least partially transparent. The vision window (123) may be a tintable window, e.g., a window in which its tint is electrically controllable (e.g., an electrochromic window). Various interactive capabilities with the display construct (1, 2, 3) are disclosed (e.g., via a touch screen).

title_en: Adjustable intraocular lenses and methods of post-operatively adjusting intraocular lenses
abstract_en: Disclosed are adjustable intraocular lenses and methods of adjusting intraocular lenses post-operatively. In one embodiment, an adjustable intraocular lens can comprise an optic portion and a peripheral portion. The peripheral portion can comprise a composite material comprising an energy absorbing constituent and a plurality of expandable components. A base power of the optic portion can be configured to change in response to an external energy directed at the composite material.

title_en: Optical systems including light-guide optical elements with two-dimensional expansion
abstract_en: An optical system provides two-stage expansion of an input optical aperture for a display based on a light-guide optical element, A first expansion is achieved using two distinct sets of mutually-parallel partially-reflecting surfaces, each set handing a different part of an overall field- of-view presented to the eye. In some cases, a single image projector provides image illumination to two sets of facets that are integrated into the LOE. In other cases, two separate projectors deliver image illumination corresponding to two different parts of the field-of-view to their respective sets of facets.

title_en: Synchronized driving waveforms for four-particle electrophoretic displays
abstract_en: The present invention provides improved driving methods for four particle electrophoretic displays. The driving methods improve the color state performance when a first pixel is displaying a mixed state of a first highly-charged particle and a second lower-charged particle of the opposite polarity, while a neighboring pixel is displaying a state of a second highly-charged particle having the opposite polarity to the first highly-charged particle. The particles can be, for example, all reflective or one type of particle can be partially light transmissive.

title_en: Flexible stamp and method for manufacturing a flexible stamp
abstract_en: The invention relates to flexible stamp configured for imprinting, in particular nanoimprinting, and a method for manufacturing such stamp. The stamp (200) comprises a substantially flexible substrate (201), said substrate comprising at least one textured area (202), at least one functional element (203) and at least two conductive tracks (204) which are connected or connectable to the at least one functional element.

title_en: Polymerizable absorbers of UV and high energy visible light
abstract_en: Described are polymerizable high energy light absorbing compounds. The compounds absorb various wavelengths of ultraviolet and/or high energy visible light and are suitable for incorporation in various products, such as biomedical devices and ophthalmic devices.

title_en: Contact lens formulation and contact lens
abstract_en: Silicone hydrogel contact lens formulations are described. The formulations have a silicone component and a silicone-free component. The silicone component includes two or three compounds represented by Formula 1, Formula 2, or Formula 3. The silicone-free component includes a methacrylate component and an N-vinyl amide component. The methacrylate component includes hydroxybutyl methacrylate (HOB) and isobornyl methacrylate (IBM). The N- vinyl amide component includes N-vinyl N-methyl acetamide. When the compounds of Formula 1 and Formula 2 are present in the formulations in a specified ratio to each other, providing the HOB and IBM in specific amounts to achieve the specified ratios results in desirable silicone hydrogel contact lenses. The silicone hydrogel contact lenses are also described.

title_en: Removable strain relief brackets for securing fiber optic cables and/or optical fibers to fiber optic equipment, and related assemblies and methods
abstract_en: Removable strain relief brackets for securing fiber optic cables (44) and/or optical fiber to fiber optic equipment, and related assemblies and methods are disclosed. The removable strain relief brackets comprise lances (48) protruding from a platform and receiving cable ties (40) for securing optical fibre cables (44). The platform is mounted on a tray surface (26) or the like via pin fastener (134) and an angled tab (140, 132) received in a mounting part (102) of the tray surface.

title_en: Optical fiber ribbon, optical fiber cable, and method of manufacturing optical fiber ribbon
abstract_en: An optical fiber ribbon in which a plurality of colored and coated optical fibers are connected to each other by a connecting part formed of a UV-curable resin, wherein each of the colored and coated optical fibers is provided with a bare optical fiber, a primary layer formed of a UV-curable resin for covering the bare optical fiber, a secondary layer formed of a UV-curable resin for covering the primary layer, and a colored layer disposed on the outside of the secondary layer and formed of a colored UV-curable resin, the Young's modulus of the primary layer being at least 75% of the saturated Young's modulus of the primary layer.

title_en: Simulator for skill-oriented training
abstract_en: The present invention is a simulator for skill-oriented training. The simulator includes a work piece platform having a sensor and an immersive virtual training environment depicting a work piece rendered on the work piece platform. The simulator includes a head-mounted display unit (HMDU). The HMDU includes a camera, a speaker and a sensor providing visual and audio output to the operator. The simulator also includes a controller having a sensor. The controller sensor, the HMDU sensor and the platform sensor output signals representing spatial positioning, angular orientation and movement data of the controller relative to the work piece. The simulator includes a data processing system that executes algorithms for rendering the work piece, a virtual powder coating spray pattern including a coating stream having particles and a coating coverage. The data processing system provides sensory guidance as to performance of the operator.

title_en: Display device and method for manufacturing the same
abstract_en: The invention relates to a display device and a method of manufacturing the same. A display device having high quality and high reliability can be provided by reliably sealing a gap between a frame and a display panel even when the gap is different. The display device includes: a display panel including a display surface; a bezel including a frame portion and an open end on an inner side of the frame portion, the bezel covering an edge of the display panel on the display surface side with the frame portion; a front panel provided on the display surface side of the display panel with the frame interposed therebetween; and a resin member provided along the entire circumference of the open end of the frame. The resin member has a first resin member formed on the display surface, and a second resin member formed to cover the first resin member and a surface of the bezel opposite to the front panel.

title_en: Fiber melting disc and flip cover for same
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of optical communication equipment, in particular to a fiber melting disc and a flip cover for the fiber melting disc. The invention discloses a turnover cover for a fiber melting disc, which comprises a shell, wherein the shell is provided with a containing cavity, the bottom surface of the shell is provided with a first avoidance hole which is arranged at an optical fiber connector flange, two detachable first hinging parts are respectively arranged at two end parts of the rear side of the shell, and two telescopic second hinging parts which are at a certain distance are arranged between the two end parts of the rear side of the shell. The invention also discloses a fiber melting disc. The flip cover can be used for installing the circuit board with the electronic tag, so that the installation of the circuit board is simpler and more convenient, the existing fiber melting disc cannot be influenced, the fiber melting disc with different models can be used for different manufacturers according to one specification, the production and the management are convenient, the cost is low, and the installation is simple and convenient.

title_en: Direct connection device of seabed active optical cable with additional thin-film capacitor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a straight-through connection device of a submarine rimmed optical cable with an additional thin-film capacitor, which comprises a bending reinforcement, a mechanical clamp, a force-bearing nut, a sealing seat, a push sleeve, an O-shaped ring bushing, a support ring, a compression ring, a locking shaft, a tray, a sealing cylinder, a capacitor cabin, a capacitor, a support washer and a connecting pipe, wherein the end part of the submarine optical cable is respectively penetrated through the bending reinforcement, the force-bearing nut, the push sleeve and a sealing assembly, the mechanical clamp is connected with an armored steel wire in the submarine optical cable, the sealing seat is in adaptive connection with the mechanical clamp, and the O-shaped ring bushing, the support ring and the compression ring are arranged between the sealing seat and the mechanical clamp and are locked by the locking shaft. The invention adds the thin film capacitor on the basis of the common joint box, so that the thin film capacitor can provide starting voltage according to the characteristics of the capacitor in the starting stage of equipment, stabilize current and voltage protection equipment in the running process, and also can be used as a temporary power supply under the condition that an optical cable is disconnected, thereby increasing the working time of the equipment, and ensuring that the equipment can be shut down slowly to protect the equipment.

title_en: Display device
abstract_en: The present invention provides a display device, including: a display panel; a frame including a flat plate portion, and an inclined portion that extends from a side edge of the flat plate portion and is inclined with respect to the flat plate portion; at least one Printed Circuit Board (PCB) disposed on the frame; and a plurality of light sources disposed on the at least one PCB and configured to emit light to the display panel, wherein at least one of the plurality of light sources is disposed at a position corresponding to the inclined portion of the frame.

title_en: Photosensitive composition, pattern forming method, cured product, and display device
abstract_en: The invention provides a photosensitive composition which has sufficient sensitivity to exposure and can provide a cured product with sufficient transmittance through curing, a pattern forming method using the photosensitive composition, a cured product formed by using the photosensitive composition, and a display device with the cured product. The photosensitive composition contains a photopolymerization initiator (A1) represented by formula (1) and a photopolymerization initiator (A2) having an aromatic ring skeleton to which a nitro group is bonded. In the formula (1), R 1 Is a hydrogen atom or a monovalent organic group, R 2 And R 3 Each is a chain alkyl group which may have a substituent, a cyclic organic group which may have a substituent, or a hydrogen atom, R 2 And R 3 May be bonded to each other to form a ring, R 4 Is an organic group having a specific cyclic structure, R 5 Is a hydrogen atom, an alkyl group having 1 to 11 carbon atoms which may have a substituent, or an aryl group which may have a substituent, and n is an integer of 0 to 4. The photopolymerization initiator (a1) has no nitro group.

title_en: Touch display screen, manufacturing method thereof and touch display device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a touch display screen, a manufacturing method thereof and a touch display device, and belongs to the technical field of touch display. The touch display screen includes: the light conversion layer is arranged between the black matrix pattern and the touch electrode layer and used for converting diffraction light passing through the black matrix pattern into parallel light, and the parallel light is emitted out of the touch display screen through the touch electrode layer. The method solves the problem that the touch display screen is prone to poor moire patterns visible to human eyes, and achieves the effect of avoiding the poor moire patterns visible to human eyes on the touch display screen. The invention is used for the touch display device.

title_en: Projector and control method
abstract_en: A projector and a control method are provided, which can adjust color balance for a plurality of brightness settings. The projector includes: a light emitting element that outputs light of a 1 st wavelength band in a 1 st polarization state; a phase difference plate for converting a part of the light output from the light emitting element, which corresponds to the rotation angle, into a 2 nd polarization state; a polarization separation element for separating the light from the phase difference plate into a 1 st light beam in a 1 st polarization state and a 2 nd light beam in a 2 nd polarization state; a phosphor excited by the 1 st light beam to output a 3 rd light beam of a 2 nd wavelength band different from the 1 st wavelength band; a light modulator for modulating the light according to an image signal; a light emitting element control unit that controls brightness of the light emitting element based on brightness information; and a phase difference plate control unit that controls a rotation angle of the phase difference plate based on the brightness information.

title_en: Liquid toner containing low symmetry conductive material for printing conductive traces
abstract_en: Liquid toner for printing conductive traces is provided. The liquid toner includes a carrier liquid and toner particles dispersed in the carrier liquid. The toner particles comprise a low symmetry conductive material dispersed in a pigment.

title_en: Method for manufacturing liquid crystal display device
abstract_en: A method for manufacturing a liquid crystal display panel, comprising preparing three rolls each of which is wound into a roll shape of two optical laminate strips each including an absorption-type polarizing film and one optical laminate strip each including a reflection-type polarizing film, discharging the optical laminate strips from the respective rolls, a sheet cut from an absorbing polarizing film in a desired length direction of a strip is laminated on the non-visible side of a liquid crystal display panel, for the absorption type polarizing film sheet, a reflection type polarizing film sheet cut out in accordance with a desired dimension in the longitudinal direction of the strip, the transmission axis of the absorption type polarizing film sheet and the transmission axis of the reflection type polarizing film sheet are bonded in parallel, and then another sheet of an absorption type polarizing film formed in accordance with a desired dimension in the longitudinal direction of the strip is subjected to a treatment, the liquid crystal display panel is bonded to the visible side of the liquid crystal display panel so that the transmission axis of the liquid crystal display panel is orthogonal to the transmission axis of the absorbing polarizing film sheet bonded to the non-visible side of the liquid crystal display panel.

title_en: Wire grid polarizer and display panel using the same
abstract_en: The invention provides a wire grid polarizer and a display panel using the same. The wire grid polarizer includes a substrate, a plurality of wire grids, a plurality of patterned light absorbing layers, and a surface covering layer. The plurality of wire grids are arranged on the substrate, wherein a plurality of gaps are formed between every two wire grids. The plurality of patterned light absorption layers are arranged corresponding to the wire grids and are overlapped, wherein the gaps are formed between every two patterned light absorption layers. The surface covering layer is arranged on the patterned light absorption layers and is in direct contact with the patterned light absorption layers.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted camera module
abstract_en: The invention relates to a vehicle-mounted camera module, which comprises a lens, a prism, a visible light sensor, an infrared sensor, a printed circuit board and a shell, wherein the prism is provided with a prism body and a beam splitter, the beam splitter allows visible incident light to transmit through and reflects infrared light, a containing cavity recessed towards the inside of the prism body is arranged on an emergent light surface of the prism body, and an optical lens is arranged in the containing cavity. The separation of visible light and infrared light is realized through the prism, and the external environment is imaged through the visible light sensor and the infrared sensor, so that the imaging quality of the vehicle-mounted camera module is effectively improved. Particularly, under the environment condition of weak visible light, the imaging effect of the vehicle-mounted camera module can be effectively ensured through the imaging effect of the infrared sensor.

title_en: Rotary light beam generator
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rotary beam generator. An optical fiber apparatus may include: a monolithic core having a major portion and a minor portion, wherein at least a portion of the minor portion is offset from a center of the monolithic core, wherein the monolithic core is twisted along a length of the optical fiber device about an optical axis of the optical fiber device, and wherein the refractive index of the major portion is greater than the refractive index of the minor portion; and a cladding surrounding the monolithic core.

title_en: Detachable connection structure and intelligent wearing equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a detachable connecting structure and intelligent wearing equipment, which comprises a shell with an inner cavity, a plunger and a hinge mechanism, wherein the plunger and the hinge mechanism extend into the inner cavity of the shell from the opening end of the shell; the hinge part is provided with an inwardly extending flange, and the outer wall of the plunger is provided with a groove matched with the flange; when the plunger pushes the hinge mechanism to enable the hinge part to extend into the inner cavity of the shell, the hinge part deflects inwards and stops on the inner wall of the shell, and the flange of the hinge part is matched with the groove of the plunger; when the plunger pulls the hinge out of the interior cavity of the housing, the hinge deflects outwardly to disengage the plunger. The connecting structure can realize quick assembly and quick disassembly between two parts, and is simple and convenient to operate.

title_en: Thin LN light control device
abstract_en: The invention provides a thin LN light control device which suppresses occurrence of DC drift and is excellent in mass productivity. The thin-plate LN light control device is provided with a thin-plate LN light guide element in which an optical waveguide formed by thermally diffusing Ti and a control electrode for controlling the optical wave propagating through the optical waveguide are provided on a substrate using lithium niobate, and at least a part of the substrate is thinned, and a case in which the thin-plate LN light guide element is hermetically sealed and housed, and is characterized in that oxygen is contained in a sealed gas inside the case.

title_en: Photomask blank and method for manufacturing the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a photomask blank and a method for manufacturing the same. The photomask blank of the present invention comprises a transparent substrate, at least one film (A) containing chromium and nitrogen and not containing silicon, and at least one film (B) containing silicon and oxygen and not containing a transition metal, the film (A) and the film (B) being in contact with each other. In the photomask blank, when the secondary ion intensity is measured in the thickness direction of the film by time-of-flight secondary ion mass spectrometry (TOF-SIMS), the film is located at or near the interface between the film (A) and the film (B) and has a source of SiCrO  5  Is derived from Cr at the position of maximum intensity of secondary ions  2  O  5  The intensity of the secondary ions of (2) is lower than that of the secondary ions derived from SiN.

title_en: Mounting device mounted on image forming apparatus main body and image forming apparatus including the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a mounting device mounted on an image forming apparatus main body and an image forming apparatus including the same. A mounting device to be mounted on a vertically-oriented top surface of a main body of an image forming apparatus configured to form an image on a sheet includes: the locking member includes a locking member extending from a surface facing the top surface of the main body toward the main body and rotatable about a rotation axis extending in a direction orthogonal to the vertical direction, and a biasing member configured to bias the locking member toward a predetermined rotational direction. In a state where the mounting device is mounted on the main body, the locking member is inserted into the main body through an opening provided on a top surface of the main body, and is engaged with the main body by a biasing force of the biasing member.

title_en: Wide-angle emission filter, optical sensor assembly having the same, PCR system having the same, and method of manufacturing the same
abstract_en: A wide-angle emission filter includes a substrate, a photoresist, and a colorant. The substrate has a flat shape and comprises a transparent material. The substrate does not generate fluorescence or phosphorescence by the excitation light. The photoresist is disposed in a substrate. The photoresist is fixed to a solid state by at least one method selected from the group consisting of thermal hardening, photo hardening, and air drying. The colorant is disposed in the matrix and includes light having a predetermined wavelength range. The wide-angle emission filter filters the excitation light regardless of the angle of incidence of the excitation light.

title_en: Augmented reality display system
abstract_en: The invention provides an augmented reality display system. The augmented reality display system comprises a first light source module, a first polarization splitting element, a first image display, a first reflection amplifying element, a first polarization conversion element, a second polarization splitting element, a second image display, a first reflection element, a second reflection element and a second reflection amplifying element. The first image display and the second image display respectively output a first beam of sub-image light and a second beam of sub-image light of an image to be displayed, the first sub-image light and the second beam of sub-image light are respectively reflected and converged by the first reflection amplifying element and the second reflection amplifying element to respectively form a first sub-image to be displayed and a second sub-image to be displayed at human eyes, and the first sub-image to be displayed and the second sub-image to be displayed respectively formed at human eyes can be spliced into the image to be displayed visually by a user. The augmented reality display system has the characteristics of large field of view and high resolution, and has smaller volume compared with the augmented reality display system with the traditional display optical module.

title_en: Toner agitator assembly
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a toner agitator assembly. A toner container according to one exemplary embodiment includes a housing having a reservoir for storing toner and a drive shaft positioned in the reservoir. The drive shaft is rotatable about an axis of rotation in an operational rotational direction. A toner agitator extends from the drive shaft in the reservoir. When the drive shaft rotates, the toner agitator is rotatable about the axis of rotation of the drive shaft. The toner agitator folds relative to the drive shaft opposite the operational direction of rotation if the resistance to rotation of the toner agitator provided by the toner in the reservoir exceeds a threshold amount. The toner agitator is offset relative to the drive shaft in an operational rotational direction. When the toner agitator folds opposite the operational rotational direction relative to the drive shaft, the radial length of the toner agitator decreases.

title_en: Heating device for camera lens
abstract_en: The invention relates to a heating device (1, 1 ', 1 ") for a lens (6, 6 ', 6") of a camera (5, 5 '), wherein the heating device (1, 1 ', 1 ") comprises at least one body (2, 2 ') comprising at least one matrix material and at least one electrically conductive material, wherein the electrically conductive material is dispersed in the matrix material to form an electrically conductive mass; and at least two electrical contacts (3a,3b,3a ', 3 b') contacting the conductive block to apply a voltage to the conductive block. The invention also relates to a system comprising such a heating device (1, 1 ') and a camera (5, 5 '), a rear view display device for a vehicle comprising such a heating device (1, 1 ') and/or such a system, and to a vehicle comprising such a rear view display device.

title_en: Developing box
abstract_en: The present invention provides a developing cartridge comprising: a rod; a force application member; a first gear; a second gear; and a protrusion rotatable together with the second gear. The lever is movable between a first position and a second position. The urging member urges the lever toward the first position. The first gear includes a first gear portion and a second gear portion. The addendum circle of the second gear part is larger than the addendum circle of the first gear part. The second gear includes a third gear portion engageable with the first gear portion and a fourth gear portion engageable with the second gear portion. The addendum circle of the fourth gear part is smaller than the addendum circle of the third gear part. When the second gear rotates in a state where the second gear part is engaged with the fourth gear part, the protrusion contacts the lever, thereby moving the lever from the first position to the second position against the urging force of the urging member.

title_en: Display panel, display device and 3D printing system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a display panel, a display device and a 3D printing system. The display panel includes: a display area and a non-display area, the display area including a plurality of pixels; the liquid crystal display panel comprises an array substrate, a liquid crystal molecular layer and an opposite substrate, wherein the liquid crystal molecular layer is positioned between the array substrate and the opposite substrate; a light shielding part is arranged between two adjacent pixels, and comprises a first light shielding part and a second light shielding part, wherein the first light shielding part is positioned on the opposite substrate, and the second light shielding part is positioned on the array substrate; wherein, the orthographic projection of the first shading part on the plane of the second shading part covers the second shading part. The invention can reduce side light leakage.

title_en: Holographic projection performance device
abstract_en: The holographic projection performance device comprises a main stage steel frame, a holographic projection film and a holographic film support are arranged on the main stage steel frame, the holographic projection film and the performance stage are arranged on the performance stage in an erected mode, the holographic projection film and the performance stage are inclined at a certain angle, supporting plates are arranged at four corners of the bottom of the main stage steel frame, a horizontal rotary supporting device and a movable wheel set are sequentially arranged below the supporting plates, a first extending swing arm is arranged on the horizontal rotary supporting device, the movable wheel set comprises a travelling wheel and a travelling wheel seat, one side of the movable wheel set is provided with an electric push rod, the electric push rod comprises a motor assembly, a push rod assembly and a fixing seat, and the movable end of the push rod assembly is hinged with the first swing arm. The invention adopts the motor reducer to drive the movable wheel set to drive the performance stage, can realize the up-and-down of the holographic film performance device on the theatre, provides space for rich performance of the theatre, realizes the steering of the movable wheel set by utilizing the electric push rod, can adapt to the arrangement of the stage space of the theatre, and is not limited by the layout of other performance devices.

title_en: Display device
abstract_en: A display device includes: a first base substrate including a display area and a peripheral area surrounding the display area; a voltage line disposed in a peripheral region of the first base substrate; a protrusion disposed on the voltage line and including a first pattern containing a first color material and a second pattern containing a second color material different from the first color material; a connection electrode disposed on the protrusion and connected with a voltage line; and a light shielding pattern disposed on the connection electrode and provided with an opening for partially exposing the connection electrode, wherein the protrusion includes a multi-layer portion in which the first pattern and the second pattern overlap each other and a single-layer portion in which the first pattern and the second pattern do not overlap each other, and a side surface of the light shielding pattern defining the opening overlaps the single-layer portion.

title_en: Colored curable resin composition
abstract_en: A colored curable resin composition comprising a colorant, a resin, a polymerizable compound, and a polymerization initiator, wherein the colorant comprises at least 1 selected from the group consisting of a red pigment and a xanthene compound, and a compound represented by formula (I).

title_en: Blue light modulation for biosafety
abstract_en: A system and method for blue light adjustment using a wearable display system is provided. Embodiments of systems and methods for blue light modulation may include: receiving an eye image of an eye exposed to the modulated level of blue light; detecting a change in pupillary response by comparing the received eye image with the first image; determining that the pupillary response corresponds to a biological characteristic of the human individual; and determining to allow access to the biological application based on the pupillary response.

title_en: Lighting device and method for assembling reflector
abstract_en: The invention provides an illumination device and a method for assembling a reflector. The lighting device comprises a base and a reflector for reflecting light rays, wherein the outer side of the reflector is connected with the base through a rotating shaft, the upper end and the lower end of the reflector can rotate around the rotating shaft, the lighting device also comprises a first adjusting component and a second adjusting component, the first adjusting component is connected between the base and the lower end of the reflector and used for adjusting the rotating angle of the reflector rotating around the rotating shaft by changing the distance between the base and the lower end of the reflector, the second adjusting component is connected between the base and the upper end of the reflector and used for limiting the rotating angle of the reflector when the reflector rotates around the rotating shaft and fixing the relative position between the upper end of the reflector and the base when the reflector is adjusted to a preset angle. The invention can simply and intuitively adjust the position of the reflector in the lighting device.

title_en: Binocular tracking system based on single camera
abstract_en: The invention provides a binocular tracking system based on a single camera, and relates to the technical field of monocular stereoscopic vision based on a prism. The system comprises an integrated frame, an optical waveguide display, an optical waveguide processor, an eyeball tracking device, a binocular camera device and a computer processing device, the visual field range of a single camera is expanded by utilizing the refraction effect of a prism, so that the single camera can capture left and right eye images simultaneously, the interpupillary distance of the two eyes can be directly solved by matching prism parameters with a pupil feature extraction algorithm, and the eyeball tracking coordinate system is also simplified under the condition of one camera.

title_en: Array substrate, display screen and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses an array substrate, which comprises a first thin film transistor and a photoelectric sensor. The first thin film transistor and the photosensor are arranged on the same layer. The array substrate can reduce the overall thickness of a display screen applying the array substrate and the overall thickness of an electronic device applying the display screen. The application also discloses a display screen and electronic equipment.

title_en: Ferrule-based fiber optic connector with ferrule retraction balancing
abstract_en: A ferrule-based fiber optic connector having a ferrule retraction balance feature for maintaining optical performance is disclosed. The fiber optic connector includes a connector assembly, a connector sleeve assembly, and a balancing resilient member. The connector assembly includes a ferrule and a resilient member for biasing the ferrule forward, and the connector sleeve assembly includes a housing and a ferrule sleeve, wherein the connector assembly is at least partially disposed in the passage of the housing and the ferrule of the connector assembly is at least partially disposed in the ferrule sleeve. The counterbalance resilient member biases the housing to a forward position, wherein the biasing resilient member has a predetermined resilient force that is greater than a frictional force required to displace the ferrule within the ferrule sleeve.

title_en: Fabricating air gap regions in multi-component lens systems
abstract_en: Embodiments relate to the fabrication of air gap regions (160) in multi-component lens systems (100). An embodiment of an apparatus comprises: a first lens (115), the first lens (115) comprising a pattern of photoresist material (140); a second lens (125) bonded to the first lens (115) by a photoresist material (140); and an air gap region (160) between the first lens (115) and the second lens (125). The photoresist pattern (140) defines an air gap region (160) between the first lens (115) and the second lens (125).

title_en: Spectacle lens for imaging optical unit and data goggles
abstract_en: An eyeglass lens (1) for an imaging optical unit for generating a virtual image of an initial image presented on an image generator is provided. The eyeglass lens includes: an inner surface (3) intended to face towards the eye and an outer surface (5) intended to face away from the eye; an input coupling section (7) for coupling an imaging beam path emanating from the initial image between the inner surface (3) and the outer surface (5) of the spectacle lens (1); and an output coupling structure (9) which is present in the spectacle lens (1) for coupling out an imaging beam path from the spectacle lens (1) in the direction of the eye. The imaging beam path is guided to the out-coupling structure (9) by reflection between the inner surface (3) and the outer surface (5). Between the input coupling section (7) and the output coupling structure (9), in the region of the inner surface (3) and/or in the region of the outer surface (5), there is at least one reflective surface (R3) which is concavely curved when viewed from the interior of the spectacle lens (1), the curvature of said reflective surface being different from the basic curvature of the inner surface (3) and/or the outer surface (5) of the spectacle lens (1).

title_en: Electrophotographic photoreceptor, process cartridge, and image forming apparatus
abstract_en: An electrophotographic photoreceptor (1) comprises a conductive substrate (2) and a photosensitive layer (3). The photosensitive layer (3) is a single-layer photosensitive layer and contains at least a charge generating agent, an electron transporting agent, a hole transporting agent and a binder resin. The electron transport agent contains a naphthoquinone derivative represented by general formula (1). The triboelectric charge amount of calcium carbonate when the photosensitive layer (3) is rubbed with calcium carbonate is +7 [ mu ] C/g or more. In the general formula (1), R 11 And R 12 Are respectively the same as R in the specification 11 And R 12 Have the same meaning, and at least one is a group substituted by a halogen atom.

title_en: Raman mixing visible laser light source and implementation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Raman mixing visible laser source and an implementation method, the Raman mixing visible laser source comprises a laser body, wherein a semiconductor laser pumping source, a total reflection cavity mirror, nd, YAG crystals, an acousto-optic Q regulator, a coupling cavity mirror, RTP crystals for cutting a near optical main shaft and an output cavity mirror are sequentially arranged in an optical path of the laser body, an oscillation cavity of 1064nm fundamental frequency laser is formed between the total reflection cavity mirror and the output cavity mirror, and the coupling cavity mirror and the output cavity mirror form a Raman cavity; the total reflection cavity mirror is plated with a first dielectric film with high transmission to the wavelength of the semiconductor laser pumping source, the coupling cavity mirror is plated with a second dielectric film, the output cavity mirror is plated with a third dielectric film, and the surfaces of the Nd-YAG crystal, the acousto-optic Q regulator and the RTP crystal are plated with antireflection dielectric films with the wave bands of 1060nm to 1150 nm. Above-mentioned technical scheme, structural design is reasonable, compact structure, with low costs, system is simple, job stabilization and convenient operation.

title_en: Composition for forming organic film, method for forming pattern, and resin for forming organic film
abstract_en: The invention provides a resin which is a material of a composition for forming an organic film with high embedding/flattening characteristics and etching resistance, the composition and a pattern forming method using the composition. The composition for forming an organic film contains: (I) a resin comprising a structure represented by general formula (1) wherein a ring structure AR containing an aromatic ring and a helical structure SP bonded to four of said ARs are alternately repeated in at least a part of repeating units; and (II) an organic solvent. [ chemical formula 1]

title_en: Composition for forming plated layer, substrate with plated layer, conductive thin film, touch panel sensor, and touch panel
abstract_en: The invention provides a composition for forming a plated layer, a substrate with a plated layer, a conductive film, a touch panel sensor and a touch panel, wherein a metal layer can be formed on the composition by plating treatment and the plated layer with excellent stretchability can be formed. The composition for forming a plating layer of the present invention comprises: an amide compound selected from the group consisting of a multifunctional acrylamide having a polyoxyalkylene group and a multifunctional methacrylamide having a polyoxyalkylene group; and a polymer having a functional group that interacts with the plating catalyst or a precursor thereof.

title_en: Interface chip on glass component
abstract_en: In one exemplary embodiment, an optoelectronic assembly (200) includes: an electronic substrate (208), a transparent member (202) coupled on a first side of the electronic substrate, and a first member (210) that may be formed of or may include nickel-plated copper coupled to a second side of the electronic substrate opposite the first side. The electronic substrate, the transparent member, and the first member may define a sealed enclosure (244). A laser array (232) or a receiver array (236) may be mechanically coupled to a transparent member inside the housing and oriented to send or receive optical signals through the transparent member. The laser array or the receiver array may be electrically coupled to the electronic substrate. A second component (214) can be positioned between the first component and the transparent component in the sealed enclosure, wherein the thermal interface material forms a first interface between the second component and the transparent component.

title_en: Optical system and image pickup apparatus
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to an optical system and an image pickup apparatus. Provided is an optical system including: a first lens unit having a positive refractive power; a second lens unit having a positive refractive power and disposed on an image side of the first lens unit; and a third lens unit having a positive refractive power and disposed closest to the image side, wherein an interval between each adjacent one of the lens units changes during focusing. The first lens unit does not move during focusing. During focusing from infinity to a close distance, the second lens unit moves along the optical axis toward the object side. The second lens unit includes, in order from the object side to the image side, a positive lens, a negative lens, and an aperture stop. The third lens unit includes a positive lens and a negative lens. The air equivalent back focal length and the length of the third lens unit on the optical axis are appropriately set.

title_en: Temperature compensation structure based on array waveguide grating
abstract_en: The invention discloses a temperature compensation structure based on an array waveguide grating. The temperature compensation structure based on the array waveguide grating comprises a bottom plate, an array waveguide grating chip, a second-stage temperature compensation structure and a third-stage temperature compensation structure, wherein the array waveguide grating chip is cut into a first sub-part and a second sub-part along a kerf, the second-stage temperature compensation structure comprises a first compensation rod, a second compensation rod, a third compensation rod, a fourth compensation rod and a fifth compensation rod which are sequentially and fixedly connected in an arc shape, the first compensation rod is fixedly connected with the first sub-part, the fifth compensation rod is fixedly connected with the bottom plate, the thermal expansion coefficients of the first compensation rod and the third compensation rod are larger than those of the fourth compensation rod, and the thermal expansion coefficients of the fourth compensation rod are larger than those of the second compensation rod and the fifth compensation rod. The technical scheme provided by the embodiment of the invention can ensure that the movement rate of the first sub-part in the array waveguide grating chip becomes larger along with the temperature increase, thereby effectively improving the wavelength drift of each temperature section and realizing effective secondary compensation.

title_en: Positively chargeable toner, method for producing same, and two-component developer
abstract_en: The invention provides a positively chargeable toner, a method of manufacturing the same, and a two-component developer. The positively chargeable toner contains a plurality of toner particles, and the toner particles are provided with toner base particles and an external additive, and the external additive is attached to the surface of the toner base particles. The external additive contains first resin particles having a number-uniform primary particle diameter of 30nm to 65nm, to the surface of which a cationic surfactant is adhered, and second resin particles having a number-uniform primary particle diameter of 80nm to 120nm, to the surface of which a cationic surfactant is adhered. The first resin particles have a MW hydrophobicity of 15% to 30%, and the second resin particles have a MW hydrophobicity of 50% to 80%. The coverage of the first resin particles and the coverage of the second resin particles are both 10% to 30%. The BL ratios of the first resin particles and the second resin particles are both 30 mass% or less.

title_en: Polymerizable composition for polythiourethane optical material
abstract_en: An embodiment of the present invention relates to a polymerizable composition for a polythiourethane-based optical material, wherein the polymerizable composition containing specific additives can suitably adjust the reactivity of isocyanate so that the viscosity remains low for a predetermined period of time, thus enabling the preparation of a high-quality polythiourethane-based optical material without a complicated purification process. Further, the polythiourethane optical material according to an embodiment has not only a uniform refractive index but also a low yellowness index, and thus can be used as various plastic optical lenses, such as spectacle lenses or camera lenses, and the like.

title_en: Polaroid attaching machine and alignment method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a polarizer attaching machine and an alignment method thereof. The polaroid attaching machine comprises a machine table, a cleaning roller group arranged on the machine table, a first position sensor and a second position sensor which are respectively arranged on two sides of the cleaning roller group, a moving unit arranged below the machine table and a control unit which is connected with the first position sensor, the second position sensor and the moving unit; the cleaning roller group is used for cleaning the polaroid; the first position sensor and the second position sensor are used for sensing the inclination angle of the polarizer and the horizontal direction; the control unit is used for controlling the mobile unit rotating machine table according to the inclination angle between the polaroid and the horizontal direction so as to enable the polaroid to be parallel to the horizontal direction, and therefore the problem that alignment cannot be carried out due to inclination of the polaroid is solved.

title_en: Array substrate, manufacturing method of array substrate and display panel
abstract_en: The invention discloses an array substrate, a manufacturing method of the array substrate and a display panel. The pixel structure comprises a thin film transistor, wherein the thin film transistor comprises a substrate, a first metal layer, an insulating layer, a semiconductor layer, a barrier layer, a second metal layer, a first passivation layer and a pixel electrode; the first metal layer is formed on the surface of the substrate; the insulating layer covers the surface of the first metal layer; the semiconductor layer covers the surface of the insulating layer; the barrier layer covers the surfaces of the semiconductor layer and the insulating layer; the second metal layer covers the surface of the barrier layer; the second metal layer comprises a source electrode and a drain electrode; the first passivation layer covers the surface of the second metal layer; the pixel electrode is arranged above the first passivation layer; and connecting grooves are arranged on the barrier layer corresponding to the source electrode and the drain electrode, one end of each connecting groove is connected with the source electrode and the semiconductor layer, and the other end of each connecting groove is connected with the drain electrode and the semiconductor layer. The etching area is small, and the phenomenon that a thin insulating layer is made to cause picture abnormity is prevented.

title_en: Phosphor-containing film and backlight unit
abstract_en: The invention provides a phosphor-containing film which can inhibit the deterioration of a phosphor even if a film containing a phosphor such as a quantum dot is cut into a desired size after a laminated structure is formed in the film, and a backlight unit having the phosphor-containing film as a wavelength conversion member. The phosphor-containing thin film of the present invention comprises: a phosphor-containing layer in which a plurality of fluorescent regions containing a phosphor that degrades by reacting with oxygen when exposed to oxygen are discretely arranged, and a resin layer impermeable to oxygen is arranged between the discretely arranged plurality of fluorescent regions; and a1 st base film and a2 nd base film laminated on both main surfaces of the phosphor-containing layer, respectively; the Knoop hardness of the resin layer was 115N/mm 2 ～285N/mm 2 The creep recovery rate is 22% or less, and the elastic recovery rate is 60% or more.

title_en: Double telecentric lens and optical system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a double telecentric lens and an optical system, which belong to the technical field of optical design, and comprise an optical amplifying group, an aperture diaphragm and an imaging group along an optical path, wherein the optical amplifying group consists of seven lenses, and the optical amplifying group sequentially comprises: a first lens, a second lens, a third lens, a fourth lens, a fifth lens, a sixth lens and a seventh lens; the third lens and the fourth lens are double glued to form a first gluing group; the imaging group consists of eleven lenses, and the imaging group sequentially comprises: eighth lens, ninth lens, tenth lens, eleventh lens, twelfth lens, thirteenth lens, fourteenth lens, fifteenth lens, sixteenth lens, seventeenth lens, eighteenth lens, wherein the twelfth lens is a meniscus lens and the thirteenth lens is a meniscus lens double-cemented with each other as a second cemented group. The technology can improve the resolution and contrast of the lens and reduce the telecentricity and distortion of the lens.

title_en: Method for regulating and controlling wavelength of graphene plasmon
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for regulating and controlling the wavelength of a graphene plasmon, which regulates and controls the strength of mutual coupling of a plasmon electric field and the dielectric property of a substrate by controlling different distances between a graphene layer and a substrate layer, thereby realizing in-situ regulation and control of the wavelength of the graphene plasmon. The method can regulate the distance between the graphene and the substrate to be in a range from 0 nanometer to hundreds of micrometers; in the range of a few nanometers to a few hundred nanometers, the wavelength of the plasmon can be regulated and controlled in situ by a method of filling gas between the graphene and the substrate; the distance change is continuous, so that the wavelength can be continuously regulated and controlled; the method is simple and easy to implement and low in cost.

title_en: Black-colored composition and black-colored resist composition comprising same
abstract_en: The present invention addresses the problem of providing a novel black coloring composition which has excellent dispersibility, high insulation properties, low dielectric constant, good NMP resistance, and high optical density, and a black coloring resist composition comprising the same. Specifically, a black coloring composition containing, as a colorant, any one of the following combinations 1 to 6: a.sv49; a.sv49 and b.blue and/or green pigments; a.sv49, b.blue and/or green pigments and c.violet pigments; a.sv49, b.blue and/or green pigments and e.red and/or orange pigments; b1.pb60 and/or PB80, d. violet colorant and e. red and/or orange pigment; 6. selected from e1.PO34, PO72, PR57: 1. at least one of PR149, PR170, PR179 and PR214, b.blue and/or green pigment and d.violet colorant.

title_en: Automatic bias control device for parallel demultiplexing module of optical analog-to-digital conversion system
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic bias control device of a parallel demultiplexing module in an optical analog-to-digital conversion system, which comprises an electro-optical switch module, an output optical coupling module, a feedback quantity conversion module, a feedback signal processing module and a program control power supply module, wherein the electro-optical switch module, the output optical coupling module, the feedback quantity conversion module, the feedback signal processing module and the program control power supply module are connected at one time and form a closed loop feedback link. The method is applied to automatic selection and stable control of the optimal working voltage (orthogonal bias point) of the dual-output electro-optic modulator of the parallel demultiplexing module in the optical analog-to-digital conversion system. A feedback link is constructed by utilizing the characteristics of two-path output complementation of the dual-output modulator and the special attributes of the optical pulse in the parallel demultiplexing module, so that the function of automatically selecting and stably controlling the optimal working voltage of the dual-output modulator in the demultiplexing system by using the simplest link structure is achieved.

title_en: Method for manufacturing arc electrochromic sheet and forming device thereof
abstract_en: A method for manufacturing arc electrochromic film and a forming device thereof, the method comprises: providing electrochromic units, attaching, bending and curing and the like, wherein two electrochromic units are manufactured in the step of providing the electrochromic units, in the step of attaching, UV fixed adhesive is used for temporarily adhering the electrochromic units to form a flat semi-finished product, in the step of bending and curing, the semi-finished product is placed on the forming device, the semi-finished product is clamped and bent by using two clamping and bending pieces of the forming device, and the adhesive is cured by a UV light source, so that the flat semi-finished product can be processed into an arc electrochromic sheet. The matching of the manufacturing method and the forming device can manufacture the electrochromic sheet with the preset radian under the condition of saving equipment cost and manufacturing cost.

title_en: Virtual image display optical system and image display device
abstract_en: The invention provides a virtual image display optical system and an image display apparatus using the same, which can display virtual images substantially simultaneously at a plurality of distances even though the structure is simple. A virtual image display optical system (30) is provided with a display element (11), a projection optical system (15) that enlarges an image formed on the display element (11), a diffusion screen (16) that has a diffusion function and is arranged on the light exit side of the projection optical system (15), a virtual image forming optical system (17) that converts the image on the diffusion screen (16) into a virtual image, and an arrangement changing device (62) that changes the position of the diffusion screen (16).

title_en: Infrared refrigeration type imaging optical system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real-time polarization infrared refrigeration type imaging optical system with a split-aperture confocal surface, which comprises a polarization group, a split-aperture group, a beam combination group, a first refraction reflector, an imaging front group, a second refraction reflector and an imaging rear group, wherein the polarization group comprises an infrared wave plate and an infrared polarizing film which are sequentially arranged along a light path; the invention adopts four paths of aperture division, reasonably arranges the structural form of the light path, has completely consistent four paths of imaging channels and fully meets the requirement of the infrared refrigeration type cold diaphragm.

title_en: Lens moving device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lens moving device, which comprises: a housing supporting the driving magnet; a bobbin including a coil disposed on an outer surface of the bobbin and located inside the driving magnet, and moving within the housing in a first direction parallel to an optical axis by electromagnetic interaction between the driving magnet and the coil; and a sensing unit sensing movement of the bobbin in the first direction.

title_en: Array substrate, manufacturing method thereof and display panel
abstract_en: The invention discloses an array substrate, a manufacturing method thereof and a display panel. The array substrate comprises a substrate, an active switch and a transparent electrode layer, wherein the active switch comprises a first metal layer, an adhesion layer arranged on the first metal layer, a first insulating layer arranged on the adhesion layer, and a through hole penetrating through the first insulating layer and exposing the first metal layer; the transparent electrode layer is connected with the first metal layer through a through hole; the adhesive force between the adhesion layer and the first insulating layer is larger than that between the first metal layer and the first insulating layer; therefore, the first insulating layer is easy to adhere to the first metal layer during deposition, and the etching speed of the first insulating layer is relatively low due to the good adhesion, so that the undercutting phenomenon is improved.

title_en: Information display device
abstract_en: The invention provides an information display device with greatly improved light resistance to sunlight. An information display device for displaying image information on a projection surface by using a virtual image, the information display device being characterized by comprising, in the inside of a casing provided with an opening in a local part: an image light generating unit that generates image light for displaying image information; a unit for performing a predetermined optical process on the image light from the image light generating unit; and means for projecting the image light from the image light processing means onto the projection surface via an opening of the housing so that an observer can recognize the image information as a virtual image in front of the projection surface, wherein means for selectively suppressing a P-polarization component of light in a visible light region is provided on an optical path inside the housing.

title_en: Adhesive composition and adhesive film
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for forming an adhesive layer with a surface resistivity of 1.0 x 10 +9 An adhesive composition for adhesive layers having extremely excellent antistatic properties and not impairing durability, which is not more than omega/□, and an adhesive film using the adhesive composition. In the adhesive composition, the acrylic polymer is a copolymer of (A) n-butyl acrylate; (B) at least one selected from tert-butyl acrylate, isobutyl acrylate, n-butyl methacrylate and methyl acrylate; (C) a copolymerizable vinyl monomer containing a hydroxyl group and/or a carboxyl group; (D) the adhesive composition comprises (F) an antistatic agent, (G) a crosslinking agent comprising a trifunctional or higher isocyanate compound or a bifunctional or higher epoxy compound, and (H) a silane coupling agent having an epoxy group, a mercapto group, or an acid anhydride group.

title_en: Image supply device, control method for image supply device, and recording medium
abstract_en: Image providing apparatus, control method of image providing apparatus, and recording medium. When the display device and the image providing device can execute a predetermined process corresponding to the position of the pointer on the display surface, the possibility that neither of them execute the predetermined process can be reduced. The image providing apparatus provides image information to a display apparatus capable of executing a predetermined process and a 1 st process, and is capable of executing a 2 nd process and a predetermined process, the 1 st process displaying a 1 st image for executing the predetermined process on a display surface, the 2 nd process providing information representing the 2 nd image for executing the predetermined process to the display apparatus, the image providing apparatus comprising: a receiving unit that receives, from the display device, a notification that the display device is executing the 1 st process; a determination section that determines whether the image supply apparatus is executing the 2 nd process; and a control unit that causes the display device to stop the 1 st process when the reception unit receives the notification and the determination unit determines that the image supply device is executing the 2 nd process.

title_en: Imaging lens with double-color molding optical element and electronic device
abstract_en: An imaging lens and an electronic device with a bicolor molded optical element are provided. The imaging lens comprises a bicolor molding optical element, a plurality of imaging lenses and a shading element. The double-color molding optical element comprises a light-transmitting part and a light-absorbing part, wherein the light-transmitting part and the light-absorbing part are respectively made of plastic materials with two different colors, and an internal space is defined in the double-color molding optical element. The plurality of imaging lenses are arranged in the inner space along an optical axis of the imaging lens. The shading element is adjacently arranged on the light-transmitting part of the double-color molding optical element. When a specific condition is satisfied, the reduction of the object-side end volume of the imaging lens is facilitated.

title_en: Gas barrier laminate, method for producing same, member for electronic device, and electronic device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a gas barrier laminate, a method for producing the same, a member for an electronic device comprising the gas barrier laminate, and an electronic device comprising the member for an electronic device, wherein the gas barrier laminate comprises: a base unit having a base and a modification promoting layer, and a gas barrier layer formed on the modification promoting layer side of the base unit; the gas barrier laminate is characterized in that: the elastic modulus of the modification promoting layer at 23 ℃ is lower than 30GPa, and the water vapor transmission rate of the substrate unit at 40 ℃ and relative humidity of 90% is 1.0 g/(m) 2 Day) or less, the gas barrier layer is a layer formed by modifying the surface of the layer containing the polysilazane compound formed on the modification promoting layer side of the base unit. The present invention can provide a gas barrier laminate and the like having excellent gas barrier properties and flex resistance.

title_en: Display device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a display device, which comprises a first substrate, at least one active element arranged on the first substrate, a dielectric layer arranged on the at least one active element, at least one pixel electrode electrically connected with the at least one active element, a second substrate arranged opposite to the first substrate, a first spacer arranged on the second substrate and a display medium. The dielectric layer has a first protrusion and a body portion outside the first protrusion. At least one pixel electrode is disposed on the main body portion of the dielectric layer. The vertical projection of the first protrusion of the dielectric layer on the first substrate is located within the vertical projection of the first spacer on the first substrate.

title_en: Lithography system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a lithography system (200) with a projection lens (104), comprising: the wafer processing system includes a first optical element (208), a first sensor subframe (212), a first sensor (218) configured to detect a position of the first optical element (208) relative to the first sensor subframe (212), and a second sensor (220) configured to detect a position of the wafer (124) relative to the first sensor subframe (212).

title_en: Liquid crystal display panel and liquid crystal display device
abstract_en: The invention provides a liquid crystal display panel in a transverse electric field mode, which can inhibit internal reflection and realize good black display without coloring. The present invention is a liquid crystal display panel (10A) having a liquid crystal layer (17) including a first lambda/4 phase difference layer (31), a first substrate (13), a color filter layer (14), and horizontally aligned liquid crystal, a second lambda/4 phase difference layer (32) is provided between the first substrate (13) and the color filter layer (14) or between the color filter layer (14) and the liquid crystal layer (17), the second lambda/4 phase difference layer (32) is made of a material different from the first lambda/4 phase difference layer (31), a thickness of a region overlapping a blue color filter (14B) is thinner than a thickness of a region overlapping a green color filter (14G) in the second lambda/4 phase difference layer (32), and a phase difference of the first lambda/4 phase difference layer (31) with respect to light having a wavelength of lambda nm is set to Rout (lambda), when the phase difference of the second lambda/4 phase difference layer (32) with respect to the light with the wavelength lambda nm is Rin (lambda), the following formula (1) is satisfied in the region overlapping with the blue color filter (14B), and-1.0 nm < Rin (450) -Rout (450) <10.0nm (1).

title_en: Low-distortion line scanning lens
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of lenses, and particularly relates to a low-distortion line scanning lens, which comprises a mechanical system and an optical system arranged in the mechanical system, wherein the optical system comprises a first lens G1 with positive focal power and a meniscus structure, a second lens G2 with positive focal power and a meniscus structure, a third lens G3 with negative focal power and a meniscus structure, a fourth lens G4 with negative focal power and a biconcave structure, a fifth lens G5 with positive focal power and a biconcave structure, a sixth lens G6 with negative focal power and a biconcave structure, and a seventh lens G7 with positive focal power and a biconvex structure, which are sequentially arranged from an object side to an image. The resolution can reach 100lp/mm, namely when the corresponding maximum imaging chip is used, the pixel can reach 12K pixels, and the maximum optical distortion of the full field of view is lower than 0.05%; the whole group of focusing modes are adopted, and the clear aperture can be flexibly adjusted.

title_en: Sub-wavelength metal super-structured grating and intermediate infrared adjustable retroreflector
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sub-wavelength metal super-structured grating and a medium-infrared adjustable retroreflector, wherein the super-structured grating comprises a metal base body, a plurality of first grooves and second grooves which are periodically and repeatedly distributed are arranged on the metal base body, a first material is filled in the first grooves to form first structural units, a second material is filled in the second grooves to form second structural units, the first structural units and the second structural units have a reflection phase difference of pi, and the refractive index n of the second material is n 2 Greater than the refractive index n of the first material 1 . The reflection type metal super-structure grating is simple in structure and easy to realize, only comprises two structural units in a large period, and can realize the retroreflection function of infrared light in double channels through simple structural design; the metal super-structure grating keeps high performance, reduces loss caused by the structure, has extremely high retroreflective efficiency (more than 98 percent), can modulate different retroreflective angles only by changing the period length, and has the characteristics of high efficiency, adjustability, dual-channel retroreflective performance and the like.

title_en: Intelligent head-mounted equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses intelligent head-mounted equipment. This intelligence head-mounted apparatus include the lens and with the shank that the lens formed the connection is same be provided with sound generating unit on the shank, sound generating unit includes first sound generating mechanism and second sound generating mechanism, first sound generating mechanism with second sound generating mechanism outwards radiates the sound wave through respective phonate hole, at the during operation, first sound generating mechanism and second sound generating mechanism's opposite phase, first sound generating mechanism is different with the distance of second sound generating mechanism to the same earhole of wearer.

title_en: Device for electrically adjusting focal length of lens of binocular camera and focusing system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of camera lens focusing, in particular to a device for electrically adjusting the focal length of a binocular camera lens and a focusing system, and the device for electrically adjusting the focal length of the binocular camera lens is suitable for the focusing process of the camera lens and comprises a workbench, a workpiece fixing seat arranged on the workbench, a module capable of being arranged in the workpiece fixing seat for focusing the lens, a clamping mechanism arranged on the workbench for locking the module, and an adjusting mechanism assembled on the workbench for matching with the module for focusing; the module includes support, camera lens and imaging sensor, the camera lens is installed in the support, and can remove on the support, imaging sensor installs in the support and lies in the camera lens rear, and the focusing precision is higher, and stability is better, and is more high-efficient high-speed, can arrange the AI and realize full autofocus, and the twin-lens of collocation makes focusing imaging better.

title_en: Lithographic apparatus and method of operating a lithographic apparatus
abstract_en: A lithographic apparatus and a method of operating a lithographic apparatus. The present disclosure describes a leak handling apparatus and method for handling fluid leaks in semiconductor manufacturing equipment. The semiconductor manufacturing apparatus may include a lithographic apparatus having a holder configured to hold a substrate and a photoresist feeder configured to dispense a coating on one or more regions of the substrate. The photoresist feeder may include a photoresist cartridge configured to output a coating material, a conduit fluidly connected to the photoresist cartridge, wherein the conduit may be configured to fluidly transfer the coating material and circulate a coolant, and a fluid leak handling device disposed above the holder, wherein the fluid leak handling device may be configured to detect a fluid leak from the conduit.

title_en: Electrochemical element comprising carbon quantum dot ionic compound electrolyte
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an electrochemical device comprising an electrolyte of a carbon quantum dot ionic compound, and more particularly, to an electrochemical device comprising a first electrode, a second electrode spaced apart from the first electrode, and an electrolyte filled between the first electrode and the second electrode, wherein the electrolyte comprises a carbon quantum dot ionic compound in the form of a salt of a graphene quantum dot anion and a metal cation having an average diameter in the range of 0.1 to 8 nanometers (nm) and a surface charge of-20 or less, and wherein the reliability, efficiency, and durability of the device can be greatly improved by using the carbon quantum dot ionic compound as the electrolyte, and the improvement of the carbon quantum dot ionic compound and the selective ionic conductivity of a specific cation and the suppression of side reactions caused by the electrolyte in the device, thus, the reliability and performance of the device can be improved, and the device can be applied to any of liquid, gel, and solid phases, and thus has high applicability.

title_en: Projection curtain and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses projection curtain includes: the base layer, and set up in proper order in graphite alkene layer and the optical coating layer of base layer one side, the raw materials components of optical coating layer include according to parts by weight: 50-60 parts of acrylic resin, 35-40 parts of ethylene propylene diene monomer, 25-30 parts of methyl vinyl silicone rubber, 6-10 parts of water-based wax, 3-8 parts of silicon dioxide powder and 3-4 parts of aluminum oxide. The projection curtain provided by the invention is provided with the graphene layer, and is combined with the optical coating layer, so that the brightness and the contrast of the projection curtain can be improved, and the projection curtain can show bright projection colors; meanwhile, the optical coating layer contains ethylene propylene diene monomer and methyl vinyl silicone rubber, so that a waterproof effect can be achieved, and the moisture resistance of the projection curtain is improved. And the manufacturing method of the projection curtain is simple and can be used for industrial production.

title_en: Optical device
abstract_en: In the optical device, the elastic support portion includes: a pair of levers facing each other in a2 nd direction perpendicular to the 1 st direction; a pair of 1 st torsion supporting parts extending along the 2 nd direction and respectively connected between the pair of rods and the base; a pair of 2 nd torsion support portions extending in the 2 nd direction and connected between the pair of levers and the movable portion, respectively; and a1 st coupling member erected between the pair of levers. A pair of rods and the 1 st coupling member demarcate a light passing opening. Each of connection positions of the pair of levers and the pair of 1 st torsion support portions is located on an opposite side of the movable portion with respect to a center of the light passing opening in a3 rd direction perpendicular to the 1 st direction and the 2 nd direction. The maximum width of the light passing opening in the 2 nd direction is defined by the interval between the pair of rods in the 2 nd direction.

title_en: Passive Q-switch pulse laser device, processing equipment and medical equipment
abstract_en: To generate a pulse laser having a stable polarization direction while suppressing an increase in pulse width of the pulse laser and a decrease in peak intensity of the pulse laser, and miniaturize an optical resonator and a laser device in the case of using an amorphous material as a base material of a laser medium. The present invention provides a passive Q-switched pulse laser apparatus, comprising: laser medium and saturable absorber. The laser medium is disposed between a pair of reflecting means included in the optical resonator. The laser medium is excited by a specific excitation light to emit an emission light. The saturable absorber is disposed on an optical axis of the optical resonator and on a downstream side of a laser medium between a pair of reflecting devices. The saturable absorber has a transmittance increased by absorbing the emitted light. At least one of the pair of reflecting means is a polarizing element. The polarizing elements have different reflectivities with respect to the emitted light in polarization directions orthogonal to each other.

title_en: Liquid crystal panel
abstract_en: Provided is a liquid crystal panel wherein an appropriate reflectance in a reflective state and an appropriate reflectance in a transmissive state are simultaneously established. The liquid crystal panel (100) is switched between a transmissive state and a reflective state in response to application of a voltage.
