A liquid crystal panel (100) comprises: an absorption-type polarizing plate (21), the absorption-type polarizing plate (21) being provided on one side of the liquid crystal cell (10); and a reflection-type polarizing plate (22), wherein the reflection-type polarizing plate (22) is provided on the other side of the liquid crystal element (10). In the reflective state, light entering from the absorption-type polarizing plate (21) side and passing through the liquid crystal cell (10) is light having a polarization axis along the reflection axis of the reflection-type polarizing plate (22), and is reflected by the reflection-type polarizing plate (22). In the transmissive state, light entering from the absorption-type polarizing plate (21) side and passing through the liquid crystal cell (10) is light having a polarization axis along a transmission axis intersecting the reflection axis of the reflection-type polarizing plate (22), and is transmitted through the reflection-type polarizing plate (22). In the absorption-type polarizing plate (21), the average degree of polarization at a wavelength of 450 to 650nm is in the range of 60 to 80%.

title_en: Optical modulator robust to manufacturing tolerances
abstract_en: An optoelectronic integrated circuit comprising (i) a first back-to-back junction component (BBJC) and a second BBJC conforming to a first fabrication pattern, wherein the first BBJC comprises a first a-type p-n junction (APNJ) in series with a first B-type p-n junction (BPNJ), wherein the second BBJC comprises a second APNJ in series with a second BPNJ, and (ii) an optical component conforming to a second fabrication pattern that is superimposed with the first fabrication pattern. The APNJ and BPNJ may be identified based on overlap with a separate arm of the optical component. The optical component overlaps the APNJ and BPNJ to modulate the optical signal using the modulation voltage from the electrode. The first APNJ, the first BPNJ, the second APNJ and the second BPNJ are arranged along respective directions, wherein metal bridges may be used to reduce imbalance in the modulation of the optical signal due to manufacturing misalignment.

title_en: Image capturing lens, image capturing module and electronic device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an image capturing lens, an image capturing module and an electronic device. The image capturing lens includes, in order from an object side to an image side, a stop, a first lens element with positive refractive power, a second lens element with negative refractive power, a third lens element with refractive power, a fourth lens element with positive refractive power, and a fifth lens element with negative refractive power. The object side surface of the first lens is a convex surface. The image side surface of the second lens is concave at the optical axis. The object side surface of the third lens is concave at the circumference. The fourth lens element has a concave object-side surface and a convex image-side surface. The object side surface of the fifth lens element is concave at the optical axis, the image side surface of the fifth lens element is concave at the optical axis, and at least one of the object side surface and the image side surface of the fifth lens element comprises at least one inflection point. The imaging lens satisfies the relation that SL/TTL is more than 0.9. The imaging lens, the imaging module and the electronic device have reasonable lens configuration and meet SL/TTL >0.9, and the possibility of generating a dark angle of the imaging lens can be reduced, so that the imaging quality is improved.

title_en: Method for manufacturing liquid crystal panel
abstract_en: A method for manufacturing a liquid crystal panel is provided, which is not easy to generate display failure even if the thickness of the substrate is various. A method for manufacturing a liquid crystal panel (10) is provided with: a contact area determination step of drawing approximate curves obtained by drawing the upper limit values of substantial contact areas (S) per unit area of the other substrate, each of which is the difference (D-T) between the protrusion height (T) and the distance (D) of the spacers (12) formed to protrude from the one substrate (10A) to the other substrate (10B), respectively, on the plate thicknesses (BT) of a plurality of pairs of substrates (10A, 10B) which are different from each other, and setting the contact area to 230 [ mu ] m regardless of the plate thicknesses  2  /mm  2  Determining the contact area according to the plate thickness in the range between the straight lines; a spacer forming step of forming a spacer so as to have the contact area determined in the contact area determining step; and a bonding step of bonding the pair of substrates.

title_en: Projector heat dissipation and dust prevention device beneficial to centrifugal force principle
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electronic products and discloses a projector heat dissipation and dust prevention device beneficial to the centrifugal force principle, which comprises an outer shell, the inner part of the outer shell is fixedly connected with an inner shell, the top of the inner shell is provided with an air inlet, the two sides of the inner shell are provided with air outlet holes, the inner part of the outer shell is fixedly connected with a suction fan, the top of the suction fan is fixedly connected with an air inlet duct, the top of the air inlet duct is fixedly connected with an adsorption layer, the outside of the adsorption layer is fixedly connected with an air inlet separation net, the two sides of the suction fan are fixedly connected with air outlet channels, the outside of the air outlet channel is fixedly connected with a liquid storage box, the inside of the liquid storage box is fixedly connected with a dividing net, and the air inlet separating net and the adsorption layer are matched for use, thereby reach the effect of preliminary dust removal, avoid the fan to inhale large granule dust in the air to can play the effect of dust removal to the air that gets into the projecting apparatus inside.

title_en: Imaging method of underwater array camera
abstract_en: Aiming at the defects of the prior art, the invention provides an imaging method of an underwater array camera, which uses laser as an active illumination light source, has long propagation distance and reconfigurable phase of coherent light, acquires optical images under different spatial spectrums by using an array camera, and analyzes the influence of ocean turbulence and wave reflection on imaging by combining an electric field type Monte Carlo simulation and spectrum splicing image reconstruction algorithm so as to obtain a clearer optical image.

title_en: Substrate
abstract_en: The present application relates to a substrate on which spacers are disposed in a specific arrangement state and an optical device using such a substrate. In the present application, the plurality of spacers are irregularly arranged on the substrate according to a predetermined rule, so that while the spacers maintain a uniform cell gap in the optical device configuration, uniform optical characteristics can be secured as a whole without causing so-called moire or the like.

title_en: Hard antireflective coatings
abstract_en: An article includes a substrate comprising a glass, glass-ceramic, or ceramic composition and a major surface. An optical film is disposed on the major surface. The film includes a first plurality of layers and a second plurality of layers, the first plurality of layers comprising diamond or diamond-like carbon. Each of the second plurality of layers is arranged in an alternating manner with each of the first plurality of layers. The optical film comprises an average photopic reflectance of about 2.0% or less and a transmittance of about 85% or more at about 500nm to about 800 nm.

title_en: Electrochromic element, optical filter, lens unit, image pickup apparatus, and window member
abstract_en: The invention provides an electrochromic element, an optical filter, a lens unit, an image pickup apparatus, and a window member. As an example of an EC element in which vertical color separation is suppressed, the present invention provides an EC element including a pair of electrodes, a solvent, an anodic EC compound, and a cathodic EC compound. In the EC element, the difference between the solvation free energy of the oxidized form of the anodic EC compound in water and the solvation free energy of the oxidized form in octanol is 35kcal/mol or more, and the cathodic EC compound has a substituent containing any one element selected from halogen, sulfur, boron, phosphorus, and silicon.

title_en: Electrophotographic photoreceptor, electrophotographic photoreceptor cartridge, and image forming apparatus
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an electrophotographic photoreceptor having a photosensitive layer on a conductive support, wherein the photosensitive layer contains a polymer a containing a repeating structural unit represented by a specific formula and a polymer B containing a repeating structural unit represented by a specific formula. The present invention also relates to an electrophotographic photoreceptor cartridge and an image forming apparatus having the electrophotographic photoreceptor.

title_en: High-temperature-resistant selective-emission infrared stealth material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The high-temperature-resistant selective-emission infrared stealth material is of a layered structure and sequentially comprises a substrate layer, a metal layer and a silicon nitride layer, wherein the thickness of the metal layer is 50nm-1000nm, and the thickness of the silicon nitride layer is 1.2-1.8 mu m. The preparation method of the infrared stealth material comprises the steps of (1) cleaning and drying a substrate material, (2) depositing a metal material on the substrate by a magnetron sputtering method, a chemical vapor deposition method or an atomic layer deposition method to form a metal layer, and (3) depositing silicon nitride on the surface of the metal layer by the magnetron sputtering method or the chemical vapor deposition method to complete the preparation of the infrared stealth material. The selective-emission infrared stealth material provided by the invention optimizes the thickness of the metal layer and the silicon nitride layer, meets the requirements of low emissivity and radiation heat dissipation, and has important significance for better realizing infrared stealth.

title_en: Projection screen and projection system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a projection screen and a projection system. The projection screen comprising a reflective layer and a light-absorbing layer for absorbing light arranged in this order from the incident side of the projection light, the reflective layer comprising a plurality of microstructure units, each microstructure unit comprising first and second planes obliquely opposed in a first direction and third and fourth planes obliquely opposed in a second direction, the angles of inclination of the first and second planes with respect to the screen plane of the projection screen being set so that at least a part of the projection light incident at a first angle of incidence in a first angle range is reflected at the first and second planes and finally enters the range of the field of view of the viewer, and the angles of inclination of the third and fourth planes with respect to the screen plane of the projection screen being set so that at least a part of the projection light incident at a second angle of incidence in a second angle range is reflected at the third and fourth planes and finally enters the range of the field of view of the viewer, and the first angle of incidence is less than the second angle of incidence.

title_en: Control device and control method for an aircraft device
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a control device and a control method for an aircraft device. To provide a controller which makes it possible to obtain highly accurate images by means of an aircraft device. There is provided a controller for an aircraft device provided with an imaging device that captures an image of an imaging target and an illumination device that illuminates the imaging target, the controller being provided with an illumination control unit that adjusts the light amount of the illumination device in accordance with the inclination of a fuselage.

title_en: Pluggable optical module easy to pull and reset and assembling method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a pluggable optical module easy to pull and reset, which comprises a shell and a pulling structure, wherein the pulling structure comprises a pull ring hinged on the shell and a sliding piece connected on the shell in a sliding way, an elastic component for driving slider reverse movement, set up first guide way on the casing and set up the second guide way on the casing, be equipped with on the pull ring be used for with the slider butt and along with the pull ring upset promote the gliding bulge of slider, the slider includes oblique guide block and straight guide block, oblique guide block is fixed with straight guide block, straight guide block and first guide way sliding connection, first guide way and second guide way intercommunication, oblique guide block and second guide way sliding connection, first inclined plane has been seted up on the second guide way lateral wall, the second inclined plane has been seted up to oblique guide block lateral part, second inclined plane and first inclined plane adaptation, straight guide block width is less than oblique guide block width, the width that oblique guide block kept away from straight guide block one end is greater than the width that oblique guide block is close to straight guide block one end. The present invention has the effect of improving the convenience of operation.

title_en: Long-stroke moving mechanism and screen laminating equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a long-stroke moving mechanism and screen laminating equipment, and is used for solving the problem that a driving end and a driven end in the long-stroke moving mechanism are asynchronous when moving along a linear guide rail. The long-stroke moving mechanism comprises linear guide rails and driving modules, the linear guide rails are located on two sides respectively, the driving modules are located on two sides, a ball screw and a turnover mechanism are installed on the linear guide rails on each side respectively, the driving modules on each side are connected with a control end, software programs on the control ends synchronously control the driving modules on each side, the driving modules on each side are connected with the ball screw respectively, and a screw nut on the ball screw is connected with the turnover mechanism. In the embodiment of the application, because the drive module of both sides can be by software program synchronous control, consequently, the drive module of both sides just also can drive tilting mechanism motion in step, and does not need the tilting mechanism of one side to drive the tilting mechanism of opposite side, the dead phenomenon of card can not appear, has improved the precision of tilting mechanism motion.

title_en: Semiconductor laser bar cleavage epitaxial wafer chip mounting device and chip mounting method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a semiconductor laser bar epitaxial wafer splitting and mounting device and a semiconductor laser bar epitaxial wafer splitting and mounting method, which belong to the technical field of semiconductor laser chips, and comprise a main body, a square frame, a round cake, a positioning block and a sliding block, wherein the square frame is positioned at the upper part of the main body, the round cake is positioned at the lower part of the main body, the main body is of a square structure, sliding grooves facing the center are arranged at four corners of the main body, the positioning block is fixed at the four corners of the main body, and the sliding block is positioned in the sliding grooves and can slide along the sliding; the middle part of the round cake is connected with the main body through a pin shaft, and four guide grooves with the same structure are arranged on the round cake close to the edge and are respectively used for guiding the sliding block to slide in the sliding groove; the square frame is of an inner telescopic structure and an outer telescopic structure, and one end of the sliding block is abutted to the corner of the square frame and used for pushing the square frame to contract. The invention has the advantages of automatic expansion function, simple structure, convenient operation and inspection, good surface mounting effect and high production efficiency.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted touch display device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a vehicle-mounted touch display device, which comprises a capacitive touch screen and a display screen, wherein the capacitive touch screen is arranged on the outer side of the display screen and is mutually attached, and the capacitive touch screen comprises a glass substrate and a touch circuit layer arranged on the inner side of the glass substrate. The vehicle-mounted touch display device not only can greatly eliminate the reflected light of the touch circuit layer and achieve the screen effect of being close to pure black, but also has simple manufacturing process and greatly reduces the manufacturing difficulty of the capacitive touch screen.

title_en: Projection optical system, projection type image display device, and imaging device
abstract_en: A projection optical system, a projection type image display apparatus, and an imaging apparatus. It is possible to prevent a part of the optical element from becoming high temperature and thermally expanding to cause deterioration of optical performance. The projection optical system (3A) is composed of a 1 st optical system (31) and a 2 nd optical system (32) in this order from the reduction side, and forms an intermediate image (33) between the reduction-side image forming surface and the enlargement-side image forming surface. The 2 nd optical system (32) is an optical element (35C). The optical element (35C) has a 1 st transmission surface (41), a reflection surface (42), and a 2 nd transmission surface (43) in this order from the reduction side toward the enlargement side. The optical element (35C) has a 1 st member portion (65) and a 2 nd member portion (66) having a different material from the 1 st member portion on an optical path of a light beam passing through the optical element (35C).

title_en: Cooling device and projector
abstract_en: A cooling device and a projector are provided, which can reduce the thermal resistance and increase the amount of heat that can be cooled. The cooling device has an evaporation portion and a condensation portion. The evaporation unit has: a housing; a core; and a groove member having a plurality of vapor flow paths through which a working fluid that changes from a liquid phase to a gas phase flows, the groove member being connected to the core. The case has a heat receiving portion to which heat is transferred from the cooling target. The tank member has a plurality of plate-like members arranged in a predetermined direction to form a plurality of vapor flow paths. Each plate-like member has a bending portion, which is formed by bending a part of the plate-like member, and is connected to the heat receiving portion.

title_en: Polarizing plate and optical display device comprising same
abstract_en: Disclosed are a polarizing plate and an optical display device including the same. The polarizing plate includes: a polarizer; and a pattern layer formed on one surface of the polarizer and including a first resin layer and a second resin layer facing the first resin layer, the first resin layer having a patterned portion formed at least a portion thereof facing the second resin layer, wherein the patterned portion includes at least two convex optical patterns and a flat section formed between a pair of adjacent convex optical patterns, each of the convex optical patterns has an upper surface on which a wave pattern is formed, and the wave pattern has a value of about 20% to 60% when calculated according to formula 1, and a pitch is greater than about 100 μm and less than about 400 μm.

title_en: Optical imaging lens
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optical imaging lens, which sequentially comprises a first lens element and a fifth lens element from an object side to an image side along an optical axis, wherein the first lens element has a positive refractive index, a circumferential area of an image side surface of the first lens element is a concave surface, a circumferential area of an object side surface of the second lens element is a convex surface, a circumferential area of an object side surface of the third lens element is a convex surface, the fifth lens element has a negative refractive index, and an optical axis area of an object side surface of the fifth lens element is a concave surface. The optical imaging lens meets the requirements of (G12+ G23+ G34)/(G45+ T5) ≥ 2.500 and EFL Fno/HFOV ≥ 3.500 mm/degree, and can reduce the length of the optical imaging lens, maintain good imaging quality, enhance the lens telephoto capability, have good optical performance and be technically feasible.

title_en: Optical module
abstract_en: The application discloses an optical module which comprises a shell, a circuit board, a photoelectric chip and an optical fiber module; the shell comprises a lower shell and an upper shell, and the upper shell and the lower shell are buckled to form an internal accommodating cavity and a light port and an electric port which are opposite front and back; the photoelectric chip is electrically connected with the circuit board; the optical fiber module comprises a plurality of optical fibers and a connecting component, one end of each optical fiber is optically coupled with the photoelectric chip, the other end of each optical fiber is connected with the connecting component, and the connecting component is arranged at the optical port; the connecting assembly comprises an optical fiber connector and a plurality of optical fiber tail handles used for holding a plurality of optical fibers; the optical fiber tail handles are fixed on the optical fiber connector. This application directly adopts optic fibre to transmit light signal between chip and module light mouth in the module, directly assembles the interface with the optic fibre lock pin in, has saved middle conversion head, and the structure is simpler, compact, and the equipment is more simple and convenient.

title_en: Polarized Mach-Zehnder interference system with output
abstract_en: The invention discloses a polarization Mach-Zehnder interference system with output, which comprises: the device comprises a beam splitter and a reflecting mirror, wherein the beam splitter comprises a first beam splitter and a second beam splitter; the reflector comprises a first reflector and a second reflector; the first beam splitter and the second beam splitter are connected in series with an incident light path, and the beam splitting surface of the first beam splitter is parallel to the reflecting surface of the second beam splitter. According to the structure, the two beam splitters are adopted for splitting and combining beams, the beam splitting surface direction of the beam splitters is adjusted, the measuring beams are led out from the beam combiners, different test light paths can be constructed outside the interferometer, and the coincidence of the test optical axis and the reference optical axis is realized through the two reflectors.

title_en: Distributed optical fiber acoustic wave sensing system based on far pump amplifier and Raman amplifier
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed optical fiber acoustic wave sensing system based on a far pump amplifier and a Raman amplifier, which comprises: a vibration detection unit providing signal light; a first laser source providing a first pump light; the head end of the first sensing optical fiber receives the beam combining light of the first pump light and the signal light; a far pump amplifier module connected to a tail end of the first sensing fiber, the far pump amplifier including an erbium-doped fiber for amplifying the signal light in an input; a second sensing fiber having a head end receiving the output of the far pump amplifier module. The invention effectively increases the sensing distance of the system.

title_en: Wide-angle lens
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wide-angle lens, which comprises the following components in sequence from an object side to an imaging surface: the first lens with negative focal power has a convex object-side surface and a concave image-side surface; a second lens with negative focal power, wherein the object side surface of the second lens is a concave surface, and the image side surface of the second lens is a convex surface; a third lens with positive focal power, wherein the object side surface of the third lens is a concave surface, and the image side surface of the third lens is a convex surface; a fourth lens having a positive refractive power, both the object-side surface and the image-side surface of the fourth lens being convex; a fifth lens element with positive refractive power having a concave object-side surface and a convex image-side surface; a sixth lens element with negative refractive power having a convex object-side surface and a concave image-side surface; a seventh lens element with positive optical power, wherein both the object-side surface and the image-side surface of the seventh lens element are convex; an eighth lens element with positive refractive power having a concave object-side surface and a convex image-side surface; a ninth lens element having a negative optical power, an object-side surface being convex at a paraxial region and an image-side surface being concave at the paraxial region. The wide-angle lens has the advantages of large wide angle, good thermal stability and high imaging quality.

title_en: Sum frequency ultraviolet light generating device and method based on fundamental frequency amplification
abstract_en: The invention relates to a laser light source, in order to solve the crystal selection limitation of frequency multiplication 532nm in the traditional method for producing 266nm '2+2', and ensure the conversion efficiency of 266nm at the same time, the invention relates to a device and a method for producing ultraviolet light based on the sum frequency of fundamental frequency amplification, after laser pulse passes through a frequency multiplication crystal and a color mirror, the rest 1064nm fundamental frequency light is reflected by the double-color mirror and then enters into Nd: YVO  4  crystal, pump light output by a 808nm semiconductor pump laser pumps the Nd: YVO  4  crystal through the double-color mirror, and the rest 1064nm fundamental frequency light enters into the triple-frequency crystal after being amplified by the Nd: YVO  4  crystal and then enters into the double-color mirror for transmission; the 532nm frequency doubling light reaches the bicolor mirror after being reflected by the reflector and then is reflected to the frequency tripling crystal, and 355nm ultraviolet light is generated. The invention is mainly applied to design and manufacturing occasions.

title_en: Six-shaft coupling equipment of endoscope
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mechanical equipment, and provides an endoscope six-axis coupling device which comprises an AA mechanism and a horizontal bottom plate, wherein the horizontal bottom plate is provided with an X-axis moving assembly and a Y-axis moving assembly; the six-axis platform is used for adjusting the posture of the module, and the AA mechanism is used for adjusting the posture of the lens and is matched with the six-axis platform to realize coupling; the endoscope assembly comprises a display, an imaging assembly and an endoscopic connecting pipe, and the module can be communicated with the endoscopic connecting pipe; the chart component is arranged on the Y-axis moving component; the light environment plate is arranged on the X-axis moving assembly and is provided with a through hole; the calibration and positioning assembly comprises a calibrator, a lower positioning camera and an upper positioning camera, and the calibrator is arranged on the light environment plate.

title_en: Optical device
abstract_en: An optical device is disclosed. The optical device includes: a light-guiding optical element having two major surfaces and two edges, an input aperture through which light waves enter the light-guiding optical element, and an output aperture through which light waves exit the light-guiding optical element; at least one optical element for coupling light waves out of the light guide optical element, at least one beam splitting surface embedded inside the light guide optical element, wherein light waves coupled inside the light guide optical element undergo multiple reflections from the at least one beam splitting surface and multiple penetrations through the at least one beam splitting surface, and wherein light waves undergo multiple total internal reflections off the two major surfaces between the input aperture and the output aperture.

title_en: Multi-beam drawing method and multi-beam drawing device
abstract_en: The embodiment relates to a multi-beam drawing method and a multi-beam drawing apparatus. The multi-beam drawing method includes: forming a multi-beam array for performing multiple patterning on a substrate; a step of assigning the sub beam array obtained by dividing the beam array to each of a plurality of sub fringe regions obtained by dividing a region on the substrate for each of the depictions; calculating, for each of the beamlet arrays, an exposure time modulation rate to be applied to each of the beamlets in the beamlet array; calculating and assigning a weight to each of the beamlet arrays corresponding to the respective groups of the mutually overlapping sub-fringe regions, based on a modulation degree of irradiation time of beams in the beamlet array; and a step of multiplying the weight assigned to each of the beamlet arrays by the irradiation time of each beam in the beamlet array, drawing each of the sub-fringe regions, and performing multiple drawing on each of the sub-fringe regions.

title_en: Method for producing cured silicone, and optical member
abstract_en: Provided are a method for producing a cured silicone material, which can significantly reduce the generation of volatile components from the cured material even when exposed to high temperatures of room temperature or higher for a long period of time, and a cured silicone material. A method for producing a cured silicone material, comprising: a curing step of curing the addition-type polyorganosiloxane composition by a hydrosilylation reaction at a temperature of 40 ℃ to 200 ℃ in a closed environment to obtain a primary cured product; and a heating step of heating the primary cured product at a temperature of 60 ℃ to 160 ℃ under open or reduced pressure; and a cured silicone material in which the total amount of the alcohol having 1 to 3 carbon atoms and the oxide thereof, and the silane compound having an alkyl group having 1 to 3 carbon atoms, generated when the cured silicone material is heated at 150 ℃ for 16 hours, is 10ppm or less.

title_en: Emergent fine storage device that jumps of modularization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a modularized emergency jump fiber storage device, which comprises: the winding assembly comprises a bobbin wall, limiting rings fixed at the edges of two ends of the bobbin wall, a rotating shaft arranged at the center of the bobbin wall along the axial direction, and a protective assembly coated on the periphery of the winding assembly, wherein two ends of the rotating shaft respectively penetrate through the front end and the rear end of the protective assembly, and one extending end of the rotating shaft is connected with a driving assembly; the protection component is also provided with two wire outlet holes which are arranged in a central symmetry manner, and the axes of the two wire outlet holes are parallel or coincident with each other; and the tail fiber bundle comprises a plurality of tail fibers which are bound into a whole through the sheath, and the tail fiber bundle is wound on the winding assembly. The invention adopts a modular design, is convenient to carry and receive and release optical fibers, can realize the quick recovery of services, improves the working efficiency and reduces the operation risk.

title_en: Augmented reality glasses device and display program
abstract_en: The invention provides an augmented reality glasses device and a display program capable of intuitively displaying the position of the front end of a tool in a workpiece coordinate system. An augmented reality glasses device (1) having a transmission type display unit (11) capable of displaying a trajectory of a tool (101) in a machine tool (100) on the display unit (11), the augmented reality glasses device comprising: a block acquisition unit (12) that acquires a block for moving the tool (101); a trajectory determination unit (13) that determines the trajectory and the movement direction of the tool (101) in the workpiece coordinate system, on the basis of the acquired plurality of blocks that are continuous in time series; and a display control unit (14) that causes the display unit (11) to display the determined trajectory and movement direction of the tool (101) in a stereoscopic manner.

title_en: Device and system for identifying state of module to be displayed
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a system for identifying the state of a module to be displayed, wherein when the device receives first state information of the module to be displayed, the device sends a first image to the module to be displayed so that the module to be displayed displays the first image; when receiving second state information of the module to be displayed, the device sends a second image to the module to be displayed so that the module to be displayed displays the second image; wherein the first image is different from the second image. The device shows through sending different images for display module assembly under different states, can improve display module assembly's detection quality to come to carry out corresponding processing to the image based on display module assembly's resolution ratio, can satisfy most display module assembly's demonstration demand, can effectual controlgear hardware cost and reduction realize the degree of difficulty.

title_en: Gravity unloading device for large off-axis three-mirror space camera
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gravity unloading device for a large off-axis three-mirror space camera, which comprises a base and an end seat, wherein the base and the end seat are horizontally arranged; the upper part and/or the lower part of the coarse adjustment mechanism is/are provided with a fine adjustment mechanism, the fine adjustment mechanism positioned on the upper part of the coarse adjustment mechanism is configured as an upper fine adjustment mechanism, and the fine adjustment mechanism positioned on the lower part of the coarse adjustment mechanism is configured as a lower fine adjustment mechanism; the base is used for bearing the coarse adjustment mechanism and the fine adjustment mechanism. The invention greatly reduces the volume of the fine adjustment mechanism, can exert unloading force on a plurality of points at different positions in space by the mutual matching of the coarse adjustment mechanism and the fine adjustment mechanism, and each unloading force can be suspended or supported in two ways, the number of fine adjustment unloading devices on each guide rail is variable, and the adaptability is good; the invention can accurately provide the unloading force in the gravity direction no matter supporting unloading or suspension unloading, and each fine adjustment assembly is provided with the pull/pressure sensor which can monitor the value of the applied force in real time, and the precision is high.

title_en: Wearable electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application mainly relates to wearable electronic equipment, including mirror holder subassembly, mirror leg subassembly, pivot subassembly and lid shell, the one end of mirror leg subassembly is passed through pivot subassembly and mirror holder subassembly swing joint, and the lid shell forms one with the cooperation of pivot subassembly and walks the line passageway to in the line structure of walking of wearable electronic equipment extends to the mirror holder subassembly from the mirror leg subassembly in through walking the line passageway, walk the line structure and be shielded by the lid shell at mirror leg subassembly and mirror holder subassembly relative pivoted in-process. The application provides a wearable electronic equipment forms one through the lid shell and the cooperation of pivot subassembly and walks the line passageway to the line structure of walking that allows wearable electronic equipment extends to mirror holder subassembly in from the mirror leg subassembly through walking the line passageway, and shields at mirror leg subassembly and mirror holder subassembly relative pivoted in-process through the lid shell and walks the line structure, exposes in order to avoid walking the line structure, and then improves wearable electronic equipment's outward appearance expressive force.

title_en: Vision training system based on VR glasses and VR glasses
abstract_en: The invention relates to a vision training method based on VR glasses, which adopts the VR glasses as training work and comprises the following steps: 1) Acquiring vision data of a user; 2) Adjusting the distance between the center points of two screens of the VR glasses to be the same as the eye distance of a user; 3) Displaying a target image on the screen, and adjusting the focal length of VR glasses according to the vision data of the user so that the target image can be clearly imaged on the retina of the user; 4) Adjusting the focal length of VR glasses and changing the size of the target image to simulate the distance movement of the target image so as to exercise the vision of the user and judge and count the training achievement rate and the total training achievement rate of the user in the stage; the invention also provides VR glasses applied to the vision training method based on the VR glasses; the training method of the invention prompts the user to adjust the focus of fixation, thereby achieving the purpose of effectively exercising ciliary muscle; the VR glasses can perform electric stimulation massage on acupuncture points of a user.

title_en: Virtual reality head-mounted display equipment and display method
abstract_en: The application provides a virtual reality head-mounted display device and a display method, and belongs to the technical field of virtual reality. The display device includes: two lenses, display module assembly and light are to changing the module, two lens spaced apart the setting, and the thickness direction of two lenses is relative each other, display module assembly sets up the one side at two lenses, at least partial display module assembly is towards the clearance between two lenses, and display module assembly is used for sending light signal to the clearance towards the part in clearance, light is to changing the module and setting up between two lenses, light is to changing the module and is used for changing light signal into the first light signal to first lens direction transmission, light is to changing the module and still is used for changing first light signal into the second light signal to second lens direction transmission. The display device sends the optical signal through one display module, and then changes the module through the light and transmits the optical signal to two lenses, and it can reduce the cost of manufacture of display module to reduce display device's cost of manufacture.

title_en: Internally grooved cam for lens system
abstract_en: A cam for imparting movement to a lens system. The cam may include a body configured to be coupled to a lens system. The body may have a slot configured to receive the lens follower. The grooves may extend in converging directions relative to each other.

title_en: Laser pulse width compression system with preset space chirp
abstract_en: The utility model provides a preset space chirp's laser pulse width compression system, includes space chirp generator, and along the first optics telescopic beam expander that this space chirp generator produced space chirp laser direction placed in proper order, near field facula corrector, second optics telescopic beam expander, first laser energy amplifier, & gt, N optical telescopic beam expander, M laser energy amplifier, & gt, terminal optics telescopic beam expander and space chirp type grating compressor; the space chirp generator is used for enabling different spectral components of the laser pulse to be distributed at different positions of the cross section of the light beam, and a specific space chirp proportion is formed. The invention can fully utilize the grating surface area, obviously increase the energy load of the grating compressor, reduce the beam energy loss of the grating compressor caused by the limited grating size, and further improve the upper limit of the output peak power of the laser chirped pulse amplifying device.

title_en: Method for establishing reference optical axis of large-caliber optical system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for establishing a reference optical axis of a large-caliber optical system. The method comprises the following steps: the laser tracker scans the primary mirror to model and calculate the virtual central axis; adjusting the position of the target ball to meet the virtual central axis space equation; the interferometer marks the central position of the target ball; adjusting the center of the reticle to coincide with the center of a converged light spot of the interferometer to complete the marking of a space point on the virtual central axis; repeating the above operations to finish marking another space point on the virtual central axis; the theodolite is aligned with the centers of the two reticles to determine a reference optical axis. The method can quickly and accurately establish the installation and adjustment reference optical axis for the optical system, provides a reliable and accurate installation and adjustment reference for subsequent installation and adjustment detection work, and is suitable for various optical systems.

title_en: Three-dimensional display device and VR equipment based on virtual operation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a three-dimensional display device based on virtual operation and VR equipment, wherein the VR equipment comprises a VR glasses main body, a lens arranged on the VR glasses main body, a heat dissipation component, a fixing component, a right elastic band and a left elastic band, the heat dissipation component is fixedly embedded on one side of the other side of the VR glasses main body, and one sides of the two sides of the VR glasses main body are respectively and fixedly connected with one end of the right elastic band and one end of the left elastic band through the fixing component. Through setting up radiator unit, thereby the radiating efficiency of VR equipment has been improved, make things convenient for personnel freely to adjust ventilation cooling's degree, the problem of face's perspiration and camera lens fogging has been avoided in the use, the normal use of equipment has been ensured, wearer's comfort level has been improved, set up fixed subassembly, make things convenient for personnel to install and dismantle the head-mounted part, be favorable to the change and the washing of head-mounted part, spot on the reduced head-mounted part has kept the aesthetic property of equipment.

title_en: Display system with single panel optical waveguide and independently adjustable microdisplay array
abstract_en: Display systems having a single panel optical waveguide and an array of individually adjustable micro-displays and related methods are provided. One method comprises the following steps: a first portion of light received from the first microdisplay array is coupled to the first input grating region of the optical waveguide, a second portion of light received from the second microdisplay array is coupled to the second input grating region of the optical waveguide, and a third portion of light received from the third microdisplay array is coupled to the third input grating region of the optical waveguide. The method further comprises the following steps: a first diffracted portion of the first light portion is directed to a first expansion grating, a second diffracted portion of the second light portion is directed to a second expansion grating, and a third diffracted portion of the third light portion is directed to a third expansion grating. The method also includes outputting the combined light using a single output grating.

title_en: Lens driving device, camera module and optical instrument
abstract_en: Disclosed are a lens driving device, a camera module and an optical instrument. The lens driving device includes: a housing; a bobbin disposed in the housing; a base spaced apart from the housing; a first coil disposed on the bobbin; a magnet disposed on the housing and facing the first coil; a second coil disposed on the base and facing the magnet; an upper elastic member connecting the case and the bobbin; and a solder connecting the first coil and the upper elastic member, wherein the upper elastic member includes an inner portion coupled to the bobbin, an outer portion coupled to the case, and a connection portion connecting the inner portion and the outer portion, wherein the inner portion of the upper elastic member includes a first portion including a first hole coupled to the first region of the bobbin, a second portion including a second hole coupled to the second region of the bobbin, and a third portion connecting the first portion and the second portion, and the third portion of the upper elastic member includes a portion connected with the solder.

title_en: Projection system and method of manufacturing the same
abstract_en: The invention provides a projection system and a manufacturing method thereof, wherein the projection system comprises an imaging unit and a projection lens, wherein the imaging unit is arranged at a position facing the projection lens to project light beams, the imaging unit generates images after processing projection signals through digital information and projects the light beams to the projection lens, and the projection lens projects the images in a mode of changing the direction of a light path and amplifying the images by at least twice reflection. The projection system can realize short-distance projection of large-size images and effectively correct the problems of chromatic aberration, distortion and the like. Compared with the traditional short-focus projection system, the projection system has smaller projection ratio, meets the requirement of projecting a large picture at a shorter distance, and reduces the influence of space limitation.

title_en: Light detection system
abstract_en: The optical scanning device is provided with: an optical waveguide array including a plurality of optical waveguides each for propagating light along a 1 st direction, the plurality of optical waveguides being arranged in a 2 nd direction intersecting the 1 st direction and emitting light beams; a phase shifter array including a plurality of phase shifters connected to the plurality of optical waveguides, respectively; a control circuit for controlling the direction and shape of the light beam emitted from the optical waveguide array by controlling the phase shift amounts of the plurality of phase shifters and/or the input of light to the plurality of phase shifters; a photodetector for detecting the light beam reflected by the object; and a signal processing circuit for generating distance distribution data based on the output of the photodetector.

title_en: Radiation source and device for feeding back emitted radiation to a laser source
abstract_en: The free electron laser (35) comprises feedback means (36) for feeding back the emitted illumination radiation (5).

title_en: Fixture for mounting liquid crystal display
abstract_en: The invention provides a clamp for mounting a liquid crystal display, which relates to the technical field of display screens and comprises a rotating mechanism, wherein the rotating mechanism comprises a first block body and a first spring, fixed rods are fixedly connected to one opposite side of the center of the inner surface of the bottom of the first block body, a first motor is fixedly embedded in the tops of the two fixed rods, an output shaft of the first motor is movably connected with a supporting plate, supporting blocks are fixedly connected to two sides of the top of the first block body, a stretching block is fixedly connected to the right side of the first spring, and a first metal block is fixedly connected to the right side of the stretching block. According to the invention, the situation that display screens with different sizes cannot be fixed is solved by adding the rotating mechanism in the clamp for processing the vehicle-mounted display screen, the situation that the angle is inconvenient to adjust in the traditional process is also solved by driving the supporting plate to select through the first motor, and the situation that original parts of the display screen are possibly damaged is solved through the second spring, the supporting plate and the rubber block.

title_en: Telescopic four-group continuous zooming optical lens, imaging component and mobile phone
abstract_en: The invention discloses a telescopic four-group continuous zoom optical lens, an imaging component and a mobile phone, wherein the telescopic four-group continuous zoom optical lens comprises a lens main body, the lens main body comprises a lens barrel, a zoom lens group and a compensation lens group, the zoom lens group comprises a first lens group, a second lens group and a third lens group, the compensation lens group comprises a fourth lens group, the lens main body is movably arranged, a diaphragm is arranged on the third lens group and is fixed relative to the third lens group so as to be driven by the third lens group, the focal length f  1  of the first lens group, the focal length f  2  of the second lens group, the focal length f  3  of the third lens group, the focal length f  4  of the fourth lens group, the distance d  w12  between the first lens group and the second lens group at the wide angle end, the distance d  t12  between the first lens group and the second lens group at the wide angle end, the distance d  w34  between the third lens group and the fourth lens group at the wide angle end and the distance d  t34  between the third lens group and the fourth lens group at the telephoto end are satisfied by the following relational expression: And The invention is helpful for enriching the application scene of the optical lens.

title_en: Viewing optic with direct active reticle collimation
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to an observation optic. In one embodiment, the present disclosure relates to a viewing optic with an integrated display system. In one embodiment, the present disclosure is directed to a viewing optic having an integrated display system for generating an image that is projected into a first focal plane of the optical system.

title_en: Rear projection screen frame, rear projection splicing wall and gluing method of rear projection screen frame
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rear projection splicing walls, in particular to a rear projection screen frame, a rear projection splicing wall and a gluing method of the rear projection screen frame. A back projection screen frame is used for being bonded with inner glass in a back projection screen, a groove is formed in one end face, in contact with the inner glass, of the screen frame, the surfaces of the highest positions of bosses on two sides of the groove are horizontal, and the highest positions of the bosses on the outer side of the screen frame are different from the highest positions of the bosses on the inner side of the screen frame in height. The structure of the end face where the screen frame is contacted with the inner layer glass is optimized, the bonding area between the screen frame and the inner layer glass is increased through the special structural design of the end face, the bonding effect is improved, and meanwhile, the use of additional connecting materials is not needed.

title_en: Vertical cavity surface emitting laser and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vertical cavity surface emitting laser and a manufacturing method thereof, wherein the vertical cavity surface emitting laser sequentially comprises the following components in a preset direction: the semiconductor device comprises a substrate, a buffer layer, an N electrode contact layer, a first distributed Bragg reflector, a first cladding, a first heterojunction limiting layer, an active region, a second heterojunction limiting layer, a second cladding, an oxidation limiting layer, a second distributed Bragg reflector, a P electrode and an N electrode, wherein the active region comprises a plurality of non-uniform compressive strain quantum wells with different widths; the doping concentration of the N electrode contact layer is higher than that of the substrate and the first distributed Bragg reflector; the N electrode is arranged on the N electrode contact layer to form an epitaxial structure of the N electrode contact layer. The design of the vertical cavity surface emitting laser can realize wide temperature range work of the device, and has the advantages of simple preparation process, good repeatability and low cost.

title_en: Wide field of view polarization switch and method of making liquid crystal optical element with pre-tilt
abstract_en: A switchable optical assembly includes a switchable wave plate configured to be electrically activated and deactivated to selectively change the polarization state of light incident thereon. The switchable waveplate includes first and second surfaces and a first liquid crystal layer disposed between the first and second surfaces. The first liquid crystal layer includes a plurality of liquid crystal molecules that rotate about respective axes parallel to the central axis, wherein the rotation varies with azimuthal angle about the central axis. The switchable waveplate additionally comprises a plurality of electrodes to apply an electrical signal across the first liquid crystal layer.

title_en: Processing method of optical lens complex
abstract_en: The invention provides a processing method of an optical lens complex, and relates to the field of optical lens processing. The processing method of the optical lens complex comprises the following processing flows: s1 raw material primary processing, S2 fine grinding processing, S3 ultrasonic cleaning, S4 vacuum plating antireflection film, S5 composite processing, S6 cylindrical surface repairing and S7 vacuum plating sapphire film. The optical lens wafer and the polaroid wafer are polished with high precision before compounding, and then the antireflection film is plated, so that the influence on light transmission after compounding can be ensured, the optical cement is bonded in a heated environment, then the temperature is raised through clamping, air between gaps can be effectively removed, the wear resistance of a product can be increased through the plated sapphire film, the product is not easy to wear, and the service life of the product is further ensured.

title_en: Optical fiber connector
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optical fiber connector which comprises a quick connector, a sleeve and a wire clamping assembly, wherein the quick connector comprises a shell and an inserting core, a connecting channel is arranged in the shell, the inserting core is inserted in the connecting channel, the end part of the inserting core is exposed out of the shell, the shell is inserted in the sleeve, the end part of the inserting core is also exposed out of the sleeve, the wire clamping assembly is used for fixing a cable connected with the inserting core, and the wire clamping assembly is detachably connected with the sleeve. Through the setting of high-speed connector and card line subassembly, can directly assemble at the scene, peel earlier to the cable and expose optic fibre, then pass the card line subassembly with the cable, optic fibre penetrates in the high-speed connector and is connected with the lock pin, it is intraductal to insert the cover with the high-speed connector card line subassembly that the equipment is good again, card line subassembly is connected with the sleeve pipe, accomplish the equipment of fiber connector and cable promptly, need not be with the help of specific anchor clamps, equipment convenient and fast, high efficiency, also can accomplish according to the circumstances, and is with low costs.

title_en: Optoelectronic oscillator using monolithically integrated multiple quantum well laser and phase modulator
abstract_en: The tunable multimode laser (100) is configured to generate a multimode optical signal (160) at a tuned wavelength. The laser (100) includes a semiconductor optical gain region (110), a feedback region (130), and a phase modulation region (120) between the gain region and the feedback region. Each region may be monolithically integrated. The feedback loop is coupled to the tunable laser (100) to receive the optical signal (160) and includes at least one delay line (450). The delay line (450) may also be monolithically integrated. The output of the delay line (450) is fed back to the tunable multimode laser (100) to provide at least one of self-injection locking and self-phase-locked loop for the multimode tunable laser (100). Each of the optical gain region (110) and the phase modulation region (120) of the laser is biased by the output of the delay line (450) so as to reduce the phase drift of the optical signal (160).

title_en: Coating film forming method and coating film forming apparatus
abstract_en: A coating film having high film thickness uniformity is rapidly formed on the surface of a substrate. The following steps are carried out: a holding step of holding the substrate by the substrate holding section; an air flow forming step of exhausting air around the substrate to form an air flow on the surface of the substrate; a coating liquid supply step of supplying a coating liquid for forming a coating film to the surface of the substrate; a gas flow control step of moving a cover member for covering the substrate from a first position to a second position with respect to the substrate to which the coating liquid is supplied, and forming the gas flow such that a gap formed between the cover member and the surface of the substrate rotated by a first rotation number at the second position is larger in flow rate than when the cover member is positioned at the first position; and a film thickness distribution adjusting step of rotating the substrate at a second rotation speed higher than the first rotation speed to spin off the coating liquid on the peripheral edge of the substrate to adjust the film thickness distribution of the coating film.

title_en: Focal length testing method and compensation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a focal length testing method and a compensation method, wherein the testing method comprises the following steps: setting an initial focal length, focal length stepping and focal length number n at the current temperature; obtaining n focal length strips and a focal length value corresponding to each focal length strip according to the initial focal length and the focal length stepping; and obtaining the optimal focal length value at the current temperature according to the focal length values of the n focal length strips. The invention can test the optimal focal length value at the corresponding temperature aiming at the plate material with the corresponding specification, can compensate the focal length value in real time, and realizes the real-time adjustment of the optimal focal length value of the lens according to the change of the temperature, thereby ensuring the imaging quality of the plate material.

title_en: Metrology data correction using image quality metrics
abstract_en: The present disclosure describes a method for correcting metrology data for a patterning process. The method comprises the following steps: obtaining (P92) (i) metrology data for a substrate undergoing a patterning process (901) and (ii) a quality metric quantifying the quality of the metrology data for the substrate (902, e.g., a focus index); establishing (P94) a correlation between the quality metrics and the metrology data; and determining (P96) a correction to the metrology data based upon a correlation between the quality metrics and the metrology data.

title_en: Microscope system, projection unit, and image projection method
abstract_en: A microscope system (1) is provided with: an eyepiece (104); an objective lens (102) that guides light from the sample to an eyepiece lens (104); and an imaging lens (103) which is disposed on the optical path between the eyepiece (104) and the objective lens (102) and forms an optical image of the sample on the basis of light from the sample. The microscope system (1) further comprises a projection device (133) for projecting the first projection image and the second projection image so as to be distinguishable from each other on an image plane on which the optical image is formed. The first projection image is an image based on the result of analysis of digital image data of a sample by a computer, and the second projection image is an image based on an input operation by a user.

title_en: Display assembly and electronic equipment
abstract_en: In a first aspect, when a preset voltage difference exists between a first viewing angle control electrode and a second viewing angle control electrode in a viewing angle control electrode pair, a liquid crystal layer between the first viewing angle control electrode and the second viewing angle control electrode rotates to form a liquid crystal grating, and emergent rays of other liquid crystal layers except the liquid crystal layer between the first viewing angle control electrode and the second viewing angle control electrode are blocked, so that the liquid crystal layer between the viewing angle control electrode pair forms a liquid crystal light blocking wall, and a peeping prevention function is realized. In the second aspect, the first visual angle control electrode and the second visual angle control electrode are separately arranged, and compared with an electrode for displaying which is used as the visual angle control electrode in a time-sharing multiplexing mode, the peep-proof effect can be improved, and the display effect cannot be reduced.

title_en: Optical device monitoring and calibration system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for monitoring and calibrating an optical device, wherein the system and the method for monitoring and calibrating the optical device comprise the following steps: an optical device to be tested and a monitoring device; the optical device to be tested is connected with an input waveguide and an output waveguide; the monitoring device comprises a first monitoring waveguide and a second monitoring waveguide; the first monitoring waveguide is provided with an input grating for inputting an optical signal; the second monitoring waveguide is provided with an output grating for outputting optical signals; a first polymer is arranged between the first monitoring waveguide and the input waveguide, so that the first monitoring waveguide is coupled and conducted with the input waveguide; a second polymer is arranged between the second monitoring waveguide and the output waveguide, so that the second monitoring waveguide is coupled and conducted with the output waveguide; and monitoring and/or calibrating the optical device to be tested according to the optical signal input by the input grating and the optical signal output by the output grating. The problem that monitoring and calibration of individual optical devices in a large-scale optical network are lacked in the prior art is solved.

title_en: Adjustable optical fiber polarization collimating lens
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of optical equipment, in particular to an adjustable optical fiber polarization collimating lens. The device comprises a shell, and a collimation module and a polarization beam splitting module which are arranged in the shell, wherein the shell comprises a base and a heat dissipation shell, the heat dissipation shell is arranged on the base, an optical fiber interface is arranged on one side of the heat dissipation shell, and the collimation module and the polarization beam splitting module are arranged on the base and are coaxial with the optical fiber interface; the installation positions of the collimation module and the polarization beam splitting module can be adjusted, and the coaxiality of the collimation module and the polarization beam splitting module is realized. The invention can ensure the coaxiality of optical components of optical fibers, collimation modules, polarization beam splitting modules and the like in the lens; the mounting mode of the polarization beam splitting cube is glue-free and screw-free contact lenses, so that the influence caused by glue deformation and the damage of the screws on the lenses due to the fact that the screws press the lenses can be avoided, optical fiber beam collimation is achieved, and the polarization state is adjustable.

title_en: Fixing belt, fixing device, and image forming apparatus
abstract_en: The application relates to a fixing belt, a fixing device and an image forming apparatus. The fixing belt includes: a ring-shaped polyimide resin base material layer having a lower imidization rate on the outer peripheral surface than in the central portion in the thickness direction; a metal layer provided on the outer peripheral surface of the polyimide resin substrate layer; and an elastic layer provided on an outer peripheral surface of the metal layer.

title_en: High-resolution lateral imaging miniature endoscopic microscope objective group and probe
abstract_en: The invention relates to a miniature endoscopic microscope objective group and a probe for high-resolution lateral imaging, which comprise a first prism, a first lens, a second lens, a third lens, a fourth lens and an imaging surface which are sequentially arranged from an object side, wherein each lens of the miniature microscope objective group is provided with parameters which are matched with each other, so that when the clear aperture of the miniature microscope objective group is smaller than 0.8mm, the working distance is 40-80 mu m under the wavelength of 488nm, the magnification is 1.9-2.1, and the visual field can reach 290 mu m. The lateral imaging miniature endoscopic microscope objective group can observe the tissue structure of the side wall of a narrow pancreatic duct, and can better cooperate with an optical fiber bundle to observe tissue cells by utilizing a confocal technology.

title_en: Heat dissipation structure and electronic device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a heat radiation structure, install in electronic device, electronic device includes the camera module, heat radiation structure includes a heat dissipation main part, locate the sealed chamber in the heat dissipation main part and seal up the heat transfer medium in sealed chamber, sealed chamber includes an evaporation zone and the condensation segment that communicates with the evaporation zone, heat radiation structure is still including connecting in the connecting plate of evaporation zone, the connecting plate is used for fixed camera module, make the heat transfer to the connecting plate of camera module production, the connecting plate is with heat transfer to evaporation zone, heat transfer medium absorbs the heat and the gasification gets into the condensation segment at the evaporation zone, heat transfer medium after the gasification liquefies and gives off the heat outside electronic device at the condensation segment. The heat dissipation structure provided by the invention can quickly take away the heat generated by the camera module, and avoids the problem of reduced imaging quality caused by the deformation of the photosensitive chip due to heating or the change of the density of the internal air. In addition, the invention also provides an electronic device with the heat dissipation structure.

title_en: Augmented reality display device and near-to-eye display equipment
abstract_en: The application provides an augmented reality display device and near-to-eye display equipment. The augmented reality display device includes a waveguide substrate, an incoupling grating, a turning grating, and an outcoupling grating. The coupling grating is carried on the waveguide substrate, and couples light into the waveguide substrate, wherein a grating vector of the coupling grating is a first vector K1. The turning grating is supported on the waveguide substrate, and expands the pupil of the light coupled into the waveguide substrate by the coupling grating, wherein the grating vector of the turning grating is the second vector K2. The coupled grating is supported on the waveguide substrate, receives the light after the pupil expansion of the turning grating, and couples the light out of the waveguide substrate, and the grating vector of the coupled grating is a third vector K3, wherein K1, K2 and K3 form a closed vector triangle, and when the augmented reality display device is used, the range of the angle a between the direction of K3 and the horizontal direction X is: a is more than or equal to 45 degrees and less than or equal to 45 degrees. The application discloses augmented reality display device can reduce and even avoid rainbow line phenomenon.

title_en: Camera lens
abstract_en: The application discloses camera lens includes following order from object side to image side along the optical axis: a first lens, a second lens, a third lens, a fourth lens, a fifth lens, a sixth lens, a seventh lens, an eighth lens, a ninth lens, and a tenth lens; wherein the seventh lens has positive focal power; the eighth lens has positive focal power; the object side surface of the ninth lens is a concave surface, and the image side surface of the ninth lens is a convex surface; the half ImgH of the diagonal length of the effective pixel region on the imaging surface of the imaging lens satisfies: ImgH >6 mm.

title_en: Preparation method of dispersion-controllable large-bandwidth chirped fiber grating
abstract_en: A method for preparing a dispersion controllable large-bandwidth chirped fiber grating comprises the following steps: hydrogen-carrying sensitization treatment optical fiber refrigerating chamber preservation; fitting a corresponding loss gain spectrum curve in a communication bandwidth based on a data fitting principle according to transmission loss or gain spectra in different optical fiber communication systems; calculating the reflectivity and the effective refractive index corresponding to each wavelength according to the loss gain spectrum curve, thereby finally and accurately obtaining the dispersion value at each wavelength; guiding the power intensity, wavelength, loss value and dispersion value of the reflected light into fiber grating writing light source control driving software to generate an exposure writing curve function; preparing a chirped fiber grating by using an ultraviolet mask engraving grating system; the fiber grating can carry out filtering or dispersion compensation on a large-bandwidth optical signal according to the 5G communication requirement.

title_en: High-isolation multi-wavelength transceiver and preparation process thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-isolation multi-wavelength transceiver, which comprises an outer sealing metal tube and two groups of optical devices which are longitudinally arranged, wherein each optical device comprises an outer tube body, a single-fiber collimator, an inner tube body, a graded index lens, a filter and four-fiber optical fiber heads, the filter, the graded index lens and the four-fiber optical fiber heads are sequentially and coaxially connected, each four-fiber optical fiber head comprises four optical fibers, a first input port, a second output port, a third input port and a fourth output port are respectively arranged from top to bottom, the second output ports of the two groups of four-fiber optical fiber heads are welded with the tail of the third input port, and the fourth output port of the upper four-fiber optical fiber head is welded with the tail of the first input port of the lower four-fiber optical head. The invention also discloses a preparation process of the high-isolation multi-wavelength transceiver, and the product prepared by the invention has high reliability and solves the problem of interference between wavelengths caused by insufficient isolation of the filter.

title_en: Optical coupling assembly, optical communication device and optical coupling method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of optical communication equipment, and provides an optical coupling assembly, an optical communication device and an optical coupling method, wherein the optical coupling assembly comprises a substrate with a mounting surface, a carrier with a bearing surface and a photoelectric conversion chip with an optical port, the mounting surface of the substrate is provided with an optical fiber fixing seat, the optical fiber fixing seat is provided with an extending port for extending an optical fiber towards the direction of the photoelectric conversion chip, the carrier is arranged on the mounting surface of the substrate, the bearing surface of the carrier and the mounting surface of the substrate are mutually perpendicular, the photoelectric conversion chip is arranged on the bearing surface of the carrier, the optical port of the photoelectric conversion chip and the extending port of the optical fiber fixing seat are oppositely arranged, the optical coupling assembly does not need to be additionally provided with a lens, and the optical coupling between the optical fiber and the photoelectric conversion chip is realized by adopting a passive alignment mode.

title_en: Wide-angle lens
abstract_en: A wide-angle lens is provided, which can easily correct various aberrations such as curvature of field, chromatic aberration of magnification, coma aberration, etc., and can easily realize miniaturization of the whole wide-angle lens. A wide-angle lens according to the present invention includes, in order from an object side, a first lens, a second lens, a third lens, a fourth lens, a stop, a fifth lens, a sixth lens, and a seventh lens, wherein the first lens is a negative lens having a concave image-side lens surface, the second lens is a negative lens having a concave image-side lens surface, the third lens is a positive lens having a convex image-side lens surface, the fourth lens is a positive lens having a convex image-side lens surface, the fifth lens is a positive lens, the sixth lens is a negative lens, the seventh lens is a positive lens, and when a focal distance of the third lens is f3 and a focal distance of the entire wide-angle lens is f, the following relationships are satisfied: 3.000 < f3/f < 12.500.

title_en: Optical imaging system
abstract_en: The present application provides an optical imaging system comprising: a first lens; a second lens; a third lens; a fourth lens having a convex object side surface; a fifth lens having a concave image-side surface; and a sixth lens, wherein the first lens to the sixth lens are disposed in order from the object side to the imaging surface. The F-number of the optical imaging system is 1.7 or less.

title_en: Wavelength division multiplexing three-dimensional display system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wavelength division multiplexing three-dimensional display system which comprises a projection module, a light splitting module, a diffusion module and an imaging module, wherein the projection module is used for emitting projection image light to the light splitting module, the light splitting module is used for separating light with different wavelengths in the projection image light emitted by the projection module in space, the separated projection image light reaches the imaging module after passing through the diffusion module, and the imaging module is used for forming the separated projection image light into images with different depths in space. The wavelength division multiplexing three-dimensional display system provided by the invention realizes the great increase of the space bandwidth product of the three-dimensional display system.

title_en: Double-cladding optical fiber laser pumping device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a double-clad fiber laser pumping device, and belongs to the technical field of laser. The optical fiber comprises an optical fiber, wherein the optical fiber comprises a signal optical fiber section and an output optical fiber section, wherein the signal optical fiber section is an input optical fiber section; the gain body is provided with a gain cavity and a light through port penetrating through the gain cavity and the gain body, and the inner surface of the gain cavity is an optical surface or a light reflecting surface; the optical fiber further comprises a fiber core section for connecting the signal fiber section and the output fiber section, and the fiber core section is positioned in the gain cavity. According to the invention, the stripped fiber core is placed in the cavity, and multiple volumes of light pass through the fiber core through repeated reflection, so that the pumping efficiency is increased.

title_en: Optical connector and module thereof
abstract_en: The present invention provides an optical connector, which includes a connector body and a first adjuster. The connector body is provided with a first end face for being inserted into the socket and a second end face which is positioned at the other side of the connector body and corresponds to the first end face.
