The first adjustment member is disposed on a first side of the connector body and has a first end portion located on a second end face side. The first adjusting piece is used for enabling the connector body inserted into the socket to exit from the socket through position adjusting movement. In another embodiment, the present invention further provides an optical connector module, which includes a receptacle and a combination of optical connectors, and can be applied to various devices for communication.

title_en: Optical imaging lens
abstract_en: The application discloses an optical imaging lens, it includes from the object side to the image side along the optical axis in order: a diaphragm; the image side surface of the first lens is a convex surface; a second lens having an optical power; a third lens with positive focal power, the image side surface of which is concave; a fourth lens with focal power, wherein the image side surface of the fourth lens is convex; and a fifth lens having optical power. The effective focal length f2 of the second lens and the effective focal length f3 of the third lens satisfy: 1.0 < | f3/f2| < 5.0; and the central thickness CT4 of the fourth lens on the optical axis and the edge thickness ET4 of the fourth lens satisfy: 2.0 < CT4/ET4 < 4.0. At least one mirror surface of the object side surface of the first lens to the image side surface of the fifth lens is an aspherical mirror surface.

title_en: Split AR display device and display method
abstract_en: The application relates to a split AR display device and a display method, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the computing processing module acquires environment information of the environment where the AR display equipment is located through the information acquisition module, processes the environment information to obtain environment signals, transmits the environment signals to the computing processing device through the interface module, processes the environment signals to obtain first display signals, the DP-MIPI interface element processes the first display signals to obtain second display signals, the computing processing module controls logic operation driven by the optical waveguide to process the second display signals into image signals, and the image signals are displayed on the display element.

title_en: Moving body periphery monitoring device
abstract_en: The panoramic imaging apparatus is provided with a panoramic imaging lens (12), wherein the panoramic imaging lens (12) is formed by a light-transmitting raw material, is formed in a manner of rotating symmetry around an optical axis at the center of the lens, and is provided with a light incidence surface (14) on the side, through which light can enter from the whole circumference of 360 degrees orthogonal to the optical axis. The panoramic imaging apparatus (10) is provided with an imaging element (24) and a relay lens (22), wherein the imaging element (24) captures an image (36) formed by entering the panoramic imaging lens (12), the relay lens (22) is arranged between the panoramic imaging lens (12) and the imaging element (24), and the light entering the panoramic imaging lens (12) forms an image on the imaging element (24). A movable body periphery monitoring device capable of monitoring a wide range of the periphery of a movable body with a simple configuration is provided with a mirror (28), and the mirror (28) is disposed in one direction of a 360 DEG field of view of a panoramic imaging device (10) and guides light from the periphery in the optical axis direction to a part of a light incident surface (14) of a panoramic imaging lens (12).

title_en: Silicon quantum dot photoresist, color film layer, OLED display structure and display
abstract_en: The application discloses a silicon quantum dot photoresist, a color film layer, an OLED display structure and a display, wherein the OLED display structure comprises a photoinitiator, a phenolic resin derivative and a diazonaphthol derivative, and further comprises single-color silicon quantum dots; the single-color silicon quantum dots account for 2-7% of the total mass of the photoinitiator, the phenolic resin derivative and the diazonaphthol derivative. According to the technical scheme provided by the embodiment of the application, the silicon quantum dots which are free of heavy metal elements, good in optical property and good in chemical stability are used as quantum dot light emitting units and introduced into the photoresist, so that the use of the heavy metal quantum dots is avoided in the preparation process, and the photoresist is more environment-friendly. The organic light emitting diode can be applied to display devices such as Liquid Crystal Displays (LCDs), organic Light Emitting Diodes (OLEDs) and the like, and can achieve the purpose of color display after being patterned through a photoetching process. The manufactured display device based on the silicon quantum dot color film has higher brightness, wider color gamut and better color purity.

title_en: Device for amplifying laser time domain light splitting by repetition frequency chirp pulse and implementation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device for amplifying laser time domain light splitting by repetition frequency chirp pulse and an implementation method thereof. The invention adds a light splitting optical returning device and a light splitting device in a CPA system, puts a stretcher into the light splitting optical returning device, places the light splitting device between a first amplifier and a second amplifier, separates pulse spaces at different time by the light splitting optical returning device, and respectively transmits the pulses to two compressors by the light splitting device; the light splitting light returning device adopts a first Pockels cell and a second Pockels cell to control the polarization state of the pulse, and is matched with the polarization light splitting mirror to control the path of the pulse; the first pulse is widened twice, so that the width of the pulse is longer, and the pulse is suitable for higher energy amplification; the second pulse is widened through a stretcher once, the pulse width is relatively short, the low-energy amplification is suitable, the double-grating distance of the first compressor is short, the grating size can be reduced, and the cost is reduced, so that one CPA system can be simultaneously input into a plurality of target ranges for use, and the laser utilization rate is improved.

title_en: Image pickup lens group
abstract_en: The invention provides a camera lens group. The image pickup lens group sequentially comprises from an object side to an image side along an optical axis: a first lens having an optical power; a second lens having a negative optical power; a third lens having a focal power; the fourth lens with focal power, the object side surface of the fourth lens is a concave surface, and the image side surface of the fourth lens is a convex surface; a fifth lens having a negative optical power; a sixth lens having optical power; the seventh lens with focal power, the object side surface of the seventh lens is a convex surface, and the image side surface of the seventh lens is a concave surface; the axial distance BFL from the image side surface of the seventh lens to the imaging surface of the camera lens group meets the following requirements: 3mm and BFL are respectively woven in a fabric layer of 5mm; the on-axis distance TTL from the object side surface of the first lens to the imaging surface of the camera lens group and the on-axis distance BFL from the image side surface of the seventh lens to the imaging surface of the camera lens group satisfy the following conditions: 3 and are woven with TTL/BFL <4. The invention solves the problem that the telescopic function of the mobile phone lens in the prior art cannot be realized.

title_en: Projector cooling method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a projector cooling method and a system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining an input signal of a target projector, obtaining the current power of the target projector from the input signal, confirming whether the target projector needs to be cooled according to the current power, if so, generating a cooling request, sending the cooling request to a terminal where a user is located, receiving an execution instruction sent by the user, and selecting a cooling mode according to the execution instruction to cool the target projector, wherein the cooling mode comprises auxiliary cooling and self cooling. Whether the working temperature of the projector is abnormal or not can be judged more quickly and accurately from the working parameters of the projector by judging whether the projector needs to be cooled or not according to the current power of the projector to replace a temperature sensor in the traditional technology, and the method is accurate and efficient. Different cooling methods can be provided according to the requirements of users, so that the experience of the users is improved, and meanwhile, the effective cooling work of the projector can be realized.

title_en: Single-mode optical fiber with large fiber core diameter
abstract_en: The invention provides a single-mode optical fiber with a large fiber core diameter, which is mainly characterized in that: comprising a core, an inner cladding and an outer cladding, wherein: the fiber core is used for absorbing the pump light and converting the pump light into signal light, rare earth elements and other co-doped elements are doped in the fiber core, and the refractive index of the fiber core is lower than that of the inner cladding material; the inner cladding wraps the fiber core, the main material of the inner cladding is pure quartz glass or other doped quartz glass, and two air holes are distributed in the inner cladding; the outer cladding layer wraps the inner cladding layer and consists of a circle of air holes which are tightly arranged and surround the inner cladding layer.

title_en: Three-dimensional display module assembly that optical waveguide sagittal is shaded
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional display module with optical waveguide sagittal backlight, which consists of a time sequence light source optical waveguide sagittal backlight component, a wave surface conversion device, a display device and other components, wherein the time sequence light source optical waveguide sagittal backlight component comprises more than one time sequence switch light source, a relay device and an optical waveguide device. The time-sequence switch light sources project corresponding sagittal light to the display device in sequence through the relay device, the optical waveguide device and other components, and the eyes of an observer receive modulated light information from the display device. The sequential light source light waveguide sagittal backlight component controls the sagittal direction of incident light beams of all pixels of the display device, and the incident light beams are modulated by corresponding pixels to enter pupils of an observer, so that the problem of focusing-converging conflict inherent in the traditional three-dimensional display is solved. The introduction of the optical waveguide device realizes the sagittal backlight assembly with a thin structure, so that the optical waveguide sagittal backlight three-dimensional display module disclosed by the invention can be applied to various portable display terminals, such as mobile phones, iPads, head-mounted VR/AR and the like.

title_en: Optimization method for improving photoetching defect caused by water adsorption of photoetching front layer film
abstract_en: The invention provides an optimization method for improving photoetching defects caused by water adsorption of a photoetching front layer film, which comprises the steps of determining the thickness T of a standard SOC coating to be sprayed on a wafer substrate; spraying a first SOC coating with C1 spraying quantity on a wafer substrate; then baking the first SOC coating, wherein the thickness of the formed first SOC coating is T1; performing surface treatment on the first SOC coating by using a solvent or oxygen-containing plasma; spraying a second SOC coating with C2 spraying quantity on the first SOC coating; then baking the second SOC coating layer, wherein the thickness of the formed second SOC coating layer is T2, and t=t1+t2; and coating an anti-reflection coating on the second SOC coating, spin-coating a photoresist coating on the anti-reflection coating, and exposing, developing and etching the photoresist coating through a mask plate to form a required pattern. The invention reduces the influence on lithography and etching. The aim of saving cost is achieved, and the influence of the adsorption substance of the front layer film on the photoresist defect is greatly reduced.

title_en: Three-piece coupling device and coupling method
abstract_en: The invention discloses three-piece coupling equipment, which comprises a substrate, a first movement module, a second movement module, a third movement module and a coupling jig table, wherein the first movement module, the second movement module, the third movement module and the coupling jig table are connected with the substrate; the first motion module is connected with a first electric clamping jaw, a first suction nozzle, a first curing device and a power supply assembly; the second motion module is connected with a second electric clamping jaw, a second suction nozzle and a second curing device; the third motion module is connected with a vision shooting assembly and a dispensing assembly; the upper end surface of the coupling jig table is provided with a first tray jig, a second tray jig, a PCB carrier and a light detection assembly; the three-piece coupling equipment provided by the invention can greatly improve the coupling efficiency under the condition of ensuring that the coupling product has better yield.

title_en: Optical fiber sensor and light intensity loss value calculation and analysis method and device thereof
abstract_en: A method for calculating and analyzing a light intensity loss value of an optical fiber sensor comprises the following steps: (S101) acquiring the characteristic relation of the gain adjusting signal and the characteristic relation of the light intensity adjusting signal; (S102) calculating a light intensity loss value in the optical fiber according to the characteristic relationship of the gain adjustment signal and the characteristic relationship of the light intensity adjustment signal; and analyzing the parameter to be measured according to the light intensity loss value. The invention makes the light intensity adjusting signal and the gain adjusting signal not need to be involved when the following signal processing and pattern recognition algorithm analysis, reduces the complexity of algorithm design, simultaneously removes the coupling of algorithm analysis, light intensity adjustment and gain adjustment, and only needs to readjust the synthesis model of the light intensity attenuation signal without changing the following algorithm design when changing the hardware or software method of light intensity adjustment and gain adjustment. Also discloses a light intensity loss value calculation and analysis device of the optical fiber sensor.

title_en: Drive control circuit of light modulation glass and light modulation glass
abstract_en: A drive control circuit (10) of dimming glass comprises an input circuit (11), a first conversion unit (13), a second conversion unit (14) and a control unit (15). The input circuit (11) is used for receiving a first alternating current power supply. The first conversion unit (13) is electrically connected to the input circuit (11) for converting the first alternating current power supply into a first direct current power supply. The second conversion unit (14) is electrically connected with the first conversion unit (13) to convert the first direct current power supply into a second alternating current power supply, and the second alternating current power supply is used for driving the dimming glass body (20). The control unit (15) is electrically connected with the first conversion unit and the second conversion unit and used for controlling the first conversion unit (13) to convert the first alternating current power supply into the first direct current power supply according to the control signal, the second conversion unit (14) provides the corresponding second alternating current power supply to drive the dimming glass according to the first direct current power supply, different control signals correspond to different first direct current power supplies and different second alternating current power supplies, and different second alternating current power supplies correspond to different transparencies of the dimming glass body (20).

title_en: Optical fiber of MPO/MTP type connector and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optical fiber of an MPO/MTP type connector, which comprises connectors fixed at two ends of the optical fiber, wherein the connectors are fixed at two ends of the optical fiber through fixing devices; the fixing device comprises a supporting table, a fixing cap and a fixing rod; the fixed rod penetrates through the top of the inlet end of the connector through the fixed inlet; the fixing cap is connected with the supporting table through a locking device; the fixed cap is welded with a protective layer of the optical fiber; both sides of the fixing cap are arranged through the bottom surface of the inlet end of the connector through the fixing through hole; the invention also provides a preparation method of the optical fiber of the MPO/MTP type connector, which comprises the following steps: s1, carrying out hot melting on the raw materials, and carrying out multi-stage cooling on the composite coolant to obtain a fixed assembly; s2, preparing a fixing device and a locking device; s3 preparing the optical fiber of MPO/MTP type connector; the invention has the beneficial effects that: through fixing device, utilize locking device to realize the swing joint of locking cap and brace table, the butt fusion between rethread locking cap and the protective layer realizes firmly fixing.

title_en: Optical imaging lens
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optical imaging lens which sequentially comprises a first lens with positive focal power, a second lens with a convex object side and a concave image side along an optical axis from the object side to the image side, a third lens with negative focal power, a fourth lens, a fifth lens with negative focal power, a sixth lens with positive focal power and a seventh lens with negative focal power, wherein the distance TTL between a half of the diagonal length of an effective pixel area on the imaging surface and the axial distance TTL between the object side of the first lens and the imaging surface is 4.8mm < ImgH, imgH/TTL is less than 7.0mm, and the chromatic dispersion coefficient V1 of the first lens is 70< V1<90. According to the optical imaging lens provided by the invention, the Abbe number is improved, the chromatic aberration of the system is optimized and improved by improving the material of the first lens, and the problem of purple fringing is solved in the shooting process of a high-pixel mobile phone.

title_en: Intelligent glasses
abstract_en: The application discloses intelligent glasses. This intelligent glasses includes: a glasses body; the sound output module is arranged in the glasses main body and used for outputting sound; and the AR module is arranged in the glasses main body and is used for realizing the AR function. The utility model provides an intelligence glasses not only can realize the AR function, but also can output sound, for the intelligence glasses that only can realize the AR function, the function is comparatively abundant.

title_en: Single-fiber-core beak-shaped optical fiber tweezers with sorting function and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The single-fiber-core beak-shaped optical fiber tweezers system with the sorting function is characterized in that the optical fiber optical tweezers are composed of a beak-shaped optical fiber probe, a laser, an adjusting frame, a sample groove and a microscopic imaging system. The beak-shaped optical fiber probe is characterized in that the distribution of evanescent fields on the side surface of the optical fiber is changed by adjusting the curvature radius of a bent tip area of the optical fiber, so that a differential gradient optical field is formed. The gradient force of cells with different volumes at different positions in the gradient optical field is different, and the magnitude of the optical trapping force is also different, so that the optical tweezers can realize the controllable screening of the cell volume.

title_en: Display panel and display device
abstract_en: A display panel and a display device, the display panel includes: a front frame (1) and a printed circuit board protective case (14), the front frame (1) including a first front frame portion (101) and a second front frame portion (102) extending in a display panel length direction; a third front frame part (103) and a fourth front frame part (104) extending in the width direction of the display panel; the first front frame part (101) and the second front frame part (102) are arranged oppositely; the third front frame part (103) and the fourth front frame part (104) are arranged oppositely and are connected between the first front frame part (101) and the second front frame part (102); the printed circuit board protective housing (14) is connected with the first front frame part (101) and the second front frame part (102) in a clamping way to form an integrated structure.

title_en: Lens and eyewear
abstract_en: The lens is composed of: a lens body; and an internal electrode attached to the lens body and at least partially exposed at an outer edge portion of the lens body, wherein a shape of a first region including an exposed portion where the internal electrode is exposed is different from a shape of a second region not including the exposed portion at the outer edge portion of the lens body. Thus, a lens which can be easily attached to a lens frame is provided.

title_en: Terahertz optical fiber based on bionic material
abstract_en: The terahertz optical fiber based on the bionic material comprises a hollow core area for transmitting terahertz waves, wherein a waveguide wall is arranged outside the hollow core area, and a plurality of conductive particles are doped in the waveguide wall. According to the terahertz wave transmission device, low-loss transmission of terahertz waves can be achieved, and doped conductive particles are uniformly or non-uniformly distributed in the waveguide wall, so that compared with a continuous metal wire in the prior art, the terahertz wave transmission device has smaller influence on flexibility of the waveguide wall, bending characteristics of the optical fiber are remarkably improved, the optical fiber can achieve bending waveguide characteristics to a certain degree, and interfaces of terahertz waves at different positions are connected according to requirements. In addition, terahertz wave transmission of different frequency bands can be realized by adjusting the doping mass ratio, the arrangement mode and the shape of the conductive particles, and the adjustment is mainly based on the proportioning change of raw materials and the adjustment of additive manufacturing process parameters, so that large-scale production can be realized on the premise of not changing a production line.

title_en: Silicon optical multichannel parallel optical component and coupling method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of optical communication, and provides a silicon optical integrated chip which comprises a transmitting input waveguide unit, a splitter unit, a modulator unit, a transmitting output waveguide unit, a receiving input waveguide unit and a receiving detector unit which are integrated in the chip. A silicon optical multi-channel parallel optical assembly is also provided. A coupling method of the silicon optical multi-channel parallel optical component is also provided. The invention adopts an integrated silicon optical chip, the transmitting part still adopts two paths of direct current laser groups, the receiving chip is integrated in the silicon optical chip, the optical interface adopts FA-MPO which is mature in the industry, and the invention has the advantages of mature process, high integration degree, relatively lower cost, less coupling procedures and the like, and is one of the advantages of the speed of more than 400G.

title_en: Optical system and image pickup apparatus having the same
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optical system and an image pickup apparatus having the same. The optical system includes, in order from an object side to an image side, a front unit of positive refractive power, an aperture, and a rear unit of positive refractive power. The front unit includes a positive lens L11, a positive lens L12, and a negative lens L13 in order from the object side to the image side. The rear unit includes, in order from the object side to the image side, a negative lens L21, a positive lens L22, and a positive lens L23. The predetermined condition is satisfied.

title_en: Water-blocking material for communication optical cable and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of communication optical cables, and discloses a plastic film, wherein waterproof cloth is wrapped inside the plastic film, non-woven fabric is bonded on the outer surface of the waterproof cloth, waterproof paint is coated on the outer surface of the non-woven fabric, and fireproof asbestos is filled between the waterproof cloth and the plastic film. The plastic film has good waterproof effect and low cost, the fireproof and flame retardant performance of the optical fiber is improved through the arranged fireproof asbestos, the use safety of the optical fiber is improved, the outer surface of the non-woven fabric is provided with the waterproof coating, the polyurethane emulsion is solidified after being contacted with moisture in the air, a layer of firm and tough seamless integral waterproof film is formed on the surface of a base layer, and the waterproof coating adopts a polyvinyl alcohol adhesive and an adhesive prepared by taking a polyvinyl alcohol aqueous solution as a bonding material, so that the waterproof coating on the non-woven fabric cannot fall off powder and is firmly bonded.

title_en: Virtual reality glasses for design
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electronic equipment, and particularly relates to virtual reality glasses for design, which comprise an imaging mechanism and a heating mechanism, wherein the heating mechanism is arranged at the rear part of the imaging mechanism, the imaging mechanism comprises a shell, a docking station, lenses, binding bands, connecting buckles, shading cloth and a radiating plate, the docking station is arranged at the front part of one side of the shell, the binding bands are connected to the middle parts of the two sides of the shell through the connecting buckles, the lenses are arranged in the shell, the radiating plate is arranged on the lower surface of the shell, and the shading cloth part is lined in the radiating plate. The invention adopts the arrangement of the docking station to lead the external equipment to be connected with the glasses, ensures the safety of the glasses when being used for a long time, does not damage elements due to overhigh temperature, and simultaneously can protect the eyes of a wearer from being over-tired under the action of the heating wires.

title_en: Large-image-surface athermal optical imaging lens
abstract_en: The invention discloses a large-image-surface athermalization-free optical imaging lens which comprises a first lens, a second lens, a third lens, a fourth lens and a fifth lens, wherein the first lens, the second lens and the third lens are arranged in parallel; the first lens to the eleventh lens respectively comprise an object side surface and an image side surface; the first lens has positive refractive index; the second lens has negative refractive index; the third lens element has negative refractive index; the fourth lens element has positive refractive index; the fifth lens element has positive refractive index; the sixth lens element has positive refractive index; the seventh lens element has a negative refractive index; the eighth lens element has positive refractive index; the ninth lens element has positive refractive index; the tenth lens element has a negative refractive index; the eleventh lens element has positive refractive index; the lens has only the eleven lens elements with the refractive index. The field angle of the invention can reach 70 degrees, the size of an imaging surface is ∅ 11mm, the optical distortion is controlled within 2.1 percent, the deformation quantity corresponding to an image and an object is small, the image is clear and does not deform, the imaging quality is high, and the distortion is not required to be corrected by a later image algorithm; the vertical axis chromatic aberration and the axial chromatic aberration of the lens are small, the field chromatic aberration is small, the color reducibility is good, and the blue-violet phenomenon is not obvious.

title_en: Shock suppression bearing seat of precision lithography machine
abstract_en: The invention provides a shock suppression bearing seat of a precision lithography machine, which comprises a front end sub-seat, a middle main body seat and a tail end maintenance seat which are sequentially arranged in a straight line shape; the front-end light source sub-seat is fixedly arranged on a working site, and the upper surface of the front-end light source sub-seat is used for installing and fixing light source media; the middle main body seat is fixedly arranged on a working site; the tail end maintenance seat is fixedly arranged on a work site, the side edge of the tail end maintenance seat is tightly attached to the side edge of the middle main body seat, the tail end maintenance seat and the front end light source are respectively arranged on two sides of the middle main body seat, and the upper surface of the tail end maintenance seat is used for fixing the wafer processing device. The invention provides a shock suppression bearing seat of a precise photoetching machine, which is purposefully provided with a double-fixing structure and can meet the requirement of fixed installation of the photoetching machine, so that stable and precise production of the photoetching machine can be ensured.

title_en: Method of forming patterned insulating layer on conductive layer and article manufactured using the same
abstract_en: A method for forming a patterned insulating layer on a conductive layer may include: the annular region of the insulating layer covering the perimeter of the opening in the mask is removed by laser ablation. The mask is removed from the conductive layer to remove excess portions of the insulating layer disposed on the mask, whereby the remaining portions of the insulating layer define a patterned insulating layer disposed on a central region of the conductive layer and a peripheral region of the conductive layer surrounding the central region of the conductive layer is not covered by the patterned insulating layer.

title_en: Two-dimensional periodic symmetry grating spectrum filtering optical film
abstract_en: The invention discloses a two-dimensional periodic symmetric spectrum filtering optical film, which relates to the technical field of filtering and comprises a substrate, a two-dimensional grating lattice periodically arranged on the substrate, a covering layer arranged on the grating lattice and a protecting layer arranged on the covering layer, wherein the grating lattice has equal periods along the two-dimensional direction and equal duty ratios along the two-dimensional direction, the grating lattice meets the condition that the diffraction angle of blue-violet light with the incidence of less than 505nm in the air is more than 90 degrees under the condition of vertical incidence along the two-dimensional direction, and the diffraction angle in a waveguide layer formed by the substrate, the grating lattice, the covering layer and the protecting layer is less than 90 degrees. The invention can effectively filter or prevent the damage of the transmission of blue-violet light to human eyes, can efficiently filter two orthogonal polarization states of an incident light source, does not change the polarization state of the incident light due to the isotropic characteristic, and has more efficient filtering effect.

title_en: Laterally tailored current injection for laser diode
abstract_en: A semiconductor laser diode comprising a plurality of layers stacked along a first direction, wherein the plurality of layers comprises: a first plurality of semiconductor layers; an optical waveguide on the first plurality of semiconductor layers, wherein the optical waveguide comprises a semiconductor active region for generating laser light, and wherein the optical waveguide defines a resonant cavity having an optical axis; and a second plurality of semiconductor layers on the optical waveguide region, wherein a resistivity profile of at least one of the plurality of layers varies gradually between a maximum resistivity and a minimum resistivity along a second direction extending orthogonal to the first direction, wherein a distance between the maximum resistivity and the minimum resistivity is greater than at least about 2 microns.

title_en: Large-aperture three-piece optical lens
abstract_en: The invention provides a large-aperture three-piece optical lens, which comprises a first lens with positive focal power, a second lens with negative focal power and a third lens with positive focal power, wherein an S1 surface, an S2 surface, an S3 surface, an S4 surface, an S5 surface and an S6 surface are sequentially arranged, one side of the S6 surface is provided with an S7 surface, an aperture diaphragm is arranged outside the S1 surface or between the S2 surface and the S3 surface, and an vignetting diaphragm is arranged outside the S6 surface; the distance between the aperture stop and the object focus of the lens is | ST-F obj L, the equivalent focal length of the lens is f 0 ，|ST‑F obj |<0.8f 0 (ii) a The diameters from the surface S1 to the surface S6 satisfy d i >0.9d j ；|R 4 |<|R 3 |，|R 5 |<|R 6 I, the equivalent focal length of the first lens is f 1 The equivalent focal length of the third lens is f 3 ，|f 1 ‑f 3 |<0.5*f 1 ；G 45 >G 23 . The invention has simple and stable integral structure and assembly toleranceThe rate is high, and the light distribution brightness can be greatly improved.

title_en: Photomask blank, method for manufacturing photomask, and method for manufacturing display device
abstract_en: The invention provides a photomask blank which can shorten the over etching time when a phase shift film is subjected to wet etching, inhibit the damage of a substrate and form a transfer pattern with good cross section shape, LER and good chemical resistance. The photomask blank is a master for forming a photomask, the photomask is provided with a phase shift film pattern obtained by wet etching a phase shift film on a transparent substrate, the phase shift film is composed of a single layer or multiple layers, and comprises a MoZrSi-based material layer formed by a material containing molybdenum, zirconium, silicon and nitrogen in an atomic ratio of molybdenum to zirconium in the MoZrSi-based material layer is Mo:Zr=1.5:1 to 1:4, and the content ratio of silicon to the total of molybdenum, zirconium and silicon is 70 to 88 atomic%.

title_en: Photomask and method for manufacturing display device
abstract_en: The invention provides a photomask and a method for manufacturing a display device, which have excellent transfer performance of transferring a fine hole pattern on a transfer object by using ultraviolet exposure light for exposure. A photomask for manufacturing a display device, the photomask being used for forming a hole pattern having a dimension Dp of 3 [ mu ] m or less by using ultraviolet exposure light on a transfer object, the photomask having a transfer pattern including the hole pattern on a transparent substrate, the hole pattern in the transfer pattern being composed of a light transmitting portion surrounded by a half tone region, a phase difference theta between the light transmitting portion and the half tone region being substantially 180 degrees with respect to light of a reference wavelength included in the ultraviolet exposure light for exposing the photomask, and a transmittance T of the half tone region with respect to light of the reference wavelength being 10% or more and T being 35% or less.

title_en: Easily-processed sealed carbon dioxide laser tube
abstract_en: The invention discloses an easily-processed sealed-off carbon dioxide laser tube, which comprises a gas storage tube and a core tube, wherein a plurality of core tubes are arranged in parallel; the core tube comprises a discharge tube and a cooling water tube, and the cooling water tube is sleeved outside the discharge tube; electrodes are arranged at two ends of the discharge tube, flanges are processed on tube orifices at the two ends, and the two flanges are arranged in parallel and concentrically; connecting the light paths of the core tubes into a combined discharge light path through a reflector; the flange at the head end of the combined discharge light path is provided with the holophote, the flange at the joint of each section of the combined discharge light path is provided with the reflecting mirror through the mirror seat to carry out light path connection, and the flange at the tail end of the combined discharge light path is provided with the output reflecting mirror.

title_en: Polyvinyl alcohol film and method for producing same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a polyvinyl alcohol film and a method for producing the same. The invention provides a PVA film which can easily manufacture optical films such as polarizing films with thin color spot width and unobvious color spots and a manufacturing method thereof. A PVA film in which, in a distribution of orientation axis angles obtained by measuring the orientation axis angles in the plane of the film at 0.8mm intervals along the width direction of the film, the maximum value of the distance between adjacent peaks is 6cm or less; and a method for producing a PVA film, comprising the steps of: when a PVA film is produced by spraying a film-forming raw solution containing PVA from a spray port of a spraying device onto a support and drying the film, air having an air velocity of 0.3 to 5 m/sec is blown to the sprayed film within 10 seconds after the spraying.

title_en: Liquid crystal aligning agent, liquid crystal alignment film, and liquid crystal display element using same
abstract_en: The invention provides a liquid crystal aligning agent which can form a liquid crystal aligning film with little generation of residual images from residual DC and AC residual images, easy reprocessing and high transmissivity. The liquid crystal aligning agent of the present invention contains: a polymer (A) having a repeating unit represented by the following formula (1); and a polymer (B) having a repeating unit represented by the following formula (2), a repeating unit represented by the following formula (3), a repeat represented by the following formula (4), and a repeating unit represented by the following formula (5). In formulae (2) to (5), X 2 Is a tetravalent organic group derived from an alicyclic acid dianhydride or an aliphatic acid dianhydride, Y 2 Is a divalent organic group represented by the formula (m-1) or (m-2). R 2－5 Is a hydrogen atom or an alkyl group having 1 to 4 carbon atoms. Z 21－51 、Z 22－52 Each independently represents a hydrogen atom or the like, and represents a bonding bond. title_en: Clamping groove for wiring in building and using method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a card slot for wiring in a building and a use method thereof, wherein the card slot comprises the following steps: a base plate for fixing to a wall surface; the two side walls are respectively connected to two opposite sides of the bottom plate and extend towards the same side from the connection part of the two side walls and the bottom plate, so that the two side walls and the bottom plate jointly enclose a channel for accommodating an optical cable, and the channel extends along the lengthwise direction of the bottom plate; an opening along the lengthwise direction of the bottom plate is formed between the two side walls, and the opening is used for allowing the optical cable to enter the channel; at least one section of the side wall is provided with a plurality of notches so that the clamping groove can form a bendable part, the notches penetrate through the side wall along the width direction of the bottom plate, and the notches penetrate through the side wall along the height direction of the bottom plate. The invention can protect the optical cable, avoid the optical cable from being excessively bent and reduce the stress formed by the clamping groove in the bending process.

title_en: Optical fiber transceiver and optical communication module
abstract_en: A fiber optic transceiver comprising: a housing; a plurality of lead frames provided to the housing and protruding outward from the housing; a first circuit board mounted in the housing and electrically connected to the plurality of lead frames; and an optical element disposed on the first circuit board. The housing includes a ceramic portion formed of ceramic and covered with a metallized film.

title_en: Spectrometer light path structure
abstract_en: A light path structure of a spectrometer is used for processing reflected light reflected by the surface of a measured object modulated by optical fibers of the spectrometer and comprises a first lens group, a dispersion component and a second lens group which are sequentially arranged, wherein the first lens group is used for paralleling the reflected light, the dispersion component is used for dispersing the reflected light, and the second lens group is used for focusing the reflected light after dispersion and eliminating chromatic aberration of the reflected light; and the zoom ratio control of the spectrometer image space and the spectrometer object space is carried out through the cooperation of the first lens group focal length f1 and the second lens group focal length f2, the spectrometer image space is an optical fiber array at the optical fiber light-emitting end of the spectrometer, and the spectrometer image space is a spectral image collected on a camera. The light path structure of the spectrometer can effectively ensure the consistency of the brightness of each channel on the detector.

title_en: Isolated automatic achromatopsia detecting system based on VR glasses
abstract_en: The invention discloses an isolated automatic achromatopsia detecting system based on VR glasses, which comprises a VR glasses body and a central processing module, wherein the VR glasses body is in bidirectional connection with the central processing module, and the central processing module is in bidirectional connection with a detection storage unit, a voice broadcasting unit, a voice recognition unit and a result recording unit respectively. This isolated automatic achromatopsia detecting system that surveys based on VR glasses, carry out achromatopsia through VR equipment and detect, guarantee that only the measurement personnel of detection card can see, thereby avoid the appearance of the condition of practising fraud, and indicate detection requirement and testing result through voice broadcast, make the user can operate under the condition of not knowing words, improve the application range of system, and whole journey detects and adopts the system to handle, when detection efficiency obtains improving, can also avoid the detection error that artifical fatigue leads to, make to detect more high-efficient, convenient.

title_en: Negative photosensitive resin composition, method for producing cured film using same, and touch panel
abstract_en: The invention provides a negative photosensitive resin composition which has high resolution, can form a cured film with high pencil hardness even when cured at a low temperature of 150 ℃ or lower, has excellent chemical resistance and weather resistance, and can inhibit generation of external gassing during electrode or wiring processing. The present invention is a negative photosensitive resin composition comprising: (a) a silicone resin having a radical polymerizable group; (B) a monomer having a radical polymerizable group; and (C) a photo radical polymerization initiator having an absorption peak in a region of wavelengths 350 to 370, wherein the absorbance at wavelength 400 is 10% or less of the absorbance at wavelength 365.

title_en: Motor type double-optical filter switcher
abstract_en: The invention relates to a motor type double-optical filter switcher, which comprises: the fixed slot has been seted up to face lid, face lid top one end, and face lid keeps away from fixed slot one end fixedly connected with spacing boss, and there is the guide rail fixed slot inside through the glue adhesion, and sliding connection has the movable plate on the guide rail, and face lid is close to spacing boss one end fixedly connected with installation round hole, and face lid has the motor through installation round hole joint, and the invention has following advantage: the device is clamped with the motor through the mounting circular hole, so that the position of the motor is limited, and the central verticality of the motor mounting is ensured; the glue is used for fixing the structure, so that the process is simplified, and the material cost is saved; the optical filter is assembled on the back of the movable sheet, so that the lowest focal length of the product is optimized; the mounting round holes on the surface cover are matched with the motor, so that the central verticality of the motor mounting is ensured, and the yield of products is improved; the boss that the inside increases of face lid avoids the camera lens to oppress the movable plate, leads to structural damage, can protect the normal operating of inner part.

title_en: Thermochromic light modulation device and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a thermochromic dimming device and a manufacturing method thereof. The thermochromic dimming device can achieve temperature control of thermochromic materials in the color changing layer by electrifying and heating the electric heating layer, so that the device can actively dim light at will.

title_en: Method for producing thiourethane resin raw material and use thereof, method for producing polythiol composition and use thereof, and polythiol composition
abstract_en: A process for producing a thiourethane resin raw material, which comprises a step of reacting a thiourethane resin with an active hydrogen compound to produce a thiourethane resin raw material, and an application thereof.

title_en: High-precision electronic paper combination equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses electronic paper high accuracy combination equipment relates to the electronic paper field, including base, centre gripping subassembly, removal subassembly, material loading subassembly, feeding subassembly, unloading subassembly and pressing means, remove the subassembly setting in the bottom of base, and remove subassembly and base sliding connection, the centre gripping subassembly is located the bottom of base, and the one end of centre gripping subassembly and the bottom sliding connection of base, and the other pot head of centre gripping subassembly is established on removing the subassembly, the material loading subassembly sets up the one side at the base with the feeding subassembly interval, and the feeding subassembly rotates with the material loading subassembly to be connected, the unloading subassembly sets up the opposite side at the base with the pressing means interval, and the unloading subassembly rotates with the material loading subassembly to be connected. The invention has the advantages that: the electronic paper can be pasted more firmly, and the electronic paper pasting deviation caused by the soft panel structure body is avoided.

title_en: Method for roughly machining 45-degree right-angle prism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for roughly machining a 45-degree right-angle prism, which comprises the following steps of: a. cutting the glass brick into sheets by an inner circle cutting machine according to a drawing; b. the obtained glass sheet is glued on a knife rest of the internal circle cutting machine by wax, and the glass sheet is cut into square strips; c. gluing a glass square strip on a diagonal cutting tool, arranging the glass square strip in a positioning groove, cutting the glass square strip along the diagonal of the glass square strip by a cutting tool bit, and cutting the glass square strip into two triangular prism glass columns along the diagonal; d. grinding the obtained glass column to ensure that the rise is within a specified range; e. the polished glass column is arranged on the cutting tool, the cutting tool is provided with a mounting groove matched with the glass column, the cutter head and the cutter frame are ensured to be vertical during cutting, and the perpendicularity of the cylindrical surface and a cutting surface is ensured by cutting along the cutting groove on the cutting tool. The method for roughly machining the 45-degree right-angle prism can ensure the machining precision, is simple to operate, reduces the machining difficulty and improves the machining efficiency.

title_en: Long-focus visible light continuous zoom lens
abstract_en: The invention relates to a long-focus visible light continuous zoom lens which comprises a front fixed group with positive focal power, a zoom group with negative focal power, a compensation group with positive focal power, a diaphragm and a rear fixed group with positive focal power, wherein the front fixed group, the zoom group with negative focal power, the compensation group with positive focal power, the diaphragm and the rear fixed group with positive focal power are sequentially arranged from an object plane to an image plane along the incident direction of light rays, and the zoom group and the compensation group can axially move along an optical axis. The lens is compact in structure, the focal length variation range is 150 mm-2400 mm, the zoom ratio reaches 16 times, and the imaging target surface is larger than 1 inch.

title_en: Method for preparing micro-core ring cavity by wet silicon etching
abstract_en: A method for preparing a micro-core ring cavity by wet etching silicon comprises the following steps: taking a silicon wafer, wherein the surface of the silicon wafer is a silicon dioxide oxide layer, and obtaining a silicon dioxide disc graph covered with photoresist on the surface of the silicon wafer by using a photoetching and hydrofluoric acid etching method; secondly, performing wet etching on the obtained silicon dioxide disc graph covered with the photoresist by using a hydrofluoric acid-nitric acid mixed solution as an etching solution to obtain a micro disc cavity; and finally, removing the photoresist on the surface of the microdisk cavity, and performing thermal reflux on the microdisk cavity by using a laser to complete the preparation of the micro-core ring cavity. The invention uses hydrofluoric acid-nitric acid etching to replace dry etching in the preparation process, improves isotropy, ensures that the etching method is suitable for preparing the ultra-high quality micro-core ring cavity, and realizes 10 nm at 1550nm waveband 8 The above quality factors are equivalent to those reported in the related art. The invention also has the advantages of low cost, simple etching equipment, easy maintenance and robustness to temperature and humidityGood rod property and the like.

title_en: Composite thin film structure, preparation method thereof and electronic component
abstract_en: The application provides a composite film structure, a preparation method thereof and an electronic component, wherein the composite film structure comprises a substrate layer, a first composite isolation layer formed on the top surface of the substrate layer and at least two film layers formed on the first composite isolation layer; a second isolating layer is arranged between two adjacent thin film layers; the first composite isolation layer comprises at least two stacked sub-isolation layers; the thin film layer is used for transmitting signals, and the first composite isolation layer and the second isolation layer are used for preventing signal leakage. A first composite isolation layer having at least two stacked sub-isolation layers is disposed between the substrate layer and the first thin film layer. Compare in prior art, only adopt the mode of individual layer isolation layer, first compound isolation layer can be with the signal isolation of first thin layer transmission, prevents that the signal from revealing the substrate layer.

title_en: Optical module
abstract_en: The optical module includes a housing, a cover portion closing an opening of the housing, an optical component disposed inside the housing, and a printed circuit board disposed on a front surface of the cover portion outside the housing so as to serve as a board on which a control circuit controlling the optical component is mounted. The optical module further includes: a side electrode disposed on a side surface of the case and configured to be electrically connected to an electrode of the optical component; and a flexible substrate providing electrical connection between the side electrodes and the electrodes of the control circuit. The optical module can be miniaturized by integrating the optical components and the control circuit.

title_en: Liquid crystal display panel and display device
abstract_en: The application provides a liquid crystal display panel and a display device, wherein the liquid crystal display panel comprises a color film substrate and an array substrate, the color film substrate comprises a first substrate and a first electrode layer arranged on the first substrate, the array substrate comprises a second substrate and a second electrode layer arranged on the second substrate, and the distance between the second electrode layer and the first electrode layer is larger than or equal to a threshold value; the threshold is a critical safety distance between the first electrode layer and the second electrode layer for generating arc discharge. The application solves the problems that the antistatic capacity of the existing liquid crystal display panel is weak and the electrode is easily damaged.

title_en: Linear polarization Sagnac total reflection mirror based on double-core optical fiber, method and optical system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a linear polarization Sagnac total reflection mirror based on a double-core optical fiber, a method and an optical system, wherein the Sagnac total reflection mirror comprises the double-core optical fiber with a tapered coupler, and the double-core optical fiber comprises a first fiber core and a second fiber core which are symmetrically distributed on two sides of a neutral axis of the optical fiber; the first 45-degree inclined fiber grating forming an included angle of 135 degrees with the first fiber core is engraved on the first fiber core, the second 45-degree inclined fiber grating forming an included angle of 45 degrees with the second fiber core is engraved on the second fiber core, and the first 45-degree inclined fiber grating and the second 45-degree inclined fiber grating are arranged at the same position along the length direction of the optical fiber. The invention has the characteristic that the Sagnac total reflection mirror is formed by the single mode fiber (namely, the total reflection function is realized), other discrete devices are not needed, and the double-core fiber has the characteristics of fiber integration, small volume, convenience for integration with other functional devices and high stability because the double-core fiber is compared with the single mode fiber.

title_en: Optical fiber connector, transceiver optical receptacle and optical adapter
abstract_en: A reconfigurable fiber optic connector, a transceiver optical receptacle for receiving fiber optic connectors, and an optical adapter are provided, wherein the fiber optic connector is for holding two or more LC-type optical ferrules. The fiber optic connector includes an outer body, an inner front body housing two or more LC-type optical ferrules, a ferrule spring for urging the optical ferrules toward a mating receptacle, and a rear body for supporting the ferrule spring. The outer and inner front bodies are configured such that four LC-type optical ferrules are housed in a small form-factor pluggable (SFP) transceiver footprint or eight LC-type optical ferrules are housed in a quad small form-factor pluggable (QSFP) transceiver footprint. A mating receptacle (transceiver or adapter) includes a receptacle hook and a housing having an opening that receives the receptacle hook in a bent position when a fiber optic connector is connected with the mating receptacle by introducing the receptacle hook into the optical receptacle hook recess.

title_en: Aperture diaphragm adjusting method and device of terahertz imaging system
abstract_en: The invention provides an aperture diaphragm adjusting method of a terahertz imaging system, which can realize the size adjustment of an aperture diaphragm of hundreds of millimeters, is light and handy in volume and convenient to adjust, and has wide application in the field of terahertz imaging. A plurality of diaphragm blades are combined to form a fan blade structure with a closed central area in a closed state, each diaphragm blade is provided with a rotating connection point on the periphery, the rotating shaft of a single steering engine is fixedly connected with the rotating connection points of the corresponding diaphragm blades, and the array angles of the diaphragm blades are synchronously controlled through the same steering engine rotating angle controller, so that the synchronous motion of the diaphragm blades is realized, and the size of an aperture diaphragm of the central area corresponding to the fan blade structure is changed.

title_en: Semi-transparent semi-reflection display device
abstract_en: The invention provides a semi-transparent semi-reflective display device which comprises a display panel, a backlight source and a processing module. The display panel comprises a semi-transparent semi-reflective layer, a thin film transistor layer and a liquid crystal layer. The transflective layer comprises a light transmittance with a first preset value and a light reflectance with a second preset value. The thin film transistor layer comprises a thin film transistor and a photosensitive unit. The light sensing unit is used for sensing the brightness of the ambient light. The liquid crystal layer is arranged between the semi-transparent semi-reflecting layer and the thin film transistor layer. The backlight source is arranged on one side of the display panel facing the semi-transparent semi-reflective layer. The processing module is used for controlling the backlight source. When the brightness of the ambient light is smaller than a preset threshold, the processing module starts the backlight source, and light incident to the transflective layer from the backlight source penetrates through the transflective layer at a ratio of a first preset value. When the brightness of the ambient light is larger than or equal to the preset threshold, the processing module turns off the backlight source, and the ambient light irradiates the semi-transparent and semi-reflective layer and is reflected by the semi-transparent and semi-reflective layer at a ratio of a second preset value to form reflected light.

title_en: Reflection type acoustic holographic imaging method based on super surface
abstract_en: The invention provides a reflection type acoustic holographic imaging method based on a super surface, which comprises a reflection type acoustic holographic imaging device and comprises the following steps: acquiring the working frequency of a reflection-type acoustic holographic imaging device, and determining an initial sound wave under the working frequency; vertically injecting the initial sound wave into a reflection type acoustic holographic imaging device to obtain a reflection sound wave; inputting the reflected sound wave into the reflected sound wave correction model to obtain a corrected sound wave; reconstructing a target image on an imaging surface of the reflection-type acoustic holographic imaging device according to the corrected sound wave; the invention has the beneficial effects that: the method is used for solving the problem that the traditional method utilizes the acoustic super surface, and directly generates a holographic sound field by designing a unit structure, and the holographic imaging has deviation due to sound wave interference when the holographic sound field is applied in a special scene.

title_en: High-precision submicron wafer packaging level photomask substrate and production method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-precision sub-micron wafer packaging level photomask base plate which sequentially comprises a chromium-nitrogen oxide low-reflection film layer, a chromium-nitride shading film layer, a chromium-nitrogen oxide anti-sinking film layer and a glass substrate from top to bottom. The production method of the high-precision submicron wafer packaging level photomask substrate mainly comprises the steps of providing a Cr target material, introducing gas to form a required film layer, and obtaining the following result through actual detection: the high-precision submicron wafer packaging level photomask base plate has high-precision optical physical properties, and the targeting and driving directions of the high-precision submicron wafer packaging level photomask base plate achieve high uniformity.

title_en: Multilayer structure packaging ceramic for 5G optical communication module and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multilayer structure packaging ceramic for a 5G optical communication module and a preparation method thereof, wherein the multilayer structure packaging ceramic comprises at least four layers of ceramic blocks which are mutually overlapped, namely a first ceramic layer, a second ceramic layer, a third ceramic layer and a fourth ceramic layer, the upper surface of the second ceramic layer is also provided with a radio frequency circuit upper grounding layer, the third ceramic layer is provided with a plurality of strip lines at intervals, each strip line comprises a radio frequency circuit group and a control circuit group, the upper surface of the fourth ceramic layer is provided with a radio frequency circuit lower grounding layer, the radio frequency circuit upper grounding layer and the radio frequency circuit lower grounding layer respectively cover the upper surface and the lower surface of the radio frequency circuit group, the upper surface of the first ceramic layer is provided with a shell upper grounding layer, the lower surface of the fourth ceramic layer is provided with a shell lower grounding layer, and the shell upper grounding layer and the shell lower grounding layer are connected through a first grounding connecting line and a second grounding connecting line. The invention realizes that the insertion loss index, the reflection loss index and the on-resistance index meet the market use requirement under high frequency and high speed and ensures the consistency of mass production.

title_en: Intelligent-control flash lamp for photography
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligently adjustable photographic flash lamp, which comprises a fixing support frame, wherein a sliding block is connected inside the fixing support frame in a sliding manner, a reflecting shielding cloth is fixedly connected to the surface of the fixing support frame, heat dissipation pore plates are fixedly connected to the intervals of the reflecting shielding cloth, an anti-collision device is fixedly connected to the outer end part of each heat dissipation pore plate, an inner reflecting device is fixedly connected between the opposite surfaces of the heat dissipation pore plates, and a connecting wire is fixedly connected to the back of the inner reflecting device. This photographic flash light of using of intelligent control receives external environment striking at the flash light, and the interior pressure gasbag is rationally alleviated outside striking according to self performance ability, and the effect of book is prevented in the bradyseism that reaches the unilateral between the heat dissipation orifice plate of homonymy and the reflection of light cover cloth simultaneously, improves the life of this flash light.

title_en: Method for manufacturing VCSEL chip without Mesa
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for manufacturing a VCSEL chip without a Mesa, and relates to the technical field of vertical cavity surface emitting lasers. The invention discloses a manufacturing method of a VCSEL chip without a Mesa, which is characterized in that a photoelectric limiting layer is deposited on the surface of a quantum well after the growth of the quantum well is finished, then the photoelectric limiting layer is subjected to photoetching and etching to define a light emitting region, and the photoelectric limiting layer is made of aluminum oxide. According to the manufacturing method of the VCSEL chip without the Mesa, the traditional oxidation or ion implantation process is omitted in the whole production process, the equipment investment in the VCSEL chip preparation process can be reduced, the whole process flow is shortened, the production time can be effectively shortened, the production efficiency is improved, and the production cost is reduced.

title_en: Light source system based on light splitting color wheel
abstract_en: The invention provides a light source system based on a light splitting color wheel, which is characterized by comprising a blue single-wavelength laser, a beam shrinking lens group, the light splitting color wheel, a diffusion sheet I, a dichroic mirror, a reflecting mirror, a diffusion sheet II, a light condensing lens group, a wavelength conversion device, a light bar and a light collecting lens. The invention utilizes the light splitting color wheel to split light in time sequence, so that the time sequence of the laser light source is divided into two light paths, one light path is used for exciting the wavelength conversion device to generate excited light, the other light path is used for direct utilization, the design of the projection mode is completed through the light splitting color wheel under the condition of ensuring that the volume is not sacrificed and even reduced, and the red, green and blue light efficiency is effectively improved.

title_en: Vertical cavity surface emitting laser
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vertical cavity surface emitting laser. The vertical cavity surface emitting laser includes: a substrate; an N contact layer, an N-DBR layer, an MQW layer, an oxide layer, a P-DBR layer and a P contact layer which are grown on the substrate in sequence; and an N electrode, a P electrode and a SiN passivation layer; the N electrode is arranged on the N contact layer, the P electrode is arranged on the P contact layer, and the SiN passivation layer covers at least part of the surface of the vertical cavity surface emitting laser; the substrate is provided with a plurality of through holes, the back surface of the substrate is provided with a metal layer covering the through holes, and the lower surface of the metal layer is provided with metal bumps; and a metal column is arranged in the through hole, and the metal salient point is connected to the N electrode and the P electrode through the metal column. The vertical cavity surface emitting laser adopts the design of electrodes on the same side of the back surface of the substrate, can directly weld on the surface of a silicon-based material, avoids space waste caused by the traditional process, and is easy to realize photoelectronic device integration.

title_en: Tiled display device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a splicing display device which comprises at least two main display panels and a splicing display module, wherein each main display panel comprises a main display part and first frames arranged on the periphery of the main display part, and a splicing gap is formed between any two adjacent first frames; the splicing display module comprises a main body part and a splicing display panel, wherein the main body part is arranged at the splicing gap, the splicing display panel is connected with the main body part at one side of the main display panel in the thickness direction, the splicing display module is provided with a light outlet surface, the light outlet surface is a part of the splicing display panel or a part of the main body part, the light outlet surface at least covers two spliced parts, namely a first frame, and the splicing display module is capable of displaying a picture independently through the light outlet surface. The splicing display device provided by the technical scheme of the invention can effectively solve the problem that splicing black seams exist at splicing positions, and realizes quasi-seamless splicing.

title_en: Resin for photoresist and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of photoresist preparation, and particularly relates to a resin for a photoresist and a preparation method thereof. Styrene, p-styrene alkyl alcohol or p-styrene alkyl carboxylic acid or p-styrene ester compound and methacrylate ester are used as polymerization monomers, and the resin for the photoresist is prepared through free radical polymerization reaction. The mole fraction of styrene in the polymerized monomer is 20-50%, the mole fraction of p-styrene alkyl alcohol or p-styrene alkyl carboxylic acid or p-styrene ester compound in the polymerized monomer is 10-60%, and the mole fraction of methacrylate in the polymerized monomer is 10-40%. The preparation method has the advantages of simple preparation process, simplified steps, easy control of polymerization reaction, good batch stability of the prepared resin for the photoresist and capability of meeting the application requirement of the photoresist.

title_en: Mid-infrared broadband difference frequency generation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a 0-type broadband difference frequency generation method and a system, wherein the center wavelength of the generated broadband difference frequency is 2-17 mu m. The system consists of a signal light source, a pump light source, a drying system, a directional pattern gallium arsenide crystal, a temperature control device and a light wave beam combining device. The method utilizes a directional pattern gallium arsenide crystal to realize broadband difference frequency generation, when the temperature is 25 ℃, a fixed signal is 2.5 mu m, broadband difference frequency with the central wavelength of 16.392 mu m and the bandwidth of 1953.32nm is generated, pump light is fixed to be 3 mu m, and broadband difference frequency with the central wavelength of 9.778 mu m and the bandwidth of 3222.72nm is generated. The method realizes the generation of the broadband difference frequency by selecting the central wavelength of the required broadband difference frequency from 2-17 mu m to calculate the related parameters and the polarization period.

title_en: Continuous frequency modulation pulse microwave signal generation device and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a continuous frequency modulation pulse microwave signal generation device and a method. The method comprises the following steps: s1, generating two beams of femtosecond lasers with group delay based on an unequal arm interference module, carrying out beam combination and frequency spectrum shaping, and inputting shaped optical pulse signals to a frequency-time mapping module; s2, frequency-time mapping is carried out to obtain a time domain interference light pulse signal, and the light pulse signal is input to a photoelectric conversion module; and S3, carrying out power amplification on the optical pulse signal, and converting the optical pulse signal into a tunable pulse microwave signal by using a photoelectric detector for output. The invention realizes the continuous adjustment of group delay time by adopting an unbalanced single-arm optical fiber interference structure and combines the frequency-time mapping based on the dispersion optical fiber, thereby realizing the generation of the pulse microwave signal with continuous frequency modulation.

title_en: Green light source with high saturation power density
abstract_en: The invention discloses a green light source with high saturation power density, which comprises a blue light LD, a light filter, a lens I, a light-emitting element and a lens II, wherein the blue light LD, the light filter, the lens I, the light-emitting element and the lens II are arranged from bottom to top in sequence, the light-emitting element comprises a Ce: LuAG transparent fluorescent ceramic rod, a reflector positioned below the Ce: LuAG transparent fluorescent ceramic rod and a heat dissipation substrate covering the periphery of the Ce: LuAG transparent fluorescent ceramic rod, and the three are of a reflection type and internal total reflection type packaging structure. The blue LD is used for emitting laser; the optical filter is obliquely arranged at an angle of 45 degrees and is used for transmitting laser and reflecting fluorescence; the lens I is used for focusing laser; the LuAG transparent fluorescent ceramic rod emits green light to the periphery under the excitation of laser and emits the green light to the vertical direction in a limited packaging form; the reflector reflects green light upwards; the heat dissipation substrate is used for ceramic heat dissipation; lens ii is used to collect and further shape the green light reflected by the filter. The system can improve the saturation power density of the green light source, the luminous efficiency is higher, and the heat dissipation performance is more excellent.

title_en: Wide-bandwidth angle anti-reflection composite micro-nano structure surface and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: A wide-bandwidth angle composite micro-nano structure anti-reflection surface belongs to the technical field of optical technology and micro-nano processing, and aims to overcome the restriction of the structure height and depth-width ratio on the micro-nano processing technology in the bionic moth eye micro-nano structure surface technologyAnd the antireflection performance in the optical antireflection film technology is limited by the incident angle, a single-layer film is formed on the surface of the optical material substrate, a moth eye micro-nano structure with a certain depth is formed on the film layer, and a residual film layer is reserved, and the optical antireflection film consists of three layers of basic structures and sequentially comprises: the micro-nano structure layer, the middle residual layer and the substrate layer. The micro-nano structure layer is composed of a micro-nano structure unit array, the period of the micro-nano structure unit meets the sub-wavelength transmission requirement under the condition of a designed incident angle, namely: wherein λ min Denotes the minimum incident wavelength, n sub Denotes the refractive index of the substrate, n 0 Denotes the refractive index of air, theta max Represents the maximum incident angle, and p represents the unit period of the micro-nano structure. The invention ensures high transmittance and has no influence on imaging quality.

title_en: Cable pipe penetrating device pulling and conveying device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pulling device of a cable pipe penetrating device, which comprises: the device comprises a frame, a motor, a speed reducer, a driving wheel, a driven wheel, a bracket, a spring and a pedal; the motor and the speed reducer can be detachably arranged on the frame, and the motor is connected with an input shaft of the speed reducer; the driving wheel comprises a first side plate, a second side plate and a rubber wheel, the rubber wheel is arranged between the first side plate and the second side plate, and the first side plate is connected with an output shaft of the speed reducer; the driven wheel is located below the driving wheel, the driven wheel is arranged on the support in a rotating mode, the support is connected with the rack in a rotating mode, the pedal is arranged on the support, the pedal is trampled, the support can swing towards the direction close to the driving wheel, a spring is arranged between the support and the rack, and the spring is used for driving the support to swing towards the direction away from the driving wheel. The device has simple structure, can drive the cable and the pipe penetrating device to move by utilizing the friction force between the rubber wheel on the driving wheel and the cable and the pipe penetrating device, is not easy to slip in the pulling and conveying process, and is very convenient to use.

title_en: Background wall for interior decoration and construction process
