abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of indoor background walls, and relates to a background wall for indoor decoration and a construction process, wherein the background wall comprises a background wall frame, a projection plate and a movable plate, a projection groove for projection of a projector is formed in the background wall frame, the movable plate is arranged at an opening of the projection groove, and the projection plate is arranged between the bottom wall of the projection groove and the movable plate; an accommodating groove for accommodating the movable plate is formed in the background wall frame; a through hole is formed in the inner wall of one side of the projection groove, the accommodating groove is communicated with the through hole, and a driving mechanism for driving the movable plate to move to the accommodating groove is connected between the movable plate and the background wall frame; the movable plate comprises a plurality of splicing plates, and the splicing plates are arranged along the moving direction of the movable plate. This application promotes the indoor effect of pleasing to the eye degree when having the convenient to use projecting apparatus.

title_en: Miniaturized DPSK decodes receiver
abstract_en: The invention discloses a miniaturized DPSK decoding receiver. Belongs to the field of photoelectronic devices. The invention aims to overcome the defect that the existing decoder and receiver are two separate and independent devices, and the output light of the decoder is coupled into the optical receiver by using optical fiber array coupling (VGA). The decoder and the optical receiver are efficiently coupled into a whole through optical fiber array coupling (VGA) and are packaged in the same metal box to form the decoding receiver integration, so that 2 independent and separated decoding and receivers are replaced. An integrated demodulation receiver is manufactured with a smaller package size and a lower production price. In the packaging process, the box is vacuum sealed with a seal at the outlet of the optical fiber. The integrated system realizes vacuum packaging of the decoder and the receiver in the same shell, and guarantees the reliability of the system. The receiver also has the function of monitoring on-line monitoring signals, and is suitable for application in an intelligent network.

title_en: Holographic grating manufacturing device, holographic grating and two-dimensional holographic grating optical waveguide
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a device for manufacturing a holographic grating, the holographic grating and a two-dimensional holographic grating optical waveguide. The manufacturing device comprises a light source, a light splitting unit, a first reflecting unit, a first diaphragm, a second reflecting unit, a second diaphragm, a prism and a holographic dry plate; the light of the light source forms a first light beam and a second light beam after passing through the light splitting unit; the first light beam is reflected by the first reflecting unit, forms a first sub-light beam and a second sub-light beam by the first diaphragm, and irradiates the holographic dry plate; the second light beam is reflected by the second reflecting unit and forms a third sub-light beam and a fourth sub-light beam by the second diaphragm; the third sub-beam is transmitted by the prism and forms interference fringes with the first sub-beam to expose the first area of the holographic dry plate, the fourth sub-beam is reflected by the prism and forms interference fringes with the second sub-beam to expose the second area of the holographic dry plate to form the holographic grating, and the manufacturing device can expose the two areas simultaneously, so that the efficiency of manufacturing the holographic grating is high.

title_en: Micro lens, substrate, preparation method and application of micro lens and substrate, and quantum dot light-emitting diode
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of display illumination, and particularly relates to a micro-lens array template and a preparation method thereof, a scattering micro-lens, a substrate and a preparation method and application thereof, and a quantum dot light-emitting diode. The concave micro-lens array template provided by the invention is characterized in that the concave transparent array template is a polystyrene concave micro-lens array template, a polydimethylsiloxane concave micro-lens array template or an impact-resistant polystyrene concave micro-lens array template, the surface of the concave micro-lens array template is a quasi-hemispherical array, the diameter of the quasi-hemispherical array is more than or equal to 5 mu m independently, and the height of the top point of the quasi-hemispherical array is more than or equal to 2 mu m independently. The scattering type micro lens obtained by the concave micro lens array template provided by the invention can be used singly, the output efficiency of the QLED can be effectively improved, and the QLED has a simple structure.

title_en: Optical film, backlight module and display device
abstract_en: An optical film, a backlight module and a display device are provided. The optical film is configured to receive and guide light. The optical film comprises a body and a plurality of optical structures. The body is provided with a light-emitting surface, an optical surface, a first side surface and a second side surface. The light-emitting surface is opposite to the optical surface, and the first side surface and the second side surface are respectively connected to two opposite side edges of the light-emitting surface and the optical surface. The optical structure is disposed on the first region of the optical surface. Each optical structure has a first surface and a second surface. The first surface and the optical surface form a first included angle. The first surface is a light receiving surface. The second surface is connected to the first surface. The second surface and the optical surface form a second included angle. The first included angle of the optical structure is gradually changed along a first direction from the first side surface to the second side surface.

title_en: Collimating lens and image sensor
abstract_en: The invention provides a collimating lens and an image sensor, wherein the collimating lens comprises an aperture diaphragm, a first lens group, a second lens group and a third lens group which are sequentially arranged at intervals along the incident direction of light beams, the first lens group has negative focal power, the second lens group and the third lens group have positive focal power, and the focal lengths of the first lens group, the second lens group and the third lens group satisfy the following relational expression: 3< f2/f <5, and 0.5< f3/f <2, and f1< -0.5 xf 2, and 0.5< f/d < 0.6; wherein f1 is the focal length of the first lens group, f2 is the focal length of the second lens group, f3 is the focal length of the third lens group, f is the total focal length, and d is the spot diameter defined by the aperture stop. By the design, the numerical aperture of the collimating lens can be ensured to be larger than 1.35 in water, so that the requirement that the numerical aperture NA of the polarization aberration measurement transmission sensor of the immersion type projection objective is larger than or equal to 1.35 can be met.

title_en: White photosensitive covering film composition for LED, covering film and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a white photosensitive covering film composition for an LED, a covering film and a preparation method thereof. The photosensitive covering film composition comprises, by weight, 100 parts of alkali-soluble photosensitive acrylic resin, 10-35 parts of epoxy resin, 5-35 parts of acrylate monomers, 1-9 parts of a photoinitiator, 15-90 parts of rutile titanium dioxide and 25-30 parts of an auxiliary agent. The acid value of the alkali soluble acrylic resin is marked as X mgKOH/g, X is more than or equal to 30 and less than or equal to 50, or X is more than 50 and less than or equal to 80, or X is more than 80 and less than or equal to 100. The photosensitive covering film composition can realize continuous coating by matching with different additives and dosage proportions in different ranges, has the beneficial effects of good thickness uniformity and further improves the resolution performance of products.

title_en: Composition for forming liquid crystal cured film and use thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a composition for forming a liquid crystal cured film, which is used for manufacturing a liquid crystal cured film with little film thickness unevenness. The present invention provides a composition for forming a liquid crystal cured film, which comprises at least one silicon-based or fluorine-based leveling agent, at least one acrylic leveling agent, and at least one polymerizable liquid crystal compound, wherein the total amount of the leveling agents is 3.0 wt% or less relative to the total amount of the polymerizable liquid crystal compounds.

title_en: System and method for holographic sensory data generation, manipulation and transmission
abstract_en: The present application relates to a system and method for holographic sensory data generation, manipulation and transmission. A method of determining four-dimensional (4D) plenoptic coordinates of content data by: receiving content data; determining a location of a data point relative to a first surface to create a digital volumetric representation of the content data, the first surface being a reference surface; determining 4D plenoptic coordinates of the data points at a second surface in which a 4D function is applied by tracking the positions of the data points in the volumetric representation relative to the second surface; and determining an energy source position value for the 4D plenoptic coordinate with the first convergence point.

title_en: Extreme Ultraviolet (EUV) lithography using an intermediate layer or multilayer stack with different mean free paths for secondary electron generation
abstract_en: A method of patterning a substrate includes providing a substrate, and depositing a multilayer stack including N layers on the substrate. N is an integer greater than one. The N layers contain N mean free paths for secondary electrons, respectively. The method includes depositing a photoresist layer on the multilayer stack, wherein the N mean free paths converge in the photoresist layer. Another method of patterning a substrate includes providing a substrate and depositing a layer on the substrate. The layer contains different mean free paths for secondary electrons. The method includes depositing a photoresist layer over the layer. The different mean free paths for secondary electrons converge in the photoresist layer.

title_en: Extreme Ultraviolet (EUV) lithography using intermediate layers or multi-layer stacks with different mean free path for secondary electron generation
abstract_en: A method of patterning a substrate includes providing a substrate, and depositing a multi-layer stack including N layers on the substrate. N is an integer greater than one. The N layers each include N mean free paths for secondary electrons. The method includes depositing a photoresist layer on the multi-layer stack, wherein the N mean free paths converge in the photoresist layer. Another method of patterning a substrate includes providing a substrate and depositing a layer on the substrate. The layer contains different mean free paths for secondary electrons. The method includes depositing a photoresist layer over the layer. The different mean free path for secondary electrons converges in the photoresist layer.

title_en: Imaging lens, camera module and electronic device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an imaging lens, a camera module and an electronic device. The imaging lens comprises a plastic lens barrel and an imaging lens group, wherein the imaging lens group is arranged in the plastic lens barrel, has an optical axis, and comprises an object side lens and an image side lens, wherein the object side lens is provided with an outer diameter surface and an optical effective part, and comprises a conical collimation surface. The conical collimation surface is positioned on the image side surface of the object side lens and is used for being connected with the image side lens in a coaxial alignment mode. When the specific condition is satisfied, the assembly stability and the imaging quality can be considered. The invention also discloses a camera module with the imaging lens and an electronic device with the camera module.

title_en: Control method and device of tunable laser
abstract_en: The invention discloses a control method of a tunable laser, the tunable laser comprises a first grating, a second grating and a storage device, the first grating comprises a plurality of different grating sections, the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a corresponding control current value group from a data combination of a plurality of control current value groups prestored in a storage device according to the received wavelength value of the laser to be output; injecting corresponding control currents into a control circuit of each grating segment in the first grating, a control circuit of the second grating, a gain control circuit, a phase control circuit and an optical power amplification control circuit respectively according to the acquired control current value group so as to enable the first grating and the second grating to generate a first reflection peak and a second reflection peak respectively; and amplifying and outputting the wavelength value of the laser corresponding to the reflected wave peak value after the first reflected peak and the second reflected peak are overlapped to obtain the wavelength value of the output laser. The invention discloses a control device of a tunable laser. The invention has higher wavelength output precision.

title_en: Light supplementing lamp control method, module, equipment, system, device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a light filling lamp control method, a module, equipment, a system, a device and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a video stream acquired by image acquisition equipment; under the condition that a preset processing process starts to process a current processing frame in the video stream, determining a frame identification of a current exposure frame of current exposure of the image acquisition equipment; determining the frame identification of a target frame to be skipped for light supplementing according to the frame identification of the current processing frame, the frame identification of the current exposure frame and the frame number corresponding to the single frame processing time length of the preset processing process, wherein the target frame is a video frame to be acquired after the current exposure frame; and controlling the light supplementing lamp of the image acquisition equipment to be closed during the period that the image acquisition equipment acquires the target frame according to the frame identification of the target frame. The embodiment of the disclosure can realize low-power consumption control of the light supplementing lamp.

title_en: Head-up display device and head-up display method
abstract_en: A head-up display device (200) and a method thereof, wherein the head-up display device (200) comprises a visual positioning unit (210) used for acquiring sight line information of a user, determining a target display area according to the sight line information, wherein the target display area is a subarea of an integral display area corresponding to an image display unit (240), an image determining unit (220) used for determining an image of target content in the target display area, the target content is content corresponding to the target display area in to-be-displayed content of the integral display area, an image control unit (230) used for adjusting a light field, generating a real image of the target content in the target display area according to the image of the target content, an image display unit (240) used for displaying the real image of the target content, and an optical unit (250) used for forming a light beam based on the real image of the target content so as to generate a virtual image of the target content. The head-up display device and the method can reduce the power consumption of the head-up display device (20), prolong the service life of display elements, enable a user to obtain a good visual effect, and are beneficial to improving the driving safety.

title_en: Extracting an object from a background
abstract_en: A video capturing of a subject, comprising: capturing video data of a subject using a first camera; capturing IR infrared video data of a subject using a second camera linked to the first camera such that the first camera and the second camera share the same field of view, wherein the second camera is sensitive to infrared light for capturing the infrared video data of the subject; illuminating an object with at least one infrared light source; and processing the video data from the first camera and the infrared video data from the second camera to identify a contour of the illuminated subject in the video data using the infrared video data.

title_en: Compact eyeball tracking system and method
abstract_en: The application discloses a compact eyeball tracking system and a method, the system comprises a polarization module, a Bragg grating is arranged to guide the IR light in a specific polarization state to diffract to the eyeball of a user, and an IR sensor module is used for receiving the IR light reflected by the mirror surface and the scattering of the eye, generating an image of the eye and detecting the position and the movement of the eye of the user. By utilizing the characteristic that the angle of the IR diffracted light is greatly changed compared with the incident angle of the IR light before diffraction, the installation position or angle of the Bragg grating can be set to occupy the space of the HMD as small as possible.

title_en: Developing oscillation device, developing method, manufacturing method and equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a developing oscillation device, a developing method, a manufacturing method and equipment. The developing oscillation device comprises an oscillation control device, a calculation control device, a horizontal detection device and a mechanical arm which are connected in pairs; the oscillation control device is used for controlling the speed, the frequency and the direction of the movement of the mechanical arm; the horizontal detection device is used for acquiring offset data of the printed circuit board substrate, sending the offset data to the calculation control device and adjusting the pose parameters of the mechanical arm under the control of the calculation control device; and the calculation control device is used for calculating the adjustment parameters of the horizontal detection device according to the offset data and controlling the horizontal detection device to adjust the pose parameters of the mechanical arm based on the adjustment parameters. The development oscillating device can adjust oscillation parameters of the substrate in the developing solution through controlling the frequency and the speed of the movement of the mechanical arm, and the defect that the edge of an image is rough due to the effects of light diffraction, diffuse reflection and the like in the production process of a printed circuit board is overcome.

title_en: Vertical resonator type light emitting element
abstract_en: A vertical resonator-type light-emitting element includes: a substrate (11); a first multilayer film reflection mirror (12) formed on the substrate; a first semiconductor layer (13N) formed on the first multilayer film mirror and having a first conductivity type; a light-emitting layer (13A) formed on the first semiconductor layer; a second semiconductor layer (13P) formed on the light-emitting layer and having a second conductivity type opposite to the first conductivity type while having a convex portion (13PB) on an upper surface; an insulating layer (14) covering an upper surface of the second semiconductor layer while having an opening exposing the second semiconductor layer on an upper surface of a convex portion, the convex portion terminating on the upper surface; a light-transmitting electrode layer (15) formed on the insulating layer to cover an upper surface of the second semiconductor layer, the upper surface being exposed through the opening of the insulating layer; and a second multilayer film mirror (16) formed on the light-transmitting electrode layer and constituting a resonator together with the first multilayer film mirror.

title_en: Large-target-surface optical imaging lens group and imaging method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a large-target-surface optical imaging lens group, which comprises an optical system, wherein the optical system comprises a first lens L1, a second lens L2, a diaphragm, a third lens L3, a fourth lens L4 and a fifth lens L5 which are sequentially arranged from left to right along a light incident light path. The optical system has reasonable structure and smaller size, adopts glass-plastic structural design, and has better optical and structural stability; meanwhile, the invention has the characteristics of large target surface, small F number, low chromatic aberration and high resolution, and has excellent imaging quality; in addition, the invention adopts a wide working band and low-temperature drift design, and ensures the imaging quality under complex illumination and climatic conditions.

title_en: Holographic fingerprint
abstract_en: A holographic projector comprising a spatial light modulator arranged to display a hologram of a light pattern for projection and to spatially modulate light according to the display to form a holographic reconstruction, wherein the holographic reconstruction is spatially separated from the spatial light modulator. If the holographic projection is functioning properly, the resulting holographic reconstruction should correspond to the light pattern. The holographic projector further comprises a detector array comprising a plurality of light detection elements arranged to detect light corresponding to a respective plurality of locations of the holographic reconstruction and to provide a respective plurality of output signals related to the light detection, and a fault detection circuit arranged to compare one or more of the plurality of output signals from the respective plurality of light detection elements with one or more of a plurality of expected signals based on the light distribution of the light pattern.

title_en: Optical module
abstract_en: The application discloses an optical module which comprises a lower shell, a circuit board, a lens assembly, an optical fiber assembly and a fixing plate, wherein two opposite side walls of the lower shell are respectively provided with a first boss; the optical fiber assembly comprises an optical fiber ferrule, an internal optical fiber and an optical fiber adapter which are sequentially connected, the other end of the optical fiber ferrule is inserted into the lens assembly, and the other end of the optical fiber adapter is connected with the external optical fiber; the fixing plate is arranged between the first boss and the end face of the optical fiber ferrule, one side of the fixing plate is abutted against the end face of the optical fiber ferrule, and the edge of the other side of the fixing plate is abutted against the first boss; the side surface of the optical fiber plug core, which is abutted against the end surface of the optical fiber plug core, is provided with an opening at the lower end, and the internal optical fiber passes through the opening and is inserted into the optical fiber plug core. This application adds the fixed plate between optic fibre adapter and optic fibre lock pin, and after the optic fibre lock pin inserted the lens subassembly, one side of fixed plate supported optic fibre lock pin, the edge of opposite side supported the first boss on the casing lateral wall down, had avoided the optic fibre lock pin to remove about, had realized the fixed of optic fibre lock pin.

title_en: Diaphragm, optical system and lithographic apparatus
abstract_en: An aperture (300), in particular a numerical aperture, an obscuration or a vignette, for a lithographic apparatus (100A,100B) comprises a clear aperture (302) and at least one aperture element (306,308), the aperture (302) being disposed in or on the at least one aperture element (306,308), wherein the aperture element (306,308) is opaque and fluid permeable outside the aperture (302).

title_en: Long-focus projector capable of short-distance and bidirectional projection
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of photography, in particular to a long-focus projector capable of projecting in a short distance and in two directions, which comprises a supporting component, a moving component, a cleaning component and a projector body, wherein the moving component comprises a screw motor, a sliding block and a position regulator, the screw motor is fixedly arranged on the supporting component, the sliding block is connected with the supporting component in a sliding way and is in threaded connection with a screw of the screw motor, the position regulator is arranged on the sliding block, the cleaning component comprises a cleaning frame, a rotating motor and a cleaning roller, the cleaning frame is rotationally connected with the sliding block, the output end of the rotating motor is connected with the cleaning frame, the cleaning roller is rotationally connected with the cleaning frame, the projector body is arranged on the position regulator, when the projector body is moved, the rotating motor drives the cleaning frame to rotate relative to the sliding block, so that the cleaning roller is contacted with the supporting component, dust on the supporting component can be cleaned through the cleaning roller when the screw motor drives the sliding block to move, so that the movement is smoother.

title_en: Thin laser beam regulating and controlling device
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a thin laser beam regulating and controlling device, including: the laser device comprises a first grating device, a second grating device, a light beam adjusting device and a detector, wherein the first grating device and the second grating device are arranged at positions where grid lines are mutually perpendicular in the laser incident light path direction, the first grating device is used for receiving laser and outputting first diffraction laser to the second grating device, the second grating device outputs second diffraction laser to the light beam adjusting device, and the light beam adjusting device adjusts light beams to be matched and input to the detector. The thin laser beam regulating device disclosed by the embodiment of the disclosure realizes the design of a thin module with the caliber/thickness ratio larger than 2.

title_en: Adhesive sheet, laminate, display device, and organic electroluminescent display device
abstract_en: Hair brushDisclosed are an adhesive sheet, a laminate, a display device and an organic EL display device, which are excellent in light resistance (particularly, light resistance to light having a wavelength of 370-400 nm). The pressure-sensitive adhesive sheet of the present invention is a pressure-sensitive adhesive sheet comprising a (meth) acrylic pressure-sensitive adhesive and a compound represented by formula (I), wherein the (meth) acrylic pressure-sensitive adhesive is formed using a (meth) acrylic resin, and the absolute value of the difference between the logP value of the (meth) acrylic resin and the logP value of the compound represented by formula (I) is 2.50 or more.

title_en: Optical system
abstract_en: The present disclosure proposes an optical system. The optical system comprises a movable part, a fixed part, a first sensing element, a second sensing element and a control unit. The optical element is arranged on the movable part, and the first sensing element and the second sensing element are respectively used for sensing the movement of the movable part relative to the fixed part in a first dimension coordinate and a second dimension coordinate, and respectively generating a first sensing value and a second sensing value. The control unit generates an error value according to the first sensing value and an error relation curve, and corrects the second sensing value according to the error value.

title_en: Microelectronic scanning galvanometer, scanning imaging system, wearable device and laser radar
abstract_en: A microelectronic scanning galvanometer, a scanning imaging system, a wearable device and a laser radar are provided, the microelectronic scanning galvanometer comprises an action system, a reflector and a driving system, the action system comprises a frame body, two first torsion beams along the slow axis direction and two second torsion beams along the fast axis direction, the two first torsion beams are symmetrical about the fast axis, the first torsion beams are symmetrical about the slow axis, the two second torsion beams are symmetrical about the slow axis, and the second torsion beams are symmetrical about the fast axis; the reflector is positioned between the two first torsion beams and between the two second torsion beams, and the two second torsion beams are connected with the reflector; the driving system drives the two first torsion beams to twist around the fast axis and the two second torsion beams to twist around the slow axis, and the reflecting mirror is driven by the two first torsion beams and the two second torsion beams to twist around the fast axis or the slow axis. Therefore, the long-term use reliability of the microelectronic scanning galvanometer is improved, and the reflecting mirror has smaller packaging volume and lower mechanical coupling while meeting the requirements of a large reflecting mirror surface, high scanning frequency and a large scanning angle.

title_en: Augmented reality device assembling method and augmented reality device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an augmented reality device assembly method and an augmented reality device. The augmented reality device assembling method comprises the following steps: fixing one of a projection module, an optical waveguide and a support in the augmented reality device to be assembled, and arranging the other two in respective preset positions relative to the projection module, so that a gap is formed between a display unit in the projection module and the shell and/or between the optical waveguide and the support for adjusting the relative position between the display unit and the shell and/or between the optical waveguide and the support; projecting image light rays by the projection module; receiving an outgoing image coupled out of the optical waveguide and determining whether the outgoing image meets a predetermined criterion: if not, adjusting the relative position until determining an optimized relative position which can enable the emergent image to meet the preset standard; if so, maintaining the optimized relative position; the optimized relative position is fixed at least by means of sizing. The method is convenient and efficient to assemble and operate, and can effectively improve the quality of the final projected image.

title_en: Method for producing a reflective film, reflective film and use thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a reflecting film, the reflecting film and application thereof, and particularly relates to the technical field of reflecting films. The method for producing a reflecting film comprises bonding a porous film loaded with polymer particles to a first base film coated with an adhesive, and then discarding the porous film to obtain the reflecting film. In the preparation method, the polymer particles are not wrapped by the adhesive and are well exposed on the surface of the first base film, so that the scratch resistance effect of the reflecting film is improved and the reflectivity is not greatly influenced.

title_en: Wavelength locking system
abstract_en: The present invention provides a wavelength locking system comprising: a semiconductor light emitting structure; an external feedback structure; a selective reflector in an optical path from the semiconductor light emitting structure to the external feedback structure, the selective reflector comprising a polarization reflective region and a transmissive region surrounding the polarization reflective region; the polarization reflection region is suitable for reflecting the light beam emitted to the polarization reflection region by the semiconductor light-emitting structure into polarized light and transmitting the polarized light to the external feedback structure, and the polarization reflection region is also suitable for transmitting the partial light beam emitted to the polarization reflection region by the semiconductor light-emitting structure; the transmissive region is adapted to transmit a light beam emitted to the transmissive region by the semiconductor light emitting structure. The wavelength locking system has the advantages of high output power, high output light beam quality, small temperature drift and high reliability.

title_en: Optical imaging system and imaging method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an optical imaging system, which comprises a first lens, a second lens, a third lens, a diaphragm, a fourth lens, a fifth lens, a sixth lens and a seventh lens which are sequentially arranged from left to right along a light incident light path; the first lens is a meniscus negative lens, the second lens is a meniscus negative lens, the third lens is a biconvex positive lens, the fourth lens is a meniscus negative lens, the fifth lens is a biconvex positive lens, the sixth lens is a biconvex positive lens, and the seventh lens is a meniscus negative lens; all lenses are made of glass material. The glass-plastic or all-plastic system has a reasonable structure, and has better optical stability compared with the existing glass-plastic or all-plastic system which exists in large quantity on the market. Meanwhile, the system has a very large field of view, and can realize dead-angle-free monitoring of the environment outside the vehicle. In order to adapt to different light environments, the invention adopts a design of small F number and wide working wave band. In addition, the invention has good performance in the temperature environment of-40 ℃ to 105 ℃ and further improves the optical and structural stability.

title_en: Portable film reading device for medical clinical image examination
abstract_en: The invention relates to a portable film reading device for medical clinical image examination, which comprises a workbench, a fixing structure and a moving mechanism, wherein the upper end surface of the workbench is provided with the fixing mechanism, and the moving mechanism is arranged on the fixing mechanism.

title_en: Confocal microscopic method and device based on laser feedback
abstract_en: The invention relates to a confocal microscopy method and a confocal microscopy device based on laser feedback, wherein the confocal microscopy method based on the laser feedback comprises the following steps: emitting laser by a linear polarization laser; the laser irradiates the microscopic sample through a collimating lens, an 1/2 wave plate, a 1/4 wave plate, a beam expander and an objective lens in sequence; driving a microscopic sample to perform same-view field scanning imaging to obtain a polarization-maintaining related component image by enabling an included angle between the main axis direction of the 1/4 wave plate and the polarization direction of laser to be 0 degrees; making the included angle between the main axis direction of the 1/4 wave plate and the polarization direction of the laser be 45 degrees; and driving the microscopic sample to perform scanning imaging in a same field of view to obtain an depolarization related component image. The confocal microscopy method based on laser feedback integrates the advantages of auto-collimation and high sensitivity of the laser feedback technology based on the laser feedback technology, obtains polarization-maintaining related component images and polarization-removing related component images of the microscopic sample, provides more image information data, improves the information acquisition capacity of a scattering medium of the microscopic sample, and expands the information quantity.

title_en: Micro-nano structure capable of adjusting circular dichroism
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of circular dichroism application, in particular to a micro-nano structure capable of adjusting circular dichroism. During application, the grid electrode and the first electrode are connected with an external circuit, and the grid voltage of the first carbon nanotube strip is changed, so that the effective dielectric constant of the first carbon nanotube strip is changed, the dielectric environment on the first parallel arm is changed, the chirality of the U-shaped structure is changed, and the circular dichroism regulation and control of the U-shaped structure is realized. In the invention, the dielectric environment at the first parallel arm can be conveniently adjusted by adjusting the voltage between the first electrode and the grid, so that circular dichroism can be adjusted and controlled, and the adjustment and control are convenient and flexible and the response speed is high.

title_en: Optical imaging lens
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optical imaging lens which sequentially comprises a first lens, a second lens, a third lens, a fourth lens, a fifth lens, a sixth lens, a seventh lens and an eighth lens from an object side to an image side along an optical axis. The third lens element has a positive refractive index and a concave peripheral region of an object-side surface of the third lens element. An optical axis region of an image-side surface of the fifth lens element is a concave surface and a circumferential region of the image-side surface of the fifth lens element is a convex surface. The optical axis area of the object side surface of the sixth lens is a concave surface. The seventh lens element has a negative refractive index. The first lens element has positive refractive index, the second lens element has negative refractive index, the sixth lens element has positive refractive index, or the eighth lens element has negative refractive index. The lenses of the optical imaging lens only have the eight lenses. The optical imaging lens can correct edge aberration, has larger image height, improves spherical aberration and aberration of the optical imaging lens, reduces distortion and chromatic aberration, and reduces ghost (flare).

title_en: Weldable manufacturing method of electroplated tin layer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a weldable manufacturing method of an electroplated tin layer, which comprises the following steps of S1: solder resist, S2: surface treatment, namely placing the manufactured substrate into a cleaning tank filled with a degreasing agent for cleaning, wherein the immersion time is 5-7min, the degreasing agent comprises 10-15g/L of sodium hydroxide, 20-30g/L of sodium carbonate, 60-70g/L of trisodium phosphate and 5-10g/L of sodium silicate, and the temperature of the degreasing agent is maintained at 85-90 ℃, and S3: and (3) performance test, namely judging the adhesion degree of the tin layer after tin plating by using a bending test method by adopting a periodical sampling method. According to the method for manufacturing the electroplated tin layer through welding, the methyl sulfuric acid with proper volume concentration and the displacement agent are added into the electroplating liquid to perform effective electroplating, only a small amount of hydrogen evolution phenomenon exists in a high current density region when the concentration of the methyl sulfuric acid reaches a proper value, and the whole plating layer is free of gaps and pinholes and uniform, so that the PCB has good appearance and weldability after manufacturing, and the thickness of a generated coating can be controlled by controlling the current, so that the PCB is suitable for different plate surface requirements.

title_en: Optical imaging lens and camera module
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optical imaging lens and a camera module, belonging to the technical field of optical imaging, wherein the optical imaging lens comprises a first lens with positive focal power, and the object side surface of the first lens is a convex surface close to an optical axis; a second lens having a focal power, an image-side surface of which is concave near the optical axis; a third lens having optical power; a fourth lens having an optical power; a fifth lens element having a negative refractive power, an object-side surface of which is concave near the optical axis, and an image-side surface of which is concave near the optical axis; the optical imaging lens meets the following conditional expression: TTL/ImgH <1.55, -0.6< CT4/f5< -0.2, 0.75< SAG42/SAG51< 1.37. The optical imaging lens provided by the invention can meet the requirement of small TTL (transistor-transistor logic) and can obtain higher imaging performance.

title_en: Terahertz all-silicon off-axis superlens and design method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a terahertz all-silicon off-axis superlens and a design method thereof, which relate to the technical field of optics, and the design method comprises the following steps: step S1, calculating the transmission amplitude and phase shift of silicon cylinders with different sizes when vertical polarization terahertz beams are incident; step S2, selecting a plurality of silicon cylinders with different sizes and high transmission amplitude, wherein the phase shift of the selected silicon cylinders can cover-180 degrees to 180 degrees; step S3, arranging the selected silicon cylinders with different sizes on a silicon substrate according to the phase modulation function corresponding to the off-axis superlens; step S4, designing an anti-reflection silicon cylinder array on the other side of the silicon substrate, wherein the silicon cylinders have the same size; the terahertz all-silicon off-axis superlens is composed of a silicon substrate and silicon cylindrical arrays on two sides of the silicon substrate. The all-silicon super-lens designed by the invention can realize focusing of an incident terahertz light beam in the off-axis direction, overcomes the problem of complex processing of the existing off-axis super-lens, and fills the blank of the research on the all-silicon off-axis super-lens in the terahertz waveband.

title_en: Endoscope system and working method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an endoscope system capable of stably detecting an irradiation region of measuring beam light and an operating method thereof. A receiving unit (38) acquires an object image including a flare (SP) that appears in an object by irradiation of measuring beam light. An irradiation region identification unit (58) identifies the position of a flare (SP) from an object image. An irradiation region identification unit (58) identifies a Spot (SP) having a circular pattern that includes a white center region (CR 1) and a peripheral region (SR 1) that covers the periphery of the center region (CR 1) and has a feature quantity based on the measuring beam light.

title_en: Display panel and display device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a display panel and a display device, relates to the technical field of display, and can solve the problem that a camera obtains images through a transparent display area with poor imaging effect. The display device includes display panel and camera, and the camera setting is at display panel's the back and corresponds with transparent display area, and display panel includes: a plurality of first wirings sequentially arranged along a first direction and a plurality of second wirings sequentially arranged along a second direction; the first direction and the second direction are intersected with each other; the transparent display area comprises a plurality of first wire groups, at least two adjacent first wires are folded into one first wire group, and the distance between the adjacent first wires in the non-transparent display area is smaller than the distance between the adjacent first wire groups and larger than the distance between the adjacent first wires in the first wire groups; further comprises: the first light shielding strip is arranged on the first wiring group, and the first wiring group is close to the display side of the display panel relative to the first light shielding strip.

title_en: Optical imaging system, image capturing module and electronic device
abstract_en: The application discloses optical imaging system, get for instance module and electron device. The optical imaging system sequentially comprises a first lens with negative refractive power, a second lens with positive refractive power, an aperture, a third lens with negative or positive refractive power, a fourth lens with positive refractive power and a fifth lens with positive refractive power from an object side to an image side, and the optical imaging system meets the following conditional expressions: 1.6< P1SD × FNO/ImgH < 2.7; wherein P1SD is the maximum effective half aperture of the object-side surface of the first lens, y is the image height corresponding to the maximum field angle of the optical imaging system, and FNO is the f-number of the optical imaging system. The optical imaging system reduces the radial size of the object side surface of the first lens while realizing a large aperture, thereby realizing a small head design, reducing the size of an opening on a product screen and further improving the screen occupation ratio of the product.

title_en: Projector position control system for determining projection position by image scanning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of projection equipment, and discloses a projector position control system for determining a projection position through image scanning, which comprises: the management module is used for sending and running a general control global instruction and used as a core control end; a projector apparatus for serving as a main tool of high definition projection; the scanning module is used for carrying out operation of a scanning instruction and scanning a projectable area of a projectable object; the detection module is used for detecting the range of the projectable area of the projection object and outputting the range as data information; and the marking module is used for marking the primarily calibrated projectable area and mapping the primarily calibrated projectable area on the projection object. The invention adds a control mode for automatically adjusting the projection position of the projector, so that a user can conveniently adjust the projection position, the requirement of the user for adjusting the projection angle in different scenes can be met, the fit degree of a projected image and a projected object in projection can be ensured to reach the standard, and the operation of the user is convenient.

title_en: Four-group six-piece miniature immersion liquid objective lens
abstract_en: The invention discloses four groups of six micro immersion objectives, which comprise a first lens, a second lens, a third lens and a fourth lens which are sequentially arranged from an object plane to an image plane, wherein the second lens is a three-cemented lens; the S11 surface of the first lens is a plane, the S12 surface of the first lens is a convex image surface, the S21 surface of the second lens is a convex object surface, the S22 surface of the second lens is a convex image surface, the S23 surface of the second lens is a convex object surface, the S24 surface of the second lens is a convex image surface, the S31 surface of the third lens is a plane, the S32 surface of the third lens is a plane, the S41 surface of the fourth lens is a convex image surface, and the S42 surface of the fourth lens is a convex image surface. The whole objective lens only comprises 4 lenses, fluorescence signal acquisition from an object surface to an image surface in the confocal system is realized through the four lenses, the structure is simple, the number of elements is reduced, the edge thickness of each lens is larger, each lens is not easy to incline under the condition that the outer diameter and the length are kept to meet clinical requirements, the inclination sensitivity and the assembly difficulty of the micro immersion objective lens are reduced, and the qualification rate of mass production is improved.

title_en: Method for manufacturing electronic light modulation device, electronic element for light modulation, and electronic light modulation glasses
abstract_en: A method for manufacturing an electronic light control device (10), an electronic device for light control, and electronic light control glasses, wherein a light control effect is obtained by supplying electric energy to an electronic device (19) that overlaps an optical device (30), wherein a laminate (20, 120) is formed in which a pair of electrode layers (22, 24) and a light control layer (23) between the pair of electrode layers are laminated, an overlapping region (V) having a shape that overlaps the optical device is set in a light control layer forming region in the laminate, and two or more terminal regions (T1, T2) that exist separately from one of the pair of electrode layers and the other are continuously set outside the overlapping region, and the electronic device is formed by cutting out a portion including the overlapping region and the terminal regions from the laminate, thereby improving production efficiency.

title_en: Semiconductor laser capable of improving uniformity of output light spots and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a semiconductor laser capable of improving uniformity of output light spots, wherein an optical fiber positioned in the laser device is in a bending state under the action of bending stress, so that the optical fiber is bent at a certain radian, and the optical fiber in the state can change a total reflection path of laser in the optical fiber, so that the uniformity of the output light spots is better. Aiming at the problems of poor uniformity of output light spots and dark center of the light spots of the conventional optical fiber beam combination output laser, the semiconductor laser provided by the invention not only effectively improves the output uniformity of the light spots, but also avoids the problem of output power loss by changing the total reflection path of laser in the optical fiber.

title_en: Retardation film with easy-to-adhere layer, polarizing plate with retardation layer, and method for producing retardation film with easy-to-adhere layer
abstract_en: Provided is a retardation film with an easily adhesive layer, which is suppressed in breakage during production and has a small phase difference. The retardation film with an easy-to-adhere layer of the present invention comprises a base film having an in-plane retardation, and an easy-to-adhere layer provided on at least one side of the base film. Average thickness T of easy-to-adhere layer  1  Average thickness T of substrate film  2  Ratio T of  1  /T  2  0.0102 and an average thickness T of the easy-to-adhere layer  1  The maximum thickness of the easy-to-adhere layer is 1.20 or less, and the minimum thickness is 0.80 or more.

title_en: Display substrate, preparation method thereof and display device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure provides a display substrate, a preparation method thereof and a display device. A display substrate comprising a pixel region, the display substrate comprising: a substrate base plate; the passivation layer is positioned on one side of the substrate base plate; the plurality of strip electrodes are positioned on one side of the passivation layer, which is far away from the substrate base plate, and are positioned in the pixel area, and the plurality of strip electrodes are sequentially arranged at intervals; the compensation layer comprises a filling part positioned between two adjacent strip electrodes, and at least in the pixel area, the surface of one side of each strip electrode, which is far away from the substrate base plate, is flush with the surface of one side of the filling part, which is far away from the substrate base plate, and a flat surface is formed; and the alignment layer is positioned on one side of the filling part and the strip-shaped electrodes, which is deviated from the substrate base plate. According to the technical scheme, the alignment layer in the pixel region is formed on the flat surface, so that the alignment uniformity in the pixel region is improved, the brightness of the display panel in a dark state is reduced, and the contrast of the display panel is improved.

title_en: 1.7 mu m mode-locked fiber laser based on GaSb single crystal semiconductor composite optical fiber
abstract_en: The invention relates to a 1.7 mu m mode-locked fiber laser based on a GaSb monocrystal semiconductor composite fiber, which comprises a pumping source, a wavelength division multiplexer, a resonant cavity and an isolator, wherein the pumping source is connected with the wavelength division multiplexer; the resonant cavity comprises a dichroic mirror, a gain optical fiber and a saturable absorber which are connected in sequence; pumping light emitted by the pumping source enters the resonant cavity through the wavelength division multiplexer, mode locking laser pulses are generated by utilizing the saturable absorption effect of a saturable absorber, and the mode locking laser pulses sequentially pass through the wavelength division multiplexer and the isolator and then are output; wherein the gain fiber is a GaSb single crystal semiconductor composite fiber. The 1.7 mu m mode-locked fiber laser is of an all-fiber linear cavity structure, is simple and compact in structure, can stably run for a long time, is easy to operate, and can realize the mode-locked laser output of 1.7 mu m wave bands with different repetition frequencies.

title_en: Night vision device and aiming device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a night vision device and aiming equipment, wherein the night vision device comprises a lens barrel, an imaging module, a switching structure, an infrared light source module and a display module, the lens barrel comprises an inner cavity and a mounting port which is positioned at the front end of the lens barrel and is communicated with the inner cavity, the imaging module is mounted in the inner cavity and comprises a lens assembly and an image sensor assembly which are arranged along the axis of the lens barrel, the switching structure comprises an infrared mounting seat and an inner ring which are integrally arranged, the inner ring is fixedly embedded in the inner side of the mounting port, the lens assembly is positioned between the inner ring and the image sensor assembly, the infrared mounting seat protrudes out of the outer peripheral surface of the lens barrel along the radial direction of the lens barrel, the infrared light source module is mounted on the infrared mounting seat, the display module is electrically connected with the image sensor assembly, and the display module is fixedly mounted on the infrared mounting seat. The night vision device can effectively improve the night vision effect when being carried on the white light sighting telescope for use, simplify the installation steps and improve the installation efficiency.

title_en: High-water-pressure-resistant diving photography buoyancy arm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-water-pressure-resistant diving photography buoyancy arm, which comprises a high-water-pressure-resistant diving photography buoyancy arm body, the body of the device comprises a connecting ball head, a metal cover, a carbon fiber pipe, a buffer rubber ring, a thick sealing rubber ring, a thin sealing rubber ring and a connecting screw rod, wherein connect the bulb including circular through-hole, buffering rubber ring mounting groove, the blind hole thread, base and bulb, the metal covering includes interior mounting groove, thick sealing rubber ring heavy groove, thin sealing rubber ring heavy groove and metal covering extension inner wall, carbon fiber pipe divide into carbon fiber pipe upper plane and carbon fiber pipe lower plane, thick sealing rubber ring and thin sealing rubber ring are equipped with respectively to the inside and outside two sides heavy groove of metal covering, it compresses tightly thick sealing rubber ring to connect bulb and metal covering to meet, connecting screw can pass the connection bulb blind hole thread at metal covering and carbon fiber pipe locking both ends, two metal coverings compress tightly with two upper and lower plane equipment of carbon fiber pipe respectively. The product of the invention can prevent looseness, prevent leakage, resist high water pressure, increase buoyancy, and has the advantages of high strength of the metal cover and the carbon fiber, corrosion resistance and long service life.

title_en: Multicomponent oxide glass, optical element, optical fiber, and method for producing multicomponent oxide glass
abstract_en: Provided is a glass which can be stably produced without requiring a special operation and which has excellent solarization resistance. A multicomponent oxide glass characterized by having a composition comprising: siO  2 : 45-53 mol%, B  2 O 3 : 22 to 30 mol% of Al  2 O 3 : 5 to 9 mol% of Sb  2 O 3 : 0.02 to 0.10 mol%, li  2  O:0 to 18 mol%, na  2  O:0 to 18 mol%, K  2  O:0 to 18 mol%, mgO:0 to 13 mol% of CaO:0 to 13 mol% of BaO:0 to 13 mol% and ZnO:0 to 13 mol%; when the total content of Li  2 O、Na 2  O and K  2  O is X (mol%) and the total content of MgO, caO, baO and ZnO is Y (mol%), 11.ltoreq.X.ltoreq.18 and 14.ltoreq.X+Y.ltoreq.24 are satisfied, and the value of βOH calculated from the formula βOH=α/t is 4cm-1 or more, where α represents the height (-) of an absorption peak caused by OH groups present in the range of 3400cm  ‑1 ～3800cm ‑1  of the infrared absorption spectrum, and t represents the thickness (cm) of the glass.

title_en: Bottom anti-reflection coating composition, preparation method thereof and microelectronic structure forming method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of photoresist, and relates to a bottom anti-reflection coating composition, a preparation method thereof and a forming method of a microelectronic structure. The bottom anti-reflection coating composition contains a modified rigid organic cage compound, a vinyl ether compound and an organic solvent, wherein the modified rigid organic cage compound is obtained by modifying and converting part of phenolic hydroxyl groups in the rigid organic cage compound into modified groups, and the general formula of the modified groups is-O-R  1  ，R  1  Is a chromophore, an acid labile group, an acidic group, or a non-functional group; the vinyl ether compound has more than two vinyl ether end groups. The bottom anti-reflective coating composition provided by the invention is not soluble in an organic solvent or a photoresist alkaline developer after being heated and crosslinked, but can be decrosslinked after being exposed in the presence of acid, so that an exposed part can be removed by the alkaline developer, but an unexposed part is not removed, and the residue of the bottom anti-reflective coating after being developed can be reduced.

title_en: Manufacturing method of 3D micro-image-text based on micro-lens array
abstract_en: A manufacturing method of 3D micro-graphics based on micro-lens array comprises the following steps: (1) Manufacturing a micro-lens array optical film, wherein the micro-lens array on the micro-lens array optical film is based on regular hexagonal aperture and honeycomb arrangement; (2) According to the period of the micro lens array and the requirement of moire fringe pattern display effect, designing a micro image-text array, and then manufacturing a printing plate according to the designed micro image-text array; (3) Printing a micro-graphic array on the micro-lens array optical film using a printing plate. According to the invention, the micro-lens array is arranged based on regular hexagonal apertures and honeycombs, and the moire fringes of the micro-lens array arranged based on regular hexagonal apertures and honeycombs are analyzed and applied to the 3D micro-image-text design and printing process based on the micro-lens array, so that the naked eye 3D display effect of the micro-lens array arranged based on regular hexagonal apertures and honeycombs is improved.

title_en: Different-color glass, manufacturing method of different-color glass and light guide plate
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application relates to different-color glass, a manufacturing method of the different-color glass and a light guide plate, and belongs to the technical field of glass. The embodiment of the application aims at solving the problems that the color types of the heterochromatic glass are limited, the processing process is complex and the service life is limited in the related technology. The heterochromatic glass comprises the following components in percentage by mass: 64.5-72.0% of silicon dioxide, 0.1-3.5% of aluminum oxide, 0.4-2.6% of phosphorus oxide, 9.3-12.7% of sodium oxide, 6.0-12.5% of calcium oxide, 0.1-1.0% of magnesium oxide, 2.0-4.5% of barium peroxide and 0.2-4.5% of nano-structure toner. The heterochromatic glass that this application embodiment provided can increase the variety of colour kind, has reduced heterochromatic glass course of working's complexity simultaneously, and has prolonged heterochromatic glass's life.

title_en: High-brightness shielding and low-deformation quantum dot diffusion plate and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-brightness shielding and low-deformation quantum dot diffusion plate and a preparation method and application thereof. The quantum dot diffusion plate comprises the following components in parts by weight: 100 parts of resin base material, 5-20 parts of glass fiber, 0.1-1 part of quantum dot, 0.2-1 part of weather-resistant agent, 0.3-2 parts of antioxidant and 1-2 parts of lubricant; the refractive index of the glass fiber is 1.4-1.58, and the average diameter is 7-17 μm. According to the invention, the glass fiber with specific refractive index and diameter is selected as the light diffusion medium, introduced into the diffusion plate, and combined with the quantum dot technology, the linear expansion coefficient of the quantum dot light diffusion plate can be obviously reduced, the deformation resistance is improved, and the quantum dot diffusion plate has higher brightness and haze value.

title_en: Backlight module and display panel with same
abstract_en: The invention provides a backlight module and a display panel with the backlight module, wherein the backlight module comprises a box dam structure, the box dam structure comprises a plurality of first box dams, the first box dams are arranged on a substrate, and a plurality of mounting areas are formed by the first box dams at intervals; the light sources are arranged on the substrate, and each mounting area is internally provided with the light source, wherein the light quantity reflected by the first box dam positioned on one side of the light source in each mounting area is larger than the light quantity reflected by the first box dam positioned on the other side of the light source. The invention provides a backlight module, which is characterized in that a dam structure with a light control function is manufactured on the surface of the backlight module and is used for meeting the requirements of a special display screen on optical visual angles and brightness.

title_en: Method for producing copolymer
abstract_en: Provided is a method for producing a copolymer wherein the molecular weight of a resin is controlled to a low molecular weight side. The copolymer of the present invention is produced by a method comprising the step of adding an olefinPolymerization of a compound of a saturated group comprising: mixing a polymerization initiator with a solvent to obtain a reaction solution 1; preparing a reaction solution 2 containing an ethylenically unsaturated group-containing compound; and a step of dropping and mixing the reaction solution 1 and the reaction solution 2 into the reactor. The concentration of the polymerization initiator in the reaction solution 1 is 16 to 50% by mass. The polymerization initiator contains 60% by mass or more of the isomer having a high solubility among the isomers composed of the racemic body and the meso body contained in the polymerization initiator. The polymerization initiator is a compound represented by the following general formula (1). In the formula (1), R 1 、R 2 : c1-6 alkyl or CN group, and R 1 And R 2 Different; r 3 、R 4 : c1-6 alkyl; r 5 : H. c1-6 alkoxy.

title_en: Optical fiber connection box, data processing method and computer storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an optical fiber connection box, a data processing method and a computer storage medium. The optical fiber connection box comprises: the optical splitter is arranged in the connecting box body, a first optical fiber connecting joint used for being connected with the line direction unit and a second optical fiber connecting joint used for being connected with the local on-off unit are arranged on the connecting box body, the optical splitter is connected between the first optical fiber connecting joint and the second optical fiber connecting joint, and the number of wire cores of the second optical fiber connecting joint is smaller than that of the first optical fiber connecting joint. The optical fiber connection box has higher compatibility.

title_en: Method and system for preparing device with grooves with different depths
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a method and a system for preparing devices with different depth grooves, which are used in the field of semiconductor manufacturing or the field of digital storage. The method in the embodiment of the application comprises the following steps: and exposing and processing the protective materials on the surfaces of different areas in the substrate material by using particle beams with different doses, and etching the substrate material by using the exposed protective materials as masks to obtain grooves with different depths. The scheme can reduce the photoetching times in the preparation process of the groove device and reduce the production cost.

title_en: Method for preparing local three-dimensional microstructure optical fiber
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a method for preparing a local three-dimensional microstructure optical fiber, which comprises the following steps: s1, preparing a sodium borosilicate glass rod; s2, preparing three-dimensional glass fiber; s3, preparing three-dimensional quartz glass fiber; and S4, preparing the local three-dimensional microstructure optical fiber. According to the invention, the operation is simple, the three-dimensional microstructure optical fibers in various forms can be obtained, and the production cost is obviously reduced.

title_en: Resin curing device for nanoimprint
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a resin curing apparatus for nanoimprinting, including: a light irradiation section that irradiates light so as to cure the resin to which the pattern is transferred; and a light shielding portion disposed to project from the light irradiation portion to shield light irradiated to the resin in a superimposed manner due to diffusion of the light irradiated to the resin.

title_en: Optical cable outlet joint assembly of aluminum alloy groove box of transformer substation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of optical cables, and discloses an optical cable outlet joint assembly of an aluminum alloy groove box of a transformer substation. In the optical cable outlet joint assembly of the aluminum alloy groove box of the transformer substation, the first threading pipe and the second threading pipe can guide the optical cable to extend out of the aluminum alloy groove box, and as the optical cable is supported by the first threading pipe or the second threading pipe, the position is fixed, the optical cable cannot move randomly and cannot be directly contacted with the notch of the aluminum alloy groove box, so that the outer skin cannot be damaged, and the normal transmission of the optical cable is ensured.

title_en: Backlight module and display device
abstract_en: The invention provides a backlight module and a display device, the backlight module comprises a light guide plate, a reflection assembly, a reflection reducing assembly and a light source, wherein the light guide plate comprises a surface which is provided with a main area and a peripheral area surrounding the main area, the reflection assembly is adjacent to the surface and is arranged corresponding to the main area, the reflection reducing assembly is adjacent to the surface and is arranged corresponding to the peripheral area, the light source emits light to one side edge of the light guide plate, and in addition, the reflectivity of the reflection reducing assembly is smaller than that of the reflection assembly.

title_en: Film-coated substrate and display system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coated substrate and a display system, and relates to the technical field of display; the film plating substrate comprises a substrate base plate and optical film components, wherein any optical film component comprises N groups of optical films which are stacked, and any group of optical films comprises a layer of first-type optical film and a layer of second-type optical film; the refractive index of the first type of optical film is smaller than that of the second type of optical film, and the first type of optical film and the second type of optical film are alternately arranged; the refractive index of the first type of optical film in the optical film assembly is gradually increased along the direction away from the substrate, and the refractive index of the second type of optical film is gradually increased or the refractive indexes of the second type of optical film are the same; or, the refractive index of the first type of optical film in the optical film assembly gradually decreases, and the refractive index of the second type of optical film gradually decreases or is the same; the method is beneficial to improving the reflection effect of the coating substrate on the picture and improving the visual experience effect of the user under the condition that the user obtains the external scene through the coating substrate.

title_en: Mode converter
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mode converter, which is formed by cascading a first mode converter and a second mode converter, wherein an optical signal of a TE  0  mode is transmitted to the first mode converter from a first transmission waveguide, the first mode converter converts the optical signal of a TE  0  mode into the optical signal of a TE  1  mode, the parity check of the mode before and after the conversion of the TE  0  mode into the TE  1  mode is opposite, so that the first mode converter breaks the parity check by adopting an asymmetric structure, the optical signal of the TE  1  mode is transmitted to the second mode converter through a second transmission waveguide, the second mode converter converts the optical signal of the TE  1  mode into the optical signal of the TE  3  mode, and the parity check is not required to be destroyed because the parity check of the mode before and after the conversion of the TE  1  mode into the TE  3  mode is identical.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted holographic display device
abstract_en: The invention provides a vehicle-mounted holographic display device, which comprises an image projection device, a holographic display device and a control device, wherein the image projection device is used for generating a real image and generating a laser beam; the processing module is positioned on one side of the image projection device and comprises a light splitting unit, and the light splitting unit is used for splitting the laser beam and generating a first light path and a second light path; the reflecting unit is positioned on one side of the processing module and receives the first light path; the imaging lens is positioned on the propagation paths of the first light path and the second light path and converts the real image into an amplified virtual image; the lengths of the optical paths of the first optical path and the second optical path are the same, and the first optical path and the second optical path contain the same wavefront information. The invention can effectively solve the problem that the prior head-up display has small visual range.

title_en: Breeze generator with holographic fan screen
abstract_en: The invention discloses a breeze generator with a holographic fan screen, which comprises a generator main body and the holographic fan screen, wherein the holographic fan screen is arranged on the generator main body, the generator main body comprises a generator cabin, generator blades and a generator tower pole, the holographic fan screen comprises a rotating motor and a projection pole, and the rotating motor drives the projection pole to rotate when being electrified. The breeze generator with the holographic fan screen can display the three-dimensional image through the holographic fan screen arranged on the breeze generator, and the display effect is better.

title_en: Color film substrate and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a color film substrate and a preparation method thereof, wherein the color film substrate comprises a substrate and a color filter layer arranged above the substrate, the color filter layer comprises barrier parts arranged at intervals, color barrier parts arranged between adjacent barrier parts and a shading part arranged on the surface of one side of the barrier parts far away from the substrate, wherein the preparation material of the barrier parts is a hydrophobic transparent material; the blocking part is made of a hydrophobic transparent material, so that light rays passing through the color blocking layer can be emitted from the blocking part, and the light emitting visual angle is increased.

title_en: Optical lens, camera module and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optical lens, a camera module and electronic equipment, wherein the optical lens comprises a first lens, a second lens, a third lens, a fourth lens, a fifth lens, a sixth lens, a seventh lens and an eighth lens; the first lens element with positive refractive power, the second lens element with positive refractive power, the third lens element with negative refractive power, the fourth lens element with refractive power, the fifth lens element with refractive power, the sixth lens element with positive refractive power, the seventh lens element with positive refractive power, and the eighth lens element with negative refractive power. The optical lens, the camera module and the electronic equipment provided by the invention can realize the miniaturization design of the optical lens, simultaneously have the characteristics of high resolution and high imaging definition, and realize the high-definition imaging requirement of the optical lens.

title_en: Semiconductor laser element, method for manufacturing the same, and semiconductor laser device
abstract_en: The semiconductor device comprises a semiconductor layer composed of an n-type cladding layer (102) formed on the surface of an n-type GaAs substrate (101), an active layer (103) formed on the surface of the n-type cladding layer (102), a p-type cladding layer (104) formed on the surface of the active layer (103) and having ridges (104 a, 105 a), and a p-type contact layer (105) formed on the surface of the p-type cladding layer (104), insulating films (150 a, 150 b) covering the surface of the semiconductor layer and having openings on the surface of the p-type contact layer (105 a), and a conductive layer connected to the p-type contact layer (105 a) through the openings and formed on the surface of the insulating layer (150 b) until a flat portion provided on the semiconductor layer adjacent to the ridges, wherein the conductive layer is provided with convex side walls on the flat portion adjacent to the ridges, and the side walls limit the expansion of solder in the vicinity of the non-light-emitting region, thereby preventing electrical shorting between the elements.

title_en: Multichannel polarization maintaining switch structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-channel polarization maintaining switch structure, and relates to the technical field of communication. The multi-channel polarization-maintaining switch structure comprises a polarization-maintaining optical fiber array, an optical waveguide array, a lens and a rotating mirror, wherein the optical waveguide array is arranged on one side of the polarization-maintaining optical fiber array, the lens is arranged on one side of the optical waveguide array, which is far away from the polarization-maintaining optical fiber array, the rotating mirror is arranged on one side of the lens, one polarization-maintaining optical fiber of the polarization-maintaining optical fiber array is an incident optical fiber, the other polarization-maintaining optical fibers are emergent optical fibers, the waveguide interval on one side of the optical waveguide array is the same as the optical fiber interval of the polarization-maintaining optical fiber array, and the waveguide interval on the other side is smaller than the optical fiber interval of the polarization-maintaining optical fiber array. The optical waveguide array has good consistency of a plurality of waveguides, and can well keep the polarization states of a plurality of polarization-maintaining optical fibers, so that the optical waveguide array can well keep the polarization consistency of the polarization-maintaining optical fiber array while realizing the compression of the optical path spacing.
