title_en: Optical waveguide packaging structure, packaging method thereof and augmented reality optical device
abstract_en: The application provides an optical waveguide packaging structure, a packaging method thereof and an augmented reality optical device, relates to the technical field of optics, and can adapt to different working environments and realize a long-time stable image combination display effect. The optical waveguide packaging structure comprises a hard frame and at least two layers of optical waveguides fixedly arranged on the hard frame in a laminated mode, wherein the hard frame is at least located on one side edge of each optical waveguide, a gap layer is arranged between every two adjacent layers of optical waveguides, the optical waveguides and the hard frame are fixedly adhered through an adhesive, the adhesive is adhered to the peripheral area of each optical waveguide along a closed path, an included angle is formed between every two adjacent layers of optical waveguides, an elastic structure is arranged on the hard frame and at least corresponds to one gap layer between every two adjacent layers of optical waveguides, and the elastic structure is stressed and deformed to keep air pressure balance between the two sides of the elastic structure.

title_en: Head-mounted device
abstract_en: The application provides a head-mounted device, and relates to the technical field of intelligent devices. The head-mounted device comprises a main machine shell, a tightness adjusting mechanism and a lacing assembly, wherein the lacing assembly comprises two headband bodies and two headband covers: the two headband main bodies are connected with the two ends of the main machine shell and the two ends of the tightness adjusting mechanism; the two headband covers are buckled with the two headband bodies, so that radiating fins extending into the host shell are clamped between the headband covers and the headband bodies which are buckled with each other, the distance from one end of each headband cover, which is close to the tightness adjusting mechanism, to one end of the tightness adjusting mechanism, which is close to the headband cover, is variable, and the variable distance is adjusted by the tightness adjusting mechanism. The application utilizes the matching of the tightness adjusting mechanism and the two headband bodies, so that the distance from one end of each headband cover close to the tightness adjusting mechanism to one end of the tightness adjusting mechanism close to the headband cover can be adjusted.

title_en: Electronic device, control method of electronic device, and computer-readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to an electronic device, a control method of the electronic device, and a computer-readable storage medium. The electronic device of the present invention includes: a receiving unit for receiving a line-of-sight input; and a control unit for moving the selection position on the display unit according to the line-of-sight input or the first operation to the operation unit, the control unit displaying an item indicating a range of a first size in a first case where the selection position is specified based on the line-of-sight input but the first operation is not performed to the operation unit, the control unit displaying an item indicating a range of a second size smaller than the first size in a second case where the selection position is specified based on the line-of-sight input and the first operation is performed to the operation unit, the object being selected according to the second operation based on a predetermined condition in the first case, and the object being selected according to the second operation not based on the predetermined condition in the second case.

title_en: Video projection apparatus
abstract_en: An object of the present invention is to provide a video projection apparatus capable of obtaining a satisfactory video (image) while achieving reduction in power consumption and size of the apparatus. There is provided a video projection apparatus equipped with at least a monolithic semiconductor laser array having a plurality of light emitting units that respectively emit laser light, an optical waveguide that guides the laser light in a predetermined direction, a mirror that performs scanning with the laser light on two axes, and a diffraction element that diffracts the laser beam in a specific direction in front of an eye and projects the laser beam onto a retina, each of the plurality of light emitting units being optically coupled to a mutually different one of a plurality of incident ports of the optical waveguide.

title_en: Display device
abstract_en: A display device, comprising: a base substrate (100); a plurality of sub-pixels (200) on a substrate (100); and a light splitting structure (300) configured to direct image light emitted by the plurality of sub-pixels (200) to different viewpoint regions, the light splitting structure (300) including a plurality of light splitting sections (310) arranged in a row direction and extending in a column direction. Each sub-pixel (200) comprises a plurality of display units (202) arranged along a row direction, a plurality of sub-pixels (200) are arranged into a plurality of sub-pixel row groups (2000), the plurality of sub-pixel row groups (2000) extend along the row direction and are arranged along a column direction, each sub-pixel row group (2000) comprises at least two rows of sub-pixels (200), a space (201) is arranged between two adjacent sub-pixels (200) in each row of sub-pixels (200), and the sub-pixels (200) in two adjacent rows in each sub-pixel row group (2000) are staggered with each other in the row direction to enable the spaces (201) between the sub-pixels (200) in one row of sub-pixels (200) and the sub-pixels (200) in the other row of sub-pixels (200) to be overlapped in the column direction; the ratio of the size of each light splitting part (310) along the row direction to the pitch of the sub-pixels (200) is 0.9 to 1.1, and the brightness compensation at the intervals of the sub-pixels (200) which emit light discontinuously can be realized to eliminate moire fringes.

title_en: Low-loss silicon-based laser capable of being monolithically integrated and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a low-loss silicon-based laser capable of being monolithically integrated and a preparation method thereof, which comprises the following steps from bottom to top: the laser comprises a silicon substrate of an SOI substrate, a silicon dioxide insulating layer, a substrate formed by a top layer intrinsic silicon and a germanium thin film layer, a buffer layer, a lower contact layer, a quantum dot or quantum well active region, an upper cover layer, a III-V laser formed by an upper contact layer and a silicon nitride waveguide. The invention generates laser output by electric pumping or optical pumping, and the emergent laser is directly aligned with the silicon nitride waveguide on the SOI, thereby obtaining high coupling efficiency; the device has compact structure and low coupling loss of signal laser and waveguide, can realize the preparation of quantum dots or quantum well lasers on the SOI substrate compatible with the CMOS process, is suitable for the development of silicon-based optoelectronic integration lacking a core light source, and has wide application prospect.

title_en: Backlight module and display panel
abstract_en: The application discloses a backlight module and a display panel, wherein the backlight module comprises a light guide plate, a fixing piece and a lamp strip; the side surface of the light guide plate comprises a light incident surface; the fixing piece comprises a body and a protruding part arranged on the body; the body is arranged on one side of the light incident surface of the light guide plate and is arranged at intervals with the light incident surface; the light bar is arranged on the body and is arranged at intervals with the light incident surface; along the length direction of the light bar, the length of the protruding part is smaller than that of the body; the bulge is contacted with the end part of the light guide plate, which is close to the light bar, and the light bar and the fixing piece displace along with the expansion or contraction of the light guide plate so as to keep the distance between the light bar and the light incident surface of the light guide plate, so that the too small distance between the light bar and the light incident surface of the light guide plate caused by the expansion of the light guide plate can be avoided, and further the light bar is prevented from being extruded.

title_en: Self-supervised characterization learning for OCD data interpretation
abstract_en: A system and method for OCD metering is provided, comprising: receiving a plurality of first sets of scatter data, grouping each set into k subvectors, and training in a self-supervised manner, mapping each of the k subvectors to k of each other  2  An automatic encoder neural network. Subsequently, a plurality of sets of respective reference parameters and a plurality of corresponding second sets of scatter data are received and a transfer Neural Network (NN) is trained. The initial layer comprises k  2  Parallel arrangement of individual encoder neural networks. The target outputs of the transfer NN training are set to a plurality of sets of reference parameters and the feature inputs are set to a plurality of corresponding second sets of scattering data, such that the transfer NN is trained to estimate new wafer pattern parameters from subsequently measured sets of scattering data.

title_en: Display panel and display device
abstract_en: A display panel, comprising: set up at array substrate (10) and to box base plate (20) between spacer group (PSG), spacer group (PSG) includes: the display panel comprises a first spacer (PS1) arranged on an array substrate (10), wherein the orthographic projection of the first spacer (PS1) on the array substrate (10) is a first pattern extending along a first direction; a second spacer (PS2) arranged on the opposite box substrate (20), wherein the orthographic projection of the second spacer (PS2) on the array substrate (10) is a second pattern extending along a second direction; at least two third spacers (PS3), wherein orthographic projections of the third spacers on the array substrate (10) are respectively positioned on two sides of the first graph along the first direction; at least two fourth spacers (PS4), wherein orthographic projections of the fourth spacers on the array substrate (10) are respectively positioned on two sides of the second pattern along the second direction; one of the third spacer (PS3) and the fourth spacer (PS4) is arranged on the array substrate (10), and the other is arranged on the opposite box substrate (20); the size of the third spacer (PS3) in the second direction is larger than that of the first spacer (PS1), and the size of the fourth spacer (PS4) in the first direction is larger than that of the second spacer (PS 2).

title_en: Projection arrangement with adjustable intelligence teaching
abstract_en: The invention discloses an adjustable projection device for intelligent teaching, which comprises a shell, a mounting seat and a rack shell: the top end of the shell is provided with a shell cover, the bottom end of the interior of the shell is provided with a projector, the placing frame is provided with two placement frames which are correspondingly arranged at the rear side of the interior of the shell in the left-right direction, a heat dissipation fan is placed in the interior of the placing frame, motors are arranged on the two sides of the interior of the mounting seat, the output shafts of the motors are connected with the inner side ends of the screw rods, the screw rods are in threaded connection with screw holes in the top end of a bracket, the bracket is sleeved on the outer side of the shell, the top end of the mounting seat is provided with an adjusting assembly, the left side and the right side of the shell are provided with insect prevention assemblies, and a fixing assembly is arranged in the shell; wherein: still include the controller, the bottom at the shell is established to the controller, the output of motor, heat dissipation fan and projector's input electric connection controller, this intelligent teaching's adjustable projection arrangement makes things convenient for the dismouting, is convenient for adjust, and the practicality is strong.

title_en: Double-layer super surface capable of realizing nano printing encryption
abstract_en: The invention discloses a double-layer super surface capable of realizing nano printing encryption. The double-layer super surface comprises a first super surface and a second super surface, the first super surface and the second super surface are both composed of periodic unit structures, each unit structure is composed of a nano brick and a substrate, the nano bricks on the first super surface have two different sizes, and the unit structures respectively play a role of a transmission type polaroid and a transmission type half-wave plate for incident light; the nano-brick on the second super-surface has the function of a transmission type polaroid for incident light. The first super surface and the second super surface respectively modulate polarization and intensity of incident light, transmitted light is polarized and spatially distributed after passing through the first super surface but does not display intensity information, information is encrypted into the transmitted light in a polarization state, and the intensity of the transmitted light after passing through the second super surface is modulated to display the encrypted information. The invention can be applied to the fields of information encryption, anti-counterfeiting and the like, and provides a new method for high-efficiency and safe information transmission.

title_en: Plasmon amplitude tuner based on rhodium-silicon dioxide nano composite structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a plasmon amplitude tuner based on a rhodium-silicon dioxide nano composite structure, and belongs to the technical field of plasmon amplitude tuners. The rhodium nanorod array antenna comprises a dielectric material and a precious metal material, wherein the center of the dielectric material and the center of the precious metal material are overlapped, the dielectric material is a silicon dioxide nanometer circular ring, the precious metal material is a cylindrical rhodium nanorod, and the rhodium nanorod is rotatably arranged inside the silicon dioxide nanometer circular ring. The invention has the beneficial effects that: by changing the rotation angle theta of the rhodium nanorod, the amplitude intensity in the absorption cross-section spectral curve can be efficiently adjusted.

title_en: Small-sized infrared lens capable of eliminating heat difference
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of infrared optics, and discloses a small-sized infrared lens for eliminating heat difference. The lens comprises a first lens and a second lens which are coaxially arranged in sequence from an object side to an image side; the first lens is a meniscus lens with positive focal power and a convex surface facing the object side; the second lens is a meniscus lens with positive focal power and a convex surface facing the image side; the first lens and the second lens are made of chalcogenide glass. The lens only adopts two lenses, and has compact structure and small volume; the lens materials are all chalcogenide glass, so that the lens is convenient to produce, easy to produce in batches and low in production cost; the distortion is small and can be controlled below 0.1%; the heat stability is good, and the wide temperature requirement of the working environment of-40 ℃ to 80 ℃ can be met; the working wave band of the small athermal infrared lens is 8-12 mu m, and the small athermal infrared lens can be matched with a detector with the resolution of 256 multiplied by 192 and 12 mu m for use.

title_en: Imprint method, imprint lithography system, and article manufacturing method
abstract_en: The invention relates to an imprint method, an imprint lithography system, and a method of manufacturing an article. The present disclosure provides methods and systems for imprinting a substrate supported on a movable stage, the methods and systems including contacting a liquid resist on the substrate with a template and aligning the substrate with the template using a feedback-feedforward control process with a first set of control parameters. Calibration data is obtained and the viscosity of at least a portion of the resist is increased. After increasing the viscosity of the resist, the substrate is aligned with the template using the feedback-feedforward control process using a second set of control parameters, the second set of control parameters is determined based on the calibration data, and the resist below the template is cured.

title_en: Multi-laser independent control-based multi-channel parallel direct-writing photoetching system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-channel parallel direct-writing photoetching system and a method based on multi-laser independent control, which relate to the technical field of optics correlation and comprise a semiconductor laser group, a single-mode optical fiber group, an optical fiber array, an f-theta lens, an objective lens, a multi-channel control bus and a multi-channel arbitrary waveform generator; the semiconductor laser group is connected with the multichannel arbitrary waveform generator through the multichannel control bus; the semiconductor laser group is connected with the optical fiber array through the single-mode optical fiber group; the surface of the optical fiber array is arranged on the focal plane of the f-theta lens; the objective lens receives the light emitted by the f-theta lens and processes the light into a lattice light field; the invention uses a plurality of independent semiconductor lasers controlled by the multi-channel arbitrary waveform generator as the exciting light source, and directly adopts parallel signals to modulate the on-off and the intensity of the light source, thereby simplifying the structure of the direct-writing photoetching system and improving the processing efficiency of light beams.

title_en: Image forming apparatus
abstract_en: An image forming apparatus. The driving unit is controlled such that a driving state in which the image bearing member is driven with a first potential difference formed between the brush member and the image bearing member at a contact portion where the image bearing member is in contact with the brush member transitions to a stop state in which the image bearing member is stopped from being driven with a second potential difference formed, an absolute value of the second potential difference being smaller than an absolute value of the first potential difference.

title_en: Super-surface broadband wave absorber of visible-near infrared wave band and preparation method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of wave absorbers, and particularly relates to a super-surface broadband wave absorber with visible-near infrared bands and a preparation method thereof. The super-surface broadband wave absorber is simple in structure, the patterned metal layer is of simple square and rectangular sheet structures, the difficulty of photoetching, stripping and other steps in a photoetching process is reduced in the process of preparing the wave absorber according to the layer sequence, the requirement on the preparation process is low, the impedance matching characteristic of the super-surface broadband wave absorber and a background medium is improved through the impedance matching layer, the reflection of light on the surface of a material is reduced, incident light can be coupled into a metamaterial with higher efficiency, surface plasma resonance is better excited, the optical field local capacity is enhanced, and therefore the absorption efficiency and the absorption bandwidth are increased.

title_en: Optical imaging lens
abstract_en: The application discloses an optical imaging lens, which sequentially comprises the following components from an object side to an image side along an optical axis: a first lens having positive optical power; a second lens having negative optical power; a third lens having positive optical power; a fourth lens having negative optical power; a fifth lens having positive optical power; a sixth lens having positive optical power; and a seventh lens having negative optical power. The total effective focal length f of the optical imaging lens and the maximum half field angle Semi-FOV of the optical imaging lens satisfy the following conditions: f×tan (Semi-FOV) is not less than 5.0mm; and the entrance pupil diameter EPD of the optical imaging lens and the center thickness CT1 of the first lens on the optical axis satisfy: EPD/CT1 is less than or equal to 2.3 and less than 3.0.

title_en: Backlight module and display module
abstract_en: The application provides a backlight module and a display module, wherein the backlight module comprises a back plate assembly, an optical diaphragm, a light-emitting substrate and a circuit board module, wherein the optical diaphragm and the light-emitting substrate are arranged on the back plate assembly, and the back plate assembly is provided with a mounting groove; the circuit board module is arranged in the mounting groove. The problem of current display holistic thickness is thick has been solved in this application.

title_en: Survey and drawing geographic information display device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a surveying and mapping geographic information display device, which comprises a display board main body, a curtain rolling assembly, supporting columns, a folding assembly, a base and a lifting and moving assembly, wherein the curtain rolling assembly is fixed on the outer wall of one side of the display board main body; the curtain winding assembly comprises a sliding chute, a spring, a mounting square rod and a winding groove; when the curtain is not used, the curtain can be rolled and protected, and the curtain is prevented from being damaged by the outside, so that the curtain is favorable for continuous use; when the equipment is not used, the equipment can be folded, so that the equipment is prevented from occupying a lot of use space, the storage of the device is facilitated, and the use effect of the device is improved.

title_en: Optical proximity correction method and system, mask, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: An optical proximity correction method and system, a mask, a device and a storage medium are provided, the optical proximity correction method comprises the following steps: providing a design pattern comprising a plurality of main patterns, wherein concave corners are formed between at least part of adjacent main patterns; generating a corner additional graph in the main graph corresponding to the vertex of the concave corner based on a design rule and a mask writing rule; based on the target graph, carrying out optical proximity effect correction on the design graph to obtain a corrected graph; photoetching simulation is carried out on the corrected graph, and whether edge placement errors corresponding to the concave corners in the corrected graph meet preset standards or not is judged; and when the edge placement error corresponding to the concave corner does not meet the preset standard, trimming the corrected graph to trim and remove the corner additional graph corresponding to the concave corner from the corrected graph. The embodiment of the invention is beneficial to reducing the edge placement error at the concave corner.

title_en: Composite microlens design for reducing hyperopic peripheral defocus
abstract_en: An ophthalmic lens is disclosed that includes composite microlenses arranged in a pattern. The compound microlens includes an on-axis microlens and an off-axis sub-microlens positioned on the on-axis microlens. The off-axis sub-lenslets have different optical functions than the on-axis micro-lenslets. By selecting an appropriate compound microlens design, the addition of microlenses with sub-lenslets around the perimeter of the main structure optimizes the eyeglass lenses for myopia prevention, vertigo prevention, or any other vision-related condition.

title_en: Electronic paper display panel and display device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides an electronic paper display panel and a display device, comprising: a plurality of pixel circuits and a control circuit; the control circuit is connected with the common electrode through a first electrostatic ring circuit; the first electrostatic ring circuit includes: a first thin film transistor, a second thin film transistor, a third thin film transistor, and a fourth thin film transistor. In the embodiment of the invention, the grid electrode and the drain electrode of the fourth thin film transistor are connected, so that the voltage difference between the grid electrode and the drain electrode of the fourth thin film transistor is zero, when a large voltage is applied to the control circuit, the voltage can be obviously reduced through the first electrostatic ring circuit, in addition, as the grid electrodes of the second thin film transistor and the third thin film transistor are in a suspended state, the current cannot pass through, the influence of the leakage current of the control circuit flowing into the common electrode on the voltage of the common electrode can be avoided, the display quality of the electronic paper display panel is improved, and the release of the first electrostatic ring circuit on static electricity is reserved.

title_en: Optical element, monitoring system and method thereof, active light emitting module and terminal
abstract_en: The invention provides an optical element, a monitoring system and a monitoring method thereof, an active light-emitting module and a terminal, relates to the technical field of electronic terminal equipment, and can monitor whether an optical element such as a diffraction optical component or a light-homogenizing sheet in the active light-emitting module is damaged or falls off in real time, and turn off a laser when the optical element is damaged or falls off, so that laser leakage is avoided. The monitoring system of the optical element comprises the optical element, and a microprocessor, a power supply and a laser which are sequentially connected, wherein the optical element is provided with a detection line, and two ends of the detection line are respectively connected with the microprocessor. The microprocessor is configured to monitor the resistance value of the detection line or the voltage values at two ends of the detection line in real time, judge whether the optical element is damaged or fallen according to the monitored resistance value or voltage value, and control the power supply to stop supplying power to the laser when the optical element is judged to be damaged or fallen.

title_en: Unidirectional labyrinth type composite flexible structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a unidirectional labyrinth type composite flexible structure, which is arranged between a radiation radiator and a remote sensor, belongs to the technical field of space optical remote sensing, and comprises a body part; an upper boss provided at one end of the body portion; a lower boss provided at the other end of the body portion; the invention has the advantages that the heat elimination between the large-area radiation radiator and the remote sensor can be realized, the heat elimination and the fixing of the radiation radiator can be realized, the aim of eliminating or reducing the thermal stress can be achieved, and the heat elimination device has the advantages of simple and reliable structure, low stress and large deformation.

title_en: Projection lens
abstract_en: The application discloses projection lens, this projection lens include in proper order by formation of image side to image source side along the optical axis: a first lens having positive power, a second lens having positive power, a third lens having negative power, a fourth lens having power, and a fifth lens having power; wherein an imaging side surface of the third lens is convex; at least one of the first lens to the third lens is a glass lens; the f-number Fno of the projection lens, the maximum half field angle Semi-FOV of the projection lens, the effective focal length f2 of the second lens and the half length ImgH of the diagonal line of the effective pixel area on the image source surface of the projection lens meet the following conditions: 4.0-sFno/tan (Semi-FOV) <6.5; and 1.1< -f2/Fno/ImgH <4.5.

title_en: Display image adjusting method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application is suitable for the technical field of intelligent automobiles, and provides a display image adjusting method, a display image adjusting device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method can be suitable for an augmented reality head-up display (AR-HUD), and comprises the following steps: acquiring the current eye position of a driver; determining a first position of a virtual image screen to be adjusted and a second position of a virtual image displayed in the virtual image screen according to the current eye position; adjusting the virtual image screen to a first position; adjusting the virtual image displayed in the virtual image screen to a second position; and the adjusted virtual image, the real object corresponding to the virtual image and the human eyes are positioned on the same straight line. By the method, the display effect of the image displayed based on the AR-HUD can be improved, the driver can be ensured to see the complete display image, and the display image and the driving real scene are accurately fused in the visual angle of the driver.

title_en: Structural member, image forming apparatus, and method of manufacturing structural member
abstract_en: The invention provides a structural member, an image forming apparatus, and a method of manufacturing the structural member. The invention aims to improve the dimensional accuracy of a structural member composed of a plurality of square pipes. The structural member (6) is formed by joining a plurality of square tubes (60). The plurality of square tubes (60) include a first square tube (60 a) and a second square tube (60 b) joined by welding. Two or three of four sides constituting an end surface (62) of the first square tube (60 a) are joining sides (62 a) joined by welding to side surfaces (63) of the second square tube (60 b), and the remaining of the four sides are non-joining sides (62 b) separated by a gap from the side surfaces (63) of the second square tube (60 b).

title_en: Intelligent automatic light supplementing lighting equipment based on photography and camera shooting
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent automatic light supplementing lighting device based on photography, which relates to the technical field of photography auxiliary devices and comprises: the base, the light compensating part and the control box; the base is placed subaerial, and installs the bracing piece on the base to the welding of bracing piece head end has the connecting rod. Each baffle seat is provided with one contact switch, and the four contact switches are connected in series; contact switch is connected with microprocessor's power supply, and support arm and contact switch contact after the support arm rotates 92 degrees, so that if do not expand the support arm contact switch will unable switch-on, just also can't realize the light filling, just so guaranteed must support the base steadily just can carry out work, just also reduced this device and emptyd the probability of colliding with, solved at first, current device is when placing, the phenomenon is emptyd to easy emergence, although be provided with bearing structure on the current device, but operating personnel does not expand the problem of strutting arrangement because of lazy phenomenon easily.

title_en: Holographic encryption method of single-pixel imaging key based on metasurface
abstract_en: The invention discloses a holographic encryption method of a single-pixel imaging key based on a metasurface, belonging to the technical fields of micro-nano optics, holographic multiplexing and optical encryption application. In order to obtain the computer-generated amplitude hologram corresponding to the reproduced image, the invention uses a phase recovery algorithm to obtain the light field phase distribution of the object on the hologram, and then binarizes the generated phase distribution to obtain the corresponding amplitude distribution. In addition, in order to obtain a reconstructed image of a target object in single-pixel imaging, an amplitude hologram generated by a computer is used as a modulation mask in a single-pixel imaging system, a mask pattern meeting reconstruction conditions is generated in a translation iteration mode, the total amplitude intensity of a modulated corresponding light field is collected, and then the reconstructed image of the target object is obtained by using a single-pixel imaging algorithm. And the reconstructed image imaged by a single pixel is used as an addressing key of the metasurface holography to realize optical encryption with anti-counterfeiting function, high security and large plaintext coverage.

title_en: Liquid crystal lens unit, liquid crystal lens device and manufacturing method
abstract_en: The invention provides a liquid crystal lens unit, a liquid crystal lens device and a manufacturing method. The liquid crystal lens unit includes: a first transparent substrate; a second transparent substrate; a liquid crystal layer; the first dielectric layer is arranged on one side of the first transparent substrate, which is close to the second transparent substrate, and is provided with a plurality of sloping surfaces; the first electrode layer comprises a plurality of first electrodes which are respectively and correspondingly arranged on a plurality of sloping surfaces, and the projection of the first electrodes on the first transparent substrate is a circle or concentric ring; and a second electrode layer. The liquid crystal lens device comprises two liquid crystal lens units, wherein the two liquid crystal lens units are stacked along a first direction, and projections of first electrodes in the two liquid crystal lens units in a first plane perpendicular to the first direction are mutually alternated. By arranging the slope surface on the first dielectric layer and correspondingly arranging the first electrode on the slope surface, the liquid crystal lens device with larger size can be manufactured, and the diffraction efficiency of the liquid crystal lens device is improved.

title_en: Image forming apparatus with a toner supply device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an image forming apparatus. The image forming apparatus includes a frame, a top plate cover that is removable from the frame and has a top surface portion constituting a part of a top surface of the image forming apparatus, and screws. The frame includes an upper surface portion opposed to the top surface portion, a front surface portion disposed on a front side with respect to the upper surface portion, and a rear surface portion disposed on a rear side with respect to the upper surface portion and provided with a through hole. The top plate cover includes a first mounting portion fixed to the front surface portion, and a second mounting portion disposed at a rear side with respect to the first mounting portion and inserted into the through hole. The screw is inserted in a front-rear direction to fix the front surface portion and the first mounting portion of the frame.

title_en: Heat sink structure and method for testing laser chip
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heat sink structure and a method for testing a laser chip, which relate to the technical field of optoelectronic device packaging and testing. The heat sink substrate is coated with a metal electrode, comprising: the first ground electrode, the first signal electrode, the second ground electrode, the second signal electrode, and the third ground electrode. The laser chip is directly welded and arranged on the metal electrode of the heat sink substrate. The first gold wire lead is connected with the laser chip and the first signal electrode, and the second gold wire lead is connected with the laser chip and the second signal electrode. The first matcher is connected with the first signal electrode in a bridging way, and the second matcher is connected with the first electrode in a bridging way. The invention can efficiently realize the impedance matching of the laser, convert the laser chip into a three-port device with two electric ports and one optical port, and perform self-calibration test on the laser chip.

title_en: Lens driving device and camera module
abstract_en: The present embodiment relates to a lens driving device including: a housing; the bobbin is arranged in the shell; the coil is arranged in the wire barrel; a magnet disposed in the housing and facing the coil; the base is arranged below the shell; and an elastic member coupled to the bobbin and the housing, wherein the base includes a groove formed in an upper surface thereof, at least a portion of the elastic member is disposed in or above the groove of the base, and the groove of the base is provided with a damping material.

title_en: Laser power stabilizing device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a laser power stabilizing device, and belongs to the technical field of laser processing. The device comprises an optical fiber laser, a laser processing head, a laser power sampling module, a photoelectric conversion module, an optical power feedback control module, a data acquisition module and a data processing module, wherein the output end of the optical fiber laser is connected with the input end of the laser processing head, the output end of the laser processing head is connected with the input end of the laser power sampling module, the output end of the laser power sampling module is connected with the input end of the photoelectric conversion module, the output end of the photoelectric conversion module is connected with the input end of the optical power feedback control module, the output end of the optical power feedback control module is connected with the input end of the data acquisition module, the output end of the data processing module is connected with the input end of the optical fiber laser, and the laser processing stability can be greatly improved and the process quality is guaranteed.

title_en: Backlight module, assembling method of backlight module and display device
abstract_en: The application discloses a backlight module, an assembling method of the backlight module and a display device, wherein the backlight module comprises a back plate, a fixed seat, a movable plate, a patch and an optical diaphragm, and the fixed seat is fixed at the bottom of the back plate; the movable sheet is made of metal materials and is correspondingly arranged on the fixed seat; the patch comprises an inserting sheet and an absorbing sheet which are connected, the inserting sheet is fixed on the side edge of the back plate, the absorbing sheet is arranged opposite to the movable sheet, and the absorbing sheet is made of magnetic materials; the optical film is positioned between the movable sheet and the suction sheet; when the patch is not installed on the side plate, the movable plate is arranged on the fixed seat, and the optical film sheet is stacked on the movable plate; when the paster is installed when on the curb plate, inhale the piece will the movable plate absorbs, with the movable plate cooperation will optical diaphragm presss from both sides tightly fixedly, avoids optical diaphragm because the warpage and the not hard up problem that expend with heat and contract with cold and lead to after fixed.

title_en: Transparent display assembly for realizing contrast adjusting function and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a transparent display assembly for realizing a contrast adjusting function and a preparation method thereof, wherein the transparent display assembly comprises a transparent display screen, a vacuum adhesive layer, a first glass substrate, an electrochromic functional layer and a second glass substrate which are sequentially stacked; the thickness of the vacuum adhesive sealing layer is 0.38-1.52mm; the thickness of the first glass substrate is 2-3mm; the thickness of the electrochromic functional layer is 600-2000nm; the transparent display assembly realizes the contrast adjusting function through the setting of the electrochromic functional layer and the adjustment of the thickness among all layers on the basis of ensuring low cost and light weight, and is favorable for production and application.

title_en: Dustproof distribution frame of optic fibre
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of optical fiber distribution frames, and particularly relates to an optical fiber dustproof distribution frame which comprises a cabinet body, a cabinet door, a butt joint mechanism and a joint mechanism, wherein the cabinet body with the cabinet door is internally provided with a plurality of butt joint mechanisms which are uniformly distributed along the vertical direction. The invention can realize good blind connection of the optical fibers at two sides in the cabinet body under the condition of keeping the cabinet body not to be opened in a dusty environment, and the butt joint effect of each pair of optical fibers in the cabinet body is obvious, thereby realizing the dust-free butt joint of the optical fibers in a dusty environment.

title_en: Electromagnetic drive micro-mirror with coil stacking structure and production process
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of micro-optoelectromechanical technology, and particularly discloses an electromagnetic drive micro-mirror with a coil stacking structure and a production process thereof. The arrangement of the structure realizes high-density coil arrangement, double coils are arranged in the same range, and the density of the coils is doubled, so that the driving force is increased, the requirements of current amplitude and magnetic field intensity are reduced, and the high-performance electromagnetic driving micro-mirror with low power consumption and large scanning angle is favorably realized.

title_en: Method for solving poor and abnormal film printing appearance caused by matte ink solder mask
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for solving the problem of poor film printing appearance abnormality caused by matte ink solder mask, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of finding a product with poor film printing appearance after welding prevention development, taking a first board, arranging a product with the poor film printing appearance on the board surface according to a normal flow, baking the first board after welding prevention, arranging volcanic ash grinding and brushing the product with the poor film printing appearance on the board surface after baking, removing a film printing on the ink surface after grinding and brushing, inspecting the appearance condition of the board surface after the product with the poor film printing appearance is ground and brushed by volcanic ash, effectively confirming that no film printing exists, arranging a mass production board to produce according to the steps, inspecting the product with the poor film printing appearance after grinding and brushing by volcanic ash, and normally continuing current. According to the method for solving the problem of poor film printing appearance abnormity caused by the matte ink anti-welding, when the product with the abnormal film printing appearance on the board surface is cleaned after baking is finished after the anti-welding by using the volcanic ash brush, the film printing on the ink surface is convenient to remove.

title_en: Diffractive optical element and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a diffractive optical element and a preparation method thereof, wherein the diffractive optical element comprises an optical element setting cavity, and the optical element setting cavity comprises at least two layers of base materials and connecting parts respectively connected with the base materials; the diffractive optical element includes an optical structure disposed within an optical element-disposing cavity, the optical structure including a diffractive structure and a collimating structure. By adopting the diffractive optical element provided by the embodiment of the invention, the optical structure arranged in the optical element setting cavity simultaneously comprises the diffractive structure and the collimation structure, namely, the adjusting effect of the optical element setting cavity on light rays is enriched. Compared with the prior art, under the condition that the diffraction structure and the collimation structure are independently arranged, the embodiment of the invention can reduce the production and processing difficulty of the diffraction optical element, improve the production efficiency, the yield and the like, and simultaneously can avoid the influence of external factors such as environment on the diffraction structure and the collimation structure.

title_en: Core-skin glass with good compatibility matching for optical fiber image transmission element and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses core-skin glass with good compatibility matching for an optical fiber image transmission element and a preparation method thereof, wherein the core-skin glass comprises the following components in percentage by mole: siO (SiO)  2   20‑25、B  2  O  3   19‑27、CaO 0.5‑5、SrO 1‑5、BaO 15‑25、TiO  2   10‑15、La  2  O  3   5‑15、Gd  2  O  3   7.1‑10、Nb  2  O  5  1-5; the molar percentage composition of the cortical glass: siO (SiO)  2   73.0‑78.0，Al  2  O  3   1.0‑5.0，B  2  O  3   1.0‑5.0，Na  2  O 0.1‑2.9，K  2  O 7.1‑12.0，MgO 5.1‑10.0，SrO 0.1‑5.0，ZnO 0.1‑1.0，F  2  1.1-2.5%. The invention has the advantages of mutually matched thermal properties and good compatibility and matching chemical properties.

title_en: Overexposure inhibition imaging method
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for inhibiting imaging by overexposure, which firstly designs a lighting device capable of flexibly configuring the number of sub-light sources and the positions of the sub-light sources according to the surface characteristics to be imaged and the size of an imaging space. The invention is little influenced by the contour change of the imaging surface and the light reflection characteristic, has flexible volume and shape, can be used for illumination imaging in free scenes such as an active illumination light source or a weak illumination environment and the like, and has low coupling of an illumination imaging system and external conditions and good adaptability.

title_en: Display device and driving method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a display device and a driving method thereof, wherein the display device comprises: the liquid crystal display comprises a first substrate, a second substrate, a liquid crystal layer, a phase delay layer and a polarizing layer, wherein the first substrate and the second substrate are opposite to each other, the liquid crystal layer is arranged between the first substrate and the second substrate, and the phase delay layer and the polarizing layer are arranged on one side of the second substrate, which is away from the liquid crystal layer. The light supplementing light source is arranged in the display device, and can supplement light to the display device under the condition of weak ambient light, so that the display brightness of the display device is improved, and the display effect is optimized.

title_en: Film-forming composition
abstract_en: The present invention addresses the problem of providing a resist underlayer film that has resistance to a solvent of a composition for a resist film formed as an upper layer, good etching characteristics against fluorine-based gases, and further good lithographic characteristics, and that can function satisfactorilyThe composition of (a). The composition for forming a film is characterized by comprising a hydrolytic condensate obtained by hydrolyzing and condensing a hydrolyzable silane compound using 2 or more acidic compounds and a solvent, wherein the hydrolyzable silane compound comprises an amino group-containing silane represented by the following formula (1). (in the formula (1), R  1  Are groups bonded to silicon atoms and, independently of one another, represent an amino-containing organic radical, R  2  A group bonded to a silicon atom, represents an alkyl group which may be substituted, an aryl group which may be substituted, an aralkyl group which may be substituted, a haloalkyl group which may be substituted, a haloaryl group which may be substituted, a haloaralkyl group which may be substituted, an alkoxyalkyl group which may be substituted, an alkoxyaryl group which may be substituted, an alkoxyaralkyl group which may be substituted, or an alkenyl group which may be substituted, or represents an organic group containing an epoxy group, an acryloyl group, a methacryloyl group, a mercapto group, or a cyano group, R  3  Is a group or atom bonded to a silicon atom, independently represents an alkoxy group, an aralkyloxy group, an acyloxy group or a halogen atom, a is an integer of 1 to 2, b is an integer of 0 to 1, and a + b is 2 or less. ) R  1   a  R  2   b  Si(R  3  )  4‑(a+b)  (1)。

title_en: Electrostatic imaging transfer printing apparatus, system and method
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to an electrostatic imaging transfer printing device, an electrostatic imaging transfer printing system and an electrostatic imaging transfer printing method. The electrostatic imaging transfer printing apparatus is configured to transfer print based on electrostatic imaging to a cloth and has a frame on which are provided, in a traveling direction of the cloth: a delivery system; a moistening processing device; and at least one transfer printing unit comprising a transfer device and at least one electrostatographic print couple, the electrostatographic print couple being configured to form a print design based on electrostatographic imaging, the transfer device being configured to transfer the print design to the fabric via a transfer device. The electrostatic imaging printing color group comprises a printing plate roller, and an imaging device and an inking device are sequentially arranged along the rotation direction of the printing plate roller. The printing plate roller is coated with a photoconductor coating, the imaging device is configured to form an electrostatic latent image on the photoconductor coating, and the inking device is configured to form a printing pattern corresponding to the electrostatic latent image on the surface of the printing plate roller by using a dye.

title_en: Measuring device, measuring program, and measuring method
abstract_en: The embodiment provides a measuring device, a measuring program and a measuring method for improving the calculation accuracy of the position offset of a pattern formed on an object. The measuring device according to the embodiment is a measuring device for measuring a positional shift amount of a pattern formed on a surface of an object. The measuring device includes a measuring unit for measuring a1 st two-dimensional intensity distribution of 1 st diffracted light generated by irradiating light onto an object after forming a1 st pattern and before forming a 2 nd pattern, and a 2 nd two-dimensional intensity distribution of 2 nd diffracted light generated by irradiating light onto an object after forming a 2 nd pattern, a storage unit for storing 1 st measurement data indicating the 1 st two-dimensional intensity distribution and 2 nd measurement data indicating the 2 nd two-dimensional intensity distribution, and an arithmetic unit for obtaining difference data between the 1 st measurement data and the 2 nd measurement data by performing arithmetic processing using the 1 st measurement data and the 2 nd measurement data, and calculating a positional shift amount of the difference pattern between the 1 st pattern and the 2 nd pattern based on the difference data.

title_en: Laser module, semiconductor laser array packaging assembly and semiconductor laser
abstract_en: The application discloses laser module, semiconductor laser array encapsulation subassembly and semiconductor laser, wherein, this laser module includes: a substrate; the positive conductor layer and the negative conductor layer are arranged on the substrate at intervals; the laser chip is arranged on the positive electrode conductor layer; and one end of the gold wire is connected to the laser chip, and the other end of the gold wire is connected to the cathode conductor layer. By the mode, the laser module in the application is simple in structure and easy to assemble, batch production and testing are easy, high-power array packaging arrangement is conveniently carried out on a plurality of laser modules in the follow-up process, and therefore semiconductor lasers with high power density and high reliability can be produced in batch.

title_en: Driving circuit, method, device and medium for driving dimming glass
abstract_en: The application discloses a driving circuit, a method, a device and a medium for driving dimming glass, and relates to the field of automobiles. The intelligent light-emitting diode comprises an MCU, a filter circuit and a differential amplification circuit, wherein the differential amplification circuit comprises a resistor and an operational amplifier, the input end of the filter circuit is connected with the MCU and used for converting an SPWM signal into a sinusoidal direct current signal, the input end of the differential amplification circuit is connected with the output end of the filter circuit and used for converting the sinusoidal direct current signal into a sinusoidal alternating current signal, and the output end of the differential amplification circuit is connected with light-adjusting glass and used for driving the light-adjusting glass through the sinusoidal alternating current signal. The differential amplifying circuit is used in the driving circuit to convert the sine DC signal into sine AC signal, and the differential amplifying circuit is composed of resistor and operational amplifier, so that the circuit structure is relatively simple and the cost is low.

title_en: Display structure and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of displays, and discloses a display structure and electronic equipment, wherein the display structure comprises a light-emitting device, a first driver and a three-dimensional body; the light-emitting device is used for emitting light rays, and the three-dimensional body is positioned on the emitting path of the light rays; the three-dimensional body is provided with a first color resistance surface, a second color resistance surface and a third color resistance surface; the first driver is used for adjusting the posture of the three-dimensional body so as to adjust the area ratio of the light passing through the first color resistance surface, the second color resistance surface and the third color resistance surface and adjust the light color emitted by the light from the three-dimensional body. The application bypasses the existing display structure and adopts a brand new technical scheme to realize the function of color display.

title_en: Optical image lens, image capturing device and electronic device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optical image lens, an image capturing device and an electronic device. The optical image lens comprises a plurality of optical lenses, wherein the optical lenses comprise a plurality of plastic optical lenses. The optical image lens is provided with a long-wavelength red light absorption optical lens which is transparent to visible light and capable of filtering long-wavelength red light, is plastic and has refractive power. When a specific condition is satisfied, it is helpful to obtain a better imaging effect. The invention also discloses an image capturing device with the optical image lens and an electronic device with the image capturing device.

title_en: Laser printer imaging quality detection device and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a laser printer imaging quality detection device and a method thereof, wherein the device comprises a first high-speed camera, a control system and a driving mechanism arranged in supporting shafts at two ends of a photosensitive roller; the first high-speed camera is used for carrying out image acquisition on the printed content on the paper and transmitting the image acquisition to the control system; the control system is used for acquiring the image transmitted by the first high-speed camera and detecting the surface defects of the paper, and if black spots are detected, the control system controls the laser printer body to stop running; if the depth of the handwriting is detected to be different, the control system controls the laser printer body to stop running and sends a driving signal to the driving mechanism; the driving mechanism is fixedly connected with the photosensitive roller and used for controlling the photosensitive roller to slide in a reciprocating manner after receiving a driving signal so as to uniformly distribute the carbon powder on the photosensitive roller. The invention can automatically detect the imaging quality during printing, and carry out corresponding processing according to the detection result, thereby avoiding continuously printing low-quality data or improving the printing quality.

title_en: Authenticity judging member and authenticity judging method thereof
abstract_en: The present invention provides an authenticity judging member comprising: a substrate layer which is a reflective circular polarizer; a first printing layer which contains a resin pigment as a fragment of the resin layer (A1) having cholesteric regularity and is provided on the base layer; and a second printing layer which contains a metal pigment having no circularly polarized light separating function and is provided on the base layer. A method of judging authenticity of an authenticity judging member, comprising: a step (1) of obtaining a reflected image (1) by observing an incident unpolarized light beam from one principal surface side of an authentication judging member; a step (2) of obtaining a reflected image (2) by observing the incident unpolarized light from the other principal surface side of the authenticity judging member; and a step (3) of determining that the reflected image (1) is different from the reflected image (2).

title_en: Display device and manufacturing method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a display device and a manufacturing method, wherein the display device comprises a color film substrate, an array substrate and a liquid crystal layer positioned between the color film substrate and the array substrate, wherein the liquid crystal layer comprises liquid crystal molecules and dye liquid crystal molecules mixed with the liquid crystal molecules; a lateral light source is arranged on the side surface of the array substrate, a reflecting layer is arranged on one side of the array substrate away from the liquid crystal layer, and a light collecting structure is arranged on the color film substrate and/or the array substrate; the surface of the array substrate, which is parallel to the color film substrate, is provided with light guide dots, and the light guide dots are used for guiding light rays emitted by the lateral light source to the direction of the array substrate, which is far away from the light guide dots. The light guide mesh points are arranged on the array substrate, the side-in light source is directly arranged on the side face of the array substrate, the color film substrate and/or the array substrate are/is also provided with the light collecting structure, and the liquid crystal molecules are mixed with dye liquid crystal molecules, so that a backlight module and a lower polarizer are not required to be additionally arranged, and the thickness of the display device is greatly reduced.

title_en: Optical system and image pickup apparatus
abstract_en: The problem is to provide a small, large-diameter, and high-performance optical system and an imaging device. The solution is that the optical system is composed of a1 st lens group (G1), a 2 nd lens group (G2) and a 3 rd lens group (G3). Each lens group has positive power, and the 2 nd lens group (G2) is a focusing group. The 1 st lens group (G1) has at least 3 lenses 1 to 3 in order from the object side. The optical system has optical characteristics represented by a specific formula defined by the lens.

title_en: Zoom lens and image pickup apparatus
abstract_en: The invention provides a zoom lens of a telephoto system which is small and has a longer focal length at a telephoto end and maintains good optical performance, and an image pickup apparatus including the zoom lens. The zoom lens includes, in order from an object side, a 1 st lens group having positive refractive power, a 2 nd lens group having negative refractive power, an intermediate group including 1 or more lens groups, and a final lens group. The intermediate group has a positive refractive power as a whole in the entire zoom region. In zooming, the interval between the 1 st lens group and the 2 nd lens group changes, the interval between the 2 nd lens group and the intermediate group changes, and the interval between the intermediate group and the final lens group changes. The zoom lens satisfies a predetermined conditional expression.

title_en: Head-mounted display device
abstract_en: The invention provides a head-mounted display device, which comprises an image source, a light guide element, a first modulation element and a second modulation element. The image source provides an image beam. The light guide element is arranged on the image light beam transmission path and used for transmitting the image light beam. The light guide element has opposite first and second faces. The image beam is totally reflected on the first surface and is emitted from the second surface. The first modulation element is arranged on one side of the first surface of the light guide element and is used for adjusting the transmittance of the ambient light beam. The light guide element is arranged between the first modulation element and the second modulation element, and the second modulation element is used for adjusting the focusing position of the image light beam. The head-mounted display device provided by the invention can improve the wearing comfort and has a good display effect.

title_en: Mask and head-mounted display
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a mask and a head-mounted display. When the mask is worn by a user, the upper bracket assembly is positioned above the main bracket assembly, the third adjusting component of the upper bracket assembly is connected with the first adjusting component of the main bracket assembly, and the connection position of the third adjusting component and the first adjusting component is adjustable. When the mask is worn by a user, the lower support assembly is positioned below the main support assembly, and a fourth adjusting part of the lower upper support assembly is connected with a second adjusting part of the main support assembly, and the connection position of the fourth adjusting part and the first adjusting part is adjustable. Therefore, the face mask can be adapted to the face shapes of different users through adjustment, so that the comfort of wearing the face mask by each user can be improved.

title_en: Product performance repairing system based on display technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of bright spot repair of Micro LED and Micro OLED, in particular to a product performance repair system based on a display technology, which comprises: the device comprises a laser module, a light spot shaping module, a light path transmission module, a light box and a processing objective lens; the laser module emits laser in a single-point excitation mode, and the emitted laser is sent to the light spot shaping module; shaping the laser facula through the facula shaping module, and sending the processed facula to the light path transmission module; changing the propagation direction of the light rays through the light path propagation module, and sending the light rays to the light box; enabling the natural light imaging to be coaxial with the laser through the light box; the natural light and the laser are coaxially focused through the processing objective lens, so that the natural light and the laser are amplified and imaged under a fixed multiplying power, and the focus of the laser is determined; the problems that black spots are possibly caused in the repairing process of the Micro LED and the Micro OLED and the manufacturing cost of an optical system is high are solved.

title_en: Current sensing circuit, manufacturing method and laser
abstract_en: The application discloses a current sensing circuit, a manufacturing method and a laser, comprising the following steps: the chip resistor and the copper columns are arranged on the upper surface of the circuit substrate, the chip resistors at least comprise one chip resistor used as a current sensing resistor, and the copper columns at least comprise one group of copper columns used as signal terminals and grounding terminals of the current sensing resistor respectively; the copper columns and the driving plate are fixed through the combined screws, and the current sensing circuit board is arranged below the driving plate, so that a plurality of current paths are formed between the current sensing circuit board and the driving plate, and the path resistance and the power consumption are reduced; and a cooling plate is mounted under the current sensing circuit board and the driving plate. This application can solve the heat dissipation problem of chip resistor, reduces pumping source driver volume, power consumption to reduce the current measurement deviation, simultaneously, can also practice thrift components and parts cost and man-hour of installation.

title_en: Lens element
abstract_en: An optical lens intended to be worn in front of an eye of a wearer having at least one prescribed refractive power Px, the optical lens comprising two opposite optical faces and a plurality of consecutive optical elements, at least a part of the optical elements having an optical function of not focusing an image on the retina of the eye of the wearer so as to slow down the progression of refractive errors of the eye, wherein-on a pupil having a diameter of at least 4mm, the modulation transfer function of the optical lens is greater than 0.1 between 0 and 20 cyc/deg. as measured in a plane corresponding to the at least one prescribed refractive power in at least one direction, -most of the light rays passing through the optical lens on the pupil pass through at least one optical element of the plurality of optical elements, and-each of the consecutive optical elements verifies formula (I), wherein d is a characteristic dimension of the profile of the optical element in mm, |p| is an absolute value of the characteristic light of the optical element expressed in diopters, and K is a number greater than or equal to 0.9.7 or less.

title_en: Lens system and projection device
abstract_en: The application protects a lens system, has an optical axis, includes: the optical lens comprises a modulation device, a first lens group, a second lens group, a diaphragm and a third lens group which are sequentially arranged between an object side and an image side along an optical axis, wherein the focal power of the first lens group is positive and is used for converging light rays, the first lens group at least comprises a first lens, and the effective clear diameter of the first lens is smaller than the size of an image circle; the focal power of the second lens group is positive and is used for further converging the light rays; the number of lens pieces of the third lens group is less than the sum of the lenses of the first lens group and the second lens group, and the third lens group is used for adapting the dilution of the etendue of the illumination light; the modulation device is used for emitting projection light rays, and the projection light rays are projected to a screen to form a projection image after passing through the first lens group, the second lens group and the diaphragm. Due to the arrangement of the third lens group, the optical expansion of the illuminating light can be effectively adapted to be diluted, and the problem of poor efficiency and uniformity caused by asymmetric arrangement is solved.

title_en: MEMS mirror system with slow beam deflection
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to MEMS mirror systems with slow beam deflection. The beam deflection system is configured to transmit the light beam at a time-varying output deflection angle. The system comprises: a first resonant structure configured to oscillate about a first axis of rotation at a first resonant frequency; a second resonant structure configured to oscillate about a second axis of rotation at a second resonant frequency, wherein the first axis of rotation is parallel to the second axis of rotation, and the first and second resonant frequencies are different and define a predetermined frequency difference; and a drive circuit configured to generate a first drive signal to drive the first resonant structure while additionally generating a second drive signal to drive the second resonant structure such that an output deflection angle of the light beam oscillates according to a beat pattern of a beat wave whose extreme amplitude is modulated and defined by the periodic envelope.

title_en: Display panel, display device and driving method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a display panel, a display device and a driving method, wherein the display panel comprises a display box and a dimming box arranged on the light emitting side of the display box, the dimming box comprises a first substrate, a second substrate and a first liquid crystal layer, the first substrate is provided with a first visual angle control electrode, the second substrate is provided with a second visual angle control electrode, a first electrode strip, a second electrode strip and a third electrode strip, and the second electrode strip and the third electrode strip are sequentially arranged towards two sides of the first electrode strip by taking the first electrode strip as a center. The second electrode strips and the third electrode strips are sequentially arranged towards the two sides of the first electrode strips by taking the first electrode strips as the center, and voltages on the first electrode strips, the second electrode strips and the third electrode strips are in gradual change trend, so that the deflection angle of the first liquid crystal layer at each electrode group is also in gradual change trend, the first liquid crystal layer is equivalent to an optical lens, and a picture displayed by the display box is refracted to the light emitting surface of the dimming box, so that the problem of depth of field is solved.

title_en: Yarn binding tension monitoring method and yarn binding system of yarn binding machine
abstract_en: The application relates to a yarn binding tension monitoring method and a yarn binding system of a yarn binding machine, which comprise the following steps: acquiring yarn binding tension by adopting a wireless pressure sensor, and detecting and acquiring the temperature and the vibration acceleration of a bearing of a yarn bobbin shaft by adopting a wireless temperature vibration sensor; and comparing the yarn binding tension, the temperature and the vibration acceleration with a threshold range, and adjusting the rotating speed of the yarn drum shaft according to the comparison result so as to adjust the yarn binding tension. The electric brush probe can be used for solving the problem that an electric brush probe in the related art needs to be matched with a sliding ring generally, extra friction force can be brought to a yarn binding system, and the measurement precision is reduced.

title_en: Quantum dot substrate and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of quantum dot substrates, in particular to a quantum dot substrate and a manufacturing method thereof, and the quantum dot substrate comprises a shell, an inflation mechanism, a brightening mechanism, a shielding mechanism and an extrusion mechanism, wherein inert gas is filled into a second cavity through a gas core, so that the periphery of a quantum dot film is prevented from contacting water oxygen, a light source is focused through a convex film, the light source penetrates through a light-transmitting plate and is refracted and reflected through a light-reflecting retaining wall to achieve a larger illumination effect, the light-reflecting retaining wall is arranged to prevent a quantum dot light-emitting unit from being mistakenly excited to cause color mixing, heat generated by a lamp bead enters a second connecting groove through a first connecting groove on a fixing body, the heat is discharged from the second connecting groove, cold external air enters the second connecting groove, dust can be prevented from entering through sponge, water vapor can be adsorbed through sponge, the external water vapor is prevented from entering the inside, and a screen can protect a display screen from being polluted by dust.

title_en: Optical lens and electronic equipment with same
abstract_en: The invention provides an optical lens and an electronic device with the same. The optical lens sequentially comprises from an object side to an image side along an optical axis: the first lens has negative focal power, and at least one of the object side surface and the image side surface of the first lens is a concave surface; the object side surface of the second lens is a concave surface, and the image side surface of the second lens is a convex surface; the third lens has positive focal power, and at least one of the object side surface and the image side surface of the third lens is a convex surface; the fourth lens has positive focal power, and at least one of the object side surface and the image side surface of the fourth lens is a convex surface; the fifth lens has negative focal power, the object side surface of the fifth lens is a convex surface, and the image side surface of the fifth lens is a concave surface; the sixth lens has positive focal power, the object side surface of the sixth lens is a convex surface, and the image side surface of the sixth lens is a convex surface; and at least one of the object side surface and the image side surface of the seventh lens is a concave surface. The invention solves the problem that the optical lens in the prior art cannot simultaneously realize high resolution and miniaturization.

title_en: Liquid crystal device and display apparatus
abstract_en: According to one embodiment, a liquid crystal device includes: a first transparent substrate; a plurality of light-shielding bodies arranged at a first pitch in a first direction on an inner surface of the first transparent substrate; a transparent overcoat layer covering the plurality of light-shielding bodies; a plurality of first electrodes each formed in a stripe shape and arranged on the overcoat layer at a second pitch smaller than the first pitch in the first direction; a first alignment film covering the plurality of first electrodes and the overcoat layer; a second transparent substrate; a second electrode disposed on an inner surface of the second transparent substrate and facing the plurality of first electrodes; a second alignment film covering the second electrode; and a liquid crystal layer disposed between the first alignment film and the second alignment film, wherein the plurality of light-shielding bodies are each formed in a wall shape having a width along the first direction and a thickness greater than the width.

title_en: Photoresist material containing acrylate side chain and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a photoresist material containing an acrylate side chain, and a preparation method and application thereof. The photoresist material containing the acrylate side chain is obtained by modifying and modifying phenolic resin by glycidyl methacrylate and di-tert-butyl dicarbonate through an epoxy ring-opening and BOC protection method of phenolic hydroxyl. The invention also provides a preparation method of the photoresist material containing the acrylate side chain. The acrylate side chain-containing photoresist material disclosed by the invention has excellent resolution, good acid resistance and coating uniformity, good adhesion with the surface of a silicon substrate, and control of the BOC ratio, can adjust the pattern development degree and the film thickness of the photoresist, has excellent photochemical performance in the aspects of industrial production of products in the G line and I line fields, and can be widely applied to the processes of circuit packaging, manufacturing of printed circuits and integrated circuits, micro-processing of semiconductor discrete devices and the like.

title_en: Electro-optical element with potassium tantalate niobate crystal and electrode forming ohmic contact and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of preparation of electrodes of photoelectric functional crystal devices, in particular to an electro-optical element with an ohmic contact formed by a potassium tantalate niobate crystal and an electrode and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method of the electro-optical element comprises the following steps of (1) adopting ion doped grown potassium tantalate niobate crystal to carry out optical-grade polishing, 2) plating a double-layer metal film electrode on the surface of the potassium tantalate niobate crystal by magnetron sputtering, and 3) carrying out rapid annealing on the film-coated crystal under the condition of ultraviolet laser irradiation.
