The potassium tantalate niobate crystal doped with ions is adopted, so that the barrier width between metal and the crystal is reduced, electrons or holes are more likely to tunnel, and the annealing temperature required for realizing ohmic contact is reduced. Meanwhile, by adding laser irradiation in the annealing process, the annealing temperature for enabling the potassium tantalate niobate crystal to form ohmic contact with the electrode is further reduced, damage to the inside of the crystal caused by high-temperature annealing is avoided, and the prepared electro-optical element is good in optical quality and stable in electrical property.

title_en: Light path adjusting component, optical system and vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of display, and provides a light path adjusting component, an optical system and a vehicle. The light path adjusting component comprises an optical element, a bracket, a permanent magnet, an electromagnet and a controller electrically connected with the electromagnet. One of the permanent magnet and the electromagnet is arranged on the optical element, and the other one is arranged on the bracket. The electromagnet is opposite to one magnetic pole of the permanent magnet. The controller is used for controlling the electromagnet to attract and/or repel the permanent magnet so that the permanent magnet drives the optical element to move.

title_en: Optical imaging system and portable electronic device
abstract_en: Optical imaging systems and portable electronic devices are disclosed. The optical imaging system includes: a first lens, a second lens, a third lens, a fourth lens, and a fifth lens arranged in order from an object side toward an image side, wherein the first lens has a positive refractive power, and a length of one axis is larger than a length of the other axis, among two axes of the first lens which intersect an optical axis and are perpendicular to each other, wherein the following conditional expression is satisfied: 4.5 are woven ttl/IMG HT <6.5;0.87 and woven fabric TTL/f <1.31; and 0.65 straw l1s1es/L1S1el <0.9, wherein TTL is a distance on the optical axis from an object-side surface of the first lens to an imaging plane, IMG HT is half a diagonal length of the imaging plane, f is an overall focal length of the optical imaging system, L1S1el is a maximum effective radius of the object-side surface of the first lens, and L1S1es is a minimum effective radius of the object-side surface of the first lens.

title_en: Phenanthroline iron complex, preparation method and application of phenanthroline iron complex in aspect of electrochromism
abstract_en: The invention relates to a phenanthroline iron complex, a preparation method and application thereof in electrochromic. The prior electrochromic material has the problems of long color-changing time, short cycle life and the like, and the electrochromic device has the problems of complex production process and the like. The invention provides a tri (4, 7-bis-hydroxymethyl) -1, 10-phenanthroline iron complex, and an electrochromic device can be constructed on the basis of the phenanthroline iron complex. The material has simple preparation process and excellent performance, and the constructed electrochromic device can realize the electrochromic function only by introducing the solution of the material into the transparent cavity, thereby avoiding using a multilayer electrochromic structure and not needing to arrange a conducting layer, an ion storage layer and positive and negative electrodes in an internal partition, completely omitting the step of depositing the electrochromic material on the surface of conductive glass or the electrode, reducing the difficulty of the production process, and simultaneously overcoming the problems of harsh production conditions, high cost and the like.

title_en: Signal detection system
abstract_en: The application discloses signal detection system, the system includes: frequency pre-estimating device and signal detecting device; the output end of the frequency pre-estimating device is connected with the input end of the signal detecting device. The system can be realized by utilizing the frequency of an incident signal and an optical carrier signal estimated by the environment to generate a chaotic photoelectric oscillator radio frequency signal, and then utilizing the chaotic photoelectric oscillator radio frequency signal to realize target signal (namely microwave photon weak signal) detection.

title_en: Polarizing plate and image display device
abstract_en: The invention provides a polarizing plate capable of contributing to improvement of display characteristics of an image display device, and an image display device having the polarizing plate. The polarizing plate of the embodiment of the invention comprises: the organic EL display panel includes a laminated film having a substrate and a surface-treated layer, and a polarizer disposed on the substrate side of the laminated film, wherein the surface-treated layer has a reflectance of 2% or less, the surface-treated layer has a haze of 1% to 13%, and the polarizer has a transmittance of 45.5% or more.

title_en: Light guide plate for augmented reality device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a light guide plate for an image display apparatus, particularly for an augmented reality device. The invention also relates to the use of a light guide plate according to the invention in an augmented reality device, and to an augmented reality device comprising a light guide plate according to the invention.

title_en: Hybrid plasmon optical waveguide
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hybrid plasmon optical waveguide which comprises an anti-oxidation protective layer and an alkali metal layer, wherein the anti-oxidation protective layer and the alkali metal layer do not react under the normal temperature condition, and the alkali metal layer is sodium and potassium. The invention not only can further improve the mode field constraint capability of the hybrid plasmon waveguide, but also can realize low-loss plasmon mode transmission, and has important application value in the field of sub-wavelength photon integration of communication wave bands.

title_en: Optical imaging system
abstract_en: The invention provides an optical imaging system, which sequentially comprises a first lens, a second lens, a third lens, a fourth lens, a fifth lens, a sixth lens and a seventh lens from the object side to the image side of the optical imaging system, wherein the radius of curvature R13 of the object side of the seventh lens and the radius of curvature R14 of the image side of the seventh lens meet 0< R14/R13<10, the distance TTL between the object side of the first lens and the imaging surface of the optical imaging system on the optical axis of the optical imaging system and the half of the diagonal length of an effective pixel area on the imaging surface meet TTL/ImgH <1.3, the effective focal length f7 of the seventh lens and the radius of curvature R13 of the object side of the seventh lens meet 2.0< f7/R13<2.5, and the dispersion coefficient V6 of the sixth lens, the dispersion coefficient V7 of the seventh lens, the effective focal length f6 of the seventh lens and the effective focal length f7 meet 7.5 (V6 + 2-V7)/6-f 7 <9.0. The invention solves at least one of the problems of larger volume, poor imaging quality and poor matching property with the chip of the optical imaging system in the prior art.

title_en: Compound weather-resistant optical cable listing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a composite weather-resistant optical cable hanging plate which comprises a hanging plate main body, a hanging plate main body and a display panel, wherein the hanging plate main body comprises a protective shell and an information plate; the fixing assembly is arranged on the back face of the signboard main body and comprises an adjusting piece and a rotary fixing piece, the adjusting piece is fixedly connected with the protective shell, and the rotary fixing piece is connected with the adjusting piece in a rotating mode. The protective shell can prolong the service life of the optical cable hanging plate, well protect the information plate in the optical cable hanging plate and prevent the information plate from being damaged in the long-term use process, and the information plate can be replaced and fixed by the fixing component, so that the optical cable hanging plate is convenient and efficient.

title_en: Photodetector, preparation method thereof, chip and optical device
abstract_en: A photoelectric detector (10), a preparation method thereof, a chip (100) and an optical device are provided, wherein the photoelectric detector (10) comprises a substrate (11), a first electrode contact layer (12), a photosensitive layer (13), a second electrode contact layer (14), a passivation layer (15) and a first electrode (161) and a second electrode (162) which are sequentially stacked on the substrate (11), the photoelectric detector (10) further comprises a through hole (V0) penetrating at least the photosensitive layer (13) and the second electrode contact layer (14), the first electrode contact layer (12) and the second electrode contact layer (14) are doped semiconductor layers with opposite polarities, the first electrode (161) and the second electrode (162) are mutually insulated, the first electrode (161) is electrically connected with the first electrode contact layer (12) through a first groove (V1), and the second electrode (162) is electrically connected with the second electrode contact layer (14) through a second groove (V2). In the photodetector (10), when the detected light passes through the through hole (V0), the photosensitive layer (13) can capture part of photons passing through the through hole (V0), thereby converting an optical signal into an electrical signal, realizing the detection of the detected light, and ensuring that the detected light is not disturbed.

title_en: Lens for blocking ultraviolet rays and near infrared rays, preparation method thereof and sunglasses with lens
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lens for blocking ultraviolet rays and near infrared rays, a preparation method thereof and sunglasses with the lens, and relates to the technical field of lenses. A lens for blocking ultraviolet rays and near infrared rays comprises the following materials in percentage by weight; 1.0-2.0% of composite modified material, 0.01-0.05% of catalyst, 0.08-0.22% of mold release agent, 0.3-0.5% of composite dye and the balance of matrix monomer resin; the composite modified material comprises a mixture of a near-infrared dye and an ultraviolet absorber. This application is through adding composite modified material in the lens material, and on the one hand, the infrared light of specific wavelength can be absorbed to the near-infrared dyestuff, reduces the injury of near-infrared ray to human eyeball. On the other hand, the ultraviolet absorbent can effectively absorb ultraviolet rays and reduce the harm of the ultraviolet rays to human bodies.

title_en: Supporting structure between primary mirror and secondary mirror
abstract_en: The invention provides a supporting structure between a primary mirror and a secondary mirror, which belongs to the technical field of optical-mechanical structures of space remote sensing cameras, and is called a central cylinder, wherein one end of the central cylinder is connected with the secondary mirror, the other end of the central cylinder penetrates through a central hole of the primary mirror to be connected with a main support structure of the camera, the central cylinder comprises a secondary mirror connecting ring, a supporting rod, a cylinder part and a supporting ring which are sequentially connected, the secondary mirror connecting ring is used for connecting the secondary mirror, the supporting rod extends along the axis direction of the secondary mirror connecting ring and is connected with the secondary mirror connecting ring and the cylinder part, and the supporting ring penetrates through the central hole of the primary mirror to be connected with the main support structure of the camera. The structure simplifies the structure form, and organically combines the supporting structure with the thermal control structure and the stray light eliminating structure. The technical problems that the support structure between the primary mirror and the secondary mirror has high requirements on temperature gradient, larger size, heavy weight, large heat control resource occupation and difficult stray light elimination are solved.

title_en: Geometric optical waveguide coupling device and near-to-eye display equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a geometric optical waveguide coupling device and near-to-eye display equipment, wherein the geometric optical waveguide coupling device comprises an optical waveguide coupling surface, a substrate, a prism and an optical waveguide coupling surface; the light wave coupling surface is used for coupling collimated light waves, and the light waves output after coupling enter the prism after passing through the substrate; a prism for changing a transmission angle of the light wave inputted to the prism; the substrate comprises a first substrate and a second substrate which are arranged in parallel, and is used for carrying out total reflection transmission on the light waves output by the prism so as to enable the light wave coupling surface to output target light waves; the prism comprises a first plane and a second plane, and the second plane is plated with a reflecting film; the light wave input to the prism is transmitted continuously after entering the first plane until the light wave is incident to the second plane, and the light wave reflected by the second plane is transmitted continuously after passing through the first plane so as to enter the matrix, so that the technical problems of angle limitation, complex structure, low light wave utilization rate and low light efficiency in the related art can be solved.

title_en: Method for manufacturing 2D wedges and partial packages for diffractive optics
abstract_en: A method of forming a three-dimensional feature inward from a surface of a material comprising: providing a droplet dispenser comprising an outlet, the droplet dispenser being configured to dispense discrete droplets of liquid material having a reactant therein, the reactant being capable of reacting with and thereby removing a portion of the layer of material with which the droplets contact; providing a support configured to support a material thereon, the support and the drop dispenser being movable relative to each other such that an outlet of the drop dispenser can be positioned over different discrete areas of the material surface; and positioning the material surface beneath the drop dispenser and dispensing the drops into discrete portions of the material surface in desired areas to remove at least a portion of the material in the desired areas and thereby form three-dimensional depressions inwardly from the material surface.

title_en: Optical-mechanical structure for improving ghost image, manufacturing method thereof and display waveguide device
abstract_en: The invention provides an optical-mechanical structure for improving ghost images, a manufacturing method thereof and a display waveguide device. The optical-mechanical structure for improving the ghost image comprises a display panel, a filling layer and a filling layer, wherein a plurality of pixels are arranged on the display panel, gaps exist among the plurality of pixels, the filling layer is arranged on the surface of one side of the display panel, which is provided with the plurality of pixels, and the filling layer is filled and arranged at the gaps among the plurality of pixels, and at least comprises a reflecting layer and a light absorption layer. The invention solves the problem that the ghost image improvement is difficult in the optical machine structure in the prior art.

title_en: Projection control method, apparatus, electronic device, and computer-readable storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a projection control method, a projection control device, electronic equipment and a computer readable storage medium, and relates to the field of intelligent home. The method comprises the following steps: detecting a current working mode of the projector; determining a current target brightness interval corresponding to a current working mode of a projector according to a preset corresponding relation between the working mode of the projector and the brightness interval; according to the current ambient light brightness and the current target brightness interval, the opening and closing degree of the intelligent curtain and/or the brightness of the light equipment are/is adjusted until the adjusted ambient light brightness is matched with the current target brightness interval, so that the ambient light brightness is automatically adjusted according to the content type played by the projector, and the continuity and the watching experience of a user in the watching process are improved.

title_en: Single photon preparation device
abstract_en: The application provides a single photon preparation device, comprising: a laser emitter for emitting laser light; the surface energy transfer cascade modulator receives laser emitted by the laser emitter and generates spontaneous parametric down-conversion to generate single photons; a Bragg grating filter for receiving and filtering single photons generated by the surface energy transfer cascade modulator; the surface energy transfer cascade modulator comprises lanthanide doped fluoride sensitized nanocrystals, and spontaneous parametric down-conversion occurs when laser passes through the lanthanide doped fluoride sensitized nanocrystals. The method modulates the single photon source based on the surface energy transfer cascade principle, remarkably improves the light utilization rate, generates single photons by using fluoride sensitized nanocrystals, and has the advantages of high production efficiency, high purity and the like.

title_en: Transient substrate and LED chip transfer method
abstract_en: The invention provides a transient substrate and an LED chip transfer method, wherein the transient substrate comprises a first substrate, a second substrate, liquid crystal molecules, a common electrode and a plurality of alignment structures; the first base plate and the second base plate are arranged in a box, liquid crystal molecules are filled between the first base plate and the second base plate, a common electrode is formed on the first base plate, a plurality of alignment structures are formed on the second base plate at intervals, each alignment structure comprises a driving electrode formed on one side of the second base plate, a photosensitive part formed on one side of the second base plate far away from the first base plate, a first electrode and a second electrode formed on one side of the second base plate far away from the first base plate, at least part of each photosensitive part is contacted with the driving electrode, the first electrode is contacted with the photosensitive part, the second electrode is arranged at intervals with the photosensitive part and the driving electrode, and the top surfaces of the first electrode and the second electrode are respectively provided with a photoresist layer. The transient substrate can realize the selective transfer of the LED with normal light emission.

title_en: Control device, control device adjustment method, lithographic apparatus, and article manufacturing method
abstract_en: A control apparatus that generates a control signal for controlling a control object includes a first compensator configured to generate a first signal based on a control deviation of the control object, a corrector configured to generate a correction signal by correcting the control deviation according to an arithmetic expression having an adjustable coefficient, a second compensator configured to generate a second signal from a neural network based on the correction signal, and an arithmetic device configured to generate the control signal based on the first signal and the second signal.

title_en: Electrochromic lens, preparation method thereof and AR (augmented reality) glasses
abstract_en: The application provides an electrochromic lens, a preparation method thereof and AR (augmented reality) glasses, and relates to the technical field of photoelectricity. The preparation method of the electrochromic lens comprises the following steps: forming a hydrophobic film on the non-conductive surface of the first ITO conductive glass; forming a heating ring on the hydrophobic membrane; plating a first electrode on the conductive surface of the first ITO conductive glass to obtain a first device; plating a second electrode on the conductive surface of the second ITO conductive glass to obtain a second device; the second device is attached to the first device through frame glue to obtain a third device, the frame glue, the first device and the second device are enclosed to form a containing part, and the containing part is provided with an opening; filling an electrochromic solution into the accommodating part through an opening of the third device to form an electrochromic layer; and (5) sealing and curing the opening to obtain the electrochromic lens. The electrochromic lens that this application obtained can adapt to the change of ambient light betterly, and can hydrophobic heating defogging, has improved the performance under the different environment.

title_en: Shaping device and method for multi-wavelength special-shaped light beam
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a method for shaping multi-wavelength special-shaped light beams, and belongs to the field of light path shaping. The multi-wavelength special-shaped beam shaping device controls the angular displacement and the linear displacement of the optical element by utilizing the motor, thereby realizing high-precision shaping of the beam. The invention develops a multi-wavelength laser shaping light path to realize independent shaping of laser beams with various wavelengths, so that the output special-shaped light beams meet the light path system requirements of different types of laser-induced fluorescence/phosphorescence test technologies and PIV flow field speed measurement technologies; meanwhile, a high-precision angular displacement/linear displacement control system is designed based on an electric control principle and an optical geometry principle. The multi-wavelength special-shaped beam shaping device is convenient to process, high in debugging precision, high in device integration level, suitable for different laser testing scenes, strong in portability and convenient to debug.

title_en: Camera module and method for producing a camera module
abstract_en: The invention relates to a camera module (1) comprising a lens (2) having an electrical interface (3) and comprising a lens holder (4) having means for electrically contacting the lens (2) in the region of the electrical interface (3), wherein the means for electrically contacting are also connected to the electronics of the camera module (1), in particular to a circuit board (5). According to the invention, the means for electrical contact comprise two contact rings (6, 7) with contact springs (8, 9), which form a first pole and a second pole and are electrically insulated by a centrally located spacer (10), wherein the two contact rings (6, 7) are mounted movably by means of the lens holder (4) and the spacer (10).

title_en: Optical module and wearable equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an optical module and wearable equipment; the optical module comprises an imaging lens group, a light splitting element, a first phase retarder and a polarization reflecting element, wherein the light splitting element, the first phase retarder and the polarization reflecting element are arranged between light paths of the imaging lens group, and the first phase retarder is positioned between the light splitting element and the polarization reflecting element; the optical module further comprises a display assembly, the display assembly comprises a first display screen and a second display screen, the first display screen and the second display screen are arranged in an up-down symmetrical mode relative to the optical axis of the imaging lens group, a target interval L is arranged between the first display screen and the second display screen, and the target interval L is more than or equal to 1.5mm. The optical module provided by the embodiment of the application is a single-eye double-screen VR scheme, and can achieve the optical effect of increasing the angle of view.

title_en: Silicon lens cover plate with light filtering function and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a silicon lens cover plate with a light filtering function and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method specifically comprises the following steps: spin-coating photoresist on the upper surface of the first silicon substrate and baking; exposing and developing the photoresist on the first silicon substrate; processing and softening the photoresist after the processing to form the photoresist with a lens shape; etching the first silicon substrate and the lens-shaped photoresist to obtain a first silicon substrate with the upper surface in a lens shape; preparing a first connecting layer on the lower surface of the first silicon substrate, and spin-coating photoresist on the surface of the first connecting layer; etching a first cavity on the lower surface of the first silicon substrate; preparing an optical film on the upper surface of the first silicon substrate and on the inner top surface of the first cavity; and obtaining the silicon lens cover plate with the light filtering function. The preparation method not only provides a light converging function for the silicon lens cover plate, but also simplifies the complexity of the optical sensor structure and reduces the production cost of the sensor.

title_en: Cycloolefin copolymer, optical product and electronic device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cycloolefin copolymer, an optical product and electronic equipment, wherein the cycloolefin copolymer is formed by copolymerizing alpha-olefin, polar monomer A and cyclic olefin B, and the molecular formula of the polar monomer A is as follows: wherein m and n are 1, 2 or 3 respectively, R  1  And R is  2  Is different aromatic groups containing 1 or 2 benzene ring structures, and the molecular formula of the cyclic olefin B is as follows: wherein R is  3  And R is  4  Is independent hydrogen or one of alkyl, cycloalkyl, alkoxy, amino, alcohol, carboxylic acid, ester, ketone and amide containing less than 20 carbons, R  3  And R is  4  Is a different group. The cycloolefin copolymers according to the invention achieve the properties of high refractive index, low Abbe number and high toughness.

title_en: Wiring box
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of optical fiber connecting devices, in particular to a distribution box for accommodating a highly modularized optical fiber module plug-in box, which comprises a distribution box main body, wherein one side of the distribution box main body is provided with a front opening, a back plate opposite to the front opening is further arranged on the distribution box main body, a fixing block is arranged on the back plate, one side of the fixing block, which is close to the back plate, is provided with a connecting groove, the opening of the connecting groove penetrates through the back plate, then the bottom of the connecting groove is connected with a spring, the spring is connected with a first connecting piece, the outer circumferential side of the optical fiber module plug-in box is provided with a second connecting piece, the first connecting piece is provided with a limiting strip inclined towards the second connecting piece, one side, which is close to the second connecting piece, is provided with a first flange and a third flange, the second connecting piece is provided with a limiting hole matched with the first flange, and the fixing block is provided with a limiting hole matched with the third flange, so that the possibility of damaging an optical fiber cable of the optical fiber module plug-in box is reduced through the embedding of the third flange and the limiting hole of the second flange.

title_en: Multistage water mark system that removes of high-speed armoured optical cable
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multistage water mark removing system of a high-speed armored optical cable, which comprises a hairbrush, an annular air knife and a hot air dryer, wherein the hairbrush, the annular air knife and the hot air dryer are sequentially arranged along the advancing direction of the armored optical cable, the hairbrush is used for brushing off water marks on the outer surface of the armored optical cable from a cooling water tank, the annular air knife is provided with a plurality of air slits which are circumferentially arranged and used for spreading the water marks attached to the outer surface of the armored optical cable, and the hot air dryer is used for blowing hot air to dry the outer surface of the armored optical cable. When the armored cable is separated from the water-cooling water tank, the hairbrush of the first stage can sweep away the water mark of the large particles on the surface of the armored cable, the annular air knife of the second stage can blow away the water mark of the small particles on the surface of the armored cable, and the hot air dryer of the third stage can remove the water mark of the small particles on the surface of the armored cable in a drying mode, so that the electric spark breakdown false alarm caused by the water mark residue on the surface of the armored cable is avoided, the bulge false alarm caused by the water mark residue on the surface of the armored cable is avoided, and the negative influence on the code-spraying mark printing quality is prevented.

title_en: Pixel circuit, driving method thereof and display device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a pixel circuit, a driving method thereof and a display device, wherein a channel material of a driving transistor is a material with a hysteresis effect, so that the driving transistor has the hysteresis effect; in the data writing stage, the driving transistor is turned on to write the data voltage; in the light-emitting stage, due to the hysteresis effect of the driving transistor, even if the gate voltage of the driving transistor is turned off, the source leakage current of the driving transistor is still larger than the off-state current of the driving transistor, and the driving transistor is still in an on-state, therefore, the pixel circuit provided by the embodiment of the invention can realize the storage function without additionally arranging a capacitor device, so that the pixel circuit can save one capacitor device, and the pixel circuit has no capacitor device, thereby saving the process flow for manufacturing the capacitor device, reducing the cost, improving the light-emitting brightness, reducing the power consumption, releasing the pixel space, reducing the pixel size and improving the pixel resolution.

title_en: System and method for manufacturing waveguide unit
abstract_en: Systems and methods for fabricating waveguide cells are disclosed. The system for the fabrication of waveguide units according to various embodiments may be configured and implemented in many different ways. In many embodiments, various deposition mechanisms are used to deposit the layer(s) of optical recording material onto the transparent substrate. A second transparent substrate may be provided and three layers may be laminated to form a waveguide unit. Suitable optical recording materials can vary widely depending on the given application. In some embodiments, the deposited optical recording material has a similar composition throughout the layer. In many embodiments, the optical recording material spatially varies in composition, allowing the formation of optical elements having varying characteristics. Any method of placing or depositing the optical recording material onto the substrate may be utilized regardless of the composition of the optical recording material.

title_en: Optical lens and electronic device
abstract_en: The application discloses an optical lens and electronic equipment comprising the same. The optical lens sequentially comprises from a first side to a second side along an optical axis: a first lens with negative focal power, wherein a first side surface of the first lens is a convex surface, and a second side surface of the first lens is a concave surface; a second lens with negative focal power, wherein the first side surface of the second lens is a concave surface; a third lens having optical power; a fourth lens having positive optical power, the first side of which is convex; a fifth lens having positive optical power, the second side of which is convex; a sixth lens with positive focal power, wherein the first side surface of the sixth lens is a convex surface, and the second side surface of the sixth lens is a convex surface; a seventh lens with negative focal power, wherein the first side surface of the seventh lens is concave, and the second side surface of the seventh lens is convex; and an eighth lens having positive optical power, the first side of which is convex.

title_en: Image pickup lens
abstract_en: The application discloses an imaging lens which comprises a lens barrel, a five-piece lens group and a positioning element group, wherein the five-piece lens group and the positioning element group are arranged in the lens barrel, the five-piece lens group comprises a first lens, a second lens, a third lens, a fourth lens and a fifth lens which are sequentially arranged from an object side to an image side along an optical axis, wherein the fifth lens has negative focal power, the distance from the image side to an imaging surface of the imaging lens is gradually reduced and then gradually increased in a direction perpendicular to the optical axis and far away from the optical axis, the positioning element group comprises a fourth positioning element and a fifth positioning element, the fourth positioning element is arranged on the image side of the fourth lens and is contacted with the image side of the fourth lens, and the fifth positioning element is arranged on the image side of the fifth lens and is contacted with the image side of the fifth lens, and the effective focal length f5 of the fifth lens, the central thickness CT5 of the fifth lens on the optical axis and the interval EP45 between the fourth positioning element and the fifth positioning element along the optical axis satisfy the range of-30.0 f 5/(EP 45-5) minus 5.0.

title_en: Light splitting structure and backlight module
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of display technical equipment, and particularly relates to a light splitting structure and a backlight module. The light splitting structure is used for splitting light of the light source, the light source projects light towards the light splitting structure, the light splitting structure is made of light-transmitting materials and is provided with a light incident surface opposite to the light source and a light emergent surface opposite to the light source, the light incident surface is provided with light incident holes for light incidence and for gathering the light, the light emits out of the light splitting structure at the light emergent surface, and the light incident holes are arranged at intervals on the light incident surface. According to the invention, a plurality of densely arranged point light sources are formed on the light splitting structure, so that the uniformity of light transmission is improved.

title_en: Azo surface relief grating doped with carbon oxide nano tube and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical fields of grating optical devices, carbon and azo functional materials and nanometer advanced processing, and discloses an azo surface relief grating optical device doped with carbon oxide nanotubes and a preparation method thereof. The azo surface relief grating doped with the carbon oxide nano tube is mainly characterized in that the azo surface relief grating is used as a typical micro optical device, has high diffraction efficiency, small volume, light weight and high design freedom degree, and has wide application prospect in the fields of optical imaging, optical data storage, laser technology, biomedicine and the like.

title_en: Backlight unit and display device including the same
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to a backlight unit and a display device including the same. In particular, a backlight unit having enhanced image quality and a display device having the same may be provided, the backlight unit including: at least one light source disposed on the printed circuit and spaced apart from each other; a reflector disposed on the printed circuit and including at least one protrusion disposed to correspond to the at least one light source; and a diffusion plate disposed on the reflector, wherein the at least one protrusion surrounds the at least one light source, respectively, and wherein the protrusion includes at least one opening in a side surface thereof.

title_en: High-power semiconductor laser
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-power semiconductor laser, which relates to the technical field of semiconductor lasers, and comprises: base is equipped with the backup pad on the base, still includes: the 2N two-dimensional laser array light sources are arranged on the base along the same direction and are used for emitting laser to form light beams; the 2N fast axis collimating mirror arrays are vertically arranged on the supporting plate and are positioned above the two-dimensional laser array light sources and used for collimating the light beams along the fast axis direction; 2N slow axis collimating mirror arrays vertically arranged on the supporting plate and above each fast axis collimating mirror array for collimating each light beam along the slow axis direction; the beam shrinking system is arranged on the base and used for shrinking the combined light beam along the fast axis direction. The invention can realize high power output of the semiconductor laser, reduce the volume and reduce the production cost.

title_en: Microscopic objective optical system, silicon wafer defect detection device and detection method
abstract_en: The invention provides a microscope objective optical system, a silicon wafer defect detection device and a silicon wafer defect detection method. The microscope objective optical system includes: a diaphragm; a first lens group positioned on a first side of the diaphragm and having a negative first optical power, a first spherical aberration, a first curvature of field, a first chromatic aberration, a first astigmatism, a first coma and a negative first distortion; a second lens group located at a second side of the diaphragm and having a second optical power, a positive second spherical aberration, a positive second field curvature, a negative second chromatic aberration, a second astigmatism, a second coma and a second distortion; and a third refractive lens group located at a second side of the second lens group, having a third optical power, a third spherical aberration, a third curvature of field, a third chromatic aberration, a positive third astigmatism, a positive second coma, and a third distortion. The invention can simultaneously meet the observation requirements of a large view field, a high numerical aperture and a wide spectrum band, and obtain the imaging effect of high imaging quality and low optical distortion close to the diffraction limit.

title_en: Laser galvanometer module and camera
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a laser galvanometer module and a camera. The laser galvanometer module includes: the vibration mirror assembly is arranged in the mounting hole in a penetrating mode; the locking assembly comprises a clamping piece and a locking piece, the clamping piece and the locking piece are sleeved between the hole wall of the mounting hole and the galvanometer assembly, and at least part of the clamping piece is positioned between the locking piece and the galvanometer assembly; the locking piece is in threaded connection with the hole wall of the mounting hole; when the locking piece is locked with the mounting hole, the clamping piece deforms and holds the vibrating mirror assembly tightly. The laser galvanometer module can better fix the galvanometer component, so that the stability of the galvanometer component fixed on the mounting seat can be ensured, and the working reliability of the galvanometer component can be ensured.

title_en: Defocused prism lens combined lens for controlling myopia progression
abstract_en: The invention provides a defocused prism lens combination lens for controlling myopia progression, which comprises an outer ring, an inner ring and a central area, wherein the inner ring is positioned between the outer ring and the central area, the outer ring is a multi-point myopia defocusing area with a forward defocused optical axis, the inner ring is a prism dispersion deflection defocusing area with a reverse dispersion deflection defocused optical axis, and the central area is a pupil optical central area. The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: has effects of preventing and controlling progressive myopia of school-age children, inhibiting eye axis lengthening, and preventing and controlling axial myopia growth.

title_en: Lamination processing apparatus, image forming apparatus, and image forming system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a laminate processing apparatus, an image forming apparatus, and an image forming system that can provide good usability for both users who pay attention to productivity even when power consumption is high and users who pay attention to power consumption reduction even when power consumption is low. A laminating processing unit (51) for performing a laminating process of heating and pressurizing a subject to be processed, and a heater (52) for heating the laminating processing unit are provided. Then, either one of a first mode and a second mode is configured to be able to be selected, wherein the first mode is to heat the lamination processing section by the heater at all times when the power is turned on, and the second mode is to start heating the lamination processing section by the heater after the lamination processing is requested, and to end heating the lamination processing section by the heater after a predetermined time (Tx) has elapsed after the lamination processing is ended. The predetermined time in the second mode can be adjusted.

title_en: Apodization of refractive index profile in bulk gratings
abstract_en: The grating coupler may be fabricated by exposing the photopolymer layer to grating forming light to form periodic refractive index variations in the photopolymer layer. The photopolymer layer can be exposed to apodized light to reduce the amplitude of the periodic refractive index variation in a spatially selective manner. Apodization can also be achieved or facilitated by subjecting the outer surface(s) of the photopolymer layer to a chemical reactant that reduces the refractive index contrast near the applied surface(s). The apodized refractive index profile of the grating helps reduce optical crosstalk between different gratings of the grating coupler.

title_en: Flat lens and device for terahertz frequency band multi-angle annular uniform illumination
abstract_en: The invention discloses a plate lens and a device for multi-angle annular uniform illumination of a terahertz frequency band, and relates to the field of terahertz active imaging. According to the invention, the plurality of annular grooves are arranged on the emergent surface of the flat lens with the air hole array and the center point defect or are constructed as random rough surfaces, so that terahertz light beams with Gaussian distribution irradiated by the terahertz source can be converted into annular uniform illumination light beams emergent at multiple angles, the terahertz waves illuminate targets from different angles, reflected wave signals entering the detection system are increased, and the terahertz wave detection device has outstanding application value for application scenes of the terahertz waves in the fields of nondestructive detection, human body security inspection and the like. In addition, in the reflective terahertz active imaging system, compared with a circular light beam, the annular light beam can convert small-angle incident light with low imaging utilization rate in the central part into large-angle incident light with higher imaging utilization rate, so that the multi-angle illumination can be provided and the energy utilization rate can be improved.

title_en: Dark field imaging super surface slide for transmission microscope
abstract_en: The invention provides a dark field imaging super surface slide for a transmission microscope, which comprises an optical frequency conversion luminous layer and an optical super surface layer. The optical filter is arranged at the bottom of the light frequency conversion luminous layer, and the spin coating layer composed of quantum dots and polymethyl methacrylate is arranged at the top of the light frequency conversion luminous layer. The light-frequency-converted light-emitting layer filters incident white light, and light with specific wavelength passes through the post-excitation quantum dot to generate excitation light through light-frequency conversion. The optical super-surface layer is composed of a multi-layer dielectric film structure, has a customized light transmission band, and has the functions of small-angle interception and large-angle transmission for excitation light, so that a large-angle emergent light cone required by dark field imaging is formed. The dark field imaging super-surface slide has a compact integral structure, is suitable for a common transmission type optical microscope, and simplifies the dark field imaging technology.

title_en: End face coupler and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application provides an end face coupler and a preparation method thereof. The end face coupler comprises a superlens, a micro-reflector and an end face coupler waveguide, wherein the superlens is used for carrying out phase regulation on incident light transmitted from an optical fiber so as to collect the incident light on the surface of the micro-reflector, and the micro-reflector is used for turning the light collected on the surface and reflecting the light to the incident end face of the end face coupler waveguide so as to realize mode spot conversion. The method and the device can solve the problem of mode field mismatch of the optical fiber and the chip waveguide in the optical chip.

title_en: Acquisition action induction interactive projection interaction device and application method
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of projection interaction devices, and discloses an interaction device for collecting action induction type projection interaction, which comprises a projector body, a heat dissipation shell, a mounting rack, a turnover adjusting mechanism, an angle adjusting mechanism and an action collection mechanism, wherein the heat dissipation shell is detachably connected to the projector body; the projector body comprises a bottom shell, a bottom cover and a mounting plate, and a projection device is arranged on the mounting plate; the bottom shell is rotationally connected with a mounting frame; the bottom surface of the mounting plate is provided with a turnover adjusting mechanism; the turnover adjusting mechanism is in transmission connection with an angle adjusting mechanism; the angle adjusting mechanism is connected with two action acquisition mechanisms in a transmission way. According to the invention, the indication action is projected by the projector, so that the induction interaction is realized, the concave seat and the acquisition camera rotate to adjust the angle, the output end of the micro motor can also drive the acquisition camera to rotate to adjust, the acquisition visual angle changes along with the change of the projection visual angle, and the smooth acquisition of the personnel indication action is realized.

title_en: Lifting system for overhead ADSS optical cable
abstract_en: The invention relates to a lifting system of an overhead ADSS optical cable, which is used for lifting a communication optical cable between two telegraph poles oppositely arranged on two sides of a road; the cable fixing device comprises a first cable fixing device, a second cable fixing device and a synchronous lifting device arranged between the two cable fixing devices; the first cable fixing device comprises a bearing plate and a cable fixing frame; the communication optical cable is fixedly connected with the cable fixing frame; a rolling device is arranged between the cable fixing frame and the telegraph pole; the rolling device comprises a first fixed roller, a second movable roller, a third movable roller and a fourth fixed roller; a pressure regulating device is arranged between the movable roller and the cable fixing frame; the synchronous lifting device comprises a pulley system and a winding drum device; the winding drum device comprises a shell, a main shaft, a winding drum and a reversing prevention device; the driving control communication optical cable on two sides of the road can be lifted synchronously through the pulley system.

title_en: Double-parabolic reflective dynamic focusing and three-dimensional scanning device with double correction of aberration
abstract_en: The invention discloses a double-parabolic reflective dynamic focusing and three-dimensional scanning device with double correction of aberration, and belongs to the field of optical design. Comprising the following steps: the double-parabolic reflective dynamic focusing modules are symmetrically arranged and are used for changing the divergence angle on the off-axis optical path so as to dynamically focus and correct static aberration; the aberration correction lens group is positioned between any two adjacent optical components of the double-parabolic reflection type dynamic focusing module arranged along the optical path and is used for reducing the optical path difference between other light rays in the off-axis optical path and the central light ray of each off-axis light ray, so as to correct the aberration generated in the dynamic focusing process. The lens group with the aberration correction function is placed at a specific position to improve the quality of laser three-dimensional scanning light spots, so that the focusing range in the Z direction is greatly improved to more than 2 times that of the prior art, the limitation of the processing range caused by the optical structure of the double-parabolic reflection type dynamic focusing system is solved, and the application scene of the structure is developed.

title_en: Optical element driving mechanism
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides an optical element driving mechanism including: a fixed part, a first movable part and a driving component. The first movable part can move relative to the fixed part. The driving assembly drives the first movable part to move relative to the fixed part. The first movable part drives an optical element to move.

title_en: Optical fiber channel
abstract_en: The application discloses an optical fiber channel, which relates to the technical field of optical fiber erection devices, and comprises a channel frame and a driving piece, wherein a plurality of wire arranging grooves are formed in the upper side of the channel frame, the wire arranging grooves are used for accommodating part of optical fibers, sliding holes are formed in the side walls of the wire arranging grooves, an elastic piece and a sliding piece which slides are arranged in the sliding holes in a sliding mode, two ends of the elastic piece are respectively connected with the sliding piece and the inner wall of the sliding hole, a first inclined surface is arranged on one side, far away from the elastic piece, of the sliding piece, and is gradually close to the elastic piece upwards, a wire storage space is formed between the lower side wall of the sliding piece and the wire arranging grooves, the wire storage space is matched with the optical fiber in size, the distance from the upper side, far away from one end of the elastic piece, of the sliding piece to the upper side surface of the channel frame is smaller than the radius of the optical fibers, and the driving piece can enable the optical fibers to abut against the channel frame and drive the optical fibers to slide on the channel frame along the axis direction of the sliding holes. The application has the effect of being convenient for maintaining the optical fiber.

title_en: Ultrathin plane geometric phase polymer liquid crystal wave plate for generating arbitrary vector light field and light field complex amplitude modulation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultrathin plane geometric phase polymer liquid crystal wave plate for generating an arbitrary vector light field and a light field complex amplitude modulation method, and relates to the technical field of optics and micro-nano photonics. The method comprises the steps of respectively constructing an intensity mask and a phase mask as the front surface and the rear surface of a polymer liquid crystal wave plate, respectively performing an intensity modulation function and a phase modulation function on the front surface and the rear surface, calculating a blazed grating phase depth distribution function according to a target light field amplitude distribution function, superposing the function on the blazed grating to obtain the intensity mask, extracting target phase distribution from target light field spatial complex amplitude, and translating the target phase distribution into optical axis orientation distribution of polymer liquid crystal to obtain the phase mask. The polymer liquid crystal wave plate with the space complex amplitude modulation capability provided by the invention has the advantages of low cost, easiness in integration, small volume, light weight, great shortening of the light path and capability of precisely regulating and controlling the space amplitude and the phase of a light field to generate any vector light field.

title_en: Cholesterol liquid crystal display device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cholesterol liquid crystal display device, which comprises a first substrate, a solar cell, a shielding layer, a first electrode layer, a cholesterol liquid crystal layer, a second electrode layer and a second substrate which are sequentially stacked from bottom to top, wherein the solar cell comprises a metal circuit pattern layer, and the shielding layer is arranged between the solar cell and the first electrode layer and corresponds to the upper part of the metal circuit pattern layer and is used for reducing the reflection of the metal circuit pattern layer on light rays. Therefore, the cholesterol liquid crystal display device replaces the traditional black absorption layer by the black material of the solar battery, thereby not only playing a role of light absorption, but also realizing autonomous power generation to display pictures; the shielding layer shields the metal circuit pattern layer, so that the picture quality of the panel can be ensured.

title_en: Laser power tuning attenuation device and annealing equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a laser power tuning and attenuating device and annealing equipment, wherein the laser power tuning and attenuating device comprises a reflective polarization rotating unit and a polarization splitting reflector, wherein the incident surface of the reflector in the reflective polarization rotating unit is positioned on the same plane, the reflective polarization rotating unit is used for receiving incident light and rotatably arranged around the optical axis of the incident light, the sum of phase delay amounts of the incident light, which is perpendicular to the incident surface, of s light and p light after passing through the reflective polarization rotating unit is an odd multiple of 180 degrees, so that the polarization direction of emergent light after passing through the reflective polarization rotating unit rotates by a certain angle relative to the polarization direction of the incident light, and the emergent light is reflected by the polarization splitting reflector to obtain output light after power attenuation. According to the technical scheme, the laser power attenuation in the high-power laser annealing equipment can be accurately controlled, and meanwhile, the stability of the shape, the size and the directivity of the output light can be maintained, so that the annealing process index is improved.

title_en: Edge coupling connectors via collimated silicon photons
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to edge-coupled connectors via collimated silicon photons. A coupled optical system configured for collimation of light is provided. The coupled optical system includes an optical system. The optical system includes a shelf. The shelf includes one or more optical alignment surfaces. The optical system includes one or more interface lenses coupled to the shelf. The coupled optical system includes an optical connector. The optical connector includes one or more connector lenses. The optical connector includes one or more connector alignment surfaces.

title_en: Laser heating optical fiber fusion tapering method and tapering system thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tapering method for melting a laser heating optical fiber, which comprises the following steps: the lower computer monitors the temperature of the heating area in real time, and generates a corresponding temperature value from the monitored temperature and feeds the corresponding temperature value back to the upper computer; and the upper computer adjusts the cone drawing speed of the cone drawing platform according to the change of the temperature value fed back by the lower computer. The invention also discloses a tapering system for realizing the tapering method of the laser heating optical fiber melting, which mainly comprises a lower computer and a lower computer, wherein the lower computer is used for monitoring the temperature of a heating area in real time, generating a corresponding temperature value by the monitored temperature and feeding back the temperature value to an upper computer, and the upper computer is used for adjusting the tapering speed of a tapering platform according to the change of the temperature value fed back by the lower computer. The invention has the advantages of improving the ratio of the optical fiber to the requirement, facilitating the maintenance of maintenance personnel in time, and the like.

title_en: System with display and sensor
abstract_en: A head-mounted device may have a head-mounted support structure (26). A rear facing display (14R, 14L) may present images to an eyebox (34) located at the rear of the head mounted support structure. A forward facing public visual display (14F) may be supported on a front side of the head mounted support structure, facing away from the rear facing display. The forward display may have pixels forming an Active Area (AA) in which an image is displayed, and may have an annular inactive border area (IA) surrounding the pixels. The active area may have a curved peripheral edge with a nasal bridge depression. The inactive border region may have a perimeter that extends parallel to the perimeter edge of the active region. The forward display may have a cover layer (92) with a deployable surface overlying the active area and an annular surface overlying the inactive area having a compound curvature. The optical component is operable in the inactive area by the cover layer.

title_en: Microwave photon filter based on stimulated Brillouin scattering effect
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of microwave photonics, and provides a microwave photon filter based on a stimulated Brillouin scattering effect, which is used for solving the problem that the input dynamic range of the existing microwave photon filter is lower due to the influence of the stimulated Brillouin scattering gain saturation effect. The invention comprises a laser source CW, an arbitrary waveform generator AWG, a double parallel Mach-Zehnder modulator DPMZM, an erbium-doped optical fiber amplifier EDFA, an optical circulator OC, a tunable laser source TLS, a phase modulator PM, a signal source SG, an optical isolator ISO, a high nonlinear optical fiber HNLF and a photoelectric detector PD, wherein in the high nonlinear optical fiber, the stimulated Brillouin loss spectrum excited by pumping light is used for processing a lower light edge band generated by phase modulation, but not a gain spectrum, so that the influence of the stimulated Brillouin gain saturation effect is avoided, and a microwave photon filter has a large input dynamic range; in addition, the filter has good tuning and passband reconstruction characteristics.

title_en: Photosensitive dry film, laminated film, method for producing laminated film, and method for producing patterned resist film
abstract_en: The invention provides a photosensitive dry film which is composed of a chemically amplified positive photosensitive composition, can inhibit the opacification and separation caused by contained resin, and can inhibit the residue of bubbles generated when heating to remove solvent. A photosensitive dry film composed of a chemically amplified positive photosensitive composition comprises: acid generator (A); resin (B), the solubility to alkali is increased by the action of acid; an organic solvent (S), wherein the resin (B) comprises an acrylic resin (B3), the acrylic resin (B3) comprises a structural unit (B3 a), the structural unit (B3 a) is derived from a (meth) acrylate containing an alicyclic hydrocarbon group which is non-dissociable with an acid, and the organic solvent (S) comprises a high boiling point organic solvent (S1) which satisfies the conditions I) and II). I) The boiling point at atmospheric pressure is 150 ℃ or higher.II) the value of the hydrogen bond energy term δh associated with the Hansen solubility parameter is 11 (MPa)  0.5  The following is given.

title_en: Double-layer liquid crystal film and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of liquid crystals, and particularly relates to a double-layer liquid crystal film and a preparation method thereof. According to the invention, acrylic ester liquid crystal and epoxy liquid crystal are utilized, chiral dopants with different end groups are used, a free radical photoinitiator and a cationic photoinitiator are added, a double-layer liquid crystal film with an acrylic ester system and an epoxy liquid crystal system separated is prepared by utilizing polymerization-induced phase separation and polymerization rate difference of a mixture of two reactive end groups through one-time coating and two-time photo-crosslinking polymerization, a double-layer liquid crystal film with double reflection bands and composite colors is obtained, and the relative positions of the two reflection bands can be adjusted by adjusting the relative content and the overall content of the two chiral dopants, so that a double-layer film with a band-tunable composite structural color is obtained.

title_en: Glimmer full-glass fish-eye lens
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of optical lenses, in particular to a low-light full-glass fish-eye lens, which adopts 9 spherical glass sheets to furthest correct the aberration of a system, has excellent performance, compact structure among lenses, reduces the use of space ring components, has the characteristics of small volume, light weight, low cost and the like, has higher cost performance, can realize the characteristics of small volume, light weight, good performance and low cost, and realizes 24-hour all-weather high-definition monitoring, day and night imaging confocal and real-time image definition through reasonable lens material selection, optical power distribution and optical design optimization.

title_en: Pattern correction method and system and preparation method of photomask
abstract_en: The application relates to a pattern correction method and system and a preparation method of a photomask. The graph correction method comprises the following steps: obtaining a design graph, wherein the design graph comprises a plurality of graphs to be corrected which are distributed at intervals; performing optical proximity correction on the design graph to obtain a plurality of initial correction graphs which are distributed at intervals; obtaining a correction area violating the minimum rule of the mask plate in the initial correction graph, and removing the correction area; setting a strip pattern on the side edge of the initial correction pattern based on the correction area; and merging the strip pattern with the initial correction pattern to obtain the target pattern. The pattern correction method can improve the convergence degree and accuracy of the pattern, ensure the accuracy of photoetching and further ensure the performance of products.

title_en: Piezoelectric driving element
abstract_en: A piezoelectric driving element (1) is provided with: a movable part (10); a pair of piezoelectric driving units (20) each having an end (20 a) connected to the movable unit (10) and configured to rotate the movable unit (10) at least with respect to the rotation shaft (R10); and a fixing part (30) connected with the end part (20 b) of the piezoelectric driving part (20). The pair of piezoelectric driving parts (20) are arranged side by side along the direction of the rotation axis (R10) with the movable part (10) interposed therebetween, the width of the movable part (10) is narrower than the width of the pair of piezoelectric driving parts (20) in a plan view, and the fixed part (30) is arranged outside the movable part (10) in a plan view and is sandwiched by the gap region (G) of the pair of piezoelectric driving parts (20).

title_en: Multimode lens switching mechanism and optical lens
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multimode lens switching mechanism and an optical lens, comprising: a bracket for mounting a lens assembly, the bracket being configured to be connectable to and rotationally coupled to one of the structures of the optical lens, an axis of rotation between the bracket and the structure being perpendicular to an optical axis of the optical lens; the first driving mechanism is used for driving the bracket to rotate on the structural member, so that the lens component can be switched into the optical path of the optical lens or completely switched out of the optical path of the optical lens. The optical lens is based on the structural characteristics of the lens switching mechanism, so that the lens component can be quickly switched in/out of the optical lens, and the performance of the optical lens is improved under the condition of expanding the functions of the optical lens; the whole structure is simpler and more compact, and the application requirements of high precision, multifunction and miniaturization of the optical lens can be better met.

title_en: Intelligent same-screen control embedded ultra-thin anti-glare down lamp
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent same-screen control embedded ultra-thin anti-glare down lamp, which comprises an external constant voltage source/double constant voltage design output/constant current constant voltage source) +a light source outer shell, wherein an anti-glare mechanism (a lamp body surface step anti-glare design) is arranged in the outer shell, the anti-glare mechanism comprises a light source component, an FPC back glue is adhered to the inner wall of the outer shell, the light source component consists of 2835 SMD LED (2700-6500K) +three-in-one RGB (red, green, blue) with 3528 sizes in two color temperature ranges, the inner wall of the outer shell is completely adhered to the FPC light source component, and through a light guide and light transmission technology, when equipment is powered on, uniform light emission of light is realized.

title_en: Glasses posture adjusting method, electronic device and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a method for adjusting the posture of glasses, electronic equipment and a storage medium, which belong to the technical field of wearable equipment, and the method for adjusting the posture of the glasses comprises the following steps: collecting target type data of the glasses in a wearing state; determining sliding gesture data of the glasses based on the change of the target type data; acquiring attitude control parameters of the glasses according to the sliding attitude data of the glasses; and adjusting the posture of the glasses based on the posture control parameters so as to inhibit sliding.

title_en: Dual layer optical coupling arrangement between photonic integrated circuit and external single mode optical fiber
abstract_en: A dual layer coupling arrangement includes a first coupling waveguide disposed within a photonic integrated circuit (at a location above an included optical signal waveguide) and a second coupling waveguide disposed above the first coupling waveguide. The first coupling waveguide and the second coupling waveguide are formed to assume a splitter configuration terminating as a pair of arms separated by a distance suitable to produce a beam that will coincide with the circular mode field of the core region of the coupled optical fiber. The vertical spacing between the first coupling waveguide and the second coupling waveguide is set such that the beam pair exiting the terminal arm of the coupling waveguide coincides with the circular mode field.

title_en: Image capturing lens
abstract_en: An image capturing lens assembly is provided, which includes, in order from an object side toward an image side along an optical axis, a first lens element, a prism, a second lens element, a third lens element, a fourth lens element, a fifth lens element and a sixth lens element. The first lens is arranged on the light incident side of the prism, the second lens to the sixth lens are arranged on the light emergent side of the prism, and the optical axis turns on the reflecting surface of the prism. The image capturing lens has six lenses with diopters, wherein the first lens to the sixth lens are aspheric lenses, and the diopters are positive, negative, positive and negative respectively. The ratio of the focal length of the first lens and the distance between the prism and the second lens on the optical axis is greater than or equal to 4 and less than or equal to 60.

title_en: Optical fiber sleeve holder
abstract_en: The invention relates to an optical fiber sleeve holder, which is provided with a piston through hole in the middle of a piston, a piston rod is provided with a guiding long through hole along the long axis direction, a hollow pipe penetrates through the piston through hole and the guiding long through hole, and two ends of the hollow pipe extend out of a cylinder body. When the optical fiber is in operation, the optical fiber is inserted into the hollow tube, passes through the cylinder body of the cylinder and the chuck through the hollow tube, and precisely enters the sleeve through the chuck. The outer wall of hollow tube and piston sealing connection, so set up, can not influence the piston and the piston rod motion of cylinder yet in increasing the hollow tube. The invention is also provided with a glue applying part, when the optical fiber passes through the glue applying ring, the glue can be adhered to the outer surface of the optical fiber, and when the optical fiber is inserted into the sleeve, the glue is distributed between the optical fiber and the sleeve. Compared with the prior art, the invention can omit the step of sizing in the sleeve in advance, finish sizing and fiber inserting when the sleeve is held, and has less operation steps and high working efficiency.

title_en: Cable manufacturing method and device
abstract_en: The application discloses a cable preparation method and a preparation device, which belong to the technical field of optical cable preparation, and comprise a reinforced core pay-off rack, a twisting table, an extruder, a code spraying machine and a cooling water tank which are sequentially arranged along the cable forming direction; the optical unit pay-off frames are arranged on two sides of the reinforced core pay-off frame along the axial direction of the cable; a first clamping wheel set is arranged between the stranding table and the extruder, a second clamping wheel set is arranged in the cooling water tank, and the clamping center of the first clamping wheel set and the clamping center of the second clamping wheel set are axially overlapped with the cable; the first clamping wheel set and the second clamping wheel set can rotate along the axial direction of the cable; the first clamping wheel set and the second clamping wheel set are adjustable in clamping distance along the radial direction of the cable. According to the application, the ink jet printer is arranged between the extruder and the cooling water tank in front, so that the ink is jet printed on the surface of the uncooled and shaped outer sheath, and the rotation of the cable is limited by the clamping wheel set, so that the cable has good scratch resistance and identification.

title_en: Optical system, camera module and imaging method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optical system, a camera module and an imaging method, wherein the optical system comprises: the imaging lens is matched with the image sensor and participates in focusing imaging; the imaging lens is used for setting an effective angle range and an ineffective angle range relative to an imaging optical axis, allowing effective incident light to completely transmit when the incident light angle falls into the effective angle range, and intercepting ineffective incident light or conditionally allowing ineffective incident light to transmit when the incident light angle falls into the ineffective angle range. The optical system provided by the invention can solve the problem of stray light interference caused by transmission or reflection, adjusts the light path to carry out expected transmission, can assist in enhancing the purity and quality of pictures, and is dynamically adapted to complex and changeable external light environments and internal light transmission paths.

title_en: Lattice laser output device and method
abstract_en: The application provides a lattice laser output device and a method, wherein the device comprises: the device comprises an optical fiber laser, a homogenizing optical fiber, a quartz end cap, a converging lens array, a diaphragm and an adjusting module; the fiber laser generates laser; the homogenizing optical fiber receives the laser from the optical fiber laser and uniformly distributes the power density from the optical fiber laser; the quartz end cap receives the laser from the homogenizing optical fiber and expands and collimates the laser from the homogenizing optical fiber; the converging lens array is provided with a plurality of micro lenses which are arranged in an array structure, and receives the laser from the quartz end cap and outputs converging lattice laser; the diaphragm adjusts the envelope shape of the converged lattice laser output by the converging lens array; the adjusting module receives the converged lattice laser from the diaphragm and adjusts the distance between single-point light spots or the size of the single-point light spots in the lattice laser.

title_en: Polymer for black matrix, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a polymer for a black matrix, which is prepared by reacting a dianhydride monomer with an esterification reagent to obtain an intermediate, and then reacting the intermediate, a diamine monomer and 1, 8-dihydroxy-2, 4,5, 7-tetramino-9, 10-anthraquinone. The polymer provided by the application has unique structural characteristics, has higher OD value, better mechanical and thermal properties and photoetching properties, and can better meet the requirements of the current industry on the performance of a black matrix when being applied to the black matrix. Meanwhile, the application also discloses a preparation method and application of the polymer, wherein the preparation method has simple process and is convenient for industrialized popularization and application. The application of the polymer not only provides a new polymer choice for the black matrix, but also can obviously improve the mechanical and thermal properties of the black matrix.

title_en: Micro lens focusing and mounting equipment and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a miniature lens focusing and mounting device, which comprises an operation platform, wherein a first positioning mechanism, a second positioning mechanism and a mounting mechanism are arranged on the operation platform, the first positioning mechanism and the second positioning mechanism are respectively connected with a PCB and a lens, the mounting mechanism comprises a driving device and an assembling device, the driving device is connected with the assembling device and is used for driving the assembling device to move between the first positioning mechanism and the second positioning mechanism, and the assembling device is used for assembling the lens on the PCB.

title_en: High-brightness liquid crystal display module suitable for use under strong light
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-brightness liquid crystal display module suitable for use under strong light, which belongs to the field of display screens and comprises an LCD display panel, a support module and a heat dissipation module, wherein the LCD display panel is connected with the support module through a plurality of elastic buffer seats, the support module comprises a lower die holder, an upper die frame, a shading inner frame body and a support panel, the support panel is fixedly connected with the inner wall of the upper die frame, and a through hole for the shading inner frame body to move is formed in the support panel.
