According to the invention, the high-pressure fan is synchronously started, the air pressure is used for driving the shading inner frame body to move, three strong lights can be obviously shaded through the shading inner frame body arranged on three sides, a negative pressure area is formed through the air outlet on the shading inner frame body, ambient air can be sucked into the negative pressure area under the action of the air pressure, the effect of blowing air from the bottom and the front to the LCD display panel is formed, and the temperature of the LCD display panel can be obviously reduced under the effect of synchronous heat dissipation from inside to outside.

title_en: Optical cable assembly with mismatched fiber lengths
abstract_en: An optical connector assembly includes a first optical connector and a second optical connector. The first optical connector includes a first housing, a plurality of first optical fibers, a first cable holder, and a first optical coupling unit attached to the plurality of first optical fibers and separated by a first optical fiber length L1. The second optical connector includes a second housing, a plurality of second optical fibers, a second cable holder, and a second optical coupling unit attached to the plurality of second optical fibers and separated by a second optical fiber length L2 different from L1. The ratio of L1/L2 is such that when the first optical connector is mated with the second optical connector, the first and second light coupling units rotate and mate with respect to the first and second housings, respectively.

title_en: Magnetic imaging device and method based on diamond NV color center under high pressure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a magnetic imaging device and a method based on diamond NV color center under high pressure, comprising the following steps: the microwave circuit module is used for generating a microwave signal, so that the NV color center structure resonates after absorbing the microwave signal to generate an optical measurement magnetic resonance signal; the confocal optical path module is used for projecting laser onto the confocal optical path, focusing the laser on a shallow NV color center in the opposite anvil, exciting a fluorescent signal of the NV color center, and shooting fluorescent image data at the NV color center by a camera along the confocal optical path through the confocal optical path module; the high-pressure test module applies pressure to the diamond through the pressurizing mechanism, so that the sample cavity generates a high-pressure environment; the method is beneficial to focusing the NV color center by the laser through the confocal optical path, and simultaneously shooting fluorescent image data at the NV color center by the camera, so that the fluorescent image data can be more directly and accurately shot, and the accuracy of experimental results is ensured.

title_en: Projection optical system and projector
abstract_en: The invention provides a projection optical system and a projector, wherein the projection optical system can realize wide angle and miniaturization. The projection optical system includes, in order from the enlargement side toward the reduction side, a 1 st lens group having positive refractive power, an aperture stop, and a 2 nd lens group having positive refractive power. The reduction side lens closest to the reduction side of the 2 nd lens group is telecentric. When ω is the maximum half field angle of the entire lens system, YIM is the distance from the optical axis to the maximum image height of the projection image formed by the image forming element, YL1 is the distance from the optical axis to the maximum image height on the virtual plane passing through the vertex of the magnification side lens surface of the magnification side lens on the most magnification side of the 1 st lens group and perpendicular to the optical axis, the following conditional expressions (1) and (2) are satisfied: omega > 40 DEG (1) YL1/YIM < 6.0 (2).

title_en: OTP (one time programmable) burning jig for liquid crystal display
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of OTP (one time programmable) programming of a liquid crystal display, in particular to an OTP programming jig of the liquid crystal display, which comprises an OTP storage module composed of a chip and a clamping seat, wherein both sides of the clamping seat are provided with a plurality of conductive pins, the OTP programming jig further comprises a programming substrate and a substrate clamp, an electric seat is arranged on the programming substrate, both sides of the electric seat are provided with copper strip parts, a programming on-off mechanism is further arranged on the programming substrate, the programming on-off mechanism comprises a socket and a plug, the socket is provided with a plurality of copper holes, the plug comprises an installation seat and a plurality of telescopic pins, each telescopic pin comprises a probe and a vertical distance adjusting mechanism, the vertical distance adjusting mechanism comprises a wiring seat and a rotating seat, and a spring is arranged between the rotating seat and the wiring seat.

title_en: Liquid crystal display of handheld device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a liquid crystal display of a handheld device, which comprises a first substrate arranged above, a second substrate arranged below and a light spacer supported between the first substrate and the second substrate, wherein the inner side surface of the first substrate is also provided with a light filtering layer, the light filtering layer is provided with a plurality of color units, the light spacer is positioned below the light filtering layer, and the projection of the light spacer in the direction vertical to the first substrate is not overlapped with the projection of the light filtering layer in the direction vertical to the first substrate; the outer circumference of the photo spacer is coated with a reflective layer, or the color of the outermost layer of the photo spacer is the same as the color of at least one of the closest color cells of the photo spacer. According to the embodiment of the invention, the light reflecting layer is coated on the periphery of the light spacer or the color of the outermost layer of the light spacer is set to be the same as the color of at least one color unit in the color units closest to the light spacer, so that the light irradiated on the light spacer can be reflected to the outer side of the liquid crystal display, and the screen brightness of the liquid crystal display is improved.

title_en: Liquid crystal display surface static electricity removing device
abstract_en: The invention provides a liquid crystal display screen surface static electricity removing device, and relates to the field of liquid crystal display screen static electricity removing devices. The liquid crystal display surface static electricity removing device comprises a supporting component, a driving component, a connecting component, a lifting component, a static electricity removing component, a cleaning component and a detecting component, wherein the cleaning component comprises a transmission component and a liquid storage component, and the transmission component comprises a transmission frame. Through the rotation of the cleaning rod, the external sponge material contacts and extrudes the adhering rod, the adhering rod moves upwards, so that cleaning liquid inside the adhering groove flows out through the contact groove and is adsorbed in the sponge material on the surface of the cleaning rod, and then the cleaning rod continuously rotates to contact the surface of the liquid crystal screen for cleaning, and the steps are repeated for a plurality of times, so that the dust removal work of the liquid crystal screen is completed, dust particles adsorbed on the surface of the liquid crystal screen can be effectively removed when the static electricity removal work is completed, and the high-quality rate of liquid crystal screen processing is further improved.

title_en: Beam direction control element, display device, and method for driving beam direction control element
abstract_en: A beam direction control element, a display device, and a method for driving the beam direction control element are disclosed. The beam direction control element includes a beam direction controller and a controller. The beam direction controller includes a first light transmissive substrate, a second light transmissive substrate, a light transmissive region sandwiched between the first light transmissive substrate and the second light transmissive substrate, a light absorbing region located between the light transmissive regions, a light transmissive dispersion medium hermetically contained in the light absorbing region, and electrophoretic particles dispersed in the light transmissive dispersion medium.

title_en: Liquid crystal display screen
abstract_en: The application relates to a liquid crystal display screen, which comprises a CF layer, a TFT layer and liquid crystal clamped between the CF layer and the TFT layer, wherein the CF layer is uniform in thickness, a main spacer and an auxiliary spacer which are positioned on the periphery of the liquid crystal are arranged on the surface of the CF layer, the thickness of the TFT layer is uneven, the heights of the main spacer and the auxiliary spacer are the same, and the distance between the main spacer and the TFT layer is smaller than the distance between the auxiliary spacer and the TFT layer. The main and auxiliary spacers of the liquid crystal display are consistent in height and can be manufactured at one time by a common Mask process, so that the technical problems that the Mask design and manufacturing requirements are high and the film breaking rate is high due to the fact that the common Mask process is required to be manufactured in a separated mode and the Halftone Mask process is used in the prior art are solved.

title_en: Green color paste for color photoresist and application
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of photoresist, and relates to green color paste for color photoresist and application thereof, wherein the green color paste for color photoresist comprises, by weight, 10 parts of green pigment, 12-18 parts of acrylic resin, 8-12 parts of dispersing agent, 0.1-0.6 part of synergist and 60-70 parts of propylene glycol methyl ether acetate. The green color paste for the color photoresist is added with the synergist which takes the green pigment as the main chain for grafting modification, has good solubility and dispersibility, can be well adsorbed and combined on the surface of the green pigment, ensures that more functional groups are linked with the dispersing agent on the surface of the green pigment, increases the combination property with the dispersing agent, ensures that the green pigment is not agglomerated, thereby improving the contrast and the brightness of the color paste, meeting the requirement of a production line, reducing the consumption of the dispersing agent, reducing the subsequent development time and improving the quality of the color photoresist.

title_en: Real-time current-adjustable laser driving circuit
abstract_en: The invention relates to a laser driving circuit capable of adjusting current in real time, which comprises the steps that firstly, a preprocessing circuit controls input impedance, sorts the amplitude range of an input voltage signal, transmits the voltage signal to a closed-loop current supply circuit, then the closed-loop current supply circuit receives the voltage signal from the preprocessing circuit as a reference signal, combines output voltage feedback, obtains Sink current, transmits the Sink current to a mirror current source array circuit, and finally, the mirror current source array circuit provides corresponding Sink current for a laser, so that the real-time driving of the laser work is realized; the design realizes the high-speed high-precision closed-loop current control in the current source by detecting the voltage signal feedback on the high-precision ceramic current detection resistor, the influence of the parasitic inductance of the load on the closed-loop system is negligible, the response frequency of the current source can reach sinusoidal signals above 10MHz, and the parasitic inductance influence of the stripped load and the load cable is realized.

title_en: Light-absorbing anisotropic film, laminate, and image display device
abstract_en: The invention provides a light absorption anisotropic film, a laminate and an image display device capable of suppressing reflection generated between adjacent layers. The light absorbing anisotropic film of the present invention contains a dichroic material, and the polarization degree A measured by the incidence of polarized light from one surface of the light absorbing anisotropic film is different from the polarization degree B measured by the incidence of polarized light from the other surface of the light absorbing anisotropic film.

title_en: Optical fiber fixing mechanism, coupling device and method, and butt joint device and method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of optical fiber connection, and particularly relates to an optical fiber fixing mechanism, a coupling device and method, a butting device and method, wherein the butting device and method comprise a mounting seat, an optical fiber positioning sleeve and a positioning adjusting assembly; at least three linear moving members I are enclosed to form a plane, one end of each linear moving member I is arranged on the inner wall of the installation cavity, and the other end of each linear moving member I is abutted to the outer wall of the optical fiber positioning sleeve; one end of the elastic piece is fixed with the inner wall of the installation cavity, the other end of the elastic piece is fixed with the outer wall of the optical fiber positioning sleeve, the elastic piece is used for pulling the optical fiber positioning sleeve towards the direction of a pulling force axis of the installation cavity, and the pulling force axis is positioned between planes formed by at least three linear moving pieces I.

title_en: Desktop remote display system with peripheral defocusing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a desktop remote display system with peripheral defocusing, which comprises: a primary image source for providing a first light; an out-of-focus image source distributed around the periphery of the primary image source for providing a second light; a spectroscope disposed adjacent to the human eye; the reflecting mirror is far away from human eyes and is arranged opposite to the spectroscope; the spectroscope is used for reflecting at least part of light rays in the first light rays and the second light rays, and then the part of reflected light rays are reflected by the reflecting mirror, wherein at least part of light rays penetrate through the spectroscope and are emitted to the exit pupil position; the principal ray of the first ray is directed to the exit pupil position in a direction parallel to the visual axis to form a main display image, and the angle of the second ray directed to the exit pupil position is larger than that of the first ray, and an out-of-focus image is formed at the periphery of the main display image. The device realizes defocusing display by distributing defocusing image sources on the periphery of the main image source, thereby realizing vision prevention and control.

title_en: High-power annular high-speed camera shooting lamp and high-speed camera based on same
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-power annular high-speed camera shooting lamp and a high-speed camera based on the same, comprising a shell, wherein the shell comprises an inner cylinder, and a supporting annular plate is fixedly sleeved in the middle of the outer peripheral surface of the inner cylinder in an axial direction; the rotary supporting pieces are circumferentially and equidistantly distributed on one end face of the supporting ring plate, and are respectively and vertically and symmetrically connected with the two sides of the rotary supporting pieces through pivot shafts of supporting lug plates on the end face of the supporting ring plate; the lamp beads are respectively and fixedly arranged at the front center of the corresponding rotary supporting piece; the annular end face of the annular pushing piece facing to one side of the lamp bead is synchronously contacted with the back surfaces of the plurality of rotary supporting pieces; and the adjusting ring is in axial threaded fit connection with the outer peripheral surface of the end part of the ring pushing piece, which faces one side of the lamp bead. The invention can illuminate from the shooting angle of the high-speed camera, thereby being beneficial to the shooting effect of the high-speed camera; the light-emitting angle adjustable function formed by a plurality of lamp beads is realized, and the high-speed camera is beneficial to flexibly selecting a shooting range.

title_en: Virtual reality system
abstract_en: The application discloses a virtual reality system, which comprises a visual optical system and a positioning optical system, wherein the visual optical system sequentially comprises a first element group, a second element group, a third element group and a fourth element group from a first side to a second side along a first optical axis, the first element group comprises a reflective polarizing element, a first quarter wave plate and a first lens, the second element group comprises a second quarter wave plate and a second lens, the third element group comprises a third lens, the fourth element group comprises a fourth lens, the positioning optical system sequentially comprises a first lens, a second lens, a third lens, a fourth lens and a fifth lens from the object side to the image side along a second optical axis, the total effective focal length f 'of the visual optical system and the curvature radius R2' of the second side of the first lens and the curvature radius R8 'of the second side of the fourth lens meet 1.0mm < f'/(R2 '/R8') <5.0mm, and the total effective focal length f of the positioning optical system, the curvature radius R2 of the image side of the first lens and the curvature radius R2 of the fifth lens meet 1.0 mm/(R2/10.0 mm).

title_en: Photographic light filling equipment with anchor clamps
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of photographic light supplementing equipment, and discloses photographic light supplementing equipment with a clamp, which comprises a clamping box with a U-shaped opening and a downward guide opening connected with a camera, wherein clamping buckles for clamping the camera are movably arranged in notches of the clamping box, light sources for photographic light supplementing are arranged on two sides of the clamping box, convex lenses for adjusting light refraction of the light sources are arranged at front ends of two sides of the clamping box, and the light sources are connected with the clamping box through an omnidirectional adjusting structure. According to the camera self-media shooting device, the clamping buckles in the clamping box are upwards exposed, the clamping buckles are manually separated outwards, then the top surface of the lens at the front end of the camera is downwards placed between the clamping buckles, then the clamping buckles are released to clamp the camera, at the moment, the camera is connected, then the camera connected with the clamping box is taken up for normal shooting, and the beneficial effects that the camera self-media shooting device can be directly installed on the camera and is more suitable for media shooting are achieved.

title_en: Display substrate, display panel and display device
abstract_en: Display substrate, display panel and display device relate to and show technical field. The display substrate includes: a substrate, and a plurality of sub-pixels disposed on one side of the substrate, the sub-pixels comprising: a thin film transistor including a drain electrode; the insulating layer is arranged on one side of the thin film transistor, which is away from the substrate base plate; the pixel electrode is arranged on one side of the insulating layer, which is away from the substrate base plate; the pixel electrode and the drain electrode are connected through a transfer hole arranged on the insulating layer, and the orthographic projection shape of the transfer hole on the substrate is a non-centrosymmetric pattern.

title_en: Demultiplexer and method of using the same
abstract_en: We generally describe an optical demultiplexer comprising: an electro-optical modulator for changing the polarization of the light pulse having a first polarization and passing through the electro-optical modulator from the first polarization to a second polarization when the electro-optical modulator is in a first state; a first mirror and a second mirror, wherein the electro-optical modulator is located in an optical path between the first mirror and the second mirror such that light pulses traveling in the optical path between the first mirror and the second mirror pass through the electro-optical modulator, wherein the first mirror and the second mirror are located in the optical demultiplexer such that light pulses traveling in the optical path between the first mirror and the second mirror are shifted between the first mirror and the second mirror perpendicular to a direction of propagation of the light pulses during each round of travel between the first mirror and the second mirror; and a first polarizing beam splitter in the optical track between the first mirror and the electro-optical modulator, wherein the first polarizing beam splitter is configured to: transmitting the light pulses having the first polarization and reflecting the light pulses having the second polarization to remove the light pulses having the second polarization from the optical trajectories between the first and second mirrors, wherein the first polarizing beam splitter is configured to reflect the light pulses shifted with respect to each other perpendicularly to the propagation direction onto different, respective output trajectories.

title_en: Z-degree-of-freedom piezoelectric inertia bidirectional smooth precise focusing platform and driving method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Z-degree-of-freedom piezoelectric inertia bidirectional smooth precise focusing platform and a driving method, wherein displacement surge motion is realized in a single direction by utilizing the contact assembly characteristics of a piezoelectric stack and a flexible hinge mechanism, and then parasitic motion is generated in a stator assembly by combining the dead weight of an optical electron microscope and a motion guide rail with voltage bias, so that locking force adjustment between the stator assembly and the motion guide rail is realized to balance forward displacement surge and reverse displacement rollback, and bidirectional smooth driving is realized. Aiming at the displacement rollback problem of the traditional piezoelectric inertia driving platform, the piezoelectric stacking and the flexible hinge mechanism are assembled in a contact way, the sawtooth wave adopts 100% duty ratio sawtooth wave, the moving guide rail and the optical electron microscope are installed in a Z degree of freedom, the dead weight of a driving target is effectively utilized, the piezoelectric stacking voltage bias realizes the locking force adjustment between the stator assembly and the moving guide rail, and then the precise focusing platform is driven in a bidirectional smooth way and the bidirectional consistency is improved.

title_en: Display comprising a light-guiding optical element with two-dimensional expansion
abstract_en: A display (10) includes a planar light guide optical element (LOE) (100) having first and second progressive deflector devices associated with first and second regions (110, 120) thereof. A support device (106), such as an eyeglass frame, supports the LOE in facing relationship with the user's eyes. An image projector (200) injects a collimated image into the LOE via a reflective incoupling surface (131). The reflective incoupling surface is preferably oriented obliquely with respect to the main horizontal and vertical axes of the LOE. The multipart wedge (132) is preferably used to compensate for chromatic aberration.

title_en: Flexible optogenetic probe based on SU-8 waveguide and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a flexible optogenetic probe based on an SU-8 waveguide, which comprises the following steps: preparing an SU-8 waveguide on a hard substrate on which a sacrificial layer is deposited through a photoetching process, immersing a waveguide chip in a sacrificial layer corrosive liquid, and partially releasing the SU-8 waveguide; then fixing the same at one end in a groove of the packaging platform with the groove, so that the released SU-8 waveguide extends out of the groove; placing an optical fiber at the other end of the packaging platform, so that the fiber core of the optical fiber is coupled with the SU-8 waveguide; dropping ultraviolet curing glue, immersing the optical fiber and the SU-8 waveguide in the groove, and curing by an ultraviolet lamp; and finally, filling the whole groove with opaque black glue to obtain the flexible optogenetic probe based on the SU-8 waveguide. The probe has small inflammatory response to organisms during long-term implantation; and through designing the waveguide size, the emergent light of the probe can meet the requirement of irradiating a brain region in a certain range, so as to realize the intervention on the organism behavior. The invention has simple process flow and high probe preparation efficiency.

title_en: Fiber path management system for optical cable cross connecting cabinet in optical fiber access network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fiber path management system for an optical cable cross connecting box in an optical fiber access network, which relates to the technical field of optical transmission terminal equipment of a communication system. This a fiber circuit management system for optical cable distributing box in optic fibre access network accomodates the fiber optic cable of being connected between two optical cable integration trays through a plurality of rolling rings between the optical cable integration tray, when drawing forth the fiber optic cable on the optical cable integration tray in addition, the middle part of fiber optic cable is from entrance hole and outlet hole penetration into the inner chamber of receiver, the fiber optic cable of unnecessary length is wound up in the outside of winding up the post, cover receiver or top cap after winding up, insert receiver and top cap back to the inner chamber of receiver, realized accomodating and the function of arrangement to the unnecessary length fiber optic cable in the optical cable distributing box, improved the operating quality of this a fiber circuit management system for optical cable distributing box in the optical cable access network.

title_en: Automatic fiber cutting device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic fiber cutting device, and relates to the technical field of optical fiber processing. The invention comprises a frame and a classified collection unit, wherein the frame comprises a base table, two groups of upright posts are fixed on the top of the base table, a detection mechanism, an upper feeding unit, a cutting unit and a lower feeding unit are sequentially fixed between the two groups of upright posts from top to bottom, the classified collection unit comprises a sliding table fixed on the ground below the base table, two collection frames are movably connected on the sliding table, and the lower feeding unit comprises a group of side plates. According to the novel feeding mechanism, the novel feeding unit and the novel feeding unit are designed, the feeding mechanism with the conveyor belt is used for feeding optical fibers, stable and efficient feeding can be achieved, the whole feeding unit and the whole feeding unit are in a vertical state, the optical fibers are affected by gravity, stability in the optical fiber conveying process is guaranteed, meanwhile, the distance between the two belt bodies on the feeding unit and the feeding unit is adjustable, and therefore the novel feeding mechanism is suitable for use of optical fibers with different specifications and is wide in application range.

title_en: Yttria transparent ceramic and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to yttrium oxide transparent ceramic and a preparation method and application thereof. The chemical composition of the yttrium oxide transparent ceramic is Y  2  O  3  +x at.％MO  3  Wherein m=w or/and Mo, and 0 < x < 0.5; when m=w, x is preferably 0.025 to 0.3, more preferably 0.075; when m=mo, x is preferably 0.025 to 0.2, more preferably 0.025.

title_en: Device for introducing an optical lens into a rotating device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a device (110) and a method for introducing an optical lens (112) into a rotating device (114). The apparatus (110) comprises a carrier (134) and a carrier element (136) for receiving the lens (112), wherein the carrier (134) is configured to receive the carrier element (136). The carrier element (136) has a bearing surface (144) for receiving the lens (112) and is displaceably mounted relative to the carrier body (134).

title_en: Posture adjustment method, projection apparatus, and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a posture adjustment method, projection equipment and a storage medium. The posture adjusting method of the projection device comprises the following steps: acquiring a preset calibration position and a preset calibration attitude angle of projection equipment; detecting a current attitude angle of the projection device at a calibration position, wherein the current attitude angle is different from the calibration attitude angle; based on the calibration attitude angle and the current attitude angle, attitude adjustment information of the projection device from the current attitude angle to the calibration attitude angle is calculated. Through the embodiment, when the current attitude angle of the projection equipment at the position is detected to be different from the calibration attitude angle, the attitude adjustment information of the projection equipment from the current attitude angle to the calibration attitude angle is determined, so that a user can conveniently use the attitude adjustment information as auxiliary information for adjusting the attitude angle of the projection equipment, the attitude adjustment of the projection equipment is simpler, and the adjustment reliability is higher.

title_en: Acrylic resin for OCA optical adhesive, OCA optical adhesive and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an acrylic resin for OCA optical cement, the OCA optical cement and application thereof. The backlight module manufactured by the OCA optical adhesive has the advantages of short production time, high assembly efficiency, low reject ratio and the like, and the manufactured backlight module is safe and reliable in quality.

title_en: Optical system
abstract_en: The invention provides an optical system which corrects various aberrations such as chromatic aberration by properly using glass materials of lenses constituting each lens group and realizes light weight. An optical system is provided, which is characterized in that an object-side lens group GF and an image-side lens group GR are arranged in order from the object side, and the optical system has a lens LA that satisfies a predetermined conditional expression.

title_en: Transparent display device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transparent display device, which comprises a display panel. The display panel is provided with a plurality of pixel areas, wherein the plurality of pixel areas comprise a first pixel area, and the first pixel area comprises a display area and a transparent area. The display panel comprises a first substrate, a second substrate, a display medium and a transparent element. The second substrate and the first substrate are arranged oppositely. The display medium is arranged between the first substrate and the second substrate and is positioned in the display area. The transparent element is arranged between the first substrate and the second substrate and is positioned in the transparent area. The area ratio of the transparent element to the first pixel region is between 20% and 90%.

title_en: Projector illumination architecture
abstract_en: A projector illumination structure comprises an optical machine module, a light source module, a reflecting mirror, a spectroscope, a fluorescent color wheel and a lens group. The light source module is configured to emit blue light along a first direction. The reflector is configured to reflect the blue light to transmit the blue light in a second direction. The blue light transmitting region of the beam splitter is configured to allow blue light to pass through. The reflective region of the fluorescent color wheel is configured to reflect a first portion of the blue light, and the first wavelength converting region of the fluorescent color wheel is configured to excite a second portion of the blue light to form a first band of light. The lens group is configured to refract blue light transmitted in the second direction to the fluorescent color wheel, refract a first part of the blue light in a third direction to the reflection area of the spectroscope, and pass the first band light. The reflection area of the spectroscope is configured to reflect the first part of the blue light and the first band light to the optical machine module along a first direction.

title_en: Laser tracker head aiming control method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a head aiming control method and a head aiming control system of a laser tracker, wherein the control method comprises the following steps: wearing head-wearing glasses, wherein the head-wearing glasses are provided with gesture sensors and display modules, and the gesture sensors are used for acquiring the pitching angle and the horizontal rotation angle of the head of a wearer when the head of the wearer rotates; the method comprises the steps of projecting a real-time picture of a camera in a laser tracker to a display module of the head-mounted glasses; based on the real-time picture of the projected screen, the wearer rotates the head to acquire the pitching angle alpha and the horizontal rotation angle beta of the head; converting the pitching angle alpha and the horizontal rotation angle beta into three-dimensional coordinate values under a rectangular coordinate system; transmitting the three-dimensional coordinate values to a laser tracker, and controlling the laser tracker to aim at the position of the three-dimensional coordinate values. The invention can conveniently and accurately control the orientation of the laser tracker.

title_en: Front-view optical lens, imaging device and driving tool with same
abstract_en: The invention discloses a forward-looking optical lens, an image pickup device and a driving tool with the same, wherein the lens comprises seven lenses which are sequentially arranged from an object space to an imaging surface, the focal power of the seven lenses is respectively negative/positive/negative, the first lens and the fifth lens are convex-concave lenses, the second lens is a concave-convex lens, the third lens, the fourth lens and the sixth lens are biconvex lenses, and the seventh lens is an aspheric convex-concave lens; the optical axis distance between the second lens element and the third lens element, the optical axis distance between the fourth lens element and the fifth lens element and the optical axis distance between the sixth lens element and the seventh lens element are respectively between 0 and 0.2mm, the optical axis distance between the image side surface of the third lens element and the object side surface of the fourth lens element is between 1.9 and 3.4mm, and the center thickness of the second lens element is between 4.0 and 6.2mm; the total optical length of the lens is 28.6mm to 32.4mm, and the ratio of the total optical length to the focal length of the whole lens is 6.89 to 8.56. The lens in the invention effectively improves the edge illumination of a large view field so as to balance the problem of insufficient light entering quantity after the aperture is placed.

title_en: Display panel
abstract_en: The application provides a display panel, this display panel is including relative array substrate and the opposite substrate that sets up, the opposite substrate be close to array substrate's one side is provided with a plurality of interval posts, be formed with a plurality of barricades through the one side that is close to opposite substrate at array substrate, the barricade sets up around the one end that is close to array substrate of interval post, the barricade can prevent interval post to be close to array substrate's one end and take place to slide, avoid the interval post to cause the fish tail to array substrate surface's alignment layer, thereby can avoid display panel to appear light leak, red blue spot unusual etc. display failure's problem.

title_en: Image generation device, display equipment, vehicle and image generation method
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an image generation device, display equipment, a vehicle and an image generation method, which can be mainly applied to a scene of naked eye 3D display. The image generation device includes: the system comprises a light source, an optical module, a first analyzer and an imaging engine. The light source emits first polarized light and second polarized light having polarization directions perpendicular to each other. The first polarized light and the second polarized light can be transmitted to different directions after passing through the optical module. The use of a pixelated analyzer allows light of a first polarization to be transmitted to a first pixel region of the imaging engine and light of a second polarization to be transmitted to a second pixel region of the imaging engine. The first polarized light will pass through the first pixel region to generate first imaging light comprising first image information and the second polarized light will pass through the second pixel region to generate second imaging light comprising second image information. The first imaging light and the second imaging light may be transmitted to the left eye and the right eye of the viewer, respectively, and then the left and right eyes will see different images, thereby achieving a 3D display effect.

title_en: Semiconductor chip and component
abstract_en: The invention relates to a semiconductor chip (LD) having a structured chip Rear Surface (RS), wherein the chip rear surface is provided for electrical and thermal connection of the semiconductor chip (LD), wherein the semiconductor chip (LD) has an emission region (E) which is provided for generating electromagnetic radiation (L), and wherein the structured chip Rear Surface (RS) has a connection pad (AP) which is provided for electrical connection of the emission region (E). The lands (AP) are p-contact points or n-contact points, wherein all the lands (AP) configured as p-contact points or as n-contact points each overlap at least two of the emission regions (E) in a plan view and are each provided for electrically connecting only one of the emission regions (E). Furthermore, a component (100) is specified which has in particular at least one such semiconductor chip (LD).

title_en: Intelligent digital tour guide display device for museum
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of work tables, in particular to an intelligent digital tour guide display device of a museum, which comprises a work table, wherein an adjusting mechanism is arranged outside the work table and comprises a fixed disc arranged outside the work table, a second rotating wheel is rotatably connected to the outer part of the fixed disc, a second cylinder is fixedly arranged outside the second rotating wheel, a second fixed plate is fixedly connected to the output end of the second cylinder, a connecting rod is fixedly connected to the outer part of the second fixed plate, a first drill bit is fixedly connected to the outer part of the connecting rod, a second drill bit is fixedly connected to the outer part of the connecting rod, the first cylinder is started, a first connecting block is arranged at the output end of the first cylinder and drives the rotating disc to rotate through a second connecting block, and then the second fixed block is used for rapidly fixing and disassembling a workpiece under the cooperation of parts such as a second chute, a second sliding block, a first sliding block, a second fixed block and the second fixed block.

title_en: Evaluation method and system of display panel
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a system for evaluating a display panel, wherein the method comprises the following steps: identifying whether the panel to be detected has a display abnormal area or not according to a first image, and obtaining an identification result, wherein the first image is image data when the panel to be detected displays a preset gray-scale picture before correction processing is carried out; performing gamma compensation processing and Mura compensation processing on a panel to be tested on the same workstation according to the first image; obtaining compensated brightness according to a second image, obtaining pre-compensation brightness according to the first image, obtaining a compensation effect according to the brightness value difference between the pre-compensation brightness and the post-compensation brightness, wherein the second image is image data when a panel to be tested displays a preset gray-scale picture after correction processing; the panel to be tested is evaluated according to the compensation effect and the identification result, and corresponding prompt information is generated according to the evaluation result.

title_en: Optical lens
abstract_en: The invention provides an optical lens, which sequentially comprises a first lens with positive focal power, a second lens with negative focal power, a third lens with positive focal power, a fourth lens with focal power, a diaphragm, a fifth lens with positive focal power, a sixth lens with negative focal power, a seventh lens with positive focal power, an eighth lens with positive focal power, an image side of the eighth lens with positive focal power, a ninth lens with negative focal power, and an object side of the ninth lens with positive focal power, wherein the object side of the first lens is a convex surface, the object side of the second lens is a concave surface, the fourth lens with focal power, the image side of the fourth lens is a convex surface, the diaphragm, the fifth lens with positive focal power, the object side of the sixth lens with focal power, the image side of the seventh lens with positive focal power, the image side of the eighth lens with the object side of the focal power, and the object side of the eighth lens with the object side of the fourth lens with the focal power is concave. The optical lens provided by the invention has the advantages of at least small volume, large image surface, large aperture and high pixel.

title_en: VCSEL device with flower-type external cavity and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a VCSEL device with a flower-type outer cavity and a preparation method thereof. The VCSEL device sequentially comprises a substrate, a buffer layer, a nitride epitaxial DBR layer, an N-type semiconductor material layer, a multiple quantum well layer, a P-type electron blocking layer, a P-type semiconductor material layer, a current limiting layer and a current expansion layer along the epitaxial growth direction, wherein a top dielectric DBR layer and a P-type ohmic electrode are arranged above the current expansion layer, an outer cavity is arranged above the top dielectric DBR layer, and an N-type ohmic electrode is arranged above the N-type semiconductor material layer; the outer cavity is flower-shaped and is formed by overlapping AlInGaN materials or SiO  2  The structure meets the Bragg reflection condition. The flower-type outer cavity of the device etches petal patterns around the cavity, the central area of the cavity can normally transmit and oscillate laser without etching, and after being filled with ammonium nitrite or indium tin oxide, the sub-pair high-order modes form loss, so that the energy at the aperture is in proportion toAnd the quality of the light beam emitted by the VCSEL device is effectively improved.

title_en: Portable holographic image equipment and holographic image system thereof
abstract_en: The utility model discloses portable holographic image equipment and a holographic image system thereof. The portable hologram apparatus includes: projector body, base and connecting device. The projector body is arranged on the base through the connecting device. The projector body is provided with a protective shell and a projection lens. Wherein, connecting device includes: the connecting piece, locking swinging block and limit the subassembly of changeing, offered the spout on the base, the connecting piece goes up and down to locate in the spout, and locking swinging block passes through the torsional spring to be located on the base. The connecting piece is provided with an extension sleeve, the protective shell is provided with an inner sleeve, and the extension sleeve is sleeved on the inner sleeve; the inner sleeve is provided with a boss, the rotation limiting assembly is arranged in the boss and comprises a telescopic block and an unlocking block, the telescopic block is propped against the inner wall of the extension sleeve through a spring, and the protective shell is provided with a rotatable driving turntable. The portable holographic imaging equipment can be conveniently carried and carried, and the projection angle of the portable holographic imaging equipment can be kept stable after erection, so that the portable holographic imaging equipment is convenient for exhibition to be arranged on the site.

title_en: Small-volume semiconductor laser
abstract_en: The invention discloses a small-volume semiconductor laser, which is characterized in that light beams emitted by a plurality of semiconductor laser chips are respectively collimated by a fast axis collimating mirror, and then are folded to another plane of an upper space by 180 degrees by using a steering optical element, and are respectively aligned to output collimated light beams after being respectively subjected to slow axis collimation. The beam may be focus coupled into an optical fiber for output. The structure can fully utilize multidimensional space to reduce the volume of the semiconductor laser, realize the light weight of the semiconductor laser, has simple installation process and can realize the high-power optical fiber output semiconductor laser device with small volume and high reliability and high efficiency production.

title_en: Preparation method of diffraction optical waveguide, diffraction optical waveguide and AR display device
abstract_en: The invention provides a diffraction optical waveguide, a preparation method thereof and an AR display device, which are characterized in that on the basis of defining a coupled grating region graph and a coupled grating region graph by utilizing a patterned hard mask layer, nano-imprinting is carried out on a liquid polymer resist based on a grating imprinting template, and the patterned polymer resist after imprinting and solidification and the patterned hard mask layer can be used for etching once to form a coupled grating region and a coupled grating region, so that the integrated formation of the coupled grating region and the coupled grating region is realized, the relative position precision of the coupled grating region and the coupled grating region is effectively ensured, and further the display effect of the AR device is further facilitated. Meanwhile, the grooves with different depths are formed in the second pattern area of the grating imprinting template, so that the coupling-out grating units with different depths can be realized in the coupling-out grating area through one-time etching, and the modulation efficiency of the diffraction optical waveguide is effectively improved.

title_en: Method for calibrating spherical waves and test system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for calibrating spherical waves and to a test system for determining the surface shape of a test object by interferometry. In the method according to the invention for calibrating a spherical wave, wherein the spherical wave is generated in a test system which is designed to determine the surface shape of a test object (120) by interferometry, and wherein at least one spherical calibration mirror (130, 230) is used for calibrating the spherical wave, the spherical wave is guided onto the spherical calibration mirror, the spherical wave is calibrated on the basis of a plurality of continuously performed interferometry measurements which differ from each other in the partial areas of the spherical wave to be calibrated, which are respectively reflected by the spherical calibration mirror.

title_en: Low-transmittance low-reflection anti-halation input window and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of optical materials, and provides a low-transmittance low-reflection anti-halation input window and a preparation method thereof. The invention adopts a vacuum coating mode to plate a multilayer film on the surface of the transparent input window substrate, utilizes the absorption layer to absorb the light entering from the input window and utilizes the dielectric layer to reduce the reflection of the absorption layer on the incident light by the absorption layer through the phase matching design of the absorption layer and the dielectric layer film, thereby realizing the absorption of the light entering and reflected to the interface, eliminating stray light, reducing the reflectivity and meeting the use requirement on an image intensifier. The preparation method provided by the invention has the advantages of simple operation process, wide application range, accurate film thickness control, good quality and high product consistency, and is beneficial to the practical application of devices. In addition, the transmittance of the anti-halation input window blacking area film prepared by the invention is less than 0.5 percent in a wide spectrum range (350-1000 nm), the reflectivity is less than 2 percent, and the optical performance is superior to that of the existing hydrogen-burning blacking glass.

title_en: Light guide device and head-mounted display device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a light guide device and head-mounted display equipment; the light guide device comprises a waveguide substrate, a coupling-in region and a coupling-out region; the light guide device further comprises a coupling-in grating arranged in the coupling-in region and used for coupling light into the waveguide substrate and enabling the light to propagate in the waveguide substrate through total reflection; the light guide device further comprises a coupling-out grating arranged in the coupling-out region and used for coupling at least part of light rays transmitted into the coupling-out grating out of the waveguide substrate through diffraction; the coupling-out grating at least comprises a first coupling-out grating and a second coupling-out grating, the first coupling-out grating and the second coupling-out grating are alternately arranged and are all one-dimensional gratings, the first coupling-out grating has a first grating vector direction, the second coupling-out grating has a second grating vector direction, and the first grating vector direction and the second coupling-out grating vector direction have set included angles. According to the method, the grating vector of the one-dimensional grating in the coupling-out region is partitioned, so that the optical effect of high efficiency and uniformity can be realized while the two-dimensional pupil expansion is met.

title_en: Optical cable fusion method and device
abstract_en: The application provides an optical cable welding method and device, wherein the optical cable welding method comprises the following steps: when the optical cables at the two sides of the power tower are welded, controlling the OTDR equipment to send optical detection signals to the target optical cable; the optical cable comprises an optical cable, an optical fiber cable controller and an OTDR device, wherein the optical cable is at least one optical cable in the optical cables at two sides of the power tower; acquiring light receiving signals of all optical cables detected by photoelectric detection equipment of all optical cables erected on the power tower; at least one photoelectric detection device is arranged at the second end of the target optical cable, the photoelectric detection device can measure the light receiving signals of all the optical cables erected on the power tower, and each optical cable corresponds to one photoelectric detection device; and determining the optical cable identification of the target optical cable according to the optical receiving signals of the optical cables, and determining the optical cables in fusion-matched pairs at two sides of the power tower according to the optical cable identification of the target optical cable so as to fuse the optical cables in the fusion-matched pairs. The application can improve the efficiency of optical cable fusion.

title_en: HUD display system based on retina projection, three-dimensional image display method and vehicle
abstract_en: The application discloses a HUD display system based on retina projection, a three-dimensional image display method and a vehicle, which belong to the technical field of display products, wherein the HUD display system comprises an image generation unit for generating periodic left-handed polarized images and right-handed polarized images; the polarizer holographic component comprises a left-handed polarizer holographic element and a right-handed polarizer holographic element which are stacked, wherein the left-handed polarizer holographic element is used for receiving and diffracting the left-handed polarized image to enable the left-handed polarized image to be converged to a first observation point, and the right-handed polarizer holographic element is used for receiving and diffracting the right-handed polarized image to enable the right-handed polarized image to be converged to a second observation point. The method combines the retina projection technology with the polarizer holographic component, and projects parallax image signals which are not mutually interfered into human eyes, so that three-dimensional stereoscopic display is realized. The retina projection technology has a large depth of field, and the human eye can clearly see the image signal in a large depth range, so that the convergence adjustment conflict is avoided. Meanwhile, the optical system only comprises an image generating unit and a polarizer holographic element due to the simple optical path, and the volume and the weight of the HUD display system are greatly reduced compared with those of the main stream scheme.

title_en: Augmented reality experience for passenger control of autonomous vehicles
abstract_en: An augmented reality system is operable to provide a personalized augmented reality environment and experience for a passenger. The augmented reality system may select an augmented reality environment according to a plurality of augmented reality topics, enabling passengers to personalize their travel experience and/or to interact with virtual objects to generate virtual commands suitable for implementing real control of the autonomous vehicle.

title_en: Lens unit and camera module
abstract_en: The invention provides a lens unit and a camera module, which can inhibit water vapor from entering into an inter-lens space between a lens positioned closest to an object side and a lens adjacent to the lens and prevent condensation on the surface of the lens. The lens unit (11) of the present invention comprises: a lens group (L) is formed by arranging a plurality of lenses (13-17) along an optical axis (O), and a tubular lens barrel (12) is provided with an inner accommodating space (S) for accommodating and holding the lens group (L). The lens group (L) has: the optical lens comprises a first lens (13) positioned closest to an object side and a second lens (14) adjacent to the first lens (13) on an image side thereof, wherein opposite surfaces (13 a, 14 a) of the first lens (13) and the second lens (14) opposite to each other in an optical axis (O) direction are adhered to each other so that an inter-lens space (S1) between the first lens (13) and the second lens (14) is sealed from the outside.

title_en: Exit pupil efficiency homogenizing modulation method based on polarizer holographic grating diffraction waveguide
abstract_en: The invention discloses an exit pupil efficiency homogenizing modulation method based on a polarizer holographic grating diffraction waveguide, which can realize the efficiency homogenizing display of a diffraction waveguide system. In the method, the in-coupling and out-coupling modules are all polarizer holographic gratings; the in-coupling polarizer grating module is used for coupling the optical information of the incident light constructing module into the waveguide transmission module; the out-coupling polarizer grating module is used for diffracting light rays transmitted in the waveguide transmission module out of the waveguide to form a virtual image, and the intermediate turning polarizer holographic grating module is used for waveguide display in different pupil expansion modes and generally needs to be adopted in a two-dimensional pupil expansion waveguide structure. According to the invention, the holographic body grating with polarization characteristics is adopted, the RCWA calculation method is compiled through self-grinding, the particle population optimization algorithm is combined, and the efficiency uniformity in the field of view based on the holographic polarization grating diffraction waveguide is improved through the parameter optimization of three polarizer grating modules, so that the product performance is improved.

title_en: Semi-reflective film and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a semi-reflecting film, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the semi-reflecting film comprises an Al  2 O 3  film layer; the reflectivity of the semi-reflecting film at the wave band of 450-650nm is 50+/-0.5%; and the number of the film layers of the semi-reflecting film is 6-8, and the thickness is 270-655nm. According to the invention, the aluminum oxide film layer with a certain thickness is added into the semi-reflective film system, so that the aluminum oxide is high in reflection, and the reflectivity of the whole film system can be greatly improved, thereby greatly reducing the film thickness and the stacking layer number of the semi-reflective film layer, reducing the thickness of the semi-reflective film, saving the production time and the production cost and reducing the production risk.

title_en: TOSA, optical module, optical network equipment and optical emission method
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a TOSA, an optical module, optical network equipment and an optical emission method, which can effectively reduce the influence of FWM. The TOSA includes: four light sources, a polarization rotation unit and a wave combination unit. The four light sources are used for respectively emitting four light beams. The four light beams have the same initial polarization state and are different in wavelength, and the four light beams are sequentially a first light beam, a second light beam, a third light beam and a fourth light beam according to the sequence from the wavelength to the bottom. The polarization rotation unit is used for adjusting the polarization states of at least two light beams so that the first polarization state of the first light beam and the fourth light beam is perpendicular to the second polarization state of the second light beam and the third light beam. The wave combining unit is used for combining four paths of light beams output by the polarization rotating unit to obtain a combined light beam.

title_en: Unidirectional light-emitting diffraction optical waveguide, preparation method thereof and display equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a unidirectional light-emitting diffraction optical waveguide, a preparation method thereof and display equipment, and relates to the technical field of optical waveguides, comprising a substrate, wherein the substrate comprises a coupling-in grating element and a coupling-out grating element, and at least one of the coupling-in grating element and the coupling-out grating element comprises an asymmetric composite grating; the asymmetric composite grating comprises a first grating structure with a cross-sectional shape symmetrical or approximately symmetrical with respect to the grating axial plane, and further comprises a second grating structure stacked on the first grating structure, wherein the second grating structure is asymmetric with respect to the grating axial plane, the material of the second grating structure is nonmetal, and the grating periods of the second grating structure and the first grating structure are the same. Compared with a so-called inclined grating which can realize similar functions, the overall manufacturing difficulty of the asymmetric composite grating is low; through the arrangement and the preparation of the asymmetric composite grating, the energy utilization rate can be improved, more light rays can enter human eyes, the energy waste is reduced, and the manufacturing is easy and the cost is low.

title_en: Field-selectable dynamic gain control mode for optical sensors
abstract_en: Apparatus, and an associated method, relates to a field selectable gain mode system. In an illustrative example, for example, an APD-based sensor can have two or more predetermined gain modes. For example, the gain mode may be activated in response to a user-generated selection signal. For example, APD-based sensors can apply a user-selected gain pattern by independently controlling circuit gain, transmitter gain, and APD gain. When a user selection signal is selected, for example, the controller can apply corresponding independent gain parameters to the circuit gain, transmitter gain, and APD gain, thereby providing an integrated high dynamic range sensor system. For example, the independent gain parameters may include a range of control voltages, a range of control currents, and/or a range of gain inputs. Various embodiments may advantageously achieve increased accuracy over an extended operating range of gain values.

title_en: Optical fiber winding tension adjusting structure and winding device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of optical fibers, in particular to an optical fiber winding tension adjusting structure and an optical fiber winding device. The technical scheme of the invention aims to solve the problem of complex disassembly and assembly of the winding structure.

title_en: Photoresist patterning device and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photoresist patterning device, which comprises a low-pressure chamber, wherein a photoresist etching positioning device is arranged in the low-pressure chamber, a plasma input pipeline is communicated with the outside of the low-pressure chamber, and the plasma input pipeline extends to the inside of the low-pressure chamber and is spaced from the photoresist etching positioning device. The technology provides an innovative photoresist patterning scheme which can be simply applied to centimeter-sized and hundred-nanometer precision, and the silicon nitride template can be reused. The technology does not need an optical module, and can prepare large-area non-defective nano-scale patterns. And has the advantages of large-area etching of chamber plasma and anisotropic etching of atmospheric pressure plasma.

title_en: Overhead cable laying bracket for inclined pulling positioning
abstract_en: The invention discloses an overhead cable laying bracket for inclined pulling positioning, which comprises a laying bracket body; the left ends of the clamping sliding blocks at the upper side and the lower side are respectively provided with an overhead mechanism, and the overhead mechanisms comprise overhead positioners; further comprises: the extension mechanism is arranged in the overhead positioners at the upper side and the lower side in a sliding way; wherein, lay the inside upper and lower both sides of laying the mounting groove of support body and all be provided with drive gear through the bolt, and lay the inside upper and lower both sides joint sliding block's of mounting groove right-hand member and all fixedly provided with drive rack. This support is laid to overhead type cable of location to one side is laid to overhead locator adaptation different cables through laying the inside adjustable use height of support body lay, can lay the support with the cable according to the quantity of cable simultaneously and carry out the composite installation to lay the support according to the quantity of actually laying the cable to the cable and lay the support and dismantle, and guarantee the stability of being connected between overhead locator and the support body of laying through articulated oblique-pulling telescopic link.

title_en: Optical fiber network system
abstract_en: The optical fiber network system at least partially adopts a microminiature (VSFF) interconnection component, such as a microminiature duplex connector, a microminiature mechanical transmission ferrule (MT) connector, a microminiature duplex single-sheath connector, a microminiature MT single-sheath connector, a microminiature duplex adapter, a microminiature MT adapter, a microminiature duplex pluggable transceiver and a microminiature MT pluggable transceiver; ultra-small jumper cable assembly; ultra-small trunk optical cable; and/or ultra-small branch cables. The ultra-small fiber optic network system may define fiber optic branch cabling that connects large-scale trunk cables to numerous peripheral network locations. The network system may define branches and sub-branches from the trunk cable. The network system may define a cross-connect sub-network between groups of transceivers or adapters. The network system may define a trunk-to-transceiver cabling assembly for connecting trunk fiber optic cables to at least 32 transceiver ports.

title_en: Myopia illumination system, myopia illumination equipment and control method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a myopia illumination system, a myopia illumination device and a control method thereof, comprising the following steps: a broad spectrum light source for emitting broad spectrum light; the beam shaping system is used for shaping the wide-spectrum light to form annular light; and the projection system is used for projecting the annular light rays to eyes of a user to form annular light spots. The wide spectrum light is shaped into the annular light by adopting the beam shaping system, so that the center of a macula of a user eye can be avoided, and the safety is improved.

title_en: Multi-charged particle beam drawing device and charged particle beam drawing method
abstract_en: A multi-charged particle beam drawing device (100) according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: a distribution ratio calculation circuit (58) that calculates, for each design grid and for each of a plurality of combinations of beams, a dose distribution ratio of each beam to the two or more beams constituting the combination, the dose distribution ratio being used to distribute a predetermined dose to be irradiated to the design grid so that a sum of the distributed doses after distribution to the two or more beams constituting the combination is equal to the predetermined dose to be irradiated to the design grid; a combination selection circuit (62) that selects, for each design grid, a combination in which the dose distribution ratio of the 1 st beam having an actual irradiation position nearest to the design grid is larger than the dose distribution ratio of the remaining one or more beams of the two or more beams constituting the combination; and a dose correction circuit (70) for correcting the dose of each irradiation position on the design of the beam by adding the dose of the irradiation position to the dose of the irradiation position, based on the dose distribution ratio of the two or more beams constituting the combination selected for each design grid in the whole beam array of the multi-charged particle beam, and outputting the corrected dose.

title_en: Optical filter unit and method for manufacturing optical filter unit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a light filtering unit and a manufacturing method of the light filtering unit, wherein the light filtering unit comprises a substrate, an organic dye layer, an inorganic optical layer and a shading structure, the organic dye layer is arranged on one side of the substrate, the shading structure is arranged on one side of the organic dye layer opposite to the substrate, part of the inorganic optical layer covers the shading structure, part of the inorganic optical layer is positioned between the organic dye layer and the shading structure, the shading structure is used for absorbing light beams with the wavelength of 400nm to 700nm, the shading structure and the inorganic optical layer covered on the shading structure jointly form a light blocking part, and the light blocking part has the reflectivity of less than 1% for the light beams with the wavelength of 500nm to 775nm at the incident angle range.

title_en: Imaging lens
abstract_en: The invention provides an imaging lens, which comprises a lens barrel, wherein the lens barrel is internally provided with: a first lens; a second lens; a third lens; a fourth lens having positive optical power; a fifth lens having an outer diameter that is the largest among the outer diameters of the lenses of all the imaging lenses; the plurality of spacers are provided with at least a fourth spacer, the fourth spacer is positioned on the image side of the fourth lens and is supported against the image side of the fourth lens, and the thickness of the fourth spacer is larger than that of the other spacers; the effective focal length f of the imaging lens, half FOV of the maximum field angle of the imaging lens, and the thickness CP4 of the fourth spacer satisfy: 0< f tan (Semi-FOV)/CP 4<10; the radius of curvature R8 of the image side surface of the fourth lens, the radius of curvature R9 of the object side surface of the fifth lens, and the thickness CP4 of the fourth spacer satisfy: 0< (R8+R9)/CP 4<15. The invention solves the problem of low yield of the imaging lens in the prior art.

title_en: Leading-in optical cable with double-unit combination
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of cables, and particularly relates to an optical lead-in cable with double-unit combination, which is provided with at least three pairs of sub-cables, wherein each pair of sub-cables is provided with a protective sleeve, the protective sleeve consists of two sub-protective sleeves, each sub-protective sleeve consists of a first arc-shaped layer, a second arc-shaped layer and a connecting layer, the lower end of the first arc-shaped layer is connected with one end of the connecting layer, and an arc-shaped branching groove is formed between the connecting layer and the corresponding second arc-shaped layer; the other ends of the connecting layers of the two sub-protective sleeves are connected with each other, and an entering groove communicated with the two branch grooves is formed between the second arc-shaped layers of the two sub-protective sleeves; and a framework component is further arranged in the middle of all the sub-cables, and is clamped into the corresponding entering groove and the corresponding branching groove of the protective sleeve. The invention has the advantages of simple structure, convenient sub-cable taking out, good protection effect, convenient construction, impact resistance and the like.

title_en: Optical system, vehicle-mounted camera and vehicle
abstract_en: The application provides an optical system, a vehicle-mounted camera and a vehicle, wherein the optical system is applied to the vehicle and comprises the following components: the lens group comprises a plurality of lenses which are sequentially arranged from an object side to an image side along an optical axis; and a compensation lens having at least one of an object side surface or an image side surface as a free-form surface, wherein the free-form surface of the compensation lens is adapted to be disposed inside a windshield of a vehicle such that the optical system and the windshield form a corrective optical system, and an MTF value of the corrective optical system is within a preset range. The application compensates astigmatism and field curvature generated by the windshield through the free curved surface of the compensation lens, improves the resolution capability of the optical system, and solves the problem of resolution degradation of the optical system caused by the windshield.

title_en: Liquid crystal optical device and electronic product
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of liquid crystal optical devices, in particular to a liquid crystal optical device and an electronic product. The liquid crystal optical device comprises a first substrate, a first electrode layer, a liquid crystal layer, a second electrode layer and a second substrate which are sequentially stacked; the second electrode layer comprises an insulating layer, a first electrode structure and a second electrode structure, wherein one of the first electrode structure and the second electrode structure is positioned on one surface of the insulating layer facing the liquid crystal layer, and the other one of the first electrode structure and the second electrode structure is positioned on one surface of the insulating layer facing away from the liquid crystal layer; the projection of the second electrode structure on the plane where the first electrode structure is located covers the gap between the adjacent segments of the first electrode structure, and the projection of the first electrode structure on the plane where the second electrode structure is located covers the gap between the adjacent segments of the second electrode structure. The invention can effectively eliminate the diffraction phenomenon of the liquid crystal optical device.

title_en: Space radiation radiating surface with autonomous variable radiating area and phase-change energy storage function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a space radiation radiating surface with an autonomous variable radiating area and a phase-change energy storage function, which comprises a radiating surface body, wherein the inside of the radiating surface body is of a cavity structure filled with phase-change materials, and a lattice framework structure is arranged in the cavity; the outside of the radiating surface body is provided with a plurality of parallel condensation pipeline branches, and one end of each condensation pipeline branch is respectively and hermetically connected with the main steam pipeline shunt; the other end of each condensing pipeline branch is respectively and hermetically connected with a supercooled liquid rectifier, and a gas-liquid separator is arranged at the end, close to the supercooled liquid rectifier, of each condensing pipeline branch; through the cooperation of main steam pipeline shunt and a plurality of parallelly connected condensation pipeline branch road, at the different duty cycle by the radiator, independently change the quantity that steam got into the condensation pipeline branch road, make effective radiation radiating surface area and by the heat consumption condition phase-match of radiator. The invention not only can reduce the arrangement space of the radiating surface, but also can automatically adjust the area of the radiating surface to effectively radiate, thereby solving the radiating problem of the ultra-high power laser.

title_en: Optimization flow of patterning process
abstract_en: A method for improving a lithographic process for imaging a portion of a patterning device pattern onto a substrate using a lithographic projection apparatus having an illumination system and projection optics, the method comprising: (1) Obtaining a simulation model modeling a projection of radiation by the projection optics, wherein the simulation model models an effect of shadowing in the projection optics; and configuring the portion of the patterning device pattern based on the simulation model, and/or (2) obtaining a simulation model that models projection of radiation by projection optics, wherein the simulation model models a deformation reduction ratio of radiation produced by the projection optics, and configuring the portion of the patterning device pattern based on the simulation model in consideration of deformation manufacturing rules or deformation manufacturing rule ratios.

title_en: HUD light control method, HUD light control device and HUD
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a light control method of a HUD, a light control device of the HUD and the HUD.
