The light control method of the HUD is applied to a light control liquid crystal layer, the light control liquid crystal layer is arranged on the screen surface of an image generation unit of the HUD and/or the reflecting surface of a reflecting mirror of the HUD, and the method comprises the following steps: determining brightness information of a plurality of first areas of the image according to the image to be projected by the image generation unit of the HUD; determining voltage application information of a plurality of second areas of the image according to the brightness information, wherein the second areas correspond to a plurality of third areas of the light control liquid crystal layer; and according to the voltage application information, applying voltage to at least part of the third areas so as to control the polarization direction of the light which can penetrate through part of the third areas, and thus adjusting the brightness of an image area corresponding to part of the third areas in a virtual image projected by the HUD, wherein the virtual image corresponds to an image. According to the scheme of the present disclosure, the contrast of the virtual image projected by the HUD may be improved.

title_en: Electrophoresis display panel
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an electrophoretic display panel, wherein when a first driving circuit provides a first driving voltage for a pixel electrode of a pixel unit and a second driving circuit provides a second driving voltage for a common electrode of the pixel unit, a potential difference between the pixel electrode of the pixel unit and the common electrode forms a first electric field, and electrophoretic particles of the pixel unit are tiled in a micro-cup unit of the pixel unit under the action of the first electric field; when the first driving circuit provides a third driving voltage for the pixel electrode of the pixel unit and the second driving circuit provides a fourth driving voltage for the common electrode of the pixel unit, the potential difference between the pixel electrode of the pixel unit and the common electrode forms a second electric field, and the electrophoretic particles of the pixel unit are distributed on two sides of the micro-cup unit of the pixel unit under the action of the second electric field.

title_en: System and method for determining target feature focus in image-based overlay metrology
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to systems and methods for determining a target feature focus in an image-based overlay metrology. A metrology system includes one or more out-of-focus imaging metrology subsystems communicatively coupled to a controller having one or more processors configured to receive a plurality of training images captured at one or more focus positions. The one or more processors may generate a machine learning classifier based on the plurality of training images. The one or more processors may receive one or more target feature selections corresponding to one or more target features for one or more target overlay measurements. The one or more processors may use the machine-learned classifier to determine one or more target focus positions based on the one or more target feature selections.

title_en: Optical film structure, preparation method thereof and optical device
abstract_en: The application provides an optical film structure, a preparation method thereof and an optical device, wherein the optical film structure comprises a substrate, an intermediate layer and a functional layer; the intermediate layer is arranged on the substrate and comprises a plurality of light-transmitting pieces; in the direction away from the substrate, taking a plane parallel to the substrate as a cross section, the cross section area of the light-transmitting member is gradually reduced; the middle layer is connected with the functional layer, and each light-transmitting piece, the corresponding part of the substrate and the corresponding part of the functional layer form a functional unit together. The application reduces the gap between adjacent functional units, thereby reducing the invalid area of the optical film layer structure.

title_en: Electronic sand table system based on naked eye 3D display
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electronic sand tables, in particular to an electronic sand table system based on naked eye 3D display, which comprises a control background, a display screen, a data acquisition unit, a data processing unit and a positioning module, wherein the data acquisition unit is connected with the control background through the data processing unit, dynamically acquires information of each position point in real time through the data acquisition unit, processes the data through the data processing unit and transmits the information to the control background, then the naked eye 3D model of a training field is displayed on the display screen through the control background, meanwhile, the positioning module is connected with the control background through the data processing unit and is installed on each participant and participant training equipment, and the information of the participant and the participant training equipment is supplemented into the naked eye 3D geographic model through the control background, so that the actual situation of the training field can be restored more truly, and the reality is improved.

title_en: Shell assembly of camera and camera
abstract_en: The invention provides a camera shell assembly and a camera. A power supply assembly is arranged in the accommodating cavity, a graphene ink coating is arranged at the edge of the camera window, and the graphene ink coating is conductive through graphene doped in the graphene ink coating; the power supply assembly is electrically connected with the graphene ink coating to raise the temperature of the graphene ink coating and transfer heat to the camera window by energizing the graphene ink coating. Adopt a new heating defogging structure, realize the defogging function that generates heat, satisfy the defogging demand.

title_en: Photoetching technology suitable for multiple materials
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of photoetching technology, in particular to a photoetching technology applicable to various materials. Particle removal, which includes high-pressure nitrogen blowing, chemical wet cleaning, high-pressure water jet cleaning, dehydration baking, wafer primer coating, which includes creating a thin, uniform and defect-free photoresist film on the wafer surface, spin-coating, which includes drop-on, spin-off, solvent evaporation, soft baking, baking to evaporate the solvent in the photoresist, alignment and exposure to align the pattern, and transferring the reticle pattern to the glued wafer. The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: through the technology of the invention, home training, family tree, personal resume, recall and the like can be written out in the form of calligraphy works by a calligrapher, and are input into a computer, and are engraved on jade, granite, wood, ceramics and gold and silver sheets by laser, a photoetching machine and a color printer, so that the preservation conditions are provided.

title_en: Method for realizing efficient optical coupling of laser and waveguide on silicon
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for realizing high-efficiency optical coupling of a laser and a waveguide on silicon, which comprises the following steps: defining a silicon pattern for heteroepitaxy on the silicon on insulator using an electron beam exposure system; depositing a SiO  2  coating layer on the surface of the insulating liner; defining a window required by lateral wet etching on the silicon pattern; etching the silicon pattern by a lateral wet method to obtain an epitaxial space and obtain a silicon crystal face required by nucleation of the III-V semiconductor film; and (3) laterally extending the III-V semiconductor film on the silicon crystal face by utilizing a metal organic chemical vapor deposition system, and forming a final device. The device can greatly reduce the space occupied by the current mainstream evanescent wave coupling scheme on the chip, and has the characteristics of higher coupling efficiency, simpler process and smaller occupied on-chip area.

title_en: Photographic system with linear light source searchlighting and application method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to a photographing system with linear light source searchlighting and an application method thereof, and relates to the technical field of photographing. The camera shooting device comprises a mounting box, wherein a linear channel is formed in the side wall of the mounting box in a penetrating mode, a power supply mechanism, a camera shooting mechanism and a light source mechanism are arranged in the mounting box, the camera shooting mechanism and the light source mechanism are connected with the power supply mechanism, output ends of the camera shooting mechanism and the light source mechanism are aligned with the linear channel, the light source mechanism is connected with one side, far away from the power supply mechanism, of the camera shooting mechanism through a connecting frame, the connecting frame is connected with the camera shooting mechanism through a positioning shaft, the connecting frame can rotate by taking the central axis of the positioning shaft as a shaft, and a positioning assembly is arranged on the connecting frame and used for fixing the connecting frame on the camera shooting mechanism. The application has the effect that a plurality of operators are not required to cooperate in the shooting process, and the operation is more convenient.

title_en: Ultrafast time delay wavelength scanning ultraviolet femtosecond laser pulse train generating device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultrafast delay wavelength scanning ultraviolet femtosecond laser pulse train generating device. The device generates ultra-fast time delay scanning pulse trains with higher precision by utilizing the combination of the cylindrical lenses and the long mirror pairs, and sums the ultra-fast time delay scanning pulse trains with wide spectrum time stretching pulses, thereby realizing ultra-fast time delay wavelength scanning ultraviolet femtosecond laser pulse train output. The invention has the advantages of simple realization, large spectrum range, high scanning speed, high scanning precision and high stability, and has important application prospects in the aspects of physical property regulation, high-resolution imaging, spectrum detection and the like.

title_en: Head-wearing device and head-wearing device thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a head-mounted device and a head-mounted device thereof; the headband device includes: a headband assembly and an elasticity adjustment mechanism; the head band assembly comprises a first head band and a second head band which are mutually overlapped, and the first head band and the second head band are jointly enclosed to form a head wearing space; one end of the first head band and one end of the second head band which are mutually overlapped are respectively provided with a first rack and a second rack; the tightness adjusting mechanism comprises a main gear, a transmission assembly and an operating piece; the operating piece is in transmission connection with the main gear through the transmission component, and the overlapping length of the first head band and the second head band is adjusted through the operating piece; wherein, the rotation axis of the operating piece is not coincident with the rotation axis of the main gear. The headband device provided by the embodiment of the application can enable a user to conveniently adjust the tightness of the headband even if the user uses the headband in postures such as lying, leaning back and the like, and can improve the use comfort of postures such as lying, leaning back and the like because the operating piece is not positioned right behind the brain of the user.

title_en: Method for improving light-adjusting liquid crystal film yield and device for improving light-adjusting liquid crystal film yield
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for improving the yield of a dimming liquid crystal film and a device for improving the yield of the dimming liquid crystal film, and relates to the technical field of dimming liquid crystal films. Firstly, carrying out laser inner engraving on a dimming liquid crystal film so as to form partition lines on a conductive film layer in the dimming liquid crystal film; then electrifying the dimming liquid crystal film in multiple periods, not directly electrifying high voltage, wherein the electrified voltages in each period are the same, and the electrified voltages in multiple periods are gradually increased; the risk of a possible explosion point is then excluded by energizing at the highest voltage. The method for improving the yield of the dimming liquid crystal film can effectively remove quality defects in the dimming liquid crystal film, avoid the problems of explosion points or partition failure and the like in the use process, improve the production yield of the partition type dimming liquid crystal film, and identify the dimming liquid crystal film with possible explosion points so as to avoid the explosion points in the use process of a user, ensure the quality of products and improve the user experience.

title_en: Detector assembly and debugging device and method based on visible light
abstract_en: The invention discloses a detector assembly debugging device and method based on visible light, comprising the following steps: a standing support structure; the base part of the three-axis adjusting platform mechanism is fixedly connected with the vertical support structure, and the three-axis adjusting platform mechanism is provided with a position adjusting output end part; the light source bracket structure is fixedly connected to the position-adjusting output end part; the light source component structure is fixedly connected to the light source support structure and can output a visible light column with a specific divergence angle and an irradiation shape; the module assembly mechanism is correspondingly positioned on the extending path of the visible light column, the visible light column corresponds to the module assembly mechanism to form a visible light spot, and the visible light spot is used as a position reference marking for the module assembly mechanism to assemble and debug the detector module. The device and the method use visible light to replace X rays for debugging the detector, remarkably improve the assembly and debugging efficiency of the detector, reduce the cost of labor and materials and time, effectively prolong the service life of functional elements such as the bulb tube and the like, and enhance the practicality of the whole function.

title_en: Heterogeneous holographic imaging reflection structure based on solid-state plasma and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a heterogeneous holographic imaging reflection structure based on solid-state plasma, which comprises the following steps: s1, selecting a GaN substrate and a sapphire substrate, and bonding to form a GaN-based substrate; s2, a deep groove isolation region is arranged in a GaN region on the top layer of the substrate; s3, etching the top GaN layer to form an active region groove, and forming a P-type active region and an N-type active region; s4, photoetching a conductive channel bridge pattern, and sputtering metal alloying to form a conductive channel bridge; s5, setting a rectangular metal area; s6, the active areas of the adjacent holographic units are connected in series through conductive bridges so as to finish the preparation of the multi-gradient phase modulation holographic imaging reflection structure based on solid plasma. The invention also discloses a heterogeneous holographic imaging reflection structure based on the solid-state plasma. According to the solid-state plasma-based heterogeneous holographic imaging reflection structure and the preparation method thereof, imaging, stealth and integration performances of devices and systems are effectively improved.

title_en: Combined optical branching device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of optical fiber communication, and discloses a combined optical splitter, which comprises an input end optical fiber array, an output end optical fiber array and an optical splitter shell, wherein a plurality of optical fiber channels are formed in the optical splitter shell, the input end optical fiber array and the output end optical fiber array are respectively composed of an optical fiber base, optical fibers and optical fiber pins, and end covers are respectively arranged at two ends of the optical splitter shell; the middle part of the optical fiber channel is provided with a container with a built-in waveguide chip, two ends of the container are respectively formed with a conduit, and a pressing plugging device is fixed in the conduit; the guide pipe is sleeved with a winding and unwinding device and an energy storage device, and the energy storage device is connected with the winding and unwinding device and the guide pipe; a pull belt is arranged in the pressing and plugging device and is fixedly connected with the pressing and plugging device and the winding and unwinding device; the pressing plugging device can independently divide the inner cavity of the catheter into two parts, and can also be matched with the optical fiber base to divide the inner cavity of the catheter into two parts; the sealing, dust-proof and waterproof effects can be realized, and the normal use of the optical divider is effectively ensured.

title_en: Conversion efficiency correction method, device, medium and product of fiber laser
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, equipment, medium and product for correcting conversion efficiency of an optical fiber laser, which relate to the field of correction of conversion efficiency of the optical fiber laser, and comprise the following steps: acquiring pumping power output by a semiconductor fiber laser LD under a set condition, normalized spectral intensity at the wavelength of the LD and unabsorbed residual coefficient of a gain fiber at the wavelength, and determining the absorption power of the gain fiber to the LD; determining effective pumping power according to the absorption power; determining an effective pumping factor according to the effective pumping power; when pumping power is injected into the fiber laser through the LD, the actual output power of the fiber laser is obtained; determining conversion efficiency before correction according to the actual output power and the pump power; determining corrected conversion efficiency according to the effective pumping factor and the conversion efficiency before correction; and the average value of the corrected conversion efficiency is the actual conversion efficiency of the fiber laser. The invention can obtain the real conversion efficiency and eliminate the measurement deviation and interference introduced by the pumping source.

title_en: Lens and glasses for slowing down consumption of children far-sighted reserves
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lens and glasses for slowing down the consumption of children far-sighted reserves, which relate to the technical field of glasses and comprise a glasses frame, wherein one side of the glasses frame is fixedly provided with a connecting plate, the inside of the connecting plate is provided with a mounting cavity, one side of the inside of the mounting cavity is fixedly provided with a mounting rack, one side of the mounting rack is fixedly provided with a double-shaft motor, the output end of the double-shaft motor is fixedly provided with a rotating shaft, and the outer side of the rotating shaft is fixedly provided with a cam, and the beneficial effects of the invention are that: when children wear glasses for a certain time, the rotating shaft and the cam can be driven to rotate by opening the double-shaft motor, when the cam rotates, the connecting sliding plate and the sliding column can be pushed to move, and after the sliding column moves, the eye clear acupoints of the eyes of the children are worn by the rubber massage column, so that the blood circulation of the eyes of the children is promoted, the eyes are relaxed, the eye fatigue is relieved, the function of slowing down the consumption of the children for far vision storage and distribution can be achieved, and the increase of myopia degree caused by the eye fatigue of the children is avoided.

title_en: Vanadium dioxide-based adjustable multi-polarized light phase gradient super surface
abstract_en: The invention provides a vanadium dioxide-based adjustable multi-polarized light phase gradient super surface. The super-surface is characterized by a three-layer structure, the method sequentially comprises the following steps from top to bottom: the vanadium dioxide and metal pattern layer (1), the intermediate medium layer (2) and the reflecting bottom layer (3). When vanadium dioxide is in a metal state, the device has wide-band circular polarization conversion capability, and the 0-2 pi phase distribution of cross polarized light is realized within the range of 0.49-1.18 THz; when vanadium dioxide is in an insulating state, the designed super surface can independently regulate x-polarized light and y-polarized light, wherein co-polarized light of x and y polarization can realize 0-2 pi phase distribution in the ranges of 1.73-1.78THz and 0.8-1.0THz, and not only can regulate and control the phases of circularly polarized light and linearly polarized light, but also can independently regulate and control the phases of linearly polarized light in different polarization states. The optical super surface designed by the invention has great potential in the terahertz frequency band, and can be widely applied to holographic imaging, information encryption, superlens, radar scattering and the like.

title_en: Illumination system and projection device
abstract_en: A lighting system comprises a first light source module, a second light source module and a light combining module. The first light beam from the first light source module is incident to the light combining module along a first direction. The light combining module is used for enabling the first light beam to be turned from a first direction to a second direction and then turned to a third direction to leave the light combining module. The second light beam from the second light source module is incident to the light combining module along the second direction. The light combining module is used for turning the second light beam from the second direction to the third direction and leaving the light combining module. The first light beam and the second light beam leave the light combining module to form an illumination light beam. A projection apparatus is also provided. The illumination system and the projection device can generate illumination light beams which are uniformly distributed.

title_en: Low-loss polarization-maintaining hollow fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to a low-loss polarization-maintaining hollow fiber and a preparation method thereof, comprising the following steps: performing air pressure control on the A area, the B area and the C area of the optical fiber preform, and drawing the optical fiber preform to obtain a low-loss polarization-maintaining hollow optical fiber; the air pressure P  1  in the A area, the air pressure P  2  in the B area and the air pressure P  3  in the C area satisfy the following conditions: p  3 ＞P 1 ＞P 2 ; the optical fiber preform includes: forming an area A inside the fiber core capillary; the cladding tube bundle surrounds the fiber core capillaries, the cladding tube bundle comprises a plurality of layers of rings which are arranged in a regular hexagon, and each layer of ring comprises a plurality of cladding capillaries; among all the cladding capillaries of the cladding tube bundle, the inner part of the cladding capillary at the corner part in the innermost layer ring forms a C area, and the inner parts of the rest of the cladding capillaries form a B area; the sleeve is disposed outside the cladding tube bundle. The application can solve the problem of high attenuation caused by the poor radial consistency of the optical fiber microstructure shaft required by the optical fiber drawing in the related technology.

title_en: Quick response liquid crystal composition and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of liquid crystal materials, in particular to a quick response liquid crystal composition and application thereof, wherein the liquid crystal composition comprises the following components in percentage by mass: (1) 1-10% of a compound represented by the general formula I; (2) 1 to 60% of a compound represented by the general formula II; (3) 1 to 25% of a compound represented by the general formula III; (4) 1 to 30% of a compound represented by the general formula IV; (5) 1 to 25% of a compound represented by the general formula V; (6) 1 to 25% of a compound represented by the general formula VI. The liquid crystal composition has low rotational viscosity, large elastic constant, good intersolubility and quick response speed, can be used for quick response liquid crystal display of various display modes, can obviously improve the display effect of the liquid crystal display when used in TN, IPS or FFS mode vehicle-mounted displays, and is particularly suitable for IPS and FFS mode liquid crystal displays.

title_en: Optical film, display module and display screen
abstract_en: The display module comprises an optical film, a display module and a display screen, wherein the optical film comprises a main body, a plurality of microstructures and an opaque layer. The microstructure is arranged on one surface of the main body and is a protruding arc-shaped structure. The opaque layer is attached to the main body and is arranged on the other surface of the main body relative to the microstructure, and the opaque layer comprises a plurality of holes. Wherein, the center point of the hole and the center point of the microstructure overlap on the projection plane. Wherein the equivalent diameter of the hole divided by the equivalent diameter of the microstructure is less than or equal to 0.3, and the equivalent diameter of the microstructure divided by the thickness of the main body is less than or equal to 1.3 and greater than or equal to 0.7. Wherein the opaque layer is adapted to face the light source. The display module has the advantages that the collimating light with better effect can be generated, and the efficiency of the display module can be further improved.

title_en: Optical lens
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optical lens, which sequentially comprises from an object side to an imaging surface along an optical axis: the first lens with negative focal power has a convex object side surface and a concave image side surface; a second lens element with negative refractive power having a concave object-side surface and a concave image-side surface; the object side surface of the third lens is a convex surface, and the image side surface of the third lens is a convex surface; a fourth lens element with positive refractive power having a convex object-side surface and a convex image-side surface; a fifth lens element with negative refractive power having a concave object-side surface and a concave image-side surface; a sixth lens element with positive refractive power having a convex object-side surface and a convex image-side surface; a seventh lens element with positive refractive power having a convex object-side surface and a convex image-side surface; the eighth lens element with positive refractive power has a convex object-side surface and a convex image-side surface. The optical lens provided by the invention has one or more advantages of wide angle, day-night confocal and high pixel.

title_en: Attaching method of soft paste in vacuum environment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of display screen lamination, in particular to a lamination method of soft lamination in a vacuum environment, wherein an OCA (optical clear adhesive) adhesive is peeled off for the first time to expose a first lamination surface, an LCD (liquid crystal display) module and the OCA adhesive are placed into a closed cavity, the closed cavity is sealed and then vacuumized to form a vacuum cavity, and the first lamination surface of the OCA adhesive is laminated with the LCD module for the first time; the second adhesive surface of the OCA adhesive is stripped for the second time, the CG cover plate is placed into the closed cavity, the vacuum cavity is formed by vacuumizing again after the closed cavity is sealed, and the second adhesive surface of the OCA adhesive is attached to the CG cover plate for the second time; and after the CG cover plate and the LCD module are attached by the OCA glue, the OCA glue is solidified by UV light irradiation, and the attachment is completed. Compared with the prior art, the bonding method of the soft bonding in the vacuum environment can effectively solve the problem of bad bubbles in the bonding process of the blind hole display screen, reduce the bubbles in the blind hole and save the material cost.

title_en: Light source and automatic exposure linkage control method and system
abstract_en: The application provides a light source and automatic exposure coordinated control method and system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an alternative exposure parameter of a next frame and a light source gear of a current frame; judging whether the light source gear needs to be adjusted according to the number of frames of the current frame; determining the light source gear of the next frame based on a gear adjusting algorithm according to the alternative exposure parameters of the next frame and the light source gear of the current frame; judging whether the light source gear of the next frame is the same as the light source gear of the current frame; if the exposure parameters are the same, the alternative exposure parameters of the next frame are used as the actual exposure parameters of the next frame, and if the exposure parameters are different, the actual exposure parameters of the current frame are used as the actual exposure parameters of the next frame; and sending the actual exposure parameters of the next frame to the image sensor, and controlling the light source according to the light source gear of the next frame. The application can automatically and cooperatively adjust the brightness of the light source and the automatic exposure parameter, provide images with stable brightness, avoid frequent change of the power of the light source and prolong the service life of the light source.

title_en: Lens capable of realizing high-precision shielding function and self-adaptive high beam comprising lens
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lens for realizing a high-precision shielding function and a self-adaptive high beam comprising the same, which sequentially comprise the following components from an image side to an object side along an optical axis direction: the image side surface and the object side surface of the first lens are respectively an S1 surface and an S2 surface; a second lens having positive optical power; the image side surface and the object side surface of the second lens are respectively an S3 surface and an S4 surface; the light source is located on one side of the S4 face, the aperture diaphragm is arranged on the S2 face, the first lens is made of plastic materials, and the second lens is made of glass materials. The invention can improve the light effect, generate clear high beam light type and anti-dazzle shielding function, and the lens material close to the light source has high stability, thereby being beneficial to the safety of vehicles.

title_en: Single-molecule resin non-chemical amplification type photoresist based on Photo-Fries rearrangement reaction
abstract_en: The invention provides a single-molecule resin non-chemical amplification photoresist based on Photo-Fries rearrangement reaction. Relates to a compound shown in a formula (I), which has cheap and easily available raw materials and simple synthesis process; can be used as single-component non-chemical amplification photoresist, and the obtained pattern has high resolution and low line width roughness, and can well meet the requirement of high-resolution photoetching.

title_en: Prism motor, rotation angle detection method of prism motor, and image pickup apparatus
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application relates to the technical field of electronic products, and provides a prism motor, a rotation angle detection method of the prism motor and image pickup equipment, wherein the prism motor comprises: the device comprises a base, a prism carrier, a first polar plate, at least two second polar plates and a conductor plate, wherein the base comprises a bottom plate and a side plate; the prism carrier is arranged above the bottom plate and can rotate around a first rotation shaft and a second rotation shaft relative to the base; the first polar plate is positioned on the surface of the bottom plate; the second pole plate is positioned on the surface of the side plate facing the prism carrier; the conductor plate comprises a first conductor plate and a second conductor plate which are electrically connected with each other, and in the process that the prism carrier rotates relative to the base through a first rotation shaft, the overlapping area of the orthographic projection of one second pole plate on the side plate and the orthographic projection of the second conductor plate on the side plate is increased, the overlapping area of the orthographic projection of one second pole plate on the side plate and the orthographic projection of the second conductor plate on the side plate is reduced, and at least the anti-shake precision of the prism motor is improved.

title_en: Probe interface module and probe
abstract_en: The invention provides a probe interface module and a probe, and relates to the technical field of endoscope. The probe interface module comprises an optical fiber, a bearing module, a circuit control module and a cable, wherein the bearing module is provided with a limiting part and an electric signal output end, and the limiting part can limit the optical fiber; the bearing module can be detachably connected with the probe; the circuit control module is arranged on the bearing module; the cable is electrically connected with the electric signal output end through the circuit control module. The probe interface module provided by the invention designs the optical fiber and the circuit control module into an integral module unit, namely, the optical fiber, the circuit control module and the cable are all installed on the bearing module to realize integrated fixation, and further, the bearing module and the probe are detachably connected, so that the bearing module is only required to be detached and installed on the other tower head when the probe is replaced, the probe interface module not only can be convenient for replacing the probe, but also can reduce the contact points in the transmission process of photoelectric signals, and improve the image quality.

title_en: Shaping device for laser beam
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of laser shaping, and particularly relates to a shaping device of a laser beam, which comprises a shell, wherein an incident light cylinder is arranged on the side wall of the shell, an installation cylinder is integrally formed on the side wall of the incident light cylinder, a laser emitter is arranged at the end part of the installation cylinder, a unidirectional light transmission lens is fixedly arranged in the incident light cylinder, the unidirectional light transmission lens is inclined by 45 degrees and is arranged under the installation cylinder, and a light supplementing mechanism is arranged at the end part of the incident light cylinder. Compared with the traditional shaping of the laser beam by the off-axis two-reflection free-form surface structure, the shaping device can supplement laser aiming at the position with insufficient energy of the original laser beam, further improves the uniformity of the energy distribution of light spots, ensures the heating uniformity of a sample heating area, can radiate heat and cool the two free-form surface mirrors, automatically trigger light supplementing operation based on the temperature of the lower reflection free-form surface mirror, and can automatically alarm and remind personnel to overhaul and regulate the laser transmitter in time.

title_en: Optical compensation film, display panel and display device
abstract_en: The application provides an optical compensation film and a display panel, and relates to the technical field of display, wherein the optical compensation film is applied to the display panel and comprises a first compensation layer and a second compensation layer, the optical compensation film is arranged between a liquid crystal layer and a polaroid of the display panel, the first compensation layer is positioned at one side of the second compensation layer far away from the liquid crystal layer, the second compensation layer is a +A type compensation layer, and nz=ny < nx is satisfied; rth  1 (λ)/Rth 2  (λ) is less than 0; wherein nz is the refractive index of the compensation layer in the thickness direction, nx and ny are the refractive indexes of the compensation layer in the in-plane direction, and x is orthogonal to the y direction; rth  1  (λ) is an optical path difference compensation value of the first compensation layer for the light having the wavelength λ in the thickness direction, and Rth  2  (λ) is an optical path difference compensation value of the second compensation layer for the light having the wavelength λ in the thickness direction. The optical compensation film is applied to the preparation of display panels.

title_en: Phase correction method
abstract_en: A phase correction method is disclosed, which automatically obtains a phase difference value between a beam phase distribution feature and a beam phase ideal distribution feature according to a semantic deviation between the two features by acquiring the beam phase distribution feature acquired by a wavefront sensor, extracting a beam phase ideal distribution feature from a database, and performing feature extraction of the beam phase distribution feature and the beam phase ideal distribution feature by using an image analysis and processing technique based on computer vision, and automatically adjusts the shape of an optical element based on the phase difference value. Thus, nonlinear or complex phase distortions can be handled, thereby accurately identifying and correcting fine phase variations that are difficult to adjust by conventional mechanically deformed elements, and improving the accuracy of correction of high-order-mode or multi-mode beams. Meanwhile, higher resolution and faster response speed can be provided, so that higher precision and faster response can be achieved when the phase is adjusted, the real-time correction requirement is met, and an intelligent correction process is realized.

title_en: Reflection type photoetching lens
abstract_en: The invention relates to a reflective photoetching lens, which comprises a first lens and a first reflecting mirror which are sequentially arranged along a first optical axis direction, a second reflecting mirror, a diaphragm, a second lens group and a sixth lens which are sequentially arranged along a second optical axis direction, wherein the diaphragm, the second lens group and the sixth lens are concentrically arranged with the second reflecting mirror, and various optical aberrations can be well balanced through the constraint of the distance from an object plane to the first lens and the distance from the diaphragm to an image plane, so that the photoetching lens realizes a larger visual field and has excellent imaging performance, and the problem that the visual field of the traditional photoetching lens is small is solved. In addition, the photoetching lens adopts a reflective structure, so that light rays pass through the second lens group in the forward and reverse directions twice, the transmission distance of light beams is ensured, and the number of lenses is reduced, thereby effectively reducing the volume of the photoetching lens and reducing the cost and the assembly difficulty of the photoetching lens.

title_en: Display substrate, preparation method thereof, display panel and display device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure provides a display substrate, a preparation method thereof, a display panel and a display device. The display substrate includes: the oxide semiconductor layer comprises a first active layer, wherein the first active layer comprises a first channel region, a first conductive region and a second conductive region which are positioned at two sides, and the prefabricated insulating layer is provided with prefabricated through holes; the first conductive material layer is positioned on the upper side of the prefabricated insulating layer and comprises a first conductive electrode and a first electrode, the first electrode at least partially overlaps the prefabricated via hole, and the first electrode is connected with the first conductive region; the prefabricated film layer is positioned on the upper side of the first conductive material layer and at least partially overlapped with the first electrode, and the data line is connected with the first conductive area through the first electrode. According to the technical scheme, the connection resistance between the data line and the thin film transistor in the display substrate can be reduced, and the product performance is improved.

title_en: Liquid crystal display device and electronic apparatus
abstract_en: The invention discloses a liquid crystal display device and electronic equipment, wherein the liquid crystal display device comprises a display liquid crystal box, a quantum dot layer and a backlight module for providing a blue light source; the display liquid crystal box comprises a color film substrate, an array substrate and a liquid crystal layer, wherein the display liquid crystal box is provided with a blue sub-pixel, a green sub-pixel and a red sub-pixel, a blank area corresponding to the blue sub-pixel, a green resistor corresponding to the green sub-pixel and a red resistor corresponding to the red sub-pixel are arranged on the color film substrate, a transparent area corresponding to the blank area and a white quantum dot area corresponding to the color resistor area are arranged on the quantum dot layer in a matching mode, white quantum dots are arranged in the white quantum dot area and can excite white light, the quantum dot layer is arranged between a backlight module and the liquid crystal layer, and the backlight module of a blue light source is adopted, so that blue light can directly penetrate through the transparent area and the blank area, and the light transmittance of the light is improved.

title_en: Full-automatic liquid crystal display laminating machine and laminating process thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of liquid crystal display production, and particularly relates to a full-automatic liquid crystal display laminating machine and a laminating process thereof, wherein the full-automatic liquid crystal display laminating machine comprises a workbench; the guide rail frame is provided with two opposite sliding frames in a sliding manner, two supporting blocks which are opposite up and down are arranged on the sliding frames, a rubber cylinder is connected between the two supporting blocks above, a rubber cylinder is also connected between the two supporting blocks below, the two rubber cylinders are positioned between the first attaching seat and the second attaching seat, rubber pipes which extend into the rubber cylinders extend through the supporting blocks, a roller is rotatably arranged between the two supporting blocks above, and a roller is rotatably arranged between the two supporting blocks below. The adhesive is discharged directionally and intensively through the adhesive discharging groove, the adhesive is uniformly coated by the rotation of the roller, the waste and the influence on the working environment caused by the discharge of the adhesive to other positions are avoided, in addition, the adhesive discharging groove of the adhesive cylinder can be blocked by the roller in a rotating state, and the outflow of the adhesive is avoided when the adhesive is not required to be coated.

title_en: Photosensitive multilayer resin film, printed wiring board, semiconductor package, and method for manufacturing printed wiring board
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a photosensitive multilayer resin film comprising a first resin composition layer and a second resin composition layer, wherein the first resin composition layer and the second resin composition layer each contain (A) a compound having an ethylenically unsaturated group, (B) a thermosetting resin, (C) a photopolymerization initiator, and (D) an inorganic filler, and the second resin composition layer further contains (E) a fluorine-containing resin, and the fluorine atom concentration in the first resin composition layer is lower than that in the second resin composition layer.

title_en: Camphorsulfonate flavonoid photoacid generator and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a camphorsulfonate flavonoid photoacid generator and a preparation method thereof, wherein the chemical structural formula of the camphorsulfonate flavonoid photoacid generator is as follows Wherein R is selected from H, halogen, C  1 -C 16  fatty alkyl, C  1 -C 16  fatty alkoxy, dimethylamino or phenyl. The camphorsulfonate flavonoid photoacid generator prepared by the invention realizes long-wave absorption based on a flavonoid mother nucleus, has stronger absorption to 248nm and 365nm UV LED light sources and high sensitivity, contains camphorsulfonate groups, is directly connected with Huang Tongfang rings, has photosensitive cracking property, generates strong acid camphorsulfonic acid by photolysis, has slower diffusion due to larger van der Waals volume of the camphorsulfonic acid, has poorer diffusivity in a resin matrix, and can obtain better resolution and line edge roughness.

title_en: Terahertz absorption spectrum device based on one-dimensional defect photonic crystal stacking and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a terahertz absorption spectrum device based on one-dimensional defect photonic crystal stacking and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of terahertz. A grating layer and a defective one-dimensional photonic crystal layer are alternately laminated from top to bottom; the outermost side is a grating layer; the single defect one-dimensional photon crystal layer comprises two identical Bragg reflection structures; two identical Bragg reflection structures are symmetrically distributed; a defect cavity is arranged between the two identical Bragg reflection structures; the single Bragg reflection structure is formed by alternately stacking a silicon layer and an air layer; the outermost side is a silicon layer; the width of the defect cavity is gradually decreased from top to bottom; a substrate is vertically arranged at the center of the defect cavity; the substrate is coated with a thin film analysis layer on one side surface. The device provided by the invention can identify a thin film analysis layer with the thickness of 0.1 mu m, the absorption enhancement factor is 303 times, and the micro-analytes can be simply and effectively detected in a wide frequency range of 0.49-0.57 THz.

title_en: Optical module
abstract_en: An optical module includes a circuit board (300), a light emitting member (500), a first light receiving member (600), a second light receiving member (700), and a circular square tube body (400); the light emitting part (500) includes a laser chip (544) and a first lens (543); the light emitting component (500) is configured to emit light of a first wavelength; the first light receiving part (600) is configured to receive first wavelength reflected light, which is light of which the first wavelength emitted light is reflected back by the outside of the light module; the second light receiving part (700) is configured to receive second wavelength reception light; the light emitting component (500), the first light receiving component (600) and the second light receiving component (700) are respectively connected with the round square tube body (400); the optical component is arranged inside the round square tube body (400) and comprises a light-splitting sheet (820), a light-absorbing sheet (830), a reflecting sheet (870), a first filter (850), a second filter (860), a third filter (880) and a second lens (890). A dual lens system is constituted by a first lens (543) and a second lens (890) to improve optical coupling efficiency; and the functions of transmitting and receiving the light module are realized through the optical component.

title_en: Optical lens
abstract_en: The invention provides an optical lens which sequentially comprises a first lens with positive focal power, a second lens with positive focal power, a third lens with positive focal power, a fourth lens with negative focal power, a fifth lens with negative focal power, a sixth lens with negative focal power and a seventh lens with focal power from an object side to an imaging surface along an optical axis, wherein the object side is a convex surface, the image side is a concave surface, the object side is a concave surface, the image side is a convex surface, the fifth lens with negative focal power, the sixth lens with negative focal power and the seventh lens with focal power are all arranged in sequence, and the real image height IH corresponding to the maximum field angle of the optical lens is 0.95< IH/f <1.1. The optical lens provided by the invention can improve the imaging quality of the optical lens, reduce the aberration and has the advantage of excellent imaging quality through specific surface shape arrangement and reasonable focal power distribution.

title_en: Apparatus and method for measuring uneven surface using active thermal laser imager
abstract_en: The invention relates to a device for measuring inhomogeneous surfaces by means of an active thermal laser imager, comprising a laser source (1) capable of emitting a laser beam (2) onto a surface (7) to be measured to form a measurement zone (8), and an observation device B for thermally imaging the surface (7) to be measured, characterized in that the observation device B is further adapted to identify an error inducing surface (9) on the surface (7) to be measured, and in that the device further comprises a shading device A adapted to change the measurement zone (8) in order to create a new measurement zone while excluding the error inducing surface (9). The invention also relates to a method for measuring uneven surfaces by means of an active thermal laser imager using the device according to the invention.

title_en: Display system, display method, display body, and method for manufacturing display body
abstract_en: The invention provides a display system capable of realizing light weight and high definition of VR goggles. A display system according to an embodiment of the present invention is a display system for displaying an image to a user, the display system including: a display element having a display surface for emitting light for displaying an image forward through a polarizing member; a reflection unit which is disposed in front of the display element, includes a reflective polarizing member, and reflects light emitted from the display element; a first lens unit disposed on an optical path between the display element and the reflection unit; a half mirror disposed between the display element and the first lens portion, and configured to transmit light emitted from the display element and reflect the light reflected by the reflecting portion toward the reflecting portion; a1λ/4 th member disposed on an optical path between the display element and the half mirror; and a2λ/4 th member disposed on an optical path between the half mirror and the reflecting section, wherein an angle between a slow axis of the 1λ/4 th member and a slow axis of the 2λ/4 th member is set to 7 ° or less or 83 ° to 97 °.

title_en: Balancing external light and generated image light in a display
abstract_en: A near-eye display includes a first polarizer in a path of external light to an eye-ward region of the display, the first polarizer for polarizing the external light to a first polarization state. A see-through light guide is disposed in the path between the first polarizer and the eyebox, the see-through light guide for transmitting image light to the eyebox in an orthogonal second polarization state while transmitting the external light in the first polarization state. A second polarizer is disposed in the path and downstream of the see-through light guide, the second polarizer for adjusting a power balance of the external light and the image light at the eyebox.

title_en: Flexible wiring substrate unit and light adjusting unit
abstract_en: The flexible wiring board unit includes a first flexible wiring board extending in a first direction and a second flexible wiring board extending in a second direction, the second flexible wiring board having a first power supply terminal and a second power supply terminal at a first end of the second flexible wiring board in the second direction and intersecting the first direction and electrically connected to the first flexible wiring board, the first flexible wiring board having a first bonded terminal and a second bonded terminal arranged in the first direction, the first bonded terminal and the second bonded terminal being connected to a power supply object, the second flexible wiring board having a first power supply terminal and a second power supply terminal at a second end of the second flexible wiring board opposite to the first end, the first power supply terminal and the second power supply terminal being connected to an external power supply.

title_en: Optical lens
abstract_en: The invention provides an optical lens which sequentially comprises a first lens with negative focal power, a second lens with positive focal power, a third lens with positive focal power, a fourth lens with negative focal power, a fifth lens with negative focal power, a sixth lens with positive focal power, a seventh lens with focal power and a concave image side at a paraxial region, wherein the first lens with negative focal power, the image side of the first lens is concave, the object side of the second lens with positive focal power is convex, the object side of the third lens with positive focal power is convex, the object side of the fourth lens with negative focal power is concave, the object side of the fifth lens with negative focal power is convex at a paraxial region, the image side of the fifth lens with negative focal power is concave at a paraxial region, and the object side of the sixth lens with positive focal power is convex. The optical lens provided by the invention can improve the imaging quality of the optical lens through specific surface shape collocation and reasonable focal power distribution, and has the advantage of excellent imaging quality.

title_en: Eyepiece for near-eye display equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an eyepiece applied to near-eye display equipment, relates to the technical field of optics, and is used for solving the problem that stray light of the existing near-eye display equipment is serious. The near-eye display device comprises an image source and an eyepiece, wherein the eyepiece comprises a reflecting element and at least one lens, so that emergent light rays of the image source are incident to the reflecting element and reflected to the at least one lens by the reflecting element, and the reflected light rays sequentially pass through the at least one lens and then are emergent. The at least one lens comprises a preset lens adjacent to the reflecting element, and a first film layer is arranged on one side surface of the preset lens, which is close to the reflecting element, so that the reflectivity of the light rays with the angle larger than or equal to a first preset angle, which are incident to the preset lens through the first film layer, is smaller than a first preset value. Therefore, the reflection of the light rays with larger angles at the preset lens can be reduced, and the situation that the light rays with larger angles are emitted through the at least one lens after being reflected by the preset lens is reduced, so that stray light is reduced.

title_en: Light source, projection system, projection method and related device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a light source, a projection system, a projection method and a related device, which are used for effectively realizing speckle suppression and reducing speckle contrast. The light source comprises a first blue light source for emitting first blue laser, a second blue light source for emitting second blue laser, a light splitting module and a fluorescent body. The light splitting module splits the second blue laser to obtain a first sub-laser and a second sub-laser. The wavelengths and polarization states of the first sub-laser and the first blue light source are different from each other, so that speckle of the blue laser is restrained. And the second sub-laser is used to excite the phosphor to obtain fluorescence. The projection system performs projection imaging according to the first sub-laser, the first blue light source and the fluorescence.

title_en: Photoetching method and system for holographic anti-counterfeiting printing
abstract_en: The application discloses a photoetching method and a photoetching system for holographic anti-counterfeiting printing, which relate to the field of printing data processing, and the method comprises the steps of receiving at least one gray level image, encoding preset holographic anti-counterfeiting information into the gray level image to obtain a holographic anti-counterfeiting gray level image, and determining the space frequency and pattern complexity of the holographic anti-counterfeiting gray level image; the method comprises the steps of determining the frequency of a laser according to the space frequency and the complexity of patterns, determining the exposure angle range of the laser and the scanning path on a substrate according to the micro-patterns of a holographic anti-counterfeiting gray image, receiving a first instruction, acquiring the intensity of reflected light on the substrate and the definition of interference patterns on the substrate in real time according to the frequency and the exposure angle range of the laser, determining the optimal focal length position of an optical system according to the intensity of the reflected light and the definition of the interference patterns on the substrate, generating a second instruction according to the optimal focal length position, and carrying out photoetching on the fixed substrate through the laser to obtain the three-dimensional holographic anti-counterfeiting pattern.

title_en: Structure-compounded ultra-wideband high-gain vortex optical fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a structure composite ultra-wideband high-gain vortex optical fiber and a preparation method thereof. The optical fiber sequentially comprises a passive fiber core, an active inner ring core, an active outer ring core and a cladding from inside to outside. The active inner ring core and the outer ring core are laser materials doped with different rare earth luminescent ions, and different luminescent wave bands correspond to different rare earth luminescent ion combination modes, for example, a blue wave band is Tb-Tm, a red wave band is Eu-Sm, a 1 mu m wave band is Nd-Yb, a 1.5 mu m wave band is Er-Tm, a 2 mu m wave band is Tm-Ho, and a 3 mu m wave band is Er-Ho or Er-Dy. The structural composite vortex fiber disclosed by the invention is used for carrying out zone doping on rare earth luminescent ions, so that unnecessary energy transfer processes can be effectively avoided, the luminous efficiency of the fiber is improved, the luminous bandwidth of the fiber is increased, and the structural composite vortex fiber is applied to high-performance vortex fiber lasers and broadband orbital angular momentum multiplexing systems.

title_en: Bidirectional conduction device of optical isolator and optical isolator
abstract_en: The application discloses a bidirectional conduction device of an optical isolator and the optical isolator, comprising a first rotating piece, a second rotating piece and a first regulating piece, wherein a plurality of first regulating pieces are arranged on the first rotating piece around the center; and the second rotating piece is provided with a plurality of second adjusting pieces around the center. According to the application, the alignment of each first adjusting piece and each second adjusting piece is controlled to realize the bidirectional conduction of light rays so as to adapt to different installation conditions, reduce the work of detaching and reinstalling after installation and lighten the workload of a user.

title_en: Peep-proof method and device for vehicle-mounted projection screen, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a peep-proof method, a peep-proof device, electronic equipment and a storage medium for a vehicle-mounted projection screen, wherein the method comprises the steps of receiving a peep-proof instruction; the method comprises the steps of determining a target peep-proof area on a vehicle-mounted projection screen based on the peep-proof instruction, performing first roughening treatment on the target peep-proof area to enable the target peep-proof area to enter a peep-proof mode, wherein the roughness of the target peep-proof area after the first roughening treatment is larger than the wavelength of a projection light source. According to the scheme, the dynamic peeping prevention is realized by adjusting the roughness of the target peeping prevention area of the vehicle-mounted projection screen, so that the privacy can be effectively protected, the safety can be improved, the intelligent level of a vehicle can be further improved, the driving experience of a user can be improved, and the diversified application requirements can be met.

title_en: Optical sensor element, thermal image sensor and method for detecting thermal radiation
abstract_en: An optical sensor element (1) for sensing thermal radiation comprises a light emitter (10) having a cavity (11), the light emitter (10) being configured to emit coherent electromagnetic radiation through an emission surface (12) and to experience self-mixing interference, SMI, caused by reflected electromagnetic radiation re-injected into the cavity (11). A micro-opto-mechanical transducer (20) is arranged remote from the emission surface (12), the transducer (20) being configured to undergo mechanical deflection in dependence on thermal radiation absorbed by the transducer (20) and reflect electromagnetic radiation emitted by the light emitter (10) back into the cavity (11) to generate the SMI. The detection unit (30) is configured to detect a degree of the generated SMI, determine a deflection of the transducer (20) according to the detected degree, and generate an output signal indicative of the determined deflection.

title_en: Display panel and display device
abstract_en: A display panel and a display device are provided. The display panel comprises a display area and a peripheral area, wherein the peripheral area at least partially surrounds the display area, and comprises a first sub-peripheral area, and is characterized in that the display panel comprises a first substrate, a black matrix and a plurality of color resistance parts, wherein the black matrix and the color resistance parts are arranged on the first substrate, the color resistance parts are arranged in the display area in an array mode along a first direction and a second direction, the plurality of spacers are arranged on the first substrate, the plurality of spacers comprise a first spacer in the first sub-peripheral area and a second spacer in the display area, the second substrate is arranged opposite to the first substrate, the second substrate comprises a second substrate, a plurality of pixel driving circuits are arranged on the second substrate, a driving chip is arranged on the second substrate, the driving chip is arranged in the first sub-peripheral area, and the frame sealing glue is arranged between the first substrate and the second substrate, and the frame sealing glue surrounds the display area.

title_en: Graph correction method
abstract_en: A pattern correction method comprises the steps of carrying out iterative correction processing for a plurality of times, wherein the iterative correction processing comprises the steps of correcting an initial pattern or a correction pattern obtained in the previous iterative correction, obtaining a correction pattern corresponding to the initial pattern, wherein the contour edge of the correction pattern comprises a plurality of first-type correction fragments and a plurality of second-type correction fragments, carrying out simulated exposure on the correction pattern, obtaining an exposure pattern corresponding to the correction pattern, wherein the exposure pattern comprises a target exposure pattern area, the contour edge of the target exposure pattern area corresponds to the plurality of second-type correction fragments, determining an evaluation function of the correction pattern in the current iterative correction processing according to a first edge placement error corresponding to each first-type correction fragment of the correction pattern, a second edge placement error corresponding to each second-type correction fragment and a dimensional change of the target exposure pattern area in the first direction, and judging whether the next iterative correction processing is carried out according to the evaluation function in the current iterative correction processing, so that the accuracy of pattern correction is improved.

title_en: Developing cartridge and process cartridge
abstract_en: The invention discloses a developing cartridge and a process cartridge for an electrophotographic image forming apparatus. The developing cartridge comprises a cartridge body and a developing roller, a developer accommodating chamber for accommodating developer is arranged in the cartridge body, a separating member is arranged at one end part in the longitudinal direction of the cartridge body, the separating member is provided with an abutting part and is abutted against the drum frame, a force receiving part is arranged above the abutting part, a connecting part is arranged below the abutting part, and when the force receiving part receives the force applied by the electrophotographic imaging equipment, the separating member rotates around the abutting part to separate the developing roller from the photosensitive drum. The invention has simple structure and can facilitate the separation or contact between the developing roller and the photosensitive drum.

title_en: Nitrocarbazole (ketoxime) ester compound and photoinitiator containing same
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of photocuring, and particularly relates to a nitrocarbazole (ketone) oxime ester compound and a photoinitiator containing the same, wherein the compound has a structure shown in a formula (I). The compound has higher curing hardness and excellent photosensitivity, can be used as a photoinitiator, and is particularly suitable for a photoinitiator of a UV-light source.

title_en: Silicon optical integrated Bragg grating assembly and optical module
abstract_en: The invention discloses a silicon optical integrated Bragg grating assembly and an optical module, which comprise a silicon optical chip, wherein a planar waveguide grating, bragg gratings and micro-circulators are arranged on the silicon optical chip, the planar waveguide grating comprises at least one optical waveguide input channel and a plurality of first optical waveguide output channels, each first optical waveguide output channel is correspondingly connected with one micro-circulator, each micro-circulator comprises two second optical waveguide output channels, and at least one second optical waveguide output channel is provided with the Bragg gratings. The invention has the advantages of small volume, high isolation and strong anti-interference capability.

title_en: Metal medium reinforced reflecting film with wavelength of 190-230nm and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of optical films, in particular to a metal medium reinforced reflecting film with the wavelength of 190-230nm and a preparation method thereof, wherein the metal medium reinforced reflecting film comprises a substrate, a main reflecting layer and a plurality of medium reinforced layers, the main reflecting layer is an Al layer, the medium reinforced layers are formed by alternately laminating MgF  2  layers and Al  2 O 3  layers, the number of layers of the medium reinforced layers is not more than 3, the physical thickness of the Al layer is 180+/-2% nm, the physical thickness of the MgF  2  layer is 26.43+/-2% nm, the physical thickness of the Al  2 O 3  layer is 36.65+/-2% nm, the evaporation rate of MgF  2  in the MgF  2  layer is 0.8+/-0.1 nm/s, and the evaporation rate of Al  2 O 3  in the Al  2 O 3  layer is 0.5+/-0.05 nm/s. The metal medium reinforced reflecting film has stable high reflectivity in the wave band of 190-230nm, high compactness and firmness between film layers and good durability.

title_en: Projection screen and projection display system
abstract_en: The application relates to a projection screen and a projection display system, wherein the projection screen comprises a substrate, one side of the substrate is provided with a plurality of grid structures which are arrayed along a first direction, each grid structure is provided with a first reflecting surface, the first reflecting surface and the first direction are arranged at an included angle, the plurality of grid structures are symmetrically arranged along a first reference surface in the first direction, the included angle between the first reflecting surface of each grid structure and the first direction is gradually increased in the direction along the first direction and far away from the first reference surface, the height of each grid structure is gradually increased along a second direction, the first direction and the second direction are mutually perpendicular, the first direction is perpendicular to the first reference surface, and the second direction is parallel to the first reference surface. The application can emit the projection light reflected by the projection screen on the two side areas to the visible area as much as possible, reduce light loss, make the brightness of the two side areas and the middle area of the projection screen as uniform as possible, and improve the brightness uniformity of the projection screen.

title_en: Optical lens and electronic equipment with same
abstract_en: The application provides an optical lens and electronic equipment with the same, which comprises a first lens, a second lens, a third lens, a fourth lens, a fifth lens, a fourth lens and a fifth lens, wherein the first lens is provided with negative focal power, the fourth lens is provided with positive focal power, the fifth lens is provided with positive focal power, the radius of curvature R1 of the first side surface of the first lens, the radius of curvature R2 of the second side surface of the first lens and the center thickness d1 of the first lens on the optical axis of the optical lens are met, R < 2+d1)/R < 1.8, the combined focal length F23 of the second lens and the third lens and the whole group focal length F of the optical lens are met, the air interval d2 of the first lens and the second lens on the optical axis of the optical lens and the optical back focal length BFL of the optical lens are met, and d2/BFL is not more than 0.8. The application solves the problems of high resolution, small telecentricity and difficult consideration of long back focus of the optical lens in the prior art.

title_en: Multidirectional controllable electro-optical switch structure based on micro-ring coupler
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multidirectional controllable electro-optical switch structure based on a micro-ring coupler, and belongs to the technical field of optical waveguides and optical switches. The electro-optical modulation micro-ring coupler comprises an optical loop formed by a silicon dioxide cladding and a waveguide layer prepared by a lithium niobate film, wherein the optical loop comprises an input end symmetrical directional coupler, an S-shaped bending waveguide and a double-bus runway micro-ring resonator, wherein the input end symmetrical directional coupler realizes the through output of an optical signal under the passive condition, the output of a cross end is realized after an electrode is applied with 25v bias voltage, the runway micro-ring coupler realizes the through output of the optical signal under the passive condition to the output of a downloading port under the modulation of a bus waveguide electrode, and a cascade device realizes the multidirectional controllable transmission function of the optical signal. The invention is beneficial to constructing a reconfigurable on-chip optical switch network, and can realize the functions of filtering and high-speed modulation in a certain free spectrum range based on the excellent electro-optic coefficient of the lithium niobate material.

title_en: Method for manufacturing mesh point of glass light guide plate, glass light guide plate and front light source assembly
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for manufacturing a glass light guide plate net point, which comprises the steps of (1) silk screen printing ink on a first surface of a glass plate to obtain a layer of ink layer, (2) punching holes on the first surface of the glass plate with the ink layer by utilizing laser to obtain a plurality of first blind holes, (3) removing the ink layer on the surface of the glass plate, then placing the glass plate into pure water for cleaning, removing glass powder and ink residues in the first blind holes, and (4) placing the cleaned glass plate into hydrofluoric acid solution for etching to obtain a plurality of concave net points. Because the ink layer can absorb part of the energy of the laser, the central area with the maximum energy density in the laser spot can penetrate the ink layer to form concave holes on the first surface of the glass plate, so that the size of the finally obtained concave lattice points is smaller, the lattice points can not be directly seen by human eyes, the display picture is clearer, and the brightness contrast ratio of the display can be improved. The invention also discloses a glass light guide plate and a front light source assembly.

title_en: Digital analysis method and system based on high signal-to-noise ratio holographic imaging of nano lens
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital analysis method and a digital analysis system for holographic imaging with high signal-to-noise ratio based on a nano lens, and belongs to the field of biochemical analysis. The invention combines microsphere nano probes with a high signal-to-noise ratio holographic microscopic imaging technology, changes the quantity of microsphere signal probes in supernatant fluid/immune complex through a series of biochemical reactions, carries out high signal-to-noise ratio holographic imaging on PS microsphere nano probes in the supernatant fluid after magnetic separation, drives a high signal-to-noise ratio lens-free holographic microscope which forms a nano lens by using a surface acoustic wave-interdigital transducer in the holographic imaging process, acquires the quantity of microsphere signal probes in the holographic image by using a light-weighted unsupervised learning target detection algorithm, and finally realizes the accurate quantitative detection of a target object to be detected. Experimental results show that the invention effectively improves the detection sensitivity and efficiency and improves the detection accuracy.

title_en: Distributed Bragg reflector resonant cavity based on plasmon supermolecule
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed Bragg reflector resonant cavity based on plasmonic supermolecules, which comprises a plasmonic supermolecule distributed Bragg reflector and a dielectric cavity, wherein the plasmonic supermolecule distributed Bragg reflector is formed by taking a gold nanoparticle supermolecule array layer and a dielectric layer as repeating units, the number of the repeating units is 1-100, the gold nanoparticle supermolecule units are formed by densely arranging N gold nanoparticles, and the distributed Bragg reflector resonant cavity is a sandwich structure formed by 2 plasmonic supermolecule distributed Bragg reflectors and 1 dielectric cavity. The resonant cavity has the excellent performances of small cavity length, high quality factor, deep resonant depth and the like. Therefore, the distributed Bragg reflector resonant cavity of the plasmon supermolecular array can effectively improve the performance of the photoelectric device and reduce the size of the device.

title_en: High-electric-conductivity heat-conductivity patterned graphene copper composite material and preparation method thereof
