abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-conductivity and high-heat-conductivity patterned graphene copper composite material and a preparation method thereof, relates to the technical field of composite material preparation, and aims to solve the problem of how to improve the performance of the graphene copper composite material, and comprises the following steps: s1: coating photoresist on graphene layers on two sides of a graphene-coated copper foil, curing, and patterning the photoresist after curing and molding; s2: placing the graphene coated copper foil in the step S1 into a photoetching machine, etching the graphene layer according to the patterned photoresist, and removing the photoresist layer to obtain the patterned graphene coated copper foil; s3: and (2) placing the patterned graphene coated copper foil prepared in the step (S2) into a hot-pressing cavity, setting proper hot-pressing temperature and proper pressure, and hot-pressing and forming the patterned graphene coated copper foil by using a lamination hot-pressing method to obtain the graphene copper composite material with high electric conductivity and thermal conductivity.

title_en: Optical fiber laser thermal management system and phase-change direct-cooling optical fiber laser
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fiber laser thermal management system and a phase-change direct-cooling fiber laser, which comprise a cold plate body, a compression refrigeration temperature control system and a water circulation temperature control system, wherein at least one layer of phase-change refrigerant flow channel and at least one layer of water flow channel are arranged in the cold plate body, the compression refrigeration temperature control system is communicated with the phase-change refrigerant flow channel to form a refrigerant loop and is used for cooling a heating device on the surface of the cold plate body and cooling media in the water flow channel, and the water circulation temperature control system is communicated with the water flow channel to form a water circulation loop and is used for cooling the heating device on the surface of the cold plate body and a laser head through circulation flow of the cooling media so as to increase the thermal inertia of the cold plate body. The optical fiber laser heat management system and the phase-change direct-cooling optical fiber laser provided by the invention can realize efficient heat dissipation and accurate temperature control of a pumping source for all heating devices of the optical fiber laser, reduce the volume and weight of the laser and improve the output power of the laser.

title_en: Image forming apparatus with a plurality of image forming units
abstract_en: The application belongs to the field of a printing product, and particularly relates to image forming equipment, wherein an LED printing head is connected with the inner side of a cover through a connecting rod mechanism, the connecting rod mechanism drives the LED printing head to be placed into a shell through an opening at the top of the shell and close to a photosensitive drum in a processing box in the process of switching the cover from an opening position to a closing position, and the connecting rod mechanism drives the LED printing head to be far away from the processing box in the process of switching the cover from the closing position to the opening position. From this setting, after opening the cover, the LED print head is packed up, and the user can not lead to the fact the damage of colliding with to the LED print head to the in-process of changing the processing box, and after the processing box is changed, at the in-process of putting down the cover, the LED print head falls into in the casing along with the cover closure under link mechanism's effect to aim at the sensitization drum for make the sensitization drum expose at the image formation in-process.

title_en: Optical module and preparation method of optical chip
abstract_en: The optical module comprises an optical chip and an optical fiber, wherein the optical chip comprises a first substrate, a first buried layer arranged on the first substrate, a first cladding layer arranged on the first buried layer, a second cladding layer arranged on the first cladding layer and a second buried layer arranged on the second cladding layer, a first waveguide and a first metal electrode group which are far away from the first substrate are arranged in the first cladding layer, a first gap is reserved between the first waveguide and the first substrate, a second waveguide and a second metal electrode group which are close to the first cladding layer are arranged in the second cladding layer, the second metal electrode group is connected with the first metal electrode group in a bonding mode, the second waveguide is connected with the first waveguide in a coupling mode, a second gap is reserved between the second waveguide and the first waveguide, and the optical fiber is connected with the first waveguide in a coupling mode. The optical chip is provided with two substrates, so that the first waveguide far away from the substrates is integrated in the optical chip, the distance between the first waveguide and the substrates is increased, and the substrate leakage loss is reduced.

title_en: Preparation method of negative photoresist patterned film
abstract_en: The application discloses a preparation method of a negative photoresist patterned film layer, and relates to the technical field of photoresist materials. The preparation method comprises the following steps of step 1, sequentially carrying out acid washing, hydrogen peroxide washing and pure water washing on an epitaxial wafer to obtain a pretreated epitaxial wafer, step 2, carrying out spin coating negative photoresist on the surface of the pretreated epitaxial wafer, carrying out soft baking, carrying out exposure treatment under the shielding of a mask plate, transferring a pattern onto the pretreated epitaxial wafer, carrying out development treatment, carrying out pure water washing and nitrogen drying, and obtaining a negative photoresist patterned film layer. The negative photoresist comprises the following raw materials, by mass, 22-26 parts of photosensitive polyimide, 4-6 parts of POSS-based branched polyimide, 10-12 parts of mercapto monomer, 3-4 parts of initiator and 108-132 parts of organic solvent. In the application, the quality of the negative photoresist patterning film layer is effectively improved by optimizing components and soft baking and exposure processes.

title_en: Polarization spectroscope and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of polarization spectroscopes, in particular to a polarization spectroscope and a preparation method and application thereof. The polarizing spectroscope comprises a diamond substrate, a polarizing spectroscope film and a first metallized film layer which are positioned on one side surface of the diamond substrate, a broadband antireflection film positioned on the other side surface of the diamond substrate and a second metallized film layer positioned on the side surface of the diamond substrate, wherein the first metallized film layer is positioned at the edge position of the one side surface of the diamond substrate. The edge of the polarizing spectroscope is metallized to weld the lens body with the metal tube shell or the water-cooling structure integrally, so that the heat conduction efficiency is improved, and a high-reliability and low-leakage-rate vacuum sealing solution can be provided.

title_en: Fresnel HUD screen
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Fresnel HUD screen, which relates to the technical field of head-up display equipment and comprises a substrate, a Fresnel structure layer and a microstructure layer, wherein the Fresnel structure layer is arranged on the top of the substrate, the microstructure layer is arranged on a reflecting surface of the Fresnel structure, and the microstructure layer sequentially comprises a micro-nano lens layer, an optical coating, a crystal layer, a reflecting layer, a light absorption layer, an isolation layer, a microcrystalline structure layer and a substrate layer from top to bottom.

title_en: Polarization-independent needle-shaped light generation system and method
abstract_en: The application relates to a polarization independent needle-shaped light generating system and a method thereof, which relate to the technical field of optical communication, wherein the polarization independent needle-shaped light generating system comprises a light source; the double-polarization assembly comprises an optical path element and a spatial light modulator, wherein the optical path element is used for dividing incident light output by a light source into two polarized lights and converting the two polarized lights into target polarized light which can be modulated by the spatial light modulator, and the spatial light modulator is written with complex amplitude of needle-shaped light so as to modulate the target polarized light to generate the needle-shaped light irrelevant to polarization. The application can process signals in any polarization state, and focus incident light into needle shape, and keep diffraction-free characteristic in the design range, thereby ensuring the quality of received signals.

title_en: Goggles with unpolarized ambient light dimming
abstract_en: An electronic eyewear device includes a spatially dimmed pixel panel within an optical assembly that delivers improved backlight conditions for a displayed image. The spatially dimmed pixel panel is spatially dimmed where the image is located on the display, and the unoccupied region of the display is not dimmed (not dimmed), such that the real world view through that portion of the display is unchanged. The spatially dimmed pixel panel is made up of a plurality of liquid crystal cells arranged in a meshed orientation, the liquid crystal cells being dye-doped or guest-host liquid crystal systems having a homeotropic alignment of phase change modes. The spatially dimmed pixel panel absorbs unpolarized light when a voltage is applied across the cell and passes the unpolarized light when there is no voltage across the cell.

title_en: Color filter structure and forming method thereof
abstract_en: The color filter structure comprises a substrate, a reflection reducing layer, a light shielding layer, a light resistance structure, a protective layer and a light shielding layer, wherein the substrate comprises a display area and a frame area, the display area comprises a light transmission area and a light shielding area, the substrate is provided with a first side and a second side which are opposite, the reflection reducing layer is positioned on the first side and covers the substrate, the light shielding layer is positioned on the first side and covers the frame area and the light shielding area towards the projection of the substrate, the reflection reducing layer is positioned between the substrate and the light shielding layer, the refractive index of the reflection reducing layer is positioned between the refractive indexes of the substrate and the light shielding layer, the light resistance structure is positioned on the first side and covers the light transmission area towards the projection of the substrate, the reflection reducing layer is also positioned between the substrate and the light resistance structure, and the protective layer is positioned on the first side and covers the light shielding layer and the light resistance structure. The reflection reducing layer is used as a refraction transition layer between the substrate and the shading layer, so that the absorption of light rays incident on the back surface is increased, the chromatic aberration caused by large reflectivity difference of a display area and a frame area is reduced, and the integrated visual effect of a screen is improved.

title_en: Polarization sensor modeling method considering solar interference
abstract_en: The invention relates to a modeling method of a polarization sensor considering sunlight interference, which comprises the steps of dividing light entering a polarization sensor into linear polarized light, normal incidence unpolarized light and sunlight, taking the influence of the sunlight interference on the polarization sensor into consideration on the basis of Malus law to characterize the transmitted light intensity of the sunlight, taking polarized light intensity information, a solar vector, calibration parameters of the polarization sensor, an angle of view of the polarization sensor, an inner wall reflection coefficient and a diffuse reflection coefficient as inputs and the transmitted light intensity of the sunlight interference and the sunlight duty ratio as outputs based on a long-term memory network, taking the polarization angle after the sunlight interference compensation as a training target to learn a transmitted light intensity equation of the sunlight interference, comprehensively taking the influence of the linear polarized light, the normal incidence unpolarized light and the sunlight on the polarization sensor into consideration, and combining the light intensity gain coefficient of the polarization sensor to establish a polarization sensor model considering the sunlight interference so as to realize the polarization information solution of the polarization angle, the polarization degree and the like.

title_en: High-energy optical fiber coupling laser for impact reinforcement
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of lasers, in particular to a high-energy optical fiber coupling laser for shock reinforcement, which comprises a Cassegrain Lin Fei stable resonant cavity, a Cassegrain unstable resonant cavity mirror, a Cassegrain Lin Fei stable resonant cavity mirror, a frequency doubling component, an optical fiber, a focusing mirror and an optical fiber, wherein a laser pulse modulation component, a first laser gain component and a polarizing component are arranged between the plano-convex total reflection mirror and the Gaussian output mirror, the frequency doubling component comprises a beam shrinking system and a frequency doubling crystal, a second laser gain component is arranged between the frequency doubling component and the Cassegrain Lin Fei stable resonant cavity, the optical fiber coupling component with a homogenizer comprises an attenuator and a beam expanding system, the honeycomb mirror is arranged behind the beam expanding system, the focusing mirror is arranged behind the honeycomb mirror, and the optical fiber is arranged behind the focusing mirror. The invention can solve the problem that the high-intensity laser pulse damages the inlet surface of the optical fiber and the inside of the core material.

title_en: Light irradiation device and exposure device
abstract_en: In a light irradiation device which combines laser beams generated by a plurality of light sources into a single beam and emits the single beam, the light path length is not increased, and the light emitted from the plurality of laser light sources is prevented from being dissipated. In the light irradiation device and the exposure device, an illumination optical system includes an incident angle conversion unit including a first lens and a second lens arranged to form a positional relationship of a beam expander, a dividing lens unit including a plurality of lenses arranged in a direction perpendicular to an optical axis of the incident angle conversion unit and along a plane, and dividing light emitted from the incident angle conversion unit by the plurality of lenses, an optical path length difference generation unit including a plurality of light transmission units having different optical path lengths and arranged in a direction perpendicular to the optical axis, and causing light passing through the plurality of lenses to be incident on the plurality of light transmission units, respectively, and a condensing lens unit overlapping an irradiation region of light emitted from the plurality of light transmission units on an irradiated surface.

title_en: Variable magnification optical system, optical device, and method for manufacturing variable magnification optical system
abstract_en: The magnification-varying optical system (ZL) has a 1 st lens group (G1) having negative optical power, a2 nd lens group (G2) having positive optical power, a 3 rd lens group (G3) having negative optical power, and a 4 th lens group (G4) having positive optical power, which are sequentially arranged from the object side along the optical axis, wherein the 1 st lens group (G1) is fixed with respect to the image plane when magnification variation is performed, the interval between adjacent lens groups varies, and the magnification-varying optical system (ZL) satisfies the following conditional expression of 0.70 (-f 1)/f 2< 1.30.55 < f 2/(-f 3) <1.20, wherein f1 is the focal length of the 1 st lens group, f2 is the focal length of the 2 nd lens group, and f3 is the focal length of the 3 rd lens group.

title_en: Optical lens
abstract_en: The invention provides an optical lens which sequentially comprises a reflecting element, a first lens, a third lens, a fourth lens, a fifth lens and a trimming lens forming process, wherein the reflecting element comprises an incident surface, a reflecting surface and an emergent surface, the reflecting surface of the reflecting element forms an included angle of 45 degrees with the optical axes of the incident surface and the emergent surface of the reflecting element respectively, the object side of the first lens is a convex surface, the second lens is provided with negative focal power, the third lens is provided with positive focal power, the object side of the fourth lens is a concave surface, the image side of the fourth lens is a convex surface, the object side of the fifth lens is a convex surface, the image side of the fifth lens is a concave surface, the first lens adopts a trimming lens forming process, and the minimum optical caliber D1min of the first lens and the maximum optical caliber D1max of the first lens meet that D1min is less than 0.92 and D1min/D1max is less than 0.98. The optical lens provided by the invention adopts the combination of the reflecting element and the plurality of lenses, effectively compresses the optical caliber of the lenses, and has the characteristics of miniaturization, light weight and thinness.

title_en: Non-external-cavity near-infrared perovskite laser and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an external cavity-free near infrared perovskite laser and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method of the near-infrared perovskite laser without the external cavity comprises the steps of dropwise adding perovskite precursor solution on a substrate, covering a flexible film on the substrate to enable the perovskite precursor solution to be uniformly distributed between the substrate and the flexible film, and removing the flexible film after standing the substrate to obtain a perovskite gain medium layer, wherein the flexible film is used for inducing the perovskite precursor solution to grow into a microcrystalline structure in the process of forming the perovskite gain medium layer, and the microcrystalline structure is a resonant cavity of the perovskite gain medium layer. The preparation method provided by the invention does not need high-temperature treatment such as heating or thermal annealing, has the advantages of simple preparation process and low cost, can realize large-area preparation of the near-infrared perovskite laser without an external resonant cavity, and can realize adjustment of the emission peak of the laser by regulating and controlling the perovskite gain material components and preparation process parameters.

title_en: Multiple light emitting devices and method for manufacturing multiple light emitting devices
abstract_en: To improve the quality of light emitted from a light emitting device. The plurality of light emitting devices include a first light emitting device including a first semiconductor laser element that emits light of a first color having a light emission peak wavelength of a first wavelength and a first reflecting member having a reflectance of 90% or more with respect to the first wavelength, a second light emitting device including a second semiconductor laser element that emits light of a second color having a light emission peak wavelength of a second wavelength and a second reflecting member having a reflectance of 90% or more with respect to the second wavelength, and a third light emitting device including a third semiconductor laser element that emits light of the first color having a light emission peak wavelength of a third wavelength, a fourth semiconductor laser element that emits light of the second color having a light emission peak wavelength of a fourth wavelength, and a plurality of third reflecting members having a reflectance of 90% or more with respect to the third wavelength and the fourth wavelength, wherein the reflectance of the third reflecting member with respect to the light of the first wavelength is higher than the reflectance of the second reflecting member with respect to the light of the first wavelength, and the reflectance of the third reflecting member with respect to the light of the second wavelength is higher than the reflectance of the first reflecting member with respect to the light of the second wavelength.

title_en: Method and system for realizing efficient optical fiber wiring planning based on intelligent path planning algorithm
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of optical fiber wiring, and discloses a method and a system for realizing efficient optical fiber wiring planning based on an intelligent path planning algorithm, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a space topology model corresponding to a wiring area; the method comprises the steps of carrying out meshing processing on a space topology model to obtain a space topology mesh, calculating optical fiber installation cost between an initial installation node and a subsequent installation node, planning an optical fiber installation line between the initial installation node and the subsequent installation node in the space topology mesh, carrying out adaptive modeling on an optical fiber and the space topology model in the optical fiber installation line to obtain an optical fiber adaptive virtual model, evaluating optical fiber interference degree between the optical fibers in the optical fiber adaptive virtual model, calculating line complexity corresponding to the optical fiber installation line, calculating environment coupling degree corresponding to the optical fibers in the optical fiber installation line, and carrying out line optimization processing on the optical fiber installation line to obtain an optimized installation line of the optical fiber in an area to be installed. The invention mainly aims to solve the problem of low optical fiber wiring efficiency.

title_en: Optical filter
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an optical filter comprising, in order, a dielectric multilayer film 1, a resin film, a phosphoric acid glass, and a dielectric multilayer film 2, wherein the resin film comprises a resin and a near infrared absorbing dye in the resin, the near infrared absorbing dye has a maximum absorption wavelength of 690 to 800nm, the thickness of the resin film is 10 [ mu ] m or less, and the optical filter satisfies all specific spectral characteristics (i-1) to (i-5).

title_en: Immersion simulation type virtual shooting experience device
abstract_en: The invention discloses immersion simulation type virtual shooting experience equipment, and relates to the technical field of XR experience equipment. The intelligent shooting device comprises a shooting cabin, wherein a green curtain is arranged on one side of the shooting cabin, a plurality of cameras are arranged on the periphery of the shooting cabin, a shooting field table is fixedly arranged in the shooting cabin, a first electric sliding table which is horizontally arranged is fixedly arranged at the top of the shooting cabin, and a control table is fixedly arranged at the telescopic end of the first electric sliding table towards the inside of the shooting cabin. According to the invention, an experimenter can control the virtual carrier to run in a preset virtual scene through the steering wheel, a plurality of cameras on the periphery side of the shooting cabin and the built-in cameras in the shooting cabin shoot the whole shooting cabin and the experience process of the experimenter in the whole process, so that the experimenter can obtain real-time immersive experience while shooting an XR film, and the experimenter has more feeling of reality and interaction in the XR shooting process, and better interaction experience is obtained.

title_en: Laser system and method for laser machining a workpiece
abstract_en: The invention relates to a laser system for laser processing a workpiece (104) using an interference pattern (124), comprising at least one laser beam source (106) for providing a plurality of coherent laser beams (112), an amplifying device (118) for forming an amplified coherent laser beam (113) by amplifying the coherent laser beams (112), a phase setting device (114) for setting a corresponding phase difference between the coherent laser beams (112) and/or the amplified coherent laser beams (113), and a beam convergence region (130) in which at least beam portions of different output laser beams (102) converge in the beam convergence region (130) based on the amplified coherent laser beams (113) or output laser beams (102) corresponding to the amplified coherent laser beams (113) to form the interference pattern (104).

title_en: Semiconductor laser device
abstract_en: A semiconductor laser element (10) is provided with a first semiconductor layer, an active layer (23), an insulating film (30), a contact electrode (40), and a barrier metal layer (50), wherein the second semiconductor layer has a bump (24R), the insulating film (30) has an opening (30 a) arranged at a position corresponding to the upper surface (24 Rt) of the bump (24R), the contact electrode (40) is arranged at the opening (30 a), the side surface (40 s) of the contact electrode (40) is inclined toward the inside of the contact electrode (40), the side surface (30 s) of the insulating film (30) is inclined toward the outside of the opening (30 a), and the barrier metal layer (50) entirely covers the upper surface (40 t) of the contact electrode (40) and continuously covers the upper surface (30 t) of the insulating film (30) from the upper surface (40 t) of the contact electrode (40).

title_en: Single-mode hollow anti-resonance optical fiber for transmitting high-power laser
abstract_en: The invention relates to a single-mode hollow anti-resonance optical fiber for transmitting high-power laser, which comprises a cladding layer and a fiber core, wherein the cladding layer and the fiber core are sequentially arranged from outside to inside, the cladding layer comprises an outer cladding layer and an inner cladding layer, the inner cladding layer comprises a plurality of anti-resonance layer units, each anti-resonance layer unit comprises a first anti-resonance layer, a second anti-resonance layer and a thin wall, the first anti-resonance layer and the second anti-resonance layer are tangent in a region close to the outer cladding layer, the tangent point of the tangent point is cut off, the thin wall is connected, and the tail end of the thin wall is connected with the outer cladding layer. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages of low transmission loss of the fundamental mode, high single-mode performance, wide spectral bandwidth, high damage threshold, low nonlinear coefficient and the like.

title_en: Small space change aberration optical design method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a small space change aberration optical design method which comprises the steps of determining performance indexes and initial structural parameters of an optical system according to imaging requirements of a target imaging system, calculating vertical height variance and horizontal width variance of a point spread function under sampling points of different fields of view, peak signal-to-noise ratio and structural similarity indexes of each field of view point list and a central field of view point list, peak signal-to-noise ratio and structural similarity difference of the point list caused by defocus, optimizing performance of the optical system under defocus, calculating a comprehensive evaluation function for evaluating the space aberration change condition of the optical system, iteratively optimizing the structural parameters of the lens through a least square method, and outputting a final optimized optical system structure when iteration is finished. According to the invention, the comprehensive evaluation function for evaluating the aberration of different fields of view and defocus distances is introduced, so that the optical system is optimally designed, and the uniformity and stability of the spatial aberration of the optical system are obviously improved.

title_en: PMPCF vernier sensitization-based double-FPI integrated seawater salinity sensor
abstract_en: The invention provides a PMPCF vernier sensitization-based double FPI integrated seawater salinity sensor, which relates to the technical field of optical fiber sensing, the sensor etches two micro-flow channels on a single-mode fiber through a femtosecond laser processing technology, and is connected with a large hole of PMPCF to form a seawater circulation channel. The welding surface of the single-mode fiber and the polarization maintaining photonic crystal fiber is used as a first reflecting surface, and the gold-plated end surface of the polarization maintaining photonic crystal fiber is used as a second reflecting surface, so that a dual-FPI structure is formed. Due to the birefringence effect of the polarization maintaining photonic crystal fiber, a vernier effect is generated by the superimposed spectrum of the double FPI in the reflection spectrum. By detecting the deviation of the reflection spectrum envelope, the change of the salinity of the seawater can be monitored in real time. The sensor has the advantages of compact structure, high sensitivity, strong anti-interference capability and the like, is suitable for long-term stable monitoring in a complex marine environment, and provides a high-efficiency and reliable solution for accurate measurement of seawater salinity.

title_en: Swing arm lever bearing support balancing unit
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of photography, in particular to a swing arm lever bearing support balancing device. The swing arm lever bearing support balancing device specifically comprises a driving mechanism, a fixed shell, a support bearing, a connecting bearing and a swing arm, wherein the driving mechanism is fixedly connected with the fixed shell, the driving mechanism is connected with the swing arm, the support bearing is fixedly connected with the middle part of the swing arm, the fixed shell is provided with a sliding groove for the support bearing to slide, one end of the connecting bearing is connected with the fixed shell, and the other end of the connecting bearing is connected with the end part of the swing arm. The invention has the advantages of avoiding overload phenomenon of the connecting bearing at the end part caused by lever effect, improving the stability of rotary motion and prolonging the service life.

title_en: Display device and display panel
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a display device and a display panel. The display device according to an embodiment of the present disclosure may include a first substrate including a display region and a non-display region, a second substrate attached to the first substrate in a state in which a first sealant is disposed, a first liquid crystal layer disposed inside the first sealant, a second sealant disposed outside the first sealant, a second liquid crystal layer disposed between the first sealant and the second sealant, a first electrode disposed over the first substrate in the non-display region, and a second electrode disposed over the second substrate in the non-display region and configured to define a capacitance together with the first electrode, thereby measuring and monitoring a cell gap in a frame region.

title_en: Polarization control method, apparatus, device and readable medium for image pickup device
abstract_en: The application discloses a polarization control method, equipment, a device and a readable medium for an image pickup device, wherein the image pickup device comprises a lens, a polarizer and an electro-optic modulator, the electro-optic modulator comprises at least three cascaded extruders, an output voltage target value of the electro-optic modulator is obtained, an output voltage actual value of the electro-optic modulator when light rays sequentially pass through the lens and the polarizer and are input to the electro-optic modulator is obtained, a target control amount is determined according to the output voltage actual value and the output voltage target value, and the target control amount is provided to the extruders so as to control the polarization direction of the input light rays from the polarizer into a transmissible polarization direction of the electro-optic modulator. The polarization direction of the input light from the polarizer can be controlled by the electro-optical modulator under the condition of no matter the polarization direction of the polarizer, so that polarized light vibrating in the target polarization direction is obtained, and the automation degree and effect of polarization control are improved.

title_en: Electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses electronic equipment, which belongs to the technical field of communication and comprises an equipment main body and an illumination assembly, wherein the equipment main body is provided with a containing cavity and a first through hole communicated with the containing cavity, the illumination assembly comprises a luminous light source and a light distribution piece, at least part of the light distribution piece is positioned in the first through hole, the luminous light source is positioned in the containing cavity, the light distribution piece is provided with a light emitting surface and a light entering surface which are arranged in a back-to-back mode, the luminous light source is opposite to the light entering surface, light emitted by the luminous light source is emitted from the light emitting surface after passing through the light entering surface, the light entering surface comprises a first light entering structure and a second light entering structure, the second light entering structure is arranged around the first light entering structure, the first light entering structure and the second light entering structure are rotationally symmetrical relative to a central optical axis of the luminous light source, the first light entering structure is an arc-shaped convex surface, and the second light entering structure comprises a plurality of annular teeth which are continuously arranged along a direction deviating from the first light entering structure.

title_en: Laser projection module
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a laser projection module, which comprises a light source, a base, an optical element and a light source, wherein the light source is positioned in an inner cavity of the base, the optical element covers an opening of the inner cavity and is provided with a first area and a second area, the first area surrounds and wraps the second area, the optical element comprises a light absorption structure arranged in the first area and a light splitting structure arranged in the second area, the light absorption structure is used for absorbing light rays emitted by the light source to the first area, the light splitting structure is used for shaping the light rays emitted by the light source to the second area, the light absorption structure comprises a plurality of protruding nano-structure parts, and the plurality of nano-structure parts are arranged at intervals in a specific distribution proportion so that the transmittance of the light rays emitted to the first area is lower than a transmittance threshold of the optical element. According to the embodiment of the application, the optical element is arranged in the laser projection module and comprises the light absorption structure with the plurality of nano structure parts, so that the contrast ratio and the energy utilization rate of the light spots projected by the laser projection module are improved.

title_en: Light guide device and head-mounted display device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a light guide device and head-mounted display equipment, wherein the light guide device comprises a double-layer substrate, an optical input element, an optical output element and an energy recovery element, wherein the optical input element, the optical output element and the energy recovery element are arranged on any layer of the substrate, the energy recovery element is arranged in a light path between one side of the optical output element and the edge of the substrate, and the energy recovery element is used for coupling light which is not coupled through the optical output element into the other layer of the substrate and re-coupling the light. The light guide device provided by the embodiment of the application is, for example, a double-layer light guide structure, and can improve the optical efficiency and the optical uniformity of the double-layer light guide element.

title_en: Super structure surface beam splitter
abstract_en: The invention discloses a super-structured surface beam splitter, and relates to the field of beam splitter devices. The beam splitter comprises a substrate and a super-structure array, wherein the super-structure array comprises a first super-structure array and a second super-structure array, the first super-structure array and the second super-structure array are arranged on the same side of the substrate and are arranged in a crossing mode, incident light enters from one side of the substrate, sequentially passes through the substrate and the super-structure array, then emits a first target beam and a second target beam with different emitting angles, the first super-structure array is used for adjusting the phase of the beam emitted from the other side opposite to one side of the substrate to emit the first target beam with polarization characteristics, and the second super-structure array is used for adjusting the phase of the beam emitted from the other side opposite to one side of the substrate and focusing the adjusted beam to a target position to obtain the second target beam with off-axis focusing characteristics. The present invention contributes to miniaturization and multifunctionality of an optical system to which a beam splitter is applied.

title_en: Electro-optical modulator, optical module and optical chip
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses an electro-optical modulator, an optical module and an optical chip. Electrodes are distributed on two sides of the waveguide of the electro-optical modulator, wherein the electrodes comprise a main electrode with the same extending direction as the waveguide and auxiliary electrodes extending from the main electrode towards the waveguide. In the extending direction of the waveguide, the electro-optical modulator is divided into a plurality of modulation areas, and the structure characteristics of auxiliary electrodes in adjacent modulation areas are different, so that the radio frequency characteristic parameters of different modulation areas are different. Therefore, the radio frequency characteristic parameters of each modulation region are flexibly configured according to actual conditions, so that the requirement of radio frequency matching is met, the bandwidth is favorably improved, the power consumption is reduced, the reflection in the electric signal transmission process is reduced, and the electro-optical modulation performance is improved.

title_en: Coding device and implementation method for D trigger function based on super-structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coding device of a D trigger function based on a super-structure body, and relates to the technical field of electromagnetic functional devices. The coding device adopts a four-substrate laminated packaging structure, wherein the upper substrate and the lower substrate are homogeneous magnetic material substrates with magnetic conduction characteristics, the left substrate and the right substrate are wave-transmitting electric substrates, a magnetic medium layer with an asymmetric layered structure is arranged in a three-dimensional cavity of the four-substrate laminated packaging structure to form an optical D trigger function core area, and electromagnetic waves enter the device along the arrangement direction of the asymmetric layered structure. The device combines the tunable electromagnetic characteristic of the super-structure body with the principle of a digital logic circuit, and provides a novel design paradigm for a microwave frequency band programmable device.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted landscape lens
abstract_en: The application discloses a vehicle-mounted landscape lens, which belongs to the technical field of vehicle-mounted lenses and comprises an optical component and a lens barrel, wherein the optical component comprises a first lens, a second lens, a third lens, a fourth lens, a diaphragm, a fifth lens, a sixth lens and a seventh lens which are sequentially arranged from left to right along a light incidence path, the eighth lens and the ninth lens, the first lens is a meniscus negative lens, the second lens is a negative lens, the third lens has positive focal power, the fourth lens is a positive lens, the fifth lens is a biconvex positive lens, the sixth lens is a biconcave negative lens, the seventh lens is a biconvex positive lens, the eighth lens is a color filter, the ninth lens is protective glass, the outer side of an image surface of the protective glass is a lens imaging surface, and the first lens, the second lens, the third lens, the fourth lens, the fifth lens, the sixth lens and the seventh lens are fixedly arranged in the lens barrel. The application has the effect of improving the stability of the structure of the vehicle-mounted landscape lens while ensuring the reliable performance of the vehicle-mounted landscape lens.

title_en: Optical imaging system
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to an optical imaging system including a first lens group having at least two reflective surfaces and including a first lens and a second lens, a second lens group including a plurality of lenses, and a reflective member disposed between the first lens group and the second lens group, wherein the at least two reflective surfaces include a first reflective surface formed on an image side of the second lens and a second reflective surface formed on an object side of the first lens, the object side of the first lens includes a first refractive surface, the image side of the second lens includes a second refractive surface, and the reflective member includes a third reflective surface, and a conditional expression f1G/fT <0.9 is satisfied, wherein f1G is a focal length of the first lens group, and fT is a total focal length of the optical imaging system.

title_en: Air-blowing micro-cable and optical cable air-blowing installation system with raised surface textures
abstract_en: The invention discloses an air-blown micro cable and an air-blown optical cable installation system with raised surface textures. The air-blown micro cable comprises a cable core and a polymer sheath for accommodating the cable core, wherein the polymer sheath contains cycloolefin copolymer and laser etching aid functional master batch, and the surface of the polymer sheath is provided with sheath material convex patterns caused by the expansion of the laser-excited master batch. The mounting system comprises a mounting pipeline, wherein the mounting pipeline is provided with a nested inner layer and an outer layer, the inner layer contains cycloolefin copolymer and laser etching aid functional master batch, the light transmittance of the outer layer for the laser wavelength excited by the laser etching aid functional master batch is more than 30%, and the inner surface of the outer layer is provided with inward convex patterns caused by the laser excitation expansion of the laser etching aid functional master batch. According to the invention, the inner wall of the air-blowing micro-cable body or the mounting pipeline forms raised textures, so that carrier gas flow can easily pass through the space between the cable body and the mounting pipeline to form an air cushion layer, and the friction resistance between the air-blowing micro-cable and the mounting pipeline is reduced, thereby improving the laying distance of the air-blowing micro-cable.

title_en: Athermal infrared lens and imaging device
abstract_en: The application discloses an infrared lens with a thermal difference elimination function, the focal length of the infrared lens is 3.2mm, the infrared lens comprises a first lens and a second lens which are sequentially arranged along the optical axis transmission direction, the first lens is a meniscus positive lens with a convex surface facing to the object side, the second lens is a biconvex lens, a diaphragm is arranged between the first lens and the second lens, and the first lens and the second lens are both made of chalcogenide glass. Therefore, the combination and arrangement modes of the lenses are adjusted by reasonably distributing the focal power, and the positive and negative focal powers are mutually matched by utilizing the difference of thermal characteristics among different materials to compensate the influence caused by temperature change, so that athermalization is realized under the condition of ensuring smaller volume. Moreover, the infrared lens only adopts two lenses, the structure is simple, the focal length is short, and the diagonal FOV can be 68 degrees. The application also discloses an imaging device.

title_en: Polarizing plate and optical display device
abstract_en: A polarizing plate and an optical display device including the same are provided, wherein the polarizing plate includes a polarizer, and a laminate stacked on one surface of the polarizer and including a first phase difference layer, a first adhesive layer, and a second phase difference layer, the first adhesive layer having a modulus of 4X 10  4  Pa to 10X 10  4  Pa at 25 ℃ and a glass transition temperature of-60 ℃ to-35 ℃.

title_en: Optical fiber array arrangement structure and method with variable core spacing
abstract_en: The application discloses an optical fiber array arrangement structure and method with a variable core distance, and belongs to the field of optical fiber arrays. The first clamping seat is arranged at the first end of the groove body and provided with a first V-shaped through groove, the first cover plate is arranged above the first clamping seat, the bottom of the first cover plate is provided with a second V-shaped through groove, the length M=DvN of the straight line where the second inclined plane is located is equal to or smaller than that of the second inclined plane, the second clamping seat is arranged on the bottom plate and is arranged at the second end of the groove body and provided with a third V-shaped through groove, the inner cover plate is recessed upwards from the bottom surface to form the first through groove, two fourth inclined planes of the first through groove form a fourth V-shaped through groove, the length L=dvN of the straight line where the fourth inclined plane is located is equal to or smaller than that of the fourth inclined plane, the inner cover plate is arranged at a position far away from the second clamping seat, the inner cover plate is slid back and forth along the length direction of the optical fibers and continuously pressed down, the inner cover plate is fixed after the arrangement structure of the second ends of the N optical fibers is stable, and the second cover plate is configured to close the top surface of the groove body. The application can lead the core spacing of the optical fibers after being distributed at equal intervals to be more accurate.

title_en: Preparation method of display panel and halftone mask plate
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of display, in particular to a preparation method of a display panel and a halftone mask plate, and aims to solve the problem of optimizing the removal effect of an inorganic packaging layer in a cutting channel area on the premise of not additionally increasing the burden of a mask process. The method comprises the steps of using a half-tone mask plate to pattern a photoresist layer, and using the patterned photoresist layer as a mask to etch, wherein the etching depth of a cutting channel region is a first depth so as to at least remove a touch interlayer dielectric layer and a part of an inorganic packaging layer at the cutting channel region, the etching depth of a lap joint hole region is a second depth so as to remove the touch interlayer dielectric layer at the lap joint hole region, and a metal layer below the touch interlayer dielectric layer is exposed to form a lap joint hole, and the first depth is larger than the second depth. On the premise of not additionally increasing the burden of a mask process, the removing effect of the inorganic packaging layer is optimized, the reliability of the panel is improved, and the manufacturing cost is reduced.

title_en: Fluorescent optical fiber probe device for three-phase flow detection
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of three-phase flow detection and provides a fluorescent optical fiber probe device for three-phase flow detection, which comprises a packaging shell, a sapphire probe, a small-diameter self-focusing lens, a large-diameter self-focusing lens, an integrated optical fiber bundle structure, a laser emitting module, a collimating lens, a trapezoidal waveguide structure, a first optical focusing assembly, a second optical focusing assembly, a first photoelectric conversion module, a second photoelectric conversion module and a main control module, wherein the sapphire probe is arranged in the packaging shell, the small-diameter self-focusing lens and the large-diameter self-focusing lens are connected and are positioned above the sapphire probe, the integrated optical fiber bundle structure is divided into an emitting optical fiber and a receiving optical fiber in a main cavity, the laser emitting module is connected with the emitting optical fiber, the collimating lens is arranged above the receiving optical fiber, the trapezoidal waveguide structure is arranged above the collimating lens, the first optical focusing assembly and the second optical focusing assembly are arranged above the trapezoidal waveguide structure side by side, and the reflective volume holographic grating is arranged below the first photoelectric conversion module and the second photoelectric conversion module. The device can effectively avoid optical power attenuation caused by optical fiber light splitting and a filter, and is beneficial to guaranteeing optical signal transmission efficiency and detection precision.

title_en: Microwave resonance suppression device of broadband electro-optic modulator packaging structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of microwave photonics and high-speed optical communication device packaging, in particular to a microwave resonance suppression device of a broadband electro-optic modulator packaging structure, which comprises: and the at least one air cavity structure is arranged in the metal tube shell of the target broadband electro-optic modulator packaging structure and is positioned below the modulator chip of the target broadband electro-optic modulator packaging structure so as to shift the cut-off frequency of mode coupling of the target broadband electro-optic modulator packaging structure out of the working frequency band of the corresponding device. Therefore, the problems that the existing cavity resonance suppression scheme depends on wave-absorbing materials, high-temperature failure exists, extra microwave transmission loss is introduced, the packaging volume is large and the like are solved.

title_en: Composition for forming organic film, method for forming pattern, and surfactant
abstract_en: The invention relates to a composition for forming an organic film, a method for forming a pattern, and a surfactant. The present invention provides a composition capable of forming an organic film which is excellent in film forming property, landfill property and swell suppressing property and is excellent in treatment margin when used as an organic film. A composition for forming an organic film, which comprises an organic film-forming material, an arylbenzyl ether compound having a partial structure represented by the general formula (B1), and a solvent. Wherein R  1  is a hydrogen atom or a fluorine-containing group represented by the formula (B2), and R  1  is a group represented by the formula (B2) wherein the ratio of hydrogen atoms is α and the ratio of groups represented by the formula (B2) is β, and the relationship of α+β=1, 0.1≤α≤0.5, and 0.5≤β≤0.9 is satisfied. R  2  is a saturated or unsaturated 1-valent organic group with 1-30 carbon atoms, b is 1-5 when a=0 or 1, a=0, c is 0-4 when a=1, b is 1-7, c is 0-6, and represents an atomic bond with other atoms.

title_en: Image pickup lens
abstract_en: The application discloses an imaging lens, which comprises a lens barrel, a lens group and at least one spacing element, wherein the lens group is assembled in the lens barrel, the number of lenses with optical power in the lens group is four, the imaging lens comprises first to fourth lenses which are sequentially arranged from an object side to an image side along an optical axis, the first lens has negative optical power, the image side is concave, the second, third and fourth lenses all have positive optical power, the image side of the third lens and the object side of the fourth lens are convex, and the at least one spacing element comprises a third spacing element which is positioned between the third and fourth lenses and is in direct contact with the image side of the third lens. Half of the maximum field angle of the imaging lens, half-fov of the maximum height L of the lens barrel in the optical axis direction, and the outer diameter D0s of the object side end surface of the lens barrel satisfy 1.25< tan (semi-fov) ×L/D0s <1.70, center thicknesses CT3 and CT4 of the third lens and the fourth lens on the optical axis satisfy 0.75< CT3/CT4<1.10, an effective focal length f3 of the third lens, an outer diameter D3s and an inner diameter D3s of the object side surface of the third spacing element satisfy 1.60< f3/D3s <2.90 and 0.45< D3s/D3s <0.85.

title_en: Underwater stripping device for communication optical cable
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underwater stripping device for a communication optical cable, which comprises a waterproof box, wherein the waterproof box comprises a fixed box and a connecting box, the fixed box is rotatably connected with one end of the connecting box, the other ends of the fixed box and the connecting box are mutually clamped, round through holes are formed in two sides of the waterproof box, the round through holes can be used for an optical cable to pass through, a first sliding block capable of moving left and right is arranged in the fixed box, and a cutter capable of moving up and down is arranged below the first sliding block.

title_en: Noninvasive full-closed-loop artificial pancreas system
abstract_en: The application belongs to the field of medical instruments, and relates to a noninvasive full-closed-loop artificial pancreas system, which comprises a glucose optical detection module, a signal processing analysis module and a dual-channel injection module, wherein the glucose optical detection module, the signal processing analysis module and the dual-channel injection module are sequentially connected, the glucose optical detection module is used for emitting laser towards an object to be detected to excite and generate a Raman spectrum signal, the glucose optical detection module is also used for acquiring an actual blood glucose value of the object to be detected according to the Raman spectrum signal and transmitting the actual blood glucose value to the signal processing analysis module, the signal processing analysis module is used for analyzing a blood glucose change trend in a preset time period in the future based on the actual blood glucose value so as to generate a blood glucose reference track, and the signal processing analysis module is also used for controlling two injection channels of the dual-channel injection module to be respectively opened according to the blood glucose reference track so as to inject corresponding medicines into the object to be detected. The application can realize the functions of noninvasively detecting the blood sugar level in real time and accurately and quantitatively infusing the corresponding medicaments to intelligently control the blood sugar level.

title_en: Reflective film
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a reflective film. The reflective film (100) of the present invention comprises a base film (10), a metal reflective layer (20), and a cured resin layer (50) in that order in the thickness direction of the reflective film. The arithmetic mean height Sa of the outer surface (51) of the cured resin layer (50) on the side opposite to the metal reflection layer (20) is 0.17 [ mu ] m or more and 0.30 [ mu ] m or less.

title_en: Brillouin semiconductor laser
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of lasers, in particular to a Brillouin semiconductor laser, which comprises a gain chip, a Bragg grating, a micro-ring resonator, a beam splitter and a beam splitter, wherein the beam splitter is positioned between the micro-ring resonator and the Bragg grating, the gain chip is used for generating spontaneous radiation light, the Bragg grating and a high reflection film form a resonant cavity, the spontaneous radiation light is processed by the resonant cavity to form pumping light, the pumping light is injected into the micro-ring resonator through a second end of the Bragg grating, stimulated Brillouin scattering effect is generated by the micro-ring resonator, stokes light is generated, the micro-ring resonator performs mode selection amplification on the Stokes light, ultra-narrow line width Brillouin laser is output from a first end of the micro-ring resonator, and the beam splitter outputs the ultra-narrow line width Brillouin laser according to a preset proportion. The invention is at least beneficial to improving the integration level and the compactness of the Brillouin semiconductor laser while ensuring the better performance of the Brillouin semiconductor laser.

title_en: Heat dissipation module and laser
abstract_en: The invention provides a heat dissipation module and a laser, and relates to the technical field of heat dissipation modules and lasers, wherein the heat dissipation module comprises a main body, and the main body comprises a bottom surface and a top surface which are arranged at intervals up and down; the main body is provided with a first end, a second end and a third end and a fourth end which are arranged along a first direction and along a second direction, the top surface comprises a first surface and a second surface which are obliquely arranged relative to the bottom surface along the direction from the first end to the second end, the distance between the first surface and the bottom surface is gradually reduced, the distance between the second surface and the bottom surface is gradually increased, the first surface and the second surface respectively define a first part and a second part with the bottom surface, the first part is provided with a first liquid inlet branch and a first liquid outlet branch, the second part is provided with a total liquid outlet pipeline, the first liquid outlet branch is communicated with the total liquid outlet pipeline through the first part and the second part, the first liquid outlet branch comprises a first transverse flow passage section extending along the first direction, and the length of the first transverse flow passage section in the second direction from the first end to the second end is gradually increased.

title_en: Large-target-surface large-aperture short-wave infrared lens
abstract_en: The invention discloses a large-target-surface large-aperture short-wave infrared lens, and relates to the technical field of optical lenses. Compared with the traditional lens, the invention has obvious technical advantages. In the aperture range, the conventional lens is usually F1.8-22, and the lens realizes the adjustment of the larger aperture range of F1.4-16, so that brighter and clearer images can be obtained in a low-illumination environment. In the aspect of temperature adaptability, the MTF of the traditional lens is reduced by more than 30% at-30 ℃, the MTF of the lens is reduced by less than 10%, the temperature drift amount is less than 5 mu m/DEG C (the traditional lens is about 10 mu m/DEG C), and good imaging quality can still be maintained in a wide-temperature environment. On the light transmittance, the transmittance of the lens in the wave band of 1.5 mu m is more than or equal to 95 percent, which is obviously higher than that of the traditional lens by 85-90 percent, and more light information can be captured. In the aspect of distortion control, the full-view field distortion of the lens is less than 1.5%, compared with 2% -3% of the traditional lens, the imaging geometric distortion is smaller, and the image is more real.

title_en: Photoelectric-driven chiral liquid crystal display device and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a chiral liquid crystal display device based on photoelectric driving, and belongs to the technical field of liquid crystal display. The optical structure layer is formed by a transparent substrate and a grating pattern layer, the chiral liquid crystal functional layer is formed by two layers of ITO conductive glass, a cholesteric liquid crystal layer and a photo-alignment layer, the cholesteric liquid crystal layer is filled between the two layers of ITO conductive glass, and the photo-alignment layer is positioned on the surface of the ITO conductive glass. The optical structure layer and the chiral liquid crystal functional layer are matched with each other, and meanwhile, the adjustable driving power supply is matched to carry out voltage adjustment on the chiral liquid crystal functional layer, so that the power consumption of the liquid crystal display device is reduced, and the continuous change of the color of the liquid crystal display device is realized. The invention also discloses a preparation method of the chiral liquid crystal display device based on the photoelectric driving.

title_en: Optical imaging device
abstract_en: An optical imaging device comprises a plurality of optical lenses. The optical lenses are arranged along an optical axis to capture images in an image capturing direction and image the images on an imaging plane. The plurality of optical lenses are divided into at least one fixed lens group and at least one movable lens group, wherein the fixed lens group is fixedly arranged, and the movable lens group is used for displacing relative to the fixed lens group so as to zoom the optical lenses.

title_en: Anti-interference six-axis parallel positioning platform and pretightening force optimization method thereof
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of optical precise imaging, and particularly discloses an anti-interference six-axis parallel positioning platform and a pretightening force optimization method thereof. The anti-interference six-axis parallel positioning platform comprises a base, a position adjusting mechanism, a pretightening force adjusting mechanism and a top cover, wherein the position adjusting mechanism adopts two adjustable sliding blocks in a guide rail groove to support a metal ball fixed under the top cover, 6-axis adjustment of the top cover can be realized through 3 position adjusting mechanisms which are uniformly arranged, the position adjusting mechanism is compact in structure and small in overall structure size, accurate pose adjustment of an optical system can be conveniently realized in a limited space, and positioning precision of the platform is improved. In addition, the length of the spring in the pretightening force adjusting mechanism is changed through rotation, so that the spring applies pretightening force to the top cover, and the pretightening force adjusting mechanism is simple and small in structure and can be well embedded into the position adjusting mechanism to realize accurate adjustment of pretightening force.

title_en: Image capturing optical system, image capturing device and electronic device
abstract_en: An image capturing optical system, an image capturing device and an electronic device, wherein the image capturing optical system comprises an image capturing optical lens corresponding to a first mode and a second mode respectively. The image capturing optical lens sequentially comprises an object side lens group and a common lens group from an object side to an image side, wherein the object side lens group is a first mode object side lens group or a second mode object side lens group, and the common lens group sequentially comprises a middle lens group and a last lens group. The image capturing optical lens is sequentially provided with a first mode object side lens group and a common lens group along the light path line direction when in a first mode, and is sequentially provided with a second mode object side lens group and a common lens group along the light path line direction when in a second mode. When certain conditions are satisfied, it is helpful to improve the degree of freedom in use of the module space.

title_en: Developing box
abstract_en: The present application relates to a developing cartridge that can be mounted in an image forming apparatus having a door cover together with a drum assembly having a photosensitive drum. The developing cartridge includes a cartridge body for accommodating a developer, the cartridge body being provided with a first end and a second end opposite to each other in a first direction and a third end and a fourth end opposite to each other in a second direction, a developing roller rotatable about an axis extending in the first direction, a second chip including a second electric contact surface capable of being electrically connected to a second electric contact pin of the image forming apparatus, the second electric contact surface being provided at the first end, and a force receiving portion for engaging a door cover to attach the developing roller to the photosensitive drum. In the present application, the developing cartridge has an advantage of simple structure.

title_en: Display device and electronic device including the same
abstract_en: A display device and an electronic device including the same are provided. The display device includes a display panel and a window disposed on the display panel, wherein the display panel includes a circuit element layer, a display element layer disposed on the circuit element layer and including a light emitting element, an encapsulation layer disposed on the display element layer, a first retarder disposed on the encapsulation layer, a first inorganic layer disposed on the first retarder, and a second inorganic layer disposed on the first inorganic layer, wherein a ratio of oxygen atoms contained in the first inorganic layer is smaller than a ratio of oxygen atoms contained in the second inorganic layer.

title_en: Electronic paper display device, manufacturing method thereof and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides an electronic paper display device, a manufacturing method thereof and electronic equipment, and relates to the field of display. The electronic paper display device comprises a first substrate, a second substrate, a flowing medium layer and a supporting structure, wherein the first substrate comprises a first electrode layer, the second substrate comprises a second electrode layer which is arranged opposite to the first electrode layer, the second electrode layer comprises a plurality of pixel units, the flowing medium layer is arranged between the first substrate and the second substrate, the flowing medium layer comprises filling liquid and conductive particles, the supporting structure comprises a blocking wall and a supporting column, the blocking wall and the supporting column are connected with the first electrode layer and the second electrode layer, the blocking wall and the supporting column are arranged on the periphery of the pixel units, and the first electrode layer and/or the second electrode layer are/is provided with limiting parts which are used for being in limiting fit with the supporting column. The electronic paper display device can effectively support the top substrate, improve the box thickness stability and further improve the viewing experience of the electronic paper display device.

title_en: Laser with adjustable repetition frequency and high beam quality
abstract_en: The invention relates to a laser with adjustable repetition frequency and high beam quality, which comprises a seed source, a pulse selector, a pulse energy editing module, a uniform temperature field module, a three-stage serial laser amplifier, a thermal lens cooperative control unit and a laser lens cooperative control unit, wherein the seed source outputs picosecond signal laser with the repetition frequency of 20-100MHz, the pulse selector is connected with the seed source and is configured to respond to a target repetition frequency value set by a user, perform conventional pulse selection when the repetition frequency is more than 50kHz, enable a Burst Mode editing function when the repetition frequency is less than or equal to 50kHz, generate a pulse train envelope containing 2-10 sub pulses, the three-stage serial laser amplifier is used for amplifying power of the pulses, each stage comprises a pumping source, a focusing lens and a laser crystal, the thermal lens cooperative control unit is used for improving the thermal lens effect of the laser crystal, the laser lens cooperative control unit comprises a pumping light spot adjusting module, responds to the target repetition frequency value, automatically adjusts the distance from the focusing lens to the laser crystal, and pumping current, dynamically modulates sub pulse energy in the pulse train to enable the pulse train to be in an increasing distribution, and a uniform temperature field module comprises an array and a temperature sensor array arranged around the laser crystal, and a uniform temperature field module is used for automatically matching the set by the temperature field of the laser crystal according to the target repetition frequency value, and the target repetition frequency value can provide a laser lens with stable laser quality, and the laser quality can be adjusted in a laser thermal lens and stable.

title_en: Rayleigh scattering enhancement optical fiber and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a novel Rayleigh scattering reinforced optical fiber and a manufacturing method thereof, wherein the novel optical fiber comprises a polymer fiber core doped with nano materials and an external quartz cladding wrapped on the fiber core, and is a novel polymer/quartz composite optical fiber. The manufacturing method comprises the steps of injecting polymer/nano composite materials in the hollow optical fiber, curing the core material and aging the optical fiber. The composite material optical fiber can be applied to a Rayleigh scattering type distributed temperature optical fiber system, nano materials are doped in a fiber core, a stronger backward Rayleigh scattering signal is provided, the sensing spatial resolution and the measuring precision of the system can be effectively improved, the fiber core background material is a polymer material, and compared with a quartz material, the fiber core background material has a higher thermo-optical coefficient, and the sensitivity of optical fiber temperature sensing can be greatly improved.

title_en: Lens group, optical module and optical equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a lens group, an optical module and optical equipment. The lens group includes first lens and second lens along the optical axis in proper order, and first lens and second lens are the prism, and wherein, first lens satisfies:  the second lens satisfies:   The first lens and the second lens are glued together, so that the lens group can realize off-axis transmission of light rays while focusing the light rays.

title_en: Single-line type optical waveguide ultra-low expansion microcrystalline glass femtosecond laser direct writing method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for preparing a single-line type optical waveguide in ultra-low expansion glass ceramics by directly using a femtosecond laser direct writing technology without a mask, belonging to the field of optical waveguide preparation and integrated photonics. The preparation method comprises the steps of (1) selecting commercial ultra-low expansion glass ceramics as a matrix material, carrying out ultrasonic cleaning pretreatment on a sample, (2) focusing a laser beam at a position about 150 mu m below the surface of the sample by using a femtosecond laser with a pulse width of 300fs under the optimized laser parameters to carry out direct writing to form a waveguide structure, and (3) carrying out polishing treatment on the directly written sample, characterizing the structure, morphology, transmittance and chemical corrosion resistance of the sample, and simultaneously testing the transmission characteristics such as insertion loss of the waveguide. Compared with the existing technology of directly writing the waveguide in a glass system such as silicon dioxide, the method provided by the invention has the advantages that the optical waveguide is prepared in the ultra-low expansion glass ceramics through femtosecond laser direct writing for the first time, and the method has important research significance for improving the light path stability and the precision of optical devices.

title_en: Vertical exposure machine and control method
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of exposure machines, and provides a control method of an exposure machine of a vertical exposure machine, which comprises a supporting seat; the exposure mechanism is arranged on the supporting seat and used for exposing the workpiece, the frame part is erected on the supporting seat and comprises an installation part and a traction assembly, the installation part is used for installing the workpiece, and the traction assembly is used for flattening the workpiece on the installation part. The vertical exposure machine enables the workpiece to be erected after being installed, the traction assembly can flatten the workpiece along the gravity direction, the workpiece is easier to flatten, and the flatness of the workpiece is improved.

title_en: Optical axis center correction method of photoelectric pod imaging module
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optical axis center correction method of an imaging module of a photoelectric pod, which comprises the steps of selecting an imaging module as a standard module in an imaging module, carrying out hardware correction on the optical axis center of the standard module, respectively imaging a correction chart on each imaging module in the imaging module to obtain imaging images of each imaging module, calculating image parameters of each imaging module according to the imaging images of each imaging module, respectively calculating relative parameters of other imaging modules according to the image parameters of the standard module and the image parameters of other imaging modules, and respectively calibrating the optical axis centers of other imaging modules according to the relative parameters of other imaging modules. The invention has the advantages of simple correction process, low cost of correction equipment, high efficiency, rapid mass production and batch production, and wide application prospect.

title_en: Micro-nano photon structure with large preparation tolerance and customizable sensitivity, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a micro-nano photon structure with large preparation tolerance and customizable sensitivity, and a preparation method and application thereof. The micro-nano photon structure comprises a substrate layer, a high reflection layer, a polymer structure and a metal layer, wherein the substrate layer is adhered to the high reflection layer through an adhesion layer, the polymer structure is positioned on the upper surface of the high reflection layer, and the metal layer is deposited on the upper surface of the polymer structure. The spectrum of the micro-nano photon structure provided by the invention has a remarkable characteristic peak at a specific wavelength, the characteristic peak is formed by wood abnormality and Fabry-Perot cavity mode coupling, the working wavelength of the coupling mode and the sensing sensitivity are hardly changed within a certain parameter tolerance range, and the micro-nano photon structure provided by the invention has extremely high preparation tolerance and customizable sensitivity when being applied to an optical sensor.

title_en: Photoelectric separation safety illumination line and illumination system
