abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mechanical engineering, in particular to a photoelectric separation safety illumination line and an illumination system, which comprise a power supply luminous host, at least one passive luminous terminal, a light energy transmission device and a light energy transmission device, wherein the power supply luminous host is used for being connected with an external power supply and generating illumination light, the at least one passive luminous terminal is arranged in an application area, the input end of the light energy transmission device is optically connected with the light output end of the power supply luminous host, the output end of the light energy transmission device is optically connected with the passive luminous terminal and is used for transmitting the illumination light from the power supply luminous host to the passive luminous terminal, the passive luminous terminal is not electrically connected with the power supply luminous host and the external power supply, the power supply luminous host converts electric energy into light energy, and then the light energy is transmitted to the passive luminous terminal through an optical fiber, so that electric shock and electric leakage risks are completely eliminated, the optical fiber transmission is free of current, no heat source is generated, fire or explosion caused by overheating is avoided, and the light energy transmission device is suitable for inflammable and explosive environments.

title_en: Display panel and display device
abstract_en: The application discloses a display panel and a display device, wherein the display panel comprises a plurality of terminals, a grid driving circuit unit, a control signal line and a first public voltage line, wherein the terminals are arranged in a terminal area at intervals, the grid driving circuit unit is arranged in a non-display area, the control signal line is arranged in the non-display area and is electrically connected with a terminal corresponding to the grid driving circuit unit, the first public voltage line is arranged in the non-display area, and the first public voltage line is led into the terminal area to carry out line walking by utilizing the space in the terminal area, so that the first public voltage line can avoid the control signal line and avoid the cross short circuit of the first public voltage line and the control signal line, and therefore, a conductive layer is not required to be additionally arranged in a flexible circuit board for layering the first public voltage line and the control signal line, and the production cost can be reduced.

title_en: Integrated module for NV color center quantum sensing microscope and quantum sensing microscope system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses an integrated module and a quantum sensing microscope system for an NV color center quantum sensing microscope, wherein the integrated module comprises a laser module, a light path module, a radiator, a magnet displacement table and an electronic module, wherein the laser module is used for generating laser, the light path module is connected with the laser module and used for receiving the laser and light detection magnetic resonance signals generated by the NV color center, the radiator comprises a diamond NV color center and used for generating light detection magnetic resonance signals, the magnet displacement table is used for applying a magnetic field to the diamond NV color center in the radiator, and the electronic module is used for controlling the laser module and the radiator and receiving the light detection magnetic resonance signals generated by the diamond NV color center. The common optical microscope is upgraded into a quantum microscope by utilizing the integrated module, so that various quantum experiments of various diamond NV color centers, such as a Laratio oscillation experiment, a T  1  time experiment, a lambda-up experiment, a Haen echo experiment and the like, are realized, and the application process of the NV quantum sensing technology in various fields of materials, biomedicine and the like can be promoted.

title_en: Low-loss multilayer coupling ridge-shaped optical waveguide laser chip and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a low-loss multilayer coupling ridge optical waveguide laser chip and a preparation method, and relates to the technical field of laser chips, the low-loss multilayer coupling ridge optical waveguide laser chip comprises a layered graded interface ridge core, a distributed coupling annular cavity, a lateral compensation ridge shell and an integrated feedback ridge terminal, wherein the bottom layer of the layered graded interface ridge core is a silicon-based ridge layer, the thickness is 180-220 nm, a graded index transition region is arranged at the top of the layered graded interface ridge core, the thickness is 40-60 nm, a gain material layer is arranged at the top of the graded index transition region, the thickness is 280-320 nm, and the mode field smooth matching is realized between the silicon-based ridge layer and the gain material layer through the graded index transition region arranged in the layered graded interface ridge core, so that the interface reflection loss is reduced to below 0.08 dB, and the problems of mode mismatch and higher reflection loss (generally above 0.5-1 dB) caused by unmatched refractive indexes in the prior art are effectively solved.

title_en: Large-size low-voltage quick response intelligent window based on ruthenium and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ruthenium-based large-size low-voltage fast-response intelligent window and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of intelligent windows. The invention adopts the ruthenium-modified indium tin oxide electrode as the working electrode, the inert metal ruthenium plating layer has electrochemical catalysis effect, can be used as a seed layer for reversible metal electrodeposition, and can quickly nucleate and grow metal grains on the surface during the electrochemical deposition (coloring), thereby leading the device to have higher deposition speed and shortening the reaction time. Meanwhile, as Ru effectively reduces the deposition potential on the surface of the electrode, even if only lower voltage is applied, a metal coating with small grain size, large quantity and even and compact distribution can be obtained on the surface of the electrode, and the transmissivity of the device is effectively reduced, so that the voltage drop limit is overcome, the device can have higher extinction coefficient by the metal coating with lower thickness, and the problems of uneven coloring and slow response time of the traditional large-size RME intelligent window are solved.

title_en: Polarizing plate switching device capable of finely adjusting angle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a polaroid switching device capable of finely adjusting angles, which solves the problem that the existing angle modulation method can only realize imaging or complex operation of specific polarization angles, and particularly comprises a support provided with a light passing hole, a rotating shaft vertically arranged on the side wall of the support, a target wheel rotatably sleeved on the rotating shaft, four polarization components and a normal lens which are distributed on the target wheel around the circumference and have the same size, and a first driving component and a second driving component which are arranged on the support; the end face of the target wheel is parallel to the side wall of the support, a gap is arranged between the end face of the target wheel and the support, the acting end of the first driving component is connected with the four polarization components respectively and used for driving the four polarization components to rotate simultaneously, and the acting end of the second driving component is connected with the target wheel and used for driving the target wheel to rotate so as to switch any polarization component or normal lens to correspond to the passing light hole.

title_en: Stray light removal system for beam splitting diffractive optical element
abstract_en: The invention discloses a stray light removing system of a diffraction optical element for beam splitting, which comprises a laser light source, a diffraction optical element for beam splitting, a first focusing element, a diaphragm, a second focusing element and a third focusing element which are sequentially arranged along the direction of a laser light path, wherein the diffraction optical element is used for dividing incident light into a plurality of sub-beams, a plurality of light passing holes for removing stray light are formed on the diaphragm corresponding to the plurality of sub-beams, the focal lengths of the first focusing element and the second focusing element are the same and are F, the distances between the diaphragm and the first focusing element are the same, the distances between the diaphragm and the second focusing element are L, and L is equal to F. The invention effectively removes stray light of each sub-beam by forming the 4f filtering system, has simple integral structure and convenient operation under the condition of not changing the transmission characteristic of light, ensures the yield of the processed product and saves the cost.

title_en: Light source for machine vision
abstract_en: The invention provides a light source for machine vision, which is of a cylindrical structure and comprises a shell, a bottom plate, a first light source component, a second light source component, a third light source component and a cover plate, wherein the bottom plate, the first light source component, the second light source component, the third light source component and the cover plate are arranged in the shell in sequence along the direction from the bottom end to the top end, a shooting hole is formed in the middle of the bottom plate, the first light source component comprises a mounting frame, a first light plate and a spectroscope, the mounting frame is of a cuboid structure, the first light plate is of a flat plate structure, the plane of the first light plate is parallel to the axis of the shell and is detachably fixed on an inner side wall of the mounting frame, the spectroscope is detachably arranged in the mounting frame and is of a square plate structure, the spectroscope gradually approaches to the first light plate along the direction approaching to the bottom end, the included angle between the first light plate and the spectroscope is 45 degrees, the plane of the first light plate is intersected with the plane of the spectroscope and the intersection line is perpendicular to the axis of the shell, and the whole shooting hole is covered when the spectroscope is observed along the direction from the top end to the bottom end.

title_en: System and method for preparing imprinting template, template and stepping nano imprinting method
abstract_en: An imprinting template preparation system and method, a template and a stepping nano imprinting method belong to the technical field of imprinting template preparation. The imprinting template preparation system comprises a projection structure, an imaging adjustment structure, a template substrate, a splicing control unit and a control unit, wherein the projection structure comprises a spatial light modulator and is used for generating a pattern to be projected, the imaging adjustment structure comprises an optical element group and is used for shrinking the pattern to be projected, an incident plane of the imaging adjustment structure is located at a focusing plane of the projection structure, the template substrate is arranged on a workpiece table and is located at the focusing plane of the imaging adjustment structure, and the splicing control unit is used for controlling the projection structure and the imaging adjustment structure to synchronously move horizontally relative to the template substrate. The application designs an imprinting template preparation system and method based on a spatial light modulator, which can realize rapid low-cost manufacture of a large-format nano imprinting template.

title_en: Intelligent glasses for ultrasonic guided kidney puncture, control method thereof and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses intelligent glasses for ultrasonic guided renal puncture, a control method thereof and a storage medium thereof, and relates to the technical field of medical appliances. The intelligent glasses comprise a wearing part and a display part connected with the wearing part, wherein the wearing part comprises a glasses frame, a processor and a wireless communication module, the processor and the wireless communication module are arranged in the glasses frame, the display part comprises a touch display screen, the processor is used for receiving real-time area images acquired by an ultrasonic probe through the wireless communication module, and matching the real-time area images with a pre-constructed dynamic color three-dimensional model displayed on the touch display screen until the ultrasonic probe is positioned at a target puncture position, and the dynamic color three-dimensional model is obtained based on kidney medical images of patients with different visual angles. The intelligent glasses can ensure that the puncture needle accurately reaches the target position, obviously reduce the risk of false puncture, effectively reduce surgical complications and improve the safety and success rate.

title_en: Device and method for detecting apparent defects of diversion tunnel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a method for detecting apparent defects of a diversion tunnel, which relate to the technical field of tunnel defect detection and comprise the following steps: the walking vehicle body comprises a detection bracket, wherein the detection bracket comprises a vertical frame component and a cross rod, wherein the height of the vertical frame component is adjustable; the vertical frame component is arranged on the walking vehicle body; the cross rod can be axially arranged along the tunnel, one end of the cross rod is connected to the upper end of the vertical frame assembly, and the other end of the cross rod extends to the outer side of the walking vehicle body; the electric control holder is arranged at the other end of the cross rod; the rotary driving end of the electric control tripod head is connected with the camera, the main optical axis of a lens of the camera is vertical to the axial direction of the cross rod, and the electric control tripod head can drive the camera to rotate around the axial lead of the cross rod so as to carry out 360-degree full-coverage detection on apparent defects of the inner peripheral wall of the tunnel; the annular lamp group is arranged above the vertical frame component, and the axial direction of the annular lamp group is parallel to the axial direction of the cross rod so as to perform uniform light filling. The invention can efficiently, orderly and stably carry out 360-degree full-coverage automatic acquisition on the high-definition images of the apparent defects of the tunnels, and has the advantages of simple structure, low cost and high detection efficiency.

title_en: Variable-focus super-structured lens compression ratio-based optical beam shrinking system and construction method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optical beam shrinking system with adjustable compression ratio based on a zooming super-structure lens and a construction method thereof, wherein the optical beam shrinking system with adjustable compression ratio based on the zooming super-structure lens comprises a first zooming super-structure lens and a second zooming super-structure lens which are sequentially arranged along a light path, and the first zooming super-structure lens and the second zooming super-structure lens are arranged in series and the space between the first zooming super-structure lens and the second zooming super-structure lens meets the afocal characteristic; the focal length of the first zooming super-structure lens and the focal length of the second zooming super-structure lens are changed by regulating and controlling the voltages applied to the first zooming super-structure lens and the second zooming super-structure lens, so that the dynamic regulation and control of the light beam compression ratio are realized. The invention breaks through the limitation of fixed compression ratio of the traditional OBRS and meets the application requirement of real-time and flexible regulation and control of the width of the emergent beam. The phase regulation and control of 0-2 pi can be realized by changing the refractive index of the nano column only by applying voltage, the electric control mode does not need mechanical displacement, the response speed is high, the system structure is fixed, the volume is small, and the regulation and control efficiency and the system integration level are obviously improved.

title_en: Lens, camera module and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a lens, a camera module and electronic equipment. The lens comprises a first lens group, a prism group and a zoom lens group. The zoom lens group is positioned between the first prism and the second prism and comprises a second lens group and a third lens group with different focal lengths. Each of the second lens group and the third lens group is movable relative to the prism group in a direction perpendicular to an optical axis thereof to move one of the lens groups onto an optical path formed by the first lens group and the prism group, and the other lens group is moved out of the optical path. When the second lens group is positioned on the light path, the lens has a first focal length, and when the third lens group is positioned on the light path, the lens has a second focal length. The light is reflected at least twice in the first prism and at least twice in the second prism. The lens provided by the application can realize the switching of focal length and reduce the size of the lens through multiple reflections. The lens is miniaturized and simultaneously double long focuses are realized.

title_en: Augmented reality interaction and virtual agent visualization method
abstract_en: The invention relates to an augmented reality interaction and virtual agent visualization method, which defines a plurality of data types by providing a multi-device data transmission architecture based on a user datagram protocol. Through the connection local area network, a plurality of Microsoft Hololens augmented reality glasses can carry out the transmission of required type data, realizes the synchronization of cooperation information. Through providing the interaction menu interface facing to the single user, the user can interact with the virtual object by using gestures, and share the content to be shared to other users, so that the user space and the sharing space are separated, and the cooperation level is improved. Finally, through two visualized user virtual agents, namely a sight line agent and a hand agent, the sight line and gesture actions of other users can be tracked in real time and visualized, and the multi-user interaction problem under the shielding condition in a complex environment is solved.

title_en: LED display screen based on nano coating technology and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of LED display screens, and particularly relates to an LED display screen based on a nano coating technology and a preparation method thereof. Compared with the prior art, the LED display screen based on the nano coating technology provided by the invention has the advantages that the transmittance and the reflectivity of the LED display screen in different wavebands are adjusted through the alternate coating of the low refractive index coating and the high refractive index coating, so that the spectrum selectivity regulation and control are realized, meanwhile, the reflection effect is increased through the surface prismatic micro-array structure, the radiation surface area is improved, the heat dissipation performance and the optical requirements are balanced, the cooling of an outdoor LED display product is realized, and the LED display screen is particularly suitable for the heat dissipation of the LED screen in outdoor strong solar radiation areas.

title_en: Multi-mode image scanning microscopic imaging system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multimode image scanning microscopic imaging system and a multimode image scanning microscopic imaging method, and belongs to the technical field of optical microscopic imaging. The system is sequentially provided with a light source, a beam expander, a mask turntable, an illumination focusing lens, a scanning galvanometer, a scanning lens, an illumination tube lens, a dichroic mirror, an objective lens, an imaging tube lens and a camera along a light path, and is uniformly controlled by a control acquisition card. The working process comprises the steps that collimated light emitted by a light source is subjected to beam expansion and then modulated by a mask plate to form a specific illumination beam, the beam is deflected by a scanning vibrating mirror, is finally focused to a sample by an objective lens to scan, and is excited to form an imaging beam, and the imaging beam is transmitted by a dichroic mirror after returning and is focused to a camera to be collected by the imaging tube mirror. The mask turntable is controlled to switch the illumination mode, and the scanning galvanometer is synchronously driven to perform periodic scanning, so that the system can rapidly realize in-situ observation of various imaging modes, and the flexibility and the efficiency of imaging are obviously improved.

title_en: Display device and display method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of display and discloses a display device and a display method thereof, wherein the display device comprises a display panel and a liquid crystal prism assembly positioned at one side of a light emitting surface of the display panel; the liquid crystal prism component comprises a first substrate, a second substrate and a liquid crystal layer arranged between the first substrate and the second substrate, wherein a plurality of spacers are arranged between the first substrate and the second substrate, orthographic projection of the spacers on a plane where the display panel is located overlaps with a first area of the display panel, and gray scale values of sub-pixels in the first area are adjusted in the first state. The display method comprises the steps of identifying and determining the position of a spacer, defining a first area according to the position of the spacer, enabling orthographic projection of the first area on the plane of the display panel to overlap orthographic projection of the spacer on the plane of the display panel, and adjusting gray scale values of sub-pixels in the first area in a first state. The method and the device can reduce the visibility of the spacer in the display panel in the first state, and guarantee the 3D display effect.

title_en: Resin, photosensitive composition, cured product, display device, electronic component, and method for producing cured product
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide a photosensitive composition that can suppress residues after development, and to provide a photosensitive composition that can obtain a cured product that is included in a display device that has excellent light-emitting characteristics that can achieve low-voltage driving when a desired current density is obtained and that has excellent reliability of a light-emitting element, and to provide a photosensitive composition that can obtain a cured product that is included in an electronic component that has excellent migration resistance. The present invention provides a resin which is one or more selected from the group consisting of polyimide, polyimide precursor, polybenzoxazole precursor, polyamideimide precursor, and copolymers thereof, and which has (DA 1) a first amine residue, namely an amine residue having a phenolic hydroxyl group, wherein the (DA 1) first amine residue has a cyclic structure containing at least two phenolic hydroxyl groups, and further has a specific structure connecting these, and which satisfies the condition that the content of fluorine element in the structure of the resin is 10,000 mass ppm or less.

title_en: Image pickup apparatus
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides an image pickup apparatus capable of reducing an optical axis shift of an optical lens with respect to an image pickup element caused by thermal deformation of a member. The imaging device is provided with a lens holder (110), a substrate (120), and a joint (130). The lens holder (110) has a lens barrel (111) that holds the optical lens (101), and a holder base (112) that supports the lens barrel (111), is joined to the substrate (120) via a joint (130), and surrounds the image pickup element (102). The substrate (120) has a narrow-width portion (121) that surrounds a part of the outer periphery of the image pickup element (102) on the inside of the holder base (112), and a wide-width portion (122) that is wider than the narrow-width portion (121) and surrounds the remaining part of the outer periphery of the image pickup element (102) on the inside of the holder base (112). The imaging device is provided with a displacement adjustment unit (160), and the displacement adjustment unit (160) enables relative displacement of the lens barrel (111) and the substrate (120) in the direction of moving the imaging element from the narrow-width part (121) to the wide-width part (122) to be easier than relative displacement of the lens barrel (111) and the substrate (120) in the direction of moving the imaging element from the wide-width part (122) to the narrow-width part (121).

title_en: Automatic liquid crystal screen performance checking equipment and method based on cooperative robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of industrial automatic detection equipment, in particular to liquid crystal screen performance automatic detection equipment and method based on a cooperative robot, comprising a robot, a robot controller, a detection probe, a force sensing module, a position sensing module and a control system; the control system dynamically adjusts the motion of the mechanical arm through the robot controller according to the actual position of the screen fed back by the position sensing module and the contact force between the probe and the screen detected by the force sensing module, so that the detection probe is accurately attached to the surface of the screen with a preset constant force. According to the invention, through multi-sensor fusion and closed-loop control, automatic adaptation to the positions and heights of different types of screens is realized, manual adjustment is not needed during shutdown, the production time is obviously shortened, and the detection efficiency, the precision and the flexibility level of a production line are effectively improved.

title_en: Device and method for improving stability of vacuum compressed state light field generator
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a method for improving the stability of a vacuum compressed state light field generator, which relate to the technical field of quantum optics, wherein the cavity length of the vacuum compressed state light field generator is locked by reflecting pump light in a closed loop; the method comprises the steps of carrying out coupling interference after carrying out resonance on seed light and a vacuum compressed state light field generator, carrying out coupling interference after matching the power and the light spot mode of the seed light and the local light, adjusting the phase to constructive interference, collecting interference signals and frequency spectrums of the interference signals by utilizing a Fourier real-time analysis oscilloscope to identify additional noise, and finally, carrying out noise suppression by combining pressure optimization of an air floatation platform and parameter adjustment of a negative feedback servo control system, thereby improving the stability of the vacuum compressed state light field generator. The invention can effectively improve the stability of the vacuum compressed state light field generator and can be widely popularized and applied to experimental systems for preparing the vacuum compressed state light field.

title_en: Holding member, optical connector, and optical connection assembly
abstract_en: The holding member (30) is provided with a front end surface (31) which faces an inner wall surface (201) of the interior of the optical connector ferrule in a first direction, a rear end surface (32) which is arranged on the side opposite to the front end surface in the first direction, a bottom surface (34) which is in contact with a bottom wall surface (202) of the interior of the optical connector ferrule in a second direction, a plurality of holding parts (37) which extend in the first direction between the front end surface and the rear end surface and are arranged in the third direction, the plurality of holding parts (37) being capable of holding the plurality of optical fibers one by one, and a stopper part (40) which is formed on the surface of the holding member, and which, when the tip end parts (14) of the plurality of optical fibers (10) extending from the holding member are inserted into the plurality of insertion holes (24) in the first direction, the distance between the front end surface and the inner wall surface in the first direction is maintained within a predetermined range.

title_en: Preparation method of MEMS (micro-electromechanical systems) micromirror driven by vertical comb teeth
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a MEMS micro-mirror driven by vertical comb teeth, which comprises the steps of forming a through alignment mark and a pre-etched comb tooth structure on a device layer by using a first composite mask, forming the through alignment mark and the pre-etched comb tooth structure on the back of the device layer by using a composite mask process on a first substrate, aligning a self-aligned composite mask of the comb tooth structure with the back pre-etched comb tooth structure by the through alignment mark after bonding the first substrate and a second substrate, realizing high-precision alignment of the comb tooth structure, avoiding accumulated errors and improving the yield of device preparation.

title_en: Textured end face mechanical sealing device of quantum dot array and preparation process thereof
abstract_en: A mechanical seal device for a textured end face of a quantum dot array and a preparation process thereof are provided, the mechanical seal device comprises a moving ring and a static ring, the distance between the sealing end faces of the moving ring and the static ring is 0.3nm-1nm, at least one of the moving ring and the static ring is a textured seal ring structure, the textured seal ring structure comprises a substrate layer, the sealing end face of the substrate layer is distributed with a quantum dot array formed by a plurality of quantum dot textures distributed in a hexagonal close-packed mode, the quantum dot textures are in a truncated cone shape, the quantum dot array is covered with a hydrogen termination layer, the surface of the hydrogen termination layer is distributed with top electrodes which are flush with the quantum dot textures up and down, and when the distance between the surfaces of the moving ring and the static ring is smaller than 1nm, electron clouds at the tops of the quantum dot textures can generate additional repulsive force through quantum tunneling effect, so that the purposes of effectively reducing, preventing or inhibiting molecular-level adhesion of the sealing end face are achieved, and ultra-low friction and ultra-high pressure resistance can be realized under a state of keeping zero contact.

title_en: Outdoor reinforced display screen with anti-dazzle and high contrast and optical self-adaptive system
abstract_en: The application discloses an anti-dazzle high-contrast outdoor reinforced display screen and an optical self-adaptive system, which relate to the technical field of optical control and comprise a light screening module, a light detection module and a light detection module, wherein the light screening module is used for acquiring the current screen orientation and determining effective ambient light data falling into a screen display area; the device comprises a polarization self-adjusting module, a visual effect adjusting module, an ambient light prediction module and a picture preloading module, wherein the polarization self-adjusting module is used for adding an electric control liquid crystal polarization modulation layer into a light path of a display screen to obtain main interference glare and adjusting the electric control liquid crystal polarization modulation layer, the visual effect adjusting module is used for extracting ambient light color temperature of effective ambient light data and carrying out self-adaptive adjustment on screen temperature and screen contrast of a reinforced display screen, the ambient light prediction module is used for constructing an ambient light prediction model and obtaining predicted ambient light data, and the picture preloading module is used for preloading picture content according to the predicted ambient light data. The application has the effect of improving the adaptability and the watching effect of the reinforced display screen to the outdoor environment.

title_en: Electrochromic material based on column arene and triphenylamine, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electrochromic material based on column arene and triphenylamine, and a preparation method and application thereof. Carrying out Suzuki reaction on a boric acid ester reagent of triphenylamine to obtain a triphenylamine alkynyl compound 2 with three 3, 4-ethylenedioxythiophene substitutions, then carrying out reaction on the triphenylamine alkynyl compound and NBS to obtain a bromocolumn arene polymer monomer compound 4, reacting the compound 4 with sodium nitrite and sodium azide to generate a column arene compound 5 with an azide group, and carrying out click reaction on the compound 2 and the compound 5 in the presence of cuprous to obtain a triphenylamine-based column arene electrochromic molecule TPA-Th-P5. The electrochromic material can change the color from pale yellow to pale blue under lower voltage, and can be reversibly recovered, and has the advantages of rapid response, high contrast and high reversibility. The electrochromic device manufactured by the electrochromic material has more outstanding color changing performance, larger transmissivity and longer service life.

title_en: Method, product and equipment for predicting imaging effect of mask defects on silicon wafer level
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a product and equipment for predicting imaging effect of mask defects on a silicon wafer layer. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a target mask layout, wherein the target mask layout is a layout with potential defects, generating a target aerial image of the target mask layout through an aerial image measuring system, analyzing and processing the target aerial image to obtain a target optical contour, and generating a target silicon wafer imaging contour corresponding to the target optical contour according to a pre-trained artificial intelligent prediction model. By the method, the imaging profile of the silicon wafer after the target mask layout is subjected to the patterning process can be obtained according to the target aerial image, so that the physicochemical characteristics in the patterning process are fully considered, the accurate prediction of the imaging profile of the silicon wafer is realized, the defect printability evaluation precision is greatly improved, and the requirement of an advanced process on the prediction precision is met.

title_en: High-stability single-mode semiconductor laser based on dynamic wave front shaping and control system
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-stability single-mode semiconductor laser based on dynamic wave-front shaping and a control system, which relate to the technical field of semiconductor lasers and comprise a semiconductor laser gain module, a dynamic wave-front shaping module, a single-mode screening module and a laser output module which are optically coupled in sequence, wherein the semiconductor laser gain module is composed of a quantum well structure gain chip, a distributed feedback grating and a surface plasma structure are integrated on the surface of an active area of the gain chip, and the distributed feedback grating and the surface plasma structure are combined on the surface of the active area through a surface etching process. The system can rapidly detect wave front distortion and compensate under a complex disturbance environment, and remarkably reduces response delay and manual intervention of traditional static correction.

title_en: Navigation assistance method, device, equipment and storage medium for blind people based on AI glasses
abstract_en: The application provides a blind person navigation auxiliary method, device, equipment and storage medium based on AI glasses, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a navigation path between the current position of a user and a destination; the navigation method comprises the steps of determining environment information and real-time pose of a user in a preset range of a navigation path according to image data and sensing data, generating navigation guide information according to the environment information and the real-time pose of the user, converting the navigation guide information into a spatial audio signal, and performing traveling navigation based on spatial audio prompt on the user through the spatial audio signal. According to the application, the navigation guidance information related to the real-time pose of the user is generated by integrating the visual sensing data, the pose information of the inertial sensor and the navigation path information of the AI glasses, and is converted into the spatial audio signal for navigation, so that the user can be guided to accurately judge the travelling direction through the spatial audio prompt when the user is separated from the navigation path, and the safety of the user is improved.

title_en: Preparation method of high gradient grating structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of a height gradient grating structure, which comprises the following steps of S1 preparing an optical substrate, uniformly coating photoresist on the surface of the optical substrate and forming a photoresist layer, S2 patterning and forming a plurality of step structures on the photoresist layer according to a preset grating period and height gradient, wherein two sides of each step structure are respectively arranged opposite to two adjacent gratings, S3 coating films on the surfaces of the optical substrate and the step structures according to preset grating widths and forming grating film layers, etching and removing the grating film layers on the tops, and removing the photoresist, wherein the rest grating film layers are the height gradient grating structure. The invention combines the photoresist layer pattern control with ALD film plating to obtain the grating structure with high gradient change, and has the advantages of simplifying the process flow, breaking through the limit of photoetching process and being particularly suitable for preparing the high gradient grating structure with small period and narrow line width.

title_en: Resist composition, application thereof and method for manufacturing resist pattern
abstract_en: The invention provides a resist composition, application thereof and a method for manufacturing a resist pattern, and belongs to the technical field of semiconductor photoresist. The resist composition comprises a photoacid generator, a positive photoresist resin, an aniline derivative and a solvent, wherein the photoacid generator has a structure shown in the following formula (I), R  1 、R 2  is independently selected from hydrogen, C  1 ~C 5  alkyl or C  1 ~C 5  alkoxy, and n  1  is an integer of 1-5. The aniline derivative has a structure shown in the following formula (II), R  3 、R 4 、R 5 、R 6  is independently selected from hydrogen or C  1 ~C 5  alkyl, and n  2 、n 3 、n 4 、n 5  is an integer of 1-5. The resist composition of the invention has higher photosensitivity and better edge roughness after subsequent film formation. The compound of formula (I), Formula (II).

title_en: Wavelength conversion device, projection device and manufacturing method of weight
abstract_en: A wavelength conversion device comprises a wavelength conversion module and a driving assembly, wherein the driving assembly is used for driving the wavelength conversion module to rotate by taking a central shaft as a rotating shaft, and the wavelength conversion module comprises a disc, a wavelength conversion layer and a weight piece. The center of the disk is located on the central axis and has a bearing surface perpendicular to the central axis. The wavelength conversion layer is disposed on the bearing surface of the disk. The weight is arranged on the disc and is close to the central axis relative to the wavelength conversion layer in the radial direction perpendicular to the central axis, the weight comprises a first weight element, the first weight element comprises a first light-cured material and a plurality of particles, the particles are uniformly distributed in the first light-cured material to form the first weight element, and orthographic projections of the particles on the bearing surface at least partially overlap along the direction parallel to the central axis. A projection device and a method for manufacturing the counterweight are also provided. Thereby, the weight position is adjusted more finely by using the first weight element.

title_en: Method and device for producing a functional coated plastic lens and functional coated plastic lens
abstract_en: One aspect relates to a method for producing a functionally coated plastic lens (1), in particular a plastic spectacle lens, wherein the method comprises the steps of (I) providing (S100) a plastic lens (1) comprising a substrate made of plastic glass, (II) providing (S102) a gas phase of a first precursor compound a to obtain at least one modified surface of the plastic lens, which surface has been modified by adsorption of the precursor compound a, (III) removing (S104) excess material of the precursor compound a not adsorbed on the modified surface of the plastic lens, (IV) providing (S106) a gas phase of a second precursor compound B, which reacts with the precursor compound a adsorbed on the modified surface and as reaction product forms a monolayer of a functional layer (3, 3') on the surface of the plastic lens, (V) removing (S108) the excess material of the precursor compound B not attached to the modified surface, (VI) obtaining (S110) a plastic lens (1) provided with a functional coating (2), wherein the formed functional coating (2) imparts oleophobic and/or hydrophobic properties to the plastic lens (1). Other aspects relate to production apparatus and function coated plastic lenses.

title_en: Broadband infrared refrigerating hyperspectral imaging system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of spectral imaging and discloses a broadband infrared refrigeration hyperspectral imaging system, which comprises an off-axis three-reflecting telescope, a view field separation assembly, a medium wave spectrometer, a long wave spectrometer and a cold box, wherein the view field separation assembly, the medium wave spectrometer and the long wave spectrometer are arranged in the cold box, the medium wave spectrometer and the long wave spectrometer are symmetrically arranged on two sides of the view field separation assembly, a light transmission window is arranged on the cold box, the cold box is used for providing a low-temperature environment, the off-axis three-reflecting telescope is configured to reflect view field light from an object and converge into the cold box through the light transmission window, so that the view field separation assembly separates the view field light into two separation light paths which are symmetrically arranged, and the two separation light paths respectively enter the medium wave spectrometer and the long wave spectrometer for hyperspectral imaging in the low-temperature environment. Through the symmetrical arrangement of the medium-wave spectrometer and the long-wave spectrometer in the cold box, the light paths are not interfered with each other, stray light and thermal background influence are restrained, and the imaging sensitivity and the spectrum precision of the system are improved.

title_en: Optical module and head-mounted device
abstract_en: The application discloses an optical module and a head-mounted device. The optical module comprises a first optical component, a second optical component, a rotating structure and a detection module, wherein the first optical component comprises a first optical piece and a first transmission piece connected to the first optical piece, the second optical component comprises a second optical piece and a second transmission piece connected to the second optical piece, the second optical component is arranged on one side of the first optical component at intervals along a first direction, the rotating structure can drive the first optical piece and the second optical piece to be far away from or close to each other along the first direction through the first transmission piece and the second transmission piece, and the detection module is used for detecting the positions of the first optical component and the second optical component. The optical module provided by the application can improve the convenience of use of a user.

title_en: Waterproof and anti-warping edge sealing coating and optical composite membrane thereof
abstract_en: An optical composite film coated with an anti-water vapor warping-resistant edge sealing coating, wherein the sealing coating adhesive mainly comprises a sealing adhesive matrix, a compatilizer, an auxiliary agent, a catalyst, an anti-sagging agent, a cross-linking agent and a rigid filler. By constructing a sealing coating with excellent water vapor barrier property and high rigidity at the cutting edge, the warping problem caused by water vapor permeation and stress unbalance is cooperatively solved.

title_en: Infrared focusing equipment based on vision
abstract_en: The invention discloses an infrared focusing device based on vision, relates to the technical field of sensing, and aims to solve the problems of poor consistency, low efficiency and limited precision of the existing manual focusing device. The equipment comprises a frame and a bedplate, wherein a product positioning visual assembly, an infrared visual imaging device, a grabbing mechanism, a jig platform driving mechanism and two groups of laser welding devices are arranged on the bedplate. The infrared visual imaging device is laterally arranged on a first support vertical plate, an infrared camera, a lens, a half-mirror and a light source part of the infrared visual imaging device can be finely adjusted in multiple directions, imaging definition is controlled by adjusting the lens, the grabbing mechanism comprises a voice coil motor lifting mechanism, a clamping part and a power-off prevention protection structure, a dust collection device is further arranged, and a jig platform driving mechanism consists of an XY axis mechanism, an R axis mechanism and a jig platform module and is used for realizing multi-station movement of the product. According to the invention, through focusing and welding, the adjusting precision is improved, the welding efficiency is improved, and the safety is high.

title_en: Glue joint assembly device and method for back mosaic optical lens group
abstract_en: The invention relates to a gluing assembly device and a gluing assembly method for a back mosaic optical lens group, which solve the technical problems that the prior art depends on personal experience, has low precision and poor consistency, or has complex process and high cost, and is easy to cause phenomena of glue overflow, glue shortage and solidification stress. The method comprises the steps of S1, fixing a reflector, S2, performing opposite grinding of a connecting sleeve and a supporting taper hole of the reflector, S3, trial assembling a reflector supporting plate and a flexible supporting block, performing primary appearance detection, S4, fixedly connecting the flexible supporting block with a corresponding connecting sleeve, S5, performing primary grinding of the flexible supporting block, S6, trial assembling the reflector supporting plate, performing secondary appearance detection, S7, performing glue joint fixing of the reflector and the connecting sleeve, S8, performing secondary grinding of the flexible supporting block, S9, mounting the reflector supporting plate on the flexible supporting block, S10, performing two-stage finish machining on the surface shape of the reflector, S11, performing film plating treatment on the reflector, and S12, warehousing for later use.

title_en: Plasma photoetching imaging method, device and computer readable medium
abstract_en: The application provides a plasma photoetching imaging method, a device and a computer readable medium, which comprise the steps of obtaining the axial direction of an imaging structure of plasma photoetching imaging, wherein the imaging structure comprises a plurality of mask patterns which are changed in a one-dimensional periodicity, and light irradiates the plurality of mask patterns which are changed in the one-dimensional periodicity in a target direction which is in a preset off-axis angle with the axial direction, so as to obtain the plasma photoetching imaging corresponding to the plurality of mask patterns which are changed in the one-dimensional periodicity. That is, the present application can affect the diffraction order of the light by irradiating the mask pattern in the target direction of the preset off-axis angle, thereby improving the transmission efficiency of the light in the forbidden period range, thereby improving the contrast of the light intensity of the mask image in the forbidden period range during imaging, and finally realizing the exposure imaging of the mask pattern in the forbidden period range.

title_en: Display apparatus
abstract_en: The invention relates to a display device (1) having two modes of operation. The invention also relates to a vehicle having such a display device (1). The display device (1) has a display panel (2), a first backlight (5), a second backlight (6), and an element (7) arranged between the first backlight (5) and the second backlight (6) for limiting the angular distribution of the light emitted by the second backlight (6). The display panel (2) has a first polarizing filter (3) arranged on the front side from the viewpoint of an observer and a second polarizing filter (4) arranged on the rear side from the viewpoint of the observer. The second polarizing filter (4) has an anisotropic scattering member (40).

title_en: Spacer column supporting substrate, stereoscopic imaging device and liquid crystal stereoscopic display
abstract_en: The spacer column supporting substrate comprises a first substrate and a plurality of spacer columns positioned on one side of the first substrate, wherein the plurality of spacer columns are distributed randomly on the basis of rules. The stereoscopic imaging device adopting the spacing column supporting substrate enables the display effect of the liquid crystal display to be uniform.

title_en: Periscope for pipeline detection
abstract_en: The invention provides a pipeline detection periscope, which comprises a support, a telescopic rod, an adjusting rod and a detection mechanism, wherein the telescopic rod is arranged in the support, one end of the adjusting rod is arranged on the telescopic rod by adopting a connecting piece, the other end of the adjusting rod is arranged on one side of the detection mechanism by adopting the connecting piece, a structure with four corners supported is formed by the composition of the support, the other end of the telescopic rod is provided with a handle, the telescopic rod is driven by the handle to be beneficial to forming a telescopic movable structure by the telescopic rod, the adjusting rod is beneficial to forming a swinging structure by the telescopic rod through the telescopic movement of the telescopic rod, the detection mechanism comprises a detection module, a base and a sliding seat, the detection module is arranged at the top of the base, one side of the detection module is provided with a photographic module, the base is arranged in the middle of the sliding seat, and one end of the sliding seat is provided with a plurality of arm rods, and pulleys are arranged at one ends of the arm rods.

title_en: Optical film, polaroid and display device
abstract_en: The application discloses an optical film, a polaroid and a display device; the application can effectively improve rainbow patterns of the display device when the optical film is used in the polaroid and the display device by balancing the tensile strength of the optical film in different directions, and further can lead the mechanical properties of the optical film in different directions to be more balanced, reduce the problems of warping, deformation, inaccurate alignment and the like caused by uneven stress and improve the yield and the reliability of products.

title_en: Single-pixel imaging device modulated by transmission type rotating wheel and imaging method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of optical imaging and computational imaging, in particular to a single-pixel imaging device modulated by a transmission type rotating wheel, which comprises an imaging lens, a transmission type rotating wheel, a signal receiving device and a signal processing unit, wherein at least one bar code mask with a marker bit is arranged on the transmission type rotating wheel, each bar code consists of coding units which are arranged according to a preset sequence, each coding unit is a light transmission area or a shading area which is used for carrying out spatial modulation on light waves, the light transmitted into a target scene of the modulation window is periodically modulated by the bar code mask through a modulation window on the transmission type rotating wheel, the signal receiving device receives the light modulated by the transmission type rotating wheel and transmits an adjusted light signal to the signal processing unit, and the signal processing unit adjusts the transmission type rotating wheel by utilizing the received light signal, the bar code time sequence and the rotating wheel speed and then carries out image reconstruction.

title_en: Laser body three-dimensional display device, control method and control device thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of three-dimensional imaging, and provides laser three-dimensional display equipment, a control method and a control device thereof. The laser body three-dimensional display device comprises a laser emitting device, a laser adjusting device, a medium display device and a control device, wherein the laser emitting device is used for emitting laser, the laser output parameter of the laser emitting device can be adjusted, the laser adjusting device is arranged in a light emitting light path and used for receiving the laser and adjusting the output position of the laser, the medium display device is located in a focusing area and used for generating visible light response when being irradiated by the laser, the control device is respectively and electrically connected with the laser emitting device and the laser adjusting device and used for analyzing an image to be displayed, and the laser output parameter of the laser emitting device and the beam space parameter of the laser adjusting device are adjusted according to the analysis result of the image to be displayed. The invention realizes the construction of high-fidelity monochromatic or color visual images in the medium directly under the condition of no moving screen by the cooperative regulation and control of the laser emitting device and the laser adjusting device by the control device, and has simple structure and good color controllability.

title_en: Lithium niobate waveguide-based integrated perovskite photoelectric detector array and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of an integrated perovskite photoelectric detector array based on a thin film lithium niobate waveguide, which is characterized in that lithium niobate on an insulator is used as an integrated platform, a low-loss optical waveguide is used as an optical transmission carrier, the high light absorption characteristic and the low dark current advantage of a perovskite material are combined, a high-performance on-chip photoelectric detection function is realized, and the detector unit consists of a lithium niobate ridge waveguide, a symmetrical electrode, a perovskite light absorption layer and a PMMA hydrophobic protective layer and realizes array integration through a micro-nano process. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages of high responsivity and good performance consistency under the condition of weak light, simple process, low cost, easy large-scale preparation and the like, provides an effective technical path for the photoelectric detection array on the high-performance large-scale die, and has wide application prospect in the fields of optical communication, sensing, integrated photoelectric chips and the like.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted screen integrated assembly processing method based on capacitive touch control
abstract_en: The invention discloses a capacitive touch-based vehicle-mounted screen integrated assembly processing method, which belongs to the field of vehicle-mounted display and touch device manufacturing and comprises the following specific steps of S1, substrate pretreatment, S2, touch electrode layer preparation, S3, insulating layer coating, S4, optical adjustment layer forming, S5, display function layer integrated forming, S6, electromagnetic shielding layer integration, S7, packaging and lead connection, S8, segmentation function detection, S9, reliability strengthening treatment, S10, final quality control and packaging. The invention adopts an integrated structure without separate optical glue for protecting the cover plate and attaching the touch module, obviously reduces the material cost, greatly reduces the interface reflectivity between the touch electrode and the display layer through gradient refractive index design, obviously improves the overall light transmittance and the display contrast, and can also support the manufacture of vehicle-mounted touch screens with different sizes and different forms.

title_en: Light-splitting prism structure, endoscope and endoscope system
abstract_en: The application provides a beam-splitting prism structure, an endoscope and an endoscope system, wherein the beam-splitting prism structure comprises a first beam-splitting prism and a prism group which are sequentially arranged along an optical axis, a first optical filter is arranged on a first light-emitting surface of the first beam-splitting prism, a second light-entering surface of a second beam-splitting prism in the prism group is parallel to and spaced from the first light-splitting surface of the first beam-splitting prism, a second optical filter is arranged on a second light-emitting surface of the prism group, and at least one of the first optical filter and the second optical filter is intersected with but not perpendicular to an optical axis of a corresponding target reflection optical axis. When this beam splitting prism is used for imaging the module to carry out formation of image, so set up, change the propagation direction of parasitic light, reduced the region outside the imaging plane of parasitic light irradiation to imaging module, reduced the probability that parasitic light and ghost image appear on corresponding imaging plane to indirectly improved imaging module's imaging quality.

title_en: Medium-length focus zoom lens and camera module
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application relates to the technical field of optical imaging, and provides a mid-tele zoom lens and a camera module, wherein the mid-tele zoom lens comprises a first lens group, a second lens group, a third lens group, a fourth lens group, a fifth lens group and a sixth lens group which are arranged from an object side to an image side, the first lens group, the third lens group, the fourth lens group, the fifth lens group and the sixth lens group all have positive focal power, the second lens group has positive focal power, the third lens group has negative focal power, at least two of the second lens group, the third lens group, the fourth lens group and the fifth lens group can move relative to the sixth lens group along the optical axis of the mid-tele zoom lens so as to enable the mid-tele zoom lens to zoom between a wide angle end and a tele end, part of lenses in the first lens can move relative to the sixth lens group along the optical axis of the mid-tele zoom lens so as to focus, and the mid-tele zoom lens satisfies the relation: 。

title_en: Dimming glass system and switching method
abstract_en: The application provides a dimming glass system and a switching method, and belongs to the technical field of vehicle dimming glass. The system comprises light-adjusting glass, an environment detection device and a controller, wherein the working state of the light-adjusting glass at least comprises a high-transmittance state and a shielding state, the environment detection device comprises a temperature detection device and/or a pressure detection device, the controller responds to a light-transmittance switching instruction to control the light-adjusting glass to switch the working state, and the voltage applied to the light-adjusting glass is adjusted according to the detected temperature and/or the detected stress so as to stabilize the corresponding working state of the light-adjusting glass after switching. According to the application, through self-adaptive voltage regulation, the influence of temperature on the activity of liquid crystal and/or the interference of pressure on the shielding effect are effectively compensated, and the performance stability and the user experience of the dimming glass under different environmental conditions are obviously improved.

title_en: Optical structure, anti-reflection device and method for manufacturing such an optical structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to an optical structure comprising a linear polarizing layer (6), a twisted liquid crystal retarder layer (4) arranged at a polarizer interface (8). A first orientation direction in which the liquid crystal within the liquid crystal retarder layer (4) is twisted immediately adjacent to the polarizer interface (8) is set by the polarization direction of the polarizing layer (6). Furthermore, the optical structure comprises an alignment layer (3) defining an alignment direction and an alignment interface (7) between the alignment layer (3) and the polarizing layer (6) or the twisted liquid crystal retarder layer (4). Furthermore, the invention relates to an anti-reflective device comprising such an optical structure and to a method of manufacturing such an optical structure.

title_en: Automatic coupling device and method for silicon optical wafer passive device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic coupling device and method for a silicon optical wafer passive device, comprising a wafer chuck, a camera, a first six-axis displacement module and a second six-axis displacement module, wherein the first six-axis displacement module comprises a first Y-axis linear module, a first X-axis linear module and a first Z-axis linear module, a first θz sliding table is arranged at the moving end of the first Z-axis linear module, a first θy sliding table is arranged at the moving end of the first θz sliding table, a first θx sliding table is arranged at the moving end of the first θy sliding table, a first nano displacement table is arranged at the moving end of the first θx sliding table, a first pressure sensor is arranged at the moving end of the first nano displacement table, a first capacitor sensor is arranged at the sensing end of the first pressure sensor, a first clamp for clamping a first optical fiber is arranged at the sensing end of the first capacitor sensor, and the second six-axis displacement module and the first six-axis displacement module are identical in structure and symmetrically arranged. The invention has the advantages of high coupling speed, high testing efficiency, low application cost and capability of accurately controlling the distance between the optical fiber and the wafer.

title_en: Reworking liquid for CF color film process
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reworking liquid used in a CF color film process, which consists of inorganic alkali, organic amine, a high boiling point solvent, an aprotic polar solvent, a fatty alcohol solvent containing phenyl, a surfactant and high purity water. The reworking liquid can effectively remove the bad photoresist on the glass substrate in the CF process, has the advantages of high solubility, low volatility, low crystallization, no back adhesion of the photoresist, good liquid medicine stability, long service life and the like, is low in foam, easy to rinse and free of environmental pollution.

title_en: High-resolution visible light super-refractive lens, camera module and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to a high-resolution visible light super-refractive lens, an imaging module and electronic equipment, which belong to the field of optical lenses and comprise a first lens, a second lens, a third lens and a fourth lens which are sequentially arranged from an object plane to an image plane along an optical axis, wherein at least one lens is a super-surface lens, and the rest lenses are non-super-surface lenses. The application adopts the technical scheme of folding and supermixing, and the design of adding a superlens into three aspheric surfaces realizes the high-resolution imaging of visible light broadband, compresses the total optical length and realizes the miniaturization and light weight design.

title_en: Electromagnetic wave oscillator capable of realizing dynamic tapering adjustment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electromagnetic undulator capable of realizing dynamic tapering adjustment, which comprises an upper iron core array and a lower iron core array which are symmetrically arranged relative to the center of an electron beam vacuum chamber, wherein an exciting coil system comprises a plurality of exciting coils with the same specification, which are respectively wound on a main period iron core and an end iron core to generate a magnetic field perpendicular to the movement direction of the electron beam, an independent power supply control system comprises a plurality of power supply modules corresponding to a main period and at least two independent end power supply modules, the independent power supply control system is connected with the exciting coil system, exciting coil groups of each period are independently powered by two independent power supply modules, the current flow directions of a group of exciting coils which are opposite up and down are the same, and the current flow directions of adjacent exciting coils are opposite. The invention can alleviate serious electron orbit distortion caused by severe change of longitudinal magnetic field gradient in a strong tapering mode, thereby providing an ideal technical scheme for improving the free electron laser efficiency, the inverse free electron laser accelerator and other requirements.

title_en: Frame assembly and display device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of liquid crystal modules, and discloses a frame assembly and a display device, wherein the frame assembly comprises a back plate and a middle frame, the back frame of the back plate is provided with at least one first clamping part, the middle frame of the middle frame is provided with a first matching part corresponding to the first clamping part, the first clamping part is used for being clamped with the first matching part along a first direction and a second direction so as to fix the backboard on the middle frame, wherein the first direction is the length direction of the frame assembly, and the second direction is the thickness direction of the frame assembly. According to the invention, the first clamping part and the first matching part are arranged to realize clamping type fixed connection, no additional fastener is needed, the assembly structure is simplified, the assembly efficiency is improved, the production cost is reduced, meanwhile, the first clamping part and the first matching part realize bidirectional limiting, the movement and the offset of the backboard relative to the centering frame are effectively limited, the connection is firmer and more reliable, the loosening, abnormal sound and falling risks are avoided, the structural universality is strong, and the backboard relative to the centering frame can also be adapted to various display shells and frame structures.

title_en: Reflective photomask, reflective photomask blank, and method of manufacturing reflective photomask
abstract_en: The invention provides a reflective photomask comprising a substrate, a multilayer reflective film, a protective film, and a pattern of light absorbing films. The protective film is composed of a plurality of layers including one a layer containing rhodium and having a thickness of 0.5 to 2 nm, one or more B layers containing niobium, not containing rhodium, having a niobium content of not less than 10 at% and having a thickness of 0.5 nm to 2 nm, and one or more C layers containing ruthenium, not containing rhodium and niobium and having a thickness of 0.5 nm to 2 nm, the a layer being in contact with the pattern of the light absorbing film, and one layer of the C layers being in contact with the multilayer reflective film.

title_en: Photosensitive nanocluster glue and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of micro-nano processing and functional nano materials, and particularly relates to photosensitive nano cluster glue, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the photosensitive nano cluster glue consists of II-VI semiconductor clusters with intrinsic photosensitivity, the semiconductor clusters can realize nano patterning processing under illumination conditions, the preparation method of the semiconductor clusters adopts a non-additive direct synthesis route, photosensitivity is directly obtained through a photosensitive ligand in the cluster synthesis process without subsequent photosensitization modification, the photosensitive nano cluster glue has the advantages of precise structure, definite components, intrinsic photosensitivity and highly consistent photoresponse behavior, no side reaction and no release of gas in the exposure process, can form micro-nano patterns with high fidelity and high resolution, can be used as permanent component parts of devices to directly participate in functional integration after patterning, and has wide application prospect in the fields of micro-nano processing, semiconductor devices, optoelectronic devices, flexible electronics, advanced packaging and the like.

title_en: Cross phase modulation effect-based full-locking optical frequency comb generation system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a full-locking optical frequency comb generating system and method, in particular to a full-locking optical frequency comb generating system and method based on a cross phase modulation effect. In order to solve the inherent contradiction that the traditional on-chip full-locking microcavity optical frequency comb cannot achieve the high bandwidth and the low repetition frequency, the full-locking optical frequency comb generating system based on the cross phase modulation effect comprises a reference pumping light source unit, an auxiliary light source unit, a micro-ring resonant cavity unit for generating a broadband soliton optical frequency comb through nonlinear four-wave mixing, and a self-reference locking unit for realizing the self-reference locking of the broadband soliton optical frequency comb. Meanwhile, the full-locking optical frequency comb generating method based on the cross phase modulation effect transfers the comb teeth of the broadband soliton optical frequency comb to a high-frequency band by utilizing a second harmonic or third harmonic effect in an amplifying or auxiliary laser replacing mode, and feeds back the comb teeth to a reference pumping light source unit to realize self-reference locking.

title_en: Design method and application of all-solid-state photonic band gap fiber for inhibiting stimulated Brillouin scattering
abstract_en: The invention provides a design method and application of an all-solid-state photonic band gap fiber for inhibiting stimulated Brillouin scattering, which comprise the steps of determining all-solid-state photonic band gap fiber to be optimally designed and initial structural parameters, constructing an objective function taking a minimized acousto-optic overlapping coefficient as an optimization target, determining microstructure parameters to be optimized, and obtaining a design scheme of the all-solid-state photonic band gap fiber for inhibiting stimulated Brillouin scattering by adjusting the microstructure parameters to be optimized of the all-solid-state photonic band gap fiber on the premise that other structural parameters of the all-solid-state photonic band gap fiber remain unchanged, searching and outputting the microstructure parameters for globally minimizing the acousto-optic overlapping coefficient. According to the invention, the microstructure is actively regulated and controlled to remodel the sound field distribution, so that the coupling efficiency between a light field and the sound field is greatly reduced, the effective inhibition of stimulated Brillouin scattering in the all-solid-state photonic band gap fiber is realized, and the method is suitable for the fields of high-power fiber lasers, fiber communication and the like.

title_en: Electroabsorption modulated laser and method of forming
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for forming a modulated laser, which comprises the steps of forming a dielectric layer on the surface of a substrate, forming a first groove in the dielectric layer and the substrate, wherein the first groove comprises a laser region, a modulation region and a buffer region, sequentially forming an N++ germanium-silicon layer and an N++ germanium-silicon layer in the first groove, wherein the surface of the N+ germanium-silicon layer of the modulation region is lower than the surface of the N+ germanium-silicon layer of the laser region, the N+ germanium-silicon layer of the buffer region is in a slope shape, forming a plurality of gratings in the N+ germanium-silicon layer of the laser region, forming a quantum well in the grating and the surface of the N+ germanium-silicon layer, wherein in each group of combinations, the germanium-silicon material layer is stacked on the surface of the germanium-silicon material layer, and the P++ germanium-silicon layer are sequentially formed on the surface of the germanium-material layer, and etching the dielectric layer and the substrate with partial thickness on two sides of the first groove to form a second groove, so that the laser region is suspended.

title_en: Active optical system for an ophthalmic spectacle lens or augmented reality device and method for adjusting the optical power thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an active optical system (100) for an ophthalmic spectacle lens or an augmented reality device. According to the invention, the active optical system (100) comprises a base lens (10), a stacked structure comprising at least one active diffractive phase lens (20) having a minimum optical power variation of at least 0.25 diopter variable optical power, the stacked structure having a variable total optical power, the active diffractive phase lens exhibiting a plurality of discrete phase steps (21, 22,23, 24) in cross section, and an activation means (30) for varying the variable optical power of the at least one active diffractive phase lens, the variable total optical power of the stacked structure continuously varying over a determined optical power range or having at least three different values over a determined optical power range, the stacked structure having a total thickness of less than 1 mm.

title_en: Light emitting device and projection apparatus
abstract_en: A light emitting device and a projection apparatus are provided. The light emitting device includes a plurality of light emitting chips and a collimator lens. The collimating lens includes a first collimating portion and a second collimating portion. The first collimating part is configured to reduce a spread angle of the laser light emitted from the first collimating part in the first direction to 0 DEG, reduce a spread angle of the laser light emitted from the first collimating part in the second direction, and the spread angle of the laser light emitted from the first collimating part in the second direction is greater than 0 DEG, and the second collimating part is configured to reduce a spread angle of the laser light emitted from the second collimating part in the second direction to 0 deg.

title_en: Full-lamination touch screen assembly and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a full-lamination touch screen assembly and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of photoelectric display. The full-lamination touch screen assembly is composed of a full-lamination structure which is formed by sequentially laminating an anti-glare cover plate, an anti-fingerprint cover plate, an SCA optical adhesive layer with light transmittance and UV curing and a high color gamut display module.
