This structure is through the apron that will possess anti-dazzle, anti-fingerprint and anti-reflection function, but the light transmissivity is good and the SCA optical glue layer of UV solidification to and high colour gamut display module assembly laminating in proper order forms the full laminating assembly that does not have the air gap, has effectively promoted display brightness, color rendition degree and picture definition, weakens reflection of light and fingerprint interference, reinforcing touch sensitivity and structural stability, wholly improves visual experience and use reliability.

title_en: Floating display structure, floating display device, control method and vehicle
abstract_en: The application relates to a floating display structure, a floating display device, a floating display control method and a vehicle. The floating display structure comprises a floating imaging mechanism and a second driving mechanism. The floating imaging mechanism comprises a floating imaging lens and a first driving mechanism, the floating imaging lens is connected with the first driving mechanism, and the first driving mechanism drives the floating imaging lens to enable the floating imaging lens to project a picture to be displayed to a target imaging area. The second driving mechanism is connected with the floating imaging mechanism and is configured to drive the floating imaging mechanism to move so as to adjust the position of the target imaging area. The floating display structure, the device, the control method and the vehicle can solve the technical problems of oversized size and high manufacturing cost of the floating imaging lens when the floating display device is applied to display areas with different requirements.

title_en: System for pop-up camera
abstract_en: The invention provides a camera module for a portable electronic device. The camera module includes a movable barrel including an objective lens assembly coaxially held with one or more lens elements defined to an optical axis. The camera module includes a retractable cover window. The lens barrel is provided with an operating state and a retracted state, and the cover window has corresponding extended and retracted positions. The camera also includes an actuator provided with a drive motor, and an ejector assembly actuated by the actuator. The ejector assembly includes a drive cam configured to be rotationally driven by the actuator, a mount for receiving the lens barrel, and an image sensor for imaging a field of view of the objective lens assembly when the lens barrel is in an operative state.

title_en: Optical filter
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a filter comprising a substrate and a dielectric multilayer film laminated on at least one main surface side of the substrate as an outermost layer, wherein the substrate comprises a resin film containing a dye (I) having a maximum absorption wavelength in methylene chloride in a range of 690nm to 900nm and a resin, and the filter transmits visible light and light in at least a part of the wavelength range of 900nm to 1000nm and satisfies all specific spectral characteristics (I-1) to (I-6).

title_en: Optical connector
abstract_en: An optical connector 5 for connecting an optical integrated circuit 3 and an optical fiber 40 includes a plug member 7 attached to the optical fiber 40, a socket member 6 disposed on the optical integrated circuit 3 and connected to the plug member 7 to transmit light L between the optical integrated circuit 3 and the optical fiber 40, and a lock mechanism 9 for switching between a locked state in which the plug member 7 and the socket member 6 are kept connected and an unlocked state in which the plug member 7 and the socket member 6 are detachable.

title_en: Differential absorption laser radar system, multi-wavelength laser frequency locking circuit and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-wavelength laser frequency locking system and method for a differential absorption laser radar. The system takes a high-precision wavemeter as an absolute frequency reference, generates a feedback voltage through an LSTM frequency locking algorithm, performs closed-loop frequency stabilization on a seed laser, further controls the pulse laser frequency generated by an Optical Parametric Oscillator (OPO), ensures that the frequency deviation is kept in an index for a long time, reduces the system error, and improves the reliability of multi-gas parallel detection. The system outputs fundamental frequency pulse laser to an optical parametric oscillator unit through a pumping source, the optical parametric oscillator unit outputs first seed light and second seed light respectively, the first seed light and the second seed light are injected into a resonant cavity of the first optical parametric oscillator and a resonant cavity of the second optical parametric oscillator respectively, and a main controller is connected with a data acquisition module and is connected with the first seed light laser and the second seed light laser through a servo control module.

title_en: Fluorescent ceramic and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides fluorescent ceramic, a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of optoelectronic materials. The preparation method comprises the steps of weighing 55-75 parts of ceramic matrix precursor, 20-40 parts of fluorescent functional body and 2-6 parts of modifying auxiliary agent according to parts by weight, carrying out ultrasonic dispersion on the raw materials for 40-80 minutes, carrying out ball milling for 3-5 hours, carrying out vacuum drying at 80-120 ℃ after tape casting and molding, carrying out infrared rapid sintering in N2 and H2 atmosphere after degreasing at 500 ℃, carrying out heating rate of 80-120 ℃ per second, carrying out heat preservation at 700-850 ℃ for 5-10 seconds, carrying out cooling rate of 50-70 ℃ per second, carrying out plasma etching, and carrying out fluorosilane modification, thus obtaining the fluorescent ceramic. The invention reduces sintering temperature, inhibits fluorescent ion oxidation and thermal degradation, improves thermal conductivity, realizes wide spectrum emission of 450-1100nm, improves light extraction efficiency, and is suitable for LD and LED dual-mode driving.

title_en: Lens assembly, camera module and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of lens structure improvement, in particular to a lens assembly, a camera module and electronic equipment, wherein the lens assembly comprises a diaphragm and a lens group, and the lens group is provided with an incident end and an emergent end; the light-emitting end is used for forming a distance smaller than or equal to 3mm with the imaging sensor. The application can reduce the space occupation of the electronic equipment.

title_en: Laser scanning focusing processing head and laser scanning focusing method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of laser scanning, and discloses a laser scanning focusing processing head and a laser scanning focusing method, wherein the laser scanning focusing processing head comprises a shell, a rotating motor is arranged in the shell, the output end of the rotating motor is fixedly connected with a polarized light cylinder, the top of the shell is fixedly connected with a light inlet body, a polarized light component and a focusing component are fixedly connected in the polarized light cylinder from top to bottom, laser sequentially passes through the polarized light component and the focusing component after entering the light inlet body, a convex lens module for focusing is skillfully arranged in the polarized light cylinder driven by the rotating motor, and a laser beam always stably enters a main optical axis of the convex lens module in the rotating process of the rotating motor, so that the problems of aberration and spherical aberration caused by the incident offset of the laser beam in the traditional design are thoroughly solved, the severe requirements on the aberration parameter difference and the aperture size of the focusing lens are greatly reduced, the manufacturing cost of optical elements is reduced, and the consistency of focusing light spots is remarkably improved.

title_en: Phase generation method of Bessel beam phase plate and wavefront coding system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a phase generation method of a Bessel beam phase plate and a wavefront coding system. The wavefront coding system comprises a first lens group, a second lens group and a Bessel beam phase plate, wherein the rear focal plane of the first lens group is coplanar with the front focal plane of the second lens group, and the Bessel beam phase plate is positioned on the front focal plane of the second lens group and used for forming a Bessel beam on the rear focal plane of the second lens group by modulating the phase of light. The Bessel beam can be obtained through the Bessel beam phase plate modulation, so that the extended focal depth is obtained in the wavefront coding system, the point spread function intensity distribution in the range is almost unchanged, and the transverse translation does not exist, so that the subsequent high-quality restored image can be obtained through digital processing.

title_en: Electro-optical modulator, chip and electronic device
abstract_en: The application discloses an electro-optical modulator, a chip and electronic equipment, and relates to the field of signal processing. The electro-optic modulator comprises a first arm and a second arm, wherein the first arm and the second arm respectively comprise a first area and a second area, the first area in the first arm is the same as the first area in the second arm in waveguide length, the waveguide width is the same, the second area in the first arm is the same as the second area in the second arm in waveguide length, the waveguide width is different, the second area in the first arm is the same as the second area in the second arm in waveguide group refractive index, and the waveguide effective refractive index of the second area in the first arm is different from the waveguide effective refractive index of the second area in the second arm. In the electro-optical modulator, zero dispersion EOM is constructed, a target phase difference is preset, a bias point can generate fixed phase shift in a wide wavelength range, and no dispersion exists.

title_en: Long resin film subjected to knurling
abstract_en: The present invention addresses the problem of providing a long resin film with a controlled amount of charge, for example, a long resin film in which charge is suppressed up to the core portion during unwinding even after long-term storage in a state of being wound into a roll. This problem is solved by a long resin film which is wound into a roll, wherein the average roll hardness in the width direction (TD direction) of the surface layer of the roll is 300-750, and the absolute value of the roll hardness difference between 2 points at 60mm intervals in the width direction of the surface layer of the roll is 300 or less.

title_en: Electrochromic device and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an electrochromic device and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the steps of performing first magnetron sputtering by adopting a W  1‑x M x O 3  ceramic target to form an electrochromic layer, wherein M comprises any one or a combination of at least two of Mo, ti and Ta, the value range of x is 0.01-0.15, and performing second magnetron sputtering by adopting a Ni  1‑y A y  O ceramic target to form an ion storage layer, wherein A comprises Li and/or W, and the value range of y is 0.01-0.1. According to the invention, the ceramic target material is adopted to sputter the electrochromic layer and the ion storage layer, so that the performance, quality and repeatability of the key functional layer in the electrochromic device can be improved, and the application prospect is wide.

title_en: High-birefringence low-limiting-loss photonic crystal fiber
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a low restrictive loss photonic crystal fiber of high birefringence, fiber substrate material are silica. The cladding of the optical fiber contains five layers of air holes in a regular hexagon shape. The air holes comprise oval air holes and round air holes, and the arrangement mode is vertically and symmetrically arranged. The first four rows of the upper half part of the optical fiber are formed by staggered arrangement of large oval air holes and round air holes, two ends of a row in the center are respectively provided with two large oval air holes, two sides close to the fiber core are provided with small oval air holes, the rest are round air holes with the same size, and the distance between every two adjacent air holes is equal to the distance from the center of the small oval air holes on the left side and the right side of the fiber core to the center of the optical fiber. The utility model discloses a photonic crystal fiber has the low restrictive loss performance of high birefringence, uses the utility model discloses can reduce the coupling on two polarization directions in the signal transmission process, improve optical signal's transmission distance greatly, be applicable to long distance fiber communication system.

title_en: Adjustable converter in four holes of industrial microscope
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an industrial microscope four-hole adjustable converter, the objective converter comprises an optical hole bayonet, an adjustable optical hole step surface, a thread adjustable optical hole step surface controller, a first through hole, a second through hole, a third through hole, a fourth through hole, a connecting hole, a thread groove, a first step surface layer clamping groove, a lens mounting layer, a thread rotating layer, a first step surface layer, an optical hole is composed of three layers, a connecting hole is arranged in the center, the optical microscope is used for being connected with an optical lens mechanism, also plays a certain positioning role, is provided with four through holes, is respectively connected with four optical micro lenses, is provided with an adjustable optical hole step surface, has an inclined plane of the step surface 45 degrees with the included angle of the horizontal plane, is provided with optical glass on the step surface along the step surface, has a certain observation angle, can rotate, and can realize multi-angle and multi-directional observation. The utility model has simple structure and good observation effect; the height of the converter can be properly adjusted by adding a thread rotating layer.

title_en: Factice coating equipment for wavy metal belt
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wave strap oleamen coating equipment for the packing of optical cable strap surface oleamen includes batch oil tank, coating head and reciprocating device, and the batch oil tank is connected the coating head and is used for carrying the oleamen to the coating head, and the coating head is installed on reciprocating device and is carried out straight reciprocating motion under reciprocating device's drive and realize forming wave oleamen route on the strap surface. In this way, the utility model discloses wave strap oleamen coating equipment can form the wave cable cream coating filling route that blocks water on the strap surface, satisfies the optical cable infiltration performance requirement, avoids the extravagant material that the oleamen volume leads to greatly under the prerequisite of guaranteeing optical cable infiltration performance.

title_en: Display module assembly and virtual reality equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a display module and virtual reality equipment, the display module includes display screen, mirror holder, optics group and spring, the mirror holder has seted up the through-hole, optics group locates in the through-hole, the one end of spring with the display screen is connected, the other end with the mirror holder is connected; one end of the spring in the elastic direction is abutted with the display screen, and the other end of the spring is abutted with the mirror bracket. The utility model provides a display module assembly and virtual reality equipment aims at solving among the prior art when VR equipment does not use, and external light gets into VR equipment from optical system to assemble at the display screen, thereby lead to the display screen to generate heat the problem of damage.

title_en: Optical cable divides fine case
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an optical cable divides fine case. Optical cable divides fine case includes: the box body is provided with a wire inlet and a wire outlet; the adapter mounting rack is arranged in the box body so as to divide the space in the box body into a first area and a second area, the first area is communicated with the wire inlet, and the second area is communicated with the wire outlet; an adapter removably mounted on the adapter mount; the incoming line fixing piece is arranged in the first area and used for fixing incoming line optical cables entering the incoming line opening; the fiber melting disc is arranged in a first area, a first installation position is arranged in the first area, and a second installation position is arranged in the second area; the outlet fixing piece is used for fixing the outlet optical cable led out from the outlet, and when the outlet fixing piece is arranged on the second installation position, the adapter is arranged on the adapter fixing frame to form an adapter type optical cable fiber distribution box; when the outlet fixing piece is installed on the first installation position, the adapter is detached from the adapter fixing frame to form the fusion-type optical cable distribution box.

title_en: Exposure positioning device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to mask plate makes the field, especially, relate to an exposure positioner, including the location structure body, the location structure body has binding face and the mounting face of relative setting, the binding face is the plane and laminates mutually with the support plane, the binding face has been seted up atmospheric pressure and has been catchmented the groove, atmospheric pressure is catchmented the groove and is all communicate with each suction hole, the mounting face is seted up and is used for supplying the mounting groove that annular mask plate placed, the tank bottom in mounting groove is the plane, and be on a parallel with the binding face, the cross sectional shape in mounting groove and the outer annular phase-match of annular mask plate, a plurality of drainage holes have been seted up to the tank bottom in mounting groove, each drainage hole all communicates to atmospheric pressure and catchments the groove, each drainage hole all sets up with annular mask plate. The utility model provides an in the technique to the easy not enough problem of suction that exists of location of annular mask plate, and then avoid the mask image dislocation on the annular mask plate, improve the mask image quality on the annular mask plate.

title_en: Optical system, lens module and terminal equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses an optical system, a lens module and terminal equipment. The optical system comprises a first lens element with positive refractive power, a third lens element with negative refractive power, a second lens element with refractive power, a fourth lens element with refractive power, a fifth lens element with refractive power, a sixth lens element with refractive power, a seventh lens element with refractive power and an eighth lens element with refractive power, wherein an object-side surface of the first lens element is convex at an optical axis, an image-side surface of the third lens element is concave at the optical axis, and an image-side surface of the fourth lens element is convex at the optical axis; the optical system satisfies the following conditional expression: TTL/f is less than 1.1, TTL is the distance between the object side surface of the first lens element and the imaging surface of the optical system on the optical axis, and f is the focal length of the optical system. The optical system has the characteristics of long focal length and good imaging quality while meeting the requirement of micro design by reasonably configuring the refractive power and the surface type of the first lens to the eighth lens in the optical system and limiting the TTL/f to be less than 1.1.

title_en: Circular luminous backlight unit of stable in structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a circular luminous backlight module with stable structure, which comprises a lower shell, a lateral entrance type light source, a light guide plate, an optical diaphragm assembly and an upper frame, wherein the lower shell, the lateral entrance type light source, the light guide plate, the optical diaphragm assembly and the upper frame are of an approximate circular structure; be provided with the location breach on the inferior valve lateral wall, be provided with the reference column on the upper ledge, reference column and location breach looks adaptation, the reference column joint is in the breach of location. The utility model discloses an increase backlight unit's inferior valve and the location structure between the upper ledge, avoid taking place between inferior valve and the upper ledge to rotate relatively and influence the stability and the luminous visual effect of backlight unit structure.

title_en: Optical fiber USB high-speed transmission line
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an optical fiber USB high-speed transmission line, the utility model relates to the technical field of optical fiber transmission, the optical fiber USB high-speed transmission line, including transmission line and plug, the transmission line is pegged graft in the middle of the front surface of plug, the transmission line is inside including optical fiber, power wire, electron wire and ground wire, the optical fiber is equipped with four, and four optical fiber evenly arrange in the middle of the inside of transmission line, the round protective layer has been cup jointed to the four optical fiber outsides, and the protective layer surface has been around having been connected with a plurality of wires, it has the anticorrosive coating to fill between a plurality of wires; the beneficial effects of the utility model reside in that: through the bulk strength of wire, bullet-proof silk and weaving layer promotion transmission line, improved the compressive resistance and the anti ability of breaking of transmission line for transmission line transmission distance increases, makes the quantity of inside heart yearn reduce half than traditional transmission line through four optical fiber transmission, and the diameter of transmission line reduces, material saving, reduce cost.

title_en: Portable photographic box for photography
abstract_en: The utility model provides a photographic portable camera chamber of using belongs to photographic goods technical field. The portable camera box for photographing includes a storage part, an adjustment support part, and a moving part. The storage part comprises a box body and a box cover, the box cover is installed at the top of the box body, the adjusting and supporting part comprises a soft light box and electric push rods, the electric push rods are installed at the bottom end inside the soft light box, the soft light box is installed at the output end of the electric push rods, the moving parts are provided with four groups, and the four groups of moving parts are respectively installed at four corners of the bottom of the box body. The utility model discloses adopt multiunit gyro wheel elastic support box among the removal part, the gyro wheel that first spring made has better shock attenuation effect, and the pulling box removes not only light convenience. The first spring and the elastic connecting piece have good shock absorption and stable supporting performance, and play a good role in protecting the photographic equipment in the box body when the photographic equipment is moved and carried.

title_en: Glass slide with two-dimensional code
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a slide glass with two-dimensional code, it includes the slide glass body, the one end subsides of slide glass body contain the two-dimensional code of the relevant information of sample on the slide glass body. The utility model discloses simple structure, it is rational in infrastructure, convenient to use. The user pastes including the relevant information of sample on various forms and the slide glass through the scanning on the flitch, and work such as management clinical teaching, data arrangement and filing that can be more convenient, the practicality is strong.

title_en: Optical cable laying device for pipeline
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an optical cable laying device for pipeline, including circular seat, the opening of rectangle is seted up at the middle part of circular seat, and the middle part fixed mounting of opening inner wall has first fixed axle, and the inside interlude of open-ended is equipped with two backup pads, and the middle part of two backup pad one ends rotates with the both ends of first fixed axle respectively and alternates and be connected, and the fixed second fixed axle that is equipped with between the middle part of the two backup pad other ends, rotates on the second fixed axle and installs the leading wheel, and the fixed articulated seat of two first U types that is equipped with in top of circular seat one side, the top of two backup pads is fixed respectively and is equipped with the articulated seat of two second U types, the beneficial effects of the: the guide wheel can be used for normal guiding operation, the installation can be adjusted according to the size of the pipeline in a certain range through the four installation assemblies, the application range is enlarged, the whole device can be installed on the pipeline through the installation assemblies, and meanwhile, the installation angle can be adjusted at will.

title_en: Backlight module and display device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a backlight module and display device, wherein, backlight module includes: a back plate; the mounting frame is arranged on the mounting frame at the periphery of the back plate, and a mounting groove with an opening facing the center of the back plate is formed; one end of the limiting piece is connected to the first side wall of the mounting groove, which is far away from the back plate, and the other end of the limiting piece extends towards the direction of the back plate; the edge of the optical diaphragm is provided with a through hole, at least one part of the optical diaphragm is inserted into the mounting groove, wherein at least one part of the optical diaphragm is inserted into the mounting groove, the optical diaphragm pushes the limiting piece to enable the limiting piece to be in an elastic deformation position, and the limiting piece automatically restores to an initial position to be clamped into the through hole. The utility model provides a backlight unit's optics diaphragm installation effectiveness is high.

title_en: Portable folding projection exhibition frame
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a portable folding projection exhibition frame belongs to projection technical application field, has solved the inconvenient problem of carrying of current projection screen. The utility model discloses a support frame and projection curtain more than two or two are through hinge connection between the adjacent support frame, are equipped with the opening draw-in groove on the topside frame of support frame, and the side frame of support frame and the inboard of end frame are equipped with the slot, and the projection curtain passes through the opening draw-in groove and inserts in the support frame, and the lateral part and the bottom card of projection curtain are in the slot. The utility model is convenient to carry and use, and can be used for projection only by unfolding the folded support frame and inserting the projection screen into the support frame; the utility model discloses simple structure, the practicality is strong.

title_en: Sub-nanometer high-precision writing field splicing photoetching machine system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sub-nanometer level high precision writing field splicing photoetching machine system, which comprises a table top in a machine body, wherein an electronic microscope, at least one nanometer contact sensor and a wafer moving workbench are arranged above the table top; an electron beam lens barrel is arranged on the electron microscope; the wafer worktable is provided with a numerical control driving device for dragging the wafer worktable to move forwards and backwards and/or leftwards and rightwards and/or upwards and downwards and change angles. The splicing deviation is calculated by comparing position coordinates of the writing field before and after the exposure and the movement of the wafer garden, and high-precision photoetching splicing of wafers is carried out in a negative feedback control mode, so that the defect that the existing off-site and far-away writing field and blind-person open-loop photoetching splicing technology is poor in splicing precision due to the influence of mechanical motion precision of the wafer garden worktable and long-time drift of an electron beam is overcome, the bottleneck that the numerical control precision of the wafer garden worktable of a photoetching machine system is seriously depended on in the prior art is broken through, and the novel sub-nanometer high-precision writing field splicing photoetching machine system is provided.

title_en: Air duct structure of projector
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of projectors, in particular to an air duct structure of a projector, which comprises a shell and a projection device, wherein the projection device is arranged inside the shell; the projection device comprises a projection mechanism, a heat dissipation mechanism, a power panel and a support, wherein the heat dissipation mechanism is installed at the rear end of the projection mechanism, the power panel is arranged at the lower part of the projection mechanism, and the projection mechanism, the heat dissipation mechanism and the power panel are connected with the shell through the support. The utility model discloses a structural design in change wind channel improves radiating rate and heat dissipation comprehensiveness to improve the projecting apparatus picture quality.

title_en: A high heat dissipation LCD screen for intelligent wearing equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high heat dissipation LCD screen for intelligence wearing equipment, include: the LCD screen comprises a heat dissipation shell with a cavity structure, a protective layer arranged on the front side of the heat dissipation shell, an LCD screen body and a touch module, wherein a heat conduction plate is fixedly connected to the back side of the LCD screen body; the LCD screen body is connected with the touch module through a connecting plate, a first air duct is formed on the front side of the connecting plate, a second air duct is formed on the back side of the connecting plate, and the air ducts are communicated with the cavity structure; the touch module comprises a plurality of touch electrodes and a bridging plate, the bridging plate is connected between two adjacent touch electrodes, the upper end face of the bridging plate is bent into a plurality of first radiating fins, the lower end face of the bridging plate is bent into a plurality of second radiating fins, and the first radiating fins and the second radiating fins are alternately arranged. The utility model discloses all set up heat radiation structure on LCD screen body and touch module, have the beneficial effect that improves LCD touch-sensitive screen radiating efficiency, extension intelligence wearing equipment life.

title_en: Multimedia projector support
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multimedia projector support, including the base, remove wheel, lift hydraulic press, brace table, heat dissipation storehouse, blast pipe, fan I, fan storehouse and fan II from locking-type, remove wheel from locking-type and locate both ends department under the base, base top center department is located to the lift hydraulic press, the lift hydraulic press top is located to the brace table, the heat dissipation storehouse is lower extreme open-ended cavity structure setting, the heat dissipation storehouse is located on the brace table, the blast pipe is T type structure setting, the blast pipe is connected in heat dissipation storehouse top center department, two rotatable blast pipes and the heat dissipation storehouse junction of locating of fan, the fan storehouse is located in the brace table and is located the lift hydraulic press both sides, fan I is located in the fan storehouse. The utility model belongs to the technical field of the support, specifically indicate one kind and rise through hydraulic elevator control projecting apparatus and reduce to increase the multimedia projector support of projecting apparatus heat-sinking capability through the heat dissipation storehouse.

title_en: Bendable double-lens industrial endoscope
abstract_en: The utility model is suitable for an industry endoscope technical field provides a flexible twin-lens industry endoscope, including industry endoscope host computer, the hose, probe, the design coiler, the twin-lens module, the inside battery that is equipped with of industry endoscope host computer, industry endoscope display screen and the crooked control button of probe, the hose top is equipped with the probe, probe is including design coiler and twin-lens module, the design coiler is by the motor, first bevel gear, second bevel gear, axis of rotation and rotor plate constitute, the rotor plate is equipped with long supporting rod and short supporting rod, rotor plate bottom and axis of rotation fixed connection, the axis of rotation is connected with second bevel gear, second bevel gear and first bevel gear intermeshing, first bevel gear is connected with the motor output shaft, twin-lens module top is equipped with the forward-looking camera and one side looks sideways at and is equipped with the camera. The utility model discloses a probe bending function and twin-lens function can complement each other, have fully weakened the defect influence that single function caused to accurate detection.

title_en: Optical cable distributing box with uniform arrangement
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an evenly-arranged optical cable cross-connecting box, which comprises a base, a box and a box door, wherein the box is arranged on the base, the box is hinged with the box door through a rotating shaft, and the box also comprises a guide rail module and a plurality of wiring modules, the guide rail module is arranged at the inner side wall of the box, the wiring modules are connected with the guide rail module, the wiring modules comprise a wiring box, a slide rail and a limiting block, the guide rail module comprises a mounting plate and a plurality of chutes, and the mounting plate is evenly provided with a plurality of chutes; the uniformly-distributed optical cable hinge box can uniformly distribute the wiring modules in the case through the synergistic effect of the wiring modules and the guide rail modules, and the connection and clamping structure between the wiring modules and the guide rail modules can ensure that the wiring modules and the guide rail modules are conveniently separated and stably clamped; the distribution box can uniformly arrange the optical cable distribution fibers in the case, so that the optical fibers are prevented from being entangled, maintenance of maintenance personnel is facilitated, and the service life of the optical fibers is prolonged.

title_en: Electro-optical switch based on lithium niobate waveguide
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an electro-optical modulation, high-speed optical communication technical field, more specifically relates to an electro-optical switch based on lithium niobate waveguide. The method is used for solving the problems of large extinction ratio, low switching frequency and limited bandwidth of the traditional electro-optical switch. The electro-optical switch has the following structure from top to bottom: the array comprises a gradient array electrode, a buffer layer and a substrate, wherein the substrate is provided with an input end and an output end; the gradient array electrode is a group of isosceles triangle microstructure array electrode units with the bottom edges changing regularly; the substrate comprises a waveguide area and a non-waveguide area, the substrate is a block-shaped lithium niobate or lithium niobate thin film integrated waveguide, the lithium niobate thin film integrated waveguide is formed by combining single crystal lithium niobate and a substrate, and the proton exchange lithium niobate waveguide is wrapped by the block-shaped lithium niobate or the single crystal lithium niobate. Through the technical scheme, the technical effects of low loss, high stability, low driving voltage and large modulation bandwidth are achieved.

title_en: Automatic curtain winding device with orderly winding function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a orderly curtain automatic winding device of rolling, including rolling axle and rolling casket, rolling casket both ends are equipped with U type groove, are equipped with a set of pulley on the U type groove, rolling axle both ends are equipped with the roller bearing, and the roller bearing middle part is equipped with the recess of round and pulley adaptation, roller bearing outer wall middle part is equipped with the slot, and rolling casket both ends outside all is equipped with a rolling motor, and rolling motor output shaft has the sleeve, and the sleeve opposite side is equipped with the gear shaping with the slot adaptation. The utility model provides a pair of orderly curtain automatic winding device of rolling can realize the automatic rolling of curtain through the motor at both ends, sets up the roller bearing at the spool both ends simultaneously, with the pulley cooperation, utilizes rolling friction, alleviates spool pivoted resistance, ensures the smooth and easy of curtain rolling, and this device has still set up bellows shock attenuation foot in the bottom simultaneously, alleviates motor vibration and spool pivoted range, ensures the smooth rolling of curtain.

title_en: Polarizing plate attaching assembly
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of the LCD screen production device and specifically relates to attached subassembly of polarizing plate, including rotatable fixed roll and activity roller, the activity roller can be along the movable groove reciprocating motion near the fixed roll, fixed roll and activity roller between a plurality of pulley that is used for promoting the glass board of one side fixed, pulley one side set up the control base, the control base on the slidable set up the promotion assembly that is used for supplementing the polarizing plate, set up distance sensor between activity roller and the control base. The utility model discloses can be in the same place glass board and the high-efficient attached of polarizing plate to can improve control accuracy and improve control efficiency through the sensor. Can nimble control to the activity control range and the maximum control scope of polarizing plate, the adjustment of being convenient for through control solenoid valve and scalable subassembly the utility model discloses be suitable for different site environment.

title_en: Polarization-independent optical circulator
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a polarization-independent type optical circulator contains following component in proper order on the incident optical axis of forward light: the polarization state converter comprises a first collimator, a first polarization beam splitter, a polarization state converter, a second polarization beam splitter, a second collimator and a third collimator. The first polarization beam splitter and the second polarization beam splitter have the same structure, and the setting state of the second polarization beam splitter is the state of the first polarization beam splitter after the current setting state is rotated by 90 degrees clockwise; the polarization state converter consists of a Faraday rotator and a lambda/2 wave plate or a quartz optical rotation plate, and can enable linearly polarized light transmitted in the forward direction to rotate pi/2 clockwise and enable the polarization direction of the linearly polarized light transmitted in the reverse direction not to change. The circulator gets rid of the complex structure of the prior similar product used in polarized light processing, achieves the same effect by using less crystal optical elements, and has lower cost and smaller structure.

title_en: CFP2 optical module
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a CFP2 optical module, connect and be used for loading the shell that the optical module connects including the optical module, the optical module connects and is connected with the shell, the shell is equipped with the inner chamber, and supply the optical module to connect the installing port that penetrates the inner chamber, the installing port connects adaptability with the optical module and is connected, the roof of inner chamber is equipped with at least one first spring leaf, the diapire of inner chamber is equipped with at least one second spring leaf, the shell surface is equipped with a plurality of first heat radiation fins who is connected with first spring leaf, the shell surface still is equipped with a plurality ofly and is connected second heat radiation fins with the second spring leaf. The utility model discloses set up a plurality of first heat radiation fins, the second heat radiation fins that help the radiating on the shell to and the inner wall in shell cavity has set up first spring leaf, the second spring leaf that is used for heat conduction.

title_en: Projection device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses projection equipment, and belongs to the technical field of projection. The projection device includes: a housing portion having a first housing portion and a second housing portion; the projection host is positioned in the first accommodating part; the projection screen comprises a curling assembly, a lifting assembly and a screen, wherein the curling assembly is rotatably limited in the second accommodating part, the screen is fixedly connected with the curling assembly, the lifting assembly comprises a lifting frame and a cross beam, the first end of the lifting frame is fixed in the second accommodating part, the second end of the lifting frame is connected with the cross beam, and the screen is also fixedly connected with the cross beam; and the camera is fixed on the beam. In the embodiment of the application, the curtain sheet can be accommodated in the second accommodating part under the control of the curling assembly, so that the appearance size of the projection device is reduced, and the integration of the projection host and the curtain sheet is realized through the first accommodating part and the second accommodating part; in addition, the video image of the user is collected through the camera, so that man-machine interaction is realized, and the user viscosity of the projection equipment is improved.

title_en: Holographic stereo image display cabinet
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a digital exhibition hall technical field discloses a holographic three-dimensional image show cupboard, the on-line screen storage device comprises a base, the cabinet body, the upper cover, display screen module and transparent four-sided cone of falling, the vertical setting of the cabinet body is on the base, the upper end setting of the cabinet body is located to the upper cover lid, transparent four-sided cone of falling has four high printing opacity mirror surfaces, transparent four-sided cone's lower end wall is the planar structure setting, fixed connection can be dismantled with the upper end wall of upper cover to transparent four-sided cone's lower end wall, display screen module is provided with four, the display screen module is relative respectively inlays the front and back and the left and right sides of locating the upper end wall of upper cover, and the display screen module is located the below setting of high printing opacity. The technical scheme of the utility model can form the stereoscopic image that has true dimension space in the centre of transparent reverse tetrahedron cone, effectively improve the old science and technology of exhibition and feel, attract spectator's eyeball more easily, help promoting brand and product grade, the practicality is strong.

title_en: Sealing device for optical cable joint box and optical cable joint box
abstract_en: The sealing device comprises a sealing component and a locking mechanism, wherein the sealing component is provided with an optical cable channel for an optical cable to pass through, and comprises a first extrusion piece, an elastic piece and a second extrusion piece which are sequentially arranged along the axial direction of the optical cable channel; the locking mechanism is assembled on the sealing component and used for driving the first extrusion piece and the second extrusion piece to move relatively along the axial direction of the optical cable channel and extrude the elastic piece so that the elastic piece seals the optical cable channel. The optical cable joint box comprises a box body and a sealing device, wherein a sealing channel is formed in the box body; the seal assembly is assembled on the seal channel. This application is through applying the axial extrusion force along optical cable passageway to the elastic component to realize that the elastic component is along axial deformation, the elastic component can not destroy optical cable passageway because of producing the distortion, can not sprain the optical cable, can not lead to the optical cable passageway dislocation yet.

title_en: Display panel and display device
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of display, and provides a display panel and a display device. The display panel comprises a plurality of first pixel units and a plurality of second pixel units, the first pixel units and the second pixel units are integrally and uniformly distributed in a matrix manner, and the first pixel units and the second pixel units are sequentially and alternately arranged; the area of the first pixel unit is equal to that of the second pixel unit, and the penetration rate of the first pixel unit is greater than that of the second pixel unit. The area of this application through with first pixel cell is equal with the area setting of second pixel cell, and the transmissivity of first pixel cell is greater than the transmissivity of second pixel cell to in proper order alternate misce bene with a plurality of first pixel cells and a plurality of second pixel cell, luminance mutual compensation, thereby display panel takes place the problem of colour cast when reaching the wide visual angle of improvement.

title_en: Micro lens
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of integrated optics and specifically relates to a microlens is related to. abstract_en: The utility model relates to an goggles designs technical field, specifically is an energy constant temperature goggles, including interior installing support and ear support subassembly, one side outer wall fixedly connected with polymer graphite alkene material transparent eye-shade of interior installing support, and the biological ruddiness irradiator of one side outer wall fixedly connected with of interior installing support, one side outer wall both ends fixedly connected with hinge of interior installing support, and one of them hinge fixedly connected with polymer elastic support of hinge, the ear holds in the palm the subassembly and sets up on one side outer wall of polymer elastic support. The utility model discloses a be provided with polymer graphene materials transparent eye-shade, polymer graphene materials transparent eye-shade utilizes the far infrared effect principle of graphite alkene, makes the far infrared emergence "resonance" of eye cell and graphite alkene release, aggravates the high amplitude vibrations of intracellular material.

title_en: Hinge screw-free inner elastic glasses
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pair of hinge screwless inner elastic glasses, relating to the technical field of glasses; the rear side of the front ring is provided with a ring wire, the middle part of the ring wire is symmetrically provided with nose supports, two ends of the ring wire are connected with clamping openings, two ends of the front ring are both provided with pile heads, the pile heads are integrally connected with a hinge, the hinge is provided with a hole groove, the pile heads are provided with through holes, one end of each of the glasses legs is provided with a fixed part and a limiting part, two sides of the limiting part are fixed parts, a groove body is arranged between the limiting part and the fixed part, the fixed part and the limiting part are both bending bodies, the end part of the fixed part is provided with an inverted hook, the limiting part penetrates to the outer side from the inner side of the through hole of the pile head, the inverted hook of the fixed part is clamped in the hole groove of the hinge, and the rear side of each of the glasses leg is sleeved with a glasses leg sleeve; the utility model adopts the inverted hook design to facilitate the rapid assembly, and does not need screws, and the looseness is not easy to appear in the later period; meanwhile, the elastic force is large, the operation is convenient, the stability is high, the wearing is comfortable, and the structure is simple.

title_en: Think political affairs education with demonstration projection arrangement
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of education appliances, and a think political affairs education and use demonstration projection arrangement is disclosed, the on-line screen storage device comprises a base, the top of base articulates there is dustproof shell, the equal activity in middle part of dustproof shell both sides is provided with the fixture block, the fixture block cooperation has runs through the fixed column at dustproof shell top, the rear side left part of dustproof shell articulates there is the dodge gate. The utility model discloses a set up the dodge gate bolt, the lead screw, articulated piece and No. two articulated pieces, because the design of dodge gate bolt, can carry out better closure to the projector body, consequently can be better carry out the dust protection to the projector body, because the design of lead screw, when rotating the lead screw, the lead screw will drive articulated piece removal No. one, because articulated piece is articulated with the connecting rod No. one, the connecting rod is articulated with articulated piece No. two, the removal of articulated piece will drive articulated piece upward movement No. two, thereby realized the regulation to projection angle.

title_en: Projection device
abstract_en: The utility model mainly provides a projection device, projection device includes an at least light source and a diffraction optical waveguide, the diffraction optical waveguide includes that an at least optical waveguide substrate, a light couple into regional, a light beam expand regional, a light couple out regional and an at least light reflection region, the light couple into regional light beam expand regional light couple out regional and light reflection region set up respectively in the surface of optical waveguide substrate, wherein the light energy that the light source sent can be thrown to in the diffraction optical waveguide light couple into regional, light reflection region is set up in neighbouring light beam expands regional, just be provided with at least one angle cone prism array in the light reflection region. Projection device can improve right the utilization ratio of light source and improvement diffraction optical waveguide's work efficiency.

title_en: Projector convenient for heat dissipation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a projecting apparatus convenient to heat dissipation, include: the heat dissipation device comprises a shell, a heat dissipation device and a heat dissipation device, wherein the shell is provided with an installation cavity and a heat dissipation port communicated with the installation cavity; the radiator is arranged in the mounting cavity and close to the heat dissipation port, the radiator is provided with at least two heat dissipation fins, a heat dissipation channel is formed between every two adjacent heat dissipation fins, and the tail end of the heat dissipation channel faces towards the heat dissipation port. The air outlet grille is arranged at the heat dissipation opening and comprises at least two grille strips, the grille strips extend along the length direction of the heat dissipation fins, an air outlet channel is formed between every two adjacent grille strips, and each grille strip is opposite to each heat dissipation fin in the opening direction of the heat dissipation opening so that the air outlet channel faces the heat dissipation channel. The utility model discloses be favorable to promoting the heat-sinking capability of heat dissipation export to promote the radiating effect.

title_en: Intelligent glasses with virtual reality VR
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of display equipment and discloses intelligent glasses with virtual reality VR (virtual reality), which comprise a glasses body, wherein the lower end of the glasses body is fixedly connected with a box body, the upper side and the lower side of the interior of the box body are respectively and fixedly connected with a single chip microcomputer and a micro fan, the position, located on the upper side of the micro fan, of the left side wall of the box body is fixedly connected with an L-shaped pipe, the upper end of the L-shaped pipe penetrates through the lower end of the glasses body and is communicated with the interior of the glasses body, the lower end of the box body is provided with an air outlet, the upper end of the glasses body is fixedly connected with an air inlet pipe, the front side wall of the glasses body is fixedly inserted with a temperature sensor, and the lower end of the glasses body is fixedly connected with a storage battery. The intelligent heat dissipation control system can perform intelligent heat dissipation regulation and control according to the temperature inside the glasses, ensures that heat can be dissipated timely, and can effectively protect two lenses of the glasses when not in use, thereby preventing the lenses from being scratched.

title_en: Open red dot sighting telescope
abstract_en: The utility model provides an open red dot sighting telescope which comprises a sighting telescope body, a lens, a light source and a dust cover with a light channel, wherein the lens is arranged at the top of the sighting telescope body, the light source is arranged in the sighting telescope body, light emitted by the light source is projected to a reflecting surface of the lens, the dust cover is detachably connected to the sighting telescope body and covers the reflecting surface of the lens and the light source so as to isolate the reflecting surface of the lens and the light source from a floating object in the external environment, and a flat plate light transmitting sheet opposite to the lens is arranged at one end of the dust cover so that light of an object space sequentially passes through the light channel and the flat plate light transmitting sheet and then enters the object space. Above-mentioned red some of open sight is through removable connect in the dust cover of sight body, all keeps apart in external environment with the plane of reflection of lens and light source, prevents that the floater from falling on lens and light source, not only ensures the accuracy of aiming at of sight in the use, still is favorable to the assembly of red some sight and makes the sight can adapt to different service environments.

title_en: Auxiliary jig for installing display screen cutting splinters into clamping grooves
abstract_en: The utility model provides an auxiliary jig for installing display screen cutting splinters into a clamping groove, which is used for assisting in installing the display screen cutting splinters into the clamping groove and comprises: a base plate; the occupation blocks are vertically fixed on the bottom plate, adjacent occupation blocks are parallel and arranged at equal intervals, and two ends of all the occupation blocks in the length direction are respectively arranged in an aligned mode; the occupation block is arranged along the length direction of the occupation block and far away from two side fillets of the bottom plate. The utility model is simple and practical, has low cost and greatly improves the production efficiency.

title_en: Spatial light modulator and display device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a spatial light modulator and display equipment, wherein a part of the surface of the spatial light modulator is provided with a periodic shading area, and the periodic shading area shades a wiring area at the edge of a pixel point and/or a boundary area of an adjacent pixel point. The utility model shields un-modulated and incompletely modulated light by manufacturing the periodic light shielding area (shielding structure) on the surface of the ITO glass, the TFT glass or the wafer, thereby reducing stray light and improving the modulation quality of devices.

title_en: Ink powder box for printer
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a toner cartridge for a printer, which comprises an outer shell, wherein a fixed rod is fixed on one side of the inner wall of the outer shell, an L-shaped rod is installed on the fixed rod, a toner cartridge body is placed on the L-shaped rod, a sliding rod is connected to the bottom of the L-shaped rod, a supporting rod is fixed on the sliding rod, a telescopic seat is fixed on the other side of the inner wall of the outer shell, the top end of the telescopic seat is fixed with the supporting rod, the top of the outer shell is connected with a top cover plate through a hinge, a fixed seat is installed on the side edge of the outer shell, a rotating rod is movably installed on the fixed seat, and the toner cartridge body can be clamped through manual control through a driving bevel gear and a driven bevel gear.

title_en: Performance device of amusement equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a performance device of amusement equipment, wherein a lens is installed on the right front side of a projector body, a shell is arranged on the outer side of the projector body, mounting bars are arranged on the left side and the right side below the shell, the projector body is installed on the inner side of a protective cover through screws a, the protective cover is welded on the upper side of a bottom plate, the bottom of the protective cover is a cover bottom, a shock pad is bonded on the upper side of the cover bottom through glue, the left side of the protective cover is a left side wall, a fan is installed on the right side of the left side wall through screws b and is located on the left side of the projector body, an air inlet is formed in the side face of the left side wall, a right side wall is formed in the right side of the protective cover, an air outlet corresponding to the air inlet is formed in the side face of the right side wall, parallel sliding slide rails are welded on the upper side and the lower side of the front side of the protective cover, a sealing plate is installed between the upper parallel slide rails and the lower parallel slide rails in a sliding mode, and cleaning cloth is bonded on the rear side of the sealing plate through a double-faced adhesive layer. Through the installation of fan, be favorable to the quick heat dissipation of projecting apparatus to through the setting of cleaning cloth, usable pneumatic cylinder cleans the camera lens.

title_en: Industrial vision waterproof device and industrial vision system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an industrial vision waterproof device and an industrial vision system, wherein the industrial vision waterproof device comprises a main body structure, a glass lens and a waterproof door structure, an installation cavity for installing industrial vision is formed in the main body structure, a viewing window communicated with the installation cavity is arranged on the main body structure, the glass lens is installed on the main body structure, the glass lens is arranged in a manner of inclining to the axis of the installation cavity and covers the viewing window, the waterproof door structure is arranged on the main body structure, and the waterproof door structure is used for covering the glass lens or exposing the glass lens. So set up, because the glass lens is inclined to the axis setting of installation cavity, also make light from the incident angle that the glass lens refraction entered into the camera lens subassembly produce the change for the shot center of camera lens subassembly has been deviated to the bright spot position, thereby can avoid causing the interference to the formation of image of camera lens subassembly.

title_en: Intelligent glasses display device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent glasses display device, wherein the device comprises a display unit, an image display module and an optical lens module which are arranged in sequence from the inner side of the intelligent glasses to the outer side of the intelligent glasses and are used for displaying and inputting the image of the intelligent glasses; the optical waveguide lens is arranged on the outer side of the optical lens module and transmits the image displayed by the display unit to a target area so as to observe the image through the target area; the electrochromic layer is arranged on the outer side of the optical waveguide lens and is used for changing the transmittance of ambient light; the light sensing unit is used for detecting the light brightness and generating a sensing signal; the control unit is connected with the light sensing unit to receive the sensing signal and generate a control electric signal based on the sensing signal; and is also connected to an electro-variable layer that changes light transmittance under the control of the control signal. By adding the electrochromic layer, the light transmittance can be changed, and the clear image can be displayed on the basis of basically not increasing the thickness and the weight.

title_en: Liquid crystal panel and liquid crystal display
abstract_en: The application is applicable to the technical field of displays, and particularly relates to a liquid crystal panel and a liquid crystal display. The low-reflectivity material layer is arranged between the liquid crystal layer of the liquid crystal panel and the base layer of the array substrate, and the low-reflectivity material layer forming one layer is a film layer or at least two film layers made of different materials, so that the reflectivity of the liquid crystal panel is reduced to 4% -5%, the color difference between a display area and a frame can be reduced without using a high-haze polaroid, the frameless structure of the display is realized, and the performances of the display such as brightness, definition and the like are guaranteed.

title_en: Anti-shake's projecting apparatus curtain
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of projector screens, in particular to an anti-shaking projector screen. The technical scheme comprises the following steps: including receiving the reel, rolling up curtain and the end strip of fixed connection in the curtain bottom of being connected with the reel, the both ends downside of receiving the reel all rotates and is connected with a first bracing piece, the both ends upside of end strip all rotates and is connected with one can rotate the second bracing piece of being connected with the first bracing piece that corresponds the position, first bracing piece and second bracing piece can fold the concatenation and pile up the state for the level. According to the curtain, the curtain is conveniently pulled in the vertical direction through the design of the first supporting rod and the second supporting rod, so that the dropping stability of the curtain is improved, and the curtain is not easy to shake after being blown by wind; the first supporting rod and the second supporting rod can be stored in the containing cavity after being folded; this application can avoid first bracing piece and second bracing piece to cause the influence to the roll-up of curtain through the horizontal slidable design of slide.

title_en: Monitoring device for fire engineering
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a monitoring device for fire engineering, which comprises a fixed plate, wherein a lifting device is arranged on the left side of the fixed plate, a fire monitoring device is arranged on one side, away from the fixed plate, of the lifting device, the lifting device comprises a sliding frame fixed on the left side of the fixed plate, a sliding block is connected to the inside of the sliding frame in a sliding mode, and a driving assembly is installed on the lifting device. This monitoring device that fire engineering used, through setting up elevating gear, when needs maintain fire control monitoring device, servo motor can operate, can adjust fire control monitoring device's high position, in order to satisfy the user demand that monitoring device is convenient for maintain, the flexible push rod of function, can make monitoring head and reserve light carry out angle modulation, in order to increase monitoring device's monitoring range, and after on-the-spot lamps and lanterns damage, under reserve energy storage battery power supply effect, reserve light can carry out the light source supply, make monitoring device can continue normal monitoring.

title_en: Invisible optical cable
abstract_en: The application discloses stealthy optical cable, including optical fiber unit, restrictive coating, first wing and second wing, the optical fiber unit be cladded in within the restrictive coating, first wing with the second wing is located outside the restrictive coating, first wing with the second wing is used for bonding with the installation basis, the optical fiber unit the restrictive coating first wing and the second wing is the transparency. By adopting the invisible optical cable, the first wing and the second wing are bonded with the installation foundation, so that the invisible optical cable is installed on the installation foundation without damaging the original surface of the installation foundation; the first wing and the second wing can increase the connection area with the installation foundation, so that the connection is firm; when wiring is needed, the first wing and the second wing are aligned and bonded with the installation foundation, the step of installing the line card is omitted, and the operation is simple.

title_en: Digital telescope
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a digital telescope, which relates to the technical field of digital equipment and comprises a telescope body, wherein one end of the telescope body is connected with a lens, the outer wall of the lens is fixedly provided with a protective cover, the outer wall of the protective cover is fixedly provided with a clamp spring, the bottom end of the clamp spring is fixedly provided with a first connecting rod, and the top end of the clamp spring is connected with a second connecting rod. The protective cover is sleeved on the outer wall of the lens, the turntable is rotated to drive the first connecting rod and the second connecting rod to rotate towards the outer sides of the upper end and the lower end of the protective cover, the gap between the protective cover and the lens is enlarged, the protective cover is detached from the outer side of the lens, the protective cover is sleeved on the outer wall of the lens again after use, after the turntable is loosened, the upper end and the lower end of the protective cover are driven to rotate towards the lens by elasticity generated after the clamp spring is stretched, and the protective cover is fixed on the outer wall of the lens, so that the problem that the lens is easily damaged due to collision because no protective measures are taken during transportation of the digital telescope is solved.

title_en: Turnover detection device for liquid crystal screen
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a turnover detection device for a liquid crystal display, and relates to the technical field of liquid crystal display detection. The utility model comprises a detection table, a mounting frame, a fixing frame and a detection frame, wherein a mounting sleeve is arranged in the mounting frame, a mounting column is arranged in the mounting sleeve, a telescopic rod is arranged in the mounting column, a rotating handle is arranged on one side surface of the fixing frame, a placing groove is arranged on the upper surface of the fixing frame, a mounting screw sleeve is arranged on one side surface of the fixing frame, a fixing screw rod is arranged in the mounting screw sleeve, the fixing screw rod is connected with a connecting sleeve, the connecting sleeve is connected with a first fixing plate, a spring is arranged on one surface of the first fixing plate, and the spring is connected with a second fixing plate. According to the utility model, the fixing screw rod is arranged, the liquid crystal screen is placed in the fixing frame, the fixing screw rod is rotated, the second fixing plate can be driven to move left and right when the fixing screw rod rotates, the fixing device can be adjusted and fixed according to the size of the liquid crystal screen, the fixing device does not need to be frequently replaced, and the operation is convenient.

title_en: LCM structure for preventing LCD corner breakage
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an LCM structure for preventing LCD corner breakage, which comprises: the left side of a first LCD polaroid of the LCM structure body is fixedly arranged with an LCD single-layer area, the right side of the first LCD polaroid is fixedly arranged with a backlight, the upper left side of the LCD single-layer area is fixedly arranged with an LCD plate, and a second LCD polaroid is fixedly arranged on the outer side of the LCD plate. This prevent broken LCM structure in LCD angle places the protection pad in the inside clearance that forms between LCD single-layer region and backlight bottom, and the setting of protection pad can support the work to the clearance that forms between LCD single-layer region and the backlight, and the protection pad is soft silica gel, and when making LCD single-layer region warp, the setting of protection pad can be effectively cushioned, can effectually avoid the both corners department on LCD single-layer region to take place to break.

title_en: Metal laser reflector, laser module and demarcation device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a metal laser speculum, laser module and demarcation appearance, metal laser speculum include the mirror body, the mirror body is including being the conical reflection conical surface that coniform set up the central axis that uses the mirror body on the conical reflection surface is equipped with a plurality of planes of reflection as centre of a circle circumference array, the contained angle is 45-50 between the central axis of plane of reflection and the mirror body, through setting up plane of reflection and the conical surface of reflection, when laser beam shines on the mirror body, the light through the refraction of the conical surface forms the reference line, and the light through the refraction forms the reference point, under the additional action of reference point, can conveniently fix a position the reference line, and then measure when making things convenient for the later stage to use.

title_en: Elevator advertisement projection arrangement
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of advertisement propagation devices, in particular to an elevator advertisement projection device, which comprises a projector, a fixed seat, a mounting seat and a fixing mechanism; the projector is provided with a first connecting part, and the first connecting part is provided with a fixing groove; the fixed seat can be fixedly arranged on the elevator, the mounting seat is arranged on the fixed seat, and a second connecting part which can be matched with the first connecting part and is in sliding connection with the first connecting part is arranged on the mounting seat; the fixing mechanism comprises a sliding piece, the sliding piece is slidably connected onto the mounting seat, and the first end of the sliding piece slides to the outside of the second connecting portion and stretches into the fixing groove to fix the first state of the projector or quit the outside of the fixing groove and is contained in the mounting seat to release the second state of the projector. When the elevator advertisement projection device is used for mounting or dismounting the projector, the mounting and dismounting operation can be completed without tools such as a screwdriver, so that the mounting and dismounting difficulty of the projector is reduced, and the projector can be conveniently mounted and dismounted.

title_en: Glasses type amplifier with light source
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a glasses type amplifier with a light source, which comprises a glasses body with a glasses frame body and a lens body, wherein the glasses frame body is connected with a direct light source and an amplifying component, and the direct light source is electrically connected with a knob; the magnifying assembly comprises a magnifying glasses frame and a magnifying glass lens which is in adaptive connection with the magnifying glasses frame, the magnifying glasses frame is located on the outer side of the glasses frame body and is in rotary connection with the top of the glasses frame body, a rotary plane in rotary connection is parallel to a symmetrical plane of the glasses frame body, and the magnifying glass lens is a convex lens and corresponds to the glasses lens body. The glasses frame body is provided with the light source, so that the situation that the light source is moved continuously is avoided, the glasses frame is very convenient, in addition, the amplification assembly is also arranged on the glasses frame body, the vision field of the instrument is effectively amplified, and the situation that the detection is omitted is avoided.

title_en: Picture frame subassembly reaches skiing mirror including it
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mirror frame assembly and a pair of ski goggles comprising the same, wherein the ski goggles comprise a mirror frame, a mounting bracket and a flexible adsorption pad, a first connecting part is arranged on the mirror frame, a mounting surface is formed on one side of the mounting bracket, and a contact surface is formed on the other side of the mounting bracket; the mounting surface is provided with a second connecting part, and the second connecting part is detachably connected with the first connecting part so as to enable the mounting bracket to be mounted on the mirror frame; the flexible adsorption pad is mounted on the contact surface. According to the picture frame assembly, the flexible adsorption pad can be detachably assembled with the picture frame through the mounting bracket, so that the picture frame assembly is convenient to disassemble, wash and replace.

title_en: Novel eyepiece appearance group
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel eyepiece outward appearance group relates to optics technical field, including the eye-shade, the one end surface of eye-shade is provided with decorates the circle, the one end surface of decorating the circle is provided with the diopter adjusting handle wheel, the outer wall of eye-shade is provided with anti-skidding groove and adjusts the sign, the anti-skidding groove site is in the top of adjusting the sign. Novel eyepiece outward appearance group, decorate circle material and adopt the aluminium alloy, the oxidation of true qualities has been made on its surface, the outward appearance is silvery white, become the contrast with eye-shade and visibility adjusting handle wheel colour, colour collocation is pleasing to the eye, eye-shade week evenly distributed recess and visibility regulation sign, its material is black rubber, it is difficult for skidding to adjust the visibility, it feels, adjusting handle wheel one end circumference has evenly distributed's tooth, the other end has the tapering, the material adopts the aluminium alloy, black bright light oxidation has been made on its surface, it is long-pending little, light in weight, colour collocation is pleasing to the eye, the effect of using is better for traditional mode.

title_en: Projection device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a projection device, including polarization beam splitting component, first wavelength beam splitting component, spatial light modulator and a plurality of projection lens, polarization beam splitting component is used for receiving incident light, and with incident light separation first polarized light and second polarized light, first wavelength beam splitting component is used for receiving first polarized light, and separate first polarized light and be the primary color light, spatial light modulator includes a plurality of liquid crystal regions, every liquid crystal region receives a primary color light or second polarized light, and forms modulated light after the modulation. Each projection lens receives the modulated light emitted from one liquid crystal area and emits image light, and the image light emitted from the plurality of projection lenses is superposed on a projection surface to form an image. The projection equipment provided by the embodiment of the application can improve the light efficiency and reduce the production and manufacturing cost of the equipment.

title_en: Display panel and display device
