abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses display panel and display device, display panel includes COA base plate and piezoelectric assembly, piezoelectric assembly and COA base plate range upon range of setting, and be formed with the liquid crystal layer between piezoelectric assembly and the COA base plate, piezoelectric assembly includes the base plate substrate, pressure-sensitive element and shielding element, the surface of base plate substrate orientation liquid crystal layer includes a plurality of induction areas and shielding area, the interval sets up between a plurality of induction areas, and each induction area sets up with the shielding area interval, pressure-sensitive element sets up in the induction area, shielding element sets up in the shielding area. According to the embodiment of the application, the shielding elements are arranged among the pressure sensing elements on the substrate, so that mutual interference of pressure sensing signals among the pressure sensing elements can be prevented.

title_en: Ultra-low loss optical fiber jumper wire
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an ultra-low loss optical fiber jumper wire which comprises a cable body, wherein a connector assembly is arranged at the end part of the cable body, the connector assembly comprises a connecting sleeve and an inserting core, the inner end of the inserting core is arranged in the connecting sleeve and is connected with the cable body, and the outer end of the inserting core extends out of the connecting sleeve; the outer end of the ferrule is processed to form a reducing part with gradually reduced size, and the top end of the reducing part is processed to form a spherical physical contact area. By adopting the structural design, the utility model fully reduces the dislocation and the contact error which are easily generated by the physical butt joint of the large cambered surface, and ensures that the light energy output by the transmitting optical fiber can be coupled into the receiving optical fiber to the maximum extent. By reducing the physical contact surface, the spherical contact surface is further reduced, the precise butt joint of the small cambered surfaces is realized, the light transmission loss of the two end surfaces of the optical fiber is further reduced, the performance of the optical fiber is favorably improved, and the aim of low loss is fulfilled.

title_en: Digital optical fiber audio signal line
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a digital optical fiber audio signal wire which comprises a box body and a limiting sleeve, wherein first limiting grooves are formed in two sides of the front surface of the box body, a motor is fixedly connected to the back surface of an inner cavity of the box body, a thread is formed in an output shaft of the motor, a movable block is movably connected to the output shaft of the motor, limiting blocks are fixedly connected to two sides of the movable block, and second limiting grooves are formed in two sides of the inner cavity of the box body. The box body is arranged, the effect of stably supporting the motor is achieved, the effect of limiting the movable rod is achieved by arranging the first limiting groove, the effect of driving the movable block to move in the inner cavity of the box body is achieved by matching the motor and the threads, the effect of driving the movable rod to slide in the inner cavity of the first limiting groove is achieved, the effect of limiting the movable block is achieved by matching the limiting block and the second limiting groove, and the condition that the output shaft of the motor drives the movable block to rotate is avoided.

title_en: Carbon powder replenishing bottle
abstract_en: The utility model provides a carbon powder supplement bottle which comprises an elastic bottle body and a neck pipe communicated with the elastic bottle body, wherein a bottle opening communicated with the interior of the elastic bottle body is arranged at the end part of the neck pipe, a pull type sealing sheet is arranged at the end part of the bottle opening, and the minimum included angle between the plane of the end part of the bottle opening and the axis of the neck pipe is smaller than 90 degrees. The toner replenishing bottle can realize toner replenishment without taking the toner cartridge out of the printing equipment, and is convenient and quick.

title_en: Stable form optical cable line laying device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a stable optical cable line laying device, which comprises a base, wherein handrails are arranged on the base, threaded rods are arranged at four corners of the lower end of the base, matching blocks and sleeves are arranged on the threaded rods, universal wheels and brake pads are arranged at the lower ends of the sleeves, a placing table is rotatably connected at the upper end of the base, and a limiting component is arranged on the placing table. The stability of the device is further ensured.

title_en: Laser projection device
abstract_en: The application discloses laser projection equipment belongs to the projection display field. The laser projection apparatus includes: the sliding mechanism comprises a shell, a sliding cover, a sliding rail assembly, a driving assembly and an elastic assembly. The sliding cover is connected with the driving assembly through the elastic assembly. The driving component drives the sliding cover to slide in the direction close to the light through opening in the shell through the elastic component until the sliding cover slides to the light through opening. At the moment, the sliding part is separated from the sliding rail body, and when the driving assembly continues to drive the elastic assembly to move, the sliding cover is enabled to ascend and move at the light through opening through the rebound force of the elastic assembly, so that the light through opening is sealed. When the sliding piece is positioned on the sliding rail body, the sliding cover can be completely moved into the shell, and the driving assembly drives the sliding cover to slide in the direction away from the light through opening in the shell through the elastic assembly so as to realize the opening and closing of the light through opening. Therefore, the sliding cover is always positioned in the shell in the sliding process, so that the overall size of the laser projection equipment is smaller, and the space utilization rate in the shell is effectively improved.

title_en: Connector protection structure
abstract_en: The utility model provides a connector protection structure, which is formed by wrapping a sealing bag, a flexible sleeve and a protection outer sleeve layer by layer outside a branch connector, so that the branch connector at the front end part of a cable main body can be effectively protected in the process of laying cables. The sealing bag is used for sealing the branch connector from contacting dust and water vapor, so that the branch connector is polluted and the loss of the branch connector becomes large. The flexible sleeve is sleeved outside the sealing bag, so that the branch connector is prevented from being pressed or collided by the irregular gap smoothly during arrangement, and the branch connector is effectively protected from being abraded. The protective sleeve is coated outside the flexible sleeve, the flexible sleeve is positioned in the protective sleeve through the protective sleeve, one end of the protective sleeve is detachably fixed on the cable main body, and one end, far away from the cable main body, of the protective sleeve is tightened and sealed. Therefore, after the laying is finished, the protective outer sleeve can be conveniently disassembled, and the flexible sleeve in the protective outer sleeve is released.

title_en: Glasses with protective structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses glasses with a protective structure, which comprise bridge rods, wherein two ends of each bridge rod are fixedly connected with a split type glasses frame, lenses are arranged in the glasses frames, one sides of the glasses frames, far away from the bridge rods, are provided with adapter pieces, the adapter pieces are rotatably connected with hollow sleeves, and leg supporting components with adjustable lengths are arranged in the hollow sleeves; according to the utility model, the upper frame body and the lower frame body are arranged, so that the glasses frame can be detached when the glasses are replaced, the elastic inserting buckle is pulled out from the inserting buckle ring by buckling the elastic inserting buckle during detachment, and then the glasses can be replaced by opening the upper frame body, so that the operation is very convenient and the replacement is convenient.

title_en: Stable fiber laser
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a stable fiber laser, which comprises a gain fiber, a first pump laser and a second pump laser, wherein the wavelength corresponding to the absorption peak of the gain fiber is L, the central wavelength of the first pump laser is less than L, and the central wavelength of the second pump laser is greater than L. According to the utility model, the pump lasers respectively longer than the absorption peak wavelength of the gain fiber and shorter than the absorption peak wavelength of the gain fiber are used, so that the emission wavelengths of the pump lasers are shifted, one causes the total absorption coefficient of the gain fiber to be increased, and the other causes the total absorption coefficient of the gain fiber to be reduced, thereby mutually offsetting a part of the variable quantity, further reducing the total absorption coefficient change of the gain fiber caused by temperature, and reducing the influence of mode instability effect on improving the stability of the fiber laser.

title_en: Medical image projection equipment convenient to adjust
abstract_en: The utility model discloses medical image projection equipment convenient to adjust, which comprises a base, wherein motors are arranged on the left side and the right side of the bottom end in the base, one ends, close to the motors, of the motors are fixedly connected with worms, supporting rods which are uniformly distributed penetrate through the top end of the base, the top ends of the supporting rods penetrate through a sleeve and are fixedly connected to the bottom of a connecting plate, the middle part of the top end of the connecting plate is rotatably connected with a turntable through balls, the top end of the turntable is fixedly connected to the middle part of the bottom end of a fixed plate, and the middle part of the top end of the fixed plate is fixedly connected with a projection device; according to the utility model, the turntable is arranged in the middle of the top end of the supporting rod, the turntable and the supporting plate can rotate relatively through the balls on the periphery of the turntable, the fixing plate is fixed at the top of the turntable and can rotate relative to the supporting plate, and the projection device is fixed at the top of the fixing plate and can adjust the projection direction of the projection device.

title_en: Imaging system
abstract_en: The utility model provides an imaging system. The imaging system sequentially comprises from the object side to the imaging side along the optical axis: a first lens having a negative refractive power, the object side surface being a concave surface; a second lens having a refractive power, the imaging side surface being concave; a third lens having optical power; a fourth lens having a negative refractive power, the object side surface being a concave surface; a fifth lens having a refractive power, the object side surface being convex; a sixth lens having optical power; at least one of the first lens, the second lens and the third lens is a glass lens; an on-axis distance SAG41 between an intersection point of the object side surface and the optical axis of the fourth lens and an effective radius vertex of the object side surface of the fourth lens and an on-axis distance SAG42 between an intersection point of the imaging side surface and the optical axis of the fourth lens and an effective radius vertex of the imaging side surface of the fourth lens satisfy: 0 < (SAG41-SAG42)/(SAG41+ SAG42) < 1.0. The utility model solves the problem that the imaging system in the prior art has high image quality and high and low temperature adaptability and is difficult to simultaneously consider.

title_en: Spectacle frame with high temperature resistant structure
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of spectacle frames, and particularly relates to a spectacle frame with a high-temperature-resistant structure, which comprises a spectacle frame main body and a spectacle frame, wherein a skin-friendly soft cushion is connected to the lower part of the spectacle frame main body, a fixed block is fixed to the side of the spectacle frame main body, a first clamping block is connected to the outer side of the fixed block, a first rotating shaft is arranged on the inner side of the first clamping block, a second clamping block is connected to the outer side of the first rotating shaft, a limiting block is arranged at one end of the first rotating shaft, an air bag nose support is connected to the lower part of the fixed block, a connecting sheet is fixed to the side of the spectacle frame main body, a second rotating shaft is connected to the side of the connecting sheet, a bolt is arranged on the inner side of the second rotating shaft, a nut is arranged on the outer side of the bolt, the spectacle frame is connected to the side of the second rotating shaft, a third rotating shaft is connected to the inner side of the spectacle frame, and an air cushion is fixed to the outer side of the spectacle frame. This spectacle-frame with high temperature resistant structure conveniently uses under high temperature environment, conveniently increases wearer's comfort level, conveniently carries out the folding of small size and deposits.

title_en: Modular OLED display eyepiece assembly
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a modularization OLED display eyepiece subassembly belongs to the system display field, including eyepiece subassembly, display subassembly and eyeshade subassembly, be connected through first screw between eyepiece subassembly and the display subassembly, through threaded connection between eyepiece subassembly and the eyeshade subassembly, be equipped with the external screw thread on eyepiece barrel of eyepiece subassembly, be equipped with the internal thread on the eye-shade seat of eyeshade subassembly, eyepiece subassembly and eyeshade subassembly pass through external screw thread and internal thread interconnect. The utility model discloses the space is compact, and simple to operate can realize that the multi-component modularization is changed.

title_en: Fixing clip for optical fiber plug
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fixing clip for an optical fiber plug, which comprises a fixing clip main body, wherein a limiting rod is arranged on the inner bottom wall of the fixing clip main body, a telescopic rod is movably arranged on the inner side of the limiting rod, a limiting plate is arranged at the bottom end of the telescopic rod, connecting frames a are arranged on the outer walls of two sides of the fixing clip main body, connecting frames b are movably arranged on the inner sides of the connecting frames a, and a connecting plate is arranged at the top ends of the connecting frames b. According to the utility model, the connecting frame b is movably arranged on the inner side of the connecting frame a, so that the connecting frame b can rotate on the inner side of the connecting frame a, the connecting frame b can drive the connecting plate to rotate when rotating, thus the angle of the fixing plate can be adjusted, the sliding plate can slide on the inner side of the sliding groove by embedding the sliding plate on the inner side of the sliding groove, and the position of the fixing plate can be adjusted when the sliding plate slides, so that the fixing plate can be better fixed at the installation position.

title_en: Optical instrument platform building device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a technical field is built to the platform, especially a device is built to optical instrument platform, including removing the seat, one side of removing the seat is rotated through the bearing and is connected with the lead screw, the surface of lead screw has first sleeve pipe through threaded connection, the first board of placing of one side fixedly connected with of first sleeve pipe. The utility model has the advantages of: the second is placed the board and is rotated to vertical state through the effect of pivot, make the position of draw-in groove correspond with the position of second kelly, the control is rotated the handle and is driven the lead screw and rotate, and through the sliding connection of second sleeve pipe with the guide bar, make first sleeve pipe drive first place the board and slide and descend, make second kelly card go into in the draw-in groove, the position of board is placed to fixed second, guaranteed that the platform builds the device and when removing or depositing, can fold and pack up, reduce occupation space, guaranteed that the platform builds the device and removes or when depositing, and is more convenient, the normal use that the device was built to the influence platform has been avoided.

title_en: Lens
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a lens, which is composed of a first negative focal power lens, a second negative focal power lens, a first positive focal power lens, a second positive focal power lens, a third positive focal power lens, a fourth positive focal power lens, a third negative focal power lens, a fifth positive focal power lens and an image plane which are arranged in sequence from an object side to an image side; the lens satisfies: -1.8< f1/f < -1.4; -1.83< f2/f < -1.43; 2.98< f3/f < 3.38; 1.2< f4/f < 1.6; 4.07< f5/f < 4.47; 0.33< f6/f < 0.73; -0.73< f7/f < -0.33; 1.03< f8/f < 1.43. The optical lens with high resolving power and the characteristics of large target surface, large aperture and the like is realized.

title_en: Smart mobile phone backlight light guide plate
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a backlight source light guide plate of a smart phone, which comprises a light guide plate body, wherein a sawtooth-shaped prism body is arranged on a light emergent surface of the light guide plate body, and the height of the prism body is gradually reduced or increased from two ends to the middle. The light-emitting surface of the light guide plate body is provided with the sawtooth-shaped prism bodies, the height of the prism bodies is gradually reduced or increased from two ends to the middle, the higher the height of the prism bodies is, the stronger the light-gathering effect is, and on the contrary, the lower the height of the prism bodies is, the weaker the light-gathering effect is, so that the distribution of the brightness of the light-emitting surface of the light guide plate can be adjusted by adjusting the height of the prism bodies, and the adjustment effect of the distribution of the brightness after light refraction is good; and moreover, the height of the prism body can be freely set to be gradually reduced or increased from two ends to the middle according to the requirements of customers, the distribution adjustment mode of the brightness after light refraction is diversified, and the market competitiveness of products is good.

title_en: Blue light filtering and high-brightness projection curtain
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a projection curtain for filtering blue light and improving brightness, which comprises a curtain body, a base fabric and a machine box, wherein one end of the machine box is provided with a machine frame, a first driving motor and a second driving motor are installed on the machine frame, two winding rollers are arranged in the machine box, one ends of the winding rollers are respectively and fixedly connected with the output ends of the first driving motor and the second driving motor, one ends of the winding rollers are respectively provided with a connecting shaft, the projection curtain for filtering blue light and improving brightness drives the curtain body and the bottom to automatically lift through arranging the first driving motor and the second driving motor, the curtain is prevented from being completely taken into the machine box through arranging a limiting block, the flatness of the curtain is improved through arranging a PVC film layer, the reflection performance is improved through arranging a reflection layer, the imaging is good, the definition is improved, the blue light filtering effect is increased through arranging a blue light filtering layer, and the vision is protected, the protection effect is improved, and the influence of an external light source on the projection curtain is reduced by arranging the shading mechanism.

title_en: Rack with multiple moving directions
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multi-moving-direction rack which comprises a main structure body, wherein the main structure body comprises a supporting part and an installation part arranged above the supporting part, a fixing component is arranged at the joint of the supporting part and the installation part, the fixing component is composed of a fixing plate and a fixing bolt, a first moving mechanism is arranged on the installation part, the supporting part comprises a plurality of arc-shaped supporting legs, and a second moving mechanism is also arranged at the end part of the supporting part.

title_en: Focusing moving frame locking mechanism, lens driving device and camera equipment
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of the optics drive of focusing, especially, relate to a move frame locking mechanism, lens drive arrangement and camera equipment focus. It has solved prior art design defect such as unreasonable. The focusing moving frame locking mechanism comprises a focusing moving frame; the locking bolts are distributed at the periphery of the focusing movable frame; the locking position is arranged on the focusing movable frame; and the locking driving assembly drives the locking bolt to abut against the locking position so as to enable the focusing moving frame to be locked in the axial direction of the optical axis, and drives the locking bolt to be separated from the locking position. The application has the advantages that: the locking of locking bolt and locking position is utilized for it is locked at the optical axis axial when focusing and moving the frame and sinking the end state, can prevent in axial external force etc. the frame is moved in focusing and is thrown away the phenomenon outside the shell, and the design is more reasonable and can prolong and focus and move frame life to and can improve and focus the precision.

title_en: Liquid crystal display module structure with flexible circuit board
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a liquid crystal display module structure with flexible line way board relates to liquid crystal display technical field. Including the liquid crystal display module casing, the mounting groove has been seted up at the top of liquid crystal display module casing, is provided with mounting substrate in the mounting groove, and the top inner wall of mounting substrate's bottom through four dead lever connection mounting grooves forms the heat dissipation chamber between the inner wall of mounting groove and the mounting substrate, and mounting substrate's bottom evenly is provided with the fin, and flexible line way board is installed at mounting substrate's top, and the department of buckling that mounting substrate's top is located flexible line way board is provided with setting device. This liquid crystal display module assembly structure with flexible line way board through setting up mounting substrate, fin and reference column, can be good dispel the heat for the flexible line way board in the work, through setting up setting device, can support the design to the department of buckling of flexible line way board, avoids the position of buckling of flexible line way board to be in unsettled state to can prevent that the flexible line way board from breaking.

title_en: Backlight with anti-loosening function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a backlight source with an anti-loosening function, which comprises a main frame body and a backlight source body, wherein the upper surface of the main frame body is provided with a mounting groove, the top end of the mounting groove is provided with a step, the backlight source body is positioned in the mounting groove, the upper surface of the step is provided with a top frame, the lower surface of the top frame is fixedly provided with an extrusion frame, two extrusion plates are arranged at two sides of the backlight source body in the mounting groove, and one side of the main frame body is provided with a cavity. According to the utility model, the backlight source body is arranged in the mounting groove and between the two extrusion plates, and then the knob is rotated to drive the two-way screw rod in the cavity to rotate, so that the two extrusion plates extrude and fix the backlight source body from two sides, and the backlight source body is prevented from loosening to influence the light-emitting effect after collision.

title_en: Intelligent glasses
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent glasses, comprising: a mirror frame; the glasses legs are detachably connected with the glasses frame through a clamping structure; the locking module is matched with the clamping structure, one of the locking module and the clamping structure is arranged on the glasses frame, the other locking module is arranged on the glasses legs, and the locking module is provided with a cavity and an elastic clamping piece for clamping or unlocking the clamping structure; when the clamping structure stretches into the cavity, the elastic clamping piece clamps the clamping structure and limits the elastic clamping piece to move out, the elastic clamping piece further comprises an unlocking portion used for unlocking the clamping structure, and the unlocking portion is located outside the cavity. This application is through detachable mirror leg, removes the portion through control and realizes spacing to the joint structure, and the joint structure of picture frame can conveniently pass in and out the cavity, and under the limiting displacement of elastic joint spare, the joint structure keeps being fixed in the cavity, guarantees the mirror leg and the stable connection of picture frame, and easy operation simultaneously easily realizes.

title_en: Large-core-number and large-diameter optical cable paying-off pulley
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an optical cable paying-off pulley with large core number and large diameter, wherein an installation frame is fixed on an installation base, and a pulley mechanism comprises: the installation roller of setting between the mounting bracket, the grafting post of rigid coupling in installation roller both sides, the first mounting disc of rigid coupling in two sets of grafting post outsides, the second mounting disc, rotate the first screw rod of multiunit of installing between first mounting disc and installation roller, rotate install between second mounting disc and installation roller and respectively with the multiunit second screw rod of first screw rod rigid coupling, two sets of spacing dishes that slidable mounting connect soon on two sets of grafting posts and with the first screw rod or the second screw rod that correspond the side, set up at spacing dish inside wall and with the nested groove of pegging graft of installation roller tip, the rigid coupling is at first mounting disc, the installation axle on two sets of mounting brackets is installed in the second mounting disc outside and rotation. The utility model can meet the requirement of stable arrangement of optical cables with different diameters and specifications and can improve the laying efficiency of optical cables with large core number and large diameter.

title_en: Operating microscope
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an operating microscope, which comprises a bracket, wherein the top end of the bracket is connected with a fixed ring through a spherical hinge, the top end of the fixed ring is fixedly connected with a limiting mechanism, a microscope is arranged in the fixed ring, the top end of the microscope is fixedly connected with a backing plate, the top end of the backing plate is provided with a groove, the limiting mechanism is clamped with the groove, the limiting mechanism comprises an installation box fixedly connected with the fixed ring, the top end of the inner wall of the installation box is fixedly connected with a spring, the bottom of the spring is fixedly connected with a movable block, the bottom of the movable block penetrates through the installation box and is fixedly connected with a rubber pad, a plurality of limiting beads are embedded on the periphery of the movable block, the top end of the movable block is fixedly connected with a pull rope, the limiting mechanism is arranged to better fix a limiting mirror and is convenient to better use the microscope, and the arrangement of the backing plate and the groove is convenient to better limit the limiting mechanism, the arrangement of the fixing ring is convenient for better limiting the bracket.

title_en: Semiconductor laser handle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a semiconductor laser handle which comprises a second shell, wherein the second shell is connected with a third shell, two ends of the second shell and two ends of the third shell are respectively connected with the first shell and a corrugated pipe sleeve, the tops of the second shell and the third shell are provided with decorative sheets, each decorative sheet is provided with a light-emitting key cap, a light-emitting key PCB is arranged below the light-emitting key cap, the third shell is provided with a display screen protective shell, a display screen and a parameter adjusting key cap are arranged on the display screen protective shell, the parameter adjusting PCB is arranged on the inner side of the parameter adjusting key cap, a gun head is arranged on the inner side of the first shell and is connected with a crystal, the crystal is provided with a crystal clamp, and the crystal clamp is connected with a target bar. This laser handle installs the lens additional and can reduce the impaired risk of crystal, improves product life, possesses and transfers the parameter function and show on the display screen, has increased the operability, and hydrologic cycle cooling improves product stability and performance, and whole crystal is fixed, and stable in structure improves product life.

title_en: Light cat support and light cat mounting structure
abstract_en: The utility model provides a light cat bracket and a light cat mounting structure, wherein the light cat bracket is used for being mounted on an electrician bottom box to mount a light cat, the light cat bracket comprises a fixing part and a suspension column, the fixing part is provided with a fixing hole corresponding to the position of a threaded hole on the electrician bottom box so as to enable a fastener to be penetrated to fix the fixing part on the electrician bottom box, the fixing part is provided with a wire passing port communicated with the inner cavity of the electrician bottom box, the position of the wire passing port corresponds to the position of a cable port on the back of the light cat so as to enable a cable in the electrician bottom box to pass through the wire passing port and be correspondingly plugged into the cable port on the back of the light cat, and the fixing part is convexly provided with the suspension column corresponding to the position of a suspension hole on the back of the light cat so as to enable the light cat to be sleeved on the suspension column through the suspension hole. The light cat support is convenient to install and fix, the cable is prevented from being exposed, and the light cat is effectively protected.

title_en: Tunable wavelength filter structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tunable wavelength filter structure, at least comprising: the first side transparent substrate is provided with a first transparent electrode layer on the outer side surface, and a first reflective coating and a brushed first alignment layer are respectively arranged on the inner side surface; the surface of the inner side of the second side transparent substrate is respectively provided with a second reflection coating film and a second transparent electrode layer, and a second alignment layer is brushed inwards; the annular sealing piece is arranged around the first side transparent substrate and the second side transparent substrate in a surrounding manner, a middle cavity is formed among the first side transparent substrate, the second side transparent substrate and the annular sealing piece, and liquid crystal is filled in the middle cavity; and the purpose of adjusting the wavelength is achieved by the turning of the liquid crystal molecules.

title_en: Laser printer for circuit board printing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a laser printer for circuit board printing, which comprises an operation table, wherein an installation plate is fixedly installed on the outer wall of one side of the operation table, a suction fan is fixedly installed at the top of the installation plate, a suction pipe is fixedly installed at the top of the suction fan, the suction pipe is placed at the top of a placement block, an adjusting frame is fixedly installed at the top of the operation table, laser printing equipment is movably installed on one side of the adjusting frame, certain harmful gas can be generated when the laser printing equipment prints a circuit board, the suction fan is started when printing is started, the generated harmful gas is sucked into the suction fan by the suction fan through the suction pipe and is discharged outdoors, so that the harmful gas in the air can be reduced, and the harmful gas sucked into the operation personnel is effectively reduced.

title_en: MPO (maximum power output) bayonet adapter and optical module
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an MPO (maximum output power) bayonet adapter and an optical module, which belong to the technical field of optical communication and comprise a bayonet mechanism and a MT (terminal) ferrule with a tail, wherein the bayonet mechanism comprises a shell, and an interface at one end of the shell is provided with a collimating groove, a first buckle and a second buckle, the first buckle and the second buckle surround to form a limiting groove, the first buckle is provided with a first guide angle, the second buckle is provided with a second guide angle, and the collimating groove is positioned in the shell; the MT ferrule with the tail comprises a tail end limiting structure and an MT positioning structure matched with the collimation groove, the tail end limiting structure is clamped with the first buckle and the second buckle respectively, and the tail end limiting structure is positioned in the limiting groove; the MT positioning structure is movably arranged in the collimation groove. The utility model achieves the technical effects of improving the alignment precision and reducing the optical power loss caused by the plugging and unplugging of the optical fiber.

title_en: Laser optical module control circuit and laser
abstract_en: The embodiment of the utility model provides a laser light module control circuit and laser instrument, this laser light module control circuit include two at least laser modules and laser control module, and the laser module is connected with the laser control module through differential data bus module, the slave station interface connection of laser module and differential data bus module, laser control module and differential data bus's main website interface connection. In the technical scheme of this embodiment, through the control circuit structural style that adopts differential data bus, every laser module only needs to connect a signal interface line, is favorable to the extension of laser module, reduces the wiring mistake, can reduce the laser control system design degree of difficulty, and through the control chip quantity of the laser control module who saves the laser instrument, can reach the effect of practicing thrift the cost moreover.

title_en: Backlight module without gasket rubber strip
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a backlight module without rubber strip padding, which comprises a lower iron frame, a reflecting sheet, a light guide plate and a middle rubber frame, wherein the lower iron frame comprises a back plate and a side edge extending upwards from the edge of the back plate; the reflector plate is arranged on the upper surface of the back plate; the light guide plate is arranged above the reflecting sheet; the middle rubber frame comprises a body sleeved on the side edge and a bearing part arranged on the inner side of the body, wherein a blocking wall extends downwards from the bearing part, and the blocking wall is abutted to the light guide plate. Utilize the fender wall and the light guide plate butt of bearing part downwardly extending, because the material of well gluey frame is for having certain elastic plastic material, in the in-service use or in falling the experiment, thereby keep off the wall and can replace and fill up the adhesive tape and avoid the light guide plate to take place the abnormal sound, and keep off the wall and can with well gluey frame integrated into one piece, it need not extra artifical installation, also need not additionally to dispose spare part, thereby the production technology of product has been simplified, the production efficiency of product is improved, the competitiveness of the product is improved.

title_en: Little sample shooting imaging system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of specimen image shooting, in particular to a small and micro specimen shooting and imaging system, which comprises an imaging system host, a controller and a motor, wherein the imaging system host is arranged on a lifting device, the imaging system host is movably connected with a shooting workbench through the lifting device, and the motor and the controller are arranged in the shooting workbench; the imaging system host comprises an upper computer and an imaging device with a macro lens, the upper computer is connected with the imaging device with the macro lens, and the controller is respectively connected with the upper computer and the motor through communication lines; the motor is connected with the lifting device; the upper computer is connected with the camera with the macro lens, can receive the sample image information collected by the imaging device with the macro lens in real time, is connected with the upper computer and the motor through the motor driver and the communication line respectively through the controller, and the motor output end is connected with the lifting device and used for controlling the host of the imaging system to move up and down, so that the imaging device with the macro lens can focus and photograph in real time.

title_en: Wire drawing structure and anti-counterfeiting film
abstract_en: The utility model provides a wire drawing structure and anti-fake membrane, the wire drawing structure includes many wire drawing lines, the wire drawing line contains a plurality of line units of periodically arranging, the line unit contains a plurality of unit points, be equipped with the grating on the unit point, the grating orientation angle of the unit point in the line unit is the trend change, presents the depth of field effect. According to the wire drawing structure provided by the invention, the grating orientation angle of the unit point in the line unit of each wire drawing line is changed in a trend manner, so that the floating or sinking effect can be presented in each direction, the anti-counterfeiting effect is good, and the experience of a user can be obviously improved.

title_en: High-applicability fiber arrangement device for optical fiber winding production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-applicability fiber arrangement device for optical fiber winding production, and relates to the technical field of optical fiber ring production and related equipment thereof. The utility model comprises a case, wherein a driving mechanism is arranged on one side of the front end face of the case, the driving mechanism comprises a driving rail and a driving block, the driving block is arranged on the outer side of the outer wall of the driving rail, a rotating assembly comprises a motor A and a rotating frame, an output shaft of the motor A penetrates through a bearing on the end face of an installation plate B and is connected with a rotating shaft B through a coupler, the other end of the rotating shaft B is fixedly connected with the rotating frame, and an adjusting assembly comprises a connecting column and a side plate. According to the utility model, by utilizing the rotating assembly and the adjusting assembly, the motor A and the motor B operate to enable the adjusting rod to rotate to adjust the angle of the optical fiber, and fine adjustment is carried out according to the arc lengths of different positions, so that the quality of an optical fiber ring is improved, the motor C operates to drive the rotating plate to rotate, the type of the fiber arranging and pressing needle can be quickly adjusted, and the working efficiency is improved.

title_en: Optical device based on lithium niobate film
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an optical device based on a lithium niobate film, which comprises a lithium niobate film chip, a DFB laser chip and a substrate, wherein the laser chip is arranged on the substrate in an inverted mode, and an optical port of the DFB laser chip is positioned below the laser chip and aligned with a lithium niobate optical waveguide to form optical coupling. The DFB laser chip and the substrate are fixedly connected through two kinds of glue, namely conductive glue and UV glue. The conductive adhesive is positioned between the bonding pad of the DFB laser chip and the substrate. The UV glue is located between the DFB laser and a fixed point of the substrate. By adopting the laser active coupling structure in the optical device, the laser chip and the lithium niobate thin film chip can be aligned in a space coupling mode, the problems caused by using optical fibers are avoided, meanwhile, the coupling alignment degree is allowed to be monitored in real time during alignment operation, and the alignment precision is obviously improved.

title_en: Large-size glass laminating device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a large-size glass laminating device, which belongs to the technical field of liquid crystal display production equipment and comprises a workbench, wherein the workbench is connected with an adsorption substrate through a turnover mechanism, the adsorption substrate is adsorbed with a laminating screen, a bearing substrate is connected under the adsorption substrate through a lifting mechanism, and the bearing substrate is supported with a laminated screen.

title_en: Grating fixing device of blending section in wire manufacturing workshop
abstract_en: The application discloses a grating fixing device of a blending section in a wire manufacturing workshop, which comprises a first assembly, a second assembly and a third assembly, wherein the first assembly comprises a support frame, a rack connecting block, a grating connecting block and a first adjusting rod; the frame connecting block is fixedly connected with a blanking port frame of the blending section, the frame connecting block is fixed at the first end of the first adjusting rod, and the second end of the first adjusting rod is detachably connected with the supporting frame; the grating connecting block is detachably connected with the supporting frame and the grating connecting block is detachably connected with the grating; a first connecting line between the grating connecting block and the supporting frame is perpendicular to a second connecting line between the rack connecting block and the supporting frame. The method and the device improve the detection quality of the grating, thereby improving the product quality and the production efficiency.

title_en: Anti-interference device for receiving objective lens
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of objective anti-interference, and particularly relates to an anti-interference device for receiving an objective, which comprises a front lens cone, a rear lens cone and an anti-interference cylinder, wherein the end part of the rear lens cone is provided with a buffering soft cylinder attached to the anti-interference cylinder, the outer end of the rear lens cone is rotatably connected with an adjusting cylinder for adjusting the distance between the anti-interference cylinder and the rear lens cone, the end surface of the anti-interference cylinder is fixedly connected with a plurality of adjusting rods distributed in an annular manner, and the end part of a sliding ring is fixedly connected with a traction rope for drawing the adjusting rods to move; drive through the haulage rope and adjust the pole and stretch, and then realize that anti-interference section of thick bamboo adjusts along the axial position of back lens cone, simultaneously through rotating control, makes the rolling speed of haulage rope more controllable, and then can resist the position of disturbing a section of thick bamboo and finely tune, with the position control to the best effect of anti-interference section of thick bamboo, guarantee that anti-interference section of thick bamboo can be under different environment, the biggest effect of performance, guarantee simultaneously that preceding lens cone, back lens cone are inside to be in dustless environment.

title_en: Back plate and peripheral plate integrated fixed shaping's backlight unit
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of a side-in type backlight module, and aims to solve the problems in the prior art, the utility model provides a backlight module with a back plate and a peripheral plate which are integrally fixed and formed, and the backlight module comprises a liquid crystal panel, a light guide plate, an optical diaphragm, a light bar, a reflector plate and a radiator, wherein the light guide plate is a glass light guide plate, the back side of the reflector plate is provided with an inner frame, the outer side of the inner frame is provided with a plastic back plate, the plastic back plate comprises an arc-shaped section, the bottom end of the arc-shaped section extends to form a first bending section connected with the inner frame, the first bending section extends to form a second bending section attached to the reflector plate, the rear end of the radiator extends towards the middle part of the backlight module and is used for clamping the second bending section, peripheral frames are arranged on the front side and the rear side of the lower part of the backlight module, and the rear end of each peripheral frame is abutted to the arc-shaped section. The light guide plate made of glass is used as a backlight main body structure, the plastic back plate is used as an appearance structure, and the plastic back plate is matched with an integrated structure of the peripheral plate, so that the existing backlight mode is changed, and materials and processes are saved.

title_en: One-way water outlet type flushing bag for hard corneal contact lens
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a one-way play water formula washing bag for rigid corneal contact lens, including liquid storage bag and the one-way play flood peak of setting at the liquid storage bag top, one-way play flood peak is including setting up at the liquid storage bag top and being located the outside play flood peak casing of liquid storage bag, goes out to form the buffering cavity between flood peak casing and the liquid storage bag, and the delivery port has been seted up to the liquid storage bag, is stamped flexible sealing pad on the delivery port, and flexible sealing pad one side edge is fixed with the liquid storage bag, and flexible sealing pad opposite side can outwards be opened, goes out flood peak casing and covers flexible sealing pad wherein. The utility model discloses an one-way water outlet has solved and has advanced the bottle because of the air and lead to the problem of flush fluid pollution, has still solved the uneven scheduling problem that easily remains of flush fluid velocity of flow, safe and reliable.

title_en: Intelligence FC fiber splice device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligence FC optical fiber splice device, it includes the fixed storehouse of chip and optical fiber connection taper pipe, the preceding tip of optical fiber connection taper pipe insert establish and nested in the circular cover in the fixed storehouse of chip, the tip upside in the fixed storehouse of chip be provided with chip groove and downwardly extending and with the circular cover in the fixed storehouse of chip that the chip groove is connected. The utility model discloses a special radio frequency identification chip of intelligent system and ordinary FC optical fiber splice are bound each other to the fixed storehouse of chip and optical fiber connection taper pipe, make it become the use of intelligent FC optical fiber splice cooperation intelligent optical fiber distribution frame, can energize intelligent attribute on ordinary FC optical fiber distribution system, make it upgrade to intelligent FC optical fiber distribution system, existing ordinary FC optical fiber equipment still can continue to use among this intelligent energizing upgrading process, this must practice thrift a large amount of intelligent upgrading transformation costs for the user, can bring good social and economic benefits.

The conversion assembly adopts a standard connector, and realizes the full utilization, load sharing and fault domain division of two 12-core optical fibers by using the optical fiber position corresponding relation of 3 MPO connectors of 8-core optical fibers and 2 MPO connectors of 12-core optical fibers.

abstract_en: The utility model discloses a piezoelectricity drive type space filter wheel ray apparatus for greenhouse gas monitoring, including ultrasonic motor, supporting seat, bearing frame supporting seat, light filter carousel subassembly, flexible coupling, bearing frame, deep groove ball bearing, bearing end cover, epaxial lock nut, detector support frame and ray apparatus bottom plate. The utility model discloses a clean the subassembly and can clean the screen body of rolling to in get rid of the dust on its surface, do not need the manual work to clean, and be convenient for adjust the height of cleaning, thereby the width that is applicable to the rolling is adjusted, strengthens the result of use.

title_en: LED lamp with adjustable irradiation angle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an adjustable LED lamp that shines angle includes round shell cover, damping pivot, turns round shell, retainer plate, lamp holder and spherical interior inclusion, round shell cover notch department is connected with spherical interior inclusion, and the inside silica gel pad that is provided with of round shell cover, and the spherical interior inclusion is connected with the lamp tail simultaneously, round shell cover rear end is provided with the handle, and round shell cover both sides are connected with movable handle, and the activity handle top is provided with flexible platform simultaneously, the nut line has been seted up to the lamp holder skin, and the nut line outside is wrapped up by the bolt line, it is provided with the retainer plate to turn round shell front end, and the retainer plate inboard is connected with the dust layer, and the dust layer inboard is provided with convex lens, this adjustable LED lamp that shines angle simultaneously. The damping rotating shaft, the handle and the movable handle are arranged, the direction of illumination can be adjusted by holding the handle to move, and the direction can be fixed by increasing friction through the rubber ring in the damping rotating shaft after the direction is adjusted.

title_en: CT reads piece device with CT piece protect function
abstract_en: The utility model provides a piece device is read to CT with CT piece protect function, read the piece lamp house including LED formula CT, ya keli printing opacity panel, light adjustment button and electrical socket, wherein: the front of the LED type CT film reading lamp box is embedded with an acrylic light-transmitting panel, a light adjusting button is nested below one side of the front of the LED type CT film reading lamp box, and a power supply jack is nested below one end of the surface of the LED type CT film reading lamp box. The utility model discloses when looking over the CT piece, avoid the CT piece direct with read the piece lamp house and pull out and insert fixed mode to effectual CT piece of avoiding produces crease or scotch problem, makes its whole safety more, can not influence subsequent looking over, be convenient for marketing and application.

title_en: Developer box
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a developer box, include: a housing having a chamber for accommodating a developer, the housing having an outer surface in a second direction, the housing having first and second ends in negative and positive directions of a first direction, respectively; a developing roller circumferentially rotatable along an axis of a roller body thereof in a second direction, the developing roller being closer to the first end than to the second end in the first direction; a first projection provided on the outer surface, the first projection being away from the developing roller in a first direction and a third direction, the third direction being different from the first direction and the second direction, the first projection being supported by the supporting portion of the drum unit when the roller body of the developing roller comes into contact with the photosensitive drum of the drum unit; the first electrode is connected with the developer roll electricity, and first electrode and first protruding integrated into one piece can install or dismantle on the casing altogether, and easy to assemble dismantles, and the spare part that easily realizes the developer box integrates, has still improved first bellied intensity, prevents effectively that first arch from damaging at the atress in-process.

title_en: Holographic projector for illumination
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a holographic projector that can be used to illumination, which comprises a frame, the one end of frame is provided with the aircraft nose, and is provided with the motor in the frame, the output and the aircraft nose center department fixed connection of motor, be provided with the battery in the frame, be provided with the standing groove in the aircraft nose, install control scheme board in the standing groove, fixedly connected with rotating turret on the aircraft nose, the top of rotating turret is provided with the recess, be provided with the LED lighting fixture in the recess, the bottom fixedly connected with installation piece of frame. The utility model discloses in, through the setting of mounting bracket, installation notch, mounting hole structure, can be convenient stable with the mounting bracket pre-install wall body or auxiliary stand on, the cooperation of cooperation installation piece, mounting groove, stopper, spacing groove, dwang, fly leaf isotructure sets up, can realize the firm location installation of stabilizing of whole frame, also can convenient dismantlement simultaneously, convenient clearance or maintenance.

title_en: Novel horizontal liquid crystal fills device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a liquid crystal production technical field discloses a novel horizontal liquid crystal filling device, and it includes the base, the top of base is fixed with the support column, and the top fixed mounting of support column has the hopper, the top of hopper is provided with the lifter plate, and the bottom of lifter plate is rotated and is installed the pivot, the both sides fixed mounting of pivot has the heat pipe, the tip of heat pipe is seal structure, fixed mounting has the heating pipe in the heat pipe, the bottom of pivot is rotated and is installed the current-limiting stopper, the bottom of hopper is fixed with the discharging pipe, the current-limiting stopper support press in on the discharging pipe, the bottom of discharging pipe is fixed with the conveyer pipe, is equipped with the transport assembly in the conveyer pipe. The utility model discloses carry out the even heating for the liquid crystal, guarantee the mobility of liquid crystal, at the in-process of carrying the filling, heat and keep warm, improve liquid crystal and fill efficiency, easily promote.

title_en: Display device
abstract_en: A display device includes a display panel and a protective member over the display panel. The protective member may include an adhesive layer over the display panel, a first protective layer over the adhesive layer, and a second protective layer between the adhesive layer and the first protective layer. The first protective layer may have a first thickness and a1 st-1 st modulus at room temperature, and the second protective layer may have a second thickness less than the first thickness and a2 nd-1 st modulus less than the 1 st-1 st modulus at room temperature.

title_en: Assembly unit, process cartridge assembly, and image forming apparatus
abstract_en: The utility model provides an assembly cell, processing box subassembly and image forming device relates to electron imaging technology field. The fitting unit includes a loading confirmation member provided on the cartridge body of the process cartridge. The process cartridge includes a fitting unit. A process cartridge assembly includes a plurality of process cartridges. The image forming apparatus includes a process cartridge assembly. The loading confirmation member can distinguish the placement position and the orientation by engaging with the apparatus body when the process cartridge is loaded into the apparatus body of the image forming apparatus, thereby preventing the process cartridge from being placed on the apparatus body reversely.

title_en: Head-up display system and vehicle
abstract_en: The application relates to a head-up display system and a vehicle. The image display is used for emitting image source light rays, the reflector and the image display are oppositely arranged at intervals and used for reflecting the image source light rays emitted by the image display, and a light transmission space is formed between the reflector and the image display; the reflecting piece is arranged between the image display and the reflecting mirror and comprises a base material and a plurality of microstructures, and the microstructures are arranged on one side of the base material facing the light transmission space; the microstructure has a first face and a second face, the first face and the second face intersecting, the first face facing the mirror. The first surface is provided with a reflecting layer, the reflectivity of the reflecting layer to visible light is greater than or equal to 50%, and light reflected by the reflecting mirror is emitted to the first surface and then at least partially reflected to a target projection position. The head-up display system improves the optical efficiency of the system and obviously reduces the volume occupied by installation.

title_en: Chemical industry operation real-time environment monitoring auxiliary support system based on augmented reality
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a chemical industry operation real-time environment monitoring auxiliary safeguard system based on augmented reality, including the first apparent, the personal safety monitoring bracelet of augmented reality, knapsack formula computational element, and the first apparent and personal safety monitoring bracelet of augmented reality all establishes communication with knapsack formula computational element; the augmented reality head is integrated with a multi-view camera and an inertial sensor; a blood oxygen sensor and a heartbeat sensor are integrated on the personal safety monitoring bracelet; the backpack type computing unit is internally integrated with a data transmission assembly, a data storage assembly and a data processing assembly, and is externally provided with a gas sensor array; the backpack type computing unit receives and analyzes the environmental information and the positioning information acquired by the augmented reality head display and the human body sign information acquired by the personal safety monitoring bracelet, and then feeds back an analysis result to a near-to-eye screen of the augmented reality head display. The above system is adopted in the utility model, the security and the operating efficiency that have improved the chemical industry operation are showing.

title_en: Light source and control system for machine vision detection
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a machine vision technical field particularly relates to machine light source and control system for visual inspection, and light source wherein includes annular light source and leaded light beam, the leaded light panel has first light emitting area, second light emitting area and third light emitting area, have the multiunit in the light source casing and be the unit display area of central symmetric distribution, each all be provided with multiunit along the optical fiber array of circumference orderly arranged in the unit display area, every in the unit display area the optical fiber array leaded light angle is different, just optical fiber array leaded light angle is in 0- +/-90 scope; by arranging more annular light sources which can independently control the brightness and the illumination angle display area in the circumferential direction and matching with a light source control system, the light reflection condition on the surface of the workpiece is pertinently adjusted, so that the surface of the workpiece presents a low-reflection and low-fall illumination environment, a CCD lens can easily obtain clear images, and the difficulty of subsequent image processing is reduced.

title_en: Camera mount that multi freedom removed
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a camera mount that multi freedom removed, which comprises a mounting bas, the both sides outer wall of mount pad all rotates and is provided with the bull stick, the fixed mounting panel that has cup jointed in outside of bull stick, the top of mounting panel is provided with displacement mechanism, install the camera body through rotary mechanism in the displacement mechanism, the outside that the bull stick is close to the mount pad is fixed cup jointed the worm wheel, the worm wheel below is corresponding to the both sides outer wall of mount pad and all fixes the installation piece that is provided with symmetric distribution, two the relative one side outer wall of installation piece rotates jointly and is provided with the worm, worm and worm wheel mesh mutually, the one end of worm is worn out the installation piece and is fixed and be provided with the knob. The utility model discloses a rotatory worm of knob, and then can make the mounting panel on the bull stick rotate, the camera carries out the angle of pitch regulation promptly, after adjusting stop rotating the knob can, can carry out the spacing of angle of pitch to the camera through the auto-lock nature of worm wheel and worm promptly, simple and convenient.

title_en: Teaching display instrument
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a teaching auxiliary assembly technical field just discloses a teaching show appearance, including the carrier ring frame, the inner wall of carrier ring frame is equipped with the support bracket, the dead eye has been seted up at the top of support bracket, the slew bearing is installed to the inner wall interference fit of dead eye, the offset shaft is installed to slew bearing's inner wall interference fit, the surface of offset shaft is equipped with the skew ring frame, the top of skew ring frame is equipped with the operation layer board. This teaching display instrument through recording the camera, makes operating personnel show the operation to associated display device according to the teaching content, and this in-process record camera will show the picture transmission of operation and give peripheral hardware display device, and peripheral hardware display device gives the student with the show operation picture transmission and imparts knowledge to students, has greatly strengthened the convenience that the student of different positions observed teaching display content, has effectively improved the effect of teaching show to the practicality of device has been strengthened.

title_en: Intracavity sum frequency tunable laser
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a laser instrument technical field just discloses an intracavity sum frequency tunable laser, including bottom plate, laser instrument body and two mounting panels, two the mounting panel symmetry is fixed to be set up in the upper surface of bottom plate, the laser instrument body sets up between two mounting panels, the preceding, the back both sides of laser instrument body are fixed respectively and are provided with the bull stick, two the bull stick is connected, one of them through first bearing and the mounting panel rotation that corresponds respectively mutually the bull stick runs through corresponding mounting panel and fixedly connected with stop gear. The utility model discloses can adjust the angle after installing the laser instrument, guarantee its normal use.

title_en: Film version location all-in-one that punches
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a film plate punching and positioning integrated machine, which comprises a frame, a screen frame fixing structure and a film positioning structure, wherein the screen frame fixing structure and the film positioning structure are arranged on the frame; wherein the rack is provided with a guide rail; the screen frame fixing structure comprises a front baffle and a rear baffle which are used for respectively clamping the front edge and the rear edge of the screen frame; the rear baffle is connected with the guide rail in a sliding manner, and the front baffle and the rear baffle are both provided with two drilling sleeves for drilling; the film positioning structure is arranged between the front baffle and the rear baffle, and the film positioning structure and the guide rail are positioned on a central line where the middle points of the two drill bushings are positioned. The utility model discloses a film version location all-in-one that punches, fix a position the film and punch and combine together, not only reduced film version equipment transfer time, still reduced the silk screen printing machine and gone up the version machine time of transferring, increased substantially production efficiency.

title_en: Toner scraping structure for toner cartridge without storing toner
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a toner cartridge avoids hiding powder and scrapes powder structure, including powder storehouse casing and developer roll, be equipped with the installation department on the powder storehouse wall of powder storehouse casing, be equipped with elasticity strip and this elasticity strip on the installation department and be located between installation department and aluminium pipe, its characterized in that: the elastic strip is provided with a working surface, the working surface is contacted with the surface of the developing roller to form a contact surface, and the distance H between the edge of the working surface and the edge of the nearest contact surface is as follows: 0-2mm. The utility model discloses a to the position adjustment of the contact surface of elasticity strip and developer roll surface contact to reduce the region that powder was hidden in formation between elasticity strip and developer roll greatly, thereby improved the printing quality.

title_en: High-point precision collimator
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high point precision collimator, it is a light output device, forms by tail optical fiber and optical lens accurate positioning, the tail optical fiber is 0 tail optical fiber, forms by single mode fiber and centreless fiber or multimode fiber butt joint, the other end of centreless fiber or multimode fiber with optical lens is relative, optical lens is for not taking the optical lens of angle. The utility model discloses an expand the beam to single mode fiber earlier, enlarge light beam NA, the mode that reuse lens carried out the collimation has avoided utilizing the angle to improve the return loss and has sacrificed the problem of some precision, consequently, can obtain the collimater that satisfies high return loss and splendid point precision simultaneously, and the design is simple, with low costs moreover. The utility model discloses a collimator does not have the angle change when remote propagation almost, has extensive using value in laser rangefinder, laser radar, space communication.

title_en: Display module assembly and intelligent interaction equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a display module and intelligent interaction equipment, comprising: the frame is provided with a positioning groove; the limiting block comprises a positioning body and a limiting body, the positioning body is connected with the limiting body, the positioning body is inserted into the positioning groove, and the limiting body extends out of the notch of the positioning groove; and the liquid crystal panel is arranged on the frame, and a preset installation gap is formed between the liquid crystal panel and the limiting body. The locating body is inserted in the locating groove when the limiting block is installed, the manual error is always eliminated, the installation position of the limiting block is uniquely determined, and therefore the accuracy of the installation position of the limiting block can be guaranteed, after the liquid crystal panel is installed on the frame, a preset installation gap is formed between the limiting body and the liquid crystal panel, in the subsequent transportation or testing process, even if the liquid crystal panel moves, the excessive extrusion force applied to the liquid crystal panel by the limiting block can be avoided, the problem of broken screen of the liquid crystal panel is prevented, and the safety and the service life of the installation and the use of the liquid crystal panel are improved.

title_en: Multi-inclined-plane lens optical fiber assembly with built-in grating structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multi-inclined plane lens optical fiber assembly with a built-in grating structure, which comprises the following components: an end multi-bevel lens and an internal grating structure; the multi-bevel lens includes: the optical lens comprises a first inclined plane, a second inclined plane, a third inclined plane, a fourth inclined plane and a micro-cylindrical lens, wherein the first inclined plane, the second inclined plane, the third inclined plane and the fourth inclined plane are distributed at intervals, and the first inclined plane, the second inclined plane, the third inclined plane and the fourth inclined plane are connected with the micro-cylindrical lens in a crossing mode. The multi-inclined-plane lens is matched with the mode field of the side-emitting semiconductor laser, so that the coupling efficiency is greatly improved, and the multi-inclined-planes have large-angle characteristics, so that the energy density of reflected light can be greatly reduced, and the laser and the optical fiber are effectively protected; meanwhile, the multi-inclined-plane lens effectively avoids collision between the end part of the optical fiber and the laser during coupling, greatly improves coupling tolerance between the optical fiber and the side-emitting semiconductor laser, and facilitates supporting installation of equipment.

title_en: Image processing camera that security performance is high
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an image processing camera with high safety performance, which comprises a protective box, wherein light plates are fixedly arranged on two sides of the bottom of an inner cavity of the protective box, sliding rings are slidably arranged on the front surface of the light plates, a camera body is fixedly arranged at one end, close to each other, of each sliding ring, springs are wound on the front surface of the light plates, filter boxes are fixedly arranged on two sides of the top of the protective box, motors are fixedly arranged on two sides of the inner cavity of the filter box through brackets, fan blades are fixedly arranged on two sides of the output end of each motor, and a filter plate is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the inner cavity of the filter box. According to the utility model, through the arrangement of the protective box, the camera body, the light plate, the slip ring, the spring and the camera body, the protective box is matched with the motor, the fan blades, the filter plate and the filter box for use, the problem that the existing image processing camera does not have the protective function, the damage to the camera can be caused, and the working efficiency is greatly reduced.

title_en: Camera tripod head installation positioning structure
abstract_en: The utility model provides a camera cradle head mounting and positioning structure, which comprises a supporting plate, wherein the left side of the supporting plate is connected with a fixed plate through bolts, and meanwhile, the middle position of the front surface of the supporting plate is connected with a wiring board through bolts; the upper side and the lower side of the fixed plate are respectively in threaded connection with mounting bolts. According to the utility model, the protection box, the dust guard, the connecting block and the clamping plate are arranged, the dust guard can be opened to position the camera on the whole day through the connecting block and the clamping plate, and then the protection box is matched with the dust guard to play a dust-proof role on the camera, so that the problem that the monitoring effect is influenced when the camera enters dust is solved.

title_en: Glasses leg positioning and retaining structure
abstract_en: The utility model provides a glasses leg positioning and retaining structure which comprises a glasses frame and glasses legs, wherein a first connecting part is arranged on the glasses frame, a second connecting part is arranged on the glasses legs, the first connecting parts are arranged in two and are mutually arranged at intervals, the second connecting parts extend into the space between the two first connecting parts and are rotatably connected through a hinge shaft, a spring is sleeved on the second connecting parts, two ends of the spring are respectively matched with the glasses legs and the first connecting parts in a propping way by virtue of a propping piece, and a connecting hole connected with the second connecting part is formed in the propping piece. The glasses legs can stably stay in the opened and folded states through the springs and the abutting pieces, the springs need to be compressed when the two states rotate and switch, and therefore the two states staying in the opened and folded states are positioned through the elastic force formed by the springs, and the glasses legs cannot automatically rotate easily.

title_en: Hand-held film reading lamp
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of medical appliances, in particular to a handheld film reading lamp, which comprises an external fixing frame, wherein one side of the external fixing frame is provided with an internal fixing frame, one side of the internal fixing frame, which is far away from the external fixing frame, is provided with a positioning frame, a marking frame and a linkage frame are connected inside the positioning frame in a sliding manner, one sides of the marking frame and the linkage frame are fixedly connected with clamping blocks, the marking frame and the linkage frame are clamped through the clamping blocks, and the inner sides of the marking frame and the linkage frame are fixedly connected with a mounting ring; through the cooperation of mark frame and interlock frame for medical personnel can mark this position when observing that certain cross section photo goes wrong, thereby make when medical personnel need contrast other positions with this moment, need not to look for once more and need not to remove the searchlight here again, make that medical personnel can be more convenient accomplish and read the piece work, thereby improve medical personnel read piece efficiency and read the piece effect.

title_en: Fire emergency sign lamp
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire emergency sign lamp, which comprises a rear shell and a face cover, wherein the rear shell and the face cover are fixedly clamped, a light guide plate mounting groove, a circuit board mounting groove and a lamp bead plate mounting groove are formed in the front surface of the rear shell, a light guide plate is assembled in the light guide plate mounting groove, a lamp bead plate is assembled in the lamp bead plate mounting groove, a light homogenizing plate is assembled between the light guide plate and the face cover, a convex mirror structure is arranged on the side wall of the light guide plate, and a diffuse reflection structure is arranged on the surface of the light guide plate. The light emitted by the lamp bead plate is guided and dispersed only through the matching of the single light guide plate and the light homogenizing plate, and the convex mirror and the diffuse reflection structure are arranged in the light guide plate, so that the light beam is conducted farther and more uniformly. Through the improvement of the product to the light guide plate, the number of parts to be assembled is reduced, so that the product is not only reduced in processing difficulty in the production and assembly process, but also quick assembly and simple installation are realized, and the practicability and applicability of the product are greatly improved.

title_en: Automatic COG bonding equipment
