abstract_en: The utility model discloses COG bonding automation equipment, which comprises a COG bonding equipment body, wherein an electric cabinet is arranged at the bottom of the COG bonding equipment body, four vibration reduction mechanisms are symmetrically arranged at four corners of the bottom of the electric cabinet, a flip cover is arranged at one side of the COG bonding equipment body, a second handle is arranged at the bottom of one side of the flip cover, an air injection mechanism is arranged at the middle upper part of one side of the COG bonding equipment body, and a warning lamp is arranged at one corner of the top of the COG bonding equipment body. Through the installation of jet-propelled mechanism, utilize the fan to carry the air nozzle blowout through communicating pipe after filtering, adsorbing external air, be favorable to blowing off the dust on the LCD glass through the air, promoted the effect of COG bonding.

title_en: Ceramic heating strip of laser printer
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a ceramic heating strip of a laser printer, which comprises a ceramic substrate, electrodes, heating wires and glass glaze, wherein the heating wires are provided with fusing points; the fusing point is a gradual narrowing section or a direct narrowing section; the length of the fusing point is between 0.1 and 5mm, and the width of the fusing point is less than or equal to 60% of the width of the non-fusing point; the heating wire is locally narrowed, so that the ceramic heating strip is automatically melted when being heated to a certain temperature, and the ignition phenomenon or other conditions caused by overhigh temperature can be effectively avoided; the temperature measuring point can be welded on the back of the design of the fusing point, and the problem of overhigh temperature at the design position of the fusing point can be effectively balanced because the temperature measuring point takes away local heat, so that the printing color difference phenomenon caused by local overheating in the printing process is avoided; the design of the fusing point can be gradually narrowed in the figure or be directly narrowed, and meanwhile, the shape of the temperature measuring point can be changed according to the design of the shape of the self-fusing point.

title_en: Faraday optical isolator
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a Faraday optical isolator, which comprises an optical rotator, wherein one end surface of the optical rotator is in threaded connection with a first bracket, a first through hole is formed in the first bracket, the first through hole is coaxial with the optical rotator, and a first polarization beam splitter is arranged in the first through hole; the end face, far away from the first bracket, of the optical rotatory device is in threaded connection with a bracket pressing ring, a second through hole is formed in the bracket pressing ring, the second through hole is coaxial with the optical rotatory device, and a second bracket is sleeved in the second through hole; a third through hole is formed in the second bracket and coaxial with the second through hole, and a second polarization beam splitter is arranged in the third through hole. According to the utility model, the first support and the second support are rotated to drive the first polarizing beam splitter and the second polarizing beam splitter to rotate, so that the isolation degree of the optical isolator is adjusted to be maximum, and the feedback minimization of the optical system and the fixation or tuning of the wavelength range are realized.

title_en: Spectacle frame
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a spectacle frame, which comprises a spectacle frame body, wherein the left side and the right side of the spectacle frame body are respectively and movably connected with a first spectacle leg, the inner surface of the first spectacle leg is movably connected with a sliding block, the back surface of the sliding block is fixedly connected with a second spectacle leg, the spectacle frame body comprises a basal layer, the top of the basal layer is fixedly connected with a first functional layer, the first functional layer comprises a polyethylene layer and a polypropylene layer, the bottom of the basal layer is fixedly connected with a second functional layer, the second functional layer comprises a polyvinyl chloride layer and a polystyrene layer, the polypropylene layer is positioned on the upper surface of the basal layer, and the upper surface of the polypropylene layer is fixedly connected with a polyethylene layer. According to the utility model, through the arrangement of the basal layer, the first functional layer, the polyethylene layer, the polypropylene layer, the second functional layer, the polyvinyl chloride layer and the polystyrene layer, the purpose of long service life is achieved, and the problem that the conventional spectacle frame is easy to damage and affects the service life due to poor toughness is solved.

title_en: Hinge assembly and glasses
abstract_en: The application discloses a hinge assembly and glasses, which belong to the technical field of glasses, wherein the hinge assembly comprises a fixed support arm, a rotating support arm and a damper, wherein the moving support arm is rotatably connected with the fixed support arm and rotates relative to the fixed support arm so that a glasses leg connected with the rotating support arm rotates relative to a glasses frame, and the damper is accommodated in the rotating support arm; the damper comprises a cam support, a plurality of elastic pieces, wherein the plurality of elastic pieces are sleeved on the cam support and drive the cam support to butt against the rotating support arms so that the cam support can butt against the rotating support arms, damping acting force is applied to the rotating support arms, the plurality of elastic pieces are arranged on one side of an axis of a joint between the rotating support arms and the fixed support arms, damping acting force of the cam support to the rotating support arms is increased, and further damping acting force of the glasses legs relative to the glasses frame is increased.

title_en: Shielding device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a shielding device, which comprises: the main shielding shell 1, the top reed 2 and the shell bottom cover 3 are integrally bent and formed, splicing gaps are formed in two side walls of the tail part of the main shielding shell 1, and the splicing gaps are continuously or electrically overlapped at multiple points; the top reed 2 is positioned at the top of the main shielding shell 1 and is welded with the main shielding shell 1 in a plurality of points; the shell bottom cover 3 is in hard lap joint with the outer walls of the two side faces of the main shielding shell 1, the shell bottom cover 3 is used for being matched with the shielding piece when the shielding piece is installed inside the main shielding shell 1, the problem that the SFP shielding shell is formed by adopting sheet metal stamping and splicing and is fixed with a PCB (printed circuit board) in a riveting or welding mode and electromagnetic interference leakage is easy to occur can be solved, continuous or multi-point electric lap joint is implemented on a splicing gap on the main shielding shell, the electromagnetic shielding capacity of the shell can be effectively improved, the electromagnetic interference leakage of an internal circuit is reduced, and the risk of electromagnetic interference generated by the shielding piece and a peripheral sensitive circuit is avoided.

title_en: Network junction box
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a network junction box which comprises a body, wherein a plurality of cover plates for closing jacks on the body are movably arranged on the body, a driving rod for driving the cover plates to synchronously rotate is movably arranged on the body, and the cover plates are driven to move so as to be separated from the driving rod. When the network connection box provided by the utility model is needed to be inserted into the jack on the body, the drive rod is driven to rotate by the precursor, the plurality of cover plates are driven to rotate by the drive rod, the jack on the body is opened so as to facilitate the network connection to be inserted into the jack, and after the network connection is inserted, the cover plates on the jack are driven to move so as to separate from the drive rod, at the moment, the drive rod can be rotated, and the drive rod drives other cover plates to rotate so as to seal other jacks on the body and prevent dust accumulation.

title_en: VR optical module and head-mounted display equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of head-mounted display equipment, and discloses a VR optical module and the head-mounted display equipment, wherein the VR optical module comprises a base, a lens module, a display module, a rotating piece and a plurality of guide shafts; the lens module is fixedly connected with the base; the display module is arranged between the base and the lens module; the plurality of guide shafts are arranged around the display module, and the axial directions of the guide shafts are parallel to the direction of the display module pointing to the lens module; the rotating piece is rotationally connected with the base and is positioned in the region surrounded by the guide shafts, and the rotating piece is in threaded connection with the display module and is used for driving the display module to approach or depart from the lens module along the axial direction of the guide shafts. The utility model provides a current optical module is realizing transferring diopter and is leading to wear display device pupil distance accommodation limited problem and can effectively alleviate optical module weight owing to the volume is great simultaneously.

title_en: Ultraviolet laser version fiber bragg grating inscription device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an ultraviolet laser version fiber bragg grating inscription device which comprises a light source part, an inscription part and a test part, wherein the light source part comprises an ultraviolet laser light source, a small-hole diaphragm, a one-dimensional electric translation table, a 45-degree total reflection mirror and a cylindrical mirror, the inscription part comprises three-dimensional adjusting frames, two three-dimensional adjusting frames are arranged, fiber clamps are arranged on the three-dimensional adjusting frames, a mask clamping device is arranged between the two fiber clamps, the two fiber clamps respectively clamp two ends of an optical fiber, and the test part comprises an optical fiber circulator, a reflecting end monitoring device, an amplified spontaneous emission light source and a transmitting end monitoring device. The writing device is simple in structure, convenient to operate, convenient to build, capable of conducting mass industrial production, good in energy distribution uniformity, capable of writing gratings with any reflectivity, and capable of effectively improving production efficiency of the writing device.

title_en: Plasma touch display screen
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a plasma touch display screen, which relates to the technical field of liquid crystal display screens, wherein a frame is arranged on the periphery of the display screen, a connecting groove is formed in the front edge of the inner wall of the frame, a protection groove is formed in the side end of the connecting groove penetrating through the frame, and a protection component is arranged in the connecting groove and the protection groove, and the utility model has the advantages that: the inside front end of frame has offered spread groove and shield groove, utilize two sets of recesses can make the front of display screen install the protection subassembly, the protection subassembly is whole protects inside display screen, and install damping spring at the rear end of protection subassembly, damping spring mainly the joint between support column and shield groove, the display screen plays the effect of buffering impact when suffering the striking, avoid the display screen surface directly to receive the striking, when installing the protection subassembly, rotate auxiliary rod makes its joint in the inside of round hole groove, make the inside front end of frame of the stable installation of protection subassembly.

title_en: Shooting equipment fixing device and shooting device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a shooting equipment fixing device and a shooting device, which relate to the technical field of shooting equipment, wherein the shooting equipment fixing device comprises: the fixing mechanism is used for being fixedly connected with an external article and is provided with a clamping part; the switching mechanism is used for fixing shooting equipment and comprises a shell, a swinging piece and an adjusting component, wherein the swinging piece is rotationally arranged on the shell and is in clamping fit with the clamping part; when the swinging piece rotates to a second angle, the clamping part can be separated from the swinging piece. By using the shooting equipment fixing device provided by the utility model, shooting equipment can be fixed on an external object, so that the shooting equipment can be taken more conveniently.

title_en: Glasses with adjustable ear hook distance
abstract_en: The utility model discloses glasses with adjustable ear hook distance, which comprises: picture frame, mirror leg and ear hook still include: a step provided at an upper end of the ear hook; the step is attached to the bottom end of the glasses leg for positioning; the ear hook includes: an inner clip attached to an inner surface of the temple; a sliding plate provided at a head end of the inner clip; an outer pressing plate connected with the inner clamping piece through a sliding plate; the fixture block, its setting is in the junction of clamping piece and sliding plate, in daily use, through adopting above-mentioned technical scheme, through the setting of step, the effect of location has been played with the mirror leg to the ear hook lower extreme, effectually plays the supporting role and prevents to wear the time-out of position of ear hook.

title_en: Simplified gear transmission device for selenium drum
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a simplified gear transmission device for a selenium drum, which comprises a magnetic roller gear, wherein the magnetic roller gear is meshed with a primary intermediate transmission gear, and the primary intermediate transmission gear is meshed with a stirring frame gear.

title_en: Quick-mounting plate
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of photographic instruments, in particular to a quick-mounting plate. The present utility model provides a quick-mounting plate comprising: the quick-mounting plate comprises a quick-mounting plate main body, a first connecting part arranged on the side surface of the quick-mounting plate main body and a second connecting part arranged at the bottom of the quick-mounting plate main body; the first connecting part is an acarid bayonet and is used for fixing; the second connecting part is a quick-mounting socket and is used for limiting. According to the technical scheme provided by the utility model, the first connecting part and the second connecting part can be connected with different connecting structures, so that the multi-point fixing is realized, the multi-point fixing is difficult to separate from the camera body even if the multi-point fixing is subjected to larger external torsion, the fixing effect is obviously improved, the relative fixing of the camera position can be effectively ensured, the camera can be well protected, and meanwhile, the multi-point fixing device has the advantage of stable connection with other external parts. The quick-mounting plate provided by the utility model overcomes the technical defect of poor fixing effect of the commercial quick-mounting plate in the prior art.

title_en: Optical system and VR device including the same
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an optical system and VR equipment comprising the same. An optical system including a lens barrel and a lens assembly mounted in the lens barrel along an optical axisThe device comprises a planar lens, a reflective polarizing element, a quarter wave plate and a first lens which are sequentially arranged from a first side to a second side, wherein the first side of the reflective polarizing element is attached to the second side of the planar lens; the first side surface of the quarter wave plate is attached to the second side surface of the reflective polarizing element; the second side of the first lens has a partially reflective layer. The optical system further includes a display located at the second side, and an outer diameter D0s of the first side end surface of the barrel, an inner diameter D0s of the first side end surface of the barrel, an effective focal length f of the optical system, a first side surface of the first lens, and a distance TL of the display on the optical axis satisfy: 0.1<π×[(D0s/2)  2  ‑(d0s/2)  2  ]/(f×TL)<2.5。

title_en: Backlight circuit board and display
abstract_en: The backlight circuit board comprises at least one backlight control chip and at least one light emitting area, wherein each light emitting area comprises light emitting units distributed in an array, each backlight control chip is arranged in the edge area of the backlight circuit board, each backlight control chip is electrically connected with each light emitting unit in the corresponding light emitting area, the number of the backlight control chips is the same as that of the light emitting areas, the backlight circuit board integrates the backlight control chips and the light emitting units contained in the original backlight circuit on one circuit board, the production cost of a backlight control board is saved, the structure of the circuit board is simplified, the line complexity is reduced, the production yield of the circuit board is improved, meanwhile, the backlight circuit board integrates the backlight control chips and the light emitting units on one circuit board, the length of connecting lines between the backlight control chips and the light emitting units is shortened, and the line loss caused by wiring length and the signal interference between the connecting lines are reduced.

title_en: Three-axis stability-enhanced waterproof double-light integrated cradle head nacelle for fire rescue
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a triaxial stability-enhanced waterproof double-light integrated cradle head nacelle for fire rescue, which relates to the technical field of fire rescue and comprises a rotary support assembly, wherein a support fixing assembly is fixedly arranged on the surface of the rotary support assembly, a waterproof protection assembly is fixedly arranged on the bottom surface of the rotary support assembly, and a heat dissipation and cooling device is fixedly arranged on the surface of the waterproof protection assembly. According to the utility model, the integrated waterproof protection cylinder is arranged outside the double-light camera device, so that the double-light camera device is effectively prevented from being influenced by water in use by the protection of the integrated assembly, and the safety performance of the equipment is improved; the water evaporation device is arranged at the bottom of the inner cavity of the integrated waterproof protection cylinder, and can be started to perform water evaporation operation when the humidity in the cylinder rises by a certain index, so that the internal water vapor is completely evaporated, and the double-light camera device is damaged due to overhigh waterproof component to influence the fire rescue operation.

title_en: Laser receiving and transmitting module
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a laser receiving and transmitting module, comprising: the optical module comprises a bracket and a plurality of lenses, two light-passing channels are formed in the bracket at intervals, the lenses are arranged in the two light-passing channels, and the lenses and the bracket are made of the same material and are integrally formed through in-mold injection molding; the laser receiving and transmitting module comprises a laser transmitting module and a laser receiving module, the laser transmitting module and the laser receiving module are in one-to-one correspondence with the two light-transmitting channels, the laser transmitting module can transmit outgoing laser which penetrates through the lens along the extending direction of the corresponding light-transmitting channel, and the laser receiving module can receive incident laser which penetrates through the lens along the extending direction of the corresponding light-transmitting channel. Through with lens and support with the same material in-mold injection integrated into one piece for optical module becomes a overall structure and directly assembles with laser transceiver module, need not to assemble lens and support, has reduced the equipment degree of difficulty, has improved production efficiency, makes overall structure's stability, reliability and structure precision promote.

title_en: Microscope objective lens converter
abstract_en: The utility model provides a microscope objective lens converter, which relates to the technical field of objective lens converters, wherein a connecting structure is formed by a swivel and a conversion head, the interior of the conversion head and the interior of the swivel are provided with screw holes in an annular array, the screw holes are connecting holes, the problem that the conventional general free rotation state is solved, but when the microscope objective lens converter is in the free rotation state, the normal observation effect is influenced due to the fact that an objective lens is displaced in the use process due to the lack of an effective limiting structure is easily caused, the problem of limitation exists, the objective lens assembly is rapidly switched through the rotation of the conversion head, and after the objective lens assembly is switched, a brake rod is released, so that the brake rod is automatically reset through a reset spring to be contacted with the swivel, the rapid locking limiting work is realized, and the aim of being more practical is achieved.

title_en: Camera accessory and camera system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a camera accessory and a camera system, wherein the camera accessory is configured to be mounted to a camera body with a first mounting seat; the first mounting seat is provided with a plurality of first contacts, and the first contacts have height variation in the axial direction of the first mounting seat; the camera accessory includes: the second mounting seat is configured to be in clamping connection with the first mounting seat; the contact retainer is arranged on the inner annular surface of the second mounting seat; the contact holder is provided with a plurality of second contacts on a holding surface facing the first mount, the second contacts being configured to be electrically connected with the first contacts; the second contacts are flush with the holding surface, and the holding surface is a smooth surface formed according to the height variation trend of the plurality of first contacts. The camera accessory can be adapted to a camera body with a height difference contact, and has simple manufacturing process and lower cost.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted camera
abstract_en: The embodiment of the utility model provides a vehicle-mounted camera which comprises a shell, a lens assembled on one side wall of the shell, a control circuit board and a defogging module, wherein the control circuit board and the defogging module are assembled in the shell, the defogging module comprises a heating component, a power supply port is arranged on the control circuit board, an installation groove is formed in the position, close to the lens, of the inner surface of the shell, and the heating component is connected with the power supply port, assembled in the installation groove and attached to the lens. According to the utility model, the heating component is arranged in the accommodating space of the shell and is assembled in the mounting groove of the shell corresponding to the lens, and the heating component is electrically connected with the power supply port of the control circuit board in the shell, so that the heating component is attached to the outer side wall of the lens to carry out heating defogging, and the heating component with the simple structure can be used on the basis of not affecting the structure of the lens, so that the assembly of the vehicle-mounted camera is facilitated, and the use cost is reduced.

title_en: Microscope objective table translation control hand wheel
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a microscope stage translation control hand wheel, comprising: the rotary knob I and the gear I are coaxially and fixedly arranged at two ends of the central shaft; the sleeve shaft is coaxially and rotatably sleeved outside the central shaft, and a knob II and a gear II are coaxially and fixedly arranged at two ends of the sleeve shaft; the shaft tube is positioned between the central shaft and the sleeve shaft and is coaxially and rotatably connected with the central shaft and the sleeve shaft; the mounting seat is rotatably sleeved outside the central shaft and is connected with the shaft tube; the first gear and the second gear are helical teeth. The beneficial effects are that: the microscope stage translation control hand wheel is compact in structure, simple, convenient and quick to operate, capable of moving and adjusting the position of the glass slide permanently and stably with high precision, high in reliability, and capable of effectively solving the problems of shaking of the glass slide, low positioning accuracy, time-consuming positioning, low efficiency, unclear image capturing and the like in actual operation.

title_en: Intelligent glasses of adjustable mobile terminal height
abstract_en: The utility model provides an intelligent glasses capable of adjusting the height of a mobile terminal, which comprises: a lens frame on which a left lens and a right lens are disposed; brackets positioned on the left side and the right side of the lens frame, and the brackets are movably arranged on the lens frame; the fixing piece is connected with one end of the bracket far away from the lens frame, and a containing groove for containing the mobile terminal is formed between the fixing piece and the bracket; the locking structure is positioned between the bracket and the lens frame and is used for unlocking or locking the bracket under the action of external force. The utility model can adjust the height of the fixed slot for accommodating the mobile terminal according to the size of the mobile terminal, so that the parallax image on the mobile terminal is properly projected onto the lens, and the utility model has strong adaptability, good user experience, simple structure and low production cost.

title_en: Laser repairing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a laser repairing device, which comprises: a base; the bearing unit is positioned above the base and is configured to bear the module to be repaired; the laser unit is positioned above the bearing unit and is configured to provide laser with selected power; the bearing unit comprises a plurality of bearing components, the bearing components comprise bearing columns with grooves and driving units, the driving units drive the bearing columns to rotate so that the surfaces of the bearing columns, including the grooves, or the surfaces, not including the grooves, are used as surfaces, away from the base, of the bearing units, when the surfaces, not including the grooves, of the bearing columns are used as surfaces, away from the base, of the bearing units, the bearing units can bear the liquid crystal panel, when the module to be repaired is selected from a photomask, the grooves of the bearing columns are located on one side, away from the base, of the bearing units, and the grooves form a containing space on the surfaces, away from the base, of the bearing units, so that the photomask can be placed.

title_en: Modularized optical fiber access structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a modularized optical fiber access structure, which comprises a shell, wherein a shell cover is arranged at the top of the shell, a plurality of screws are fixedly connected between the shell cover and the shell, and two mounting plates are fixedly connected at the center of the shell; an optical transmitting and receiving assembly is fixedly connected between the two mounting plates, an optical fiber cable is mounted on one side of the shell, a wire plugging hole is formed in the other side of the shell, and a locking assembly is arranged in the center of the shell; according to the utility model, through the locking assembly, the optical fiber can be limited by the two locking frames after being connected, and the optical fiber cable can have higher stability after being connected due to the elastic force of the strong spring to squeeze the optical fiber cable, so that the optical fiber cable has a better use effect; through the sealing washer that sets up for the junction of fiber cable and shell can possess higher leakproofness, prevents that moisture from getting into the shell center, has promoted fiber cable's life, has promoted user's result of use simultaneously.

title_en: End protection assembly of optical fiber cable
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of optical fiber cables, in particular to an end protection assembly of an optical fiber cable, which comprises a first connecting sleeve and a second connecting sleeve which can be separated or close to each other, wherein two tightening arc openings for the optical fiber cable to pass through are formed on one sides of the first connecting sleeve and the second connecting sleeve which are close to each other, a positioning notch is formed on one side of each tightening arc opening, a protective cover is arranged on one side of each first connecting sleeve and one side of each second connecting sleeve and is used for accommodating capillaries at two ends of the optical fiber cable, two ends of the optical fiber cable can be clamped in the two tightening arc openings simultaneously through the arrangement of the first connecting sleeve and the second connecting sleeve which can be close to and separated from each other, the protective cover is clamped on one side of the first connecting sleeve and one side of the second connecting sleeve, the protective cover can sleeve the capillaries at two ends of the optical fiber cable, and simultaneously provides anti-pressure protection for the capillaries at two ends of the optical fiber cable, and the protective cover is simple to operate and convenient to use.

title_en: Adjustable opening touch-press switch for laser printer processing box
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an adjustable opening touch switch of a laser printer processing box, which comprises a processing box shell and a touch plate, and is characterized in that: the touch pressing plate is fixedly connected with the processing box shell through the movable buckle mechanism. The touch pressing plate is fixedly connected with the processing box shell through the movable buckle mechanism, so that the position of the touch pressing plate on the processing box shell can be adjusted through the movable buckle mechanism, and the touch pressing plate corresponds to the position of the elastic switch key in the printer shell to be installed, so that a processing box corresponds to multiple printers, compatibility is realized, cost is saved, and follow-up inventory management is simplified.

title_en: Light guide plate with excellent optical characteristics
abstract_en: The utility model provides a light guide plate with excellent optical characteristics, which comprises a light guide plate, wherein the light guide plate comprises a light emitting plate, a light shielding frame plate and a reflecting top plate, the middle part of the bottom surface of the reflecting top plate is fixedly connected with a reflecting assembly, and the reflecting assembly comprises a connecting wire and a reflecting hopper. When the light source is started, the light source light rays are uniformly reflected to the bottom of the light guide plate through the reflection inclined plane, the light guide points uniformly emit light, the bottom of the light source irradiation port is provided with the reflection assembly, the reflection hopper of the reflection assembly is fixedly connected through the connecting wires and is made of semi-transparent materials, the light intensity of the light source directly irradiating the light emitting plate below the light source can be weakened, the reflection hopper can reflect the light rays directly irradiating the light source to a certain extent, and the reflection angle of the reflection hopper is controlled to enable the light rays reflected by the reflection hopper to irradiate the tail end of the reflection inclined plane so as to supplement the intensity of the light rays reflected by the tail end of the reflection inclined plane, so that the light guide of the whole light guide plate is more uniform.

title_en: Novel single-sided perspective mirror
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel single-sided perspective mirror, which comprises: a lens, a polaroid, a wave plate and a second lens; the lens, the polaroid, the wave plate and the second lens are sequentially arranged side by side, one side where the lens is positioned is a perspective side, natural light sequentially penetrates through the lens and the polaroid and then becomes linearly polarized light I, then becomes circularly polarized light after penetrating through the wave plate and is reflected by the second lens and then becomes linearly polarized light II after penetrating through the wave plate, and the polarization angle of the linearly polarized light II is perpendicular to that of the polaroid; the side where the second lens is located is a mirror side, natural light on the mirror side irradiates the second lens, one part of light is directly reflected, and the other part of light is changed into linearly polarized light III through the wave plate and the polarizing plate after passing through the second lens, and then is observed by an observer on the perspective side through the lens. Compared with the traditional single-sided perspective mirror, the utility model has higher luminous efficacy and wider applicable conditions, and one side has the effect of mirror reflection and the other side has the effect of black perspective glass.

title_en: Positioning structure of selenium drum transmission head
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a positioning structure of a selenium drum transmission head, which comprises a drum core bearing plate, wherein a positioning hole in running fit with the transmission head is formed in the drum core bearing plate. The utility model integrates the positioning holes matched with the transmission head on the drum core bearing plate, can reduce the number of parts, not only reduce the production cost, but also avoid the problem of poor stability of the transmission head caused by the problems of a split structure or an assembly method, and improve the product quality.

title_en: CT film reading device with CT film protecting function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a CT film reading device with a CT film protecting function, which relates to the technical field of film reading devices and comprises an outer frame, wherein an observation window is arranged on the outer wall of the outer frame, a transparent shell is inserted into the outer frame, a first supporting block is arranged on the outer frame, a sliding block is arranged in a sliding way in a rotating column, a sliding rod is arranged on the sliding block, an adjusting shell is arranged on the sliding rod, a third supporting block is arranged on the adjusting shell, a threaded rod is arranged in the third supporting block in a rotating way, a rotating handle is arranged on the threaded rod, a threaded block is sleeved on the outer wall thread of the threaded rod, a connecting block is arranged on the threaded block, a film reading lamp is arranged on the connecting block, an adjusting hole is formed in the adjusting shell, and the connecting block is arranged on the adjusting hole in a sliding way. According to the utility model, through the design of the mechanisms such as the slide bar, the adjusting shell, the threaded rod, the threaded block, the reading lamp and the like, the positions of lesions on the CT film can be independently illuminated, the positions of the lesions can be more intuitively researched, and medical staff can be helped to diagnose the diseases.

title_en: Backlight structure with isolation layer and display module
abstract_en: The present utility model relates to the field of display backlight technology, and in particular, to a backlight structure with an isolation layer and a display module. A backlight structure with isolation layers comprises an LED lamp, a reflecting film, a light guide plate and a rubber frame for supporting, wherein the isolation layers arranged in the middle of the backlight structure along the direction perpendicular to the rubber frame divide the backlight structure into an upper display area and a lower light-emitting area; the reflective film is paved from top to bottom along the inner side of the rubber iron frame and downwards extends into the light-emitting area through the isolating layer; the light guide plate is arranged in the display area and covers the reflecting film positioned in the display area; light of the LED lamp upwards enters the display area through the transparent isolation layer; the isolation layer blocks debris and foreign matters from entering the display area from the light-emitting area. According to the utility model, the separation layer can effectively separate the backlight structure, the broken backlight FPC in the assembly process cannot enter the display area of the upper layer, meanwhile, the transparent area in the middle of the separation layer cannot influence the light of the LED lamp to enter the display area of the upper layer, and the display effect cannot be influenced.

title_en: Light guide plate with concave-convex panel structure
abstract_en: The utility model provides a light guide plate with a concave-convex panel structure, which relates to the technical field of light guide plates and comprises a connecting frame, wherein a light guide plate body is arranged in the middle of the inside of the connecting frame, and concave-convex surfaces are respectively arranged on the upper side and the lower side of the inside of the connecting frame; and a connecting mechanism is arranged between the connecting frame and the concave-convex surface. According to the utility model, the concave-convex surface and the light guide plate body are connected and installed through the connecting mechanism, so that the concave-convex surface and the light guide plate body are tightly attached, the concave-convex surface is convenient to cooperate with the light guide plate body to conduct light guide dispersion work, then when the reflecting angle of the light guide plate body needs to be adjusted, the adjustment work of the light guide plate body can be realized only by adjusting or replacing the concave-convex surface, and therefore the light guide plate body does not need to be replaced, the practical cost of the light guide plate body is greatly reduced, and the concave-convex surface and the light guide plate body are tightly attached through the clamping connection between the positioning hole and the positioning rod.

title_en: Sample stage suitable for front-mounted optical microscope
abstract_en: The utility model provides a sample stage suitable for a front-mounted optical microscope, comprising: the sample bin is of a hollow structure, the middle part of the sample bin is provided with a cavity penetrating through the top surface and the bottom surface, the cavity is formed by an upper cylinder and a lower cylinder which are different in diameter and coaxial, the diameter of the upper cylinder is smaller than that of the lower cylinder, and a shaft shoulder is formed between the two cylinders; the cavity is used for placing the reflecting light sheet sample, wherein the front side of the reflecting light sheet sample is upwards placed in the cavity of the sample bin, and the front side of the reflecting light sheet sample is attached to the shaft shoulder; the middle part of base is installed the spring, the spring inserts in the cavity, and the top of spring is used for supporting the back of the reflection light piece sample of placing in tight cavity, the base passes through a plurality of screws with the sample bin and links to each other. The utility model can effectively lighten the focusing intensity during the observation of the sample, improve the imaging quality, improve the working efficiency and simultaneously facilitate the later image processing.

title_en: Optical imaging system
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to optical imaging systems. The optical imaging system includes: a first lens group having a negative refractive power; a second lens group having a positive refractive power; and a third lens group having a negative refractive power, wherein the second lens group and the third lens group are configured to move in an optical axis direction to adjust a focal length and magnification, and satisfy the following conditional expression: FNOt is less than or equal to 3.6, wherein FNOt is the F value of the optical imaging system at the telephoto end.

title_en: Vehicle display system and vehicle
abstract_en: The embodiment of the utility model discloses a vehicle display system and a vehicle, wherein the vehicle display system comprises: the video generation chip is used for outputting video signals; a digital signal processor connected with the video generation chip and used for compressing the resolution of the video signal; and the display screen is connected with the digital signal processor and used for displaying the video signal compressed by the digital signal processor, and the resolution of the display screen is smaller than that of the video signal. The utility model can meet the display requirements of users and improve the user experience.

title_en: Prism mounting device for multi-method compound monitoring
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a prism installation device for multi-method compound monitoring, which comprises a protection mechanism and a monitoring mechanism, wherein the protection mechanism covers the outside of the monitoring mechanism. The prism installation device for multi-method compound monitoring can be suitable for valley amplitude string line measuring points and can also monitor front intersection at the same time. Meanwhile, two kinds of monitoring equipment are not required to be maintained respectively during daily maintenance, and the method is simple and convenient. Leveling is realized through leveling bubbles and leveling bolts, errors are reduced, and monitoring accuracy is improved. And the device protects the prism through the protection cylinder, so that the prism is prevented from being exposed outside for a long time and being interfered by external factors.

title_en: Artificial intelligence VR device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of VR, in particular to an artificial intelligent VR device, which comprises a shell, wherein an equipment cavity is formed in one side of the shell, an internal equipment box is fixedly arranged in the equipment cavity, two mirror grooves are formed in the outer wall of one side of the internal equipment box, observation mirror frames are fixedly arranged on the inner walls of the two mirror grooves, observation mirrors are arranged in the two observation mirror frames, and mounting grooves are formed in the two ends of the outer wall of the other side of the internal equipment box. According to the utility model, the worm wheel disc and the concave mirror are driven to rotate in the mounting groove by utilizing the meshing effect of the worm and the worm wheel disc, so that different concave mirrors can be matched with the first observation hole, when a myopic user wears the VR glasses, pictures in the VR glasses can be adjusted according to the eyesight of the user, the user can see clearly the simulation environment inside, the effect of being in the scene is achieved, and the experience effect of the whole VR device is improved.

title_en: Optical fiber quick connector
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of optical fiber mechanical connecting devices, in particular to an optical fiber quick connector, which aims at solving the problems that matching paste for the existing optical fiber quick connector is in a non-sealing state and is easy to volatilize, so that the matching paste is invalid after the time is long; the coupling body is arranged in the stopper, a spring is arranged between the inner frame sleeve and the stopper, the spring is sleeved on the circumferential surface of the coupling body, a V-shaped groove is formed in the coupling body, and a V-shaped groove cover plate is clamped in the V-shaped groove; the sealing part provides a sealed space for the connection part of the embedded optical fiber and the field optical fiber, and matching paste is injected into the sealed space, so that the volatilization or reaction of the matching paste caused by the open space can be prevented.

title_en: Double-rotation lens system
abstract_en: The application provides a dual-rotation lens system, which comprises a lens module, a driving module and a supporting module, wherein the lens module comprises a first lens group, a second lens group, a first ball bearing, a second ball bearing, a front lens barrel, a convex lens and a rear lens barrel which are arranged along the incidence direction of an optical path; the driving module comprises a first driving group and a second driving group, and the first driving group is matched with the first lens group and can apply driving force to the first lens group to drive the first lens group to rotate; the second driving group can apply driving force to the front lens barrel to drive the front lens barrel to rotate; the support module is matched with the outer wall of the second ball bearing and is used for supporting the whole double-rotation lens system, and the modulation function of a single light source can be realized by independently controlling the angular position relation of the corresponding lens group, so that the purpose of completing optical imaging by multiple characteristic lights is achieved. The system has the advantages of high flexibility, high stability, high economical efficiency and the like.

title_en: Device for calibrating left trapezoid and right trapezoid
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a device for calibrating a left trapezoid and a right trapezoid, and belongs to the technical field of projectors. An apparatus for calibrating a left trapezoid and a right trapezoid, comprising a base, further comprising: the projector comprises a projector body, a base, a bearing plate, a driving block, a connecting rod, a rotating seat II, a connecting rod and a driving block, wherein one end of the bearing plate is rotatably connected to the base; the base is rotationally connected with a screw rod, the screw rod is in threaded connection with the driving block, and the base is provided with a driving part for driving the screw rod to rotate; according to the utility model, one end of the bearing plate is rotationally connected to the base, the screw is used for driving the bearing plate to rotate around the rotation shaft of the first rotating seat, so that the angle adjustment of the bearing plate can be realized, the adjustment is convenient, the adjustment precision is high, the adjustment efficiency is improved, the integral movement is facilitated, and the use effect is improved.

title_en: Program-controlled high-power stroboscopic light source driver
abstract_en: The application discloses program-controlled high-power stroboscopic light source driver, including master controller, communication module, reference current digital adjustable module and constant current source module, communication module with reference current digital adjustable module respectively with the master controller is connected, constant current source module connect in between reference current digital adjustable module and the light source. The beneficial effects of the application are as follows: compared with the prior art, the LED lamp has the advantages of on-line adjustability of light source current and light emitting mode, and the like, and application occasions are more flexible; the multi-stage brightness adjustment can be realized remotely for the light source, the switch of the light source can be controlled remotely, and the service life of the light source can be greatly prolonged; the device can also drive the stroboscopic light sources with different spectrums according to a certain stroboscopic time sequence so as to help the industrial camera to obtain various characteristic data.

title_en: Beam adjusting device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a light beam adjusting device and electronic equipment, wherein the light beam adjusting device comprises a light source, an adjusting module and a first lens, wherein the light source, the adjusting module and the first lens are sequentially stacked along a first direction and are arranged at intervals, the light source is used for emitting light, and the adjusting module is used for adjusting the angle of the light which irradiates the adjusting module and is emitted through the adjusting module according to a first voltage signal and a second voltage signal; the first lens comprises a body, a first extension part and a second extension part, the first extension part and the second extension part extend from two opposite sides of the body along a direction away from the first direction towards one side where the adjusting module is located, the body, the first extension part and the second extension part are enclosed to form an accommodating space, the orthographic projection range of the accommodating space on the body is covered by the orthographic projection range of the adjusting module on the body, the inner side wall of the accommodating space formed by the first lens is used for receiving light rays adjusted by the adjusting module, so that the light rays are refracted and reflected in the first lens for multiple times and then exit at an emergent angle through the emergent surface of the first lens.

title_en: Optical path turning element, imaging lens module and electronic device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a light path turning element, which comprises an optical part, a connecting part, a plurality of extinction structures and a shading layer. The optical portion has an optical surface, a first reflecting surface and a second reflecting surface. The light rays are injected into the light path turning element through the optical surface and are reflected once in the light path turning element through the optical surface. The first reflecting surface and the second reflecting surface are respectively used for reflecting the light rays in the light path turning element. The connecting part is provided with a plurality of connecting surfaces for connecting the optical surface, the first reflecting surface and the second reflecting surface. The extinction structure is at least arranged at the connecting part and integrally formed with the connecting part. The single structure of the extinction structure gradually reduces from the surface of the connecting part to the inside of the light path turning element, so that the surface of the connecting part is concave-convex. The shading layer is at least arranged on the surface of the connecting part and used for shading light rays to pass through. The utility model also discloses an imaging lens module with the light path turning element and an electronic device with the imaging lens module.

title_en: Light source frame for physical experiments
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a light source frame for physical experiments, which relates to the technical field of physical experiment equipment and comprises an experiment box, wherein a lens plate is connected to the inner wall of the experiment box in a sliding manner, a light shielding plate is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the experiment box, and a light source plate is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the experiment box; the inner wall sliding connection of slip box has the sliding plate. The utility model has reasonable design structure, the sliding box can drive the lens plate to move to the approximate position through the fixing mechanism, then the positioning mechanism drives the rotating shaft to rotate, the rope winding shaft drives the sliding plate to move through the fixing rope, and the sliding plate drives the lens plate to conduct fine adjustment under the cooperation of the elastic mechanism, so that the lens plate moves to the accurate position, the effect of fine adjustment on the lens plate is achieved, and the problems that the conventional light source frame cannot conduct fine adjustment normally and has lower adjustment precision and inconvenient use are solved.

title_en: AI glasses
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of intelligent wearing, and belongs to AI (advanced technology) glasses, which comprise an AI glasses body, wherein a glasses frame is fixedly arranged in the AI glasses body, glasses legs are fixedly arranged at two ends of the AI glasses body, a fixed groove is formed in each glasses leg, an expansion arc is fixedly arranged in the fixed groove, an air bag is fixedly arranged in the expansion arc, an adjusting mechanism for adjusting the air pressure in the air bag is arranged in each glasses leg, and a limiting mechanism for controlling the adjusting mechanism is arranged on each glasses leg; through the rotation of rotatory piece, rotatory piece drives the lug and rotates, makes lug and gasbag contact, and the lug extrudes the gasbag to control gasbag internal gas, and then make expansion arc inflation or shrink, adjust the distance between two mirror leg insides, be applicable to the crowd of different facial forms, avoided changing the operation of mirror leg repeatedly to different crowds.

title_en: Camera module and head-mounted display device
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a camera module and a head-mounted display device, and belongs to the technical field of head-mounted display devices. The camera module is applied to the head-mounted display equipment and comprises a camera, an image processing assembly and a USB interface component. The image processing component is respectively and electrically connected with the camera and the USB interface component, and is used for packaging the image shot by the camera into a USB UVC format and then sending the USB UVC format to a controller in the head-mounted display device through the USB interface component. Because the USB interface component is a universal interface, when the camera module is applied to different types of head-mounted display equipment, debugging is not needed again, and the application range of the camera module is enlarged.

title_en: Multi-film laminated lens based on free ring surface
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multi-film laminated lens based on a free ring surface, which has the technical scheme that the multi-film laminated lens comprises: the anti-ultraviolet lens comprises a free torus substrate, wherein a front abrasion-resistant thick film layer is plated on the top surface of the free torus substrate, a blue light-resistant film layer is plated on the top surface of the front abrasion-resistant thick film layer, an anti-ultraviolet film layer is plated on the top surface of the anti-ultraviolet film layer, an anti-reflection film layer is plated on the top surface of the anti-reflection film layer, a front anti-fouling film layer is plated on the top surface of the anti-dazzle film layer, a rear abrasion-resistant thick film layer is plated on the bottom surface of the free torus substrate, and a multi-layer protective film is plated on the bottom surface of the free torus substrate, so that light reflected by a lens is reduced, the light transmittance of the lens is improved, the blue light-resistant performance of the lens is improved, ultraviolet light entering eyes of a user can be effectively prevented, the high transmittance, abrasion resistance, blue light resistance, ultraviolet resistance and dust resistance are integrated, and the practicability of the lens in various scenes is greatly improved.

title_en: Extension arm device for oral microscope
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an extension arm device for an oral microscope, which comprises a main transverse connecting arm fixed on the top end of a vertical support column, and is characterized in that: a first connecting shaft part is inserted into a through hole in the bottom plate at the left end of the main transverse connecting arm, the first connecting shaft part is movably connected to the main transverse connecting arm through a bearing, and a first elastic protective sleeve is clamped on the inner side wall of a vertical through hole in the middle of the first connecting shaft part; the bottom end of the first connecting shaft part is fixed on the top surface of the right part of the second transverse connecting arm below the bottom end of the first connecting shaft part, and the bottom end of the first elastic protective sleeve of the first connecting shaft part is communicated with the upper through hole on the top plate of the right part of the second transverse connecting arm. The inner parts of the control signal connecting wire and the like are sleeved in the inner parts of the first elastic protective sleeve, the second elastic protective sleeve, the transverse elastic protective sleeve and the like, so that the control signal connecting wire and the like cannot be worn out by contacting with the outer metal parts, the service life is prolonged, normal use is ensured, and maintenance is reduced.

title_en: Optical reticle scribe line coloring apparatus
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an adjustable optical reticle line coloring device, in particular to an optical reticle line coloring device, which comprises a base, wherein two lifting frames are fixedly connected to the left side and the right side of the upper surface of the base respectively, lifting components are arranged in the lifting frames, the front surface and the back surface of the inner wall of each lifting frame are respectively in sliding connection with the front surface and the back surface of a mounting block, the opposite surfaces of the two mounting blocks are respectively fixedly connected with the left side and the right side of a movable frame, four clamping plates are driven by four cylinders to mutually approach to position a reticle and fix the reticle at the center of a placing plate, a servo motor a drives a gear b and a gear a to rotate, and the gear a rotates to drive a connecting column and the placing plate to adjust the azimuth, so that a line coloring mechanism is convenient to line coloring, and the problem that the positioning mechanism of the traditional device cannot automatically operate when in use is solved, and the using convenience of the positioning mechanism is reduced.

title_en: Head-mounted display device
abstract_en: The application provides a head-mounted display device, which comprises a display shell, wherein the headrest shell is arranged opposite to the display shell; the headrest shell comprises an assembly space and two assembly grooves, wherein the two assembly grooves are positioned at two end parts of the headrest shell and are communicated with the assembly space; the adjusting gear is positioned in the assembly space and is rotatably connected to the headrest housing; the end part of each head belt comprises a rack, and the two racks penetrate through the assembly groove and are respectively meshed with the two sides of the adjusting gear; the folding and unfolding shaft is rotatably connected to the headrest shell; one end of the top belt is connected to the display shell, and the other end of the top belt is wound on the winding and unwinding shaft; the first rotating roller can be attached to the top belt, so that the first rotating roller can be driven to rotate when the top belt is retracted; the first rotating roller is indirectly connected to the adjusting gear through a linkage device; when the winding and unwinding shaft is rotated, the top belt is wound or turned out, so that the first rotating roller drives the adjusting gear to rotate through the linkage device, and the adjusting gear is used for driving the two racks to approach or separate.

title_en: Antireflection film, display screen and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an antireflection film, a display screen and electronic equipment. The anti-reflection and anti-reflection film specifically comprises: a plurality of first refractive layers and a plurality of second refractive layers; the refractive index of the first refractive layer is smaller than that of the second refractive layer, the first refractive layer and the second refractive layer are alternately arranged, and the first reflectivity of the antireflection film in a first wave band is larger than that in a second wave band; the light of the first wave band is used for fingerprint identification, and the first reflectivity is the reflectivity of the light signal when the light signal is incident to air from the anti-reflection film. In the embodiment of the application, the anti-reflection film can meet the requirements of enhancing display and under-screen fingerprint imaging.

title_en: Take insurance anticreep formula cloud platform holder
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a safe anti-falling holder, which comprises a holder, wherein the holder comprises a holder body and a clamping plate movably arranged on the holder body, the holder is movably connected with a locking spanner used for driving the clamping plate to move relative to the holder body, the locking spanner is provided with a matching groove, and a locking element which is mutually locked with the matching groove is movably arranged on the clamping plate. Compared with the prior art, the locking element is locked with the matching groove, so that unlocking caused by external force action of the locking spanner can be avoided, the connection stability of the clamping seat and the holder is ensured, damage to objects caused by random unlocking is avoided, and the use requirement of a user is met.

title_en: Auxiliary device for installing optical fiber cable
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an auxiliary device for installing an optical fiber cable, which comprises an installation sheet, wherein a fixing groove is fixed at the top end of the installation sheet, a movable groove is arranged at the top end of the fixing groove, connecting layers are fixed on the inner sides of the fixing groove and the inner sides of the movable groove, rubber gaskets are fixed on the inner sides of the connecting layers, fixing holes are formed in two sides of the inner part of the fixing groove, locking holes are formed in two sides of the inner part of the movable groove, installation holes are formed in two sides of the inner part of the installation sheet, and clamping grooves are formed in the side edges of the top of the locking holes. According to the utility model, the rubber pad is arranged at the top of the locking hole during installation, the clamping ring is clamped into the clamping groove, the rubber pad is fixed at the top of the locking hole, the positioning bolt can be installed into the fixing hole through the rubber pad and the locking hole, the movable groove can be fixed on the fixing groove, the rubber pad plays a role in protection, and the locking hole can be prevented from being worn.

title_en: Sealing device applied to projector
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sealing device applied to a projector, which comprises: the inside of the shell is divided into a containing cavity and a heat conducting cavity for installing and placing the projector through a partition plate, the partition plate faces the wedge-shaped surface of the shell, and the top of the shell is provided with a hot air outlet communicated with the containing cavity and the heat conducting cavity and a cold air inlet communicated with the containing cavity; the cooling mechanism is arranged above the shell and used for cooling hot air exhausted by the shell and comprises a fan communicated with a hot air exhaust port, a cooling cavity with a semiconductor refrigerating sheet arranged at the top and a connecting cavity communicated with a cold air inlet. The utility model can realize the flow of air flow in the whole shell, the surface of the projector and the full coverage of heat dissipation, so that the heat dissipation is uniform and efficient, the surrounding temperature of the projector is kept at a lower value, the heat exchange is quicker, the projector temperature meets the requirement of efficient operation, the whole shell is sealed, and the external water vapor and dust are prevented from entering to influence the use of the projector.

title_en: Microscope multi-angle adjustment mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multi-angle adjusting mechanism of a microscope, which comprises a mounting ring and a multi-angle adjusting mechanism, wherein the multi-angle adjusting mechanism comprises a guide rod, a first connecting piece, a second connecting piece, a third connecting piece and a fourth connecting piece, a first bending piece is arranged on the first connecting piece, a first connecting hole is formed between the first bending piece and the first connecting piece, the second connecting piece is provided with a connecting rod, the fourth connecting piece is provided with a second connecting hole and a guide groove, the mounting ring is provided with a sliding block, the rotating freedom degree of the microscope is increased, the microscope can observe a workpiece from more angles, the detection is more comprehensive, and the detection accuracy is improved.

title_en: Crystal filling device
abstract_en: The application belongs to the field of liquid crystal display, and particularly provides a crystal filling device, which comprises a back plate, a panel and a magnetic supporting component, wherein the back plate is provided with a first accommodating groove, a second accommodating groove and a third accommodating groove, the second accommodating groove is positioned below the first accommodating groove, and the third accommodating groove is positioned at one side of the bottom of the first accommodating groove; the panel is covered on the back plate and surrounds the back plate to form a crystal filling cavity; the magnetic support assembly comprises an inner magnetic attraction piece and an outer magnetic attraction piece which are in magnetic attraction fit, the inner magnetic attraction piece is located in the crystal filling cavity, the outer magnetic attraction piece is located on one side, far away from the crystal filling cavity, of the panel, the inner magnetic attraction piece comprises a support state and an idle state, the inner magnetic attraction piece is located at the bottom of the first accommodating groove and can support target glass in the support state, and the inner magnetic attraction piece is located in the third accommodating groove in the idle state. Under the premise of ensuring the reliable crystal filling quality of the target glass, the crystal filling device can be simplified, the manufacturing cost of the device is low, and the device is better suitable for small-scale use scenes.

title_en: Self-locking camera quick-hanging device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a self-locking camera quick-hanging device, which comprises a base and a connecting seat, wherein a self-locking device is arranged in an inner cavity of the base, the self-locking device comprises a key, a U-shaped pressing rod, a buckle and a base, the base is fixed on the bottom surface of the inner cavity of the base, an n-shaped plate is arranged on the top surface of the base, the buckle is fixed on the top surface of the n-shaped plate, a first inclined surface is arranged at the top of the buckle, a guide groove is arranged on the top surface of the base, clamping grooves matched with protruding ends of the buckle are formed in the periphery of the bottom surface of the connecting seat, three limiting blocks are arranged at the edge of the top surface of the base, a limiting space is formed by the limiting blocks and the buckle, the top surface of the inner wall of the limiting block is inwards turned and is contacted with the top surface of the connecting seat, a through hole penetrating through the inner surface and the outer surface is formed in the middle of the connecting seat, and a bolt is arranged in the through hole.

title_en: High-efficiency particulate air filter with static electricity removing function and exposure machine
abstract_en: The utility model provides a high-efficiency particulate air filter with a static electricity removing function and an exposure machine, comprising: the filter body is internally provided with a HEPA filter screen; the air outlet cover plate is arranged at one side of an air outlet of the HEPA filter screen, a plurality of through holes are formed in the air outlet cover plate, and the through holes are distributed in an array manner; the ion discharge network comprises a plurality of ion discharge needles which are arranged on one side of the air outlet cover plate, which is far away from the HEPA filter screen, and the positions of the ion discharge needles are not overlapped with the projection of the through holes on the air outlet cover plate in the air outlet direction. The beneficial effects are that: the ion discharge grid is provided with one side of the air outlet cover plate far away from the HEPA filter screen, so that the ion airflow is prevented from self-neutralizing when reaching the air outlet of the air outlet cover plate, and the number of positive and negative ions in the airflow is reduced; in addition, the position of the ion discharge needle avoids the through hole on the air outlet cover plate, and avoids the influence on the wind speed and the wind direction of the air outlet, thereby ensuring the temperature control effect of the air flow.

title_en: Light filling lamp convenient to it is clean
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of light supplementing lamps, and particularly discloses a light supplementing lamp convenient to clean, which comprises a lamp holder, wherein a driving box is fixedly connected to the outer surface of the lamp holder, a jack is formed in the outer surface of the driving box, an inserting rod is movably inserted into the jack, a light supplementing lamp body is fixedly installed at one end, far away from the driving box, of the inserting rod, a stabilizing mechanism for fixing the light supplementing lamp body is arranged in the driving box, the stabilizing mechanism comprises a fixing disc fixedly connected to the inner wall of the driving box, and a sliding groove is formed in the outer surface of the fixing disc. This light filling lamp convenient to it is clean, consider and accumulate more dust easily on the light filling lamp body in daily use, in order to be convenient for carry out thorough cleaning to the dust of many tiny surfaces, corner and depressed part on the light filling lamp, accessible stabilizing mean will swiftly take off the light filling lamp to the effective and swift cleanness to the light filling lamp is carried out to the no hindrance.

title_en: Lens assembly and bronchoscope
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of medical equipment, and discloses a lens assembly and a bronchoscope, wherein the lens assembly comprises: the first lens and the second lens are sequentially arranged from the object side to the image side, and a binary optical element is arranged on one side, away from the first lens, of the second lens. According to the utility model, the binary optical element is arranged on one side, close to the object side, of the second lens, and the unique dispersion characteristic of the binary optical element is utilized to correct high chromatic aberration generated by the first lens and the second lens, so that the number of lenses can be reduced on the premise of ensuring a large divergence angle, the number of lenses is reduced, the structural complexity is reduced, the integral length of the lens assembly can be shortened, the integral structural size of the lens assembly is smaller, and the development trend of miniaturization of the lens assembly is met.

title_en: Optical fiber laying and arranging device for municipal construction
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an optical fiber laying and arranging device for municipal construction, which relates to the technical field of optical fiber laying and arranging of municipal construction and comprises a first vehicle body, wherein one side of the first vehicle body is connected with a fixed block, the outer side of the fixed block is sleeved with a fixed frame, the middle parts of the fixed block and the fixed frame are respectively inserted with a bolt, and the other side of the fixed frame is connected with a second vehicle body. According to the utility model, through the arrangement of the first car body, the second car body, the first lantern ring and the second lantern ring, under the driving action of the first car body serving as the active car body, the optical fiber and the second car body can be pulled to carry out laying operation along the pipeline, when encountering a bending part, an included angle is necessarily formed between the first car body and the second car body, so that when the blocking phenomenon of the gasket to the circuit contact arranged on the outer wall of the car body occurs, and the phenomenon is taken as a critical value, the bending degree of the part is large, the damage degree of the optical fiber is large, and the part needs to be adjusted and tidied.

title_en: Intelligent exposure lamp structure for digital imager
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent exposure lamp structure for a digital imager, which belongs to the technical field of exposure lamps and comprises a mounting plate, wherein the left side surface of the mounting plate is fixedly connected with an adjusting exposure lamp, the upper surface of the mounting plate and the bottom surface of the mounting plate are both provided with sliding grooves, the inside of each sliding groove is slidably connected with a scraping rod, one end, close to each other, of each scraping rod is fixedly connected with the mounting plate, and the right side surface of the mounting plate is fixedly connected with a connecting rod which is arranged at equal distance. This intelligent exposure lamp structure for digital imager through being provided with the mounting panel, adjusting exposure lamp, sliding tray and scraping the cooperation of moving the pole, reduces the accumulation of the inboard dust of intelligent exposure lamp structure, and the cooperation of rethread movable plate, connecting rod and brush cleaner utilizes the brush cleaner to remove on adjusting exposure lamp surface, comes to adjust the dust of exposure lamp electrostatic adsorption at its surface and clears away, plays the dust clearance of making things convenient for the manual work to the fluorescent tube surface, facilitates the effect of using this intelligent exposure lamp.

title_en: Optical imaging module, camera module and electronic device
abstract_en: An optical imaging module, a camera module and an electronic device are provided, wherein the optical imaging module comprises an optical imaging lens group, an optical path turning element and a shading element. The optical imaging lens group comprises at least one optical lens element, the optical path turning element is provided with an incident surface, an emergent surface and at least one optical reflecting surface, and the optical path turning element is arranged on the image side of the optical imaging lens group. The shading element is arranged on one of the optical lens element and the light path turning element, and comprises an opening and a shading surface. The light shading surface is provided with an anti-reflection light shading film layer, the surface of the anti-reflection light shading film layer is provided with a plurality of nanometer microstructures, and the nanometer microstructures are arranged in an irregular mode. Therefore, the volume of the optical imaging module is reduced through the light path turning element, so that the optical imaging module is suitable for a remote imaging system.

title_en: Printing down machine with detachable dustproof mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a plate copying machine with a detachable dustproof mechanism, which relates to the field of plate copying machines and comprises a machine body, wherein a rotating shaft is arranged in the machine body, two ends of the rotating shaft respectively penetrate through the inner wall of the machine body to the outer side of the machine body, a cover plate is rotatably arranged on the outer side of the rotating shaft, racks are symmetrically and fixedly arranged on two sides of the cover plate, two sliding grooves are symmetrically formed in two sides of the inner part of the machine body, and screw rods and sliding rods are respectively arranged in the two sliding grooves.
