According to the utility model, the machine body, the handle, the cover plate, the rotating shaft, the gear, the connecting block, the rack, the dustproof mechanism, the sliding block, the cleaning sponge, the U-shaped clamping block, the cross rod, the storage groove, the printing plate, the sliding groove, the screw rod, the limiting mechanism, the sliding rod and other part structures are arranged to cooperatively operate, the dustproof mechanism can clean the printing plate in the opening and closing process of the cover plate, the influence of dust on plate making quality is prevented, the U-shaped block is used for bearing the cleaning sponge, and the cleaning sponge is convenient to detach.

title_en: Positioning device for cutting optical fiber jumper wire
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a positioning device for cutting an optical fiber jumper wire, belonging to the technical field of positioning and cutting of optical fiber jumper wires, wherein a cutting blade for cutting the optical fiber jumper wire is arranged in a base body of a cutting base, and a clamping component I for clamping the optical fiber jumper wire is arranged on the front side surface of the cutting base; and a second clamping component for clamping the optical fiber jumper is arranged in the base body of the movable base. The first arc clamping sleeve is driven to move upwards through the second lifting operation plate, the first arc clamping sleeve is connected with the clamping of the first arc clamping sleeve, the first arc clamping plate is driven to move upwards through the second lifting operation plate, the first arc clamping plate is connected with the second arc clamping plate in a clamping mode, then the screw rod is driven to rotate through the turntable, the movable seat can be driven to position and adjust the optical fiber jumper according to scales on the scale marks, and finally the cutting blade is driven to move downwards through the top plate, so that the optical fiber jumper can be cut.

title_en: Lens and lamp
abstract_en: The utility model provides a lens and a lamp, and belongs to the technical field of illumination. The lens is connected with the lamp and arranged in the light emitting direction of the light source so as to change the light distribution angle of the lamp, the lens comprises a first lens and a second lens which are connected with each other, the first lens and the second lens are coaxially arranged, the axial projection of the first lens is larger than that of the second lens, when the first lens is close to the light source, part of light rays emitted by the light source penetrate through the second lens to be emitted outwards, and when the second lens is close to the light source, all the light rays emitted by the light source penetrate through the first lens to be emitted outwards. The lens has the advantages that the first lens and the second lens with different sizes are arranged, the light-emitting angle of the first lens when the first lens is close to the light source is different from the light-emitting angle of the second lens when the second lens is close to the light source, and the lens has two light-emitting angles by forward and reverse dual-purpose, so that the replacement steps are simplified and the replacement cost is reduced.

title_en: Quick positioning device for industrial camera
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field related to industrial cameras, in particular to a quick positioning device for an industrial camera, which comprises a device body, wherein the device body internally comprises a workbench and a camera body, the workbench is centrally rotated to penetrate through a rotating shaft, the upper end of the rotating shaft is connected with a movable table, the camera body is arranged on the movable table, a movable groove is formed in the movable table, a first gear is rotationally arranged in the movable groove, two groups of rack bars are oppositely meshed on two sides of the first gear, the upper end of the rack bar penetrates through a movable table connecting clamping plate, the lower end of the rotating shaft is connected with a second gear, an inner cavity is formed in the workbench, and a motor is arranged in the inner cavity.

title_en: Transmitting mirror body of laser telescope
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of laser ranging telescopes, in particular to a transmitting lens body of a laser telescope, which comprises a laser lens body, wherein a chute is arranged in one end of the laser lens body, a sealing cover is connected in the chute in a sliding manner, and a shifting block is arranged at one end of the middle part of one side of the sealing cover. The lens frame and the lens can be rotated through the cooperation among the object lens frame, the lens, the connecting piece, the rotating shaft, the rotating rod and the fixed block, the object lens assembly is replaced through the rotation of the object lens frame and the lens, the object lens frame and the lens can be opened and closed through the cooperation among the connecting piece, the rotating shaft and the rotating rod, the lens frame and the lens can be rotated to replace lenses through the cooperation of the rotating capability of the connecting piece, meanwhile, the lens frame and the lens can be conveniently stored through the opening and closing structure, and the sealing cover can be sealed through sliding through the cooperation of the sealing cover, the fixed block, the sliding groove and the laser lens body, so that the storage function is effectively protected.

title_en: Viewing telescope with self-service vending function
abstract_en: The utility model is suitable for the technical improvement field of telescopes, and provides a viewing telescope with a self-service vending function, which comprises a telescope body, a connecting piece, a base and self-service vending equipment, wherein the telescope body is arranged on the connecting piece, the connecting piece is arranged on the base, the self-service vending equipment is arranged in the base, a delivery port of the self-service vending equipment is arranged on the base, a delivery port is arranged on a panel of the base, and a movable baffle is arranged on the delivery port. The telescope is simple in structure, the self-service vending mechanism is additionally arranged on the base of the basic viewing (light) telescope, so that small commodities can be sold for emergency use by a user, the user is facilitated, and the experience of the user is promoted.

title_en: Energy-saving LED display module
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an energy-saving LED display module, which comprises a shell, wherein one side of the front surface of the shell is connected with a sliding rod in a sliding way, the inner surface of the shell is fixedly connected with a heat dissipation plate, the heat dissipation plate is far away from a shell fixedly connected with a circuit board, the circuit board is far away from a heat dissipation plate and is fixedly connected with a mounting plate, the upper and lower inner side surfaces of the shell are far away from the mounting plate and are provided with screen sliding grooves, the upper surface of the mounting plate is fixedly connected with a photovoltaic plate, the upper surface of the photovoltaic plate is contacted with the inner surface of the upper side of the shell, the upper surface of the shell is made of transparent toughened glass, the mounting plate is provided with a lamp room, and the side of the lamp room is provided with a reflecting plate. Through above-mentioned structure, through setting up heating panel, slide bar, photovoltaic board, reflector panel, can go out the heat conduction that the module during operation produced to go out the light reflection that will be blocked, practiced thrift the electric power, also conveniently demolish the display screen simultaneously and change the lamp pearl of damage.

title_en: Underwater inspection robot
abstract_en: The utility model provides an underwater inspection robot, which comprises a machine body, wherein a propelling device for propelling the whole machine body to move underwater is arranged on the machine body; the machine body is provided with a vision acquisition module for acquiring images of underwater conditions; the visual acquisition module is connected with the signal input end of the control module through the communication module; the signal output end of the control module is connected with the propulsion device; a cleaning device for removing foreign matters is arranged below the machine body. The robot can carry out intelligent periodic maintenance on a dam or a hydropower station through machine vision, can clear peripheral garbage, and helps to solve the problems of low safety of manual inspection under water, low efficiency of a traditional detection method and the like.

title_en: Planar waveguide optical divider structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a planar waveguide optical divider structure which comprises a substrate and an optical waveguide channel, wherein the optical waveguide channel is provided with an input end face and an output end face, the optical waveguide channel is positioned in the substrate, and gaps are reserved between the input end face and the output end face of the optical waveguide channel and the corresponding end faces of the substrate. The utility model leaves the tail end of the optical waveguide channel blank (i.e. does not make an optical waveguide structure), so that the end face of the optical waveguide is positioned inside the substrate, and the problem of optical waveguide damage caused by optical processing and film plating factors is avoided; the end face of the planar waveguide optical divider is a beam expanding light spot, so that the optical power density is effectively reduced, and the transmission power tolerance threshold is greatly improved, thereby improving the reliability of the planar waveguide optical divider.

title_en: Double-lens transmitting and receiving common-lens 3D system
abstract_en: A dual-lens transmit and receive common-lens 3D system, comprising: a housing; the laser is used for infrared laser; the collimating mirror is positioned on the light path of the infrared laser so as to collimate the infrared laser; the polarization switcher is positioned on the optical path of the infrared laser and is used for changing the polarization state of the infrared laser; the polarization splitting prism is positioned on the light path behind the collimating lens and comprises a first surface, a second surface, a third surface and a fourth surface; the sensor is positioned outside the third surface and is used for receiving the reflected light ray signals; a prism positioned outside the second surface; a 1/4 wave plate positioned outside the fourth surface; a first lens located outside the fourth surface; and the second lens is positioned on the side surface of the prism, which is different from the polarization splitting prism. The FOI of the transmitting end and the FOV of the receiving end can be accurately matched, and the FOI has better performance.

title_en: Backlight module and display device
abstract_en: A backlight module and a display device are provided, wherein the backlight module comprises a light source, a diffusion plate, an optical film and a back frame. The diffusion plate is arranged above the light source. The optical film stack is arranged on the diffusion plate, and the diffusion plate is positioned between the light source and the optical film. The back frame comprises a bottom plate and side walls. The bottom plate is used for bearing the light source. The side wall is connected to the bottom plate and surrounds the light source. The side wall comprises a first part side wall and a second part side wall. The first part side wall comprises a wall body and a bearing part, wherein the bearing part extends out from one end of the wall body and is positioned between the diffusion plate and the bottom plate, and the bearing part is used for bearing the diffusion plate. The device has the advantages that the diffusion plate is borne by bending part of the side wall of the back frame to form the bearing part, so that the process of forming an additional support frame by insert molding is omitted, and the aim of reducing the cost is fulfilled.

title_en: Optical fiber protection tube and optical fiber
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to the field of communications devices, and in particular, to an optical fiber protection tube and an optical fiber. The optical fiber protection tube according to the present disclosure includes a protection main tube 10, a plurality of protection branch tubes 20, and a connection portion 30, wherein the protection main tube 10 and the connection portion 30 are connected to each other, and the plurality of protection branch tubes 20 communicate with the protection main tube 10 through the connection portion 30. The plurality of protection branch pipes 20 are flexibly configured in the protection main pipe 10 according to actual needs, so that the plurality of protection branch pipes 20 respectively correspond to fiber melting discs which need to be connected, bare fiber protection of optical fibers in the fiber melting discs is realized through the protection branch pipes 20 when the fiber melting discs are formed into ends, and network quality and stability are ensured under the condition that a large number of protection pipes are not additionally added.

title_en: Controller for automatic dimming film of automobile
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a controller for an automatic dimming film of an automobile, which comprises a display screen, wherein a control host is fixedly arranged on the back of the display screen, a plurality of keys are arranged on two sides of the display screen, the keys are connected with the control host, a photosensitive lens is fixedly arranged on one side of the control host, a signal receiver is fixedly arranged on the top of the control host, a temperature sensor is arranged on the side surface of the signal receiver, an installation module is arranged on the back of the control host, and clamping modules are arranged on two sides of the installation module.

title_en: Waterproof type water curtain projection frame bottom shell
abstract_en: The utility model provides a waterproof water curtain projection frame bottom shell, and relates to the technical field of water curtain projection frames. The utility model is used for solving the technical problems that the existing water curtain projection frame cannot ensure the connection of the upper frame and the bottom shell to be compact, and water is easy to permeate into the shell to influence the normal operation of equipment. This waterproof type water curtain projection frame drain pan, including the drain pan, set up a plurality of blind holes on the drain pan, the rigid coupling has a plurality of screw thread barrels on the drain pan, a plurality of screw holes have been seted up at the drain pan middle part, and the drain pan middle part rigid coupling has two reference columns, is provided with the connector on the drain pan, installs a plurality of mounting panels on the drain pan, and the slidingtype is provided with the connecting plate in the mounting panel, installs the push pedal on a plurality of connecting plates jointly. The pushing plate is pushed to compress the second air bag, so that air in the second air bag is input into the first air bag through the air guide pipe, the first air bag is expanded, a gap between the bottom shell and the upper frame is filled and sealed, and the effect of sealing the gap at the joint of the bottom shell and the upper frame is achieved.

title_en: SC type MPO multicore fiber connector
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an SC-type MPO multi-core optical fiber connector which comprises a shell, an inner core, an SC-type multi-core MT (metal-to-optical) ferrule, a positioning seat, a spring and a metal main body, wherein optical fibers sequentially penetrate through the metal main body, the positioning seat and the SC-type multi-core MT ferrule, the inner core is sleeved on the periphery of the SC-type multi-core MT ferrule and the positioning seat, the front end of the SC-type multi-core MT ferrule protrudes out of the front end face of the inner core, the front end of the metal main body is fixed in the rear end of the inner core, and the spring is sleeved on the optical fibers, and two ends of the spring are propped against the positioning seat and the metal main body. The utility model has the same volume as the existing SC type single-core optical fiber connector and is compatible with the SC adapter, greatly reduces the volume of the SC type single-core optical fiber connector, provides a simple and quick solution for directly upgrading the single-core optical fiber connector to the multi-core optical fiber connector, saves more space in the application of a data center and an optical path device in a high-density environment, improves the utilization rate of the space, and saves a great amount of cost.

title_en: Embossing device
abstract_en: The utility model provides an imprinting device which comprises a substrate, an upper shell, a sealing element, a connecting element and a carrying platform, wherein the upper shell is connected with the carrying platform through the connecting element to form a first sealing chamber between the upper shell and the carrying platform, the sealing element is arranged between the carrying platform and the substrate to form a second sealing chamber between the carrying platform and the substrate, an imprinting template is formed on the carrying platform, at least two telescopic elements are arranged on one side, far away from the imprinting template, of the carrying platform, the at least two telescopic elements are positioned between the carrying platform and the substrate, the carrying platform is lifted to different heights in different imprinting areas through the telescopic action of the telescopic elements, the telescopic elements are controlled to be telescopic to different heights in the vertical direction according to a preset demolding direction, the decoupling area and/or a turning area are preferentially decoupled, and finally the decoupling area is decoupled.

title_en: Radiating module and projection device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a heat dissipation module which comprises a fan and a damping sleeve. The damping sleeve is sleeved on the fan. The damping sleeve has opposite inner and outer surfaces, the inner surface facing the fan. The damping sleeve comprises a plurality of damping convex parts. One of the inner surface and the outer surface is formed with a shock absorbing protrusion, and each side of the other of the inner surface and the outer surface is planar. The utility model also provides a projection device comprising the heat radiation module. The heat radiation module and the projection device can buffer vibration generated when the fan runs.

title_en: Outdoor wireless AP equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides outdoor wireless AP equipment, which comprises an AP equipment shell and a breathable waterproof assembly, wherein the breathable waterproof assembly comprises a membrane support, a waterproof breathable membrane, a hole support and a breathable cover, a first assembly hole is formed in one side of the AP equipment shell, and the breathable waterproof assembly is arranged on the inner side of the first assembly hole. The first bleeder vent, waterproof ventilated membrane, air vent and second bleeder vent are a gas flow channel each other made up, can make the gas circulation under the effect of waterproof ventilated membrane, make the inside atmospheric pressure of AP equipment casing balanced with outside atmospheric pressure, prevent the inside moisture condensation of AP equipment casing, and prevent to lead to accelerating seal ring's ageing and damage because of the atmospheric pressure difference, waterproof ventilated membrane has the water proof effect simultaneously, be used for preventing outside moisture to get into the inside of AP equipment casing, through setting up membrane support, pore support and the mutual separable connection of ventilative lid, the waterproof ventilated membrane has been made things convenient for and has been changed.

title_en: Powder outlet opening and closing device of toner container
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a powder outlet switch device of a toner container, which comprises a powder outlet plate of the toner container and a clamping plate, wherein a first baffle is arranged on one side of the lower end of the powder outlet plate of the toner container, a second baffle is arranged on the other side of the lower end of the powder outlet plate of the toner container, a first driving inclined seat is arranged on the first baffle, a second driving inclined seat is arranged on the second baffle, and vertical plates are arranged on both sides of the upper end of the clamping plate.

title_en: Confocal microscope for correcting and adjusting chromatic aberration
abstract_en: The utility model provides a chromatic aberration correction adjustment confocal microscope, which comprises a microscope body, wherein the microscope body comprises a fixed seat, a supporting seat is fixed at the top of the fixed seat, an ocular is fixedly arranged on the supporting seat, a connecting seat is arranged on the side of the supporting seat, a slot is formed in the connecting seat, a movable frame is movably arranged in the slot, one end of the movable frame is matched with the ocular, an illumination mechanism is fixedly arranged on the fixed seat, a movable seat is movably arranged at the top of the illumination mechanism, and the movable seat is movably arranged on the fixed seat. This adjustment confocal microscope is corrected to colour difference removes the grip block to the one end of backup pad in the later stage when using, with backup pad and grip block shrink to open-ended inside downwards, the fly leaf shelters from sealedly to open-ended top, avoids the dust to drop on lighting mechanism from the opening, also is convenient for in addition clear up the use to the surface of movable seat.

title_en: Optical fiber scanning projection device
abstract_en: The application discloses an optical fiber scanning projection device which comprises a light source module and an optical scanning module, wherein light emitted by the light source module is scanned and output by the optical scanning module and is used as display image light, the optical scanning module comprises an actuator, an optical fiber emitting end in the light source module is fixed on the actuator, an optical fiber extends out of the actuator and forms an optical fiber cantilever, the optical fiber cantilever is driven by the actuator to sweep in space, the light source module at least comprises a group of light sources, the light sources at least comprise R, G, B light-emitting units, and the optical fiber scanning projection device further comprises an infrared sensor which is configured to receive infrared information reflected by a projection area of the optical fiber scanning projection device. The embodiment of the specification provides an optical fiber scanning projection device, which can scan and collect objects in a projection area through additionally arranging an infrared sensor and an infrared light-emitting unit, so that the functions of scanning detection and projection are realized at the same time.

title_en: Carbon powder box with counting structure
abstract_en: The utility model provides a toner cartridge with a counting structure, which comprises a toner cartridge body, wherein one end of the toner cartridge body is provided with a gear end cover, the gear end cover is provided with a printing gear assembly and a counting device, the counting device is connected with the printing gear assembly in a meshed mode, the counting device comprises a counting gear which is meshed with the printing gear assembly, the middle of the counting gear is uniformly provided with a plurality of stirring pieces and a torsion spring pressing piece, one end of the torsion spring is fixed on the gear end cover, the other end of the torsion spring is in contact with the torsion spring pressing piece, a stirring rod assembly is positioned above the torsion spring, two ends of the stirring rod assembly are arranged on two sides of the counting gear, when the counting gear rotates, the stirring pieces stir and trigger sensing elements in a printer through the stirring rod assembly, and a gear reset assembly is arranged on one side of the counting gear and is blocked on the running path of a counting stop block on the surface of the counting gear. The utility model relates to the technical field of toner cartridges.

title_en: Cleaning scraper assembly
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cleaning scraper component which comprises a cutter rest, a front cutter body and a rear cutter body, wherein the front cutter body and the rear cutter body are arranged on two sides of the cutter rest and are fixedly connected with the cutter rest, a front cutter body mounting structure is arranged on the cutter rest, the front cutter body mounting structure comprises guide frames fixedly arranged on two sides of the cutter rest, the guide frames are opposite to each other and are provided with guide grooves, two sides of the front cutter body are in sliding fit with the guide grooves, the guide frames are fixedly connected with a mounting frame, and a cutter body pressing structure is arranged on the mounting frame. The cleaning scraper component has the advantages of being capable of better cleaning carbon powder on the surface of the photosensitive drum, being convenient for cleaning the carbon powder and being long in service life.

title_en: Laser uniform light lamp for single LD lamp bead for investigation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a laser uniform light lamp for a single LD lamp bead for investigation, which comprises a lamp cap, a lamp tube, a rear cover, a chargeable power supply and a switch, wherein the chargeable power supply is fixedly arranged in the lamp tube, the two ends of the lamp tube are respectively fixedly connected with the lamp cap and the rear cover, the rear cover is fixedly provided with a switch and a charging port of the chargeable power supply, the lamp cap is internally fixedly provided with a laser light system, and the laser light system comprises a semiconductor laser tube, a first uniform light piece, a planoconvex mirror, a second uniform light piece, a mirror rod and a biconvex mirror.

title_en: Display panel, display module and panel circuit board
abstract_en: The display panel comprises a display substrate, a panel circuit board and a panel circuit board, wherein the display substrate comprises a display area and a peripheral area, the peripheral area comprises a bending area connected with the display area and a binding area connected with the bending area, a driving chip is arranged in the binding area, the panel circuit board is electrically connected with the driving chip, the binding area bends towards the direction away from the light emitting side of the display panel through the bending area, so that the panel circuit board is located at the side away from the light emitting side of the display panel, the driving chip is bound and connected on a first surface of the peripheral area, the area surrounding the periphery of the driving chip on the first surface is a first area, and a chip protection piece is arranged at least in the first area. The display panel, the display module and the panel circuit board provided by the disclosure can improve the reliability of the display module.

title_en: Backlight structure capable of avoiding displacement of LED lamp
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a backlight structure capable of avoiding displacement of an LED lamp, which comprises a backlight frame, a backlight LED lamp bar, a shading rubber cushion and a graphite limiting sheet, wherein a limiting cavity is formed in the backlight frame, the backlight LED lamp bar comprises the LED lamp and an FPC, the LED lamp is arranged on the FPC, one part of the FPC is adhered to the backlight frame and faces the limiting cavity, the shading rubber cushion is partially adhered to one side surface of the FPC, which is far away from the LED lamp, one part of the graphite limiting sheet is adhered to the back surface of the backlight frame, and the other part of the graphite limiting sheet is reversely folded to the front surface of the backlight frame from the bottom of the FPC in an extending mode, so that the other part of the graphite limiting sheet is adhered to the shading rubber cushion. Therefore, the position of the FPC lamp can be limited through the graphite limiting sheets, the risk that products break away from after being transported and oscillated is avoided, the backlight LED lamp is further prevented from being displaced, the display effect is further ensured, and in addition, the heat dissipation effect of the products can be further improved through the graphite limiting sheets.

title_en: Display structure
abstract_en: The utility model provides a display structure. The display structure comprises a display layer, a reflective polarizing layer, a dispersed liquid crystal layer and a pattern layer. The reflective polarizing layer is disposed on one side of the display layer. The dispersion type liquid crystal layer is disposed on a side of the reflective polarizing layer opposite to the display layer. The pattern layer is disposed on a side of the dispersed liquid crystal layer opposite to the reflective polarizing layer. The reflective polarizing layer and the dispersive liquid crystal layer can prevent the pattern layer from affecting the display effect of the whole display layer when the display layer is opened, and can also achieve the visual effect of highlighting the pattern layer when the display layer is closed.

title_en: Multi-angle adjusting device for camera
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a camera multi-angle adjusting device, and relates to the technical field of pulp molding production detection. The camera multi-angle adjusting device comprises a fixing device, wherein the fixing device is used for fixing a camera, the fixing device comprises a first fixing plate and a second fixing plate, the second fixing plate is circumferentially arranged on the outer ring side of the first fixing plate in a ring mode, the first fixing plate is provided with a first angle adjusting assembly, and the first angle adjusting assembly is used for adjusting the rotation angle of the first fixing plate in a first direction. And/or the second fixed plate is provided with a second angle adjusting component, the second angle adjusting component is used for adjusting the speed, the second fixed plate rotates along a second direction, and the first direction is perpendicular to or parallel to the second direction. By adopting the technology provided by the utility model, the detection camera can be effectively adjusted at any angle.

title_en: Optical device for generating word line light spots
abstract_en: The application provides an optical device for generating a word line light spot, which comprises a first superlens, a Horizontal Cavity Surface Emitting Laser (HCSEL) light source, wherein the first superlens comprises a first substrate and a first micro-nano structure arranged on the first substrate, and is used for expanding a received light beam of the first superlens in the line length direction of the word line light spot so as to modulate the light beam into a word line light beam, and the word line light beam is used for forming the word line light spot on a target plane. The application can realize the generation of a word line light spot or a word line light spot array through the superlens, and reduces the production cost and the volume of the optical device.

title_en: Projector automatic testing machine
abstract_en: The utility model provides an automatic projector testing machine which comprises a sliding frame and a curtain frame, wherein a rolling structure is arranged on the curtain frame, a curtain is arranged in the rolling structure, a first sliding plate is in sliding fit with the sliding frame, a mounting frame is fixed on the first sliding plate, two second sliding plates are in sliding fit with the mounting frame, a fixing plate is in rotating fit between the two second sliding plates, a clamping structure is arranged on the fixing plate, and a projector is arranged in the clamping structure. According to the utility model, the winding structure is arranged on the curtain frame, so that the curtain can be wound, the curtain can be conveniently replaced, different curtains can be used for testing projectors, the first sliding plate is arranged on the sliding frame, the fixed plate is arranged between the two second sliding plates, the clamping structure is arranged on the fixed plate, the projectors can be clamped and fixed through the clamping structure, and the height and the angle of the projectors can be adjusted through the first sliding plate, the second sliding plate and the fixed plate.

title_en: Projection suspension structure for computer classroom teaching
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of projection suspension, in particular to a projection suspension structure for computer classroom teaching, which comprises a fixing plate, a screw hole for positioning and mounting through screws is arranged at the end wall of the fixing plate, a fixing column for connecting two fixing plates is fixed at the end wall of one side of the fixing plate far away from the screw hole, a screw hole is formed in the middle part of the fixing plate at the end wall of one side of the fixing plate far away from the fixing column, and a screw seat is connected with the inner side of the screw hole in a threaded manner and is used for moving along the axis direction of the screw hole when the screw seat is rotated. The fixed column and the movable column are detachably assembled together, so that the fixed column and the movable column can be detached, the wire harnesses are connected in a penetrating manner and arranged, and after the wire harnesses are assembled, the wire harnesses in the fixed column and the movable column are simply wrapped for protection.

title_en: Developing cartridge and process cartridge
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a developing cartridge and a process cartridge for an electrophotographic image forming apparatus. The developing cartridge comprises a cartridge body and a developing roller, a developer accommodating chamber for accommodating developer is arranged in the cartridge body, a separation assembly is arranged at the non-driving end of the cartridge body, the separation assembly comprises a force receiving part for receiving force applied by the electrophotographic image forming device and an abutting part abutting against the drum frame, when the force receiving part receives the force applied by the electrophotographic image forming device, the abutting part is limited to move due to abutting against the drum frame, so that the separation assembly drives the developing cartridge to move, and the developing roller is separated from the photosensitive drum. The utility model realizes the change of the direction and the position of the force by the separating component, so that the force applied to the force receiving part is converted into the force for separating the developing roller from the photosensitive drum, the structure is simple, the precision requirement is low, and the manufacturing cost of the developing box is low.

title_en: Air knife assembly and glasses cleaning device comprising same
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an air knife assembly and a glasses cleaning device comprising the same, and belongs to the technical field of glasses cleaning equipment. The air knife assembly is used for air drying of the glasses legs of the frame glasses and comprises a first air knife and a second air knife, wherein the first air knife and the second air knife comprise an air inlet part, a hollow pipeline and an air outlet part which are sequentially communicated, the air inlet part is connected with an external air source, and the air outlet part of the first air knife is opposite to the air outlet part of the second air knife and is respectively arranged below and above the glasses legs. The air flow output by the air source enters the first air knife hollow pipeline and is guided by the air outlet part, the air flow obliquely upwards is sent out from the air outlet to the frame glasses legs, and the air flow entering the second air knife hollow pipeline and is guided by the air outlet part, and the air flow obliquely downwards is sent out from the air outlet to the frame glasses legs. The utility model can rapidly air-dry the water drops on the surface of the glasses legs of the frame glasses.

title_en: Polarizer filter support
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a polarizer filter support, which comprises a shell, limiting plates and limiting members, wherein the middle part of the shell is provided with a round hole, a later-installed filter is observed through the round hole, the limiting plates are symmetrically arranged at two sides of the rear part of the shell, the limiting plates and the shell are integrally arranged, clamping grooves are formed in the limiting plates, a tightening piece is arranged in the clamping grooves, one end of the tightening piece is fixed in the clamping grooves, the other end of the tightening piece is adjustably connected with the end part of the rear surface of the limiting plates, the bending of the tightening piece in the clamping grooves to different degrees is realized by adjusting the positions of the tightening piece on the limiting plates, so that the clamping force of the filter is adjusted according to different installation requirements, and the limiting members are further included.

title_en: Detection circuit of extinction lamp and printing equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a detection circuit of a extinction lamp and a printing device, belonging to the technical field of printing devices, wherein the detection circuit of the extinction lamp comprises the extinction lamp; the LED lamp comprises a light source, a light spectrum detection circuit and a control circuit, wherein the light spectrum detection circuit comprises a light spectrum sensor, the light spectrum sensor is arranged at the light source of the light extinction lamp, the light spectrum detection circuit is used for receiving the light-emitting source of the light extinction lamp so as to detect the intensity of each wavelength of the light-emitting source and generate corresponding detection signals, the first input end of the control circuit is connected with the output end of the light spectrum detection circuit, the control end of the control circuit is connected with the controlled end of the light extinction lamp, and the control circuit is used for controlling the on-off of the light extinction lamp according to the detection signals. The application improves the detection precision and efficiency of the extinction lamp in the production process and solves the production detection problem of the extinction lamp of the printer and copier components.

title_en: Optical fiber amplification system with self-adaptive wavelength
abstract_en: The application discloses a wavelength self-adaptive optical fiber amplifying system, and belongs to the technical field of optical fiber communication. The application comprises an input wavelength division multiplexer, a short-wave amplifying light path, a long-wave amplifying light path and an output wavelength division multiplexer, wherein signal light enters the input wavelength division multiplexer and is divided into long-wave signal light and short-wave signal light, the long-wave signal light enters the long-wave amplifying light path to be amplified in a cladding pumping mode, the short-wave signal light enters the short-wave amplifying light path to be amplified in a cladding pumping mode, and the amplified short-wave signal light and the amplified long-wave signal light enter the output wavelength division multiplexer and are combined into one path of signal light to be output. According to the technical scheme, the problem that the power gains of signals with different wavelengths in the optical signals are uneven when the broadband optical signals are amplified by the optical path amplifier under the high power amplification requirement is solved.

title_en: Waterproof lens
abstract_en: The utility model provides a waterproof lens which comprises a lens barrel, a mounting seat, a lens group, a plano-convex lens and a first water absorbing cotton, wherein the mounting seat is arranged at the top of the lens barrel, a dispensing groove is formed in the top of the mounting seat, the top of the mounting seat is provided with the first sealing ring, the lens group is arranged on the inner side surface of the mounting seat, the top of the lens group is provided with the threaded ring, the top and the bottom of the threaded ring are respectively provided with the second sealing ring, the plano-convex lens is arranged at the top of the mounting seat, the outer side surface of the mounting seat is in threaded connection with the positioning ring, and the bottom of the positioning ring is provided with the first water absorbing cotton. According to the waterproof lens, the first water-absorbing cotton is sleeved on the outer side surface of the mounting seat, and the second water-absorbing cotton is sleeved on the inner side surface of the gland, so that when the water-absorbing cotton needs to be replaced after long-time use, the gland is only required to be connected with the outer side surface of the mounting seat in a threaded manner, and then the first water-absorbing cotton and the second water-absorbing cotton can be detached and replaced, and the waterproof lens is convenient and quick to operate.

title_en: Optical fiber installation construction equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses optical fiber installation construction equipment, which comprises a base, wherein a through hole penetrating through the base is formed in the base, the through hole is used for penetrating through a screw, the screw is used for fixing the base on a wall of a tunnel, the left side and the right side of the base are respectively hinged with an arc plate through a first hinge piece, the other ends of the two arc plates are connected through a detachable connecting piece, and a recording plate for recording light transmission information is arranged on the detachable connecting piece. When the optical fibers in the tunnel are installed, the base is fixed on the wall surface of the tunnel, the optical fibers are placed in the two circular arc plates, and information transmitted by the optical fibers in the circular arc plates is recorded on the recording plate after the two circular arc plates are fixed, so that the optical fibers can be easily taken out and placed, the names of the information transmitted by the optical fibers can be marked, and great convenience is provided for subsequent maintenance and detection.

title_en: Dimming conductive film
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a dimming conductive film which comprises a dimming conductive film layer, a silicon nitride bottoming film layer and a flexible substrate which are sequentially arranged, wherein an ultraviolet-proof acrylic acid adhesive layer is arranged on one side, far away from the flexible substrate, of the dimming conductive film layer, an antibacterial coating is arranged on one side, far away from the dimming conductive film layer, of the ultraviolet-proof acrylic acid adhesive layer, an infrared absorption layer is arranged between the dimming conductive film layer and the silicon nitride bottoming film layer, the antibacterial coating is a nano silver antibacterial layer or a nano zinc antibacterial layer, and the thickness of the antibacterial coating is 6 mu m. According to the utility model, through the arrangement of the ultraviolet-proof acrylic acid adhesive layer, ultraviolet rays can be effectively prevented from penetrating through the dimming conductive film, so that damage to articles caused by ultraviolet rays penetrating through glass is avoided, and by matching with the use of the antibacterial coating, the breeding of bacteria on the surface of the dimming conductive film can be reduced, and the sanitary environment is improved.

title_en: Reverse hanging type glasses frame adjusting device
abstract_en: The application discloses an inverted mirror bracket adjusting device which solves the technical problems of long installation time and low precision of an inverted mirror bracket in the prior art. The reverse hanging type glasses frame adjusting device comprises a first base, an X-direction adjusting unit, a Y-direction adjusting unit, a Z-direction rotation adjusting unit and a Z-direction adjusting unit, wherein the X-direction adjusting unit comprises a first adjusting component arranged on the first base, the Y-direction adjusting unit comprises a second base and a second adjusting component, the Z-direction rotation adjusting unit comprises a third base, a third adjusting component and a rotating component, the Z-direction adjusting unit comprises a fourth base and a fourth adjusting component, and the output end of the fourth adjusting component is used for being connected with the reverse hanging type glasses frame. According to the application, the X-direction adjusting unit, the Y-direction adjusting unit, the Z-direction rotation adjusting unit and the Z-direction adjusting unit are arranged on the first base, so that the multi-degree-of-freedom adjustment of the large-scale inverted mirror bracket in the high air can be realized, and the structure is simple and the adjustment is quick.

title_en: Liquid crystal display lighting detection equipment convenient to disassemble and assemble
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a liquid crystal display lighting detection device convenient to disassemble and assemble, which comprises a workbench, wherein a plurality of evenly distributed detection plates are arranged at the top end of the workbench, the detection plates are connected with the workbench through a connecting assembly, a U-shaped placing frame is arranged at the top end of the detection plates, symmetrically arranged clamping plates are arranged in the U-shaped placing frame, the clamping plates are connected with the U-shaped placing frame through elastic assemblies, and a fixing plate is arranged at the top end of the detection plates and positioned at one side of the U-shaped placing frame. The liquid crystal display device has the beneficial effects that the detection plate and the workbench can be quickly disassembled and assembled through the arrangement of the connecting component, the detection plate is convenient to replace, meanwhile, the connecting component is matched with the detection plate through the screw rod, the moving block, the connecting frame, the moving plate and the limiting column and is limited and fixed, the liquid crystal display device is simple to use and convenient to operate, the liquid crystal display can be clamped and positioned through the arrangement of the clamping plate and the elastic component, and the FPC circuit is convenient to butt-joint and insert.

title_en: Optical interface assembly and optical module
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an optical interface assembly and an optical module, wherein the optical interface assembly comprises an adapter base, the adapter base at least comprises a first connecting part connected with a female head of an optical fiber connector and a second connecting part connected with a male head of the optical fiber connector, the first connecting part and the second connecting part are mutually communicated, the optical interface assembly further comprises two clamping blocks, the first connecting part at least comprises two clamping arms which can elastically expand outwards and can be matched with the female head of the optical fiber connector in a clamping way, the two clamping blocks are detachably connected with the two clamping arms in a one-to-one correspondence way, and the clamping blocks can limit the expansion of the corresponding clamping arms after being connected with the corresponding clamping arms. According to the optical connector, the clamping arms and the clamping blocks are arranged, when the optical module needs the pluggable optical interface, the optical interface assembly only provided with the clamping arms is selected in the optical module, when the optical module needs the fixed optical socket, the clamping blocks are arranged after the clamping arms clamp the female head of the optical fiber connector, the structure is simple, the operation is convenient, and the production cost is low.

title_en: Optical fiber specification recognition device
abstract_en: The application relates to an optical fiber specification recognition device, which relates to the field of optical fiber core diameter recognition, and comprises a shell, a color recognition circuit board and a color recognition circuit board, wherein the shell is arranged on a laser, the shell comprises a through hole for an optical fiber connector to pass through, the through hole is opposite to an optical fiber socket of the laser, different colors of the optical fiber connector respectively correspond to one optical fiber specification, the color recognition circuit board is arranged on the shell and comprises a lighting device and a color sensor for recognizing the color of the optical fiber connector, a color collection window of the color sensor faces the optical fiber connector, the color recognition circuit board is in communication connection with a main control system of medical laser equipment, and the main control system is used for transmitting the recognized color data to obtain the corresponding optical fiber specification through the color data. The application coats the color on the surface of the optical fiber connector, greatly simplifies the production link of the optical fiber connector and reduces the manufacturing cost.

title_en: Hydraulic photographic support convenient to use
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a convenient-to-use hydraulic photographing support, which comprises a supporting seat, a plurality of telescopic legs rotatably connected to the supporting seat, a group of hydraulic locking assemblies are arranged on each telescopic leg, and a hydraulic control handle which is arranged on any telescopic leg and is connected with the plurality of hydraulic locking assemblies, wherein the hydraulic control handle is used for unlocking or locking the hydraulic locking assemblies, and the hydraulic control handle can be simultaneously outwards rotated to be unfolded or simultaneously inwards rotated to be folded with the telescopic legs, so that the hydraulic control handle can be synchronously unfolded or folded along with the telescopic legs through the structure, the occupied space of the hydraulic photographing support in a folded state is reduced, the use convenience of the hydraulic photographing support is improved, and the use requirement is met.

title_en: Toner box structure capable of preventing toner leakage
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a toner box structure capable of preventing powder leakage, and relates to the technical field of printer accessories, and the technical scheme is that the toner box structure comprises a box body, a powder adding pipe and a powder adding pipe, wherein the powder adding pipe is fixedly embedded at the top of the box body; the powder adding device comprises a powder adding pipe, a hopper, a baffle block, two connecting rods, cylinders and a movable rod, wherein the hopper is arranged at the top of the powder adding pipe, the bottom end of the hopper extends into the powder adding pipe, the baffle block is arranged in a conical shape, the upper half section of the baffle block is arranged in the powder adding pipe, the baffle block is in contact with the bottom end of the powder adding pipe, the two bottom ends of the two connecting rods are fixedly connected with the top of the baffle block, the two connecting rods are respectively fixedly connected with the inner walls of the two sides of the hopper, the two cylinders are respectively arranged at the top of a box body, and the two cylinders are respectively arranged at the front side and the rear side of the powder adding pipe.

title_en: Adjustable optical fiber fixed-length cutting device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an adjustable optical fiber fixed-length cutting device which comprises a base, wherein two grooves are formed in the upper end of the base, rotatable threaded rods are respectively arranged in each groove in a penetrating manner, a rotating mechanism is arranged on one side of the base and connected with the two threaded rods, slidable thread seats are respectively arranged in the two grooves and are arranged on the threaded rods in a penetrating manner, a movable table is fixedly arranged at the upper ends of the two thread seats, a cutting groove is formed in the upper end of the base, a limiting block is fixedly arranged at the lower end of the movable table, two graduated scales are further arranged at the upper end of the base, two indication arrows are fixedly arranged on one side of the movable table, two sliding grooves are formed in the bottom of the base, slidable moving rods are respectively arranged in each sliding groove in a penetrating manner, two cutting scissors are arranged in the cutting groove, and a moving mechanism is respectively connected with the two moving rods.

title_en: Head stripping device for optical cable
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of optical fiber processing, in particular to a head stripping device for an optical cable. The technical scheme is that the head stripping device for the optical cable comprises a first wire stripping clamp assembly and a second wire stripping clamp assembly, wherein the second wire stripping clamp assembly is arranged at the lower end of the first wire stripping clamp assembly. According to the utility model, one end of a cable of an optical fiber is placed in a cable receiving hole, then a clamping plate of a second wire stripping clamp assembly is correspondingly spliced with the wire stripping clamp and is pressed and combined with force, at the moment, the two optical fiber stripping blades cut the outer skin of the optical fiber and the optical fiber is positioned in a light through hole formed by the two optical fiber stripping blades, and then the other end of the optical fiber is pulled by one hand, so that the outer skin of the optical fiber is extruded, cut and discharged from one end of the light through hole, and further the cutting and stripping functions of the outer skin of the optical fiber are realized.

title_en: Light supplementing bracket with light adjustment function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of light supplementing brackets and discloses a light supplementing bracket with light regulation, which comprises a supporting seat, wherein an annular lamp is detachably arranged at the top of the supporting seat, regulating mechanisms are arranged at the left side and the right side of the supporting seat, each regulating mechanism comprises a fixed plate, the inner wall of each fixed plate is fixedly connected with a rotating shaft, the outer cambered surface of each rotating shaft is rotationally connected with a rotating column, the outer cambered surface of each rotating column is fixedly connected with a rotating plate, the inner wall of each rotating shaft is in threaded connection with a bolt, a positioning assembly is arranged at one side, close to the supporting seat, of the light supplementing lamp, and an opening assembly is arranged at the bottom of each supporting seat. According to the utility model, when the light source is needed to be added, the light supplementing lamp can be turned on and extended and used at the moment, so that diversified illumination requirements are met, the overall live broadcasting effect is improved, and when the whole device is not used, the light supplementing lamp can be stored at the moment, and is convenient to transport.

title_en: Live broadcast desk lamp position fixing device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of desk lamp fixing devices and discloses a live broadcast desk lamp fixing device which comprises a desk lamp fixing mechanism, wherein a plurality of mobile phone support mechanisms are fixedly arranged at the front side of the upper end of the desk lamp fixing mechanism, the desk lamp fixing mechanism comprises a fixing bottom plate, sliding grooves are formed in the two sides of the upper end of the fixing bottom plate, sliding blocks are slidably arranged in the two sliding grooves, adjusting frames are hinged to the upper ends of the two sliding blocks through threads, mounting rings are fixedly arranged at the front ends of the two adjusting frames, and light supplementing lamps are fixedly arranged at the front ends of the two mounting rings through threads. According to the utility model, the rear ends of the light supplementing lamp and the large-size desk lamp of the device are respectively provided with the power interfaces, the power storage box can supply power for the light supplementing lamp and the large-size desk lamp, the power storage box of the mobile phone support mechanism can supplement electric quantity for the mobile phone, the constraint of an external power line is reduced, the live broadcast environment is tidier, and the potential safety hazard caused by the winding of the power line is avoided.

title_en: Multi-angle optical scanning platform and optical scanning system based on rope group driving
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of optical scanning equipment, in particular to a multi-angle optical scanning platform based on rope group driving and an optical scanning system. The multi-angle optical scanning platform based on rope group driving comprises an optical scanning piece, a bearing assembly, a base and a support, wherein a track is arranged on the base, the bearing assembly comprises a bottom platform, a suspension platform and at least three groups of rope groups, the support is fixedly arranged on the bottom platform, the suspension platform is rotatably arranged on the support, the bottom platform is in sliding connection with the track, the rope groups comprise telescopic driving pieces and connecting ropes, the telescopic driving pieces are fixedly arranged on the bottom platform, the suspension platform is connected with the telescopic driving pieces through the connecting ropes, and the telescopic driving pieces are used for adjusting the extending amount of the connecting ropes. The angle of the workpiece to be scanned is adjusted by the rope group based on the extending amount of the connecting ropes of the rope group, so that the multi-angle optical scanning platform driven by the rope group has higher flexibility, accuracy and applicability.

title_en: Lens assembly and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a lens assembly and electronic equipment, and relates to the field of imaging technology, wherein the lens assembly comprises a mounting cylinder and a lens; the mounting cylinder extends along a first direction, the lens is arranged in the mounting cylinder, the lens is in clearance fit with the inner surface of the mounting cylinder, the mounting part and at least one positioning structure are formed on the inner surface of the mounting cylinder, the at least one positioning structure is arranged on the mounting part, the lens comprises a lens main body and at least one limiting structure which are connected, the lens main body is arranged in the mounting part, and each limiting structure is accommodated and matched with one positioning structure. The application can reduce the possibility of mutual contact between the lens main body and the side wall of the mounting part, reduce the possibility of extrusion deformation of the lens main body and improve the imaging definition of the lens.

title_en: On-chip culture microscopic imaging equipment used in high-temperature and high-humidity environment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses on-chip culture microscopic imaging equipment used in a high-temperature high-humidity environment, which belongs to the technical field of sealing and comprises an upper cover plate and a lower cover plate matched with the upper cover plate, wherein an electric appliance component is arranged in a cavity formed between the upper cover plate and the lower cover plate, a first sealing ring is arranged at the joint between the upper cover plate and the lower cover plate, an air tightness detection port is arranged on the side wall of the lower cover plate, a plug is inserted at the air tightness detection port, an optical window component is integrally formed at one side position of the upper end of the upper cover plate, a third sealing ring is arranged between a top cover body and a bottom bracket of the optical window component, an inserting port is formed on the upper cover plate, a flip structure is arranged on the inserting port, and a second sealing ring is arranged between the inserting port and the flip structure. The utility model seals the device with high efficiency, prevents moisture from invading the interior of the device, and ensures the performance and service life of the on-chip culture microscopic imaging device.

title_en: AI intelligent glasses that play sound effect is good
abstract_en: The utility model discloses AI intelligent glasses with good sound output effect, which comprise glasses legs and glasses frames, wherein the glasses legs comprise leg body parts, the rear ends of the leg body parts are connected with leg tail parts, the glasses legs comprise glasses leg shells, the inner sides of the glasses leg shells are connected with glasses leg inner covers, a first accommodating cavity and a second accommodating cavity are formed in the positions, corresponding to the leg body parts, of the glasses leg shells, the second accommodating cavity is positioned at the rear end of the first accommodating cavity, a loudspeaker cavity shell is arranged in the second accommodating cavity, a loudspeaker assembly is arranged in the loudspeaker cavity shell, a sound cavity is formed between the loudspeaker assembly and the inner wall of the loudspeaker cavity shell in a surrounding mode, the sound output direction of the loudspeaker assembly faces the sound cavity, sound output holes used for communicating the sound cavity are respectively formed in the glasses leg shells, sound output directions of the sound output holes face the lower sides of the leg tail parts, an outer cavity is formed between the loudspeaker assembly and the inner walls of the second accommodating cavity in a surrounding mode, sound adjusting holes used for communicating the outer cavity are formed in the glasses leg shells, and a pressure releasing hole used for communicating the outer cavity is formed in the loudspeaker assembly. The utility model has good sound effect.

title_en: Beam-combining lens holder
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a beam combining mirror bracket which comprises a shell, wherein a light outlet is formed in one end of the shell, a beam combining mirror is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the light outlet, a light inlet is formed in the other end of the shell, a connecting ring is connected to the inner wall of the light inlet in a threaded manner, a laser tube is fixedly connected to the connecting ring, a through hole is formed in the top of the shell, a red light seat is mounted on the through hole, four adjusting components are arranged between the shell and the red light seat, and a fixing cover is placed on the top of the red light seat. The device utilizes the synergistic effect of the spring, the limit bead and the adjusting screw to realize high-precision beam combination of red light and laser, can conveniently and rapidly adjust, and simultaneously enhances the stability of the mechanism and ensures the reliability of the beam combination state.

title_en: Microscope with adjustable objective table
abstract_en: The application discloses a microscope with an adjustable objective table, and belongs to the field of microscopes. The numerical control device comprises a first numerical control light source, a carrying seat, a carrying groove, a first carrying plate, a carrying table, a plurality of carrying grooves, a first adjusting component, a second adjusting component and a numerical control objective lens converter, wherein the carrying seat is arranged below the light source, the carrying groove is formed in a carrying plate, the first carrying plate is arranged on the carrying seat, the second carrying plate is arranged on the carrying plate, the carrying table is movably arranged on the first carrying plate, the carrying table is movably arranged on the second carrying plate, the carrying grooves are formed in a plurality of carrying grooves and are uniformly formed in the carrying table, the first adjusting component is arranged on the first carrying plate and is used for adjusting the longitudinal movement of the carrying table, the second adjusting component is arranged on the second carrying plate and is used for adjusting the transverse movement of the carrying table, the numerical control objective lens converter is arranged below the carrying plate and corresponds to the carrying groove, and the numerical control objective lens converter is connected to an interface of the numerical control objective lens converter. The microscope provided by the application has the beneficial effect of providing a microscope with an adjustable objective table.

title_en: Video camera
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a camera. The camera comprises a shell, a camera, a circuit board assembly and a circuit board assembly, wherein the camera is arranged on the shell and provided with an optical lens, the circuit board assembly is arranged in the shell and comprises a metal mounting frame, a main board and a circuit board, the main board is arranged on the metal mounting frame, and the circuit board is arranged on the metal mounting frame. The camera has the advantages of few parts, high assembly efficiency, small size and the like.

title_en: High-definition large-aperture projection lens
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-definition large-aperture projection lens which is applied to a projection device, wherein the projection device comprises a projection chip, the high-definition large-aperture projection lens comprises a first lens, a second lens, a third lens, a first lens group, a sixth lens, a seventh lens, a second lens group, a third lens group and a twelfth lens which are sequentially arranged along the direction close to the projection chip, and the focal power of the first lens, the second lens, the third lens, the first lens group, the sixth lens, the seventh lens, the second lens group, the third lens group and the twelfth lens is sequentially negative, positive and positive. The device has high definition, high contrast and uniform brightness, small volume, vibration resistance and good temperature change adaptability.

title_en: Powder box
abstract_en: The utility model provides a powder box which can be detachably arranged in imaging equipment, wherein an in-place detection component and a guide rail groove are arranged in the imaging equipment, the in-place detection component is positioned at the downstream side of the guide rail groove in the installation direction of the powder box, a guide piece and an in-place triggering mechanism are arranged on a first end wall in the length direction of the powder box, the guide piece can be in sliding fit with the guide rail groove, the in-place triggering mechanism is arranged at the downstream side of the guide piece in the installation direction of the powder box, the in-place detection component can be triggered by the in-place triggering mechanism, the in-place triggering mechanism comprises a connecting part, a triggering part and an elastic deformation part, the connecting part is connected with the first end wall, the triggering part can be switched between a triggering position and an avoiding position, the triggering part can be in sliding fit with the guide rail groove when the triggering part is in the avoiding position, and the in-place detection component can be triggered by the triggering part when the triggering part is in the triggering position. The powder box is simple in structure and convenient to assemble, and a user can conveniently judge whether the powder box falls into place in time.

title_en: Traction device for optical cable laying
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a traction device for optical cable laying, which belongs to the technical field of optical cable laying equipment and comprises a supporting plate, an adjusting component and a turnover component, wherein the adjusting component comprises a first electric push rod, a first sliding block, a second sliding block, a limiting groove and a guide wheel, the first sliding block is driven by the first electric push rod, the second sliding block is linked to move through the cooperation of the limiting block and the limiting groove so as to adjust the position of the guide wheel, the turnover component comprises a second electric push rod, a push block, a sliding column, a rotating block, a sliding groove and a cover plate, the second electric push rod drives the push block, the sliding column slides in the sliding groove of the rotating block, and the rotating block is driven to rotate, so that the cover plate can be automatically turned. The utility model solves the problems of inconvenient adjustment and difficult maintenance of the existing device, can rapidly adapt to different optical cables and conveniently open and close the cover plate through the two sets of automatic assemblies, and has the effects of high automation degree, accurate adjustment and convenient maintenance.

title_en: Portable cosmetic Yan Daguang lamp with soft light diffusion plate
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of lighting lamps, and discloses a portable American Yan Daguang lamp with a soft light diffusion plate, which comprises a first lamp post, wherein the upper end of the first lamp post is sequentially provided with a second lamp post and a third lamp post, the upper ends of the insides of the second lamp post and the third lamp post are respectively provided with a lifting mechanism, the lifting mechanisms comprise mounting cavities which are arranged on two sides of the lower ends of the second lamp post and the third lamp post, the inner walls of the mounting cavities are fixedly connected with damping rods, the rod bodies of the damping rods are respectively sleeved with a damping spring, and the output ends of the damping rods are respectively fixedly connected with movable columns. According to the utility model, the movable column is pressed to enter the mounting cavity, then the second lamp post and the third lamp post are adjusted to proper positions, and then the movable column is sprung into the positioning groove through the damping spring and the damping rod, so that the positions of the second lamp post and the third lamp post are respectively fixed.

title_en: A light-proof box for color reaction
abstract_en: The utility model provides a shading box for a color reaction, which relates to the technical field of shading boxes for color reaction and comprises a shading mechanism, wherein the shading mechanism comprises a bottom plate, the top of the bottom plate is provided with a box body, the top of the box body is provided with a top cover, one of the box bodies is fixedly connected with a black cover layer, the bottom of one of the top covers is fixedly connected with a black cushion layer, and the other box body is fixedly connected with a white cover layer. According to the utility model, the shading mechanism is arranged, so that a detector cannot be influenced by external light when in titration color reaction observation and comparison, further the detection result can be more accurate, and the two boxes and the top cover are arranged, and the two boxes and the top cover are respectively fixedly connected with the black cover layer, the black cushion layer and the white cover layer, so that two boxes can provide two different detection environments.

title_en: Bridge convenient to install for optical cable
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of bridges, and particularly relates to a bridge convenient to install for an optical cable, which comprises a bridge, wherein the upper end of the bridge is connected with a frame cover in a sliding manner, a plurality of uniformly distributed supporting frames are fixedly arranged at the bottom of the inner side of the bridge, an optical cable limiting mechanism is arranged on each supporting frame, a splicing sheet is fixedly connected to the left end of the bridge, a plurality of uniformly distributed fixing nails are fixedly connected to the outer side of the bridge, a limiting frame is connected to the outer side of each fixing nail in a sliding manner, a first spring is arranged on the outer side of each fixing nail, the limiting frame is in sliding contact with the frame cover, and the limiting frame is in sliding contact with the bridge. According to the utility model, the bridge frame cover, the limiting frame, the splicing pieces and other structures are additionally arranged on the bridge frame, so that the two bridge frames can be spliced through the splicing pieces and the guide rails in the using process, and then the limiting frame is used for installing the frame cover on the outer side of the bridge frame, so that the bridge frame can be spliced, and the bridge frame can be more conveniently installed.

title_en: Light supplementing lamp for broadcasting television engineering
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of light supplementing lamps, and particularly discloses a light supplementing lamp for broadcasting and television engineering, which comprises the following components in part by weight; the utility model relates to a photoelectric video recorder, which is provided with a light supplementing structure, wherein the light supplementing structure comprises an upper supporting component and a lower supporting component, the bottom of the lower supporting rod is hinged with the top of a positioning frame, one end of the upper supporting rod is hinged with the lower supporting rod, the bottom of a light supplementing lamp panel is hinged with the upper supporting rod, the back of the light supplementing lamp panel is provided with a battery pack, the number of extension rods is multiple, the ends of every two extension rods are hinged, and one end of an inserting rod is hinged with one extension rod.

title_en: Laser weeding machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of agriculture, in particular to a laser weeding machine which comprises a power supply, a mechanical mounting structure, a system main control module, a functional module, a motor and a driving module thereof. According to the utility model, the two right-angle prism faces are utilized to respectively reflect the light emitted by the opposite spectrometer light source and the light emitted by the laser, the stepping motor can accurately adjust the angle of the right-angle prism, so that two beams of light from the spectrometer light source and the laser can be focused in almost the same micro area, the light beam positioning precision is improved, the reliability and the efficiency of the system are improved, and meanwhile, the complex and expensive dichroic mirror which is necessary to be used in the traditional laser weeding equipment is avoided, thereby greatly simplifying the structure of an optical system, and reducing the production cost and the technical implementation difficulty.

title_en: Adjustment mechanism and head-mounted device
abstract_en: The application provides an adjusting mechanism and head-mounted equipment comprising the same, which are used for improving the adjusting efficiency, wherein the adjusting mechanism comprises a shell; the belt assembly comprises a left belt, a right belt and a top belt, wherein the left belt and the right belt are arranged in the shell in an inner layer manner and are respectively provided with a containing groove and a containing groove, the groove walls of the containing grooves and the groove walls of the containing grooves are respectively provided with a first rack and a second rack, the top belt and the right belt are arranged at intervals and are provided with a setting groove, the groove walls of the setting groove are provided with a third rack, the adjusting assembly comprises a first gear piece, a second gear piece and an adjusting piece, the first gear piece movably penetrates through the containing grooves and is respectively meshed with the first rack and the second rack, the second gear piece movably penetrates through the setting groove and is meshed with the third rack, the second gear piece and the first gear piece are coaxially arranged, and the adjusting piece movably penetrates through the shell, the first gear piece and the second gear piece.

title_en: Amplified spontaneous emission light source
abstract_en: The embodiment of the utility model discloses an amplified spontaneous emission light source. The amplified spontaneous emission light source comprises a seed source and a power amplifier, wherein the seed source is used for outputting wide-spectrum signal light with the wave band of 900-930 nm, the power amplifier comprises a first neodymium-doped optical fiber, a first pump source and a beam combiner, the first pump source is used for outputting first pump light, the input end of the beam combiner is respectively connected with the output end of the seed source and the output end of the first pump source, the output end of the beam combiner is connected with the input end of the first neodymium-doped optical fiber, and the first pump light is used for pumping neodymium ions in the first neodymium-doped optical fiber so as to enable the neodymium ions to be stimulated to radiate and amplify the seed signal light.
