abstract_en: The present embodiment comprises: a fixing part; a movement part arranged inside the fixing part; a driving magnet arranged on the movement part; a coil arranged on the fixing part to correspond to the driving magnet; and a ball arranged between the fixing part and the movement part, wherein the ball guides the movement part to move in an optical axial direction with respect to the fixing part, the fixing part comprises a first side plate and a second side plate arranged on the opposite sides as each other, and a third side plate and a fourth side plate which connect the first and the second side plate and are arranged on the opposite sides as each other, the movement part comprises a first side surface and a second side surface arranged on the opposite sides as each other, and a third side surface and a fourth side surface which connect the first side surface and the second side surface and are arranged on the opposite sides as each other, the first through fourth side plates facing the first through fourth side surfaces, the driving magnet moves the movement part in the optical axial direction via interaction with the coil, and comprises a first driving magnet arranged on the first side surface of the movement part, and a second driving magnet arranged on the third side surface of the movement part, and the ball comprises a first ball arranged in a first corner region at which the first side plate and the fourth side plate of the fixing part are connected, and a second ball arranged in a second corner region at which the second side plate and the third side plate of the fixing part are connected.

title_en: Pulse compression electrum optical grating and manufacturing method therefor
abstract_en: A pulse-compressed amber gold grating and its preparation method, wherein the metal layer of the amber gold grating is composed of a binary or multi-element mixture of gold-based materials containing silver and platinum group elements in appropriate proportions, or a gold-on-silver thin film structure. The preparation process includes the optimization of the characteristic contour parameters of the amber gold grating and the material ratio of the amber gold film. The amber gold grating of the present invention, without degrading the traditional optical performance of gold gratings, broadens the high-diffraction-efficiency wavelength range of the grating, addresses or improves the oxidation susceptibility of pure silver gratings, and further enhances the laser damage threshold of gold gratings. The process parameters can support the fabrication of gratings with an aperture size up to the meter level. The gratings and related process parameters of the present invention can support the development of various devices, ranging from spectrometers and commercial ultrafast lasers to large-scale high-peak-power lasers. This has significant implications for the advancement of pulse compression gratings.

title_en: Intermediate transfer unit, image forming apparatus including same and method for manufacturing intermediate transfer unit
abstract_en: An intermediate transfer unit (30) includes a seamless intermediate transfer belt (8), a plurality of primary transfer members (6a) and a power supply line (81). On the intermediate transfer belt (8), toner images formed on a plurality of image carrying members (1a to 1d) are sequentially stacked. The primary transfer members (6a) are respectively arranged opposite the image carrying members (1a to 1d) via the intermediate transfer belt (8), and transfer the toner images formed on the image carrying members (1a to 1d) onto the intermediate transfer belt (8). The power supply line (81) branches to at least two or more locations from a transfer voltage power supply which applies a primary transfer voltage to each of the primary transfer members (6a) to cause a primary transfer current to flow to each of the primary transfer members. The power supply line (81) and each of the primary transfer members are connected via a high-voltage resistor unit (80a) that includes a plurality of resistors (801a, 802a and 803a) having different resistance values.

title_en: An aqueous bioink solution for use in light-based bioprinting applications, and methods of using the aqueous bioink solution
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to an aqueous bioink solution for use in light-based bioprinting applications, comprising: (a) 0.5-95 wt % water-soluble prepolymer; (b) 0.001-5 wt % biocompatible metal acylphosphinate photoinitiator; (c) 0.001-10 wt % biocompatible light absorber; and (d) 5 to 99.5 wt % solvent. The disclosure further relates to a method of using the aqueous bioink solution including living cells and a method of using the aqueous bioink solution without living cells (acellularly).

title_en: Camera module and driving-assistant device
abstract_en: A camera module provided by an embodiment of the invention may include: a head part having a side wall part, a receiving space in the side wall part, and multiple ribs; a lens barrel having an opening connected to the receiving space of the head part and a lens holder perpendicularly extending through the opening; a lens part having multiple lenses in the lens holder; and an image sensor for converting light incident from the multiple lenses into an electrical signal, wherein the multiple ribs are spaced apart from each other on an upper circumference of the opening, each of the multiple ribs has a first inclined surface on the upper circumference of the opening, the opening has a second inclined surface on the circumference thereof, a first angle which is an internal angle between the first inclined surface and a horizontal straight line is R1, a second angle which is an internal angle between the second inclined surface and a horizontal straight line is R2, and a view angle of the image sensor in a diagonal direction is FOV and satisfies equation 1: R1 ≤ 90-1(1/2*FOV).

title_en: Electrophotographic image forming device and cartridge
abstract_en:
[Problem to be solved] 
     To further develop a prior art cartridge. 
     [Solution] 
     A cartridge includes a holding movable between a first position for stably holding a second unit in a spaced position by a first unit and a second position, and a contact force receiving portion capable of receiving a contact force for moving the holding portion from the first position toward the second position to move the second unit to a developing position, when the second unit is in the spaced position. When a predetermined tangential line is a tangential line of a surface of a photosensitive member at an intersection, which is more remote from a rotational center of a charging member, of intersections between a line connecting a rotational center of the charging member and a rotational center of the photosensitive member and the surface of the photosensitive member, as viewed along a direction of a rotational axis of the developing member, and the cartridge is divided by the predetermined tangential line into sections, a predetermined section is a section in which the rotational center of the charging member does not exist, and as viewed along the rotational axis of the developing member when the second unit is in the spaced position, the contact force receiving portion is in the predetermined section.

title_en: System and method for micro laser particles
abstract_en: Disclosed are photonic particles and methods of using particles in biological samples. The particles are configured to emit laser light when energetically stimulated by, e.g., a pump source. The particles may include a gain medium with inorganic materials, an optical cavity with high refractive index, and a coating with organic materials. The particles may be smaller than 3 microns along their longest axes. The particles may attach to each other to form, e.g., doublets and triplets. The particles may be injection-locked by coupling an injection beam into a particle while pumping so that an injection seed is amplified to develop into laser oscillation. A microscopy system may include a pump source, beam scanner, spectrometer with resolution of less than 1 nanometer and acquisition rate of more than 1 kilohertz, and spectral analyzer configured to distinguish spectral peaks of laser output from broadband background.

title_en: Broadband radiation source and method for generating broadband output radiation
abstract_en: Disclosed is a method of controlling a broadband radiation source comprising at least an optical fiber configured to receive pump radiation and generate broadband output radiation. The method comprises obtaining ambient pressure data describing an ambient pressure in an environment of the broadband radiation source; controlling at least one parameter of the pump radiation in dependence of the ambient pressure data; and generating the broadband output radiation using the pump radiation to excite the optical fiber and/or a working medium confined therein.

title_en: Resist underlayer film formation composition
abstract_en:
A resist underlayer film-forming composition, containing a polymer (A) having a repeating unit represented by formula (1) below and a solvent (B).
       
     In formula (1), X 1  represents a divalent group having a ring structure and an iodine atom directly bonded to the ring structure, 
X 2  represents a divalent group, and 
A 1 , A 2 , A 3 , A 4 , A 5 , and A 6  each independently represent a hydrogen atom, a methyl group, or an ethyl group.

title_en: Optical laminate, display comprising same, and window for vehicle or building
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an optical laminate comprising a base layer and an absorption layer, and may provide: an optical laminate which absorbs visible light of all wavelengths evenly, thereby providing good color, prevents glare while ensuring visibility, and has excellent light resistance; a display comprising same; and a window for a vehicle or building.

title_en: Static eliminator, image forming system, and electric charge adjustment apparatus
abstract_en: An image forming system (400) includes an image forming apparatus (100) configured to form an image on a sheet (S), and a static eliminator (300) having a charge eliminating component (51b) configured to neutralize a sheet (S) having an image formed by the image forming apparatus. The static eliminator includes a first setting unit (54a) configured to set a voltage to be applied to the charge eliminating component. The image forming apparatus includes a second setting unit (157) configured to set a voltage to be applied to the charge eliminating component. The image forming system includes a third setting unit (153; 54c) configured to set which voltage is applied as a voltage to be applied to the charge eliminating component, the voltage set by the first setting unit or the voltage set by the second setting unit.

title_en: Method to perform a sweeping motions in microlithography
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a method to perform a non-orthogonal sweeping motion in a microlithography system. The method comprises measuring a position deviation of the tool head relative the stage in a first direction parallel with the first axis, receiving a sweep command comprising a sweep angle, α, wherein the sweep angle is an angle between the sweep direction and the first direction, determining an X-offset in the scanning direction, based on the position deviation and the sweep angle, performing a first compensation of the sweeping motion of the optical beam scanning arrangement based on the position deviation and the sweep angle, performing a second compensation of the sweeping motion by moving the tool head and/or the stage in the scanning direction based on the X-offset, performing the sweeping motion in the sweep direction wherein the sweep direction is non-orthogonal to the first axis and the second axis, respectively.

title_en: High resolution photolithography
abstract_en: Devices, systems, and method for high resolution photolithography can include a mounting stage for receiving a substrate in position to receive projected light for photolithography, a light processing system for projecting light onto the mounting stage for photolithography on the substrate, and a positioning system for adjusting relative positioning between the light processing system and the mounting stage. A control system for conducting operations for high resolution photolithography, can be configured to determine relative positioning between the light processing system and the mounting stage and for governing operation of the positioning system for adj usting relative positioning.

title_en: Image printing apparatus, control method of image printing apparatus, and program
abstract_en: An image printing apparatus (100) comprising: a first processing unit to execute processing for transitioning the image printing apparatus to a power saving state with the power of the image printing apparatus kept on, based on a non-operating time period for which the image printing apparatus has been in a non-operating state and information indicating whether or not the image printing apparatus in the non-operating state is in a predetermined state (201,S404,S405); a second processing unit to execute processing for automatically turning off the power of the image printing apparatus from the power saving state, based on the non-operating time period of the image printing apparatus (201, S404,S405,S407,S408); and a third processing unit to execute processing for automatically turning off the power of the image printing apparatus from a state other than the power saving state, based on the non-operating time period of the image printing apparatus (201, S404,S407,S408).

title_en: Baseplate for supporting a reticle and related systems and methods
abstract_en: Described are baseplate devices used to support, transport, and process a reticle, including to support a reticle during a step of detecting particle contamination at a surface of the reticle prior to using the reticle in an extreme ultraviolet (EUV) lithography process. The baseplate device can be designed to prevent or to reduce an amount of light used in a reticle backside inspection system that is reflected from a baseplate, e.g., by edge structures of the baseplate, and re-directed to a camera of the reticle backside inspection system.

title_en: Mixed-reality apparatuses and systems
abstract_en: The disclosed mixed-reality display may include an optical system dimensioned to project a mixed-reality image to a user such that an angle of projection determines a region hidden from a peripheral view of the user. The mixed-reality display may also include one or more hardware components electronically coupled to the optical system and dimensioned to fit within the region such that the one or more hardware components are hidden from the user. Additionally, the mixed-reality display may include a frame coupled to hold the optical system and the one or more hardware components, wherein a rim of the frame is dimensioned to fit within the region. Various other apparatuses, systems, and methods of manufacturing are also disclosed.

title_en: Hybrid heads-up display for presenting virtual content outside boundaries
abstract_en: A relative location of each eye (112a-b) of user(s) (114) with respect to an optical combiner (106) is determined. A position and an orientation of a first region of a light-emitting component (118) of a light field display unit (104) is determined. A first region of a given light field image (LFI) is generated, wherein the first region of the light-emitting component displays the first region of the given LFI. A second region of the given LFI is generated, wherein the second region of the light-emitting component displays the second region of the given LFI. When the given LFI is displayed, wherein a first part of a synthetic light field (122) corresponding to the first region of the given LFI is directed towards the user(s), whilst a second part of the synthetic light field corresponding to the second region of the given LFI is directed towards the optical combiner.

title_en: Photoelectric sensor with improved light spot overlap and related method
abstract_en: A photoelectric sensor includes an emitter that emits a plurality of light beams. Fractions thereof pass through transparent portions of a first body and a second body in series before intersecting an optically powered surface, which directs the fractions to a target focusing an image that passes through a perimeter of the first body in one direction and focusing an image that passes through a perimeter of the second body in a perpendicular direction. The emitter, first and second bodies, and the optically powered surface are positioned so as to form a light spot on the target within which the fractions of the plurality of light beams substantially overlap. The fractions of the plurality of light beams reflect off of the target and are received by a receiver, which detects changes in the light to determine whether a mark is present on the target.

title_en: A microscopy system, a method of moving a microscope slide, and a transport unit
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a microscopy system, a method of moving a microscope slide in a microscopy system, and to a transport unit. The microscopy system (1) comprising an image data capturing unit (6) configured to capture image data of the sample on the microscope slide (60) at the analysis position (AP), and a transport unit (2) configured to move the microscope slide (60) between a receiving position (RP) and the analysis position (AP), wherein the transport unit (2) comprises; a first and a second opposing gripper member (10, 20) having a respective gripping portion (11, 21) being reciprocally movable relative to each other along a first direction (A) to selectively grip the microscope slide (60), and a manoeuvring unit (30) configured to reciprocally move along a second direction (B) between a first, a second, and a third position (P1, P2, P3) such that the transport unit (2) assumes a gripping mode (GM), an open mode (OM), and an ejection mode (EM), respectively.

title_en: Optical fiber connector and connection box
abstract_en: Embodiments of this application relate to the field of communication technologies, and provide an optical fiber connector and a connection box. The optical fiber connector includes an inner housing assembly, a ferrule assembly, and an optical cable. The ferrule assembly includes a plurality of ceramic ferrules. One end of each of the ceramic ferrules is located in an accommodation cavity of the inner housing assembly, and the other end extends out of the inner housing assembly. The optical cable includes a plurality of optical fibers, the plurality of optical fibers penetrate through-holes of the ceramic ferrules, and the plurality of ceramic ferrules are arranged in an array including M rows and N columns, where M≥2, and N≥2. The ceramic ferrule has high stiffness and strength, which helps improve precision of the ferrule, allowing ceramic ferrules at two ends to be better aligned during interconnection between optical fiber connectors. This helps improve alignment precision of optical fibers in the ceramic ferrules, and effectively reduce a loss of transmission between optical fibers. Therefore, efficiency of optical signal transmission between the optical fiber connectors is efficiency improved, and a ferrule loss is reduced.

title_en: Organometallic sn oxo carboxylate clusters with carboxylate ligands that contain a linear or cyclic ester functionality
abstract_en: The disclosed and claimed subject matter relates to Sn6-oxo clusters with carboxylic acids containing linear ester or cyclic ester (lactone) functional groups, the synthesis thereof, formulations thereof and use thereof in EUV lithography.

title_en: Display structure
abstract_en: According to an embodiment, a display structure (100) comprise: a waveguide (101); an in-coupling structure (102) configured to couple a set of input beams (103) into the waveguide (101) as a set of in-coupled beams (104); a first exit pupil expansion structure (105) comprising a diffraction grating configured to receive the set of in-coupled beams (104) and to diffract the set of in-coupled beams (104) to form a first set of diffracted beams (106); and an out-coupling structure (107) configured to receive the first set of diffracted beams (106), and to out-couple the first set of diffracted beams (106) from the waveguide (101) as a set of output beams (108); wherein the diffraction grating of the first exit pupil expansion structure (105) is further configured to, for incident light at a first wavelength hitting the first exit pupil expansion structure (105), in-couple the incident light into the waveguide (101) and/or not diffract the incident light.

title_en: A micro-optic device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a micro-optic device for use in a micro-optic image presentation system. Specifically, the micro-optic device is formed as a single layer unitary structure arranged to generate various complex imagery effects.

title_en: Optical assembly
abstract_en: An optical assembly includes an optical element 12 defining a primary axis and an actuator assembly 14 which deforms the optical element. The actuator assembly includes a first part 22 coupled to the optical element, a support structure 18, a moving part 20 and a shape memory alloy (SMA) element. The moving part moves relative to the support structure and is coupled to the first part. The shape memory alloy (SMA) element drives movement of the moving part relative to the support structure effecting movement of the first part and thus deforming the optical element. The optical assembly retains the first part in position with respect to the support structure when the SMA element is unpowered. The actuator assembly may drive movement of the first part in a direction parallel to the primary axis. The actuator assembly may rotate the first part about an axis perpendicular to the primary axis. The moving part may include two friction surfaces 25 and 28,36 engaging with a friction force to resist movement of the moving part with respect to the first part and/or support structure. A virtual reality headset, augmented reality headset or pair of glasses may include the optical assembly.

title_en: Suppression of ghost reflections in a windscreen
abstract_en: A head-up display (HUD) includes a display which outputs linearly, S-polarised display light 810 to an optical combiner 800. The optical combiner has primary 802A and secondary 806A surfaces which reflect first 822 and second portions of the display light respectively towards a viewing plane forming a primary image 830 and its ghost reflection. The optical combiner has a polarisation converter 808 between its primary and secondary surfaces which reduces the intensity of the ghost reflection. The optical combiner may receive the HUD light at the primary surface before the secondary surface. The polarisation converter may change the polarisation of the S-polarised HUD light using a half-wave component converting the S-polarised HUD light to P-polarised light 823 or a quarter-wave component converting the S-polarised light to circularly polarised light 823. The optical combiner and display may be arranged so that the polarisation converter reduces the intensity of the ghost reflection to near zero. The head-up display light may include multiple replicas. A windscreen includes primary and secondary surfaces with a polarisation converter in-between which reduces the intensity of a ghost reflection from the secondary surface. The windscreen acts as an optical combiner for a head-up display using S-polarised light.

title_en: Optical fibre assembly
abstract_en: An optical fibre assembly 100 for dispersing light, the assembly comprising: a first optical fibre section 101 having a proximal end 102 and a distal end, the distal end comprising a first down-taper 104 in which the diameter of the optical fibre decreases; and a second optical fibre section 105 having a proximal end and a distal end 107, the proximal end comprising a first up-taper 108 in which the diameter of the optical fibre increases; wherein the assembly is arranged such that when light is directed into the proximal end of the first optical fibre section, at least a portion of the light is emitted from the first down-taper and is dispersed by the first up-taper (figure 2 111, 113). Optionally the fibre may comprise a plurality of tapered sections and may be clad 110 and/or sheathed (figure 7 122), which may facilitate the dispersal of light. Figure 1.

title_en: Display device
abstract_en: To provide a touch panel having a thin thickness, provide a touch panel with high visibility, provide a lightweight touch panel, or provide a touch panel reduced in power consumption.SOLUTION: A pair of conductive layers constituting a capacitive touch sensor is made to have a mesh shape having a plurality of openings. Furthermore, a material for shielding visible light is used and made to be functioned as a light-shielding layer by being arranged so as to overlap with an area between two display elements in a plan view. Moreover, the pair of conductive layers which constitutes the touch panel is arranged inside a pair of substrates possessed by the touch panel, and the conductive layer capable of supplying a constant potential is provided between the pair of conductive layers and a circuit for driving the display element.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Driving device
abstract_en: To provide a driving device that can be reduced in size as a whole.SOLUTION: Extending parts 71, 72 of yoke parts 7A, 7B hold a base part 4 therebetween, and end parts 711, 721 of the yoke parts face magnetic elements 5A, 5B provided on an intermediate frame 3. This configuration reduces the dimension of a whole driving device 1A in a Z direction in comparison to a configuration in which the whole yoke part is arranged on one side in the Z direction with respect to the base part. Additionally, the base part 4 surrounds substantially halfway a mirror 2 and opens, in comparison to a configuration in which the whole circumference is surrounded, the dimension of the whole driving device 1A in a Y direction can be reduced. As such, the whole driving device 1A can be reduced in size.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Image capturing optical lens
abstract_en: To provide an image capturing optical lens which offers high imaging performance and meets the demand for extreme thinness and a wider view angle.SOLUTION: An image capturing optical lens comprises, in order from the object side to the image side, a first lens L1, second lens L2, third lens L3, fourth lens L4, fifth lens L5, and sixth lens L6, the first lens L1 having positive refractive power, the second lens L2 having negative refractive power, and the third lens L3 having negative refractive power. The image capturing optical lens satisfies the following conditional expressions: 10.00≤f2/f3≤20.00, 1.00≤d2/d4≤3.00, where f2 represents a focal length of the second lens L2, f3 represents a focal length of the third lens L3, d2 represents a distance from an image-side surface of the first lens L1 to an object-side surface of the second lens L2 along an optical axis, and d4 represents a distance from an image-side surface of the second lens L2 to an object-side surface of the third lens L3 along the optical axis.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Setting information utilization system, setting information transition method, information processing apparatus, and program
abstract_en: To provide a setting information utilization system that prevents a mistake in an application destination of setting information.SOLUTION: An information processing apparatus has a setting information registration unit 32 that registers setting information transmitted from a first electronic apparatus and first identification information for identifying a network that is used when the first electronic apparatus transmits the setting information in association with each other, a specification unit 33 that, in response to an acquisition request for requesting acquisition of the setting information transmitted from a second electronic apparatus, specifies the setting information registered by the setting information registration unit based on the first identification information and second identification information for identifying the network used when the acquisition request is transmitted, and a transmission unit 31b that transmits the setting information specified by the specification unit to the second electronic apparatus.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Fluorescent filter unit and fluorescent observation light device including the same
abstract_en: To provide a filter unit capable of miniaturizing a device without switching a light absorption filter.SOLUTION: A filter unit 100 includes: a first incident section for making excitation light incident; a second incident section for making observation light emitted by the excitation light incident; an emission section for emitting the observation light; and a light absorption filter 103 arranged between the second incident section and the emission section. The light absorption filter 103 has an optical element for changing a wavelength region through which the observation light passes. Preferably, the optical element is an electrochromic element having a first electrode, a second electrode, and an electrochromic layer arranged between the first electrode and the second electrode.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Image forming apparatus and program for adjustment
abstract_en: To provide an image forming apparatus that can easily adjust machine setting information to machine setting information corresponding to a sheet supplied to an accommodation unit.SOLUTION: An image forming apparatus 100 comprises: an image forming unit 14; an accommodation unit 121; a conveying unit 13; a control unit 18; an acquisition unit 11; and a storage unit 17. The control unit 18 controls the image forming unit 14 and the conveying unit 13 according to machine setting information corresponding to the type of a sheet S. The acquisition unit 11 acquires an image for specification for specifying the type of the sheet S. The storage unit 17 stores a plurality of candidates for machine setting information in association with a plurality of registered images. When the sheet S is supplied to the accommodation unit 121, the control unit 18 determines whether an adaptive image that is a registered image adapted for the image for specification is present in the plurality of registered images. When determining that the adaptive image is present, the control unit 18 adjusts the machine setting information on the basis of a candidate for the machine setting information associated with the adaptive image among the plurality of candidates for the machine setting information.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Sheet transport device, image reading device, and sheet transport method
abstract_en: To provide a sheet transport device that suppresses the effect of noise and detects double feeding highly accurately.SOLUTION: The sheet transport device transports a document to a transport route 217 from a document tray 101. Across a transport route 217 provided are an ultrasonic wave transmitter 206 that transmits burst waves with predetermined intervals and an ultrasonic wave receiver 207 that receives burst waves transmitted from the ultrasonic wave transmitter 206 and outputs an electric signal that is a received burst wave converted into voltage amplitude. The sheet transport device performs a process of generating an AD conversion value from the electric signal in accordance with N pieces of burst waves at the same sampling position of one cycle ultrasonic wave M times while shifting the sampling position in the one cycle of the ultrasonic wave. The sheet transport device performs a process of calculating the amplitude of the burst waves from the generated, N×M pieces of AD conversion values each time AD conversion values by the electric signal in accordance with N pieces of burst waves are obtained. The sheet transport device detects double feeding based on the amplitude.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Laser module and fiber laser device
abstract_en: To provide an inexpensive laser module capable of outputting a laser beam with a desired wavelength.SOLUTION: A laser module 1 comprises: an optical fiber 14; a plurality of semiconductor laser elements 22A to 22F and 122A to 122F; a beam splitter 150 that synthesizes a laser beam ejected from each of the semiconductor laser elements 22A to 22F and a laser beam ejected from each of the semiconductor laser elements 122A to 122F to direct them to condenser lenses 32 and 34; and a plurality of wavelength stabilization elements 41 to 46 that achieve a narrow band of a wavelength of laser beams LA to LF ejected from the semiconductor laser elements 22A to 22F. Each of the wavelength stabilization elements 41 to 46 is arranged on a downstream side of mirrors 28 and 128, and is structured so as to achieve the narrow band of the wavelength of the laser beams ejected from the semiconductor laser elements 22A to 22F and 122A to 122F.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Developer supply container and image forming apparatus
abstract_en: To provide a developer supply container that allows more stable discharge of a developer in a developer storage container.SOLUTION: A developer supply container is arranged with a regulation member 853 that separates a container body storing a developer and a discharge part 850 having a discharge port 8501 from each other. The regulation member 853 has an elastically bendable circular regulation plate 855. An outer peripheral part 880 of the regulation plate 855 is provided with a notch part 882 to be a passage for a developer. When an area 883 adjacent to the notch part 882 is pushed in an arrow Y-direction by the developer being conveyed, the regulation plate is elastically bent according to magnitude of the pushing force to form an expanded passage for a developer.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Position holding mechanism and image forming apparatus
abstract_en: To prevent falling from a holding position.SOLUTION: A position holding mechanism comprises: a connection member 10 that is provided on any one of an outer door and an inner door and includes a slide hole 12; and a connection boss 4 that is provided on the other of the outer door and the inner door and is connected to the slide hole 12 to slide the slide hole 12 in association with rotation of the inner door with respect to the outer door. The slide hole 12 has, in communication with each other, a first wide part 12a, a second wide part 12c and a third wide part 12f in which the length in a width direction W orthogonal to a slide direction D2 in which the connection boss 4 slides is equal to or longer than the length d1 in the width direction W of the connection boss 4, a first narrow part 12b that is provided between the first wide part 12a and the second wide part 12c and is less than the length in the width direction W of the connection boss 4, and a second narrow part 12d that is provided between the second wide part 12c and the third wide part 12f and is less than the length in the width direction W of the connection boss 4.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title_en: Infrared imaging device, infrared imaging system and infrared imaging method
abstract_en: To provide an infrared imaging device with a temperature measurement function capable of accurately measuring a temperature of a substance with a low emissivity.SOLUTION: An infrared imaging device comprises an imaging element 106 having a main light receiving sensitivity at a wavelength of 0.9 to 1.7 μm, an optical diaphragm 105 for adjusting a light volume of an infrared ray incident on the imaging element, and a storage unit 109 in which the emissivity of an object to be measured and the upper limit of the measurement temperature of the object to be measured are stored in advance. The infrared imaging device calculates an output value of the imaging element based on the emissivity and the upper limit of the measurement temperature stored in the storage unit, and adjusts an exposure time, the optical diaphragm, or both based on the calculated output value.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Information processing device, control method of information processing device, and program thereof
abstract_en: To improve the convenience and confidentiality of an information processing device having an overlay display function.SOLUTION: Reference information indicating a reference destination of an overlay image 450 is set in an information processing device 10. When a remote live view function is executed in a photographing system 100, a live view screen 410 displaying a live view image 411 received from the imaging device 20 is displayed on a display 51 of the information processing device 10. A reference destination image set as the overlay image 450 and an auxiliary line are overlaid on the live view image 411. When an overlay image setting clear button 422 of the live view screen 410 is pressed, the setting of the reference destination information of the overlay image 450 is canceled, and the setting of the auxiliary line is retained.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 9

title_en: Semiconductor device
abstract_en: To provide an improved technique for implementing a LIDAR system that achieves lower manufacturing costs while improving the quality of input data.SOLUTION: A packaged semiconductor device includes a substrate, a diode die supported by the substrate and arranged to emit an electromagnetic energy beam, and a shell coupled to the substrate to enclose the diode die, the shell including an aperture or transparent region that allows the electromagnetic energy beam emitted from the diode die to pass through the shell.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 9A

title_en: Molding die, and method for manufacturing optical element
abstract_en: To provide a technique capable of suppressing the inclination eccentricity of an optical element being a molding.SOLUTION: The molding die comprises: a cylindrical barrel die; an upper die for pressing the material of an optical element from above in the inside of the barrel die; a spacer arranged above the upper die; and a lower die for pressing the material from below in the inside of the barrel die. The barrel die includes a vertical sleeve for storing the material; the upper die includes an upper shaft inserted into the sleeve of the barrel die; and the lower die includes a lower shaft inserted into the sleeve of the barrel die. The upper surface of the spacer having a curved surface convex upward has the highest point in height on the vertical center line of the upper shaft, and the lower surface of the spacer having a curved surface convex downward has the lowest point in height on the vertical center line of the upper shaft.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3A

title_en: Process cartridge and electrophotographic device
abstract_en: To provide a process cartridge having an electrophotographic photoreceptor and electrifying means that maintain photosensitivity and prevent image deletion after a long-term repeated use and storage under a high-temperature and high-humidity environment.SOLUTION: A process cartridge has an electrophotographic photoreceptor having a first support and a photosensitive layer, and an electrifying member. When a voltage is applied to a surface of the photoreceptor while changing the voltage to measure a current, in a graph with the square root of the electric field intensity of the photoreceptor on the horizontal axis and the common logarithm of the current on the vertical axis, the inclination a1 of a low electric field area and the inclination a2 of a high electric field area are a2/a1≥1.50. The electrifying member has a second support having a conductive outer surface and a second conductive layer. The second conductive layer has a matrix and a plurality of domains dispersed in the matrix. At least some of the domains are exposed to an outer surface of the electrifying member. The outer surface is composed at least of the matrix and at least some of the domains. The volume resistivity of the matrix ρM is 1.00×105 or more times the volume resistivity of the domains ρD.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Photosensitive resin composition, photosensitive element, semiconductor device and method for forming resist pattern
abstract_en: To provide a photosensitive resin composition that can form a resist pattern having reduced dielectric constants as an insulation film.SOLUTION: A photosensitive resin composition contains (A) component: a copolymer having a structure in which a polyphenylene ether unit and a polybutadiene unit are bonded via an ester bond.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Image data acquisition method
abstract_en: To provide a method for acquiring the image data of a subject efficiently in a shorter time.SOLUTION: Provided is a method for acquiring the image data of a subject comprising a first scan step including a plurality of steps W for determining one place existing in a first space that is one-, two- or three-dimensional, and a second scan step for scanning the inside of a second space that includes at least one said place. The second scan step includes a step X for determining the position of an observation point at random and a step Y for acquiring the image data of the observation point. At the time one scan inside of the second space is terminated, the second space has a first region that includes 50% of observation points and a second region that includes the remaining 50% of observation points existing in the outside of the first region, the second region being made to be 15% wider than the first region.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Polymerizable liquid crystal composition and liquid crystal polymerized film
abstract_en: To provide a liquid crystal polymerized film of a polymerizable liquid crystal composition, which suppresses occurrence of irregular alignment directions or alignment defects caused by disturbance in the alignment of liquid crystal molecules, and to provide a liquid crystal polymerized film inducing little elusion of an ionic component into a liquid crystal layer in a liquid crystal cell and having excellent recoating property so as not to impair display quality of an obtained liquid crystal display device.SOLUTION: A polymerizable liquid crystal composition is disclosed, which comprises a nonionic antistatic agent. A polymerizable liquid crystal composition is disclosed, which comprises a surfactant and a nonionic antistatic agent having a structure represented by formula (B).SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Image formation device and image formation method
abstract_en: To realize high productivity by reducing a paper feed interval between continuously-fed recording mediums, in an image formation device for forming a foil image on the recording medium.SOLUTION: An image formation device 1 comprises: a conveyance path P for conveying a recording medium 9 in a prescribed direction; an image printing part 2 which is provided to the conveyance path P to print a monochromatic image or a color image on the recording medium 9; a toner image forming part 3 for transferring a toner image to the recording medium 9; and a foil image forming part 5 which is provided on a downstream side of the toner image forming part 3 on the conveyance path P, and melts the toner image transferred to the recording medium 9 so that the foil is attached to the toner image to form a foil image. The conveyance path P has a configuration containing a first passage P1 by which the recording medium passes through the foil image forming part 5 on the downstream side of the toner image forming part 3 and a second passage P2 by which the recording medium 9 does not pass through the foil image forming part 5.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Liquid crystal composition and liquid crystal display element
abstract_en: To provide a liquid crystal composition with negative dielectric anisotropy which contains a polymerizable compound and a polar compound having a polymerizable group (or polymer thereof), and in which a vertical orientation of liquid crystal molecules is achievable by the effect of the compound, and a liquid crystal display element.SOLUTION: A nematic liquid crystal composition that contains polymerizable compound as an additive X, contains a polar compound having a polymerizable group as an additive Y, and has negative dielectric anisotropy. The composition may contain specific liquid crystalline compound as component A having negatively large dielectric anisotropy, specific liquid crystalline compound as component B having high upper limit temperature or small viscosity, and a polymerizable compound as additive Z, and a liquid crystal display element containing the composition.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Camera device for vehicle
abstract_en: To suppress unnecessary intrusion of water.SOLUTION: In a camera device for vehicle, a camera captures an image of the vehicle rear side of a cover glass 26 through the cover glass 26. In this case, in the cover glass 26, a hydrophilic film 32 is not disposed at both of the ends in the vehicle width direction of a transparent conductive film 30. As a result of this, the movement of water from the hydrophilic film 32 to both of the ends in the vehicle width direction of the transparent conductive film 30 is suppressed, thereby suppressing unnecessary intrusion of water to both of the ends in the vehicle width direction of the transparent conductive film 30.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Image formation device
abstract_en: To provide an image formation device of a pickup-less system possible to suppress occurrence of non-feeding of a strong recording sheet while suppressing occurrence of a fold of a weak recording sheet.SOLUTION: A recording sheet S before entering a separation nip by a contact between a feeding roller and a separation roller is bent by its own contact, and a deflection imparting portion 127b is provided for generating wrinkles on the recording sheet S extending along a conveying direction (arrow direction in the figure), and a tip end portion of the deflection imparting body 127b in contact with the recording sheet S is composed of a flexible member.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 13

title_en: Colored photosensitive resin composition and black matrix prepared therefrom
abstract_en: To provide a colored photosensitive resin composition and a black matrix prepared therefrom.SOLUTION: The colored photosensitive resin composition of the present invention comprises a multifunctional thiol compound and/or a compound containing a double bond and a hydroxyl group, whereby it can sufficiently form a cured film even at low temperatures. In addition, the photosensitive resin composition of the present invention has a fast development speed and excellent resolution and chemical resistance.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Electronic device
abstract_en: To provide a novel touch panel that is highly convenient or reliable, to provide a novel information processing device that is highly convenient or reliable, and to provide a novel touch panel, a novel information processing device, or a novel semiconductor device.SOLUTION: A structure is contemplated, which comprises: a sensing element that includes a first conductive film and a second conductive film; and a display element that includes a layer containing a liquid crystal material and a third conductive film which is arranged so that an electric field controlling the alignment of the liquid crystal material contained in the layer containing the liquid crystal material can be applied to a space between the first conductive film and itself.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Phase difference laminate, optical laminate, and manufacturing method for these
abstract_en: To provide a phase difference laminate and an optical laminate with which handleability is good when manufacturing an optical laminate, etc., and a manufacturing method for these.SOLUTION: The phase difference laminate includes a first phase difference layer, a first pasted layer and a second phase difference layer in the order stated. The first phase difference layer includes a first liquid crystal layer which is a cured layer of a polymerizable liquid crystal compound, and the second phase difference layer includes a second liquid crystal layer which is a cured layer of a polymerizable liquid crystal compound. A piercing elastic modulus E1 of the first phase difference layer is 35 g/mm or greater. The piercing elastic modulus E1 and a piercing elastic modulus E2 of the second phase difference layer satisfy formula (1). Formula (1): 0.7≤E1/E2≤1.3.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Image forming apparatus
abstract_en: To accurately obtain the surface potential of an image carrier without using an expensive sensor such as a surface potential sensor.SOLUTION: An image forming apparatus 1 comprises: a developing device 64 that develops an electrostatic latent image formed on a photoreceptor drum 65 to form a toner image; an electrifying device 63 that electrifies the photoreceptor drum 65; a developing power supply 648 that applies a predetermined bias voltage to the developing device 64; and a calculation unit 647 that calculates the surface potential of the photoreceptor drum 65 on the basis of a developing current flowing in the developing device 64. The calculation unit 647 calculates, as a surface potential, a bias voltage when a non-electrification developing current Id0 flowing in the developing device 64 in a non-electrification state in which the electrifying device 63 does not electrify the photoreceptor drum 65 becomes equal to an electrification developing current flowing in the developing device 64 in an electrification state in which the electrifying device 63 electrifies the photoreceptor drum 65.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Laminate, method for producing laminate, optical laminate and flexible display
abstract_en: To provide a laminate that has high-level gas barrier properties despite its low-cost, simple structure, and also has high sterilization performance and high light transmittance.SOLUTION: A laminate has, on at least one side of a base material 1, A layer 2 containing silicon, a metal element and oxygen. The laminate has a spectral absorption rate of 15% or less at a wavelength 300 nm as measured with a spectrophotometer.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Electrooptical device and electronic apparatus
abstract_en: To provide an electrooptical device excellent in specifying a view angle and an electronic apparatus.SOLUTION: An electrooptical device comprises: a first light emitter for emitting light of a first wavelength region from a first light-emitting region; a second light emitter for emitting light of a second wavelength region from a second light-emitting region; a third light emitter for emitting light of a third wavelength region from a third light-emitting region; a first filter that transmits the light of the first wavelength region and the light of the second wavelength region and that blocks the light of the third wavelength region; and a second filter that transmits the light of the first wavelength region and the light of the third wavelength region and that blocks the light of the second wavelength region. The third wavelength region is shorter than the second wavelength region. The second wavelength region is shorter than the first wavelength region.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 7

title_en: Toy system
abstract_en: To provide a more novel toy system capable of attracting user's interest.SOLUTION: A toy system 100 includes a plurality of elastically deformable bounce members 10 laid on a floor surface, and a projector for projecting image light to the plurality of bounce members.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Image forming device, information processing device, and program
abstract_en:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an image forming device which, upon receipt of an instruction from a user to collectively execute two or more adjustment items that can be arbitrary selected and executed for adjustment related to image formation of the image forming device, makes adjustments corresponding to the adjustment items in a predetermined order regardless of the order in which the two or more adjustment items were selected by the user. 
     SOLUTION: An image forming device is provided, comprising: image forming means for forming an image on a recording material; a control unit configured to provide control to make a display unit display a screen showing multiple adjustment items related to quality of an image formed by the image forming means; and an adjustment unit configured to respond to a situation where two or more arbitrary selectable adjustment items are selected through manipulation on the screen and an instruction is issued to collectively execute the two or more adjustment items by making adjustments corresponding to the two or more adjustment items in a predetermined order regardless of an order in which the two or more adjustment items were selected.

title_en: Image processing device, control method of the same, and program
abstract_en: To improve user operability when operating an image processing device in which the display order of buttons changes automatically.SOLUTION: The image processing device includes means for displaying a plurality of display objects on an operation screen to instruct the execution of a process, means for determining whether to change the display order of the plurality of display objects on the basis of the status of the image processing device, and means for changing the display order of the plurality of display objects displayed on the operation screen in accordance with the number of times each display object is used in the case where it is determined to change the display order by the determination means.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 9

title_en: Storage case for powder, developing device, and image forming apparatus
abstract_en: To provide a storage case for powder that can prevent stored powder from leaking from between a first member and a second member located at an edge of a case opening.SOLUTION: In a storage case for powder in which a first member 10 and a second member 20 are joined to each other to form an edge of a case opening, a main junction 70 of the first member 10 and the second member 20 is provided such that ends 75a are located at the edge of the case opening, and additional junctions 81 of the first member 10 and the second member 20 are provided adjacent to the ends 75a. The additional junctions 81 are provided such that ends 81a of the additional junctions are located at different portions from ends 85a of the main junction 70 at the edge of the case opening.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title_en: Electronic device, light source device, and projection device
abstract_en: To provide an electronic device capable of firmly connecting unit members together.SOLUTION: A light source device 60 as an electronic device includes: a first unit member 610 having a first contact engagement part 611; a second unit member 620 which includes a second contact engagement part 621 and which is connected to the first unit member 610; and a fixing member 655 sandwiching the first contact engagement part 611 and the second contact engagement part 621 in a state to make them engage and contact with each other.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title_en: Optical display media and articles
abstract_en: To provide an optical display medium with increased difficulty in reuse.SOLUTION: There is provided an optical display medium including a holding portion having a first translucent portion that can transmit light, a second translucent portion that can transmit light, a connection portion that connects the first translucent portion and the second translucent portion; and a display portion provided with a polarization separation layer having a polarization separation function. The first translucent portion, the connection portion, and the second translucent portion are continuously formed. The first translucent portion and the second translucent portion face each other. The display portion is provided between the first translucent portion and the second translucent portion. The polarization separation layer is directly or indirectly adhered to both the first translucent portion and the second translucent portion.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Toner conveying device and cleaning device including the same and image forming apparatus
abstract_en: To provide a toner conveying device that can maintain stable toner conveyance performance while effectively preventing solidification of toner, a cleaning device including the same, and an image forming apparatus.SOLUTION: A toner conveying device of the present invention is a toner conveying device comprising a toner conveyance path, a conveying screw, and a scraping member. title_en: Optical waveguide device
abstract_en: To reduce variations in characteristics for polarized waves without complicating a configuration.SOLUTION: An optical waveguide device comprises: a support substrate; a cladding formed on the support substrate; and an optical waveguide core embedded in the cladding and provided parallel to a top face of the support substrate. The optical waveguide device has a first wavelength selection unit that selects a specific wavelength of a TE (transverse electric) polarized wave, a polarization conversion unit that performs polarization conversion between a TM (transverse magnetic) polarized wave and the TE polarized wave, and a second wavelength selection unit that selects a specific wavelength of the TE polarized wave, which are arranged in series in this order.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Image forming apparatus
abstract_en: To solve the problem in which: both ends of a cleaning blade 6 can be impregnated with an isocyanate compound to be cured, thereby preventing turn-up of the blade; however, swelling of an impregnation part forms a gap, which causes slip-through of toner.SOLUTION: Isocyanate treatment can be gradually performed on both ends of a cleaning blade 6 to reduce a boundary level difference while maintaining μ of an outermost end of the cleaning blade 6, and thereby both prevention of blade turn-up and prevention of boundary slip-through are achieved.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Display device and optical unit
abstract_en: To reduce distortion to improve resolution.SOLUTION: A display device 100 comprises: a projector lens 21 that transmits image light ML from a video element 11; a prism mirror 22 that makes the image light ML emitted from the projector lens 21 incident on a light incident surface 22a, reflects the image light on an internal reflection surface 22b, and emits the image light from a light emission surface 22c; and a see-through mirror 23 that reflects the image light ML emitted from the prism mirror 22 toward a pupil position. The prism mirror 22 and the see-through mirror 23 are arranged to bend a light path along a reference surface to form an off-axis optical system. An intermediate image IM is formed between the internal reflection surface 22b and the see-through mirror 23. The display device includes, between the internal reflection surface 22b and the see-through mirror 23 with respect to the reference surface, the light emission surface 22c as a refractive surface having a front side area R1 with a relatively high refractive power on a front side and an area R2 with a relatively low refractive power on a rear side.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Image forming apparatus
abstract_en: To achieve both accurate detection of sheet characteristics of a recording material and detection of an operation sound.SOLUTION: An image forming apparatus comprises: a cassette tray 101 on which sheets 2 are placed; a feeding roller 104 that feeds the sheets 2 from the cassette tray 101; a process cartridge 22 that forms images on the sheets 2; a transmission unit 31 that transmits ultrasonic waves; a receiving unit 71 that receives the ultrasonic waves transmitted from the transmission unit 31 or an operation sound generated during image formation; a basis weight detection control unit 302 that detects the basis weight of the sheets 2 based on output from the receiving unit 71; an operation sound detection control unit 305 that detects the operation sound based on the output from the receiving unit 71; and a receiving mode selection unit 301 that selects, for every sheet 2, a basis weight detection instruction to the basis weight detection control unit 302 or an operation sound detection instruction to the operation sound detection control unit 305 and transmits the selected instruction to the receiving unit 71. The receiving mode selection unit 301 selects the interval between the sheets 2 for which the operation sound detection instruction is selected such that the interval and the period of the sheet characteristics of the sheets 2 placed on the cassette tray 101 do not continuously overlap each other.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 7

title_en: Tunable lens and method of operating tunable lens
abstract_en: To provide a tunable lens 1 comprising a fluidic volume 2, a flexible membrane 3, and a shaping element 4.SOLUTION: A membrane 3 delimits a fluidic volume 2 on one side. The shaping element 4 is configured to alter optical properties of a tunable lens 1 by deflection. title_en: Image forming apparatus
abstract_en: To allow changing the attitude of a cartridge in association with the movement of a moving member, and increase the capacity inside the cartridge.SOLUTION: When a moving member is moved in an attachment direction with a cartridge attached to an attachment part in a first attitude, a contact target part of the cartridge is brought into contact with a contact part of an apparatus main body, and thereby the first attitude of the cartridge changes to a second attitude different from the first attitude. The cartridge has a projection in an area on a top face of a frame and including the middle position of the cartridge in a rotation axis direction of a developing roller, the projection projecting to an upper side in the vertical direction compared with areas on both sides of the area in the rotation axis direction on the top face. At least part of the projection is located on the downstream side in the attachment direction of the middle position on the top face in the attachment direction, and the inside of the projection is a cavity being part of a developer storage part. The contact target part is part of the projection.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Fixing device, and image forming apparatus including fixing device
abstract_en: To provide a fixing device that can prevent a reduction in image quality and a reduction in conveyance performance of a recording medium, while preventing breakage of foams of gap parts.SOLUTION: A fixing device comprises a rotating body to be heated, a pressure rotating body, and a heating unit. The pressure rotating body has a core grid and an elastic layer laminated on an outer peripheral surface of the core grid, and brings the elastic layer into pressure contact with the rotating body to be heated to form a fixing nip part between the rotating body to be heated and the pressure rotating body. The heating unit heats the rotating body to be heated. The fixing device applies heat and pressure to a recording medium passing through the fixing nip part to fuse and fix an unfixed toner image on the recording medium. The elastic layer has a plurality of gap parts. The plurality of gap parts are divided into single bubbles to be separated from each other, and a first length of the gap part along a radial direction of the pressure rotating body is four or more times a second length orthogonal to the radial direction and is 300 μm or less.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Proximity effect correction method, original plate manufacturing method and drawing device
abstract_en: To provide a proximity effect correction method capable of properly correcting a proximity effect whatever surface shape a substrate has, an original plate manufacturing method and a drawing device.SOLUTION: A proximity effect correction method includes acquiring drawing information for drawing a pattern on a substrate through irradiation with an electron beam. The method also includes acquiring surface shape information related to a surface shape of the substrate. The method further includes calculating, on the basis of, the acquired drawing information and surface shape information, an energy distribution of a back scattered beam generated as the electron beam is scattered back in the substrate. The method furthermore includes calculating, on the basis of, calculated energy distribution, a necessary energy amount of the electron beam.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Liquid crystal display device, method of driving the same, and electronic device
abstract_en: To provide a liquid crystal display device which suppresses display troubles by preventing impurity ions from concentrating in one place.SOLUTION: An image signal supply circuit 70 performs multiple correction processes, including gamma correction for correcting transmittance with respect to an effective voltage value of a liquid crystal panel 50, on gradation specified by an image signal. title_en: Image forming apparatus, control program, and control method
abstract_en: To provide an image forming apparatus that can estimate humidity despite the absence of a humidity sensor.SOLUTION: An image forming apparatus (10) comprises a toner concentration sensor (52) that is provided in a developing device (50) and detects the concentration of toner, and a toner concentration calculation unit (S7) calculates the concentration of toner based on a detection signal from the toner concentration sensor. A ripple value calculation unit (S5) calculates the median value between the maximum value and the minimum value of ripples included in the detection signal as an output ripple value. The toner concentration calculation unit (S7) calculates a toner concentration value (%) from the difference between the output value from the toner concentration sensor and an adjustment reference value (A) of the toner concentration sensor. A reference ripple value calculation unit (S9, S10) calculates a reference ripple value by using a conversion table set in advance and based on the concentration of toner calculated by the toner concentration calculation unit. A humidity estimation unit (S11, S13) estimates humidity according to the difference between the output ripple value calculated by the ripple value calculation unit and the reference ripple value calculated by the reference ripple value calculation unit.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 10

title_en: Photographing device for paraglider flight including selfie using entire-celestial-sphere camera
abstract_en: To provide a safe photographing device that can perform omnidirectional photographing including selfie without releasing a user's hand from a break cord being a controlling device in a series of paraglider flight steps including takeoff, sky flight, and landing.SOLUTION: An entire-celestial-sphere camera is attached to a tip of a selfie stick. Two camera straps are attached to the tip of the selfie stick. Small carabiners are attached to the other end of the two camera straps, respectively. The small carabiners are attached to attachments on the left and right ends near a lower back of a harness on which a paraglider pilot rides. The selfie stick is made in two stages so that it can be extended. The other end of the selfie stick is pinned to a rotatable pedestal with a pivot so that it can rotate around the pivot. The rotatable pedestal with the pivot is rotatably pinned to a selfie stick mounting plate.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure -5

title_en: New unsaturated group containing epoxy carboxylate compound, derivative thereof, photosensitive resin composition including the same and cured product thereof
abstract_en: To provide a resin composition excellent in photosensitivity to an active energy ray, capable of forming a pattern by developing a fine image and a via by a rare alkaline aqueous solution and capable of forming a film having high insulation, adhesion and heat resistance, and a cured product thereof.SOLUTION: A reactive epoxy carboxylate compound is obtained by reacting a monocarboxylic acid compound having one or more ethylenic unsaturated groups in a specific molecule with a compound having a hydroxyl group and a carboxyl group in one molecule if needed; an unsaturated group containing polycarboxylic acid compound is obtained by reacting polybasic acid anhydride with the reactive epoxy carboxylate compound; a resin composition includes them; and a cured product is obtained by curing the resin composition.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Optical scanning device, and manufacturing method of the same

title_en: Liquid crystal panel
abstract_en: To suppress a display defect.SOLUTION: A liquid crystal panel 11 comprises an array substrate 21, a counter substrate 20 disposed to face the array substrate 21, and a liquid crystal layer 22 sandwiched between the array substrate 21 and the counter substrate 20. The array substrate 21 is provided with a plurality of pixel electrodes 24 aligned at intervals in a plane of the array substrate 21, a common electrode 25 disposed to overlap the plurality of pixel electrodes 24, an insulating film 37 disposed on an upper layer side of the common electrode 25, and an alignment film 33 disposed on an upper layer side of the insulating film 37. The counter substrate 20 is provided with a light blocking portion 29 separating the plurality of pixel electrodes 24, and a spacer 30 disposed to overlap the light blocking portion 29 and protruding to the liquid crystal layer 22 side from the counter substrate 20. The alignment film 33 is connected to the common electrode 25 directly or via another member through an opening 37A provided in the insulating film 37. In the insulating film 37, the opening 37A is disposed at a position that does not overlap the spacer 30 but overlaps the light blocking portion 29.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 7

title_en: Positive type photosensitive resin composition and cured film produced from the same
abstract_en: To provide a positive type photosensitive resin composition, and a cured film produced from the same.SOLUTION: There are provided a positive type photosensitive resin composition, and a cured film produced from the same. The positive type photosensitive resin composition contains an acid-modified epoxyacrylate resin having a specific structure, and thereby enables production of a cured film which is excellent in flexibility while having excellent film retention rate and sensitivity.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Optical laminate and image display device
abstract_en: To provide an optical laminate which may realize an image display device capable of reducing reflection brightness.SOLUTION: An optical laminate according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises a polarizer, a first optical compensation layer having a refractive index property exhibiting a relationship expressed as nz>nx=ny, a second optical compensation layer having a refractive index property exhibiting a relationship expressed as nx>ny, and a third optical compensation layer having a refractive index property exhibiting a relationship expressed as nx>ny, arranged in the described order. The reflective property of the second optical compensation layer and/or that of the third optical compensation layer exhibit a relationship expressed as nx>ny≥nz. Each of the second and third optical compensation layers has an in-plane retardation in a range of 10-220 nm, inclusive. An absorption axis direction of the polarizer and a slow axis direction of the first optical compensation layer intersect without being substantially orthogonal. The third optical compensation layer has an Nz coefficient in a rage of -4 to 0, inclusive, or 0.9 to 4, inclusive. The first, second, and third optical compensation layers satisfy a specific expression (2).SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Fixing device
abstract_en: To provide a configuration that can achieve both prevention of the occurrence of uneven glossiness and prevention of the occurrence of wrinkles in a recording material.SOLUTION: A slide member 304 slides with an inner peripheral surface of a belt 301 at a nip part N formed by the belt 301 and a pressure roller 305. A pad 303 is arranged inside the belt 301 to sandwich the slide member 304 and the belt 301 with the pressure roller 305, and backs up the slide member 304. When the value of load on the nip part N is defined as W [N], the Young's modulus of the slide member 304 as E [Mpa], the thickness of the slide member 304 as t [mm], the coefficient of friction between the slide member 304 and the belt 301 as μ, and the length of the slide member 304 with respect to the width direction of a recording material as L [mm], the slide member 304 satisfies the following formula.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Adhesive film for OLED display devices
abstract_en: To provide an adhesive film capable of providing high weather resistance to an OLED device that does not use polarizing plates.SOLUTION: Provided is an adhesive film for use in an OLED display device having just an optical element with a polarization degree of 95% or less laminated on an OLED element on a viewer side, the adhesive film comprising at least one ultraviolet absorbent-containing layer as a layer constituting the optical element, and having a 380-nm transmittance of 20% or less.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 9

title_en: Image forming apparatus
abstract_en: To easily remove a sheet after stopping another discharge mode and improve usability.SOLUTION: A control part, when a discharge part is unavailable and a second conveyance passage is available, executes another discharge mode to discharge a plurality of sheets present in an image forming apparatus to a loading part and stops another discharge mode in the state of leaving the sheets to a detection position of a sheet detecting part. The control part, after stopping another discharge mode, forces a sheet conveyance part to discharge the sheets present in the detection position of the sheet detecting part to the loading part (S34) in response that an open/closed detecting part detects a change in the open/closed state of an open/closed part (Y of S31, Y of S32).SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 7

title_en: Method of manufacturing light reflecting member and method of manufacturing light-emitting device having light reflecting member
abstract_en: To provide a method of manufacturing a light reflecting member, which enables suppression of variations in the shape of the light reflecting member among a plurality of light-emitting devices, and to provide a method of manufacturing a light-emitting device having the light reflecting member.SOLUTION: A method of manufacturing a light reflecting member according to an embodiment of the present disclosure comprises a preparation step of preparing silica powder and an alkaline solution, a first mixing step of mixing the silica powder and the alkaline solution, a reaction step of bringing a first member obtained in the mixing step into a chemical equilibrium state, and a second mixing step of mixing a second member that is in the chemical equilibrium state with light reflective material powder.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Electro-optic device and electronic apparatus
abstract_en: To provide an electro-optic device in which electrical damage caused when a contact hole is formed is reduced.SOLUTION: A scanning line 241 and a gate electrode 232 of a first TFT 23A are electrically connected in a thickness direction through a first contact hole 276A, the scanning line 241 and the gate electrode 232 of a second TFT 23B are electrically connected in a thickness direction through a second contact hole 276B, the scanning line 241 and a first light-shielding layer 254A are electrically connected in a thickness direction through a third contact hole 275A, the scanning line 241 and a second light-shielding layer 254B are electrically connected in a thickness direction through a fourth contact hole 275B, the first light-shielding layer 254A and the gate electrode 232 of the first TFT 23A are electrically connected in a thickness direction through a fifth contact hole 280, and the second light-shielding layer 254B and the gate electrode 232 of the second TFT 23B are electrically connected in a thickness direction through a sixth contact hole 281.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title_en: Optical unit with shake correction function
abstract_en: To assemble a camera module to a camera holder in a process subsequent to a process of assembling a support mechanism supporting a movable body and the camera holder.SOLUTION: An optical unit 1 with a shake correction function comprises a rotation support mechanism 12 that supports a movable body 10 rotatably around an optical axis L. The movable body 10 includes a camera holder 50 that holds a first camera module 2A and a second camera module 2B. The rotation support mechanism 12 includes a rotation support frame 60 that supports the camera holder 50 at two points on a rotation axis L0. The camera holder 50 includes a camera module insertion port 56 opening in a +Y direction. A solid body 11 includes a case 3 that accommodates the camera holder 50 and the rotation support mechanism 12, and the case 3 includes a case notch part 36 located on an outer peripheral side of the camera module insertion port 56.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 9

title_en: Image capturing lens and image capturing device having the same
abstract_en: To provide an image capturing lens which is compact, has high resolution, and yet offers a wide angle of view and high peripheral light intensity, and to provide an image capturing device having the same.SOLUTION: An image capturing lens provided herein consists of a lens system comprising, in order from the object side, a first lens with negative refractive power having a concave surface on the image side, a second lens with positive refractive power having a convex surface on the object-side, an aperture stop, a third lens with positive refractive power, and a fourth lens with positive refractive power having a convex surface on the image side, and is configured to satisfy the following conditional expressions: -3<f1/f<-1.15 ...(1), 2.4<TTL/ImgH<5 ...(2), where f1 represents a focal length of the first lens, f represents a focal length of the lens system, TTL represents a total length of the lens system, and ImgH represents the maximum image height of the lens system.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Image forming apparatus
abstract_en: To reduce the influence of heat of a sheet in image reading using an image reading sensor.SOLUTION: An image forming apparatus has a color sensor 61 to which a test chart for color adjustment is transferred at a secondary transfer unit 30, and reads the test chart on a test sheet to which the test chart is fixed at a fuser 14.
