The color sensor 61 is arranged at a position where an interval on a sheet conveyance path between a registration roller pair 20 and the color sensor is shorter than a length in a sheet conveyance direction of the test sheet. A control unit can selectively execute a first mode for correcting the skew of a sheet S by a leading end of the sheet S abutting against the registration roller pair 20 while the registration roller pair is stopped, and a second mode for conveying the sheet S to the secondary transfer unit 30 without stopping the registration roller pair 20. When conveying the test sheet to the registration roller pair 20 again through a double-sided conveyance path 52, the control unit executes the second mode.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: In-vehicle display with stereoscopic and monocular depth programming
abstract_en: To provide light field displays and image capturing devices in general and, more specifically, to enable dynamic control of an optical path of light emitted within a light field display or an image capturing device.SOLUTION: A display system configured to be integrated into a vehicle comprises: a light source; and an optical subsystem optically coupled to the light source. The optical subsystem includes a reflector and at least one semi-reflective optical component. The optical subsystem is configured to generate light so as to guide the light rays to provide a plurality of virtual images that appear to a viewer concurrently at a respective plurality of different optical depths. The respective virtual images travel different distances within the optical subsystem before exiting the optical subsystem on a path toward eyes of the viewer.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Salt, acid generator, resin, resist composition, and method for producing resist pattern
abstract_en: To provide a resist composition and the like which allow a resist pattern having good line edge roughness to be produced.SOLUTION: There are provided: an acid generator and the like using a salt represented by formula (I) or a resin containing a structural unit derived from the salt; and a resist composition. [In the formula, R1 and R2 each represent -O-R10 or the like; R10 represents an alicyclic hydrocarbon group having one or more substituents; at least one of the substituents is -OR11 or an -I group; R11 represents a hydrogen atom or an acid-labile group; R4, R5, R7 and R8 each represent a halogen atom or the like; A1 and A2 each represent a hydrocarbon group; m1 represents an integer of 1-5; m2 and m8 represent integers of 0-5; and m4, m5 and m7 represent integers of 0-4.]SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: semiconductor laser
abstract_en: To provide a semiconductor laser with excellent characteristics.SOLUTION: A semiconductor laser includes: an active layer; a diffraction grating layer that has a phase shift part whose diffraction grating period is partially different; a contact layer arranged on an upper part of the diffraction grating layer; a high resistor having a higher electric resistance than the contact layer; and an electrode in contact with the contact layer. The high resistor is arranged under at least a part of a portion overlapped with the phase shift part, of the electrode.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Louver film and device
abstract_en: To adjust a viewing angle from a specific direction of the viewing angles in all directions to a desired angle in a louver film having a winding structure.SOLUTION: A louver film includes a louver part 30 having a winding structure around which a laminate body having a light transmission layer, a light shielding layer, and an adhesive layer is wound. The louver part 30 includes a light transmission part including a light transmission layer and a light shielding part at least including a light transmission layer. The index of refraction of at least one of the light shielding layer and the adhesive layer is different from the index of refraction of the light transmission layer.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Photosensitive composition, method for producing patterned cured product, patterned cured product, and black matrix
abstract_en: To provide a photosensitive composition capable of forming a patterned cured product excellent in water resistance and adhesion to a substrate, a method for producing a patterned cured product using the photosensitive composition, a patterned cured product comprising a cured product of the photosensitive composition, and a black matrix comprising a cured product of the photosensitive composition.SOLUTION: The photosensitive composition is used which contains an alkali-soluble resin (A), a photopolymerizable monomer (B), a photopolymerization initiator (C), a light-shielding agent (D), and a silane coupling agent (E). The light-shielding agent (D) contains carbon black (D1) coated with an epoxy resin. The photopolymerizable monomer (B) contains a high hydroxyl value monomer (B1) having a hydroxyl value of 180 mg KOH/g or more and a low hydroxyl value monomer (B2) having a hydroxyl value of less than 180 mg KOH/g. The content of the high hydroxyl value monomer (B1) is 5 mass% or more and 60 mass% or less based on the mass of the photopolymerizable monomer (B).SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Semiconductor optical element
abstract_en: To distinguish the orientation of a semiconductor optical element.SOLUTION: A semiconductor optical element includes a substrate 16 which has a first side surface 20 and a second side surface 22 opposed to each other and in which the first side surface 20 is flat; the second side surface 22 includes an upper side surface 22U and a lower side surface 22L; and the lower side surface 22L protrudes from the upper side surface 22U to form a step, an optical function layer 24 which is located on the top surface of the substrate 16 and has a first end surface 26 and a second end surface 28 opposite to each other, the first end surface 26 being flush with the first side surface 20 and the second end surface 28 being flush with the upper side surface 22U of the second side surface 22, a first film 42 that continuously covers the first end surface 26 and the first side surface 20, a second film 44 which is different in reflectance from the first film 42, and continuously covers the second end surface 28 and the upper side surface 22U of the second side surface 22, a first electrode 38 electrically connected to the upper surface of the optical functional layer 24, and a second electrode 40 electrically connected to the lower surface of the optical functional layer 24.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Fixing device and image forming apparatus
abstract_en: To prevent members provided around the ends in the width direction of a fixing member from being excessively heated with radiant heat from heat sources reflected on a reflection member, and prevent a deterioration in peripheral members to extend their lives.SOLUTION: In the present embodiment, sealing parts 55 (inside ends in width direction 55in of sealing parts 55) of halogen heaters 23a and 23b are provided on the outside of the outside ends in the width direction 26out of a reflection member 26. This prevents heat reflected on the reflection member 26 from reaching the sealing parts 55. The inside ends in the width direction 40in of belt holding members 40 are provided on the outside of the outside ends in the width direction 26out of the reflection member 26. This prevents heat reflected on the reflection member 26 from reaching the belt holding members 40 (or stationary shielding members 28 provided opposite to belt holding members).SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 7

title_en: Rotary reciprocating drive actuator
abstract_en: To provide a rotary reciprocating drive actuator having high manufacturability, good assembly accuracy, and the ability to drive with high amplitude even if a movable object is a large mirror.SOLUTION: A rotary reciprocating drive actuator has: a shaft portion that supports a movable object; a movable body that has a movable magnet in which a first half and a second half of a ring shape that are fixed to the shaft portion on one side of the movable object in an axial direction, have a ring shape, and are divided by a magnetic pole switching portion that extends in a direction perpendicular to the axial direction, are magnetized to different poles; a fixed coil that is arranged on one side and rotates the movable object back and forth about the shaft portion by electromagnetic interaction with the movable magnet; and a base that supports the shaft portion via bearings on both sides of the movable object in the axial direction. The base is a U-shaped member formed with a pair of bearing arrangement surface portions, each of which has a bearing and is arranged on both sides opposite to each other and a joint surface portion that joins each of the pair of bearing arrangement surfaces. The joint surface portion is parallel to the shaft portion inserted into the bearings.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Semiconductor device
abstract_en: To improve an aperture ratio of a semiconductor device.SOLUTION: A semiconductor device is provided in which a pixel portion including a first thin film transistor and a driver circuit including a second thin film transistor are provided over one substrate. The thin film transistor of the pixel portion includes: a gate electrode layer; a gate insulation layer; an oxide semiconductor layer having a thin film thickness in a peripheral edge; an oxide insulation layer that is in contact with one part of the oxide semiconductor layer; a source electrode layer and a drain electrode layer; and a pixel electrode layer. Each of the gate electrode layer, the gate insulation layer, the oxide semiconductor layer, the source electrode layer, the drain electrode layer, the oxide insulation layer, and a pixel electrode layer, of the first thin film transistor has a light transmissivity. The source electrode layer and the drain electrode layer of the thin film transistor of the driver circuit are covered with a protection insulation layer and made of a conductive material of which a resistance is lower than that of the source electrode layer and the drain electrode layer of the pixel portion.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Image forming apparatus
abstract_en: To provide an image forming apparatus that can prevent transmission of heat from a fuser to a drive motor for driving a cutter.SOLUTION: An image forming apparatus (1) comprises: a housing (10); a process unit (4) that forms an image on a sheet (S); a fuser (45) that fixes the image to the sheet (S); a cutting mechanism (100) that has a cutting blade for cutting the sheet (S); a fan (F) that exhausts air to the outside of the housing (10); and a drive motor (M1) for moving the cutting blade. The fan (F) is arranged between the fuser (45) and the drive motor (M1) in the vertical direction.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Image forming device
abstract_en: To provide an image forming device capable of successively forming images on multiple paper sheets of different types at higher speed.SOLUTION: An image forming device provided herein offers variable sheet conveyance speed and is capable of successively printing images on paper sheets of multiple types. The image forming device comprises a CPU 222 configured to compare the number of pages associated with printing interruption when successively printing images and page numbers corresponding to switching of conveyance speed, to determine a paper sheet conveyance speed according to a result of the comparison.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Resist composition, resist pattern forming method, acid diffusion control agent, and compound
abstract_en: To provide a resist composition having high sensitivity and good lithographic characteristics, a resist pattern forming method using the resist composition, and an acid diffusion control agent usable for producing the resist composition.SOLUTION: The resist composition, which generates an acid upon exposure and whose solubility in a developer changes by the action of an acid, contains: a resin component (A1) whose solubility in a developer changes by the action of an acid; and a compound (D0) represented by the following general formula (d0). Rd01 represents a divalent organic group; Rd02 represents a monovalent organic group or a hydrogen atom; and Ld01 represents a single bond or a divalent linking group.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Aerial Display Device
abstract_en: To provide an aerial display device capable of accurately detecting a touch operation of an observer to an aerial image.SOLUTION: An aerial display device includes: a display element 20 for displaying an image; an optical element 40 which reflects light from the display element 20 to an opposite direction to the display element 20 for image-forming an aerial image in the air; a sensing element 50 which forms a detection region in a space region crossing the aerial image, and detects an object in the detection region; and a correction unit 70D which corrects detection timing at which the object is detected by the sensing element 50. The detection region includes a first partial region 80 being from an end at the sensing element 50 side of the aerial image to a crossing line of the aerial image and the detection region, and a second partial region 81 being from the crossing line to a far side end of the aerial image to the sensing element 50. When the detection position of the sensing element 50 is the second partial region 81, the correction unit 70D retards the detection timing.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Imaging device, imaging system, and fisheye lens
abstract_en: To provide an imaging device capable of obtaining a clearer image even in a peripheral part of a lens.SOLUTION: A camera 12 that captures images using a fisheye lens 102 includes a fisheye lens 102 with an angle of view greater than 180 degrees, and an imaging element 104 that captures an image projected from the fisheye lens 102, and when an image height at a maximum incidence angle, which is an incidence angle corresponding to the maximum angle in the angle of view of the lens, is defined as a maximum image height, and an image height calculated by a formula indicating an equidistant projection method by making the maximum image height equal to the fisheye lens 102 is defined as an equidistant projection image height, the image height of the fisheye lens 102 at an incidence angle of 90 degrees is smaller than the equidistant projection image height, and when an increase amount in the image height per unit angle is defined as an image height increase rate, the image height increase rate of the fisheye lens 102 is larger than the image height increase rate calculated from the equidistant projection image height at incidence angles greater than or equal to 90 degrees.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Sheet conveyance device
abstract_en: To suppress a down-time of an instrument to a minimum by performing a notification of occurrence of sheet abnormality at a time suitable for the notification to users while keeping on printing, not notifying the moment the sheet abnormality occurs in a sheet conveyance device of an image formation device forming images on a sheet set to be conveyed.SOLUTION: A sheet conveyance device comprises: a sheet abnormality detection device 14; an escape tray 16; and a notification device 26. The sheet abnormality detection device 14 is configured to detect sheet abnormality. The escape tray 16 is configured to receive a discharge of a sheet 10 having abnormality detected by the sheet abnormality detection device 14. The notification device 26 can notify the sheet abnormality. An image formation unit 13 is configured to form the same image as that formed on the sheet 10 having the sheet abnormality detected and discharged to the escape tray 16 on a different sheet 10, and enable keeping on forming the image with respect to the sheet 10 thereafter. The notification device 26 is configured not to notify the sheet abnormality unless an instruction of the notification is performed.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Image forming apparatus
abstract_en: To provide an image forming apparatus that can perform, with one motor, contact and separation of a developing roller, drive of a fuser, and switching of the nip pressure of the fuser.SOLUTION: An image forming apparatus comprises: a photoconductor drum 50; a developing roller 61 that is movable between a contact position where it is in contact with the photoconductor drum 50 and a separation position where it is separated from the photoconductor drum 50; a separation cam 150 that moves the developing roller 61 between the contact position and the separation position; a fuser 80 that conveys a sheet between a heating unit 81 and a pressure unit 82; a nip pressure adjustment cam 230 that switches the nip pressure on the heating unit 81 and the pressure unit 82; a main motor M1; a development separation gear train GT1 that transmits a driving force of the main motor M1 to the separation cam 150; a fixing driving gear train GT2 that receives the driving force of the main motor M1 from the development separation gear train GT1 and transmits it to the fuser 80; and a nip pressure adjustment gear train GT3 that receives the driving force of the main motor M1 from the development separation gear train GT1 and transmits it to the nip pressure adjustment cam 230.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Microscope for determining properties of moving objects in biological sample
abstract_en: To provide a method of determining properties of moving objects in a biological sample.SOLUTION: The method comprises using multiple detector elements of a detector (414) in the form of a detector array to detect, multiple times over a measurement duration, detection radiation from a confocal volume created in the sample, where measurements from the detector elements can be analyzed individually. At least one pair of detector elements are selected such that each partner of a pair is formed by at least one detector element. Cross-correlations are created from the measurements detected by the detector elements of at least one pair, and cross-correlations are calculated starting from one of the selected detector elements in a first direction to the further selected detector element. In a second sub-step, cross-correlations are additionally calculated starting from the further selected detector element in a second direction (back direction) to the first selected detector element.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Zoom lens and image capturing device
abstract_en: To provide a zoom lens which offers a wider angle of view, a reduced size, a higher zoom ratio, and high optical performance.SOLUTION: A zoom lens disclosed herein has multiple lens groups arranged in order from the object side to the image side, the lens groups comprising a first lens group U1 with positive refractive power configured to be stationary for zooming, at least two movable lens groups U2-U4 with negative refractive power configured to move for zooming, and a final lens group U5 with positive refractive power configured to be stationary for zooming. At least a part U12 of the first lens group moves for focusing. The first lens group comprises one negative lens and five positive lenses successively arranged in order from the object side to the image side. The zoom lens satisfies: 2.96≤Ndn+0.0333×νdn≤3.20, 1.82≤Ndn≤2.07, 2.0≤|f1n/fw|≤18.0, where Ndn represents a refractive index of the negative lens, νdn represents an Abbe number of the negative lens, f1n represents a focal length of the negative lens, and fw represents a focal length of the zoom lens at the wide-angle end.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Laminate production method
abstract_en: To provide a laminate production method capable of acquiring a resin pattern which is excellent in photo mask fidelity.SOLUTION: There is provided a laminate production method comprising: an adhering step for adhering a photosensitive transfer material and a substrate, so that, a transfer layer of the photosensitive transfer material contacts the substrate, the photosensitive transfer material including a temporary support, an alkali soluble resin, a photoinitiator, and a transfer layer including a photosensitive resin layer including, a polymerizable compound with an ethylenic double bond; a step for pattern exposure for pattern exposing, the transfer layer through a photomask; and a development step for development of the transfer layer subjected to pattern exposing, for forming a resin pattern. An exposure amount S1 of the pattern exposure is 80% or less of an exposure amount S0 when, after adhering the substrate and the photosensitive transfer material, then, a Stauffer 21st step tablet is exposure as a mask and is subjected to development, a maximum residual film step number is 6.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Multi-camera cross reality device
abstract_en: To provide a suitable multi-camera cross reality device.SOLUTION: A wearable display system with a limited number of cameras. Two cameras can be arranged to provide an overlapping central view field and a peripheral view field associated with one of the two cameras. A third camera can be arranged to provide a color view field overlapping the central view field. The wearable display system may be coupled to a processor configured to generate a world model and track hand motion in the central view field using the two cameras. The processor may be configured to execute a calibration routine to compensate for distortions during use of the wearable display system.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 22

title_en: Sealing layers for sealing microcells of electro-optic devices
abstract_en: To provide sealing layers for sealing microcells of electro-optic devices.SOLUTION: The present invention is directed to a sealing layer that comprises a poly(vinyl alcohol) homopolymer or poly(vinyl alcohol-co-ethylene) copolymer and a polyurethane. The sealing layer shows good barrier properties and low moisture absorption to a non-polar fluid. The sealing layer can be used to seal microcells of electro-optic devices. This invention relates to aqueous sealing compositions and sealing layers for sealing microcells of electro-optic devices. The aqueous sealing compositions and the corresponding sealing layers comprise a combination of poly(vinyl alcohol) homopolymer or poly(vinyl alcohol-co-ethylene) copolymer and polyurethane.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Ultraviolet wavelength conversion element and ultraviolet spectrometry device
abstract_en: To provide an ultraviolet spectrometry device having an excellent wavelength resolution by the manner of a new ultraviolet wavelength conversion element.SOLUTION: The ultraviolet wavelength conversion element according to the present invention converts an input ultraviolet ray into at least two visible lights with different wavelengths. The wavelength of the ultraviolet ray is calculated from the intensity ratio information of the visible lights formed through the conversion. Also, obtaining the wavelength of the input ultraviolet ray from the intensity ratio of visible lights with different wavelengths can realize an ultraviolet spectrometry device with an excellent wavelength resolution.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Optical device, optical transmitter and optical receiver
abstract_en: To suppress optical coupling loss between an optical waveguide and an optical fiber.SOLUTION: An optical device incudes an optical element ana an optical fiber block. The optical element has an optical waveguide, a first end face on which an end face of the optical waveguide is arranged, and a second end face protruding from the first end face. The optical fiber block has an optical fiber, a third end face on which an end face of the optical fiber is arranged, and a fourth end face concaved from the third end face. With the second end face and the fourth end face being fixed to be pressed against each other, the optical device connects the first end face and the third end face through butt coupling and optically couples the end face of the optical waveguide to the end face of the optical fiber.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Double feeding detection device, image formation device, double feeding detection method, and double feeding detection program
abstract_en: To provide a double feeding detection device capable of detecting double feeding regardless of how recording media are overlapped when double feeding occurs.SOLUTION: The double feeding detection device detects double feeding of sheet-shaped recording media transported in a predetermined transport direction, the double feeding detection device comprising: an optical sensor that reads the recording medium transported in the transport direction; and a control unit that detects a period corresponding to the thickness of the recording medium near an edge of the recording medium based on a signal profile obtained from the optical sensor and determines double feeding of the recording medium based on the period.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 8

title_en: Electrophotographic image forming system
abstract_en: To provide an image forming system that can obtain a satisfactory image for a long period without causing toner filming on a surface of a photoreceptor.SOLUTION: An electrophotographic image forming system includes the steps of: forming an electrostatic latent image at least on a photoreceptor; performing development by using a toner for electrostatic charge image development; and bringing a leading end ridge part of a cleaning blade into pressure contact with a surface of the photoreceptor to remove the toner for electrostatic charge image development. A surface layer of the photoreceptor contains a thermoplastic resin having at least electron acceptability. Toner particles constituting the toner for electrostatic charge image development each contain at least a fatty acid metal salt in its surface as an external additive. A leading end ridge part of a cleaning blade having an edge angle within a range of 90-130° is brought into pressure contact with a surface of the photoreceptor, and the effective contact angle of the cleaning blade is within a range of 7-20°.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Image forming device
abstract_en: To solve such a problem that a user unfamiliar with an image forming device cannot find a door for replacement of consumable supplies.SOLUTION: When an image reading unit 13 reads a manuscript placed on a manuscript placement table 13a, an image forming unit 14 forms an image read by the image reading unit 13 on a prescribed sheet, and an ejection unit 15 ejects the sheet formed with the image by the image forming unit 14 and places the sheet on an ejection tray 16. An in-cylinder ejection space 17 is formed between the image reading unit 13 and the image forming unit 14 in a body 12, a housing 11 includes therein, a consumable supply attachment portion to which a consumable supply used in the image forming unit 14 is attached, and also includes a transparent portion 11b in which at least a partial surface of a region in the consumable supply attachment portion in the housing 11 is formed transparent. When the consumable supply is used up and replenishment is required, an operator can visually recognize the region of the consumable supply attachment portion in the housing 11 from the outside of the body 12 via the transparent portion 11b.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Electrostatic collection device
abstract_en: To provide an electrostatic collection device capable of efficiently eliminating the static electricity from a cleaning target that has been electrified due to rubbing by a collection member.SOLUTION: An electrostatic collection device 100 includes: a collection rotating body 11 that rotates and rubs a cleaning target F with a collection member 11a at a collection part P1 to collect a collection object H from the cleaning target F which moves relative to the collection part P1 onto the collection member 11a; and removal members 12, 13 that remove the collection object H from the collection member 11a. The electrostatic collection device also includes a static elimination member 15a which is arranged so as to face the cleaning target F on the downstream side relative to the collection part P1 in a relative movement direction E of the cleaning target F with respect to the collection part P1. The static elimination member 15a is electrically connected to conductors 11a, 12b, 13b which constitute at least a portion of at least one of the collection rotating body 11 or the removal members 12, 13, and does not contact the cleaning target F.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Sample freezing apparatus
abstract_en: To provide a sample freezing apparatus which easily freezes a sample in a desired state.SOLUTION: A sample freezing apparatus includes: a first support part for supporting a removal part for removing an excess sample solution from a penetrated part where the sample solution is penetrated; a retreat mechanism for retreating the first support part, from a removal position where the removal part can remove the sample solution from the penetrated part; a second support part for supporting the penetrated part; a moving mechanism for moving the second support part, so that the penetrated part enters into a freezing space where the sample solution is frozen; and a control part for controlling the retreat mechanism and the moving mechanism, wherein the control part controls retreat of the first support part by the retreat mechanism, and movement of the second support part by the moving mechanism, so that a time until the penetrated part enters into the freezing space after the first support part starts to be retreated from the removal position is one second or less.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Photosensitive resin composition, photosensitive resin film, photosensitive dry film and pattern formation method
abstract_en: To provide a photosensitive resin composition which enables formation of a resin film that facilitates fine pattern formation with a thick film without discoloration of copper, and is excellent in copper migration resistance, adhesion to a base material and reliability, a photosensitive resin film, a photosensitive dry film, and a pattern formation method using them.SOLUTION: A photosensitive resin composition contains (A) a silicone resin having an acid crosslinkable group, (B) an oxazoline compound or its derivative, and (C) a photoacid generator.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Sheet adhesion device and image formation system
abstract_en: To realize a sheet adhesion device with a universal specification corresponding to a system with an input AC power supply voltage configured at a low cost.SOLUTION: A sheet adhesion device 202 for producing a booklet by adhering a plurality of recording materials S to each other includes: a connection part 230; a thermocompression bonding unit 201 which has a sheet adhesion heater 201a and thermally melts a toner image for adhesion to bond the recording materials S to each other; and a post-processing control part 216 which controls temperature of the sheet adhesion heater 201a. The sheet adhesion heater 201a receives an AC voltage of either 100 V system or 200 V system. The post-processing control part 216 switches the power supply to sheet adhesion heater 201a depending on whether the AC voltage is 100 V system or 200 V system.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Determination method, adjustment method, and article manufacturing method
abstract_en: To provide a technique advantageous for making adjustment of an exposure apparatus easier in a transfer destination having a different environment from a place before transfer.SOLUTION: A determination method for determining an adjustment amount of an exposure apparatus having a projection optical system in the case of transferring the exposure apparatus from a first environment to a second environment includes: a measurement step of measuring optical performance in the first environment regarding the projection optical system of a reference state to which a first optical component having a first light-transmitting member is attached; an estimation step of estimating optical performance in the second environment regarding the projection optical system of the reference state to which a second optical component having a second light-transmitting member with a different thickness from the first light-transmitting member; and a determination step of determining an inclination amount of the second light-transmitting member in installing the second optical component to the projection optical system in the second environment such that a difference between the optical performance measured in the measurement step and the optical performance estimated in the estimation step is reduced.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 9

title_en: projector
abstract_en: To suppress reduction in efficiency for light utilization of a projector.SOLUTION: The projector comprises: a first light source emitting linearly polarized first light; a first light condensing element condensing the first light emitted from the first light source; a first light guide member guiding the first light emitted from the first light condensing element; and a first liquid crystal panel modulating the first light emitted from the first light guide member. The first light guide member has: a first incidence surface to which the first light emitted from the first light condensing element is incident; a first light emission surface emitting the first light toward the first liquid crystal panel; and a first inclination part inclined to a first optical axis of the first light guide member and having a cross-sectional area increasing along a direction for guiding the first light. The first light emission surface of the first light guide member is in contact with a portion of a light incident side of the first liquid crystal panel. Alternatively, an air layer of 3 μm or less is provided between the first light emission surface and the portion of the light incident side of the first liquid crystal panel.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Optical laminate and image display device using the same
abstract_en: To provide an optical laminate which includes a liquid crystal alignment solidified layer, has an integrated front plate, and is capable of suppressing particular appearance defects when used in image display devices.SOLUTION: An optical laminate according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises a front plate, an adhesive layer, a polarizing plate including a polarizer, and a retardation layer laminated on the polarizing plate via a first adhesive layer in this order. The retardation layer comprises a first liquid crystal alignment solidified layer and a second liquid crystal alignment solidified layer laminated on the first liquid crystal alignment solidified layer via a second adhesive layer in order from the polarizing plate side. A refractive index nLC1 of a polarizer of the first liquid crystal alignment solidified layer in a transmission axis direction and a refractive index nAD1 of a polarizer of the first adhesive layer in a transmission axis direction satisfy the following expression (1): (nAD1-nLC1)2≤0.005 ...(1).SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Stereo optical system and imaging apparatus
abstract_en: To provide a stereo optical system capable of taking an image with good stereoscopic effect while being small sized and with a large diameter.SOLUTION: A stereo optical system includes two optical systems OSR and OSL arranged in parallel. The two optical systems are co-axial optical systems, respectively, and include an aperture diaphragm SP and at least two positive lenses arranged closer to an image side than the aperture diaphragm. If a distance between optical axes of the two optical systems is D, focal distances of the two optical systems are respectively f, and maximum viewing angles of the two optical systems are respectively ω, a condition 1.8≤D/(f.tanω)≤5.5 is satisfied.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Light distribution generator
abstract_en: To enable the light intensity of a three-dimensional light distribution to be modulated to a desired value in a technique of generating the three-dimensional light distribution based on a phase distribution image, irrespective of a mode of the three-dimensional light distribution to be generated.SOLUTION: A light distribution generator comprises: a spatial light modulator 5 capable of modulating the phase distribution of light; a light source unit 1 for emitting light to illuminate the spatial light modulator 5; a light intensity modulation unit 6 capable of modulating the intensity of light emitted from the light source 1; and a signal processing unit 7 for transmitting an indication signal pertaining to mode information of a phase distribution image to the light intensity modulation unit 6 so that the intensity of light emitted from the light source unit 1 can be modulated based on the mode information of the phase distribution image by the light intensity modulation unit 6 in synchronism with display timing of the phase distribution image to the spatial light modulator 5. The light distribution generator is constituted so that a three-dimensional light distribution 8 having the desired intensity is dynamically generated at a position away by a prescribed distance from the spatial light modulator 5 on the basis of the mode of the phase distribution image displayed on the spatial light modulator.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Exposure device, joint device, and method for manufacturing semiconductor device
abstract_en: To improve a yield of semiconductor devices.SOLUTION: A joint device according to an embodiment includes a first stage, a second stage, a first measurement device, a second measurement device, and a control device. The first stage can hold a first substrate. The second stage faces the first stage, and can hold a second substrate. The first measurement device measures a first alignment mark of the first substrate. The second measurement device measures a second alignment mark of the second substrate. The control device executes joint processing. In the joint processing, the control device adjusts a relative position between the first stage and the second stage on the basis of the measurement result of the first alignment mark, the measurement result of the second alignment mark, and a first collection expression related to the first substrate, and then joins the first substrate and the second substrate to each other.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 17

title_en: Image forming device
abstract_en: To solve the problem that in cases when a door for maintenance, in an electrophotographic printer, is opened during exposure of a rotating photoconductor drum and the photoconductor drum is made to stop, a light-emitting element continues irradiating the same point on the surface of the halted photoconductor drum with light, accidentally forming a latent image, unless emission from the light-emitting element is halted when the photoconductor drum stops rotating.SOLUTION: It is possible to prevent a latent image from being accidentally formed on the surface of a photoconductor drum by outputting, to a light-emitting element drive unit 400, image data indicating that emission from a light-emitting element 602 be turned off, when a photoconductor drum 102 is halted.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 7

title_en: Polarizing plate and optical display device
abstract_en: To provide a polarizing plate that sufficiently prevents permeation of iodine eluted from a polarizer into a retardation layer after the polarizing plate is left under high temperature and high humidity for a long time.SOLUTION: A polarizing plate includes a polarizer, and a first adhesive layer and a first retardation layer that are sequentially stacked on a lower surface of the polarizer. The first retardation layer has a light transmittance of 1.0% or less in a UVA wavelength region. The first adhesive layer includes a cured substance of a non(meth)acrylic composition including a curable compound and a photo-initiator. The curable compound includes (A) an epoxy compound. The epoxy compound includes a mixture of a bifunctional alicyclic epoxy compound, a bifunctional aromatic epoxy compound, and a bifunctional aliphatic epoxy compound. The photo-initiator includes a mixture of a iodonium photo-acid generator and an anthracene light increasing-decreasing agent. The anthracene light increasing-decreasing agent is contained by 0.5 parts by weight or more per 100 parts by weight of the curable compound.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Brush, method for manufacturing brush, and image forming apparatus
abstract_en: To provide a brush that provides a sufficient pressing force and can be used in an image forming apparatus forming an image using an electrophotographic system to improve the quality of the image.SOLUTION: A brush includes brush bristles, and the brush bristles include a conductive polyester fiber having an endothermic main peak that is an endothermic peak having the maximum endothermic quantity in a DSC curve within a range of 20°C or more and 300°C or less, which is measured by a differential scanning calorimeter during the temperature rise at a rate of temperature rise of 10°C/min, and an endothermic sub peak having a peak top in a region of 155°C or more and 190°C or less in the DSC curve. The brush is used in an image forming apparatus that forms an image using an electrophotographic system.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Image forming apparatus, adjustment method, and adjustment program
abstract_en: To prevent a reduction in productivity of an image forming apparatus.SOLUTION: An image forming apparatus comprises: a first reading unit; a second reading unit that is different from the first reading unit; a first adjustment unit 123 that executes first shading processing of adjusting an output value of the first reading unit on the basis of the output value of the first reading unit; a second adjustment unit 129 that executes second shading processing of adjusting an output value of the second reading unit on the basis of the output value of the second reading unit; and a determination unit 125 that determines timing at which the first shading processing is executed and timing at which the second shading processing is executed, on the basis of a first condition for starting the first shading processing and a second condition for starting the second shading processing.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 9

title_en: Image forming system, method for controlling image forming system, and program
abstract_en: To provide an image forming system that can reduce a processing time of the entire system, a method for controlling the image forming system, and a program.SOLUTION: An image forming system 1 comprises an image forming unit 24, a reading unit 32, a color measuring unit 34, and a control unit. The image forming unit 24 forms an image on a recording medium. The reading unit 32 reads the image formed on the recording medium. The color measuring unit 34 is arranged on the downstream side of the reading unit 32 in a conveyance direction of the recording medium, and measures the colors of a color adjustment chart formed on the recording medium. The control unit controls the color measuring unit on the basis of image information read by the reading unit 32.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Display device, method for controlling display device, and program
abstract_en: To provide a display device for presenting a photographing result of a VR image by a method matched with a display system of the VR image in photographing.SOLUTION: A determination unit configured to determine a first display method for displaying a live view image on a display unit from among a plurality of display methods including a display method in which distortion is suppressed by causing a user to select the first display method; And a control unit configured to, in a case where an image capturing instruction is issued while the live view image is displayed on the display unit in the first display method, perform control to display, on the display unit in the first display method, a captured image recorded in a recording unit in response to the image capturing instruction.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Method and apparatus for producing free-standing films of harm structures
abstract_en: To produce a self-supporting film of a high aspect ratio molecular structure (HARM structure).SOLUTION: The second frame is positioned from the opening of the first frame to a position where the second frame contacts the film of the HARM structure for stretching the film to a stretched position, wherein in the stretched position the second region of the film is supported by the second frame as a free-standing film. An evaporative wetting agent forms a contact surface between the second frame and the second region of the film. At the moment the evaporative wetting agent evaporates, the film is held in the stretched position, thereby adhering the second region of the film to the second frame. The second region of the film is separated from the first frame.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Antireflection film and eye shield
abstract_en: To achieve both an antifogging function and an antireflection function by suppressing deformation of a fine uneven structure due to water absorption.SOLUTION: The antireflection film 1 includes an optical functional layer 11 formed of a resin, the optical functional layer 11 having a fine uneven structure 12 including convex portions 13 or concave portions 14 arranged at a pitch equal to or less than a wavelength of visible light, the optical functional layer 11 having an indentation elastic modulus of 130 MPa or more, and the optical functional layer 11 having a water absorption rate of 11 mass% or more.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Antiglare film and image display device
abstract_en: To provide an antiglare film excellent in antiglare properties and capable of suppressing reflected and scattered light.SOLUTION: An anti-glare film having an anti-glare layer, wherein the anti-glare film has an uneven surface, and when a sum of amplitudes corresponding to spatial frequencies of 0.0005 μm - 1, 0.0010 μm - 1, and 0.0015 μm - 1 is defined as AM1 and an amplitude at a spatial frequency of 0.0300 μm - 1 is defined as AM2 with respect to an amplitude spectrum of a height of the uneven surface, AM1 is 0.070 to 0.400 μm and AM2 <AM1.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Line beam optic and apparatus for laser lift off using the same
abstract_en: A line beam optical system according to the present invention comprises: a beam generating unit; an optical fiber unit for emitting a laser beam output from the beam generating unit in the form of a flat-top beam; and a beam expander which expands an output distribution of the flat-top beam emitted from the optical fiber unit and emits the beam in the form of a line beam having a high aspect ratio. The numerical aperture of the laser beam includes a first numerical aperture which is a numerical aperture of the laser beam transmitted to the optical fiber unit, a second numerical aperture which is a numerical aperture of the laser beam transmitted to the beam expander, and a third numerical aperture which is the numerical aperture of the laser beam transmitted to the beam expander. The third numerical aperture satisfies an equation. The output distribution of the laser beam emitted from the beam expander maintains a predetermined value and is transmitted to an object in the form of a line beam. According to the equation, NA_3=third numerical aperture, constant k=0.43, S=end slope of laser power distribution, and H=laser homogeneity.

title_en: boresight moudle for electropict apparatus of aircraft
abstract_en: Disclosed is a boresight module for aircraft electro-optical equipment, which comprises: a Cassegrain optical system having a sub-mirror of a front side and a main mirror of a rear side when being viewed on an optical axis; a target assembly installed at a rear side of the main mirror, and installed with a target in which a pattern is displayed in the center; a Peltier element installed to have the target assembly to be in contact with one side of the center of high- and low-temperature sides at the rear side of the target assembly, and installed to have a cavity in the center to expose the target; a diffusion plate installed in contact with the Peltier element at the rear side of the Peltier element, having a polished surface at the center to transmit light, and processed with a peripheral part at least partially overlapping the cavity to scatter light; a light source module installed at the rear side of the diffusion plate, having a light source installed at a position facing the peripheral part of the diffusion plate, and having a through-hole to allow a laser light to pass therethrough at the center; a beam splitter installed at the rear side of the light source module, and installed to have a reflective surface to face the through-hole in the front side; a laser transmitting unit installed in a direction in which light passing through the through-hole is reflected from the reflective surface, and is oriented; and a laser receiving unit installed at the rear side of the beam splitter, which is a direction in which the light passing through the through-hole is transmitted through the reflective surface and travels straight. Accordingly, electro-optical equipment for an aircraft target can be small and lightweight.

title_en: Running vehicle in an inside of a sewer and method of photographing an inside of a sewer using the same
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide a running vehicle inside a sewer including a main moving body and an end moving body separable from an intermediate moving body. The running vehicle inside a sewer, in accordance with the present invention, comprises: the main moving body (110) running inside the sewer; the intermediate moving body (120) provided on an upper surface of the main moving body and separated from the main moving body in accordance with a separation signal transmitted from the main moving body and running inside the sewer (20); and the end moving body (130) provided on an upper surface of the intermediate moving body (120) and separated from the intermediate moving body in accordance with a separation signal transmitted from the intermediate moving body and running inside the sewer (20). In accordance with the present invention, photographing the inside of the sewer can be performed smoothly.

title_en: Buried person search device using detachable module
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a shipwrecked person detecting device at a collapse disaster site, and more specifically, to a buried person searching device using a detachable module. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the buried person searching device using a detachable module comprises: a ground drone (10) deployed at the collapse disaster site, traveling by driving a track device (20), and equipped with a communication device (80) and a first beacon; a camera device (40) mounted on the ground drone (10) to photograph the front, rear, left and right sides, and top of the ground drone (10); a storage (50) installed on the ground drone (10), storing a repeater module (60), and throwing the repeater module (60) at the collapse disaster site according to an operation signal; a plurality of repeater modules (60) connected to a wireless communication network to relay wireless communication between the ground drone (10), a flying drone (32), and a command and control unit (100) and equipped with a second beacon; and a detection device (70) installed on the ground drone (10) or the repeater module (60) to collect human breathing sounds, voice sounds, mobile phone sounds, and artificial rhythm sounds. According to the present invention, it is possible to more clearly determine whether someone needs help, and if so, where and in what situation.

title_en: Method and system for providing streaming services using telescopes
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and method for providing streaming services using telescopes to increase usability of a telescope. According to the present invention, the system comprises: a plurality of installation-type telescopes connected through a wired/wireless communication network, installed in different locations, using front and rear camera units installed on the front and rear surface to acquire and display front and rear images on a display, and transmitting or receiving the front image, rear image, or front and rear merged image from the wired/wireless communication network; and a streaming server connected to the plurality of installation-type telescopes through the wired/wireless communication network, and when a connection request is received from any installed telescope (hereinafter referred to as a requester-side installed telescope) to at least one installation-type telescope installed in another location (hereinafter referred to as an acceptor-side installed telescope), interconnecting the requester-side installed telescope and the acceptor-side installed telescope and using images received from the requester-side installed telescope and the acceptor-side installed telescope to provide a streaming service.

title_en: Swivel Guide Board
abstract_en: An object of the present invention is to provide a rotary guide board capable of connecting and managing a plurality of users and target objects by installing a plurality of smart arms for indicating a destination in conjunction with road guidance content. A rotary guide board comprises: a device part having a touch screen for providing route guidance content; a route guidance part having a rotary smart arm installed on an upper side of the device part and providing a direction indication function in conjunction with the route guidance content; a control module for controlling the operation of the device part and the route guidance part; a GPS module for providing current location information of the device to the control module; and a communication module for connecting the control module with a user terminal and a network server. The route guidance part comprises an arm post, a smart arm, and an LED panel.

title_en: Improved user accessibility Facility management computer and unmanned management platform
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a user accessibility improved facility management computer and unmanned management platform implemented to perform efficient management and work in a management room of an unmanned building. The user accessibility improved facility management computer and unmanned management platform comprises: a management terminal which is a terminal used by an employee of a management office managing an unmanned building, wherein a dedicated application for providing an unmanned building facility management service in consideration of user convenience is installed; and a platform server in charge of facility management, material management, manpower management, and office work of the unmanned building, and building a computerization system for each task.

title_en: Dye dispersion composition for color filter and dye dispersion resist composition for color filter
abstract_en: The present invention is to obtain a dye dispersion composition for a color filter, wherein a resist composition for a color filter has excellent viscosity-lowering properties and viscosity stability and also has excellent optical properties when the resist composition for a color filter is prepared based on the dye dispersion composition for a color filter. To this end, the dye dispersion composition for a color filter of the present invention contains a particulate insoluble xanthene-based dye, a dispersant or an acrylic block polymer, a dispersion aid or a phenyl group-containing phosphoric acid, an alkali-soluble resin and an organic solvent.

title_en: Color photosensitive resin composition, column spacer manufactured thereby and liquid crystal display comprising the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a colored photosensitive resin composition, to a column spacer manufactured thereby, and to a liquid crystal display device comprising the same and, more specifically, to a colored photosensitive resin composition comprising: a colorant; an alkali-soluble resin; a photopolymerizable compound; and a photoinitiator along with random silsesquioxane having a reactive group, thereby having excellent light blocking properties, elastic recovery rate, solvent resistance and heat resistance so that it can be applied to both a black matrix and the column spacer, and thus being capable of producing a liquid crystal display device with improved reliability, to a column spacer manufactured thereby, and to a liquid crystal display device comprising the same.

title_en: Controlling charging voltage
abstract_en: Disclosed is an image forming apparatus including a photosensitive body, a driving unit rotating the photosensitive body, a charger, a power supply unit applying a charged voltage to the charger, a current measuring unit measuring a current flowing through the charger and the photosensitive body according to the charged voltage, and a processor. The processor may control the driving unit to rotate the photosensitive body at a plurality of different rotation speeds, control the power supply unit to apply at least one test charged voltage to the charger at each of the plurality of different rotation speeds, execute a charged voltage determination process to determine a charged voltage based on a current measured for each test voltage through the current measuring unit, and control the charged voltage according to states of the photosensitive body and the charger based on a result of executing the charged voltage determination process.

title_en: polyamine polymer of bis-indole compound
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a hard mask composition using a polyamine polymer manufactured from a bisindole compound, and to a hard mask polymer that simultaneously satisfies solubility, etch resistance, and heat resistance. The present invention provides a polymer for the hard mask comprising a repeating unit represented by chemical formula 1.

title_en: Augmented Reality Optical System to Correct Weares's Vision
abstract_en: Disclosed is an augmented reality optical system capable of correcting a wearer's vision. According to one aspect of the present embodiment, an augmented reality optical system equipped to a wearer includes an image output part for outputting light corresponding to an augmented reality image and an optical system that reflects the light output from the image output part in the direction of the eyeball of the wearer, and an optical path adjusting part that is disposed at a position where light is reflected from the optical system and changes the path of incident light from the optical system to the eye of the wearer. It is possible to provide fully augmented reality images to wearers with various vision.

title_en: Liquid Crystal Display Device
abstract_en: A liquid crystal display device in accordance with the present invention comprises: a plurality of gate lines arranged in a first direction; a plurality of data lines arranged in a second direction to cross the gate line and defining a pixel area together with the gate line; a thin film transistor including a control electrode connected to the gate line, a second electrode connected to the data line, and a first electrode formed to be spaced apart from the second electrode; a pixel electrode connected to the second electrode to receive a data voltage from the data line; and a common electrode receiving a common voltage through a common line and forming a horizontal electric field in the pixel region together with the pixel electrode. The first electrode includes (1-1)^th and (1-2)^th electrodes disposed to face each other in the second direction with the gate line interposed therebetween, and a bridge pattern connecting the (1-1)^th and (1-2)^th electrodes. The first electrode overlaps the common line. In accordance with the present invention, a capacity of a storage capacitor can be increased by using the first electrode having a symmetrical structure.

title_en: Camera module
abstract_en: According to an embodiment, provided is a camera module for increasing reliability of electrical connection between terminal units and a liquid lens comprising: a substrate; a lens holder disposed on the substrate; a lens barrel coupled to the lens holder; a holder disposed in the lens barrel; a liquid lens disposed within the holder and including an electrode; a first current carrying unit disposed on the lens holder; a first terminal unit disposed in the holder and coupled to the first current carrying unit; and a second terminal unit connecting the first terminal unit and the electrode of the liquid lens. The second terminal unit comprises: a first part coupled to the electrode of the liquid lens; a second part coupled to the first terminal unit; and a third part connecting the first part and the second part. The third part includes at least one curved portion or bent portion.

title_en: Screen for screen golf and manufacturing method of the same
abstract_en: In the case of a conventional screen golf screen made of yarn made of polyester, a large portion of the light of an image output by a projector is transmitted, so the reflectance of light is lowered. The present invention solves the above problems, suppresses transmission of the light of the image output to a screen by a projector in the screen used for screen golf, and increases the reflectance of light from the front to increase the brightness and clarity of a projected image without deteriorating the brightness and clarity of the projected image by golf shots of a large number of users.

title_en: Color and luminance measuring device
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a color and luminance measuring device including a filter unit, which comprises: a case which surrounds the entire device and has a light incident part formed on one side, wherein the light incident part receives measurement light emitted from an object to be measured; a measurement unit which receives the measurement light from the inside of the case and measures luminance and color; and a filter unit which is disposed on a movement path of the measurement light inside the case, to selectively control the luminance of the measurement light transmitted to the measurement unit and allow the measurement light to pass through the filter unit. The filter unit lowers the luminance of the measurement light to a certain level when the measurement light has luminance greater than or equal to preset luminance, and transmits the measurement light to the measurement unit.

title_en: Progressive metalens for sensing system
abstract_en: A meta lens includes areas of at least one nanostructure. A first area of the nanostructure leads a first FOV of light inputted into the first area of the nanostructure to head toward a first area of an image plane. A second area of the nanostructure leads a second FOV of light inputted into the second area of the nanostructure to head toward a second area of the image plane, the second FOV is different from the first FOV, and the second area of the image plane is different from the first area of the image plane. A third FOV of the nanostructure leads a third FOV of light to head toward a third area of the image plane, the third FOV is different from the first FOV and the second FOV, and the third area of the image plane is different from the first area of the image plane and the second area of the image plane. Therefore, the present invention is capable of allowing lower sensor-space resolution with a reduced processing ability.

title_en: Compound, infrared absorber, infrared absorbing/blocking film, photoelectric device, sensor and electronic device
abstract_en: Provided are a compound represented by chemical formula 1, and an infrared absorber, an infrared absorption and blocking film, a photoelectric device, a sensor, and an electronic device including the same. In the chemical formula 1, R^1 to R^4, R^(11a) to R^(14c), and n are as defined in the detailed description.

title_en: Rectangular substrate for imprint lithography and making method
abstract_en: The present invention provides a method for manufacturing a rectangular-shaped substrate for imprint lithography. In terms of a lateral side of the rectangular-shaped substrate for imprint lithography in which the lateral side thereof has been processed by polishing, the lateral side of the rectangular-shaped substrate is polished by translocating the rectangular-shaped substrate and a rotary polishing pad relatively in parallel with respect to the lateral side, while applying constant pressure to the rotary polishing pad in the vertical direction. According to the present invention, pressurization and a pattern shape can be controlled with high precision during imprint lithography processes, and thereby enabling transcription of complicated patterns with high definition.

title_en: Catadioptric image acquisition method and apparatus with minimum occlusion
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an image acquisition method and apparatus to acquire a wide-area image with minimized occluded areas. According to one embodiment of the present invention, the image acquisition apparatus comprises: a first reflector reflecting light of a first path incident from the outside; a second reflector positioned spaced apart from the front surface of the first reflector to re-reflect the light of the first path reflected from the first reflector to be incident into a first hole at a vertex of the first reflector; and an image sensor installed on the rear surface of the first reflector to convert the light of the first path and the light of the second path incident from the outside into electrical signals. The second reflector includes a concave lens installed in the hole of the second reflector to allow the light of the second path to pass through and reach the image sensor installed on the rear surface of the first reflector.

title_en: In-cell touch type display device
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to an in-cell touch type display device comprising: a first ESD structure, wherein a static electricity flowing into a thin film transistor substrate is discharged through a first ground wiring without passing through a conductive connecting member such as a silver dotting part; and a second ESD structure, wherein the static electricity flowing into a color filter substrate is discharged through a transparent conductive thin film, the conductive connecting member, and a high-resistance second ground wiring. According to the present disclosure, by separating the ESD structures of the thin film transistor substrate and the color filter substrate, all the touch sensitivity and the ESD effect can be satisfied.

title_en: Stacking Cassette
abstract_en: According to one aspect of the present invention, provided is a loading cassette, which includes: a cassette frame partitioned with a plurality of slots in which loads on a plurality of flat plates are vertically loaded at regular intervals; a pair of support frames spaced apart from each other and coupled to each slot of the cassette frame so as to support opposite sides of the loaded object; a pair of sliding units slidably coupled to each of the support frames and drawn in and out of the slot; and a loading holder which is coupled to the pair of sliding units and on which both sides of the load are seated.

title_en: A lens moving device, and camera device and optical instrument including the same
abstract_en: The embodiment of the present invention includes: a housing; a bobbin including a first frame disposed within the housing and a second frame disposed within the first frame; an elastic member coupled to the housing and the bobbin; and a driving unit for moving each of the first frame and the second frame in an optical axis direction. The present invention provides a lens driving device capable of preventing plastic deformation of the elastic member and improving the accuracy and reliability of auto- focusing, and a camera device and an optical device including the same.

title_en: A composition of anti-reflective hardmask
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a hard mask composition having anti-reflection film properties useful for lithographic processes, and specifically, to an aromatic ring polymer containing organometals showing strong absorption in the ultraviolet wavelength region and having a relatively transparent polymer form in the visible light region, and to a hard mask composition comprising the same.

title_en: Optical laminate, and manufacturing method for the same, and smart window including the same, and automobile or windows for building using the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a variable-transmittance optical laminate with simplified manufacturing processes, a manufacturing method thereof, a smart window including the same, and an automobile using the same. The optical laminate includes polarizing plates stacked on both sides while a liquid crystal layer driven in accordance with an electric field and arranged therebetween. The polarizing plate includes a polarizer and a protective layer formed on at least one side of the polarizer. A transparent conductive layer is formed by directly coming in contact with at least one polarizing plate between the polarizing plates on both sides. The transparent conductive layer includes a pattern area patterned in a prescribed shape and a non-pattern area without a pattern. A refractive index adjustment layer provided between the polarizing plates and the transparent conductive layer is formed across the pattern area and the non-pattern area. The total light transmittance of the optical laminate is changed in accordance with voltage application.

title_en: Resin and preparation method thereof, resin composition and molded product
abstract_en: The present application relates to a resin including a unit represented by chemical formula 1, a manufacturing method thereof, a resin composition including the same, and molded articles including the resin composition. The resin according to embodiments of the present invention has a high refractive index and high transparency.

title_en: Calibration-free wavemeter based on optical frequency comb, and operating method thereof
abstract_en: A calibration-free wavemeter includes: a pulsed laser which outputs an optical frequency comb; a probe laser in which a specific frequency mode of the optical frequency comb is set as a scan start frequency and scans a certain frequency band by varying the frequency from the start frequency; and a processor which uses interference signal frequencies measured through interference of signals output from a measurement target, the pulse laser, and the probe laser to calculate the frequency of the measurement target.

title_en: Untact touch screen for adjustable height of air layer
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a noncontact touch screen, and more specifically, to a noncontact touch screen with an adjustable height of an air layer, comprising: a mainframe having a space formed therein; a sensor module installed in the inner space of the mainframe and including a plurality of infrared sensors; and a filter part installed on one side of the main frame and through which infrared rays generated from the sensor module can pass, wherein a height between a display and infrared rays generated from the sensor module varies according to the mounting position of the sensor module varies in the inner space of the main frame. Therefore, the height of an air layer can be adjusted without a separate frame for height adjustment, thereby securing competitiveness in the unit price of the product, and enabling the height of the air layer to be adjusted as desired by a user even after installation is completed.

title_en: outside optical fiber cable and method of manufacturing the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an outdoor optical fiber cable, which comprises one optical fiber and an external sheath layer for covering the optical fiber. The optical fiber includes: a core; a clad layer for covering the core; a first protective layer formed of an acrylate-based material at the outside of the clad layer; a bending buffer layer formed by including at least one of Mg(OH)2, Talc, and CaCO3 at the outside of the first protective layer; and a unit sheath layer formed of a sheath material at the outside of the bending buffer layer. According to a manufacturing method of the outdoor optical fiber cable, optical loss due to bending can be suppressed, thereby alleviating restrictions on outdoor installation and use environments.

title_en: Optical system and camera module including the same
abstract_en: An objective of the present invention is to provide an optical system with improved optical characteristics. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the optical system comprises a first to an eighth lens arranged along an optical axis from an object side toward a sensor side. The first lens has a positive (+) refractive power on the optical axis. The eighth lens has a negative (-) refractive power on the optical axis. The object-side surface of the first lens has a convex shape and the sensor-side surface has a concave shape on the optical axis. The object-side surface of the fifth lens has a concave shape and the sensor-side surface has a convex shape on the optical axis. The object-side surface of the third lens has the smallest effective diameter among the first to eighth lenses. The sensor-side surface of the eighth lens has the largest effective diameter among the first to eighth lenses. The average value of the effective diameters of the object-side and sensor-side surfaces of the second lens is smaller than the average value of the effective diameters of the object-side and sensor-side surfaces of the third lens. The sensor-side surface of the eighth lens is concave on the optical axis, has a critical point, and satisfies 0.5 < total track length (TTL) / ImgH < 3 (TTL is the distance from the peak of the object-side surface of the first lens to the upper surface of the sensor, and ImgH is 1/2 of the maximum diagonal length of the sensor).

title_en: Nozzle inspecting unit and substrate treating apparatus including the same
abstract_en: Provided are a nozzle inspection unit for inspecting a nozzle of an inkjet head unit using the dummy area of the substrate, and a substrate processing device including the same. The substrate processing device includes: a processing unit which supports the substrate while the substrate is being processed; an inkjet head unit including a plurality of nozzles and discharging a substrate processing liquid onto the substrate so that the substrate is processed; a control unit which controls the inkjet head unit; and a nozzle inspection unit inspecting the nozzles. The substrate includes a product area used for product production and a dummy area excluding the product area, and the nozzle inspection unit uses the dummy area when inspecting the nozzles.

title_en: Electronic device including flexible display
abstract_en: An electronic device including a flexible display according to various embodiments of the present disclosure comprises: a first housing; a second housing slidably coupled with the first housing; and a flexible display of which a display region, which is a portion of the electronic device that is visible to the outside, increases or decreases in size according to sliding of the first housing relative to the second housing. The flexible display comprises: a panel layer including a display panel; a plurality of intermediate layers including at least one shock absorbing layer; a protective layer disposed on one surface of the flexible display and protecting the panel layer; a grid layer disposed on the other surface of the flexible display; and a plurality of adhesive layers disposed between each layer included in the flexible display. The protective layer comprises: a first region having one surface on which the adhesive layer is laminated and disposed; and a second region formed to extend from one end of the first region in a direction parallel to the first region and having at least a portion of a thickness smaller than that of the first region. By preventing a pressure-sensitive adhesive from making direct contact with a slide cover, problems with the appearance of an electronic device and increased display driving force can be prevented.

title_en: Light source device
abstract_en: The present invention aims to provide a light source device capable of suppressing the impacts of debris. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the light source device comprises a beam introduction unit, a plate member, a raw material supply unit, and a radiation extraction unit. The beam introduction unit introduces an energy beam. The plate member has a surface and another surface, and is arranged on a location where the introduced energy beam is incident into the surface, and rotates with the direction at right angles to the surface as a direction of a rotation shaft. The raw material supply unit supplies plasma raw materials to an incident area where the energy beam is incident into the surface, thereby generating plasma. The radiation extraction unit extracts and emits the radiation from the generated plasma. In addition, the plate member is arranged so that a normal line shaft in the incident area of the surface can deviate from an inter-axis area configured between an incident axis of the energy beam incident into the incident area and an emission axis of the radiation extracted from the plasma.

title_en: Optical Module Including a Plurality of Optical Sources
abstract_en: Disclosed is an optical module including a plurality of light sources. According to one aspect of the present embodiment, the optical module includes: a printed circuit substrate; a driver chip disposed on the printed circuit substrate; an interposer substrate disposed on the driver chip; a first light source disposed on the interposer substrate and irradiating light vertically upward; a second light source disposed on the printed circuit substrate at a preset distance from the driver chip and irradiating light vertically upward; and a dispersion unit disposed on the optical path emitted by each light source to disperse the light emitted from each light source.

title_en: Uv detectable touch panel
