abstract_en: A touch panel according to the present invention, which can detect the intensity of ultraviolet rays that can be harmful to a human body, comprises: a touch detection electrode forming a capacitor with an object providing an input; a drive circuit detecting the input by detecting the capacitance of the capacitor formed between the touch detection electrode and the object; a wire connecting the electrode and the drive circuit; and an ultraviolet light detection layer located on a surface of the electrode for detecting the intensity of ultraviolet light, and outputting a detection signal corresponding to the detected intensity.

title_en: Optical laminate and the preparation method for the same
abstract_en: Disclosed is an optical laminate having a significantly higher accuracy and reproducibility of chiral structures, which can function as bio-inspired functional nanomaterials in photonic crystal, electrochemical catalysis, and sensor applications, among others. Specifically, the present invention relates to an optical laminate and a manufacturing method thereof, wherein the optical laminate comprises: a first layer including a metasurface layer, wherein the metasurface layer includes at least two layers of nanoparticles, wherein the nanoparticle layer includes a plurality of nanoparticle arrays in one layer, wherein the plurality of nanoparticle arrays are spaced apart from each other and have a unidirectionally aligned structure, and wherein the at least two layers of nanoparticles include a plurality of nanoparticle arrays aligned in a first direction; and a second layer adjacent to the first layer comprising a plurality of nanoparticle arrays aligned in a second direction that is different from said first direction. The angle (θ) formed by the first direction and the second direction is any angle in the range of 0° < θ < 90°, and the metasurface layer exhibits chirality.

title_en: Pop-up type segmented mirror module, segmented mirror telescope including the same and method for installing segmented mirror telescope
abstract_en: Disclosed are a pop-up segmented mirror module that can be deployed by transporting a plurality of segmented mirrors in a folded state, a segmented mirror telescope including the same, and a segmented mirror telescope installation method. According to an embodiment of the present invention, a pop-up segmented mirror module, which can be used as a main reflector of a segmented mirror telescope, comprises: a segmented mirror module including a plurality of segmented mirrors divided and arranged to divide the main reflector; and a deployment device which converts the segmented mirror module from a folded state to a deployed state by popping up at least one first segmented mirror among the plurality of segmented mirrors.

title_en: Gan-based artificial intelligence hologram image restoration method and system
abstract_en: Disclosed are a GAN-based artificial intelligence hologram image restoration system and a method thereof. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the GAN-based artificial intelligence hologram image restoration system comprises: a compression unit receiving a single hologram image in which optical field information is omitted, analyzing data distribution of the hologram image to extract feature information, and compressing the single hologram image into feature map data based on the extracted feature information; a storage unit storing the feature map data in a predetermined db; a restoration unit generating a restoration image for the feature map image stored in the storage unit; and a learning unit unsupervised learning the compression unit and the restoration unit based on a GAN algorithm.

title_en: Cup, liquid processing apparatus, and liquid processing method
abstract_en: Adjusting the airflow around a substrate as a liquid treatment target to achieve a desired treatment state. The cup of the present disclosure comprises: a flow path forming member which is an annular path each opening toward the central axis of the cup, and forms a first exhaust path, a fly product recovery path for recovering fly products from a substrate, and a second exhaust path, each of which is partitioned from each other, upwardly and sequentially on the peripheral side of the cup with respect to the substrate within the cup; a combined exhaust path which is connected to each of the first exhaust path, the fly product recovery path, and the second exhaust path so that each of the first exhaust path, the fly product recovery path, and the second exhaust path is exhausted collectively toward the peripheral side of the cup; a first annular portion which is included in the flow path forming member and forms a fly product recovery path and a first exhaust path upwardly and downwardly, respectively, and is formed along the outer periphery of the substrate; and a communication hole provided in the flow path forming member to connect the waste product recovery path and the combined exhaust path so that the pressure loss becomes larger compared to the gap formed between the first illusionary portion and the substrate.

title_en: Electronic device and operating method of thereof
abstract_en: An electronic device according to one embodiment may comprise: a glove-shaped driving unit; at least one hydraulic actuator including a driving force applying member extending in a first direction and expanding or contracting in a first direction; and at least one processor electrically connected to the driving unit and the at least one hydraulic actuator. The at least one processor may obtain operation status information of the driving unit according to hand movement of a user wearing an electronic device, determine a driving signal related to an operation of the hydraulic actuator based on the operation status information, transmit the determined driving signal to the hydraulic actuator, and control a driving force of the driving force application unit based on the operation of the hydraulic actuator according to the determined driving signal. In addition, various embodiments identified through the specification are possible.

title_en: Method of making the laminated liquid crystal element and the laminated liquid crystal element made by the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for manufacturing a laminated liquid crystal optical device and a laminated liquid crystal optical device manufactured by the method. the method comprises: a first step of having an alignment film on a substrate; a second step of recording an alignment pattern on the alignment film; a third step of manufacturing a liquid crystal layer by applying and drying a liquid crystal composition according to the alignment pattern recorded on the alignment film; a fourth step of having a resin layer on the manufactured liquid crystal layer; and a fifth step of forming a diffraction pattern on the resin layer.

title_en: Lens and lens assembly including the same
abstract_en: A lens according to one embodiment of the present invention comprises: an optical part that refracts light; and a flange part extended from the optical part. In the optical part, a length in the first axis direction is longer among the first axis and the second axis that are perpendicular to the optical axis and perpendicular to each other. The flange part facing the second axis direction comprises: a first inclined part that includes an inclined surface and is connected to the first surface of the optical part; and a second inclined part that includes an inclined surface and is connected to the second surface of the optical part. In a portion where the second inclined part is connected to the second surface of the optical part, the second inclined part protrudes further in the optical axis direction than the second surface of the optical part, and a light absorbing layer may be arranged at a portion where the second inclined part is connected to the second surface of the optical part.

title_en: Method for providing remote augmented information using deep learning based object recognition technology
abstract_en: A method for providing remote augmented information using deep learning-based object recognition technology of the present invention comprises the steps of: receiving, by a service server, a surrounding image from ar glass; receiving, by the service server, the surrounding image, relaying the surrounding image to a remote terminal, and recognizing an object based on deep learning; matching, by the service server, a 3D modeling image with the recognized object; receiving, by the service server, augmented information from the remote terminal; calculating, by the service server, a location value of the augmented information based on a center coordinate of the matched modeling; and matching, by the service server, the 3D modeling image with the object of ar glass to implement an augmented image based on the center coordinate of the modeling and the location value of the augmented information.

title_en: Actuator for camera
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, an actuator for a camera comprises: a carrier in which a magnet is installed; a base accommodating the carrier; a coil facing the magnet; and a back yoke provided at the rear of the magnet and installed in the carrier. in this case, the back yoke comprises: a body plate provided at the rear of the magnet; and a cover protruding from the body plate in the direction of the coil to cover a side surface of the magnet, and forming a gap with the side surface of the magnet.

title_en: Overlay Measurement Device with Optical Modulator
abstract_en: An object of the present invention is to provide an overlay measurement device capable of obtaining a clear image from layers having different optical properties and more accurately measuring an overlay error between layers at high speed. An overlay measurement device includes an illumination source configured to generate a first illumination; a first illumination optical system configured to direct the first illumination toward the sample; a first main beam splitter configured to separate a first reflected light into a first beam and a second beam; a first detector configured to generate a first overlay mark image; a second detector configured to generate a second overlay mark image; a first imaging optical system configured to image the first beam to the first detector; a second imaging optical system configured to image the second beam to the second detector; a first optical modulator configured to modulate at least one of a shape, an amplitude, a frequency, and a phase of the first illumination, the first reflected light, or the first beam; and a second optical modulator configured to modulate at least one of a shape, an amplitude, a frequency, and a phase of the second beam. According to the present invention, a clear image can be obtained from layers having different optical properties.

title_en: Camera module
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, a camera module comprises: a printed circuit board on which an image sensor is mounted; a holder member disposed on an upper side of the printed circuit board and having a plurality of magnets installed therein; a bobbin installed inside the holder member to be movable along an optical axis and having a coil unit installed on an outer circumferential surface to enable electromagnetic interaction with the magnets; a plurality of receiving grooves formed on a circumferential surface of the bobbin and spaced apart from the coil unit by a predetermined distance to form a space portion; and a cover member formed at a position corresponding to the plurality of receiving grooves, wherein one side surface is spaced apart from the coil unit by a predetermined distance, and the other side surface is integrally formed with a plurality of inner yokes spaced apart from the bobbin by a predetermined distance.

title_en: Iris module, lens module and camera device including the same
abstract_en: An embodiment includes: a housing; a rotating body disposed to be spaced apart from the housing; a circuit board including a first substrate and a second substrate disposed in the housing and positioned opposite to each other with respect to an optical axis, and a third substrate connecting the first substrate and the second substrate; a magnet including a first magnet unit and a second magnet unit spaced apart from each other and disposed on the rotating body; a coil including a first coil unit disposed on the first substrate to face the first magnet unit and a second coil unit disposed on the second substrate to face the second magnet unit, and rotating the rotating body; a blade unit connected to the rotating body; a blade unit connected to the rotating body; a first sensor disposed on the first substrate and positioned in the hollow of the first coil unit; and a second sensor disposed on the second substrate and positioned in the hollow of the second coil unit to face the first sensor, wherein the circuit board includes a first terminal electrically connected to the first sensor and a second terminal electrically connected to the second coil unit.

title_en: Optical Imaging System
abstract_en: An imaging optical system according to embodiments of the present invention comprises: a first lens group including at least one lens arranged in the direction of a first optical axis; a second lens group including at least one lens arranged in the direction of a second optical axis perpendicular to the first optical axis; and a prism arranged between the first lens group and the second lens group and configured to convert the path of light from the direction of the first optical axis to the direction of the second optical axis; and may satisfy the condition 0.200 < d(LG1P)/d(PLG2) < 0.600 (wherein d(LG1P) is the distance on the first optical axis from the upper surface of the lens arranged at the uppermost side of the first lens group to the incident surface of the prism, and d(PLG2) is the distance on the second optical axis from the exit surface of the prism to the object-side surface of the lens arranged at the object-side of the second lens group).

title_en: Photoacid generator and photoresist composition comprising the same
abstract_en: A photoacid generator according to embodiments of the present invention includes an oxime sulfonate-based compound including a fluorenyl group represented by formula 1. The photoresist composition including the photoacid generator has excellent solubility and photosensitivity, and thus may implement a high-resolution pattern.

title_en: Apparatus for smart farm having vertical bed
abstract_en: The present specification relates to a smart farm device equipped with a vertical bed, wherein the device is a natural light irradiation device for a stacked smart farm, and the device includes (1) a light collecting device that collects natural light layer by layer, (2) a light transmission system that efficiently transmits natural light to an indoor crop bed, and (3) a control system that monitors and automatically adjusts crop growth and development conditions.

title_en: Compound for forming metal-containing film, composition for forming metal-containing film, and patterning process
abstract_en: [Problem] To provide a metal compound having excellent dry etching resistance, combined with high film-forming properties and a high tin content, a composition for forming a metal-containing film using this compound, and a method for forming a pattern using this composition on a resist underlayer material. [Solution] A compound for forming a metal-containing film, characterized in that the compound is represented by the following general formula (M) (wherein T is independently the following general formula (T-1) or (T-2), P is independently *OCOR (* indicates a bonding part with a Sn atom, and R indicates a monovalent organic group), and Q is independently a C1-20 alkyl group, a cycloalkyl group, an aliphatic unsaturated hydrocarbon group, an alkoxy group, a C6-30 aryl group, a C7-31 arylalkyl group, or a halogen atom. Additionally, n_1, n_2, and n_3 are such that n_1>=1, n_2>=0, and n_3>=1. n_1+n_2+n_3=4 is an integer that satisfies this.

title_en: Multiplexing of an active sensor detector using structured illumination.
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a structured illumination imaging system that utilizes an image sensor (e.g., an active pixel sensor) in an active plane of a patterned sample to increase image resolution. The imaged sample may be patterned and/or aligned over an image sensor such that each light sensor (e.g., pixel) of the image sensor has a respective plurality of features formed and/or mounted above it. In response to illumination, each of the features may emit fluorescent light that is collected by a pixel of the image sensor. During imaging, each pixel of the image sensor may be spatially multiplexed using structured illumination such that only a subset (e.g., one or two) of the features aligned over the pixel are illuminated with structured light during an image read.

title_en: Rot at able fiber optic connector.
abstract_en: A fiber optic connector assembly incorporates features that improve structural rigidity and the integrity of transmitted signals. These features also allow the connector assembly to be accessed easily in high density connectivity environments. These features also facilitate a technique for reversing polarity of the connector assembly with little or no risk of twisting the optical fibers and without requiring the housing assembly to be disassembled. The connector assembly is constructed using a small number of parts, thereby maintaining low maintenance costs while yielding a sturdy structure. A puller can be added to the connector assembly to improve access in congested connectivity applications without increasing the size profile. Chamfered front faces afford a degree of alignment tolerance when plugging the connector assembly into an adapter. Features of the connector assembly can be implemented in both a duplexed housing version as well as a paired simplex clipped version.

title_en: Optical lens element for slowing down evolution of abnormal visual refraction.
abstract_en: The invention relates to a lens element intended to be worn in front of an eye of a wearer, the lens element being adapted to provide a prescribed dioptric correction function in a prescription plane, the lens element comprising an arrangement of microoptical elements, wherein, when receiving a collimated beam of monochromatic light: - the lens element is configured to produce a primary luminous intensity maximum in a prescription plane, - the arrangement of microoptical elements is configured to produce at least one first secondary luminous intensity maximum at a first proximity difference from the prescription plane and at least one second secondary luminous intensity maximum at a second proximity difference from the prescription plane, the first proximity difference and the second proximity difference having opposite signs.

title_en: Films having asymmetric grin optical elements for application to spectacles or other ophthalmic lenses
abstract_en: A film (1), an ophthalmic lens including a film (1), spectacles comprising an ophthalmic lens including a film (1), and a method of manufacturing a film (1) are described. The film (1) has a base refractive index and includes at least one gradient index optical element (7a, 7b) having an asymmetric refractive index profile.

title_en: Compact head-mounted display system
abstract_en: There is provided an optical system, including a light-transmitting substrate (20) having at least two major surfaces (26) and edges, an optical prism (54) having at least a first (58), a second (56) and a third (60) surface, for coupling light waves having a given field- of-view into the substrate by total internal reflection, at least one partially reflecting surface located in the substrate, the partially reflecting surface being orientated non-parallelly with respect to the major surfaces of the substrate, for coupling light waves out of the substrate, at least one of the edges (50) of the substrate is slanted at an oblique angle with respect to the major surfaces, the second surface of the prism is located adjacent to the slanted edge of the substrate, and a part of the substrate located next to the slanted edge is substantially transparent, wherein the light waves enter the prism through the first surface of the prism, traverse the prism without any reflection and enter the substrate through the slanted edge.

title_en: Laser processing apparatus and method
abstract_en: The invention concerns an apparatus and a method for laser processing. There is provided at least one first laser beam from at least one first optical feed fiber connected to at least one first laser device (6) and at least one second laser beam from at least one second optical feed fiber (9) connected to at least one second laser device (7). Said first and second laser beams are combined in a multi-core optical fiber (12; 50). Said first core (51) of said multi-core optical fiber has a circular cross-section, and said second core (53) has an annular shape concentric to said first core. A composite laser beam comprising first and second output beams is directed from said multi-core optical fiber (12; 50) to a workpiece with overlapping elements (4a, 4b) to be welded.

title_en: Ophthalmic lens
abstract_en: An implantable or wearable lens for ophthalmic use, having a front surface and a rear surface, wherein at least one surface of said front surface and rear surface has an aspherical refractive profile with circular or rotational symmetry, or with cylindrical or non-rotational symmetry, with respect to the optical axis, and having a geometric elevation z(r) defined by a series expansion of Forbes polynomials, wherein said refractive profile generates an enhancement of the wavefront W(r) emerging from the lens such as to extend the depth of field thereof progressively and continuously in a power range between -1,0D and 4.0D.

title_en: Extreme ultraviolet light generation apparatus and electronic device manufacturing method
abstract_en: An extreme ultraviolet light generation apparatus includes a target supply unit, a target passage detection device, a delay circuit, a laser device, a target image capturing device, and a processor. Here, the processor controls the vibrating element to provide irregular intervals between droplet targets adjacent to each other; generates integrated image data by integrating plural pieces of image data imaged at different times; specifies a position, in the integrated image data, of the droplet target most emphasized in the integrated image data; and sets a delay time based on a distance from a position ofthe most emphasized droplet target to a second detection position.

title_en: Method of connecting an optical fiber cable to a closure box, and a connector and assembly therefore
abstract_en: The present document relates to a method of connecting an optical fiber cable to a closure box, wherein the optical fiber cable comprises a rigid cable sheath of a first stiffness enclosing one or more fibers, the method comprising reserving an excess cable length of the optical fiber cable for installation of the closure box, introducing at least one of the one or more fibers in the closure box, and connecting the optical fiber cable to the closure box, wherein the steps of introducing and connecting comprise removing the rigid cable sheath from the optical fiber cable across said excess cable length, introducing the one or more fibers exposed by removal of the rigid cable sheath in a flexible duct of a second stiffness, the second stiffness being smaller than the first stiffness; fixing the optical fiber cable to the flexible duct by means of a first connector, and fixing the flexible duct to a gland of the closure box by means of a second connector.

title_en: Mems scanning display device
abstract_en: The invention relates to near-eye (e.g., heads-up) scanning image display systems. A scanning head-mounted display system includes a light source, a motion sensor, a MEMS-based scanning mirror system configured to scan light from the light source to form an image, and a controller configured to control the scanning mirror system to scan the light to form the image, receive head motion data from the motion sensor, determine a likely head velocity from the head motion data, and adjust one or more of a scan rate and a phase offset between a first frame and a second frame of the image based upon the likely head velocity. The invention addresses the prior art limitations of display resolution in near-eye displays, while compensating for head motion.

title_en: Lighting fixtures
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a lighting fixture including a light source, a light panel, and a light shade fixedly connected to the light panel. The light source is fixedly connected to the light panel and arranged in the light shade. The light shade includes a reflective plate and a reflective cover. The reflective plate is located between the reflective plate and the light panel, and has an included angle with the light panel ranging from 10° to 45°. The reflective cover includes a condenser plate having a curved surface, and the light emitted from the light source is irradiated onto the inner concave surface of the condenser plate. The above-mentioned lighting can generate the light with high illuminance and low glare characteristics.

title_en: Photosensitive resin composition, photosensitive resin composition film, and semiconductor device using the photosensitive resin composition or the photosensitive resin composition film
abstract_en: Disclosed are a photosensitive resin composition and a photosensitive resin composition film, each of which has small stress after curing and exhibits excellent adhesion after thermal compression bonding. Specifically disclosed is a photosensitive resin composition which is characterized by containing: (a) an alkali-soluble polyimide which has a structural unit represented by general formula (1), while having a structure represented by general formula (2) and/or (3) at at least one end of the main chain; (b) a compound which has two or more epoxy groups and/or oxetanyl groups in each molecule; and (c) a quinonediazide compound. The photosensitive resin composition is also characterized in that: less than 10 parts by weight of an acrylic resin is contained per 100 parts by weight of the polyimide (a); and the content of the compound (b) is not less than 20 parts by weight per 100 parts by weight of the polyimide (a).

title_en: Developer accommodating container, process cartridge, electrophotographic image forming apparatus
abstract_en: A developer accommodating container for accommodating a developer includes a developer bag 16 provided with an injection port for permitting entrance of the developer and an opening 35a for permitting discharge of the developer and includes a sealing member 19 which includes a bonded portion bonded to the developer bag 16 so as to seal the opening and which is capable of exposing the opening by peeling the bonded portion from the developer bag 16 by being moved, and the sealing member includes a first bonded portion 22a in an upstream side of the opening and a second bonded portion 22b in a downstream side of the opening with respect to a sealing member unsealing direction, the first bonded portion and the second bonded portion interposing the opening, and the second bonded portion is provided in a non-contact position with the opening.

title_en: Optical element with a stack of layer packets, and method for producing the optical element
abstract_en: The invention relates to an optical element (100), comprising a substrate (20) and an interferometric reflection-reducing layer system (10) on at least one surface (22) of the substrate (20). The layer system (10) comprises a stack (40) of at least four successive layer packets (42, 44, 46, 48), wherein each layer packet (42, 44, 46, 48) comprises a first sub-layer (60) with a first optical depth (t1) and a second sub-layer (62) with a second optical depth (t2) which differs from the first optical depth (t1). The refractive index (n1) of each first sub-layer (60) nearer the substrate is greater than the refractive index (n2) of each second sub-layer (62) further away from the substrate, of the respective stack (40), wherein the layer system (10) has a brightness (L*), a colorfulness (C*), and a hue angle (h) of a residual reflection color. The value of a change (?h) in the hue angle (h) of the residual reflection color in a range of a viewing angle (AOI) with the boundary values of 0ø and 30ø relative to a surface normal (70) to the layer system (10) is smaller than the value of a change (?C*) in the colorfulness (C*) in the range of the viewing angle (AOI).

title_en: Optical analogue-to-digital converter
abstract_en:
FIELD: optics. 
     SUBSTANCE: invention relates to specialized computer engineering and can be used in designing high-speed information processing devices and computer equipment. Optical analogue-to-digital converter has an optical radiation source, a K-output optical splitter (K = M + 1, M = 2 N -1, N - digit capacity of the analogue-to-digital converter), M optical transparencies, a voltage source, M optical comparators, electrooptical amplitude modulator, M-output optical splitter, M N-output optical splitters, N M-input optical couplers, N photodetectors. 
     EFFECT: invention provides faster conversion of electrical analogue signals into a position binary code. 
     1 cl, 2 dwg

title_en: Cholesteric liquid crystal composition and liquid crystal display element having high dielectric anisotropy and refractive index anisotropy
abstract_en: The present invention provides a cholesteric liquid crystal composition with positive dielectric anisotropy and a liquid crystal display element using the same. The cholesteric liquid crystal composition contains: a compound represented by the general formula (1-1), a compound represented by the general formula (1-2), a compound represented by the general formula (2-1) serving as a second component having a neutral dielectric property, and at least two optically active substances that are different in temperature dependence of the chiral pitch length from each other.

title_en: Head-mounted display device
abstract_en: A head-mounted display device includes a head-mounted assembly, a display assembly and a movable assembly. The head-mounted assembly is adapted to be mounted on a head of a user. The movable assembly has a first connection portion and a second connection portion. The first connection portion is rotatably connected to one of the head-mounted assembly and the display assembly, and the second connection portion is slidably connected to the other one of the head-mounted assembly and the display assembly.

title_en: Luminescent compound or salt thereof, and polarizing luminescent element, polarizing luminescent plate, and display comprising the same
abstract_en: Provided is a luminescent compound or salt thereof represented by the following formula (1).

title_en: Fingerprint sensing module and electronic device
abstract_en: A fingerprint sensing module including an image sensor, a collimator, a filter, and a light-blocking structure is provided. The collimator is disposed on the image sensor. The filter is disposed between the image sensor and the collimator. The light-blocking structure is disposed on a periphery of the filter to block stray light from entering the image sensor. An electronic device is also provided.

title_en: Release sheet-attached touch sensor, manufacturing method therefor, and image display device
abstract_en: This release sheet-attached touch sensor comprises: a release sheet; a hard coat layer disposed on one side in the thickness direction of the release sheet; a routing conductor pattern disposed on one surface of the hard coat layer in the thickness direction and having a terminal; a transparent electrode connected to the routing conductor pattern; a first adhesive layer that is disposed on one surface of the hard coat layer around the transparent electrode in the thickness direction to cover the transparent electrode and does not overlap with the terminal when projected in the thickness direction; an optical member disposed on one surface of the first adhesive layer in the thickness direction; a printed wiring board electrically connected to the routing conductor pattern 6 having a terminal part disposed on one surface of the terminal in the thickness direction; and a second adhesive layer disposed on one surface of the optical member in the thickness direction. The printed wiring board has an overlapping part that overlaps the hard coat layer when projected in the thickness direction. A gap is interposed between the optical member and the overlapping part in a first direction perpendicular to the thickness direction. The second adhesive layer is in contact with one surface of the overlapping part in the thickness direction.

title_en: Data processing device
abstract_en: To provide a highly browsable data processing device, provide a highly portable data processing device, provide a data processing device which consumes low power, or provide a data processing device having high display quality, the data processing device includes a display portion having flexibility, a plurality of driver circuit portions arranged in the periphery of the display portion, a sensor portion discerning an external state of the display portion, an arithmetic portion supplying image data to the driver circuit portions, and a memory portion storing a program executed by the arithmetic portion. A first mode in which the display portion is unfolded or a second mode in which the display portion is folded is sensed by the sensor. Low power consumption processing and degradation correction processing are carried out by the program in accordance with the first mode or the second mode.

title_en: Round bar molding glass and method for manufacturing the same capable of reducing the cost for manufacturing glass, suppressing the amount of glass waste (sludge) discharged along with cut glass, and being advantageous to the environment
abstract_en: The present invention provides a round bar molding glass used as a material for a glass molded product and a method for manufacturing the same. A round bar molding glass which has a cross-sectional diameter of 3.5 mm or less, a side surface roughness Ra of 1.5 or less, and an aspect ratio (major axis/cross-sectional radius) of 35 or more. The method for manufacturing a round bar glass includes a step of forming a round bar glass having a cross-sectional diameter of 3.5 mm or less by using a plurality of rollers having irregularities on the surface to perform hot drawing on a square glass or a round bar glass.

title_en: Photosensitive resin composition, dry film, cured object, and electronic component
abstract_en: To provide a photosensitive resin composition which has a high exposed-area dissolution rate and renders excellent dissolution contrast (resolution) possible. A photosensitive resin composition that comprises (A) a polyimide precursor, which is a product of reaction between one or more diamine compounds and one or more dicarboxylic acids, and (B) a photosensitizer, wherein the diamine compounds comprise at least one compound selected from among diamine compounds represented by general formulae (1) and (2) and the dicarboxylic acids comprise at least one compound selected from among carboxylic acid anhydrides and dicarboxylic acid chlorides.

title_en: Reflection preventing structure
abstract_en: An anti-reflective structural body includes a main body constituted of a raw material that contains a color material of black color and an anti-reflective structure formed on an outer surface of the main body, the anti-reflective structure includes a plurality of recesses each being formed to be recessed with respect to the outer surface and a base portion forming boundary portions of the recesses that are mutually adjacent and having a top portion on the outer surface, a profile curve of the base portion in a depth direction of the recesses includes the top portion formed to a curved shape, and virtual circles respectively including portions of the top portion of the curved shape as circular arcs each have a diameter [phi] of not more than 50 [mu]m.

title_en: Image sensor with shared microlens
abstract_en: An image sensor includes a plurality of photodiodes, a plurality of color filters, and a plurality of microlenses. The plurality of photodiodes are arranged as a photodiode array, each of the plurality of photodiodes disposed within respective portions of a semiconductor material with a first lateral area. The plurality of color filters are arranged as a color filter array optically aligned with the photodiode array. Each of the plurality of color filters having a second lateral area greater than the first lateral area. The plurality of microlenses are arranged as a microlens array optically aligned with the color filter array and the photodiode array. Each of the plurality of microlenses have a third lateral area greater than the first lateral area and less than the second lateral area.

title_en: Drawing apparatus
abstract_en: A drawing apparatus 1 includes a supply part 51 for holding a supply roll 511 around which a long base material 9 is wound, a table 52 for holding the base material drawn out from the supply part on a holding surface 521, a collection part 53 for winding the base material, which has passed through the holding surface, with the collection roll 531, a conveying part 54 for conveying the base material along a conveyance path from the supply part to the collection part through the holding surface when no pattern is drawn, a light emitting part 31 for emitting light when a pattern is drawn, and a moving mechanism 4 for moving the table in a moving direction when the pattern is drawn. When viewed along a width direction of the base material on the holding surface, the conveyance path is folded back in the moving direction at a folded position located in the vicinity of one end of the table in the moving direction, and the supply part and the collection part are located on the table side of the folded position. It is therefore possible to efficiently perform replacement work of the supply roll and the collection roll.

title_en: Directional display apparatus
abstract_en: A switchable privacy display for an automotive vehicle comprises a spatial light modulator, a first switchable liquid crystal retarder and first passive retarder arranged between a first pair of polarisers and a second switchable liquid crystal retarder and second passive retarder arranged between a second pair of polarisers. The first switchable liquid crystal retarder comprises a homeotropic alignment layer and a homogeneous alignment layer. The second switchable liquid crystal retarder comprises two homeotropic alignment layers or two homogeneous alignment layers. In a privacy mode of operation, on-axis light from the spatial light modulator is directed without loss to the passenger, whereas off-axis light has reduced luminance to reduce the visibility of the display to off-axis driver leaning towards the display. In a shared mode of operation, the liquid crystal layers are controlled so that off-axis luminance and reflectivity are unmodified.

title_en: Liquid crystal display device
abstract_en: An object is to reduce parasitic capacitance of a signal line included in a liquid crystal display device. A transistor including an oxide semiconductor layer is used as a transistor provided in each pixel. Note that the oxide semiconductor layer is an oxide semiconductor layer which is highly purified by thoroughly removing impurities (hydrogen, water, or the like) which become electron suppliers (donors). Thus, the amount of leakage current (off-state current) can be reduced when the transistor is off. Therefore, a voltage applied to a liquid crystal element can be held without providing a capacitor in each pixel. In addition, a capacitor wiring extending to a pixel portion of the liquid crystal display device can be eliminated. Therefore, parasitic capacitance in a region where the signal line and the capacitor wiring intersect with each other can be eliminated.

title_en: Method of commissioning electrochromic windows
abstract_en: Networks of electrochromic windows and methods of commissioning the windows on such networks are described. The commissioning may involve determining where each electrochromic window is installed and/or which controller is associated with which electrochromic window. In various cases, a number of windows may be simultaneously commissioned.

title_en: Aberration impact systems, models, and manufacturing processes
abstract_en: Scanner aberration impact modeling in a semiconductor manufacturing process is described. Scanner aberration impact modeling may facilitate co-optimization of multiple scanners. Scanner aberration impact modeling may include executing a calibrated model and controlling a scanner based on output from the model. The model is configured to receive patterning system aberration data. The model is calibrated with patterning system aberration calibration data and corresponding patterning process impact calibration data. New patterning process impact data may be determined, based on the model, for the received patterning system aberration data. The model comprises a hyperdimensional function configured to correlate the received patterning system aberration data with the new patterning process impact data. The hyperdimensional function is configured to correlate the received patterning system aberration data with the new patterning process impact data in an approximation form in lieu of a full simulation without involving calculation of an aerial image or a representation thereof.

title_en: Photonic chip and packaged photonic chip system
abstract_en: A photonic chip includes a substrate, an electrical isolation region formed over the substrate, and a front end of line (FEOL) region formed over the electrical isolation region. The photonic chip also includes an optical coupling region. The electrical isolation region and the FEOL region and a portion of the substrate are removed within the optical coupling region. A top surface of a the substrate within the optical coupling region includes a plurality of grooves configured to receive and align a plurality of optical fibers. The grooves are formed at a vertical depth within the substrate to provide for alignment of optical cores of the plurality of optical fibers with the FEOL region when the plurality of optical fibers are positioned within the plurality of grooves within the optical coupling region.

title_en: Display apparatus and a driving method thereof
abstract_en: A display apparatus including a display panel and a display driver is provided. The display driver is coupled to the display panel. The display driver is configured to drive the display panel to display image frames by at least one of a plurality of gray levels in a first state. The display driver is configured to drive the display panel to display standby frames by a predetermined gray level in a second state. The display driver determines the predetermined gray level of the standby frames according to the gray levels of the image frames. In addition, a method for driving a display apparatus is also provided.

title_en: Optical diffusing element and light-emitting assembly for three-dimension sensing
abstract_en:
An optical diffusing element includes a light-emitting surface. The light-emitting surface has a plurality of microstructures. Each microstructure has a boundary. The boundary of each microstructure is completely connected with the boundary of the adjacent microstructures. Each microstructure has a surface profile, and the function of the surface profile is
         , wherein s(x) represents the surface profile of each microstructure on the x-coordinate axis, x value represents the vertical projection position of the surface contour on the x-coordinate axis, R value represents the radius of curvature of the apex of each microstructure, κ value represents the conic coefficient of each microstructure, and the microstructures have the same R value and κ value. A light emitting assembly for three-dimensional sensing includes the optical diffusing element and a light source. The optical diffusing element and the light emitting assembly for three-dimensional sensing have the advantages of controlling light shape, light profile and simplifying design.

title_en: Apparatus for and method of optical component alignment
abstract_en: Apparatus for and method of aligning optical components such as beam splitters in an optical pulse stretcher in which a landing spot of a beam which has traversed a portion of the optical beam splitter and a coincident landing spot of a beam split from a retroreflected input beam are made to align on a target spot. Also disclosed is an apparatus and method for aligning the retroreflector to facilitate proper beam alignment. A fluorescent material may be used to render a beam landing spot visible.

title_en: Methods for fabricating semiconductor devices
abstract_en: In a method of forming a pattern over a semiconductor substrate, a target layer to be patterned is formed over a substrate, a mask pattern including an opening is formed in a mask layer, a shifting film is formed in an inner sidewall of the opening, a one-directional etching operation is performed to remove a part of the shifting film and a part of the mask layer to form a shifted opening, and the target layer is patterned by using the mask layer with the shifted opening as an etching mask. A location of the shifted opening is laterally shifted from an original location of the opening.

title_en: Die bonding device and method for manufacturing semiconductor device
abstract_en: To provide a technique capable of improving the accuracy of the abnormal inspection of the side surface of an element. A die bonding device includes an intermediate stage in which a mirror is installed on the upper surface thereof, an imaging apparatus which is provided so that a die placed on the intermediate stage by a pickup head and the reflection surface of the mirror are located in a visual field, above the intermediate stage, an illumination device which is provided below the imaging apparatus and above the intermediate stage, and a control part which is configured so as to image the upper surface and side surface of the die placed on the intermediate stage by the imaging apparatus.

title_en: Optical film having improved restoring force after folding and display device comprising the same
abstract_en: Disclosed are an optical film containing a polymer resin and having a yellowness index of 3.0 or less and a parameter of restoring force after folding of 1.5 GPa or less, and a display device including the same.

title_en: Method for lithographically patterning photoresist and extreme ultraviolet mask and method of using the same
abstract_en: A method for lithographically patterning a photoresist is provided. The method includes receiving a wafer with the photoresist and exposing the photoresist using an extreme ultraviolet (EUV) radiation reflected by an EUV mask. The EUV mask includes a substrate, a reflective multilayer stack on the substrate, a capping layer on the reflective multilayer stack, a patterned absorber layer on the capping layer. The patterned absorber layer includes a matrix metal and an interstitial element occupying interstitial sites of the matrix metal, and a size ratio of the interstitial element to the matrix metal is from about 0.41 to about 0.59.

title_en: Multi-resolution overlay metrology targets
abstract_en: A product includes at least one semiconductor substrate, multiple thin-film layers disposed on the at least one substrate, and an overlay target formed in at least one of the thin-film layers. The overlay target includes a first sub-target having a first center of symmetry and including first target features having a first linewidth, and a second sub-target having a second center of symmetry coincident with the first center of symmetry and including second target features, which have a second linewidth, greater than the first linewidth, and are adjacent to but non-overlapping with the first target features.

title_en: Optical imaging lens
abstract_en: An optical imaging lens including a first, a second, a third, a fourth, a fifth, a sixth and a seventh lens element sequentially along an optical axis from an object-side to an image-side is provided. The first to the seventh lens element each includes an object-side surface facing toward the object-side and allowing imaging rays to pass through as well as an image-side facing toward the image-side and allowing imaging rays to pass through. The first lens element has positive refracting power. The fourth lens element has a positive refracting power and a periphery region of the object-side surface of the fourth lens element is a convex. An optical axis region on the object-side surface of the sixth lens element is convex and an optical axis region on the image-side surface of the sixth lens element is concave. An optical axis region on the object-side of the seventh lens element is concave. Wherein lens elements of the optical imaging lens are only the seven lens elements.

title_en: Full-field metrology tool for waveguide combiners and meta-surfaces
abstract_en: Embodiments described herein provide for metrology tools and methods of obtaining a full-field optical field of an optical device to determine multiple metrology metrics of the optical device. A metrology tool is utilized to split a light beam into a first light path and a second light path. The first light path and the second light path are combined into a combined light beam and delivered to the detector. The detector measures the intensity of the combined light beam. A first equation and second equation are utilized in combination with the intensity measurements to determine an amplitude and phase [psi] at a reference point directly adjacent to a second surface of the at least one optical device.

title_en: Optical packaging using embedded-in-mold optical module integration
abstract_en: In one embodiment, an optical module includes an electronic integrated circuit, a photonic integrated circuit, and a pluggable optical coupling connector. The photonic integrated circuit sends or receives optical signals. The pluggable optical coupling connector is adjacent to the photonic integrated circuit and includes a pluggable interface to optically couple a fiber array to the photonic integrated circuit. Further, the electronic integrated circuit, the photonic integrated circuit, and the pluggable optical coupling connector are all embedded in a mold.

title_en: Laminate, window film, and touch panel
abstract_en: The present invention is a laminate including a first substrate (SL), an elemental-fluorine-containing layer (r), and a protective layer (P) in the stated order, wherein the elemental fluorine content in the peeled surface of the protective layer (P) upon peeling the protective layer (P) while leaving the elemental-fluorine-containing layer (r) on the first substrate (SL) side is 1.4 at% or more. Said elemental fluorine content is preferably 50 at% or less, and the peel strength when peeling the protective layer (P) while leaving the elemental-fluorine-containing layer (r) on the first substrate (SL) side is preferably 1.0 to 9.0 gf/25 mm.

title_en: Liquid-crystal medium comprising polymerizable compounds
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an LC medium comprising two or more polymerizable compounds, at least one of which contains a substituent comprising a tertiary OH group, to its use for optical, electro-optical and electronic purposes, in particular in LC displays, especially in LC displays of the PSA (polymer sustained alignment) or SA (self-aligning) mode, to an LC display of the PSA or SA mode comprising the LC medium, and to a process of manufacturing the LC display using the LC medium, especially an energy-saving LC display and energy-saving LC display production process.

title_en: Electronic device
abstract_en: An electronic device includes a light guide plate, a plurality of light sources, a plastic frame and at least an optical film. The light guide plate includes a first terminal and a second terminal opposite to the first terminal. The plurality of light sources are disposed adjacent to the second terminal and are arranged along the first direction. The plastic frame is disposed adjacent to the first terminal. One of the at least an optical film includes a body part and a protrude part connected to the body part, and the protrude part is fixed on the plastic frame, the body part includes a first side adjacent to the plastic frame, and in a second direction, a shortest distance between the first side and the plastic film is in a range between 0 to 0.4 mm.

title_en: Lens assembly
abstract_en:
A lens assembly includes a first lens, a second lens, a third lens, and a fourth lens. The first lens is with positive refractive power and includes a convex surface facing an image side. The second lens is a meniscus lens with negative refractive power. The third lens is with positive refractive power. The fourth lens is with negative refractive power and includes a concave surface facing an object side. The first lens, the second lens, the third lens, and the fourth lens are arranged in order from the image side to the object side along an optical axis. The lens assembly satisfies the following condition: 0.6 < f/TT L < 0.8; wherein f is an effective focal length of the 
lens assembly and TTL is an interval from an image side surface of the first lens to a luminous plane along an optical axis.

title_en: Photoacid generators, photoresist compositions, and pattern formation methods
abstract_en: A photoacid generator, including an organic cation; and an anion including an anionic core, wherein the anionic core includes a cyclopentadienide group, wherein the cyclopentadienide group is substituted with an organic group including a semi-metal element, and wherein the anion is substituted with one or more electron withdrawing groups.

title_en: Light guiding laminate and planar light source device
abstract_en:
An object of the present invention is to provide a light guiding laminate exhibiting good contrast. The light guiding laminate according to one aspect of the present invention has an anisotropic optical film whose diffusivity changes depending on incident angle of light and a light guiding plate. The light guiding plate has: an incident surface that is provided at an end of the light guiding plate and may introduce light into the light guiding plate; an exit surface as a first main surface that emits light incident from the incident surface and reflected and refracted inside the light guiding plate; and an opposite surface as a second main surface that is located on the opposite side of the exit surface. The anisotropic optical film is laminated on the exit surface of the light guiding plate directly or via other layers. The anisotropic optical film has a matrix region and a columnar region that is composed of a plurality of columnar structures having a refractive index different from that of the matrix region. The plurality of columnar structures are aligned from one main surface to the other main surface of the anisotropic optical film and extend from the one main surface to the other main surface. When the normal direction angle of the exit surface of the light guiding plate and the normal 
direction angle of the anisotropic optical film are 0°, the scattering central axis angle θ 1  of the anisotropic optical film exceeds 15°. In the light guiding plate, at least when measuring the emitted light intensity of the transmitted light that enters the opposite surface from the normal direction of the opposite surface and exits from the exit surface, a first maximum value appears in the range of less than 5° from the normal direction angle, and a second maximum value appears in the range above 5° from the normal direction angle. When the polar angle at which the second maximum value appears is expressed as a polar angle θ 2 , the difference (θ 1 -θ 2 ) between the scattering central axis angle θ 1  and the polar angle θ 2  is -10° or more and less than -1°, or more than + 1° and +35° or less.

title_en: Optical film, polarizer protective film, polarizing plate, and image display device
abstract_en: Provided is an optical film that comprises a first outermost layer comprising a first resin composition, a second outermost layer comprising a second resin composition, and an intermediate layer that is disposed between the first outermost layer and the second outermost layer and comprises a (meth)acrylic resin composition including a (meth)acrylic resin that has a ring structure in a main chain, the first resin composition and the second resin composition including hard particles, and the glass transition temperature Tga of the first resin composition, the glass transition temperature Tgb of the second resin composition, and the glass transition temperature Tgc of the (meth)acrylic resin composition satisfying expression (A) and expression (B). Expression (A): Tga > Tgc. Expression (B): Tgb > Tgc.

title_en: Uv-curable composition, hard coat and hard coated article
abstract_en:
The present invention relates to a UV-curable composition which comprises a combination of a (meth)acrylate-based curable resin composition, comprising one or more acrylate ester with 3 or more acrylate groups; and (meth)acrylate-based urethane or (meth)acrylate acid-based ester or (meth)acrylate-based epoxy or (meth)acrylate-based silicone oligomers; as well as a mixture of a compound having a perfluoropolyether (PFPE) group and a curable moiety; and a di(meth)acrylate 
monomer. In addition, the present invention relates to a hard coat which is obtainable by curing this composition, and a surface-treated article which includes the hard coat on one or more surfaces thereof, as well as a process for producing the article.

title_en: Lens module and electronic device
abstract_en: The application discloses a lens module comprising a foundation, a supporting plate, a PLC board arranged with a sensor mounted on the supporting plate, and a plurality of bulges arranged on the foundation or the supporting plate, therefore the bulges provide a point contact or a line contact between the supporting plate and the foundations for allowing the supporting plate to slide relative to the foundation. The bulges reduce resistance of the supporting plate during sliding, and the bulges and the foundation/the supporting plate can be formed integrally for reducing processing of the lens module. An electronic device comprising the lens module is also disclosed.

title_en: Semiconductor device manufacturing method
abstract_en: Disclosed is a method comprising: providing at least two structures with a metal layer over each; forming a patterned photolithographic layer over the metal layer over the first structure; removing the metal layer from the second structure via wet etch operations using a chemical etchant that is resistant to penetration into the photolithographic layer; and achieving, after wet etch operations, a remaining metal ratio of a distance X over a distance Y that is less than 179 and greater than 1, wherein X is the distance from a first line extending from an edge of the metal layer over the first structure to a second line extending from an edge of a channel region in the second structure, and Y is a second distance from the first line to a third line extending from an edge of the metal layer formed over the channel region in the first structure.

title_en: Transfer method for uv optical film
abstract_en: The present invention provides a transfer method for ultraviolet (UV) optical film and a manufacturing method of a transferring roller by using a deep UV light. The transfer method includes: coating a photoresist (PR) layer onto an outer surface of a metallic roller; emitting a deep UV light having a predetermined exposure wavelength, which forms a predetermined light shape by passing through a mask or an interference, to travel onto the PR layer, so that the PR layer becomes a patterned transfer layer; continuously using the patterned transfer layer to roll onto a UV optical film; and emitting a solidifying UV light having a wavelength in a predetermined light curing band to irradiate and to solidify on the UV optical film being shaped. The predetermined exposure wavelength is less than the predetermined light curing band by at least 100 nm.

title_en: Display device and display panel
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a display device including: a first optical area included in a display area in which one or more images can be displayed and allowing light to be transmitted; a normal area included in the display area and located outside of the first optical area; a first optical bezel area included in the display area and located between the first optical area and the normal area; a first anode electrode of a first light emitting element disposed in the first optical area; a first pixel circuit disposed in the first optical bezel area; a first anode extension line electrically interconnecting the first anode electrode and the first pixel circuit; and at least one first compensation line connected in parallel with at least a portion of the first anode extension line.

title_en: Photosensitive resin composition, partition wall, and optical element
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a photosensitive resin composition comprising an alkali-soluble material (A), a photosensitive material (B), and an ink repellent agent (C), wherein the ink repellent agent (C) contains a structure represented by formula (c). (c): -(OCF2)n- where n is an integer from 3 to 100.

title_en: Correction method for 3d image processing
abstract_en: A correction method for three-dimensional image processing, wherein a host obtains a first image and a second image of the image area through a first image acquisition device and a second image acquisition device, the first image and the second image containing a first image object and a second image object of the correction block, respectively. The host obtains a first parameter matrix and a second parameter matrix based on the first image and the second image, respectively, and The first image, the second image, the first image object, the second image object, the first parameter matrix, and the second parameter matrix are used to reconstruct and correct a three-dimensional space, wherein the first parameter matrix and the second parameter matrix correspond to the correction functions of the first imaging device and the second imaging device, respectively, to provide depth information for the three-dimensional space correction.

title_en: Liquid crystal element
abstract_en: Provided is a liquid crystal element which has excellent initial low-temperature responsiveness even without using a polarizing plate, and which is not susceptible to deterioration of the low-temperature responsiveness in a light resistance test. The liquid crystal element is not provided with a polarizing plate, and is provided with a pair of electrode substrates comprising a first electrode substrate and a second electrode substrate, a liquid crystal layer disposed between the pair of electrode substrates, and an ultraviolet blocking layer provided on the side of the first electrode substrate opposite to the liquid crystal layer, the first electrode substrate being a transparent electrode substrate, and the second electrode substrate being a transparent electrode substrate. The ultraviolet blocking layer is a layer having a light transmittance of 0.1% or less in a wavelength region of 378 nm or less, the liquid crystal layer contains a liquid crystal component containing one or more types of liquid crystal compounds, and the liquid crystal component contains a liquid crystal compound represented by formula (1).

title_en: Improved reticle and reticle blank
abstract_en: There is provided a reticle or a reticle blank comprising a low deformation material, wherein the reticle or reticle blank material has a Zero Crossing Temperature (ZCT) profile, and a ZCT slope profile, wherein at least one of the ZCT profile and the ZCT slope profile is non-uniform. Also provided is a method of mitigating non-correctable deformations in a reticle or reticle blank, the method including providing a reticle or reticle blank having at least one of a Zero Crossing Temperature (ZCT) profile and a ZCT slope profile which is non-uniform across the reticle or reticle blank.

title_en: Photosensitive resin composition, photosensitive resin film, pattern formation method and light-emitting element
abstract_en: To provide a photosensitive resin composition which enables easy formation of a film having high lithography resolution and good light-emitting characteristics, a photosensitive resin film obtained using the photosensitive resin composition, a pattern formation method using them, and a light-emitting element having a cured film obtained by using the photosensitive resin film. A photosensitive resin composition contains (A) a resin having a (meth)acryloyl group, (B) a photoradical generator, and (C) a polymer obtained by copolymerization of quantum dots obtained by subjecting a silane coupling agent to coordinate treatment, alkoxysilane, an alkoxysilane hydrolysate or its condensate.

title_en: Polyether-based resin, and manufacturing method and use of the same
abstract_en:
Provided is a polyether-based resin that exhibits high refractive index and heat resistance. 
 
     A polyether-based resin is prepared, which contains a bispolycyclic arylfluorene ether unit represented by formula (1) and an aliphatic ether unit represented by formula (2) as follows. 
 
     
       
         
       
     
     In formula (1), ring Z 1a  and ring Z 1b  independently represent a polycyclic arene ring; R 1a  and R 1b  independently represent a substituent; n1 and n2 independently represent an integer of 0 or more; R 2a  and R 2b  independently represent a substituent; and m1 and m2 independently represent an integer from 0 to 4. 
 
     
       
         
       
     
     In formula (2), A 1  represents an alkylene group having 2 or more carbon atoms.

title_en: Floating projection device
abstract_en: A floating projection device includes a mirror structure, an optical structure, an optical coating and a display. The optical structure covers the mirror structure, and forms an accommodating space with the mirror structure. The optical coating is disposed on the optical structure. The display is disposed in the accommodating space formed between the optical structure and the mirror structure, and is configured to transmit a plurality of image light beams to the optical structure.

title_en: Electronic device
abstract_en: An electronic device including a substrate, a circuit structure, two adjacent supporting elements and another two adjacent supporting elements is provided. The substrate has a first surface and a region connected with a circuit board. The circuit structure is disposed on the first surface. The two adjacent supporting elements are disposed on the first surface and separated by a first distance. The another two adjacent supporting elements are disposed on the first surface and separated by a second distance, wherein the two adjacent support elements are farther away from the region than the another two adjacent support elements, and the first distance is less than the second distance.

title_en: Resist material, pattern forming method, and patterned structure
abstract_en: Provided are: a novel resist material containing a polyacid salt; a pattern forming method; and a patterned structure.

title_en: Fixed-focus projection lens
abstract_en: A fixed-focus projection lens includes a first lens group, an aperture and a second lens group arranged in order from a magnified side to a minified side. The fixed-focus projection lens includes 6-9 lenses with refractive powers and meets the following conditions: (1) -9 < EFLf/EFL < -1.5 and (2) 0.08 < IMH/OAL < 0.3, where EFLf is an effective focal length of the first lens group, EFL is an effective focal length of the fixed-focus projection lens, IMH is an image height measured at the effective focal length, and OAL is a distance along the optical axis between two outermost lens surfaces at opposite sides of the fixed-focus projection lens.

title_en: Scanning mirror with dual axis gimbal structure
abstract_en: A dual axis MEMS mirror assembly is disclosed. The assembly has a mirror and two arms, each having a rotational degree of motion and a translational degree of freedom. Each arm is hingedly attached to opposite ends of the mirror. A first pair of actuators is coupled to opposite ends of the first arm. A second pair of actuators is coupled to opposite ends of the second arm. The mirror is rotated around a first axis by the first and second arms when the first and second pair of actuators are rotated in the same angular direction causing the arms to translate in the translational degree of freedom. The mirror is rotated around a second axis by the first and second arms when the first and second pair of actuators are rotated in the opposite angular direction causing the arms to move in the rotational degree of motion.

title_en: Meta-lens assembly and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: A method for manufacturing a meta-lens assembly, including the steps of: providing a substrate that includes a first region, a second region, and a third region connecting the first and second regions; etching the third region to form micro-scale support structures; etching one side of the first region to form nano-scale meta-lenses, which are connected to the support structures; and removing the support structures to separate the meta-lenses from the second region, thereby obtaining the meta-lens assembly. The manufacturing method provided by this application significantly enhances the strength of the microstructures of the meta-lenses, reducing the risk of damage in subsequent processing. Furthermore, the application also provides a meta-lens assembly.

title_en: Fiber array unit structure and method of forming the same
abstract_en: A fiber array unit (FAU) structure and the method for forming the same are provided. The FAU structure includes a FAU, a passive optical component structure, and a carrier board. The FAU includes a fiber holder holding optical fibers. The passive optical component structure includes a reflective layer and a lens layer. The reflective layer includes reflectors adjacent to the optical fibers. The lens layer includes silicon lenses adjacent to the reflectors. The carrier board is configured to support the FAU and the passive optical component structure. The FAU and the passive optical component structure are adjacent to each other. The lens layer is located between the reflective layer and the carrier board.

title_en: Adhesive, adhesive sheet, laminate, and display
abstract_en: The problem of the present invention is solved by an adhesive comprising a specific acrylic copolymer (A), an isocyanate compound (B), and a metal chelate compound (C), the adhesive after curing satisfying all of (1) to (3). (1) 3.0 * 104 Pa < G'(-20) < 4.0 * 105 Pa; (2) 5 < G'(-20)/G'(200) < 17; (3) 2 < tan[delta] (-20)/tan[delta] (200) < 6.5. In the abovementioned formulas, G'(-20) represents the storage elastic modulus at -20 DEG C and 1 Hz, G'(200) represents the storage elastic modulus at 200 DEG C and 1 Hz, tan[delta] (-20) represents the loss tangent at -20 DEG C and 1 Hz, and tan[delta] (200) represents the loss tangent at 200 DEG C and 1 Hz, respectively.

title_en: Polarizing plate with pressure-sensitive adhesive and display device
abstract_en: An objective of the present invention is aimed to provide a polarizing plate with pressure-sensitive adhesive, which is capable of suppressing both decrease of transmittance in high-temperature environment and decrease of polarization degree in high-temperature environment. A means for attaining the objective is a polarizing plate with pressure-sensitive adhesive comprising a polyvinyl alcohol-based resin polarizing film which is formed by absorbing and orienting iodine therein, a protecting film, and a pressure-sensitive adhesive layer, and containing an amide compound represented by the following formula (1): [In formula (1), R1, R2 and R3 each independently represents hydrogen, a hydroxyl group, an alkyl group having 1 to 5 carbons, or an alkyl group having 1 to 5 carbons in which one or more hydrogen atoms have been substituted with hydroxyl groups.].

title_en: Compound having naphthalene rings, optical film, coating material, and ink
abstract_en: The present invention provides a compound having naphthalene rings which is useful as an optical material. Also provided are an optical film, a coating material, and an ink which contain the compound having naphthalene rings. This compound having naphthalene rings is represented by formula (1). In formula (1), R1, R2, R3, R4, R5, R6, R7, and R8 each independently represent a hydrogen atom, a C20 or lower alkyl group, or an amino group in which one or more of the hydrogen atoms may have been replaced with other structure. In formula (1), Ra represents a hydrogen atom, a C20 or lower alkyl group, or an oxo group (=O) and Rb represents a hydrogen atom, a C20 or lower alkyl group, or an imino group in which the hydrogen atom may have been replaced with a structure having an aromatic ring.

title_en: Optical sheet, laminated sheet and equipment device
abstract_en: The present invention provides an optical sheet comprising a layer composed of a composition containing an ethylene-unsaturated carboxylic acid copolymer (A) or an ionomer (A1) of an ethylene-unsaturated carboxylic acid copolymer having a content of structural units derived from unsaturated carboxylic acid of 5% by mass or more and a melting point of 90 DEG C or less.

title_en: Optical element capable of increasing uniformity of reflecting visible light, and coating structure thereof
abstract_en: A coating structure of an optical element capable of increasing uniformity of reflecting visible light, includes a firs layer set and a second layer set. The first layer set includes first high refractive-index and low refractive-index layers alternately stocked on a substrate. The second layer set includes second high refractive-index and low refractive-index layers alternately stocked on the first layer set. The first high refractive-index layer(s) contains silicon. The second high refractive-index layer(s) is dielectric layer(s). The first and second low refractive-index layers are the same in material. The reflectance of the coating structure with respect to visible light exceeds 95%.

title_en: Redundant touch panel
abstract_en: A redundant touch panel (114) is placed above an electronic display (112) and the assembly is housed in a sealed gasket. The touch panel (114) has at least two adjoining, seamless touch sections, each in communication with an input/output device (116). The touch panel may be comprised of electronic circuits configured to minimize electromagnetic interference. Detectors are placed adjacent to the touch sections to detect signals therefrom. The electronic display (112) is comprised of multiple layers configured to provide visibility in bright ambient conditions.

title_en: Display module
abstract_en:
A display module including a backlight module, a liquid crystal layer and a first light-expanding layer is provided. The backlight module provides surface light source. The liquid crystal layer is disposed on the backlight module, and the first light-expanding layer is disposed on the liquid crystal layer. The surface light source forms image light through the liquid crystal layer, and the first light-expanding layer increases the viewing angle range of the image light along a first direction. The first light-expanding layer is substantially extended along a virtual plane, and the first direction is perpendicular to the normal of the virtual plane, and a second direction is perpendicular to the first direction and the normal of the virtual plane. The light intensity at the 60 degree viewing angle of the surface light source along the first direction is lower than the light intensity 
at the 60 degree viewing angle of the surface light source along the second direction.

title_en: Display device and electronic device
abstract_en:
A display device that can display an image along a curved surface is provided. In the display device, a first display panel and a second display panel overlap each other with a light-transmitting layer provided therebetween. The light-transmitting layer is positioned on a display surface side of the first display panel, and on a side opposite to the display surface of the second display panel. The light-transmitting layer has an average transmittance of 80 % or more with respect to light in the wavelength range of 450 nm to 700 nm and a refractive index higher than that of air. A display region of the first display panel overlaps 
a region transmitting visible light of the second display panel with the light-transmitting layer provided therebetween. It is preferred that the display region of the first display panel not overlap with a region blocking visible light of the second display panel.

title_en: Liquid crystal display
abstract_en:
A liquid crystal display (LCD) including: a first electrode disposed on a first substrate; an insulating layer disposed on the first electrode; a second electrode disposed on the insulating layer, overlapping the first electrode, and including a plurality of branch electrodes; and a second substrate disposed on the second electrode, opposing the second substrate is disclosed. Liquid crystal molecules of a liquid crystal layer disposed between the substrates are aligned to have pretilt angles in an alignment direction. The branch electrodes include a main branch portion forming a 
first angle with the alignment direction and a first center portion forming a second angle with the alignment direction, respectively. The branch electrodes include an outermost branch electrode, and the outermost branch electrode includes the main branch portion forming a first angle with the alignment direction and a second center portion forming a fourth angle with the alignment direction.

title_en: Head mounted display device
abstract_en: A head mounted display (HMD) includes a tube, a reflective mirror, an infrared camera, and an imaging device. The reflective mirror is disposed in the tube. The reflective mirror has a first surface and a second surface which are connected in sequence, where a normal vector of the first surface is not parallel to a normal vector of the second surface.
