The controller controls scanning of the sensor across a surface of the reticle such that transmission data for multiple points on the reticle are captured by the sensor. All desired aspects of the transmission data for the multiple points on the reticle are captured in less than about 30 seconds.

title_en: Image projection device
abstract_en: An image projection device 100 comprises: a first imaging unit 40 that images the surrounding of a user; an image projection unit 10 that projects, onto eyes 60 of the user, a first image 71 of the surrounding of the user imaged by the first imaging unit 40; a second imaging unit 41 that images the eyes 60 of the user; an identification unit 34 that identifies, on the basis of a second image 72 of the eyes 60 imaged by the second imaging unit 41, a gaze point 70 on which the user is gazing in the first image 71; and a focus control unit 35 that controls the first imaging unit 40 such that the focus of the first imaging unit 40 matches the gaze point 70.

title_en: Array substrate, display panel, and display device
abstract_en: An array substrate, a display panel, and a display device. The array substrate comprises a base substrate (101); and a plurality of electrodes (102) located on the base substrate (101). The electrodes (102) include a first main electrode (M1), a second main electrode (M2), a plurality of first branch electrodes (B1), a plurality of second branch electrodes (B2), and a plurality of third branch electrodes (B3), wherein the plurality of first branch electrodes (B1) extend in a first direction (D) and are arranged in a second direction (Y), and the plurality of second branch electrodes (B2) extend in a third direction (D') and are arranged in the second direction (Y), the first direction (D), the second direction (Y) and the third direction (D') intersecting; the plurality of third branch electrodes (B3) extend in the first direction (D) and are arranged in the second direction (Y) on one side of the plurality of first branch electrodes (B1); the first main electrode (M1) is located between the column where the plurality of first branch electrodes (B1) are located and the column where the plurality of second branch electrodes (B2) are located, and the first main electrode (M1) is connected to the plurality of first branch electrodes (B1) and the plurality of second branch electrodes (B2); and the second main electrode (M2) is located on the side of the plurality of third branch electrodes (B3) away from the first main electrode (M1), and the second main electrode (M2) is connected to the plurality of third branch electrodes (B3). Thus, the problems of a large dark field at the edge, low light efficiency, and wire breakage caused by excessively long electrodes are solved.

title_en: Polymer optical waveguide and optical module
abstract_en: According to the present invention, a polymer optical waveguide can be highly accurately positioned with respect to an optical circuit board in a simple configuration and with simple assembly work by engaging protrusions formed on a cladding with guide grooves formed in the optical circuit board.　This polymer optical waveguide comprises a core (11) and a cladding (12, 13) disposed around the core (11) and having a lower refractive index than the core (11). The cladding (12, 13) is provided with protrusions (17) that each extend along the periphery of the core (11) and engage with a guide groove (22) formed in an optical circuit board (20). A plurality of cores (11) are respectively disposed alongside each other in the protrusions (17).

title_en: Optical modulator, wavelength selective switch, port-level optical switch, optical cross connection and optical communication system
abstract_en: Provided in the embodiments of the present application are an optical modulator, a wavelength selective switch, a port-level optical switch, an optical cross connection and an optical communication system, which aim to reduce the insertion loss during optical switching. In the optical modulator provided in the present application, an included angle is formed between a first surface of a first substrate and a second surface of a second substrate, and a liquid crystal layer is located between the first substrate and the second substrate, such that an included angle is formed between an incident light beam of a signal light beam irradiating the optical modulator and an emergent light beam emitted from the optical modulator. In addition, the first substrate is provided with a first electrode layer, the second substrate is provided with a second electrode layer, the first electrode layer and the second electrode layer are adjusted such that electric fields of different intensities are generated to change the refractive index of the liquid crystal layer, and the included angle between the incident light beam and the emergent light beam is further adjusted, thereby directing the signal light beam toward a target output port. Moreover, the signal light beam is deflected on the basis of the principle of refraction, thereby reducing the insertion loss of the signal light beam in the optical modulator, and further reducing the insertion loss during optical switching.

title_en: Detection device, gaze detection device, and image display device
abstract_en: This detection device detects information relating to user's eyes. The detection device comprises: a frame that is attached to the face of a user; a light source unit that emits infrared light; a light guide plate that is disposed in front of an eye of the user, and has an emission layer for dividing and duplicating the infrared light incident from the light source unit and emitting the duplicated light from each of a plurality of emission positions; and an imaging unit that captures images of a plurality of infrared light beams emitted from the plurality of emission positions and reflected by the eye of the user and the pupil of the eye of the user. The light source unit, the light guide plate, and the imaging unit are attached to the frame.

title_en: Low-refractive-index compound, preparation method therefor, and low-refractive-index optical film and display device, which comprise same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a low-refractive-index compound, a preparation method therefor, and a low-refractive-index optical film and a display device, which comprise same. The low-refractive-index compound of the present invention satisfies physical properties of both low refractive index and high viscosity, and thus can be effectively applied to the production of a low-refractive-index layer or a low-refractive-index optical film, which has low reflectance, and to a mold patterning technique. Therefore, a low-refractive-index optical film with ensured quality uniformity can be cost-effectively manufactured, and is applied such that a high-quality display device with improved light efficiency can be provided.

title_en: Lens structure and wearable electronic device comprising same
abstract_en: A wearable electronic device according to an embodiment of the present disclosure comprises: a lens housing; a lens structure disposed in the lens housing and including a first surface facing a first direction and a second surface opposite to the first surface; and a light output member disposed on one side of the lens housing, wherein the lens structure includes: an input coupler formed at a first position of the first surface or the second surface and configured to receive light output from the light output member; an output coupler formed at a second position spaced apart from the first position on the first surface or the second surface, and configured to output light to a user when the user wears the wearable electronic device; and an extension coupler disposed at a third position different from the first position and the second position of the first surface or the second surface and configured to radiate light incident through the input coupler and transmit the light toward the output coupler, wherein the extension coupler is divided into at least two regions, and the extension coupler includes: a coating layer disposed on the first surface or the second surface; and a plurality of diffraction elements disposed on the first surface or the second surface to correspond to the at least two regions above the first surface or the second surface such that the light transmitted from the input coupler is uniformly radiated.

title_en: Multiwavelength measurements for scanning overlay metrology
abstract_en: A metrology system and method for imaging samples such as semiconductor devices having metrology targets for measuring overlay. In embodiments, the system includes an illumination source configured to generate a multiwavelength illumination beam, collection channels for collecting wavelength-selective collected light from the sample in accordance with a metrology recipe, and a controller configured to receive wavelength-selective datasets and determine at least one overlay measurement from the wavelength-selective datasets received.

title_en: Optical phase trimming for silicon or other photonic devices
abstract_en: A photonic component (102A) includes a substate and a dielectric layer (206) disposed over the substrate (202). The photonic component (102A) also includes a waveguide section (160) disposed within the dielectric layer (206) and a heating element (170) disposed within the dielectric layer (206) and configured to transfer heat to the waveguide section (160). In addition, the photonic component (102A) includes one or more cavities (232) in the substrate (202) disposed below the waveguide section (160) and the heating element (170), where the one or more cavities (232) is configured to confine heat in an area of interest to reach an elevated temperature within and around the waveguide section (160).

title_en: Storage battery management device and method
abstract_en: A storage battery management device of an embodiment is provided with: a characteristics storage unit in which electrical storage characteristics of a storage battery unit are stored in the form of a storage battery characteristics table; a characteristics acquiring unit which acquires electrical storage characteristics on the basis of storage battery information output from the storage battery unit; a characteristics update unit which updates the storage battery characteristics table on the basis of the acquired electrical storage characteristics; and an estimating unit which estimates the state of charge (SOC) of the storage battery unit with reference to the updated storage battery characteristics table.

title_en: Systems and methods for measuring the rate of angular displacement using magnetic field sensing
abstract_en: This invention discloses a method for measuring the rate of angular displacement, of a traveling object, using magnetic field sensing, said method comprising: measuring magnetic field intensity and/or changes in said magnetic field intensity, projected onto a magnetic field sensor coupled to said traveling object, each measurement being per orthogonal rotation axis to provide a magnetic field intensity value per axis and/or a change in magnetic field intensity per axis, as said object's orientation changes with time; determining, number of peaks, present in a measurement sample comprising a set of said measurements, of time duration; and computing said rate of angular displacement, for said traveling object, as a function of said determined number of peaks and said time duration.

title_en: Apparatus, rock drilling rig and method for mining navigation
abstract_en: An apparatus, rock drilling rig, method and computer program for executing navigation for a rock drilling rig in a mine tunnel. The rock drilling rig (5) is positioned at faces (9) of rounds (8) and is navigated before initiating drilling. The navigation is executed without a predetermined tunnel line (10). The realized tunnel line is formed by combining navigation data on several rounds. Length and direction of the round to be drilled next may be adjusted according to a need.

title_en: Method for assessing an external event on an automotive glazing
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for detection and analysis of an external event occurring on an automotive glazing. According to the present invention invention, the method comprises : - receiving a signal comprising characteristic information of at least one electrical signal resulting from an occurrence of said external event on said automotive glazing, - applying said signal comprising said characteristic information to a computer-implemented classification model, whereby for each of one or more quantities related to said characteristic information a prediction is made of a value of a parameter indicative of said external event, - deriving a decision on replace or repair based on said value of said parameter from said predictions.

title_en: A sensing array, system and method for ore processing equipment
abstract_en: Described is a wear part for minerals processing equipment. The wear part comprises an inner surface for contact with slurry when the minerals processing equipment is in use and an outer surface of the wear part. The wear part further comprises at least one sacrificial wear sensor located at a predetermined distance between the inner surface and the outer surface, the at least one sacrificial wear sensor being arranged to wirelessly communicate with a remote wear monitoring unit.

title_en: Emergency medicine delivery transportation using unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en:
EMERGENCY MEDICINE DELIVERY TRANSPORTATION USING 
UNMANNED AERIAL VEHICLE 
Abstract: 
Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) can swiftly, safely, and cost-effectively 
deliver products via accessible and inaccessible lands such as mountain 
climbers or boats on board. Unmanned air vehicles are capable. Both land 
transportation and aircraft, both fixed and rotor wings, are usually provided for 
medical supplies. Blood products and medicines in critical access hospitals 
typically have a restricted availability during crises, and normal supply routes 
may be interrupted. This invention seeks to design the possibility of transporting 
medicinal goods to areas affected by the epidemics using tiny UAVs. Drown 
flew from the base to a predetermined place of delivery. The drone was guided 
back to base by the operator after the successful delivery of the medicine. The 
future improvements to the drone model include an on-board computer program 
and a GPS unit for the facial identification system to check recipients before 
delivery, autopilot drones control, a real-time picture and video 
relay/transmission back to control stations, and an autonomous drug delivery 
without physical contact from the recipient.

title_en: Self-contained biological indicator
abstract_en:
A biological sterilization indicator is disclosed that in some embodiments comprises a 
housing having a first enclosure and a second enclosure, an ampule containing a liquid growth 
medium, and an insert disposed at least partially in the first enclosure. A portion of the ampule 
may be disposed inside the first enclosure. The insert may have a platform including a top 
surface, an abutment surface, and a side surface, as well as a first void disposed in the platform 
and configured to allow passage of a first volume of the liquid growth medium into the second 
enclosure and a second void disposed through at least a portion of the side surface and 
configured to allow passage of a second volume of the liquid growth medium into the second 
enclosure. The second void of the insert may be an angled cut through the abutment surface and 
the side surface, which may be disposed entirely beneath the top surface. In some embodiments, 
stress concentrators and other features are included to reduce the force required to activate the 
biological sterilization indicator.

title_en: Estimation of spatial profile of environment
abstract_en:
Disclosed herein is a system and method for facilitating estimation of a spatial profile 
of an environment based on a light detection and ranging (LiDAR) based technique.  
In one arrangement, the present disclosure facilitates spatial profile estimation based 
on directing light over one dimension, such as along the vertical direction. In another 
arrangement, by further directing the one-dimensionally directed light in another 
dimension, such as along the horizontal direction, the present disclosure facilitates 
spatial profile estimation based on directing light in two dimensions.

title_en: Bird or bat detection and identification for wind turbine risk mitigation
abstract_en:
An automated system for mitigating risk from a wind turbine includes a plurality of optical 
imaging sensors. A controller receives and analyzes images from the optical imaging sensors 
to automatically send a signal to curtail operation of the wind turbine to a predetermined risk 
mitigating level when the controller determines from images received from the optical imaging 
sensors that an airborne animal is at risk from the wind turbine.

title_en: Method and apparatus for determining target soc of power battery of hybrid vehicle
abstract_en: A method for determining a target SOC of a power battery of a hybrid vehicle, said method comprising: obtaining current associated information, and, on the basis of the current associated information, determining a current lower limit state-of-charge (SOC) and a current upper limit SOC, the current associated information comprising at least part of the following items: a current altitude of the position at which a target hybrid vehicle is currently located, a current grade of the road surface on which the target hybrid vehicle is currently located, a current environmental temperature of the environment in which the target hybrid vehicle is currently located, a current battery temperature of a power battery of the target hybrid vehicle, and a current state-of-health (SOH) of the power battery; and, on the basis of a current actual SOC of the power battery, the current lower limit SOC, and the current upper limit SOC, determining a first target SOC of the power battery.

title_en: Electric grounding simulator
abstract_en: Grounding simulation models for training linemen and other power or utility technicians are disclosed. The grounding simulation models can be configured to provide equipotential zone (EPZ) grounding training for high voltage electric power transmission. In some instances, the grounding simulation models can include a power pole assembly including power poles, a top conductor, a middle conductor, a bottom conductor and an optical ground wire (OPGW). In some instances, the grounding simulation models can include a lineman meter configured to emulate a utility worker operating on high voltage electric power lines. In some instances, the grounding simulation model can include step leads that can be positioned anywhere along a matrix pattern on a mounting board, wherein the step leads are configured to demonstrate step and touch potential. In some instances, the grounding simulation models can include a model wire puller and insulation and isolation platforms.

title_en: Medical mr imaging with corrected t1 data in presence of elevated iron.
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides systems and methods which may assist in evaluating liver fibrosis/inflammation in the presence of elevated iron using magnetic resonance relaxometry. In a non-limiting embodiment, the systems and methods include: obtaining a measurement of relaxometry data of a subject's liver for extracellular fluid, preferably using a magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) device; determining an iron content for the liver; simulating a measurement of the subject's liver for extracellular fluid for the determined iron content; comparing the measurement of the subject's liver for extracellular fluid to the simulated measurement of the subject's liver for extracellular fluid; and determining from said comparison a value of extracellular fluid in the subject's liver based on a normal iron content for the liver. The simulation can include multi-compartment modeling of various fractions of extracellular fluid in the liver and the impact of iron content in the liver on both the intra- and extracellular relaxation times.

title_en: Kit and methods for detecting sulfur in gypsum
abstract_en: A method for rapid detection of sulfur in a gypsum sample by causing emission of sulfur from the sample as vapors, reacting the vapors with silver nitrate and detecting sulfur by monitoring for color change. A kit for rapid detection of sulfur in a gypsum sample is also provided. Further methods include those in which the amount of sulfur in a gypsum sample is quantified in colorimetric analysis with silver nitrate and gypsum standards with known concentrations of sulfur.

title_en: A particle size tracking (pst) system for predictive maintenance, battery tuning and manifold distribution compensation
abstract_en: A particle size tracking system for providing predictive maintenance and battery tuning of hydrocyclones arranged in a battery configuration, featuring a control having a signal processor configured to: receive signaling containing information about particle sizes of material flowing in pipes of hydrocyclones arranged in a battery configuration; and determine corresponding signaling containing information to control the operation of each hydrocyclone arranged in the battery configuration, based upon the signaling received. The signal processor may be configured to provide the corresponding signal as control signaling to control the operation of each hydrocyclone arranged in the battery configuration.

title_en: Associative object tracking systems and methods
abstract_en: Systems and methods track a first object when continuous tracking information for the first object is not available. The systems and methods detect when the tracking information for the first object is not available. A last time of a last determined location of the first object is determined and a second object closest to the last determined location at the last time is determined. The location of the first object is associated with a location of the second object if tracking information for the first object is not available. Proximity of the first object to the second object may also be detected and used to associate the location of the first object to the second object. An ID of a tracking tag is automatically associated with an ID of an object to which it is attached.

title_en: Method for selection of improved hydrocarbon recovery agents for hydrocarbon revervoirs
abstract_en: A physical modeling method that includes providing a reservoir core plug, the reservoir core plug having a wellbore interface end, an outlet interface end, and a cylindrical face and saturating the reservoir core plug with hydrocarbon and brine to fonn a saturated core plug. The method also includes positioning the saturated core plug within a flooding apparatus and pumping the fracturing fluid through saturated core plug to displace a portion of the hydrocarbon to fonn a displaced hydrocarbon plug. In addition the method includes positioning the displaced hydrocarbon plug in an imbibition cell and conducting an imbibition test to fonn an imbibed core plug having brine and hydrocarbon. Further the method includes positioning the imbibed core plug in core-flooding apparatus and displacing a portion of the brine and hydrocarbon from the imbibed core plug.

title_en: Systems and methods for verifying and maintaining accuracy of metering devices
abstract_en: Systems for identifying a meter that is out of calibration and methods of controlling the same include obtaining a power measurement value for each of a plurality of metering devices in a hierarchy of metering devices, calculating virtual metering points for a candidate metering device using metering devices connected upstream and/or downstream to the candidate metering device, and identifying the candidate metering device as being out of calibration by leveraging the virtual metering points and the candidate metering device's specification.

title_en: Devices and methods for line-scanning microscopy
abstract_en: The present description relates to a device (200) for line-scanning optical-coherence-tomography microscopy. The device comprises an interferometric microscope (201) comprising a reference arm, an object arm configured to receive an object (10), a beam splitter (204) coupling said object and reference arms to a light source (210) and to a detector (222), and a first microscope objective (202) arranged on said object arm. The device further comprises a one-dimensional confocal spatial filtering device configured to interact with the light source in order to illuminate the object along a focal line located in an object space of the first microscope objective, and a device (235, 237) for scanning the focal line in one direction, which device is arranged on the object arm upstream of the first microscope objective and configured to scan the focal line in a lateral direction (y) substantially perpendicular to an optical axis (z) of said first microscope objective.

title_en: Position detection apparatus for seam portion and heating portion of welded steel pipe, manufacturing equipment for welded steel pipe, position detection method for seam portion and heating portion of welded steel pipe, manufacturing method for welded steel pipe, and quality control method for welded steel pip
abstract_en: A position detection apparatus for a seam portion and a heating portion of a welded steel pipe is a position detection apparatus configured to detect a position of the seam portion of the welded steel pipe and a position of the heating portion, the position detection apparatus including a light source configured to irradiate the seam portion and the heating portion with light in a first wavelength range, an imaging unit configured to capture an image of each of the seam portion and the heating portion irradiated with the light by the light source, and an image processing unit configured to process the image captured by the imaging unit and to detect the position of each of the seam portion and the heating portion, in which the imaging unit includes a first channel capable of receiving the light in the first wavelength range, and a second channel capable of receiving light in a second wavelength range corresponding to radiation light from the heating portion.

title_en: Sonogenetic stimulation of cells expressing a heterologous mechanosensitive protein
abstract_en: Provided and described are mechanosensory polypeptides and encoding polynucleotide products and compositions thereof, methods of expressing such polypeptides and polynucleotides in a cell type of interest, and methods of inducing and/or modifying the activity and/or function of various types of cells that express the exogenous mechanosensory polypeptides using ultrasound.

title_en: Solution electrode glow discharge apparatus and method of use
abstract_en: A solution electrode glow discharge ("SEGD") apparatus comprising a pressurized housing. The apparatus SEGD may comprise an inlet to allow entry of compressed gas in the pressurized housing; an outlet opening to allow gas flow through the pressurized housing while maintaining a specific pressure; and an optical window for letting light generated from the plasma exit the apparatus. The apparatus may comprise a solid electrode and a solution electrode and be configured to produce a plasma between a solid electrode and a solution electrode. The apparatus may be configured to flow gas from outside of the pressurized housing into the inlet and through at least a region of an interior of the pressurized housing.

title_en: Flaw detection device and flaw detection method using flaw detection device
abstract_en: The invention provides a flaw detection device and a flaw detection method using the flaw detection device, which can prevent detection omission and overdetection of a flaw and improve the detection rate of the flaw. A magnetic particle inspection device (1) is provided with: an imaging device (16) that images the surface of the object (10); and a detection device (30) that processes an original image captured by the imaging device (16) and detects a flaw on the surface, wherein the detection device (30) comprises: a 1 st extraction unit (31) for performing binarization processing on the original image by using a 1 st threshold value to extract a 1 st injury candidate unit (40); an inspection area generation unit (32) that generates an inspection area (42) so as to include the 1 st injury candidate unit (40); a 2 nd extraction unit (33) that extracts a 2 nd lesion candidate unit (42) by performing binarization processing on the inspection area (41) using a 2 nd threshold value; and a flaw determination unit (34) that performs an expansion process on the 2 nd flaw candidate unit (42) to detect a flaw.

title_en: Gas analysis device and method based on spectrum technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a gas analysis device and a method based on spectrum technology, wherein the gas analysis device comprises: the light source emits measuring light matched with the gas to be measured; the detector converts measuring light interacted with the gas to be measured into an electric signal and transmits the electric signal to the analysis module; the detector is fixed on the voice coil motor and moves back and forth on the light path; and the analysis module is used for processing the electric signals by utilizing a spectrum technology so as to acquire the information of the gas to be detected. The invention has the advantages of high precision, simple structure, low cost and the like.

title_en: Particle separation device and method based on liquid tension effect in micro-channel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a particle separation device and method based on a liquid pulling force effect in a microchannel. The device comprises a microfluidic chip, a control module and a microinjection pump. The microfluidic chip is sequentially provided with a microfluidic chip main body and a substrate from top to bottom, N separation channels which are sequentially connected end to end are concavely carved on the microfluidic chip main body, and liquid storage holes are respectively arranged at the junction of the separation channels and at the end to end; the control module is communicated with an electromagnetic micro valve arranged at a certain position behind the junction hole in the separation channel, and the opening and the disconnection of the separation channel are realized by adjusting the action of the electromagnetic micro valve; the micro injection pump is communicated with the liquid inlet of the first separation channel, and the flow rate of liquid is pushed by adjusting the speed of injected air. The device has low cost and simple structure, and can be used for rapidly carrying out on-line separation.

title_en: Sensor assembly and mobile terminal
abstract_en: The invention provides a sensor assembly and a mobile terminal. The sensor component comprises at least one light emitter and at least one light receiver, wherein each light receiver at least corresponds to one light receiver; each optical transmitter is provided with an emergent surface for emitting optical signals, and the optical signals are reflected by barriers to form reflection signals; each light receiver is provided with a light incident surface for receiving corresponding reflection signals, and the included angle between the light emergent surface and the light incident surface at one side of the emergent light signals is less than 180 degrees. In the mobile terminal provided by the invention, the included angle of less than 180 degrees is formed between the light emitting surface of the light emitter and the light incident surface of the light receiver, so that the quantity of light signals received by the light receiver can be increased, and the detection sensitivity can be improved.

title_en: Gamma ray removes ray testing platform
abstract_en: The application discloses a gamma ray mobile ray detection platform, which comprises: the device comprises a shielding box, a lifting table, a storage room, a camera, an automatic door, a radioactive source and a controller; wherein, the top end of the shielding box is provided with an automatic door; a lifting table is arranged in the shielding box; the top end of the automatic door is provided with a camera; a storage room is arranged at the top end of the lifting table; the side surface of the storage room is provided with a radiation window; a radioactive source is arranged in the storage chamber, and the radioactive source and the radiation window are positioned on the same horizontal plane; the controller is electrically connected with the lifting table and the camera; the controller is electrically connected with the automatic door. According to the gamma ray mobile ray detection platform disclosed by the application, the radioactive source is placed in the shielding box in an undetected state, the radioactive source is pushed out during detection, and after a detection task is completed, the radioactive source is retracted into the shielding box by the lifting platform, so that the whole detection process is safely realized in a wireless remote control mode, and the harm of gamma rays to a human body is avoided.

title_en: Worm gear driver life test device
abstract_en: The invention provides a life testing device of a worm and gear driver, which is used for testing the abrasion degree of a gear matched between a worm and a worm wheel in the worm and gear driver. The life testing device comprises a testing platform, an input motor, a first connecting shaft, a second connecting shaft, a first gear transmission, a first brake, a second gear transmission, a second brake, a first torsion sensor and a second torsion sensor. The first torque sensor is arranged on the first connecting shaft and used for detecting the output torque of the first output end of the worm gear driver when the input motor drives the input end of the worm gear driver. The second torque sensor is arranged on the second connecting shaft and used for detecting the output torque of the second output end of the worm gear driver when the input motor drives the input end of the worm gear driver. The invention can efficiently test the service life of the product of the worm and gear driver.

title_en: Method and system for verifying satellite positioning
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for verifying a satellite based positioning. The system comprises a radio navigation device (10) mounted on a mobile carrier (2) and comprising satellite geolocation means (12) able to receive a composite radio signal comprising a plurality of radio navigation signals transmitted by the transmitting satellites and time synchronization and position reference information, the radio navigation device being able to process the received radio navigation signals to calculate first navigation information comprising geographic position, velocity and time information of the carrier. The radio navigation device (10) is capable of transmitting a baseband digitised signal (IF) of a radio navigation signal received at a reference processing station (16) 1 、...、IF N ) The reference processing station (16) being able to apply a digital signal (IF) 1 、...、IF N ) A process (29) similar to the process (20) performed by the radio navigation device (10) is performed to calculate the second navigation information, the system comprising means (22, 42) for verifying the first navigation information in accordance with the second navigation information calculated by the reference processing station (16).

title_en: Detection device for lighter middle wheel sequencing machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to a lighter middle wheel sequencing machine, in particular to a detection device for identifying teeth of a lighter middle wheel before automatic installation. The device comprises a left driving device, a motor, an elastic coupling and a driving rotating shaft. Driven rotation axis, right drive arrangement. A detection probe and a probe driving device. The motor is connected with the driving rotating shaft through the elastic coupling, and the left driving device drives the motor, the elastic coupling and the driving rotating shaft to reciprocate. The invention has simple and reasonable structure design and high automatic program, the middle wheel of the lighter can be almost 100 percent correctly installed with the lighter, the lighter which can not be ignited can not appear, the structure of the invention is simple, and most spare and accessory parts are the prior technical equipment. The cost is low, and the automatic modification of the production line can not be carried out with high cost.

title_en: Water heater and temperature sensing blind pipe thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of household appliances and discloses a water heater and a temperature sensing blind pipe thereof, wherein the temperature sensing blind pipe is arranged in a container and stretches into the liquid level, and comprises a hollow blind pipe main body (11) and a temperature sensing probe (21) arranged in the hollow blind pipe main body (11), wherein a positioning structure (12) for the temperature sensing probe (21) is arranged on the inner wall of the blind pipe main body (11), and the positioning structure (12) is higher than the bottom of the blind pipe main body (11) by a certain distance so that a safety distance H is reserved between the temperature sensing probe (21) and the bottom of the blind pipe main body (11); the water heater comprises the temperature sensing blind pipe, and the container is a water tank liner of the water heater. The invention can obtain the effect of avoiding the temperature sensing probe from contacting or soaking the condensed water accumulated at the bottom of the blind pipe main body, and the temperature sensing probe in the temperature sensing blind pipe is convenient and simple to install, high in installation efficiency and high in equipment working reliability.

title_en: Sound wave signal frame rate adjusting method for sound wave indoor positioning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sound wave signal frame rate adjusting method for sound wave indoor positioning, which is used for periodically transmitting sound wave signals by adopting a digital mechanism and comprises the following steps: firstly, designing a frame structure of a sound wave signal; then setting a preferred code rate set of the beacon nodes, deducing the symbol duration according to the known position information of the beacon nodes, and selecting the optimal code rate in the preferred code rate set to set the beacon nodes; and presetting the available code rate of the mobile node according to the preferred code rate set, estimating the symbol duration by the mobile node according to the STFT spectrum in the positioning process, and adaptively selecting the closest code rate in the preferred code rate set to realize code rate judgment. The method effectively solves the key technical problem of sound wave signal frame rate adjustment in sound wave indoor positioning, achieves the design goal of improving the code rate while ensuring the decoding reliability, further shortens the positioning period and improves the positioning performance.

title_en: Quick measuring device for dimension and form and position tolerance of driving axle housing parts
abstract_en: A device for rapidly measuring the dimension and form and position tolerance of driving axle housing parts comprises: base, elevating gear, two supports III, horizontal alignment device, measuring device I and two measuring device II. During measurement, the lifting device is lifted, the tested driving axle housing is prevented from being lifted to the lifting device at the moment, the lifting device is lowered, the shaft shoulders on two sides of the driving axle housing are arranged in the V-shaped grooves on the same side, and at the moment, the rotation of the driving axle housing in the vertical direction is limited. And then the horizontal alignment device drives the middle disc surface of the driving axle housing to be parallel to the horizontal plane, so that all the 6 degrees of freedom constraint of the driving axle housing are realized. The horizontal turning device drives the measuring device I to rotate for one circle, so that the measuring device I can measure the dimensional tolerance and the form tolerance of the disc surface part of the driving axle housing. And the longitudinal rotary device drives the measuring device II to measure the dimensional tolerance and form and position tolerance of the shaft shoulder. The measurement accuracy is high. The intensity of manual measurement is reduced, and the working efficiency is improved.

title_en: Catalyst abrasion strength testing device with adjustable incident angle
abstract_en: The invention relates to a catalyst abrasion strength testing device with an adjustable incident angle, which comprises a flue gas supply unit for supplying simulated flue gas, a feeding unit for supplying an abrasion agent, a test sample bin and a comparison sample bin for placing a catalyst to be detected, and an abrasion agent collecting unit for collecting the abrasion agent, wherein the flue gas supply unit, the comparison sample bin, the feeding unit, the test sample bin and the abrasion agent collecting unit are sequentially connected in series through pipelines, and an incident angle adjusting unit for adjusting the incident angle of the flue gas is respectively arranged on the pipelines between the flue gas supply unit and the comparison sample bin and between the feeding unit and the test sample bin. The invention realizes the incidence of the flue gas through various angles, greatly enriches the functions of the abrasion strength testing device, ensures that the influence of the incidence angle of the flue gas on the abrasion of the catalyst is characterized, and meets the requirement of the flue gas for scouring the catalyst at different incidence angles to cause the abrasion in the simulated denitration actual operation.

title_en: Novel automatic calibration device for vortex liquid level meter
abstract_en: The invention relates to an automatic calibration device of an eddy current liquid level meter, which comprises a calibration rod, a fixed frame, a calibration plate and a stepping motor, wherein the fixed frame is vertically arranged on a base, the calibration rod is arranged in parallel with the fixed frame, the calibration plate is arranged at the bottom end of the calibration rod, the stepping motor is arranged above the inside of the fixed frame, a screw rod vertically downwards arranged is connected to the output end of the stepping motor, a lifting block in threaded connection is arranged on the screw rod, one side of the lifting block is connected with a calibration rod clamping seat, the calibration rod is fixedly inserted in the calibration rod clamping seat, and a scale for calibration measurement is vertically fixedly arranged on the fixed frame. The invention completes one-key calibration and verification and rechecking of calibration data under the unified control of the liquid level secondary instrument, and automatically, well and quickly completes the calibration of the vortex system.

title_en: Wearable device-based auxiliary riding enhanced positioning method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for assisting riding, enhancing and positioning based on wearable equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: pre-calibrating the correlation coefficient of the bicycle rim and the correlation coefficient of the sensor; judging whether the user is in a riding mode; if the user is in the riding mode, calculating a course angle of the wearable device coordinate system relative to the navigation coordinate system; calculating the misalignment angle of the user coordinate system relative to the wearable device coordinate system and the heading of the user; calculating the current height; judging whether the user is in a pedal mode or a sliding mode at present, and carrying out corresponding calculation according to different modes to obtain the position of the pure inertial navigation of the user; fusing the position of the pure inertial navigation of the user with the position obtained by GNSS positioning, and setting corresponding weight for the GNSS positioning quality; outputting and fusing the user 3 axis position information and the user course and pitch angle information; and continuously judging whether the user is in the riding mode, and circulating until the task is finished.

title_en: Method for adjusting the distance during laser processing
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for adjusting the distance during laser machining using an electric oscillating circuit (17) whose oscillation frequency is dependent on the distance between the laser machining head (10) and the workpiece (14), and an adjusting device (23) for adjusting the distance (d) between the laser machining head (10) and the workpiece (14). In order to be able to achieve an accurate measurement of the distance between the laser processing head (10) and the workpiece (14) with the required measurement rate and measurement accuracy for the processing process, according to the invention, the period duration of the oscillating circuit signal is measured, and the distance (d) between the laser processing head (10) and the workpiece (14) is determined as a result of the measured period duration of the oscillating circuit signal and is supplied to the adjustment device (23).

title_en: Camera installation posture calibration method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a camera installation posture calibration device, comprising: the light source assembly (1) comprises three light sources distributed and arranged in an isosceles triangle; an imaging camera (2) located at the geometric center of the isosceles triangle; the base plate (3) is vertically arranged in the calibration device, and the three light source assemblies (1) and the imaging camera (2) are fixedly arranged on the front surface of the base plate (3); the inertial navigation assembly (4) is fixedly arranged on the back surface of the substrate (3); the mechanical arm (5) is horizontally arranged at the bottom of the calibration device, the substrate (3) is connected with the light source assembly (1), the imaging camera (2) and the inertial navigation assembly (4) and is arranged on the mechanical arm (5), and the mechanical arm (5) provides azimuth and pitching two-dimensional movement; and the industrial personal computer (6) is used for performing two-dimensional motion control on the mechanical arm (5), comparing inertial navigation data with reference data and giving out a test result of the pitch angle and the azimuth angle of the imaging camera.

title_en: Special measuring tool for measuring cone
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of cone manufacturing, in particular to a special measuring tool for cone measurement, which comprises a base, and a cone fixing mechanism, a rotating mechanism and a measuring mechanism which are fixed on the base; the gear fixing mechanism comprises a locking sleeve, a tool cone, a rotating sleeve, a locking screw, a first worm wheel, a first worm and a small worm wheel box body, wherein the rotating sleeve is installed in the small worm wheel box body through a bearing, the top of the rotating sleeve is fixedly connected with the tool cone, the top of the locking screw is fixedly connected with the locking sleeve through a bolt, the locking screw penetrates through the middle of the rotating sleeve, the first worm wheel is fixed in the middle of the rotating sleeve, two ends of the first worm are installed on the small worm wheel box body through bearings, the first worm is matched with the worm wheel, and one end of the first worm is connected with a first hand wheel. The device can measure the cone, and improves the quality of products.

title_en: Impact-resistant north-seeking calculation method based on inertial north-seeking device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-impact north-seeking calculation method based on an inertial north-seeking device, which comprises the steps of firstly carrying out data acquisition to obtain gyro measurement data G1 and accelerometer measurement data A1, then carrying out filtering on the gyro data based on a Kalman filter, grouping the test data at single positions, quantizing the divergence degree of each grouped data, then rejecting the groups with abnormal numerical deviation based on a Grabas filtering algorithm, and finally carrying out data statistics, transposition control, attitude calculation and circumference compensation in sequence to obtain the calculation results of a course angle and an attitude angle of the inertial north-seeking device. The invention adopts various filtering modes to filter the measured data, reduces the influence of impact vibration on the north-seeking result, and adopts an inclined state latitude-free north-seeking calculation method so as to obtain an accurate calculation result.

title_en: Enameled wire defect online detection method and detection device, computer device and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses an enameled wire defect online detection method and a detection device, a computer device and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of receiving set defect detection conditions, wherein the defect detection conditions comprise the length of a detection unit and the information of preset defect conditions; receiving data sent by enameled wire defect online detection equipment, judging whether the defect of a preset defect condition appears on the surface of the enameled wire currently detected within the length of a detection unit according to the data sent by the detection equipment, and if so, sending alarm information; wherein the preset defect condition comprises at least one of the following: the number of the first particles larger than the first particle size is larger than a first value, and the number of the second particles larger than the second particle size and smaller than the first particle size is larger than a second value. The invention also provides a detection device, a computer device and a computer readable storage medium for realizing the method. The invention can improve the detection efficiency of the enameled wire defects and improve the accuracy of the enameled wire detection.

title_en: Water bath test device of reversal difference in temperature
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water bath test device with alternating temperature difference, which comprises a master control system (1), wherein the master control system (1) is positioned at the center of a circular test base structure (6), a water bath heating device (4) is arranged on the test base structure (6), a temperature detection and control element (5) for temperature control is arranged in the water bath heating device (4), a plurality of water bath heating devices (4) are circumferentially distributed along the master control system (1) as the center, a rotating device is arranged on the master control system (1), one end of a component clamping device (2) is driven by the rotating device to rotate along the master control system (1) as the center of a circle, and the other end of the component clamping device (2) is connected with an electric push rod (8) for driving a sample to move up and down. The water bath test device for alternating temperature difference can realize the simulation of temperature change in areas with larger temperature difference in real environment and can automatically realize the alternation of temperature difference and temperature amplitude.

title_en: Calibration method of magnetic moment tester
abstract_en: The invention discloses a calibration method of a magnetic moment tester, which mainly comprises six steps of constructing a stable magnetic field assembly by utilizing a plurality of magnetized permanent magnets, wherein the magnetic field directions of the magnetic field assembly are parallel and uniformly distributed; fixing the magnetic field assembly in the center of the test coil to ensure that the direction of the magnetic field is consistent with the direction of a main shaft of the test coil; processing a nickel standard sample and putting the processed sample into a uniform magnetic field for saturation magnetization; zeroing the data of the magnetic flowmeter, drawing the nickel standard sample to a far place, and recording the reading of the magnetic flowmeter; calculating the constant of the test coil and completing the calibration of the instrument according to the uncertainty of the nickel standard sample and the uncertainty of the test process analysis system; the calibration method of the magnetic moment tester has the advantages of accurate and convenient test, high calibration efficiency and the like.

title_en: Calibrating device for flow velocity meter
abstract_en: According to the calibrating device for the flow velocity meter, the moving coil 11 is sleeved outside the cylindrical stator 12, when three-phase alternating current is supplied to the moving coil 11, the moving magnetic field generated between the moving coil 11 and the stator 12 enables the moving coil 11 to bear force parallel to the radial direction of the stator 12, and if the moving coil 11 and the stator 12 are not coaxial, the radial force pulls the moving coil 11 to a position coaxial with the stator 12, so that the moving coil 11 moves in a suspending mode on the stator 12, and the calibrating precision of the flow velocity meter is improved; and, can provide great electric current for moving coil 11 through three-phase alternating current power module 15, and then make moving coil 11 produce great axial acceleration force and braking force, realize faster acceleration and deceleration, and then can reduce the length of basin 14.

title_en: Ground signal receiving meteorological station based on Beidou navigation system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a ground signal receiving weather station based on a Beidou navigation system, which comprises a weather station body, a mounting plate, a rotation receiving device and cleaning adjusting devices, wherein the mounting plate is arranged at the upper end of the weather station body, the rotation receiving device is arranged in the middle of the upper end of the mounting plate, two cleaning adjusting devices are arranged on the mounting plate, and the two cleaning adjusting devices are symmetrically arranged at the left side and the right side of the mounting plate. The invention can solve the problems of poor angle adjusting effect, manual adjustment, low automation degree, high labor intensity, poor signal receiving and transmitting effect, difficult adjustment of the angle of the weather station, inaccurate signal receiving, cleaning one by one in a manual mode, high labor intensity, complex operation, poor using effect, low working efficiency and the like of the existing weather station because a large amount of sand and dust are accumulated after the weather station is used for a long time outdoors with large sand wind.

title_en: System and method for detecting distribution of temperature field of heat storage water tank
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of heat storage pools, in particular to a heat storage pool temperature field distribution detection system and method. The heat storage water tank temperature field distribution detection system comprises a heat storage water tank body, a top cover, a soil coupling temperature detection system and a water body temperature detection system, wherein the heat storage water tank body comprises a water tank slope and a water tank bottom surface, the soil coupling temperature detection system comprises a plurality of first temperature detection elements arranged on the water tank slope and a plurality of second temperature detection elements arranged on the water tank bottom surface, and the water body temperature detection system comprises a plurality of water body temperature detection devices arranged in the heat storage water tank body. The system and the method for detecting the distribution of the temperature field of the heat storage water tank can realize the collection of temperature change and temperature layering data of the temperature field after the heat storage water tank is coupled with soil, and provide data basis for the application of water with different temperature layers.

title_en: Method for detecting pigment with negative charges
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of nanorods, in particular to a detection method of pigment with negative charge, which adopts gold nanorods as substrate materials to carry out surface enhanced Raman detection; the gold nanorod comprises a coating agent as a raw material, wherein the coating agent is one of dodecyl trimethyl ammonium bromide, N-dodecyl-N-2-hydroxyethyl-N, N-dimethyl ammonium bromide and N-dodecyl-N, N-dihydroxyethyl-N-methyl ammonium bromide. The invention also discloses a preparation method of the nano rod. The invention provides three novel cationic surfactants as coating agents for preparing gold nanorods, the obtained gold nanorods with positive charges and pigment molecules with negative charges form electrostatic adsorption, which is beneficial to the detection of the pigment molecules, and the nanorods serving as a surface-enhanced Raman spectrum substrate material are used for the detection of the pigment molecules, and have the advantages of weak background signal intensity, strong sensitivity, high reproducibility and the like.

title_en: Chip table positioning device
abstract_en: A chip table positioning device comprises a Y-axis motion plate, a positioning plate, a base, a chip tray, a Z-axis direction positioning unit and an XY plane positioning unit; the Z-axis and XY-plane positioning units drive the chip to move on the Z-axis and XY-plane respectively and share the same power unit. The chip stage positioning device realizes accurate positioning of the biochip in the XYZ direction. Because the upper locating plate is used for locating and is also a chip locating reference surface, in the temperature control process of heating and refrigerating of the refrigerating sheet assembly, the whole refrigerating sheet assembly can sink towards the Z direction under the action of thermal expansion and cold contraction, and the chip detection surface basically keeps unchanged in the Z direction, so that the deformation influence of thermal expansion and cold contraction during temperature control is greatly reduced. The Z-axis direction positioning unit and the XY plane positioning unit share the same power unit, so that the number of parts is reduced, and the manufacturing cost is reduced. The bin inlet and outlet device is adopted, so that the high-precision Y-axis travel is reduced, the device space is further reduced, and the complexity and cost of the system are reduced.

title_en: Radio frequency mixed signal integrated circuit test system and test method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a test system and a test method of a radio frequency mixed signal integrated circuit, wherein the test system is composed of an automatic test unit, a test interface unit, an off-chip interface unit and a control host; the control host software controls the automatic test unit to act and output a test report; the automatic test unit generates an excitation signal and an expected signal, captures a response signal and returns a comparison result to the control host; the test interface unit is connected with the automatic test unit and integrates various types of signal interfaces into a standard external interface which has low density, simple butt joint process and signal type distinguishing function and bidirectionally transmits excitation and response signals; the calibration module of the off-chip interface unit realizes the radio frequency error separation of the test interface unit and the off-chip interface unit, and the circuit to be tested is connected to the standard off-chip interface through the off-chip interface unit to input an excitation signal and output a response signal. The integrated test of the universal, high-performance, high-efficiency and low-cost radio frequency mixed signal integrated circuit from 0.1GHz to 12GHz is realized.

title_en: Mine induced polarization detection system and fine imaging method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a polarization detection system and a fine imaging method, belongs to the field of electrical prospecting, and particularly relates to a mine induced polarization detection system and a fine imaging method. Wherein, the system includes: the data acquisition electrode group comprises a plurality of electrode groups connected with the host through extension sets; the signal conditioning device is used for conditioning input data of the data acquisition electrode group and sending the input data to the processor for processing; and the potential compensation device is used for compensating the data which are not met with the detection requirements and returned by the processor and sending the processed data to the signal conditioning device. Therefore, the device and the method for detecting the induced polarization of the mine in real time are realized, and the detection effect is greatly improved; the mine induced polarization exploration method provided by the invention realizes the refined inversion imaging of the unfavorable geology in front of the working face, can perform inversion imaging on the unfavorable geology condition in front of the working face, and has good engineering practical value.

title_en: Ultrahigh pressure test instrument for nanofluid test
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultrahigh pressure test instrument for a nanofluid test, which comprises a piston cylinder, a piston cylinder cover, a piston column, a sealing ring, an O-shaped ring, a bolt and a nut, wherein the piston cylinder cover is arranged on the piston cylinder; the cavity of the piston cylinder is the same as the inner diameter of a piston hole of the piston cylinder cover; the piston cylinder cover is fixedly connected to the top of the piston cylinder through a plurality of bolts and nuts, and the piston hole corresponds to the cavity; the piston column is arranged in the piston hole and the cavity; two sealing rings are embedded in the inner wall of the piston hole; an O-shaped ring is embedded between the connecting surfaces of the piston cylinder and the piston cylinder cover. The invention adopts a sealing combination mode, and the mechanical processing can meet the requirement from the original need of pairing grinding to the need of finish turning, thereby greatly reducing the mechanical processing requirement, lowering the production cost, and being simple to detach and easy to maintain.

title_en: Instrument for measuring shield tail gap of shield tunnel
abstract_en: The invention relates to an instrument for measuring a shield tail gap of a shield tunnel, which comprises a sliding track module, a movable slide rule module, a fixed module and a fixed baffle (4); the sliding track module comprises a fixed groove (8) and a sliding track (13); the movable slide rule module comprises a slide rule main body with a scale panel (10), a slide groove (7) and a spring-ball device, wherein the slide rule main body is arranged in the slide rail module, and the slide groove (7) is matched with the slide rail for sliding positioning; one end of the slide rule main body is a tail end, the other end of the slide rule main body is a front end connected with the pull rod handle (1), and a 0 scale of the front end is provided with a convex grid (2) for preventing the slide rule module from being separated from the slide track module; the fixed baffle (4) is vertically fixed at the tail end of the slide rule main body.

title_en: Pile body stress testing system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a pile body stress test system and a method, wherein the pile body stress test system comprises a pile body strain test device, a control device, a displacement measurement device and a strain temperature tester; the control device is connected with the pile body strain testing device and is used for controlling the pile body strain testing device to be fixed in the pile hole; displacement measurement device and temperature tester that meets an emergency all with pile body test device that meets an emergency is connected, displacement measurement device is used for measuring pile body test device that meets an emergency apart from the distance variation at pile body top, the temperature tester that meets an emergency is used for reading record strain value change and temperature variation from pile body test device that meets an emergency. The invention has wide application range, simple and convenient operation, strong flexibility, low cost and high precision.

title_en: Multichannel broadband signal coherent characteristic rapid calibration system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid on-line calibration system for the coherent characteristics of multichannel broadband signals, and aims to solve the problem of coherent characteristic calibration of multichannel, high-precision, broadband and large dynamic coherent signals. The invention is realized by the following technical scheme: the clock/trigger distribution module provides a down-conversion clock, an acquisition clock and a trigger signal for the radio frequency front end & signal conditioning module and the multi-channel data acquisition & signal processing board card through frequency division/frequency multiplication phase locking; through the combination of a plurality of groups of radio frequency switches, the measured coherent signals which are rapidly traversed and measured are switched and output to a radio frequency front end and a signal conditioning module in a time-sharing way, and the coherent characteristics are measured after the radio frequency signals are subjected to frequency conversion attenuation or amplification for many times; the method comprises the steps of completing calibration of phase inconsistency of self amplitude channels and reporting of measured system coherent characteristics and calibration values through a state machine realized by built-in software, and realizing online rapid calibration of the coherent characteristics of multi-channel broadband signals by combining a signal rapid switching channel and a flow line calibration flow based on the state machine.

title_en: Radioactive substance monitoring device, system and monitoring method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a radioactive substance monitoring device, a radioactive substance monitoring system and a radioactive substance monitoring method. The radioactive substance monitoring device comprises a detector, a positioner and a control module, wherein the detector is connected with a first rotating mechanism, the detector can detect radioactive substances within a preset range from the detector and generate detection signals, the positioner can position the rotating direction of the detector, the control module is communicated with the detector and the positioner, whether radioactive substances exist within the preset range or not is judged according to whether the detection signals exceed a threshold value, and the direction of the radioactive substances detected by the detector is determined according to the rotating direction. The radioactive substance monitoring device disclosed by the invention can monitor radioactive substances and determine the direction of the radioactive substances, and can monitor the radioactive substances in real time and dynamically.

title_en: Simulation box and method for different land soil and underground water salt migration experiment
abstract_en: The invention provides a simulation box and a method for different land soil and underground water and salt migration experiments, and relates to a soil simulation test box. The simulation box can reveal the migration rate and the migration quantity of the moisture among different land types according to the permeability of the soil moisture.

title_en: Digital pathological section scanner
abstract_en: The invention relates to a digital pathological section scanner, which comprises a base, a supporting bar, a main body and a scanning device, wherein a translation mechanism is arranged on the base, a light control mechanism is arranged below the main body, the translation mechanism comprises a fixed bar, a movable block, an object placing piece, a connecting rod, a shifting block and a fixed assembly, the light control mechanism comprises a lamp shell, a power supply, a metal long piece, a plurality of lamp beads and a plurality of contact assemblies, each fixed assembly comprises two fixed units, each fixed unit comprises a sleeve, a fixed plate, a spring, a fixed rod and a pressing plate, each contact assembly comprises a driving unit, a hinged block, a rotating rod, a horizontal rod, a pressing rod and a contact piece, each driving unit comprises a driving motor, a driving rod and a sleeve ring, the digital pathological section scanner adjusts the position of a glass slide through the translation mechanism so as to facilitate scanning, and the glass slide is illuminated through the light control mechanism, meanwhile, the brightness of light can be adjusted, and the usability is improved.

title_en: Metal pipeline characteristic analysis system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a metal pipeline characteristic analysis system, which comprises: the device comprises a current source, a resistor network, a reference board, a differential pressure signal monitoring unit, a differential amplifying circuit, an amplifying circuit based on a chopping technology, a phase shifting circuit, a phase locking amplifying circuit, a digital-to-analog conversion circuit, a main control circuit, a calculation module and an analysis module. The resistance between each measured electrode pair can be directly obtained, and the pipeline characteristics can be obtained through analysis of the resistance network. The electric energy can be saved, the requirements on electronic elements are reduced, and the safety in flammable and explosive environments is improved.

title_en: System and method for mobile environment testing and analysis
abstract_en: Systems, devices, and methods for mobile scientific or measurement platforms are described herein. In one aspect, a mobile scientific platform may include a vehicle having an electrical energy source and a measurement device, such as a mass spectrometer, coupled to the electrical energy source. The input line may be coupled to a measurement device and one or more sample collectors, for example, for obtaining a gas sample. In some aspects, the input line may include a heating element configured to maintain the line temperature at or above the temperature of the collected sample to reduce or prevent condensate formation in the collected sample. In some aspects, the mobile scientific platform may rely on electricity, propane, compressed natural gas, or other similar fuel to operate or switch to operate to enable collection of a gas sample without (or with reduced levels of) vehicle-induced pollution.

title_en: Thermal conductivity measuring device and thermal conductivity measuring method
abstract_en: The method comprises the following steps: a second clamping member for clamping the object to be measured together with the first clamping member; a heating member that has a contact end surface that contacts the distal end surface of the first clamping member with the first shaft correcting member having two opposing surfaces and a distal end surface that is located on the opposite side of the contact end surface, and that heats the first clamping member; a cooling member that has a contact end surface that contacts the distal end surface of the second clamping member with the second shaft correcting member having two opposing surfaces, and a distal end surface that is located on the opposite side of the contact end surface, and that cools the second clamping member; a plurality of temperature sensors disposed on the first clamping member and the second clamping member; and a pressing force applying mechanism for applying a pressing force between the heating member and the cooling member, wherein at least one surface of the first shaft correcting member and the second shaft correcting member is a curved surface having a convex curved shape, and the other surface is a flat surface.

title_en: Robot repositioning method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a robot repositioning method and a robot repositioning device. The method comprises the following steps: and acquiring environment information through the camera and radar data to construct a local map and generate a local information table. Acquiring a global information table corresponding to a global map machine, determining a target local map corresponding to the local map in the global map according to the corresponding relation between the local information table and the global table information, and selecting an effective error area according to an error parameter between the local map and the target local map; and determining target radar data with the highest similarity to the current radar data of the robot by acquiring a radar data set of a plurality of selected pixel points in the effective error area, and finally determining the target pose of the robot according to the target pose corresponding to the target radar data. By applying the method, the current position of the robot can be quickly and accurately positioned, and the robot can be ensured to accurately position and judge the surrounding environment in the working process.

title_en: Method and device for determining household, transformer and phase relation based on neutral point voltage compensation
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a device for determining a phase relation of a user, a transformer and a phase based on neutral point voltage compensation, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a first measurement voltage at a meter; adjusting a first output voltage of a controllable voltage source, wherein a phase angle is the same as that of the phase A, the phase B or the phase C; acquiring a second measurement voltage at the meter; calculating a first voltage amplitude difference; if the amplitude difference of the first voltage is not 0, adjusting a second output voltage of the controllable voltage source, wherein the phase angle lags or leads the phase A, the phase B or the phase C by 90 degrees, and the amplitude of the second output voltage is the same as that of the first output voltage; acquiring a third measurement voltage at the meter; calculating a second voltage magnitude difference; and determining a phase-change correlation according to the first voltage amplitude difference and the second voltage amplitude difference. This application is through injecting voltage at the neutral point, changes the mode of the voltage parameter of circuit, except can effectively confirming the family, becoming the two relation, can also confirm simultaneously the phase difference of unknown strapping table, and this application principle is simple reliable, can effectively solve the family, become, looks three's relation.

title_en: Crop canopy assimilation measuring robot
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a crop canopy assimilation measurement robot, which comprises the following components: the first base beam, the second base beam, the wheels and the box body; at least two wheels are respectively connected below the first base beam and the second base beam; the inner left side box surface of the box body is fixedly connected above the first base beam, and the inner right side box surface of the box body is fixedly connected above the second base beam; the inner left side box surface and the inner right side box surface are fixedly connected with the top box surface, and the inner front box door and the inner rear box door are rotatably connected with the top box surface; the outer left side box surface, the outer right side box surface, the outer front box door and the outer rear box door can extend downwards into soil; a sensor box is arranged in the box body. The crop canopy assimilation measurement is realized in the advancing process of the crop canopy assimilation measurement robot, and the crop canopy assimilation measurement at a plurality of positions can be realized by adopting only one device, so that the automation degree of the crop field in-situ assimilation measurement is improved, the measurement cost is reduced, and the natural growth of crops is not influenced.

title_en: Controllable algorithm for circulating on-off program
abstract_en: The invention discloses an algorithm of a controllable circulation on-off program, which mainly relates to the technical field of a blast furnace feeding system and comprises a setting and resetting control part, a circulation counting part and a circulation control part, wherein the circulation counting part controls a switching value output value so that the switching value output value can be controlled to do the actions of setting at regular time and resetting at regular time in a circulation mode.

title_en: Data processing apparatus, data processing method, and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data processing method, which comprises the following steps: reading a test file related to the test of the piece to be tested; extracting a first scattering parameter file of the to-be-tested part and a second scattering parameter file of the calibration part from the test file according to a preset file identifier; performing de-embedding processing on the scattering parameters in the first scattering parameter file by using the second scattering parameter file to obtain target scattering parameters; and outputting the target scattering parameters. The invention also discloses a data processing device and a readable storage medium. The invention aims to improve the efficiency and the accuracy of the batch de-embedding processing of scattering parameters of electric devices.

title_en: Cable parameter determination method based on phase-mode transformation
