abstract_en: The invention discloses a cable parameter determination method based on phase-mode transformation, which comprises the following steps: s10, acquiring a voltage phase domain equation and a current phase domain equation of a loop where the cable is located; s20, converting the voltage phase domain equation into a voltage mode domain equation, and converting the current phase domain equation into a current mode domain equation; s30, obtaining a voltage calculation formula of the cable according to the voltage mode domain equation, and obtaining a current calculation formula of the cable according to the current mode domain equation; and S40, calculating the mode area voltage of each position of the cable according to the voltage calculation formula, and calculating the mode area current of each position of the cable according to the current calculation formula. By adopting the method, the cable parameters such as the mode domain voltage, the mode domain current and the like at all positions of the cable can be quickly determined, and the determined cable parameters have high accuracy.

title_en: Dry gas quantitative enrichment system and method
abstract_en: According to the dry gas quantitative enrichment system and method provided by the invention, in the quantitative enrichment stage, the closed space in the enrichment system is in a negative pressure state, no requirements are required on the gas quantity and the gas pressure of the gas sample entering the closed space, the experimental analysis requirements of the gas sample with less gas quantity and low gas pressure stored in various modes can be met, and the application range is wide. The quantitative sample injection can be realized by extracting quantitative gas samples into the closed space through a device with scales under normal pressure, in the sample injection analysis stage, the switching pipeline is utilized to switch a path to send carrier gas into the closed space before, and all the gas samples entering the closed space finally enter an analysis instrument along with the carrier gas, so that the accuracy of the sample injection amount of the gas samples is ensured, the relative percentage content of the sample components can be obtained, the molar concentration of the sample components can be obtained, and the data obtained by analysis are more perfect.

title_en: Preparation method of micro-fluidic photo-electrochemical sensor for detecting heart failure marker B-type natriuretic peptide
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of a micro-fluidic photoelectrochemical sensor for detecting a heart failure marker B-type natriuretic peptide. The micro-fluidic photoelectrochemical sensor comprises a micro-fluidic bottom plate, a micro-fluidic upper chip, a micro-fluidic lower chip and a diaphragm between the upper chip and the lower chip. The microfluidic upper chip comprises an electrode groove for placing a counter electrode, a reference electrode, a working electrode, a sample inlet, a micro-channel, a cleaning port and a micro-channel, and the microfluidic lower chip comprises a working electrode groove, a gas valve port and a micro-channel; the photoelectrochemistry three electrodes are integrated on the microfluidic sensor, automatic detection can be realized by using the control of a pump, and an accurate detection result can be quickly obtained without artificial interference. The micro-fluidic photoelectrochemical sensor can realize rapid, efficient, sensitive and automatic detection of the B-type natriuretic peptide.

title_en: Camera with offset structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a camera with offset structure, comprising: the imaging sensor is used for sensing light to be converted into corresponding image signals, and is provided with a sensor plane which is used for receiving the light; a housing for accommodating the imaging sensor; a lens for transmitting light to the imaging sensor; the housing accommodates the imaging sensor, and the lens is mounted to the housing; the sensor plane of the imaging sensor faces the lens; the main optical axis of the lens and the plane of the sensor are obliquely intersected, and the included angle formed by the intersection is 25-85 degrees. The invention has the advantages that: a camera with offset structure is provided, which has a large depth of field and a large clear imaging surface, and improves the shooting effect of shooting an object with surface depth at a short distance.

title_en: Lidar transmitter and detector system for reducing range ambiguity using pulse coding
abstract_en: A lidar system comprising: a transmitter for encoding successive transmit pulses with different pulse characteristics; and a receiver detecting a pulse characteristic of each received (scattered or reflected) pulse and distinguishing the received pulses based on the detected pulse characteristic. Thus, lidar systems address range ambiguity by encoding pulses of scan locations in the same or different scan periods to have different pulse characteristics (e.g., different pulse widths or different pulse envelope shapes). The receiver includes: a pulse decoder configured to detect a relevant pulse characteristic of the received pulse; and a parser to determine whether the pulse characteristics of the received pulses match the pulse characteristics of the current scan position or the pulse characteristics of the previous scan position.

title_en: Test device for preparing sand body in pressure-bearing seepage characteristic state and operation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a test device for preparing a sand body with a pressure-bearing seepage characteristic state and an operation method, wherein the test device comprises a model box, a fixed frame, a connecting roller, a base, a water pressure reading plate, a jacking system, a height adjusting mechanism, a plurality of adjusting bolts, a plurality of pressing plates and a plurality of pressure measuring pipes; the outer part of the model box is provided with a fixed frame, the model box is positioned above the base and comprises an upstream water tank, a downstream water tank, a sand filling box and a sealing plate, a sand body is filled in the sand filling box, the upstream water tank and the downstream water tank are respectively connected with two sides of the sand filling box, the bottom surface of the downstream water tank is hinged with the base through a connecting roller, a jacking system is arranged on the base and used for lifting the model box; fill out the side of sand box and be equipped with a plurality of pressure taps, a plurality of pressure-measuring pipes insert a plurality of pressure taps, and the one end of a plurality of pressure-measuring pipes is located the sand layer, and the other end passes through the hose to be connected with water pressure reading board, and the pressure-measuring pipe is the cavity setting, and the one end that the pressure-measuring pipe is located the sand layer is equipped with the gauze.

title_en: MRI-based two-phase fluid convection mixing experimental method under high temperature and high pressure
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of multiphase flow, and provides a two-phase fluid convection mixing experimental method based on MRI (magnetic resonance imaging) at high temperature and high pressure. The experimental method is used for observing the characteristics of the two-phase convection mixed interface in real time, and breaks through the limitation that the convection process in the three-dimensional porous medium cannot be observed by the original two-dimensional Hello box method and the like. The high-field nuclear magnetic resonance equipment utilized by the invention has the characteristics of accurate imaging and continuous and rapid scanning of the sample. The application range of the selected substitute fluid pair can be popularized to any two-dimensional and three-dimensional device (with/without) porous medium; the method can accurately realize the visual observation of the convection mixing process under the high-pressure condition, is simple and is close to the real reservoir condition. The method is suitable for the interface front observation of the convection mixing process in the three-dimensional porous medium, and the prediction research of parameters such as fingering form, mass transfer between fluids and the like under reservoir temperature and pressure.

title_en: Optical deflection microscopic surface measuring device and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optical deflection microscopic surface measurement method, which comprises the following steps: measuring and calibrating a structural position parameter S of the optical deflection microscopic surface measuring device by adopting three-coordinate measuring equipment; calculating the phase distribution of the deformed stripe optical signal according to the measured and calibrated structural position parameter S, wherein the deformed stripe optical signal comprises the information of the microcosmic surface profile characteristics of the element to be measured; acquiring actual light spot distribution corresponding to the microscopic surface of the element to be detected according to the phase distribution; and comparing the actual light spot distribution with a preset ideal light spot distribution to obtain the microcosmic surface profile of the element to be detected. Correspondingly, the invention also discloses an optical deflection microscopic surface measuring device. The invention realizes the technical scheme of microscopic measurement with high precision, low cost, high spatial resolution and high measurement speed.

title_en: Analysis method of biomarker compounds in crude oil asphaltenes
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for analyzing biomarker compounds in crude oil asphaltenes, which comprises the following steps: extracting crude oil to obtain asphaltene; in the hydrogen atmosphere, leading the asphaltene to have hydrodesulfurization reaction in the presence of a catalyst to obtain a desulfurization product; carrying out asphaltene precipitation treatment on the desulfurization product to obtain a deasphalted product; carrying out column chromatography separation treatment on the deasphalted product to obtain saturated hydrocarbon; and carrying out GC-MS analysis on the saturated hydrocarbon to obtain the biomarker compounds in the crude oil asphaltenes. The method can quickly and effectively analyze the biomarker compounds in the asphaltenes of the crude oil (particularly the biodegradable crude oil and the high and over mature crude oil), and the analysis process is simple. The method widens the analysis method of the steroids and the hopane compounds in the petroleum geological sample.

title_en: Internet-of-things intelligent water traffic running danger assessment system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an Internet of things intelligent water traffic driving risk assessment system, which relates to the field of tourism facilities and comprises the following components: the system comprises a drifting ship body, a first distance acquisition module and a second distance acquisition module which are arranged on the drifting ship body, a third distance acquisition module and a fourth distance acquisition module which are arranged on two sides of a first bend, a GPS module arranged on the drifting ship body and a rear end evaluation platform; the rear-end evaluation platform is in communication connection with the GPS module, the distance acquisition modules are in communication connection, and at least one module is in communication connection with the rear-end evaluation platform; the back-end evaluation platform comprises: the system comprises a ship response module, a drifting ship center solving module, a traveling direction solving module and a risk degree evaluation module. According to the invention, danger assessment is carried out on the drifting ship passing through the curve, so that a tourist attraction management party can effectively know the dangerous curve on the drifting project line, the tourist attraction management party can modify the related drifting curve, and the safety of the drifting project is improved.

title_en: Method and system for filtering thermal image data
abstract_en: A method (1300) and system (1000) for filtering thermal image data are provided. The method (1300) comprises: capturing (1302) thermal image data by a thermal image detector (1110); forming (1304) a signal distribution of intensity values; identifying (1306) a first portion (220) of the signal distribution of intensity values, the first portion being a peak having an intensity width (222) equal to or less than a predetermined intensity span based on a resolution parameter of the thermal image detector; identifying (1307) a second portion (210) having an intensity width greater than a predetermined intensity span; determining (1308) an intensity range between the first portion and the second portion; and filtering (1310) the thermal image data by excluding thermal image data forming part of the first portion if the intensity range is greater than a predetermined minimum intensity range.

title_en: Experimental turning rail capable of realizing multiple working conditions and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an experimental turnover rail capable of realizing multiple working conditions and a control method thereof, wherein the turnover rail comprises a support frame, a turnover body, a first steel rail and a second steel rail, the first steel rail and the second steel rail are mutually parallel and fixed on the turnover body, the turnover body comprises a lifting component, a translation component and a tilting component, one side, close to the second steel rail, of the turnover body is rotationally connected with the support frame, one side, close to the first steel rail, of the turnover body is fixed on the support frame in a lifting mode through the lifting component, and the translation component and the tilting component are fixedly connected with the first steel rail.

title_en: Thermal runaway detection circuit and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a thermal runaway detection circuit and method, and relates to the technical field of batteries. The thermal runaway detection circuit includes: the sensing module comprises a sensing line, and the distance between at least one part of the sensing line and a single battery cell in the battery pack is smaller than a temperature sensing distance threshold value; the detection module is connected with the induction line and comprises at least one group of voltage dividing resistor sets, one end of each group of voltage dividing resistor set is connected with the first power supply end, the other end of each group of voltage dividing resistor set is connected with the ground, and each group of voltage dividing resistor set comprises at least two voltage dividing resistor sets which are connected in series; the processing module is used for acquiring thermal runaway detection data and determining whether the battery pack is thermally runaway or not according to the thermal runaway detection data, wherein the thermal runaway detection data comprise battery pack data and sampling data acquired from sampling points, and the sampling points are arranged between two connected voltage dividing resistor sets. By using the technical scheme of the invention, the safety of the battery pack can be improved.

title_en: Radiation biological dosimeter, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention relates to a radiation biological dosimeter, a preparation method and application, and belongs to the technical field of biology. The biological dose is calculated as SoxR radiation biological dose formed by adding EGFP gene at the downstream of SoxR promoter of escherichia coli or Cda radiation biological dose formed by adding EGFP gene at the downstream of Cda promoter of escherichia coli. The radiation dosimeter can monitor the physical radiation dose on line in real time, and has wide detection and application range; the group effect of microorganisms is used as a biological signal amplification system, and the sensitivity is greatly improved compared with the prior related detection technology; the radiation dosimeter is placed in a microfluidic chip for culture in the later period, online real-time monitoring can be realized, commercial production is realized, the carrying is convenient, the detection is rapid, the cytotoxic substances and the radiation dose in the environment can be provided at any time, and reference is provided for detecting the damage dose.

title_en: Vehicle dynamic tracking method based on current-epipse model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a current-epipse model-based vehicle dynamic tracking method, which comprises the following steps of: s1, deploying an RSUs vehicle wireless positioning system in the GNSS signal limited area to obtain motion observation data of the target tracking vehicle; s2, improving and obtaining a current-oblique movement mathematical model of the target tracking vehicle on the basis of the current model; s3, on the basis of the current-epipse motion mathematical model obtained through improvement in the step S2, an adaptive Kalman filtering algorithm is executed on target tracking vehicle observation data from RSUs, and therefore accurate motion data of the target tracking vehicle are obtained. The invention introduces RSUs for auxiliary positioning, and realizes accurate tracking of dynamic vehicles based on a new vehicle motion mathematical model current-epipse and a fusion algorithm adopting adaptive Kalman filtering.

title_en: Photonic structure for light suppression
abstract_en: The invention discloses an integrated device for parallel analysis of samples and related instruments and systems. The integrated device may include sample wells configured on a surface thereof, wherein individual sample wells are configured to receive samples labeled with at least one fluorescent label configured to emit emitted light in response to excitation light. The integrated device may further include a light detector positioned in a layer of the integrated device, wherein one or more light detectors are positioned to receive photons of the emitted light emitted from the sample aperture. The integrated device further includes one or more photonic structures positioned between the sample wells and the photodetectors, wherein the one or more photonic structures are configured to attenuate the excitation light relative to the emission light such that signals generated by the one or more photodetectors are indicative of detection of photons of the emission light.

title_en: Ionosphere inclination correction system and method based on buoy type double-pass back-tilt detection
abstract_en: The invention relates to a radar detection technology, in particular to an ionosphere inclination correction system and method based on buoy type two-way back-tilt detection, wherein the system comprises a short wave transmitting station and a buoy positioned in an irradiation area of the short wave transmitting station; the short wave transmitting station is used for radiating short waves to a preset area of the ionized layer, receiving coordinate information returned by the buoy and correcting the inclination angle of the ionized layer according to the coordinate of the short wave transmitting station and the relative position relationship between the received buoy coordinates; the buoy is provided with a transponder, the transponder is used for modulating the geographic coordinates of the buoy into short waves and transmitting the short waves to the short wave transmitting station after receiving the short waves transmitted by the short wave transmitting station, modulating the Doppler frequency shift error and/or the short wave time delay information of the measured short waves into the received short waves, and then transmitting the modulated short waves to the short wave transmitting station. The modification system can obtain a more accurate ionosphere inclination angle, and further improves the positioning accuracy of the target to be detected.

title_en: Biosensor, biomolecule detection circuit and biochip
abstract_en: The invention provides a biosensor, a biomolecule detection circuit and a biochip, and belongs to the technical field of biology. The biosensor provided by the invention is provided with a detection area, wherein a comb-shaped first electrode and a comb-shaped second electrode are arranged in the detection area. The plurality of first conductive interdigital parts of the first electrode and the plurality of second conductive interdigital parts of the second electrode are alternately arranged, and the action coefficient of the first electrode and the biomolecule to be detected is larger than that of the second electrode and the biomolecule to be detected. The biosensor also includes a first sensing unit connected to the first electrode and a second sensing unit connected to the second electrode. Since the first electrode and the second electrode in the detection region can react with the biomolecules to different degrees, the detection of the biomolecules can be achieved according to the difference of the electrical signals between the first electrode and the second electrode. And because the first electrode and the second electrode are both comb-shaped electrodes, the occupied space is smaller, and the volume of the biosensor can be reduced.

title_en: Test device for quantitatively simulating inner and outer double-rotor non-centering and coupling non-centering faults
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rotor system fault simulation tests, in particular to a test device for quantitatively simulating the faults of decentration of an inner rotor and an outer rotor and the misalignment of a coupler. The invention aims to provide a test device for quantitatively simulating the misalignment of an inner rotor and an outer rotor and the misalignment of a coupler, and solves the technical problems that most rotating machinery simulation test beds in the prior art adopt a bearing seat and a gasket to carry out misalignment simulation of the coupler, and the simulation precision is difficult to effectively ensure through the design of the test device for quantitatively simulating the misalignment of the inner rotor and the outer rotor and the misalignment of the coupler.

title_en: Laser radar transmitting device and laser radar
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of laser radars, and discloses a laser radar transmitting device, which comprises a laser generating unit and a laser transmitting unit, wherein the laser generating unit comprises a plurality of laser transmitters; a rotation unit including a rotation shaft; a reflector connected to the rotation shaft and having a reflection surface inclined from the rotation shaft; the collimation unit is arranged on the light path between the laser generation unit and the reflector; the laser beams emitted by the laser transmitters are respectively collimated by the collimating units and then are incident on the reflecting surface of the reflector, and the rotating shaft drives the reflector to rotate so as to reflect the laser beams incident on the reflecting surface. The application adopts a reflecting collimating lens system or a collimating system combining a collimating lens and a reflecting mirror, has stable structure, can flexibly design the emergent angle of each laser according to actual needs, and realizes large-view-field scanning in the vertical direction.

title_en: Intelligent flange plate supporting system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a flange board intelligence braced system, including braced system (1), driving system (2), control system (3), driving system (2) set up in braced system (1) lower extreme, control system (3) are connected with driving system (2) electricity, braced system (1) is including setting up base (11) under the flange board, vertically set up in screw rod (12) on base (11) upper portion, bracing piece (13), screw rod (12) transversely set up two at least every line, screw rod (12) vertically set up the triplex row at least, bracing piece (13) transverse connection is in screw rod (12) top with the line. According to the invention, a plurality of screws are arranged in each row to be matched, so that the cross slope can be accurately adjusted; through the matching of the screw rod and the supporting rod, the simple installation is realized, the structure is simple, and the applicability is strong; the screw rod is uniformly controlled through the master control system, so that various functions such as force and displacement control, operation locking, process display, fault alarm and the like are realized, the control is simple and convenient, and the safety is high.

title_en: Raman spectrum-based microorganism single cell growth detection method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a Raman spectrum-based microorganism single-cell growth detection method, which is designed based on a clustering analysis algorithm in machine learning and combines culture time (or OD)  600  ) The method can rapidly and sensitively detect the growth of the single cell of the microorganism without marking, solves the problems of time consumption, complex operation, expensive labor force, sensitive reagent and the like in the prior art, is simple to operate, and is suitable for popularization.

title_en: Adapter device
abstract_en: Provided is an adapter which is used when a radar device is mounted on a vehicle, and which can reduce the installation space for the adapter and the radar device. The adapter according to the present invention is an adapter that is mounted on a mounting portion of a vehicle and holds a radar device, and has at least three female screw portions formed therethrough, and an adjusting bolt having at least three male screw portions formed to engage with the female screw portions, the adjusting bolt having one end rotatably and angularly alterably mounted on the mounting portion of the vehicle.

title_en: Immobilized enzyme electrode, immobilized enzyme sensor and detection method for enzyme membrane anti-interference
abstract_en: The invention provides an immobilized enzyme electrode, an immobilized enzyme sensor and an anti-interference detection method of an enzyme membrane of the immobilized enzyme electrode, and belongs to the technical field of biological sensors. The immobilized enzyme electrode comprises a detection electrode and an auxiliary electrode, wherein the auxiliary electrode comprises a base electrode, an immobilized inactivated enzyme layer and a carrier film which are sequentially connected, and the immobilized enzyme of the immobilized inactivated enzyme layer is an inactivated enzyme. When the invention is used for measuring a sample, the reference values of the detection electrode and the auxiliary electrode are tested, and the detection electrode and the auxiliary electrode correct the fluctuation and the change of the signal caused by interference at the same time, thereby avoiding the interference of the electrode signal caused by the problem of 'integrity' of the enzyme film and improving the measurement accuracy.

title_en: Parameter monitoring method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a parameter monitoring method, a parameter monitoring device and a storage medium, wherein a terminal can be an unmanned vehicle, and the method comprises the following steps: respectively acquiring point cloud data and calibrated parameters of a plurality of radars calibrated on a terminal; based on the calibrated parameters, respectively extracting projection data of the point cloud data of each radar in a preset plane; and analyzing the change information between every two radars in the plurality of radars respectively according to the projection data, and outputting the change information. This application has realized carrying out real-time parameter monitoring to the multi-thread radar of installing on unmanned car, has promoted unmanned driving's factor of safety.

title_en: Bubble defect analysis method based on optical transparent adhesive tape
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optical transparent adhesive-based bubble defect analysis method which can be used for analyzing bubble defects of a sample to be detected. The initial condition of the original bubble defect can be intuitively judged, and accurate guidance is provided for actual production.

title_en: Comprehensive performance test bed for variable-gauge wheel set
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to a comprehensive performance test bed for a variable-gauge wheel set, which is used for testing the comprehensive performance of the variable-gauge wheel set and comprises a portal frame, two groups of wheel jacking and unlocking devices, a rail changing device and a wheel driving device, wherein the portal frame is provided with a plurality of groups of wheel jacking and unlocking devices; the portal frame comprises a base, a stand column and a cross beam; become rail device sets up on the base, includes: the track switching mechanism comprises a track switching driving mechanism, two track bearing mechanisms and two bearing tracks; the two groups of wheel jacking unlocking devices are separated from two sides of the rail transfer device; the wheel driving device is arranged on the first guide rail positioned on the cross beam; when the variable-gauge wheel pair enters the bearing rail, the axle box of the variable-gauge wheel pair is jacked up by the wheel jacking unlocking device; the wheel driving device drives running-in; lifting the wheel jacking unlocking device to unlock the locking mechanism of the axle box, and detecting an unlocking force value in real time; the track-changing driving mechanism drives the two track bearing mechanisms to generate opposite or relative movement along the projection direction of the first guide rail so as to realize track changing and detect a track-changing force value in real time.

title_en: Toxin modification method for solving excessive enzymolysis of insecticidal toxin by insect intestinal digestive enzyme
abstract_en: The invention provides a toxin transformation method for solving the problem that insecticidal toxin is excessively enzymolyzed by insect intestinal digestive enzyme. The specific cleavage site of the insect intestinal digestive enzyme is determined by PeptideCutter or fluorescence polypeptide enzyme activity determination or multiple substrate mass spectrometry (MSP-MS); then, screening a modification site in a toxin non-functional area by combining Swiss Model and PyMOL software; finally, the screened multiple sites are mutated into amino acids which are not recognized by the intestinal protease at the same time. The modification method can simultaneously and accurately mutate a plurality of protease cleavage sites on the toxin, obviously improve the insecticidal activity to target insects, and has the advantages of strong specificity, simple operation and the like. It provides a favorable way for the biological control and resistance treatment of agricultural and forestry pests.

title_en: Airport luggage and personnel double-matching security check management method, device and equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides an airport luggage and personnel double-matching security check management method, which comprises the following steps: collecting passenger face information, identity document information and air ticket information; verifying whether the three kinds of information are consistent; if the check result is consistent with the first check result, checking the consigned luggage to obtain a first safety check result; carrying out security inspection on the passenger baggage and the passenger person to obtain a second security inspection result; if the first security inspection result and the second security inspection result meet the security inspection requirement, allowing the vehicle to pass; collecting passenger image information and recording a passenger moving track; carrying out quantity identification and feature identification on the luggage; and (4) associating the passenger moving track with the baggage quantity information and the characteristic information, and recording the association. By the scheme, the security check process is guaranteed to meet the regulations, the correlation information of passengers and luggage can be recorded in real time, the condition that the passengers lose the luggage and cannot be tracked is avoided, and the security check management effect of passengers in an airport is improved. In addition, the embodiment of the invention provides an airport luggage and personnel double-matching security check management device, equipment and a storage medium.

title_en: Directional ground penetrating radar device for drilling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a directional ground penetrating radar device for drilling, which comprises a control unit, a winch ranging system, a ground penetrating radar antenna system, a rotary inverse compensation system, a cable and a pluggable push rod, wherein the winch ranging system is connected with the ground penetrating radar antenna system; the control unit, the winch ranging system and the ground penetrating radar antenna system are connected through cables, and the winch ranging system is arranged on one side close to the control unit; the rotary inverse compensation system consists of a driving motor, an inner pipe, an outer pipe and two bearings, and the ground penetrating radar antenna system is fixedly arranged on the inner pipe of the rotary inverse compensation system; the device can carry out data acquisition in the hole according to preset angle, can be applied to horizontal drilling and vertical drilling around the geologic structure and the detection of the body of the hidden calamity.

title_en: Chip pressing device and chip pressing device suite
abstract_en: The invention discloses a chip pressing device which is used for being fixedly arranged on a chip bearing device so as to press a chip arranged on the chip bearing device. The chip pressing device comprises: the device comprises a body, a pressing unit and a clamping assembly. The pressing unit is detachably arranged on the body. The clamping assembly is arranged on the body, and the body can be fixedly arranged on the chip bearing device through the clamping assembly. The pressing unit is provided with a contact structure. When the chip pressing device is fixedly arranged on the chip bearing device, the contact structure correspondingly presses the chip. Because the pressing unit is detachably arranged on the body, a user can replace the pressing unit with a corresponding contact structure according to different types of chips.

title_en: Application of alkynyl-containing ruthenium complex as inhibitor or medicine
abstract_en: The invention provides application of an alkynyl ruthenium complex as an inhibitor or a drug. The R2 and R3 polypeptide fragments of neuronal Tau protein are key fragments for Tau protein self-aggregation, which forms neurofibrillary tangles, leading to alzheimer's disease. Experiments prove that the alkynyl ruthenium complex has an inhibition effect on the self aggregation of the R2 and R3 polypeptide fragments of Tau protein; meanwhile, the ruthenium (II) complex has the advantages of low cytotoxicity, stable photophysical property, good water solubility and the like, and the terminal modified alkynyl can promote the binding capacity of the ruthenium (II) complex with Tau protein, so that the ruthenium (II) complex is shown to have a stronger inhibition effect on aggregation of R2 and R3 polypeptide fragments, and therefore, the ruthenium (II) complex containing alkynyl can be used as an inhibitor for self aggregation of R2 and R3 polypeptide fragments of Tau protein and also can be used as a medicament for treating Alzheimer disease.

title_en: Power measurement circuit, method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power measuring circuit, a method and a device, wherein the circuit comprises a magnetic field sensing unit, a first voltage signal generating unit and a second voltage signal generating unit, wherein the magnetic field sensing unit is used for testing the magnetic field of a tested object to output a first voltage signal; the amplifying unit is connected with the magnetic field sensing unit and used for amplifying the first voltage signal and outputting a second voltage signal; the electric field sensing unit is connected with the amplifying unit, takes the second voltage signal output by the amplifying unit as a bias voltage, and is used for testing an electric field generated by the tested object to output a third voltage signal; and the processing unit is used for processing the third voltage signal to obtain the power of the measured object. The power measuring circuit and the power measuring device can finish the success rate measurement of the measured object without performing power failure treatment on the measured object and additionally installing and modifying the measured object, thereby improving the convenience of power measurement and reducing the test cost.

title_en: Correction method and device for laser radar and environment sensing system
abstract_en: A correction method for laser radar and a device and an environment perception system thereof are provided, wherein the correction method comprises the following steps: acquiring point cloud data generated by the laser radar; acquiring an image corresponding to the point cloud data; determining an image area which meets a preset condition in the image based on pixel data of each pixel in the image; acquiring a point data set corresponding to the image area; and adjusting the output laser power of a corresponding transmitting channel in the laser radar based on the pixel data of the image area and the point data set. By adopting the scheme, the quality of point cloud data generated by the laser radar can be effectively guaranteed, the energy consumption of the laser radar is reduced, and the working performance of the laser radar can be improved.

title_en: Intelligent tunnel construction quality detection device
abstract_en: The intelligent tunnel construction quality detection device comprises a main vehicle body, a top detection vehicle, a top detection circuit, a side detection circuit and a wireless control circuit, wherein the main vehicle body comprises an electric drive vehicle, an upright post and an arc-shaped guide groove plate which are installed together, the top detection vehicle comprises a shell, four sets of motor speed reducing mechanisms and guide wheels which are installed together, the guide wheels and the wheels of the top detection vehicle are respectively sleeved in grooves on the inner sides of the guide groove plate, the top detection circuit comprises a first storage battery, a first charging socket, a first power switch and a control sub-circuit and is electrically connected with a photoelectric switch installed on the shell of the top detection vehicle, and the side detection circuit comprises a second storage battery, a second charging socket, a second power switch and a trigger sub-circuit and is electrically connected with a plurality of photoelectric switches installed on the side ends of the upright post. The invention can detect the top and two sides of the tunnel at the same time, stop the main car body after detecting the quality problem, indicate the fault point, and give prompt to the detecting personnel through the short message module at the first time.

title_en: Distance measuring device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distance measuring device, comprising: a support; the laser range finder is arranged on the bracket; a moving member mounted on the support and having a degree of freedom to move in a light emitting direction of the laser range finder; and the probe is arranged at one end of the moving piece, which is far away from the laser range finder. The invention has accurate and comprehensive measurement.

title_en: Aquarium water quality monitoring detecting system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water quality monitoring and detecting system for an aquarium, which structurally comprises an electrolytic box, a water outlet pipe, a filter ring, a water inlet pipe, a valve and a sample extracting system, wherein the water inlet pipe is arranged on one side of the bottom of the electrolytic box, the water inlet pipe is arranged outside the aquarium through the electrolytic box, aquaculture water entering from the water inlet pipe enters an electrolytic tank and is subjected to sodium ion electrolysis, attachments on a positive rod and a negative rod are observed to judge the sodium ion content of the aquaculture water at the level, the electrolyzed liquid is discharged from the water outlet pipe and then enters water at another level, the water is detected again according to the method without being sent to a laboratory, the detection is directly carried out on site, a switching-closing valve is used as a switch extracting pipe of the system to extract samples of the aquaculture water from different water levels of the aquarium one by one time, a main pipe is used as a main conveying channel to convey the samples to the position of the electrolytic box, realize the extraction of aquarium different layers inferior water, detect while extracting, do not need the test tube dress to get, convenient regulation more.

title_en: Cleaning system for full-automatic chemiluminescence immunoassay analyzer
abstract_en: The invention provides a cleaning system for a full-automatic chemiluminescence immunoassay analyzer, which belongs to the technical field of medical instruments and comprises the following components: a frame; the motion module is arranged on the rack and comprises a turntable driven by a motion motor, and an installation groove is formed in the turntable; the liquid injection module is arranged on the motion module and comprises a first lifting structure driven by a liquid injection motor, wherein the first lifting structure is provided with a first liquid injection structure, a second liquid injection structure and a uniformly mixing structure; the imbibition module is installed on the motion module, and this imbibition module includes the second elevation structure through imbibition motor drive, wherein, installs the imbibition structure on the second elevation structure. The liquid injection module and the liquid absorption module share the motion module, and liquid injection and liquid absorption in the corresponding reaction cup are synchronously completed along with rotation of the motion module, so that on one hand, the automation integration level is embodied, on the other hand, the speed of sample detection is accelerated, and the working efficiency is improved.

title_en: Two-port on-chip calibration part model and parameter determination method
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of wafer-level semiconductor device microwave characteristic measurement, and provides a method for determining a two-port on-chip calibration part model and parameters, which comprises the following steps: obtaining a first S parameter by measuring a single-port on-chip calibration part model corresponding to a first frequency band; according to the first S parameter, calculating to obtain the intrinsic capacitance value of the two-port on-chip calibration part model corresponding to the single-port on-chip calibration part model; measuring a two-port on-chip calibration part model corresponding to the terahertz frequency band to obtain a second S parameter; and calculating the parasitic capacitance value and the parasitic resistance value of the two-port on-chip calibration piece model according to the second S parameter and the intrinsic capacitance value. The different two-port on-chip calibration part models provided by the invention solve the calibration and measurement errors caused by imperfect circuit models of the terahertz frequency band standard part, and can improve the accuracy of testing the terahertz frequency band on-chip S parameters; in addition, a calculation method of parameters of different two ports in the chip calibration part model is provided.

title_en: Axial-fixed type prestress controllable vibration excitation method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vibration excitation method and device with controllable axial prestress, and belongs to the technical field of vibration measurement. The invention adopts a coaxial prestress controllable vibration excitation mode, the first piezoelectric stack is a cylinder which is formed by stacking ring sheet-shaped piezoelectric ceramic sheets and electrodes and is provided with a shaft hole in the middle, and the piezoelectric effect is utilized to generate sine-rule telescopic motion to push an excitation table surface to generate sine-rule vibration; the second piezoelectric stack is a cylinder which is formed by stacking a ring sheet-shaped piezoelectric ceramic piece and an electrode and is provided with a shaft hole in the middle, and the first piezoelectric stack generates prestress with controllable magnitude by utilizing the telescopic motion generated by the piezoelectric effect. The invention takes a threaded shaft acted by two piezoelectric stacks together as the extension and contraction generated by the elastic body to generate a vibration excitation waveform with controllable axial prestress, thereby realizing high-quality vibration excitation. The invention can avoid the problem of unbalanced tension and compression load capacity caused by the variation and inaccuracy of the prestress and the like, and avoid the problem of low quality of vibration waveform caused by the unbalance.

title_en: Preparation method of stable circular DNAzyme and its use in Pb2+Applications in assays
abstract_en: The invention develops a preparation method of a stable circular DNAzyme and application thereof in Pb2+ detection, wherein the circular DNAzyme is prepared by self-template closure of dumbbell-shaped single-stranded DNA and synthesis. Because the double chains in the ring structure exist in a stable intramolecular hybridization mode, and the closed ring structure can resist the degradation of nuclease, the DNAzyme has good thermodynamic and biological stability. Next, the reaction is carried out for Pb based on the circular DNAzyme 2+ Is highly dependent (GR5 DNAzyme is only at Pb 2+ Shows catalytic activity in the presence of the lead-acid), combines a terminal transferase (TdT) extension reaction and a T7 Exo-assisted cyclic amplification technology, designs and constructs ultra-sensitive Pb 2+ A biosensor. And is used for Pb in food and environmental samples 2+ The detection result is consistent with the detection result of the ICP-MS instrument.

title_en: Remote monitoring device for gas in dangerous area of working face rock burst
abstract_en: The invention relates to a remote monitoring device for gas in a working face rock burst dangerous area, and belongs to coal mine monitoring equipment. The technical scheme adopted by the invention is as follows: the sampling beam tube is a hard tube, an air inlet at the front end of the beam tube is positioned in a return airway of the working face and is not more than 10 meters away from a tangential coal wall in the return airway, a gas sampling pump is connected to the rear end of the beam tube, a gas outlet of the sampling pump is connected with a tee joint, a laser methane sensor is installed at one gas outlet of the tee joint, and a gas valve is installed at the other gas outlet of the tee joint and is used for manual sampling. The invention has the advantages that: the device has realized the remote monitoring to working face rock burst danger area gas. The problem that personnel must enter into rock burst danger area to carry out gas inspection work is solved, the safety factor is improved, and the personal safety of miners is guaranteed. Use of the malleable material for gas monitoring in other hazardous locations.

title_en: Screen body detection equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses screen body detection equipment, and relates to the field of automatic visual detection. The apparatus comprises: an annular light source, an industrial camera and a detection unit; the industrial camera is used for acquiring a screen body image of the product to be detected when the annular light source is in a lighting state and the product to be detected is in a non-lighting state; when the annular light source is in an unlighted state and the product to be detected is in a lighted state, acquiring detection images of the product to be detected in N detection states; n is a natural number which is more than or equal to 1, and N detection states can be classified into poor defect detection, coaxiality detection and rotation degree detection on the product to be detected; the detection unit is used for carrying out screen body detection on the product to be detected based on the screen body image of the product to be detected and the detection images of the product to be detected in N detection states.

title_en: Pulverized coal block forming device and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a pulverized coal block forming device and a pulverized coal block forming method, which comprise a cylindrical heating furnace body, a rotating arm, a top sealer, a sample introduction lifting ram, a back condenser and a cylinder, wherein the rotating arm is welded and fixed with the upper part of the cylinder, external threads on the lower part of the cylinder are tightly fit with internal threads of a notch on the upper surface of the cylindrical heating furnace body, external threads on the lower part of the top sealer are tightly fit with internal ring threads of the rotating arm, the sample introduction lifting ram is matched with the aperture of an opening on the upper part of the cylindrical heating furnace body, and the back condenser is fixed on the back of the cylindrical. The invention solves the problems of poor safety and high failure rate of the existing thermal state sample preparation process of the coal rock analysis sample, improves the electric heater and the sample inlaying machine into a whole, does not need middle transfer operation, simplifies the steps and is safer.

title_en: Billboard aging detection device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a billboard aging detection device, which comprises a machine body and a striking cavity in the machine body, wherein a first chute is arranged on the bottom wall of the striking cavity, a moving block is arranged on the first chute in a sliding manner, a detection chute is arranged in the moving block, a firing pin is arranged on the detection chute in a sliding manner, a pressure sensor is arranged in the moving block, and a detection spring is connected between the pressure sensor and the firing pin. Thereby reducing the risk of the billboard falling.

title_en: Construction method of epigenetics drug apoptosis induction model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of epigenetics, in particular to a construction method of an epigenetics drug apoptosis induction model, which comprises the steps of selecting epigenetics related tumor cells, adopting cell culture solution to culture in vitro, adding epigenetics drugs with gradient concentration and then culturing; changing the cell culture solution without epigenetic medicine, culturing in a carbon dioxide incubator at 37 deg.C, extracting DNA, performing agarose gel electrophoresis, observing cell morphology by transmission electron microscope, and detecting cell growth cycle by flow cytometry. The method adopts a tumor cell in-vitro culture mode, adds the epigenetic drug with gradient concentration into the culture solution for processing, and establishes an epigenetic drug apoptosis induction model by DNA agarose gel electrophoresis, transmission electron microscopy for cell morphology observation and flow cytometry for cell growth cycle detection, so that the method has the advantages of simple operation and accurate result, and is favorable for guiding the application of the epigenetic drug in tumor treatment.

title_en: Stirring equipment bearing state online monitoring method
abstract_en: According to the on-line monitoring method for the bearing state of the stirring equipment, provided by the invention, the vibration sensor is arranged on the equipment, so that the vibration data of the bearing to be monitored is detected in real time, the abnormal vibration data is found based on the vibration data, and the running state of the bearing to be monitored in a diagnosis period is confirmed; based on the technical scheme, the bearing state of the stirring equipment is automatically monitored on line in real time, the subjective judgment of technicians is not needed, and the result is objective and accurate.

title_en: Big data intelligent air conditioning equipment with household metering function
abstract_en: The invention discloses big data intelligent air conditioning equipment with household metering function, which comprises a display device, wherein a positioning device and a locking device are arranged in the display device; through display device, positioner, measuring device's cooperation is fixed the toper pipe, make the toper pipe can keep absolute vertical state under the effect of gravity, the monitoring degree of accuracy is high, through display device, float the body, locking device, strain device, conversion equipment, electric connection device's cooperation is automatic to be sent accumulated data that accumulative total flow display screen shows to clearing terminal, time saving and labor saving, use cost is reduced, the unusual impact force that the cooperation through measuring device and float the body received to the float the body buffers, make float the body can not be with the second backstop ring under the too fast condition of opening the valve, the second landing leg is crashed and is blocked, service life has been prolonged, maintenance frequency has been reduced, the practicality of this big data intelligence air conditioning equipment with branch family measurement function has been improved.

title_en: Detection apparatus for surface water dissolved oxygen
abstract_en: The invention discloses a detection device for dissolved oxygen in surface water, which relates to the technical field of water quality detection equipment and comprises a box body with a built-in detection tank and a detector for detecting the dissolved oxygen, wherein a water sample to be detected is contained in the detection tank; a water sample feed hopper is arranged at the top of the detection tank, the inlet end of the water sample feed hopper extends to the outside of the box body, and a plugging component is arranged at the inlet end of the water sample feed hopper; and a heating assembly is arranged around the detection tank. The water sample feeding hopper connected with the top of the detection tank is arranged at the top of the detection tank, and the inlet end of the water sample feeding hopper extends to the outside of the box body, so that the water sample is conveniently taken and put; meanwhile, the detection tank is sealed by using the plugging component at the water sample inlet end, and the plugging component is taken down when the water sample is taken and put; in addition, the heating assembly around the detection tank is utilized to heat the water sample in the detection tank, so that the consistency of the temperature of the water sample is ensured. By adopting the invention, the sealing performance and the heating effect of the detection tank can be improved, and the detection precision of the dissolved oxygen content in the surface water can be further improved.

title_en: Auxiliary positioning early warning device for self-elevating drilling platform in place
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-elevating drilling platform in-place auxiliary positioning early warning device, which comprises a supporting pile, a driving motor, a driving gear, a driven gear, a central shaft, a telescopic arm and a manipulator, wherein when a self-elevating drilling platform is in a designed position of a in-place scheme, the rotation, the expansion and the contraction of the telescopic arm and the opening and closing of the manipulator are controlled by a control system, a pressure sensor is started after a hydraulic pincerlike hand grip is meshed with a pile leg of a production platform, in the ship lifting process, no matter the front sliding or the back sliding of the self-elevating drilling platform is performed, when the self-elevating force of the hydraulic pincerlike hand grip exceeds a set limit early warning value, the manipulator is controlled to release, the early warning prompt is transmitted to a central control room of the self-elevating drilling platform, an operator stops the ship lifting, the accurate control of the safety distance between the self-elevating drilling platform and the production platform is realized, and the, the safety of large facilities on the sea is ensured.

title_en: Hydrogen energy automobile motor test bench
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydrogen energy automobile motor test bench. According to the test bench for the hydrogen energy automobile motor, the transmission is loaded between the tested piece and the load dynamometer motor, and the tested piece is a first tested motor or a power assembly. The test bench for the hydrogen energy automobile motor is additionally provided with a speed changer between a tested piece and a load dynamometer motor; the speed ratio can be set to fourth gear: 1: 1; 1: 7; 1: 8; 1:9 (can be designed according to requirements); when the tested piece is the first testing motor, the 1:1 gear is directly selected for testing; when the tested piece is a power assembly; the following 3 grades can be selected for testing as required; the compatibility problem can be completely solved.

title_en: Automatic intelligent boiler drum level gauge of calibration
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of liquid level meter devices, and particularly discloses an automatic-calibration intelligent boiler drum liquid level meter, which comprises a metal cylinder, a calibration cylinder, a liquid level measuring element, a liquid phase pipe and a gas phase pipe, wherein the metal cylinder is connected with the calibration cylinder; the calibration cylinder body and the metal cylinder body are arranged in parallel, the bottom parts of the metal cylinder body and the calibration cylinder body are communicated together through a calibration liquid pipe, and a third electromagnetic valve is arranged on the calibration liquid pipe; the other end of the three-way pipe communicated with the bottom of the liquid discharge pipe is communicated with the bottom of the checking cylinder through a return pipe, and a return motor is arranged on the return pipe; the top end of the liquid level measuring element is connected with an adjusting electric cylinder. The calibration cylinder communicated with the metal cylinder controls the opening of different valves and elements through the controller, so that the calibration is separated from the detection of the liquid level meter, and the accurate calibration of the liquid level meter is ensured; the correction is automatically carried out through the controller in the correction process, manual operation is not needed, and the labor intensity of the project is reduced.

title_en: Time-frequency processing method suitable for rotating blade tip timing signal
abstract_en: The invention discloses a time-frequency processing method suitable for a rotating blade tip timing signal, which comprises the steps of obtaining a sampling signal of the tip timing signal; setting a power spectrum change rate threshold; determining a power spectral vector W (i) (ii) a According to the power spectrum vector W (i) Calculating an autocorrelation matrix R (i) (ii) a Fourier transform F of the acquired tip timing signal (i) Calculating a discrete amplitude spectrum S (i) (ii) a And according to the discrete amplitude spectrum S (i) Calculating a power spectral vector W (i) (ii) a Carrying out F (i) 、S (i) 、W (i) Performing loop iteration, and stopping the loop iteration when the iteration times reach a set threshold value or the power spectrum change rate is smaller than a set power spectrum change rate threshold value; and taking the frequency spectrum signal obtained by the last Fourier transform as a processing result. The method provided by the invention expands the range of analysis frequency, improves the frequency resolution and can accurately analyze the frequency spectrum of the non-uniform and under-sampled blade tip timing signal.

title_en: Early warning method before aflatoxin pollution
abstract_en: The invention relates to an early warning method before aflatoxin pollution. The method comprises the following steps: weighing quantitative samples, carrying out sample toxin extraction to obtain sample extracting solution, carrying out liquid chromatography-high resolution mass spectrometer detection analysis on the sample extracting solution, collecting mass spectrum information, carrying out qualitative analysis according to the mass spectrum information to obtain qualitative results, carrying out quantitative analysis according to corresponding chromatographic peak areas of the qualitative results and an internal standard, and carrying out quantitative analysis based on a chromatographic peak area/internal standard peak area-early warning molecule concentration standard curve of each early warning molecule to obtain the quantitative results of the early warning molecules; and inputting a quantitative result of the aflatoxin production strain early warning molecules by using a classification prediction model obtained by modeling by a chemometrics method based on the content of the early warning molecules as a variable, and outputting a risk evaluation result based on the classification prediction model to evaluate the aflatoxin pollution risk of the sample. Early warning before aflatoxin pollution occurs is realized.

title_en: Image sensor and camera module using the same
abstract_en: An image sensor according to an embodiment of the present invention includes: a pixel array in which a plurality of pixels are arranged in a grid form, and which converts a reflected light signal reflected from an object into an electric signal; an image processor converting the electrical signal to generate a subframe and extracting a second depth information piece having a resolution higher than that of the first depth information piece extracted from the plurality of subframes; and a memory for storing the first depth information pieces, wherein the reflected light signals are input to the pixel array through mutually different optical paths offset in sub-pixel units of the pixel array, and the memory stores a plurality of first depth information pieces corresponding to the mutually different optical paths.

title_en: Ultrasensitive method for detecting mercury ions in water body
abstract_en: The invention provides an ultrasensitive method for detecting mercury ions in a water body, which comprises the following steps: preparing a tapered polymer nano channel; preparing a hybridization chain reaction solution initiated by mercury ions; detecting mercury ions; and (6) data processing. The invention has the advantages of simplicity, rapidness, low cost, high flux and no need of marking according to Hg 2+ Can form a stable T-Hg-T structure with thymine base, designs the principle of specifically detecting Hg 2+ The functional nucleic acid sequence of (2) can realize Hg in water body 2+ The hybridization chain reaction signal amplification technology is combined with the nanopore single molecule detection technology, so that the sensitivity of the detection method is effectively improvedThe sensitivity realizes the ultra-sensitive detection and analysis of the metal ion mercury on the single molecule level, and can be applied to the real-time detection of the mercury ions in the water environment and the research of the toxicological action of the mercury ions.

title_en: Hyperpolarized gas human lung imaging coil for multi-nuclear magnetic resonance system
abstract_en: The invention provides a hyperpolarized gas human body lung imaging coil for a multi-nuclear magnetic resonance system, which comprises a coil plug, an upper coil part and a lower coil part, wherein the upper coil part comprises an upper coil wrapping layer and a plurality of upper flexible coil units arranged in the upper coil wrapping layer, and the plurality of upper flexible coil units are sequentially distributed; the lower coil part comprises a lower coil wrapping layer and a plurality of lower flexible coil units arranged in the lower coil wrapping layer, and the lower flexible coil units are sequentially distributed. The invention has high sensitivity, strong universality for patients with different body types, and convenient installation and use.

title_en: Full-tensor gravity gradient dynamic measurement system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a full tensor gravity gradient measurement system and a full tensor gravity gradient measurement method, which comprise a stable platform, a single rotary accelerometer type gravity gradient sensor, a single relative gravity sensor and a display control computer, wherein the single rotary accelerometer type gravity gradient sensor is fixedly connected with the single relative gravity sensor and is jointly installed on the stable platform, and signal chalk output ends of the single rotary accelerometer type gravity gradient sensor, the single relative gravity sensor and the stable platform are connected with the display control computer and are used for outputting collected horizontal component gravity gradient tensor data, relative gravity data and carrier motion data to the display control computer and calculating full tensor gravity gradient information. The invention can realize the real-time measurement function of the full-tensor gravity gradient information under the movable base by a mathematical decoupling method.

title_en: Method for calibrating and/or adjusting at least one sensor unit of a vehicle
abstract_en: According to the invention, at least one section (A) suitable for carrying out the calibration and/or adjustment is determined along the upcoming road (F) when the need for the calibration and/or adjustment of the at least one sensor unit (2) is detected, on which section the at least one sensor unit (2) to be calibrated and/or adjusted is not required or is at least rarely required or is at least required for the at least semi-automated operation of the vehicle (1), wherein the calibration and/or adjustment of the at least one sensor unit (2) is carried out as soon as the vehicle (1) reaches the determined section (A).

title_en: Fluorescence-radioactivity combined in-vitro targeting screening method
abstract_en: The invention provides a fluorescence-radioactivity combined in-vitro targeting screening method, which comprises the following steps of: binding the drug to be detected on a solid phase carrier, and adding a target molecule marked by a radionuclide and the same target molecule marked by a fluorescent probe; after competitive binding is formed, fluorescence and radioactivity signals are synchronously detected, and two sets of mutually verifiable data results are obtained and used for more accurately analyzing the binding capacity of the drug and the target molecule, so that targeted drug screening is realized. The method can realize single test to simultaneously detect the combined fluorescence and radioactive signal intensity of a plurality of medicaments to be detected, and rapidly and efficiently screen out medicaments with high specific binding capacity to target molecules. The false positive probability can be effectively reduced, and the method has the characteristics of high flux, high accuracy, simplicity in operation and the like. Antibody drugs specifically binding to the target molecule can be rapidly screened out and developed as indications for pre-targeting antibodies for expanding the target radiopharmaceuticals in radiation targeting therapy.

title_en: Threaded hole structure capable of accurately measuring threaded connection state in real time
abstract_en: The invention discloses a threaded hole structure capable of accurately measuring a threaded connection state in real time, which comprises a threaded hole structure, a strain measurement module, a transmission module and a single chip microcomputer module; the thread hole structure increases the diameter of a root circle on the basis of a standard thread hole, so that the major diameter of the thread hole structure is larger than that of the corresponding standard thread hole, a part of thread-shaped space is reserved in the thread hole structure, and a strain sensor is attached to the inner wall of the reserved thread-shaped space; according to the invention, the stress and strain data of the threaded connection can be tracked and measured through the strain sensor tightly attached to the inner wall of the threaded hole, so that the purpose of monitoring the fastening state of the threads in real time and the aim of assisting the space optimization arrangement of the screws are achieved.

title_en: Motor structure for liquid floated gyroscope
abstract_en: The invention relates to a motor structure for a liquid floated gyroscope, which comprises: the motor comprises a rotor assembly, a stator assembly, a motor shaft, a thrust plate, a frame and a buoy; the rotor assembly comprises a rotor ring and magnetic steel; the stator assembly comprises a winding coil and a stator frame, the winding coil is fixedly arranged on the stator frame, and the winding coil and the stator frame are fixedly arranged on a motor shaft through nuts; the motor shaft is fixedly connected with the frame; the buoy is sleeved on the frame; the rotor ring and the magnetic steel are coaxially sleeved on the motor shaft; the magnetic steel is positioned on one side of the rotor ring close to the motor shaft; the rotor ring is of a spherical structure, and the distance between the spherical surface of the rotor ring and the inner wall of the buoy is equal everywhere. The invention can eliminate the air flow disturbance during the operation of the motor, thereby meeting the requirements of random drift and low noise of the high-precision liquid-floated gyroscope.

title_en: Context-aware navigation voice assistant
abstract_en: To provide context-aware audio navigation instructions, a server device obtains a set of audio navigation instructions previously provided to a user, as well as sensor data describing the context in which the audio navigation instructions are provided and an indication of whether the driver responded correctly to the audio navigation instructions. The server device trains a machine learning model using the data, wherein the machine learning model identifies audio navigation instruction parameters for the particular context. In response to the request for navigation directions, the server device receives, from the client computing device that generated the request, sensor data indicative of an environment surrounding the client computing device. The server device then applies the sensor data and the navigation instructions to a machine learning model to generate a set of audio navigation instructions in response to the request. The server device provides the set of audio navigation instructions to the client computing device.

title_en: Magnetoelectric rotation angular velocity and angular acceleration integrated sensor
abstract_en: The invention provides a magnetoelectric rotation angular velocity and angular acceleration integrated sensor, which comprises a motor assembly, an inductance assembly, a first induction voltage output circuit and a second induction voltage output circuit, wherein the motor assembly is connected with the first induction voltage output circuit; the rotor shaft is in transmission connection with the measured shaft at the same rotating speed; the rotor base body is fixed on the rotor shaft, a ring groove is formed in the rotor base body, the stator is fixed in the motor shell, and the inner ring of the stator is sleeved in the ring groove; the magnets are arranged on the rotor base body and positioned on two sides of the annular groove; a first electrode on the outer ring of the stator is electrically connected with the input end of the inductance assembly, and a second electrode on the inner ring of the stator is electrically connected with the output end of the inductance assembly; the first induction voltage output circuit is electrically connected with the first electrode and used for outputting a first induction voltage generated by cutting magnetic lines of force so as to obtain an angular velocity value of the measured shaft. The second induction voltage output circuit is electrically connected with the output end of the inductance assembly and used for outputting second induction voltage induced by the inductance assembly so as to obtain the angular acceleration of the measured shaft.

title_en: Method for rapidly and accurately measuring orientation of crystal axis of gallium oxide single crystal
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of gallium oxide single crystal processing, and particularly discloses a method for quickly and accurately determining the crystal axis orientation of a gallium oxide single crystal, which comprises the following steps: s1, preliminarily judging the direction of a crystal face (010); s2, cutting an initial (010) crystal face to obtain an S2.1 gallium oxide wafer; s3, measuring an initial (010) crystal plane drift angle by an X-ray diffractometer; s4, precisely cutting a (010) crystal face to obtain an S4.1 gallium oxide wafer; s5, determining the (100) and (001) crystal faces of the S2.1 gallium oxide wafer by a cleavage method; s6, determining the [010] crystal axis direction according to the traces of the (100) and (001) crystal planes of the S2.1 gallium oxide wafer; s7, determining the directions of the [001] and [100] crystal axes of the S2.1 gallium oxide wafer by using an X-ray orientation instrument. The method has the advantage of rapidly and accurately measuring the crystal axis orientation of the gallium oxide in any unknown crystal direction.

title_en: Multi-temperature-zone refrigerator car temperature and humidity monitoring system and method
abstract_en: The temperature and humidity monitoring system comprises a data acquisition module, wherein the data acquisition module is installed on the wall of the multi-temperature-zone refrigerator car and comprises at least one data acquisition unit, each data acquisition unit comprises a microprocessor, a temperature and humidity sensor and an LORA communication module, and the temperature and humidity sensor and the LORA communication module are respectively connected with the microprocessor; and the data aggregation module is installed in a cab of the multi-temperature-zone refrigerator car, the data aggregation module comprises a vehicle-mounted terminal, an LORA gateway and a satellite positioning module, the vehicle-mounted terminal passes through the LORA gateway and the LORA communication module, and the satellite positioning module is connected with the vehicle-mounted terminal. The invention also provides a monitoring method of the temperature and humidity monitoring system of the multi-temperature-zone refrigerator car.

title_en: Multifunctional grinding tool quality detection equipment for grinding tool production
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional grinding tool quality detection device for grinding tool production, which comprises a base, wherein a centering clamping mechanism is arranged on the base; the centering and clamping structure comprises: the device comprises a plurality of bearing seats, a screw rod, a small-sized rotating motor, two guide rods, a clamping structure and an expansion structure; the small-sized rotating motor is embedded in the inner cavity of the base, and the driving end is connected to one end of the screw rod.

title_en: Body temperature monitoring method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of communication, and discloses a method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium for monitoring body temperature.

title_en: Rifle system control circuit charges
abstract_en: The invention discloses a charging gun system control circuit, which comprises an AC-DC power supply module, a single chip microcomputer, a controller and a relay control circuit, wherein the AC-DC power supply module is connected with a mains supply to supply power to the single chip microcomputer, the controller and the relay control circuit; the single chip microcomputer is provided with a relay control pin, and the input end of the controller is connected with the relay control pin; the relay control circuit comprises a relay K1, a relay K2, a diode D1 and a diode D2, the anodes of primary coils of the relay K1 and the relay K2 are connected with an AC-DC power supply module, and the cathodes of the primary coils are connected with an output pin of the controller; one end of a secondary coil of the relay K1 is connected with a power supply live wire L, and the other end of the secondary coil is connected with an L-pole output end of the charging gun; one end of a secondary coil of the relay K2 is connected with a power supply zero line N, and the other end of the secondary coil is connected with the N-pole output end of the charging gun. The invention can still drive the switch relay at an extremely low temperature, has good adaptability and is more convenient and accurate to control.

title_en: Construction site dust raising control method
abstract_en: The invention provides a construction site dust control method, which comprises the following steps: (1) setting a fence; (2) covering materials, (3) hardening roads, (4) wet processing, (5) installing dust concentration monitoring equipment, arranging a dust monitoring system at an entrance and an exit of a construction site, detecting dust concentration, environment temperature, humidity, wind speed and direction and the like, transmitting data to a background server, and realizing real-time data online monitoring control; (6) the method has the advantages that the vehicle closed transportation (7) is implemented, the muck vehicle intelligent management system (8) is established, the intelligent bayonet system (9) is installed, the wagon balance system (10) is improved, and the vehicle flushing system is improved.
