title_en: Cable connection detection device for cable installation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a cable connection detection device for cable installation, which comprises a workbench, wherein a lower sleeve is fixedly connected to the top end of the workbench, upper sleeves are fixed to two ends of the lower sleeve through bolts, an adjusting mechanism is installed on the inner walls of the lower sleeve and the upper sleeve, a through pipe fixed to the inner walls of the lower sleeve and the upper sleeve is arranged inside the adjusting mechanism, a first spring is fixedly connected to the inside of the through pipe, a connecting piece is fixedly connected to the other end of the first spring, and transmission wheels are fixedly connected to two sides of the connecting piece. The lower sleeve and the upper sleeve are fixed through bolts, so that the device is convenient to disassemble or assemble; through setting up first spring and second spring for drive wheel and pulley can compress tightly the laminating to the outer wall of not unidimensional cable body, thereby realize this cable body to not unidimensional and detect, improve the suitability.

title_en: Spring detection device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a spring detection device which comprises a detection table, a rotary table, a base plate, a sliding table support, a laser profiler and a linear translation table, wherein the rotary table is arranged on the detection table and used for driving a spring to be detected to rotate, the base plate is arranged on the detection table, the sliding table support is arranged on the base plate, the laser profiler is movably arranged on the sliding table support and used for scanning the spring to be detected, and the linear translation table is arranged on the sliding table support and used for controlling the laser profiler to move along the vertical direction. According to the spring detection device, the turntable, the linear translation table and the laser profiler are combined, so that the whole area of the spring is scanned, all the appearance parameters of the spring can be measured, the distribution change condition of the appearance parameters of the spring along the spiral line of the spring can be monitored, and the high-precision measurement of the spring is realized.

title_en: Remote tower monitoring system
abstract_en: A tower monitoring system for monitoring a remote tower for structural evaluation and analysis. The tower monitoring system includes a sensor unit that receives tower data readings including displacement readings. The sensor unit provides tower data readings to a ground control unit near the tower. The remote server communicates with the surface control unit and includes auxiliary data sources such as historical data for the tower, current or historical data from nearby towers, and nearby weather and geological data. The monitoring system performs a modal analysis to determine a contribution to the displacement readings and alerts an operator when the modal readings indicate structural stresses exceed a predetermined threshold. The data is saved and can be used in trend analysis to check for any changes in tower displacement readings over a period of time.

title_en: Method and device for detecting impulse impedance of grounding grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for detecting impulse impedance of a grounding grid, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a voltage peak value of a grounding grid and a current peak value of the grounding grid; determining the detection surge impedance of the grounding grid according to the voltage peak value of the grounding grid and the current peak value of the grounding grid; and determining the actual impact impedance of the grounding grid according to the detection impact impedance and the equivalent impedance of the test fan, reducing the influence of the inductance of the fan blade and the tower drum on the test result under the condition that the test fan is struck by lightning, and improving the accuracy of the detection result of the impact impedance of the grounding grid.

title_en: Experimental fixing device of vehicle JRS
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fixing device for a vehicle JRS test, which comprises a bracket, wherein the bracket consists of a longitudinal beam assembly arranged from a vehicle head to a vehicle tail, a cross beam assembly vertically arranged with the longitudinal beam assembly and a stabilizing beam assembly positioned at the bottom of the longitudinal beam assembly; the longitudinal beam assembly comprises a first longitudinal beam and a second longitudinal beam which are arranged in parallel and a third longitudinal beam which is positioned between the first longitudinal beam and the second longitudinal beam, the beam assembly comprises a first cross beam and a second cross beam which are positioned at two ends of the longitudinal beam assembly and a third cross beam which is positioned in the middle of the longitudinal beam assembly, and the first longitudinal beam, the second longitudinal beam, the third cross beam and the first cross beam, the second cross beam and the third cross beam are perpendicular to each other and welded to form a grid structure. The rigidity of the fixing device is increased by the aid of a grid structure formed by vertically welding the first longitudinal beams, the second longitudinal beams, the third longitudinal beams and the first cross beams, the second cross beams and the third cross beams; the stabilizing beam component positioned at the bottom of the longitudinal beam component avoids the support from deforming in the test process.

title_en: Method for detecting packaging effect of aluminum plastic film of soft package battery
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for detecting the packaging effect of an aluminum plastic film of a soft package battery, which comprises the steps of preparing a test sample, carrying out tension test on an aluminum plastic film shell sample before aging, preparing a battery cell sample, aging the battery cell sample, finally carrying out tension test on the aged aluminum plastic film shell sample, establishing a standard expression and establishing an acceleration model according to the obtained packaging tension data before and after aging, and further realizing the inspection and judgment on the packaging effect of the aluminum plastic film shell of the soft package battery.

title_en: Composite board bonding strength detection device and detection method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of glass detection, and discloses a device and a method for detecting the bonding strength of a composite plate. The composite sheet is flexible square plate-shaped member, is formed by first plate and the laminating of second plate through wet glue film, detection device includes two line backup pads, two the line backup pad is respectively along longitudinal extension and mutual interval setting, two the line backup pad sets up to can the horizontal support the composite sheet, and makes two of composite sheet indulge the limit symmetry and stretch out correspondingly outside the line backup pad and the natural downwarping extension. By adopting the technical scheme, the joint strength of the composite board can be rapidly and accurately detected on line, the detection result is the joint strength of the composite board, small-size samples are not required to be used for detection, the detection result is reliable, and batch representativeness is high; and the composite boards are not damaged in the detection process, the detection method is simple, and the batch quality of the composite boards can be well monitored.

title_en: Method for measuring installation error of camera of airborne surveying and mapping pod of unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for measuring the installation error of a camera of an airborne surveying and mapping pod of an unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises the following steps: placing a calibration plate on the surveying and mapping ground, and measuring coordinates under a reference coordinate system through a GPS positioning module; the unmanned aerial vehicle carries a surveying and mapping pod to fly over the calibration board from a plurality of courses, and a surveying and mapping attitude angle and a surveying and mapping position coordinate are respectively obtained through an IMU and a GPS positioning module; calculating a coordinate transformation relation between a reference coordinate system corresponding to each photo and a pixel coordinate system according to the surveying attitude angle and the surveying position coordinate; obtaining accurate pixel coordinates of the calibration plate through coordinate transformation and image processing; constructing a coordinate remapping function from a reference coordinate system to a pixel coordinate system, wherein the coordinate remapping function comprises an installation error parameter; constructing a remapping error function by utilizing the pixel coordinates and the coordinate remapping function of the calibration plate; and converting the remapping error function into a nonlinear least square optimization problem, and solving by using a Gauss-Newton method to obtain an installation error parameter.

title_en: Chemical sampling equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses chemical sampling equipment which comprises a sampling mechanism, wherein the top of the outer surface of the sampling mechanism is in threaded connection with a positioning cylinder, the top of the outer surface of the positioning cylinder is fixedly connected with limit ring hooks, the top of the outer surface of the positioning cylinder, which is positioned between the limit ring hooks, is movably connected with an auxiliary arc rod, one end of the auxiliary arc rod, which is far away from the positioning cylinder, is movably connected with a pressure rod, the pressure rod comprises an inner rod, the outer surface of the inner rod is movably connected with a sleeve rod, a contraction ring sleeve is arranged at the middle position of the sleeve rod, the outer surface of the sleeve rod is movably connected with the positioning cylinder, and the outer surface of the contraction ring sleeve is movably connected with the. Through getting rid of to inside air, realize inside vacuum environment, inside air gets into inside the chemical reagent when avoiding the sample, reduces the reaction progress and the speed of chemical, extension operating personnel's reaction time, realizes the protection to personnel and equipment.

title_en: Single portable accuse cable is to traditional thread binding putting
abstract_en: The invention relates to a single portable cable control and alignment device, which comprises a controller and a receiver, wherein the controller comprises a control chip, a power module, a multi-position wiring terminal, a grounding terminal, a power switch and a reset button, the power module supplies power to the control chip, the multi-position wiring terminal of the controller is used as a transmitting terminal, one end of a control cable with a plurality of wire cores is connected with the power module at the same time during working, and the grounding terminal is grounded during working; the receiver includes many binding post, a plurality of pilot lamp and ground terminal, and the many binding post of receiver connect the control cable other end simultaneously as receiving terminal, and the ground terminal ground connection is connected to each way of many binding post after connecting corresponding pilot lamp respectively to during operation forms the return circuit through controller, control cable, receiver and ground net, lights corresponding pilot lamp, realizes the accuse cable to the line. The device is favorable for improving the convenience and the reliability of cable alignment, improving the working efficiency and reducing the labor consumption.

title_en: Sample rack taking-out method, sample processing system and in-vitro detection equipment
abstract_en: A sample rack taking-out method, a sample processing system and an in-vitro detection device, and a selection command of the sample rack is received; receiving a sample rack removal command, determining a selected sample rack according to the selection command, and dispatching the selected sample rack to the recycling area (12) according to the removal command. So that the sample rack which the user wants to take out can be preferentially dispatched to the recycling area (12) without waiting for the sample rack to be sequentially discharged, thereby facilitating timely treatment of the sample rack which the user wants to take out, such as a problematic sample rack.

title_en: Phase control in steering of LIDAR output signals
abstract_en: The chip includes a plurality of guide waveguides on a substrate. Each guide waveguide is configured to carry an output signal. The guide waveguides each terminate at a facet. The facets are arranged such that the output signals leave the chip through the facets and combine to form a LIDAR output signal. The chip further includes a phase tuner located on at least a portion of the guided waveguide. The electronics operate the phase tuner to tune the phase difference between the output signals on adjacent guided waveguides. The electronics tune the phase difference in order to tune the direction in which the LIDAR output signal travels away from the chip.

title_en: Method for simulating and evaluating platelet adhesion in blood contact medical instrument in vitro
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for simulating and evaluating platelet adhesion in blood contact medical instruments in vitro. The method comprises the following steps: (1) simulating the viscosity and the fluid mechanics characteristic of blood by using a glycerol aqueous solution with the mass percentage concentration of 40% in an extracorporeal circulation loop, and adding fluorescent particle simulated platelets with the diameter of 3-5 microns into the solution; (2) after the solution circulates in the loop for a certain time, the overflowing part of the tested artificial organ or medical instrument is detached, and the deposition condition of fluorescent particles on the blood contact surface in the instrument is observed by naked eyes and a photographing mode; (3) the laser induced fluorescence technology is used for shooting laser on the surface of an instrument which is deposited by fluorescent particles and is in contact with blood, and the charge coupled device camera imaging method is used for shooting the aggregation and adhesion conditions of the laser induced fluorescent particles. The method can locate the position of the apparatus where the platelet adhesion and the thrombus are easy to form, and is used for analyzing the structural defect of the position and improving and optimizing the position in time.

title_en: System and method for measuring strain of luminous photoelastic coating based on ratio fluorescence technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for measuring the strain of a luminous photoelastic coating based on a ratio fluorescence technology, which comprises an excitation light wave generating system, a first dichroic spectroscope, a component to be measured, an analyzer, a second dichroic spectroscope, a first emitted light collecting system, a second emitted light collecting system and a data processor, wherein the excitation light wave generating system is connected with the first dichroic spectroscope; the surface of the component to be tested is provided with a luminous photoelastic coating, and two fluorescent materials which can be excited by the same wavelength are arranged in the luminous photoelastic coating; the excitation light wave generating system generates excitation light waves to irradiate the luminescent photoelastic coating, the two fluorescent materials are excited to generate emission light waves, and the emission light waves are separated by the second dichroic beam splitter to form a reflected light beam O Ⅰ And a transmitted beam O Ⅱ The first emission light collection system and the second emission light collection system respectively collect the reflected light beam O Ⅰ And a transmitted beam O Ⅱ And simultaneously transmitting the parameters to the data processor. Has the advantages that: the invention can eliminate the influence of external environmental factors on the measurement result and improve the measurement precision.

title_en: Method for detecting p-aminophenol substances by UPLC-MS/MS
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for detecting p-aminophenol substances by UPLC-MS/MS; the method comprises the following steps: a. determining UPLC-MS/MS conditions; b. respectively detecting the reference solution and the test solution by adopting an ultra performance liquid chromatography-triple quadrupole mass spectrometry (UPLC-MS/MS) method; c. and calculating the impurity content in the sample according to the peak area by an external standard method. The invention provides a novel detection method for detecting p-aminophenol substances, which has the advantages that objects to be detected are mutually free of interference, the sensitivity is high, the accurate detection of 4-amino-3-fluorophenol and 4-aminophenol can be simultaneously realized, and an effective detection method is provided for monitoring the content of the p-aminophenol substances.

title_en: Automatic head changing system and automatic head changing method for three-dimensional measuring head gear measuring center
abstract_en: An automatic head changing system and an automatic head changing method for a three-dimensional measuring head gear measuring center. In the measurement and verification of the three-dimensional measuring head gear measurement center, due to the specification diversity of gears, the detection head needs to be replaced more frequently, and the problems of long measuring head replacement time, low instrument efficiency, irregular operation, replacement failure and the like occur. The invention comprises the following components: the measuring head frame (1) is connected with the measuring head frame connecting plate (2) through bolts, the measuring head frame connecting plate is connected with the upper portion of the cylinder connecting plate (3) through bolts, the lower portion of the cylinder connecting plate is connected with the cylinder (5) through bolts, fixing plates at two ends of the cylinder are respectively connected with a supporting plate A (6) and a supporting plate B (9) of the bottom plate through bolts, a hydraulic damping A (7) and a hydraulic damping B (8) are respectively installed on the outer side of the supporting plate A and the outer side of the supporting plate B, a linear guide rail (4) is installed between the supporting plate A and the supporting plate B, and the linear. The automatic head changing system is used for the three-dimensional measuring head gear measuring center.

title_en: Calibration device and method for torque and stroke measurement system of valve and actuator thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a calibration device for a torque and stroke measurement system of a valve and an actuator thereof, which comprises: an electrically operated valve actuator comprising: the output shaft of the worm wheel is connected with the friction type torque limiter through a torque sensor so as to acquire the dynamic torque value of the worm through the torque sensor; the fiber grating sensor is embedded on the outer peripheral surface of the worm along the axis direction, and the center wavelength of the fiber grating sensor periodically changes along with the rotation of the worm; the rotor outgoing line of the optical fiber rotating slip ring is connected with the tail fiber of the fiber bragg grating sensor, and the stator outgoing line of the optical fiber rotating slip ring is connected with the fiber bragg grating demodulator; the torque signal detection module and the upper computer. The invention can realize the accurate calibration of the measurement of the dynamic torque of the measurement system by measuring the central wavelength of the fiber grating sensor embedded in the outer peripheral surface of the worm under different loads and the output torque of the electric valve actuator in real time, and the measurement system calibrated by the calibration device has the function of anti-electromagnetic interference.

title_en: Three-dimensional detection method and device for water-applying abnormal area
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of underground survey, and provides a three-dimensional detection method and a three-dimensional detection device for a water-bearing abnormal area, wherein the method comprises the following steps: establishing a plane rectangular coordinate system of a target area; the target area is a working surface area to be detected, and a plurality of detection points are preset on the working surface area to be detected; acquiring transient electromagnetic detection data of each detection point; and determining a three-dimensional image of the water-applying abnormal region according to the transient electromagnetic detection data of each detection point and the plane rectangular coordinate system. The invention can intuitively and accurately reflect the spatial distribution and the range of the water supply abnormal area.

title_en: Auxiliary distance measuring device for mounting acoustic pipe
abstract_en: The invention discloses an auxiliary distance measuring device for mounting acoustic pipes, which comprises a sleeve, a protective cavity, a self-adaptive clamping adjusting assembly, a verticality detecting assembly and a laser distance meter, wherein the protective cavity is arranged on the outer side wall of the sleeve, one end of the self-adaptive clamping adjusting assembly is arranged in the protective cavity, the other end of the self-adaptive clamping adjusting assembly is arranged on the sleeve, the verticality detecting assembly is arranged on the lower wall of the sleeve, and the laser distance meter is arranged on the side wall of the sleeve.

title_en: Laboratory test method for sound scattering characteristic of oil spilling under ice based on sound-transmitting floating body mold
abstract_en: The invention provides an under-ice oil spilling sound scattering characteristic laboratory test method based on an acoustic transmission floating body mold, and belongs to the field of under-ice oil spilling disaster detection and underwater target sound scattering characteristic research. The method is characterized in that a laboratory test method for the sound scattering property of oil spilling under ice based on an acoustic transmission floating body mold is characterized in that firstly, an acoustic transmission and low-density material is selected to construct the floating body mold, a sea ice layer is prepared in the mold, the floating body mold is placed upside down in a test water area, oil is injected from the lower part, and a multi-layer medium of sea water-oil spilling-ice layer is established; then designing and testing the water depth to ensure that the width of a transmitting beam is smaller than the dimension of a multilayer medium; and finally, testing the sitting bottom type sound scattering characteristics, and analyzing to obtain the sound scattering characteristics of the multilayer medium. The method has the advantages that the floating body mold is constructed by using the sound-transmitting and low-density material to prepare the multilayer medium of the seawater-oil spill-ice layer, so that the uncontrollable problem of the ice layer and the oil layer in the high-frequency sound scattering characteristic of the oil spill under the ice in a laboratory test is solved, and the acoustic interference of the mold material is avoided.

title_en: Method for measuring and monitoring optical speckle ground stress of hole wall of drill hole
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for measuring and monitoring the optical speckle ground stress of the hole wall of a drill hole, which comprises the following steps: drilling a test hole at the tested point, wherein the test hole comprises a conical hole and a cylindrical test hole section which are arranged up and down; establishing a hole wall speckle field serving as a carrier of deformation information of the surface of the measured hole wall at the complete rock test hole section of the hole wall area; installing an in-hole double-cone reflective camera device in the test hole section, and continuously observing and recording information of an inner cone image and an outer cone image of a speckle field of a hole wall through the in-hole double-cone reflective camera device; converting the information of the inner conical surface image and the outer conical surface image into three-dimensional coordinate information of the hole wall, establishing a hole wall strain field, calculating disturbance stress according to the hole wall strain field, and monitoring the disturbance stress; aiming at the defects of the electrical testing method in the field of ground stress measurement, the digital optical speckle measurement is introduced, so that the problems of the traditional displacement sensor can be effectively improved or solved.

title_en: Airtight box for measurement, airtight device, measurement system, and measurement device
abstract_en: The invention provides a measuring airtight box, an airtight device, a measuring system and a measuring device, which can easily realize the measurement of anaerobic samples under the condition of not contacting with the atmosphere. An airtight device is provided in which an airtight box (30) for measurement is combined with a glove box (20). The airtight box (30) for measurement is provided with a frame body (31) with a hollow interior and a sample table (34) with a sample loading part. The sample stage (34) is conveyed by a conveying stage (35) provided in the frame (31). A measurement window (40) for measuring a sample loaded on the sample stage (34) from the outside by the measurement device (10) is provided in the housing (31).

title_en: Landslide deformation monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of landslide deformation monitoring, in particular to a landslide deformation monitoring system which comprises a row of guardrails arranged on one side of a slope, wherein water pipes are arranged at the upper ends of the guardrails, the water pipes are communicated with one another, water is arranged in the water pipes, sleeve pipes are sleeved outside a plurality of water pipes in the row of guardrails, the top surfaces and the bottom surfaces of the water pipes protrude outwards to form parallel parts, the opening ends of the sleeve pipes are bent inwards to form parallel sealing parts, more than one water outlet hole is vertically arranged on the bottom surfaces of the parallel parts at the lower ends, the water outlet holes are sealed through the sealing parts, a water level sensor is arranged in one of the water pipes of the row of guardrails, and audible and visual alarms are arranged on the water pipes. The device is simple in structure, and is combined with the guardrails according to the condition that the guardrails are arranged on the two sides of the road, so that the whole guardrail can synchronously play a warning role after a landslide is monitored, subsequent vehicles can quickly avoid the lane, and the safety and the comprehensiveness are greatly improved.

title_en: Three-wheeled ground reference station based on Beidou navigation system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-wheeled ground reference station based on a Beidou navigation system, which comprises twenty ground reference receivers, wherein the four ground reference receivers b11, b12, b13 and b14 are sequentially arranged on the circumferences of circles A corresponding to 45 degrees, 135 degrees, 225 degrees and 315 degrees in a counterclockwise order; b22, B23, B24, B25, B26, B27, B28 and B21 are sequentially arranged on the circumference of the circle B, which is corresponding to the left, the south, the west and the north of the circle B, and is offset by 22.5 degrees respectively; b33, b35, b37, b31, b36, b38, b34 and b32 are sequentially arranged on the circumferences of the east, the west, the south and the north of the circle C and the left and the right of the circle C which are respectively deviated by 45 degrees in a counterclockwise sequence. The invention combines the interpolation method with the layout design scheme of the three-wheeled reference station, and can effectively improve the utilization rate of the airspace of the airport, the approach grade and the approach efficiency.

title_en: Active drug dissolution precipitate acquisition device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of drug analysis and detection, in particular to an active drug dissolution precipitate acquisition device, wherein a stirring device comprises a fixed seat, a transfer ball, a power end and a stirring rod; the stirring rod comprises an inner tube and an outer tube, the top end of the outer tube penetrates through the transfer ball, so that the outer tube and the transfer ball rotate synchronously relative to the fixed seat, and the bottom end of the inner tube extends into the dissolving container; the top end of the outer pipe is connected with the power end through a spherical hinge and moves in a circular track in a horizontal plane under the driving of the power end, and the rotating center of the top end of the outer pipe and the rotating center of the transfer ball are on the same longitudinal axis; the outer pipe end is provided with a cavity, a spring is arranged in the cavity, and the inner pipe stretches into the cavity to extrude the spring. According to the invention, the stirring process is more uniform and stable, relatively consistent stirring behaviors can be obtained when sediment is measured under different stirring time, the relation between the stirring time and the sediment amount is established under relatively uniform standard, and the accuracy of measurement is ensured.

title_en: AGV multi-spectrum color-differentiation tracking navigation and shape-color positioning method based on visual recognition technology
abstract_en: The application relates to an AGV multi-spectrum color-discrimination tracking navigation and shape and color positioning method based on a visual identification technology, which comprises the following steps: constructing a longitudinal and transverse grid type AGV running network, constructing a plurality of longitudinal color bands by adopting a first color mark, constructing a plurality of transverse color bands by adopting a second color mark, respectively constructing the longitudinal color bands and the transverse color bands in a crossing way to form the longitudinal and transverse grid type AGV running network, wherein the intersection points or specific position points of the longitudinal color bands and the transverse color bands are marked by specific shapes of the longitudinal and transverse color bands, have the shape and color, and are intersection position points or specific position points; in the AGV navigation operation process, the operation route of the AGV is determined through spectral color visual identification of the longitudinal color bars and the transverse color bars, and the intersection and the position information of the AGV are determined through visual identification of the position information marked in a shape-color combined mode. And the AGV runs to a preset end point according to the determined running route, the intersection and the position information. The application is applied to the technical field of AGVs.

title_en: Electric power intelligent detection equipment for adjusting noise receiving position in real time
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power equipment and discloses electric power intelligent detection equipment for adjusting noise receiving positions in real time. This electric power intellectual detection system equipment of noise sound receiving position is adjusted in real time, through screw rod circular telegram anticlockwise rotation and drive main part synchronous motion, the screw rod drives the main part gradually and rotates, the main part anticlockwise rotates along with it and drives the motion of amortization piece, the amortization piece carries out preliminary elimination to the noise of inside, the main part drives effect piece anticlockwise rotation, effect piece anticlockwise rotation and little effect pole interact, little effect pole produces certain wave band, carry out real-time detection to equipment inside through the effect piece, then make equipment have certain detection function, adjust the sound receiving to the noise, the operation mode is also very simple relatively.

title_en: Precise diagnosis method for complex faults of gearbox
abstract_en: The invention discloses a precise diagnosis method for complex faults of a gear box, which comprises the steps of firstly, carrying out noise reduction pretreatment on an original vibration signal measured by a sensor; secondly, using a kurtosis comparison function as an index, and carrying out normalization treatment; optimizing a normalized kurtosis comparison function based on an optimal step gradient descent method, and realizing self-adaptive updating of a separation filter; then, a wiener filter is constructed to separate a required single fault signal from an observation signal, so that the effective extraction of the single fault of the gear box is realized; and finally, improving a signal structure through an autocorrelation function, highlighting fault characteristic frequency in a signal, and realizing accurate detection of the composite fault type of the gear box. The invention can effectively extract the single fault vibration signal of the gear, has the function of data optimization, and can realize the accurate detection of complex faults of the gear box.

title_en: Gas concentration detection device and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gas concentration detection device and a control method thereof, wherein the gas concentration detection device comprises a light source module, a gas chamber module, an infrared thermopile module and a signal processing module, wherein the light source module and the infrared thermopile module are both arranged on the signal processing module, and the gas chamber module is arranged above the signal processing module. According to the gas concentration detection device, the light source module is used for generating infrared light and transmitting the infrared light to the gas chamber module, the gas chamber module is used for absorbing the infrared light by utilizing the gas to be detected inside and reflecting the infrared light to the infrared thermopile module, the infrared thermopile module is used for detecting the infrared light intensity absorbed by the gas to be detected and outputting corresponding voltage signals to the signal processing module, and the signal processing module is used for calculating the concentration of the gas to be detected according to the voltage signals, so that a user can directly measure the concentration of the gas, the concentration measurement requirements of different gases are met, a great amount of time is not consumed by the user to learn related principles, the project development efficiency is improved, and the development time is shortened.

title_en: Optical fiber FP resonant cavity temperature sensor and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optical fiber FP resonant cavity temperature sensor and a manufacturing method thereof. The optical fiber FP resonant cavity temperature sensor comprises an optical fiber FP resonant cavity, a first protective tube is sleeved outside the optical fiber FP resonant cavity, one end of the first protective tube close to the reflection end of the optical fiber FP resonant cavity is sealed, and a heat-conducting medium is filled in the first protective tube; the first protection tube is fixedly connected to the connecting seat, the second protection tube sleeved with the hollow-out part outside the first protection tube is fixedly arranged on the connecting seat, the connecting seat is connected with the optical fiber protection sleeve, and the incident optical fiber of the optical fiber FP resonant cavity is arranged on the optical fiber protection sleeve. The temperature monitoring system can realize the temperature monitoring of oceans, underground spaces and the like which need long-term, high precision, high sensitivity and quick response, and has the advantages of electromagnetic interference resistance, high stability and the like. The manufacturing method of the optical fiber FP cavity temperature sensor can realize convenient manufacturing of the optical fiber FP resonant cavity temperature sensor.

title_en: Engine oil seal tightness detection device
abstract_en: The device for detecting the sealing performance of the engine oil seal capable of realizing quick, accurate, efficient and large-batch detection comprises a pressure head, an ejector block and an external floating part, wherein the ejector block is fixed between an air cylinder output end and the pressure head, a first O-shaped ring is sleeved at the bottom of the outer side of the pressure head, a circle of convex edge is arranged on the bottom surface of the pressure head, a steel ring is sleeved outside the convex edge, a second O-shaped ring is arranged in a gap between the steel ring and the convex edge, the floating part comprises a casing and a partition plate positioned in the casing, a plurality of first reset springs are arranged between the partition plate and the upper surface of the pressure head, the partition plate divides the inner space of the casing into an upper part and a lower part, the pressure head is positioned at the lower part of the casing, the ejector block is positioned at the upper part of the casing, a first closed space is formed between the ejector block and the partition plate, a first air, the second suction nozzle is connected to the airtightness detector, and the air outlet is located between the raised edge and the convex edge.

title_en: Method for automatically calculating stray inductance of IGBT module loop
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for automatically calculating stray inductance of an IGBT module loop, which comprises the steps of setting a device for testing, adjusting an adjustable direct-current power supply to enable the voltage at two ends of a supporting capacitor to reach Udc, applying negative voltage signals to g and e ends of non-tested IGBTs, applying pulse signals to g and e ends of the tested IGBT, monitoring the state of the current conversion process of the tested IGBT, intercepting two adjacent pulse waveforms, and ending after the turn-off process of a first pulse and the turn-on process of a second pulse; extracting data of voltage Vce and current Ic in the moment of the turn-off process and the turn-on process of the generated waveform, respectively performing integration processing on the difference value of the voltage and the reference voltage in the moment of the process, and then respectively performing data fitting processing on the difference value and the corresponding current Ic to obtain a fitted slope K; k is stray inductance; stray inductance of the IGBT loop in the switching-on process and the switching-off process can be accurately calculated, the stray inductance calculated in the two processes is high in matching degree, and deviation is within 6%.

title_en: Monitoring method of liquid cooling charging cable, liquid cooling charging cable and charging station
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for monitoring a liquid-cooled charging cable of a charging station for a traction battery of an electrically driven motor vehicle, wherein a minimum permissible bending radius of the charging cable is detected and a user or a charging point operator or a service worker is notified of the minimum permissible bending radius.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted detection device based on machine vision and 5G network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vehicle-mounted detection device based on machine vision and a 5G network, which comprises a calculation unit, a transmission unit and a power distribution unit, wherein the power distribution unit comprises a power distribution transmission module, a power distribution analysis module and a POE power supply module, the power distribution transmission module comprises an LM317 voltage stabilizer, eight resistors R1-R8, six triodes, two capacitors C1, C2 and a direct current power supply VCC, the six triodes are mutually connected in parallel, the resistor R7 is connected between the No. 2 end and the No. 1 end of the LM317 voltage stabilizer in parallel, the No. 1 end of the LM317 voltage stabilizer is grounded through a resistor R8, the No. 3 end of the LM317 voltage stabilizer is connected with a vehicle-mounted power supply VCC _ in, the No. 3 end of the LM317 voltage stabilizer is grounded through a capacitor C1, and the power distribution. The device does not reform transform the car power, can avoid manual operation to realize detecting simultaneously, and is convenient simple.

title_en: Heat meter with defrosting function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heat meter with a defrosting function, which comprises a first flow channel positioned underground, wherein the tail end of the upper side of the first flow channel is communicated with a second flow channel, the first flow channel is positioned in the middle of the second flow channel, the left end and the right end of the second flow channel are respectively communicated with a first cavity, a thawing device capable of helping an automobile to defrost is arranged in each first cavity, the thawing device comprises two first sliding chutes which are arranged in the bottom wall of the first cavity and are symmetrically distributed front and back, and the heat meter is integrated in a parking space and can thaw the automobile; the invention can automatically detect the distance between the automobile and the inner water outlet, and automatically adjust the position of the inner integrated block according to the distance, thereby preventing the waste of unfreezing water caused by the too long distance of the automobile; the invention is provided with the heat meter which can detect the amount of the defrosting water, so that the defrosting charging is more reasonable and standard.

title_en: Electricity stealing detection method and device, electricity stealing prevention device and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electricity stealing detection method and device, an electricity stealing prevention device and a readable storage medium. The method is applied to the electricity stealing prevention device, the electricity stealing prevention device is in communication connection with the remote background monitoring center, and the method comprises the following steps: when a remote control instruction sent by a remote background monitoring center is not detected, acquiring magnetic field intensity information around an ammeter box; judging whether the current magnetic field strength exceeds a magnetic field threshold value according to the magnetic field strength information; if the current magnetic field strength is judged not to exceed the magnetic field threshold, acquiring current motion information of the electric meter box; and judging whether the current acceleration amplitude exceeds an acceleration threshold value according to the current motion information, and executing corresponding processing operation according to a judgment result. The invention considers the normal condition of the electric meter box in daily routing inspection, and accurately identifies whether the current electric meter box is operated for electricity stealing operation or not by preferentially detecting whether the remote control instruction exists or not, thereby avoiding unnecessary early warning response of an electricity stealing prevention device.

title_en: Research method for influence degree of sulfur hexafluoride breaker arc discharge decomposition product on nozzle material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a research method for the influence degree of arc discharge decomposition products of a sulfur hexafluoride breaker on a nozzle material, and belongs to the technical field of electric power. According to the research on the influence degree of the sulfur hexafluoride circuit breaker arc discharge decomposition product on the spout material, the isotope tracing technology is utilized to mark key elements in the polytetrafluoroethylene material, the spout material is made into a spout and placed into the sulfur hexafluoride circuit breaker for a breaking test, and then the analysis equipment is utilized to measure the type, content and concentration ratio of the product containing the isotope mark in the sulfur hexafluoride circuit breaker arc discharge decomposition product, so that the research on the influence degree of the sulfur hexafluoride circuit breaker arc discharge decomposition product on the spout material is realized. The research method solves the problems of tracking and tracing the reaction path of the damage of the nozzle material of the circuit breaker under the arc discharge working condition, and is SF 6 Circuit breaker operating condition evaluation or fault diagnosis provides important data support.

title_en: Electroplating detection system for conductive terminal of connector
abstract_en: The application relates to an electroplating detection system of a conductive terminal of a connector, which comprises an electroplating bath and a detection table, wherein a conveying conversion device is arranged between the detection table and the electroplating bath, and the detection table is provided with a detection device; the conveying conversion device comprises a power mechanism for driving the intermittent conveying of the material belt and a material belt temporary storage mechanism for temporarily storing the material belt, wherein the material belt temporary storage mechanism comprises a temporary storage frame and two material rollers, and the material belt sequentially bypasses the two material rollers; the material rollers are arranged on the temporary storage frame in a lifting manner, four groups of emergency back mechanisms for driving the two material rollers to lift along the directions close to each other or away from each other are arranged on the temporary storage frame, and an adjusting mechanism is further arranged on the temporary storage frame and is positioned between the two material rollers. According to the application, the continuous conveying mode of the material belt is converted into the intermittent conveying mode by the cooperation of the conversion device and the power mechanism, so that the conductive terminal is convenient to detect, the material belt is not required to be detected after being collected, the detection steps are simplified, and the manpower and material resources are reduced.

title_en: Underwater sound array signal direction-of-arrival estimation method based on wavelet transformation and convolutional neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underwater acoustic array signal direction-of-arrival estimation method based on a wavelet transform and convolution neural network, and belongs to the field of direction-of-arrival estimation technology in the field of underwater acoustic array signal processing. Firstly, constructing a time-frequency array model based on wavelet transformation according to underwater acoustic signals acquired by a receiving end; then improving the covariance matrix characteristic, and reducing the input dimensionality of the neural network; and finally, training a direction-of-arrival estimation model based on the double-branch convolutional neural network, and accurately acquiring the direction of arrival of the underwater sound signal. The method can effectively inhibit the influence of noise and time-varying characteristics on the signal in the complex marine environment, solve the problem of performance degradation of a common angle of arrival estimation method in the complex marine environment, and obtain a more accurate target incident angle.

title_en: Portable wind turbine generator system's fault detection device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fault detection device of a portable wind turbine generator, which comprises a fault detection box, wherein a movable hole extending to the inner cavity of the fault detection box is formed in the central position of the bottom of the fault detection box, fixed vertical plates are symmetrically welded at the left side and the right side of the bottom of the inner cavity of the fault detection box, two groups of fixed vertical plates are respectively arranged at the left side and the right side of the movable hole, winding shafts penetrating through the fixed vertical plates are respectively connected at the upper end positions inside the two groups of fixed vertical plates in a rotating mode through bearings, winding shafts are fixedly sleeved at the middle positions outside the winding shafts, and the winding shafts are arranged at positions between the two groups of fixed vertical plates. This portable wind turbine generator system's fault detection device starts positive and negative motor through the PLC controller and drives take-up spool and rolling dish synchronous rotation and then makes magnetism hammer out go into in the lubricating oil, makes the iron fillings adsorb on the magnetism hammer under the magnetism effect of magnetism hammer, detects the content of iron fillings in the lubricating oil and then judges whether to need change lubricating oil through observing, weighing the quality of iron fillings.

title_en: Deep learning-based route planning method and system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a route planning method and a route planning system based on deep learning, wherein a first dynamic navigation initial route to be planned and a first non-dynamic navigation initial route to be planned are formed, then complete first route planning data to be planned are synthesized, other set navigation route node information of the dynamic navigation initial route to be planned and the non-dynamic navigation initial route to be planned are respectively extracted, a second dynamic navigation initial route to be planned and a second non-dynamic navigation initial route to be planned are formed, complete second route planning data to be planned are synthesized, and the first route planning data to be planned and the second route planning data to be planned are outputted in a time-sharing mode and then uploaded to a corresponding planning route library. Therefore, the route planning precision and the route planning efficiency can be improved by distinguishing the dynamic navigation initial route and the non-dynamic navigation initial route and carrying out the operation of route planning data on the basis of real time and fixation.

title_en: Graphene-niobium pentoxide-based all-solid-state ion selective electrode and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a graphene-niobium pentoxide-based all-solid-state ion selective electrode and a preparation method and application thereof. According to the invention, the graphene-niobium pentoxide nanocomposite is used as a solid transduction layer material to construct the all-solid-state ion selective electrode, so that the formation of a water layer can be eliminated, the anti-interference capability on interference factors such as gas and the like is good, the interface capacitance is obviously improved, and the potential stability of the solid-state ion selective electrode is enhanced.

title_en: Real-time monitoring device and method for welding quality of large component of crude oil transfer barge
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a method for monitoring the welding quality of a large component of a crude oil transfer barge in real time, which belong to the field of the construction of crude oil transfer barges and comprise a welding trolley, a welding controller, a pulse laser, a polishing laser, a laser interferometer, an industrial personal computer and a trolley driving mechanism; the polishing laser is used for carrying out laser polishing treatment on the surface of the welding seam; the laser interferometer is used for projecting detection laser, and the industrial personal computer is used for identifying internal defects and surface defects of the welding component. The welding controller, the pulse laser, the polishing laser and the laser interferometer are arranged on the welding trolley, so that the welding components and the welding seams formed by welding are detected in real time in the automatic welding process, the working efficiency is improved, the problems of low welding efficiency and low welding quality in the construction of the existing crude oil transfer ship are solved, the construction period of the ship is shortened, the welding quality is improved, and repair is avoided.

title_en: Signal identification method and device for vehicle-mounted range radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a signal identification method and a device for a vehicle-mounted range radar, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a plurality of sampling signals, wherein each sampling signal is a target echo signal or an interference signal; processing each sampling signal to obtain a plurality of processed signals; performing Fourier transformation on each processed signal to obtain amplitude-frequency response information corresponding to each sampling signal; determining a feature vector corresponding to each sampling signal according to the amplitude-frequency response information; training a classification vector machine by utilizing the feature vector; and identifying the received signals by using the trained two-classification vector machine so as to determine whether the received signals belong to the target echo signals or the interference signals.

title_en: Jig for observation
abstract_en: The invention provides an observation jig for easily observing the side surface of a chip such as a packaged device chip. The observation jig (2) comprises: a stage (4) having an adhesive layer (10) on the front surface thereof for holding a chip (34); a frame (6) having a through opening (20) formed corresponding to the back surface of the table (4), the frame (6) supporting the table (4) so as to be rotatable from a lying state to a standing state; and a base (8) having a projection (30), wherein the projection (30) is inserted into the through-hole (20) and the base (4) is set from a lying state to a standing state.

title_en: Circuit fault detection for diode arrays
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a method for detecting circuit faults of a diode array. The device comprises: a diode array; and a diode array test circuit electrically coupled to the diode array and operable to perform circuit fault detection during a test mode in which a test input voltage is applied, the diode array test circuit including an input resistor, an input voltage node, a buffer amplifier circuit, and a plurality of amplifier circuit switches. The apparatus further includes a current detector electrically coupled to the output of the buffer amplifier circuit and operable to determine a current measurement of the pulsed laser diode array during the test mode.

title_en: Measuring equipment for measuring anti-embolism degree of plant xylem by using pneumatic method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a measuring device for measuring the anti-embolism degree of a plant xylem by using a pneumatic method, which comprises an air pressure control circuit, a detection object, a signal acquisition circuit, a power supply circuit, a communication circuit, a mobile device, a clock signal generation circuit, a working state indicating circuit, an SD card module and a single chip microcomputer U. And a complete embolism vulnerability curve can be constructed by measuring one sample, so that the determination efficiency is improved, and the potential error among plant individuals is reduced. The device has excellent economical efficiency while ensuring high precision of measurement, and can greatly reduce the economic cost of measurement compared with the measurement by using devices such as a CT machine, a centrifugal machine and the like.

title_en: Test method for testing cross-connection performance of cables in laying site
abstract_en: The invention provides a test method for cross interconnection performance test of cables laid on site, which comprises the steps of arranging a test power supply, wherein the test power supply is used as a power supply for performance test and loop resistance measurement of a cable metal sheath cross interconnection grounding system; applying three-phase power frequency alternating current to a cable core of the cable metal sheath cross interconnection grounding system by using three-phase alternating voltage output by the test power supply, measuring induced voltage and circulating current of the metal sheath in the cable metal sheath cross interconnection grounding system, and realizing the performance inspection of the cable metal sheath cross interconnection grounding system; and applying the direct-current voltage output by the test power supply to two ends of the cable metal sheath cross-connection grounding system, and measuring the loop resistance of the cable metal sheath cross-connection grounding system. The invention solves the problem that the test for testing the cross interconnection performance of the cable lines of 110kV and above is difficult to implement on the laying site, can carry out site test on the system performance and ensures stable, reliable and safe power supply.

title_en: Method for determining substrate temperature in molecular beam epitaxy equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for determining the temperature of a substrate in molecular beam epitaxy equipment, and relates to the technical field of semiconductor manufacturing. The method comprises the following steps: establishing a linear temperature model for representing the relation between the measured temperature of the thermocouple and the actual temperature of the substrate; calculating a determination constant a; obtaining a thermocouple temperature T when the substrate oxide layer is desorbed; calculating a determination constant b; the calculation determines the actual temperature of the corresponding substrate at any of the measured temperatures of the thermocouples. The method comprises the steps of setting two thermocouples in a molecular beam epitaxy device, solving a model by utilizing the actual measured temperatures of the two thermocouples and the actual desorption temperature of the substrate, and calculating the actual temperature of the substrate based on the model and the actual measured temperatures of the thermocouples. The method can establish a relation model between the actual temperature of the thermocouple and the actual temperature of the substrate only by providing the desorption temperature of the oxide layer of the substrate, avoids introducing other factors related to the test conditions into the model, and can realize high-precision measurement of the actual temperature of the substrate.

title_en: Safe and energy-saving power storage battery nuclear capacity discharging device and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a safe and energy-saving power storage battery nuclear capacity discharging device and method, and relates to the technical field of power detection equipment; the device comprises a controller, an optical coupler, a diode, a direct current contactor, a power conversion unit, a voltage acquisition unit and a current acquisition unit, wherein the voltage acquisition unit and the current acquisition unit are respectively and electrically connected with the controller; the method comprises the steps that a controller triggers a direct-current contactor to be disconnected through an optical coupler, the controller generates a boosting instruction and sends the boosting instruction to a power supply conversion unit, the power supply conversion unit receives the boosting instruction and boosts the output voltage of the power supply conversion unit, and the output voltage of the power supply conversion unit is higher than the output voltage of a charger and discharges; the working efficiency of the storage battery is high through the controller, the optical coupler, the diode, the direct current contactor, the power conversion unit, the voltage acquisition unit, the current acquisition unit and the like.

title_en: Distance measurement method based on double lasers
abstract_en: The invention provides a distance measuring method based on double lasers, which comprises the following steps: adjusting the laser range finder to a horizontal state; placing a laser ranging board at a first position in front of a laser ranging instrument, obtaining a distance FB from a first laser ranging module at the first position to a laser testing board, obtaining a distance GC from a second laser ranging module to the laser testing board, and obtaining a distance BC, wherein the first laser ranging module and the second laser testing module form a vertex A; calculating the values of AF and AG; solving an angle value of the angle FAG; further obtaining the values of AB and AC; according to the value, the distance AH from the point A to the point BC can be obtained; the laser range finder is moved to a position to be tested, so that the testing distance can be obtained; the distance data collected by the distance measuring device is more accurate.

title_en: Gold/copper double-metal nano-cluster fluorescent probe, preparation method thereof and histidine detection application
abstract_en: The invention provides a gold/copper double-metal nano-cluster fluorescent probe, a preparation method thereof and histidine detection application, and belongs to the technical field of nano materials and biological analysis. The gold/copper double-metal nano-cluster probe prepared by the invention has a histidine-induced turn-on type fluorescence function, can specifically identify and respond to histidine, and realizes the rapid fluorescence detection and analysis of histidine. The method has the advantages of rapidness, high sensitivity, small background interference and the like when the gold/copper bimetallic nano-cluster probe is used for detecting histidine in body fluid (serum) and metabolite (urine), so that the method has good practical application value.

title_en: Membrane type sedimentation extraction device and method for in-vitro biological sample
abstract_en: The invention relates to a membrane sedimentation extraction device and a membrane sedimentation extraction method for an in-vitro biological sample, wherein the membrane sedimentation extraction device comprises a first filter membrane cup and a second filter membrane cup, the first filter membrane cup comprises a first filter membrane and a first cup body, the first filter membrane is fixed in the first cup body, the second filter membrane cup comprises a second filter membrane, a second cup body, a support plate and a sponge layer, the second filter membrane is fixed in the second cup body, the support plate is arranged in the second cup body and positioned below the second filter membrane, the sponge layer is arranged between the second filter membrane and the support plate, the support plate is provided with a plurality of through holes, the aperture of the first filter membrane is larger than the diameter of the sample to be separated, and the aperture of the second filter membrane is smaller than the diameter of the sample to be separated. The invention adopts double-layer filter membrane filtration and negative pressure adsorption during the second filtration, can realize the rapid separation of biological sample liquid and is convenient for transferring the collected sample to be separated onto a glass slide.

title_en: Method for quantifying nitrogen absorption and nitrogen nutrition contribution of non-root organs of crops
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of crop nutrition management and fertilization, in particular to a method for quantifying nitrogen absorption and nitrogen nutrition contribution of non-root organs of crops, which specifically comprises the steps of planting the crops after setting an isolated micro-area in a crop field; before spraying nitrogenous fertilizer on crops, paving a high-molecular water-absorbing resin layer in the isolated micro-area; the spraying concentration of the leaf surface is 0.5 to 0.75 percent 15 N isotope fertilizer solution; removing the high molecular water-absorbing resin layer, weighing, and calculating 15 The mass difference m of the high molecular water-absorbing resin layer before and after the spraying of the N isotope fertilizer solution; the mass is m and the concentration is 15 Equal in N isotope fertilizer solution 14 N fertilizer liquid is filled into the isolated micro-area; determining parameters after the crops are mature; the nitrogen uptake as a non-root organ and its contribution to the nitrogen nutrition of the crop was calculated. The invention is based on' isolation before compensation 15 N isotope tracing marks' quantitative nitrogen absorption amount of non-root organs and contribution of nitrogen absorption amount to crop nitrogen nutrition under the fertilization mode of spraying nitrogen fertilizer on the surfaces of canopy leaves.

title_en: Pesticide residue sample pretreatment concentration method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pretreatment concentration method of a pesticide residue sample, which belongs to the technical field of pesticide detection, and combines a QuEChERS method and a DLLME method to carry out pretreatment concentration on the pesticide residue sample.

title_en: Photoelectric sensor calibration device and method
abstract_en: The application discloses a photoelectric sensor calibration device and method, and relates to the technical field of sensors. The calibration device comprises a controller, a calibration mechanism, a data acquisition module and a data processing module; the calibration mechanism comprises a stepping motor linear sliding table, a traction rope, a support, a rotating part, a first clamping mechanism and a second clamping mechanism; the support is fixedly connected to the linear sliding table of the stepping motor, the rotating piece is rotatably connected to the support, and the second clamping mechanism is fixedly connected to the rotating piece; two ends of the traction rope are respectively connected with the linear sliding table of the stepping motor and the rotating piece; the first clamping mechanism is used for clamping the first mounting part, and the second clamping mechanism is used for clamping the second mounting part; the data processing module is used for receiving displacement of the sliding table, converting the displacement of the sliding table into a standard angle input value, processing the standard angle input value and an output signal of the photoelectric sensor, and outputting a transfer function and a static characteristic index of the photoelectric sensor. The application also provides a calibration method based on the calibration device.

title_en: Full-flexible three-dimensional force flexible touch sensor based on hourglass-shaped structure
abstract_en: A full-flexible three-dimensional force flexible touch sensor based on an hourglass-shaped structure comprises a trapezoidal contact, a flexible cavity, an hourglass-shaped elastomer and a flexible electrode, wherein the hourglass-shaped elastomer is adhered to the inner wall of the flexible cavity; the flexible electrode comprises a flexible excitation electrode and a flexible grounding electrode, the flexible excitation electrode and the flexible grounding electrode are respectively stuck on an upper curved surface and a lower curved surface of the hourglass-shaped elastomer at equal intervals by taking a central shaft of the flexible cavity as a symmetrical shaft, a certain distance is reserved between the flexible excitation electrode and the inner wall of the flexible cavity, and the flexible excitation electrode and the flexible grounding electrode are mutually aligned; an air layer is arranged between the flexible excitation electrode and the flexible grounding electrode as a dielectric layer; the trapezoidal contact is tightly stuck to the central position of the upper part of the flexible cavity. The invention has the advantages of more excellent structure, easy deformation, quicker response, better flexibility, lower hysteresis, better restorability and wider detection range.

title_en: Stratum crude oil sample transferring and water discharging alarm device and liquid discharging inspection method
abstract_en: The invention provides a stratum crude oil sample transferring and water outlet alarm device and a liquid discharge inspection method. The stratum crude oil sample transferring and water outlet alarm device is used for detecting the water containing condition in a crude oil sample taken out by a sampler, and comprises: the detection component is connected with the sampler, and the crude oil sample is conveyed to the detection component to detect whether the crude oil sample contains water; the high-pressure physical property analyzer is connected with the detection assembly, and the anhydrous crude oil sample detected by the detection assembly flows to the high-pressure physical property analyzer; and the alarm component is connected with the detection component and gives an alarm when the detection component detects that the crude oil sample contains water, and the crude oil sample is controlled to stop flowing to the high-pressure physical property analyzer from the detection component during alarm. By applying the technical scheme of the invention, the problem that the analysis period of the sample is prolonged because the crude oil sample of the stratum contains water in the prior art can be solved.

title_en: Determining a range limit of a lidar device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for determining a limitation of the range of a lidar device due to environmental influences by means of a control device, wherein, in order to find the distance between the lidar device and at least one surface in the scanning area, transmitting a beam into the scanning region by a transmitting unit of the lidar device, receiving a beam reflected from the scanning region and/or a beam backscattered from the scanning region by a receiving unit of the lidar device, and calculating a distance between the lidar device and the surface from the propagation times of the transmitted beam and the reflected beam and/or the backscattered beam, wherein the range limit of the maximum possible range of action of the lidar device is found based on the calculated variance of the distance. Furthermore, a control device and a lidar device are disclosed.

title_en: Organic luminescent material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an organic luminescent material which has a structure shown in a formula I. The preparation method comprises the following steps: taking IV compound and V compound as raw materials, reacting at 40-130 ℃ in the presence of catalyst and alkali compound to obtain the organic luminescent material shown in formula I. The organic luminescent material has higher quantum yield in solid state and liquid state, can show different luminescent colors in different solvents, and can be used for encryption, anti-counterfeiting or solvent detection.

title_en: Typing method of shiga toxin-producing escherichia coli
abstract_en: The invention discloses a typing method of shiga toxin producing escherichia coli, which comprises the following steps: A. respectively preparing a matrix mixed solution and a sample mixed solution by using a shiga toxin-producing escherichia coli sample to be detected, and dropwise adding the matrix mixed solution and the sample mixed solution onto a target plate to prepare two target plates to be detected; B. respectively detecting the two target plates by using MALDI-TOF equipment to obtain two mass-to-charge ratio peak spectrograms; C. and comparing the two mass-to-charge ratio peak spectrograms, calculating to obtain the characteristic data of each ion peak, and typing the Escherichia coli producing the shiga toxin according to the characteristic data of the ion peaks. The method can improve the defects of the prior art, and improves the accuracy of matrix-assisted laser adsorption ionization time-of-flight mass spectrometry in the typing of Shiga toxin-producing Escherichia coli.

title_en: Composite calibration plate and calibration method
abstract_en: The invention provides a composite calibration plate, comprising: detecting the pattern, the millimeter wave reflector and the composite board; the detection pattern and the millimeter wave reflector are arranged on the composite board and are positioned on the same side of the composite board. The detection pattern includes a two-dimensional code. The number of the millimeter wave reflectors is multiple, and the millimeter wave reflectors are arranged at the edge or the corner of the composite board. The shape of the composite plate includes a polygon. The composite board comprises a reflecting layer and a wave-absorbing layer, wherein the wave-absorbing layer is arranged on one side of the reflecting layer. The invention also provides a calibration method, which uses the composite calibration plate for calibration. The invention can calibrate the laser radar, the camera and the 4D millimeter wave radar at the same time, improves the calibration efficiency, is compatible with the 4D millimeter wave radar for calibration at the same time and reduces the calibration error of the whole sensor system.

title_en: 5G-based laser scanning steel rail abrasion detection system and method
abstract_en: A rail wear detection system and method based on 5G laser scanning comprises a remote PC and a detection vehicle, wherein the detection vehicle is provided with a GPS, an encoder, an upper computer, a lower computer, a position module, a laser profile sensor and an industrial black-and-white CCD camera, the rail vehicle automatically runs on a rail, remote image data are collected by using a 5G technology and then transmitted to the PC for processing, and rail wear conditions are detected in a rapid, accurate and efficient mode. The rail abrasion detection device is simple in structure and convenient to use, can be directly used for rail abrasion detection, greatly reduces the later maintenance cost of a railway and improves the maintenance efficiency, and software has the characteristic of easiness in maintenance.

title_en: Space positioning method for corona of generator stator winding
abstract_en: The invention discloses a space positioning method for corona of a generator stator winding. The corona visualization plane image of the stator winding is combined with different wiring modes of the stator winding of the generator and the position relation of the upper and lower wire rods, the corona plane image is subjected to spatial decomposition, and the upper and lower layer accurate positioning in the space of the stator winding corona is realized. The method for decomposing and positioning the corona space of the stator winding of the generator has the advantages of clear principle, quick analysis, practicability and high efficiency. During the corona test of the stator winding, the corona space position of the winding can be accurately positioned under the condition of not increasing the test quantity, the technical means of analyzing and processing the corona cause is established, the corona troubleshooting and cause judging efficiency of the winding is improved, and a solution is provided for the spatial positioning of the corona fault of the winding of the generator set.

title_en: Imaging quality analysis device
abstract_en: An imaging quality analyzer according to an aspect of the present invention includes: an analysis execution unit (1) executes MS for a target component for each of a plurality of minute regions in a two-dimensional measurement region (50) set on a sample (5) n Analyzing to collect data; an ion selection unit (21) that selects a plurality of product ions derived from the target component or estimated to be derived from the target component, based on at least a part of the data obtained by the analysis execution unit (1); a distribution image creation unit (22) estimates a small region in which all of the plurality of product ions are detected in the measurement region or a highly reliable small region in which the plurality of product ions are derived from the target component in common, using the signal intensity in each of the small regions in the measurement region for each of the plurality of product ions, and creates a distribution image in which the small region is visualized. Thereby, an MS imaging image with higher accuracy can be created than in the case of using 1 product ion.

title_en: Intelligent gas leakage detection method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent gas leakage detection method and system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: step S1: setting a target area; step S2: establishing a time interval comparison library, and determining a time interval corresponding to the target area based on the time interval comparison library; step S3: acquiring detection parameters of a target area at intervals, and detecting gas leakage based on the detection parameters; step S4: and outputting a detection result. According to the intelligent gas leakage detection method and system, the time interval comparison library is arranged, a reasonable time interval corresponding to the target area set by the inquiry user is compared, the infrared image sequence of the target area is obtained every other time interval for gas leakage detection, gas leakage detection is not required to be carried out all the time, the occupancy rate of system resources is reduced, and the power consumption of the system is reduced.

title_en: Asphalt pavement compaction real-time monitoring method based on intelligent particles
