abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent particle-based asphalt pavement compaction real-time monitoring method, which comprises the following steps of 1) installing intelligent particles; 2) filtering the intelligent particle acceleration time domain signal; 3) drawing a change curve of acceleration and rotation angle data along with time in the intelligent particle sensing data, and combining the change curve with rolling data of the compaction machine to obtain particle motion response modes corresponding to different compaction machine actions; 4) extracting a maximum acceleration response value under each compaction action, and an overall angle change value and a relative angle change value under each compaction mechanical action; 5) analyzing according to the change rule of the intelligent particle motion response characteristic obtained in the step 4), and realizing real-time monitoring of the pavement compaction state. The invention has simple installation process, strong operability, sensor size close to that of coarse aggregate, no damage to the integrity of the asphalt mixture and good compatibility with the asphalt mixture.

title_en: Optical lens manufacturing system and optical lens manufacturing method
abstract_en: An optical lens manufacturing system includes a base, a lens picker, a driving device, a displacement detector and a controller. The lens picker is arranged on the base. The driving device is disposed adjacent to the base. The displacement detector is configured on the driving device. The controller is electrically connected with the driving device and can control the driving device to drive the base to move with the variable driving current. The invention also provides a manufacturing method of the optical lens.

title_en: Industrial vehicle geographic feature system
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to industrial vehicle geographic feature systems. In a location-based geographic feature implementation, a message for transmission on an industrial vehicle is determined based on a current operating state of the industrial vehicle, information about an area having expected operating conditions, and a location of the industrial vehicle. When the industrial vehicle enters the area, the current operating state of the industrial vehicle is compared to the expected operating state to determine a message for display. Furthermore, the current operating state may change the manner in which messages are displayed. In a vehicle-based implementation, vehicle data is collected and analyzed to generate a message upon triggering a predetermined event. The detection of events may be combined with vehicle location data to create an event record of the captured location. Tools for establishing, managing and using the above capabilities are also provided.

title_en: Cabin section profile accurate measurement method based on line laser
abstract_en: The invention relates to a cabin surface profile accurate measurement method based on line laser. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, preprocessing before measurement is required to be carried out on equipment, wherein the preprocessing comprises the establishment of a base coordinate system, global calibration, camera calibration and laser plane calibration; and then dynamically measuring the cabin section, wherein all light planes are not required to be adjusted in one plane in the measuring process, obtaining a final light bar central point by utilizing image processing algorithms such as an image enhancement method, a gray scale gravity center method, a flood filling method and the like, obtaining a three-dimensional point cloud of the light bar under a base coordinate system by utilizing a laser triangulation principle, cutting the three-dimensional point cloud along the Z-axis direction of the base coordinate system to obtain section point cloud data of any contour of the cabin section, and processing the section point cloud data to obtain a series of parameters such as cabin section coaxiality and the like. The method provided by the invention overcomes the interference of factors such as reflection of light and laser ghost light existing in ambient light, is simple to operate and high in measurement precision, and can realize rapid measurement and analysis of the cabin section.

title_en: On-line weld joint monitoring system and method based on optical fiber temperature measurement technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for monitoring a welding line on line based on an optical fiber temperature measurement technology, wherein the system comprises a temperature field measurement sensor and a microprocessor; the temperature field measuring sensor is arranged on the outer surface of the welding seam and used for measuring the temperature field data of the surface of the welding seam in real time and uploading the data to the microprocessor; and the microprocessor compares and analyzes the received real-time temperature field data and the reference temperature field data, and judges whether the welding seam has leakage or defects. The invention can monitor the welding seam of the pipeline, the welding seam of the container and the like in real time and accurately determine the leakage position, thereby providing accurate basis for striving for rush repair time and avoiding safety accidents.

title_en: Multifunctional experiment table for motor detection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional experiment table for motor detection, relating to the technical field of motor performance detection, the experiment table comprises a supporting frame and a supporting table top, wherein the supporting table top is fixedly arranged above the supporting frame, a supporting mechanism is arranged at one end of the upper surface of the supporting table board, a motor to be detected is fixedly arranged above the supporting mechanism, the other end of the upper surface of the supporting table surface is provided with a detection mechanism through a telescopic rod, the invention is scientific and reasonable, the use is safe and convenient, the invention is provided with a self-locking mechanism, so that the extrusion air bag can be extruded by the gravity of the motor to be detected, the gas in the extrusion air bag is conveyed to the position of the clamping mechanism, and then utilize clamping mechanism to treat the motor of examining and fix for can realize self-locking, reduce the bolt and to waiting to examine the process that the motor carries out the fixing, make the fixed mounting who waits to examine the motor more convenient.

title_en: Estimation method of power battery health state
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for estimating the health state of a power battery, which comprises the following steps: establishing an equivalent circuit model of the power battery; building a power battery test platform, and measuring the internal resistance of the battery in the battery model; initializing state variables and covariance in a state equation by using two extended Kalman filters; taking the internal resistance of the battery as the input quantity of a first extended Kalman filter, outputting the internal resistance as the SOC, and establishing a related state equation and an observation equation; taking the output SOC of the first extended Kalman filter as the input quantity of the second extended Kalman filter, selecting the capacity Q as the state variable of the estimated SOH, and establishing a corresponding state equation and an observation equation; and repeating the first and second extended Kalman filter algorithms until the double extended Kalman filter algorithm is finished, obtaining an estimated SOC value and an estimated capacity value Q, and obtaining the SOH of the battery according to the obtained capacity value Q. The invention has high estimation accuracy.

title_en: Device for measuring seabed sand wave migration based on triangular pressure sensor and working method
abstract_en: The invention provides a device for measuring seabed sand wave migration based on a triangular pressure sensor and a working method, wherein the device comprises a penetration probe rod, a stabilizing frame and the triangular pressure sensor, and the working method comprises the following steps: s1 collecting data and determining distribution sea area; s2: equipment preparation work; s3: performing sea trial work; s4: the device works; s5: and (5) recovering the device. Through the technical scheme, the method can ensure that the seabed sand wave migration direction and speed are inverted through the pressure sensor, and has the advantages that the method can be used for measuring the sand wave period, the wave crest and wave trough form characteristic parameters, measuring the sand wave migration speed and direction, and inverting the wavelength characteristics through a mathematical method. Compared with the similar method of the previous application, the method of the invention can obtain the morphological characteristics and the migration parameters of the seabed sand waves by using only one technology of the pressure sensor, and has good economical efficiency.

title_en: Method and device for measuring surface temperature of object
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for measuring the surface temperature of an object, wherein the method comprises the following steps: after the temperature sensing device is in contact with the surface of the measured object for a set time, obtaining the temperatures measured by the temperature sensing device at the current moment and the last moment, wherein the temperature sensing device is in conductive contact with the surface of the measured object; determining a temperature compensation factor at the current moment according to the temperatures measured by the temperature sensing device at the current moment and the last moment at the current moment; obtaining a correction factor of the temperature compensation factor; obtaining a static correction factor; and determining the surface temperature of the measured object at the current moment according to the temperature measured by the temperature sensing device at the current moment, the temperature compensation factor at the current moment, the correction factor of the temperature compensation factor and one or more of the static correction factors. The invention can accurately measure the temperature under the condition that the measured object is not damaged.

title_en: Quality analysis method of vegetable oil
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quality analysis method of vegetable oil, which can analyze the quality of the vegetable oil by dynamically searching key characteristics (and non-single characteristics) in the vegetable oil, is more accurate and has universality, and further can be used for identifying the authenticity of the vegetable oil.

title_en: Snow boots capable of monitoring exercise steps and monitoring method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a snow boot capable of monitoring exercise steps and a monitoring method thereof. The invention has the advantages that the storage bag has the function of storing and placing the placing box, the zipper has the function of opening or closing the storage bag, the placing box can be prevented from being separated from the inner cavity of the storage bag, the storage module is used for storing program instructions and exercise information, the counter is used for recording the walking mileage of a user, the microprocessor is used for calculating the energy of the exerciser according to the number of steps of the exerciser in exercise, the height, the weight and the exercise time of the exerciser, the data acquisition module is used for acquiring the data of the height, the weight, the exercise time and the like of the user, and the acceleration sensor is used for recording the mileage of the user running quickly.

title_en: Three-dimensional displacement compensation method and control device for photothermal reflection microscopic thermal imaging
abstract_en: The invention provides a three-dimensional displacement compensation method and a control device for photothermal reflection microscopic thermal imaging. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring an acquisition image when a measured piece is positioned at a position to be compensated and a reference image when the measured piece is positioned at a reference position; calculating to obtain a first Fourier transform according to the reference image, and calculating to obtain a second Fourier transform according to the acquired image; determining peak point coordinates and fitting diameters of a point spread function of an optical subsystem in the photothermal reflection microscopic thermal imaging device according to the first Fourier transform and the second Fourier transform; and calculating the three-dimensional displacement of the measured piece relative to the reference position at the position to be compensated according to the peak point coordinates, the fitting diameter and the imaging parameters of the optical subsystem in the photothermal reflection microscopic thermal imaging device so as to perform three-dimensional displacement compensation on the measured piece. The invention can simultaneously calculate the three-dimensional displacement of the measured piece relative to the reference position when the measured piece is positioned at the position to be compensated, thereby improving the working efficiency of displacement compensation.

title_en: Method and device for determining detection sample
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a device for determining a detection sample, and belongs to the technical field of gas transmission pipelines. The method comprises the following steps: obtaining multiple types of gas transmission pipelines according to the obtained parameter values of the attribute parameters and the state parameters of each gas transmission pipeline, obtaining the parameter values of the preset internal corrosion parameters of each type of gas transmission pipeline, carrying out nonlinear fitting according to the occurrence times of each parameter value in each type of gas transmission pipeline, and determining the relation function between the distribution function relation parameter values and the occurrence times of the preset internal corrosion parameters of each type of gas transmission pipeline so as to determine the sample parameter values of the preset internal corrosion parameters of the multiple sample tubes. This application is through the sample pipe that this sample parameter value production corresponds, and such sample pipe is closer with actual gas transmission pipeline to the corruption condition in the simulation actual gas transmission pipeline for the defect relevance ratio of corroding the nondestructive test technique in detecting obtains more accurate defect relevance ratio.

title_en: Flowmeter suitable for sewage detection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flow meter suitable for sewage detection in the field of flow measurement, which comprises an installation pipe, wherein the top end of the installation pipe is fixedly connected with an installation box, the top end of the installation box is penetrated through and is slidably connected with a flow meter, the pipe orifice of an injection box sprays cleaning liquid to the flow meter to wash away stains on the surface of the flow meter, meanwhile, an air injection pipe intermittently blows air to the surface of the flow meter to blow away the stains on the surface of the flow meter, the flowing speed of the stains on the surface of the flow meter is accelerated, the volatilization time of the cleaning liquid is also accelerated, the surface cleanness of the flow meter is ensured, the service life of the flow meter is prolonged, the cleaning equipment can automatically clean the flow meter, a worker does not need to frequently detach the flow meter to clean, only needs to regularly supply cleaning in a storage box, the operation is simple, and the maintenance cost is reduced.

title_en: Automatic sampling and sample preparing device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic sampling and sample preparing device, which comprises: sample groove, dilution pond, driver, sample groove and the setting of diluting the pond interval still include sampler and controller, and the controller is connected with the driver, and the sampler setting is on the driver, through the controller at sample groove and dilute the changeable operation between the pond. In the automatic sampling and sample preparing device, the sampling groove is not only used for containing the sodium aluminate solution, but also more importantly, the sodium aluminate solution flows in the sampling groove in real time so as to solve the technical problem, ensure the quality and stability of the taken sodium aluminate solution and effectively prevent the sampler from being blocked; the whole sampling, diluting and sample preparing process of the automatic sampling and sample preparing device is carried out automatically, the sampling and sample preparing efficiency is improved, the sampling quality of the sample liquid is high, the analysis result of the sample liquid is stable, and the fluctuation is small.

title_en: Scratch-resistant glass and testing device thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a method for preparing scratch-resistant glass, which comprises the following steps: step one: preparing a glass matrix, wherein the glass matrix comprises the following components in percentage by mass: siO (SiO)  2  ：58‑63％，Al  2  O  3  ：16‑21％，Na  2  O≤10％，K  2  O≤2％，B  2  O  3  ≤2％，ZnO≤1％，Li  2  O：2‑6％，P  2  O  5  Less than or equal to 2 percent; step two: the scratch-resistant glass is obtained after the glass matrix is subjected to chemical strengthening treatment. The application discloses a scratch-resistant glass and a device for testing the scratch-resistant performance of the scratch-resistant glass. According to the scratch-resistant glass and the preparation method thereof, the glass substrate with specific components is selected, the glass with excellent scratch resistance is obtained by adopting a secondary chemical strengthening treatment mode, the speed of the base carrying platform of the scratch-resistant glass testing device moving back and forth along the longitudinal direction is adjustable, the speed of the glass placing platform moving back and forth along the transverse direction is adjustable, and the detection pressure of the pressurizing device is adjustable.

title_en: Inter-splicing zipper inspection device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mutual-splicing zipper checking device, which comprises a processor and a zipper length detection module, wherein the zipper length detection module is used for detecting the moving distance of a tested zipper; the tooth number detection module is used for detecting and outputting the tooth number of the zipper to be detected; the processor is internally provided with a data receiving module, a calculating module and a data output module; the data receiving module is connected with the zipper length detecting module and the tooth number detecting module and is used for receiving the moving distance L of the tested zipper and the number n of the zipper teeth in the section of the zipper detected by the tooth number detecting module in real time; the calculating module calculates the ratio m of L to n according to the moving distance L of the tested zipper and the tooth number n of the zipper teeth in the section of the zipper, and judges whether the m meets the standard; the data output module outputs a judging result or outputs a warning signal when m does not meet the standard; the invention can detect whether the number of teeth in unit length of the mutually spliced zipper meets the standard, ensures the quality of the zipper, is convenient to detect and improves the detection efficiency.

title_en: Electronic cigarette control method, electronic cigarette control device and electronic cigarette
abstract_en: The invention discloses a control method of an electronic cigarette, a control device of the electronic cigarette and the electronic cigarette, wherein the control method of the electronic cigarette comprises the following steps: determining a first voltage detection value; determining a second voltage detection value; performing difference calculation on the first voltage detection value and the second voltage detection value to obtain an actual voltage detection value output by the capacitive air flow detection device; when the actual voltage detection value is larger than or equal to the reference voltage value, triggering the electronic cigarette to heat and atomize. According to the invention, the first voltage detection value and the second voltage detection value are respectively obtained under different charging current signals, and then the difference value calculation is carried out on the first voltage detection value and the second voltage detection value, so that an actual voltage detection value formula without an interference current value is obtained. The method eliminates the interference of the interference current on the air suction flow detection signal, solves the problem that the control device judges the air suction flow detection signal to be invalid due to the instant change of the current when the electronic cigarette works, and improves the stability of the electronic cigarette.

title_en: Underground three-dimensional accurate positioning system
abstract_en: The invention provides an underground three-dimensional accurate positioning system which comprises a digital twin map, a positioning server, a monitoring terminal, a communication network, a positioning substation and a positioning device. The system realizes two-dimensional primary positioning of the moving target by using a method of two-dimensional spatial distribution of positioning substations in a mine and applying the existing radio wave distance measurement technology, fully utilizes sensor data, realizes real-time direction monitoring of the moving target, and further realizes two-dimensional and three-dimensional accurate positioning of the underground moving target. The system has the characteristics of simplicity, effectiveness, low construction cost, high positioning accuracy and the like, can adapt to the development direction of less humanization and no humanization of coal production, meets the global two-dimensional and three-dimensional positioning of unmanned equipment, and has wide application prospect.

title_en: Ultra-wideband indoor positioning system and method
abstract_en: An ultra-wideband indoor real-time location system (201) for determining the location of a mobile tag device within a location area is disclosed. The real-time positioning system comprises a plurality of UWB signal transmitters (MB, BSI, …) located at preset positions and defining a positioning area, wherein the UWB signal transmitters are operated with synchronized clocks and are configured to transmit UWB signals (LFs _ MB, …) based on a UWB frame format, wherein the UWB frame format comprises unique information content of the UWB signal transmitters for locally/accordingly transmitting the UWB signals (LFs _ MB). The real-time positioning system further comprises at least one mobile tag device (T) comprising a signal receiving unit (249) configured to receive a UWB signal (LFs _ MB), a time detection unit (229A) configured to derive for the received UWB signal respective points of arrival time (ToA1_ T, …), an identification unit (229B) configured to derive unique information content (LFs _ MB, …) from the received UWB signal, and a control unit (229C) configured to process the unique information content and the points of arrival time (ToA1_ T) of at least a subset of the UWB signal transmitters (MB, BS1, …) in a positioning algorithm to derive a position of the mobile tag device (T) relative to the subset of the UWB signal transmitters (MB, BS1, …).

title_en: Open channel flow measurement system and method based on underwater particle velocity measurement
abstract_en: The invention provides an open channel flow measuring system based on underwater particle velocity measurement, which comprises an underwater PIV measuring system, a Particle Image Velocimetry (PIV) measuring system and a Particle Image Velocimetry (PIV) measuring system, wherein the PIV measuring system comprises a bubble generator arranged underwater, a laser device facing to the area above the bubble generator is arranged at the downstream of the bubble generator, and a camera facing to the area above the bubble generator is also arranged at one side of a river bed; the water level measuring system comprises a water level meter and a water level measuring device, wherein the water level meter is used for measuring the water level; the data processing system comprises an embedded single chip microcomputer and is used for finishing video processing and image processing and finishing flow calculation by combining water level information; the power supply system is used for supplying power to the whole system, and the bubble generator, the laser camera, the water level meter and the data processing system are all connected with the power supply system; and the remote monitoring equipment is used for receiving the processing data of the data processing system. The invention solves the two problems that the existing open channel measurement method is low in measurement precision and a PIV method needs to spread a large amount of tracer particles.

title_en: Electrical contact and electrical connection device
abstract_en: The present invention reduces the number of components to improve conductivity, improves the sliding property of an elastic member, controls the elastic force according to the characteristics of a contact object, and improves the electrical contact stability with the contact object. The electrical contact of the present invention is formed by winding a plate-like member having conductivity, and includes: a1 st contact portion formed by winding a1 st distal end portion of the plate-like member; a1 st elastic portion formed by winding a tapered upper arm portion; a2 nd contact portion formed by winding the 2 nd distal end portion; a2 nd elastic portion formed by winding a tapered lower arm portion; and a tubular portion formed by winding the main body of the plate-like member.

title_en: Detection device of image system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of automobile image system detection, and discloses a detection device of an image system, wherein the image system comprises a display screen and a plurality of buttons arranged on the side surface of the display screen, the detection device of the image system comprises a loading mechanism and a pressing mechanism, the loading mechanism can bear and fix the display screen, the pressing mechanism comprises a pressing head and a position adjusting component, the position adjusting component can adjust the position of the pressing head so that the pressing head can be abutted against each button, in the invention, the display screen borne and fixed on the loading mechanism is in communication connection with a computer, the pressing head of the pressing mechanism presses the buttons on the side surface of the display screen, and the computer detects signals output by the display screen. According to the invention, the pressure head is moved through the position adjusting assembly, so that the pressure head can press different buttons.

title_en: Frame cleaning method, sample injection device and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a frame cleaning method which is applied to a sample injection device, wherein the sample injection device comprises: the recovery area is positioned above the cache area and forms an upper-lower stacked structure with the cache area, and the method comprises the following steps: detecting the mechanism state of a dispatching mechanism when the sample injection device is in a fault shutdown state; and under the condition that the mechanism state is fault-free, transporting the sample rack stored in the buffer area to the recovery area by utilizing the dispatching mechanism, and completing rack cleaning.

title_en: Battery state of health monitoring method and apparatus, vehicle, and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a battery health state monitoring method and device, a vehicle and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of vehicles. The method is applied to a battery circuit including a battery, a controller and a preset load. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring first measurement data of a battery and a first voltage of a controller after a first preset duration of access to a preset load; acquiring second voltage of the controller after the preset load is removed for a second preset time and second measurement data of the battery after a third preset time, wherein the second preset time is shorter than the first preset time, and the third preset time is shorter than the first preset time and longer than the second preset time; and calculating the internal resistance of the battery according to the first measurement data, the second measurement data, the first voltage and the second voltage, thereby calculating the internal resistance of the battery on line, and monitoring the health state and the service life of the battery according to the internal resistance, so as to early warn or inform a user to reserve to replace the battery of the vehicle in time before the battery is scrapped.

title_en: Dark plum detection and quality control method
abstract_en: The invention provides a detection and quality control method for dark plums, wherein the detection method for the dark plums comprises the following steps: detecting by adopting liquid chromatography, wherein the chromatographic conditions during detection are as follows: a chromatographic column using octadecylsilane chemically bonded silica as a filler is adopted; taking methanol as a mobile phase A and phosphoric acid with the mass concentration of 0.1-0.2% as a mobile phase B, and carrying out gradient elution; the preparation process of the test solution comprises the following steps: and (3) taking a test sample, adding a solvent, and pretreating to obtain a test sample solution. The invention not only reduces the damage to the instrument, but also makes the component polarity presented by the atlas more diversified, and has the advantages of good separation effect and the like.

title_en: Synchronous detection and application of exposure and effect markers of volatile pollutants in urine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for synchronously detecting exposure of volatile pollutants and effect markers in urine and application thereof, wherein the method selects OH-PAHs, mVOCs and 8-OHdG which possibly have correlation in the same urine sample as target detection objects to synchronously extract, detect and analyze, and comprises the following steps: pretreating a sample; enriching and separating a sample; concentration and detection of samples: and (3) respectively carrying out on-machine detection on OH-PAHs, mVOCs and 8-OHdG by adopting HPLC-MS/MS, correspondingly analyzing to obtain content data of various target detection substances in the urine, and analyzing the correlation among the three. The invention applies the relation between the content data of the analysis target object to the evaluation of the human body exposure characteristics of the two pollutants. According to the invention, through an optimization scheme, various target detection objects can be synchronously detected and analyzed, the detection steps are simplified, the detection cost is reduced, and the application range of the health exposure risk assessment result is expanded.

title_en: VR device of intelligent acquisition and transmission natural environment index
abstract_en: The invention provides a VR device capable of intelligently acquiring and transmitting natural environment indexes, which comprises a VR all-in-one machine and an environment detection assembly, wherein a panoramic camera and the environment detection assembly are arranged on the VR all-in-one machine, the environment detection assembly is used for acquiring environment data, and the environment detection assembly transmits the acquired environment data to a cloud end through network transmission. Therefore, the method and the device can solve the technical problem that most of the existing virtual reality technologies (VR) only comprise visual perception and auditory perception, so that the experience sense of the environment where the user is personally on the scene is reduced, and realize the immersive experience and use interaction of the metauniverse.

title_en: Navigator with tilt compensation and related method
abstract_en: A navigator with tilt compensation and related methods. The navigator comprises an orientation angle calculation unit, in particular a first orientation angle and a second orientation angle, characterized in that the orientation angle calculation unit is configured to be able to determine the first and second orientation angles in a given order and in a reversed order; the calculation unit is arranged to be able to select between said given order and said reversed order to calculate the first orientation angle and the second orientation angle based on a comparison between an error risk indicator quantifying the risk of instability of said calculation unit during the determination of the first orientation angle and the second orientation angle and a predetermined threshold.

title_en: Ranging method and apparatus, terminal system, and computer-readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a distance measuring method, a distance measuring device, a terminal system and a computer readable storage medium. The distance measurement method comprises the following steps: transmitting a first check code from a transmitting end to a receiving end by adopting a first communication technology; transmitting a modulation signal from the transmitting end to the receiving end by adopting a second communication technology, wherein the modulation signal carries a second check code, and the first communication technology is different from the second communication technology; acquiring a first moment when a transmitting end transmits a modulation signal and a second moment when a receiving end receives the modulation signal; demodulating a second check code in the modulated signal; obtaining a distance measurement confidence coefficient according to the first check code and the demodulated second check code; and acquiring the measurement distance between the transmitting end and the receiving end according to the first time, the second time, the transmission speed of the modulation signal and the ranging confidence. Compared with a reflection type distance measurement method, the distance measurement method has higher measurement frequency when measuring the same distance, and can ensure that the obtained measurement distance is accurate and reliable by combining with the confidence coefficient of distance measurement.

title_en: Through-wall radar detection system and detection method based on unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a through-wall radar detection system and a detection method based on an unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein the system comprises the unmanned aerial vehicle, an environment sensing unit, a through-wall radar, a holder and a control unit; the unmanned aerial vehicle, the environment sensing unit, the through-wall radar and the holder are all connected with the control unit; the through-wall radar is positioned on the unmanned aerial vehicle and used for detecting the external structure, the internal structure and the internal personnel of the building to be detected; the environment sensing unit is positioned on the unmanned aerial vehicle and used for sensing the flight environment information of the unmanned aerial vehicle and sending the flight environment information to the control unit; the control unit controls the flight of the unmanned aerial vehicle according to the flight environment information so as to keep the distance between the unmanned aerial vehicle and the outer wall body within a certain range; the cloud platform is located unmanned aerial vehicle, and the receiving and dispatching antenna of through-wall radar is located the cloud platform, and the control unit is according to flight environment information control cloud platform's action so that the array face of receiving and dispatching antenna keeps parallel with outer wall body. The invention has the advantages of simple structure, good detection performance and the like.

title_en: Conveying device and inspection system
abstract_en: Provided are a conveying device and an inspection system. The conveying device comprises a walking mechanism, a rotating mechanism and a conveying mechanism. The traveling mechanism is configured to reciprocate linearly and includes a first support frame and a fixed base mounted on the first support mechanism. The rotating mechanism comprises a rotating base and a first driving mechanism suitable for driving the rotating base to rotate relative to the fixed base. The conveying mechanism comprises: the rolling mechanism comprises a second supporting frame arranged on the rotating base, a plurality of rolling mechanisms arranged on the second supporting frame, and at least one second driving mechanism suitable for driving the rolling mechanisms to rotate. The second driving mechanism is arranged between the two groups of rolling mechanisms, so that the space between the two auxiliary longitudinal frames can be fully utilized, and the overall height of the conveying device is reduced.

title_en: Liquid sight lens airtightness and pressure resistance detection equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an air tightness and pressure resistance detection device for a liquid sight glass, which comprises a base, wherein a transparent water storage tank is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the base, a tank cover plate is hinged to the upper opening of the water storage tank, a rubber sealing strip for sealing the upper opening of the water storage tank is arranged on the lower surface of the tank cover plate, an air suction pump is arranged inside the base, a containing support plate and a clamp holder are arranged inside the water storage tank, a blowing nozzle is fixedly connected to the inner rear wall of the water storage tank, and a negative pressure suction pipe is fixedly connected to the input end of the air suction pump. This equipment aspiration pump is bled to the storage water tank, air injection after the pressurization looks in the liquid mirror, look in the liquid mirror soaks, if have sealed and withstand voltage defect, leak gas in the water, can directly perceived discovery, the formation negative pressure atmospheric pressure in the testing process storage water tank reduces, the bubble of leaking gas will be big than under the ordinary pressure environment, the quick come-up surface of water, easily discovery, even the bubble of small gas leakage, also can realize enlargeing, solve the difficult problem of discovering of small gas leakage, guarantee the accuracy that detects.

title_en: Coarse error elimination method and system for INS assisted GNSS positioning
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a gross error rejection method and a gross error rejection system for INS assisted GNSS positioning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: step 1: acquiring GNSS observation value data of the current time; step 2: estimating the state of the GNSS Kalman filter according to the previous GNSS positioning result; and step 3: eliminating pseudorange observation value gross errors and eliminating Doppler observation value gross errors; and 4, step 4: setting observation value noise according to the tracking state, channel noise, carrier-to-noise ratio and pseudo-range residual error of the observation value; and 5: setting system noise according to the overall condition of the observation value and the distribution condition of the participating positioning satellite; step 6: and performing Kalman filtering of GNSS positioning, updating the current state of Kalman filtering, and outputting data. According to the method, the INS is adopted to assist the GNSS positioning to remove the gross errors, and the INS positioning assisted by the GNSS has the characteristics of small positioning error and no influence of sheltered environment in a short time, so that the accuracy of removing the gross errors of the observed values of the GNSS can be effectively improved, and the positioning deviation of the GNSS is reduced.

title_en: Three-phase load unbalanced current protection GFI relay circuit
abstract_en: The invention provides a three-phase load unbalanced current protection GFI relay circuit; the device comprises a detection circuit and a protection circuit, wherein the detection circuit samples the three-phase current vector sum through a mutual inductor, compares the three-phase current vector sum with reference voltage after filtering and rectifying, and starts the protection circuit when an unbalanced protection signal is high; the GFI relay action control, GFI protection and RESET (RESET) functions are all realized by pure hardware circuits, and the problems that the product debugging performance, the maintenance performance and the industrialization are influenced because an external interface does not have a reserved software programming port when a microprocessor is used for control and protection are solved; the 28V circuit is isolated from the internal control circuit, and the reliability is higher.

title_en: Supercritical fluid chromatograph and sample supply method for supercritical fluid chromatograph
abstract_en: The supercritical fluid chromatograph includes: a suction/discharge unit for sucking and discharging a sample; a first sample circuit connected to the suction/discharge unit via a first channel; a first channel switching unit connected to the first sample circuit via a second channel; a sample container connected to the second channel via a third channel when the first channel switching unit is set to the first switching state; and a second channel switching unit that is connected to the second channel via a fourth channel when the first channel switching unit is set to the second switching state. When the second channel switching unit is set to the third switching state, the fourth channel is connected to the second sample circuit, and when the second channel switching unit is set to the fourth switching state, the second sample circuit is connected to the analysis channel to which the solvent as the supercritical fluid is supplied.

title_en: Three-degree-of-freedom false supporting mechanism
abstract_en: A three-degree-of-freedom false support mechanism belongs to the technical field of aerodynamic wind tunnel tests. The invention comprises a pitching transmission mechanism, a rolling transmission mechanism, a mounting seat and a longitudinal and transverse adapter frame, wherein the pitching transmission mechanism and the rolling transmission mechanism are connected through the longitudinal and transverse adapter frame, and the mounting seat is arranged at the rear side of the rolling transmission mechanism. The invention aims to solve the problems that the position of a dummy support can be adjusted in real time, the interference between the dummy support and a model is avoided, and the measurement of a balance is inaccurate; and aiming at different main supports, the appearance of the false support is replaceable, and the false support is suitable for various support interference correction tests. The mechanism integrates long-time experience and training in the aspects of test equipment development and use, and finally develops the three-degree-of-freedom adjustable false support mechanism suitable for various support interference correction tests.

title_en: Peak-shaving gas turbine unit combustion simulation test device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of peak-shaving gas turbine units, and particularly relates to a combustion simulation test device of a peak-shaving gas turbine unit. Aiming at the defect that the combustion simulation test of the current gas turbine unit mainly burns natural gas and does not test the mixed combustion of hydrogen and natural gas, the invention adopts the following technical scheme: a peak shaving gas turbine unit combustion simulation test device comprises: an air system; a gas system; a combustion system; a flue gas recovery system; flushing the system; the air system sends air to the combustor, and the gas system sends natural gas or hydrogen to the surge tank; when a natural gas and hydrogen mixed combustion test is carried out, the air system sends air to the pressure stabilizing tank, and the gas system sends mixed natural gas and hydrogen to the pressure stabilizing tank. The invention has the beneficial effects that: can carry out independent hydrogen or natural gas and co-combustion experiment, can carry out recovery processing to the flue gas, can wash the system.

title_en: System and method for cooperatively acquiring track and motion state of double-screen telephone watch
abstract_en: The invention discloses a track and motion state collaborative acquisition system and a method of a double-screen telephone watch, which utilize the double-screen characteristic of the double-screen telephone watch, one screen displays real-time map and track data, the other screen displays real-time motion state data, so that a user can conveniently and comprehensively know the real-time motion state of the user, the user can be allowed to click and check motion state data associated with a certain position point of the motion, and the user is allowed to check the motion state data of a certain time period after the motion is finished, so that the user can conveniently master different motion states of different places of each time period, and effective scene recording or repeated playing is realized.

title_en: Portable base of acting as go-between
abstract_en: The invention discloses a portable stay wire base which comprises a portable assembly, wherein the portable assembly comprises a first protective shell and a second protective shell which have the same structure, a locking piece arranged on the first protective shell and a lifting piece arranged on the second protective shell, and the locking piece and the lifting piece are matched with each other; the invention improves the stay wire base, can realize the functions of coarse adjustment and fine adjustment, has more stable structure, is convenient to carry, can more accurately position the control point, and can effectively fix the stay wire direction.

title_en: Optical feedback cavity enhanced absorption spectrum device based on optical fiber coupling device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of laser spectroscopy, and particularly relates to an optical feedback cavity enhanced absorption spectroscopy device based on an optical fiber coupling device. The device uses an optical fiber coupling semiconductor laser as a light source. The temperature and current of the laser are controlled using a laser controller, and the laser output frequency is tuned by a function generator sweeping the laser drive current. The light output by the laser is input into an electro-optical modulator coupled by an optical fiber, and then is converted into space light by a collimator, and the space light is emitted into the cavity after passing through a lambda/2 plate, a polarization beam splitter, a lambda/4 plate, a matching lens and a beam splitter. And laser transmitted by the cavity is converged to a photoelectric detector through a focusing lens and then is sent to a computer through a high-speed data acquisition card, and a LabView program is used for recording and processing cavity mode signals. The cavity, the barometer and the vacuum pump are connected through the corrugated pipe, so that the air pressure in the cavity is controlled.

title_en: Equal-volume discrete method for target in double-height section three-dimensional space
abstract_en: The invention discloses a double-height-section three-dimensional space target equal-volume discrete method, and belongs to the field of aerospace. According to the invention, for the double-height segment spherical layer determined by the target distribution height, the equal-volume dispersion is carried out on the double-height segment spherical layer in two dimensions of distance and zenith angle, the dispersed double-height segment spherical layer is analyzed in the azimuth angle dimension, the three-dimensional space target dispersion is realized by two-dimensional calculation, and the dispersion efficiency is obviously improved. According to the invention, the coverage judgment of a single discrete unit is carried out according to the coverage condition of the center line of the isometric discrete unit of the double-altitude-section three-dimensional space target, the multiple coverage area judgment of any single discrete unit is realized by a one-time interval superposition algorithm through an analytic azimuth angle coverage interval superposition method, and the judgment efficiency and the judgment precision can be considered at the same time. The invention takes the double-height section as a subset of any three-dimensional space multi-target section to carry out expansion discrimination, and expands the application range of the invention to the discrimination of the equal-volume dispersion and the corresponding coverage area of the multi-height section three-dimensional space target.

title_en: GNSS-R sea surface height measurement precision and along-track spatial resolution reconstruction method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a GNSS-R sea surface height measurement precision and along-track spatial resolution reconstruction method and a system, wherein the method comprises the steps of processing original data to obtain complex waveforms; the method comprises the steps of processing complex waveforms to obtain power waveforms, calculating to obtain average height measurement accuracy corresponding to N mirror points, correcting time delay of the mirror points, inverting to obtain vertical distance from sea surface of a satellite point of a receiver to a reference ellipsoid, calculating to obtain average height measurement accuracy corresponding to N mirror points, obtaining average height measurement accuracy and average height measurement accuracy obtained by different signal processing time, and combining the relation between the space resolution along the track and the signal processing time to realize reconstruction of GNSS-R sea surface height measurement accuracy and the space resolution along the track. The invention comprehensively analyzes the relation between the airborne iGNSS-R height measurement precision and the along-track spatial resolution from the two angles of height measurement precision and accuracy, and provides reference for the balance consideration of relevant parameters of future satellite-borne iGNSS-R height measurement tasks.

title_en: Digital oscilloscope and digital channel correction method for digital oscilloscope
abstract_en: The application discloses a digital channel correction method for a digital oscilloscope and the digital oscilloscope, wherein the method comprises the steps of firstly, performing zero level correction on a comparator of each digital channel to obtain zero level flip voltage of the digital channel; then acquiring respective analog trigger compensation time of each digital channel when the digital channel is at an analog channel trigger source; then obtaining the digital trigger compensation time of each digital channel when the digital channel is used as a trigger source; and finally, acquiring the mixed trigger compensation time of each digital channel when the analog channel and the digital channel are in mixed trigger, and acquiring the mixed trigger correction parameters when the analog channel and the digital channel are in mixed trigger according to the mixed trigger compensation time. Because the mixed trigger compensation time is obtained according to the time of the first trigger signal of each digital channel during the mixed trigger, the waveform displayed by the digital oscilloscope is only deflected to one direction, and the purpose of stabilizing the waveform is further achieved.

title_en: Inverter power source aging method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of aging methods, in particular to an inverter power supply aging method. The method comprises the following steps: A. connecting a plurality of aging units in series, wherein the input end of one aging unit is connected with the output end of the aging unit adjacent to the aging unit; the aging unit consists of a tested inverter and a DC parallel output module, and the output end of the tested inverter is connected with the input end of the DC parallel output module; the output end VD0 of the DC parallel output module of the last aging unit is fed back to the V2 input ends of the DC parallel output modules of the other aging units, and the input end and the output end of each aging unit are connected with the static contact bridge of the alternating current contactor JS. The invention has the advantages that the power supply capacity required by the inverter aging equipment can be greatly reduced, the power supply equipment is greatly saved, much electric energy is prevented from being consumed on a resistor, and the pollution to the environment is reduced.

title_en: Electromagnetic ultrasonic stress detection device and method for oil and gas pipeline
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electromagnetic ultrasonic stress detection device for an oil-gas pipeline, which relates to the field of industrial nondestructive detection and aims to solve the problem of inaccurate flaw detection of the traditional pipeline.

title_en: Special device for verifying high-temperature fatigue performance of automobile rubber lifting lug
abstract_en: The invention discloses a special device for verifying high-temperature fatigue performance of an automobile rubber lifting lug, and aims to provide a special device convenient for detecting the performance of the rubber lifting lug, and the special device is characterized by comprising a machine box seat, a servo electric cylinder, a control touch screen, an electric cylinder push rod connecting disc, a lower heat insulation block, a lower connecting disc, an operation box, a power switch, a lower connecting rod, a temperature control box, a lower fixing tool, a lifting lug sample, an upper fixing tool, an upper connecting rod, a temperature control box heat insulation block, an upper connecting disc, an upper heat insulation block force sensor, a gantry fixing frame, a control assembly and other parts, wherein the whole structure is simple, compact and reasonable, the manufacturing and processing are convenient, and the cost is very economic; the rubber lifting lug durability test requirement for simulating high-temperature fatigue environment is met.

title_en: Luminescent composition
abstract_en: A light-emitting composition comprising: a luminophore and a polymer, the polymer comprising: formula Ar 1 Wherein Ar is a repeating unit of 1 Is an arylene repeat unit unsubstituted or substituted with one or more substituents; and a repeating unit of formula (I): wherein Ar is 2 And Ar 3 Each independently represents C which is unsubstituted or substituted by one or more substituents 6‑20 Arylene or 5-20 membered heteroarylene, and CB represents in Ar 2 And Ar 3 A conjugate disrupting group which does not provide a conjugation pathway therebetween; wherein the polymer is in water or C at 20 DEG C 1‑8 The solubility in alcohol is at least 0.1 mg/ml. The composition may be a light-emitting polymer, wherein the polymer contains a light-emitting group. The luminescent composition may be part of a particle comprising a polymer and a matrix material, such as silica. The luminescent compositions are useful in assays for detecting target analytes.

title_en: Information processing apparatus, mobile apparatus, method, and program
abstract_en: Provided is a configuration that generates travel section display data that enables at least an automatic driving permission section and a manual driving section on a travel route of a vehicle to be recognized, and presents the travel section display data to a user (driver). Includes a data processing portion that generates traveling section display data that enables at least an automatic driving permission section and a manual driving section on a traveling route of a vehicle to be recognized. The data processing unit generates time-linear display data in which time (t) and display position (h) are expressed in a proportional relationship between the short-distance section and the long-distance section. The data processing unit generates display data in which the distance per unit display length of the long-distance section is made longer than the distance per unit display length of the short-distance section. The data processing unit generates display data having a time axis that gradually changes at a predetermined rate from a first time axis corresponding to the short-distance section to a second time axis corresponding to the long-distance section in relation to the intermediate-distance section between the short-distance section and the long-distance section.

title_en: Simulation check out test set in rhythm of heart area
abstract_en: The present application relates to a detection, which relates to an analog detection device of a heart rate belt, comprising: a placing table; the switch section is arranged on the placing table; the placing section is arranged on the placing table and is provided with a placing groove for placing the heart rate belt; the simulation section is arranged on the placing table, is sequentially arranged with the placing section and the switch section in parallel, and is provided with a vibrator to simulate the vibration frequency of human heartbeat; the bumper is attached to the heart rate belt in the placing groove and vibrates to detect the heart rate belt. This application has the detection of present heart rate area, reduces the effect of the defective rate of product when leaving the factory.

title_en: Method for estimating SOP of lithium ion battery
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for estimating SOP of a lithium ion battery, which comprises the following steps: obtaining the maximum specified multiplying power of the battery at the specified temperature and duration; selecting a measurement multiplying power which is not higher than the maximum specified multiplying power; obtaining OCV of the battery after standing at a specified temperature and a specified SOC; obtaining different terminal voltages of the battery at the last moment of specified temperature, specified SOC, different measurement multiplying powers and the same duration; obtaining different over-potentials; obtaining a maximum allowable overpotential; s7, selecting an overpotential which is less than the maximum allowable overpotential and has the closest value to the maximum allowable overpotential as x1, selecting a measurement multiplying power corresponding to the overpotential as y1, selecting an overpotential which is greater than the maximum overpotential and has the closest value to the maximum allowable overpotential as x2, and selecting a measurement multiplying power corresponding to the overpotential as y 2; solving a linear equation through x1, y1, x2 and y 2; and substituting the maximum allowable overpotential into a linear equation for calculation to obtain the maximum allowable multiplying power.

title_en: Fin elevator guide rail interval auxiliary measurement's device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device for auxiliary measurement of a guide rail distance of a lifting fin, which comprises: the first bottom plate is provided with a right-angle outer edge matched with a first side guide rail with a right-angle section, and a first measuring point is arranged on the first bottom plate; the second bottom plate is provided with a trapezoidal outer edge matched with a second side guide rail with an obtuse angle structure in cross section, and a second measuring point is arranged on the second bottom plate; the thickness of the first bottom plate is equal to that of the second bottom plate, and when the first bottom plate and the second bottom plate are used for measurement, the first bottom plate and the second bottom plate are located on the same horizontal plane.

title_en: Magnetic field generating device for vehicle load monitoring and using method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of vehicle load monitoring, in particular to a magnetic field generating device for vehicle load monitoring, which comprises an upper mounting plate and a lower mounting plate, wherein the lower end of the upper mounting plate is provided with a mounting groove for mounting a permanent magnet, four groups of threaded rods are fixedly connected to the lower end of the upper mounting plate and positioned on the outer ring of the mounting groove at equal intervals in the circumferential direction, a limiting pressing plate is sleeved on each threaded rod, and a fixing nut is connected to the threaded rod and positioned on the lower end of the limiting pressing plate in a threaded manner. The permanent magnet is convenient to mount and dismount, so that the permanent magnet is convenient to maintain and replace, the upper shell and the upper mounting plate are convenient to mount and dismount, internal elements of the permanent magnet are convenient to maintain and replace, the first Hall sensor and the second Hall sensor are convenient to mount and dismount, so that the first Hall sensor and the second Hall sensor are convenient to maintain and replace, the lower shell and the lower mounting plate are convenient to mount and dismount, and internal elements of the permanent magnet are convenient to maintain and replace.

title_en: Sound sensor convenient to maintain and used for detecting cableway skidding and using method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sound sensor convenient to maintain and used for detecting the skidding of a cableway and a using method thereof. According to the sound sensor for detecting the cableway wheel slip, the aim of good using effect is fulfilled through the matching of the shell, the sound sensor body, the first through hole, the second through hole, the first limiting plate, the second limiting plate, the first slot, the second slot, the third through hole, the cross rod, the first connecting plate, the first inserting plate, the first spring, the groove, the slide rod, the slide sleeve, the second spring, the second connecting plate, the second inserting plate, the support rod, the moving plate, the rotating rod, the elliptical plate and the hand wheel, and the function of convenient disassembly is achieved, so that the sound sensor for detecting the cableway wheel slip is convenient to overhaul, the experience of a user on the sound sensor for detecting the cableway wheel slip is improved, and the requirements of the current market are met.

title_en: Stress compensation circuit and magnetic field sensing system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a stress compensation circuit and a magnetic field sensing system, wherein the stress compensation circuit is used for compensating mechanical stress of a magnetic field sensing element and comprises a current generator, a first reference resistor, a second reference resistor, a third reference resistor, a circuit output end, and a first mirror image branch, a second mirror image branch and a third mirror image branch which are mutually connected in parallel; the current generator is connected with the first mirror image branch, the first mirror image branch and the second mirror image branch are respectively grounded through a first reference resistor and a second reference resistor, and the third mirror image branch is connected with the output end of the circuit; the third reference resistor is connected in parallel between the second mirror branch and the third mirror branch, and the third reference resistor is configured to have the same piezoresistance coefficient as the first reference resistor. The stress compensation circuit provided by the invention simplifies the adjustment process, enables the output compensation voltage value to be calculated quantitatively, and further increases the corresponding compensation adjustment range.

title_en: Large-view-field high-speed photoacoustic microscopic imaging device and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a large-view-field high-speed photoacoustic microscopic imaging device and a large-view-field high-speed photoacoustic microscopic imaging method. The device comprises a laser source component, a light beam transmission component, a light beam scanning component, a reflective imaging port component and a computer. The method uses nanosecond pulse laser emitted by a sheet-shaped optical fiber bundle transmission pulse laser as excitation light, uses a micro lens array to realize light focusing, simultaneously excites photoacoustic signals on a single radius of an imaging area, uses a line focusing ultrasonic transducer array to simultaneously detect the photoacoustic signals on the single radius, and combines a radius rotation scanning method to realize three-dimensional imaging. The imaging time is shortened to the second level by simultaneous laser and simultaneous acquisition and reconstruction of the photoacoustic signals, and meanwhile, high-speed imaging under the condition of large field of view is realized, thereby providing conditions for animal organ scale photoacoustic imaging and large animal photoacoustic imaging.

title_en: A-shaped frame back plate flatness detection device and detection method
abstract_en: The invention provides a device for detecting the flatness of a backboard of an A-shaped frame, which comprises: the datum part comprises an upper datum plane, a lower datum plane parallel to the upper datum plane and a through groove penetrating through the upper datum plane and the lower datum plane, and the lower datum plane is used for being attached to the back plate plane of the A-type frame to be measured; the measuring piece comprises a measuring piece body and a measuring head connected to the measuring piece body, and the measuring head penetrates through the through groove and abuts against the back plate plane of the to-be-measured A-shaped frame; and the measuring part is connected to the upper reference surface in a sliding manner along the length direction of the reference part through the connecting part. The A-shaped frame backboard flatness detection device is simple and quick to operate, the measurement method is easy to implement, and the measurement result is more accurate.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and storage medium for detecting power line
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for detecting a power line, wherein the method is applied to a fault inspection terminal, the fault inspection terminal is connected with detection clamp equipment, and the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a first line parameter of a first detection line and a second line parameter of a second detection line, and determining a line parameter threshold value based on the first line parameter and/or the second line parameter, wherein the first detection line and the second detection line are lines positioned at two sides of a hanging point when the detection clamp equipment is hung on a suspected fault power line; receiving a first current value corresponding to the first detection circuit and a second current value corresponding to the second detection circuit, which are sent by the detection clamp equipment; and judging whether the first detection circuit and the second detection circuit have faults or not according to the circuit parameter threshold value, the first current value and the second current value, so that the fault detection precision and the fault detection efficiency are improved.

title_en: Autonomous operation platform of unmanned forklift
abstract_en: The invention discloses an autonomous operation platform of an unmanned forklift, which comprises a traveling computer and a platform control end, wherein the traveling computer is connected with an information acquisition end, the traveling computer comprises a control module, an alarm module, a wireless output module, a positioning module, a display module, a detection module and a voice module, the platform control end comprises a wireless receiving module and an operation panel, and the platform control end is respectively connected with a cloud server and an offline server. The basic autonomous operation of unmanned fork truck is realized through the combination of the platform control end of the driving computer and the high in the clouds of taking in the fork truck under the line, through information acquisition end and orientation module, the precision navigation of fork truck has been realized, and practice thrift the cost, high durability and convenient use, through the inspection module, detect fork truck operation conditions in real time, driving computer controls fork truck, thereby guarantee unmanned fork truck's even running, the high in the clouds can real time monitoring when meetting the trouble, and in time overhaul unmanned fork truck, the practicality is stronger.

title_en: Poria cocos standard decoction quality detection method
abstract_en: The invention provides a quality detection method of a poria cocos standard decoction, which comprises the steps of determining the dry extract yield, the properties and the thin layer identification of the poria cocos standard decoction, and determining extract and a characteristic spectrum, wherein the dry extract yield is determined by adopting a decocting method; thin-layer identification is carried out by adopting thin-layer chromatography; measuring the extract by adopting a hot dipping method; the characteristic spectrum is determined by liquid chromatography. According to the quality detection method of the poria cocos standard decoction, the quality of the poria cocos standard decoction is evaluated through multi-aspect measurement, a solid foundation is laid for the stable quality of products, a feasible quality standard of the poria cocos decoction can be established, and the effective control of the quality of the poria cocos standard decoction is realized.

title_en: Sensor device and method for determining the axial and rotational position of a body
abstract_en: A sensor device for determining the axial position of a body (10) along a longitudinal axis (a) comprises: an excitation coil (23) extending around the longitudinal axis; one or more first detection coils (21) arranged in the vicinity of the exciting coil and in a first detection plane (P1); and one or more second detection coils (22) arranged in the vicinity of the excitation coil and in a second detection plane (P2). The excitation circuitry supplies a current having an excitation frequency to the excitation coil (23) to produce an excitation field distribution. The detection circuitry determines an axial position of the body based on signals from the first and second detection coils at the excitation frequency. The detection circuitry determines the axial position based on at least one difference between the signal from the first detection coil and the signal from the second detection coil. The rotational position of the body may be determined by detecting stray magnetic fields of a magnet carried by the body using at least two magnetic field sensors (24). The magnetic field sensor is arranged on a common printed circuit board (25) together with the excitation coil and the detection coil.

title_en: Freight vehicle-mounted terminal abnormality detection method and device, storage medium and terminal
abstract_en: The invention relates to a freight vehicle-mounted terminal abnormity detection method, a device, a storage medium and a terminal, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting vehicle real-time position data through a vehicle-mounted positioning terminal and storing the vehicle real-time position data; acquiring the latest position data of the vehicle from the stored real-time position data of the vehicle; acquiring historical running track data of the vehicle from the stored real-time position data of the vehicle; calculating the track continuity rate of the vehicle according to the historical running track data; and judging whether the vehicle-mounted positioning terminal of the vehicle is in an abnormal condition or not according to the current system time, the latest position data of the vehicle and the track continuity rate. The invention can prompt the vehicle owner to maintain when the vehicle-mounted positioning terminal of the vehicle is detected to be in an abnormal state, so as to solve the problems of disconnection and the like of the vehicle-mounted positioning terminal of the vehicle, and achieve the purposes of legalized operation of the freight vehicle and reduction of illegal penalty of an operation unit.

title_en: Double-channel self-purification type runoff sediment automatic monitoring equipment and monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a double-channel self-cleaning runoff sediment automatic monitoring device and a monitoring method, the technical scheme comprises a flow inlet pipe, the flow inlet pipe is respectively connected with two sets of runoff sediment collecting and monitoring devices arranged on a shell through a shunt valve, each set of runoff sediment collecting and monitoring device comprises a Y-shaped shunt pipe, the inlet of the Y-shaped shunt pipe is connected with a flow guide pipe, two outlets are respectively connected with the inlet of a flow storage chamber and the inlet of a sediment measuring chamber through a hose pipeline, the flow storage chamber and the sediment measuring chamber are respectively provided with a water level meter, and the bottom outlets are respectively provided with a valve; the flow storage chamber is fixed on the shell through a support piece, and a weighing sensor is arranged at the bottom of the sediment measuring chamber. The invention has the advantages of simple structure, easy control, difficult sediment deposition, self-cleaning capability, stable operation, high accuracy, long service life and good adaptability.

title_en: Environment monitoring device for energy regulation and control for carbon neutralization and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an environment monitoring device for carbon neutralization for energy regulation and control and a using method thereof, relates to the technical field of carbon neutralization environment monitoring, and solves the problems that the environment monitoring device for carbon neutralization for energy regulation and control is difficult to move due to large size and is difficult to remove so as to cause inconvenience in use when the device is used. The environment monitoring device for regulating and controlling the energy for carbon neutralization comprises an assembly rod assembly, wherein four instrument placing assemblies are arranged on the outer surface of the assembly rod assembly, and a data display screen is arranged on the outer surface of the assembly rod assembly. According to the invention, through the matching of the assembling rod top buckle and the assembling plate limiting buckle, a plurality of assembling rods can be clamped into the bottom groove of the assembling rod through the assembling rod top buckle, and the assembling plate limiting buckle is clamped into the assembling rod limiting groove, so that the height and the size of the device can be freely controlled, and the device is more convenient to install an instrument placing component.

title_en: System and method for measuring lunar soil particle interaction force in simulated lunar environment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a system and a method for measuring lunar soil particle interaction force under a simulated lunar environment, which simulate the high vacuum and high temperature difference environment of the moon by designing a lunar environment simulation system. The method is beneficial to analyzing the contact property among the lunar soil particles in a simulated lunar environment, establishes a refined digital lunar soil model, and can provide theoretical support for research and exploration of lunar soil macroscopic properties and engineering properties in a complex lunar environment.

title_en: Penetration driver based on shear thickening effect and working method thereof
abstract_en: A penetration driver based on shear thickening effect comprises a penetration end, a driver shell, a feeding device, a transmission structure, a limiting sleeve and a sealing cover plate. The invention relates to a penetration driver which completes penetration driving by means of the shear thickening effect of a medium after being completely immersed into the medium non-Newtonian fluid medium or solid particles of non-Newtonian fluid. The invention has the characteristics of large penetration depth, simple structure, light weight and convenient carrying, and is particularly suitable for extreme environments such as geographic environment exploration, seabed exploration, deep space celestial body landing exploration and the like.

title_en: Pretreatment method for detecting PCBs, PBDEs and EHFRs in sediment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pretreatment method for detecting PCBs, PBDEs and EHFRs in sediments. The method comprises the steps of firstly extracting a sediment sample by using a rapid solvent extractor, then dehydrating after concentrating by using a rotary evaporator, purifying by using a purification gel chromatograph, then secondarily purifying by using a chromatographic column, and finally blowing nitrogen to a constant volume. The chromatographic column adopted by the invention is simple to fill, and the purification effect is improved and the effect of removing the matrix effect is obvious by controlling the composition of the chromatographic column filler and the mass ratio of each component. After the treatment by the method, the recovery rate of PBDEs is 82-134%, the recovery rate of PCBs is 81-120%, and the recovery rate of EHFRs is 66-141%.

title_en: Automatic sampler
