abstract_en: The needle driving section moves the sampling needle. The display control unit causes the display unit to display an arrangement input unit that receives input of arrangement information of the additional sample containers. The position information acquiring unit acquires position information indicating positions of a predetermined number of additional sample containers by a teaching operation. The storage unit stores the input arrangement information and the acquired position information. The designation information acquisition unit acquires designation information designating the storage unit. The movement control unit controls the needle driving unit so as to move the sampling needle to the storage unit specified by the specification information, based on the stored arrangement information, the stored position information, and the acquired specification information.

title_en: Full-automatic program-controlled computer sample cutting machine
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of corrugated paper processing, and particularly relates to a full-automatic program-controlled computer sample cutting machine which comprises a rack, wherein a moving mechanism is arranged on the rack, the moving mechanism comprises first guide rails symmetrically arranged at two ends of the rack, first sliding tables are arranged on the two first guide rails in a sliding manner, a cross beam is arranged on the two first sliding tables, a second guide rail is arranged in the cross beam, a second sliding table is arranged on the second guide rail in a sliding manner, an air cylinder is arranged on the front surface of the second sliding table, and a piston rod at the output end of the air cylinder is connected with a lifting table; when cutting a sample, at first, carry out the pre-reinforcement to corrugated container board through locking mechanism, carry out the centre gripping spacing to corrugated container board, follow-up vacuum adsorption mechanism adsorbs corrugated container board through, corrugated container board stable the installing in assigned position when dual fixed cooperation makes follow-up cutting a sample, prevents that corrugated container board from appearing the skew and influencing the cutting orbit.

title_en: Multifunctional high-opening true triaxial rigidity testing machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional high-opening true triaxial rigidity testing machine, and relates to the field of rock material mechanics. The specific structure is as follows: the host loading system adopts a four-column vertical structure, and the pressurizing mode is up-pressing; the movable workbench comprises a movable platform and two guide rails, and moves along the front-back direction; the confining pressure device is of a square frame structure with four equidistant sides and comprises confining pressure frames, and four confining pressure piston oil cylinders are respectively arranged in the middle of the four sides of each confining pressure frame; the hydraulic system comprises a hydraulic support impact test system, a shaft pressure loading system, a confining pressure loading system, a press rigid frame pre-tightening system and an auxiliary action system; the electric control system comprises a motor control system, a PLC control system, a testing machine detection system and a computer data acquisition and analysis system. All the components are connected into a whole through pipelines and electric devices. The invention can meet the research of the unbalanced load, point load and dynamic load performance test, the true triaxial deformation and fracturing test of the large rock mass and the uniaxial compression deformation test of the large rock sample of the large hydraulic support.

title_en: Multiple electrochemistry biological detection micro-fluidic chip based on electrode array
abstract_en: The invention provides a multiple electrochemical biological detection microfluidic chip based on an electrode array, which comprises an upper substrate, at least two reaction electrodes and a lower substrate, wherein the at least two reaction electrodes and the lower substrate are arranged aiming at different targets; redox groups for detection are attached to the surfaces of the reaction electrodes, and the reaction electrodes are sequentially arranged in the extending direction of the micro flow channel; the upper surface of the lower substrate is provided with a counter electrode and a plurality of working electrodes which are intersected in the extension direction of the micro-channel, and the working electrodes are connected with the reaction electrodes in a one-to-one correspondence manner. The multiple electrochemical biological detection micro-fluidic chip based on the electrode array has the advantages of being capable of detecting various biochemical indexes at one time, not needing to sample for many times, being capable of relieving the pain and economic burden of a patient and being good in detection effect.

title_en: High heat conduction photovoltaic new forms of energy spare part heat conductivity check out test set
abstract_en: The invention relates to detection equipment, in particular to high-heat-conductivity photovoltaic new energy component heat conductivity detection equipment. The technical problems of the invention are as follows: the utility model provides a can detect by oneself for work efficiency improves, and can reduce the high heat conduction photovoltaic new forms of energy spare part heat conductivity check out test set of detection error. The technical implementation scheme of the invention is as follows: the utility model provides a high heat conduction photovoltaic new forms of energy spare part heat conductivity check out test set, includes main framework, division board, contact switch and first detection frame etc. and the main framework left and right sides all is equipped with the division board, and main framework top rear side is equipped with contact switch, is equipped with first detection frame in the middle of the bottom in the main framework. According to the invention, the heating module is controlled to be started through the distance sensor, so that the heating module heats the heat conduction pipe, and further the heat on the heat conduction pipe is conducted to the new energy component, therefore, people do not need to heat the new energy component by means of a heating tool, and the detection error can be reduced.

title_en: Digital fluorescent magnetic powder detection device for welded joint
abstract_en: The invention provides a digital fluorescent magnetic powder detection device for a welded joint. The device comprises a mobile body, a detection function mechanism and a fluorescent magnetic powder radiography mechanism; the vehicle body of the mobile body is provided with a detection function mechanism and a fluorescent magnetic powder radiography mechanism, and the stability and reliability of permanent magnet adsorption are utilized to ensure safety, so that the small-range curvature surface adaptation, obstacle crossing and the body posture adjustment action are completed; the detection function mechanism realizes vertical up-down and horizontal rotation movement of the magnet yoke through the motor driver all-in-one machine for controlling vertical reverse movement and the motor driver all-in-one machine for controlling the rotation of the magnet yoke, and realizes magnetic powder detection operation according to related national standards; the fluorescent magnetic powder radiography mechanism drives the magnetic suspension nozzle array to reciprocate by controlling the rodless cylinder, realizes the spraying of the magnetic suspension, makes a dark environment, performs cross excitation by using the magnet yoke under the irradiation of a black light lamp with standard illumination intensity, performs photographing recording, and completes one-time detection to automatically perform the next station detection. The device is suitable for being used as a fluorescent magnetic powder detection device.

title_en: Mechanical equipment electronic box temperature monitoring and fire protection device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mechanical equipment safety protection devices, and discloses a temperature monitoring and fire-proof device for an electronic box of mechanical equipment, which comprises the electronic box, wherein a temperature monitoring mechanism and a shell are arranged on the electronic box, and the temperature monitoring mechanism is used for monitoring the temperature change in the electronic box; temperature monitoring mechanism is including setting up smoke monitor and the temperature monitor in the electronic box, be provided with the display on the electronic box, this mechanical equipment electronic box temperature monitoring and firebreak device, temperature change and the smog of whether producing the fire through temperature monitoring mechanism in to the electronic box carry out real-time supervision, and pass through the display with the data of surveying and show, when the temperature rises to certain threshold value, send out the police dispatch newspaper through the display and remind the staff to maintain the inspection, when the incasement high temperature and the fire has appeared, then store the fire extinguishing agent of storage in the subassembly through the switch subassembly automatic triggering who sets up and spray out through spraying the subassembly, in time put out the conflagration.

title_en: Blade detection method, device, system, equipment and medium of wind generating set
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a blade detection method, a device, a system, equipment and a medium of a wind generating set, wherein the blade detection method of the wind generating set comprises the steps of acquiring first point cloud data of the front edge surface of a blade, wherein the first point cloud data comprises space position coordinates of a plurality of points on the front edge surface of the blade; and determining deformation parameters of the front edge surface of the blade according to the first point cloud data and the second point cloud data of the front edge surface of the reference blade, wherein the second point cloud data comprises spatial position coordinates of a plurality of points on the front edge surface of the reference blade, and determining the detection result of the blade of the wind generating set according to the deformation parameters of the front edge surface of the blade. The embodiment of the application can reduce the cost of blade detection while realizing the blade detection of the wind generating set.

title_en: Monitoring system with photoelectric sensor and monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a monitoring system with a photoelectric sensor and a monitoring method thereof, wherein the monitoring system comprises an optical signal receiving module, a photoelectric conversion module, a data processing module and an output control module, wherein the optical signal receiving module transmits a received optical signal to the photoelectric conversion module, the photoelectric conversion module converts the optical signal into an electric signal, the electric signal is transmitted to the data processing module after being processed, the electric signal is converted into a digital signal by the data processing module, the optical signal received by the optical signal receiving module changes along with the change of a measured physical quantity, the optical signal is processed by the data processing module after being converted into the digital signal, and the change rule of the measured physical quantity is displayed through a state change curve by a display device; and the method can also be used for detecting whether the appearance color of the product is qualified or not.

title_en: Bridge measuring device and using method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of bridge measurement and discloses a bridge measuring device and a using method thereof, wherein the measuring device comprises a device body, a leveling component, a horizontal plate and an infrared distance meter, the infrared distance meter is arranged on the horizontal plate, the horizontal plate and the leveling component are both arranged in the device body, and the leveling component is used for adjusting the horizontal plate, so that the horizontal plate is in a horizontal state as much as possible, and the accuracy of the measuring device in measuring is improved; the using method comprises the steps of assembling the measuring device and measuring, and further the measuring efficiency of workers using the bridge measuring device is improved.

title_en: Inertial navigation track correction method and device, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an inertial navigation track correction method, an inertial navigation track correction device, a storage medium and electronic equipment, which are applied to a vehicle-mounted navigation system, wherein the vehicle-mounted navigation system comprises an inertial navigation system and a positioning system; matching the positioning system with a road network and calculating a first positioning credibility score corresponding to the positioning system; fitting the track trend corresponding to the positioning system and the track trend corresponding to the inertial navigation system and calculating a corresponding second positioning credibility score; calculating a third positioning credibility score corresponding to the positioning system according to the positioning system attribute parameters; and calculating a positioning system credibility score according to the first positioning credibility score, the second positioning credibility score and the third positioning credibility score, and correcting the inertial navigation track according to the positioning system credibility score. The method utilizes the road network data with high reliability and the advantage of high reliability of the inertial navigation trend in a short time to calculate the reliability of the positioning system, and improves the accuracy of correcting the inertial navigation track by utilizing the positioning system.

title_en: Zero disturbance power-assisted device for EMC test of electric power-assisted bicycle
abstract_en: The invention discloses an EMC test zero-disturbance power assisting device of an electric power-assisted bicycle, which comprises an EMC darkroom, wherein the EMC darkroom is provided with a pneumatic motor, a transmission mechanism and a clamp for clamping a bicycle pedal, the transmission mechanism comprises a first connecting rod and a second connecting rod, one end of the first connecting rod is rotatably connected with an output shaft of the pneumatic motor, the other end of the first connecting rod is rotatably connected with one end of the second connecting rod, the other end of the second connecting rod is rotatably connected with the clamp, the output shaft of the pneumatic motor is parallel to the rotation center line of a pedal crank, the first connecting rod is driven by the pneumatic motor to rotate by taking the output shaft of the pneumatic motor as the axis line, and then the second connecting rod drives the pedal crank of the bicycle to do circular motion. The invention provides the test assistance for the electric moped with the pedal crank and reduces the electromagnetic interference of the power assisting device in the test process.

title_en: Overvoltage detection and energy absorption device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power supplies, in particular to an overvoltage detection and energy absorption device which comprises a two-stage voltage detection circuit, an energy absorption control module and an energy absorption power module, wherein the two-stage voltage detection circuit comprises a first-stage low-power-consumption voltage detection circuit and a second-stage temperature and voltage detection circuit, the first-stage low-power-consumption voltage detection circuit and the second-stage temperature and voltage detection circuit are connected through a second-stage power supply switch, and the second-stage temperature and voltage detection circuit and the energy absorption power module are connected through the energy absorption control module; the invention can improve the safety of the battery or the electric equipment and effectively absorb external abnormal overvoltage or abnormal energy.

title_en: Method and apparatus for current sensing and current limiting
abstract_en: Methods, apparatus, systems, and articles of manufacture for current sensing and current limiting are disclosed. Example apparatus include: a first main transistor (302) comprising a first main transistor gate terminal (306) coupled between the output terminal (108) and the intermediate node (201); a second main transistor (312) comprising a second main transistor gate terminal (318) coupled between the intermediate node (201) and a ground terminal; a first amplifier (350) comprising a first amplifier output (362) coupled to the first main transistor gate terminal (306); a second amplifier (310) comprising a second amplifier output (364) coupled to a second main transistor gate terminal (318); and a third amplifier (330) comprising a third amplifier inverting input coupled to the intermediate node (201), a third amplifier non-inverting input coupled to the sense transistor (314), and a third amplifier output coupled to a third gate terminal (338) of the third transistor (332).

title_en: Single CCD double prism binocular stereo vision sensor
abstract_en: The invention provides a WAAM molten pool three-dimensional reconstruction method, which designs a binocular stereoscopic vision sensor capable of adjusting the length of a base line based on prism beam splitting, wherein the sensor utilizes a single video camera and a prism to achieve the purpose of changing the length of the base line by adjusting the distance between the prism and the optical center of the camera, and the flexibility of a shooting angle and a shooting distance is increased. Compared with a traditional binocular stereoscopic vision sensor formed by two left and right parallel cameras, the binocular stereoscopic vision sensor has the advantages of short base length, good image acquisition synchronism and small occupied space, and is particularly suitable for monitoring the process of robot electric arc additive manufacturing. In addition, the designed sensor has compact structure and beautiful appearance.

title_en: Path planning system of underground scraper
abstract_en: The invention discloses a path planning system of an underground scraper, which comprises: the map generation system comprises a map import module, a path planning module, a positioning point function setting module, a path function setting module and a path generation module; the map import module imports the CAD roadway map and the electronic map into a database; the path planning module is used for planning a reciprocating travel path of the forklift according to the positions of the stope and the chute; the positioning point function setting module defines the functions of the positioning points in the driving path and determines the action of the scraper; the path function setting module integrates the functions of all positioning points in the driving route to complete the definition of the driving direction and the action of the whole path; the path generation module generates a corresponding path according to the ore removal path and the ore dumping path, and the scraper automatically moves according to the generated path. The invention solves the problem that the existing scraper is difficult to move automatically underground to carry ores.

title_en: Assessment method and device for quality of data collected by external field spectrometer
abstract_en: The application provides an evaluation method and device for quality of data collected by an external field spectrometer, comprising the following steps: acquiring external field spectrum radiation measurement data acquired by a spectrometer and external field parameters of at least one influence factor, and determining a correction coefficient and uncertainty of the correction coefficient of each influence factor; determining an external field measurement result of the spectrometer by using the laboratory calibration coefficient, each correction coefficient and external field spectrum radiation measurement data of the spectrometer; based on the uncertainty of the laboratory scale factors, the uncertainty of the external field spectral radiometric data, and the uncertainty of each correction factor, a synthetic standard uncertainty for evaluating the external field measurements is determined. Therefore, the accuracy of the external field measurement result is improved by determining the correction coefficient of each influence factor and correcting the external field spectrum radiation measurement data, and the reliability of the external field measurement result can be effectively evaluated by determining the uncertainty of the synthesis standard, so that the high-precision calibration is facilitated.

title_en: Calibration test method for flow resistance simulation device of high-pressure explosion valve
abstract_en: Compared with the prior art, the invention aims to disclose a calibration testing method for a high-pressure blast valve flow resistance simulator, which is characterized in that a 1:1 pipeline structure, a 1:1 pipeline size and a 1:1 pipeline flow resistance simulator calibration tool are configured according to the actual pipeline arrangement of an engineering system, so that the performance test of the high-pressure blast valve flow resistance simulator before being applied to the debugging of the engineering system is realized, the actual precision accurate measurement of the high-pressure blast valve flow resistance simulator in the actual engineering application is realized, the accurate calculation and analysis of the body flow resistance of the blast valve flow resistance simulator are realized, the measurement capability verification of the blast valve flow resistance simulator is realized, and the aim of is realized.

title_en: Sampling device for geotechnical engineering investigation and using method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sampling device for geotechnical engineering investigation and a using method thereof. The extension end of action bars be equipped with sampling port complex shutoff head, when the piston removed to the sampling portion and was spacing by the sampling portion, the shutoff head reached the extreme position after stretching out the sampling port. The invention has simple structure and reasonable design, and when in use, the sample is not easy to be polluted, and can be conveniently pushed out, thereby being very convenient and fast and having better use effect.

title_en: Method for determining deltamethrin in water based on gas-mass linkage method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of pollutant measurement, in particular to a method for measuring deltamethrin in water based on a gas-mass linkage method, which comprises the steps of precipitating the water to be measured to obtain a precipitate and precipitated water; filtering the precipitated water to obtain filtered water; dropwise adding the filtered water on a watch glass for dehydration to obtain organic matter residues; dissolving organic matter residues on the watch glass by using an organic solvent, and then carrying out centrifugal separation to obtain a sample to be detected; the method has the advantages that the content of the deltamethrin in the sample to be detected is detected by using a gas-mass linkage method, and the water to be detected is subjected to double filtration treatment through precipitation and filtration, so that the residue of impurities is reduced, and the problem that the detection result of the content of the deltamethrin is influenced by the impurities in the sample in the conventional detection method is solved.

title_en: Measurement system and method for determining the state of an electrical system in a vehicle using the measurement system
abstract_en: A measurement system and a method of determining a state of an electrical power system in a vehicle using the measurement system are provided. The measurement system for determining safe operating conditions of a high voltage power system of a vehicle, comprising: a first voltage measurement unit arranged to measure a first voltage between a positive pole and a negative pole of the power system; a second voltage measurement unit arranged to measure a second voltage between the positive pole of the power system and ground; a third voltage measurement unit arranged to measure a third voltage between the negative pole of the power system and ground; and a measurement system control unit connected to the first voltage measurement unit, the second voltage measurement unit, and the third voltage measurement unit and configured to: each of the first, second and third voltages is compared to a corresponding first, second and third voltage threshold and an indication of the exceeding of the threshold voltage is provided if any of the first, second and third voltages exceeds the corresponding threshold.

title_en: Miniaturized orthogonal altimeter transmitting antenna
abstract_en: The invention discloses a miniaturized orthogonal altimeter transmitting antenna, which comprises two pairs of identical and mutually perpendicular delta antennas, wherein the two pairs of delta antennas are loaded at the top end and share a central supporting tower, and are electrically connected with ionosphere altimeter equipment through a matcher. The miniaturized orthogonal altimeter transmitting antenna disclosed by the invention has the advantages of low height, small occupied area, wide frequency band, simple installation and erection, antenna cost saving and stronger practicability, and can be widely matched with an ionosphere altimeter system for ionosphere monitoring work.

title_en: Multi-field coupling simulation test device and method for mine groundwater pollution
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-field coupling simulation test device and method for mine groundwater pollution, comprising a constant-temperature water bath box, wherein one side of the constant-temperature water bath box is communicated with a water storage box, the outer side of the water storage box is provided with a control mechanism, the top of the constant-temperature water bath box is provided with a stress loading mechanism, the stress loading mechanism comprises a covered steel plate movably connected to the top of the constant-temperature water bath box, the constant-temperature water bath box is respectively provided with a temperature control mechanism and a monitoring mechanism, the constant-temperature water bath box is also internally provided with a water level control mechanism, and the stress loading mechanism, the temperature control mechanism, the monitoring mechanism and the water level control mechanism are respectively and electrically connected with the control mechanism, so that four-field coupling of a stress field, a chemical field, a seepage field and a temperature field is realized, the simulation environment where pollutants are located is more similar to real natural conditions, and scientific and accurate simulation is realized, and the underground water pollutant transportation process under the multi-field coupling effect.

title_en: Detection method for blind carbon-rich manganese carbonate ore
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of mineral resource exploration, in particular to a detection method of blind manganese carbonate-rich ore, which comprises the following steps: delineating the manganese-containing stratum on the ground surface by adopting a remote sensing technology; performing ground pursuit on the section of the manganese-containing stratum to determine a manganese-rich ore section; determining the position of the hidden manganese carbonate-rich ore body in the manganese-rich ore section by adopting an induced gradient technology; and (3) tracking the extension range information of the manganese carbonate-rich ore body by adopting a well-ground induced polarization technology. The application provides a detection method for improving exploration efficiency and safety for geologists, and is further favorable for reducing the working time of the geologists in severe environments and improving the working safety of the geologists. The method is favorable for providing a feasible method for deeply searching the blind manganese carbonate-rich ore body and providing a basis for the subsequent comprehensive drilling deployment.

title_en: Method for measuring stress triaxial degree in material sample tensile fracture test process
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for measuring the triaxial stress degree in the process of a material sample tensile fracture test, which comprises the following steps: A. performing a tensile fracture test on the material sample by adopting a standard method; B. measuring the main strain increment, the secondary strain increment and the equivalent strain of a certain point on a material sample in a tensile fracture test by adopting a DIC (digital computer) method; C. obtaining the change trend of the triaxial stress degree of the point along with the increase of the equivalent strain in the test process through a material assumption and conversion formula, and obtaining a triaxial stress-equivalent strain curve of the material sample; D. and averaging the obtained triaxial stress-equivalent strain curve to obtain the triaxial stress of the material sample. The method provided by the invention can be used for analyzing and calculating the stress triaxial degree directly through the test measurement result without constructing a complex constitutive model, the result depends on the test result, the authenticity and the accuracy are better, and the method is particularly suitable for measuring the stress triaxial degree of a plate-shaped sample in a tensile fracture test.

title_en: Temperature and amplitude remote measuring system and method based on laser dispersion spectrum
abstract_en: The invention provides a temperature and amplitude remote measuring system and method based on laser dispersion spectrum, which comprises a laser emission module, an electro-optic modulator, a beam splitter, a collimating mirror, a transmission and reflection integrated optical module, a photoelectric detector, a data acquisition and processing module, a gas cell, a primary reflecting device and the like. When the temperature and the amplitude are remotely measured, light is modulated in intensity through the electro-optical modulator and then is divided into two paths through the beam splitter, and one path of light is directly input into the electro-optical detector to serve as a reference phase signal. The other path retroreflects the light beam passing through the gas cell in the original path through an original direction reflecting device, converges to the photoelectric detector through the transmission-reflection integrated optical module, and finally calculates the phase change caused by distance and the phase change caused by dispersion through the data acquisition processing module, and the phase changes are respectively used for calculating amplitude and temperature. The passive measurement device is simple in structure and easy to realize, can perform long-term stable passive measurement, can be used for testing the thermal vibration of the wall surface of a key part in the fields of aerospace and the like, and has wide application prospect.

title_en: Optical addressing-synaptic neurotransmitter sensor
abstract_en: The invention provides a structural design and a preparation method of a light addressing-synaptic (light synaptic) neurotransmitter sensor, which mainly comprises a synaptic region and a light-controlled neurotransmitter sensitive region. The synaptic region comprises a bottom electrode layer, a nerve bionic layer formed on the bottom electrode layer and a top electrode layer formed on the nerve bionic layer; adjacent to the synaptic region is a light-operated neurotransmitter-sensitive region comprising a shutter layer, neurotransmitter receptor proteins modified at the surface of the shutter layer, an electrolyte solution drop-wise applied to the region, and a platinum electrode suspended therein. The invention is prepared by adopting full liquid phase stripping, spin coating and microelectronic printing technology, is a novel nerve morphology biochemical sensing device with low cost and high flux, and can inject new vitality for the development of artificial synapse devices in the fields of brain science and bionic visual sensing systems.

title_en: Terahertz biosensor based on combination of coplanar waveguide and resonant structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a terahertz biosensor based on combination of coplanar waveguide and a resonant structure, which comprises a resonant structure, a dielectric substrate and the coplanar waveguide arranged on one end face of the dielectric substrate, wherein the coplanar waveguide is composed of a metal transmission line in the middle and metal grounding lines arranged at two sides of the metal transmission line in parallel at intervals, at least one group of resonant structures are etched on the metal transmission line, each group of resonant structures comprises a first metal arm, a second metal arm and two opposite tips, one tip grows at the tail end of the first metal arm, the second metal arm is in a shape of a square, the other tip grows on the second metal arm, and a common capacitance gap is formed between the two tips. The invention realizes local electric field enhancement, enhances the interaction between the terahertz waves and the biological sample, and realizes high-sensitivity biological detection in the terahertz range.

title_en: Endoscope cleaning equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the specification discloses endoscope cleaning equipment. The endoscope cleaning apparatus includes: a body; a cleaning tank detachably disposed in the body, the cleaning tank having a space to accommodate an endoscope; and a piping system provided in the body, the piping system being for supplying the cleaning tank with liquid and/or gas for cleaning an endoscope. The endoscope cleaning equipment disclosed by the embodiment of the specification can automatically clean the inside and the outside of the endoscope and detect the air tightness of the endoscope, the cleaning process does not need manual operation, and the risk of cross infection can be reduced.

title_en: Novel dynamic balance test tool structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel dynamic balance test tool structure which comprises a workpiece, wherein a rotating shaft is fixedly connected to the outer side of the workpiece, a rotating part is fixedly connected to the outer side of the rotating shaft, and a fixing assembly is installed on the outer side of the rotating part. This novel dynamic balance test fixture structure, relative ratio has following advantage in the conventional art: the rotating head drives the threaded rod to rotate, the threaded rod moves upwards in the transverse plate, the threaded rod rotates in the round block through the inner bearing, the round block drives the first arc-shaped plate to move upwards, the first arc-shaped plate is made to leave the rotating part, the workpiece can be conveniently replaced, the use is convenient, the existing dynamic balance test tool structure is solved, the workpiece can not be randomly replaced, the use is inconvenient, an external power source stretches into the spline groove, the rotating shaft is driven to rotate in the first arc-shaped plate and the second arc-shaped plate through the rotating part, the workpiece is made to rotate, the connection with the external power source is facilitated, the existing dynamic balance test tool structure is solved, and the problem of connection with the external power source is not facilitated.

title_en: Method for rapidly screening natural products with transmembrane transport activity in high throughput manner
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of ion channel screening, and discloses a method for rapidly screening a natural product with transmembrane transmission activity in a high throughput manner, which comprises the following steps: (1) taking a phospholipid bilayer chloroform solution, drying in vacuum, adding a buffer solution containing a fluorescent probe, cooling and returning the temperature for multiple times, then extruding through a membrane to obtain a phospholipid monolayer vesicle suspension, and passing through a sephadex column to obtain a vesicle stock solution; (2) inoculating vesicle stock solution coated with the fluorescent probe into a black-wall opaque microplate, adding a buffer solution containing corresponding cations or anions into micropores, respectively adding a compound to be tested into the black-wall microplate, then testing the relative fluorescence intensity change of the fluorescent probe, and when the relative fluorescence intensity is gradually quenched or increased, the compound to be tested has transmembrane transmission activity.

title_en: Display module and image display thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a display module and an image display thereof. The display module comprises a circuit substrate, a plurality of image display units and at least one optical sensing component. The plurality of image display units are arranged on the circuit substrate and are arranged in a matrix manner. The optical sensing component is arranged at the position of the circuit substrate where the plurality of image display units are not arranged, and the ratio of the number of the image display units to the number of the optical sensing component is between 1 and 100000.

title_en: Method for evaluating upsetting deformation capability of wire rod for fastener
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for evaluating upsetting deformation capability of a wire rod for a fastener, which comprises the following steps of: measuring the tensile strength and the compressive strength of the material to be evaluated; calculating the tension-compression asymmetry of the material to be evaluated based on the measured tensile strength and compressive strength; upsetting a material to be evaluated to form a fastener, and measuring the head out-of-roundness of the head of the fastener; and evaluating the upsetting deformation capability of the material to be evaluated based on the tensile strength, the compressive strength, the tension-compression asymmetry and the head out-of-roundness obtained by measurement or calculation. The method for evaluating upsetting deformation capability of the wire rod material for the fastener combines the drawing and pressing asymmetry and the head out-of-roundness to evaluate the upsetting deformation capability of the material, and can definitely indicate the tissue uniformity or consistency of the material in the axial direction through the quantitative analysis of the drawing and pressing asymmetry; through the quantitative analysis of the head out-of-roundness, the tissue uniformity or consistency of the material in the radial direction can be clearly indicated.

title_en: Radio altimeter data processing method and device based on external information
abstract_en: The invention discloses a radio altimeter data processing method, a device, equipment and a storage medium based on external information, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a first altitude value of a radio altimeter at the current moment and a second altitude value at the previous moment; judging whether the height difference value of the radio altimeter at the current moment and the previous moment meets the altitude effective condition; the effective condition is that the height difference value is within a preset range of the external information difference value; if the height difference value meets the effective condition, outputting a first height value as the height value at the current moment; otherwise, determining and outputting the real height value at the current moment based on the second height value and the external information difference value. According to the method, the effectiveness of the altimeter data is judged in real time by acquiring the altitude difference value and the external information difference value between the current moment and the previous moment, and the error altitude data is corrected, so that the altitude data requirements of pilots in executing different flight tasks are met.

title_en: Aspheric lens detection system and method based on fringe transmission method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for detecting an aspheric lens based on a fringe transmission method, and the detection system provided by the invention mainly comprises: stripe generating device, condensing lens, spectroscope, main light path, auxiliary light path and computer. The invention adopts the sine phase shift stripe as the transmission light source, which can effectively improve the detection speed and precision of the system and enhance the anti-noise capability; the combination of the condenser lens and the microscope objective lens is adopted, so that the stripe light can cover the whole aspheric lens to be detected, the detection of the lenses with different calibers and surface shapes can be completed within a certain range, and the detection system has higher flexibility; the auxiliary light path symmetrical to the main light measuring path is arranged, so that the synchronous measurement of the transmission wave surface and the surface shape of the aspheric lens can be realized, the distortion and the aberration of the transmission wave surface and the surface shape can be obtained at one time, the system error is small, and the detection efficiency and the precision are high.

title_en: Polyurethane plastic course production process and detection method
abstract_en: The application relates to a polyurethane plastic runway production process and a detection method, and relates to the technical field of runway production, comprising a control module, an analog inspection module, an actual inspection module, a modeling module, a display module and a sampling module, wherein the sampling module is used for sampling a produced runway, numbering the sampled samples, respectively sending the samples with different numbers to the analog inspection module and the actual inspection module for inspection, the modeling module is used for scanning the samples with different numbers after inspection for modeling, sending modeling results to the control module, receiving the modeling results, carrying out damage analysis on the modeling results, and sending the damage degrees of the samples with different numbers to the display module for display. The application has the advantage of being convenient for detecting the service life of the runway.

title_en: Surface mounting type infrared detector
abstract_en: An infrared detector which can be surface-mounted and has excellent electromagnetic wave resistance, comprising: a metal can type infrared detector configured by disposing a pyroelectric photoelectric conversion element inside a metal package having a plurality of leads; and an insulating spacer having one or more through holes through which the plurality of leads can pass. The plurality of leads of the metal can type infrared detector are inserted into the through holes from one side of the upper surface of the insulating spacer, and the tip ends of the leads are bent toward the outer periphery of the insulating spacer on the lower surface of the insulating spacer, whereby the metal can type infrared detector is mechanically fixed to the insulating spacer.

title_en: Power supply and inspection device
abstract_en: The invention provides a power supply and an inspection apparatus with high efficiency and low noise. The power supply of the present invention supplies power to a heating mechanism for heating a measurement object capable of generating a measurement signal, the power supply including: an input unit for inputting an input signal obtained by reflecting a control signal on a differentiable periodic waveform having a frequency of 1kHz or less; and a switching amplification unit that amplifies the signal input from the input unit by the switching circuit and outputs the amplified signal.

title_en: A reconnaissance device for geology ground situation
abstract_en: The invention provides a investigation device for geological rock and soil conditions, which comprises a driving rod and a coring barrel, wherein the coring barrel comprises a cylindrical body, a cutting head and a wrapping assembly, a first air passage of the wrapping assembly, a guide rod, a first partition plate and a second partition plate which are arranged at intervals along the axial direction of the cylindrical body, and a cylindrical elastic bag film sleeved on the first partition plate, wherein the first partition plate and the second partition plate are respectively connected with the end part of the guide rod extending into the cylindrical body in a sealing manner, one end of the cylindrical elastic bag film is fixedly sealed with the edge of the second partition plate so as to form a first air chamber among the first partition plate, the second partition plate and the cylindrical elastic bag film, the guide rod is provided with a first air passage communicated with the first air passage, the guide rod is internally provided with a second air passage communicated with the first air passage and the first air passage, and the wrapping assembly is arranged, so that the cylindrical elastic bag film can be downwards wrapped on the periphery of a rock core through the wrapping assembly when the rock core is drilled, thereby realizing the effect of wrapping the rock core and guaranteeing the complete extraction of the loose rock core.

title_en: Measuring device for measuring clock signal jitter and board card
abstract_en: The invention relates to a measuring device and a board card for measuring clock signal jitter, wherein the calculating device is included in an integrated circuit device which comprises a universal interconnection interface and other processing devices. The computing device interacts with other processing devices to jointly complete computing operations specified by the user. The integrated circuit device may further include a storage device, which is connected to the computing device and the other processing device, respectively, for data storage of the computing device and the other processing device.

title_en: Navigation system and method based on quantum communication
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of communication navigation, and discloses a navigation system and a method based on quantum communication, which comprises the following steps: the master control module is used for controlling the overall system, running and sending instructions and serving as a core control end; the communication module is used for wirelessly receiving and transmitting data acquired by the satellite through a processing mode of a quantum communication mechanism, encrypting the data and transmitting the encrypted data again; the navigation module is used for positioning a preset destination according to the submitted geographic data and the positioning information of the navigation module, and planning a route; and the patrol correcting module is used for collecting interference information sources possibly existing in the information source identification range in real time in the positioning process and marking interference signals. The invention can effectively restrain and filter interference frequency signals, ensure normal receiving and sending of navigation signals, and can carry out route simulation preview according to previous navigation data when navigation failure occurs, thereby providing temporary route auxiliary navigation for users and ensuring safety.

title_en: High-temperature force sensor and production method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-temperature force sensor, which relates to the technical field of sensors and comprises an elastic body, a film sensing assembly and a temperature measuring assembly; the middle section of the elastic body is in a square column shape, and four groups of the film sensitive assemblies are arranged and are respectively arranged on four surfaces of the middle section of the elastic body; the shell is fixedly sleeved on the elastomer, and the thin film sensitive component is positioned in the shell; the temperature measuring component is arranged in the elastic body; the thin film sensitive assembly comprises a transition layer, an insulating film, a strain resistance film and a passivation protective film from inside to outside. The invention also discloses a production method of the high-temperature force sensor. On the basis of a high-temperature force sensor, the temperature measurement function is integrated, and the integrated measurement of force and temperature is realized; because the high-temperature sensitive layer is deposited, and the high-temperature stabilizing effect of the constant elastic alloy and the palladium resistance alloy is utilized, the temperature sensitivity precision of the force sensor is improved by one order of magnitude, and the precision of the sensor is correspondingly improved.

title_en: Lane line evaluation method and device and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for evaluating a lane line and a storage medium, which relate to the field of automatic driving, realize automatic evaluation of the lane line and improve the efficiency of the lane line evaluation. The specific scheme comprises the following steps: acquiring first initial data and second initial data, wherein the first initial data is acquired by a sensor to be detected in the driving process of a vehicle, the second initial data is acquired by a reference sensor in the driving process of the vehicle, and the first initial data and the second initial data are data of a target lane line acquired by the vehicle at the same time; processing the first initial data according to a prestored perception algorithm to obtain first lane line data, and processing the second initial data to obtain second lane line data; evaluating the first lane line data according to the second lane line data to obtain an evaluation result; and determining the lane line identification performance of the sensor to be detected according to the evaluation result of each moment in the target time period.

title_en: Foundation pit construction site monitoring device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a foundation pit construction site monitoring device, which comprises: the base body is movably positioned in the foundation pit; the spraying unit is arranged on the seat body; the wind speed detection unit is arranged on the spraying unit and is used for detecting the wind speed in the foundation pit; the processing unit is arranged in the seat body, and the spraying unit and the wind speed detection unit are both connected with the processing unit. The invention discloses a foundation pit construction site monitoring device, a base body is moved into a foundation pit, a wind speed detection unit monitors the wind speed in the foundation pit in real time and uploads the wind speed to a processing unit, when the wind speed is larger than a set threshold value, the processing unit sends a working instruction to a spraying unit, and the spraying unit works so as to spray water mist to control flying dust.

title_en: Detection device for detecting surface defects of curved surface and compensation lens group
abstract_en: The invention relates to a detection device for detecting surface defects of a curved surface and a compensation lens group, wherein the compensation lens group comprises: the first compensation lens is a positive meniscus lens, the first surface of the first compensation lens faces the curved surface and is an aspheric surface, and the second surface of the first compensation lens is a spherical surface; the second compensation lens is a negative meniscus lens and is arranged on the other side of the first compensation lens relative to the curved surface, and the first surface and the second surface of the second compensation lens are spherical surfaces; the third compensation lens is a positive meniscus lens and is arranged on the other side of the second compensation lens relative to the first compensation lens, and the first surface and the second surface of the third compensation lens are spherical surfaces. The detection device and the compensation lens group are beneficial to detecting the curved surface at the object plane end, complete the detection of the whole surface of the curved surface at one time, improve the detection efficiency and are beneficial to industrial production.

title_en: Transformer winding deformation monitoring system and method
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a system and a method for monitoring deformation of a transformer winding, wherein the system comprises the following components: the voltage source injects a first voltage signal into each phase of the secondary side of the transformer through the split-phase switch and the secondary side capacitance sensor at different output frequencies; the voltage measuring unit is used for measuring a second voltage signal of a sleeve end screen on the primary side of the transformer and transmitting the second voltage signal to the winding deformation diagnosis unit; and the winding deformation diagnosis unit determines the tangent value of each phase of the transformer under different output frequencies by using the first voltage signal and the second voltage signal injected by each phase, and judges whether the winding of the transformer is deformed or not by using the tangent value of each phase. The voltage signal is injected from the secondary side, so that slight winding deformation faults can be found, online monitoring can be realized, the capacitance sensor is favorable for injecting the voltage signal, and the secondary side voltage is low in grade and convenient to install.

title_en: Non-dripping flame-retardant B1-grade wire and cable and manufacturing system thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a non-dripping flame-retardant B1-grade wire and cable manufacturing system which comprises a conductive wire core, an enveloping module, a detection module, an adjusting module and an insulating extrusion module, wherein the enveloping module is used for enveloping the conductive wire core so as to form a plurality of protective layers nested on the periphery of the conductive wire core; the adjusting module is used for adjusting the angle of the conductive wire core so as to protect the periphery of the conductive wire core by matching with the insulating extrusion module; the insulation extrusion module is used for extruding the low-smoke halogen-free flame-retardant B1-grade polyolefin material on the outermost layer of the conductive wire core to form a protective layer for protecting the conductive wire core; the detection module detects insulating layer, filling layer, buffering insulating layer, metal isolation layer, flame retardant coating and the outer jacket of conductive core periphery respectively. According to the invention, through the matching of the detection module and the adjustment module, the adjustment module adjusts the position of the conductive wire core based on the detection data of the detection module, so that the eccentricity of the conductive wire core meets the requirements of the generation process.

title_en: Spherical internal detection system for gas pipeline
abstract_en: The invention relates to a spherical internal detection system of a gas pipeline, which is applied to the gas pipeline and comprises a detection ball; the detection ball includes: a spherical shell with the same diameter as the gas pipeline; the plurality of detection probes are circumferentially and parallelly distributed on the spherical shell and are used for detecting a stress concentration area of the gas pipeline to obtain a stress detection signal; and the computer system is arranged in the cavity inside the spherical shell, is respectively connected with each detection probe, is used for controlling the working state of the detection probes, and analyzes according to the stress detection signals and clock position information of the spherical shell so as to realize positioning analysis of the stress detection signals. The invention solves the problem that the elbow in the town gas pipeline is easy to be blocked by the spherical design of the equipment configuration, and realizes the on-line stress detection of the wall of the town gas pipeline.

title_en: Universal modularized test fixer
abstract_en: A modular test fixture configured to rapidly support differently configured test samples for testing.

title_en: Power device testing method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for testing a power device, wherein the method for testing the power device comprises the following steps: putting a power device to be tested into a module to be tested, and taking the power device as the device to be tested to be connected into a test circuit; inputting different voltage conditions; inputting a double-pulse signal through a grid driving signal; in the conducting process of a device to be tested, the inductance through which the current passes is obtained through the inductance module, and the magnitude of the current is adjusted according to the magnitude of the inductance; measuring voltage measurement data of the device to be measured according to the double-pulse signal through a clamping circuit; and detecting the current flowing through the measured value of the detection resistor, and combining the voltage measurement data to obtain the test result of the device to be tested. The power device testing method and the power device testing system can test the change condition of the dynamic on-resistance value of the power device during working, and the resistance value obtained through testing is high in precision and good in anti-interference performance.

title_en: Precast concrete apron bearing capacity detection device that splits
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of building detection equipment, in particular to a precast concrete cover plate crack resistance bearing capacity detection device which comprises a supporting platform, a detection power box, a thrust component and a detection mechanism, wherein the detection power box is connected with the supporting platform through a cylindrical rod, the thrust component is positioned in the detection power box, the detection mechanism is respectively connected with the supporting platform and the cylindrical rod and is matched with the thrust component for installation, and the detection mechanism comprises an elastic pad, an observation cylinder, a protruding plate, an observation component and a pressurizing component.

title_en: MiRNA accurate addressing and ultrasensitive detection equipment and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to miRNA accurate addressing and ultrasensitive detection equipment and method, the method comprises the steps of preparing an AFM probe, wherein the AFM probe comprises an AFM needle point and an AFM cantilever, and the AFM needle point is obtained by depositing a two-dimensional film on the diamond surface containing an NV color center through an atomic layer; and positioning and detecting the target miRNA coupling magnetic sphere by utilizing the AFM probe combined with the magnetic field module and the optical path system, wherein the surface of the target miRNA coupling magnetic sphere is modified with the DNA probe with the modifier and the target miRNA. According to the AFM probe of the diamond NV color center, an ODMR spectrum is obtained according to the change of magnetic field intensity through the magnetic effect between the AFM probe and the magnetic ball, magnetic imaging is realized, and a fluorescence intensity change spectrum is obtained through the fluorescence resonance energy transfer and fluorescence enhancement of the diamond NV color center and a modifier, so that the accurate addressing and ultrasensitive detection of in-vitro miRNA are realized through the cooperation of the AFM and an optical path system.

title_en: High-voltage cable connector with temperature monitoring function
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-voltage cable connector with a temperature monitoring function, and belongs to the technical field of power monitoring. The following technical scheme is provided, including plug assembly, stud, flat pad, nut, K type blanking cover and terminal cap, plug assembly is provided with preceding plug and back plug, and the one end of back plug has been seted up, and the one end of preceding plug and back plug are through dismantling the connection, and plug assembly all is provided with the through-hole, and all is provided with induction system installation component in the through-hole, and the effect is used for installing temperature, current detection device. According to the invention, through the matching of the mounting sleeve, the convex strip, the stop block, the terminal cap and the K-shaped plugging cover, the monitoring component can be arranged on the plug to monitor the real-time temperature of the cable connector. The temperature monitoring device is effectively protected, damage to the temperature monitoring device caused by other construction operations is greatly reduced, and real-time monitoring of the temperature monitoring device on the temperature of the cable joint is guaranteed.

title_en: Inertial navigation method based on Bayesian NAS
abstract_en: The invention provides an inertial navigation method based on Bayes NAS, which adopts an inertial/milemeter combined navigation mode, introduces Bayes optimization to search a neural framework, assists an integrated navigation system to further improve navigation accuracy, anti-jamming capability and stability under a satellite rejection environment, completes the Bayes optimization by extracting an upper computer for realizing the scheme on low-cost equipment, and dynamically optimizes delay, computing capability, FLAH, SRAM resources and the like of the system at the same time, has high accuracy and reliability, is mainly applied to inertial navigation systems with limited resources such as ground traveling vehicles, intelligent robots and the like, has deep learning capability, realizes high-efficiency algorithms on low-cost equipment, reduces equipment cost using deep learning, can only carry out conventional operation on a lower computer, and transfers a large amount of convolution type operation to the upper computer for carrying out, meanwhile, one upper computer can simultaneously support several navigation devices, and even the capability can be further improved by using a cloud computing mode.

title_en: Rubidium atomic clock drift control device and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rubidium atomic clock drift control device, which comprises a rubidium spectrum lamp, a first light intensity acquisition and processing module, a second light intensity acquisition and processing module, an excitation circuit, a CPU processing unit and a D/A converter. The invention carries out comprehensive treatment aiming at a plurality of factors influencing the drift coefficient of the rubidium atomic clock, namely the change of the self light intensity amplitude of the spectrum lamp, the change of the light intensity caused by a cavity bubble system (a filter bubble, an absorption bubble and the like) and the light frequency shift, thereby reducing the drift rate of the rubidium atomic clock and greatly improving the timekeeping performance index of the rubidium atomic clock.

title_en: Method and device for rapidly and comprehensively evaluating tunnel slag hole performance for machine-made sand
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a device for quickly and comprehensively evaluating tunnel slag performance for machine-made sand, which comprises the following steps of 1) sample manufacturing, namely quickly acquiring a drying and saturated and dry sample by adopting a vibration device (1), a temperature control device (3) and a weighing device (10). 2) Apparent density and water absorption testing, namely measuring the quality of the water discharged by the known quality saturated surface dry sample and heating to obtain the quality of the dry sample. 3) Crushing index and softening coefficient test, namely pressurizing, automatically screening and weighing the dried and saturated dry samples respectively. 4) Robustness testing-rapid testing of robustness based on temperature control, automatic screening and weighing. 5) And (3) automatically collecting and processing the data. The evaluation method and the device provided by the invention can be used for simultaneously and rapidly testing the physical and mechanical properties and the durability of the hole slag, solve the problems of long hole slag performance test period, single detection result and the like, and are suitable for rapid evaluation of the hole slag, pebbles/gravel and other mechanically-made sandstone parent rocks.

title_en: Intelligent sterilizing electric bathroom cabinet
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent sterilization electric bathroom cabinet, which comprises a bathroom cabinet body and lenses arranged on the bathroom cabinet body, wherein a plurality of hanging rods are arranged in the bathroom cabinet body, and a heating component is arranged in the bathroom cabinet body; the bathroom cabinet also comprises a pulley mechanism arranged inside the bathroom cabinet body; the detection assemblies are arranged at the positions, close to the two ends, of the hanging rod, and clamping assemblies are arranged at the positions, close to the inner walls of the two sides, of the bathroom cabinet body; the regulating and controlling component is arranged in the bathroom cabinet body; and set up in heating member surface power component, this electronic bathroom cabinet disinfects dries the towel through the heating member to detect the moist situation of towel under gravity sensor's effect, carry on spacingly under the combined action of detecting element and joint subassembly to the towel, and make detecting element and joint subassembly extrude the rolling action to the towel through power component, so that the contact area of towel and peg changes, thereby guarantees that the towel surface can be dried evenly.

title_en: Wheat variety purity detection method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a device and electronic equipment for detecting the purity of wheat varieties, wherein a sample set consisting of a group of target wheat varieties with known authenticity and other wheat varieties is used as a calibration set for modeling, a diffuse reflection near infrared spectrum and a diffuse transmission spectrum of the calibration set are collected and then fused to obtain a diffuse reflection diffuse transmission fused spectrum of a sample, a regression model of the fused spectrum and a wheat variety label is constructed by using a discriminant partial least square method, when a wheat sample to be detected is predicted, the fused spectrum of a sample of a small sample to be detected is obtained, the variety attribution of wheat is predicted by inputting the regression model, and the purity of the target variety in the wheat sample to be detected is calculated according to the wheat variety attribution. The purity detection of the wheat variety is realized accurately, objectively, quickly and simply without reagent consumption and sample damage.

title_en: Seawater ammonium nitrogen profile continuous analysis device and analysis method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a seawater ammonium-nitrogen profile continuous analysis device and an analysis method thereof, wherein the seawater ammonium-nitrogen profile continuous analysis device comprises a filtering device, a reagent bottle, a two-position three-way selector valve, a sampling device, a three-way valve, a gas diffusion device, a reaction coil, a fixed heating device, a fluorescence detector and a waste liquid recovery device; a method for continuously analyzing the ammonium nitrogen profile of seawater comprises the following steps: step S1, continuously inputting seawater into the analysis flow path; s2, filtering the input seawater by a filter; step S3, inputting the filtered seawater into a separation device to separate ammonium nitrogen in the seawater from a seawater substrate; step S4, inputting the separated ammonium-nitrogen solution into a detection device, and calculating the ammonium-nitrogen concentration in the seawater according to the measurement result; and step S5, measuring the concentration of the ammonium nitrogen standard solution according to the steps and monitoring the data quality. The method can quickly acquire the high-resolution and high-quality distribution data of the ammonio nitrogen profile of the true optical layer, and is high in accuracy and easy to operate and maintain.

title_en: Automatic judging system and method for residual magnetism of power plant transformer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for automatically judging residual magnetism of a power plant transformer, wherein the system comprises an excitation system, a magnetic field circuit breaker FMK, an excitation coil, a generator, a first current transformer, a second current transformer, a high-voltage transformer, a main transformer, a grid-connected circuit breaker, a first circuit breaker, a 6kV working A section, a second circuit breaker, a 6kV working B section and a generator set protection device, the excitation system is connected with the excitation coil through the magnetic field circuit breaker, the excitation coil is coupled with the generator, the output end of the generator is divided into two paths through the first current transformer, one path is connected with the high-voltage side of the high-voltage transformer through the second current transformer, the other path is connected with the system through the main transformer and the grid-connected circuit breaker, one path is connected with the 6kV working A section through the first circuit breaker, and the other path is connected with the 6kV working B section through the second circuit breaker, and the system and the method can automatically identify whether residual magnetism affecting the starting of the generator set exists.

title_en: Solid-state laser radar control method, control unit and solid-state laser radar
abstract_en: The invention provides a solid-state laser radar control method, a control unit and a solid-state laser radar, wherein the method comprises the steps of enabling a first gating device to gate a corresponding light-emitting unit and enabling a second gating device to gate a target photoelectric conversion element corresponding to the light-emitting unit according to a preset light-emitting sequence, and enabling the power supply voltage of the target photoelectric conversion element to be periodically changed by at least 1 period so as to complete scanning of a detection area corresponding to the light-emitting unit; after the scanning of the detection areas corresponding to all the light emitting units is completed, determining a detection result according to the light emitting time recorded by the first timer and the signal receiving time recorded by the second timer. According to the second gating device, one second timer serves a plurality of target photoelectric conversion elements, so that field detection is completed in the corresponding scanning mode, the number of amplifiers and timers required to be arranged for the solid-state laser radar can be effectively reduced, and the complexity of the radar is reduced.

title_en: Global surface frictional resistance testing method based on optical flow algorithm
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of wind tunnel tests, and discloses a global surface frictional resistance test method based on an optical flow algorithm, which comprises the following steps: coating a test oil solution on the surface of a model to be tested to form an oil film, and performing a wind tunnel test under the irradiation of an ultraviolet light source; continuously acquiring an oil film evolution image of the test oil on the model to be tested by adopting imaging equipment; deducing to obtain an oil film motion function based on the relation between the oil film brightness and the oil film thickness in the oil film evolution image; iteratively solving an oil film motion function by using an optical flow algorithm to obtain an oil film motion speed; and acquiring the surface friction resistance based on the functional relation between the surface friction and the oil film movement speed. The invention provides a surface friction resistance testing method which has no direct interference to a flow field and can obtain the surface friction resistance only by the brightness and thickness change information of an oil film.

title_en: Device and method for detecting radial clearance of aerospace bearing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a detection device for the radial clearance of an aerospace bearing, which comprises: the inner ring installation rod penetrates through the workbench, the first end of the inner ring installation rod is used for installing a bearing inner ring, the second end of the inner ring installation rod is connected with a gear in a rotating mode, the workbench is provided with a clamping detection assembly, and the clamping detection assemblies on the two sides are driven synchronously through the gear. A method for detecting the radial clearance of an aerospace bearing comprises the following steps: observing an initial numerical value of the detection piece when the bearing is not installed; installing a bearing outer ring; observing the displacement change numerical value displayed by the detection piece; and starting the driving mechanism to move the clamping plate, and observing the displacement variation displayed by the detection piece. The clamping detection assemblies on two sides are driven by the gears to synchronously move, so that the concentricity of the outer ring and the inner ring of the bearing is ensured, the workload is reduced, and the detection accuracy is improved; the applicability and the detection range are improved; by observing whether the radial gaps on the two sides are consistent or not, the detection accuracy is improved.

title_en: Ambient temperature acquisition method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for acquiring environmental temperature, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring a current temperature calibration value, wherein the current temperature calibration value is used for calibrating the temperature of equipment by utilizing the working heat of the equipment; determining a target temperature calibration value according to the current temperature calibration value and a preset temperature calibration value, acquiring a current actual temperature value detected by equipment, and acquiring an actual environment temperature value according to the target temperature calibration value and the current actual temperature value. Therefore, by adopting the method, the equipment can utilize the working heat of the equipment, and the target temperature calibration value of the environmental temperature is determined by acquiring the current temperature calibration value and combining the current temperature calibration value and the preset temperature calibration value, and the environmental temperature acquired by the equipment is calibrated by utilizing the target temperature calibration value, so that the accuracy of acquiring the environmental temperature by the equipment is improved.

title_en: Performance evaluation method, device and medium of ion capacitance type flexible pressure sensor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a performance evaluation method, a device and a medium of an ion capacitance type flexible pressure sensor, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining surface morphology data of an electrode layer and an electrolyte layer, and constructing a model; setting parameters and solving a model; counting the contact area between the electrode layer and the electrolyte layer under each loading condition, and drawing a curve; fitting the curve to obtain fitting parameters; acquiring a representative formula of each random rough surface ion capacitance type flexible pressure sensor; and the linearity and the bearing range of the sensor are predicted, estimated and compared by summarizing and comparing the data information in the function curve corresponding to the representation formula. According to the invention, the performance of the ion capacitive flexible pressure sensor is predicted by combining a simulation model and a mathematical formula aiming at different random rough surface morphology combinations, and the prediction result and the regulation scheme are verified by experiments, so that the accuracy is higher, and the ion capacitive flexible pressure sensor can be widely applied to the field of flexible wearable sensing and the field of random rough surface contact theory.

title_en: Piezoelectric ceramic piece pasting tool and process applied to tuning fork liquid level switch
