abstract_en: The invention discloses a piezoelectric ceramic piece pasting tool and a piezoelectric ceramic piece pasting process applied to a tuning fork liquid level switch, which belong to the technical field of tuning fork liquid level switches and comprise a main fixed base plate, an insulating piece fixed base plate, a piezoelectric ceramic piece position plate, a compression column fixed plate and a compression column top plate; the insulation piece fixing base plate is arranged on the main fixing base plate and is provided with a plurality of insulation piece fixing holes, and the piezoelectric ceramic piece position plate is provided with a plurality of piezoelectric ceramic piece position holes; the pressing column position plate is arranged on the main fixed bottom plate and is provided with a plurality of pressing column position holes for the pressing columns to pass through; the compression column fixing plate is arranged above the compression column position plate and is provided with a plurality of compression column through holes; the compression leg top plate is arranged above the compression leg fixing plate and is provided with a compression bar through hole for the compression bar to pass through. The invention standardizes the thickness of the glue, the pressure during curing and the position of the piezoelectric ceramic plate in the production process, can save a large amount of production time and reduce the rejection rate in the production process.

title_en: High-stability interference device based on phase locking between multi-core optical fiber cores
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-stability interference device based on phase locking among multi-core optical fiber cores, which comprises: the device comprises a laser, a first polarization-preserving coupler, a fan-in end, a multi-core optical fiber, a fan-out end, a polarization state adjusting device and an optical phase-locked loop; the laser, the first polarization maintaining coupler, the fan-in end, the multi-core optical fiber and the fan-out end are sequentially connected along the optical path transmission direction; the polarization state adjusting device is connected between the optical phase-locked ring and the fan outlet end, or the polarization state adjusting device is connected between the optical phase-locked ring and the fan inlet end; the multi-core optical fiber is used as a transmission channel of the local oscillator light and the signal light, and simultaneously plays a role in preliminarily inhibiting relative disturbance noise of the two beams of light; and the optical phase-locked loop further dynamically eliminates the disturbance noise of the local oscillator light and the signal light. The invention can realize the stable transmission of the long-distance optical fiber link and obtain high measurement precision in the aspect of coherent light interference measurement.

title_en: Wall perpendicularity measurement detection equipment for building construction
abstract_en: The invention discloses wall surface verticality measuring and detecting equipment for building construction, which belongs to the field of building engineering detecting equipment and comprises a base, wherein the upper end of the base is fixedly connected with a fixed frame, the inside of the fixed frame is rotatably connected with a movable pipe, the lower end of the base is fixedly connected with a motor, an output shaft of the motor is connected with the movable pipe, and the front side end of the fixed frame is movably connected with a detecting device. According to the wall surface inclination detection device, the detection plate is in contact with the wall surface, then the motor is started to drive the movable tube to rotate, the movable tube can drive the connecting tube to move upwards when rotating, the connecting tube can drive the detection plate to move along the wall surface when moving upwards, the detection plate can compress the reset spring in the moving process when the wall surface is inclined, the sliding column can push the prompt plate, and the inclination direction and the inclination angle of the wall surface can be clearly observed by observing the prompt plate.

title_en: Self-adaptive adjustment polishing method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a polishing method and device capable of self-adaptive adjustment, which comprises initializing a polishing device, acquiring an initial position coordinate, a probe position coordinate and a product position of a polishing assembly, controlling the polishing assembly to pick up and carry a probe to move to the product position according to the initial position coordinate, the probe position coordinate and the product contour point position of the polishing assembly, detecting the contour point coordinates of the product contour point position one by one and assigning the contour point coordinates to program polishing point positions to generate a polishing point parameter sequence; obtaining polishing reference parameters, fitting a polishing path based on the polishing reference parameters and the polishing point parameter sequence, and determining the polishing attitude of a polishing assembly; the polishing assembly drives the probe to reset, and polishing operation is carried out according to the polishing path and the corresponding polishing gesture; the whole process polishing assembly carries out self-adaptive posture adjustment, manual machine adjustment is not needed, polishing quality is reliable, and polishing efficiency is high.

title_en: Novel open framework silver bromide compound, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel open framework silver bromine compound, the chemical formula of which is pIm [ (Hmta)  2  (NH  3  )Ag  8  Br  9  ]Wherein pIm is 1-propyl-3-methylimidazole cation, and Hmta is hexamethylenetetramine. The structure of the novel open framework silver bromide compound is a three-dimensional open framework structure consisting of [ Ag ]  8  Br  9  ]  ‑  The infinite anion layer expands into a three-dimensional hybrid framework through Hmta connection, andpIm  +  the cations are located in the channels to balance the charge of the framework. The invention is found by experiments that: the compound shows a special fluorescent double-emission phenomenon, and emission peaks are respectively positioned at 516 nm and 725 nm. The compound shows obvious thermotropic fluorescence discoloration in the temperature range of 80-300K, and the intensity ratio of emission peaks at 516 nm and 725nm shows a good linear relation to the temperature in the temperature range of 100-200K, so that the compound is a sensitive ratio type fluorescence temperature sensing material.

title_en: Fault diagnosis method, device and equipment for oil and gas pipeline system moving equipment
abstract_en: The specification provides a fault diagnosis method, device and equipment for oil and gas pipeline system mobile equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting vibration signals of the oil and gas pipeline system dynamic equipment to be detected; performing continuous wavelet transformation on the vibration signal to obtain a two-dimensional time-frequency image; inputting the two-dimensional time-frequency image into a pre-constructed convolutional neural network fault diagnosis model, and performing fault diagnosis on the oil and gas pipeline system dynamic equipment to be detected by using the convolutional neural network fault diagnosis model to obtain a fault diagnosis result; and analyzing the fault diagnosis result by using a LIME algorithm to obtain fault analysis information, wherein the fault analysis information is obtained by marking different energy intensities on a two-dimensional time-frequency image, and the different energy intensities represent different contribution degrees of a time-frequency region corresponding to the energy intensities to the fault diagnosis result. By utilizing the embodiment of the specification, a complicated characteristic extraction process can be avoided, uncontrollability of a diagnosis result is broken, and fault diagnosis accuracy is improved.

title_en: Millimeter wave radar system and chip data transmission method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a millimeter wave radar system and a chip data transmission method thereof, wherein the method comprises the steps that a main processing unit sends an instruction for acquiring a calculation result of a constant false alarm rate of each millimeter wave chip to a first-stage millimeter wave chip; the first-stage millimeter wave chip sends the calculation result of the constant false alarm rate to the next-stage millimeter wave chip; the intermediate millimeter wave chip compares the calculation result of the constant false alarm rate of the upper millimeter wave chip with the calculation result of the constant false alarm rate of the intermediate millimeter wave chip, eliminates the calculation result of the constant false alarm rate corresponding to the same target, and sends the calculation result of the constant false alarm rate of the upper millimeter wave chip and the calculation result of the constant false alarm rate of the intermediate millimeter wave chip to the lower millimeter wave chip; and the final millimeter wave chip sends the constant false alarm rate calculation result of each millimeter wave chip after the same target is removed to the main processing unit. The invention also provides a millimeter wave radar system for implementing the method. The invention can improve the data transmission efficiency of the millimeter wave radar system.

title_en: Method for optimizing superconducting magnet passive offset type external magnetic shielding coil
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of superconducting magnet system optimization, and discloses a superconducting magnet passive offset type external magnetic shielding coil optimization method, which comprises the following steps: s1, giving initial parameters of a group of shielding coils; s2, obtaining a shielding coefficient according to the initial parameters SF An expression; s3, establishing a target function with the volumes of all the shielding coil superconducting wires as the minimum; s4, establishing a nonlinear programming mathematical model according to the objective function and the constraint condition; and S5, solving the nonlinear programming mathematical model to obtain the optimal design parameters of the shielding coil, which meet the constraints of shielding coefficients and the like. The volume of the superconducting wire of the shielding coil is used as the minimum target, so that the minimum wire is ensured, and the cost is lowest. The volume is taken as a target, the shielding coefficient is taken as a constraint condition, the usage amount of the superconducting wire can be minimized under the condition of meeting the shielding effectiveness, and the maximization of the volume ratio of the shielding effectiveness and the superconducting wire is realized.

title_en: Electromagnetic composite friction nano power generation device and self-powered vehicle weight measurement system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electromagnetic composite friction nano power generation device and a self-powered vehicle weight measurement system, wherein the electromagnetic composite friction nano power generation device comprises a top cover, a multi-layer shell, a base, an FEP (fluorinated ethylene propylene) plectrum, a copper patch electrode, an aluminum shaft, a bearing, a magnet and a coil; a magnet and an FEP pulling sheet are fixed under the top cover; the bearing and the multi-layer shell are fixed on the base, each layer of shell is wound with a coil, each layer of shell is stuck with a copper patch electrode to rub against the FEP pulling sheet, and the device greatly improves the output power through parallel connection and recombination. The self-powered vehicle weight measuring system comprises a loading plate, a rack, a gear bolt, a spring, a supporting seat, a copper patch electrode, a DAQ data acquisition card and display equipment, wherein the friction nano generator sends out a signal through displacement of the loading plate, so that the measured weight is determined.

title_en: Intelligent monitoring and detecting device of HDS support frame
abstract_en: The application discloses an intelligent monitoring and detecting device of an HDS (high density discharge) supporting frame, which belongs to the technical field of bridge construction and comprises a supporting frame and a splicing piece, wherein the splicing piece comprises a transverse plate and two side plates, a plurality of stress pieces are attached to each supporting frame, a controller and a wireless communication module are further arranged among the plurality of supporting frames, the output ends of the stress pieces are electrically connected with a plurality of input ends of the controller in a one-to-one correspondence manner so as to output bending signals of the supporting frame, the output end of the controller is electrically connected with the input end of the wireless communication module, and the wireless communication module can send a plurality of bending signals to a network server through a network. In the long-term use process of the support frame, the stress sheet can feed back bending signals of the current support frame to the controller, and the controller sends a plurality of bending signals to the network server through the wireless communication module, so that a user can monitor the bending degree of the support frames from the appointed network address through the electronic equipment.

title_en: Method and device for acquiring modal parameters
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a method and a device for acquiring modal parameters, electronic equipment and a computer readable storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: determining a power spectral density function of the plurality of channel turbulence response signals; processing a matrix corresponding to the power spectral density function based on frequency domain decomposition to obtain a maximum singular value curve; and fitting the maximum singular value curve in the target frequency range based on an orthogonal polynomial, and calculating to obtain modal parameters. The method and the device solve the problems of complex processing process and large error of the modal parameter estimation method in the related technology, and achieve the technical effect of effectively improving the performance and the precision of modal parameter estimation.

title_en: Toughness detection equipment for curtain fabric
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of curtain cloth detection, in particular to toughness detection equipment for curtain cloth. The toughness detection equipment for the curtain cloth comprises a workbench, wherein the upper surface of the workbench is connected with a first bottom plate and a second bottom plate; the curtain fabric clamping mechanisms with the multiple constraint points are two in number and are respectively connected with the first base plate and the second base plate; the toughness detection mechanism is connected with the workbench. The toughness detection equipment for the curtain cloth has the advantage of high use stability.

title_en: Air leakage detection equipment and detection method for electronic thermometer
abstract_en: The invention relates to an electronic thermometer air leakage detection device and a detection method, which belong to the technical field of electronic thermometer air leakage detection. The detection part comprises a test fixture, a gas storage tank and a pressure sensor, the electronic thermometer to be detected is placed in the cavity of the test fixture, the gas storage tank is used for supplying gas with preset pressure to the cavity of the test fixture, and the pressure sensor is used for detecting the pressure in the cavity of the test fixture to obtain a cavity pressure value. The processing component is used for processing the cavity pressure value, and whether each electronic thermometer to be detected leaks greatly or leaks slightly is determined, so that the electronic thermometers can be simultaneously detected in the air leakage process, a plurality of detection components are arranged, a plurality of electronic thermometers can be simultaneously detected, and the detection efficiency is improved.

title_en: Measuring height differences in patterns on semiconductor wafers
abstract_en: An improved technique for determining height differences in patterns provided on semiconductor wafers uses actual measurements (e.g., measurements from SEM images) and a height difference determination model. In one version of the model, the measurable variable of the model is a function of the change in depth (i.e., relative brightness) expressed as a shadow, where the depth of the shadow depends on: the height difference and the width difference between two features on a semiconductor wafer. In another version of the model, the measurable variable is represented as a function of the change in measured distance between two feature points on the actual image of the periodic structure relative to the change in the angle of inclination of the scanning electron beam.

title_en: PRM route planning method based on AIS data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a PRM route planning method based on AIS data, which comprises the following steps: carrying out gridding treatment on the electronic chart; extracting a high-frequency historical track point set based on AIS data of the ship; extracting channel information in the electronic chart, and randomly selecting sampling points in a non-channel area in a navigable area to form a sampling point set; converting the high-frequency historical track point set into grid coordinate system coordinates, fusing the grid coordinate system coordinates with the sampling point set, connecting the points in the point set according to a certain distance range, performing collision detection on the connected edges, and adding the edges which cannot be intersected with the navigation obstructing area into the edge set to obtain a path network; and searching the shortest path in the path network as the optimal route by using an A-x algorithm. According to the invention, the PRM algorithm is used to randomly select sampling points in the navigable area on the basis of the AIS data, so that the safety of the planned course and the comprehensiveness of the coverage area can be considered.

title_en: Ecological risk evaluation method for heavy metal pollution of acid mineral wastewater bottom sediment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of environmental ecological risk assessment, and provides an ecological risk assessment method for heavy metal pollution of acid mineral wastewater bottom mud. Inputting a corresponding calculation formula according to the measured effective heavy metal concentration, carrying out risk assessment and then carrying out corresponding treatment measures according to an assessment result. Determining sampling points; extracting a leaching solution by sample pretreatment; determining the concentration of heavy metal in the sample leaching solution; calculating the variation coefficient of each heavy metal, and analyzing the heavy metal pollution degree and the pollution source mode of the acid mine water polluted water area according to the content and the variation coefficient of each heavy metal; and (3) carrying out ecological risk evaluation on the heavy metals in sediments in the acid mine water pollution area of the mountain bottom river by adopting a potential environmental risk index method, and comprehensively evaluating the heavy metal pollution condition of the bottom sediment by combining the variation coefficient result. The pollution condition of the heavy metal elements at the sampling points and the comprehensive pollution degree of all the heavy metal elements are comprehensively known, the ecological risk condition is determined, and theoretical support and method reference are provided for the prevention and treatment of the acidic mineral wastewater.

title_en: Motor life test fixture
abstract_en: The invention discloses a motor service life testing jig which comprises a base, wherein a first support, a second support and a limiting support are respectively arranged on one side of the base, the first support is used for fixing a motor, and a limiting plate is arranged at the top of the limiting support; the magnetic hysteresis brake is arranged on the second bracket; the two ends of the connecting component are respectively connected with the motor and the hysteresis brake, the connecting component is provided with a limiting block and a magnet, and when the motor rotates, the two sides of the limiting block are respectively abutted against the two sides of the limiting plate; and the detection circuit board is arranged on one side of the limiting plate close to the magnet. According to the motor service life testing jig, a simulated working environment is provided for the motor for testing, and the service life of the motor in the simulated environment can be tested through the motor service life testing jig.

title_en: Pin shaft pressing force detection equipment for chain detection and operation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of chain detection, in particular to a pin shaft pressing force detection device for chain detection and an operation method thereof. The invention provides a pin shaft pressing force detection device for chain detection and an operation method thereof, wherein the pin shaft pressing force detection device can protect a chain from deformation and ensure that the position of a pin shaft does not deviate in the process of detecting the pin shaft extrusion pressure. The utility model provides a chain detects uses round pin axle pressure power check out test set, includes base, slide rail, screw rod, screw thread seat, detector etc. installs the slide rail on the base, and the even interval of antetheca of slide rail is installed and is used for instructing the instruction piece that expandes back chain round pin axle position, and the screw rod rotary type is installed in the slide rail, and the detector passes through the screw thread seat to be installed on the screw rod. The chain automatic unfolding device disclosed by the invention can automatically unfold the chain after the chain is installed, is convenient to use, and the backward moving bearing plate can support the bottom of the unfolded chain, so that the chain is prevented from deforming to change the position of the pin shaft during detection.

title_en: Atmospheric particulate collection device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an atmospheric particulate collection device, which comprises a shell, wherein an air inlet and an air outlet are respectively formed in two ends of the shell, a fan is arranged at the air inlet, and a sampling mechanism is arranged between the air inlet and the air outlet in the shell; the sampling mechanism comprises slide bars arranged at two sides in the shell, the slide bars are arranged in two rows, the slide bars in the two rows are staggered with each other in the vertical direction, a dust sampling film is connected between every two adjacent slide bars in the horizontal direction, and each layer of dust sampling film in the vertical direction is folded in sequence; release the second slide bar on right side, and left slide bar keeps static, is favorable to folding the taking in with the dust sampling membrane after the sample, and struts new dust sampling membrane and take a sample, and the particulate matter in the air can be carried out a lot of samplings to repeated above-mentioned process to dust sampling membrane after the sample is folded and is stored, thereby is favorable to later stage staff to take it.

title_en: Based on Au/SnO 2 Nitrogen dioxide sensor of nano wire and preparation thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of gas sensors, and particularly relates to a gas sensor based on Au/SnO  2  A nitrogen dioxide sensor of a nanowire and preparation thereof. The Au/SnO prepared by the electrostatic spinning method  2  The nano wire is used as a sensitive material, metal Au is doped, the concentration of oxygen ions on the surface of the composite material is increased through the excellent catalytic performance of the nano wire, and SnO is reacted with the nano wire  2  Formation of Schottky barrier and bulk Hot Electron injection SnO from localized plasma vibration under UV irradiation  2  Au/SnO (indium tin oxide)/free electron concentration synergistically promoted by adding free electrons into conduction band  2  NO of nanowires  2  The sensor obtains high response, short response/recovery time and low response/recovery time under the UV illumination at room temperatureLimit of detection of NO at room temperature  2  The detection method has wide application prospect.

title_en: Method for detecting methyl isocyanate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a detection method of methyl isocyanate, which comprises the following steps: 1) sample pretreatment: adding a mixed solution of hydrochloric acid and acetic acid into a sample to be detected, and uniformly mixing the solution by shaking; heating for degradation, and cooling to room temperature after the reaction is finished; fixing the volume of the reaction product by using a methanol water solution to obtain a sample solution; adding acetonitrile-methanol mixed solution containing formic acid into the solid phase extraction pore plate, then adding the sample solution into the solid phase extraction pore plate, and uniformly mixing; applying positive pressure above the solid phase extraction pore plate to enable the sample solution to pass through the filler of the solid phase extraction pore plate for purification; collecting the purified solution flowing out of the lower part of the solid phase extraction pore plate as a test sample; 2) and detecting the test sample by adopting a liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry method, and then calculating by utilizing a standard curve to obtain the content of the methyl isocyanate in the sample to be detected. The method can remove endogenous interferents, has small matrix effect, simple operation and high efficiency, and has high accuracy and precision.

title_en: Method for detecting illegal additives in health care product and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of detection and analysis, and particularly relates to a method for detecting illegal additives in a health-care product and application thereof. The method for detecting illegal additives in the health care product specifically comprises the following steps: s1, crushing a health product, adding an organic solvent, performing ultrasonic extraction, centrifuging, taking a supernatant to obtain a solution I, adding water into the residual residue, heating in a water bath, centrifuging, taking the supernatant to obtain a solution II, mixing the solution I and the solution II, drying by blowing with nitrogen, redissolving with an acetonitrile aqueous solution, and filtering to obtain a product to be detected; the organic solvent is a mixed organic solvent of ethanol, hexamethylphosphoramide and 3-hydroxypropionic acid. And S2, performing HPLC-MS/MS determination on the to-be-detected product. The invention adopts the liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry to detect 18 illegally added medicines in the health care product, and verifies from aspects such as sensitivity, precision, recovery rate, stability and the like, which shows that the method has the advantages of rapidness, accuracy, simplicity, convenience and the like, and has good practical application value.

title_en: Single-phase series ferroresonance detection and type identification method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for single-phase series ferroresonance detection and type identification, which carry out boundary processing through time window movement, carry out frequency spectrum analysis on phase voltage in a window and identify harmonic frequency; comparing the mean envelope curve and the harmonic frequency with the types in the fault type judgment table to obtain a fault type judgment result; the time window is utilized to carry out sliding detection, when the ferromagnetic resonance mode changes, the change of the signal characteristics can be extracted in time, and the self-adaptability of the method is ensured.

title_en: Real aperture scanning radar super-resolution imaging method based on improved regularization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real-aperture scanning radar super-resolution imaging method based on improved regularization, which specifically utilizes the statistical property of the scattering coefficient of echo data, adopts a moment estimation method to estimate a parameter p, firstly calculates the 1 and 2-order absolute central moments of the echo data, and further adopts a function fitting strategy to fit an inverse function of a generalized Gaussian function by a hyperbola in order to realize quick estimation. The method realizes reasonable estimation of the parameter p by utilizing the statistical characteristics of the echo data, avoids the limitation of selecting the value of the shape parameter p through experience, simultaneously ensures that the super-resolution result has higher precision and faster operation speed, overcomes the limitation of manually selecting the value of p according to experience, improves the self-adaption degree of the Lp norm regularization method, effectively reduces the imaging error caused by norm selection, enhances the continuity of the target, meets the requirements of different imaging scenes, improves the operation efficiency and is more beneficial to practical engineering application.

title_en: Test system, test method, electronic device, and computer storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a test system, a test method, electronic equipment and a computer storage medium, wherein the test system comprises: the intelligent voice test system comprises test control equipment, intelligent voice equipment to be tested and photosensitive equipment, wherein the intelligent voice equipment is provided with a state indicator lamp; the photosensitive equipment and the state indicator lamp are arranged in the same light shielding space, and the photosensitive equipment is connected with the test control equipment; wherein: the test control equipment is used for sending a state test signal to the intelligent voice equipment; the intelligent voice equipment is used for controlling the state indicator lamp to change the light emitting state according to the state test signal; the photosensitive equipment is used for sensing the light change of the state indicator lamp and sending a corresponding signal to the test control equipment; and the test control equipment is also used for obtaining a state test result of the intelligent voice equipment according to the signal sent by the photosensitive equipment.

title_en: Analyte detection and methods thereof
abstract_en: Methods and systems for analyte detection in a sample, and more particularly a biological sample, are disclosed. Some methods and systems are particularly directed to differentiating and/or identifying cell types in a biological sample (e.g., a blood sample) by adding antibodies specific for a predetermined CD antigen. Other methods and systems relate to controlling the dynamic range of an assay for analyte detection.

title_en: Calibration method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a calibration method, a calibration device, calibration equipment and a storage medium. The method is applied to a calibration system, and comprises the following steps: driving a camera to move above the convex calibration block through a mechanical arm, and shooting a first image of the convex calibration block through the camera; acquiring a first included angle between a target edge of the convex calibration block and a first image boundary according to the first image; acquiring a target height map corresponding to the first image through a laser sensor; determining a second included angle between the target edge of the convex calibration block and the boundary of the target height map according to the target height map; determining an included angle error between the camera and the laser sensor according to the first included angle and the second included angle; and horizontally calibrating the camera and the laser sensor according to the included angle error. According to the technical scheme, the manual participation in the calibration process can be reduced, the calibration result is more precise and accurate, and the consistency of the equipment when leaving a factory is ensured.

title_en: Stretch bender wire sensor and stretch bender adjusting method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a wire pulling sensor of a stretch bender and an adjusting method of the stretch bender, wherein the wire pulling sensor of the stretch bender comprises a rotating base, a wire pulling sensor and a bracket, the rotating base can be arranged on a swing arm cable-stayed bridge of the stretch bender, one end of the bracket is rotationally connected with the rotating base, and the wire pulling sensor is arranged at the end of the bracket; the other end of support can extend to the one end of the mould of stretch bender, is equipped with the guide structure that a plurality of was led for the acting as go-between of acting as go-between the sensor on the support, and the one end of acting as go-between is located the sensor of acting as go-between, and the other end of acting as go-between can be connected with the mould other end, and the part of acting as go-between and mould profile level tangent through guide structure derivation can be acted as go-between. The invention can quickly obtain the accurate position information of the stretching cylinder and the swinging cylinder of a certain product stretch bender, can greatly reduce the waste caused by the trial pulling of the product, and improves the working efficiency and the quality of the stretch bender.

title_en: Purple phosphazene/graphene temperature-sensitive sensor and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a purple phosphazene/graphene temperature-sensitive sensor and a preparation method thereof, wherein a chemical vapor deposition method is adopted to prepare a graphene film, the graphene film and the purple phosphazene are compounded to prepare a heterojunction, and preparing an electrode on the graphene film of the heterojunction to obtain the purple phosphorus graphene/graphene temperature-sensitive sensor with high temperature sensitivity, so that the response to the temperature can be realized quickly and efficiently.

title_en: Testing device and testing method for tearing of lithium battery insulating tape
abstract_en: The invention discloses a testing device and a testing method for tearing of a lithium battery insulating tape, and belongs to the technical field of tape tensile testing. The utility model provides a testing arrangement that lithium cell insulating tape was torn, includes: a base plate; the rotating screw rod is rotatably connected to the bottom plate; the clamping components are symmetrically connected to the bottom plate and used for fixing two ends of the insulating adhesive tape; the screw rod seat is fixedly connected to the clamping assembly and is in threaded connection with the rotary screw rod; the sliding pressure rod is connected to the bottom plate in a sliding mode and is positioned between the two groups of clamping assemblies; connecting a pull rope; the guide wheels are symmetrically arranged; the clamping assembly, the screw rod seat and the rotary screw rod are arranged, so that the insulation tape can be conveniently torn and pulled, the detection effect is good, the friction block is arranged, the insulation tape can be heated, the influence on the insulation tape when the temperature rises in the use process of the lithium battery is simulated, and the detection effect of the tearing and pulling test is further improved.

title_en: Floor determination method, device, terminal equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a floor determining method, a device, terminal equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a plurality of historical direct change information; according to the altitude change value intervals respectively corresponding to the plurality of historical direct change information, evaluating each floor height value contained in the floor height range to determine the target floor height; acquiring the air pressure value of the terminal equipment in a building in real time by an air pressure meter, and determining the real-time altitude according to the air pressure value; and determining the target floor where the terminal equipment is located according to the real-time altitude and the target floor height. By implementing the embodiment of the application, the height of the single floor of the building where the terminal equipment is located can be accurately determined, and the accuracy of the determined target floor where the terminal equipment is located can be improved.

title_en: Tool structure for automatically testing valve
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tool structure for automatically testing a valve, which is characterized in that a driving seat is connected to a linear motor in a sliding manner, the head end of the driving seat is fixedly connected with a right-end jacking column through a push rod, a sliding block is arranged above a valve seat, a left vertical plate and a right vertical plate of the sliding block are respectively fixedly connected with the left-end jacking column and the right-end jacking column, the left-end jacking column and the right jacking column respectively penetrate through a left end cover and a right end cover of the valve seat and then movably extend into a valve mounting cavity in the valve mounting cavity, a vertical quick clamp is arranged at the top of the valve seat, a fixed contact of the vertical quick clamp abuts against the surface of the left end cover, a displacement sensor is arranged beside the valve seat, and the displacement sensor is fixedly connected with the driving seat. The tool structure adopts a new design principle and structure, is used for measuring the performance test of valve parts, and can automatically change the moving position of the valve and automatically record the valve test curve by controlling the automatic valve testing tool through a computer. And the valve installation is simplified by a vertical quick clamping mode, and the valve part testing efficiency is improved.

title_en: V-shaped insulator string flashover fault simulation method based on bird dung pollution
abstract_en: The invention provides a V-shaped insulator string flashover fault simulation method based on bird dung pollution, which relates to the technical field of power transmission line maintenance, and is characterized in that an environment model is established, then the actual running condition of the V-shaped insulator string and the dropping state of bird dung are simulated, and model parameters are set, so that the situation that the flashover fault occurs due to the change of a space electric field in the dropping process of the bird dung is simulated, and a theoretical basis is provided for the fault tracing and optimization design of the V-shaped insulator string; the simulation method provided by the invention fully considers the actual structure of the V-shaped insulator string, and in the simulation process, the modeling and simulation calculation are carried out on the V-shaped insulator string and the wet pollutants accumulated on the surrounding three-dimensional space and surface of the V-shaped insulator string due to long-term operation, the calculation precision is high, and various influence factors are fully considered.

title_en: Method for rapidly determining IGBT driving resistance value under high-voltage condition
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electric power, and relates to a method for quickly determining an IGBT driving resistance value under a high-voltage condition, which comprises the following steps: s1, determining the charging electric quantity; s2, calculating an equivalent parasitic capacitance; and S3, calculating a driving resistance value. The method can rapidly calculate the optimized driving resistance value by utilizing the inherent parasitic capacitance of the driver and the change amount of the design voltage of the use occasion, most of the power is not lost on the driving resistance, the phenomenon that the peak voltage breaks through the grid is avoided, a large number of hardware debugging processes are omitted, the explosion danger of a welding debugging experiment in a high-voltage scene is avoided, and the time is saved.

title_en: Water level detection system and method for steam box
abstract_en: The invention provides a water level detection system and a water level detection method for a steam box, which comprise the following steps: the device comprises a light emitting tube, N light receiving tubes and a microcontroller; the light emitting tubes are arranged on one side of the top of a water tank in the steam box, and each light receiving tube is sequentially arranged on the other side of the top of the water tank and connected with the microcontroller, wherein N is greater than or equal to 2; the light emitting tube is used for emitting light; the light receiving tube is used for receiving reflected light under the reflection of the liquid level and jumping from a high level to a low level; the microcontroller is used for determining the light receiving tube with level jump according to the pin and determining the size of the liquid level according to the light receiving tube with level jump; this application does not receive the influence of quality of water, and is small, easily installation, can the accurate water level of measuring in the water tank.

title_en: Low-turbulence operating room air quality monitoring and sampling device and using method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses low turbulent flow operating room air quality monitoring sampling device and application method thereof, mainly including low turbulent flow purification subassembly, low turbulent flow purification subassembly is used for circulating the interior air of operating room, purify, low turbulent flow purification subassembly is provided with two at least air outlets, at least one air outlet is towards the operating room indoor, at least one air outlet is kept away from in the operating room indoor, it is provided with the sampling subassembly to keep away from on the indoor air outlet of operating room, the sampling subassembly is used for taking a sample to the air of following the air outlet exhaust. When the air detection is not needed in the operating room, the air circulation and the purification can be carried out on the interior of the operating room by the low turbulent flow purification assembly, and the purified air can be discharged from the air outlet facing to the indoor side of the operating room, so that the low-speed air circulation in the operating room is driven. When needing air detection, then can be discharged towards the sampling component with the air after purifying, sampling component can take a sample and finally accomplish the detection to the air in the operating room afterwards.

title_en: Low-voltage circuit breaker and method and device for identifying terminal faults thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a low-voltage circuit breaker and a method and a device for identifying terminal faults thereof, wherein the method comprises the following steps: calculating a characteristic value for representing contact resistance according to the temperature value and the current value of the low-voltage circuit breaker terminal in advance; acquiring an actual temperature value and an actual current value of the low-voltage circuit breaker terminal, and calculating to obtain an actual temperature rise value of the low-voltage circuit breaker terminal according to the actual temperature value and the actual current value; and determining the state of the low-voltage circuit breaker terminal according to the actual temperature rise value and the characteristic value. According to the method for identifying the fault of the low-voltage circuit breaker terminal, whether the terminal of the low-voltage circuit breaker has the fault or not can be identified only by utilizing the terminal temperature and the current of the low-voltage circuit breaker, the environmental temperature does not need to be measured, and the economic cost can be saved.

title_en: Method and device for determining subjective evaluation of vehicle abnormal sound based on objective test
abstract_en: The invention relates to a subjective evaluation method for determining vehicle abnormal sound based on objective test, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a subjective and objective evaluation database, wherein the subjective and objective evaluation database at least stores sound quality parameter data and corresponding subjective evaluation scores which are respectively obtained based on a large number of historical vehicle abnormal sound tests; receiving an audio signal in the vehicle under the test condition; analyzing sound quality parameter data of the received audio signal; inquiring subjective evaluation scores in the subjective and objective evaluation database according to at least one sound quality parameter data in the analyzed sound quality parameter data; and outputting the inquired subjective evaluation score. The invention also includes a computer readable medium, an apparatus for determining a subjective assessment of vehicle abnormal sound based on an objective test, and a system for determining a subjective assessment of vehicle abnormal sound based on an objective test.

title_en: Distributed transient overvoltage monitoring system based on optical voltage sensor
abstract_en: A distributed transient overvoltage monitoring system based on an optical voltage sensor belongs to the technical field of overvoltage monitoring of power systems. The invention aims at the problem that the static working voltage fluctuation caused by the light source fluctuation is not easy to eliminate and the accuracy of the overvoltage monitoring result is influenced. The method comprises the following steps: light emitted by the SLD light source is transmitted into the optical voltage sensor and the non-equipartition optical splitter after being evenly divided; the output of the non-equipartition optical splitter is subjected to photoelectric conversion by a narrow-band optical fiber receiver to obtain a light source output power monitoring voltage, and the light source output power monitoring voltage is transmitted to a data processor after being collected by a high-speed collection card; the optical signal collected by the optical voltage sensor is converted by a broadband optical fiber receiver to obtain a collected voltage signal; the monitoring output voltage of the monitoring point is obtained after the processing of the preposed signal processing circuit, and the monitoring output voltage is transmitted to a data processor after being collected by a high-speed collection card; and the data processor processes the input data to obtain a detected transient overvoltage monitoring result. The invention is used for overvoltage monitoring.

title_en: Method and device for calculating concentration of soluble organic carbon in water environment by fluorescence spectrometry
abstract_en: The method and the device calculate the concentration of soluble organic carbon (DOC) in the water environment by using a fluorescence spectrometry, reduce the dimension of the spectral data and cluster the spectral data by acquiring the fluorescence spectrum data of the water sample, construct a regression model between the spectral data and the DOC, and acquire the DOC value of the water sample to be detected based on the spectral data of the water sample to be detected. The method realizes rapid determination of DOC in water environment through fluorescence spectrum, does not need to consume chemical reagents or long-term personnel attendance, and realizes the technical effects of cleanness, environmental protection and high-efficiency determination.

title_en: Shared array time-to-digital converter based on-chip storage
abstract_en: The invention discloses a shared array time-to-digital converter based on-chip storage, which comprises a macro-pixel circuit, a time sequence control circuit, a synchronous signal circuit and a parallel-serial data interface circuit, wherein an SRAM unit and a read-write access are arranged in the macro-pixel circuit; wherein: the data transmission start mark and the end mark generated by the time sequence control circuit are connected with the synchronous signal circuit, the data transmission window signal generated by the time sequence control circuit is connected with the parallel-serial data interface circuit, and the output end of the pixel array system of the macro pixel circuit is connected with the parallel-serial data interface circuit; the global signal comprises an enabling signal EN, a RESET signal RESET and TDC high-frequency clock signals HCK1 and HCK2 which are accessed into each macro pixel of the whole pixel array system through a symmetrical H-Tree type distribution network; on the premise of ensuring the consistency of effective data and precision, the on-chip storage technology can relieve the limitation of data reading time on the high frame frequency of the reading circuit, and reduce the area and power consumption of the reading circuit.

title_en: Method for characterizing mesoscopic trap of polymer nano composite dielectric interface region
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for characterizing a mesoscopic trap of an interface region of a polymer nano composite dielectric, which comprises the steps of constructing a three-dimensional structure model of the nano composite dielectric by adopting a Monte Carlo method, calculating by utilizing a high-flux simulation solution steady-state charge conservation equation to obtain electric field distribution of the nano composite dielectric under different interface region conductivity distribution conditions, calculating according to an effective dielectric theory to obtain effective conductivity of the nano composite dielectric, inverting to obtain mesoscopic conductivity distribution characteristics of the interface region of the nano composite dielectric, and utilizing the three-dimensional distribution characteristics to help reveal a change rule of the carrier capturing effect of the interface region trap from a microscopic level and establish a relationship between a condensed state structure of the interface region of the nano composite dielectric and molecular motion and macroscopic electrical performance. Theoretical support is provided for improving the resistance, breakdown, energy storage and other performances of the nano composite dielectric medium from the trap regulation and control angle, so as to meet the development requirements of power equipment such as high energy storage density pulse capacitors and the like.

title_en: Method for extracting degradable micro-plastic from biological tissue
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for extracting degradable micro-plastic from biological tissues, which is characterized by comprising the following steps: (1) Washing biological tissue, cutting into pieces, and crushing for later use; (2) Adding appropriate amount of crushed biological tissue into hydrochloric acid solution containing pepsin, oscillating for the first time, and adding H  2  O  2  After the second oscillation, carrying out vacuum filtration by using a PTFE hydrophilic filter membrane; (3) Soaking the PTFE hydrophilic filter membrane into NaI solution for ultrasonic treatment, then washing with NaI solution, standing the solution, and carrying out vacuum filtration on the upper layer solution to obtain a retentate; (4) For the trapped mattersAnd identifying and counting the line Raman spectrum. The method can ensure that the degradable micro-plastic can be conveniently and quickly extracted from the biological tissue on the premise of minimum influence on the plastic, is convenient for accurately analyzing the type and abundance of the degradable micro-plastic in the organism, and provides technical support for further researching the enrichment, migration and transformation rules and health risk evaluation of the degradable plastic in the organism.

title_en: Separation detection method of glycyrrhizic acid epimers
abstract_en: The invention provides a separation and detection method of glycyrrhizic acid epimer, belonging to the technical field of medicine separation and detection. The invention uses octadecyl bonded silica gel as filler, and the separation and detection of 18 alpha glycyrrhizic acid and 18 beta glycyrrhizic acid are carried out under the following chromatographic conditions: mobile phase A: tetrahydrofuran-containing organic solvent, mobile phase B: an acid-containing aqueous solution; column temperature: 25-45 ℃; flow rate: 0.8-1.2mL/min; detection wavelength: 210-460nm; mobile phase elution procedure: isocratic elution. The separation detection method can effectively separate the 18 alpha and 18 beta epimers in the glycyrrhizic acid, and can carry out quantitative detection by an area normalization method, the separation degree meets the requirements, and the detection sensitivity is high; can realize the quantitative detection of another impurity when the 18 alpha glycyrrhizic acid and the 18 beta glycyrrhizic acid are independently used, and can monitor the impurity in the quality control of monoammonium glycyrrhizinate, diamine glycyrrhizinate or other glycyrrhizinate products.

title_en: Online motor insulation automatic detection device and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an online motor insulation automatic detection device and method, which comprises a box body, wherein a detection module, a power supply module, a control module and an interface module are arranged in the box body; the detection module comprises a first detection port, a voltage/current withstanding detection circuit, a first microcomputer, a first RS485 communication module, a starting switch, a high-voltage direct-current voltage source, a motor start-stop detection circuit and a second detection port; the control module comprises a second RS485 communication module, a second microcomputer, a third RS485 communication module, an upper computer communication port, an alarm output driving circuit and an alarm output port. The invention saves manpower resources, improves the production automation level, provides a novel detection method and means for motor insulation detection, and is also suitable for other fields needing insulation detection.

title_en: Water quality condition detection sampling device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water quality condition detection sampling device, which comprises a sampling box and a sampling rod, wherein a handle is arranged at the top of the sampling box, a through hole is formed in the bottom of the sampling box, the sampling rod is connected in the through hole in a sliding manner, a sealing layer is arranged between the sampling rod and the through hole, a storage cavity is formed in the bottom of the sampling rod, a water inlet channel is formed in the side wall of the storage cavity, a sampling bottle is arranged in the storage cavity, a bottle opening of the sampling bottle is communicated with the tail end of the water inlet channel, an opening is formed in the bottom of the storage cavity and connected with a sealing cover, a driving structure for driving the sampling rod to slide is arranged in the sampling box, the driving structure comprises a lifting seat arranged at the bottom of the sampling box, a lifting frame is arranged on the lifting seat, a sliding chute and an air cylinder for driving the lifting frame to lift are arranged on the lifting seat, a supporting plate is fixed at the top of the lifting frame, and the supporting plate is fixedly connected with the sampling rod. According to the invention, through the arrangement of the sliding connection of the sampling box and the sampling rod, the sampling rod is convenient to be accommodated in the sampling box, and the sampling box is convenient to carry.

title_en: Large-dynamic-range receiving front end facing laser radar and control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a laser radar-oriented large-dynamic-range receiving front end and a control method, and belongs to the technical field of integrated circuits, wherein the receiving front end comprises a transimpedance amplifier, a gain control circuit, a delay chain and a voltage amplifier, a detector irradiated by echo light generates photocurrent which is input into the transimpedance amplifier, the output of the transimpedance amplifier is respectively connected with the gain control circuit and the delay chain, and the output of the gain control circuit and the output of the delay chain are both connected with the voltage amplifier; the time delay of the time delay chain is larger than or equal to the time for the voltage signal output by the trans-impedance amplifier to complete gain regulation and control switching through the gain regulation and control circuit. The invention does not use an automatic gain control loop, thereby improving the stability of a receiving link.

title_en: Integrated device and method for underground water collection and determination
abstract_en: The invention discloses an integrated device and a method for collecting and measuring underground water, wherein the device comprises a collecting cylinder, a water inlet is arranged on the collecting cylinder, a first slide block is arranged in the collecting cylinder, a water outlet is arranged on the side wall of the collecting cylinder, a water inlet hole is arranged on the first slide block, a first floating ball is arranged in the water inlet hole, limiting rings are arranged at two ends of the water inlet hole, a first piston is arranged in the collecting cylinder, a push rod is arranged on the upper end face of the first piston, a motor box is arranged at the upper end of the collecting cylinder, the push rod is connected with a press plate arranged in the motor box, a motor is arranged in the motor box, a crank is arranged on an output shaft of the motor, the press plate is connected with the crank through a connecting rod, a power supply is arranged in the motor box, a detection cylinder is arranged on the motor box, and the detection cylinder is communicated with the water outlet through a water inlet pipe on the side wall of the detection cylinder.

title_en: Loess landslide hazard comprehensive monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a loess landslide hazard comprehensive monitoring method and a loess landslide hazard comprehensive monitoring system, wherein the loess landslide hazard comprehensive monitoring method comprises the following steps: acquiring various monitoring data of an area to be monitored; acquiring a ground surface three-dimensional deformation time sequence, an atmospheric water vapor content time sequence and a ground surface soil water content time sequence of a region to be monitored by using a GNSS relative positioning technology and a GNSS remote sensing technology; analyzing the relevance between the atmospheric water vapor content time sequence and rainfall data of the area to be monitored; the association between the three-dimensional earth surface deformation time sequence and the earth surface soil water content time sequence is analyzed; and carrying out rainfall early warning on the area to be monitored, and carrying out landslide comprehensive monitoring on the area to be monitored. According to the invention, the GNSS technology is utilized to acquire environmental information such as deformation information of a region to be monitored, the atmospheric water vapor content, the change of the soil water content and the like, and the response relationship among the environmental information is analyzed, so that the GNSS technology is better used for comprehensively monitoring landslide disasters.

title_en: Fault diagnosis method for rolling bearing under variable working conditions and complex noise environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fault diagnosis method of a rolling bearing under variable working conditions and complex noise environments. The method has the advantages of low requirement on manual experience, low loss rate and the like.

title_en: Method for rapidly detecting volatile components in coal sample
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coal analysis and detection, in particular to a rapid detection method for volatile components in a coal sample; the invention does not need expensive instrument and equipment, has simple process and short consumed time, has the characteristics of rapidness, simple operation, low detection cost, no need of expensive detection instruments, and rapidness in detection, saves the cost, improves the efficiency, can meet the current detection requirement, and is convenient and rapid.

title_en: Storage medium and infrared thermal image processing system
abstract_en: The present application relates to the field of image data processing or generating technology, and more particularly, to a storage medium and an infrared thermal image processing system. The storage medium stores instructions or programs that are loaded and executed by a processor to implement the steps of acquiring A, T  B  and T  C , acquiring T  AB ＝T 1   A -T 1   B  if C is located in S  B  or C is not located in S  B , but d  BC <d 0  and T  BC <T 0 , outputting second hint information indicating T  AB , and outputting first hint information indicating re-shooting or re-acquiring L if C is not located in S  B  and d  BC ≥d 0  or T  BC ≥T 0 . The application can accurately acquire the temperature of the symmetrical position of a certain position of the human body in the infrared thermal image.

title_en: Method for rapidly and accurately solving true thickness of rock stratum based on solid geometric model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for rapidly and accurately solving the true thickness of a rock stratum based on a solid geometric model. The method comprises the following steps of firstly, acquiring basic data; acquiring coordinates and elevations of any point of the top and bottom of the rock stratum; measuring the occurrence of the rock layer; step two, establishing a solid geometric model; setting the top surface and the bottom surface of the rock stratum to be plane and parallel; making the top and bottom surfaces of a rock stratum in a cuboid, and marking the top and bottom surface points of the rock stratum; making a line segment representing the true thickness of the rock stratum through a series of auxiliary lines and points, and establishing a solid geometric model; thirdly, deriving a solving formula of the true thickness of the rock stratum under various conditions based on the solid geometric model; step four, establishing a general formula of the true thickness of the rock stratum; and step five, substituting the basic data into a general formula of the true thickness of the rock stratum to calculate the true thickness of the rock stratum. The method has the advantages of high working efficiency, small error of the acquired data, small calculation error, simple solution and high accuracy.

title_en: Multifunctional robot for home health monitoring and safety protection
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multifunctional robot, in particular to a multifunctional robot for home health monitoring and safety protection. The invention aims to provide a multifunctional robot for home health monitoring and safety protection, which can detect the heart rate of the old people and give an alarm in time when a fire disaster happens. The invention provides a multifunctional robot for home health monitoring and safety protection, which comprises a driving mechanism, a camera shooting mechanism and the like, wherein the driving mechanism for moving is arranged at the lower part of a fixed shell, and the camera shooting mechanism for observing the surrounding environment is arranged on a connecting shell. The temperature detector can detect the ambient temperature and display the detection result on the control panel, when the temperature detector detects that the ambient temperature is higher than the preset value, the temperature detector can send a signal, and the control cabinet can automatically alarm after receiving the signal, so that the safety is high.

title_en: Clamp and method for synchronous tensile compression of sheet sample of universal testing machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a clamp and a method for synchronously using stretching and compressing of a sheet sample of a universal testing machine, and belongs to the technical field of testing equipment for testing mechanical properties of materials. The device comprises upper portion anchor clamps and lower part anchor clamps that the symmetry set up, is different from traditional single-purpose anchor clamps, through reasonable structural design, realizes carrying out many cycles, continuous tensile and compression to the sample. In the test process, the upper clamp is tightly connected with a movable beam at the top of the universal test machine through a first joint mechanism; the lower part anchor clamps pass through the fixed work platform zonulae occludens in bottom of second joint mechanism and universal tester, and the upper portion of the slice sample that awaits measuring and the first fixture zonulae occludens of upper portion anchor clamps, the second fixture zonulae occludens of lower part anchor clamps through reciprocating of universal tester top beam, drives upper portion anchor clamps, and the test piece form sample that awaits measuring is tensile and compression. The invention has the advantages of simple structure, high precision, easy operation, high test accuracy and repeatability and the like.

title_en: Anti-interference method and device for angle tracking measurement of unmanned aerial vehicle frequency hopping system
abstract_en: The application relates to an anti-interference method and device for angle tracking measurement of a frequency hopping system of an unmanned aerial vehicle, and relates to the field of signal processing. It includes: acquiring a first sum signal and a first difference signal of a first monopulse signal by using a sum-difference network system of a receiving end; acquiring a second sum signal and a second difference signal of a second monopulse signal by using a sum-difference network system of a receiving end; the frequencies of the first single pulse signal and the second single pulse signal are different; performing correlation operation on a first reference sequence and a first sum signal of a receiving end to obtain a first phase shift generated by a first monopulse signal at the receiving end; performing correlation operation on the second reference sequence of the receiving end and the second sum signal to obtain a second phase shift generated by the second monopulse signal at the receiving end; and taking the difference value of the first phase shift and the second phase shift as a correction value for correcting the random phase shift of the first signal after the second sum signal and the second difference signal are mixed. The method has the technical effect of measuring the angle of the frequency hopping signal.

title_en: Sodium fluorescence Doppler laser radar data quality control method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a sodium fluorescence Doppler laser radar data quality control method and a system, the method comprises photon counting data quality control and data yield quality control, and the automatic diagnosis and batch processing of the data of the sodium fluorescence Doppler laser radar are realized through the processes of original echo signal height correction, sodium layer signal-to-noise ratio detection, reference height Rayleigh signal-to-noise ratio detection, laser frequency stability detection and bad data elimination, photon counting linearity detection and correction, optical filter transmissivity correction, temperature ratio detection and abnormal value elimination, wind speed ratio detection and abnormal value elimination, zenith direction wind speed profile detection and abnormal value elimination, temperature and wind speed detection error detection and unreliable value elimination and the like, so that the problems that the manual intervention is more, the detection result quality depends on personal experience in the sodium fluorescence Doppler laser radar parameter inversion process, the detection result has larger errors or a large amount of detection data cannot be fully utilized and the like are solved.

title_en: Method for testing unstable pixels of infrared focal plane device based on relative current
abstract_en: The invention provides an unstable pixel testing method of an infrared focal plane device based on relative current, which comprises the following steps: step S1, a detector is spaced from a surface source black body by a preset distance, and the surface source black body is set to be at a preset temperature; step S2, setting integration time to enable the depth of the detector output well to be within a preset well depth range, and enabling the step to be within a preset step range; s3, acquiring an infrared detection image, and fitting pixel voltage along with integration time to obtain a first pixel ammeter; s4, deducting blind pixel current, and calculating to obtain a first relative ammeter; step S5, repeating the steps S3-S4 at least once to obtain a second pixel ammeter and a second relative ammeter; and S6, judging whether the pixel is an unstable pixel or not according to the first relative ammeter and the second relative ammeter. The beneficial effects are that: starting from the pixel current, the method capable of effectively measuring the unstable pixel of the infrared detector is provided, so that the unstable pixel is accurately judged.

title_en: Cab electric detection system and method
abstract_en: The application relates to a cab electric detection system and a method. The system comprises: the detection equipment is statically arranged at the starting point of the moving path of the vehicle to be detected; the slide rail is arranged in parallel with the moving path of the vehicle to be detected; the following mechanism is slidably suspended on the slide rail and is used for moving in the same direction and at the same speed with the vehicle to be tested; the control panel is fixed on the following mechanism; the test wire harness comprises a detection wire harness and a switching wire harness, two ends of the detection wire harness are respectively connected with the control panel and the vehicle to be tested, and two ends of the switching wire harness are respectively connected with the control panel and the detection equipment; the plurality of moving mechanisms are slidably suspended on the slide rail and are positioned between the following mechanism and the detection equipment; the plurality of moving mechanisms are sequentially arranged along the extending direction of the slide rail. By adopting the system, the vehicle to be detected can be electrically connected with the detection equipment effectively in the moving process, the electrical detection time of the vehicle to be detected is shortened, and the detection efficiency is improved.

title_en: Protection inspection method for 0.4kV circuit breaker
abstract_en: The invention discloses a protection inspection method for a 0.4kV circuit breaker, which comprises the following steps: determining a rated protection reliable action value and a rated protection non-action value of the circuit breaker; setting a constant value action value of a current relay and inputting the constant value action value into an intelligent controller to ensure that the constant value action value is consistent with a starting value of the intelligent controller; switching on the circuit breaker, adjusting a large circuit generator, adding the reliable action value, and judging whether the action of the intelligent tripping controller is accurate or not; and when the set reliable action value is reached, judging the action behavior of the circuit breaker, recording related data, comparing the data with a theoretical value, and judging whether the protection function of the circuit breaker is qualified. The method facilitates the regular development of the inspection work of the same type of equipment, meets the requirement of the on-site circuit breaker protection inspection work, can verify the protection functionality of the circuit breaker, evaluates the state of the circuit breaker protection equipment, has high accuracy and can save the time of workers.

title_en: Cloth tensile resistance detection device for clothing research and development
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of clothing research and development, in particular to a cloth tensile resistance detection device for clothing research and development, which comprises the following components: a longitudinal moving table and a lower clamp which are arranged in an up-down alignment way, wherein one side of the longitudinal moving table is provided with a track frame which can be butted with the longitudinal moving table; the distributing and dispatching slide seat is connected to the track frame in a sliding manner, and a clamping assembly and a distributing and grabbing assembly are arranged on the distributing and dispatching slide seat; the longitudinal moving table and the lower clamp are connected to the frame, a plurality of cloth test boxes are arranged on the frame, and the cloth test boxes are positioned in the moving path of the cloth dispatching slide seat; the shaping clamps can be arranged in the cloth test box and are used for shaping and unfolding cloth, and the invention can coordinate the matching mode between testing and detection in the clothes research and development process, reduce the operation amount of research and development detection personnel and liberate the time of the research and development detection personnel on low-quality repeated labor.

title_en: Method for detecting rare earth in zinc liquid by ICP-OES
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for detecting rare earth in zinc liquid by ICP-OES, which comprises the following steps: 1) Sampling and cooling at a position 80cm below the liquid level of the zinc liquid in front of the sink roll of the zinc pot; 2) Weighing a sample, dissolving the sample in 38-40% nitric acid, and heating until the liquid turns colorless and transparent from turbid; adding water to dilute and fix the volume into a volumetric flask, and standing for a certain time; 3) Taking 1ml of rare earth standard solution with the rare earth content of 1000ppm to directly dissolve the rare earth standard solution into a volumetric flask with the rare earth content of 1000ml to prepare high-standard rare earth solution with the rare earth content of 1ppm, and continuously using the high-standard rare earth solution without newly preparing the high-standard rare earth solution for subsequent detection; 4) And establishing a rare earth element detection method of the spectrum analyzer, and detecting by adopting a standard analysis curve in which a blank point and a high-standard point form a line. The invention establishes a method which is simple to operate, has high detection speed and can detect at any time, and plays an important role in stabilizing the product quality.

title_en: Calibration method and calibration device for digital key, vehicle, storage medium and chip
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to the field of vehicle technologies, and in particular, to a calibration method and a calibration apparatus for a digital key, a vehicle, a storage medium, and a chip. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring first distance information between a vehicle where a digital key to be calibrated is located and a digital key client when a preset action is executed and first time information for executing the preset action; determining second distance information between the vehicle and the digital key client when the vehicle executes a preset action according to the first distance information and the first time information; and generating a target mapping relation between the communication signal strength and the distance of the digital key to be calibrated according to the first distance information, the second distance information and the initial mapping relation between the communication signal strength and the distance of the digital key to be calibrated. Therefore, the generated target mapping relation accords with the current parking environment of the vehicle, and when positioning is carried out based on the target mapping relation, the influence on the positioning accuracy caused by shielding or reflecting the signal can be avoided, and the accuracy of positioning the digital key client is improved.

title_en: Steel bar flatness detection equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to steel bar flatness detection equipment, which relates to the technical field of flatness detection equipment and comprises a bearing device, a limiting device and a detection device; the bearing device comprises an operation table, and the operation table is used for placing a steel bar body to be detected; the limiting device comprises two groups of clamping mechanisms, and the two groups of clamping mechanisms are arranged on an operating platform and used for positioning the steel bar body to be detected on the operating platform; the detection device comprises a leveling piece and a lifting mechanism, wherein the leveling piece is arranged on the operating platform in a lifting mode through the lifting mechanism to be used for detecting the flatness of the steel bar body. This application has the effect that improves the precision that check out test set detected the straightness of rod iron body.

title_en: Control lithium cell undervoltage circuit based on singlechip
