abstract_en: The invention discloses a singlechip-based lithium battery undervoltage monitoring circuit, which relates to the technical field of lithium battery voltage monitoring and comprises a lithium battery, wherein a capacitor C2 and a capacitor C3 are electrically connected to the lithium battery, the capacitor C2 and the capacitor C3 are respectively connected with a management chip in series, a capacitor C1 is electrically connected to the management chip, an anti-reverse diode D2 is electrically connected to the anti-reverse diode D1, an anti-reverse diode D3 is electrically connected to the singlechip, and a capacitor C4 and a capacitor C5 are connected in parallel. This control lithium cell under-voltage circuit based on singlechip has the singlechip of low-voltage detection module when adopting wide voltage to carry out the voltage real time monitoring of lithium cell, and the circuit can all normally work under the condition of lithium cell and adapter power supply, adopts this kind of method cost lower, and the software is uncomplicated, makes things convenient for later maintenance, and is accurate to the low-power monitoring of battery.

title_en: Polynomial chaotic expansion fault positioning method and system for uncertain parameters of line
abstract_en: The invention discloses a polynomial chaotic expansion fault positioning method and system aiming at uncertain parameters of a line. And then obtaining a training set of a regression model through EMTR correlation coefficient criterion, and realizing the prediction of a fault interval through the regression model. According to the method, the fault interval containing the actual fault position is accurately obtained through simulation example verification, the effective positioning of the fault position is realized, and the problem that a large positioning error exists when the parameters of the power transmission line contain uncertainty in the traditional fault positioning method is solved. The method has potential engineering value in the fault location of the power transmission line.

title_en: Reinforced building steel structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of steel structure reinforcement, in particular to a reinforced building steel structure, which comprises the following components: including supporting part, be connected with the riser on the supporting part, sliding connection has two supplementary round bars on the riser, still includes the articulated rod, and the articulated rod is equipped with two, sliding connection has the slider on the supporting part, every all articulate the one end that has a articulated rod on the supplementary round bar, be equipped with a cylinder pole on the slider, the other end of two articulated rods all is equipped with circular through-hole, and the cooperation of circular through-hole of accessible and cylinder pole cup joints the other end of two articulated rods on the cylinder pole, riser sliding connection is equipped with the magnetic block on the supporting part on the riser, and the magnetic block can adsorb on the supporting part, still including establishing the scale mark on the supporting part, can all need bear the U shaped steel structure cell pole of great pressure to both sides and carry out firm support.

title_en: GMM-FBG current transformer real-time temperature drift suppression method based on finite element calculation
abstract_en: A GMM-FBG current transformer real-time temperature drift suppression method based on finite element calculation belongs to the technical field of power grids. The method solves the problem that the existing method has poor effect of inhibiting the temperature drift of the static working point of a grating sensor in the current transformer, and adopts a finite element analysis method to calculate the working curve of the GMM-FBG current transformer; performing data fitting on the working curve to obtain a corresponding relation between the wavelength output and the current input of the GMM-FBG current transformer at different temperatures; and (3) carrying out temperature drift suppression by utilizing the corresponding relation between the wavelength output and the current input of the GMM-FBG current transformer at each temperature at different temperatures. The method is suitable for the real-time temperature drift suppression of the GMM-FBG current transformer.

title_en: Method and apparatus for per-method positioning assistance prioritization
abstract_en: A User Equipment (UE) configured for positioning determination receives positioning assistance data from a location server, the positioning assistance data being specific for a positioning method and providing information related to prioritization of one or more of frequency layer, transmission point (TRP), positioning Reference Signal (PRS) resource set and PRS resource, or a combination thereof. The positioning assistance data may be generated by the location server in response to the UE measurement capabilities. The UE determines prioritization for PRS measurements based at least on one or more orderings of information in positioning assistance data regarding frequency layers, TRPs, sets of PRS resources or PRS resources, or a combination thereof, and a positioning method. Measuring, by the UE, a downlink PRS based on the prioritization.

title_en: Measuring device
abstract_en: The application discloses a measuring device, which comprises a body provided with an origin scale, a first scale arranged on the body and comprising a plurality of first scale lines distributed in sequence, wherein all the first scale lines extend towards one side of the length direction of the body by taking the origin scale as a starting point, the numerical value L marked by the first scale lines is gradually increased, and the distance F (L) between the origin scale and different first scale lines is calculated according to a formula The second graduations are distributed one by one and are arranged on the body, the second graduations comprise a plurality of second graduation marks which are uniformly distributed, all the second graduations extend towards the other side of the length direction of the body by taking the original point graduation as a starting point, the second graduations are marked with a numerical value L', the starting point graduation value of the second graduations is 0 and extends to the position of the minimum measuring range k, and the maximum measuring range marked by the second graduations is the minimum measuring range k of the first graduation.

title_en: Line loss testing method and system for communication cable
abstract_en: The invention belongs to a method for testing the line loss of a cable in the field of communication, and particularly relates to a method and a system for testing the line loss of a communication cable.

title_en: High-resolution imaging method for scanning radar under low signal-to-noise ratio condition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-resolution imaging method of a scanning radar under the condition of low signal-to-noise ratio, which comprises the following steps: step 1: modeling an echo signal of a scanning radar, and initializing a scattering point power matrix; and 2, step: calculating a covariance matrix according to the scattering point power matrix; and 3, step 3: modeling a radar imaging problem into a least square problem by using a covariance matrix, and calculating a least square solution of the scattering intensity of a target; and 4, step 4: calculating a scattering point power matrix according to a least square solution of the target scattering intensity; and 5: removing the smaller value in the scattering point power matrix to update the smaller value; step 6: and repeating the operations from the step 2 to the step 5 until the maximum iteration number is reached. The iterative adaptive method based on the least square method is applied to scanning radar imaging, and the small value of the scattering point power matrix is removed in the iterative process, so that the target signal is more prominent, the azimuth resolution under the condition of low signal-to-noise ratio is improved, and the imaging effect is improved.

title_en: Method for determining deep-sea water channel migration degree, storage medium and computer equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for determining the migration degree of a deep-sea water channel, a storage medium and computer equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: dividing the deep sea composite water channel on the deep sea water channel plane distribution diagram into a plurality of bending sections; the following steps are performed separately for each curved segment: determining the vertical migration amount and the lateral migration amount of the deep-sea single water course corresponding to the bending section on the seismic amplitude profile corresponding to the bending section; calculating a waterway transfer index of the bent section according to the vertical transfer amount and the lateral transfer amount of the deep-sea single waterway corresponding to the bent section; the deep-sea water channel migration degree of each bent section is analyzed according to the water channel migration index of each bent section, the migration evolution degree of a single deep-sea water channel can be quantified through the water channel migration index, morphological parameters of the deep-sea water channel are enriched, and the method has an important supporting effect on the research of quantitative sedimentology and sedimentation system of the deep-sea water channel.

title_en: Method for respectively quantifying bacterial capsular polysaccharide and lipopolysaccharide
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for respectively quantifying bacterial capsular polysaccharide and lipopolysaccharide, belonging to the technical field of biology. The method comprises the steps of releasing lipopolysaccharide on the outer membrane of a bacterial sample by a physical method, and centrifuging to collect a first supernatant and a first precipitate respectively; removing protein and lipid impurities from the first supernatant, adding a precipitator to obtain lipopolysaccharide dry powder, redissolving to obtain a lipopolysaccharide solution, and quantifying lipopolysaccharide by using a sulfuric acid-phenol method; washing the first precipitate with a cleaning solution, adding a surfactant for treatment, and centrifuging to collect a second supernatant; removing protein and lipid impurities from the second supernatant, and adding a precipitator to obtain capsular polysaccharide dry powder; adding low-concentration hydrochloric acid into the capsular polysaccharide dry powder for redissolving, incubating at room temperature to obtain capsular polysaccharide solution, and quantifying capsular polysaccharide by using an uronic acid lactone assay method. The method can realize simultaneous separation and quantification of lipopolysaccharide and capsular polysaccharide without cracking bacterial thallus, and improves purity and accuracy.

title_en: Component detection method of elastomer material
abstract_en: A component detection method of an elastomer material relates to the technical field of material detection, and solves the problem that the prior art cannot accurately perform qualitative and quantitative detection on each component of the elastomer material, and comprises the following steps: s1, performing Soxhlet extraction on an elastomer material to be detected to obtain a first insoluble substance and a first solution, wherein the first solution is main body resin; s2, heating and dissolving the first insoluble substance in a solvent to obtain a second insoluble substance and a second solution; s3, drying the second insoluble substances to obtain ash; s4, drying the second solution to obtain an auxiliary agent; and S5, weighing and analyzing the dried main resin, the dried auxiliary agent and the dried ash to finish the quantitative and qualitative detection of the components of the elastomer material. The invention is applicable to forward development of materials, supplier constraints, and consistency verification.

title_en: Truck axle type detection method based on visual infrared fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a truck axle type detection method based on vision and infrared fusion, which comprises an infrared thermal imager, a camera and a data processing device, wherein the infrared thermal imager is used for collecting a truck infrared image, the camera is used for collecting an RGB (red, green and blue) image, when the data processing device detects a truck in the infrared image, the infrared image and the camera image at the moment are obtained, and the truck axle type is judged by adopting an image fusion algorithm after image preprocessing. The method and the device can solve the problem that in the prior art, the shaft type of the truck is identified by a single means, and the identification result is not accurate enough.

title_en: Laser ablation method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a laser ablation method and a device, wherein the laser ablation device comprises: the system comprises a femtosecond laser module, a galvanometer system and a field lens, wherein the galvanometer system comprises an X-axis galvanometer and a Y-axis galvanometer; the X-axis galvanometer adjusts the position of laser focusing on the surface of the sample along the X-axis direction, and the Y-axis galvanometer adjusts the position of laser focusing on the surface of the sample along the Y-axis direction; the X-axis direction and the Y-axis direction are mutually vertical; the X-axis galvanometer and the Y-axis galvanometer can perform high-frequency reciprocating rotation around a shaft at a preset frequency so as to switch the laser focus among a plurality of positions; the field lens is used to focus the laser pulses onto the sample. The laser ablation device can be used for laser ablation of samples in different areas within a nanosecond time period, the number of generated particles is more for homogeneous samples, and the sensitivity is higher during elemental analysis; for different samples, the information of the samples obtained by element analysis after the generated particles are uniformly mixed is richer.

title_en: Intelligent actuator for online detection of carpet pile cluster quality
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent actuator for online detection of carpet pile cluster quality, which comprises a portable support, an execution controller, a detection bedplate, a lifting sliding table, a lifting bedplate, a contact type appearance detector, a pressure-bearing detector, a pull-out force detector and a hydraulic integrated block, wherein the contact type appearance detector comprises a first hydraulic motor, a second hydraulic motor and a rotary table driven by the hydraulic motor, and the rotary table and the first hydraulic motor are fixed on the lifting bedplate; the intelligent actuator for online detection of the pile quality of the carpet adopts the cooperation of an actuator machine and a mobile hydraulic station, does not need sample shearing, directly selects a certain area of the carpet to detect indexes such as extraction force, friction resistance color fastness, appearance retentivity and the like, and has high detection efficiency.

title_en: Data fusion method and system for radar and ship automatic identification system and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a data fusion method and system for a radar and ship automatic identification system and a storage medium, which belong to the technical field of ships, wherein the data fusion method for the radar and ship automatic identification system comprises the following steps: acquiring radar data and ship automatic identification system data; performing linear fitting on the radar data and the data of the automatic ship identification system; missing data supplement is carried out through a data automatic supplement rule of an automatic ship identification system; calculating the association degree of the target tracks of the radar and the automatic ship identification system through a grey association algorithm to obtain a first judgment result; respectively calculating the target speed and the course of the radar and the target speed and the course of the automatic ship identification system to obtain a second judgment result; and performing data fusion according to the first judgment result and the second judgment result. Through the technical scheme of this application, can make radar data and boats and ships automatic identification system data form the data fusion of automation, system to solve the obstructed problem of information on water.

title_en: RFID-based unmanned aerial vehicle rapid warehousing and ex-warehousing registration method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a RFID-based unmanned aerial vehicle rapid warehousing and ex-warehousing registration method and a system, and the method comprises a verification module, a processing module, an intelligent cabinet, a receiving end and a registration module; the verification module is used for inputting and verifying the identity information of the calling personnel; the processing module is used for providing unmanned aerial vehicle calling requirement options corresponding to calling authorities and/or unmanned aerial vehicle returning requirement options corresponding to calling authorities according to identity information of calling personnel; the calling personnel select the unmanned plane option to be called based on the unmanned plane requirement option to form calling requirement information and/or returning requirement information; the intelligent cabinet calls out the corresponding unmanned aerial vehicle from the corresponding storage cavity to an output port based on the calling demand information; the intelligent cabinet receives the corresponding unmanned aerial vehicle from the output port based on the return demand information and stores the unmanned aerial vehicle into the corresponding storage cavity; the receiving end is in butt joint with an output port of the intelligent cabinet; the registration module is used for carrying out corresponding warehousing registration and/or ex-warehouse registration on the unmanned aerial vehicle based on the calling requirement information and/or the returning requirement information.

title_en: Cable length detection device and detection method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cable length detection device and a detection method thereof, and the cable length detection device comprises a working base table and a fixed winding frame, wherein the fixed winding frame is arranged behind one side of the upper end of the working base table; the sliding bottom frame is arranged at the front end of one side of the upper end of the working bottom table, a mounting seat is fixedly mounted above the sliding bottom frame, a measuring frame is fixedly mounted above the mounting seat, and a control box is fixedly mounted above the working bottom table along one side of the sliding bottom frame. The cable disassembling device has the advantages that the cable disassembling capability is convenient, and the problem that the operation is very troublesome when the cable is maintained or replaced for disassembling is solved.

title_en: Inverter zero voltage drop data processing method based on machine learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of inverters, in particular to a zero voltage drop data processing method of an inverter based on machine learning, which comprises the following steps: obtaining current in an alternating current side voltage transformer circuit of the inverter to form a current data sequence, calculating a grouping length according to a maximum value and a minimum value in the current data sequence, and grouping the current data sequence to obtain a current data matrix; performing singular value decomposition on the current data matrix to obtain a plurality of sub-matrices, calculating the association degree of the two sub-matrices, grouping the sub-matrices according to the association degree, and processing the sub-matrices in the grouping to obtain a diagonal element sequence; calculating a noise evaluation value, and deleting the diagonal element sequence with the value smaller than an evaluation threshold value; and then calculating the noise degree, further determining the weight, carrying out weighted summation on all diagonal element sequences according to the weight to obtain a denoising current sequence, determining whether an abnormality exists, and processing abnormal data. The invention can remove noise, so that the current detection precision is higher.

title_en: Closed gas circulation flow heat exchange experimental device and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a closed gas circulation flow heat exchange experimental device and a method, which are used for solving the problem that the prior art cannot provide reliable thermal hydraulic experimental data for the design of a gas direct cooling reactor system. The experiment device comprises an experiment assembly, a preheating assembly, a pressurizing assembly, a high-pressure air source group and a vacuum pump, wherein the experiment assembly comprises an air inlet cavity and an air outlet cavity sleeved in the air inlet cavity, a plurality of air outlet channels communicated with the inside of the air inlet cavity and the air outlet end of the air outlet cavity are arranged in the air outlet cavity, heating rods are arranged in the air outlet channels, a first thermocouple and a first pressure gauge are arranged on the air inlet cavity, the preheating assembly comprises a preheating air tank and the preheating rods arranged in the preheating air tank, the air outlet end of the pressurizing assembly is communicated with the air inlet end of the preheating air tank, the air outlet end of the preheating air tank is communicated with the air inlet end of the air inlet cavity, the air outlet end of the air outlet cavity is communicated with the air inlet end of the pressurizing assembly, a second thermocouple and a second pressure gauge are arranged on a connecting pipe of the air outlet cavity, and the high-pressure air source group is used for filling experiment gas, and the vacuum pump is used for vacuumizing.

title_en: Tangential-impact coupling mode micro-motion abrasion simulation device
abstract_en: The invention provides a tangential-impact coupling mode fretting abrasion simulation device, and relates to the technical field of fretting abrasion simulation devices. The experimental tank body is positioned above the melting tank body, the melting cavity and the experimental cavity are communicated through a conveying pipeline and a connecting pipeline respectively, the connecting pipeline is provided with a valve for switching on and off a controller, the experimental tank body is internally provided with a sample clamp assembly, experimental working media are filled in the melting cavity, and when high-pressure gas is introduced into the melting tank body, the experimental working media can be introduced into the experimental tank body through the conveying pipeline, experimental research of impact-tangential coupling fretting abrasion can be carried out, impact-tangential coupling fretting abrasion under the condition of liquid lead bismuth alloy corrosion is simulated, a reliable impact-tangential coupling fretting abrasion result is obtained, and material loss caused by impact-tangential coupling fretting abrasion in a lead bismuth cooling fast reactor is effectively predicted.

title_en: Method and system for estimating and assimilating latent heat of condensation
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a system for estimating and assimilating latent heat of condensation, and relates to the field of atmospheric science numerical weather forecast. A latent heat of condensation estimation assimilation method includes: writing a corresponding program in the WRF3DVar indirect assimilation system, and adding a module which can comprehensively utilize the vertical integral liquid water content, the observed reflectivity and the background temperature to reasonably judge the condensation latent heat increasing area in the WRF3DVar indirect assimilation system; developing an estimation and assimilation method of condensation latent heat of radar observation reflectivity; and (3) according to a plurality of selected strong convection examples, utilizing the estimation and assimilation method of the latent heat of condensation to carry out radar data assimilation and numerical simulation tests. By researching the effect of the method on the accuracy of the strong convection forecast in the east China, the forecast level of the strong convection weather in the area is improved.

title_en: Current online monitoring system for heating device of outdoor high-voltage circuit breaker of transformer substation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of transformer substation monitoring, in particular to a current online monitoring system for a heating device of an outdoor high-voltage circuit breaker of a transformer substation, which comprises a plurality of current acquisition units arranged at an acquisition end, a monitoring unit and a current monitoring unit, wherein the current acquisition units are used for acquiring real-time current data of each heating device of the outdoor high-voltage circuit breaker in a monitoring area; the server side is provided with a monitoring management platform, the running state of the outdoor high-voltage circuit breaker heating device is judged, and monitoring, alarming and management are completed according to the judgment result; remove the end and be provided with terminal monitoring APP, look over each outdoor high voltage circuit breaker heating device's real-time current data, warning message. The invention realizes the monitoring, alarming and managing of the real-time current data, the maintenance personnel check the monitoring, alarming and real-time current data in real time, the operation state of the outdoor high-voltage circuit breaker heating device is known in real time, and the operation and maintenance personnel receive the alarming information at the first time when the outdoor high-voltage circuit breaker heating device breaks down and take corresponding measures in time to ensure the normal operation of the power equipment.

title_en: Mooring rope with fracture early warning function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mooring rope with a fracture early warning function, which comprises a rope core, an intermediate layer rope bundle and a rope sheath which are sequentially arranged from inside to outside; the cable core is formed by twisting 12 strands of ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene fiber ropes; the middle layer rope bundle comprises 12 strands of nylon ropes; the cable jacket is coated on the outer side of the 12 strands of nylon ropes; a strain gauge type pressure sensor is inserted between the 12 strands of ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene fiber ropes; a strain gauge type pressure sensor is also inserted between the 12 strands of nylon ropes; a display is fixedly arranged on the outer wall of the end part of the cable sheath, and a control processor is arranged on the display. According to the invention, the cable core and the middle layer rope bundle are respectively made of the ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene fiber rope and the nylon rope, and the strain gauge type pressure sensor, the control processor and the acousto-optic alarm device are arranged, so that managers can timely take appropriate remedial measures or obtain precious escape time through the two modes, and serious accidents are reduced.

title_en: High-efficiency simulation device for impact blocking structure of large-deformation flowing soil body and using method of high-efficiency simulation device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-efficiency simulation device for a large-deformation flowing soil impact blocking structure and a using method thereof. The device comprises a chute frame, a material storage area, a blocking area and a stacking area. The material storage area and the blocking area are located on the same bottom plate of the upper half part of the sliding groove, the stacking area is located on the other bottom plate of the lower half part of the sliding groove, the height of the material storage area and the stacking area is adjusted through the hydraulic lifting support, and the stacking area is connected with the bottom plates through hinges and is adjusted in angle. The storage area controls the storage and release of materials through a baffle, a pin bolt, a high-strength spring and the like. The blocking area comprises a blocking structure embedded with a metal base, a special cover plate, a common cover plate and an electromagnetic bottom plate; the blocking structure is inserted into a specially-made cover plate with the same thickness as the metal base, the electromagnetic bottom plate is positioned in a guide rail rigidly connected below the bottom plate of the blocking area, and the metal base is adsorbed by the controllable power supply to fix the blocking structure; the special cover plate and the solid cover plate are spliced on the bottom plate to provide a smooth channel for soil body flowing.

title_en: Welding slag detection method and device for battery module and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a welding slag detection method, a device and electronic equipment of a battery module, and relates to the technical field of battery safety detection, comprising the steps of constructing a simulation device for simulating a process of breakdown detection of welding slag of the battery module, wherein the simulation device comprises a metal rod, a first metal plate and a second metal plate; the method comprises the steps of providing a metal rod, applying a current to the metal rod, applying an external current to the metal rod, applying a preset breakdown voltage to the battery module in a simulated manner, enabling a first metal plate and a second metal plate to represent parallel battery planes between the battery modules, constructing a fitting formula of a breakdown voltage critical value according to different mapping combinations of the distance between the metal rod and the second metal plate and the diameter of the metal rod, determining the breakdown voltage of the current battery module for detecting welding slag according to the fitting formula of the breakdown voltage critical value, and relieving the technical problem that battery safety and welding slag accurate detection cannot be considered at the same time.

title_en: Method for calibrating reflector map based on known map and positioning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for calibrating a reflector map based on a known map and positioning, which comprises the following steps: s1: deploying a reflector in an area to be scanned in advance; s2: establishing a large environment map; s3: scanning a feature point set of a reflector region map by using a laser radar; s4: and calculating the coordinates of the reflector under the map coordinate system. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the reflector is deployed in a high-dynamic area, a large environment map is built, scanning is carried out through the laser radar, and the coordinates of the reflector under a map coordinate system are calculated, so that the deployment time is shortened, and the calibration accuracy is guaranteed.

title_en: Auxiliary device for maintaining medicine containers in pharmacy
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of pharmacy maintenance, in particular to an auxiliary device for pharmacy medicine container maintenance, which comprises a pharmacy body, container bodies are uniformly arranged on the inner side of the pharmacy body, a support frame is fixed on the inner side of each container body, a plurality of partition plates for separating different medicines are uniformly fixed at the top end of each support frame, lifting assemblies are arranged on the rear side between every two adjacent container bodies, trays are fixed at the output ends of the lifting assemblies, maintenance assemblies for container maintenance are arranged in the trays, the maintenance assemblies are arranged on the top surface of each support frame in a rolling manner during maintenance, each maintenance assembly comprises a shifting plate body, rollers are arranged at four corners of the bottom surface of each shifting plate body, and an installation box is fixed on the bottom side of each shifting plate body. The automatic medicine box monitoring device is ingenious in design and reasonable in structure, can be used for regularly and accurately monitoring the goods shelf when the automatic medicine box monitoring device is used in an automatic medicine room, is simple and convenient to operate during maintenance, and can not be messed, so that a certain guarantee is provided for high-quality and efficient maintenance of a pharmacy.

title_en: Method for detecting falling strength of iron ore green pellets based on falling-rebounding characteristics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for detecting the falling strength of iron ore green pellets based on the falling-rebounding characteristic, and belongs to the technical field of pellet falling strength detection. The method comprises the steps of selecting m green pellets, enabling the green pellets to fall onto a ball receiving steel plate from a fixed height in a free falling body state, judging whether cracks are generated on the surfaces of the green pellets or not according to the bouncing state of the green pellets on the ball receiving steel plate, if the green pellets bounce with the ball receiving steel plate after collision, enabling the green pellets to perform free falling body movement again until the green pellets cannot bounce, and taking the bouncing frequency of the green pellets as the falling strength P of the green pellets  m  = (n-1), and the dropping strength of the m pellets is detected in sequence; average falling strength of m green pellets The invention provides a method for detecting the falling strength of iron ore green pellets based on the falling-rebounding characteristic, which replaces the traditional visual observation with the effect that whether the pellets bounce after falling freely and impacting a steel plate, reduces the labor intensity of detection personnel and improves the detection efficiency and accuracy.

title_en: Urease-assisted diagnosis method for waxberry asthenia disease
abstract_en: The invention discloses an auxiliary diagnosis method for waxberry asthenia, which comprises the steps of collecting healthy waxberry growth soil and suspected diseased waxberry growth soil in the same area, and respectively measuring urease activity of the soil; and comparing and analyzing the urease activity determination results of the healthy waxberry growth soil and the suspected diseased waxberry growth soil. If the activity of urease in the suspected diseased waxberry growing soil is obviously lower than that of the healthy waxberries, the suspected diseased waxberries are high in possibility of being weakened, and if the activity of the urease in the suspected diseased waxberry growing soil is not obviously different from that of the urease in the healthy waxberries growing soil, the suspected diseased waxberries are not weakened. The method can assist in diagnosing the waxberry asthenia disease, avoids subjective misjudgment of personnel for observing and diagnosing, and is simple and rapid in detection and low in detection cost. In addition, the diagnosis result of the method can provide reference for further orchard soil treatment and prevention and control of the debilitation for subsequent fruit growers.

title_en: Analysis and troubleshooting method and system for CAN bus error frame of electric vehicle and electric vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses an analysis and troubleshooting method and a system for CAN bus error frames of an electric vehicle and the electric vehicle, wherein the method comprises the following steps: dividing the whole CAN bus into a plurality of wire harnesses according to the troubleshooting priority, and performing independent troubleshooting on the plurality of wire harnesses; when the CAN Bus of the whole vehicle has an error frame or Bus off, detecting whether the terminal resistance of the whole vehicle is normal; when the terminal resistance of the whole vehicle is normal, detecting whether the CAN bus level is normal; when the terminal resistance of the whole vehicle and the CAN bus level are normal, the wire harnesses are sequentially disconnected according to the troubleshooting priority, and the wire harness sections in the wire harnesses are gradually removed until the source of the error frame is locked. According to the invention, the CAN bus of the whole vehicle is divided into a plurality of wire harnesses according to the troubleshooting priority, and the plurality of wire harnesses CAN be independently checked, so that the error frame problem point CAN be quickly determined on the premise of not disassembling the vehicle, the troubleshooting efficiency is improved, the maintenance time is shortened, the running stability of the whole vehicle is improved, and the market competitiveness of the whole vehicle is improved.

title_en: Start-stop detection circuit for mining equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a start-stop detection circuit for mining equipment. The start-stop detection circuit comprises a sensor circuit, a control circuit and a control circuit, wherein the sensor circuit is used for detecting the current of the equipment cable so as to output a corresponding electric signal; the signal processing circuit is connected with the sensor circuit and is used for processing the electric signal and outputting a switching value signal for representing whether an equipment cable is electrified or not; the driving circuit is connected with the signal processing circuit and is used for generating a plurality of driving signals according to the switching value signals; and the control end of the switch tube on the bridge arm of the bridge output circuit is connected with the drive circuit and used for controlling the corresponding switch tube to be switched on or switched off according to the drive signal so as to output current signals in at least two directions. By the scheme of the invention, the problem that the conventional equipment start-stop detection mode brings to safe and efficient production of the mine is solved.

title_en: Engine test run system
abstract_en: The application discloses an engine test run system, which relates to the technical field of engine test equipment and comprises a test run movable frame, a test run fixed frame, a force measuring assembly and a calibration assembly, wherein the test run fixed frame is fixedly arranged, the test run movable frame is positioned at the inner side of the test run fixed frame, the force measuring assembly and the calibration assembly are arranged between the test run movable frame and the test run fixed frame, the force measuring assembly comprises a horizontal force measuring device, an axial force measuring device and a vertical force measuring device, the horizontal force measuring device is horizontally arranged between the test run movable frame and the test run fixed frame, the axial force measuring device is horizontally arranged and is perpendicular to the horizontal force measuring device and is vertically arranged between the test run movable frame and the test run fixed frame, and the application can simulate and measure the thrust direction and the thrust in the running process of an engine, so that a worker is assisted in debugging the engine.

title_en: Analog continuous wave doppler ultrasound signal generation within an ultrasound probe and associated systems, devices, and methods
abstract_en: An ultrasound probe communicates with an ultrasound system. The ultrasound probe includes a transducer array configured to generate an analog ultrasound signal. The ultrasound probe includes an analog in-phase/quadrature (I/Q) mixer disposed within a housing of the ultrasound probe and in communication with the transducer array. The analog I/Q mixer is configured to generate an analog Continuous Wave (CW) doppler signal based on the analog ultrasound signal. The ultrasound probe includes a cable coupled to the housing, wherein the cable is configured to transmit the analog CW doppler signal from the ultrasound probe to the ultrasound system. Associated devices, systems, and methods are also provided.

title_en: Aircraft weighing method for eliminating deformation influence of undercarriage
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of airplane weighing, and particularly relates to an airplane weighing method for eliminating deformation influence of an undercarriage. The method measures standard points on the airplane by using a laser tracker on a weighing site, establishes an airplane weighing coordinate system, avoids using the wheel center of a main wheel as a weighing reference point, avoids the influence of undercarriage deformation, and obtains the barycentric coordinate by solving a primary equation set of two-dimensional equations containing barycentric coordinates Xw and Zw.

title_en: Method for measuring displacement of top of enclosure structure
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for measuring the top displacement of an enclosure structure, which is used for efficiently measuring the top horizontal and vertical displacement by using a novel measuring device so as to effectively reduce the monitoring difficulty, remarkably reduce the error and simplify the calculation process and solve the problem of measuring the irregular foundation pit enclosure structure. The method for measuring the displacement of the top of the enclosure structure comprises the following implementation stages of (1) layout of monitoring points, (2) setting of initial values, and (3) tracking and real-time monitoring.

title_en: Bionic infrared sensor
abstract_en: The application discloses a bionic infrared sensor. The bionic infrared sensor comprises a Fresnel lens structure, a bionic thermal expansion bag and a bionic flexible strain sensor, wherein the Fresnel lens is used for converging infrared light, the bionic thermal expansion is used for containing thermal expansion liquid, the thermal expansion liquid is used for absorbing infrared light converged by the Fresnel lens structure and converting infrared heat into liquid expansion, and the bionic flexible strain sensor is used for converting strain caused by the liquid thermal expansion into an electric signal to be read. The bionic infrared sensor is prepared from solid-liquid multi-materials, combines a bionic structure, realizes infrared sensing through thermal expansion, and has the characteristics of high efficiency, simplicity, low cost, intelligence and the like.

title_en: Wind power blade structure damage detection method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a wind power blade structure damage detection method which comprises the steps of obtaining a current working vibration mode signal of a wind power blade structure measured by a laser vibration meter; wherein, the current working mode signal is a two-dimensional signal; and analyzing the current working vibration mode signal based on a signal singularity detection method of spectral decomposition to obtain the damage position of the wind power blade structure. The invention can solve the problems of complex operation and long operation time of the traditional detection method.

title_en: Method for realizing directional transmission of electromagnetic energy
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for realizing directional transmission of electromagnetic energy, which comprises the steps of sequentially arranging a plurality of annular plasmas side by side in the propagation direction of electromagnetic waves, wherein the distance between the outer edges of each two annular plasmas is smaller than or equal to one quarter of waveguide wavelength corresponding to the central frequency point of the electromagnetic waves transmitted inside the annular plasmas. The invention uses annular plasma to replace circular waveguides with the same size, the annular plasma can also be sleeved on the surface of a solid medium to form the function of filling the circular waveguides with the medium, the effect of the annular plasma can be realized by using the lighted annular fluorescent lamp, the transmission of electromagnetic waves with different frequency bands can be realized by customizing the annular fluorescent lamps with different sizes, the manufacture is simple, the production cost is low, the weight of the waveguides can be greatly reduced, and the transportation is convenient.

title_en: Defect detection device and defect detection method
abstract_en: The invention provides a defect detection device and a defect detection method, which can detect defects of a bonding surface of a semiconductor die in a short time by using a simple structure. The defect detection device detects defects of the semiconductor device, and includes an ultrasonic horn that ultrasonically excites the semiconductor device, a laser light source that irradiates parallel laser light to the semiconductor device, a camera that includes an imaging element that captures an image of the semiconductor device irradiated with the parallel laser light, and a detection unit that detects defects of the semiconductor device based on the image captured by the camera, and that detects defects of the semiconductor device based on a deviation between an image of the semiconductor device at rest and an image of the semiconductor device at ultrasonic vibration, which is captured by the camera.

title_en: Vehicle detection method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vehicle detection method, a vehicle detection device, vehicle detection equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a detection result identifier of a central gateway control unit of a vehicle to be detected and a detection result identifier of a vehicle body control unit; determining a target station to be detected according to the detection result identification of the central gateway control unit and the detection result identification of the vehicle body control unit; and detecting the vehicle to be detected through the target station to be detected. By the technical scheme, the vehicle detection effectiveness and accuracy can be improved.

title_en: Method for measuring fluid flow rate, flow measuring device and computer storage medium
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a method, flow measurement device and computer readable storage medium for measuring a flow rate of a fluid. The method comprises the following steps: transmitting a probe ultrasonic wave to the fluid; acquiring sound pressure data of scattered ultrasonic waves generated by scattering of the probe ultrasonic waves by moving particles in the fluid in a plurality of continuous time intervals; and determining a moving speed of the moving particles in the fluid as a flow speed of the fluid based on a sound pressure distribution generated in the fluid by the probe ultrasonic wave and sound pressure data of the scattered ultrasonic wave.

title_en: Optical phased array, laser radar transmitting module and laser radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optical phased array, a laser radar transmitting module and a laser radar, wherein the optical phased array comprises an optical coupling area, an optical splitting area, a phase modulation area and an optical output area, wherein the optical coupling area is used for coupling light emitted by a laser into an input end of the optical splitting area, the optical splitting area is used for distributing received light to a plurality of antenna element waveguides in an equal proportion or a non-equal proportion, the phase modulation area is used for applying an electric field to the antenna element waveguides through an electrode unit to modulate the phase of transmitted light, and the optical output area is used for radiating the light subjected to the phase modulation into free space. A one-dimensional periodic F-shaped silicon block structure is arranged between the antenna element waveguides and is enabled to work in a resonance area, so that optical crosstalk is restrained. The optical phased array adopts the electric field modulation phase to replace temperature regulation and control, so that the phase modulation process is not influenced by the ambient temperature, and the stability of the phased array is improved. A one-dimensional periodic F-shaped silicon block structure is designed between the waveguides of the antenna element, so that the optical crosstalk between the waveguides can be greatly reduced, and the overall performance of the optical phased array is greatly improved.

title_en: Micro light-emitting element detection device
abstract_en: The invention provides a micro light-emitting element detection device suitable for detecting a plurality of micro light-emitting elements. The carrier is configured to carry the micro light-emitting elements. The light guide module is arranged on a transmission path of the light beams emitted by each micro light-emitting element and comprises a plurality of optical fibers. Each optical fiber has a light-emitting surface with light-receiving surfaces far away from each other. The light receiving surface of each optical fiber is arranged corresponding to at least one micro light-emitting element and is used for receiving at least one light beam emitted by the at least one micro light-emitting element. The at least one light beam is transmitted in the optical fiber and is emitted out through the light-emitting surface. The sensing module is arranged on one side of the light emergent surfaces of the optical fibers. The sensing module is used for receiving and detecting the at least one light beam from the light-emitting surface of each optical fiber so as to obtain at least one optical characteristic.

title_en: Fault identification and protection method and device for direct current line
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a method and a device for identifying and protecting faults of a direct current line. Acquiring the measured wave impedance of the side and the measured wave impedance of the opposite side of the fault line after the fault occurs, wherein the measured wave impedance is the ratio of the target voltage traveling wave and the target current traveling wave of the fault line measured by the protection device on the same side; and determining the fault type of the fault line according to the difference value between the measured wave impedance of the side and the measured wave impedance of the opposite side and the set setting value, wherein the fault type comprises an intra-area fault and an extra-area fault. The method has higher reliability and sensitivity, is not easily influenced by line distributed capacitance current, fault distance and transition resistance, can reliably identify the internal and external faults of the area, and meets the requirement of a multi-terminal flexible direct-current power transmission system on relay protection.

title_en: Turnout control circuit fault diagnosis system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a switch control circuit fault diagnosis system, which is characterized in that: the system comprises a monitoring center management unit, at least more than one outdoor acquisition unit and more than one indoor acquisition unit, wherein the outdoor acquisition units and the indoor acquisition units are respectively connected with the monitoring center management unit through a network; the monitoring center management unit is used for acquiring data of the outdoor acquisition unit and the indoor acquisition unit, analyzing and processing the data through the data trend analysis module and giving the state quantity of each data; the method is used for comparing and analyzing historical data and real-time collected data of the outdoor collecting unit and the indoor collecting unit to obtain whether potential state change exists or not. The invention can conveniently acquire the fault position and the fault information in a short time, and provides convenience for the timely judgment and subsequent processing of the fault by maintenance personnel.

title_en: Kit for diagnosing animal immune diseases
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kit for diagnosing animal immune diseases, which comprises an antibody or a cytokine, an antigen of the antibody or a stimulating source of the cytokine, and other necessary reaction reagents for forming the kit; the antibody is two or more than two antibodies or subclass antibodies with the function of distinguishing different immune reaction types, and the cell factors are two or more than two cell factors with the function of distinguishing different immune reaction types. The invention takes the specific biological marker as the diagnosis index, not only can achieve the purpose of diagnosis, but also can achieve the purpose of distinguishing different immunoreaction types such as one type and two types. The significance of this diagnosis is: the diagnosis index can indicate the degree of disease development, correctly guide a clinician to adjust a treatment scheme in time according to the dynamic change of the index in the treatment process, achieve proper treatment and make correct judgment on prognosis.

title_en: Radio frequency probe, radio frequency matcher, radio frequency power supply and radio frequency measuring instrument
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a radio frequency probe, a radio frequency matcher, a radio frequency power supply, and a radio frequency measurement instrument. The radio frequency probe comprises a shell, a radio frequency tube, a detection module and a signal processing module. The shell is provided with a detection hole. The radio frequency tube is inserted into the detection hole. The detection module comprises a current acquisition unit and a voltage acquisition unit. The signal processing module comprises a first differential amplifier, a second differential amplifier and an amplitude-phase detection chip, wherein the first differential amplifier is connected with the current acquisition unit, the first differential amplifier is connected with the amplitude-phase detection chip, the second differential amplifier is connected with the voltage acquisition unit, and the second differential amplifier is connected with the amplitude-phase detection chip. According to the scheme, the differential amplifier is arranged in the radio frequency probe, so that differential mode signals can be amplified, interference of common mode signals is restrained, and measurement accuracy of the radio frequency probe is improved.

title_en: Code Doppler effect eliminating method in signal merging process
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of signal processing, and discloses a code Doppler effect elimination method in a signal merging process. The invention solves the problem that the prior art lacks a technical scheme capable of efficiently and accurately eliminating the code Doppler effect.

title_en: Full-automatic cover plate machine of battery
abstract_en: The invention relates to a full-automatic storage battery cover plate machine, which comprises a transverse moving material taking module, a storage battery positioning and clamping module, a visual detection module and an unqualified product push-out module, wherein the transverse moving material taking module, the storage battery positioning and clamping module, the visual detection module and the unqualified product push-out module are arranged along a battery conveying line, a rotary feeding module and a feeding intermediate transition module are arranged below the transverse moving material taking module, a robot material taking cover plate module is arranged between the feeding intermediate transition module and the storage battery positioning and clamping module, and the unqualified product push-out module is relatively provided with an unqualified product push-out frame. The cover plate is fully filled in the rotary feeding module, and the cover plate is sucked and placed on the transition module in the middle of feeding by the transverse moving material taking module. The robot takes the cover plate out of the storage battery clamped by the positioning and clamping module and covers the storage battery, so that automatic cover plate is realized. The storage battery covered with the cover sheet is conveyed by the battery conveying line and passes through the visual detection module, and the quality of the cover sheet covered in the storage battery conveyed by the conveying line module is detected. If the battery is normal, the conveyor line continues to convey the battery to the tail; otherwise, the unqualified products are pushed out by the unqualified product pushing module.

title_en: Ground sampling device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of sampling, in particular to a rock-soil sampling device which comprises an installation frame, outer cylinders, drill cylinders and a sampling mechanism, wherein the number of the outer cylinders is at least two, the axes of two adjacent outer cylinders are parallel and are arranged at intervals, the number of the drill cylinders is at least two, the axes of the drill cylinders are parallel to the axis of the outer cylinder, and the two adjacent drill cylinders are arranged at intervals, the drill cylinders are used for synchronously rotating with the outer cylinders and synchronously drilling downwards, and move upwards relative to the outer cylinders after drilling downwards to a sampling position so as to take out soil in the outer cylinders; the sampling mechanisms are at least two and are used for taking out soil layer samples between two adjacent outer cylinders after the drilling cylinder takes out soil in the outer cylinders. Because the soil layer between the two outer cylinders is not extruded when being drilled, the layering condition is more accurate, and the accuracy degree is higher when the soil layer is used as a sample for analysis.

title_en: Probe and kit for identifying nucleolus and nucleolus labeling method
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of molecular marker recognition, in particular to a nucleolus recognition probe, a nucleolus recognition kit and a nucleolus marking method. The nucleolus-recognizing probe provided by the application comprises a nucleotide sequence shown as GGXGGG, and the probe has a length of at least 20 nucleotides; the specific probe can be specifically combined with various nucleolin proteins, so that the nucleolin can be specifically marked, the nucleolin can be specifically marked and detected by the probe, the cost is low, the nucleolin phase separation structure can be well reflected, and the three-dimensional structure of the nucleolin can be reflected by an image obtained by imaging after marking, so that the probe has a good application prospect.

title_en: Radar antenna beam control system for satellite self-rotation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a radar antenna beam control system for the rotation of a satellite itself, said system comprising: the antenna scanning angle calculating unit is used for calculating beam pointing according to the self parameter information of the satellite and the detection target information; a beam on-orbit forming unit, configured to generate an amplitude-phase control word of a plurality of TR components of a radar antenna of the satellite according to the beam direction; and the beam parameter control unit is used for writing the amplitude and phase control word into the corresponding TR component according to a preset time sequence and adjusting the beam direction of the radar antenna in real time. The invention has the advantages of low system complexity, high pointing precision, high beam autonomous adjustment speed and the like, has the on-orbit autonomous control capability, and does not need frequent uploading control instructions of a ground measurement and control station.

title_en: Method and system for fitting circuit tripping simulation curve
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fitting method of a line trip simulation curve, which comprises the following steps: firstly, automatically extracting relevant parameters of a target line based on imported BPA data, and calculating current values before and after the line trips; building curve fitting of line tripping, automatically fitting a simulation curve through a specified fault type, and generating simulation data in a Commrode format containing a fault time sequence; finally, reading the simulation data through a stability control tester, and replaying and checking the accuracy of the trip judgment of the device; the technical problems that in the prior art, the design of criterion and fixed value is strictly dependent on manual setting, the difference of circuit parameters in an actual system is large, and the reliability of a stability control device is poor due to the inconsistency of the method for calculating the fixed value setting are solved.

title_en: Aircraft atmospheric data system check out test set
abstract_en: The application provides an aircraft atmospheric data system detection device, which comprises an atmospheric data system detection platform and a dynamic and static air pressure simulation source device, and can be used for off-site detection of an atmospheric data computer, a total temperature indicator, a total temperature sensor and a field pressure setter of an aircraft atmospheric data system; the system can also be used for carrying out static pressure, full pressure, altitude, airspeed and lifting speed in-situ detection on an aircraft atmospheric data computer; the detection equipment can detect the aircraft atmosphere data system more comprehensively, and can judge the overall working condition of the aircraft atmosphere data system more accurately; in addition, the detection equipment adopts the Bluetooth technology, and the identity-based key management can prevent illegal invasion and can also improve the detection efficiency of an aircraft atmosphere data system.

title_en: Battery diagnosis device, battery diagnosis method, storage medium, and vehicle
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a battery diagnosis apparatus, a battery diagnosis method, a storage medium, and a vehicle. The battery diagnosis apparatus diagnoses a state of a battery and includes: a first acquisition unit that acquires actual years of use of the battery; a second acquisition unit that acquires a full charge capacity of the battery; and a determination unit that performs a degradation determination of the battery based on the actual years of use and the full charge capacity, wherein the determination unit determines that the battery has degraded when the actual years of use exceeds a determination year and the full charge capacity is less than a determination capacity.

title_en: Power distribution early warning method, device, equipment and storage medium based on intelligent bus
abstract_en: The invention relates to an artificial intelligence technology, and discloses a power distribution early warning method based on an intelligent bus, which comprises the following steps: all the access devices are gathered into an access device group, and a device type form is generated according to the access device group; acquiring normal working data corresponding to the access equipment group through a temperature sensor, a voltage sensor and a current sensor of the intelligent bus, and generating normal working data according to the normal working data; monitoring the state of the access equipment group to obtain monitoring working data, and judging the state of each access equipment in the access equipment group according to the monitoring working data and the normal working data to obtain an equipment state form; and when the abnormal state appears in the equipment state form, performing abnormal early warning by using a display component of the intelligent bus according to the equipment type form. The invention further provides a power distribution early warning device based on the intelligent bus, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The invention can improve the accuracy of the safety early warning and has lower accuracy.

title_en: Obstacle detection method and system based on reference line
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for detecting an obstacle based on a reference line, belongs to the technical field of obstacle detection, can accurately judge obstacle information, hardly causes the condition of missing detection, is suitable for a closed or semi-closed low-speed scene, can accurately track and predict the scene with high risk, such as the coming vehicle and the rear overtaking vehicle, and realizes the obstacle avoidance function of a vehicle by combining decision planning and using low computing power and low-cost hardware. Accurate obstacle information does not need to be obtained, only the nearest point of each route to the vehicle needs to be obtained, historical data is combined, therefore, the obstacle tracking prediction of each route is achieved, the method can be achieved by adopting a low-resolution laser radar and a simple algorithm, the calculation force demand is reduced, the problem of low-cost unmanned obstacle recognition in a closed and semi-closed low-speed scene is solved, and the popularization and the application of unmanned vehicles are facilitated.

title_en: Intersection point load actual measurement and verification method for statically indeterminate installed engine
abstract_en: The invention establishes an intersection point load actual measurement and verification method for statically indeterminate installation of an aeroengine, firstly, a strain bridge is designed and installed, an independent load calibration test of an inner/outer thrust pin and a vertical/horizontal pull rod of the engine is carried out, a strain-load equation of each intersection point load component is established by adopting a gradual multiple linear regression method, then, an on-board load calibration test of the inner/outer thrust pin and the vertical/horizontal pull rod of the engine is carried out, and calibration test data is utilized, so that a method for verifying rationality and prediction accuracy of the strain-load equation is established. The method and the device avoid the problem of multiple collinearity of the constructed load equation to influence robustness, improve the prediction precision of the equation, provide a technical path for verifying the rationality of constructing the statically indeterminate installation aeroengine strain-load equation based on the independent load calibration test data, and provide reliable support for the flight actual measurement of the aeroengine installation intersection point load.

title_en: Test device for simulating constant-load stress corrosion in deep sea environment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of stress corrosion tests of deep sea environments, and particularly relates to a constant-load stress corrosion test device for simulating a deep sea environment, which can perform a stress corrosion test of a material under the simulated deep sea environment, a sample is placed in a high-pressure test cabin for simulating the deep sea environment, medium conditions such as sea pressure, temperature and the like in the high-pressure test cabin are adjusted to simulate the deep sea service environment, meanwhile, constant-load loading is performed on the sample through an extravehicular stress ring and a cabin-penetrating tension rod, the loaded stress change and the stress corrosion crack expansion condition are monitored on line through an external load sensor and a crack expansion test technology, the stress corrosion parameter monitoring and the constant-load stress corrosion test of the sample under the simulated service environment are realized, and the critical stress intensity factor and the crack expansion rate of the sample under the simulated deep sea environment are obtained according to test results, so as to comprehensively evaluate the stress corrosion sensitivity of metal materials.

title_en: Method for manufacturing grid oxygen sample of transmission electron microscope and structure thereof
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a method for manufacturing a gate oxide sample of a transmission electron microscope and a structure thereof, wherein the method for manufacturing the gate oxide sample of the transmission electron microscope comprises providing a sample; selecting a region to be detected on a sample, exposing an active region, and exposing a single row of active regions. According to the method, the samples on the periphery of the initial protective layer are sequentially removed along the length direction of the to-be-detected area, partial samples are removed along the arrangement direction of the active area on the samples, the active area on the samples is exposed, the angles of the samples relative to the electron beams emitted by the transmission electron microscope are adjusted, for example, the machine table of the transmission electron microscope rotates at the same angle with the included angle between the length direction of the to-be-detected area and the length direction of the bit line on the samples, the electron beams are perpendicular to the length direction of the bit line on the samples or the arrangement direction of the active area on the samples, the purpose that the section along the arrangement direction of the active area and the section along the length direction of the bit line exist on a single sample is achieved, and then the detection of different angles is carried out through single sample preparation.

title_en: Double-layer coating upper and lower layer slurry mutual dissolution detection method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of lithium ion batteries, and discloses a double-layer coating upper and lower layer slurry mutual dissolution detection method, which comprises the following steps: (1) Respectively preparing upper sizing agent with various viscosities and lower sizing agent with various viscosities; (2) Combining the upper-layer sizing agent and the lower-layer sizing agent with various viscosities, and obtaining coated pole pieces with different viscosity combinations through a double-layer die head; (3) Sampling a plurality of the coated pole pieces, and performing EDS test; (4) And judging the mutual solubility degree of the upper layer slurry and the lower layer slurry according to the EDS test result. The method of the invention can effectively detect the mutual solubility degree between the upper layer slurry and the lower layer slurry through the distribution of special elements or the difference of graphite forms, and determine the proper formula composition of the upper layer slurry and the lower layer slurry and the viscosity combination mode of the upper layer slurry and the lower layer slurry according to the mutual solubility degree, or provide an improvement direction for the mutual solubility of the upper layer slurry and the lower layer slurry, thereby avoiding the influence of the mutual solubility of the upper layer slurry and the lower layer slurry on the battery performance and achieving the aim of improving the battery performance.

title_en: Environment data processing method, device, storage medium and product
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides an environmental data processing method, apparatus, storage medium, and product, the environmental data processing method comprising: determining whether a predetermined condition is satisfied according to the environment monitoring information; when the environmental monitoring information does not meet the preset condition, determining whether the first terminal equipment receives or generates first confirmation information; if the first terminal equipment does not receive or generate the first confirmation information, determining whether the second terminal equipment receives or generates the second confirmation information; and if the second terminal equipment receives or generates the second confirmation information, sending a notice to one or both of the first terminal equipment and the second terminal equipment. The technical scheme can remind and adjust the environment and safety protection inside the vehicle influencing children at any time, and provides great guarantee for the family closing and the travel of the users.

title_en: Positioning method for reducing power consumption, terminal equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a positioning method for reducing power consumption, a terminal device and a storage medium, wherein the positioning method is applied to the terminal device, the terminal device stores first position information in advance, the first position information is position information which is acquired by the terminal device last time and meets a fuzzy positioning requirement, and the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a first positioning request sent by an application program of the terminal equipment; and when the position acquisition authority of the application program is fuzzy positioning, feeding back the first position information to the application program. By feeding back the first position information to the application program, the method for executing or not executing the positioning request command or action is reduced, and the energy consumption generated when the terminal equipment provides the fuzzy positioning function is reduced.

title_en: Real-time environment temperature and humidity monitoring device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an environment temperature and humidity real-time monitoring device, which relates to the technical field of humidity monitoring equipment and comprises a monitoring box, wherein the outer wall of the rear side of the monitoring box is fixedly connected with a mounting plate, the outer wall of the front side of the monitoring box is fixedly connected with a display plate, and the outer wall of the front side of the monitoring box is fixedly connected with a plurality of control buttons. This environment humiture real-time supervision device, the staff can pass through the mounting panel with the device and fix on the wall in workshop, starter motor can drive the rotation axis and take place to rotate, the fan is inhaled in the burden and is inhaled a section of thick bamboo inside emergence rotation, utilize the burden to inhale the rotatory effect of fan, can adsorb ambient gas, ambient gas can enter into the inside of monitoring box through the inlet port on the admission cylinder, the humidity monitor can monitor the humidity that enters into monitoring box inside gas, the device is to the effect of humidity monitoring, for prior art says, monitoring speed is fast, monitoring effect is good.

title_en: Method for extracting five medicinal components from radix puerariae based on eutectic solvent
abstract_en: The invention provides an extraction method of five medicinal components in kudzuvine root based on eutectic solvent, wherein the preparation of the eutectic solvent adopts a one-step preparation method, and hydrogen bond donors and acceptors are mixed according to a certain molar ratio until stable liquid is formed; and then adding the eutectic solvent into the pretreated kudzuvine root, preparing a sample solution, and performing HPLC detection. The five medicinal components in the kudzuvine root are 3-hydroxy puerarin, 3-methoxy puerarin, soyabean glycoside and soyabean aglycone, ultrasonic assistance is utilized in preparation of a sample solution, and a hydrogen bond donor of the eutectic solvent is urea, fructose or glucose, and an acceptor is choline chloride or betaine. The eutectic solvent is simple and economical to prepare, does not need auxiliary technology or purification, and adopts a one-step preparation method.

title_en: Laying device and laying method for shallow stratum deformation monitoring cable
abstract_en: The invention discloses a laying device and a laying method of a shallow formation deformation monitoring cable, and relates to the technical field of laying of the deformation monitoring cable. The invention can realize the accurate positioning of the laying position by utilizing the CPT device, realize the separation of the laying device and the CPT device after the deformation monitoring cable is penetrated, and provide energy and operation support by utilizing the auxiliary mechanism, thereby leaving the laying device in situ for long-term in-situ monitoring.

title_en: Wafer penetration type defect detection device and method
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a wafer penetration type defect detection device and a wafer penetration type defect detection method, and relates to the technical field of wafer quality detection. Compared with the prior art, the wafer penetration type defect detection device and method provided by the invention realize exposure and detection of penetration type defects through colored smoke, avoid the use of complex optical equipment, realize detection of small-size penetration type defects, and have the advantages of simple structure, convenience in operation, simplified detection process and good detection effect.

title_en: Fitting method and device of battery capacity increment comprehensive curve and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a fitting method, a fitting device and electronic equipment of a capacity increment comprehensive curve, wherein a mode of filtering discrete values in capacity increment values of voltage (sub) intervals of the capacity increment curve of charge and discharge data is adopted to eliminate interference of fluctuation and instability of current and voltage data on the capacity increment comprehensive curve, and the integrity and accuracy of the calculated capacity increment comprehensive curve are greatly improved.

title_en: Wall perpendicularity testing instrument for building engineering
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wall perpendicularity testing device for constructional engineering.
