The invention aims to provide the wall perpendicularity testing device for the building engineering, which is used for easily testing the wall perpendicularity and is convenient for a user to intuitively and accurately judge the inclination condition of the wall. A wall surface verticality testing device for construction engineering comprises a base, wherein a shell is connected to the upper part of the base; the mounting mechanisms are arranged at the upper side and the lower side of the inside of the shell; the upper side and the lower side of the installation mechanism are provided with sliding drums in an up-down symmetry way; the inner sides of the sliding drums are connected with the sliding bars in a sliding manner; the measuring plate is connected between one side of the upper sliding rod and one side of the lower sliding rod; the extension springs are connected between the sliding rods and the sliding cylinders; and the testing mechanism is arranged between one side of the shell and the sliding rod. The wall perpendicularity testing device for the building engineering has the advantages of being convenient to move, guaranteeing smooth testing and convenient to align the measuring plate by stabilizing the device.

title_en: Reservoir parameter prediction method based on fused convolution neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a reservoir parameter prediction method based on a fused convolution neural network, and belongs to the technical field of petroleum exploration and development. According to the method, the three convolution operations are input into the fusion convolution network by respectively carrying out convolution operation on the seismic waveform data, the seismic edge attribute data and the wave impedance inversion data near the well logging data, and the relation between the well logging data and the seismic data volume is established by training the fusion convolution network, so that the prediction of reservoir parameters of the area lacking the well logging data can be realized by utilizing the relation and the corresponding seismic data volume. Therefore, the method and the device can realize the estimation of the logging data in the area lacking logging data through the related seismic data, further realize the prediction of the reservoir parameters, and avoid the problem that the reservoir parameters cannot be accurately predicted due to the lack of the logging data.

title_en: Multi-channel simultaneous inversion identification method, device and medium for improving inversion resolution
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-channel simultaneous inversion identification method, a multi-channel simultaneous inversion identification device and a multi-channel simultaneous inversion medium for improving inversion resolution. The time domain seismic inversion method is superior to the frequency domain seismic inversion method in anti-noise, but the frequency domain seismic inversion method is superior to the time domain seismic inversion method in resolution. The invention combines the advantages of the seismic inversion method in the time domain and the frequency domain, and improves the resolution of the inversion result on the premise of ensuring noise resistance. Aiming at the problem that the traditional channel-by-channel inversion does not consider transverse information, a multi-channel simultaneous inversion method is introduced, so that the correlation between adjacent seismic channels is enhanced, and the transverse continuity of inversion results is improved. According to the background of the seismic data, the purposes of high noise resistance and high resolution can be achieved by adjusting the weight coefficients of the time domain and the frequency domain.

title_en: Measurement calculation method of camera shooting projection coordinate measuring instrument with legal code triangular cone
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of shooting projection coordinate measurement, in particular to a measurement calculation method of a shooting projection coordinate measuring instrument with a legal code triangular pyramid, wherein the coordinate measuring instrument comprises two or more cameras, the legal code triangular pyramid and an intelligent calculator, the cameras have a laser ranging function, the legal code triangular pyramid consists of four points and six lines, a camera signal is connected to the intelligent calculator, the intelligent calculator shoots an object to be measured by utilizing the two or more cameras with known distances and angles on a bracket, and the legal code triangular pyramid is arranged in a range of a region to be measured; cameras with different angle distances pick up the same area to be measured, two-dimensional images are obtained respectively, then the distance measurement data of the cameras are obtained, then the length and the angle proportion of the images are corrected according to the known size method code triangular cone, then the distances are obtained through three hemispherical intersection points, and then three-dimensional calculation is carried out, so that three-dimensional images of the area to be measured and the object to be measured can be obtained, and the defect that a single camera has irradiation dead angles due to different angles of multiple cameras can be improved.

title_en: Miniature linear sliding platform with displacement measuring function
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of medical instruments and discloses a miniature linear sliding platform with a displacement measurement function. The miniature linear sliding platform comprises a guide sliding rail, a sliding platform, a driving assembly and a light curtain type distance sensor. The light curtain type distance sensor is arranged on the sliding platform, and an inclined plane and/or a chute which change monotonically along the axial direction are formed on one side of the positioning guide shaft, which faces the light curtain emitted by the light curtain type distance sensor, so that the light curtain type distance sensor has the advantages of compact overall structure, high measurement precision and good reliability, and is beneficial to miniaturization and precise control of equipment. When the sliding platform moves from the first position to the second position, according to the corresponding relation between the change of the distance measurement value and the slope on the inclined plane and/or the chute, performing first measurement calculation and/or second measurement calculation to obtain the displacement of the sliding platform relative to the guide sliding rail, further obtaining the running speed and the position information of the sliding platform, and forming a closed-loop control system by the light curtain type distance sensor and the driving assembly, thereby ensuring the movement precision and the stability of the sliding platform.

title_en: Battery health degree estimation method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a battery health degree estimation method, which comprises the following steps: receiving operation data of a vehicle; judging whether the operation data can be used for estimating the health degree of the battery; and if so, calculating a value for each of the plurality of health features from the operational data and providing the calculated value to a trained neural network model of the vehicle to estimate the battery health, wherein the trained neural network model is used to represent a relationship between the plurality of health features and the battery health. The scheme of the invention considers the factors of the use process and the environment of the battery, so that the obtained battery SOH is more accurate. When the method is executed online, namely, the operation data transmitted by the vehicle-mounted networking terminal is utilized to estimate the SOH of the battery at the cloud server of the host factory, the host factory can dynamically grasp the battery health condition of the sold vehicle and dynamically monitor the battery service condition of the user, so that after-sale and maintenance service is provided, and the user experience is improved.

title_en: Product testing system for automatic assembly product of phased array radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a product testing system for automatically assembling products by a phased array radar, which comprises a testing host, a power module and a program control switch, wherein the testing host comprises a software system and a hardware system, the software system comprises a flight simulation system, a microwave simulation system, a weapon simulation system, a scanning control system and a multi-channel digital testing system, the hardware system comprises a bus communication module, a digital signal instrument, a digital multimeter, a power analyzer, a vector network analyzer, a spectrum analyzer and a microwave signal source, the power module supplies power for the software system and the hardware system in the testing host, and the program control switch integrates a connecting wire and a control switch and can be used for connecting the testing host and the products and controlling the start of a testing program. The invention basically covers all the test indexes of the phased array radar product by combining the software system and the hardware system, has high test automation degree and test accuracy, and can be suitable for various types of instruments for testing.

title_en: Grating diffraction efficiency optimization method for point target infrared spectrum measurement
abstract_en: The invention provides a grating diffraction efficiency optimization method of point target infrared spectrum measurement, which combines the characteristics of an infrared grating diffraction efficiency curve, and gives consideration to the factors such as infrared target radiation characteristic, atmospheric window transmittance, spectral bandwidth, infrared detector spectral response and the like.

title_en: Fork truck bracket convenient for loading weight and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of forklift supports, in particular to a forklift support convenient for loading heavy objects and a using method thereof, wherein the forklift support comprises a frame, a sliding sleeve and a control box; the weighing module is arranged at the bottom of the inner cavity of the frame, positioning columns are arranged at four corners of the bottom of the frame, positioning sleeves matched with the positioning columns are arranged at four corners of the top of the frame, and the positioning columns correspond to the positioning sleeves in position; the sliding sleeve is arranged at the bottom of the front surface of the frame, a threaded sleeve is arranged at the top of the sliding sleeve, a threaded rod is arranged in an inner cavity of the threaded sleeve, a locking knob is arranged at the top of the threaded rod, and a fork hole of a forklift is arranged at the bottom of the sliding sleeve; the control box is arranged at the top of the front surface of the frame, and the front surface of the control box is provided with a display unit; the novel weighing machine is reasonable in structure, convenient to stack in the use process, good in stability, strong in practicality and high in safety, and has a weighing function.

title_en: Very low frequency birdcage resonator based on novel lumped parameter transmission line method
abstract_en: The invention relates to an extremely low frequency birdcage resonator based on a novel lumped parameter transmission line method, and belongs to the field of electromagnetic detection. Based on the lumped parameter transmission line method of the multi-turn litz wire winding structure, the half-wavelength transmission line can be in redundant configuration, the full-wavelength configuration formed by the redundant configuration can adopt an orthogonal mode, namely, the second half part of the redundancy is wound on the first half part in a certain mode, and signal connection points are offset by 90 degrees in space, so that a roof tile structure is formed. The multi-turn litz wire winding structure-based lumped parameter transmission line method is applicable to not only low-pass birdcage coils but also high-pass birdcage coils. The very low frequency birdcage resonator designed by the invention has the advantages of large inductance, convenient tuning, strong excitation magnetic field, simple structure and high detection sensitivity, and can be used for very low frequency magnetic nanoparticle imaging, very low field MRI and the like.

title_en: Slag volume flow measuring device and measuring method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a slag volume flow measuring device and a slag volume flow measuring method, wherein the slag volume flow measuring device comprises binocular cameras, a green laser source, a red laser line and a green laser line, wherein one camera is arranged on two sides of the center of a slag discharging direction, the two cameras are arranged front and back in the slag discharging direction, the green laser source is used for emitting the green laser line, the red laser source is used for emitting the red laser line, one laser line is parallel to the slag discharging direction, the other laser line is perpendicular to the slag discharging direction, and each camera of the binocular cameras respectively acquires slag discharging images with the green laser line and the red laser line. The measuring device adopts two red and green lasers and a binocular camera. And calculating the cross-sectional area of slag on the conveyor belt by using the R channel image, performing cross-correlation calculation displacement by using the matching result of the front and rear frames of images of the G channel, and calculating the speed of the conveyor belt by combining the sampling time, wherein the coupling cross-sectional area and the speed realize the online detection of the volume flow of slag.

title_en: Control method and device for dust removal system pipe network
abstract_en: The application discloses a control method and a control device for a dust removal system pipe network. The method comprises the following steps: receiving a first signal of a dust removing point in the dust removing system pipe network to determine a predicted treatment level; receiving a second signal in the dust removal system pipe network to determine an actual treatment level; and adjusting the air quantity of the dust removal system pipe network based on the comparison of the predicted treatment level and the actual treatment level. The invention reduces the energy consumption to the minimum on the basis of ensuring the dust raising control at the tail end of the dust remover.

title_en: Cab electrical equipment function detection device and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a system for detecting functions of electric equipment in a cab, and relates to the technical field of the device for detecting the functions of the electric equipment in a vehicle, wherein the device for detecting the functions comprises: the intelligent cabinet temperature control device comprises a cabinet body, a direct current power supply, a transition joint and a plurality of detection joints, wherein the direct current power supply is arranged in the cabinet body; the transition joint is detachably and electrically connected with the direct-current power supply; the detection joints are electrically connected with the transition joint, and the detection joints are used for alternatively and detachably electrically connecting with one electrical device in the cab. The invention integrates the connectors, is more convenient to use, and can realize the detection of the functions of various vehicle types of cab electrical equipment.

title_en: Radar detection system for detecting falling accident and detection method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a radar detection system for detecting falling accidents and a detection method thereof, wherein the radar detection system comprises a detection radar, a detection antenna, an A/D converter, a signal processor and a central processing unit, wherein the detection radar comprises a signal generator for generating radio frequency signals, a detection antenna for transmitting or receiving the radio frequency signals, the A/D converter is used for converting the radio frequency signals into digital signals, the signal processor is used for converting the digital signals into detection parameters, and the central processing unit is used for analyzing and processing the detection parameters; the detection parameters comprise one or more of angle, position, distance and speed; the cloud server comprises a client and one or two of a management terminal and a mobile terminal; the single-control double-output module is used for supplying power to the detection radar uninterruptedly and supplying power to the power utilization terminal in a switching mode; the cloud server is respectively connected with the detection radar and the client in a communication way; the central processing unit sends falling information to the cloud server and the client; the detection radar is electrically connected with the urban power grid. The radar detection system can accurately and timely detect falling accidents.

title_en: Tool clamp for airtight detection of connector
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fixture for detecting tightness of a connector, and relates to the technical field of circuit connection. This a detect frock clamp for connector is airtight, including the anchor clamps base with install the detection support at anchor clamps base top surface, the bottom surface mounting who detects the support has check out test set, check out test set is used for carrying out the gas tightness to the connector and detects, the top surface mounting of anchor clamps base has limit clamp, limit clamp's outside surface mounting has guide mechanism. According to the invention, the hydraulic pump is controlled by the controller to drive the driving shaft to move downwards, so that the upper test plate is driven to contact with the lower test plate, the air tightness of the connector in the limiting cavity is detected, the detection result is sent to the controller, and after the detection is finished, the electromagnet has the same magnetism with the corresponding surface of the bearing plate, so that the bearing plate moves upwards along the limiting cavity under the action of magnetic repulsive force, and the detected connector is pushed out of the limiting cavity.

title_en: Quick drying device of heating of food detection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heating and quick drying device for food detection, which relates to the technical field of food detection and comprises the following components: the food heating device comprises a box body, a heating mechanism, a storage component and a filtering mechanism, wherein the heating mechanism is arranged at the lower end of the box body, a fixing mechanism is arranged inside the box body, the storage component is transversely arranged in the fixing mechanism in a sliding mode, the filtering mechanism is fixed at the upper end face of the box body, the filtering mechanism is used for adsorbing peculiar smell generated during food heating, a circulation pipeline is arranged in the box body, and the circulation pipeline is used for circulating the absorbed hot air, so that the heat utilization rate is improved.

title_en: Sample crushing and mixing device for food detection and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sample crushing and mixing device for food detection and a use method thereof, comprising a stirring mechanism, a crushing mechanism and a mixing cylinder, wherein the end part of the mixing cylinder is in threaded connection with a sealing cover, the inside of the mixing cylinder is provided with the crushing mechanism, and the crushing mechanism comprises a piston block, crushing teeth, an electromagnet and a compression spring, and the beneficial effects of the invention are that: by arranging the crushing mechanism, the repulsive force generated by the electromagnet and the first permanent magnet is larger than the tensile force of the compression spring, and under the repulsive force, the piston block impacts and extrudes the blocky material downwards with the crushing teeth, so that the blocky material is crushed in a reciprocating manner; through setting up rabbling mechanism and driving the regulation diaphragm at the inside up-and-down motion of piston piece through elevator motor and transmission lead screw, the (mixing) shaft drives puddler and cutting knife and stirs liquid mixed reagent, and the steel wire rotates under inertial action simultaneously, smashes inside granule, stirs the blending drum not co-altitude under elevator motor effect.

title_en: Low-cost nucleic acid/protein electroelution device and method
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of elution devices, and provides a low-cost nucleic acid/protein electroelution device which comprises a glue bearing module, a dialysis membrane module and a fixing module, wherein the glue bearing module and the dialysis membrane module are both arranged in the fixing module, and an assembly of the glue bearing module and the dialysis membrane module is fixed in a horizontal electrophoresis tank through the fixing module; the gel receiving module is used for loading gel blocks cut after gel electrophoresis separation, one end of the gel receiving module is inserted into the dialysis membrane module, and one end of the gel receiving module, which is positioned in the dialysis membrane module, is provided with a separation gel block for constructing an elution space between the gel receiving module and the dialysis membrane module; the dialysis membrane module is provided with a dialysis membrane, the dialysis membrane is fixed on the dialysis membrane module through a clamping ring, and target molecules to be eluted are intercepted and collected through the dialysis membrane. The device has the advantages of simple operation, mild condition, low cost, recycling, high economical efficiency, high actual elution recovery rate and wide applicability.

title_en: Inspection tool for connecting rod connecting screw of marine diesel engine
abstract_en: The invention discloses an inspection tool for connecting rod connecting screws of marine diesel engines, which comprises an inspection tool table, wherein an electric push rod is arranged on the outer surface of the upper end of the inspection tool table, a fixing rod is arranged on the outer surface of the upper end of the electric push rod, a connecting disc is fixedly connected with the outer surface of the lower end of the fixing rod, a connecting rod is fixedly connected with the inner surface of the upper end of the connecting disc, and a mounting rack is arranged on the outer wall of the connecting rod. This marine diesel engine connecting rod connecting screw's inspection frock uses through connecting rod, mounting bracket, hold-down spring, swash plate and slipmat's cooperation, and the swash plate can adapt to adjust the interval so that the different connecting screw of centre gripping improves the centre gripping effect of inspection frock, uses through the cooperation of first gear, second gear, screw handle and slipmat, and the nut will install on connecting screw with threaded connection's mode this moment, reaches the purpose of inspection screw, can also carry out the inspection of multiunit connecting screw simultaneously, improves the work efficiency of inspection frock.

title_en: Electromagnetic unlocking type dynamic composite loading experimental device and experimental method
abstract_en: An electromagnetic unlocking type dynamic composite loading experiment device and an experiment method comprise two compression/tension wave loading guns, a torque machine, an electromagnetic unlocking mechanism and a synchronous control mechanism. The incident rod is disconnected with the flange during compression-torsion experiments, and the incident rod is connected with the flange during tension-torsion experiments. The two compression wave/tension wave loading guns are respectively positioned at two ends of the sliding rail. The two torque machines and the two electromagnetic unlocking mechanisms are respectively arranged on the sliding rail. The inner end of the first incident rod sequentially passes through the torque machine and the electromagnetic unlocking mechanism at the end, and the inner end of the second incident rod sequentially passes through the torque machine and the electromagnetic unlocking mechanism at the end. According to the invention, through bidirectional compression-torsion and bidirectional stretching-torsion loading, the internal stress balance time of a sample can be reduced, the strain rate of the sample is improved, the large plastic deformation and damage of a high-strength large plastic material in the dynamic compression-torsion/stretching torsion process are realized, and the technical blank of the related field is filled.

title_en: Anemometer fault early warning method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anemometer fault early warning method, a device and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring real-time data and historical operation data of a target anemometer; extracting impeller rotating speed and wind speed data under a stable working condition from the historical operation data; calculating to obtain fault thresholds of multiple levels according to the impeller rotating speed and the wind speed data; performing deviation analysis on the real-time data to obtain data deviation; and comparing the data deviation with the fault threshold value to obtain a fault grade for early warning. According to the invention, by analyzing the historical operation data of the anemometer and comparing the real-time data with the historical conditions, whether the current operation state of the anemometer has fault risks and risk severity is accurately judged, so that early warning is timely carried out, timely overhaul of staff is facilitated, and loss is reduced.

title_en: Cooling socket of chip temperature cycle aging test board
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cooling socket of a chip temperature cycle aging test board, and relates to the technical field of chip desktop-level high-temperature aging test; the cooling socket includes: the cooling socket comprises a cooling socket body, a cooling fan, a regulating ring, a cooling socket slide bar and a cooling socket spring; the temperature-reducing socket is used for an aging test bench, two chips can be tested at the same time, the heating socket and the cooling socket are alternately contacted with the two test chips through the sliding seat and the connecting frame, no heat loss is caused during the heating of the heating socket, when the temperature of the other chip is raised, no heating rod is arranged between the cooling socket and the chip, the temperature-reducing socket is nearer to the chip, the temperature-reducing speed is high, the temperature circulation time is shortened, and the test efficiency is improved; the temperature-cycling aging test method is used for the aging test method, and the two chips to be tested are alternately contacted with the heating socket and the cooling socket, so that the temperature of the heating socket is prevented from being reduced when the temperature is reduced, and meanwhile, the temperature-cycling aging test method adopts a more efficient cooling socket, is high in cooling speed, and improves the temperature-cycling aging test efficiency.

title_en: Intelligent river and lake water ecological restoration MABC system cloud pipe platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water ecological restoration, which is used for solving the problems that in the existing water ecological restoration mode, planning and classification of water environment cannot be achieved, the expected effect of water ecological restoration is poor, verification of water ecological restoration results cannot be achieved, and further the water ecological restoration period cannot be timely adjusted. According to the invention, a restoration technical means of the treatment of the target object is defined by a data analysis mode, different restoration strategies are adopted aiming at different water body types so as to obtain the best restoration effect of the water body, promote the sustainable healthy development of the water ecological system and realize the ecological balance of the river and lake water ecological system.

title_en: High-temperature material yield point testing method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for testing yield point of high-temperature material, which relates to the technical field of high-temperature material testing, and solves the technical problems that stress parameters of high-temperature materials are not considered to change in different temperature states, so that the stress testing result is inaccurate easily, abnormal high-temperature materials are directly removed, whether the abnormal high-temperature materials affect normal use is not analyzed, the quantitative loss is reduced, the stress parameters of the high-temperature materials in different stay temperature states are confirmed according to an established two-dimensional coordinate change curve graph, whether the corresponding stress tests of the high-temperature materials are normal is analyzed and judged according to the confirmed stress parameters, if abnormal, the limit test is carried out, whether the abnormal high-temperature materials affect normal use is analyzed, the practicability of the system is improved, the abnormal stress is avoided, the use of the high-temperature materials is avoided, and the production loss is reduced to a certain extent.

title_en: Fireproof testing device for fireproof electric wire and cable production
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fire resistance testing device for cables, in particular to a fire resistance testing device for producing fireproof electric wires and cables. The invention aims to provide a fire-resistant testing device for producing fireproof electric wires and cables, which can test samples of a plurality of cables simultaneously. The invention provides a fire-resistant testing device for producing fireproof electric wires and cables, which comprises a bottom frame, a testing frame body, a cover plate, side plates and flame ejectors, wherein the two sides of the top of the bottom frame are connected with the side plates, the testing frame body is connected between the side plates on the two sides, the bottom of the testing frame body is uniformly provided with ventilation holes at intervals, the testing frame body is rotatably connected with the cover plate, and the flame ejectors are arranged on the testing frame body. According to the invention, the cables can be put in through the sleeves, and when the cables are put in, the cables with different types and specifications can be put in at the same time, so that the effect of testing the cables at the same time is realized, and the cables can be compared transversely during testing, so that the obtained test knot is more visual.

title_en: SRM switching tube short-circuit fault dynamic diagnosis method adopting current translation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic diagnosis method for short-circuit faults of an SRM switching tube by adopting current translation. The method for diagnosing the short-circuit fault of the switching tube adopts a mode of translating an actual current waveform by one electric period, takes the current waveform of the last electric period as a reference current waveform corresponding to the current electric period, further compares the reference current with the current of the current electric period to obtain a corresponding current difference value, and accurately judges the short-circuit fault of the switching tube of the asymmetric half-bridge power converter by combining a symbol of a measured value of a current sensor and a rotor position angle. The SRM switching tube short-circuit fault dynamic diagnosis method adopting current translation can meet fault diagnosis during steady-state and dynamic operation of the motor. The switching tube short-circuit fault diagnosis scheme is suitable for switching reluctance motors with various phase numbers. The method has important application prospect in the application occasions with extremely high requirements on the reliability of motors, such as aero-starter generators, electric automobile motors and the like.

title_en: Bearing fault diagnosis method based on time-frequency image global descriptor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bearing fault diagnosis method based on a time-frequency image global descriptor, which comprises the following steps: collecting bearing vibration signals of different fault categories through a sensor; sampling a sample from the acquired bearing vibration signal according to the length N of the vibration signal as one sample, and dividing the sample into a training data set, a verification data set and a test data set according to a certain proportion; performing short-time Fourier transform on each extracted sample, and converting the signals into a two-dimensional time-frequency image; constructing a depth measurement neural network model for bearing fault diagnosis, obtaining a global descriptor of a time-frequency image and obtaining a classification result; training and testing the performance of the model; and diagnosing the bearing faults by using the trained model. The method can effectively diagnose the bearing faults by using a small amount of bearing fault samples.

title_en: Special dynamic comprehensive testing device for multi-specification continuous casting roller
abstract_en: The invention discloses a special dynamic comprehensive testing device for multi-specification continuous casting rolls, wherein an adjustable mounting seat is arranged on a reference table surface of the device at intervals, a guide rail is centrally arranged on one side of the reference table surface, a driving roller is arranged on the guide rail through a base, a driving motor is connected with the driving roller and drives the driving roller to rotate, a screw rod is arranged below the base of the driving roller through a screw block and drives the driving roller to move along the guide rail, a roll water circulation mechanism comprises a first water pipeline connected with a roll set rotary joint, a valve, a flowmeter and a pressure gauge arranged on the first water pipeline, a bearing seat water circulation mechanism comprises a second water pipeline connected with a roll set bearing seat, a valve, a flowmeter and a pressure gauge arranged on the second water pipeline, and a bearing seat fat feeding mechanism comprises a lubricating grease pipeline connected with a roll set bearing seat, and a valve, a flowmeter and a pressure gauge arranged on the lubricating grease pipeline. The device can carry out a plurality of detection tests under the condition of simulating dynamic, improves the test efficiency and ensures the online reliable operation of the roller set.

title_en: Map generation method, map generation device, electronic device, storage medium and vehicle
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a map generation method, a map generation device, electronic equipment, a storage medium, a program product and an automatic driving vehicle, and relates to the technical field of computer vision, in particular to the technical field of automatic driving. The method comprises the steps of determining a local feature point description subset of each of a plurality of images, carrying out aggregation processing on the local feature point description subset of each of the plurality of images to determine a global description of each of the plurality of images, calculating global matching degrees between any two images of the plurality of images based on the global description of each of the plurality of images to obtain a plurality of global matching degrees, and determining a plurality of target images from the plurality of images based on the plurality of global matching degrees, wherein the plurality of target images are initial images for generating a target map.

title_en: Microwave measurement equipment and method for dry content of natural rubber fresh latex
abstract_en: The invention discloses microwave measurement equipment and a measurement method for dry content of natural rubber fresh latex, wherein the equipment comprises a dry air bottle, a flowmeter, a microwave heating system, an electronic balance, a data display window, a reaction tube and a crucible; the dry air bottle is connected with an air inlet of the flowmeter through a connecting pipe, an air outlet of the flowmeter is connected with a reaction pipe inlet of the reaction pipe, and an outlet of the reaction pipe is connected with the air extracting device; the reaction tube is arranged in a microwave heating system; the lower part of the reaction tube is provided with a crucible which is communicated with the inside of the reaction tube; the crucible is arranged on an electronic balance; the electronic balance can weigh the mass of the crucible together with the natural rubber in the crucible; the measuring method can obtain the weight change of the natural rubber fresh latex through controlling the microwave heating power and the temperature and through a data display window, and finally obtain the weight of the natural rubber fresh latex dry rubber.

title_en: Near infrared spectrum system for coal quality analysis and coal quality analysis method
abstract_en: The invention provides a near infrared spectrum system for coal analysis and a coal analysis method, wherein the near infrared spectrum system comprises a light source, a coaxial light path, an integrating sphere and a spectrometer, the integrating sphere comprises a light source inlet, a sample reflection port and a diffuse reflection light outlet, the coaxial light path is arranged between the light source and the integrating sphere and is coaxial with the integrating sphere, the distance between the coaxial light path and the light source and the distance between the coaxial light path and the integrating sphere are set to enable light emitted by the light source to enter from the light source inlet and then directly diffuse-reflect through the integrating sphere, but firstly irradiate on the sample at the sample reflection port, the relative positions of the sample reflection port and the diffuse reflection light outlet of the integrating sphere are set to enable reflected light of the sample to enter the spectrometer through the diffuse reflection light outlet after being subjected to multiple diffuse reflection in the integrating sphere, and the spectrometer is used for generating spectrum data of the sample. The spectrometer is rear-mounted, different light sources can be conveniently replaced according to different signal intensities of samples, and the spectrometer has the advantages of compact structure, small volume, high light intensity and high signal to noise ratio.

title_en: Preparation method of polymer film layer for biosensor
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a method of preparing a polymer film for a biosensor, including preparing a base layer reagent including a first type of polymer, an adhesive layer reagent including a second type of polymer, and an outer surface layer reagent including a third type of polymer, the second type of polymer being a copolymer formed of a first monomer identical to a monomer of the first type of polymer and a second monomer identical to a monomer of the third type of polymer, and sequentially forming a base layer, an adhesive layer having an adhesive effect on the base layer, and an outer surface layer having a biocompatibility on the adhesive layer, wherein in the polymer film, the adhesive layer has diffusion controlling properties, and the adhesive layer is adhered to the base layer and the outer surface layer by at least one of a conjugation effect, a similar compatibility, a hydrogen bond interaction, and a crosslinking. Thus, a method for producing a polymer film layer for a biocompatible biosensor, which can expand the response linearity range, can be provided.

title_en: Method for determining 4 metabolites of tolfenpyrad in tea and tea soup based on ultra-high performance liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry
abstract_en: A method for determining 4 metabolites of tolfenpyrad in tea and tea soup based on ultra-high performance liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry belongs to the technical field of tea pesticide residue detection. The invention comprises the following steps: 1) Sample extraction and purification: extracting fresh tea leaf or tea leaf sample with 1% acetonitrile formate, C  18  、MgSO  4  GCB and C  NT  -OH dispersion solid phase extraction purification, acetonitrile constant volume after concentration; or 1) extracting the tea soup sample with 1% acetonitrile formate, concentrating and then fixing the volume of acetonitrile; 2) Separating by ACQUITY UPLC HSS T chromatographic column, and detecting 4 metabolites of tolfenpyrad by ultra-high phase liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry; 3) Calculating a tolfenpyrad metabolite standard curve, a linear correlation coefficient and a matrix effect; 5) The addition recovery rate, the relative standard deviation, the detection limit of the method, and the quantification limit were calculated. The method meets the requirement of residual analysis and can be used for preparing the tea fresh leaves, the tea leaves and the tolfenpyrad in tea soupResearch detection of the amide 4 metabolites provides an analytical method.

title_en: Detection instrument and detection method for measuring catecholamine in plasma based on two-dimensional online magnetic bead adsorption liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry
abstract_en: The invention discloses a detecting instrument and a detecting method for measuring catecholamine in plasma by using a two-dimensional online magnetic bead adsorption liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry combined instrument, wherein the detecting instrument is applied integrally by adopting a pretreatment flow path instrument and the detecting instrument, and comprises a chromatographic column and a mass spectrometer which are communicated through a first switching valve; the pretreatment flow path instrument is used for running a water mobile phase and comprises a pump 1, an automatic sampler and a magnetic bead adsorption column which are sequentially connected, wherein the magnetic bead adsorption column is connected into a chromatographic column through a switching valve II, and an annular magnetic field is arranged outside the magnetic bead adsorption column; and the device also comprises a pump 2 for running the sample mobile phase, and the pump 2 is connected into the chromatographic column through a switching valve II. The magnetic bead pretreatment technology and the two-dimensional liquid chromatographic column mass spectrometry combined detection technology are applied to the scheme, the plasma sample can be directly injected by simply diluting, the rapid on-line detection of 6 catecholamine substances in the plasma is realized, complex pretreatment is not needed, the degree of automation is high, the detection result is accurate and reliable, and the method is suitable for clinical sample analysis and detection.

title_en: Efficient detection device and method for heavy metal ions in food
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a method for efficiently detecting heavy metal ions in food, which relate to the technical field of detection of heavy metal ions in food, and comprise a detection device body blanking component, a trowelling component, a detection unit, a processing unit and a control unit; after the detection liquid and the food particles are gathered on the surface of the filtering structure, the detection unit detects the state of the mixture on the surface of the filtering structure, and state detection information is formed and output; after analysis, a detection condition coefficient GL is formed in a correlation mode, if the detection condition coefficient GL is larger than a threshold value, the rotating speed of the second motor is adjusted, the sliding frequency of the push plate along the surface of the grid baffle plate is increased, and the air flow is accelerated to pass through the surface of the filtering structure. The blanking assembly and the trowelling assembly are matched to compensate the external conditions of the detection reaction, so that the detection efficiency is improved, toxic components of food particles and active components in the detection liquid are fully reacted, and the detection result is closer to the actual result.

title_en: Wind speed and direction sensor with anti-interference function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind speed and direction sensor with an anti-interference function, which relates to the technical field of wind speed and direction sensors and comprises a sensor main body, wherein a sensor bracket is arranged in the sensor main body, a wind speed sensor is arranged on one side of the top end of the sensor bracket, a wind direction sensor is arranged on the other side of the top end of the sensor bracket, a mosquito attracting mechanism is arranged on the top end of the sensor bracket, and a supporting frame is arranged in the mosquito attracting mechanism. This kind of wind speed wind direction sensor with anti-interference function lures the mosquito through the mosquito mechanism that lures that sets up, lures the mosquito through the ultraviolet light source of mosquito lamp to hit the mosquito of flying into through the electric wire netting and kill, collect the mosquito dead body through collecting the frame simultaneously, make can realize the trapping and killing, collecting the peripheral mosquito of sensor main part, thereby can prevent to influence the staff, can reduce the influence to peripheral pedestrian simultaneously, thereby guaranteed the healthy safety of staff and peripheral pedestrian.

title_en: Machining surface determination device, machining surface determination program, machining surface determination method, and machining system
abstract_en: The machined surface determination device (7) is provided with: an image acquisition unit (70) that acquires a determination image (42) having a predetermined determination image area in which a processing surface of a determination target object is captured; an inference unit (71) that inputs each of a plurality of small images (43) generated from a determination image (42) by dividing the determination image area into small image areas, to a learning model (2), thereby inferring classification results for the plurality of small images (43) on a small image-by-small image basis, wherein the learning model (2) machine learns a correlation between a learning image having a learning image area corresponding to the small image area and a classification result that classifies a state of a machining surface included in the learning image into one of a plurality of machining states; a classification result processing unit (73) that obtains a processing result by processing classification results for a plurality of small images (43) that are deduced in units of small images; and a determination unit (75) that determines the state of the machined surface on the basis of the processing result.

title_en: Multi-parameter layered sampling water sample collector and sampling method
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-parameter layered water sample collector and a sampling method, wherein the water sample collector comprises a bracket and water sampling tanks, wherein a plurality of water sampling tanks are fixed on the periphery side of the bracket, and each water sampling tank is provided with an end cover opening and closing mechanism which is controlled independently; the top end of the bracket is provided with a draw hook and a pull rope connected with the draw hook, and the pull rope is provided with an indicating mechanism for indicating the sampling completion state; the bottom end of the support is also provided with a deep water propeller; the water sample collector is characterized in that a main control box is arranged inside the upper end of the support, a controller and a plurality of functional pieces are arranged in the main control box, and the functional pieces are used for detecting water quality and reflecting the state of the water sample collector. The invention can realize water sample collection with the depth of 200 meters, can complete continuous water quality parameter collection by one-time collection and realize collection of water samples with multiple layers of depths, and has high collection efficiency and high collection accuracy.

title_en: High-sensitivity self-activated fluorescent temperature measurement material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of fluorescence temperature sensing, and particularly relates to a high-sensitivity self-activated fluorescence temperature measuring material and a preparation method thereof, wherein the chemical formula of the self-activated fluorescence temperature measuring material is NaEr  x  Yb  1‑x  (MoO  4  )  2  Wherein x is more than or equal to 0.005 and less than or equal to 0.2. The invention provides a high-sensitivity self-activated fluorescence temperature measuring material which is prepared from a self-activated material NaYb (MoO) containing ytterbium  4  )  2  As a matrix, yb in the matrix  3+  The ion concentration is far higher than other Yb doped  3+  Luminescent materials of ions, therefore, can be used in Yb  3+  And Er  3+  High-efficiency energy resonance transmission is constructed between ions, so that high up-conversion luminous efficiency and high-sensitivity temperature measurement are realized. In addition, the rare earth dimolybdate belongs to one of rare earth oxide matrixes, and has the advantages of stable physical and chemical properties, easiness in preparation, moderate phonon energy and the like.

title_en: Power transmission tower online monitoring system and monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power transmission tower online monitoring, and discloses a power transmission tower online monitoring system and a power transmission tower online monitoring method.

title_en: Safety state monitoring system of train bogie reloading equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a safety state monitoring system of a train bogie reloading device, which comprises: the acquisition module is used for acquiring state parameters of the train bogie reloading equipment; the conversion module is used for converting the acquired state parameters to acquire corresponding digital signals; the preprocessing module is used for substituting the digital signals into corresponding state parameter models respectively to perform analysis, calculation and preprocessing so as to obtain corresponding analysis and calculation results respectively; the fault analysis module is used for carrying out abnormal analysis and diagnosis on the analysis and calculation result so as to obtain a fault diagnosis result of the train bogie replacement equipment. According to the invention, the state parameters of the bogie changing equipment of the train are acquired, comprehensive safety monitoring analysis is carried out based on the acquired data and the corresponding calculation model, so that fault hidden danger and abnormal trend affecting the changing safety can be found in advance, and timely pre-alarming can be carried out, so that accidents can be avoided, the safety of the bogie changing process is effectively ensured, and the changing risk is reduced.

title_en: Method and device for detecting chloride ion content
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a device for detecting chloride ion content. The method for detecting the chloride ion content comprises the following steps: preparing a first volume of liquid to be detected; adding a second volume of phosphoric acid solution into the to-be-detected liquid to form a to-be-detected sample; and (3) dropwise adding a silver nitrate solution into the sample to be detected, and determining the chloride ion content in the sample to be detected according to the potential change in the sample to be detected. By the scheme, the accuracy and the stability of detecting the content of chloride ions in the brown oxide liquid can be improved.

title_en: Environment engineering detection device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of environmental engineering, in particular to an environmental engineering detection device. The problems to be solved are: the prior art utilizes electrical components to sample work, and the reliability is extremely poor, can't realize sampling a plurality of changeable degree of depth, can't utilize the water of different degree of depth to clean the sample cavity, and the water sample at the water sampling bottom can stir the water bottom impurity, influences sampling data. The technical proposal is as follows: an environmental engineering detection device comprises a sampling box, a lifting closed system, a cleaning sampling system, a stabilizing system and the like; the sampling box is connected with a lifting closed system; the rear part of the sampling box is provided with a clean sampling system; the lower part of the sampling box is connected with a stabilizing system. The lifting closed system provided by the invention can be used for respectively obtaining water samples with different depths according to requirements when the device is used for sampling, so that the problem that only a plurality of water with fixed depths can be sampled and only the sampling device can be replaced when the sampling depth requirements are changed is solved.

title_en: Path planning method and device, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a path planning method, a path planning device, a storage medium and electronic equipment. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a first original reference route of a front target distance range and a rear target distance range of a vehicle based on current first driving parameter information of the vehicle, a global path planning route of the vehicle and a preset high-precision map; carrying out smoothing treatment on the first original reference route by adopting a preset optimization algorithm to obtain a first smoothed route so as to obtain a path planning result of a first running period of the vehicle; when the vehicle runs in the second running period, a smooth route for obtaining the second running period or a curvature value of the second smooth route corresponding to the second running period obtained through smoothing processing cannot be calculated, the vehicle is controlled to stop, and the first smooth route is used as a path planning result of the second running period. The method can control the parking and reasonably plan the running path to continue running when the vehicle encounters an obstacle in the running process or the turning curvature of the vehicle is overlarge.

title_en: High-multiple water flooding numerical simulation characterization method for bottom water reservoir by considering phase permeation time variation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-multiple water flooding numerical simulation characterization method of a bottom water reservoir in consideration of phase permeation time variation, which comprises the steps of obtaining a plurality of cores of the bottom water reservoir; performing a conventional oil displacement efficiency experiment on the core, recording the liquid production amount and the oil production amount of each displacement speed, calculating the original oil saturation of the core and the oil displacement efficiency of the core at each speed increasing moment, and observing the change of the oil displacement efficiency of the core at different displacement speeds; performing a high-multiple water flooding experiment on the rock core to obtain a relation curve of oil displacement efficiency and displacement multiple; calculating to obtain the saturation of the residual oil under different displacement multiples; and (3) establishing a curve between the saturation of the residual oil and the displacement multiple, and regressing a functional relation between the saturation of the residual oil and the displacement multiple, so as to realize characterization of the phase permeation time change in the numerical model based on Python software. Aiming at the time-varying starting end point of the phase-permeability time-varying technology in the current numerical simulation, the invention provides improvement, and the prediction of water flooding efficiency and final recovery ratio in the actual production of an oil field is more accurate.

title_en: Generator detection method, electronic device and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a detection method of a generator, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a phase voltage signal of any phase output by a generator; determining a first magnetic flux parameter of the generator from the phase voltage signal; if the deviation between the first magnetic flux parameter and the preset magnetic flux parameter is smaller than the preset deviation range, outputting a power supply enabling signal; wherein a power enable signal is used to indicate that the generator matches the electronic device. By the mode, when the deviation between the first magnetic flux parameter and the preset magnetic flux parameter is smaller than the preset deviation range, the main power loop can convert the voltage output from the generator to the electronic equipment, so that the situation that the generator is not matched with the electronic equipment can be avoided, and the safety of the generator and the electronic equipment can be improved.

title_en: Kinematic inverse solution method for series-parallel drive CTS wind tunnel test motion system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kinematic back-solution method of a series-parallel drive CTS wind tunnel test motion system, which comprises the steps of establishing a wind tunnel coordinate system, an XYZ series linear guide rail coordinate system, a Z3 parallel mechanism static platform coordinate system, a Z3 parallel mechanism dynamic platform coordinate system and a missile model coordinate system in the series-parallel drive CTS wind tunnel test motion system, performing kinematic analysis on the series-parallel drive CTS wind tunnel test motion system, establishing a forward kinematic model, providing a back-solution strategy for separating and solving linear displacement and angular displacement according to a target pose of the missile model and the forward kinematic model, establishing a stroke amount equation set of each drive component, solving the stroke of each drive component by adopting an analytic method to obtain a back-solution model of the CTS wind tunnel test motion system, and ensuring the accuracy of control of the CTS wind tunnel test motion system so as to realize automatic positioning of the missile model in the wind tunnel test.

title_en: Carrier phase positioning method based on chaotic mapping sparrow regression search
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of satellite navigation, in particular to a carrier phase positioning method based on chaotic mapping sparrow regression search, which adopts chaotic mapping to initialize the sparrow population in the process of searching integer ambiguity, optimizing follower strategy and alerter strategy, introducing a memory regression model and a monitoring strategy according to the foraging behavior of sparrows, and introducing baseline constraint based on the coherence characteristics of carriers. Through the arrangement, the problems that the whole-cycle ambiguity searching is trapped in local optimum and has poor convergence are solved, the exploration and development performances of a searching space are improved, the quick searching of the whole-cycle ambiguity is realized, and meanwhile, through three-dimensional experiments, multidimensional experiments and RTK experiments in actual environments, the real-time performance, the effectiveness, the accuracy and the like of the method are superior to those of the traditional method.

title_en: Bridge detection auxiliary device and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an auxiliary device and method for bridge detection, comprising a detection assembly, and is characterized in that: the detection assembly comprises a square plate, one end of the square plate is provided with an arc groove matched with the shape of a bridge upright, the middle of the square plate is fixedly connected with a guide plate, the other end of the square plate is fixedly connected with a motor support, the guide plate is fixedly connected with a cross rod, the cross rod is fixedly connected with a first arc plate, the first arc plate is fixedly connected with a conical surface plate, the conical surface plate is fixedly connected with an arc guide rail, the square plate corresponds to support rods which are fixedly connected with two ends of the arc groove respectively, and the support rods are fixedly connected with a winding motor. The invention relates to the field of detection equipment, in particular to an auxiliary device and method for bridge detection. The invention aims to provide an auxiliary device and method for bridge detection, which are convenient for bridge detection.

title_en: Multichannel nanopore measurement circuit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multichannel nanopore measurement circuit, which comprises a gating control circuit and an analog-to-digital conversion circuit, wherein the gating control circuit comprises a controller and at least one first multiplexing switch, two ends of each switch in the first multiplexing switch are respectively connected with the analog-to-digital conversion circuit and a nanopore channel, and the controller is connected with the first multiplexing switch and the analog-to-digital conversion circuit to control each switch in the first multiplexing switch to be sequentially and circularly conducted in a time interval mode and collect currents of multiple nanopore channels. Compared with the prior art, the invention adopts a time-sharing multiplexing mode to gate the switch in the first multiplexing switch so as to lead the multi-path switch to be staggered and conducted, and the induced currents of the multi-path nanopore channel are circularly collected at different times in sequence, so that the current collection of the multi-path nanopore channel can be realized by using the same analog-digital conversion circuit and gating control circuit, and the circuit has simple structure and lower cost.

title_en: Miniature DI input detection method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a miniature DI input detection method and device, the method comprises the steps that an input module obtains passive or active switching value signals and transmits the signals to an input detection protection module, the input detection protection module carries out signal conversion and detection on the switching value signals, different voltages are obtained according to different input switching value signals and output to an output control module, and the output control module outputs and obtains the level of a current switching value conversion output result according to different voltage values output to the output control module. The invention establishes a set of miniature DI input detection device with low power consumption, high reliability, low cost and small volume through simple separation components, and realizes compatible input detection of passive switching value and active switching value through the device.

title_en: Debugging device and method for electric type sensor of electric power Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses a debugging device and method for an electric sensor of an electric Internet of things. The device comprises: the system comprises a debugging tool, an intelligent gateway and a program control isolation module; the debugging tool is in communication connection with the program-controlled isolation module and is used for acquiring a test case, sending test data to the program-controlled isolation module and the equipment to be tested based on the test case, comparing the test data with the electrical quantity data, and acquiring a test report according to a comparison result; the program control isolation module is used for adjusting the test data according to the debugging requirement of the equipment to be tested and outputting the adjusted test data to the equipment to be tested; the device to be tested is connected with the intelligent gateway and used for collecting electrical quantity data corresponding to the test data, sending the electrical quantity data to the intelligent gateway and sending the electrical quantity data to the debugging tool through the intelligent gateway. The method and the device can solve the difficult problem of on-site debugging of the Internet of things, effectively improve the current debugging situation of the equipment to be tested, reduce the labor cost and make the debugging work more economical.

title_en: Highway basic unit thickness detection device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a highway base layer thickness detection device which comprises a drilling mechanism, wherein one side of the drilling mechanism is provided with a supporting rod, a control mechanism is movably sleeved outside the supporting rod, the drilling mechanism is fixedly connected to one side of the control mechanism, the bottom end of the supporting rod is fixedly connected with a base mechanism, and one side of the control mechanism is provided with a screening mechanism. According to the invention, the core bit is lifted to take out the base layer core body and place the base layer core body in the protection plate, a user can press and touch the top of the core body by rotating the telescopic measuring ruler and utilizing the pressing plate, so that the height of the core body is measured, and the lifting plate is driven to lift the core body by pulling the pull rod, so that the thickness of each layer of the highway base layer is conveniently and independently measured, the user can conveniently and well measure the thickness, and the device integrates various measured tools, so that the trouble of a large number of tools carried by the user is avoided, and the measuring efficiency of the user is improved.

title_en: Configurable parallel test circuit and method for three-dimensional stacked packaged chips
abstract_en: The invention discloses a configurable parallel test circuit and a method of a three-dimensional stacked package chip, wherein the test circuit comprises a configurable boundary scanning unit pair, the three-dimensional stacked package chip is provided with a plurality of layers of small chips, the configurable boundary scanning unit pair comprises a first configurable boundary scanning unit used for being connected with an input port of the small chips and a second configurable boundary scanning unit used for being connected with an output port of the small chips, the first configurable boundary scanning unit and the second configurable boundary scanning unit are configured into different modes through different control signals, a plurality of configurable boundary scanning unit pairs are arranged on each layer of small chips, the plurality of configurable boundary scanning unit pairs on each layer of small chips are connected in series according to different modes, and the configurable boundary scanning unit pairs on adjacent layers of small chips are connected in series.

title_en: Intelligent medical health monitoring equipment and system thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides intelligent medical health monitoring equipment and a system thereof, and relates to the technical field of health monitoring equipment. The electronic display comprises a fixed base, wherein a mounting bracket is fixedly arranged on the outer side wall of the fixed base, an electronic display is slidably arranged on the outer side wall of the mounting bracket, and a height monitoring module is fixedly arranged on one end, far away from the fixed base, of the mounting bracket; the upper surface of the fixed base is fixedly connected with two mounting beams, and two movable mounting plates are slidably mounted between the upper surfaces of the two mounting beams. Through mutually supporting between installing support, electronic display ware, height monitoring module, monitoring seat, blood pressure monitoring module and the weight monitoring module, height monitoring module, blood pressure monitoring module and weight monitoring module integrate on an equipment, need not to change different medical equipment when carrying out monitoring such as weight, blood pressure, simple structure, easy operation.

title_en: Positioning device and positioning method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a positioning device and a positioning method of the positioning device, and belongs to the technical field of positioning. The positioning device comprises: a device body; a positioning identification component for arranging as a map identification in a target environment, comprising at least one feature identification; at least one optical sensor for acquiring image information of the target environment, including image information of the positioning identification component; the at least one inertial sensor is used for collecting motion parameter information of the positioning device; and the identification positioning unit is used for obtaining positioning data of the positioning device based on the image information of the target environment and the motion parameter information of the positioning device. The device is favorable for improving the positioning precision and reliability.

title_en: Zero calibration method and device for moisture meter, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a zero calibration method and device for a moisture meter, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining a to-be-calibrated process and at least one reference process, and respectively determining a reference value offset corresponding to a reference moisture meter at each reference process, wherein the process execution time sequence corresponding to the reference process is later than the process execution time sequence corresponding to the to-be-calibrated process; and determining zero offset corresponding to the moisture meter to be calibrated at the process to be calibrated based on the prestored target calibration function corresponding to the process to be calibrated and the reference value offset corresponding to the reference moisture meter at each reference process, so as to perform zero calibration on the moisture meter to be calibrated at the process to be calibrated based on the zero offset. According to the technical scheme, the effect of automatically calibrating the moisture meter in each tobacco leaf shredding process is achieved, the calibration period of zero calibration of the moisture meter is shortened, and the measurement accuracy of the moisture meter after calibration are improved.

title_en: Polypeptide solid phase synthesis sampling manipulator device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a polypeptide solid-phase synthesis sampling manipulator device which comprises a shell, a plurality of sampling tubes, a sampling tube fixing plate, a sampling tube telescopic driving mechanism, a negative pressure sample collecting mechanism and a sampling bottle. The invention realizes full automation of polypeptide sampling and bottling, does not need to manually install and detach the sampling tube, has high sampling efficiency and accurate sampling, and has no impurity entering risk in whole-process sealing.

title_en: Three-dimensional space PM2.5 mobile monitoring method based on anemometer correction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional space PM2.5 mobile monitoring method based on anemometer correction, which comprises the following steps that firstly, PM2.5 concentration monitoring equipment and an anemometer are combined to form a monitoring module; secondly, a single factor experiment is designed, the influence of wind speed on PM2.5 concentration is explored, the relation between wind speed and PM2.5 concentration is obtained, and a wind speed correction function is constructed; thirdly, carrying a PM2.5 monitoring instrument and an air speed monitoring instrument on a mobile platform for sampling, and storing accurate air pollution data and real-time air speed data of each sampling point by combining longitude and latitude and elevation data acquired by a positioning module of the mobile platform; and finally, correcting the PM2.5 monitoring result according to the functional relation between the wind speed and the PM2.5 concentration, thereby obtaining accurate PM2.5 concentration data. The method solves the problem that the current PM2.5 mobile monitoring is influenced by wind speed, and further improves the accuracy of PM2.5 mobile monitoring. The monitoring module is small in size, light in weight and suitable for being carried by various mobile platforms, and solves the problem of high homogeneity of the traditional mobile monitoring sampling range.

title_en: Integrated circuit testing device and testing method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an integrated circuit testing device and a testing method, the integrated circuit testing device comprises a testing box body, the upper end surface of the testing box body is rotationally connected with a testing cover plate, one side of the testing cover plate is provided with a detection unit, the middle part of the upper end surface of the testing box body is provided with a conveying groove, the middle part of the conveying groove is rotationally connected with a limiting mechanism for clamping the testing plate, a driving mechanism for driving the limiting mechanism to drive the testing plate to rotate and turn over is arranged between the testing cover plate and the testing box body, the device is convenient to carry, and the testing plate can be automatically turned over and detected in the detection process, and the device is convenient to operate.

title_en: Site soil lead pollution source analysis method based on isotopes
abstract_en: The invention discloses a site soil lead pollution source analysis method based on lead isotopes, belongs to the technical field of environment, and is used for analyzing lead pollution sources of site soil in the mining and selecting/smelting industry of mines. Which comprises the following steps: (1) Investigation of site production processes, collecting site raw materials, intermediate products, final products and contaminated soil samples; (2) Measuring the lead content in site raw materials, intermediate products, final products and polluted soil samples; (3) Determining lead isotope composition in site raw materials, intermediate products, end products, and contaminated soil samples; (4) And measuring and calculating the relative contribution rate of each pollution source to the polluted soil sample by adopting a mass balance model. And quantitatively calculating the relative contribution rate of each pollution source to lead pollution in the polluted site soil through a lead isotope mass balance model, and identifying a possible unknown pollution source.

title_en: Radio frequency electromagnetic energy explosion test device and method
abstract_en: The application discloses a radio frequency electromagnetic energy explosion test device and a method, wherein the device comprises: sealing the gas cavity; the antenna assembly comprises an antenna body, wherein two ends of the antenna body are respectively and electrically connected with a conductive disc and a metal disc; the gap adjusting assembly comprises a linear driving mechanism, wherein the linear driving mechanism is connected with a metal rod, one end of the metal rod penetrates through the metal disc, and the distance between the end of the metal rod and the conductive disc is an electric gap; during the test, explosive gas is filled in the sealed gas cavity, the antenna assembly obtains radio frequency electromagnetic energy, the linear driving mechanism drives the metal rod to be close to or far away from the conductive disc to change the distance, so that the gap minimum breakdown voltage corresponding to each gap distance is obtained, and the mapping relation between the gap minimum breakdown voltage and the gap distance is established. The application can obtain the minimum breakdown voltage of the gap corresponding to different gap distances under a specific frequency band, thereby providing data support for theoretical analysis of plasma discharge under high-frequency conditions and explosive environments.

title_en: Thin-specification material sample clamping piece based on Gleeble thermal simulation machine and measuring method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of thermal simulation physical tests, and relates to a thin-specification material sample clamping piece based on a Gleeble thermal simulation machine and a measuring method; thin gauge material sample holder based on Gleeble thermal simulator. The thin-specification material sample clamping piece based on the Gleeble thermal simulation machine comprises a first clamping piece, wherein the first clamping piece is suitable for samples with the thickness of 6 mm-10 mm. Wherein, first holder includes: the first copper fixture, the first gasket and the second gasket. The first copper fixture comprises two symmetrically arranged square blocks, and grooves with semicircular sections are formed in the opposite positions of each square block. The appearance of first gasket suits with the recess, and the cross-section of first gasket is semi-circular, and when first gasket set up in the recess, first gasket and recess cell wall laminating. The appearance of second gasket suits with first gasket, and the cross-section of second gasket is semi-circular, and when the second gasket set up in first gasket, second gasket and first gasket inner wall laminating.

title_en: MEMS hot-film flow sensor chip and preparation method thereof
