abstract_en: The application relates to an MEMS hot film type flow sensor chip and a preparation method thereof, wherein the method comprises the following steps: silicon nitride layers are respectively arranged on the front side and the back side of the substrate; forming a silicon supporting layer on the silicon nitride layer on the front surface of the substrate; forming a groove array in a designated area on the front surface of the silicon supporting layer; oxidizing and filling the groove array by using a thermal oxidation method, so that all designated areas are thermally oxidized to form a silicon oxide layer; sputtering a metal layer on the silicon oxide layer to form an upstream bridge resistor, a downstream bridge resistor and a heating resistor; sputtering a metal layer on the non-designated area on the front surface of the silicon supporting layer to form an environmental resistor, wherein the non-designated area is positioned on two sides of the designated area; depositing a passivation protection layer on the metal layer; and photoetching and etching the middle area of the silicon nitride layer on the back of the substrate, and corroding the substrate from the back of the substrate and the bottom of the silicon nitride layer stopping on the front of the substrate, so as to form a suspended film structure. The application improves the mechanical strength by optimally controlling the thickness of the membrane area and prevents the membrane area from deforming or cracking.

title_en: Bridge modal parameter identification method based on array mobile sensor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bridge modal parameter identification method based on an array mobile sensor, which can overcome the limitation of small data collection amount of the existing single sensor by arranging the sensors on an axle of a measuring vehicle in a linear array and utilizing a plurality of sensors to collect the vertical vibration response of a bridge; the cross covariance response among different vertical vibration responses is obtained through the vertical vibration responses acquired by the plurality of sensors, so that the defect of frequency resolution and the influence of noise on the accuracy of an identification result in the traditional signal processing technology are overcome; the improved wavelet transformation and singular value decomposition technology is combined to process covariance of the record response of the array mobile sensor, the obtained cross covariance response is utilized to further identify the modal parameters of the bridge, and the identification of the modal parameters of the bridge is not limited and interfered by adverse factors such as signal length, low resolution of a signal analysis technology, field test environment and the like, so that the modal parameters of the bridge can be identified rapidly, efficiently and accurately.

title_en: Intelligent traffic haze concentration real-time monitoring device and monitoring method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real-time monitoring device and a monitoring method for haze concentration for intelligent traffic, wherein the device is arranged on a mobile carrier and comprises a shell, an inlet is formed in the surface of the shell, and a haze detection module, a display module, a power module, a communication module, a positioning module and a central processing unit are arranged in the shell; the central processing unit is connected with the haze detection module, the display module, the communication module and the power module, meanwhile, the power module is connected with the rechargeable battery, the communication module comprises an uploading unit and a downloading unit, and the communication module is in communication connection with the ground meteorological base station. According to the invention, the on-vehicle haze concentration is monitored by the vehicle-mounted haze monitoring device and is uploaded to the ground meteorological base station, and the ground meteorological base station is updated in real time, so that other users can receive and update haze concentration information conveniently, and the system is real-time, efficient and high in accuracy.

title_en: Near infrared deep tissue focusing system and method based on rapid mechanical calibration
abstract_en: The invention discloses a near infrared deep tissue focusing system based on quick mechanical calibration, which comprises a control device, a laser, a pose adjusting device, a first unpolarized beam splitting cube, a second unpolarized beam splitting cube, a third unpolarized beam splitting cube, a first image sensor and a spatial light modulator, wherein the first image sensor and the spatial light modulator are respectively arranged at the symmetrical positions of the reflecting surfaces of the first unpolarized beam splitting cube, the second unpolarized beam splitting cube is arranged between the first unpolarized beam splitting cube and the spatial light modulator, and the third unpolarized beam splitting cube is arranged between the first unpolarized beam splitting cube and the first image sensor. The invention also discloses a near infrared deep tissue focusing method based on the rapid mechanical calibration. According to the invention, through the arrangement of the light paths and the arrangement of the pixel matching system and the focusing system, the symmetry degree of the light modulator and the image sensor is greatly improved, so that the focusing precision and speed of light passing through a scattering medium are improved.

title_en: Cartesian sampling dual-core synchronous magnetic resonance imaging and image reconstruction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Cartesian sampling dual-core synchronous magnetic resonance imaging and image reconstruction method, which is immediately adjacent to excitation  1  H and X nuclei, introducing an adjusting parameter ap1 of the thickness of the X nuclei, and applying pre-dephasing gradient pulses in advance in the layer direction; introducing regulating parameters ap2 and ap3 of X-kernel frequency and phase coding direction visual field, performing spatial coding on X-kernel and collecting echo1, applying frequency and phase coding compensation gradient to make k track of proton evolve to target point, and then performing frequency coding and collecting  1  Echo2 of H, applying a frequency encoding gradient in the opposite direction and acquiring  1  Echo3 of H, TE1 of X core,  1  TE2 and TE3 of H and respective turning angles are independently controlled, so that adjustment of three-direction resolution of X kernel is realized, and multi-parameter weighted can be obtained  1  H image. The invention solves the problem of X-kernel in the synchronous imaging method  1  The problem of larger difference of the resolution of the H image can be timely adjusted according to specific application scenesResolution of X kernel.

title_en: Meteorological prediction model correction method, device, equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a meteorological prediction model correction method, a device, equipment and a readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a meteorological history training set and a meteorological history testing set; training the neural network by utilizing a weather history training set to obtain a weather prediction model; acquiring each intermediate training meteorological feature output by an intermediate network feature layer of the neural network, and calculating a shape value of each intermediate training meteorological feature according to each intermediate training meteorological feature; judging whether the weather prediction model drifts according to the weather history training set, the shape values of the weather characteristics of each intermediate training and the weather history testing set; if yes, correcting the weather prediction model by utilizing data before drift occurs in the weather history test set. According to the scheme disclosed by the invention, the model drift detection is carried out under the condition of not using a real label, and the model is corrected when the drift of the model is detected, so that the model precision is improved, and the accuracy of weather prediction is improved conveniently.

title_en: High-efficient stable geological investigation appearance
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of geological exploration, and particularly relates to a high-efficiency stable geological exploration instrument.

title_en: Novel four motor environment storehouse dynamometer system of whole car
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel four-motor environment bin power measuring system of a whole vehicle, which comprises an environment bin and a power measuring machine positioned outside the environment bin, wherein the power measuring machine is connected with the whole vehicle in the environment bin through a shafting for transmission, and the whole vehicle is positioned on a lifting supporting mechanism. According to the invention, the dynamometer is arranged outside the environmental bin, so that the heat loss in the environmental bin and the loss of wind field circulation are reduced; and the tested piece is replaced by the whole car by the bridge of the traditional four-motor rack, the whole car is directly tested, and the real performance of the car under various environmental parameters can be tested more accurately.

title_en: Multi-terminal co-connected partial discharge imaging detection system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-terminal co-connected partial discharge imaging detection system, which comprises: the system comprises a characteristic database module, a custom connection module, a terminal sharing module, a calculation coordination module, a space positioning module, an abnormal data synchronous connection module and an acoustic wave visual fusion module. The whole system can be subjected to distribution presetting of the terminals according to the own needs and favorites of users before and after the establishment and application processes by adding terminal connection and customizing the terminals to enter detection logic, and corresponding calculation logic is matched, and meanwhile, the terminals meeting different needs types can be connected, so that the terminals including the sensors accessed by the system can be replaced and maintained more flexibly, and the operation of equipment is not influenced; the device is rapidly detected and the partial discharge position is accurately positioned in a partial discharge visualization mode, so that the electrified detection level and detection efficiency of the power grid are improved, and the reliable operation of the power grid device is ensured.

title_en: Underwater sensing structure and communication method based on GPS technology
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of underwater acoustic sensor communication, and particularly relates to an underwater sensing structure and a communication method based on a GPS technology. According to the communication method provided by the invention, the low-power-consumption GPS device is arranged in the underwater sound sensing structure, can work on water for a long time, is suitable for shallow sea work, and can realize GPS timing to ensure absolute time synchronization of the whole network; when the underwater sensing structure is to send signals, the sending time of each network node is planned through the GPS device time service, so that the collision problem is reduced, the network efficiency is improved, and the time delay is reduced.

title_en: Method and system for measuring spectral distribution of PAR
abstract_en: A measuring method and measuring system of the spectral distribution of PAR, including through geometric calibration and radiation calibration to the all-sky imager, obtain all-sky image every pixel observe zenith angle and observe azimuth angle and RGB wave band radiance value; dividing the all-sky image into a clear sky condition and a cloudy condition through a cloud detection algorithm; for a clear sky image, a PAR spectrum radiation distribution algorithm is reconstructed by combining a radiation transmission mode to obtain PAR spectrum distribution; and for cloud images, obtaining the spectrum radiation distribution of the PAR by adopting a deep learning model, and finally obtaining the spectrum distribution of the full-day PAR. The application has the advantages that: the PAR spectral distribution reconstruction is realized by using the all-sky image, and the visible light wave band spectral irradiance reaching the ground surface, namely PAR spectral distribution information, is obtained from the image shot by the all-sky imager by combining the physical radiation model and the deep learning model.

title_en: Method for manufacturing pH and DO synchronous response integrated photoelectric sensing probe
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electrochemical and fluorescence technology detection, and relates to an integrated photoelectric sensing probe for synchronously responding to pH and DO. Comprises a fluorescent optical fiber, a reference electrode, a working electrode and a counter electrode. The working electrode is positioned at the middle part of the photoelectric membrane, the reference electrode is positioned at the right side of the working electrode, the counter electrode is wrapped at the peripheries of the working electrode and the reference electrode, and the fluorescent optical fiber surrounds the periphery of the counter electrode. The pH and DO synchronous response integrated photoelectric sensing probe can realize the integrated real-time monitoring of pH, DO and cell morphology, and realize the accurate control of environment and metabolic state in the strain culture process through the real-time detection of process parameters, thereby being matched with the industrial production environment, having small amplification effect and shortening amplification.

title_en: Multi-monitoring-point optical film thickness direct monitoring system
abstract_en: The application provides a multi-monitoring-point optical film thickness direct monitoring system, and relates to the technical field of optical film preparation instruments. The multi-monitoring-point optical film thickness direct monitoring system comprises a multi-point monitoring piece arranged on a film thickness substrate to be monitored, a light source device, a light path transmission system, a spectrum analysis device, a detector, an amplifier device, a signal conversion device and a signal processing system, wherein light rays emitted by the light source device penetrate through the multi-point monitoring piece which is coated with the film thickness substrate to be monitored simultaneously, then the light rays are transmitted to the spectrum analysis device through the light path transmission system to be subjected to optical signal processing, the detector converts processed optical signals into current signals and transmits the current signals to the amplifier device, the amplifier device converts the current signals into voltage signals and amplifies the voltage signals, the signal conversion device converts the amplified voltage signals into digital signals and transmits the digital signals to the signal processing system, and the signal processing system obtains film thickness monitoring data after signal processing.

title_en: Film thickness measurement method based on spectral reflectance extreme point slope
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of optical precision measurement, and discloses a film thickness measurement method based on a spectral reflectance extreme point slope. The method solves the problems that the reliable fitting result is difficult to obtain, the film thickness measurement error is large and the like in the prior art.

title_en: Detection method, detection device and detection equipment for air film holes
abstract_en: The application provides a detection method, a detection device and detection equipment for air film holes, and relates to the field of air film hole detection, wherein the detection method for the air film holes comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining an imaging piece and obtaining a first light beam with a first preset wavelength and a first preset color, irradiating the obtained first light beam on the imaging piece after passing through a gas film hole, forming an imaging picture of the bottom of the gas film hole on the imaging piece, and compared with a mode of manually detecting the gas film hole by using a plug gauge, the imaging picture of the bottom of the gas film hole can be obtained more intuitively and clearly by forming the imaging picture of the bottom of the gas film hole on the imaging piece, the size and the morphological characteristics of the bottom of the gas film hole can be obtained more intuitively and clearly, the detection accuracy of the gas film hole is high, the detection efficiency of the gas film hole is high, in addition, the damage to a workpiece can be avoided in the detection process, and the loss of the workpiece in the detection process of the gas film hole can be reduced.

title_en: Method and device for detecting fault of pressure sensor before vortex, vehicle and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fault detection method and device for a pre-vortex pressure sensor, a vehicle and a storage medium. The fault detection method of the pressure sensor before vortex comprises the following steps: after the sensor fault detection enabling condition is met, acquiring a first pre-vortex pressure value in a first time period, and determining the current pre-vortex pressure value change rate in the first time period according to the first pre-vortex pressure value; determining whether an engine has a plugging failure within the first time period according to a first pre-vortex pressure value integral and the current pre-vortex pressure value change rate; after judging whether the engine is blocked and failed in the first time period, acquiring a second pre-vortex pressure value and a current environmental pressure value in a second time period, and determining whether the pre-vortex pressure sensor is credible and failed in the second time period according to the second pre-vortex pressure value and the current environmental pressure value.

title_en: Multi-sensor fusion mapping method and system
abstract_en: The application discloses a multi-sensor fusion mapping method and system, belongs to the technical field of robots and automatic driving, and is used for solving the technical problem of poor robustness of the existing mapping method. The method comprises the following steps: ORB feature extraction is carried out on the environment image acquired by the binocular camera; providing an initial pose for the laser radar through the ORB feature by utilizing a visual inertial odometer; providing a point cloud registration initial value for the laser radar according to a loop detection result of the visual inertial odometer; and updating a map by utilizing the laser radar and the visual inertial odometer and registering an initial value through the initial pose and the point cloud. The method realizes the coupling between the laser radar and the visual inertial odometer, the visual energy provides the initial pose estimation and the initial value of point cloud registration for the laser, and the laser can also provide depth information and initialization information for the visual energy, so that the robustness and the accuracy in the robot mapping process are improved.

title_en: Accurate data metering method for new energy grid-connected voltage regulation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, and provides a precise data metering method for new energy grid-connected voltage regulation, which comprises the following steps: collecting branch voltage data and branch load data of each branch at a plurality of moments in a grid-connected voltage regulating system; acquiring the voltage deviation degree of each branch voltage data according to the branch voltage data of each branch at the adjacent moment; acquiring a first abnormal factor of voltage data of each branch according to the change of the branch load data of each branch; acquiring a second abnormal factor of each branch voltage data according to the change of the branch load data of all branches and the first abnormal factor; obtaining the abnormal expression degree of each branch voltage data according to the voltage deviation degree of the branch voltage data, the first abnormal factor and the second abnormal factor; screening and cleaning abnormal voltage data according to the abnormal expression degree of the branch voltage data. The invention aims to solve the problem that grid-connected voltage regulation is affected due to the influence of multiple paths of voltage generated by new energy.

title_en: False solution judging method, aircraft and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a false solution judging method, an aircraft and a storage medium, which can accurately judge whether a false integer ambiguity fixed solution exists or not under the condition of not depending on external parameters. The method for judging the false solution comprises the following steps: determining a whole-cycle ambiguity fixed solution of each target satellite in at least one target satellite in a global satellite navigation system at the moment T, and determining a first attitude angle of the aircraft at the moment T based on the whole-cycle ambiguity fixed solution; obtaining a second attitude angle of the aircraft output by an inertial navigation system pre-configured by the aircraft at the moment T, wherein the first attitude angle and the second attitude angle are of the same type; and if the difference value between the first attitude angle and the second attitude angle is larger than a set threshold value, determining that the integer ambiguity fixed solution is a false solution.

title_en: Active cooling construction device and method for bored pile in permafrost region
abstract_en: The invention discloses an active cooling construction device and method for a bored pile in a permafrost region, wherein the device comprises a refrigeration circulation system, a temperature monitoring module, a temperature analysis module and a refrigerant control module, wherein the temperature monitoring module monitors an initial temperature field of surrounding soil of the bored pile and temperature field changes in the processes of boring, pouring and maintenance in real time, the temperature analysis module analyzes and processes data measured by the temperature monitoring module to calculate conveying and circulation rates required by the refrigerant control module, and estimates and evaluates cooling effects of the cooling construction device and operation time required by achieving target cooling effects, and the refrigerant control module controls the conveying circulation rates and circulation continuous operation time of a refrigerant in the refrigeration circulation system so as to finish a complete cycle of temperature monitoring, temperature analysis and refrigerant control. The invention can shorten the engineering construction period and efficiency, improve the initial bearing capacity of the frozen soil pile foundation and is beneficial to the promotion of subsequent construction engineering.

title_en: Measurement method, measurement device, measurement system, and measurement program
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a measurement method, a measurement device, a measurement system, and a measurement program. The measuring method can calculate the deflection of the structure when the moving body moves by processing with relatively small calculated quantity. The measuring method comprises the following steps: generating first displacement data according to data of an observation point of the structure; generating observation information; calculating a time interval in which each vehicle of the moving body moves alone in the structure; calculating a first deflection of the structure; calculating the displacement response of each vehicle when the structure moves independently according to the first displacement data and the time interval; calculating a deflection response of each vehicle when the structure moves independently according to the first deflection amount and the time interval; calculating a weighting coefficient for each vehicle from the displacement response and the deflection response; and calculating a second deflection amount after correcting the first deflection amount according to the weighting coefficient.

title_en: Vehicle swing arm detection method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of vehicle swing arms, in particular to a vehicle swing arm detection method and system. The method comprises the following steps: step S11, based on the completion of positioning of the swing arm and the detection system, a first bulge on the first positioning conical ring is abutted with an outer conical surface of a connecting rod part of the swing arm; step S12, based on the contact of the first bulge and the outer conical surface of the connecting rod part, the first positioning conical ring rotates relative to the connecting rod part; step S13, collecting a first abutting force and a first driving moment based on rotation of the first positioning cone ring relative to the connecting rod part; step S14, a first locatable area of a first locating cone ring is obtained; step S15, based on the first positioning cone ring being positioned in the first positionable area, a first detection head of the first detection part is sleeved at the end part of the connecting rod part; and S16, judging that the ball head assembly of the swing arm is qualified based on the fact that the first detection head is sleeved at the end part of the connecting rod part and extends to a first set distance. Thus, the problem that the detection result is influenced by the damage of the swing arm is solved.

title_en: Anti-interference processing method for surge test CDN input end signal
abstract_en: A processing method capable of resisting interference for a signal at an input end of a surge test CDN is provided with a combination integrating module, a linear power amplification module, an output switching isolation feedback module, a peak current detection dynamic attenuation module and a common mode filtering module. The anti-interference processing method for the signal at the input end of the surge test CDN can realize high-precision output of the signal after the signal passes through the linear circuit, and the output signal is not distorted and is not fluctuated excessively after the signal passes through the surge coupling decoupling network. The integrated module has larger open loop gain and good phase margin through the high-voltage linear power amplifier, so that the alternating-current voltage power supply has the advantages of low distortion and high stability.

title_en: Intelligent pavement system for movement management
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent parks and discloses an intelligent pavement system for motion management, which comprises a server switchboard and a plurality of intelligent pavement devices; the intelligent pavement device comprises a server auxiliary machine, a touch screen, a face acquisition module and a plurality of layers of access components, wherein the access components comprise a storage drawer and a wearing cabin. The wearing cabin is internally provided with wearing equipment, and the wearing equipment is internally provided with a second communication signal module, a second processor, a second storage unit, a second positioner, an ambient light sensor, a heart rate sensor, a gyroscope sensor, an acceleration sensor and a navigation unit; the second locator is used for detecting the running path. The intelligent pavement system is applied to urban parks, sports parks, community streets and the like, card punching recording points at different positions are formed through the intelligent pavement device, the movement data are monitored through the intelligent pavement device and sharing wearing equipment, and the movement monitoring quality is guaranteed by uploading the movement data to a server switchboard.

title_en: Impurity particulate matter collecting method, device and impurity particulate matter evaluating method
abstract_en: The application relates to a method and a device for collecting impurity particles and a method for evaluating the impurity particles. A method for collecting impurity particles comprises the steps of supplying simulated gas into a hydrogen ejector by a gas supply module, spraying the simulated gas by the hydrogen ejector to form working gas, and filtering the working gas by a collecting module to collect the working impurity particles by filtration. The hydrogen injector simulates the working condition of the hydrogen injector through the simulated gas, the simulated gas is used as a cleaning medium, impurities in the hydrogen injector are mixed in the working gas together, and the working gas is filtered by the collecting module so as to collect working impurity particles. The impurity particle collecting method can efficiently collect impurity particles generated in the hydrogen injector and in the working process, and is easy to evaluate the cleanliness in the hydrogen injector and in the working process and the impurity particle level.

title_en: Method for measuring I-type fracture toughness of rock based on critical distance theory
abstract_en: A method for determining the type I fracture toughness of rock based on a critical distance theory comprises the following steps of; s1, manufacturing rock Liang Biaozhun test pieces with different grooving widths; s2, carrying out a three-point bending test on rock beam test pieces with different grooving widths on a rock uniaxial compression tester, and recording a P-V curve of the opening of the grooving; s3, determining the load of the crack when the crack starts according to the P-V curve; s4, calculating the characterization fracture toughness of the rock under different grooving widths according to the crack initiation load and the corresponding grooving opening displacement; s5, drawing a change curve representing fracture toughness along with square root of the width of the grooving, and performing function fitting on the curve; s6, carrying out parameter comparison on a relation between the inherent fracture toughness and the characteristic fracture toughness of the rock obtained according to the critical distance theory and a fitting function to obtain the type I fracture toughness of the rock. The method obtains the calculated value of the inherent fracture toughness of the rock, and avoids errors caused by insufficient grooving diameter in single measurement.

title_en: Method for testing organic solvent in clobetasol propionate bulk drug
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of drug detection, and particularly relates to a method for testing an organic solvent in a clobetasol propionate bulk drug. The invention adopts DMSO with higher boiling point as the solvent, and the measured solvent can be mutually dissolved with the solvent, and the measurement of other measured solvents is not interfered because the DMSO has the latest peak; and, because the boiling point difference of each solvent is large, the temperature programming is adopted, so that 6 residual solvents are all peaked in a proper time, the minimum separation degree among the solvents is more than 1.5, and 6 residual solvents of methanol, acetone, methylene dichloride, diisopropyl ether, ethyl acetate and N, N-dimethylformamide are effectively separated. In addition, the invention limits the headspace sample injection, and avoids the problem of pollution to the liner tube and the sample inlet due to high concentration of the sample. In addition, the detection method established by the invention is convenient and quick to operate, accurate and reliable, has good repeatability, can be used for detecting the residual solvent of the clobetasol propionate, and provides technical support for the safety of the raw materials.

title_en: Shallow charge-discharge capacity prediction method and system for lithium ion battery system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for predicting shallow charge and discharge capacity of a lithium ion battery system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: according to the existing electric quantity, testing the lithium ion battery pack according to the shallow charge and discharge testing process step so as to acquire charge and discharge data at the current moment; the electric quantity of the lithium ion battery pack is emptied, the lithium ion battery pack is stood for a preset time period, and the lithium ion battery pack is tested according to the full charge and discharge performance test step so as to acquire charge and discharge data after the lithium ion battery pack is stood; repeating the step S1 and the step S2 for different lithium ion battery packs to collect at least 2 groups of data samples at the sample trial manufacturing stage, so as to establish a mathematical model of shallow charge and discharge performance test and theory; and in the subsequent mass production of the lithium ion battery pack, estimating the actual capacity of the lithium ion battery pack in the subsequent production process according to the shallow charge and discharge performance test and a theoretical mathematical model. The invention solves the technical problems of low testing efficiency and higher production cost of the battery pack.

title_en: Method and system for monitoring full life cycle of intensive bus duct
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and discloses a method for monitoring the full life cycle of an intensive bus duct, which is characterized by comprising the following steps of: the method is applied to a full-period monitoring system, the system is in communication connection with a plurality of image acquisition devices, and the system is electrically connected with a plurality of sensors. According to the method and the system for monitoring the full life cycle of the intensive bus duct, the first quality detection index set is detected before installation, so that a first detection result is obtained, the first quality detection index set is installed based on the installation method of the first quality detection index set, meanwhile, the first quality detection index set which is completely finished is monitored in real time through a plurality of image acquisition devices, so that a second detection result is obtained, meanwhile, the installed environment, air and installation surfaces are detected through a plurality of sensors, a third detection result is obtained, and power transmission detection is carried out on the first quality detection index set after the installation is finished, so that a fourth detection result is obtained.

title_en: Intelligent vehicle testing method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of vehicle testing, and discloses an intelligent vehicle testing method and system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: aiming at each group of parameters to be tested corresponding to the simulated automobile, the control subsystem controls the vehicle traction subsystem with the complex track to drive the simulated automobile to move to the initial position to be tested according to the initial position to be tested; the control subsystem sends a test instruction to the complex track vehicle traction subsystem and the intelligent vehicle; when receiving a test instruction, the complex track vehicle traction subsystem drives the simulated automobile to move according to the motion parameter to be tested based on the motion parameter to be tested; when the intelligent vehicle receives a test instruction, the intelligent vehicle is started at a preset test position, moves according to an intelligent algorithm built in the intelligent vehicle, and generates a single test result when the intelligent vehicle completely passes through an area corresponding to a guide rail of a complex track vehicle traction subsystem or collides with a simulated vehicle. The invention fully simulates the sudden turning process of the obstacle on the road surface, and improves the reliability of the intelligent vehicle test result.

title_en: Kit for detecting COD (chemical oxygen demand), and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: A kit for detecting COD and a preparation method and application thereof belong to the technical field of detection materials. The kit for detecting COD comprises a reagent tube filled with a COD detection reagent and a standard colorimetric card; wherein the COD detection reagent comprises potassium permanganate, a strong alkaline reagent and a weighting agent. The strong alkaline reagent comprises a mixture of one or more of sodium carbonate, sodium bicarbonate and sodium phosphate; the weighting agent includes a mixture of one or more of calcium carbonate, sodium sulfate, and potassium sulfate. The invention is designed based on the characteristic that the potassium permanganate method oxidizes the reducing substances in water under alkaline conditions and manganese with different valence states is obtained according to the quantity of the reducing substances so as to show different colors. The invention has the advantages of no need of instruments and equipment, low cost, convenience, rapidness, flexibility, stability and the like, has simple actual operation and little environmental pollution of a laboratory, and is widely applied.

title_en: FSMC and APB protocol converter and satellite navigation spoofing signal generator
abstract_en: The invention provides a protocol converter of FSMC and APB and a satellite navigation spoofing signal generator, which comprise an APB bus multiplex check module, a clock domain crossing data processing module, an APB bus multiplex check module, an FSMC bus conversion APB bus module and an FSMC bus conversion APB bus control module. The FSMC bus signal of the STM32 is communicated with the APB bus signal of the FPGA satellite navigation spoofing signal generating module through a protocol converter of the FSMC and the APB. According to the FSMC and APB protocol converter and the satellite navigation deception signal generator, through ingenious design, the STM32 can directly communicate the calculated satellite navigation deception signal with the satellite navigation deception signal generation module in the FPGA, so that the FPGA generates the satellite navigation deception signal, and the purpose of deception interference of a satellite navigation receiver is achieved.

title_en: Port area unmanned aerial vehicle routing inspection path searching method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for searching a patrol path of an unmanned aerial vehicle in a port area, which comprises the following steps: step S1, determining the unmanned aerial vehicle and camera parameters configured on the unmanned aerial vehicle according to the unmanned aerial vehicle inspection area; s2, drawing a grid map of an inspection area of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and decomposing the inspection area according to the obstacle; and S3, searching obstacle avoidance paths of the port areas based on the decomposed patrol sub-areas, and determining unmanned aerial vehicle patrol paths. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantage of high inspection efficiency.

title_en: Variable-scale peak phase identification method, terminal and system for early fault signals
abstract_en: The application provides a variable-scale peak phase identification method, a terminal and a system for early fault signals, wherein a signal to be detected of a target bearing under a variable-scale Duffing system is firstly obtained; then, drawing a phase bifurcation diagram of the signal to be detected by taking the phase of the reference signal as a benchmark; then, identifying the phase bifurcation diagram, and determining a period boundary value in the phase bifurcation diagram; and finally, calculating the initial phase of the signal to be detected according to the period boundary value. The early fault signal phase is identified by manufacturing a phase bifurcation diagram and a variable-scale convex peak phase identification method, so that the accuracy of frequency identification of fault signals is ensured, and the influence on bearing fault identification is avoided.

title_en: Vibration reduction early warning device and method for stay cable out-of-plane
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of suspension cable damping vibration attenuation, and particularly relates to a vibration attenuation early warning device and method used outside a suspension cable plane. The invention comprises a damping box, wherein a planetary gear train is arranged in a cylinder cavity of the damping box; the rotating shaft is radially extended with a lower connecting rod, the extending section of the lower connecting rod is hinged with an upper connecting rod, the upper connecting rod is hinged with a connecting block fixed on the stay cable, and the axis of each hinged position is parallel to the axis of the rotating shaft; the rotating shaft is also provided with conductive energy dissipation rotors, and each energy dissipation rotor is insulated from the rotating shaft; in the axial direction of the rotating shaft, damping fluid is filled in a cylinder cavity space between adjacent conductive energy-consuming rotors; the two ends of the rotating shaft are also provided with magnets for the conductive energy-consumption rotor to cut the magnetic induction wire, and the current sensor is used for obtaining the current quantity generated after the magnetic induction wire is cut. The invention can provide a basic platform for monitoring and early warning the vibration amplitude of the stay cable in the working process, thereby ensuring the purpose of stable and reliable operation of the stay cable and avoiding safety accidents caused by the super-amplitude vibration of the stay cable.

title_en: Method and device for detecting midway offline equipment of production line
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for detecting equipment on the way of a production line, wherein the method for detecting the equipment on the way of the production line comprises the following steps that S1, detection results of a first RFID label and a weighing sensor on each working procedure position tool plate are read, and the first RFID labels on each tool plate are different; s2, if the detection result of the weighing sensor is zero, searching and recording the procedure position of the weighing sensor with the first detection result of zero according to the first RFID label corresponding to the weighing sensor, and taking the procedure position as the offline position of equipment corresponding to the first RFID label. According to the invention, whether equipment is offline or not at each process position can be obtained by arranging the first RFID tag and the weighing sensor on the tooling plate, the offline condition of the equipment at each process position can be obtained by detecting each process position, and the offline process position of the equipment can be searched to obtain the accurate offline position of the equipment.

title_en: Method for detecting fatigue resistance of mice
abstract_en: The application discloses a method for detecting fatigue resistance of a mouse, which comprises the steps of carrying out a load swimming experiment of the mouse, carrying out blood lactic acid measurement after a test object is given for a certain time, taking blood after a certain time of rest after swimming for 0min before and after swimming, and carrying out lactic acid measurement after blood sampling after a certain time of rest after swimming, wherein the area=5× (blood lactic acid value before swimming+blood lactic acid value after 3×swimming+blood lactic acid value after 0min after swimming+blood lactic acid value after 2×blood lactic acid value after rest for a certain time) under a blood lactic acid curve. The anti-fatigue capability of the mice is measured by a plurality of measuring methods, the data are characterized by the combination of a plurality of indexes, and the detection result is accurate and reliable.

title_en: Photon-assisted distributed compressive sampling system and implementation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photon-assisted distributed compression sampling system, which comprises a multi-wavelength light source, a first wavelength division multiplexer in a far-end node, a first electro-optic modulator, a second wavelength division multiplexer, an erbium-doped fiber amplifier (EDFA), a wavelength division demultiplexer in a central site, a second electro-optic modulator, a photoelectric detector, a low-pass filter, a sampler, a joint reconstruction calculation module, an antenna connected with the first electro-optic modulator in the far-end node and a pseudo-random sequence generator connected with the second electro-optic modulator in the central site. Aiming at the monitoring requirement of the distributed broadband signal spectrum, the invention uses the optical carrier radio frequency mode to pull back a plurality of remote node signals to the central station for processing, and simultaneously adopts the photon compression sampling technology and the combined reconstruction algorithm to realize the efficient compression sampling of the remote node signal spectrum at the central station.

title_en: All-weather-oriented multiband wind-finding radar system
abstract_en: The application discloses an all-weather-oriented multiband wind-finding radar system, which belongs to the technical field of radars and comprises: the laser module is used for simultaneously providing high-energy pulse laser and a seed signal light source; the laser wind measuring module is shared by a receiving antenna and a transmitting antenna, and mixes the echo signal with local oscillation light provided by the laser to generate a laser wind measuring signal; the microwave wind measuring module adopts a receiving and transmitting antenna to share, mixes the echo signal with a local oscillator optical signal generated by the photoelectric oscillator to generate a microwave wind measuring signal; the acquisition control module is used for realizing the controlled emission of laser pulse signals and radio frequency signals, the controlled receiving of antenna signals and data processing, and calculating wind speed and wind direction information according to the acquired laser wind measuring signals and microwave wind measuring signals. The system meets the high-precision wind measurement requirement under all-weather conditions, has stronger anti-interference capability, effectively filters noise of working wave bands, and has higher measurement precision and reliability compared with the traditional radar system.

title_en: Air-tight detection tool for air inlet of hydrogen fuel cell
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of airtight detection, in particular to an airtight detection tool for an air inlet of a hydrogen fuel cell, aiming at the problem that a detection device is easy to loosen due to pressure change, thereby influencing detection accuracy. The airtight detection tool for the hydrogen fuel cell air inlet has the effect of improving the connection stability of the joint during detection, can assist in fixing the joint during use, can ensure the tight effect of the joint during fixing, and improves the detection accuracy.

title_en: Palladium diselenide wafer-level preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of two-dimensional material preparation, in particular to a palladium diselenide wafer-level preparation method and application. According to the invention, the temperature and the gas flow rate in the tubular furnace are simulated through fluid dynamics, and whether the temperature and the gas flow rate in the tubular furnace are uniformly distributed in the selenizing process is verified; verifying the influence of the selenizing temperature on the synthesis of the palladium diselenide film; verifying the effect of precursor thickness on palladium diselenide preparation, comparing temperature and thickness on Pd metal and post-selenium synthesis PdSe by electron beam evaporation  2  To widen the growth parameter window. Finally preparing the high-performance palladium diselenideAnd (3) at the wafer level, and further applying and preparing the palladium diselenide device by the preparation method to construct a field effect transistor and a photoelectric detector. Can be used for preparing wafer-level high-quality PdSe for silicon process compatibility  2  Two-dimensional materials provide an important reference.

title_en: Acoustic ray tracking method and system based on polynomial interpolation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of marine acoustic submarine topography detection and underwater positioning, in particular to a sound ray tracking method and a system based on polynomial interpolation, wherein the method comprises the following steps: dividing the sound line to be solved into an initial layer, an intermediate layer and an end point layer, and calculating the horizontal displacement and the propagation time of the sound line of the initial layer according to the glancing angle and the initial water depth of the sound line to be solved; estimating the sound ray end point water depth according to the propagation time of the sound ray, and obtaining the horizontal displacement and propagation time of the sound ray of the middle layer through polynomial interpolation according to a pre-established polynomial interpolation coefficient table; and calculating to obtain the water depth and horizontal displacement of the sound ray of the end layer, and outputting the horizontal displacement and the sound ray end water depth of the sound ray. The invention ensures the accuracy of sound ray tracking, greatly improves the working efficiency of the multi-beam sounding system and underwater positioning, and can meet the sound ray tracking requirements of different accuracy by adjusting the angle interval and the polynomial interpolation order.

title_en: Near-infrared wavelength standard substance and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a near infrared wavelength standard substance and a preparation method thereof, wherein the raw materials of the near infrared wavelength standard substance comprise solute and solvent; the solute is halogenated phenol, and the solvent is halogenated olefin. The near infrared wavelength standard substance provided by the invention can completely cover a near infrared light region (900-2600 nm), and the half-peak width of an absorption peak is narrower than that of a glass optical filter, so that the peak positioning is more accurate; compared with the standard substances in the prior art, the near infrared wavelength standard substance provided by the invention has more characteristic peaks and more excellent peak shape, and can meet the requirements of high-end instrument performance evaluation and analysis method evaluation as well as quality control of organisms, foods, medicines, chemical products and cosmetics.

title_en: Service life acceleration test method and system for proton exchange membrane fuel cell
abstract_en: The invention provides a life acceleration test method and a system of a proton exchange membrane fuel cell, which are characterized in that collected voltage-time series data of the proton exchange membrane fuel cell are subjected to filtering treatment and empirical mode decomposition, and the voltage data are decomposed to obtain K eigenmode functions; the constructed two-way long-short-term memory artificial neural network has multiple-input characteristics, can independently model each intrinsic mode function, and reduces the difficulty of long-period life prediction in a limited training data scene; in addition, the optimization of the optimal parameters of the two-way long-short-term memory artificial neural network is realized through a sparrow search algorithm, and the prediction accuracy of the residual life of the proton exchange membrane fuel cell is greatly improved. The method and the system of the invention have low operation cost, simple parameter setting and high prediction precision, and are extremely suitable for the operation and maintenance of proton exchange membrane fuel cells.

title_en: Material type identification method based on XGBoost model
abstract_en: The invention provides a material type identification method based on XGBoost models, which comprises the following steps: acquiring photon count value data of an object to be measured under different channels; determining X-ray images under all channels of an object to be detected based on photon count value data under all channels; inputting each X-ray image into XGBoost models to obtain the target equivalent atomic number of an object to be detected, wherein XGBoost models are obtained by training based on sample image blocks corresponding to a plurality of sample objects of different types, and the sample image blocks are determined based on the thickness of the corresponding sample objects; and determining the target substance type corresponding to the target equivalent atomic number based on the corresponding relation between the equivalent atomic number and the substance type in the substance type list. The method can determine the target equivalent atomic number of the object to be detected by using the trained XGBoost model, so that the target substance type of the object to be detected can be determined, and the substance type identification efficiency is improved.

title_en: Communication cable trimming device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a communication cable trimming device, which relates to the technical field of electricity and comprises a frame, a heat source and a trimming mechanism. According to the invention, the heat transfer roller and the trimming mechanism are arranged on the rack, the output end of the driving motor drives the rotating shaft to rotate, the turning piece is driven to reciprocate and turn on the rack through the connecting rod and the rotating wheel under the action of the pulling force of the tension spring of the rotating cam piece, and further the dislocation part is high-frequency aligned with the dislocation breakpoint detection of the softened flat cable by the detection unit staggered above through the connecting seat and the pushing piece, so that the dislocation is accurately aligned respectively, and the breakpoint is repaired; the upset piece is swung from top to bottom, can put the soft flat cable of line space inboard end location of each and straighten the processing, and the elasticity of locating wheel on the portion of straightening stretches out the setting, guarantees that the thickening section of the benefit joint department of communication cable passes through smoothly, does not influence subsequent installation and lays.

title_en: Synchronous detection system and detection method for target size and hole site
abstract_en: The invention discloses a target size and hole site synchronous detection system and a detection method; wherein the XYZ three-axis linear module is arranged on the detection platform; the measuring head base station is fixed at the lower end of the spindle moving station in the XYZ three-axis linear module; the measuring needle connector is fixed at the right lower extreme of gauge head base, the both sides of measuring needle connector with install camera rotating device's stiff end rigid coupling, first camera and second camera are installed respectively to two camera rotating device's rotating end, first camera and the camera rotating device who links to each other with first camera, and second camera and the camera rotating device who links to each other with the second camera are symmetrical for the axis of measuring needle connector, the measuring needle connector axisymmetric setting to measuring needle connector both sides, the detection probe is fixed in measuring needle connector below. The invention integrates the size detection and the hole site visual detection on one device, avoids the error or missing detection of manual detection and improves the detection speed through double-camera synthesis judgment and three-coordinate needle detection rechecking.

title_en: Method for measuring internal structural parameters of liquid metal
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for measuring internal structural parameters of liquid metal, which belongs to the field of liquid metal heat convection measurement and comprises the following steps: a plurality of probe groups are arranged outside the side wall of the square closed cavity containing the liquid metal; inserting the thermocouple of each probe group into the square closed cavity and immersing the thermocouple into liquid metal; a common negative electrode is arranged outside the side wall of the square closed cavity, so that the thermocouple and the common negative electrode form a thermoelectric potential loop through contact with liquid metal; measuring the local temperature of the internal structure of the liquid metal through the temperature difference and potential difference; applying a magnetic field in a vertical direction to the side surface of the square closed cavity, so that the thermocouples positioned on the same plane generate a speed potential difference when the liquid metal flows; the velocity of the liquid metal internal structure is measured by the velocity potential difference. The temperature of the liquid metal obtained by the method is more accurate, and the speed of the internal structure of the liquid metal can be obtained.

title_en: Dangerous chemical gas identification system based on infrared spectrum technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a hazardous gas identification system based on an infrared spectrum technology, which is applied to the field of gas identification systems, and comprises a monitoring equipment set arranged in a monitoring area, wherein the monitoring equipment set comprises an infrared image acquisition device, a plurality of gas monitors, ventilation equipment and a temperature and humidity sensor; the cooling equipment, the drying equipment and the gas sampling equipment are arranged in the ventilation equipment, the output end of the gas sampling equipment is connected with the infrared spectrum detector, the rapid reaction can be carried out to change the air in the area when dangerous chemical gas appears in the monitoring area, and the air flow is sampled and detected during ventilation so as to rapidly identify the dangerous chemical gas species, strengthen and display the dangerous chemical gas in the image and facilitate the positioning of the dangerous chemical gas leakage points.

title_en: Soybean oil flavor detection system and method based on long-path FT-IR combined GC-IMS
abstract_en: The invention provides a soybean oil flavor detection system and method based on combination of long-optical-path FT-IR and GC-IMS; firstly, the optical path of spectrum measurement is improved through a multi-reflection optical system, so that higher detection sensitivity is obtained; then using the modified FT-IR to rapidly detect the main category of the soybean oil volatile flavor compound; and identifying volatile flavor compounds in the soybean oil by using a GC-IMS method, and finally combining analysis results of the volatile flavor compounds and the volatile flavor compounds to evaluate and analyze the flavor of the soybean oil based on the volatile substance VOCs fingerprint.

title_en: Method and system for improving service cycle of lubricating grease
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of lubricating grease maintenance, and discloses a service cycle method and a service cycle system for lifting lubricating grease, wherein the service cycle method comprises the following steps of: performing image segmentation processing on the scene image to obtain an equipment scene image and a grease scene image; identifying an equipment speckle image in the equipment scene image, extracting equipment texture characterization in the equipment speckle image, calculating equipment abrasion coefficient in the equipment scene image, and calculating corresponding grease end leakage when grease is used in equipment; extracting image color characteristics corresponding to a grease scene image, calculating grease viscosity corresponding to grease, and analyzing current lubricating performance corresponding to the grease; and calculating the affinity coefficient of each thickener class to the lubricating grease, determining the target thickener class in the thickener class, calculating the additive amount of the target thickener class according to the end leakage amount and the current lubricating property of the lubricating grease, and executing the maintenance management of the lubricating grease to obtain a maintenance result. The invention aims to improve the service life of grease.

title_en: Large-scale complicated spare part measuring device based on robot vision servo
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of measuring equipment, and discloses a large-scale complex part measuring device based on robot vision servo. This large-scale complicated spare part measuring device based on robot vision servo through being provided with coarse adjustment mechanism and fine setting measuring mechanism's cooperation, can utilize coarse adjustment mechanism, makes this measuring device remove the below of large-scale complicated spare part earlier, and the fine setting measuring mechanism of recycle can be after being close to large-scale complicated spare part, through the flexible rotation adjustment structure of fine setting, can make the measuring induction rod carry out analysis response to the profile and the inside shape of large-scale complicated spare part, plays and can conveniently operate and use this measuring device, improves its effect to large-scale complicated spare part measurement efficiency.

title_en: Optical measuring device and method for scanning focus
abstract_en: An optical measurement device (100) comprises a point source (102) of electromagnetic radiation and an optical path extending from the point source of electromagnetic radiation to a window (122). An optical input arrangement (108) is also provided, and the optical input arrangement (108) comprises a static input lens. The optical output arrangement (114) of the device comprises a static output lens. The apparatus also includes an intermediate lens (112) and a scanning mechanism (110), the scanning mechanism (110) configured to carry the intermediate lens (112). The position measurement system is operably coupled to the scanning mechanism (110) and configured to measure a position of the intermediate lens (112). An optical input arrangement (108), an intermediate lens (112) and an optical output arrangement (114) are provided in the optical path, and the intermediate lens (112) and the scanning mechanism (110) are provided between the optical input arrangement (108) and the optical output arrangement (114). The scanning mechanism (110) is configured to linearly scan the intermediate lens (112) by position.

title_en: Protection system of electronic control unit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a protection system of an electronic control unit, which comprises: a processor minimum system and an actuator drive unit; the processor min system comprises: a power supply system and an MCU processor on the SOC chip; the actuator driving unit includes: an actuator control module and an actuator diagnostic module; the power supply system on the SOC chip is electrically connected with the MCU processor; the MCU processor is electrically connected with the actuator driving unit; the MCU processor controls the actuator control module to output a driving signal to peripheral equipment by outputting an actuator control signal, and returns a diagnosis signal through the actuator diagnosis module to complete system protection. The invention improves the safety of the system, controls the volume of the circuit and reduces the cost and complexity of the system.

title_en: Automatic detection device and detection method for hydrogen leakage
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic detection device and a detection method for hydrogen leakage, and relates to the technical field of automatic detection for hydrogen leakage. The automatic detection device and the detection method for hydrogen leakage disclosed by the invention have the effects that the specific position of hydrogen leakage is determined by stage segmentation detection, the filling sealing of the inside of a partial region is realized through the region sealing assembly, and the detection assembly and the device are in a relatively sealed environment, so that the accuracy of a stage segmentation detection result is improved, the accurate position determination of hydrogen leakage in the region is realized by the mode, the working efficiency of staff maintenance is improved, and the potential safety hazard caused by hydrogen leakage is reduced.

title_en: High-resolution waveform decomposition method and equipment based on laser radar physical model
abstract_en: A high-resolution waveform decomposition method and equipment based on a laser radar physical model belong to the technical field of full-waveform laser radar waveform data processing. The method aims to solve the problem that the existing waveform decomposition method cannot realize high-resolution decomposition of waveforms due to the limitation of the emission pulse width of a laser radar system. The method comprises the steps of differentiating light spots into adjacent small light spots, building a transmitting pulse model by using superposition of two Gaussian functions, and building a waveform model of a received echo signal based on correspondence; further separating the laser radar emission pulse and the echo signal to obtain a narrow emission pulse and a corresponding echo signal, recovering a target scattering cross section function by utilizing a deconvolution algorithm aiming at the narrow emission pulse and the corresponding echo signal, taking the target scattering cross section function as the sum of the scattering cross section functions of the two targets, and decomposing by using a cubic spline; and after the target scattering cross section function is decomposed in sequence, the sub-echo signals are obtained by convolving the target scattering cross section function with the transmitting pulse.

title_en: Method, system and equipment for correcting constant-source transient electromagnetic response
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system and equipment for correcting a constant-source transient electromagnetic response, and relates to the technical field of transient electromagnetic exploration; constructing an equivalent model; the parameters of the equivalent model include: the number of layers and thickness of the ground model; constructing an equivalent model objective function according to the response corresponding to the equivalent model under the acquisition parameters and the constant source transient electromagnetic response under the acquisition parameters; optimizing the equivalent model objective function by adopting an effective set method to obtain an optimal equivalent model; and determining the transient electromagnetic response of the central loop under the acquisition parameters by using the optimal equivalent model, and taking the transient electromagnetic response as the corrected transient electromagnetic response of the current measuring point. The invention can solve the problem of complex response caused by field source effect in the fixed source transient electromagnetic method.

title_en: Distribution network protection self-adaptive system under power system
abstract_en: The invention provides a power distribution network protection self-adaptive system under a power system, which relates to the field of power distribution systems and comprises the following components: the power distribution network protection module comprises at least one relay protection device arranged on the power distribution network; the setting value preset module is used for establishing a setting value database, wherein the setting value database is used for recording setting values of at least one relay protection device under various preset operation modes of the power distribution network; the data acquisition module is used for acquiring real-time operation information of the power distribution network; the operation determining module is used for determining a real-time operation mode of the power distribution network based on the real-time operation information of the power distribution network and determining a real-time setting value of at least one relay protection device based on the setting value database and the real-time operation mode of the power distribution network; the instruction issuing module is used for issuing the real-time setting value of the at least one relay protection device to the at least one relay protection device, and has the advantages of improving the flexibility and the instantaneity of power distribution network protection.

title_en: Device and method for testing microwave heat injection permeability-increasing distance of water-containing coal bed
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a method for testing a microwave heat injection anti-reflection distance of a water-containing coal seam, which relate to the technical field of anti-reflection of a microwave heat injection coal seam and consist of an industrial microwave oven, a waveguide, a transmission antenna, a microwave emitter, a lead box, a coal pillar and a crushed coal mixed layer. The method includes the steps of saturating and analyzing an original coal pillar, putting the original coal pillar into a lead box one by one while keeping a certain interval, and paving a crushed coal mixing layer with the same height as the coal pillar. Then, the industrial microwave oven is turned on, and microwaves act on the simulated coal seam after passing through the transmission antenna and the microwave transmitter through the waveguide. And after the microwave heat injection is finished, opening the lead box, taking the heat injection coal pillar, filling water for 24 hours, then placing the heat injection coal pillar into a nuclear magnetic resonance instrument, and finally comparing and analyzing the experimental result with the original coal pillar. The method provides qualitative and quantitative basis for judging the response degree of the coal pillars with the same water content to the microwave field under different distances, and has great theoretical and practical significance for deeply exploring the heat generation and transmission characteristics of the coal pillars with the same water content under different distances under microwave heat injection.

title_en: Electromagnetic field multi-dimensional simulation device and method special for electric energy metering equipment
abstract_en: An electromagnetic field multidimensional simulation device and method special for electric energy metering equipment belong to the technical field of electromagnetic field multidimensional simulation, and perform integral management and control on reference information, forward-phase information, process information and construction information of target electric energy metering equipment; performing electromagnetic field simulation estimation for the target electric energy metering equipment; acquiring the numerical value of the electric energy metering equipment controlled by the target electric energy metering equipment control module so as to master the numerical value condition of the electric energy metering equipment; the tolerance level of the target electric energy metering equipment can be mastered, the electric energy metering equipment with good working state can be better selected, the estimation performance is good, the electric energy metering equipment is better analyzed by an operator, the electric energy metering equipment works in a limit electromagnetic field, and the defect that the simulation estimation is not performed on the electromagnetic field around the electric energy metering equipment in the prior art so as to identify the working state of the electric energy metering equipment is effectively avoided.

title_en: Intelligent detection device for transformer
abstract_en: The invention is applicable to the technical field of transformers, and provides an intelligent transformer detection device which comprises a base, wherein a transformer body is arranged at the top end of the base, locking units are symmetrically arranged on the base, the movable end of a lifting mechanism is positioned at the outer side of the transformer body, the free end of a directional driving mechanism is in transmission connection with the lifting mechanism, an adaptive adjusting mechanism is arranged at the movable end of the lifting mechanism, and the detection end of the adaptive adjusting mechanism is abutted to the side surface of the transformer body; according to the detection device, detection modules of different types can be selected as required to complete detection work on the transformer, the detection height is automatically adjusted under the condition that the telescopic piece does not work, and the telescopic piece can pass through the set directional driving mechanism and the self-adaptive adjusting mechanism during working, so that the detection modules continuously cross a gap of the heat dissipation grid, and continuous detection in the gap of the heat dissipation grid is realized.

title_en: Fuel system, and diagnosis method, device and storage medium thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses fuel system and diagnostic method, equipment and storage medium thereof relates to vehicle technical field, and fuel system includes carbon tank, isolation valve, desorption valve, air pump, ooff valve, oil tank, controller, and the first end and the isolation valve of carbon tank are connected, and the second end and the desorption valve of carbon tank are connected, and the third end and the first end of air pump of carbon tank are connected, and the second end and the first end of ooff valve of air pump are connected, and the second end and the oil tank of ooff valve are connected, and the method includes: the controller controls the isolation valve to be closed, the switch valve to be opened and the air pump to be opened so as to charge air into the oil tank; acquiring a first pressure in the oil tank, and if the first pressure reaches a first preset pressure threshold, controlling the switch valve to be closed and controlling the air pump to be closed; and after the first preset time period, acquiring a second pressure in the oil tank, and if a first difference value between the second pressure and a first preset pressure threshold value is larger than a first difference value threshold value, determining that the oil tank of the fuel system has leakage. The method can reduce fuel waste in the diagnosis process.

title_en: Equipment health state monitoring and evaluating method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application is suitable for the technical field of equipment operation and maintenance, and provides an equipment health state monitoring and evaluating method and device and electronic equipment. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring first operation data of each operation parameter of the cigarette machine power equipment and the corresponding failure times of each operation parameter in a first preset time period; determining the health degree of the cigarette machine power equipment according to the first operation data of each operation parameter and the corresponding failure times of each operation parameter; if the health degree is smaller than the preset threshold value, determining a global covariance matrix based on a first data matrix constructed by first operation data of each operation parameter, determining a corresponding data increment mean value and standard deviation based on the global covariance matrix, and determining the health state of the cigarette machine power equipment according to the data increment mean value and the standard deviation. The application can accurately monitor and evaluate the health state of the cigarette machine power equipment, thereby being capable of maintaining the cigarette machine power equipment in time when the cigarette machine power equipment fails and improving the production efficiency.

title_en: Defect detection system, method and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a defect detection system, a defect detection method and a storage medium, which belong to the field of pipeline detection and comprise a sensor and a processor, wherein the sensor is used for acquiring eddy current differential voltage and magnetic field differential voltage of a pipeline to be detected; the processor is used for preprocessing the eddy current differential voltage and the magnetic field differential voltage to obtain differential data; and detecting and analyzing the differential data to obtain a defect detection result. The invention can improve the magnetization level of the pipeline, thereby improving the detection capability of the defects, eliminating the influence of the sensor lift-off vibration on the signals and improving the accuracy of defect identification.

title_en: Detection method and application of lithium supplementing slow release technology, and soft-package three-electrode battery
abstract_en: The invention provides a detection method and application of a lithium supplementing slow release technology, a soft package three-electrode battery is provided with a reference electrode, the reference electrode is used as a reference electrode for measuring electrode potential, and voltages of a positive electrode and a negative electrode relative to a stable reference electrode and voltage changes of the positive electrode and the negative electrode under different test working conditions are respectively tested so as to realize in-situ monitoring of electrochemical reactions inside the battery.
