The reference electrode is introduced, so that in-situ monitoring of electrochemical reaction inside the battery can be realized, and various electrochemical performances of the battery can be conveniently and better researched; the method is also helpful for analyzing and revealing the action mechanism of the slow-release lithium supplement, and the principle of the lithium supplement technology on improving the cycle performance of the lithium ion battery is clarified.

title_en: Attention twin intelligent migration interpretability diagnosis method suitable for high-end equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an attention twin intelligent migration interpretability diagnosis method suitable for high-end equipment, which comprises the steps of firstly obtaining vibration signal data of different fault parts of a bearing and a gear under different loads or rotating speeds, and preprocessing the data; constructing a convolution neural network model of a double-branch architecture, so that the model can simultaneously receive unbalanced samples under two different working conditions for training; adding a cross-module serial dual-attention mechanism comprising a channel feature attention enhancement module and a segment feature attention enhancement module into the model, wherein the cross-module serial dual-attention mechanism is used for reasonably enhancing the feature information of small samples, enhancing the domain invariant features of unbalanced samples and realizing the attention interpretability of the features; meanwhile, a twin feature fusion module is introduced, so that domain invariant features in an unbalanced sample are better extracted; finally, various proposed feature visualization methods are adopted to realize feature visualization interpretation of the migration diagnosis model, and high-efficiency migration diagnosis accuracy is completed on the test data set.

title_en: I-shaped wood beam structure firm detection device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a firm detection device for an I-shaped wood beam structure, which comprises a moment wrench and a special-shaped detection piece, wherein the special-shaped detection piece comprises a special-shaped detection plate, the special-shaped detection plate comprises a first special-shaped channel steel and a second special-shaped channel steel, two side leg walls of the first special-shaped channel steel are provided with special-shaped clamping groove walls which shrink towards the middle, two side leg walls of the rear end of the second special-shaped channel steel are provided with special-shaped groove walls which shrink towards the middle, and the front end of the second special-shaped channel steel is connected with the rear end of the first special-shaped channel steel; and a connecting hole is formed in the waist wall of the front side of the first special-shaped channel steel, and the moment spanner is connected with the whole body formed by connecting the first special-shaped channel steel and the second special-shaped channel steel through the connecting hole. According to the device, the flange plate above the front end of the I-shaped wood beam to be detected is clamped in the special-shaped clamping groove wall of the first special-shaped channel steel, the special-shaped groove wall of the second special-shaped channel steel is abutted against the upper end face of the flange plate below, force application is carried out through a torque wrench, and firm connection between the web plate of the I-shaped wood beam and the flange plate is detected.

title_en: Method for high-throughput rapid detection and evaluation of skeletal muscle toxicity of compound
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for rapidly detecting and evaluating skeletal muscle toxicity of a compound with high flux, which takes a skeletal muscle specific calcium ion channel RYR1 as a target point, combines a cell line stably expressing RYR1 with a calcium sensitive fluorescent probe, screens and evaluates the compound which can induce activation of the calcium ion channel RYR1 and cause increase of calcium ions in the cell stably expressing RYR1, further detects and evaluates the skeletal muscle toxicity of the compound, has high sensitivity, short time consumption and low cost compared with the existing detection method of the muscle toxicity, provides a rapid screening means for muscle toxicity adverse reaction and compound muscle toxicity monitoring of drug development, and has good development prospect.

title_en: Water quality detection device for industrial wastewater
abstract_en: The invention relates to a water quality detection device for industrial wastewater, which comprises a floating seat, wherein a supporting plate is arranged at the top of the floating seat, a stand column is arranged in the center of the supporting plate, a top frame plate is arranged at the top of the stand column, a master controller is arranged at the top of the top frame plate, a signal receiving rod is arranged at one side of the master controller and used for sending signals and receiving signals, a multi-stage electric telescopic rod is arranged in the stand column, a water taking mechanism is arranged at the bottom end of the multi-stage electric telescopic rod, a positioning bracket is arranged at the outer side of the stand column, a plurality of solar panels are arranged on the positioning bracket, an electric storage box is arranged at the inner side of the positioning bracket, a detection mechanism is arranged at one side of the electric storage box, and water samples in the water taking mechanism are detected, data information is transmitted to the signal receiving rod through the master controller and processed and analyzed through a remote client.

title_en: Drop hammer type deflectometer drop point laser positioning device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a falling point laser positioning device of a falling weight deflectometer, which relates to the field of roadbed and pavement detection and comprises a shell, a support frame and a top plate, wherein a pneumatic push rod is fixedly arranged on one side of the shell, a movable ring is arranged on the inner side of the support frame, a falling weight deflectometer body is fixedly connected on one side of the top of the movable ring, and three movable mechanisms are arranged between the support frame and the top plate. According to the invention, the positions of the movable ring and the drop hammer type deflectometer body are accurately changed by only adjusting one movable mechanism, in the process, the other two movable mechanisms can play a role of limiting and guiding, not only can the movable ring be assisted to change the position, but also the height of the movable ring can be limited, the situation that the movable ring is askew in the moving process is avoided, and the movable ring can be enabled to move more stably by matching the three movable mechanisms, so that the angle between the drop point and the measuring point of the drop hammer type deflectometer body is avoided, and the effect of improving the detection accuracy is achieved.

title_en: RGB-IR 3D camera
abstract_en: The application provides an RGB-IR 3D camera, including camera lens, RGB-IR sensor, IR structure light source, IR illumination light source, RGB-IR sensor is connected with the sensor control board, IR structure light source, IR illumination light source with the light source control board is connected, camera lens, RGB-IR sensor, IR structure light source, IR illumination light source all set up in pairs, IR structure light source, IR illumination light source are located between a pair of camera lens, and wherein, the FOI size of two IR structure light sources is different, and the FOI size of two IR illumination light sources is also different. The light sources are also arranged in pairs, have FOIs with different sizes, and can be started according to the difference of the distance of objects, so that the near-distance and long-distance high-quality RGB-IR imaging and depth detection are realized.

title_en: RSSI-based three-dimensional space positioning method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a three-dimensional space positioning method, device, equipment and storage medium based on RSSI, and relates to the technical field of indoor positioning. The three-dimensional space positioning method comprises steps S1 to S5. S1, acquiring RSSI signal values sent by a plurality of positioning anchor nodes scanned by equipment to be positioned. S2, according to the RSSI signal value, obtaining the prediction distance between the equipment to be positioned and the positioning anchor nodes through a pre-constructed three-dimensional Newton-Lawson iteration model. S3, taking the positioning anchor node as a sphere center, taking the predicted distance between the equipment to be positioned and the positioning anchor node as a radius, constructing spheres, and adjusting the states among the spheres to be intersected. S4, constructing a uniform point set P in the intersection area of the spheres. And S5, solving a median center through a K nearest neighbor algorithm according to the equipartition point set P, and obtaining coordinates of the equipment to be positioned.

title_en: Controllable seismic source for long-term monitoring of drilling and operation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coal mining, and discloses a controllable seismic source for long-term monitoring of drilling and an operation method thereof, which comprise a shell, wherein the middle part of the shell is provided with an exhaust hole, one end of the shell is provided with an air inlet mechanism, and the other end of the shell is provided with a plugging mechanism; the fixed sleeve is arranged in the shell, one end of the fixed sleeve is propped against the air inlet mechanism, the other end of the fixed sleeve is propped against the sealing mechanism, the sealing mechanism is communicated with the exhaust hole, and the sealing mechanism is propped against the plugging mechanism; the air release piston is in sliding contact with the sealing mechanism, and the outer circle of the large end of the air release piston is in sliding contact with the inner wall of the air inlet mechanism and forms a right cavity with the plugging mechanism; the small end excircle of the air release piston is connected with the piston body, a left cavity is formed between the piston body and the plugging mechanism, and the left cavity is communicated with the exhaust hole through the sealing mechanism. The invention can improve the adaptability of different working conditions and improve the safety performance.

title_en: Method and device for monitoring braking performance of unmanned mine car
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for monitoring the braking performance of an unmanned mine car, which comprise the following steps: s1, collecting working conditions and braking areas of a mine car in a braking process; s2, calculating the braking torque of the mine car according to the working condition of the mine car in the braking process; s3, comparing the braking torque obtained in the step S2 with the braking torque of the braking data of the same working condition and the same braking area in the historical database, and judging whether the braking performance of the mine car is qualified or not according to a comparison result. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the current braking performance of the vehicle can be objectively reflected by comparing the same working condition with the braking torque in the braking area, the computing efficiency is improved without computing the braking frequency, the accuracy of the monitoring process can be ensured, and the safety of the vehicle in the running process is further ensured.

title_en: Switchable monochromator system for neutron diffraction stress texture analysis
abstract_en: The invention provides a switchable monochromator system for neutron diffraction stress texture analysis, which comprises an angle rotating table, an angle tilting table, a horizontal displacement table, a first monochromator and a second monochromator, wherein the angle tilting table is used for detecting the angle of the angle rotating table; the first monochromator and the second monochromator are used for generating different monochromatic neutron beams; the horizontal displacement table is used for adjusting the horizontal displacement of the first monochromator and the second monochromator; the angle tilting table is used for adjusting the tilting angle of the first monochromator or the second monochromator; the angle rotary table is used for adjusting the rotation angle of the first monochromator or the second monochromator. The invention solves the problems of monochromator switching and high-precision motion control in a smaller shielding space by adopting a structure integrating multi-axis motions such as angle rotation, angle inclination, horizontal displacement and the like and a high-precision encoder; by adopting a horizontal displacement table, the switching of high-resolution/high-neutron flux measurement modes and the setting of an empty beam state are realized through the switching of different types of monochromators.

title_en: Gas detector
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gas detector, which comprises a shell, a circuit board assembly and a supporting piece, wherein the circuit board assembly comprises a circuit board and a detection unit arranged on the circuit board, and the circuit board assembly is at least partially positioned in the shell; the housing has a first ventilation portion and a second ventilation portion, the first ventilation portion and the second ventilation portion being respectively oriented to different sides of the detection unit; the support piece is provided with a support frame and a waterproof breathable film, the waterproof breathable film and the support frame are integrally arranged, the support piece is fixed or limited with the shell, the waterproof breathable film comprises a first film part and a second film part, the first film part covers the first ventilation part, and the second film part covers the second ventilation part. The invention can fix the waterproof and breathable films at different positions, is beneficial to reducing the number of assembly parts of the gas detector and reduces the installation complexity.

title_en: Method for identifying plum blossom and wax plum blossom medicinal materials
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for identifying plum blossom and wax plum blossom medicinal materials, which belongs to the technical field of medicament detection, wherein the method comprises the steps of preparing a medicinal material solution to be detected by utilizing the medicinal material to be detected, detecting by adopting high performance liquid chromatography, and identifying the type of the medicinal material to be detected by analyzing a chromatogram of the obtained medicinal material to be detected; in the chromatogram of the medicinal material to be detected, when 4 chromatographic peaks appear in the retention time of 11.0-14.0 min, the medicinal material to be detected is plum blossom medicinal material; when only 2 chromatographic peaks appear within the retention time of 11.0-14.0 min, the medicinal material to be detected is the Chimonanthus praecox medicinal material. The identification method disclosed by the invention is simple to operate, short in analysis time, good in uniformity, high in accuracy and high in comprehensiveness, the accuracy rate can reach 100%, and the identification method is suitable for wide popularization and application.

title_en: Digital holographic object morphology measuring device and method based on concave mirror
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital holographic object morphology measuring device and method based on a concave mirror, and belongs to the technical field of photoelectric detection. The method comprises the following steps: the laser emitted by the laser is changed into parallel light after passing through the beam expanding and collimating system, and is divided into two parallel light waves through a beam splitter; one of the parallel light waves is reflected by the sample to be detected to carry object information and become object light waves; the other beam of parallel light waves is reflected by the concave mirror to become spherical reference light waves; after the object light wave and the reference light wave interfere on the target surface of the detector, recording a lens-free Fourier transform off-axis digital hologram through the detector; the phase information of the measured sample is obtained by processing the lens-free Fourier transform off-axis digital hologram through a computer, and the morphology height of the measured sample is obtained through the relation between the phase and the optical path. The system has the advantages of simple structure, high measurement speed and strong environmental noise resistance.

title_en: Broadband signal azimuth estimation method based on quantum genetic algorithm optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wideband signal azimuth estimation method based on quantum genetic algorithm optimization, which comprises the steps of adopting a signal subspace fitting method to construct subspace fitting criterion functions at all frequency points; encoding the azimuth solution space by utilizing a quantum genetic algorithm, and constructing a dynamic distribution range of a quantum rotation angle irrelevant to iteration times according to the distribution condition of an optimal solution; and determining the optimal estimated azimuth according to the optimal fitness value. The invention has better azimuth estimation capability and system stability and lower calculation complexity.

title_en: Measuring tool for measuring blind hole with large radial drop and deep inner cavity
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of blind hole inner cavity measurement, and particularly relates to a blind hole measuring tool for measuring a radial fall large and deep inner cavity, which comprises a movable support, a fixed support, a spring shaft, a first fixed nut, a second fixed nut, round head screws and fixed screws, wherein the movable support is positioned at one side of the fixed support and is connected through one spring shaft, positioning components are arranged on the surfaces of the two spring shafts, and the side wall of the fixed support is provided with a protection component for the fixed screws.

title_en: Grid meteorological monitoring system based on gridding data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a grid weather monitoring system based on grid data, which comprises a weather monitoring sensor group, a grid weather data acquisition unit, a data processing unit, a weather data transmission unit, a processor module and a signal transmission module, wherein the weather monitoring sensor group is connected with the data processing unit through the grid weather data acquisition unit, the data processing unit is connected with the processor module through the weather data transmission unit, and the processor module is connected with a background monitoring center through the signal transmission module.

title_en: Application of chemiluminescence adder method in preparation of monoclonal antibodies for recognizing different epitopes
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of monoclonal antibodies, in particular to application of a chemiluminescent additive method in preparation of monoclonal antibodies for recognizing different epitopes. Based on the high sensitivity and wide linear range of chemiluminescence immunoassay (CLIA), the invention applies chemiluminescence to monoclonal antibody classification, and establishes a chemiluminescence additive method. The chemiluminescence adder method is a simple and rapid method for classifying antibodies, provides a new method for preparing monoclonal antibodies for recognizing different epitopes, and can avoid preparing the same monoclonal antibody, thereby greatly reducing the cost for preparing monoclonal antibodies for recognizing different epitopes and saving time and energy of scientific researchers.

title_en: Rock mass ground stress field inversion method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rock mass ground stress field inversion method and a system, which relate to the technical field of geotechnical engineering and comprise the following steps: measuring initial ground stress of the original rock by adopting a hydraulic fracturing method; measuring unloading ground stress by adopting a surface stress relief method; and inverting the ground stress field based on simulation analysis and artificial intelligence to obtain an inversion result. The method combines the hydraulic fracturing method with the surface stress measurement to obtain the initial ground stress and the unloading ground stress of the original rock, and compared with the traditional method, the method has the advantages of simpler and more convenient operation, strong intuitionistic property, high precision, high speed, low cost and the like, and can reach the construction standard.

title_en: Method for detecting defect structure of shielding network of vehicle-mounted cable based on temperature derivative method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for detecting a defect structure of a vehicle-mounted cable shielding net based on a temperature derivative method, which comprises the steps of firstly grounding one end of the shielding net, injecting current from the other end of the shielding net, enabling a defect area of the shielding net to generate heat, measuring a surface temperature distribution image of the defect area, eliminating background noise after digitally filtering the surface temperature distribution image, obtaining a scalar field of the filtered temperature image, respectively obtaining a second derivative field, a fourth derivative field and a sixth derivative field of the scalar field, horizontally intercepting a curve of a derivative amplitude image, taking a coordinate position of a main peak and a peak value of the derivative curve as the position of the defect structure of the shielding net, and finally drawing a defect topological structure in the shielding net according to the position of the defect structure of the shielding net. The invention can accurately, efficiently and rapidly detect the defect structure in the vehicle-mounted cable shielding network, and has important significance for guaranteeing the safe and stable operation of the vehicle-mounted cable.

title_en: High performance liquid chromatography analysis and detection method for 6 genotoxic impurities in telmisartan
abstract_en: The invention provides a high performance liquid chromatography analysis and detection method for 6 genotoxic impurities in telmisartan, and aims to separate and detect the impurities A, B, C, D, E, F and other 6 genotoxic impurities in a telmisartan bulk drug by using high performance liquid chromatography. The limit of genotoxic impurities is low, and in detection, a high-concentration sample solution is usually required to be prepared, so that the set detection limit is reached, the problems of poor separation degree and the like caused by chromatographic column blockage and unknown peak interference are inevitably caused, and further, the accuracy and the quantification are not ensured. The method has the advantages of low cost, high sensitivity, good separation degree, simple operation, good stability, good reproducibility, high precision and the like, reduces the cost, effectively detects telmisartan and improves the safety of the product.

title_en: Method for estimating focal length of crystal thermal lens
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for estimating the focal length of a crystal thermal lens, which comprises the steps of firstly measuring and correcting spot data of a measuring end, enabling the distance from a light emitting position of a detector to a focusing lens to be consistent with the actual measuring distance, deducing the beam waist radius of the light emitting position of the detecting laser, deducing the inherent lens focal length of the crystal due to clamping stress or residual stress generated during growth under the condition that the crystal is placed in the crystal but no pumping is carried out, deducing the total lens focal length value of the crystal by a curvature radius formula deduction method after the spot size of the detected light passing through two sides of the crystal is consistent under the condition that the crystal is irradiated by pumping light, and finally removing the influence of the inherent lens caused by the clamping stress or the residual stress generated during growth by a combined lens focal length formula to obtain the thermal lens focal length value of the crystal. The invention has smaller measurement error and is suitable for measuring the focal length of the crystal thermal lens with arbitrary strength.

title_en: Conductive film conductivity mutual capacitance detection system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a conductive performance mutual capacitance detection system and method of a conductive film, comprising the following steps: the mutual capacitance module comprises a conductor which can be placed on the conductive film; the control unit comprises a control chip, a transmitting interface, a receiving interface and a communication interface are arranged on the control chip, each conductive channel in the conductor and the conductive film in the mutual capacitance module is connected with the control chip through the transmitting interface and the receiving interface to form an alternating current loop, the control chip transmits electric signals through the transmitting interface, and the coupled electric signals fed back by the loop are received through the receiving interface after passing through the conductor and each conductive channel; the data processing unit is connected with the control unit through the communication interface, receives the coupling electric signals transmitted by the control unit, converts the coupling electric signals, and outputs readable capacitance related values and resistance related values. The invention has strong universality by mutual capacitance detection, low detection cost and high production efficiency.

title_en: Building engineering measuring robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of building work measuring robot equipment, in particular to a building engineering measuring robot which comprises a propeller, an obstacle removing device, a cover, a wiring device and a base, wherein the cover is fixedly arranged at the center of the upper surface of the base, the wiring device is rotatably arranged at the center of the inside of the base, the obstacle removing device is rotatably arranged on the outer surface of the edge of the base, and the propeller is fixedly arranged at the center of the top surface of the cover. The invention can measure the construction engineering by using the measuring robot, can achieve the aim of saving labor, and can improve the efficiency of measuring the construction engineering.

title_en: Overflow alarming and observing integrated device for marine fuel tank and use method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an overflow alarm and observation integrated device of a marine fuel tank, which comprises a flow guide module and an overflow module, wherein one side of the flow guide module is provided with the overflow module, the flow guide module comprises a flow guide body, an inlet short pipe, an outlet short pipe and a flow guide plate, the upper end of the flow guide body is provided with the inlet short pipe, the lower end of the flow guide body is provided with the outlet short pipe, the inner wall of the flow guide body is provided with the flow guide plate, the flow guide plate is arranged above the outlet short pipe, the overflow module comprises an overflow pipe, a liquid level switch and a visual device, the liquid level switch is arranged on the overflow pipe, and the end head of the overflow pipe is sealed by the visual device; the inlet short pipe and the outlet short pipe are arranged on the upper end face and the lower end face of the diversion body in a staggered mode. According to the invention, the liquid flow holes are formed in the outlet short pipe, so that the liquid level switch does not alarm when the fuel flowing into the diversion body is very small, and false alarm caused by ship body shaking or other conditions is avoided. The accuracy of the liquid level switch is improved.

title_en: Inclination angle measuring tool
abstract_en: The invention discloses an inclination angle measuring tool, and relates to the field of angle measurement; at present, the dip angle measurement of the telegraph pole has the problems of more factors influencing the measurement precision and low measurement precision; the invention comprises the following steps: a spherical clamping seat which is detachably assembled on the telegraph pole, wherein a plurality of scale marks are arranged on the spherical surface of the clamping seat, a containing groove passing through the sphere center is arranged on the clamping seat, and the axis of the containing groove is vertical to the plane where the annular scale marks are arranged; the floating ring assembly is detachably and rotatably sleeved on the clamping seat, and the top end of the floating ring assembly can be kept horizontal under the action of self gravity; the supporting clamp is assembled in the clamp seat and clamps the surface of the telegraph pole, and the supporting clamp can enable the axis of the telegraph pole to coincide with the axis of the accommodating groove in the clamping process; the floating bubble indicating disc is fixedly assembled at the outer edge of the through hole of the containing groove at the top of the clamping seat, the deflection angle difference value between the circumferential point of the floating ring assembly corresponding to the high-position floating bubble of the floating bubble indicating disc and the clamping seat is the telegraph pole inclination angle, and the telegraph pole inclination angle detection precision is effectively improved.

title_en: Switch board detection device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of cabinet detection, in particular to a power distribution cabinet detection device which comprises a base, a bearing plate and a detection mechanism. According to the invention, the movement of the right side pressing plate in the left-right direction is controlled through the movement of the electric sliding block, namely whether the pressing plate is in contact with the corresponding supporting strips or not is controlled, when strength detection is carried out, the two conditions of applying acting force to only one supporting strip and simultaneously applying acting force to two supporting strips are simulated, the two conditions when the frame is actually subjected to acting force are more practical in the detection process, so that the detection operation is more comprehensive, the detection result is fit with the practical condition, the detection operation of the two conditions can be realized through controlling the left-right movement of the right side pressing plate, and the operation steps are simple.

title_en: Circuit board bending performance testing device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of circuit board devices, in particular to a circuit board bending performance testing device, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a mounting plate is fixed above the bottom plate, a plurality of testing rings are arranged on the mounting plate, each testing ring comprises a plurality of testing rods, each testing rod penetrates through the mounting plate and is in sliding connection with the corresponding testing rod, each testing ring further comprises a positioning ring, the bottoms of the testing rods are fixed on the corresponding positioning ring, a positioning plate is further fixed at the bottom of each positioning ring, pull rings are respectively fixed at the tail ends of the positioning plates, a sliding plate is further arranged above the bottom plate, a translation motor is fixed on the sliding plate, a translation screw rod is fixed at the output end of the translation motor, a pull rod in threaded connection with the translation screw rod is arranged on the translation screw rod, a lifting threaded pipe and a limiting pipe are further fixed on the sliding plate, and a lifting screw rod and a positioning rod are arranged on the bottom plate. The device can realize that the circuit board is bent into a curved surface for testing, and has obvious testing effect.

title_en: Urban low-lying road section water level monitoring and information publishing system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water level monitoring and information issuing system for urban low-lying road sections, which particularly relates to the technical field of water level monitoring, wherein water level acquisition and information transmission equipment comprises an electronic water gauge, an LED display screen, an antenna, a power supply and a network collector, wherein the lower part of the electronic water gauge comprises a plurality of water level sensors, the upper part of the electronic water gauge comprises a plurality of interfaces which can be externally connected with the power supply to supply power for the electronic water gauge, the water level collector is connected with the LED display screen, real-time water level data of a special road section are obtained through the electronic water gauge, the water level information is converted and transmitted through a signal conversion and transmission device, a code program and the like, influences of different water levels on different vehicle types on the low-lying road section are analyzed by using special knowledge in the traffic and vehicle fields, personalized grading early warning is carried out, and the real-time information is fed back to road markers (LED display screens) or small programs of mobile ends of mobile phones in the form of dynamic water waves for different audience groups, so that traffic accidents of the special road sections caused by sudden weather are reduced.

title_en: Method for quantitatively predicting shale reservoir water saturation based on petrophysical template
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of shale petrophysical and logging data interpretation, and particularly relates to a method for quantitatively predicting shale reservoir water saturation based on a petrophysical template. According to the invention, firstly, the elastic modulus of brittle minerals is obtained by using VRH theory, then the elastic modulus of a mixed mineral matrix is obtained by using SCA self-consistent model calculation, then shale elastic parameters under the influence of fluid saturation are obtained by using EIAS equivalent medium theory and Wood equation, finally, an elastic parameter petrophysical template under the influence of porosity-water saturation is constructed, the template is corrected by using logging data, and the consistency of the two is good. The rock physical template provided by the invention can accurately predict the water saturation of the shale reservoir, and can greatly reduce risks brought by exploration and development.

title_en: Method for rapidly detecting content of index component in PLA/PLGA microsphere preparation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for rapidly detecting the content of index components in PLA/PLGA microsphere preparation, which comprises the following steps of (1) preparing a reference substance solution, (2) preparing a test substance solution, and (3) detecting the reference substance solution and the test substance solution by adopting a high performance liquid chromatography. The chromatographic detection result has good peak shape, small deviation of the detection result and good repeatability, and the detection period is greatly shortened, and the single-needle detection time is shortened to 5min from original 20 min.

title_en: Automatic monitoring method and device for shallow point touch of underwater hard sweeping bed
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic monitoring method for shallow point touch of an underwater hard sweeping bed, which comprises the following steps: s1, acquiring real-time data; s2, setting an resolvable frequency range through a short-time window and a sensor sampling rate, removing high-frequency noise and a periodic signal with stronger energy to obtain a time domain convolution coefficient of frequency domain filtering, and directly carrying out convolution processing with sampled gesture data; s3, convolving the filtered vertical rod attitude data of the sweeping bed frame with a detection convolution kernel function, finding local maxima, analyzing the mean value and standard deviation of the local maxima, and identifying shallow point touch signals according to a 3-time standard deviation principle; and S4, constructing weight coefficients according to the time scale parameters, and scoring the detection results of the suspected touch signals at all times. The invention also discloses an automatic monitoring device for shallow point touch of the underwater hard sweeping bed. The swing automatic monitoring and identifying device can automatically monitor and identify swing of two types of shallow point touch events of the sweeping bed frame, and can be widely applied to the field of navigation safety.

title_en: Circuitry for analyte measurement
abstract_en: Circuitry for measuring characteristics of an electrochemical cell, the circuitry comprising: the hysteresis comparator is provided with a first comparator input end, a second comparator input end and a comparator output end; a feedback path between the comparator output and the second comparator input and configured to provide a feedback signal to the second comparator input; and a loop filter configured to apply filtering to the feedback path to produce a feedback signal, wherein the loop filter comprises an electrochemical cell.

title_en: Method for self-diagnosing a circuit for insulation resistance measurement of a high voltage system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for self-diagnosing a circuit (22) for insulation resistance measurement of a battery system, said circuit (22) having: a first switch (S  1 ) that connects the positive electrode of the battery system (12) to a ground line via a first series-connected comparison resistor (R  S ); and a second switch (S  2 ) that connects the negative electrode of the battery system (12) to a ground line via a second comparison resistor (R  S ) connected in series. -performing a current measurement on the closed first switch (S  1 ) to obtain a measured first current (I  G1 ) and on the closed second switch (S  2 ) to obtain a measured second current (I  G2 ), wherein only one of the two switches (S  1 、S 2 ) is always closed, -calculating a theoretical current (It 1, it 2) through the switch (S  1 、S 2 ) based on the voltage (U  P /U M ) of the battery system (12) and the magnitude of the comparison resistor (R  S ), and-comparing the measured current (I  G1 、I G2 ) with the associated theoretical current (It 1, it 2), wherein a fault signal is issued and/or a fault action is performed when the comparison result is below or exceeds a predetermined reference value range.

title_en: Ceramic center stick straightness accuracy detection device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a straightness detection device for a ceramic center rod, which relates to the technical field of industrial ceramics and comprises a detection mechanism, a rotating mechanism and a turnover mechanism, wherein the detection mechanism comprises a first cylinder and an electronic dial indicator, the first cylinder drives the electronic dial indicator to move downwards and abut against the middle of the ceramic center rod, and then the straightness of the ceramic center rod is detected by the electronic dial indicator; the rotating mechanism is provided with a pair of symmetrical left and right ends of the ceramic center rod and comprises a double-head motor and a rotating roller, and the double-head motor drives the rotating roller to rotate and rubs to drive the ceramic center rod to rotate; the turnover mechanism is provided with a pair of turnover mechanisms and is arranged on the detection mechanism in a bilateral symmetry way, the turnover mechanism comprises a cylinder II and a turnover plate, a rotating mechanism positioned on the same side is arranged on the turnover plate, and the turnover plate and the rotating mechanism are driven to deflect downwards through the cylinder II and automatically discharge the ceramic center rod after detection. The invention has the characteristics of reasonable scheme, convenient use and high detection efficiency.

title_en: Concave web foot bionic robot based on intelligent detection and feedback of crop information and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a web-sinking foot bionic robot based on intelligent detection and feedback of crop information and a use method thereof, the web-sinking foot bionic robot comprises a supporting platform, an intelligent web-sinking bionic foot is arranged below the supporting platform, the support platform is also provided with a detachable intelligent fertilizing device, a GreenSeeker detector, a hyperspectral imager, a GreenSeeker conversion control device, an intelligent identification control device, a Beidou navigation system, a wind direction sensor, a wind speed sensor, an energy supply device, an energy storage device and a notebook computer. The invention can simultaneously realize the one-time real-time acquisition, processing, decision making and feedback of multiple information such as crop image information, spectrum information, distance information, climate information and the like, controls the corresponding feedback device to realize the fertilization or pesticide spraying of crops to targets, simplifies the complexity of the traditional operation tool, improves the crop information detection efficiency, and promotes the development of intelligent agriculture and intelligent agricultural machinery.

title_en: Method and device for processing DC side current test data of three-phase PWM converter
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of AC/DC current measurement, and particularly relates to a method and a device for processing DC side current test data of a three-phase PWM converter, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring direct current test data of a direct current side of the three-phase PWM converter, which is measured by a Rogowski coil current probe; acquiring alternating current test data of any phase on the alternating current side of the three-phase PWM converter; calibrating the direct current test data according to the alternating current test data, then judging the correctness of the calibrated direct current test data, and if the judgment result is wrong, calibrating the direct current test data again; and if the judgment result is correct, obtaining the calibrated direct current test data. The application realizes the test of the direct current side alternating current component of the three-phase PWM converter, further reconstructs the direct current component based on the test data processing, and realizes the accurate measurement of the direct current side current of the three-phase PWM converter.

title_en: Device and method for measuring perpendicularity of large-diameter tubular pile
abstract_en: The invention provides a device and a method for measuring perpendicularity of a large-diameter tubular pile, which relate to the technical field of wind power piles and specifically comprise the following steps: a three-dimensional coordinate system is defined for the whole wind power pile, the wind power pile is transversely placed, the central axis of the wind power pile is an X axis, one end of the wind power pile is defined as 0 point of the X axis, the Y axis is parallel to the horizontal plane, and the Z axis is determined through a right-handed system criterion; cutting the whole wind power pile into n sections by n+1 equidistant longitudinal sections, wherein the side cross sections of the wind power pile with the number of i are all positioned on a three-dimensional coordinate system; according to the method, equidistant sectioning analysis is carried out on the wind power pile, data acquisition, data analysis and data processing are carried out on point location data of each sectioning plane, a plurality of groups of elliptic functions are generated through fitting, the elliptic functions intuitively represent the values of the center point and the edge point of each sectioning plane of the wind power pile, a comprehensive evaluation index ZPz is formed, and the perpendicularity of the wind power pile can be judged more accurately through the data.

title_en: Motor noise evaluation method and system under multiple working conditions of electric automobile
abstract_en: The invention discloses a motor noise evaluation method and a system under multiple working conditions of an electric automobile, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an original audio signal in the running process of a driving motor of an electric automobile, performing variation modal decomposition, calculating the similarity between different modal components and the original audio signal, dividing a high-frequency component and a low-frequency component, and dividing the high-frequency component and the low-frequency component based on the working condition of the driving motor; acquiring noise characteristics under different working conditions according to the arrangement entropy of the high-frequency component and the low-frequency component, constructing a noise objective psychological parameter set, and screening objective evaluation indexes of different working conditions by utilizing the noise characteristics; and constructing a motor noise evaluation model, generating an input matrix according to objective evaluation indexes under different working conditions, and obtaining a noise evaluation classification result. According to the invention, the actual operation condition of the driving motor of the electric automobile is considered, the accuracy and the efficiency of noise evaluation are improved, and objective psychological factors can be considered in the evaluation process, so that the evaluation is more in line with the actual feeling of human ears on noise.

title_en: Automatic induction temperature early warning method and system for hair straightening comb
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data cleaning, in particular to an automatic induction temperature early warning method and system for a hair straightening comb. The method comprises the steps of obtaining independent characteristic values of each independent component signal of an original temperature signal, and obtaining the difference degree between the independent component signals according to the amplitude difference of data points in any two independent component signals and the independent characteristic value difference; combining the discrete degree of the slope between adjacent data points in the independent component signal and the chaotic degree and the independent characteristic value of the amplitude average change rate of the local signal section of the independent component signal, and adjusting the difference degree to obtain the filtering intensity value of the independent component signal; filtering the independent component signals by using a filtering algorithm based on the filtering intensity value to obtain a denoising temperature signal; and pre-warning the temperature of the hair straightening comb according to the amplitude difference of the data points in the signal of the temperature and the normal temperature. The invention adaptively acquires the filtering intensity value of the independent component signal, improves the denoising effectiveness of the original temperature signal, and increases the accuracy of temperature early warning of the hair straightening comb.

title_en: Method and device for improving parametric array sonar detection efficiency based on multiple beams
abstract_en: The method and the device for improving the detection efficiency of the parametric array sonar based on the multiple beams comprise the following steps: the electronic scanning of the wave beam is realized by a wave beam forming method of the phase control parametric array, and the array design is optimized to solve the problems of main lobe widening, side lobe increasing, peak point misalignment and the like of the difference frequency wave beam. The transmitting end reduces the correlation of the multi-beam signals by using a linear frequency modulation signal with adjacent center frequency and a positive and negative direction linear frequency modulation method, and the receiving end adopts a matched filtering technology to realize the separation and detection of the multi-beams. The method realizes beam deflection control and multi-beam scanning through a phase delay superposition method, and simultaneously suppresses main lobe weakening and widening to the greatest extent; under the condition of wide beam receiving, the separation and detection of multiple beams are realized by reducing the signal correlation and matched filtering, and the scanning speed of the parametric array sonar is effectively improved.

title_en: Bionic skin micro-tissue electrochemical sensor and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bionic skin micro-tissue electrochemical sensor and a preparation method and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of electrochemical sensors and food safety detection. Dispersing a platinum-loaded multiwall carbon nanotube in a chitosan-sodium alginate composite material solution to obtain a dispersion; dropping the dispersed liquid on a working electrode of a screen printing electrode to obtain the screen printing electrode for detecting peroxynitroso (ONOO  ‑ ) in active oxygen; then, mixing a mouse mast cell (RBL-2H 3), a mouse islet vascular endothelial cell (MS 1) and a methacryloyl gelatin (GelMA) hydrogel solution to obtain a biological ink, and performing 3D printing on the biological ink to obtain a bionic skin micro-tissue model; and then, mixing and incubating the sample to be detected and the bionic skin microstructure model, and after the mixed incubation is finished, taking supernatant to detect in a screen printing electrode for detecting peroxynitroso (ONOO  ‑ ) in active oxygen to obtain the concentration of peroxynitroso (ONOO  ‑ ). The method of the invention can be used for detecting the allergen fish parvalbumin.

title_en: Scenic spot map network route planning method based on layering mode
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of route planning, in particular to a scenic spot map network route planning method based on a layering mode, which comprises the following steps: s1, acquiring a target scenic spot map, and carrying out data identification on the target scenic spot map so as to obtain map data, wherein the map data comprises scenic spot data and line segment data; s2, constructing an undirected graph based on the map data, taking the scenic spot data as nodes of the undirected graph, and taking the line segment data as edges of the corresponding nodes, so as to obtain a bus line model. The invention solves the problems that the line is infinite and cannot be exhausted or the line is too much and poor in performance, and simultaneously solves the problem that the planned line is not the optimal solution in the current situation caused by the sequence of the passing points to a certain extent.

title_en: Infrared array annular sensing device based on FPC
abstract_en: The application discloses an infrared array annular sensing device based on an FPC (flexible printed circuit), which relates to the technical field of sensors and comprises a flexible transmitting plate, a flexible receiving plate and an installation circular ring; the flexible transmitting board is provided with a transmitting circuit, and the flexible receiving board is provided with a receiving circuit; the flexible transmitting plates and the flexible receiving plates are distributed on the inner annular wall of the mounting circular ring at equal intervals in an annular mode, and transmitting circuits on the flexible transmitting plates and receiving circuits on the flexible receiving plates are arranged at intervals; the transmitting circuit and the receiving circuit are respectively and electrically connected with the detection main board circuit; the flexible transmitting board and the transmitting circuit thereon form a transmitting FPC, and the flexible receiving board and the receiving circuit thereon form a receiving FPC. By adopting the application, under the use requirements corresponding to the mounting rings with different diameters, the FPC with corresponding length is cut off and sleeved in the mounting ring, so that the universality of the product is improved.

title_en: Packaging module of integrated photoelectric detector on chip and preparation method
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a package module of an on-chip integrated photodetector and a method of manufacturing, wherein the package module includes: the shell comprises a protruding part, and the protruding part is arranged in the shell; a photodetector chip accommodated in the recess of the projection, the photodetector chip comprising: a substrate; a photodetector formed on the substrate, the photodetector being adapted to receive an optical signal from the input waveguide and convert the optical signal into an electromagnetic wave; the coplanar waveguide is formed on the substrate and is suitable for transmitting electromagnetic waves; a probe antenna formed on the substrate; and a low-pass filter adapted to effect reflection of electromagnetic waves by varying the impedance; and a rectangular waveguide configured to form a channel at a region of the protrusion corresponding to the probe antenna, the rectangular waveguide being adapted to cooperate with the probe antenna to change an electromagnetic field mode of the electromagnetic wave and output the electromagnetic wave.

title_en: Mechanical sealing performance test method integrating test data and theoretical model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mechanical sealing performance testing method for fusing test data and a theoretical model, wherein a first theoretical model can be established through a coupling action relation existing between related equations of the mechanical sealing structure, so that the fluid leakage quantity of the mechanical sealing structure can be obtained by adopting a finite element method and combining a multiple numerical iteration method, and the like; through the first theoretical model and the second theoretical model, the service life of the mechanical sealing structure and the performance parameters under certain specific moments can be accurately simulated based on the influence of physical factors to which the mechanical sealing structure is subjected during operation. The invention is widely applied to the technical field of mechanical sealing.

title_en: Water hammer testing arrangement
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of pipeline testing, in particular to a water hammer testing device, which comprises a test bench, wherein a water source box is arranged on one side of the test bench, a power driving part is arranged at the bottom of the test bench, the input end of the power driving part is communicated with the water source box, a first pipe frame is arranged at the top of the test bench, a first connecting pipe for connecting pipeline workpieces is connected to the first pipe frame, the output end of the power driving part is communicated with the first connecting pipe, a second pipe frame is arranged on the first pipe frame, a second connecting pipe is connected to the second pipe frame, a cavity is arranged in the second pipe frame, a dismounting part for connecting the pipeline workpieces is detachably connected to the second connecting pipe, and the second pipe frame is communicated with the water source box. The application has the effect of improving the water hammer test efficiency.

title_en: Hybrid distributed optical fiber sensing system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed optical fiber sensing system of a mixed Brillouin optical time domain analysis method and a phase sensitive optical time domain reflection method, which utilizes the Rayleigh scattering principle and the Brillouin frequency shift characteristic to sense so as to measure the temperature value, the tensile force and the vibration parameter of a to-be-measured point.

title_en: Mowing robot path planning method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a path planning method, a device, equipment and a medium for a mowing robot, wherein the method comprises the following steps: calculating and determining a working area of the mowing robot based on coordinates corresponding to the first positioning point, the second positioning point and the third positioning point, and calculating and determining a first working route track in the working area based on the working area of the mowing robot; calculating and determining a first safe obstacle avoidance path of the mowing robot by adopting a depth-first search algorithm based on the first operation route track, the position of the mowing robot and the obstacle information; performing secondary planning optimization on the first safety obstacle avoidance path by adopting a sectional step-by-step construction algorithm so as to determine a second safety obstacle avoidance path; determining motion information of the mowing robot, generating a second operation route track based on the second safety obstacle avoidance path and the motion information of the mowing robot, and driving the mowing robot to perform weeding operation. The application improves the flexibility and the robustness of the path in the face of dynamic change and complex narrow scenes.

title_en: Aerosol temperature measuring device and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an aerosol temperature measuring device and a method thereof, and relates to the technical field of temperature measuring jigs, wherein the aerosol temperature measuring device comprises an air inlet pipe, a communicating pipe, a suction pump and a base, a positioning mechanism is arranged between the air inlet pipe and the communicating pipe, and a measuring mechanism is arranged on the base; the positioning mechanism comprises a connecting block, a through hole is formed in the connecting block, a sealing part and a positioning part are arranged in the connecting block, the positioning mechanism has the advantages that the practicability is high, the piston on the guide rod can carry out reciprocating push-pull motion in the measuring pipe, under the action of air pressure, aerosol flowing in the communicating pipe can be sucked into the measuring pipe, then the aerosol is transmitted to the gas thermometer through a capillary tube communicated with the measuring pipe to carry out temperature measurement, the temperature of the aerosol can be displayed on the gas thermometer, and along with the reciprocating motion of the piston, the temperature of the aerosol can be monitored by the gas thermometer in real time, and the characteristics of convenience for workers to grasp the temperature change of the aerosol in real time are achieved.

title_en: Emergency power grid line transmission fault monitoring system with automatic adjusting function
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency power grid line transmission fault monitoring system with an automatic adjusting function, which belongs to the technical field of power grid monitoring and comprises the following components: the power transmission module is used for adjusting the power transmission load required by the emergency power grid line; the data acquisition module is used for acquiring the associated parameters during the operation of the emergency power grid line; the comprehensive processing platform is used for analyzing and processing according to the acquired associated parameters so as to generate a risk index, and judging the risk condition of the emergency power grid line according to the risk index condition; and the adjusting module is used for automatically adjusting the transmission load of the power transmission module according to the acquired risk index. According to the risk index condition of the power transmission line, the method and the system can be used for carrying out comprehensive analysis by combining the length of the power transmission line and the number of supplied power users, so that the quantity of the power transmission charges can be accurately adjusted, and the power utilization and the power transmission are ensured to be normal.

title_en: Battery health state prediction method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of batteries, and provides a battery health state prediction method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein battery data are acquired; clustering battery data of different batteries according to the battery use degree to obtain a plurality of clusters; separating charging data and discharging data in the battery data of each battery to obtain the charging data and discharging data of each battery; training and predicting battery data corresponding to batteries belonging to the same cluster through a corresponding target prediction model, performing deep learning on charging data through a first prediction model, outputting a first intermediate prediction result, performing deep learning on discharging data input through a second prediction model, and outputting a second intermediate prediction result; fusing the first intermediate prediction result and the second intermediate prediction result by using a linear regression algorithm to obtain a target prediction result of the battery health state; and obtaining a more accurate battery health state prediction result.

title_en: Current automation control method for power system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of distribution system load distribution, in particular to a current automation control method for a power system, which comprises the steps of firstly obtaining substation current data and substation voltage data; the time sequence change of the power obtained by combining the current and the voltage in the current time period and the change trend of the current in the current time period are combined, and a low-load-demand transformer substation and a high-load-demand transformer substation are screened out from the transformer substations; according to the power consumption change of the low-load-demand transformer substation and the overall current and voltage, the corresponding current to be distributed is calculated; calculating the peak time deviation and the distribution current corresponding to the high-load-demand transformer stations with different power consumption by combining the total power to be distributed obtained by the current to be distributed; the accuracy of current load distribution of the power system according to the distribution current and the current to be distributed is higher.

title_en: Automatic detection device for cutterhead of pulverizer
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of flour mills, in particular to an automatic detection device for a cutterhead of a flour mill, which comprises a supporting frame, an alignment part, a detection part and a mobile station, wherein the middle side of the supporting frame is fixedly connected with a supporting plate, the upper end of the supporting plate is rotatably connected with a rotating disc, the upper side of the rotating disc is fixedly connected with a limit column, the upper end of the rotating disc is fixedly connected with a rubber ring, the rubber ring supports a cutterhead body, and the limit column limits the cutterhead body; the automatic detection device comprises a support frame, a first movable plate and a second movable plate, wherein a pair of movable moving plates are arranged on two sides of the inner side of the support frame, a centering part is arranged on the upper side of the first movable plate, a detection part is arranged on the upper side of the second movable plate, the lower ends of the first movable plate and the second movable plate are connected with a movable platform, and the movable platform is used for driving the centering part and the detection part to synchronously move.

title_en: Method for testing lithium salt in lithium battery electrolyte
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for testing lithium salt in lithium battery electrolyte, and relates to the technical field of lithium salt testing methods. A method for testing lithium salt in lithium battery electrolyte comprises the following steps; s1, qualitative: performing an X-ray fluorescence spectrum test on the lithium battery electrolyte; selecting a spectrogram according to an X-ray fluorescence spectrum test result, adding a deuteration reagent into the lithium battery electrolyte, and then performing nuclear magnetic resonance spectrum test to qualify lithium salt in the lithium battery electrolyte; s2, quantification: and uniformly mixing the internal standard with the lithium battery electrolyte sample and the solvent, performing nuclear magnetic resonance spectrum test, and calculating the content of lithium salt in the lithium battery electrolyte sample through a formula. The testing method comprises the steps of qualitative and quantitative, wherein the qualitative is carried out firstly, and then the quantitative is carried out; qualitative and quantitative results of lithium salt in the lithium battery electrolyte can be obtained rapidly, no complex pretreatment process is needed, the operation is simple, the detection speed is high, the analysis time is short, and the accuracy of the detection result is high.

title_en: Storage battery remote monitoring system and method based on data analysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of storage battery monitoring, in particular to a storage battery remote monitoring system and method based on data analysis, comprising a terminal data acquisition module, a data discrete value analysis module, a critical electricity value determination module, a discrimination limit value analysis module and a terminal response module; the terminal data acquisition module is used for acquiring user use data recorded by the connection terminal of the riding equipment based on energy supply of the storage battery; the data discrete value analysis module is used for extracting all mobilization events recorded by each monitoring station in the monitoring period and corresponding user use data and analyzing the data discrete value of the monitoring station; the critical electricity value determining module is used for analyzing mileage data corresponding to the use of the storage battery in the effective monitoring site to determine a critical electricity value; the distinguishing limit value analysis module is used for determining distinguishing limit values of the target riding equipment corresponding to the monitoring site based on the data discrete values; the terminal response module is used for responding to the user terminal in a differentiated mode based on the size relation.

title_en: CsMnCl3Preparation method and application of microcrystalline material
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application relates to a preparation method and application of a CsMnCl  3  micron crystal material, belonging to the technical field of halogen ion detection. The preparation method of the CsMnCl  3  micron crystal material provided by the embodiment of the application comprises the following steps: s1, dissolving a manganese source in a halogen acid solution, and performing ultrasonic dissolution to obtain a first mixed solution; s2, adding a cesium source into the first mixed solution, heating and stirring to react, and cooling to room temperature after the reaction is completed to obtain a second mixed solution; and S3, centrifuging, washing and drying the second mixed solution to obtain CsMnCl  3  microns. The CsMnCl  3  with excellent luminous performance is prepared by introducing halogen ions to be detected in the presence of CsMnCl  3  and PbC  4 H 6 O 4 ·3H 2  O, and quantitatively analyzing the halogen ions through a fluorescence test of a reaction product.

title_en: Method for measuring internal volume of lipid nano-carrier drug
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of medicine analysis, and particularly relates to a method for measuring the internal volume of a lipid nano-carrier medicine. The method is an electron paramagnetic resonance detection method, wherein a paramagnetic reagent used in the method is perfluoro-2, 5-diazahexane-2, 5-ethoxy, and a stretcher is potassium chromium oxalate. The method provided by the invention can accurately and effectively measure the internal volume of the drug-loaded liposome with strong fluidity.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle photovoltaic power station terrain three-dimensional mapping method and control system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional topographic mapping method and a control system for an unmanned aerial vehicle photovoltaic power station, and relates to the technical field of three-dimensional topographic mapping of photovoltaic power stations, wherein the three-dimensional topographic mapping method comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle plane route planning module, a photographed picture screening module, an unmanned aerial vehicle posture adjusting module and a three-dimensional model creating module; according to the scheme, the unmanned aerial vehicle flight route is planned through the photovoltaic power station field, so that the unmanned aerial vehicle can shoot the most comprehensive photovoltaic power station field photo under the minimum path, the photo shot is screened and analyzed in real time, whether the photo needs to be taken in a supplementing mode is judged according to the exposure degree and the definition of the photo, a large number of exposure photos and fuzzy photos exist after the unmanned aerial vehicle flight is finished, and three-dimensional modeling mapping is conducted according to the shot photo in the later period.

title_en: Multi-beam underwater three-dimensional panorama construction method and system based on fusion image features
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-beam underwater three-dimensional panorama construction method and system based on fusion image features, and relates to the field of underwater scene three-dimensional construction. The multi-beam sounding system solves the problem that the traditional multi-beam sounding system only focuses on the landform information and does not consider the water body target information. The invention provides the following scheme, which comprises the following steps: processing the underwater information data to obtain multi-beam depth data; the depth data are used as underwater topography depth data and stored, the underwater topography depth data are removed from the multi-beam depth data, and the corresponding depth of the highest energy point in the beam is extracted from the residual data to be used as water body data; fusing underwater topography depth data and water body data, and drawing the fused underwater topography depth data and water body data in an image; splicing underwater topography depth data, water body data and multiple Ping sonar data in a single Ping image to obtain a complete underwater three-dimensional panoramic image; and completing the three-dimensional on-line construction of the underwater panorama. The method is suitable for the field of large-range autonomous detection under shallow water.

title_en: Lead frame feeding and discharging detection system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of lead frame detection and discloses a lead frame feeding and discharging detection system, which comprises a multidimensional sensing unit, wherein the multidimensional sensing unit comprises an optical unit, an acoustic unit and an electromagnetic sensing unit, and the multidimensional sensing unit is used for detecting the comprehensive state of a lead frame; the intelligent recognition processing unit is connected with the multidimensional sensing unit at the input end and comprises a deep learning algorithm unit which is used for analyzing and recognizing sensing data. The data is rapidly and accurately analyzed and identified through the deep learning algorithm, the detection parameters are automatically adjusted to adapt to environmental changes, the detection accuracy and reliability are remarkably improved, meanwhile, the interactive user interface and the efficient energy management scheme of the system not only improve the convenience and flexibility of user operation, but also realize energy conservation, emission reduction and cost effectiveness, and ensure the safety of data and operation.

title_en: Bonding wire batch test tool
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of bonding wire testing tools, in particular to a bonding wire batch testing tool. The device comprises a supporting part and two testing parts rotationally connected with the supporting part, wherein the testing part comprises a driving motor and a plurality of clamping assemblies arranged in an array manner, the plurality of clamping assemblies are arranged along the outer array of the driving motor, and the distance between the two testing parts is gradually increased from top to bottom; one of the test parts is connected with a plurality of auxiliary detection rods, and each auxiliary detection rod is positioned between two opposite clamping assemblies. According to the application, the bonding wire is clamped through the two symmetrically arranged test parts, the bonding wire is tensioned gradually in the rotation process of the test parts, the detection of the tensile strength of the bonding wire is realized, and the test efficiency of the bonding wire is improved.

title_en: Displacement monitoring method, device, equipment and medium for earth-rock dykes and dams
abstract_en: The application relates to a displacement monitoring method, a device, equipment and a medium of a soil and stone dam, wherein after first position information of a target center point in an image is extracted by utilizing a target detection means, an ellipse fitting means is introduced to relieve the problem of inaccurate displacement monitoring caused by coordinate jumping of the first position information, namely, second position information of the target center in the image is fitted by utilizing the first position information and adopting ellipse fitting, so that the actual position of the target center point is obtained by further two means, the more accurate actual position of the target center point is obtained by utilizing the position information, and finally, the displacement of the soil and stone dam is calculated by the deviation between the actual positions of two frames of images at different moments. The method has high precision and generalization, and small calculated amount, and can be used for deployment in edge equipment.

title_en: Knee point sampling circuit and method for feedback voltage of secondary winding of switching power supply
abstract_en: The invention discloses a knee point sampling circuit for sampling knee point values of feedback voltage of an auxiliary winding of a switching power supply, which comprises the following components: the voltage offset circuit, the delay circuit, the comparison circuit and the sampling output circuit. The voltage offset circuit is used for receiving the auxiliary winding feedback voltage, offsetting the auxiliary winding feedback voltage and outputting the offset auxiliary winding feedback voltage. The delay circuit is used for receiving the feedback voltage of the auxiliary winding, delaying the feedback voltage of the auxiliary winding and outputting the delayed feedback voltage of the auxiliary winding; the comparison circuit is used for comparing the offset auxiliary winding feedback voltage with the delayed auxiliary winding feedback voltage and outputting a comparison signal; the knee point sampling circuit is used for sampling the delayed auxiliary winding feedback voltage based on the comparison signal and outputting a knee point sampling signal representing a knee point value of the auxiliary winding feedback voltage. In this way, accurate sampling of the knee point value of the auxiliary winding feedback voltage of the switching power supply can be achieved.

title_en: Portable sampler for Gobi soil stratified sampling
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of soil sample collection, in particular to a portable sampler for gobi soil stratified sampling, which comprises a central column, a positioning bracket, a shallow soil sampling assembly and a deep soil sampling assembly, wherein the shallow soil sampling assembly and the deep soil sampling assembly both comprise three drilling collectors, sampling windows are formed in the pipe wall of an outer layer column, a sliding rail mechanism is arranged on the drilling collectors and is connected with the central column in a shaft mode through a sliding block, a central shaft is further arranged on the inner side of the central column and is in tooth transmission with a rotating shaft, a special-shaped lifting block is arranged in the central column, and the special-shaped lifting block is connected with the three drilling collectors below through connecting rods. According to the invention, a heavy and complex hydraulic system is not required to be equipped, multi-point distribution collection can be carried out on shallow and deep soil respectively, each soil sample can be stored independently, the accuracy of subsequent sample analysis is ensured, and the soil can be conveniently backfilled after sampling, so that the method is more environment-friendly compared with the traditional mode.

title_en: Welding quality detection equipment for automobile heater
