abstract_en: The invention discloses welding quality detection equipment for an automobile heater, which comprises a base, a driving mechanism and an air pump, wherein the base is provided with a supporting surface capable of sealing and blocking a notch at one end of a plurality of through grooves far away from a second shell, the base is provided with a plurality of first vent holes, the first vent holes are in one-to-one correspondence and are communicated with the through grooves on the first shell on the base, the air pump is arranged below the base through the driving mechanism, and an air nozzle of the air pump can extend into one of the first vent holes to charge air into an assembly cavity through the first vent holes and the through grooves; the welding quality detection equipment provided by the invention can be used together with welding equipment, and can be used for sequentially detecting welding positions after welding is completed, so that the production efficiency of a heater is improved, the locating piece arranged by the device can be used for locating the second shell during welding, and the assembly cavity can be divided into two parts during detection to reduce the detection inflation quantity, so that the detection efficiency is improved.

title_en: Millimeter wave radar antenna calibration method based on statistical distribution
abstract_en: The invention relates to a statistically distributed millimeter wave radar antenna calibration method, which comprises the following steps: performing antenna calibration on a large number of radars in a darkroom to obtain antenna calibration data of the radar in the large number; carrying out statistical distribution fitting on the antenna calibration data to obtain a certain statistical value (such as a mean value) of each calibration data; writing the statistic value of the calibration data into a radar to be shipped, performing secondary calibration on a corner reflector in front of a darkroom (aligning azimuth and pitching), observing whether the azimuth of the corner reflector deflects, and writing the deflection value into a corresponding radar if the azimuth deflects; in the subsequent application, subtracting the corresponding deflection value from the target azimuth measured by the radar is the actual azimuth value of the target; the millimeter wave radar antenna calibration application is simplified, convenient and quick, and the millimeter wave radar calibration and production efficiency are improved.

title_en: Channel addition-based environmental noise suppression circuit, method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application provides an environment noise suppression circuit, a method and application thereof based on channel addition, comprising a plurality of SAPDs, a plurality of sampling circuits and a plurality of sampling circuits, wherein the SAPDs are used for outputting current pulses, and the current pulses are input to an AND gate after being shaped into positive pulses with set coincidence width; the AND gate is used for overlapping the outputs of the channels formed by the SPAD, and performing pulse superposition detection, wherein the pulse superposition detection records how many channels have signals within the set superposition width time and outputs signals with different superposition depths to the selector; a selector for selecting a signal for setting the coincidence depth to trigger the TDC; the method comprises the steps of setting the superposition width to be related to the arrival time range of signal photons, wherein the quicker the arrival rate of the signal photons is, the smaller the superposition width is; the overlapping depth is the number of channels with pulses in the same time period. The application can effectively reduce the detection probability of the ambient photons and improve the signal to noise ratio.

title_en: Thin reservoir prediction method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: According to the prediction method, the prediction device, the electronic equipment and the storage medium of the thin reservoir, the earthquake rock physical model of the complex oil-gas-containing reservoir to be predicted is constructed by responding to the prediction instruction; determining frequency-dependent fluid sensitivity parameters according to the seismic petrophysical model; combining the frequency-dependent characteristics of the elastic parameters of the complex reservoir, and establishing a pre-stack inversion objective function of the frequency-dependent fluid sensitive parameters corresponding to the frequency-dependent fluid sensitive parameters; developing a frequency-dependent fluid sensitive parameter pre-stack seismic inversion method under a Bayesian theory framework, solving a frequency-dependent fluid sensitive parameter pre-stack inversion objective function by combining the constraint of logging information, and extracting a frequency-dependent fluid factor; the frequency-dependent fluid factor is used to predict a thin reservoir. By means of Bayesian theory and a frequency-dependent fluid sensitive parameter pre-stack seismic inversion method of logging information, model test results are summarized from inversion results, so that gas-containing sandstone, water-containing sandstone and mudstone can be distinguished, and accurate thin reservoir prediction is achieved.

title_en: Urban low-lying road section ponding monitoring method based on neural network model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of urban waterlogging management, in particular to a method for monitoring accumulated water in urban low-lying road sections based on a neural network model. The water inflow is estimated at the current moment, the water inflow is estimated at the predicted moment and the water inflow is estimated at the predicted moment of the low-lying road section, and the water inflow is input into a trained BP neural network model for predicting a predicted increase water line of the low-lying area. Unlike the traditional prediction algorithm which takes rainfall as prediction information only, the method considers rainfall, rainfall error, associated road section overflow, low-lying road section drainage and associated road section drainage, and the constructed neural network model is more reasonable and higher in accuracy aiming at the actual situation. Meanwhile, the actual drainage quantity of the associated road section is calculated through the area of the drainage outlet, so that the overflow quantity of the associated road section to the low-lying road section can be accurately calculated; errors exist between the rainfall of the weather forecast and the real data, and the prediction accuracy is further improved by fitting an error function.

title_en: Current precision detection method, system, equipment and medium based on BMS communication
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a system, equipment and a medium for detecting current precision of a vehicle-mounted battery in the technical field of electric automobiles, wherein the method comprises the following steps: step S10, after connection is established between the charging pile and the electric automobile, handshake interaction is carried out between the charging pile and the electric automobile; step S20, the charging pile sets a detection duration, a sampling period, a detection condition and a charging current with a fixed size; the sampling period is smaller than the detection duration; step S30, the charging pile charges a battery of the electric automobile based on the charging current, and the charging pile detects a first current value of the battery based on the detection duration, the sampling period and the detection condition and communicates with a BMS of the electric automobile to obtain a second current value detected by the BMS; and S40, the charging pile foundation calculates the current precision on each first current value and each second current value. The invention has the advantages that: the accuracy of current accuracy detection is greatly improved.

title_en: Channel detection-assisted satellite navigation receiver observed quantity anomaly detection system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a channel detection-assisted satellite navigation receiver observed quantity abnormal detection system, which comprises a channel detection module and an observed quantity detection module, wherein the channel detection module is used for detecting the observed quantity abnormal detection of a satellite navigation receiver; the channel detection module performs preliminary detection on the distortion degree of each satellite signal by utilizing the early, instant and late correlation values generated by the internal tracking loop of the receiver in the processing channel of each satellite signal of the receiver, divides the detection result into three categories of normal, possible abnormality and abnormality, estimates the abnormality probability for the possible abnormality observed quantity, and transmits the classification result and the abnormality probability thereof to the observed quantity detection module along with the corresponding pseudo range; the observed quantity detection module is arranged in the receiver positioning resolving part, the channel detection result is used as prior information, the observed quantity is divided into a normal set and a waiting queue, the abnormal probability is arranged from small to large, the observed quantity detection module receives the pseudo-range observed quantity and the mark thereof, and the preliminary detection result is used as the prior information to further detect and reject the abnormal pseudo-range observed quantity.

title_en: Power detection system for medium-length wave communication
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power detection system for medium-long wave communication, which comprises a directional coupling circuit, a peak detection circuit, an isolation circuit, a differential amplification circuit and an in-phase amplification circuit, wherein the peak detection circuit is connected with the directional coupling circuit; the peak detection circuit comprises a forward power detection circuit and a reverse power detection circuit; the input end of the isolation circuit is connected with the output end of the forward power detection circuit, the in-phase output end of the isolation circuit is connected with the in-phase input end of the differential amplification circuit, and the anti-phase output end of the isolation circuit is connected with the anti-phase input end of the differential amplification circuit; the output end of the differential amplifying circuit is connected with the non-inverting input end of the non-inverting amplifying circuit. The power detection system of the invention avoids the problem of influencing signal transmission due to measurement, can ensure the stability and accuracy of power acquisition, and can also avoid the influence of factors such as failure of a front-stage circuit, unstable signal to be detected and the like on the main control board.

title_en: Shear test device suitable for various composite boards and use method
abstract_en: The invention provides a shear test device suitable for various composite boards and a use method thereof, wherein the shear test device suitable for various composite boards comprises a clamp main body, a rolling bar, an adjustable sliding block, an eccentric wheel adjusting mechanism and a locking mechanism, through optimizing the structure of the clamp and adopting the designs of the rolling bars, the eccentric wheel adjusting mechanism, the locking mechanism and the like, the rolling bars are designed on the two sides contacted with the sample, so that the original surface contact of the sample and the shear test device is changed into line contact, and the influence of friction force on test results is greatly reduced; the design of an automatic eccentric wheel locking structure comprising an eccentric wheel adjusting mechanism and a locking mechanism is added, so that the sample holding process is simple and quick, and the working efficiency is greatly improved; meanwhile, the multifunctional performance of the device is realized by changing the movable clamping plate, and the device can adapt to shearing tests with different standards and sizes, so that the application range and the value of the device are improved.

title_en: Urban land utilization decision-making method considering economic benefit and environmental benefit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a urban land utilization decision-making method taking economic benefit and environmental benefit into consideration, which comprises the following steps: s1, inversion of surface temperature; s2, calculating surface runoff; s3, based on the surface temperature inversion result in the step S1 and the surface runoff calculation result in the step S2, land is optimized by balancing cooling, waterlogging reduction and yield increase; s4, identifying a urbanization stage; and S5, matching the urban stage in the step S4 based on the classification result of the optimization result in the step S3, and determining an optimization strategy according to the matching result. The urban land utilization decision method taking the economic benefit and the environmental benefit into consideration greatly simplifies the complex trade-off relation between the environmental benefit and the economic benefit through space subdivision and mathematical statistics, and realizes the intelligent algorithm trade-off optimization of three targets of cooling, waterlogging reduction and yield increase.

title_en: Low-cost skin sensor and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a low-cost skin sensor and a preparation method thereof, wherein a transfer printing material which is easy to dissolve in water is used as a base material layer, a conductive layer based on functional ink is compounded on the base material layer, and a protective layer is compounded on the conductive layer, so that the skin sensor is prepared by adopting a simplified and improved water transfer printing technology. The invention combines safe and biological friendly materials, and realizes the low-cost and rapid manufacturing of the electronic tattoo skin sensor. The method is simple and easy to implement, does not need professional equipment, can quickly generate personalized patterns, and is easy for mass production. The invention not only reduces the production cost of the electronic tattoo skin sensor, but also expands the application range of the electronic tattoo skin sensor in the fields of personalized decoration and man-machine interaction, and meets the dual requirements of users on individuation and functionality. The technology can be closely attached to the skin and provide real-time biofeedback, so that huge application potential is shown in the fields of man-machine interaction, wearable technology, health monitoring and the like.

title_en: Spectral line bending correction method and correction system
abstract_en: The spectral line bending correction method and the correction system provided by the application utilize a monochromator to output monochromatic light with a certain wavelength, the monochromatic light is subjected to spectral curve imaging through an area array detector, and a digital quantized DN value is output, the DN value output by the area array detector is used as an element of the two-dimensional matrix to construct the two-dimensional matrix so as to represent the spectral curve with the wavelength, the element on the two-dimensional matrix is moved so as to enable the spectral curve to be closest to a straight line and record the arrangement mode of the two-dimensional matrix, the wavelength of the monochromatic light is replaced, the steps are repeated, the arrangement modes of matrixes corresponding to different wavelengths are recorded, and each pixel only needs to record one parameter as the matrix element only moves in one dimension, so that the parameters are solidified into an FPGA program, the spectral line bending correction on a chip is realized, and the spectral data application efficiency is improved.

title_en: Impact test frame device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of impact test devices, and discloses an impact test rack device, which comprises: the support and the rotating sleeve, the test piece supporting plate and the cover piece test piece arranged on the support are matched with the guide sleeve on the support, so that the support of the impact weight is realized, and when the impact weight falls down freely, the guide sleeve is used for guiding the impact weight and acts on the cover piece test piece arranged on the test piece supporting plate. When the lifting device is used for lifting the impact weight to the upper end face of the guide sleeve along the U-shaped groove, the support and free falling of the impact weight are operated by the rotating sleeve, so that dangerous operation of personnel at high places is avoided, the impact weight moves up and down along the U-shaped groove in the guide sleeve, the safety of the whole-course test is improved, and the lifting device has the advantages of being simple in structure, convenient to operate and the like, and the test efficiency is improved.

title_en: Preparation method and application of photoelectrochemistry self-powered sensor coupling photo-thermal effect
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a photoelectrochemistry self-powered sensor coupling a photo-thermal effect and application of the photoelectrochemistry self-powered sensor in enrofloxacin detection. The invention combines the photo-thermal effect with the photoelectrochemical detection analysis technology, utilizes the photo-thermal effect of poly, 3, 4-ethylenedioxythiophene (PEDOT) to make the poly, 3, 4-ethylenedioxythiophene (PEDOT) become a local heater of a sensing electrode, and simultaneously combines the photosensitive material strontium titanate (SrTiO  3 ), and then modifies chitosan and enrofloxacin aptamer on the electrode. The aptamer is split type aptamer, is a good recognition element, and can realize the specificity detection of enrofloxacin. Based on the above, a photoelectrochemistry self-powered sensor coupling the photo-thermal effect is constructed. The sensor prepared by the invention has visible light response and photo-thermal effect, has wider detection range, higher sensitivity and lower detection limit, and has important significance for detecting trace enrofloxacin.

title_en: Flood discharge gate detection device and detection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood discharge gate detection device and a detection method, which relate to the technical field of gate detection, wherein the device comprises: the installing frame is arranged at one side of the flood discharge gate in parallel; the displacement mechanism is arranged in the installation frame and is controlled by the control mechanism to vertically move up and down; the detection mechanism is arranged at the tail end of the displacement mechanism, faces the face of the flood discharge gate and is used for acquiring and acquiring speed information, vibration information and surface image information of the flood discharge gate; the communication mechanism is respectively connected with the detection mechanism and the processing mechanism and is used for transmitting the speed information, the vibration information and the surface image information of the flood discharge gate to the processing mechanism; and carrying out safety detection of the flood discharge gate through the processing mechanism according to the speed information, the vibration information and the surface image information of the flood discharge gate, and displaying the detection result. The invention can acquire the speed information and the vibration information of the flood discharge gate through the detection mechanism, thereby realizing the detection of the speed information and the vibration information of the flood discharge gate.

title_en: Automatic deviation rectifying method and system for anti-collision beam of hydraulic ship lift
abstract_en: The application provides an automatic deviation rectifying method and system for an anti-collision beam of a hydraulic ship lift, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring operation mode information of an anti-collision beam of the hydraulic ship lift, wherein the operation mode information comprises position information and lifting information of the anti-collision beam; in the lifting or descending process of the anti-collision beam, detecting the heights of the left side and the right side of the anti-collision beam in real time, and calculating the deviation value of the heights of the two sides; when the deviation value is larger than a preset deviation correction threshold value, judging the magnitude relation between the deviation value and the preset deviation judgment value; and determining the adjusting voltage of the input voltage of the proportional amplifying plate of the corresponding hydraulic pump station at the two sides by combining the position information, the lifting information and the comparison result of the heights of the two sides, and operating the adjusting voltage so that the control voltage at one side with a shorter displacement distance at the left side and the right side is larger than the control voltage at the other side. The method corrects the deviation rectifying logic in the lifting process of the anti-collision beam, and the deviation values of the two sides of the anti-collision beam in the lifting process can be reduced by adjusting the pump station control voltage.

title_en: Ceramic resistor pressure sensor
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of pressure sensors and discloses a ceramic resistor pressure sensor, which comprises a sensor body, wherein the sensor body comprises a body, a connecting piece and a shell, the connecting piece comprises a prism, one end of the prism is provided with a threaded column, the connecting piece is an integral piece, the connecting piece is made of stainless steel materials or aluminum alloy materials, a sealing ring is sleeved on the outer side of the joint of the prism and the threaded column, after the connecting piece is mounted on a workpiece, the sealing ring is pressed on a mounting surface by the end face of the prism, the sealing of the joint is realized, the shell is mounted at the other end of the prism in a matched manner, and a pressure chip and a circuit board are mounted in the shell. According to the invention, the pressure chip and the circuit board are arranged in the shell, so that an integral structure is formed, the connecting piece and the shell are conveniently and rapidly spliced, and compared with the existing method that the pressure chip is arranged in the connecting piece, the assembly and the placement of the shell are more convenient.

title_en: Transformer vibration analysis method
abstract_en: A vibration analysis method of a transformer comprises the steps of collecting vibration signals of a plurality of positions on the surface of a transformer box body, and carrying out low-pass filtering and fast Fourier transformation on the signals to extract frequency spectrum distribution in a specific frequency band; constructing initial features through vibration spectrum vectors, wherein the features reflect the relative magnitudes of vibration amplitudes of different positions at the same frequency; applying Box-Cox transformation to the initial characteristics to enable the initial characteristics to approximately meet normal distribution, and forming intrinsic characteristics; carrying out outlier identification on the intrinsic characteristics by utilizing the Leida criterion, and distributing scores for the intrinsic characteristics of each frequency component; and integrating all the intrinsic characteristic scores of each sample, and calculating an integrated score so as to judge the mechanical structure state of the transformer. The method can effectively identify internal mechanical faults, early warn disastrous fault risks in time, improve the reliability of power supply of the system, have the advantages of low cost and high efficiency, are not influenced by external excitation, and improve the accuracy and the robustness of state monitoring.

title_en: Shock-resistant pressure transmitter
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-seismic pressure transmitter, and relates to the field of pressure detection. The pressure sensor aims to solve the problem that the pressure sensor in the pressure transmitter is abnormal in measurement due to the fact that the pressure in a pipeline is changed in the working process of the existing pressure transmitter. The pressure measuring device comprises a pressure measuring channel, wherein one side of the pressure measuring channel is communicated with a first liquid guide pipe, the first liquid guide pipe is fixedly connected with a connecting frame, the upper side of the connecting frame is fixedly connected with a connecting ring, the connecting ring is in threaded connection with a second liquid guide pipe, the lower side of the connecting ring is provided with a first sliding ring which is in sealing fit with the inner side of the connecting ring, and the lower side of the first sliding ring is in sealing fit with the upper side of the first liquid guide pipe. According to the pressure sensor, the influence of pressure fluctuation in the pipeline on the pressure measuring element in the pressure transmitter is reduced by buffering the pressure in the pipeline, so that the service life of the pressure measuring element in the pressure transmitter is prolonged, the accuracy of measured data is ensured, and the vibration resistance of the pressure measuring element is realized.

title_en: Hydraulic oil particle pollutant detection device and method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of oil detection, in particular to a hydraulic oil particle pollutant detection device and a method, wherein the hydraulic oil particle pollutant detection device comprises a machine body and a shading particle sensor, the surface of the machine body is provided with an adjusting component, the surface of the machine body is fixedly connected with a protective cover, the anti-sedimentation device is characterized in that an anti-sedimentation mechanism is arranged below the protective cover, a controller and a pump body are fixedly connected to the top of the machine body, a liquid inlet pipe is communicated with the pump body, an electric piston cylinder is fixedly connected to the surface of the machine body, and a shading particle sensor is arranged at the top of the electric piston cylinder. The device is when detecting the hydraulic oil in the detection bottle, can adjust the spiral pipe and be located the position of detection bottle to at the testing process, the hydraulic oil in the detection bottle rocks, prevents that granule in the hydraulic oil from being in the different degree of depth positions in the detection bottle, improves the accuracy of follow-up testing result to hydraulic oil.

title_en: ZnO/TiO-based2Preparation method of chipless RFID ammonia gas detection sensor of nanocomposite, passive ammonia gas detection sensor of chipless RFID ammonia gas detection sensor, and indoor ammonia gas detection system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a chipless RFID ammonia gas detection sensor based on ZnO/TiO  2  nanocomposite, which belongs to the technical field of radio frequency sensors, and comprises the steps of preparing a microstrip patch antenna, loading ZnO/TiO  2  nanocomposite on the microstrip patch antenna, and enabling the ZnO/TiO  2  nanocomposite to have larger specific surface area, so that the sensitivity and response speed of the sensor can be improved during ammonia gas detection; the invention also provides a sensor prepared by the preparation method, wherein the microstrip patch in the sensor is provided with a rectangular groove, and the connection part of the microstrip patch and the feeder unit is provided with a metal short circuit, so that the sensitivity of the sensor is improved, and the response speed of the sensor is accelerated; on the other hand, the invention also discloses a system and a method for constructing indoor ammonia gas detection by the sensor, which are used for detecting the ammonia gas, and the sensor has better robustness in detecting the ammonia gas by improving the sensitivity and the response speed of the sensor.

title_en: Method for measuring motion gesture of lower limbs of automobile collision dummy
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of automobile crash dummy, and discloses a method for measuring the motion gesture of lower limbs of an automobile crash dummy. In a real vehicle collision test, continuously acquiring lower limb images of a vehicle collision dummy in a collision process; identifying an edge contour in each lower limb image; sampling a plurality of points on the edge profile for fitting to respectively obtain a thigh outside expression, a thigh inside expression, a shank outside expression and a shank inside expression; determining the bone position, the joint position and the bone angle of the lower limb; and correlating the bone positions of the lower limbs, the joint positions and the included angles at two ends of the joints in the plurality of lower limb images according to time sequence to form a series of two-dimensional human body rod-shaped model diagrams, wherein the two-dimensional human body rod-shaped model diagrams represent the motion change condition of the lower limbs and solve the problem that the frame connecting points are difficult to directly measure due to the shielding of the skin of a dummy in the prior art.

title_en: Human body weight measuring method, measuring device, body weight scale and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a human body weight measuring method, a measuring device, a body weight scale and a storage medium, wherein the human body weight measuring method is applied to the body weight scale, the body weight scale is provided with a thermal imager, and the human body weight measuring method comprises the following steps: when the user is detected to stand on the weighing scale, collecting the initial weight of the user; controlling a thermal imager to acquire a current whole-body dressing thermal imaging image of a user; determining the dressing weight of the user according to the current whole-body dressing thermal imaging image; the current net weight of the user is determined based on the initial weight and the dressing weight. According to the method, the net weight of the user is calculated according to the initial weight of the user acquired by the weighing scale and the dressing weight of the user acquired based on the thermal imager, and the dressing weight of the user is removed from the initial weight, so that the net weight of the user has higher data accuracy, and the measurement accuracy of measuring the human body weight of the user is improved.

title_en: Device and method for detecting multi-characteristic performance of heat-shrinkable film
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of heat-shrinkable film detection equipment, in particular to a multi-characteristic performance detection device and a detection method for a heat-shrinkable film, comprising a frame, wherein the middle part of the frame is provided with a conveying mechanism, the conveying mechanism comprises a chain transmission assembly and a clamping and fixing assembly, the chain transmission assembly is provided with a plurality of uniformly distributed connecting blocks I, the first fixed plate of the clamping and fixing assembly is fixedly connected with the first connecting block, and the upper side of the frame is sequentially provided with an electrostatic detection mechanism, a defect detection mechanism, a puncture resistance detection mechanism and a tensile resistance detection mechanism which span the conveying mechanism, wherein the puncture resistance detection mechanism comprises a puncture assembly and a cutting assembly. The device and the method for detecting the multi-characteristic performance of the heat-shrinkable film can detect various performances of the heat-shrinkable film on the same equipment at the same time, shorten the detection time of the finished product of the heat-shrinkable film and improve the working efficiency.

title_en: Black tea fermentation degree judging method based on 3D-SwinT-CNN
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of food engineering, and discloses a black tea fermentation degree judging method based on 3D-SwinT-CNN, which comprises the following steps: s1: collecting and preprocessing hyperspectral images of fermented black tea; s2: designing a 3D Swin Transformer module; s3: designing a 3D-SwinT-CNN model; s4: algorithm model performance comparison. According to the invention, the key space-spectrum combined characteristic and the global characteristic of the three-dimensional hyperspectral image are captured by using the improved 3D-SwinT-CNN, so that the fermentation degree of the black tea is judged; compared with the traditional deep learning algorithm, the 3D-SwinT-CNN algorithm has the advantages of small calculated amount of three-dimensional feature extraction, good model performance and remarkable effect, achieves end-to-end processing of black tea hyperspectral images, is beneficial to digitization and intellectualization of the black tea fermentation process, and improves the processing quality of black tea.

title_en: Intelligent parameter estimation method for super-network and mechanism compensation dual-drive lithium battery model
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent parameter estimation method of a super-network and mechanism compensation dual-drive lithium battery model, which is characterized in that the capability of improving the dynamic property of a processing model parameter from the nonlinear enhancement and optimization target guide angle is innovated through a composite dynamic characteristic enhancement module and a multidimensional performance optimization regulator, and the functional relation between the model parameter and a state quantity is effectively captured; and the open-circuit voltage compensation calculation module takes an equation of a model as constraint, and adopts a compensation mechanism to calculate, so that the fine estimation of the open-circuit voltage is realized. The invention separates the estimation process of open-circuit voltage from the estimation process of other model parameters, reduces the calculation complexity while optimizing the model parameter estimation process, realizes the end-to-end estimation of the functional relationship between the model parameters and the state quantity for the first time, provides a reliable parameter estimation strategy for a second-order equivalent circuit model, has the advantages of low experimental dependence, flexibility, reliability and the like, and provides practical help for battery modeling and virtual platform construction.

title_en: Trusted optimization design method for electric field array type measuring device of multi-conductor system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a reliable optimal design method of an electric field array type measuring device of a multi-conductor system, which comprises the following steps: determining an objective function according to the relative difference between the electric field value when the electrode plate is measured and the electric field value when the electrode plate is not measured; establishing geometric constraint for avoiding electrode overlapping and confirming uniform distribution of electrodes according to the angle and width of the ith electrode plate and the information of the number N of the electrodes; establishing electric parameter constraint for conductor position identification, electric field gradient identification and induced current identification according to the electric field values and design parameters under the existence of the measuring electrodes; taking the design parameters as individuals, and continuously updating the design parameters based on a genetic algorithm until an optimal set of design parameters meeting the objective function, the geometric constraint condition and the electrical parameter constraint condition is obtained; establishing a model of the multi-conductor system electric field array type measuring device based on design parameters; the reliable optimal design of the array type measuring device of the multi-conductor system is realized more efficiently.

title_en: Flow rate detection device and flow rate detection method
abstract_en: The invention provides a flow detection device and a flow detection method, wherein the flow detection device comprises a flow passing pipe, a whistle pipe, a focusing strain gauge, a vibration detection assembly and a processing module, the whistle pipe is arranged at the inflow end of the flow passing pipe and is used for enabling fluid flowing into the flow passing pipe to generate an inflow sound field which propagates along the inflow direction, the focusing strain gauge is provided with a focusing concave surface, the focusing concave surface can reflect the inflow sound field to form a focusing sound field, the vibration detection assembly is arranged on the flow passing pipe and corresponds to the focus of the focusing sound field in position, the vibration detection assembly is used for generating a corresponding first voltage signal based on the sound field intensity of the fluid in the flow passing pipe, the focusing strain gauge can generate a corresponding second voltage signal based on self strain, and the processing module is used for performing decoupling processing on the first voltage signal and the second voltage signal so as to determine the flow of the fluid flowing through the flow passing pipe. According to the invention, the fluid flow is determined by detecting the sound field and the strain of the focusing strain gauge, so that the flow detection accuracy is improved and the flow detection range is enlarged.

title_en: Design method of multifunctional supporting mechanism and supporting mechanism
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of high-rotation-speed small-sized gas turbine tests, and discloses a design method of a multifunctional supporting mechanism and the supporting mechanism. The design method comprises the following steps of designing a bearing substrate, designing a circular tube type air inlet-to-full ring uniform exhaust structure, designing a variable cross section pressurizing high-through flow lubricating oil inlet-return system, designing an elastic viscous damping vibration reduction integrated structure, and performing iterative design until the support requirement of a high-rotation-speed rotor is met. The bearing matrix of the multifunctional supporting mechanism is provided with a variable-section pressurizing high-flow lubricating oil inlet and return system, a circular tube type air inlet-to-full ring uniform exhaust structure and an elastic viscous damping vibration reduction integrated structure. The design method of the multifunctional supporting mechanism and the design method in the supporting mechanism are clear and easy to realize, the supporting mechanism has simple and compact structure, high strength and rigidity, stable and reliable bearing force and convenient disassembly and maintenance, can meet the supporting requirement of small-sized gas turbine test equipment on the high-rotation-speed rotor, and has engineering application value.

title_en: Automatic test cabinet and test method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic test cabinet and a test method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of energy storage converter test. The testing device comprises a cabinet body and a testing device arranged in the cabinet body; the testing device comprises a touch control integrated machine, an intelligent debugging instrument, a programmable power supply, a code scanning gun and a testing clamp, wherein the touch control integrated machine is fixedly connected with the intelligent debugging instrument, and the programmable power supply and the touch control integrated machine are positioned at the same horizontal height; the test fixture is installed touch control all-in-one with under the programmable power supply, the preceding cabinet door center of the cabinet body be equipped with the opening of test fixture looks adaptation, sweep a yard rifle and hang the right side surface of cabinet body open surface is located programmable power supply with between the test fixture. According to the invention, through the replaceable test fixture, the energy storage converter plug-in components with different models can be automatically tested, the test efficiency is high, manual intervention is not needed in the test process, the manual investment is reduced, and the test result is visual.

title_en: Application of oxalic acid and iron complex in melt dynamic nuclear polarization
abstract_en: The invention discloses an application of oxalic acid and an iron complex in molten dynamic nuclear polarization, which takes oxalic acid as a free radical polarizer of molten dynamic nuclear polarization, can generate oxalic acid photosensitive free radicals with narrower peak width for dDNP, and has shorter polarization transfer time and higher polarization transfer efficiency compared with the conventional free radical polarizers (such as pyruvic acid, alpha-ketoglutaric acid and the like). The invention adds the photocatalyst iron complex (such as ferric oxalate hexahydrate, potassium ferric oxalate, ferric ammonium citrate, ferric acetylacetonate and the like), so that the yield of free radicals such as oxalic acid free radicals and the like can be greatly improved, and an unpaired free radical electron source with proper concentration can be provided for dDNP.

title_en: Low-voltage user power failure identification method based on power failure intelligent monitoring terminal
abstract_en: A low-voltage user power failure identification method based on a power failure intelligent monitoring terminal comprises the steps of using the power failure intelligent monitoring terminal and an electric energy meter connected through an RS485 communication interface to form a low-voltage user power failure identification system based on the power failure intelligent monitoring terminal; implanting a power failure recognition algorithm; the intelligent power failure monitoring terminal acquires the terminal electric energy meter file in a meter searching mode, then acquires data of the electric energy meter, and simultaneously combines metering data of the intelligent power failure monitoring terminal to perform data analysis; and the power failure recognition algorithm analyzes and judges the power failure event according to the collected data and feeds back the judging result to other related equipment and personnel. The method comprises the following steps: the first step: a starting stage; and a second step of: a data acquisition stage; and a third step of: analyzing and judging; fourth step: and an output stage. The invention can more quickly and accurately identify the power failure event of the electric energy meter and distinguish the power failure before/after the meter, thereby improving the timeliness and the accuracy of the power failure event processing. The scheme is simple and is easy to implement and maintain.

title_en: Detector and measuring method for detecting leakage of closed space by using infrasonic wave technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a detector and a measuring method for detecting leakage of a closed space by using an infrasonic wave technology. The detector for detecting the leakage of the closed space by using the infrasonic wave technology comprises a gas leakage detector and a closed container leakage detector; the closed container leakage detector is arranged in the closed space to be detected. The measuring method comprises the following steps: placing the closed container leakage detector in a closed container to be detected; the infrasonic wave generator of the leak detector of the closed container generates an infrasonic wave to detect a target area, and the receiving probe detects the infrasonic wave generated by the infrasonic wave generator; the earphone is used for receiving the friction sound between the gas molecules detected by the gas leakage detection module and the outlet of the damaged part of the closed container, and positioning the leakage position according to the linear propagation principle of the infrasonic wave sound wave, so as to obtain the gas leakage position.

title_en: Equipment for detecting bearing capacity of inner packaging film
abstract_en: The invention discloses a packaging inner film bearing capacity detection device, which belongs to the technical field of packaging inner film detection, and comprises a bracket and a detection mechanism, wherein the detection mechanism comprises: the device comprises a supporting plate, a supporting frame, a fixing frame, a first telescopic piece, a fixing cylinder, a compression frame, a detection assembly, a supporting assembly and a compression assembly; the middle part of the inner side of the support is fixedly provided with a support plate, the support plate is provided with a support frame, the packing inner film can be pressed through the first telescopic piece, the fixed cylinder and the fixed frame, the packing inner film can be detected through the detection assembly in pressure bearing capacity, the detection mode can be adjusted and changed, and the detection operation on different packing inner films is facilitated; be equipped with supporting component in the backup pad, with compressing tightly the subassembly cooperation and can carry out leveling operation before packing the intima compresses tightly, guarantee detection precision, the simple operation is convenient to be suitable for different packing intima, improves detection efficiency.

title_en: Signal dynamic processing method, equipment and medium based on leak rate of helium mass spectrometer leak detector
abstract_en: The invention discloses a signal dynamic processing method, equipment and medium based on the leak rate of a helium mass spectrometer leak detector, and relates to the technical field of ion flow signal processing, and the invention switches the gears of an amplifier based on the upper limit value of the flow rate of an ion flow signal in each gear so as to ensure the connectivity of the signal and avoid the interference caused by abrupt change; and calculating by using the dynamic filtering signal, the magnitude filtering parameter and the filtering factor after gain to obtain a filtering leakage rate output signal, wherein the filtering leakage rate output signal overcomes the problem of calculation errors caused by ion source signal interference.

title_en: Wind tunnel extremely low dew point rapid test method based on cold mirror type test principle
abstract_en: The invention provides a wind tunnel extremely low dew point rapid test method based on a cold mirror type test principle, the dew point test system of the scheme is arranged at the position of the wind tunnel section, which is led out from the dew point test position, and the signal is accessed to the exchanger configured by each section. The dew point testing system mainly comprises a cold mirror dew point meter and an auxiliary system. The cold mirror dew point meter is mainly responsible for finishing the dew point test; the auxiliary system mainly comprises a bypass purging test system (a purifier and the like), a pipeline electric tracing system (a thermal resistor, a heat tracing belt, a temperature controller and the like), a bypass flow system, a sampling system (a pipeline, a valve and the like), a control system and the like, and is responsible for completing the functions of purging and on-site detection of a system pipeline, heating and dewatering of the pipeline, high-flow rapid dewatering, gas sampling, control and the like.

title_en: PT secondary phase checking method and device for transformer substation, medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a transformer substation PT secondary phase checking method, device, medium and electronic equipment. The method comprises the following steps: generating a standard phasor image of each PT secondary voltage according to the wiring group of each PT; under the condition that a generator set of a transformer substation is in a normal operation condition, determining a first characteristic value of secondary voltage between two PT in each PT so as to generate a reference phasor image of the secondary voltage of each PT; carrying out validity judgment on the standard phasor image according to the reference phasor image; and if the standard phasor image is judged to be effective, carrying out secondary nuclear phase on each group of the overhauled PT according to the standard phasor image of each group of PT secondary voltage. In the scheme, the validity of the simulated standard phasor image is checked by using the reference phasor image under the normal working condition, so that the accuracy of the standard phasor image can be ensured, and the secondary nuclear phase is carried out on each group of PT after overhaul according to the standard phasor image of each group of PT secondary voltage, thereby improving the accuracy of the nuclear phase result.

title_en: Triaxial linkage type marking equipment for multiple sample gauge lengths
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of material detection marking, in particular to a triaxial linkage type marking device for multiple sample gauge lengths, which comprises a control unit, a bearing unit for placing samples, a marking unit for marking the samples, a transmission unit for driving the marking unit to move, wherein the transmission unit comprises a probe arm for installing the marking unit, a transverse transmission mechanism connected with the bearing unit and controlling the probe arm to move left and right, a longitudinal transmission mechanism connected with the transverse transmission mechanism and controlling the probe arm to move back and forth, and a vertical transmission mechanism connected with the longitudinal transmission mechanism and controlling the probe arm to move up and down, the bearing unit comprises a bottom plate for installing the transverse transmission mechanism, a sample platform arranged on the bottom plate and parallel to the transverse transmission mechanism, and the marking unit comprises a fixer arranged at the front end of the probe arm and a marker arranged on the fixer, so that the mark gauge length can be quickly, accurately and nondestructively marked on the surface of the samples.

title_en: Voltage internal resistance testing device based on semi-automatic aluminum shell and soft package battery
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of battery production equipment, in particular to a voltage and internal resistance testing device based on a semi-automatic aluminum shell and a soft package battery, which aims at solving the problem of lower efficiency of battery production in the prior art, and provides the voltage and internal resistance testing device based on the semi-automatic aluminum shell and the soft package battery, wherein the surface of a mounting frame is connected with two sets of four-wire clamps capable of lifting in a sliding manner, one side of the mounting frame is provided with a two-dimensional code scanner, the upper end of the frame is provided with an internal resistance tester, the button box that a control four-wire position anchor clamps reciprocated is installed to the front side of frame, and this device presses down the button when using, and cylinder work on the four-wire position anchor clamps promotes four-wire position anchor clamps to descend to press the positive negative pole of battery, can read out the voltage internal resistance of battery through the internal resistance tester, and the two-dimensional code scanner can scan the two-dimensional code on the battery, then binds two-dimensional code and this battery voltage and internal resistance value through the procedure and upload MES system, accomplishes voltage internal resistance test work.

title_en: Low-back-force air compressor stage unsteady oscillation pumping excitation application experimental device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an experimental device for applying low-back-force compressor-level unsteady oscillation suction excitation, relates to the technical field of compressors, and solves the problem that a test device for applying oscillation excitation to a blade grid is lacking at present. The outer connecting section, the suction control section, the expansion end and the cascade connecting section are connected in sequence; the suction control section comprises a runner sleeve and an axial motor assembly; one end of the runner sleeve is connected with the outer connecting section, and the other end of the runner sleeve is connected with the expansion end; an axial motor component is arranged in the runner sleeve; baffles are arranged at two ends of the runner sleeve; the axial motor assembly comprises an axial motor and a rotating wheel, the axial motor is arranged in the runner sleeve, and the rotating wheel is arranged on an output shaft of the axial motor; half of the rotating wheel is of a solid structure, half is hollow structure. According to the invention, the axial motor and the rotary wheel are arranged in the runner sleeve, and the rotary wheel rotating speed is controlled by the axial motor, so that the position of the hollow structure of the rotary wheel in the runner sleeve is controlled, and the oscillation suction flow is controlled.

title_en: Wireless passive temperature sensor and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wireless passive temperature measurement sensor and a preparation method thereof, which belong to the technical field of sensors, wherein high-temperature solder paste is printed on a substrate and a PCB respectively; attaching the sensor chip, the inductor and the spring antenna to a PCB (printed circuit board); the PCB is subjected to reflow heating welding by using a special jig tray, and is fixed on a substrate; carrying out coding silk-screen printing on the plastic protective rubber shell; and (3) fastening and packaging the substrate and the plastic protective rubber shell to prepare the wireless passive temperature sensor. The invention does not need power supply driving, and realizes the wireless passive temperature measurement function.

title_en: Method and system for measuring position of magnetic probe
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of nuclear fusion, and discloses a magnetic probe position measurement method and a magnetic probe position measurement system, wherein the magnetic probe position measurement method comprises the following steps: establishing an absolute coordinate system of the vacuum chamber based on the known preset position coordinates by using a laser tracker; converting a coordinate system of the multi-joint mechanical arm fixed in the vacuum chamber into an absolute coordinate system by using the same set of targets fixed in the vacuum chamber; the magnetic probe position is measured by utilizing the multi-joint mechanical arm under the absolute coordinate system, and the magnetic probe position is measured by adopting the implementation mode of the multi-joint mechanical arm, so that the multi-joint mechanical arm arranged in the vacuum chamber can detect the position of the magnetic probe positioned at the bottom of the vacuum chamber more accurately, and the technical problem that the method for detecting the positioning hole on the surface of the magnetic probe by independently adopting the laser tracker to determine the position of the magnetic probe is inaccurate when detecting the position of the magnetic probe positioned at the bottom of the vacuum chamber is solved.

title_en: Test equipment of flexible probe
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a test apparatus for a flexible probe having a first end and a second end, the test apparatus comprising a first platform, a second platform, an introduction device, and a drive device; the first platform comprises a first fixing part for fixing the first end part of the flexible probe, the second platform comprises a second fixing part for fixing the second end part of the flexible probe, the introduction device comprises an introduction part for introducing the second end part of the flexible probe into the second fixing part, and the driving device drives the first platform and the second platform to move or rotate relatively so as to bend or twist the flexible probe. In this case, the flexible probe can be favorably fixed by the test apparatus through the first fixing portion and the second fixing portion, and the introduction device can be favorably fixed the second end portion of the flexible probe in the second fixing portion, whereby the test apparatus can be favorably complete the bending test of the flexible probe.

title_en: Method and device for measuring discharge current in nuclear fusion device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of nuclear fusion, and discloses a method and a device for measuring discharge current in a nuclear fusion device, wherein the method is applied to the device for measuring the discharge current in the nuclear fusion device, and the device comprises a mutual inductance type current acquisition module and a shunt; the measuring method comprises the following steps: acquiring first current data acquired by a mutual inductance type current acquisition module between a discharge starting time of a power supply in the nuclear fusion device and a preset time; acquiring second current data acquired by the current divider from a preset time to a discharge end time of the power supply; splicing the first current data and the second current data according to the acquisition time sequence to obtain discharge current data; according to the embodiment, the step signal can be effectively avoided, the actual current signal can be accurately measured, and the current collection accuracy in the whole current signal collection process is ensured.

title_en: Nondestructive rapid detection method for meat structures of fishes with different freshness
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of food quality safety nondestructive testing and provides a nondestructive rapid testing method for fish meat structures with different freshness, which comprises the following steps of preparing fish meat samples with different freshness, so that the modeled fish meat samples comprise primary freshness, secondary freshness and tertiary freshness; the method comprises the steps of testing elasticity, hardness and masticatory indexes of fish with different freshness by adopting a texture analyzer, respectively collecting near infrared spectrum and Raman spectrum information of the fish by utilizing near infrared spectrum and Raman spectrum, extracting characteristics of the spectrum information of the fish by adopting CARS and SiPLS methods, preprocessing the spectrum information by adopting an OSC method on the basis, carrying out medium-level data fusion on the processed spectrum, respectively establishing PLSR prediction models aiming at elasticity, hardness and masticatory property, and finally testing the texture characteristics of the fish with unknown freshness by utilizing the established prediction models. The detection method improves the accuracy of nondestructive detection of the fish texture, and has important significance for rapid evaluation of the fish quality.

title_en: Forward modeling method and system based on difference coefficient and seismic source function optimization
abstract_en: The invention provides a forward modeling method and a forward modeling system based on differential coefficient and seismic source function optimization, which define a 2N-order finite difference staggered grid of a first derivative according to a first-order stress-speed wave equation; carrying out Taylor expansion on the 2N-order finite difference staggered grid to obtain a difference coefficient calculation equation; introducing expansion conditions, substituting the expansion conditions into a differential coefficient calculation equation, and solving the optimal differential coefficient of the expanded differential coefficient calculation equation under constraint; adopting a Gaussian function to replace a seismic source position function, setting an attenuation factor and acting on a seismic excitation source to optimize the seismic source; based on the optimal differential coefficient and the optimized seismic source, forward modeling is performed, so that forward modeling can be accurately, efficiently and stably realized.

title_en: Rapid detection method for cell metabolite N-L-lactoyl-L-phenylalanine
abstract_en: The invention provides a rapid detection method for cell metabolite N-L-lactoyl-L-phenylalanine, wherein the sensor adopts an L-lactic acid aptamer and an L-phenylalanine aptamer to respectively modify two grids on an electrolyte grid-control graphene field effect transistor (SGGT); during detection, the configuration of the aptamer on the grid is changed after capturing two target substances of L-lactic acid and L-phenylalanine, so that the offset of the Dirac point of the transfer curve is generated, the two target substances are detected respectively, and the detection of the N-L-lactoyl-L-phenylalanine is finally realized by establishing a concentration model of a target system. The sensor solves the disadvantage of weak selectivity of the electrochemical grid-control graphene field effect transistor, can be used for rapidly detecting one or more substances in lactic acid, phenylalanine or lactic acid phenylalanine in a cell culture medium through combination and disassembly of grids, can be used for cell experiment detection, and has a certain practical value.

title_en: Nanomaterial composition for detecting multiple bacteria, preparation method thereof and multiple bacteria detection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nano material composition for detecting multiple bacteria, a preparation method thereof and a multiple bacteria detection method, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: s1, synthesizing a capture probe of the grafted aptamer 1: s1-1, synthesizing Fe  3 O 4  nano particles by adopting a solvothermal method; s1-2, synthesizing aminated Fe  3 O 4  nano particles: s1-3, synthesizing AuNPs@Fe  3 O 4  nano particles: s1-4, grafting an aptamer 1; s2, synthesizing a detection probe of the grafted aptamer 2: s2-1, synthesizing silver nano particles: s2-2, grafting aptamer 2. According to the invention, four different Raman signal molecules are adopted, an aptamer magnetic capture technology is combined, the Raman signal molecules are matched with four groups of probes which are correspondingly designed, and multiple bacteria of escherichia coli, staphylococcus aureus, pseudomonas aeruginosa and salmonella typhimurium can be rapidly and accurately realized through detection and analysis of a Raman signal characteristic spectrogram, so that the method has a good application prospect.

title_en: Universal heating temperature-control sample holder for detecting thin film device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a universal heating temperature-control sample holder for detecting a thin film device. The sample holder is provided with a flat plate made of a plate material and a sample holder bracket arranged below the flat plate, wherein the minimum distance between the flat plate and the holder base is 2 mm, and at least four direct current interfaces and one microwave interface are arranged outside the flat plate and the heating plate. The sample holder can be directly arranged on a common normal-temperature test platform of each instrument for heating test, meets the requirements of heating temperature control test on various instruments, is convenient to repeatedly dismantle, transfer and install between the heating test platforms of different test equipment, does not need to be provided with a heat insulation part, and can ensure the temperature control stability during test.

title_en: Signal processing device, signal processing method, and program
abstract_en: The present invention can acquire an appropriate image when a plurality of types of images are generated based on the output of the light receiving sensor. The signal processing device according to the present technology includes: a signal processing unit that performs signal processing on at least one of a plurality of types of images generated based on an output of a light receiving sensor in which pixels having light receiving elements are arranged in two dimensions; and a control unit controlling the signal processing parameters in the signal processing unit so that the plurality of types of images are in a proper mode.

title_en: Performance test and calibration method for photonic interconnect chip based on deep machine learning algorithm
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of chip performance test, in particular to a performance test and calibration method of a photonic interconnect chip based on a deep machine learning algorithm. The method comprises the following steps of calibrating output of a light source, calculating root mean square error of light source power changing along with time, calculating insertion loss and return loss by considering connection loss and alignment loss of an optical fiber and a chip, analyzing spectral response and phase response of the chip by utilizing a photonic chip deep learning analysis algorithm, calculating spectral response width, measuring output signals of a photonic interconnection chip to generate an eye pattern, calculating signal-to-noise ratio and error rate, placing the photonic interconnection chip in an environment with adjustable temperature, introducing thermal expansion of materials to influence calculation temperature coefficient, and establishing an optical output power model. According to the method, the connection loss and the alignment error are compensated, and the transmission characteristic modeling is performed by using the deep learning model, so that the accuracy and the reliability of chip testing are effectively improved.

title_en: Continuous calibration of atomic clocks to external references
abstract_en: An atomic clock is provided. The output of the tunable LO is coupled to the user output of the atomic clock. The charge pump adjusts the tunable LO using the LO tuning voltage. The follower circuit sets the output frequency of the atomic clock to the frequency of an external reference signal coupled to an external reference input. The atomic reference circuit sets the output frequency of the atomic clock to a frequency set based on the stored operation. The controller stores a current operation setting generated based on a current external reference signal coupled to the external reference input. The controller is further configured to apply the stored current operation setting to the atomic reference circuit to maintain the output frequency of the atomic clock at the output frequency set by the follower circuit when the current external reference signal is removed from the external reference input.

title_en: Commercial communication tower with inclination early warning function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a commercial communication tower with an inclination early warning function, which comprises a communication tower body, wherein the top of the body is fixedly provided with a mounting plate, a balance mechanism and a laser positioning and transmitting device; the balance mechanism comprises a sealing cover, an upper fixing plate, a lower fixing plate, a sealing ball, sealing liquid and a floating ball; the laser positioning and transmitting device comprises a roller, a servo drive, an angle sensor, a laser transmitting head, a power supply and a circuit board; a main control center is arranged on the communication tower body, a plurality of reference laser induction receivers are arranged on the ground of the communication tower body, and the reference laser induction receivers position reference coordinate points; after the tower body deflects to different degrees, the laser positioning transmitting device can automatically adjust and maintain the horizontal state, and the monitoring precision is maintained; the influence of the earth surface on the reference coordinate point can be reduced by taking the most positioned circle centers as the reference coordinate point; the overall inclination condition of the tower body can be judged; the local inclination condition of the communication tower body can be judged.

title_en: Aptamer sensor for detecting allergen and method for detecting beta-lactoglobulin in dual modes
abstract_en: The invention discloses an aptamer sensor for detecting allergen and a method for detecting beta-lactoglobulin in a dual mode, belonging to the technical field of biosensors and allergen detection. The Aptamer sensor for detecting the allergen is DNA WALKER formed by autonomously assembling Aptamer, TRIGGER DNA, GOx@AuNPs complex, LINKER DNA and streptavidin magnetic beads. The aptamer sensor can convert biological signals of beta-lactoglobulin into chemical signals of complex enzyme, so as to realize signal amplification; when DNA WALKER is adopted to detect the beta-lactoglobulin, the double-mode qualitative and quantitative detection of the beta-lactoglobulin can be realized by using a personal glucometer and a colorimetric method. The detection method has the advantages of low cost, rapid detection, low requirement on detection instruments, simple operation and visual result, and is suitable for the detection requirement of family scenes.

title_en: Distributed power transmission line fault accurate positioning system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of distributed fault positioning of a power transmission line, and discloses a distributed power transmission line fault accurate positioning system and method, wherein the system comprises the steps of collecting wave recording data when the power transmission line fails; the method comprises the steps of acquiring fault transient recording data, constructing graph structure data based on the acquired fault recording data, inputting the graph structure data into a neural network model, outputting a result representing the position of a fault point of a power transmission line by the neural network model, calculating the distance between the fault point and an endpoint of the fault transient recording which is started first according to a fault distance ratio, extracting the endpoint position of the fault transient recording which is started first, and then positioning the fault point.

title_en: Gradient coil assembly, gradient coil vibration suppression method and magnetic resonance imaging device
abstract_en: The application belongs to the field of medical equipment, and provides a gradient coil assembly, a gradient coil vibration suppression method and magnetic resonance imaging equipment, the magnetic resonance imaging device comprises a gradient coil assembly, wherein the gradient coil assembly comprises a gradient coil and a damping structure, the damping structure is connected with the gradient coil, and the damping structure is a particle damper. According to the gradient coil assembly, the damping structure is connected with the gradient coil, and is used for converting part of vibration energy of the gradient coil into heat energy, when the particle damper is adopted in the damping structure, the gradient coil transmits part of vibration energy to the particle damper when the gradient coil vibrates, so that particles of the particle damper are driven to vibrate, mutually collide and rub, and the vibration energy of the gradient coil is converted into heat energy rapidly and efficiently, so that the vibration energy is consumed, vibration and noise reduction of the gradient coil are realized, noise is effectively reduced, and the running reliability of MRI equipment is guaranteed.

title_en: Kettle seat assembly of electric kettle and electric kettle
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electric kettles, and discloses a kettle seat assembly of an electric kettle and the electric kettle, wherein the kettle seat assembly comprises: the bottom shell is fixed with a water inlet pipe and a power line; the upper shell is floatably arranged on the bottom shell; and the weighing assembly is arranged on the upper shell. When the kettle is used, the kettle body is placed on the upper shell, and the upper shell is floatably arranged on the bottom shell, so that when the water quantity in the kettle body changes, the deformation quantity of the weighing assembly changes, and water addition or water addition stopping can be judged according to the deformation quantity of the weighing assembly. Because the weighing assembly is installed in the upper shell, the water inlet pipe and the power line are fixed in the bottom shell, and the weighing of the weighing assembly can not be influenced even if the power line and the water inlet pipe are pulled by the outside, so that the measurement accuracy of the weighing assembly is higher.

title_en: Device and method for testing dynamic temperature of closed space
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a method for testing dynamic temperature of a closed space, which relate to the field of temperature testing and solve the problem of insufficient accuracy of the device for testing dynamic temperature of the closed space, and comprise the following steps: respectively marking the rectangular coordinate system of the temperature test space as first to mth temperature test feature points, and obtaining space coordinates of the first to mth temperature test feature points to obtain the number of the closed space feature points; temperature testing is conducted on the first to the m-th space coordinate points in the closed space according to the closed space characteristic point data, and an abnormal space coordinate point, an abnormal characteristic point quantity ratio, a characteristic peak-valley difference change value and a space temperature difference coefficient are respectively obtained, so that space temperature test data are obtained; the method and the device can effectively improve the comprehensiveness, objectivity and accuracy of the test result of the dynamic temperature test of the closed space.

title_en: Safety hanging basket for building construction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a safety hanging basket for building construction, which belongs to the technical field of building construction and comprises a base, wherein limit rods are fixedly arranged at four corners of the top of the base, a protection top plate is slidably arranged on the limit rods, a first protection frame is fixedly arranged at the top of the base, a second protection frame is arranged at the top of the first protection frame, fixed cross rods are fixedly arranged between the first protection frame and the second protection frame, the number of the fixed cross rods is multiple and uniformly distributed between the first protection frame and the second protection frame, and an adjusting mechanism for adjusting the internal protection space of the hanging basket according to different people is arranged between the top of the second protection frame and the bottom of the protection top plate. According to the invention, by arranging the adjusting mechanism, the safety coefficient is lower when the angle is inclined or swaying, the adjusting component and the locking component can protect constructors without dead angles, and the adjustment of the protection space can be carried out according to construction crowds with different heights.

title_en: Pressure vessel gas tightness testing arrangement
abstract_en: The application discloses a pressure container air tightness testing device, and relates to the technical field of air tightness detection. The application comprises the following steps: the detecting mechanism comprises an annular cover, an annular groove is formed in the inner peripheral side of the annular cover, a connecting plate is vertically inserted in the top of the annular cover in a sliding mode, one end of the connecting plate is located in the annular cover and is provided with a sealing annular plate, an annular water storage cavity is formed between the sealing annular plate and the annular groove, and the sealing annular plate is sleeved on the container tank. According to the application, the annular cover is sleeved on the container, and the sealing ring plate is moved upwards during detection to realize the mode that water overflows the welding seam, so that the container is not required to be carried in a reciprocating manner, and the welding seam condition of the container can be directly observed from the annular cover by a detector in a short distance when the water tank is used for detection, the detection is more convenient, the welding seam is completely immersed in water, the problems of uneven spraying and volatilization are not easy to occur, and the use is more convenient.

title_en: Water ecology field monitoring equipment with prevent destroying alarming function
