abstract_en: The invention relates to water ecology field monitoring equipment with a damage prevention alarm function, which comprises a bionic stump shell, wherein a plurality of bionic branches are distributed on the side surface of the bionic stump shell, a plurality of bionic stumps are distributed on the bottom edge of the bionic stump shell, a box door is arranged on the side surface of the bionic stump shell, a water pipe is arranged in the bionic stump, a cylinder is fixedly arranged in the bionic stump shell, the upper surface of the cylinder is fixedly connected with a solar photovoltaic panel, a rubber ring is fixedly arranged on the periphery of the solar photovoltaic panel, the outer surface of the rubber ring is fixedly connected with the bionic stump shell, the rubber ring can meet the buffer effect through double matching of a damage prevention buffer structure and the rubber ring when the bionic stump shell is slightly collided, the rubber ring can not be buffered when the bionic stump shell is excessively damaged, the strength of the force transmitted to a pressure sensor through the damage prevention buffer structure is judged, and then the force is transmitted to a terminal through an electric signal, so that the monitoring is facilitated.

title_en: Explosion-proof valve explosion monitoring and thermal runaway battery positioning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an explosion-proof valve explosion monitoring and thermal runaway battery positioning method, which does not need decoupling the temperature and strain of an optical fiber, and can rapidly monitor and alarm by analyzing the inconsistency and the integrity of optical fiber wavelength data. When the internal pressure of the battery is too high, the notch of the explosion-proof valve is punched out under high pressure, and the generated impact force can lead to the breakage of the optical fiber. Although the area in front of the break point can still collect signals, the reflected wave signals of the subsequent area will be lost. By observing the data integrity, the explosion monitoring of the explosion-proof valve can be realized, and the fault battery can be accurately positioned. In addition, the pressure abnormality of the battery is identified by comparing the inconsistencies of the signals of different sections, and early warning is sent out. According to the technical scheme, the plurality of gratings are distributed in one path of optical fiber, the plurality of batteries are allowed to share one optical fiber interface, the system is simple and reliable, the grating positions are attached to the notch of the battery explosion-proof valve, the impact force during explosion can be ensured to effectively destroy the optical fiber, and therefore high-reliability monitoring is achieved.

title_en: Lithium battery health state estimation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lithium battery health state estimation method, which comprises the steps of converting a coordinate space of a complete charging voltage data sequence and a coordinate space of a segment charging voltage data sequence into a voltage-differential voltage coordinate space, taking the complete charging voltage data sequence converted by the coordinate space as training data, taking the segment charging voltage data sequence converted by the coordinate space as verification data, training a self-adaptive sampling depth neural network based on the training data and a health state label to obtain a health state prediction model, inputting the verification data into the health state prediction model to obtain a health state prediction value sequence, sequentially extracting a plurality of sub-prediction value sequences from the health state prediction value sequence, calculating variance of each sub-prediction value sequence, and averaging health state prediction values of the sub-prediction value sequences with variances lower than a variance threshold to obtain a final lithium battery health state estimation value. The battery state of health estimation method can accurately predict the state of health of the lithium battery based on the segment voltage data sequence.

title_en: Building deformation monitoring device for constructional engineering
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building deformation monitoring device for constructional engineering, which relates to the technical field of constructional engineering and comprises a supporting box, wherein a connecting box is arranged on the top surface of the supporting box, a base plate is arranged on the top surface of the connecting box, a rubber bushing is fixedly arranged between the connecting box and the base plate and used for sealing a gap between the rubber bushing and the base plate, a staff can monitor the deformation of a building through the surveying and mapping machine body and the telescope set in the follow-up supervision of the constructional engineering through the arranged surveying and mapping machine body and the telescope set, and the angles of the surveying and mapping machine body and the telescope set can be adjusted by mutually matching the arranged connecting box, a gyroscope, an information processing unit, an electric push rod, a universal joint, a supporting rod, the rubber bushing, the base plate, the surveying and mapping machine body and the telescope set, so that the level of the surveying and mapping machine body and the telescope set is kept, the inclination of the surveying and mapping machine body and the telescope set caused by the uneven ground is avoided, and the accuracy of the surveying and mapping machine body and the telescope set in monitoring the deformation of the building is improved.

title_en: Automatic detection equipment for hub bearing rotation moment
abstract_en: The invention discloses automatic detection equipment for the rotation moment of a hub bearing, which is characterized by comprising an equipment body, an electric cylinder press-fitting assembly, a servo motor rotation detection assembly, a positioning mandrel and a control cabinet assembly, wherein the positioning mandrel is arranged on the equipment body; the device body is provided with an electric cylinder press-fitting assembly, a servo motor rotation detection assembly and a positioning mandrel, and a control cabinet assembly is arranged beside the device body; under the control of a PLC, the electric cylinder controls the pressing plate to apply pressure to the hub bearing, the servo motor drives the workpiece to rotate, and the torque sensor detects the rotation moment to realize the detection of the rotation moment of the hub bearing under different pressures; the method is convenient to operate, high in detection precision and capable of accurately reflecting the variation trend of bearing rotation moment of different products and different bearings under different pressures, so that the assembly parameters of the bearings of different types of each product are optimized, and the product quality is improved.

title_en: Water quality mineral content detection device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water quality detection, in particular to a water quality mineral content detection device which comprises an external component, a storage component and a driving component, wherein the external component comprises a first detection cylinder and a second detection cylinder arranged on the inner side of the first detection cylinder, the storage component comprises a sliding cylinder arranged on one end of the second detection cylinder and an inclined plane groove arranged on the inner side of the sliding cylinder, the driving component comprises a bearing frame arranged on one end of the second detection cylinder, a bearing disc arranged on the inner side of the bearing frame and an arc plate arranged on one end of the bearing disc, and the driving component comprises a turnover groove arranged on the inner side of the first detection cylinder.

title_en: Wearing equipment
abstract_en: The application provides wearing equipment, which comprises an equipment body and a fixing belt, wherein the equipment body comprises a metal frame, a display module, a main board and a bottom shell, the fixing belt is connected with the metal frame, the display module and the main board are positioned in the metal frame, and the bottom shell is fixedly connected with the metal frame; the main board is provided with a switch unit and a feed source; the metal frame is an annular metal frame, the metal frame is electrically connected with the switch unit and the feed source respectively, the central angle of a first connecting point and a second connecting point is smaller than or equal to 60 degrees, the first connecting point is a connecting point of the metal frame and the switch unit, and the second connecting point is a connecting point of the metal frame and the feed source; when the switch unit is in a first state, the metal frame works in a first frequency band and is in a first circular polarization state; when the switch unit is in the second state, the metal frame works in the second frequency band and is in the second circular polarization state.

title_en: Packaging method of thermal sensor
abstract_en: The invention provides a packaging method of a thermal sensor, which comprises the following steps of providing an integrated packaging substrate, wherein the integrated packaging substrate comprises a plurality of packaging plates, each packaging plate is provided with a pin hole, each packaging plate comprises a sub-substrate and a chip connected to the sub-substrate, the integrated packaging substrate is placed on a plurality of tube seats in a mode that the pin holes correspond to pins on the tube seats, so that the pins on the tube seats are inserted into the pin holes of the corresponding packaging plates, conducting slurry is injected into each pin hole, the integrated packaging substrate is cut to obtain a plurality of separated assemblies, each assembly comprises a single packaging plate and a single tube seat, and the tube seat of each assembly is respectively connected with a tube cap to package to obtain a plurality of thermal sensors, wherein the packaging plates are positioned between the tube caps and the tube seats, so that the packaging efficiency of the thermal sensor is improved, the cost is reduced, and the reliability of the structure is improved.

title_en: Slump cone limiting device for concrete slump test
abstract_en: The invention discloses a slump cone limiting device for a concrete slump test, which relates to the technical field of concrete slump tests and comprises an experiment plate, a cylinder body, a handle, a limiting block, a U-shaped plate I, a connecting folding rod, a U-shaped plate II, a treading lifting assembly, a rotation positioning assembly and a limiting assembly. Placing the barrel on the experimental plate, U-shaped plate one and stopper butt are fixed the barrel, rotate locating component and fix a position U-shaped plate one, when removing fixedly to the barrel, the staff tramples lifting assembly, trample lifting assembly and drive the U-shaped plate and move upwards, U-shaped plate two drives and connects the book pole, rotate locating component, U-shaped plate one upward movement for U-shaped plate one breaks away from with the stopper, after breaking away from, rotate locating component and drive connect book pole, U-shaped plate one rotation, make U-shaped plate one be located barrel one side, guarantee that U-shaped plate one can not influence the pick-up of barrel, need not two people's cooperation and carry out slump test, manpower resources have been saved.

title_en: Glass defect detection method and system
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a glass defect detection method and system, and relates to the technical field of optical measurement. The glass defect detection system comprises a workbench, a detection mechanism and a defect analysis mechanism, wherein the workbench is used for placing glass to be detected along an X-direction reference edge and a Y-direction reference edge, the X-direction reference edge and the Y-direction reference edge form an XY plane, the detection mechanism is arranged above the workbench and used for sequentially acquiring optical information of each glass acquisition point based on horizontal coordinates of each glass acquisition point from a coordinate origin, the optical information comprises an image and light round trip time, the coordinate origin is an intersection point of the X-direction reference edge and the Y-direction reference edge, and the defect analysis mechanism is connected with the detection mechanism and used for analyzing whether the glass has defects or not based on the optical information of each glass acquisition point sent by the reception detection mechanism. The system can realize accurate measurement of the contour data of the glass and accurate detection of defects of the glass through omnibearing data acquisition, and improves measurement accuracy, thereby rapidly evaluating the quality of glass products.

title_en: Protection network abnormality detection system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of protection network anomaly detection, in particular to a protection network anomaly detection system and method, comprising a three-dimensional display unit, a first early warning unit, a second early warning unit, a real-time warning unit, an image acquisition unit and a defect classification unit, and further comprising: the model construction unit is used for carrying out three-dimensional modeling on the target protection net through a three-dimensional modeling technology so as to obtain a three-dimensional model of the target protection net, and transmitting the three-dimensional model of the target protection net to the region matching unit and the three-dimensional display unit. According to the invention, the state data of a plurality of positions of the target protective net are obtained in real time through the state monitoring unit and the early warning unit, and early warning is carried out according to the preset state threshold value table, so that the real-time performance can help to find possible abnormal conditions of the protective net in time.

title_en: Millimeter wave radar signal motion noise removing method based on total variation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of non-contact vital sign detection, in particular to a millimeter wave radar signal motion noise removing method based on total variation, which comprises the following steps of S1, obtaining a thoracic cavity signal containing motion noise by utilizing a millimeter wave radar, rearranging and converting the thoracic cavity signal into a gray level map; S2, after acquiring a chest image containing noise, respectively calculating second-order gradient information of the image in different directions, S3, according to the gradient information in different directions, obtaining sparse characteristics of noise and a bottom image structure, respectively designing a transverse second-order regularization constraint term and a longitudinal second-order regularization constraint term by introducing an Lp pseudo-norm, simultaneously designing a global sparse constraint term based on the priori characteristic of the noise, and S4, restoring the denoised image into a one-dimensional chest signal. According to the method, the sparse characteristics of the motion noise and the underlying image structure are fully utilized, the Lp pseudo-norms are introduced to better describe the sparse characteristics, the motion noise is effectively removed, and the detailed characteristics of the chest signals are better reserved.

title_en: Geophysical inversion method and system based on multiple constraints
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a geophysical inversion method and system based on multiple constraints, applied in the field of geophysical exploration. In view of the fact that the existing Bayesian inversion theory framework is easily affected by various interferences such as random noise, the present invention will simultaneously utilize multiple mixed prior information such as the characteristics of underground geological structures and the spatial extension relationship of seismic data, combined with compressive sensing theory, taking into account the constraints of lateral continuity and extension relationship of seismic data traces, to improve the reliability of inversion results while reducing the ambiguity of inversion results.

title_en: Device and method for detecting lap rate of copper shielding layer of lead based on visual identification
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a method for detecting the overlapping rate of a copper shielding layer of a lead based on visual identification, wherein the device comprises a frame, a first clamping mechanism, a second clamping mechanism and a visual identification mechanism, wherein the first clamping mechanism is fixed on one side of the frame and is used for clamping the lead and driving the lead to rotate around the axis of the lead, the second clamping mechanism is movably arranged on one side of the frame far away from the first clamping mechanism along the axis direction of the lead and is used for clamping the lead and driving the lead to rotate around the axis of the lead, the visual identification mechanism comprises a bottom plate which is movably arranged in parallel with the axis direction of the lead, a plurality of visual cameras which move perpendicular to the moving direction of the bottom plate are arranged on the bottom plate, the lead wrapped with the copper shielding layer is clamped by the first clamping mechanism and the second clamping mechanism and moves by the second clamping mechanism, and the copper shielding layer is unfolded, so that the visual identification mechanism can conveniently carry out visual detection on the lead.

title_en: Indoor course estimation method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention provides an indoor heading estimation method, equipment and medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring local features of IMU data packets, integrating the local features with preset additional features, inputting the local features into a deep learning model to acquire correlations so as to update the additional features, and finally reducing dimensions of the integrated features to obtain a heading estimation result. The method can carefully mine the local characteristics of the data, capture specific information of different areas, realize global characteristic extraction and feature representation enrichment through correlation updating of additional characteristics, reduce the calculation complexity, reduce training reasoning time, remove redundant information and noise and improve model generalization and robustness through dimension reduction processing. Compared with the prior art, the method can better adapt to the complexity of the indoor environment and improve the accuracy and reliability of course estimation.

title_en: Carrier rocket telemetry data analysis method, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, equipment and a storage medium for analyzing telemetry data of a carrier rocket, which belong to the technical field of telemetry data processing of carrier rockets and comprise the steps of generating a calculation result array with a plurality of result values for each sensor formula at the compiling period; and when the telemetering data is analyzed, acquiring each sensor data in the telemetering data according to the names and the positions of the sensors recorded in the generated configuration file, searching a result value corresponding to the sensor data in a calculation result array of the corresponding sensor by taking the acquired sensor acquisition value as an index, thereby completing real-time analysis of the sensor data. The method and the device can be suitable for launch scenes of the carrier rocket, effectively improve analysis efficiency of the telemetry data and ensure real-time analysis of the telemetry data.

title_en: Shafting coaxiality adjusting device and shafting coaxiality adjusting method for radial sliding bearing
abstract_en: The invention relates to a shafting coaxiality adjusting device and method for a radial sliding bearing, which can calculate the parallel deviation and the angle deviation of the main shaft of the radial sliding bearing in an adjusting state and a rotation stable state by measuring displacement values of two sections of the main shaft in different states, correct the parallel deviation and the angle deviation of the shafting coaxiality adjusting state, solve the problem of inaccurate shafting coaxiality adjustment of the radial sliding bearing, adjust the accuracy of shafting coaxiality, and avoid mechanical faults caused by shafting misalignment.

title_en: Full-field stress synchronous test experiment system and method based on photoelastic-infrared
abstract_en: The invention discloses a full-field stress synchronous test experiment system and method based on photoelastic-infrared, and belongs to the technical field of mechanical tests. The system comprises an intelligent photoelastic testing system, an infrared testing system, a synchronous control system and a high-speed CMOS camera, wherein the intelligent photoelastic testing system is used for acquiring optical interference fringes generated by stress on the surface of a test piece, which is stuck with a photoelastic material, in real time by using a photoelastic testing method, the infrared testing system is used for acquiring temperature changes generated by stress on the opposite surface of the test piece, which is stuck with the photoelastic material, by using an infrared thermal imaging testing method, and the synchronous control system is used for controlling the fluctuation frequency of the optical axis position and the fast axis position in an optical lens, the frequency of the optical interference fringes acquired by the high-speed CMOS camera, the load applying frequency and the infrared thermal image acquisition frequency. The method can realize synchronous testing of a dynamic real-time photoelastic method and an infrared high-speed thermal imaging related method, high-precision real-time full-field stress automatic analysis, combines the advantages of the two methods, and visually detects the full-field stress distribution and evolution condition of the rock solid material test piece through experiments.

title_en: High-speed train wind tunnel test system and method based on PIV particle tracing technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of wind tunnel tests, in particular to a high-speed train wind tunnel test system and a high-speed train wind tunnel test method based on PIV particle tracing technology, wherein the test system comprises a wind tunnel shell, a trace particle emitting device, a light curtain component, an imaging component and a train component, the train component is movably arranged in the wind tunnel shell, the light curtain component is fixed at the bottom of the periphery of the wind tunnel shell, the imaging component is positioned on the peripheral side surface of the wind tunnel shell, the trace particle emission device comprises a storage, a transmission pipeline and a hollow rectifying net, the hollow rectifying net is fixed at a port of the wind tunnel stabilizing section, the transmission pipeline is connected between the hollow rectifying net and the storage, and a plurality of nozzles are arranged on the hollow rectifying net in a matrix shape. The invention solves the problem of uneven distribution of trace particles when the PIV technology is adopted to obtain flow field speed distribution in the wind tunnel test of the high-speed train, and ensures the accuracy and reliability of test results.

title_en: Method for constructing HPLC characteristic spectrum of acalypha australis medicinal material, decoction piece, standard decoction and formula granule thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an acalypha australis medicinal material, decoction pieces, standard decoction and a formula particle HPLC characteristic spectrum construction method thereof, which comprises the steps of A) extracting acalypha australis raw material by using a solvent to obtain to-be-detected liquid, B) measuring the to-be-detected liquid by using a high performance liquid chromatography to obtain the HPLC characteristic spectrum of the acalypha australis raw material, wherein the chromatographic condition of the high performance liquid chromatography is that a chromatographic column is a C18 column, a mobile phase A is methanol, and a mobile phase B is 0.1% phosphoric acid solution, and gradient elution is carried out. The invention adopts high performance liquid chromatography, uses the mobile phase to carry out gradient elution, uses gallic acid and ellagic acid as reference substances, establishes the HPLC characteristic spectrum of the acalypha australis medicinal material, decoction pieces, standard decoction and the formula particles thereof, has good repeatability and precision, and has stable and reliable method, and the quality of the acalypha australis medicinal material, decoction pieces, standard decoction and the formula particles thereof can be controlled.

title_en: Battery testing equipment and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses battery testing equipment and a battery testing method, which solve the problems of poor battery testing compatibility, low power conversion efficiency and insufficient voltage stability in the prior art by an integrated rack, a tray, a detection assembly and a power assembly. In particular, the scheme of the high-voltage direct current conversion and DCDC module not only improves the accuracy and efficiency of charge and discharge test, but also simplifies the equipment structure, reduces the maintenance difficulty and the operation cost, enhances the safety in the test process, is suitable for the test requirements of various battery types, and shows remarkable technical progress and practical value.

title_en: Processing method and device for mesoscale vortex vertical structure and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a processing method, a processing device and electronic equipment for a medium-scale vortex vertical structure, which can be applied to the technical field of underwater observation. The method comprises the steps of obtaining section data of a plurality of sections of a single underwater glider in a mesoscale vortex, obtaining vertical densities of the sections according to the section data of the sections, determining N section sections from the sections according to the vertical densities of the sections, wherein N is a positive integer, constructing a multi-element ordinal mode sequence of each of the N section sections according to the vertical density difference of adjacent sections in each section of the N section sections, wherein the multi-element ordinal mode sequence represents structural characteristics of the sections of the mesoscale vortex at different depths, and obtaining a visual result of the mesoscale vortex vertical structure according to the multi-element ordinal mode sequence of each of the N section sections.

title_en: Water quality detection sampling device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water quality detection, in particular to a water quality detection sampling device which comprises a shell, a floating body and a filtering frame, wherein the shell is of a cylindrical hollow structure, the floating body is arranged in the middle of the outer side of the shell and used for driving the shell to float on the water surface, the filtering frame is arranged at the lower end of the outer side of the shell and is uniformly provided with filtering holes, the filtering frame is used for filtering floating matters on the upper layer of the water surface, the sampling assembly is arranged in the shell and used for sampling water quality of different depths in a plurality of areas one by one, when the sampling tube descends to the lowest position, the sampling tube is just opened, the sampling tube is vertically inserted into the water, the collecting tubes with different heights on the sampling tube can perform a layered sampling function, and the sampling tubes can perform layered sampling on the water quality of different samples one by one.

title_en: Pipeline system and sample scheduling method
abstract_en: The invention provides a pipeline system and a sample scheduling method, wherein the pipeline system comprises a plurality of sample analyzers, a first identification device and a controller, wherein the plurality of sample analyzers are used for executing at least one detection item on samples, the first identification device is used for detecting whether the sample analyzers are in contact with sample containers below in the descending process of the sample analyzers, the controller is used for controlling the sample analyzers and the first identification device to work and judging whether the first identification device is in contact with the sample containers according to feedback information of the first identification device, when the first identification device is judged to be in contact with the sample containers, the descending height of the first identification device is obtained, the type of the sample containers is judged according to the descending height, whether the type of the sample containers is matched with item information is judged, and the sample containers are distributed to the corresponding sample analyzers or recycled according to the matching result. The invention can prevent the unmatched sample containers from being distributed to the sample analyzer, so that the sample analyzer cannot detect the unmatched sample containers.

title_en: Load series arc detection method, system and device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a load series arc detection method, a system and a device, which belong to the technical field of fault arc detection and comprise the steps of collecting target data to be detected and circuit signals for normal operation of a circuit under various loads, including load current waveforms, load voltage, current and fault arc voltage signals, calculating according to the circuit signals to obtain a volt-ampere characteristic standard curve, wherein the volt-ampere characteristic curve comprises the volt-ampere characteristic standard curve and a target volt-ampere characteristic curve of the target data to be detected, carrying out matching comparison on the target volt-ampere characteristic curve of the target data to be detected and the volt-ampere characteristic standard curve, judging whether the target data to be detected is a fault arc, and if the target data to be detected is judged to be the fault arc, carrying out fault arc positioning on the target data to be detected.

title_en: Battery clamp performance test equipment and test method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a battery clamp performance test device and a test method thereof, wherein the battery clamp performance test device comprises test paper, a piece to be tested and a mounting bottom plate, a side fixing block is arranged on the mounting bottom plate, a connecting rod is connected in a rotating manner in the side fixing block, the piece to be tested is arranged in the side fixing block through the connecting rod, the test paper is positioned at one side of a clamp opening of the piece to be tested, a mounting bin is arranged on the mounting bottom plate, and the mounting bin comprises bin brackets at two sides. The invention can provide the battery clamp performance test equipment, the test method and the use method thereof, and has the beneficial effects of improving the test precision and efficiency, realizing automatic test, intuitively reflecting the performance of the to-be-tested piece, facilitating data recording and analysis, enhancing the flexibility and expandability of the equipment, improving the test safety and the like. The accuracy and the reliability of the test result are ensured, and powerful support is provided for quality control and performance improvement of the battery clamp product.

title_en: Semiconductor testing device, equipment and semiconductor testing method
abstract_en: The application provides a semiconductor testing device, equipment and a semiconductor testing method, wherein the semiconductor testing device comprises a first passage, a second passage and a main control unit, the main control unit is connected with equipment to be tested through a signal transmission line, the first passage and the second passage comprise analog-to-digital converters, a first signal end of the first passage is connected with the main control unit, a second signal end of the first passage is connected with the equipment to be tested, the first passage is used for measuring voltage and/or current of the equipment to be tested, the first signal end of the second passage is connected with the signal transmission line, the second signal end is connected with the analog-to-digital converters, the second passage is used for collecting communication signals transmitted by the signal transmission line to obtain collected signals, the analog-to-digital converters are used for sending the collected signals to the main control unit, and the semiconductor testing device is used for realizing waveform collection based on function multiplexing of the analog-to-digital converters.

title_en: Evaluation method for bacteriostasis of chemical oral solution
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of medicine analysis, in particular to a method for evaluating the bacteriostasis of a chemical oral solution. The evaluation method comprises the steps of preparing bacterial suspension of a bacterial strain, drawing a test group growth curve, obtaining lambda, mu  max  and OD  max  according to the test group growth curve, drawing a control group growth curve, obtaining lambda  0 、μ max0  and OD  max0  according to the control group growth curve, and judging that a sample to be tested has antibacterial property when at least one of lambda/lambda  0 ＞1、μ max /μ max0 ＜1、OD max /OD max0  <1 conditions is met, wherein the larger the lambda/lambda  0  value is, the smaller the mu  max /μ max0  value is, and the smaller the OD  max /OD max0  value is, the stronger the antibacterial property of the sample to be tested is. The invention realizes high-flux and rapid evaluation of the bacteriostasis of the chemical oral solution.

title_en: Geological ecological monitoring system and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological ecological monitoring, in particular to a geological ecological monitoring system and a geological ecological monitoring method. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a monitoring area topographic map, utilizing a sensor network to conduct real-time data acquisition according to the monitoring area topographic map, conducting rock-soil physical characteristic matrix construction to obtain a rock-soil physical characteristic matrix, conducting rock-soil mechanical response spectrum construction according to the rock-soil physical characteristic matrix to obtain a rock-soil mechanical response spectrum, conducting slope geometric model construction according to the monitoring area topographic map through point cloud data processing to obtain a slope three-dimensional geometric model, conducting unit stress analysis according to the slope three-dimensional geometric model to obtain unit stress data, conducting strength reduction calculation according to the unit stress data to obtain a reduction strength parameter. The invention better serves the control of geological disasters and the protection of ecological environment through comprehensive, dynamic and systematic monitoring and evaluation of the geological ecological system.

title_en: Laser scanning device for deformation detection of storage tank
abstract_en: The invention is applicable to the technical field of laser detection, and provides a laser scanning device for detecting deformation of a storage tank, which comprises a detection main body, a supporting component, a cleaning component, a storage component and a shading component; the supporting component is arranged in the detection main body and comprises a supporting plate, the end face and the free end of the supporting plate are both connected with supporting blocks, the outer wall surface of the supporting plate is provided with fixing blocks, the supporting and storage of the laser scanning unit can be conveniently achieved through the arrangement of the supporting component and the storage component, the laser scanning unit is not required to be held by a worker, the supporting component is not required to be arranged on a support, the supporting leg and the storage leg can be used for adjusting the supporting height of the laser scanning unit, the supporting component is convenient to store after the supporting component is used, the carrying difficulty is reduced, the scanning lens of the laser scanning unit can be cleaned through the movement of the supporting component through the arrangement of the cleaning component, and the influence on the detection result due to accumulation of a large amount of dust is avoided.

title_en: Method and device for establishing prediction model, and method and device for predicting interception efficiency
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a method and a device for establishing a prediction model, and a method and a device for predicting interception efficiency, and relates to the field of cigarette performance analysis. The method for establishing the prediction model comprises the steps of obtaining a mass transfer model and a heat transfer model of aerosol particles in a filter part of a cigarette, obtaining a trapping model of the filter part on the aerosol particles, and establishing a prediction model of trapping efficiency of the filter part according to the mass transfer model, the heat transfer model and the trapping model. In this way, the quality of the relevant smoke components in the smoke flowing out of the cigarettes can be predicted more accurately, and the accuracy of the established prediction model of the interception efficiency is higher.

title_en: Ground levelness mapping equipment for mapping engineering
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of surveying and mapping engineering, and particularly relates to ground levelness surveying and mapping equipment for surveying and mapping engineering, which comprises a base, wherein four screw holes formed in the upper surface of the base and close to four corners are respectively inserted with an adjusting screw, the surface of the base is provided with a surveying and mapping assembly, the surveying and mapping assembly comprises an L-shaped supporting rod, an external screw thread pipe sleeve, a first rectangular frame, a first hexagonal rod and a built-in pipe sleeve, the built-in pipe sleeve is inserted in a first circular groove formed in the upper surface of the base, a paper roll can be vertically moved according to the ground level condition, a recording pen draws a tortuous continuous line segment on paper on the surface of the paper roll to reflect the ground leveling condition, and a sliding block slides to pull a counterweight ball through a stay cord to store force in the rotation of the L-shaped supporting rod, so that the rotation radius is automatically changed, and the surveying and mapping range is adjusted.

title_en: Vibration probe positioning tool and vibration measurement method of vibration probe
abstract_en: The application provides a vibration probe positioning tool and a vibration measuring method of a vibration probe, the vibration probe positioning tool comprises a telescopic device, a universal adjusting device and a probe clamping adjusting device which are sequentially connected. The probe clamping and adjusting device is used for clamping vibration measuring probes with different specifications. The universal adjusting device is used for adjusting the clamping angle of the probe clamping adjusting device for clamping the vibration measuring probe. The telescopic device is used for adjusting the telescopic length of the vibrating probe positioning tool. The application solves the problem that the vibration measurement of the mechanical equipment parts is difficult under the complex condition by arranging the telescopic device, the universal adjusting device and the probe clamping and adjusting device.

title_en: Suspension cable segment model vortex-induced vibration and pressure measurement wind tunnel test system
abstract_en: The invention provides a vortex-induced vibration measuring and pressure measuring wind tunnel test system for a suspension cable segment model, which belongs to the technical field of wind tunnel tests and comprises a supporting frame, a wind deflection angle adjusting frame, an inclination angle adjusting frame, a plurality of pressure measuring pipe adjusting brackets, a plurality of laser displacement meters and pressure measuring scanning valves, wherein the wind deflection angle adjusting frame is connected with the supporting frame in a sliding mode and has a degree of freedom of rotating around the Z axial direction, the inclination angle adjusting frame is connected with the wind deflection angle adjusting frame in a sliding mode in a horizontal plane, the inclination angle adjusting frame is used for being connected with the suspension cable segment model and adjusting the posture, the laser displacement meters are respectively and correspondingly connected with the pressure measuring pipe adjusting brackets, the laser displacement meters are used for monitoring displacement of the suspension cable segment model in the wind tunnel test, and the pressure measuring scanning valves are used for monitoring wind pressure of model surface streaming. The invention has the technical effects of being capable of flexibly adjusting the posture of the stay cable segment model in multiple dimensions, simultaneously carrying out vibration measurement and pressure measurement tests, having accurate test data and high test efficiency.

title_en: Height test control method and system for vehicle headlight and vehicle controller
abstract_en: The application relates to a height test control method, a system and a vehicle controller of a vehicle headlight, which relate to the technical field of vehicle test control and comprise the steps of responding to the test vehicle entering a test area, obtaining the vehicle model of the test vehicle, and reading a test template and static attitude data corresponding to the vehicle model; the method comprises the steps of reading sensor data of a test vehicle, calculating dynamic posture data of the test vehicle by using the sensor data, predicting the height of a vehicle headlight by using a test template according to the static posture data and the dynamic posture data to obtain a set headlight height value, reading an actual headlight height value of the test vehicle from the sensor data, displaying the actual headlight height value, the set headlight height value and a height difference value on a central display screen of the test vehicle, and adjusting the height of the vehicle headlight according to the height difference value in response to headlight height adjustment operation. The application has the effects of improving the height test efficiency of the vehicle headlight and realizing the fine adjustment of the height of the vehicle headlight.

title_en: Mixed gas concentration detection method based on temperature modulation technology
abstract_en: A mixed gas concentration detection method based on a temperature modulation technology relates to the field of semiconductor gas sensing. The method solves the problem that the concentration of the mixed gas is predicted at present and is difficult to analyze more accurately. According to the invention, the characteristic of the gas-sensitive response data expanded under the scale of the space domain is realized through the temperature modulation technology, the LSTM neural network model is adopted to process the time sequence data, the characteristic information contained in the sequence data is fully mined, and the combination of the characteristic information and the LSTM neural network model remarkably improves the recognition accuracy of the concentration of the mixed gas. The invention is mainly used for detecting the concentration of H  2  and CO gas released from the transformer oil during faults.

title_en: Bluetooth anti-theft system for police high-speed lacrimator equipment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of police instruments, in particular to a Bluetooth anti-theft system for a police high-speed lacrimator device, which comprises a lacrimator gun body, a gun sleeve, a first Bluetooth module and a second Bluetooth module, wherein the first Bluetooth module is arranged on the gun sleeve, the second Bluetooth module is arranged on a circuit board arranged in the lacrimator gun body, and the first Bluetooth module and the second Bluetooth module are connected through short-distance wireless signals. According to the invention, the first Bluetooth module is arranged in the gun sleeve, the second Bluetooth module is arranged on the circuit board in the lacrimator gun body, the two Bluetooth modules are mutually and wirelessly connected, when the lacrimator gun body is far away from the gun sleeve, the signal connection relation between Bluetooth can be disconnected, and then the line switch is disconnected, so that the lacrimation pressurizing water pump in the lacrimator gun body cannot work normally, the anti-theft purpose is achieved, the lacrimator gun body cannot be used normally after being stolen by a gangster, and the problems that the lacrimator is easy to be stolen and the hazard is increased in the present stage are solved.

title_en: Pressure sensor and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a pressure sensor and a preparation method thereof, wherein the pressure sensor comprises a substrate, a semiconductor layer, a dielectric layer, a lead structure and a packaging shell, wherein the substrate comprises a plurality of first cavities and second cavities and vent holes communicated with the second cavities, the first cavities and the second cavities are distributed in an array, the semiconductor layer is stacked on the upper surface of the substrate, four piezoresistors which are uniformly distributed and comprise at least one resistor area are arranged in the edge area of the upper surface layer of the semiconductor layer above the openings of the first cavities and the second cavities, the upper surface layer of the semiconductor layer above the first cavities and the second cavities is provided with the lead area, the dielectric layer covers the upper surface of the semiconductor layer, the dielectric layer is provided with contact holes, the lead structure is positioned on the upper surface of the dielectric layer and fills the contact holes, the packaging shell packages sensor units, and the top wall and the bottom wall of the packaging shell are respectively provided with the first pressure holes and the second pressure holes. According to the invention, absolute pressure sensors and gauge pressure sensors which are arranged in an array are integrated in the same sensor, so that the influence of temperature on the output characteristics of the sensor is eliminated.

title_en: Method for testing bonding strength between ceramic shell layers
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for testing bonding strength between ceramic shell layers, which comprises the steps of testing the interlayer high-temperature bonding strength of a1 st layer and a2 nd layer of a shell, testing the interlayer normal-temperature or wet bonding strength of the 1 st layer and the 2 nd layer of the shell, testing the high-temperature bonding strength of other layers of the shell, and testing the normal-temperature/wet bonding strength of other layers of ceramic shell layers.

title_en: Tapping switch oil chamber oil flow velocity detection sensing system and working method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a tapping switch oil chamber oil flow velocity detection sensing system and a working method thereof. When the flow velocity equipment works, the distributed optical fiber vibration sensing system demodulates and analyzes the phase of light transmitted by the optical fiber at each nesting point, and the real-time monitoring of the oil flow velocity is realized according to the corresponding relation between the phase change and the flow velocity. The invention can collect the oil flow state data of the oil chamber during the switching of the tapping switch for a long time, the collected data has strong objectivity, the real-time flow velocity can be truly obtained, and the real-time monitoring of the tapping switch state is facilitated.

title_en: Ground receiving end positioning method and system for enhancing low-orbit satellite opportunistic signal based on OTFS modulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ground receiving end positioning method based on OTFS modulation enhanced low-orbit satellite opportunistic signals, which comprises the steps of obtaining real-time position and speed information of E satellites to obtain first data, modulating E-group random low-orbit satellite opportunistic signals based on OTFS modulation technology to obtain a first signal set, carrying out satellite-ground communication link level simulation according to the first signal set and a signal transmission model to obtain a second signal set, carrying out tracking sampling on the E satellites according to the second signal set and obtaining sampling signals respectively to obtain sampling signal sets, obtaining Doppler frequency shift measured values of the E satellites according to the sampling signal set and a signal processing algorithm, constructing a positioning equation set according to the first data and the Doppler frequency shift measured values of the E satellites and a Doppler positioning principle, and solving the positioning equation set to obtain the position information of the ground receiving end. The invention also discloses a ground receiving end positioning system for enhancing the low-orbit satellite opportunistic signal based on OTFS modulation.

title_en: Multispectral satellite fireproof method and multispectral satellite fireproof system based on data identification
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-spectrum satellite fireproof method and a system based on data identification, wherein a multi-spectrum satellite optical sensor array scans a target area for 30 minutes, acquires data through a high-precision attitude system and a formula, acquires quality through self-adaptive filtering and multi-source data correction, extracts fire characteristic construction vectors through dynamic threshold and wavelet transformation, inputs a fusion model to judge fire in real time, transmits early warning information containing position, fire and the like to a ground command center within 8 minutes, updates data every 10 minutes during fire, evaluates fire according to multiple indexes by combining a GIS and a time sequence model, adjusts strategies and stores the data. The invention has the advantages of rapid data acquisition and processing, early warning in 8 minutes, accuracy exceeding 92 percent, 15 minutes in advance for prejudging fire, stable system, high-efficiency data processing and conservation of ecology and life and property safety.

title_en: Air inlet device for gas turbine test bed
abstract_en: The invention discloses an air inlet device for a gas turbine test bed, which comprises a gas treatment box, a fixed support welded at the lower end of the gas treatment box, a gas turbine air inlet pipe arranged at the right end of the gas treatment box, and an air inlet groove arranged at the left end of the gas treatment box, wherein the docking mechanism is arranged at the right end of the gas treatment box, compression limiting is carried out between a connecting plate and the gas turbine air inlet pipe through a fixed pressing strip, and a gas treatment net is inserted and installed at the right end of the gas treatment box. This an air inlet unit for gas turbine test bench can dock the gas turbine intake pipe of equidimension not, can remove dust and purification treatment to gas through the gas treatment net, simultaneously in dust removal process, can clean the dust of adhesion on the gas treatment net through the cleaning brush, guarantees the unobstructed of whole filtration purification process, is convenient for dismantle clearance and change the gas treatment net moreover.

title_en: Triaxial stabilized platform servo loop gain variation value calibration and compensation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a calibration and compensation method for a gain variation value of a servo loop of a triaxial stabilized platform. Firstly, a table body shaft, an inner frame shaft and an outer frame shaft are arranged at the positions of 0 degree, 0 degree and 0 degree, a servo loop is closed, sine waves are input by external test equipment, output signals of a triaxial stabilized platform are collected, the amplitude values of the input signals and the output signals under different frequencies are calculated, and an open-loop amplitude-frequency characteristic curve of the current position of the triaxial stabilized platform is obtained. Next, the gain variation values of the servo loops of the inner frame shaft at different angles were calculated every time the inner frame shaft was rotated by 10 °. And finally, fitting a function between the angle of the inner frame shaft and the gain change value through the calibration data, and compensating the function into the outer frame shaft servo loop gain. The invention provides a calibration and compensation method for the gain variation value of the triaxial stabilized platform servo loop under the condition of uncertain rotational inertia for the first time, and ensures the stability of the servo loop when the platform frame system is at any position of an inner frame.

title_en: Atomic magnetometer probe based on hyperpolarized nuclear spin measurement magnetic field and detection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an atomic magnetometer probe based on a hyperpolarized nuclear spin measurement magnetic field and a detection method, and the atomic magnetometer probe comprises a probe body, wherein a cavity for accommodating an alkali metal air chamber is formed in one end part of the probe body,  3  He atoms and alkali metals are filled in the air chamber, pump light holes and detection holes corresponding to the positions are formed in two side walls of the cavity respectively, a right-angle prism is correspondingly arranged with the pump light holes, a photoelectric detector is correspondingly arranged with the detection holes, radio-frequency magnetic field biplane coils are arranged on the upper surface and the lower surface of the cavity respectively, a heating optical fiber hole and a pump optical fiber hole are formed in the other end part of the probe body, one end of the pump laser optical fiber is inserted into the pump optical fiber hole, the other end of the pump laser optical fiber is connected with a pump laser, one end of the heating laser optical fiber is inserted into the heating optical fiber hole, the other end of the heating laser optical fiber is connected with the heating laser, pump light emitted by the pump laser enters the right-angle prism through a first optical path structure, and laser light emitted by the pump laser enters the air chamber through a second optical path structure.

title_en: MEMS chip micro-system for sensing and detecting characteristic information and frequency domain characteristic information sensing and detecting micro-system applied to underwater and working method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of information and underwater sound engineering, and particularly relates to a micro-system for sensing and detecting MEMS (micro-electromechanical systems) chips by using characteristic information and a frequency domain characteristic information sensing and detecting micro-system applied to underwater and a working method thereof. The MEMS chip microsystem for sensing and detecting the characteristic information is formed by integrating and packaging a characteristic sensing chip, a characteristic information processing chip, a characteristic information detection chip and a target detection chip. The method comprises the steps of carrying out targeted sensitivity on external frequency domain characteristic information and outputting an electrical signal according to the frequency domain characteristic information, carrying out matching processing on the characteristic sensing signal by a characteristic information processing chip, judging whether the characteristic information exists or not according to a dynamic threshold value to give a result by the characteristic information detection chip, carrying out logic filtering detection according to a target characteristic preset vector group by a target detection chip, judging whether a target exists or not, and outputting the result. The microsystem has the capability of selectively and highly sensitively acquiring the characteristic information of the underwater frequency domain, the capability of detecting the characteristic information or the target, and the characteristics of extremely low power consumption and small scale, and is suitable for carrying an unmanned small platform to complete the monitoring and early warning task. And supporting the rapid edge decision based on the presence or absence of the characteristic information inside and outside the wide area boundary.

title_en: Tunnel double-parameter safety evaluation index construction method based on dislocation and strong earthquake coupling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for constructing a tunnel double-parameter safety evaluation index based on dislocation and strong shock coupling, and belongs to the technical field of tunnel safety evaluation. The method comprises the steps of obtaining tunnel characteristic parameters and stratum rock-soil mechanical characteristic parameters, determining fault dislocation size, selecting seismic waves conforming to a standard spectrum, establishing a multi-characteristic coupling nonlinear dynamic finite element numerical analysis model, calculating an incremental dynamic time course based on the fault dislocation size and the selected seismic waves by adopting the nonlinear dynamic finite element numerical analysis model to obtain a dynamic response curve of a tunnel lining structure under the action of multiple disasters, establishing a tunnel dual-parameter safety index function considering coupling effects based on tunnel radial convergence rate and plastic strain, and determining index damage states and threshold division based on the tunnel dual-parameter safety index function and lining response-structure performance curve, wherein the index damage states and the threshold division are used as tunnel dual-parameter safety evaluation indexes.

title_en: Method for measuring microscopic residual stress of large crystal grains of nickel-based alloy
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for measuring microscopic residual stress of large crystal grains of nickel-base alloy, which comprises the steps of directionally cutting selected large crystal grains to be measured of nickel-base alloy by using a focused ion beam, cutting out micro-scale islands, measuring the crystal grains before and after cutting by using a micro-area X-ray diffraction method, and obtaining deformation of materials before and after cutting, so that the microscopic residual stress in the large crystal grains of nickel-base alloy is calculated, the microscopic residual stress in the large crystal grains of nickel-base alloy can be accurately measured, and the error of a measurement result is obviously reduced compared with the prior method.

title_en: Device and method for measuring interfacial tension of multiphase fluid of simulated high-temperature reservoir
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of interfacial tension measurement, in particular to a device and a method for measuring multiphase fluid interfacial tension of a simulated high-temperature reservoir, which solve the problems that only a single sample can be centrifugally measured, the measurement efficiency is low, the sample is inconvenient to replace and observe and measure, and the measurement is easy to be interfered by the outside when the conventional rotary drop interfacial tension meter is used for measuring the interfacial tension. The utility model provides a simulation high temperature reservoir multiphase fluid interfacial tension measuring device and method, includes measurement control mechanism, observes adjustment mechanism and centrifugal heat preservation mechanism, the up end of measurement control mechanism is installed and is observed adjustment mechanism, observe the one end of adjustment mechanism and install centrifugal heat preservation mechanism, measurement control mechanism includes the support base, centrifugal heat preservation mechanism includes the installation cover that separates the heat. According to the invention, the synchronous temperature-increasing centrifugation is carried out on a plurality of samples, so that the measurement efficiency can be effectively improved, the samples can be conveniently replaced and protected for measurement, and the measurement accuracy is prevented from being interfered by external light.

title_en: Method and system for detecting quality of bonding tool of bonding alloy wire
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of bonding tools, in particular to a method and a system for detecting the quality of a bonding alloy wire bonding tool, wherein the detection method comprises the steps of matching size detection, elasticity detection, roughness detection, strength and hardness detection; the method comprises the steps of matching size detection, namely measuring original spacing data of a target part in a bonding tool by adopting a three-coordinate measuring instrument, converting the original spacing data into the target spacing data by using a mark analysis algorithm and a semantic mapping algorithm, elastic detection, namely calculating the size of the elastic part in the bonding tool by using an elastic modulus, strength and hardness detection, namely obtaining the strength and hardness of a plurality of test points by using strength and hardness tests, and calculating standard deviations of the strength and the hardness. The invention indirectly obtains the size and the flatness of the object by using the elasticity, the strength and the hardness detection data, and combines the detection of the size, thereby widening the quality detection range of the bonding tool, improving the detection precision and the efficiency and ensuring the reliability and the stability of the bonding tool.

title_en: Method, system, equipment and medium for detecting long-strip light spots
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a system, equipment and a medium for detecting strip light spots, which comprise the steps of adjusting the position of a light spot analyzer according to actual conditions, collecting partial light spot graph data and enabling the light spot analyzer to move step by step until the whole light spot is measured, covering the whole light spot, carrying out sectional detection on the linear light spot by adopting the light spot analyzer, then carrying out integration and analysis processing, obtaining a distribution effect graph of the whole light spot, comparing with a theoretical imaging light spot effect, obtaining whether the actual light spot meets the use requirement, further guiding the adjustment of an optical system, and improving the use efficiency of the light spot.

title_en: Multifunctional pigsty environment regulation and epidemic disease early warning device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional pigsty environment regulation and epidemic disease early warning device, which belongs to the technical field of cultivation and comprises a control unit, a fence, an infrared temperature sensor and a pump assembly for supplying disinfectant or cleaning liquid, wherein a linear motor is fixedly connected to the longitudinal edge and the transverse edge of any side of the fence, a positioning box is fixedly connected to the output end of the linear motor, the infrared temperature sensor and the pump assembly are fixedly connected to the inner side wall of the positioning box, a radio microphone is fixedly connected to the outer wall of the positioning box, and the linear motor, the infrared temperature sensor, the pump assembly, the radio microphone and a dust sensor are in signal connection with the control unit, and the control unit is provided with a sick pig judging module, a positioning tracking module, a disinfection control module and a dust judging module. The method is scientific and reasonable, and realizes accurate regulation and control of pig house environment and sick pigs and timely early warning of epidemic diseases by automatically controlling and tracking the sick pigs so as to improve pig raising efficiency and health level of pigs.

title_en: Emergency locking simulation test device for automobile seat belt
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency locking simulation test device for an automobile seat belt, which relates to the field of automobile safety detection and comprises a support frame, wherein the top of the support frame is symmetrically and slidingly connected with a sliding table, one side of the top of the support frame is symmetrically provided with a retractor, the top of the support frame is symmetrically provided with a safety belt to be tested, one end of the safety belt to be tested is wound in the corresponding retractor, the other end of the safety belt to be tested is connected with the corresponding sliding table, and the other side of the top of the support frame is internally and rotationally connected with a guide shaft.

title_en: Experimental device for testing permeability characteristics of undisturbed sandstone
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of soil infiltration experiments, in particular to an experimental device for testing the infiltration characteristics of undisturbed sandstone, which comprises a sample tank, a moisture temperature sensor, a water supply system and a water collecting barrel, wherein the moisture temperature sensor is arranged on the outer side wall of the sample tank, the water supply system is connected with the top end of the sample tank, the water collecting barrel is arranged below the sample tank, the bottom end of the sample tank is provided with a water permeable plate, the top end of the sample tank is provided with a glass cover, the inside of the sample tank is provided with water permeable stones and a sandstone sample to be tested, the water permeable stones are arranged above the sandstone sample to be tested, and fine sand, broken stone and gauze are sequentially arranged below the sandstone to be tested.

title_en: Exciton state energy level detection method based on plasmon enhanced nonlinear spectrum
abstract_en: The invention relates to the fields of nanophotography and optical materials, in particular to an exciton state energy level detection method based on plasmon enhanced nonlinear spectrum, which comprises the steps of constructing a mixed nano cavity structure of a single-layer two-dimensional material coupled with a plasmon cavity; the method comprises the steps of collecting two-photon photoluminescence spectrum, second harmonic spectrum and third harmonic spectrum of a single-layer two-dimensional material in a mixed nano cavity structure, improving the intensity of nonlinear optical signals through the local enhancement effect of plasmons, and determining dark exciton state energy level, bright state and dark exciton state energy level of the single-layer two-dimensional material and high-energy exciton state energy level of the single-layer two-dimensional material according to the two-photon photoluminescence spectrum, the second harmonic spectrum and the third harmonic spectrum of the single-layer two-dimensional material. The invention can accurately detect the energy level of the Redberg exciton state of the semiconductor material with the nano-scale thickness.

title_en: Automatic detection device for lamp bead test of LED lamp strip
abstract_en: The application discloses an automatic detection device for testing lamp beads of an LED lamp strip, and belongs to the technical field of LED lamp strip testing. The automatic lamp strip winding and unwinding device mainly comprises a workbench, a discharging device used for installing a lamp strip disc is arranged on one side of the top surface of the workbench, a receiving device used for winding the lamp strip disc is arranged on the other side of the top surface of the workbench, a lamp bead detection bin used for detecting an LED lamp strip is fixedly arranged between the discharging device and the receiving device, the inside of the lamp bead detection bin is divided into a dust removal area and a detection area through a partition plate, the detection area comprises a press belt assembly and a detection assembly, rapid and continuous detection can be realized by combining the winding and unwinding of the LED lamp strip with the detection of the lamp beads, each lamp bead can reliably emit light and can be accurately identified, the press belt assembly and a conductive terminal effectively maintain the flatness of the LED lamp strip, and a power supply contact is ensured to be accurately contacted, so that the damage risk of the lamp beads is reduced, the production efficiency is improved, the product quality is also facilitated, and errors caused by manual operation are reduced.

title_en: Portable positioning instrument for detecting quality of underground UWB signals of coal mine and detection method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mine safety production, in particular to a portable positioning instrument for detecting the quality of an underground UWB signal of a coal mine and a detection method thereof. The portable positioning instrument for detecting the underground UWB signal quality of the coal mine comprises a main control module, a power supply module and a user interface component, wherein the power supply module is used for providing a safe power supply for the positioning instrument, the main control module comprises a main control MCU and three UWB ranging modules, the main control MCU is preloaded with an Android operating system, the three UWB ranging modules are synchronous by using the same crystal vibration and are used for performing PDOA positioning on a positioning base station, the user interface component comprises an IPS touch screen, and an operator performs interface interaction with the main control MCU through the IPS touch screen. The invention solves the problems that in the underground accurate positioning system based on UWB, the signal coverage quality cannot be quantitatively tested and graphically displayed and can only be gradually optimized by means of empirical test, thereby greatly improving the working efficiency of practitioners and shortening the period of mine safety production and construction.

title_en: Automatic change communication navigation test simulation system architecture
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic communication navigation test simulation system architecture, which provides an automatic and integrated test system in the batch production test process of aircraft communication navigation equipment, efficiently utilizes test resources, realizes reuse of test cases, liberates human resources, integrates various equipment functions into a whole, constructs a unified hardware interface, realizes unified integrated control of equipment, greatly improves the automation degree and the expandability of equipment test, realizes performance test and data management of different aircraft equipment, and improves the test efficiency and the equipment installation quality in an omnibearing and multi-angle manner. The invention provides an automatic communication navigation test simulation system and a test method, which can provide a communication navigation equipment test interface and a control logic test function, have the function performance automatic test capability and realize the automatic integrated test of different aircraft communication navigation equipment.

title_en: Transmission load spectrum generation method, device, vehicle and medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of a transmission, in particular to a method, a device, a vehicle and a medium for generating a load spectrum of the transmission, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring respective environmental data and operation data of a plurality of test vehicles; determining a load spectrum of a corresponding test vehicle according to the running data, segmenting the running data into a plurality of scene segment data according to the target scenes of the plurality of dimensions, determining a test score of the corresponding test vehicle according to the load spectrum of the test vehicle and the corresponding scene segment data, selecting the target test vehicle from the plurality of test vehicles according to the test score, and generating a load spectrum of a transmission according to the load spectrum of each scene segment data of the target test vehicle. Therefore, the problems of limited number of vehicles to be tested, insufficient scene representativeness, single driving style, high cost and the like in the related technology are solved.

title_en: Truck lithium battery testing method and device based on Bluetooth communication
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of battery testing, and discloses a method and a device for testing a lithium battery of a truck based on Bluetooth communication. The method comprises the steps of performing intelligent remote matching processing on Bluetooth identification information of a truck lithium battery management system to obtain a remote Bluetooth control key, performing lithium battery data acquisition protocol test processing to obtain a dual-channel acquisition instruction set, performing dynamic voltage, current and temperature collaborative acquisition processing on the dual-channel acquisition instruction set to obtain a multi-dimensional battery working condition characteristic spectrum, performing remote parameter linkage calibration processing on the multi-dimensional battery working condition characteristic spectrum to obtain an intelligent calibration control sequence, performing remote charge and discharge management test processing to obtain a battery running state monitoring record, and performing remote health evaluation processing on the battery running state monitoring record to obtain a lithium battery performance test report. The application provides a lithium battery test scheme which does not need physical connection, is simple and convenient to operate and has the capability of monitoring in real time, so that the test efficiency and the flexibility are improved.

title_en: Intelligent photovoltaic junction box testing method and system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of fault detection, in particular to an intelligent photovoltaic junction box testing method and system, which specifically comprise the steps of constructing a voltage-current dissimilarity index based on data changes of current and voltage of the intelligent photovoltaic junction box at adjacent moments, and constructing an electrical parameter anomaly coefficient by combining the relativity between the voltage and the ambient temperature; the photovoltaic junction box fault detection method based on the time series correlation of the temperature inside the photovoltaic junction box and other parameters and the electrical parameter anomaly coefficient is used for constructing the fault confidence coefficient of the photovoltaic junction box, anomaly detection of the photovoltaic junction box is carried out based on the fault confidence coefficient, influence of environmental factors on relevant data of the photovoltaic junction box is reduced, the problem that false detection is easily caused due to unreasonable threshold setting when the existing photovoltaic junction box detection technology passes through temperature threshold detection is avoided, the detection precision of the photovoltaic junction box is improved, and false detection is avoided.

title_en: Novel fractured reservoir geological cause modeling method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological modeling, in particular to a novel geological cause modeling method of a fractured carbonate reservoir, which comprises the following steps of dividing the fractured carbonate reservoir into two main categories of matrixes and cracks according to the difference of a reservoir space and a seepage channel, and modeling step by step; dividing the crack into two types of large scale and medium scale according to the scale difference, establishing crack models of different scales step by step, classifying and modeling by adopting different methods according to the difference of the crack scales when the crack is modeled, counting crack elements according to the crack of different scales, classifying and assigning the porosity, permeability and saturation of the crack, and equivalently combining the matrix model and the crack model to establish a three-dimensional model. The invention establishes the three-dimensional geological model which accurately reflects the real distribution situation of the underground cracks, more accurately describes the three-dimensional spatial distribution characteristics of the crack type carbonate rock hydrocarbon reservoir matrix and the cracks, and the result can reflect the underground real geological information.

title_en: Nitrogen-doped fluorescent carbon dot for ferric iron detection and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nitrogen-doped fluorescent carbon dot for ferric iron detection and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of chemical detection.
