The nitrogen-doped fluorescent carbon dot is prepared from erythromycin and L-isoleucine serving as raw materials by a hydrothermal method. The invention prepares red nitrogen doped fluorescent carbon dots (N-CDs) with high yield (70%) by hydro-thermal treatment of L-isoleucine and erythromycin. The obtained N-CDs have high selectivity and sensitivity to Fe  3+ , and have wide application prospects in sensors, detection platforms and environment monitoring systems. The N-CDs-based high biocompatibility and low toxicity can be successfully used for multicolor cell imaging, and have great potential in the biomedical field.

title_en: Non-metal precision part deformation resistance detection device and use method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to a non-metal precision part deformation resistance detection device and a use method thereof, which relate to the technical field of non-metal precision part detection, wherein the detection device comprises a frame, two sliding seats, two clamping and stretching mechanisms, an extrusion mechanism and a detection mechanism, the two sliding seats are arranged on the frame in a sliding way, the two clamping and stretching mechanisms are used for clamping and positioning the nonmetallic precision piece, driving the two sliding seats to be far away from each other and stretching the nonmetallic precision piece, the extrusion mechanism is used for extruding the nonmetallic precision piece, and the detection mechanism is used for controlling the force and detecting the deformation of the nonmetallic precision piece. According to the application, the requirement of detecting the pressure and the tension independently or simultaneously can be met through the clamping and stretching mechanism, the extrusion mechanism and the detection mechanism, the clamping and stretching mechanism can realize tension detection and simultaneously can realize clamping and positioning of the nonmetallic precision piece during detection of the extrusion mechanism, and the detection efficiency and the detection effect are improved.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and medium for detecting fault line
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a fault line detection method, device, equipment and medium, and relates to the technical field of power distribution networks. The method comprises the steps of obtaining zero sequence current data of all feeder lines in a three-phase circuit after a target time point, wherein the target time point is time when high-resistance ground faults occur in the feeder lines in the three-phase circuit, the zero sequence current data are time sequence data, constructing a zero sequence current array corresponding to the feeder lines based on the zero sequence current data corresponding to the feeder lines, calculating cosine similarity of zero sequence currents among the feeder lines according to the zero sequence current array corresponding to each feeder line, and determining fault feeder lines in all the feeder lines based on the cosine similarity. According to the technical scheme, after the high-resistance grounding fault of the three-phase circuit occurs, the zero-sequence current arrays are constructed based on the zero-sequence current data after the high-resistance grounding fault occurs, the fault feeder lines are accurately identified in the feeder lines according to cosine similarity among the zero-sequence current arrays, and support is provided for electricity safety of the distribution network.

title_en: Local pickling process for specific surface carburized layer of high-temperature carburized steel bearing ring
abstract_en: The invention relates to a bearing detection technology, in particular to a local pickling process for specific surface carburization of a high-temperature carburized steel bearing ring, which comprises the following steps of S1, preparing pickling solution according to the following components by mass ratio, namely, 2-5% of nitric acid, 3-5% of hydrochloric acid, 3-5% of ferric trichloride, 85-90% of water, S2, degreasing and cleaning, S3, protecting before pickling, coating a protective layer outside a local surface of a specific surface carburized layer of the bearing ring, S4, pickling the local surface, pickling for 90-150 seconds, S5, cleaning after pickling, removing the protective layer, and then cleaning, brightening, neutralizing and rust-preventing in sequence, S6, and checking. The invention can rapidly and accurately check whether a carburized layer exists in a certain area of the bearing ring, has uniform pickling corrosion, does not generate over corrosion, can rapidly and accurately check whether the carburized layer exists in a certain area of the bearing ring, and has uniform carburized layer.

title_en: Online in-situ low-temperature high-pressure ultrafast spectrum device, system and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an on-line in-situ low-temperature high-pressure ultrafast spectrum device, a system and a method thereof. The high-pressure device comprises a cold screen with an optical window, a metal ring, a gasket, a first pressurizing air bag, a second pressurizing air bag, a pressurizing metal column, a diamond butt anvil pressing cavity, a first temperature sensor, a second temperature sensor, a heat conducting base, a cryostat and an air pressure controller. The online in-situ pressure calibration and imaging system comprises a continuous light laser, a high-voltage device, an online in-situ pressure optical component and an online in-situ pressure imaging system. The low-temperature high-pressure ultrafast pumping detection system comprises a femtosecond laser, an online in-situ pressure calibration and imaging system, a pumping detection optical component and a pumping detection imaging system. The invention realizes the temperature regulation and control of 6-325K under the high pressure of the pressure regulation of the double air bags, realizes the free increase and decrease pressure regulation and control of the online in-situ at low temperature, continuously regulates and controls the increase and decrease of the pressure within the range of 0-80GPa with the precision of 0.1GPa, and realizes the ultra-fast spectrum and ultra-fast dynamic measurement of the online in-situ low temperature and high pressure.

title_en: Noise phase measurement method and device based on homologous signals
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of precise measurement, and discloses a noise phase measurement method based on homologous signals and a corresponding device. The method comprises the following steps of generating an original signal containing two different frequencies f  1  and f  2  by using the same channel of a signal source under the action of an external trigger clock, dividing the original signal into two beams, obtaining a signal to be detected with the frequency of f  1  by low-pass filtering one beam, obtaining a pilot signal with the frequency of f  2  by band-pass filtering the other beam, combining the two beams to form a double-frequency signal, collecting the double-frequency signal by a single port of a phase meter, extracting phase fluctuation of the signal to be detected and the pilot signal by the phase meter, and finally correcting the phase fluctuation of the signal to be detected by using the phase fluctuation of the pilot signal, thereby obtaining corrected phase fluctuation. Correspondingly, the invention also provides a noise phase measuring device based on the homologous signal for realizing the method.

title_en: Steel plate data tracking method and device
abstract_en: The application provides a steel plate data tracking method and device, which are characterized in that a synchronous instrument is used for controlling a camera to shoot and collect steel plate image information, the length and width of a steel plate are calculated according to a steel plate edge detection algorithm and the steel plate image information, a laser source is used for emitting laser to the upper surface and the lower surface of the steel plate, a linear array CCD assembly is driven by a driving module to collect upper surface and lower surface light spot image information, a signal processing module is used for processing the upper surface and lower surface light spot image information and calculating the thickness of the steel plate according to angle information of the laser source and parameter information of the linear array CCD assembly, the length, the width and the thickness of the steel plate are stored in a measurement database, steel plate information data is obtained from the measurement database through a tracking module, and steel plate automatic tracking data are generated according to the steel plate information data and speed information of a roller way, so that the problems of inaccurate steel plate data tracking and low efficiency are solved.

title_en: Wide-area oxygen sensor chip and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wide-area oxygen sensor chip and a preparation method thereof, wherein a chip substrate layer consists of a first medium layer, a second medium layer, a third medium layer and a fourth medium layer, an oxygen pumping external electrode is arranged on the first medium layer, an oxygen pumping internal electrode is arranged between the first medium layer and the second medium layer, a reference electrode is arranged between the second medium layer and the third medium layer, a heater is arranged between the third medium layer and the fourth medium layer, an electrode part of the reference electrode and the oxygen pumping internal electrode are at least partially overlapped in the projection direction of the third medium layer, and an ion blocking layer is arranged on the electrode part of the reference electrode. According to the invention, the position of the reference electrode is set, and the ion blocking layer is arranged on the reference electrode to reduce the difference of ion diffusion paths from the upper electrode and the lower electrode of the pump oxygen inner electrode to the reference electrode, so that the chip can reach the target internal resistance, the test precision is high, and the test data near lambda=1.0 in the dynamic atmosphere is accurate, and no clutter signal influence exists.

title_en: Method for comprehensively identifying PFAS in environment by combining targeted analysis, suspicious screening and non-targeted identification
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for comprehensively identifying PFAS in an environment by combining targeted analysis, suspicious screening and non-targeted identification. The method comprises the following steps of S1, carrying out liquid chromatography-high resolution mass spectrum fullscan/DDA/DIA analysis on an environmental sample, S2, carrying out liquid chromatography-high resolution mass spectrum analysis on a plurality of PFAS standard substances, S3, collecting names and molecular formulas of a plurality of PFAS according to a public chemical database and a literature, calculating accurate mass numbers, jointly establishing a suspicious screening database by combining an open-source MS2 spectrogram library, S4, establishing a non-targeting identification workflow by combining the mass number characteristics, the characteristic MS2 fragments, the characteristic neutral loss and the homolog characteristics of the PFAS, and S5, integrating a targeting analysis compound, a suspicious screened candidate compound and a non-targeting identification candidate compound, and comprehensively identifying the PFAS in the environmental sample. The method of the invention realizes the full identification of known and unknown perfluoroalkyl compounds by three mutually complementary analysis techniques.

title_en: Flexible sensing device for strong electric field and strong magnetic field and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flexible sensing device used under a strong magnetic field of a strong electric field and a manufacturing method thereof, wherein the method comprises the steps of selecting miniature low-power-consumption components, including PCB antennas, wireless communication modules, main control chips, batteries, flexible circuit boards (FPCBs) and configuring sensing devices; the method comprises the steps of carrying out PCB layout and welding on components to obtain a first-stage FPCB, carrying out anti-interference structural design with a super-surface structure on the first-stage FPCB to obtain a second-stage FPCB, carrying out packaging processing on the second-stage FPCB to obtain a flexible sensing device applied to a strong electric field and strong magnetic field environment, and carrying out super-surface structure electromagnetic field shielding performance test and overall anti-interference performance test on the flexible sensing device through a test platform. The flexible sensing device has good flexibility and accords with the scene application of the complex strong electric field and strong magnetic field environment in the power industry.

title_en: Accurate temperature control method and system for die pipeline
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of pipeline temperature control, in particular to a method and a system for precisely controlling the temperature of a die pipeline. The scheme includes setting a water way structure of a die and a water tank, recording the time required for heating under the maximum heating power under different pressures, recording the water flow speed at an inlet of a water system, performing online water temperature adjustment according to the time required for heating under different pressures, recording the temperature difference of water at an inlet and an outlet, controlling the temperature of water stored in the water tank according to the temperature difference of the water at the inlet and the outlet after the recorded temperature difference of the water at the inlet and the outlet is received, and displaying the temperature in a pipeline online. According to the scheme, the high-precision temperature sensor is arranged at the key position of the water pipe, the temperature change of water flow is monitored in real time, data are sent to the central processing unit or the data acquisition system, and the accuracy and the reliability of temperature measurement are ensured.

title_en: Construction method of lung injury animal model after inhalation of radioactive dust
abstract_en: The invention relates to a construction method of a lung injury animal model after radioactive dust inhalation, which comprises the steps of injecting sodium pentobarbital into an abdominal cavity to carry out rat anesthesia and observing the change of the rat, lifting the rat vertically after anesthesia, fixing the rat with the head upwards, opening the airway of the rat by using a laryngoscope, inserting a quantitative atomizer of a rat lung dry powder containing UO  2  aerosol powder into the trachea of the rat, quickly pressing a piston of the injector to the bottom, shaking the rat left and right after inhalation and contamination are finished, enabling the UO  2  aerosol powder to be uniformly distributed in the lung of the rat, observing the respiratory and physiological states of the rat, pressing the heart of the rat in time to carry out cardiopulmonary resuscitation if the rat is in an uncomfortable state, carrying out normal feeding after the rat is recovered, and finally carrying out animal model evaluation. According to the invention, the atomizer filled with UO  2  powder is inserted into the rat trachea through the laryngoscope to induce an acute lung injury model, and the quantitative contamination dry powder aerosol mode has accurate contamination dosage and better simulates scene exposure of professionals.

title_en: Self-discharge test method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-discharge test method which comprises the following steps of A, adjusting to a target SOC, keeping the temperature unchanged, standing for a period of time until the voltage is stable, recording the voltage at the moment as U0, B, separating the time required by the test, then recording the voltage at the moment as Un, and charging until the voltage reaches U0 again when Un is smaller than U0, C, estimating the capacity consumed by the step B to U0, namely the capacity lost in the step B, according to the capacity consumed by the step B, the SOC in the self-discharge process is conveniently estimated, a relation diagram and a relation formula of the SOC and the time are obtained, the self-discharge performance of a lithium iron battery with a voltage platform is conveniently analyzed by research personnel, and the self-discharge test method which is more suitable for the characteristics of the battery is obtained.

title_en: Resistance type temperature sensor, testing method, measuring method and power switch system
abstract_en: The invention provides a resistance type temperature sensor, a testing method, a measuring method and a power switch system, which comprise a Wheatstone resistance bridge, a driving stage circuit, an analog-to-digital converter, a driving controller and a sampling controller, wherein the driving stage circuit comprises a first driving circuit and a second driving circuit, the two driving ends are respectively connected with the Wheatstone resistance bridge, the first input end and the second input end of the analog-to-digital converter are respectively connected with two output voltage ends of the Wheatstone resistance bridge, one output end of the analog-to-digital converter is used as an output end of the temperature sensor, the output end of the driving controller is respectively connected with the first driving circuit and the second driving circuit and is also connected with the analog-to-digital converter, the sampling period sequentially comprises two measuring stages, the first driving circuit is enabled in the first measuring stage, the second driving circuit is enabled in the second measuring stage, the analog-to-digital converter is used for sequentially executing working time sequences of the analog-to-digital converter, and subtracting the two quantized results to obtain an output result. According to the technical scheme, the related double sampling is adopted, so that the accuracy of a measurement result is improved.

title_en: Wide-working-condition multi-dimensional-force-representation flexible film piezoelectric sensor and signal analysis method
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of flexible piezoelectric sensors, and discloses a flexible film piezoelectric sensor with wide working conditions and multidimensional force representation and a signal analysis method. Therefore, the multi-dimensional force characterization can be realized on one film sensor, and meanwhile, the paper-cut design enhances the tension and conformal capacity of the sensor so as to meet the attachment requirement of a complex surface. And combines a multi-layer composite structure, comprising a flexible polymer protective layer and a flexible connecting layer, and realizes high sensitivity, excellent tensile property and mechanical durability through hot pressing and local ultrasonic welding. The defect of poor tensile property of the traditional PVDF piezoelectric sensor is overcome while the sensing capability is enhanced. The preparation method has simple flow and low cost, and is suitable for large-scale industrial production. In addition, we provide a deep learning analysis method for multichannel signals, enabling classification as well as nonlinear fitting.

title_en: High-altitude operation safety alarm method and device
abstract_en: The application discloses a safety alarm method and a safety alarm device for high-altitude operation, and belongs to the field of data processing, wherein the method comprises the following steps of S1, collecting tension data and speed data of a safety rope; the method comprises the steps of calculating second-order difference of speed data, carrying out similarity matching on collected tension data and a preset tension safety range template to obtain tension matching degree, carrying out similarity matching on speed change rate data and the preset speed change rate safety range template to obtain speed change rate matching degree, S4 judging whether a safety rope is in a safety state according to the tension matching degree and the speed change rate matching degree, if so, entering a step S5, if not, entering a step S6, S5, generating a first control signal according to a preset fuzzy control rule, S6, classifying dangerous states by using a support vector machine SVM algorithm to obtain dangerous grades, generating a second control signal according to the dangerous grades, and aiming at low reliability of the high-altitude operation safety rope in the prior art, the method improves reliability.

title_en: Automobile steering intermediate shaft performance detection device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of detection of automobile steering intermediate shafts, and particularly discloses an automobile steering intermediate shaft performance detection device which comprises a sliding unit, two lifting units and a plurality of lifting units, wherein the sliding unit comprises a sliding assembly which is horizontally arranged, a bearing seat which is connected with the sliding assembly in a sliding manner, a connecting shaft which is arranged on the bearing seat, and two first universal joints, wherein the two ends of the connecting shaft extend out of the bearing seat and are connected with the two first universal joints in a one-to-one correspondence manner, the axial direction of the connecting shaft is the same as the moving direction of the bearing seat, the lifting units are correspondingly arranged at the two ends of the sliding unit, each lifting unit comprises a lifting assembly, a first motor which is connected with the lifting assembly in a lifting manner and a second universal joint which is arranged at the power output end of the first motor, the first ends of the two steering intermediate shafts are correspondingly arranged at the two first universal joints, and the second ends of the two steering intermediate shafts are correspondingly arranged at the second universal joints of the two lifting units. The invention can simultaneously carry out linkage detection test on torsion and sliding of the steering intermediate shaft.

title_en: Method and system for rapidly evaluating health state of lithium battery
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for rapidly evaluating the health state of a lithium battery, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining voltage, current and temperature of the lithium battery under different cycle lives collected by a sensor, calculating a charging capacity differential curve of the lithium battery according to the voltage and the current of the lithium battery, extracting characteristic parameters from the charging capacity differential curve, preprocessing an obtained temperature signal to obtain preprocessed temperature, extracting characteristic values of the preprocessed temperature, calculating the association degree between the characteristic values of the temperature and the SOH value of the battery, constructing a training data set by the battery SOH value corresponding to the characteristic values and the temperature characteristic value with the largest association degree, inputting the training data set into a neural network model for training to obtain a SOH evaluation model of the battery, and completing evaluation of the health state of the target lithium battery by using the SOH evaluation model of the battery. The invention adopts the deep machine learning neural network model, can automatically learn the complex nonlinear relation between the characteristic parameters and the SOH, and improves the generalization capability of the evaluation model.

title_en: Display verification method, bridging chip, display device and electronic device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of screen display and discloses a display verification method, a bridge chip, display equipment and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining a target detection area corresponding to a graph to be displayed according to initial graph data corresponding to the graph to be displayed; the method comprises the steps of determining a reference chromaticity value corresponding to a graph to be displayed according to initial graph data and a target detection area, determining a real-time chromaticity value corresponding to the graph to be displayed according to real-time graph data and the target detection area, wherein the real-time graph data is obtained after the graph to be displayed is displayed and optimized, the real-time chromaticity value and the reference chromaticity value are mapped in the same chromaticity space, performing display verification according to the reference chromaticity value and the real-time chromaticity value, and determining a verification result corresponding to the real-time graph data. According to the display verification method, the chromaticity value of the target detection area can be utilized for display verification, the influence of visual effect optimization on the display verification is reduced, and higher accuracy and reliability are achieved.

title_en: Tower crane path planning method, device and equipment based on polar coordinate recursion division
abstract_en: The invention provides a tower crane path planning method, device and equipment based on polar coordinate recursion division, and relates to the field of path planning. The method comprises the steps of obtaining relevant information of a lifting point, a target point, a tower crane, a lifted object and an obstacle, establishing a polar coordinate system by taking the position of the tower crane as a circle center, further obtaining a tower crane lifting range represented by a circular cylinder, then dividing the tower crane lifting range into a plurality of sub-bodies in different dynamic recursion modes until a division termination condition is achieved, dividing the lifting point and the target point into a new sub-body on the premise that the division termination condition is met under the condition that the lifting point and the target point are not in a sub-body outer boundary box, calculating by adopting an A-type algorithm and combining a cost function to obtain an optimal path and optimizing the optimal path, executing collision detection between the obstacle and the lifted object on the optimal path until a detection result is safe, obtaining a planning path, and controlling the operation of the tower crane. The path planned by the invention has high operability and safety.

title_en: Universal rubber cylinder testing tool and testing method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a universal rubber cylinder testing tool and a testing method, wherein the universal rubber cylinder testing tool comprises an inner pipe, a piston, an outer pipe and a stop piece, the inner pipe comprises a central pipe, a mandrel and a lower joint, a first pressure transmission hole is formed in one end, far away from the mandrel, of the central pipe, the piston is sleeved on the outer wall of the central pipe in a sliding mode and communicated with the first pressure transmission hole, the outer pipe is sleeved on the outer wall of the mandrel and surrounds a testing cavity with the piston and the lower joint, a pair of second pressure transmission holes are formed in the outer pipe and are positioned at two ends of the testing cavity, the hydraulic driving setting mode is realized through the arrangement of the first pressure transmission holes, the sealing performance of the tool is stronger through the hydraulic driving setting mode, the device can simulate two extrusion modes through the arrangement of the stop piece, after the rubber cylinder is set, the pressure bearing performance of the rubber cylinder can be tested through pressing towards the second pressure transmission holes, and the accuracy of the tool on a rubber cylinder testing result is improved effectively.

title_en: Near infrared silver nanocluster, preparation method, application and experimental method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biomedicine, in particular to a near-infrared silver nanocluster, a preparation method, application and an experimental method, wherein reducing lipoic acid is combined with the silver nanocluster, a novel near-infrared fluorescent probe is synthesized by a microwave method, so that rapid and accurate quantitative detection of hydrogen peroxide can be realized, meanwhile, the probe has the advantages of high-sensitivity fluorescent signal and small self-fluorescence interference, can be well applied to detection of hydrogen peroxide in cells, compared with a fluorescent probe in a visible light range, the near-infrared fluorescent probe can be used for avoiding the problems of self-fluorescence interference, low tissue penetrability, low sensitivity and background fluorescence interference, and can also reduce errors caused by substrate concentration.

title_en: Insulation monitoring method and system for low-voltage direct-current system of thermal power plant
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of cable insulation monitoring, and discloses an insulation monitoring method and system for a low-voltage direct-current system of a thermal power plant, wherein the insulation monitoring method comprises the steps of measuring the voltage value of a positive electrode and a negative electrode to the ground; and (3) calculating insulation resistances of the positive electrode and the negative electrode to the ground respectively based on the voltage values of the positive electrode and the negative electrode to the ground, and positioning the fault branch by combining the insulation resistances and leakage current data of the branch. The method adopts the numerical value of the calculated resistor after reaching the stable state as the basis of insulation monitoring, and can more accurately reflect the actual condition of the insulation resistor of the low-voltage direct-current cable, thereby improving the accuracy and reliability of insulation monitoring. The insulation monitoring method for the low-voltage direct-current system of the thermal power plant has certain engineering application value.

title_en: Voltage divider circuit and semiconductor device using the same
abstract_en: The invention provides a voltage dividing circuit and a semiconductor device using the same, which simultaneously reduce the change of a divided output voltage caused by the time-dependent change of a resistance value generated in a resistance element and inhibit the area increase of a voltage dividing circuit area. The voltage dividing circuit includes a first terminal, a second terminal, a voltage dividing output terminal, a first resistor group having a plurality of resistor elements connected between the first terminal and the voltage dividing output terminal, a second resistor group having a plurality of resistor elements connected between the second terminal and the voltage dividing output terminal, a first metal film connected to the first terminal and covering a region including at least a part of the first resistor group in plan view, and a second metal film connected to the second terminal and covering a region including at least a part of the second resistor group in plan view.

title_en: Magnetic separator device and hydrogen atomic clock
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of atomic clocks, and discloses a magnetic separator device and a hydrogen atomic clock, wherein the magnetic separator device comprises a shell, a plurality of magnetic poles, a plurality of magnets and a vacuum assembly. The casing has the cavity, sets up a plurality of draw-in grooves in the cavity, and a plurality of draw-in grooves set up along the even interval in circumference of cavity, and the cavity has first end and the second end that link up at the length direction of casing, and first end is used for with hydrogen atom source sealing connection, second end is used for with atomic storage bubble sealing connection. The plurality of magnetic poles are arranged in the clamping groove, and the tips of the plurality of magnetic poles extend to the center line of the cavity. The magnets are arranged in the cavity, any one magnetic pole is clamped between two adjacent magnets, the magnets are surrounded to form a magnetic field space, and the center line of the magnetic field space coincides with the center line of the cavity. The vacuum assembly is arranged outside the shell and communicated with the cavity through the through hole in the shell, and the vacuum assembly is used for enabling the cavity to be in a vacuum environment.

title_en: Self-decoupling three-dimensional force multi-modal sensing device, system and method based on radial magnetization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-decoupling three-dimensional force multi-modal sensing device, a system and a method based on radial magnetization, wherein the device comprises a flexible magnetic film with radial magnetization, a microstructure layer, an optical waveguide layer, a shell, a Hall element, a PCB board, a common camera and an infrared camera, the flexible magnetic film, the microstructure layer, the optical waveguide layer and the shell are sequentially overlapped from top to bottom, the PCB, the common camera and the infrared camera are all located on the bottom surface of the shell, and the Hall element is installed on the PCB. The system comprises an auto-decoupling three-dimensional force multi-mode sensing device and a signal processing device, wherein the signal processing device can realize three-dimensional force decoupling, infrared distance sensing and force application position measurement according to data of a PCB, a common camera and an infrared camera. The invention has high resolution, can realize three-dimensional force decoupling and can realize multi-mode sensing.

title_en: Cross positioning method based on energy fusion and density clustering
abstract_en: The application relates to an energy fusion and density clustering-based cross positioning method which comprises the following steps of firstly obtaining array receiving signals and generating one-dimensional position energy estimation spectrums, secondly dividing a grid of a region of interest, inverting each array one-dimensional position energy estimation spectrum to a two-dimensional grid region by combining propagation loss, thirdly fusing the two-dimensional energy spectrums of each array obtained in the secondly to obtain multi-array fusion energy spectrums on the two-dimensional grid region, inverting the one-dimensional position energy estimation spectrums generated by the multi-array receiving signals to the two-dimensional grid region by combining a signal propagation loss model, forming the two-dimensional fusion energy spectrums of each array, generating the two-dimensional fusion energy spectrums by adopting a fusion strategy, obviously enhancing target signal characteristics, inhibiting noise interference, effectively reducing false target points in cross positioning, improving positioning accuracy and reliability, realizing automatic processing, and reducing dependence on manual intervention.

title_en: Device and method for detecting tidal current energy potential of offshore narrow water channel by underwater unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model provides a but underwater unmanned aerial vehicle surveys narrow water course trend energy potential device in coastal waters, the device includes a remote control's underwater unmanned aerial vehicle, is equipped with the velocity of flow detector that is used for carrying out the measurement to the sea water velocity of flow at the top of underwater unmanned aerial vehicle, and velocity of flow detector includes the main support of vertical installation on underwater unmanned aerial vehicle, installs a plurality of horizontal supports of horizontal setting from last to installing down in proper order on the main support, all installs a plurality of propeller-type flowmeters on horizontal support. The invention also provides a potential method for detecting the tidal current energy of the offshore narrow water channel by the underwater unmanned aerial vehicle, which can efficiently and accurately detect the flow speed and the tidal current energy of the offshore multi-layer seawater and has important significance for improving the accuracy and the efficiency of marine environment detection and the development of the tidal current energy.

title_en: Device and method for periodically and bi-directionally penetrating erosion test of soil body by repeatedly lifting reservoir water
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a device and a method for testing periodic bidirectional infiltration erosion of a soil body by repeatedly lifting water in a reservoir, and relates to the field of geotechnical engineering. The device for testing the periodical bidirectional infiltration erosion of the soil body by repeatedly lifting the reservoir water comprises a water supply device, an infiltration erosion device, a lifting table, a particle collecting device and a particle water separating device. Aiming at the actual seepage working conditions that the soil body of the gorge river channel type reservoir hydro-fluctuation belt is subjected to periodical, slope external-pointing slope and slope internal-pointing slope external-pointing under the repeated lifting action of reservoir water, the device can simulate the effect of periodical horizontal direction slope external-pointing slope internal-pointing slope and slope internal-pointing slope external-seepage force action through the switch 4 valves, compared with the traditional seepage deformation test instrument, the device is more in line with the actual working conditions that the soil body of the gorge river channel type reservoir hydro-fluctuation belt is subjected to, and the device is high in efficiency in the test process, meanwhile, the periodic process of repeated lifting of the reservoir water can be accurately simulated, the time consumption is short, and the erosion fine particles collected by horizontal direction seepage are more accurate than the vertical direction.

title_en: Biological sensing device
abstract_en: A biological sensing device comprises a bearing substrate, a light source arranged on the bearing substrate, a photodiode sensor arranged on the bearing substrate and transversely spaced from the light source, a light blocking wall arranged on the bearing substrate and positioned between the light source and the photodiode sensor, a cover glass, a dual-band optical filter plated on one front surface of the cover glass, a first optical adhesive formed on one back surface of the cover glass, and a second optical adhesive covering the bearing substrate, the light source, the photodiode sensor and the light blocking wall and used for being attached to the first optical adhesive. When the second optical adhesive is adhered to the first optical adhesive, the first optical adhesive is cured, and the second optical adhesive is cured by ultraviolet irradiation after contacting with the first optical adhesive.

title_en: Multi-azimuth adjustable sampler
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sampler capable of being adjusted in multiple directions, which relates to the technical field of samplers and comprises a carrying frame serving as a main body supporting structure of a sampling system, a driving device, a signal receiving module, a sampling tube and a separation plate, wherein the output end of the driving device is fixedly arranged at the top of the carrying frame, the driving device is internally provided with a signal receiving module, a through hole is formed in the driving device and is used for penetrating a hoisting rope, the sampling tube is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the carrying frame, a sampling tube is arranged on the circumferential surface of the sampling tube and is used for sampling waste water, the separation plate is fixedly arranged in the sampling tube, the separation plate divides the inner part of the sampling tube into an upper cavity and a lower cavity, and after the bottom of the sampling tube is touched by a lifting rod, the lower sewage of a sewage pool is automatically sampled, so that the independent collection of the upper layer and the lower layer of sewage is ensured, the repeated operation is reduced, and the sampling efficiency is improved.

title_en: Voiceprint fault analysis system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of industrial equipment fault detection, in particular to a voiceprint fault analysis system which comprises a sound source separation module based on a microphone array, an analog-to-digital converter, an edge calculation unit and a data transmission module. The sound source separation module adopts a non-uniform distribution design and combines a beam forming and time difference positioning algorithm to realize noise suppression and sound source positioning, the edge calculation unit operates a deep learning model, extracts characteristics such as a Mel frequency cepstrum coefficient and the like and classifies fault types, and the data transmission module supports encryption communication. The system improves the noise immunity and the fault discrimination accuracy under the complex environment through the cooperative work of multiple modules, is suitable for various industrial scenes, and provides an intelligent solution for equipment fault detection.

title_en: Processing method and system for improving target positioning robustness based on smooth filtering
abstract_en: The invention discloses a processing method and a system for improving target positioning robustness based on smooth filtering, wherein at least two first data corresponding to target objects to be positioned by FMCW radar are generated and acquired through the method, corresponding second data are generated according to the first data, eighth data corresponding to FMCW radar are generated and acquired based on the second data, ninth data corresponding to the target objects are generated according to the eighth data, corresponding third data with high robustness are generated according to the second data and combined with the eighth data through two-dimensional Fourier transform processing, sparse MUSIC algorithm processing and smooth filtering processing in sequence, and a system corresponding to the method is used for realizing super-resolution positioning to the target objects, greatly improving positioning accuracy of the target objects, improving target positioning effect under a stronger noise environment, reducing time complexity and space complexity and improving robustness to target object positioning.

title_en: Lithium ion battery SOC estimation method, system, computing equipment and medium based on improved volume Kalman filtering
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lithium ion battery SOC estimation method, system, computing equipment and medium based on improved volume Kalman filtering, relates to the technical field of energy storage lithium ion battery management, and solves the problem of SOC estimation errors caused by model mismatch in the prior art. The invention establishes a second-order fractional order equivalent circuit model with high fidelity, designs a double-time-scale volume Kalman filtering framework, can dynamically track time-varying parameters of the battery, and reduces errors caused by model mismatch.

title_en: Mist boundary layer parameterization scheme correction method based on multi-scale physical coupling network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a correction method of a fog boundary layer parameterization scheme based on a multi-scale physical coupling network, relates to the field of intersection of numerical weather forecast and artificial intelligence, aims to improve the performance of different boundary layer parameterization schemes in a WRF mode, constructs a fusion frame of physical mode and deep learning, adopts a double-branch heterogeneous network structure, combines a space-time attention mechanism, establishes a nonlinear mapping relation between different parameterization scheme deviations and large vortex simulation turbulence characteristics, improves the resolving power of a turbulence structure and optimizes the physical description of a boundary layer process by correcting systematic deviations existing in the parameterization scheme, obviously improves the simulation precision of a fog region compared with the traditional boundary layer scheme, reduces the visibility of the fog region, the root mean square error of a liquid water content and a liquid water path by 66.7%,50% and 58.3%, effectively solves the problem of insufficient intermittent representation of turbulence in the traditional method under the stable boundary layer, and provides a new paradigm for refined forecast of a fog generation and elimination process.

title_en: Indoor test device for carrying out high-pressure abrasive jet combined shield cutter head rock breaking
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of rock breaking tests, in particular to an indoor test device for breaking rock by combining high-pressure abrasive jet flow with a shield cutter head, which comprises a workbench, a cutter head and a cutter head, wherein the workbench is provided with rock claws; the device comprises a workbench, a mounting assembly, a rock breaking assembly, an abrasive mixing assembly, a cleaning assembly and a back flushing assembly, wherein the mounting assembly is used for mounting the rock claw on the workbench, the rock breaking assembly comprises a feeding mechanism, a torsion mechanism and a jet cutter head, the abrasive mixing assembly comprises a mixing tank, a mixing mechanism, an adjusting mechanism and a high-pressure jet mechanism, and the cleaning assembly comprises a residual pressure collecting mechanism, an airflow guiding mechanism and a jet mechanism.

title_en: Multifunctional combined type position detection oil needle for coal mining machine and coal mining machine
abstract_en: The invention provides a multifunctional combined type level detection oil needle for a coal mining machine and the coal mining machine, which are used for measuring the liquid level information of oil in a reduction gearbox of a rocker arm of the coal mining machine, and comprise an electronic magnetic needle, a measuring rod, a bearing seat and an information exchange device, the bearing seat is arranged at the triaxial of the rocker arm reduction gearbox of the coal mining machine, the measuring rod is arranged on the bearing seat, the electronic magnetic needle is arranged in the measuring rod, one end of the electronic magnetic needle is arranged in oil in the reduction gearbox, and the other end of the electronic magnetic needle is connected with the information exchange device so as to send the detected liquid level information to the external device. The electronic magnetic needle and the measuring rod are arranged at the triaxial part of the reduction gearbox of the rocker arm of the coal mining machine, the other end of the electronic magnetic needle is arranged in oil, liquid level collection of the oil in the reduction gearbox is achieved, the oil is sent to an upper computer in real time through the information exchange device, and therefore oil level measurement of the reduction gearbox of the rocker arm of the coal mining machine and continuous collection and output of oil signals are achieved, and the condition that the oil level of the oil in the reduction gearbox of the rocker arm can be observed without stopping is achieved.

title_en: Shutter resistance testing method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a shutter resistance testing method and a shutter resistance testing system, and relates to the technical field of cooling towers. The louver resistance testing method comprises the following steps of S1, distributing air inlet measuring points and air outlet measuring points on the periphery of a cooling tower, S2, opening a louver to a set opening degree, measuring and recording the temperature and the humidity of the air inlet measuring points and the air temperature and the air flow rate of the air outlet measuring points, S3, calculating the suction force of the cooling tower according to data measured in the step S2, calculating the louver resistance according to the suction force resistance balance principle of the cooling tower, and S4, repeating the steps S2 and S3, and calculating the louver resistance under different louver opening degrees. The blind window resistance testing method can accurately obtain the resistance characteristics of the blind window under different opening conditions, is convenient for power plant operators to accurately adjust the opening of the blind window, and provides accurate data support for the anti-freezing and economic operation of the blind window of the indirect air cooling tower.

title_en: Data analysis-based method and system for breeding and managing penaeus vannamei boone
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for breeding and managing penaeus vannamei boone based on data analysis, which are characterized in that a water quality anomaly detection model is built based on a generation countermeasure network, environment monitoring information is obtained, abnormal water quality detection is carried out on a breeding area, the influence degree of the breeding quality under the current water quality is estimated according to the water quality anomaly detection information, regulation and control early warning are carried out, disease monitoring is carried out on penaeus vannamei boone in a target breeding area, disease prediction is carried out by combining the water quality anomaly detection information, disease reason is analyzed, noise identification analysis and noise tracing are carried out on the breeding area according to the environment monitoring information, noise anomaly early warning is carried out, and breeding feed optimization is carried out according to the disease type and disease condition of penaeus vannamei boone in a target breeding pool. The comprehensive of the breeding management of the penaeus vannamei boone is improved, meanwhile, the breeding feed is optimized for the breeding pool with diseases so as to enhance the disease resistance capability of other shrimps in the target breeding pool, and the breeding quality is improved.

title_en: Method and system for testing satellite remote sensing camera
abstract_en: The invention discloses a testing method of a satellite remote sensing camera, which comprises the steps of obtaining orbit information and a satellite imaging task, verifying the satellite imaging task based on the orbit information, carrying out satellite attitude simulation maneuver according to the satellite imaging task when the satellite imaging task passes the verification, sending the satellite imaging task to a satellite minimization module, obtaining imaging data fed back by the satellite minimization module, and analyzing and processing the image data. The method and the system for testing the satellite remote sensing camera can realize full-automatic, full-flow and high-efficiency remote sensing camera ground segment function test in the whole satellite desktop joint test stage, so that the ground test of the satellite is not dependent on physical devices such as a gesture track control machine, a semi-physical simulation platform and the like, ground general computing resources can be effectively utilized, and the method and the system for testing the satellite remote sensing camera have the characteristics of low cost, high reliability, simplicity in construction, convenience in operation and high test efficiency.

title_en: Foldable wire harness thermal coefficient testing machine
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of heat conduction performance testing equipment, and discloses a foldable wire harness thermal coefficient testing machine which comprises a heat conduction coefficient tester, wherein a display panel is embedded and installed on the surface of a shell of the heat conduction coefficient tester, a power knob and a reference knob are arranged on the right side of the display panel, the sliding blocks at the bottoms of the two cover plates are caused to slide with the sliding grooves formed in the accommodating grooves, the distance between the two cover plates gradually increases, the two cover plates respectively pull the base plate at the bottoms of the accommodating grooves through a plurality of tension springs, the height of the sample clamp on the base plate is lifted, when the two cover plates are completely separated from the shielding accommodating grooves, the positioning grooves on the side surfaces of the base plate correspond to the plum blossom knobs which are arranged on the shell of the thermal conductivity tester in a threaded manner under the action of manual lifting, and the base plate is supported through the plum blossom knobs.

title_en: Meta universe-based vehicle detection path planning and interaction method and system and application thereof in Mars roaming vehicle detection
abstract_en: A method for planning and interacting path of vehicle based on metauniverse includes realizing voice, video and data transmission based on WebRTC protocol, using support vector machine algorithm to classify gesture motion of user, mapping classification result to operation command of movement, data collection or path modification of vehicle in metauniverse environment, planning and optimizing detection path, utilizing machine learning method to extract geological data feature, combining with terrain detection target to generate vehicle terrain detection path plan and projecting it to metauniverse environment in real time, enabling user to share and visually data in metauniverse environment by cooperative interaction module to audit and modify path plan, executing detection task, feeding back final optimized path plan and relevant operation command to vehicle to guide it to execute terrain detection task after user confirms that path plan is correct, raising efficiency and scientificity of terrain detection.

title_en: Double-sided self-adhesive label quality inspection machine and detection process
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of double-sided self-adhesive labels, and discloses a double-sided self-adhesive label inspection machine and a detection process, wherein the double-sided self-adhesive label inspection machine comprises a mounting unit, a transmission unit and a cleaning unit, the mounting unit comprises a workbench, an unreeling component and a reeling component, the unreeling component and the reeling component are mutually symmetrical, and double-sided self-adhesive label bodies are arranged on the unreeling component and the reeling component; the transmission unit comprises a driving assembly, and the driving assembly is used for driving the unreeling assembly and the reeling assembly to rotate. According to the invention, when the moving plate moves to half of the track of the special-shaped notch, the placing box stops moving downwards at the moment, and the detection assembly body can continue to move downwards, so that the front end of the camera arranged on the detection assembly body can be attached to the sponge cleaning plate, the detection assembly body moves downwards and the rotating motion state drives the front end of the camera to move downwards and rotate synchronously, and the sponge cleaning plate can clean the sponge cleaning plate.

title_en: Batch soil easily-oxidized organic carbon determination method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a batch soil easily-oxidized organic carbon determination method, which comprises the steps of weighing a certain amount of soil sample in a triangular flask, adding a specific concentration and volume of ethylenediamine tetraacetic acid disodium salt solution, potassium dichromate solution and concentrated sulfuric acid containing silver sulfate, shaking uniformly, standing for oxidation in a heat-preserving environment, adding sodium diphenylamine sulfonate and ferrous sulfate solution for titration, and determining easily-oxidized organic carbon after titration is completed. According to the method, the detection efficiency and accuracy are remarkably improved through operations such as complexing metal ions with disodium ethylenediamine tetraacetate, carrying out catalytic oxidation on silver ions, accurately indicating an end point by an indicator, optimizing the concentration of the oxidant, the consumption of sulfuric acid, the oxidation time and the like, and a plurality of problems existing in the traditional potassium permanganate oxidation method are effectively solved. Compared with the traditional method, the method has the advantages of simple and convenient operation, high detection efficiency, accurate and stable result and the like, can better meet the measurement requirement of batch soil easily-oxidized organic carbon, and provides powerful support for soil quality evaluation and related carbon research.

title_en: Electric energy metering method under waveform distortion of power grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric energy metering method under waveform distortion of a power grid, and particularly relates to the technical field of electric energy metering; aiming at the problems that zero sequence current or false phase drift is easy to generate in a multipoint grounding or grounding fault power system in the prior art, and the error triggering energy compensation mechanism, metering deviation and electricity price settlement risk are caused, the abnormal identification and control method for integrating the frequency domain characteristic analysis of the zero sequence current and the trend consistency judgment of the three-phase deviation is provided, the false phase deviation state is accurately identified through synchronous sampling, frequency domain analysis and trend consistency evaluation of three-phase voltage, current and neutral line current, the error compensation behavior is shielded in real time and is switched to a fundamental wave power metering mode, the electric energy metering accuracy is ensured through an error backtracking correction mechanism after recovery, and the anti-interference capability and metering reliability of an ammeter under complex working conditions are effectively improved.

title_en: Improved Doppler signal processing method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an improved Doppler signal processing method and system, which belong to the technical field of Doppler signal processing and comprise the following steps of S1, collecting signals and preprocessing, S2, performing time-frequency analysis, namely, adopting a Hamming window function, denoising an improved wavelet threshold value and performing time-domain analysis on the filtered Doppler signals by combining short-time Fourier transform, S3, extracting features, namely, calculating a real envelope by adopting Hilbert transform and traversing data in the motion spectrogram by combining a peak finding function based on the envelope analysis so as to extract peak points, S4, judging and outputting, namely, screening the peak points meeting the peak height threshold value condition, and outputting the peak points and position coordinates thereof. By adopting the method, a better signal extraction effect and visual speed measurement are realized, the separation and extraction of signals are effectively realized, and the precision and reliability of signal processing are obviously improved.

title_en: Ground temperature detection device and detection system for ground source heat pump system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ground temperature detection device and a ground temperature detection system for a ground source heat pump system, and relates to the technical field of ground temperature detection. The invention comprises a shell and three drill bits arranged on the outer side of the shell, wherein a push-pull lifting assembly and a detection assembly are arranged in the shell, the push-pull lifting assembly is positioned right above the detection assembly, the push-pull lifting assembly comprises a rotary table, the rotary table is movably arranged on the inner wall of a circular groove formed in the shell, three strip-shaped sliding holes are uniformly formed in the surface of the rotary table, and the inside of each sliding hole is connected with one end of a push-pull rod through a movable shaft. According to the invention, the temperature detector is accommodated in the shell in the drilling process, after the drilling is carried out to a designated depth, the detection device is started, the drill bit moves outwards and downwards, the movable bottom plate is driven to move downwards to expose the mounting hole, and the temperature detector passes through the mounting hole to be in contact with the soil of the rock stratum, so that the temperature of the soil rock stratum is measured, and therefore, the temperature detector can be well protected from being damaged in the drilling process.

title_en: Wire harness production quality detection system and method based on machine vision
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wire harness production quality detection system and method based on machine vision, and relates to the technical field of industrial automation detection, wherein the system comprises the steps of collecting wire harness data, including wire harness surface images, wire harness internal structure perspective views and vibration data, preprocessing the wire harness data, performing geometric correction on the wire harness surface images, and performing field-of-view deviation elimination on the wire harness internal structure perspective views; and extracting the features of the wire harness surface image by using ResNet, generating a surface feature map, segmenting the defects of the wire harness internal structure perspective view by using U-Net, generating an internal feature map, and fusing the surface feature map and the internal feature map to obtain a fused feature map. According to the invention, the pose offset of the camera is calculated through the state transfer equation and the Kalman filtering algorithm, so that the effective correction of image acquisition distortion in a dynamic environment is realized, the stability and the accuracy of a detection method are improved, and the problem of low detection precision in the dynamic environment is solved.

title_en: Multi-station airtight test device for solid rocket engine and use method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-station airtight test device for a solid rocket engine and a use method thereof. The test device is characterized by comprising an air exhaust diversion assembly, an airtight assembly and a ball valve, wherein the air exhaust diversion assembly is used for an engine airtight test, and the airtight assembly is used for connecting and fixing an engine and is connected with the air exhaust diversion assembly through the ball valve. Meanwhile, the use method of the test device is also disclosed. Compared with the prior art, the airtight assembly has the advantages that the airtight assembly is used for realizing the simultaneous airtight test of multiple solid rocket engines, the efficiency of the engines in the airtight test process is effectively improved, the screwing time of threads is reduced through the boss interface of the base, the butt joint disassembly and assembly efficiency is improved, the axial limit in the airtight process of the engines can be realized through the base and the clamping cover, the multiple solid rocket engines can be disassembled and assembled quickly, the base of the multiple solid rocket engines does not need to be replaced or adjusted when the multiple solid rocket engines are sequentially subjected to the airtight test, the safety is guaranteed, and the overall efficiency of the multiple rocket engines in the airtight test is remarkably improved.

title_en: Sampling device for marine geological survey
abstract_en: A sampling device for marine geological survey belongs to the field of marine geological survey, aims to solve the problems that the mixing of samples can lead to the destruction of sample characteristics which originally represent specific position and depth information, so that the analysis result can not accurately reflect the real condition of each sampling point, and further the inaccuracy of data is caused, and the reliability and the scientificity of the marine geological survey result are seriously influenced, including the drum place the case, set up the negative pressure machine in the drum place the case outside, the intercommunication is at the first hose of negative pressure machine input, the intercommunication is at the negative pressure head of first hose other end, the intercommunication is at the second hose of negative pressure machine output, through being provided with elastic mechanism for drive elastic mechanism and upwards move when pushing mechanism moves downwards, separate the sample at every turn, for prior art, reduce the mixture of sample, thereby improve the accuracy of sample.

title_en: Fault self-checking device and sports equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to a fault self-checking device and moving equipment, which comprises a first travel circuit and a second travel circuit, wherein a first switch component is connected in series with the first travel circuit, when the first switch component is closed, a power supply anode and a position reader are conducted, a second switch component is connected in series with the switch circuit and is arranged in parallel with the first switch component, when the second switch component is closed, the power supply anode and the position reader are conducted, an exclusive OR gate circuit is provided with a first input end, a second input end and an output end, the first input end is electrically connected with the first switch component, the second input end is electrically connected with the second switch, an alarm circuit is electrically connected with the output end, wherein when the working states of the first switch component and the second switch component are normal, the output end of the exclusive OR gate circuit outputs a low level, when the working states of the first switch component and the second switch component are inconsistent, the output end of the exclusive OR gate circuit outputs a high level, and the alarm circuit alarms.

title_en: Living single cell in-situ extraction and on-line mass spectrum detection device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a living single-cell in-situ extraction and online mass spectrum detection device, which relates to the technical field of single-cell mass spectrum research and comprises a filter assembly, wherein the filter assembly comprises a filter box, the living single-cell in-situ extraction and online mass spectrum detection device can enhance adsorption of nonpolar impurities by introducing hydrophobic groups, a coating brush can absorb the hydrophobic groups leaked from a liquid leakage hole, a layer of hydrophobic groups is coated on the surface of a second filter layer, a solution containing an initiator can be injected into the soaking box through a vortex groove, a first filter layer is inserted into the soaking box along the inner wall of the vortex groove, and then the solution containing hydrophilic monomers is added into the system, and meanwhile, good hydrophilicity of cellulose is utilized, so that adsorption of polar impurities can be enhanced, and the problem that an extract injected into a fluid pipeline by an injection pump is mixed with interference impurities is solved.

title_en: Extraction and accurate quantitative analysis method for tea true aroma profile
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of analysis and detection of tea components, and in particular relates to a method for extracting and accurately and quantitatively analyzing the outline of the true aroma of tea, which comprises the steps of preparing tea soup of tea to be tested by adopting a tea sensory evaluation method; directly placing twister stirring rod containing PDMS coating in tea soup being brewed for extracting aroma components, desorbing and analyzing tea aroma extract by TD-GC-MS after brewing is finished to identify molecular structure and abundance composition of aroma profile of tea to be detected, quantitatively analyzing target aroma substances of tea by improved standard adding method, adding the calculated simulated concentration into blank matrix of tea, comparing with total ion flow diagram of original tea-like aroma components, and fine-tuning to obtain accurate concentration of each target aroma substance. The method has the advantages of convenient operation and short extraction time, and can restore the true aroma profile of tea to obtain the accurate concentration of each aroma component.

title_en: Method and system for monitoring Flash read-write condition of electric energy meter
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for monitoring Flash read-write conditions of an electric energy meter, and belongs to the field of Flash monitoring of electric energy meters. The invention obtains whether the read operation or the write operation is performed at the moment by monitoring the read-write channel between the controller of the electric energy meter and the Flash, then calculates corresponding read-write operation frequency according to the read-write operation, and judges that the read or the abnormality occurs at the moment when the read-write operation frequency is larger than the corresponding set threshold value. According to the invention, through the fact that the read-write frequency exceeds the set value, the alarm signal is sent out, whether the electric energy meter performs frequent read-write operation on Flash or not can be effectively monitored, the service life of Flash is prolonged, and therefore the running stability and reliability of the electric energy meter are improved.

title_en: Processing device and operation method suitable for induction brazing of electromagnetic relay shell group
abstract_en: The invention discloses a processing device and an operation method suitable for induction brazing of an electromagnetic relay shell group, and relates to the technical field of relay shell group processing, wherein the processing device comprises a feeding mechanism, a positioning mechanism, a detection mechanism, a pressing mechanism and a brazing heating mechanism; the welding device comprises a feeding mechanism, a positioning mechanism, a detection mechanism and a pressing mechanism, wherein the feeding mechanism is used for grabbing a shell group to be welded onto a heating seat of a welding heating mechanism, the positioning mechanism is used for pushing the shell group to be welded onto the heating seat to a target positioning point, the detection mechanism is used for acquiring an image of a working position of a pressing head of the pressing mechanism and identifying the oxidation degree of the pressing head based on the image of the working position, and the pressing mechanism is used for pressing the shell group to be welded onto the target positioning point through the pressing head so that a heating coil of the welding heating mechanism can perform welding operation. The invention relieves the technical problems of low production efficiency, serious oxidation, ablation and serious deformation of local areas when the soldering temperature is uneven in the manual operation mode of resistance soldering.

title_en: Spectrum measuring method and device
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a spectrum measurement method and a device, wherein the spectrum measurement method comprises the steps of irradiating a sample to be measured with a detection light beam generated by a blackbody light source to obtain an incident light beam with response characteristics of the sample to be measured, performing radial spatial beam splitting on the incident light beam to obtain at least two split light beams, and performing spectrum measurement in a preset spectrum range on the at least two split light beams to obtain spectrum information of each split light beam, wherein the preset spectrum ranges corresponding to the split light beams are different, and the sum of the preset spectrum ranges corresponding to the split light beams continuously covers a target spectrum interval. The method solves the problem that the existing spectrum method for measuring the ultra-wideband spectrum range does not exist.

title_en: Detection circuit and wearable equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a detection circuit and wearable equipment, wherein the detection circuit comprises a voltage comparator, a capacitor plate and a main control chip, a first input end of the voltage comparator is connected with a power supply, a second input end of the voltage comparator is connected with the capacitor plate, an output end of the voltage comparator is respectively connected with the capacitor plate and the main control chip, the voltage comparator is used for receiving power supply voltage provided by the power supply, outputting first voltage when the voltage of the first input end is larger than that of the second input end, and outputting second voltage when the voltage of the first input end is smaller than that of the second input end. When a human body serving as a conductor approaches a capacitor pole plate, a capacitor is formed, the capacitor is continuously charged and discharged, the voltage comparator can continuously output the converted first voltage and the converted second voltage, the main control chip can determine whether the human body approaches the human body according to the voltage continuously output by the voltage comparator, and a detection function can be realized through a circuit comprising the comparator, the capacitor pole plate and the main control chip, so that the cost of a device is reduced.

title_en: Lithium battery health state and residual life combined prediction large model and prediction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lithium battery health state and residual life combined prediction large model and a prediction method, and generating a bimodal image through charge and discharge data of the lithium battery, and outputting the lithium battery health state and the residual life prediction result through a combined prediction model. The training stage adopts an attention mask strategy to predict the original image and the mask image twice, dynamically enhances the attention of key aging characteristics and suppresses noise, remarkably improves the accuracy, robustness and generalization capability of lithium battery health state prediction, and solves the problems of high data quality dependence, weak model generalization and large long-term prediction error in the prior art.

title_en: Ion conductive elastomer, preparation method thereof and application thereof in underwater sensing field
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of elastomer materials, and provides an ion conductive elastomer, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in the field of underwater sensing, wherein the ion conductive elastomer P (EGPEA-co-AA) -IL takes poly (acrylic acid-2-phenoxyethyl-co-acrylic acid) copolymer as a main body material and hydrophobic ionic liquid 1-ethyl-3-methylimidazoline bis (trifluoromethyl sulfonyl) imine as a conductive medium. The ion conductive elastomer provided by the embodiment of the invention has ultrahigh underwater adhesion, can spontaneously repair mechanical damage at room temperature, has good underwater stability, excellent sensing performance, controllable mechanical property and conductivity, and simple preparation method, and can be prepared by one-step photoinitiated polymerization.

title_en: Dimension detection system and dimension detection method for process hole
abstract_en: The application provides a size detection system and a size detection method for a process hole, which relate to the technical field of workpiece detection and comprise a camera, a target measuring tool with scales and a controller; the measuring tool comprises a target measuring tool, a camera, a controller and a controller, wherein the target measuring tool is positioned on one side of a workpiece to be measured, a scale mark on the target measuring tool is perpendicular to the center line of the workpiece to be measured, at least one process hole is formed in the workpiece to be measured, the camera is positioned right above the target measuring tool and the workpiece to be measured, the camera is connected with the controller, the target measuring tool and the camera are relatively static, the camera is used for collecting images containing the target measuring tool and the process hole, and the controller is used for analyzing the images to obtain the size and the position of the process hole. The application reduces the cost of the process hole detection, improves the accuracy of the process hole detection, optimizes the resource utilization of the camera, ensures the efficiency of the process hole size and position detection, and improves the accuracy.

title_en: Concrete hardness detection device for civil engineering
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of concrete hardness detection, in particular to a concrete hardness detection device for civil engineering, which comprises a base, wherein a lifting mechanism is arranged on the base, a motor is arranged on the lifting mechanism, a transmission pipe is coaxially arranged at the output end of the motor, the device also comprises a drill bit and a mounting cylinder coaxially fixed at the top of the drill bit, and more than two grinding blocks are slidably arranged on the side wall of the mounting cylinder. In the drilling process, when the drilling reaches the set depth, the grinding block automatically stretches out, so that the annular pull groove is expanded on the hole wall, and when the diameter of the annular pull groove is expanded to the set value, the diameter of the annular pull groove is not increased continuously, so that the method has higher degree of automation.

title_en: Method, equipment, medium and product for evaluating corrosion degree of inner wall of metal water supply pipeline
