abstract_en: The application discloses a method, equipment, medium and product for evaluating corrosion degree of an inner wall of a metal water supply pipeline, and relates to the field of corrosion evaluation. The method comprises the steps of firstly obtaining lining types, pipe ages, water quality indexes and pipe wall corrosion degree scoring thresholds of a plurality of metal water supply pipe samples, calculating the water corrosion accumulation degree of each metal water supply pipe sample according to the pipe ages and the water quality indexes of the metal water supply pipe samples of the same lining type, performing function fitting on the water corrosion accumulation degree scoring thresholds and the pipe wall corrosion degree scoring thresholds of the metal water supply pipe samples of the same lining type to obtain a pipe wall corrosion degree scoring model under the lining type, substituting the target water corrosion accumulation degree of a metal water supply pipe to be evaluated into the pipe wall corrosion degree scoring model under the target lining type during actual measurement, calculating to obtain a corresponding pipe wall corrosion degree score, further determining the inner wall corrosion degree, and realizing efficient and accurate measurement of the inner wall corrosion degree of the metal water supply pipe under the condition that ground excavation is not required.

title_en: Advertisement display and play device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of advertisement display and play, and particularly discloses an advertisement display and play device which comprises an advertisement player, wherein the advertisement player comprises a machine body, a front plate and a back plate which are respectively connected to two sides of the machine body, an LCD screen is arranged on the front plate, a migration mechanism comprises transmission covers which are respectively connected to two narrow sides of the machine body, cleaning pieces are arranged between the two groups of transmission covers and are arranged on the outer sides of the front plate, the transmission covers are provided with migration pieces for adjusting the lifting of the cleaning pieces, a bimodal energy-saving mechanism is arranged on the top of the machine body and comprises a photovoltaic plate and a vertical shaft bracket arranged at the bottom of the photovoltaic plate, and the photovoltaic and wind power generation are cooperated to ensure outdoor continuous operation.

title_en: Raman spectrum-based medicine efficacy and action mechanism prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for predicting drug efficacy and action mechanism based on Raman spectrum, and relates to the technical field of drug efficacy prediction, wherein the method comprises the following steps of preparing a sample to be detected, and carrying out Raman spectrum scanning on the sample to be detected to obtain corresponding Raman spectrum data; the method comprises the steps of processing Raman spectrum data to form a spectrum data set, dividing the spectrum data set to obtain a corresponding training set and a corresponding test set, constructing a prediction model, training the prediction model by utilizing the training set, evaluating the prediction effect of the prediction model by utilizing the test set, acquiring sample data of other medicines, inputting the sample data into the prediction model for prediction, analyzing cells or cell secretions stimulated by different types of immune medicines by a machine learning algorithm, and establishing a Raman spectrum database and model of the different types of medicines, thereby providing powerful support for research and development of the immune medicines and further mechanism exploration.

title_en: Sewage treatment equipment monitoring method based on data analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sewage treatment equipment monitoring method and system based on data analysis, and relates to the technical field of equipment monitoring. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a target vibration signal by reducing noise of the vibration signal of equipment, carrying out two-dimensional representation on the target vibration signal by adopting continuous wavelet transformation to obtain a target time-frequency image, carrying out feature extraction on the target vibration signal and the target time-frequency image by a convolution network to obtain a first feature vector and a second feature vector, fusing the first feature vector and the second feature vector to obtain fusion features, and inputting the fusion features into a classifier to obtain the current state of the target equipment. By combining deep learning, multi-mode feature extraction, data fusion and signal noise reduction, the early fault detection capability is remarkably improved, the false alarm rate and the false alarm rate are reduced, and the state monitoring of the blower is more accurate and reliable, so that hidden trouble can be eliminated in time, and the overall stability of the sewage treatment system is improved.

title_en: Sensor error calibration method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of error calibration and discloses a sensor error calibration method, device, equipment and storage medium, comprising the steps of collecting environmental state information of sensors and calculating partition calibration parameters of each sensor based on the environmental state information; dividing each sensor into a plurality of dynamic calibration intervals based on partition calibration parameters, wherein each dynamic calibration interval comprises a plurality of error parameters, the difference value between the error parameters can dynamically adjust the interval range of the adjacent dynamic calibration intervals, calculating an error compensation value of each dynamic calibration interval according to the error parameters, generating calibration information based on the error compensation values, inputting the calibration information into each dynamic calibration interval to obtain a target calibration interval, and compensating real-time weighing data of the sensor according to the target calibration interval. The sensor error correction method can respond to the change of the errors of the sensors in real time, ensure that each sensor can be effectively calibrated under different working conditions, and further improve the measurement accuracy.

title_en: Rice product raw material quality prediction method and device based on partial least square method
abstract_en: The invention provides a rice product raw material quality prediction method and device based on a partial least square method, and relates to the technical field of food quality detection and control. The method. Firstly, uniformly dividing rice raw materials into a plurality of groups according to weight, extracting an equal weight of raw materials from each group to serve as a sample to be detected, detecting cracks, yellowing and insect pest particles in the sample by using a Japanese zozhu particle assessment instrument, and weighing. Meanwhile, the grinding sample is divided into three parts, the contents of protein, moisture and amylose in the sample are respectively measured by adopting a Kjeldahl nitrogen determination method, an oven drying method and an iodine colorimetric method, the absorbance of the sample in a specific wave band is recorded by adopting an infrared spectrum imaging technology, a prediction model of the contents of the protein, the moisture and the amylose is established based on a partial least square method, a quality evaluation system of rice raw materials is constructed according to the ratio of cracks, yellowing and insect pests, and the quality of the rice raw materials is classified into different grades of excellent, good, qualified and poor according to different evaluation standards.

title_en: Method and system for determining physical state of wire and nonvolatile storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a system for determining the physical state of a wire and a nonvolatile storage medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining first magnetic induction generated by a coil winding, obtaining second magnetic induction detected by a magnetic induction sensing device, wherein the coil winding and the magnetic induction sensing device are respectively arranged on two sides of a target wire along the radial direction of the target wire, the radial direction is the direction of one diameter of the same cross section of the target wire, and determining the physical state of a steel core included in the target wire based on the first magnetic induction and the second magnetic induction, wherein the physical state is used for measuring the deformation degree of the steel core. The application solves the technical problem of poor accuracy of the determination result of the physical state of the steel core in the wire in the related technology.

title_en: Comprehensive performance testing method for electrically-controlled silicone oil clutch water pump assembly
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive performance test method of an electrically controlled silicone oil clutch water pump assembly, which comprises the following steps of (1) mounting the electrically controlled silicone oil clutch water pump assembly to be tested on a test bench, (2) installing a test program in a control and data acquisition system, inputting test parameters in the test program, (3) driving a fan of the tested electrically controlled silicone oil clutch water pump assembly by using controllable load equipment to simulate the air resistance moment characteristics of the fan at different rotating speeds, (4) starting a driving unit, and controlling the load of the electrically controlled silicone oil clutch and the working signals of the clutch according to the program to test various working conditions of the electrically controlled silicone oil clutch. The comprehensive performance testing method of the electrically controlled silicone oil clutch water pump assembly can comprehensively, efficiently and accurately detect the performance of the electrically controlled silicone oil clutch water pump assembly, can early find problems of products, optimize product design and ensure product quality.

title_en: Detection device for jet loom
abstract_en: The invention provides a detection device for an air-jet loom, which relates to the technical field of fabric detection, and comprises a case and a laser generator, wherein a detection component is arranged on the case, the detection component comprises a first laser receiver and a second laser receiver, a suction component is arranged on the case, the suction component comprises a partition plate and a suction port, a lifting component is arranged on the case, the lifting component comprises a motor and a screw rod, and a filtering component is arranged on the partition plate, and comprises an air box and a filter screen.

title_en: Parameter self-adaptive setting device and method for laser pumping cesium atom Shu Zhong
abstract_en: The invention provides a device and a method for adaptively setting parameters of laser pumping cesium atoms Shu Zhong, which relate to the technical field of atomic clocks and comprise cesium beam tube units, cesium beam tube driving units, frequency stabilization laser light source units, acousto-optic frequency shifting units, crystal oscillator frequency locking units and temperature acquisition and control units, wherein a main control unit is connected with each controlled module through a communication interface, an onboard computer runs upper computer software, calculates relative frequency deviation and alembic variance, obtains a frequency deviation sequence and alembic variance data set, determines optimal working parameter combinations corresponding to peaks, performs primary temperature control, secondary temperature control and tertiary temperature control in a linkage mode, realizes temperature gradient compression and wavelength stability control, compares real-time monitoring parameters with preset thresholds, judges alarm grades, and accordingly triggers a system response instruction. The invention has the beneficial effects of reducing labor cost, improving temperature adaptability and improving long-term stability index.

title_en: Early fault diagnosis method and related device for rotary part of drill jumbo
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a related device for diagnosing early faults of a rotary part of a drill jumbo, and relates to the technical field of equipment fault diagnosis; the method comprises the steps of generating embedded vector samples through linear symbolization and phase space reconstruction, calculating discrete entropy of each sample by using shannon entropy, carrying out the same processing on denoising data and time delay versions thereof to generate samples with time delay and samples without time delay, denoising the data to obtain original data subjected to wavelet denoising only, determining distance correlation based on the samples, constructing feature vectors, calculating an dissimilarity matrix among the samples, obtaining a space distribution matrix through multidimensional scaling and singular value decomposition, comparing the space distribution positions of test data samples based on the space distribution matrix, and diagnosing early faults of rotating parts of the drilling trolley based on the minimum Euclidean distance. The application can accurately diagnose different faults of the rotating part in early stage.

title_en: Wind tunnel valve vibration signal fault early warning device and method based on edge calculation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind tunnel valve vibration signal fault early warning device and method based on edge calculation, comprising the following steps of obtaining structural parameters of a wind tunnel valve to construct a finite element simulation model, simulating and collecting vibration signals in the operation of the valve, and combining measured data to form a training data set; and training the obtained component energy characteristics based on the CNN-LSTM self-encoder neural network model, establishing a mapping relation between the vibration signal energy distribution and fault characteristics, and realizing fault prediction. Compared with the prior art, the method combines finite element simulation with actual signal analysis, and through the embedded lightweight neural network model, the accuracy and the instantaneity of fault diagnosis are remarkably improved, and the safety and the reliability of wind tunnel valve operation are improved.

title_en: Metal material accelerated corrosion test device under simulation plateau complex environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a metal material accelerated corrosion test device under a simulated plateau complex environment, which comprises a box body (1), a water collecting tank (2), a sample carrying platform (9), an electrolyte water tank (6), a liquid outlet pipeline, a circulating water pump (3) and an electrode loop, wherein the box body is provided with an electric control system (12), the water collecting tank (2) is arranged at the lower part of the box body (1), the sample carrying platform (9) is arranged above the water collecting tank (2), the electrolyte water tank (6) is arranged above the sample carrying platform (9), the liquid outlet pipeline is provided with a throttle valve (16) and a liquid outlet device (22), and the circulating water pump (3) is arranged between the water collecting tank (2) and the electrolyte water tank (6), and the electrode loop comprises an anode lead (19), a cathode lead (20), a graphite electrode (21) and a direct current power supply. According to the invention, acceleration is carried out under the low conductivity condition by means of temperature control, oxygen enrichment, anodic polarization and the like, and ultraviolet rays and temperature and humidity control are integrated, so that a simulation accelerated corrosion test is carried out on a plateau environment, and a basis is provided for material selection and evaluation.

title_en: Construction and application of recombinant PRRSV strain expressing green fluorescent EGFP protein
abstract_en: The invention discloses construction and application of a recombinant PRRSV strain expressing green fluorescent EGFP protein. Recombinant PRRSV capable of expressing green fluorescent EGFP protein was successfully constructed and saved by reverse genetic manipulation techniques. The modified virus is inoculated to Marc-145 cells for subculture, and the result shows that the modified virus can trigger cytopathy and stably express EGFP green fluorescent protein. The obtained recombinant strain shows stable passage capacity in Marc-145 cells. The invention is suitable for tracking virus infection and replication conditions in experiments and carrying out drug screening, can simplify the processes of virus detection and quantitative analysis, and improves the efficiency and accuracy of the experiments.

title_en: Street lamp with environment monitoring function
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of street lamps, in particular to a street lamp with an environment monitoring function. This street lamp with environmental monitoring function includes supporting component, lamps and lanterns, solar module, environmental monitoring mechanism and collection subassembly, and supporting component is including supporting bench, bracing piece, arc connecting rod and the extension pole of slope that connects gradually, and environmental monitoring mechanism includes carousel subassembly, monitoring component, radiator unit, diversion and merges piece and two pieces of catchmenting, and switch module includes conductive switch piece and expansion block. The lamps and lanterns can release the light after starting, and solar energy component can absorb solar energy, and the energy is given the lamps and lanterns and give light, and environmental monitoring mechanism's monitoring component can monitor near environment, and radiating component reduces monitoring component's temperature, and switch assembly can guide the rainwater of collecting to monitoring component's surface for monitoring component's cooling, collecting component and water collecting piece homoenergetic can collect the rainwater, and the diversion meets the collection that the piece can accelerate the rainwater.

title_en: Self-adaptive hybrid neighborhood search method for solving unmanned aerial vehicle path problem
abstract_en: The invention relates to a self-adaptive mixed neighborhood search method for solving a vehicle path problem of an unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises the following steps of generating an initial solution only comprising a vehicle path through an initial solution generating program, recording the initial solution as a best solution, calculating the initial temperature, exploring a potential better solution space through a guided type destructive recombination operation to generate a new solution, optimizing the solution through a double-layer mixed neighborhood search algorithm, updating the solution, calculating the new annealing temperature, considering whether the new solution is accepted or not according to an acceptance criterion, updating the best solution, updating the weights of a destructive operator and a repair operator method, repeating the steps (2) - (4) until the set stop condition is reached to obtain the optimal solution of the problem.

title_en: Calibration method and system of optical on-machine measuring device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a calibration method and a calibration system of an optical on-machine measuring device, which solve the problem of lower detection precision of a ranging sensor in the prior art and have the advantages of ensuring the accuracy and precision of a measuring result and improving the operation efficiency of the calibration of the ranging sensor, and the method comprises the following steps that the ranging sensor of the optical on-machine measuring device is arranged on a main shaft of a machine tool, the ranging sensor can rotate relative to the main shaft of the machine tool, and a standard ball is arranged on a workbench; the ranging sensor emits a light beam to the surface of the standard sphere, the starting point of the light beam is used as an emitting point, the point of the light beam on the surface of the standard sphere is used as a sampling point, a deviation change rule is determined according to the deviation of the measured circle model and the fitted circle model, a micro-inclination angle identification model is built based on a random forest algorithm according to the deviation change rule, and the deviation angle of the ranging sensor is obtained according to the relation between the deviation angle and the deviation change value of the ranging sensor.

title_en: Time difference calibration method and device of metering device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a time difference calibration method, a time difference calibration device and electronic equipment of a metering device, wherein the method comprises the steps of respectively acquiring initial first transmission time from an upstream transducer to a downstream transducer and initial second transmission time from the downstream transducer to the upstream transducer in N periods of ultrasonic signals; for the nth period, respectively determining an initial first transmission time as a first transmission time, determining an initial second transmission time as a second transmission time, calculating a time difference between the second transmission time and the first transmission time, adjusting the first transmission time or the second transmission time by using a staggered wave when the time difference exceeds a preset range, traversing the next period until the N periods are traversed to obtain a filled time difference array, and determining a target time difference according to each time difference recorded in the time difference array. The embodiment of the invention can improve the time difference measurement precision, thereby improving the calculation accuracy of parameters such as the flow speed, the flow quantity and the like of the fluid to be measured.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted bow net temperature detection method and device
abstract_en: The application provides a vehicle-mounted bow net temperature detection method and device, wherein the vehicle-mounted bow net temperature detection method comprises the steps of collecting an initial infrared image set containing a bow net related to a target train through infrared imaging equipment arranged on the roof of the target train, screening the initial infrared image contained in the initial infrared image set based on a pre-trained definition recognition model to obtain a to-be-processed infrared image set, processing the to-be-processed infrared image contained in the to-be-processed infrared image set based on a pre-trained noise point elimination model to obtain a target infrared image set, and determining the bow net temperature related to the target train according to the target infrared image set. The automatic bow net temperature monitoring is realized, and the problems of image blurring, quality reduction, isolated impulse noise point and the like caused by train movement are avoided, so that the temperature monitoring process is influenced.

title_en: Tungsten-rhenium thermocouple automatic detection system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic detection system and method for tungsten-rhenium thermocouples, which relate to the technical field of thermocouple detection, wherein a reference end of a detected tungsten-rhenium thermocouple in the system is directly connected with a change-over switch, a digital thermometer is used for measuring the temperature of the reference end of the detected tungsten-rhenium thermocouple, compared with the traditional mode that the reference end is sequentially connected with the compensation wire and the copper wire and then the freezing point thermostat is inserted to be connected with the change-over switch, when the number of the tungsten-rhenium thermocouples to be detected is large, the problem that the compensation wire and the freezing point thermostat are used in a large number is avoided, the system structure is simplified, and the stability of the system is improved. And moreover, the actual thermoelectromotive force and indication deviation of the detected tungsten-rhenium thermocouple at the detected temperature point are calculated based on the temperature of the reference end of the detected tungsten-rhenium thermocouple measured by the digital thermometer, so that the problem that the ambient temperature corresponding to the correction value of the traditional compensation lead deviates from the actual ambient temperature is solved, namely the condition limit on the detection environment is reduced, and meanwhile, the accuracy of a calculation result is improved.

title_en: Test tool and method for network transformer
abstract_en: The application provides a testing tool of a network transformer, which comprises a testing motherboard, wherein a first connector and a multistage switch are arranged on the testing motherboard, the first connector is used for being connected with the network transformer to be tested, the first connector comprises a plurality of first connecting channels, the network transformer to be tested comprises a plurality of testing channels, each testing channel is connected with one first connecting channel, each first connecting channel is connected with a multistage switch, one end of the multistage switch, which is far away from the first connecting channel, is used for being connected with a testing instrument, and the testing instrument can be communicated with at least one first connecting channel by adjusting the on-off state of the multistage switch so as to finish a plurality of tests on the testing channels. The application can improve the testing efficiency of the network transformer to be tested, prolong the service lives of the testing instrument and the network transformer to be tested, and is beneficial to improving the practicability of the testing tool.

title_en: Intelligent robot mine scanning device
abstract_en: The application relates to an intelligent robot mine scanning device, which relates to the technical field of mine scanning and comprises a walking assembly and a fixed bin, wherein the fixed bin is installed on the walking assembly, anti-smashing assemblies for preventing falling objects from smashing to the fixed bin are symmetrically arranged on the fixed bin, communication assemblies are symmetrically arranged at the inner top of the fixed bin, the anti-smashing assemblies and the communication assemblies are arranged through hydraulic transmission, a collecting assembly is arranged in the fixed bin, falling objects smash into the anti-smashing assemblies, the communication assemblies are started to enable the falling objects to fall into the collecting assembly, rotating assemblies are installed on the side faces of the fixed bin, and scanning modules for detecting mines are arranged on the rotating assemblies. The application has the effects of reducing the exposure time of personnel in dangerous areas and improving the automation level and the overall efficiency of mine scanning operation.

title_en: Intelligent textile fabric quality detection method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent textile fabric quality detection method and system, which relate to the technical field of textile fabric quality detection and comprise the steps of carrying out data acquisition, type processing and feature extraction analysis on textile fabrics through a plurality of sensor groups, carrying out fabric feature positioning, obtaining type abnormal distribution information according to fabric feature positioning information, carrying out quantity and range comparison analysis on the type abnormal distribution information, carrying out abnormality degree analysis when one type of comparison analysis result is normal in characteristic and the other type of comparison analysis result is abnormal in characteristic, further determining abnormal types of fabrics, obtaining a type number ratio according to the abnormal type number of fabrics and the normal type number of fabrics, carrying out abnormality judgment on the textile fabrics according to the type number ratio, and obtaining fabric abnormality judgment information.

title_en: Battery thermal runaway detection method and device
abstract_en: The application provides a battery thermal runaway detection method and device, in the method, a time sequence signal generated when a gas sensor identifies a gas component released by a battery is acquired, the time sequence signal is converted into an image signal to strengthen key characteristics in the signal, then the image signal is processed through a target detection model, the gas type and the gas concentration are predicted, and then the risk of the battery thermal runaway is determined according to a prediction result. Therefore, by introducing a machine learning algorithm, the method not only meets the simple gas identification requirement, but also can carry out complex data analysis and prediction, thereby realizing accurate prediction of the thermal runaway risk of the lithium battery and effectively improving the thermal runaway early warning precision.

title_en: Apparatus and method for stress testing
abstract_en: The first voltage source is coupled to a first terminal of the test transistor. The first terminal of the detection circuit is coupled to the first terminal of the test transistor. A second terminal of the probing circuit is coupled to a second terminal of the test transistor. A third terminal of the detection circuit is coupled to the control terminal of the test transistor. The first terminal of the first resistor is coupled to the second terminal of the test transistor. The second terminal of the first resistor is coupled to a second voltage source. The first input terminal of the amplifier is coupled to a third voltage source. A second input terminal of the amplifier is coupled to a first terminal of the first resistor. The output terminal of the amplifier is coupled to the control terminal of the test transistor. Embodiments of the present application also relate to apparatus and methods for stress testing.

title_en: Visual inspection equipment for surface oxidation defect of aluminum alloy profile
abstract_en: The invention discloses visual detection equipment for surface oxidation defects of aluminum alloy sections, which belongs to the technical field of section visual detection, wherein a first connecting rod is pulled through a protruding end on the left side of a deflection seat, so that a right side turning material plate can rotate anticlockwise and is in contact with an upper section, meanwhile, a protruding end on the right side of the deflection seat pushes a second connecting rod, so that the left side turning material plate can rotate clockwise, the right side turning material plate can turn the section into a material supporting groove in the left side turning material plate, the section can fall on two conveying belts along with the anticlockwise rotation of the deflection seat, one hundred and eighty degrees of turn-over work of the section is completed, one face of the section after detection faces downwards and contacts with the conveying belts, the undetected face faces upwards, thus the double-face detection work of the section is completed, the section is prevented from being scratched after the turning-over operation is carried out without adding a mechanical arm, and the whole detection process is carried out on the same conveying line, so that the detection efficiency of the surface of the aluminum alloy section is improved.

title_en: Automobile part detector and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of automobile part detection, in particular to an automobile part detector and an automobile part detection system, comprising a detection table, a shooting instrument and an adjusting assembly, wherein the adjusting assembly comprises an extension bracket, a screw adjusting mechanism, a main table sliding frame, an extension sliding frame, a mounting member and a driving and controlling member, the extension bracket is slidably arranged on one side of the detection table, the screw adjusting mechanism is arranged on the detection table, the main table sliding frame is slidably arranged on one side of the detection table, the extension sliding frame is slidably arranged on one side of the extension bracket, the mounting member is connected with the main table sliding frame, the driving and controlling member is connected with the detection table, and the whole detection range and the placement range can be adjusted according to the actual sizes of parts through the arranged members, so that the detector is more flexible in actual operation and is convenient for users to detect automobile parts with different types of sizes.

title_en: Battery diagnosis device, battery pack, battery system, and battery diagnosis method
abstract_en: Provided are a battery diagnosis device, a battery pack, a battery system, and a battery diagnosis method. The battery diagnosis apparatus includes a data acquisition unit configured to acquire capacity-voltage relationship data of a battery cell, and a processor configured to generate a voltage curve and a differential voltage curve of the battery cell based on the capacity-voltage relationship data. The processor is configured to extract a first curve of interest from the voltage curve based on the feature points of the differential voltage curve. The processor is configured to determine a characteristic curvature associated with the first curve of interest. The processor is configured to diagnose a degradation state of the battery cell based on the characteristic curvature.

title_en: Environment-friendly molten salt environment creep mechanical property testing equipment and testing method
abstract_en: The application provides environment-friendly molten salt environment creep mechanical property testing equipment and a testing method, and relates to the technical field of creep tests in molten salt environments. The application comprises a main machine of the testing machine, a gas filtering system, an upper clamping section, a lower clamping section, a container, a fused salt and a sample, wherein the top end of the upper clamping section is detachably connected with the upper fixed end of the main machine of the testing machine, the bottom end of the lower clamping section is detachably connected with the lower stretching end of the main machine of the testing machine, the gas filtering system is arranged corresponding to the top of the container, the bottom end of the upper clamping section stretches into the top of the container and is blocked at the top of the container, the top end of the lower clamping section is detachably connected with the bottom of the container and is in sealing arrangement with the container, the sample is detachably connected between the bottom end of the upper clamping section and the top end of the lower clamping section and is positioned in the container, and the fused salt is positioned between the inner wall of the container and the sample. Overall, the application has simple structure, effectively improves the sealing performance and reduces the influence on the data accuracy.

title_en: Metal corrosion monitoring device and method based on magnetic attraction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a metal corrosion monitoring device based on magnetic attraction, which comprises a central processing unit and also comprises a collecting module, wherein the input end of the collecting module is provided with a connecting wire, the connecting wire is connected with an adsorption module matched with metal to be tested, the collecting module is provided with a communication module, and the signal output end of the communication module is connected with the central processing unit and transmits signals collected by the collecting module to the central processing unit. The adsorption module is matched with the metal to be detected, the acquisition module magnetizes the adsorption module through the connecting wire, and a corrosion detection dynamic model of the metal to be detected is constructed through acquired magnetization data, so that the adsorption module is simple in structure and good in adaptability, and corrosion monitoring in a long-term complex environment can be completed.

title_en: Preparation method of heparin disaccharide standard substance
abstract_en: The invention particularly relates to a preparation method of a heparin disaccharide standard substance. Heparin is a polysaccharide drug with extremely complex structure, and is widely applied to the prevention and treatment of cardiovascular diseases. Heparin disaccharide composition is an important component of heparin structural analysis. However, due to the complex synthesis route of heparin disaccharide, the structure of the raw materials is complex, and no heparin disaccharide standard substance exists in China at present. The invention adopts means such as membrane separation, chromatographic separation, salting out and the like to purify and prepare the high-purity heparin disaccharide raw material, and the purity of the raw material can reach more than 99 percent after measurement, thus being expected to be used as a heparin disaccharide standard substance.

title_en: Hardness detection device for polyester chips
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of polyester chip detection, and discloses a hardness detection device for polyester chips, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a top frame is arranged right above the bottom plate, a supporting rod is connected to the lower edge of the top frame, the bottom end of the supporting rod is fixedly connected to the bottom plate, a gap type rotating structure is arranged on the bottom plate, a material transferring structure is arranged in the top frame, and the intermittent type rotating structure is utilized to drive a rotating disc on the material transferring structure to intermittently rotate, so that the polyester chips can be fed in one of the material tanks on the rotating disc, and simultaneously, the polyester chips in other material tanks can be subjected to extrusion detection and cleaning and blanking work, the working time is reasonably utilized, the detection working efficiency is greatly improved, the hardness detection of the polyester chips in the material tanks is also prevented, the problem that the polyester chips fall in the hardness detection process is also prevented, and the normal operation of the detection work is ensured.

title_en: Weak measurement high-sensitivity interval compensation method and system for zero calibration
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for compensating a weak measurement high-sensitivity interval of zero calibration, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting light intensity data of two paths and four paths in a zero input state, calculating asymmetry caused by channel loss difference by using the weak measurement method, correcting a system according to intensity difference of output projection to a horizontal polarization state and a vertical polarization state, selecting the state, compensating sensitivity, calculating phase offset of the high-sensitivity interval according to the four paths of channel loss difference, generating compensation phase, and modulating the center of the high-sensitivity interval to a working point. Compared with the prior art, the method can correct high-sensitivity loss and high-sensitivity interval offset caused by system asymmetry through phase compensation and post-selection state correction, ensure that a measurement system always works in an optimal sensitivity interval, improve measurement sensitivity and stability of a photoelectric detection system under weak measurement, and is suitable for application scenes with strict requirements on micro signal detection.

title_en: Anticorrosion pipeline anticorrosion coating adhesive force testing device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of pipeline anti-corrosion coating testing, in particular to an anti-corrosion pipeline anti-corrosion coating adhesive force testing device which comprises a base, wherein a placing table is arranged at the top of the base, and an adjusting and fixing assembly is arranged at the top of the placing table. This anticorrosive pipeline anticorrosive coating adhesive force testing arrangement through being provided with presses the test module, can detect with pressing the test module during the detection, selects the steel ball of suitable diameter to install its below at the clamp plate, then can hold the grip and drive the screw rod and twist for the clamp plate moves down, slowly exerts pressure through loading mechanism, makes steel ball and pipeline anticorrosive coating surface contact, and increase pressure gradually, in the in-process of exerting pressure, observe the change on coating surface, the pressure value when the beginning crack appears in the record coating, peel off or other destruction phenomenon, the pressure value is through the degree of depth auxiliary judgement of sliding down, obtain the adhesive force data of coating under different pressure conditions.

title_en: Bearing temperature early warning device for wind power generation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bearing temperature early warning device for wind power generation, which relates to the technical field of monitoring of wind power generation equipment and comprises a power generation mechanism, wherein a detection mechanism and a braking mechanism are arranged in the power generation mechanism, and an early warning control mechanism is arranged on one side of the inner wall of the power generation mechanism. According to the invention, the temperature sensors are annularly distributed and mounted on the mounting sleeve, the temperature detection probes are arranged on the temperature sensors, so that the temperature detection probes are close to the position of the transmission shaft, the real-time monitoring and sensing of the temperature of the transmission shaft are facilitated, the comparison of data is facilitated through the distribution of a plurality of groups of designs, the accuracy of the test is effectively improved, the synchronous transmission detection function is realized when the transmission shaft rotates through the rotation speed detection roller, the rotation speed of the transmission shaft is conveniently and timely fed back, and the detection effect is improved.

title_en: Improved Hough transformation track starting method based on correction
abstract_en: The invention discloses an improved method for starting a path based on modified Hough transformation, which is designed for solving the problem of high false alarm rate of path starting under a strong clutter environment and comprises the steps of clutter filtering and path starting. The calculation amount of the algorithm is reduced by using the clutter filtering algorithm, the clutter is less and relatively concentrated after clutter filtering, and the fine track starting algorithm suitable for the environment with less clutter and relatively concentrated is designed, so that the calculation amount and the storage space of a system occupied by the track starting are reduced as much as possible, and the track starting algorithm with high quality is ensured.

title_en: Buried pipeline earthquake vulnerability analysis method based on three-parameter square normal distribution
abstract_en: The invention discloses a buried pipeline earthquake vulnerability analysis method based on three-parameter square normal distribution, which belongs to the field of civil engineering and earthquake engineering and solves the problem that the existing lognormal distribution model cannot accurately reflect the deviation characteristic of structural response data so as to cause calculation deviation of failure probability; the invention constructs a complete system covering earthquake motion simulation, buried pipeline response analysis and earthquake vulnerability analysis, and improves the calculation accuracy of the earthquake failure probability of the buried pipeline by introducing three-parameter square normal distribution capable of accurately reflecting the deviation characteristics of structural response data, thereby providing an earthquake vulnerability model with wider application range and higher accuracy.

title_en: High-resolution remote sensing camera vibration isolation and detection integrated device for micro-nano satellite
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-resolution remote sensing camera vibration isolation detection integrated device for a micro-nano satellite, which comprises a vibration damping base, wherein the vibration damping base consists of a vibration damping platform and a vibration damping support, the vibration damping support is arranged at the bottom end of the vibration damping platform, a support component is arranged below the vibration damping support, a damping block is fixedly connected to the vibration damping support, a dynamic vibration isolation detection integrated component is fixedly connected to the damping block, the dynamic vibration isolation detection integrated component comprises a sensor, and the sensor is used for dynamically detecting the displacement and the acceleration of the integrated component. The vibration energy is uniformly dispersed through the dynamic vibration isolation detection integrated component, the vibration isolation structure is used for buffering and isolating vibration, the influence on the high-resolution camera by a vibration source in a satellite is reduced, the anti-interference capability of the high-resolution camera is improved, the vibration intensity in each direction can be real-time detected by the sensor, the potential vibration problem can be timely found and treated, and the working stability and reliability of the high-resolution camera are ensured.

title_en: Optical cable route calibration method and system based on optical cable route census instrument
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of data denoising, in particular to an optical cable route calibration method and system based on an optical cable route census instrument, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a vibration intensity sequence, GPS positioning coordinates and geographic position names of target calibration points in an optical cable pipe gallery channel to be tested; obtaining clutter confidence coefficient of each peak position according to local distribution characteristics and difference conditions of clutter interference degree, correcting each peak value in the vibration intensity sequence, further determining the cable skin length of each target calibration point, and completing cable route calibration through the cable skin length, GPS positioning coordinates and geographical position names of each target calibration point in a pipe gallery channel of the cable to be tested. The application can improve the data precision of the calibration point in the optical cable route calibration process and the route calibration accuracy.

title_en: Method for creating a navigation base for navigating in a sales area
abstract_en: Method for creating a navigation basis for navigating in a sales area, with the method steps listed-detecting a magnetic field along a movement path in the sales area by means of at least one position-variable magnetic field detection device which moves along the movement path in the sales area, and-establishing a position reference in the sales space in a computer manner for the magnetic field detected at the respective position along the movement path, and-storing the detected magnetic field and its position reference in the sales area in the form of a digital magnetic field map.

title_en: Distributed optical fiber multi-parameter testing system and method for landslide surge model test
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide surge model test distributed optical fiber multi-parameter test system and a method, wherein the system comprises a landslide surge physical model module, a distributed optical fiber sensing network module, an integrated demodulation module and a data processing module; the method comprises the steps of determining the size of a landslide and surge physical model, arranging a distributed optical fiber sensing network module, synchronously demodulating multi-parameter signals, carrying out data denoising and feature extraction, establishing a Kalman filtering state equation and an observation equation of a multi-parameter coupling state vector, and capturing the whole process of landslide impact, wave height propagation and energy transfer of dam vibration. The test system of the invention realizes high-precision, distributed and synchronous monitoring of physical and mechanical parameters in the whole landslide and surge process, introduces Kalman filtering denoising in the test method, calculates multi-parameter time domain characteristic values, solves the problems of multi-equipment dispersion and poor data consistency in the traditional scheme, and has the advantages of high precision, electromagnetic interference resistance, corrosion resistance, long test distance and high spatial resolution.

title_en: Rotating shaft linkage experiment device and method for five-axis machine tool configuration forward design
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rotating shaft linkage experiment device and method for forward design of a five-axis machine tool configuration, comprising a support frame, wherein the tail end of an upper support frame of the support frame is provided with a swinging head mechanism, the tail end of a lower support frame is provided with a rotary table mechanism, the swinging head mechanism comprises a B axis and a C swinging head shaft, the B axis is arranged on an upper mounting seat, the upper mounting seat is rotationally connected with the tail end of the upper support frame through the C swinging head shaft, the B axis is connected with a swinging head translation mechanism, the rotary table mechanism comprises a C rotary table shaft and an A axis, the C rotary table shaft is arranged on the inner bottom surface of a U-shaped frame, the U-shaped frame is rotationally connected with a lower mounting seat through the A axis, the lower mounting seat is fixed with the tail end of the lower support frame, the C rotary table translation mechanism is arranged on the C rotary table shaft, and the upper end of the rotary table translation mechanism is provided with a guide rail sliding block. By utilizing the invention, the linkage experiment of the rotating shaft of the five-axis machine tool can be realized, and the forward design of the configuration and structural parameters of the five-axis machine tool can be guided by comparing the linkage characteristics of the rotating shafts of the machine tools with different configurations.

title_en: Impedance calculation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an impedance calculation method and an impedance calculation system, which belong to the technical field of impedance measurement, wherein a voltage signal sequence and a current signal sequence are obtained by collecting voltages and currents at two ends of a to-be-measured product, a voltage error equation and a current error equation are established, the voltage error equation and the current error equation are solved by using a nonlinear least square method, so that the voltage error and the current error are minimized, an optimized voltage signal amplitude, a voltage signal phase angle, a current signal amplitude and a current signal phase angle are obtained, and then an impedance module value, a phase angle, a resistance and reactance are calculated. Therefore, the impedance calculation method and the impedance calculation system do not carry out Fourier transform, avoid being influenced by noise with the same frequency, improve the accuracy of impedance calculation and solve the technical problem that the impedance calculation is easily influenced by noise in the prior art.

title_en: Poria cocos and cassava mixed nondestructive testing method based on headspace-solid phase microextraction
abstract_en: The invention relates to a headspace-solid phase microextraction-based poria cocos and cassava nondestructive testing method. The method comprises the steps of (1) sample pretreatment, (2) microextraction adsorption, namely adopting a DVB/CAR/PDMS three-component composite solid-phase microextraction needle subjected to 250 ℃ aging treatment to adsorb 40+/-2 minutes at a constant temperature of 25+/-1 ℃, and (3) thermal desorption analysis, namely inserting the adsorbed extraction needle into a gas chromatography-mass spectrometer combined instrument provided with a cold trap focusing module, desorbing for 300 seconds at a sample inlet at 260 ℃, and improving peak shape sharpness through secondary focusing, (4) chromatographic separation conditions, (5) mass spectrum detection conditions, and (6) characteristic marker combined judgment, namely judging that the poria cocos sample is doped with cassava when anethole and decanol are detected simultaneously. The invention can carry out nondestructive identification.

title_en: Unmanned vehicle emergency deviation rectifying method and system with road-air coordination
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses an unmanned vehicle emergency correction method and system with road-air coordination, wherein the unmanned vehicle is used for carrying laser radar to collect environmental data and realizing sensor space-time calibration by combining RTK positioning and PTP time synchronization; and the three-dimensional point cloud map is built by fusing IMU pre-integration and laser odometer and RTK constraint by adopting SLAM technology, and the point cloud is filtered, downsampled, converted into a two-dimensional travelable area map through orthogonal projection and transmitted to the unmanned vehicle. And the unmanned vehicle calculates the distance between the left and right vertexes and the boundary of the drivable region in real time, and when any distance is smaller than a threshold value, the unmanned vehicle requests reverse steering torque to the electric power steering system to realize deviation correction. The method gets rid of dependence on illumination and lane lines, multiplexes the laser radar, reduces cost, is suitable for complex scenes such as ports, disaster areas and the like, and effectively reduces collision risk.

title_en: Gear short shaft measuring device and method
abstract_en: The application discloses a gear short shaft measuring device and a method, which relate to the technical field of measurement of specific variables, wherein the measuring device comprises a base, a positioning plate, a supporting plate and a first measuring meter, wherein the positioning plate and the supporting plate are arranged on the base, a positioning inclined plane is arranged on the positioning plate, and a V-shaped groove is arranged on the supporting plate; the first measuring meter is arranged on the base and at least arranged at one end position of the gear shaft. According to the gear short shaft measuring device, the positioning inclined plane is used as a reference, the gear short shaft measuring device is directly attached to the inclined plane of the measured gear shaft for positioning, the V-shaped groove is used for supporting the shaft body in an auxiliary mode, the workpiece is effectively prevented from shifting, shaking or tilting in the measuring process, the clamping state of each measurement is consistent, the process that a measurement starting point is required to be found repeatedly or the measurement process of complex equipment is relied on in the traditional measurement is avoided, the rapid clamping and alignment of the workpiece are achieved, the single piece detection time is obviously shortened, and the measurement efficiency is improved.

title_en: Sample automated management and distribution system and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sample automatic management and distribution system and device in the technical field of pathology research, and the system comprises a transmission device, a material preparation assembly and a material distribution assembly, wherein the material preparation assembly and the material distribution assembly are sequentially arranged on the transmission device along the transmission direction, the material preparation assembly comprises two first baffles and a control assembly arranged on the first baffles, the material distribution assembly comprises two second baffles and a second driving piece for driving the two second baffles to move, the control assembly of the material preparation assembly is used for controlling serum samples, so that the serum samples are fed onto the material distribution assembly one by one, the second driving piece drives the two second baffles to move, the transmission areas corresponding to the transmission ends of the two second baffles are changed, the serum samples between the two second baffles can be fed into different transmission areas, the intelligent distribution of the serum samples is realized, the problem of sample accumulation of the transmission areas is effectively avoided, and the detection efficiency is improved.

title_en: Method and system for positioning defects of piezoelectric device based on dynamic weighting feature fusion
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of industrial visual detection and discloses a method and a system for positioning defects of a piezoelectric device based on dynamic weighting feature fusion, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining an image to be detected and extracting a multi-scale feature map; the method comprises the steps of constructing a state vector based on a feature map and an uncertainty map generated through a scout network, inputting the state vector into a cyclic strategy agent to generate a composite action comprising dynamic fusion weights and processing path selection, carrying out dynamic weighted fusion on a multi-scale feature map according to the composite action, and calling a detection head corresponding to the selected path to decode, so as to obtain a defect positioning result. The system comprises a feature extraction module, a state construction module, a circulating strategy agent and a strategy driving execution module. According to the application, by introducing the circulation strategy agent and adaptively controlling the feature fusion and decoding process in a reinforcement learning manner, the positioning accuracy and robustness can be improved, the decision cost is considered, and the intelligent level is improved.

title_en: Mine wind power supply system monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power supply system monitoring, and particularly relates to a mine wind power supply system monitoring method. The fan fault diagnosis method based on zero sample learning is provided for solving the problem that the fault class of the training set is different from the fault class of the test set. The method comprises the following steps of S1, building a fan fault diagnosis frame considering unknown faults, S2, embedding a fan fault attribute space in a fault sample space and a fault category space, establishing a mapping classification of a fault sample, a fault attribute and a fault category, S3, describing the fault attribute to form a fault attribute feature set, S4, preprocessing data of the fault attribute feature set by adopting a supervised principal component analysis method, extracting key fault features, S5, carrying out fault classification based on the preprocessed fault features, and S6, dynamically updating diagnosis capability by adopting an incremental diagnosis method.

title_en: Efficiency optimization method, equipment and system of photovoltaic photo-thermal system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of solar power generation, in particular to an efficiency optimization method, equipment and system of a photovoltaic photo-thermal system. The first-stage tracking device of the four-side ladder photoelectric sensor is started under the condition of real-time weather, the azimuth angle and the altitude angle of sunlight incidence are subjected to first-stage adjustment, photovoltaic power generation or photo-thermal power generation is alternately selected, the real-time weather is obtained through a cloud image, correction is carried out through a weather radar, the actual power generation of one day and the power generation predicted according to the weather of one day are compared, the second-stage tracking device of the four-side ladder photoelectric sensor is started according to the comparison result, the azimuth angle and the altitude angle of sunlight incidence are subjected to second-stage adjustment, and the alternating selection rule of the photovoltaic power generation or the photo-thermal power generation is corrected, so that the efficiency optimization of photovoltaic power generation and photo-thermal power generation is realized, the service lives of a photovoltaic panel and the photo-thermal power generation are prolonged, and the efficiency optimization of solar power generation is realized aiming at the real-time weather condition of each day.

title_en: Automatic drainage structure of internal pipeline of differential pressure sensor
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic drainage structure of an internal pipeline of a differential pressure sensor, which relates to the technical field of sensors and comprises a shell part, wherein an equipment cabin and a drainage cabin are sequentially stacked and communicated in the shell part, a plurality of pressure sensing spaces are formed in the drainage cabin in a separated mode, a differential pressure sensing element is arranged in the equipment cabin, the pressure sensing end of the differential pressure sensing element faces the drainage cabin to measure the air pressure of the pressure sensing spaces, a plurality of air inlet pipes are arranged on one side of the drainage cabin and are respectively communicated with the pressure sensing spaces, a drainage inclined surface inclining from the drainage cabin to the air inlet pipes is arranged in one side of the drainage cabin, which is adjacent to the air inlet pipes, and is used for promoting condensate water to drain from gravity along the drainage inclined surface, the volume of a single pressure sensing space is larger than the volume of the air inlet pipes connected with the single pressure sensing space, so that differential pressure is used for assisting drainage by utilizing air pressure change, and the structure can realize efficient drainage of condensate water under the condition that the installation size of the sensor is unchanged, the reliability under low temperature and complex environment is improved, the pipeline blockage is avoided, and the measurement accuracy and the service life is ensured.

title_en: Cable insulation degradation degree assessment method based on frequency domain feature analysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to a cable insulation degradation degree assessment method based on frequency domain feature analysis, which belongs to the field of cable insulation degradation detection, and comprises the steps of collecting cable operation environment data and laboratory accelerated aging data, generating a low-frequency impedance characteristic data set marked in a growth stage of a water tree, extracting a dielectric response spectrogram and analyzing a relaxation polarization peak value, extracting harmonic component features and loss factor distribution features by wavelet transformation and principal component analysis when the peak value exceeds a threshold value, constructing a support vector regression model to predict the length, density and growth stage of the water tree, calculating microstructure evolution feature parameters for the middle-later water tree, predicting insulation penetration time, simulating and analyzing degradation probability by Monte Carlo to generate a risk distribution curve, optimizing cable replacement time by adopting dynamic programming, and outputting an assessment report of quantized degradation degree and maintenance advice. The invention realizes accurate evaluation and prediction of cable insulation degradation and provides important guarantee for safe operation of the power system.

title_en: Evaluation method for equivalent service life of wind power blade
abstract_en: The application discloses an evaluation method for equivalent service life of a wind power blade. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a wind power blade standard test sample, setting four-point bending fatigue test parameters, carrying out four-point fatigue bending tests for specified times on the wind power blade standard test sample, obtaining test sample bars, setting parameters of static bending tests, testing static bending performance of the test sample bars, drawing a relation curve of static bending modulus of the test sample bars and the fatigue times of the wind power blade standard test sample, and testing static Qu Moliang of a wind power blade actually in service to obtain equivalent service life of the wind power blade. According to the method, the modulus and the strength of the standard spline are obtained through designing the fatigue times of the wind power blade, the quantitative relation between the modulus and the fatigue times is built, the relation curve is obtained, the bending modulus of the experimental spline is tested, and the equivalent service life is obtained through comparing the bending modulus of the experimental spline with the modulus of the standard spline, so that the time-consuming problem of testing a large experimental sample piece is avoided, and the equivalent service life of the experimental spline can be estimated rapidly and accurately.

title_en: Skin structure forming quality control system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a skin structure forming quality control system and a skin structure forming quality control method. The system comprises a six-axis industrial robot (1), a tail end quality detection unit (2), a turntable (4), a supporting platform (5) and a control console (6), wherein the tail end quality detection unit (2) acquires surface image information in real time and transmits the surface image information back to the control console (6) for defect detection, and the control console (6) controls the tail end quality detection unit (2) to move and position to a defect area according to a defect detection result. The invention can effectively reduce the error rate of operators, greatly improve the molding efficiency of the skin composite material and reduce the economic loss of enterprises.

title_en: Method for measuring bleeding rate and static shear force of slurry
abstract_en: The invention discloses a test measurement method of a slurry bleeding rate and a static shear force, which is based on a bleeding device, wherein the bleeding device comprises a mounting plate, the bottom surface of the mounting plate is connected with a shell, a sealing cavity is formed in the shell, a water permeable shell is arranged in the sealing cavity, a cavity is formed between the periphery of the water permeable shell and the shell, a cylindrical water draining cavity is formed in the water permeable shell, an air injection channel communicated with the cavity and a grouting channel communicated with the water draining cavity are arranged on the mounting plate, a liquid draining metering device communicated with the cavity is arranged at the bottom of the shell, a driving motor is fixedly arranged above the mounting plate, the output end of the driving motor is sequentially connected with a coupler, a dynamic torque sensor and a rotating shaft in a transmission manner from top to bottom, a shaft hole is arranged on the mounting plate, the rotating shaft penetrates through the shaft hole and stretches into the water draining cavity, the rotating shaft and the water draining cavity are coaxially arranged, and the end part of the rotating shaft is connected with a rectangular slurry plate. Different rotation speeds and different pressures can be set, tests can be carried out respectively, the bleeding rate and the static shearing force of the slurry under different conditions can be measured, and the measurement accuracy is high.

title_en: CCD precision calibration method for winding machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of precision verification, in particular to a CCD precision verification method for a winding machine, which comprises the following steps: based on a standard calibration plate image, firstly carrying out graying treatment on the image, then applying gradient change detection to locate the initial pixel coordinates of a plurality of angular points, and carrying out interpolation operation by using the gray values of neighborhood pixels to obtain sub-pixel level coordinates. In the invention, in the static calibration stage, through carrying out graying treatment, gradient change detection and sub-pixel interpolation on the standard calibration plate image, the corner point can be positioned with higher resolution, which provides a firmer data base for the subsequent solution of the internal parameters and distortion coefficients of the camera, so that the generated distortion correction mapping table can restore the geometric relationship of the image more accurately, and the systematic image distortion introduced by the optical lens is eliminated. Next, the reference pixel equivalent is calculated using the undistorted image, ensuring global consistency of pixel-to-physical size conversion.

title_en: Wafer scanning data acquisition method and verification method of semiconductor detection system
abstract_en: The invention provides a wafer scanning data acquisition method and a verification method of a semiconductor detection system, wherein the wafer scanning data acquisition method comprises the following steps: and acquiring the scanning simulation parameters and the description data of the wafer scanning characteristics, and generating the wafer scanning data according to the scanning simulation parameters and the description data of the wafer scanning characteristics. According to the invention, the description data describing the scanning characteristics of the wafer are subjected to simulated scanning through the scanning simulation parameters so as to obtain the wafer scanning data, so that the real wafer is not required to be scanned by real scanning equipment, and the acquisition cost of the wafer scanning data is reduced.

title_en: Pavement crack disease optimization identification method based on grading mechanism and data enhancement
abstract_en: The application discloses a pavement crack disease optimizing and identifying method based on a grading mechanism and data enhancement, which is characterized in that the grading mechanism of the crack severity is introduced, the detection precision of mild cracks is effectively improved, meanwhile, the crack detection is divided into different grades, a clearer technical basis is provided for subsequent coring verification and engineering decision, a diversified data enhancement strategy is further introduced on the grading basis, a training data set is enriched through turning, cutting, brightness adjustment, saturation adjustment and sharpening processing data expansion modes, the robustness and detection capability of a model on complex crack diseases are obviously improved, and the identification efficiency and accuracy of the crack diseases in a pavement structure in three-dimensional ground penetrating radar data processing are effectively improved.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle area coverage flight path planning method and system based on graph segmentation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for planning an unmanned aerial vehicle area coverage flight path based on graph segmentation, which relate to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle path planning, and are characterized in that a high-quality, comprehensive-coverage and robust coverage point pool is constructed for subsequent greedy selection through self-adaptive generation of a candidate point strategy, then a greedy selection mechanism based on effective scores is adopted, the current optimal coverage point is accurately selected in each round of iteration, the new coverage area can be increased to the maximum extent, the overlapping area can be effectively controlled, and finally the complete coverage of the whole target area by using the minimum number of circles is realized. At the level of a path planning algorithm, a hybrid initialization mode combining a greedy algorithm and a random generation strategy is innovatively balanced, and meanwhile, in each generation of evolution of a genetic algorithm, a 2-opt local search strategy is embedded into a new non-elite individual, so that the algorithm convergence speed is increased, and the path optimization efficiency is remarkably improved. In conclusion, the method and the device can realize more efficient and reliable planning of the unmanned aerial vehicle area coverage flight path.

title_en: IMU attitude estimation and error correction method based on state space physical information neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of inertial navigation and sensor fusion, in particular to an IMU attitude estimation and error correction method based on a state space physical information neural network, which comprises the steps of collecting original data of an IMU and preprocessing; the method comprises the steps of constructing a state space model, designing a state transition physical information neural network based on the state space model, training the state transition physical information neural network based on preprocessed original data, optimizing network parameters through a joint loss function in the training process, obtaining a trained state transition physical information neural network, collecting real-time data flow of an IMU, inputting the real-time data flow into the trained state transition physical information neural network, and outputting corrected pose, position and speed. According to the invention, by fusing physical constraint and adaptive noise estimation, the attitude estimation precision and the error correction capability under a dynamic complex environment are obviously improved.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and medium for detecting air leakage of pneumatic system of steel mill
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of steel rolling. A method for detecting air leakage of pneumatic system in steel mill includes obtaining air supply pressure and air supply flow of main pipe, judging whether air leakage exists or not according to air supply flow based on initial flow threshold value set in advance, obtaining system pressure and working state of each cylinder at each sampling time when air leakage exists, obtaining theoretical air consumption flow at each sampling time according to air supply pressure of main pipe, air supply flow and system pressure based on flow model set in advance, and judging position of air leakage cylinder according to theoretical air consumption flow at each sampling time and working state of each cylinder. According to the application, the air leakage judgment is carried out according to the initial flow threshold, and then the air leakage cylinder position is determined according to the theoretical air consumption flow obtained through calculation and the working state of each cylinder, so that the air leakage position can be determined efficiently and accurately, the manpower and material resources are saved, and the energy and the cost are saved.

title_en: Cable surface damage detection device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of cable detection, in particular to a cable surface damage detection device, which comprises a sleeve ball sleeved on the outer side of a detection cable, wherein one side of the sleeve ball is provided with a through hole penetrating to the other side, the sleeve ball consists of a reinforced hemisphere and a detection hemisphere, an optical probe is arranged in the detection hemisphere, a plurality of atomizing nozzles for cleaning the surface of the cable are also arranged in the detection hemisphere, and a spray pipe for spraying repair materials to the surface of the detection cable is arranged in the reinforced hemisphere.

title_en: Construction method and application of liver-warming decoction fingerprint
abstract_en: The invention provides a construction method and application of a liver-warming decoction fingerprint, belonging to the technical field of medicine detection, wherein the construction method comprises the steps of preparing a sample solution by utilizing liver-warming decoction, and then obtaining the liver-warming decoction fingerprint by taking acetonitrile (A) -0.08-0.12wt% formic acid aqueous solution (B) as a mobile phase and detecting by high performance liquid chromatography; and establishes a standard fingerprint spectrum for quality evaluation or control in the whole process of liver warming decoction research/development/production/clinical application. According to the construction method of the liver-warming decoction fingerprint, the main medicinal material components in the liver-warming decoction can be detected through high performance liquid chromatography, so that the quality condition of the liver-warming decoction is more comprehensively reflected.

title_en: Underground space digital twin system of coal mine based on numerical simulation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mine safety monitoring, and discloses a coal mine underground space digital twin system based on numerical simulation, which comprises the following modules: the multisource sensor assembly is arranged in roadway surrounding rock and used for collecting stress, displacement, anchor rod axial force and vibration data in real time.
