The underground space digital twin system of the coal mine based on the numerical simulation realizes the dimension crossing from single index trend analysis to full-field stress and displacement continuous evolution process prediction, and provides more comprehensive stability cognition. The model parameters are continuously updated through a dynamic self-calibration mechanism, the traditional method of relying on fixed experience values is replaced, and the long-term fidelity and the prediction accuracy of the model under complex geological conditions are remarkably improved. The system provides a visual risk map based on simulation deduction and a multi-scene simulation function, reduces the dependence on manual experience, and provides visual and scientific basis for support scheme optimization and disaster emergency decision.

title_en: Energy storage support wind power grid-connected current collection line single-phase grounding fault positioning method based on compressed sensing and application thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of relay protection of power systems, in particular to a single-phase grounding fault positioning method for an energy storage support wind power grid-connected current collecting line based on compressed sensing and application thereof. And solving a ranging equation by combining voltage and current data of measuring points at two ends of the fault area and line parameters, reducing the dependence on the number of the voltage measuring points and synchronous sampling of the whole network, and realizing single-phase grounding fault positioning of the energy storage support wind power grid-connected collecting line. The method aims to solve the problem of fault positioning under the condition that the measuring point samples are limited in the energy storage supporting wind power grid-connected current collecting circuit scene.

title_en: Aviation turboshaft engine fault diagnosis system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an aviation turboshaft engine fault diagnosis system, which relates to the technical field of fault diagnosis, and comprises an acquisition module for acquiring horizontal, vertical and axial vibration signals, a processing module for generating real-time feature vectors by introducing dynamic short-time Fourier transform, variation modal decomposition and singular value decomposition of a non-fixed-width Gaussian window, an increment diagnosis module for calculating the matching degree of the real-time feature vectors or predicted feature vectors and known classes through a dynamic expansion network, selecting the known classes or triggering an expansion mechanism according to a self-adaptive resonance theory, constructing joint loss by using a Bayesian learning framework after expansion, modeling a Gaussian process, determining loss and updating network parameters through Bayesian optimization, a prediction module for generating the predicted feature vectors when no fault exists, and a maintenance module for transmitting or storing a maintenance scheme according to requirements, so that the self-adaptive identification of the known classes and the new fault classes can be realized, the pre-judging state can be advanced, the running safety of an engine can be effectively ensured, and the maintenance cost can be reduced.

title_en: Six-dimensional force sensor calibration method based on intelligent algorithm and ensemble learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a six-dimensional force sensor calibration method based on intelligent algorithm and integrated learning, which improves calibration precision and system adaptability by combining data anomaly detection, intelligent algorithm and integrated learning. The calibration method comprises the steps of S1, building a six-dimensional force sensor calibration system, S2, carrying out force and moment loading and unloading experiments on the six-dimensional force sensor on a standard calibration table to obtain multi-channel analog signal data output by the six-dimensional force sensor, S3, repeating the operation of the step S2 for a plurality of times, S4, detecting data anomalies, S5, carrying out preliminary calibration by adopting a multiple linear regression model to obtain a preliminary decoupling matrix of the six-dimensional force sensor, S6, calculating error data after multiple linear regression calibration and taking the error data as input characteristics of subsequent error compensation, S7, carrying out error compensation based on a residual neural network, and S8, judging calibration accuracy and outputting a final model.

title_en: Thermal evaluation method and device for pull-push pipe laying double-spliced cable line
abstract_en: The invention discloses a thermal evaluation method and a device for a pull-push pipe laying double-spliced cable line, which comprise the steps of obtaining a first alternating current resistance of a core wire and a second alternating current resistance of a metal sheath of each cable at the initial temperature of the core wire, obtaining actual conveying capacity data and thermal resistance parameters, obtaining core wire loss and circulation loss of each cable, obtaining the mutual thermal temperature rise of a kth cable to a p-th cable, obtaining the self-heating temperature rise of each cable, obtaining the core wire calculated temperature of each cable according to the mutual thermal temperature rise, the self-heating temperature rise and the environmental boundary temperature of each cable, obtaining the temperature difference between the initial temperature of the core wire of at least one cable and the core wire calculated temperature, determining the core wire calculated temperature of each cable as the core wire steady-state temperature of each cable when the temperature difference is smaller than or equal to the preset difference and each core wire calculated temperature is smaller than the first preset temperature, otherwise, determining the core wire calculated temperature of each cable as the core wire initial temperature of each cable, and executing the steps.

title_en: Absolute grating sensor
abstract_en: The application discloses an absolute grating sensor which comprises a light source module, a grating module, a processing module and a processing module, wherein the light source module is used for generating partial coherent light, the grating module comprises a grating ruler which is arranged on a light emitting path of the light source module so as to enable the partial coherent light to be modulated into a characteristic fringe pattern, a plurality of light transmitting units and light shielding units are alternately arranged on the grating ruler, a gap interval is formed between each light transmitting unit and a light shielding unit adjacent to one side of each light transmitting unit, the partial coherent light at least covers two light transmitting units adjacent to the grating ruler, the receiving module is correspondingly arranged with the light source module and is used for receiving the characteristic fringe pattern and converting the characteristic fringe pattern into an electric signal, the processing module is used for carrying out cross-correlation calculation on the electric signal so as to determine the position offset of a target object, and the grating ruler is movably arranged between the light source module and the receiving module along the length direction of the grating ruler.

title_en: High-resolution precipitation set forecasting method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: A method for forecasting a high-resolution precipitation set includes the steps of obtaining a historical atmospheric analysis data set and a multisource fusion precipitation data set, training a built deterministic neural network learning model to output a target duration accumulated average precipitation, training a probability precipitation model built by a variable self-encoder model and a denoising diffusion probability model, obtaining weather data at a moment to be forecasted, inputting the weather data into the deterministic precipitation model to obtain an accumulated average precipitation forecasting result in the target duration, sampling from Gaussian distribution to obtain noise, denoising in a hidden space by the trained denoising diffusion model, recovering the denoising result by the trained variable self-encoder model, adding the obtained variable self-encoder model to the output of the deterministic model to obtain the target duration accumulated precipitation, and building a set forecast based on a plurality of groups of target duration accumulated precipitation forecasting. The invention can generate high-resolution precipitation distribution, improve the prediction accuracy of extreme precipitation, and evaluate the uncertainty of precipitation.

title_en: Video and text driven millimeter wave radar gesture data generation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a millimeter wave radar gesture data generation method driven by videos and texts, which comprises the steps of firstly constructing a millimeter wave radar gesture data generation model comprising a video feature coding network, a text feature coding network, a radar feature coding network and a radar gesture data fitting decoding network, wherein each feature coding network extracts features of corresponding modes according to prompt data of the corresponding modes, the radar gesture data fitting decoding network generates Lei Dadian cloud data according to the features, acquires a training sample set according to actual needs to train the millimeter wave radar gesture data generation model to obtain a trained millimeter wave radar gesture data generation model, setting prompt data according to actual needs, and inputting the prompt data into the trained millimeter wave radar gesture data generation model to generate millimeter wave radar gesture data. According to the method, a unified frame is constructed for different modes, and the authenticity of generating millimeter wave radar gesture data is improved.

title_en: Mark point layout method, equipment and medium for rotation monitoring
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, equipment and medium for arranging mark points for rotation monitoring, which are used for acquiring a curved surface normal vector and a curved surface center point of a curved surface structure to be monitored, acquiring an optimal position of a binocular camera, acquiring a threshold value of a sight angle of the binocular camera according to eccentricity of elliptical distortion of a circular mark point, acquiring a relation between visibility of points on each position of the curved surface and a rotation angle of the curved surface structure, acquiring a relation between elliptical distortion of the circular mark point and the rotation angle, acquiring an image available frame of each point under the sight of the current rotation angle, and constructing mark point selection logic to obtain the optimal arrangement position of the mark points. The method for positioning the binocular camera and the method for positioning the positions of the mark points are adopted to optimize the layout of the mark points, so that the elliptical distortion of the mark points is reduced, the accuracy of rotation monitoring is improved, the layout of the mark points can be optimized, the measurement blind area is avoided, the number of the mark points is reduced, the time for pasting and removing the mark points in the measurement operation is shortened, and the measurement efficiency is improved.

title_en: Ground source heat pump system energy efficiency monitoring platform based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of energy system monitoring, in particular to a digital twin-based ground source heat pump system energy efficiency monitoring platform, which comprises a buried pipe monitoring module, a heat exchange efficiency analysis module, a buried pipe state analysis module and a health state analysis module. According to the invention, fluid data such as inlet and outlet temperature, flow, pressure and the like, and health state parameters such as vibration frequency, soil moisture content, fluid conductivity and the like are synchronously collected through the buried pipe monitoring module, so that three directions of heat exchange, flow and health of the buried pipe are covered. According to the invention, the heat exchange qualification rate, the flow qualification rate and the health qualification rate are deduced through the buried pipe state analysis module, the influence coefficient is set according to the actual scene, the comprehensive energy efficiency is calculated, the health grade is divided according to the comprehensive energy efficiency, different treatment timeliness is formulated for three grades of normal, early warning and abnormal buried pipes, and corresponding treatment suggestions are generated for the qualification conditions of the heat exchange qualification rate, the flow qualification rate and the health qualification rate.

title_en: Test device for simulating and testing oil gas state of crankcase ventilation system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a test device for simulating and testing the oil gas state of a crankcase ventilation system, which belongs to the technical field of engine tests and comprises simulation units, an oil gas state detection unit, an oil gas generator and a gas collection and treatment unit, wherein the simulation units simulate the actual running condition of an engine, the oil gas generator generates oil gas to flow through the simulation units to be tested, the final oil gas passes through the gas collection and treatment unit for collection and treatment, and the oil gas state detection unit detects the oil gas at the inlet and outlet of each simulation unit. The invention systematically detects the mixed oil-gas state of each key node in the engine system, and the detection data can effectively support the whole system improvement of the crankcase ventilation system.

title_en: Line loss analysis method and device based on intelligent fusion terminal, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application provides a line loss analysis method, a device, equipment and a medium based on an intelligent fusion terminal, which belong to the technical field of line loss analysis, and are applied to the intelligent fusion terminal, wherein the method comprises the steps of responding to receiving first electric energy information sent by each power distribution network monitoring terminal respectively, executing first operation on each first electric energy information to obtain technical line loss of each corresponding power distribution network, and executing second operation on each corresponding first electric energy information based on the technical line loss of each power distribution network to obtain management line loss of each corresponding power distribution network, wherein one power distribution network corresponds to one power distribution network monitoring terminal; and determining a line loss analysis result based on the management line loss of each power distribution network and the statistical data of the distributed power sources in each power distribution network. According to the line loss analysis method, device, equipment and medium based on the intelligent fusion terminal, which are provided by the application, the accuracy of line loss analysis can be improved.

title_en: Navigation anti-interference device, navigation system and navigation anti-interference method
abstract_en: The application provides a navigation anti-interference device, a navigation system and a navigation anti-interference method. The navigation anti-interference device comprises a navigation antenna, an anti-interference processing part and a navigation receiver, wherein the navigation antenna is used for receiving navigation signals transmitted by a navigation signal transmitting device, the navigation antenna is in communication connection with the anti-interference processing part, the navigation antenna is used for transmitting received signals to the anti-interference processing part, the anti-interference processing part is used for analyzing and processing the received signals received from the navigation antenna, the received signals comprise navigation signals, the anti-interference processing part is in communication connection with the navigation receiver, the anti-interference processing part is used for transmitting navigation signals in the received signals to the navigation receiver, and the navigation receiver is used for analyzing the navigation signals received from the anti-interference processing part to acquire positioning information. The navigation anti-interference device provided by the application has anti-interference capability and can realize stable and reliable navigation positioning.

title_en: Semiconductor process defect screening method
abstract_en: The invention provides a semiconductor process defect screening method, which comprises the steps of collecting thicknesses of all layers of a structural layer comprising an abnormal protrusion structure, the same side edge inclination angle of all abnormal protrusion structures and the radius length of the abnormal protrusion structure in a top layer structural layer, constructing a calculation model, calculating to obtain the radius length of the abnormal protrusion structure corresponding to each m layers of structural layer, and screening out the abnormal protrusion structure exceeding the preset radius length threshold value of the abnormal protrusion structure. The method obtains the size of the abnormal protrusion structure in each structural layer through the thickness of the structural layer, the radius length of the abnormal protrusion structure of the top structural layer and the edge angle of the abnormal protrusion structure, only detects the yield of the abnormal protrusion structure exceeding the preset abnormal protrusion radius length threshold, reduces the number of times of detecting the protrusion structure by the yield, improves the yield detection efficiency and the defect detection accuracy, sets the abnormal protrusion radius length threshold through the imaging rate, improves the defect detection efficiency, and further improves the yield of a small-size manufacturing Cheng Gongyi by applying the detection method to small-size process.

title_en: HPLC fingerprint spectrum of notopterygium root medicinal material and one-measurement-multiple-evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an HPLC fingerprint spectrum and a one-measurement multi-evaluation method of notopterygium root medicinal materials, which aim to solve the problems that the basic chemical characteristics of the notopterygium root medicinal materials are not obvious, the detection depends on a high-cost reference substance, the pharmacodynamic substances cannot be comprehensively represented and the like at present; the multi-component quantitative analysis is realized by using a multi-evaluation technology and using notopterol as an internal standard substance, so that the detection cost is obviously reduced and the efficiency is improved; and carrying out objective weight distribution and quality sequencing by utilizing an entropy weight approximation ideal solution sequencing method, comprehensively evaluating the advantages and disadvantages of different producing areas and batches of samples, comprehensively improving the controllability and the accuracy of the quality of medicinal materials, effectively distinguishing primitive differences, and providing a reliable scientific framework for standardization and sustainable utilization of the Chinese medicinal resources.

title_en: Target intelligent detection positioning method based on multispectral laser radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of laser radar detection, in particular to an intelligent target detection and positioning method based on a multispectral laser radar. The method comprises the following steps of controlling a multispectral laser radar platform carrying four transmitting and receiving channels with different center wavelengths, collecting laser echo original samples of a target area, generating a multispectral laser echo point cloud data set and a waveform energy sequence corresponding to each echo, and solving the problems of missed detection, false detection and positioning deviation caused by dependence on single echo intensity or geometric information in a complex scene of the traditional laser radar target detection method by fusing point cloud and waveform data of the multispectral laser radar, constructing spectrum shape anomaly detection characteristics and introducing a weighted contribution mechanism and positioning confidence assessment, thereby improving the identification capability of a specific target in a spectrum dimension and the accuracy and reliability of three-dimensional space positioning.

title_en: Environment-friendly water quality index monitoring device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water sampling devices, in particular to an environment-friendly water quality index monitoring device. The technical scheme includes that the water taking bucket comprises a plurality of elastic rods capable of elastically deforming, an opening and closing valve is arranged at the top of the water taking bucket, the opening and closing valve comprises a flow hole and a valve core for plugging the flow hole, a tension conversion component is arranged above the water taking bucket and comprises a mounting plate, a support column which is arranged on the mounting plate in a sliding manner, a plug connector which is arranged on the mounting plate and is plugged with the support column, the support column is fixedly connected with the hanging rod through a traction rope, a sliding rod with limited sliding distance is arranged on the mounting plate in a sliding manner, and the sliding rod is fixedly connected with the valve core through a connecting rope. According to the invention, the plug board and the support column of the tension conversion component are in plug-in design, so that the device is subjected to load bearing by the traction rope in the lowering stage, and is switched to the slide bar to lift the valve core to close the valve after triggering, thus realizing the synchronous completion of multi-layer water sample collection by single lowering, and preventing the mutual interference of water body shapes with different depths.

title_en: Circuit board production line testing device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of circuit board testing and discloses a circuit board production line testing device which comprises an installation table, a probe tester and a clamping table, wherein the probe tester is movably connected with the installation table, the clamping table comprises a first rocker, a first clamping block, a second rocker and a second clamping block, one end of the first rocker is connected with one end of the first clamping block through a bearing, one end of the second rocker is connected with one end of the second clamping block through a bearing, the first clamping block and the second clamping block are respectively used for clamping two opposite side edges on a circuit board, the other end of the first rocker and the other end of the second rocker are active driving ends connected with a rotary driving mechanism, the first rocker and the second rocker are in central symmetry, and the plane where the active driving ends of the first rocker and the second rocker are located is perpendicular to the circuit board.

title_en: Intelligent diagnosis method, system and storage medium for circuit board faults
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of circuit board detection and discloses an intelligent circuit board fault diagnosis method, system and storage medium. The method comprises the steps of collecting reflected waveforms injected by a test signal, obtaining a reflected signal sequence of an impedance mutation position and signal energy loss through time domain reflection analysis, determining a potential breakpoint region based on impedance model matching, carrying out noise filtering and background noise separation to obtain a purified reflected signal sequence, analyzing the purified reflected signal sequence to obtain breakpoint primary coordinates, combining multipath reflection isolation correction coordinates to generate a correction coordinate set, screening and sorting candidate positions in the set according to feature extraction precision, determining a precise value of a preferential breakpoint position, and combining the purified reflected signal sequence verification and comparison to determine the physical position of the breakpoint. The application overcomes multipath reflection and noise interference in complex circuit environment by multilayer signal processing and data fusion, obviously improves the precision and reliability of breakpoint positioning, reduces the misjudgment rate and improves the fault diagnosis efficiency.

title_en: Method for measuring lubricating oil flow of aeroengine
abstract_en: The application belongs to the field of metering measurement, and particularly relates to a method for measuring lubricating oil flow of an aeroengine, wherein a turbine flowmeter is arranged on an external pipeline of the aeroengine under test, and pressure loss, volume and weight indexes of the flowmeter meet performance requirements and safety requirements of a system; and (3) calibrating the flowmeter for a plurality of times by adopting a medium with the same viscosity, obtaining a Reynolds number-instrument coefficient fitting formula of the flowmeter by using a correlation calculation method, evaluating the relative error of the fitting formula, and calculating the measured flow value by using the fitting formula of the calibration result.

title_en: Infrared detector correction method and device, detection method and infrared detector
abstract_en: The application provides an infrared detector correction method, an infrared detector correction device, a detection method and an infrared detector, which comprise the steps of collecting electric signals output by the infrared detector when reference radiation sources are respectively at two preset reference temperatures; the method comprises the steps of establishing an initial linear mapping model between an electric signal and temperature based on the electric signal and corresponding preset reference temperatures, collecting the electric signal output by an infrared detector when a reference radiation source is sequentially at a plurality of test temperatures, mapping the electric signal into detection temperatures by using the initial linear mapping model, determining errors of the initial linear mapping model according to deviation between each test temperature and the corresponding detection temperature, and correcting model parameters based on the errors to obtain a final linear mapping model. The application obviously improves the correction precision on the premise of not increasing the real-time calculation complexity, not additionally occupying the calculation resources of the detector and not affecting the operation efficiency.

title_en: Main lobe interference suppression method for planar array FDA-MIMO radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a planar array FDA-MIMO radar main lobe interference suppression method, which is characterized in that the DL loading factor is dynamically adjusted by estimating target signal power through a Capon technology, a self-adaptive subspace dimension selection strategy is introduced based on characteristic value distribution of a sample covariance matrix so as to balance robustness and main lobe suppression performance under different mismatch conditions, and a beam former can adjust projection subspace and diagonal loading coefficients according to actual condition changes, so that the problem of mismatching of guide vectors caused by distance-angle errors, array element position errors, frequency offset and coherent local scattering can be solved, main lobe interference is effectively suppressed while beam robustness is improved, better SINR performance is obtained, and the planar array FDA-MIMO radar main lobe interference suppression method has wide application value and popularization prospect.

title_en: Navigation system and method for robotic device
abstract_en: A method and system for navigating a robotic device includes planning a collision-free navigation path of the robotic device from an initial location to a predetermined destination location according to environmental map information, and determining a pre-planned trajectory associated with the navigation path, determining a most similar point cloud from pre-planned trajectory points in response to a current point cloud acquired via a sensor of the robotic device in real time, and then taking a next frame point cloud of the most similar point cloud as a desired point cloud, and guiding the robotic device to travel along the navigation path based on the current point cloud and the desired point cloud. The scheme can effectively cope with environmental uncertainty and accidents in a narrow space.

title_en: Detection tracking method and system for bimodal low-speed unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention provides a detection tracking method and a detection tracking system of a bimodal low-speed unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein the method comprises the steps of synchronously acquiring infrared images and visible light images of the same airspace and acquiring the current illumination intensity; the method comprises the steps of inputting an infrared image, a visible light image and illumination intensity into a preset bimodal fusion recognition model to capture images and coordinates of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and tracking the unmanned aerial vehicle according to the images and coordinates of the unmanned aerial vehicle based on an improved BoTSORT tracking algorithm. The unmanned aerial vehicle based on the visible light image and the infrared image is accurately and quickly fused and identified by utilizing the dual-mode fusion model, a closed loop flow of detection and tracking is realized, fusion weights can be adaptively adjusted according to illumination intensity, accurate identification of the unmanned aerial vehicle under various scenes is realized, meanwhile, the detection speed can be effectively improved through the lightweight model design, deployment on edge equipment is allowed, and the use scene of unmanned aerial vehicle detection and tracking is expanded.

title_en: Reliability test equipment for semiconductor device and probe adjusting method thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a reliability test device of a semiconductor device and a probe adjusting method thereof, wherein the device comprises a plurality of probe groups, a plurality of test probes and a plurality of test probes, wherein the probe groups comprise test probes and accompanying probes which are arranged at intervals and in parallel, the test probes are used for contacting corresponding test pads, the accompanying probes are arranged at intervals and are electrically connected with the test probes, the semiconductor device to be tested is provided with accompanying pads, the accompanying probes are electrically connected with each other through the accompanying pads, a plurality of groups of judging circuits are respectively connected with one group of judging circuits, each group of the accompanying probes is electrically connected with one group of judging circuits, each judging circuit comprises a power supply and a contact state indicator and the accompanying probes, and when the contact depth of the accompanying probes relative to the accompanying pads contacted with the corresponding probes reaches a preset depth, the contact state indicator is started, so that the contact depth of the test pads is indicated by the contact state indicator to reach the preset depth, and the contact depth of the accompanying probes is equal to the contact depth of the test probes. The application can ensure the consistency of the contact quality of the probe and the bonding pad in each test.

title_en: High-precision zero magnetic flux compensation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-precision zero magnetic flux compensation method, which comprises the steps of obtaining a tested current signal, generating a magnetic field detection interface structure after noise reduction, frequency band extraction and magneto-dependent configuration processing, carrying out magnetic field analysis, feature matching and resource optimization on the basis of the data to generate high-efficiency compensation parameters, generating final compensation output through interference identification, compensation recombination and power adaptation, further generating a calibration trigger mark through standard value comparison, stability evaluation and threshold judgment, and finally forming a closed loop calibration instruction set through type identification, intensity calculation and time sequence arrangement to finish parameter updating and verification. The invention obviously improves the precision and stability of current measurement, effectively inhibits complex environment interference, and has the characteristics of strong self-adaptability and low power consumption.

title_en: High-robustness multi-target track tracking method based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of wireless perception, and discloses a high-robustness multi-target track tracking method based on millimeter wave radar, which comprises the following steps of firstly acquiring and preprocessing millimeter wave radar signals to obtain a distance-angle diagram of a target with a static background removed; and finally, combining a self-adaptive Kalman correction mechanism based on sharp steering detection with a static person identification and track keeping mechanism based on breathing micro-motion characteristics to realize stable tracking of the person track in a complex indoor scene. Compared with the traditional tracking mode, the high-robustness multi-target track tracking method can still maintain stable track under the scene that the target is suddenly turned or kept still, and has higher robustness.

title_en: Satellite product inspection method and system based on atmospheric precipitation space-time variability
abstract_en: The embodiment of the specification discloses a satellite product inspection method and system based on atmospheric precipitation (TPW) time-space variability, wherein the satellite product inspection method comprises the steps of obtaining TPW observation data of an area to be observed, determining a time-space variability matrix of each station in the area to be observed based on the TPW observation data of the area to be observed, determining a month-to-month time-space variability characteristic of the area to be observed based on the time-to-time variability matrix of each station in the area to be observed, determining a space matching window and a time matching window based on the month-to-month time-space variability characteristic of the area to be observed, and generating a matching data set based on the space matching window and the time matching window, wherein the matching data set is used for satellite TPW product inspection.

title_en: Apparatus and method for analyzing crystal structure
abstract_en: A crystal structure analysis apparatus and method are provided. The crystal structure analysis apparatus includes an Electron Back Scattering Diffraction (EBSD) data acquisition module for acquiring EBSD data of a solid material, an image generation module for generating a shape of the solid material as a first image including a plurality of pixels, a clustering module for performing clustering on the plurality of pixels by using the EBSD data such that the first image includes a plurality of clusters, each cluster representing a first index of a crystal in a first color, an image processing module for processing the first image to generate a second image such that the second index associated with the first index is displayed as an overlay pattern on the plurality of clusters, and a rendering module for rendering the second image to a display area.

title_en: Online early warning method for partial discharge harmonic waves of cable branch box
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cable branch box partial discharge harmonic wave online early warning method, in particular relates to the technical field of electric measurement and power equipment state monitoring, and aims to solve the engineering problems that under the conditions of no power failure and harmonic wave working condition change, a unified time base is difficult to obtain in multipoint monitoring, harmonic wave distortion is easy to misjudge as discharge, and stable positioning is difficult to achieve in topology constraint. The harmonic scene fingerprint is constructed under the unified time base, version locking is carried out, recalibration is carried out on the power frequency phase according to the fingerprint, gating compensation is set in a non-whole frequency band domain, joint matching is carried out by combining arrival time difference with energy attenuation under the constraint of a topological equivalent transmission matrix, and double-threshold interlocking triggering early warning is carried out by combining separability with topological consistency, so that the purposes of stably displaying local discharge pulse under the change of harmonic working conditions, inhibiting false alarm and caliber drift caused by harmonic waves, realizing rechecking positioning and executable grading early warning of branch and joint levels and improving the stability, comparability and feasibility of field judgment are achieved.

title_en: Method for extracting characteristics of radiation electromagnetic wave of circuit breaker
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for extracting radiation electromagnetic wave characteristics of a circuit breaker, which belongs to the technical field of electromagnetic wave processing and comprises the following steps of S1, simulating an arc process of the circuit breaker, preprocessing a temperature distribution cloud picture of an arc area at continuous moments to obtain a standard temperature distribution cloud picture at the continuous moments, S2, generating a temperature weighted change intensity sequence according to the standard temperature distribution cloud picture at the continuous moments, constructing a temperature change derivative curve, and S3, generating an electromagnetic radiation signal picture according to the temperature change derivative curve. According to the invention, the temperature distribution is obtained through simulation calculation, so that the influence of electromagnetic wave signals generated by auxiliary contact action and auxiliary contact gap discharge on a measurement result is avoided, and the problems of high cost, limited experimental conditions and the like in the traditional test method are successfully overcome.

title_en: Analysis method of intelligent lithium battery pack thermal management system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an analysis method of an intelligent lithium battery pack thermal management system, which belongs to the technical field of lithium battery thermal management and comprises the steps of obtaining working condition data of a lithium battery pack, power consumption of a thermal management system and environmental temperature of a lithium battery pack working environment, generating real-time heating power of the lithium battery pack according to the working condition data of the lithium battery pack, generating heat power dissipated by the lithium battery pack to the environment according to the environmental temperature of the lithium battery pack working environment, generating theoretical optimal energy consumption according to the real-time heating power of the lithium battery pack and the heat power dissipated by the lithium battery pack to the environment, generating energy efficiency health degree score of the lithium battery pack thermal management system according to the theoretical optimal energy consumption and the power consumption of the thermal management system, and intelligently analyzing the lithium battery pack thermal management system.

title_en: Broadband sound source positioning method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a broadband sound source positioning method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, which relate to the technical field of neural networks and comprise the steps of obtaining sound field signals of a free space field, calculating a covariance matrix based on the sound field signals, carrying out fusion splicing on the covariance matrix to generate a covariance tensor, inputting the covariance tensor into a self-adaptive convolution attention neural network model, obtaining subspace feature vectors of the covariance tensor, calculating a spatial spectrum value based on the subspace feature vectors and a preset scanning vector, and determining the sound source position of the free space field through the spatial spectrum value. And the self-adaptive convolution attention neural network model is used for carrying out sound source localization prediction, so that the flexibility and accuracy of sound source localization are improved.

title_en: Informer-based monopulse secondary radar angle measurement method
abstract_en: The application discloses a Informer-based monopulse secondary radar angle measurement method which comprises the steps of decoding video data acquired by a secondary radar, constructing an original decoding matrix according to decoded data, respectively obtaining three target azimuth angles by the original decoding matrix through a weighted average algorithm, a low-pass filtered weighted average algorithm and a Kalman filtered weighted average algorithm, fusing the three target azimuth angles to obtain target angle vectors, fusing the original decoding matrix and the target angle vectors to obtain a first splicing matrix, when a secondary radar detection target and an ADS-B target are determined to be the same target, correlating the secondary radar data of the target with the ADS-B data to form a first sample matrix and a second sample matrix, splicing the first sample matrix and the second sample matrix to obtain a coding matrix serving as input of a Informer model, outputting a predicted angle sequence, and performing performance evaluation on the Informer model through an evaluation index. The application realizes the accurate prediction of the target angle.

title_en: Dual-frequency comb imaging spectrum ellipsometer
abstract_en: A measurement system may direct an illumination beam including at least one of a first frequency comb or a second frequency comb to a sample, and generate a sequence of images of the sample based on the first frequency comb and the second frequency comb. The system may include one or more coding optical elements to encode data associated with one or more transfer matrix elements into the sequence of images of the sample. The system may further generate a transfer matrix dataset comprising measurements of at least one of the one or more transfer matrix elements associated with the sample based on at least one of a spectral, spatial, or temporal analysis of the sequence of images, and generate one or more measurements of the sample based on the transfer matrix dataset.

title_en: Intelligent library navigation system
abstract_en: The invention provides a smart library navigation system, which belongs to the technical field of indoor navigation and comprises a map building module, a positioning module, a dynamic updating module, a navigation module and a communication transmission module. The map construction module is used for constructing a semi-dense point cloud map based on an ORB-SLAM2 algorithm and marking space elements, the positioning module is used for constructing a mapping chart through Bluetooth signal intensity and determining positions by combining a triangular positioning algorithm, the dynamic updating module is used for monitoring resource states in real time and triggering map updating, the navigation module is used for realizing anti-interference path planning through a Kalman filtering and factor graph algorithm by adopting a double-engine architecture, and the communication transmission module is used for guaranteeing stable data transmission through a Mesh network and priority transmission. The modules cooperatively realize real-time sensing, accurate positioning and intelligent navigation of the library environment, solve the problems of difficult book searching, tension of seats, inconvenient space navigation and the like, and improve the service efficiency and the user experience of the library.

title_en: Novel high-voltage magnetic detection device and detection method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel high-voltage magnetic detection device and a detection method thereof, wherein the novel high-voltage magnetic detection device comprises a diamond anvil cell consisting of diamond anvil cells with upper and lower anvil surfaces opposite to each other, a reserved sample cavity, a magnetic sample and ruby pressure calibration unit arranged in the sample cavity, and a blind hole arranged in the lower anvil cell; and (3) arranging the NV color center at the bottom of the blind hole, and collecting NV color center fluorescent signals before and after the microwave field is applied under the continuous excitation of laser, so as to obtain the spin state and magnetic field data of the NV color center. According to the invention, the NV color center is arranged at the bottom of the diamond anvil with the blind hole, so that the direct influence of stress on the NV color center in a high-pressure environment is effectively avoided, and the key technical problems of fluorescence intensity reduction and peak position movement of the NV color center under high pressure are solved. Not only ensures stable fluorescence emission of the NV color center under high-pressure conditions, but also obviously improves the accuracy of spin state reading and the high precision of magnetic field measurement, and provides a novel, efficient and reliable solution for the field of high-pressure magnetic detection.

title_en: Electronic paste fineness detection device and application method thereof
abstract_en: An electronic paste fineness detection device and a use method thereof belong to the technical field of electronic material detection. The detection device comprises a detection device frame, a precise pressure regulating valve, a table plate front movement mechanism, a touch screen, a button operation box, a table plate mounting plate, a detection device air circuit system, a detection device electric control system and a table plate back movement mechanism. The detection device rack is a three-layer frame type support, the top layer is a desktop mounting plate, a precise pressure regulating valve is mounted on the left side of the front face of the desktop mounting plate, a desk plate front face movement mechanism is mounted in the middle area, a touch screen and a button operation box are mounted at the right end of the rear side, the desk plate back face movement mechanism is mounted on the back face, the detection device electric control system is mounted in the middle layer, and the detection device air circuit system is mounted in the bottom layer. The method solves the problems that the existing electronic paste fineness detection can only be performed manually, uncertainty errors exist in detection results, the detection results are different from person to person, and consistency cannot be guaranteed. The method is widely applied to fineness detection technology of various slurries.

title_en: Wind speed measuring instrument and terminal applied to camera
abstract_en: The application discloses a wind speed measuring instrument and a terminal applied to a camera, wherein the wind speed measuring instrument comprises a shell, the shell is detachably connected with a probe support, an angle-adjustable mounting seat is mounted on the probe support, the mounting seat is used for fixing a core measuring module, the core measuring module is used for measuring wind speed data and wind direction data of a ventilation system, a processing module, a communication module and an abnormality alarming module are arranged in the shell, the processing module determines whether the wind speed data and the wind direction data are abnormal or not based on analysis results, an alarm is given out when the processing module is abnormal, the communication module is in wireless communication with the terminal, the wind speed data and the wind direction data are sent to the terminal, the communication module receives control signals sent by the terminal, and the processing module controls a driver to drive the mounting seat to rotate so that the core measuring module measures the wind speed data and the wind direction data in all directions. The application can eliminate the measurement blind area caused by the fixation of the probe of the traditional equipment and improve the test coverage. The shell has high protection performance, long service life of equipment and low cost.

title_en: Conductive slip ring loop conduction identification device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a conductive slip ring loop conduction identification device, which relates to the technical field of electrical detection and comprises a main control unit, a multi-path switching module, a conduction detection module, a man-machine interaction module, a power module and an identification driving module. The multi-path switching module sequentially gates the multi-path loop access device of the slip ring to be tested under the control of the main control unit; the invention realizes automation and intellectualization of conducting slip ring loop conduction test, solves the problems of low manual test efficiency and easy error, can realize digital management and quality tracing of test data, and is suitable for production, inspection and maintenance links of the conducting slip ring.

title_en: Micro-environment intelligent regulation and control and structural health monitoring system for historic building protection
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of historical building protection, in particular to a microenvironment intelligent regulation and control and structural health monitoring system for historical building protection, which comprises a deployment module, a collection and screening module, an instruction generation module and a regulation and control module, wherein the deployment module is used for acquiring and screening a target object; through the targeted deployment of the sensor and verification of the effectiveness, the physical and chemical properties of the screening materials and the environmental data are synchronously acquired, the environmental-material-structure causal relationship is constructed through three-layer logic judgment, the secondary damage is avoided by combining a simulation technology, and the regulation and control parameters are dynamically optimized. The invention realizes the deep fusion analysis of the three components, accurately identifies the damage mechanism, achieves the preventive protection of the historical building, remarkably improves the intelligentized and accurate level of the protection, and provides reliable technical support for the conservation of cultural heritage.

title_en: Thermal measurement device for determining fluid properties by changing surrounding reference properties
abstract_en: The invention relates to a measurement method for determining at least one property of a fluid to be measured by means of a thermal sensor. The thermal sensor includes a heating element that is driven oscillatingly at least one frequency. At least one characteristic of the fluid under test is determined by measuring a frequency dependent temperature response of the thermal sensor. The fluid to be measured is guided on the upper side above the heating element, whereas on the lower side below the heating element a reference substance is present. The reference substance is distinguished from the fluid under test in at least one thermal property, thereby affecting the frequency dependent temperature response of the thermal sensor. The invention further relates to a thermal sensor for use in the method according to the invention.

title_en: Shale atmospheric pressure splits microseism real-time intelligent monitoring and early warning system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a shale gas fracturing microseism real-time intelligent monitoring and early warning system, which relates to the technical field of crack effectiveness monitoring and risk early warning in shale gas exploitation fracturing engineering, and comprises a sensor array and a signal processing unit for capturing stratum signals, a five-element coupling sensor array, a tracer injection and synchronous acquisition subsystem, a five-element characteristic decoupling unit, a crack effectiveness comprehensive judging module and a real-time feedback regulation and control module; according to the invention, the problems that the gas-bearing layer and the gas-bearing layer are difficult to distinguish in traditional microseismic monitoring, the weak signals are easy to interfere, the effectiveness of cracks is fuzzy in judgment, and the existence of monitoring blind areas leads to ineffective fracturing are solved by utilizing the five-element coupling sensor array to synchronously acquire multidimensional signals, tracer specific reaction linkage, five-element characteristic decoupling algorithm and quantitative judgment and real-time feedback regulation and control mechanism, and the effective crack precise identification, the monitoring coverage range expansion, the interference misjudgment rate reduction and the dynamic optimization of fracturing strategies are realized.

title_en: Mixed ambiguity fixed real-time orbit determination method and device based on inter-satellite ranging
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mixed ambiguity fixed real-time orbit determination method and device based on inter-satellite ranging, and belongs to the technical field of satellite navigation and precise orbit determination. According to the method, a combined filtering model is constructed by fusing satellite-borne GNSS observation data and inter-satellite distance measurement data, state estimation is carried out by using extended Kalman filtering, inter-satellite distance measurement constraint is introduced to enhance ambiguity covariance, a covariance structure is adjusted by a dynamic weighting factor, and the whole-cycle ambiguity fixing success rate is improved. And (3) realizing quick fixation of the ambiguity by adopting an LAMBDA algorithm, and re-estimating the track state. The invention effectively solves the problems of slow fixation of the ambiguity and poor stability of the traditional PPP-AR method in a low-orbit high-dynamic environment, realizes faster convergence, higher precision and stronger robustness of real-time orbit determination, and is suitable for low-orbit constellation formation control, remote sensing, navigation enhancement and other applications.

title_en: Environmental noise adaptive multi-frequency spectrum stress wave-voiceprint damage detection method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an environment noise adaptive multi-frequency spectrum stress wave-voiceprint damage detection method and system, and relates to the technical field of nondestructive detection. The method comprises the steps of constructing passive-active mixed excitation, combining an active signal with environmental noise as a passive source, forming enhanced excitation through self-adaptive weight adjustment, synchronously acquiring 20-150kHz signals by multiple frequency bands, filtering interference, constructing a three-dimensional voiceprint map containing references and calibration, and realizing defect identification and quantification through acoustic impedance tensor inversion, a difference algorithm and a Bayesian framework. The system comprises an acquisition module, a voiceprint construction module, an intelligent analysis module, a monitoring and early warning module and a cooperative complete flow detection module. The invention solves the problems of single excitation limitation, environmental interference and complex structure detection, improves the detection sensitivity, accuracy and environmental adaptability, is suitable for detecting the damage of metal and composite material components, and has important engineering value.

title_en: Water softener-based serial water detection method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of intelligent household appliances, in particular to a water softener-based water-flowing detection method, device, equipment and medium, which aim to solve the technical problem that when a water flowing fault occurs in a valve head, the water softener-based water flowing fault is difficult to detect because the water flowing fault is difficult to detect by a user. The water softener-based water-crossing detection method comprises the steps of obtaining water hardness and water consumption information, obtaining residual salt amount if the water hardness is determined to be larger than preset hardness, and determining that water crossing faults occur according to the water consumption information if the residual salt amount is determined to be larger than the preset salt amount.

title_en: Mother substrate for sensor
abstract_en: A mother substrate for a sensor is disclosed, the mother substrate including a base substrate and a sensor substrate over the base substrate, and the sensor substrate including a main body portion including a sensing region, a non-sensing region surrounding the sensing region in a plan view, a sensing electrode in the sensing region, and a trace in the non-sensing region and electrically connected to the sensing electrode, and a peripheral portion surrounding the main body portion in a plan view and including an inspection line spaced apart from the trace and having the same shape as the trace.

title_en: Sub-terahertz electric large-size compact range device based on Huygens super surface and testing method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Huygens super-surface-based sub-terahertz electric large-size compact range device and a test method, which belong to the technical field of novel artificial electromagnetic materials and comprise a corrugated horn feed source antenna, a Huygens super-surface array, a clamp and a scanning frame, wherein the Huygens super-surface array comprises a plurality of Huygens super-surface basic unit structures, each Huygens super-surface basic unit structure comprises a top grid metal layer, a dielectric layer, a middle pattern metal layer, a dielectric layer and a bottom metal grid layer, each top grid metal layer comprises a periodic interval grid in the horizontal direction, each middle pattern metal layer comprises a split resonant ring pointing to the diagonal direction, each bottom grid metal layer comprises a periodic interval grid in the vertical direction, and the Huygens super-surface-basic unit structure is suitable for testing the performance of the electric large-size antenna in the sub-terahertz frequency band. The invention selects an economic printed circuit board process, integrates the super surface and the glass substrate to improve the integral rigidity, and has stable structure and novel design.

title_en: Cavity Shan Kongfeng coupling field distribution equivalent excitation test method, device and system
abstract_en: The application provides a cavity Shan Kongfeng coupling field distribution equivalent excitation test method, device and system, and relates to the field of electromagnetic environment monitoring. The method comprises the steps of gradually adjusting input power of the radiation antenna to first power, obtaining target response of a monitoring probe in a tested cavity under far field irradiation test, wherein the tested cavity is a metal cavity, shortening distance between the radiation antenna and a hole seam on the tested cavity, gradually adjusting the input power of the radiation antenna to second power after shortening the distance, obtaining first response of the monitoring probe in the tested cavity under equivalent irradiation test, and completing equivalent excitation test process of the tested cavity when the first response is equal to the target response. The application can improve the test efficiency, scientificity and accuracy.

title_en: Test device and method for simulating influence of loess collapsibility on pile-tunnel structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of geotechnical engineering, in particular to a test device and a test method for simulating the influence of loess collapsibility on a pile-tunnel structure. The device comprises a model box, a tunnel model and a pile foundation model which are buried in soil in the box, a water immersion system and a data acquisition system. The water immersion system is integrated with a top precipitation simulation layer, a bottom water level control layer and an underground pipeline rupture simulation layer, and can accurately simulate various water immersion conditions such as surface precipitation, underground water level change, pipeline rupture and the like. The bottom water level control layer can realize local or whole soaking through the water through holes which can be independently controlled, and the underground pipeline fracture simulation layer can dynamically adjust the fracture opening according to the water pressure. The data acquisition system monitors the tunnel lining stress, pile foundation bearing characteristics and soil deformation in real time. The invention realizes the fine simulation of the mechanical response of the pile-tunnel structure system under the coupling action of various water environments, and provides an important test means for the prevention and control of underground engineering disasters in loess areas.

title_en: Motor current sampling method and system
abstract_en: The application relates to a motor current sampling method and a motor current sampling system. The method comprises the steps of monitoring a current value of motor operation in real time, adjusting a sampling frequency of motor current to obtain an adjusted sampling frequency when the current value of motor operation is lower than a preset current threshold value, wherein the preset current threshold value is a minimum value of motor current for keeping elevator comfort, measuring sampling delay of the motor current in the process of sampling the motor current by utilizing the adjusted sampling frequency, and performing compensation sampling on the motor current based on the sampling delay to obtain a sampling value of the motor current after compensation sampling. The method can solve the problems that the existing motor current sampling mode cannot achieve high precision, high accuracy and low delay.

title_en: Method, device, system, equipment and medium for determining remaining available time
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a device, a system, equipment and a medium for determining remaining available time, wherein the method comprises the steps of responding to a power failure instruction of a large power grid, acquiring current state information of energy storage equipment, predicted power generation information of power generation equipment in a set period of time and predicted load information of electric equipment; and determining the residual available time of the energy storage equipment according to the current state information, the predicted power generation information and the predicted load information. The residual available time of the energy storage device is comprehensively determined by considering the influence of load change and power generation change on the residual available time and combining the current state information of the energy storage device. The accuracy of the remaining available time is improved, and further support is provided for early warning of a user in time during subsequent power failure.

title_en: Building engineering foundation ditch deformation monitoring devices
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of foundation pit monitoring. Aim at provides a building engineering foundation ditch deformation monitoring devices, monitors and predicts the deformation condition of easy deformation collapse area on the foundation ditch lateral wall. Adopt following technical scheme, including butt joint installation mechanism, baffle coupling mechanism, laser monitoring structure and monitoring mechanism, a plurality of butt joint installation mechanism inserts perpendicularly in the foundation ditch lateral wall and transversely horizontally arranged, the butt joint installation mechanism that is located both sides outside sets up in the safe region department of easy deformation collapse region both sides, be connected with baffle coupling mechanism on it, other butt joint installation mechanism set up in easy deformation collapse region department, be connected with laser monitoring structure on it, monitoring mechanism spanes all baffle coupling mechanism and laser monitoring structure, and monitoring mechanism's both ends are connected on corresponding baffle coupling mechanism, laser monitoring structure is just to monitoring mechanism. And the laser monitoring structure is used for measuring at regular intervals, a plurality of groups of measurement results are compared, and the deformation condition of the foundation pit is monitored and predicted.

title_en: Ice wind tunnel cloud and fog particle measuring device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ice wind tunnel cloud and fog particle measuring device which is suitable for testing an incoming cloud and fog field in a wind tunnel test section, wherein a first hole and a second hole are formed in corresponding positions on two sides of the length direction of the wind tunnel test section, the ice wind tunnel cloud and fog particle measuring device comprises a first shell, a second shell and a controller, wherein the first shell is arranged in a central area of the first shell, the second shell is arranged in a central area of the second shell, the first cylinder and the second cylinder are both arranged in a hollow structure with two open ends, laser beams irradiate the incoming cloud and fog field and then scatter, water drops on the irradiated parts in the cloud and fog field shield laser to form projection, a projection image is shot by the camera and fed back to the controller, and the controller is used for completing detection, so that the detection or testing efficiency is improved.

title_en: Asynchronous motor excitation inductance calibration method, and asynchronous motor excitation inductance online identification system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an excitation inductance calibration system and method of an asynchronous motor, wherein the excitation inductance calibration system comprises the steps of measuring a leakage inductance value of a motor rotor according to operation data of the motor in a locked-rotor operation state of the motor, determining motor stator inductance values under different direct-axis currents according to direct-axis currents and quadrature-axis voltages when the motor is operated at a fixed rotating speed of the motor, calculating motor excitation inductance values under different direct-axis currents according to the motor stator inductance values under different direct-axis currents and the leakage inductance value of the motor rotor, and manufacturing a mapping table of the direct-axis currents, the corresponding motor rotor leakage inductance values, the corresponding motor stator inductance values and the corresponding motor excitation inductance values into a direct-axis current and motor mutual inductance parameter, and calculating an equivalent direct-axis current according to the direct-axis currents and the quadrature-axis currents when the motor is operated normally, and inquiring the mapping table of the direct-axis currents and the motor mutual inductance parameters according to the equivalent direct-axis currents so as to obtain the real-time mutual inductance parameters under the current operation condition of the motor.

title_en: Power distribution network single-phase grounding reason diagnosis method based on confidence and ambiguity assessment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network single-phase grounding reason diagnosis method based on confidence and ambiguity assessment. The method comprises the steps of obtaining original diagnosis data corresponding to waveforms to be detected, determining confidence levels corresponding to the original diagnosis data based on similarity distances corresponding to a plurality of neighbor sample waveforms in the original diagnosis data according to preset grading rules, determining a plurality of candidate reasons based on single-phase grounding reasons corresponding to the neighbor sample waveforms, determining occurrence frequencies corresponding to the candidate reasons based on the number of the neighbor sample waveforms, determining target ambiguity based on the occurrence frequencies corresponding to the candidate reasons and a reason tag semantic association matrix, and generating diagnosis results in a self-adapting mode based on the confidence levels and the target ambiguity. The invention solves the technical problem that the operation and inspection personnel lack objective judgment basis for the reliability of the conclusion when making the decision due to the insufficient information completeness of the conclusion output by the current analysis method.

title_en: Flow test device for premixed flow state solidified soil
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of solidification soil fluidity test and discloses a pre-stirring flow state solidification soil fluidity test device which comprises a bottom box, wherein telescopic cylinders are circularly arranged in an inner cavity of the bottom box, sleeved parts are rotatably sleeved on the outer sides of two ends of each telescopic cylinder, one group of sleeved parts are fixedly connected with the bottom of the inner cavity of the bottom box, a cover plate is fixedly arranged at the top of the other group of sleeved parts, a bottom plate is arranged above the cover plate, a slump cone is arranged above the bottom plate, a fixing component for fixing the slump cone is arranged on the outer side of the slump cone, and a single device can automatically lift the standard slump cone through the telescopic cylinders and simulate standardized vibration of a 'jump table', so that the problems that samples and replacement equipment are required to be carried in the prior art are solved, the operation flow is greatly simplified, and the test time is shortened.

title_en: In-situ reaction tank device for combination of X-rays and infrared rays
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of material characterization, in particular to an in-situ reaction tank device for combining X rays and infrared rays, which comprises a tank body and a tank cover, wherein an X ray inlet, an infrared ray inlet and an infrared ray reflection outlet are arranged on the side wall of the tank body, a receiver is fixedly arranged in the tank body, the receiver is positioned in the extending direction of the X rays after penetrating through a sample, an opening and closing sealing mechanism is arranged between the tank body and the tank cover, and the tank body, the tank cover, a traction assembly, a positioning assembly and the opening and closing sealing mechanism are subjected to integrated collaborative design, so that the sample can be rapidly guided out, replaced and automatically recycled in the testing process of the combination of the X rays and the infrared rays, and accurate positioning and reliable sealing can be synchronously completed at the tail end of the recycled, thereby obviously improving the positioning repeatability, the sealing stability and the overall operation efficiency of an in-situ experiment under the condition of not increasing extra operation steps, and effectively relieving the technical problems of complex sample replacement, large positioning error of the recycled positioning and insufficient sealing reliability and the like of the existing in-situ reaction tank.

title_en: Quick-response smell stimulation system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quick response odor stimulation system. The system comprises a pulse signal generating module, a conduction control module, a compressed gas transmission gas circuit, a conduction valve and at least one smell conveying conduit, wherein smell stimulating liquid is arranged in the smell conveying conduit, the conduction control module is arranged in the compressed gas transmission gas circuit and is electrically connected with the pulse signal generating module and used for conducting and communicating the compressed gas transmission gas circuit based on a pulse signal output by the pulse signal generating module, and the conduction valve is communicated with the compressed gas transmission gas circuit and the smell conveying conduit so as to transmit the compressed gas in the compressed gas transmission gas circuit to the smell conveying conduit to push the smell stimulating liquid to a sample to be tested. By adopting the technical scheme, the time error of gas transmission is reduced, the response time of the stimulation system is shortened, the time resolution is improved, and the rapid odor stimulation driven by the pulse signals is realized.

title_en: Laser survey ware code generation and discernment integrated circuit system
abstract_en: The application discloses a code generation and identification integrated circuit system of a laser tester, which relates to the technical field of laser coding and comprises a photodiode module, a differential-to-TTL module, an ARM module, an FPGA module and a TTL-to-differential module, wherein the photodiode module converts a laser pulse signal into an electric pulse signal and takes the electric pulse signal as a main wave signal, the differential-to-TTL module converts the main wave synchronous signal to obtain the main wave synchronous signal, the ARM module converts a TXT file output by an upper computer into coded information in binary representation, the FPGA module carries out code generation and identification based on the coded information and the main wave signal or the main wave synchronous signal to obtain a recognition result and a coded pulse, the ARM module carries out closed-loop verification based on the recognition result, and the TTL-to-differential module converts the coded pulse into an external trigger signal and transmits the external trigger signal to the laser tester. The application can flexibly encode the circuit system, realize high integration and self-adaptation performance and improve environmental robustness.

title_en: Sealed self-adaptive soft package lithium battery packaging image detection method and system
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a system for detecting sealed self-adaptive soft package lithium battery packaging images, which relate to the technical field of image detection and acquire characteristic information through analysis and processing of image information of a soft package lithium battery packaging area to be detected. Based on the characteristic information, judging whether material batch switching occurs, when the material batch switching is detected, collecting an image sample of a current product, extracting local visual characteristics for statistical analysis, and constructing reference information. The method comprises the steps of obtaining current image information of a product to be detected, extracting local visual characteristics of the product to be detected, comparing the current image information with reference information, identifying an abnormal region, quantifying the geometric form, the size and the strength of the abnormal region, carrying out similarity matching and multiple verification by combining a preset defect mode, and judging whether the abnormal region is a real defect, thereby effectively solving the problem that in the prior art, an automatic image detection system frequently misjudges that a qualified product is a defect because the automatic image detection system cannot adapt to the change of material characteristics when facing different batches of raw materials.

title_en: Wind speed calculation method and system based on pulse laser radar echo signals
abstract_en: The application provides a wind speed resolving method and a system based on pulse laser radar echo signals, which relate to the technical field of laser radar wind measurement, and the method comprises the steps of accurately acquiring atmospheric turbulence data of a preset detection path, performing targeted wave front modulation on a coded laser pulse sequence through an adjustable optical element, generating a transmitted laser pulse sequence adapting to detection requirements, and transmitting along the path; the method comprises the steps of receiving echo signals returned from a detection path, converting the echo signals into initial electric signals, inputting the initial electric signals into a preset constructed neural network, removing distortion and noise interference contained in the signals to obtain a purified echo pulse sequence, decoding the sequence, separating a plurality of independent echo pulses respectively corresponding to different distance segments, and finally accurately calculating and obtaining wind speed data of each distance segment according to frequency offset of each independent echo pulse, so that accurate calculation of the laser radar on wind speeds of different distance segments can be realized.

title_en: Downhole health monitoring of survey sensors
abstract_en: The application relates to downhole health monitoring of survey sensors. A method for surveying a wellbore includes rotating a wellbore survey tool in the wellbore. The borehole survey tool includes a plurality of magnetometers, a plurality of accelerometers, and optionally a plurality of temperature sensors. Sensor measurements are made as the survey tool is rotated in the borehole.
