A faulty accelerometer or faulty temperature sensor is automatically detected from the accelerometer measurements or temperature measurements. The corrected sensor measurement is calculated for the faulty sensor from selected ones of the magnetometer measurements, accelerometer measurements, and temperature measurements and used to further calculate at least one of borehole inclination or borehole azimuth.

title_en: Fastener detection method and device based on pose sensing and computer storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of displacement or angle monitoring, in particular to the technical field of detection of bolt and nut components, and discloses a fastener detection method and device based on pose sensing, and a computer storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of performing data acquisition operation on a fastener based on a wheel value acquisition time parameter to obtain a data acquisition result; the fastener comprises a bolt component and/or a nut component, a data reading result of the fastener is determined according to a data acquisition result, coding detection information of the fastener is determined, data conversion parameters corresponding to the fastener are generated based on the coding detection information, data conversion operation is performed on the coding detection information based on the data conversion parameters, the data conversion result is obtained, and a component detection result corresponding to the fastener is determined according to the data conversion result. Therefore, the invention is beneficial to improving the intelligence and efficiency of bolt and nut loosening and fracture detection, and is also beneficial to improving the accuracy, reliability and detection precision of bolt and nut loosening and fracture detection.

title_en: High-precision full-automatic aircraft multi-axis correction system and method based on total station
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of aviation measurement and calibration, in particular to a high-precision full-automatic aircraft multi-axis correction system and method based on a total station. The three-axis attitude angle measuring device comprises a total station measuring unit, a six-degree-of-freedom precise calibration platform, a central control and calculation unit and an intelligent calibration target plate attitude calculation and multiaxial coupling compensation unit, wherein the total station measuring unit is used for establishing a three-dimensional rectangular coordinate system, the six-degree-of-freedom precise calibration platform is arranged right in front of an aircraft and is used for bearing the intelligent calibration target plate and realizing six-direction motion adjustment, the intelligent calibration target plate is used for measuring through the total station measuring unit, the intelligent calibration target plate is opposite to the aircraft, the central control and calculation unit is used for calculating the three-axis attitude angle of the aircraft through space geometric operation according to a plurality of datum point coordinates of the aircraft measured by the total station measuring unit, and the central control and calculation unit is also used for carrying out intelligent calibration target plate attitude calculation and multiaxial coupling compensation. The invention has high precision, adopts the total station as a unique measurement reference, avoids the transformation error of a multi-equipment coordinate system and improves the anti-interference capability.

title_en: Anchor cable force monitoring method and system based on fundamental frequency vibration method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anchor cable force monitoring method based on a fundamental frequency vibration method, which comprises the following steps of sensor deployment and signal acquisition, wherein an acquisition node separates interference components in vibration signals through noise reduction, the interference components are transmitted to a main acquisition module through a wireless communication link after data compression, the main acquisition module is uploaded to a monitoring platform, the wireless communication link is a LoRa wireless communication link, a channel frequency hopping and signal power self-adaptive adjustment mechanism is adopted to improve communication anti-interference capacity, fundamental frequency extraction and cable force calculation are carried out, the monitoring platform extracts vibration signal fundamental frequency through a VMD-HHT fusion method, a cable force model containing boundary correction coefficients is constructed based on string vibration, actual cable force is determined by combining fundamental frequency and anchor cable parameters, multi-stage early warning is triggered by combining cable force values, cable force change rates and abnormal vibration mode conditions, early warning information is pushed to a related system and corresponding linkage measures are carried out, anti-interference capacity and real-time and accuracy of non-stable vibration signal extraction are improved, and powerful guarantee is provided for accurate and reliable measurement of cable force.

title_en: Barometer capable of automatically detecting on-off load NPN/PNP characteristics
abstract_en: The barometer comprises a main control chip, a load NPN/PNP characteristic detection circuit, an NPN control module, a PNP control module and an output protection circuit, wherein an external load of the barometer is connected to the input end of the main control chip through the load NPN/PNP characteristic detection circuit in a signal mode, the NPN control module and the PNP control module are respectively arranged at the output end of the main control chip, the output ends of the NPN control module and the PNP control module are connected to the output protection circuit, and the main control chip is configured to selectively activate the NPN control module or the PNP control module according to detection characteristic parameters so as to realize a corresponding NPN or PNP output mode. The MCU main control chip can intelligently control the corresponding NPN/PNP control module along with the NPN/PNP characteristics of the load according to the parameters detected by the detection module, and output corresponding switching value parameters. The NPN/PNP output can be automatically switched on the barometer without hardware replacement, and corresponding working modes are set according to the requirements of users.

title_en: Test method for judging cavitation erosion of engine cylinder sleeve by utilizing water pressure fluctuation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a cavitation erosion test method for judging an engine cylinder sleeve by utilizing water pressure fluctuation, which relates to the field of engines and comprises the following steps of continuously and alternately circulating cooling water on the outer wall of the engine cylinder sleeve; under the vibration of cylinder sleeve and different water pressure changes, when the transient pressure of cooling water at a certain position of cylinder sleeve is reduced to be lower than the saturated steam pressure of liquid, the bubbles are produced and separated, as the bubbles are increased, under the vibration of cylinder sleeve and the water pressure changes, the bubbles are compressed to a certain extent, then the pressure is increased to cause bursting, the water pressure fluctuation data are collected and analyzed, whether the cylinder sleeve has cavitation phenomenon is judged according to the collected data, and whether a cooling water channel needs to be redesigned is determined. The invention is beneficial to quickly and accurately judging the cavitation condition of the cylinder sleeve, finding potential problems in time and taking preventive measures, prolonging the service life of the cylinder sleeve and reducing the maintenance cost.

title_en: Quality evaluation method, device, equipment, medium and program for assembly data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quality evaluation method, a quality evaluation device, quality evaluation equipment, quality evaluation media and quality evaluation program for assembly data. The method comprises the steps of obtaining measurement data obtained by measuring a preset standard component by measuring equipment and coordinate data obtained by measuring a preset point to be measured in a measurement space, determining an equipment precision evaluation result corresponding to the measuring equipment according to the measurement data, determining a registration error evaluation result corresponding to the measurement space according to the coordinate data, and determining a quality evaluation result based on assembly data generated by the measuring equipment and the measurement space according to the equipment precision evaluation result and the registration error evaluation result. The technical scheme of the invention solves the problem that the evaluation of the assembly data in the prior art depends on manual experience, can avoid poor reliability of the assembly data caused by unreasonable data evaluation, and improves the reliability of the assembly data evaluation.

title_en: Lunar satellite formation relative navigation method based on factor graph optimization
abstract_en: The invention relates to a lunar satellite formation relative navigation method based on factor graph optimization, which comprises the following steps of constructing a factor graph by using a series of relative orbit states of satellite formation as constraint factors of state nodes and connection state nodes in a sliding window with set length; and optimizing the factor graph to obtain the optimal estimation of the relative orbit states of the satellite convoy at the current moment. The relative navigation method of the invention utilizes the historical data to re-optimize and correct the historical track state in the process of optimizing the factor graph, effectively inhibits error accumulation and remarkably improves navigation precision and robustness.

title_en: AGV cooperative self-adaptive pipetting system based on dynamic visual guidance and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an AGV collaborative self-adaptive pipetting system based on dynamic visual guidance, which comprises an AGV transferring module, a dynamic visual detection module, a self-adaptive pipetting module and a control module, wherein the dynamic visual detection module is used for detecting the occupation state of a test tube rack station, container parameters and liquid level information in real time and sending detection results to the control module, the control module is respectively in communication connection with the AGV transferring module, the dynamic visual detection module and the self-adaptive pipetting module and is used for generating control instructions according to the detection results, the AGV transferring module is used for receiving the control instructions and executing picking, placing and transferring of test tubes, and the self-adaptive pipetting module is used for receiving the control instructions, adaptively matching pipetting parameters and consumable materials according to the container parameters and the liquid information and executing pipetting operations. According to the invention, the AGV collaborative operation, parameter self-adaptive matching and cloud optimization and fault self-healing are guided by dynamic vision, so that the pipetting efficiency, the pipetting accuracy and the pipetting system reliability are comprehensively improved.

title_en: Dynamic detection method for mechanical properties of in-service pavement
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic detection method for mechanical properties of an in-service pavement, which belongs to the technical field of pavement mechanical property detection and comprises the steps of determining the interference quantity of vehicle and road vibration on a running device in vehicle-mounted sensor test data based on vehicle-road coupling dynamics, further improving the test precision of road response quantity, designing a loading excitation component of the pavement based on impact dynamics to realize quantitative excitation of the pavement, and calculating the mechanical properties of a layered system of the in-service pavement based on vehicle dynamics and combining a modulus inversion method. The dynamic detection of the mechanical properties of the road surface can be realized by adopting the dynamic detection device, the detection interval can be adjusted according to different requirements, the dynamic stability of the running device under multiple working conditions is analyzed, a stable test platform is provided for dynamic detection of the mechanical properties of the road surface in service, and the detection efficiency and the detection precision are both considered.

title_en: Acetylcholinesterase fluorescent probe based on non-bond breaking mechanism, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an acetylcholinesterase fluorescent probe based on a non-bond breaking mechanism, a preparation method and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of acetylcholinesterase detection, wherein the fluorescent probe is designed based on a naphthalimide structure, the preparation process comprises the steps of intermediate synthesis, final product preparation and column chromatography purification, the used solvents, alkali, acyl chloride and other reagents are easy to obtain, the reaction conditions are mild, and the preparation is simple and convenient. The fluorescent probe realizes non-broken bond recognition of AChE through a PET mechanism, wherein a carbamate fragment in a probe structure quenches fluorophore fluorescence, and when the carbamate fragment acts with AChE, the fragment enters a hydrophobic pocket of enzyme, and the PET process is interrupted to recover fluorescence. Experiments show that the probe is sensitive and rapid in response to AChE, has positive correlation between fluorescence intensity and AChE concentration, has good specificity to AChE, is little interfered by common anions and cations and amino acids, and can be used for detecting acetylcholinesterase in acetylcholinesterase indication.

title_en: Coal body strain synchronous in-situ monitoring device and method based on true triaxial impact
abstract_en: The invention provides a coal body strain synchronous in-situ monitoring device and method based on true triaxial impact, which relate to the field of coal body dynamics test and structural damage monitoring and comprise a sample bearing module, an impact loading module, an internal fiber Bragg grating dynamic strain monitoring module, a surface strain gauge monitoring module, a synchronous data acquisition module, a micro-crack detection module and a macroscopic damage analysis module, the sample bearing module is used for bearing the gas-solid coupling coal sample, the impact loading module is used for applying transient impact load with set impact speed to the gas-solid coupling coal sample, and the internal fiber Bragg grating dynamic strain monitoring module is respectively embedded with at least one fiber Bragg grating sensing grating point along three mutually orthogonal directions of the gas-solid coupling coal sample. The invention discloses a damage evolution mechanism of a gas-solid coupled coal body under a high strain rate condition, and provides a means for analyzing the risk of rock burst-coal and gas outburst composite dynamic disasters.

title_en: Foam curtain generation and performance characterization device, method and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a foam curtain generation and performance characterization device, a method and application, wherein the device comprises a foam curtain injection system for generating a foam curtain, a combustion system for heating the foam curtain and a motion capture system for capturing a motion track of the foam curtain, the foam curtain injection system comprises a foam mixed liquid tank body, a pump body and a foam curtain injector, the pump body is arranged between the foam mixed liquid tank body and the foam curtain injector, the pump body is connected with the foam curtain injector through a pipeline, the combustion system comprises a combustion gas cylinder, a combustion improver cylinder, a combustion mixer and a combustor, the combustion gas cylinder and the combustion improver cylinder are respectively connected with the input end of the combustion mixer through pipelines, and the combustor is connected with the output end of the combustion mixer. The invention can monitor the movement track of the marking section foam curtain in real time and control the angle of the combustion flame, so that the marking section foam curtain receives heat radiation at any time, more truly simulates the actual working condition and reflects the actual heat insulation effect.

title_en: Distribution network uninterrupted operation bypass flexible cable situation sensing method and device integrating multi-parameter monitoring
abstract_en: The invention discloses a situation sensing method and device for bypass flexible cables for distribution network uninterrupted operation integrating multi-parameter monitoring, relates to the technical field of cable detection, and aims to solve the problems of insufficient monitoring technology and high potential safety hazard of the existing bypass flexible cables. The method comprises the steps of S1 synchronously collecting parameters such as cable current, environment temperature and humidity and the like and adding a time stamp, S2 preprocessing data by a double-factor moving average algorithm, S3 calculating a coupling influence coefficient based on parameter coupling characteristics, S4 fusing the coefficient with a safety threshold to calculate a health index, and S5 triggering grading early warning according to the index and trend. The bypass cable real-time fine monitoring is realized, faults can be early warned, the power failure loss and the operation and maintenance cost are reduced, the operation safety is improved, meanwhile, the power-assisted power supply enterprise optimizes service and establishes good social image, and support is provided for the upgrading of the distribution network uninterrupted operation technology.

title_en: Real-time monitoring and safety early warning system for wearing state of safety belt
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of safety protection in electric power operation, and relates to a real-time monitoring and safety early warning system for the wearing state of a safety belt, the intelligent safety belt monitoring system comprises an intelligent safety belt host, a safety rope monitoring module, a surrounding rod belt monitoring module, a video acquisition expansion module, a safety risk management and control platform and a manager mobile terminal, wherein all components are connected in a wired or wireless mode, and the functions of automatic detection, voice reminding and remote notification are realized together. The invention can effectively improve the compliance rate of wearing the safety belt on the power operation site, reduce the falling risk, realize the centralization of data, the visualization of monitoring and the rapid response, and accord with the development trend of the safety management of the power industry.

title_en: Car light gauge with split-combined function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a car lamp detection tool with a split-combination function, which belongs to the technical field of car lamp detection tools and comprises a detection tool base, wherein a lower end cover is arranged in the middle of the upper side of the detection tool base, an upper end cover is arranged on the upper side of the lower end cover in a clamping manner, a supporting table is fixedly arranged on the periphery of the lower end cover at the upper end of the detection tool base, a main control device is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the detection tool base, and after one face of a car lamp die is detected, the supporting table can move to change the position in the range of the device through an electric control push rod, so that the upper end cover is conveniently disassembled and positioned, the car lamp die can be positioned and fixed through the structure provided with the upper end cover and the lower end cover, meanwhile, the front surface of the car lamp die can be detected through the disassembly and assembly structure, and meanwhile, the rear side circuit system of the car lamp die can be detected.

title_en: Deep sea sediment acoustic multi-parameter synchronous measurement device and multi-level acoustic parameter calculation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deep sea sediment acoustic multi-parameter synchronous measurement device and a multi-layer acoustic parameter calculation method, which comprise a mechanical bearing platform, a longitudinal acoustic detection module, a sampling module and a control communication system, wherein the control communication system comprises a deck communication machine, an upper computer and an underwater main control module, the longitudinal acoustic detection module comprises a transmitting transducer and a vertical acoustic receiving array, a stroke sensing module and the transmitting transducer are carried on the mechanical bearing platform, a main control cabin carrying the underwater main control unit is arranged above the mechanical bearing platform, the sampling module is arranged below the main control cabin, the vertical acoustic receiving array and a temperature probe are arranged at the periphery of the sampling module, and the stroke sensing module, the longitudinal acoustic detection module and the sampling module are communicated with the deck communication machine and the upper computer through the underwater main control module. The invention realizes in-situ measurement of propagation characteristics of sound waves in a middle-low frequency range in the sediment, synchronous sampling of the sediment and calculation of acoustic parameters of the multi-layer sediment.

title_en: RGB-infrared multi-mode sensing measurement method and system for automatic driving navigation
abstract_en: The invention provides an RGB-infrared multi-modal sensing measurement method and system for automatic driving navigation, the method comprises the steps of obtaining a visible light image and an infrared image of a forward view field of a vehicle, executing time synchronization, mapping the infrared image to a coordinate system of the visible light image, carrying out frequency domain physical feature fusion through a cross-modal spectrum injection mechanism based on amplitude-phase decoupling, and generating a multi-modal input tensor with time-space alignment and physical feature complementation; the method comprises the steps of inputting a multi-modal input tensor into a convolution neural network with shared weight, extracting multi-modal fusion characteristics, carrying out multi-scale detection on the multi-modal fusion characteristics, outputting a two-dimensional boundary frame of a target, constructing a space ray based on a center pixel of the lower edge of the two-dimensional boundary frame, calculating an intersection point of the space ray and a road plane to obtain three-dimensional position information of each target in a vehicle coordinate system, carrying out time sequence smoothing on the three-dimensional position information, and transmitting the processed three-dimensional position information to an automatic driving navigation control unit of a vehicle.

title_en: Construction method of intravascular device application experimental device and experimental device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a construction method of an application experimental device of an intravascular device, which comprises the steps of constructing two intravascular clamping mechanisms, arranging a liquid inlet and outlet port and an instrument extending port on the intravascular clamping mechanisms, connecting the liquid inlet and outlet port with an external liquid circulation module, respectively fixedly connecting and slidingly connecting the two intravascular clamping mechanisms on a longitudinally moving track seat, respectively slidingly connecting the two intravascular clamping mechanisms on the longitudinally moving track seat, connecting the longitudinally moving track seat on the bottom of a water tank, and connecting the water tank with a temperature control module. Through set up the longitudinal movement track seat in the basin to connect two blood vessel end clamping machine constructs on the longitudinal movement track seat, set up into flowing back port and apparatus and stretch into the port on blood vessel end clamping machine construct, make two blood vessel end clamping machine construct and can hold the blood vessel both ends, make the blood vessel intracavity be full of flowing liquid in order to simulate blood vessel intracavity environment through flowing back port, only need stretch into the port with the apparatus from the apparatus when carrying out the experiment can.

title_en: Method for identifying RNA interaction protein by dCS 13-TurboID system and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biological genes, and discloses a method for identifying RNA interaction proteins by using a dCAS13-TurboID system, which comprises the steps of constructing fusion proteins formed by dCAS13 protein and TurboID biotin ligase by using the fusion proteins to obtain recombinant plasmids, constructing sgRNA of target RNA, using an agrobacterium-mediated genetic transformation method to transfer genes into plant receptors to obtain fusion proteins and transgenic plants A successfully expressed by the sgRNA, cloning coding genes for expressing the target RNA into plant expression vectors to construct recombinant plasmids, using the agrobacterium-mediated genetic transformation method to transfer genes into the plant receptors to obtain transgenic plants B over-expressed by the target RNA, hybridizing the transgenic plants A and the transgenic plants B to obtain filial generations after the transgenic plants A and the transgenic plants B bloom, and carrying out protein extraction, enrichment and mass spectrum identification on samples after the germinated seedlings are soaked in a biotin solution. The invention provides a feasible method for researching the centering on RNA and identifying the protein interacted with the RNA.

title_en: Display screen data acquisition device, erection method, acquisition method and correction system
abstract_en: The application provides a display screen data acquisition device, an erection method, an acquisition method and a correction system. The display screen data acquisition device comprises a plurality of acquisition components, wherein the acquisition components are integrated into a whole, and optical axes of the acquisition components are intersected on the same point. The display screen data acquisition device can realize the integral adjustment of the acquisition components, so that the data acquisition difficulty of the display screen data acquisition device is reduced, the acquisition is more standardized, and the utilization rate of the view fields of all the acquisition components can be improved.

title_en: Device and method for improving film thickness measurement precision
abstract_en: The invention provides a device and a method for improving the measurement precision of film thickness, which relate to the technical field of film thickness measurement based on optics, wherein the device comprises a broadband light source, a spatial filter, a collimator, a measuring device, an imaging lens and a spectrometer, the measuring device comprises a reference mirror and a beam-splitting prism, and the method comprises the steps of calibrating parameters of the measuring device; the method comprises the steps of placing a sample to be detected into a detection light branch, acquiring spectrum interference fringe data of two-dimensional distribution corresponding to different OPD values through single acquisition of an imaging spectrometer, preprocessing the spectrum interference fringe data based on nonlinear fitting iteration, acquiring an experimental measurement value of SRPS based on the preprocessed spectrum interference fringe data, acquiring a theoretical value of SRPS, and obtaining a thickness value of a film and the OPD of an initial position of the sample through cross-correlation operation of the theoretical value of SRPS and the experimental measurement value. The invention has the advantages of realizing a measuring method with higher precision and lower cost through single measurement.

title_en: Pollen counter
abstract_en: The invention provides a pollen counter which comprises a shell, wherein an air inlet is formed in the shell, an air outlet is formed in the shell, an electric interface is formed in the shell, and a counting mechanism for detecting and counting pollen is arranged in the shell. The pollen counter can automatically detect and count pollen, and realizes the replacement of manpower.

title_en: Special miniature bearing appearance defect detection device
abstract_en: The invention provides a special miniature bearing appearance defect detection device which comprises a frame, a feeding component, a discharging component, a rotating disc, a clamp component and a detection component, wherein the feeding component is arranged on the frame, the discharging component is arranged on the frame, the rotating disc is arranged on the inner side of the frame, the clamp component is arranged on the rotating disc and used for receiving a bearing in the feeding component and sending the bearing into the discharging component after detection is completed, the detection component is fixedly arranged on the frame and used for driving the clamp component to rotate to the bottom of the detection component and complete detection, the detection component comprises a bearing front detection station I, a bearing overturning station, a bearing back detection station I, an outer circle detection station I and an inner hole detection station I which are sequentially arranged, the bearing front detection station I and the bearing back detection station I complete image comparison detection through a color camera, the outer circle detection station I complete image comparison detection through a linear array camera, and the inner hole detection station completes image comparison detection through an endoscope head camera.

title_en: Method and system for detecting compressive strength of concrete for constructional engineering
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for detecting the compressive strength of concrete for constructional engineering, and relates to the technical field of detection of the concrete strength of constructional engineering. And performing cross-modal fusion processing on the data set to generate a concrete internal defect characteristic map and a material uniformity distribution spectrum. And calling a pre-training strength prediction model to analyze the feature map and the distribution spectrum to obtain a compressive strength predicted value and a structural weak area mark. And carrying out space weight correction on the predicted value according to the mark to generate a corrected compressive strength value. Based on the correction value and the distribution spectrum, a detection report and a maintenance proposal are output. The method improves the intensity detection precision and the defect identification comprehensiveness.

title_en: Three-degree-of-freedom spherical gear tooth surface error measurement method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a three-degree-of-freedom spherical gear tooth surface error measurement method, a system, equipment and a medium, wherein the method is used for determining an origin coordinate of a measurement coordinate system based on a plurality of first coordinate positions, establishing a first plane of a spherical gear based on a plurality of second coordinate positions and a plurality of third coordinate positions, and establishing a second plane of the spherical gear based on a plurality of fourth coordinate positions and a plurality of fifth coordinate positions; the method comprises the steps of determining a measurement coordinate system based on an origin coordinate of the measurement coordinate system, a first plane and a second plane, calculating a theoretical tooth profile, a theoretical tooth direction, a theoretical tooth thickness and a theoretical tooth pitch based on the theoretical coordinate system, calculating an actual tooth profile, an actual tooth direction, an actual tooth thickness and an actual tooth pitch based on the measurement coordinate system, calculating deviations between the theoretical tooth profile and the actual tooth profile, between the theoretical tooth direction and the actual tooth direction, between the theoretical tooth thickness and the actual tooth thickness and between the theoretical tooth pitch and the actual tooth pitch, and obtaining deviation results. The application can improve the accuracy of measuring the tooth surface error of the three-degree-of-freedom spherical gear.

title_en: Method for measuring lowest point elevation of section of lower chord member of steel mesh frame
abstract_en: The invention discloses a steel mesh frame lower chord section lowest point elevation measurement method which comprises the following steps of S1, determining a measured section of a rod piece to be measured, S2, erecting a total station on the ground right below the lower chord piece to be measured, wherein the horizontal projection distance L between the total station and the measured section meets the following relation that L=k (H-i) (1.2 is less than or equal to k is less than or equal to 2.8), S3, fixing the vertical angle of a total station telescope, enabling a laser indication point to be located at the rightmost end of the rod piece section, recording a horizontal angle alpha  start , enabling the laser indication point to be located at the leftmost end of the rod piece section, recording a horizontal angle alpha  end , calculating a horizontal angle span, S4, equally dividing a horizontal angle interval [ alpha  start ,α end  ] into n, S5, sequentially measuring each measuring point elevation H  k  according to a measuring point horizontal angle sequence alpha  k , S6, locating an elevation minimum measuring point index k_min, meeting H  k_min =min(H k , and adopting a three-point quadratic interpolation formula to calculate a theoretical lowest point elevation H  min .

title_en: Ultra-high voltage transmission tower grounding grid detection device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power equipment detection and relates to an ultra-high voltage transmission tower grounding grid detection device which comprises a moving robot, a ground penetrating radar and a remote controller, wherein the moving robot is provided with the ground penetrating radar, the remote controller is respectively connected with the moving robot and the ground penetrating radar in a wireless communication mode, and the movement of the moving robot is controlled remotely, the detection data of the ground penetrating radar and the movement position information of the moving robot are received, so that the imaging detection and the positioning of an underground grounding grid are realized. By mounting the ground penetrating radar on the movable moving robot and performing non-excavation detection on the ground network buried underground and invisible to naked eyes, physical structural anomalies such as deformation or fracture of the ground network can be effectively identified. The moving robot is controlled to walk in a remote control mode and returns detection data, so that the automation level and the intelligent level of the detection process are improved.

title_en: Detection device for boiler pressure vessel capable of checking different heights
abstract_en: The invention discloses a detection device for a boiler pressure container capable of detecting different heights, and relates to the technical field of boiler pressure container detection. The invention comprises a movable seat, a chassis and an adjusting mechanism, wherein one side of the movable seat is in sliding fit with the chassis, two supporting frames are fixed on the upper side of the movable seat, one side of each supporting frame is in sliding fit with a top disk, a detecting piece is arranged on the top disk, and the adjusting mechanism comprises a screw rod which is in rotating fit in one supporting frame. According to the invention, the flexible movement of the device and the adjustment of the horizontal position of the chassis can be realized through the movable seat and the sliding fit chassis, so that the boiler pressure container with various mounting positions is adapted, the carrying adjustment of multiple persons is not needed, the flexibility of the detection device is improved, the height and the transverse position of the top tray can be adjusted through the arranged adjusting mechanism under the matched use of the telescopic piece, the boiler pressure container with various heights can be adapted, and the applicability of the device is improved.

title_en: Three-dimensional imaging method and apparatus, program product, and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a three-dimensional imaging method, a device, a program product and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of dividing sub-apertures with equivalent phase centers with the same positions in a multi-input multi-output MIMO array into the same sub-aperture group to obtain a plurality of sub-aperture groups, wherein the sub-apertures are obtained by dividing receiving antennas and transmitting antennas in the MIMO array in advance, the equivalent phase centers are centers of center connecting lines of all antennas in the sub-apertures, performing spectrum compression on the sub-aperture groups based on echo data acquired by the sub-aperture groups in a transmitting and receiving period to determine a plurality of target sub-images corresponding to the sub-aperture groups, and coherently superposing the target sub-images to obtain a target three-dimensional image. The application solves the problem of low imaging efficiency in the related technology and achieves the effect of high-efficiency imaging.

title_en: Noise data processing method based on cavitation flow characteristics of propeller
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ship power device state monitoring and fault diagnosis, and provides a noise data processing method based on cavitation flow characteristics of a propeller. According to the method, the observable dynamic frequencies such as leaf frequency, cavitation shedding main frequency and the like, frequency spectrum broadening factors, autocorrelation time, broadband energy, kurtosis and other statistical non-stationary quantities are unified to the same analysis framework, a mapping model of cavitation state and signal processing parameters is constructed, analysis parameters such as FFT, STFT and CWT are configured in a self-adaptive mode, and multi-scale feature extraction of non-stationary pressure pulsation signals under different cavitation types and cavitation intensities is achieved. Based on the extracted multi-domain features, the cavitation state and type are identified and evaluated, and the identification result is reversely updated with the threshold value and the mapping parameter, so that a closed loop of 'state discrimination-parameter mapping-multi-domain analysis-feature output-cavitation identification-parameter updating' is formed, and the accuracy and engineering applicability of the cavitation monitoring and diagnosis of the propeller are improved.

title_en: Tension testing method, electronic device, storage medium, and program
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a tension test method, electronic equipment, a storage medium and a program, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining target current data when target body-building equipment runs in a target rope-out speed preset deviation interval, determining the target rope-out speed preset deviation interval according to target expected rope-out speed and a speed steady-state fluctuation value of the target body-building equipment in a speed mode, calculating an average value of the target current data to obtain target average current data, and determining target tension of a target user at the target expected rope-out speed according to a current weight proportion coefficient of the target body-building equipment and the target average current data. According to the technical scheme provided by the embodiment of the invention, the tension test can be directly completed without additional auxiliary equipment, and meanwhile, the efficiency of the tension test is improved.

title_en: Water quality detection device and water quality detection method using the same
abstract_en: The water quality detection equipment comprises a detection cavity device, a pump module, a light source, a light sensor and a controller. The detection chamber device has a detection chamber. The pump module is used for conveying the liquid to be detected and the reagent to the detection cavity. The light source is located outside the detection cavity and used for emitting detection light to the detection cavity. The light sensor senses the detection light passing through the detection cavity and generates a detection voltage value. The controller is electrically connected with the light sensor and the pump module and is configured to execute the following procedures of a voltage sensing procedure, a dilution judging procedure, a to-be-detected liquid dilution procedure and a concentration obtaining procedure. The dilution determination process can calculate the voltage ratio of the detected voltage value to the base voltage value. And executing a concentration obtaining program when the voltage ratio is larger than the critical value, and executing a dilution program of the liquid to be detected when the voltage ratio is not larger than the critical value.

title_en: LiDAR 3D target detection optimization method for small targets
abstract_en: The invention discloses a LiDAR 3D target detection optimization method for small targets, which comprises the steps of collecting original point cloud data through a laser radar and carrying out voxelization processing to generate a three-dimensional voxel feature tensor, inputting the three-dimensional voxel feature tensor into a point cloud target detection model to obtain 3D target detection frame parameters and target types, generating positive and negative samples based on a dynamic sample distribution strategy, training the model, calculating a total loss function according to detection results and manually marked labels, further optimizing the model, and finally utilizing the optimized model to infer the voxelization processing point cloud to be detected to realize accurate detection of the small targets. According to the method, through dynamic sample distribution and loss function optimization, the detection precision and robustness of the small target in the LiDAR point cloud are effectively improved.

title_en: Application of metabolite marker in preparation of hyperuricemia diagnosis product and hyperuricemia diagnosis device
abstract_en: The invention provides application of a metabolite marker in preparing a hyperuricemia diagnosis product and a hyperuricemia diagnosis device, and relates to the technical field of biomedicine. According to the invention, through a non-targeted metabonomics technology, the fecal metabolism spectrum of a crowd queue is systematically analyzed, and a difference analysis, partial least squares discriminant analysis (PLS-DA) and a machine learning algorithm are comprehensively utilized to screen and identify core fecal metabolism markers (tongue fur acid, cowagarcinone E and Tuliposide B) capable of reliably predicting the occurrence tendency of hyperuricemia from mass metabolites. Finally, a prediction device based on the marker combination is established, the prediction accuracy of the device is high, and a brand new, noninvasive and high clinical transformation potential tool is provided for early screening and risk stratification of hyperuricemia.

title_en: Power quality transient disturbance analysis method and system based on phase robust kurtosis
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power systems, and provides a method and a system for analyzing transient disturbance of electric energy quality based on phase robust kurtosis, which are used for acquiring single-period waveform data of transient disturbance of the electric energy quality, decomposing the acquired single-period waveform data into fundamental wave signals and disturbance signals, and determining a disturbance initial phase; the method comprises the steps of determining an optimal phase shift point according to a value of a disturbance initial phase, calculating a phase shift quantity between the disturbance initial phase and the optimal phase shift point, calculating a disturbance phase after phase shift, calculating kurtosis of a phase shift waveform, comparing the kurtosis of the phase robustness with a preset monitoring threshold value of a monitoring range boundary in different states as the kurtosis of the phase robustness, and determining a state of transient disturbance of power quality. According to the invention, the phase shift waveform is constructed by introducing the optimal phase shift point, so that the robustness of the disturbance initial phase and the severity of the disturbance are accurately represented, and the accurate and lightweight representation of the transient disturbance is realized.

title_en: Cross-linked polyethylene cable fault point positioning detection method
abstract_en: The invention provides a fault point positioning detection method of a crosslinked polyethylene cable, which comprises an impedance distribution mapping step, a characteristic frequency analysis step, an excitation signal synthesis step, a signal detection step and a fault positioning step. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a reflection echo sequence of the whole length of a cable to be tested, obtaining a broadband detection signal to the single end of the cable to be tested in an impedance distribution mapping step, constructing an impedance distribution map of the cable to be tested, determining an impedance mutation position based on the impedance distribution map in a characteristic frequency analysis step, calculating reflection characteristics of the impedance mutation position in a frequency domain, screening out characteristic frequencies, synthesizing a composite excitation signal based on the characteristic frequencies in an excitation signal synthesis step, continuously injecting the composite excitation signal into the cable to be tested, moving along a path of the cable to be tested by utilizing a magnetic induction probe in a signal detection step, obtaining a phase jump value, carrying out logic association judgment on a spatial magnetic field intensity gradient and the phase jump value in a fault positioning step, and determining a fault point.

title_en: Laser radar, scanner and equipment for laser radar
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a lidar, a scanner for a lidar, and an apparatus. The lidar includes a transmitter and a scanner. The emitter is configured to emit probe light. The scanner is configured to oscillate around the rotation axis within an oscillation range, and deflect the probe light into a field of view range. The swing range includes a first speed fixed zone, a first shift transition zone, and a second speed fixed zone in a first direction. The first direction is perpendicular to the rotation axis. The rotation speed of the scanner in the first speed fixing area is larger than that of the scanner in the second speed fixing area. In the first variable speed transition region, the change relation of the rotating speed of the scanner along with the angle satisfies a half-period cosine function.

title_en: Saline-alkali soil chickpea-astragalus sinicus planting method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a planting method and a planting device for chickpea-milk vetch in saline-alkali soil, relates to the technical field of agricultural planting, and aims at solving the problem that linear salt damage lacks seedlings caused by condensation and drip return of film edges; according to the color-changing continuity measuring and calculating interval, constructing an artificial pressure relief point at the edge of the film, configuring a condensation fin to convert continuous water vapor escape into discrete fixed-point dripping, paving a sacrificial salt interception belt outside the film in an aligned manner, instantly receiving and solidifying high-concentration condensed salt water to block the salt interception belt from entering soil, carrying out risk avoidance, lofting and sowing in combination with a safe offset distance, and removing the salt interception belt full of salt after seedlings are stabilized to form a plateau from a farmland. The method realizes the accurate positioning, discrete breaking and stripping of hidden salt damage, thoroughly eliminates the pulse toxicity of edge salt lines to seedlings, and remarkably improves the continuity and survival rate of vegetation planting in saline-alkali soil.

title_en: Fault transient waveform capturing device for power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power distribution network fault transient waveform capturing device which comprises an induction energy-taking power supply module, a sensor module and a data acquisition and processing module, wherein the sensor module is used for accurately measuring current and voltage signals in a power distribution network circuit, the data acquisition and processing module is used for synchronously acquiring the current and voltage signals measured by each detection point sensor module and automatically starting and storing fault transient traveling waves, and the induction energy-taking power supply module adopts a high-energy-density composite electricity-taking structure with an induction energy-taking magnetic core and a weak electric field electricity-taking electrode connected in parallel, acquires energy from the power distribution network circuit through a double path and stably supplies power for the data acquisition and processing module. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of realizing efficient and reliable capturing of the fault transient waveform of the power distribution network and the like.

title_en: Master-slave star cooperative SAR-GMTI system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a master-slave type satellite group cooperative SAR-GMTI system and method, wherein the master-slave type satellite group cooperative SAR-GMTI system comprises an azimuth multi-channel master satellite M1, a course-following small satellite group M2 and an on-board combined processing module M3, wherein the azimuth multi-channel master satellite M1 is used for transmitting radar signals on a full array surface and receiving radar signals on a multi-channel basis, the course-following small satellite group M2 is composed of at least 2 small satellites in a receiving mode, the small satellite groups are linearly distributed along a course, and the on-board combined processing module M3 is used for fusing SAR image data of the azimuth multi-channel master satellite M1 and the course-following small satellite group M2 and completing target detection and repositioning through space-time self-adaptive processing. The invention effectively solves the problems of large minimum detectable speed of a single-platform system, fuzzy speed of a distributed system and the like, and provides important technical support for the subsequent ground imaging observation of the spaceborne SAR.

title_en: Ionosphere correction precision estimation method and system in GNSS enhanced positioning
abstract_en: The application relates to an ionosphere correction precision estimation method and system in GNSS enhanced positioning, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a regional ionosphere model by using GNSS observation data of reference stations in a CORS network and adopting a linear interpolation method, calculating ionosphere interpolation residual errors of each reference station based on the regional ionosphere model, calculating unit weight variances according to the residual errors of all the reference stations and taking the unit weight variances as reference station ionosphere interpolation precision, and obtaining an ionosphere interpolation standard deviation at a mobile station by combining the unit weight variances and the relative geometric relation between the mobile station and the reference stations through an error propagation law and taking the unit weight variances as an estimation value of the ionosphere correction precision. According to the method, the regional ionosphere model is built by using GNSS observation data of the reference stations, the multi-reference-station observation information is integrated by using a linear interpolation method, the regional consistency of ionosphere space distribution modeling is improved, the ionosphere interpolation residual error of each reference station is calculated based on the model, the unit weight variance is calculated, and the statistical quantization basis is provided for the ionosphere interpolation accuracy of the reference stations.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle for inspection and application method thereof in bridge water composite scene
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, provides a patrol unmanned aerial vehicle and an application method thereof in a bridge water composite scene, and solves the problems that an existing unmanned aerial vehicle cannot be marked on site in real time due to defects and is poor in reliability of water surface marking. The three-axis camera is fixedly arranged on a first side of the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle body, at least one throwing bin is fixedly arranged on a second side of the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle body opposite to the first side, a clamping opening is formed in the bottom of the throwing bin, at least one throwing object is clamped between each opening and closing hook, the throwing objects are divided into two types of bridge deck throwing objects and water surface throwing objects, opening and closing parts are arranged above the throwing bin and used for driving each opening and closing hook to rotate relatively around the corresponding mounting rod, and the three-axis camera and the double-type throwing system are integrated.

title_en: Response gel-based method and system for detecting chloride ions of effluent ceramic cultural relics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a response gel-based method and a response gel-based system for detecting chloride ions of a ceramic cultural relic, which relate to the technical field of cultural relic protection and comprise the steps of preparing a topology self-adaptive paper-cut microstructure composite gel patch, mixing functional components into a prepolymer solution, and performing photo-curing and laser cutting to obtain the gel patch with a micro-incision structure; the method comprises the steps of carrying out surface pretreatment on a region to be detected of the ceramic cultural relics, removing surface attachments and eliminating temperature differences to obtain a clean surface of the cultural relics to be detected, applying a topology self-adaptive paper-cut microstructure composite gel patch to the surface of the cultural relics to be detected, carrying out fluorescence spectrum collection on a chloride ion response gel patch, calculating the ratio of characteristic emission peak intensities to obtain a chloride ion concentration fluorescence response signal, driving deep chloride ion migration by using a directional electric field, breaking through the bottleneck of low passive diffusion efficiency, realizing objective and accurate determination of a desalination endpoint by combining a dynamic curve relative change rate, and avoiding artificial misjudgment.

title_en: Power assisting method and device for equipment movement and computer equipment
abstract_en: The present application relates to a method, an apparatus, a computer device, a computer readable storage medium and a computer program product for assisting a device when moving. The method includes collecting thrust force applied to the equipment by an operator, moving speed of the equipment, and attitude data when the equipment moves, wherein the attitude data includes pitch angle, course angle and roll angle. And determining the output torque output by the power assisting unit to the power wheel based on the thrust, the moving speed, the gesture data and preset torque output information, wherein the torque output information comprises the corresponding relation among the thrust, the moving speed and the torque. The output torque includes a first output torque positively correlated with the thrust force for powering the movement of the device and a second output torque for counteracting the gravitational component and the movement resistance of the device when ascending or descending the slope. By adopting the method, the stability and the operability of the movement of the equipment can be improved.

title_en: Tool and method for accurately measuring torque coefficient of bolt
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tool and a method for accurately measuring a torque coefficient of a bolt, wherein the tool comprises a first component, a second component, a third component and bolt test pieces, wherein the first component and the bolt test pieces are respectively made of the same material and processed by the same processing technology as the parts of the products, the bolt test pieces are qualified parts of the same batch of the products, the number of the bolt test pieces is not less than 8, the first component and the second component are provided with through holes, the third component is provided with threaded holes, and the first component, the second component and the third component can be used independently or in combination according to the specifications of the bolt test pieces and are respectively used for measuring studs or bolts. Based on the tool, the method realizes accurate measurement of the torque coefficient by combining the double-method detection and system calibration through four steps of early preparation, fastening and synchronous measurement, analysis optimization of a measurement system and batch retesting. The invention has the advantages of actual working condition reduction, strong universality and high measurement precision, can be directly used for product production and assembly, and ensures the bolt connection quality and the equipment operation reliability.

title_en: Automatic defect detection equipment for noble metal electroplated layer
abstract_en: The invention provides automatic detection equipment for defects of noble metal plating layers, which belongs to the technical field of plating layer detection and comprises a detection table, wherein a pair of supporting plates are fixedly connected to the detection table, a movement detection mechanism is arranged at the rear sides of the pair of supporting plates, a loading and unloading mechanism is arranged at the top of the pair of supporting plates, a surface dust removing mechanism is arranged below a clamping and rotating mechanism, the loading and unloading mechanism comprises a bracket fixedly connected to the supporting plates, an electric push rod II is arranged at one side of a sliding table, a connecting seat I is arranged at the output end of the electric push rod II, a material taking frame is arranged on the connecting seat I, a traction mechanism is arranged on the material taking frame, the material taking frame comprises a fastening area, and the fastening area comprises an initial fastening strip, a middle fastening strip and a tail fastening strip. The invention solves the problems that in the existing automatic detection equipment for the defects of the noble metal electroplated layer, the electroplated product needs to be manually taken to or moved from the clamping plates in the detection process of the electroplated product, the detection process is time-consuming and labor-consuming, is not beneficial to the durable detection, and reduces the detection efficiency.

title_en: Infrared sensor for detecting concentration of carbon dioxide in pipeline and working method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of measurement, and particularly relates to an infrared sensor for detecting the concentration of carbon dioxide in a pipeline and a working method thereof, wherein the infrared sensor for detecting the concentration of the carbon dioxide in the pipeline enters a gas chamber through a first flow channel when the flow rate of the gas is low, the gas enters the gas chamber through a second flow channel when the flow rate of the gas is high, the flowing length of the gas in the second flow channel is longer than the flowing length of the gas in the first flow channel, so that the flowing distance of the gas is reduced when the flow rate of the gas is low, the flowing distance of the gas is increased when the flow rate of the gas is high, the gas is prevented from flowing into the gas chamber too fast, and the detecting precision of the carbon dioxide is ensured.

title_en: Three-phase intelligent electric energy meter, single optocoupler pulse signal switching circuit and detection circuit thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of intelligent electric meters, and particularly relates to a three-phase intelligent electric energy meter, a single optocoupler pulse signal switching circuit and a detection circuit. The light-emitting diode switching device comprises an optical coupler and a controllable switching tube, wherein the positive electrode of a light-emitting diode in the optical coupler is connected with a working power supply, the output end of the optical coupler is used for being connected with a group of external terminals, the control end of the controllable switching tube is used for being connected with the electric energy pulse signal output end of a metering chip, the current outflow output end of the controllable switching tube is used for receiving a switching control signal, the current inflow output end of the controllable switching tube is connected with the negative electrode of the light-emitting diode in the optical coupler and the second pulse signal output end of a processor, when the external terminals are required to output the second pulse signal, the switching control signal is a signal for controlling the controllable switching tube to be turned on, and the second pulse signal is controlled to be in a high-resistance state, so that the cost and the layout space are reduced.

title_en: Method, device and equipment for extracting sounding signal of satellite-borne single-photon laser radar
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a device and equipment for extracting sounding signals of a satellite-borne single-photon laser radar, and relates to the technical field of photon extraction, wherein the method for extracting sounding signals of the satellite-borne single-photon laser radar comprises the steps of acquiring original photons, and extracting water surface characteristic photons from the original photons according to elevation distribution and density characteristics of the water surface photons; separating and finely extracting water surface characteristic photons through photon elevation iteration clustering segmentation and local density filtering to obtain water surface signal photons, extracting water bottom signal photons through a multi-scale robust regression and multi-stage filtering strategy, determining a sounding signal based on the water surface signal photons and the water bottom signal photons, and carrying out tidal correction on the sounding signal. The invention can effectively solve the problem of poor photon extraction quality in the prior related technology, and provides an effective new way for accurately, automatically and low-cost obtaining the water depth information of the open sea or shallow water areas which are difficult to approach.

title_en: Testing arrangement is used in preparation of quantum dot membrane
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of testing, in particular to a testing device for quantum dot film manufacture, which comprises a friction testing machine, a penholder and a loading arm, wherein a fixed seat for fixing a testing piece is arranged at the top of the friction testing machine, a counter clamping assembly is arranged on the fixed seat and used for centering and clamping the testing piece, a sweeping cleaning assembly is arranged at the bottom of a sliding guide block and used for carrying out blowing cleaning on the surface of the testing piece.

title_en: Asynchronous envelope detector based on zero crossing event of input signal
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of digital-analog hybrid integrated circuits, and particularly relates to an asynchronous envelope detector based on an input signal zero crossing event. The asynchronous envelope detector based on the zero crossing event of the input signal can flexibly adapt to the input signals with different frequencies, the detection time sequence of the asynchronous envelope detector is directly driven by the zero crossing event of the input signal, and real-time envelope detection can be realized without an external clock. The design completely depends on the dynamic characteristics of the input signal to realize asynchronous self-adaptive work, so that the working frequency of the envelope detector can be automatically adjusted along with the change of the frequency of the input signal, and stable detection precision and quick response capability can be maintained under the condition of broadband signals from low frequency to high frequency. The invention does not need complex clock distribution and control logic, obviously reduces the system power consumption and design complexity, can realize high-real-time and high-energy-efficiency envelope extraction in a high-speed signal environment, and is very suitable for integrated realization and high-speed signal processing application.

title_en: Watson-Watt direction-finding machine amplitude phase calibration method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Wotesen-Watt direction finding machine amplitude-phase calibration method and device, which are used for constructing a double-channel amplitude-phase coupling deviation reference spectrum through amplitude-phase deviation extraction and drift direction classification, establishing a channel deviation coupling relationship spectrum by carrying out temperature drift and frequency dependence joint tracing on each deviation factor, generating an overshoot risk mark by combining compensation direction overturning risk quantification, carrying out calibration residual error convergence assessment based on the channel deviation coupling relationship spectrum and the overshoot risk mark, determining deviation grades and identifying blocking factor sets, completing frequency band classification weight distribution according to a cross-frequency band transmission path of the blocking factor sets, acquiring each frequency band deviation value, determining deviation distribution types through polarity overturning detection and asymmetry grading, finally completing cross-frequency band amplitude-phase coupling compensation quantity calculation and combining deviation grades to output amplitude-phase calibration compensation parameters, and realizing system identification and linkage compensation of double-channel amplitude-phase deviation under a wide-frequency band working scene.

title_en: Method and system for time synchronization of sensor units
abstract_en: Methods and systems for time synchronizing sensor units. Method for time synchronizing sensor units in a distributed system, wherein sensor data are acquired by the sensor units and transmitted to a central unit, wherein, when the sensor data are acquired, a further current value of an internal time unit of the sensor units is stored, wherein, at least the value of the internal time unit stored when a time characteristic of a characteristic signal is received, a transmitter identification of the characteristic signal and a further value of the internal time unit stored when the sensor data are acquired are assigned to the sensor data and transmitted to the central unit together with the sensor data, wherein the central unit acquires the voltage and phase value of at least one phase conductor as a current vector, the acquisition period is more than one measurement period, and the current vector is aggregated into an aggregate current vector, and is transmitted to the central unit, and the power is calculated from the voltage value and the aggregate current vector.

title_en: Mitochondria-targeted hemicyanine-like fluorescent dye, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mitochondrial-targeted hemicyanine-like fluorescent dye, a preparation method and application thereof. According to the invention, the aldehyde structure containing naphthalene ring and the indole salt structure are subjected to Aldol condensation, so that the rigid enhanced half-cyanine fluorescent dye is formed, and the problem of insufficient stability of the cyanine dye is solved. The invention realizes the final construction of the dye through three to four steps, and the ultraviolet-visible absorption wavelength of the synthesized half cyanine fluorescent dye can reach 690 nm, and the fluorescence emission wavelength can reach 742 nm. In addition, cell experiments prove that the fluorescent probe can also target mitochondria (the Pearson coefficient is as high as 0.94).

title_en: Method for detecting biomarker GSH content based on TMB colorimetric method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biochemical detection and discloses a method for detecting the GSH content of a biomarker based on a TMB colorimetric method, which comprises the following steps that firstly, a hydrogen bond organic framework is synthesized by adopting a hydrothermal method, and transition metal Fe is introduced for modification to obtain an HOF-Fe material; step three, adding glutathione solutions with different concentrations into the reaction system respectively to quantitatively detect the glutathione, and the method constructs a high-performance colorimetric sensor by preparing novel HOF-Fe nano enzyme, so that the rapid, high-sensitivity and high-specificity detection of the glutathione can be realized, and the method can be widely applied to the measurement of the glutathione content in actual samples.

title_en: Multi-connected-zone seismic attribute consistency processing and self-adaptive fusion method and system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of seismic data processing, and relates to a multi-patch work area seismic attribute consistency processing and self-adaptive fusion method and system, comprising the following steps of S1, performing grid division on space coordinates in original seismic attribute data, establishing a grid data index, executing a localized search strategy based on the grid data index, and extracting a neighboring data point set of a seismic data point to be processed; the method comprises the steps of S2, eliminating systematic value domain differences of original seismic attribute data based on adjacent data point sets, splicing to obtain consistent fusion seismic attribute data, S3, filling a blank area by adopting a hierarchical interpolation strategy to obtain continuous seismic attribute interpolation data, S4, carrying out global optimization based on Gaussian pyramid decomposition and an energy minimization model to obtain final fusion seismic attribute data, and efficiently avoiding attribute unfused effects of a traditional splicing work area method with better splicing work areas and interpolation so as to achieve the aim of consistent splicing of the seismic attributes of multiple work areas.

title_en: Track detection system and method based on self-adaptive matching and multi-source fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a track detection system and a track detection method based on self-adaptive matching and multi-source fusion, relates to the technical field of track detection, and solves the problems of weak interference resistance, insufficient multi-source data fusion robustness and inaccurate disease tracing of the existing profile matching. The method comprises the steps of acquiring profile and fastener images by a 3D camera, acquiring attitude positioning data by laser inertial navigation and GNSS, synchronously triggering and processing data by a synchronous controller, a processing computer and an odometer, processing 3D camera data by self-adaptive weighted profile matching, fusing multisource positioning data by federal Kalman filtering, combining rail mapping, sleeper counting and geometric parameter extraction modules, realizing rail abrasion calculation, rail parameter extraction, sleeper counting and geometric parameter extraction, accurately correlating rail abrasion, rail geometric parameters and sleeper numbers, realizing accurate positioning of rail detection results, and reducing detection mileage positioning errors.

title_en: Daily preservative skin comprehensive toxicity prediction and verification method based on cutin-fiber co-culture multichannel response
abstract_en: The invention discloses a daily preservative skin comprehensive toxicity prediction and verification method based on cutin-fiber co-culture multichannel response, and belongs to the technical field of daily chemical safety evaluation. The invention uses human keratinocytes (HaCaT) and human dermal fibroblasts (HSF) as double targets, and carries out mechanical skin toxicity assessment, grading and guiding methods of formula application on preservatives through inflammatory, barrier damage, cell aging and organelle damage multi-dimensional end points. The method disclosed by the invention has the advantages of high prediction accuracy, high sensitivity, high efficiency and compliance, breaks through the limitation that the traditional method only focuses on 'cell death and activity', analyzes the toxic action path of the preservative in a panoramic manner from three dimensions of gene expression (early signals), organelle damage (middle process) to population apoptosis (end-to-end), avoids false negative caused by a single end point, and has a wide application prospect.

title_en: Detection method of kidney-tonifying body-strengthening tablet
abstract_en: The invention provides a detection method of a kidney-tonifying body-strengthening tablet, which comprises the step of identifying active ingredients of epimedium herb, glossy privet fruit and semen cuscutae in the kidney-tonifying body-strengthening tablet by a thin layer chromatography. The chromatographic identification method has clear spots and good separation degree, eliminates impurity interference, improves the controllability of the quality standard of the kidney-tonifying body-strengthening tablet, and further ensures the internal quality and the curative effect of the product.

title_en: Quick track measurement method, device, computer equipment, storage medium and product
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid track measurement method, a rapid track measurement device, computer equipment, a storage medium and a rapid track measurement product. According to the method, the laser point positions are aligned based on the images acquired by the CCD camera, the target track data are determined at the positions of the reflecting targets based on laser ranging, measuring head angle data, trolley inclination data and the like, the track data between traveling are determined based on gyro data, odometer data, trolley inclination data and the like, the track data between traveling are corrected based on the target track data, automatic identification and accurate movement to the control points are achieved, automatic measurement is carried out, walking is automatically started to start the measurement of the next interval after the measurement of the control points is completed, only one reflecting target is needed to be measured at each control point, the measurement efficiency is greatly improved, the measurement precision is also ensured, compared with that of an expensive inertial navigation device and an automatic total station device are omitted, the cost is greatly reduced, the overall intelligent level is high, and the technical requirements on operators are also greatly reduced.

title_en: Sampling detector for radiation environment
abstract_en: The application relates to a sampling detector for a radiation environment, which relates to the technical field of environment detection and comprises a walking component and a fixed bin, wherein the fixed bin is arranged on the walking component, a collecting component is arranged on one surface outside the fixed bin, a material storage component is arranged in the fixed bin, a conveying component is arranged in the fixed bin, a supporting plate is arranged in the fixed bin, a first conveying component is arranged on the supporting plate, an extraction component for extracting an output end of the material storage component to the first conveying component is arranged in the fixed bin, a filter membrane is positioned between the acquisition bottle and the output end of the collecting component, a posture changing plate is arranged at the output end of the first conveying component, a second conveying component is arranged at the other end of the posture changing plate, a pressing and cutting component is arranged in the fixed bin and above the second conveying component, a detection box is arranged below the supporting plate in the fixed bin, and the output end of the second conveying component is communicated with the detection box. The application has the effects of reducing the long-term radiation environment of staff, shortening the sampling detection time and improving the sampling detection efficiency and the integrity.
