title_en: Clothing air permeability test equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses clothes air permeability testing equipment, which relates to the technical field of clothes air permeability testing, and comprises a center seat, wherein a carrier is arranged on the outer side of the center seat, an auxiliary fixing mechanism for fixing clothes is arranged on the carrier, the auxiliary fixing mechanism comprises an annular boss and a pressing assembly, the annular boss is fixed on the carrier, the position, close to the center, of the annular boss is raised upwards, an opening is formed in the middle of the annular boss, the opening penetrates through the annular boss and the carrier, the pressing assembly is used for pressing clothes on the annular boss, and a detection mechanism is arranged on the center seat. In the detection process, firstly, the clothing is paved above the annular boss, the clothing is pressed and fixed by the pressing assembly, the opening is shielded by the clothing, the vapor output mechanism conveys vapor into the opening, part of the vapor passes through the clothing, the detection mechanism detects the vapor passing through the clothing, and the air permeability of the clothing is judged based on the feedback data.

title_en: Preparation method and application of gellan gum base ion conductive hydrogel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of gellan gum base ion conductive hydrogel, which comprises the following steps of dissolving high-acyl gellan gum and low-acyl gellan gum in deionized water to obtain a pre-solution, stirring, freezing and thawing to obtain HLG hydrogel, immersing the HLG hydrogel in manganese compound solution, taking out after 1-3 h, washing with deionized water for several times to obtain GM hydrogel, placing the GM hydrogel in cross-linking agent solution for cross-linking for 1-24 h, taking out, and washing with deionized water for several times to obtain gellan gum base ion conductive hydrogel. The ion conductive hydrogel prepared by the invention not only has excellent mechanical properties, but also has good self-healing property, can accurately sense pressure and temperature differences, and has the potential of detecting human body movement and temperature in a self-powered flexible sensor.

title_en: Method for detecting ethylene glycol and diethylene glycol in aripiprazole oral solution
abstract_en: The invention name is as follows: summary of the detection method of ethylene glycol and diethylene glycol in aripiprazole oral solution: the invention provides a method for detecting glycol and diglycol in an aripiprazole oral solution, which is suitable for the technical field of detection of pharmaceutical oral preparations, in particular to the field of pharmaceutical quality control, and is a gas chromatography detection method for monitoring impurities and byproducts of pharmaceutical excipients, the method overcomes the limitation that no ultraviolet absorption method is adopted for glycol and diglycol, a sample solution is injected into a sample inlet through a microinjector, and is gasified instantly in a high-temperature gasification chamber, the invention increases sensitivity and accuracy, solves the problems of low detection efficiency and low precision, improves the separation degree and the detection efficiency by optimizing conditions such as column temperature, and the like. The method is suitable for detecting the ethylene glycol and the diethylene glycol in the aripiprazole oral solution, has the advantages of good separation degree, strong specificity, high precision and good repeatability, and meets the research of the method for measuring the ethylene glycol and the diethylene glycol in the aripiprazole oral solution.

title_en: Test device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a testing device which is used for testing a tested module, wherein the tested module comprises a body, a first terminal and a second terminal which are respectively arranged on two sides of the body, the testing device comprises a jig, a base and a first testing component, the first testing component comprises a capacitor, a first testing piece and a second testing piece, the first testing piece comprises a first crimping part which is horizontally arranged, the second testing piece comprises a second crimping part which is horizontally arranged, the second crimping part is stacked on the top surface of the first crimping part, and the length of the second crimping part is larger than that of the first crimping part. When the base is close to the bearing position, the first crimping part is crimped on the first terminal, and the second crimping part is crimped on the second terminal, so that the positive and negative terminals are matched with the tested modules arranged on the two sides of the body respectively, the low noise of the loop can be ensured, and the accuracy of the test result is ensured.

title_en: Transmission line ranging method based on three-dimensional point cloud and two-dimensional image mapping
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power transmission line ranging method based on mapping of three-dimensional point clouds and two-dimensional images, which comprises the steps of obtaining three-dimensional point cloud data of a power transmission line channel and two-dimensional images of a monitoring device, preprocessing the three-dimensional point cloud data to construct a three-dimensional space coordinate system, optimizing camera pose parameters of the monitoring device in an automatic/semi-automatic mode, accurately projecting the three-dimensional point clouds to a two-dimensional plane based on the optimized camera pose to achieve alignment and fusion with the two-dimensional images, accurately positioning the power transmission line position by utilizing the three-dimensional point cloud data on the basis, achieving positioning of hidden danger targets identified in the two-dimensional images in the three-dimensional space coordinate system by a back projection algorithm based on a ground intersection principle, further accurately calculating the shortest three-dimensional distance between the hidden danger targets and the power transmission line, and dividing a protection area and a risk level according to preset safety distances. The invention obviously improves the automation and precision level of the potential safety hazard ranging of the transmission line channel.

title_en: Data management device and operation method thereof
abstract_en: The data management apparatus according to the embodiments disclosed herein may include a data acquisition unit to acquire battery data including shadow battery data from a vehicle, a storage unit including a plurality of partitions and storing the battery data, and a controller to store the battery data in each of the plurality of partitions based on a generation time of generating the battery data in the vehicle, generate battery data corresponding to the generation time of the shadow battery data and temporary battery data including the shadow battery data among the battery data stored in the storage unit, and divide the temporary battery data to restore the divided temporary battery data in the partition corresponding to the generation time among the plurality of partitions.

title_en: Temperature and humidity controllable liquid drop evaporation experiment device and temperature and humidity adjusting method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a temperature and humidity controllable liquid drop evaporation experimental device and a temperature and humidity adjusting method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of complex multiphase flow systems and solution micro-phase thermal physical precision experimental instruments. The device comprises an air circuit system, a semi-open type pneumatic evaporation cavity, a precise micro-area liquid drop hanging device and a multichannel photoelectric heterogeneous data acquisition and recording system, wherein the air circuit system is used for environment reconstruction, and the micro-area liquid drop hanging device is arranged in the semi-open type pneumatic evaporation cavity to resist interference. The temperature and humidity regulation method adopts a thermodynamic state feedforward decoupling control path, namely reversely calculating saturated air dew point temperature corresponding to the target absolute moisture content according to the preset target temperature and humidity, forcing air flow to reach a high humidity state through a mixed humidifying device, guiding the air flow into a freezing dehumidifying device to be forcibly cooled to the dew point temperature, condensing and separating out moisture exceeding the saturated moisture content to lock the absolute moisture content of the air flow, and then carrying out equi-humidity heating on the air flow to the target dry bulb environment temperature through a gas heater. The invention also utilizes a high-speed orthogonal double-camera array to capture the tiny elastic deflection displacement of the metal suspension wire through a machine vision algorithm, and the non-contact inversion liquid drop mass attenuation data. The invention overcomes the defects of traditional humidity feedback regulation retardation, space layering, closed chamber waste gas enrichment and the like, can realize the high-precision in-situ synchronous measurement of multiple parameters such as mass loss rate, phase transition temperature, microcosmic appearance and the like in the whole evaporation life cycle of single liquid drops of complex solution under the stable convection boundary condition, and provides a high-end experimental platform support for spray drying and concentration theory CFD simulation modeling.

title_en: Cloud-edge cooperative lithium battery state-of-charge estimation method and system
abstract_en: The application provides a cloud-edge collaborative lithium battery state-of-charge estimation method and a cloud-edge collaborative lithium battery state-of-charge estimation system, which combine a mixed deep learning model with reliable safe time integral at an edge and cloud parameter optimization with a self-adaptive unscented Kalman filter to carry out state-of-charge estimation so as to realize high-precision and high-robustness state-of-charge estimation under wide temperature range and multiple working conditions and ensure basic safe operation capability of the system in network abnormality.

title_en: Liquid cooling battery pack flow thermal coupling evaluation method, device, terminal and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of battery evaluation and discloses a method, a device, a terminal and a storage medium for evaluating the flow thermal coupling of a liquid cooling battery pack, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a temperature field of the target liquid cooling battery pack under a target working condition and an interface heat flux field between a liquid cooling plate and the battery pack based on the thermal coupling simulation operation of the target liquid cooling battery pack; the method comprises the steps of dividing a contact interface of a liquid cooling plate and a battery pack into at least two geometrically continuous evaluation areas based on an interface heat flux field, determining corresponding relative heat flux performance coefficients based on area interface heat fluxes of all the evaluation areas, determining a weak heat dissipation attention area according to all the coefficients, determining dominant physical mechanism types of heat dissipation bottlenecks of the attention area based on a cooling liquid temperature field and a liquid cooling plate temperature field which correspond to the attention area and a reference area respectively, and obtaining a target attribution conclusion for the attention area by combining the relation between flow channel densities of the attention area and the reference area.

title_en: Gamma ray prediction method based on well deviation constraint type mechanical specific energy
abstract_en: The invention provides a gamma ray prediction method based on well deviation constraint type mechanical specific energy, which aims at the measurement hysteresis problem caused by the position difference of a logging while drilling instrument and a drill bit, constructs well deviation constraint type mechanical specific energy, combines drilling engineering data to realize accurate prediction of gamma data, breaks through the limitation that the traditional method only depends on a small amount of logging features, and can more comprehensively reflect stratum characteristics and drilling working condition information by introducing multidimensional engineering parameter modeling. The model adopts an encoder-decoder neural network based on a self-attention mechanism to carry out global association modeling and self-adaptive weight distribution on input features, so that high-efficiency compensation prediction on lag gamma data is realized. The method can adapt to the working condition of complex stratum, effectively reduce the risk of drilling operation, improve the safety and efficiency of the operation, and provide efficient and reliable technical support for logging while drilling and on-site drilling decisions.

title_en: Analysis method, system, equipment and medium for cementing and friction in process of shearing reservoir rock-soil mass
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geotechnical engineering, in particular to a method, a system, equipment and a medium for analyzing cementing and friction effects in a shotcrete mass shearing process of a reservoir bank, which comprise the steps of constructing a microcosmic cementing-friction decoupling model, generalizing a shearing surface into a microcosmic system consisting of a cementing unit and a friction unit, and defining a microcosmic constitutive relation of the cementing unit and the friction unit and a statistical association relation of the cementing unit and the friction unit on the macroscopic shearing surface; calibrating parameters in the microcosmic cementing-friction decoupling model based on macroscopic shear stress-shear displacement relation data to obtain a calibrated decoupling model, and calculating and separating a cementing stress component evolution curve corresponding to cementing action and a friction stress component evolution curve corresponding to friction action in the whole shear displacement process by using the calibrated decoupling model. The invention has the beneficial effects of providing a scientific basis for establishing a more accurate rock-soil strength theory and guiding more refined stability design and analysis of reservoir engineering.

title_en: Soil layer intensity detection mechanism suitable for foundation ditch slip casting is consolidated
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of soil layer reinforcement detection, and discloses a soil layer strength detection mechanism suitable for foundation pit grouting reinforcement, which comprises a protection cylinder; the soil sample detection device comprises a supporting mechanism, a positioning plate, a locking piece, a driving piece, a detection steel needle fixedly connected to the bottom of the positioning plate, a protection cylinder extending out of the lower end of the detection steel needle, and a sampling groove arranged at the lower end of the detection steel needle and used for allowing a soil sample to enter in the process that the detection steel needle penetrates through a soil layer to be detected. According to the invention, the first spring in the power storage state is instantaneously stretched to push the measuring steel needle to penetrate into the soil layer to be detected, the strength of soil layer reinforcement can be known according to the penetrating depth, the soil sample can enter the sampling groove for storage in the process of penetrating the measuring steel needle into the soil layer, and the soil sample can be brought out when the measuring steel needle is taken out from the soil layer, so that soil layer strength detection and soil sampling can be finished at the same time, and the overall detection efficiency is greatly improved.

title_en: Method for measuring migration quantity of antioxidant in low-temperature solid grease
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for measuring migration quantity of an antioxidant in low-temperature solid grease. The method comprises the steps of measuring initial content of a target antioxidant in a food contact material, closely attaching a food contact surface of the material to a grease layer which can keep geometric form and can be sliced and layered at a migration temperature, migrating at-20 ℃ to 0 ℃, freezing and slicing the material according to the distance between the grease layer and the surface of the material under the condition that the migration temperature is less than or equal to 0 ℃ after the migration is finished, obtaining grease samples in different distance intervals, extracting each sample at least twice by acetonitrile, carrying out centrifugal phase separation, standing at-20 ℃ to remove grease, filtering, detecting by adopting GC-MS/SIM, and subtracting and calculating migration quantity in each distance interval by matching an external standard curve with a blank matrix. The method can obtain the layering migration result of the antioxidant under the condition of keeping the space structure of the low-temperature solid grease, and is suitable for migration detection of the antioxidant such as BHT in the refrigerating or freezing fat food packaging material.

title_en: Insulation aging evaluation method and device for high-voltage circuit breaker
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-voltage circuit breaker insulation aging evaluation method and device, which comprise the steps of determining an evaluation factor set, wherein the evaluation factor set comprises electrical characteristic parameters and physical and chemical characteristic parameters, obtaining actual measurement data values of to-be-evaluated high-voltage circuit breaker insulation pieces corresponding to all parameters in the evaluation factor set, determining a weight coefficient of each parameter in the evaluation factor set by adopting an objective weighting method based on the actual measurement data values of all parameters to form a weight set, determining membership degrees of each parameter to all comment grades in a preset comment set according to the actual measurement data values of each parameter and preset membership functions, constructing a fuzzy relation matrix based on all membership degrees, carrying out fuzzy synthesis operation on the weight set and the fuzzy relation matrix to obtain a comprehensive evaluation result vector, and determining the comment grade corresponding to the maximum membership degree in the comprehensive evaluation result vector as the aging evaluation grade of the high-voltage circuit breaker insulation pieces according to the maximum membership degree principle. The insulation aging state of the high-voltage circuit breaker is accurately estimated.

title_en: Compression-resistant detection device and method based on wood board processing
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of compression resistance detection and discloses a compression resistance detection device and method based on wood board processing. The device comprises a calibration module, an acquisition module, a differential module and a resolving module, wherein the differential module comprises a construction unit, a differential unit and an analysis unit, and the calibration, the acquisition, the differential analysis and the wave velocity resolving are sequentially executed by the modules and the units to obtain a three-way anisotropic compressive capacity map of the wood board. The application improves the accuracy of the compression-resistant detection conclusion of the wood board on the representation of the mechanical property under the actual processing working condition.

title_en: Online water quality monitoring system and monitoring method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water quality online monitoring system and a monitoring method thereof, relates to the technical field of water quality monitoring, and solves the problem that the existing water quality online monitoring system only focuses on monitoring precision and system energy consumption and ignores the quantitative relation between sampling frequency and sensor service life. The system comprises a sampling unit, a plurality of water quality sensors, a control unit, a data transmission unit and a power supply unit, wherein a three-dimensional dynamic balance optimization module is arranged in the control unit, three independent optimization targets of monitoring precision, system energy consumption and sensor service life are established, a service life loss standing book is established for each sensor, the optimal independent sampling frequency is calculated, and a water quality abnormality grading judgment module, a service life loss dynamic compensation module and an algorithm self-learning module are also arranged in the control unit. The invention can effectively reduce the energy consumption of the system, prolong the service life of the sensor and improve the stability and adaptability of the system operation on the premise of ensuring the monitoring precision, and is suitable for continuous real-time on-line monitoring of various water bodies.

title_en: Domestic AI energized remote sensing cloud edge collaborative water quality monitoring device and data processing method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water quality monitoring, in particular to a domestic AI energized remote sensing cloud edge cooperative water quality monitoring device and a data processing method, wherein the device comprises a remote sensing monitoring module, an edge computing module and a cloud processing module which are sequentially connected in a communication way, and a cloud edge bidirectional cooperative computing architecture is constructed; the method comprises four core steps of data acquisition, edge pretreatment, cloud edge collaborative AI analysis and layered data management, and integrates an improved LSTM water quality prediction algorithm with a attention mechanism and an isolated forest anomaly detection algorithm to realize full-link localization AI adaptation. The intelligent monitoring system can realize high-efficiency and accurate monitoring of a large-scale water body, remarkably improves the prediction precision of water quality parameters and the response speed of abnormal events, is suitable for monitoring water quality in multiple scenes such as rivers, lakes, oceans and the like, and provides stable, autonomous and controllable technical support for intelligent supervision of water environment.

title_en: Method for detecting weld joint consistency of frame of children electric scooter
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of weld joint detection and discloses a method for detecting the weld joint consistency of a frame of a children electric scooter, which comprises the steps of obtaining basic data of the frame of the children electric scooter and obtaining frame structure reference information; the method comprises the steps of collecting multisource detection data of a frame to be detected to obtain original acquisition information of a welding line, carrying out posture correction on the original acquisition information of the welding line to obtain frame coordinate detection information, carrying out welding line consistency feature extraction on the frame coordinate detection information to obtain geometric consistency feature of the welding line, and carrying out load sensitive area marking on reference information of a frame structure to obtain information of a load sensitive area of the welding line. According to the invention, by adopting the technical schemes of posture correction, coordinate conversion and deviation compensation based on the frame structural reference, the technical effects of distinguishing clamping posture deviation, post-welding micro-deformation and abnormal consistency of a real welding line are achieved, accurate detection of the welding line relative to the frame stress reference is realized, and the defect that the fixed template detection is easy to misjudge and miss-judge is overcome.

title_en: Inspection apparatus and method for detecting defects in electrode tabs of electrode assemblies
abstract_en: An inspection device for detecting defects in an electrode tab of an electrode assembly, wherein the electrode tab is disposed at a longitudinal end of the electrode assembly. The inspection device includes a radiation emitting device configured to emit x-rays or beta-rays toward the electrode tabs, and a radiation measuring device disposed opposite the radiation emitting device so as to position the electrode tabs therebetween. The radiation measurement device is configured to measure an amount of x-rays or beta rays transmitted through the electrode tab. The inspection apparatus further includes a processor configured to process a signal corresponding to the measured amount of x-rays or beta-rays and determine a defect if the measured amount of x-rays or beta-rays at the portion within the electrode tab shows a decrease by a predetermined threshold or more compared to a reference value.

title_en: Uncertainty assessment method for temperature and humidity of automobile battery compartment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to an uncertainty assessment method and storage medium for temperature and humidity of an automobile battery compartment, wherein the uncertainty assessment method for temperature and humidity of the automobile battery compartment is characterized in that temperature and humidity data sets of a plurality of time sequences are obtained through sampling the temperature and the humidity, probability density estimation functions of the temperature and the humidity of a target time sequence are calculated respectively, posterior distribution sampling results of the temperature and the humidity corresponding to the last time sequence are obtained, posterior distribution information of the temperature is obtained based on the posterior distribution sampling results of the temperature corresponding to the last time sequence and the probability density estimation functions of the temperature of the target time sequence, uncertainty of the corresponding temperature is obtained based on the posterior distribution information of the temperature, and uncertainty of the corresponding humidity is obtained based on the posterior distribution information of the humidity. The method can fully utilize the measurement data information of the temperature and the humidity of different time sequences, and improves the accuracy of uncertainty assessment of the measurement data of the temperature and the humidity of the battery compartment of the automobile.

title_en: Dynamic measurement and state evaluation method for power of rotary driving unit
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mechanical transmission energy characterization and discloses a dynamic measurement and state evaluation method of rotary drive unit power, which comprises the steps of synchronously collecting phase voltage and phase current of a prime executive end and double-end pulse signals of a mechanical conduction path, determining transient torsion angle deviation according to pulse count value deviation, determining relaxation parameters representing internal physical hysteresis characteristics by using deviation change gradients, establishing a dynamic model, correcting torsional rigidity through the relaxation parameters, deconstructing transient mechanical transmission power after subtracting inertia and correction components, calculating power residual error and time domain integration, generating a physical fatigue evaluation index.

title_en: System and method for detecting defects of wafer with multiple types of light sources
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for detecting wafer defects by multiple types of light sources, which relate to the technical field of wafer defect detection and comprise a light source module; the device comprises a plurality of paths of illumination light beams, an optical modulation module, an imaging acquisition module and a signal processing module, wherein the optical modulation module is arranged in the light paths of the plurality of paths of illumination light beams, the optical modulation module is used for respectively applying carrier modulation with different spatial frequencies and/or different directions to each path of illumination light beam so as to convert each path of illumination light beam into a plurality of paths of structure light and irradiate the structure light onto a detection area on the surface of a wafer to be detected at different preset incidence angles, the imaging acquisition module is used for receiving detection light signals generated by different structure light from the detection area and acquiring a first detection image, and the signal processing module is in communication connection with the imaging acquisition module. By adopting the scheme, the optical path crosstalk generated by multi-optical path detection can be fundamentally avoided while the detection efficiency is improved.

title_en: Harmonic source positioning method and device for electric automobile charging pile and computer equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to a harmonic source positioning method, a harmonic source positioning device, computer equipment, a computer readable storage medium and a computer program product of an electric automobile charging pile. The method comprises the steps of dividing a distribution network area into a preset number of distribution network subareas based on detection points on the distribution network area of a target automobile charging pile, taking the distribution subarea with the highest priority in the current distribution network subarea set positioned at the current time as a target area, constructing a plurality of candidate harmonic source sets based on the detection points in the target area, calculating a harmonic injection current sequence of each candidate harmonic source based on a transfer matrix for each candidate harmonic source set, calculating mutual information confidence of the candidate harmonic source sets based on the harmonic injection current sequence of each candidate harmonic source, and positioning the target harmonic source set of the target area from the plurality of candidate harmonic source sets based on the mutual information confidence of each candidate harmonic source set. The method can be used for positioning the harmonic source of the electric vehicle charging pile.

title_en: Monitor for AFDX exchanger
abstract_en: The invention discloses a monitor for an AFDX switch, which is embedded into the AFDX switch as an independent functional unit and comprises a power supply monitoring module, a temperature monitoring module, a watchdog reset module, a state reporting module and a microcontroller. The system comprises a power supply monitoring module, a temperature monitoring module, a watchdog reset module, a state reporting module and a network management system, wherein the power supply monitoring module is used for monitoring power supply voltages of all paths in a switch and judging threshold values, the temperature monitoring module is used for collecting working temperatures of key chips in the switch, the watchdog reset module is used for monitoring the running state of a microcontroller program and generating a reset signal when the microcontroller program is abnormal, and the state reporting module is used for collecting running state information of the switch and reporting the running state information to the network management system. The invention realizes three self-test mechanisms of power-on self-test, continuous self-test and initialization self-test through the built-in ADC, timer and communication peripheral of the microcontroller, provides comprehensive monitoring function for the AFDX switch, and has high safety, real-time performance and reliability.

title_en: Image acquisition method and device for transparent cylinder surface printing quality detection
abstract_en: The invention discloses an image acquisition method and device for detecting printing quality on the surface of a transparent cylinder, and relates to the technical field of quality detection, wherein the method comprises the steps of horizontally placing a bottle to be detected on a rotary roller mechanism to be fixed and driving the bottle to rotate at a constant speed; the light source and the acquisition module are arranged on the same side of the bottle body to be detected, the light beam emitted by the light source obliquely irradiates the bottle body to be detected in rotation, the acquisition module synchronously acquires images, a corresponding area is selected from the acquired images to serve as an acquisition position according to the color characteristics of the bottle body to be detected, the area where the front wall light band is located is selected if the bottle body is transparent or light-colored, a dark background area outside the front wall light band is selected if the bottle body is dark-colored, and the acquisition module acquires the selected acquisition position row by row and splices to obtain a printing unfolding two-dimensional image of one circle of the surface of the bottle body to be detected. The invention can effectively eliminate shadow and ghost interference and improve detection efficiency.

title_en: Calibration method and system for laser wind-finding radar platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a calibration method and a system of a laser wind-finding radar platform, belonging to the technical field of laser wind-finding calibration, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring an orthogonal wind vector component original data set, a platform motion interference component original data set and a beam space geometric configuration based on the laser wind-finding radar platform; and if the residual norm is smaller than a preset residual threshold value and the signal-to-noise ratio level is larger than the preset signal-to-noise ratio threshold, marking the initial three-dimensional wind vector components as effective three-dimensional wind vector components, integrating the effective three-dimensional wind vector components into a continuous three-dimensional wind field data sequence, and completing the calibration of the laser wind-finding radar platform. The calibration method of the laser wind-finding radar platform provided by the invention can realize real-time calibration of the laser wind-finding radar platform.

title_en: Adjustable cyclone anti-winding protection device of hydrological sensor
abstract_en: The invention discloses an adjustable cyclone anti-winding protection device of a hydrological sensor, which relates to the field of hydrological surveying and comprises an outer shield and a sensor mounting seat, wherein an annular cyclone separation assembly is arranged in the outer shield, a water inlet end of the outer shield is provided with a diversion anti-winding inlet assembly, the adjustable cyclone anti-winding protection device also comprises a sand setting bin, a sand blocking backflow baffle plate and a one-way sand discharging assembly, the inner side walls of the annular cyclone separation assembly are combined to form a central steady flow measurement area, the sensor mounting seat is arranged in the outer shield and limits a hydrological sensor probe in the central steady flow measurement area, the annular cyclone separation assembly is used for adjusting the tangential inflow state of water flow, and water and sediment are separated by virtue of cyclone.

title_en: LIBS instrument for brine detection and detection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a LIBS instrument and a detection method for brine detection, and belongs to the technical field of liquid sample spectrum detection equipment. The method comprises the steps of 1, a pretreatment stage of a brine sample, wherein stirring torque parameters are regulated and controlled to control liquid splashing and liquid vortex of the brine sample and avoid crystal precipitation, a coaxial annular cover slip is arranged, electromagnetic vibration amplitude is controlled to enable liquid level fluctuation to be 0.1-0.5 mm, 2, a LIBS spectrum signal acquisition stage is used for linking a spectrum signal with the stirring torque and the electromagnetic vibration amplitude in real time, parameter mapping is established, synchronous acquisition is triggered and an average value is taken as a spectrum to be analyzed when the spectrum is normal, a pretreatment stage of spectrum data is obtained, a pretreatment spectrum is obtained, and an element quantitative analysis stage is used for obtaining an element content analysis result containing control parameters.

title_en: Adaptive laser inertial navigation SLAM method based on wavelet multi-scale sensing
abstract_en: The invention provides a self-adaptive laser inertial navigation SLAM method based on wavelet multi-scale sensing, and relates to the technical field of positioning and navigation. The method comprises the steps of collecting laser radar point cloud data and inertial measurement unit data, carrying out feature extraction after preprocessing, constructing an environment observation vector according to the preprocessed data and geometric features, carrying out wavelet multi-scale decomposition in a fixed-length time window to obtain a low-frequency trend item and a high-frequency disturbance item, obtaining an environment state according to the low-frequency trend item in a trend channel, obtaining a mutation mark according to the high-frequency disturbance item in a disturbance channel, generating self-adaptive execution parameters, carrying out frame pose tracking and point cloud map correction of a key frame, maintaining a local key frame and a local point cloud map, and outputting an optimized six-degree-of-freedom pose and a consistent environment map. The invention can realize high-robustness pose estimation and environment mapping under the condition of lacking an external positioning reference or unstable external positioning signals.

title_en: Filling spiral cover aluminum foil sealing detection method and equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and equipment for detecting an aluminum foil seal by filling and screwing, and belongs to the technical field of aluminum foil seal detection. The utility model provides a filling spiral cover aluminium foil seals check out test set includes preprocessing module, multisource detection module, intelligent decision module, defect processing module, closed loop feedback module, self-maintenance module and off-line verification module, through adopting multisensor information fusion algorithm, integrate four kinds of detection data of infrared temperature measurement, machine vision, high frequency impedance, micro vacuum, through layering fusion and dynamic weight adjustment, carry out outward appearance, butt fusion and sealed tertiary verification, effectively cover various defects such as aluminium foil loss, damage, micro virtual seal, micro leakage, adopt diffuse reflection coaxial light source and low angle annular light source to combine simultaneously, effectively restrain aluminium foil high reflection of light, transparent bottle refraction ghost and bottleneck residual droplet interference, simultaneously, the infrared differential temperature measurement technique of multiband combines adjustable delay to carry control, enlarge weak difference in temperature, accurate discernment micro virtual seal and micro crack.

title_en: Battery cell diagnosis method and diagnosis device
abstract_en: The invention provides a battery cell diagnosis method and a diagnosis device capable of grasping an internal state for each battery cell. The battery pack heats the plurality of battery cells by ripple current in a state where the plurality of battery cells are not charged or discharged, calculates resistance values at a plurality of frequencies, estimates a positive resistance value and a negative resistance value based on relation information indicating a relation between the resistance values at the time of ac impedance obtained in advance and frequencies of the positive resistance reaction region and the negative resistance reaction region, and the calculated resistance values, and diagnoses the respective states of the plurality of battery cells based on the positive resistance value and the negative resistance value.

title_en: Device and method for detecting total manganese water quality and removing manganese by adding chemicals
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a method for detecting total manganese water quality and adding medicine to remove manganese, which belong to the technical field of detection of total manganese concentration in water, wherein the device comprises a treatment tank, a water inlet end and a water outlet end of the treatment tank are respectively provided with a total manganese water quality detection mechanism, and the treatment tank is connected with a medicine adding pump with a medicine adding control module; the total manganese water quality detection mechanism comprises a connecting pipeline, wherein a total manganese water quality detection assembly and a flowmeter are arranged on the connecting pipeline, the total manganese water quality detection assembly comprises a submersible total manganese detection probe, a lifting structure, a self-cleaning structure, a signal processing and communication module, a data diagnosis module and a detection control module, and the submersible total manganese detection probe comprises a sampling cavity, a filtering cavity and a detection cavity which are sequentially connected in series, wherein a manganese ion detection sensor is arranged in the detection cavity. The invention can solve the problems that the existing total manganese water quality analyzer can not realize the direct immersion detection of the sensor probe, the measurement response is lagged and the detection precision is reduced due to the water film interference on the surface of the sensor.

title_en: Linear motor open-circuit fault ride-through method based on space characteristic temporary unlocking
abstract_en: The invention discloses a linear motor open-circuit fault ride-through method based on space characteristic temporary unlocking and belongs to the technical field of electromagnetic propulsion. Aiming at the problems that the sectional power supply linear motor is frequently switched and is easy to break down under the ultra-high speed working condition, and the traditional protection strategy is difficult to distinguish temporary faults from permanent faults, the fault crossing method based on the rotor space position and the current monitoring is provided. The method comprises the steps of executing temporary locking on a fault section according to the position of a rotor when an overcurrent fault is detected, judging a secondary state at the time of power supply switching, judging as a permanent fault and executing permanent locking if the fault is continuous and accumulated to reach a preset number of times, and otherwise, recovering normal power supply. The invention realizes the accurate identification and classification processing of faults, ensures the continuous operation of the system under most fault conditions, and remarkably improves the fault tolerance capability and the operation reliability of the piecewise power supply linear motor under the ultra-high speed working condition.

title_en: Signal processing method and system
abstract_en: The application provides a signal processing method and a system, relating to the signal processing technology; the method comprises the steps of determining a first echo signal and a second echo signal based on echo signals of a mixed signal after target reflection, wherein the mixed signal comprises a conventional linear frequency modulation continuous wave signal and a frequency stepping linear frequency modulation continuous wave signal, determining a distance fine estimation result and peak energy under each velocity hypothesis based on compensation of the second echo signal and synthesis of a one-dimensional high-resolution range image for each velocity hypothesis, determining each velocity hypothesis based on a system speed measurement requirement and a rough estimation result obtained by processing the first echo signal, determining a deviation between the distance fine estimation result and a distance rough estimation result in the rough estimation result based on the peak energy, and determining a distance estimation value and/or a velocity estimation value of the target from each velocity hypothesis. According to the application, the target estimation precision can be effectively improved while the long-distance high-resolution detection is realized.

title_en: Coal seam floor water inrush probability imaging method based on microseismic wake signals
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal seam floor water inrush probability imaging method based on microseismic wake signals, and belongs to the field of coal mine water damage monitoring and geophysical imaging. The method comprises the steps of firstly collecting and screening effective microseismic events of a bottom plate, determining a wake wave time window and extracting dispersion characteristics, constructing a dimensionless dispersion response index which is positively correlated with the opening of a water-containing fracture, carrying out extremum normalization processing on the dispersion response indexes of all the effective microseismic events in an evaluation area to obtain relative water guide indication indexes, associating the space coordinates of each effective microseismic event with the corresponding relative water guide indication indexes to construct a space discrete data set, and generating a continuous bottom plate water inrush probability distribution image through space interpolation. According to the method, the crack parameters do not need to be accurately inverted, the influence of the difference of observation conditions can be effectively reduced, discrete single event evaluation is converted into continuous imaging of the region, the water inrush dangerous region is intuitively defined, and the method is suitable for dynamic evaluation and prevention and control of the water inrush probability of the coal seam floor under the complex mining condition.

title_en: Nut guaranteed load pressing test fixture
abstract_en: The utility model provides a nut guarantees load and presses to test fixture. The nut guarantees that load pressure includes to test fixture: a base; the universal testing machine body is fixed at the top of the base; the device comprises a compression device and a base plate, wherein the compression device comprises a compression block and a base plate, the top of the compression block is provided with a groove, the bottom of the base plate is fixedly connected with a vertical rod, one side of the base plate is fixedly connected with a handle, and the top of the base plate is provided with an installation groove; the nut, the nut set up in on the mounting groove, the recess with the montant is provided with a plurality ofly altogether, and it is a plurality of the recess respectively with a plurality of montant looks adaptation. The utility model provides a nut guarantees that load presses to the top of test fixture nut and is located the top of backing plate, pushes down the nut through the universal tester body and carries out the load experiment to the nut, adopts to press to experiment, has avoided the phenomenon that the screw installation is unchangeable and skidded.

title_en: Three-axis force value detection sensor
abstract_en: The utility model provides a three-axis force value detection sensor, which comprises an elastic body, wherein the upper part and the lower part of the elastic body are provided with connecting structures for connecting with a detected object; the sensor is characterized in that a through hole is formed in the center of the elastic body, so that the bending resistance of the sensor is ensured; the strain area is arranged between the upper connecting structure and the lower connecting structure and is in a cylindrical shape, and strain gauges are attached to the outer wall of the through hole of the strain area and comprise a first group of strain gauges for measuring force in the horizontal direction and a second group of strain gauges for measuring force forming a certain angle with the horizontal plane. The utility model discloses can effectually detect the real-time dynamic all-directional stress state of measured object, simple to operate again.

title_en: Nitrogen fixation enzyme activity measuring device improved by acetylene reduction method
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a nitrogenase activity measuring device improved by an acetylene reduction method, which comprises a sealed reaction bottle, wherein the mouth of the sealed reaction bottle is provided with an isobutyl rubber plug, a gas sample inlet pipe and a nutrient solution sample inlet pipe are fixed on the isobutyl rubber plug, the gas sample inlet pipe is sequentially connected with a first valve and a second valve, and the other end of the gas sample inlet pipe is communicated with an injector through a rubber plug; the nutrient solution sampling pipe is sequentially provided with a third valve and a multi-connection pipe valve; the multi-connection pipe valve is connected with a nutrient solution bottle; the sealed reaction bottle is positioned in the porous heat-preservation type vibration plastic component. The utility model solves the problem of air leakage caused by pinholes in the process of measuring the activity of azotase, reduces the system error of each reaction system and improves the reproducibility of experimental results; meanwhile, due to the design of the multi-joint valve, an operator can finish more sample pretreatment in batches within a certain time, and the experimental efficiency is improved.

title_en: Peristaltic pump type intelligent inspection and sampling device

title_en: Rotary electromagnetic sensor for measuring rotating speed of new energy automobile motor
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rotary electromagnetic sensor for measuring rotating speed of a new energy automobile motor, an inner stator iron core is arranged in a shell, a rotating shaft is arranged in the inner stator iron core, an outer stator iron core output winding is also arranged on the shell, two sides of the shell are respectively connected with a mounting plate, the upper end and the lower end in the shell are respectively provided with a first annular groove, and a first sliding block is connected in the first annular groove in a sliding manner; the utility model discloses a make further improvement to prior art, reach the effect that gives sound insulation, insulate against heat, ventilate the heat extraction, set up the inner panel in the casing, and the inner panel can be at the casing internal rotation, the rotation process is smooth and easy, first slider slides in first annular during the rotation, the inboard heat of casing passes through fan work and passes through ventilation assembly with the heat and discharge, it discharges in getting into first ventilation pipe to get into the second ventilation pipe through the third ventilation pipe earlier, avoid leading to internal fault because of this sensor operational environment is overheated.

title_en: Single-measuring-line gradient measuring device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a single measuring line gradient measuring device, which belongs to the mechanical field, and comprises a scale display device (1) fixedly connected with an object to be measured, wherein the scale display device (1) is provided with a gradient pointing device (2) which keeps a vertical state, the gradient pointing device (2) sequentially comprises a gradient pointer (22), a connecting rod (23) and a gravity weight balancer (24) from top to bottom, the bottom end of the gradient pointer (22) is detachably connected with the top end of the connecting rod (23), the bottom end of the connecting rod (23) is detachably connected with the top end of the gravity weight balancer (24), the inclination pointer (22), the connecting rod (23) and the gravity weight device (24) are positioned on the same central line, the bottom end of the inclination pointer (22) is positioned at the circle center position of the scale display device (1), and the pointer of the inclination pointer (22) falls in the scale of the scale display device (1). The device is simple and convenient to install, low in cost and simple to operate.

title_en: Portable ultraviolet flue gas analyzer
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a portable ultraviolet flue gas analyzer, including sampler and handheld detection body, handheld detection body is connected with the handheld handle of sampler, the front end of handheld handle is equipped with the sampling tube, still includes connecting piece, mounting, the mounting is used for connecting piece and sampling tube fastening connection, the surface of connecting piece front end is equipped with the toper screw thread, the connecting piece is equipped with the through-hole that is used for the sampling tube to pass along the axial direction of toper screw thread. Can be fixed in the sampling tube in the thief hole of flue gas emission pipeline through the connecting piece, need not to hold the sampler for a long time among the exhaust-gas detection process, and the connecting piece is fixed with flue gas emission pipeline and the dismouting mode is simple swift.

title_en: Ultrasonic phased array welding seam detection scanning frame
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an ultrasonic phased array welding seam detection scanning frame, which comprises a bracket, a scanner is arranged at the upper end of the bracket, a base is fixed on the upper surface of the bracket, grooves are arranged on the left side surface and the right side surface of the base, a driving component is arranged in the base, the driving component comprises a motor, the back side surface of the motor is fixed with the front side surface of the inner wall of the base, a slider moves towards the inside of a shell, a spring is in a compression state at the moment, the slider moves towards the inside of the shell and drives the lower end of a cross rod to move towards the center of the shell, the cross rod rotates through a round rod, so that one end of a top plate moves downwards through the rotation of the cross rod, the cross rod at the other end still supports the top plate, the top plate is in an inclined state, the detected workpiece drops through the trapezoid of the groove, and the detected workpiece drops by itself through the mode, compared with the traditional manual taking mode, the device can drop by itself when in use, more editing is used.

title_en: Semi-automatic hole plugging detection device for through hole and blind hole of watch case
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a semi-automatic stifled hole detection device of watch case through-hole and blind hole, include: a first detection structure including a first transmission unit for passing through a first through hole of a watch case and a first reception unit for passing through a second through hole of the watch case, the first reception unit and the first transmission unit forming a correlation angle; the sensing insert pin, the one end of sensing insert pin is used for being connected with the light touch switch, the other end of sensing insert pin is used for imbedding the first blind hole of watch casing. Use the utility model discloses, can effectively promote the detection efficiency whether stifled hole of watch case through-hole and blind hole.

title_en: Multi-beam sonar signal emission probe structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multi-beam sonar signal emission probe structure, which comprises two fixed plates which are symmetrically arranged, wherein one sides of the upper ends of the two fixed plates are connected through a shaft lever, a rotating plate is fixedly penetrated on the shaft lever and is of a hollow structure, a limiting component is arranged in the hollow structure, the bottom end of the rotating plate is fixedly connected with a connecting rod, the bottom end of the connecting rod is fixedly connected with a mounting plate, a protection component is arranged below the mounting plate, and the bottom end of the mounting plate is also provided with a probe; drive the rotor plate through the axostylus axostyle and rotate, when the probe is out of work, can accomodate the probe between two fixed plates, avoided the probe to receive the collision of external object of hull and damage, through the spacing subassembly that sets up, can wholly fix mounting structure when the probe is accomodate, also can examine time measuring when needs, with mounting structure monolithic stationary in the fixed plate upper end, through being provided with protective assembly, examine time measuring at the probe, protect the filtration to the granule impurity in the water, thereby can protect the probe.

title_en: Air leakage detection device of filter screen
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a gas leakage detection device of a filter screen, which comprises a smoke generator, a smoke pipeline, a support piece and an illumination component, wherein a cavity is arranged in the support piece; the lighting assembly is suitable for irradiating light rays to the filter screen so as to observe whether smoke flows out of the cavity through the filter screen. According to the utility model discloses a detection gas leakage device of filter screen can observe the filter screen more directly perceivedly, conveniently whether there is the condition of leaking the cigarette, consequently can the short-term test assess the leakproofness of filter screen or whether qualified filterable effect, and can assess the leakproofness or the filterable effect of filter screen through the naked eye, if the filter screen is unqualified, can be directly perceived quick measure the dew point of filter screen, and can effectively prevent the smog condensation, improved the reliability that detects.

title_en: Geological survey device of fetching earth
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a geological survey soil sampling device, which comprises a drill rod, a pressing component and a rotating component, wherein the pressing component is arranged on the outer wall of the top end of the rotating component, and the rotating component is arranged on the pressing component; the outer walls of two sides of the drill rod are welded with frames, the outer walls of two sides of each frame are respectively provided with a first sliding chute, the inner walls of two sides of each first sliding chute are movably provided with a square sliding rod, the outer wall of the bottom end, located in the first sliding chute, of each square sliding rod is welded with a spring, the bottom end of each spring is welded to the inner wall of the bottom end of each first sliding chute, one end, located outside the first sliding chute, of each square sliding rod is welded with a first handle, and the two sides, located below the first sliding chutes, of each frame are welded with second handles; the utility model discloses the subassembly and the rotating assembly of pressing down that set up, simple structure, convenient operation, the task of fetching earth can be accomplished to only needing a staff to be convenient for, has practiced thrift operation and labour cost, and this equipment volume ratio is less, and it is more convenient to carry.

title_en: Portable test paper detection box
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a portable test paper detection box, which relates to the technical field of test paper detection boxes and comprises a lifting handle and a rubber head dropper, wherein the inner side of one end of the lifting handle is connected with a detection frame through a bearing, a waste collection frame is arranged at the bottom of the detection frame, an infiltration frame and the rubber head dropper are respectively embedded and placed at the two sides of the top of the detection frame, and a test paper box is embedded and placed at one end of the middle part of the detection frame; the waste collection frame comprises a waste drawer, a containing bin, a magnetic sheet, a round through groove and an armature sheet, the containing bin is arranged at one end of the bottom of the waste collection frame, the magnetic sheet is arranged on the inner side of one end of the containing bin, the round through groove is arranged at the top of the containing bin, and the armature sheet is arranged on the outer side of one end of the waste drawer; the test paper soaking speed of the detected solution in a large area can be improved, and the detection efficiency is improved; moreover, the paint can be recycled, so that the use cost is reduced; meanwhile, waste can be collected, and the desktop of the workbench is prevented from being polluted.

title_en: Oil gas pipeline defect internal detection device based on magnetic field compensation effect
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of auxiliary devices for oil gas pipeline detection, in particular to an oil gas pipeline defect internal detection device based on magnetic field compensation effect, which comprises a supporting seat, a universal metal hose and a detecting head assembling seat, wherein the front position of the supporting seat is fixedly connected with one end of the universal metal hose, and the other end of the universal metal hose is fixedly connected with the detecting head assembling seat; the outer wall of the supporting seat is provided with four self-locking expansion brackets, the end face positions of the four self-locking expansion brackets are connected with guide wheels through support rotation, and the back face position of the supporting seat is fixedly connected with a detection host through a signal line. According to the internal diameter of the pipeline to be measured, the length of the self-locking expansion bracket is adjusted and fixed relative to the supporting seat until the guide wheel is attached to the inner wall of the pipeline, the detection probe installed on the detection head assembling seat is not easy to wear and impact with the inner wall of the pipeline when moving, and the using effect is improved.

title_en: Soil sampler special for monitoring heavy metals in soil
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a soil borrowing technical field discloses a special geotome of soil heavy metal monitoring, in order to improve the nimble usability of geotome for soil heavy metal monitoring, the outside of transmission casing is located port position department embedding and is provided with pressing means, the below of transmission casing is located middle part position department embedding and is fixed with a feeding section of thick bamboo, and the below of transmission casing is located border position department symmetrical embedding and is connected with the feed cylinder that gathers materials, the top embedding block of a feeding section of thick bamboo has rotatory feed cylinder. The utility model discloses have nimble portable mobility, can be convenient for the staff and carry the use, carry out the sample detection work to the soil of different positions, and at the in-process of fetching earth, through staff control pressing mechanism, can be convenient for the staff to carry out nimble work of fetching earth to soil, simultaneously through the elastic combination of relief spring and location sliding sleeve among the pressing mechanism, can make the staff in time sense the hard thing in the soil and exist.

title_en: Sample dyeing device for rapid on-site evaluation
abstract_en: A specimen staining device for rapid on-site evaluation comprises a staining tank, a push plate and a slide fixing groove, wherein the slide fixing groove is supported on the push plate, and the push plate can slide in the staining tank and drive the slide fixing groove to slide; a dyeing liquid containing tank is arranged in the dyeing tank, and a through slide rail is arranged above the tank wall of the dyeing tank; the push plate is provided with a working hole, and the two sides of the push plate are integrally connected with sliding plates; the slide fixed slot include trapezoidal dyeing board, the both sides integral type of trapezoidal dyeing board is connected with the pterygoid lamina, trapezoidal dyeing board is inserted and is put in the push pedal, it has a plurality of discharge orifices to open on the trapezoidal dyeing board, the bottom of trapezoidal dyeing board is fixed with a plurality of slide fixture blocks, it has the slide draw-in groove to open on the slide fixture block. The device can dye the biopsy tissue fast, and whole dyeing process only need to follow the dye vat and promote the operation and can accomplish, need not to insert in the dyeing process and put and take out, prevents to pollute the workstation, and dyeing operation is convenient easy, further saves the time that dyeing was spent, provides the work efficiency of ROSE system.

title_en: Tool for detecting sealing of filter head
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a be used for detecting sealed frock of filter head, the frock includes lower part sealing mechanism, left side sealing mechanism and right side sealing mechanism, lower part sealing mechanism includes the lower air cylinder that top-down set gradually, the unsteady joint of lower air cylinder, lower pressure head and bottom seal receptacle, the lower air cylinder, the unsteady joint of lower air cylinder connects gradually with lower pressure head, lower pressure head just sets up to the bottom seal receptacle, it is equipped with the inflation through-hole to run through on the bottom seal receptacle, left side sealing mechanism and right side sealing mechanism a left side right side are located the both sides of lower part sealing mechanism respectively, left side sealing mechanism is including the aligning bearing frame and the sealed ejector pin that connect gradually, right side sealing mechanism is including the right side cylinder that connect gradually, right side cylinder unsteady joint and sealed head, lower pressure head, the bottom seal receptacle, leave the space that holds the filter head between sealed ejector pin and the sealed head. Compared with the prior art, the utility model discloses can realize the totally enclosed and applicable in multiple filter head of filter head to can fix a position, easy and simple to handle.

title_en: Automatic smoke and fume tester
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic flue gas tester, including base and mobile station, the inside of base is the hollow structure who runs through, the first motor of lateral wall fixedly connected with of base, the output fixedly connected with screw rod one of first motor, the last fixed surface of mobile station is connected with the mount, the inside of mount is provided with the lifter plate, the top fixedly connected with second motor of mount, the output fixedly connected with screw rod two of second motor, the surface of lifter plate is provided with the tester main part, one side that the surface of lifter plate just is located the tester main part rotates through the bearing and is connected with the gauge rod, and the gauge rod keeps away from lifter plate one end and is provided with two infrared distance meters. The utility model discloses, when examining, need not the handheld operation of workman, when testing the pipeline of co-altitude not, can realize the height of automatic height-adjusting tester, and then reduced the degree of difficulty of detect operation.

title_en: Folding device and GPS navigator
abstract_en: The utility model provides a folding device and GPS navigator, this folding device include collapsible or the display screen that extends, be used for holding fold condition display screen the accommodation space, be used for placing the control panel of extension condition display screen and drive display screen along the drive arrangement that the accommodation space stretches out or retracts, control panel is located the top of accommodation space. The folding device of the scheme has the display screen which is divided into a folding state and an extending state. During the non-operating condition, the display screen is folded in the accommodation space, practices thrift control panel's space, and the most possible protection display screen avoids colliding with and prevents garrulous screen. In the working state, the display screen extends to the control panel for positioning or navigation.

title_en: Multi-stage precise bait metering and feeding machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a bait feeding machine, in particular to a multi-stage accurate measurement bait feeding machine, which comprises a feeding device and a base which is used for bearing the feeding device and has adjustable buoyancy; the feeding device comprises a step cylinder, a spiral conveyor, a throwing device, a storage bin, a weighing sensor and a human-computer interaction controller, the feeding device adopts a feeding mode of a combination form of the spiral conveyor and the throwing device, the feeding amount of bait in unit time can be conveniently calculated, and the purpose of multistage accurate measurement of the feeding amount of the bait can be realized by additionally monitoring the actual throwing times of the throwing device. The utility model provides a "promote the bait of bait machine of throwing something and feeding and throw something and feed the technical problem that the volume realized accurate measurement". The utility model discloses possessed bait feeding speed adjustable, bait feeding volume accurate control, mechanical intelligent degree is high, a series of advantages such as the fault rate is low.

title_en: Canned abalone with sealing performance detection function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a from abalone can of taking leakproofness to detect, which comprises a tank body, the rubber sleeve, the clear plastic circle, sealed lid and detection device, the inherent rubber sleeve of top cover of the jar body, the top seal of rubber sleeve is fixed with the clear plastic circle, the top thread fastening of clear plastic circle has sealed lid, the top center department of sealed lid is provided with the undercut groove of bottom open-ended, the undercut inslot is provided with detection device, detection device includes the fixed plate, the pull rod, sealed dish, a spring, long strip structure's clamp plate and fagging, be fixed with the fixed plate on the inner wall of undercut groove, insert on the fixed plate and be equipped with the pull rod that can move about, the upper and lower end of pull rod is fixed with clamp plate and sealed dish respectively, the cover is equipped with the spring on the pull rod, be fixed with the fagging on the inner wall of undercut groove. Has the advantages that: whether the tank body leaks air or not can be known through observing the shape change of the air bag, the detection mode is simple and reliable, the change is more visual, the air bag can be recycled, and the air bag is extremely convenient to use.

title_en: Infrared spectroscopic oil detector for environmental monitoring
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of oil measuring instruments, in particular to an infrared light oil measuring instrument for environmental monitoring, which comprises a box body, an oil measuring instrument main body and a box cover, wherein the box cover is hinged on the box body; the cell box comprises a box body, a cell groove, a slide rail, a clamping strip and a clamping strip, wherein the box body is fixedly provided with a mounting frame, the mounting frame is provided with the cell groove for placing a cell, the wall of the cell groove is fixedly provided with the slide rail, and the rough surface side of the cell is fixedly provided with the clamping strip matched with the slide rail; the utility model discloses a joint strip on the hair side can fix a position the process that the color cell got into the cell groove for the color cell can enter into the cell groove perpendicularly, and is equipped with the stopper on the grip block, and it has the spacing groove to open on the mounting bracket, ensures that the color cell can not rock in the cell groove, makes the optics face touch the cell groove, guarantees the cell luminousness, ensures the precision that detects.

title_en: Rescue vehicle with medicine identification and rechecking functions
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rescue vehicle with drug identification and rechecking functions, which comprises a vehicle body; the main control board is arranged on the vehicle body; the display panel is arranged on the vehicle body and connected with the main control panel; the medicine RFID recognizer is arranged on the vehicle body and is connected with the main control panel; the drug RFID recognizer is used for recognizing and rechecking the rescue drugs, and the main control board is used for receiving the recognition information and the rechecking information transmitted by the drug RFID recognizer and sending the recognition information and the rechecking information to the display panel for displaying. The embodiment of the utility model provides an in the rescue vehicle with medicine discernment and recheck function increase main control board, display panel and medicine RFID recognizer on the basis of traditional rescue vehicle, after the rescue, discern and recheck the rescue medicine through medicine RFID recognizer, make the rescue vehicle more intelligent, reduced medical personnel's work load, improved recheck efficiency greatly.

title_en: Vibrating table with gradient adjusting mechanism for backlight plate processing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a vibrating table with a gradient adjusting mechanism for backlight plate processing, which comprises a vibrating table body, a bottom plate for a table is arranged at the bottom position of the vibrating table body, a bearing plate is arranged at the bottom position of the bottom plate for the table, a protective component is arranged at the upper end position of the bearing plate, the protective component comprises a first protective plate and a second protective plate which are arranged at the upper end position of the bearing plate, and an embedded protective plate which is arranged at the upper end position clearance of the first protective plate and the second protective plate, the vibrating table further comprises a clamping component which is arranged at the inner wall of the first protective plate and the second protective plate, a lifting column is driven and adjusted to drive a matching block to ascend, the matching block can move at the outer side position of a stable guide column by ascending of the matching block, the rotating shaft rotates, the matching block is pulled to move to one side of the bottom plate body, namely, the bottom plate for the table at the moment drives the vibrating table body to present a certain inclination angle state, the inclination of the shaking table body can be simply adjusted.

title_en: Welding frock that oscilloscope probe was used
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a welding frock that oscilloscope probe was used relates to oscilloscope technical field. The clamping device comprises a clamping table, wherein a turnover clamping mechanism is fixedly mounted at the top of the clamping table and comprises a stand column, the inner wall of the stand column is rotatably connected with a rotating shaft, and a drive plate is fixedly mounted at the other end of the rotating shaft. This welding frock that oscilloscope probe was used, through setting up fixture that can overturn, utilize and rotate through gear motor between stand and the pivot and connect, thereby make the gripper jaw treat and to carry out the angle upset after the centre gripping is accomplished to the cramping thing, make the centre gripping effect show and improve, the electric putter that deuterogamies drives two lead screws and rotates in step through the fluted disc, make two gripper jaws move in opposite directions or from each other, make the gripper jaw can carry out effectual centre gripping to the cramping thing of treating of different specifications, and whole process all adopts mechanized operation, possess the advantage of automatic centre gripping, the spacing problem of wasting time and energy of traditional has been solved.

title_en: Pressure limiting valve hardness detection device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pressure limiting valve hardness detection device, which belongs to the field of pressure limiting valves and comprises a base, wherein the top of the base is fixedly connected with a side plate, the top of the base is provided with a horizontal moving mechanism, the horizontal moving mechanism is positioned in front of the side plate, the top of the horizontal moving mechanism is fixedly connected with two supporting plates, the number of the supporting plates is two, a fixing mechanism is arranged between the two supporting plates, a thread sleeve is movably sleeved in the inner part of one supporting plate, and a rotating motor is fixedly arranged on one side of the other supporting plate; this pressure limiting valve hardness detection device through setting up horizontal migration mechanism, can be at the in-process that the pressure limiting valve hardness detected, is convenient for carry out horizontal migration to the pressure limiting valve according to the demand that detects, and through setting up backup pad and rotating electrical machines, is convenient for rotate the pressure limiting valve according to the demand that detects, can adjust the detection position on pressure limiting valve surface to the result of pressure limiting valve hardness detection has been improved.

title_en: Auxiliary device and test device for pull-out force test of embedded radiator
