abstract_en: The utility model discloses an auxiliary device and a testing device for pull-out force test of an embedded radiator, wherein the auxiliary device comprises a bottom plate, a vertical plate and a connecting piece; the shape of the bottom plate is matched with that of a substrate of the embedded radiator and is fixedly connected with the substrate through a connecting piece; the vertical plate is fastened on the bottom plate and is perpendicular to the bottom plate, the mounting position of the vertical plate corresponds to the mounting position of the fin on the base plate, and the shape of the vertical plate is the same as that of the fin. The testing device comprises a base plate, fins and the auxiliary device for the pull-out force test of the fin-embedded radiator, wherein the fins are fastened on the base plate, and the base plate is attached to the bottom plate and is fixedly connected with the bottom plate through a connecting piece. The utility model has the advantages of easy and simple to handle, high experimental reliability.

title_en: Utensil is examined in special use of straight stroke executor circuit board
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of an actuator circuit board checking fixture, in particular to a straight-stroke actuator circuit board special checking fixture which comprises a base, wherein a positioning plate is fixedly connected to the upper end of the base, five groups of stations are arranged at the upper end of the positioning plate at equal intervals, a supporting frame is welded on the rear side of the upper end of the base and is in an n shape, a mounting plate is fixedly connected to the front side of the supporting frame through screws, an air cylinder is fixedly mounted on the front side of the mounting plate through screws, and a connecting plate is fixedly connected to the lower end of the output end of the air cylinder. The utility model has the isolation transformer, the whole process operation is not directly contacted with the metal piece, the operation safety is ensured, the appearance is simple, light and movable, the downward-pressing type electrification is simple and convenient, the five stations can be simultaneously tested, the test efficiency is improved, the five stations are provided with the independent switches to meet different requirements, the switches can realize one-key simulation of the positive and negative rotation of the real motor, and the display screen can directly display the voltage of the circuit board module, so that the circuit board can be judged at a glance.

title_en: Clamp for aluminum alloy profile shear strength detection test
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a clamp for a shear strength detection test of an aluminum alloy section, which comprises a bracket, wherein the top end of the bracket is provided with a fixing plate matched with the section, and the fixing plate is movably connected with a bonding device which is inserted into the section and clamps the section on the fixing plate. The clamp for the aluminum alloy profile shear strength detection test is convenient to assemble and disassemble, high in safety factor, free of damage to a sample body, simple in use process, high in detection safety factor, and free of external force damage outside a normal detection result in the test process.

title_en: Detection device for bearing pressure of fire hose
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a detection device for bearing capacity of a fire hose, and belongs to the technical field of fire control detection. According to the utility model, the number of the grinding wheels is a plurality, the first sliding block can vertically slide on the screw rod slide rail, the first electric telescopic rod can extend to the middle of the two hydraulic telescopic columns and is symmetrically arranged, and the electric motor can be used for performing friction resistance test on the straightened fire hose, so that the fire hose is convenient and simple to detect the wear resistance, and the problem that the wear resistance detection cannot be performed on the fire hose is solved.

title_en: Automatic foam smoke detection device of location
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic-positioning foam smoke detection device which comprises a protection shell, an infrared gas detector, a PLC (programmable logic controller) and a driving motor, wherein the upper part of the protection shell is connected with the lower end of a fixed inclined connecting rod through a bolt, the middle part of the protection shell is fixedly connected with a support column, the upper end of the support column is connected with the infrared gas detector, a foam liquid storage tank is arranged inside the protection shell, a high-pressure pump is arranged in the middle of the foam liquid storage tank, the high-pressure pump is connected with a high-pressure foam sprayer through a conveying connecting pipe, a storage battery is arranged inside the protection shell, and the PLC is arranged in the middle of the storage battery. The utility model can detect the concentration of harmful gas in the air in real time by utilizing the infrared gas detector, and can also automatically position the smoke detection device, so that the display screen can be controlled by the PLC electric cabinet to display related data, thereby increasing the flexibility of the detection device.

title_en: Experimental press device of car steering wheel loudspeaker
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a horn test pressing device for an automobile steering wheel, which comprises: the bracket component comprises a cross beam, wherein one end of the cross beam is provided with a first connecting mechanism, the other end of the cross beam is provided with a second connecting mechanism, and the bracket component can be connected to an automobile steering wheel through the first connecting mechanism and the second connecting mechanism and enables the cross beam to cross a pressing area of a horn of the automobile steering wheel; and the pressing assembly is connected with the cross beam of the support assembly and is used for applying acting force to a pressing area of the automobile steering wheel horn. Through this experimental press device of car steering wheel loudspeaker, the tester need not to operate under the interior closed environment of car, and the flexibility is bigger. Simultaneously, above-mentioned technical scheme direct mount is in car steering wheel, and the structure dismouting is simple, saves man-hour, improves work efficiency.

title_en: Computer casing detection mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a computer case detection mechanism, which comprises a bottom plate, two racks, a sliding device and a detection device, wherein the two racks are vertically and symmetrically arranged on two sides of the bottom plate, the sliding device is arranged on the racks, the detection device is arranged on the sliding device, a product fixing device is arranged below the detection device, a moving device is arranged below the product fixing device, and the product fixing device comprises two brackets, a product placing plate, a sensing device and a fixing device, wherein the two brackets are vertically arranged on the moving device, the product placing plate is arranged between the brackets, and the fixing device is positioned on the periphery of the product placing plate and/or above the product placing plate; the product positioning and detecting device detects whether the product is placed in place or not through the sensing device, adjusts the product according to the distance deviation in the detection result, eliminates the influence of the product positioning precision on the product detection result, completes the positioning and detection of the product through the cooperation among the sliding device, the detection device, the moving device and the product fixing device, improves the positioning efficiency and the detection efficiency, and has higher accuracy.

title_en: Detection apparatus for steel constructs raw materials
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of steel structures, and particularly relates to a detection device for a steel structure raw material. This detection device of steel structure raw materials, through setting up the hydraulic pump, the hydraulic pump drives the hydraulic ram through the hydraulic stem and goes up and down to carry out pressure detection to the steel structure raw materials of centre gripping, observe the bearing pressure of steel structure raw materials through display instrument, through setting up the force pump, the steel structure raw materials is behind pressure detection, remove the supporting platform upper surface of placing the test box in, at this moment the force pump takes the alkali lye in the collection liquid box out, discharge the test box in through the conveyer pipe, the alkali lye of emission soaks the steel structure raw materials and handles, thereby carry out corrosion-resistant detection to the steel structure raw materials, carry out diversified detection to the steel structure raw materials through pressure and corrosion-resistant simultaneously.

title_en: Calibration test device of broadband Rogowski coil
abstract_en: The application discloses calibration test device of broadband rogowski coil includes: the utility model discloses a high accuracy collection and calibration analysis display module, the main control module, the complex current generator, polymorphic type standard signal conversion module, wire and high accuracy collection and calibration analysis display module, the main control module connects and controls the complex current generator, the complex current generator is connected with polymorphic type standard signal conversion module, convert current signal into voltage signal, polymorphic type standard signal conversion module is connected to the one end of wire, the other end passes the broadband rogowski coil of being surveyed, and be connected with the complex current generator, form the current circuit, high accuracy collection and calibration analysis display module show the calibration result. By using the device, the problem that the existing calibration test device cannot perform calibration test on the measurement result of the broadband Rogowski coil when the broadband Rogowski coil measures broadband signals above 50 Hz is solved, and the accuracy and the reliability of the test are improved.

title_en: Manufacturing tool for pipeline sealing gasket
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a manufacturing tool of a pipeline sealing gasket, which comprises a positioning assembly, a clamping piece and a positioning cone, wherein the clamping piece is embedded into one end of a shell; the measuring assembly comprises a measuring gear, a first measuring arm and a second measuring arm, the measuring gear is arranged in the shell, the first measuring arm is meshed with one side of the measuring gear, and the second measuring arm is meshed with the other side of the measuring gear; the cutting assembly comprises a positioning terminal and a cutting piece, the positioning terminal is arranged at the end part of the first measuring arm, and one end of the cutting piece is in threaded connection with the positioning terminal. The utility model has the beneficial effects that: the manufacturing tool of the pipeline sealing gasket is convenient to use, simple and time-saving in operation process, and accurate in measurement and cutting and meets the process requirements.

title_en: Novel optical fiber vibration detection device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel optical fiber vibration detection device, and relates to the technical field of optical fiber detection. According to the utility model, by arranging the vibration sensor and the display screen, when the optical fiber is detected, the vibration sensor is attached to the optical fiber, the vibration of the optical fiber caused by the influence of the environment is detected, the data is displayed through the display screen, and by arranging the limiting plate, the driving gear, the transmission gear and the movable plate, the limiting plate moves outwards under the action of the torsion spring, so that the movable plate moves upwards, and the movable plate is matched with the L-shaped plate and can clamp the optical fiber, so that the vibration sensor can be attached to the optical fiber, and the detection precision is ensured.

title_en: Concrete block compressive strength detection device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a concrete block compressive strength detection device which comprises a stable loading platform, wherein reinforcing support legs are fixedly arranged at corner positions at the bottom of the stable loading platform, a directional butt joint guide rail is transversely and fixedly arranged at the edge side of the outside of the stable loading platform, a positioning support is fixedly arranged at the middle position of the upper end of the outside of the stable loading platform, a limiting support rod is fixedly arranged at the corner position of the upper end of the outside of the stable loading platform, a dust collection frame is movably arranged at the inner side position of the directional butt joint guide rail, a bearing support plate is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the outside of a pressure sensing support column, a pushing cylinder is fixedly arranged at the middle position of the edge side of the outside of the reinforcing support plate, and an auxiliary support is fixedly arranged at the edge side of the outside of the bearing frame. This concrete block compressive strength detection device through having add dust removal mechanism, makes the device can carry out the in-process and carry out timely cleaning processing to detecting produced garrulous dirt at the detection achievement, has richened holistic service functionality.

title_en: Detection device for detecting installation flatness of civil air defense door
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a detection device for detecting the installation flatness of a civil air defense door, which comprises a Z-direction attaching piece, an angle adjusting assembly, an X-direction attaching piece and a Y-direction attaching piece, wherein the X-direction attaching piece is vertically arranged on the Z-direction attaching piece, the Y-direction attaching piece is vertically arranged on the Z-direction attaching piece, every two of the Z-direction attaching piece, the X-direction attaching piece and the Y-direction attaching piece are vertically arranged, and the angle adjusting assembly is respectively arranged in the X-direction attaching piece and the Y-direction attaching piece.

title_en: Medical electronic infant scale with function of soothing emotion of infant
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of electronic infant scales, and discloses a medical electronic infant scale with a function of soothing infant emotions, which comprises a base, a weighing sensor, a driving assembly, a playing assembly and a control assembly, wherein the weighing sensor is arranged on the outer wall of the bottom surface of the base, a weighing groove is formed in the upper surface of the base, a side plate is arranged on the outer side wall of the base, the driving assembly is arranged on the outer surface of the side plate, the playing assembly is arranged on the upper surface of the driving assembly, and the control assembly is arranged on the outer side wall of the base; the medical electronic infant scale disclosed by the utility model can attract the attention of an infant in time so as to achieve the purpose of soothing the emotion of the infant, is extremely suitable for crying and screaming of the infant in the process of weighing the weight of the infant, can quickly and stably weigh the weight of the infant, can serve as a temporary infant care place, is very suitable for crying and screaming of multiple infants or parents of the infant in medical care personnel, and is suitable for wide popularization and use.

title_en: Automatic detection and drainage device for chimney of generator
abstract_en: The utility model provides an automatic detection and drainage device for a generator chimney, which comprises a chimney body and is characterized in that the chimney body comprises a first chimney section and a second chimney section, wherein the first chimney section is horizontally arranged; the first chimney section is communicated with the second chimney section; one end of the first chimney section, which is far away from the second chimney section, is connected with a generator; the bottom of one end, close to the second chimney section, of the first chimney section is provided with a water through opening, and the water through opening is communicated with a water discharge pipe; the drain pipe is provided with a liquid level sensor and an electric valve; and the liquid level sensor and the electric valve are both connected with a control device. By applying the technical scheme, the phenomenon that liquid enters the generator from the chimney to cause equipment damage can be avoided.

title_en: Be applied to high-purity gas's pressure detection alarm device
abstract_en: A pressure detection alarm device applied to high-purity gas belongs to the technical field of pressure alarm of high-purity special gas, and solves the problem of how to design a pressure detection alarm device for high-purity gas to detect and alarm the pressure of the high-purity gas in a gas source in real time; through setting up pressure threshold in pressure sensor, when pressure sensor detected the atmospheric pressure of air supply and reduced the threshold value of settlement, pressure sensor's contact became the electricity closed, the atmospheric pressure in alarm device suggestion air supply is not enough, the staff learns alarm information and handles normal back, eliminate the warning through closing stop button, can detect and report to the police the high-purity gas's in the air supply pressure in real time at production process, the operational aspect of apparatus for producing is directly perceived, in time known, reduce the emergence of risk.

title_en: Focal length adjusting system for high-magnification camera
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a focal length adjusting system for a high-multiple camera, which comprises: the distance measurement module is used for acquiring distance information between the sample placing table and the experiment camera; the experiment camera is used for acquiring image information of an experiment area on the sample placing table; and the control module is used for controlling the focusing motor according to the distance information. The utility model adopts the distance measuring module to assist in acquiring distance information, assists in controlling the focusing motor to perform coarse adjustment according to the distance information, and assists in controlling the focusing motor to perform fine adjustment through image information acquired by the experimental camera, thereby improving the focusing efficiency. The utility model can be widely applied to the technical field of focusing.

title_en: Bird repeller with two-sided owl
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a double-sided owl bird repeller applied to a power transmission and distribution line for preventing birds from invading, which comprises a left body and a right body, wherein two LED red light flickering eye assemblies, two infrared induction motion sensor assemblies, two solar panels, two rechargeable batteries, two variable-frequency ultrasonic loudspeakers with variable time, two switches and a powerful magnetic block are arranged in the left body and the right body. The method is characterized in that: a, a modeling bionic owl of the device is erected on the imitated stump; b, the solar panel provides power for charging the battery; c, hemispherical lens infrared motion induction sensor of protrusion has promoted motion sensor's response scope and sensitivity, gets into the response scope when birds and will trigger response and starting drive: d, the device integrates the functions that the LED eyes emit flickering red light and the ultrasonic speaker with variable frequency at variable time can emit ultrasonic waves, and bird repelling is integrated, and particularly bird repelling components are arranged on the left and right of the device respectively, so that the sensing range of the device is free of dead angles. The device has the advantages of easy installation, low cost, no maintenance and the like.

title_en: Paper bursting strength detector
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a paper bursting strength detector which comprises a bursting strength detector, wherein a sealing ring is arranged at the air inlet end of the bursting strength detector, an input mechanism connected with the bursting strength detector is fixedly connected in the sealing ring, a placing mechanism is arranged on the input mechanism, a limiting mechanism is connected on the placing mechanism, an inserting mechanism matched with the placing mechanism is arranged on one side of the sealing ring, one end of the inserting mechanism is connected with an external air source, an installing mechanism matched with the input mechanism is connected on the inserting mechanism, and a supporting mechanism supporting the inserting mechanism is connected on the bursting strength detector. The insertion block is further limited in the annular groove under the assistance of the contraction spring and the limiting plate, so that the insertion tube can be arranged on the input tube, the separation of the insertion tube is further avoided, the device can be normally used, and the detection accuracy of the instrument is indirectly improved.

title_en: Cabinet type flue gas humidity detection device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a cabinet type smoke humidity detection device, which comprises a detection cavity and a heating element, wherein the heating element is used for heating the detection cavity to ensure that smoke in the detection cavity keeps a gasification state, the detection cavity is provided with an air inlet and an air outlet, a detection unit is arranged in the detection cavity, the air inlet and the air outlet are respectively communicated with the detection cavity, the air inlet is arranged between the detection unit and the air outlet, and the distance between the air inlet and the detection unit is greater than the distance between the air inlet and the air outlet, the utility model arranges the air inlet between the detection unit and the air outlet, and the distance between the air inlet and the detection unit is greater than the distance between the air inlet and the air outlet, and the detection cavity is heated by the heating element, so that water vapor and acidic substances in the smoke cannot be attached to the surface of the detection unit, the detection unit is corroded, the detection precision is influenced, and the service life of the cabinet type smoke humidity detection device is greatly prolonged.

title_en: Ferris wheel type mechanical rail-changing type cigar appearance detection device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a ferris wheel type mechanical track-changing type cigar appearance detection device, which comprises a door-shaped frame, a turntable motor, two rotating discs, a rotating shaft, a fixed disc, a plurality of groups of flexible clamping mechanisms and a group of area array cameras, wherein the turntable motor drives the rotating discs to synchronously rotate through the rotating shaft; the flexible clamping mechanisms are distributed on the two rotating discs; the fixed disc is fixed with the door-shaped frame, an annular sliding track is arranged on the fixed disc corresponding to the tail end of the flexible clamping mechanism, the sliding track is divided into a shallow groove area and a deep groove area, and the shallow groove area and the deep groove area are connected through a smoothly-transitional inclined plane; the clamping end of the flexible clamping mechanism on the rotating disc adjacent to the fixed disc has certain movement allowance in the axial direction, and the clamping end is provided with a return spring. The device accomplishes the centre gripping action through simple mechanical structure, and the testing process need not to shut down, detects no dead angle, need not artifical the participation, and detection accuracy is higher, can adapt to the cigar of various different specifications.

title_en: Engineering survey sighting rod equipment that many topography was used
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an engineering survey sighting rod equipment that multi-topography was used belongs to engineering survey sighting rod equipment field, the on-line screen storage device comprises a base, the base is provided with open rectangle cavity structure for the top, the diapire symmetry of base is provided with four bearing structure, the welding has the fixed axle between the inner wall of base both sides, rotate and install a plurality of turning blocks on the fixed axle, one side of a plurality of turning blocks is fixed with the backup pad, the upper surface of backup pad is fixed with the roof through the bracing piece, the lower surface of roof is fixed with the sighting rod, the upper surface mounting of roof has the surveyor's level, install the air level on one side wall of roof, one side of backup pad lower surface is fixed with ejector pad one, one side of base diapire internal surface is fixed with the installation piece, rotate and install the lead screw between installation piece and the base inner wall; the utility model relates to a novelty, the structure is ingenious, when the topography user equipment of difference, can both make sighting rod and horizontal plane keep perpendicular, improves measuring precision, and the practicality is high.

title_en: Novel tester of electric stay bar driving unit of automobile tail door
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a novel tester of an electric stay bar driving unit of an automobile tail door, which comprises a load device, a support, a base, a first fixing seat, a test sleeve, a jacking structure and a second fixing seat, wherein the support, the first fixing seat and the second fixing seat are respectively arranged at the front, middle and rear parts of the base, the support is used for fixing the load device, the load device is connected with an output shaft of the test sleeve, one end of the test sleeve is fixed on the first fixing seat, the other end of the test sleeve is provided with an end cover, the end cover is tightly pressed by the jacking structure, the jacking structure is fixed on the second fixing seat, a motor to be tested and a gear box are arranged in the test sleeve, and the end cover of the test sleeve is connected with a power line of an electric stay bar belt. The utility model has the advantages that the practical application scene can be simulated, and the installation and the test on the automobile body are not needed. In the production and research and development processes, a large number of motors and gear box assemblies can be conveniently tested, and the working efficiency is improved. The utility model has great popularization value.

title_en: Radar monitoring equipment with heat dissipation function
abstract_en: The utility model provides a radar monitoring device with a heat dissipation function, which comprises a box body, and a mounting bracket and a radar monitoring assembly which are arranged in the box body, wherein the mounting bracket is of a tubular structure with openings at two ends, the radar monitoring assembly is mounted on the outer wall of the mounting bracket, the left side of the box body is provided with an air inlet, the right side of the box body is provided with an air outlet, the air inlet and the air outlet are respectively communicated with an inner hole of the mounting bracket, the air inlet is provided with an air suction device, and the air inlet and the air outlet are respectively provided with an outer cover. The utility model has good heat dissipation capability and electromagnetic shielding level, and can adapt to severe environments such as sand, dust, rainwater and the like.

title_en: Material feeding and weighing device for powder metallurgy injection molding in manufacturing industry
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a material feeding and weighing device for powder metallurgy injection molding in manufacturing industry. The system comprises a control system, an auxiliary material and iron powder weighing system, a semi-finished product banburying system and a finished product batching system; a production plan is prerecorded in the control system, and the weight standards of all auxiliary materials and iron powder are set; the auxiliary material and iron powder weighing system weighs the auxiliary material and iron powder through an electronic scale, and if the weighing data are consistent with the production plan, the printing system prints single-product two-dimensional code labels of the auxiliary material and the iron powder; the semi-finished product banburying system comprises a scanning gun, wherein the scanning gun scans a single-product two-dimensional code label, after scanning and confirmation, the control system controls the banbury mixer to open the protective cover, corresponding auxiliary materials and iron powder are added for banburying, and the printing system prints the semi-finished product information two-dimensional codes of each unit; and the finished product approval system scans the semi-finished product information two-dimensional codes in sequence through the scanning gun, and the printing system prints the finished product information two-dimensional codes after all the semi-finished product two-dimensional codes are approved and qualified by the control system.

title_en: Portable hydrology detector
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a portable hydrological detector which comprises a detection box, wherein the front end of the top of the detection box is rotatably connected with a box cover, the center of the front end of the detection box is provided with a containing groove, the bottoms of the two sides of the containing groove are rotatably connected with a pull rod through a rotating shaft, the two sides of the front end of the center of the bottom of the detection box are both provided with sinking grooves, the centers of the tops of the two sinking grooves are both fixedly connected with elastic vibration damping assemblies, the centers of the bottoms of the two elastic vibration damping assemblies are both provided with pulleys, and the two sides of the rear end of the center of the bottom of the detection box are both welded with supporting blocks. According to the utility model, the containing groove is formed in the center of the front end of the detection box, the pull rod is rotatably connected to the bottom of the containing groove, the sliding groove corresponding to the pull rod is formed in the containing groove, the pressure spring and the push rod piece are arranged on the inner wall of the sliding groove and are rotatably connected with the pull rod through the torsion support, the deflection angle of the pull rod can be conveniently adjusted, the detection box is convenient for technicians to use, and the force for pulling the detection box is saved.

title_en: Building wall hardness detection device for building detection
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a house wall hardness detection device for building detection, which comprises a base body, a hydraulic pressurizing mechanism and a lifting wheel mechanism, wherein the hydraulic pressurizing mechanism is installed at the upper end of the right side of the base body, the hydraulic pressurizing mechanism is composed of a base, a pressure regulating pump A, a hydraulic body, a nitrogen pushing disc, a pressurizing column, a lifting switch sheet, a pressurizing lever, a switch shifting sheet and a descending switch sheet, the hydraulic pressurizing mechanism is provided with the hydraulic body, the pressurizing column is embedded in the hydraulic body, the nitrogen pushing disc is installed at the upper end of the pressurizing column, the base is welded at the lower end of the hydraulic body, and the pressurizing lever is installed on the right side wall of the hydraulic body. Hardness testing dynamics is enough, can control effectively and carry out the power way that the hammering detected hardness to the wall, has improved the detection data accuracy nature, can carry out easy to assemble and removal transportation to detection device simultaneously, has reduced intensity of labour, has improved work efficiency.

title_en: Multi-battery system gas detection device combined with transient mass spectrometer
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of on-line detection of battery gas, and discloses a multi-battery system gas detection device used with a transient mass spectrometer, which comprises a flow meter, a battery pack and a combined tee joint; the combined three-way joint comprises a three-way sleeve, a sealing head and a flow guide pipe; the three-way sleeve comprises a first sleeve, a second sleeve and a third sleeve, the first sleeve and the second sleeve are connected up and down to form a battery compartment, the third sleeve is connected with one side of the battery compartment, the battery pack is located in the battery compartment, the sealing head is connected with the second sleeve, one end of the flow guide pipe is connected with the first sleeve, the gas carrying bottle is connected with the third sleeve through the flow meter, and the other end of the flow guide pipe is connected with the transient mass spectrometer. The beneficial effects are that: the gas production condition of the ion battery in the using process can be monitored in real time, and the gas components can be qualitatively and quantitatively analyzed on line in real time and the pressure change in the battery can be monitored.

title_en: Normal-temperature integrating sphere tester for LED spectral analysis
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a normal temperature integrating sphere tester for LED spectral analysis, which comprises a sphere, wherein the bottom end of the sphere is symmetrically and fixedly provided with supporting legs, the bottom end of each supporting leg is fixedly provided with a supporting plate, one side of the sphere is fixedly provided with an optical fiber connector, the other end of the sphere is fixedly provided with a fixed seat, a slot is formed in the fixed seat in a penetrating way and communicated with the inner space of the sphere, a lamp body mounting seat is inserted in the fixed seat in a sliding way, a plurality of sliding rods are symmetrically and fixedly arranged on one side of the sphere close to the fixed seat in an array mode, the other end of each sliding rod is fixedly connected with a fixed plate, a sliding plate is sleeved on each sliding rod in a sliding way, and a top block matched with the lamp body mounting seat is fixedly arranged on one side of the sliding plate close to the fixed seat, meanwhile, the phenomenon that the cable is scattered is avoided.

title_en: Heat dissipation type digital oscilloscope
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of oscilloscopes, in particular to a heat dissipation type digital oscilloscope, which comprises an oscilloscope shell and a semiconductor refrigerating sheet, wherein a circuit board and a fan are fixedly installed on the inner wall of the oscilloscope shell, a heat conducting fin is bonded on the hot end of the semiconductor refrigerating sheet, a frame is fixedly connected with the outer wall of the hot end of the semiconductor refrigerating sheet, the frame is fixedly connected with the oscilloscope shell, the cold end of the semiconductor refrigerating sheet penetrates through the oscilloscope shell and extends into the oscilloscope shell, a heat conducting block is bonded on the cold end of the semiconductor refrigerating sheet, horizontal fins are fixedly arranged between the circuit board and the fan and are distributed at equal intervals in the vertical direction, inclined fins are fixedly arranged at one ends of the horizontal fins close to the circuit board, and the inclined fins are inclined upwards. According to the utility model, the gas blown out by the horizontal fin homogenizing fan and the cold air is guided to flow upwards by the inclined fins, so that the cooling effect of the semiconductor refrigerating sheet on the shell of the oscilloscope is improved.

title_en: Meniscus lens center thickness gauge
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of meniscus lenses, in particular to a meniscus lens center thickness gauge, which comprises a handheld thickness gauge, wherein a sliding part is arranged on a base of the handheld thickness gauge, a limiting part is arranged at the end part of the sliding part, a bearing clamping part is arranged at the top part of the sliding part, supporting parts are arranged at the bottoms of the bearing clamping part and the sliding part, an extrusion part is arranged in the bearing clamping part and connected with a swinging part, the swinging part comprises a groove, a swinging rod and a rotating wheel, the rotating wheel is arranged in a bearing plate, one end of the swinging rod is arranged on the outer wall of the rotating wheel, and the groove is formed in the side wall of the bearing plate; the beneficial effects are that: the supporting clamping piece provided by the utility model can clamp the meniscus lens for detection, and the top of the supporting clamping piece is provided with the groove, so that the lens can be stably placed on the top of the supporting clamping piece.

title_en: Device for improving closed flash point detection precision
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of detection devices, and discloses a device for improving the detection precision of a closed flash point, which comprises a cup body (104), wherein a cup cover (102) is arranged on the cup body (104), an ignition assembly (101) is arranged on the cup cover (102), the output end of the ignition assembly (101) extends into the cup body (104), a temperature measurement assembly (105) is arranged on the cup body (104), and the lower side end of the temperature measurement assembly (105) also extends into the cup body (104); a stirring component (103) is also arranged in the cup body (104); the devices for improving the closed flash point detection precision are arranged into ten groups, and the ten groups of devices for improving the closed flash point detection precision are arranged on the mounting ring (2); the ten groups of ignition components (101) on the device for improving the detection precision of the closed flash point ignite at the interval of 0.1 ℃, and the ignition temperature difference of the adjacent ignition components (101) is 0.1 ℃. The utility model has the advantage of high detection precision.

title_en: Detection platform of microscope for detecting silicon carbide single crystal
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of silicon carbide crystal processing and detecting devices, in particular to a detection platform of a microscope for detecting silicon carbide single crystals, which comprises a positioning base, a rotary bearing disc, a lifting frame and a microlens part, wherein the positioning base comprises a base plate, a vertical slide rail frame, a front and back limiting slide table and a left and right limiting slide table, the front and back limiting slide table and the left and right limiting slide table are sequentially stacked on the upper end surface of the base plate from bottom to top, the rotary bearing disc is fixedly arranged at the top of the left and right limiting slide table, the base plate is of a rectangular plate-shaped structure, one end of the base plate is fixedly provided with the vertical slide rail frame, one end of the lifting frame is in limiting connection with the vertical slide rail frame, the other end of the lifting frame is connected with the microlens part, the device has the advantages of simple operation, convenient detection, high efficiency, uniform detection and high repeatability, and greatly improves the utilization rate of microscope equipment for detecting silicon carbide single crystals, the resource allocation is optimized, and the using effect and the using benefit of the microscope are improved.

title_en: Wireless pressure gauge based on NB-IOT
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wireless pressure gauge based on NB-IOT, which comprises a main shell, one end of the main shell is fixedly provided with a display meter detection shell, the other end of the main shell is fixedly provided with a battery rear cover, six battery tanks are arranged on the outer surface of the other end of the main shell, a conductive ring is fixedly arranged on the outer surface of each battery tank, a battery is fixedly arranged in the battery tank, four bayonet locks are arranged on the outer surface of the detection shell of the display meter, one side of the bayonet lock is fixedly provided with a sealing outer ring positioned on the outer surface of the detection shell of the display meter, the outer surface of one end of the sealing outer ring is symmetrically provided with two conducting strips, two positive and negative electrodes are installed to main casing inner wall's one end symmetry, the inner wall of main casing one end is arranged and is had four draw-in grooves, the inner wall of lid is arranged and is had six spacing grooves behind the battery. The utility model improves the sealing effect and the endurance mileage in the device and facilitates the replacement of the battery.

title_en: Tension detection roller for calender and calender thereof
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tension detection roller for a calender and the calender thereof, wherein the tension detection roller comprises: roller, dabber, pressure detection piece, mounting bracket and level adjustment device, the dabber with one heart arrange in inside the roller, pressure detection piece fixed connection in between dabber and the roller, the dabber both ends are worn to establish respectively the roller rotates with the mounting bracket to be connected, mounting bracket sliding connection in the level adjustment device. The utility model realizes the detection of the pressure applied to the roller and the tension on the PI film, and simultaneously realizes the adjustment of the position of the roller, so that the surface tension of the PI film is in a stable state in the working process of the calender, the condition of uneven material distribution is avoided, the finished product quality of the PI film is improved, and the production yield is improved.

title_en: Detection device is used in gearbox production
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of detection, in particular to a detection device for gearbox production. It includes the base, the base lower extreme is connected with a plurality of evenly distributed's universal wheel, base upper end sliding connection has hydraulic pressure elevating gear, hydraulic pressure elevating gear keeps away from guider one end and is connected with the mobile device, hydraulic pressure elevating gear upper end can be dismantled and be connected with the lift seat, three parallel and evenly distributed's T type spouts are seted up to the lift seat, sliding connection has two symmetric distribution's T type slider in the T type spout, T type slider upper end is connected with the dog, the base upper end is connected with the curb plate, the curb plate rotates the output shaft that is connected with motor A, motor A can dismantle and be connected with the curb plate, motor A's output shaft passes the curb plate and is connected with the swivel mount, swivel mount periphery side is connected with the ring handle. The rotary seat of the utility model drives the gear box to turn, which is convenient for workers to check the appearance of the gear box and also convenient for assembling or disassembling the gear box.

title_en: Polymer anti-crack mortar monitoring device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a polymer anti-cracking mortar monitoring device, which comprises a workbench and an object stage, wherein the object stage is arranged outside the workbench, clamping components are symmetrically arranged outside the workbench, each clamping component comprises two connecting plates, each connecting plate is arranged outside the workbench, an open slot is formed in the outer part of each connecting plate, a limiting rod is slidably connected inside each open slot, one end of each limiting rod is fixedly connected with an arc-shaped clamping block, one end, far away from each arc-shaped clamping block, of each limiting rod is fixedly connected with a handle, a reinforcing component is arranged outside the object stage and comprises two triangular supports, the utility model is provided with the clamping components, a material cylinder can be fixedly clamped by using the two arc-shaped clamping blocks, and an anti-skid strip is arranged outside each arc-shaped clamping block, so that the material cylinder is clamped more firmly, and the designed clamping components can conveniently and quickly clamp the material cylinder, and the stability in the working process is ensured, and the accuracy of the monitoring data is improved.

title_en: Anemorumbometer inspection device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anemorumbometer checking device which comprises a telescopic rod lower part arranged above a base, a telescopic rod upper part arranged above the telescopic rod lower part, a first rotating block arranged at the top end of the telescopic rod upper part, a first wind scoop and a second wind scoop arranged on the first rotating block, a data receiver arranged below the first rotating block, a second rotating block arranged below the data receiver, a wind vane arranged on the second rotating block, a placing box arranged outside the telescopic rod lower part, a data display box arranged on the placing box, a lead arranged between the data display box and the data receiver, and a fixing mechanism arranged on the base. The anemoscope inspection device is convenient to carry, the screw is fixed through the matching of the screw and the friction surface, the screw only needs to be inserted into the placing groove on the base, the movable plate only needs to be pushed into the movable groove, the weight is light, and the anemoscope inspection device is convenient to carry.

title_en: Wire capable of detecting tissue resistance value
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wire capable of detecting a tissue resistance value, which comprises a detector, wherein a mounting seat is mounted on the outer wall of the middle part of one side of the detector through a bolt, a clamping seat which is distributed in an upper-lower structure is movably mounted on the outer wall of the other side of the mounting seat, which is far away from the detector, through a rotating shaft, springs are welded on the inner side wall of the clamping seat, the springs are distributed in an annular structure with equal distance, a plastic plate is welded on the outer wall of one end, close to each other, of each spring, a guide sheet is welded on the inner side wall of each plastic plate, the guide sheets are electrically connected with the detector through connecting wires, and a wire body is arranged on the inner side wall, close to each guide sheet, of each guide sheet. According to the utility model, the device can effectively detect the resistance value of the detected tissue through the electrical connection of the guide sheet, the detector, the conducting sheet and the electrode rod, and the arrangement of the spring enables the installation of the structural lead body to be more stable and effective, so that the practicability of the device is improved.

title_en: Levelness measuring device for project supervision
abstract_en: The application discloses a levelness measuring device for project supervision, which belongs to the technical field of building measurement and comprises a box body; a supporting plate is horizontally arranged in the box body, a level meter is arranged in the middle of the upper surface of the supporting plate, clamping grooves for the supporting plate to be horizontally inserted are formed in two opposite side walls in the box body, and the clamping grooves are located at the top of the side walls of the box body; the box body is provided with a pair of box covers at the upper end face, one sides of the pair of box covers far away from each other are hinged with the box body, and one sides of the pair of box covers opposite to each other are provided with lock catches; a groove is formed in one surface, facing the box body, of the box cover; handles are arranged on the two outer walls opposite to the box body. This levelness measuring device for engineering supervision easily carries, and has the altitude mixture control function.

title_en: Chemical reagent auxiliary agent redispersible latex powder metering device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a redispersible latex powder metering device of chemical reagent auxiliary agent, including bottom plate, driving motor, gravity sensor and pneumatic cylinder, the top of bottom plate is fixed with the backup pad, and the top of backup pad is fixed with the roof to the top of roof is provided with the rotation case, the left side of roof is fixed with fixed stirring leaf, driving motor is installed to the right side top of roof, and driving motor's output is fixed with driving gear, the fixed block is installed at both ends about the top of bottom plate, and the middle part of fixed block is provided with the fly leaf. This redispersible latex powder metering device of chemical reagent auxiliary agent through being provided with rolling dish, wire rope and fixed plate, can make rolling dish rolling wire rope through rotating the rolling dish, conveniently makes wire rope pulling fixed plate move to the inboard, and then conveniently makes the metering cylinder of fixed plate extrusion fly leaf top, has made things convenient for the row's of the redispersed latex powder of rotation incasement portion to arrange the material measurement, improves the device's result of use.

title_en: Chip detection device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a chip detection device, which comprises a chip detection card seat, a video interface switching circuit, a rapid charging PD control circuit, an auxiliary channel AUX control circuit, a voltage and current detection circuit and a test machine, wherein the video interface switching circuit is connected with the chip detection card seat through a network; the video data output interface and the video data input interface of the chip to be tested are respectively connected with the input interface and the output interface of the video interface switching circuit to form a video data conversion loop; the PD control circuit is used for testing the physical performance and the communication protocol of the PD interface of the chip to be tested; the AUX control circuit is used for testing the physical performance and the communication protocol of the AUX interface of the chip to be tested; the voltage and current detection circuit is used for supplying power to the chip detection card seat, and the tester judges the correctness of the chip power supply system to be detected according to the detection result of the voltage and current detection circuit. The chip detection device can reduce the cost of chip test and improve the automatic test efficiency of the chip.

title_en: Leakage detection device of refrigeration pipeline for air conditioner production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a leakage detection device of a refrigeration pipeline for air conditioner production, which comprises a base, a detection box, a refrigeration pipe body and a discharge pipe, wherein the base is arranged on two sides of the bottom end of the detection box, a storage structure is arranged at the bottom end inside the detection box and used for storing redundant soap bubbles, guide pipes are arranged on two sides of the bottom end of a stirring structure, and injection heads are arranged at the bottom ends of the guide pipes. When the leakage of the refrigerating pipe body needs to be detected, the soap bubbles can be guided to the injection head through the guide pipe, and then the soap bubbles are sprayed into the refrigerating pipe body through the injection head to detect whether leakage occurs or not.

title_en: Insulating tool for 27.5kV GIS terminal testing
abstract_en: An insulation tool for 27.5kV GIS terminal testing comprises an epoxy resin workpiece, a metal shielding cover, a metal flange, an insulator containing workpiece, a high-voltage insulator and a high-voltage insulator lead-in valve. The epoxy resin part, the metal shielding cover and the metal flange are cast into a hat-shaped part similar to a hat, and bolt holes used for being connected with tail pipes on the tested GIS terminals through bolts are formed in the hat-shaped part. The metal flange is detachably and hermetically connected with the insulating object containing part. The high-voltage insulator lead-in valve is fixedly arranged on the insulator containing part, and the high-voltage insulator with certain pressure is filled in the space defined by the epoxy resin part, the insulator containing part and the high-voltage insulator lead-in valve. The insulating tool for testing the 27.5kV GIS terminal is used for detecting the 27.5kV GIS terminal before leaving a factory, so that the unqualified 27.5kV GIS terminal can be effectively prevented from entering the market.

title_en: Steel aqueduct defect detecting and early warning system based on unmanned aerial vehicle image recognition
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a steel aqueduct defect detecting and early warning system based on unmanned aerial vehicle image recognition, which comprises an image acquisition and transmission module, an image recognition and analysis module and an early warning module. The image acquisition and transmission module comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle, a high-definition camera and wireless communication equipment; the image recognition and analysis module mainly comprises image recognition software, an image database and the like and is used for recognizing the defect form of the steel aqueduct and positioning the defect position; the early warning module is composed of a warning lamp, a warning sound, a mobile phone warning, e-mail triggering software and other warning modes and is used for timely warning detection personnel. The method and the device have the advantages that the steel aqueduct is patrolled and examined by the unmanned aerial vehicle according to the preset flight route, the image information of the key part of the steel aqueduct is collected in real time, the collected image information is processed and analyzed, and the defect position and the distribution condition which possibly exist in the steel aqueduct are rapidly identified and early warned.

title_en: Multi-station hazardous waste fixed-point management station based on cloud data
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cloud data-based multi-station hazardous waste fixed-point management station, which comprises an electronic weighing instrument, a support plate, a vertical screen, a display screen, a control box and a wireless communication module, wherein the support plate is fixed on the table top of the electronic weighing instrument and used for placing a hazardous waste storage box; n dangerous waste storage box placing stations are sequentially arranged on the bearing plate at intervals along the left-right direction, N detection stations are sequentially arranged at intervals on the vertical screen corresponding to the N dangerous waste storage box placing stations, a code reader for reading two-dimensional code information on the dangerous waste storage box is arranged on each detection station, and the code reader is connected with the controller. The utility model realizes remote automation and integrated management of hazardous waste garbage.

title_en: Far infrared electric heating film damage detection mechanism on base material
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a far infrared electrothermal film damage detection mechanism on a base material, which comprises a single chip microcomputer and the base material, wherein an electrothermal film electrically connected with the single chip microcomputer is arranged on the base material; the two ends of the electric heating film are respectively connected with a first control switch and a second control switch, and the first control switch and the second control switch are respectively in electric control connection with the power supply end and the single chip microcomputer; the electric control is connected with the current detection circuit or the waveform detection circuit on the single chip microcomputer, the current detection circuit or the waveform detection circuit are electrically controlled to be connected with the electric heating film, and the detection information is fed back to the single chip microcomputer when the electric heating film is damaged, the single chip microcomputer receives the detection information, and controls the first control switch and the second control switch to be turned off simultaneously, so that the power supply of the electric heating film is cut off, the electric heating film after the damage is touched by a user, or the electric shock problem can not occur when the metal piece is contacted with the electric heating film, and the use safety of a product is improved.

title_en: High-efficient marine gear box axle head seal structure durability aassessment test device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a durability evaluation test device for a shaft end sealing structure of a high-efficiency marine gearbox, which comprises a dragging motor, a coupler, a speed regulating gearbox and at least two testers, wherein each tester rotates together, and each tester comprises a tester shell, a transmission shaft, a simulation shaft, an adjusting seat and a sealing element; the testing device is characterized in that the dragging motor drives the speed regulating gear box to rotate through the coupler, the speed regulating gear box drives the transmission shaft of the tester, the simulation shaft is fixedly mounted on the transmission shaft, the adjusting seat is mounted on the shell of the tester, the sealing element is mounted between the adjusting seat and the simulation shaft, and the adjusting seat, the sealing element and the simulation shaft can be detached. The device can simultaneously obtain a plurality of life data samples of the marine gearbox shaft end sealing test piece with different structural forms in a test period, and obviously shortens the period of a related durability evaluation test and the confidence coefficient of an evaluation result.

title_en: Portable soil stirring divides appearance device
abstract_en: The application discloses a portable soil stirring and sample separating device, and relates to the technical field of soil sampling auxiliary equipment; comprises a basin body formed with a first groove and a stirring component which is detachably arranged at the bottom of the basin body; the stirring assembly comprises a driving part and a rotating shaft arranged at the driving end of the driving part, and the driving part drives the rotating shaft to rotate; a plurality of mounting holes are formed on the outer side wall of the rotating shaft; the auxiliary piece is detachably arranged on the mounting hole; adopt the technical scheme that this application provided to have when having solved current soil sampling stirring soil and sample divide the inconvenient technical problem of appearance.

title_en: Elevator braking force detection device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a detection device of elevator braking force, which belongs to the technical field of elevator detection, and comprises a main machine body, a display screen, buttons and a main rolling wheel, wherein an auxiliary wheel set matched with the main rolling wheel for use is installed on the outer side wall of the main machine body, the auxiliary wheel set comprises an upper limiting wheel and a lower limiting wheel, the upper limiting wheel and the lower limiting wheel are positioned on the same vertical line, limiting columns are installed at the axes of the upper limiting wheel and the lower limiting wheel, the limiting columns are inserted in the inner side of the main machine body, and the upper limiting wheel and the lower limiting wheel are used for extruding a steel wire rope passing through the main rolling wheel; this design adopts auxiliary wheel and main rolling wheel complex mode, increases the area of contact between wire rope and the main rolling wheel, increases the compactness of contact simultaneously, avoids taking place the condition of skidding, increases the accuracy that the braking force detected.

title_en: Range finder for house construction engineering
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a range finder for a building construction project, which belongs to the field of range finders and comprises a range finder body, wherein the range finder body comprises a range finder shell and a screen, a mounting groove is formed in the left wall of the range finder shell, a traction rope penetrates through the upper end of the range finder shell, the lower end of the traction rope is fixedly connected with a transition plate, the left end of the transition plate is fixedly connected with an L-shaped connecting plate, the lower end of the L-shaped connecting plate is fixedly connected with a first toothed plate, the right end of the first toothed plate is meshed and connected with a gear, a rotating rod is fixedly connected with an inner ring of the gear, the rear end of the rotating rod is rotatably connected with the range finder shell, and the lower end of the gear is meshed and connected with a second toothed plate, so that the range finder screen can be protected when the range finder is out of hand or a user is temporarily not used during the building construction range finder, the range finder screen is prevented from being damaged by being impacted by hard objects such as scaffolds and the like, the normal use of the screen is further ensured, and the normal use of the range finder is ensured, the working efficiency is improved, and the construction progress is not influenced.

title_en: Laser sensor mounting base
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a laser sensor mounting seat, which belongs to the field of sensor adjustment and comprises a body, wherein the top of the body is provided with a groove, a laser sensor is arranged in the groove, a fixing mechanism is arranged in the body and is arranged at two sides of the laser sensor, a first groove is arranged in the body, four second grooves are vertically arranged in the first groove, the fixing mechanism comprises a first spring, a lifting plate, an adjusting rod and a contact block, a pressure is applied during the installation of the laser sensor to enable the contact block to be far away from two sides, the contact block drives the adjusting rod at the moment, the adjusting rod pushes the lifting plate, the lifting plate compresses the first spring at the moment, the contact block can return to the original position under the elasticity of the first spring and is in close contact with the laser sensor, so that the effect of fixing the laser sensor is achieved, when the disassembly is needed, the pull rod is pulled to enable the abutting block to be far away, so that the disassembly can be carried out.

title_en: Anti structure and laser striping machine that fall of laser striping machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-falling structure of a laser line marking instrument, which comprises a turntable structure, wherein the upper end of the turntable structure is provided with an upright post, the lower end of the turntable structure is fixedly connected with a shell, and a first protection mechanism for preventing the laser line marking instrument from being broken is arranged in the shell; the utility model also discloses a laser line marking instrument, which comprises a machine core arranged in the upright post, and the upper end of the upright post is provided with a universal suspension mechanism. According to the utility model, when the laser graticule falls to the ground, the first spring and the rubber elastic ball are extruded to deform to absorb impact energy, and when the top of the laser graticule is impacted, the third spring is extruded to deform to absorb energy caused by impact, so that the damage of the universal suspension mechanism is avoided.

title_en: Steel ball type insulation strength cyclic inspection station
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of insulation detection, in particular to a steel ball type insulation strength circulation detection station which comprises a test cavity, a steel ball group arranged in the test cavity, an insulation jig seat inserted in the test cavity, a test insertion shaft inserted in the insulation jig seat and inserted in the steel ball group in the test cavity, a tested object arranged on the insulation jig seat and connected with the test insertion shaft, a positioning sleeve detachably sleeved outside the test cavity, and a test assembly connected with the positioning sleeve and used for contacting the tested object; the testing assembly comprises an insulating seat connected with the positioning sleeve, a first testing contact element and a second testing contact element, wherein the first testing contact element and the second testing contact element are arranged in the insulating seat; during testing, the first testing contact element is contacted with a tested object, and the second testing contact element is contacted with the testing plug shaft; the utility model has good test effect, reliable structure and stable test.

title_en: A yard testing arrangement is swept to blood analyzer
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a code scanning testing device of a blood analyzer, which comprises a fixed frame, a positioning jig and a code scanning platform, wherein the fixed frame is provided with a positioning groove; the fixed frame is provided with a guide rail pair; a microswitch and a front and rear limiting block are arranged beside the guide rail pair; the positioning jig is connected with the guide rail pair in a sliding manner, a product groove is formed in the upper side of the positioning jig, adsorption units are arranged on the front side and the rear side of the positioning jig, and a touch piece is arranged on the lateral side of the positioning jig; the adsorption unit is correspondingly adsorbed with the front and rear limiting blocks; the touch piece is arranged corresponding to the microswitch; the code scanning platform is connected with the fixing frame in a sliding manner, and a code scanning through groove and a light source are arranged on the code scanning platform; a sliding locking block is arranged beside the code scanning through groove; the light source is electrically connected with the micro switch. The distance between the code scanning platform and the positioning jig is adjusted once, the code scanning focal length of the mobile terminal can be set, subsequent quick code scanning tests can be realized without adjusting the angle and focusing for many times, and compared with the traditional mode of scanning codes one by hands, the code scanning efficiency is greatly improved, the labor cost is reduced, and the consistency of two-dimensional codes and test data is ensured.

title_en: Full-automatic wheel steering angle detector
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a full-automatic wheel steering angle detector which comprises a left frame and a detection disc, wherein an in-place switch and a rack are arranged in the left frame, the detection disc is installed on the left frame, a locking mechanism and a return spring are arranged at the bottom of the detection disc, a motor is installed on the lower surface of the detection disc, an automatic positioning mechanism is connected onto the detection disc, a supporting plate is arranged on one side surface of the detection disc, a connecting plate is arranged on the other side surface of the detection disc, a right frame is connected onto the connecting plate, and a motor base is arranged at the bottom of the motor. According to the utility model, the locking mechanisms are arranged at the bottoms of the two detection discs and the automatic positioning mechanism is arranged on the upper surface of the detection discs, so that the detection can be completed when the wheel of the vehicle is not in the center of the detection discs, and meanwhile, the detection discs can be automatically reset after the detection is completed by the relative movement distance of the detection discs, the whole process is electrically controlled, the automation is complete, and the detection efficiency is improved.

title_en: Water level monitoring device for hydropower station
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of hydropower station monitoring, in particular to a water level monitoring device for a hydropower station, which comprises a base, wherein a fixed cylinder is fixedly connected onto the base, a lifting cylinder is arranged in the fixed cylinder through a lifting mechanism, the upper part of the lifting cylinder is fixedly connected with a fixed block, a fixed block is fixedly connected onto the fixed block, a rotating block is rotatably connected onto the fixed block, a lower arm is fixedly connected onto the rotating block, the upper part of the lower arm is provided with an upper arm through a telescopic mechanism, the lower part of one end of the upper arm is rotatably connected with an ultrasonic water level meter, and an angle adjusting mechanism is arranged between the lower arm and the lifting cylinder. The ultrasonic water level meter can be driven to stretch, lift and adjust the angle, so that the ultrasonic water level meter can cover a larger monitoring range.

title_en: Sampling device for chemical detection
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sampling device for chemical detection, which comprises a sampling tube, wherein an anti-skid structure is arranged outside the sampling tube, a sealing plug is arranged at the bottom end inside the sampling tube, a pull rod penetrates through the top end inside the sampling tube, a rolling structure is arranged outside the pull rod, a handle is arranged at the top end of the pull rod, clamping seats are arranged outside the clamping blocks, one sides of the clamping seats are fixed with one side of the top end of the sampling tube, and a piston is arranged at the bottom end of the pull rod. The locking structure is arranged, the sampling device extracts a liquid sample by holding the handle to pull the piston, and the clamping block is clamped in the clamping seat to lock the handle before the sampling device is used, so that the sampling device is locked when not used, the sampling device is convenient to store, the loss of the sampling device is reduced, and the service life of the sampling device is prolonged.

title_en: Detection device for food processing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a detection device for food processing, which comprises a base, wherein the lower end of the base is provided with a supporting leg close to the corner, the supporting leg comprises a gasket, a supporting column, a thread and a sleeve, the upper end of the base is provided with an operating platform, the upper end of the operating platform is provided with a vibration turntable, the surface of the vibration turntable is provided with a placing groove, the side end of the inner side of the operating platform close to the vibration turntable is provided with a detection chamber, the upper end of the detection chamber is provided with a sealing door, and the outer surface of the front end of the operating platform is provided with a control panel. According to the detection device for food processing, the vibration motor and the vibration turntable are arranged, so that food to be detected can be subjected to full vibration mixing, separation and dilution, detection is facilitated, the levelness of the device can be adjusted by matching with the supporting legs, and the levelness and stability of the detection device are facilitated to be ensured.

title_en: Electric field intensity testing arrangement based on unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electric field intensity testing device based on an unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises the unmanned aerial vehicle, an electric field intensity testing unit, a host machine, a wireless transceiving unit and a wireless receiving unit, wherein the electric field intensity testing unit is suspended on the unmanned aerial vehicle and comprises a measuring probe, a filter amplifier, an AD converter and a processor, the measuring probe, the filter amplifier, the AD converter and the processor are sequentially connected, the electric field intensity testing unit is sequentially connected through the wireless transceiving unit, and the host machine is respectively connected with the wireless transceiving unit and the wireless receiving unit; the measuring probe comprises three parallel polar plates and three coils, the three parallel polar plates are mutually orthogonal, each parallel polar plate is arranged in one-to-one correspondence with the coil, and the parallel polar plates are arranged in parallel with the corresponding coils; the thickness of each parallel plate is 2-4 mm. The utility model has the advantages of accurate and reliable measurement, large measurement range and the like.

title_en: Utensil is examined to eccentric wheel for quadriversal car climbing mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model provides an eccentric wheel checking fixture for a four-way vehicle jacking mechanism, which is used for checking whether an eccentric wheel is qualified or not, and comprises a base, wherein a checking fixture shaft hole is vertically formed in one end of the base, a checking fixture shaft platform is arranged at the top of the other end of the base, and a checking fixture flat key is arranged on the outer side wall of the checking fixture shaft platform; the checking fixture shaft hole, the checking fixture shaft platform and the checking fixture flat key are arranged corresponding to the eccentric wheel shaft, the eccentric shaft hole and the eccentric key groove on the eccentric wheel. The utility model is designed according to the structure of the eccentric wheel, is used for checking whether the eccentric wheel is qualified or not, mainly checks whether an eccentric key slot, a shaft hole and a shaft are on the same line or not, and checks that all tolerance of the eccentric wheel meet the preset range, thereby ensuring the synchronism of the four-way vehicle lifting mechanism during lifting; and the structure design is simple and novel, the use is flexible and convenient, the detection efficiency is high, and the practical value is good.

title_en: Based on chemical vapor deposition equipment monitoring is with appearance that leaks hunting
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a leakage detector for monitoring based on chemical vapor deposition equipment, which comprises an instrument main body, a data connecting seat and a metal connecting pipe, wherein the data connecting seat is arranged at the top end of the instrument main body, anti-skidding structures are arranged on two sides of the instrument main body, the metal connecting pipe is arranged in the data connecting seat, and one end of the metal connecting pipe is fixedly connected with a gas detection head. According to the utility model, the fastening structure is arranged, when the other end of the metal connecting pipe is inserted into the data connecting base, the fastening hoop is sleeved on the outer side of the limiting groove, and then the fastening hoop is screwed, and the data connecting base is gradually folded after the fastening hoop is screwed after the data connecting base is divided by the dividing groove, and the data connecting base extrudes and clamps the inserted metal connecting pipe, so that the other end of the metal connecting pipe is not easy to drop or loosen in the inserted data connecting base, and the connection and the reinforcement of the metal connecting pipe are realized.

title_en: Sealing performance detection device for valve core of electromagnetic valve
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sealing detection device for a valve core of an electromagnetic valve, which comprises an equipment main body, wherein a placing groove is arranged outside the equipment main body, a screw rod is rotatably connected inside the equipment main body, the outer part of the screw rod is in threaded connection with a thread block, the outer part of the thread block is movably connected with a connecting rod, the inside of the equipment main body is in sliding connection with a movable frame, the inside of the movable frame is fixedly connected with a contact rod, the inside of the movable frame is fixedly connected with a connecting spring, and the inside of the movable frame is in sliding connection with a sliding rod. This a leakproofness detection device for solenoid valve case rotates through the screw rod and drives the screw thread piece and remove, and then makes the connecting rod remove and drives the removal frame and remove, removes the frame and removes and drive the slide bar and remove, and the slide bar removes and drives the fixed plate and remove, and after the fixed plate contacted with the solenoid valve, and then begins to fix the solenoid valve, avoids artifical simple fixed condition that leads to the accident to take place to solenoid valve case leakproofness detects has been improved to a great extent stability.

title_en: Glass substrate duplex position weighing system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a glass substrate double-station weighing system, which belongs to the field of weighing of glass substrates and comprises a load weighing component and a no-load weighing component, wherein a transmission device is arranged between the load weighing component and the no-load weighing component, and weighing modules are arranged on the load weighing component and the no-load weighing component.
