The glass weight measuring device is reasonable in structural design, the glass substrate is subjected to weight measurement in a double-station mode, the glass weight measurement is completed under the condition that the glass is not grabbed, and the glass is protected from being scratched or damaged while the measurement accuracy is ensured.

title_en: Sampler
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sampler, which comprises a sampling part, a sample part and a suction part, wherein the sampling part, the sample part and the suction part are sequentially connected; a flow passage penetrating through the sampling part and the sample part is arranged in the sampler, the sampling part is provided with an access hole for a sample to enter and exit the flow passage, the access hole is communicated with the flow passage, the sample part is provided with an opening communicated with the flow passage, the opening is also communicated with the suction part, a storage cavity for storing the sample is also arranged in the sample part, and the storage cavity is communicated with the flow passage; the suction part sucks air, and the sample can enter the storage cavity along the flow passage from the access hole; the suction part injects air to the flow channel, and the sample in the storage cavity is discharged from the access hole along the flow channel. The sampler of the utility model integrates the functions of sampling, sample arrangement and observation, is convenient to sample and can be used repeatedly.

title_en: Monitoring device for ecological environment improvement
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a monitoring device for ecological environment management, which comprises a shell, a detection mechanism and a sampling mechanism, wherein the shell is provided with a sampling hole; a housing: arc-shaped grooves are uniformly distributed on the outer portion of the shell, supporting rods are uniformly distributed on the upper end of the shell, the tops of the supporting rods are fixedly connected with the lower surface of an upper end plate body of the protective cover, and a circular plate is arranged on the upper end of the inner portion of the shell; the detection mechanism comprises: the lower surface of the circular plate is provided with a groove; the sampling mechanism comprises: the upper ends of the sampling mechanisms respectively penetrate through holes formed in the upper ends of the arc-shaped grooves, and the upper ends of the sampling mechanisms extend into the shell; wherein: still include the horn mouth, the horn mouth sets up in the lower extreme of shell, and this monitoring devices is used in ecological environment improvement can initiatively guide the surrounding air to detecting element flow, can enlarge the detection range of device, is convenient for monitor regional air, improves the degree of accuracy of regional detection data.

title_en: Glass strength detection device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a glass strength detection device which comprises a workbench, wherein a through hole is formed in the top end surface of the workbench, a recovery cavity is formed in the workbench, a collection box is arranged in the recovery cavity, the recovery cavity is communicated with the through hole, and a rotating shaft is arranged at the through hole. According to the utility model, after the strength of the glass is detected, massive broken glass can be rapidly collected by a worker, and fine glass fragments remained on the surface of the workbench can be driven to rotate by starting the driving motor, the driving motor drives the second gear to rotate, and the rotating shaft is driven to rotate under the action of the second gear, the chain and the first gear, so that the bearing plate is driven to rotate, so that the fine glass fragments on the surface of the workbench fall into the collecting box in the recovery cavity along the through hole, the recovery and cleaning work of glass slag is completed, the environment pollution is avoided, and the possibility of injury to the worker is reduced.

title_en: Device capable of adjusting and controlling thickness of sprayed concrete surface layer of foundation pit support
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a device capable of adjusting and controlling the thickness of a sprayed concrete surface layer of a foundation pit support, which comprises a limiting clamping sleeve, wherein a supporting block is arranged at the middle position of the top end of one side of the limiting clamping sleeve, a limiting sliding groove is formed in the supporting block, an L-shaped measuring arm is arranged inside the limiting sliding groove, an infrared visible light emitting head is arranged at one end of the L-shaped measuring arm, a battery bin is arranged at the middle position of the top end of the limiting clamping sleeve, a plurality of movable rollers are arranged at the top end inside the limiting clamping sleeve, a fixed clamping plate is arranged at one side inside the limiting clamping sleeve, a movable clamping plate matched with the fixed clamping plate is arranged at the other side inside the limiting clamping sleeve, and the movable clamping plate and the limiting clamping sleeve are matched and connected through an adjusting screw. Has the beneficial effects that: the problem that the thickness of the concrete surface layer is uneven due to uneven treatment of the foundation pit side slope can be avoided, the thickness of the concrete surface is detected, and the device is convenient to adjust and use.

title_en: Controllable formula PCB test of flow is with spray set
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of PCB testing, and provides a flow-controllable spraying device for PCB testing, which comprises a support and a spraying plate, wherein the spraying plate is arranged at the top end inside the support, a dismounting structure is arranged at the top end of the spraying plate, a butt joint pipe is arranged on one side of the spraying plate, and a flow adjusting structure is arranged inside the butt joint pipe. According to the utility model, the flow regulating structure is arranged, the rotating poking block can drive the second water guide block to rotate, the position of the water through hole in the second water guide block is driven to change by rotating the second water guide block, after the position of the water through hole of the second water guide block is changed, the surface intersected with the water through hole of the first water guide block also changes, the larger the intersection area of the water through hole of the first water guide block and the water through hole of the second water guide block is, the larger the flow of water entering the spraying plate through the butt joint pipe is, otherwise, the smaller the flow is, the water flow is regulated according to the actual test requirement, and the applicability is higher.

title_en: Microwave digestion instrument for water quality detection
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a microwave digestion instrument for water quality detection, and particularly relates to the technical field of water quality detection. According to the utility model, the limiting plate is used for extruding the limiting spring by pulling the pull rod through the limiting ring, the pull rod, the limiting groove, the limiting block and the limiting spring, the diameter between the limiting plates can be increased when the limiting plate extrudes the limiting spring, the container is placed between the limiting plates, then the pull rod is loosened, the limiting spring limits the container according to the elastic resilience of the limiting spring, and the container is prevented from shaking left and right when the interior of the instrument body works.

title_en: Unsaturated soil one-dimensional water-gas two-phase seepage test device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a one-dimensional water-gas two-phase seepage test device for unsaturated soil, which comprises a protective cylinder (1) and a gas-liquid separator (7), wherein an overflow port (5) is arranged on the protective cylinder (1), an inlet pipe (8) and an adjusting pipe (10) are arranged on the gas-liquid separator (7), the inlet pipe (8) is communicated with the lower end of the protective cylinder (1), an air overflow pipe (12) and a water outlet pipe (14) are arranged on the side wall of the gas-liquid separator (7), and a bending section of a water sealing part of the water outlet pipe (14) or the outlet end of the water outlet pipe (14) is higher than or equal to the horizontal height of the water outlet pipe (14). The device is characterized in that gravels (3), soil (2) and overlying water (4) are sequentially filled in a pile casing (1), and the flow speed and flow of water and air in the soil can be intuitively obtained by measuring an air overflow pipe (12) and a water outflow pipe (14). The technical problem that the flow velocity and the flow of water and air cannot be measured simultaneously in the seepage process of unsaturated soil is solved.

title_en: Take liquid sampling and discharging device of metering module
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of water quality monitoring, and discloses a liquid sampling and discharging device with a metering module, which is used for sampling and discharging liquid for a movable sampling container, wherein a liquid inlet and a liquid outlet are formed in the sampling container; the liquid sampling and discharging device comprises a rack, a lifting driving piece, a moving piece and a metering module, wherein a liquid inlet piece for a liquid sample to enter is arranged on the rack; the lifting driving piece is arranged on the rack and is used for driving the moving piece to move along the length direction of the lifting driving piece; the moving part comprises a sampling part and a liquid discharging part which are connected into a whole; the sampling piece is used for communicating the liquid inlet piece and the liquid inlet; the liquid discharging piece is used for opening the liquid discharging port; the metering module is arranged on the sampling piece and is used for sensing the liquid level in the sampling container to reach a set position. The liquid sampling and discharging device provided by the utility model can automatically sample, discharge and measure, and solves the problems that the existing sampler is influenced by aging of a peristaltic pump tube, so that the measurement is inaccurate and frequent calibration is needed.

title_en: Full-automatic vitamin analyzer
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a full-automatic vitamin analyzer. The rack is provided with a rotatable reaction disk, a three-electrode detection system, an electrode cleaning device and a reaction cup cleaning device, and the reaction disk is provided with a reaction cup; a sample adding station, a detection station and a reaction cup cleaning station are sequentially arranged on the rack along the rotation direction of the reaction disc; the detection station is provided with a detection arm which can be lifted and can move back and forth, and the detection arm is provided with at least two sets of three-electrode detection systems, so that samples in a plurality of reaction cups can be detected at the same time, and the efficiency is high; an electrode cleaning station is arranged on one side of the reaction disc and corresponds to the detection station, so that online cleaning is realized, the space of the reaction disc is not occupied, the continuous work of the reaction disc is not influenced, and the detection efficiency is further improved; the lower end of the glassy carbon electrode can be polished, so that the glassy carbon electrode can be cleaned and repaired, and the subsequent detection quality is ensured; the reaction cup can be cleaned on line by a plurality of sets of cleaning devices, the water consumption is low, the cleaning is thorough, and the reaction cup can be repeatedly used.

title_en: Heavy truck disc brake braking force test bench
abstract_en: The utility model provides a heavy truck disc brake braking force testboard belongs to heavy truck disc brake test technical field. The utility model provides a heavy truck disc brake braking force testboard, includes bearing frame and base, the bottom fixedly connected with platform seat of bearing frame, the inside rotation of bearing frame is connected with the main shaft, the fixed cover of one end of main shaft has connect the brake disc, one side of brake disc is provided with pneumatic brake. The utility model discloses a set up electric hydraulic cylinder, pressure sensor, the arm of force, main shaft, bearing frame, brake disc and pneumatic brake cooperation and use, directly drive the arm of force through electric hydraulic cylinder, the arm of force drives the rotation of brake disc for the structure of installation is compacter, has shortened the arm of force and has rotated the distance to brake disc transmission moment of torsion, and to the stress burden of main shaft when having reduced pneumatic brake braking, it is more steady to make the test operation, improves the degree of accuracy of braking moment numerical value.

title_en: Waterproof testing device for manufacturing instruments and meters
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a waterproof testing device for manufacturing instruments and meters, which comprises a base, an open testing box, a top plate and a box cover, wherein the open testing box is fixedly arranged at the middle part of the top end of the base, fixing mechanisms are arranged at both sides of the top end of the inner wall of the open testing box in a rotating way, both fixing mechanisms comprise a fixing frame, a threaded rod, a pressing plate and a spring, both sides of the top part of the inner wall of the fixing frame are fixedly connected with the spring, the bottom ends of the two springs are fixedly connected with the pressing plate, the threaded rod is alternately connected with the top part of the fixing frame, the bottom end of the threaded rod is abutted against the top end of the pressing plate, and one side of the open testing box is fixedly provided with a motor. The accuracy of detection is improved.

title_en: Test device for measuring interface performance of sheet and matrix under action of explosive load
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a measure test device of sheet and base member interface performance under the blast load effect relates to interface performance measuring device technical field, include: the sheet plate is bonded on the top surfaces of the two base bodies, one ends of the two base bodies close to each other are hinged to each other, two supports used for supporting the base bodies are arranged on the bottom surfaces of the ends of the two base bodies close to each other, and the supports are hinged to the base bodies. The utility model provides a scheme can guarantee to study FRP-concrete interface department bonding sliding behavior under the blast load effect under reasonable and controllable destruction mode.

The base is provided with a containing groove with an upward opening and suitable for placing a sample and a water outlet communicated with the containing groove; the washing piece is used for washing the surface of the sample; the washing device slides along a first direction relative to the base, and is provided with a plurality of washing holes which are suitable for being accommodated by the washing piece and enabling the washing piece to be suitable for being abutted against the surface of the sample along a second direction vertical to the first direction; the number of the water passing pipes is the same as that of the washing holes, the water passing pipes correspond to the washing holes one to one, liquid is guided to the surface of the sample, and the distances between the water inlets and the water outlets of the water passing pipes are equal. The distance between the water inlet and the delivery port of each water pipe equals, namely the water route of each water pipe is the same journey to prevent that each water pipe from leading to the water pressure inconsistent because the water route is different journey, the water pressure inconsistent then the velocity of water-out is inconsistent, thereby the time of water to the delivery port by the water inlet in each water pipe is influenced, influence test result.

title_en: Intensity detection equipment for side door plate of rear carriage of railway wagon
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a carriage side door board intensity check out test set behind railway freight car, including examining test table, the top of examining test table is equipped with the layer board, the upper surface of examining test table is close to four corners fixed mounting and has the supporting seat, supporting seat rear end face fixed mounting has the hydraulic stem, the upper surface of examining test table and the both sides movable mounting that is located the layer board have the door plant sheath, the inside of door plant sheath is equipped with the clamp plate, the one end fixed surface of door plant sheath installs spacing motor. A railway freight car back carriage side door board intensity check out test set, through layer board, examine test table, door plant sheath, clamp plate, spacing motor and the mode that the hydraulic stem was mutually supported, can be convenient carry out intensity detection to the door plant of different width and length to at the in-process that the door plant was bent, can effectually avoid the door plant to take place the skew, guaranteed the accuracy of detection data like this.

title_en: Core board testing device with high automation degree
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a core board testing device with high automation degree, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein one end of the bottom plate is provided with an adjusting component, one end of the adjusting component is provided with an adsorption component, one side of the bottom plate is provided with a detection component and a placing box, and a rotating component and a clamping component are arranged in the placing box; the adjusting part is including setting up the hydraulic stem one in the square inslot that bottom plate one end was seted up, hydraulic stem one end is equipped with the connecting block, examine time measuring when needs are examined nuclear core plate, start conveyer belt one and conveyer belt two, adjusting part control adsorption component's position, adsorb nuclear core plate through adsorption component, place the core on the centre gripping subassembly, carry out the centre gripping through the centre gripping subassembly to nuclear core plate, detect and test nuclear core plate through detection component after then, nuclear core plate after the test is accomplished is adsorbed by the adsorption component of the bottom plate other end and is placed conveyer belt two, accomplish the transport, set up the test that can carry out the streamlined formula on this, the efficiency that detects is improved, and then the production efficiency of improvement enterprise.

title_en: Measuring device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a measuring device, which has a clearance measuring mode and comprises a test board, an angle sensor, a mounting bracket arranged on the test board, a driving mechanism and a clamping device, wherein the driving mechanism comprises a transmission shaft connected with a first transmission piece to drive the first transmission piece to rotate, and the first transmission piece is detachably connected with the transmission shaft; the clamping device is used for clamping and fixing the second transmission piece so that the second transmission piece is kept still; the angle sensor is arranged on the transmission shaft and used for detecting the rotation angle of the transmission shaft; in the clearance measurement mode, the driving mechanism works to drive the first transmission piece to rotate, the clamping device clamps and fixes the second transmission piece to be kept still, and the meshing clearance between the first transmission piece and the second transmission piece is determined according to the rotating angle of the transmission shaft detected by the angle sensor. According to the utility model discloses a measuring equipment, simple structure, convenient operation can accurately measure the engagement clearance between first driving medium and the second driving medium, improve measurement of efficiency.

title_en: Roadbed compactness detects assistor
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a road bed compactness measures technical field, discloses a road bed compactness detects assistor, and its structure includes mount and sampling tube, and the thread groove has been seted up to the both sides of mount, and the screw rod is installed to the inner chamber spiral of thread groove, and the lower extreme of screw rod is rotated and is installed and remove the wheel, and demountable installation has servo motor on one side of the upper end of mount, and the lead screw is installed to servo motor's output, and upper end one side fixed mounting of sampling tube has the slide bar. This application is through the servo motor who sets up, the sampler barrel, the piston rod, the solenoid valve, the arc board, baroceptor and trachea, when carrying out compaction measurement borrowing, both can make lead screw cooperation lead screw cover drive slide bar move, the slide bar drives the sampler barrel and removes downwards and insert the borrowing, can make the piston rod produce the negative pressure again and take out the gas in the gasbag through the trachea, thereby make arc board and cylinder soil block separation, thereby convenient quick cylinder soil block that takes out, further improve compaction measurement efficiency.

title_en: Portable sampling frame of occupational health sampling
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a portable sampling frame of occupational health sampling, include the base, remove wheel, leveling subassembly, high coarse adjustment mechanism, height fine setting subassembly and mounting panel, remove the wheel rotation and locate on the base, the leveling subassembly is located on the base, height coarse adjustment mechanism locates on the base, height fine setting subassembly is located on the high coarse adjustment mechanism, the mounting panel is located on the high fine setting subassembly, the leveling subassembly includes knob, first lead screw, lifting sleeve and support, be equipped with on the base and remove the chamber, it passes through round hole and external intercommunication to remove the chamber, first lead screw is rotatory to be located in the round hole, the knob is located on the first lead screw, lifting sleeve slides to cup joint and locates on the first lead screw. The utility model relates to a sampling technical field specifically provides a be convenient for remove, and the flexibility is higher, is convenient for carry out the leveling, and the portable sampling frame of occupational health sampling that the altitude mixture control precision is higher.

title_en: Electron beam tensile strength testing arrangement
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an electron line tensile strength test technical field just discloses an electron line tensile strength testing arrangement, comprising a base plate, the first slide rail seat of top fixedly connected with of bottom plate, the inner chamber diapire fixedly connected with connecting block of first slide rail seat, the first spring of right side fixedly connected with of connecting block, the inside swing joint of first slide rail seat has the first slider that is located the connecting block right side. This electron line tensile strength testing arrangement, possess advantages such as the maximum value that detects a certain length of electron line, it mainly comprises conductor and insulating layer to have solved the electron line, in the production electron line, in order to guarantee the quality of electron line, will cut one section electron line generally and test tensile strength, the tradition is used for electron line tensile strength testing arrangement, because the tensile strength of the different time quantums of electron line test is different, numerical value also is the transient change, the problem that the user can't audio-visual maximum numerical value of learning.

title_en: Temperature measurement structure of intelligent terminal and intelligent terminal
abstract_en: The utility model provides an intelligent terminal's temperature measurement structure and intelligent terminal, this intelligent terminal's temperature measurement structure, include: a lower housing; the intelligent terminal comprises a lower shell, a mounting position, a temperature measuring sensor and a mounting groove, wherein the mounting position is arranged on the lower shell and used for accommodating the measuring sensor, the temperature measuring sensor is arranged in the mounting position, and the mounting groove is formed in the lower shell and used for mounting a main circuit board of the intelligent terminal; the mounting position and the mounting groove are mutually separated, and the temperature measuring sensor is electrically connected with the main circuit board through the flexible circuit board. Compared with the prior art, the temperature measurement structure of the intelligent terminal and the intelligent terminal can improve the measurement accuracy of the temperature measurement sensor.

title_en: Sludge sampler convenient to observe
abstract_en: The utility model provides a pair of sludge sampler convenient to observe, including the support, track box fixed mounting has a gear track in the upside of support, and the inside movable mounting of track box has a waterproof servo motor, and the bottom intermediate position department fixed mounting of support has a waterproof servo motor, and waterproof servo motor's upper surface output runs through the support and carries out the gomphosis with the inside gear track of track box and be connected, and the bottom both sides position department of support all has the screw thread bull stick through track box movable mounting, and the layer board is installed to the bottom of screw thread bull stick. The utility model provides a pair of sludge sampling ware convenient to observe, waterproof servo motor through the installation of support bottom can directly utilize first grab bucket storehouse, the second grab bucket storehouse of nut cover piece control bottom both sides to carry out the mud sampling through the screw thread bull stick, and the sampling dynamics is bigger, and steerable effect is higher to combine waterproof camera can effectually solve a current sludge sampling ware can't acquire submarine state, the problem of being not convenient for observe.

title_en: A measure frock that is used for downthehole narrow groove size of major diameter
abstract_en: The utility model provides a measure frock for downthehole narrow groove size of major diameter, is including detachable measuring head and micrometer main part, micrometer main part one end is screw thread portion, and the opposite side is spherical measuring head, and the diameter of this spherical measuring head is less than the width of narrow groove is contradicted during the measurement one side tank bottom of narrow groove, the measuring head is the member, and one end is provided with the screw hole, with the screw thread portion of micrometer main part is connected, and the other end is the measuring head, and this measuring head is described for the bulb, and the diameter is less than the width of narrow groove is contradicted during the measurement the opposite side tank bottom of narrow groove. The utility model provides a problem that the narrow groove was measured difficultly, avoided the narrow groove diameter size overproof to lead to produce the hidden danger that property performance descends, reduced the part effectively and scrapped the risk, made things convenient for in the operating personnel course of working to the control of quality, have simple structure, simple operation, measure accurate, be suitable for extensive advantage, be applicable to the measurement in various specification holes, especially the measurement of the downthehole narrow groove of major diameter.

title_en: Passive vibration sensor
abstract_en: The passive vibration sensor comprises a shell, and a plurality of magnets and induction coils which are arranged in the shell, wherein the magnets are distributed along the inner wall of the shell in an annular array manner to form a closed magnetic field; the top of the shell is provided with a hole and a connector for suspending the induction coil, and the connector is externally connected with acquisition equipment and used for transmitting induction signals; the induction coil is arranged in the magnetic field, and the motion cutting magnetic induction line generates an electric signal for measuring vibration.

title_en: Encoder with dustproof engineering
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an encoder with dustproof engineering, including the shell with the pivot that the shell internal rotation is connected, rotate in the pivot and be connected with the connecting axle, the silence bearing is installed to the pivot upper end, the axle sleeve is installed to silence bearing upper end, there is the upper cover through the screw connection on the shell, cover the fixedly connected with mounting panel on, install fixed part on the mounting panel, fixed part includes rotary rod, torsion spring, rack plate, sucking disc, flat board, the rotary rod rotates to be connected on the mounting panel, rack plate sliding connection is in the mounting panel, the utility model discloses the rotary rod can drive rack plate when rotatory and remove to make the flat board keep away from the mounting panel, make a terminal surface that the flat board deviates from the rack plate flush with the shell lateral wall, laminate sucking disc and desktop this moment for the sucking disc can adsorb on the desktop.

title_en: Motor rotor dynamic balance testing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a dynamic balance testing device of a motor rotor, which adjusts and positions the position of a movable plate through a T-shaped groove, a movable frame, the movable plate and a positioning screw, so that the movable frame is arranged at a proper position to meet the length of a shaft body and ensure the stable clamping of a workpiece to be tested; the connecting frame and the right side mounting barrel are driven to rotate by a driving motor in an electric driving mode after being clamped, so that the right side mounting barrel and the left side mounting barrel stably rotate along the left side circular rail and the right side circular rail and simultaneously drive the rotor to rotate, the rotor is positioned in the middle support during detection, the friction pads are in contact with the rotor, rotation detection is carried out, the abrasion degree of the friction pads is observed after the rotation detection is finished, and the balance degree is visually obtained through the damage degree of each friction pad; the initial stress of the spring is compared with the stress degree of the rotor in the rotating process through the pressure sensor, and the stress in the rotating process of the rotor is obtained to test the dynamic balance state of the rotor according to the stress.

title_en: Force sensor in insulator form
abstract_en: The application relates to a force transducer in an insulator shape, which comprises a shell, a tension detection assembly and an inclination angle detection assembly, wherein the tension detection assembly and the inclination angle detection assembly are arranged in the shell; the insulator of direct replacement transmission line during the use, there is special insulator to change fixture because of the change of insulator, wherein change work load, change the convenience and all be much higher than the force sensor of gold utensil form, to a great extent save manpower, material resources, fine solution icing on-line monitoring device's force sensor model variety, the problem of uncertainty, reinforcing icing monitoring device's commonality, thereby make the producer stock feasibility increase, greatly shorten icing monitoring device's supply time, reinforcing transmission line state monitoring device's ageing, the emergent supply of material problem of icing monitoring device has been solved.

title_en: Folding electronic scale
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a folding electronic scale, belonging to the technical field of electronic scales, comprising a scale body assembly, wherein one side of the scale body assembly is provided with a folding assembly, a plurality of moving wheels are arranged below the scale body assembly, and a cleaning device is arranged at the position close to the edge of the scale body assembly; the utility model has the advantages that through the arrangement of the cleaning device, workers can wipe off dust on the scale body assembly through the movement of the cleaning brush when needed and can gather large sundries together, so that the cleaning difficulty is reduced, the labor burden of the workers is lightened, and the convenience of the electronic scale is further improved; the utility model discloses a set up buffer for the impact when the electronic scale can put down the object carries out certain buffering, thereby has reduced the electronic scale because of the impaired possibility of impact that the object was put down when weighing heavier object, and then has improved the practicality of electronic scale.

title_en: Multifunctional aquaculture water sampler
abstract_en: The utility model provides a multifunctional aquaculture water sampler, which comprises two fixed brackets, wherein the two fixed brackets are respectively provided with a lifting unit, and the lifting unit is fixedly connected with a collector; the side wall of the collector is provided with a plurality of water outlet holes, a filtering component is arranged below the water outlet holes, and a water sample collecting component is arranged below the filtering component; the filtering component comprises a plurality of filtering sieves which are sequentially arranged from top to bottom, the pore diameters of the filtering sieves are sequentially reduced from top to bottom, and the filtering sieves are fixedly connected with the inner wall of the collector. The utility model discloses not only can realize dynamic sampling, static sampling, but also can sample and classify the different composition of water.

title_en: Saw blade
abstract_en: The present application relates to a saw blade. The saw blade comprises a matrix and a knife edge; the whole base body is circular, and a plurality of accommodating holes are formed in the base body; the knife edge is fixedly connected to the edge of the substrate and comprises a plurality of tooth-shaped diamond particles, the diamond particles are provided with end parts, the end parts are used for grinding concrete sand, and the end parts of the diamond particles are provided with grooves. The automatic concrete core sample cutting machine comprises: the saw blade clamping device comprises a rack, a pressure rod, a rotary driving device, a pushing cylinder, a clamping device and a saw blade, wherein the middle part of the pressure rod is rotationally connected to the rack, and the rotary driving device is connected to a rotary shaft to drive the rotary shaft to rotate; saw bit fixed connection is in the one end of pressure pole, and the piston rod fixed connection of push cylinder is in the other end of pressure pole. The saw blade is tightly occluded with the concrete sandstone, so that the abrasion of the sandstone to the saw blade is reduced; the lever structure design of the automatic concrete core sample cutting machine saves the energy cost in the cutting process.

title_en: Low-power consumption bluetooth 4G wrist-watch
abstract_en: A low-power-consumption Bluetooth 4G watch comprises a Bluetooth main control chip, a 4G main control chip and an analog change-over switch, wherein the Bluetooth main control chip is connected with the 4G main control chip, and the Bluetooth main control chip is connected with a sensor module for acquiring external signals, a user interaction module for man-machine interaction and a GPS/Beidou positioning module; the 4G main control chip is connected with an SIM card seat, and the SIM card seat is used for installing an ESIM card or an SIM card; the Bluetooth main control chip with 4G main control chip's audio signal all is connected with the simulation change over switch, and the simulation change over switch is controlled by Bluetooth main control chip in order to be used for the audio frequency to switch, and the simulation change over switch is connected with loudspeaker and microphone. The utility model can self-adaptively switch the main control according to the application scene, if the Bluetooth communication of the Bluetooth main control chip is in a connection state, the 4G work of the 4G main control chip is closed, and the watch data and the communication are realized by Bluetooth; if the Bluetooth communication of the Bluetooth main control chip is in a disconnected state, starting the 4G work of the 4G main control chip to realize communication and data transmission.

title_en: Portable PCB detector protection box
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of the PCB detector, especially, be a portable PCB detector protection box, including U type seat, the inside lower extreme one side of U type seat is rotated through the pivot and is installed the upset apron, the opposite side of U type seat relatively connected upset apron still installs the bottom plate through the pivot rotation, still includes the inboard detector organism of fixed mounting at the upset apron, be provided with supporting component between U type seat and the detector organism, the utility model discloses a set up a protected dustcoat structure again in the outside of original detector organism, can play better guard action to it, and set up whole guard shield into split type structure and set up the spacing subassembly of portable between guard shield and detector organism, guaranteed the convenience of using, and when equipment upset slope uses, still with the mesa contact of U type seat bottom and placing throughout, avoid causing wearing and tearing to the detector organism, still guaranteed stability and the security of using simultaneously.

title_en: A multi-functional pole for hydraulic engineering
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multi-functional pole for hydraulic engineering, including the steel riser, the upper end of steel riser has down set gradually first support lateral frame, second support lateral frame, third support lateral frame, fourth support lateral frame, fifth support lateral frame from top to bottom, the second supports the one end top fixed mounting that the lateral frame kept away from the steel riser and has a rain gauge cylinder, the third supports the one end bottom fixed mounting that the lateral frame kept away from the steel riser and has solar panel, and the top fixed mounting that the steel riser one end was kept away from to the fourth support lateral frame has intelligent ball machine, the top fixed mounting that steel riser one end was kept away from to the fifth support lateral frame has intelligent rifle bolt, and the fluviograph is equipped with to the bottom. This a multifunctional rod for hydraulic engineering can gather sunshine and store the electric energy through the solar panel cooperation lithium cell that sets up, and setting up of lightning rod can be applicable to various climatic environment, and the rainfall bucket can collect the rainwater and judge the rainfall, but the setting of intelligence rifle bolt and intelligent ball machine is the condition around the real-time supervision, and the water level can be monitored to the fluviograph, and the function is various, and mobility is strong.

title_en: Water taking device for environment monitoring unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an environmental monitoring equipment technical field just discloses a water intaking ware for environmental monitoring unmanned aerial vehicle, including unmanned aerial vehicle, unmanned aerial vehicle's bottom both ends are fixed with first connecting plate and second connecting plate respectively, the bottom of first connecting plate and second connecting plate all is fixed with the landing leg, two be fixed with the fixed plate between the landing leg, the right side of second connecting plate is fixed with servo motor, servo motor's output is fixed with the axis of rotation. This a water intaking ware for environmental monitoring unmanned aerial vehicle, through cartridge filter and the cooperation between the filtration pore to the realization filters the inside water that gets into the cartridge filter, and through signal receiver received signal, control electrical cylinder through the controller stretches out and draws back, makes the rubber buffer move down, thereby makes the inside that the sampling bottle was irritated to the water after filtering, avoids aquatic impurity to get into the sampling bottle to a certain extent, thereby reduces the influence to the testing result to a certain extent.

title_en: Become oar sliding ring testing arrangement
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a become oar sliding ring testing arrangement relates to and becomes oar sliding ring technical field, including the device base, the top of device base is fixed with the guide rail, and the internally mounted of guide rail has the ball, and the ball has the multiunit, and the multiunit ball is linear distribution on the guide rail, and the top of ball is provided with the supporting seat, and the guide way has been seted up to the side of supporting seat, and one side of guide way is provided with the annular, and one side of annular is provided with becomes oar sliding ring body. The utility model discloses a through setting up guide rail, ball, guide way, annular, solid fixed ring, slider, the slider of installation on the solid fixed ring enters into the annular through the guide way and slides, can install the become oar sliding ring body of connecting on the solid fixed ring in the inside of supporting seat, the supporting seat slides on the ball of guide rail, has realized the loading and unloading function to becoming oar sliding ring body like this; through setting up first magnetic path, second magnetic path for the supporting seat can be connected with the change oar sliding ring body steadily, has strengthened the stability of installation.

title_en: Automatic driving camera module detection device
abstract_en: The application provides an autopilot camera module detection device relates to autopilot technical field, especially relates to camera detection technical field. The specific implementation scheme is as follows: the automatic driving camera module detection device comprises a workbench, a leveling device, a detection table and a clamping device. The workbench comprises a top plate. The leveling device is connected with the workbench and is suitable for leveling the top plate. The detection platform is arranged on the top plate. The camera module comprises a bracket and a camera arranged on the bracket, and the clamping device is arranged on the detection table and is suitable for fixing the bracket. From this, autopilot camera module detection device can detect camera module before the loading, avoids unqualified camera module to assemble to the car on, and then the maintenance efficiency of vehicle is high, maintenance cost is low.

title_en: Integral type food tray and semi-solid state grease stock automatic checkout device thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of liquid level detection, especially, relate to an integral type food tray and semi-solid state grease stock automatic checkout device thereof, it includes the food tray main part, and the top integral type of food tray main part is fixed with eccentric ring, and eccentric ring is eccentric setting with the food tray main part, and the lateral wall of eccentric ring is used for contacting with the magnetic path. It still includes the oil storage tank, and oil storage tank internally mounted has the food tray main part, and the pivot is installed along the axis in the top of food tray main part, and the lateral wall fixed mounting of pivot has the mounting panel, and the one end rotation that the pivot was kept away from to the mounting panel is installed and is surveyed oily board, and it is vertical setting to survey oily board, and the magnetic path is installed to survey oily board's lower extreme, and the magnetic path is located same horizontal plane with eccentric ring, and the sensor is installed to the outer lane of oil storage tank, and the magnetic path is used for triggering the sensor. The device is beneficial to improving the use stability of the oil pan in the detection process and reducing the occurrence of the situation that the eccentric ring is separated due to the scratch of the magnetic block.

title_en: Pneumatic clamp for crankshaft detection table
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of crankshaft clamping devices, in particular to a pneumatic clamp for a crankshaft detection table, which solves the problem of poor clamping stability when the pneumatic clamp with double clamps in the prior art is applied to a crankshaft. The utility model provides a pneumatic clamp for bent axle detects platform, includes the support frame, and the support frame is rectangular frame structure, and the inboard of support frame is provided with two regulating plates that are upper and lower symmetric distribution and two curb plates that are bilateral symmetry distribution, and two regulating plates and two curb plates are cross distribution, all are provided with splint between every regulating plate and the adjacent two curb plates, and four splint all one end rotate with adjacent regulating plate to be connected and the other end rotates with adjacent curb plate to be connected. According to the utility model, through the matching of the air cylinder, the movable block and the lifting seat, the four clamping plates are retracted and retracted, so that four clamping points can be provided for the crank handle by the four side plates to prevent the crank handle from rolling sideways, and the effect of stably clamping the crank is realized.

title_en: Meteorological data transmission joint for microwave radiometer
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of data connectors, in particular to a meteorological data transmission connector for a microwave radiometer, which comprises a meteorological data collector and a butt joint component matched with the meteorological data collector, wherein the butt joint component comprises a connecting sleeve inserted into a slot of the meteorological data collector and a butt joint matched with the connecting sleeve in an inserted manner. This weather data transmission connects for microwave radiometer through setting up the interfacing part, can realize being connected between weather data collector and the interfacing part to seal waterproof between weather data collector and the interfacing part, separates the effect of thermal protection through thermal insulation frame and filling layer to the interfacing part, and during the use, separates the thermal insulation through the aerogel felt in thermal insulation frame and the thermal insulation frame of glass fiber material to the interfacing part, when outside temperature is higher, avoids the influence of high temperature to the interfacing part, seals the junction between weather data collector and the interfacing part through first sealing ring and sealed gasbag.

title_en: Automatic detection device for thickness of rotary copper-clad steel copper layer
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of copper thickness detection, in particular to a rotary copper-clad steel copper layer thickness automatic detection device which comprises a fixed structure, wherein the fixed structure comprises a detection shell and fixed blocks fixedly connected with the left side and the right side of the detection shell, the front parts and the back parts of the tops of the two fixed blocks are respectively connected with a fixed bolt in a threaded manner, a round hole is formed in the middle part of the front part of the detection shell, the detection structure is fixedly connected with a detection structure in the round hole, the detection structure comprises a rotating motor, a driving gear is fixedly connected with the back part of a transmission shaft of the rotating motor, a motor support plate fixedly connected with the detection shell is arranged at the bottom of the rotating motor, a driven toothed ring meshed with the driving gear is arranged at the bottom of the driving gear, an inner rotary ring is fixedly connected with a copper thickness detector at the inner side of the inner wall of the inner rotary ring, and a ring groove is formed in the front part of the outer side of the inner rotary ring, and a plurality of rotating shafts are arranged in the groove.

title_en: Noise reduction rectifying device of ultrasonic gas flowmeter
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a noise reduction rectifying device of an ultrasonic gas flowmeter. The noise reduction rectifying device of the ultrasonic gas flowmeter comprises: the measuring assembly comprises an ultrasonic gas flowmeter and a pipeline, the ultrasonic gas flowmeter is fixedly arranged on the pipeline, the noise reduction rectifying assembly is arranged in the pipeline and comprises a positioning groove, a positioning block, two connecting blocks, sound absorption cotton I, sound absorption cotton II, a rectifying plate I and a rectifying plate II, the positioning groove is formed in the inner wall of the pipeline, the positioning block is slidably arranged in the positioning groove, the two connecting blocks are arranged in the pipeline, the bottoms of the corresponding connecting blocks are fixedly connected with the top of the positioning block, and the sound absorption cotton I is fixedly arranged on the outer wall of one side, close to the two connecting blocks, of the other side. The noise-reducing rectifying device for the ultrasonic gas flowmeter has the advantages of being capable of reducing noise and rectifying, and therefore accuracy of measuring results is improved.

title_en: Pressure measuring device for detecting water level of water tank at bottom of industrial heating furnace
abstract_en: The utility model provides a pressure device is got in detection of industrial heating stove bottom portion basin water level, relates to the technical field of basin detecting instrument, and its structure is: including basin, water storage tank and detecting instrument, basin side lower part connection connecting pipe, the connecting pipe is connected on the water storage tank, be provided with the ball valve on the connecting pipe, water storage tank side bottom is provided with gets the pressure pipe, it is connected with detecting instrument through the flange to get the pressure pipe, water storage tank bottom is provided with the drain pipe, drain valve is connected to the drain pipe below. The utility model has the beneficial effects that: simple structure has avoided impurity precipitation to influence detecting instrument's accuracy, sets up detecting instrument in the basin outside, can avoid detecting instrument frequent damage to overhaul.

title_en: Novel hydraulic engineering is with convenient measurement of observing water level device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel measuring device for conveniently observing water level for hydraulic engineering, which comprises a box body, scale marks, grooves, sliding blocks, connecting rods, a circular frame, a rotating shaft, floating balls and an indicator, wherein the scale marks are arranged on the front surface and the back surface of the box body, the grooves are formed in the right side of the box body, the sliding blocks are arranged in inner cavities of the grooves, the connecting rods are arranged on the right side of the sliding blocks, the circular frame is arranged on the right side of the connecting rods, the rotating shaft is arranged in the inner cavity of the circular frame, the floating balls are sleeved on the outer ring of the rotating shaft and are arranged in the inner cavity of the circular frame, and the indicator is arranged on the left side of the circular frame. This novel hydraulic engineering is with convenient measuring device who observes water level, through the cooperation of slider, floater, scale mark and indicator, owing to buoyancy effect, the floater can upwards move, floats on the surface of water until the position that the horizontal plane is co-altitude. In the process of moving the circular frame, the indicator on the left side can also move simultaneously, so that the water level is measured by being matched with the scale marks on the box body.

title_en: Configurable multichannel Rogowski coil current measurement automatic calibration device
abstract_en: The utility model aims to solve the technical problem of providing a configurable multichannel Rogowski coil current measurement automatic calibration device which replaces manual operation calibration by utilizing automatic adjustment and calibration of the device and improves efficiency and accuracy. The device comprises an ARM MCU chip, an FPGA chip, a wireless communication module, a touch display screen, an EEPROM memory, an EMMC memory, a power supply, 8-channel synchronous sampling ADC, 64 integrators, 64 amplifiers and 64 Rogowski coil current sensors; the device can calibrate up to 64 sets of rogowski coil integrators simultaneously, greatly improves the efficiency, can be used by combining two devices, can realize the requirement of being greater than 64 channels, and is controlled by an ARM MCU chip to adjust an integrating circuit, thereby realizing automatic calibration of current measurement of the rogowski coil, realizing automatic measurement, calculation and calibration, avoiding errors caused by manual operation and being suitable for popularization and application in the technical field of on-line monitoring.

title_en: Bimetallic strip temperature controller fixing structure
abstract_en: The utility model provides a bimetallic strip temperature controller fixing structure which comprises a protection tube, wherein a first thread cylinder is fixedly arranged in the middle of the outer side of the protection tube, and a first embedded thread sleeve is correspondingly embedded in the first thread cylinder. According to the bimetallic strip temperature controller fixing structure provided by the utility model, the bottom detection end of the bimetallic strip temperature controller is inserted through the inner cavity structure of the protection tube, the second embedded threaded sleeve on the outer surface of the second threaded cylinder can be rotated according to different lengths of the bimetallic strip temperature controller, the positions of the cylindrical sleeve frames can be adjusted to adapt to bimetallic strip temperature controllers with different lengths, the embedded tightening clamps can be tightened to seal and clamp through the everting elastic sheets, the positions of the external mounting plates can be adjusted through the movable relation of the first threaded cylinder and the first embedded threaded sleeve, the mounting angle of the external mounting plates can be changed through rotating and adjusting through the movable relation of the chuck rod and the circular sleeve frame according to actual mounting environments, and the mounting flexibility of the device is improved.

title_en: Needle frame lifting device of nitrogen blowing instrument
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a needle frame lifting device of a nitrogen blowing instrument, which comprises the nitrogen blowing instrument, wherein a test tube bin is arranged on the nitrogen blowing instrument, the side edge of the nitrogen blowing instrument is connected with a base, a screw is arranged on the base, and a lifting frame is arranged on the screw; the side of the lifting frame is connected with a mounting frame, a mounting block is mounted on the mounting frame, an adjusting nut is connected to the lifting frame, and an adjusting electric mechanism is arranged on the side of the lifting frame; a bearing expansion bracket is connected between the lifting frame and the base, and a spring is arranged on the bearing expansion bracket. According to the utility model, through the penetration of the lifting frame on the screw rod, the height of the lifting frame is convenient to adjust, and meanwhile, the installation frame designed integrally with the lifting frame can flexibly install and process the installation block, so that the whole equipment is convenient to detach and store or transfer the equipment.

title_en: Fastener screwability detects with criticizing head
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a batch head for detecting the screwing-in property of a fastener, which comprises a joint, wherein the bottom end of the joint is fixedly connected with a sleeve, a groove cavity is arranged below the inside of the sleeve, and a stability enhancement component is arranged inside the groove cavity. This fastener screwdriving nature detects with criticizing head, through the cooperation between joint, the sleeve, the cell chamber and the stability-increasing subassembly, follow-up screw in-process fastener is difficult for appearing the slope, be convenient for go on to fastener detection accurate, the inside slip to the inside of perpendicular groove after the butt joint of cell chamber inside round bar part and fastener hexagonal end upper surface, and the round bar that links to each other with fastener hexagonal end side can not be to the inside slip of perpendicular groove, can laminate mutually with fastener hexagonal end side, the lower surface of a plurality of round bars of this in-process can form the hexagonal recess, so that carry out suit application of force to the fastener hexagonal end of equidimension not and use, application scope is comparatively extensive, do benefit to popularization and sale use.

title_en: Pipeline and hole wall scanning robot based on 3D laser scanning
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a pipeline and pore wall scanning robot based on 3D laser scanning, including the laser acquisition head, the sampling protecting crust, electrohydraulic servo advancing mechanism, the tail housing, bear and climb sufficient, skid board, auxiliary control circuit, main control unit, be connected through electrohydraulic servo advancing mechanism between sampling protecting crust and the tail housing, the laser acquisition head inlays in the sampling protecting crust, auxiliary control circuit inlays in the tail housing, main control unit is located outside sampling protecting crust and the tail housing, it climbs sufficient all to bear outside sampling protecting crust and the tail housing, bear and climb sufficient preceding terminal surface and skid board and be connected. The using method comprises the three steps of equipment assembly, detection operation and data communication. On the one hand, the novel device can effectively flexibly adjust the structure of the device according to the pipeline structure, and effectively improve the barrier resistance of the device during operation; on the other hand, the pipeline internal detection precision is high, and the information data is comprehensive, so that the precision and the comprehensiveness of pipeline detection operation are greatly improved.

title_en: 10ML low boron silicon tube system injection bottle and test fixture
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a 10ML low boron silicon tube injection bottle and a test fixture, which comprise an annular base, wherein a limit seat is fixed on the lower surface of the annular base, a positioning mechanism is arranged on the upper surface of the annular base, a limit hole is formed in the lower surface of the limit seat, and a reinforcing mechanism is arranged on the lower surface of the limit seat. This 10ML low boron silicon tube system injection bottle and test fixture has set up positioning mechanism in this test fixture, mutually support between each structure in positioning mechanism, in the test process to the injection bottle, can firmly fix the injection bottle in the test hole, prevent that the injection bottle from taking place the condition of position offset in the test process from taking place, guarantee the accuracy of test, the fixed effect of this test fixture has been increased, the stability of injection bottle in the test process has been improved, cooperate reinforcing mechanism again, carry out the secondary to the injection bottle in the test process and fix, the stability of injection bottle has been improved, the accuracy of test has been improved on the whole.

title_en: Drilling machine for collecting deep soil samples
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a drilling machine for collecting deep soil samples, which belongs to the technical field of sample collecting equipment; the motor is fixedly arranged on the top wall of the movable plate, and the output end of the motor passes through the movable plate and is fixedly provided with a driving shaft, and the motor is externally connected with a power supply through a wire; the driven shafts are respectively arranged on the bottom wall of the movable plate in a bilateral symmetry rotation way through bearings; the driving wheel is sleeved and fixed on the driving shaft; the driven wheels are respectively sleeved and fixed on driven shafts on the left side and the right side, and are connected with the driving wheel through a belt; the sampling pipes are respectively and fixedly arranged at the bottom ends of the driving shaft and the driven shaft; the drill bits are respectively and fixedly arranged at the bottom ends of the sampling tubes; the drilling sampling range is conveniently enlarged, and the sampling efficiency is improved.

title_en: Automatic detection equipment for opening and closing of container door
abstract_en: The utility model discloses automatic detection equipment for opening and closing a container door, which comprises a transmission assembly, wherein two ends of the transmission assembly are respectively connected with a first rotation assembly and a second rotation assembly in a rotating way, the transmission assembly comprises a pipe body, a hydraulic cylinder is fixedly arranged in the pipe body, one end of the pipe body is detachably connected with a connection assembly, and the other end of the pipe body is fixedly connected with a buffer assembly. According to the utility model, the transmission assembly, the first rotating assembly and the second rotating assembly are mutually matched, so that the opening and closing speed of the box door can be slowed down when the opening and closing condition of the box door is detected, the box door is protected, the damage is avoided, the cost loss is increased, and meanwhile, the connection stability between the detection equipment and the box door and between the detection equipment and the container can be enhanced, and the falling damage of the detection equipment can be avoided.

title_en: Furniture bearing detection device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a furniture bearing detection device, and belongs to the technical field of furniture bearing detection. The technical scheme is mainly aimed at solving the problem that the existing furniture bearing detection device cannot prevent the furniture from being deviated after being affected by pressure, and comprises a fixed shell and a box door, wherein the front surface of the fixed shell is provided with the box door through an opening and closing page; the bearing plate is installed to the bottom inner wall of fixed shell, the intercommunication groove has all been seted up at the top of bearing plate, the threaded rod is installed through the bearing to the inboard in intercommunication groove, the surface threaded connection of threaded rod has the grip block, two sets of gag lever posts are installed to the inboard in intercommunication groove. According to the utility model, the bearing plate, the communication groove, the threaded rod and the clamping plate are arranged on the fixing shell, the handle is rotated by external force to drive the threaded rod to rotate, and then the clamping plate is driven to fix furniture, so that the position of the furniture influenced by pressure is prevented from being deviated, and the use experience of the device is improved.

title_en: Wire harness assembly detection device for wire harness production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wire harness assembly detection device for wire harness production, which is characterized in that: the feeding assembly comprises a feeding rotating disc, the transmission assembly comprises a transmission motor, a transmission plate is connected to the end face of the transmission motor in a transmission manner, the feeding rotating disc is connected to the transmission plate in a transmission manner, the transmission limiting assembly comprises a transmission limiting fixed metal plate, the transmission limiting fixed metal plate is placed on the end face of the feeding rotating disc, and a detection sensor is connected to the end face of the transmission limiting fixed metal plate. The size is adjusted to the cable inlet through using the spacing subassembly of transmission for whole cable goes on the spacing fixed panel beating of complete card income transmission, rotates the spacing fixed handle of transmission and adjusts the inside gear device of the spacing regulating block of transmission and adjusts, and wherein the spacing subassembly of transmission is in order to raise the efficiency, uses the binary channels to carry out common inlet wire, makes rear detection sensor detect, thereby simpler, and is simple understandable, and it is high to integrate, and has the automation concurrently.

title_en: Coagulation analyzer and coagulation light path system thereof
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a coagulation analyzer and a coagulation light path system thereof, wherein the coagulation light path system comprises a coagulation light source component, an optical adjusting unit and an optical signal receiving component; the coagulation light source assembly comprises at least one coagulation light source unit for emitting a detection light beam; the optical adjusting unit comprises a prism, and the prism comprises at least one light inlet surface forming an included angle with the axis of the prism and is used for filtering light and reflecting the filtered light to the reaction cup; the blood coagulation light source component and the prism can generate relative rotation along the axis of the prism so that the blood coagulation light source unit can emit detection light beams to different light inlet surfaces; the optical signal receiving component is used for receiving the optical signal transmitted through the reaction cup after the coagulation light source unit is reflected by the light inlet surface and converting the optical signal into an electric signal. After the coagulation light source unit and the light inlet surface rotate relatively, the light rays emitted by the coagulation light source unit can be combined with the light inlet surface to emit light with specific wavelength to the reaction cup, the wavelength interval of the emitted light beam is larger, the number of detection items is increased, and the detection time is shortened.

title_en: Varistor testing device suitable for different models
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of resistor testing, and discloses a piezoresistor testing device suitable for different types, which comprises a main body mechanism, an electric appliance mechanism and a detection mechanism, wherein the electric appliance mechanism is positioned at the upper end of the main body mechanism, the detection mechanism is positioned at the inner end of the main body mechanism, the main body mechanism comprises a resistor testing device body, a bearing plate and universal wheels, the bearing plate is fixedly arranged at the lower end of the resistor testing device body, the universal wheels are fixedly arranged at the lower end of the bearing plate, the electric appliance mechanism comprises an electric appliance box, a placing box door and a box door handle I, the electric appliance box is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the bearing plate, the placing box door is movably arranged at the right end of the electric appliance box, and the box door handle I is fixedly arranged at the right end of the placing box door. The piezoresistor testing device adapting to different models is used by the detector, so that the piezoresistor is detected more rapidly, and the display can be used by the display to show what condition of the device is.

title_en: Radar signal device
abstract_en: A radar signal device is used for detecting movement of an object. The radar signal device comprises an integrated circuit and a microwave antenna. The integrated circuit comprises a radio frequency receiving and transmitting pin for simultaneously transmitting a transmitting radio frequency signal and receiving a receiving radio frequency signal. The microwave antenna comprises a feed-in point coupled to the radio frequency receiving and transmitting pin.

title_en: Nondestructive testing device for nut raw materials
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of nut production, in particular to a nut raw material nondestructive testing device which comprises a main body, a main body and a main body, wherein the main body is provided with a main body and a main body, the main body is provided with a: the device comprises limit strips and torsion springs, wherein two torsion springs are arranged on the upper surface of the guide plate, and the axis of each torsion spring is axially parallel to the piston rod of the rotary cylinder; the two spacing connection in torsion spring leaves the clearance between the two spacing, can make the nut stop in the detection area through above-mentioned structure, makes supersonic generator and ultrasonic receiver have fine reaction time to can not appear information deviation, just also can not appear misdetection or the condition of leaking to examine, improved nut detection's rate of accuracy.

title_en: Real-time alarm gas meter with isolated power adapter
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of remote gas alarm and gas meters, and discloses a gas meter with an isolated power adapter and capable of alarming in real time. The gas meter with the isolated power adapter can alarm in real time, and can supply power to an alarm device and a gas meter device respectively. The purpose of safely supplying power to the gas meter can be achieved, and the commercial power is respectively connected with the gas alarm and the gas meter through the AC-DC conversion power supply adapter, so that the gas meter is continuously supplied with electric energy, and the requirement of real-time data transmission is met; meanwhile, the wireless transmission module is connected with the gas meter, the gas alarm is connected with the gas meter, and then the gas meter can transmit the received alarm information, the gas information acquired by the gas meter and the like to the server in real time, so that the purpose of data real-time transmission is fulfilled.

title_en: Hydraulic cylinder body sealing test equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides hydraulic cylinder body sealing test equipment, which comprises a box body, wherein a top cabinet door is movably arranged at the top of the box body through a hinge, a side cabinet door is arranged at one side of the front surface of the box body through a hinge, guide sleeves are symmetrically distributed at two corners of the bottom of the box body, a mounting seat is fixedly arranged at the center of the bottom of the box body, and a fixing bracket is arranged in the middle of the box body in a penetrating manner from bottom to top; and a lifting bracket is arranged in the guide sleeve. According to the hydraulic cylinder body sealing test equipment, the hydraulic cylinder to be detected is clamped between the positioning groove and the pressure plate, and pressure oil is filled into the hydraulic cylinder through the connecting pipe for testing the sealing performance of the hydraulic cylinder; the lifting brackets on the two sides are convenient to adjust, so that the hydraulic cylinder test device is suitable for testing hydraulic cylinders with different heights; the box is spliced by the inner side box plate and the outer side box plate, and is provided with the second ventilation holes and the first ventilation holes which are distributed in a staggered manner, so that oil liquid is prevented from splashing when testing is lost, heat dissipation is not affected, and safety is high.

title_en: Universal material testing machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a universal material testing machine, which comprises a supporting mechanism, wherein a testing mechanism for testing materials is arranged on the supporting mechanism, a protection mechanism for shielding damaged materials is arranged on the outer side of the testing mechanism, and the testing mechanism and the protection mechanism are connected with the supporting mechanism; the supporting mechanism comprises a box body, guide posts are symmetrically arranged on two sides of the upper end of the box body, and a top plate is arranged at the upper end of each guide post; the testing mechanism comprises a force measuring piece arranged at the lower end of the top plate, a hydraulic column is vertically arranged at the inner side of the box body, and a sliding beam is arranged at the upper end of the hydraulic column. According to the utility model, the sliding seat of the protection mechanism slides in the sliding groove, so that the transparent protection plates between the vertical plate and the connecting plate, between the connecting plate and the fixing strip are used for shielding and fixing the test area, splashing during material testing is prevented, the safety of the test is improved, and the cleaning range is reduced.

title_en: Test circuit for thyristor-level control circuit of converter valve
abstract_en: The utility model provides a test circuit for a thyristor-level control circuit of a converter valve, which comprises the following components: the power supply side circuit is connected with the load side circuit and is used for reproducing the voltage and the current under the actual operation working condition for the tested thyristor stage in the load side circuit; a power supply side circuit comprising: and the plurality of parallel bridge arms comprise a plurality of cascaded H-bridge circuits. The cascade quantity of the H-bridge circuits in each bridge arm is controlled according to the target voltage waveform by tracking the target voltage and current waveform, and the voltages at two ends of the tested thyristor stage when the tested thyristor stage is turned off under the actual operation condition are reproduced. And controlling the parallel quantity of bridge arms according to the target voltage current waveform, and repeating the on-state current when the tested thyristor stage is turned on under the actual operation condition, so as to complete the assessment of the compatibility of the thyristor stage control circuit according to the actual operation condition.

title_en: Automatic torque detection mechanism of power-assisted steering device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of nonstandard automation of automobiles, in particular to an automatic torque detection mechanism of a power-assisted steering device, which comprises a test mechanism support, wherein a data acquisition unit is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the test mechanism support through a support, a driving module is arranged at the lower end of one side of the test mechanism support, a spline shaft measuring and connecting module is fixedly arranged under the data acquisition unit, an ECU (electronic control unit) connecting unit is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the test mechanism support, and a spline sleeve connecting driving module is fixedly arranged at one end, far away from the spline shaft measuring and connecting module, of the upper surface of the test mechanism support.

title_en: Integrated detection circuit based on wireless signals and nonlinear nodes
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides an integrated detection circuit based on wireless signals and nonlinear nodes, the circuit comprising: the antenna comprises a power supply component, a control unit, an FPGA signal processing unit, a nonlinear radio frequency unit, a signal intensity detection unit and an antenna component, wherein the first end of the control unit is connected with the power supply component, the second end of the control unit is connected with the first end of the FPGA signal processing unit, the second end of the FPGA signal processing unit is connected with the first end of the nonlinear radio frequency unit, the third end of the FPGA signal processing unit is connected with the first end of the signal intensity detection unit, the first end of the antenna component is connected with the second end of the nonlinear radio frequency unit, and the second end of the antenna component is connected with the second end of the signal intensity detection unit. And the detection circuit sends a detection signal to the setting area, and whether the electronic equipment exists or not is determined according to the harmonic signal fed back in the setting area.

title_en: Sample separating device with mixed division function
