abstract_en: The utility model provides a sample separating device with a mixing shrinkage separation function, which relates to the field of sample separating and preparing and comprises a shell, wherein a moving assembly is arranged at the bottom of the shell, a feed hopper is arranged at the top of the shell, a first material separating plate group is arranged below the feed hopper, a second material separating plate group is arranged right below the first material separating plate group, two sides of the first material separating plate group and the second material separating plate group are respectively provided with a material baffle, the two material baffles are distributed up and down, and the top of one material baffle is fixedly connected with the top wall of the shell; when the device works, a worker only needs to send materials into the feed hopper, and the first material distributing plate group, the second material distributing plate group, the material baffle plate and the material guide plate are matched, so that the entered materials are mixed and reduced, and the device can be used for automatically mixing and reducing the needed mixture, so that the workload of the worker is reduced, and meanwhile, the device is simple to operate and high in sample preparation efficiency in reduction and division.

title_en: Spectacle case detects frock
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of automotive interior spare processing equipment, and provides a spectacle case detection tool which comprises a frame, a detection chamber, an electric cabinet, an operation display panel, a controller and a timer, and further comprises: the lower module is detachably connected with the frame; the upper module is arranged above the lower module and can do reciprocating linear motion along the longitudinal direction; the power output end of the first driving device is detachably connected with the upper module; the optical fiber sensor is arranged on one side of the lower module, which is away from the opening of the detection chamber, and is electrically connected with the controller; and an uncovering assembly disposed on the lower module and electrically connected with the controller for opening the glasses case. The spectacle case detection tool provided by the utility model can detect spectacle cases with different specifications by replacing the upper module and the lower module, and has a wider application range.

title_en: Multifunctional self-detection shore power box
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multifunctional self-detection shore power box, and belongs to the technical field of shore power boxes. The raspberry pie is arranged in a shore power box; the insulated electromotive force detection sensor is arranged in the shore power box, is electrically connected with the raspberry and is used for detecting the insulated electromotive force between the lead and the shore power box so as to judge whether the insulation performance of the lead is good or not; the voltage meter is arranged in the shore power box, is electrically connected with the raspberry group, is positioned on one side of the insulated electromotive force detection sensor, and is used for measuring the real-time voltage at two ends of a wire in a power supply loop of the shore power box, the data are transmitted back to the raspberry group, and the raspberry group judges whether the current voltage and the voltage fluctuation are abnormal or not through historical data; the metering and charging device is arranged in the shore power box, is positioned below the voltmeter and the insulated electromotive force detection sensor, is electrically connected with the raspberry pie, records the power consumption and transmits data back to the raspberry pie in real time, and the raspberry pie generates a charging two-dimensional code through the value of the power consumption.

title_en: Novel efficient LED lamp test fixture
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel efficient LED lamp test fixture, which comprises: the bottom plate, the riser, the left side at the bottom plate top is installed to the riser, the diaphragm, the top at the riser is installed to the diaphragm, places clamping mechanism, place clamping mechanism setting on the bottom plate, place clamping mechanism including placing the board, place the board setting on the upper portion of bottom plate, there is the fixed axle through bearing swing joint in the recess at bottom plate top. According to the LED lamp group testing device, the working efficiency of the LED lamp group during testing is improved by the mutual matching of the placing plate, the fixed shaft, the stop block, the connecting block, the electric push rod, the moving block, the clamping block, the fixed groove, the rotating block, the fixed rod, the movable block, the clamping groove, the push rod, the push block and the buffer spring, the problem that the LED lamp group to be tested needs to be taken down from the clamp after the testing of the LED lamp group is completed is avoided, then the LED lamp group to be tested is placed on the clamp to be clamped, and then the testing can be continued, so that the working efficiency is prevented from being influenced.

title_en: Positioning tool for detecting automobile parts
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a positioning tool for detecting automobile parts, and relates to the technical field of automobile parts detection. The utility model comprises a bottom plate and a top plate arranged right above the bottom plate, wherein a middle plate is arranged in the middle between the bottom plate and the top plate, a rotating motor is fixed in the middle of the upper side of the bottom plate, a connecting plate is arranged between the middle plate and the top plate, a mounting frame is fixed on the lower side of the connecting plate at the front side of the rotating motor, a progressive motor is fixed in the mounting frame, two symmetrically arranged strip-shaped openings are arranged on the upper side of the top plate, positioning plates are arranged at the positions of the upper ends of the strip-shaped openings, and a strip-shaped toothed plate is arranged in the middle of the lower side of the top plate. According to the utility model, through the arrangement and use of the strip-shaped opening and the progressive toothed plate, different detection is carried out on a plurality of positions on the parts, so that the comprehensiveness of the detection of the parts is improved, and meanwhile, the parts are placed at the positions between the two positioning plates, so that the parts can be stably detected.

title_en: Production detection device of mechanical sealing element
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of mechanical sealing elements and discloses a production detection device of the mechanical sealing elements, which comprises a base frame, wherein a sealing element main body for detection is arranged at the upper end of the base frame, a rotatable adjusting frame is arranged above the base frame, a rotating shaft assembly is arranged between the bottom of the adjusting frame and the top of the base frame, the adjusting frame is of a U-shaped structure with an opening transversely arranged, and the sealing element main body is positioned in the adjusting frame.

title_en: Building templates straightness dipperstick that hangs down
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a building template verticality measuring scale, which comprises a main body, wherein the upper end and the lower end of the side wall of the main body are respectively provided with a supporting structure in a rotating way, the two supporting structures can rotate by ninety degrees, U-shaped aluminum alloy sections are respectively arranged at the two ends of a finished building engineering quality detecting scale, and are respectively arranged and fixed on the detecting scale through fastening screws, the aluminum alloy sections can be retracted when not used, the purpose of normal use can be achieved by twisting the screws, when the building template is required to be measured, the fastening screws are loosened, a supporting rod is outwards rotated to form 90 degrees with the main scale of the detecting scale, the fastening screws are screwed and locked, the supporting rod is kept fixed, the position with a certain depth can be measured, the product is partially changed on the basis of the original building engineering quality detector scale, the product is convenient and quick, the working efficiency can be greatly improved, the precision can be ensured, the processing and manufacturing cost is lower, and the popularization is strong.

title_en: Finished product verifying attachment is used in clothing production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a finished product inspection device for clothing production, which comprises a supporting table and a supporting plate, wherein a lifting mechanism is arranged between the supporting table and the supporting plate, two rotating shafts are respectively rotatably arranged on the lower surface of the supporting plate, a first belt wheel and a second belt wheel are respectively and fixedly arranged on the outer surfaces of the two rotating shafts, belts are sleeved on the outer surfaces of the first belt wheel and the second belt wheel, a plurality of connecting blocks are uniformly and fixedly arranged on the outer surfaces of the belts, and supporting rods are inserted on the outer surfaces of the connecting blocks from top to bottom. When the connecting block fixedly arranged on the belt drives the supporting rod to move to the rack, the gear fixedly arranged on the outer surface of the supporting rod is meshed with the rack, so that the gear can drive the supporting rod to rotate, the clothes hanger hung on the hanging ring can rotate along with the rotating, and the finished clothing on the clothes hanger is driven to rotate, so that inspection personnel can observe and inspect the whole finished clothing conveniently.

title_en: Detection device for solid-liquid-gas three-phase trace substances
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a detection device for solid, liquid and gas three-phase trace substances, which comprises: a housing; a data processor disposed within the housing; the ion migration device is arranged in the shell and is connected with the data processor; the solid-liquid detection device is arranged in the shell and is connected with the data processor; the shell is provided with a first detection port and a second detection port which are respectively communicated with the ion migration device and the solid-liquid detection device. According to the utility model, the ion migration device and the solid-liquid detection device are integrated in the same solid-liquid-gas three-phase trace substance detection device, so that the substance types of solid, gas or liquid can be detected, a plurality of detection devices are not required to be provided, and the detection device is promoted to be applicable to more scenes. On the other hand, the detection device of the substance also comprises an array sensor, and the array sensor can also detect the type of the gas, and can assist the ion migration device to detect the gas, so that the detection type of the gas is more, and the detection accuracy is higher.

title_en: Device for measuring insulation resistance of pipeline sleeve
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a device for measuring insulation resistance of a pipe sleeve, comprising: a pipe; the sleeve is sleeved outside the pipeline; the first acquisition device is respectively connected with the sleeve and the second test piece; the second acquisition device is respectively connected with the pipeline and the first test piece; and the resistor box is respectively connected with the first acquisition device and the second acquisition device. The utility model can more accurately estimate the resistance value between the sleeve and the pipeline, and when the resistance value is smaller than a fixed value, an alarm is sent out to prevent erroneous judgment.

title_en: Leveling and clearance measuring device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a leveling and clearance measuring device, which comprises a sliding rail, a sliding block, an upper plate and a dial; the sliding rail is of a symmetrical structure and comprises a first part and a second part, two sliding blocks are arranged on the sliding ways on the first part and the second part respectively and move along the sliding way; the upper plate comprises a first upper plate and a second upper plate, one ends of the first upper plate and the second upper plate are arranged in the middle of the sliding rail, and the connection parts of the first upper plate and the second upper plate and the sliding rail are rotationally connected; the sliding block is arranged between the upper plate and the sliding rail, and the included angle between the upper plate and the sliding rail is adjusted through the movement of the sliding block on the sliding rail. The utility model solves the problems that the left-right balance is difficult to adjust and the gap height is difficult to adjust during blade coating and roll gap adjustment.

title_en: Cable tension testing machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cable tension tester which comprises a base and a control button, wherein a motor is arranged on one side of the inside of the base, a rotating shaft is arranged at the output end of the motor, a gear is arranged on the surface of the rotating shaft, a transmission belt is arranged on the surface of the gear, a fixing structure is arranged on the upper surface of the base, supporting frames are arranged on two sides of the top of the base, threaded rods are arranged in the supporting frames, a threaded sleeve is movably connected to the surface of the threaded rods, a fixing plate is fixed on one side of the threaded sleeve, a plurality of groups of fixing structures are arranged on the cable tension tester, a worker can conveniently test a plurality of cables at the same time, the testing efficiency of the cable tension tester is effectively improved, meanwhile, the contact area between the cables and the fixing structures is increased, and the fixing strength of the cables is effectively improved.

title_en: Wheel speed sensor
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wheel speed sensor, which comprises a sensor body and a flange, wherein the flange comprises a connecting base part, a first installation part and a second installation part which are arranged on the connecting base part, and the sensor body comprises a matching part; wherein the first mounting portion is adapted to be fitted with the fitting portion so that the flange is detachably fitted to the sensor body, and the second mounting portion is adapted to be fixed to a predetermined position. The wheel speed sensor comprises a sensor body and a flange, wherein the sensor body is detachably assembled on the flange, so that the standardized design of the sensor body can be realized, and the wheel speed sensor is designed to be matched with the flange according to different installation environments, thereby avoiding the time and money cost consumed by multiple development and production of a die, simplifying the development process and improving the universality.

title_en: Quick connector for air tightness detection
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a quick connector for detecting air tightness, which belongs to the field of machining operation and is used for improving the efficiency of detecting the air tightness of a carbon slide plate. One end of the air tightness detection quick connector is connected with an air tap, the other end of the air tap is connected with a hose, and the air tap is sequentially connected with an air tap connector, a connector, a sealing gasket and a hose quick connector; the hose securing cap secures the hose to the hose quick connector. The utility model replaces the existing air tightness detection mode that the hose is directly connected with the air tap, and improves the efficiency of detecting the air tightness of the carbon slide plate.

title_en: Novel oscilloscope
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of oscilloscopes and discloses a novel oscilloscopes, which comprises an oscilloscopes body, wherein a box body is fixedly connected to the side face of the oscilloscopes body, two current probes are assembled on the box body, a conversion assembly is arranged in the box body, and a positioning assembly is further arranged on the box body. The oscilloscope provided by the utility model replaces the structure of the traditional oscilloscope, and a user can quickly replace two current probes, so that the operation is convenient and quick, the loss of an oscilloscope connector is avoided, the service life of the oscilloscope is prolonged, and the practicability of the oscilloscope is improved.

title_en: Metallographic sample grinding clamp
abstract_en: The utility model provides a metallographic sample grinding clamp, which comprises: the base is provided with a plurality of rotationally symmetrical clamping grooves for clamping the embedded sample; a plurality of pressing plates which are rotationally symmetrical and correspond to the clamping grooves; the pressing plate is hinged with the base; the driving block compresses or releases the pressing plate through the linear movement of the driving block, so that the pressing plate opens and compresses the embedded sample or is separated from the embedded sample. Firstly, clamping the embedded sample in a clamping groove, and mounting the cover plate on the base; then the whole is reversely buckled, the embedded sample falls under the action of gravity, and the top of the embedded sample is flush with the cover plate; then the driving block moves to press the pressing plate, so that the pressing plate opens, the pressing plate applies force to the embedded sample, and the embedded sample is clamped between the clamping groove and the pressing plate to realize fixation; finally, the cover plate is taken down, and the clamp is installed on an automatic sample grinding machine to realize automatic sample grinding; the utility model replaces manual work, and improves sample grinding quality and efficiency.

title_en: Physique detector
abstract_en: The utility model provides a physical fitness detector, which belongs to the technical field of intelligent detection equipment and comprises a height and weight measuring instrument and a physical examination integrated machine, wherein a sucker barrel is arranged at the bottom of the height and weight measuring instrument, a sucker nozzle is arranged on one side, far away from the height and weight measuring instrument, of the sucker barrel, a movable wheel is arranged at the bottom of the physical examination integrated machine, a fixed plate is arranged on one side of the physical examination integrated machine, a lifting plate is slidably arranged on the fixed plate, a power piece for lifting the lifting plate is arranged on the fixed plate, and the height and weight measuring instrument is placed on the lifting plate. The utility model is beneficial to using the whole body height and weight measuring instrument and physical examination all-in-one machine, so that the physical examination instrument can be better used in a smart campus, and the application requirements of more people are met.

title_en: Visual detection mechanism for assembly clearance of compressor
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of detection mechanisms, in particular to a visual detection mechanism for an assembly gap of a compressor. According to the visual detection mechanism for the assembly gap of the compressor, the gap width of the compressor during assembly is more intuitively seen, when the assembly gap of the compressor is detected, the thin plates are inserted into the gap, then the knob is twisted clockwise, the knob drives the transmission column to rotate, meanwhile, the gear rotates, the gear surface is respectively meshed with the upward moving rack and the downward moving rack, the upward moving rack moves upwards to drive the upper clamping block to move downwards, the lower clamping block moves downwards to drive the lower clamping block to move downwards, the two thin plates are opened until the two thin plates are respectively connected with the upper end and the lower end of the gap, the knob cannot continue to rotate, and a pointer fixedly connected with the tail end of the transmission column rotates to point to a numerical value on the display disc, namely the gap width.

title_en: Environment detector with good protection effect
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an environment detector with good protection effect, which comprises an environment detector body. According to the environment detector, the environment detector body can be effectively opened through the control panel, the environment can be detected through the cooperation of the temperature detector, the air detector and the humidity detector, the detected data are displayed in a numerical value through the display screen, and then the transparent plate is supported through the supporting rod at the top, so that the transparent plate protects the display screen, the problem that the existing environment detection has no protection function is solved, when the environment detector is used by a detector, the surface of the environment detector is too smooth, the environment detector can slide down from hands carelessly, the environment detector is damaged due to the fact that the environment detector slides down to the ground, the display screen and internal electronic elements are easily damaged, and the service life of the environment detector is shortened is solved.

title_en: IC chip appearance defect detecting device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of machine vision, and particularly discloses an IC chip appearance defect detection device. The device is used for detecting the IC chip to be detected and comprises a base and two rotating structures; a reference straight line is arranged on the base, and a detection position is arranged on the reference straight line; the rotating structure is movably arranged on the base and can rotate around a reference straight line, and the two rotating structures rotate in the same plane; the rotating structure comprises a lens fixing plate, a shooting camera movably mounted on the lens fixing plate and a light source fixedly mounted on the lens fixing plate, wherein the shooting camera can be close to or far away from the reference straight line along the direction perpendicular to the reference straight line and is used for shooting an IC chip to be detected located at the detection position, and the light source selectively irradiates the IC chip to be detected. The device can shoot the both sides of waiting to detect IC chip positive light and backlight, carries out image acquisition and analysis to the outward appearance defect of solder ball and IC components and parts, realizes the comprehensive detection to the outward appearance defect, has promoted test efficiency and test accuracy.

title_en: Fork truck combination meter test fixing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a forklift combination instrument test fixing device which comprises a shell, wherein an instrument body is arranged at the top of the shell, a cavity is formed in the shell, a driving mechanism comprises a motor fixedly connected to the cavity, and an output shaft of the motor is fixedly connected with a threaded pipe. The utility model has the advantage of convenient disassembly, in the actual use process, the angle of the adjusting block can be adjusted through the matched use of the driving mechanism and the adjusting mechanism, so that the positioning block is separated from the inner cavity of the positioning groove, the fixation of the instrument body is further relieved, the traditional bolt installation is replaced by a clamping connection mode, a user can conveniently disassemble the forklift combination instrument, the forklift combination instrument is not easy to damage while time-saving and labor-saving, the service life of the forklift combination instrument is prolonged, and the installed forklift combination instrument is more stable when being placed.

title_en: Electric putter stroke verifying attachment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electric push rod stroke inspection device which comprises an inspection platform, an electric push rod arranged on the inspection platform, an electric push rod fixing piece, a buffering pushing component and a display platform, wherein a base of the electric push rod is connected with the electric push rod fixing piece, the buffering pushing component is arranged at the telescopic end of the electric push rod, the display platform is arranged at one side of the buffering pushing component far away from the electric push rod, the buffering pushing component comprises a connecting block, an elastic piece and a pushing component, the connecting block is connected with the telescopic end of the electric push rod, the pushing component is connected with the connecting block through the elastic piece, the display platform comprises a baffle plate arranged on the inspection platform, an indicator lamp is arranged on the baffle plate, and a button which corresponds to the pushing component and is used for lighting the indicator lamp is arranged on the side wall of the baffle plate. The inspection device is simple to operate, low in cost and suitable for popularization and application.

title_en: Enameled wire tensile testing device and system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an enameled wire tensile testing device and system, comprising: the device comprises a supporting part, a stretching part and an identification part, wherein the stretching part comprises an electric push rod and supporting rods, the fixed end of the electric push rod is arranged on the supporting part, the two supporting rods are respectively arranged at the fixed end and the telescopic end of the electric push rod in a penetrating way, one end, far away from the electric push rod, of each supporting rod is provided with a winding groove, and a product is arranged between the two winding grooves; the recognition part comprises an adjusting bracket and an intelligent camera, the adjusting bracket is arranged on the supporting part, the intelligent camera is arranged on the adjusting bracket, and a lens of the intelligent camera is opposite to the product. The utility model utilizes the stable elasticity of the electric push rod to drive the stable stretching and fixing length of the enameled wire; secondly, taking a picture of the product through an intelligent camera, analyzing the taken picture, and accurately identifying the positions and the number of pinholes; and the stability and the accuracy of the test result data of the number of pinholes on the surface of the enameled wire are improved.

title_en: Centering tool for steam turbine generator unit
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of electric power construction engineering, and particularly relates to a centering tool for a steam turbine generator unit. Through installing the support frame on the base to install first adjusting part on the support frame, install the support frame on the base through second adjusting part, and install gyro wheel and spud pile on first adjusting part, through this structure, first adjusting part can transport the gyro wheel to suitable height, improve whole result of use, can drive wire rope through second adjusting part and control and remove, make the search center that operating personnel can be better, simultaneously, can be used for restricting first adjusting part's position through the gag lever post, prevent that first subassembly from taking place to remove, and then guarantee that wire rope can not take place the skew, avoid wire rope skew to cause the influence to whole process.

title_en: Accurate sheet metal component thickness test tool
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a thickness test fixture for a precise sheet metal part, and relates to the technical field of test devices; the utility model comprises a bottom plate, wherein a placing plate is fixedly arranged on the top surface of the bottom plate, a motor is arranged in the bottom plate, a screw rod is fixedly arranged at the output end of the motor, screw threads on the surface of the screw rod penetrate through screw blocks, an adjusting plate is fixedly arranged on the top surface of the screw blocks, a fixing frame is fixedly arranged on the top surface of the bottom plate, an air cylinder is fixedly arranged on the bottom surface of the fixing frame, a fixing frame is fixedly arranged at the output end of the air cylinder, a measuring plate is slidably arranged on one side of the fixing frame, a mounting groove is formed in the bottom surface of the bottom plate, the motor is arranged in the mounting groove, a sheet metal part is placed on the placing plate, and then the screw rod is turned by starting the motor, so that the screw blocks can drive the adjusting plate to slide, the adjusting plate clamps the sheet metal part, and errors caused by deviation of the shaking sheet metal part during detection are avoided.

title_en: Rotor balance
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rotor balance, which relates to the technical field of rotor balances and comprises a mounting frame, wherein a rotor balance body is mounted on the mounting frame, a feed inlet is formed in the rotor balance body, and a discharge guide pipe is connected to the lower end of the rotor balance body; the butt joint toothed ring is arranged on the discharge guide pipe and is connected with the discharge guide pipe through a sealing bearing, a scattering blade is arranged at the inner diameter of the butt joint toothed ring, a driving gear is connected to the side edge of the butt joint toothed ring, and a driving motor is arranged on the driving gear; and the guide-out pipeline is positioned at the lower end of the discharge conduit. This rotor is called through the sealed axle of installation between ejection of compact pipe and the butt joint ring gear, can seal the processing to the butt joint ring gear at first, and secondly can assist the butt joint ring gear to rotate under drive gear's meshing, and rotatory butt joint ring gear drives its internal scattered blade rotation, avoids the powder to produce the accumulation phenomenon through rotatory scattered blade, promotes the efficiency of ejection of compact.

title_en: Luminous quartz tube with double-layer quartz electrode structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a luminous quartz tube with a double-layer quartz electrode structure, which comprises a luminous quartz tube, outer-layer isolation quartz and a cable, wherein the outer-layer isolation quartz is covered outside the luminous quartz tube, and the cable penetrates through the outer-layer isolation quartz and is connected with the luminous quartz tube. In order to solve the technical problems and achieve the corresponding technical effects, the utility model effectively solves the problem that the joint of the luminous quartz tube and the cable is exposed by additionally arranging an outer layer of isolation quartz outside the luminous quartz tube, and can effectively isolate high-frequency high-voltage electricity at the joint, thereby avoiding damage to electric elements in an instrument caused by the high-frequency high-voltage electricity at the joint, and simultaneously effectively improving the safety of the device.

title_en: Automatic bentonite montmorillonite content detection equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses automatic bentonite montmorillonite content detection equipment, which is equipment adopting detection equipment technology and comprises a detection table, a medicament tank, a pump, a hose, a needle cylinder, a second screw rod, a lower seat, a movable seat and a support. When the device is used for detecting, the second screw rod can be driven to rotate by the second motor, the lower seat can move in the needle cylinder, the lower seat can push out the medicament in the needle cylinder, and the push-out amount of the medicament can be controlled by the arrangement of the screw rod, so that the detection is more accurate.

title_en: Energy-saving environment-friendly intelligent heating device for greenhouse
abstract_en: The utility model provides an energy-saving environment-friendly intelligent heating device for a greenhouse, which comprises a heating assembly, wherein the heating assembly comprises a bottom plate, a rotating disc, a rotating plate, a heater, a mounting rod, a temperature sensor, an electric cylinder, a connecting plate, a sliding chute, a sliding block and a controller. According to the utility model, one end of a piston rod of the electric cylinder stretches and contracts in the whole process to drive the sliding block to slide in the sliding groove in the whole process, and the rotating plate is driven to rotate in a reciprocating manner to heat the left side area of the heater; the temperatures of the front half area and the rear half area of the left side of the heater can be detected by means of two temperature sensors; when the temperature of the front half area is lower than a preset value, controlling one end of a piston rod of the electric cylinder to stretch in the front half way to drive the sliding block to slide in the rear half way of the sliding groove, so that the heater only heats the front half area, and the temperature of the front half area is raised to recover normal heating; and if the temperature of the second half area is lower than the preset value, controlling one end of a piston rod of the electric cylinder to stretch out and draw back in the second half process, and heating the second half area preferentially.

title_en: Leakage test structure of circuit breaker and circuit breaker with same
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a leakage test structure of a circuit breaker and the circuit breaker with the same, wherein the leakage test structure comprises: the test button, the tripping coil, the flexible connection, the first power taking seat and the second power taking seat; the tripping coil is provided with two different first wiring ports and two different second wiring ports, the flexible connection is provided with two different first end parts and two different second end parts, the second wiring ports are electrically connected with the first end parts of the flexible connection, and the second end parts of the flexible connection are electrically connected with the second power taking seat; the first electricity taking seat can be driven to be electrically connected with the first wiring port by pressing the test button, and the first electricity taking seat is disconnected with the first wiring port when the pressing force of the test button is lost. Thus, a structure capable of performing an electric leakage test on the circuit breaker is provided.

title_en: Surge testing device of new energy charging line
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a surge testing device of a new energy charging wire in the technical field of charging wire leakage detection, which comprises a surge generating module, a leakage current collecting module and a main controller module, wherein the output end of the surge generating module is connected with an inner core of the new energy charging wire to be detected, an insulating layer of the new energy charging wire is connected with the leakage current collecting module, and the leakage current collecting module is connected with the surge generating module.

title_en: Three-coordinate measuring needle angle adjusting structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a three-coordinate measuring needle angle adjusting structure, which comprises a measuring table, wherein a supporting frame is connected onto the measuring table in a sliding manner, a measuring machine body is connected onto the supporting frame in a sliding manner, and the three-coordinate measuring needle angle adjusting structure further comprises: one end of the rotating arm is movably arranged at the lower side of the measuring machine body and is perpendicular to the measuring table; the probe assembly is arranged at the lower end of the rotary arm and is movably connected with the rotary arm; the adjusting component is movably arranged in the lower end of the rotary arm and is in driving connection with the measuring needle component; the rotating arm rotates around the hinge through rotating the adjusting knob and the measuring needle assembly, the second pointer is matched with the second angle mark to perform the first angle adjustment, the rotating arm rotates at the lower end of the measuring machine body through the connecting column above the rotating arm, the first pointer is matched with the first angle mark to perform the second angle adjustment, and the angle of the measuring machine body can be accurately adjusted through the pointer and the angle mark, so that the measuring precision of the measuring machine body is improved.

title_en: Mattress cover processing finished product needle inspection detection device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of mattress cover detection, in particular to a mattress cover processing finished product needle checking detection device. The technical proposal comprises: including detecting platform and metal detector, the lift groove has been seted up at detecting platform upper end center, the splitter box has been seted up to the lift groove lateral wall, sliding connection has the lifter plate in the lift groove, the conveyer belt is all installed to lifter plate, splitter box and detecting platform upper end, in the lift groove and be located the lifter plate bottom and be provided with drive assembly, detecting platform upper end is kept away from splitter box one side and is fixed with the mounting bracket, a set of mounting groove has been seted up on the mounting bracket and with the conveyer belt alignment position, the mounting groove all is fixed with metal detector. According to the utility model, after the mattress cover passes through the mounting frame, the metal detector is used for detecting the residual needle heads, and the lifting plate is used for lifting, so that the mattress cover with and without the metal needle heads is automatically split, the purpose of automatic sorting is further realized, the working efficiency is improved, and omission or personnel needle pricking which possibly occurs in manual sorting is avoided.

title_en: Tread cleaner test bed
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tread cleaner test bed, relates to the field of tread cleaners, and solves the problems that the higher the wheel speed is, the lower the adhesion coefficient of a wheel rail is, the more easily the wheel rail is idle or slipped in the running process to cause wheel abrasion, and the phenomenon is more obvious, so that potential safety hazard is brought to the running of a high-speed train, and the tread cleaner is of great importance. The technical characteristics include: a base; the bearing structure is arranged on the upper surface of the base and is used for bearing; the simulation structure is mounted on the bearing structure and is used for simulation. The tread sweeper can effectively ensure the quality of the tread sweeper, avoids dangerous occurrence, and has relatively simple structure and convenient use.

title_en: Field data acquisition equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses field data acquisition equipment, which comprises a moving device, a telescopic device and a first detection device, wherein the moving device is used for running on a ridge according to a preset route, the telescopic device is arranged on the moving device and can stretch in the horizontal direction, the first detection device is arranged at the free end of the telescopic device to extend to a farmland for detection, so that the field data acquisition equipment can acquire data of the farmland on the ridge.

title_en: Overvoltage protection device of negative pressure type pressure gauge
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an overpressure protection device of a negative pressure type pressure meter, which comprises: the connector is provided with a pressure gauge connector and a pressure cavity, the pressure gauge connector is communicated with the pressure cavity to form a first communication side, the bottom of the connector is also provided with a through hole, and the through hole is also communicated with the pressure cavity to form a second communication side; a protection assembly comprises a valve core and a spring mechanism, wherein the spring mechanism comprises a pressure regulating cylinder, one end of the pressure regulating cylinder forms a sealing end through a diaphragm and is fixedly connected to a connector through the sealing end, a tension spring is fixedly connected to the pressure regulating cylinder and is fixedly connected with the diaphragm through a diaphragm seat, a valve seat is further fixedly arranged on the diaphragm, a valve core is fixedly connected to the valve seat, and when negative pressure is overlarge, the valve core and a pressure cavity are in sealing connection, so that a first communication side and a second communication side are isolated. The utility model aims to solve the technical problem of providing the overpressure protection device for the negative pressure type pressure gauge, so that the function of protecting the pressure gauge can be ensured under the condition of overlarge negative pressure, the pressure gauge is not damaged, and the working stability of the pressure gauge is ensured.

title_en: Lake remote sensing monitoring device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of lakes, and in view of the problem that the conventional remote sensing monitoring device is inconvenient to adjust, and discloses a lake remote sensing monitoring device, a base, wherein the top of the base is provided with a mounting groove; the rotary disc is arranged on the inner side wall of the mounting groove; the first screw is symmetrically arranged at the top of the turntable; the support rod is arranged at the top of the turntable; the connecting block is arranged at the top of the supporting rod; the sliding groove is formed in one end of the connecting block; through owing to the mounting groove bearing links at carousel and base top when using, can rotate branch like this and conveniently maintain the spare, then fix through twisting the screw rod one, when the position of monitor needs to be adjusted, drive the lead screw through the starter motor and rotate, because the movable block is inserted to the one end of lead screw, can drive movable block round trip movement through the starter motor like this to adjust the position of monitor, so as to change or use.

title_en: Automatic measuring device of paper bag
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic paper bag measuring device which comprises a conveying device, a measuring device and an editable controller, wherein the conveying device and the measuring device are respectively connected with the editable controller, the measuring device is matched with the conveying device and used for automatically measuring the size of a paper bag, the measuring device comprises a measuring bracket, a first measuring device, a second measuring device, a third measuring device and a fourth measuring device, one end of the conveying device is arranged in the measuring bracket, the first measuring device, the second measuring device, the third measuring device and the fourth measuring device are respectively connected with the editable controller, and the conveying device comprises a travel switch and a motor which are respectively connected with the editable controller.

title_en: Weight measuring device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a weight measuring device, which comprises a first supporting plate, a second supporting plate and a measuring assembly, wherein the second supporting plate is positioned above the first supporting plate, supporting rods are hinged at four corners of the top surface of the second supporting plate, the top of each supporting rod is fixedly connected with a lifting rope, the ends of the four lifting ropes, which are far away from the supporting rods, are respectively used for being bound on four corners of a bed sheet, and the bottom of each supporting rod is provided with a limiting piece for enabling the four supporting rods to be in a vertical state; the measuring assembly is arranged between the first supporting plate and the second supporting plate and comprises a weight sensor and a cylinder. The weight measuring device stretches through the extending rod of the air cylinder, the weighing plate and the second supporting plate are lifted, the weight sensor is extruded, the weight of the patient added with the bed sheet is measured, and finally the weight of the patient can be calculated by subtracting the weight value of the bed sheet from the value at the moment, so that the patient lying in bed for a long time is not required to be carried, and secondary damage caused in the carrying process is avoided.

title_en: Metal contour plate roofing seepage detection structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of metal contour plates and discloses a metal contour plate roof leakage detection structure, which solves the problems that a detection device is required to be taken down from the high altitude, manually adjusted and then placed at the high altitude to be attached to the metal contour plate, the adjustment mode is very troublesome, the adjustment mode is not only required to be taken down and lifted up, but also repeated adjustment is required to be finally realized, the attachment is very time-consuming and the working efficiency is influenced, and the rotation mechanism and the limiting mechanism are arranged to enable the pulling limiting mechanism to move up and down so as to drive the rotation mechanism to rotate, so that a worker does not need to take down the detection device body from the high altitude to repeatedly adjust, the adjustment can be directly completed in the air, the purposes of saving time and improving the working efficiency are achieved, the cleaning is not required to be manually carried out, and the aim of conveniently cleaning a spiral drill bit is achieved.

title_en: Tamping car mileage sensor with fixed knot constructs
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tamping car mileage sensor with a fixed structure, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein fixing bolts are arranged on the periphery of the upper surface of the bottom plate, rails are arranged on two sides of the upper surface of the bottom plate, buckles are arranged on two sides of the center of the upper surface of the bottom plate, a mounting frame is movably connected to the upper surface of the bottom plate, a clamping groove is formed in the surface of the bottom of the mounting frame, a pressure switch is arranged on the surface of the side wall of the mounting frame, a locking mechanism is arranged in the mounting frame and comprises a movable groove, the movable groove is formed in the mounting frame, through grooves are formed in the side surfaces of the mounting frame, which are close to the movable groove, fixing columns are connected in a sliding manner, the two ends of the through grooves are fixed through the mileage sensor, and the connecting frame can be taken by pressing the pressure switch when the fixing device is detached, so that the stability of the mileage sensor is improved, and the effect of quickly disassembling the mileage sensor is achieved.

title_en: Inner wall surface detection device of petroleum storage tank
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an inner wall surface detection device of a petroleum storage tank, which comprises an oil tank and a bottom plate, wherein the oil tank is arranged on a base, the upper end of the bottom plate is connected with a plurality of connecting rods, the upper ends of the connecting rods are connected with a bracket in a sliding manner, and the upper end of the bottom plate is connected with a hydraulic cylinder; the support is pushed to the opening of the detected oil tank, the scanner can move into the oil tank, the push rod motor is started, the push rod motor drives the push rod to move, the push rod drives the rotary motor to move, the rotary motor drives the scanner to move, the scanner can scan the whole depth of the oil tank, the rotary motor is started and drives the scanner to rotate, the scanner can completely scan the inner wall of the oil tank, and then the computer standard part is matched for comparison detection, so that the inner wall of the oil tank is detected, and the detection effect of the oil tanks with different sizes is also realized by adjusting the height of the scanner.

title_en: Environmental protection detects with gaseous sampling device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a gas sampling device for environment-friendly detection, which comprises a support piece, wherein a sampling pipe is horizontally fixed on the top surface of a support, an air pump is fixedly communicated with the sampling pipe, a three-way pipe is arranged at the air outlet end of the sampling pipe, one end air inlet end of the three-way pipe is fixedly communicated with the air outlet end of the sampling pipe, and the other two ends of the three-way pipe are respectively provided with a valve; one end of the pore plate in the gas storage piece is communicated and fixed on one end face of the three-way pipe, the telescopic plate is horizontally inserted on the pore plate in a sliding mode, a rubber cylinder is horizontally arranged between the pore plate and the telescopic plate, two ends of the rubber cylinder are respectively fixed on the adjacent end faces of the pore plate and the telescopic plate, an exhaust pipe is communicated and fixed on the telescopic plate, and a valve is installed on the exhaust pipe. The utility model solves the problems that in the existing gas storage process, most of sampled air is directly injected into an empty collecting bottle, so that the air in the bottle body dilutes the collected gas, thereby causing inaccurate detection results and easy experimental errors.

title_en: NB-IoT ultrasonic heat meter with key touch
abstract_en: The utility model provides an NB-IoT ultrasonic heat meter with key touch, which comprises a water pipe, wherein a detection pipe is longitudinally and integrally connected with the left opening and the right opening of the upper side of the water pipe respectively, and the upper ends of the detection pipes are respectively and spirally connected with a temperature probe; the outer walls of the detection pipes are respectively sleeved with a fixed sleeve, and the fixed sleeves are respectively connected with the detection pipes through bolts in a fastening way; the middle part of the inner side between the fixed sleeves is integrally connected with a mounting plate, and the middle part of the upper part of the mounting plate is connected with an ultrasonic heat meter shell through bolts, wherein a touch display screen is connected with the opening of the middle upper part of the inner side of the ultrasonic heat meter shell through bolts. The arrangement of the reverse-character-shaped mounting seat, the dust cover, the operation groove, the micro switch and the illuminating lamp is beneficial to realizing the effect of protecting the display screen in a dust-proof way, and the problem that dust is accumulated on the display screen can be effectively avoided.

title_en: Multimedia information public telephone booth with article left-behind prompt assembly
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a multimedia information public telephone booth provided with an article carry-over prompt component, which comprises a base, a main frame, a multimedia information device and the article carry-over prompt component, wherein one side of the main frame is provided with a switch door; the door is provided with an infrared sensor on a handle, the input end of the door switch circuit is connected with a proximity sensing component and the infrared sensor, and the output end of the door switch circuit is connected with a loudspeaker. Compared with the prior art, the utility model can reduce the occurrence of the situation that a user forgets articles in a public telephone booth, and has the advantages of low structural transformation cost, high user friendliness and the like.

title_en: Pressure testing device for special equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of special equipment, and discloses a pressure testing device for special equipment. This pressure testing arrangement for special equipment uses down through the motor, threaded rod, slider, connecting rod, pressure piece and the mutually supporting of diaphragm that set up, thereby realized height-adjusting's effect, drive the rotation of threaded rod through opening the motor, thereby drive the slider and control and remove, thereby drive the stretching about the connecting rod, thereby be convenient for drive the reciprocating of diaphragm, thereby be convenient for utilize the pressure piece to extrude equipment, thereby be convenient for detect the compressive strength of equipment, be convenient for adjust the height according to user's demand through highly adjusting, thereby make the device more convenient when using as far as possible, the practicality of the device has been promoted.

title_en: Automatic cooling device of viscometer heater
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic cooling device for a viscometer heater, which comprises a box body, wherein a controller is arranged at the upper end of the box body, the controller is electrically connected with a booster pump, the booster pump is arranged in the box body, a cooling device is arranged at the upper end of the booster pump, a partition plate is arranged on the inner wall of the box body, a holding vessel is arranged in the box body, a threaded rod is arranged at the top of the box body in a penetrating manner, a knob is fixedly connected to the upper end of the threaded rod, and an internal thread block is arranged on the threaded rod in a threaded connection manner. According to the utility model, the heater arranged at the bottom of the containing vessel can heat the liquid in the box body and transmit the liquid to the detection material arranged in the containing vessel, so that the viscosity coefficient of the fluid at a specified temperature is measured, the liquid is conveyed to the cooling tower through the liquid outlet pipe and the pressurizing pump, the temperature of the liquid in the box body can be regulated, the detection material is ensured to be at a constant temperature, and the temperature change is uniform during cooling.

title_en: Valve water detection jig
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a valve water detection jig, which belongs to the technical field of valve water detection and particularly relates to a valve water detection jig. According to the utility model, after the servo motor is started to drive the screw rod to rotate, the movable seat moves along the screw rod and the rod body of the guide rod, when one carrying frame moves to the lower part of the mounting frame, the other carrying frame is positioned at the outer side part of the mounting frame, at the moment, the PCB positioned on the carrying frame below the mounting frame can be detected, and the PCB can be disassembled and assembled on the other carrying frame, namely, the next PCB can be quickly detected after one PCB is detected, then the PCB which is just detected is disassembled, and the reciprocating operation is performed, so that the detection efficiency is improved.

title_en: Quick detector for compactness of thick-layer aeolian sand roadbed
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a rapid detector for compactness of a thick-layer aeolian sand roadbed, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein the top of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with an air cylinder, the output end of the air cylinder extends to the lower part of the bottom plate and is fixedly connected with a fixed plate, the inside of the fixed plate is connected with two sliding rods in a sliding manner, one end of each sliding rod extends to the lower part of the fixed plate and is fixedly connected with a detection plate, and the bottom of the fixed plate is positioned between the two sliding rods and is fixedly connected with a pressure sensor. The device has the beneficial effects that the device drives the fixed plate through the air cylinder until the detection plate contacts the roadbed, then continuously pushes the fixed plate to slide outside the sliding rod, uses the pressure sensor at the bottom of the fixed plate to contact with the detection plate, and uses the positioning plate to measure the distance between the detection plate and the bottom plate by matching with the infrared range finder when the pressure reaches a threshold value, measures the descending depth of the detection plate, and further measures whether the distance value is a normal value, thereby observing whether the compactness is qualified or not, being quite rapid and convenient, and greatly improving the working efficiency of the device.

title_en: Detector for detecting railway fastener pressure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a detector for detecting railway fastener pressure, which comprises a cement sleeper, wherein the left side of the upper end of the cement sleeper is fixedly connected with a hydraulic jack, the output end of the hydraulic jack is fixedly connected with a bearing rod, the right side of the lower end of the bearing rod is fixedly connected with a base, the lower end of the base is provided with a steel rail, the middle part of the lower end of the bearing rod is provided with a hook claw piece, elastic strips are matched between the hook claw pieces, the upper end of the bearing rod is provided with a meter drag rod, and the upper end of the meter drag rod is provided with a dial indicator.

title_en: Anti-powdering performance detection mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a powder resistance detection mechanism, which has the technical scheme that: including the main bottom plate, the top surface fixed mounting of main bottom plate has the fixed plate, the top surface fixed mounting of fixed plate has housing body, the top surface fixed mounting of main bottom plate has the installation piece, the top surface fixed mounting of main bottom plate has the fixed block, the cooling subassembly sets up the inside of installation piece for cool down the processing to inside brown corundum, ventilate through the cooling subassembly to inside, thereby make brown corundum rapid cooling, conveniently take out record data and observe, through electric putter's promotion, drive heat-insulating barrier's removal, thereby effectually blockking and open inside, thereby also can effectually exhaust when conveniently sealed, thereby more quick cooling down the processing to it through setting up the rotation of electric fan body, can make inside steam effectual circulation go out through the ventilative board simultaneously, thereby more conveniently cool down brown corundum.

title_en: Sample detection device for rice processing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sample detection device for rice processing, which belongs to the technical field of rice processing and comprises a base component, wherein a box component is arranged above the base component, a stirring component is arranged at the position close to the center of the box component, discharging components are arranged on the box component and positioned at the two sides of the stirring component, an upper cover is arranged above the box component, and a detection head component is arranged at the position close to the center of the upper cover; according to the utility model, the spraying and sealing device is arranged, so that the device can comprehensively spray and clean the inside of the box body assembly through the cooperation of the motor, the pump body and other structures when needed, thereby reducing the cleaning difficulty of workers, relieving the labor burden of the workers, sealing the charging hole through the L-shaped plate when needed, reducing the possibility that external impurities accidentally enter the charging hole, and further improving the working capacity of the device.

title_en: Sensor structure of electromagnetic flowmeter
abstract_en: The utility model provides a sensor structure of an electromagnetic flowmeter, which comprises a flange, a flow guide pipe, a steel wire mesh, a side plate, a cover plate, a lining, an electrode, a sealing gasket, a pressure sensor, a fixed seat, a locking pressing ring, an O-shaped sealing ring, an excitation coil and a connecting piece, and is mainly suitable for the fields of agricultural water-saving irrigation and the like. The utility model can improve the structural strength of the sensor lining, improve the sealing effect of the electrode and the like, can embed the pressure sensor, optimize the magnetic circuit mounting mode and the like, is suitable for a general converter of the electromagnetic flowmeter, can improve the assembly efficiency of the sensor of the electromagnetic flowmeter, and is more suitable for application scenes with high negative pressure or flow velocity.

title_en: Measuring device applying infrared technology
abstract_en: The utility model provides a measuring device applying infrared technology, which comprises an infrared emitter and an infrared receiver, wherein the infrared emitter and the infrared receiver are both arranged in a rotating ball, the rotating ball is arranged on a rotating rod, and the rotating rod is arranged in a shell; and a shielding component for protecting the infrared emitter and the infrared receiver is arranged on the rotating ball. According to the utility model, the angle adjustment of the infrared emitter and the infrared receiver is realized by arranging the rotating rod and the rotating ball, and meanwhile, the shielding component is arranged to shield the infrared emitter and the infrared receiver, so that the infrared emitter and the infrared receiver are prevented from being polluted.

title_en: Deformation detection device for touch screen production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a deformation detection device for touch screen production, which relates to the technical field of touch screen detection and aims to solve the problems that after the production of the existing touch screen, deformation detection is generally required to be carried out on the surface of the touch screen so as to determine the yield of the touch screen, but the existing deformation detection device for the touch screen cannot accurately detect the surface of the touch screen, so that the detection error rate is high and the detection effect is poor; further comprises: the support, it sets up in the upper end both sides of roof, the upper end fixed mounting of support has the roof, be provided with the detection seat in the middle of the below of roof, the bottom of detecting the seat is provided with flexible pipe, and flexible pipe is provided with a plurality of and is two rows of symmetry and set up in the bottom both sides of detecting the seat, the inside upside integrated into one piece of flexible pipe is provided with the circular slot, the bottom of circular slot is provided with the expansion tank, and the expansion tank runs through the bottom of flexible pipe.

title_en: Automatic flushing system for sampling pipeline of on-line monitoring system for polluted water
abstract_en: The utility model provides an automatic flushing system for a sampling pipeline of an on-line monitoring system for polluted water, which comprises the following components: the device comprises an electric cabinet, a sampling pool and a water inlet pool; the water quality monitoring equipment is arranged on one side of the electric cabinet, and the four sides of the water quality monitoring equipment are respectively connected with a fifth electromagnetic valve, a seventh electromagnetic valve, an eighth electromagnetic valve and a tenth electromagnetic valve, a sixth electromagnetic valve is connected between the fifth electromagnetic valve and the seventh electromagnetic valve, and a ninth electromagnetic valve is connected between the eighth electromagnetic valve and the tenth electromagnetic valve. The utility model provides an automatic flushing system for a sampling pipeline of an on-line monitoring system for polluted water, which can reasonably set flushing time and flushing times after the automatic flushing of the sampling pipeline system is added on the original detection system, avoid equipment faults caused by blockage, ensure the normal operation of on-line monitoring equipment, ensure that the data acquisition and transmission rate reach the national relevant regulations, reduce the operation and maintenance fault processing times and effectively reduce the operation and maintenance cost.

title_en: Wearable device and watchband assembly
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a wearable device and a watchband assembly. The wearable device includes a watch body and a wristband assembly. The watch body includes a case, a main board, a battery, and an electrical connection socket. The watch case includes a case body and a connection leg. At least one of the two opposite sides of the shell is provided with two connecting support legs. The main board and the battery are arranged in the shell. The battery is electrically connected with the main board. One of the two connecting legs on the same side of the casing is provided with an electrical connection socket. The electric connection socket is electrically connected with the main board. The wristband assembly includes a wristband, electronics disposed on the wristband, an electrical connection plug, and a latch member. The electric connection plug and the bolt component are arranged at the same end part of the watchband. The electric connection plug and the bolt component are arranged at intervals along the width direction of the watchband. The electronic device is electrically connected with the electrical connection plug. The electric connection plug is inserted into the electric connection socket on one connection support leg, and the electric connection plug can be rotatably connected to the electric connection socket. The latch member is rotatably coupled to the other of the connecting legs.

title_en: Novel near infrared analyzer equipment
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of infrared grain analyzers, in particular to novel near infrared analyzer equipment, which comprises an analyzer main body, wherein a detection table is arranged on the analyzer main body, a detector is arranged on the detection table, and a grain placement component is arranged on the detection table; the grain placement component comprises a bearing plate movably arranged on the detection table, a driving part is arranged at the bottom of the bearing plate, four accommodating cavities are formed in the top of the bearing plate, a carrying tray is arranged in each accommodating cavity, and a connecting part is arranged between each carrying tray and each accommodating cavity; the inside of the carrying disc is provided with a mounting groove, and the connecting part comprises an abutting spring fixedly connected to the inner wall of the mounting groove; through setting up cereal and place the structural design of subassembly, realized the function to the detection of a plurality of samples, solved and need take out the sample box again and carry out sample replacement after the scanning detects one sample, comparatively waste time and energy, the lower problem of detection efficiency has improved cereal detection's efficiency.

title_en: Device for eliminating water mist interference of tank top loading liquid level meter
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a device for eliminating water mist interference of a top-mounted liquid level meter at the top of a tank, which comprises a liquid level meter interface fixed on a top cover of the tank, wherein a liquid level meter is mounted on the liquid level meter interface, a liquid level meter interface flange is fixed at the top end of the liquid level meter interface, a liquid level meter flange is fixed at the bottom end of the liquid level meter, and a liquid level meter connecting piece is arranged between the liquid level meter interface flange and the liquid level meter flange; the liquid level meter comprises a liquid level meter head, a connecting rod and a liquid level meter probe, and the liquid level meter probe is positioned in the liquid level meter connecting piece; a defogging mechanism is arranged in the liquid level meter connecting piece, and the defogging mechanism is correspondingly arranged with the liquid level meter probe. The liquid level meter probe is arranged in the liquid level meter connecting piece, and the demisting mechanism is arranged in the liquid level meter connecting piece, so that dew condensation at the liquid level meter probe is reduced through the structural design of the liquid level meter connecting piece; on the other hand, by arranging the defogging mechanism in the liquid level meter connecting piece, the dewing of water mist on the liquid level meter probe is avoided, and the accuracy of the detection result is ensured.

title_en: Magneto-sensitive photoelectric panel display
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a magneto-sensitive photoelectric panel display, which relates to the technical field of liquid level meter instruments and comprises a display body, wherein mounting plates are fixedly connected to the edge positions of the side surfaces of the display body, T-shaped grooves are formed in the side surfaces of the mounting plates, T-shaped blocks are slidably arranged in the T-shaped grooves, extension columns are fixedly connected to the side surfaces of the T-shaped blocks, extension plates are rotatably connected to the outer walls of the extension columns, protection plates are fixedly connected to the tops of the extension plates, and cleaning assemblies for cleaning display screens are arranged on the protection plates. According to the utility model, the mounting plates are fixedly connected to two sides of the display screen body, the T-shaped blocks are slidably arranged in the mounting plates, the side surfaces of the T-shaped blocks are rotatably connected with the extension plates, the top parts of the extension plates are fixedly connected with the protection plates, the protection plates can move to the top parts of the display screen to perform anti-collision protection on the display screen, and when the display screen is required to be used, the protection plates can be rotatably stored in the bottom parts of the display screen body to serve as supporting structures.

title_en: Agricultural product weighing frame
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an agricultural product weighing frame in the technical field of agricultural product transportation, which comprises a base and a weighing bracket, wherein the weighing bracket is fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the base, the lower end of the base is provided with a weighing component for weighing, the front surface of the upper end of the weighing bracket is slidably provided with a hook, and the weighing frame also comprises a driving component for controlling the hook to shrink.

title_en: Battery aging test cabinet
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a battery aging test cabinet, which comprises a rack, wherein the rack is provided with a plurality of test units, each test unit comprises a test table and a test machine box, the test table is connected with the rack in a sliding manner, the test machine box is arranged on the test table and is detachably connected with the test table, one side of the test machine box is provided with a test area for placing a battery to be tested, the test tables are connected with a drag chain structure, each drag chain structure is provided with a movable end and a fixed end, and the test table is connected with the movable end of the drag chain structure. The utility model introduces the test machine box, is provided with the test bench capable of installing the test machine box, and is also provided with the drag chain structure capable of protecting the test circuit.

title_en: Gear checking tool
abstract_en: The application discloses a gear checking tool, and belongs to the technical field of gear checking. Mainly comprises the following steps: the guide seat is of a horizontal rod body structure; the mounting table is provided with a shell, the shell is rotationally connected to one end of the top of the guide seat, and the top of the shell is provided with a clamping mechanism; the detection assembly comprises a detection column, the detection column is sleeved and mounted on the outer surface of the guide seat, and a detection strip is arranged in the detection column. The gear checking tool can measure the radius of the gear, can observe the change of the distance between the outer ring of the gear and the detection column through the rotation of the gear, can detect whether the outer ring of the gear is regular, calculates the difference between the maximum radius and the minimum radius of the gear, and can read the reading of the tooth slot depth after the detection head is abutted against the inner wall of the tooth slot of the gear so as to check the gear.

title_en: Intelligent fermentation detection device for PTFE (polytetrafluoroethylene) compost film system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent fermentation detection device for a PTFE (polytetrafluoroethylene) composting film system, which comprises a foundation and a PTFE composting film, wherein the PTFE composting film is arranged at the top end of the foundation, the top end of the PTFE composting film is connected with a detection component through a pipeline, and a detection component is arranged at the rear side of the PTFE composting film, so that a detector detects the concentration of flammable gas in a detection cavity, and further, whether the composting in the PTFE composting film is completely fermented is judged; through having set up the metering assembly on the detection case right side, make vortex counter measure the flow of gas inflow through pivot pivoted number of turns and test probe, avoid detecting the inside inflammable gas of intracavity and hold too much to lead to the easy gas to leak.

title_en: Laser module of integrative light path of receiving and dispatching
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of laser radar optics, and in particular relates to a laser module of a transceiving integrated optical path, which comprises: a light source module; the Fresnel lens is provided with a basal plane and an annular tooth surface deviating from the basal plane, and the annular tooth surface is provided with a plurality of concentric annular saw teeth; the Fresnel lens is arranged on one side of the light source module, and the basal plane of the Fresnel lens faces the light source module; a receiving APD which is arranged on one side of the light source module far away from the Fresnel lens; the receiving APD, the light source module and the Fresnel lens are sequentially coaxially arranged with the measured object, the light source module and the Fresnel lens are connected with the measured object through a transmitting light path channel, the receiving APD and the Fresnel lens are connected with the measured object through a receiving light path channel, and the near-distance test blind area can be eliminated and the volume and cost of the laser module can be reduced by coaxially arranging the centroid of the receiving APD, the light source module and the Fresnel lens.

title_en: On-line analyzer for measuring pH of organic matter-containing medium
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an online analyzer for measuring the pH of a medium containing organic matters, which relates to the technical field of medium detection of the organic matters and comprises a carrying handle and an online analyzer body for measuring the organic matters, wherein the carrying handle is installed and connected at the upper end position of the online analyzer body for measuring the organic matters, measuring rod placing sleeves are arranged at the two ends of the online analyzer body for measuring the organic matters, pH electrode measuring rods are arranged at the inner sides of the measuring rod placing sleeves, a data line source is arranged on the online analyzer body for measuring the organic matters at the upper end of the pH electrode measuring rods, and a line source positioning plate is arranged in the middle of the lower end of the online analyzer body for measuring the organic matters. The pH electrode measuring rod is sleeved in the measuring rod placing sleeve, so that the pH electrode measuring rod cannot run at will, and the carrying is more convenient.

title_en: Tension detecting device convenient to fix
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a convenient-to-fix tension detection device, in particular to the technical field of tension detection equipment, which comprises a base, wherein one side of the top of the base is provided with a die, and the die is integrally in a hand shape; through adjusting part, but push-and-pull mould's position can make the mould turn over to the department that is perpendicular with the base simultaneously, conveniently overlaps the operation of establishing gloves.

title_en: Fixing device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a fixing device which comprises a mounting shell, a fixing part and a plurality of clamping assemblies.
