The fixed part is arranged in the installation shell, and one end of the fixed part penetrates through the vibration sensor to be fixed and then penetrates through the installation shell so as to fix the vibration sensor relative to the installation shell; the plurality of chucking components are used for surrounding the vibration sensor at intervals and set up, and a plurality of chucking components wear to establish respectively on the installation casing, and each chucking component all has the first curved surface that mutually supports with vibration sensor's outer peripheral face, and each first curved surface all is used for with vibration sensor's outer peripheral face butt to compress tightly vibration sensor through a plurality of first curved surfaces, with the lower problem of fixing effect of fixing device to vibration sensor among the solution prior art.

title_en: Integrated comprehensive detection and early warning equipment for river channel
abstract_en: The utility model discloses integrated comprehensive detection and early warning equipment for a river channel, and relates to the technical field of comprehensive detection. This integrated comprehensive testing, early warning equipment in river course includes unable adjustment base, unable adjustment base's lower fixed surface is connected with two fixed pins that correspond the setting from front to back, unable adjustment base's last fixed surface is connected with the data processing case, the support column that corresponds the setting from front to back of data processing case's last fixed surface is connected with two, the last fixed surface on two support columns is connected with rain-proof tops, the last fixed surface on rain-proof tops is connected with solar panel, the rear side fixedly connected with central processing unit of baffle is kept away from to the inside bottom of data processing case, the velocity of flow in river course in different positions can be measured through No. two hydraulic cylinder, simultaneously drive measuring board downwardly moving through starting hydraulic cylinder, not only can measure the river course degree of depth, can also drive water quality detector and detect the quality of different degree of depth water, thereby realize the comprehensive testing to the river course, the flexibility of this equipment has been improved.

title_en: Automatic pressure regulating device of hydraulic valve test bench
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of valve test tables and discloses an automatic pressure regulating device of a hydraulic valve test table, which comprises a base mechanism and a pressing disc mechanism, wherein the pressing disc mechanism comprises a threaded head, the threaded head is fixedly connected to a cylinder, the pressing disc is fixedly connected to a connecting rod, a spring groove is formed in the test table, a second spring is fixedly connected to the spring groove, a fixing plate is fixedly connected to the second spring, the spring rod is separated from the threaded head through a rotary spring rod, a pressing disc attached to a hydraulic valve is replaced, the hydraulic valve is pressed, the hydraulic valve is placed in the middle of three fixing plates to prop against the second spring to shrink and rebound, the three fixing plates are convenient for fixing the hydraulic valves with different specifications, the cylinder is convenient for pressure regulating work, the second spring is stably shrunk by limiting the limiting rod in the limiting rod groove, the second spring is prevented from deforming and damaging, and the working efficiency and the practicability of the device are improved.

title_en: Oil gas pipeline leakage monitoring device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an oil gas pipeline leakage monitoring device, which belongs to the technical field of oil gas pipeline monitoring and comprises a frame body assembly, wherein a driving assembly is inserted in a circumferential array at the outer side of the middle position of the frame body assembly, a monitoring assembly is transversely and fixedly arranged on the frame body assembly, the monitoring assembly comprises a driving motor, the output end of the driving motor is fixedly provided with a rotating plate, one side of the rotating plate is fixedly provided with an ultrasonic flaw detector, one side of the rotating plate is fixedly provided with an electric telescopic rod, the output end of the electric telescopic rod is fixedly provided with a monitoring probe, the monitoring probe is electrically connected with the ultrasonic flaw detector, the inside of an oil gas pipeline is conveniently monitored during use, flaw detection is conveniently carried out at each position inside the oil gas pipeline during monitoring, the inside of the oil gas pipeline is conveniently and comprehensively checked, the oil gas pipeline with leakage is avoided, and the safety risk during use is reduced.

title_en: Protection device of tensile testing machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a protection device of a tensile testing machine, which belongs to the technical field of tensile tests and comprises a tensile testing machine body and a base, wherein the tensile testing machine is fixed on the base, the base is provided with a protection mechanism, the protection mechanism comprises a first curtain, a second curtain, a sliding block, a supporting rod, barbs and a fixing plate, two ends of the base are respectively fixed on the supporting rod, the supporting rod is fixedly connected with the fixing plate, sliding grooves are formed in the fixing plate and the base, the sliding block is respectively arranged in the sliding grooves of the fixing plate and the base to slide, limiting holes are formed in the first curtain and the second curtain, one end of a barb is arranged in the limiting holes, and the other end of the barb is movably connected with the sliding block.

title_en: IGBT static test fixture
abstract_en: The utility model provides an IGBT static test fixture, comprising: the two opposite sides of the bottom plate are fixedly provided with vertical installation frames, a first transverse installation frame is arranged between the upper ends of the two vertical installation frames, and a quick pressing clamp is arranged on the first transverse installation frame; the product template is arranged between the middle parts of the two vertical installation racks, the upper side of the product template is provided with a caulking groove, and a plurality of first probe slots which are communicated up and down are arranged in the caulking groove; the probe mounting plate is fixed on the lower side of the product template and provided with a plurality of second probe slots; and one probe is inserted into each second probe slot. The utility model solves the problems that the probe in the prior art moves up and down along with manual rapid clamping, the test is unstable due to fatigue falling or virtual connection of the welded part of the test probe and the welded wire, and the probe is electrified during the test, but the probe design is exposed, and potential safety hazards exist.

title_en: On-site marker post for building engineering management
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a field pole for building engineering management, and particularly relates to the field of building engineering poles. The utility model can loosen the limit bolt at the end of the loop bar when the device is used by related personnel, the related personnel can draw the embedded bar in the cavity after the limit bolt is loosened, the related personnel can fix the embedded bar after the whole device is adjusted to a proper length, the related personnel can place the device at a designated position after the whole device is adjusted, then the related personnel can rotate the thread driving rod, the thread driving rod can promote the conical locating piece to move upwards or downwards in the rotating process, the related personnel can insert the conical locating piece into the ground in the mode, the stability of the device can be further ensured, and in addition, when the device is not used, the related personnel can retract the conical locating piece into the locating column, and the conical locating piece is prevented from being damaged by being exposed to the outside for a long time.

title_en: Intelligent locking device with output unlocking and locking states
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent locking device with an output unlocking and locking state, which comprises a device main body, an installation cabinet door, a lock pin and a connecting wire, wherein a front outer ring of the device main body is fixedly connected with a limiting strip, an electrolysis verification lock hole is arranged on one side of the front of the device main body, an electrified indicator lamp is arranged on the upper part of the other side of the front of the device main body, a phase checking device is arranged below the electrified indicator lamp, and the position of the phase checking device corresponds to the electrified indicator lamp, and the intelligent locking device further comprises: the front of device main part has seted up the slot, the inside sliding connection of slot has the lamp stand, wherein, the emergent unlocking hole has been seted up at the front middle part of device main part, has solved the pilot lamp part and the device main part of current device and has been as an organic whole structure, is inconvenient for carrying out the individual change to the pilot lamp, comparatively inconvenient during the maintenance, simultaneously, the device is inconvenient to export the problem of having certain limitation on opening and shutting state to remote equipment.

title_en: Connecting device for calibrating universal meter
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a connecting device for calibrating a universal meter, which comprises a universal meter plug, on-off switches, connecting wires and measuring pieces, wherein the universal meter plug comprises a COM public port plug and a plurality of other plugs, the number of the universal meter plugs is n, the number of the on-off switches is n-1, the heads of the COM public port plug and the plurality of other plugs are respectively inserted into measuring jacks corresponding to the universal meter, the tails of the COM public port plug are respectively connected with the tails of the plurality of other plugs through the on-off switches, the number of the measuring pieces is two, the connecting wires are a plurality of, the tails of the COM public port plug are also connected with the tail of one measuring piece through the connecting wires, the tails of the plurality of other plugs are also respectively connected with the tail of the other measuring piece through the connecting wires, and the heads of the two measuring pieces are inserted into corresponding positions of a standard device.

title_en: Standby low-voltage power supply circuit board test equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides a standby low-voltage power circuit board test device, which comprises: the device comprises a bracket, wherein a motor is arranged at the top of the bracket, a turntable is arranged at the output end of the motor, and a test module and a magnetic attraction device are arranged on the turntable; an electric push rod is fixedly arranged at the top of the bracket along the vertical direction, a connecting shaft and a worm are arranged on the side wall of the bracket in a penetrating and rotating manner along the horizontal direction, the connecting shaft is positioned above the worm, and the electric push rod is in transmission connection with the connecting shaft; the bottom of the bracket is rotationally provided with a clamping disc along the vertical direction, and the clamping disc is in transmission connection with the worm; one end of the connecting shaft is fixedly provided with a one-way bearing, and a first belt wheel is arranged outside the one-way bearing; one end of the worm is fixedly provided with a second belt wheel; a belt is sleeved between the first belt pulley and the second belt pulley. Through the arrangement of the unidirectional bearing, the test module in the device is fixed in the tray loading clamp in the descending process, so that the circuit board is detected; in the rising process, the tray clamp rotates, so that the detected circuit board is replaced conveniently.

title_en: Can have enough to meet need indoor pipeline and suppress device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a turnover indoor pipeline pressing device which comprises a main pipe, first connecting pieces, second connecting pieces, branch pipes, a switch valve and a pressure gauge, wherein a plurality of first connecting pieces are arranged on the main pipe, the second connecting pieces are arranged at the end parts of the main pipe, the first connecting pieces and the second connecting pieces are communicated with the branch pipes, the number of the branch pipes is the same as the total number of the first connecting pieces and the second connecting pieces, the pressure gauge and the switch valve are arranged on one side, far away from the first connecting pieces and the second connecting pieces, of the main pipe, the output end of the switch valve is communicated with the input end of the pressure gauge, and the input end of the switch valve is provided with a pressing machine interface. The utility model can realize simultaneous pressing test of a plurality of pipelines, quickens construction rhythm, improves pressing efficiency, has simple device installation and centralized assembly, does not need the cooperation operation of a plurality of persons or other auxiliary tools in the construction process, can be repeatedly used, is convenient to install and dismantle, and greatly improves construction efficiency.

title_en: High-pole lamp with height limiting function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-pole lamp with a height limiting function, which belongs to the field of high-pole lamps, and comprises a stand column, wherein the top end of the stand column is provided with a support, a plurality of illuminating lamps are arranged on the side wall of the support, two mounting plates are symmetrically arranged on the side wall of the support, the bottom surfaces of the mounting plates are fixedly connected with a shell, a laser ranging sensor is arranged in the shell, a data transmission module is arranged in an inner cavity of the shell, and a display assembly is arranged on the side wall of the stand column.

title_en: Semiconductor wafer thickness detects frock
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of semiconductor wafer detection equipment and discloses a semiconductor wafer thickness detection tool, wherein a circulating transmission assembly is arranged in a bracket of a track frame, a plurality of groups of mold mechanisms are arranged on a transmission belt surface of a transmission belt in the circulating transmission assembly, and a scanning detection mechanism right above the mold mechanisms is arranged in the middle of the bracket of the track frame. According to the utility model, when the thickness of the semiconductor wafer is detected by using the detection tool, the semiconductor wafer to be detected is sequentially placed in the die mechanism, and then the semiconductor wafer can be sequentially transmitted into the scanning detection mechanism for optical lens scanning detection by using the circulating transmission assembly for circulating feeding transmission of the die mechanism, so that the device has good circulating detection performance, and can be used for continuously and uninterruptedly detecting the thickness of the semiconductor chip, and the detection efficiency is improved.

title_en: Intelligent cabin core board detection system
abstract_en: The application relates to an intelligent cabin core board detection system, which relates to the technical field of core board detection and comprises display detection equipment, camera detection equipment and a processor, wherein the processor is electrically connected with the display detection equipment and the camera detection equipment respectively; the display detection equipment is used for being electrically connected with a plurality of display interfaces of the intelligent cabin core board so as to detect display signals; the camera detection equipment is used for being electrically connected with a plurality of camera interfaces of the intelligent cabin core board so as to detect camera signals. The application has the effects of improving the detection efficiency of the core board and enhancing the detection accuracy.

title_en: Building material incombustibility test equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of building material incombustibility tests and discloses building material incombustibility test equipment which comprises a fixed frame, a heating furnace, a sliding seat, a connecting frame, a bearing table, a supporting rod, an adjusting component, a refractor and a fixed rod, wherein a cleaning mechanism is arranged at the top of the fixed frame, the cleaning mechanism is convenient for a worker to observe the combustion heating condition of building materials in the heating furnace, and the cleaning mechanism comprises a mounting frame fixedly arranged on the outer wall of the right side of the fixed rod. The utility model provides a building material incombustibility test equipment, angle through adjusting pole and damping pole regulation refracting mirror, the bottom outer wall that makes refracting mirror is located parallel state with the top outer wall of clearance brush, the effect through electric telescopic handle and mount table is located same vertical plane with the clearance brush with refracting mirror, the steam of refracting mirror bottom outer wall is convenient for clear with the action of driving motor, the heating state of the inside building material of observation heating furnace of the staff of being convenient for, the accuracy of improvement test data.

title_en: Kiln-entering raw material rotor scale
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kiln raw material rotor scale which comprises a rotor scale body, wherein the rotor scale body is arranged at the upper part of a supporting steel rack, a feed inlet at the top of the rotor scale body is connected with a feed inlet chute, a discharge outlet at the bottom of the rotor scale body is connected with the feed outlet chute, an anti-blocking pneumatic punching structure is arranged on the side wall of the feed inlet of the rotor scale body, the anti-blocking pneumatic punching structure comprises a pneumatic punching pipe, and the pneumatic punching pipe is inserted on the side wall of the discharge outlet in a sliding manner. The problem of current rotor balance's feed inlet department appears the arching condition easily, influences feed stability is solved.

title_en: Sampling device for soil pollutant detection
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of sampling devices, and particularly relates to a sampling device for detecting soil pollutants, which comprises a support, wherein a sampling mechanism is arranged on the support, a sampling tube is arranged on the sampling mechanism, a support is welded on the support, wheels are arranged in the support, a sliding frame is connected to the outer side of the support in a sliding manner, a sliding rod is welded on the sliding frame, and a supporting plate is welded on the support. According to the utility model, through arranging the structures such as the support, the wheels, the sliding frame, the sliding rod, the supporting plate and the screw rod, the sliding frame drives the wheels to stretch and retract in the support by rotating the screw rod and the supporting plate, so that the whole device is convenient to move, and the device can be stably placed after moving to a designated position.

title_en: Viscosity tester
abstract_en: The application discloses a viscosity tester, which belongs to the field of testers and comprises a water storage tank, wherein a supporting plate is fixedly arranged at the top end of the water storage tank, a control console is fixedly arranged on the inner side of the supporting plate, a placement hole is formed in the top end of the water storage tank, a placement cup is arranged in the placement hole, heating wires distributed in a straight line are arranged in the water storage tank, a filter plate is fixedly arranged in the water storage tank, a clamping assembly is arranged at the top end of the water storage tank, a stirring assembly is arranged in the water storage tank, a box body is fixedly arranged at the bottom end of the control console, a second air cylinder is fixedly arranged in the box body, the end part of a piston shaft of the second air cylinder penetrates through the box body in a sliding mode, an installation box is fixedly arranged at the end part of the piston shaft of the second air cylinder, and a testing assembly is arranged below the installation box. According to the application, through the arrangement of the clamping assembly, the effect of clamping and fixing the placing cup is achieved, shaking and deviation of the placing cup due to rotating force in the testing process can be avoided, and the accuracy of the measuring result of the equipment can be improved.

title_en: Resilience centre gripping pipe foundry goods inner chamber defect detection platform
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an inner cavity defect detection table for a rebound clamping pipe casting, which can enable the pipe casting to be more stable and convenient in inner cavity defect detection through rebound clamping rods and hydraulic telescopic rods and is particularly suitable for special-shaped pipe castings. The device is characterized by comprising a detection support plate, a sliding limit rod, a clamping tool, a rebound clamping rod, a sliding limit hole, a weight reduction groove, a hydraulic telescopic rod, a support frame, a fixing rod, a rebound limit groove, a support spring and a support limit plate, wherein the detection support plate is arranged on the support frame, the detection support plate is of a U-shaped structure, one end of the sliding limit rod is arranged on one side surface of the detection support plate, the other end of the sliding limit rod is arranged on the other side surface of the detection support plate, the clamping tool is of an inverse L-shaped structure, the clamping tool is parallel to the side surface of the detection support plate, and the bottom surface of the clamping tool is not in contact with the bottom surface of the detection support plate.

title_en: Electrical detection device convenient to carry
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electrical detection device convenient to carry, which comprises a test pencil body, wherein a pencil head clamp is fixedly arranged at the front end of the test pencil body, a test contact pencil head is arranged at the outer sides of the test pencil body and the pencil head clamp, an LED night vision lamp switch is arranged at the outer side of the test pencil body close to the front end, an LED blue light indicator lamp is arranged at the outer side of the test pencil body close to the middle, an LED night vision blue screen is arranged at the outer side of the test pencil body close to the middle, and a direct detection function button is movably arranged at the outer side of the test pencil body close to the rear end. According to the portable electrical detection device, the pen point clamping head is matched with the test contact pen point, so that different test pen points can be replaced by the test pen, the replacement and disassembly processes are more convenient and simple, different electrical equipment and devices are more adaptively contacted, and the detection position of the test pen is easier to find when the test pen is used in a dim environment through the LED night vision lamp.

title_en: Bridge pier column template installation accuracy measuring tool
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of bridge construction and discloses a bridge pier column template installation precision measuring tool which comprises a right bottom plate, a left bottom plate and a measuring ruler, wherein an adjusting component is arranged above the right bottom plate, a supporting component is arranged above the left bottom plate, the adjusting component comprises a fixed column fixedly installed at the top of the right bottom plate, a fixed groove is formed in the fixed column, and the top of the fixed column is rotationally connected with a threaded rod of which one end penetrates through and extends to the inside of the fixed groove. This bridge pier column template installation accuracy measuring tool can adjust the horizontal position of dipperstick through setting up adjusting part and supporting component for the dipperstick is in horizontal position when measuring, simultaneously, when measuring, can also carry out stable support to the dipperstick, has solved current bridge pier column template installation accuracy measuring tool measuring method and has more trouble, and consuming time longer, also the problem of error appears relatively easily.

title_en: Automatic Flare detector
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a flash automatic detector, which comprises a workbench and a computer arranged at the top end of the workbench, wherein the middle part of the top end of the workbench is provided with a clamping and adjusting structure, one side of the top end of the workbench is provided with a light simulation structure for simulating irradiation light, the bottom end of the light simulation structure is provided with a rotating structure for driving the light simulation structure to rotate circumferentially, the rotating structure comprises a plurality of cross arm section bars, the bottom end of each cross arm section bar is provided with a driving piece for driving the cross arm section bars to rotate, and the bottom end of the workbench is provided with a supporting structure.

title_en: Battery thickness measuring device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a battery thickness measuring device, which relates to the technical field of lithium battery production and comprises a thickness measuring chassis, an inductor display assembly arranged on one side of the thickness measuring chassis, and a top thickness measuring clamp assembly arranged on the thickness measuring chassis, wherein the thickness measuring clamp assembly comprises a clamp bottom plate, a plurality of thickness measuring mechanisms are arranged on the clamp bottom plate, each thickness measuring mechanism comprises a thickness measuring cushion block, a first clamping plate and a second clamping plate, the thickness measuring cushion blocks are arranged between the first clamping plates and the second clamping plates and are fixed on the clamp bottom plate through supporting blocks, positioning stop bars used for being in contact with the large-surface edges of a battery are arranged on the first clamping plates and the second clamping plates, positioning columns are arranged on the positioning stop bars, the thickness measuring mechanisms further comprise sensors used for measuring thickness, and driving mechanisms used for driving the first clamping plates and the second clamping plates in the thickness measuring mechanisms to be close to or far away from each other are arranged on the thickness measuring chassis. The battery thickness measuring device provided by the utility model solves the problems of battery deformation, low thickness measuring precision and even inaccuracy.

title_en: Laminator dispersion integration acquisition temperature analysis system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a laminator dispersion integrated acquisition temperature analysis system, which comprises: the laminating machine is characterized by comprising a plurality of laminating machines to be tested, a plurality of temperature detection sensor modules, a data acquisition instrument, an industrial switch and a computer which are connected in sequence; the temperature detection sensor modules are arranged at preset positions of the corresponding laminating machines to be detected and are connected with the corresponding laminating machines to be detected; the temperature detection sensor modules are connected with the data acquisition instrument; the temperature detection sensor modules are used for detecting temperature signals of all the laminators to be detected, the data acquisition instrument is used for receiving the temperature signals of all the laminators to be detected and transmitting the temperature signals to the industrial switch, the industrial switch is used for amplifying the temperature signals of all the laminators to be detected, the amplified temperature signals are obtained and transmitted to the computer, and the computer displays and stores the amplified temperature signals. The utility model solves the problems of low temperature acquisition accuracy and high cost of the laminating machine in the prior art.

title_en: Aplanatic detection device of beam splitter prism
abstract_en: The utility model provides an aplanatic detection device of a beam-splitting prism, which can detect that the axial aplanatic difference of the beam-splitting prism on two light paths reaches a micron level and has extremely high precision. The device comprises a white light source, a lens, a spectroscope, an objective lens, a tube lens and a CCD (charge coupled device) for detecting the optical path difference of a spectroscope; white light emitted by the white light source is converged after being reflected by the lens and the spectroscope, then is emitted by the objective lens in parallel, enters the beam splitting prism through the second right-angle surface of the right-angle prism I, and a beam of parallel light is reflected to the first right-angle surface of the right-angle prism I through the inclined surface of the beam splitting prism and is reflected by the first right-angle surface of the right-angle prism I to form a first reflected light beam; the other beam of parallel light entering the beam splitting prism is reflected by the first right-angle surface of the right-angle prism II to form a second reflected light beam after passing through the inclined plane of the beam splitting prism, and the first reflected light beam and the second reflected light beam are converged on the CCD through the beam splitting prism, the objective lens, the beam splitter and the tube lens.

title_en: Testing system of power device
abstract_en: The application relates to a testing system of a power device, which comprises an industrial personal computer, a testing module and a product board, wherein the testing module is connected with the industrial personal computer, the product board comprises a grid driving module, and the product board is used for placing the power device to be tested; the grid driving module is connected with the grid of the power device to be tested, and the testing module is connected with the source electrode and the drain electrode of the power device to be tested. The grid electrode of the power device to be tested is directly connected with the grid electrode driving module, the driving distance is reduced in a front grid electrode driving mode, parasitic inductance of a grid electrode cable is reduced, and grid electrode/drain electrode oscillation is effectively reduced.

title_en: Traction force measuring mechanism of tractor
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of traction force measurement of tractors, in particular to a traction force measuring mechanism of a tractor, which has the technical scheme that: the traction device comprises a fixing plate and a force measuring assembly for measuring traction force of a tractor, wherein guide assemblies are arranged on two sides of the force measuring assembly, a traction rope penetrates through the middle of the guide assemblies, and a first fixing block and a second fixing block are respectively arranged at one end, far away from the force measuring assembly, of the traction rope, and the traction device has the beneficial effects that: one end of the traction rope is connected to one side of the first fixing block or the second fixing block, the other end of the traction rope penetrates through the guide assembly to be connected with the force measuring assembly, at the moment, the two tractors can move to pull the traction rope in opposite directions, the force measuring assembly is used for measuring traction force of the tractors, when the traction rope penetrates through the guide assembly, through the through hole in the middle of the guide inner barrel, the guide inner barrel conveniently guides the traction rope, horizontal extension of the traction rope is guaranteed, and deflection of the traction rope during force measurement is prevented.

title_en: Sampling device for engineering investigation design
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of engineering investigation sampling devices and discloses a sampling device for engineering investigation design, which comprises a base, wherein a through groove is formed in the front end face of the base, a fixing frame and a connecting frame are fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the base, a rotating frame is rotatably arranged on the inner wall of the fixing frame, a lifting plate is slidably arranged on the inner wall of the rotating frame, the lower end of the lifting plate is fixedly connected with a sliding cylinder, a first motor is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the lifting plate, and the output end of the first motor is fixedly connected with a screw rod and penetrates through the sliding cylinder. According to the sampling device for engineering investigation design, the sampling device for engineering investigation design has the effect of sampling soil layers or rock layers with different angles, so that the structure of the soil layers or the rock layers can be better known, and meanwhile, the sampling device for engineering investigation design has the effect of fixing the sampling device, so that the sampling device is more stable and is not easy to shake in the sampling process.

title_en: Grid detector
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a grating detector which comprises a main frame, wherein a processing housing is fixedly arranged at the top of the main frame, a feeding supporting plate and a discharging supporting plate are respectively and fixedly arranged at two sides of the processing housing, a driving shaft is rotatably arranged on the processing housing, a driven shaft is movably arranged on the processing housing, a second pattern roller and a first pattern roller are respectively and fixedly sleeved on the driven shaft and the driving shaft, a driving mechanism is arranged on the main frame and used for driving the driving shaft to rotate, and an elastic extrusion assembly is arranged on the processing housing and used for vertically and elastically extruding the driven shaft. The grid plate inspection device is high in efficiency, convenient to observe whether the grid plate meets the standard or not, and convenient to use.

title_en: Water pump outlet water pressure monitoring device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a water pump water outlet pressure monitoring device which comprises a pressure sensor, a monitoring instrument, a mounting structure, a pressure measuring meter, a first mounting structure, a second mounting structure and a water outlet pipeline, wherein the pressure sensor is connected with the pressure measuring meter; the water outlet pipeline is provided with a flaring pipeline, and the pressure sensor is detachably connected with the flaring pipeline through a first mounting structure; the first mounting structure comprises a first fixing sleeve, a sealing structure, two mounting bases and two fastening mechanisms. The water pump outlet water pressure monitoring device solves the problem that an operator cannot accurately know the working state of a water pump due to the fact that a water pump in the related technology lacks the water outlet water pressure monitoring device.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle's air data acquisition device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an air data acquisition device of an unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body, wherein a mounting frame is arranged at the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle body, the bottom of the mounting frame is connected with a shell, a plurality of sampling cavities for storing sample gas are formed in the shell at equal angles, and a one-way outlet valve pipe and a one-way inlet valve pipe are respectively communicated with the bottom of the shell corresponding to each sampling cavity. This unmanned aerial vehicle's air data acquisition device, clean air after the purification enters into the sampling chamber, then promotes the one-way outlet valve pipe and opens and discharge sampling chamber from it, at this in-process, clean air flow carries the impurity of sampling intracavity and discharges sampling chamber, reaches the washing effect, need not extra manual cleaning, labour saving and time saving has promoted the practicality of device.

title_en: Water sample collection system that water quality testing used
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water sample collecting device for water quality detection, which relates to the technical field of water quality detection and comprises an outer bottle body, wherein a slide bar is arranged in the outer bottle body, a thermometer is arranged on the inner surface of the slide bar, a buoyancy block is arranged on the outer wall of the slide bar, the buoyancy block can slide up and down along the slide bar, a magnet block is arranged on the outer surface of the upper end of the buoyancy block, two groups of water inlets are arranged on the outer surface of the outer bottle body, magnetic control valves are arranged at the tail ends of the two groups of water inlets and are positioned in the inner part of the outer bottle body, a waterproof bin is arranged on the outer surface of the upper end of the outer bottle body, a magnetic control terminal is arranged in the waterproof bin, an induction groove is formed in the magnetic control terminal, the switch of a water inlet valve can be controlled without manual operation, the buoyancy structure of the buoyancy block and the magnet block are matched with the induction groove and the magnetic control terminal, the effect of switching the magnetic control valve can be automatically completed, the whole flow is automatically completed, and the water sample collecting device is convenient to use.

title_en: Orthodontic periodontal ligament tensile testing device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of oral medical appliances, in particular to an orthodontic periodontal ligament tensile testing device, which comprises an alveolar bone clamping mechanism and a tooth clamping mechanism, and further comprises: the base is provided with an alveolar bone clamping mechanism; adjustment mechanism, adjustment mechanism sets up on the base, adjustment mechanism includes the supporting groove, supporting groove fixed connection is on the base, a drive screw thread axle through the motor rotates, the screw thread axle of being convenient for cooperates with the supporting groove, force the lifter plate and go up and down, thereby be convenient for drive electronic jar, tooth fixture etc. go on going up and down, electronic jar is convenient for carry out horizontal migration to tooth fixture, rethread motor two and the cooperation of rotating the seat, be convenient for drive tooth fixture and rotate, alright realize the automatically regulated to tooth fixture like this, manual operation has been avoided, the practicality is improved.

title_en: Single-shaft sensor for detecting inclination angle of object
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of single-axis sensors, in particular to a single-axis sensor for detecting the inclination angle of an object. The sensor comprises a sensor main body, wherein a sensor shell is sleeved outside the sensor main body, and a sensor base is arranged below the sensor shell; the sensor base comprises a mounting plate and a fixing plate, wherein one side of the upper surface of the fixing plate is fixedly connected with a 匚 -shaped connecting frame, the inner wall of the 匚 -shaped connecting frame is fixedly connected with a rotating shaft, one side of the mounting plate is provided with a rotating groove corresponding to the rotating shaft, and the other side of the upper surface of the fixing plate is fixedly connected with a positioning sleeve.

title_en: Pipeline outer detection device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of pipeline detection, and discloses an external pipeline detection device which comprises two supporting bottom plates and two supporting rods, wherein the tops of the two supporting bottom plates and the two supporting rods are fixedly connected with supporting columns, the inner walls of the supporting columns are provided with mounting grooves for fixing, the inner wall of one of the mounting grooves is fixedly provided with a hydraulic rod for pushing, the other end of the hydraulic rod is fixedly connected with one of the supporting rods, the surfaces of the supporting rods are sleeved with adjusting cylinders for fixing, one side of each supporting column is fixedly provided with a mounting frame for fixing, and the inner wall of each mounting frame is clamped with a mounting rod for supporting. This outer detection device of pipeline, through the setting of bracing piece with adjust a section of thick bamboo, with the help of the sliding action of bracing piece at an inner wall of an adjusting cylinder, and then can conveniently adjust the length that the bracing piece stretches out to can adjust the length that the bracing piece stretches out according to the thickness of spacing ring, consequently can conveniently place the spacing ring of equidimension not.

title_en: Sealing laboratory for laser fracturing test
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of laser rock breaking application and discloses a sealing laboratory for a laser fracturing test, which comprises an optical experiment platform, an experiment cavity and a laser emitter, wherein the experiment cavity is arranged at the top of the optical experiment platform, an annular sealing gasket is fixed at the bottom of the experiment cavity around an inner cavity of the experiment cavity, the annular sealing gasket is in compression state to contact the optical experiment platform, a sample table is arranged in the experiment cavity, the sample table is arranged on the optical experiment platform, the laser emitter is vertically arranged right above the test table, an imaging camera and a power test probe are arranged on the inner side wall of the experiment cavity, a test window is arranged on the experiment cavity, a glass window plate is arranged in the test window, the glass window plate is in sliding connection with the experiment cavity, and the glass window plate moves along the height direction of the experiment cavity and is used for opening or closing the test window. The sealed experimental environment is formed, the interference of the external environment to the experimental environment is avoided, the experimental environment parameters are more accurate, and the experimental accuracy is improved.

title_en: Connecting plate for chip
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a connecting plate for chips, which comprises a fixed bottom plate, wherein a test circuit board is connected to the fixed bottom plate, and a conduction connecting component for conducting the test circuit board and a product is connected to the center of the test circuit board. The utility model can improve stable connection and ensure the accuracy of detection.

title_en: Reservoir water level monitoring device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a reservoir water level monitoring device which comprises a hollow upright rod, a radar water level gauge and a base arranged at the bottom of the hollow upright rod, wherein a U-shaped bracket is movably arranged at the outer side of the upper part of the hollow upright rod, one end of the U-shaped bracket, which is far away from the hollow upright rod, is provided with a mounting plate for mounting the radar water level gauge, a supporting inclined rod is arranged below the mounting plate, two ends of the supporting inclined rod are connected with a hinged bracket through a rotating shaft, one side of the lower end of the supporting inclined rod is provided with a driving mechanism, and the driving mechanism is connected with the hinged bracket positioned at the lower part through a sliding connection mechanism; the utility model controls the sliding connection mechanism to move downwards through the driving mechanism, and the mounting plate is driven to rotate downwards by the supporting inclined rod along with the U-shaped bracket, so that the height of the radar water level gauge is reduced, the operation risk is reduced, the safety is improved, and the driving mechanism is electrically controlled, time-saving and labor-saving, and in addition, the driving mechanism consisting of the driving motor, the driving screw and the nut sliding seat is simple in structure, easy to realize and beneficial to popularization.

title_en: Building construction line weighs down
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a building construction line drop, which comprises a line drop body, wherein a quick-release assembly is fixedly arranged at the top of the line drop body, a replacement assembly is arranged at the bottom of the line drop body, and the top of the quick-release assembly is connected with a height adjusting assembly; the quick-dismantling assembly comprises a fixing frame and a rotating plate, wherein the fixing frame is fixedly arranged at the top of a wire pendant body, the rotating plate is hinged at the top of the fixing frame, one side of the rotating plate is fixedly provided with a first fixing plate, and the top of the first fixing plate is connected with a threaded rod through threads; this construction line weighs down, through quick detach subassembly, can dismantle fast for can be more convenient when changing the rope, timely change the rope can let its use safer, can not appear the condition of incident in the in-process of using, more reduced the condition that has to break, also reduced the cost of breaking and bringing, also reduced the required time of change, the effect of using also can increase thereupon, facilitate promotion uses, makes.

title_en: Laser radar receiving system and laser radar
abstract_en: The utility model provides a laser radar receiving system and a laser radar, and relates to the technical field of laser radars. The laser radar receiving system includes: the sampling module and the photoelectric receiving module. The sampling module can adjust the resistance of the sampling module according to the receiving time of the photoelectric receiving module under the preset voltage, so as to adjust the gain of the photoelectric receiving module. According to the utility model, the sampling resistor of the laser radar receiver is dynamically adjusted on the basis of fixing the voltage of the laser radar receiver, and the sampling resistor with smaller resistance can be used under the condition of short-distance sampling. And further, the blind area of laser radar ranging is reduced, and the accuracy of laser radar detection in a close range is greatly improved. The sampling resistor with larger resistance value can be used under the condition of long-distance sampling, so that the ranging range of the laser radar is dynamically adjusted.

title_en: Soil detection edulcoration preprocessing device
abstract_en: A soil detection impurity removal pretreatment device belongs to the technical field of soil treatment equipment and comprises: the shell, the shell is central front side open-ended cavity structure, two rolls are installed in the inner chamber top symmetry rotation of shell, first protective housing is installed on the right side top of shell, first motor is installed to the outer wall of first protective housing, just the output of first motor extends into the inner chamber of first protective housing, two gears are installed in the inner chamber rotation of first protective housing. This soil detection edulcoration preprocessing device can roll the soil of knot and smash in the in-service use, guarantees that all soils appear loose state, can also sieve and edulcorate soil sample voluntarily, makes soil and impurity carry out automatic discharge through different routes respectively, improves efficiency, saves the cost, and concentrated transfer when can also guaranteeing soil sample upper and lower floor transfer avoids soil to scatter outside equipment.

title_en: Tester for detecting semiconductor device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tester for detecting semiconductor devices, which comprises a test table, wherein a supporting frame and a detector are arranged on the test table, an adjusting box is arranged on the test table, a supporting sleeve is arranged in the adjusting box, an adjusting plate is arranged on the supporting sleeve in a sliding mode, a supporting rod is arranged on the adjusting plate, a supporting plate is arranged on the supporting rod, an adjusting cylinder is arranged between the adjusting box and the adjusting plate, a supporting column is arranged on the supporting sleeve in a sliding mode, a clamping seat is arranged at the top of the supporting column, the clamping seat is rotationally connected with the supporting plate, a moving groove is arranged on the clamping seat, a moving rod is arranged in the moving groove in a sliding mode, sliding grooves are arranged on the upper side and the lower side of the moving groove, sliding blocks are arranged on the moving rod, a limiting block is arranged on the moving rod, the limiting block is provided with a clamping device, the adjusting cylinder drives the adjusting plate to move in the vertical direction, the moving direction of the moving rod in the moving groove is limited, and the position of the clamping device is adjusted through the matching of the sliding blocks and the sliding grooves.

title_en: Image shooting device for detecting product appearance
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of detection equipment, and particularly discloses an image shooting device for detecting the appearance of a product, which comprises a detection table and a camera, wherein the camera is arranged on one side of the detection table; one side of the detection table is provided with a curtain wall, the curtain wall comprises a bracket, a cloth box is arranged on the bracket, a rotary cover is arranged at the top of the cloth box, a curtain is arranged in the cloth box, a winding drum and a cloth foot clamp are respectively arranged at two ends of the curtain, the curtain is wound on the winding drum, and the cloth foot clamp is slidably arranged in the bracket; an inner cavity for accommodating the curtain wall and the camera is arranged in the detection table; according to the utility model, the bracket can be stored through the arranged inner cavity, so that the curtain is protected, the curtain is prevented from being polluted, the desktop of the detection table can be emptied, larger or larger objects to be detected can be placed, and the cloth box can be opened by rotating the rotary cover, so that a user can conveniently replace the curtain with larger color difference with the objects to be detected.

title_en: Radiation visual green plant
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a radiation visualization green plant which comprises a mounting box, wherein an electric push rod is fixedly connected to the inner bottom side wall of the mounting box, the upper end of the electric push rod is fixedly connected with a lifting plate, the lifting plate is slidably connected in the mounting box, simulated grass is arranged on the upper side of the lifting plate, a central controller is mounted on the inner bottom side wall of the mounting box, a display screen and an electromagnetic radiation sensor are fixedly connected to the outer side wall of the mounting box, and the display screen and the electromagnetic radiation sensor are electrically connected with the central controller. The utility model has reasonable design and ingenious conception, and can lead surrounding people to intuitively feel the intensity of radiation in the surrounding environment and give precautions by the tangible radiation value, and when the radiation value rises, the simulated grass can also grow, thus having high practicability.

title_en: Online monitoring device of high-permeability nylon 6 filament winding machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of spinning, and provides an on-line monitoring device of a high-permeability nylon 6 filament winding machine, which comprises the following components: a winder, a yarn tension monitoring assembly, a yarn appearance monitoring assembly and a computer; the yarn tension monitoring assembly comprises a first yarn guide, a second yarn guide and a yarn tension meter, and the yarn tension meter is electrically and mechanically connected with the machine; the silk thread appearance monitoring component comprises a camera and an ultraviolet lamp, and the camera and the ultraviolet lamp are electrically connected with a computer; the silk thread sequentially passes through the first silk guide, the silk thread tension meter and the second silk guide and is wound on a winding drum of the winding machine. The utility model has the advantages that: a wire tension meter is arranged at the upper part of a frame of the winding machine, and the wire tension is monitored in real time; a camera is arranged at the lower part of a frame of the winding machine to monitor the appearance of the silk thread, and an ultraviolet lamp is used for irradiating the oxidation surface of the silk thread to generate fluorescent reaction so as to judge the oxidation condition of the silk thread; and the quality of the product is controlled on line by checking the record chart in a computer.

title_en: Data line intensity detection device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of data line detection technology, particularly a data line strength detection device, comprising a device body. The top of the device body is pierced with two arc-shaped grooves arranged in a circular array with the same center, and moving rods are respectively slid in the two arc-shaped grooves. When fixing the data line, the data line detection device only needs to rotate one control handle to synchronously release the data line from the two pairs of clamping plates on the two fixed plates. The disassembly and assembly of the data line is more convenient and fast, and the fixed plate at the top of the moving rod is always oriented towards the central axis in the heavy sliding of the arc-shaped groove, effectively avoiding interference from the free rotation of the two fixed plates and affecting the control of the bending angle of the data line. The detection is more accurate.

title_en: Tunnel hidden disease detection test device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a tunnel hidden disease detection test device, which belongs to the technical field of tunnel engineering, and comprises a tunnel model comprising an internal disease model and an external disease model, wherein a linear guide rail coaxial with the tunnel model is arranged below a channel of the tunnel model, and a sliding block on the linear guide rail is connected with radar equipment through an angle-adjustable and length-adjustable adjusting bracket.

title_en: Chemical oxygen demand detection device for dyeing wastewater
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of dyeing wastewater detection, and discloses a chemical oxygen demand detection device for dyeing wastewater, which comprises a flat plate, wherein a shaking component is arranged at the bottom of the flat plate, and a filtering component is arranged at the top of the flat plate; the shaking component comprises a motor fixedly connected with the inner top wall of the flat plate, a rotating block is fixedly connected to the bottom of the motor, a detection tank body is fixedly connected to the bottom of the rotating block, a stabilizer bar is fixedly connected to the bottom of the detection tank body, a positioning ring is sleeved on the outer surface of the detection tank body, a connecting rod is fixedly connected to the outer surface of the positioning ring, supporting legs are fixedly connected to the left side and the right side of the flat plate, a protection tube is fixedly connected to the top of the detection tank body, and a detection probe is fixedly connected to the bottom of the protection tube. This dyeing waste water is with chemical oxygen demand detection device can shake the liquid of jar internal portion even through quick pivoted mode, makes the liquid carry out intensive mixing, can promote the quality of detection of sample.

title_en: Chemical fiber cloth with high wear resistance and cloth wear resistance testing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a chemical fiber cloth with high wear resistance and a cloth wear resistance testing device, which comprise a first chemical fiber outer layer and a second chemical fiber outer layer, wherein a first reinforcing layer, a water absorption layer, a heat preservation layer and a second reinforcing layer are sequentially arranged between the first chemical fiber outer layer and the second chemical fiber outer layer from right to left. This chemical fiber cloth and cloth wear resistance testing arrangement with high wear resistance through setting up a plurality of test section of thick bamboo, and when the device was used, firstly took off a plurality of test section of thick bamboo from the pole of placing of the device, then install a plurality of batches cloth that awaits measuring respectively on a plurality of test section of thick bamboo, later install a plurality of test section of thick bamboo back in the device, can start the device afterwards, and the device starts the back, places the pole and rotates and will drive a plurality of test section of thick bamboo synchronous rotation to carry out synchronous test to a plurality of batch cloth sample, improved the whole work efficiency of cloth wear resistance test.

title_en: A detection device for furniture stability
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of stable clamping detection, in particular to a detection device for furniture stability, which comprises a machine base, wherein the upper side wall of the machine base is fixedly connected with an air cylinder, the driving end fixedly connected with pressure measurement piece of cylinder, the middle-end fixedly connected with drive plate of the driving end of cylinder, the frame includes symmetrical fixture, symmetrical fixture includes fixed block and connecting plate. According to the utility model, the transmission plate is contacted with the connecting plate along with the movement of the driving end of the air cylinder through the air cylinder, so that the movable column is driven to move upwards, the limiting plate is driven to move upwards when the movable column moves upwards, the left connecting end of the limiting block is also stressed upwards, the movable block II rotates upwards under the influence of the limiting block, and the movable block I rotates upwards under the influence of the clamping column and the upward rotating force of the movable block II when the movable block moves upwards, and at the moment, the clamping column moves upwards right, and the symmetrical clamping column contacts furniture to complete the fixing effect.

title_en: Performance detection equipment for insulating sleeve accessory production
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of insulating sleeves, in particular to performance detection equipment for producing an insulating sleeve accessory, which comprises a box body, wherein a rotating rod is arranged at one end of the inner wall of the bottom of the box body, a fixed structure is arranged on the outer wall of the top end of the rotating rod, a heating assembly is arranged at the other end of the inner wall of the top of the box body, and a controller is arranged on the outer wall of the top of the box body; the fixed structure comprises a mounting seat rotationally connected to the top end of the rotating rod, a connecting pipe arranged on the inner wall of the mounting seat, a fixed box welded on the outer wall of one end of the connecting pipe, a bevel gear I rotationally connected to one end of the inner wall of the fixed box and a moving rod equidistantly arranged on the inner wall of the fixed box. According to the utility model, the fixed motor drives the bevel gear I to rotate, the bevel gear I drives the movable screw to rotate through the bevel gear II, the clamping rods are driven to be far away from each other in the movable groove, a certain pulling force is applied to the insulating sleeve, the insulating sleeve is placed and falls, the experiment is convenient, and the fixing is convenient.

title_en: Broadband hyperspectral imager
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a broadband hyperspectral imager, which comprises a movable frame and an adjustable focal length lens arranged on one side of the movable frame, wherein a visible light camera, a first hyperspectral imager and a second hyperspectral imager are further arranged on the movable frame, and the broadband hyperspectral imager further comprises a driving component for driving the movable frame to move along a direction parallel to a plane, so that the visible light camera, the first hyperspectral imager and the second hyperspectral imager are respectively aligned with the adjustable focal length lens. The working wave bands of the first hyperspectral imager and the working wave bands of the second hyperspectral imager are different, the hyperspectral imager with the wide wave band further comprises an imaging system, the imaging system respectively carries out data processing and image splicing on spectrum signals acquired by the first hyperspectral imager and the second hyperspectral imager to the object to be detected, so that a spectrum image with the first working wave band and the second working wave band is obtained, and the manufacturing cost can be reduced.

title_en: Electronic product supporting device for sealing pressurization test
abstract_en: The utility model provides an electronic product supporting device for a sealing pressurization test, which comprises a plurality of trays, wherein the trays are arranged in a stacking way from top to bottom, and gaps are reserved between every two adjacent layers of trays; a plurality of support columns capable of supporting the upper layer of trays are arranged between every two adjacent layers of trays, the support columns are arranged around the edges of the trays, and the support columns are detachably connected with the trays. By adopting the utility model, the trays are arranged in a stacked manner and a gap is reserved, so that products can be arranged on each tray and simultaneously subjected to a sealing pressurization test, the products are prevented from being stacked, and the defects caused by uneven stress in the test process are prevented; the method realizes batch product simultaneous test, improves the loading rate of the pressure chamber, improves the detection yield and reduces the detection cost. Further, the edge of the tray is also provided with a flange, and the inner side of the flange is provided with a boss; the support column is connected with the boss.

title_en: Hall displacement sensor with position-adjustable Hall element
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a Hall displacement sensor with an adjustable position of a Hall element, which comprises a shell, wherein one end of the shell is provided with a circuit board accommodating hole, the other end of the shell is provided with a piston hole communicated with the circuit board accommodating hole, the circuit board accommodating hole is a threaded hole, an adjusting screw plug matched with the circuit board accommodating hole is arranged in the circuit board accommodating hole, one end of the adjusting screw plug, which is close to the piston hole, is fixedly provided with the circuit board, the Hall element is welded on the circuit board, the piston hole is internally provided with a piston rod which is in penetrating match with the piston hole, one end of the piston rod, which is close to the circuit board accommodating hole, is fixedly provided with a permanent magnet, and one end of the piston rod, which is far away from the circuit board accommodating hole, is provided with a probe.

title_en: Portable noise detector for mine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of mining detection, in particular to a portable noise detector for mines, which comprises a noise monitor body, wherein two sides of the noise monitor body are fixedly connected with armband holes, two armband holes are respectively sleeved with two sections of an armband, the armband is positioned below the noise monitor body, and a limiting hole is formed in the surface of the armband. The portable noise detector after the improvement, one side fixedly connected with rope hole of noise monitor can let the rope pass from rope hole the inside, can hang noise monitor on the neck, and the both sides fixedly connected with arm area hole of noise monitor body can let the arm area pass from the centre in arm area hole, carries out spacingly to the arm area according to the thickness of individual arm, fixes the arm area through the block between public buckle and the female buckle, can tie noise monitor on the arm and need not take with the hand, also need not worry to lose, carries more convenience.

title_en: Intelligent inspection system for full scene of railway power remote box transformer substation
abstract_en: The application provides a full-scene visual intelligent inspection system for a railway electric remote control box transformer substation, which comprises a cloud background and an inspection subsystem arranged on a remote control box body, wherein the inspection subsystem comprises an indoor inspection mechanism arranged in the remote control box body and an outdoor inspection mechanism arranged outside the remote control box body. According to the application, the indoor inspection mechanism and the outdoor inspection mechanism are combined to carry out panoramic monitoring on the running state in the remote control box and the outer environment state of the box, so that the labor intensity of operation and maintenance personnel is reduced, the discovery time and speed of fault hidden danger are improved, the inspection efficiency and inspection quality of the electric remote control box transformer substation are improved, and the stable running of a railway power supply and distribution system is ensured.

title_en: Water absorbing structure for winding wire of inclination measuring equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water absorption structure for winding up a wire of slope measuring equipment, which comprises a fixed casing, a guide pipe, a cable part and an inclinometer rod, wherein the cable part is arranged on the fixed casing and comprises a winding drum around which a cable is wound, the guide pipe is fixedly connected on the fixed casing and is provided with a guide channel communicated with the fixed casing in a penetrating way, and the inclinometer rod is arranged in the guide channel in a sliding way, and one end of the inclinometer rod is connected with the cable. The water absorption structure comprises a first water absorption part and a second water absorption part which are matched for use, wherein the first water absorption part is arranged at the junction of the guide channel and the fixed casing, a water absorption channel through which a cable passes is arranged on the first water absorption part, the second water absorption part is positioned between the first water absorption part and the winding wire disc and can flexibly abut against the cable positioned between the winding wire disc and the first water absorption part, and the water absorption rate of the second water absorption part is larger than that of the first water absorption part. The utility model can absorb water to the cable in the winding process, thereby avoiding the winding trouble caused by the water dipping of the cable.

title_en: Flange type electromagnetic calorimeter
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a flange type electromagnetic calorimeter which comprises a dial plate and a pipeline connector, wherein the dial plate is arranged at the upper position of the pipeline connector, a supporting seat is fixedly connected to the bottom of the pipeline connector, a supporting component is arranged at the lower position of the supporting seat, the supporting component comprises a threaded column which is spirally inserted at the bottom of the supporting seat, a nut which is sleeved outside the threaded column and is spirally connected, an adjusting seat which is fixedly connected to the bottom end of the threaded column, a power assisting hole formed in the outer wall of the adjusting seat, and a base which is fixedly connected to the bottom end of the adjusting seat. After the pipeline joint is connected with the external pipeline in a conducting manner, the base is screwed relative to the supporting seat according to the distance between the pipeline joint and the supporting surface, the plug-in end of the threaded column rotates relative to the supporting seat until the base is attached to the supporting surface, and the supporting surface provides supporting force for the pipeline joint through the base and the supporting seat, so that the pipeline joint has good stability.

title_en: Pipeline inner wall anti-corrosion coating thickness detection device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a device for detecting the thickness of an anti-corrosion coating on the inner wall of a pipeline, which relates to the technical field of pipeline detection, round corners such as a collision plate are distributed on the outer side of a cross rod, connecting rods are hinged on the left side and the right side of the inner arc wall of the collision plate, the connecting rods are movably arranged in movable grooves formed in the outer annular wall of the cross rod, movable blocks are movably arranged in the cross rod, one end of each connecting rod is hinged on each movable block, the adaptation mechanism connected with the movable block is arranged in the cross rod, the fixing frames are respectively fixedly arranged on the outer arc walls of the plurality of abutting plates, the rollers are rotatably connected to the fixing frames through the shafts and the bearings, the detection probes can be supported in the detection process and located at the circle center of the circular pipeline, and the accuracy of the detection result and the convenience in the detection process are improved.

title_en: Outflow test device for large arc-shaped radiator
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a large-scale arc-shaped radiator outflow test device which comprises a water tank, wherein an arc-shaped radiator is arranged at the bottom of the water tank, two end faces of the arc-shaped radiator are matched with each other to form a cartridge receiver, the shape of the end face of the cartridge receiver, which is contacted with the arc-shaped radiator, is matched with that of the outer wall face of the cartridge receiver, which is contacted with water flow, is identical to that of the outer wall face of the arc-shaped radiator, and the water flow in the water tank is guided to be completely jointed with the outer wall face of the arc-shaped radiator to be evenly flushed. The utility model can simulate the flow heat exchange of the arc radiator under water, is more in line with the actual situation, improves the test accuracy, reduces the test cost and shortens the test period.

title_en: Load box detection equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses load box detection equipment, which belongs to the technical field of load box detection and comprises a detection box for load box detection, wherein a movable plate is arranged in the detection box, first fixed blocks are arranged at the upper end and the lower end of the front surface of the detection box, a motor is arranged at the top end of one of the first fixed blocks, and a first screw rod is arranged at the output end of the motor. This load case check out test set through being equipped with motor, connecting plate, placing board and fly leaf, places the load case that will await measuring on placing the board, drives through motor work and places the board and upwards move, until it flushes the back with the fly leaf, will place the board and remove to the fly leaf on, can assist the load case that awaits measuring from the fly leaf in the detection case like this through this kind of mode and get and put, and whole process need not the manual work to lift up the load case, after detecting for a long time like this, can slow down the inspector fatigue to reduce and influence detection efficiency.

title_en: Special sample holder for analyzing slag and iron by intelligent x-fluorescence analyzer
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of chemical metallurgy, in particular to a special sample holder for analyzing slag and iron by an intelligent x-ray fluorescence instrument, which comprises a protection holder and a positioning holder which are integrally formed, wherein the positioning holder is connected to the bottom of the protection holder, the protection holder and the positioning holder are coaxially arranged, a slag sample cavity for placing a slag sample is formed in the top of the protection holder, and an iron sample cavity communicated with the slag sample cavity is formed in the bottom end of the positioning holder in a penetrating manner. According to the utility model, the slag sample can be placed in the slag sample cavity or the iron sample can be placed in the iron sample cavity, so that when the pushing device configured by the instrument automatically pushes the sample holder body, the sample holder body drives the slag sample or the iron sample to move, and then the sample holder body can move to the designated circle center position at the inlet of the sample box of the fluorescent instrument, so that the sample holder body can completely cover the caliber of the sample box, fluorescent detection analysis of the iron sample and the slag sample on the same set instrument is facilitated, the instrument analysis requirement is met, a plurality of instruments are not required to be configured, and a certain investment cost of an enterprise is reduced.

title_en: Detection tool for automobile water cutting compression load
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a detection tool for a compression load of an automobile water cutter, which comprises a fixed frame, a mounting plate and a movable assembly, wherein the mounting plate is used for mounting the water cutter, a pressure sensor is arranged between the mounting plate and the fixed frame, and the movable assembly is arranged on the fixed frame and comprises a movable plate which can move relative to the mounting plate, and the movable plate can move along the direction towards or away from the mounting plate so as to extrude or release the water cutter. In the utility model, a movable plate and a mounting plate are arranged, the movable plate is positioned above the mounting plate, a water cut is arranged above the mounting plate, the movable plate moves downwards to squeeze the water cut, at the moment, the water cut also has an acting force on the mounting plate, the acting force is equal to the compression load of the water cut, and the force is transmitted to a pressure sensor through the mounting plate and displayed in a numerical form. Therefore, the detection tool for the water cutting compression load can be provided, and the detection tool is lighter in weight, smaller in size, lower in cost and more convenient to move.

title_en: Battery gas collecting device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of batteries, in particular to a battery gas collecting device. The battery gas collection device comprises a collection pipe, a push rod assembly and a baffle plate, wherein the top of the collection pipe is provided with an opening in a penetrating mode, and the bottom of the collection pipe is provided with a through hole and an air hole in a penetrating mode. One end of the push rod component is sealed through the opening and movably penetrates through the collecting pipe. One end of the baffle plate is sealed and movably penetrates through the through hole and stretches into the collecting pipe, and the baffle plate is provided with a detection position for plugging the air hole and a collection position for opening the air hole. When the baffle is positioned at the collecting position, the collecting pipe is communicated with the inside of the battery through the air hole. The push rod assembly is pulled to slide outwards along the axial direction of the collecting pipe so as to suck the battery gas into the collecting pipe, and after the collection is completed, the baffle plate moves to the detection position. Through pulling push rod subassembly quick collection battery gas, realize the closure of gas pocket through the baffle simultaneously to guarantee the leakproofness of collecting pipe, simplified the structure of battery gas collection device, improved collection efficiency.

title_en: Wall sampling device for quality detection of building engineering
