abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wall sampling device for detecting the quality of constructional engineering, which comprises a cutting pipe, wherein one side of the cutting pipe is fixedly connected with a mounting shaft, a plurality of circumferentially arranged matching grooves are formed in the side wall of the mounting shaft, a movable ring is slidably connected to the side wall of the cutting pipe, a jointing cover is fixedly connected to one side of the movable ring, a supporting mechanism for supporting the movable ring is arranged on the side wall of the cutting pipe, a limiting mechanism for limiting the jointing cover is arranged on one side, far away from the mounting shaft, of the jointing cover, a collecting box is fixedly connected to one side of the jointing cover, and a collecting opening is formed in one side of the collecting box. The dust collecting device is provided with the collecting box, the collecting opening, the water supply bag and other structures, dust and scraps generated in the cutting process can be collected through the collecting opening and the collecting box, and meanwhile, the dust can be wetted by conveying water through the conveying pipe, so that the influence on the health of workers caused by the fact that the dust is dispersed in the air is avoided.

title_en: Fiber grating demodulator shell
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fiber grating demodulator shell, which is used for installing an optical path system and a circuit module of a fiber grating demodulator, the shell comprises a first mounting plate, a front panel and a top shell which are fixedly mounted with the first mounting plate, the first mounting plate, the front panel and the top shell form a cavity for accommodating an optical path system and a circuit module, the circuit module is arranged on the surface of the first mounting plate, and the optical path system is fixedly mounted with the first mounting plate. According to the fiber bragg grating demodulator shell, integrated installation in a 3U chassis of a train is realized, and the problem of miniaturization of the 3U is solved. The optical fiber connector, the communication interface and the multifunctional structure which need to be connected and plugged are respectively exposed aiming at the 3U chassis structure, so that the rapid connection and disconnection are convenient, and the rapid connection of equipment is realized.

title_en: Clamp for thermocouple calibration
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of metering detection, and discloses a clamp for thermocouple calibration. According to the application, the standard thermocouple can be clamped and fixed through the two main clamping plates, the first auxiliary clamping plate and the second auxiliary clamping plate are matched to clamp and fix the calibration thermocouple, the standard thermocouple and the calibration thermocouple are fixed at intervals, the abnormal calibration data caused by short circuit is avoided, and the calibration precision is improved.

title_en: Quick positioner of laser demarcation device stock hole
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of laser demarcation devices, in particular to a rapid positioning device for an anchor rod hole of a laser demarcation device, which can rapidly position the anchor hole without repeated measurement, thereby improving the construction efficiency; including the location pole setting, install two fixed arms through adjusting part on the lower part outer wall of location pole setting, install first laser unwrapping wire appearance on the lower part fixed arm, install second laser unwrapping wire appearance on the upper portion fixed arm, arrange the setting about first laser unwrapping wire appearance and the second laser unwrapping wire appearance, second support arm fixed connection is on the middle part outer wall of location pole setting, installs horizontal laser emitter on the second support arm, and the second horizontal laser emitter is installed through apart from adjusting part on the upper portion of location pole setting, and second horizontal laser emitter arranges the setting from top to bottom with horizontal laser emitter, the bottom of location pole setting is installed on fixed part.

title_en: Angle-adjustable plugging jig for air tightness detection
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an angle-adjustable plugging jig for air tightness detection, which comprises a bearing seat, a rotating base and an adjusting guide rail, wherein one end of the rotating base is rotationally connected with the bearing seat, the other end of the rotating base is in sliding connection with the adjusting guide rail, a positioning groove and an air filling hole are formed in the middle of the rotating base, an air bag is arranged in the positioning groove, a folding edge is arranged at the lower end of the air bag, compression cylinders are arranged on two sides of the rotating base, a piston rod of each compression cylinder penetrates through the rotating base and is fixedly connected with a pressing plate, an abdication groove is formed in the middle of each pressing plate, the air bag is positioned in the abdication groove, and the folding edge is positioned between the pressing plate and the rotating base. The utility model has the beneficial effects that the air bag can be quickly disassembled and assembled according to the detection requirement, can adapt to the plugging of the hole grooves of workpieces with different angles, has wide application range and is simple and convenient to operate.

title_en: Rotary slicing machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a rotary slicing machine, which comprises a slicing machine body, wherein a hand wheel is rotatably arranged on the right side surface of the slicing machine body, a sample clamping seat is arranged on the front side surface of the slicing machine body, a mounting seat is arranged at the bottom of the front side surface of the slicing machine body, a slicing and expanding mechanism is arranged on the mounting seat, the slicing and expanding mechanism comprises a cutter frame seat and a preheating water tank arranged at the front side of the cutter frame seat, a blade is arranged at the rear side of the top of the cutter frame seat, a conveying water channel is arranged at the front side of the cutter frame seat, the front side of the conveying water channel is communicated with the preheating water tank, and the conveying water channel is used for conveying sample slices cut by the blade into the preheating water tank.

title_en: Grinding device for bean product food safety detection
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of food detection and discloses a grinding device for bean product food safety detection, which comprises a first box body, wherein the upper surface of the first box body is connected with a top cover in a sliding manner, the inside of the top cover is fixedly connected with a conveying pipe, the top end of the conveying pipe is fixedly connected with a second box body, the upper surface of the top cover is fixedly connected with a supporting plate, the outer wall of the supporting plate is fixedly connected with a first motor, the output end of the first motor is fixedly connected with an eccentric circle, the inside of the second box body is connected with a filter screen in a sliding manner, and the upper surface of the top cover is provided with a rebound assembly. In the utility model, the bean products to be ground are placed in the second box body, the bean products are screened by the filter screen, and when the eccentric circle is driven by the first motor to rotate, the eccentric circle can push the second box body to slide up and down, so that the filter screen in the second box body filters the bean products to achieve the effect of screening more quickly.

title_en: Cement weighing and calibrating device for mine filling
abstract_en: The utility model provides a cement weighing and calibrating device for mine filling, which is characterized by comprising a powder metering scale for weighing and feeding cement, wherein a discharging hole of the powder metering scale is connected with a discharging pipe, the bottom end of the discharging pipe is connected with a discharging hose, an ash containing bag is arranged below the discharging hose, the top end of the ash containing bag is provided with a feeding hole, the bottom end of the discharging hose is movably connected with the feeding hole at the top end of the ash containing bag, the bottom end of the ash containing bag is provided with a discharging hole, a binding belt is arranged at the discharging hole, and an electronic scale for calibration is arranged below the ash containing bag. The device can effectively count the weighing errors of the powder weighing scale and the electronic scale, so that the powder weighing scale can be rapidly weighed and calibrated; the utility model greatly reduces the labor intensity of calibrating the powder metering scale, eliminates the potential safety hazard of personnel entering the stirring barrel operation, ensures the quality of filling slurry, and has simple structure and convenient installation and maintenance.

title_en: Intelligent agricultural greenhouse air temperature and humidity sensor
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent agricultural greenhouse air temperature and humidity sensor which comprises a plurality of groups of temperature and humidity sensor bodies and a supporting structure, wherein the temperature and humidity sensor bodies and the supporting structure are sequentially arranged from bottom to top, the supporting structure comprises a plurality of groups of supporting columns which are sequentially arranged from bottom to top, the supporting columns which are sequentially arranged from bottom to top correspond to the temperature and humidity sensor bodies which are sequentially arranged from bottom to top, any one group of the supporting columns which are sequentially arranged from bottom to top is movably connected with the corresponding temperature and humidity sensor body through a mounting structure, and the intelligent agricultural greenhouse air temperature and humidity sensor can be integrally monitored in real time for air with different heights in a greenhouse.

title_en: Air tightness test equipment for complete machine fuel system of airplane
abstract_en: The utility model provides air tightness test equipment for a complete machine fuel system of an aircraft, which relates to the technical field of aircraft manufacturing equipment and comprises a cabinet, an air pipeline and a nitrogen pipeline, wherein the air pipeline comprises an air main pipeline, a low-pressure air branch pipeline and a micro-pressure air branch pipeline, the air main pipeline comprises an air inlet connector, an air inlet valve, a water drop separator, a first air pressure gauge and a first electric control pressure reducing valve which are sequentially connected, the first electric control pressure reducing valve is respectively connected with the low-pressure air branch pipeline and the micro-pressure air branch pipeline, and the nitrogen pipeline comprises a nitrogen inlet connector, a nitrogen inlet valve, a nitrogen filter, a fourth air pressure gauge, a third electric control pressure reducing valve, a third electromagnetic valve, a third flowmeter and a nitrogen outlet connector which are sequentially connected. The utility model has the beneficial effects that the air tightness test device can work under three pressure conditions, is used for solving the problems of air tightness test process control and result detection of complex fuel systems of aircrafts such as airplanes and the like, and can rapidly and accurately perform air tightness test of the fuel systems.

title_en: Brake disc circumference runout detection device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a circumference runout detection device of a brake disc, which relates to the technical field of detection devices and comprises a machine body, wherein an electric push rod is arranged in the machine body, one end of the electric push rod is provided with a machine head, the bottom end of a gear is rotationally connected with the inner wall of a rectangular groove, two T-shaped grooves are formed in the bottom end of the inner wall of the rectangular groove, the top end of each T-shaped block is fixedly connected with a toothed bar, one end of each toothed bar is fixedly connected with a connecting rod, and one end of each connecting rod is fixedly connected with a sector block.

title_en: Sewage discharge detector
abstract_en: The utility model is suitable for the technical field of sewage detection, and provides a sewage discharge detector which comprises a clamping fixture capable of being connected with a sewage water outlet, a detection shell arranged at the top of the clamping fixture, a detection assembly arranged in the detection shell, an unreeling water storage assembly and a pushing assembly, wherein a circular through hole is arranged in the clamping fixture in a penetrating manner, an installation seat is horizontally arranged at the top of the clamping fixture, the top of the installation seat is connected with the detection shell, the detection shell is of a hollow rectangular structure, and a pushing groove is formed in the side wall of the detection shell. The device has solved sewage and has had the problem unable in time to remain sewage sample, carries out retaining after the detection is accomplished again, produces great error easily, leads to remaining sample and the inconsistent problem of testing result, has reached and to sample the storage when the detector detects, guarantees to store the sample and the interior sewage cost of detector unanimously, does not have the effect of error with the detector testing result.

title_en: Quick type sample suction sampler
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of sampling detection devices and discloses a quick sample suction sampler which comprises a box body, wherein a main fixing block is fixedly arranged on the outer wall of the box body, a filter element fixing block is connected to the inner wall of the main fixing block in a sliding manner, one end of a hose is fixedly arranged on the inner wall of the main fixing block, and a suction head is fixedly arranged at the other end of the hose. Through pressing two briquetting for two briquetting drive the inside removal of L board to the filter core fixed block, two L boards break away from with main fixed block when two L boards remove the both sides of gag lever post outer wall extension piece, upwards pull the filter core fixed block this moment, take out the filter core fixed block from the inside of main fixed block, and then the di euro filter core main part is changed, press the briquetting after the filter core main part is changed, place the filter core fixed block in main fixed block and press its bottom to the bottom of main fixed block, loosen the briquetting this moment, spring two resilience resets the L board, accomplish the change to the filter core main part.

title_en: Anti-shaking magnetic turning plate liquid level meter
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-shaking magnetic flap liquid level meter, wherein a magnetic flap display meter is arranged on the outer wall of a tube body, a connecting flange is welded at the bottom end of the tube body, a guide casing is of a hollow cylinder structure with openings at two ends, a guide casing fixing folding strip is arranged at the top of the guide casing, a guide casing bottom opening is arranged on the outer wall of the lower part of the guide casing, a plurality of guide casing side holes are arranged on the outer wall of one side of the guide casing, a bottom plate is welded at the bottom end opening of the guide casing, the lower part of the guide casing passes through a matched same-diameter container flange, the guide casing fixing folding strip is positioned between the connecting flange and the matched same-diameter container flange, a magnetic float is positioned in the tube body, a connecting rod is connected to the bottom of the magnetic float, and extends into the guide casing, and a floating ball is connected to the bottom of the connecting rod. The utility model solves the problem of shaking generated by the floating ball under the action of the stirrer in the container, stabilizes the vertical angle of the floating ball and avoids the fluctuation of the detection of the floating ball caused by the fluctuation of the liquid level.

title_en: Monitoring device for power supply safety management
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of power supplies and discloses a monitoring device for power supply safety management. According to the application, the mounting groove provides a butt joint position for mounting the detector main body, the detector connector can enable a circuit between the device and the detector main body to be connected with a data line, a fixed ring, a threaded groove and a screw rod are used for combining to form a limit component of the detector main body, the screw rod is screwed to penetrate through the fixed ring and the threaded groove to fixedly mount the detector main body in the mounting groove, the screw rod is dismounted from the fixed ring and the threaded groove to lift the fixed ring to take out the detector main body from the equipment box, so that the detector component can be quickly replaced, a shell is not required to be dismounted to accelerate maintenance, the component for quickly replacing the detector is mounted by the device, the shell is not required to be dismounted when the detector is damaged, the detector can be conveniently replaced after the limit component is released, and the normal function of the device can be quickly restored.

title_en: Weighing and screening integrated pulverized coal screen with positive and negative pressures available
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a weighing and screening integrated pulverized coal screen with available positive and negative pressure, relates to the technical field of pulverized coal screens, and aims to solve the problems that a pulverized coal screen is easy to block and screening efficiency is low. The coal dust collecting box comprises a base and a box shell, wherein the base is connected with the box shell through spring supporting legs, an excitation source for driving the box shell to vibrate is arranged on the outer wall of the box shell, the box shell is a shell with two through ends, a box cover is arranged at the top of the box shell, a feed inlet and a pipeline which are communicated with the interior of the box shell are arranged on the box cover, the pipeline is connected with external positive and negative pressure equipment, a screen frame is arranged in the box shell, a plurality of groups of screen frames are arranged on the screen frame, a box cover and a discharge hopper are respectively arranged above and below the box shell, and the positive and negative pressure equipment and the interior of the box shell are communicated through the pipeline, so that positive pressure and negative pressure inside the box shell are controlled by the positive and negative pressure equipment, positive pressure pushes coal dust to pass through the screen mesh, the screen mesh is prevented from being blocked, and negative pressure can collect coal dust floating inside the box shell, and pollution to working environment is avoided.

title_en: Portable hand-held dust detector
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a portable hand-held dust detector, which relates to the technical field of dust detection and comprises a support disc, supporting legs and a hand-held dust detector body, wherein three supporting legs are arranged around the support disc, one ends of the three supporting legs are hinged with the side surface of the support disc, the portable hand-held dust detector is provided with a bracket consisting of the three supporting legs and the support disc and a telescopic rod cylinder consisting of a first rod cylinder, a second rod cylinder and a third rod cylinder, the bracket can conveniently support the hand-held dust detector body, the utility model is convenient for continuous dust detection in fixed areas, can lift the handheld dust detector body through the telescopic rod tube, is convenient for detecting the dust concentration in higher areas, can be suitable for various different occasions, the application scope is wide, and the handheld dust detector body is installed on the dust detector mounting seat through the hand-operated supporting component, and the handheld dust detector body can be independently disassembled to be handheld, so that the handheld dust detector is convenient to independently carry.

title_en: Integrated valve control water meter
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an integrated valve-controlled water meter which comprises a valve-controlled water meter body, wherein one side of the valve-controlled water meter body is fixedly communicated with a water inlet pipe, the outer surface of the water inlet pipe is fixedly communicated with an installation pipe, a filter pipe is arranged in the installation pipe, and the middle part of the lower end of the filter pipe is fixedly communicated with a slag discharge pipe. According to the utility model, after water enters the water inlet pipe, the large impurity filter pipe in the water is blocked when the water passes through the filter pipe, the blocked large impurity falls into the bottom of the filter pipe under the action of gravity in the subsequent accumulation process to be collected, after a certain amount of impurity is collected in the filter pipe, a worker opens the second sealing cover, water flows out along the slag discharge pipe and directly brings the impurity in the filter pipe out, so that the water passing through the valve-controlled water meter body is rapidly filtered and cleaned, the blocking probability of the valve-controlled water meter body is reduced, and the valve-controlled water meter is simple in structure and convenient to operate.

title_en: Colliery power supply line fault location device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fault positioning device for a coal mine power supply line, and relates to the technical field of circuit fault diagnosis. The device is based on electromagnetic induction theory and thermoelectric effect, installs voltage current sensor and temperature sensor on colliery power supply line, and the data that will measure is uploaded to singlechip and judge trouble type and position according to whether data is unusual to solve colliery line fault's problem that is difficult to diagnose. When a certain point of the line breaks down, the voltage, current and temperature parameters are changed, the single chip microcomputer can judge the fault type according to the parameter values, the single chip microcomputer can calculate the fault position according to the address codes of the sensors, the fault position can be directly found according to the sensor numbers and the fault type can be judged through arranging a plurality of groups of devices, the detection result is more accurate and reliable due to the addition of the temperature sensors, and the problem that the faults of the coal mine power supply line are difficult to detect is solved.

title_en: Simple device for checking defects of capsules on capsule counting plate
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a simple device for checking capsule flaws on a capsule counting plate, which comprises a plane magnifying glass lens with proper multiple and a bottom plate with the same size as the plane magnifying glass. Four screws penetrate through the material and are fixed by the combination of nuts and gaskets. Then the clamp with clamping function is used to clamp the plane magnifier, and the other end passes through the screw to fix the clamp by using a nut and gasket mode. The device of the present utility model allows the "volume of the capsule to be seen to be increased" so that defects (if any) are better perceived. But also rotates more consistently, more completely, and more rapidly. The possibility that the defects of the capsule are more easily detected is improved. Thereby improving the product quality and improving the working efficiency to a certain extent on the other hand.

title_en: Simple device for watch case detection
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a simple device for detecting a watchcase, which relates to the technical field of watchcase detection and aims to solve the technical problems that the prior watchcase has larger detection volume, is inconvenient for small-scale production and can influence detection accuracy due to manual swing, and the simple device comprises a workbench, wherein clamping equipment is horizontally arranged on the workbench, impact equipment is vertically arranged on the side surface of the workbench, the clamping equipment comprises two clamping mechanisms which are in sliding connection with the workbench, and arc grooves are formed in one sides of the two adjacent clamping mechanisms; the utility model solves the problems that the prior watchcase has larger detection volume and is inconvenient for small-scale production, and the manual swing hammer can influence the detection accuracy, and a section of screw of a spring arranged in a jogging groove is screwed out after the elasticity of the spring in a cylinder is weakened, so that the rebound force of the impact hammer is improved.

title_en: Double-spectrum thermal imaging miniature cradle head device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of micro cradle head devices and discloses a double-spectrum thermal imaging micro cradle head device, which comprises an equipment base, a cradle head arranged on the top side of the equipment base, a camera module arranged on the cradle head and an equipment shell arranged on the outer side of the cradle head, wherein a supporting seat is fixedly arranged in the middle of the top side of the equipment base through a bracket, an upper mounting bracket and a lower mounting bracket are respectively and fixedly arranged in the middle of the bottom wall surface of the supporting seat and the middle of the top wall surface of the equipment base, an adjusting mechanism for adjusting the inclination angle of the cradle head is arranged on the upper mounting bracket and the lower mounting bracket, and the adjusting mechanism comprises an upper winding roller, a lower winding roller, two first adjusting ropes and two second adjusting ropes, wherein the upper winding roller and the lower winding roller are respectively rotatably arranged in the upper mounting bracket and the lower mounting bracket. According to the utility model, by arranging the adjusting mechanism, the convenience of the device for adjusting the inclination angle of the camera module is realized, and the practicability of the device is improved.

title_en: Connector detection device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a connector detection device which comprises an operation table, wherein a connector is placed on the upper end face of the operation table, a first fixing frame is arranged on the upper end face of the operation table, a rotating rod is inserted into the upper end of the first fixing frame, an amplifying lens is arranged on the outer wall of the rotating rod, and a supporting plate is arranged below the amplifying lens on the first fixing frame. The amplifying lens of the connector detection device forms a rotating structure through the rotating rod and the first fixing frame, so that connector pins sprayed with magnetic powder can be observed conveniently through the amplifying lens, an electric push rod of the connector detection device forms a limiting sliding structure through the screw rod, the first sliding rod, the first movable block and the operating platform under the action of the first servo motor, the second fixing frame forms a vertical lifting structure through the telescopic arm and the operating platform under the action of the electric push rod, the connector is driven to carry out limiting sliding under the action of the first servo motor, and the connector is moved to other equipment to be convenient for carrying out various detection.

title_en: Temperature control testing device and sorting machine
abstract_en: The application relates to a temperature control testing device and a sorting machine. The temperature control testing device comprises a testing chamber, a refrigerating chamber and a heat exchange loop connected between the testing chamber and the refrigerating chamber, wherein the testing chamber is provided with a testing area, the heat exchange loop is provided with a heat exchange part, the heat exchange part is arranged in the refrigerating chamber, a cold source is arranged in the refrigerating chamber and is used for injecting refrigerant into the refrigerating chamber, and the temperature of the testing area is reduced by means of heat exchange between the heat exchange loop and the testing area, a regeneration module for collecting the refrigerant is further connected between the refrigerating chamber and the testing chamber, the regeneration module comprises a regeneration pipe and a storage unit, two ends of the regeneration pipe are respectively communicated with the refrigerating chamber and the storage unit, and the storage unit is used for collecting the refrigerant in the refrigerating chamber. The temperature control testing device has high local temperature control efficiency and small refrigerant consumption, and can timely recycle and regenerate the refrigerant.

title_en: Multi-drive pressure monitoring module
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multi-drive pressure monitoring module which comprises a main valve body, wherein a main flow channel extending along the length direction of the main valve body is arranged in the main valve body, an inflating nozzle is arranged at the side part of the main valve body and communicated with the main flow channel, valve dividing bodies are sequentially arranged along the arrangement direction of the main flow channel and connected with the side part of the main valve body, pressure release valves are connected with the valve dividing bodies and communicated with the main flow channel, two connecting valves are arranged and respectively connected with the corresponding valve dividing bodies, and the connecting valves are communicated with the main flow channel. The external air source can be connected into the monitoring module through the charging connector, multiple groups of charged devices can be operated at the same time, pressure balance of each path is guaranteed, and the sealing accessory in the pressure release valve is not easy to damage, has a stable sealing effect and is durable.

title_en: Airtight test equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses airtight test equipment, which comprises an equipment profile frame, wherein one side of the inner wall of the equipment profile frame is connected with an air source treatment and valve rod airtight test part, one side of the valve rod airtight test part is connected with a plunger pump detection station and a normally open valve detection station, one side of the equipment profile frame is connected with a secondary control console, one side of the secondary control console is connected with a right start button and a left start button, the top end of the equipment profile frame is connected with a three-color tower lamp, one side of the equipment profile frame is connected with a main control panel, the valve rod airtight test part comprises a first mounting seat, the top end of the first mounting seat is connected with a transplanting rodless cylinder, and one end of the transplanting rodless cylinder is connected with a lifting cylinder. The valve rod air tightness test device is stable in structure, simple to operate, high in judgment accuracy and good in consistency, reduces the labor intensity of operators, ensures the personal safety of the operators, and can automatically perform valve rod air tightness test.

title_en: Organoid embedding mould
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of organoids, and discloses an organoid embedding mould which comprises two closed shells, wherein a mould shell is arranged in each closed shell, an observation cover is arranged on the top side of each closed shell, and an exhaust pipe is fixedly communicated with the top side of each observation cover. According to the utility model, the sealed shell and the inner die shell are driven to rotate through the rotation of the rotary table, so that the liquid paraffin is driven to rotate, and the rotatable observation cover is matched, so that the exhaust pipe can keep a static state when the rotary table rotates, air in the sealed shell is pumped out, so that gas in the paraffin is accelerated to escape, and bubbles are avoided.

title_en: Machine vision check out test set
abstract_en: The utility model discloses machine vision detection equipment which comprises a machine body and two CCD vision cameras arranged on the machine body, wherein a rotary table is arranged on a workbench of the machine body, a pneumatic rotating assembly is jointly arranged between the rotary table and the machine body, two chambers are symmetrically arranged in the rotary table, and one side of the inner top of each chamber is fixedly connected with a rubber block with holes penetrating to the top. According to the utility model, through the pneumatic lifting assembly, the rotary table, the double-shaft air cylinder, the second rotary air cylinder, the clamping block and the fixed rod, the product can be clamped and rotated, the CCD vision camera can comprehensively detect the surface of the product without secondary operation, the detection time is shortened, the detection efficiency is improved, and the pneumatic rotary assembly, the chamber, the belt Kong Jiaodian and the pneumatic piston are arranged, so that the detected product is replaced while the product to be detected is detected, and the time for feeding, discharging and detecting can be shortened.

title_en: Ultra-thin split type inductance encoder
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an ultrathin split type inductance encoder which comprises a rotor and a stator, wherein the rotor and the stator are annular, the rotor and the stator are coaxially arranged, the rotor comprises an upper shell and a reflecting plate, the reflecting plate is arranged in the upper shell and is used for being connected with a rotating shaft of a measured object, the reflecting plate is used for reflecting electric field signals, the stator comprises a lower shell, a signal plate and a receiving plate, the receiving plate is arranged in the lower shell, the signal plate is arranged on the inner side surface of the receiving plate, the lower shell is used for being connected with a fixed shaft of the measured object, the receiving plate is used for receiving electric field signals, and the signal plate is used for transmitting the electric field signals and analyzing and processing the received electric field signals. The fixed shaft of the measured object is directly connected with the stator, the rotating shaft of the measured object passes through the middle of the stator to be connected with the rotor, and the stator and the rotor are arranged in a separated mode, so that the axial size of the encoder can be effectively reduced, and the application of special occasions is met.

title_en: Pressure testing device for simulating use condition of bottom valve
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pressure testing device for simulating a using working condition of a bottom valve, which is characterized by comprising a pressure loading assembly, a bottom valve to be tested and a bottom valve testing tool, wherein the core of the pressure loading assembly is a multistage pump with a frequency converter, the main body of the testing tool is a pressure container, the bottom valve to be tested is detachably connected in the whole testing device by selecting variable-diameter flanges with different sizes according to different nominal diameters, the testing device simulates the actual working condition of the bottom valve, and is suitable for the expansion type discharging valves with different diameters, particularly the valve body with an included angle of 45 degrees or 135 degrees, and meanwhile, all components of the testing device can be recycled for daily production and life, so that the testing device is green and economical.

title_en: Quenching device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of quenching, and particularly relates to a quenching device which comprises a base, wherein two electric telescopic rods which are distributed front and back are fixedly arranged at the top of the base, the output ends of the two electric telescopic rods are fixedly connected with side brackets, a sliding rail is fixedly arranged between the two side brackets, a sampler is movably arranged on the sliding rail, and a reagent bottle and a cooling tank are arranged at the top of the base. According to the utility model, when the sampler is positioned at the left end of the slide rail, the electric telescopic rod works and drives the slide rail to move downwards, so that the sampler stretches into the reagent bottle to sample, the servo motor works and can drive the reciprocating screw rod to rotate, then the reciprocating block drives the sampler to move, so that the sampler can move to the upper part of the quenching mixing bottle, the bottle cap is opened, the electric telescopic rod can drive the sampler to move downwards, so that the reagent in the sampler is introduced into the quenching mixing bottle, the operation is simple and effective, the sampler is kept to move linearly, the rotating moving mode is avoided, and the sampler is easy to place.

title_en: Novel solvent storage tank tail gas treatment device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel solvent storage tank tail gas treatment device which comprises a support, wherein a water washing tower and a water pump are fixedly arranged on the support, a water inlet pipe and a bent pipe are fixedly arranged on the water pump, and the water inlet pipe is fixedly communicated with the bottom of the water washing tower. According to the utility model, the water pump, the water inlet pipe, the bent pipe, the water receiving plate and the second water drain pipe are arranged, the water pump is started, the water inlet pipe can be used for pumping a water source at the bottom of the inner cavity of the water washing tower, the water source is conveyed to the spray head through the bent pipe to spray out the tail gas in a first-stage circulating mode, when the organic matter content in the water at the bottom of the inner cavity of the water washing tower reaches a certain concentration, the water source can be discharged from the first water drain pipe to be recovered, the water source is introduced into the water washing tower from the transverse pipe, the water source can be contacted with the rising tail gas to realize second-stage spraying, and finally the water source flows into the water receiving plate and can be discharged from the second water drain pipe.

title_en: Large-scale test bench device for bridge expansion joint
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of bridge expansion joint tests, in particular to a large-scale test pedestal device for a bridge expansion joint. This large-scale test pedestal device of bridge expansion joint, when using, at first place bridge expansion joint device in the inside of test groove, carry out the afterbody fixed to the device through third hydraulic cylinder control fixed plate, rethread first hydraulic cylinder, the second hydraulic cylinder carries out the work and carries out extrusion test to its structural strength, in the in-process of test, spout liquid nitrogen through the shower nozzle and cool down to test environment, the structural strength of device under the simulation low temperature heats test environment through heating panel, the structural strength of device under the simulation high temperature environment, above design makes the test of device more comprehensive, the accuracy of test has been fully improved.

title_en: Measuring device
abstract_en: The application discloses measuring equipment which comprises an air extraction part, a main body part and optical detection equipment, wherein the main body part is provided with a first interface and a second interface, the first interface is used for being connected with an air extraction opening of an atomization device, the second interface is connected with the air extraction part, the main body part is also provided with a first main runner, a second main runner and more than two branch runners, two ends of each branch runner are respectively communicated with the first main runner and the second main runner, the first interface is communicated with the first main runner, the second interface is communicated with the second main runner, at least one branch runner is provided with the optical detection equipment, and the optical detection equipment is used for measuring particle size and distribution information of particles of aerosol flowing through the branch runners. The measuring device can improve the accuracy of aerosol measurement of the atomizing device and enables the measurement to have reproducibility.

title_en: Multiple temperature detection assembly and food thermometer
abstract_en: The application provides a multiple temperature detection assembly and a food thermometer, wherein the multiple temperature detection assembly comprises a thermometer shell, a circuit board, a first temperature sensitive electronic device and a second temperature sensitive electronic device, wherein the first temperature sensitive electronic device is used for being inserted into food to be tested, the second temperature sensitive electronic device is used for being exposed to the external environment, the first temperature sensitive electronic device is positioned between a first temperature detection part and the first temperature sensitive electronic device, the first temperature sensitive electronic device receives heat conducted by the first temperature detection part and is electrically connected with the first temperature detection part, the second temperature sensitive electronic device is positioned between the second temperature detection part and the second temperature sensitive electronic device, the second temperature sensitive electronic device receives heat conducted by the second temperature sensitive electronic device and is electrically connected with the second temperature detection part, so that the heat of the food to be tested and the heat of the external environment can be conveniently detected, the food heat detection function is avoided, and the functions of food heat detection and environment heat detection are integrated.

title_en: Transformer quality detection device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a transformer quality detection device, which relates to the technical field of transformer detection and comprises a bracket, an arc-shaped frame, two mounting plates, a placement table and a camera, wherein the placement table is rotationally connected between the two mounting plates, a transparent window is fixedly arranged in the middle of the placement table, a toothed ring is fixedly sleeved on the outer wall of the placement table close to the lower end, a driving motor is fixedly arranged at the upper end of one mounting plate, and the automatic comprehensive detection effect of the appearance of a transformer is realized by arranging the arc-shaped frame, the placement table, a limiting ring, the transparent window, the toothed ring, the driving motor, a driving gear, a tooth socket, a sliding frame, a mounting shaft, a walking gear and a regulating motor structure, so that the problem that the appearance quality of the existing transformer is in a relatively static state during detection, and the position of the transformer needs to be regulated back and forth in order to ensure the comprehensiveness of a shot image is solved, and the detection speed is reduced.

title_en: Wireless temperature measuring device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of energy storage system temperature measuring devices, in particular to a wireless temperature measuring device. The wireless temperature measuring device comprises a temperature measuring module, a plurality of temperature measuring sensors and a plurality of temperature collecting line units which can be mutually and electrically connected for extension, wherein the number of the temperature collecting line units is larger than that of the temperature measuring sensors, the temperature measuring sensors are electrically connected with the temperature measuring module through the temperature collecting line units to form a plurality of temperature measuring channels, the temperature measuring module comprises a data collecting module and a wireless module, the data collecting module is used for receiving temperature data of the temperature measuring channels, and the wireless module is used for sending the temperature data to a designated position. The wireless temperature measuring device of the embodiment can support temperature acquisition of a plurality of temperature measuring points, can be provided with different numbers of temperature acquisition line units according to specific distances, and meanwhile, due to the fact that the wireless module is used for data transmission, the phenomena that the temperature acquisition lines are overlong and intertwined are not easy to occur.

title_en: Survey and drawing is with fixed sighting rod of being convenient for
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of surveying and mapping, and discloses a mark post convenient to fix, which comprises a supporting table and a measuring mark post, wherein four corners of the supporting table are connected with adjusting supporting rods in a threaded manner, the measuring mark post is arranged on the top end surface of the supporting table, the supporting table comprises a supporting table body, a locking connecting sleeve and a limiting assembly, and the four corners of the locking connecting sleeve, which are fixedly connected with the supporting table body, are arranged at the middle positions of the locking connecting sleeve. This survey and drawing is with fixed target of being convenient for, through being provided with spacing picture peg, metal insert platform, connecting block and measurement target, promote spacing picture peg grafting and advance the junction of metal insert platform and connecting block to can be with the position determination of measurement target, conveniently dismantle the change with measurement target, can protect the safety of measurement target, rotate the nut, the nut is rotatory at the threaded rod surface of supporting bench body, coil spring begins to kick-back, coil spring can promote spacing picture peg and slide, lets the dismantlement of spacing picture peg quick and convenient.

title_en: Door lock service life testing device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of door lock service life testing, in particular to a door lock service life testing device which comprises a base, a positioning seat, a pressing top block, a pressing power mechanism, a controller and a counter module, wherein the positioning seat is arranged on the base and used for positioning and placing a door lock to be tested, the pressing top block is connected above the positioning seat in a sliding manner along the vertical direction, the pressing power mechanism is used for driving the pressing top block to slide, and the output end of the pressing power mechanism is in driving connection with the pressing top block.

title_en: Casting concrete gradient measurement structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of gradient measurement, in particular to a pouring concrete gradient measurement structure which comprises a detection trolley and is characterized in that a trolley amplitude rod is arranged on the detection trolley, the trolley amplitude rod is parallel to the amplitude of the detection trolley, a support frame is slidably arranged on the detection trolley, a gradient inclined balancing weight is rotatably arranged on the support frame, a backing plate is arranged on the gradient inclined balancing weight, drawing paper is arranged on the backing plate, and a drawing pen is arranged on the backing plate.

title_en: Adjusting mechanism and sensing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an adjusting mechanism and an induction device, which belong to the technical field of knife switch monitoring in an electric power system, wherein the adjusting mechanism comprises a supporting seat, a first adjusting component, a second adjusting component and a third adjusting component, the first end of the first adjusting component is in running fit with the supporting seat in a first direction, the first end of the second adjusting component is in sliding fit with the second end of the first adjusting component in a second direction, the third adjusting component is in sliding fit with the second end of the second adjusting component in a third direction, the first direction is clockwise or anticlockwise, the second direction and the third direction are straight directions, and the second direction and the third direction are intersected. When the position between the reed sensor and the magnetic steel needs to be adjusted, any one or more of the first adjusting component, the second adjusting component and the third adjusting component can be selectively adopted for adjustment, the adjusting mode of the adjusting mechanism is simpler, and the convenience of operation is improved.

title_en: Limit structure, weighing device and weighing part
abstract_en: The utility model provides a install limit structure on weighing module, this limit structure is used for restricting the removal of roof along first direction, including setting up the first spacing subassembly between material jar and weighing module, first spacing subassembly includes limiting plate, lower limiting plate and the subassembly that slides, go up limiting plate and material jar fixed connection, but lower limiting plate and last limiting plate relative movement ground are connected to with roof relative fixed connection, the subassembly that slides sets up between last limiting plate and lower limiting plate, in order to permit last limiting plate and lower limiting plate along first direction relative movement, in order to guarantee weighing accuracy. The weighing component and the weighing device with the limiting structure are further provided.

title_en: Rim scanning transverse wave adjustment-free probe support
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rim scanning transverse wave adjustment-free probe support, which belongs to the technical field of railway wheel rim detection devices and comprises a middle transition block, a transition block shaft, a shaft seat and a shaft seat fixing beam, wherein the transition block shaft is fixedly connected to the side wall of the middle transition block, middle transition block center holes are formed in the middle of the middle transition block and the middle of the transition block shaft, shaft seat holes are formed in the middle of the shaft seat, the transition block shaft is inserted into the shaft seat holes, a shaft seat hole locking screw and a shaft seat fixing screw are connected to the shaft seat, a screw hole is formed in the shaft seat fixing beam, and the shaft seat is connected with the shaft seat fixing beam through the shaft seat fixing screw. The utility model can accurately and stably install and replace the probe, and only needs to finely adjust the probe when the probe is initially installed, and the posture of the probe can be kept in the previous state when the probe is replaced, so that the process of fine adjustment again is avoided.

title_en: Socket tester working circuit and socket tester
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a socket tester working circuit and a socket tester. The working circuit of the socket tester comprises a microprocessor module, a wiring state detection module, an insulation state detection module and a display module, wherein the wiring state detection module is connected with a live wire, a zero wire and a ground wire, the insulation state detection module comprises a first insulation state detection sub-module, a second insulation state detection sub-module and a third insulation state detection sub-module, the first insulation state detection sub-module is connected with the live wire and the zero wire, the second insulation state detection sub-module is connected with the live wire and the ground wire, the third insulation state detection sub-module is connected with the zero wire and the ground wire, the microprocessor module is used for determining the wiring states of the live wire, the zero wire and the ground wire of a tested socket and the insulation states between any two wires of the live wire, the zero wire and the ground wire of the tested socket, and sending detection results to the display module for display. The working circuit of the socket tester can meet the testing requirements of users in various ways, and improves the testing efficiency of the users.

title_en: In-mold pneumatic punching leakage on-line detection structure
abstract_en: The utility model provides an in-mold pneumatic punching leakage on-line detection structure which comprises an air inlet hole formed in the middle of an air vent base plate, a product placing cavity formed in the middle of the bottom of a housing, a mounting groove formed in the middle of the top of the product placing cavity, a nitrogen spring clamped in the mounting groove, air vents corresponding to air vents on the product placed in the housing, air vents formed in the side, close to the placing cavity, of the air vents at equal intervals, of the air vents, and a plurality of groups of detection components connected through bolts and evenly spaced around the outer side wall of the housing.

title_en: Subway signal AP antenna looking-up device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of rail transit inspection tools, in particular to a subway signal AP antenna inspection device. The subway signal AP antenna viewing device specifically comprises a camera shooting assembly, a lap joint assembly and a telescopic rod, wherein the camera shooting assembly comprises an outer frame support and a camera, the outer frame support is sleeved with the camera, the lap joint assembly comprises a hanging rod platform and a magnetic attraction piece, the hanging rod platform is connected with the magnetic attraction piece, the hanging rod platform is hung on the antenna support, the magnetic attraction piece is in magnetic attraction fit with the antenna support, and the telescopic rod penetrates through the hanging rod platform and is connected with the outer frame support. The utility model has the advantages of high maintenance efficiency and safe operation.

title_en: Steel cable tension testing device for engineering detection
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of steel cable tension test and discloses a steel cable tension test device for engineering detection, which comprises an engineering box, wherein a bottom plate is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the bottom of the engineering box, a support column is fixedly connected to the top end of the bottom plate, a placing circular plate is slidably connected to the outer part of the support column, a hydraulic cylinder is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the bottom of the placing circular plate, a driving end of the hydraulic cylinder is fixedly connected with a driving block, a plurality of support plates are fixedly connected to the outer wall of the driving block, a driving plate is rotatably connected to the inner wall of the support plates, and a rotating block is rotatably connected to the far side of each driving plate. According to the utility model, the effective fixation of steel cables with different specifications is realized, the operation flow is simplified, the applicability and the testing efficiency of the device are improved, in addition, the whole device is convenient to carry and store due to the design of the engineering box, the device is suitable for being used in various field environments, and the practicability and convenience are further enhanced.

title_en: Sample rotary scour corrosion test device in high-temperature lead bismuth environment
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of material corrosion resistance testing, in particular to a test sample rotary scour corrosion testing device in a high-temperature lead bismuth environment, which comprises a testing kettle, a rotating shaft, a driving motor and scour tables, wherein a plurality of scour tables are arranged along the axial direction of the rotating shaft at intervals, a plurality of clamping structures are arranged on the scour tables, a first sealing structure, an oxygen control assembly and a liquid level monitoring assembly are arranged on the testing kettle, and an adjusting assembly is arranged on the rotating shaft. According to the application, through the cooperation of the adjusting component and the plurality of flushing tables, the installation of the samples of a plurality of categories can be realized, so that the synchronous rotation flushing corrosion test of the samples of the plurality of categories can be detected at one time, and the detection efficiency is more efficient.

title_en: Groundwater resource surveys device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an underground water resource surveying device, which relates to the technical field of underground water resource surveying, and comprises a box body and a resistivity detector, wherein the resistivity detector is arranged on the inner wall of the box body, the resistivity detector comprises electrode rods, the number of the electrode rods is two, jacks which are symmetrically distributed are arranged at the bottom end of the box body, two scraping rings are arranged at the bottom end of the box body, the two scraping rings are respectively arranged at the outer sides of the jacks, a fixed plate is fixedly arranged on the inner wall of the box body, a rotating shaft is rotatably inserted in the fixed plate, a one-way threaded rod is inserted in the rotating shaft, the structures such as the one-way threaded rod, a mounting plate, the rotating shaft, the jacks and the scraping rings are mutually matched, the electrode rods can be automatically inserted in a region to be detected, the problem that manual operation is too troublesome is avoided, and impurities attached to the outer sides of the electrode rods can be cleaned through the scraping rings after the test is completed, so that the outer sides of the electrode rods can be cleaned automatically.

title_en: Measuring device for aluminum product cutting
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a measuring device for aluminum product cutting, which relates to the technical field of aluminum product processing and comprises a measuring table, wherein a bottom plate is fixedly connected to the outer surface of the lower end of the measuring table, a movable roller is arranged in the middle of the measuring table, a main measuring plate is arranged in the measuring table, a first chute is arranged on the outer surface of the upper end of the main measuring plate, an auxiliary measuring plate is arranged above the first chute, a first sliding block is arranged between the auxiliary measuring plate and the first chute, and a first scale is arranged on the outer surface of one end of the auxiliary measuring plate. According to the measuring device for aluminum cutting, the main measuring plate can be used for comparing and measuring the length of the aluminum through the first scale, and the auxiliary measuring plate can be used for measuring the width of the aluminum during measurement, so that the length and the width of the aluminum can be measured simultaneously according to actual processing requirements, and the measuring device is convenient and fast.

title_en: Manual support of fish finder probe
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a manual bracket for a fish finder probe, which comprises a hollow pipe body, wherein a handle is arranged at the rear end of the hollow pipe body, a fish finder probe is arranged at the front end of the hollow pipe body, a pipe clamp is arranged on the hollow pipe body, the pipe clamp comprises a clamping part and a fixing part, the side surface and the bottom of the fixing part are both butt joint surfaces, the butt joint surfaces are connected with a supporting part, and the supporting part is fixed on a ship body. The handle can be adjusted up and down by the locking screw, so that the handle is convenient to use.

title_en: Vacuum pump gas tightness detection device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of vacuum pump production devices, in particular to a vacuum pump air tightness detection device, which comprises a water tank, wherein a top plate is fixed on the water tank, a supporting shaft is fixed on the top plate, a cover plate is arranged above the top plate, a supporting pipe is fixed on the cover plate, the supporting shaft penetrates through the supporting pipe and is rotationally connected with the supporting pipe, a supporting ring matched with the cover plate for use is also fixed on the water tank, an exhaust pipe with a valve is also fixed on the cover plate, a rotating shaft is also arranged in the water tank, the rotating shaft is fixed with the output end of a turnover motor, a connecting plate is also fixed on the rotating shaft, a fixing pipe is fixed at the tail end of the connecting plate, an air bag is fixed in the fixing pipe, the air bag is connected with an air pump through an air inlet pipe, an overflow pipe with a valve is also fixed on the water tank, and a sliding block is arranged in the observation pipe. The device can realize the air tightness test of the pump body of the vacuum pump.

title_en: Laser radar receiving circuit and receiving device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a laser radar receiving circuit and a receiving device, which relate to the technical field of radars and aim at solving the anti-interference problem of the laser radar under the condition of strong background light, and comprise a photoelectric detector, wherein the photoelectric detector is connected with an operational amplifier, the first end of the photoelectric detector is connected with a power supply, the second end of the photoelectric detector is connected with the first input end of the operational amplifier, the second input end of the operational amplifier inputs bias voltage, a feedback module is connected between the first input end and the output end of the operational amplifier, the laser radar receiving circuit and the receiving device of the utility model, the direct current component of the background light can be eliminated, meanwhile, the weakening of the strong background light to the dynamic range of TIA output is reduced, and the performance difference of the laser radar in different background light environments is reduced.

title_en: Temperature sensing probe assembly of air conditioner temperature controller
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a temperature sensing probe assembly of an air conditioner temperature controller, which comprises a sensor cable, wherein a clamping groove row bar is clamped at a spiral part of the sensor cable, a cable plug is fixedly connected to the upper end of the sensor cable, a temperature sensing probe main body is fixedly connected to the lower end of the sensor cable, a fixed splicing frame is sleeved on the outer side of the temperature sensing probe main body, and the clamping groove row bar comprises a round angle strip, a clamping groove and a C-shaped rubber sleeve. According to the temperature sensing probe assembly of the air conditioner temperature controller, the spiral part can be clamped through the clamping groove row bars, the number of turns of the spiral part can be adjusted according to requirements, the sensor cable of the temperature sensing probe assembly can be prevented from being wound and knotted, the temperature sensing probe main body can be attached to the installation position of the air conditioner temperature sensor through the fixed splicing frame, the temperature sensing probe main body is more stable and firm after installation, the temperature sensing probe main body is more convenient to disassemble and assemble after installation, the disassembly and assembly mode is simpler, and the maintenance and the replacement of the temperature sensing probe assembly are facilitated.

title_en: Integrated leakage detection device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an integrated leakage detection device which comprises a shell, a protective cover, a zero sequence current transformer and a PCB (printed circuit board), wherein the top of the protective cover is open and is arranged in the shell, the zero sequence current transformer is arranged in the protective cover, the PCB is arranged in the shell and is positioned outside the protective cover, the zero sequence current transformer is connected with a pin header, and the pin header extends out of the protective cover and is connected with the PCB. The leakage detection device is simple and convenient to assemble, the zero sequence current transformer and the PCB are protected, the zero sequence current transformer and the PCB are not easy to damage, and the service life of the zero sequence current transformer and the PCB can be prolonged.

title_en: Concrete additive quantitative sampling device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a quantitative sampling device for concrete additives, which belongs to the technical field of concrete additive sampling and comprises a cylinder, wherein two fixed blocks are fixedly connected to the cylinder, movable rods are connected to the fixed blocks in a sliding manner, sleeves are sleeved on the movable rods, screws are connected to the sleeves in a threaded manner, rings are fixedly connected to the sleeves, connecting blocks are fixedly connected to one ends of the movable rods, and the number of the connecting blocks is two. This concrete additive ration sampling device through setting up scale mark, sleeve, screw, movable rod, connecting plate and piston, and the sleeve can conveniently be adjusted with the position of ring to be convenient for change required ration according to actual conditions, and the device need not carefully observe the scale mark when the sampling, even one carelessly exert oneself too hard, ring, screw and telescopic existence also make the piston unable continue the right side to move, thereby be convenient for carry out quantitative sampling, sampling efficiency is high-efficient.

title_en: Sensor signal output system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sensor signal output system, which relates to the technical field of sensors and comprises a signal acquisition module, a signal processing module, a signal conversion module, a signal output module and a system regulation module, wherein the utility model realizes plug and play of an analog/digital/bus sensor through the arrangement of the signal acquisition module, has higher compatibility, through the setting of the signal conversion module, 24 is ADC, precise reference source and multistage calibration module, and combined with linearization compensation and digital filtering algorithm, the measurement error <0.1% FS can be realized, the high-precision scene requirement is met, through the setting of the signal output module, a 0-10V/4-20mA standard interface is provided, and the digital quantity output integrates high-speed GPIO, serial and Ethernet interfaces.

title_en: Bendable device for checking surface wound of coil inside heating furnace
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of oil and gas gathering and transportation engineering, in particular to a bendable device for checking surface wounds of a coil inside a heating furnace, which comprises a main body, wherein the main body stretches into the heating furnace, the main body is connected with a remote controller in a wireless mode, the remote controller controls the main body to check the internal environment of the heating furnace, the main body can check the internal environment of the heating furnace by 360 degrees through rotation, the main body comprises a display, the display is connected with a telescopic pipe, the telescopic pipe is connected with a sleeve pipe on the outer side of the telescopic pipe, the telescopic pipe is connected with a bent pipe through a hinge, one end of the sleeve pipe is provided with a fixing clamping groove, an endoscope probe is arranged in the top end of the bent pipe, an LED lamp is arranged on the outer side of the bent pipe, and the display is electrically connected with the endoscope probe and the LED lamp. According to the device provided by the utility model, the bending tube can be bent, the LED light source is bright, the definition of the picture shot by the endoscope probe is high, the whole main body supports 360-degree random rotation, the whole internal environment of the heating furnace can be clearly checked, and the safety performance is high.

title_en: Semiconductor finished product deformation detection device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a semiconductor finished product deformation detection device, which relates to the technical field of semiconductor finished product detection and comprises a bottom plate, a detection component, an adjusting component, a placement component and a clamping component, wherein a placing groove is formed in the top end of the bottom plate, the detection component is used for detecting a semiconductor finished product, the adjusting component is used for adjusting the height of the detection component, the placement component is used for supporting and placing a semiconductor, the clamping component is used for fixedly clamping the semiconductor, the placement component comprises a placement plate, the placement plate is connected to the inner side of the placing groove in a sliding mode, a first rubber cushion is arranged on one side of the placement plate, and the clamping component comprises a pressing plate. According to the utility model, the placing plate is arranged at the top end of the bottom plate, the plurality of groups of clamping assemblies are arranged on the inner side of the placing plate, so that the semiconductor finished products to be detected can be effectively clamped, and meanwhile, the plurality of groups of clamping assemblies are arranged at the top end of the placing plate, so that the plurality of semiconductor finished products can be simultaneously fixed, the detection work can be rapidly carried out, and the detection efficiency is effectively improved.

title_en: Mounting platform of train axle temperature sensor
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mounting platform of a train axle temperature sensor, which relates to the technical field of axle temperature sensors and comprises an axle temperature sensor body and a mounting protective shell, wherein a unidirectional motor is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the mounting protective shell, a linkage force application disc is fixedly connected to an output rotating shaft of the unidirectional motor, a linkage column is fixedly connected to one side of the linkage force application disc, the linkage column is slidably connected in a position control groove formed in a positioning linkage swinging plate, and one end of the positioning linkage swinging plate is rotatably connected with the outer circumferential surface of a positioning supporting rod. This application is through the setting of axle temperature sensor body, installation protective housing, unidirectional motor, linkage application of force dish, linkage post, location linkage pendulum plate, accuse position recess, location bracing piece, can effectively realize nimble effect that changes axle temperature sensor body self angle orientation for axle temperature sensor body can detect train axle box ground body surface temperature in a larger scale, thereby can effectively judge the operating condition of axle box bearing.

title_en: Remote electric leakage test device for coal mine
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of coal mine power supply safety, and particularly relates to a coal mine remote electric leakage test device, which is characterized in that a resistor, a rectifying circuit, two groups of magnetic attraction coils and a ground wire are connected into an electric loop through wires, one end of a first conducting rod is intermittently contacted with a neutral electrode and a test electrode, the other end of the first conducting rod is intermittently contacted with an intermediate electrode, one end of a second conducting rod is intermittently contacted with the intermediate electrode, the first conducting rod and the second conducting rod are indirectly contacted through the corresponding intermediate electrode, when a remote electric leakage test is carried out, the resistor with a corresponding voltage level is not needed to be manually selected, the test resistor is prevented from being connected in a wrong way, the potential safety hazard caused by loosening of a clamp can be further avoided, and the safety production is ensured to the greatest extent.

title_en: Disk claw power meter
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of bicycle articles, and discloses a disc claw power meter which is arranged between a crank and a driving sprocket of a bicycle and comprises a disc claw body, a containing box, a circuit board and a strain gauge, wherein the disc claw body comprises a disc body and connecting pieces, the disc body is connected with the crank, at least two connecting pieces are arranged at intervals along the periphery of the disc body and are used for being connected with the driving sprocket, the containing box is made of plastics, the containing box is arranged on the peripheral wall of the disc body, the containing box is positioned between the two adjacent connecting pieces, the circuit board is arranged in the containing box, the strain gauge is arranged on the connecting pieces, and the strain gauge is electrically connected with the circuit board. The utility model can ensure the stable signal transmission of the disk claw power meter.

title_en: Watch processing carrier and processing equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of watch assembly, and discloses a watch processing carrier and processing equipment. The watch processing carrier comprises a carrier body, wherein a plurality of first placing grooves are formed in the carrier body, the first placing grooves are arranged side by side and are matched with the watch body in shape, first through grooves are formed in two sides of each first placing groove, the first through grooves are communicated with adjacent first placing grooves, a plurality of second placing grooves are formed in the carrier body, the second placing grooves are arranged side by side and are matched with watch components in shape, second through grooves are formed in two sides of each second placing groove, and the second through grooves are communicated with adjacent second placing grooves. Compared with the traditional method of completely relying on manual assembly, the application can be applied to the assembly line of automatic production, reduces the labor cost, improves the production efficiency and can ensure the stability of the production quality.

title_en: Test fixture after heat treatment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a testing tool after heat treatment, which can be used for testing the internal resistance of a part. The upper test support comprises an upper plate body, a first sliding rail is arranged on the upper surface of the upper plate body, a first servo motor is arranged at the top of the first sliding rail, an output shaft of the first servo motor is connected with a first screw rod, a first sliding block is arranged on the first sliding rail, the first screw rod is inserted into the first sliding block to drive to move, a test probe with a needle head facing downwards is arranged on the first sliding block, the test probe comprises a voltage contact and a current contact, the test probe penetrates through the upper plate body, a magnetic induction coil is arranged on the lower surface of the upper plate body, the lower test support comprises a lower plate body, a second sliding rail is arranged on the lower surface of the lower plate body, a second servo motor is arranged at the top of the second sliding rail, a second screw rod is connected with the output shaft of the second servo motor, a second sliding block is arranged on the second sliding rail, the second screw rod is inserted into the second sliding block to drive to move, and an infrared temperature measuring probe is arranged on the second sliding block.

title_en: Caliper type voltage measuring device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of cable detection, and particularly discloses a caliper type voltage measuring device which comprises a left measurer, a right measurer and a measuring mechanism, wherein the measuring mechanism comprises a caliper assembly, shaft rods, rotating wheels, arc rings and a lock catch assembly, the left measurer is fixedly connected with the caliper assembly, the right measurer is fixedly connected with the caliper assembly, two shaft rods are respectively and fixedly connected with the corresponding left measurer and the right measurer, each rotating wheel is respectively and rotatably connected with the corresponding shaft rod, each arc ring is respectively and fixedly connected with the corresponding rotating wheel, the arc rings are respectively sleeved on the outer surface walls of the corresponding rotating wheels, and the lock catch assembly is arranged on the outer surface walls of the left measurer and the right measurer and is mutually matched with the left measurer and the right measurer.
