The detection convenience to the cable is improved, the phenomenon of clamping in the moving process is avoided, the voltage and the current of the cable can be detected at a constant speed, and the stability and the accuracy of detection data are improved.

title_en: Gap width detection tool for constructional engineering
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of constructional engineering and discloses a gap width detection tool for constructional engineering, which comprises a plug rod, wherein a scale strip is embedded in the plug rod, an electronic reading device is movably sleeved on the plug rod, a display screen for reading data is arranged on the electronic reading device, a plug blade is arranged at the front end of the plug rod, an L-shaped connecting rod is fixedly connected to one end, close to the plug blade, of the plug rod, and an L-shaped connecting groove for assembling the plug rod and the plug blade together by matching with the L-shaped connecting rod is formed in one end, close to the plug rod, of the plug rod. In actual use, the L-shaped connecting rod is in fit and clamped with the L-shaped connecting groove to realize preliminary assembly, the poking plate is rotated to drive the threaded rod, so that the ejector block enters the clamping groove of the L-shaped connecting rod to complete tight connection, and when the plug gauge piece needs to be replaced, the poking plate can be reversely rotated to be separated, so that the operation is simple, convenient, economical and efficient.

title_en: Detection device is used in metal part production
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of metal part production and discloses a detection device for metal part production, which comprises a base, wherein a bedplate is arranged on the right side of the top of the base, supporting legs are fixedly connected to four corners of the bottom of the bedplate, the bottoms of the supporting legs are fixedly connected to the top of the base, a frame is fixedly connected to the top of the bedplate, a lifting plate is arranged on the left side of the bedplate, the top of the lifting plate is contacted with the bottom of the frame, ultrasonic detection equipment is fixedly arranged at the top of the bedplate, and a positioning rod group is fixedly connected to the top of the base. According to the utility model, through the mutual matching of the structures such as the base, the bedplate, the frame, the lifting plate, the positioning rod group and the lifting assembly, the lifting plate is driven to move downwards to one side of the external transfer trolley, the moving distance of metal parts is shortened, and the advantage of being capable of rapidly moving the metal parts with larger weight or volume is realized.

title_en: Stud structure interface measuring device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a stud structure interface measuring device. The stud structure interface measuring device comprises a main body structure, wherein an upper limit value detection threaded hole is formed in the end face of an upper limit value measuring end, a lower limit value detection threaded hole is formed in the end face of a lower limit value measuring end, an observation notch is formed in the side face of the main body structure, and the bottom face of the upper limit value detection threaded hole and the bottom face of the lower limit value detection threaded hole are exposed in the observation notch. The upper limit value detection threaded hole and the lower limit value detection threaded hole are manufactured according to the go gauge, the effective thread length of the stud structure is inspected while the go gauge inspection is carried out on the stud of the stud structure, multiple point selection measurement is not needed, and inspection procedures and workload are reduced. The non-effective thread part of the stud structure to be detected cannot be screwed into the lower limit value detection threaded hole and the upper limit value detection threaded hole, whether the effective thread length is qualified or not is judged by the number of threads exposed out of the main body structure after the screw is screwed, and the detection accuracy can be ensured.

title_en: Marine workshop test pond
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a test pool for a marine workshop, which relates to the technical field of ship test and solves the problems that when the test pool is filled with water and overflows in a water full overflow mode, heated water overflows through the inside of a cleaning groove while floating objects are discharged, if the floating objects are more, the water needs to be continuously added, the ground in the test workshop is soaked by water, meanwhile, the experimental work of workers is influenced, and the use efficiency of the pool is reduced, including pond, first filter plate and second filter plate sliding connection are in the inside in pond respectively, first filter plate is fixed with the second filter plate, and first filter plate and second filter plate mutually perpendicular, the right-hand member lateral wall fixed mounting in pond has the second drain pipe, through the cooperation between first filter plate and the second filter plate that sets up, can be convenient filter the floater in the aquatic, be convenient for make the floater in the pond blocked.

title_en: Exhaust valve testing machine for prosthetic socket
abstract_en: The utility model provides an exhaust valve testing machine for an artificial limb receiving cavity, which belongs to the technical field of receiving cavity testing and comprises a testing machine body, wherein a first outer connecting pipe, a second outer connecting pipe and a sealing plate are arranged in the testing machine body, the sealing plate is fixedly sleeved on the outer surface of the first outer connecting pipe, an air inlet joint and an air outlet joint are arranged on the testing machine body in a penetrating and communicating manner, an air inlet passage component is arranged at one end pipe orifice of the air inlet joint in a communicating manner, the other end pipe orifice of the air inlet joint is in detachable threaded connection with the first outer connecting pipe, an air outlet passage component is arranged at one end pipe orifice of the air outlet joint in a communicating manner, the other end pipe orifice of the air outlet joint is in detachable threaded connection with the second outer connecting pipe, a pressure gauge and an air pump are arranged on the testing machine body, the air inlet end of the pressure gauge is fixedly communicated with the connecting pipe, and the connecting pipe is fixedly communicated with the air inlet joint. And opening the exhaust passage assembly to enable the gas in the sealed space to be slowly discharged through the exhaust passage assembly, and detecting the pressure in the sealed space in real time by the pressure gauge.

title_en: Highway bridge construction steel bar interval detection device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a highway bridge construction steel bar spacing detection device which comprises a ruler body, wherein a graduated scale is arranged at the top of the ruler body, an adjusting groove is formed in one side of the bottom of the ruler body, a screw rod is rotatably connected in the adjusting groove, one end of the screw rod is connected with a miniature motor arranged in the inner wall of the ruler body, a nut moving block is sleeved on the screw rod in a threaded manner, the nut moving block is slidably connected in the adjusting groove, and a movable marker post is fixed at the bottom of the nut moving block. The utility model has the following beneficial effects that through the design of the limiting mechanism, when the steel bars with different sizes are adapted, the steel bar locking piece with clamping grooves with different sizes can be assembled on the ruler body at the moment, namely, the sliding sleeve and the clamping rod are driven to move by pulling the movable rod to rotate, the clamping rod moves to be separated from the clamping groove on the butt joint block, at the moment, the steel bar locking piece can be taken down, and then a new steel bar locking piece can be assembled.

title_en: Soil opener for rock-soil investigation
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of rock-soil exploration equipment, and discloses a soil opener for rock-soil exploration, which comprises a supporting seat, wherein the supporting seat is used for supporting the ground, a soil opening device is vertically arranged in the middle of the supporting seat, the supporting seat comprises a supporting frame, a connecting cylinder and a spiral guide groove, the supporting frame is of a 'nearly' shape structure, the top of the supporting frame is fixedly provided with a vertical connecting cylinder, an inner hole of the connecting cylinder is provided with the spiral guide groove, the soil opening device comprises a telescopic column, a soil opening cylinder, a guide ball and a handle, the telescopic column slides up and down in the connecting cylinder, the bottom of the telescopic column is fixedly provided with the soil opening cylinder, the top of the soil opening cylinder is closed and opened, the bottom of the soil opening cylinder is positioned below the supporting frame, the outer wall of the telescopic column is fixedly provided with a plurality of guide balls, the guide balls slide along the spiral guide groove, and the top of the telescopic column is provided with the handle. The soil opening cylinder can be inserted vertically on the ground, inclination is avoided, the soil opening cylinder automatically rotates in the downward moving process, the soil opening cylinder is easier to insert into the ground, the labor force is saved, and the rock and soil sampling efficiency of the soil opening cylinder is improved.

title_en: High-precision pressure sensing level meter
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of level meters, in particular to a high-precision pressure sensing level meter, which comprises a U-shaped protection seat, wherein a placement seat is arranged in the U-shaped protection seat, a plurality of grooves are formed in the top of the placement seat at equal intervals, pressure sensors are installed in the grooves, rotating holes are formed in the inner walls of two sides of the U-shaped protection seat, a rotating seat is rotatably installed in the rotating holes, a rectangular groove is formed in one side of the rotating seat, a fixing pin is slidably installed in the rectangular groove, fixing grooves are formed in two sides of the placement seat, the fixing pin is matched with the corresponding fixing grooves, threaded holes are formed in the inner wall of one side of the rectangular groove, a driving screw is installed in the threaded holes in threads, and one end of the driving screw is rotatably installed on the fixing pin. The utility model has reasonable design, can protect the pressure sensor through the U-shaped protection seat, avoids the condition that the pressure sensor is damaged due to collision and the accuracy is affected, and is convenient for the disassembly, the assembly and the replacement of the pressure sensor.

title_en: Food detection solid-liquid separation device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a food detection solid-liquid separation device which comprises a rotating motor arranged in a fixed base and a rotating disc fixedly connected with an output shaft of the rotating motor, wherein a plurality of limiting grooves for placing sampling cups are sequentially formed in the edge of the rotating disc, magnet fixing blocks are fixed at the bottom of the rotating disc and are sequentially arranged at the inner side edges of the limiting grooves, magnets are arranged in the magnet fixing blocks, and a filter plate which is used for partitioning the sampling cups and has the same height as the sampling cups is hung in the sampling cups. The utility model can effectively improve the solid-liquid separation efficiency and accuracy, has simple device, low cost for realizing automatic solid-liquid separation, simple operation and can reduce the error rate of manual solid-liquid separation.

title_en: Sampling detection device of feed pipe of sealing bag film blowing machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sampling detection device for a feed pipe of a sealing bag film blowing machine, and belongs to the technical field of sampling detection. The feeding pipe comprises a feeding pipe, a sampling mechanism is arranged in the middle of the outer surface of the feeding pipe, a feeding mechanism is arranged on the outer surface of the sampling mechanism, and a control mechanism is arranged on one side of the inner portion of the feeding pipe. This sampling detection device of sealing bag inflation film manufacturing machine feed pipe passes through timing module according to production speed and raw materials stability, sets for reasonable sampling frequency, and first dwang is rotatory by first motor drive, makes the screw conveying leaf carry the inside material of feed pipe to the inside of sampling tube for the device can quantitative sampling, avoids the waste of sample, realizes not shutting down the sample operation, and the quality of raw materials in the real-time supervision feed pipe ensures that the raw materials that gets into inflation film manufacturing machine accords with the production requirement, avoids the product defect because of the raw materials problem leads to, guarantees production efficiency.

title_en: Electrical equipment maintains with detecting platform
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a detection table for electric equipment maintenance, which comprises a base assembly, a table top assembly and a clamp assembly, wherein the base assembly comprises two groups of cross bars, a supporting structure is arranged at the top of each cross bar, a placing plate is arranged between the two groups of supporting structures, the table top assembly comprises a detection table, the detection table is fixedly connected with the supporting structure, fixed hinges are arranged at two sides of the detection table, side baffles are arranged between the fixed hinges, a magnet is arranged on the surface of each side baffle, the clamp assembly comprises a driving structure, the bottom of the driving structure is connected with the detection table, a movable structure is arranged at one side of the driving structure, and a clamp structure is arranged at one side of the movable structure. According to the utility model, a semi-closed space can be realized on the tabletop through the side baffle, the interference of the external environment during detection is effectively reduced, and meanwhile, different electrical equipment can be fixed through the clamp structure, so that the application range of the device is increased.

title_en: High temperature detector for cable thermal stability test
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of cable detection, in particular to a high-temperature detector for cable thermal stability test, which comprises a rectangular shell, wherein rectangular shell cavities are formed in the shell, a slot with a size larger than that of the shell cavities is formed in the end walls of the left side and the right side of the shell, a pair of hanging devices for hanging cables penetrate through the slot in the shell cavities of the shell, and rectangular through holes communicated with the shell cavities are formed in the front end wall and the rear end wall of the shell. The connecting seat is clamped at the connecting groove of the machine shell, at the moment, the clamping column of the connecting seat is clamped into the bayonet, then the screw is screwed into the threaded hole, the machine shell and the connecting seat are positioned and connected, at the moment, the machine shell and the connecting seat are assembled together, the heating pipe in the temperature cavity of the connecting seat operates, the temperature is raised, and the temperature is raised and heated in the shell cavity, so that a high-temperature environment is created in the shell cavity.

title_en: Quick detection device of aquaculture disease
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rapid detection device for aquaculture diseases, and particularly relates to the technical field of water quality detection equipment, comprising an outer barrel, wherein the top of the outer barrel is fixedly connected with a handle, and a sampling mechanism is arranged on the inner side of the outer barrel; the sampling mechanism comprises a sharp tube, one side of the sharp tube is fixedly connected with the bottom of the outer cylinder, the bottom of the sharp tube is provided with a first opening, the outer side of the outer cylinder is provided with a second opening, the top of the outer cylinder is fixedly connected with a servo motor, and the output end of the servo motor is fixedly connected with a rotating rod. The utility model reduces the contact area of the detection device and water by the conical outer surface formed by the outer cylinder and the sharp tube, effectively reduces the water flow, keeps the water body at each depth relatively stable, improves the accuracy and representativeness of the detection device for detecting the water bodies at different depths, can discharge the water entering the device without moving the detection device out of the water body, realizes the rapid multiple detection of the water bodies at different depths on the premise of not stirring the water body too much, and improves the water body detection efficiency.

title_en: Mother liquor water recovery device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mother liquor water recovery device which comprises a kettle body, wherein a hollow shaft penetrating into the kettle body is arranged at the top of the kettle body, a plurality of hollow stirring rods are fixedly penetrated through the outer surface of the hollow shaft, liquid suction pipes are fixedly penetrated through the bottoms of the hollow stirring rods, a rotary joint is fixedly penetrated through the top of the hollow shaft, an elbow is fixedly penetrated through the movable end of the rotary joint, a piston type electric liquid suction assembly is arranged at the other end of the elbow, and a discharge pipe is fixedly arranged at the output end of the piston type electric liquid suction assembly. According to the utility model, through the hollow shaft, the hollow stirring rod, the liquid suction pipe, the rotary joint, the bent pipe, the discharge pipe, the piston type electric liquid suction assembly and the rotary assembly, liquid after mother liquid reaction can be automatically extracted in the stirring process, the traditional manual shutdown sampling is replaced, the reaction time is ensured, the recovery efficiency of the mother liquid is improved, and meanwhile, the operation risk is reduced.

title_en: Accurate thickness measuring device of wire skin
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an accurate thickness measuring device for an electric wire sheath, which comprises a stabilizing component, a measuring component and a protecting component, wherein the stabilizing component comprises a handle, a fixed rod and clamping holes, the fixed rod is fixedly connected to the handle, the clamping holes are formed in the handle, the number of the clamping holes is two and are distributed symmetrically up and down, the measuring component comprises a stabilizing frame, a sliding groove, a moving plate, an adjusting rod, a fastening ring, an infrared ranging sensor, a fixed plate and a fastening bolt, and the sliding groove is formed in the rear side wall of the stabilizing frame. Through setting up stable frame, spout, movable plate, regulation pole, holding ring, infrared distance measurement sensor, fixed plate and fastening bolt, when measuring, utilize movable plate and fixed plate to press from both sides the interior outer wall of wire skin tightly, utilize infrared distance measurement sensor to measure the distance between movable plate and the fixed plate, can accurately obtain the thickness of wire skin, it is more accurate to measure.

title_en: Six-station servo leak detector convenient for mounting test piece
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of six-station servo leak detection machines, and in particular relates to a six-station servo leak detection machine convenient for installing a test piece, which comprises a test seat, wherein the upper end of the test seat is fixedly connected with a baffle plate, the outer side of the baffle plate is fixedly connected with a plurality of pairs of guide rod frames which are uniformly distributed, the outside sliding connection of guide bar frame has the link, the outside fixed mounting of link has the mounting panel, the outside fixed mounting of mounting panel has the leak hunting machine, the outside of baffle is provided with elevating system, the upper end sliding connection of test seat has the clamping frame. According to the utility model, the clamping frame, the movable plate, the springs and other structures are additionally arranged on the test seat, so that the clamping frame above the movable plate can be pushed to be extruded on the outer side of the test piece by the elasticity of the springs in the use process, and the test piece can be clamped without screw thread matching, and the test efficiency of the test piece can be effectively improved.

title_en: Extraction element is used in soil cyanide detection that safe storage nature is good
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an extraction device for detecting soil cyanide, which belongs to the technical field of extraction devices for detecting soil and comprises a positioning component, wherein a sampling component is arranged above the positioning component, a lifting component for bearing the sampling component is arranged at the top of the positioning component, a protection component is arranged right below the sampling component and comprises a mud shield, a cleaning brush and a storage cylinder, the sampling component comprises a sampling drill bit, the mud shield is of a hollow round platform structure with a small upper part and a large lower part, the storage cylinder is detachably connected with the top surface of the mud shield, the sampling drill bit penetrates through the mud shield and the storage cylinder, the cleaning brush is arranged on the inner wall of an upper port of the mud shield and is in contact with the surface of the sampling drill bit, the positioning component ensures that the device is stably placed on the soil surface and prevents offset, and in the sampling process, the mud shield, the storage cylinder and the cleaning brush act together, so that pollution and sample loss are reduced.

title_en: Oiling metering device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a refueling metering device which comprises an oil tank, a static balance, a plunger pump, a flowmeter and a radar liquid level meter, wherein the oil tank is arranged on the static balance and used for weighing the weight of the oil tank in real time, the radar liquid level meter used for monitoring the liquid level of mineral oil in the oil tank in real time is arranged at the top of the oil tank, an oil outlet of the oil tank is communicated to an inlet of the plunger pump through a pipeline, an outlet of the plunger pump is communicated to a reaction tank through a pipeline, the plunger pump is used for conveying the mineral oil in the oil tank to the reaction tank, and the flowmeter is arranged on a pipeline between the plunger pump and the reaction tank and used for monitoring the flow rate of the mineral oil in the pipeline in real time. According to the utility model, three-level oiling metering is performed through the static scale, the radar liquid level gauge and the flowmeter, so that mineral oil can be ensured to be stably added into the reaction tank at a constant speed.

title_en: Nail leakage detection device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a nail leakage detection device, and belongs to the technical field of product quality detection equipment. The device comprises a product in-place sensing assembly, a plurality of proximity switches, an in-place indicating assembly and a missing nail indicating assembly. The product in-place sensing assembly is used for confirming whether a product is in place or not, the plurality of proximity switches are arranged corresponding to rivet installation positions of the product, when the product is in place, rivets arranged at the rivet installation positions can trigger the proximity switches at the corresponding positions to be turned on, the proximity switches emit first electric signals when turned on and emit second electric signals when turned off, the in-place indicating assembly indicates whether the product is in place according to the electric signals emitted by the product in-place sensing assembly, and the rivet leakage indicating assembly receives the electric signals emitted by the proximity switches and emits corresponding indicating signals according to the received signals. The utility model can automatically detect whether the rivet is neglected to be installed at the rivet installation position of the product, improves the detection efficiency and accuracy, and reduces the manual detection cost.

title_en: Leakage protector trigger mechanism with self-checking function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a leakage protector triggering mechanism with a self-checking function, in particular to the field of leakage protectors, which comprises a junction box and an induction box clamped at one side of the junction box, wherein two sides of the junction box are respectively provided with a wiring hole, the inside of two wiring holes is all installed the conducting strip of buckling, and the conducting strip extends to the inboard of terminal box, is connected with the electrode slice of inserting in the response box at the other end of conducting strip, is connected with zero line and live wire respectively on two electrode slices. According to the utility model, the coil excitation intensity is monitored in real time by arranging the magnetic field intensity sensor, hidden faults such as aging of the coil, short circuit or demagnetization of the iron core are effectively detected, protection failure caused by reduced magnetic circuit performance is avoided, the self-checking coil and the main detection coil are coaxially nested, the insulating framework and the magnetic circuit are shared, the volume is greatly reduced compared with the traditional independent coil design, the self-checking function is integrated on the premise of not increasing the volume, and the requirements of scenes such as families, industry and the like on compact power distribution equipment are met.

title_en: Auxiliary equipment for universal mechanical testing machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of universal mechanical testing machines, in particular to auxiliary equipment for the universal mechanical testing machine, which comprises a first protection plate, a second protection plate, an upper installation block, a lower installation block and an installation side block, wherein the upper end of the first protection plate is provided with a slot, the bottom of the second protection plate is inserted into the slot, the upper installation block is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the second protection plate, the lower installation block is fixedly arranged at the lower end of the first protection plate, L-shaped installation rods are fixedly arranged at the left end and the right end of the upper installation block and the lower installation block, the installation side block is fixedly arranged at the other end of the L-shaped installation rod, a positioning screw rod which is horizontally arranged penetrates through an upper thread of the installation side block, and a positioning head is rotatably arranged at one end of the positioning screw rod, which is close to the second protection plate. The utility model has the safety protection function, avoids the damage to staff caused by the breakage and splashing of the detection material generated in the detection process of the universal mechanical testing machine, is convenient to store and carry, and has high practicability.

title_en: Signal acquisition and processing circuit for partial discharge of switch cabinet based on current method and gain method
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a signal acquisition processing circuit for partial discharge of a switch cabinet based on a current method and a gain method, which comprises a chip U10 and an operational amplifier U11, wherein a high-low pass filter circuit is arranged on a pin 2 of the operational amplifier U11, a signal filter circuit is arranged on a pin 5 of the operational amplifier U11, the high-low pass filter circuit and the signal filter circuit are jointly connected with a current sensor, the current sensor is arranged on a main cable of the switch cabinet and used for detecting a current signal PD A, a power supply filter circuit is arranged on a pin 4 and a pin 8 of the operational amplifier U11, and a pin 1 of the operational amplifier U11 is connected with pins 3, 4 and 5 of the chip U10. The current sensor is directly arranged on the main cable, and can be used for filtering and amplifying the current signal PD A of the main cable and then sending the current signal PD A into the programmable gain unit U10, so that the current signal PD A can be maximally restored and amplified, the current signal PD A can be conveniently processed by the singlechip, the partial discharge position of the high-voltage cable can be accurately reflected, and the current sensor can be applied to GIS equipment and has small volume and low cost.

title_en: Inertial sensor matrix assembly for motion capture
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an inertial sensor matrix assembly for motion capture, which belongs to the technical field of motion capture and comprises a mounting seat, wherein an adaptive matrix sensor is arranged on the front side of the mounting seat, limiting plates are arranged on the left side and the right side of the mounting seat, a transverse plate is arranged on the top of the mounting seat, inserting rods are fixedly arranged on the left side and the right side of the bottom of the transverse plate, positioning bolts are arranged on the top of the transverse plate, a first elastic belt and a second elastic belt are respectively and fixedly arranged on the left side and the right side of the mounting seat, a limiting seat is arranged on the rear side of the mounting seat, a connecting block is arranged on the right side of the limiting seat, and clamping blocks are fixedly arranged on the top and the bottom of the left side of the connecting block. The utility model has the advantages of convenient installation, enhances the stability between the sensor assembly and the installation assembly, improves the accuracy of motion capture, improves the wearing adaptability of the device, and avoids affecting the degree of freedom of the joint movement of the human body.

title_en: Ice coating observation frame for power transmission line
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an ice coating observation frame for a power transmission line, which comprises a mounting plate, two support plates and two adjusting mechanisms, wherein the mounting plate is used for being detachably connected with an electric tower, the two support plates are detachably arranged on one side of the mounting plate, the two adjusting mechanisms are respectively arranged at one ends of the two support plates, which are far away from the mounting plate, the adjusting mechanisms comprise telescopic plates arranged at one ends of the corresponding support plates, which are far away from the mounting plate, and the telescopic plates are slidably provided with adjusting plates which can move towards one side, which is close to or far away from the support plates. According to the utility model, the adjusting mechanism is arranged between the support plate and the tension sensing mechanism, so that an operator can operate the driving part to drive the adjusting plate to move towards one side close to or far away from the support plate according to the position of the electric wire, and the fixing plate is arranged on the adjusting plate, so that the distance between the tension sensing mechanism and the mounting plate can be changed, the adjusted tension sensing mechanism can be kept vertical to the electric wire, and the influence of angle deviation between the tension sensing mechanism and the electric wire on data acquisition is avoided.

title_en: Imaging mechanism and device
abstract_en: The application relates to an imaging mechanism and a device, wherein the imaging mechanism comprises a shell, a reflector module, a light filtering module, a main control module, a heat dissipation module and a processing module, the shell is provided with a plurality of side walls, a cavity is formed by surrounding the side walls, and the reflector module, the light filtering module, the main control module, the heat dissipation module and the processing module are all positioned in the cavity and are all arranged on the side walls. The imaging mechanism provided by the application has the advantages that the reflector module, the light filtering module, the main control module, the heat dissipation module and the processing module are all positioned in the cavity, and all the elements are arranged on the side wall, so that the reflector module, the light filtering module, the main control module, the heat dissipation module and the processing module are directly arranged on the side wall of the shell, the positions of all the elements in the shell are more compact, the installation and arrangement of all the elements in the shell are easy, and the miniaturized design of the imaging mechanism is facilitated.

title_en: Clamp for diode test
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a clamp for diode test, and relates to the technical field of diode test equipment. This anchor clamps for diode test, including clamping unit and material loading unit, the clamping unit is located the right side of material loading unit, the clamping unit includes backup pad and curb plate, the curb plate is located the backup pad top, the curb plate inboard is provided with the conveyer belt, the conveyer belt outside is provided with evenly distributed's grip block, the grip face has been seted up to the grip block both sides, the grip face sets up to the arc. The clamp for testing the diode has the advantages that the arc-shaped clamping surface can be tightly attached to the diode, the friction force is increased, the diode is effectively prevented from being displaced in the testing process, the accuracy of a testing result is ensured, the automatic feeding of the diode is realized through the feeding unit, the testing efficiency is greatly improved by matching with the automatic operation of the clamping unit, the manual operation is reduced, and the labor intensity is reduced.

title_en: Thickness measuring instrument for household paper
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a thickness measuring instrument technical field, an embodiment of the present disclosure provides a thickness measuring instrument for paper for daily use, it includes the detector main part, still include the frame, first guide roll, the second guide roll, movable plate and positioning mechanism, the frame passes through the mounting panel to be installed on one of them in the detector main part both sides, the cavity has been seted up to the inside of frame, the inside at the frame is installed in first guide roll rotation, the second guide roll passes through two movable plates rotation and installs the inside at the frame, and be in the top of first guide roll, the movable plate can be at the inside vertical movement of frame, the shape of movable plate is square, the movable plate can be in the cavity of frame inside seting up. Through above-mentioned technical scheme for solve among the prior art paper and receive external force influence easily to take place the displacement phenomenon, probably can influence the measurement effect, lead to the technical problem that measurement data appears the deviation.

title_en: Module combined type magnetic turning plate liquid level meter transmitter
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a modular combined magnetic flap level meter transmitter in the technical field of magnetic flap level meter transmitters, which comprises a signal processing unit and a plurality of modular sensor bodies, wherein a connecting structure is arranged between any two of the modular sensor bodies, the connecting structure can adopt threaded connection, clamp connection, fixed connection and dislocation connection, and a connecting unit is arranged between electronic circuits inside any two of the modular sensor bodies. According to the utility model, two or more than two modular sensor bodies can be combined and fixed through the connecting structure, and the signal processing unit modulates the electric signals of the plurality of modular sensor bodies to the standard signals meeting the requirements, so that the transmitter is suitable for different occasions, and the universality of the transmitter is improved.

title_en: Laser ranging sensor communication circuit
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of communication circuits, in particular to a communication circuit of a laser ranging sensor, which comprises a power supply module, a main control unit, a buffer circuit, a special control unit and a ranging circuit, wherein the power supply module is used for supplying power to the whole communication circuit, a plurality of communication pins are arranged and are used for generating corresponding control instructions according to the distance measured by the laser ranging sensor, the communication pins are connected, a level conversion and bus isolation function is configured, a special data processing module is configured and is used for sending specially processed data to the main control unit through the buffer circuit, the special control unit and the power supply module are connected, and the laser ranging sensor is connected to the ranging circuit. The utility model aims to improve the resource utilization rate and solve the defects of bus conflict and driving force.

title_en: Tightness detection device for knife handle of machining center
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tool shank tightness detection device of a machining center, which is characterized in that a through hole is formed in the axial direction of a main shaft, a conical head matched with an inverted conical hole is formed in the tool shank, the conical head is installed in the inverted conical hole in a matched mode, a blind rivet is installed at the top of the conical head, a pull rod is installed in a stepped hole in a sealing mode, an air inlet through hole is formed in the axial direction of the pull rod, the air inlet through hole is communicated with a reaming, the bottom of the pull rod is located in the reaming, a clamping jaw is installed at the bottom of the pull rod, the head of the blind rivet is clamped by the clamping jaw, a movable sleeve is installed in the reaming, the top of the movable sleeve is installed in the reaming in a sliding mode, an air inlet channel is formed between the middle lower portion of the movable sleeve and the reaming, and an air supply device is further installed at the top of the pull rod and is communicated with the air inlet through hole. The utility model has the beneficial effects that whether the tool handle is clamped in place or not and whether the tool handle is loose or not can be effectively detected by introducing high-pressure gas and then detecting the pressure change in the air pressure cavity through the sensor, so that the reliability in the processing process is ensured.

title_en: Balance test table for multi-channel ball production detection for sports
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of balance test equipment, and discloses a balance test table for detecting production of multichannel sports balls. This multichannel ball production detects with balanced testboard, the transport box realizes height-adjustable through adjusting the electric putter, combines the slide bar design that multiunit interval dwindled step by step, but adaptation different diameter spheroids (like volleyball, football, basketball), and during the spheroid was rolled to the testboard along the slide bar, the slide rail terminal kept same datum plane with the testboard upper surface, ensured the spheroid steady transition, avoided blocking or skew because of the size difference leads to, is showing the commonality of lifting means to many specifications spheroid.

title_en: Detection device for research and development of energy efficiency transformer
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a detection device for developing an energy-efficient transformer, which relates to the technical field of energy-efficient transformer development and comprises a lifting mechanism, a matching mechanism and a control box, wherein the lifting mechanism consists of a hydraulic pump, a bottom plate, a hydraulic cylinder, a guide plate, a flexible plate, a bearing table and a template, so that the stable lifting of the energy-efficient transformer is realized, the problems of difficult manual position adjustment and inaccurate positioning are solved, the matching mechanism comprises a servo motor, a double-head screw, a bearing seat, a sliding block, a supporting plate and an auxiliary wheel, the stable supporting and accurate positioning of the transformer in the detection process are ensured, the problems of human error and vibration influence in the traditional method are avoided, the problems of complex operation, low safety and insufficient precision of the energy-efficient transformer in the detection preparation stage are solved, the effects of improving the working efficiency and enhancing the safety are achieved, in addition, the control box centrally controls the two mechanisms to cooperatively work, the operation flow is further simplified, and the convenience and the reliability of the whole work are improved.

title_en: Can lid opening force testing device
abstract_en: A can cover opening force testing device comprises a base and a testing frame arranged on the base, wherein a positioning frame used for positioning a can cover to be tested is arranged on the base, a chest expander used for detecting the tensile force of the can cover to be tested in real time is arranged on the testing frame, a lifting block used for controlling the lifting of the chest expander is arranged on the testing frame, and the lifting block and the chest expander synchronously lift.

title_en: Sample collection device for water and soil layered storage
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of environment monitoring equipment, in particular to a sample collection device for water and soil layered storage, which comprises a sampling drill barrel, a layering mechanism and a connection sampling mechanism, wherein the layering mechanism is fixedly connected to the inside of the sampling drill barrel. According to the utility model, through the arrangement of the water collecting box, the fine filter screen and the negative pressure guide pipe, the efficient water-soil separation process is realized, the water collecting boxes are arranged corresponding to the layered partition boards with different depths, so that water samples can be accurately stored in the water collecting boxes corresponding to the water collecting boxes, the mixing among the water samples is avoided, the layering accuracy of the water samples is ensured, the leakage and the external pollution of the water samples in the storage and transportation processes are effectively prevented through the double sealing effect of the sealing cover and the sealing gasket, the water is secondarily filtered through the fine filter screen, the pure water samples are ensured to flow into the water collecting boxes through the inflow of the pure water samples, and the process that the water in soil enters the layered sampling cavity through the metal filter screen is greatly accelerated through the negative pressure environment and flows into the water collecting boxes is concentrated.

title_en: Adjustable cargo volume measuring equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides adjustable cargo volume measuring equipment which comprises a storage table, wherein a lifting mechanism is arranged on one side edge of the storage table, sliding rails are arranged on two side parts of the lifting mechanism, a screw rod is arranged in the middle of the lifting mechanism, a light shield is arranged in a sliding mode on the lifting mechanism, a camera and a ranging sensor are arranged in the middle of the inside of the light shield, a computer display screen and an electronic scale display are arranged on one side, close to the storage table, of the lifting mechanism, a weighing table is arranged above the storage table, a positioning mechanism is embedded on the weighing table, a cavity is arranged in the storage table and is used for placing a computer.

title_en: Cable insulation monitoring device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of cable insulation monitoring and provides a cable insulation monitoring device which comprises a device shell, wherein a guide wheel set and a detection structure are arranged in the device shell, the guide wheel set comprises a first guide wheel and a second guide wheel, two sides of the first guide wheel are respectively provided with a first rolling shaft, the first rolling shafts are in rotary connection with the device shell, two sides of the second guide wheel are respectively provided with a second rolling shaft, the second rolling shafts are in sliding connection with the device shell, the second guide wheel is provided with a first telescopic structure, the first telescopic structure is in butt joint with the device shell, the detection structure comprises an upper arc detection plate and a lower arc detection plate, the upper arc detection plate is provided with a fixed rod, the fixed rod is fixedly connected with the device shell, the lower arc detection plate is provided with a second telescopic structure, and the second telescopic structure is in butt joint with the device shell. Through the technical scheme, the problems that the distance between the rolling wheels needs to be adjusted every time in the prior art, so that the number of installation steps is increased, the operation is complex, and the detection efficiency is reduced are solved.

title_en: Rear bearing housing processing tool detection device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a detection device for a rear bearing sleeve machining tool, which belongs to the field of bearing sleeve machining and comprises a first detection mechanism, wherein the first detection mechanism comprises an adjusting rod, the outer wall of the adjusting rod is connected with an adjusting block in a sliding manner, one end of the adjusting rod is fixedly connected with one side corresponding to a rotating piece, two slots are formed in the outer wall of the adjusting rod, a moving groove is formed in the inner wall of the adjusting block, and the adjusting block is respectively connected with two inserting blocks in a sliding manner through the moving groove. This back bearing housing processing instrument detection device, through setting up first detection mechanism, this detection device is when using, through circumference pivoted detector, the inner wall of bearing housing main part that can be quick detects, guarantees to detect accurate, detect comprehensively, the nothing is missed, and can once carry out thickness, inner wall roughness, radian's detection, and is swift convenient, adjusts the position of detector simultaneously, can adapt to the bearing housing main part of different internal diameters, has guaranteed this detection device's suitability.

title_en: Reservoir dam piezometer tube mouth of pipe protection device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of pressure measuring pipe orifices, and discloses a pressure measuring pipe orifice protection device of a reservoir dam, which comprises a pipe orifice body, the pipe orifice is characterized in that two sliding rods are fixedly connected to the surface of the pipe orifice body, the arc surfaces of the two sliding rods are slidably connected with a protection plate, and a sealing ring is fixedly connected to the lower surface of the protection plate. This reservoir dam piezometer tube mouth of pipe protection device has reached and has carried out high-efficient sealed protection and stable fixed dual effect to reservoir dam piezometer tube mouth of pipe body, forms interior stopper and the double seal structure of outer seal, can effectively block that impurity such as rainwater, silt, weeds get into inside the piezometer tube, has avoided after long-time use, and external impurity gets into the mouth of pipe body, leads to impurity jam pipeline, influences the accuracy of pressure measurement data, and mouth of pipe body inner wall is corroded because of long-term contact impurity emergence simultaneously, causes the condition that mouth of pipe body life reduces to appear, has improved the security of device.

title_en: Sounding consumable combination carrier
abstract_en: The utility model provides a sounding consumable combined carrier which comprises a sounding instrument, a sounding instrument seat, an air valve, a rope releasing device, a sounding balloon, a release mechanism, a bottom plate and a protective cover, wherein the sounding instrument seat is fixed on the bottom plate and is used for placing the sounding instrument. The release mechanism is fixed on the bottom plate and used for fixing and releasing the air valve, the sounding balloon is sleeved on the air valve, the protective cover is fixed on the lower surface of the bottom plate and used for protecting an antenna of the sounding instrument, and the sounding instrument is connected with the air valve through the rope unreeling device. The utility model combines a sounding instrument, a sounding balloon, a rope releasing device, a releasing mechanism and the like into a whole, designs a positioning module to realize accurate grabbing and placing of a manipulator, designs a baffle to protect the balloon from damage in the carrying and inflating processes, adopts the mutual matching of the releasing mechanism and the balloon to realize automatic inflation and release of the balloon, and the sounding instrument automatically lifts up along with the balloon to detect high-altitude weather.

title_en: Side airbag joint insertion detection device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of side airbag connector plugging detection, in particular to a side airbag connector plugging detection device which comprises a carrier, a plugging assembly and a displacement sensor, wherein the plugging assembly comprises a telescopic cylinder and a connecting frame connected to the output end of the telescopic cylinder, a sliding rail, a supporting block and a plugging block are arranged on the connecting frame, the plugging block is elastically connected with a plugging rod through a connecting piece, and the telescopic cylinder is used for driving the plugging rod to push a wire harness to be plugged. Through the setting of connecting rod and compression spring one for when telescopic cylinder drive spliced pole drove the spliced pole and promote the pencil grafting, the spliced pole received the reaction force of pencil and driven compression spring one compression, compression spring one produced reverse elasticity offset the thrust that part spliced pole applyed the pencil, thereby when making telescopic cylinder drive spliced pole grafting power too big, the thrust that the pencil received offset a part by the elasticity that compression spring one produced, reduced the pencil and received when the grafting power is too big, thereby improved the grafting effect.

title_en: Undisturbed soil sampler for soil
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of soil sampling, in particular to a soil undisturbed soil sampler which comprises a placing and using frame, wherein a ring cutter for collecting soil is arranged in the placing and using frame, a surrounding movable frame is rotationally connected to the placing and using frame, a bottom ring is fixedly connected to the bottom of the surrounding movable frame, a plurality of soil shoveling sheets are fixedly connected to the outer wall of the bottom ring, a reference rod is detachably connected to the top of the ring cutter, the top of the reference rod is inserted into the surrounding movable frame, the reference rod can be inserted into an inserting hole for position control sampling by the center of a circle, the gravity block can be used for shoveling the soil around the ring cutter by rotating the surrounding movable frame, the surrounding movable frame is positioned in a limit ring, the falling and rotating movement of the soil shoveling sheets can be realized, the phenomenon that the surrounding cutter is easy to collide or shake during shoveling is avoided, and the surrounding soil around the ring cutter is convenient to be stably shoveled and taken out.

title_en: Cable detects with cutting system appearance device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cutting sample preparation device for cable detection, which comprises a workbench, wherein the upper end surface of the workbench is provided with a support, the top end inside the support is provided with a hydraulic cylinder, the bottom ends of the hydraulic cylinders are connected with cutting knives, the upper end surface of the workbench is provided with cutting seats corresponding to the cutting knives, the upper end surface of the cutting seats is provided with cutting grooves corresponding to the cutting knives, the left side and the right side of the upper end surface of the workbench are detachably provided with limiting seats, the limiting seats are provided with a plurality of groups, the types of the inner grooves of the limiting seats are different, the bottom ends of the inner grooves of the limiting seats are horizontally arranged relative to the upper end surface of the cutting seats, the top ends inside the support are symmetrically provided with electric push rods, the bottom ends of the two electric push rods are respectively provided with a pressing seat, and the two bottom ends of the pressing rods are respectively provided with a pressing seat.

title_en: Phase scanning positioning device and equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a phase scanning positioning device and equipment, wherein the phase scanning positioning device comprises a position positioning module, a radio frequency low-noise amplification module, a filtering module and a control module, wherein the position positioning module acquires the azimuth angle of the equipment through a first antenna, the radio frequency low-noise amplification module receives a wireless signal of a target terminal through a second antenna and performs channel selection and signal amplification, the filtering module is connected with the radio frequency low-noise amplification module and is used for branching and filtering the selected channel signal, and the control module acquires the position of the target terminal based on the wireless signal of the target terminal after signal amplification and the azimuth angle of the equipment. The phase scanning positioning device can inhibit multi-frequency interference when positioning the target terminal, improves the positioning accuracy of the complex electromagnetic environment and supports multi-frequency-band parallel processing.

title_en: Auxiliary measuring device for monitoring displacement of steel rail
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of steel rail safety, in particular to an auxiliary measuring device for monitoring steel rail displacement, which comprises a mounting part and a measuring part, wherein the measuring part is provided with a first measuring surface and a second measuring surface, the mounting part is used for fixing the measuring part on the rail web of a steel rail in a clamping mode, the first measuring surface is used for responding to the transverse displacement of the steel rail, and the second measuring surface is used for responding to the longitudinal displacement of the steel rail.

title_en: Industrial furnace high-temperature flue gas detection device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-temperature flue gas detection device for an industrial furnace, which belongs to the technical field of flue gas detection and comprises a sampling pipeline, wherein the sampling pipeline comprises a connecting section and a sampling section which are connected, the connecting section is used for connecting the flue gas pipeline, one side, close to the connecting section, of the sampling section is provided with an annular pipeline, the annular pipeline is connected with water supply equipment, cooling water flows in the annular pipeline, the annular pipeline is arranged around the outer wall or the inner wall of the sampling section and extends along the axial direction of the sampling section, the annular pipeline is connected with an atomization nozzle, a nozzle of the atomization nozzle is positioned in the sampling section, and one side, far away from the connecting section, of the sampling section is provided with a sampling port for placing a sampler into the sampling. The utility model increases the heat exchange area through the annular pipeline matched with the atomizing nozzle, and avoids the situation that the pipeline material is thermally stressed and cracked due to local quenching caused by direct spraying of the traditional spraying component.

title_en: Ultraviolet visible spectrophotometer with anti-falling function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an ultraviolet-visible spectrophotometer with an anti-falling function, and relates to the technical field of physics. The utility model provides an ultraviolet visible spectrophotometer that possesses anti-falling function, including the ultraviolet visible spectrophotometer, be provided with four protector on the ultraviolet visible spectrophotometer, protector includes lag and protection pad, protection pad fixed mounting has all seted up T type piece groove in the lower extreme outer wall of lag, when the instrument receives unexpected collision, fall etc. impact in the protector, protection pad at first contacts external object, utilize self elastic deformation to absorb impact force, reduce the impact force to the influence of instrument, the lag also can resist partial striking through self structure simultaneously, further protect the instrument, the practicality of equipment has been improved when effectively carrying out effective protection to the instrument corner like this, the life of equipment has been improved simultaneously.

title_en: Rock mass core drilling sampling device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of rock mass sampling and discloses a rock mass drill core sampling device which comprises a support, wherein a rotating shaft which is transversely arranged is connected to the support, a stand column is rotatably arranged on the rotating shaft through an annular bearing, a screw shaft is rotatably arranged on the stand column, a longitudinally extending mounting groove is formed in the stand column, a sliding block is arranged in the mounting groove and meshed with the screw shaft, a driving motor is arranged on the sliding block, a coring bit is arranged at the bottom of the driving motor, two sections of external threads are arranged on the rotating shaft and are respectively positioned on two sides of the central position of the rotating shaft, and locking nuts are meshed with the two sections of external threads. According to the utility model, the angle of the upright post can be adjusted through the cooperation of the rotating shaft and the locking nut, the vertical sampling can be completed on a slope without building a platform, meanwhile, the damage to the landform is avoided, the universal wheel is convenient for the device to move and position quickly, the detachable cross rod and connecting rod can improve the use flexibility of the device, the cost of manpower and material resources is reduced, and the sampling efficiency is improved.

title_en: Novel wired temperature probe fixing mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel wired temperature probe fixing mechanism, and relates to the technical field of wired temperature probes. Which includes. The temperature probe comprises a sleeve, an aperture mechanism and a fixing mechanism, wherein the aperture mechanism used for clamping the temperature probe is arranged at the bottom end of the sleeve, an aperture hole through which the temperature probe passes is formed in the aperture mechanism, the aperture size is changed by adjusting the opening and closing of the blades, and the fixing mechanism used for fixing the sleeve is arranged on the side wall of the sleeve. The adjustable sheet blade of the aperture mechanism has the beneficial effects that the size of the aperture can be changed according to the requirement, so that the adjustable sheet blade is suitable for the diameters of different temperature probes. This makes the installation of the temperature probe more flexible and convenient. The device adopts a relatively simple design, consists of a sleeve, an aperture mechanism and a fixing mechanism, and is easy to manufacture and maintain.

title_en: Shell punching edge distance measuring device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of lithium ion batteries, and particularly relates to a shell punching edge distance measuring device which comprises a bottom plate, a cover plate, a hinge assembly, side baffles, a reference plate and a magnet, wherein the cover plate is movably connected to the bottom plate through the hinge assembly so that the cover plate can be opened and closed relative to the bottom plate, the side baffles and the reference plate are fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the bottom plate, the magnet is arranged on the bottom plate and/or the cover plate and is used for being adsorbed and fixed when the cover plate is closed so as to tightly press an aluminum-plastic shell to be tested on the bottom plate, a gap for accommodating the edge of the aluminum-plastic shell is formed between the bottom surface of the reference plate and the upper surface of the bottom plate, and at least one through hole is formed in the reference plate. The utility model can rapidly and stably position and press the soft aluminum plastic shell on the detection station, and effectively avoids errors caused by sample displacement, deformation or inaccurate positioning in the traditional manual measurement.

title_en: Battery film puncture strength detection device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a battery film puncture strength detection device which comprises a fixing support used for fixing a battery film and a thimble used for puncturing the battery film, wherein clamping plate parts are respectively arranged on two sides of the top of the fixing support, the battery film is clamped and fixed between the two clamping plate parts, the clamping plate parts comprise a lower clamping plate and an upper clamping plate, the lower clamping plate and the upper clamping plate are connected through a clamping adjusting piece, the two clamping plate parts are symmetrically arranged, the thimble is positioned above the upper clamping plate, one clamping plate part is connected with a tensioning adjusting piece used for adjusting the tension of the battery film, tension detection pieces are respectively arranged on one side of the two opposite lower clamping plates, and the device further comprises a controller, and the tensioning adjusting piece and the tension detection pieces are controlled by the controller. The utility model realizes automatic and accurate adjustment of the film tension, and further improves the accuracy and reliability of the test.

title_en: Multi-axis linkage loading clamp for wind power blade part level torsion test
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multi-axis linkage loading clamp for wind power blade component level torsion test, and relates to the technical field of test clamps. The wind power blade torsion testing device comprises a mounting base, wherein a mounting mechanism for wind power blade component level torsion testing is arranged on the mounting base, the lower end of a first hydraulic rod is rotationally connected with the mounting base, the upper end of the first hydraulic rod is rotationally connected with a movable block, the movable block can be pushed to rotate around a rotating shaft of a first mounting plate in the vertical direction during expansion and contraction, one end of a second hydraulic rod is rotationally connected with a fixed support, the other end of the second hydraulic rod is rotationally connected with a sliding rail support, the sliding rail support can be driven to rotate around a rotating shaft of a second mounting plate in the horizontal direction during expansion and contraction, torque sensors on the movable block and the second mounting plate monitor torsion force values in real time, accurate acquisition of test data is achieved, the first hydraulic rod is matched with the second hydraulic rod, multi-axis linkage torsion of a blade main body in the vertical and horizontal directions is achieved, and a complex stress state of the blade in actual working conditions is simulated.

title_en: Sar measurement for a combined 5g and lte rf device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for measuring the specific absorption rate SAR of a mobile device under test DUT enabled for a combined LTE RF and 5G RF transmission, the method comprising the following steps: a.) Providing a mobile device under test DUT operable in LTE RF and 5G standard, b.) Setting the DUT in a mode to transmit with maximum power level according to the 5G standard, and at the same time transmitting with lower power level of LTE RF standard, c.) Performing a SAR scan and measuring the 5G signal, without taking into account any contribution from the LTE RF signal, d.) Setting the DUT in a mode to transmit with maximum power at maximum power in LTE RF standard, without transmitting according to the 5G standard, e.) Performing a SAR scan and measuring the LTE RF standard signal, f.) Combining the results of step c.) and e.) in order obtain a combined SAR value.

title_en: Detection system, catheter device, and laser cauterizing device
abstract_en: For the purpose of detecting a state of an optical fiber, a detection system includes at least one light source that outputs a plurality of test beams input to a proximal end of the optical fiber and having different wavelengths and providing different bending losses of the optical fiber, at least one reflector that reflects each of the test beams propagating through the optical fiber, on a distal end portion side of the optical fiber, a plurality of light receiving units that receives a plurality of reflected beams each being a beam reflected by the at least one reflector, on the proximal end portion side, and a determination unit that, based on information about the reflected beams at the plurality of light receiving units, compares the information about the reflected beams and reference set values.

title_en: Magnetic resonance imaging system with a rotatable magnet
abstract_en: The invention relates to a magnetic resonance imaging system (10) comprising a magnetic field generation unit (13), an image acquisition region (14) and a radiofrequency system including at least one radiofrequency antenna, wherein the radiofrequency system is configured to emit a radiofrequency excitation pulse into the image acquisition region (14) and receive magnetic resonance signals from the image acquisition region (14) and wherein the magnetic field generation unit (13) comprises at least one magnet (17) configured to generate a magnetic field in the image acquisition region (14), a magnet holder (33) configured to carry the at least one magnet (17) and a rotation system (30) configured to position the magnet holder (33) along a rotation trajectory (32).

title_en: Measurement device
abstract_en: A measuring device 1 according to the present disclosure measures a state of a solution L. The measuring device 1 includes a measuring unit 10 that outputs a measurement signal associated with the state of the solution L, a protection unit 20 attached to the measuring unit 10, and a controller 40 that obtains the information on the state of the solution L on the basis of a measurement signal output from the measuring unit 10. The measuring unit 10 has a first part P1 in a usable state that contributes to output of the measurement signal by coming into contact with the solution L, and a second part that is isolated from the solution L by the protection unit 20 and is in a standby state for measurement.

title_en: Rack for sample tubes
abstract_en: An apparatus for holding sample tubes for sample preparation is provided. The apparatus includes a sample tube holder with an opening to accept a sample tube. The apparatus includes a hinge assembly with a hinge plate and a hinge support, wherein the hinge plate is movable relative to the hinge support. In one example, the hinge plate pivots in two rotation directions and slides in two translational directions relative to the hinge support. The hinge plate limits vertical movement of the sample tube within the sample tube holder. In one aspect, a method includes inserting a sample tube into an opening of a sample tube holder and pivoting and sliding a hinge plate relative to a hinge support, wherein the hinge plate limits vertical movement of the sample tube within the sample tube holder.

title_en: Delivery plan generating method and delivery plan generating system
abstract_en: A delivery plan generating method includes determining a start point that is point where delivery of a delivery object starts (S201), determining an end point where the delivery of the delivery object finishes (S202), determining a transfer point as a destination with reference to the start point, the end point, a position of the first mobile unit, and a position of the second mobile unit, the transfer point being a point where the delivery object is transferred from the first mobile unit to the second mobile unit (S203), and generating a delivery plan for causing the first mobile unit to travel via the start point to the determined transfer point and causing the second mobile unit to travel via the determined transfer point to the end point (S204) .

title_en: Cleaning indicator and method of using same
abstract_en: A cleaning indicator including a substrate having an image upon it that can be interrogated to assist in monitoring a process for washing articles in a washing machine system. The image can be a printed image, which in turn is covered at least partially by a test soil to be removed by the washing process. Alternatively, the test soil can be formed into an image on the substrate. The cleaning indicator can be imaged before the start of a washing process to allow the washing process to proceed only if the appropriate image is observed. The cleaning indicator can be imaged during operation of the washing process, and when a criterion for cleanliness is met, the washing process can be automatically terminated. A washing system for using the cleaning indicator in an automated washing process is also disclosed.

title_en: Method for contactlessly characterizing a substance
abstract_en:
