title_en: Device for measuring a mass of a body, and associated methods
abstract_en: The invention relates to a device (10) for measuring a mass of a body (22), the device (10) having a support (20) suitable for supporting the body (22), a frame (15) and an actuator (25) configured to vibrate the support (20) with respect to the frame (15). The device (10) comprises an accelerometer (35) configured to measure acceleration values of the support (20) during a vibration of the support (20) and an electronic control module (40) configured to estimate the mass of the body (22) on the basis of the acceleration values measured.

title_en: System and method for converging mediated reality positioning data and geographic positioning data
abstract_en: There is provided a system and method for converging mediated reality (MR) positioning data and geographic positioning data. The method including: receiving three or more geographic coordinate points, the geographic coordinate points each associated with different points in time; receiving three or more MR coordinate points, each of the MR coordinate points associated with one of the points in time; determining a geographic trend line from the geographic coordinate points; determining an MR trend line from the MR coordinate points; determining a correction angle as an angle between the geographic trend line and the MR trend line; and outputting the correction angle.

title_en: Estimated wake turbulence trail for aircraft system
abstract_en: A system may include at least one processor (404). The at least one processor may be configured to: obtain air traffic data associated with at least one air traffic target (102); based at least on the air traffic data, determine at least one estimated wake turbulence trail (104) for each of the at least one air traffic target; and at least one of: (a) generate at least one display image based at least on the at least one estimated wake turbulence trail and output the at least one display image to at least one display for presentation to a user, each of the at least one display image including at least one wake turbulence trail indicator, the at least one wake turbulence trail indicator generated based at least on the at least one estimated wake turbulence trail; or (b) operate the aircraft to avoid the at least one estimated wake turbulence trail.

title_en: Apparatus and method for determining three-dimensional shape of an object
abstract_en: The present disclosure proposes an apparatus for determining a first three-dimensional shape of an object. The apparatus according to the present disclosure includes one or more first light sources configured to irradiate one or more first pattern lights to the object, a second light source configured to sequentially irradiate one or more second pattern lights having one phase range, a beam splitter and one or more lenses configured to change optical paths of the one or more second pattern lights so that the lights corresponding to respective phases of the phase range reach a partial area of an upper surface of the object in a dispersed manner, an image sensor configured to capture one or more first reflected lights generated by reflecting the one or more first pattern lights from the object and one or more second reflected lights generated by reflecting the one or more second pattern lights from the partial area, and a processor electrically connected to the one or more first light sources, the second light source and the image sensor. The processor may determine the first three-dimensional shape of the object based on the one or more first reflected lights and the one or more second reflected lights.

title_en: Optical detector of particles
abstract_en: The invention provides an optical detector (1) of particles that is intended to simultaneously detect at least two particles (101, 102) within a useful detection volume (100). This detector comprises a sensory area (20) able to receive light rays scattered by said particles. It is characterised in that it furthermore comprises a dark reticle (30) interposed between the useful detection volume (100) and the sensory area (20). This dark reticle (30) comprises: - at least one optical aperture (301, 302) that permits passage, to the sensory area (20), of one portion (31) of first scattered light rays (kd1) and one portion (32) of second scattered light rays (kd2), - an opaque surface (300) on the periphery of the at least one aperture (301, 302), preventing passage, to the sensory area (20), of another portion (30) of the first and second scattered light rays (kd1, kd2), so as to project, onto the sensory area (20), first and second scattering patterns S1, S2 that are separate from each other.

title_en: Method for calibrating optical sensor, optical sensor and related electronic device
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a method for calibrating an optical sensor, an optical sensor and a related electronic device. The method includes: acquiring (S1) a plurality of spectral detection values of ambient light collected by the optical sensor; acquiring (S2) a plurality of first parameter detection values of the ambient light and the corresponding plurality of second parameter detection values according to the plurality of spectral detection values, a type of the first parameter detection values being different from a type of the second parameter detection values; determining (S3) at least one effective detection value from the plurality of first parameter detection values according to the plurality of second parameter detection values; and calibrating (S4) the optical sensor according to the at least one effective detection value. Based on this method, fluctuations of the light source may be avoided to affect the calibrating for optical parameters.

title_en: Method for extraction of target cells from 3d tissue by optical identification
abstract_en: The invention is directed to a process for extracting target cells from a three dimensional biological specimen by the steps imaging the three dimensional specimen; identifying target cells; registering the spatial parameters (x,y,z coordinates) of the target cells; and extraction of target cells according to their spatial parameters

title_en: Determining the status for strand-guiding rollers by means of vibration evaluation
abstract_en: A strand-guiding section (8) of a continuous casting line (1) is arranged downstream of a continuous casting mould (2) of the continuous casting line (1). The strand-guiding section (8) has at least one strand-guiding roller (6) for supporting a metal strand (5) cast with the continuous casting mould (2). The strand-guiding roller (6) is mounted in roller bearings (10) in the strand-guiding section. The strand-guiding section (8) has at least one sensor device (14), which in turn has at least one vibration sensor (15) which is acoustically coupled to the strand-guiding roller (6) or its roller bearings (10), and by means of which the vibrations occurring with the rotation of the strand-guiding roller (6) in the roller bearings (10) are detected. The strand-guiding roller (6) is cooled internally by means of supplied cooling water (11). The vibration sensor (15) is acoustically coupled to the strand-guiding roller (6) and/or to the roller bearings (10) via the cooling water (11). The evaluation device (17) determines the status (Z) of the at least one roller bearing (10) by evaluating the vibration data (SD).

title_en: Nondestructive testing method for crack defects, and testing standard part and manufacturing method therefor
abstract_en: A nondestructive testing method for crack defects, and a testing standard part and a manufacturing method therefor, used for nondestructive testing of crack defects in an additive manufactured workpiece. The manufacturing method for the crack defect standard part comprises: step A, setting a crack defect area of the standard part, and setting, in the crack defect area, the proportion of crack defects in the crack defect area as a first proportion value; step B, selecting an additive manufacturing forming process for manufacturing the crack defect area to obtain a first process parameter of the additive manufacturing forming process corresponding to the first proportion value; and step C, performing the additive manufacturing forming process on the basis of the first process parameter to form the crack defect area. The nondestructive testing method for crack defects has the advantage that the testing results are accurate and reliable.

title_en: Electronic monitoring system with kpi-based optimization
abstract_en: An electronic monitoring device and system uses a wearable monitoring device in conjunction with an associated smartphone's location services to track a person's location. Cameras or biometric sensors associated with the smartphone allow incremental responses to apparent violations by requiring the wearer to check-in using a photograph, biometric data, GPS location, and other relevant information. The system optimizes compliance by tracking KPIs and using predictive analytics to adjust compliance programs as they apply to client throughout the system.

title_en: Lidar comprising two laser emission modules
abstract_en: A LiDAR device is provided, which includes two laser emission modules and one laser receiving module. The two laser emission modules are separately on opposite sides of the laser receiving module, and a combination of emission fields of view of the two laser emission modules matches a receiving field of view of the laser receiving module. In this application, the two laser emission modules and a laser receiving module are disposed, the combination of the emission fields of view of the two laser emission modules matches the receiving field of view of the laser receiving module, and compared with matching between an emission field of view of one laser emission module and the receiving field of view of one laser receiving module in a related art, it is more flexible to dispose the two laser emission modules, which can implement a miniaturized design for the LiDAR device; and disposing the two laser emission modules can also improve a receiving rate in the field of view of the laser receiving module and expand the detection angle of view of the LiDAR device.

title_en: Isolation resistance monitoring for high voltage systems
abstract_en: Electrical circuits, systems, methods, and/or computer program products that can facilitate isolation resistance monitoring for high voltage buses are addressed. In one example, a system can comprise an electrical circuit further comprising one or more resistors and a voltage meter which measures voltage, such that the voltage measurement assists with monitoring isolation resistance, simultaneously, for a smartcell system of an electric vehicle, and for a direct current (DC) charging source external to the electric vehicle.

title_en: System, method, and computer program product for detecting road marking points from lidar data
abstract_en: Systems, methods, and autonomous vehicles for detecting road marking points from LiDAR data may obtain a LiDAR dataset generated by a LiDAR system; process, for each laser emitter of the LiDAR system, a point cloud associated with that laser emitter by: determining, for each point in the point cloud, based on a gradient of intensity at that point, whether that point corresponds to a gradient edge point; and determining, based on intensities of points in an interior segment of points between at least one candidate pair of gradient edge points and intensities of points in exterior segments of points outside the at least one candidate pair of gradient edge points, whether that candidate pair of gradient edge points corresponds to a road marking edge; and aggregate, from the processing of the plurality of point clouds, candidate pairs of gradient edge points determined to correspond to road marking edges.

title_en: Raster image digitization system for field data
abstract_en: A method can include receiving raster images of logs, where the logs include plots, tracks and headers and where, compared to the plots and the tracks, the headers are underrepresented; processing the raster images using a trained machine learning model to generate segmentation masks for the logs for identification of the plots, the tracks and the headers; and generating digitized versions of the logs using the segmentation masks, where each of the digitized versions of the logs includes a digitized plot with an associated digitized header and an associated digitized track.

title_en: Electric vehicle
abstract_en: Disclosed is a battery performance management system and method using an electric vehicle charging station. The battery performance management server collects battery performance evaluation information including identification information and operation characteristic accumulative information of a battery, identification information and driving characteristic accumulative information of the electric vehicle, and latest charging characteristic information of the battery from a plurality of charging stations through a network. Also, the server determines a current SOH corresponding to the collected battery performance evaluation information by using an artificial intelligence model that is trained in advance to receive the battery performance evaluation information and output a SOH of the battery. Also, the server determines a latest control factor corresponding to the current SOH, and transmits the latest control factor to the charging station through the network so that the charging station may transmit the latest control factor to a control system of the electric vehicle to update the control factor.

title_en: Polarizing microscope, crystal defect evaluation device, and crystal defect evaluation method
abstract_en: A polarization microscope 1 includes a sample stage 4 on which a sample 8 is placed, a polarizer 3 provided on a side of the sample 8 toward a light source, and an analyzer 6 provided on a side of the sample toward an observer. At least one of the polarizer 3 and the analyzer 6 is placed such that a polarization direction is inclined with respect to an optical main axis of the sample 8 or placed such that an angle formed by a polarization direction of the analyzer 6 and a polarization direction of the polarizer is deviated from a right angle.

title_en: Arrangement for optical measurements and related method
abstract_en: An arrangement for optically measuring the surface, such as surface shape and/or associated surface defects, of an optionally glossy target object, comprising: a diffusive, semi-transparent illumination structure defining a hollow, preferably curved, elongated surface shape, constituting a tunnel shape, configured to surround at least one target object at least partially, a number of LED (light- emitting diode) light sources optically coupled to the illumination structure for illuminating at least one target object via the surface of the illumination structure, wherein the light sources are situated at a distance from the surface of the illumination structure, wherein the LED light sources are arranged in a matrix array along the curvilinear cross-section of the illumination structure and along the length of the tunnel shape of the illumination structure, at least one imaging device, configured to image the target object through at least one, optionally lens-provided, apertures, in the illumination structure or from an open position on a side of the illumination structure, such that the illumination structure is not in between the imaging device and target object, and a control entity configured to instruct said LED light sources to form an image sequence of pre- determined illumination patterns on the surface of the illumination structure to illuminate the target object with said patterns projected via said surface, to instruct the at least one imaging device to obtain an image of the target object relative to each illumination pattern, and to derive, through the utilization of said patterns utilized and images obtained, a predetermined surface-related property of the target object. title_en: Ultra-light and ultra-accurate portable coordinate measurement machine with reduced profile swivel joints
abstract_en: A coordinate measurement machine (CMM) may include a manually-positionable articulated arm including arm segments and rotary joints. A swivel joint may include two or more bearings, a shaft coupled to an inner race of the first bearing and an inner race of the second bearing, a first housing coupled to an outer race of the first bearing, and a second housing coupled to an outer race of the second bearing. The second housing is not directly connected to the first housing. The swivel joint may also include an inner spacer coupled to the inner race of the first bearing and the inner race of the second bearing and an outer spacer coupled to the outer race of the first bearing and the outer race of the second bearing. Most of an outer surface of the outer spacer may be exposed to form a portion of the housing of the CMM.

title_en: System and method for generating clock pulses for at-speed testing of integrated circuits
abstract_en: An integrated circuit (IC), including a recording circuit and a clocking system, is provided. During a capture phase of an at-speed testing of the IC, the recording circuit records a number of clock pulses of a test clock signal and generates configuration data indicative of the recorded number of the clock pulses. The clocking system receives a reference clock signal and the configuration data and generates an at-speed clock signal. During the capture phase, the at-speed clock signal includes clock pulses that are extracted from the reference clock signal based on the configuration data. A count of the extracted clock pulses is equal to the recorded number of clock pulses of the test clock signal. The at-speed testing of the IC is enabled based on the at-speed clock signal.

title_en: Methods, systems, and devices for breathing monitoring
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure include methods, systems, and devices for breathing detection and monitoring comprising: receiving, via a data interface, a first parameter; receiving, via a receiver, a plurality of signals; generating a channel impulse response from the plurality of signals; selecting a portion of the channel impulse response based on the first parameter; generating a modified signal from the portion of the channel impulse response, wherein the modified signal is the portion of the channel impulse response with clutter removed; generating a plurality of regression lines from the modified signal; computing a plurality of times based on the plurality of regression lines, wherein each of the plurality of regression lines goes through zero at one of the plurality of times; estimating a zero-crossing time based on the plurality of times; and generating a breathing rate estimation based on the zero-crossing time.

title_en: Systems and methods for generation of hyperpolarized materials
abstract_en: Methods for increasing the concentration of a hyperpolarized molecule of interest in solution are disclosed. The hyperpolarized molecule of interest is prepared in an organic solution. A portion of the organic solution is rapidly evaporated to increase its concentration in the solution while maintaining sufficient nuclear spin polarization. The hyperpolarized molecule of interest is then used in an MRI or NMR experiment. Methods for increasing the nuclear spin polarization in molecules of interest polarized by SABRE methods are disclosed. An at least partially deuterated molecule of interest is placed in a magnetic field having a mean magnetic field strength of at most about 2 T. The molecule of interest forms a coordination complex with a SABRE catalyst or pre-catalyst and parahydrogen in solution. An oscillating magnetic field is applied to transfer spin order from the parahydrogen to the molecule of interest, thereby increasing the nuclear spin polarization in the molecule of interest.

title_en: Sensing device and control system including the same
abstract_en: A sensing device is provided. The sensing device according to an aspect of the present disclosure includes a housing including a first side wall member arranged in an up-down direction with respect to a bottom surface; a first handle formed in a closed curve shape, at least a portion of which is exposed to an outside of the housing and placed on a predetermined first surface, and coupled to one side of the first side wall member so as to be capable of orbital movement along an extension direction of the closed curve at a predetermined location on the closed curve; a first rotating body configured to rotate around a predetermined first rotation axis in conjunction with the orbital movement of the first handle; a support member coupled to the housing, and configured to support the first handle such that the first handle maintains a fixed position at the predetermined location; and a first sensor configured to sense information on a rotational movement of the first rotating body.

title_en: Method for measuring crosstalk between spatial channels, and device for measuring crosstalk between spatial channels
abstract_en: This inter-spatial channel crosstalk measuring method involves measuring inter-spatial channel crosstalk in a space division multiplexed optical system which has a first input/output unit and a second input/output unit on the side opposite to the first input/output unit, and also has a first spatial channel and a second spatial channel. This method comprises: a first step for forming or providing a light reflecting surface at the second input/output unit; a second step for inputting testing light into the first spatial channel at the first input/output unit; a third step for causing at least partial light of the testing light to be reflected at the light reflecting surface; a fourth step for detecting first light power which is the power of light that is a portion of said partial light outputted from the first spatial channel at the first input/output unit and second light power which is the power of light that is a portion of said partial light outputted from the second spatial channel at the first input/output unit; and a fifth step for calculating the magnitude of crosstalk between the first spatial channel and the second spatial channel on the basis of the first light power and the second light power.

title_en: Superconducting magnet and magnetic resonance imaging device
abstract_en: A superconducting magnet, comprising multiple superconducting coils (10) and multiple connection units (20). The multiple superconducting coils (10) are used for forming a main magnetic field for magnetic resonance imaging. The multiple superconducting coils (10) are arranged in an axial direction (A) of the superconducting magnet. Each connection unit (20) is connected to two superconducting coils (10) that are adjacent, and at least one manner of connection to these two superconducting coils (10) is a detachable connection. The connection unit can be connected to a refrigerator (30) of the superconducting magnet, so that cold is transferred to the superconducting coil by means of the connection unit to help reduce maintenance costs of the superconducting magnet, and help reduce temperature differences during cooling of the superconducting magnet. In addition, a magnetic resonance imaging device is also provided.

title_en: Power supply circuit and electronic device comprising same
abstract_en: This power supply circuit may comprise: an input portion for obtaining power from a power supply; an output portion for providing power to an electronic component; a transistor arranged between the input portion and the output portion; a controller for providing an over-voltage (OV) protection function by selectively turning on or off a gate of the transistor, according to a comparison result of comparing a voltage of a control signal with a threshold value configured for the OV protection function; a resistor circuit arranged in parallel to the output portion; and a detection circuit connected to the resistor circuit to obtain at least a portion of a voltage applied to the output portion. The detection circuit may be configured to provide the controller with the control signal having a voltage greater than the threshold value when the voltage applied to the output portion is greater than a clamping voltage, and provide the controller with the control signal having a voltage less than or equal to the threshold value when the voltage applied to the output portion is less than or equal to the clamping voltage.

title_en: Method and system of mri imaging to estimate liver water r1 and r2* variability
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the field of liver imaging using MRI. In particular, the present invention provides means to estimate the variability in liver water R 1  and R 2 * with reference to liver water, iron and fat content. Disclosed is a method of liver imaging comprising the following stages: 1. input stage; 2. T 2 * fat-correction stage; 3. generation of simulated MOLLI signals stage including: (a) LIC-LWC relaxation rate i) estimating the influence of LWC on R 1  and R 2 * ii) estimating the influence of LIC on R 1  and R 2 * iii) healthy-liver reference water R 1 , LIC, and R 2 * values; and (b) estimation of water T 2  and (c) generating a dictionary of simulated MOLLI signals; 4. signal matching stage; 5. water T 1  iron correction stage; and 6. water T 1  standardisation stage including : (a) water T 1  field strength correction; b) water T1 vendor correction.

title_en: ADVANCED PROCEDURE FOR FILLING A PRESSURIZED BOILER (Machine-translation by Google Translate, not legally binding)
abstract_en: Dedicated to the industrial sector specializing in the manufacture of hot beverage machines, this procedure manages boiler filling based on whether coffee is being dispensed, avoiding disruptions in the hot water supply from the boiler during filling or filling. Microfills and/or status fluctuations around the maximum level are also avoided through an additional filling delay time managed by its control unit. title_en: SYSTEM FOR MEASURING AND MONITORING THE RESISTANT TORQUE IN THE ROTARY JOINTS OF PARABOLIC CYLINDER COLLECTOR ASSEMBLIES AND MEASUREMENT PROCEDURE (Machine-translation by Google Translate, not legally binding)
abstract_en: A system for measuring and monitoring the resistive torque in the rotary joints of parabolic trough collector assemblies and a measurement procedure refers to a system consisting mainly of at least one collector assembly with at least one hydraulic cylinder for its rotary displacement and a portable device equipped with pressure sensors, connected to the cylinder chambers located on both sides of the piston, and at least one inclinometer for measuring the angle of the collector, and further equipped with components to, by means of an algorithm, perform the measurement of the resistive torque in the rotary joints used in the joining of solar collector assemblies to each other, as well as for the rotary joints located in the joint between the collector assemblies and different components of the solar field. title_en: Label for attachment to a container
abstract_en: A label 102 for attachment to the outside of a container 101 comprises at least one capacitive sensor 105 configured to vary in capacitance in response to a change in an amount 107 of dielectric material stored in the container. The label further comprises a communication module and control logic configured to detect the variation in capacitance of the capacitive sensor and control the communication module to send a signal when the variation is detected. Change in orientation of the container is detected from a variation in capacitance of one or more of the sensors. Reference capacitive sensors 106 may be provided, and the control logic may detect the container has been placed in proximity to another container based on variation in the reference capacitance. The container may be a flexible pouch containing blood. The label may be attached such that capacitive plates of the sensor are placed on opposing parts of the container, fig. 6.

title_en: Method, system and apparatus for communication for geolocation devices
abstract_en: A method for generating a data packet for transmission over a first short-range communication channel using a first short-range communication technology is provided. The method comprises receiving a location data from a Global Navigation Satellite Systems (GNSS) port; by the GNSS receiver, simultaneously receiving a measurement data through a second short-range communication channel using a second short-range communication technology from an external measurement device; generating a data packet comprising, concurrently, the location data and the measurement data; and transmitting the data packet over the first short-range communication channel via a computer-compatible port to an electronic device paired to the GNSS receiver using the first short-range communication technology. An apparatus for determining a location of a measurement spot and a system for communication of geolocation of a measurement data are also provided.

title_en: Sers nanosensor for detecting substances produced in plants, manufacturing method thereof, and plant monitoring device using sers nanosensor and method
abstract_en: Disclosed are a surface-enhanced Raman scattering (SERS) nanosensor for detecting a substance produced within a plant, a manufacturing method thereof, and a plant monitoring apparatus and method using the SERS nanosensor. The disclosed SERS nanosensor for detecting a substance produced within a plant may include a first nanostructure, a second nanostructure containing a metal and disposed on a surface of the first nanostructure to cause SERS, and a polymer material bound to a surface of the second nanostructure, and generating an attraction force that attracts the substance produced within the plant. The first nanostructure may have a shape of a nanoparticle or nanotube. The second nanostructure may include a plurality of nanoparticles. The polymer material may include PDDA [poly(diallyldimethylammonium chloride)]. <Figure 1>

title_en: Restitution coefficient measuring machine, and hardness measuring machine
abstract_en: To provide a restitution coefficient measuring machine and a hardness measuring machine for improving stable emission of an impact ball.SOLUTION: A restitution coefficient measuring machine for measuring a restitution coefficient of a measurement object includes: a holder for holding a spherical impact ball allowed to hit against the measurement object by an elastic member; an injection mechanism for injecting the impact ball held by the holder toward the measurement object from the holder; a speed measurement part for measuring both of a collision speed at which the impact ball hits against the measurement object, and a restitution speed at which the impact ball is bounced back from the sample; and an operation part for calculating a restitution coefficient on the basis of the restitution speed relative to the collision speed. A hole for venting air is provided on a side face of the holder, and the elastic member is a replaceable separate member for the holder and is disposed in an axial edge of the holder.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Automatic valet parking assisting system, method, infrastructure for them, and vehicle
abstract_en: To provide an automatic valet parking assisting system, a method, an infrastructure for them, and a vehicle.SOLUTION: According to the present invention, communication between an infrastructure and a vehicle is used to move the vehicle to a vacant parking space without a driver and park the vehicle. In addition, according to the present invention, by using communication between the infrastructure and the vehicle, the vehicle is moved to a pick-up region from a parking space without a driver.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 9

title_en: Power source monitoring device, apparatus, and electromagnetic flowmeter
abstract_en: To provide a power source monitoring technique for determining the state of voltage level of an AC power source.SOLUTION: A detection circuit (11) outputs a detection signal Sd indicative of detection period where AC waveform voltage Vd detected from a supplied AC power source changes from threshold Vth1 to threshold Vth2. A measuring circuit (13A) measures time width Wd of the detection period from the detection signal Sd. A comparison circuit (13B) compares the time width Wd to a threshold Wth, and an output circuit (13C) outputs voltage level E of the AC power source on the basis of the comparison result.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Sensor unit and sensor unit calibration method
abstract_en: To propose a calibration method for correcting the individual difference of sensor units that are used in plurality.SOLUTION: Provided is a first sensor unit comprising a sensor, a processing module for processing the measured data of the sensor, and a communication module. The communication module is capable of transmitting the measured data of the first sensor unit to a second sensor unit, and is constructed to be capable of receiving the measured data of the second sensor unit from the second sensor unit. The processing module calculates reference data on the basis of the received measured data of the second sensor unit and the measured data of the first sensor unit, and stores the correction data calculated on the basis of the reference data and the measured data of the first sensor unit.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 9

title_en: Sensor system, and failure detection method for sensor system
abstract_en: To provide a sensor system that can detect a failure in a DA converter, and a failure detection method for a sensor system.SOLUTION: A sensor system 1 comprises: a sensor element 3S to which a control current Ip is input; a DA converter 42 that outputs the control current; and a control unit 4C that generates a control current indication value Ipcmd and inputs the value to the DAC. The sensor system further comprises: an indication value generation unit 47 that, in place of the control current indication value, generates an inspection current indication value Chcmd to be input to the DAC in order for every generation period Tc; an inspection current detection unit 7 that detects an inspection current value Ichv of an inspection current Ich; an expected value calculation unit 8 that calculates an inspection current expected value IMchv that is an expected value of the inspection current value Ichv; a differential value acquisition unit 9 that acquires a differential value DIch between the inspection current value Ichv and the inspection current expected value IMchv; and a failure detection unit 10 that, through frequency analysis of a temporal change of the differential value DIch, detects a failure in a bit belonging to a low-order bit group BL of the DA converter 42.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Displacement measurement tool, displacement measurement device, and displacement measurement method
abstract_en: To provide a displacement measurement method which costs less than using an existing sensor and allows for easily measuring an increase in length of any portion of a measurement target object.SOLUTION: A displacement measurement tool (1) provided herein comprises: an elongate first member (10) with a tip end (11) and a base end (12), provided with a plurality of locking teeth (13) arranged at regular intervals along a longitudinal direction; and a second member (20) having an insertion hole (21) configured to allow the first member (10) to be inserted and a locking claw (22) capable of engaging with each of the plurality of locking teeth (13).SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Measurement device
abstract_en: To perform measurement at two or more multiple points using two or more head units without narrowing a measurement wavelength band per head unit.SOLUTION: A measurement device is provided, comprising a holding unit and a measurement unit, the measurement unit includes: a light source unit; a first optical fiber transmitting light emitted by the light source unit; a branch unit branching the light transmitted by the first optical fiber to at least two optical fibers for measurement; a plurality of head units each of which includes a flux collector collecting the light branched by the branch unit to a measurement object; a shutter unit delaying timing at which the measurement object is irradiated with light from each head unit; a second optical fiber which is branched off by the branch unit and through which return light having been reflected by the measurement object is transmitted; a spectroscopic unit having a light receiving unit receiving return light; and a control unit controlling the operation of the shutter unit, thereby controlling the timing at which the measurement object is irradiated with light from each head unit, consequently causing the light receiving unit to individually receive the return light.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Method for operating three-dimensional measuring apparatus and three-dimensional measuring apparatus
abstract_en:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a method for operating a three-dimensional measuring apparatus and the three-dimensional measuring apparatus that can easily perform settings for output of a voice guidance according to the proficiency of an operator. 
     SOLUTION: The method for operating the three-dimensional measuring apparatus has an output setting step of changing the setting of whether to output a voice guidance on the basis of the relation between the timing of output of the voice guidance and the timing of inputting an instruction of probing by an operator in a case where the voice guidance about probing is not output when a measurement target object is probed by the three-dimensional measuring apparatus.

title_en: Automatic driving system, automatic driving method and program
abstract_en: To shorten a travel time to the next destination.SOLUTION: A vehicle (20) is automatically driven in an environment that first roads (1a, 10a and 11a) for vehicles moving forward in a first direction and second roads (1b, 10b and 11b) for vehicles moving forward in a second direction which is a direction different from the first direction are provided together, first parking spaces (4 and 14) where vehicles enter from the first roads and leave to the first roads are installed, and second parking spaces (5 and 15) where vehicles enter from the second roads and leave to the second roads are installed. When the vehicle (20) is temporarily parked in the first parking space (4, 14) and a direction of travel of the vehicle (20) moving toward the next destination after parking is the second direction, after a user of the vehicle (20) gets off the vehicle (20), the vehicle (20) is moved from the first parking space (4, 14) to the second parking space (5, 15) by automatic driving.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Determination device, determination system, judgment method, program, and storage medium
abstract_en: To provide a determination device, a determination system, a determination method, a program, and a storage medium capable of automatically determining a condition of processing for an image.SOLUTION: A determination device according to an embodiment determines quality of an article by using an image obtained by capturing the article. The determination device repeats a processing set including first to fourth processing. In the first processing, a condition is selected from condition data including a plurality of conditions that define a channel to be used and preprocessing. In the second processing, a plurality of processed images are acquired by applying the selected condition to each of a plurality of images. In the third processing, the quality of the article captured in each of the processed images is determined based on each of results obtained by comparing a plurality of pixel units included in each of the processed images and a plurality of thresholds. In the fourth processing, an evaluation of the selected condition is determined by using one or more selected from a determination result of the quality for each good-part image and a determination result of the quality for each defective-part image. The determination device determines one of the plurality of conditions based on the evaluation of each of the plurality of conditions.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Systems and methods for positioning mobile devices in fifth generation wireless network
abstract_en:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a method and apparatus enabling location support for 5G New Radio (NR) wireless access by user equipment (UE) by utilizing existing LTE location support. 
     SOLUTION: A method of supporting location of UE with 5G wireless access comprises: receiving, from a location server via a 5G base station, a first LTE Positioning Protocol (LPP) message comprising a location request (810); obtaining a location measurement based on the first LPP message (820); determining location information based on the location measurement (830); and sending a second LPP message to the location server (840). The second LPP message comprises the measured location information.

title_en: State monitoring method. state monitoring system, state monitoring device for mechanism, and wind power generation device and program
abstract_en: To precisely monitor a state of a mechanism even if the rotating speed of a rotating action of the mechanism varies in an environment in which the rotating speed may intermittently vary.SOLUTION: There is provided a state monitoring method for a mechanism that performs a rotating action, and the state monitoring method comprises: an acquisition process of acquiring vibration information or sound information in the rotating action of the mechanism at intervals of a certain time; a conversion process of converting the vibration information or sound information acquired in the acquisition process to obtain a waveform in a state in which the rotating action has a constant angular speed; and a diagnostic process of using the vibration information or sound information converted in the conversion process to diagnose the state of the mechanism.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Defect estimation device, defect estimation method and program
abstract_en: To estimate a three-dimensional position of an internal defect in a laminate of a fiber-reinforced plastic.SOLUTION: A defect estimation device comprises: a feature amount reception unit which is configured to receive an input of an image obtained by measuring feature data based on a temperature change generated on a surface of a laminate of a fiber-reinforced plastic; and a defect position estimation unit which is configured to estimate a three-dimensional position of an internal defect in the laminate by inputting the feature data received by the feature amount reception unit to a model that has learned a relation between the feature data and position information expressing the three-dimensional position of the internal defect.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title_en: Method for manufacturing force sensor
abstract_en: To manufacture a force sensor which can maintain positional information between a first substrate and a second substrate so that the distance between the first substrate and the second substrate is constant under no weight applied.SOLUTION: A method for manufacturing a force sensor includes the steps of: preparing a first substrate of a material which transmits an electromagnetic wave and having a metal array arranged in a periodic pattern on its surface and a second substrate having a metal layer which reflects an electromagnetic wave on its surface; forming a spacer member around the metal array on the surface of the first substrate; forming a first metal layer thinner than the spacer member around the spacer member on the surface of the first substrate; forming a second metal layer thinner than the spacer member in a region of the second substrate which corresponds to the first metal layer; and fusing the first metal layer and the second metal layer and fixing the first substrate and the second substrate with the spacer member formed on the surface of the first substrate abutting on the surface of the second substrate.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: electronic component unit
abstract_en: To suppress a reduction in temperature estimation accuracy.SOLUTION: An electronic component unit 10 includes a metal part 20, a seal member 41, a reactor 51, a heat conduction part 71, and a temperature sensor 81. The reactor 51 is electrically connected to a switching element. When the switching element turns on, a current flows in the reactor 51. The metal part 20 includes a lid part 21, and a case part 31. The heat conduction part 71 abuts to the lid part 21 and the reactor 51. The temperature sensor 81 is provided in the lid part 21. The lid part 21 and the case part 31 are spaced apart from each other.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Electrode chip and electronic apparatus
abstract_en: To provide an electrode chip which prevents a liquid insulating resin from expanding up to an electrode film on the side face of a conductive substrate, and has high adhesion to the insulating resin, and an electronic apparatus having the electrode chip.SOLUTION: An electrode chip has a conductive substrate, and an electrode film which is provided on a crystal growth surface that is one main surface out of two main surfaces of the conductive substrate, and is composed of a polycrystal diamond, wherein two kinds of regions of a region composed of a smooth surface and a region composed of a non-smooth surface are formed on the side face of the conductive substrate, and the smooth surface is formed in a belt shape continuous in the circumferential direction of the conductive substrate.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Method and apparatus for acquiring cross-sectional image of stacked capacitor
abstract_en: To provide a method and apparatus for acquiring a cross-sectional image of a stacked capacitor capable of realizing the time (or cost) efficiency in acquiring the cross-sectional image of the stacked capacitor and fine resolution of the cross-sectional image of the stacked capacitor.SOLUTION: A stacked capacitor comprises a body having a plurality of internal electrodes and a plurality of dielectric layers stacked alternately. An apparatus for acquiring a cross-sectional image of the stacked capacitor may comprise: a camera for acquiring an enlarged image of a cross-section of the stacked capacitor where the plurality of internal electrodes and the plurality of dielectric layers of the body are exposed; a lens positioned between the cross-section and the camera; a light source outputting visible light; and a first polarizer polarizing and outputting light input from between the light source and the cross-section.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1a

title_en: current sensor
abstract_en: To provide a current sensor with which it is possible to measure the current to be measured that is flowing in a conductor with higher accuracy than before.SOLUTION: A current sensor 1 comprises a magnetic core 11 that can be located so as to enclose the periphery of a conductor 50 in which the current to be measured flows, a plurality of magnetic sensors 12 each of which detects the flux in a predetermined portion of the magnetic core 11, a plurality of amplifiers 13 that are installed so as to correspond to the plurality of magnetic sensors 12, a plurality of feedback coils 14 that are installed so as to correspond to the plurality of magnetic sensors 12, and a current detection unit 16 that detects the current to be detected, on the basis of the combined current of currents flowing in each of the plurality of feedback coils 14. Each of the plurality of amplifiers 13 amplifies the output of the corresponding magnetic sensor 12 and outputs a current that corresponds to the output of the magnetic sensor 12. Each of the plurality of feedback coils 14 is arranged by being wound around the magnetic core 11, and flows the current outputted by the corresponding amplifier 13 in a direction to cancel out the flux in the predetermined portion of the magnetic core 11.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: torque sensor
abstract_en: To provide a torque sensor which detects a displacement by a limited space and has an increased detection accuracy for a torque.SOLUTION: A torque sensor 1 includes: a first structure 11 formed in the shape of a wheel; a second structure 12 formed in the shape of a smaller wheel than the first structure 11 and arranged in the inner peripheral side of the first structure 11; a protrusion unit 14 provided in the first structure 11, the protrusion unit protruding to the second structure 12; a sensor 2 provided in the second structure 12, the sensor detecting a physical amount which shows the distance between two members which is changed by contact with the protrusion unit 14 caused in a manner that the first structure 11 receives a torque Mz and relatively rotates to the second structure 12; and torque detection means for detecting the torque Mz on the basis of the physical amount detected by the sensor 2.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Information processing device, information processing method, and program
abstract_en: To provide a technique for generating more efficient position information according to a purpose.SOLUTION: A data acquisition unit 52 obtains first type data that is used to generate position information of an object, which is specified by a predetermined generation method for generating position information. A position information generation unit 53 generates the position information of the object by executing generation processing of the position information using the first type data according to the predetermined generation method. A purpose result estimation unit 54 estimates a result for a predetermined purpose of the object, based on the position information of the object. A method selection unit 51 selects, based on the purpose, the predetermined generation method used by the data acquisition unit 52 and the position information generation unit 53 from among N kinds (N is an integer equal to or greater than 2) of generation methods for generating the position information.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Electronic device and electronic timepiece
abstract_en: To suppress the reduction of electrical performance due to miniaturization of devices.SOLUTION: A timepiece 100, which is an electronic device, comprises: a circuit board 5; an annular antenna 6 that has at least an outer peripheral edge 60a and an inner peripheral edge 60b in a plan view from a first direction I and has at least in part a notch portion 67 or a hole portion not shown in figure; a solar panel 4; and at least one substrate-panel contact member 46 electrically connected to the solar panel 4 and the circuit board 5. The solar panel 4, the antenna 6, and the circuit board 5 are arranged in order along the first direction I orthogonal to a surface of the circuit board 5. The solar panel 4 is located so as to overlap the antenna 6 at least in part in a plan view from the first direction I, and the substrate-panel contact member 46 is arranged at a position corresponding to the notch portion 67 of the antenna 6.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 10

title_en: Mass spectrometer and setting method of analysis condition
abstract_en: To improve the detection sensitivity of target ions while preventing interfering particles that become noise from being taken into a detector.SOLUTION: An ICP-MS includes a control device, a collision cell and a first electrode provided on an optical axis of plasma, a second electrode provided on a detection axis, a mass separator, and a detector. For an axis-shifting voltage applied to each of the first electrode and the second electrode, the control device sets an axis shift voltage in the gas mode to a voltage obtained by adding an offset determined according to the mass-to-charge ratio of the target ion to the initial voltage in the gas-free mode.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Length measurement device
abstract_en: To provide a length measurement device capable of preventing the generation of a positional deviation due to play of a screw feed mechanism, in the length measurement device enabling fine adjustment with the screw feed mechanism.SOLUTION: A length measurement device 1 is equipped with: a slide rail 15; and a slide portion 3 that is slidably installed on the slide rail 15, and has a slide body 30, a length measuring apparatus 80 measuring a slide distance of the slide body 30 with respect to the slide rail 15, a temporarily fixed body 40, a fine adjustment mechanism 50 having a feed screw 51 coupling the slide body 30 and the temporarily fixed body 40 in a sliding direction so as to relatively move, a first clamp 35 for fixing the slide body 30, and a temporarily fixed clamp 45 for fixing the temporarily fixed body 40. The fine adjustment mechanism 50 is equipped with a compression coil spring 57 installed coaxially with the feed screw 51 between the slide body 30 and the temporarily fixed body 40 so as to always push or pull against each other.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Testing device
abstract_en: To provide a testing device which can notify appropriate replacement timing regarding components of a testing device body unit and carry out efficient maintenance.SOLUTION: A testing device comprises: a signal switch 30 that connects one of a plurality of measuring instruments 10 and an instrument 2 to be tested together by a plurality of relays 31; and a controller (control unit) 20 for the instrument to be tested, which inputs and analyzes measurement results from the plurality of measuring instruments 10. The controller 20 for the instrument to be tested controls on/off of each of the plurality of relays in the signal switch 30, counts the number of times being switched on and off, and notifies the replacement timing of the relevant relay when the counted number of times of switching exceeds a specific threshold.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 9

title_en: Magnetic detector
abstract_en: To provide a magnetic detector which, when detecting magnetic fields in a plurality of directions, can bring detection positions for each magnetic field in the plurality of directions close to each other while suppressing the deterioration in sensitivity.SOLUTION: A magnetic detector 100 includes: a plurality of magnetic sensor parts 10a to 10f respectively having excitation coil parts, signal coil parts, and ring cores; a drive circuit part 20; and a detection circuit part 30. A first axis sensor part is comprised of at least the two magnetic sensor parts 10a, 10b provided in a manner to set a first axis direction as a detection direction among the plurality of magnetic sensor parts 10a to 10f, and a second axis sensor part is comprised of at least the two magnetic sensor parts 10c, 10d provided in a manner to set a second axis direction intersecting with the first axis direction as the detection direction among the plurality of magnetic sensor parts 10a to 10f.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Monitoring diagnostic system and monitoring diagnostic method
abstract_en: To provide a monitoring diagnostic system which enables use of the correlation anomaly detection method on a particular parameter even when the parameter has become perfectly constant in a target period.SOLUTION: A monitoring diagnostic system is provided, comprising an input unit for receiving input of time-series data on operation of a device, a determination unit configured to determine that the time-series data is abnormal when variation of the time-series data is less than a given amount during a certain period, and a correction unit configured to correct the time-series data when the data is determined to be abnormal by the determination unit.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 8

title_en: Method for estimating content of allophane in deposited material of volcanic ejecta and manufacturing of hydraulic composition
abstract_en: To provide a method for rapidly estimating the content of allophane in the deposited material of volcanic ejecta.SOLUTION: The method for estimating the content of allophane in the deposited material of volcanic ejecta includes the step of estimating the content of allophane in the deposited material of volcanic ejecta on the basis of the BET specific surface area of the deposited material of volcanic ejecta and an index which shows the content ratio of Fe3+ of iron ions in the deposited material of volcanic ejecta.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Apparatus and method for assigning material value score to printed circuit board waste material or portion thereof and system for sorting printed circuit board waste material
abstract_en: To provide an apparatus and a method for assigning a material value score to a printed circuit board waste material or a portion thereof, and a system for sorting the printed circuit board waste material.SOLUTION: An apparatus is configured to determine a material value score and to perform the determination on the basis of a dual energy or spectral X-ray image of a printed circuit board waste material 200 or a portion 210 thereof. Furthermore, the apparatus is configured to perform the determination by applying the dual energy or spectral X-ray image to a machine learning module.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Determination method, determination program, substrate processing device, and information processing device
abstract_en: To detect an occurrence of an embedding failure.SOLUTION: A determination method includes a step a) and a step b). In the step a), a pattern including a recessed part is formed, spectral measurement of a substrate in which an embedding material is embedded in the recessed part is performed, and either spectrum of an absorbance spectrum or a reflectance spectrum of the substrate is measured. In the step b), an embedded state of the recessed part is determined from an integration value of a spectrum value in each wavelength range of one spectrum of the substrate measured by the step a) by using a model generated by mechanically learning data obtained by associating the integration value of the spectrum value in each wavelength range about a plurality of wavelength ranges of the one spectrum of a plurality of substrates in which the embedding material is embedded with the embedded state of the recessed part.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 14

title_en: Sealing method and structure of sealing part
abstract_en: To provide a sealing method for performing proper sealing with a sealing member and further, introducing sufficient pressure transmission oil into a sensor chip.SOLUTION: A sealing method includes the steps of: forming a sensor chip 22 on a wafer; sticking a dicing tape to the wafer; cutting out the sensor chip 22; peeling off the dicing tape; accumulating pressure transmission oil 25 in a counterbore 27; sucking the pressure transmission oil 25 into an oil introduction path 23 by a reduced pressure injection method; and sealing an introduction port 26 with a sealing member 24. In the step of accumulating the pressure transmission oil 25 in the counterbore 27, a volume of the pressure transmission oil 25 that at least fills the oil introduction path 23 is accumulated in the counterbore 27.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Detection system, detection method, and detection program
abstract_en: To provide a detection system, a detection method, and a detection program which are capable of accurately detecting stain of a distance measuring part.SOLUTION: An acquisition processing part 211 acquires a plurality of distance measurement data measured by a sensor 24 which measures a distance to a subject in a predetermined distance measuring direction. A calculation processing part 212 calculates variation of the plurality of distance measurement data acquired by the acquisition processing part 211. A determination processing part 213 determines the state of stain of the sensor 24 on the basis of the variation calculated by the calculation processing part 212.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Projected beam smoke detector
abstract_en: To enable checking of whether a heater is normally operating in a projected beam smoke detector with a heater that prevents a non-fire alarm due to condensation.SOLUTION: A projected beam smoke detector that senses a fire from a reduced amount of light reception caused by blocking of transmitted light with smoke, comprises, in least one of a light transmission unit and a light reception unit: a heating unit that heats an optical member; and temperature detection means for detecting a temperature of the heating unit. A heating abnormality of the heating unit is detected by the temperature detection means.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Label, and method for removing ink layer from label
abstract_en: To provide a label from which an ink layer can be efficiently removed, and a method for removing an ink layer from a label.SOLUTION: A label (11) comprises a substrate (101) and an ink layer (103) on the substrate (101), and the ink layer (103) contains a material that emits light when irradiated with energy rays. When the label (11) is irradiated with energy rays, the ink layer (103) emits light, making it possible to identify and distinguish the label (11) from other labels.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Inspection method and inspection apparatus
abstract_en: To improve detection accuracy of a defect of a specimen by suppressing reception of a diffracted wave by a reception part, in an inspection method for inspecting the specimen based on an ultrasonic wave transmitted through the specimen from a transmission part and received by a reception surface of the reception part when the specimen is positioned in a space between the transmission part and the reception part.SOLUTION: In the inspection method for inspecting the subject 100, the subject 100 is conveyed from the outside position OP1 toward the space S1 between the transmission unit 21 and the reception unit 22, the subject 100 is guided, and the subject 100 is inspected based on the ultrasonic waves after the length 22a in the space OP1 is made smaller than the length L2 in the outside position S1 with respect to the length between the reception surface L1 of the reception unit 22 and the subject 100 in the arrangement direction Z of the transmission unit 21 and the reception unit 22.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: magnetic sensor
abstract_en: To suppress variations in the intensity of a bias magnetic field applied to a magnetoresistance effect element.SOLUTION: The magnetic field sensor 1 includes a substrate 31 having an upper surface 31a, an insulating layer 33 having an upper surface including a first inclined surface 31a and a second inclined surface 33a that are inclined with respect to the upper surface 33b of the substrate 31 and face in different directions from each other, a first MR device 33a disposed on the first inclined surface 50A, a second MR device 33b disposed on the second inclined surface 50B, and two magnetic field generators 70 disposed from the first inclined surface 33a to the second inclined surface so as to sandwich the first MR device and the second MR device and configured to apply bias magnetic fields to the first MR device and the second MR device, respectively. 33b 50B 50A 50A 50B.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title_en: Apparatus and method for measuring modified area of substrate
abstract_en: To provide a substrate reforming area measuring device.SOLUTION: The imaging apparatus includes a first imaging device 101, a second imaging device 102, a third imaging device 103, and a microcomputer unit 104. The first imaging device faces the first surface of the substrate 110 and is configured to photograph the substrate to obtain a first image. The second imaging device faces the second surface of the substrate and is configured to photograph the substrate to obtain a second image. The first surface of the substrate is opposite to the second surface of the substrate. The third imaging device obliquely faces the first surface of the substrate or the second surface of the substrate, and is configured to photograph the substrate to obtain a third image. The micro-processor unit obtains a modified area measurement information of at least one modified area of the substrate according to the first image, the second image and the third image.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Reflector and target device
abstract_en: To provide a reflector and a target device capable of retroreflecting measurement light from a wide range without almost generating errors in distance measurement and angle measurement of a measurement reference point when the reflector is installed at a measurement point.SOLUTION: The optical system is provided with a plurality of reflector elements 1, which are provided on an incident optical axis 4 of measuring light and have a deflecting optical member 2 for reflecting the measuring light and a retroreflector 3 for retroreflecting the measuring light provided on a reflection optical axis 4' of the deflecting optical member, and the virtual image of the optical center of the reflector element is formed on the extension of the incident optical axis, and the plurality of reflector elements are combined so that the positions of the virtual images are matched or nearly matched.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: AI-based vibration reduction monitoring device with microvibration triggers and easy cable entry of horizontal maintaining structure
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an AI-based vibration reduction monitoring device, which is configured to relieve transmission of vibration or impact caused by an earthquake to an object, and comprises a base unit, a support unit, and a transfer guide unit.

title_en: Radiation shielding device for meteorological observation with internal air circulation
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a radiation shielding device for meteorological observation with internal air circulation. According to the present invention, the radiation shielding device for meteorological observation with internal air circulation comprises: a body which includes one or more meteorological observation means inside, and whose upper surface is inclined for at least a first angle value toward the ground surface based on a flat surface parallel to the ground; a cover engaged with the body to have a lower surface inclined for at least a second angle value based on a flat surface parallel to the ground toward the sky; and a venturi tube physically formed by a difference in angle between the upper surface of the body and the lower surface of the cover (the value of the difference in angle is the sum of the first angle value and the second angle value) with the body engaged with the cover. The venturi tube includes: a first opening unit for absorbing the external air; a second opening unit for absorbing the internal air of the body; and a third opening unit for discharging the external air and the internal air. When the radiation shielding device for meteorological observation is mounted in a moving body and is moved, the external air is absorbed through the first opening unit, and the internal is absorbed into the venturi tube through the second opening unit, and the absorbed external air and internal air are discharged through the third opening unit, so that the internal air can be circulated. The present invention aims to provide a radiation shielding device for meteorological observation with the internal air circulation, which is able to circulate the internal air in a radiation shielding tank without the external help of a fan or a motor.

title_en: Underground facilities detection system using augmented reality based on ground control point through uav photograghy
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an underground facility measurement system. More specifically, the present invention comprises: a capturing unit generating a capturing image by capturing an installation section of an underground facility; a wireless controller controlling flight of the capturing unit; an image unit performing imaging processing by receiving capturing image data from the capturing unit; and a smart terminal communicating with the image unit to receive information of the underground facility to realize augmented reality. The present invention relates to the underground facility measurement system using augmented reality based on a ground reference point through UAV shooting which can rapidly collect and measure position information of the underground facility newly installed in a mass development target zone only by the minimum workers and work time.

title_en: Sample collection method using microplastic sampling apparatus
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a sampling method using a microplastic sampling device. The method comprises: a first step where use water is supplied through an inlet pipe; a second step where a foreign substance is filtered; a third step where microplastic is stacked in an upper portion of a microfilter; a fourth step where an inlet electronic valve and a discharge electronic valve are opened; a fifth step where the microplastic is stacked; and a sixth step where the microplastic is sampled.

title_en: System for Waterworks Network Management
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a water supply network management system capable of quickly replacing water supply pipes and bypassing water sources as the water supply pipe network is managed by a control server. Specifically, the water supply network management system includes: a water supply pipe network which supplies water sources for each block of units; a measurement device which is formed in the water supply pipe network, and measures the flow rate and flow amount of the water sources; a control server which communicates with the measurement device and monitors the water supply pipe network; and a control server which is formed in the control server and controls the path of the water source moving in the water supply pipe network.

title_en: Method for improving gnss positioning accuracy based on doppler effect using multi low earth orbit satellites
abstract_en: According to the technical idea of the present disclosure, a positioning method of a terminal using multiple low earth orbit satellites includes the steps of: receiving a signal output from each of a plurality of low earth orbit satellites; defining a positioning model based on a Doppler shift generated with respect to the received signals and a clock error of the terminal; and obtaining a positioning result for the terminal based on a defined model.

title_en: Apparatus for detecting rain using wire mesh sensor
abstract_en: According to an aspect of the present invention, a wire mesh sensor rainfall detector comprises: a wire mesh including a plurality of transmitters and a plurality of receivers; and a fixing part for fixing the wire mesh, wherein the plurality of transmitters supply electricity to the wire mesh. When rainfall is located between a specific transmitter among the plurality of transmitters and a specific receiver among the plurality of receivers, the specific receiver among the plurality of receivers receives electricity from the specific transmitter and transmits the electricity to a measuring part to support the measuring part for measuring conductivity. Thus, the present invention can provide the rainfall detector that can accurately detect rainfall by ensuring that an angle of incidence of rainfall is vertical regardless of the direction of the rainfall.

title_en: System and method of standardization of local event detection capability of seismological observatory
abstract_en: An objective of the present invention is to provide a system and a method for evaluating the local seismic event signal detection capabilities of seismological observatories, which can classify whether seismological observatories detect signals of local seismic events, thereby assessing the local seismic detection capabilities of the seismological observatories and determining the abnormality of the seismic observation equipment. To achieve the objective, the system for evaluating the local seismic event signal detection capabilities of seismological observatories according to the present invention comprises: an earthquake analysis system or an earthquake early warning system which generates observation logs and analysis logs; and an observation server which classifies whether seismological observatories detect signals of local seismic events based on the observation logs and the analysis logs, thereby assessing the local seismic detection capabilities of the seismological observatories and determining the abnormality of the seismic observation equipment.

title_en: Method for providing model recommendation to support air quality forecast
abstract_en: According to the present invention, in a method for proposing a recommendation model for supporting an air quality forecast, disclosed is the method comprising: (a) a step of calculating, by a computing device, the prediction accuracy of each of a plurality of air quality prediction models by utilizing past atmospheric prediction data and past atmospheric observation data; and (b) a step of providing, by the computing device, each of the plurality of air quality prediction models corresponding to a selected specific air pollutant, a specific time period, and a specific forecast area with the corresponding forecast accuracy as a reference, when a selection is inputted for a specific forecast area, which is one among the specific air pollutant, the specific time period, and a plurality of forecast areas.

title_en: the smart illumination energy efficiency monitoring system through the curtain control
abstract_en: The present invention provides a smart lighting energy efficiency monitoring system through curtain control. the smart lighting energy efficiency monitoring system through curtain control comprises: a lighting device capable of adjusting brightness by installing lighting on a ceiling inside a building; a curtain device in which a curtain is installed on a window of the building to adjust a shade; and a control device for storing data on the building, the lighting, and the curtain, storing the movement of the sun and solar radiation data, and controlling the opening and closing of the curtain and the brightness of the lighting with respect to the solar radiation by an algorithm.

title_en: Autonomous driving precision map production system with MMS data
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an autonomous driving precision map manufacturing system and more specifically, relates to a precision road map manufacturing system based on MMS data that guides to become one base station through a satellite communication, in a state wherein a communication network is collapsed due to a natural disaster while enabling automatic generation of a road alignment when manufacturing a high-precision electronic map for an autonomous driving vehicle by a field investigation method by utilizing speech recognition and image information and positioning information photographed around a road, thereby becoming an emergency communication network in case of an emergency situation; and stably and effectively cools a processing module mounted on a module enclosure to prevent deterioration of a mounting module, and is improved to prevent errors or defects generated during processing work in advance through the same.

title_en: Touch Prove
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, a touch probe comprises: a shaft having a central axis (a); a sensor housing forming an accommodation space for accommodating the shaft; a sensor housing cover coupled to cover an opened upper surface of the sensor housing and having an open center so that an upper portion of the shaft is exposed to the outside; a supporter positioned in the accommodation space and disposed below the shaft along the central axis (a) to support rotation of the shaft; and a main spring positioned in the accommodation space and disposed below the supporter along the central axis (a) to elastically support the supporter. Here, the shaft may include a rotating tail extending to protrude downward along the central axis a, and the supporter may include a central groove recessed downward along the central axis a so that the rotating tail is rotatably in contact therewith.

title_en: Method and computer program for Training a Model for Solar Power Generation
abstract_en: The present invention is to overcome the above-described limitations, and an object of the present invention is to improve performance of a prediction model by effectively removing outlier data in learning of the prediction model. The present invention relates to a method for learning a power generation amount prediction model of solar power generation. First data including the maximum power generation amount by date and a cloud amount at a corresponding time point is generated from weather data and power generation amount data, and second data by cloud amount is generated based thereon. After third data is configured by removing outliers, a first model and a second model for predicting a power generation amount by taking a cloud amount as an input are learned, respectively, and a third parameter for determining an outlier criterion is calculated according to a performance comparison result of the two models.

title_en: Car Trunk Control Method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method of controlling a trunk of a vehicle capable of facilitating a user′s trunk control, which prevents trunk control malfunction by verifying that the user controlling the trunk through a smart key is a legitimate user when a user′s trunk control command operation or user′s voice control command registered in advance in a computing device is detected from a radar or voice recognition device, and prevents safety accidents by measuring the distance between obstacles when opening and closing the trunk through the radar.

title_en: Dynamic collar swage conformance checking based on swage tool parameters
abstract_en: Provided are systems and methods for inspecting fastener installation. One embodiment relates to a method for inspecting the installation of a fastener. The method includes the following steps of: determining an initial distance between an inner mold line (IML) of a component and a nose of a swage tool; swaging a collar on a fastener protruding through the IML of the component by operating the swage tool; determining a terminating distance of the nose with respect to the IML during the swaging before a rupture of a pintail of the fastener; and reaching a conclusion indicating the condition of the installation of the fastener based on the terminating distance.

title_en: Imaging system for surface inspection
