abstract_en: The present invention relates to an imaging system and a method thereof, which are able to assess the unevenness or irregularity in a reflective display such as a prefabricated display module in a type found in smartphones and tablet PCs or the like. The system includes polarized light and collimated incoherent light, for instance, a light-emitting diode (LED). The surface to be assessed is vertical to the collimated light, and accordingly, the light collides with the surface straightforwardly. The polarized light of light is changed before and after reflection. The light reflected from the surface under assessment is received by a sensor. The unevenness or the irregularity of the surface will appear in a detected image as a contrast change. The reflection from the surface under assessment is at 180 degrees, so the detected image can have a clear focal point over the whole surface to be assessed. Selectively, the system can use a single collimated lens which does not have a condensing lens for efficiency and closeness.

title_en: Multi gas detection apparatus incluidng infrared pass filter and driving method thereof
abstract_en: According to one embodiment of the present invention, provided is a gas detection device of a non-dispersive infrared method, which comprises: a light source unit radiating light; a plurality of light sensor units extracting light of a specific wavelength from the light to measure a quantity of the light and extracting the light from each different wavelength range; a control unit shifting the wavelength of the light extracted by the light sensor units; and a light sensor unit driving control unit controlling to shift the wavelength of the light extracted by one light sensor unit among the light sensor units when the other light sensor unit among the light sensor units measures the quantity of the light.

title_en: Method of inspection using image masking operation
abstract_en: A defect inspection method using image masking is disclosed. A defect inspection method using image masking according to an embodiment includes an image photographing step of photographing an image of an object disposed on a work bench; a masking processing step of masking a predetermined area of the photographed image; and a defective product classification step of determining whether a product is defective by using an area other than the masked area and classifying the defective product.

title_en: Sensor principle for surface wear
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a textile machine including components (2) coming in contact with a process material (1) and a sensor assembly (5) monitoring wear of the components (2). In general, it is desired to achieve an increase in economic efficiency of textile machines. To this end, the sensor assembly (5) comprises: a sensor element (3) which comes in contact with the process material (1) to be worn through relative movement with respect to the process material (1), wherein the electrical properties of the sensor element (3) are changed through wear; and a device for detecting an electrical characteristic.

title_en: Horizontal rotatable cell jig and secondary battery evaluation apparatus comprising the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a cell jig capable of horizontal rotation and a secondary battery evaluation device including the same, wherein each cell cartridge constituting the cell jig has a structure capable of horizontal rotation, accordingly various electrical connections to the battery cells can be implemented, and temperature behavior or performance evaluation of a secondary battery module can be easily performed.

title_en: Apparatus and method for controlling synchronous generator having initial reactive power adjustment function
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a synchronous generator control apparatus having a function of adjusting initially input reactive power and a method thereof. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the synchronous generator control apparatus having the function of adjusting initially input reactive power comprises: a reference signal adjustment unit for adjusting a reference signal to match a voltage of a synchronous generator and a system voltage; and a reactive power adjustment unit for calculating and providing a reference signal variation for adjusting a terminal voltage of the synchronous generator in addition to the reference signal so that the synchronous generator can adjust reactive power during initial synchronizing.

title_en: A theft-monitoring system for laptop PC using a USB memory stick in which a movement sensor is embedded
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a laptop PC theft prevention system using a movement sensor-embedded USB memory stick. The laptop PC theft monitoring system according to an embodiment of the present invention includes: a laptop PC (100); a USB memory stick (200) connected to the laptop PC (100) and incorporating a movement sensor (212); a system server (300) Internet-communicating with the laptop PC (100); and a smartphone (400) Internet-communicating with the system server (300). In a case where a movement of the laptop PC (100) is detected through the USB memory stick (200), the laptop PC (100) determines that a theft event has occurred and transmits a theft event notification message to the smartphone (400) through the system server (300).

title_en: Voice processing system including voice processing device and terminal
abstract_en: A voice processing system is disclosed. The voice processing system includes a voice processing device and a terminal installed in a vehicle. The voice processing device includes: a microphone configured to generate a voice signal in response to voices uttered at a plurality of sound source locations; a voice processing circuit configured to generate a separated voice signal associated with each of the voices by separating the voice signal on the basis of a sound source location of each of the voices; and a communication circuitry configured to transmit the separated voice signal to the terminal. The terminal includes: a communication unit configured to receive a separated voice signal; a storage unit configured to store source language information indicating a source language and destination language information indicating a destination language for translating voice associated with the separated voice signal; and a control unit configured to, with reference to the storage unit, generate a translation result in which the language of voice corresponding to the separated voice signal is translated from the source language to the destination language.

title_en: Radar signal processing apparatus and method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus and a method for active electronically scanned array-type multi-antenna-based frequency modulated continuous wave radar signal processing. The radar signal processing apparatus according to an embodiment of the present invention includes: a transmission unit transmitting, through an individual transmission antenna, a radar transmission signal adjusted in output and phase by individual transmission antenna; a reception unit generating an individual intermediate frequency signal in which an individual local oscillator signal is synthesized with a radar reception signal in which the radar transmission signal is reflected from a target and received by individual reception antenna; and a control unit generating a waveform using a trigger signal for solving time sharing attributable to separation between the individual transmission antenna and the individual reception antenna, transmitting the waveform to the transmission unit and the reception unit, and detecting the target in accordance with a target angle estimation result generated based on the individual intermediate frequency signal received from the reception unit.

title_en: Multi pressure test device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a multi-pressure test device and, more particularly, to a multi-pressure test device capable of generating pressure necessary for a pressure test of a test target container by using compressed air of an air compressor, selecting a step suitable for a pressure range to be tested by having a plurality of pressure regulators and a step-selection on-off valve, which are capable of decompressing introduced compressed air to a set pressure and outputting the same, and precisely setting an output pressure for each step to perform various pressure tests with one device. According to the present invention, the multi-pressure test device comprises: an air compressor for generating compressed air; an air inlet port connected to the air compressor; a plurality of pressure regulators capable of decompressing and outputting compressed air introduced into the air inlet port to a set pressure; an air exhaust port connected to the test target container to supply the compressed air output from the plurality of pressure regulators to the test target container; and a pressure sensor capable of measuring pressure generated between an output end of the plurality of pressure regulators and the air exhaust port. In addition, the plurality of pressure regulators are provided to independently set each output pressure. Moreover, the multi-pressure test device further comprises: a step-selection on-off valve connected to each output terminal of the plurality of pressure regulators; and a control unit for controlling opening and closing of the step-selection on-off valve so that one pressure regulator among the plurality of pressure regulators can be connected to the air exhaust port.

title_en: Optical inspection device for high speed and high precision alignment using multi-camera
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an optical inspection device for high-speed and high-precision alignment using a multi-camera, and the optical inspection device is capable of aligning and inspecting glass and a fine metal mask (FMM) by simultaneously measuring different points along a height axis using a multi-camera. In detail, alignment marks on a flat glass surface and an FMM surface are measured at the same time by using a multi-camera to check an alignment state, and a position is accurately aligned. Then, the flat glass surface and the FMM surface are in close contact with each other to be deposited, and an alignment state is inspected. According to the present invention, the optical inspection device for high-speed and high-precision alignment using a multi-camera comprises: a light source for generating light; a first beam splitter and a second beam splitter for changing a path direction of the light generated from the light source; an objective lens for condensing and irradiating the light, of which the path has been converted in the first beam splitter and the second beam splitter, to the glass surface and the FMM surface; a wave plate for forming an optical path difference (phase difference) before the light is irradiated to the glass surface and the FMM surface so that each light can be condensed and irradiated; a height measurement unit for measuring heights of the glass surface and the FMM surface in real time; first and second detection units composed of a plurality of cameras or imaging devices for receiving and detecting the light separated through the first beam splitter and the second beam splitter; and a galvanometer for detecting positions of the glass surface and the FMM surface.

title_en: Detecting system for welding-seam of pipe member
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for detecting a pipe welding seam. According to the present invention, the system for detecting a pipe welding seam comprises: a plurality of loading modules loading and lifting up and down a large number of pipe members; and a detection module receiving the pipe members from the loading module, and coming in rolling contact with the pipe members to detect a welding seam of the pipe members. The detection module includes: a detection body having an indented unit provided on the inner side to accommodate the pipe members; a pair of rolling contact rolls arranged in the indented unit to come in rolling contact with the pipe members and having different diameters; a light source transmission unit transmitting a light source towards the pipe members; and a photographing unit photographing the welding seam of the pipe members. According to the present invention, the system for detecting the pipe welding seam allows a large number of pipe members to be loaded and aligned on an inclined mounting block and to enter the detection module, thereby enabling loading of the pipe members in multiple stages; has a simple transfer lifter structure to facilitate alignment for a large-scale inspection; and can perform a precise, reliable vision inspection by using a shading forming surface unit of the light source transmission unit, thereby reducing labor cost, minimizing monitoring errors, and deleting additional rework.

title_en: Method and apparatus for generating solar space satellite observation data
abstract_en: A method and an apparatus for generating solar space satellite observation data are disclosed to generate solar satellite observation data from solar ground observation data generated in the past when there were no satellite observation devices. The method is a method of operating a computing device, comprising the steps of training a data conversion model to generate solar satellite observation data from solar ground observation data, and inputting solar ground observation data measured in the past into the trained data conversion model to generate solar satellite observation data corresponding to the solar ground observation data measured in the past.

title_en: Multi-Wavelength Image Simultaneous Acquisition System
abstract_en: A multi-wavelength image simultaneous acquisition system includes a first optical separation part, a first imaging lens part, a second imaging lens part, and a relay lens part. The first light separation part separates first light, which is one light, from three lights having different wavelength ranges. The first imaging lens part collects the first light to form an image. The second imaging lens part collects the second light and third light separated from the first light to form an image. The relay lens part separates the image formed by the second imaging lens part into the second light and the third light and transmits the images to the second and third image acquisition parts corresponding to the second light and the third light, respectively.

title_en: Stop pawl for horological movement
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a stop pawl (1) for a horological movement (2). The stop pawl (1) for the horological movement (2) at least comprises: a lug (4) for latching engagement with the teeth (50) of a ratchet (5) in the periphery thereof; and a body (3) cooperating with a fixed rod (7) to freely rotate with the fixed rod according to the angular displacement between active and inactive positions at which the body enables the teeth (50) of the ratchet (5) to engage with the lug (4), through intermediate positions. The stop pawl (1) at least comprises one means (9) returning the stop pawl (1) during an angular displacement from the inactive position to the active position. The means (9) and the body (3) are manufactured in pieces. The present invention also relates to a timepiece having such a horological movement (2) as well as the horological movement (2) having such a stop pawl (1). Therefore, the horological movement can be simplified.

title_en: A system and method for real-time tidal current information in a wide area through the analysis of the position movement history of the electronic fishing gear buoy
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and method for observing a real-time flow direction and flow speed in a wide ocean area through an analysis of position movement history of an electronic fishing gear buoy, which are able to analyze a position movement history of a buoy attached to a fishing gear in a wide ocean area (an area where fishers do their work) where fishers do their work by using a fishing gear, observe the tidal current information of the wide ocean area in real time, provide the tidal current information needed for the work to the relevant fishers or a relevant agency, contribute to the maritime safety such as rescuing people when an accident of a ship occurs, transmit the position information of a fishing gear buoy to an inland collection server through a subsidiary communication network by detouring when it is impossible to transmit the position information of the fishing gear buoy through a main communication network, continuously observe the tidal current information of the wide ocean area, observe the flow direction and flow speed and the like in real time in the wide ocean area, apply the accumulated tidal current information of various positions to a seawater flow model, and use the information for making the tidal current and ocean current modeling prediction more elaborate. According to the present invention, the system comprises: an electronic fishing gear buoy, and an inland collection server.

title_en: Pressure sensor being able to measure the pressure though the pressure acts to not sensible region
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a pressure detection material capable of measuring pressure even when a non-pressure detection region is pressed. More specifically, the present invention provides a pressure detection material capable of measuring pressure even when a non-pressure detection region is pressed, in which two pressure detection material unit modules are arranged to face each other in a vertical direction. A first unit module of the two pressure detection material unit modules comprises: a substrate; a conductive layer formed on the substrate and working as an electrode; and a contact layer formed on the conductive layer and working as a detection unit. A second unit module of the two pressure detection material unit modules comprises: a substrate; and a conductive layer formed on the substrate and working as an electrode. The conductive layer is respectively realized in a shape of a plurality of straps parallel to each other on the substrate. The conductive layer is configured to cross in a vertical direction. An elastic transformation layer is additionally attached to the upper side of the substrate pressed by the pressing means among the first unit module and the second unit module. When the pressing means presses the upper side of the elastic transformation layer, even if the lower side of the elastic transformation layer is a region where no pressure detection unit is located, pressure is detected by a pressure detection unit near the region.

title_en: Solar photovoltaic buoyancy apparatus and offshore photovoltaic system
abstract_en: Provided are a solar buoyancy device and marine solar power system that can prevent damage due to changes in the marine environment by adjusting the height of the solar panel according to changes in the marine environment. Among these, the solar buoyancy device may comprise: a floating tank installed on the lower side of a solar panel so that the solar panel floats and provided with an internal space that can accommodate seawater or air; a pump for selectively moving seawater or air into and out of the internal space; a detection sensor which measures the wind direction and speed applied to the solar panel; and a controller which calculates the wind power applied to the solar panel based on information on the measured wind direction and speed, and controls the operation of the pump so that the height of the solar panel is adjusted according to the preset height according to the preset wind power standard that matches the calculated wind power.

title_en: Semiconductor test apparatus with improved edge output structure of timing generator
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present disclosure, a semiconductor test apparatus comprises: a timing generator configured to generate a timing signal; and pin electronics configured to generate a test signal using the timing signal and apply the test signal to a semiconductor device. The timing generator comprises: a first edge generator which outputs a first edge signal by combining a plurality of interleave signals transmitted through a plurality of interleave channels and is set as a transmission channel for the rising waveform of an incoming pulse; a second edge generator which outputs a second edge signal by combining a plurality of interleave signals transmitted through a plurality of interleave channels different from those of the first edge generator and is set as a transmission channel for the falling waveform of the incoming pulse; and a formatter which generates the timing signal based on the first edge signal and the second edge signal.

title_en: A Low concentration hydrogen peroxide detection kit and the low concentration hydrogen peroxide detection method using the same
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kit for detecting a low concentration hydrogen peroxide concentration and a method for detecting a low concentration hydrogen peroxide using the same, wherein the kit for detecting a low concentration hydrogen peroxide concentration has a simple measurement procedure, is economical with simple addition of chemicals, is accurate in measurement, and remarkably increases accuracy of measurement when measuring a low concentration hydrogen peroxide concentration to derive a reliable measurement result. The kit for detecting the low concentration of hydrogen peroxide of the present invention is formed by including a hydroquinone powder (a), an anilpermonic solution (b), and a molybdate solution (c).

title_en: Disinfection robot and controlling method thereof
abstract_en: A quarantine robot may include: a main body provided with a discharge port; a fan provided inside the main body; a fan motor for rotating the fan; a wheel provided under the main body; a wheel motor for rotating the wheel; a three-dimensional camera for photographing a three-dimensional image with a field of view toward the front of the main body; and a processor for controlling the fan motor to rotate the fan to discharge air through the discharge port, and controlling the wheel motor to rotate the wheel to move the main body based on the three-dimensional image.

title_en: A Remote Type of a System for a Meter Reading Based on an Image
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an image-based remote water meter reading system. An image-based remote water meter reading system comprises: an image meter reading module (11a) which obtains an image (im) of metering information of a water meter; a communication means (13) which transmits information obtained by the image meter reading module (11a); and a cloud server (14) which stores image information transmitted from the communication means (13) and processed.

title_en: Product inspection apparatus
abstract_en: The present invention provides a product inspection device which is advantageous for precise inspection of a plurality of targets of a chip product. A first illumination device (11) emits a first inspection light in a direction forming a first angle (θ1) with respect to a straight line (Lv), and a second illumination device (12) emits a second inspection light having a wavelength different from the first inspection light in a direction forming a second angle (θ2) greater than the first angle (θ1) with respect to the straight line (Lv). An imaging device (13) acquires an image of a chip product (Ｑ) irradiated by the first inspection light and the second inspection light. An image processing unit (14) performs image processing to detect a state of the chip device (W) based on an image component of the first inspection light in the acquired image, detect a state of the carrier tape (7) based on an image component of the second inspection light in the acquired image, and detect a state of at least a portion of the top tape (17) based on both an image component of the first inspection light and an image component of the second inspection light in the acquired image.

title_en: Suitability evaluation method for negative electrode active material
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for evaluating a negative electrode active material for a lithium secondary battery and a negative electrode for a lithium secondary battery including a negative electrode active material determined to be suitable according to the same. the evaluation method quantifies the degree of side reactions of a negative electrode active layer that may occur after activation in a non-destructive manner, so that the material suitability of the negative electrode active material included in the secondary battery can be determined with high reliability. the determined negative electrode active material has excellent high-temperature stability and excellent lifespan characteristics when applied to the negative electrode.

title_en: Map-aided inertial odometry with neural network for augmented reality devices
abstract_en: The present invention solves the problem that the battery supplying power to AR smart glasses may be quickly consumed. A method comprises the steps of: receiving inertial measurement unit (IMU) data from an IMU; receiving image data representing an image of a scene at a location; generating first 6-degrees of freedom pose data of the IMU based on the image data and a map around the location; generating second 6-degrees of freedom pose data of the IMU; and generating modified 6-degrees of freedom pose data.

title_en: System for inspecting defect of solid electrolyte sheet
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a solid electrolyte sheet defect inspection system (1) and, more specifically, to a solid electrolyte sheet defect inspection system (1) which inspects defects of a solid electrolyte sheet (s) through laser beam excitation and prevents contamination of an inspection unit (30) from contaminants such as outgassing emitted from the solid electrolyte sheet (s).

title_en: Reliability test system capable of simultaneous complex test and the method thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a reliability inspection system and method for verifying the quality and reliability of manufactured items and raw materials by performing four complex tests: a maximum withstand pressure test, a test of pressure performance variation depending on temperature, a test of repeated opening and closing, and a test of flow rate variation depending on the degree of opening and closing. The reliability inspection system capable of simultaneous complex testing comprises: a test control unit that controls the simultaneous execution of at least one of the following complex tests on a manufactured item: a maximum withstand pressure test, a test of pressure performance variation depending on temperature, a test of repeated opening and closing, and a test of flow rate variation depending on the degree of opening and closing; and a result processing unit that verifies the quality and reliability of the manufactured item and raw materials by checking at least one of the temperature, flow rate, flow velocity, and pressure from the complex tests.

title_en: Apparatus and method for calibrating lidar sensor
abstract_en: According to the present invention, an apparatus for calibration of a lidar sensor comprises: a chart unit configured to form a chart by irradiation of light; a frame unit including a base to be supported on a front bottom surface of the chart unit; a motion unit supported on the base to fix a lidar sensor to be inspected, wherein the lidar sensor is configured to be movable in a multi-axis direction; and a control unit installed in the frame unit and formed to control the chart unit and the motion unit.

title_en: Method and apparatus for providing radiation meteorological information service
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method and an apparatus for providing a radiant weather information service. The method for providing a radiant weather information service comprises the steps of: generating a first radiant transfer model based on a first parametric method; generating a second parametric method corresponding to a short wave and a long wave based on the first parametric method; generating a second radiant transfer model based on the second parametric method; and displaying a comparison result of the first radiant transfer model and the second radiant transfer model.

title_en: Noise reduction system using wave plates and PBS in wavelength combination microscopy
abstract_en: An object of the present invention is to provide a noise reduction system using a wave plate and a polarization beam splitter in a wavelength combination microscope that reduces noise by adjusting polarization so that only light reflected from a sample and light reflected from a mirror of a reference end can travel toward a camera. In order to achieve the above object, the present invention includes: a first light source unit which generates and outputs first light of a first wavelength; a first half wave plate and a first polarization beam splitter which divide the light output from the first light source unit into horizontally polarized light and vertically polarized light; a third half wave plate which converts the vertically polarized first reference end light into horizontally polarized light; a second quarter wave plate which is located at the front end of an objective lens and converts light incident on and emitted from the objective lens as horizontally polarized light into vertically polarized light; and a fourth polarization beam splitter which advances the converted vertically polarized light to a camera.

title_en: Magnet defect detection system
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, a magnet defect detection system capable of automatically detecting whether a magnet is defective comprises: a conveyor belt for moving a magnet; a magnetic viewer in contact with the magnet to display a magnetic force line of the magnet; a contact frame disposed on an upper side of the conveyor belt and on which the magnetic viewer is installed; a lifting device for lowering the contact frame to a predetermined height when the magnet is positioned below the contact frame; a photographing unit installed on an upper side of the magnetic viewer and generating a magnetic viewer image by photographing the magnetic viewer when the magnetic viewer is in contact with the magnet; and a control unit for detecting whether the magnet is defective using the magnetic viewer image.

title_en: Method for determining state of health
abstract_en: According to some embodiments of the present disclosure, disclosed is a method for determining a state of health (soh) performed by a computing device including at least one processor. The method for determining the soh may include determining a first state of charge (soc) of a target battery; performing charging or discharging of the target battery for a first time period based on a comparison result obtained by comparing the first soc with a preset value; measuring an open circuit voltage (ocv) of the target battery for a second time period after the charging or discharging is performed; determining a second soc based on the measured ocv; and determining the soh based on a first change amount between the first soc and the second soc.

title_en: Testing apparatus and testing method
abstract_en: According to an embodiment disclosed in the present document, a test apparatus comprises: a voltage applying unit applying a first voltage and a surge voltage to a relay of a battery; a voltage obtaining unit obtaining a second voltage applied to both ends of the relay in response to an input of the first voltage; a voltage detecting unit detecting a transient section indicating a transient state of the second voltage; and a controller controlling the voltage applying unit to apply the surge voltage in the transient section.

title_en: Geometric error analysis method, system, equipment and storage medium of five-axis machine tool
abstract_en: Based on the neighboring low-order body relationship and the coordinate system of each axis, construct a kinematic orthogonal solution model; substitute the initial position of each axis into the kinematic orthogonal solution model to obtain the corresponding theoretical angular transformation of each axis, and according to the theoretical angular transformation determine the theoretical trajectory of the corresponding axis; and collect the error between each axis and the theoretical trajectory at a plurality of positions when it is in use, so as to determine the geometric error of each axis. The present invention solves the problem that the traditional error analysis in the existing technology relies on complex sensor arrangement and expensive equipment, and it is difficult to realize efficient and accurate geometric error analysis in the actual production.

title_en: Downhole 3-phase flow measurement using speed of sound above and below the bubble-point pressure
abstract_en: Methods and apparatus for hydrocarbon monitoring are provided. An example method (e.g., performed by a monitoring system) includes receiving one or more first downhole measurements including a first speed of sound (SoS) measurement of a flowing fluid at a first location. A pressure of the flowing fluid at the first location is greater than a bubble-point pressure of the flowing fluid. One or more second downhole measurements including a second SoS measurement of the flowing fluid at a second location are received. A pressure of the flowing fluid at the second location is less than the bubble-point pressure of the flowing fluid, and the flowing fluid is a 3-phase fluid mixture at the second location. One or more phase flow rates of the 3-phase fluid mixture are calculated based on the first SoS measurement, the second SoS measurement, and a measurement of a bulk velocity of the flowing fluid.

title_en: Method and device for inspecting glass containers according to at least two modes with a view to classifying the containers by their glass defects
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for inspecting glass containers (2), comprising the following steps of: - inspecting each container using an inspection system (10) with a view to obtaining at least one analysis image according to a first mode corresponding to an absorption image (Ia), and at least one analysis image according to a second mode corresponding to a birefringence image (Ib) or to a refraction image (Ir), - defining a list of classes (D1, D2, ..., Dk, ..., Dp) including at least glass defects, - matching at least some of the analysis images according to the first mode and according to the second mode, - from at least one analysis image according to the first mode and at least one analysis image according to the second mode that have been matched, classifying the analysis images by means of an image classifier (Cl) which determines what result class from the list of classes they belong to, the image classifier having been trained by supervised learning, - classifying the container according to the result class.

title_en: Conductivity sensor with void correction
abstract_en: Systems and methods can be used for correcting for the presence of voids in a fluid when measuring the conductivity thereof. The conductivity of a fluid can be measured using a conductivity sensor. Capacitance electrodes can be used to measure the capacitance of the fluid. The measured capacitance affected by the fluid can be used in combination with the measured conductivity to determine a corrected conductivity value that compensates for possible voids in the fluid. Other parameters, such as the makeup or temperature of the fluid can be used in determining the corrected conductivity measurement. Some such systems include an annular housing and can be inserted or integrated into fluid flow systems so that fluid to be analyzed flows through an aperture defined by the annular housing.

title_en: Tracking aggregation and alignment
abstract_en: Systems and methods are disclosed that provide contextual tracking information to tracking sensor systems to provide accurate and efficient object tracking. Contextual data of a first tracking sensor system (204) is used to identify a tracked object of a second tracking sensor system (210). The most suitable drawing: FIG. 1.

title_en: Method and related apparatuses for analysing a target region beneath a surface of the earth
abstract_en: A method for determining one or more ground properties of a target region beneath a surface of the earth, the method comprising: receiving a data set, the data set comprising: a first response signal, the first response signal indicative of the ambient noise measured at or near the surface by a first receiver arranged at a first location; and a second response signal, the second response signal indicative of the ambient noise measured at or near the surface by a second receiver arranged at a second location, wherein the first and second locations are different; processing the first and second response signals; cross-correlating the processed first response signal with the processed second response signal; and performing tomographic inversion using the cross-correlated response signals to generate a two- dimensional ‘2D’ or three-dimensional ‘3D’ model of the target region in terms of the one or more ground properties.

title_en: Apparatus for controlling an overhead power transmission line disconnector with a remote control function
abstract_en:
FIELD: electrical equipment. 
     SUBSTANCE: invention relates to electrical equipment, in particular to apparatuses intended for providing the operation of high-voltage overhead power transmission lines. The technical result is achieved by the fact that the remote-controlled apparatus for controlling a power transmission line disconnector, containing a drive control module including a controller of the electric drive of the mechanical power transmission line disconnector, a microprocessor information collection and transmission controller, a manual control element unit, a system status display unit and a unit for receiving and transmitting control commands via a GSM wireless communication channel, as well as external sensors of the emergency process on the line, including a microprocessor control unit, a current sensor, a voltage sensor and a battery power supply unit, is characterised by the fact that the microprocessor information collection and transmission controller and the manual control element unit are connected with the controller of the electric drive of the disconnector through a unit for blocking disconnection under load. 
     EFFECT: increasing the operating life of overhead power transmission line disconnectors. 
     1 cl, 1 dwg

title_en: Method for continuous measurement of mass fraction of impurities and flow analyzer of impurities in oil and petroleum products
abstract_en:
FIELD: oil industry; oil refining industry.  
     SUBSTANCE: invention can be used for the analysis of the content of impurities in oil and petroleum products with a flow-through impurity analyzer. The essence of the invention is that for the analyzed medium, a sample of oil and petroleum products, radiation from the X-ray source is directed, spatially separating the radiation from the X-ray source into the radiation stream directed through the X-ray fluorescence channel and the radiation stream directed through the X-ray adsorption channel, while the primary radiation in the X-ray fluorescence channel excites the fluorescence of impurity elements in oil and petroleum products, which is recorded using the X-ray fluorescence channel radiation detector, and the radiation passed through the X-ray adsorption channel is recorded using X-ray absorption channel detector, the electrical signals received from the detectors are processed, according to which the composition and amount of impurities are judged.  
     EFFECT: ensuring the possibility of continuous monitoring of the content of sulfur and other impurity elements at high pressure in the flow of oil and petroleum products.  
     7 cl, 1 dwg

title_en: A method and control arrangement for measuring a current flowing through a battery unit
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for estimating the resistance of a shunt resistor (502) in an electric energy storage system (500) comprising an electric energy storage (501). A current (I) flows through the electric energy storage (501) and the shunt resistor (502) when powering a load. The method comprises:providing a measurement current ( Imeas ) through a reference resistor ( Rref), the measurement current (Imeas) flowing also through the shunt resistor (502);measuring a voltage drop over the shunt resistor (502) resulting from the measurement current (Imeas);measuring a voltage drop over the reference resistor {Rref) resulting from the measurement current (Imeas)\ andestimating a resistance (Rshunt) of the shunt resistor (502) utilizing the measured voltage drop over the shunt resistor (502), the measured voltage drop over the reference resistor ( Rref ) and the resistance of the reference resistor ( Rref ).

title_en: Substrate processing apparatus and non-transitory computer-readable recording medium
abstract_en: Described herein is a technique capable of adjusting an inner pressure of a process chamber into a high vacuum state in a short time. According to one aspect of the technique, there is provided a substrate processing apparatus including: a process chamber; a main exhaust line including a first pipe, a first opening degree adjusting valve, an opening/closing valve and a pressure sensor; a bypass exhaust line including a second pipe and a second opening degree adjusting valve; and a controller configured to adjust an inner pressure of the process chamber by: (a) adjusting an opening degree of the second opening degree adjusting valve; (b) closing the second opening degree adjusting valve and opening the opening/closing valve and the first opening degree adjusting valve; and (c) closing the opening/closing valve and the first opening degree adjusting valve and adjusting the opening degree of the second opening degree adjusting valve.

title_en: The present invention relates to a semiconductor test socket of a hybrid coaxial structure and a manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a semiconductor test socket of a hybrid coaxial structure and a manufacturing method thereof. The test socket includes a test socket locating plate, an insulation test socket body, a built-in conductive socket body, a built-in conductive socket cover, and an insulation test socket cover. The test socket locating plate, the insulation test socket body, and the insulation test socket cover are sequentially disposed from top to bottom. An opening is provided on the insulation test socket body. The built-in conductive socket body and the built-in conductive socket cover are disposed in the opening. In the present invention, relatively good inter-channel isolation is achieved by using the coaxial structure made of conductive metal, thereby greatly reducing manufacturing costs and a production period of the test socket. In addition, an insertion loss of - 1 Db/40 GHz and a return loss of - 10 dB/40 GHz can be achieved for high-frequency signals, and the inter-channel isolation exceeds - 40 dB/20 GHz.

title_en: Assembly, pressure measurement sheet set, sheet
abstract_en: The present invention provides: an assembly having a sheet that has a layer including coloring-agent-containing microcapsules wound about a winding core, the assembly being such that breakage of the microcapsules is suppressed even when an impact due to falling is imparted; a pressure measurement sheet set; and a sheet. This assembly has a winding core, and a roll of a long first sheet formed so that the first sheet is wound on the winding core, the assembly being such that: the first sheet has a long resin substrate, and a first layer including coloring-agent-containing microcapsules positioned on the resin substrate; and the width-direction rigidity of the first sheet is 150 mN or higher.

title_en: Monolithic electronic device
abstract_en: A method of forming and testing a plurality of monolithic electronic devices is provided. As part of the method a monolithic device array comprising Group III-nitrides is formed on a sacrificial substrate. A test substrate comprising electrical contacts is aligned with electrical contacts of the monolithic device array and bonded to the monolithic device array via bonding dielectric layers. Power is supplied from the test substrate to test the monolithic devices of the monolithic device array. Portions of the sacrificial substrate are then selectively removed to separate each of the monolithic electronic devices, wherein a sacrificial dielectric layer is removed to separate each monolithic electronic device from the test substrate.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle tour guide positioning system capable of achieving comprehensive and safe tour navigation service
abstract_en: The present invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) tour guide positioning system, which includes a tour guide service-end control module, at least one tour guide assisting UAV, and a plurality of tourist user-end control modules. The tour guide service-end control module includes a navigation service control module and a tourist search control module. The navigation service control module controls the tour guide assisting UAV to fly according to a guide flight path, controls the UAV to capture scenic spot images, controls the UAV to broadcast the scenic spot images and scenic spot guide introduction content information, and simultaneously controls the UAV to perform detection and searching and determines whether any tourist is lost. The tourist user-end control module is provided for a tourist to use. The tourist user-end control module is used to receive the scenic spot images and the scenic spot guide introduction content information broadcasted by the tour guide service-end control module while controlling transmission of the tourist identity information for allowing the navigation service control module and the tourist search control module to carry out detection and search, so as to achieve the purpose of comprehensive and safe tour navigation service.

title_en: Distributed depth data processing
abstract_en: Examples are provided that relate to processing depth camera data over a distributed computing system, where phase unwrapping is performed prior to denoising. One example provides a time-of-flight camera comprising a time-of-flight depth image sensor, a logic machine, a communication subsystem, and a storage machine holding instructions executable by the logic machine to process time-of-flight image data acquired by the time-of-flight depth image sensor by, prior to denoising, performing phase unwrapping pixel-wise on the time-of-flight image data to obtain coarse depth image data comprising depth values; and send the coarse depth image data and the active brightness image data to a remote computing system via the communication subsystem for denoising.

title_en: Method for measuring angle of arrival with phased array
abstract_en: The disclosure is directed to a method for measuring an angle of arrival (AoA), with a steerable phased array. The method would include but not limited to: receiving a signal by the steerable phased array with a first steering angle and with a second steering angle; obtaining a first power-related information (PRI1) of the signal corresponding to the first steering angle; obtaining a second power-related information (PRI2) of the signal corresponding to the second steering angle; and calculating an AoA of the signal based on the first power-related information and the second power-related information, wherein the first steering angle is different from the second steering angle, and an absolute difference between the first steering angle and the second steering angle is less than FNBW/2.

title_en: Torque sensor for an ebike system
abstract_en: A torque sensor for a bicycle includes a coil. The torque sensor may include a support that is disposable around a device of the bicycle, such that the support and the device of the bicycle are separated by an air gap. The torque sensor may also include an excitation coil supported by the support, and a sense coil supported by the support at a distance away from the excitation coil in an axial direction of the support. The excitation coil is configured to induce a voltage and/or current in the sense coil via the device of the bicycle when the support is disposed around the device of the bicycle. The induced voltage is related to a torque in the device.

title_en: Substrate cassette handling apparatus, substrate processing apparatus, substrate processing method, method of manufacturing semiconductor device and program
abstract_en: To improve an accuracy of detecting whether an orientation of a substrate is correct, there is provided a technique that includes: a stage where a cassette accommodating substrates is placed, wherein the substrates are provided with orientation indicators; a reflector provided at a first end of an optical path set to enable a light to pass therethrough without hitting the substrates when the orientation indicators of the substrates are oriented in a predetermined direction; a robot configured to transfer the cassette between the stage and a shelf, and including a reflective optical sensor configured to emit the light along the optical path and to detect the light reflected from the reflector; and a controller controlling the robot to move the reflective optical sensor to a position corresponding to the optical path when checking whether the orientation indicators of the substrates on the stage are aligned in the predetermined direction.

title_en: Kit for detecting detection target substance, and detection method
abstract_en: Disclosed is a kit for detecting a detection target substance, said kit comprising: a plasmon resonance chip; a first protein that specifically binds to the detection target substance; and a second protein that specifically binds to the detection target substance, wherein the plasmon resonance chip is provided with a substrate, a metallic particle aggregate layer that is formed on the substrate, and a protective layer that covers the metallic particle aggregate layer. Also disclosed is a detection method for a detection target substance which uses said kit.

title_en: Stationary ergometric exercise device, method of oprating stationary ergometric exercise device, and computer program product
abstract_en:
A stationary ergometric exercise device (10) comprises a foot-operable drive including alternately operable drive elements in the form of foot-driven pedals (18) mounted via pedal cranks (20) to opposite sides of a drive wheel (22). A flywheel (24) is coupled to the drive wheel (22) via a gear mechanism (26), the flywheel including a magnetic rim (38). The exercise device (10) includes a brake device (40) in the form of one or more permanent magnets (44a,44b) mounted for movement by means of a motor (42) towards and away from the magnetic rim (38) of the flywheel (24) so as to selectively adjust a braking force applied to the flywheel (24) by means of the or each permanent magnet (44a,44b). 
 
     A measuring unit (58) is provided for measuring, in use, at least one of drive force applied via the drive and the torque related to it, together with a measuring device (66) for measuring, in use, cadence. 
 
     A command module (72) is connected to the measuring unit (58), the measuring device (66) and the motor (42) of the brake device (40), and a communications module (74) is connected to the command module (72) and configured to receive command signals and transmit those command signals to the command module (72) and configured to transmit feedback signals received from the command module (72) reporting user performance. 
 
     The command module (72) is configured to receive measurements from the measuring unit (58) and the measuring device (66) and to use those measurements to calculate one or more performance parameters and to compare the or each performance parameter against a predetermined performance profile. The command module (72) is also configured to control the motor (42) so as to move the or each permanent magnet (44a,44b) relative to the magnetic rim (38) of the flywheel (24) in order to adjust the braking force applied by the or each permanent magnet (44a,44b) and thereby tune the measurements received from the measuring unit (58) and the measuring device (66) so as to adjust the or each performance parameter calculated by the command module (72) to conform with the predetermined performance profile.

title_en: Measurement system and method
abstract_en:
Methods and systems for performing optical measurements of the porosity of geometric structures filled with a fill material by a capillary condensation process are presented herein. Measurements are performed while the structure under measurement is treated with a flow of purge gas that includes a controlled amount of vaporized fill material. A portion of the fill material condenses and fills openings in the structural 
features such as pores of a planar film, spaces between structural features, small volumes such as notches, trenches, slits, contact holes, etc. In one aspect, the desired degree of saturation of vaporized material in the gaseous flow is determined based on the maximum feature size to be filled. In another aspect, measurement data is collected when a structure is unfilled and when the structure is filled. The collected data is combined in a multi-target model based measurement to estimate values of porosity and critical dimensions.

title_en: Single-phase and two-wire smart meter
abstract_en:
The present invention relates to a single-phase and two-wire smart meter. A receiver is raised from a casing to receive a communication module therein. The receiver has a cover to cover an opening thereof. A waterproof tape is between the opening and the cover and a sealing assembly is used for a sealing task. The lead sealing assembly has a screw, a positioning element and a lead sealing element. The cover is screwed to the receiver by the screw. The positioning element is on a screwing path of the screw and a channel is formed through the screw. When a thickness of the waterproof tape achieves a sealing thickness, the channel aligns a positioning slot formed on the cover so the lead sealing element passes through the 
positioning slot and the channel and then securely locked. Therefore, the lead sealing assembly of the present invention has locking function, waterproof confirmation, and lead sealing function.

title_en: Correction method for 2d vision measurement with large fov
abstract_en: A correction method for 2D vision measurement with a large field of view is provided. The method includes a preparation step, a full-area calibration step, a remapping step, a partial-area calibration step, a world coordinate conversion step, and a measurement step. The full-area calibration step and the partial-area calibration step are used to calibrate and output an actual error distribution map and a system standard deviation, so as to improve a measurement accuracy after a system calibration.

title_en: Solid-state lidar device
abstract_en: The present invention provides a solid-state lider device, which includes a emitting module and a receiving module. The emitting module includes a laser driver and an light emitting source. The laser driver is used to drive the light emitting source to emit a light signal. The laser driver is a high electron mobility transistor, and the light emitting source includes at least one laser diode. The receiving module is used to receive the light signal to be reflected and generate an output signal according to the light signal, and the receiving module includes an avalanche photodiode. The avalanche photodiode includes a lead sulfide quantum dot colloid layer, and the lead sulfide quantum dot colloid layer is arranged on a reflection path of the light signal received by the avalanche photodiode.

title_en: Distance monitoring method, apparatus, system and medium based on object
abstract_en:
The application discloses a distance monitoring method, apparatus, system 
and medium based an object. The method comprise: determining a target body region of the object to be monitored in an infrared thermal image based on a color temperature of an acquired infrared thermal image; receiving echo signal information directed at a place near a target detection point in the object to be monitored. The target detection point is a center point of a target axis in the target body region of the object to be monitored. The echo signal information is information directed at the 
echo signal corresponding to a radar signal emitted in the place near the target detection point; determining relative distance information of the target object to be monitored based on the echo signal information. An alarm signal is generated for early warning processing when the relative distance information does not meet with the predetermined distance information. The method is capable of realizing the determination of the relative distance information of the target object to be monitored, thereby improving the accuracy of the monitoring results and reducing the security risks on the basis of crowds trampling preventing monitoring.

title_en: Method and apparatus to mitigate evaporation in high throughput measurements
abstract_en: A method and apparatus are disclosed for the collection of light scattered from a liquid sample contained within a multiwell plate for which evaporation from the wells is mitigated by the application of a barrier between the liquid sample and the environment. A vertical thermal gradient is applied across the vessel so that condensation is inhibited from forming on the interior surface of the barrier, thus permitting clear illumination of the sample for visual imaging, fluorescence studies and light scattering detection.

title_en: User identification via motion and heartbeat waveform data
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to methods, devices, and systems to identify a user of a wearable fitness monitor using data obtained using the wearable fitness monitor. Data obtained from motion sensors of the wearable fitness monitor and data obtained from heartbeat waveform sensors of the wearable fitness monitor may be used to identify the user.

title_en: Bio/chemical assay devices and methods for simplified steps, small samples, accelerated speed, and ease-of-use
abstract_en: The present invention is related to the field of bio/chemical sampling, sensing, assays and applications. Particularly, the present invention is related to how to make the sampling/sensing/assay become simple to use, fast to results, highly sensitive, easy to use, using tiny sample volume (e.g. 0.5 uL or less), operated by a person without any professionals, reading by mobile-phone, or low cost, or a combination of them.

title_en: Utilizing a geo-locator service and zone servers to reduce computer resource requirements for determining high quality solutions to routing problems
abstract_en: A method involves utilizing a geo-locator service and zone servers to reduce server resource requirements for determining high quality solutions to routing problems. The use of a geo-locator service and zone servers enables the use of servers having less memory which can handle determination of high quality solutions to routing problems involving locations spanning a smaller geographic area even if they are incapable of handling determination of high quality solutions to routing problems involving locations spanning a larger geographic area, and enables efficient assignment of requests to an appropriate server without unduly burdening high value servers having sufficient memory to handle determination of high quality solutions to routing problems involving locations spanning a very large geographic area with determination of high quality solutions to routing problems involving locations spanning a smaller geographic area.

title_en: Stress-managed specialty fiber for sensory application
abstract_en: Embodiments describe an optical fiber that includes a core. The core has high compressive stress. The compressive stress of the core is in a range of about 20 to 60 MPa. The optical fiber further includes a cladding. The cladding is divided into a first cladding layer and a second cladding layer. The second cladding layer has a high residual stress. The high residual stress of the second cladding layer is in a range of about 20 to 60 MPa. The optical fiber enables reduction of particle related breaks. Further, the optical fiber has elevated LLT strength. The LLT strength is about 6 Kg. The optical fiber has high proof test yield. Furthermore, the optical fiber is highly sensitive to micro-bending of the optical fiber.

title_en: Electric vehicle
abstract_en: The electric vehicle includes a first battery, a second battery having an output weight density higher than that of the first battery and an energy weight density lower than that of the first battery, a motor generator, an electric power conversion circuit, and a control device for controlling the electric power conversion circuit. The control device controls the electric power conversion circuit so that, during a powering operation of the motor generator, at least a part of electric power necessary for changing a vehicle speed among requested electric power is discharged from the second battery, and remaining electric power obtained by subtracting the electric power discharged from the second battery from the requested electric power is discharged from the first battery; and it controls the electric power conversion circuit so that, during a regenerative operation of the motor generator, electric power generated is charged to the second battery.

title_en: Software simulation method for estimating fluid positions and pressures in the wellbore for a dual gradient cementing system
abstract_en: A dual gradient cementing system is modeled in a modeled subsea wellbore. The modeled dual gradient cementing system comprises a plurality of components including a mud lift pump (MLP) coupling a subsea rotating device (SRD) to a surface mud return line, wherein the MLP is located at a subsea depth and the SRD diverts annular fluids from an annulus away from a riser. The modeled dual gradient cementing system is simulated in operation, wherein a fluid loss value of  100 % at the subsea depth of the MLP is assumed, and a fluid property of a simulated non-static fluid in the simulated dual gradient cementing system while in operation is estimated. Thereafter, an actual dual gradient cementing operation is performed in an actual subsea wellbore, wherein an actual non-static fluid corresponding to the simulated non-static fluid exhibits the fluid property.

title_en: Adaptive geographical data caching based on a route pattern
abstract_en: Various embodiments partition map data into discrete portions of map data based on predetermined boundaries, and individual map data portions (e.g., shards) are assigned to individual computing nodes in a plurality of computing nodes that service geographic routing requests. A routing component associated with the plurality of computing nodes directs the geographic routing request to one or more computing nodes. The computing nodes adaptively cache geographical map data based on, for example, data relating to past geographic routes. Once cached at a computing node in a plurality of computing nodes, the computing node services current and future geographic routing requests using its assigned portion of map data and one or more portions of map data adaptively cached at the computing node, thereby reducing chances of more than one computing node getting involved in servicing a request.

title_en: Photoacoustic measurement device and method
abstract_en: An acoustic wave detector detects photoacoustic waves generated by absorbing measurement light emitted toward a subject, and reflected acoustic waves with respect to acoustic waves transmitted toward the subject. A preamplifier amplifies a detection signal output by the acoustic wave detector. A bypass unit is intended to output the detection signal without passing through the preamplifier. Controller causes the preamplifier to enter an operating state and selects a first path along which the detection signal is amplified by the preamplifier and then is input to the reception circuit as a signal path in a case where the photoacoustic waves are detected. The controller stops an amplification operation in the preamplifier and selects a second path along which the detection signal is input to the reception circuit via a bypass unit as the signal path in a case where reflected acoustic waves are detected.

title_en: Hermetic sealed beam projector module and method for manufacturing the same
abstract_en: An embodiment provides a beam projector module including: a light source configured to output light; a substrate configured to support the light source; an optical device configured to reduce the light in terms of intensity output to a predetermined space; a frame configured to separate the optical device from the light source by a predetermined distance; an optical substrate configured to attach the optical device thereto and to define a sealed space with the substrate and the frame, the sealed space having internal pressure lower than pressure outside the sealed space; a sensor configured to measure a state of the sealed space; and a processor configured to change an operation mode of the light source depending on a measured value of the sensor.

title_en: Use of wavelet cross-correlation for virtual source denoising
abstract_en: Seismic shot gather data is received from a computer data store for processing. The received seismic shot gather data is separated into downgoing and upgoing wavefields, a time-frequency-wavenumber (t-f-k) three-dimensional (3D) data cube comprising multiple time-frequency (t-f) slices is formed. The downgoing wavefields are wavelet transformed from a time (t) domain to a t-f domain and the upgoing wavefields are wavelet transformed from the t domain to the t-f domain. A wavelet cross-correlation is performed between the downgoing wavefields in the t-f domain and the upgoing wavefields in a t-f-k domain to generate wavelet cross-correlated data. Soft-threshold filtering if performed for each t-f slice of the t-f-k 3D data cube. An inverse wavelet transform is performed to bring wavelet cross-correlated data from the t-f-k domain to a time-receiver (t-x) domain. All seismic shots of the received seismic shot gather data are looped over and the wavelet cross-correlated data is stacked as a virtual source gather.

title_en: Wireless mechanism for detecting an open or closed container, and methods of making and using the same
abstract_en: An electronic device including a continuity sensor and electrical circuitry configured to detect and report the continuity state of an article, container or product packaging is disclosed. The continuity sensor includes a first substrate with first and second coils thereon, and a second substrate with a third coil thereon. The first coil has an integrated circuit electrically connected thereto. The first substrate is part of, or is attached or secured to a part of the article, container or packaging. The second substrate is another part of, or is attached or secured to another part of the article, container or packaging. One of the article, container or packaging parts is (re)movable with respect to the other part. The first and second coils have one coupling when the article, container or packaging is closed or sealed, and a different coupling when the article, container or packaging is open or unsealed.

title_en: Semiconductor sensor structure
abstract_en: A semiconductor sensor structure is provided which has a top side and a bottom side and includes a first semiconductor wafer, a second semiconductor wafer, and an insulating layer. The second semiconductor wafer includes a substrate layer having an integrated circuit, formed on the front side, with at least one metal terminal contact formed on the front side. The front side of the second semiconductor wafer and a front side of the first semiconductor wafer are each formed on the insulating layer. The first semiconductor wafer has a semiconductor layer with a three-dimensional Hall sensor structure having a sensor area formed of a monolithic semiconductor body and extending from the backside to the front side of the semiconductor layer. At least three mutually spaced apart first metal terminal contacts are on the front side and at least three mutually spaced apart second metal terminal contacts are on the backside.

title_en: IC test architecture having differential data input and output buffers
abstract_en: Testing of integrated circuits is achieved by a test architecture utilizing a scan frame input shift register, a scan frame output shift register, a test controller, and a test interface comprising a scan input, a scan clock, a test enable, and a scan output. Scan frames input to the scan frame input shift register contain a test stimulus data section and a test command section. Scan frames output from the scan frame output shift register contain a test response data section and, optionally, a section for outputting other data. The command section of the input scan frame controls the test architecture to execute a desired test operation.

title_en: Method for making blackbody radiation source
abstract_en: A method for making blackbody radiation source is provided. A blackbody radiation cavity and a carbon nanotube array located on a substrate are provided. A black lacquer layer is coated on an inner surface of the blackbody radiation cavity. A pressure is applied to the carbon nanotube array to form a carbon nanotube paper. The carbon nanotube paper is placed on the black lacquer layer. The substrate is peeled off to make the carbon nanotube paper bond to the black lacquer layer. An adhesive tape is placed on the carbon nanotube paper. And then the adhesive tape peeling off to separate carbon nanotubes in the carbon nanotube paper from the adhesive tape and bond to the black lacquer layer, the carbon nanotubes vertically aligned and forms the carbon nanotube array.

title_en: Capacitive sensor for respiratory monitoring
abstract_en: A system is provided for monitoring a patient on an air support system. The system comprises a capacitive sensor system having a capacitive sensor positioned at the underside of an air filled mattress, and a respiration signal processing module that receives the output of the capacitive sensor system and is configured to monitor patient respiration. Respiration is monitored by: periodically sampling the capacitive sensor system output to obtain measurements of incremental body displacement; analyzing a plurality of the samples to determine one or more values for parameters of patient respiratory rate; and determining when one or more of the parameter values indicate abnormal respiration. A corresponding method and computer program are also provided.

title_en: Semiconductor device
abstract_en: A semiconductor device includes: a test transistor which is formed over a substrate; a test pattern structure which is formed in an upper portion of the substrate to be spaced apart from the test transistor; and a protection transistor which is positioned between the test pattern structure and the test transistor.

title_en: Systems and methods for providing uninterrupted media content during vehicle navigation
abstract_en: Systems and methods are disclosed herein for selecting alternate routes with fewer directions during vehicle navigation. The disclosed techniques herein determine directions from route data and direction timestamps for each of the directions. For each direction, a corresponding media asset from media assets in a playlist having a media asset duration that matches a direction duration is determined. The direction duration is the time difference between the direction timestamp and a subsequent direction timestamp.

title_en: Distortion correction for tracking an object in a magnetic field
abstract_en: A system is configured to model a magnetic field by measuring a first value for characteristics of a magnetic field at a first position in the magnetic field. The system measures a second value characteristics of the magnetic field at a second position in the magnetic field. The system determines a distance between the first position and the second position. The system estimates a distortion component of the magnetic field at approximately the second position in the magnetic field based on each of the distance, the first value for each of the one or more characteristics, and the second value for each of the one or more characteristics. The system outputs a model of at least a region of the magnetic field.

title_en: Post sleeve positioning systems and related methods
abstract_en: A system for positioning post sleeves is provided including a plurality of post sleeve positioning devices and a spacing mechanism. Each post sleeve positioning device is configured to receive a respective post sleeve and to enable selective adjustment of a position and orientation of the respective post sleeve. The spacing mechanism is coupleable between the pair of post sleeve positioning devices to determine or control the position and orientation of the post sleeve received by one of the pair of post sleeves positioning devices relative to the post sleeve received by the other one of the pair of post sleeve positioning devices. Related systems and methods are also provided.

title_en: Method, apparatus, and system for wireless proximity sensing
abstract_en: Methods, apparatus and systems for wireless proximity sensing are described. In one example, a described system comprises: a transmitter configured for transmitting a first wireless signal through a wireless multipath channel of a venue; a receiver configured for receiving a second wireless signal through the wireless multipath channel; and a processor. The second wireless signal differs from the first wireless signal due to the wireless multipath channel that is impacted by a movement of an object in the venue. The processor is configured for: obtaining a time series of channel information (TSCI) of the wireless multipath channel based on the second wireless signal, wherein each channel information (CI) of the TSCI comprises a plurality of CI components, each of which is associated with an index; computing an inter-component statistics based on the plurality of CI components; computing, based on the inter-component statistics, a proximity information of the object with respect to a reference location in the venue; and performing a task based on the proximity information of the object.

title_en: Abnormality detection device, abnormality detection method, and non-transitory computer-readable medium
abstract_en: An abnormality detection device that detects an abnormality of a target device includes a processor that executes a process of acquiring a plurality of types of measured values of the target device, a process of calculating Mahalanobis distances of the acquired plurality of types of measured values, a process of extracting the plurality of Mahalanobis distances calculated in a past predetermined period from a point in time of evaluation of the target device and calculating a moving average value of a square value of each of the extracted Mahalanobis distances, and a process of determining whether or not an abnormality has occurred in the target device on the basis of the moving average value.

title_en: Indicators for valves
abstract_en: An indicator adapted to provide a visual indication of an over pressure situation in a system. The indicator (also referred to as a pop indicator), includes a main body, a piston that is disposed in the main body, and one or more O-rings disposed around the piston. Initially, the piston is in a first position where the piston is retracted into the body. However, when an over pressure situation occurs, the pressure causes the piston to move in a direction out of the main body against a friction force created by the O-ring. When the piston is moved, i.e., popped, then end of the piston extending out of the body provides a visual indication.

title_en: Linearization of input signals
abstract_en: An apparatus for linearizing an input signal includes a memory, in which an output value is stored for each of a plurality of linearization points. The linearization points divide a value range into a plurality of intervals. Each interval is delimited by a first linearization point with an assigned first output value and a second linearization point with an assigned second output value. The apparatus includes a computer device configured to determine the interval in which an input signal value of the input signal is located and to calculate a linearized output signal value for the input signal value by way of a linear interpolation using the input signal value, the first output value of this interval, and the second output value of this interval. At least two of the intervals have different interval lengths, which are formed by multiplication of an output interval length by an integer factor.

title_en: Frequency steered sonar user interface
abstract_en: A marine sonar display device comprises a display, a memory element, and a processing element. The display displays sonar images. The memory element stores sonar data. The processing element is configured to transmit a transmit electronic signal to a frequency steered sonar element which transmits an array of sonar beams into a body of water, each sonar beam transmitted in a different angular direction, receive a receive electronic signal from the frequency steered sonar element, the receive electronic signal including a plurality of frequency components, calculate an array of sonar data slices, one sonar data slice for each frequency component, generate an array of sonar image slices, one sonar image slice for each sonar data slice, and control the display to visually present the array of sonar image slices in near real time and a historical sequence of at least one sonar image slice.

title_en: Digital map truth maintenance
abstract_en: The described technology is generally directed towards digital map truth maintenance. Map inputs shared among multiple users of a shared overlay map service can have a range of credibility, from not credible to highly credible. The disclosed digital map truth maintenance technologies can be used to enhance credibility of shared map inputs. Credibility values can be calculated for map inputs, based on any of multiple factors. Map inputs having sufficiently high credibility, such as a credibility value determined to be above a threshold value, can be shared among multiple mobile devices.
