abstract_en: The present invention provides methods for predicting in vivo cell-specific toxicity of a compound that combine high throughput imaging, quantitative phenotypic profiling, and machine learning methods of cultured cells. More specifically, the present invention provides a method for predicting in vivo proximal tubular, bronchial epithelial and alveolar cell-specific toxicity of soluble or particulate compounds, the method comprising contacting cultured human kidney and lung cells with the compound over a range of concentrations, then labeling the cells with DNA, yH2AX and actin markers, and obtaining texture features, spatial correlation features, marker ratios, intensity features, cell counts and morphology, estimating dose response curves, and performing automated classification of the compound using a random forest algorithm.

title_en: Test equipment and test method for indoor test of lateral deformation of concrete mixture
abstract_en: The invention discloses test equipment and a test method for testing lateral deformation of a concrete mixture indoors, wherein the test equipment comprises a box body, a positioning plate, a transverse scale and a vertical scale; the box body mainly comprises a bottom plate, a left side wall, a right side wall, a front rotating plate and a rear rotating plate; the bottom of the bottom plate is provided with a leveling plastic steel cushion block, and the leveling plastic steel cushion block is provided with a horizontal bubble; one end of the positioning plate is provided with a round hole, the other end edge is provided with a semicircular opening, the middle is provided with a hollow groove; the transverse scale is limited in the hollow groove of the positioning plate by the cylindrical bolt to slide in a reciprocating manner; the vertical scale is equipped with 4, installs respectively in four edges and corners departments of box. The method is used for simulating the liquefaction characteristic of the slip form construction process concrete for the road surface indoors after high-frequency vibration and the lateral deformation amount when the side wall template support is lost after compaction by vibration, fills up the blank that the slip form concrete vertical formwork characteristic for the road is evaluated only by the concrete slump consistency index in the industry, and greatly facilitates construction, scientific research and detection.

title_en: Self-adaptive fluorescence immunochromatography quantitative detection feature extraction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-adaptive fluorescence immunoassay quantitative detection feature extraction method, and belongs to the technical field of biology, medical engineering and computer signal processing. The fluorescence signal obtained on the basis of the fluorescence quantitative detection and measurement technology is subjected to data processing such as fluorescence signal filtering, and the data processing of the fluorescence signal comprises the following steps: signal peak identification, boundary determination, fluorescence line fitting, base line fitting and characteristic value determination. In order to ensure the self-adaptability and the accuracy of measurement and solve the problem that the measurement value of a fluorescence signal is saturated and cannot be measured and calculated in the current fluorescence immunoassay quantitative detection, a self-adaptive fluorescence immunoassay quantitative detection feature extraction method is provided to ensure the accuracy of measurement.

title_en: Full-automatic buried lifting following tail exhaust system of tail gas detection area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a full-automatic buried lifting following tail gas exhaust system of a tail gas detection area, which comprises a main steel structure frame and a main control cabinet, wherein a scissor type lifting mechanism is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the inner wall of the main steel structure frame, the scissor type lifting mechanism comprises an installation base, a cylinder, a supporting lifting frame and a lifting table top, rail installation supports are fixedly arranged on two sides of the top of the lifting table top, and guide rails are fixedly arranged on the top of the rail installation supports. This tail system of arranging is followed in going up and down to full-automatic formula of burying of tail detection zone, when the vehicle that detects stops on the spacing card of wheel and goes up and down to follow tail row equipment region and be no object, will turn over automatic the opening of board through pneumatic means, scissors formula elevating system adjusts the position of lift mesa, thereby remove the coaster outside total steel structural framework, use through the cooperation of advancing distance detection group and total safety switch, detect the distance between the blast pipe of total exhaust hood and waiting to detect the vehicle, thereby reach the best pump drainage distance.

title_en: Wear-resistant and crease-resistant polyester fabric integrated dyeing device and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an integrated dyeing device for wear-resistant and crease-resistant polyester fabric and a control method thereof. Belongs to the technical field of polyester fabric production equipment. The device can make the upper and lower face dyeing of polyester fabric even, and is effectual to the stoving of polyester fabric, can detect the polyester fabric ventilative and detect with the heat preservation nature. The device comprises a cloth discharging machine, a polyester fabric dyeing device body, a polyester fabric steam drying device, a cloth storage rack, a polyester fabric winding machine, a microcontroller and a rack; the polyester fabric dyeing device body is arranged on the right side of the cloth outlet machine, the polyester fabric steam drying device is arranged on the right side of the polyester fabric dyeing device body, the cloth storage rack is arranged on the right side of the polyester fabric steam drying device, and the polyester fabric winding machine is arranged on the right side of the cloth storage rack.

title_en: Optical fiber oxygen measuring sensor
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optical fiber oxygen measuring sensor, which consists of a broadband light source, an air chamber, an air outlet hole, an air inlet hole, a butterfly cone, an oxygen-sensitive film, a spectrometer, an oxygen cylinder, a nitrogen cylinder, a gas flowmeter, a femtosecond laser and an optical fiber grating, wherein the oxygen-sensitive film specifically uses hemoglobin, and the film plating method is an optical fiber photothermal method; the fiber bragg grating made of the double-core fine-core fiber is adopted to provide a temperature compensation effect for the whole sensor, so that the influence of temperature on the sensor is eliminated; the femtosecond laser is used for processing the single-mode fiber and the butterfly cone structure is manufactured on the optical fiber fusion splicer, the cladding thickness of the structure is thinner than that of a common butterfly cone structure, and the sensing performance of the structure can be improved. At the time of measurement, oxygen binds to oxygen-sensitive membrane hemoglobin, where its effective refractive index changes. The change of the effective refractive index can cause the interference peak of the interference spectrum on the spectrometer to change, and the concentration of oxygen can be detected by observing the change of the interference peak on the spectrometer.

title_en: Soil heavy metal content detection device based on DDS
abstract_en: The invention provides a DDS-based detection device for detecting the heavy metal content in soil, which is completely different from the prior art, and comprises: the device comprises a sensor, a Direct Digital Synthesizer (DDS), a current sampler, a voltage sampler, an instrument amplifier, an A/D converter, an interface circuit, an MCU, input equipment, a temperature control module and a power supply module, wherein the DDS is connected with the current sampler; the sensor is also internally provided with an electric heater and a thermocouple; during detection, the collected soil sample is filled in the sensor. The heavy metal content of the soil can be inverted according to the shapes of the Cp-f curve and the Tan (Delta) -f curve of the soil sample obtained by measurement.

title_en: Synthetic method and application of theophylline artificial antigen
abstract_en: The invention relates to a theophylline artificial antigen which is characterized by comprising the following structural general formula: the invention also relates to a preparation method and application of the theophylline artificial antigen, wherein hydroxyl is derived from N at the 7 th position of theophylline, carboxyl is derived from succinic anhydride, and the theophylline artificial antigen is obtained by coupling carboxyl and protein. The preparation process method is simple, materials and catalysts used in the process are common products, the reaction conditions are easy to realize, chloroform is not used in the reaction process, and the method is suitable for industrial production. The connecting arm adopted by the invention is in a chain shape, so that the characteristic structure of theophylline is kept, the recognition of an immune system of an immune animal to the connecting arm is reduced as much as possible, a specific antibody is easy to prepare, and the method is suitable for the application of the colloidal gold theophylline detection test strip.

title_en: Alpha-hemolysin variants and uses thereof
abstract_en: Described herein are variants of alpha-hemolysin having at least one mutation, such as a mutation to a positive charge. In certain examples, the mutation is selected from V149K, E287R, H G, T109K, P151K, K147N, E111N, M a or a combination thereof in the mature, wild-type α -hemolysin amino acid sequence. Alpha-hemolysin variants may also include a substitution at H144A of mature, wild-type alpha hemolysin and/or a series of glycine residues spanning residues 127 to 131. Also provided are nanopore assemblies comprising alpha-hemolysin variants, the assemblies having reduced penetration times. For example, reduced penetration time increases DNA sequencing efficiency and accuracy.

title_en: Dual-targeting fusion proteins targeting PD-1 or PD-L1 and targeting the VEGF family and uses thereof
abstract_en: The present invention provides a dual-targeting fusion protein targeting both PD-1 or PD-L1 and targeting the VEGF family, comprising (i) an anti-PD-1 antibody or an anti-PD-L1 antibody and (ii) one VID operably linked at the C-terminus of each of the two heavy chains of the anti-PD-1 antibody or anti-PD-L1 antibody. The invention also provides polynucleotides encoding the dual-targeting fusion proteins, vectors comprising the polynucleotides, host cells comprising the polynucleotides or vectors, and uses of the dual-targeting fusion proteins in treating, preventing and/or diagnosing diseases associated with PD-1 activity, PD-L1 activity and VEGF family activity in an individual.

title_en: Water quality on-line detector
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water quality on-line detector which comprises a detection cavity, wherein the bottom end of the detection cavity is connected with a drainage pipeline, the drainage pipeline is provided with a drainage valve, one side of the detection cavity is uniformly connected with five flushing joints, one end of the five flushing joints, which is far away from the detection cavity, is connected with a flushing pipeline, the top end of the flushing pipeline is provided with a purified water inlet, a purified water valve is arranged below the purified water inlet and on the flushing pipeline, the level of the purified water valve is higher than that of the flushing joint, one side of the detection cavity, which is far away from the flushing joint, is uniformly connected with five detection joints, and the five detection joints are sequentially connected with a pH probe, a turbidity probe, a conductivity probe, a residual chlorine probe and an oxygen dissolving probe from top to bottom.

title_en: Incubation sample loading device based on multi-channel immunochromatography detection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-channel immunochromatography detection-based incubation sample loading device, and aims to realize multi-channel incubation and simultaneous sample loading. The device comprises a top cover, a sealed detection column, a sample introduction cover plate, a sample introduction pipeline, a base and an incubation disc. The top cover is used for sealing the top end of the sealed detection column and providing a pressure environment required by uniform mixing and sample introduction; the sealed detection column is used for carrying out chromatographic reaction; the sample feeding cover plate is used for sealing the base; the sample introduction pipeline provides a sample introduction channel for incubating samples; the base is used for containing a sample loading solution; the incubation disc is used for containing the enzyme labeling holes to realize pre-incubation reaction. The invention can also be used for detecting items without a pre-incubation step, and the pressure change of the device in the environment with the required pressure change can be realized by a manual or automatic device, so that multi-channel incubation and synchronous sample introduction are realized. The method can be applied to fields including clinical diagnosis, inspection and quarantine, food safety detection, judicial identification and the like, and has wide market prospect.

title_en: Virus detection equipment of potato
abstract_en: The invention discloses a virus detection device for potatoes, which comprises: the grinding mechanism is arranged at the upper part of the testing mechanism; the testing mechanism comprises a main box, the main box is provided with a first accommodating cavity with openings on the peripheral side and the upper part, and virus detection test paper of potatoes can be placed at the bottom of the first accommodating cavity; the grinding mechanism comprises a grinding box, a grinding cover and a grinding pestle, the grinding box is provided with a grinding cavity with an opening at the upper part, the grinding cover is arranged on the grinding cavity, a through hole is formed in the grinding cover, and the grinding pestle is arranged in the through hole in a penetrating mode; the grinding mechanism further comprises a partition plate and a filtering hole formed in the partition plate, the partition plate is located in the middle of the grinding cavity, and the filtering hole is communicated with the first accommodating cavity. The detection equipment provided by the embodiment of the invention is convenient for preparing the filtrate on site, does not need to carry excessive testing tools, and is convenient to carry.

title_en: Citrus allergen Cit 2.01 antigen expression purification, polyclonal antibody preparation and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses citrus allergen Cit 2.01 antigen expression purification, polyclonal antibody preparation and application, and particularly discloses a codon-optimized rutaceae plant allergen Cit 2.01 gene, which is characterized by comprising a sequence shown as SEQ ID NO. 2. According to the invention, a prokaryotic expression system of allergen Cit 2.01 is constructed by optimizing a Cit 2.01 gene prokaryotic expression sequence and gene synthesis, a rabbit polyclonal antibody Anti-Cit 2.01 is prepared by using expressed and purified rCit 2.01 protein, the content of allergen Cit 2.01 in citrus peel and fruit pulp is detected, and the potential allergenicity of the allergen Cit 2.01 in edible parts of citrus fruits can be evaluated by a method of measuring the intensity of Western blot by using a light density value.

title_en: Immobilised analyte
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for detecting an analyte comprising a) contacting the analyte, a capture agent and a solid surface to form a capture complex attached to a solid surface, b) cleaving at least one covalent bond within the analyte and/or within the capture agent comprised in the capture complex and thereby releasing the analyte or a fragment thereof from the capture complex, and c) detecting the at least one fragment of the analyte and thereby detecting the analyte. The invention further relates to a kit comprising: i) a capture agent that binds (in one embodiment specifically binds) to the analyte; and ii) a reagent that cleaves at least one covalent bond within the analyte and/or within the capture agent, and to the use of a protease for releasing analyte fragments for detection of the analyte, wherein the analyte is bound to a solid surface via the capture agent.

title_en: Conjugates to programmed death ligands and uses thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a conjugate aiming at programmed death ligand (PD-L1) and application thereof. Specifically, the invention provides a novel anti-PD-L1 monoclonal antibody. The antibody of the invention can be combined with PD-L1 antigen with high specificity, has high affinity, biological activity and low immunogenicity, and is used for preparing medicaments for preventing or treating PD-L1 related diseases.

title_en: Chlorpyrifos monoclonal antibody and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a chlorpyrifos monoclonal antibody and a preparation method and application thereof, and the invention has the advantages of strong specificity, high sensitivity, simplicity, convenience and rapidness, and vivid, visual and accurate result display; the cost is saved, the application range is wide, and the popularization is convenient; the prepared chlorpyrifos colloidal gold test strip does not need professional operators and any auxiliary instruments, can judge the result within a few minutes according to the strip shown by the reaction, is simple and convenient to operate, is quick, has intuitive and accurate result and low cost, and can be used for outdoor detection.

title_en: Method for measuring content of water-absorbent resin, and method for producing sanitary material or absorbent article using same
abstract_en: The invention provides a convenient, safe and high-precision method for measuring the content of a water-absorbent resin in a sanitary material or an absorbent article. By the measuring method of the present invention, without separating the water-absorbent resin from the sanitary material, the water-absorbent article, or the intermediate product of the production process thereof, which contains the water-absorbent resin having the water-soluble cation in the form of the ion-dissociable group, the amount of the water-absorbent resin in the sanitary material, the water-absorbent article, or the intermediate product of the production process thereof can be estimated from the previously prepared calibration curve by pretreating with the aqueous solution containing the total ionic strength adjuster and measuring the amount of the predetermined water-soluble cation in the supernatant after the pretreatment by the ion-selective electrode method, thereby enabling the content of the water-absorbent resin to be measured with high accuracy.

title_en: Activity-based probe compounds, compositions, and methods of use thereof
abstract_en: The present invention provides activity-based probe compounds for labeling cysteine proteases. The compounds target proteases through specific target elements. The compounds also include a detectable element, such as a fluorescent label, a radiolabel, or a chelator. In some cases, the compound further comprises a quencher that is released upon reaction with the protease. The invention also provides compositions comprising the compounds, and methods of using the compounds, such as labeling proteases and visualizing tumors in animals.

title_en: Device for extracorporeal blood-gas exchange
abstract_en: A device for extracorporeal blood gas exchange is proposed. The device has a blood flow region for directing blood flow; an air guide region for guiding an air flow; a diaphragm which forms a gas-liquid barrier between the blood flow and the gas flow and which furthermore makes possible a transfer of the carbon dioxide of the blood flow into the gas flow, wherein the device furthermore has at least one measurement cuvette which is at least partially separated from the region of the blood flow by the diaphragm, so that the carbon dioxide of the blood flow can be transferred into the measurement cuvette, and wherein the device has an optical measurement unit which is designed to measure the partial pressure of carbon dioxide in the measurement cuvette.

title_en: O antigen affinity medium and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an O antigen affinity medium, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the O antigen affinity medium comprises a super-macroporous medium and an O antigen of salmonella, and the O antigen is chemically fixed on the surface of the super-macroporous medium. The preparation process of the O antigen affinity matrix is simple, the purification operation is simple and convenient, the efficiency is high, and the antibody prepared by utilizing the affinity medium and the purification method has high specificity to the O antigen and can be used for assisting the diagnosis of salmonella and the like.

title_en: Universal full-automatic analysis system
abstract_en: The invention provides a general full-automatic analysis system, which is used for qualitative and quantitative determination of analytes, and comprises a solid phase unit, a solid phase unit storage module, a sample storage module, a reagent storage module, an incubation module, a cleaning module, a determination module and a transfer module, wherein the incubation module comprises at least one group of solid phase unit accommodation sites for accommodating solid phase units in different reaction stages, each group of solid phase unit accommodation sites comprises a new sample loading site and a sample to be tested site, a group of solid phase units in different reaction stages can perform incubation reaction on the incubation module at the same time, and are transferred to the cleaning module through the transfer module to be cleaned at the same time, so that on one hand, single sample sequential detection is realized, the processing conditions of all samples are consistent, and the detection result is more accurate; on the other hand, each group of solid phase units at different stages can be simultaneously incubated and cleaned, so that the detection efficiency is improved.

title_en: Dam piping simulation test device and test method under high water level
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dam piping simulation test device under high water level and a test method, wherein a test box is divided into a water storage chamber and a soil sample filling chamber by a water permeable partition plate; a valve ball is arranged in the pressure regulating water tank, and the height of the valve ball is adjustable; the water inlet of the water storage chamber is communicated with the water outlet of the pressure regulating water tank through a pipeline, water is supplied and the water pressure is regulated through the pressure regulating water tank, and the height of the pressure regulating water tank is adjustable; the opening and closing of the water pump is controlled by a valve ball in the pressure regulating water tank, and the pressure regulating water tank is matched with the valve ball to accurately control the water level of the water storage chamber; the bottom of the soil sample filling room is filled with a sand gravel layer, and a test sand layer is arranged on the sand gravel layer; embedding a pore water pressure sensor in a test sand layer, paving colored glass beads on the top of the test sand layer along the axial direction, and tracking the upstream development track of piping; the piping outlet is communicated and led out through a water sand discharge pipeline; a funnel for collecting sand is arranged below the outlet of the water sand discharge pipeline.

title_en: Saliva exosome protein biomarker
abstract_en: The invention provides a saliva exosome protein biomarker, which is one or more of keratin, actin, histone, mitogen activated protein kinase1, calpain1, myeloperoxidase, matrix metalloproteinase-9 and inflammatory protein. The keratin, actin, histone, mitogen-activated protein kinase1, calpain1, myeloperoxidase, calpain-9 and inflammatory protein can be used as biomarkers of AD, and the keratin, actin, histone, mitogen-activated protein kinase1, calpain1, myeloperoxidase, matrix metalloprotease-9 and inflammatory protein are sensitive, effective and noninvasive saliva exosome protein biomarkers.

title_en: Multi-enzyme signal particle and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of biological detection, in particular to a multi-enzyme signal particle, and a preparation method and application thereof. The sensitivity of the detection method can be obviously improved through a multi-enzyme signal amplification mechanism. In a preferred technical scheme of the invention, the immunochromatographic test strip prepared based on the multi-enzyme signal particles is subjected to enzyme color development, signals are obviously amplified, and a detection result can be directly interpreted by naked eyes within 5-10 minutes, so that rapid detection of a target object to be detected is realized; compared with the traditional immunoassay method, the method has the advantages of high detection efficiency, higher sensitivity and the like. Meanwhile, the detection result can be judged by naked eyes, and the method has convenience, practicability and wider application range.

title_en: Anti-human 4-1BB monoclonal antibody, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: Novel fully human monoclonal antibodies that bind to human 4-1BB are provided. Also provided are hybridoma production methods using humanized rats, nucleic acid molecules encoding anti-4-1 BB antibodies, vectors and host cells for expressing the anti-4-1 BB antibodies. The invention further provides methods for validating antibody function in vitro and for validating antibody efficacy in vivo. The antibodies of the invention provide very effective agents for the treatment of various cancers by modulating human immune function.

title_en: Lubricant quality management for compressors
abstract_en: A heating, ventilation, air conditioning and refrigeration (HVACR) system is disclosed. The HVACR system includes: a refrigerant circuit. The refrigerant circuit includes a compressor, a condenser, an expansion device, and an evaporator fluidly connected. A controller is electrically connected to the compressor. The controller is configured to prevent the compressor from operating at a rate less than a minimum rate limit. A lubricant separator has an inlet fluidly connected between the compressor and the condenser, and a plurality of outlets. A first outlet of the plurality of outlets is fluidly connected to the condenser. A second outlet of the plurality of outlets is fluidly connected to one or more components of the compressor to provide lubricant to the one or more components.

title_en: Application of ZYX (Zollinger X) porphyrins in diagnosis and treatment of malignant glioblastoma
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biological medicines, and relates to a brain glioma-related tumor molecular marker and application thereof. The invention discloses an application of ZYX (Zollinger-associated protein) as a diagnosis marker of malignant glioblastoma multiforme, wherein the expression level of the ZYX-associated protein is positively correlated with the invasion intensity of glioma. The expression level of the ZYX porphyrins is positively correlated with the malignancy grade of glioma. The invention confirms the dynamic relation between the expression quantity of the ZYX adiponectin and the occurrence and development of glioma, and provides important guiding significance for the treatment, diagnosis, curative effect prediction, prognosis judgment and the like of glioma.

title_en: Method and system for determining diffusion trend of diffusible object
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for determining diffusion trend of a diffusible object, wherein the method comprises the following steps: receiving first associated information, sent by a first device, of a first moment when a diffusible object is detected through a set sensor and a first position where the diffusible object appears; receiving second associated information, sent by a second device, of a second moment when the diffusible object is detected by the arranged sensor and a second position where the diffusible object appears; the diffusion trend of the diffusible object is determined according to the first associated information and the second associated information, the problems that in the related art, only the existence condition of the diffusible object of the local scene in the target scene can be detected through a group of devices of the same type, and the diffusion trend of the diffusible object cannot be identified can be solved, and the target scene can be detected comprehensively or in different dimensions, so that the diffusion trend of the diffusible object can be identified.

title_en: Process recording slide for immunohistochemical staining
abstract_en: An apparatus and method for determining the effect of paraffin removal, antigen retrieval and the use of primary and secondary staining reagents in an assay procedure, particularly a multi-step Immunohistochemistry (IHC) assay. The device includes an adhesive coated microscope slide containing a plurality of compounds spotted in a 2D or 3D configuration and sealed under a paraffin coating. Subsequently, tissue sections or loose cells are added to the same slide and all undergo IHC processing steps applied from tissue capture to coverslip. The compounds were reacted with primary or secondary IHC staining reagents to record the processing history of the coexisting tissue sections or loose cells.

title_en: Chimeric antigen receptor affinity detection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for detecting affinity of a CD19CAR, which mainly comprises the following steps: 1) Constructing a stable cell strain with high expression of CD 19; 2) Affinity of CD19 antibodies to CD19 positive cells; 3) Affinity detection of CD19 protein to CD19 CAR. The method can effectively determine the affinity of the CD19CAR antibody, and has the advantages of safety, high sensitivity, good repeatability, stable and reliable detection result and the like.

title_en: Water-gas separation device suitable for deep water high-pressure environment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a water-gas separation device suitable for a deep water high-pressure environment, which comprises a shell, an airtight electrical connector and a gas outlet which are respectively arranged at two ends of the shell, a spiral notch groove arranged on the inner side wall of the shell, a liquid inlet and a liquid outlet which are respectively arranged on the outer side walls of two ends of the shell and are communicated with the notch groove, a supporting block embedded in the shell and a water-proof and gas-permeable film wrapped on the outer side wall of the supporting block. The supporting block comprises a supporting block main body and a cavity arranged in the middle of the supporting block main body. The supporting block main body comprises a first supporting block and a second supporting block which are symmetrically arranged. The cavity comprises a first cavity and a second cavity which are arranged in sequence. A wedge-shaped supporting block is arranged in the first cavity. And a heating rod and a liquid level sensor are arranged in the second cavity. The first supporting block, the second supporting block and the wedge-shaped supporting block are all made of porous loose materials. The invention can solve the defects in the prior art and effectively improve the efficiency of extracting the dissolved gas by adopting the waterproof breathable film.

title_en: Method for detecting pesticide residue by magnetic relaxation time sensor based on quantity and state change of nano magnetic particles
abstract_en: The invention discloses a biological sensing method for changing the quantity and the state of nano magnetic particles based on a biological orthogonal reaction so as to detect pesticide residues.

title_en: Crustacean flavivirus and detection method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a crustacean flavivirus and a detection method and application thereof. The infectious precocious virus (Infectious precocity flavivirus) belongs to infectious precocious viruses, and the preservation number is CCTCC No. V201870. The shape is spherical, the diameter is 40-60 nm, and the Macrobrachium rosenbergii can be infected. The invention also provides a kit for the infectious early-maturing virus. Provides new possibility for detecting, preventing and controlling the infectious precocious virus of the crustacean aquatic products.

title_en: Real-time on-line monitoring system and method for coal quality in furnace
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a system and a method for real-time on-line monitoring of coal quality in a furnace. In the real-time on-line monitoring system for the coal quality entering the boiler, a data acquisition module is configured to acquire the operation data of the boiler and a coal pulverizing system; the coal quality component detection module is configured to perform real-time online detection on the coal quality index; the communication module is configured to send the data acquired by the data acquisition module and the real-time online detection result of the coal quality component detection module to the monitoring module; the monitoring module is configured to obtain the layered state of multiple coal types of the raw coal bunker, the current coal quality condition of entering the furnace and the change reminding information of the combustion coal type according to the operation data and the real-time online detection result; and the operation display module is configured to display the layered states of multiple coal types of the raw coal bunker, the current coal quality condition of the coal entering the furnace and the change reminding information of the combustion coal type. The method and the device are beneficial to improving the informatization capability and the operation optimization level of the coal quality of the unit, and further realize energy conservation and consumption reduction of the unit.

title_en: Research method for HBV genome amplification
abstract_en: The invention discloses a research method for HBV genome amplification, which comprises a research process of miR-146a for regulating HBV genome amplification and a research process of taking Ago2 as a carrier for regulating HBV genome amplification in cooperation with miR-146a, wherein a novel miR-146 a- & gt FEN 1- & gt HBV DNA regulating shaft is discovered and confirmed in HBV amplification infection by the research method, the regulating shaft provides necessary conditions for HBV genome amplification, a specific molecular mechanism of HBV DNA replication is further described, and theoretical basis is provided for understanding HBV pathogenesis and developing novel cure targets and schemes; the molecular mechanism of HBV replication can be thoroughly clarified for intensive researches in the future, and conditions are created for clearing the intracellular cccDNA library and completely blocking the cure target of HBV replication.

title_en: Optical waveguide microfluid detection system based on CMOS image sensing
abstract_en: The invention provides an optical waveguide microfluid detection system based on CMOS image sensing, which comprises a microfluid chip, a spectrum collecting device and an analyzing device, wherein the microfluid chip comprises an optical waveguide and a micro-channel, the optical waveguide is used for guiding light into the micro-channel along the horizontal direction, the microfluid chip further comprises a CMOS image sensing layer, a lower cladding layer, a waveguide layer, an upper cladding layer and a channel cover plate which are sequentially arranged from bottom to top, the waveguide layer is made of silicon nitride material formed at the deposition temperature of 25-150 ℃, the waveguide layer is used for forming the optical waveguide, the micro-channel penetrates through the upper cladding layer, the waveguide layer and the lower cladding layer from top to bottom to expose the CMOS image sensing layer, and the width of the micro-channel is 10-100 mu m. The method has the advantages that the silicon nitride optical waveguide with adjustable optical performance is deposited on the CMOS image sensing layer and the high polymer material at low temperature, the CMOS image sensing layer is not damaged, the preparation work of adjusting the collecting optical path and the like in the experiment is reduced, the experiment efficiency is improved, the portability of the detection system is improved, and the application scene of the system is greatly increased.

title_en: Fusion protein of monomer streptavidin and gauss luciferase and application thereof
abstract_en: The fusion protein comprises a monomer streptavidin full-length protein and a gauss luciferase full-length protein or a continuous luminescence mutant, wherein the monomer streptavidin full-length protein is connected with the gauss luciferase full-length protein or the continuous luminescence mutant through a flexible peptide. The fusion protein can conveniently and specifically identify biotin molecules, has the function of catalyzing substrate oxidation luminescence, and is convenient to detect. Compared with the detection of biotin by combining SA and anti-SA antibodies, the fusion protein is convenient and quick, does not cause substrate aggregation, can be obtained by only once expression and purification, has simple production process and is beneficial to large-scale production. The fusion protein has wide application prospect in the fields of DNA hybridization, immunodetection, biochemical diagnosis and the like.

title_en: Aspirin drug resistance detection method based on thromboelastogram
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of blood detectionIn particular to an aspirin drug resistance detection method based on thromboelastography. The technical scheme of the invention is as follows: respectively measuring the thrombus strength MA of the anticoagulation blood to be detected by using a thromboelastogram common cup CK And thromboelastography cup determination of thrombus intensity MA containing liver esterase AA The difference between the two can represent the curative effect and residue of aspirin, and the thrombelastogram cup MA containing liver esterase AA Can hydrolyze aspirin in blood into salicylic acid, and decompose aspirin thrombelastogram MA without liver esterase CK Control, based on the difference between the two, was compared with a liver esterase-containing thromboelastogram cup MA AA The ratio is calculated to evaluate the inhibition rate of the platelet to aspirin resistance, and the method has the characteristics of simple operation, low cost, high detection speed and good method path and has technical popularization value.

title_en: sensor element
abstract_en: The invention provides a sensor element with excellent poisoning resistance. The sensor element includes an element substrate and a porous tip protection layer, the element substrate having: a ceramic body that contains an oxygen ion-conductive solid electrolyte and has an inlet at one end; at least 1 internal cavity provided inside the ceramic body and communicating with the gas introduction port at a predetermined diffusion resistance; an electrochemical pump unit comprising an outer pump electrode of the ceramic body outer surface, an inner pump electrode facing the inner cavity, and a solid electrolyte therebetween; and a heater buried in a predetermined range on one end side of the ceramic body, wherein the porous tip protection layer covers the tip surface and the 4 side surfaces in the predetermined range on one end side of the element substrate, the tip protection layer has an extension portion extending into the gas introduction port, the extension portion adheres to an inner wall surface of the ceramic body dividing the gas introduction port, and a gap communicating with the gas introduction port, which is divided by a surface of a portion of the tip protection layer continuous with the extension portion, is formed in the tip protection layer.

title_en: Novel polypeptide specifically bound with multiple tumor cells and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of biomedicine, and particularly relates to a novel polypeptide specifically bound with multiple tumor cells and application thereof. The amino acid sequence of the polypeptide is selected from the amino acid sequence shown in one of SEQ ID NO.1-SEQ ID NO. 5. The polypeptide and its bioactive segment and derivative are used as molecular imaging probe and medicine target head in diagnosis and treatment of tumor. The polypeptide has the function of specifically targeting various cancer cells, has high specificity and small side effect, develops a series of tumor early diagnosis reagents and targeted therapeutic drugs, and opens up a new direction for designing and developing novel tumor targeted drugs.

title_en: Single-chain antibody targeting folate receptor alpha and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a single-chain antibody of a targeted folate receptor alpha and application thereof, belonging to the field of tumor targeted therapy, wherein the nucleotide sequence of the folate receptor alpha single-chain antibody is shown as SEQ ID No.1, the amino acid sequence of the single-chain antibody is shown as SEQ ID No.2, and the CDR region in the SEQ ID No.2 is shown as SEQ ID No.3-SEQ ID No. 8. The folate receptor alpha single-chain antibody sequence is obtained by screening by phage display technology, expresses antibody molecules by a prokaryotic expression system, and can be used for targeting folate receptor alpha expression positive tumor cells. The invention can utilize the obtained single-chain antibody molecule to play potential medical and pharmaceutical values in tumor diagnosis and provides a new method for the targeted therapy of tumors.

title_en: New antigen identification using hot spots
abstract_en: A method for identifying a neoantigen that may be presented on the surface of a tumor cell in a subject. The peptide sequence of the tumor neoantigen is obtained by sequencing tumor cells of the subject. Correlating the peptide sequence of each neoantigen with one or more k-mer units of the plurality of k-mer units of the nucleotide sequencing data of the subject; the peptide sequences and associated k-mer units are input into a machine learning presentation model to generate presentation possibilities for the tumor neoantigen, each presentation possibility representing the possibility of presentation of a neoantigen by an MHC allele on the surface of tumor cells of the subject. A subset of the new antigens is selected based on the presentation possibilities.

title_en: Multifunctional soil detection device for environment detection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional soil detection device for environmental detection, which comprises an installation vehicle plate, wherein two sides of one end of the installation vehicle plate are fixedly connected with a pushing handle bar, one end of the ground top of the installation vehicle plate is fixedly connected with a storage battery, the middle part of the other end of the top of the installation vehicle plate is symmetrically and fixedly connected with an installation vertical rod, the middle part of one side of the installation vertical rod is provided with an installation vertical groove, and the inner side of the installation vertical groove is movably connected with an installation bolt. The phenomenon of mixing of soil samples is effectively prevented, and the accuracy of soil sample detection is further improved.

title_en: Bispecific human antibody of EGFRvIII and EGFR and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bispecific humanized antibody of EGFRvIII and EGFR and application thereof, relating to the technical field of biological medicines. The human antibody disclosed by the invention has light chain CDRs shown as SEQ ID NO.6-8 and heavy chain CDRs shown as SEQ ID NO. 11-12. The human antibody can be specifically combined with two proteins of human EGFR and EGFRvIII, has higher affinity, is a fully human antibody, and has lower immunogenicity.

title_en: Single-stranded DNA aptamer capable of specifically recognizing O-GlcNAc modification, and screening method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a single-stranded DNA aptamer capable of specifically recognizing O-GlcNAc modification, a screening method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of biochemical detection. In particular to a method which is based on a ligand system evolution technology (SELEX) of exponential enrichment and takes O-GlcNAc modified polypeptide as a screening target and unmodified polypeptide as a counter-screen. And obtaining the DNA aptamer capable of specifically recognizing the modification of O-GlcNAc after multiple rounds of screening. DNA aptamers labeled with biotin or the like using the aptamers as a core are used to detect the O-GlcNAc modification level in proteins. The invention provides a screening method of an O-GlcNAc modified single-stranded DNA aptamer, wherein the DNA aptamer marked by biotin and the like is used for detecting the modification of protein O-GlcNAc, so that a new method is provided for the research of the modification of O-GlcNAc and a new direction is opened for the application of the aptamer in post-translational modification, and the method has potential application prospect.

title_en: Method for performing immune labeling on tissue sample
abstract_en: The application discloses a method for performing immune labeling on a tissue sample, in particular to a labeling system, which comprises the tissue sample to be subjected to immune labeling, a probe for labeling the tissue sample and a buffer solution; and (b) placing the marking system under the action of an electric field to carry out marking treatment, so that the probe enters the inside of the tissue sample, and thus, the tissue sample is subjected to immune marking, and an immune marked tissue sample is obtained. The application not only shortens the time for the probe to enter the tissue sample, but also maintains the integrity of the tissue, and has great application value.

title_en: Open type multi-air-chamber method soil respiration value monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention provides an open type multi-air-chamber method for monitoring soil respiration value, which comprises the following steps: selecting a stable and continuous soil carbon dioxide concentration time sequence according to Fick's second law; substituting the soil carbon dioxide concentration time sequence value into a Fick first law to calculate a soil carbon flux value changing along with time, and then obtaining a soil carbon flux time sequence with low noise content by utilizing wavelet packet transformation; according to the signal-to-noise ratio of the carbon dioxide concentration obtained by calculation, 4 closeness degrees of the carbon dioxide concentration, the temperature, the air pressure and the humidity of each air chamber are respectively calculated by using a maximum and minimum closeness degree method; finally obtaining the distribution weight of each air chamber according to the 4 closeness degrees; and multiplying the soil carbon flux time sequence by the distribution weight of each air chamber to perform weighted fusion, finally obtaining a data fusion result, and performing decision making according to the weighted fusion result. The method can accurately acquire the soil respiration value at every moment, and realizes low-cost soil respiration monitoring.

title_en: Bentonite building block single joint healing effect testing device and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a method for testing the single seam healing effect of a bentonite building block, wherein the device comprises a transparent plate structure, a connecting pipeline, a water inlet system, a sample, a metal water permeable plate, a camera and a data acquisition system. Compared with the prior art, the method can acquire the image and video data of the building block joint healing process in real time, obtain the whole building block joint healing process, reveal the joint healing effect rule of the bentonite building block, and provide a basis for engineering design of a high-level waste deep geological repository.

title_en: Management system and method for intelligently processing urban environmental pollution
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent management system and method for treating urban environmental pollution, the system comprises an environmental pollution monitoring point positioning module, a plurality of drainage pipeline corresponding marking modules, a drainage pipeline waste water random sampling detection module, an urban different lake pollution index directional analysis module and a lake environmental data management module, wherein the environmental pollution monitoring point positioning module is used for positioning the position of a lake to be monitored and then counting, the drainage pipeline corresponding marking modules are used for marking drainage pipelines discharging waste water into the lake, the drainage pipeline waste water random sampling detection module is used for randomly sampling the waste water discharged by the drainage pipelines, the urban different lake pollution index directional analysis module is used for analyzing different lake pollution indexes, the lake environmental data management module is used for acquiring data information monitored by all the modules in real time, the monitored water quality condition is fed back in real time, different water drainage pipes are matched, and the sewage discharge is conveniently checked.

title_en: Underground cavern simulation experiment device and experiment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underground cavern simulation experiment device and an experiment method, wherein the device comprises a supporting underframe, a gravity compensation mechanism and a pair of adjusting brackets; the adjusting brackets are symmetrically arranged on the supporting underframe and can move or be fixed relative to the supporting underframe; the gravity compensation mechanism comprises a pressing plate and a force application assembly, the pressing plate is arranged between the two adjusting brackets, and the force application assembly is arranged on the upper portion of the pressing plate and can apply pressure to the pressing plate. The device provided by the invention has the advantages of simple structure, adjustable size, uniform top counterweight and convenience in use, and the provided experimental method is simple to operate, high in efficiency and high in precision.

title_en: Bletilla striata mildew detection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bletilla striata mildew detection method. The method comprises the following steps: s1: introducing clean air into the detection air chamber for cleaning; s2: after the detection gas chamber is cleaned, nano-scale TiO is added  2  Spraying the powder on the surface of a bletilla striata sample to be detected, and irradiating the bletilla striata sample to be detected by adopting ultraviolet light; s3: absorbing volatile gas generated by a bletilla striata sample to be detected into a detection gas chamber, and enabling a gas sensor array in the detection gas chamber to be in contact with the volatile gas to generate a response signal; s4: the data acquisition device samples the response signals generated by the gas sensor array and sends the sampling values to the computer; s5: and the computer processes the received sampling value and judges whether the tested bletilla striata sample mildews or not. The invention can quickly and accurately detect whether the bletilla striata is mildewed or not, and improves the working efficiency.

title_en: Method, reagent and chip for determining concentration of analyte in biological sample
abstract_en: The present invention provides a method capable of measuring the concentration of an analyte with high accuracy without the need for classification of biological components. The present invention relates to a method for measuring the concentration of an analyte in a biological sample, comprising the steps of: (1) preparing the biological sample, (2) mixing a color reagent, an oxidoreductase, and a scattered light adjuster with the biological sample to obtain an analysis sample having substantially the same scattered light as the biological sample, and (3) measuring the concentration of the analyte using the analysis sample.

title_en: FGF18 and HE4 combined used as early ovarian cancer biomarker and kit
abstract_en: The invention relates to FGF18 and HE4 combined used as early ovarian cancer biomarkers and a kit, belonging to the technical field of immunodetection. The present invention discloses the use of an agent for detecting FGF18 and HE4 levels in a sample from a subject for the preparation of a kit for predicting, evaluating or diagnosing early ovarian cancer in said subject. The invention also provides a kit for predicting, evaluating or diagnosing the early ovarian cancer of a subject, which can be effectively used for early screening of the ovarian cancer, and the sensitivity and specificity of the prediction, evaluation and diagnosis of the ovarian cancer in the subject are obviously improved and the false positive rate in early ovarian cancer detection is greatly reduced by the kit provided by the invention.

title_en: Clostridium perfringens beta toxin mutant protein, preparation method, application and vaccine thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a clostridium perfringens beta toxin mutant protein, a preparation method, application and a vaccine thereof, and relates to the field of biological products. The clostridium perfringens beta toxin mutant protein comprises: the arginine at the 212 th site and the tyrosine at the 266 th site of the wild clostridium perfringens beta toxin with the amino acid sequence shown as SEQ ID NO.3 are mutated into alanine, and compared with the wild clostridium perfringens beta toxin, the clostridium perfringens beta toxin mutant protein has obviously reduced toxicity and simultaneously keeps good immunogenicity.

title_en: Therapeutic targeting drug for enhancing MUC1CAR-T cells, application thereof, drug combination and molecular marker
abstract_en: The invention relates to a MUC1CAR-T cell therapy enhancing targeted drug, application thereof, a drug combination and a molecular marker. The targeted drug is a RAF/MEK/ERK pathway inhibitor, the inhibitor can reduce the methylation of MUC1 genes so as to promote the expression of the MUC1 genes, reduce the glycosylation degree of MUC1 extracellular segments so as to promote the exposure of antigen epitopes, and is used for improving the expression of MUC1 tumor antigens of tumor cells so as to improve the curative effect of MUC1CAR-T cell treatment. In addition, the CA15-3 can be used as a molecular marker for predicting the therapeutic effect of MUC1CAR-T cells as the existing form of the tumor cells in which MUC1 is shed in body fluid.

title_en: Detection and application of cervical cancer metastasis marker
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of genetic engineering, and discloses detection and application of a novel cervical cancer metastasis marker, wherein the cervical cancer metastasis marker is a lymphatic metastasis mode LVEM surrounded by tumor-related macrophages, and is applied to diagnosis for distinguishing metastatic early cervical cancer from non-metastatic early cervical cancer. Aiming at the defects of low sensitivity, limitation on detection of micrometastasis lymph nodes, low timeliness, low economical practicability and the like of the existing early cervical cancer lymph node metastasis evaluation method, which are all provided with false negative or false positive and low sensitivity and specificity of the existing tumor markers, the invention is based on the fact that the LVEM expression level can be used as an index for evaluating the cervical cancer patient lymph node metastasis state, the LVEM is used as a marker for developing, the expression level of LVEM in cervical cancer tissues is detected by a multicolor immunofluorescence technology, and the cervical cancer patient lymph node metastasis state can be evaluated more sensitively and specifically before operation.

title_en: Airflow collection device, SCR ammonia gas and after-treatment airflow flow velocity uniformity testing method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an airflow collecting device, an SCR ammonia gas and a post-treatment airflow flow velocity uniformity testing method, which are characterized in that the collection of airflow data is carried out through a collecting pipe at the same time, and when the ammonia gas uniformity test or the airflow flow velocity uniformity test is carried out, the airflow data of all positions of the whole cross section can be obtained through one-time detection, so that the time of the whole testing process is greatly reduced. The plurality of gas taking pipes are supported at fixed positions through the supporting plates, in the testing process, the gas taking pipes only pick up the gas flow data at the fixed positions, the movement cannot occur, the fluctuation of the data is small, and the accuracy and the reliability are high.

title_en: Biomarker for evaluating curative effect of new adjuvant radiotherapy and chemotherapy of esophageal cancer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a biomarker for evaluating the curative effect of new auxiliary radiotherapy and chemotherapy of esophageal cancer. The MMP12 protein is used as a biomarker for preparing a reagent, a kit or a detection device for evaluating the curative effect of neoadjuvant radiotherapy and chemotherapy of esophageal cancer. The abnormal expression level of MMP12 is obviously related to TNM stage, lymph node metastasis and survival time of esophageal squamous cell carcinoma (P <0.05), the invention determines a novel biomarker for predicting nCRT response of esophageal squamous cell carcinoma patients through microarray data analysis, and MMP12 can be a useful tumor biomarker and a treatment target of ESCC patients.

title_en: Detection of bacteria and immune T cells causing sexually transmitted diseases
abstract_en: Methods and devices are provided for rapid detection of bacterial samples causing sexually transmitted diseases (chlamydia, gonorrhea or syphilis). Methods and devices for rapid detection of immune cells (CD3, CD4, and CD8 cells) are also provided.

title_en: Novel target for anticancer and immune enhancement
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a pharmaceutical composition for treating or preventing cancer, which contains an inhibitor of KIRREL3, CNTN4, and/or CD 351. In addition, the present disclosure provides a pharmaceutical composition for immune enhancement containing an inhibitor of KIRREL3, CNTN4, and/or CD 351. In addition, the present disclosure provides a method of screening for anti-cancer agents using KIRREL3, CNTN4, and/or CD351, and a method of providing information necessary for analyzing prognosis of cancer using KIRREL3, CNTN4, and/or CD 351.

title_en: Human source antibody of novel coronavirus specific antigen peptide, preparation method and use
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a human antibody of a novel coronavirus specific antigen peptide, a preparation method and uses thereof. In particular, the disclosure relates to an anti-SARS-CoV-2 antibody or antigen binding fragment thereof, and the use thereof in disease diagnosis, preparing COVID-19 vaccine, preparing medicament for preventing and treating COVID-19.

title_en: NbPLP gene polyclonal antibody of Bunsen tobacco, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a polyclonal antibody of a bunsen NbPLP gene and a preparation method and application thereof, which comprises the steps of (1) constructing a recombinant expression vector containing a nucleotide sequence shown in SEQ ID NO.1, and transforming escherichia coli competent cells into the recombinant expression vector to obtain NbPLP protein; (2) the NbPLP protein is used as an antigen to immunize animals, and an NbPLP protein polyclonal antibody is obtained through serum separation and purification. The preparation of the NbPLP protein antibody has important significance for detecting the expression condition of the NbPLP gene of the Bunsen cigarette in the virus infection process and researching the function of the NbPLP protein.

title_en: Portable flour multi-quality detector based on near infrared and detection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a portable flour multi-quality detector based on near infrared and a detection method, wherein the detector comprises a case, and a power supply, a light source module, a spectrum acquisition module and a control processing module which are arranged on the case; the light source module comprises a detection accessory, wherein the detection accessory comprises an object stage, a light source seat, a light source cover, a sample reference box, a reflecting cover, an optical fiber collimating mirror, a height adjusting mechanism and a halogen lamp bead; the spectrum acquisition module comprises a spectrometer, and the spectrometer is connected with the optical fiber collimating mirror through an optical fiber; the control processing module comprises a circuit board, an embedded computer and a liquid crystal display screen, the embedded computer is connected with the halogen lamp beads through the circuit board, the spectrometer is connected with the embedded computer, and the embedded computer is connected with the liquid crystal display screen. The invention has compact structure, complete functions, lightness, portability, strong universality, capability of moving everywhere, simple detection method, capability of effectively detecting whether the moisture value and the DON value of a sample exceed the standard or not and high detection precision.

title_en: Split immunochromatography detection device and immunochromatography detection method
abstract_en: The invention provides a split immunochromatography detection device and an immunochromatography detection method. The split immunochromatographic detection device includes a first portion and a second portion. The first portion includes a first housing and a sample pad disposed in the first housing and a portion of which is exposed from the first housing, the first housing being provided with a first liquid adding portion for adding at least a chromatographic liquid. The second portion includes a second housing and a test strip disposed in the second housing. The split immunochromatographic detection device can absorb chromatographic liquid through the first liquid adding part when the first part is connected with the second part, and the sample pad is contacted with the test strip. According to the scheme of the invention, the function of the sample pad is utilized to the maximum extent, the steps of the sample pretreatment process and the used consumable materials are simplified, and the sensitivity and the accuracy of immunochromatography detection are improved.

title_en: Self-cleaning air sampling alarm device and working method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-cleaning air sampling alarm device which comprises a valve assembly, a fan assembly, a base, a driving motor, a valve assembly coupler and an MCU (microprogrammed control Unit) controller integrated on a PCB (printed Circuit Board), wherein the fan assembly is communicated with one end of the valve assembly through the valve assembly coupler, the other end of the valve assembly is provided with a plug, the fan assembly is used for providing sample air flow for stabilizing air pressure, the valve assembly is used for realizing a multi-path sampling detection feedback result, and the MCU controller is used for receiving and feeding back an instruction to realize automatic control. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the structure is simple, the wind speed loss is good, the multifunctional functions of cleaning a pipe network and supercharging can be switched, and when the wind turbine generator works normally, a high-pressure air inlet of a blower is cut off, so that an air suction type fire detector on the pipe network is prevented from being damaged; when cleaning, the blower sucks air through the air filter and outputs high-pressure clean air; when the pressure is increased, the sensitivity of the air suction type fire detector can be improved.

title_en: Water quality monitoring device based on big data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water quality monitoring, in particular to a water quality monitoring device based on big data, which comprises a shell, wherein an operation screen is arranged on the surface of the shell, the shell and the operation screen are fixed through bolts, a base is arranged at the bottom of the shell, the shell and the base are designed in an integrated mode, a fixed table is arranged at the top of the shell, the shell is fixedly connected with the fixed table, an inner cylinder is arranged inside the fixed table, the fixed table is fixedly connected with the inner cylinder, a first cylinder is arranged inside the inner cylinder, the inner cylinder is connected with the first cylinder through threads, and a second cylinder is arranged inside the first cylinder. The sample can not be spilled, has good market competitiveness and is worthy of recommendation.

title_en: Fluorescence quantitative detection kit for progesterone, estradiol and beta-human chorionic gonadotropin
abstract_en: The invention provides a fluorescence quantitative detection kit for progesterone, estradiol and beta-human chorionic gonadotropin, and relates to the technical field of in vitro diagnosis. The kit comprises a test strip, wherein the test strip comprises a substrate and a sample pad, a CP pad, an NC membrane and an absorption pad which are sequentially adhered on the substrate; the CP pad is coated with a fluorescein labeled conjugate of a mouse anti-progesterone monoclonal antibody, a mouse anti-estradiol monoclonal antibody, a mouse anti-beta-human chorionic gonadotropin monoclonal antibody and chicken IgY; the NC membrane is respectively provided with a detection line coated with a progesterone antigen, an estradiol antigen and a beta-HCG monoclonal antibody and a quality control line coated with a rabbit anti-chicken IgY monoclonal antibody. The kit can realize the simultaneous, rapid and accurate quantitative detection of three early pregnancy indexes by one-time sampling, and provides more accurate reference basis for dynamically detecting the hormone level change in early pregnancy and predicting the pregnancy outcome of patients with early threatened abortion.

title_en: Multi-source soil environment data detection and space fusion processing method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for detecting and spatially fusing multisource soil environment data, which comprises the following steps: acquiring multi-source soil environment data by using an on-site sensor and a chemical reagent method; grouping according to attribute categories of the data; and carrying out fusion processing on any two groups of data of the same attribute category: on the basis of judging whether the two groups of data detection methods are the same, adjusting the data according to the difference value of the characteristic values of the data; judging whether the positions of the two groups of data after adjustment coincide in space or not, and adjusting the data again according to the comparison of the confidence interval or interpolation result of the data; combining the final adjusted data to generate fusion data; and visually displaying by adopting an image processing method. The method can solve the problem of data fusion of incomplete overlapping of the multi-source investigation detection result and the spatial point location, and provides a data basis for mining the data space-time double scale, so that the long-time and discrete multi-source soil environment data can be spatially fused and displayed.

title_en: Waste water detection instrument who possesses dropproof structure
abstract_en: The invention provides a waste water detection instrument with a drop-proof structure, relates to the technical field of waste water detectors, and solves the problems that the existing waste water detector cannot effectively protect the detector from drop in the practical application process, so that the waste water detector is damaged when being dropped, and the detection result is inaccurate and serious, so that the machine is possibly damaged and economic loss is possibly generated.

title_en: Water quality detection device and detection method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water quality detection device, which comprises a hull, wherein support frames are arranged on two sides of the hull, a driving assembly is arranged at the tail end of the hull, an aircraft is arranged on the upper side of each support frame, a submersible vehicle is arranged on the lower side of each support frame, the periphery of each aircraft is connected with a flight device, a winding shaft in each aircraft is connected with a buckle at the top end of the submersible vehicle through a traction line, the bottom end of each aircraft is connected with a detection device through a telescopic rod, the side edge of the bottom end of each aircraft is connected with a floater through a support rod, first cavities are arranged on two sides of the submersible vehicle, a plurality of through holes are formed in the bottom end of each first cavity, a second cavity is arranged in the middle of the submersible vehicle, an air. The invention can detect deeper water areas and can simultaneously detect a plurality of water surfaces and underwater, and the use is convenient and efficient.

title_en: Amlodipine hapten, artificial antigen, antibody and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses AN amlodipine hapten, AN artificial antigen, AN antibody, a preparation method and AN application thereof, wherein the amlodipine hapten AN-SSA is prepared firstly, the hapten is used to obtain AN amlodipine artificial complete antigen and AN amlodipine polyclonal antibody, the antibody has high sensitivity and high specificity recognition capability on amlodipine, the half inhibition concentration is 0.31 mu g/kg, the quantitative detection range is 0.04758-2.078 mu g/kg, the detection limit is 0.085 mu g/kg, and the cross reaction rate on felodipine and nitrendipine is lower than 1%. In addition, the invention establishes a colloidal gold immunochromatographic assay technology by using the amlodipine antibody, has a wider detection range and higher sensitivity, can specifically identify the detection of amlodipine, has a visual detection line of 20ng/mL, and has a wider application prospect in the rapid immune detection of amlodipine in health foods.

title_en: Affinity agent of TIGIT-IgV and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a affinity agent of TIGIT-IgV and application thereof, wherein the affinity agent is selected from amino acids shown in SEQ ID NOs:1, 3 or 4, or the structure of the affinity agent is shown in formula I or formula II, X1-Tyr-X2-His-X3-Arg-X4-X5(I) X1-Tyr-X2-His-X3-Arg-X4-X5- (L) n-X6 (II). The invention develops a new method, and the affinity agent obtained by repeated screening and optimization can better block the interaction between TIGIT/PVR, thereby treating tumors or other types of diseases.

title_en: Antigen binding proteins against proprotein convertase subtilisin KEXIN type 9 (PCSK9)
abstract_en: Antigen binding proteins that interact with proprotein convertase subtilisin kexin type 9 (PCSK9) are described. Methods of treating hypercholesterolemia and other diseases by administering a pharmaceutically effective amount of an antigen binding protein to PCSK9 are described. Methods of detecting the amount of PCSK9 in a sample using an antigen binding protein to PCSK9 are described.

title_en: Babesia canis BcMSA1-BcSA1 recombinant protein and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Babesia canis BcMSA1-BcSA1 recombinant protein, and belongs to the field of animal virus antibody detection. The recombinant protein comprises an amino acid sequence shown in SEQ ID NO.1 or consists of the amino acid sequence shown in SEQ ID NO. 1. The invention further discloses a gene of the recombinant protein, a vector and a host cell containing the gene, a preparation method of the recombinant protein and application of the recombinant protein in detecting an antibody of the Babesia canis. The recombinant protein is used for detecting the canine Babesia antibody, is convenient and rapid, has high sensitivity, no cross reaction with other pathogens, strong specificity, great clinical significance and wide application prospect.

title_en: Method for establishing dengue virus high-sensitivity detection based on nano magnetic bead immunochromatography technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dengue virus high-sensitivity detection method established based on a nano magnetic bead immunochromatography technology, and preparation of a dengue virus nano magnetic bead-antibody probe; assembling the nano magnetic bead test strip; the dengue virus detection method is characterized in that the dengue virus is detected by using the nano magnetic bead test strip, a novel dengue virus detection method based on the nano magnetic bead immunochromatography technology is established by utilizing the magnetic enrichment and separation function of the nano magnetic beads and the characteristic that color signals can be observed by naked eyes, the detection sensitivity can be effectively improved, the method is simple, convenient and easy to operate, and the dengue virus detection method can be used for large-scale rapid diagnosis.

title_en: Isocarbophos hapten, artificial antigen and antibody, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The isocarbophos hapten, the artificial antigen and the antibody as well as the preparation method and the application thereof are disclosed, the isocarbophos hapten provided by the invention not only furthest reserves the characteristic structure of isocarbophos, so that the immunogenicity of the isocarbophos hapten is obviously enhanced, but also has amino which can be coupled with carrier protein; the isocarbophos artificial antigen obtained by coupling isocarbophos hapten and carrier protein is used for immunizing animals, so that the animal immune response can be stimulated to generate antibodies with stronger specificity and higher sensitivity, the sensitivity of the isocarbophos antibody can reach 0.03 mu g/L through detection, the cross reaction rate with other organophosphorus insecticides is low, and a foundation is provided for the subsequent establishment of various immunoassay methods of isocarbophos.

title_en: Kit for measuring full-range C-reactive protein and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kit for measuring full-scale C-reactive protein, which comprises: fluorescence immunochromatography test paper strip and sample diluent, fluorescence immunochromatography test paper strip includes: the detection device comprises a bottom lining, a sample pad, a nitrocellulose membrane and a water absorption pad, wherein a quality control line and a detection line which are parallel to each other are arranged on the end, close to the water absorption pad, of the nitrocellulose membrane, and a trace particle labeled antibody line is arranged on the end, close to the sample pad, of the nitrocellulose membrane. According to the invention, the tracer particle labeled antibody is directly scratched on the nitrocellulose membrane in a special complex solution preparation mode, so that a marking mode and a conventional combined pad structure in the prior art are replaced, the detection sensitivity and accuracy are improved, and the preparation process of the test strip is simplified. Meanwhile, the sample is pretreated before the sample is added by preparing the sample diluent, so that the hemolysis phenomenon can be generated, the interference of background noise is avoided, and the stability of detection is further improved.

title_en: Water treatment facilities with quality of water monitoring function
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water treatment equipment and discloses water treatment equipment with a water quality monitoring function, which comprises a support, wherein a first barrel and a second barrel are arranged on the upper side wall of the support, two support rods are symmetrically and fixedly connected to the upper side wall of the support, the upper ends of the two support rods are fixedly connected with a same support plate, a cover plate is arranged at the upper end of the second barrel, limiting barrels are fixedly connected to the side walls of the two sides of the second barrel, two limiting plates matched with the limiting barrels are symmetrically and fixedly connected to the lower side wall of the cover plate, a clamping groove is formed in the inner wall of the limiting barrel, and a clamping plate is inserted in the clamping groove. According to the invention, after the stirring rod and the stirring plate work for a period of time, the stirring rod can be conveniently and quickly disassembled and assembled to clean the stirring rod and the stirring plate, so that the problems that more impurities are adhered to the surfaces of the stirring plate and the stirring rod, the energy consumption of a stirring part is increased, and the reasonable utilization of resources is inconvenient are solved.

title_en: Method for improving electrochemiluminescence signal in bioassay
