abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for biological analysis, in particular, to immunoassays and nucleic acid assays using electro-generated chemiluminescence or Electrochemiluminescence (ECL) of non-localized luminophores.

title_en: Digital mining gas sensor calibration and verification device and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a digital calibration and verification device and method for a mining gas sensor. The digital mining gas sensor calibration verification device comprises an upper computer, a data acquisition unit, a control instruction sending unit, a user interface unit, a data storage unit and a data transfer-out unit; the data acquisition unit comprises a switch, a serial port server, a CAN module and a data acquisition analysis module; one path of the switch is connected with the upper computer network port for collecting digital signals by upper computer software, the other path of the switch is connected with the serial port server for collecting digital signals of the Modbus protocol, the other paths of the switch is connected with the CAN module for collecting digital signals of the CAN protocol, the sensors are respectively configured with an IP and a port, the control instruction sending unit is connected with the upper computer and used for receiving commands sent by the upper computer and controlling the on-off of standard gas and the on-off of channels, and verification of the digital sensors of different communication protocols of the CAN and the Modbus is realized.

title_en: Method for driving a tyre on a simulated road surface of a worn roller
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for testing the wear of a tyre rolling on a roller-simulated road surface, comprising the following steps: -determining the relation between the speed and acceleration at the centre of gravity of the vehicle, and the angular and directional forces applied to a given axle, using the structural data of the vehicle and a dynamic balance model, -continuously recording the speed and acceleration of the vehicle travelling on a predetermined route, -arranging two tires belonging to the same axle on a drum simulated road surface, and applying the values of camber, load and longitudinal forces to each wheel of the axle at all times depending on the recorded values of speed and acceleration. The value of the lateral force experienced by each wheel is measured and the offset angle is varied such that the sum of the lateral forces resulting from the deflection of the tires is always equal to the lateral force applied to the axle center and such that the offset angle difference between the two wheels accounts for the parallelism variation applied to the axle.

title_en: Preparation and application of multiple signal amplification biosensor for detecting MUC1
abstract_en: The invention discloses a construction method and application of an enzyme-free multiple signal amplification biosensor capable of quantitatively detecting mucin 1. Quantitative analysis of mucin 1(MUC1) plays an important role for cancer prevention and early diagnosis. The invention constructs a high-sensitivity signal amplification strategy for detecting MUC1 based on Strand Displacement Reaction (SDR) and DNase cyclic amplification. The combination of MUC1 and Aptamer Probe (AP) initiates a strand displacement reaction, releasing the MUC1/AP complex for recycling and forming dnase at both ends of the double stranded product. The DNase can cyclically cleave a substrate Signal Probe (SP) while releasing a G-quadruplex sequence and a new active DNase sequence. This SDR-induced multiplex signal amplification system can generate a large number of G-quadruplex sequences and can generate a significantly enhanced colorimetric signal after incubation of hemin to improve sensitivity. The method can effectively distinguish MUC1 from other interference proteins, and has great potential in clinical diagnosis.

title_en: Construction, preparation and application of plasmodium falciparum RIFIN recombinant protein PfRIFIN-54
abstract_en: The invention relates to a plasmodium falciparum RIFIN recombinant protein coded by a plasmodium falciparum RIFIN gene PF3D7_0833100, which is named as PfRIFIN-54, the gene sequence of the recombinant protein is shown as SEQ ID No.1, and the amino acid sequence of the recombinant protein is shown as SEQ ID No. 4. A recombinant plasmid containing the gene PF3D7_ 0833100. A protein chip containing protein PfriFIN-54. The invention also discloses a preparation method of the plasmodium falciparum RIFIN recombinant protein. Compared with a control PfMSP1-42, the protein of the invention not only has better ability of specifically recognizing the serum of patients infected with plasmodium falciparum, but also shows obvious difference in the serum immunoreaction of severe patients and non-severe patients infected with plasmodium falciparum, and the positive rate of the immunoreaction of the serum of severe patients is obviously lower than that of the serum immunoreaction of non-severe patients.

title_en: Method for predicting titer of neutralizing antibody of novel coronavirus and kit thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for predicting the titer of a neutralizing antibody of a novel coronavirus and a kit thereof, and relates to the technical field of the titer prediction of the neutralizing antibody, wherein the method for predicting the titer of the neutralizing antibody of the novel coronavirus comprises the following steps: firstly, providing a biological sample to be detected, and then detecting the expression level of the novel coronavirus specific protein in a serum sample after the novel coronavirus specific protein is combined with an affinity antibody; the detection result is then correlated with the neutralizing antibody titer to predict the neutralizing antibody titer of the novel coronavirus in the biological sample to be tested. The method can well predict the result of the neutralizing antibody of the novel coronavirus only through serum detection, has the advantages of simple operation, high detection speed, short detection period and safe detection environment compared with the existing plaque reduction neutralization test and pseudovirus neutralization titer detection, and can be used as an evaluation index of secondary relapse after novel coronavirus vaccination or infection.

title_en: Therapeutic protein selection under simulated in vivo conditions
abstract_en: A method of determining the effect of non-specific interactions under simulated in vivo conditions is currently disclosed. The method comprises the following steps: (a) contacting a solution comprising a biologically relevant molecular crowding agent and a target molecule with a biosensor, wherein a surface of the biosensor comprises capture molecules that specifically bind the target molecule; (b) binding the target molecule to the capture molecule; and (c) determining the amount of said target molecule bound to the capture molecule using biolayer interferometry.

title_en: Preparation method, epitope identification and application of African swine fever virus p54 protein monoclonal antibody
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method, epitope identification and application of an ASFV p54 protein monoclonal antibody. The dominant epitope of p54 protein is analyzed, a proper region is selected to be cloned into a pET-30a vector, a prokaryotic expression vector pET-30a-p54-JD is constructed, an expressed p54 protein is purified and then immunized with a Balb/c mouse, spleen cells of the mouse and myeloma SP2/0 cells are taken to be fused after four times of immunization to prepare hybridoma cells, then an indirect ELISA method is utilized to perform subcloning to obtain a monoclonal antibody of the anti-p 54 protein, and the p54 protein epitope corresponding to the antibody is identified.

title_en: Method for determining soil drying degree according to rice leaf color ratio
abstract_en: A method for determining the degree of soil drying according to the leaf color ratio of rice belongs to the technical field of agriculture, the invention determines the degree of soil drying suitable for water-saving irrigation according to the leaf color ratio in the tillering stage, the jointing stage, the spike development stage, the early stage of grouting, the middle stage of grouting and the later stage of grouting of rice according to the leaf color ratio according to the synergistic and efficient quantitative relation of soil moisture, the leaf color ratio of the 3 rd fully-unfolded leaf and the 2 nd fully-unfolded leaf on the upper part of a rice stem and the yield, so as to guide the irrigation, and realize the synergistic improvement of the rice yield, the water utilization efficiency and the nitrogen fertilizer utilization efficiency. Compared with the conventional irrigation method, the method for determining the soil drying degree according to the rice leaf color ratio has the advantages that the rice yield, the irrigation water productivity and the nitrogen yield and grain utilization rate can be respectively improved by 10.41-11.07 percent, 44.6-49.3 percent and 10.63-12.10 percent.

title_en: Detection proteome of novel coronavirus SARS-CoV-2 and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a detection proteome of a novel coronavirus SARS-CoV-2 and application thereof, and a detection method for detecting the novel coronavirus SARS-CoV-2 is an enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay method. The invention optimizes the N protein, and selects the receptor binding region (RBD 331aa-532aa) of the S protein to express aiming at the novel coronavirus S gene through structural analysis, thereby further increasing the specificity of detection; by using an enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay method, whether the serum to be detected is positive or not can be efficiently and accurately determined by optimizing conditions such as coating concentration and time, primary-antibody and secondary-antibody incubation time, color development time and the like.

title_en: Detection apparatus for breed waters of shrimp or razor clam through microbial detection
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of aquaculture, in particular to a detection device for detecting a shrimp or razor clam aquaculture water area through microorganisms, which comprises a paying-off mechanism, a cable, a spherical water sample collection box, a detector, a mounting box, an internal pressure control mechanism and a load bearing block, wherein the cable is arranged on the pay-off mechanism; the paying-off mechanism is fixed on the bank; the cable is connected with the working end of the pay-off mechanism; the spherical water sample collecting box is fixedly connected with the other end of the cable and is positioned below the liquid level in a working state; the detector is arranged in the spherical water sample collection box; the mounting box is fixed at the bottom of the spherical water sample collecting box; the internal pressure control mechanism is arranged in the mounting box, and the working end penetrates through the top end of the mounting box to be communicated with the inside of the spherical water sample collecting box; the negative weight block is arranged at the bottom of the internal pressure control mechanism; this scheme seedlings such as prawn or razor clam play good protection effect, and structural strength is high, and resistance to pressure is good, the control of being convenient for, stable in structure.

title_en: Molecular sensor and cancer diagnosis system using the same
abstract_en: The present invention provides a molecular sensor capable of precisely detecting a detection target substance on a molecular basis by using the level of an oxidation-reduction potential, and more particularly, the present invention is characterized in that the levels of a negative electrode substance and a positive electrode substance are designed by analyzing the level of an oxidation-reduction potential of a substance to be detected, and thereby, when the detection target substance flows in, electrons are caused to move from a cathode to an anode using electrons supplied from the detection target substance as a medium.

title_en: Reproductive system disease detection kit
abstract_en: The invention relates to a reproductive system disease detection kit, and belongs to the field of diagnostic reagents and medical instruments. The kit comprises a monoclonal antibody for specifically recognizing f-PSA, has higher sensitivity, and is used for early screening diagnosis, curative effect detection and prognosis judgment of prostate diseases with PSA abnormality.

title_en: Carcinoembryonic antigen CEA detection kit
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of medical detection, and discloses a detection kit for carcinoembryonic antigen CEA. The kit comprises a reagent R1 and a reagent R2; the reagent R2 is a latex reagent coated with a carcinoembryonic antibody, and the latex reagent coated with the carcinoembryonic antibody is prepared by sealing a sealing agent comprising triethanolamine and casein. Experiments show that the latex reagent coated with the carcinoembryonic antibody is prepared by utilizing triethanolamine and casein in a closed manner, so that the detection sensitivity and the stability of the kit are effectively improved.

title_en: Immunochromatographic test piece
abstract_en: The problem to be solved by the present invention is to provide a test strip which can avoid the occurrence of the so-called bleaching phenomenon in an immunochromatographic test strip, thereby enabling better detection and visibility. Another object of the present invention is to provide an immunochromatographic test strip capable of preventing variation in a detection value on a test line. The present invention solves the aforementioned problems by an immunochromatographic test strip comprising at least a porous membrane and having a sample application region, a development region and a detection region on which a specific binding substance is immobilized, wherein the detection region is immobilized on the surface of the porous membrane, and wherein an opaque substrate having a thickness of 30 μm or more and 200 μm or less is provided on the back surface of the porous membrane.

title_en: Intelligent wardrobe based on gas-sensitive odor detection
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent wardrobe based on gas-sensitive odor detection, which comprises a microprocessor, a plurality of gas-sensitive sensors and a prompting device, wherein the microprocessor is connected with the gas-sensitive sensors; the signal end and the public end of the gas sensor are respectively connected to the signal end and the public end of the microprocessor through communication lines; the prompting device is in signal connection with the microprocessor; the microprocessor contains an odor identification model, compares a solving value theta of the odor identification model with a set threshold phi, and triggers the response of the microprocessor to the signal from the sensor if the solving value theta is greater than the threshold phi, so as to trigger the prompting device to send out prompting information; if the value is less than or equal to the threshold value phi, no response is given, and the device is prompted to not work; the intelligent wardrobe capable of detecting peculiar smell by gas-sensitive sensing provided by the invention not only can be convenient for a user to quickly and efficiently search and find out various clothes and other stored articles stored in the wardrobe, but also can carry out intelligent detection according to whether peculiar smell is generated in the wardrobe or not so as to remind the user to find and treat the peculiar smell in time, and is greatly beneficial to the body health of the user.

title_en: Method and chromatographic system for determining the amount and purity of multimeric proteins
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a chromatography system and method for assessing the amount and/or purity of multimeric proteins in a sample, wherein the chromatography system comprises two different affinity chromatography matrices connected via an on-off valve.

title_en: Food material type detection method based on motor attribute and food processing machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a food material type detection method based on motor attributes and a food processing machine, wherein the method comprises the following steps: respectively collecting different food material types of the food processing machine and motor attribute values corresponding to the food material types in a preset mode; fitting the collected food material types and the collected motor attribute values to obtain a fitting relation between the food material types and the motor attribute values; and determining the food material type during processing of the food processing machine according to the comparison between the actual motor attribute value and the fitting relation. The food material type detection method based on the motor attribute and the food processing machine disclosed by the invention have the advantages that the rapid fitting of the food material type and the motor attribute value of the food processing machine is realized, different food material types are distinguished based on the attribute of the motor, the intellectualization and automation of the food processing machine are realized, and the system sensor is reduced, so that the hardware cost is reduced.

title_en: Device for replacing sample suction gun head of chemiluminescence immunoassay analyzer
abstract_en: The invention provides a device for replacing a sample suction gun head of a chemiluminescence immunoassay analyzer, which belongs to the technical field of medical instruments and comprises: the device comprises a frame, a first conveying channel and a second conveying channel, wherein a first discharging frame is arranged in the first conveying channel, and a second discharging frame is arranged in the second conveying channel; the first lifting mechanism is arranged on one side of the rack, and a feeding platform is arranged on the first lifting mechanism; and the second lifting mechanism is arranged on the other side of the rack, and a discharging platform is arranged on the second lifting mechanism. The feeding platform is respectively communicated with the first transmission channel or the second transmission channel in a butt joint mode, the corresponding first sample suction gun head and the second sample suction gun head on the first discharging frame and the second discharging frame are timely supplemented, and the discharging platform is respectively communicated with the first transmission channel or the second transmission channel in a butt joint mode, so that the corresponding output of the first sample suction gun head or the second sample suction gun head is achieved, and the purpose of replacing the sample suction gun heads is achieved.

title_en: Quick sampling treatment air chamber for gas
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of gas collection and signal processing, and discloses a gas rapid sampling processing gas chamber, which comprises a gas chamber body, wherein a sampling cavity is formed in the gas chamber body, a fixing cavity is connected with the sampling cavity, a gas sensor is fixedly arranged in the fixing cavity, a control circuit board is fixedly arranged on the gas chamber body, the control circuit board comprises a signal processing module and a main control module which are connected together, the gas sensor is electrically connected with the signal processing module, and the signal processing module processes an analog signal collected by the gas sensor into a digital signal and amplifies the digital signal and then sends the digital signal to the main control module; the device realizes the whole process of gas collection to be detected, signal processing and signal interaction with monitoring equipment by combining the control circuit board with the gas chamber body; and can finish the processing of the sampled signal fast; meanwhile, the collection cavity and the air passage are respectively arranged in the air chamber body, so that the collection can be rapidly completed; meanwhile, the temperature control module enables the air chamber body to be kept at a constant temperature, so that acquired data are more accurate.

title_en: Multifunctional gas component dynamic change and dynamic detection device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional gas component dynamic change and dynamic detection device, belongs to the technical field of gas reaction devices and gas detection devices, and aims at a flowing, short-time or open dynamic gas component change process. The device comprises a single-function, small and simple assembly and is provided with a unified interface. The device has different functions through the closed connection of a certain number and sequence of the components and the simple electromechanical control, thereby completing different tasks. The device comprises a conveying assembly (1), a control assembly (2), a monitoring assembly (3), a detection assembly (4), a reaction assembly (5) and a shell assembly (6). The device can decompose the complicated and concentrated gas component change and detection process into a plurality of simple and continuous steps; the change and detection of the dynamic gas components are more convenient and popular; the functions are rich, and the diversified requirements of teaching and basic experiments are met; the corresponding working efficiency is improved, and the cost is reduced.

title_en: Detection kit for B factor
abstract_en: The application relates to a detection kit for B factor. The kit comprises a first reagent, a second reagent, and optionally a calibrator. The first reagent comprises: Tris-HCl buffer solution, sodium chloride, polyoxyethylene lauryl ether, polyethylene glycol 4000 and sodium azide; the second reagent comprises: Tris-HCl buffer solution, sodium chloride, sodium azide and factor B antibody; the calibrator comprises: factor B, phosphate buffer solution, sodium chloride, disodium ethylene diamine tetraacetate and sodium azide. The reagent has accurate detection result and high sensitivity.

title_en: Water quality time sequence prediction method based on improved Seq2Seq frame
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a water quality time series prediction method based on an improved Seq2Seq framework, wherein a model constructed by adopting the improved Seq2Seq framework has good prediction performance on time series data, a known time step and a prediction time step can be freely set, and the prediction length is flexible and variable by using the encoding and decoding processes. By adopting the method, the key problem of predicting the univariate by using the covariate in the water quality prediction problem is solved, and the GRU model is used as an encoder and a decoder and is integrated with the FM model, so that the interaction problem of the high sparsity and the high-dimensional characteristics of data is solved, and the technical problem which is not solved by a water quality prediction model in the prior art is solved.

title_en: Solid nanotube and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biological analysis and discloses a solid-state nanotube and a preparation method and application thereof. The PDA film is modified around the inner wall of the solid nano tube at the inner tube opening of the solid nano tube. The invention adopts a simple method to polymerize dopamine in situ on the solid nanotube, the diameter of the modified nanotube is reduced to below 10nm from about 90-120nm, the perforation rate can be greatly slowed down due to pi-pi conjugation and hydrogen bond action between PDA and oligonucleotide, different bases with the same length can be distinguished through the interaction between PDA and bases, and oligonucleotides with different lengths can be distinguished through retention time, thus achieving the purpose of analyzing the length, the bases and the modified groups of a single oligonucleotide chain by the modified solid nanotube.

title_en: Antibody for detecting novel coronavirus and detection kit
abstract_en: The invention discloses an antibody for detecting novel coronavirus and a detection kit. The invention also relates to nucleic acid molecules encoding the antibodies and methods of using these antibodies for diagnosis.

title_en: Nano-pore membrane with hydrophobic coating and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nano-pore membrane with a hydrophobic coating, and a preparation method and application thereof. The nanopore membrane is grafted with an SSDNA aptamer, and any surface of the nanopore membrane is provided with a hydrophobic coating. A preparation method of a nanopore membrane with a hydrophobic coating comprises the following steps: s1: cleaning the nanopore membrane; s2: depositing a hydrophobic material on one surface of the nanopore membrane in a vapor phase manner to obtain the nanopore membrane with the hydrophobic coating; s3: the SSDNA aptamer was grafted to the nanopore membrane with the hydrophobic coating obtained in step S2. The invention is applied to mercury ion detection. According to the nanopore membrane with the hydrophobic coating, due to the fact that the SSDNA aptamer is grafted, the nanopore membrane can be used for detecting an object to be detected combined with the SSDNA aptamer, the object to be detected is effectively gathered by utilizing the concentration effect of the hydrophobic coating, and therefore specific detection of the object to be detected is achieved, and a detection signal of the object to be detected is amplified.

title_en: Magnetic microsphere detection kit for detecting glycosylated CD59 and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a magnetic microsphere detection kit for detecting glycosylated CD59, which consists of magnetic microspheres coupled with anti-gCD 59 monoclonal antibody, gCD59 standard substance gradient solution, sample diluent, peroxidase-labeled anti-CD 59 monoclonal antibody enzyme conjugate, 20 multiplied by concentrated cleaning solution and luminescent solution which are arranged in a box body. The invention also discloses application of the kit in detecting gCD 59-containing biological samples. Experiments prove that the kit disclosed by the invention is high in stability, strong in selectivity, high in detection speed, low in cost, easy to operate, and capable of overcoming the defects of low sensitivity, long operation time and the like in gCD59 detection in the prior art, the operation time is shortened from 400 minutes to 30 minutes, the quantification limit is improved from 18.75pg/mL to 5pg/mL, and the kit has a very good clinical application prospect.

title_en: Integrated pump station integrated control system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an integrated pump station, in particular to a comprehensive control system of the integrated pump station. The invention integrates the front system and the rear system of the pump station into a whole to form a complete control system. The integrated pump station comprehensive control system comprises a pump station main body, a water inlet tank, a first connecting pipe, a thick grid and a flowmeter and a water outlet electric valve, wherein one end of the pump station main body is provided with the water inlet pipe, the other end of the pump station main body is provided with the water outlet pipe, the water inlet tank is communicated with the pump station main body through the water inlet pipe, one end of the first connecting pipe is communicated with the water inlet tank, the other end of the first connecting pipe is communicated with a water drawing end, the thick grid is fixed in the water inlet tank and used for separating the water inlet pipe from the first connecting pipe, the water outlet pipe is provided with the flowmeter and the water outlet electric valve, the water outlet pipe is communicated with the discharge end, one end of the water inlet pipe is provided with the basket grid, and the other end of the water inlet pipe is provided with the water inlet electric valve.

title_en: Enterprise pollution discharge monitoring method, device, system and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses an enterprise pollution discharge monitoring method, device and system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring enterprise facility operation data; acquiring intermediate process data of an enterprise; acquiring enterprise terminal row port data; and sending the obtained enterprise facility operation data, the enterprise intermediate process data and the enterprise terminal row port data to a cloud system platform, and performing data storage and data analysis on the cloud system platform to generate and output enterprise environment comprehensive evaluation data. The technical problems of low pollution monitoring efficiency and large error caused by lack of data support for enterprise activity related parameters in the prior art are solved.

title_en: Big data sewage monitoring system based on thing networking
abstract_en: The invention discloses a big data sewage monitoring system based on the Internet of things, which belongs to the technical field of sewage treatment monitoring and comprises an Internet of things communication module and a cloud treatment center, wherein the output end of the cloud treatment center is connected with a sewage treatment unit, the input end of the sewage treatment unit is connected with a change intervention unit, the input end of the change intervention unit is connected with the Internet of things communication module, and the input end of the Internet of things communication module is connected with the output end of the cloud treatment center. According to the invention, multiple data can be accurately judged through an algorithm, when an enterprise steals, arranges and leaks, the routing inspection alarm module of the change intervention unit drives the linkage routing inspection personnel to carry out parking sudden inspection on a plant area, the power control module can carry out remote power-off treatment on the discharge equipment when an alarm is obtained, the environmental pollution caused by continuous steal and arrangement of sewage is avoided, the judgment precision is obviously improved by matching the algorithm with the big data water level database, and the integral use requirement is met.

title_en: Die casting burr measuring system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a die casting burr measuring system and a die casting burr measuring method, aiming at the problem that after the existing die casting is produced, a certain amount of burrs or flashes often appear on the outer surface of the die casting, but the lengths of the burrs or flashes cannot be actually measured, so that the machining precision of a production machine cannot be accurately measured. The invention can realize accurate measurement and analog display of the flash generated on the die casting, so that the precision on the production machinery can be accurately controlled, and the precision of the production machinery can be accurately adjusted, thereby having good use convenience.

title_en: Die casting burr measuring system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a die casting burr measuring system and a die casting burr measuring method, aiming at the problem that after the existing die casting is produced, a certain amount of burrs or flashes often appear on the outer surface of the die casting, but the lengths of the burrs or flashes cannot be actually measured, so that the machining precision of a production machine cannot be accurately measured. The invention can realize accurate measurement and analog display of the flash generated on the die casting, so that the precision on the production machinery can be accurately controlled, and the precision of the production machinery can be accurately adjusted, thereby having good use convenience.

title_en: Operation method of two-way inclined ground access type shield launching model test device capable of being accurately controlled
abstract_en: An operation method of a bidirectional inclined ground access type shield launching model test device capable of being accurately controlled determines a reduced scale and a test scheme according to the actual situation and site conditions of a ground access type shield launching project, selects a shield model box and a model shield machine which meet the test requirements, lays a soil body, and inputs the coordinates of the central point of the shield launching axis, the horizontal inclination angle and the vertical inclination angle into a microcomputer according to the test scheme of the ground access type shield launching model test; excavating a soil body, confirming various parameters to a microcomputer, and starting a model test; mounting a shield reaction system on a reaction system guide rail; and (5) installing a model shield tunneling machine. The method can be applied to ground-in shield initial model tests with any angle and inclined plane, and the angle adjusting operation has high automation degree and is simple and clear.

title_en: Testing device and method for anti-caking effect of redispersible latex powder
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of redispersible application technology, and particularly discloses a redispersible latex powder anti-caking effect testing device and a method. An experimental test method for anti-caking effect of redispersible latex powder comprises the following steps of S1: vertically placing a sleeve on a horizontal base, placing latex powder in the sleeve, beating the sleeve for several times, and then placing a cylinder in the sleeve to obtain an experiment whole; s2: putting the whole experiment in the step S1 into a heating device, standing for 8-20h at the temperature of 30-70 ℃, and taking out; s3: the whole experiment taken out in the step S2 is placed in a standard curing room to room temperature; s4: and (5) taking out the latex powder in the step S3, and sieving. The application has the effect of conveniently detecting the anti-caking performance of the redispersible latex powder.

title_en: Formaldehyde detection method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a formaldehyde detection method, which uses two formaldehyde sensors with different reaction strengths on interference components; starting two formaldehyde sensors to work; respectively and simultaneously acquiring original detection data of target detection gas by using two formaldehyde sensors; then mixing purified gas into the target detection gas to form mixed gas, and respectively acquiring comparison detection data of the mixed gas by using two formaldehyde sensors; and comparing the original detection data and the comparison detection data of the two formaldehyde sensors to judge whether the interference gas exists or not, and calculating the formaldehyde concentration value in the target detection gas when the two formaldehyde sensors are started according to the original detection data and the comparison detection data of the two formaldehyde sensors. The formaldehyde detection method can effectively realize anti-interference and obtain a more accurate formaldehyde concentration detection result when the machine is started.

title_en: Clinical examination of clinical laboratory is with adopting urine inspection structure that has storage frame that circles round
abstract_en: The invention discloses a urine collection test structure with a rotary storage rack for clinical test of clinical laboratory, which comprises a main box body, wherein a box door is arranged on one side of the main box body, fourth gears are fixedly connected to two rotary transverse shafts, the two fourth gears are meshed with the third gears, sliding sleeve bolts are connected to the two rotary transverse shafts, atomizing nozzles are fixedly connected to the two sliding sleeve bolts, and a peculiar smell removal device is arranged on one side of the main box body. The wine bottle has a reasonable structure, not only can intermittently inject the wine liquid into the main box body through the intermittent injection device so as to reduce the temperature in the main box body, but also can disinfect the interior of the main box body, and can absorb and remove the peculiar smell in the main box body through the peculiar smell removing device, and continuously ventilate the interior of the main box body so as to ensure the air environment in the main box body.

title_en: Automatic detector for multiple magnetosensitive biological chips
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic detector for a plurality of magnetic-sensitive biological chips, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a magnetic-sensitive biological detection unit is arranged on the bottom plate, and a fluid driving unit is arranged on one side of the magnetic-sensitive biological detection unit, wherein: the magnetic-sensing biological detection unit comprises a GMR magnetic-sensing biological chip, a chip chamber and a chip loading table, wherein the chip loading table is of a clamping groove structure, a plurality of mounting clamping grooves which are arranged in parallel are formed in the bottom of an inner cavity of the chip loading table, and a chip chamber is arranged in each mounting clamping groove; a GMR magneto-sensitive sensing biochip is arranged in each chip chamber; the mobile head is provided with a signal acquisition unit which is used for acquiring information stored by the GMR magneto-sensitive sensing biochip and transmitting the acquired stored information to the controller; the invention effectively improves the detection efficiency; compatible detection of different biological sensing chips can be realized; thus realizing low-cost, rapid and accurate detection of the GMR-based biological sensing chip.

title_en: Magnetic particles and method
abstract_en: The magnetic particle (30, 70) has a layered structure (6, 56) between a top surface of the particle and an opposite bottom surface of the particle. The layers of the structure include one or more nonmagnetic layers and one or more magnetized layers. The ratio of the lateral dimension of the one or more magnetized layers to the total thickness of the one or more magnetized layers is greater than 500. A plurality of such magnetic particles (30, 70) may be functionalized and marked with a readable code (16, 66) corresponding to the functionalization for performing an assay, such as a bioassay.

title_en: Hybridoma cell strain secreting gelsemine monoclonal antibody and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of immunodetection, and particularly relates to a hybridoma cell strain secreting gelsemine monoclonal antibody and application thereof. The monoclonal antibody secreted by the hybridoma cell strain MY-2 has good specificity and sensitivity (IC) to gelsemine 50 The value can reach 0.66 ng/mL), and the content detection of the gelsemine in samples such as honey, blood plasma, vomit and the like can be realized. The gelsemine belongs to the characteristic of gelsemium which is a highly toxic plantThe compound is used for detecting the content of gelsemine in a sample, and has great practical application value for guaranteeing the quality safety of honey, avoiding poisoning events and diagnosing gelsemium poisoning persons in time.

title_en: Laboratory is with water oil separating testing arrangement
abstract_en: The invention relates to a separating device, in particular to an oil-water separation testing device for a laboratory. The technical problem to be solved is as follows: the utility model provides a laboratory is with water oil separating testing arrangement convenient to get rid of the residue to oil water mixture, can extract grease in it and carry out the detection. The technical scheme is as follows: the utility model provides an oil-water separation testing arrangement is used in laboratory, including: the mount pad, mount pad top one side is equipped with places the mechanism. The oil-water mixture with the residues can be separated through the arranged placing mechanism, and the residues in the oil-water mixture can be separated; the oil-water mixture without residue can continuously flow into the separation barrel through the arranged injection mechanism without manual multiple addition.

title_en: Underground gas detection device based on grounding circulation monitoring
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underground gas detection device based on grounding circulation monitoring, and relates to the technical field of grounding circulation monitoring devices. The CMG sensor comprises a first mounting cylinder and a second mounting cylinder, wherein a second rotating shaft is arranged on one side of the first mounting cylinder and one side of the second mounting cylinder, an electric wire is arranged between the first mounting cylinder and the second mounting cylinder, and an electricity taking coil and two CMG sensors are matched on the peripheral sides of the first mounting cylinder and the second mounting cylinder in a sliding manner. According to the grounding circulation monitoring device, the CMG sensor and the electricity taking coil are arranged in the sub-cabin manner, so that the influence of electromagnetism of a power supply end on the CMG sensor is reduced, the practicability of the grounding circulation monitoring device is improved, and the magnetic rings are arranged above and below the electricity taking coil and can be used for compensating external magnetic field interference errors and magnetic field interference errors of a power supply, so that the measurement accuracy of the grounding circulation monitoring device is improved.

title_en: Pollution type identification method and device and storage medium
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a pollution type identification method and apparatus, and a storage medium, the method comprising: determining a first index sequence and a second index sequence of a predetermined water area in a first time period according to the water quality information of the predetermined water area; determining at least one pollution identification parameter according to the first index sequence and the second index sequence; and inputting at least one water quality distinguishing parameter into the pollution type recognition model for processing, and determining the water quality pollution type of the preset water area. According to the pollution type identification method disclosed by the embodiment of the disclosure, the first index sequence and the second index sequence of the preset water area can be measured in situ, on line and at high frequency through the water quality information, and various pollution types can be analyzed in real time according to the two indexes, so that the accuracy and the application range of pollution type identification are improved.

title_en: Fluorescence ratio type immunoassay method for detecting fenitrothion
abstract_en: The invention provides a fluorescence ratio type immunoassay method of fenitrothion. The method comprises the steps of coating fenitrothion coating antigen in a micropore plate, fusing alkaline phosphatase (Nb-ALP) recognition and signal amplification elements with fenitrothion nano antibodies, competitively binding fenitrothion in a sample and the coating antigen on the plate with Nb-ALP, then washing off redundant drugs and antibodies, catalyzing the Nb-ALP connected with the micropore plate, and hydrolyzing L-ascorbic acid-2-trisodium phosphate (AAP) added subsequently to generate Ascorbic Acid (AA); subsequently, o-phenylenediamine (OPD), chitosan-modified platinum nanoparticles (Ch-Pt NPs) are added, and AA and OPD are competitively oxidized by Ch-Pt NPs with oxidation-like characteristics. Wherein OPD is oxidized into fluorescent substance 2, 3-Diaminophenol (DAP), and the fluorescence emission peak is 568 nm; the oxidation state AA reacts with OPD to generate quinoxaline Derivative (DFQ), and the fluorescence emission peak is 430 nm; therefore, the content of fenitrothion in the sample is more sensitively reflected on the fluorescence ratio of 430nm to 568nm, and the purpose of high-sensitivity detection of fenitrothion pesticide is realized.

title_en: Application of anti-SSA autoantibody as diagnosis marker of Hirschmannica
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biomedicine, in particular to application of an anti-SSA autoantibody as a diagnosis marker of Hirschsprung's disease. The invention finds that the anti-SSA autoantibody has the advantages of simple operation, no intervention, high flux and low cost in the congenital disease diagnosis of children, and fills the blank of the congenital megacolon plasma diagnosis. The diagnostic sensitivity and specificity of the method are good, and the AUC is 0.7756; the optimal limit corresponds to a sensitivity of 62.50% and a specificity of 74.36%, overcoming the disadvantages of the prior art without plasma diagnosis.

title_en: A sample chemical examination device that is used for marker screening of early examination of esophagus cancer to examine
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of medical equipment, in particular to a sample testing device for marker screening for early screening of esophageal cancer, which aims at solving the problems that most of the existing tumor markers are observed and detected in an exposed environment, so that bacterial infection is easy to cause, and the device is inconvenient to clean after the sample detection is finished. The invention has simple operation and convenient use, can facilitate the sealing inspection of the sample by people, can also facilitate the cleaning of the interior, is convenient for the supplement and addition of the inspection reagent and is convenient for the use of people.

title_en: Peripheral blood TCR marker of acute myelocytic leukemia and detection kit and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a TCR marker of peripheral blood of acute myelocytic leukemia and a detection kit and application thereof. The marker comprises at least one protein with a sequence of SEQ ID NO. 1-100. Based on a high-throughput sequencing method, only a small amount of peripheral blood is needed to be taken, RNA is extracted, an immune map library is established through sample processing, and through high-throughput sequencing and TCR data analysis, a characteristic TCR sequence in the peripheral blood of the acute myelocytic leukemia is determined firstly, and then a test result of a sample to be tested is compared with the characteristic TCR sequence, so that whether the acute myelocytic leukemia is suffered or not is determined. The invention can simultaneously compare a great number of acute myelocytic leukemia specific TCR sequences, has higher specificity and accuracy compared with the single detection of one or more markers, and improves the diagnosis efficiency.

title_en: Donor reagent and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a donor reagent and application thereof. The donor reagent provided by the invention comprises a buffer solution and donor particles suspended in the buffer solution, wherein the donor particles can generate active oxygen after being excited, and the donor reagent is characterized in that the ZETA potential of the donor particles in the donor reagent is not higher than-10 mV and not lower than-60 mV. The kit containing the donor reagent can be used for measuring the content of the marker in the body fluid of the main body, and has the advantages of high sample discrimination and good test performance.

title_en: Human immunodeficiency virus antibody detection kit and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a human immunodeficiency virus antibody detection kit, which comprises a reagent R1, wherein the reagent R1 comprises a first buffer solution and acceptor particles which are suspended in the first buffer solution and can react with active oxygen to generate a chemiluminescent signal, and is characterized in that: the receptor particles comprise a carrier, the interior of the carrier is filled with a luminous composition, and the surface of the carrier is bonded with HIV antigen; the receptor particles have a particle size distribution coefficient of variation C.V value in the receptor agent of not less than 5% and not more than 20%; the sugar content in the acceptor particle is not higher than 25 mug per milligram by mass. The receptor particle size distribution variation coefficient C.V value of the R1 reagent in the kit is not lower than 5% and not higher than 20%, and the sugar content in each milligram of the receptor particles is not higher than 25 mug; furthermore, the R1 reagent can meet the commercial requirement of mass production, has ultrahigh sensitivity and has a very wide detection range.

title_en: Preparation of enzyme linked immunosorbent assay kit for detecting variegated aflatoxin
abstract_en: The invention relates to an enzyme linked immunosorbent assay kit for detecting the aflatoxin and a detection method thereof, which have the advantages of sensitive, accurate and rapid detection, simple and convenient operation and strong specificity and are suitable for detecting a large number of samples. The kit comprises: the kit comprises an ELISA plate for coating a variegated aflatoxin antigen, a variegated aflatoxin standard substance, a variegated aflatoxin antibody working solution, a variegated aflatoxin enzyme-labeled secondary antibody working solution, a substrate solution A, a substrate solution B, a stop solution, a concentrated diluent and a concentrated washing solution. The principle of the enzyme linked immunosorbent assay kit for detecting the variegated aflatoxin is that a solid phase indirect competitive enzyme linked immunoreaction is carried out, an extracted sample, enzyme-labeled secondary antibody working solution and antibody working solution are added into corresponding micropores of an enzyme label plate, after incubation for a period of time, the substrate solution A and the substrate solution B are added into the plate, a color developing agent presents blue under the action of enzyme, and a stop solution is added, so that the color is changed from blue to yellow. The color depth of the color development is inversely proportional to the content of the aflatoxin in the standard or the sample. The method can be directly used for detecting the residual quantity of the aflatoxin in the dairy product.

title_en: Apparatus and method for droplet detection of cells
abstract_en: Devices, systems, and associated methods for manipulating and/or determining one or more characteristics of cells contained in a biological sample are provided. In particular, an apparatus and method of using the apparatus are provided, the apparatus comprising: a sorting component configured to separate a droplet containing cells from an empty droplet into a first population of droplets containing cells; a droplet manipulation member configured to manipulate the first droplet using a real or virtual electrowetting electrode; and an optical detection system configured to detect an optical signal from the droplet through the one or more detection windows.

title_en: Biological detection kit and detection method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a biological detection kit and a detection method thereof, and relates to the technical field of detection equipment. The utility model provides a biological detection kit and detection method, which comprises an outer shell, the equal fixedly connected with supporting leg in lower surface four corners of shell, the leading flank center department fixedly connected with kelly of shell, the equal fixedly connected with hinge of the upper surface rear end left and right sides of shell, the upper surface fixedly connected with upper cover of hinge one, the trailing flank upper end fixedly connected with handle of upper cover, current biological detection kit when using has been solved, the fixed buffer of test tube encloses the test tube and closes, only play simple fixed guard action, after putting into biological sampling in the test tube, because the test tube outer wall is enclosed and closes, heating device can't heat the test tube well in the kit, can't guarantee that the microorganism can survive at suitable temperature in the test tube, thereby cause adverse effect to follow-up testing result, make the great problem of testing result error.

title_en: Method for detecting bacterial endotoxin in egg yolk lecithin by gel method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for detecting bacterial endotoxin in egg yolk lecithin by a gel method, which comprises the following steps: determining a limit L of bacterial endotoxin in egg yolk lecithin and a minimum effective dilution concentration c; rechecking the sensitivity of the limulus reagent; carrying out interference pre-test on the test sample solution with different dilution times to find out the maximum non-interference concentration under the condition of no interference, and carrying out interference test on the test sample solution with the maximum non-interference concentration; an absolute ethanol interference test; egg yolk lecithin interference test. According to the method for detecting the bacterial endotoxin in the egg yolk lecithin by the gel method, the bacterial endotoxin in the egg yolk lecithin is accurately detected by a simple method, and the detection of a test solution can effectively eliminate interference.

title_en: Method for detecting acid resistance of antacid
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for detecting the acid resistance of an antacid, which comprises the following steps: uniformly mixing hydrochloric acid and pure water which are respectively preheated to 37 +/-1 ℃ in a volume ratio of 1: 0-1: 1, wherein the concentration of the hydrochloric acid is 0.05-0.2 mol/L to obtain a mixed solution A, adding an antacid to be detected into the mixed solution A, stirring, timing and monitoring the pH value, adding 0.05-0.2 mol/L hydrochloric acid preheated to 37 +/-1 ℃ into the system at a constant speed when 10-30 min is carried out after the antacid is added, recording the change of the pH value, and obtaining the time when the pH value reaches 3.0, the maximum pH value and the time when the pH value is kept at 3.0-5.0. The method for detecting the acid resistance of the antacid improves the regional component of the acid resistance of the antacid with different prescriptions and processes, can detect the change of the acid resistance in the storage process, and improves the quality evaluation index of the medicine.

title_en: Buffer solution for coronary heart disease blood amino-terminal brain natriuretic peptide detection and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a buffer solution for coronary heart disease blood amino-terminal brain natriuretic peptide detection and a use method thereof, relating to the technical field of whole blood sample pretreatment and comprising the following steps: the buffer solution comprises Tris hydrochloride, heparin sodium, BS12 amphoteric surfactant, CA630 neutral surfactant and Benzonase nuclease, and the pH value of the buffer solution is 6.8; the molar concentration of Tris hydrochloride is 98-103 mM, the addition amount of heparin sodium is 9-11 IU, the mass percentage content of BS12 amphoteric surfactant is 0.08-0.12%, the mass percentage content of CA630 neutral surfactant is 0.09-0.11%, and the addition amount of Benzonase nuclease is 0.8-1.3 IU. The product pretreats a whole blood sample by using a newly designed Tris buffer solution, so that the blood sample to be detected can detect myoglobin on colloidal gold test paper, and is suitable for coronary heart disease patients needing to monitor myocardial infarction risks at any time.

title_en: Full-automatic immunoassay device
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a fully automated immunoassay device configured to directly perform an immunoassay test on a whole blood sample without the need to pre-process the whole blood sample. The device comprises a detection assembly, a sample supply assembly, a reagent supply assembly and a cuvette supply assembly. The detection mechanism of the detection assembly comprises an excitation light source and a photon detector. One or more reagent components and a target in a whole blood sample to be tested immunoreact in a cuvette at the testing assembly to produce a long-afterglow luminescent complex. The excitation light source is configured to excite the long-afterglow luminescent compound in the reaction cup and is turned off after excitation is completed, and the photon detector is configured to collect luminescent signals emitted by the long-afterglow luminescent compound after the excitation light source is turned off. The device directly detects the whole blood sample in the blood collection tube, and can realize full-automatic detection.

title_en: Complex comprising a ligand and a CEACAM5 antibody Fab fragment
abstract_en: The present invention provides a complex comprising a ligand, a spacer and a peptide linker useful in vivo diagnostic agents and internal irradiation therapies, using an anti-human CEACAM5 antibody Fab fragment whose binding activity is not reduced by labeling with a metal, a fluorescent dye or the like. A complex comprising an anti-human CEACAM5 antibody Fab fragment containing a heavy chain fragment comprising a heavy chain variable region composed of a specific amino acid sequence and a light chain comprising a light chain variable region composed of a specific amino acid sequence, and a spacer, or a complex comprising a ligand, a spacer and a peptide linker, the binding activity of which is not impaired by labeling with a metal, a fluorescent dye or the like, can be used as a diagnostic composition and/or a pharmaceutical composition.

title_en: Two-chamber model experiment device for simulating medicament in-vivo release and absorption process
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of dissolution detection equipment, and relates to a two-chamber model experiment device for simulating the in-vivo release and absorption process of a medicament, which comprises a box body and a medicament dissolution part; the drug eluting member includes a drug mounting member, an eluting inner chamber, and an eluting outer chamber; the dissolution inner chamber comprises a simulated gastric pouch part and a drug absorption part; a hammering and stirring device is arranged in the dissolution outer chamber and is positioned at the periphery of the simulated gastric bag part; the medicine placing basket at the end part of the medicine installation part is inserted in the dissolution inner chamber, a medium input pipeline inserted in the dissolution inner chamber is communicated with a dissolution medium source, an inserted sampling pipe is connected to the sampling three-way valve through a liquid outlet main pipeline, and a liquid inlet pump and a liquid outlet pump are respectively arranged on the medium input pipeline and the liquid outlet main pipeline. Through the up-and-down reciprocating motion of the dissolution medium in the dissolution inner chamber, the situation of drug fragment accumulation is avoided, meanwhile, the uniformity of the concentration of the dissolution liquid which is dissolved out by Cheng Gege part is ensured, the occurrence of protruding points is avoided, and the in-vivo and in-vitro relativity is good.

title_en: Tryptophan optical probe and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a tryptophan optical probe and a preparation method and application thereof. In one aspect, the invention relates to an optical probe comprising a tryptophan-sensitive polypeptide or a functional variant thereof and an optically active polypeptide or a functional variant thereof, wherein the optically active polypeptide or the functional variant thereof is located within the sequence of the tryptophan-sensitive polypeptide or the functional variant thereof. The invention also relates to a preparation method of the probe and application of the probe in tryptophan detection.

title_en: Energy-saving emission-reducing examination and evaluation device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of energy conservation and emission reduction, in particular to an energy conservation and emission reduction examination and evaluation device which comprises a sewage tank and detection equipment, wherein a motor is fixedly connected to the central position of the top end of the sewage tank, a speed reducer is fixedly connected to the output end of the motor, the output end of the speed reducer is connected with a rotating mechanism, the rotating mechanism is inserted into the sewage tank, an anti-blocking mechanism is arranged on one side of the rotating mechanism, a water inlet pipe is fixedly communicated with one side of the upper end of the sewage tank, one side of the anti-blocking mechanism is inserted into the water inlet pipe, a lifting mechanism is arranged on the outer side of the lower end of the rotating mechanism, and a scraping mechanism is connected to the lower end of the lifting mechanism. Before detecting sewage, can stir the mixture to sewage, guarantee to detect data's accuracy, can strike off the spot on the sewage incasement wall when stirring, prevent that the spot on the sewage incasement wall from piling up too much and can influence the detection of follow-up sewage, simultaneously, can also dredge the inlet tube, prevent in the inlet tube because accumulational mud piece blocking phenomenon appears, guarantee testing process.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle system for monitoring gas quality
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle system for monitoring gas quality, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle, a gas detection device, a posture-fixing height-fixing device and an obstacle avoidance device, wherein the posture-fixing height-fixing device and the obstacle avoidance device are both arranged on the unmanned aerial vehicle; the attitude and height fixing device is used for enabling the unmanned aerial vehicle to realize fixed height and self-stable flight, and the obstacle avoidance device is used for avoiding collision of the unmanned aerial vehicle. According to the invention, the gas detection device, the attitude and height determining device and the obstacle avoidance device are carried on the unmanned aerial vehicle, so that the unmanned aerial vehicle can fly in a tunnel in a coal mine quickly, stably and safely, the gas detection is completed, and the detection efficiency is improved; meanwhile, the gas is pre-warned, and the personal safety of workers is guaranteed.

title_en: Construction method and application of platinum-shell gold-core nano-enzyme-mediated magnetic relaxation sensing signal amplification system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biochemical analysis. In particular to a construction method and application of a platinum-shell gold-core nano-enzyme-mediated magnetic relaxation sensing signal amplification system. The biosensor is characterized in that gold nanoparticles are synthesized by a microwave synthesis method, the gold nanoparticles are taken as cores, pt@AuNPs nano enzyme is prepared by platinum precipitation on the surfaces of the gold nanoparticles through oxidation-reduction reaction between ascorbic acid and chloroplatinic acid, the Pt@AuNPs nano enzyme is taken as a signal amplifier, a hydrogen peroxide mediated paramagnetic ion valence conversion sensing system is taken as a magnetic relaxation signal reading system, and the Pt@AuNPs nano enzyme mediated magnetic relaxation immunosensor and the magnetic relaxation DNA sensor are respectively constructed and are used for rapid and high-sensitivity detection of bacterial infection markers and food-borne pathogenic bacteria.

title_en: Liquid crystal form aptamer biosensor, preparation method thereof and application thereof in detection of prostate specific antigen
abstract_en: The invention relates to a liquid crystal form aptamer biosensor, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in detecting prostate specific antigen. The invention provides a new method for quickly detecting Prostate Specific Antigen (PSA), and the PSA liquid crystal type aptamer sensor has the advantages of good specificity, wide linear range, high sensitivity, no need of marking, convenience and quickness in detection and the like, and is beneficial to wide application.

title_en: Kit for detecting anti-adhesion plaque protein-IgG antibody
abstract_en: The invention provides a kit for detecting an anti-plaque adhesion protein-IgG antibody, which consists of an antigen protein Vincultin (plaque adhesion protein), a solid phase carrier, a labeled antibody, an antigen diluent, a sample diluent buffer, an antibody diluent, a substrate developer, a washing solution, a standard substance, a positive quality control product and a negative quality control product. The kit provided by the invention detects the anti-Vincultin-IgG antibody in the sample to be detected by using an indirect method reaction principle and combining with magnetic particle chemiluminescence immunoassay. The invention identifies the autoantibody aiming at the target antigen Vincultin in the serum of the autoimmune nephrotic syndrome patient for the first time, and provides a detection kit aiming at the autoantibody. The kit provided by the invention provides a basis for molecular mechanism research and clinical diagnosis and treatment of autoimmune nephrotic syndrome related to Vincultin and Vincultin-IgG autoantibodies at home and abroad.

title_en: Phospholipase A2 lateral chromatography detection test strip, detection card and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a phospholipase A2 lateral chromatography detection test strip, a detection card and application thereof, wherein a flow blocking sheet is added between a binding pad and a chromatographic membrane in the test strip, so that the flowing time of a sample on the binding pad can be controlled; on the basis, a phospholipase A2 lateral chromatography detection card is designed, a liquid flow control switch is arranged on a shell, the movable end of a flow blocking sheet penetrates out of the shell through the liquid flow control switch, and the liquid flow control switch can start a subsequent analysis process after the identification reaction of a fluorescent microsphere labeled antibody and an object to be detected is completed. Experiments show that the phospholipase A2 detection card designed by the lateral chromatography device has lower detection limit and stronger fluorescence signal compared with the conventional lateral immunochromatographic detection card, and indicates that the phospholipase A2 detection card has wide clinical application prospect.

title_en: Detection device and detection method for matched tea
abstract_en: The invention discloses a detection device and a detection method for matched tea, comprising a hollow cylindrical cover body, wherein the cover body is driven by a motor to rotate around the axis of the cover body; the rotary peripheral surface of the cover body is provided with a through hole, two sections of conveying lines for conveying tea products are additionally arranged on the rotary peripheral surface of the cover body, the two sections of conveying lines are respectively arranged on two sides of the cover body, the products are input into the cover body from the first section of conveying lines through the through hole, and after the through hole rotates to one side of the second section of conveying lines, the products are output onto the second section of conveying lines from the through hole; the cover body is internally provided with a sliding rail, the sliding rail is connected with a weighing platform in a sliding way, and the weighing platform is configured to: when the opening is towards the first section conveying line, the weighing platform is close to the first section conveying line and is used for receiving products input by the first section conveying line, and when the opening is towards the second section conveying line, the weighing platform is close to the second section conveying line. The invention designs a relatively closed cover body, and the conveying of products and the weighing detection in the conveying process are completed in the cover body, thereby being beneficial to improving the accuracy of detection.

title_en: Quantitative distribution device and method for rapid soybean detection
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of soybean rapid detection, in particular to a quantitative distribution device and a quantitative distribution method for soybean rapid detection, wherein the quantitative distribution device comprises a distribution structure, the distribution structure is connected with a protection structure for protecting the interior of the device, the distribution structure is connected with a limiting structure and a quantitative structure, the distribution structure is connected with a promotion structure for promoting soybean blanking and quantitative measurement, and the distribution structure is connected with a locking structure for limiting the work of the quantitative structure; can carry out the rapid Assembly through the soybean that the distribution structure needs short-term test, can protect the inside subassembly of device through protective structure, can set the motion of quantitative structure when the device adds soybean through limit structure, can lock quantitative structure when not using through locking structure, can quantitatively emit the soybean in the distribution structure through quantitative structure to be convenient for carry out short-term test to it, can promote the soybean in the distribution structure to emit through promoting the structure, avoid the jam.

title_en: Extracellular free protein detection method based on metal coding technology
abstract_en: The invention provides an extracellular free protein detection method based on a metal coding technology, which specifically comprises the following steps: encoding microspheres by using first metal ions, and combining the encoded microspheres with a capture antibody to form a microsphere immune complex with a microsphere-first metal ion-capture antibody structure; labeling the detection antibody with a second metal ion; adding the microsphere immune complex and the marked detection antibody into a sample to be detected respectively, and carrying out antigen-antibody reaction to form a structure of microsphere-first type metal ion-capture antibody-object to be detected-detection antibody-second type metal ion; detecting the sample suspension by using a mass spectrometry technology to respectively obtain the contents of the first metal ions and the second metal ions; and obtaining the information of the sample to be detected by utilizing the obtained metal ion content and the mapping relation, wherein the mapping relation is the corresponding relation between the metal ion content and the sample information. The invention has the advantages of high detection accuracy, rapidness and the like.

title_en: Medical detection sample immunoassay device and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of medical equipment, in particular to a medical detection sample immunoassay device which comprises a case, wherein a cover is rotatably arranged on the case, a feeding base is fixedly arranged in the case, a material pushing device is arranged on the feeding base, a sample guide groove is fixedly arranged on the feeding base, a side box is fixedly arranged on the sample guide groove, sample clamp structures with intermittent retraction functions are arranged on the sample guide groove and the side box, a slot is formed in the top of the case, an additional guide groove is connected in the slot, and a sample pressing structure with a uniform-speed moving function is connected on the additional guide groove. The medical detection sample immunoassay system can complete environment monitoring work and eliminate interference factors of analysis results.

title_en: Swine-derived anti-PDCoV-N protein scFv, expression vector, construction method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of molecular biology, relates to scFv of swine anti-PDCoV-N protein, and particularly relates to scFv of swine anti-PDCoV-N protein, and an expression vector, a construction method and application thereof. The amino acid sequence of the scFv of the swine anti-PDCoV-N protein is shown as SEQ ID No. 2. The scFv comprises a heavy chain variable region V  H  And light chain variable region V  L  Wherein the heavy chain variable region V  H  The nucleotide sequence of (2) is shown as SEQ ID NO.3 and the light chain variable region V  L  The nucleotide sequence of (2) is shown as SEQ ID NO. 4. The specific scFv-25 screened and expressed by the invention can be used for developing PDCoV diagnostic and therapeutic reagents, and can also provide assistance for further research of N protein mechanism.

title_en: Air quality detection system based on car networking
abstract_en: The invention provides an air quality detection system based on a vehicle networking, which comprises a protection outer box, wherein two ends of the inner side wall of the protection outer box are respectively provided with a first sliding groove, the upper end and the lower end of the inner side wall of the first sliding groove are respectively provided with a screw rod, the outer side wall of each screw rod is in threaded connection with a first sliding block, the inner side of each first sliding block is provided with a first threaded hole, the outer side wall of each sliding rod is welded with a buffer mechanism, the outer side wall of each buffer mechanism is provided with a detector, the inner side wall of each detector is provided with a dustproof mechanism, and one end of the outer side wall of each screw rod is in threaded connection with a driving mechanism. According to the invention, through the arrangement of the driving mechanism, the buffer mechanism, the first sliding block, the first sliding groove, the first threaded hole and the screw rod, a damping and buffering effect can be achieved on the detector in the running process of a vehicle, so that a protection effect is achieved on the detector, and the detector is prevented from being damaged.

title_en: Multi-robot collaborative indoor flavor source searching method
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-robot collaborative indoor scent source searching method, which improves an artificial ecosystem algorithm for scent source searching, so that the method has good searching efficiency under the conventional condition and can show more stable performance under the condition of the disadvantage of the initial position of a robot. The robot is regarded as a producer, a consumer or a decomposer, and the algorithm is optimized through the energy transfer mechanisms of the three, so that the algorithm still keeps stable performance at the initial position of the disadvantage. Meanwhile, a discrete wind direction system is designed in consideration of the characteristic of diffusion of the odor source, a wind chaser role is added in the ecological system, and wind direction information is introduced from the overall dimension and the individual dimension and is utilized hierarchically.

title_en: Device and method for controlling purging and automatic calibration of CEMS system by time timer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a method for controlling purging and automatic calibration of a CEMS system by a time timer, wherein the device comprises the time timer, a Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) and a CEMS (continuous monitoring system for flue gas emission), the time timer is connected with the PLC and is used for sending time signals to the PLC at regular time, the PLC is connected with the CEMS and is used for controlling the CEMS to purge and automatically calibrate the CEMS according to the time signals sent by the time timer, the PLC logic is started by the time controller to complete data retention and simultaneously automatically calibrate the CEMS system purging and the analyzer, the stability and the reliability of the system are improved, the environmental protection data monitoring stability is ensured, and the occurrence of environmental pollution events is avoided.

title_en: River water quality detection device for hydraulic engineering
abstract_en: The invention aims to solve the problem of water quality detection in a river, and discloses a river water quality detection device for hydraulic engineering, which comprises a liquid passing net, wherein a first motor is fixedly arranged in the middle of the upper surface of the liquid passing net, two ends of the first motor are symmetrically provided with first rotating shafts, the outer ends of the first rotating shafts are fixedly provided with connecting blocks, the upper sides of the connecting blocks are fixedly provided with rotating plates, through holes are uniformly formed in the rotating plates, connecting plates are symmetrically welded on the two sides of the upper surface of the liquid passing net, clamping plates are sleeved outside the connecting plates, fastening screws are arranged between the clamping plates and the connecting plates, the upper sides of the clamping plates are fixedly connected with traction ropes, a rotating drum is wound inside the traction ropes, the inner parts of the rotating drums are sleeved with third rotating shafts, and the inner ends of the third rotating shafts are provided with third motors. The invention is convenient to move, and the rotating plate can be used for locally blocking the river, so that the water quality in the river can be detected under the condition that the river is relatively static, and the detection accuracy is improved.

title_en: Simoa kit of biomarker CA15-3 and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a single molecule array detection (Simoa) kit of a biomarker CA15-3 of an immunodetection technology and a using method thereof. The Simoa kit is used for detecting the content of carbohydrate antigen (CA15-3) protein in human body fluid based on a Simoa platform monomolecular array technology and a double-antibody sandwich method, and comprises magnetic beads coated with capture antibodies, a CA15-3 standard, biotinylated detection antibodies, an SBG solution, a fluorogenic substrate solution and a sample diluent.
