The sensitivity of the Simoa kit reaches 0.0048U/mL, the sample loading amount only needs 1-2 mu L, the repeatability is good, the detection range is 0.005-10U/mL, and the content of CA15-3 in human body fluid can be accurately detected.

title_en: Sulfur hexafluoride detection device and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sulfur hexafluoride detection device and a method, wherein the sulfur hexafluoride detection device comprises a movable frame and a control electric box arranged on the movable frame, a detection box is arranged at the top of the control electric box, a controller is arranged on one side of the detection box, and an induced draft assembly is arranged at the top of the detection box; an induced air channel is arranged inside the detection box, an air draft assembly is arranged in the induced air channel, and a detection assembly is arranged at the bottom of the induced air channel and used for detecting sulfur hexafluoride in the air; when the dust collection device is used, the air draft assembly introduces air, the air draft cover stirs and mixes the air in the rotation process, the externally stirred air enters from the air draft opening, the detection assembly can detect sulfur hexafluoride in the air and detect whether sulfur hexafluoride leaks from electrical equipment, the dust cover can filter dust in the air, and the cleaning brush in the interior of the air draft cover can clean the dust accumulated on the outer wall of the dust cover into the annular dust collection box in the rotation process, so that the long-term use and the effective detection of the detection device are facilitated.

title_en: Multifunctional transparent soil model test master control system device and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional transparent soil model test master control system device and a use method thereof, wherein the method comprises the following steps: 1) Connecting the working platform with the main structure system, the acquisition system and the temperature control system, and debugging; 2) Opening a sealing door, and conveying a transparent soil model groove used for the test to an optical platform through a model groove track; 3) Closing the sealing door, starting the semiconductor temperature changing piece, and adjusting the temperature in the incubator to a test preset value; 4) Adjusting the positions and angles of a CCD camera and a laser; 5) Carrying out transparent soil model test in the incubator, and continuously shooting and recording the soil displacement and deformation, porosity change, soil particle position adjustment, crushing and other conditions in the transparent soil model groove by using a CCD camera; 6) And combining with PIV image processing technology, analyzing and processing the shooting result of the CCD camera by using a working platform computer. The device has the advantages of simple structure, high automation degree, convenient operation and strong functionality, greatly improves the test efficiency, and is suitable for various test working conditions.

title_en: Cervical cancer prognosis scoring system and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a reagent for judging the postoperative recurrence risk of a cervical cancer patient and a prognosis scoring system. After patients with FIGO (2018) cervical cancer in stages I-II and IIIC are treated by radical surgery, according to clinical physical examination and pathological examination, staging and assigning risk scores; formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded specimens were tested for PD-L1, VISTA and B7-H4 expression by immunohistochemistry, and assigned a risk score. The 2 scores are added to obtain a recurrence risk or prognosis score, and cervical cancer patients are stratified according to the scoring system and are divided into low-risk, medium-risk and high-risk. Compared with the existing FIGO staging, the prognosis scoring system has higher capability of judging relapse, and is helpful for avoiding over-treatment and under-treatment.

title_en: Groundwater sampling and monitoring apparatus and method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to testing or analysing materials by means of determining chemical or physical properties of the materials, and in particular to sampling. Groundwater sampling and monitoring device and method, at least some equipment are located in the drilling, and the drilling encloses into first space, and the equipment includes: the layering device comprises at least one packer with variable volume, and the packer is used for dividing the first space into at least one closed sample space distributed along the axial direction of the drill hole; the monitoring device comprises at least one detection piece for measuring the physical parameters of the underground water, each detection piece is positioned in a sample space, and the detection pieces are connected with the layering device; the sampling device comprises at least one collecting container for collecting underground water, each collecting container is positioned in a sample space, and the collecting containers are connected with the layering device. The groundwater with different depths can be sampled and monitored at the same monitoring point, namely, the groundwater with different depths of the same monitoring point is sampled while the physical properties of the groundwater are continuously monitored.

title_en: Monoclonal antibody of anti-CK 20 protein, cell strain, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a monoclonal antibody capable of recognizing human CK20 antigen, a secretory cell strain, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in immunoassay. In the technical scheme, 1-424 amino acids at the C terminal of the CK20 protein are selected as antigen peptides to perform codon optimization to obtain a gene fragment suitable for expression in escherichia coli BL21(DE3), and the finally obtained recombinant protein comprises a GST protein tag, a CK20 protein fragment and a histidine protein tag. The recombinant protein is used for immunizing a mouse, and a mouse hybridoma cell strain 10A2 capable of efficiently secreting the anti-CK 20 protein monoclonal antibody and the anti-CK 20 protein monoclonal antibody secreted by the cell strain are obtained through cell fusion, screening and subcloning. The antibody obtained by the scheme has high specificity and sensitivity, can specifically recognize cells expressing CK20 protein, and is suitable for immunological detection, particularly immunohistochemical detection.

title_en: HCN4 mutant gene, mutant and Brugada syndrome detection kit
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of human genetics and cardiovascular in internal medicine, in particular to an HCN4 mutant gene, wherein a base G is mutated into a base T at a genome position chr15: 73615687; the reference genomic version is GRCh 37. The invention also relates to an HCN4 mutant with a p.Gly916Val mutation. The invention also relates to a Brugada syndrome detection kit, which comprises a reagent for detecting the HCN4 mutant gene and/or the HCN4 mutant, wherein the base G of the HCN4 mutant gene is mutated into the base T at the genomic position chr15: 73615687; the HCN4 mutant had the p.gly916val mutation. The human HCN4 mutant gene provided by the invention can distinguish Brugada syndrome patients from normal people and serve as a biomarker for clinically and auxiliarily diagnosing Brugada syndrome; the carrier for detecting the variation can provide bearing and rearing guidance and genetic counseling for the testee and reduce the birth of the infant; provides possible drug targets for the human to overcome Brugada syndrome and promotes the research and development of innovative drugs.

title_en: Research, development and manufacturing process of novel clay and porcelain plate
abstract_en: The application relates to a novel clay research and development manufacturing process, which belongs to the field of clay production equipment and comprises the following steps of S1: mixing black mud, white mud, quartz and feldspar according to a certain proportion; step S2, ball milling of raw materials: preparing raw materials into slurry; step S3, removing iron and sieving; step S4, cooling and standing; in step S3, the performance of the clay needs to be tested after the raw materials are iron-removed and sieved, and the tested clay is processed by a special ball milling device. After the development of the novel clay, the performance of the clay product needs to be detected for more comprehensive detection of the performance of the novel clay. The used clay of testing process is made through special ball-milling device, compares the clay of equipment processing through production line department, and the waste on the reducible raw materials of special ball-milling device improves the utilization ratio of raw materials, simultaneously, can improve environmental protection effect, reaches the purpose of energy saving.

title_en: Method for realizing array type MEMS multi-gas sensor
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for realizing an array type MEMS multi-gas sensor, which comprises the following steps: step 1: acquiring a test requirement, and determining a gas measurement type according to the test requirement; step 2: selecting a corresponding gas component from a gas element database according to the gas measurement type; and step 3: constructing an array type MEMS multi-gas sensor model based on a test platform according to the gas component and a test rule corresponding to a test requirement; and 4, step 4: and testing the array type MEMS multi-gas sensor model, judging the qualification, and then outputting and manufacturing the qualified array type MEMS multi-gas sensor model. And after the gas element is subjected to combined test and qualified judgment and output and manufactured, the error of the sensor in the establishing process can be effectively reduced.

title_en: Method for realizing array type MEMS multi-gas sensor
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for realizing an array type MEMS multi-gas sensor, which comprises the following steps: step 1: acquiring a test requirement, and determining a gas measurement type according to the test requirement; and 2, step: selecting a corresponding gas component from a gas element database according to the gas measurement type; and 3, step 3: constructing an array type MEMS multi-gas sensor model based on a test platform according to the gas component and a test rule corresponding to a test requirement; and 4, step 4: and testing the array type MEMS multi-gas sensor model, judging the qualification, and then outputting and manufacturing the qualified array type MEMS multi-gas sensor model. And after the gas element is subjected to combined test and qualified judgment and output and manufactured, the error of the sensor in the establishing process can be effectively reduced.

title_en: Frost heaving and thawing sinking test device
abstract_en: The invention provides a frost heaving and thaw collapse test device which comprises a bottom plate, an excavating mechanism, a freezing pipe, a soil sample fixing and detecting mechanism and a control mechanism, wherein the soil sample fixing and detecting mechanism comprises a turnover plate, a first hydraulic cylinder and a frost heaving and thaw collapse amount detecting structure, the frost heaving and thaw collapse amount detecting mechanism comprises a stress plate, a spring, a push rod and a pressure sensor, a soil sample to be tested is placed between the turnover plates, a freezing hole and a communication channel are dug out on the soil sample through the excavating mechanism, after the freezing pipe is inserted into the freezing hole, the turnover plate is turned to enable the frost heaving and thaw collapse amount detecting mechanism to face the soil sample, then low-temperature saline water and high-temperature saline water are introduced into the freezing pipe to perform a frost heaving and thaw collapse test, the soil sample can deform when being frozen and thawed, the stress plate is subjected to external force or external force, and the thrust of the stress plate to the pressure sensor is pushed to change, finally, stress changes in the frost heaving and thawing process can be displayed, and theoretical guidance is provided for the subsequent actual construction process.

title_en: Combination therapy of an anti-HER 2 antibody-drug conjugate and a Bcl-2 inhibitor
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a combination therapy involving an anti-HER 2 antibody-drug conjugate and a selective Bcl-2 inhibitor for use in the treatment of a patient suffering from cancer, in particular a HER-2 expressing cancer.

title_en: Magnetic particles and detection reagent
abstract_en: The present invention provides a magnetic particle which can improve magnetism collection and dispersibility and can maintain high magnetism collection. The magnetic particles according to the present invention are magnetic particles for specifically interacting with a target substance, and comprise: resin particles containing a1 st magnetic substance; a magnetic layer which is disposed on the outer surface of the magnetic-substance-containing resin particles and contains a2 nd magnetic substance; and a substance that is supported on the outer surface side of the magnetic layer and specifically interacts with the target substance.

title_en: Method for processing paraffin-embedded tissue sample and mass spectrometry detection method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a processing method of a paraffin-embedded tissue sample and a mass spectrometry detection method thereof. The invention provides a processing method, which comprises the following steps: step 1: cracking the paraffin-embedded tissue sample in a lysate in the presence of sodium dodecyl sulfate to obtain a protein lysate; step 2: precipitating the protein lysate obtained in the step 1 by acetone to obtain a protein solid; and step 3: dissolving the protein solid in the step 2 in a buffer solution in the presence of urea to obtain a protein solution; and 4, step 4: and (4) carrying out FASP enzymolysis and desalination on the protein solution obtained in the step (3) to obtain a peptide segment. The method can obtain the peptide segment with high yield and has less steps, and the protein and peptide segment information in the paraffin-embedded tissue sample can be obtained through further mass spectrum detection.

title_en: Microbial community by-product and application thereof
abstract_en: A method for treating a microorganism-associated condition in a patient can include detecting a microorganism in a set of samples taken from a population, and comparing the relative abundance and co-occurrence of different taxa of microorganisms in the set of samples. The method further comprises correlating the relative abundance or co-occurrence of the microbial taxa with a sample from a person in the population having the microbial-related condition and a sample from a person in the population not having the microbial-related condition to determine a target taxa. A mixture of phage configured to remove the target taxa from the population of microorganisms is then identified. The therapeutic composition comprising the mixture is then administered to a patient suffering from a microorganism-associated condition.

title_en: Kit and method for detecting SARS-CoV-2 neutralizing antibody
abstract_en: The application relates to a kit and a method for detecting SARS-CoV-2 neutralizing antibody. The application relates to the field of biological medicine, and provides a detection kit and a method for detecting a SARS-CoV-2 neutralizing antibody, wherein a protein label is adopted to modify RBD and ACE2 so that the RBD and the ACE2 have better stability and reactivity, and the detection sensitivity is improved.

title_en: Anti-hepatitis B virus surface antigen antibody, antibody pair, detection reagent containing same and kit
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-hepatitis B virus surface antigen antibody, an antibody pair, a detection reagent containing the antibody pair and a kit, wherein the antibody comprises an antibody light chain and an antibody heavy chain, the antibody light chain comprises complementarity determining regions CDR-L1, CDR-L2 and CDR-L3, and the antibody heavy chain comprises complementarity determining regions CDR-H1 and CDR-H, CDR-H3. The antibody disclosed by the invention is used for detecting the surface antigen of the hepatitis B virus, can specifically bind to the surface antigen of the hepatitis B virus, and has high detection specificity and sensitivity.

title_en: Novel portable instrument for monitoring diabetic nephropathy
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel portable instrument for monitoring diabetic nephropathy, wherein double-layer shells are arranged on the basis of the conventional portable detection instrument to protect components in the instrument, honeycomb-shaped shock absorbers are filled between the double-layer shells, so that the shock resistance and falling resistance of the portable detection instrument are effectively improved, a pneumatic protective bag is arranged at a test paper socket, the pneumatic protective bag keeps a closed state before test paper is inserted to play an effective dustproof and waterproof role on one hand, on the other hand, the pneumatic protective bag can fix the inserted test paper to prevent the test paper from falling off in the test process to cause detection failure, an emergency help function is additionally arranged on the basis of the conventional portable instrument body, for the old, the probability is greatly accompanied with various diseases, so that effective life guarantee can be obtained under the sudden condition of other diseases, and a displacement sensor is also arranged in the test paper socket to monitor whether the test paper is inserted in place or not, ensuring the validity of the detection.

title_en: Incubation device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an incubation device, which comprises an incubation disc, wherein the incubation disc is rotationally connected to a rotating mechanism, a driving mechanism is arranged below the incubation disc, the driving mechanism comprises a pressing block part moving up and down and a pushing part moving horizontally, the pressing block part is hinged with the pushing part and drives the pushing part to move, the upper end of the pushing part is in contact with the incubation disc and pushes the incubation disc to intermittently rotate in a single direction, the pushing part is movably connected with a positioning mechanism, and the positioning mechanism is used for positioning the incubation disc at fixed angles. The locking mechanism is arranged by matching with the driving mechanism, when the driving mechanism pushes the incubation disc to perform unidirectional intermittent rotary motion, the driving mechanism is utilized to drive the locking mechanism to lock or unlock the incubation disc, the locking mechanism does not need to be driven by extra driving force, the layout and the arrangement are compact, the occupied area is small, the requirements of various working conditions are met, the reliability is high, and the design structure of the whole device is simple.

title_en: Application of PRKCZ autoantibody in auxiliary diagnosis of esophageal squamous cell carcinoma
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of medical biology, and particularly discloses a biomarker and a detection kit for auxiliary diagnosis of esophageal squamous cell carcinoma. The biomarker for auxiliary diagnosis of esophageal squamous cell carcinoma provided by the invention is an autoantibody of an anti-tumor associated antigen PRKCZ, the expression level of the marker in the serum of an esophageal squamous cell carcinoma patient is higher than that of a normal person, and the difference has statistical significance. The invention also provides a kit for auxiliary diagnosis of esophageal squamous cell carcinoma, which contains a reagent for detecting the marker, wherein the reagent is a reagent for detecting the biomarker in a sample by enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay, a protein chip, immunoblotting or microfluidic immunoassay. The invention can effectively distinguish esophageal squamous carcinoma patients from normal people by detecting the expression level of the anti-tumor associated antigen PRKCZ in human serum, and can be used for auxiliary diagnosis of esophageal squamous carcinoma.

title_en: Gas detection system
abstract_en: A gas detection system includes a first sensor unit (31) that outputs a voltage corresponding to a concentration of a specific gas, a storage tank (40) that is capable of storing a sample gas or a purge gas to be supplied to the first sensor unit (31), and a control unit (64). The control unit detects the type and concentration of gas contained in the sample gas based on the detection result of the first sensor unit (31). The control unit (64) sets a collection period for collecting the gas in the predetermined space as the sample gas or the purge gas into the storage tank (40) and a supply period for supplying the sample gas or the purge gas to the first sensor unit (31) so that the collection period and the supply period fall in different time slots.

title_en: Portable pipeline inspection robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a portable pipeline detection robot, which comprises a machine body shell, wherein fixed plates are fixedly connected with the upper part and the lower part of the front end of the machine body shell, a front part shell is arranged between the fixed plates on the upper part and the lower part, a mounting groove is formed in the center of the left end surface of the front part shell, a camera is fixedly arranged in the mounting groove, a plurality of LED lamp beads are annularly distributed on the outer surface of the front part shell, a threaded sleeve is fixedly connected with the front end of the machine body shell, a transparent cover is screwed on the outer surface of the threaded sleeve in a threaded manner, when the portable pipeline detection robot is used, power is provided for the pipeline robot through a plurality of vector thrusters, the condition in a tap water pipeline can be observed through the camera, meanwhile, a light source is provided for the camera by matching with the LED lamp beads, so that the camera can more clearly shoot out the condition in the pipeline, and the arranged transparent cover protects the camera and the LED lamp beads, the transparent cover is in threaded connection with the outer surface of the threaded sleeve, and then the transparent cover can be conveniently disassembled and assembled.

title_en: Marker-based prediction product for curative effect of transcatheter arterial chemoembolization and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of biomedicine, and particularly relates to a marker-based prediction product for curative effect of transcatheter arterial chemoembolization and application thereof. The invention provides a kit for predicting the response of a patient to treatment of transcatheter arterial chemoembolization, which comprises a reagent for detecting the expression level of any one or more of HILPDA, LIN28B and SLAIN1, and whether the patient can obtain good curative effect after the patient receives the transcatheter arterial chemoembolization can be predicted according to the detection result of the expression level.

title_en: Molecular marker HSF1 for diagnosing and treating bladder cancer and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a molecular marker HSF1 for diagnosing and treating bladder cancer and application thereof. According to the invention, the gene expression result in the clinical bladder cancer specimen is compared to find that HSF1 is highly expressed in the bladder cancer tissue with positive lymph node metastasis, is negatively related to the overall survival prognosis, can be used as a marker for prompting bladder cancer lymph node metastasis, and can be used as an independent index for predicting the survival prognosis of patients; according to the invention, the in vivo and in vitro functional experiments of bladder cancer cells show that the silent HSF1 can inhibit the proliferation and lymphatic metastasis of the bladder cancer cells; the invention discovers that HSF1 is an important carcinogenic factor of bladder cancer for the first time, and HSF1 can be used as a molecular marker for diagnosing and judging prognosis of bladder cancer and a new target for treating bladder cancer.

title_en: Quick test calibration device and calibration method for hydrogen concentration sensor
abstract_en: The invention provides a quick test calibration device and a quick test calibration method for a hydrogen concentration sensor. The rapid test calibration device and the calibration method for the hydrogen concentration sensor are safe, reliable and accurate in measuring the precision of the hydrogen concentration sensor, can realize the test of the hydrogen concentration sensor under any hydrogen concentration within the range of 0-4%, and have the functions of air purging, pressure measurement, temperature and humidity measurement, pressure maintaining test, explosion prevention and the like, so that the hydrogen concentration sensor can be rapidly calibrated.

title_en: Quick poison detection method, one-minute quick poison detection device and distributed poison detection system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of drug detection, and particularly discloses a rapid drug detection method, a one-minute rapid drug detection device and a distributed drug detection system. The rapid toxicity detection method comprises the following steps: providing a toxicity detection model, wherein the toxicity detection model is used for judging whether the toxicity content of a sample to be detected exceeds a critical value according to the visual effect change condition of the detection test paper; reacting the sample to be detected with the detection test paper; before the test paper fully reacts, obtaining the actual measurement visual effect change condition of the test paper; and combining the actual measurement visual effect change condition with the toxicity detection model to preliminarily judge whether the toxicity content of the sample to be detected exceeds a critical value. The rapid toxicity detection method, the one-minute rapid toxicity detection device and the distributed toxicity detection system provided by the invention can effectively shorten the detection time, improve the detection efficiency and further reduce the general detection difficulty.

title_en: Multi-sensor optimized deployment method for soil component collection
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-sensor optimized deployment method for soil component collection, and relates to the technical field of soil component collection. The invention provides a two-stage sensor deployment method which comprises the following steps: in the first stage, the soil component value of each deployment point is repeatedly calculated for multiple times by a small number of sensors and a systematic random method, if the distribution difference of the soil components is small, the deployment point closest to the average value of the soil components of a single grid is taken as a final deployment scheme, otherwise, the deployment is carried out in the second stage, and a point deployment algorithm based on uniform gridding and Delaunay triangulation is used; constraining the dispersion degree of the soil components in each triangular net by using the variation coefficient, and subdividing the triangular net with higher dispersion degree until all the triangular nets meet the requirements; the deployment scheme can be used for monitoring the soil components before, during and after planting of crops, is combined with the agricultural condition, and can scientifically and comprehensively continuously reflect the soil components compared with the existing sensor deployment scheme from the practical perspective.

title_en: Tunnel harmful gas real-time alarm automatic atomization spraying treatment equipment and spraying method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tunnel harmful gas real-time alarm automatic atomization spraying treatment device and a spraying method thereof, wherein the tunnel harmful gas real-time alarm automatic atomization spraying treatment device comprises a high-pressure pump set, a solution tank and an atomization spraying device, an alarm controller and a pump set controller are arranged on a supporting base, the atomization spraying device comprises a first spraying assembly and a second spraying assembly, the first spraying assembly is connected with a driving assembly, the driving assembly drives the first spraying assembly to rotate, the second spraying assembly is arranged above the first spraying assembly in a matched mode, and the first spraying assembly rotates to drive the second spraying assembly to move. The spraying method of the invention comprises the following steps: 1) movement of the device; 2) adding a solution; 3) mounting a gas sensor; 4) the equipment is operated. The invention has the characteristics of high precision, high real-time performance, special pertinence of harmful gas, convenience, high safety and the like, and is suitable for tunnel construction of railways, highways, urban rail transit and the like which are damaged by toxic and harmful gas.

title_en: Gas uniformity testing device, testing system and testing method
abstract_en: The utility model provides a gaseous homogeneity testing arrangement, its includes the sampling pipe, be used for installing the rotary device of sampling pipe, be used for driving the sampling pipe is along the first drive arrangement of radial removal and be used for driving rotary device takes place to rotate in order to drive the sampling pipe is along circumferential direction's second drive arrangement, the sampling pipe is used for gathering the gas of a plurality of sampling positions department on the sampling cross-section. The invention also discloses a test system and a test method with the gas uniformity test device. Compared with the prior art, the sampling pipe can move along the radial direction and rotate along the circumferential direction, so that gas at a plurality of sampling positions on the sampling section can be collected, the coverage rate of the sampling positions is increased, and the convenience and the accuracy of measurement are improved.

title_en: Development method of cytokine detection kit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a development method of a cytokine detection kit. In the invention, the confining liquid is added, a vortex oscillation machine is used for carrying out vortex oscillation treatment on the confining liquid, then an ultrasonic oscillation machine is used for carrying out ultrasonic oscillation treatment on the confining liquid, and after the ultrasonic oscillation treatment is finished, the supernatant in the centrifugal liquid is taken out and is not used for abandonment; the process of labeling the antibody can then be terminated; the form and storage stability of each component of the test product; testing the preservation form and stability of each component at 2-8 ℃, wherein the components are preserved for at least 18 months when not opened, and are preserved for 30 days when opened, thereby completing the development of the cytokine detection kit; the method realizes the independent marking of the microspheres and the matching of the combined detection factors to form a product which meets the market demand, lays a foundation for entering the clinical market and is in the leading position in the same industry at home; compared with commercial products, the method is close to or reaches the leading level of domestic and foreign manufacturers in the aspects of accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, stability, detection factor quantity and the like.

title_en: Constructor based on big data and corresponding monitoring method and system for construction building quality
abstract_en: The invention discloses a constructor based on big data and a corresponding method for monitoring the quality of a construction building, which comprises the following steps: step 1, a monitoring device is worn by a constructor, the constructor registers on line, step 2, registration information of the constructor is obtained, the working position of the constructor is located through the monitoring device, position information is obtained, step 3, environment information of the working position where the constructor is located is detected according to a sensing module arranged in the detecting device, environment data is obtained, step 4, safe construction environment data of similar construction environments are obtained through big data integration processing, comparison is carried out according to the environment data and the safe construction environment data, and whether the construction environments are safe or not is judged. Through the overall structure of equipment, can be clear know corresponding region by which constructor construction, monitoring devices can also detect whether qualified by the concrete simultaneously, and guaranteed the quality of engineering.

title_en: Control unit and dosing module insertable into a milk analysis device
abstract_en: A control unit (240) and a dosing module (137) of a milk analysis device (120) comprising first wireless communication means (210) for communicating with memory means (230) of the dosing module (137). The dosing module (137) is insertable into the milk analysis device (120) by a second wireless communication means (220) comprised in the dosing module (137). The control unit (240) is configured to: determining a measurement related to the use of the pump (320, 330); and transmitting information about the determined measurement results to the memory device (230) of the dosing module (137) by the first wireless communication device (210) for storage in the memory device (230) of the dosing module (137).

title_en: Device for detecting precision of part of pylon3d medical equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a precision detection device for detecting pylon3d medical equipment components, which comprises a stable base, wherein a first fixing bolt is detachably arranged on one side of the top end of the stable base, a positioning device is detachably arranged on the top end of the stable base, a lifting rod is detachably arranged on the left side of the top end of the stable base, an installation frame is detachably arranged on the top end of the lifting rod, a first connection through hole is formed in the top end of the front face of the installation frame, the top end inside the installation frame is connected with a connecting rod in a clamping manner through the first connection through hole, and a limiting device is detachably arranged at one end of the connecting rod. In the above scheme, the precision detection device utilizes the positioning equipment to position and limit the part to be detected, thereby preventing the part from deviating, and avoiding the problem that once the medical equipment part moves when detecting, the work of the detection device is influenced and the detection precision of the device is reduced because the detection device does not have the part positioning function.

title_en: Preparation and effect analysis of nitrendipine self-micelle amorphous solid dispersion
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method and effect analysis of nitrendipine self-micelle amorphous solid dispersion, which adopts nitrendipine as a hypertension drug to self-micelle polymer As a carrier material to prepare amorphous solid dispersion, the influence of the preparation process of the nitrendipine self-micelle amorphous solid dispersion and the polymer concentration thereof on the dissolution effect of the nitrendipine in the supersaturated state is discussed, the nitrendipine self-micelle amorphous solid dispersion prepared by adopting a hot-melt extrusion method is finally obtained by analysis and evaluation, the dissolution and the solubility of the nitrendipine can be better improved, and the polymer along with the self-micelle in the supersaturation experiment is shown The more remarkable the crystallization inhibiting effect is due to the increase of the concentration. The solid dispersion prepared by the hot-melt extrusion method has better solubilisation, good dissolution and higher stability, and is more suitable for being put into practical production compared with other preparation processes.

title_en: Method and device for detecting biological sample by terahertz time-domain spectroscopy and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for rapidly detecting a biological sample based on an immune terahertz time-domain spectroscopy technology and application thereof. The invention rapidly detects bacteria, viruses, mycoplasma, biotoxins, disease-related markers and the like in a complex environment sample, a food substrate, a serum (plasma) sample, a body fluid sample, a tissue sample and the like by combining the sample enrichment of a specific monoclonal antibody and the terahertz time-domain spectroscopy technology. The method has high sensitivity, the detection time is less than 30 minutes, the rapid trace detection of biological samples such as bacteria, viruses, mycoplasma, biotoxin, disease-related markers and the like in complex environments with different states can be realized, and the method can be used for disease screening and diagnosis based on serum (plasma) samples, body fluid samples, cell samples, tissue samples and the like. The method has the characteristics of high accuracy, good sensitivity and quick and convenient detection.

title_en: Application of metabolic marker in diagnosis of ADHD (ADHD-associated tic disorder) of children
abstract_en: The invention discloses a group of metabolic markers for diagnosing attention deficit hyperactivity disorder combined tic disorder, which comprise one or more of FAPy-adenine, N-acetyl aspartyl glutamic acid, dopamine-4-sulfate, aminocaproic acid and asparagine-leucine, and are used for preparing early screening and diagnosis products for the attention deficit hyperactivity disorder combined tic disorder; the metabolic marker of the invention is used for early screening and diagnosis of attention deficit hyperactivity disorder and tic disorder, has high specificity and sensitivity, and has guiding significance for development of subsequent clinical application research.

title_en: 10-hydroxy mesaconine hapten, artificial antigen and antibody as well as preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a 10-hydroxy mesaconine hapten, an artificial antigen, an antibody, and a preparation method and application thereof. The structural formula of the 10-hydroxy mesaconine hapten is shown as a formula I, and the preparation method can be used for preparing the hapten by the following steps: pyridine is used as a solvent, and 10-hydroxy mesaconine and succinic anhydride are reacted. The invention also provides a 10-hydroxy mesaconine monoclonal antibody, which is prepared by immunizing experimental animals with the artificial antigen of 10-hydroxy mesaconine to generate antiserum, screening hybridoma cells secreting the anti-10-hydroxy mesaconine monoclonal antibody through ELISA, and has high sensitivity and broad spectrum and can cross-identify aconitine alkaloids. The broad-spectrum specific antibody provided by the invention can be used for establishing immunological detection methods of aconite alkaloids, such as enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay, chemiluminescence assay, time resolution assay, fluorescence polarization assay and the like, can be used for preparing kit detection products of aconite alkaloids, and is suitable for large-scale sample detection and on-site rapid detection.

title_en: Marker for diagnosing breast cancer and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biological medicines, and particularly relates to a marker for diagnosing breast cancer and application thereof. LncRNA030 is highly expressed in breast cancer stem cells and is associated with poor prognosis in breast cancer patients; LncRNA030 is located on human chromosome 8, and the adjacent gene SQLE is mainly located in cytoplasm; LncRNA030 promotes dryness maintenance and enrichment of BCSC; LncRNA030 promotes dryness maintenance and enrichment of BCSC by regulating SQLE; LncRNA030 enhances SQLE mRNA stability through RNA binding protein PCBP 2; the LncRNA030 can increase the content of cholesterol in stem cells by regulating SQLE, and promote the dryness maintenance and enrichment of BCSC; LncRNA030 maintains the dryness of BCSC through activating PI3K/AKT signaling pathway; the lncRNA030/SQLE signal axis promotes BCSC neoplasia in vivo. The invention provides LncRNA030 as a breast cancer marker and application thereof in related medicines and diagnosis.

title_en: Treatment process of high-sealing powder ring for nitrogen-oxygen sensor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a treatment process of a high-leakproofness powder ring for a nitrogen-oxygen sensor.A chip of the nitrogen-oxygen sensor is sequentially sleeved with first fixed ceramic, first smooth stone blocks, second fixed ceramic, third smooth stone blocks, fourth smooth stone blocks and third fixed ceramic from bottom to top; integrally placing a nitrogen-oxygen sensor chip, first fixed ceramic, a first sliding stone block, a second sliding stone block, second fixed ceramic, a third sliding stone block, a fourth sliding stone block and third fixed ceramic into a first metal shell and a second metal shell which are welded in advance; putting the whole body into a press-fitting mold for prepressing to form a whole sample piece; performing final pressing on the pre-pressed integral sample piece; carrying out heat treatment on the pressed integral sample piece; carrying out air tightness test on the whole sample piece subjected to heat treatment; and adjusting parameters of pre-pressing pressure, final pressure and heat treatment temperature according to the situation that the air tightness of the whole sample piece reaches the standard. Above-mentioned technical scheme, it is convenient to make, sealing performance is good, long service life and practicality are good.

title_en: Urinary surgery catheterization device
abstract_en: The invention provides a urinary surgery urethral catheterization device, which relates to the technical field of medical instruments and comprises a device main body, wherein a bearing and containing device is arranged in the middle of the device main body, sterile discharge devices are arranged around the bearing and containing device, a pipeline guide fixing device is arranged at the top of the bearing and containing device, and a component detection device is arranged on one side of the pipeline guide fixing device. According to the invention, the urine bottle in the main body of the non-contact type collection device is realized by using the sterile discharge device, the control module is used for controlling the butt joint collection base to butt joint the bottom of the urine bottle when in use, and the receiving control device clamps the bottleneck of the urine bottle to finish clamping and fixing the urine bottle, so that the contact between the hand of a human body and the urine bottle is avoided, the difficulty of urine collection and dumping is reduced, the whole sterile discharge device can directly fix the whole urine bottle containing urine, and the difficulty of urine treatment is reduced.

title_en: LNAPL migration simulation method in porous medium in cold region
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for simulating LNAPL migration in a porous medium in a cold region, which is based on a COMSOL Multiphysics three-phase flow model for simulating water-gas-NAPL of the porous medium and comprises the following steps: (1) Constructing a flow field by establishing a control equation of LNAPL migration and LNAPL existence state and interconversion process; (2) A temperature field is built by building a porous medium heat transfer equation, a melting latent heat item of ice is additionally arranged on a source item of the three-phase flow, and the porous medium heat transfer equation is built based on heat conservation; (3) Coupling a temperature field and a flow field through an empirical relation between unfrozen water and frozen ice; (4) Constructing a chemical field by establishing a dissolved phase-volatile phase LNAPL mass balance equation, and realizing coupling with a flow field by a mass conversion term; (5) Calculating and solving the expression equation in the steps (1) - (4) by adopting COMSOLMultiphics to obtain an LNAPL migration rule; the method can be used for simulating and quantitatively engraving the migration distribution of the LNAPL after freezing in the LNAPL leakage process, and provides a reference for repairing the LNAPL in the cold region after leakage.

title_en: Nucleic acid aptamer capable of combining prometryn and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nucleic acid aptamer capable of combining prometryn and application thereof, belongs to the field of detection of environmental pollutants, and particularly relates to a nucleic acid aptamer for detecting prometryn and a nanogold colorimetric detection method thereof. The aptamer provided by the invention has higher affinity and specificity to prometryn, and can be used for detecting prometryn in environments, foods, medicines, raw materials or biological samples. The invention also provides a nanogold colorimetric method for detecting prometryn in a sample.

title_en: Fusion protein of high-affinity PD-1 extracellular region mutant, and pharmaceutical composition and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-affinity PD-1 extracellular domain mutant, which consists of an amino acid sequence selected from SEQ ID NO. 3. The invention further provides fusion proteins of the high-affinity PD-1 extracellular domain mutants and application thereof. The invention creatively synthesizes a high-affinity PD-1 extracellular region mutant or fusion protein thereof, wherein the fusion protein has higher affinity and higher efficacy for binding human PD-L1 or PD-L2 compared with wild type PD-1. The fusion protein provides a wider approach for the immunotherapy of tumors.

title_en: Ultra-high temperature-based underground sand consolidation strengthening evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of oil and gas field development, and particularly relates to an underground sand consolidation strengthening evaluation method based on ultrahigh temperature; the invention aims to: silicon carbide powder and clay are mixed into the core of the sandstone reservoir after being heated at the ultrahigh temperature of 1500 ℃ to change the mineral components of the core, so that the modified artificial consolidated core is artificially reformed into a honeycomb structure under the ultrahigh temperature condition, and the original sand consolidation capability of the sandstone reservoir is enhanced; the technical scheme includes that an X-ray diffraction experiment and an electron microscope scanning experiment are carried out on sandstone reservoir cores before and after severe deformation, porosity, gas permeability and sand production rate are evaluated, various parameters influencing the sand consolidation capability of the reservoir are comprehensively considered, and finally, the underground sand consolidation strengthening evaluation system coefficient is calculated. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the following advantages: (1) the evaluation coefficient is visual, and the evaluation system is convenient and effective; (2) the evaluation system gives consideration to multiple factors influencing sand production, so that the evaluation result is more reliable; (3) the evaluation method is easy to popularize.

title_en: Method for coating magnetic beads with alpha-fetoprotein antibodies, coupled magnetic beads and kit
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for coating a magnetic bead with an alpha fetoprotein antibody, a coupled magnetic bead and a kit. Before the alpha-fetoprotein antibody is coupled with the carboxyl magnetic beads, the alpha-fetoprotein antibody is pretreated by the sodium dodecyl sulfate, so that the coupling efficiency of the alpha-fetoprotein antibody and the magnetic beads can be obviously improved, and the sensitivity and the signal-to-noise ratio of detecting the alpha-fetoprotein in human serum by using a chemiluminescence magnetic particle immunoassay method in the prior art are improved.

title_en: Paint mist pollution detection method for automobile coating
abstract_en: The application discloses a paint mist pollution detection method for automobile coating, which is used for simulating the field condition of automobile coating and accurately detecting the condition of paint mist pollution so as to more accurately perform product development design and early prevention of paint mist pollution resistance. The paint mist pollution detection method for automobile coating comprises a first color paint coating step, a second color paint spraying step and an evaluation step.

title_en: Affinity separation systems and methods using switch-like binding reactions
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an affinity separation system and method using switch-like binding reactions. An affinity separation system according to an embodiment of the present invention includes: a ligand (10); a binder (20) which binds reversibly to the ligand (10) and structurally changes with a binding reaction with the ligand (10); a recognition material (30) specifically binding to the structurally-altered conjugate (20); a fixing member (40) having any one of the binding material (20) and the identification material (30) fixed to the surface thereof; and a capture material (50) conjugated to the other of the binder (20) and the recognition material (30) to form a conjugate (C) and specifically binding to the target material (1) from the target subpopulation of the sample solution.

title_en: Preparation and application of cantharis yellow colloidal gold lateral flow immunochromatographic card
abstract_en: The invention discloses a structural formula of cantharis yellow hapten, a preparation method of an artificial antigen, an antibody and an immunochromatography detection card corresponding to the cantharis yellow hapten, and application of the cantharis yellow hapten in Gold colloidal lateral flow immunochromatography (GLFA) detection. The prepared cantharidin yellow artificial antibody has high immunogenicity, the antibody prepared by animal immunization has high affinity binding force to the cantharidin yellow, and the prepared cantharidin yellow immunochromatographic detection card can be used for on-site rapid detection of the cantharidin yellow in a poultry egg sample.

title_en: Combustible gas detector
abstract_en: The application relates to a combustible gas detector, it includes the protection casing, the protection casing is provided with and holds the chamber, it is provided with circuit control panel to hold the intracavity, circuit control panel integration has: the system comprises a processor and a controller, wherein the processor is used for receiving and processing signals, the controller is used for receiving control signals of the processor, and the controller executes control instructions; the sensor assembly is connected with the processor and used for acquiring parameters of the combustible gas and transmitting the parameter information of the combustible gas to the processor; the wireless communication module is connected with the processor and used for receiving the parameter information of the combustible gas processed by the processor and remotely sending the information; and the antenna component is connected with the wireless communication module. The application has the effect that the combustible gas detector can also be remotely monitored in the environment where the network cable is not conveniently arranged.

title_en: Use of Rv1860 protein, RV3881c protein, Rv2031c protein and Rv3803c protein in distinguishing active and latent tuberculosis infection
abstract_en: The invention provides application of a product for detecting the levels of an anti-Rv 1860 antibody, an anti-RV 3881c antibody, an anti-Rv 2031c antibody and an anti-Rv 3803c antibody in serum in preparation of a product for distinguishing or assisting in distinguishing active tuberculosis patients from latent tuberculosis infection patients. The biomarker combination of the 4 antigens can effectively distinguish ATB patients from LTBI populations. And in the verification stage, more than 300 serum samples are further used for verifying the biomarker panel by an ELISA method, and the final result shows that the microarray detection result is basically consistent with the ELISA detection result.

title_en: Thermal power generating unit pressure-bearing member temperature tube seat safety evaluation system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a thermal power generating unit pressure-bearing member temperature tube seat safety evaluation system, which comprises: the temperature tube seat state quantity influence value acquisition module is used for acquiring a temperature tube seat state quantity influence value according to the influence degree of the temperature tube seat state quantity on the safety of the temperature tube seat of the thermal power unit; the state quantity comprises a structure, materials, welding, inspection, operation, working conditions and service time; the temperature sleeve seat safety evaluation module is used for obtaining a temperature sleeve seat safety evaluation value TS through a temperature sleeve seat safety evaluation calculation formula based on the obtained state quantity influence value: and the temperature sleeve seat safety state grade evaluation module is used for obtaining the temperature sleeve seat safety state grade according to the temperature sleeve seat safety evaluation value TS. The invention can realize quantitative evaluation of service safety of the temperature sleeve pipe seat of the in-service unit.

title_en: Method and system for dividing rock mechanical layer of compact carbonate reservoir
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for dividing a rock mechanical layer of a compact carbonate reservoir, wherein the method comprises the following steps: respectively obtaining static rock mechanical parameters of a plurality of rock core samples; respectively obtaining dynamic rock mechanical parameters of a depth point corresponding to each core sample; acquiring a corrected static rock mechanical parameter of each depth point based on the static rock mechanical parameter of each core sample, the dynamic rock mechanical parameter of the corresponding depth point and the dynamic rock mechanical parameter of each depth point; respectively calculating the rock mechanical index of each depth point based on the static rock mechanical parameter corrected by each depth point and a reservoir rock mechanical index calculation model; and dividing the rock mechanical layer of the reservoir based on the single well fracture development characteristics and the rock mechanical index of each depth point. The rock mechanical index obtained by utilizing conventional logging information calculation is high in accuracy and calculation efficiency, and the compact carbonate reservoir rock mechanical layer is divided quickly, accurately and reliably.

title_en: Intelligent cooking equipment and automatic control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses intelligent cooking equipment and an automatic control method thereof. The intelligent cooking equipment comprises a box body, a camera device, a man-machine interaction device, a smell sensing device and a controller which is in telecommunication connection with the camera device, the man-machine interaction device and the smell sensing device and can automatically control cooking. The high-end intelligent cooking equipment integrates the camera device, the human-computer interaction device and the odor sensing device, has the functions of image recognition, intelligent voice and character conversation, food cooking color-forming judgment and the like, increases the use function of the cooking equipment, improves the system performance of the cooking equipment, solves the problem that the existing cooking equipment industry does not exist or is not mature, improves the user experience effect and greatly improves the product competitiveness.

title_en: Device for evaluating wear-resistant energy-saving self-repairing performance of lubricant
abstract_en: The invention provides an anti-wear energy-saving self-repairing performance evaluation device for a lubricant, which relates to the technical field of performance evaluation devices and comprises a test bearing transmission system, a test machine head, a hydraulic loading system, a lubricating system and an online monitoring system, wherein the test bearing transmission system comprises a main transmission motor, a transmission belt, a main transmission shaft, a coupler, the test machine head, a radial loading oil cylinder and an axial loading oil cylinder, the transmission belt is arranged at the output end of the main transmission motor, and the position of the transmission belt, which is far away from the main transmission motor, is sleeved on the surface of the main transmission shaft. The invention can fully test various performances of the lubricating oil through the arranged on-line monitoring system, meanwhile, the invention can improve sufficient power through the simultaneous transmission of the main transmission motor and the driven motor, and meanwhile, through the arranged heat pipe and the heat dissipation fan, the invention can provide sufficient heat dissipation for the torque sensor, the acceleration sensor and the current sensor when in use in summer.

title_en: Mining three-dimensional simulation experiment model experiment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mining three-dimensional simulation experiment model experiment method, which comprises the following steps: laying a simulation coal bed; laying a simulated rock stratum, a simulated water-resisting layer and a simulated aquifer on the simulated coal bed to lay a mining three-dimensional simulation experiment model, wherein the aquifer simulation material for simulating the aquifer is solid during laying and is liquid after heating; and laying a simulated earth surface rock stratum, heating the simulated aquifer or waiting for the conversion of the aquifer simulation material into liquid state so as to finish the laying of the mining three-dimensional simulation experiment model, carrying out a simulation experiment on the mining three-dimensional simulation experiment model, and monitoring the simulated aquifer in the simulation experiment. The invention realizes the laying of the aquifer by simulating the aquifer by the aquifer simulation material, and monitors the simulated aquifer during the simulation experiment, so that the authenticity and the accuracy of the simulation experiment are greatly improved and enhanced.

title_en: Multi-wavelength breath analysis system and method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a breath analysis apparatus and method. In particular, the invention relates to a breath analysis device operating in the 3.3-3.6 μm wavelength range and arranged to provide absorption information in at least two different wavelength bands within said wavelength range. The absorbance information from the band is compared to list data of preselected substances to identify unidentified substances.

title_en: Epoxy resin performance testing method for packaging high-frequency transformer
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for testing the performance of epoxy resin for packaging a high-frequency transformer, which relates to the field of material testing and comprises the following steps: covering the epoxy resin outside the electric heating wire by using a mold, and curing the modified epoxy resin into a packaging sleeve after cooling and solidification; the packaging sleeve and the heating wire are arranged in a test bin, and the temperature in the bin at the moment is measured and recorded by using a handheld infrared thermal imager; measuring and recording the temperature of the packaging sleeve and the exposed heating wire by using a handheld infrared thermal imager five times before the set temperature of the heating wire is reached; measuring and recording the temperature of the heating wire after the heating wire reaches the set temperature for ten minutes by using a handheld infrared thermal imager, and then closing a power supply of the heating wire to naturally cool the heating wire and starting timing; the timing is stopped after the temperature sensing color-changing paster is changed back to the original color, and the color-changing time is recorded.

title_en: System and method for detecting sulfur content in industrial gas
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of sulfur content detection, in particular to a system and a method for detecting sulfur content in industrial gas. The system comprises: the combustion chamber is used for carrying out combustion treatment on industrial gas and air; the detection device is used for detecting the content of sulfur dioxide and oxygen in the residual gas after combustion in the combustion chamber and is communicated with the combustion chamber; the gas pipeline is used for processing the industrial gas and transporting the industrial gas to the combustion chamber and is communicated with the combustion chamber; and the air pipeline is used for processing the air and conveying the air to the combustion chamber, and the air pipeline is communicated with the combustion chamber. The industrial gas combustion and detection device is directly connected for use, organic sulfur which is difficult to detect and inorganic sulfur which is easy to absorb in the industrial gas are all converted into sulfur dioxide, and then detection is carried out, so that the total sulfur change in the gas can be directly, continuously, stably, accurately and in real time.

title_en: Tunnel excavation face stability experiment equipment and method considering shield cutter head influence
abstract_en: The invention provides tunnel excavation face stability experiment equipment and method considering shield cutter head influence, and the tunnel excavation face stability experiment equipment comprises an integral frame part, a shield system, a cutter head power control system, a soil bin plate power control system and a monitoring system, wherein the integral frame part comprises a test box, a protective cover, a working face, a working table I and a working table II, the shield system comprises a cutter head, a tunnel, a flange and a soil bin plate, the cutter head power system comprises a transmission shaft, a speed reducer II, a motor II and a frequency converter II, the soil bin plate power control system comprises a push rod, a reaction frame, a bearing platform, a ball screw, a guide rail, a speed reducer I, a motor I and a frequency converter I, and the monitoring system comprises a laser ranging device and a spoke type force sensor. The equipment can analyze the stability of the excavation surface under the action of the dynamic cutter head of the shield, and determine the limit supporting pressure required for maintaining the stability of the excavation surface, so that the stability of the excavation surface during shield tunneling construction can be guaranteed.

title_en: Method for detecting absolute content of nicotinamide and nicotinamide mononucleotide
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for detecting absolute contents of Nicotinamide (NAM) and Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN), which can quickly, simply and conveniently detect the absolute contents of NAM and NMN and belongs to the technical field of molecular biology. Firstly, selecting the concentration of an NAM standard substance, processing the NAM standard substance and a sample at the same time, and making an NAM standard curve during data analysis; separating, cracking and/or blocking the intrinsic enzyme reaction of the sample; then, adding excessive Methyl Nitrosourea (MNU), acetophenone, KOH and formic acid into the standard substance, the sample and the blank in sequence for reaction to finally obtain the fluorescent derivative; detecting the fluorescence intensity by using an enzyme-labeling instrument; and finally, analyzing data, and calculating the NAM and NMN content of the sample according to the standard curve. The detection method has the advantages of simple operation, low cost, accuracy, rapidness, short time consumption and high flux.

title_en: Hybridoma cell strain capable of secreting monoclonal antibody of flubendiamide and application of hybridoma cell strain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hybridoma cell strain secreting monoclonal antibodies of flubendiamide and application thereof, and belongs to the field of food safety immunodetection. The flubendiamide complete antigen is completely mixed and emulsified with equivalent Freund's adjuvant, and a BALB/c mouse is immunized by back subcutaneous injection. Complete Freund's adjuvant is used for the first immunization, incomplete Freund's adjuvant is used for multiple times of boosting immunization, and flubendiamide complete antigen is used for the last time of impact immunization. Get high-efficient low IC 50 The spleen cells of the mouse are fused with myeloma cells of the mouse by a PEG method, and a hybridoma cell strain Ta4C1 with the preservation number of CGMCC No.45020 is obtained by screening and three times of subcloning by an indirect competitive enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay. The monoclonal antibody secreted by the cell strain has better specificity and detection sensitivity (IC) to the flubendiamide 50 The value is 2.4ng/mL), provides raw materials for immunoassay of flubendiamide residues in food, and has practical application value.

title_en: Real-time accurate trace moisture determination method and device for assembly line
abstract_en: The application discloses a real-time accurate trace moisture determination method and device for an assembly line, wherein the real-time accurate trace moisture determination method for the assembly line comprises the following steps: moisture absorption treatment, branch introduction into a glove box, residue removal treatment and accurate measurement. The invention has the beneficial effects that: adopt branch pipe and pipe, utilize "T" word sampling method, directly carry out accurate survey with leading-in trace moisture apparatus of solution, reach the effect of assembly line real-time measurement, and before the survey, open the valve on the branch pipe, solution is discharged from the one end of branch pipe, can make remaining solution and gaseous discharge in the branch pipe, avoid remaining solution and gas in the branch pipe, cause the influence to the testing result, the precision of survey has been improved, it connects the solution to have changed the current reagent bottle that adopts, then the enterprising line survey of moisture apparatus of resending, moist environment, or there is remaining reagent bottle inside, when air humidity is great, all can cause the influence to the testing result, reach the effect of accurate survey, and the device is suitable for extensive popularization.

title_en: Intelligent sniffing method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent sniffing method and a system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting and analyzing the gas to be detected to obtain sample information of the gas to be detected; inputting the sample information into a trained odor detection model to obtain an odor objectification grade and a source tracing result; the odor detection model is constructed in the following way: acquiring sample data, wherein each sample data at least comprises K odor substances, and each odor substance comprises a CAS number and a quantization value; establishing a deep learning model by taking the objective odor grade as a dependent variable and K odor substances as independent variables, screening typical odor substances from the peculiar smell according to an odor track graph, and adjusting the weight coefficient of the deep learning model according to a perception threshold and a stimulation threshold of the typical odor substances; and training the deep learning model by adopting the sample data to obtain a trained odor detection model. The invention can rapidly carry out objective grade evaluation, odor tracing, tracing visualization and toxic substance quantification on the odor in the air.

title_en: Application of reagent specifically binding to MUCORICIN protein and trichoderma detection kit
abstract_en: The invention provides an application of a reagent specifically binding to MUCORICIN protein and a trichoderma detection kit. Wherein the use comprises: the reagent for detecting mucorales infection is prepared by using the reagent which is specifically combined with the MUCORICIN protein. Solves the problems of specificity and sensitivity of mucor detection in the prior art, and is suitable for the field of mucor detection.

title_en: Underground water pollution condition detection device and detection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device for detecting pollution condition of underground water. The collecting box comprises a collecting part and a detecting part fixedly connected to the collecting part, wherein the collecting part comprises a collecting box body, a water pumping part positioned in the collecting box body and a water taking part connected with the water pumping part, and the collecting box body is divided into a plurality of spaces for respectively placing the water pumping parts; the detection part comprises a detection host and a detection probe rod, the detection probe rod extends into the collection box body, and the water taking part comprises a telescopic pipe and a filter screen which is fixed on the telescopic pipe in a covering mode and is far away from the end part of the water pumping part. The detection part and the sampling part are integrated into a whole to form a new groundwater pollution condition detection device. When the water sampling device is used, the water taking part extends into the sampling hole, water pumping is stopped when the floating rod is lifted and shaken by water in the collecting box, and the detection part is started to detect a water sample. In the process that the underground water in the space of the collecting box body is detected, the rest of the space can be sampled simultaneously. With this circulation, the detection efficiency of groundwater pollution condition has been improved greatly.

title_en: Preparation and detection method of pepsinogen II time-resolved microsphere detection kit
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of pathological detection of stomach, and provides a preparation method and a detection method of a time-resolved microsphere detection kit for pepsinogen II. The detection method comprises the steps of respectively preparing a microporous plate, a PGII monoclonal antibody marked by europium microspheres, a buffer solution and a concentrated plate washing solution, and carrying out detection analysis by using the prepared reagent and a 96-hole microporous plate and a time-resolved fluoroimmunoassay analyzer, wherein the detection steps are simple, the detection time is short, the test range can reach 0-100ng/ml, the detection sensitivity is higher, the detection range is wider, and the method is more favorable for screening and monitoring stomach diseases.

title_en: Targeted Golgi-body glutathione ratiometric fluorescent probe, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention relates to a glutathione ratiometric fluorescent probe targeting Golgi, in particular to a 4-trifluoromethyl-7-aminoquinoline compound which can be used as the glutathione ratiometric fluorescent probe for detecting glutathione in Golgi and shows selective toxicity to cancer cells. Such probes can achieve at least one of the following technical effects: glutathione is recognized with high selectivity; the response to the glutathione can be quickly realized; the ultra-sensitive analysis of the glutathione can be realized; quantitative analysis of the ratio of glutathione can be realized; golgi can be targeted; can exhibit selective toxicity to cancer cells; has stable properties and can be stored for a long time.

title_en: Monoclonal cell strain secreting antibody with PEDV (porcine epidemic diarrhea Virus) neutralizing activity and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a monoclonal cell strain secreting an antibody with PEDV (porcine epidemic diarrhea Virus) neutralizing activity and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of biology. The name of the monoclonal cell strain is hybridoma cell strain 2B11, and the preservation number is CCTCC NO: c2020188, deposited at the China center for type culture Collection, located at the university of Wuhan, China, in 2020, 9, 26. It can be used for preparing antibodies with PEDV neutralizing activity. The invention also provides a method for detecting the titer of the PEDV vaccine, which has the advantages of good specificity, high sensitivity and simple and convenient operation, can quickly detect the level of PEDV neutralizing antibodies in immune pig serum in batches, can evaluate the immune effect of the PEDV vaccine, and fills the gap of the conventional method for quickly detecting the level of the PEDV antibodies.

title_en: Heterogeneous core model and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a heterogeneous core model and a preparation method thereof, wherein the method comprises the following steps: preprocessing the core body processed into a preset shape; mixing quartz sand with epoxy resin to form an adhesive with permeability close to that of the core body; bonding the at least two pretreated core bodies by using the adhesive; cutting the bonded core body according to a preset size to prepare the heterogeneous core model. The invention can realize that a plurality of outcrop cores with the same layer or similar physical properties as the natural core layer of the reservoir are adopted, the whole core is bonded, pressed and cut, a single-length 1m core model with multiple layers of heterogeneous one-dimensional length is formed, the stability of seepage can be ensured, the vertical heterogeneity of the reservoir can be simulated, and the invention has greater advantages in the development of a method for expanding the swept volume, promotes the technical progress of experimental means, and perfects the physical simulated oil displacement experimental method.

title_en: Recombinant antigen of rat parvovirus RPV-1 specific VP2 gene, synthetic method and kit
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rat parvovirus RPV-1 specific VP2 gene recombinant antigen, a synthesis method and a kit, wherein the amino acid sequence of the rat parvovirus RPV-1 specific VP2 gene recombinant antigen is SEQ ID NO:1. the rat parvovirus RPV-1 specific VP2 gene recombinant antigen of the invention selects specific sequence segment 201-450aa segment on rat parvovirus VP2 protein, and prepares antigen, and establishes indirect ELISA method to realize ELISA detection with low cost, high specificity and safety. The rat parvovirus RPV-1 specific gene recombinant antigen can be used for an indirect ELISA kit of the rat parvovirus or an immunological kit of the rat parvovirus, can be used for independently detecting the rat parvovirus RPV-1, can avoid cross reaction with KRV and H-1 positive serum, has high detection accuracy, and has high detection efficiency, simple detection operation and low detection cost compared with a detection method of virus separation culture and observation identification.

title_en: CXCR4 binding molecules
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to polypeptides (also referred to herein as CXCR4 binding molecules or polypeptides) directed against the G-coupled protein receptor CXCR4, also known as fusin or CD 184. The invention also relates to nucleic acids encoding said polypeptides; methods for preparing the polypeptides; compositions, and in particular pharmaceutical compositions comprising said polypeptides; and the use of said polypeptides for therapeutic or diagnostic purposes.

title_en: Medical test strip analysis
abstract_en: The present invention provides a system having a processor and a memory coupled to the processor. The memory stores a local detection database having a detection profile, wherein the detection profile has a strength threshold indicative of a positive detection result. The system includes a carrier for receiving a cartridge containing lateral flow assay ("LFA") test strips, and an LFA test strip reader coupled to the processor for reading the LFA test strips regardless of the alignment of the cartridge within the carrier and for transmitting LFA test strip images to the processor. The processor determines an LFA detection result based on comparing an intensity value of a portion of the LFA test strip image to the intensity threshold and provides the LFA detection result on an indication panel.

title_en: Device for monitoring poisonous and harmful gas in special environment in real time
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device for monitoring poisonous and harmful gases in a special environment in real time, which comprises a monitoring component, a sliding component, a lifting component, a container and a fixed frame, wherein the monitoring component is arranged on one side of the lifting component, the lifting component is welded on one side of the sliding component, the sliding component is arranged in the container, the container is movably matched on one side of the fixed frame, and the left, right, up and down positions of the monitoring component are adjusted through driving of a first motor and a second motor, so that the device has a wider area for monitoring the poisonous and harmful gases, the flexibility of the monitoring device in use is further improved, the efficiency of the monitoring device in monitoring the poisonous and harmful gases is improved, and unnecessary damage to human bodies caused by monitoring the poisonous and harmful gases in a manual mode is also avoided.

title_en: Method for estimating cyanide release amount after tobacco combustion
