abstract_en: The invention provides a method for estimating the cyanide release amount after tobacco combustion, which comprises the following steps: (1) Detecting the content of water-soluble cyanide precursor in tobacco, namely PCN mug/g, detecting the total nitrogen content in tobacco, namely N mug/g, detecting the total plant alkali content in tobacco, namely Nic mg/g; (2) The cyanide release amount HCN mug/g after tobacco combustion is calculated, wherein a calculation formula is HCN=A+B× (C×PCN-C1×N+c2×Nic), wherein A, B, C, C and C2 are constants, the value range of A is 505-585, the value range of B is 3.2-3.5, the value range of C is 0.6-1.2, the value range of C1 is 10.8-11.6, and the value range of C2 is 1.85-2.0. The estimation method is simple and feasible, the result is accurate, a new strategy is provided for the evaluation of the cyanide release amount of the cigarette smoke, and the estimation method has important significance for the quality control of tobacco products.

title_en: South paddy field nitrogen and phosphorus loss prevention and control equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device for preventing and controlling nitrogen and phosphorus loss in a south paddy field, which is applied to the technical field of agricultural irrigation, and comprises a shell, a monitoring device and an interception device; the shell is provided with the monitoring device and the interception device, and a containing position for containing the shell, the monitoring device and the interception device is arranged at the water outlet of the paddy field; the monitoring device is electrically connected with the interception device, and is used for monitoring the loss condition of nitrogen and phosphorus in the paddy field, and the interception device is used for intercepting the loss of nitrogen and phosphorus in soil and moisture; when the monitoring device monitors that the loss value of nitrogen or phosphorus in the paddy field is larger than a preset value, the interception device is controlled to start to intercept, and the monitoring device is adopted to monitor the loss condition of nitrogen and phosphorus in the paddy field in real time, so that a nitrogen and phosphorus recovery instrument is adopted to recover nitrogen and phosphorus, and the effect of reutilization is realized.

title_en: Preparation method and application of nanoscale cationic carboxyl latex microspheres
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a nano cationic carboxyl latex microsphere, which comprises the following steps: mixing and stirring basic monomer styrene, a functional cationic cross-linking agent, a functional cationic monomer I, a functional cationic monomer II, a cationic emulsifier and an initiator, and polymerizing to obtain latex microspheres; cleaning and dispersing the latex microspheres, and adding concentrated sulfuric acid and a Jones reagent into the dispersion liquid. The cationic carboxyl microspheres obtained by the method have good uniformity, so that carboxyl anions and cations coexist in the polystyrene microspheres, and the carboxyl content is high. The antibody coupling effect is verified by adopting the Alzheimer's disease phosphorylated Tau protein antibody, the carboxyl group of the microsphere is firstly reacted through EDC/NHS through a two-step method, so that the surface of the microsphere only contains cations, and then the cations attract the C end of the antibody, so that the efficiency of coupling the C end to the surface of the microsphere is improved, and the coupling rate of the antibody and the detection sensitivity of the phosphorylated Tau protein are greatly improved.

title_en: Computer process after AQUA enhanced version
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a computer process following an enhanced version of AQUA, in part to a system and method for scoring a sample containing tumor tissue derived from a cancer patient. The score obtained from these methods can indicate the likelihood that the patient is likely to respond positively to immunotherapy. The invention also relates in part to methods of deriving a value for% biomarker positivity (PBP) for all cells present in a field of view of a tissue sample derived from a cancer patient, or alternatively for one or more subsets thereof. The value of PBP can be indicative of the patient's response to immunotherapy.

title_en: Experimental device for strengthening cooling effect of organic coolant in metal tube by using electric field
abstract_en: An experimental device for strengthening the cooling effect of an organic coolant in a metal pipe by utilizing an electric field belongs to the technical field of strengthening heat and mass transfer. The application solves the problem that the existing electric field arranged outside the cooling channel is easy to generate electrostatic shielding phenomenon. The utility model discloses a high-voltage power supply, including first casing, second casing, wire electrode, electrode wire, ceramic pipe, insulating mud, coolant inlet pipeline, metal pipe wears to adorn along the axial and keeps away from the one end of first casing on the second casing, the wire electrode wears to adorn in proper order along the axial in second casing and first casing, and the outside cover of wire electrode that is located the second casing is equipped with ceramic pipe, fills between ceramic pipe and the metal pipe has insulating mud, the positive pole of power, negative pole are connected respectively at the both ends of wire electrode, another tip through connection of second casing has the coolant inlet pipeline. The electrode wire is arranged in the cooling channel based on electrohydrodynamic basis, and the electric field intensity distribution in the cooling channel is controlled by adjusting the surface voltage of the electrode wire, so that a stable and controllable electric field environment is provided for cooling liquid, and the cooling effect is effectively enhanced.

title_en: Hydrate visual development simulation device and experiment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydrate visual development simulation device and an experimental method, belonging to the technical field of petroleum and natural gas exploitation simulation, and comprising the following steps: the visual development simulation device host is provided with a closed space and a plurality of visual windows; a pressure control unit communicated with the closed space; a liquid supply unit communicated with the closed space; the sensor unit comprises a plurality of temperature and pressure sensors pre-embedded at the bottom of the rock core; a temperature control unit; a vacuum unit communicated with the closed space; the gas-liquid separation and collection unit is communicated with the closed space; the data and image acquisition, storage and processing unit comprises a plurality of high-speed cameras and computers which are arranged corresponding to the visual windows. The invention solves the problems that the existing natural gas hydrate development simulation device can not be visualized or indirectly visualized or the working pressure of the visualization device is low, and realizes real-time observation, image and data acquisition and computer-based data and image correlation processing of an experimenter in the natural gas hydrate development process.

title_en: Antibody specifically binding to rotavirus VP6 protein and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an antibody specifically binding to rotavirus VP6 protein and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of biology. The invention provides an antigen, which consists of polypeptide with an amino acid sequence shown as SEQ ID NO. 1; the polyclonal antibody which can be specifically combined with rotavirus VP6 protein can be obtained by immunizing animals with the antigen, and the titer of serum obtained by immunizing animals with the antigen is as high as 1:320 ten thousand, so the polyclonal antibody has great application prospect in rotavirus titration detection and rotavirus neutralizing antibody detection.

title_en: Environmental protection detects auxiliary device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an environment-friendly detection auxiliary device, which comprises a fixed probe rod and a movable probe arranged at the bottom of the fixed probe rod, wherein the movable probe is arranged in an auxiliary box; a rotary replacing device is arranged on the side surface of the limiting piece, and a cleaning device is arranged on one side of the rotary replacing device; the dust collecting device is arranged below the cleaning device and used for concentrating carbon dust cleaned by the cleaning device, the environment-friendly detection auxiliary device can be used for connecting and disassembling the movable probe and the replacement part through the connecting part in a matching mode, the disassembled movable probe is replaced, the cleaning device is used for removing the dust from the attached carbon dust on the replaced movable probe and entering the dust collecting box, direct contact between workers and the carbon dust on the movable probe is avoided, the cleaning efficiency of the movable probe can be improved, and the detection efficiency of automobile exhaust is improved.

title_en: Carbon dioxide concentration prediction method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a carbon dioxide concentration prediction method, a carbon dioxide concentration prediction device, equipment and a medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring first carbon emission data corresponding to a first type boiler and second carbon emission data corresponding to a second type boiler; respectively performing characteristic transformation on the first carbon emission data and the second carbon emission data to obtain a first carbon emission sample set and a second carbon emission sample set; calculating a corrective optimization parameter between the first set of carbon emission samples and the second set of carbon emission samples; constructing a carbon dioxide concentration prediction model according to the training data set and the correction optimization parameters corresponding to the first carbon emission device; and predicting the concentration of the carbon dioxide emitted by the second carbon emission equipment according to the data set to be predicted, the correction optimization parameters and the carbon dioxide concentration prediction model corresponding to the second carbon emission equipment. The method and the device solve the technical problem that in the prior art, the carbon dioxide concentration prediction accuracy is low due to the difference of models of carbon emission devices.

title_en: Rotating disc type measuring mechanism, cleaning and measuring device and chemiluminescence immunoassay analyzer
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rotating disc type measuring mechanism and application thereof, comprising: the transfer disc is used for transferring the reaction cups to corresponding operation positions, the operation positions are distributed in the circumferential direction of the transfer disc and at least comprise reaction cup taking and placing positions and light measuring positions, and reaction cup taking and placing position openings are formed in the top wall of the outer shell corresponding to the reaction cup taking and placing positions; the detection mechanism is correspondingly arranged at the light measurement position and is used for detecting the luminous intensity of the reaction cup in the light measurement position; and the shading device is correspondingly arranged at the position of the reaction cup taking and placing port and can completely shield or open the reaction cup taking and placing port. The invention realizes the measurement of the luminous intensity on the transfer disc, and the transfer disc is completely formed into a closed whole through the shading device, thereby avoiding the external light from entering the measurement position to the maximum extent and ensuring the accuracy of the measurement result.

title_en: Residual chlorine decomposition and disinfection equipment and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses residual chlorine decomposition and disinfection equipment and a control method thereof, and the residual chlorine decomposition and disinfection equipment comprises an ultraviolet reactor for decomposing residual chlorine in water and sterilizing and disinfecting, an inlet residual chlorine detection device arranged at an inlet of the ultraviolet reactor and used for monitoring the concentration of the residual chlorine at the inlet in real time, an outlet residual chlorine detection device arranged at an outlet of the ultraviolet reactor and used for monitoring the concentration of the residual chlorine at the outlet in real time, and an ultraviolet control cabinet used for controlling the irradiation intensity of the ultraviolet reactor, wherein the ultraviolet reactor can release medium-pressure full-band ultraviolet rays and the ultraviolet intensity is adjustable. Setting an inlet target residual chlorine concentration, an outlet target residual chlorine concentration and default operating power of the ultraviolet reactor through an ultraviolet control cabinet; automatically controlling the ultraviolet reactor to pre-adjust the ultraviolet intensity by comparing the inlet residual chlorine concentration with the inlet target residual chlorine concentration; through comparing export chlorine residue concentration with export target chlorine residue concentration, the automatic control ultraviolet reactor finely tunes ultraviolet intensity, until export chlorine residue concentration is unanimous with export target chlorine residue concentration.

title_en: Antibody detection reagent for membranous nephropathy
abstract_en: The invention provides a membranous nephropathy antibody detection reagent, which comprises a slide reagent, a fluorescence-labeled secondary antibody and a phosphate buffer solution, and is characterized in that the slide reagent comprises PLA2R and/or THSD7A transfected cells for expressing labeled fluorescent protein and blank vector transfected cells for expressing the labeled fluorescent protein; the fluorescence of the fluorescently labeled secondary antibody and the fluorescence of the transfected cells expressing the fluorescent protein are fluorescence of different color systems. The method is applied to judging whether a sample contains a target antibody or not through fluorescence of different color systems and fluorescence combination.

title_en: Blood sample detection equipment and detection method thereof
abstract_en: The utility model provides a blood sample check out test set and blood sample detection method, it can accomplish blood conventional examination and glycated hemoglobin to a blood sample and detect, and this glycated hemoglobin detects and realizes through the enzyme method to obtain blood conventional examination result and glycated hemoglobin examination result, not only can improve detection speed, compare with this mode on same assembly line with blood analysis appearance and glycated analysis appearance integration in addition, the structure is compacter, and it is littleer to occupy space.

title_en: Power supply mounting structure and sample analyzer
abstract_en: The invention provides a power supply mounting structure and a sample analyzer, which are used for solving the problem that a power supply and a reaction group are easily influenced in a cross mode in the prior art. The present invention provides a power supply mounting structure, including: the power supply is positioned above the bottom plate and is mounted in a suspended manner; the reaction device also comprises a power supply clapboard and a reaction group, wherein the power supply clapboard is used for isolating the power supply from the reaction group; through carrying out unsettled installation with the power for bottom space in the shell can be vacated out, has improved space utilization, through the setting of power baffle, makes power and reaction group can keep apart, makes the power can not influenced by reaction group, makes the stability and the security of power improve, and the life of power also can obtain the extension simultaneously.

title_en: In-vitro degradation simulation device of degradable vascular stent
abstract_en: The invention provides an in-vitro degradation simulation device of a degradable vascular stent, which belongs to the technical field of biomedical materials and comprises a solution tank, a stent tube, a driving device and an in-vitro degradation simulation device, wherein the interior of the solution tank is suitable for containing degradation solution, the stent tube is provided with an indwelling cavity with two through ends, the indwelling cavity is suitable for being connected with the vascular stent, the driving device is connected with the stent tube, and is suitable for driving the stent tube to reciprocate in the solution tank along the central line direction of the indwelling cavity.

title_en: Multichannel PEM pure water electrolysis hydrogen production testing device and application method
abstract_en: The application discloses a multichannel PEM pure water electrolytic hydrogen production testing device and a using method thereof, wherein the multichannel PEM pure water electrolytic hydrogen production testing device comprises a frame, a pure water supply mechanism, a hydrogen detection assembly and a power supply assembly, the pure water supply mechanism comprises a pure water supply pipeline and a pure water cooling assembly, the pure water supply pipeline comprises a water tank, a water supplementing and filling valve, a plurality of water supply channel water supply pump sets, a plurality of pure water supply pipes and a plurality of pure water return pipes, the hydrogen detection assembly comprises a hydrogen-water separator and a dryer which are arranged in the frame, an intelligent dew point instrument arranged on an instrument display area, a high-pressure mass flowmeter connected with a flow indicator, a plurality of hydrogen collecting joints arranged on an operation area, the power supply assembly comprises a power supply arranged on the frame, a conductivity instrument connected with the power supply, and a plurality of pairs of power supply joints arranged on the operation area, and the testing efficiency is improved by controlling the serial-parallel combination of the power supply and the water flow of the plurality of the water supply channels and the testing of PEM electrolytic tanks under different currents, voltages and flow rates.

title_en: Evaluation method of infant formula milk powder
abstract_en: The invention discloses an evaluation method of infant formula milk powder, which comprises the steps of detecting and uniformly quantizing specific secondary physical parameters in five primary parameter indexes of the milk powder, namely compression, shearing, flowing, granularity and content, drawing a physical fingerprint spectrum as a standard spectrogram according to quantized numerical values, and evaluating the quality of the milk powder; wherein the secondary physical parameters include compressibility, conditional bulk density, cohesion, unconfined yield strength, principal stress, internal friction angle, effective internal friction angle, flow function, basic flow energy, stability index, flow index, etc. The invention determines 18 indexes which can be used for evaluating infant formula milk powder and summarizes the indexes into five first-level indexes. By constructing a conversion formula of various parameter values of the milk powder sample, the physical fingerprint spectrum capable of visually distinguishing the infant formula milk powder is finally obtained. The physical fingerprint spectrum has the advantages of large quantity of related parameter indexes and wide types, and can comprehensively analyze and evaluate the infant formula milk powder.

title_en: Application of mitochondrial respiratory chain complex V in diagnosis of idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis
abstract_en: The application finds that the activity of the mitochondrial respiratory chain complex V of the idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis patient is obviously reduced compared with a healthy person, and finds that the TGF-beta rise is related to the reduction of the activity of the mitochondrial respiratory chain complex V of the pulmonary fibrosis patient, thereby proving that the mitochondrial respiratory chain complex V is used as a molecular marker for diagnosing the idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis. Further, the application discloses the use of an agent for detecting mitochondrial respiratory chain complex V activity in the preparation of a composition or kit for aiding in the diagnosis of idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis, a composition for aiding in the diagnosis of idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis comprising an agent for detecting mitochondrial respiratory chain complex V activity and a kit for aiding in the diagnosis of idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis, and a method of screening an agent for treating idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis in vitro.

title_en: Cultivation ship with cultivation cabin seawater partition intelligent cleaning system and cleaning method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of fishing of culture cabins, and particularly relates to a culture cabin with an intelligent fish-catching and classifying integrated device and a collecting method The automatic fishing device is automatic, reduces the influence of human factors on the production process, and realizes the integration of catching and sorting.

title_en: Model building method for immune checkpoint inhibitor related adverse reaction risk prediction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a biomarker for risk prediction of immune checkpoint inhibitor related adverse reaction, a kit, a model building method and application, and belongs to the technical field of tumors. The biomarkers include peripheral blood platelets, lymphocytes, serum albumin, and serum soluble tumor suppressor (sST 2). The biomarker can well predict the risk of immune checkpoint inhibitor-related adverse reactions.

title_en: Damage monitoring and online maintenance system for thermoplastic composite material structure
abstract_en: The equipment is light and rapidly developed, and the thermoplastic composite material is more and more widely applied. However, currently, there is a low degree of automation in the operational monitoring and maintenance of thermoplastic composite parts. Therefore, the invention provides a damage monitoring and online maintenance system for a thermoplastic composite material structure, which belongs to the technical field of new materials and intelligent manufacturing, and comprises a thermoplastic composite material structure damage identification and positioning and evaluation subsystem, an acoustic emission sensor, a damage identification and evaluation system, a damage positioning system, a three-dimensional laser scanner, a thermoplastic composite material structure damage area pretreatment subsystem, a thermoplastic composite material structure damage area maintenance subsystem and the like, wherein the damage identification and positioning are realized, and then the damage area maintenance is carried out by using a 3D printing technology, so that the problems of time consumption, low efficiency, low automation degree and the like of the traditional maintenance method can be solved, and the system can be applied to equipment such as mining equipment, offshore platforms, airplanes and the like, and is particularly suitable for maintenance in toxic and harmful dangerous environments.

title_en: Hexokinase 2(HK2) acetylation site-specific antibody and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of basic medicine, and particularly relates to a hexokinase 2(HK2) K451 acetylation site specific antibody, and a preparation method and application thereof. The inventor firstly proposes that the acetylation modification of the K451 site of HK2 is closely related to the metastasis and prognosis of cancer (especially colorectal cancer), and based on the discovery, develops a corresponding hexokinase 2(HK2) K451 acetylation site-specific diagnostic antibody, and provides more choices for clinically judging the metastasis and prognosis of cancer.

title_en: A monitoring facilities for safety control for wisdom garden
abstract_en: The invention discloses monitoring equipment for safety management of an intelligent park, and relates to the technical field of monitoring devices. This a monitoring facilities for safety control for wisdom garden, including the stand, the fixed surface of stand installs the equipment shell, the inside of equipment shell is provided with the air monitering subassembly, the inside of equipment shell is provided with retrieves the mechanism, it includes the sliding plate to retrieve the mechanism, the inner wall sliding connection of sliding plate and equipment shell, the last fixed surface of sliding plate installs the connecting rod, the quantity of connecting rod is two and be the symmetry setting, the one end and the air monitering subassembly fixed connection of sliding plate are kept away from to the connecting rod, and the rainwater is discharged along the discharge pipe when the sliding plate moves to the discharge pipe, and spring response elasticity drives the air monitering subassembly and resets to reach in retrieving the equipment shell with the air monitering subassembly automatically when rainwater weather, prevent that the rainwater from leading to the unable normal use of equipment.

title_en: Water resource and water environment monitoring and early warning device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water resource and water environment monitoring and early warning device, which comprises: mounting a support; the floating pontoons are arranged in a plurality, and are symmetrically arranged on the lower end surface of the mounting support; the damping springs are arranged corresponding to the floating cylinders and connected between the mounting support and the floating cylinders; the insertion rods are arranged in a plurality and are vertically inserted into the riverbed, the insertion rods are connected with connecting rope sections, and one ends of the connecting rope sections are connected with the mounting support; the upper fixed body piece is fixed on the upper end surface of the mounting support; the multi-azimuth liquid taking assembly is vertically and relatively arranged on the upper fixed body in a deflecting manner, and can be used for sampling multi-point liquid taking in a specified water area; the water quality detection device is fixed on the upper fixed body; and the warning device is arranged on the upper fixed body piece.

title_en: Coal bed gas biological enrichment experiment system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal bed gas bio-enrichment experiment system, which comprises: a reaction apparatus comprising a plurality of bioreactors; a temperature control device for controlling the reaction temperature of each bioreactor; the automatic sample introduction device is used for respectively inputting a sample, a culture medium and atmosphere gas into each bioreactor; a detection device for detecting the product components and concentrations of the bioreactors; the control device adjusts the reaction temperature of each bioreactor through the temperature control device, controls the sample injection process of each bioreactor through the automatic sample injection device and receives the detection result of the detection device. The invention designs a set of intelligent coal bed gas biological enrichment integrated device with the characteristics of convenience, rapidness, constancy, reality, accuracy and the like by fully considering the biological enrichment constant experimental environment, reducing the uncertainty caused by the regular sampling operation, the consistency of the experimental conditions of the same batch of samples, reducing the artificial error, intelligently controlling the experimental reaction process and the like.

title_en: Water quality biological activity detection method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a water quality bioactivity detection method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of determining a plurality of water quality index sequences of a preset water area in a first time period according to water quality information of the preset water area; and determining the water quality biological activity index according to the plurality of water quality index sequences and the pre-trained water quality detection network. According to the water quality bioactivity detection method disclosed by the embodiment of the disclosure, a plurality of water quality index sequences of a preset water area can be measured in real time and high frequency, so that the data in the water quality index sequences can reflect the current microbial activity in the water body in real time. Furthermore, the water quality index sequence is a plurality of water quality indexes measured in a time period, and the fluctuation condition of biological activity can be reflected through the fluctuation of the water quality indexes, so that the condition of microorganisms in the water body can be more accurately reflected, and bases are provided for water quality monitoring, water bloom prediction and the like.

title_en: Method for establishing bimolecular fluorescence complementary system based on red fluorescent protein in yeast
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for establishing a bimolecular fluorescence complementary system based on red fluorescent protein in yeast. The method comprises the following steps: the yEmRFP (SEQ ID No.1) is divided into an N end (1-159 bit) and a C end (160-236 bit); connecting the coding gene of the target protein A at the 5 'end or the 3' end of the coding gene at the N end through a connecting sequence (coding connecting peptide shown as SEQ ID No. 2) to form a fusion gene segment A; connecting the coding gene of the target protein B at the 5 'end or the 3' end of the coding gene at the C end through the connecting sequence to form a fusion gene segment B; introducing the fusion gene segments A and B into a receptor yeast cell, culturing the obtained transgenic yeast cell, detecting whether the transgenic yeast cell generates red fluorescence or not, and if the transgenic yeast cell generates the red fluorescence, interacting the target protein A and the target protein B; if red fluorescence is not generated, the target proteins A and B do not interact. The BiFC technology established by the invention has higher sensitivity and specificity and is suitable for screening protein interaction in yeast.

title_en: Method for quickly measuring optimal water content of compacted soil of earthwork roadbed
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for quickly measuring the optimal water content of compacted soil of an earthwork roadbed, which comprises the following steps: firstly, making soil samples with different water contents; secondly, clenching the soil sample and obtaining an initial sample image of each clenching soil sample; thirdly, preprocessing an initial sample image; fourthly, constructing an image database; fifthly, training and testing the VGG convolutional neural network; sixthly, quickly measuring the optimal water content of the compacted soil of the earthwork road bed; seventhly, adding water into the actually manufactured earthwork foundation soil, and then executing the sixth step; and eighthly, adding soil into the actually manufactured foundation soil of the earthwork, and then executing the step six. According to the soil sample water content real-time quick adjustment device, a constructor can grab a soil sample to clamp tightly to measure the water content of the soil sample in the soil sample manufacturing process, whether the soil sample required by soil compaction of the earthwork roadbed reaches the optimal water content is quickly identified by using the soil sample water content measurement system, the water content of the soil sample is quickly and conveniently adjusted in real time according to the measurement result of the soil sample water content measurement device, and the timeliness is good.

title_en: Flow type cell pretreatment instrument
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flow cytometry pretreatment instrument. The device consists of a bottom plate, a reaction tube tray, a liquid transfer device, a sample translation device, a sample injection and discharge device, a reagent tank and a needle washing pool. The reagent needle and the puncture needle are respectively aligned with the reagent groove, the sample container, the needle washing pool and the mouth of the reaction tube accurately; the clamping jaw clamps the sample container to shake uniformly in a plane manner under the control of the steering engine; the invention has reasonable design and simple structure, improves the speed of the experiment and the utilization rate of the reagent, avoids the cross contamination of the reagent, avoids the bad sensory stimulation of the short-distance contact of the biological sample and the chemical reagent of the detection personnel, avoids the possible iatrogenic pollution and improves the biological safety level of the experiment.

title_en: Predictive biomarkers for human colorectal cancer or human colorectal cancer metastasis and uses thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a predictive biomarker GJA4 for human colorectal cancer patient prognosis and immunotherapy responsiveness, also called connexin 37(Cx37), the invention discovers through clinical pathology that GJA4 is up-regulated in colorectal cancer tissues, is related to poor prognosis, mainly and intensively expresses on tumor-related fibroblasts, and has lower expression level in normal intestinal epithelial cells; in addition, the expression level of GJA4 is related to infiltration abundance of M2 macrophages, and can be a potential immunosuppressive factor. The research shows that the overexpression of GJA4 is obviously related to the adverse prognosis of the patient in the colorectal cancer tissue, the response of the colorectal cancer patient to immunotherapy can be predicted, and the method has important clinical application value.

title_en: Physical reaction test experiment detection device of medicine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of drug detection devices, in particular to a drug physical reaction test experiment detection device which comprises a device bottom plate and a top cover plate, wherein a host supporting plate is fixedly arranged on the surface of one side of the device bottom plate, a control host is fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the host supporting plate, shock absorption foot pads are respectively and fixedly arranged on the lower surface of the device bottom plate close to the four corners, electromagnet modules are respectively and fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the device bottom plate close to the four corners, and supporting and fixing columns are respectively and fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the device bottom plate close to the four corners; through the screening level box that sets up can make the granule medicine of caking carry out layer upon layer classification according to the caking condition in the medicine physical reaction, and the granule that the caking is the biggest is stayed on the upper strata, and the granule that the caking is little falls downwards in proper order to can be more audio-visual observe the medicine result of the physical reaction experiment that wets, be favorable to detecting more.

title_en: Rheumatism autoantibody detection kit and detection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rheumatism autoantibody detection kit and a detection method thereof. Antigens include U1-RNP, Sm, RO60, SSA, SS-B, Scl-70, Jo-1 and Rib 52. The enzyme conjugate comprises one or more of alkaline phosphatase-labeled goat anti-human IgG, IgM and IgA. The detection method and principle is to adopt an immunoblotting method for in vitro diagnosis. The detection kit provided by the invention can conveniently and rapidly carry out in-vitro detection, and is simple to operate and high in sensitivity; provides a reliable basis for clinical diagnosis, typing, disease observation, prognosis and treatment evaluation of rheumatism.

title_en: Mass spectrometric determination of specific tissue states
abstract_en: The invention relates to the determination of specific tissue states in histological tissue sections from mass spectral signals acquired with spatial resolution and to the visualization of their spatial distribution. The present invention proposes a method by which tissue regions with similar mass spectra are automatically found and further proposes summing the mass spectra of these regions in order to improve the spectral quality to the point where known markers of tissue degeneration can be identified with more certainty. Regions with similar mass spectra may be interconnected on a large scale, but may also be isolated from each other on a small scale.

title_en: Rapamycin ring-opening degradation impurity and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of pharmaceutical chemicals, and particularly relates to rapamycin ring-opening degradation impurities and a preparation method and application thereof. The rapamycin ring-opening compound is obtained by alkaline hydrolysis ring opening, acid neutralization and purification, and the structural formula is as follows: the method has mild reaction conditions and simple operation, can obtain the high-purity rapamycin ring-opening compound, can be used as an impurity reference substance for quality inspection of the rapamycin and the preparation thereof, and improves the accuracy of quality control of the rapamycin and the preparation thereof.

title_en: Adjustable marine buoy support capable of carrying sensor
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of ocean buoys, and particularly relates to an adjustable ocean buoy support capable of carrying a sensor. According to the adjustable ocean buoy support capable of carrying the sensor, the seawater except impurities can be absorbed through the arrangement of the three absorption filter heads, and then the seawater can be detected; by means of the arrangement of the drying plate, the influence of seawater accumulated on the drying plate can be avoided, and further higher result errors are avoided; and can adjust the angle of self and then reach best work angle under the effect of photovoltaic board and electronic gyro wheel, can be under reset spring's effect at last for the sensor butt can reply initial condition fast, and is washd by the clean box and weathers.

title_en: Dissolved oxygen concentration data restoration and prediction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dissolved oxygen concentration data restoration and prediction method which comprises the steps of collecting water quality data, establishing an original data set, identifying missing values, carrying out outlier analysis on the water quality data by utilizing a box graph, eliminating outliers, calculating and repairing the identified missing values and the eliminated outliers by utilizing a Lagrange interpolation method, analyzing the correlation between dissolved oxygen and other water quality parameters by utilizing an improved gray correlation analysis method, optimizing parameters of an LSTM neural network by utilizing a sparrow search algorithm, establishing an improved LSTM model, and predicting the dissolved oxygen data by utilizing the improved LSTM model. The invention establishes an improved LSTM model by utilizing a sparrow algorithm, accurately predicts the change of the concentration of dissolved oxygen on the basis of optimizing the missing value in the original data set to the abnormal value, and provides a water quality high-precision prediction technology of the water power complex estuary area.

title_en: Blood coagulation measuring device, method for measuring blood coagulation time, method for determining completion of blood coagulation reaction, and blood automatic centrifugal separator
abstract_en: The invention discovers that: the progress of blood coagulation reaction can be observed by irradiating a blood collection tube (1) containing a blood test substance with near infrared light having a specific wavelength of 1050 nm to 1350 nm by a near infrared light source (4) and measuring the time change of the intensity of light passing through the inside of the blood test substance detected by an infrared camera (6). Thus, the completion or incompletion of the blood coagulation reaction can be determined from the tendency of increase or decrease in light intensity in addition to the measurement of the blood coagulation time, and the pretreatment step of the centrifugal separation treatment can be automated.

title_en: Method for detecting residual amount of flocculating agent in machine-made sand
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for detecting residual flocculant in machine-made sand, which comprises the following steps: determination of total organic carbon content of tap water as TOC  0  (ii) a Preparing flocculant aqueous solutions with different concentrations by using the tap water, and measuring the total organic carbon content of the flocculant aqueous solutions with different concentrations as TOCs; determining the relationship between TOCs and flocculant concentration of an aqueous flocculant solution by least squares fitting (1) TOCs ═ TOC  0  + K C, and R  2  Checking; mixing the dried sand sample to be measured with tap water, washing with clear water, diluting with sand washing water, and determining total organic carbon content as TOC  Sample (I)  (ii) a Mixing TOC  Sample (I)  Substituting the formula (1) to calculate the residual amount of the flocculating agent in the machine-made sand. The detection method provided by the invention is characterized in that the content of the flocculant is quantitatively represented by adopting a total organic carbon analysis method, and the concentration of the residual flocculant in the machine-made sand can be rapidly detected.

title_en: Be used for mine geological environment monitoring facilities
abstract_en: The invention discloses mine geological environment monitoring equipment, and belongs to the technical field of mine geological monitoring. The utility model provides a be used for mine geological environment monitoring facilities, includes equipment box, equipment locating component, flexible drilling rod and advances the drill bit structure, one side of equipment locating component links to each other with the equipment box, and the opposite side of equipment locating component passes through screw fixed connection with the domatic of waiting to monitor the mine, flexible drilling rod rotates with the equipment box to be connected; the invention has the advantages of convenient and quick installation, no need of an extra mounting frame, better matching with mine ground, higher stability compared with a spring, more stability when drilling into a mountain, difficulty in causing impact damage to the front end of a propelling drill bit structure, capability of forming downward force when rotating when being jointed with soil, capability of telescoping a telescopic drill rod, capability of adjusting the length of a specific distance according to the actual geological exploration requirement, and deep penetration into the mountain.

title_en: BCMA-targeted nano antibody and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nano antibody, which comprises a heavy chain variable region containing CDR1, CDR2 and/or CDR3, has the function of identifying and combining with BCMA, and the specific CDR sequence is shown in the text. The invention also discloses a BCMA binding molecule, a composition containing the nano antibody or the BCMA binding molecule, a BCMA detection agent and application of the nano antibody, the BCMA binding molecule or the composition in preparing medicines for treating diseases related to BCMA. The nanobody, BCMA binding molecule and composition of the invention can recognize and bind BCMA, and have potential utility in treating diseases associated with BCMA.

title_en: Effective state analysis method for soil
abstract_en: The invention provides a soil effective state analysis method, and relates to the field of soil effective state analysis. The effective state analysis method of the soil comprises the steps of obtaining a soil sample for effective state analysis; preparing the soil sample into a soil solution according to a preset soil-to-liquid ratio; obtaining the pH value of the soil solution; selecting a leaching agent according to the pH value of the soil solution, wherein the leaching agent is used for leaching heavy metal elements in the soil solution; and separating clear liquid and residues of the leached soil solution, and determining the content of the heavy metal elements. The soil effective state analysis method provided by the invention can automatically carry out effective state analysis on the soil, has the characteristics of convenience in operation and easiness in analysis, and is beneficial to reducing the labor input.

title_en: Environment-friendly atmosphere monitoring unmanned aerial vehicle capable of monitoring environmental pollution concentration
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, and provides an environment-friendly atmosphere monitoring unmanned aerial vehicle capable of monitoring environmental pollution concentration, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle main body, wherein the upper end of the main body is in threaded connection with an installation frame, a plurality of detectors of different types are installed on the installation frame, each detector detects one atmosphere pollutant in the environment and detects the corresponding concentration, and the installation frame is used for performing gravity distribution on a plurality of detectors of different weights so as to ensure that the weight born by the unmanned aerial vehicle in all directions is the same or close and the normal flight and steering of the unmanned aerial vehicle are not influenced. Install the mounting bracket additional in the unmanned aerial vehicle main part and be used for various types of detector installation specially, drive the xarm through electronic jar in the mounting bracket and go up and down for the extrusion pole of xarm front end carries out the locking control of position to the slide that removes along the ring frame well annular, and electronic jar drives fluted wheel or gear and meshes mutually simultaneously, makes the motor drive the xarm rotate, and then drives the slide and carry out the removal of position along the annular.

title_en: Special base for flaw detector
abstract_en: The invention provides a special base for a flaw detector, which relates to the field of flaw detector bases and comprises a base, wherein the base is integrally formed by welding a left longitudinal support ground contact rod and a right longitudinal support ground contact rod and two first cross support connecting rods which are symmetrically welded between the two longitudinal support ground contact rods in a front-back mode; all weld a driven gear on the bottom swivel of two said swing vaulting poles, and the symmetry rotates between two L form installation axles and two installation earrings and installs two intermediate gears, two driven gears and two scarce tooth gears correspond around being and two intermediate gear meshing transmissions, power transmission through two intermediate gears, the appearance body of detecting a flaw is when lasting upwards swinging and erectting and being applicable to the rainy day and using, can link the meshing and order about driven gear and two swing vaulting poles, control rain cover pendulum changes the overhead and implement rain-sheltering to the appearance body of detecting a flaw in the top of the appearance body of detecting a flaw, this saves the trouble that extra manual operation hides rain part pendulum and changes the receipts exhibition around rainy day uses.

title_en: Peste des petits ruminants virus antibody detection kit
abstract_en: The application discloses a peste des petits ruminants virus antibody detection kit. The peste des petits ruminants virus antibody detection kit comprises a solid carrier and a specific polypeptide combination independently connected to the solid carrier. Even in the case of immunizing a subject organism in an animal population with a live attenuated peste des petits ruminants virus vaccine, the use of the kit for detecting antibodies against peste des petits ruminants virus of the present invention enables discrimination between vaccine immunity and natural infection without knowing whether or not the subject organism has been immunized with the vaccine and the time at which the subject organism has been immunized with the vaccine.

title_en: Platelet activation assay based on soluble CLEC-2 and platelet count
abstract_en: The present invention has developed a biomarker that better reflects platelet activation in a living body, and provides a method that can be used to assist in grasping the platelet activation state for examination of thrombotic hemostatic diseases and the like. The method for assisting in grasping the platelet activation state comprises (1) a step of measuring the concentration of soluble CLEC-2 in a sample from a subject and the number of platelets, (2) a step of dividing the concentration of soluble CLEC-2 by the number of platelets to calculate a value of the concentration of soluble CLEC-2/the number of platelets, and if necessary, a step of comparing the value of the concentration of soluble CLEC-2/the number of platelets obtained using the sample from a healthy subject.

title_en: Industrial flue gas emission monitoring equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses industrial flue gas emission monitoring equipment which comprises a detection main body, wherein the detection main body comprises a processing and analyzing assembly, a heat tracing sampling tube and a sampling part are fixedly communicated with the outer side of the processing and analyzing assembly, the sampling part comprises an inner connecting tube, and the outer end of the inner connecting tube is fixedly communicated with a flange plate detachably mounted with an external pipeline valve. This industry fume emission monitoring facilities can solve prior art effectively, the narrowest department at the flue should probably be selected at the flue gas sampling point, so that the flue gas velocity of flow is higher, the combustion products intensive mixing, and the sampling point extends the middle part of flue gas circulation cross-section best, reduce measuring error, but the flue gas sampling probe that current fume emission monitoring facilities was equipped with mostly adopts integral type mechanism, the measuring length of sampling probe can not effectively be adjusted, can't satisfy the problem that different diameter chimneys or flue gas collection analysis.

title_en: High-affinity fully human monoclonal antibody for resisting rabies virus and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fully human monoclonal antibody of high affinity anti-rabies virus, belonging to the field of biological immunology. The heavy chain variable region of the monoclonal antibody or the binding fragment thereof has a nucleotide sequence of the heavy chain variable region shown as SEQ ID NO. 11; and the variable region of the light chain nucleotide sequence shown in SEQ ID NO 12. The invention also provides a coding gene, an expression vector, application and a composition of the antibody. Rabies virus Glycoprotein (GP) is the only protective antigenic protein on the surface of the virus. The invention successfully constructs a prokaryotic expression vector of rabies virus specific antigen protein, and expresses and purifies the prokaryotic expression vector by utilizing an escherichia coli prokaryotic system, and the antigen protein is successfully used for screening antibodies. And 1 strain of specific fully human monoclonal antibody sequence aiming at rabies virus GP fragment is successfully screened by using the screening platform, which lays a foundation for clinically developing antibody medicaments for treating rabies.

title_en: Ozone source analysis method based on precursor receptor model and box model
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ozone source analysis method based on a precursor acceptor model and a box model. The method is a qualitative and quantitative analysis method for atmospheric ozone pollution sources based on real-time observation data, and specifically comprises the steps of measuring the concentration of pollutants and other parameters in the environment, inputting the concentration of Volatile Organic Compounds (VOCs) into a receptor model to conduct source analysis on the pollutants, inputting the pollutants and other parameters into a box model to calculate ozone generation rates of pollutants of different species at specific moments, and finally combining the VOCs component spectrum obtained by a precursor receptor model to obtain the ozone generation rates of different sources at different moments. The method realizes qualitative and quantitative analysis of the source of the ozone precursor, improves the accuracy of model simulation, and enables the model simulation to be more fit with the real air pollution process.

title_en: Ozone pollutant monitoring and treating device for atmospheric environment and using method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of air quality monitoring, in particular to an ozone pollutant monitoring and treating device for an atmospheric environment and a using method thereof. The ozone pollutant detection device has the advantages of being convenient to adjust and use, and capable of reducing labor intensity of workers, so that ozone pollutant detection efficiency is improved.

title_en: Pipe gallery well lid for gas basement self-detecting gas components and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pipe gallery well cover for self-detecting gas components of a gas basement and a method thereof, belongs to the technical field of pipe gallery well covers, and comprises a well cover table sub-base, wherein an installation inner groove for accommodating a well cover body is formed in the well cover table sub-base, and a gas detection assembly is arranged below the well cover body. According to the pipe gallery well lid and the method for automatically detecting gas components in the gas basement, a detection system is used for analyzing results and monitoring in real time, gas in a basement can be known, the use safety is improved, continuous power supply is realized, energy waste is reduced, the detection cost is reduced, manual power supply is not needed, the use convenience is improved, the detection depth can be adjusted according to needs, the detection accuracy is improved, the detection quality is ensured, the surface of the pipe gallery well lid is cleaned by a scraper, the filter screen is prevented from being blocked, the filter effect is improved, and the drainage efficiency is improved.

title_en: Sampling analysis test device and method for ultrasonic range finder
abstract_en: A sampling analysis test device of an ultrasonic range finder comprises the ultrasonic range finder and an ultrasonic range finder test container, wherein the ultrasonic range finder test container is connected with a sealing flange, and the ultrasonic range finder is installed in the sealing flange in a threaded manner; the sealing flange is also connected with an aviation plug, and the aviation plug is connected with an ultrasonic distance meter; the ultrasonic distance meter test container is also connected with a three-way joint, and the three-way joint is connected with a vacuum hose and a pressure gauge; the aviation plug is provided with a cable special for the aviation plug, and the cable special for the aviation plug is connected with the distance measuring instrument. According to the invention, the ultrasonic range finder sealing flange, the aviation plug, the ultrasonic range finder test container and the ultrasonic range finder are connected, so that the ultrasonic range finder is well sealed, and a high-vacuum sampling environment is ensured.

title_en: Visualization method and system for gridding atmospheric pollutant emission
abstract_en: The invention discloses a visualization method and a visualization system for gridding atmospheric pollutant emission, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a gridding monitoring mode, and acquiring the atmospheric pollutant emission data in each grid; analyzing and judging the emission data of the atmospheric pollutants to obtain a judgment result; visually displaying the judgment result, and accurately managing the environment based on the display result; the system comprises: the system comprises a grid construction module, a data acquisition module, a data analysis module and a visual display module. Through the technical scheme, the method and the system can realize real-time monitoring of the monitoring data of the air quality gridding monitoring station, and can realize the crossing of environmental management from extensive management to accurate management.

title_en: Indoor environment formaldehyde detection device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a formaldehyde detection device for an indoor environment, which comprises an exhaust duct, a fan and a case, wherein the case is installed on the outer surface of the exhaust duct; the formaldehyde detection device comprises a placing platform and a detection device, wherein the placing platform is provided with a placing opening and a sealing ring arranged at the top of the placing platform, the inner surface of the sealing ring is connected with a detection cylinder in a sliding mode, the left side of the top of the placing platform is fixedly connected with a controller, and the bottom of the placing platform is fixedly connected with a case. This indoor environment formaldehyde detection device makes and collects the casing and be in the air that the height of difference can be to different positions and collect the detection, and then has reduced the holistic detection error of equipment, is convenient for clean its surface, has avoided equipment to collect the casing when not using and has caused the condition of damage because of bumping.

title_en: Dining game system and method for old people
abstract_en: The invention discloses a meal game system and method for old people, which comprises an intelligent application terminal system, a background server system general platform and a communication module, wherein the intelligent application terminal system comprises an APP small program, a third party system or platform, a main control module or a subentry control module, meal game software of the old people is downloaded, installed and connected on the intelligent application terminal system, and the game platform on the meal game of the old people is combined with a VR3D system to enable the old people to virtually experience games on the game platform, particularly to provide a mental virtual world for the old people in the late year, and relieve the empty, solitary or silent mood of the old people for the old people in the mental life and daily life and enrich the nutrition and health of the old people in the aspects of mental life and daily life.

title_en: Physical property evolution simulation device for tight oil reservoir
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tight oil reservoir physical property evolution simulation device, which can realize automatic pressurization on a sand oil storage structure at the upper part by arranging an upper simulation pressing mechanism, can effectively apply pressure on the side surface by arranging a left side oscillation pressing mechanism and a right side oscillation pressing mechanism, is convenient for simulating the phenomenon that sandstone is extruded from the side surface in reality, can simulate the humidity condition in the sandstone in reality by arranging a front humidity control mechanism and a rear humidity control mechanism, and is convenient for simulating the real porosity.

title_en: Method for rapidly detecting trace dibromophosphate residue in agricultural products
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for rapidly detecting trace dibromophosphate residue in agricultural products, which comprises the following steps: step a, performing pretreatment to obtain a first object to be detected; step b, extracting and filtering to obtain a first solution to be detected; c, adding the reaction solution, and reacting to obtain a second solution to be detected; step d, adding a sodium hydroxide solution for layered extraction, adding a saturated sodium chloride solution into the lower layer, uniformly mixing, and heating for reaction to obtain a third solution to be detected; step e, adding a third solution to be detected into the newly prepared copper hydroxide suspension, heating, and observing the phenomenon; and f, judging the result. The method has the advantages of simple and understandable principle, strong specificity, high sensitivity, visual detection result, high accuracy of the detection result, no need of a large-scale analyzer, relatively less time consumption, extremely low uniform analysis cost, suitability for on-site rapid detection of the dibromophosphate residue in agricultural products and very strong practicability.

title_en: Gas monitoring system and monitoring method for hexafluorobutadiene storage place
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of intelligent gas monitoring, and particularly discloses a gas monitoring system of a hexafluorobutadiene storage place and a monitoring method thereof. In this way, the concentration of the hexafluorobutadiene gas in the storage site can be accurately monitored.

title_en: Evaluation method for influence of hydrogenation catalyst of raw material benzene p-nitrobenzene and production method of aniline
abstract_en: The invention relates to an evaluation method for influence of a raw material p-nitrobenzene hydrogenation catalyst, which comprises the following steps: the heavy component monitoring index is added to the purchased raw material benzene, and the heavy component below a certain content can be directly used for the nitration and hydrogenation processes; and (3) when the heavy component is higher than a certain content, concentrating the raw material benzene, evaluating the influence of the heavy component on the activity of the hydrogenation catalyst, and formulating a raw material benzene use and treatment scheme according to an evaluation result. The invention also relates to a production method of the aniline. The method can effectively prevent substances which are harmful to the catalyst from being carried in the raw material benzene, and the nitrobenzene enters the hydrogenation reactor, so that the activity of the catalyst is effectively prevented from being reduced, the severe fluctuation of the hydrogenation reaction parameters is caused, the catalyst consumption is further increased rapidly, the integral inactivation of the system catalyst can be caused in serious cases, and the stability of the production process is improved.

title_en: Ligation-co-localization sandwich assay for multiplexing
abstract_en: Methods and systems for detecting and/or quantifying an analyte are provided. In particular, methods and systems for simultaneously detecting and/or quantifying two or more analytes in a sample are provided. A ligation-co-localization assay (CLAMP) on microparticles can be engineered and used to effectively multiplex the detection of analytes in a sample. There is provided a link-co-localized (CLA) structure for detecting or quantifying an analyte in a sample, the CLA structure comprising: a carrier; a capture reagent attached to the carrier; a detection reagent anchor polynucleotide attached to the vector, wherein the anchor polynucleotide comprises an anchor sequence; and a detection reagent linked to the hook polynucleotide and an anchor binding sequence complementary to at least a portion of the anchor sequence, wherein the detection reagent releasably binds to the detection reagent anchor polynucleotide.

title_en: Water quality detection system for controlling grouper diseases and control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water quality detection system for preventing and controlling grouper diseases, which comprises a mounting plate, a supporting plate and a control box, wherein the control box is fixedly connected with the bottom of the mounting plate, one side of the mounting plate is fixedly connected with a plurality of locking blocks, and locking openings are formed in the locking blocks; the control method comprises the following steps: step 1: firstly, a communication module receives a remote control instruction, and then a cylinder is started to drive a stand column to move up and down, so that the height of a fixed plate is adjusted; step 2: then, detecting the water body by using a detection module, and sending a detection signal to a controller; step 3: after the controller processes the detection signal, the detection data is sent to a remote control center through a communication module for analysis and processing. According to the invention, through the arrangement of the detection module, the control module and the communication module, the culture water body can be effectively detected, and the garrupa is prevented from being affected by the water quality problem, so that the culture benefit of the garrupa is effectively improved.

title_en: Air quality monitoring device and monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an air quality monitoring device and a monitoring method, and the air quality monitoring device comprises a waterproof cloth, a first monitoring main body, a second monitoring main body, a fixed support base, an opening and closing control device, a limiting clamping groove, a limiting toothed plate, a controller and a control display screen, wherein the control display screen is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the limiting toothed plate, and the controller is fixedly arranged inside the bottom end of the control display screen. According to the invention, the first monitoring main body and the second monitoring main body are arranged, the device can synchronously monitor the air with different heights by controlling the use and the monitoring height of the first monitoring main body and the second monitoring main body to be different, the three sliding control devices in the first monitoring main body and the second monitoring main body can respectively control the three monitoring parts to slide along the lifting mounting frame to adjust and control the monitoring area and the monitoring point, the multi-point synchronous monitoring in different areas can be realized, and the monitoring result is more accurate.

title_en: Combined test method for detecting addition of anti-stripping agent to improve adhesion performance of acid aggregate and asphalt concrete and determining doping amount
abstract_en: The invention discloses a combined test method for detecting the addition of an anti-stripping agent to improve the adhesion performance of acid aggregate and asphalt concrete and determining the doping amount, which comprises the following steps: s1: washing acid natural gravel materials, crushing and screening to obtain coarse and fine aggregates meeting the grading required by engineering; s2: carrying out chemical analysis on the coarse and fine aggregates to determine the coarse and fine aggregates as acid aggregates; s3: selecting asphalt meeting engineering requirements, filler meeting set technical requirements and a plurality of different types of anti-stripping agents to be tested; s4: selecting coarse and fine aggregates and asphalt to carry out adhesion test; s5: selecting coarse and fine aggregates and asphalt to perform an asphalt concrete water stability test; s6, carrying out an asphalt film oven aging test; s7: according to the orthogonal test scheme, a water boiling method, an asphalt concrete water stability test and an asphalt film oven aging test are respectively carried out. The method disclosed by the invention is objective in evaluation and high in accuracy, and provides technical support for the application of the acidic aggregate in hydraulic engineering.

title_en: Method, device, medium and system for detecting chemical oxygen demand of wastewater
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of water quality monitoring, and discloses a method for detecting the chemical oxygen demand of wastewater, which is used for acquiring characteristic parameter data of a water sample to be detected in real time; and inputting the characteristic parameter data into a preset chemical oxygen demand prediction model to obtain the chemical oxygen demand of the water sample to be detected. The preset chemical oxygen demand prediction model can predict the chemical oxygen demand according to the characteristic parameter data of the water sample, so that the chemical oxygen demand of the water sample can be predicted by inputting the characteristic parameter data of the water sample to be detected, which is acquired in real time, into the preset chemical oxygen demand prediction model; compared with the method for detecting the chemical oxygen demand of the water sample by a chemical method, the method for predicting the chemical oxygen demand by the model has the advantages of high speed, no need of consuming chemicals, almost no influence on water quality, low cost, capability of reflecting the change of the chemical oxygen demand in the wastewater in real time and capability of providing instant data guidance for the actual production process.

title_en: Method for determining type of gas well output liquid
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for determining the type of gas well output liquid, which comprises the following steps: 1) Respectively detecting delta of stratum water sample, external water sample and output liquid  2  H and delta  18  O; 2) According to delta of the stratum water sample  2  H and delta  18  O and delta of the extraneous water sample  2  H and delta  18  O, establishing a marking line; 3) According to delta of the marking line and the output liquid  2  H and delta  18  And O, determining the type of the output liquid. According to the method for determining the type of the gas well output liquid, provided by the invention, the relation between the oxyhydrogen isotope value of the gas well output liquid and the mark line determined by the oxyhydrogen isotope value of the formation water sample and the oxyhydrogen isotope value of the external water sample can be used for accurately judging whether the gas well output liquid is formation water or external water or a mixed liquid of the formation water and the external water, and the method is simple to operate and can provide support for efficient development and management of the gas well.

title_en: Test device and method for explosive response under mechanical and thermal compound stimulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a test device and a test method for explosive response under mechanical and thermal compound stimulation, which can be used for recovering a flat plate impact experiment and avoid the influence of secondary damage of a sample on the impact damage characteristic research of the sample. Including sample impact systems, test systems, and recovery systems. The sample impact system consists of a fly sheet, a sample and a coated PMMA window. The test system consisted of PZT probes, VISAR systems, and PMMA through holes. The recovery system consists of a steel front end cover, a recovery sleeve, a rear end cover, a limit steel ring and a pressurizing spring. The device is used for executing measurement and baking test, wherein the measurement test is to drive the flying sheet impact test device under a certain vacuum degree. The PZT probe measures the moment at which the shock wave reaches the sample interface. And VISAR, measuring the particle speed history of the interface of the sample and the coated PMMA window by the system, and calculating the sound speed of the sample. The baking and burning test is to use a temperature control box to control a heater to heat the whole recovery sleeve, and use a temperature thermocouple to measure the environmental temperature in response to the mechanically damaged sample.

title_en: Device and method for testing gas hydrate decomposition rate
abstract_en: The invention provides a device and a method for testing the decomposition rate of a gas hydrate. The testing device comprises a sample container, a calibration container, a cooling device, a temperature measuring device, a gas pressure measuring device, a vacuum pump, a high-pressure gas storage device and a constant temperature box. The sample container, the calibration container, the high-pressure gas storage device and the vacuum pump are respectively connected to the same connecting pipeline through different valves; the sample container, the calibration container and the connecting pipeline form a closed system, and the closed system is positioned in the constant temperature box; the temperature measuring device and the gas pressure measuring device are respectively used for measuring the temperature and the pressure of the gas in the connecting pipeline; the cooling device is used for adjusting the temperature in the sample container. Compared with the prior art, the testing device simulates the real reservoir conditions of the seabed hydrate reservoir, simulates and tests the decomposition rate of the natural gas hydrate under different temperature and pressure conditions aiming at the processes of heating exploitation, depressurization exploitation and the like, and provides important technical support for the selection of exploitation parameters and the optimization design of an exploitation scheme.

title_en: Application of 4,4-dimethyl oxazoline in preparation of reagent containing horseradish peroxidase
abstract_en: The application relates to an application of 4,4-dimethyl oxazoline in preparing a reagent containing horseradish peroxidase. The inventor of the application discovers that the 4,4-dimethyl oxazoline can obviously improve the stability of horseradish peroxidase and horseradish peroxidase labeled antibodies in a solution. Therefore, the application of the 4,4-dimethyl oxazoline in preparing the reagent containing the horseradish peroxidase can improve the stability of the horseradish peroxidase in the reagent containing the horseradish peroxidase and widen the application field of the horseradish peroxidase.

title_en: Lake water pollution treatment method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of water pollution treatment, in particular to a lake water pollution treatment method and a system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1, a data acquisition module acquires a plurality of water pollution characteristic parameters for representing lake water pollution conditions; s2, the central control module controls a screening module to screen the water pollution characteristic parameters acquired by the data acquisition module; s3, the central control module secondarily judges whether factory pollutant leakage occurs according to the actual concentration of the pollutant on the monitoring section, which is detected by the pollutant concentration sensor; s4, the central control module judges whether the water pollution degree of the lake is in an allowable range according to the actual value of the lake water pollution influence evaluation parameter; and S5, secondarily adjusting the water pollutant concentration screening reference value to a second corresponding value by the central control module according to the difference value between the actual number of the aquatic plant species and the preset number of the aquatic plant species. The invention realizes the improvement of the accuracy of the treatment of the lake water pollution.

title_en: Plasma preservation solution, blood coagulation quality control product and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biology, in particular to a plasma preservation solution, a blood coagulation quality control product and application thereof. The plasma preservation solution consists of nicotinamide, tris (hydroxymethyl) aminomethane, sucrose, aprotinin, magnesium chloride, manganese chloride, a preservative, a defoaming agent and a pH regulator, the liquid coagulation quality control product prepared by adopting the plasma preservation solution has no matrix effect and high stability, and the values of PT, APTT, TT, FIB and AT-III coagulation tests are within the coagulation indexes of normal people, so that the quality control requirements of the PT, APTT, TT, FIB and AT-III coagulation tests are met.

title_en: Application of reagent for detecting Prdx1 protein in preparation of early diagnosis/prognosis product of acute organ injury or sepsis
abstract_en: The invention discloses an application of a reagent for detecting biomarkers in a sample in preparing an early diagnosis/prognosis product of acute organ injury or sepsis, wherein the biomarkers comprise Prdx1 protein or specific antibodies of Prdx1 protein. Experiments show that the expression level of Prdx1 protein is remarkably increased in organ injury serum or other body fluids or samples such as bronchoalveolar lavage fluid and the like, and the Prdx1 protein can be a clinical target of organ injury; and in acute liver failure, the content of the Prdx1 protein in the serum is increased earlier than ALT. The expression level of Prdx1 of the test subject sample is detected by detecting the serum of the test subject sample or specific antibodies of Prdx1 protein in other body fluids such as bronchoalveolar lavage fluid and the like or samples, so that whether the test subject suffers from organ injury or not and the severity of the injury can be effectively judged, and the test subject sample has important research significance and clinical application value for the organ injury.

title_en: Method for determining remote scenic area of hydrothermal uranium ore
