abstract_en: The application relates to a method for analyzing a geologic body by means of physical and chemical properties of the geologic body, in particular to a method for determining a remote scenery region of a hydrothermal uranium mine, which comprises the steps of determining a first region in an investigation region, wherein the first region is a region in which at least one abnormal region corresponding to an element group is distributed, determining a second region in the investigation region, wherein the second region is a region in which a mineral vein is located, determining a third region in the investigation region, wherein the third region is a region in which uranium content in surface rock in the investigation region is larger than a preset value and a marker in the surface rock has rigid deformation and plastic deformation at the same time, and determining the remote scenery region of the hydrothermal uranium mine based on one or more of the first region, the second region and the third region.

title_en: Integrated intelligent wrist-watch that has wine system of driving of preventing
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent watch integrated with a drunk driving prevention system, which comprises a dial plate, wherein a base is fixedly installed on one side of the dial plate, and a charging module is fixedly connected to the middle of the base. According to the invention, the detection switch is arranged on the touch dial plate, the detection switch is touched and then blows air towards the alcohol detection device, the gas exhaled by an operator can be captured and analyzed by the internal acquisition module, the analyzed data is converted into an electric signal and transmitted to the processing module, the processing module can display the obtained data through the touch screen, if the standard of drunk driving is met, the touch screen can present red content to remind the operator of not driving, at the moment, the alarm sound is sent out through the loudspeaker, the warning lamp flickers red and blue alternating light to remind the operator, if the operator holds the driving, the function of using the intelligent watch as a car key is disabled, so that the operator cannot start a car, and the behavior of reminding or preventing the operator from driving after drinking is realized.

title_en: Sensor arrangement optimization method for urban lake basin water quality monitoring
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water quality monitoring, in particular to a sensor arrangement optimization method for monitoring water quality of a river basin of an urban lake, which comprises the following steps: dividing an urban lake basin into a plurality of preset modules through a partition net, and putting a plurality of sensors capable of moving autonomously in each preset module to form a sensor network; setting an initial sampling frequency and a pollution degree triggering threshold value of a sensor in each preset module, and acquiring water pollution information by the sensor through an acquisition node of the sensor at regular time according to the set initial sampling frequency. The invention can monitor the change of the water pollution degree in real time, can adjust different working energy consumption of the sensor according to different pollution degrees, has high use flexibility, improves the cruising ability of the sensor, can adjust the position of the sensor according to the pollution degree, and can accurately obtain the water pollution degree of the lake by adjusting the spacing position and the sampling frequency of the sensor, improve the detection accuracy and ensure the detection accuracy.

title_en: Preparation method and application of ternary heterojunction composite material photoelectrochemical immunosensor
abstract_en: A preparation method and an application of a ternary heterojunction composite material photoelectrochemical immunosensor belong to the technical field of photoelectrochemical biosensors, and particularly relate to a method for preparing a ternary heterojunction composite material photoelectrochemical immunosensor by adopting BiPO  4  A preparation method and application of a photoelectrochemical immunosensor for detecting alpha fetoprotein by using a BiOBr/CdS composite material are provided. According to the method, a ternary heterojunction is assembled on an FTO modified electrode to fix a capture antibody, and accurate determination of alpha fetoprotein is realized through photocurrent signal response. BiPO  4  the/BiOBr heterojunction enlarges the forbidden band width and enlarges the light absorption range; the absorption of visible light is enhanced due to the sensitization of the CDs, thereby increasing the photocurrent signal. The method has good stability and specificityThe kit has the advantages of high sensitivity, good reproducibility and the like, is good for quickly detecting the alpha fetoprotein, solves the technical difficulties in the prior art, and provides a feasible method for detecting the tumor marker.

title_en: Method for predicting surface quality grade of steel plate
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a method for predicting the surface quality grade of a steel plate, which comprises the following steps: in the current continuous casting process, the equivalent number of non-metallic inclusions in molten steel in a tundish is obtained, the equivalent number of the non-metallic inclusions is used for representing the cleanliness of the molten steel, and the cleanliness of the molten steel is positively correlated with the quality of a continuous casting billet produced in the current continuous casting process; and predicting the surface quality grade of the steel plate corresponding to the current continuous casting process according to the equivalent number of the nonmetallic inclusions. The method can obtain the equivalent number of the non-metallic inclusions of the molten steel in the tundish in the current continuous casting process, and predict the surface quality grade of the steel plate corresponding to the current continuous casting process according to the equivalent number of the non-metallic inclusions, so that guidance is provided for subsequent steel plate production, the surface defects of the steel plate can be reduced, the surface quality of the steel plate is improved, and the high-quality steel plate is produced.

title_en: Anti-human LAG-3 antibodies and their use in Immunohistochemistry (IHC)
abstract_en: The present invention provides chimeric or recombinant antibodies (abs) or antigen-binding fragments thereof, or monomeric or dimeric antigen-binding proteins, which can specifically bind human LAG-3 polypeptides, including human LAG-3 polypeptides expressed on the surface of lymphocytes, such as tumor-infiltrated activated T cells or tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes (TILs); and methods of making and using the same. In alternative embodiments, the chimeric or recombinant antibody (Ab) or antigen-binding fragment thereof, or monomeric or dimeric antigen-binding protein as provided herein is used for in vitro diagnosis by its ability to specifically bind activated T cells or tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes that have infiltrated a tumor, e.g., in Immunohistochemistry (IHC), e.g., for diagnosis and/or treatment of cancer, e.g., bladder cancer, urothelial cancer, breast cancer, lung cancer, non-small cell lung cancer, kidney cancer, clear cell carcinoma of the kidney, and/or melanoma or malignant melanoma.

title_en: Lubricating apparatus oil monitoring
abstract_en: The invention relates to a detection device (25) for detecting particles in lubricating oil of a machine, comprising a particle separator (24.1, 24.5, 24.6); at least one particle detector (25.2, 25.3); a bypass conduit (25.1) for oil collected by the particles, which is fluidly connected to the oil outlet (24.7) of the particle separator (24.1, 24.5, 24.6), thereby collecting the particles; and wherein at least one particle detector (25.2, 25.3) is operatively mounted on the bypass conduit (25.1) so as to be able to detect particles in the bypass conduit.

title_en: Magnetic control-based microsphere array chip, detection assembly, detection system and detection method
abstract_en: The invention provides a magnetic control-based microsphere array chip, a detection assembly, a detection system and a detection method. The microsphere array chip comprises a chip substrate; a first micro-channel, a second micro-channel and a reaction cavity are arranged in the chip substrate, and a sample inlet and a sample outlet are arranged on the top surface of the chip substrate; one side of the reaction cavity is communicated with the sample inlet through a first micro-channel, and the other side of the reaction cavity is communicated with the sample outlet through a second micro-channel; a micro magnetic cone array is embedded below the reaction cavity in the chip substrate. The microsphere array detection assembly comprises: microsphere array chips based on magnetic control; and the second magnet is arranged below the magnetic control-based microsphere array chip and can adjust the distance between the second magnet and the microsphere array. The detection system comprises a liquid storage device communicated with the sample inlet; the inlet is communicated with the waste liquid pool of the sample outlet; a negative pressure pump communicated with the outlet of the waste liquid pool; and a light source used for irradiating the microsphere array so as to quantitatively detect the quantity of the microspheres in the microsphere array captured by the chip through a fluorescence antigen method.

title_en: Monoclonal antibody aiming at AFP-L3 and lectin complex, kit and application thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a monoclonal antibody aiming at AFP-L3 and lectin complex, and a kit and application thereof, wherein the monoclonal antibody comprises heavy chain variable regions CDR1, CDR2 and CDR3 with amino acid sequences shown as SEQ ID NO.1, 2 and 3 respectively, and light chain variable regions CDR1, CDR2 and CDR3 with amino acid sequences shown as SEQ ID NO.4, 5 and 6 respectively. The antibody can recognize a space epitope formed after the AFP-L3 protein is combined with lectin, improves the specificity and affinity, and combines the space epitope into a detection kit for alpha fetoprotein heterosomes, and the kit has good accuracy and high sensitivity.

title_en: Shield muck improvement comprehensive evaluation test device and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a shield muck improvement comprehensive evaluation test device and a shield muck improvement comprehensive evaluation test method, which comprise the following steps: a support portion; the permeability testing part is arranged on the supporting part and is communicated with the gas supply part; an earth pressure loading part disposed on the supporting part and used for applying pressure to the permeability testing part; the cutter head shearing driving part is arranged in the permeability testing part, one part of the cutter head shearing driving part is used for stirring the sample in the permeability testing part, and the other part of the cutter head shearing driving part is arranged on the supporting part; the propelling part is arranged on the supporting part and is used for driving the permeability testing part to move up and down; and the modifier injection part is connected with the cutter head shearing driving part and inputs a modifier to the permeability testing part through the cutter head shearing driving part. The invention can simulate the actual stress state of the tunnel face and the muck in the soil bin in the actual construction process, and better ensures the reliability of the model test.

title_en: Rabbit monoclonal antibody for resisting human pairing box 2 protein, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an anti-human pairing box gene 2 rabbit monoclonal antibody, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the monoclonal antibody comprises a light chain variable region and/or a heavy chain variable region, the light chain variable region comprises LCDR1, LCDR2 and LCDR3, the amino acid sequence of the LCDR1 is shown as SEQ ID NO.4, the amino acid sequence of the LCDR2 is shown as SEQ ID NO.5, the amino acid sequence of the LCDR3 is shown as SEQ ID NO.6, the heavy chain variable region comprises HCDR1, HCDR2 and HCDR3, the amino acid sequence of the HCDR1 is shown as SEQ ID NO.8, the amino acid sequence of the HCDR2 is shown as SEQ ID NO.9, and the amino acid sequence of the HCDR3 is shown as SEQ ID NO. 10. The anti-human pairing box gene 2 rabbit monoclonal antibody can be specifically combined with PAX2 protein, does not have cross reaction with PAX5 and PAX8, remarkably improves the specificity, accuracy and reliability of PAX2 protein immunodetection, and is widely applicable to the labeling of PAX2 protein in various tumors.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted air sampling system and sampling method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vehicle-mounted air sampling system and a sampling method, wherein the vehicle-mounted air sampling system comprises a vehicle body, an air chamber, a plurality of gas detection devices and at least one air sampling probe, wherein the air chamber and the plurality of gas detection devices are arranged in the vehicle body; the active air intake system and/or the natural air intake system are connected with the sampling interface of the air bin and used for enabling air outside the vehicle body to enter the air bin through the air sampling probe in an active and/or natural mode. The gas detection device solves the problems of complex pipeline arrangement, repeated functions and high power consumption along with the increase of gas detection equipment in the prior art, and has the characteristics of simple structure, low power consumption and wide application range.

title_en: Extremely early monitoring method for smoldering
abstract_en: The smoldering monitoring method adopts a radio electromagnetic sensing technology, information is transmitted through radio electromagnetic waves by using an ultrahigh frequency passive sensing label, a honeycomb Internet of things system is formed by the ultrahigh frequency passive sensing label, a base station and an auxiliary base station around a storage warehouse, and physical factors such as carbon monoxide concentration and environment humidity around stored and transported articles can be sensed in near real time to generate a real-time dynamic cloud picture, so that whether smoldering occurs or not can be predicted and found more quickly and accurately, the position where the smoldering occurs can be located, and early warning can be given to nearby workers to prevent and reduce fire and corresponding economic loss caused by smoldering of the stored and transported articles.

title_en: Blending detection device for white spirit process
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of liquor process blending detection, and discloses a blending detection device for a liquor process, which comprises a processing table, wherein a supporting base table is installed at the bottom of the processing table, a material transferring mechanism for transferring and sequencing detection test tubes is installed at the top of the supporting base table, and a vertically-installed double-shaft motor is installed between the processing table and the supporting base table. This white spirit technology is with mingling detection device, through setting up transfer mechanism and direction feeding mechanism's cooperation, can be with the detection test tube propelling movement in the direction feeding mechanism to transfer mechanism in through external propelling movement structure, and transfer mechanism can transmit the detection test tube, remove in proper order to detection mechanism's bottom and detect, need not the manual work at this in-process and operate, it is in between draw-in groove and the direction ball to detect the test tube in this process, at the in-process that turns to, can drive simultaneously and detect the test tube and rotate, the effect of detection test tube is rocked to this coming time, thereby avoid taking place phenomenons such as sediment to influence detection effect.

title_en: Method for preparing biotinylation antibody
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of in vitro diagnosis, in particular to a preparation method of a biotinylated antibody. The invention discloses a high-efficiency preparation method of a biotinylated antibody, which comprises the following steps: aminating the antibody; reacting the antibody with a biotin solution; and removing free biotin, and adding a protective agent to obtain a biotinylation antibody finished product. The invention changes the physicochemical property of the antibody, increases the reaction site of the antibody and biotin reaction, changes the isoelectric point of the antibody, increases the hydrophilicity, and further improves the biotinylation efficiency through reaction system optimization.

title_en: Biological probe for identifying polypeptide of pilose antler and recombinant plasmid thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of cell biology and molecular biology, and relates to a biological probe for identifying polypeptide of pilose antler and recombinant plasmid thereof, which is designed and prepared based on a cyclic rearrangement fluorescent protein cpFP technology and a biological subcloning technology. The probe comprises cyclized rearrangement Mcherry fluorescent protein, interaction proteins T beta RI-R and T beta RI-F which are respectively connected with two ends of the Mcherry fluorescent protein and used for identifying polypeptide of the antler, and recombinant plasmids are formed by the interaction proteins and expression vector plasmids. After the probe is transfected into the living cell, the probe can be expressed in the living cell, when the probe expressed in the cell interacts with the antler polypeptide, the probe shows red fluorescence, namely, whether the antler polypeptide enters the cell can be reflected by dynamically detecting whether a fluorescence signal exists in real time, and the visual detection of the antler polypeptide is realized; the expression of the probe fusion protein can also be realized through a prokaryotic expression system, and then the antler polypeptide is detected through scanning the fluorescence emission wavelength intensity, so that the detection of the antler polypeptide in the liquid is realized.

title_en: Running stabilizing device for direct-current system of combustion machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a running stabilizing device of a direct current system of a combustion engine, which comprises a combustion engine body and a conveying pipeline arranged at the middle end of the combustion engine body, wherein a first detection box is detachably arranged on the conveying pipeline, the first detection box is provided with a first detection cavity and a second detection cavity, a concentrated gas detector is arranged in the first detection cavity, a detection probe of the concentrated gas detector penetrates through the first detection box and is inserted into the conveying pipeline, and an insulation detector and a buzzer connected with the insulation detector in an electric signal manner are arranged in the second detection cavity. The burner direct current system operation stabilizing device provided by the invention detects the concentration of the gas by using the concentrated gas detector, so that unstable burner operation caused by gas concentration change is avoided, and the insulation detector and the buzzer are arranged, so that the insulativity of the conveying pipeline can be detected, and unstable burner operation caused by poor insulativity after the burner works for a long time is avoided.

title_en: Monoclonal antibody and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention utilizes tumor cells to immunize mice, screens and prepares a monoclonal antibody by hybridoma fusion technology, and the monoclonal antibody has obvious inhibition effect on the growth and migration of tumor cells and has obvious anti-tumor activity in animal tumor experiments.

title_en: Method for monitoring working performance and repair efficiency of self-repairing cement-based material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for monitoring the working performance and the repair efficiency of a self-repairing cement-based material, which relates to the technical field of material detection and comprises the steps of building a test platform based on acoustic emission and 2D-DIC (two-dimensional digital computer), obtaining the mechanical property, acoustic emission characteristic signals and strain fields of microcapsule self-repairing cement materials with different contents, researching the crack initiation and expansion and destruction evolution processes, analyzing a deformation failure mechanism, and providing a detection method and a theoretical basis for the research on the working performance and the repair efficiency of microcapsule self-repairing. A test platform based on acoustic emission and 2D-DIC is built, mechanical properties, acoustic emission characteristic signals and strain fields of microcapsule self-repairing cement materials with different contents are obtained, crack initiation and expansion and destruction evolution processes are researched, a deformation failure mechanism is analyzed, and an effective monitoring method is provided for research of microcapsule self-repairing working performance and repairing efficiency.

title_en: Improved generation computer lab new trend system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of machine room fresh air systems, and particularly discloses an improved machine room fresh air system. The working states of the machines corresponding to the set detection time points in the machine room are detected, so that the machine working state evaluation index of the machines corresponding to the set detection time points in the machine room is obtained through analysis, the detection of the working states of the machines in the machine room is realized, the accuracy, the comprehensiveness and the accuracy of air quality evaluation of the machines corresponding to the set detection time points in the machine room are effectively improved, the air quality requirement in the machine room is met to a great extent, and powerful data support is provided for the follow-up fresh air system operation.

title_en: Processing method and device of induction signals and induction component detection equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a processing method and device of sensing signals and sensing component detection equipment, which comprise the steps of acquiring sensing signals generated by a sensing signal acquisition mechanism when sensing components pass through, judging whether the signal length of the sensing signals is equal to a pre-stored preset value, if not, determining that the signal length of the sensing signals is larger than the preset value, dividing the sensing signals according to preset signal lengths to obtain a plurality of divided sensing signals, carrying out pairing processing on the plurality of divided sensing signals and acquired scanning signals according to time sequence to generate pairing information, so that the preset detection equipment can conveniently analyze the sensing components based on the pairing information, wherein disturbance caused by various interference information can not generate the pairing information.

title_en: Non-invasive bladder cancer detection system using liquid phase and gas phase analysis
abstract_en: A method for detecting a disease state in a subject includes obtaining a liquid biological sample (306) from the subject and contacting the liquid biological sample (306) with a first chemical sensor element (308), wherein the first chemical sensor element (308) may include a plurality of discrete graphene varactors (312). The method may include sensing and storing a capacitance of each discrete graphene varactor (312) to acquire a first sample data set.

title_en: Microtubule-associated protein Tau antigen, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a microtubule-associated protein Tau antigen, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein four dominant linear epitope polypeptides are internally enveloped and expanded, and the sequences of the four dominant linear epitope polypeptides are respectively shown as SEQ ID NO.1, SEQ ID NO.2, SEQ ID NO.3 and SEQ ID NO. 4. The amino acid sequence of the microtubule-associated protein Tau antigen is obtained by connecting the sequences containing the Tau protein linear epitope polypeptide in series through flexible chain amino acids, and is shown as SEQ ID NO. 5. The recombinant Tau protein antigen is expressed and purified by prokaryotic cells Ecoli, and the expressed protein antigen has high purity. The soluble Tau protein antigen provided by the invention has good immunogenicity, and the immune animal can generate specific polyclonal antibodies by using the recombinant Tau protein antigen, and can recognize six different Tau protein subtypes. Therefore, the antigen can be used as a high-efficiency immunogen for immunization and antibody preparation and production, thereby being used for scientific research detection of Tau protein and diagnosis of Tau serving as a disease marker of cognitive dysfunction.

title_en: Antibody for resisting novel coronavirus and application of antibody in detection
abstract_en: The invention discloses an antibody for resisting novel coronavirus and application thereof in detection, and relates to the technical field of antibodies. The antibody provided by the invention comprises LCDR1, LCDR2 and LCDR3 with amino acid sequences shown as SEQ ID No. 1-3 in sequence and HCDR1, HCDR2 and HCDR3 with amino acid sequences shown as SEQ ID No. 4-6 in sequence, and the antibody has high specificity and sensitivity, can be used for detecting new coronavirus, can be used for specifically detecting the new coronavirus under the condition of not being influenced by the mutation of the antigen protein of the virus mutant strain based on the new coronavirus detection reagent developed by the antibody, and can reduce the detection cost, shorten the detection time and improve the detection efficiency.

title_en: Urease reinforcement-based detection method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of roadbed treatment,the method comprises the following steps of preparing a urease reinforcement detection device and measuring the pH value of unreinforced alkaline soil, reinforcing the roadbed in an original soil area which is unreinforced in the first step by adopting a MICP (micro-Integrated Circuit process) technology or an EICP (electronic engineering load control) technology to form a reinforced roadbed, and driving the urease reinforcement detection device in the first step to the reinforced roadbed in the second step to detect the pH value of the soil: pH value  After reinforcement  Calculating the concentration of ammonium ions through a formula, and judging the reinforcing effect according to the concentration of the ammonium ions calculated in the third step, wherein the larger the concentration of the ammonium ions is, the more calcium carbonate crystals can be generated, and the better the reinforcing effect is; the lower the ammonium ion concentration, the less carbonate ions available for the production of calcium carbonate, and the more non-consolidated areas, thereby determining consolidated sites. The method of the invention is easy to detect the reinforcement range after the roadbed is reinforced by the MICP technology or the EICP technology and is rapid in detection.

title_en: Detection method and kit for exosomal galectin 9
abstract_en: The invention provides a detection method and a kit of exosome-form galectin 9, wherein the method comprises the following steps: incubating the sample with an ELISA plate coated and blocked with a mouse anti-human CD63 antibody; performing enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay using the incubated ELISA plate and galectin 9 antibody, biotin-labeled goat anti-rabbit IgG antibody, streptavidin-coupled horseradish peroxidase; and (3) detecting by using a developing solution and a microplate reader, and calculating the content of the exosome-form galectin 9 in the sample.

title_en: Automatic sampling device and method for measuring farmland greenhouse gas emission flux
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic sampling device and method for measuring farmland greenhouse gas emission flux, and relates to the field of farmland greenhouse gas emission flux measurement, wherein the device comprises a static box, a current meter and a collection box; the static box is communicated with the air inlet of the collection box; the flow meter is arranged in an air pipe between the static box and the collecting box; the static box is used for covering the plant to be detected and enabling the plant to be detected to be in a closed environment; the flow meter is used for measuring the gas flow rate in the gas pipe between the static box and the collection box in real time; a plurality of acquisition loops and controllers are arranged in the acquisition box; each acquisition loop is used for acquiring the gas in the static box at different moments according to the acquisition setting of the controller; the acquisition setting includes: gas production starting time, gas production time interval and collection times. The invention can realize accurate timing sampling and automatic control of the whole process of farmland greenhouse gases.

title_en: Pyrazolonamine hapten, antigen, antibody, detection device and preparation and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a isopyrazam hapten, an antigen, an antibody, a detection device and preparation and application thereof, and relates to a isopyrazam hapten, an antigen, an antibody, a colloidal gold chromatography detection device and preparation and application thereof in detecting isopyrazam residues in foods. The invention provides an artificial antigen prepared from a isopyrazam hapten coupled carrier protein, and an antibody which is specifically aimed at isopyrazam and is produced by a body of the animal after the animal is immunized, wherein the titer is high, and the IC50 value is 22.3ng/mL. The invention utilizes the specific immunological reaction of antigen and antibody and the easily identified immune mark amplification technology, can qualitatively and semi-quantitatively detect the residual isopyrazam in food, and has the advantages of high sensitivity, strong specificity, low cost, simple operation, short detection time, on-site rapid detection and the like.

title_en: BCMA-targeted nanobody, chimeric antigen receptor and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nano antibody targeting BCMA, a chimeric antigen receptor and application thereof, wherein the nano antibody comprises VHH01 and VHH02, has stronger specificity and higher affinity to BCMA, can be specifically combined with a BCMA positive cell line with high affinity, and has higher specific killing efficiency to the BCMA positive cell line based on CAR-T cells constructed by the nano antibody.

title_en: Application of protein marker in preparation of detection product for distinguishing early NASH (NASH) from NAFL (non-catalytic artificial membrane replacement) and detection method
abstract_en: The invention provides an application of a protein marker in preparation of a detection product for distinguishing early NASH from NAFL and a detection method. Through screening of population queues of NAFL and early NASH, 22 serum protein markers which are obviously related to the early NASH are found, and therefore, the proteins have important clinical application value as markers for effectively detecting the early NASH.

title_en: Alzheimer disease detection marker and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an Alzheimer's disease detection marker and application thereof, which realize noninvasive detection diagnosis of Alzheimer's disease by detecting p-Tau217 from exosomes (total exosomes from plasma or urine or specific exosomes from nerve). The kit has the advantages of noninvasive detection, high sensitivity, strong specificity, no dependence on large-scale equipment and the like, solves the problems of invasiveness, low accuracy, large-scale equipment dependence, poor precision and the like of sample acquisition of the existing Alzheimer's disease detection kit, is suitable for the requirements of clinical mass sample detection, and can be used for early diagnosis, disease progress monitoring, curative effect evaluation and the like of Alzheimer's disease.

title_en: Rotary basket clamping mechanism for medicine dissolving-out instrument
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a rotary basket clamping mechanism and a stirring mechanism for a drug dissolution apparatus, wherein the rotary basket clamping mechanism comprises a driving shaft, a limiting table and an elastic claw. The limiting table is fixed at one axial end of the driving shaft and comprises a step surface positioned on the outer peripheral surface of the limiting table, and the step surface is a first inclined surface forming an included angle with the axial direction of the driving shaft. The elastic claw comprises a fixing part, a transition part and a clamping part which are sequentially distributed from top to bottom, and the clamping part crosses over the step surface. Under natural state, the internal surface of transition portion orientation spacing platform is formed with the second inclined plane parallel with first inclined plane, and the horizontal interval between first inclined plane and the second inclined plane is not more than the thickness of last edge portion, and the vertical interval between first inclined plane and the second inclined plane is less than the height of last edge portion. The rotating basket can be stably and reliably held by the limiting table and the elastic clamping claws, and the rotating basket is easy to disassemble and assemble.

title_en: Antibodies binding to human IL-4R, antigen binding fragments thereof and medical uses thereof
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to antibodies that bind to human IL-4R, antigen binding fragments thereof, and pharmaceutical uses thereof. The present disclosure relates to chimeric antibodies, humanized antibodies comprising CDR regions from the human IL-4R-binding antibodies and antigen-binding fragments thereof, and also to pharmaceutical compositions comprising the human IL-4R-binding antibodies and antigen-binding fragments thereof, and their use as medicaments for the treatment of allergic diseases. The present disclosure relates to a humanized antibody that binds human IL-4R, use in the manufacture of a medicament for treating an IL-4R mediated disease or disorder.

title_en: Quantitative detection kit for influenza A virus and adenovirus antigens, preparation method and quantitative detection method
abstract_en: The invention provides a quantitative detection kit for influenza A virus and adenovirus antigens, a preparation method and a quantitative detection method, and relates to the technical field of biology. The invention provides a quantitative detection kit for influenza A virus and adenovirus, which comprises the following components: the kit comprises a quantum dot microsphere marked influenza A virus antibody, a quantum dot microsphere marked adenovirus antibody, a compound solution A, a compound solution B and detection test paper; the detection line of the detection test paper is coated with an influenza A virus capture antibody and an adenovirus capture antibody. The quantitative detection kit for influenza A virus and adenovirus has the advantages of high sensitivity, strong specificity, good stability and sensitivity to the reaction of a simulated sample, can realize synchronous quantitative detection of influenza A virus and adenovirus antigens, and effectively improves the diagnosis efficiency. And the detection operation flow is simple and efficient, the result can be reported within 15 minutes, and the method is suitable for on-site rapid detection of respiratory tract infection and fever patients.

title_en: Nano-structure material attachment detection device and detection process thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nano-structure material attachment detection device and a detection process thereof, which relate to the field of detection of tubular nano-structure material attachments and solve the problems that the conventional nano-structure material attachment detection device and the detection process thereof are difficult to fully sample a tubular nano-structure material and automatically and orderly complete feeding and discharging and detection processes.

title_en: Orally disintegrating tablet disintegration measuring device and method capable of simulating oral environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an orally disintegrating tablet disintegration measuring device capable of simulating an oral environment, which comprises a medium cup, a sample basket for placing a sample to be measured, a pressure control system and a water circulation control system, wherein the medium cup is used for accommodating a sample to be measured; the sample basket is suspended in the medium cup, and the lower half part of the sample basket is of a screen structure; the pressure control system comprises a testing end which is used for extending into the sample basket and pressing a sample to be tested; the water circulation control system comprises a water inlet end and at least two water outlet ends, wherein the water outlet ends comprise an upper water outlet end opposite to the top of the test end and a lower water outlet end opposite to the bottom of the sample basket, and water outlet holes are distributed on the test end; the invention also discloses a method for measuring the disintegration of the orally disintegrating tablet. The invention can more accurately, conveniently and normally measure the disintegration time of the orally disintegrating tablet, and detect the disintegration speed of the orally disintegrating tablet under the condition of approaching reality.

title_en: Molecular disease profile and use thereof for monitoring and treating rheumatoid arthritis
abstract_en: Biomarkers are described that indicate the efficacy of a rheumatoid arthritis treatment or that indicate responsiveness of a subject being treated for rheumatoid arthritis to a treatment regimen. Probes capable of detecting these biomarkers are also described, as are related methods and kits for assessing, monitoring, and selecting rheumatoid arthritis treatments.

title_en: Rabbit monoclonal antibody of ractopamine and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of bioengineering, in particular to a Rabbit monoclonal antibody of ractopamine, and a preparation method and application thereof. The rabbit monoclonal antibody comprises an antibody heavy chain and an antibody light chain, and the heavy chain variable region of the rabbit monoclonal antibody comprises an amino acid sequence shown as SEQ ID NO.1 or SEQ ID NO. 2; the light chain variable region of the rabbit monoclonal antibody comprises an amino acid sequence shown as SEQ ID NO.3 or SEQ ID NO. 4. The research of the invention obtains the rabbit monoclonal antibody for detecting the ractopamine, which has higher tolerance to urea and has important significance in the field of detecting the ractopamine in animal urine.

title_en: Biomarker for predicting risk or prognosis of preoperative pulmonary vein stenosis of TAPVC patient or combination of biomarker and application of biomarker
abstract_en: The invention discloses a biomarker for predicting risk or prognosis of pre-operation pulmonary vein stenosis of a TAPVC patient or a combination thereof, a reagent for detecting the biomarker, a kit containing the biomarker or the combination thereof and/or the reagent, application of the reagent and/or the kit in preparation of products for predicting the pre-operation pulmonary vein stenosis of the TAPVC patient, a system and a method for predicting the risk of the pre-operation pulmonary vein stenosis of the TAPVC patient, a computer readable storage medium containing the biomarker or the combination thereof and/or the kit, and a computer device. The detection of the expression level of the marker or the combination thereof in the patient can judge whether the TAPVC patient has pulmonary vein stenosis before operation, and the area under the working characteristic curve (AUC) of the training set receiver is 0.89 by taking NR3C2 as an example, the sensitivity can reach 0.89, the AUC of the verification set is 1, and the sensitivity is 0.86.

title_en: Wine inspection recorder and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wine detection recorder and a system, comprising a wine detection module, a recording module and a background system, wherein the wine detection module comprises a flow sensor, an alcohol sensor, an air pump, an air inlet and an air outlet, and the alcohol sensor can detect alcohol and output alcohol detection test data. The invention combines the quick-discharge detection mode and the accurate detection mode into one by setting the quick-discharge detector and the accurate detector to share the key core device, and integrating the video-audio shooting and recording module, the information association module and the wireless image transmission module in the law enforcement recorder, and combines the quick-discharge detection mode, the accurate detection mode and the law enforcement recorder into one, and associates the alcohol detection recorder with a background system, thereby realizing video-audio evidence collection in the alcohol detection process, associating alcohol detection test data with equipment information, personnel information using equipment and the like, avoiding counterfeiting and cheating of the alcohol detection data, reducing the cost of the equipment, and facilitating the use, management and maintenance of the equipment.

title_en: Throwing type detection device and gas-water-soil all-medium detection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a throwing type detection device and a gas-water-soil all-medium detection method, wherein the detection device comprises a probe arrangement module, a probe main body and a unhooking module, the probe arrangement module refers to an unmanned operation system, so that the arrangement position is accurately fixed, the problem that the current detection equipment arrangement has high dependence on sea conditions is overcome through unmanned throwing type design, the balance of the actual arrangement position and throwing is controlled by combining actual conditions, reliable detection parameters are ensured to be obtained, remote control arrangement recovery and remote in-situ ocean detection and long-term monitoring are realized, the remote control type detection device is used for rapidly realizing sky, ocean profile and ocean sediment high-efficiency detection under any operation condition, remote arrangement under any sea area and any operation condition is realized, and the operation safety of staff is effectively ensured.

title_en: Application of substance for inhibiting FAM111B protein activity and/or expression amount in preventing non-small cell lung cancer
abstract_en: The invention discloses application of a substance for inhibiting FAM111B protein activity and/or expression quantity in preventing non-small cell lung cancer. The substance inhibiting the activity and/or expression level of FAM111B protein is z 1) or z 2): z 1) SEQ ID NO:1, an RNAi molecule as set forth in 1; z 2) shRNA synthesized by shRNA expression system by taking the RNAi molecule as a target point. Experiments prove that FAM111B is remarkably high in expression in non-small cell lung cancer tissues, is obviously related to sex, histological type, tumor size, stage and lymph node metastasis, FAM111B enhances the capacity of non-small cell lung cancer cells to resist apoptosis through a mitochondrial apoptosis pathway participating in p53 regulation, and can inhibit the activity and/or expression quantity of FAM111B in the non-small cell lung cancer cells so as to promote the apoptosis of the non-small cell lung cancer cells and further prevent and/or treat the non-small cell lung cancer. The invention has important application value.

title_en: Non-road vehicle hub testing system and testing method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for testing hubs of non-road vehicles, which belong to the field of non-road vehicle testing, wherein an industrial computer control module is used for controlling a power control module to start testing, a non-road vehicle installation module, a wheel base and wheel base adjusting module, a loading module and a tail gas measuring module are respectively controlled, the non-road vehicles are fixed by the non-road vehicle installation module, the wheel base and wheel base adjusting module is used for adjusting the tested wheel base and wheel base, a tested piece of the non-road vehicles is loaded by the loading module, driving resistance and operation resistance are simulated, and finally test data are acquired and analyzed by the industrial computer control module, so that the system can realize no-load and loading automatic testing of the non-road vehicles under various working conditions (two-drive and four-drive modes) of the non-road vehicles, can meet different test requirements and non-road vehicles with different wheel bases and wheel bases, has no special requirements on sites, and can save test space and test period.

title_en: Flexible intelligent patch and method for in-situ monitoring of wound bacteria
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flexible intelligent patch and a method for in-situ monitoring of wound bacteria. The patch includes an encapsulation adhesive layer, a control circuit, an electrode array, and a wound exudate absorbing layer. The control circuit and the electrode array are electrically connected through the electrode array connecting pad to form a combined plane structure which is jointly embedded in the packaging adhesive layer. The wound exudate absorbing layer is fixed to the lower surface of the electrode array package. The electrode array comprises a staphylococcus aureus transpeptidase sensing electrode and a pyocin sensing electrode. According to the invention, wireless power supply and data interaction are carried out through the mobile terminal by utilizing the near field communication module, and in-situ real-time measurement is carried out on wound exudates by adopting an electrochemical analysis means, so that the simultaneous monitoring of the infection conditions of staphylococcus aureus and pseudomonas aeruginosa in the wound is realized. The patch provides an instant detection platform for the management of infected wounds, and has the advantages of flexibility, intelligence, real-time in-situ performance and convenience in operation.

title_en: Anti-human IgM antibody and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to an anti-human IgM antibody, a method of making and uses thereof. The anti-human IgM monoclonal antibody prepared by the method has high affinity, high reactivity, high sensitivity and specificity to human IgM. The anti-human IgM monoclonal antibody provided by the application has good effects of blocking and eliminating immune interference when used for immunodetection, and provides an important source of blocker raw materials.

title_en: Soil detection equipment and detection method for deep soil
abstract_en: The invention discloses a soil detection device and a detection method for deep soil, which relate to the technical field of soil detection and comprise the following steps: the support frame and the sampling device comprise a sampling assembly and a sampling drive; the sampling drive is arranged on the supporting frame; the sampling drive can drive the sampling assembly to rotate and drive the sampling assembly to move downwards to a designated position; the sampling assembly comprises a drill bit, a mud scraping cylinder and a connecting cylinder which are sequentially arranged from bottom to top; the mud scraping cylinder comprises a plurality of independent sample storage bins; the sample storage bin is provided with a bin gate which can be opened; a power component capable of independently driving any bin gate to open and close is arranged in the connecting cylinder; the mud scraping cylinder is divided into a plurality of independent sample storage bins, bin gates of each sample storage bin can be opened and closed independently, and sampling is completed under the action of sampling drive after the bin gates are opened; the soil can be sampled and temporarily stored at different depths by the multiple sample storage bins, so that the traditional sampler is prevented from being used for sampling back and forth for many times, and the sampling efficiency is greatly improved.

title_en: Emergency disaster relief simple housing structure identification device and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an emergency disaster relief simple house structure identification device and a use method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of house structure identification tools. The device's transposition seat slidable mounting is on the base to can carry out the position upset of multi-angle on the base, the transposition seat carries out the position locking through spacing card, is provided with two cloth clamping devices on the transposition seat, and two cloth clamping devices all suit is in the pivot, and drives with the pivot and rotate, and the cloth clamping device who accomplishes the tarpaulin centre gripping is just that surplus tarpaulin is rolled up in the outside of oneself. According to the invention, the tarpaulin can be positioned at the posture positions of various inclined angles by arranging the transposition seat capable of overturning at various angles, so that various identification projects are conveniently carried out, and meanwhile, the transposition seat is simple in overturning form, easy to operate and convenient to use; the device is provided with the cloth clamping device through the sound of the rotating shaft, so that the tarpaulin can be spread and flattened with different tightness, the practical application scene can be conveniently simulated, and the identification can be conveniently carried out.

title_en: Training method, forecasting method and device for air target pollutant component forecasting model
abstract_en: The application relates to a training method, a forecasting method and a device for an air target pollutant component forecasting model, which are implemented by acquiring actual measurement values of target pollutant components of a target monitoring site at a plurality of time points; and acquiring meteorological data of the target monitoring point at the plurality of time points, and training an air target pollutant component forecasting model by using actual measurement values of the plurality of time points as labels and the meteorological data of the plurality of time points as samples. After the air target pollutant component forecasting model is trained, the target pollutant component is forecasted by calling the model, so that the target pollutant component forecasting is realized. According to the application, the air target pollutant component forecasting model is constructed to forecast the target pollutant component, and the types of the target pollutant component are not limited, so that the method has the advantage of wide forecasting range; meanwhile, compared with the existing air quality mode, the air target pollutant component forecasting model has the advantages of high forecasting speed and low consumption of computing resources.

title_en: Acidizing and well-stewing experimental system and experimental method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an acidification well-logging experiment system and an experiment method, and relates to the field of rock core detection in an oil gas well, wherein the acidification well-logging experiment system comprises a advection input device, a stratum water runner, an acid liquor runner and a main runner; the stratum water flow passage and the acid liquid flow passage are arranged in parallel and are converged and communicated with the main flow passage; the advection input device is configured to drive formation water in the formation water runner or acid liquor in the acid liquor runner into the main runner respectively; and a core clamping structure is also communicated in the main runner and is configured to fix a sampling core so that formation water or acid liquid entering the main runner can flow through the sampling core. The technology carries out an acidizing and well-stewing simulation experiment on the rock core, and detects the rock core at each time node, so that the physical characteristics of the rock core before and after the rock core passes through the acidizing and well-stewing can be more comprehensively and accurately reflected.

title_en: Application of antibody combined with HMMW micro-peptide in preparation of medicines for treating renal fibrosis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of micropeptides, in particular to application of an antibody combined with HMMW micropeptides in preparation of medicines for treating renal fibrosis. The antibody can reduce the kidney coefficient of a mouse, improve the survival rate of the mouse and reduce the expression content of TGF-beta 1, BUN and Scr; inhibiting the expression of a protein associated with renal fibrosis; from the aspect of pathological indexes, the monoclonal antibody can improve the kidney structure of mice, reduce infiltration of inflammatory cells and reduce deposition of collagen. The inventors have unexpectedly found that the four antibodies (D24, L9, F22, P17) have therapeutic effects on renal fibrosis, with potential clinical application value.

title_en: Device and method for quickly detecting and biologically repairing soil pollution
abstract_en: The invention discloses a soil pollution rapid detection and bioremediation device, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein two shaft rods are rotatably arranged on the bottom surface of the bottom plate, two moving wheels are arranged on the two shaft rods, and a driving mechanism is connected to the shaft rod positioned on the right side; a fixed pipe is arranged on the bottom surface of the bottom plate, and a plurality of spray heads are arranged on the bottom surface of the fixed pipe; the top surface of the bottom plate is provided with a detection mechanism and a cylinder, and an automatic liquid supply mechanism is arranged between the cylinder and the fixed pipe; when the bottom plate moves, the driving mechanism drives the automatic liquid supply mechanism to start to operate, so that the liquid medicine in the cylinder body is conveyed into the fixed pipe. When the device moves, the shaft rod drives the driving mechanism to rotate, and then drives the automatic liquid supply mechanism to start to operate, the liquid medicine in the cylinder body is conveyed into the fixed pipe, and finally the liquid medicine is sprayed onto soil through the spray head, so that the soil is repaired through the liquid medicine; compared with the prior art, the device can repair the soil in the paddy field.

title_en: Electrochemical sensor
abstract_en: The present invention relates to electrochemical sensors for determining the presence or amount of an analyte (e.g., free chlorine) in a sample.

title_en: Quaternary ammonium salt modified cyanine fluorescent dye and its synthesis and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quaternary ammonium salt modified cyanine fluorescent dye, and a synthesis method and application thereof. Wherein, the cyanine fluorescent dye modified by quaternary ammonium salt has the following structural general formula I: in the traditionThe new structure dye obtained by introducing sulfonic acid groups and quaternary ammonium salt modification on the basis of the structure of the pentamethine cyanine dye has better water solubility. The improvement of water solubility avoids self-quenching of the dye, increases the practicability of the dye, and ensures that the dye shows better water solubility, biocompatibility and smaller biotoxicity. The dye has near infrared absorption and high fluorescence quantum yield, and can be used for cell imaging, protein labeling, antibody specific recognition, nucleic acid labeling, DNA sequencing and other applications.

title_en: Application of OMA1 in reversing acute lymphoblastic leukemia drug resistance
abstract_en: The invention discloses an application of OMA1 in reversing acute lymphoblastic leukemia drug resistance. According to the invention, by detecting the OMA1 gene expression condition in the ALL of children, the expression level is obviously reduced, and the AUC=0.775 of the working characteristic curve of the initial diagnosis of the OMA1 to the ALL is found; auc=0.822 of the operating profile of OMA1 versus ALL recurrence diagnosis; therefore, OMA1 can be used as a good molecular marker for diagnosis, recurrence and drug resistance discrimination of ALL in children. According to the invention, the OMA1 can obviously inhibit malignant proliferation of human ALL drug-resistant cells, promote apoptosis of the human ALL drug-resistant cells and further reverse drug resistance of the drug-resistant cells by constructing an over-expression OMA1 plasmid vector and transfecting the OMA1 plasmid vector into various ALL drug-resistant cells. Thus, it is demonstrated that OMA1 may be a novel target for treatment of human ALL, particularly drug resistant, relapsing ALL.

abstract_en: The invention discloses an O  3  A zone transmission channel analysis method, comprising: determining target zone troposphere O  3  The concentration value exceeds the standard; acquisition of target zone troposphere O  3  O in first time period before and after exceeding concentration value  3  Spatial distribution map, weather analysis data, and ground site data; preliminary construction of O  3  Pollution of the transmission channel; simulating and calculating a backward track and a forward track; calculating to obtain O  3  Potential source contribution factor PSCF  ij  And concentration weight trace CWT  ij  The method comprises the steps of carrying out a first treatment on the surface of the Presetting a judging condition comprising exceeding O  3  Potential source contribution factor PSCF  ij  And concentration weight trace CWT  ij  The threshold area of (2) is a contaminated transmission area;judging a potential pollution area according to the area of the judging condition; acquisition of potentially contaminated areas and O  3  Common area of contaminated transmission channels as O  3  And (5) an area transmission channel. The method has the advantages of simple operation, high accuracy, and capability of realizing the region O  3  The method has the advantages of providing powerful support for regional atmospheric pollution prevention and treatment research and the like by the transmission of the polluted region and the identification of the polluted contribution key region.

title_en: Endotoxin retention time estimation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an estimation method of endotoxin retention time and application thereof, the method comprises the steps of adding an endotoxin standard substance into a sample to be estimated to prepare a labeled sample, and storing the labeled sample under different temperature conditions, and periodically detecting the recovery rate of endotoxin in the labeled sample so as to estimate the retention time of endotoxin in the sample; wherein, the range of the recovery rate R of endotoxin is required to satisfy that R is more than or equal to 50% and less than or equal to 200%. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the following advantages: (1) The method provided by the invention aims at the situation of low recovery rate of endotoxin in biological medicines, and designs an estimation method of endotoxin retention time of samples or biological stock solution in the production process; (2) The method can provide guidance for the QC department to provide the maximum storage time of the sterile biological medicine, thereby establishing a perfect detection flow.

title_en: Kit and method for detecting exosomes by using composite immunofluorescence
abstract_en: The invention relates to a kit and a method for detecting exosomes by composite immunofluorescence, belonging to the field of immunodetection. The method reduces incomplete capturing caused by heterogeneity of exosomes to the greatest extent, thereby improving the capturing rate of exosomes; in addition, the detection mode of combining the fluorescent dye and the direct-current type antibody by the film specificity is adopted, so that the cost is lower, and the result is more accurate.

title_en: Aromatic dipeptide functionalized sulfhydryl compound and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of compound synthesis, and discloses an aromatic dipeptide functionalized sulfhydryl compound, wherein 3, 5-di (methylthio) benzoic acid and pyridine are added into a trityl chloride solution, and the 3, 5-di (trityl) benzoic acid is obtained by purification after full reaction; then mixing with N-hydroxysuccinimide, dissolving in an organic solvent, adding EDC and HCl, fully reacting, and purifying to obtain 2, 5-dioxopyrrolidin-1-yl 3, 5-bis ((tritylthio) methyl) benzoate; then adding phenylalanine-tryptophan and triethylamine, fully reacting, and purifying to obtain (3, 5-bis ((tritylthio) methyl) benzoyl) tryptophanyl phenylalanine; then adding trifluoroacetic acid and triethylsilane, fully reacting, and purifying to obtain the aromatic dipeptide functionalized sulfhydryl compound. The aromatic dipeptide functionalized sulfhydryl compound can rapidly and effectively identify sodium and potassium ions, and has relatively low detection limit and loose detection conditions.

title_en: SjHNF4 polypeptide antibody, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses SjHNF polypeptide antibody, a preparation method and application. The preparation method comprises the steps of downloading SjHNF-SjHNF protein sequences, screening polypeptide sequences, adding cysteine at the N end, then carrying out polypeptide synthesis and purification, coupling to obtain recombinant polypeptide, mixing the coupled polypeptide with Freund's complete adjuvant to obtain a mixture, immunizing a mammal by using the mixture, taking heart blood of the mammal, and separating serum to obtain the polypeptide antibody. The polypeptide antibody titer is detected by ELISA method, and then the polypeptide antibody is purified by polypeptide affinity chromatography column. Finally, the binding affinity of the antibody to the antigen was detected by WesternBlot and immunofluorescence experiments. The polypeptide antibody obtained by the invention has high purity (not lower than 90%) and high titer (not lower than 512000), has good purity and immunogenicity, can meet various experimental requirements and has commercial value.

title_en: Nanometer antibody targeting CD150 protein and application thereof
abstract_en: The present invention provides a nanobody or antigen-binding fragment capable of specifically recognizing CD150. The antibody or antigen binding fragment is selected from the group consisting of a heavy chain variable region CDR sequence or an amino acid sequence having at least 80% identity thereto of at least one of the following: SEQ ID NO 1-3. The antibody has low immunogenicity, can specifically target and combine with CD150, and can reverse the function exhaustion of immune cells by blocking the action of CD150 and ligand thereof, thereby achieving the effect of killing tumor cells.

title_en: Humidity adjusting device for cotton fiber inspection
abstract_en: The invention provides a humidity adjusting device for cotton fiber inspection, which structurally comprises: the device comprises a locking block, a base, a regulating main body, a temperature control rod and a spraying component, wherein the locking block is welded on the edge of the surface layer of the base, and the center of the surface layer of the base is mutually perpendicular to the regulating main body; according to the invention, after the spraying component is further improved, the circle center of the screw rod of the starting and stopping mechanism can be aligned with the circle center of the pressing key connected with the electrified piece through the starting and stopping mechanism arranged on the atomizing module, so that the screw rod can gradually descend through the rotation of the electric wheel and the spraying process of cotton fibers, and finally the screw rod can extrude the pressing key after the cotton fibers are sprayed to a specific humidity, so that the atomizing module can be paused at the first time according to an emergency stopping program matched with the pressing key and the regulating main body, and the subsequent use effect of the cotton fibers caused by excessive water absorption of the cotton fibers due to the influence of time errors during manual operation and stopping is prevented.

title_en: High-flux integrated plant root system water absorption rate detection system
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-flux integrated plant root system water absorption rate detection system, which is characterized in that a transparent pipeline is arranged in soil, a base station is arranged at one end of the transparent pipeline, and a data acquisition box is arranged at the joint of the base station and the transparent pipeline; be equipped with pipeline robot in the transparent pipeline, pipeline robot includes control unit, drive unit and collection unit, and drive unit is used for driving the collection unit and removes along the transparent pipeline, and the collection unit is used for obtaining the outside soil section moisture content information of transparent pipeline and plant root system growth image information. According to the system, through the movable pipeline robot in the transparent pipeline, soil profile moisture parameters can be automatically detected and root system growth images can be shot according to manually set measurement time intervals, so that root depth, root length density and other data are obtained, the water absorption rate of the plant root system is calculated, the consumption of manpower and material resources is reduced, the integrity of the plant root system is protected, and the system has important significance for plant root system research.

title_en: Substation water body analysis and treatment method based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention provides a substation water body analysis and treatment method based on the Internet of things, which belongs to the technical field of cyclic treatment and comprises the following steps: and determining the current water use, water consumption and corresponding sewage generation amount in the transformer substation. According to the components and the content of impurities in the sewage, the different kinds of sewage are respectively subjected to corresponding purification treatment and are respectively stored after the purification treatment. In combination with the water demand of the equipment and the determined activity type of the person, purified sewage of corresponding specification is provided. According to the substation water body analysis and treatment method based on the Internet of things, the sewage is purified to different degrees, and the sewage with different degrees is supplied to different requirements, so that the water recycling is more fully completed, and finally the consumption of water resources is reduced.

title_en: Water environment detection buoy and detection method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a water environment detection buoy and a detection method, the detection buoy comprises a buoy body, the buoy body comprises an upper half body and a lower half body, the upper half body and the lower half body can be closed/opened, the upper half body is provided with a water quality detection device, the lower half body is internally provided with a containing cavity, and the water quality detection device can extend into the containing cavity to detect water quality in the containing cavity; the upper half body is provided with an obstacle avoidance mechanism, and the obstacle avoidance mechanism is used for driving the buoy body to move towards a direction away from the obstacle. The utility model aims at solving the problems that the floating object or the floating object in the water is easy to be wound on the detection probe because the whole device is arranged in an opening/closing mode, when the detection is needed, the surrounding floating object or the sundry is blown open and then the water quality detection is carried out by opening the device, and the floating object or the sundry in the water floats in the water for a long time.

title_en: Device and method for measuring surface deformation of hydrate reservoir in supergravity experiment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a method for measuring surface deformation of a hydrate reservoir in a supergravity experiment. The top of the autoclave is provided with a cover and placed in a hypergravity environment, an upper soil covering layer, a hydrate reservoir and a lower soil covering layer are arranged in the autoclave, and a combined capacitance type deformation measuring system is arranged at the upper part of the upper soil covering layer and comprises a plurality of groups of capacitors, a limiting rod, polar plate fixed insulation flexible wires, corresponding connecting wires and the like; the surface deformation of the reservoir layer in the process of hydrate exploitation causes the change of the capacitance value of the combined capacitance type deformation measurement system, so that the change of monitoring voltage data is converted, and the real-time measurement of the surface deformation value of the reservoir layer is calculated through the monitoring of the voltage value under the condition of supergravity. The method is simple and quick to operate, reliable and accurate in test result, capable of accurately measuring the surface deformation of the hydrate reservoir in real time under high-pressure, low-temperature and super-gravity environments, and capable of solving the problem that the conventional displacement sensor is difficult to work normally under the extreme environments of the super-gravity test at present.

title_en: Composite immunopotentiator for AD marker detection and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of medical immune in-vitro diagnosis, and provides a composite immunopotentiator for detecting AD markers, which comprises a copolymer of 2-methacryloxyethyl phosphorylcholine, polyethylene glycol 20000, polyvinylpyrrolidone-10 and a membrane cleavage agent. The invention also provides application of the composite immunopotentiator in preparing a kit for detecting Alzheimer disease biomarkers. The invention has the advantages that: the composite immunopotentiator is added into the reagent R1 and the reagent R2 of the existing AD marker detection kit, so that the reaction can be accelerated, the immunoreaction time can be shortened, the detection sensitivity and accuracy can be improved, and the stability can be maintained.

title_en: Target intelligent positioning control system and method based on infrared imaging, laser radar and sound directional detection
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent target positioning control system based on infrared imaging, laser radar and sound directional detection, which comprises an infrared imaging module, a laser radar module, a sound directional detection module, a radio detection module, a gas detection module, a three-dimensional map building and sensing module, a three-dimensional fusion and processing module, a target positioning and tracking module and a decision and early warning module. The infrared imaging, laser radar and sound directional detection-based target intelligent positioning control system and the infrared imaging, laser radar and sound directional detection-based target intelligent positioning control method map three-dimensional point infrared imaging data, microphone sound source probability distribution, wireless and gas detection information of each frame into probability distribution of objects to be rescued in a three-dimensional scene, provide three-dimensional fusion environment detection and object positioning capability to be rescued, effectively and scientifically improve rescue detection efficiency, remarkably enhance efficiency and accuracy of positioning trapped people, and have a wider application range.

title_en: Magnetic zirconium metal organic framework material, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a magnetic zirconium metal organic framework material, a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of toxin purification. The novel magnetic zirconium metal organic framework material can realize high-selectivity adsorption of various toxins, and has the technical advantages of short toxin adsorption time, high efficiency, good purification effect, more impurity removal and low economic cost. And the MOFs crystal material has stable chemical property and excellent thermal stability. Has higher toxin adsorption capacity at normal temperature and normal pressure, and can be applied to the adsorption separation of various toxins. After the magnetic zirconium metal organic framework material is mixed with the sample, toxins in the sample can be effectively adsorbed, and the sample adsorbed by the magnetic zirconium metal organic framework material can be used as a purifying material for toxin detection tests.

title_en: Irrigation area water body greenhouse gas monitoring system based on low-cost sensor and intelligent algorithm
abstract_en: The invention provides a system for monitoring greenhouse gases in a water body of a irrigated area based on a low-cost sensor and an intelligent algorithm, which monitors water environment parameters (flow, water temperature, water depth, pH, nitrate nitrogen, ammonia nitrogen and CO) of a pond and a river in the irrigated area in real time  2  Dissolved concentration) and atmospheric environmental parameters (CO  2  Gas concentration), based on water environmental parameters and dissolved N  2  Construction of dissolved N from measured data set of O  2  O intelligent algorithm, and then realizing dissolved N of water environment of irrigation area through greenhouse gas-water gas interface exchange model  2  O and CO  2  And the emission flux is synchronously monitored, and the timing remote control and the dissolved state N of the water quality and the dissolved state N of the irrigation area water ecosystem are realized through an OneNET cloud server  2  O and CO  2  Visual display of the change in discharge flux. The design fully combines the advantages of the sensor technology and the intelligent algorithm, reduces the cost and realizes the rapid and effective irrigation area water ecological system N  2  O and CO  2  Emission assessment.

title_en: Reagent and method for detecting lupus nephritis marker
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of multiple immunohistochemistry, and particularly relates to a reagent and a method for detecting lupus nephritis markers, wherein the markers are DC3 cells, and the reagent comprises an anti-CD163 antibody, an anti-CD11c antibody and at least one of anti-CD1c antibodies; the invention designs the antibody according to the characteristic gene of the DC3 cell, can accurately carry out quantitative detection on the DC3 cell of the kidney of the LN patient, and has higher specificity.

title_en: Biomarker for early diagnosis of hepatic fibrosis and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a biomarker for early diagnosis of liver fibrosis and application thereof, relating to the field of biotechnology; the biomarker is lymphatic endothelial receptor-1. According to the research of the invention, after the liver fibrosis early liver blood sinus endothelial cells are damaged, the liver fibrosis early liver blood sinus endothelial cells are metabolized by blood, so that lymphatic endothelial receptor-1 in blood can be obviously increased, therefore, the blood serum lymphatic endothelial receptor-1 can replace hyaluronic acid as a new index of liver fibrosis, and monitoring the blood serum lymphatic endothelial receptor-1 level provides a new marker for early liver fibrosis screening.

title_en: Health management monitoring device and method based on food nutrition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a health management monitoring device based on food nutrition, which comprises a base, wherein a quantitative structure is arranged in an inner cavity of the base, a scraper structure is arranged at the top of the quantitative structure, two symmetrically arranged embedded connecting frames are arranged on one side of the base and one side of the scraper structure in a penetrating manner, a feeding bin is arranged at the top of the scraper structure, and a bolt type bracket is connected on one side of the base and one side of the feeding bin in a bolt type manner. According to the invention, through the cooperation of the feeding bin and the driving structure, the inner cavity of the feeding bin is provided with the meshed crushing structure, powdery materials can be crushed for the second time, the hardened block structure is destroyed, the driving structure can drive the upper screening disc and the lower screening disc to realize uniform reciprocating motion, so that powder is uniformly shaken, the powder enters a container in the inner cavity of the quantitative grid for standby, and at the moment, the scraper structure is started to scrape out overflowed parts of the powder, so that quantitative weighing can be realized.

title_en: Peanut seed intelligent detection device
