abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent peanut seed detection device, which comprises a classification mechanism, wherein the classification mechanism comprises a classification frame, a secondary classification screen is fixedly connected in the classification frame, the secondary classification screen is communicated with a sequencing mechanism, the sequencing mechanism comprises a seed cavity arranged at the bottom of the secondary classification screen, a conveying mechanism is arranged at one side of the seed cavity far away from the classification frame, a detection mechanism is fixedly connected at one side of the conveying mechanism far away from the seed cavity, and a bagging mechanism is fixedly connected at one side of the detection mechanism far away from the conveying mechanism. According to the invention, the automatic grading and ordered arrangement of peanut seeds are realized through the sorting mechanism of the grading mechanism, and the particle number, the static angle, the gravity flow angle, the volume weight and the thousand-grain weight of the peanut seeds are directly measured through the detection mechanism.

title_en: Internet of things monitoring system, method, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application relates to the technical field of the Internet of things and discloses an Internet of things monitoring system, method, equipment and storage medium, wherein the system comprises: the system comprises an Internet of things sensor platform, a big data analysis platform and a green plant maintenance platform, wherein the Internet of things sensor platform is used for acquiring temperature and soil humidity and sending the temperature and the soil humidity to the big data analysis platform; the big data analysis platform is used for determining the water spraying amount in a unit area if the temperature is in a first preset range and the soil humidity is smaller than a first preset threshold value or if the temperature is in a second preset range and the soil humidity is smaller than a second preset threshold value, determining the total water spraying amount in a target area according to the water spraying amount in the unit area and the total area of the target area, and transmitting the total water spraying amount to the green plant maintenance platform; the green plant maintenance platform is used for starting the spraying equipment to spray water to plants in the target area until the total water spraying amount is completed. Through the mode, the accuracy of the total water spraying amount is improved when the water is sprayed to the greening plants.

title_en: Unsupervised carbon dioxide emission monitoring method based on deep transfer learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unsupervised carbon dioxide emission monitoring method based on deep transfer learning, and relates to the technical field of carbon dioxide emission monitoring. The unsupervised carbon dioxide emission monitoring method based on deep transfer learning has the following advantages and effects: tags of target domain data are often difficult or very costly to acquire during the transfer learning process. The use of a model trained using only source domain labeled data with a common non-migration method directly for predicting target domains is often unsatisfactory. The model can be trained under the condition of lacking the target domain label based on the deep unsupervised transfer learning method. Compared with the traditional countermeasure field self-adaptive method, the method adopts a double-flow structure, simultaneously focuses on the influence of edge distribution difference and the difference of conditional distribution, and represents the relative importance of feature mobility and separability through balance factors.

title_en: ELISA method for detecting porcine epidemic diarrhea virus antibody SIgA
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ELISA method for detecting an antibody SIgA of porcine epidemic diarrhea virus, belonging to the technical field of biology. The method comprises the step of detecting a porcine epidemic diarrhea virus antibody SIgA antibody in a sample to be detected by taking S1 protein as a coating antigen, wherein the amino acid sequence of the S1 protein is a truncated sequence of 19 th to 719 th positions. The invention initially establishes an indirect ELISA method for detecting the porcine epidemic diarrhea virus specific SIgA antibody in serum, intestinal tissues and milk by optimizing conditions, and determines the optimal antigen coating concentration and the optimal antigen coating time to be 0.25 mug/ml and 4 ℃ for 12-16h overnight respectively, and other optimal detection conditions. The method for detecting the PEDV specific SIgA in serum, intestinal tissues and milk, which is established by the research, is simple, convenient and quick, has better sensibility and specificity, and provides basis and detection standard for evaluating PEDV mucous membrane immunity level.

title_en: MagLOCI composite microsphere and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses MagLOCI composite microspheres and application thereof. The invention discloses a detection kit based on photo-excitation chemiluminescence, which comprises magnetic composite microspheres, namely MagLOCI composite microspheres, wherein the magnetic composite microspheres comprise host magnetic microspheres and guest nano microspheres which are covalently connected to the surfaces of the host magnetic microspheres, and the guest nano microspheres are used for generating singlet oxygen or converting the energy of the singlet oxygen into fluorescence. The invention can make up the deficiency of the existing LOCI technology and expand the application field of LOCI. Compared with the traditional LOCI technology MagLOCI technology, the method is a light-activated chemiluminescence detection platform which is higher in performance, universal and flexible.

title_en: Pathological section scanning device and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pathological section scanning device and a pathological section scanning method, and belongs to the technical field of medical detection. The device comprises a control module, an analysis processing module, a feedback module, a display module, a storage module, a transmission module, a scanning assembly, a fixing assembly and an anti-shake assembly, wherein the analysis processing module, the feedback module, the display module, the storage module and the transmission module are in communication connection with the control module; the scanning component scans pathological section images and transmits the pathological section images to the control module; the anti-shake assembly detects vibration generated in the process that the scanning assembly focuses on pathological sections and transmits the vibration to the control module, and the control module drives the fixing assembly to fix the scanning assembly. The scanning definition is prevented from being influenced by vibration generated when the guide rail rapidly moves to focus, so that the scanning image is unclear to cause misdiagnosis, and the scanning precision and the scanning efficiency are improved.

title_en: Self-assembled fusion polypeptide targeting S100A9 and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-assembled fusion polypeptide targeting S100A9 and application thereof, and the self-assembled fusion polypeptide targeting S100A9 has a main structure of MEWSLEKGYTIK-linker-QQKFQFQFEQQ or QQKFQFQFEQQ-linker-MEWSLEKGYTIK. The self-assembled fusion polypeptides of some examples of the invention can self-assemble in vitro to form β -sheet nanofiber structures with high affinity for S100A9 protein (affinity kd=9.27 μm); by an in-vivo tracing technology, the self-assembled polypeptide H6-Q11 prolongs the in-vivo circulation time of the polypeptide H6 and effectively targets lung tissues of a main part of tumor metastasis; by constructing melanoma and breast cancer metastasis models, the self-assembled polypeptide H6-Q11 effectively inhibits tumorigenic lung metastasis.

title_en: Groundwater monitoring device for preventing groundwater cross contamination
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of preventing cross contamination of underground water, in particular to an underground water monitoring device for preventing cross contamination of underground water, which aims at solving the problems that in the prior art, after water sample detection is finished, a sampling tube is exposed outside for a long time and is polluted by various bacteria and the like, cross contamination is easily caused in later sampling, and when the device is used, the stability is low and the normal monitoring work is influenced. The invention has simple structure, can protect the sampling tube after the water sample detection is finished, avoids cross contamination during the later sampling, can improve the stability of the device through the stabilizing mechanism, avoids the condition of influencing normal monitoring work, and is convenient for people to use.

title_en: Quantitative evaluation method for microcosmic compressibility of tight sandstone reservoir
abstract_en: The invention provides a quantitative evaluation method for microcosmic compressibility of a tight sandstone reservoir, which comprises the following steps of analyzing mineral components of the tight sandstone reservoir by using an X-ray diffraction full rock analysis technology and an energy dispersion X-ray fluorescence spectrum technology, cutting and sampling a tight sandstone core sample according to nanoindentation experiment requirements, recording a load-displacement curve in the nanoindentation process, establishing a tight sandstone mineral component complex equivalent rock mechanical parameter calculation model, comprehensively considering natural microcracks and bedding development degrees, and establishing a final tight sandstone reservoir comprehensive compressibility model by using all the normalized parameters. According to the invention, the problems of high cost, difficult acquisition of the rock core and consideration of the inherent weak structural surface characteristics of the deep tight sandstone are overcome through the nanoindentation experiment, so that accurate and rapid evaluation of the microcosmic compressibility of the deep tight sandstone reservoir is realized.

title_en: ECL sensor based on ferrocene hollow nanospheres and chlorpyrifos detection method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of pesticide residue analysis and determination, in particular to an ECL sensor based on ferrocene hollow nanospheres and a chlorpyrifos detection method, which comprises the steps of ECL sensor preparation, an operation method for determining chlorpyrifos by using the sensor and the like; the sensor outputs ECL signals, can detect the chlorpyrifos content, and mutually proves the results, and has high accuracy; the determination method is simple, quick, good in selectivity and high in sensitivity.

title_en: Lung cancer prognosis marker for predicting anti-PD-1 immunotherapy and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lung cancer prognosis marker for predicting anti-PD-1 immunotherapy and application thereof. The invention discloses that the higher the gene expression of transmembrane serine protease 2 (TMPRSS 2) in the cancer tissue of a lung cancer patient, the better the prognosis of lung adenocarcinoma, and the worse the prognosis of lung squamous carcinoma. And in a combination study with anti-PD-1 treatment, expression of TMPRSS2 was found to be positively correlated with prognosis of lung adenocarcinoma patients not responsive to anti-PD-1 treatment. A model for influencing the prognosis of a lung cancer patient is constructed through multi-factor COX survival analysis, and the accuracy and the specificity of the model are verified by a K-M plot curve, a ROC curve and the survival time of the patient. Therefore, the marker has potential application value as a lung cancer prognosis index for predicting anti-PD-1 immunotherapy in lung cancer, can further provide basis for personalized therapy selection of lung cancer patients, and has important significance for personalized therapy and reduction of lung cancer mortality.

title_en: Targeted induction method for improving tyrosinase inhibition rate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for improving the targeted induction of tyrosinase inhibition rate, which relates to the technical field of targeted induction and comprises gene sequencing and selective induction modes, wherein the induction modes can be divided into hypoxia or signal molecule induction; by utilizing vesicle transportation and a water molecule channel, barrier-crossing transportation is realized, vesicle bionic components are divided into nanoscale micro-lipid vesicle pellets, and then vesicle is utilized for transportation.

title_en: Device, system and method for multi-factor detection of in vitro skin tissue culture
abstract_en: The application discloses a device, a system and a method for detecting multiple factors in vitro skin-like tissue culture, wherein a skin-like tissue culture chip receives input of culture solution, performs skin-like tissue culture, externally stimulates the skin-like tissue, outputs the culture solution after stimulation reaction to a sample processing chip, and the culture solution contains multiple cytokines; the sample processing chip processes the culture solution after the stimulation reaction with the magnetic beads and the substrate to form a mixture of the magnetic beads and the substrate, and outputs the mixture to the multi-factor detection chip, wherein the magnetic beads are coupled with a linking structure of a capture antibody-cytokine; the multi-factor detection chip is used for detecting the content of different cytokines in the mixture of the magnetic beads and the substrate. The device, the system and the method for detecting the multifactor in the in-vitro skin-like tissue culture can culture the skin-like tissue in vitro, detect the response of the skin-like tissue after the skin-like tissue is stimulated externally and have high speed.

title_en: Portable ozone monitoring device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of environment detection equipment, and discloses a portable ozone monitoring device which comprises a monitoring device, wherein a channel is formed in the monitoring device, a moving block is connected in the channel in a sliding manner, a sliding rail is fixedly connected to the outside of the monitoring device, a push-pull handle is fixedly connected to one side of the moving block, the push-pull handle extends to the outside of a cavity, an exhaust pipe is fixedly connected to the inside of the moving block, an air pump is fixedly installed at the bottom of the moving block, an air inlet pipeline is fixedly connected to the inside of the air pump, and a monitoring mechanism is arranged in the monitoring device. The utility model has the following advantages and effects: this device is through stretching out and drawing back the exhaust tube, contracts the inside to monitoring devices with the exhaust tube, not only can protect the exhaust tube, after the exhaust tube extends to monitoring devices's inside simultaneously, will be convenient for carry monitoring devices.

title_en: Fabric softness and comfort level detection and evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for detecting and evaluating the softness and comfort of a fabric, which is used for testing the numerical values of three indexes of softness, looseness and softness of the fabric, and performing Z-Score standardization treatment on the numerical values of the three indexes of softness, looseness and softness to obtain numerical values Lz, bz,Rz, fabric softness comfort S is calculated using formula (1): (1) The larger the S value is, the higher the softness comfort level of the fabric is, and w1, w2 and w3 are respectively weight coefficients of three indexes of fabric softness, looseness and softness, wherein w1+w2+w3=1; for the thin fabric, the values of w1, w2 and w3 are respectively 0.5-0.8,0.1-0.2,0.1-0.2; for the medium-thickness fabric, the values of w1, w2 and w3 are respectively 0.3-0.4 and 0.4-0.6,0.3-0.5; for the thick fabric, the values of w1, w2 and w3 are respectively 0.1-0.2,0.3-0.6,0.3-0.6. The invention provides a relatively systematic and comprehensive fabric softness detection and evaluation method, which effectively supplements the current softness evaluation method in the industry, can more intuitively help consumers to better perceive softness during purchase, and promotes the consumers to make purchase decisions.

title_en: Method and device for determining droplet distribution information, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: A method for determining droplet distribution information comprises the steps of obtaining neighborhood information of a to-be-detected micro-group in a current cloud fog area, judging whether the to-be-detected micro-group is broken into sub-droplets based on the neighborhood information, calculating motion information of each sub-droplet formed by breaking the to-be-detected micro-group if the to-be-detected micro-group is broken into the sub-droplets, obtaining current distribution information of each sub-droplet, and calculating motion information of the to-be-detected micro-group if the to-be-detected micro-group is not broken into the sub-droplets, and obtaining current distribution information of the to-be-detected micro-group. The method can improve the accuracy of the appearance simulation of the cloud and fog area.

title_en: Triglycerides and cholesterol mixed quality control liquid and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a triglyceride and cholesterol mixed quality control liquid and a preparation method and application thereof, relates to the technical field of in-vitro diagnostic reagents, and solves the problem of poor compatibility of components of the triglyceride and cholesterol mixed quality control liquid. The triglyceride and cholesterol mixed quality control liquid comprises mother liquor and diluent, wherein the mother liquor comprises the following components in percentage by mass: 7-10% of triolein, 85-90% of TritonX-100 and 3-5% of cholesterol; the diluent comprises the following components in percentage by mass: 50-51% of isopropanol, 39-40% of sodium phosphate buffer solution, 9.50-9.75% of sodium cholate and 0.25-0.50% of sodium benzoate. The mixed quality control liquid has high stability and accuracy, can detect triglyceride and cholesterol simultaneously, and the detection results are not mutually interfered.

title_en: Medical respiratory carbon dioxide concentration measuring system and zeroing method thereof
abstract_en: A zeroing method of a medical respiratory carbon dioxide concentration measurement system, comprising the steps of: at each starting time, performing zero calibration operation by taking air as a reference; recording the time and zero correction deviation D1 of each starting moment; and (B) step (B): before each shutdown, performing zero calibration operation again by taking air as a reference; recording the time before each shutdown and the zero correction deviation D2; step C: counting zero correction deviation D1 of the execution step A after a plurality of times of startup according to set interval time, and calculating a statistical average value of the plurality of zero correction deviations D1; and the statistical average value of the zero correction deviation D1 is used as the zero correction deviation D1 of the next starting moment. The method can record the time of repeated startup and shutdown zero correction and the zero correction deviation D1, and utilize the zero correction deviation to carry out statistical average, eliminate the influence of the carbon dioxide concentration deviation in the air at different startup time on the zero correction, so that the zero correction can be closer to the real reference zero.

title_en: Ecological health safety evaluation method for toxic pollutants in water body
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of water body safety evaluation, and particularly discloses an ecological health safety evaluation method for toxic pollutants in a water body. The method comprises the following steps: the transgenic zebra fish is exposed to an adult fish stage in the pollutants to be detected from the embryo stage; constructing three zebra fish injury models; and (3) performing a fluorescence imaging experiment on the three constructed zebra fish injury models, and respectively analyzing the number of immune cells and the distribution situation of the immune cells according to the fluorescence area and the distribution of fluorescence intensity. According to the application, the zebra fish is exposed to adults at an environment-related dose, and the tiny damage caused by direct exposure of pollutants is amplified by establishing three damage zebra fish models, so that the aquatic health risks of the pollutants are reflected more truly and objectively; and the adult zebra fish is subjected to fluorescent imaging through the small animal three-dimensional fluorescent imaging instrument, so that fluorescent signals of the zebra fish can be sensitively and accurately captured, toxic effects of pollutants are displayed in situ and intuitively, and high-flux imaging of a plurality of fluorescent zebra fish is realized simultaneously.

title_en: Gene marker combination, kit and system for predicting bad prognosis of gastric cancer
abstract_en: The application discloses a gene marker combination, a kit and a system for predicting bad prognosis of gastric cancer, belonging to the field of medical molecular biology. The gene marker combination comprises ACTG1, AKR1B10, GPX2, H2AFZ, HMGB2, KIAA0101, MUC5AC, STMN1, TFF1 and TUBA1B, the gene interaction and the actual effect of the gene are fully considered, the bad prognosis evaluation of gastric cancer is more comprehensive, and the gene marker combination has very important clinical application value.

title_en: Methods of treating copper metabolism-related diseases or disorders
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to methods of diagnosing and treating copper metabolism related diseases or disorders such as Wilson's Disease (WD).

title_en: Outdoor water environment monitor for river treatment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an outdoor water environment monitor for river treatment, which relates to the technical field of water environment monitoring and comprises a monitoring component, wherein a water taking component is arranged on the side surface of the monitoring component, a floating component is arranged at the bottom of the monitoring component, a propeller component is arranged at one end of the floating component, a monitor is arranged at the top of the monitoring component, and a monitoring rod is connected to the bottom of the monitor. The invention can configure the monitoring sensor according to the selection of a user through an instrument, all the sensors adopt a non-reagent monitoring method, a field monitoring pool is matched, the pollutant concentration in the water body can be conveniently, quickly and quickly checked, screened and monitored, the out-of-standard water body or the out-of-standard water body can be monitored and confirmed by carrying out manual sampling and carrying back, the positioning function can be provided for the equipment through the positioning component, meanwhile, the wireless connection control of the wireless transmission component is matched, the movement of the monitoring equipment is favorably controlled remotely, and the data is transmitted remotely.

title_en: Underground water quality detection method, system and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses an underground water quality detection method, an underground water quality detection system and a readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: extracting a first water quality parameter of a target detection point at a certain moment, and judging whether the first water quality parameter is larger than a preset water quality parameter threshold value or not; acquiring abnormal second water quality parameters of other detection points in a preset area where the target detection point in a preset first period is located; calculating each target deviation of each abnormal second water quality parameter and the first water quality parameter, and judging whether the local variation value of each target deviation is larger than a preset variation threshold value in a preset first period; and acquiring a third water quality parameter of the target detection point at another moment, and determining whether water quality abnormality exists at the target detection point based on the third water quality parameter. Whether the water quality of the current target detection point is stable or not can be analyzed, so that the target detection point can be rapidly detected again, and the accuracy of underground water quality detection is improved.

title_en: Water quality monitoring and early warning method and system for secondary water supply
abstract_en: The invention provides a water quality monitoring and early warning method and a water quality monitoring and early warning system for secondary water supply, which relate to the technical field of data processing and are used for obtaining hierarchical subducting by obtaining the distribution of subducting connected with a water storage tank and carrying out hierarchical division on pressurization parameters and water supply flow of each subducting in the distribution of the subducting; and sampling to obtain a level water quality monitoring sample and an in-tank water quality monitoring sample, and inputting the level water quality monitoring sample and the in-tank water quality monitoring sample into a water quality monitoring function obtained based on training with the level water quality monitoring sample and the in-tank water quality monitoring sample, so that N subductions with abnormal water quality are obtained. The method solves the technical problem that the high-rise residential residents use severely polluted domestic water because the secondary water supply storage tank and the water system pipeline are killed and cleaned based on a fixed period in the prior art. The method and the device achieve the technical effects of improving the timeliness and accuracy of the pollution conditions of the water storage tank and the water system pipeline for obtaining secondary water supply, timely sterilizing and cleaning the polluted water system pipeline and the polluted water storage tank and improving the water safety of residents in high-rise houses.

title_en: Crop growth simulation method for saline soil by considering root system dynamic distribution
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a crop growth simulation method for saline soil by considering root system dynamic distribution, which comprises the following steps: constructing a root length distribution model of the crops according to the root length distribution conditions of the crops in different salinity and growth periods; calibrating parameters in the root length distribution model according to the root length measured data in each soil layer under different salinity and growth periods to obtain a calibrated root length distribution model; and (3) coupling the root length distribution model calibrated in the step (2) with the SWAP model to obtain a SWAP-LRDG model, calibrating parameters of the coupled SWAP-LRDG model, and finally simulating crop growth by adopting the calibrated SWAP-LRDG model. The invention considers the condition that the root system distribution is changed by soil water and salt and is changed along with the growth period in the whole growth period of crops when constructing the model, and the constructed model can simulate the actual root system growth condition of crops, thereby more accurately simulating the growth of underground and overground parts of the crops.

title_en: Serum protein marker for early screening and diagnosis of pancreatic duct adenocarcinoma, application and corresponding analysis method
abstract_en: The application provides a serum protein marker for early screening and diagnosis of pancreatic duct adenocarcinoma, which is a combination of one or more than two of autoantibodies of tumor-associated antigens HEXB, TXLA and SLAMF 6. Provides application of a reagent for detecting serum protein markers, a kit and an analysis method. The application screens autoantibodies of pancreatic duct adenocarcinoma related antigens, and can distinguish pancreatic duct adenocarcinoma, healthy control and pancreatic benign disease by measuring the expression levels of the indexes in serum of pancreatic duct adenocarcinoma, healthy control and pancreatic benign disease control, and the screened anti-HEXB, anti-TXLNA and anti-SLAMF 6 autoantibodies; the tumor-related antigen combination which can be used for pancreatic duct adenocarcinoma diagnosis is designed and optimized, the optimized antigen is applied to an ELISA kit, and the detection of serum anti-TAA autoantibodies is carried out by an indirect ELISA adsorption experimental method, so that pancreatic duct adenocarcinoma patients, healthy control patients and pancreatic benign disease patients can be accurately identified.

title_en: Methods and systems for detecting microorganisms using infectious agents
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are methods, compositions, kits, and systems for rapid detection of microorganisms of interest on surfaces, including medical devices. Hybrid compositions of recombinant phage can be used to detect potentially harmful bacteria. The specificity of recombinant phage for binding microorganisms allows for the targeted and highly specific detection of the microorganism of interest.

title_en: Preparation method of conjugate
abstract_en: The application relates to a preparation method of a conjugate. Specifically, the mutant glucose 6-phosphate dehydrogenase of the present application comprises one mutation or a combination thereof selected from the group consisting of D306C, D375C, G C, as compared to the wild-type glucose 6-phosphate dehydrogenase. The detection kit prepared by using the glucose 6-phosphate dehydrogenase mutant has the advantages of strong specificity, high sensitivity, convenient operation, short detection time, accurate quantification and suitability for high-throughput detection.

title_en: Semi-rigid base asphalt pavement crack cause diagnosis method
abstract_en: The application discloses a cause diagnosis method for a semi-rigid base asphalt pavement crack, which comprises the steps of acquiring crack data and classifying the cause of the semi-rigid base asphalt pavement crack; diagnosing special causes of cracks based on basic information investigation; traffic and temperature external cause diagnosis based on index and threshold analysis; diagnosing internal causes of materials and structures based on core sample tests and field tests; and comprehensively diagnosing the crack cause of the semi-rigid base asphalt pavement. The application realizes the system and comprehensive diagnosis of the cause of the crack of the semi-rigid base asphalt pavement and provides theoretical support for the subsequent targeted treatment of the crack and pavement maintenance.

title_en: Quantum dot microsphere fluorescence immunochromatography test paper for combined detection of ASFV antibody and nucleic acid and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides quantum dot microsphere fluorescence immunochromatography test paper for combined detection of ASFV antibodies and nucleic acids and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of veterinary biological diagnostic products. The quantum dot microsphere fluorescence immunochromatographic test paper for combined detection of ASFV antibodies and nucleic acids comprises a bottom plate, wherein a sample pad, a binding pad, a nitrocellulose membrane and a water absorption pad are sequentially connected in an end-to-end mode on the bottom plate, an antibody detection line, a nucleic acid detection line and a quality control line are sequentially arranged on the nitrocellulose membrane from the binding pad to the water absorption pad, a goat anti-pig IgG-Fc antibody is coated on the antibody detection line, streptavidin is coated on the nucleic acid detection line, a rabbit anti-sheep IgG antibody is coated on the quality control line, and a recombinant protein P22 marked by quantum dot microspheres and a sheep anti-digoxin antibody marked by the quantum dot microspheres are coated on the binding pad. The test paper can be used for rapidly detecting ASFV antibodies and nucleic acids with high specificity and high sensitivity.

title_en: Application of beta-1, 4-galactosyltransferase 1 and inhibitor thereof in preparation of medicines for treating acute and chronic liver diseases
abstract_en: The invention discloses application of beta-1, 4-galactosyltransferase 1 and an inhibitor thereof in liver diseases, in particular acute liver injury and liver failure, and application of the beta-1, 4-galactosyltransferase 1 and an inhibitor thereof in the acute liver injury and liver failure, provides relevance of the beta-1, 4-galactosyltransferase 1 and the acute liver injury and the liver failure, and proves that the activity of the beta-1, 4-galactosyltransferase 1 can be inhibited to relieve the acute liver injury and the liver failure, and the beta-1, 4-galactosyltransferase 1 can be used as a drug target for screening acute hepatitis, chronic hepatitis, liver injury, fatty liver, hepatic fibrosis and acute and chronic liver failure; the invention also demonstrates the alleviation of acute liver failure by inhibitors of beta-1, 4-galactosyltransferase 1, which improve acute liver failure by reducing the enzyme activity or protein expression of beta-1, 4-galactosyltransferase 1.

title_en: Application of LMO7 expression level in prediction of pancreatic cancer gemcitabine resistance
abstract_en: The application discloses an application of LMO7 expression level in prediction of pancreatic cancer gemcitabine resistance, and belongs to the technical field of biological material detection. According to the application, the drug resistance of pancreatic cancer patients to gemcitabine is predicted by using the expression level of LMO7, and afatinib is recommended to be used when the expression level of LMO7 is higher, so that the treatment effect and the safety can be effectively improved, and the prognosis is expected to be improved, so that the method has important clinical significance for the treatment selection of pancreatic cancer patients.

title_en: Application of AOC1 as marker for distinguishing ovarian clear cell carcinoma and high-grade serous carcinoma
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of biological medicine, and particularly relates to application of AOC1 as a marker for distinguishing ovarian clear cell carcinoma and high-grade serous carcinoma. In particular, the invention provides the use of an agent for detecting the expression level of AOC1 in the manufacture of a product for determining the type of cancer, whether it is clear cell ovarian cancer or high grade serous ovarian cancer.

title_en: Safety detection method, system and device for resident fuel gas and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a safety detection method, system and device for resident fuel gas and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a structure of a house to be tested; the house to be tested is used for representing a house using resident fuel gas; determining a track to be tested according to the structure of the house to be tested; scanning detection is carried out through a track to be detected based on the flight equipment, so that detection data are obtained; the detection data comprises video data and density data; the concentration data is used for characterizing the concentration of harmful gases in the measured environment; and detecting potential safety hazards of the house to be detected through the video data and the concentration data, and obtaining a detection result. According to the embodiment of the application, the track to be measured is formulated through the structure of the house to be measured; the house to be tested is automatically detected through the flying equipment; the safety detection of resident gas can be realized under any condition, the safety performance is judged through the detection data, the detection accuracy is improved, and the safety detection method can be widely applied to the technical field of gas.

title_en: DNA aptamer for detecting PD-L1 positive cells and application thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of biology, in particular to a DNA aptamer, a method for detecting PD-L1 positive cells with high sensitivity by using a flow cytometer and application thereof. The nucleotide aptamer provided by the application has high sequence specificity and stronger affinity to PD-L1 positive cells, and has the advantages of simple synthesis, low cost, simple and convenient analysis process and short time. The method for detecting PD-L1 positive cells provided by the application has the advantages that the fluorescent groups are modified on the nucleic acid aptamer designed by the method, the method can be observed under a fluorescence microscope and can be analyzed on a flow cytometer, and the flow cytometer analysis has the characteristics of high sensitivity and quantitative analysis.

title_en: DNA aptamer for detecting PD-L1 positive cells and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biology, in particular to a DNA aptamer, a method for detecting PD-L1 positive cells with high sensitivity by using a flow cytometer and application thereof. The nucleotide aptamer provided by the invention has high sequence specificity and stronger affinity to PD-L1 positive cells, and has the advantages of simple synthesis, low cost, simple and convenient analysis process and short time. The method for detecting PD-L1 positive cells provided by the invention has the advantages that the fluorescent groups are modified on the nucleic acid aptamer designed by the method, the method can be observed under a fluorescence microscope and can be analyzed on a flow cytometer, and the flow cytometer analysis has the characteristics of high sensitivity and quantitative analysis.

title_en: Cyclone desanding experimental device and experimental method
abstract_en: The invention provides a cyclone desanding experimental device and an experimental method. The device comprises a heating tank, a cam rotor pump, an inlet mass flowmeter, a cyclone desander, a static mixer, an air injection device, an overflow port mass flowmeter, a polarization microscope, first, second and third pressure detection devices, wherein the heating tank, the cam rotor pump, the inlet mass flowmeter and the cyclone desander are sequentially connected, the static mixer is arranged in a connecting pipeline between the inlet mass flowmeter and the cyclone desander, the air injection device is communicated with the connecting pipeline between the inlet mass flowmeter and the static mixer, the overflow port mass flowmeter is connected with a first overflow outlet of the cyclone desander, the polarization microscope is connected with a sand setting fluid sampling port, an overflow fluid sampling port and a to-be-desanded fluid sampling port, and the first, second and third pressure detection devices are used for detecting the sample fluid pressure, the fluid outlet pressure and the overflow fluid pressure of the cyclone desander, the heating tank comprises a stirring paddle module and a conical cylinder module which are detachably connected with a heating tank, and a valve is arranged on the connecting pipeline between the overflow port mass flowmeter and the first overflow outlet of the cyclone desander or at the overflow port mass flowmeter.

title_en: Sequencing data-encoded peptides according to tandem mass spectrometry
abstract_en: Peptide sequencing is important in decoding data stored in data-encoded peptides. Tandem mass spectrometry (MS/MS) is particularly useful for peptide sequencing. In a computer-implemented method for sequencing data-encoded peptides from an experimental spectrum, raw data of the experimental spectrum is first pre-processed to remove unexplained peaks, resulting in pre-processed data. A first set of one or more candidate sequences competing for the peptide sequence of the peptide is identified from the spectrogram. The spectrogram is formed from pre-processed data rather than raw data to produce a smaller number of candidate sequences, thereby reducing the time cost of sequencing. The first set of candidate sequences is then processed to estimate the peptide sequences, thereby obtaining a set of peptide sequence estimated sequences. Verifying whether each estimated sequence is invalid. The set of peptide sequence estimation sequences is cleaned up to remove any invalid estimation sequences.

title_en: Direct-extraction type flue gas total mercury concentration monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a direct-extraction type flue gas total mercury concentration monitoring system which comprises an acid device, a mercury analyzer and an air pump, wherein a sampling end of a sampling gun stretches into a flue to be used for extracting sample gas from the flue, a high-temperature furnace, an acid removal device, the mercury analyzer and the air pump are sequentially arranged along the flowing direction of sample gas, the high-temperature furnace is used for converting bivalent mercury in the sample gas extracted by the sampling gun into elemental mercury, the acid removal device is used for removing acid gas in the sample gas, the mercury analyzer is used for monitoring the total mercury concentration in the sample gas, and the air pump is used for extracting air. Breaks through the conventional sampling mode without a dilution sampling probe. According to the invention, the high-temperature cracking process of the high-temperature furnace is adopted to convert mercury and compounds thereof into total mercury for monitoring, the total mercury concentration measuring range is wider, the total mercury conversion rate is high and more stable, the reliability of the monitoring result is high, the equipment setting of the system is simplified, and the equipment cost and the mercury concentration monitoring cost are reduced.

title_en: Thyroxine fluorescent conjugate and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a thyroxine fluorescent conjugate and a preparation method thereof, and application of the thyroxine fluorescent conjugate in a kit for detecting thyroxine, and also provides a kit for detecting thyroxine and a preparation method thereof. The thyroxine fluorescent conjugate is used in a kit for detecting thyroxine, so that the stability of the kit can be improved. In the process of marking thyroxine by adopting the acridine derivative, a carbon chain structure with imino groups at two ends is embedded in the middle of thyroxine and the acridine derivative as a connecting arm to form a thyroxine fluorescent conjugate with a coupling structure of thyroxine-connecting arm-acridine derivative, and the thyroxine fluorescent conjugate is used as a reagent component of a reagent kit for detecting thyroxine, so that the stability of the reagent kit can be improved.

title_en: Food laboratory safety inspection system
abstract_en: A safety detection system of a food laboratory relates to the technical field of safety of the food laboratory, the detection system comprises a food laboratory body and a channel door slot arranged at the center of the front surface of the food laboratory body, wherein a positioning door frame body for supporting is fixedly arranged in the channel door slot; a positioning toothed ring is fixedly arranged at the center position of the rear top surface of the food laboratory body; the left side and the right side of the inside of the positioning door frame body are fixedly provided with driving frames; the transmission frame is fixedly installed in the middle of the ground of the positioning door frame body, and a transmission rotating rod is arranged in the transmission frame through a bearing rotating rod. According to the invention, the safety detection is carried out on the experimenters through the detection analyzer arranged on the front face of the food laboratory body, then the experimenters step into the detection disinfection pool to disinfect, and the safety disinfection is carried out on the experimenters through the disinfection sprayer arranged on the rear revolution.

title_en: Agents and uses for treating neuroendocrine prostate cancer
abstract_en: The invention relates to an agent for treating neuroendocrine prostate and application thereof, in particular to application of the agent in preparing a medicament for treating or preventing neuroendocrine prostate cancer, wherein the agent comprises one or more of the following components: (1) a FOXA2 inhibitor, (2) a FOXA1 promoter, and (3) a KIT response signaling pathway inhibitor. The invention discovers a novel target for treating or preventing neuroendocrine prostate cancer.

title_en: D-dimer detection kit and detection method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of medical detection, in particular to a D-dimer detection kit and a detection method thereof. The invention provides a D-dimer detection kit, which consists of a reagent R1 and a reagent R2. Wherein the R1 reagent mainly comprises buffer solution, preservative, inorganic salt, surfactant and protein stabilizer; the R2 latex reagent mainly comprises buffer solution, protein protecting agent, sucrose and preservative. Experiments show that the kit is easy to operate and short in analysis time, has high analysis sensitivity, high precision, high test accuracy and wide linear range, and can be combined with an automatic analyzer, thereby being beneficial to wide popularization and use in clinic.

title_en: Detection method for identifying whether calcium aspartate is chelate structure
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of compound identification, in particular to a detection method for identifying whether calcium aspartate is a chelating structure, which provides an optimal detection numerical range by carrying out qualitative analysis, microscopic imaging, specific rotation, TG analysis, determination of calcium retention rate in a PH range, detection of calcium retention capacity after gastrointestinal digestion simulation and the like on the calcium aspartate, and realizes the detection requirement of simply and rapidly identifying whether the calcium aspartate is the chelating structure through the combination of optimal parameters in the monitoring; the detection method is simple to operate, does not need complex treatment on the product, can rapidly obtain a conclusion, has accurate detection results, is suitable for determining whether calcium aspartate is a chelate structure, and can meet the rapid and accurate detection requirements in production.

title_en: Evaluation method and application of breast milk fat-soluble vitamins
abstract_en: The invention relates to an evaluation method and application of breast milk fat-soluble vitamins, which are carried out according to the following steps: (1) Collecting a breast milk sample, and collecting breast milk information corresponding to the breast milk sample at the same time of collecting the breast milk sample, wherein the breast milk information comprises mother basic information, infant basic information, meal intake information and infant feeding information; (2) preprocessing a breast milk sample to obtain a sample to be detected; (3) Measuring the content of fat-soluble vitamins in a sample to be measured, combining the content with breast milk information, and establishing a model of the fat-soluble vitamins in the breast milk; (4) And calculating the content level of the corresponding fat-soluble vitamin in the breast milk according to the model evaluation. The method can effectively establish a dynamic regression model, and can effectively judge the content level of the fat-soluble vitamins in the breast milk according to the dietary condition of the mother so as to infer whether the fat-soluble vitamins in the breast milk meet the growth requirement of infants or not, and feed back the deficiency or excess types of the fat-soluble vitamins in the breast milk.

title_en: Risk processing method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a risk processing method, a risk processing device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of computers, wherein the risk processing method comprises the following steps: acquiring a parameter value of a preset detection parameter aiming at a scene to be detected in a preset historical time period as a parameter value to be detected; processing the parameter values to be detected based on a risk processing model corresponding to the scene to be detected to obtain the probability of occurrence of preset risks in the scene to be detected as the prediction probability; the risk processing model is obtained by training based on user portraits of target users in a scene to be detected and sample detection parameters aiming at preset detection parameters in a sample scene; and if the prediction probability meets the first preset alarm condition, adopting an alarm mode corresponding to the preset risk to alarm. Based on the processing, the monitoring of the scene to be detected can be realized, whether the risk occurs in the scene to be detected or not is determined, and the alarm is given in time so as to reduce or avoid the loss caused by the risk.

title_en: Method for detecting sulfide content in water
abstract_en: The application provides a method for detecting the content of sulfide in water, which belongs to the technical field of water detection and comprises the following steps: s1: preparing a standard solution; s2: drawing a standard curve; s3: acid blowing and absorbing of a sample; s4: preparing a prediction solution; s5: and (5) detecting and calculating absorbance. According to the method, sulfide in the water body to be detected is acidified into hydrogen sulfide by using acid liquor, zinc acetate is used for absorbing the hydrogen sulfide to generate zinc sulfide precipitate, and the sulfide content in the water body to be detected is calculated according to a standard curve of preset absorbance-zinc sulfide content. The method does not use large-scale equipment such as a gas chromatograph, an ion chromatograph and the like in the sulfide detection process, and has low cost; meanwhile, toxic reagents such as N, N-dimethyl-p-phenylenediamine in a methylene blue spectrophotometry are not adopted, so that the method is harmless to human bodies and environment-friendly.

title_en: Blood sample analysis module
abstract_en: The application provides a blood sample analysis module, which comprises a shell and a wall assembly, wherein a cavity is arranged in the shell, and a first through hole, a second through hole and a third through hole are formed in the shell; the enclosure component is arranged in the cavity and is contacted with the cavity to form a standard cavity and a contrast cavity, the first through hole, the second through hole and the standard cavity are communicated, and the third through hole is communicated with the contrast cavity; the cavity walls of the standard cavity and the control cavity are respectively provided with an electrode assembly; the periphery side in the standard chamber and/or the contrast chamber of enclosure subassembly is equipped with first pipeline and second pipeline, and first pipeline embedding first through-hole, second pipeline embedding second through-hole, and first pipeline and second pipeline all communicate standard chamber. According to the blood sample analysis module provided by the embodiment of the application, the standard cavity and the control cavity are formed by arranging the enclosing wall component in the shell, and the first pipeline and the second pipeline which are communicated with the standard cavity are arranged on the enclosing wall component, so that external liquid of the blood sample analysis module can flow into and out of the standard cavity from the first pipeline and the second pipeline, and repeated measurement is realized.

title_en: Method and system for calculating alarm threshold value of combustible gas in battery energy storage system
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of battery energy storage, and particularly relates to a method and a system for calculating a flammable gas alarm threshold in a battery energy storage system; according to the correction value and the association relation, determining a gas detection device acquisition value corresponding to the flammable gas explosion limit value; determining a flammable gas alarm threshold according to the collection value of the gas detection device corresponding to the flammable gas explosion limit value and the alarm threshold percentage; and carrying out combustible gas alarm based on the combustible gas alarm threshold. The method can solve the problem that the concentration true value deviation at the position of the combustible gas monitoring value and the thermal runaway is larger, and can more accurately predict the explosion risk in the energy storage system.

title_en: Detection device and detection method
abstract_en: The detection device (100) is provided with: a flow path (103) provided on one surface of the sheet substrate (101) and configured to convey a liquid sample by capillary phenomenon; a detection region (105) provided in a part of the flow path (103); and a fine concave-convex structure A having a plurality of convex parts, which is provided at least in the detection region 105 and is formed integrally with the substrate 101 in the flow path 103, wherein a detection substance that specifically binds to the detection substance in the liquid sample is immobilized on the surface of the fine concave-convex structure A in the detection region 105, and wherein the detection device is configured to detect the detection substance by detecting a change in optical characteristics of the detection region 105 that occurs by an enzyme reaction.

title_en: Big data sewage prediction treatment method based on machine learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a machine learning-based big data sewage prediction treatment method, which comprises the following steps: step a, a data acquisition module: the module is responsible for collecting water inflow data of the urban sewage plant and collecting urban meteorological data at the same time; step b, a data processing module: the module performs pretreatment and analysis on the collected data, and establishes a sewage prediction model by utilizing a big data technology; step c, model training: training the characteristic data by using a machine learning algorithm, and establishing a sewage prediction model; step d, a controller: according to the predicted result of the sewage prediction model and a preset sewage treatment strategy, a sewage treatment scheme is formulated; step e, an actuator: the assembly controls the operation of the sewage treatment equipment according to the treatment scheme of the controller; step f, communication module: the module is responsible for data exchange and communication with external systems. Through big data technology and machine learning algorithm, realize the accurate prediction to sewage production to the fluctuation of coping with sewage production better improves sewage treatment ability.

title_en: Method for extracting soil protein by sequence and application thereof
abstract_en: The application belongs to the field of biotechnology and microorganisms, and particularly discloses a method for extracting soil proteins by sequences, which comprises the steps of extracting extracellular proteins of microorganisms in soil by using a pyrophosphoric acid buffer solution and extracting living whole proteins of the microorganisms in the soil by grinding with SDS (sodium dodecyl sulfate) liquid nitrogen, wherein the extracted proteins are functional proteins of the microorganisms in the soil which are newly participated in the circulation of an ecological system; comprises extracting organic matters such as humic acid or Al with NaOH  2  O  3  Active minerals bind tightly to proteins; and Na is used as  2  S  2  O  4  The buffer solution and NaOH further extract proteins, and the extracted proteins are functional proteins which are deposited in soil and participate in the circulation of an ecological system; purifying the extracted protein extract, precipitating, and performing enzymolysisDetection was performed on-press with mass spectrometry. The method can efficiently extract the protein in the soil, especially the active protein tightly combined with humus and minerals, and can effectively analyze the functions of soil protein microbial communities.

title_en: Soil detection device for land restoration
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a soil detection device for land restoration, which comprises a detection component and a drilling component, wherein the detection component is provided with a control component, the drilling component is arranged on the control component, the control component is also provided with a shell component, the shell component is provided with a stirring component, the detection component is replaced by controlling a magnetic block to slide on an upper turntable according to actual conditions, a plurality of groups of different detections are carried out, then the magnetic block is fixed by the magnetic force of a sliding installation block, so that the diversity of detection contents is realized, the meshing of an inner gear ring and a gear on the upper turntable drives a threaded rod to rotate, the shallow and deep soil is conveyed up, and the soil at the position is discharged through an opening on a middle collar, so that the soil at the position is detected more comprehensively, and the influence on a detection structure due to the difference of the shallow and deep soil environments is avoided.

title_en: Device and method for analyzing and characterizing swelling property and dispersion uniformity of ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene
abstract_en: The device for analyzing and representing the swelling property and the dispersion uniformity of the ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene comprises a solvent tank, a feed pump, a swelling tank, a feed pump and a pipeline mixer which are sequentially connected, wherein an on-line swelling monitoring device is arranged at the upper position, the middle position and the lower position of the swelling tank respectively, an on-line swelling monitoring device is arranged at a discharge port of the pipeline mixer, a solid feeder is connected with a discharge port of the swelling tank, and a particle raw material tank is connected with a feed port of the solid feeder. According to the invention, by monitoring the particle size and distribution of the ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene before and after feeding in the swelling reaction device, the swelling initial temperature and initial time, the lowest swelling temperature, the swelling rate of different temperatures and time periods, the swelling balance point, the swelling and dissolution demarcation point and the agglomeration condition of particles can be obtained, so that the swelling process is monitored, analysis data can be obtained rapidly, the particle size distribution of the ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene in the swelling process is monitored directly, and the swelling property and dispersion uniformity are monitored online.

title_en: Method and kit for detecting CD28 antibody residues in T lymphocyte preparation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biology, in particular to a method and a kit for detecting CD28 antibody residues in a T lymphocyte preparation. The invention provides a method for detecting CD28 antibody residues in a T lymphocyte preparation and a kit for detecting the CD28 antibody residues in the T lymphocyte preparation. The CD28 antibody residue measured by the method disclosed by the invention has high accuracy, and can accurately reflect and measure trace residues of the sample CD28 antibody. The detection range of the invention can reach 12.5-800 pg/mL, the relative recovery rate (RE%) is 80-120%, and more accurate data reference is provided for objectively evaluating the quality of the T lymphocyte preparation.

title_en: Ellagic acid reagent preparation method and activated partial thromboplastin time determination kit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing an ellagic acid reagent. The method comprises the following steps: aging the ellagic acid solution to obtain ellagic acid buffer solution, wherein the aging treatment is carried out for 20-80 h under the condition of 35-45 ℃; performing low-temperature ultrasonic treatment on the phospholipid to obtain emulsified phospholipid; and mixing the ellagic acid buffer solution with emulsified phospholipid to obtain the ellagic acid reagent. The preparation method disclosed by the invention is simple in preparation process, the ellagic acid solution is subjected to aging treatment, so that ellagic acid or other components are fully dissolved and diffused in the solution, the stability of the ellagic acid buffer solution is improved, and the ellagic acid reagent obtained by mixing the aged ellagic acid buffer solution with the emulsified phospholipid is not easy to precipitate, and the ellagic acid reagent has the advantages of high stability, high detection sensitivity and the like.

title_en: Assay for the detection of SARS-COV-2
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to detecting a protein from a SARS-CoV-2 virus or a fragment thereof in a sample obtained from a subject using a first antibody or antigen-binding fragment thereof that binds to a protein from a SARS-CoV-2 virus or a fragment thereof and a second antibody or antigen-binding fragment thereof that binds to a protein from a SARS-CoV-2 virus or a fragment thereof.

title_en: Mouse-anti-rabbit IgG (immunoglobulin G) heterotrophic antibody blocking agent and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a mouse anti-rabbit IgG isophilic antibody blocker and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following specific steps: 1) Animal immunization: dissolving rabbit IgG antigen in physiological saline according to immunity, adding an adjuvant to prepare an emulsifying agent, and immunizing Balb/c mice; 2) Cell fusion: selecting Balb/c mouse spleen cells with highest detection titer through ELISA to fuse with SP2/0 mouse myeloma cells to form hybridomas; 3) Screening hybridoma cells; 4) Cloning of hybridoma cells; 5) Preparing monoclonal antibodies in large quantities; 6) Purification of monoclonal antibodies: purifying by protein G column affinity chromatography to obtain the mouse anti-rabbit IgG isophilic antibody blocker. The mouse anti-rabbit IgG isophilic antibody blocking agent provided by the invention has the advantages of high purity, high activity, safety, no side effect and the like.

title_en: Experiment method and experiment device for hydrogen-doped natural gas with gas rush repair operation
abstract_en: The invention provides an experimental method and device for hydrogen-doped natural gas with gas rush-repair operation, which solve the technical problems that the hydrogen-doped natural gas with gas operation lacks effective experimental technical means, and the operation is safe and the data acquisition is reliable and cannot be ensured. The method comprises the following steps: forming an experiment environment with a pneumatic fire, and presetting an experiment identifier, a sampling port and a gas source port; performing field experiments by using an experiment environment with pneumatic fire; collecting internal experimental state data in the field experimental process; flame morphology data with gas cutting and gas welding stages were collected. The experimental risk in the operation with air is isolated, so that accidental fire is avoided from extending, and the site safety is ensured. The important nodes in the experimental process are marked, so that experimental steps are further standardized, and the omission in the whole experimental process is avoided. Meanwhile, an acquisition environment of internal and external state data in an experiment is formed, the accuracy and the dimension of the experimental process data are ensured, and the data requirement of a flame height and pressure relation model of the hydrogen-doped natural gas operation can be met.

title_en: Ecological lake water quality environment monitoring device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ecological lake water quality environment monitoring device, and belongs to the field of water quality monitoring. The ecological lake water quality environment monitoring device comprises a sampling head, a connector communicated with the bottom of the sampling head, a filter screen arranged in the sampling head, and a water inlet pipe, a water outlet pipe and a water outlet pipe, wherein the water inlet pipe is connected with the water outlet pipe; the protective shell is arranged on one side of the sampling head, an ejection mechanism and a pushing mechanism are respectively arranged on the inner side of the protective shell, and the ejection mechanism is used for cleaning the blocked impurities in the protective shell; the invention realizes timely cleaning of the blocked impurities in the filter screen, prevents the blocked impurities in the protective shell from being incapable of timely cleaning to influence the pumping efficiency, further improves the working efficiency, simultaneously can timely push and clean the impurities attached to the filter screen, prevents the impurities from remaining to influence the pumping efficiency, further improves the convenience, can discharge the impurities in opposite directions, avoids the possibility of being sucked again when the impurities are discharged in the same direction, and further reduces the unnecessary workload.

title_en: Water pollution anomaly traceability detection method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of sewage treatment, in particular to a water pollution anomaly traceability detection method and system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: presetting a sampling point in a wastewater discharge pipe network, and acquiring a wastewater sample containing process pollutants according to the sampling point; determining pollutant parameters of wastewater samples at all sampling points according to a chemical analysis method, and calculating central coordinates of pollutant spatial distribution at sections of different pipe sections in a wastewater discharge pipe network; constructing a pipe network water quality parameter prediction model according to the central coordinates, and determining model training data according to historical pollutant parameters of the water taking sampling points so as to train the pipe network water quality parameter prediction model; and positioning an abnormal procedure and abnormal equipment according to the generated area, and performing abnormality investigation. The invention can realize rapid and automatic identification and positioning of abnormal sewage changes in the waste water discharge pipe network of the paper mill.

title_en: Use of GPR37L1 as biomarker in diagnosis of multiple sclerosis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the use of GRP37L1 as a biomarker in the diagnosis of multiple sclerosis; a kit or diagnostic reagent for detecting mRNA or encoded protein of the biomarker GRP37L1 gene or fragment thereof in a biological sample. The method is used for predicting or diagnosing the multiple sclerosis, can be quantized, is more convenient to operate, has low professional requirements on operators, is more objective than the existing diagnosis method, is more beneficial to carrying out large-scale screening work, is more beneficial to the discovery and diagnosis of diseases, and provides a targeted personalized treatment scheme.

title_en: Roller type model test coal seam exploitation and slag conveying simulation system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a coal seam mining and slag conveying simulation system for a roller type model test, and relates to the technical field of geotechnical engineering and mining engineering tests. The device comprises an excavation module, a slag conveying module, a feeding module and an intelligent control operation cabinet; the excavation module is used for completing the stoping simulation work of the coal seam; the slag conveying module is arranged below the excavation module and is used for conveying and recycling coal slag after excavation and stoping; the output end of the feeding module is connected with the slag conveying module and is used for feeding the slag conveying module in the stoping direction; the intelligent control operation cabinet is used for truly simulating the complete excavation and stoping and waste residue conveying processes of coal seams with different thicknesses; the excavation module adopts a double-roller coal mining mechanism to realize continuous stoping of coal beds with different thicknesses. The invention has simple and convenient operation and can truly simulate the complete excavation and stoping and waste residue conveying processes of coal beds with different thicknesses.

title_en: Intelligent operation monitoring system and method for rural septic tank system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of domestic sewage treatment, in particular to an intelligent operation monitoring system and a monitoring method for a rural septic tank system.

title_en: Method and system for visually detecting nucleic acid based on cationic conjugated polymer
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for visually detecting nucleic acid based on a cationic conjugated polymer, wherein the method for visually detecting nucleic acid takes double-stranded DNA with a certain concentration or double-stranded DNA after amplification reaction as a bridge, and the double-stranded DNA is mixed with the cationic conjugated polymer and fluorescent dye, so that the visual detection is realized through fluorescence resonance energy transfer between the cationic conjugated polymer and the fluorescent dye. The invention can carry out rapid, sensitive and specific detection on the nucleic acid to be detected or the amplified product of the nucleic acid to be detected, thereby realizing simple and rapid analysis of the biomarker of the nucleic acid to be detected.

title_en: Screening and detecting method for genotoxic substances in food matrix based on high-content combined analysis disc
abstract_en: The invention uses the humanized in vitro cultured cell strain for genotoxicity evaluation, selects biomarkers gamma-H2 AX, p-H3, p53 and Rad51 associated with different DNA damage repair paths to construct a combined analysis disc, and simultaneously examines the influence of complex food substrates on the detection result of the combined analysis disc, thereby establishing a screening detection method of genotoxic substances in complex food substrates based on the high-content combined analysis disc.

title_en: Parameter detection test method, vehicle body structural adhesive selection method and system
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a parameter detection test method, a vehicle body structural adhesive selection method and a system. The parameter detection test method is used for detecting physical parameters of the structural adhesive and comprises the following steps: and manufacturing a test sample, and performing a structural adhesive physical parameter detection test by using the test sample to obtain data of the structural adhesive physical parameter corresponding to the characteristic information and the test condition of the test sample. The test sample was prepared by: coating structural adhesive doped with glass beads between a first substrate and a second substrate to bond the first substrate and the second substrate to form an initial sample; fixing the initial sample; baking the initial sample; cooling the initial sample after baking; and cutting the cooled initial sample to obtain the test sample. Thus, the parameters of the structural adhesive can be detected more accurately.

title_en: Use of human fibronectin or functional fragments thereof, screening method and kit
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of biological medicine and skin care, and relates to application, a screening method and a kit of human fibronectin or functional fragments thereof. In particular, the invention relates to the use of human fibronectin or a functional fragment of human fibronectin in the preparation of: a medicament for increasing the level of a protein or the expression level of a gene encoding the same, wherein the protein is selected from one or more of AQP1, AQP3, DSC3 and EPPK; or a medicament for moisturizing skin, promoting wound healing of skin, or promoting skin repair by increasing the level of a protein or the expression level of a gene encoding the same, wherein the protein is selected from one or more of AQP1, AQP3, DSC3, and EPPK. The invention also relates to a method for screening the functional fragments of human fibronectin and a kit.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle detection system and method for greenhouse gas emission hot spot and emission flux
abstract_en: The invention provides an unmanned aerial vehicle detection system and method for greenhouse gas emission hot spots and emission flux, comprising the following steps: step S1: the airborne detection equipment performs first round inspection, and the important point is to identify potential greenhouse gas emission hot spots; step S2: the airborne detection equipment carries out second round inspection, and focuses on grid units with thermal anomalies, gas collecting wells and other pile structures; step S3: calculating the actual position of a leakage point according to the wind vector surface above the surface of the landfill and the concentration of greenhouse gases; step S4: and calibrating the greenhouse gas sensor after the airborne detection equipment is inspected for a preset number of times. The unmanned aerial vehicle detection system and method for the greenhouse gas emission hot spots and the emission flux can accurately identify the positions of the greenhouse gas emission hot spots of the landfill, accurately calculate the gas emission amount of the emission hot spots and quantify the greenhouse gas emission amount of the whole landfill.

title_en: Regional environment monitoring and early warning system and method based on big data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of environmental monitoring, in particular to a regional environmental monitoring and early warning system and method based on big data, comprising the following steps: the system comprises a monitoring information acquisition module, a database, an environment monitoring module, a collaborative monitoring judging module and a collaborative monitoring planning module, wherein the monitoring information acquisition module is used for acquiring regional environment monitoring site information and information of unmanned aerial vehicles to be collaborative for monitoring regional environments of the collaborative monitoring sites, the database is used for storing all received data, the environment monitoring module is used for carrying out regional environment monitoring by utilizing the monitoring sites, the collaborative monitoring judging module is used for judging whether unmanned aerial vehicles are needed to carry out atmospheric environment monitoring, the collaborative monitoring planning module is used for planning the number of unmanned aerial vehicles to be collaborative monitored when judging that the unmanned aerial vehicles are needed, the unmanned aerial vehicles are used for carrying out atmospheric environment collaborative monitoring, the problems of insufficient coverage of a monitoring range and inaccurate monitoring data are solved, and unnecessary monitoring cost is reduced while monitoring efficiency is improved.

title_en: Underwater water quality acquisition device based on remote control of ship
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote control underwater water quality acquisition device based on a ship, which comprises a main shell, wherein a left side surface of the main shell is connected with a signal transmitter through a left connecting column, the right side of the main shell is connected with a counterweight through a right connecting column, a release cavity with a downward opening is arranged in the main shell, a water quality acquisition main body is arranged in the release cavity, a water quality acquisition component is arranged in the water quality acquisition main body, an arc-shaped annular groove is arranged in the arc-shaped inner wall of the peripheral side of the release cavity, and a traction component capable of carrying out traction on the water quality acquisition component is arranged in the annular groove.

title_en: Portable TOC analysis appearance with inside clearance structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of TOC analyzers, and particularly discloses a portable TOC analyzer with an internal cleaning structure, which comprises a shell, wherein an analyzer body is fixed above the inside of the shell, a base is fixed in the shell, a combustion chamber is movably installed on the base by utilizing a rotating shaft, the combustion chamber is positioned right below a top cover plate, an angle adjusting mechanism of the combustion chamber is further arranged on the base and used for changing the positioning state of the combustion chamber and adjusting the orientation angle of a port of the combustion chamber, and a cleaning and pollution discharge member penetrates through the side wall of the shell and is transversely and coaxially distributed with the combustion chamber and used for cleaning, drying and pollution discharge treatment of the inner wall of the combustion chamber.
