This portable TOC analysis appearance with inside clearance structure is convenient for the total carbon amount detection analysis of complete combustion reaction to carry out quick clearance and drying treatment to its inside after the combustion reaction is accomplished, synchronous blowdown operation, operation safety is swift.

title_en: Clay cement slurry proportioning selection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for selecting a clay cement slurry proportion, which belongs to the technical field of grouting and comprises the following steps: s1, performing serous fluid and calculus body performance tests: preparing slurry by adopting an orthogonal test method, determining orthogonal test factors, measuring the performances of the slurry and the lithiasis body under different proportioning conditions, and analyzing the influence of the factors on the performances of the slurry and the lithiasis body according to a linear regression analysis method; s2, preliminary selection of the proportion of the slurry: selecting working performance of rock mass crack grouting, respectively analyzing influence factors, and selecting preliminary slurry proportion; s3, selecting an optimized slurry ratio: XRD diffraction test, scanning electron microscope test and thermodynamic test are carried out on the hardened clay cement slurry in different ages, microscopic characteristic research of the clay cement slurry is carried out, and preliminary selection of slurry proportion is optimized. The method for selecting the proportion of the clay cement slurry can select proper proportion of the slurry according to different working conditions, so that the grouting effect is better improved, and the construction cost is reduced.

title_en: Method for predicting cycle life of lithium ion battery
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for predicting the cycle life of a lithium ion battery. The prediction method comprises the following steps: respectively carrying out cycle performance tests under different cycle numbers on a plurality of lithium ion batteries to be tested in the same electrochemical system to obtain the coulomb efficiency CE of each lithium ion battery to be tested corresponding to the cycle number; disassembling a plurality of lithium ion batteries to be tested under different cycle numbers, and testing the dissolution value M of metal impurities in a negative electrode plate of each lithium ion battery and the disorder value I of a negative electrode active material in the negative electrode plate; obtaining a plurality of groups of degradation indexes D corresponding to different cycle numbers based on a plurality of groups of coulomb efficiencies CE of a plurality of lithium ion batteries to be tested, a plurality of groups of dissolution values M of metal impurities and a plurality of groups of disorder values I of the negative electrode active material; and predicting the cycle life of the lithium ion battery to be tested based on the degradation index D. The prediction method provided by the invention realizes the rapid and accurate prediction of the cycle life of the battery cell, and reduces the test cost.

title_en: Micro-environment controllable plant population photosynthetic rate measuring instrument
abstract_en: The invention provides a plant group photosynthetic rate measuring instrument with controllable microenvironment, which comprises: a transparent square assimilation box for placing plants; a sensor module placed in the transparent square assimilation box; an environmental control module; a control circuit box; a core processing control module; controlling the air path; an industrial control screen; a lamp box. The plant group photosynthetic rate measuring instrument provided by the invention effectively controls humidity conditions in the assimilation box, provides a finely-controllable illumination environment, avoids the problem that water vapor needs to be evacuated frequently in the traditional scheme, realizes accurate measurement of the photosynthetic rate of plant seedlings, controls stable temperature and humidity in the assimilation box, reduces conditions affecting the photosynthetic rate of plants, improves the precision of detecting the photosynthetic rate of the plant group, and reduces measurement errors.

title_en: Automatic monitoring device for water pollutant flux and accounting method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water pollutant monitoring, and provides an automatic water pollutant flux monitoring device and a verification method, wherein the automatic water pollutant flux monitoring device comprises a shell, a concentration meter and a flowmeter are arranged in the shell, a plurality of extending shells are connected to the rear side of the shell, a connecting shell is connected to the rear side of the extending shell on the rearmost side, a second screen plate is arranged on the connecting shell, and butt joint assemblies are arranged between the shell and the extending shells, between two adjacent extending shells and between the extending shell on the rearmost side and the connecting shell. Through above-mentioned technical scheme, solved current monitoring devices can not be to the pollution degree of the rivers that flow that the monitoring head-on flows according to the flow direction of rivers, can not guarantee to detect the face all the time towards the direction of the flow direction of rivers, thereby can not be through the problem of the impurity content in the rivers of monitoring the jam degree in the unit time of detection filter plate.

title_en: Method for monitoring working environment in live working process
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data filtering, in particular to a method for monitoring an operation environment in a live working process; acquiring the neighborhood fluctuation degree according to the data change characteristics of the data points in the humidity time sequence in a preset average window; and obtaining the neighborhood discrete degree according to the data distribution characteristics in a preset average window of the data points. Obtaining a stable characteristic value of the data point according to the type characteristic of the data change in the preset average window of the data point; and obtaining an abnormal fluctuation assessment value and a correction factor according to the neighborhood fluctuation degree, the neighborhood discrete degree and the stable characteristic value. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a self-adaptive fractal dimension of a data point according to a correction factor and the fractal dimension; and filtering the humidity time sequence according to the self-adaptive fractal dimension to obtain a fitting monitoring sequence for environmental monitoring, so that the accuracy and reliability of environmental monitoring are provided.

title_en: Novel medical technology using follicular T cells
abstract_en: The present invention provides a novel medical technique using follicular T cells. The present invention provides a method for producing follicular T cells specific for a disease, based on the finding of a common TfhTCR (Public TfhTCR) specific for a common disease factor of each patient, the method comprising a step of determining a disease-related factor or a part thereof having the ability to trigger follicular T cells specific for a disease-related factor, a step of using the disease-related factor or the part thereof to trigger follicular T cells specific for a disease-related factor, and a step of obtaining follicular T cells specific for the disease.

title_en: Double-fluorescent protein co-expression system for lepidopteran insect cells and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a double fluorescent protein co-expression system for lepidopteran insect cells and application thereof. The double fluorescent protein co-expression system comprises a recombinant vector which is inserted into a pIZ-V5-His vector of an EGFP gene fragment or an mCherry gene fragment respectively, wherein the nucleotide sequence of the EGFP gene fragment is shown as SEQ ID NO.1, and the nucleotide sequence of the mCherry gene fragment is shown as SEQ ID NO. 2. According to the double fluorescent protein co-expression system for lepidopteran insect cells, EGFP and mCherry genes are respectively inserted into a pIZ-V5-His carrier, and the EGFP and mCherry designed are inserted into the forward positions (HindIII and BamHI sites) of enzyme cutting sites, so that the utilization rate of enzyme cutting sites of a carrier skeleton is improved to the greatest extent while fluorescent protein fusion is realized; the recombinant expression vector can be used for promoting expression of green or red double-fluorescence fusion proteins in silkworm BmN cells, can be used for functional research such as protein detection and interaction, realizes visualization of protein expression and localization to be detected, and can be used for detecting protein expression and interaction by using antibodies of EGFP and mCherry proteins.

title_en: Method for researching adaptability regulation of inositol in anguilla marmorata to high salinity environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for researching adaptability regulation of inositol in anguilla marmorata to high salinity environment, which comprises the following steps: determining the expression of NKA, AQP, NHE genes of the anguilla marmorata under different salinity stress at different inositol concentration levels, and observing the positioning of proteins in cells; MIPS and IMPA1 gene expression analysis after salinity stress; isolated tissues of young anguilla marmorata, which are obtained from injection of normal saline, MIPS and IMPA1dsRNA, are used for detecting inositol content and MIPS and IMPA1 gene expression; isolated tissues of gill and kidney of young anguilla marmorata, which were obtained from c-Myc dsRNA and physiological saline injection, were examined for c-Myc, MIPS and IMPA1 gene expression. The invention can promote the artificial breeding of wild fish and the breeding of new species, and can also relieve or solve the adverse effect of salinity on fish from the aspect of nutrition addition of inositol aiming at the continuously changing water environment salinity.

title_en: Polypeptide with binding affinity to EB virus nuclear antigen 1 and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of biological medicine, in particular to a polypeptide with binding affinity to EB virus nuclear antigen 1 (EBNA 1) and application thereof. The invention provides a polypeptide with binding affinity to EB virus nuclear antigen 1, which is a target antigen selected by the inventor of EBNA 1. The inventor uses Z structural domain of staphylococcus protein A as a bracket, carries out random mutation on the surface amino acid residue analog antibody binding site, constructs a mutant library by phage display technology, carries out affinity screening on the library by using EBNA1 as a target antigen, and finally obtains the polypeptide with high affinity to the EBNA1 through a large amount of screening work. Through intensive research, the invention discloses a polypeptide with binding affinity to EB virus nuclear antigen 1, and in addition, the invention also provides diagnostic or therapeutic application of the polypeptide as a medicine or a molecular targeting reagent.

title_en: Monoclonal antibody for resisting A-type sai virus, epitope and application
abstract_en: The invention provides a monoclonal antibody for resisting A-type sai virus, an epitope and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of biological antibodies. The invention aims to provide an antibody sequence capable of specifically recognizing SVA VP2 protein and an antigen site sequence recognized by the antibody. The invention provides a monoclonal antibody of an anti-A type sai virus, wherein the amino acid sequence of a heavy chain variable region of the monoclonal antibody is shown as SEQ ID NO. 5; the amino acid sequence of the light chain variable region of the monoclonal antibody is shown as SEQ ID NO. 7. Provides basis for further rationally designing epitope vaccine and developing SVA infection specificity serological diagnosis method.

title_en: Auxiliary platform for collecting oil sample of tapping switch of transformer
abstract_en: The application discloses transformer tapping switch oil appearance collection auxiliary platform belongs to transformer maintenance technical field. The platform comprises a sinking type tray, lifting screw fixing rods are symmetrically arranged on the sinking type tray, clamp bases are sleeved on the lifting screw fixing rods, two ends of each clamp base are respectively sleeved with one lifting screw fixing rod, oil pipe clamps are arranged on the clamp bases, height adjusting knobs are arranged on the lifting screw fixing rods on the upper side and the lower side of each clamp base, a needle cylinder support is further arranged on the sinking type tray, and the needle cylinder support can fix an oil sample collecting container. The device is developing tapping switch oil sample collection during operation, can place the oil sampling container on this auxiliary platform, and the staff only need control oil sampling valve just can accomplish oil sample collection work smoothly, improves man-machine work efficiency and work efficiency, and auxiliary platform uses the anti-skidding design that sinks, prevents oil sampling container slip landing ground, collects the waste oil that splashes simultaneously, prevents polluted environment and staff.

title_en: Immunomagnetic bead coated with recombinant PEDV S1 protein and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a porcine epidemic diarrhea virus S1 protein and application thereof. The invention also discloses a magnetic particle chemiluminescence method for detecting the PEDV IgG antibody and the PEDV IgA antibody by taking the PEDV S1 recombinant protein as an antigen, and the magnetic particle chemiluminescence method is assembled into a kit, so that the effective serological diagnosis and investigation of the currently popular PEDV viruses can be carried out, the PEDV antibody level and the natural infection condition in a pig group can be judged, and a rapid and simple detection method is provided for preventing and treating the PEDV viruses.

title_en: Preparation method of insulin aspart derivative
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of an insulin aspart derivative. In particular to a preparation method of a derivative impurity reference substance or standard substance. The impurity reference substance or standard substance provided by the invention can be used as an important index for qualitatively or quantitatively detecting the functional activity of the insulin aspart, and plays an important role in the aspects of quality control of the insulin aspart, formulation optimization, storage condition screening and the like.

title_en: Crop drought monitoring method and system and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a crop drought monitoring method, a system and electronic equipment, belonging to the field of drought monitoring, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring meteorological station data and crop coefficients of a region to be monitored in a set period; the meteorological site data comprise daily environmental data of the region to be monitored within a set period; calculating the daily potential evaporation in a set period according to the meteorological site data; calculating the daily water demand of crops in a set period according to the daily potential evaporation and the crop coefficient; calculating the daily effective precipitation in a set period according to weather site data; determining a daily crop drought index according to the daily water demand and the daily effective rainfall of crops in a set period; and determining the drought duration and the drought intensity based on the daily crop drought index so as to monitor the drought condition of crops in the area to be monitored. The invention improves the accuracy of crop drought monitoring.

title_en: anti-LILRB 1 nanobody or antigen binding fragment thereof, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of immunity, in particular to an anti-LILRB 1 antibody or an antigen binding fragment thereof, a preparation method and application, and particularly relates to an anti-LILRB 1 nanobody or an antigen binding fragment thereof, a preparation method and application. The anti-LILRB 1 antibody or antigen-binding fragment thereof may inhibit the immune escape mechanism of tumor cells so that immune cells may exhibit their anticancer effect.

title_en: Immunogenicity evaluation method of polypeptide material and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an immunogenicity evaluation method of polypeptide materials and application thereof, wherein the evaluation method comprises a cell layer, a blood layer and an in-vivo layer, the cell layer comprises the function of detecting the phagocytic effect of the polypeptide materials on phagocytes, the blood layer comprises the function of detecting the polypeptide materials on complement and pro-inflammatory factors in blood, and the in-vivo layer comprises the function of detecting the polypeptide materials on humoral immunity and hypersensitivity. The methods of the invention can evaluate the immunogenicity of a polypeptide material to ensure its safety and effectiveness in biomedical applications.

title_en: Automatic radioactive inert gas monitoring device based on compressed sampling
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of radiation monitoring, in particular to an automatic radioactive inert gas monitoring device based on compressed sampling, which comprises: a pressurizing pump for pressurizing the gas in the nuclear facility gas-carrying effluent pipeline; the measuring container is used for containing the gas output by the pressurizing pump, is provided with an air inlet valve and an air outlet valve, and is provided with a detector for detecting the activity and the concentration of the radioactive inert gas in the measuring container; the pressure reducing valve is connected with the outlet of the exhaust valve and is used for discharging the gas in the measuring container back to the nuclear facility air-carrying outlet pipeline. The invention utilizes online automatic compression sampling and online measurement, can realize online monitoring of radioactive inert gas, has low detection lower limit, and improves the accuracy of inert gas emission statistics.

title_en: Sampling detection equipment and method for food safety
abstract_en: The invention discloses sampling detection equipment and a sampling mechanism for food safety, and relates to the technical field of food detection, the sampling detection equipment comprises a frame, wherein a conveying belt is arranged on the frame, a separation strip is uniformly arranged on the conveying belt, the conveying belt is used for carrying out separation conveying on food cans through the separation strip, a detection box is arranged on the upper side of the conveying belt, a grabbing mechanism and a sampling mechanism are arranged in the detection box, a detection bottle is uniformly arranged in the detection box, the detection bottle is installed with a scissor lifting bracket, the sampling mechanism comprises a puncture tube and a sampling cotton swab which is telescopically installed in the puncture tube, the sampling cotton swab stretches out to sample the food cans after the puncture tube punctures the food cans, and the sample on the sampling cotton swab is transferred into the detection bottle by combining a sliding rail; according to the invention, the food cans on the conveyor belt are grabbed by the grabbing mechanism and the food cans are penetrated by the penetrating pipe in the sampling mechanism, so that the sampling samples are obtained.

title_en: Method for detecting organic pollutants in river-underground water system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of organic pollutant detection, in particular to a detection method of organic pollutants in a river-underground water system, which can describe the convection, diffusion and adsorption processes of the organic pollutants in the river-underground water system based on Darcy's law and Fick's law; the influence of factors such as permeability coefficient, dispersion coefficient and adsorption rate constant is considered, the accuracy of the model is improved, the movement and transmission characteristics of organic pollutants in a river-underground water system can be predicted, and scientific basis and technical support are provided for environmental pollution control.

title_en: Water quality detection system for construction engineering for water
abstract_en: The application discloses a water quality detection system for water construction engineering, which belongs to the technical field of water quality detection of hydraulic engineering and comprises a cylinder body, a cylinder cover and a filtering structure; the filtering structure is arranged in the cylinder body and is used for filtering out colloidal particles suspended in water to be detected and input into the cylinder body; the filter structure comprises a base mechanism and a filter element unit arranged in an inner cavity of the base mechanism, wherein the filter element unit comprises a semipermeable membrane component and an induction initiating piece. When the water quality detection system for the construction engineering for water is used, suspended colloid particles in upper clear water in water to be detected in the water body to be detected pumped into the inner part of the cylinder body can be filtered through the filtering structure with water pressure sensing monitoring and back flushing capability, so that the situation that the colloid particles in the water body to be detected adhere to the surface of the detection end of the sensor for water quality detection when water quality detection work is carried out on the water body nearby in the construction process of water conservancy construction is effectively avoided.

title_en: Three-dimensional polymer networks and uses thereof
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides three-dimensional crosslinked polymer network transmission channels, arrays comprising the networks, methods for manufacturing the networks, and uses of the networks and arrays.

title_en: Latex microsphere reagent and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a latex microsphere reagent and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of in-vitro diagnosis. On the one hand, the concentration of the activator solution in the activation process is optimized, so that the aggregation condition of the microspheres in the activation process is adjusted; on the other hand, the aggregation during the antibody coupling of the microspheres is adjusted by adjusting the kind of buffer during the coupling. In addition, a suitable blocking agent is used during the blocking process, thereby reducing the inter-batch differences of the latex reagent. The preparation method of the latex microsphere reagent provided by the invention can improve the stability of the reagent or the kit.

title_en: Prefabricated vegetable tracing method based on two-dimensional identification code
abstract_en: The invention discloses a prefabricated vegetable tracing method based on a two-dimensional identification code, which relates to the technical field of prefabricated vegetable tracing and comprises the following steps: detecting and obtaining the total number of bacterial colonies of each raw material for producing the prefabricated vegetables And heavy metal content, calculating to obtain flora index of each batch of raw materials And heavy metal index The method comprises the steps of carrying out a first treatment on the surface of the Detecting to obtain the total number of colonies of the finished prefabricated vegetables Calculating to obtain bacterial colony index of each batch of finished prefabricated vegetables The method comprises the steps of carrying out a first treatment on the surface of the Calculating to obtain qualification index of each batch of finished prefabricated vegetables The method comprises the steps of carrying out a first treatment on the surface of the And generating production information of all the prefabricated vegetables into first tracing codes by using two-dimension code generation software, and generating transportation information into second tracing codes. When quality problems occur, deep tracing and investigation can be performed to find out the root cause of the problems.

title_en: SNAP25C tag polypeptide tag system and application
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of molecular immunology, in particular to a SNAP25C tag polypeptide tag, a monoclonal antibody resisting the polypeptide tag and application thereof, wherein the polypeptide sequence is shown as SEQ ID NO. 1. The invention discovers a new polypeptide tag which consists of 10 hydrophilic amino acids, and the polypeptide tag and a target protein can promote the expression of the protein after being fused and expressed without affecting the properties of the original protein; monoclonal antibodies that specifically recognize the peptide fragments are obtained by single B cell antibody preparation techniques that address one or more of the above-described needs or limitations. The polypeptide tag fusion protein can completely replace the existing tag systems in application, such as an HA tag system, a Flag tag system, a c-Myc tag system and the like, thereby realizing the application fields of expression detection, positioning, purification and the like of the polypeptide tag fusion protein.

title_en: In situ and real-time generation and administration of viral vaccines using UV light inactivation
abstract_en: The present invention provides a system (1000) for distributing an attenuated airborne pathogen (72) in an indoor space (3) for a human or animal, wherein the system (1000) is configured to (a) subject a first air (81) comprising the airborne pathogen (71) to a first radiation (111) in a treatment mode to attenuate the airborne pathogen (71) to provide a second air (82) having the attenuated airborne pathogen (72), and (b) introduce the second air (82) into the indoor space (3); wherein the spectral power distribution of the first radiation (111) is controllable over at least a portion of the wavelength range of 100nm-380nm, wherein the system (1000) comprises a control system (300), the control system (300) being configured to control the spectral power distribution of the first radiation (111) of the treatment mode in accordance with an airborne pathogen (71) to be attenuated.

title_en: Supercritical CO 2 Rock fracturing test system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a supercritical CO  2  The rock fracturing test system comprises a test bed and a rock sample placed on the test bed, wherein a fracturing test component is arranged on the test bed and comprises a supercritical CO filled therein  2  The invention relates to an energy accumulator which is arranged on a test bed, one end of the energy accumulator, which releases impact gas, is inserted into a rock sample, a plurality of sample pressing plates are arranged on the outer side of the rock sample in a surrounding way, the sample pressing plates are abutted to the rock sample, a pressing mechanism is arranged on the test bed, the output end of the pressing mechanism is connected with the sample pressing plates, and the pressing mechanism drives the sample pressing plates to apply load to the rock sample  2  Impact gas generated by phase change is directly impacted and cracked from the inside of the rock sample, and meanwhile, the pressure applying mechanism drives the testThe sample pressing plate applies load to the rock sample and can be used for supercritical CO  2  Accurate simulation of phase-change fracturing rock is carried out, and supercritical CO is improved  2  Accuracy of rock fracture dynamic impact index measurement.

title_en: High-throughput screening method of alpha-amylase inhibitor in tea
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-throughput screening method of an alpha-amylase inhibitor in tea, which comprises the following steps: 1) Preparing tea leaf extract; 2) Immobilization of alpha-amylase; 3) Incubating the tea extract and immobilized alpha-amylase together; 4) Removing compounds that are not bound to the alpha-amylase; 5) Releasing the target protein alpha-amylase binding substrate; 6) Screening and structure identification of the compound; 7) Compound inhibition alpha-amylase activity assay. The invention directly utilizes the tea extract and the alpha-amylase for incubation, screens the active compounds with the alpha-amylase inhibition capability, does not need the separation and purification steps of compound monomers in the tea, can screen the active compounds with stronger binding capability to the alpha-amylase directly while saving the workload, has the advantages of simple operation, high speed, high efficiency and low cost, and has wide application prospect in the field of screening and research of the active components of the tea.

title_en: Coating method of valproic acid immunochromatography detection card
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for coating a valproic acid immunochromatography detection card, and belongs to the field of in-vitro detection kits. The coating buffer solution used in the coating method of the invention is composed of saccharide substances and phosphate buffer solution as components; the concentration of the phosphate buffer solution is 0.1-0.25M, and the pH of the coating buffer solution is 7.0-9.0. The whole coating process of the coating method is simple to operate, the obtained coating film is suitable for developing a fluorescence immunochromatography valproic acid detection kit, the valproic acid can be quantitatively detected by adopting the detection kit, and the valproic acid detection method is simple and convenient to use, rapid in detection, high in sensitivity, wide in linear range, good in stability, accurate in result and controllable in cost. The method can realize the on-site quick detection of the sample, is little limited by instruments and sites, improves the clinical application of the valproic acid detection reagent of the fluorescence immunochromatography, and has good application prospect.

title_en: Method for improving content determination accuracy of malondialdehyde in biological sample
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for improving the accuracy of malondialdehyde content measurement in a biological sample, which comprises the steps of adding buffer solution, protease solution and thiobarbituric acid (TBA) into malondialdehyde standard solution, measuring the absorbance of the malondialdehyde standard solution, constructing a standard curve, and calculating the actual concentration of malondialdehyde in the biological sample through the measured absorbance of the biological sample solution. The method has the advantages that the sample treatment process is simple, the Buffer A Buffer solution and the protease can release MDA combined with protein, not only can avoid the adsorption interference and supernatant extraction limitation of protein precipitation on the red complex of MDA and TBA, but also can detect the MDA in a protein combined state, can obviously improve the detection limit of the sample, has good selectivity, improves the accuracy of the detection result, and can be used for trace detection of clinical precious samples.

title_en: Analysis method of gaseous molecular pollutants in clean factory
abstract_en: The invention discloses an analysis method of gaseous molecular pollutants in a clean factory, and relates to the technical field of gaseous molecular pollutant detection. The invention comprises the following steps: step S1: collecting gaseous molecular pollutant data in a clean room through a gas sensor; step S2: preprocessing gaseous molecular contaminant data; step S3: based on the preprocessed data and expert knowledge, calculating the prior probability before exceeding the standard; step S4: constructing a Bayesian analysis network based on an evolutionary algorithm, and adjusting a network structure to be optimal; step S5: and obtaining the cause of the out-of-standard gaseous molecular pollutants through a Bayesian analysis network. According to the invention, the prior probability before the occurrence of the exceeding standard is calculated by collecting the indoor gaseous molecular pollutant data, the cause of the exceeding standard gaseous molecular pollutant is obtained by constructing the Bayesian analysis network analysis based on the evolution algorithm, the purpose of accurate analysis is further realized, and the pollutant searching efficiency and timeliness are improved.

title_en: PH value determination method and application of sodium ion positive electrode material
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of sodium ion battery manufacturing, in particular to a pH value measuring method and application of a sodium ion positive electrode material. The method for measuring the pH value of the sodium ion positive electrode material comprises the following steps of uniformly mixing the sodium ion positive electrode material with an organic solvent, carrying out solid-liquid separation to obtain a mixed solution, measuring the pH value of the mixed solution to be the pH value of the sodium ion positive electrode material, and determining the pH value of the mixed solution to be the pH value of the sodium ion positive electrode material, wherein the organic solvent is ethylene glycol. According to the method for measuring the pH value of the sodium ion positive electrode material, disclosed by the invention, the organic solvent is utilized to dissolve the residual alkali on the surface of the sodium ion positive electrode material, and the residual alkali can not react with the sodium ion positive electrode material, namely, glycol can not cause precipitation of sodium ions in the sodium ion positive electrode material, so that the stability of the lattice structure of the sodium ion positive electrode material can be maintained, and the pH value of the sodium ion positive electrode material can be accurately measured.

title_en: Environment monitoring device and detection method for evaluating ground backfill of gangue
abstract_en: The invention discloses an environment monitoring device and a detection method for evaluating ground backfill of coal gangue, and belongs to the technical field of solid waste environment pollution monitoring. Aiming at the problems that the whole ground backfilling effect is difficult to predict, sampling is difficult, time and labor are consumed in the existing landfill process, the environment monitoring device provided by the invention has the advantages that the test cavity part comprises a test cavity and a sealing cover at the top, and the test cavity formed by the test cavity and the sealing cover at the top is a sealing cavity; the leaching collecting part comprises a leaching collecting port, a percolate collecting port and a filter screen; the side wall of the testing cavity is provided with a scale, a plurality of sampling ports and a liquid overflow port, the bottom is provided with a leaching collecting port and a percolate collecting port, a smoke analyzer and a thermocouple are connected with the sampling ports, and a gas output port arranged on the sealing cover is connected with a gas flowmeter. The device is simple in design, easy to process and easy to operate in the test process, the gangue hill can be guided to be reduced to further damage the ecological environment through prediction, and the ground backfill later-period environment monitoring cost is saved.

title_en: Detection kit, rapid detection method and application thereof in aflatoxin detection
abstract_en: The invention provides a detection kit, a rapid detection method and application thereof in detecting aflatoxin, wherein the detection kit comprises a microfluidic chip with a sample adding port, a first reagent, a second reagent, a magnetic particle cleaning solution and a luminescent substrate solution which are mutually and independently arranged in the microfluidic chip; the first reagent comprises magnetic particles coated with an antigen, the second reagent comprises an enzyme-labeled antibody, the luminescent substrate solution comprises a luminescent substrate and a substrate buffer, and the substrate buffer comprises bis (N-methylacridine) nitrate, 2-amino-2-methyl-1, 3-propanediol, 3-indoxyl disodium phosphate, 2-methyl-4-isothiazolin-3-one hydrochloride and chloroacetamide. The substrate of the invention is more stable, so that the shelf life of the kit can be prolonged. In addition, the kit has the advantages of simplicity and convenience in operation, high sensitivity, high accuracy, good repeatability, no reagent pollution, no waste and the like.

title_en: Bimodal immunoassay method for MC-LR toxin
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of microcystin detection, in particular to a bimodal immunodetection method of MC-LR toxin. Comprising the following steps: synthesizing MS@Au-Pt NZs, and connecting an A23-SBP recombinant antibody label to obtain NZs@Ab; mixing and incubating NZs@Ab and a solution to be tested containing MC-LR, magnetically separating, removing supernatant, and adding carbonate coating buffer solution for mixing; fixing MC-LR-BSA in a micro-porous plate, adding a mixed solution, incubating to obtain a compound combined by MC-LR and NZs@Ab on the micro-porous plate, and washing the micro-porous plate with a washing buffer solution; adding 3,3', 5' -tetramethyl benzidine and H  2  O  2  Developing the solution for 20-30 min, then adding a stop solution, and detecting absorbance; then AuNPs solution is added, and SERS signals are detected after incubation for 10-35 min. The method has the advantages of high detection sensitivity and good accuracy.

title_en: Chemiluminescent kit for detecting activity of nucleic acid cytosine deaminase APOBEC3B and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of chemiluminescent detection, and particularly relates to a chemiluminescent kit for detecting the activity of nucleic acid cytosine deaminase APOBEC3B and application thereof. The invention provides a single-stranded DNA, a chemiluminescent kit for detecting the activity of nucleic acid cytosine deaminase APOBEC3B, and a chemiluminescent kit for screening nucleic acid cytosine deaminase APOBEC3B inhibitor, wherein the chemiluminescent kit comprises the single-stranded DNA. The invention provides a single-stranded DNA and a kit for developing color by utilizing chemiluminescence, which can sensitively and stably detect the activity of APOBEC3B with different concentrations, can effectively avoid the quenching interference of a compound on traditional bioluminescence, prevent false positive detection, have convenient and quick detection method and lower cost, and can be suitable for high-throughput screening of APOBEC3B inhibitors.

title_en: Full life cycle-based carbon emission evaluation system for construction of traffic infrastructure
abstract_en: The invention provides a full life cycle-based carbon emission evaluation system for construction of a traffic infrastructure, which comprises an exhaust pipe, wherein the exhaust pipe comprises an exhaust pipe of an infrastructure material production factory and an automobile tail gas pipe, a carbon emission monitor is attached to the outer wall of the exhaust pipe, clamping frames are rotatably arranged at the upper end and the lower end of the carbon emission monitor through hinges, the carbon emission monitor is arranged on the exhaust pipe through the clamping frames, the exhaust pipe can be the exhaust pipe of the infrastructure material production factory or the automobile tail gas pipe, the exhaust gas is monitored and counted to obtain carbon emission, and when a vehicle for transporting materials cannot continue to run, a front ring, a cleaning layer and a rear ring of a protection assembly wrap a detection end, and the cleaning layer is driven to rotate by the driving of the rear ring to clean dust on the surface of the detection end, meanwhile, the relatively sealed detection end can not be influenced by external carbon emission, the carbon emission value is recorded in an accumulated mode, and the error of carbon emission statistics is reduced.

title_en: Method for preparing tear diluent
abstract_en: Disclosed is a method of preparing a tear diluent comprising the steps of: contacting the first absorbent sheet with the ocular surface to collect tear fluid, obtaining a first absorbent sheet at least partially saturated with tear fluid, wherein the first absorbent sheet at least partially saturated with tear fluid has a predetermined length of fully saturated portion or is fully saturated with tear fluid; and contacting a portion of the first absorbent sheet that is fully saturated for a predetermined length with a predetermined volume of the sample eluent for a predetermined time to obtain a tear diluent, or immersing the first absorbent sheet that is fully saturated with tear in the predetermined volume of the sample eluent to obtain a tear diluent. By using an absorbent material, a small volume of a tear sample can be stably collected, and a substance to be detected of the sample can be stably released after elution with a sample eluent.

title_en: Sample stage for detecting solid sample and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a sample stage for detecting a solid sample and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of component detection. Through setting up standard product integrated device, all be provided with a plurality of standard product installation position that are used for placing the standard product at a plurality of surfaces of sample integrated main part, can improve sample platform can hold the sample quantity of sample, and then improve detection efficiency, because the sample platform can hold the quantity increase of standard product, consequently can place the detection together with all samples, guaranteed the uniformity of testing result, the standard product is because in the device that detects always, detection device is mostly vacuum condition, consequently be difficult for receiving the influence of environment, the life of extension standard product.

title_en: Atmospheric measuring instrument with cradle head
abstract_en: The invention discloses an atmosphere measuring instrument with a holder, which comprises an atmosphere measuring instrument main body, wherein a gyroscope self-stabilizing holder is arranged at the bottom end of the atmosphere measuring instrument main body, a movable base is fixedly connected with the bottom end of the gyroscope self-stabilizing holder, the movable base can be an unmanned plane, an airplane, a balloon, a airship, a rocket, a ship, a vehicle and the like, the atmosphere measuring instrument main body is arranged in a combined structure of supporting rods, and a plurality of supporting rods are fixedly connected with the outer side wall of the movable base; the invention aims to provide an atmosphere measuring instrument with a holder, which can realize that when the angle and the position of an installation platform are changed due to the influence of the environment on the atmosphere measuring instrument main body, the changed angle and the changed position can be compensated by the stability-increasing holder of a gyroscope, so that the relative locking of a measuring instrument in a space is ensured, and the shaking and the movement of the atmosphere measuring instrument main body during the measurement are prevented, and even the data distortion caused by severe vibration causes larger errors of data.

title_en: Meconium diluent for detecting avian leukosis antigen and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a meconium diluent for detecting avian leukosis antigen and application thereof. The meconium diluent of the invention is prepared by using PBS as a base solution and adding a protein stabilizing composition, a surfactant and the like. In meconium collection, the virus protein P27 can be better exposed, and meanwhile, the liquid contains a protein stabilizer, so that the protein in the meconium is not easy to degrade in the freeze thawing process; when the leukemia virus general detection P27 protein kit is used for detection, the detection efficiency is improved.

title_en: Experimental device and testing method for hydrogen leakage explosion rule of hydrogen storage well
abstract_en: The invention discloses an experimental device for a hydrogen leakage explosion rule of a hydrogen storage well; the experimental device comprises: a transparent case; the hydrogen storage tank is arranged in the transparent box body and is used for simulating a hydrogen storage well; the hydrogen storage tank is provided with at least one leakage port; a simulated formation, which is filled with a filling material and formed between the side wall of the transparent box body and the hydrogen storage tank, for simulating the formation; wherein the filling material is a transparent filling material; the cladding plate seals the hydrogen storage tank and the simulated stratum in the transparent box body; a plurality of igniters distributed in the simulated formation; and the information acquisition mechanism is used for acquiring the change of the environment in the transparent box body before and after the igniter. The invention also provides a method for testing the hydrogen leakage explosion rule of the hydrogen storage well. The method fills the blank of the explosion behavior test caused by hydrogen leakage under the stratum condition in the prior art, and provides effective data support for the safety prevention measure technology of the hydrogen storage well.

title_en: Egg sterilization experimental device and method
abstract_en: The invention provides an egg sterilization experimental device and method, comprising two experimental boxes, wherein a cover is arranged on each experimental box, a plurality of clamping mechanisms are arranged on the inner side wall of each experimental box, each clamping mechanism is rotatably connected with a rotating mechanism, each clamping mechanism comprises a push rod, a plurality of grooves are formed in each push rod, the tail parts of the push rods are positioned outside the experimental boxes, the push rods penetrate through the experimental boxes and a fixed plate arranged on the inner side wall of each experimental box, a limiting frame is arranged on each fixed plate, the push rods penetrate through the middle parts of the limiting frames, the two experimental boxes are arranged to compare the effects of heating sterilization and radio frequency sterilization, eggs can be clamped by the clamping mechanisms, the outer surfaces of the eggs are exposed, the eggs are subjected to omnibearing heating or irradiation by the rotating mechanisms, the uniformity and the comprehensiveness of egg sterilization are maintained, and the accuracy of experimental results is improved.

title_en: Monoclonal antibody against estradiol, detection reagent based on monoclonal antibody and application of monoclonal antibody
abstract_en: The present invention relates to monoclonal antibodies or antigen binding fragments thereof directed against estradiol (E2), related nucleic acid products, cell products, detection reagents or kits, and methods of making and using the same. The monoclonal antibody or antigen binding fragment thereof can bind E2 with high specificity and high affinity, thereby improving the detection accuracy and sensitivity of E2; in addition, the invention also develops a high-performance paired antibody suitable for double-antibody sandwich method immunodetection, thereby breaking through the limitations of low sensitivity and poor clinical relevance of the traditional competitive method detection reagent, realizing the E2 double-antibody sandwich method immunodetection and having important significance for early diagnosis and treatment of ovarian diseases and domestic substitution of core antibody raw materials.

title_en: Hydraulic engineering encloses fender device with water quality testing function
abstract_en: The invention provides a hydraulic engineering enclosure device with a water quality detection function, which relates to the field of hydraulic enclosure, and comprises: a fixed structure; the fixed knot constructs the concatenation in the bottom that encloses fender device, and fixed knot constructs's top both sides are fixed with a mosaic structure respectively, and mosaic structure's both sides are equipped with a rectangular form structure's auxiliary tank respectively, and the inside in auxiliary tank can insert the round bar that is used as the key, and mosaic structure's outer end outside is equipped with L shape structure's agreeing with the groove. When enclosing fender device damage needs to be changed, the inside of auxiliary tank is inserted to the direct control round bar, and control round bar rebound, round bar promote cardboard subassembly slope, and the pulling encloses fender device and conveniently takes off the change, improves the convenience of changing, and can not destroy the concrete, improves maintenance efficiency, has solved common hydraulic engineering that has the water quality testing function and encloses fender device, encloses fender device damage or excessively ageing after, and it needs to destroy the concrete to change and encloses fender device, can increase use cost's problem.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and medium for judging solidification process of casting blank when exiting crystallizer
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of continuous casting, in particular to a method, a device, equipment and a medium for judging the solidification process of a casting blank when a crystallizer is arranged. The method comprises the steps of obtaining carbon content change of the continuous casting blank in the thickness direction, determining the thickness of a shell of the crystallizer according to the minimum value of the carbon content based on a flushing mechanism of electromagnetic stirring of the crystallizer on the solidification front, and determining the solidification process of the continuous casting blank according to the thickness of the shell. According to the invention, by analyzing the change rule of the carbon content of the continuous casting blank in the thickness direction and combining the flushing mechanism of the electromagnetic stirring of the crystallizer on the solidification front, the thickness of the blank shell in the process of the crystallizer is determined by the minimum value of the carbon content, and the method plays an important role in improving the continuous casting quality and optimizing the process. Meanwhile, compared with the problem of deviation caused by diffusion in the related art, the method improves the accuracy of thickness determination by determining the thickness of the shell through the carbon content and the change rule of the continuous casting billet.

title_en: Canine C reaction protein and glycocholic acid duplex detection reagent card and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a canine C reaction protein and glycocholic acid duplex detection reagent card, and a preparation method and application thereof. The duplex detection reagent card comprises a canine C reaction protein and glycocholic acid duplex immunochromatographic test strip, wherein the duplex immunochromatographic test strip comprises a sample pad, a marking pad, an analysis membrane and a water absorption pad which are sequentially connected, and two test lines and a quality control line are arranged on the analysis membrane. The invention creatively designs the duplex detection reagent card for simultaneously detecting the C-reactive protein and the glycocholic acid, which has high accuracy, strong specificity and high sensitivity, can simultaneously obtain the results of two items in a short time by only one sample adding, brings great convenience for clinical diagnosis, saves the cost for production and can eliminate the condition of lower C-reactive protein content caused by liver injury.

title_en: Biomarkers for Alzheimer's disease treatment
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are methods of diagnosing, selecting, monitoring, and treating a subject suffering from Alzheimer's Disease (AD) or suspected of suffering from AD or another disorder associated with amyloid accumulation in the brain.

title_en: Device and/or analysis apparatus with averaging function
abstract_en: An apparatus and/or analysis device having an averaging function. The device, in particular for analysing exhaust gases and/or fumes, comprises: a sensor unit and a housing having a first end and a second end, a plurality of inlet openings and at least one outlet opening; wherein the device additionally comprises a fastening mechanism on the first end of the housing for fastening the housing to a wall; wherein the first end is different from the second end and the at least one exit opening is different from each of the plurality of entrance openings; wherein the sensor unit is arranged inside the housing and has a first spacing from the first end and a second spacing from the second end; and wherein a first spacing of the sensor unit from the first end is greater than a second spacing of the sensor unit from the second end.

title_en: Airborne radionuclide14C transfer research method in crops
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for researching the transfer of airborne radionuclide  14  C in crops, which comprises the steps of establishing a sealed test cabin in a laboratory, releasing  14 CO 2  in the test cabin, concentrating  14 CO 2  released in the test cabin into plants through photosynthesis of the crops, and obtaining concentration factors of  14  C by spring wheat, lettuce and eggplant through detection of  14 CO 2  in the gas in the test cabin and  14  C in the plants. The invention has the advantages of radionuclide timing pollution, cost saving, uniform pollution range, waste gas collection, pollution prevention and the like. By implementing the invention, the working time of the staff can be effectively reduced, and the risk of the staff under irradiation is reduced. The invention has reliable technology and complete experimental flow, can comprehensively consider factors such as the difficulty of nuclide measurement in the experimental process, the experimental limit of a laboratory on certain nuclides and the like, and effectively reduces the period of the subject experiment.

title_en: Biomarker for predicting prognosis of intrahepatic duct cancer and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a biomarker for predicting prognosis of intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of biomedicine. The biomarker is TLR4. The study of the invention finds that TLR4 can be used as a biomarker for predicting prognosis of intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma, and the overall survival rate of high expression of TLR4 in cholangiocarcinoma tissues is obviously lower than that of TLR4 low expression groups. In addition, the invention also discovers that patients with intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma with high expression of TLR4 are found to have higher incidence of lymph node metastasis and higher metastasis number. Meanwhile, the invention also discovers that the expression level of the TLR4 has obvious correlation with vascular invasion and nerve invasion, and the statistical analysis discovers that the TLR4 can be used for predicting the vascular invasion and the nerve invasion, and the incidence rate of the vascular invasion and the nerve invasion of patients with the intrahepatic bile duct cancer with high expression of the TLR4 is obviously higher than that of the patients with low expression of the TLR4.

title_en: Method for evaluating catalytic action of coal ash component
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for evaluating the catalysis effect of coal ash components, which is to construct an evaluation index of each component of the ash components in coal on the dissolution loss catalysis effect of coke to obtain the mass fraction of each component of the ash components in coal, consider the ash distribution in the coal, establish a new catalysis index ARCI of the ash components, and combine with the volatile component V  daf  of the coal to construct a model to predict the coke reactivity index CRI. Compared with the existing catalytic indexes of other coal ash components, the method provided by the invention has the advantages that the consideration of the coal forming environment and the ash dispersion degree in coal is included, the influence of the coal ash components on the quality of the coke can be more comprehensively considered, and the influence of each component in the coal ash components on the coke in the dissolution loss reaction process is established.

title_en: Wisdom agricultural thing networking information acquisition management equipment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of intelligent agriculture, and particularly relates to intelligent agriculture Internet of things information acquisition and management equipment, which comprises an organism, a fixed plate and the like; the upper part of the machine body is fixedly connected with a fixing plate. According to the invention, the soil in vegetables is collected through the movement of the collecting pipe, so that the soil is analyzed in the later period to obtain the growth state information of the vegetables, the vegetable blades at corresponding positions are extruded through all the extruding plates, so that the vegetable blades are outwards expanded, the gap between the adjacent vegetable blades is increased, the mutual shielding among the vegetable blades is reduced, the growth information of the vegetable blades is collected through the two cameras, the comprehensiveness and the accuracy of the collected information are improved, the outwards extending and expanding range of all the connecting rods is changed along with the change of the moving position of the limiting cylinder, and the outwards extending and expanding range of the connecting rods can be adjusted by the limiting cylinder according to different growth conditions of the vegetables, so that the applicability is improved.

title_en: Groundwater pollution evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of water pollution detection, and provides a groundwater pollution evaluation method and system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring underground water pollution monitoring data, constructing an underground water pollution hysteresis coefficient according to hysteresis characteristics among monitoring data acquired by underground water pollution detection points, constructing a pollution monitoring characteristic synergistic coefficient according to the underground water pollution hysteresis coefficient and change characteristics of the monitoring data acquired among different underground water pollution detection points, dividing the underground water pollution detection points in the same underground water pollution detection area according to the pollution monitoring characteristic synergistic coefficient, acquiring pollution evaluation weights of each acquired monitoring data based on dividing results, and acquiring underground water pollution evaluation results according to the monitoring data acquired by the underground water pollution detection points and the pollution evaluation weights of each monitoring data. According to the application, the pollution evaluation weights of different monitoring data are constructed by analyzing the pollution monitoring characteristics among different groundwater pollution detection points, so that the accuracy of groundwater pollution evaluation is improved.

title_en: Specific antibody of IL18 protein and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an antigen binding protein, antibody or antibody active fragment obtained by immunizing a camelid with an IL18 protein. The invention screens, identifies and prepares the antibody which specifically recognizes and binds IL18 protein by means of the immune system of camelid, and the obtained antibody has strong specificity, can be used for target antigen detection, and has potential clinical diagnosis and treatment value; the antibody provided by the invention has the advantages of simple structure, easiness in genetic engineering transformation, easiness in humanization, high stability and low mass production cost, and is beneficial to realizing large-scale production.

title_en: Inspection method and mobile detection equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a patrol method and mobile detection equipment. The inspection method is used for inspection in workshops and comprises the following steps of S1: carrying a detection device by a patrol trolley to carry out patrol along a planned route; step S2: sampling air along the road section by the detection device to obtain detection data; step S3: the detection data is uploaded to a system server, so that the detection data is processed through the system server and presented to a PC end or a mobile equipment end in a report form, and the problem of heavy manual detection workload of the existing production workshop is solved.

title_en: Portable oil sludge measuring instrument
abstract_en: The invention discloses a portable oil sludge measuring instrument, in particular to the technical field of oil sludge measuring instruments, which comprises an oil sludge measuring instrument body, wherein a protective component is arranged at the bottom of the oil sludge measuring instrument body, a control grip is arranged at the bottom of the oil sludge measuring instrument body, a brace is arranged at the bottom of the control grip, two ends of the brace are adhered to the bottom end of the control grip, and the brace is made of nylon materials; the protection assembly comprises a connecting seat, wherein the connecting seat is welded at the bottom of the oil sludge measuring instrument body, a fixing screw is welded at the bottom of the connecting seat, and the bottom end of the fixing screw is welded with the top end of the control grip. The portable oil sludge measuring instrument is convenient to carry due to the protective component, achieves the protective effect on the oil sludge measuring instrument body while being portable, avoids the situation of collision damage in the carrying process, and can achieve the waterproof effect under the raining condition, so that the practical use effect of the portable oil sludge measuring instrument is good.

title_en: Method and device for detecting liquid water content in air by using hot wire moisture meter
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of detection of liquid water content in air, in particular to a method and a device for detecting the liquid water content in air by a hot wire water content meter. The method comprises the steps of obtaining first data related to a hot-wire moisture meter and second data related to a cloud particle probe, wherein the hot-wire moisture meter and the cloud particle probe are located on the same detection platform, establishing a data set of physical parameter changes along with time according to the first data and the second data, setting cloud entering standards, calculating liquid water content according to a liquid water content calculation formula, calculating liquid water content of each step according to the step type of the cloud particle probe, and selecting an optimal value of the liquid water content. The invention solves the problems of error superposition generated by multi-parameter combination calculation in a laboratory empirical formula and errors caused by manual operation in the prior art.

title_en: Biomarker for diagnosing sepsis and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biology and medical examination, and provides a neutrophil gelatinase related lipid carrier egg 2 or a combination of the neutrophil gelatinase related lipid carrier egg 2 and matrix Gla protein, which can be used as a protein marker for diagnosing sepsis, has high diagnosis efficiency, has a lower area of 0.903 of a curve and good sensitivity and specificity, is developed into a kit for diagnosing sepsis, and can diagnose sepsis early, so that patients can be treated timely and accurately.

title_en: Intelligent pesticide spraying equipment for agriculture and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of soil experiments, in particular to intelligent pesticide spraying equipment for agriculture and a using method thereof. The technical problems are as follows: the soil needs to be tested by configuring containers with different sizes, so that the soil is troublesome and the nutrient substances of the surface fertilizer are lost. The technical proposal is as follows: an intelligent pesticide spraying device for agriculture comprises a placing rack, a storage frame and the like; the placing rack is provided with a heater; a plurality of storage frames are arranged on the placement frame, and all the storage frames are formed by connecting a plurality of symmetrical frames. According to the invention, the range of pushing soil by the pushing frame connecting plate is increased through the cylinders, so that the stirring degree of the soil in the storage frame is increased, the thinning effect of the agglomerated soil is improved, the cylinders are distributed in a staggered manner, and when the cylinders push the soil, the pushing range of the cylinders is increased again, and the crushing effect of the cylinders on the agglomerated soil is improved.

title_en: Solid-state hydrogen storage leakage detection device
abstract_en: The invention provides a solid-state hydrogen storage leakage detection device. The solid-state hydrogen storage leakage detection device comprises a protection cylinder, wherein a bottom plate is arranged at the bottom of the protection cylinder, and the solid-state hydrogen storage leakage detection device is characterized in that a first detector is arranged on the side surface of the lower end of the protection cylinder, and a storage barrel is arranged in the protection cylinder. According to the invention, the detection rod is arranged at the right end of the first detector, the detection rod is electrically connected with the first detector, the right end of the detection rod penetrates through the protection cylinder and extends into the protection cylinder, the detection rod can be used for detecting the content of hydrogen in air, when solid hydrogen in the storage cylinder leaks, the leaked solid hydrogen can be converted into a gas state and can fill the inside of the protection cylinder, the hydrogen can pass through the through hole formed in the base and can fill the inside bottom space of the protection cylinder, at the moment, the detection rod detects that the content of the hydrogen in the air is increased, and then the first detector sends an alarm to equipment of an operator so as to remind the operator to overhaul.

title_en: Novel specific diagnostic and therapeutic markers for the antigen CD111 as polymorphonuclear myeloid derived suppressor cells (PMN-MDSCs)
abstract_en: The CD111 antigen serves as a novel specific diagnostic and therapeutic marker for polymorphonuclear myeloid derived suppressor cells (PMN-MDSCs). The present invention relates to methods for detecting polymorphonuclear myeloid-derived suppressor cells (PMN-MDSCs) in a biological sample by using the CD111 antigen as a marker for said cells and the use of said marker as an immunotherapeutic target.

title_en: Wheat quality evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a wheat quality evaluation method and a system, which relate to the technical field of wheat quality detection and specifically comprise the following steps: s1, collecting N groups of wheat field self parameters, wherein the wheat field self parameters comprise soil pH value SJ, soil organic matter content YH and soil humidity SD, collecting N groups of wheat self parameters, wherein the wheat self parameters comprise particle size KL and particle filling degree KC, and collecting N groups of wheat growth environment parameters, wherein the wheat growth environment parameters comprise daily average temperature WD, daily average precipitation JS and daily average sunlight time RZ. According to the invention, correlation analysis is carried out on the influence coefficient XS  MT  of the wheat field, the influence coefficient XS  HJ  of the growth environment of the wheat and the theoretical quality coefficient XS  LL  of the wheat, so that the actual quality coefficient XS  SJ  of the wheat is generated. Therefore, the related parameters affecting the quality of the wheat can be directly collected, so that the quality grade of the wheat can be evaluated, and the quality evaluation of the wheat is more comprehensive and accurate.

title_en: Characteristic polypeptide for identifying scorpion of strip-shaped plaque and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biology, and particularly relates to a characteristic polypeptide for identifying scorpions of strip-shaped plaque pincers and application thereof. The characteristic polypeptide of the buthus martensi karsch obtained by screening has excellent specificity and stability and strong specificity, can effectively identify whether buthus martensi karsch medicinal materials and preparations thereof are doped with the buthus martensi karsch or not, and has good application prospect; the characteristic polypeptide provided by the invention is applied to help ensure the quality of scorpion medicinal materials, decoction pieces and related medicines containing scorpions, strike illegal adulteration behaviors of illegal enterprises, ensure the medication safety of masses and have good social and economic benefits.

title_en: Dynamic experimental method and device for simulating co-migration of different colloids and nuclides
abstract_en: The invention relates to a dynamic experimental method for simulating co-migration of different colloids and nuclides, which comprises the following steps: separating and characterizing natural colloid of a target site; acquiring parameters of an undisturbed soil nuclide migration experiment; injecting a natural colloid sample for a nuclide migration tracing experiment, and adopting a device for simulating the co-migration dynamic experiment of different colloids and nuclides, wherein key migration parameters such as a deposition rate coefficient, a deposition desorption coefficient, a primary adsorption and desorption rate coefficient in a filtration curing process, a blocking coefficient and the like of the colloid are obtained by carrying out the migration behavior and the transmission mechanism experiment of the colloid in a porous medium by adopting the device for simulating the co-migration dynamic experiment of different colloids and nuclides, and considering the stability, the deposition and the deformation blocking processes of the colloid in the migration and the transmission processes of the colloid in the porous medium from four aspects of the particle size, the ionic strength, the concentration of the colloid and the injection flow rate.

title_en: Traffic road detection device and detection method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of traffic road detection, and discloses a traffic road detection device and a detection method thereof, wherein the traffic road detection device comprises a fixing frame, a bracket is fixedly connected to the surface of the fixing frame, a motor is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the bracket, and the traffic road detection device further comprises: the punching part comprises a rotating rod, the output end of the rotating rod is fixedly connected with a motor, the bottom of the rotating rod is fixedly connected with a cross rod, and the surface of the cross rod is slidably connected with a threaded rod. According to the invention, the motor is started to drive the stabilizing component to move downwards, the stabilizing component can be drilled into soil beside a road, so that the stabilizing component is utilized to support and fix the punching component, when the surface of the road is contacted with the extrusion component, the extrusion component can push the stabilizing component to shrink, so that the stabilizing component can be fixed in the soil, at the moment, the motor can drive the punching component to punch and sample and detect the traffic road, and the stability of the punching component in sampling and detection is improved by the stabilizing component.

title_en: Deodorizing system and deodorizing method in house
abstract_en: The invention provides a deodorizing system in a house, and relates to the technical field of cultivation deodorization. The in-house deodorizing system includes: the induced draft fan is arranged on a side wall body of the cultivation house; a spray pipe installed at the top of the cultivation house; the spray head is arranged on the spray pipeline; the liquid outlet of the liquid supply pump is communicated with the inlet of the spraying pipeline; the medicine storage box is internally stored with a deodorizing medicine, and a liquid inlet of the liquid supply pump is arranged in the medicine storage box; the detection assembly is arranged in the breeding house; and the first signal and the second output end of the controller are connected with the signal input ends of the induced draft fan and the liquid supply pump, and the signal input end of the controller is connected with the signal output end of the detection assembly. According to the invention, the spraying pipeline is arranged at the top of the cultivation house, so that the reaction time and the action space of the deodorant and the air in the cultivation house are increased, the deodorant and the air in the cultivation house are fully and uniformly mixed, and the deodorizing effect and deodorizing efficiency of the unit agent are improved. The invention also discloses a deodorizing method in the house.

title_en: Near infrared fluorescent probe and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a near infrared fluorescent probe and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the near infrared fluorescent probe comprises near infrared aggregation-induced emission nano particles PS@AIE  830  NP, the near infrared aggregation-induced emission nano particles are prepared by encapsulating near infrared aggregation-induced emission molecular solution AI E  830  into polystyrene nano particles, and the preparation method comprises the following steps of S1: near infrared aggregation-induced emission nanoparticle PS@AIE  830  NP, S2: the invention mainly uses near-infrared aggregation induced emission nano particles composed of PS nano particles and AIE  830  as fluorescent probes, can completely eliminate background interference such as strong absorption and high autofluorescence in complex samples, light scattering of NC films and the like, improves fluorescence quantum yield to 14.76%, can directly detect targets in complex samples, such as soy sauce AFB  1 , joint fluid Hla and C reaction protein in hemolytic samples, and improves detection accuracy and sensitivity in complex samples.

title_en: Microporous array and method for producing the same
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a microwell array and a method of making the same. Each microwell structural unit of the microwell array according to the present disclosure comprises: ASIC substrate, metal layer, passivation layer, dielectric layer, electrode layer and micropore layer. Micropores are formed that extend from the top of the microporous layer to the top of the electrode layer. In one implementation, the sidewalls of the microwells are, from top to bottom, a microwell layer and an electrode layer, respectively. Increasing the surface area of the exposed electrode layer in the micropores while maintaining the cross-sectional size of the micropores unchanged; or decreasing the cross-sectional size of the microwells while maintaining the surface area of the electrode layer exposed in the microwells unchanged. Thus, the voltage driving force and the chip integration level are improved.

title_en: Novel pollutant detection device for agriculture
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of agricultural detection, in particular to a novel agricultural pollutant detection device, which comprises a treatment tank, a motor fixedly arranged at the top end of the treatment tank, and a driving rod rotatably arranged between the top wall and the bottom wall of the treatment tank, wherein the end part of an output shaft of the motor is fixedly connected with the top end of the driving rod, and a driving mechanism for accelerating soil crushing is arranged in the treatment tank; the driving mechanism comprises a fixing frame fixedly arranged on the inner wall of the treatment tank, a filter screen is fixedly arranged on the fixing frame, and the bottom end of the driving rod is rotatably arranged on the fixing frame. According to the invention, by arranging the mechanisms such as the stirring rods, the sliding rods and the guide plates, a worker starts the motor after putting soil into the treatment tank, and the output shaft of the motor drives the driving rods to rotate, so that the stirring rods are driven to rotate, a plurality of stirring rods rotate in the treatment tank, the stirring rods drive the sliding rods to rotate above the filter screen, and the stirring rods and the soil on the second filter screen of the sliding rods are stirred.

title_en: Concrete quality detection device for hydraulic engineering
