abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of concrete quality testing, and discloses a concrete quality testing device for hydraulic engineering, which comprises a box body for accommodating components, a bottom plate arranged at the bottom of the box body and used for supporting, a control center for controlling the start and stop of each component, and an opening and closing door arranged on the front end surface of the box body, wherein the top of the bottom plate is electrically connected with the box body, and the box body further comprises: the device has the advantages that the device can simulate actual conditions only through one driving source when detecting the samples, the compressive strength data of the device can be detected according to the actual conditions, and the device can preprocess the detection surface of the concrete foundation column samples before detecting the compactness of the concrete foundation column samples, so that the detection effect of the device is improved.

title_en: Immune turbidimetry detection sensitizer
abstract_en: The invention provides an immune turbidimetry detection sensitizer/detection reagent containing cross-linked cyclodextrin, which can greatly improve the detection sensitivity of a target analyte to be tested, hardly improves detection noise, does not reduce specificity and has industrial application value.

title_en: Molecular marker and immunoassay kit related to prognosis of positive head and neck squamous cell carcinoma patient and application of molecular marker and immunoassay kit
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of biomedicine, and particularly relates to a molecular marker and an immunoassay kit related to prognosis of a positive head and neck squamous cell carcinoma patient and application thereof. A molecular marker related to prognosis of a positive head and neck squamous cell carcinoma patient, which is characterized in that a tumor immune infiltration factor LAYN is adopted as a biomarker for diagnosis, treatment and prognosis evaluation of the positive head and neck squamous cell carcinoma. The invention can realize the grading and stage development stage of the risk of the positive head and neck squamous cell carcinoma from the molecular level, rapidly and accurately detect and evaluate the prognosis of the positive head and neck squamous cell carcinoma, and effectively improve the sensitivity and specificity of the prognosis detection and evaluation of the positive head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.

title_en: Kit for detecting human Th1/Th2 cytokines
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of cytokine detection, in particular to a kit for detecting human Th1/Th2 cytokines. The kit can realize simultaneous detection of various human Th1/Th2 cytokines in single detection, is simple and convenient to operate, has short detection time and high flux, greatly improves detection efficiency, has higher specificity, sensitivity and stronger anti-interference capability, has accurate and reliable detection results, and has better application prospect in detection of human Th1/Th2 cytokines.

title_en: Preparation method of sulfur-doped selenide heterojunction nano-enzyme and application of sulfur-doped selenide heterojunction nano-enzyme in detection of acetylcholinesterase activity
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of sulfur-doped selenide heterojunction nano-enzyme and application thereof in acetylcholinesterase activity detection, comprising the following steps: preparing NiO-NS; preparing FeO-NS; dispersing the prepared NiO-NS and FeO-NS in water to obtain a solution A; dissolving H  4  DMBD in a mixed solvent to obtain a solution B; mixing the solution A with the solution B, and carrying out ultrasonic treatment, heating, centrifugation and washing to obtain Fe  x Ni y  DMBD-NS; and respectively placing the Fe  x Ni y  DMBD-NS and the selenium powder at two ends of a heating container, and performing Joule thermal shock to obtain the nano-enzyme. The nano-enzyme provided by the invention can solve the problems of time and energy consumption, lack of regulation on the active site of the heterojunction phase of the metal chalcogenide and low activity and stability of the catalyst in the traditional pyrolysis preparation method.

title_en: Application of PRKDC as lung cancer immunotherapy marker or drug target
abstract_en: The invention discloses application of PRKDC as a lung cancer immunotherapy marker or a drug target, and relates to the technical field of biological medicines. The predictive molecular marker applied to lung cancer immunotherapy or serving as a target screening combined therapeutic drug is specifically applied to: 1) The application of the compound as a therapeutic target in combined lung cancer immunotherapy; 2) The application of the recombinant DNA as a drug target in screening drugs for inhibiting PRKDC gene expression; 3) Lung cancer patients were evaluated as immunotherapeutic markers for their benefit from immunotherapy. The application of the PRKDC as the lung cancer immunotherapy marker or the drug target can be used for evaluating the benefit condition of a lung cancer patient from immunotherapy and screening drugs for inhibiting the expression of the PRKDC, and provides a new drug target and a combined therapy drug for treating lung cancer.

title_en: Small-producing-area wine identification method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of wine detection and discloses a wine identification method of a small-area, which comprises the following steps of collecting a grape sample, crushing, clarifying, taking juice, brewing wine from other grapes, measuring the contents of 45 mineral elements in the obtained grape juice and the grape wine sample, combining the grape juice with measured data of the grape wine, and establishing a data model by using linear discriminant analysis and a multi-layer perception-artificial neural network to identify the small-area of the grape wine. The invention makes clear the characteristics of the small-area, makes up the data of the grape and the grape wine in the Diqing high-altitude area, and improves the accuracy of identifying the grape wine in the small-area.

title_en: Slope deformation damage evaluation method and system considering soil porosity space variability
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of geotechnical engineering, and particularly relates to a slope deformation damage evaluation method and system considering soil body porosity space variability, which can fully reflect the influence of soil body space variability on large-scale slope instability. The slope deformation damage evaluation method considering the space variability of the soil body porosity comprises the following steps: step 1, determining statistical characteristics of soil parameters of a target site, wherein random characteristics in the statistical characteristics at least comprise: marginal distribution of porosity, coefficient of variation, fluctuation range; step 2, constructing a soil slope space variation model based on the step 1, generating N groups of random field data corresponding to the porosity e, and further obtaining N groups of input data; step 3, inputting the input data obtained in the step 2 into a random simulation framework based on a statistical simulation method to simulate until convergence, so as to obtain serial simulation data; and 4, carrying out probability analysis on the simulation data so as to obtain a series of results of landslide instability behaviors under different spatial variation levels.

title_en: Circulation material loading catalyst reaction detection device based on continuous flow
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of catalyst reaction detection, in particular to a circulating feeding catalyst reaction detection device based on continuous flow, which comprises a reaction box, wherein a mixing mechanism, a crushing mechanism and a conveying mechanism are arranged on the reaction box, the mixing mechanism comprises a reaction cavity, the reaction cavity is arranged in the reaction box, and a rotating rod is rotationally connected in the reaction cavity. According to the invention, when the rotating shaft rotates, the first bevel gear fixedly sleeved on the outer wall of the rotating shaft is driven to rotate, and then the second bevel gear meshed with the first bevel gear is driven to rotate, so that the rotating rod fixedly sleeved on the inner wall of the second bevel gear is driven to rotate, the stirring rod fixedly installed on the outer wall of the rotating rod and the scraping plate are driven to rotate, the stirring rod can mix reaction materials with a catalyst, the reaction rate is improved, and the scraping plate can scrape the reaction materials attached to the inner wall of the reaction cavity, so that the reaction cavity is convenient to clean subsequently.

title_en: Tobacco leaf baking stage detection method, medium and system based on gas sensor
abstract_en: The invention provides a tobacco leaf baking stage detection method, medium and system based on a gas sensor, belonging to the technical field of tobacco leaf baking, comprising the following steps: a pre-heating gas sensor array; the method comprises the steps of conveying dry tobacco leaf gas to an air chamber through a first drying pipe and a two-position three-way electromagnetic valve to enable a gas sensor array to respond to the tobacco leaf gas, pumping the tobacco leaf gas in a bulk curing barn through an air pump, enabling the tobacco leaf gas to enter the air chamber through the first drying pipe, the two-position three-way electromagnetic valve and a rotor flowmeter to monitor the flow rate of the gas entering the air chamber, transmitting response signals of the gas sensor array to the tobacco leaf gas to a storage module and a PC (personal computer) through a communication module, writing sensor response signals into an SD (secure digital) card through the storage module, conveying clean air to the air chamber through a second drying pipe and the two-position three-way electromagnetic valve to clean the gas sensor array, inputting the tobacco leaf gas response signals into a pre-trained tobacco leaf curing stage detection model to obtain corresponding tobacco leaf curing stages and outputting the corresponding tobacco leaf curing stages.

title_en: Automatic water tank liner cleaning, disinfecting and filling system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic water tank liner cleaning, sterilizing and filling system and method, and relates to the technical field of intelligent drinking water. The method for cleaning, disinfecting and filling the water tank liner monitors the pollution degree of the water tank in the circulation process of automatic water selling in real time, prevents the pollution of the water tank, and can carry out the traceability monitoring and management of the polluted water tank; the return water tank is cleaned and disinfected, the water quality in the cleaning process is monitored in real time, the water tank is ensured to be cleaned, and meanwhile, the water tank is monitored in real time in the filling process, so that the safety of the filling water quality is ensured.

title_en: Anti-pollution electrochemical sensor based on double-network hydrogel and preparation and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an anti-pollution electrochemical sensor based on double-network hydrogel and preparation and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of chemical sensors. According to the invention, firstly, the micron-sized chitosan hydrogel is prepared, then an aptamer chain and a DNA chain are added, a nano-sized DNA hydrogel structure is added into the micron-sized chitosan hydrogel, and finally, the anti-pollution electrochemical sensor based on the double-network hydrogel with the ultra-large specific surface area is constructed. Experimental results show that the anti-pollution electrochemical sensor based on the double-network hydrogel constructed by the invention has a wide linear range, low detection limit and good selectivity for ATP detection, particularly has excellent accuracy, and can ensure that the electrochemical sensor is not interfered in a complex serum environment.

title_en: Big data supported traffic carbon emission monitoring method and monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of carbon emission monitoring, and discloses a large data supported traffic carbon emission monitoring method and a monitoring system.

title_en: Water affair water quality detection early warning device and use method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water quality detection early warning device and a use method thereof, wherein the water quality detection early warning device comprises an outer pipe body and an inner pipe body, two ends of the outer pipe body and two ends of the inner pipe body are connected into a whole through annular plates, an annular cavity is formed among the outer pipe body, the inner pipe body and the two annular plates, piston mechanisms which are used for changing the detection depth of the water quality detection early warning device and switching the water quality detection early warning device from a horizontal state to a vertical state are symmetrically arranged in the annular cavity, two air cavities and a detection cavity positioned between the two air cavities are formed in the annular cavity through the two piston mechanisms, the detection cavity is communicated with the inner part of the inner pipe body, and at least one detection probe used for detecting water quality is fixedly arranged in the detection cavity.

title_en: Molecular semiconductor material conformation detection method and spin life detection device
abstract_en: The invention provides a molecular semiconductor material conformation detection method and a spin life detection device, wherein the molecular semiconductor material conformation detection method comprises the steps of regulating and controlling different conformations of a molecular semiconductor film and preparing the spin life detection device based on the different conformations; detecting the spin life of the molecular semiconductor layer by using a spin life detection device; by utilizing the relation between the conformation of the molecular semiconductor layer and the spin life of the molecular semiconductor layer, different conformations in the molecular semiconductor layer are detected, the research blank that the conformation in the current molecular semiconductor material film cannot be detected is filled, and the academic and application development of the crossing front research field of organic spintronics and electronics are promoted.

title_en: Water supply network water quality monitoring analysis equipment and analysis processing system thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses water quality monitoring and analyzing equipment for a water supply network and an analyzing and processing system thereof, which comprise a box body, wherein a monitor is arranged in the box body, an alarm is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the box body, and a floating base is fixedly connected to the lower surface of the box body. This water supply network water quality monitoring analysis equipment and analysis processing system thereof, the user can start the motor, drive the pivot and rotate, and drive the monitor through the threaded rod and carry out vertical movement, when the monitor is at the in-process of removing, can synchronous drive the sampler and move down, it is inside to stretch out the box through the butt joint hole, sample detection through sampling module, but start the motor through power module, make sampling module sample detection, and carry out the analysis through analysis module to the sample, and pass through communication module with data transmission to alarm module inside, when quality of water has problems, the alarm starts, so that the staff knows the testing result.

title_en: Monoclonal antibody of conserved epitope peptide of anti-A group streptococcus M protein and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biomedicine, and particularly discloses a monoclonal antibody of an anti-A-group streptococcus M protein conserved epitope peptide, which has heavy chain CDR1-3 of sequences shown in SEQ ID NO.2, 3 and 4 and light chain CDR1-3 of sequences shown in SEQ ID NO.6, LAS and SEQ ID NO. 7. The colloidal gold detection method prepared by using the monoclonal antibody has high sensitivity, the minimum detection limit reaches 8 multiplied by 10  3  CFU/mL, and common serotypes M1, M3, M5, M6, M12, M18 and M24 of streptococcus A in China can be detected; and has high specificity, and has no cross reaction with common respiratory pathogens causing similar symptoms including group B streptococcus, group C streptococcus, group D streptococcus, streptococcus pneumoniae, influenza A virus, influenza B virus, mycoplasma pneumoniae, chlamydia pneumoniae and respiratory syncytial virus.

title_en: Water environment assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water environment assessment method and a system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring first water area data of a target water environment area and second water area data of a plurality of adjacent nearby water environment areas; the first water area data and the second water area data are respectively sent to a plurality of evaluation terminals to be evaluated to obtain corresponding water area evaluation results; calculating a regional assessment result of the target water environment region according to the water area assessment result of each assessment end on the first water area data; and correcting the regional assessment result according to the water area assessment result corresponding to the second water area data to obtain a corrected assessment result. Therefore, the method can effectively improve the efficiency and accuracy of water environment assessment, and brings more scientific and intelligent assessment results for ecological assessment.

title_en: Groundwater quality maintenance capability restoration method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a groundwater quality maintenance capability restoration method, which comprises the steps of firstly comprehensively evaluating the groundwater to be restored according to tolerance capability and restoration capability of the groundwater to be restored, thereby quantifying the groundwater to be restored in a data manner, and selecting a proper means according to the size of the maintenance capability to restore the groundwater. The invention has the beneficial effects that: compared with the prior art that the method directly carries out simple and rough restoration on the groundwater, the method plays the advantages of combining natural and artificial systems, and forms a complete groundwater quality maintenance capability restoration system.

title_en: Tap water quality detection micro-nano sensor, preparation method and detection method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a tap water quality detection micro-nano sensor, a preparation method and a detection method, wherein the tap water quality detection micro-nano sensor comprises a substrate, wherein a residual chlorine test electrode, a pH test electrode, a conductivity test electrode, a chemical oxygen demand test electrode, a temperature test electrode, a reference electrode and a flow rate test and temperature compensation module are laid on the front surface of the substrate, the reference electrode is used as the residual chlorine test electrode and the pH test electrode to provide reference potential, the flow rate test and temperature compensation module is used for temperature compensation and flow rate test, and a turbidity test electrode is laid on the back surface of the substrate; the preparation method and the detection method are a manufacturing method of the sensor and a method for detecting water quality by using the sensor; the invention can solve the problems that each parameter can cross interference on detection accuracy, and meanwhile, the temperature and the flow rate can obviously influence the test result, and the like, and has accurate detection result and good use value.

title_en: Upper gastrointestinal hemorrhage detection kit based on G4 chain body and heme catalytic activity
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of bleeding detection kits, and discloses an upper gastrointestinal bleeding detection kit based on G4 chain and heme catalytic activity, which comprises the following components: the sampling device consists of a sampling tube and a sampling bottle, wherein the sampling bottle contains Tris-EDTA buffer solution; the detection device comprises a detection reagent, a reaction cup, a positive quality control reagent and a semi-quantitative detection colorimetric card. The invention provides an upper gastrointestinal tract bleeding detection kit based on the G4 chain body and heme catalytic activity based on the HRP-like catalytic activity of the G4 chain body/heme complex, which can solve the problem of low result reliability caused by the lack of the existing upper gastrointestinal tract bleeding detection method and more interference factors of the alternative method clinically.

title_en: Photodynamic sterilization inspection system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of food processing, and discloses a photodynamic sterilization inspection system and method, wherein the inspection method comprises the following steps: detecting physicochemical indexes of the food powder to obtain initial data; determining the type and content of microorganisms, selecting a photosensitizer and controlling the usage amount; monitoring parameters of a sterilization process, and adjusting illumination intensity and time of photodynamic sterilization; measuring physical and chemical indexes and microorganism content after sterilization, and evaluating the sterilization effect; wherein the photosensitizer comprises porphyrin sensitizer, azo sensitizer and hydroxy phenyl acrylate sensitizer. The invention not only improves the sterilization effect and efficiency of the food powder and reduces the sterilization cost, but also provides powerful support for the industrial application of photodynamic sterilization, and has important practical application value and wide market prospect.

title_en: CO is absorbed to concentrated salt waste water2Evaluation method and device of (a)
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for evaluating CO  2  absorption of concentrated salt wastewater, wherein the measurement method comprises the following steps: s1, preparing concentrated salt wastewater and ammonia water into a waste salt ammonia solution, and placing the waste salt ammonia solution into a gas-liquid reactor; s2, introducing CO  2  gas into a gas-liquid reactor, contacting and reacting with a waste ammonia salt solution, and discharging redundant CO  2  gas after drying treatment; s3, measuring the inlet flow and the outlet flow of the CO  2  gas in the step S2 in real time, and calculating the absorption capacity of the concentrated salt wastewater to the CO  2  according to the measured inlet flow and outlet flow of the CO  2  gas after the reaction is finished. The invention has simple structure and easy operation, accurately judges the balance state of the concentrated salt wastewater for absorbing carbon dioxide by measuring the inlet flow and the outlet flow of the CO  2 , and can accurately acquire the absorption performance of the concentrated salt wastewater on the CO  2  so as to make up for the defects of the existing method for measuring the carbon dioxide absorption performance.

title_en: Flexible circuit board surface coating quality detection method based on image recognition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flexible circuit board surface coating quality detection method based on image recognition, which relates to the technical field of image processing and comprises the following steps: scanning the surface of the flexible circuit board by using a high-resolution scanner; performing image preprocessing and gray level calculation on the surface coating image; calculating a defect threshold of the coating image to be processed; marking a defect area in the coating image to be processed; performing edge tracking processing on the marked defect area; calculating characteristic parameters of edge information of the defect area; determining the defect reason of each defect area by using a binary tree classification method; calculating the safety coefficient of the flexible circuit board; judging whether the safety coefficient of the flexible circuit board is higher than a set safety threshold value. The defect cause of each defect area is determined by calculating the characteristic parameters of the defect area and utilizing a binary tree classification method, so that the problem that various defects cannot be detected simultaneously by a common detection technology is solved.

title_en: Aptamer and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nucleic acid aptamer, a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of preparation of nucleic acid aptamers, wherein the nucleic acid aptamer comprises an aptamer and a blocking nucleic acid; the core matching nucleic acid is obtained by adding a modification section on the basis of the core matching nucleic acid, the sequence of the core matching nucleic acid is shown as SEQ ID No.1, the matching nucleic acid and the blocking nucleic acid form the nucleic acid aptamer through hybridization, wherein the matching nucleic acid is shown as SEQ ID No.2, the blocking nucleic acid is shown as SEQ ID No.3, and the nucleic acid aptamer has high affinity with the breeding mycobacterium tuberculosis, namely high dissociation constant with EC protein, high sensitivity, strong specificity and low cost, and is suitable for first-line popularization and application.

title_en: Method for establishing diffusion cell performance verification program
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for establishing a diffusion cell performance verification program, which comprises the steps of determining diffusion cells, preparation tools and experimental conditions, measuring the leaking groove conditions of standard substances, performing a release test to determine the sampling time of the diffusion cell performance verification program, selecting a data set in the corresponding time of the leaking groove conditions, determining the diffusion cell performance verification standard, establishing the diffusion cell performance verification program, calculating the slope of a release curve through the diffusion cell performance verification program, and judging whether the performance of the diffusion cell to be tested is qualified according to whether the slope of the release curve is within the limit range. According to the invention, a diffusion cell performance verification program with distinguishing force and sensitivity can be established, evaluation standards are determined, consistency and comparability of verification results are ensured when different laboratories or different researchers verify, and the performance verification process of the diffusion cell is more standardized and standardized.

title_en: Biomarkers for predicting atopic dermatitis
abstract_en: A method of predicting a predisposition of an individual to develop atopic dermatitis is disclosed. The methods involving the use of biomarkers may also be used to evaluate the efficacy of a composition in treating atopic dermatitis. These markers include hBD1, IL1RA, IL36g, and S100A8/9, various skin microbial species, and total amino acid content.

title_en: Urban sewage intelligent detection method based on multidimensional analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent urban sewage detection method based on multidimensional analysis, which relates to the technical field of sewage detection and comprises the steps of collecting sewage flow characteristic parameters, collecting urban activity characteristic parameters, carrying out fusion distribution analysis according to the sewage flow characteristic parameters and the urban activity characteristic parameters to obtain fusion pollutant distribution information, carrying out sewage sampling to obtain a sewage sample sequence, carrying out sewage component prediction to obtain a sewage component prediction result, obtaining a plurality of pollutant detection schemes according to the sewage component prediction result, detecting a first sewage sample to obtain a first detection result and first detection suitability information, obtaining a sewage detection result sequence and a detection scheme set sequence, and analyzing to obtain a sewage detection result. The invention solves the technical problems that the detection efficiency is low and the real condition of the content of pollutants in urban sewage cannot be accurately reflected when the detection of the sewage components is carried out in the prior art, and achieves the technical effects of improving the detection efficiency of the sewage and the detection accuracy of the content of the pollutants.

title_en: Automatic detection method and device for flocculant content in machine-made sand
abstract_en: The invention relates to an automatic detection method and device for flocculant content in machine-made sand, which are characterized in that the turbidity parameter, viscosity parameter and image parameter of machine-made sand mixed liquor are combined, the flocculant content is detected by means of a machine-made sand mixed liquor image parameter image recognition model and a flocculant content neural network model instead of manual work, and the difference of the turbidity parameter, viscosity parameter and image parameter of the machine-made sand mixed liquor caused by different mud content and stone powder content in the machine-made sand is screened from model input parameters, and the flocculant content is directly output. The automatic detection method can further improve the accuracy and efficiency of detection.

title_en: Self-healing performance test method for steel slag regenerated asphalt mixture
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of steel slag reclaimed asphalt mixtures, and discloses a steel slag reclaimed asphalt mixture self-healing performance test method, which comprises the following test steps: 1) Providing a Marshall sample prepared from a steel slag reclaimed asphalt mixture, wherein a notch groove is formed in the middle of the Marshall sample; 2) Placing the Marshall sample on a test bench, and forming cracks in the Marshall sample by impact; 3) Heating the Marshall sample, and healing cracks; 4) Evaluating the healing performance of the Marshall sample according to the healing index; forming the notch groove in the formed Marshall sample, placing the Marshall sample on a test bench for impact, forming cracks in the Marshall sample, heating the Marshall sample to enable the cracks to heal, evaluating the healing performance of the Marshall sample through a healing index, and the whole test is simple and convenient to operate, low in cost and high in test efficiency.

title_en: ELISA kit for detecting RPL30 antibody and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of medical detection, and particularly relates to application of an autoimmune disease marker in preparation of a detection reagent or a detection kit for diagnosis of autoimmune diseases, wherein the autoimmune disease marker is an RPL30 antibody, and the invention also provides an ELISA kit for detecting the RPL30 antibody, and the ELISA detection kit for the RPL30 antibody can effectively assist in solving the problems of limited means, poor effect and other limitations of the autoimmune disease diagnosis of primary cholangitis and the like, and has important significance for early diagnosis, treatment and curative effect judgment of primary cholangitis patients.

title_en: Application of SESN1 recombinant protein in intervention of primate skeletal muscle aging
abstract_en: The invention discloses an application of SESN1 recombinant protein in intervening primate skeletal muscle aging. The invention provides application of a substance for increasing the expression level of SESN1 of skeletal muscle cells in any one of the following: preparing a product for treating diseases caused by skeletal muscle aging or atrophy, or preparing a product for delaying skeletal muscle cell aging; or preparing a product for treating diseases caused by skeletal muscle injury; SESN1 can be used as a marker to distinguish aged skeletal muscle and young skeletal muscle of primates, can distinguish the aging degree of organisms to which serum or plasma or other body fluids belong, and can evaluate and use recombinant proteins to intervene in skeletal muscle aging-related diseases. SESN1 plays an important role in screening and identifying skeletal muscle cells, and particularly provides important molecular indicators for human skeletal muscle function assessment and disease diagnosis, and has important application value.

title_en: Aptamer combined with FOXJ1 protein and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nucleic acid aptamer combined with FOXJ1 protein and application thereof, wherein the nucleic acid aptamer has nucleotide sequences shown as SEQ ID NO.1 and SEQ ID NO. 2; or a nucleotide sequence having at least 30% homology with SEQ ID NO.1, SEQ ID NO.2 and binding to the FOXJ1 protein; or has an RNA sequence transcribed from the nucleotide sequence shown as SEQ ID NO.1, SEQ ID NO. 2. The nucleic acid aptamer has the advantages of relatively stable and simple structure, easy modification, capability of being artificially synthesized in a short period, stable chemical property, easy preservation and marking; can be used for detection, diagnosis, imaging, treatment and other aspects, and has wide application prospect.

title_en: Marker, kit and medicine for diagnosis, differential diagnosis and prognosis evaluation of cerebral apoplexy
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of cerebral apoplexy diagnosis and evaluation, and particularly relates to a marker, a kit and a medicament for diagnosing, differential diagnosing and prognosis evaluating cerebral apoplexy. The invention discovers that the expression of the ninjurin1 in the cerebral apoplexy patients is obviously higher than that of healthy controls, and the expression level of the ninjurin1 is positively correlated with the disease degree of the cerebral apoplexy. The marker for cerebral apoplexy can be used as a detection target molecule of cerebral apoplexy diagnosis and differential diagnosis reagent, and is applied to diagnosis, curative effect observation and prognosis evaluation of cerebral apoplexy patients. Can improve the diagnosis and treatment level of cerebral apoplexy, and is suitable for clinical popularization and application.

title_en: River water quality online detection method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, in particular to a river water quality online detection method and system, comprising the following steps: acquiring the influence degree of rainfall on the content data of each suspended matter; obtaining an abnormal upper limit and an abnormal lower limit of the box diagram according to the influence degree of rainfall influence of the content data of each suspended matter; obtaining an abnormal upper limit and an abnormal lower limit of the final adjusted box diagram according to the abnormal upper limit and the abnormal lower limit of the box diagram and the upper quartile and the lower quartile of the box diagram corresponding to all suspended matter content data; and obtaining river water quality detection results according to the abnormal upper limit and the abnormal lower limit of the finally adjusted box diagram and the content data of each abnormal suspended matter. According to the method, the influence relation between the expansion degree of the upper limit and the lower limit of the box diagram in the historical data and the ratio of the water quality data influenced by rainfall in the box diagram is analyzed, so that the abnormal analysis speed of the river water quality data can be effectively improved.

title_en: River water quality online detection method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, in particular to a river water quality online detection method and system, comprising the following steps: acquiring the influence degree of rainfall on the content data of each suspended matter; obtaining an abnormal upper limit and an abnormal lower limit of the box diagram according to the influence degree of rainfall influence of the content data of each suspended matter; obtaining an abnormal upper limit and an abnormal lower limit of the final adjusted box diagram according to the abnormal upper limit and the abnormal lower limit of the box diagram and the upper quartile and the lower quartile of the box diagram corresponding to all suspended matter content data; and obtaining river water quality detection results according to the abnormal upper limit and the abnormal lower limit of the finally adjusted box diagram and the content data of each abnormal suspended matter. According to the method, the influence relation between the expansion degree of the upper limit and the lower limit of the box diagram in the historical data and the ratio of the water quality data influenced by rainfall in the box diagram is analyzed, so that the abnormal analysis speed of the river water quality data can be effectively improved.

title_en: Neutrophil gelatinase-associated lipocalin antibody, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a neutrophil gelatinase-associated lipocalin antibody, and a preparation method and application thereof. The method comprises the steps of (1) constructing recombinant neutrophil gelatinase related lipocalin antigen, (2) obtaining monomer and dimer of the neutrophil gelatinase related lipocalin antigen, (3) immunizing mice, (4) constructing phage single-chain antibody library, and (5) enriching and screening. The invention utilizes antibody genetic engineering technology and phage display technology to construct phage single-chain antibody library, screens out ScFv of neutrophil gelatinase related lipocalin antibody, has high specificity and sensibility, can specifically recognize the antigen of neutrophil gelatinase related lipocalin antibody, is suitable for immunological detection, especially immunohistochemical detection, and provides theoretical basis and material basis for establishing immunological rapid detection of neutrophil gelatinase related lipocalin antibody in later period.

title_en: Multidimensional performance test system suitable for semiconductor material processing
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of performance testing of semiconductor materials, relates to a data analysis technology, and aims to solve the problem that in the prior art, a test treatment measure cannot be dynamically analyzed according to a staged test result, so that the test efficiency cannot be optimized; the component evaluation module and the centralized analysis module are all in communication connection with the performance test module; the invention can analyze the component evaluation time according to the set mark judgment logic, evaluate the overall performance state of the whole test component according to the test result of the tested object at proper time, and improve the performance test efficiency of the semiconductor material by adopting a dynamic test analysis mode.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted front car lamp and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of lamps, in particular to a vehicle-mounted front lamp and a control method thereof, the vehicle-mounted front lamp comprises a rear lamp cover and a reflecting shade arranged on the rear lamp cover, the rear lamp cover also comprises a mounting groove, the mounting groove is used for mounting a lamp holder, and a through groove for allowing the tail end of the reflecting shade to pass through is formed in the inner wall of the mounting groove.

title_en: Atmospheric pollution monitoring and early warning device and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an atmospheric pollution monitoring and early warning device and a use method thereof, and relates to the technical field of monitoring equipment. The device comprises a mounting plate and a mounting rod fixedly mounted on one side of the mounting plate, wherein a collecting sleeve is arranged at the upper part of one end of the mounting rod, a monitoring mechanism is arranged in the collecting sleeve, a mounting mechanism for equipment installation is arranged on the other side of the mounting plate, the mounting mechanism comprises an operating cavity arranged in the mounting plate, a transmission sliding rod is slidably mounted in the operating cavity, and one end of the transmission sliding rod is slidably extended to the outside of the mounting plate and provided with a fastening bent pipe. According to the invention, through the arrangement of the mounting mechanism, the mounting between the mounting bracket and the fixing rod is realized, and compared with a transmission mounting mode, the mounting work can be realized only by rotating the winding roller, so that the mounting step is greatly reduced, and meanwhile, the position of the mounting bracket is not required to be adjusted when a worker fastens a nut, so that the protection force on the worker is improved to a certain extent.

title_en: Kit for HER-2 negative reagent type breast cancer auxiliary chemotherapy
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kit for auxiliary chemotherapy of HER-2 negative breast cancer, and relates to the technical field of breast cancer chemotherapy, comprising a box body and a supporting plate, wherein the supporting plate is positioned in the box body and is in sliding connection with the box body; the support assemblies are transversely arranged in the support plate at intervals, each support assembly further comprises a support plate rotationally connected with the support plate, a placing groove with an upward opening is formed in the support plate, and the placing groove is detachably connected with a test tube; the plugging components are transversely arranged at the upper end of the supporting plate at intervals and correspond to the supporting components one by one; the invention can improve the accuracy of the detection result.

title_en: Metabolites for detecting intestinal bacterial activity and uses, systems and methods thereof
abstract_en: The present description provides a set of metabolites and uses thereof for detecting the activity of intestinal bacteria in a subject. Methods for detecting the activity of intestinal bacteria are also provided. The method comprises the following steps: detecting an abundance of one or more target metabolites from the blood sample, the target metabolites including the metabolites in table 1; inputting the abundance into a fitting model to obtain a fitting value; and assigning the fit value as an activity of the intestinal bacteria. Kits for detecting the activity of intestinal bacteria are also provided.

title_en: Smoke monitoring method based on MEMS multichannel intelligent gas sensor and related equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a smoke monitoring method based on an MEMS multichannel intelligent gas sensor, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps that smoke in a target environment area is monitored in real time through a plurality of MEMS multichannel intelligent gas sensors, and smoke information is obtained; extracting smoke characteristics of the smoke information through a wavelet transformation technology to obtain smoke dynamic characteristics; carrying out density statistics calculation on the smoke dynamic characteristics to obtain a smoke density distribution area; dynamically drawing the smoke density distribution area based on the smoke dynamic characteristics to generate a dynamic smoke density distribution thermodynamic diagram; carrying out risk trend prediction based on the smoke concentration distribution thermodynamic diagram to obtain a risk prediction result; if the risk prediction result exceeds the preset risk range, early warning occurs, and the technical problems that the traditional method mostly depends on simple threshold judgment, dynamic changes of smoke cannot be effectively recognized, the monitoring result is inaccurate, and the trend of fire development is difficult to predict are solved.

title_en: Staphylococcus aureus double-recognition artificial antibody, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a staphylococcus aureus double-recognition artificial antibody, a preparation method and application thereof, the surface of the double-recognition artificial antibody contains imprinting holes matched with the shape and the size of target bacteria, and the imprinting holes contain glycopeptide antibiotics capable of recognizing peptidoglycan. The preparation method comprises the steps of firstly modifying glycopeptide antibiotics on the surface of a matrix material, then sequentially adding staphylococcus aureus (Staphylococcus aureus, SA) and a functional monomer, and then carrying out polymerization reaction, and removing SA from a polymerization product after the reaction is finished, so that the SA double-recognition artificial antibody can be obtained. The artificial antibody prepared by the invention can double identify the morphology of SA and cell wall peptidoglycan, has the characteristics of high affinity and strong specificity, and can be used for high-efficiency adsorption separation of trace SA in foods and biological samples.

title_en: Gene for treating AKT/mTOR signaling pathway related diseases
abstract_en: The invention discloses genes for treating diseases associated with AKT/mTOR signaling pathway. Experiments prove that FAM64A promotes proliferation, invasion, lipid drop formation and chemotherapy resistance of colorectal cancer through an Akt/mTOR signal pathway. Upregulation of FAM64A expression is closely related to the occurrence and subsequent progression of colorectal cancer. Its abnormal expression can be used as an indicator of colorectal cancer invasion behavior and poor prognosis. This finding provides a new direction for the treatment, resistance of diseases associated with the Akt/mTOR signaling pathway, especially colorectal cancer.

title_en: Device for fluorescent marking of organoid and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device for fluorescence labeling of an organoid and a use method thereof, and relates to the field of fluorescence labeling of organoids, wherein the device comprises an upper layer, a middle layer and a lower layer, the upper layer and the lower layer are both circular annular glass, the middle layer is a nylon filter membrane, the thickness of the circular annular glass of the lower layer is larger than that of the circular annular glass of the upper layer, and one side of the circular annular glass of the lower layer is provided with an opening: the organoid can be fixed in the liquid level, and reduces organoid destruction simultaneously, and the dyestuff can the direct contact organoid, is convenient for organoid immunofluorescence labeling experiment go on, uses bright field formation of image to combine together with fluorescence formation of image mode, carries out 3D to reconstruct and merge in a picture with the image, and nylon film and organoid structure are clearly visible, and organoid adheres to on the nylon film, and intestinal organoid budding structure is obvious, has realized fine formation of villin Villin.

title_en: Ecological environment data monitoring method and system based on data analysis
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of water quality heavy metal monitoring, in particular to an ecological environment data monitoring method and system based on data analysis, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining the content credibility of any kind of heavy metal in each sampling point; determining the first disturbed similarity of any kind of heavy metal in each sampling point; and determining the second disturbed similarity of any kind of heavy metal in each sampling point based on the difference of the distribution condition of any kind of heavy metal content in each of the two adjacent stable intervals of each descending interval and the length of each descending interval of the same kind of heavy metal, and determining the monitoring availability of any kind of heavy metal in each sampling point by combining the first disturbed similarity and the content reliability, so as to monitor the content of any kind of heavy metal in the river to be monitored. According to the application, the accuracy and the reliability of the monitoring data are improved by comprehensively analyzing the change pattern of the heavy metal content and the authenticity of the heavy metal content.

title_en: Air quality inference method based on unsupervised learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses an air quality inference method based on non-supervised learning, which comprises the steps of firstly rasterizing a region, then acquiring air quality data, meteorological data, traffic data and geographic data, establishing an air quality inference model, wherein an non-supervised learning task is dedicated to feature extraction, the supervised learning task is responsible for executing a core inference process, the model comprises a category type feature coding module, a position coding module, a spatial interpolation module, a feature coding module and a feature decoding module, regularization based on gradients is included in a loss function, and feature importance is calculated based on gradients to complete air quality inference. The method is suitable for the category type feature method, improves the prediction accuracy of the model, and further improves the inference capability and the interpretability of the model.

title_en: Multifunctional guarantee vehicle, control system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of a guarantee vehicle, in particular to a multifunctional guarantee vehicle, a control system and a method, wherein the multifunctional guarantee vehicle comprises a control module, a management module, a positioning module and a display module, the control module comprises an in-vehicle control unit, a remote control unit and an acoustic control unit, and the management module is used for managing and guaranteeing the operation of in-vehicle equipment; the positioning module is used for positioning the guarantee vehicle based on a positioning technology and synchronizing the guarantee vehicle to the display module; the display module displays and guarantees the layout state, the running state, the positioning information and the route navigation of the equipment in the vehicle; the in-vehicle control unit can control and guarantee the stop and running states of in-vehicle equipment in the vehicle; the remote control unit can remotely control and guarantee the stopping and running states of the equipment in the vehicle; the sound control unit can control the starting and running states of the equipment in the vehicle, and the system can control the starting and running states of the equipment in the vehicle manually or in a sound control manner outside the vehicle, so that all operation buttons are integrated into a whole, and the operation is simple and convenient.

title_en: Mikroorganic acid mimotope peptide and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mimotope peptide of rice fermentation acid, which can be specifically combined with a rice fermentation acid antibody, and a sensitive and rapid competitive enzyme-linked immunoassay method can be established by utilizing phage or the mimotope peptide displaying the mimotope peptide; the competitive immunoassay method constructed by using the mimotope peptide provided by the invention has the IC  50  of 0.30ng/mL and the LOD of 0.02ng/mL, and compared with the sensitivity of the traditional hapten-based ELISA method, the sensitivity of the method is improved by 60 times; the competitive immunoassay method established based on the mimotope peptide provided by the invention has good cross reaction to other common structural analogues.

title_en: Coal quality evaluation method, system, equipment and medium based on historical coal blending coking data
abstract_en: A coal quality evaluation method based on historical coal blending coking data specifically comprises the following steps: acquiring historical coal blending coking data; establishing a coke cold and hot strength prediction model, and obtaining weights of various coal quality indexes of various coals based on the prediction model; based on historical data and expert experience, giving out standard values of various indexes; and calculating a coal quality evaluation score. The coal quality evaluation method in the prior art has limitations, and key indexes such as ash content, volatile matters, sulfur content, bonding index and the like are not considered, so that the applicability is not wide; the evaluation method is difficult to migrate depending on manually setting a basic value; coal quality evaluation was performed by evaluating ash alone, and the results were not comprehensive enough. The invention aims to provide a coal quality evaluation method based on historical coal blending coking data, which realizes comprehensive and scientific coal quality evaluation by comprehensively considering a plurality of coal quality evaluation indexes such as ash content, volatile matters, sulfur content, bonding index, maximum colloid layer thickness and the like.

title_en: Application of sample normal temperature preservation and mass spectrum detection method in metabonomics
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of biology, in particular to application of a sample normal-temperature preservation and mass spectrum detection method in metabonomics. The application provides the marker and the detection method, the high-throughput detection can be carried out only by a trace amount of serum, the extraction, pretreatment and matrix are avoided, the simple dilution is only needed, the operation is simple and convenient, and the sample added with porous silicon particles can be transported at normal temperature and has good salt resistance. The application discovers that the deregulated metabolite is used as a biomarker through non-targeted serum metabonomics analysis, and the proposed treatment-free serum metabonomics mass spectrometry technology not only can be used for observing the HCC pathogenesis approach on the metabolic level, but also is expected to be applied to large-scale HCC screening in high-risk groups.

title_en: Intelligent inspection unmanned vehicle for non-coal mine underground
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent inspection unmanned vehicle for a non-coal mine underground, which comprises a mobile vehicle body, a sensor suite, a sensor operation auxiliary component and a program analysis operation auxiliary component. The top of the mobile car body is provided with a receiving-transmitting integrated coil lifting device, a receiving-transmitting integrated coil, an upper touch detector, a laser radar and a panoramic stitching camera. The side part of the mobile car body is provided with a carbon monoxide sensor, a sulfur dioxide sensor, a nitrogen dioxide sensor and an air velocity sensor, and the front part of the mobile car body is provided with a binocular camera and a car lamp. The inside of the mobile car body is provided with a sealing box, and an edge computing box, a motor controller, a main control box, a CAN analyzer, an electromagnetic method host and a power supply box are arranged in the sealing box. The laser radar, the carbon monoxide sensor, the sulfur dioxide sensor, the nitrogen dioxide sensor, the wind speed sensor, the panoramic stitching camera and the binocular camera are connected with the main control box and the edge computing box through electric signals.

title_en: Energy storage box weld appearance detection method and system based on machine vision
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of weld joint detection of an energy storage box body, and particularly discloses a method and a system for detecting the appearance of the weld joint of the energy storage box body based on machine vision, which are characterized in that key features are extracted from an image of the appearance of the weld joint, defect identification is carried out based on the key features, whether the surface of the weld joint has defects is judged, then image data in the weld joint is obtained by utilizing a nondestructive testing technology, three-dimensional reconstruction is carried out after pretreatment is carried out, generating a three-dimensional model, identifying internal defects through image processing, finally matching the welding seam appearance image with characteristic points in internal structure data, and fusing the data to generate a complete view of the welding seam through adjustment to ensure that errors are within an acceptable range.

title_en: Preparation and application of anti-digoxin nano antibody
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digoxin nano antibody and a preparation method and application thereof. The amino acid and nucleotide sequences of the digoxin nano-antibody are shown in SEQ ID NO.8-9. The antibody has good affinity with target antigen, and dissociation constant Kd value of 73.1nM, and can be used for digoxin content measurement, nucleic acid probe detection and in vivo digoxin neutralization detoxification. The antibody has the advantages of small volume, high stability, low cost, low immunogenicity and the like, and has good application prospect.

title_en: Method for removing heavy metal chromium from agaric, screening method of heavy metal chromium remover and application
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of heavy metal removal, and particularly relates to a method for removing agaric heavy metal chromium, a screening method of a heavy metal chromium remover and application of the heavy metal chromium remover. The invention provides an application of alpha-glucoheptonate sodium in removing edible tree fungus heavy metal chromium and a method for removing edible tree fungus heavy metal chromium by alpha-glucoheptonate sodium. The alpha-glucoheptonate can form stable complex with metal ion chromium, and the hydroxyl functional group in the molecular structure can form oxygen bridge bond with the metal ion chromium to form complex with stable structure, so as to remove chromium in the edible tree fungus and achieve the technical effect of removing chromium in the edible tree fungus.

title_en: Anti-A botulinum toxin neutralizing antibody A16 and related biological materials and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-A botulinum toxin neutralizing antibody A16 and a related biological material and application thereof. The invention belongs to the technical field of biology, and particularly relates to an anti-A botulinum toxin neutralizing antibody A16 and a related biological material and application thereof. The nanobody targeting botulinum toxin A or an antigen binding fragment containing the same of the present invention has 3 complementarity determining regions CDR1, CDR2 and CDR3; wherein the amino acid sequence of CDR1 is shown as SEQ ID No.2, the amino acid sequence of CDR2 is shown as SEQ ID No.3, and the amino acid sequence of CDR3 is shown as SEQ ID No. 4. Fusion protein A16-hFc obtained by fusing nanobody A16 and Fc segment (hFc) of human immunoglobulin can effectively block infection of botulinum toxin type A, and the half lethal dose ED  50  of the botulinum toxin type A resisting 20LD  50  is 1.1 mug.

title_en: Preparation and application of Golgi apparatus protein 73scFV antibody
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of antibody preparation and in-vitro diagnostic reagents, in particular to the preparation of GP73 protein scFV antibody based on phage display technology and the application of detecting the GP73 content in human serum based on the development of a magnetic particle chemiluminescence kit of the antibody. Compared with the same type of products, the scFv antibody and the detection product developed based on the scFv antibody have wider linear range and better detection sensitivity, are simple to operate, have the detection time of not more than 30 minutes, and have more stable and reliable detection results.

title_en: Aptamer containing modified base and application thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of biology, and discloses a nucleic acid aptamer containing modified bases, wherein the base sequence of the nucleic acid aptamer is shown as SEQ ID NO. 1. Nucleic acid aptamers containing modified bases can be applied to molecular probes. The application provides a nucleic acid aptamer (HSH 10) containing modified bases and capable of being combined with the surface of a tumor-derived exosome membrane. The modified base containing aptamer (HSH 10) was able to bind to the membrane surface Collagen alpha-1 (XVIII) chain (COL 18A 1). The nucleic acid aptamer of the application can detect COL18A1, has a wide application range, and can be used in any occasion where COL18A1 detection is required, for example, the nucleic acid aptamer (HSH 10) containing modified bases according to the application can be used for finding and verifying tumor markers.

title_en: Lake-phase shale chemical phase division method, system, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a system, equipment and a storage medium for dividing the chemical phases of lake-phase shale, belonging to the field of petroleum exploration and development geology. Element data are acquired by acquiring a lake-phase shale sample, and are processed, so that trace elements greatly influenced by land source scraps are removed. And screening the characteristic construction characteristic vector with larger influence on the chemical phase division by adopting a Principal Component Analysis (PCA) method, and carrying out clustering analysis on the characteristic vector by utilizing a clustering algorithm to obtain the chemical phase type. And (3) training by utilizing a random forest algorithm to obtain a chemical phase prediction model, automatically and efficiently dividing the chemical phases of the lake-phase shale, and finally applying a chemical phase division result to the exploration and development of shale oil and gas, and identifying and evaluating the oil and gas resource potential in the lake-phase shale.

title_en: Test strip for quantitatively detecting 1, 5-dehydrated-D-sorbitol as well as preparation method, detection method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of medical examination and determination, and relates to a test strip for quantitatively detecting 1, 5-dehydrated-D-sorbitol, a preparation method, a detection method and application thereof, wherein the test strip comprises a PET substrate, a reaction film, a precipitation film and a diffusion film which are sequentially laminated; wherein the precipitation film contains a first reaction substance, and the reaction film contains a second reaction substance; the first reactive species comprises 4-aminoantipyrine, adenosine triphosphate and hexokinase and the second reactive species comprises peroxidase, pyranose oxidase and hydroxytoluene sulfonyl iodobenzene. The application has simple operation flow, greatly shortens the detection time and improves the detection efficiency.

title_en: Training data set creation and roll break detection method, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a training data set creation and roll breakage detection method, a device and a storage medium, wherein the training data set creation method comprises the following steps: filling the index column of the training data set with the roll number of the roll as an index; respectively filling the historical rolling data and the processing parameters of the historical process piece as various characteristic data into one or more data columns of a training data set; filling the state labels of each roll in a label column; each row of the training dataset includes a respective roll number, characteristic data, and status label for each roll. According to the application, the training data set containing various data information is created, so that the diversity of data in the training data set is improved. In addition, the data in the training data set are classified according to the index column, the data column and the tag column respectively, so that the data is easy to process, and the data processing difficulty in the training data set is reduced.

title_en: Method and device for detecting nutrition quality of nutrition ingredients in vegetable oil
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for detecting the nutrition quality of nutrition components in vegetable oil, which comprises a detector body and a plurality of pluggable vegetable oil detection components, and is characterized in that, the upper middle part of the detector body is provided with a concave part, and the opening of the middle part of the inner bottom of the concave part is integrally connected with a fixed cannula, wherein the opening of the middle part of the upper end of the fixed cannula is fixedly connected with an aviation socket. The liquid density measuring sensor is arranged in the detection cylinder and can be connected with the control main board through the aviation plug and the aviation socket, so that the liquid density measuring sensor is very easy to separate from the control main board, and only the detection cylinder is required to be lifted upwards during separation, thereby facilitating the disassembly and replacement of the detection cylinder by an operator, realizing the effect of facilitating the disassembly and replacement of the detection cylinder, facilitating the cleaning or replacement of the detection cylinder by the operator, effectively improving the detection efficiency and being more convenient to use.

title_en: Anti-influenza A virus antibody, reagent for detecting influenza A virus and kit
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-influenza A virus antibody, a reagent for detecting influenza A virus and a kit, and relates to the technical field of antibodies. The anti-influenza a virus antibodies disclosed herein comprise a heavy chain complementarity determining region and a light chain complementarity determining region. The antibody provides an important raw material source for detecting influenza A virus, and has improved affinity and activity.

title_en: Smell source searching method, device, storage medium and equipment
abstract_en: The present specification discloses a method, apparatus, storage medium, and device for scent source searching, wherein a search robot is disposed at a target site, searches for a scent value exceeding a discovery threshold in the target site, performs a total of m searches with the search center as a start point, where each n searches determines a highest scent value searched in the last n searches as a sample scent value, if a search result satisfies a search termination condition, determines scent source positions according to the positions searched for each sample scent value, otherwise, re-determines the search center according to at least a portion of the positions as the search center, and performs m searches with the re-determined search center as the start point until the search result satisfies the search termination condition, and avoids the situation that the robot falls into a locally optimal region by re-determining the search center according to the position as the search center, but fails to search a globally optimal region.

title_en: Device and method for rapidly measuring formaldehyde in indoor air
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid determination device and a determination method for formaldehyde in indoor air, which relate to the technical field of indoor formaldehyde detection and comprise a moving assembly and a dust filtering and collecting assembly. The rapid measuring device can accelerate dust attached to the fine filter screen to fall off, the fallen dust is adhered and collected by the adhesive net, so that the blocking of the dust to the air passing is avoided, the air passing is accelerated under the operation of air dust filtration, and the formaldehyde measuring efficiency is improved.

title_en: Antibodies to kynurenine
abstract_en: The present invention relates to monoclonal antibodies or antigen binding fragments thereof or synthetic and biotechnological derivatives thereof which specifically bind kynurenine and act as a marker for the detection of inflammation in an individual. Furthermore, the present invention provides a reliable method and a detection kit for detecting inflammation by measuring the level of kynurenine in a body fluid, preferably saliva. Using the monoclonal antibodies of the present invention, the inventors provide a means to easily and quickly determine the level of KYN when saliva is used as a sample, without the need for any trained person. This is also beneficial in pediatric medicine and in the monitoring of various diseases.

title_en: Silk fibroin-based flexible nerve electrode device for brain-computer interface
abstract_en: The invention relates to a silk fibroin-based flexible nerve electrode device for a brain-computer interface, which is integrated with an ion selective electrode and a reference electrode, wherein the ion selective electrode comprises a silk fibroin substrate, PEDOT (packet data) PSS/CNFs conductive layers, an ion selective membrane and a silk fibroin packaging layer, PEDOT (packet data) PSS/CNFs conductive layers are inserted and fixed between silk fibroin molecular chains on the silk fibroin substrate, the reference electrode comprises the silk fibroin substrate, an Ag/AgCl conductive layer, a PVB film and a silk fibroin packaging layer, the silk fibroin substrate is a silk fibroin film, the silk fibroin packaging layer is a tannic acid modified silk fibroin film, and the Young modulus of the silk fibroin film is below 10 MPa. The product of the invention can more effectively monitor the nerve electric signal and the ion signal of the corresponding tissue, and can maximally improve the detection precision and accuracy.

title_en: Endocrinology blood glucose data monitoring method and endocrinology blood glucose data monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of blood sugar data monitoring, in particular to a method and a system for monitoring endocrinology blood sugar data, wherein the method generates a first type of fault parameter set of blood sugar monitoring equipment by evaluating storage environment parameters of the blood sugar monitoring equipment, analyzes performance parameters of the blood sugar monitoring equipment, generates a second type of fault parameter set of the blood sugar monitoring equipment, judges data precision coefficients of the blood sugar monitoring equipment, and generating a third type of fault parameter set of the blood glucose monitoring equipment to realize comprehensive monitoring of the blood glucose monitoring equipment, so that monitoring feedback is carried out on fault data of the blood glucose monitoring equipment, the specific problem types existing in the blood glucose monitoring equipment can be quickly identified and positioned, scientific basis is provided for maintenance of the blood glucose monitoring equipment, and accuracy and continuity of blood glucose data monitoring results are ensured.

title_en: Application of FUNDC1 inhibitor in preparation of medicine for preventing and treating skin photodamage
abstract_en: The invention relates to application of a FUNDC1 inhibitor in preparing a medicine for preventing and treating skin photodamage, wherein the FUNDC1 inhibitor can relieve, alleviate or prevent the skin photodamage by inhibiting or reducing the expression of the FUNDC 1. According to the invention, a photodamage model is established by irradiating mouse skin and HaCaT cells with UVB, the UVB treatment shows that the expression of FUNDC1 is down-regulated, whether the FUNDC1 can protect the HaCaT cells and the mouse model from UVB-induced photodamage is explored by knocking down the FUNDC1 in view of the fact that the over-expression of the FUNDC1 aggravates UVB-induced photodamage, the cell survival rate is improved to 80% after the FUNDC1 is knockdown, compared with a UVB group, ROS level, apoptosis and gamma H  2  Ax expression are reduced, and mitochondrial damage is lightened after the UVB irradiation, and the mitochondrial distribution is uniformly distributed along cell nuclei, mitochondrial membrane potential repolarization and mtROS accumulation are reduced. The invention provides that the intervention of the fusion C1 mediated mitochondrial autophagy can protect UVB-induced mitochondrial injury and photodamage by regulating and controlling mitochondrial apoptosis pathway, and provides a potential target point for relieving skin photodamage in the future.

title_en: Urban area multicomponent flux measurement system and method based on vorticity covariance method
abstract_en: The application discloses a urban area multicomponent flux measurement system and method based on a vorticity covariance method, and relates to the technical field of urban area multicomponent flux measurement, wherein the system comprises the following components: the multi-satellite clock synchronous time service module, the high-altitude microclimate measurement module, the ectopic sample transmission module, the ground multi-component concentration measurement module, the accumulated covariance time lag judgment module and the multi-component flux calculation module can acquire a vertical wind speed time sequence at high altitude, simultaneously transmit high-altitude air to the ground multi-component concentration measurement module corresponding to each to-be-measured component on the ground, collecting to obtain a concentration time sequence corresponding to each component to be measured, unifying the time axis of the vertical wind speed time sequence and the time axis of the concentration time sequence, the method and the device can be used for guiding the flux measurement of various gas components in urban areas.

title_en: Fishery ecological water pollution monitoring sampling device
abstract_en: The invention provides a fishery ecological water pollution monitoring and sampling device which comprises a cabin body capable of floating on a water surface, wherein the top of the cabin body is provided with a mounting groove, the bottom of the mounting groove is provided with a through groove, the top of the through groove is provided with a separation column, the top of the separation column is provided with a through separation through groove, an anchoring component is arranged in the mounting groove and comprises an anchor and a winch, the winch is arranged in the mounting groove, a steel rope is wound around the outer side of the winch, one side of the separation column is provided with a through hole, one end of the steel rope is connected with the anchor through the through hole, one side of the separation column is also provided with a locking component corresponding to the steel rope, the mounting groove is internally provided with a sampling and detecting component, the sampling and detecting component comprises a water quality detector and a detecting box, the bottom of the mounting groove is provided with the detecting box, the device can be fixed at a designated monitoring position through the arrangement of the anchoring component even if the device encounters heavy wind weather, the problem that the traditional monitoring device easily deviates from a monitoring area is solved, and the reliability of monitoring data is ensured.

title_en: Ore deposit analog device for detecting roof pressure
abstract_en: The invention provides an ore deposit simulation device for detecting roof pressure, which comprises a supporting frame, a plurality of roof supporting components, a surrounding baffle component, a pressurizing component and a local stress component, wherein in the scheme, different geological conditions can be simulated by filling different materials into a simulation space, the roof supporting components are used for simulating a roof support, and pressure data can be measured through a sensor on the roof supporting components so as to judge the pressure born by the current roof supporting components; and moreover, the local stress concentration of the existing roadway above the excavated roadway on the excavated area can be simulated through the local stress assembly, the pressure with a required value can be simulated through the stress assembly, and the influence of the local stress on the excavated area is detected through the sensor on the top plate supporting assembly, so that a technician is guided to select a better supporting scheme. Thus, this approach avoids the single problem of prior art mining analog measurement, making the simulation more realistic in production.

title_en: Disease detection device
abstract_en: Described herein are methods of analyzing and detecting a disease or condition in a subject, comprising a sample collection container for collecting a sample, a filtration unit in fluid communication with the sample collection container, the filtration unit comprising at least one filter for filtering the sample to obtain a filtrate, and a filtrate collection container in fluid communication with the filtration unit for collecting the filtrate and contacting the filtrate with a preservative. Furthermore, described herein are methods of preserving a sample for detecting a disease or condition in a subject.

title_en: Detection device for producing water-based paint
