abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of paint production and detection, in particular to a detection device for water paint production, which comprises an equipment seat, wherein a sliding sleeve is arranged on the equipment seat in a penetrating and sliding manner, two fixing frames are fixedly arranged on the sliding sleeve in a connecting manner, a paint dish is arranged on a rotating seat, a box body is fixedly arranged in the equipment seat in a connecting manner, a transmission mechanism is arranged in the box body in a penetrating and rotating manner, an automatic flushing pipe is arranged on the box body in a penetrating and rotating manner, after the water paint is detected, the automatic flushing pipe is driven by the transmission mechanism to swing in a reciprocating manner, and meanwhile, the automatic flushing pipe can spray cleaning liquid, so that the surfaces of a detection plate and the paint dish can be rapidly and comprehensively covered, the attached paint can be effectively removed, and compared with manual cleaning, the problems of incomplete cleaning or excessive cleaning caused by human factors are avoided, and the overall efficiency and the quality of the water paint production are effectively improved.

title_en: Paper-based sensor for creatinine detection and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a paper-based sensor for creatinine detection and a preparation method thereof, wherein the paper-based sensor comprises a polylactic acid paper-based material and a colorimetric indicator attached to the polylactic acid paper-based material, the colorimetric indicator is formed after aqueous colorimetric indication ink is solidified, the aqueous colorimetric indication ink comprises a solvent, an indicator, a stabilizer and a thickening agent, the indicator is an aromatic compound with meta-double nitro groups, the stabilizer is a water-soluble inorganic alkaline compound, and the thickening agent is a biomass polysaccharide derivative. The paper-based sensor provided by the invention can be used for detecting creatinine in a solution in a portable and handheld manner, and the creatinine level is judged by comparing the creatinine with a colorimetric card, so that compared with the main-stream enzymatic method on the market, the paper-based sensor has the advantages that the corresponding speed is higher, the cost is lower, and the polylactic acid paper substrate and the colorimetric indicator can be naturally degraded, so that the paper-based sensor is more environment-friendly.

title_en: Method and system for predicting greenhouse gas emission flux in compost based on machine learning
abstract_en: The method and the system for predicting the greenhouse gas emission flux of the compost based on machine learning are used for sampling samples of the compost to be predicted through a multipoint sampling method to obtain samples of the compost to be predicted, DOM to-be-detected liquid of the compost to be predicted is generated according to the samples of the compost to be predicted, a plurality of DOM characteristic indexes corresponding to the compost to be predicted at the current moment are determined by the DOM to-be-detected liquid, the DOM characteristic indexes are input into a gas prediction model to conduct gas prediction to obtain the greenhouse gas emission flux of the compost to be predicted, the gas prediction model is obtained by training the machine learning model through a data set corresponding to the target compost, and the data set comprises the greenhouse gas emission flux corresponding to the target compost at each sampling moment and the DOM characteristic indexes.

title_en: Application of polyvinylidene fluoride microporous filter membrane and western blotting method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of protein transfer printing, and provides an application of a polyvinylidene fluoride microporous filter membrane and a protein immunoblotting method, wherein the surface of the polyvinylidene fluoride microporous filter membrane is provided with spherulites and rod-shaped short fiber crystals and has no compact cortex, and the application comprises the steps that the polyvinylidene fluoride microporous filter membrane is used as a solid phase carrier to carry out high-sensitivity detection on a protein sample with microgram level content in the protein immunoblotting process, and clear protein strips are obtained; the polyvinylidene fluoride microporous filter membrane is prepared by dissolving polyvinylidene fluoride in a solvent at a first temperature, adding an additive, mixing to obtain a feed liquid, cooling the feed liquid to a second temperature to obtain a casting solution, preparing the casting solution to form a liquid membrane, separating a vapor-induced phase of the liquid membrane, and immersing the liquid membrane in a coagulation bath for coagulation molding to obtain the polyvinylidene fluoride microporous filter membrane. The polyvinylidene fluoride microporous filter membrane prepared by the invention has good protein transfer effect in the western blotting process, and the detection effect is improved remarkably.

title_en: Be applied to hull crack monitoring's underwater robot
abstract_en: The invention provides an underwater robot applied to hull fracture monitoring, which comprises bionic tension legs, a trunk main body and a fixing mechanism, wherein 4 groups of bionic tension legs are arranged on two sides of the trunk main body, the bionic tension legs are formed by hinging main support legs and auxiliary support legs, the auxiliary support legs are connected with rollers in the trunk main body through tension cables, synchronous alternate movement of adjacent bionic tension legs is realized through a special roller combination mode, the fixing mechanism is connected with a spherical limiter at the bottom of the trunk main body through a spherical clamping block, and a thimble is controlled to be ejected through a wedge-shaped sliding block and a magnetic sliding block so as to lock the spherical clamping block.

title_en: Water quality monitoring and sampling device for water pollution treatment and sampling method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of sewage sampling, and discloses a water quality monitoring and sampling device for water pollution treatment and a sampling method thereof, the device comprises a power mechanism, the power mechanism further comprises a collecting pipe, a plurality of extracting pipes are connected at the side wall of the collecting pipe in a penetrating way, before equipment is used, the equipment is arranged beside a river bank, all filtering mechanisms are buried in a horizontal plane, a power supply of an electric telescopic rod is connected, the electric telescopic rod generates a trend of stretching up and down, the electric telescopic rod drives a sliding rod to move downwards through a fixing plate, at the moment, the sliding rod pushes a piston plate to move downwards along the inner wall of the extracting pipe, in the process, a sliding round rod drives a round ring to move downwards through a pulling spring, the round ring is influenced by friction force of a friction ring, in the process of moving downwards of the piston plate, a distance between the round ring and the piston plate is increased, a blocking block is far away from a water inlet, sample water in the extracting pipes enters the top of the piston plate through gaps between the blocking block and the fixing bracket, and the collection of samples is completed.

title_en: Preparation and application of dual-mode immunosensor based on PdSn dual-function nano-enzyme
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical fields of novel functional nano materials, immunoassay and biosensing, and provides a preparation method of a dual-mode immunosensor based on PdSn dual-functional nano enzyme, which is used for sensitively detecting cardiac troponin I (cTnI). The method is characterized in that a palladium-tin alloy/molybdenum carbide composite material (PdSn/Mo  2  C-C) serving as a secondary antibody beacon and a gold nanoparticle/hydrogen bond organic framework composite material (Au NPs/HOFs) serving as a base material are respectively prepared, a sandwich type sensor is constructed based on the composite material, and a double-mode (electrochemical method and colorimetric method) is used for quantitatively detecting the concentration of cTnI antigen in an actual serum sample, so that the visual interpretable and ultrasensitive double-mode analysis is realized, the advantages of high sensitivity, low detection limit and the like are shown, and a new idea is provided for detecting the cTnI.

title_en: Soil heavy metal pollution monitoring device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a soil heavy metal pollution monitoring device which comprises a terrain matching support component and a sampling detection component, wherein a bolt-assembled route transfer mechanism is arranged on the top side of the terrain matching support component. The device mainly utilizes the output power of the pneumatic expansion plate to drive the output end so that the rotating base is matched with the swing rod, the supporting block, the rotating motor and the positioning screw rod can be enabled to be aligned with the ground effectively under the action of the pneumatic expansion rod and the hydraulic expansion limb, the terrain applicability of the device is improved, the output power of the motor cabin is used for driving the output end to operate, the rotating rod and the screw blade can be enabled to perform real-time flight action on the device, and the sampling detection component can conduct self-adaptive cleaning on a water body on samples attached to a product by the collected screw rod and the drill bit through the flight action, so that the cleaning effect is achieved, and the automation applicability of the device is improved.

title_en: Gas sensor module aging system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of aging of gas sensor modules, and provides a system and a method for aging a gas sensor module, wherein the system comprises a plurality of aging bottom plates, and a plurality of power supply voltage reducing modules and module aging plates are arranged in the aging bottom plates; the power supply voltage reducing module receives the input voltage of the aging bottom plate, the power supply voltage reducing module reduces the input voltage to obtain output voltage, the output voltage is input into the module aging plate, a plurality of gas sensor modules connected in parallel are arranged in the module aging plate, and the module aging plate ages one gas sensor module or a plurality of gas sensor modules simultaneously after receiving the output voltage of the power supply voltage reducing module. The invention solves the problems that when the gas sensor module is aged, the gas sensor module cannot be aged in a large scale, the aging capacity is limited and the efficiency is low, and the open circuit or short circuit of one gas sensor module can not influence the aging of the gas sensor on other modules.

title_en: Application of RNF14 in diagnosis and treatment of cerebral infarction
abstract_en: The invention discloses application of RNF14 in diagnosing and treating cerebral infarction, provides application of a reagent for detecting expression level of a biomarker in preparing a product for diagnosing cerebral infarction, provides application of the biomarker or an accelerant thereof in preparing a pharmaceutical composition for treating and/or preventing cerebral infarction, and provides a method for screening candidate drugs for treating cerebral infarction.

title_en: Device for measuring decayed part of wood beam in ancient building and repairing method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device for measuring a wood beam decay part in an ancient building and a repairing method, which aim at the problem that the excision position of the wood beam decay part of the ancient building is difficult to determine. The device comprises a base connected to the top of a wood beam, a positioning sleeve connected with a groove shaft of the overhanging end of the base, and an impact steel rod connected to the positioning sleeve. The method comprises the steps of adjusting the telescopic length between an impact steel rod and a positioning sleeve and locking, so that the distance between the center of a hollow steel ball and the tail end of the positioning sleeve is equal to the distance between the center of an impact point of a wood beam and the upper surface of the wood beam, connecting a base to the upper surface of the wood beam, lifting the impact steel rod to a horizontal position, loosening the impact steel rod, impacting the side surface of the wood beam by the hollow steel ball to form an impact indentation, fitting parameters such as the diameter of the indentation, the density of wood, the water content and the like to obtain a wood decay degree judgment coefficient, measuring the wood decay degree of each impact point one by one from the end part to the middle part of the wood beam, and judging that a region with the wood decay degree judgment coefficient larger than a set value is a decay part, and removing and updating are needed.

title_en: Kit for detecting iridovirus of largemouth black bass
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kit for detecting the iridovirus of micropterus salmoides. The invention utilizes DNA nucleic acid aptamer for specifically recognizing particles of the largehead jewfish iridovirus (LMBV) to combine isothermal Strand Displacement Amplification (SDA) and colloidal gold (AuNPs) marking technologies to construct a kit for detecting the largehead jewfish iridovirus. The kit can realize quick visual field detection of LMBV, has accurate detection result, good detection sensitivity and short time consumption, does not need to rely on professional laboratory instruments and laboratory conditions, has low requirements on detection equipment and detection personnel, is suitable for basic level detection units, farms and the like which need to detect LMBV regularly, and is favorable for early discovery and early prevention of LMBV.

title_en: Design method of semi-autogenous mill cylinder equal-service-life lining plate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a design method of a semi-autogenous mill cylinder equal-service-life lining plate, which comprises the following steps of carrying out mechanical property test and crushing experiments on ores, steel balls and the lining plate to obtain corresponding mechanical property and crushing characteristic parameters, establishing an ore crushing model and a medium particle model by using a Tavares crushing model based on a discrete element method, establishing a semi-autogenous mill three-dimensional model by using SOLIWORKS software, carrying out region division on the semi-autogenous mill cylinder lining plate along the axial direction and the radial direction, obtaining the abrasion volume amounts of different regions in the axial direction and the radial direction by using an Arcard abrasion model, and redistributing the lining plate volumes of each region based on the simulated abrasion volume amounts to design the equal-service-life lining plate. The invention adopts the design method of the service life lining plate of the semi-autogenous mill cylinder body, reduces the axial uneven abrasion degree of the lining plate of the semi-autogenous mill, prolongs the whole service life of the lining plate, improves the utilization rate of steel of the lining plate, improves the working efficiency of the semi-autogenous mill and reduces the ore dressing cost.

title_en: Method for predicting curative effect of immunotherapy on hepatocellular carcinoma patient
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for predicting curative effect of a liver cell cancer patient receiving immunotherapy or combined immunotherapy and anti-angiogenesis drug treatment by utilizing peripheral blood protein mass spectrometry, belonging to the technical field of biological medicine. The method comprises the steps of collecting and detecting a peripheral blood sample of a patient before receiving treatment, detecting the content of main proteins in blood plasma, screening out difference proteins related to treatment effects according to different treatment effect results of the patient, wherein the difference proteins comprise at least one of SULT2A1, KYNU, MMP1, SHMT1, FGF19, LAMA4, AMBN, MVK and TPP1, establishing a treatment effect prediction model by using the screened difference proteins, and obtaining a detection kit based on the prediction model.

title_en: Device and method for observing influence of human activity damage on habitat based on remote sensing image
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a method for observing influence of human activity damage on a habitat based on remote sensing images, wherein the device comprises at least one unmanned aerial vehicle main body, a remote sensing acquisition mechanism is arranged on the unmanned aerial vehicle main body, and a sampling mechanism is arranged at the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle main body, the sampling mechanism comprises a guide shell, a filter screen and a sampling lifting part, the bottom of the guide shell is provided with an inclined guide edge, the filter screen is obliquely arranged in the guide shell and is symmetrical to the guide edge, the sampling lifting part is arranged in the guide shell, the bottom end of the sampling lifting part penetrates through the guide shell, and the discharge end of the sampling lifting part is positioned above the filter screen. The invention can collect and sample the image and soil of the human activity damage area, divide the area to be monitored into a plurality of human damage areas and obtain the area division map according to the soil data of the human damage areas, so that the influence of the soil coverage rate and the air concentration of the human damage areas on the soil of the area can be clearly estimated, and the area to be monitored can be conveniently and better observed.

title_en: Hair drug colloidal carbon detection kit and detection method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hair drug colloidal carbon detection kit, which comprises a kit body and a colloidal carbon immunochromatographic test strip, wherein the colloidal carbon immunochromatographic test strip comprises a nitrocellulose membrane and a carbon pad, a test area and a quality control area are arranged on the nitrocellulose membrane, the test area is coated with bovine serum albumin coupled drug synthetic antigen, the quality control area is coated with goat anti-rabbit IgG, and the carbon pad is coated with colloidal carbon labeled drug monoclonal antibody and colloidal carbon labeled rabbit IgG. The detection method of the hair drug colloidal carbon detection kit provided by the invention is simple to operate, can detect drugs aiming at hair, can obtain detection results within 5 minutes, and is suitable for rapid drug screening.

title_en: Water quality detection base station of pond
abstract_en: The application provides a water quality detection base station of a water tank, which comprises a power supply module, a water quality detection module, a control device and a detection device, wherein the water quality detection module comprises a mounting part and a water quality detection sensor, the power supply module is used for supplying power to the water quality detection module, and the water quality detection sensor is detachably arranged on the mounting part and is used for detecting the water quality of the water tank. The water quality detection module can be freely disassembled and assembled by a user, can be installed according to the user needs and the needed water quality detection module, is more in applicable scene, and is further provided with the detection device to remind the user whether the water quality detection module is installed in place or not, so that the water quality detection module is beneficial to the user to check some installation problems, and the user experience is improved.

title_en: High-dispersity magnetic nano gold particle and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of immunochromatography, in particular to a high-dispersity magnetic nano gold particle and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps of 1) preparing Fe  3 O 4  magnetic particles by adopting a hydrothermal synthesis method; 2) preparing polystyrene magnetic particles with controllable colors and aminated surfaces by adopting a dispersion polymerization method, and 3) preparing the magnetic gold nanoparticles by combining nano gold with the polystyrene magnetic particles with controllable colors and aminated surfaces by adopting a citric acid reduction method through electrostatic adsorption. The magnetic nano gold particles prepared by the invention have the particle size range of 300-500nm, controllable color, high sensitivity, good dispersibility and good stability, the color polystyrene shell is introduced to realize the regulation and control of the color of the microsphere particles, the magneto-mechanical property, the optical property and the immunochromatography technology are combined, the purpose of qualitative and quantitative dual-detection of the object to be detected can be realized, and the purpose of multi-color multi-detection can be realized by different colors.

title_en: Rapid screening model for debilitation and use method
abstract_en: The invention provides a rapid screening model for debilitation and a use method thereof, and the method for using blood protein markers and debilitation phenotype indexes in combination comprises a basic data module, a calculation module and a result evaluation module, wherein the basic data module is divided into a blood protein marker evaluation submodule containing gamma interferon (IFN gamma), granulocyte Colony Stimulating Factor (GCSF), tumor necrosis factor alpha (TNF alpha) and the like and a debilitation phenotype index evaluation submodule containing factors such as grip strength reduction, weight loss, fatigue, pace decline and the like. The invention can rapidly screen the senile people for the debilitation through the analysis of the blood protein markers and the debilitation phenotype indexes singly or in combination.

title_en: Method for evaluating and regulating wear resistance of spheroidal graphite cast iron based on electronic work function
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electron work function-based ductile iron wear resistance evaluation and regulation method, which relates to the technical field of surface engineering and performance evaluation and comprises the steps of collecting electron work function data and material characteristic data of the surface of ductile iron, extracting characteristics of the electron work function data to obtain electron work function characteristics, establishing a mathematical model based on the electron work function characteristics to analyze correlation between the electron work function data and the material characteristic data, analyzing the relation between the electron work function characteristics and the wear resistance, and establishing a comprehensive evaluation model to evaluate the wear resistance of ductile iron. The method combines the characterization technology, the complex data analysis method and the multivariate statistical model, can not only deeply understand the relation between the electronic structure and the macroscopic performance of the material, but also establish a comprehensive evaluation model to predict the wear resistance of the spheroidal graphite cast iron, and guides the design of the material and the optimization of the production process.

title_en: Detection device and detection method
abstract_en: The application provides a detection device and a detection method, wherein the detection device comprises a gas generation device, a sealing cover and a pipeline, the gas generation device comprises a reaction container, the reaction container is used for containing a proper amount of chemical reactants and is used as a reaction place of the chemical reactants, the chemical reactants generate chemical reactions under preset conditions and generate detection gas, and the detection gas is the same as the gas detected by a gas concentration detector. The sealed cover is used for sealing the gas concentration detector, and the volume of the sealed cover is larger than that of the gas concentration detector. One end of the pipeline is connected with the gas generating device, and the other end of the pipeline is connected with the sealing cover, so that the detection gas generated in the reaction container is conducted to the sealing cover. The detection device has simple structure, and generates a proper amount of detection gas under the preset condition in the using process, so that the accident rate caused by gas leakage can be reduced.

title_en: Corrosion-resistant groundwater monitoring protection device
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of groundwater monitoring, and particularly discloses a corrosion-resistant groundwater monitoring protection device which comprises an inner protection cylinder, an outer protection cylinder, a filter screen, an intermittent flushing mechanism for cleaning the filter screen, a driving mechanism for driving the intermittent flushing mechanism to rotate and a drainage mechanism for sucking impurities flushed on the filter screen, wherein a cavity is reserved between the inner protection cylinder and the outer protection cylinder, and the filter screen is arranged on the side wall of the outer protection cylinder. The filter screen can filter the impurity in the groundwater, and actuating mechanism can drive intermittent type washing mechanism and clean the filter screen, and will clean impurity drainage down to the position of keeping away from the filter screen, produces a large amount of bubbles simultaneously and assists the transfer of impurity, has reduced the impurity that the clearance was got down by a wide margin and has adhered the possibility on the filter screen again to extension filter screen's life and change frequency realize the protection to cylindric detection end.

title_en: Antibodies and antibody conjugates and uses thereof
abstract_en: The present invention provides a conjugate comprising an antibody and a conjugate moiety; the antibody comprises a heavy chain constant region comprising engineered lysine residues comprising the following sites: 1. 3, 5, 14, 31, 58, 59, 60, 61, 79, 81, 116, 141, 144, 165, 169, 190, 192, 199, 208, 209, 213, 218, 219, 220, 224, 231, 232, 233, 236, 238, 249, 255, 260, 266, 267, 271, 273, 274, 275, 279, 290, 295, 309, 313, 315, 317, 319, 320, or the like; a conjugate moiety is attached to the antibody. The conjugate has high activity, high sensitivity or strong stability.

title_en: Stratum rock-soil parameter testing method based on controllable neutron source, ground acquisition computer, system and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a stratum rock-soil parameter testing method based on a controllable neutron source, a ground acquisition computer, a system and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining rock-soil mechanics and physical property synthetic data and rock-soil mechanics and physical property in-situ measured data, and preprocessing to obtain target rock-soil synthetic data and target rock-soil in-situ measured data; determining a preset dual neural network model, carrying out model training on the preset dual neural network model according to target rock-soil synthesis data and target rock-soil in-situ measured data to obtain a stratum rock-soil parameter prediction model, obtaining current rock-soil mechanics and physical property in-situ measured data, inputting the current rock-soil mechanics and physical property in-situ measured data into the stratum rock-soil parameter prediction model, and outputting a stratum rock-soil parameter prediction result. According to the invention, by combining a controllable neutron source, a static cone penetration test and a data processing method and introducing a neural network model, effective measurement and accurate analysis of stratum key parameters can be realized, and more accurate stratum parameter data can be obtained.

title_en: Recombinant antibody, preparation method thereof, nucleic acid fragment, expression vector, recombinant cell and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a recombinant antibody, a preparation method thereof, a nucleic acid fragment, an expression vector, a recombinant cell and application thereof, and relates to the field of antibodies, wherein the recombinant antibody is a hexamer, the recombinant antibody comprises a heavy chain and a light chain, the heavy chain comprises a heavy chain variable region and a heavy chain constant region, the light chain comprises a light chain variable region and a light chain constant region, the heavy chain variable region amino acid sequence is a sheep-derived IgG heavy chain variable region amino acid sequence, the heavy chain constant region amino acid sequence is a human-derived IgM heavy chain constant region amino acid sequence, the light chain variable region amino acid sequence is a sheep-derived IgG light chain variable region amino acid sequence, and the light chain constant region amino acid sequence is a human-derived IgM light chain constant region amino acid sequence. The recombinant antibody has stable performance, can efficiently recognize and bind to the T3 antigen, and has higher affinity activity to the T3 antigen compared with sheep-derived IgG.

title_en: Seaweed bed monitoring system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of marine ecological environment monitoring, in particular to a seaweed bed monitoring system and method, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining image data of a target marine area and various environment parameters of each seaweed bed; determining the area change rate and the seaweed coverage of each seaweed bed in a target ocean area according to image data in different periods, taking various environmental parameters, the area change rate and the seaweed coverage of each seaweed bed as characteristic parameters affecting the health state of any seaweed bed, carrying out weighted summation on all the characteristic parameters to obtain a comprehensive evaluation index of the seaweed bed, substituting the comprehensive evaluation index and the various characteristic parameters into a pre-established seaweed bed health state evaluation model, and evaluating the health state of the seaweed bed. The invention can realize accurate assessment of the health state of the seaweed bed.

title_en: Carbon emission concentration monitoring method and early warning device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of carbon emission monitoring, in particular to a carbon emission concentration monitoring method and an early warning device, which can accurately analyze the processing compliance degree by acquiring the raw material processing process parameters of a target factory, thereby timely adjusting the raw material processing process, effectively reducing unnecessary carbon emission sources, laying a solid foundation for reducing the whole carbon emission, collecting the waste gas treatment process parameters of the target factory, scientifically evaluating the waste gas treatment efficiency, and the waste gas treatment process is optimized and regulated, so that the waste gas purification efficiency is obviously improved, the carbon emission is further reduced, finally, the abnormal condition in the carbon emission process can be early warned in real time by monitoring and collecting the carbon emission concentration related parameters of the target factory, measures are timely taken to regulate, the carbon emission control is ensured to be in a reasonable range, the carbon emission reduction process of the factory is forcefully promoted, and the powerful technical support is provided for constructing a low-carbon, environment-friendly and sustainable production mode.

title_en: Application of FBH1 protein in judging curative effect of auxiliary treatment of pancreatic neuroendocrine tumor postoperative somatostatin analogue
abstract_en: The invention discloses application of FBH1 protein in judging curative effect of auxiliary treatment of a pancreatic neuroendocrine tumor postoperative somatostatin analogue, and relates to the technical field of proteomics and clinical detection. The invention discovers that the disease-free survival time and the total survival time of the post-operation SSA auxiliary treatment group of PNETs patients with high-expression FBH1 are obviously superior to those of the non-auxiliary treatment group, and the relative content of the FBH1 protein in the tumor tissue of PNETs patients can be effectively evaluated whether the patients use SSA drug auxiliary treatment after operation or not by detecting the relative content of the FBH1 protein, thereby having great significance for the post-operation drug instruction of the patients.

title_en: Carbonate rock scale quality reservoir quantitative geological evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of lithofacies paleogeography and reservoir geology, in particular to a carbonate rock scale quality reservoir quantitative geology evaluation method, which comprises the following steps of firstly, determining the compilation of a carbonate rock facies base map; the method comprises the steps of identifying a carbonate paleogeographic pattern and a high-quality reservoir phase zone, quantitatively describing a high-quality reservoir sedimentary body, expressing a geological body structure, judging a reservoir space type, and analyzing a large-scale reservoir diagenetic effect and a diagenetic sequence. The invention can better perform carbonate rock scale quality reservoir quantitative geological evaluation.

title_en: Fluorescent compound, preparation method and application thereof, and method for labeling extracellular vesicles
abstract_en: The invention provides a fluorescent compound, a preparation method and application thereof, and a method for labeling extracellular vesicles, belonging to the technical field of biological medicines. The fluorescent compound provided by the invention comprises a cationic group and an anionic group, wherein the anionic group is selected from iodide ions, bromide ions or PF  6   ‑ , and the cationic group has a structure shown in a formula I. The fluorescent compound provided by the invention has higher extracellular vesicle marking efficiency, and the marked extracellular vesicles have higher fluorescence intensity.

title_en: Kit combination for screening urinary system diseases and application thereof
abstract_en: The application provides an SNCG immunochromatography test strip, application of a methylation detection composition in preparation of a kit for detecting urinary system diseases, and a kit combination.

title_en: D3 binding molecules and uses thereof
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides D3 binding molecules, including anti-D3 antibodies, and uses thereof.

title_en: Atomization water tank device with vertical angle and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vertical angle atomization water tank device and a control method thereof, wherein the atomization water tank device is used for a satellite simulation platform and comprises a tank body, a water absorption strip, an ultrasonic atomization assembly, a beam tube, a humidity sensor and a control board, wherein the tank body is connected with the satellite simulation platform, a water storage cavity is formed in the tank body, a water outlet channel is formed in one side of the water storage cavity, a limit groove is formed in the other side of the water storage cavity, the water absorption strip is arranged in the limit groove, one end of the water absorption strip extends to the bottom of the water storage cavity, the other end of the water absorption strip is bent and inserted into the water outlet channel, the ultrasonic atomization assembly is connected with the tank body, the beam tube is connected with the tank body and nested on the ultrasonic atomization assembly, the humidity sensor is arranged on the inner wall of the beam tube, and the control board is electrically connected with the ultrasonic atomization assembly and the humidity sensor. The water absorption strip is restrained by the limit groove and the water outlet channel, water at the bottom of the box body is sent to the ultrasonic atomization assembly, the utilization rate of water in the box body is improved, and the reality of satellite simulation is improved.

title_en: TiO (titanium dioxide)2/Au-C3N4Preparation method and application of heterojunction photoelectrochemical biosensor
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method and application of a TiO  2 /Au-C 3 N 4  heterojunction photoelectrochemical biosensor, comprising the steps of preparing TiO  2 /FTO, preparing TiO  2 /Au-C 3 N 4 , preparing a nucleic acid aptamer, preparing a sealing liquid mercapto hexanol and using the sealing liquid mercapto hexanol. The method comprises the steps of preparing a TiO  2  film by an electrophoretic deposition method, then combining the TiO  2  film with graphite-phase carbon nitride (g-C  3 N 4 ) doped with high-conductivity noble metal gold nanoparticles (Au NPs) to form a heterojunction, generating a regional surface plasmon resonance phenomenon by interaction of the Au NPs and photons under the illumination condition, forming a strong electromagnetic field and high-concentration high-energy carriers on the surface of a nano structure in the process, and obviously enhancing the photocurrent response of a composite material.

title_en: Aquaculture monitoring method and system adopting multi-mode sensing technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses an aquaculture monitoring method and system of a multi-mode sensing technology, which relate to the technical field of aquaculture, and are characterized in that a plurality of sensors are integrated according to the layout of an aquaculture farm and the flow condition of water bodies to form a multi-mode sensor array, the multi-mode sensor array periodically collects water body monitoring data, the water body monitoring data are segmented according to a preset period to extract monitoring sample data, the monitoring sample data are integrated by a data fusion algorithm to form a multi-dimensional monitoring data set, a self-adaptive fusion mechanism is introduced to adjust a fusion strategy according to the growth environment characteristics of different aquatic products, and the multi-dimensional monitoring data set is processed by a deep learning technology to obtain a monitoring result. The invention comprehensively evaluates the parameters of the aquatic products and the water quality, effectively improves the monitoring efficiency and accuracy of the environment and the water quality, and improves the survival rate and the quality of the aquatic products.

title_en: Shale mirror body reflectivity determination method and device based on neutron-density envelope area, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a shale vitrinite reflectivity determining method and device based on neutron-density envelope area, computer equipment and storage medium, and relates to the technical field of oil and gas exploration and development. According to the method, address characteristics of a research area and logging response rules are combined, the unit area of the compensated neutron and lithology density logging curve is calculated through the left scale and the right scale of the compensated neutron and lithology density logging curve of the fixed research area, then the enveloping area of the compensated neutron and lithology density logging curve is determined, and then a mathematical fitting model is adopted to establish the relation between the enveloping area and the reflectivity of the core analysis mirror body, so that the reflectivity of the shale mirror body of a pre-logging well is calculated rapidly and quantitatively. The method is simple in operation, strong in replicability, high in calculation progress, and good in universality and popularization value, and the calculation result meets the field requirements of the oil field, especially in old well review with insufficient data.

title_en: Rapid detection method, system and device for water pollution applied to underground water remediation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of water pollution detection and discloses a method, a system and a device for rapidly detecting water pollution, which are applied to underground water remediation, and comprise the following steps of acquiring concentration change curves corresponding to concentration data of target pollutants acquired by a plurality of position detection points in a plurality of sampling periods according to sampling frequency; analyzing the position trend degree of the concentration change of the target pollutant on different sampling periods according to the concentration change curves of the plurality of position detection points, calculating the environmental disturbance significant coefficients of the different position detection points according to the position trend degree of the different position detection points and the concentration change curves, dividing the concentration data of the different position detection points into a normal data set and an environmental disturbance data set according to the environmental disturbance significant coefficients, and completing the construction of a rapid detection prediction model for the groundwater remediation water pollution according to the normal data set and the environmental disturbance data set to realize the dynamic detection early warning of the groundwater remediation water pollution.

title_en: Method for identifying water utilization of taxus cuspidata vegetation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of moisture detection, and particularly discloses a method for identifying the utilization of water in taxus cuspidata vegetation; the invention collects xylem at the same position on the northeast yew in different growth stages as a sample, simultaneously samples soil and precipitation near the collection point, extracts water in plant xylem samples and soil samples in laboratory environment, detects and compares oxyhydrogen isotopes of water in plant samples, water in soil samples and water in precipitation samples, and determines the water utilization characteristics of the northeast yew in a very small population by selecting a sample plot, collecting and testing the sample, determining the water utilization sources and proportions of the plant water and utilizing a stable isotope method so as to better maintain the ecological stability of the northeast yew population.

title_en: Hydrogen detection circuit and automatic calibration method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydrogen detection circuit and an automatic calibration method, wherein the hydrogen detection circuit comprises a single chip microcomputer, a hydrogen sensor, a temperature and humidity sensor, a power supply module, a data storage module and an output module, wherein the hydrogen sensor, the temperature and humidity sensor, the power supply module, the data storage module and the output module are all connected with the single chip microcomputer, and a signal amplifying circuit is connected between the hydrogen sensor and the single chip microcomputer so as to amplify signals output by the hydrogen sensor and input the signals into the single chip microcomputer. According to the hydrogen detection circuit and the automatic calibration method, the weak signal of the hydrogen sensor is amplified by arranging the signal amplifying circuit between the hydrogen sensor and the singlechip, so that the detection of low-concentration hydrogen is realized, and the accuracy of the finally output hydrogen concentration data can be ensured to be higher by utilizing the automatic calibration of the calibration method.

title_en: Water quality early warning method and system based on buoy monitoring
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of big data processing, in particular to a water quality early warning method and system based on buoy monitoring, comprising the steps of collecting historical water quality parameters in a monitored water area, training a water quality prediction model according to the historical water quality parameters, collecting historical environment parameters in the monitored water area, calculating environment adjustment factors according to the historical environment parameters, collecting the water quality parameters and the environment parameters of a current monitoring period, correcting the environment adjustment factors according to the water quality parameters and the environment parameters of the current monitoring period, fusing the corrected environment adjustment factors into the trained water quality prediction model to obtain a corrected water quality prediction model, collecting the water quality parameters and the environment parameters of a next monitoring period in real time, inputting the water quality parameters collected in the next monitoring period into the corrected water quality prediction model to obtain an output value, and carrying out water quality prediction through the output value. The application can reduce the influence of natural environment factors on the monitoring precision, and improve the analysis precision of the water quality condition so as to perform accurate early warning.

title_en: Concrete durability detection method based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of concrete durability detection, in particular to a concrete durability detection method based on the Internet of things, which comprises the steps of receiving a durability detection instruction, confirming to-be-detected concrete according to the durability detection instruction, starting a pre-built concrete durability detection unit, acquiring environmental data by utilizing a data acquisition unit, acquiring detection data corresponding to-be-detected items based on the environmental data, confirming a fuzzy interval of the extracted to-be-detected items by utilizing a pre-built fuzzy database, calling a corresponding membership function, calculating membership according to the membership function and the detection data, summarizing membership of the to-be-detected concrete to obtain membership data, constructing a fuzzy rule base by utilizing a data analysis unit, calculating a durability risk value by utilizing the fuzzy rule base, judging the durability of the concrete according to a pre-built durability evaluation standard and the durability risk value, and finishing the durability detection of the concrete based on the Internet of things. The invention can improve the efficiency and accuracy of concrete durability detection.

title_en: Concrete durability detection method based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of concrete durability detection, in particular to a concrete durability detection method based on the Internet of things, which comprises the steps of receiving a durability detection instruction, confirming to-be-detected concrete according to the durability detection instruction, starting a pre-built concrete durability detection unit, acquiring environmental data by utilizing a data acquisition unit, acquiring detection data corresponding to-be-detected items based on the environmental data, confirming a fuzzy interval of the extracted to-be-detected items by utilizing a pre-built fuzzy database, calling a corresponding membership function, calculating membership according to the membership function and the detection data, summarizing membership of the to-be-detected concrete to obtain membership data, constructing a fuzzy rule base by utilizing a data analysis unit, calculating a durability risk value by utilizing the fuzzy rule base, judging the durability of the concrete according to a pre-built durability evaluation standard and the durability risk value, and finishing the durability detection of the concrete based on the Internet of things. The invention can improve the efficiency and accuracy of concrete durability detection.

title_en: Immunochromatography analyzer and detection analysis method
abstract_en: The invention provides an immunochromatography analyzer and a detection analysis method, which relate to the technical field of immunochromatography analysis and comprise test strips and photoelectric detection devices arranged corresponding to the test strips; the test strip adopts blue latex particles as an indicator and is provided with a quality control line, a test line and a blank part, and the photoelectric detection device comprises an orange light source and a cyan light source which are used for irradiating the quality control line, the test line and the blank part. According to the immunochromatography analyzer and the detection analysis method, the blue latex particles are used as the indicator, and the color is developed into blue after the sample is added, so that the color development influence of the wetting degree can be removed according to the color development condition of the blank part, and the immunochromatography analyzer can be tested under the cyan and orange illumination conditions respectively, so that the influence of blood and blood color can be removed, and the detection accuracy is improved.

title_en: High-voltage cable buffer layer ablation characteristic gas analysis and cable state grading evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of electric insulation detection of power equipment, and discloses a method and a system for analyzing ablation characteristic gas of a buffer layer of a high-voltage cable and evaluating the state of the cable in a grading way. The invention can provide accurate assessment through the relation between the gas composition and the concentration and the ablation degree, and helps to make a targeted maintenance and replacement plan. The invention can monitor and evaluate in time, reduce accident risk caused by cable faults and enhance the safety and reliability of the power system. The invention reduces the power failure and maintenance cost caused by sudden faults by finding out the problems in advance, thereby improving the overall economic benefit. The gas analysis data can provide basis for long-term monitoring and management of the cable running state, and support a more scientific maintenance strategy.

title_en: Ozone net generation rate analysis method and analysis device
abstract_en: The invention provides an analysis method and an analysis device for an ozone net generation rate, which belong to the technical field of air detection, and comprise the following steps of S10, covering the peripheries of a reaction cavity and a reference cavity with a transparent cover, S20, irradiating the transparent cover by adopting different incident angles to obtain corresponding ozone generation rates delta P1, delta P2, delta Pn, S30, removing the transparent cover, repeating the step S20 to obtain ozone generation rates delta P1', delta P2', delta Pn ', and S40, fitting delta P1, delta P2', delta Pn, delta P1', delta P2',.

title_en: Flash evaporation method nonwoven fabric uniformity detection method and device
abstract_en: The application discloses a flash evaporation method non-woven fabric uniformity detection method and device, relates to the field of cloth production detection, and can solve the technical problem of larger delay of the existing flash evaporation method non-woven fabric uniformity test method, and comprises the steps of obtaining rolling pressure data and light transmission intensity data of a detection sample; the method comprises the steps of carrying out time sequence analysis processing on rolling pressure data and light transmission intensity data to obtain a pressure change curve and a light transmission change curve, obtaining a uniformity curve of a detection sample based on an interpolation algorithm according to the pressure change curve and the light transmission change curve, marking outliers of the uniformity curve of the detection sample based on a maximum likelihood estimation method to obtain an outlier set, obtaining a clustering analysis result of the outlier set according to a clustering algorithm based on density, obtaining a uniformity detection result of the detection sample according to the clustering analysis result, and adjusting process parameters according to the uniformity detection result.

title_en: Urban water pollution detection method, device, equipment and medium based on multi-mode deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a medium for detecting urban water pollution based on multi-mode deep learning, which are characterized in that topological graph data taking a pollution monitoring sensor as a node and monitoring data as node data are constructed, the nodes are taken as topological centers, a first graph convolution neural network is adopted to process the graph data to obtain graph structural characteristics, a similarity matrix of each monitoring water area image is calculated, a second graph convolution network is adopted to process the similarity matrix and the graph structural characteristics to obtain pollution characteristics, the pollution detection result of each pollution monitoring sensor is predicted based on the pollution characteristics, and the improvement of the water pollution detection accuracy is facilitated by the dual-mode prediction of the monitoring water area image and the monitoring data.

title_en: Airport roof rainwater treatment monitoring system and method based on cloud computing
abstract_en: The invention discloses an airport roof rainwater treatment monitoring system and method based on cloud computing, relates to the technical field of rainwater monitoring, and solves the technical problems that under extreme weather conditions such as heavy rain and the like, a traditional drainage system is difficult to quickly drain accumulated water on a roof, and accumulated water is likely to overflow, so that normal operation of an airport is affected; the method comprises the steps of predicting the rainfall of a target area, determining a drainage pipeline combination according to the rainfall of the target area, obtaining the content of each element in rainwater, analyzing the water quality index of the rainwater, evaluating the pollution level of the rainwater based on the water quality index, conveying different water qualities to corresponding reservoirs based on the pollution level of the rainwater, and conveying different water qualities to corresponding filter tanks based on the pollution level of the rainwater.

title_en: Monoclonal antibody against Ki-67 protein and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of antibody preparation, and particularly relates to an anti-Ki-67 protein monoclonal antibody and application thereof. The amino acid sequences of the CDRs 1-3 of the light chain variable region of the monoclonal antibody are respectively shown as SEQ ID NO.3-5, and the amino acid sequences of the CDRs 1-3 of the heavy chain variable region are respectively shown as SEQ ID NO. 8-10. The monoclonal antibody provided by the invention can effectively identify Ki-67 protein expressed by cells/tissues, has good antigen binding specificity, higher affinity and excellent anti-interference capability, is favorable for greatly improving the accuracy, sensitivity and reliability of detecting whether the cells/tissues express Ki-67, has cross reactivity to human and mouse (including rats and mice) homologous Ki-67, and has wide detection applicability to Ki-67 proteins of different species.

title_en: Full-automatic detector for detecting food pesticide residues
abstract_en: The invention discloses a full-automatic detector for detecting food pesticide residues, which relates to the technical field of pesticide detection, and comprises a base, a power mechanism, a stirring mechanism and a detector, wherein the power mechanism is fixedly connected with the base, the power mechanism is in transmission connection with the stirring mechanism, the stirring mechanism is fixedly connected with the base, the stirring mechanism is communicated with the detector, the stirring mechanism is used for conveying sample liquid to the detector, and the detector is used for detecting food pesticide residues; during detection, firstly, the crushed sample is added into a stirring mechanism, then the extracting solution is added for stirring so as to promote precipitation of pesticide components in the sample, and finally, the liquid to be detected is introduced into a detector for detection.

title_en: Power distribution cabinet with dampproofing anticorrosive function
abstract_en: The application discloses a power distribution cabinet with a dampproof and corrosion-proof function, which belongs to the technical field of power distribution cabinets and is characterized by comprising a cabinet body, wherein an air inlet hole and an air outlet hole are formed in the side wall of the cabinet body, the air inlet hole and the air outlet hole are respectively formed in two sides of the cabinet body, a first fan for covering the air inlet hole is arranged in the cabinet body, an exhaust fan connected with the cabinet body is arranged in the air outlet hole, a circulation channel is formed in the cabinet body, a drying agent is filled in the circulation channel, a second fan connected with the cabinet body is arranged at a port of the circulation channel, a humidity sensor is connected to the inner wall of the cabinet body and used for detecting humidity in the cabinet body, and the humidity sensor is electrically connected with a control module which is electrically connected with the first fan, the second fan and the exhaust fan, so that the dampproof function of the power distribution cabinet is improved.

title_en: Microorganism fumigation device for soil detection
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of soil microorganism detection, and discloses a microorganism fumigation device for soil detection, which comprises a fumigation box, wherein an isolation plate is fixedly arranged at the bottom in the fumigation box, the isolation plate separates the fumigation box into a fumigation cavity and an isolation cavity, a central shaft is movably arranged at the center position of the top in the fumigation cavity, and a detection plate is movably arranged at the middle position of the central shaft through a reciprocating lifting piece.

title_en: Dynamic air pollution monitoring device and method
abstract_en: The application discloses a dynamic air pollution monitoring device and a method, and relates to the technical field of air monitoring. The application comprises a shell, a standpipe and a shell, wherein a PM2.5 sensor, a VOCs sensor and a receiving end of an optical sensor are arranged in the shell, and the receiving ends of the PM2.5 sensor, the VOCs sensor ‌ and the optical sensor are in signal connection with an information terminal. When the application is used, the threaded rod is driven by the handle rod, so that the accommodating shell is driven to move downwards, the accommodating shell gradually pushes the inclined block, the inclined block drives the pushing rod to push the blocking cover, the blocking cover releases the blocking of the pipe orifice of the side pipe, the external air flow enters the accommodating shell from the air inlet through the air suction fan, and is extracted from the vertical pipe from the air outlet through the air suction fan, and the accommodating shell gradually moves downwards, so that each sensor is driven to detect at different heights, thereby completing the monitoring of a monitoring place, and the accuracy of the monitoring is increased.

title_en: Gas measuring apparatus and gas measuring method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a gas measuring device (100) and a gas measuring method, which are capable of measuring the concentration of a component in a gas mixture (A), in particular the concentration of respiratory alcohol in a respiratory sample. The gas mixture (A) flows into a tubular inlet unit (1) which is detachably connected to the base body (6, 16). A portion of the gas mixture (A) is branched off and the gas sample (Gp) thus produced flows into the measurement chamber (2). A gas sensor (50) measures a measure for the concentration of a constituent in a gas sample (Gp). The gas sample (Gp) is branched off from the input unit (1) in an entry point (P.e) and enters the input unit (1) again in an exit point (p.a1) located downstream or into a channel to the environment. The measuring chamber (2) is connected to the two points (P.e, P.a1) by two different fluid-conducting units (3, 4).

title_en: Acridinium ester or alkaline phosphatase antibody, application thereof and chemiluminescent kit
abstract_en: The invention provides an acridinium ester antibody and an alkaline phosphatase antibody, wherein the acridinium ester antibody is an anti-acridinium ester monoclonal antibody, the amino acid sequence of the acridinium ester antibody is shown as any one of SEQ ID NO. 1-8, and the alkaline phosphatase antibody is an anti-alkaline phosphatase monoclonal antibody, and the amino acid sequence of the alkaline phosphatase antibody is shown as any one of SEQ ID NO. 9-14. The invention also provides application of the acridinium ester antibody and alkaline phosphatase antibody in preparing a chemiluminescent detection kit and the chemiluminescent detection kit. The antibody can be directly coupled with acridinium ester/alkaline phosphatase to form a complex without additional chemical method, thus greatly reducing operation steps and research and development investment, and meanwhile, the antibody has strong affinity with acridinium ester/alkaline phosphatase, good specificity, and the chemiluminescent reagent prepared by the bispecific antibody which is fusion expressed has better sensitivity and specificity and stronger signal value and stability.

title_en: Intestinal flora marker related to obesity, product and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intestinal flora marker related to obesity, a product and application thereof. The intestinal flora markers include smart faecalis Coprococcus catus, lacuna Lachnospiraceae bacterium, and ruminococcus Ruminococcus sp. The invention provides a kit, which comprises a detection reagent for detecting the intestinal flora marker. The invention also provides a product for diagnosing obesity and a computer program product related to obesity. The product provided by the invention has good feasibility and accuracy, can effectively evaluate the risk of obesity, and provides a new tool for clinical diagnosis.

title_en: Detection method and kit for N-protein of novel coronavirus
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of new coronavirus detection, in particular to a novel coronavirus N-protein detection method and a novel coronavirus N-protein detection kit, which are characterized in that an N-protein standard of a novel coronavirus is incubated and subjected to enzymolysis treatment, a high performance liquid chromatography tandem triple quadrupole mass spectrometry detection device is adopted for carrying out the enzymolysis treatment on the N-protein standard of the recombinant novel coronavirus, the content of the standard is taken as an abscissa, a novel coronavirus inactivated vaccine sample to be detected is incubated and subjected to enzymolysis treatment, then the supernatant after enzymolysis is detected, and the concentration of the novel coronavirus N protein in the inactivated vaccine sample to be detected can be obtained by quantifying the area of a sub-ion peak of a peptide section. The method effectively avoids the possible interference factors such as virus protein structural change, protein modification, matrix effect and the like in the novel coronavirus inactivated vaccine sample, and is suitable for detecting the N protein content in intermediate products and finished products of each stage of the novel coronavirus inactivated vaccine.

title_en: Fusion protein for detecting aquaporin 4 antibody and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a fusion protein for detecting aquaporin 4 antibody, a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of aquaporin 4 antibody detection. The nucleotide sequence of the fusion protein is shown as SEQ ID NO.5, and the fusion protein is used as a coating antigen, so that the M1 type aquaporin 4 and the M23 type aquaporin 4 can be detected simultaneously, and the sensitivity and the accuracy of detecting the aquaporin 4 antibody are high and the repeatability is good. When the kit is used for aquaporin 4 antibody, the detection method is simple and quick, and is suitable for large-scale screening of aquaporin 4 antibody in clinic and scientific research.

title_en: Application of CREPT as treatment response index for predicting anti-gastric cancer immunotherapy
abstract_en: The invention relates to application of CREPT gene expression as a therapeutic response index for predicting anti-gastric cancer immunotherapy, wherein CREPT expression level predicts therapeutic response effect of gastric cancer immunotherapy, and when CREPT gene expression and PD-L1 expression are further used together as the therapeutic response index for predicting anti-gastric cancer immunotherapy, CREPT expression level is low and PD-L1 expression predicts good therapeutic response effect of gastric cancer immunotherapy. The therapeutic response index of the invention has high sensitivity and specificity, and can accurately predict the therapeutic response effect of anti-gastric cancer immunotherapy.

title_en: Synchronous detection device for total ions and calcium and magnesium ions in fracturing water and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of oilfield chemical water quality detection, in particular to a synchronous detection device for total ions and calcium and magnesium ions in fracturing water and a use method thereof, wherein the synchronous detection device comprises a sampling unit, a sampling unit and a detection unit, the sampling unit comprises a sampling pump, the sampling unit comprises a buffer tank, a precipitator storage tank and a precipitator metering pump, the detection unit comprises a first conductivity meter, a second conductivity meter and a turbidity meter, the sampling pump inlet is fixedly connected with a sampling pipeline, a heating pipeline is fixedly communicated between the sampling pump outlet and the first inlet of the buffer tank, the bottom outlet of the buffer tank is fixedly communicated with a reinjection pipeline, the inlet of the precipitant storage tank is fixedly communicated with a precipitant feeding pipeline, the precipitant storage tank is fixedly communicated with the second inlet of the buffer tank, and a precipitant feeding pipeline is fixedly arranged on the precipitant feeding pipeline. The invention can rapidly measure the water performance parameters for fracturing on line, improves the construction efficiency and has wide popularization prospect.

title_en: Virus antigen detection method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a virus antigen detection method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, which relate to the technical field of detection, and are used for acquiring any virus antigen fluorescent image as a current fluorescent image, carrying out noise reduction treatment on the current fluorescent image on RGB three channels by adopting a time-space domain combined method, inputting the noise reduced fluorescent image into a trained convolutional neural network model to obtain a positive cell detection result of the fluorescent image, and finally obtaining the virus antigen detection result based on the positive cell detection result. The invention effectively solves the problems of low detection efficiency and low accuracy of detection results in the traditional antigen detection method, and can effectively avoid the influence of human factors, thereby obtaining more accurate detection results and improving the sensitivity, accuracy and reliability of virus antigen detection.

title_en: Monoclonal antibody for sandwich detection of testosterone and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a monoclonal antibody for sandwich detection of testosterone, a preparation method and application thereof, and the monoclonal antibody comprises the steps of S1, preparing testosterone-3- (O-carboxymethyl) oxime, activating the testosterone-3- (O-carboxymethyl) oxime, taking testosterone antibody P2G1 after activation, dropwise adding activated testosterone-3- (O-carboxymethyl) oxime according to a proportion for reaction to prepare immunogen, S2, immunizing an animal based on the prepared immunogen, S3, fusing spleen cells and myeloma cells of the immunized animal into hybridoma cells, selecting real hybridoma cells, and S4, separating and purifying antibodies from the hybridoma cells. The invention provides a preparation method of a raw material and a reagent for testosterone sandwich method detection, solves the problems of insufficient sensitivity, narrow detection range and poor specificity of a small molecular compound testosterone competition method reagent, and provides a new thought and a new method for rapid and accurate testosterone detection.

title_en: Experimental method for researching influence of MPN patient bone marrow supernatant on MPN disease progress
abstract_en: The invention discloses an experimental method for researching the influence of bone marrow supernatant of an MPN patient on the progress of MPN diseases, relates to the technical field of myeloproliferative neoplasms, provides a new idea for MPN treatment, and comprises the following steps of separating and culturing primary mononuclear cells (MNC) of the MPN patient or using TF1 and HEL cell lines as alternative models, separating CD14+ mononuclear cells and CD34+ hematopoietic stem/progenitor cells by an immunomagnetic bead sorting technology, treating the TF1 and HEL cell lines by using bone marrow supernatant of the MPN patient, analyzing the influence of the bone marrow supernatant on cell proliferation, apoptosis and phenotype, and carrying out proteomic and transcriptomic analysis. The invention can accurately separate and analyze monocyte subgroup changes in the bone marrow of MPN patients, in particular to Intermediate Monocytes (IM) and non-classical monocytes (NCM), and screen key targets affecting the progress of MPN diseases through histologic analysis.

title_en: Aptamer combined with Bst DNA polymerase and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biology, and discloses a nucleic acid aptamer combined with BstDNA polymerase and application thereof. The nucleic acid aptamer provided by the invention has higher Bst enzyme affinity, can specifically identify and bind with the Bst enzyme, and protect the active site of the Bst enzyme, so that the nucleic acid aptamer is used as a hot start molecule of the Bst enzyme, and can also improve the reaction activity of the Bst enzyme and prolong the preservation time of the Bst enzyme.

title_en: CA15-3 antigen binding protein and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a CA15-3 antigen binding protein and application thereof, wherein the CA15-3 antigen binding protein comprises a heavy chain variable region and a light chain variable region, the heavy chain variable region comprises CDR3 with a sequence shown as SEQ ID NO.7 or SEQ ID NO.13, and the light chain variable region comprises CDR3 with a sequence shown as SEQ ID NO.10 or SEQ ID NO. 16. The CA15-3 antigen binding protein is a rabbit monoclonal antibody, and compared with a mouse antibody and a polyclonal antibody, the rabbit antibody has higher affinity and stronger specificity naturally, the antibody obtained by combination has strong specificity and high accuracy, and the obtained CA15-3 antigen binding protein can be matched and applied to diagnosis of breast cancer.

title_en: Colorectal cancer large-division radiotherapy relapse-resistant cell strain and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a colorectal cancer large-division radiotherapy relapse-resistant cell strain and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of cell biology. The colorectal cancer large-division radiotherapy relapse-resistant cell strain is preserved in China center for type culture Collection with a preservation address of China university of Wuhan and China with a preservation number of CCTCC NO: C202533 at 1 month and 2 days. The invention provides a new biological material for researching colorectal cancer resisting recurrence by constructing colorectal cancer large-division radiotherapy recurrence-resisting cell strains. The cell strain is screened in a body of a mice with sound immune system, has better physiological relevance, and is beneficial to researching the influence of immune microenvironment on tumor cell radiotherapy resistance and the remodelling effect of radiotherapy resistant cells on the immune microenvironment. The cell line can also monitor the recurrence of tumor after radiotherapy in real time through fluorescence imaging.

title_en: Application of reagent for detecting aging-related metabolites in preparation of products for detecting aging of mammals
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biomedicine, and particularly discloses application of a reagent for detecting aging-related metabolites in preparation of a product for detecting aging of mammals. The senescence-associated metabolite is PEN ITREM A and/or UDP-N-acetylglucosamine. The invention achieves differentiation between young and aged individuals by detecting PEN ITREM A and/or UDP-N-acetylglucosamine content, and detects the degree of aging.

title_en: Multi-parameter integrated detection method, device, terminal and storage medium for frozen soil
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-parameter integrated detection method, device, terminal and storage medium for frozen soil, and belongs to the technical field of frozen soil detection. The method comprises the steps of obtaining soil temperature data of an area to be detected, inputting the soil temperature data into a pre-trained multi-parameter detection model to obtain the water content of the soil of the area to be detected, the ice content of the soil, the heat conductivity coefficient of the soil and the volumetric heat capacity of the soil, wherein the multi-parameter detection model is obtained by training a PINN model based on a pre-constructed data set, the training process of the multi-parameter detection model comprises the steps of constructing a one-dimensional unsteady state heat conduction equation according to the soil temperature data of a frozen soil sample, constructing a loss function according to the one-dimensional unsteady state heat conduction equation, and training when the loss function reaches convergence, so as to obtain the multi-parameter detection model. The invention can detect various parameters in frozen soil at the same time.

title_en: Application of T-bet+CD8+T cells as markers in preparation of medicines for treating digestive tract tumors
abstract_en: The invention discloses an application of T-bet+CD8+T cells as markers in preparation of medicines for treating digestive tract tumors. Specifically, the content level of T-bet+CD8+ T cells in a sample is measured, and the therapeutic effectiveness of the PD-1 signal inhibitor (ICI) for digestive tract tumor is determined according to whether the expression of the T-bet+CD8+ T cells is positive. The present invention has the long-standing clinical problem of lack of accurate prediction of MSS GC response to ICI by layering microsatellite stabilized gastric cancer (MSS GC) patients into MSS potential responders (MSS-PRs) and MSS non-responders (MSS-NRs) through positive-unlabeled (PUL) semi-supervised machine learning. The invention identifies that the infiltration of T-bet+CD8+T cells in tumor areas is a key for determining the effectiveness of ICI treatment of MSS-PRs patients, and proves that the adoptive treatment of T-bet+CD8+T cells can make tumors of immune deserts sensitive to ICI. The invention shows how advanced machine learning is effectively applied to medical research, and solves the clinical problem which is challenging originally by accurately screening ICI treatment beneficiary groups in MSS GC and improving immune microenvironment of the immune desert MSS GC to enlarge two dimensions of the ICI treatment beneficiary groups.

title_en: Hybridoma cell strain secreting dichlormid monoclonal antibody and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a hybridoma cell strain secreting a dichlormid monoclonal antibody and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of immunodetection. The monoclonal antibody secreted by the hybridoma cell strain has good sensitivity to the dichlormid, and the IC  50  of the monoclonal antibody to the dichlormid is 1.13ng/mL, so that the monoclonal antibody can detect trace dichlormid. In addition, the monoclonal antibody of the invention has no cross reaction on structural analogues of the dichlormid, such as the alachlor, the acetochlor, the metazachlor, the propanil, the diquat and the diuron, so that the monoclonal antibody of the invention can accurately detect the low-concentration dichlormid.

title_en: Fe3O4Nano particle @ Au-WGA, preparation method thereof, SERS label and detection product
abstract_en: The invention provides Fe  3 O 4  @Au-WGA nanoparticles, a preparation method thereof, SERS labels and detection products, and particularly relates to the technical field of nano materials. The Fe  3 O 4  @Au-WGA nanoparticle sequentially comprises a Fe  3 O 4  inner core, a polymer layer, a nano Au layer, a first Raman molecular layer, an Au shell layer, a second Raman molecular layer and a WGA molecular layer from inside to outside, and has stronger paramagnetic property, stable structure and monodispersity.
