The two Raman molecule layers can generate stable and strong SERS signals, and the outer Raman molecule layer is connected with WGA molecules, so that the A virus and the S.pneumoniae can be captured simultaneously. The invention also aims to provide SERS labels and detection products based on the Fe  3 O 4  @Au-WGA nanoparticles so as to improve a detection method and detection products based on Raman spectrum.

title_en: Multi-sensor water quality automatic detection dynamic feedback system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-sensor water quality automatic detection dynamic feedback system and a multi-sensor water quality automatic detection dynamic feedback method, relates to the technical field of automatic monitoring, and is used for solving the problems of accuracy and timeliness of water quality monitoring in a complex water area environment, and high-efficiency monitoring and accurate judgment of water quality are achieved through reasonable arrangement of sensors and data fusion and evaluation. Firstly, the system selects and arranges a plurality of types of sensors according to the characteristics of water areas, climate conditions and other factors, and collects water quality parameter data. Secondly, aligning time sequence data of water quality parameters by using a dynamic time warping algorithm through a data processing and fusion module, and completing fusion processing of different water quality data by combining a weighted summation method. And finally, comprehensively analyzing the fused data by the water quality assessment and decision module by adopting an evidence theory, judging the water quality grade according to the maximum probability, and providing dynamic feedback according to the monitoring result.

title_en: Sand pebble stratum catastrophe grouting control virtual-real blending cooperative test method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of grouting simulation tests, in particular to a method and a system for a disaster grouting control virtual-real blending cooperative test of a sandy pebble stratum, wherein the method comprises the steps of developing a grouting test on a sandy pebble stratum simulation model, and acquiring grouting parameters and monitoring parameters in the grouting process; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a slurry diffusion path and a diffusion range of a region with higher surrounding rock grade based on resistivity and radar data, obtaining a slurry diffusion path and a diffusion range of a region with lower surrounding rock grade based on resistivity and optical fiber sensing data, inputting initial grouting parameters into a neural network model after training to obtain simulation data, respectively preprocessing and aligning the past data, performing fusion analysis, and performing pre-control adjustment on grouting equipment parameters and grouting schemes according to fusion analysis results. Realizing the instant regulation and control of grouting scheme and equipment.

title_en: Comprehensive real-time monitoring experiment system and experiment method for lubrication state
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lubrication state comprehensive real-time monitoring experiment system and an experiment method, wherein the comprehensive real-time monitoring experiment system comprises a motion supporting mechanism, a loading mechanism, a film thickness observation mechanism and a wear observation mechanism, the experimental system can synchronously and real-timely measure a series of data such as oil film thickness, lubricating grease form, friction coefficient, wear rate and the like, and the data can be used as some parameters for monitoring the lubrication state.

title_en: Chinese herbal medicine planting soil detection method and system
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a system for detecting Chinese herbal medicine planting soil, wherein the method comprises the steps of dividing a target soil area, collecting and obtaining gradient parameter distribution and illumination parameter distribution, collecting Chinese herbal medicine growth parameters in historical time to obtain historical growth parameter distribution, conducting influence compensation on the historical growth parameter distribution according to the illumination parameter distribution to obtain compensated growth parameter distribution, conducting nutrient consumption classification to obtain actual soil nutrient distribution of the target soil area, conducting non-uniformity analysis according to the gradient parameter distribution to obtain non-uniformity distribution, conducting non-uniformity analysis according to the illumination parameter distribution and the actual soil nutrient distribution to obtain area non-uniformity, conducting soil detection point setting optimization according to the non-uniformity distribution and the area non-uniformity to obtain optimized soil detection point distribution. Solves the technical problems of unreliable and inaccurate detection of the Chinese herbal medicine planting soil in the prior art.

title_en: Coal wet separation experimental device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coal experiments, and provides a coal wet separation experiment device which comprises a detection frame, wherein a liquid storage barrel is arranged below the detection frame, an opening is formed above the liquid storage barrel, flushing liquid is stored in the liquid storage barrel, a screen drum is arranged on the detection frame in a lifting manner, the screen drum is arranged above the liquid storage barrel, a screen is arranged on the screen drum, and the screen drum is close to or far away from the liquid storage barrel after lifting. Through the technical scheme, the problem that the difficulty of simulating solvent to flush coal samples by operators in the prior art is high, so that the detection efficiency is low is solved.

title_en: Rice culture system based on dynamic visual detection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rice cultivation system based on dynamic visual detection, which comprises a monitor, an analysis system, a file management system, a display device, an information confirmation system and a control device, wherein the monitor comprises an image shooting device and a soil monitoring device, the analysis system comprises a comparison system, a data self-checking system and a retrieval system, the image shooting device is used for shooting rice planting, whether the rice has diseases and insect pests or not is confirmed through pictures, and the soil monitoring device is used for detecting soil information of the rice planting position. This rice culture system based on dynamic vision detects has set up image capture device, shoots the rice, can show the image through display device simultaneously, and the user can observe it this moment, and soil monitoring device can detect the humidity and the acid-base nature of soil simultaneously, and the different aspect of many is monitored along with the growth of rice, improves the practicality of device.

title_en: Compounds and their use for detecting diseases in exhaled breath of a subject
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a compound of formula X  m -(Y-L-T) n  and a method for detecting or prognosing a disease in the exhaled breath of a subject. X is a moiety operable when present to target the compound to a target site in the body, m is 0 or at least 1, Y is a cleavable group, L is a self-sacrificing linker, T is a capping moiety, and n is 1 when m is 0 or at least 1 when m is at least 1, L is a self-sacrificing linker. The capping moiety T may comprise an isotopically labelled reporter or precursor thereof. The reporter is operable to be released upon cleavage of the cleavable group Y, and the reporter is a volatile compound upon release.

title_en: Efficient bitter gourd seedling stage cold resistance identification method
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-efficiency bitter gourd seedling stage cold tolerance identification method which is characterized by comprising the steps of selecting bitter gourd seeds, carrying out scalding treatment, sowing the seeds to be pretreated in a precooled seedling substrate after being exposed to white, carrying out low-temperature stress at 8-12 ℃ for at least 5d, and judging whether the sample to be tested is a cold tolerance bitter gourd germplasm according to the activity change of superoxide dismutase of the sample to be tested, wherein the activity change of the superoxide dismutase is that the activity of the superoxide dismutase is measured for at least 5d for at least 3 times under the condition that the temperature is 8-12 ℃, and the activity of the SOD enzyme is gradually enhanced along with the prolongation of the low-temperature stress time of 8-12 ℃, so that the higher the activity of the SOD enzyme is, the higher the cold tolerance level of the bitter gourd germplasm is judged.

title_en: Non-porous microsphere and specific adsorption column containing same
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-porous microsphere and a specific adsorption column containing the microsphere, compared with the commonly used microsphere of a coupled antibody, the coupled antibody has the advantages of immunogenicity, poor safety, long research and development period of a monoclonal antibody, high input cost, firm microsphere loading and good adsorptivity, the prepared specific adsorption column realizes specific adsorption through the microsphere contained in the column, and captures target molecules IL-16, TNF-alpha, C5a, MMP-8 and IL-3 with high affinity to the microsphere through coupling nucleic acid molecules on the surface of the microsphere.

title_en: Water quality monitoring method and system based on AI optical sensor
abstract_en: The application provides a water quality monitoring method and system based on an AI optical sensor, and relates to the field of water quality monitoring. In addition, by establishing a dynamic mapping of the spectral features and the environmental timing features, space-time decoupling of the interference components is achieved. That is, by learning the mapping relation between the time sequence characteristics of the water body parameters and the spectrum interference, the environment interference analysis is performed in a characteristic matching mode, so that the problem that the influence of the environment parameters on the spectrum has time delay is solved, the spectrum interference at the current moment can be predicted more accurately, the interference of the water body environment factors on the spectrum signal can be eliminated or weakened from the original spectrum data, and the purer water body component spectrum characteristic information and the purer water quality category information can be obtained.

title_en: Immunoassay for detection of bioactive proteins
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a pure-plain immunoassay for the detection of biologically active antigens, a device in which such an immunoassay is arranged, a kit comprising such a device, as well as the use of such an immunoassay and a method for the detection of biologically active antigens.

title_en: Compositions and methods involving integrin alpha 3 beta 1
abstract_en: Compositions and methods comprising antibodies that bind to integrin α3β1 are provided.

title_en: Photo-excitation chemiluminescence immunoassay method for small molecular substances and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a photo-excited chemiluminescence immunoassay method of a small molecular substance and application thereof, wherein the photo-excited chemiluminescence immunoassay method comprises the steps of constructing a marker-long chain molecule-competitive small molecular compound as a competitor of the small molecular substance to be detected, and detecting the small molecular substance by adopting a competition method, wherein the molecular weight of the marker-long chain molecule-competitive small molecular compound is 1500 Da-20000 Da. The light-activated chemiluminescence immunoassay method has higher signal value and discrimination degree for detecting the small molecular substances, is simple to operate, and can be applied to detecting the small molecular substances with the molecular weight of less than 1000 Da.

title_en: Kit for detecting mycotoxin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kit for detecting mycotoxin, which comprises a box body, an outer baffle, an inner baffle, a sealing cover, a motor, a rotating shaft, a rotating assembly, an expanding assembly and a material guiding assembly, wherein the box body is arranged on an experiment table, the outer baffle and the inner baffle are both fixed on the upper end face of the box body, the inner baffle is positioned in the outer baffle, the sealing cover is sealed and detachably arranged at the upper ends of the outer baffle and the inner baffle, the motor is fixedly arranged at the center of the upper end face of the box body, an output shaft of the motor rotates to penetrate through the box body, the rotating shaft is fixed at the output end of the motor, the rotating assembly is arranged at the bottom in the box body, the expanding assembly is arranged in the middle in the box body, and the material guiding assembly is arranged at the top in the box body.

title_en: Sewage detection and analysis method based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sewage detection analysis method based on the Internet of things, which particularly relates to the technical field of sewage detection, wherein a multisource sensor is deployed in a sewage treatment system, pollutant and environmental parameter data are collected, characteristic extraction is carried out by means of a cloud platform, a concentration change rate fluctuation value and a relative proportion anomaly value are constructed and are used for comprehensively evaluating the dynamic prediction capability of a traditional machine learning model in a space-time dimension, model capturing accuracy grades are divided according to evaluation results, an anomaly detection algorithm is introduced for carrying out performance optimization on an incomplete accurate model, so that the prediction precision and stability of the model in a complex pollutant space-time variation scene are remarkably improved, the accurate prediction of the concentration of the pollutant in the sewage is finally realized, and the intelligent response capability and the operation efficiency of the sewage treatment system are enhanced.

title_en: Nano antibody for specifically recognizing prostate cancer cell line 22RV1 and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biology, and particularly discloses a group of nano antibodies for specifically recognizing a prostate cancer cell line 22RV1 and application thereof, which are technically characterized in that the nano antibodies are nano antibody molecules with high specificity and affinity of the prostate cancer cell line 22RV1, and comprise A1, B1, C1, D1 and E1, wherein the sequences of the nano antibodies are respectively shown in SEQ ID NO.1, SEQ ID NO.2, SEQ ID NO.3, SEQ ID NO.4 and SEQ ID NO.5, and the amino acid sequences of the nano antibodies are respectively shown in SEQ ID NO.6, SEQ ID NO.7, SEQ ID NO.8, SEQ ID NO.9 and SEQ ID NO. 10. The invention obtains the high-affinity nano antibody molecule of the prostate cancer cell 22RV1 specificity by utilizing the method of separating the specific antibody through in vitro affinity screening enrichment by utilizing the constructed high-capacity phage display nano antibody library, has the characteristics of low immunogenicity, high affinity, strong tissue penetration, easy transformation, high stability, low production cost and the like, and provides a basis for diagnosis, antibody coupling drug treatment and drug evaluation of the prostate cancer.

title_en: Method for evaluating condensate gas cause mode of coal-based stratum
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of analysis of condensate gas causes of coal-based strata, in particular to a method for evaluating a condensate gas cause mode of a coal-based strata, which aims to avoid errors caused by natural gas maturity calculated by natural gas delta  13 C 1 , efficiently study the condensate gas causes of the coal-based strata at low cost, and comprehensively evaluate the condensate gas causes of the coal-based strata by carrying out natural gas source comparison in the coal-based strata through natural gas delta  13 C 1  and a natural gas drying coefficient C  1 /C 1‑5 , determining the organic matter type and maturity distribution stage of the coal-based hydrocarbon source rocks by characteristic biomarker compounds, determining whether the condensate gas can be generated by the coal-based hydrocarbon source rocks per se or not, and combining the condensate gas generation of the coal-based hydrocarbon source rocks type, the oil source comparison and the hydrocarbon source rocks per se according to the distribution characteristics of PVT phase states of the oil-based hydrocarbon reservoirs in the oil-gas reservoir section.

title_en: Preparation method and application of 7-hydroxy anisodamine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of pharmaceutical chemical industry, in particular to a preparation method and application of 7-hydroxy anisodamine. The preparation method of 7-hydroxy anisodamine provides a qualified 7-hydroxy anisodamine reference substance for the research of anisodamine hydrobromide bulk drug and the impurities of the preparation thereof, has high purity, can be used as a reference substance for the quality control of anisodamine hydrobromide bulk drug and the preparation thereof, is beneficial to improving the quality control of anisodamine hydrobromide bulk drug and the preparation thereof and the safety of the drug, and is also beneficial to timely treating the anisodamine hydrobromide bulk drug and the preparation thereof which do not reach the standard and reducing the storage cost.

title_en: Nanometer antibody targeting staphylococcus aureus and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a targeted staphylococcus aureus nano antibody and application thereof. The invention obtains a pair of staphylococcus aureus nanobody pairs with good pairing effect through nanobody phage library construction and phage screening technology, and constructs a detection kit based on sandwich ELISA for detecting actual living bacteria in food. The nano antibody disclosed by the invention has the advantages of high affinity and high specificity when being combined with staphylococcus aureus, good stability, low cost and the like compared with a monoclonal antibody, can be produced in a large scale, and has wide application prospect in the field of staphylococcus aureus detection and analysis. The detection kit disclosed by the invention can realize the detection limit of 4.27-10  4  cfu/ml.

title_en: Fruit preservative detection method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of preservative detection, in particular to a fruit preservative detection method, which comprises the steps of extracting corresponding surface characteristics by calling state data of surface fruits in a box body before transportation, detecting the surface fruits at a first transportation intermediate station, identifying the corresponding real-time surface characteristics, determining a surface deviation value by combining the surface characteristics, analyzing attachment quality characterization parameters of the surface fruits by combining the surface particle density of the surface fruits to mark the box body, detecting and analyzing the fruits in the box body, acquiring attachment change characteristics of the surface fruits attached to abnormal stations, evaluating whether the fruits in the box body meet attachment falling standards, judging whether the fruits in the box body have attachment defects or not, marking the attachment abnormal stations and sending out prompt signals, acquiring the transportation distance between the marked attachment abnormal stations and a transportation destination station, determining whether secondary smearing of attachments is carried out on the fruits in the box body, and dynamically and accurately evaluating the effectiveness of the fruit preservative in the transportation process.

title_en: The method comprises the following steps of240Measurement method and measurement structure for Pu to-be-measured sample equivalent mass
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a measuring method and a measuring structure for equivalent quality of  240  Pu samples to be measured, wherein the measuring method comprises the following steps of sequentially placing a plurality of  240  Pu standard sources with different equivalent quality in the measuring structure to obtain a first counting rate of each  240  Pu standard source. And obtaining a relation curve according to the equivalent quality of each  240  Pu standard source and the first counting rate. And measuring  240  Pu of a second counting rate of the sample to be measured through the measuring structure. And obtaining the equivalent mass of the  240  Pu sample to be measured according to the relation curve and the second counting rate. The measuring method of the embodiment of the application has higher measuring precision.

title_en: Device and system for detecting bearing capacity of expressway
abstract_en: The invention discloses a detection device and a detection system for the bearing capacity of an expressway, which belong to the field of road construction and comprise an equipment control module, a detection module, a calculation module, a transmission module and a prediction module, wherein the detection module comprises an environment detection module and a performance test module, the environment detection module comprises a drying detection unit, a humidity detection unit and a cold detection unit which respectively correspond to three different environment conditions, the performance test module comprises a pavement performance test unit, a structure test unit and a material performance test unit, and the system can automatically select a proper detection mode according to different environment conditions through flexible design of the drying, humidity and cold detection units.

title_en: Indirect ELISA kit for detecting bovine nodular skin disease virus antibody
abstract_en: The invention provides an indirect ELISA kit for detecting bovine nodular skin disease virus antibodies, which comprises a coating antigen, wherein the coating antigen is bovine nodular skin disease virus 095 protein with an amino acid sequence shown as SEQ ID NO. 1. The kit has the characteristics of high sensitivity, strong specificity and good stability, can be used for LSDV infection and vaccine immunity condition assessment, and has important significance for effective epidemic disease prevention and control.

title_en: Antibody for detecting GDF9 of black-bone Mu Qin sheep and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: Antibody for detecting GDF9 of black-bone Mu Qin sheep and preparation method and application thereof. The invention discloses an antibody for detecting GDF9 of a sheep with black beads Mu Qin. The antibody comprises a monoclonal antibody A, a nucleic acid aptamer B and a nucleic acid aptamer B, wherein the monoclonal antibody A can be combined with an epitope of Wu Zhumu sheep GDF9, the amino acid sequence of the epitope is shown as SEQ ID NO. 1, the full-length sequence of a light chain of the antibody is shown as SEQ ID NO. 2, the full-length sequence of a heavy chain of the antibody is shown as SEQ ID NO. 3, the sequence of a variable region of the light chain of the antibody is shown as SEQ ID NO. 4, the sequence of the variable region of the heavy chain of the antibody is shown as SEQ ID NO. 5, the amino acid sequence of the epitope is shown as SEQ ID NO. 6, and the amino acid sequence of the nucleic acid aptamer B is shown as SEQ ID NO. 7. The antibody of the invention can form double recognition, improve the specificity of the antibody, effectively distinguish the cytokine from other cytokines and avoid false positive.

title_en: Promoter, recombinant vector, adeno-associated virus and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a promoter, a recombinant vector, adeno-associated virus and application thereof. The promoter is used for identifying and/or regulating the level of the Dcc cells, and the nucleotide sequence of the promoter contains one of (1) the nucleotide sequence shown as SEQ ID NO.1 and (2) the nucleotide sequence shown as SEQ ID NO.1, which is obtained by substituting, deleting and/or adding one or more nucleotides on the basis of the core promoter sequence and has the same function, and is derived from the nucleotide sequence shown as SEQ ID NO. 1. The promoter is constructed by taking the Dcc genome DNA as a template, has stronger specificity, and can accurately identify the Dcc cells so as to regulate the level of the Dcc cells.

title_en: Biomarkers for aiding in diagnosis or diagnosis of graves 'eye disease and/or graves' disease
abstract_en: The invention provides a biomarker for assisting in diagnosing or diagnosing Graves ' eye diseases and/or Graves ' eye diseases, wherein the biomarker is used for identifying Graves ' eye diseases and/or Graves ' eye diseases and comprises tryptophan metabolites including indoxyl propionic acid, indole-3-lactic acid and/or indoleacetic acid, the novel study of the invention finds that the levels of the indoxyl propionic acid, the indole-3-lactic acid and the indoleacetic acid in serum of Graves ' eye diseases and Graves ' eye diseases are obviously reduced compared with a healthy control group, and the levels of the indoleacetic acid of Graves ' eye diseases are further reduced compared with Graves ' disease, and the tryptophan metabolites including the indoxyl propionic acid, the indole-3-lactic acid and/or the indoleacetic acid can be used for assisting in diagnosing or diagnosing Graves ' eye diseases and/or Graves ' disease and can be used as the biomarker for assisting in diagnosing or diagnosing Graves ' eye diseases.

title_en: Test method for detecting filtering capability of allergen in vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a test method for detecting in-vehicle allergen filtering capability, which comprises the steps of preparing target allergen suspension, arranging vehicle positions and sampling points in a test cabin, controlling the temperature, humidity and cleanliness of the test cabin, atomizing and guiding the allergen suspension into the test cabin, uniformly mixing, collecting the concentration of the allergen inside and outside the test cabin, calculating the concentration ratio (I/Q) of the allergen aerosol in the test cabin and the allergen aerosol outside the vehicle in the collected gas, classifying the in-vehicle allergen filtering capability according to the concentration ratio (I/Q), and classifying the classes according to the range corresponding to the concentration ratio (I/Q) to judge the in-vehicle allergen filtering capability.

title_en: Corrugated paper waste water circulation processing apparatus
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a waste water treatment technical field, an embodiment of the present disclosure provides a corrugated paper waste water circulation processing apparatus, it is including handling the bucket, still include rabbling mechanism, the packing dish, collect the fill, the filter layer, a driving frame, return mechanism, vibrating motor, the return line, circulating pump and adsorption equipment, rabbling mechanism rotates and installs on handling the interior roof of bucket, the upside of handling the bucket is provided with and is used for driving rabbling mechanism pivoted driving piece, rabbling mechanism is used for the stirring to waste water and treating agent, the packing dish sets up in handling the inside of bucket, and be located rabbling mechanism's below. Through above-mentioned technical scheme for solve among the prior art waste water treatment facilities and carry out single processing to waste water generally, lead to not enough comprehensive to waste water's treatment, treatment effect is relatively poor, and single processing's treatment method is comparatively single, leads to not enough comprehensive to waste water's treatment, is difficult to carry out recycle's technical problem to waste water.

title_en: New material yarn quality detecting system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a new material yarn quality detection system, which relates to the technical field of new material yarn detection and comprises a yarn quality detection platform, wherein the yarn quality detection platform is in communication connection with a performance data acquisition module, a defect identification module, a yarn performance detection module, a comprehensive quality evaluation module and a visual display module, wherein the performance data acquisition module is used for acquiring physical and mechanical performance data of the new material yarn by utilizing an intelligent sensing system. According to the invention, through integrating an intelligent sensing technology, a machine learning algorithm and multi-module cooperative work, high-precision and high-efficiency detection of the new material yarn is realized, the appearance defect of the yarn is concerned in the detection process, the mechanical property and environmental adaptability of the yarn are deeply evaluated, the performance of the yarn under the mechanical property and environmental condition can be comprehensively analyzed, the use performance of the yarn is deeply known, and the special requirements of different fields on the yarn performance are met.

title_en: Monitor indicator system
abstract_en: A method of monitoring the concentration of a disinfectant in a solution includes providing a device including a plurality of sensors. The method continues to perform a calibration phase via the device, the calibration phase comprising placing the device in water without the disinfectant, wherein the device determines a temperature of the water, performs a water analysis, and measures a baseline resistance of the water via the at least one sensor. The method includes the steps of adding a sanitizing compound to water, and performing an operational phase by the device, wherein the device determines a resistance of the water having the sanitizing compound, calculating a concentration of the sanitizing compound in the water, wherein the concentration is based on a temperature of the water, a water analysis, and a baseline resistance, comparing the calculated concentration to a predetermined threshold concentration, and activating an indicator module of the device based on the comparison of the calculated concentration to the predetermined concentration.

title_en: Method for simulating degumming effect of silicon wafer degumming agent in laboratory
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for simulating the degumming effect of a silicon wafer degumming agent in a laboratory, which comprises the following steps of S1, selecting a cleaned thick sheet, measuring the thickness h  1  of the thick sheet, uniformly smearing a layer of glue on the surface of the thick sheet, simulating a diamond wire cutting process by a knife when the glue is semi-dry, uniformly scratching the glue layer, keeping the scratch distance to be 1mm, standing for two hours, completely drying the glue for completely drying, then breaking the thick sheet, and measuring the thickness h  2  of the thick sheet and the glue layer to obtain the thickness delta h=h  2 -h 1  of the glue layer. The method for simulating the degumming effect of the silicon wafer degumming agent in the laboratory can accurately evaluate the performance of the degumming agent, optimize the formula and the technological parameters of the degumming agent, develop the degumming agent with high efficiency, no toxicity and smell and low volatility, reduce the research and development cost, enhance the reliability of experimental results, obviously improve the success rate of subsequent on-machine verification, reduce the product research and development bend caused by simulation deviation, ensure the stability of industrial production, improve the quality and the productivity of the silicon wafer, reduce the cost and increase the efficiency.

title_en: Motor rotor colloid beating quality detection device and automatic motor assembly system
abstract_en: A motor rotor colloid beating quality detection device and an automatic motor assembly system belong to the technical field of material detection. The detection device comprises a support unit, a detection unit and a power unit, wherein the support unit is used for supporting a motor rotor, the detection unit comprises a vertical sliding rail, a movement seat, two detection supports and two groups of distance sensors, the movement seat is arranged on the vertical sliding rail and is matched with the vertical sliding rail in a sliding manner along the vertical direction, the two detection supports are connected with the movement seat and are distributed at intervals along a first direction, the two detection supports respectively correspond to two ends of adhesive tape materials in a rotor groove of the motor rotor, the two groups of distance sensors are oppositely arranged and are respectively arranged on the inner side surfaces of the bottoms of the two detection supports, and the power unit is in transmission connection with the movement seat and is used for driving the movement seat to lift. The detecting device detects the distribution condition of the adhesive tape material along the thickness direction of the adhesive tape material, and the detecting result can reflect the property of the adhesive tape material in the rotor groove, thereby being beneficial to more accurately evaluating the quality of the adhesive tape material.

title_en: Bispecific antibody for resisting CD38 and Nkp46 and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of immunology, and relates to a bispecific antibody for resisting CD38 and Nkp46 and application thereof. The bispecific antibody comprises (a) a first antigen-binding portion for specifically binding to CD38, and (b) a second antigen-binding portion for specifically binding Nkp to 46, the first and second antigen-binding portions being fused to each other. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the beneficial effects that the bispecific antibody of CD38 and Nkp46 is obtained by using a biological genetic engineering technology, and the ADCC effect is better.

title_en: Solid material element analysis equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses solid material element analysis equipment, and belongs to the technical field of coal element analysis. The utility model provides a solid material element analysis equipment, includes the base, the fixed first slide rail that is provided with in base top, first slide rail outside slip is provided with the second slide rail, second slide rail outside slip is provided with the expansion bracket, the expansion bracket bottom is flexible to be provided with the detecting head, through the removal of storage silo drive the shovel board with the tiny particle material after the analysis push the feed opening inside and finally fall to collect the storehouse inside collect, the effectual efficiency that has improved analysis, and through setting up stirring board, make stirring board rotate through rack and first gear engagement when removing, effectually avoided the unloading to jam, and through setting up baffle and arc surface, when the unloading, through baffle and arc surface cooperation, the even tiny particle material ration is distinguished, and through the even homogeneity of falling down of weeping hole, effectual improvement spread, and then improve the accuracy of analysis.

title_en: Special card support for microcolumn gel immunodetection card
abstract_en: The application discloses a special clamping support for a microcolumn gel immunodetection card, which belongs to the field of medical appliances and comprises a first clamping support and a second clamping support which is detachably connected with the first clamping support, wherein the first clamping support and the second clamping support are components with the same structure, the first clamping support also comprises support bars which are uniformly and fixedly connected to the outer surface of a lower connecting piece in an annular shape, one ends of the support bars are fixedly connected with centrifugal cylinders, the outer surfaces of the centrifugal cylinders which are annularly distributed are fixedly connected with a fixing ring together, detection card slots are formed in the centrifugal cylinders, and microcolumn gel detection cards are inserted into the centrifugal cylinders through the detection card slots. The application utilizes the support bars and the fixed rings to uniformly distribute and arrange the even number of centrifugal cylinders in a ring shape, can ensure that the distance between each centrifugal cylinder and the rotating shaft center is the same, further ensure that the mass moment is the same, finally ensure that the centrifugal forces are the same, ensure the accuracy of the detection result, and have convenient operation and improve the detection efficiency.

title_en: Nucleic acid aptamer for detecting transgenic component CP4-EPSPS protein in transgenic soybean
abstract_en: The invention provides a nucleic acid aptamer for detecting a transgenic component CP4-EPSPS protein in transgenic soybeans, wherein the nucleotide sequence of the nucleic acid aptamer is shown as SEQ ID No.1 or 2. The two aptamers have stronger specificity to the CP4 EPSPS protein, the detection limit can reach 2 ng/kg, the recovery rate is between 88.34% and 112.12%, the precision is 5.18%, and the repeatability is better.

title_en: Geotechnical test for simulating slope soil stress and deformation process and slope instability process analysis method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geotechnical test for simulating a slope soil stress deformation process and a slope instability process analysis method, which comprises the steps of (1) carrying out uniaxial compression on a core sample under the limited lateral limit action of an annular soil body in a large sample in a metal hoop, simulating a slope soil strip stress deformation process in a downhill direction, (2) applying shear load in the same direction, forming a cylindrical shear plane between the core sample and the annular soil body, simulating the slope soil strip stress deformation process in the downhill direction, (3) synchronously testing the suction force and the water content change process in the soil sample, (4) calculating compression deformation energy and shear deformation energy based on the test curve, and deducing and defining a slope stability safety coefficient by utilizing an energy conservation principle. The invention can simulate the slope soil strips, especially the deteriorated slope soil, by using the geotechnical test, and calculate the change process of the slope soil stability safety coefficient along with the shear deformation in the stress deformation development process of 'compression-shear-instability' along the slope direction, thereby reflecting the evolution process of the slope stability more truly.

title_en: Water quality monitoring device for environmental protection
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of water quality monitoring, and particularly relates to a water quality monitoring device for environmental protection. In order to solve the problem that the existing monitoring equipment cannot store water samples in time, each detection equipment is carried in a detection carrying cabin, a detected probe is installed in a detection pipe, when monitoring is carried out, the water samples without abnormality are discharged through a branch pipe, a detection system and a sample storage system are arranged when the water samples are abnormal, a butt joint pushing arm and an opening and closing pushing arm are utilized to butt joint a sample storage test tube with a liquid injection head, the water samples with the abnormal detection are stored in time, and a floating cabin can be lifted out of the sample storage cabin through a double-fork lifting base, so that the samples are convenient to transfer in time.

title_en: Flow property testing device for pickling corrosion inhibitor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pickling corrosion inhibitor flow performance testing device which comprises a liquid circulating device, a liquid flowing device and a first bracket, wherein the liquid circulating device comprises a first container, a second container and a liquid extracting assembly, the middle part inside the first container is fixedly connected with a partition plate, two liquid containing bins are symmetrically arranged inside the first container, the bottom end outside the second container is fixedly connected with a discharge pipe, the outer side of the second container is provided with a first fluoroplastic centrifugal pump, one end of the discharge pipe, which is far away from the second container, is fixedly arranged at the input end of the first fluoroplastic centrifugal pump, and the output end of the first fluoroplastic centrifugal pump is fixedly provided with a return pipe. According to the invention, various variable circulating systems are designed, so that different types of tests can be performed, including a circulating flow test, a different flow rate test and a multi-round reflux pickling solution test, and various test modes are realized through a set of devices.

title_en: Textile quality detection device and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a textile quality detection device and a method, which relate to the technical field of textile materials and comprise a workbench, a dustproof frame and limiting rollers, wherein the dustproof frame is arranged right above the workbench in a sliding manner through a bracket, the limiting rollers are arranged at two sides above the workbench in a sliding manner respectively, the two limiting rollers are used for clamping two ends of the to-be-detected fabric, a plurality of observation grooves are arranged below the inside of the dustproof frame, a positioning frame is arranged in the observation grooves in a sliding manner, and an upper magnetic ring is arranged at the lower end of the positioning frame. According to the invention, the cloth is horizontally laid and fed above the workbench, and then the two ends of the cloth are clamped and fixed through the two limiting rollers, the motor is driven to drive all the adjusting shafts to synchronously move downwards, all the positioning frames are driven to synchronously move downwards, so that different detection parts of the cloth are independently clamped and fixed, the detection modules at different positions are driven to realize quality detection of different positions of the cloth, detection steps of detection personnel for multiple detection modes of the same kind of cloth are saved, and the detection is more convenient.

title_en: Analysis method for influence of tuff on cement performance
abstract_en: The application provides an analysis method for influence of tuff on cement performance, and relates to the technical field of cement production. The method comprises the steps of S1, selecting a tuff-cement composite material with a specific proportion, S2, carrying out hydration reaction, recording hydration reaction conditions, S3, collecting a hydrated tuff-cement composite material sample, carrying out microstructure analysis, S4, evaluating the influence on the microstructure of a cement hydration product, S5, analyzing the influence of the blended tuff on cement according to an evaluation result, and systematically researching the influence of tuff powder blending on cement performance by mixing tuff with cement, carrying out hydration reaction, microstructure analysis and performance evaluation.

title_en: Bionic hydrophilic adsorbent for glycopeptide and phosphopeptide simultaneous enrichment and separation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biological analysis chemistry, in particular to a method for simultaneously enriching and separating glycopeptides and phosphopeptides by using a bionic hydrophilic adsorbent, which comprises the following steps of firstly, preparing a polyether ether ketone (PEEK) frame by using a fused deposition modeling method (FDM); step three, adding a mixed solution containing hyaluronic acid methacrylate, vinyl phosphoric acid, N-dimethyl bisacrylamide and phenyl-2, 4, 6-trimethyl benzoyl lithium phosphate into the PEEK frame, wherein in the preparation of the material, a fused deposition modeling method (FDM) is adopted to prepare the PEEK frame, and the material has good mechanical property and chemical stability and can bear a series of subsequent complex treatment processes without damage.

title_en: Boiler water quality real-time monitoring method, device, equipment, medium and program product
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of boiler water quality real-time monitoring, in particular to a method, a device, equipment, a medium and a program product for monitoring boiler water quality in real time, wherein the method comprises the steps of continuously collecting an initial water quality sample from a target boiler steam-water pipeline, and performing temperature and pressure reduction treatment on the initial water quality sample to obtain a water quality sample to be tested; the method comprises the steps of carrying out waste heat recovery on a water quality sample to be detected in a temperature reduction treatment stage to determine a water quality sample of a target boiler based on the water quality sample to be detected after the waste heat recovery, calculating a water quality comprehensive index of the water quality sample according to at least two water quality parameters in the water quality sample, and determining a water quality monitoring result corresponding to the target boiler according to the water quality comprehensive index, wherein the water quality monitoring result at least comprises a water quality risk grade. Therefore, the problems that in the related technology, the detection efficiency is low, the real-time performance is poor, the data parameters are single, the water quality mutation is difficult to discover in time, the water quality state cannot be comprehensively reflected and the like are solved.

title_en: Full-automatic cementing material setting time tester
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of chemical material setting time measurement, in particular to a full-automatic cementing material setting time measuring instrument, wherein a material containing cylinder is arranged on a supporting vertical frame, the time measuring instrument is used for entering materials and measuring the material setting time, the time measuring instrument comprises a fixed base, a central lifting disc movably arranged at the central position of the fixed base, and a central probe arranged on the central lifting disc, the central lifting disc is lifted up and down along the axis direction of the central lifting disc, a structural cavity is arranged in the central probe, an anti-adhesion structure for preventing the central probe from being adhered with the materials and an anti-deformation structure for preventing the central probe from downwards penetrating to the bottom of the touch are arranged in the structural cavity, and the technical problems that the central probe in the traditional chemical material setting detecting instrument is easy to be deformed at the bottom of touch and blocked in lifting during detection are solved.

title_en: Dry biochemical microfluidic detection chip, dry chemical test paper and combination thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a dry biochemical microfluidic detection chip, dry chemical test paper and a combination thereof, and belongs to the technical field of in-vitro detection. The microfluidic chip comprises a chip body, a sample adding cavity and a sample dripping cavity are formed in the edge of the chip body, a spring cavity and a test paper cavity are formed in the edge of the chip body, the front end of the test paper cavity is located below the sample dripping cavity, the tail end of the test paper cavity is located below the spring cavity, an elastic piece and a counterweight piece are arranged in the spring cavity, one end of the elastic piece is connected with the cavity wall of the spring cavity, the other end of the elastic piece is connected with the counterweight piece, and the counterweight piece can move back and forth along the radial direction under the combined action of centrifugal force and elasticity. The dry chemical test paper is ready to use and does not need preassembling, so that the problems of high cost, low adaptability and the like caused by preassembling in the prior art are avoided, and the balancing weight can press the test paper under the combined action of the spring and the centrifugal force to enable the first reactant to be in contact with or separated from the second reactant.

title_en: Positive ion saliva metabolite marker related to brain glioma, product and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a positive ion saliva metabolite marker related to brain glioma, a product and application thereof, and relates to the field of biological medicine. The positive ion saliva metabolite marker comprises one or more of glycerol monolinoleate, 1-palmitic acid-2-oleic acid-3-linoleic acid glyceride, 2, 6-dimethoxy phenol, 20-hydroxy arachidonic acid, 3, 5-dihydroxybenzyl alcohol, brassicasterol, histidyl alanyl lysine, pethidine and palmitoleic acid ethanolamide. The invention provides a kit which comprises a detection reagent for detecting the positive ion saliva metabolite marker. The present invention provides a computer program product associated with brain glioma. The product provided by the invention has good feasibility and accuracy, can effectively evaluate the risk of brain glioma, and provides a new tool for clinical diagnosis.

title_en: Small-sized water recycling system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water recycling and discloses a small-sized water recycling system which comprises a collecting tank, a sedimentation tank and a storage tank, wherein used wastewater is collected into the collecting tank and enters the sedimentation tank to form reclaimed water which enters the storage tank, a first water level gauge and a first water quality detector are arranged on the sedimentation tank, a second water level gauge and a second water quality detector are arranged on the storage tank, when the water level in the sedimentation tank is higher than the sedimentation water level, the used wastewater in the sedimentation tank is discharged into a wastewater discharge pipe network, when the water level in the storage tank is higher than a storage water level interval, the reclaimed water in the storage tank is discharged into the wastewater discharge pipe network, when the water level in the storage tank is lower than the storage water level interval, tap water is injected into the storage tank through an external pipeline, the storage tank is connected with water using equipment, a pressurized water pump is arranged on the external pipeline, and the reclaimed water in the storage tank is conveyed to the water using equipment after being pressurized by the pressurized water pump, so that water recycling is realized, and water resources are avoided.

title_en: Dynamic tracking adsorption test device and method adapting to different carbon dioxide partial pressure adsorption performances of multi-scene adsorbent
abstract_en: The dynamic tracking adsorption test device comprises a reaction total control part, a self-regulating air supply system and a gas analysis system, wherein an air inlet end of the reaction total control part is communicated with the self-regulating air supply system, an air outlet end of the reaction total control part is communicated with the gas analysis system, and the dynamic tracking adsorption test method is to obtain adsorption stage quality change and inlet and outlet concentration data after vacuum activation pretreatment of a test sample, establish a triple adsorption amount calculation model based on the adsorption stage quality change and inlet and outlet concentration data, and complete adsorption cycle stability test process according to the triple adsorption amount calculation model after data analysis.

title_en: Pancreatic cancer treatment target point aiming at ECHS 1K 115 locus and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of biological medicine, and particularly relates to a pancreatic cancer treatment target aiming at ECHS 1K 115 locus and application thereof. The invention discovers through experiments that the level of lysine succinylation modification (ECHS 1K 115 su) at position 115 of ECHS1 protein is obviously reduced in pancreatic cancer tumor, and the existence of the modification is confirmed through specific succinylation modification antibody for the first time. Further, the K115 succinylation modification can mediate the conversion efficiency of ECHS1 protein to the substrate thereof so as to inhibit the beta oxidation metabolism of fatty acid of pancreatic cancer cells, and in vivo and in vitro functional experiments prove that the ECHS 1K 115 succinylation modification inhibits the proliferation of pancreatic cancer tumor cells and the increase of tumor volume.

title_en: Be used for soil amendment applicator
abstract_en: The invention discloses a soil conditioner applying device which comprises a base, an applying component and a testing component, wherein the applying component comprises a storage barrel arranged on the base, a cover plate is covered at the top end of the storage barrel, a connecting groove is connected to the outer side of the storage barrel, a plurality of fixing frames are connected to the bottom end of the connecting groove through a pump and a transmission channel, the fixing frames are rotatably clamped at one end of the base, the rotating angle of the fixing frames is controlled by a central control system, telescopic air bags are arranged on the fixing frames, the free ends of the telescopic air bags are connected with a fixing barrel, a pair of cutting plates are arranged on the outer side of the fixing barrel, and the two cutting plates are slidably clamped in the fixing frames.

title_en: Portable detection device for multi-temperature freshness of livestock and poultry meat
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of food detection, in particular to a portable detection device for multi-temperature freshness of livestock and poultry meat, which comprises a main body, a display screen, a storage barrel, a temperature detection module and a gas collection and analysis module, wherein the display screen is arranged at the top of the main body, the storage barrel is fixedly connected with the lower end of the main body through a connecting plate, the temperature detection module comprises a refrigeration temperature sensor and a freezing temperature sensor which are respectively arranged at two sides of the storage barrel, and the gas collection and analysis module comprises a gas collection probe, a control chip and a gas sensor. The temperature of the frozen and refrigerated livestock and poultry meat is detected and judged by adopting the refrigeration temperature sensor and the refrigeration temperature sensor, and compared with an infrared temperature sensor, the refrigeration temperature sensor and the refrigeration temperature sensor have lower cost, can adapt to the humid and temperature-changing environment, can work at a specific temperature for a long time, have strong durability, can provide higher measurement precision in a certain temperature measuring range, and are easy to install and maintain.

title_en: Atmospheric methane concentration prediction method based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses an atmospheric methane concentration prediction method based on multi-source data fusion in the technical field of environment monitoring prediction, which comprises the steps of 1) obtaining climate factors, social economic indexes and methane data of a target area, sequentially carrying out spline interpolation filling missing values, bicubic interpolation space reclassification, K adjacent value correction deviation and principal component analysis dimension reduction on the climate factors, simultaneously carrying out missing value filling and principal component analysis dimension reduction on the methane data to finally obtain a preprocessing result, 2) screening climate and social economic factors which obviously influence methane, 3) constructing a mixed depth learning model structure comprising a double-layer LSTM, a full-connection layer, a splicing layer, a random inactivation layer and a linear output layer based on the target climate driving factors and the target social economic driving factors, and training to generate a target prediction model, wherein the mixed depth learning has a collaborative processing and division cooperation mechanism, and obviously improves model efficiency while maintaining the characteristics of multi-modal data.

title_en: Food metal detector
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of food detection, in particular to a food metal detector, which comprises a food conveyor and a metal detection mechanism arranged on the food conveyor, wherein a tray conveyor is arranged beside the food conveyor, a supporting frame is fixedly connected between the tray conveyor and the top end of the food conveyor, a chute is arranged at the top end of the supporting frame, an upper T-shaped block is connected with the inner side of the chute in a sliding way, the invention can push the middle two rows of four rows of bread on the tray to the middle through the arrangement of the structure, the bread in the outside is pushed to the both sides, the moving space of the upper shovel plate and the lower shovel plate is reserved, the upper shovel plate and the lower shovel plate can be lowered onto the tray, then the upper shovel plate and the lower shovel plate are driven to move to the both sides, four rows of bread are completely shoveled up, and then the bread is placed on the food conveyor through the moving mechanism to carry out metal detection, so that the bread in the tray is automatically taken, a worker is not required to shoveling at one side, and the convenience of equipment is improved.

title_en: Method for determining and repairing apparent damage of concrete member containing steel slag aggregate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for determining and repairing apparent damage of a concrete member containing an expansion damage source in the technical field of diagnosis and treatment of building structure performance. The method for determining apparent damage of the concrete member comprises the steps of carrying out different experimental methods corresponding to a group of concrete core samples drilled by a concrete member in a concrete structure, determining a first volume expansion rate and a second volume expansion rate which reflect expansion of steel slag aggregate in the concrete member, setting a steel slag aggregate equivalent model in a finite element calculation model of the concrete member, simulating acting force of the volume expansion of the steel slag aggregate on the concrete member, and determining a surface expansion damage specification according to the acting force and a design specification of the concrete member. The method can be used for predicting the specification possibly reached by the expansion damage of the surface of the concrete member, and can be used for early treatment to avoid loss.

title_en: Application of CYP4A11 in preparing medicament for preventing and treating diabetic nephropathy
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biomedicine, and particularly relates to application of CYP4A11 in preparation of a medicament for preventing and treating diabetic nephropathy. The invention provides a biomarker CYP4A11 gene or a coded product of the CYP4A11 gene for auxiliary diagnosis of diabetic nephropathy for the first time. CYP4A11 is up-regulated in the kidney tubule of DKD patient, CYP4A14 is up-regulated in the kidney tubule of db/db mouse, CYP4A11mRNA is up-regulated in HK-2 cell of in vitro high sugar culture, so CYP4A11 or its coded product can be used as auxiliary diagnostic index of diabetic nephropathy, used for auxiliary diagnosis of diabetic nephropathy. The invention also discovers that the iron death level in the diabetic nephropathy can be successfully reversed by the specific interference of sh-CYP4A11 lentivirus on the expression of CYP4A11mRNA, so that the CYP4A11 gene or the coded product of the CYP4A11 gene can be used as a drug treatment target point and applied to the prevention, alleviation or/and treatment of the diabetic nephropathy.

title_en: Method for acquiring and testing threshold permeability coefficient and distribution coefficient of unfixed pollutant soil
abstract_en: The invention discloses a test method for acquiring and calculating the permeability coefficient and distribution coefficient of an unsealed pollutant soil threshold, and belongs to the field of soil threshold calculation. The method comprises the steps of selecting sampling points on a site, excavating an annular groove fixed soil column to collect permeability coefficient measurement samples, and simultaneously collecting distribution coefficient samples at multiple points on the circumference of the sampling points. And when the permeability coefficient is measured, water is supplied by using a Marshall bottle and calculated by Darcy's law, and the distribution coefficient is obtained by measuring the fixed proportion of pollutant solutions with different concentrations in soil through a static adsorption test. The method solves the problems of structural damage and insufficient representativeness of distribution coefficient samples of the traditional soil column sampling, can accurately acquire the permeability coefficient and the distribution coefficient, provides a reliable basis for calculating the soil threshold value for protecting the underground water, and is suitable for risk assessment of unsealed new pollutants in chemical industry sites.

title_en: Plant nitrogen content monitoring method, device, electronic equipment, medium and program product
abstract_en: The invention provides a plant nitrogen content monitoring method, a plant nitrogen content monitoring device, electronic equipment, a medium and a program product, and relates to the technical field of plant nitrogen content monitoring; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a vegetation index and a vegetation coverage of a target plant, constructing a canopy structure correction index of the target plant based on the vegetation coverage and the vegetation index, inputting the canopy structure correction index into a mapping relation between the canopy structure correction index and the plant nitrogen content to obtain the plant nitrogen content of the target plant, obtaining the canopy structure correction index of the target plant by obtaining the vegetation index and the vegetation coverage of the target plant, so that influences of the canopy structure of the plant on the vegetation index in different growth stages are eliminated, and further obtaining the plant nitrogen content of the target plant according to the canopy structure correction index, so that accurate monitoring of the plant nitrogen content in different growth stages of the target plant is realized.

title_en: Indoor environment monitoring equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an indoor environment monitoring device, which aims to solve the technical problem that the current indoor environment discontinuous or continuous monitoring device has lower accuracy on formaldehyde monitoring data, and the structure of the indoor environment monitoring device comprises a monitor body, the bottom of the monitor body is provided with an air inlet, the air inlet of monitor body bottom department cage has the air inlet fan, the inside air inlet department cage of monitor body has the gas gathering cover, the other end intercommunication that gathers the gas gathering cover is connected with the air guide subassembly, the air guide subassembly is used for changing the angle when gas gets into the inside air stripping mechanism. The invention can lead the air stripping assembly to stably swing back and forth, reduce the intermittent times, and further lead the dust stripping net to shake in the process of cleaning the dust stripping net by the brush plate, thereby increasing the cleanliness of the dust stripping net after cleaning, reducing the probability of blocking the dust stripping net in the use process, and enhancing the smoothness and stability of gas passing through the dust stripping net.

title_en: Multi-parameter environment air quality real-time monitoring portable device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-parameter real-time ambient air quality monitoring portable device, which relates to the field of air quality monitoring devices and comprises a box body, a gas sensor, a particulate matter sensor, a lifting mechanism and an extension mechanism, wherein the lifting mechanism is arranged in the box body and used for adjusting the heights of the gas sensor and the particulate matter sensor, the lifting mechanism comprises a linkage plate, the turnover mechanism is arranged on the linkage plate and used for overturning and swinging the gas sensor and the particulate matter sensor, a transmission assembly is arranged between the lifting mechanism and the turnover mechanism, and the extension mechanism is arranged on the linkage plate and used for extending the heights of the gas sensor and the particulate matter sensor. The invention can not only carry out rapid extension height adjustment treatment on the gas sensor and the particulate matter sensor, but also carry out rapid storage treatment on the gas sensor and the particulate matter sensor, thereby guaranteeing the service life of the gas sensor and the particulate matter sensor, and enhancing the portability of the equipment.

title_en: Camel source nano antibody of feline calicivirus and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a camel-source nano antibody of feline calicivirus and application thereof, belonging to the field of biological medicine. The invention takes feline calicivirus as immunogen, and two nano antibodies VHH-V14 and VHH-V29 are obtained through screening by the steps of immunizing camel, constructing library, enriching and sequencing, and the like, and the amino acid sequences of the two nano antibodies VHH-V14 and VHH-V29 are respectively shown as SEQ ID NO. 1-2. Experimental results show that the nanobodies VHH-V14 and VHH-V29 have outstanding neutralizing activity on the feline calicivirus, and the IC  50  of the nanobodies VHH-V14 and VHH-V29 are 0.6536mg/mL and 0.6931mg/mL respectively, so that the nanobodies have good inhibiting effect on the feline calicivirus. The invention provides a new biological material for preventing and treating the infection of the feline calicivirus, provides a new design theory and technical support for an antibody treatment strategy of the feline calicivirus, and has outstanding significance for clinically treating the infection of the feline calicivirus.

title_en: Visual tracing method and simulation device for soil reinforcement
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of soil reinforcement visual construction, and discloses a soil reinforcement visual tracing method and a simulation device. The method aims at solving the technical problems that the traditional soil body reinforcement detection method in the prior art is large in destructive performance and high in cost, continuous tracing detection cannot be realized, and the diffusion range, flow distribution and reinforcement effect judgment of reinforcement materials in the soil body cannot be intuitively known. The soil body reinforcement visual tracing method comprises the following steps of (1) arrangement of an excitation electrode array, (2) discharge measurement of the excitation electrode, (3) potential difference measurement, (4) calculation of resistivity, and (5) response judgment of a geologic body. The method can judge the quality of soil body reinforcement engineering and improve the implementation safety of the engineering by means of exciting current real-time monitoring, accurate positioning of defect positions, dynamic optimization of reinforcement parameters, three-dimensional visual tracking and the like.

title_en: Disulfide bond isomerase single domain antibody, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disulfide bond isomerase single domain antibody, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the disulfide bond isomerase single domain antibody comprises a variable region, the variable region comprises a CDR1, a CDR2 and a CDR3, the amino acid sequences of the CDR 1-CDR 3 of the disulfide bond isomerase single domain antibody are sequentially shown as SEQ ID NO. 15, SEQ ID NO. 16 and SE Q ID NO. 17, and the CDR 1-CDR 3 are defined by an IMGT definition scheme. The single domain antibody provided by the invention can inhibit PDI activity, obviously reduce platelet aggregation and thrombosis, and does not influence physiological hemostasis function.

title_en: Deep ice while-drilling vibration-resistant gas separation, enrichment and fusion detection device and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deep ice while-drilling vibration-resistant gas separation, enrichment and fusion detection device and method, which belong to the technical field of polar deep ice drilling. The separation and enrichment chamber can realize efficient enrichment and separation of target gas by simulating the turbinate structure and the gas separation function of a mouse. The flow guide structure imitating the design of the dog nasal cavity is used for guiding the gas to form vortex, so that the contact time of the gas and the sensor can be prolonged, and the detection sensitivity and the detection accuracy are improved; the outer vibration reduction structure imitates a sunflower pith structure and a V-shaped structure of a leech epidermis, can prolong the contact time and absorb impact energy, realizes the vibration reduction effect, and improves the stability and the accuracy of a detection system; according to the fusion detection method, the target gas is detected by using the multiple types of sensors, so that data fusion and dynamic error compensation are realized, and the detection accuracy and the system stability are improved.

title_en: Kit for detecting porcine reproductive and respiratory syndrome virus and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a kit for detecting porcine reproductive and respiratory syndrome virus and a preparation method thereof, which belong to the technical field of virus detection and specifically comprise the following preparation steps that S1, a composite precipitator (polyethylene glycol, ammonium sulfate and modified cellulose nanocrystalline) is used for extracting and purifying antigens from viruses; S2, coating the purified antigen on a micropore reaction plate to form a solid-phase antigen, and S3, preparing and aseptically storing the solid-phase antigen, an enzyme marker, a diluent, a buffer solution, a color reagent and a stop solution to obtain the kit for detecting the porcine reproductive and respiratory syndrome virus. The raw materials such as cellulose nanocrystals, polyethylene glycol, ammonium sulfate and the like used in the preparation method are all environment-friendly materials, and no harmful substances are generated in the preparation process, so that the preparation method accords with the concept of green chemistry. Has the characteristics of improving precipitation efficiency, enhancing antigen stability, optimizing precipitation conditions, improving purification quality, being environment-friendly, and the like.

title_en: WTAP as rheumatoid arthritis clinical diagnosis marker and application thereof
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of biomedicine, and particularly relates to WTAP serving as a clinical diagnosis marker for rheumatoid arthritis and application thereof. Experiments prove that WTAP levels in the affected parts of the rheumatoid arthritis such as serum, synovial tissue and the like of a patient suffering from the rheumatoid arthritis are obviously higher than those of normal people, WTAP and the rheumatoid arthritis are positively correlated, WTAP genes or WTAP proteins can be used as molecular markers for screening, diagnosing or prognostic evaluation of the rheumatoid arthritis, CIA mice with WTAP genes knocked out show alleviation of illness state and symptom, and WTAP can be used as an effective target for treating the rheumatoid arthritis.

title_en: Systems, devices, and methods for scheduling workflows for automated cell therapy manufacturing
abstract_en: Systems, devices, and methods for high throughput manufacturing of cellular products for biomedical applications using automated systems that perform parallel workflows are described herein. A method for scheduling cell process cartridges for loading into a cell process system may include determining a system configuration, determining a configuration for each cell process cartridge of a plurality of cell process cartridges of the system, and providing a loading schedule for loading a first cartridge of the plurality of cartridges into the system. A method for monitoring contention of a cell processing system that processes a plurality of cell samples in parallel may include loading the plurality of cell samples into the system, and determining contention for each of a plurality of processing instruments before and after processing operations are performed by the system. The contention may be based on the number of cell samples that need the instrument during a period of time.

title_en: Evaluation method for quick charge performance of ternary positive electrode material
abstract_en: The invention relates to an evaluation method of quick charge performance of a ternary positive electrode material, which comprises the steps of detecting mass concentration of LiOH in the ternary positive electrode material, mass concentration of Li  2 CO 3 , specific surface area and molar quantity of Co contained in the ternary positive electrode material per mole, detecting particle size of primary particles of the ternary positive electrode material and particle size corresponding to the cumulative particle size distribution percentage reaching 50%, testing resistivity of the ternary positive electrode material in a powder state, calculating a quick charge factor k  f , and judging whether the ternary positive electrode material is the quick charge positive electrode material according to an evaluation standard or not according to the calculated quick charge factor k  f . The method for evaluating the fast charge factor can evaluate the fast charge performance of the ternary positive electrode material, and can effectively evaluate the DCR value of the material, so that performance evaluation support is provided for the design of material modification and the like.

title_en: Method for evaluating contribution rate of exogenous carbon in mangrove environment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of ecological environment monitoring and tracing, and particularly relates to a method for evaluating the contribution rate of exogenous carbon in mangrove forests. The invention combines two technologies of stable isotope and eDNA analysis, and overcomes the limitation of a single method in tracing the carbon source of mangrove. The stable isotope analysis can evaluate the relative contribution of different sources from the angles of element composition and isotope ratio, the environment DNA can provide species information with high resolution, determine the contribution of specific plant species or species group to carbon, and supplement each other, quantitatively evaluate the exogenous carbon contribution rate of mangrove forest, greatly improve the traceability accuracy of carbon sources, and solve the technical problem of carbon source analysis in complex environments with multi-source carbon input.

title_en: Glass fiber cloth flaw detection device
abstract_en: The invention provides a glass fiber cloth flaw detection device, and relates to the technical field of chain processing. The utility model provides a fine cloth flaw detection device of glass, includes mounting bracket and servo motor, the installation notch has been seted up to the positive side wall of mounting bracket, the internally mounted of installation notch has accommodate the lead screw, servo motor's drive end and accommodate the top fixed connection of lead screw, accommodate the lead screw keeps away from servo motor's one end and installs the bottom rotation of notch and be connected, accommodate the lead screw's surface thread bush is equipped with the regulation pedestal, accommodate the positive side wall of pedestal and rotate through the pivot and be connected with the dancer roll. In the detection process, a servo motor is started, the driving end of the servo motor drives an adjusting screw rod to do rotary motion, the adjusting screw rod rotates to drive an adjusting seat body sleeved on the outer surface of the adjusting screw rod to move in the vertical direction, glass fiber cloth in an extrusion motion state can be moved downwards, the state of the glass fiber cloth is tested in a certain stretching range, hidden injuries can be detected, and the detection accuracy is improved.

title_en: Method for testing and analyzing content of endogenous hormones in angelica sinensis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for testing and analyzing the content of endogenous hormone in angelica, which comprises the following steps of homogenizing a sample by using 80% methanol solution in an enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA), extracting 2-10 h at 4 ℃, centrifuging to obtain a supernatant, drying by nitrogen after purification, and dissolving to a constant volume.
