In a liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS) method, a sample is leached with 80% methanol, filtered and then rotary evaporated, the sample is eluted by using a methanol-water-acetic acid mixed solution, and the eluent is collected, dried by nitrogen and dissolved for sample injection. And if the difference value of the results of the two methods is less than or equal to 15%, finishing the result correction of the ELISA method, and if the difference value is large, adjusting the sample amount and leaching conditions until the difference value is less than or equal to 15%. The invention utilizes ELISA method and HPLC-MS/MS method to determine endogenous hormone content, realizes simple operation and rapid and accurate detection of hormone content.

title_en: Strep-tag II specific antibody and application thereof
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a nanobody or antigen-binding fragment thereof that specifically binds Strep-Tag II, which is capable of specifically recognizing and binding Strep-Tag II, and has a good affinity therewith.

title_en: Monoclonal antibody generated by aconitine hybridoma cell strain and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of antibodies, in particular to a monoclonal antibody generated by aconitine hybridoma cell lines and application thereof. The aconitine hybridoma cell strain is preserved in China general microbiological culture Collection center, and has the address of North Star Xiu Hirudo No. 1, no. 3 national academy of sciences of China, the classification name of aconitine hybridoma cell strain, the preservation date of 2025, 06 month and 05 days, and the preservation number of CGMCC No.46541. The invention takes aconitine as a raw material to prepare an artificial synthetic antigen with immunological activity and characteristics, induces a mouse to generate a specific antibody in an immune mode, and then prepares a hybridoma cell strain capable of specifically recognizing diester aconitine alkaloids (aconitine, aconitine and aconitine) through cell fusion, and the generated monoclonal antibody is successfully applied to products such as immunoaffinity columns, enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay kits, colloidal gold immunochromatography assay cards and the like.

title_en: Umbilical cord blood separation and pathogen detection integrated system
abstract_en: The application discloses an integrated system for separating umbilical cord blood and detecting pathogens, which belongs to the technical field of blood detection and comprises an information acquisition module, a data processing module, a separation module and a pathogen confirmation module, wherein the information acquisition module is used for acquiring image information of umbilical cord blood cells, the data processing module is used for analyzing the acquired image information through a trained deep learning model, judging whether the sample is HIV infection, HBV infection or not and marking and transmitting the sample judged to be HIV infection and HBV infection to the pathogen confirmation module, the separation module is used for centrifuging the umbilical cord blood sample to extract stem cells, the pathogen confirmation module comprises a nucleic acid detection unit and an antigen-antibody detection unit, the nucleic acid detection unit is used for automatically extracting cellular nucleic acid according to the HIV infection and HBV infection marked by the data processing module, and the antigen-antibody unit is mutually verified with a nucleic acid detection result through a chemical law immunity analysis method.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle-based gas monitoring system and method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of gas monitoring, relates to an unmanned aerial vehicle acquisition technology, and is used for solving the problem that the acquisition accuracy, the integrity and the timeliness of atmospheric data in the prior art cannot be guaranteed; the monitoring layout module is used for carrying out unmanned aerial vehicle detection layout analysis on the gas monitoring area, wherein the gas monitoring area is divided into a plurality of subareas, a plurality of acquisition points are arranged in the subareas according to the GIS map, a calibration route and a plurality of inspection routes are generated according to the acquisition points and the number of unmanned aerial vehicles distributed in the subareas, and the calibration route is used for carrying out calibration point data acquisition according to the calibration route through a calibration object to ensure data validity, so that data acquisition resources distributed in the subareas are reasonably allocated.

title_en: Screening method of monoclonal antibody, ELISA kit for screening monoclonal antibody and application of ELISA kit
abstract_en: The invention provides a screening method of monoclonal antibodies, an ELISA kit for screening monoclonal antibodies and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of biology. According to the screening method of the monoclonal antibody, the BMPS is utilized to couple the polypeptide with the carrier protein, so that the problem of coating efficiency of the polypeptide on the ELISA plate is solved, the possibility of the polypeptide having free in a liquid phase is greatly reduced due to the existence of the spacer arm, the risk of shielding of polypeptide epitopes is greatly reduced, 100% of the polypeptide is free in the liquid phase through the streptavidin-biotin system, the risk of shielding of the polypeptide epitopes is avoided, and the ELISA false negative problem in the screening process of the high-throughput antibody is greatly reduced.

title_en: Salmonella typhimurium aptamer lateral flow chromatography test strip based on ferroferric oxide@colloidal gold composite nano material photo-thermal effect, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a salmonella typhimurium aptamer lateral flow chromatography test strip based on a ferroferric oxide@colloidal gold composite nano material photo-thermal effect, a preparation method and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of lateral flow chromatography test strips, wherein the preparation method comprises the steps of preparing a probe; the preparation method comprises the steps of preparing Fe  3 O 4  @Au composite nano material, dissolving FeCl  3 ·6H 2  O and FeCl  2 ·4H 2  O in deionized water under the protection of nitrogen, adding ammonia water, stirring at room temperature, adding trisodium citrate, collecting by using a magnet, then adding the trisodium citrate into boiling HAuCl  4  solution, keeping boiling until the color of the solution becomes reddish brown, continuing heating, cooling and collecting by using the magnet, and the test strip can realize quantitative detection of salmonella typhimurium.

title_en: Apolipoprotein E detection reagent and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an apolipoprotein E detection reagent and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of biomedicine. The invention provides the use of a plant derivative selected from at least one of curcumin, emodin, EF24, FLLL-32 in the preparation of an APOE epitope-exposing agent. The invention also provides APOE epitope exposing agents, including surfactants, salts, reducing agents, and plant derivatives. According to the invention, the sufficiency of the epitope exposure of the ApoE protein is improved by using the epitope exposure agent containing the plant derivative to pretreat the sample and the protein, so that the accurate typing of the ApoE gene and the accurate quantification of proteins with different genotypes based on an immunological detection method are realized. The invention carries out genotyping of ApoE and quantitative detection of proteins with different genotypes based on an immunological detection method, and the genotyping detection result has high consistency with a fluorescence PCR result.

title_en: Method for improving capacity of waste lead-acid maintenance-free dry battery
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of battery repair, in particular to a method for improving the capacity of a waste lead-acid maintenance-free dry battery. A method for improving capacity of a waste lead-acid maintenance-free dry battery is characterized by comprising the steps of detecting 101 a battery deformation, 102 a lack of electricity, 103 a single battery is lower than 10V, 104 an appearance damage and 105 a battery heating, and concretely comprises the steps of detecting 101 the battery deformation of a battery body, judging whether the battery is deformed or not, if so, carrying out the next battery cleaning operation, and then carrying out 102 the lack of electricity to judge whether the battery is/is not lack of electricity to die.

title_en: Metabolic composition for diagnosing rheumatoid arthritis and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a metabolic composition for diagnosing rheumatoid arthritis and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of biomedicine. The metabolic composition comprises imidazole-4-acetic acid, ergothioneine, N-acetyl-L-methionine, 2-keto-3-deoxy-D-gluconic acid, 1-methylnicotinamide, and dehydroepiandrosterone sulfate. The feature combination formed by the cooperation of the six metabolites shows obvious difference in RA patients, can effectively distinguish RA from non-RA groups, and obviously improves the overall diagnosis accuracy of RA. The finding provides a powerful complement for early and accurate identification of RA, and is particularly suitable for complex cases with negative traditional indexes but highly suspected RA in clinic.

title_en: Air quality sensor based on Internet of things and remote control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of air quality monitoring, and provides an air quality sensor based on the Internet of things and a remote control method thereof. The remote control method comprises the steps of processing a linkage control matrix of the purification device through a heterogeneous instruction fusion technology to obtain a space optimization control vector set, forming a man-machine interaction entropy mechanism by the space optimization control vector set, processing a space state sensing vector by a man-machine interaction entropy model through an entropy weight dynamic allocation strategy, forming a cross-medium alarm triggering channel by the space state sensing vector, processing a device state feature topology by a bi-directional response coupling engine by the cross-medium alarm triggering channel, and forming a closed-loop control entropy correction instruction by the device state feature topology. The invention dynamically converts the pollution of the physical space into the operational equipment control parameters, and establishes a complete Internet of things closed-loop system from environment monitoring to purification execution.

title_en: Quick screening device and method for infant Tong Hufu product allergen
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of allergen screening devices, and discloses a quick infant Tong Hufu-item allergen screening device which comprises a kit and a placement mechanism arranged on an allergen detector, wherein the placement mechanism comprises a moving assembly and a first adjusting assembly, the moving assembly comprises a limiting box fixedly arranged on the allergen detector and provided with a moving column in a sliding manner, a friction block is arranged in the limiting box in a sliding manner, the placement mechanism is provided with the moving assembly and the first adjusting assembly, the first adjusting assembly can dynamically drive the friction block in the limiting box based on the insertion depth in the complete stage of the kit into the allergen detector, and gradient pressure is applied to the moving column which is arranged on a first gear in a sliding manner, so that the moving speed of the kit is matched with the speeds required in the initial stage, the stable stage and the terminal buffering stage, the structures of equipment and the kit are protected, and the stability and the accuracy of the detection process are guaranteed.

title_en: Modified polypeptides, polypeptide complexes, polypeptide mixtures, and systems and methods for controlling polypeptide translocation rates or characterizing polypeptides
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of protein or polypeptide analysis, in particular to a modified polypeptide, a polypeptide complex and a polypeptide mixture, a method for preparing the modified polypeptide, the polypeptide complex and the polypeptide mixture, a kit, a system for controlling the translocation speed of the polypeptide or characterizing the polypeptide containing the modified polypeptide, the polypeptide complex and the polypeptide mixture, and a method for controlling the translocation speed of the polypeptide or characterizing the polypeptide by using the modified polypeptide, the polypeptide complex and the polypeptide mixture.

title_en: Spherical unmanned aerial vehicle for quantitatively monitoring corrosion of concrete structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of engineering detection and discloses a spherical unmanned aerial vehicle for quantitatively monitoring corrosion of a concrete structure, which comprises a lower annular plate and an upper annular plate, wherein a protective component is arranged at the bottom end of the lower annular plate and at the top end of the upper annular plate, an unmanned aerial vehicle main body is fixedly arranged on the inner wall of the lower annular plate, a plurality of lower rotating grooves are formed in the side wall of the lower annular plate, and the relative positions of the lower annular plate and the upper annular plate can be rapidly determined through the design of locating pins and pin holes.

title_en: New energy automobile battery thermal runaway early warning device based on binary channels QCM
abstract_en: The invention discloses a new energy automobile battery thermal runaway early warning device based on a dual-channel QCM, and relates to the technical field of new energy automobile battery safety monitoring. The early warning device comprises a characteristic gas detection crystal oscillator unit, a reference gas detection crystal oscillator unit, a crystal oscillation starting circuit, a frequency dividing circuit and a main control and early warning module, wherein the characteristic gas detection crystal oscillator unit is used for detecting concentration information of relevant gas generated when a battery of a new energy automobile is out of control, the reference gas detection crystal oscillator unit is used for detecting concentration information of relevant gas in an environment, the crystal oscillation starting circuit is used for providing stable oscillation for each crystal oscillator unit, the frequency dividing circuit is used for inputting gas concentration signals subjected to respective oscillation starting and frequency dividing to the main control and early warning module, and the main control and early warning module is used for capturing frequencies of two paths of gas concentration signals in real time and high precision, calculating differential frequency offset and warning according to the offset. The device can monitor the concentration change of key characteristic gas in the battery pack in real time, and gives out early warning in the initial stage of thermal runaway and the micro-smoke stage.

title_en: Multi-parameter thromboelastography instrument for animal coagulation function evaluation
abstract_en: The multi-parameter thromboelastography instrument for animal blood coagulation function evaluation comprises a magnetic suspension driving and sensing module, a multi-dimensional signal processing module, a species characteristic database module, a dynamic calibration and quality control module, an artificial intelligent decision module and a multi-mode interaction output module, wherein the magnetic suspension driving and sensing module is used for realizing high-precision blood coagulation monitoring through electromagnetic driving and nanoscale displacement detection, the multi-dimensional signal processing module is used for extracting key parameters such as R values and MA values by adopting a composite algorithm, the species characteristic database module is used for storing multi-species blood coagulation data in a layered mode and supporting dynamic correction, the dynamic calibration and quality control module is used for ensuring system stability through a three-stage cascade control mechanism, the artificial intelligent decision module is used for providing blood coagulation risk evaluation and medication advice based on a hybrid neural network, and the multi-mode interaction output module is used for dynamically presenting detection results through a visual engine. The system has the characteristics of high sensitivity, anti-interference performance, cross-species adaptability and low output delay, and is suitable for coagulation function evaluation of various animals.

title_en: Information sensing method, device, equipment and storage medium based on gas sensor
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of gas sensing, in particular to an information sensing method, a device, equipment and a storage medium based on a gas sensor, which continuously acquire real-time gas information of a sensing area through a pre-deployed gas sensor network to obtain gas monitoring data of each acquisition position, perform characteristic analysis of gas performance on the gas monitoring data of each acquisition position, generating sensing information of each acquisition position, summarizing the sensing information of each acquisition position according to a preset standard to obtain a sensing list of a sensing region, and sensing gas information on a time relation and a space relation of the sensing region based on the sensing list to generate a gas sensing event of the sensing region.

title_en: Method for detecting apramycin by quantum dot fluorescence immunoassay
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biological medicine detection, in particular to a method for detecting apramycin by using a quantum dot fluorescence immunoassay method. The method comprises the steps of adding a sample and an apramycin monoclonal antibody solution into a coated ELISA plate for incubation, then carrying out incubation reaction on a fluorescent probe solution, measuring fluorescence intensity, and finally calculating the content of apramycin in the sample. The invention combines CdSe/ZnS quantum dots with rabbit anti-mouse IgG as a novel fluorescent probe, establishes a fluorescent immunoassay method, is used for quantitative detection of apramycin in animal feed, and is more sensitive compared with the traditional indirect competitive ELISA method.

title_en: Intelligent soil pollution detection system and method based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent detection system and method for soil pollution based on the Internet of things, which relate to the technical field of soil pollution detection, and are characterized in that soil pollution detection points are arranged, soil pollutant concentration values of each detection point are collected according to preset frequency, pollutant concentration values of undetected areas are calculated by adopting a spatial continuity algorithm, pollutant concentration values of all areas are obtained, a pollution change function model is built based on the pollutant concentration values of sampling points in all areas, pollution change function values under different distance intervals are calculated, and pollution degree values of the areas are calculated based on the pollution change function values under different distance intervals, so that the pollution condition of the areas is judged.

title_en: Device and method suitable for measuring soil-water characteristics of dam soil impermeable body
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a method suitable for measuring soil-water characteristics of a dam soil impermeable body, comprising a sampler, a soil sample rapid cutting device, a constant-temperature box, a centrifugal suction measuring device and a steam balance suction measuring device, wherein the sampler is used for placing a soil sample, the soil sample rapid cutting device comprises a cutting box body, a cutting driving mechanism and cutting sleeves, the sampler is placed in the cutting box body, a plurality of cutting sleeves are installed at the driving end of the cutting driving mechanism and are positioned above the sampler, the cutting driving mechanism drives the cutting sleeves to be inserted into the sampler for cutting the soil sample, the constant-temperature box is provided with the centrifugal suction measuring device, the centrifugal suction measuring device is arranged in the constant-temperature box and is used for centrifuging the cutting sleeves with drainage meshes for holding the soil sample to form a quasi-gravity field environment, the steam balance suction measuring device is arranged in the constant-temperature box and comprises a solution box and a shielding plate, a plurality of solution cavities are arranged in the solution box, and solutions with different concentrations and components are contained in each solution cavity and are shielded by the shielding plate, so that the specified solution cavities are exposed to form environments with different relative humidity and total suction.

title_en: AST-3424 for treating liver cancer
abstract_en: The method for treating the hepatocellular carcinoma by using the AST-3424 and the application of the AST-3424 in preparing a medicament for treating a hepatocellular carcinoma patient are provided, and the method is characterized in that the pathological wax lump or pathological section of the isolated liver tumor tissue of the hepatocellular carcinoma patient is detected by an immunohistochemical staining method to obtain the detection result, wherein the detection result is that the H-score is greater than or equal to 200, or the pathological wax lump or pathological section of the isolated liver tumor tissue of the hepatocellular carcinoma patient is detected by an immunohistochemical staining method to obtain the detection result, and the sum of the percentages of medium-intensity staining and high-intensity staining is greater than or equal to 70%. AST-3424 is administered once every 21 days, once on days 1 and 8, at a first dose of 6.0mg/m  2  each, for a maximum of 34 cycles to be admitted.

title_en: Method for improving sewage treatment efficiency by intelligent regulation type ecological floating bed
abstract_en: The application discloses a method for improving sewage treatment efficiency by an intelligent regulation type ecological floating bed, and belongs to the technical field of environmental engineering. The method comprises the steps of dividing an ecological floating bed into a plurality of functional areas, setting biological signal transmission channels to enhance metabolic coupling, establishing an enzymatic reaction cascade path, monitoring and adjusting water flow and residence time in real time to realize load balancing, intelligently regulating environmental parameters and implementing a metabolic enhancement strategy to optimize degradation efficiency, and periodically evaluating the state of the ecological floating bed, predicting performance attenuation and executing an automatic maintenance and optimization strategy. According to the application, the ecological floating bed is divided into a plurality of modules which are mutually coupled and have definite functional partitions, and the intelligent monitoring and dynamic regulation are utilized by combining the regulable microporous semi-permeable membrane and the differential carrier material, so that the cooperative optimization of microorganism metabolism and environmental parameters is realized, the sewage treatment efficiency is improved, and the continuous and stable operation of the system is ensured.

title_en: Soil moisture measurement method and system for fusing single point and regional data
abstract_en: The invention relates to a soil moisture measurement method and system for single point and regional data fusion, and belongs to the technical field of agricultural information. The method and the device calibrate the overall average soil moisture of the target area by utilizing the measured soil moisture of each single point, further ensure the measurement precision of the overall average soil moisture of the target area, improve the vertical resolution of the overall average soil moisture of the target area, respectively interpolate the soil moisture data of each depth layer measured by each single point of the target area to obtain the soil moisture of each depth layer of the target area, and carry out weighted fusion on the overall average soil moisture of the calibrated target area and the soil moisture of each depth layer of the target area obtained by interpolation, so that the fused soil moisture of the target area integrates the advantages of single point measurement and area measurement, realize the area soil moisture measurement with high precision and high resolution, and improve the area layered moisture monitoring precision.

title_en: Single-chain antibody for identifying extracellular region of PPRV H protein and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a single-chain antibody for identifying an extracellular region of PPRV H protein and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of genetic engineering. The amino acid sequence of the heavy chain variable region of the single-chain antibody is shown as SEQ ID NO.5, and the amino acid sequence of the light chain variable region is shown as SEQ ID NO. 9. The invention provides a single-chain antibody for recognizing PPRV H protein extracellular region (185-609 aa), which is prepared by immunizing a mouse through PPRV H protein extracellular region protein, and connecting VH and VL genes of the monoclonal antibody obtained by immunization in series by utilizing a monoclonal antibody preparation technology and a DNA molecular technology. The neutralization test shows that the single-chain antibody can neutralize PPRV virus and can be used for clinical detection of peste des petits ruminants.

title_en: Carbon-saving deodorizing control method and system based on gas on-line monitoring
abstract_en: The application is applicable to the technical field of big data acquisition and provides a carbon-saving deodorizing control method and system based on gas on-line monitoring, wherein the method comprises the steps of deploying a corresponding sensor array according to a preset sensor deployment strategy to acquire gas environment data and obtain a multidimensional space-time data set; the method comprises the steps of carrying out feature extraction on a multi-dimensional space-time data set by utilizing a multi-layer convolutional neural network to obtain a diffusion feature set of odor pollutants, constructing an odor pollutant diffusion model according to the diffusion feature set, simulating probability distribution of diffusion paths of the odor pollutants according to the odor pollutant diffusion model and a Li Yongmeng terCarlo algorithm to generate a diffusion topological structure, determining control priority of a preset discharge valve according to the diffusion topological structure, and controlling the on-off state of the preset discharge valve according to the control priority so that the concentration of the odor pollutants meets preset concentration conditions. The method is beneficial to improving the prediction precision of the diffusion path of the gas pollutants.

title_en: Characterization of aerosol particles using decomposition induced by pneumatic atomizers
abstract_en: Systems and methods for decomposing and analyzing analyte aerosol particles are provided. In various embodiments, these systems collect aerosol particles and introduce them into a high pressure gas stream. When ejected near the outlet of the liquid conduit, the stream atomizes the exiting liquid, promoting high impact collisions between aerosol particles and the liquid. This interaction results in complete or partial decomposition of the aerosol particles, with the potential to dissolve them in the resulting liquid droplets. In certain embodiments, at least some of the resulting analyte species are ions that can be analyzed with a mass spectrometer. These systems and methods may be suitable for analyzing a wide range of aerosols and are particularly promising for inspecting plumes generated by laser ablation of tissue.

title_en: Hypotonic reservoir sensitivity evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention provides a hypotonic reservoir sensitivity evaluation method. The method comprises the steps of preparing test samples of a target reservoir by using a full-diameter rock core of the target reservoir, respectively carrying out standard salt water permeability test on each test sample to determine that the minimum flow rate of each test sample capable of realizing permeability test is initial flow rate, grouping each test sample according to the initial flow rate, carrying out sensitivity test on the same group of samples, wherein the test samples A are taken as the minimum flow rate in a test group, carrying out flow rate sensitivity test on the test samples A to determine the critical flow rate of the test group, respectively taking the test samples B, C, D, E, F in the test group, carrying out water sensitivity, salinity sensitivity, acid sensitivity, alkali sensitivity and stress sensitivity test on the test samples A to obtain the water sensitivity, salinity sensitivity, acid sensitivity, alkali sensitivity and stress sensitivity of the test group, and selecting the critical flow rate corresponding to the critical flow rate of the test group in each sensitivity test process.

title_en: Self-adaptive correction prediction method and system for surface water environment monitoring data abnormality
abstract_en: The application relates to a self-adaptive correction prediction method and a self-adaptive correction prediction system for surface water environment monitoring data anomalies, which comprise the steps of detecting anomaly data in water quality automatic monitoring data according to water quality automatic monitoring data and position parameters of corresponding automatic monitoring points, predicting to obtain a water quality manual monitoring data predicted value at the current automatic monitoring point at the beginning time of a monitoring period according to the water quality manual monitoring data and the position parameters of the corresponding manual monitoring positions, obtaining a weather change amplitude according to weather monitoring data at the current time and weather monitoring data at the beginning time of the monitoring period, adjusting the water quality manual monitoring data predicted value at the current automatic monitoring point at the beginning time of the monitoring period according to the weather change amplitude, and correcting the anomaly data in the water quality automatic monitoring data according to the adjusted value. The application can improve the quality and usability of the monitoring data and provide more powerful data support for water environment protection and treatment.

title_en: Anti-Trop 2 nano antibody and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of molecular biology, and particularly relates to an anti-Trop 2 nano antibody and application thereof. The invention provides an anti-Trop 2 nanometer antibody, the amino acid sequence of which is SEQ ID NO.4. The anti-Trop 2 nano antibody provided by the invention has specific recognition and binding capacity, and the application thereof relates to a plurality of fields of diagnosis and treatment, basic medical research, biological research and the like of tumor diseases related to Trop2, and has wide biological application and clinical application values.

title_en: System and method for monitoring and diluting hydrogen concentration of crankcase of hydrogen internal combustion engine
abstract_en: The application provides a system and a method for monitoring and diluting the hydrogen concentration of a crankcase of a hydrogen internal combustion engine, wherein the system comprises a hydrogen concentration monitoring device, a controller and an inert gas diluting device, wherein the hydrogen concentration monitoring device is arranged on an exhaust pipeline of the crankcase and is used for monitoring the hydrogen concentration in exhaust gas, the controller is connected with the hydrogen concentration monitoring device and is configured to output a control signal according to a comparison result of the hydrogen concentration and a preset concentration threshold value, and the inert gas diluting device is connected with the controller and is used for receiving the control signal and injecting inert gas into the exhaust pipeline so as to dilute the hydrogen. The system monitors the exhaust of the crankcase in real time by arranging the hydrogen concentration monitoring device, and controls the start and stop of the inert gas dilution device by utilizing the controller according to the monitoring result, so that the active management of the hydrogen concentration in the crankcase is realized, the explosion risk of the crankcase in the hydrogen internal combustion engine test is eliminated, and the problem of pipeline blockage is solved.

title_en: Real-time accurate monitoring method and related equipment for displacement field of multi-bifurcation path at tip of concrete crack
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real-time accurate monitoring method and related equipment for a concrete crack tip multi-bifurcation path displacement field, wherein the method comprises the steps of generating a virtual data set according to line elastic fracture mechanics, a cohesive force model and computer graphics; the method comprises the steps of inputting a virtual data set into an initial depth displacement resolving network, carrying out concrete fine feature extraction and motion feature enhancement operation on the virtual data set to obtain an enhancement feature map, carrying out discontinuous displacement matching operation on the enhancement feature map through a deformable convolution layer to obtain a coarse displacement field, carrying out sub-pixel level refinement treatment on the coarse displacement field to obtain a fine displacement field, optimizing the initial depth displacement resolving network according to a real displacement field and the fine displacement field to obtain a target depth displacement resolving network, and inputting a material surface speckle image into the target depth displacement resolving network to obtain a crack tip deformation displacement field. The method can improve the accuracy and the robustness of the displacement field acquisition, and can be widely applied to the technical field of concrete structure health monitoring.

title_en: Method for evaluating usability of surface-gathered binary compound flooding produced sewage based on indoor test
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of oil-gas field development, in particular to a centralized-surface binary compound flooding produced sewage usability evaluation method based on an indoor test, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises five parts of content including water quality characteristic measurement, core permeability injury evaluation, reinjection decision pattern construction, backflushing and permeability recovery evaluation and oil displacement effect verification, comprehensively evaluates the water quality characteristics of the aggregate-surface binary compound flooding produced sewage and the damage mechanism of the aggregate-surface binary compound flooding produced sewage to the core, provides a method for preparing backflushing medium to help the permeability recovery for the produced sewage, provides a basis for a blocking removal process, establishes a scientific reinjection pattern, guides oilfield sewage reinjection practice, has environmental protection and economic benefits, and finally verifies the oil displacement effect of the produced sewage preparation polymer system, and provides technical support for resource reuse.

title_en: Water ecology normal position monitoring devices
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water ecology in-situ monitoring device, which relates to the technical field of water quality monitoring and comprises a floating vessel, a sampling assembly and a monitoring assembly, wherein the floating vessel comprises a hull and a limiting anchor, and the limiting anchor is connected with the hull and is used for limiting the hull to stay in place. The sampling assembly comprises a winding wheel, a pull rope and a sampling tube, the pull rope is wound on the winding wheel, one end of the pull rope is connected with the sampling tube, and the winding wheel can release or tighten the pull rope when rotating, so that the pull rope drives the sampling tube to vertically lift in a water body. The monitoring component is used for monitoring the water collected by the sampling tube. The limiting anchor can be hung at the bottom of the water to limit the ship body to stay in place, and the water sample of the vertical depth in place is monitored. The winding wheel can receive and release the stay cord when rotating to make the stay cord drive the sampling tube vertical lift, the sampling tube can sample the water of the different degree of depth in the vertical direction, and the monitoring component can monitor the water that the sampling tube gathered, can reflect the ecological situation of the different vertical depth water of coplanar position.

title_en: Soil detection device capable of deeply sampling soil
abstract_en: The invention provides a soil detection device capable of deeply taking soil and sampling, which relates to the technical field of soil detection and comprises detection probes, wherein supporting plates are arranged at two ends of each detection probe, bases are fixedly connected to the lower ends of the two supporting plates, a connecting plate is arranged between the two supporting plates, threads are arranged on the surface of each detection probe, the connecting plate is in threaded sleeve joint with the detection probes, a U-shaped plate is arranged at the upper end of each connecting plate, a worker places the device at a position to be detected, at the moment, the worker starts a motor, and the detection probes gradually descend due to the threaded sleeve joint between the detection probes and the connecting plate, and can be smoothly inserted into the deep part of soil by virtue of a sharp structure of the detection probes when the detection probes gradually descend. With the continuous deep soil of detection probe, it can acquire the soil sample from the soil layer of different degree of depth, realizes the degree of depth sampling that fetches earth, has avoided the soil detection device unable problem of evaluating soil pollution degree comprehensively, has improved the accuracy of evaluation.

title_en: Chemical gas abnormal concentration traceability system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention provides an artificial intelligence-based chemical gas abnormal concentration tracing system, which is characterized in that detection nodes are deployed based on the internal layout of a chemical plant, real-time gas concentration data are collected based on the detection nodes, reasonable design of the detection nodes based on the internal layout of the chemical plant is realized, global non-blind area monitoring is realized, meanwhile, multi-node data can be mutually verified, key area data collection precision is ensured, a space-time distribution thermodynamic diagram is established by combining a preset gas distribution model based on the relation between the real-time gas concentration data and the detection nodes, a real-time accurate data base is provided for positioning a leakage source position, the leakage source position is determined by combining environmental parameters based on the space-time distribution thermodynamic diagram, and environmental parameters are considered, so that positioning deviation caused by neglecting small environmental influence in a traditional method is avoided, the accuracy of the leakage source position is ensured, the positioning precision is improved, and the timeliness of emergency treatment is met.

title_en: Nanometer antibody targeting Claudin18.2, related products and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nano antibody targeting Claudin18.2, a related product and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of biological medicine. The nano antibody comprises a heavy chain variable region, wherein the heavy chain variable region comprises a CDR1, a CDR2 and a CDR3, the amino acid sequence of the CDR1 is shown as SEQ ID NO.1, the amino acid sequence of the CDR2 is shown as SEQ ID NO.2, and the amino acid sequence of the CDR3 is shown as SEQ ID NO. 3. The nano antibody can be specifically combined with Claudin18.2 antigen, has higher affinity, can inhibit the clone formation, migration and invasion of Claudin18.2 positive tumor cells by taking the nano antibody as a monoclonal antibody, and has good targeted therapeutic activity on Claudin18.2 positive tumors.

title_en: Real-time monitoring device and method for rock stratum while drilling integrated with MEMS (micro electro mechanical System) sensing
abstract_en: The application provides a real-time monitoring device and method for rock stratum while drilling integrated with MEMS sensing, wherein the device comprises a sensor module, a data processing module and a ground control terminal, wherein the sensor module is integrated in drilling equipment and is used for collecting rock stratum parameters of rock stratum in real time in the drilling process of the drilling equipment, the data processing module is connected with the sensor module and is used for carrying out signal filtering, feature extraction and signal fusion on the rock stratum parameters, a comprehensive evaluation result of the rock stratum parameters is generated through a weighted fusion or Kalman filtering algorithm, and the ground control terminal is connected with the data processing module and is used for adjusting the drilling parameters of the drilling equipment based on the comprehensive evaluation result. The device provided by the application solves the problems that the traditional rock stratum monitoring device cannot monitor and evaluate rock stratum parameters in real time in the drilling process and does not optimize the drilling parameters in real time.

title_en: Construction and application of Stard gene knockout mouse animal model
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of animal models, in particular to construction and application of an animal model of a Stard gene knockout mouse, which is to mate a Stard6-flox mouse with a Stra8-Cre mouse to obtain a Stard gene knockout mouse model. The application constructs Stard gene knockout mouse model, and discovers that the gene level and protein level expression of the specific Stard gene knockout mouse in male germ cells are obviously reduced, so that the testis development and spermatogenesis of the male mouse of the Stard gene knockout mouse are abnormal. Therefore, the problems that a common animal model cannot target a target gene, other factors interfere, the whole-body knockout animal model is easy to cause embryonic death and the like are solved.

title_en: Application of tumor marker based on metabolic enzyme ACSS3 function in preparation of triple negative breast cancer diagnosis, treatment and prognosis products
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of tumor medicines, and particularly relates to application of a tumor marker based on a metabolic enzyme ACSS3 function in preparation of triple negative breast cancer diagnosis, treatment and prognosis products. The invention provides ACSS3 mediated PARP 1K 903 propionyl to promote tumor growth and positively correlate with clinical invasiveness of triple negative breast cancer, inhibits ACSS3 expression, specifically blocks positive regulation and control effect of KAT9 on ACSS3 lactogenesis, inhibits ACSS3 from exerting non-classical functions to inhibit tumor occurrence and development, and provides a new thought and effective scheme for development of anti-tumor drugs targeting metabolic reprogramming and early diagnosis of tumors.

title_en: Method for diagnosing benign and malignant lung nodules based on clinical linking technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for diagnosing benign and malignant lung nodules based on a clinical linking technology, which comprises the following steps of 1) extracting and purifying exosomes, S1) preparing blood plasma, S2) preparing a two-aqueous-phase system, S3) collecting the exosomes, and 2) detecting protein signals. The method for diagnosing benign and malignant lung nodules based on the clinical linking technology is based on the extraction and purification technology of peripheral blood exosomes, concentrates and enriches tumor-derived proteins, and then utilizes the micro-scale hypusination protein detection technology to exponentially amplify protein signals, so that the detection sensitivity and accuracy are improved.

title_en: Steel structure performance detection method and system
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a system for detecting the performance of a steel structure, which relate to the technical field of steel structure detection and comprise the following steps of acquiring original detection data acquired by a sensor deployed in a key area of the steel structure; the method comprises the steps of preprocessing and compressing original detection data, processing the compressed original detection data by adopting a stream mode decomposition algorithm, extracting a low-dimensional concentrated feature vector, and analyzing the concentrated feature vector by utilizing a lightweight diagnosis model based on the lightweight diagnosis model to obtain a state diagnosis result of the steel structure. Greatly reduces the data transmission quantity and cloud dependence. By combining the strategies of 'cloud meta-learning pre-training' and 'edge small data fine adjustment', the diagnosis model has wide priori knowledge, can accurately adapt to the unique characteristics of a specific structure, solves the model adaptation problem under a small sample, remarkably improves the diagnosis accuracy, and can ensure high accuracy, high calculation efficiency and strong self-adaptation capability.

title_en: Hybridoma cell strain secreting acephate monoclonal antibody and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a hybridoma cell strain secreting a acephate monoclonal antibody and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of immunodetection. The invention obtains a hybridoma cell strain secreting the acephate monoclonal antibody through screening, the acephate monoclonal antibody has high specificity and high sensitivity to the acephate, the IC  50  of the acephate is 0.231 ng/mL, and structural analogues of the acephate such as triazophos, diazinon, methamphetamine, acephate and the like have no cross reaction, so that the low-concentration acephate can be accurately detected.

title_en: Simulation test method for asymmetric supporting effect of weak-cementing strong-expansion soft rock roadway
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulation test method for asymmetric support effect of a weakly cemented strongly-expanded soft rock roadway, and belongs to the technical field of coal mining. The method aims at solving the problems that the prior art is difficult to truly reproduce asymmetric large deformation of a roadway under the action of weak cementation-strong expansion-rich water multi-field coupling and the effectiveness of an asymmetric supporting scheme cannot be rapidly evaluated in a quantitative mode. The technical scheme is characterized in that real rock parameters are obtained through on-site core sampling, similar materials are prepared and a physical model is constructed based on a similar theory, surrounding rock deformation environments are reproduced with high fidelity, multiple asymmetric supporting schemes are designed for simulation comparison, a non-contact full-field strain measurement system is adopted for monitoring surrounding rock deformation, and an optimal supporting scheme is preferably selected and applied to on-site verification. The invention moves the complex field problem to a controllable laboratory environment, realizes the rapid and accurate optimization of the supporting scheme, and provides scientific and reliable basis for the soft rock roadway supporting design.

title_en: Sample analysis method, sample analyzer, and computer-readable storage medium
abstract_en: Sample analysis methods, sample analyzers, and computer-readable storage media for analyzing blood samples. The method comprises the steps of obtaining optical signals generated by excitation light irradiation when particles in a sample liquid to be tested pass through an optical detection area one by one in one test, obtaining the sample liquid to be tested after blood samples are treated by adopting a hemolyzing agent, a first dye and a second dye, wherein the first dye can dye white blood cells, the second dye can dye infected red blood cells, the optical signals comprise scattered light signals, first fluorescent signals corresponding to the first dye and second fluorescent signals corresponding to the second dye, identifying nucleated red blood cells based on the scattered light signals and the first fluorescent signals, and obtaining red blood cell optical information based on the scattered light signals and the second fluorescent signals. The method can simultaneously obtain the optical information of the nucleated red blood cells and the optical information of the infected red blood cells in the same detection channel or the same test, thereby reducing the blood volume and the cost for detection.

title_en: Anti-TNFSF 8 peptide vaccine and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-TNFSF 8 peptide vaccine, a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of biomedicine. The vaccine comprises a TNFSF8 protein specific extracellular peptide TTEKAPLKGG as an antigen, is further prepared into KLH-C-TTEKAPLKGG antigen peptide, enhances the immune response of an organism to the antigen peptide by matching with an oligonucleotide CpG adjuvant, can induce Th1 type immune response mainly comprising IFN-gamma, enhances the blocking treatment effect of immune check points, and has the effects of durably generating specific antibodies and inducing Th1 type anti-tumor immune response. The invention obviously relieves the immune pneumonia in a preclinical model and has the effect of obviously increasing the anti-tumor curative effect of blocking and treating immune checkpoints.

title_en: GIS equipment gas leakage monitoring and early warning method based on confidence coefficient
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power equipment state monitoring, and discloses a GIS equipment gas leakage monitoring and early warning method based on confidence, which comprises the following steps of collecting The method comprises the steps of monitoring data by gas, preprocessing the data, restraining fluctuation interference of original data, extracting peak value and valley value characteristics of the preprocessed data by adopting an envelope curve method, establishing a leakage trend identification model based on probability distribution, introducing a tolerance mechanism and a confidence threshold, screening effective leakage signals, and outputting leakage alarm results and performance indexes. According to the method, the smooth data peak-valley value is extracted through an envelope curve method, the confidence coefficient of the continuous peak-valley same-drop mode is quantized by combining a probability distribution model, a 0.001MPa tolerance mechanism is introduced to avoid critical misjudgment, slow leakage with the daily average variation less than or equal to 0.001MPa can be identified, the detection rate is improved by more than 40% compared with the traditional threshold method and slope method, and the requirement that the detection rate of abnormal defects is more than 80% is met.

title_en: Magnetic bead-bicolor quantum dot premixing type host-guest encoding microsphere, preparation method thereof and multiplex analysis kit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a magnetic bead-bicolor quantum dot premixing type host-guest encoding microsphere, a preparation method thereof and a multiplex analysis kit, according to the invention, the bicolor hydrophobic quantum dots are pre-mixed and assembled into the dendritic silicon dioxide dSiO  2 , and the coded object ball is prepared by regulating the color proportion through premixing. The host ball is a polystyrene ball filled with superparamagnetic particles of 5 mu m, a large number of object balls are coupled to the surface of the host ball through a statistical averaging effect, the fluctuation (standard deviation) of the whole output coding signal (blue/red intensity ratio) is small, and the uniformity of the coding signal is improved. And meanwhile, the green quantum dots are loaded by the small-size hollow silica nanotubes so as to improve the immunoreaction dynamics of the detection probe. The full quantum dot narrow emission under the single excitation (405 nm) takes blue-red double color as coding color and green as signal color, so as to form a nuclear-satellite structure immune complex for coding multiplex analysis, and the imaging quantitative analysis with high sensitivity and high accuracy can be realized for various respiratory tract pathogen antigens.

title_en: Raman spectrum-based blood glucose measurement
abstract_en: A blood glucose level measuring apparatus includes a light source configured to irradiate light to a subject, a monochromator configured to separate wavelength components of light reflected and scattered from the subject, a light receiver configured to receive light transmitted via the monochromator and generate an electrical signal based on the received light, and a processor configured to extract information of a blood glucose level of the subject based on a frequency shift of the light due to a Raman effect.

title_en: Blood Urea Nitrogen (BUN) sensor and method of sensing urea nitrogen in biological samples
abstract_en: One embodiment of a Blood Urea Nitrogen (BUN) sensor measures urea nitrogen in a biological sample by measuring a differential voltage signal based on first and second voltage signals, each representing a detected carbon dioxide amount. The first signal is representative of the amount of carbon dioxide detected, which is generated by an enzymatic reaction of the biological sample contacting the sensor surface with urease immobilized thereon. The second voltage signal is indicative of a detected amount of background carbon dioxide in the biological sample. The differential voltage signal is indicative of the amount of urea nitrogen in the biological sample, which can be determined by appropriate correlation. Other embodiments of BUN sensors and methods of sensing BUN, as well as other aspects, are also provided.

title_en: Stress restraint device for monitoring methane emission of cattle and methane emission monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a stress restraint device for monitoring methane emission of cattle and a methane emission monitoring system, the stress restraint device comprises two bundles of limb units, a forelimb limiting unit, a first horizontal adjusting unit, a first locking unit, a second horizontal adjusting unit, a second locking unit, a supporting unit and a head limiting unit. The device has the advantages that the cooperation of the limb binding unit and the front limb limiting unit brings the effect of limiting the movement of the front limb and adapting the distance, the front limb limiting unit is connected with the two limb binding units and adjusts the distance, the front limb stretching amplitude can be flexibly adjusted according to the size of the cow, the cow stress caused by constraint overstretching is avoided, the cooperation of the front limb limiting unit, the first locking unit and the second locking unit brings the effect of preventing and stabilizing the front limb limiting unit, the first locking unit and the second locking unit are respectively contacted with the two ends of the front limb limiting unit, the front limb limiting unit is prevented from being separated from the limb binding unit, and the front limb constraint is ensured to be continuously and effectively.

title_en: Hong Kong oyster NKA-alpha protein polyclonal antibody, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hong Kong oyster NKA-alpha protein polyclonal antibody, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps of constructing a recombinant expression vector containing NKA-alpha target gene fragments; transforming the recombinant expression vector into competent cells to construct recombinant expression strains, inducing the recombinant expression strains to express fusion proteins, collecting and purifying the recombinant expression strains to obtain NKA-alpha recombinant proteins, performing animal immune treatment by taking the NKA-alpha recombinant proteins as antigens, collecting and separating antisera, and purifying the antisera to obtain the hong Kong oyster NKA-alpha protein polyclonal antibody. The hong Kong oyster NKA-alpha polyclonal antibody prepared by the invention has high affinity, can specifically identify the NKA-alpha protein in hong Kong oyster, and can be widely applied to biological immunodetection of hong Kong oyster.

title_en: Method and system for evaluating thixotropy and structural recovery capability of slurry
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a system for evaluating thixotropy and structural restoration capability of slurry. The method comprises the steps of determining 1 test geometric matrix containing m multiplied by n combinations, respectively adopting the m multiplied by n combinations to carry out standard test to obtain eta-t recovery curves of the combinations, analyzing all the eta-t recovery curves, and extracting quantization parameters, wherein the quantization parameters comprise initial recovery viscosity eta 0, pre-shear viscosity eta initial, final recovery viscosity eta final, recovery degree R and recovery rate constant k, constructing 1 thixotropic index matrix, and evaluating the thixotropic property and structural recovery capacity of the slurry according to the recovery degree R% and the recovery rate constant k in the thixotropic index matrix. The application has the following technical effects of breaking through the limitation of single measurement geometry, improving the comprehensiveness and accuracy of evaluation, definitely prescribing a unified standard test flow, and remarkably improving the consistency and repeatability of test results.

title_en: Visual rock mass grouting experimental device for multi-field coupling monitoring
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rock mass grouting experiments, and discloses a visual rock mass grouting experiment device for multi-field coupling monitoring, which comprises an air source for providing aerodynamic force, a slurry storage tank for storing slurry and a grouting assembly for performing grouting experiments, wherein the output end of the air source is connected with an air pipe connected with the slurry storage tank, and the slurry storage tank is connected with a grouting pipe for feeding the grouting assembly. The invention realizes rock mass grouting test operation, provides data support for rock mass grouting deformation research, realizes rock mass constant pressure grouting operation, can adjust grouting pressure and speed of rock mass grouting, is suitable for rock mass grouting test requirements under different conditions, clamps the rock mass by the sampling end part and the side surface, can adjust clamping force according to the test requirements, is convenient to clamp and disassemble, changes the defect that the traditional clamping apparatus is messy and inconvenient to collect, is convenient for storage and arrangement of experimental apparatuses, and improves experimental efficiency of experimental staff.

title_en: Experimental device capable of uniformly distributing water to simulate interaction of water and rock
abstract_en: The invention discloses an experimental device capable of uniformly distributing water to simulate interaction of water and rock, which relates to the technical field of simulation experimental devices, and comprises a base, wherein the upper surface of the base is provided with a mounting frame body, the upper surface of the mounting frame body is provided with two mounting struts, the other end of each mounting strut is provided with a soil storage box, a test mechanism is arranged below each soil storage box, the test mechanism comprises a flow guide assembly and a storage assembly, the storage assembly comprises two connecting side frames, one ends of the two connecting side frames are connected with the side surface of the mounting frame body, one end of each connecting side frame, which is away from the mounting frame body, is provided with a movable substrate, a rotating shaft is arranged at the joint of each connecting side frame and the movable substrate, the flow guide assembly comprises a liquid transfer box, the liquid transfer box is positioned at the bottom surface of each soil storage box, and the upper surface of each liquid transfer box is provided with a limiting jacking pile.

title_en: IRF8 polyclonal antibody and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an IRF8 polyclonal antibody, a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of biology. The invention successfully constructs a prokaryotic expression vector of IRF8 through methods of RT-PCR, cloning, double enzyme digestion and the like, obtains high-concentration and high-purity target protein by adopting a nickel column affinity purification technology after induced expression, takes New Zealand white rabbits as a polyclonal antibody preparation object, mixes recombinant protein with Freund's adjuvant, adds pachyman for common emulsification treatment to improve immune effect, and shows that when the antigen coating concentration is 1.25 mug/mL, the titer reaches 1:2048000, and the titer of the polyclonal antibody added with pachyman group is obviously higher than that of a normal control group. The IRF8 polyclonal antibody has excellent specificity and sensibility to poultry animals, provides a reliable tool for expression detection, positioning analysis and function exploration of IRF8 protein in poultry related disease research, and has important application value.

title_en: Microsphere array-based high-sensitivity small molecule detection method and system
abstract_en: The application relates to a microsphere array-based high-sensitivity small molecule detection method and a microsphere array-based high-sensitivity small molecule detection system, wherein the small molecule detection method comprises the following steps of preparing quantum dot labeled detection small molecule hapten; preparing antibody coated microsphere, preparing microsphere array biochip, adding sample to be tested and quantum dot labeled small molecule hapten into reaction container, slowly adding detection zone of microsphere array biochip, incubating for 5min under the condition of constant temp. of 37 deg.C to make competition reaction, after reaction is completed, slowly adding cleaning liquor into detection zone of microsphere array biochip, placing microsphere array biochip on inverted fluorescent microscope stage to make imaging, after fluorescent bright spot is identified, counting quantum dot signal quantity and fluorescent signal integral intensity of every microsphere, and according to poisson distribution principle or establishing standard curve obtaining concentration of sample to be tested. The method has the advantages of high sensitivity, high reaction efficiency, simple and convenient operation and the like.

title_en: Intelligent rod for measuring water quality and position of drainage well
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of detection equipment, in particular to an intelligent rod for measuring water quality and position of a drainage well, which comprises an integrated telescopic measuring rod, wherein a central controller with a screen and an RTK positioning module are fixedly arranged at the top of the integrated telescopic measuring rod, a movable water quality sensor assembly is arranged on the integrated telescopic measuring rod, the water quality sensor assembly comprises a sliding frame sleeved on the integrated telescopic measuring rod, an RTU unit is fixedly arranged at the outer side of the sliding frame, a water quality sensor group is arranged at the bottom of the RTU unit, a floating ball is further arranged on the sliding frame, when the sliding frame is scratched into water, the lower part of the water quality sensor group is immersed into flowing water with a few centimeters below, and the upper part of the water quality sensor group and the RTU unit are positioned above the water surface. The invention can accurately acquire longitude and latitude coordinates and wellhead elevation, completely adapt to the high-precision requirement of accurate maintenance and asset check of a pipeline network, and realize weight adaptation by a single person without complex auxiliary equipment, thereby completing measurement operation by the single person.

title_en: Signal amplification system and kit based on acridinium ester chemiluminescence
abstract_en: The invention provides a signal amplification system and a kit based on acridine ester chemiluminescence, which belong to the technical field of in-vitro diagnostic reagents, and particularly comprise streptavidin polymer and a luminescent compound, wherein the luminescent compound is biotin-carrier protein-acridine ester compound, and the biotin-carrier protein-acridine ester compound and the streptavidin polymer are bridged through the specific combination of biotin and streptavidin. The signal amplification system provided by the invention can realize the detection of the sub-picogram antigen, and has a wide application prospect.

title_en: Anti-tmTNF-alpha antibodies and their use in CART treatment
abstract_en: The invention relates to an anti-transmembrane tumor necrosis factor alpha antibody and application thereof, wherein the anti-transmembrane tumor necrosis factor alpha antibody comprises a heavy chain variable region and a light chain variable region, the sequence of the heavy chain variable region is shown as SEQ ID NO. 1, and the sequence of the light chain variable region is shown as SEQ ID NO. 2. The anti-tmTNF-alpha antibody and the single-chain antibody constructed by the anti-tmTNF-alpha antibody can specifically identify and bind tmTNF-alpha and cells expressing tmTNF-alpha, and CART cells constructed by the single-chain antibody can specifically kill the cells expressing tmTNF-alpha in vitro, and can inhibit the development of breast cancer in vivo and in vitro, thereby remarkably delaying the death time of breast cancer mice.

title_en: Application of sFRP2 in preparation of medicines for treating ischemic heart failure by inhibiting Wnt/beta-catenin signal pathway, related kit and medicine screening method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an application of sFRP2 in preparing a medicament for treating ischemic heart failure by inhibiting a Wnt/beta-catenin signal pathway, a related kit and a medicament screening method, relates to the technical field of biological medicaments, and relates to the application of sFRP2 in preparing a medicament for treating heart failure caused by ischemic cardiomyopathy by inhibiting the Wnt/beta-catenin signal pathway, wherein the medicament comprises an effective dose of sFRP2 protein, the medicament comprises a Wnt/beta-catenin signal pathway inhibitor, a kit for evaluating the risk of ischemic heart failure, a reagent for detecting the expression level of the sFRP2 and the Wnt/beta-catenin, and an application of the medicament for treating the ischemic heart failure by inhibiting the Wnt/beta-catenin signal pathway, the related kit and the medicament screening method, so as to develop a new therapeutic medicament and improve the therapeutic effect of the ischemic heart failure, and simultaneously, the kit for evaluating the risk of the ischemic heart failure realizes early-stage and accurate diagnosis and risk evaluation of the ischemic heart failure.

title_en: Use of CCNDBP A in inhibiting malignant progression of cervical cancer cells
abstract_en: The invention discloses an application of CCNDBP to inhibiting malignant progress of cervical cancer cells, relates to the field of medical treatment, and relates to an application of CCNDBP gene or CCNDBP gene encoding protein thereof in preparation of a medicament for inhibiting malignant progress of cervical cancer cells, wherein the medicament is applicable to a HIF1A-CCNDBP1-Nrf2 signal shaft in a targeted cervical cancer hypoxia microenvironment, the application is realized by up-regulating CCNDBP1 expression or activity, the targeted cervical cancer hypoxia microenvironment is realized by regulating and controlling the HIF1A-CCNDBP1 shaft. The key effect of CCNDBP in the cervical cancer hypoxia microenvironment is disclosed for the first time, a theoretical basis is provided for the cervical cancer hypoxia microenvironment as a treatment target, and the cervical cancer hypoxia microenvironment can effectively inhibit the malignant behaviors of cancer cells, enhance the chemotherapy sensitivity, has a definite mechanism and has clinical transformation potential through regulating CCNDBP.

title_en: Antibodies recognizing MSLN and uses thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of biological medicine, in particular to an antibody for recognizing MSLN and application thereof. The ScFv for identifying the MSLN is obtained through screening and can be used for detecting the expression of the MSLN by immunohistochemistry, flow cytometry and the like, and meanwhile, the ScFv and immune cells constructed on the basis of taking the ScFv as an extracellular identification domain have the advantages that compared with the contrast and the prior art, the tumor cell killing capability is obviously improved, and the application prospect is wide.

title_en: Single use disposable sex reference sensor
abstract_en: A single-use disposable potentiometer reference sensor includes an insulating base substrate, a reference electrode disposed on the insulating base substrate, wherein the reference electrode is a silver-silver chloride electrode, an inner layer disposed on the reference electrode, wherein the inner layer is an amorphous salt layer comprising an amorphous polysaccharide and a salt having equal mobility cations and anions, and a semi-permeable cover film disposed over the inner layer, wherein the semi-permeable cover film has water vapor and ion permeability.

title_en: Multifunctional intelligent ecological monitoring water surface unmanned cruising robot for watershed
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional intelligent ecological monitoring water surface unmanned cruising robot for a river basin, and belongs to the technical field of ecological environment monitoring and intelligent unmanned systems. According to the invention, through the rotor wing assembly and the four-drive propeller group, the robot can navigate in water and air, and can dynamically cover a full-river basin by combining with the autonomous cruise module, so that the low-efficiency operation of sparse monitoring and manual sampling of a fixed site is replaced, and the real-time data acquisition with a large range and no dead angle is realized. And the data processing module is used for preprocessing the acquired data and uploading the preprocessed data to the THINGSPEAK platform. The data processing module can also realize the space visualization of the data and meet the distribution analysis requirement of the regional scale. The millimeter wave radar, the ultrasonic detector and other devices of the autonomous cruise module can identify floaters, submerged reefs and other obstacles. The positioning unit adopts a GPS and Beidou dual-mode system, ensures stable transmission of signals, and solves the problems of small detection range and untimely data transmission of the existing device.

title_en: Electronic soil tensiometer capable of being automatically maintained and maintenance method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of soil moisture monitoring, and discloses an electronic soil tensiometer capable of being automatically maintained and a maintenance method thereof, wherein the electronic soil tensiometer comprises a water storage pipe, a sealing cap, an electric push rod assembly, a pressure sensor and a comprehensive control system; the top of the water storage pipe is provided with a water supplementing port, the bottom of the water storage pipe is connected with a tensiometer, one end of the tensiometer, which is far away from the water storage pipe, is provided with a porous ceramic head, the inner cavity of the water storage pipe is a water storage cavity, and the bottom of the water storage cavity is provided with a fluid channel so that the water storage cavity is communicated with the inner cavity of the tensiometer; the sealing cap is used for sealing the fluid channel, the electric push rod assembly is detachably arranged at the water supplementing port of the water storage pipe, when the output end of the electric push rod assembly acts, the sealing cap can be driven to open or close the fluid channel so as to realize the exhaust and water supplementing of the tensiometer, the pressure sensor is used for monitoring the pressure change of the inner cavity of the tensiometer, and the pressure sensor and the electric push rod assembly are connected with a comprehensive control system through signals so as to control the electric push rod assembly to act according to the pressure change of the tensiometer.

title_en: In-pipe concrete bubble escape test device and test method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of concrete pumping and pouring of steel pipes, in particular to an in-pipe concrete bubble escape test device and a test method, wherein the device comprises a test pipe, a support frame, an air injection device and a gas collection device; the test tube is used for simulating an actual steel tube, the test tube is provided with an exhaust hole and is in sealing connection with the gas collecting device, the support frame is used for bearing and fixing the test tube, the angle of the test tube can be adjusted to simulate different setting states of the steel tube, and the air injection device is used for quantitatively injecting air into concrete in the tube to simulate a scene of on-site bubble generation. The device can accurately simulate the on-site steel pipe erection and concrete pouring working conditions, realize the real-time observation and multi-index quantification of bubble escape, efficiently provide scientific basis for construction parameter optimization, has a simple structure, can be repeatedly used, and has higher practical value and industrial popularization prospect.

title_en: Water quality sampling detection device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water quality sampling and detecting device, which relates to a detecting device, and comprises a substrate, wherein the middle part of the substrate is rotationally connected with a central shaft, the outer side of the central shaft is fixedly connected with a plurality of connecting rods, the outer sides of the connecting rods are fixedly connected with detecting components, each detecting component comprises a detecting cylinder, the side wall of each detecting cylinder is provided with a plurality of sampling holes, the inner sides of the sampling holes are fixedly connected with elastic baffle plates, and the detecting cylinders are used for injecting water quality samples into the detecting cylinders through the elastic baffle plates at different positions. Compared with the prior art, the water quality detection device has the beneficial effects that the structure is simple, the use is convenient, the sampling can be carried out at different sampling depths through the plurality of groups of detection assemblies which are independently arranged, meanwhile, water is injected into the detection cylinder at a single sampling site through different positions, the accuracy of the sampling is ensured, and the water quality detection result can reflect the actual water quality more truly.

title_en: Petroleum component detection device based on intelligent sensor
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent sensor-based petroleum component detection device, and relates to the technical field of petroleum detection. The petroleum component detection device based on the intelligent sensor comprises a detection bin, wherein a first moving rod driven by a first linear motor is arranged in the detection bin, a detection probe with the intelligent sensor is arranged at the bottom of the first moving rod, and a second moving rod penetrates through the detection bin and is driven by the second linear motor. This petroleum composition detection device based on intelligent sensor, when movable rod one and test probe move down to the measuring flask that holds petroleum in, cooperation connecting rod, toothed bar one, gear one, cam, hydraulic pressure storehouse one, atress pole one, hydraulic hose, spring one, hydraulic pressure storehouse two, arc pole and vibration board can strike the outer wall position of measuring flask that holds petroleum under this circumstances, makes it produce vibrations to a certain extent, prevents that the petroleum subsides layering, has improved the accuracy of testing result.

title_en: Automatic auditing method of glycosylated hemoglobin, sample analysis equipment and system
