abstract_en: An automatic auditing method, sample analysis equipment and sample analysis system for glycosylated hemoglobin are provided, wherein basic information of a detected person is obtained, a detection value related to blood sugar and a detection value related to red blood cells of the detected person are obtained, an estimated value of the glycosylated hemoglobin of the detected person is calculated according to the basic information of the detected person, the detection value related to blood sugar and the detection value related to red blood cells, and the detection value of the glycosylated hemoglobin of the detected person is automatically audited according to the estimated value of the glycosylated hemoglobin of the detected person. The application provides an automatic auditing scheme for glycosylated hemoglobin, which can lighten the workload of auditors, so that the auditors can concentrate on auditing the detection value of the glycosylated hemoglobin which is not automatically audited and is suspected to be problematic.

title_en: Sampling detection device and detection method for fluorite mine survey
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sampling detection device and a detection method for fluorite mine exploration, and belongs to the technical field of mineral resource exploration. The device comprises a vertical frame, a drilling mechanism, a sample accommodating mechanism, a layered sampling mechanism, a spraying mechanism and a central control system. A liftable sorting cylinder is coaxially sleeved in a hollow drill rod of the drilling mechanism, and an annular base of the layered sampling mechanism is fixed on the inner wall of the drill rod and provided with a circumferential cutting piece. The lithology interface is identified while drilling through a sensor in the sorting barrel, and when drilling is suspended, the cutting piece is controlled to extend out to perform in-situ horizontal cutting on the rock core, and the sample carrying section is supported by the sorting barrel to ascend. For broken cores, in-situ spray consolidation can be performed by an atomizing nozzle. And the central control system intelligently selects standard cutting, cutting after consolidation or rock debris collecting modes according to the rock core integrity evaluation result. The invention realizes in-situ accurate stratified sampling and sample protection according to a real geological interface, and fundamentally solves the problem that the mixed sample and the sample are easy to damage.

title_en: Dentin tubule blocking rate test pretreatment equipment and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pretreatment device and a pretreatment method for dentin tubule blocking rate test. The device comprises a main control unit and at least one group of test branches, wherein each group of test branches is integrated with a tooth brushing connecting rod mechanism, a flushing connecting rod mechanism, a tested material containing module and a dentin fixing module. The main control unit cooperatively completes the integrated automatic circulation operation of 'quantitative dipping-controllable pressure tooth brushing-multi-angle vibration flushing' through the time sequence linkage control of each mechanism. The tooth brushing pressure is controlled in a closed loop manner within the range of 300g-800g through the pressure sensor and the elastic buffer piece, and the high-efficiency cleaning is realized through the angle-adjustable spray head with the angle of 0-45 degrees and the integrated vibrator in the flushing process. The invention realizes standardization, automation and data whole course traceability of the test flow, is particularly suitable for dentinal tubule blocking rate test of oral cavity materials such as toothpaste, desensitization paste and the like, and solves the problems of complicated manual operation, poor parameter consistency and insufficient material suitability in the prior art.

title_en: Cloud big data processing method of water quality analysis platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water quality analysis, in particular to a cloud big data processing method of a water quality analysis platform. The method comprises the steps of calling a photoelectric sensor group to collect original water quality signals, performing timestamp mapping on the signals and a geographic space grid, packaging the signals and the geographic space grid into a water quality information body, resolving a reaction dynamics constraint relation through a chemometric consistency logic gate, repairing a data hole by utilizing Kerling space interpolation and integrating the data hole into a water quality analysis set, calculating nonlinear coupling coefficients between physicochemical factors and environment flux, constructing a water quality coupling matrix, generating a water quality ecological tensor through a chemometric self-coding mechanism, analyzing water quality chemical components based on pedigree homology, and inverting physicochemical index tracks by utilizing a time sequence evolution prediction model. According to the invention, through introducing chemical mechanism constraint and environmental coupling analysis, the island effect of single monitoring data is broken, and rapid analysis, accurate tracing and dynamic trend prediction of water quality data are realized.

title_en: Hydrogeology conceals calamity detection device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of hydrogeology investigation, in particular to a hydrogeology hidden disaster detection device which comprises a fixed plate, wherein a threaded sleeve is fixedly connected to the outer part of the fixed plate, a second motor is fixedly connected to the outer part of the threaded sleeve, a main shaft is arranged at the output end of the second motor, a second bevel gear is connected to the outer part of the main shaft in a meshed mode, the second bevel gear is rotationally connected with the threaded sleeve, a threaded rod is connected to the outer part of the second bevel gear in a threaded mode, a first telescopic rod is fixedly connected to the outer part of the fixed plate, a second telescopic rod is slidingly connected to the outer part of the first telescopic rod, a fixing frame is fixedly connected to the outer part of the fixing frame, a small gear is arranged at the output end of the first motor, a large gear is connected to the outer part of the small gear in a meshed mode, and the hydrogeology hidden disaster detection device can adapt to complex geological environments.

title_en: Rice taste quality detection method, rice taste quality detection device, electronic equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rice taste quality detection method, a device, electronic equipment and a readable storage medium, wherein the method is used for acquiring physical and chemical index measurement values of rice to be detected, inputting the physical and chemical index measurement values of the rice to be detected into a pre-trained feed-forward neural network MLP model to obtain taste values, and determining the taste quality of the rice to be detected by the taste values. The invention detects the taste quality of rice based on the neural network combined with the physicochemical index of rice, is not influenced by personnel experience and regional habit, has high accuracy and efficiency, does not need to be equipped with an expensive rice taste instrument, and has lower cost.

title_en: Original austenite grain boundary display method for high-pressure end steel of steam turbine rotor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a prior austenite grain boundary display method for high-pressure end steel of a steam turbine rotor, and belongs to the technical field of metallographic detection. The method comprises the steps of carrying out surface treatment on a steel sample to be tested to obtain a metallographic specimen with no macroscopic scratches on the surface, carrying out electrolytic corrosion, washing and metallographic observation on the metallographic specimen, wherein the electrolyte is a mixed solution of phosphoric acid and sulfuric acid, the electrolytic parameter is 14-16V direct current voltage, and the electrolytic corrosion is 50-70 s. The invention utilizes the customized acid electrolyte and the microcosmic difference of the prior austenite grain boundary and the surrounding bainite matrix in chemical activity under the optimized electrochemical condition to realize controllable and selective corrosion, thereby safely and efficiently revealing the grain boundary network which is critical to the material performance.

title_en: Drain pipe for deep coal bed gas shaft
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of drainage pipes, in particular to a drainage pipe for a deep coal bed gas shaft, which comprises an inner layer pipe, a compression layer, a tensile member and an outer layer pipe; the compression-resistant layer is sleeved outside the inner layer pipe, the outer layer pipe is sleeved outside the compression-resistant layer, and a plurality of tensile pieces extending along the length direction of the compression-resistant layer are arranged between the compression-resistant layer and the outer layer pipe. The compression-resistant layer and the tensile member are arranged, so that the compression-resistant effect and the tensile effect of the drain pipe can be obviously improved, the tensile member is arranged between the compression-resistant layer and the outer layer pipe and can bear partial tensile force generated along the length direction of the drain pipe, the tensile member can well protect the compression-resistant layer, the problem that the compression-resistant layer is damaged due to the tensile force is reduced, the compression-resistant effect of the compression-resistant layer is guaranteed, the compression-resistant member can avoid the damage of the compression force to the inner layer pipe, and the overall service life of the drain pipe is prolonged.

title_en: Method and device for reading immunochromatography detection result based on solid-state quantum enhancement
abstract_en: The application provides an immunochromatography detection result reading method and device based on solid-state quantum enhancement, and relates to the technical field of immunochromatography detection. The immunochromatography detection result reading method comprises the steps of emitting excitation light to a standard substance to excite the standard substance to generate a fluorescence signal for detection, outputting microwaves to the standard substance to enable the standard substance to generate spin resonance and cause intensity change of the fluorescence signal, collecting the fluorescence signal after the intensity change to obtain a photodetection magnetic resonance ODMR reference spectral line, determining corresponding microwave calibration frequency according to the photodetection magnetic resonance ODMR reference spectral line, emitting the excitation light and microwaves which are calibrated according to the microwave calibration frequency and are subjected to amplitude or frequency modulation to a detected sample, and respectively detecting fluorescence intensity change amounts of a quality control line and a detection line to obtain an immunochromatography detection result of the detected sample. The application realizes the calibration of microwave frequency by using the standard substance, effectively shields background fluorescence interference and improves the detection sensitivity and accuracy.

title_en: Methods for monitoring potential rejection indicators in allograft recipients
abstract_en: The present invention relates to methods of monitoring potential indications of allogeneic organ rejection by monitoring transplanted hair follicles from the same donor as the transplanted organ, and performing immunosuppressive therapy or modifying immunosuppressive therapy to ameliorate or prevent the occurrence of acute or chronic organ rejection. The methods of the invention can also be used to select candidate allograft solid organ donors for recipients, as well as to improve the incidence of acute rejection of transplanted allograft solid organs (e.g., kidneys).

title_en: Full-automatic multimode immunity analyzer
abstract_en: The application belongs to the field of medical examination automation equipment, and particularly relates to a full-automatic multi-mode immunoassay analyzer which comprises a frame module, wherein a sample processing area, a reagent consumable area and a core reaction detection area are respectively arranged on the frame module, the sample processing area and the reagent consumable area are positioned at the front part of the frame module, the core reaction detection area comprises a magnetic separation module consisting of N independent units, a trolley reaction module consisting of 2N independent units and a detection module, the 2N independent units of the trolley reaction module are divided into N groups, each group is distributed in an upper-lower double layer manner, and each group is positioned below each independent unit of the magnetic separation module. The analyzer provided by the application comprises 4 trolley reaction modules, 2 magnetic separation modules, a multi-axis transfer arm and the like, so that the detection flux is more than or equal to 100T/H (four modules are parallel), and the efficiency is improved by 67%. The space utilization rate is improved, the arrangement ratio of the magnetic separator to the trolley reaction module is 1:2, and the magnetic separator is of a vertical nested structure, so that the occupied area is reduced by 40%.

title_en: Automatic station soil humidity observation data layer-by-layer correction method based on meteorological environment factors and multi-model integration
abstract_en: The invention discloses a layer-by-layer correction method for automatic station soil humidity observation data based on meteorological environment factors and multi-model integration, which is characterized in that the influence of evaporation and precipitation on soil humidity is considered, hysteresis effect is achieved, the change of different layers of soil humidity is influenced by the change of upper layer humidity, the soil humidity observed manually is taken as a reference, meteorological factors such as air temperature, wind speed, precipitation and vegetation index are combined with environmental factors, a plurality of machine learning algorithms such as Generalized Additive Model (GAM) integration Cubist, random forest, XGBoost and CatBoost are comprehensively adopted, the automatic station soil humidity observation data are corrected in a layer-by-layer manner, the corrected soil humidity data obviously improves the observation precision, particularly the soil humidity observation network with high precision and long-term stability is improved obviously in deep soil, and a reliable data basis is provided for verification of remote sensing and numerical simulation soil humidity products.

title_en: Underground water aquatic water threshold grading dynamic early warning method integrating multiple source indexes
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for dynamically pre-warning underground water ecological threshold grading by fusing multiple source indexes, which comprises the steps of constructing a pre-warning index system comprising topography, gas-covered zone lithology, precipitation infiltration replenishment intensity, underground water level burial depth and TDS, dividing the value range of the pre-warning index into continuous warning grades and assigning values, constructing a judging matrix, determining relative weights corresponding to the pre-warning indexes, determining GWES, pre-warning grading the GWES, and setting multiple future pre-warning scenes for pre-warning evaluation. The multi-source fusion early warning index system breaks through the limitation of traditional single index evaluation, determines the GWES through standardized assignment and index weight, not only reflects the relative importance of each early warning index in an ecological system, but also remarkably improves the objectivity and ecological relevance of early warning classification, overcomes the subjectivity of artificial division, fully reserves the characteristic of data space heterogeneity, and enables the early warning result to reflect the overall trend and reflect the local difference.

title_en: Method, system, equipment and medium for detecting drug resistance of klebsiella pneumoniae
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of computer information processing, in particular to a method, a system, equipment and a medium for detecting the drug resistance of klebsiella pneumoniae, which comprise the steps of acquiring and processing original mass spectrum data of a strain to be detected, determining topology persistence therefrom to screen characteristic peaks and constructing an ordered characteristic sequence; generating view pairs by data enhancement, mapping the view pairs into position codes and intensity embedded tensors, combining embedded marks to construct an input sequence, inputting the input sequence into an interpretable contrast learning network, optimizing characterization consistency by using an attention mechanism and contrast learning, updating a feature extractor, freezing extractor parameters, accessing a classification head, and adjusting by using a labeling sample to realize judgment of collaborative characterization. Therefore, the invention utilizes the attention mechanism and the aggregation logic to eliminate the black box attribute in the decision process by combining the topology persistence feature extraction and the interpretable contrast learning network, thereby realizing the drug resistance detection with high accuracy and clinical reliability.

title_en: Ship ballast water monitoring method based on ballast water sampling data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ship ballast water monitoring method based on ballast water sampling data, and particularly relates to the field of data analysis and monitoring. The method comprises the steps of triggering flow ratio composite sampling according to a pump valve and an accumulated volume under loading/discharging working condition, synchronously obtaining on-line sensing fragments of an on-line pipe, establishing a correlation link of a business batch and a blank control batch, a calibration batch, a container and a detection record, extracting fingerprint characteristics of activity, structure, environment, working condition and process, generating prediction and residual error based on a dynamic baseline model, calculating risk probability and judging level by combining residual error abnormality, change point and source consistency, adaptively updating a threshold value, writing back parameter versions, and outputting a monitoring report, a work order and audit and certification.

title_en: PD-1 and CTLA-4 double-target inhibition polypeptide or pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof and application thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a polypeptide or pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof, wherein the polypeptide has an amino acid sequence shown as SEQ ID NO. 1 or SEQ ID NO. 2. The polypeptides of the application, or pharmaceutically acceptable salts thereof, can bind to PD-1 and CTLA-4 for effective inhibition of PD-1 and CTLA-4. Thus, the polypeptide or the pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof can be used for detecting PD-1 and/or CTLA-4, and can also be used for treating or preventing diseases mediated by PD-1 and/or CTLA-4 (such as tumors or cancers, e.g. lung cancer, melanoma, lymphoma, leukemia and the like).

title_en: Textile physical property testing method based on sensor
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of textile physical property testing, and discloses a textile physical property testing method based on a sensor, which comprises the following steps of S1, pretreatment, S2, preliminary information acquisition, S3, washing, S4 and low-tension extraction; S5, drying, S6, data processing, S7, and calculating the shrinkage rate. According to the technical scheme, the sample is lifted from the water in a horizontal lifting mode through the tray with the plane, so that the problem that the sample is easy to pull and then generate irreversible deformation after being just washed due to the fact that the dead weight of the water is large is effectively avoided, and the operation mode is optimized, so that the test precision is effectively improved. Through the tray with the pressure sensor matrix, whether the position of the sample is correct or not can be tested in the process of primary sample information acquisition, the condition that the sample is initially spread is ensured to be qualified from the source, and subsequent testing errors caused by improper spreading of the sample are avoided.

title_en: Method and system for detecting fluorine ions in water
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for detecting fluoride ions in water, and relates to the technical field of ion detection, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting time-aligned multidimensional data streams through a multi-mode sensor, constructing a physical time sequence neural network embedded with a Nernst equation and ion interference dynamics constraint, learning space-time correlation and outputting an interference compensation vector, and calculating a concentration value by combining multi-factor coupling compensation; meanwhile, a calibration utility model is built based on model confidence, sensor state and environmental fluctuation, and the model and Nernst mechanism parameters are dynamically triggered, calibrated and updated in a linkage mode.

title_en: Ferritin monoclonal antibody pair and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ferritin antibody pair and application thereof, comprising a first antibody 7A8 and a second antibody 3H4, wherein the amino acid sequences of a CDR1, a CDR2 and a CDR3 of a heavy chain variable region of the first antibody are respectively shown as SEQ ID NO. 1, SEQ ID NO. 2 and SEQ ID NO. 3, the amino acid sequences of a CDR1, a CDR2 and a CDR3 of a light chain variable region of the first antibody are respectively shown as SEQ ID NO. 4, SEQ ID NO. 5 and SEQ ID NO. 6, the amino acid sequences of a CDR1, a CDR2 and a CDR3 of a heavy chain variable region of the second antibody are respectively shown as SEQ ID NO. 11, SEQ ID NO. 12 and SEQ ID NO. 13, and the amino acid sequences of a CDR1, a CDR2 and a CDR3 of a light chain variable region of the second antibody are respectively shown as SEQ ID NO. 14, SEQ ID NO. 15 and SEQ ID NO. 16. The sandwich immunofluorescence detection reagent prepared based on the antibody shows high sensitivity, wide linear range and high clinical compliance in detection, can meet clinical requirements of iron deficiency anemia primary screening, tumor auxiliary diagnosis and the like, and is suitable for popularization and application in primary medical treatment and home self-test.

title_en: Electrochemical luminescence immunosensor with low trigger potential and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low trigger potential electrochemiluminescence immunosensor and a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the field of biological detection, comprising a three-electrode system, wherein the three-electrode system comprises a working electrode, a reference electrode and a counter electrode, and the working electrode comprises a conductive substrate; the device comprises a conductive substrate, a vertical ordered mesoporous silica film, gold-copper alloy nano particles, an epoxy group modification layer, a placenta growth factor specific antibody, bovine serum albumin and a placenta growth factor specific antibody, wherein the vertical ordered mesoporous silica film is formed on the surface of the conductive substrate and is provided with a nano channel, the gold-copper alloy nano particles are formed in the nano channel, the epoxy group modification layer is formed on the outer surface of the vertical ordered mesoporous silica film, the placenta growth factor specific antibody is covalently bound to the epoxy group modification layer, and the bovine serum albumin is covalently bound to a region, which is not bound by the placenta growth factor specific antibody, on the epoxy group modification layer. The invention has the advantages of realizing high-efficiency electrochemiluminescence under low potential and improving detection sensitivity and stability.

title_en: Atmospheric pollutant concentration prediction method and system for mutation early warning
abstract_en: The invention discloses an atmospheric pollutant concentration prediction method and system for mutation early warning. The method comprises the steps of obtaining historical monitoring data and carrying out hierarchical cleaning treatment, constructing an input characteristic set containing external influence, periodical time, historical hysteresis and statistical sliding window characteristics, carrying out abnormal event detection and fusing event characteristics, dividing the data set according to time sequence, constructing a supervision learning sample under strict time and causal constraint, constructing and training a CNN-LSTM composite prediction model, constructing mutation discriminant based on a prediction value, and outputting early warning when the mutation discriminant exceeds an adaptive threshold. The invention also provides a system for realizing the method, which can be deployed in the FPGA. The method improves the prediction precision, stability and mutation response capability through time causal constraint, stable data cleaning, multidimensional feature fusion and a CNN-LSTM model of the whole flow, and ensures the consistency of offline evaluation and online deployment.

title_en: Goat pox virus specific competition ELISA detection kit and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biological detection, and discloses a goat pox virus specific competition ELISA detection kit and application thereof. The invention discloses a hybridoma cell strain GTPV-N1P-4H6, which is based on a prokaryotic expression system to realize efficient soluble expression of GTPV-N1, and is used as an immunogen to immunize a mouse, and after cell fusion, a GTPV positive hybridoma cell strain GTPV-N1P-4H6 capable of stably secreting antibodies is successfully prepared and screened. The ELISA titer of the antibody obtained after the purification of the ascites of the monoclonal antibody secreted by the cell strain is 1:64000, the heavy chain of the antibody is IgGa subtype 2, and the light chain is Kappa chain. Based on the antibody, the high-efficiency detection of goat pox virus N1 protein can be realized.

title_en: Application of exosome lncOSLMT in diagnosis and treatment of osteosarcoma lung metastasis
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biological medicines, and discloses application of an exosome lncOSLMT in diagnosis and treatment of osteosarcoma lung metastasis. The invention discloses application of a reagent for detecting lncOSLMT in preparation of products for diagnosing or prognostic evaluation of osteosarcoma pulmonary metastasis, and the invention discovers that lncOSLMT is selectively enriched in exosomes released by osteosarcoma cells with high metastatic potential through research. The increase in expression is positively correlated with the incidence of pulmonary metastasis and serves as an independent prognostic factor for poor prognosis in osteosarcoma patients. The invention clarifies the regulation and control effect of lncOSLMT in the microenvironment before osteosarcoma lung metastasis and the effect of lncOSLMT on lung metastasis, and clearly targets lncOSLMT to have important clinical transformation value for targeting osteosarcoma lung metastasis treatment, especially the effect in osteosarcoma liquid biopsy and early metastasis prediction, and has important significance for ensuring sufficient clinical safety.

title_en: Remote operation and maintenance system of water environment quality monitoring equipment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of water environment monitoring, and particularly provides a remote operation and maintenance system of water environment quality monitoring equipment, which comprises an alternate measurement and decoupling module, a mutual exclusion collaborative decision module, a hydraulic transient suppression and calibration reconstruction module and a physical mechanism mapping correction module. The method comprises the steps of obtaining signals through three sections of alternate measurement by an alternate measurement and decoupling module, decoupling an equivalent pollution film thickness and a probe body sensitivity attenuation coefficient based on a joint inversion model, generating a mutual exclusion regulation and control instruction according to the mutual exclusion regulation and control instruction by a mutual exclusion cooperative decision module, outputting a time sequence combination instruction of cleaning before calibration during mixed degradation, calculating delay time by a hydraulic transient suppression and calibration reconstruction module according to pipeline pressure attenuation data fitting hydraulic time constant to obtain a reconstruction calibration signal, and updating a fluid shear force mapping coefficient in the joint inversion model by a physical mechanism mapping correction module by combining the front and rear pollution film thicknesses and the hydraulic time constant. The invention realizes the physical separation of the abnormal root causes and the accurate mutual exclusion scheduling.

title_en: NanoLuc-dRNH1 fusion protein, preparation method and kit thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of protein engineering and bioluminescence analysis, and discloses a fusion protein nanoLuc-dRNH1, a preparation method and a kit thereof. The fusion protein is a single polypeptide chain, is formed by connecting a NanoLuc luminous enzyme domain and a dRNH domain through a connecting peptide, and has the selective binding capability of a DNA-RNA hybrid and the bioluminescence signal output capability taking furimazine as a substrate. The fusion protein can be obtained by recombinant expression in escherichia coli and purification by affinity chromatography. Experiments show that the fluorescent dye forms a complex with DNA-RNA hybrid, has low nonspecific binding to single-stranded DNA, single-stranded RNA and double-stranded DNA, and can generate stable and measurable luminescent signals in a short time at room temperature. The kit containing the fusion protein, furimazine and buffer solution is further provided, can be used for nucleic acid structure identification and signal reporting integrated detection, and has the advantages of simple preparation, high specificity, low background and quick reading.

title_en: Soil erosion dynamic monitoring method suitable for ecological planting of under-forest ginseng
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of chemical detection, and particularly discloses a soil erosion dynamic monitoring method suitable for ecological planting of under-forest ginseng, which comprises the steps of collecting basic environment parameters of a target forest land in each monitoring stage; the method comprises the steps of carrying out comprehensive sensitivity grading judgment to obtain an erosion sensitivity evaluation index system, carrying out erosion sensitivity grading judgment to generate a marked soil layer of a target forest land, collecting erosion sediment samples of a monitoring sample belt in each monitoring stage, carrying out measurement analysis to obtain rare earth element concentration values of the erosion sediment samples, carrying out risk monitoring analysis on the basic environment parameters, the rare earth element concentration values and preset correction influence factors to obtain the unit area soil erosion amount of the target forest land, carrying out risk judgment, generating erosion risk early warning information and planting parameter adjustment suggestion of the target forest land based on a risk analysis result, and obviously improving monitoring accuracy and practicality and effectively guaranteeing ecology and planting safety of the forest land.

title_en: Real-time diagnosis method and system for invisible defects of amorphous strips
abstract_en: The application provides a real-time diagnosis method and a real-time diagnosis system for invisible defects of an amorphous strip, and belongs to the technical field of nondestructive testing of materials. The method comprises the steps of synchronously collecting at least two physical signals of the amorphous strip through a multi-physical-field synchronous sensing array, extracting various characteristic parameters from the signals, inputting the characteristic parameters into a pre-trained machine learning diagnosis model, and outputting a diagnosis result containing defect information through the model. The system includes the multi-physical field synchronous sensor array and a processing unit coupled to the sensor array and configured to perform the method. According to the application, by fusing various physical signals and analyzing by using a machine learning model, the problems that the existing single detection means has a detection blind area and cannot be diagnosed in real time with high precision are solved, the comprehensive, online and high-precision diagnosis of the invisible defects of the amorphous strip can be realized, and the quality control level of products is improved.

title_en: FAM166A gene missense mutation molecular marker and application thereof in esophageal cancer disease risk assessment or prognosis judgment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biology, in particular to a FAM166A gene missense mutation molecular marker and application thereof in esophageal cancer disease risk assessment or prognosis judgment, which find that the expression level of FAM166A in esophageal cancer patient tissues is obviously higher than that of normal control, and the expression level is positively correlated with the occurrence and development of esophageal cancer, an in vitro cell function experiment proves that the FAM166A gene P84L missense mutant can further obviously enhance proliferation, invasion and migration capacity of esophageal cancer KYSE150 cells compared with wild FAM166A, the wild FAM166A is upregulated to obviously promote malignant phenotype of esophageal cancer cells, and the P84L mutant is upregulated to enhance the effect, and an esophageal cancer cell model for stably and excessively expressing FAM166A wild type and P84L mutant is constructed and can be used as a drug screening platform for high-throughput screening of antitumor candidate drugs targeting FAM166A or the mutant thereof.

title_en: Cascade catalytic nano-composite, preparation method thereof and cholesterol detection kit
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of functional nano materials and biological detection thereof, and discloses a cascade catalytic nano composite, a preparation method thereof and a cholesterol detection kit. The cascade catalytic nanocomposite comprises a metal-organic framework, copper ions doped in the metal-organic framework and cholesterol oxidase immobilized by the metal-organic framework. The preparation method comprises the steps of preparing a mixed solution containing a zinc source and a copper source, and sequentially adding a cholesterol oxidase solution and an organic ligand solution into the mixed solution to react to form the nano-composite. The cholesterol detection method comprises the steps of carrying out contact reaction on a sample to be detected, the nano-composite and a chromogenic substrate, and monitoring the color or absorbance change of a reaction system to determine the cholesterol content. The compound integrates cholesterol oxidase and peroxidase-like activity, and has excellent thermal stability and cascade catalytic efficiency.

title_en: Abnormal state early warning method and system applied to on-line monitoring of underground water
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses an abnormal state early warning method and system applied to on-line monitoring of groundwater, wherein the method converts a continuous monitoring curve into a dynamic causal state segment sequence consisting of segments with single internal dynamic change trend by carrying out dynamic causal state partition reconstruction processing on groundwater level values and groundwater quality values which are continuously collected at each monitoring point, so as to generate a finite state machine model representing state migration rules according to the trend transition direction among the segments. And then, carrying out mode semantic violation identification processing on a state transition path in the finite state machine model by calling a preset irreversible cause and effect semantic rule set, identifying a violation transition segment which violates natural evolution cause and effect logic of the groundwater, and generating a groundwater abnormal state early warning instruction containing a violation geographic coordinate point position mark according to positioning information of the violation transition segment in time sequence and space.

title_en: NOx redundancy detection method based on soft and hard sensors in SCR denitration system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a NOx redundancy detection method based on soft and hard sensors in an SCR denitration system, which comprises the steps of constructing a NOx detection model by using a NOx analyzer and a plurality of soft sensors, selecting one piece of most reliable data from input data according to a preset switching decision, and calculating and outputting the concentration of NOx at an outlet of the SCR denitration system; the switching decision in the NOx detection model comprises the steps of calculating quality indexes of a NOx analyzer and all soft sensors, analyzing process constraint conditions and mechanical constraint conditions of an SCR denitration system, eliminating unreliable input data, calculating and outputting NOx concentration at an outlet of the SCR denitration system for each piece of remaining input data, analyzing a tolerance model, outputting the final NOx concentration at the outlet of the SCR denitration system, realizing fault detection of the NOx analyzer, and realizing redundant switching of the soft sensors without depending on additional hardware.

title_en: Monoclonal cell capable of stably secreting anti-butyrylhydrazine monoclonal antibody and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a monoclonal cell 1B1 for stably secreting an anti-butyryl hydrazine monoclonal antibody and application thereof. The preservation number of the monoclonal cell 1B1 in the China general microbiological culture Collection center of the China Committee for culture Collection of microorganisms is CGMCC No.46765. The monoclonal cell 1B1 can stably secrete anti-butyrylhydrazine monoclonal antibody, the heavy chain subtype of the antibody is IgG1, the light chain subtype of the antibody is Kappa, the affinity constant Kaff=8.85×  9  L/mol, based on the monoclonal antibody, the invention establishes a butyrylhydrazine ELISA detection method, the lowest detection limit in a buffer solution system is 1.26 mug/mL, and the detection limit in an actual sample (such as broad beans, peanuts and the like) is 1.35-2.52 mug/mL. The ELISA detection method provided by the invention has the advantages of short detection time, simplicity and convenience in operation, low cost, excellent specificity and sensitivity, capability of rapidly and accurately detecting the butyryl hydrazine residue in an actual sample, suitability for batch rapid screening and quantitative detection of the butyryl hydrazine residue, and wide application prospect.

title_en: Groundwater detection method, system and terminal
abstract_en: The application relates to a method, a system and a terminal for detecting groundwater, which relate to the technical field of groundwater detection and comprise the steps of collecting a static detection trigger signal of groundwater; the method comprises the steps of responding to a static detection trigger signal to conduct static detection on a preset underground water sample to generate a static TDS value, collecting a dynamic detection trigger signal of underground water, responding to the dynamic detection trigger signal to conduct dynamic detection on the underground water sample to generate a dynamic TDS value, and fusing the static TDS value and the dynamic TDS value based on a preset fusion model to generate an actual TDS value. The application has the effect of improving the accuracy of groundwater detection.

title_en: Sand liquefaction influence range evaluation method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, in particular to a method, a device, equipment and a medium for evaluating the influence range of sand liquefaction. According to the physical parameters of soil body obtained at a plurality of drilling positions in a target area, calculating the actual cyclic stress ratio and the critical cyclic stress ratio of each drilling position, calculating a basic safety coefficient according to the ratio of the critical cyclic stress ratio to the actual cyclic stress ratio, correcting the basic safety coefficient according to the coarse sand mass ratio of each drilling position to obtain a corrected safety coefficient, obtaining the liquefaction index of each drilling position according to the corrected safety coefficient range of each drilling position and the liquefaction index corresponding to the corrected safety coefficient range, and obtaining the liquefaction index spatial distribution map of the target area according to the liquefaction indexes of all drilling positions and the preset geological complexity index. And a clear space range basis is provided for the targeted arrangement of the anti-liquefaction measures, so that the judgment ambiguity in engineering decision-making is reduced.

title_en: Antibody for detecting apolipoprotein E4 and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an antibody for detecting apolipoprotein E4 and application thereof, in particular relates to a detection antibody and a kit for detecting an Alzheimer disease blood marker ApoE4, and can accurately detect the presence of the apolipoprotein E4 based on the antibody and the kit.

title_en: Submerged plant biomass in-situ measurement method
abstract_en: The invention relates to an in-situ measurement method of submerged plant biomass, which comprises the steps of firstly, measuring the wet biomass of a unit area corresponding to the heights of different submerged plants under the same pressure in a laboratory, and fitting a relational expression of the wet biomass of the unit area of the submerged plants and the heights of the submerged plants meadow. The submerged plant meadow height measurer comprises a measurer main body and a measuring ruler, wherein the submerged plant meadow height in situ is measured through the cooperation of the measurer main body and the measuring ruler, and the wet biomass of the submerged plant in unit area can be calculated through a fitting formula. The in-situ measurement method provided by the invention has small damage to the submerged plant, can effectively obtain biomass at different stages in the growth process of the submerged plant, can effectively monitor the growth process of the submerged plant, and can ensure that the control experiment is completed efficiently and accurately.

title_en: Airport pavement damage real-time monitoring and disaster early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a real-time monitoring and disaster early warning method and a system for airport pavement damage, wherein the invention collects pavement multi-element data through a multi-element collaborative monitoring network to construct a pavement multi-element database; the method comprises the steps of capturing evolution of road surface damage under multi-factor coupling by adopting a CNN-transducer mixed model, simultaneously comprising an accumulation equation considering the road surface structure damage rate of structural heterogeneity and construction of a dynamic potential function of a road surface structure system, analyzing the stability of the road surface structure system of a unit in real time and calculating the potential energy of the system, defining a critical point of mutation of a dynamic potential function curved surface as a dynamic catastrophe threshold value, calculating the distance between the position of a current system state parameter on the dynamic potential function curved surface and the dynamic catastrophe threshold value in real time, and triggering three-level warning of concern, warning and catastrophe according to the distance. The invention realizes the whole process from microscopic sprouting to macroscopic catastrophe of road surface damage, and the cross-scale real-time perception ensures that the road surface early warning is updated from experience judgment to mechanization prediction.

title_en: Method and system for detecting moisture content of battery cell baking process based on multi-sensor time sequence characteristics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for detecting the moisture content of a battery cell baking process based on a multi-sensor time sequence characteristic, and relates to the technical field of lithium ion battery cell manufacturing; the method comprises the steps of preprocessing target sensing data, carrying out global feature extraction and local feature extraction, carrying out global feature extraction on all baking steps, carrying out local feature extraction on each vacuum baking step in the baking steps, carrying out optimization processing and weight distribution on the extracted features, constructing a LightGBM architecture-based moisture content detection model, training the moisture content detection model based on an optimization processing result, a weight distribution result and a moisture content label, and realizing moisture content detection of the battery cell baking process through the trained moisture content detection model. The invention has the technical advantages of good detection instantaneity, full coverage and high precision.

title_en: Method for reversely analyzing and tracing uncomfortable components of cigarette smoke based on sensory histology guidance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for reversely analyzing and tracing bad sensory components of cigarette smoke based on guidance of sensory group, and belongs to the technical field of tobacco processing. The method comprises the steps of taking waste tobacco powder as a raw material, extracting and preparing extracts with different sensory intensities through gradient concentration ethanol, adding the extracts to blank cigarettes to construct a full gradient sample library, acquiring smoke bad sensory dynamic characteristic data by adopting a double sensory evaluation method, coupling three chromatographic-mass spectrometry technologies to detect three types of components in smoke in full dimensions to construct a dynamic sensory and chemical component double database, screening bad sensory related markers through a multivariate statistics and random forest coupling model, reversely tracing the sources of the markers, and quantifying contribution degree and synergistic effect of each component by combining single/composite component verification, so as to lock key core components. The invention realizes the precise association of the sensory and chemical components, solves the problems of weak targeting, incapability of tracing and quantifying contribution degree, and simultaneously realizes the high-value utilization of waste tobacco powder.

title_en: GDF15 neutralizing antibodies and uses thereof
abstract_en: The present invention provides an antibody or antigen binding fragment thereof that binds GDF 15. The antibody or antigen binding fragment thereof comprises a CDR sequence selected from at least one of the following or an amino acid sequence having at least 66% identity with the same, namely a heavy chain variable region CDR sequence of SEQ ID NO 1-34 and SEQ ID NO 74-76, and a light chain variable region CDR sequence of SEQ ID NO 36-73 and SEQ ID NO 77-82. According to embodiments of the invention, the antibodies or antigen binding fragments thereof can specifically bind to GDF15 and can effectively block GFRAL from binding to GDF15, while also effectively inhibiting Treg differentiation, and can be used for the prevention and/or treatment of cancer and cachexia.

title_en: Lake water quality dynamic multi-parameter monitoring system based on intelligent sensor
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent perception of water environment monitoring, in particular to a lake water quality dynamic multi-parameter monitoring system based on an intelligent sensor, which comprises a characteristic manifold construction module, a key path extraction module, a water quality track prediction module and a signal generation module. The system periodically collects an original sequence of water quality parameters, converts the original sequence into high-dimensional state feature points through serialization coding, clusters the high-dimensional state feature points to form dynamic feature manifolds, calculates internal dimensions and curvatures to construct multidimensional parameter topological mapping, and extracts and screens a time evolution key path conforming to a threshold value. And inputting the critical path into a graph convolution circulation network, aggregating node information through an attention mechanism, introducing track smoothness and manifold structure retention constraint into a loss function to generate a predicted track, and finally outputting an early warning signal by combining the original data. The system can accurately describe the association relation of multidimensional water quality parameters, and ensure the physical rationality and evolution continuity of the water quality prediction track.

title_en: Underground harmful gas detection and correction method and system based on vehicle emission monitoring
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of coal mine safety monitoring and environment sensing, and discloses a method and a system for detecting and correcting underground harmful gas based on vehicle emission monitoring, wherein the method firstly acquires multi-source data of vehicle emission sources, spatial positions, gas flow fields and sensor observations and performs time synchronization alignment; the method comprises the steps of calculating a flow field coupling factor of a vehicle to a sensor, calculating tail gas transmission lag time by combining an air flow field and position data, constructing an interference prediction model based on emission source data, lag time and diffusion parameters, quantitatively calculating theoretical interference concentration generated by the vehicle, further calculating a dynamic confidence coefficient weight, calculating by combining observed data and theoretical values to obtain corrected real environment gas concentration, comparing the real concentration with a safety threshold value, and executing alarm triggering or inhibition control according to the result. The invention can effectively peel off the vehicle tail gas interference, restore the real roadway background concentration, reduce the false alarm rate and improve the monitoring accuracy and the production efficiency of the coal mine.

title_en: Intelligent monitoring method and system for state evaluation of gas unit
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent monitoring, in particular to an intelligent monitoring method and system for evaluating the state of a gas unit, comprising the following steps: and carrying out differential calculation on the oxygen concentration information to generate a transverse distribution map, comparing the adjacent measuring point trend screening positions to generate a starting region map, deducing connecting lines to generate a combustion diffusion track map, generating a start-stop distribution map according to track division levels, and judging and generating a unit monitoring scheme by combining the information. According to the invention, a transverse change gradient is constructed based on a multi-sensing sequence differential evolution process, an initial area and an extension path are defined by multi-point time sequence comparison, a monitoring panel deduction mechanism based on space-time correlation is constructed to eliminate misjudgment risks, a set operation evolution characteristic is built by leading capture parameter abnormal symptoms, hysteresis consulting and static rule standard alignment limitation are abandoned, through tracking from parameter abnormal to integral state deviation is realized, and equipment hidden danger exploring prospectivity and monitoring panel analysis effectiveness are improved.

title_en: Green optimization method based on barium slag innocent treatment process
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of solid waste treatment, in particular to a green optimization method based on a barium slag innocent treatment process, which comprises the steps of obtaining the pH value, oxidation-reduction state value, leached barium concentration value, sulfide concentration value and input resource data of each treatment round in the process stage of the barium slag innocent treatment; and screening out the inflection point turn from the treatment turn according to the pH value and the oxidation-reduction state value of the treatment turn, acquiring the steady-state confidence coefficient of the inflection point turn, acquiring the state convergence degree of the current treatment turn by combining the leached barium concentration value and the sulfide concentration value of the treatment turn after the inflection point turn, and regulating and controlling the barium slag harmless treatment process according to the state convergence degree and the delayed allowance degree of the current treatment turn. According to the invention, the dynamic regulation and control of the barium slag innocent treatment process are realized by analyzing the treatment process data of each treatment round in the barium slag innocent treatment process.

title_en: Methods of treating chronic wounds using caspase inhibitors
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to the treatment of wounds. Disclosed herein are compositions and methods for treating wounds, particularly chronic wounds, using caspase-3 inhibitors. Also disclosed are methods of detecting a wound based on the level of cleaved caspase-3 and/or caspase-3 activity in a wound sample.

title_en: System and method for quantification of dynamic response of a straightened skeletal tissue
abstract_en: A first waveform is obtained that includes a force response of skeletal tissue that experiences tonic contraction during a first period of time. One or more transformed waveforms are generated from the first waveform. The one or more transformed waveforms include at least one transformed waveform encoding a rate of change of the first waveform over the first period of time. A change point is identified within the one or more transformed waveforms. The change points occur at a plurality of time points within the first time period. A dynamic contractility vector is generated from the first waveform based on a comparison of values of the first waveform determined at the plurality of time points. The dynamic contractility vector characterizes a dynamic response of the bone tissue over the first period of time. An effect is determined based on the dynamic contractility vector.

title_en: Kit and application of RNF40 in preparation of products for detecting rheumatoid arthritis-related parkinsonism
abstract_en: A kit and application of RNF40 in preparing products for detecting rheumatoid arthritis-related parkinsonism comprises detection components for specifically detecting the expression level of RNF40 genes or proteins. Based on large-scale crowd queue analysis, mendelian randomization research, multi-tissue transcriptome screening and in-vivo function verification of animal co-disease models, the invention discovers that RNF40 presents bidirectional mediating characteristics on rheumatoid arthritis and parkinsonism joint, and when the expression level of RNF40 in samples such as peripheral blood of rheumatoid arthritis patients is obviously lower than a reference value, the risk of parkinsonism is increased for the first time. The kit realizes layering evaluation of the risk of the parkinsonism of the rheumatoid arthritis patient through in-vitro noninvasive detection, can also perform dynamic early warning through continuously monitoring the RNF40 expression change, has the characteristics of simplicity and convenience in operation and suitability for large-scale screening, and provides a reliable tool for early clinical intervention and accurate management.

title_en: A stationary flow removes congeals low gas circuit and detection chamber structure that remains for multi-sensor exhale gas detection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a steady-flow condensation-removal low-residue gas circuit and detection cavity structure for detecting multi-sensor exhaled gas, which belongs to the technical field of gas circuit structures of exhaled gas detection equipment and comprises a blowing interface assembly, a guide-in channel, a steady-flow buffer assembly, a liquid blocking/condensation-removal assembly, a detection cavity assembly and an exhaust and cleaning recovery assembly which are sequentially communicated. Through the combination setting of stationary flow chamber, fender liquid board, separation chamber, sprue and washing recovery branch road, can reduce and blow pulsation, liquid drop impact, condensation interference and sample remain, improve the effect uniformity of sample in a plurality of sensor installation positions department, be applicable to multi-sensor exhale gas check out test set.

title_en: Application of nicotinic acetylcholine receptor alpha 6 subunit as target in preparation of medicine for treating atopic dermatitis
abstract_en: The invention discloses application of a nicotinic acetylcholine receptor alpha 6 subunit (Chrna) serving as a target in preparing a medicament for treating atopic dermatitis. The present invention for the first time found that the mRNA and protein expression levels of Chrna were significantly up-regulated in the dorsal root ganglion of model mice for atopic dermatitis. The use of Chrna inhibitors significantly reduced the scratching behavior of the model mice and improved the skin inflammation score and skin thickness. The invention provides a new drug target for atopic dermatitis, and Chrna inhibitor can be used for preparing drugs for simultaneously relieving chronic pruritus and skin inflammation of atopic dermatitis.

title_en: Cotton fiber detection system and detection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cotton fiber detection system and a detection method, and relates to the technical field of cotton fiber detection, wherein the cotton fiber detection system comprises a cotton sample quantifying device, a cotton sample conveying system, a quality detection system and a control system; the cotton sample quantitative device is communicated with the cotton sample conveying system, the cotton sample quantitative device can receive cotton samples and separate the cotton samples into a plurality of cotton fibers to be detected with set weight, the cotton sample conveying system is communicated with the quality detection system, the cotton sample conveying system can receive the plurality of cotton fibers to be detected and convey the cotton fibers to the quality detection system, the quality detection system can detect the quality of the cotton fibers to be detected, the cotton sample conveying system can recycle the cotton fibers detected by the quality detection system, and the control system is in communication connection with the cotton sample quantitative device, the cotton sample conveying system and the quality detection system and can perform action control. The cotton fiber detection system and the detection method can improve the automation of cotton fiber detection and improve the detection efficiency and the detection precision.

title_en: Distributed water pollution early warning method based on edge calculation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed water pollution early warning method based on edge calculation, and belongs to the technical field of signal devices. The method comprises the steps of deploying edge calculation monitoring nodes on the river section of an industrial park, collecting historical data of multiple water quality indexes, training a long-period memory artificial neural network prediction model for each index locally by each node, inputting a plurality of time data before the current time into the model to obtain expected predicted values in real time monitoring, calculating fluctuation residual errors of the actual measured values and the predicted values, combining the multidimensional residual errors into a vector, inputting the vector into a pre-trained single-class support vector machine model, and generating early warning information and reporting if the vector is judged to be located outside a normal fluctuation domain. According to the invention, second-level response is realized through edge calculation, normal fluctuation is stripped by using a prediction residual error, burst pollution and hidden theft are accurately identified by combining multidimensional collaborative analysis, and the false alarm rate is remarkably reduced.

title_en: Environment monitoring hydrogeology testing device and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of environmental monitoring and discloses an environmental monitoring hydrogeologic testing device and method, wherein the environmental monitoring hydrogeologic testing device comprises a sampling tube, a sampling cover, a counterweight seat, a dynamic balance assembly and a water sample uniformity, wherein the sampling cover is sleeved on the outer side of the sampling tube and can rotate around the sampling tube by a preset angle, the counterweight seat is fixedly connected to the bottom of the sampling tube, a driving part for pushing the counterweight seat to rotate is arranged in the counterweight seat, the dynamic balance assembly is arranged in the counterweight seat and is used for realizing dynamic balance adjustment when the counterweight seat rotates, water is driven to flow through a tangential jet hole to be discharged through a submersible pump, a fluid reaction moment is utilized to drive the counterweight seat to rotate and form vortex, the layering of the water body is broken, the wall of a well is cleaned, and meanwhile, the uniformity of the water sample is ensured.

title_en: Multi-dimensional comparison analysis method for blast furnace tuyere damage
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of blast furnace tuyere maintenance, and particularly discloses a multi-dimensional contrast analysis method for blast furnace tuyere breakage, which comprises the following steps of firstly collecting broken tuyeres, selecting tuyeres which are in the same batch and normal in operation under the same working condition as a comparison sample, and preprocessing the tuyeres; then sequentially detecting macroscopic performance, structure and material performance of the pretreated tuyere, comparing and analyzing the damaged tuyere with a comparison tuyere, quantifying and evaluating indexes, and finally pertinently making measures for preventing tuyere damage. Aiming at the problem of single dimension of the current tuyere damage analysis, the invention realizes the accurate analysis and effective prevention of tuyere damage by constructing a complete technical system of sample collection, multidimensional detection, classification comparison, cause tracing, mechanism analysis and measure optimization, and solves the problem that the tuyere damage analysis dimension is single, the comparison standard is lost and the analysis result is disjointed from the actual application in the prior art, thereby influencing the stable and smooth operation of a blast furnace system.

title_en: Asphalt pavement structural layer performance attenuation and service life prediction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a performance attenuation and service life prediction method for an asphalt pavement structure layer, which comprises the steps of adopting an ALT-S100 system, carrying out a cyclic acceleration loading test on a small-scale pavement structure test piece under the condition of accurately simulating temperature and ultraviolet radiation environment, acquiring modulus, crack width, rutting depth, layer bottom strain and anti-skid performance indexes at preset loading frequency intervals, establishing a modulus attenuation model, a crack width logarithmic-power function evolution model and the like to represent the performance attenuation rule of the pavement structure layer, establishing a wheel load conversion coefficient based on equivalent ground pressure ratio and an equivalent loading frequency conversion method under the condition of strain, establishing a fatigue service life prediction equation based on strain control, and outputting a fatigue service life predicted value according to the first reached of multi-index failure standards. The method of the invention greatly shortens the test period of pavement fatigue performance evaluation, reduces the test cost, and simultaneously realizes the coupling simulation of environmental factors and mechanical loads.

title_en: Application of RAB40B gene in screening breeding bull and improving reproductive capacity of bull
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of animal molecular breeding and bioengineering, in particular to application of RAB40B genes in breeding bull screening and improving reproductive capacity of bull. The RAB40B candidate gene is obtained based on transcriptome data, GWAS phenotype data and WGCNA analysis and screening, the RAB40B is found to have important regulation and control effects in the male reproduction process, the reproductive capacity, the spermatogenesis capacity and the semen quality of the bull can be improved through over-expression of the RAB40B gene, and the spermatogenesis capacity, the semen quality, the breeding bull fertility and relevant reproduction regulation and control can be evaluated through detection of the expression level of the RAB40B gene in a sample to be tested from the bull.

title_en: Anti-interference intelligent optimization method and system for nail matrix UCP detection signals
abstract_en: The invention provides an anti-interference intelligent optimization method and system for a nail matrix UCP detection signal, which relate to the technical field of in-vitro diagnosis and drug detection, and realize accurate background subtraction on a physical modeling level by multi-angle scattering measurement and inversion of self-fluorescence intensity, and endow each section of detection signal with direct comparability by utilizing a correction signal curve of spatial scanning along a nail longitudinal axis and scattering gradient normalization, and finally improve self-fluorescence subtraction from empirical signal processing to quantitative calculation based on a physical mechanism through cooperation closed loop output time concentration distribution result of spatial positioning and precise quantification, and convert non-uniform scattering compensation from passive adaptation to active correction, thereby improving the detection signal quality and the detection result accuracy, and providing a detection means with both time traceability and quantitative accuracy for drug detection.

title_en: High-strength crosslinked polyethylene insulated overhead cable
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-strength cross-linked polyethylene insulated overhead cable applied to the cable field, which is characterized in that the integration of mechanical strength improvement and intelligent monitoring of an operation state is realized through the multilayer structural design of an inner buffer framework, a composite shielding layer, an outer protective framework and an outer insulating layer, a pressure strain bar and a temperature change bar are integrated by a reinforcing bar, an overvoltage and overheat area can be visually identified through color change, a temperature detection line is built in a composite reinforcing wire, a real-time monitoring network is constructed by matching with a sensor interface of a segmented sleeve, the acquisition and abnormal early warning of the temperature of a wire core, the surface temperature and a damp state are realized, the operation safety and the operation and maintenance response efficiency of the cable are improved, the radial compressive strength of the cable is improved through the reinforcing bar design of the outer protective framework, the overvoltage and overheat area can be visually identified through the color change, and the operation and maintenance visualization is realized by matching with an observation hole of the outer insulating layer.

title_en: Method for comparing and evaluating burst breaking brittleness in burst cigarette filter stick
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for comparing and evaluating the burst break brittleness of a burst cigarette filter stick, and relates to the technical field of burst break brittleness comparison and evaluation. The method is simple to operate, stable and reliable in result, and capable of effectively evaluating the burst break brittleness of the burst cigarette filter stick, making up for the method that the burst break brittleness of the burst cigarette filter stick cannot be effectively evaluated in a systematic comparison mode in the industry, effectively checking the difference of heat resistance and moisture resistance of different wall materials and core material formulas of the burst in the burst cigarette filter stick, and further guiding and optimizing the wall materials and the core material formulas to improve the burst break brittleness and visual experience of consumers in smoking the burst in the middle section of the cigarette.

title_en: Anti-CEACAM 1 single domain antibody and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of biological medicine, and in particular relates to an anti-CEACAM 1 single-domain antibody and application thereof, wherein the nucleotide sequence of the anti-CEACAM 1 single-domain antibody is any one of SEQ ID NO. 1-SEQ ID NO. 3. The invention utilizes phage display technology to carry out multi-round screening on a alpaca CEACAM1 nano antibody M13 phage display library, enriches phage which can specifically bind to CEACAM1 receptor, constructs recombinant plasmid after positive clone gene amplification, sequencing and identification, adopts an escherichia coli expression system to express and purify, and finally obtains the anti-CEACAM 1 single domain antibody with high purity and good affinity. The anti-CEACAM 1 single domain antibody can specifically target CEACAM1 antigen on the surface of a tumor, enhance NK cell activity to exert a tumor killing function, and has important practical significance and application prospect in immunotherapy of the tumor and related basic research.

title_en: Manual random spot check method for automobile coal bottom layer sample
abstract_en: The invention discloses a manual random spot check method for an automobile coal bottom layer sample, which comprises the following steps of S1, preparing to be in butt joint with a system in the early stage, S2, inputting basic parameters of a program, S3, automatically and randomly extracting a sampling target vehicle and a target point, S4, identifying and operating the target vehicle, S5, sampling a manual bottom layer, S6, confirming spot check states, S7, archiving data and managing traceability. According to the invention, the target vehicles and target points are selected randomly automatically, the normalized spot check of the bottom sample is realized in a manual sampling mode, the coal quality detection coverage of the whole material layer is ensured, key indexes such as bottom water, ash and the like are truly reflected, the quality misjudgment caused by detection of one side is avoided, the target vehicles are extracted by taking the accumulated vehicle number as a basis instead of the vehicle number, the cheating space caused by repeated transportation of the vehicles is avoided, the sampling objectivity is further improved by random selection of 16 kinds of point distribution schemes, and the illegal behaviors of 'secondary filling' of suppliers are strongly frightened.

title_en: Evaluation method and detection equipment for utilization degree of hydrogen-rich gas in blast furnace reflow zone
abstract_en: The application discloses an evaluation method and detection equipment for the utilization degree of hydrogen-rich gas in a blast furnace reflow zone, which comprise the steps of obtaining comprehensive furnace burden used by the blast furnace, loading the comprehensive furnace burden into a crucible, placing the crucible in a constant temperature area simulating the furnace body of the blast furnace, applying a preset load on the comprehensive furnace burden, heating the comprehensive furnace burden in an argon atmosphere with a first preset flow, switching the argon atmosphere with the first preset flow into the hydrogen-rich gas atmosphere with a second preset flow after the temperature of the comprehensive furnace burden reaches the preset temperature, continuously heating the comprehensive furnace burden in the hydrogen-rich gas atmosphere, collecting tail gas reduced at the upper part of the comprehensive furnace burden, and determining the utilization degree of the hydrogen-rich gas in the blast furnace reflow zone based on the gas component in the tail gas. The embodiment of the application effectively solves the industrial problem that the working condition of the blast furnace smelting black box is difficult to directly detect, and provides the key data support for the key reaction area which cannot be obtained before for optimizing the hydrogen-rich smelting process.

title_en: Intelligent slurry discharging system and method for desulfurization system of power plant
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of flue gas desulfurization of coal-fired power plants, and relates to an intelligent slurry discharging system and method for a power plant desulfurization system. The system comprises a multi-parameter on-line monitoring unit, a data processing unit, a dynamic threshold adjusting unit, an intelligent pulp discharging decision unit and an intelligent pulp discharging execution unit. Five steps of multi-parameter acquisition, data preprocessing, dynamic threshold adjustment, intelligent decision calculation and slurry discharge execution are carried out to form a complete closed-loop intelligent slurry discharge control flow. The system disclosed by the invention has the advantages that each module of the system is mutually matched, the accurate and on-demand control on the slurry discharging process of the desulfurization system is realized, the technical problems that the traditional method is single in judgment, the response is lagged and the threshold is fixed and can not adapt to the change of working conditions are effectively solved, and the rationality and the operation economy of the slurry discharging opportunity are obviously improved.

title_en: Soil loss monitoring system, method, electronic equipment, storage medium and product
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ecological environment monitoring and discloses a system, a method, electronic equipment, a storage medium and a product for monitoring soil loss, wherein the system for monitoring the soil loss comprises a runoff identification module, a runoff identification module and a runoff identification module, wherein the runoff identification module is used for carrying out runoff identification according to the instantaneous flow of the soil surface of a target area and a preset flow threshold value; the system comprises a runoff collection module, a flow guide pipe, a flow monitoring module, a turbidity monitoring module and a data processing module, wherein the runoff collection module is used for sampling runoffs to obtain runoff samples, the flow guide pipe is used for conveying the runoff samples to a steady flow groove, the flow monitoring module is used for buffering the runoff samples, the flow monitoring module is used for collecting the flow of the runoff samples of the steady flow groove to obtain runoff flow data, the turbidity monitoring module is used for collecting the turbidity of the runoff samples of the steady flow groove to obtain runoff turbidity data, and the data processing module is used for determining a soil loss monitoring result according to the runoff flow data and the runoff turbidity data.

title_en: Body index detection system compatible with breath and saliva detection
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a body index detection system compatible with breath and saliva detection, wherein the system comprises a disposable detection consumable material providing device, which is used for providing corresponding disposable detection consumable materials according to the detection items of users; the detection device is used for analyzing saliva and/or breath and detecting body indexes; and the main control module is used for managing the disposable detection consumable supply device and the detection device. Adopt the utility model discloses a health index detecting system can be convenient detect oral cavity saliva and halitosis to carry out the analysis to it, make things convenient for masses to detect at any time, reduce medical burden, show and reduce social medical expenditure, promote masses' quality of life, alleviate the pressure of seeing a doctor of patient and hospital, have great social meaning, spreading value, fine market perspective and obvious economic benefits.
