title_en: Multi-physical quantity measuring system for indoor simulation of fault seepage healing process after earthquake
abstract_en: The utility model provides a many physical quantity measuring system of indoor simulation post-earthquake fault seepage flow healing process includes: a hybrid power supply system; a multi-physical quantity preamplifier which converts the analog quantity small signal into an analog quantity large signal; the multi-channel analog-digital converter front-end differential conditioning circuit converts an analog signal into a double-end differential signal and filters common-mode noise in the signal; the multichannel analog-digital synchronous conversion circuit comprises a multichannel analog-digital converter for synchronously acquiring multiple physical quantities; a central controller logic circuit including a field programmable gate array chip to implement digital logic control; and a USB transmission circuit which can realize data transmission between the user computer and the logic circuit of the central controller. The utility model provides a measurement system adopts adjustable synchronous sampling rate, and its control range is seepage flow healing experiment when 0.56 second sampling point to about half an hour sampling point so that can be competent at different rock creep speeds.

title_en: Environmental test cabin
abstract_en: The utility model provides an environmental test cabin, including air cleaner, sealed cabin and the air sampler who connects gradually, the air sampler includes the casing, and the casing bottom is equipped with elevating gear. The utility model discloses a sealed cabin simulation indoor environment exposes the sample in sealed cabin, lasts after certain time, gathers the harmful gas in the cabin to this has avoided directly sampling the inaccurate problem of test result when sampling the gas that volatilizees slowly, and the sample volatilizees naturally in sealed cabin simultaneously, need not operating personnel to wait for a long time, also can not expose in harmful environment for a long time, has eliminated the potential safety hazard; meanwhile, on the basis of the existing air sampler, the lifting device is added, so that the working height of the air sampler can be adjusted, and the sampling operation is convenient.

title_en: Electronic patch spot welding detection device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of electronic patch detection, in particular to an electronic patch spot welding detection device, aiming at the problems that the existing spot welding detection method mostly adopts a manual flaw detector, the manual intensity is high, the automation degree is low, only one spot welding area can be detected at one time, and the detection efficiency is low, the utility model provides a scheme which comprises a workbench, wherein one side of the top of the workbench is fixedly provided with a vertical plate, one side of the vertical plate is fixedly provided with a transverse plate, the top of the workbench is fixedly provided with a sliding table, the top of the sliding table is in transmission connection with a clamping table, the top of the clamping table can be movably clamped with an electronic patch body, the bottom of the transverse plate is fixedly provided with a detection block, and the detection block is arranged in a hollow way, compared with the traditional electric welding detection device, the automation degree is high, the manual intensity is low, and two spot welding areas can be detected at one time, the efficiency of spot welding detection has been improved greatly.

title_en: Water chemistry simulation experiment device of heat exchange water tank for nuclear power
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water chemistry simulation experiment device of a heat exchange water tank for nuclear power, which comprises a first storage tank and a second storage tank, wherein the first storage tank is hinged with a sealing cover, the first storage tank is connected with a liquid level display tube and a temperature sensor, the first storage tank and the second storage tank are respectively connected with a communicating tube, two communicating tubes are respectively connected with a butterfly valve, one communicating tube is connected with a first sealing plate, the other communicating tube is connected with a second sealing plate, the second sealing plate is provided with a sealing groove, the second sealing plate is fixedly connected with a silica gel ring, the first sealing plate and the second sealing plate are respectively provided with a group of through holes, and two groups of through holes are respectively communicated with the inside of the two communicating tubes, the outer surface of the second storage tank is connected with a plurality of connecting blocks, and the connecting blocks are connected with a support, the support is in threaded connection with a filter plate.

title_en: Engineering probe for detecting water content of concrete
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a probe for concrete water content detection engineering, which comprises two probes which are symmetrically distributed, wherein the input ends of the probes are communicated with a driving pipe, a resisting plate is arranged between the driving pipe and the probes, the outer walls of the probes are connected with a dust scraping component in a sliding manner, the dust scraping component comprises dust scraping pipes connected with the probes, a supporting plate is arranged between every two adjacent dust scraping pipes, and the top surfaces of the supporting plates are vertically welded with stirring blocks; through the ash scraping assembly, concrete is easily adhered to the surface of the built-in probe of the existing device, the concrete is favorably adhered to the surface of the probe, and the use accuracy of the device is improved.

title_en: Portable colloidal gold immunochromatography detector box
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a portable colloidal gold immunochromatography detector box, which comprises a box body with an opening at the top, a detector body is arranged in the box body, a pulley is arranged at the lower part of the side wall of one side of the detector body, a sliding groove is vertically arranged on the inner wall of the box body, the pulley is slidably arranged in the sliding groove, a rack is vertically arranged on the side wall of the other side of the detector body, a locking mechanism is arranged on the upper part of the side wall of the box body, which is opposite to the rack, under the action force of a spring of the locking mechanism, the limiting teeth are clamped on the corresponding meshing teeth, the outer walls of the two sides of the box body are provided with the reverse-U-shaped handles, and the inner walls of the arms of the two sides of the handles are hinged on the outer wall of the box body, the arrangement is convenient for the lifting use of the detector, and the box plays certain guard action to the detector body, when carrying out the long-range transportation, can avoid the external destruction to the detector.

title_en: Cultivation device suitable for agriculture
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cultivation device suitable for agriculture, which comprises a water collection box, wherein a circulating water mechanism is arranged in the water collection box, and a circulating water tank is arranged on one side of the water collection box; through the circulating water mechanism that sets up in the inside of water collecting box, permeate to the bottom from the inside of cultivation case when water, part water can flow in the inside of water collecting box, the inside of water collecting box is provided with the filter pulp, the filter pulp can prevent that the inside earth of cultivation incasement from excessively losing, play the effect of secondary protection, the bottom of filter pulp is provided with the activated carbon layer, the impurity of activated carbon layer filtration aquatic that can be preliminary, make endless water can continue to utilize, the division board can support activated carbon layer and filter pulp, make its inside bottom with water collecting box produce certain height, be convenient for the storage of water and collect, can reach the effect of collection water loss like this.

title_en: Extruded polystyrene insulation board water absorption rate detection device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an extruded polystyrene insulation board water absorption rate detection device which comprises a detection box, wherein a motor is fixedly installed on one side of the bottom of the detection box, the output end of the motor is fixedly connected with one end of a double-headed screw, the other end of the double-headed screw is rotatably connected with one side of the bottom in the detection box, the outer surface of the double-headed screw is sequentially in threaded connection with two connecting frames, threaded holes matched with the outer surface of the double-headed screw are formed in the two connecting frames, the tops of the two connecting frames are respectively hinged with one end of two ejector rods, the other ends of the two ejector rods are respectively hinged with two sides of the bottom of a placing basket, two sides of the middle of the placing basket are respectively hinged with a switch net door, and a plurality of isolation plates are arranged in the placing basket. Through setting up actuating mechanism and division board thereof, actuating mechanism user of facilitating the use sample, the division board is convenient for separate a plurality of division boards to be convenient for better detection.

title_en: Cement boiling box
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of cement performance testing, and discloses a cement boiling box which comprises a protective box body, wherein a boiling chamber and an electric room are respectively arranged on the front surface of the protective box body. According to the utility model, the test piece rack is placed on the upper surface of the support plate, water in the boiling box is heated through the heating pipe, so that the water is boiled in about minutes, after the water is boiled, bubbles are generated on the surface of the heating pipe and continuously rise, when the bubbles touch the filter plate, the bubbles are split into small bubbles which can penetrate through the filter plate, and under the action of the support plate, the small bubbles move to the periphery of the filter plate along the bottom of the filter plate, so that the small bubbles rise along the inner wall of the boiling box and are prevented from contacting with a cement test piece, and therefore, the impact on the test piece caused by the contact between the cement test piece and the bubbles when the bubbles rise due to water boiling is avoided, and further, the cement test piece is prevented from being impacted, so that residues fall off, even the test piece is damaged, and the measurement result is influenced.

title_en: Prevent sulfuric acid concentration on-line analysis device of sulphuric acid drying tower overflow jam
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sulfuric acid concentration online analysis device for preventing overflow blockage of a sulfuric acid drying tower, which comprises a third sulfuric acid drying tower, a second sulfuric acid drying tower and a first sulfuric acid drying tower, wherein the bottom of the third sulfuric acid drying tower is connected with a third drying tower cooler through a third circulating pump, the third drying tower cooler is connected with the top of the third sulfuric acid drying tower, the third drying tower cooler is further connected with a first overflow pipe through a third regulating valve, the bottom of the second sulfuric acid drying tower is connected with a second drying tower cooler through a second circulating pump, the second drying tower cooler is connected with the top of the second sulfuric acid drying tower, the second drying tower cooler is further connected with a second overflow pipe through a second regulating valve, the bottom of the first sulfuric acid drying tower is connected with the first drying tower cooler through the first circulating pump, and the first drying tower cooler is connected with the top of the first sulfuric acid drying tower. The on-line analysis method can realize the on-line analysis of the sulfuric acid concentration, and effectively solves the problems of frequent manual sampling analysis, easy blockage of an overflow pipe, large workload and the like in the prior art.

title_en: Water distribution system of water quality monitoring station
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water distribution system of a water quality monitoring station, which comprises: the device comprises a water distribution tank, a water inlet and a waste liquid barrel, wherein the water inlet and the waste liquid barrel are connected with the water distribution tank through pipelines, a temperature control box, a booster pump, a sampling pipe and a monitoring unit are arranged in the water distribution tank, the water inlet is connected with the temperature control box and the booster pump through pipelines, the temperature control box is connected with the booster pump through pipelines, and the booster pump is sequentially connected with the sampling pipe, the monitoring unit and the waste liquid barrel through pipelines. Through setting up temperature control box and booster pump, both can accomplish the monitoring to water sample temperature and pressure, also can adjust according to the requirement to monitoring factor to water sample temperature and pressure. Therefore, the utility model meets the requirements of monitoring factors on the complex monitoring state of the water sample while meeting the diversity requirements of the monitoring factors, and ensures that the obtained monitoring data is more accurate and reliable.

title_en: Food detects uses sample conveyer with constant temperature and humidity regulatory function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sample conveying device with a constant temperature and humidity adjusting function for food detection, which comprises a box body, wherein a first partition plate is fixedly arranged in an inner cavity of the box body, an atomizer is fixedly arranged on one side of the bottom of the inner cavity of the box body, an exhaust end of the atomizer penetrates through the first partition plate and is communicated with the outside of the first partition plate, a semiconductor refrigerating sheet is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the first partition plate and on one side far away from the atomizer, a radiating fin is fixedly arranged at the refrigerating end of the semiconductor refrigerating sheet, and the top of the radiating fin penetrates through the first partition plate and extends to the outside of the first partition plate; according to the utility model, the atomizer and the semiconductor refrigeration sheet are arranged to generate cold air and water vapor to carry out heat preservation and moisture preservation on the food sample, and the fan blades and the motor are arranged to uniformly diffuse the cold air and the water vapor and respectively enter the sample box through the air inlet pipe, so that the heat preservation and moisture preservation effects are improved.

title_en: Domatic soil heavy metal migration analogue means and system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a slope soil heavy metal migration simulation device and system. The system comprises the devices, the devices are three, and operation steps are arranged between adjacent devices. According to the utility model, rainfall simulation and terrain simulation can be carried out, so that the real slope soil environment conditions such as a tableland tea garden and the like can be accurately simulated, the collecting tank and the percolate collecting pipe can be used for sampling, and the soil heavy metal migration rule can be conveniently explored; the utility model also has the advantages of simple structure and convenient observation and sampling.

title_en: Blood collector with blood type detects function
abstract_en: The utility model provides a blood collector with a blood type detection function, which comprises a blood type detection card and a collector body; the blood type detection card comprises a sample absorption pad, and the blood type detection card is detachably connected with the outer wall of the collector body; the sample absorbing pad of the blood type test card is in blood communication with the connection area of the collector body. The utility model integrates the functions of blood sampling and blood type detection, can realize the rapid, closed and spontaneous execution of a blood type detection test, realizes the simplification of a blood type primary screening test, and improves the detection accuracy, thereby replacing the existing blood type screening mode of matching labels after manual judgment.

title_en: Portable SF6Decomposition product mixed gas analysis device
abstract_en: The utility model particularly relates to portable SF 6 The decomposition product mixed gas analysis device comprises a box body, a gas inlet, a gas outlet, a zero gas port, a gas path and ultraviolet SO 2 And H 2 S sensor, infrared CO sensor, SF 6 The device comprises a sensor, a micro water sensor, a switching power supply and a main control module; the bottom in the box body is provided with ultraviolet SO 2 And H 2 S sensor, infraredCO sensor in ultraviolet SO 2 And H 2 Ultraviolet SO above and connected to the S sensor 2 And H 2 The S sensor and the infrared CO sensor are arranged by being attached to one side surface of the box body, and the surface is defined as a first surface, SF 6 The sensor is connected with the infrared CO sensor at the end part far away from the first surface, the micro-water sensor is positioned at one side of the infrared CO sensor, and the micro-water sensor is connected with SF 6 The sensor is connected, the main control module is positioned at one side of the micro water sensor, which is far away from the infrared CO sensor, and the switching power supply is positioned below the main control module; the scheme effectively utilizes the limited space in the box body and forms SF 6 A decomposition product mixed gas analyzer is compact and portable.

title_en: Glossy ganoderma is planted and is used carbon dioxide concentration detection device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a carbon dioxide concentration detection device for planting lucid ganoderma, which comprises an insertion rod, wherein the bottom of the insertion rod is arranged in a conical manner, a cavity is arranged in the insertion rod, a first bevel gear and a second bevel gear which are meshed with each other are arranged in the cavity, the right end of the first bevel gear is fixedly connected with a first rotating rod, the right end of the first rotating rod is fixedly connected with a handle, an adjusting mechanism is arranged in the insertion rod, the top of the second threaded rod is fixedly connected with an installation plate, a detector is placed on the installation plate, and two dismounting mechanisms are arranged on the installation plate. According to the utility model, the limiting block can be inserted into the ground bottom or contracted into the inserting rod by rotating the handle, so that the inserting rod is convenient to fix or pull out, and the operation is simple; the carbon dioxide concentration at different heights can be detected through the height adjusting mechanism, and the application range is wide; the damaged detector can be disassembled and maintained through the disassembling mechanism, and the operation is simple.

title_en: Soil detection device for land planning service
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a soil detection device for land planning service, which comprises an equipment shell, wherein a driving motor is fixedly arranged in an inner cavity of a motor groove, the output end of the driving motor is connected with a first bevel gear, one side of the top of the inner cavity of the equipment shell is provided with a soil detection analyzer, the input end of the soil detection analyzer is fixedly connected with a detection rod, a spiral rotating rod is inserted in a stabilizing plate, one end of the spiral rotating rod, which is close to the soil detection analyzer, is sleeved with a second bevel gear, one end of the detection rod, which is far away from the soil detection analyzer, penetrates through the inner cavity of the spiral rotating rod and is connected with a detection head, the first bevel gear and the second bevel gear are driven to rotate by the operation of the driving motor, the rotation of the second bevel gear drives the rotation of the spiral rotating rod, so that the detection head on the detection rod is drilled to a specified depth by the rotation of the spiral rotating rod, and then the detection head is used for detection, the detection efficiency is improved.

title_en: Detection device is administered to colliery gas in pit
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a coal mine underground gas treatment detection device, and relates to the technical field of coal mine equipment. The technical key points are as follows: be equipped with the intake pipe in the box respectively, first explosion-proof gear box, the explosion-proof gear box of second, first motor and second motor, first motor is connected with first connecting axle, first connecting axle is connected with first bevel gear, first bevel gear meshing has second bevel gear, second bevel gear is connected with first pivot, first pivot is connected with first aspirating fan, the second motor is connected with the second connecting axle, the second connecting axle is connected with third bevel gear, third bevel gear meshing has fourth bevel gear, fourth bevel gear is connected with the second pivot, the second pivot is connected with the second aspirating fan, and be equipped with water tank and gas holding vessel in the box, the gas holding vessel is equipped with gas dilution discharger. The gas emission detection device has the advantages that the gas emission detection device can safely discharge gas to avoid fire hazard caused by overlarge gas concentration, and the working efficiency of the gas emission detection device is effectively improved.

title_en: Water conservancy water and electricity construction is with surveying equipment
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of water conservancy surveying equipment, and particularly relates to surveying equipment for water conservancy and hydropower construction. The technology includes the bottom plate, the bottom plate bottom is provided with the removal subassembly, and the vertical two fixed plates that are provided with on the bottom plate, the level is provided with it and puts the thing board that sliding fit is about presenting between two fixed plates, puts and puts communicating first through-hole about offering on the thing board, wears to be equipped with the control tube in the first through-hole, independently wears to be equipped with the drilling rod in the control tube, and the control tube bottom is provided with the drill bit, set up the second through-hole that is used for the drill bit to pass on the bottom plate, put install on the thing board with drill bit complex actuating mechanism, set up on the control tube lateral wall and have used a plurality of mounting hole, be provided with the collection subassembly that is used for soil collection in the mounting hole. The sampling device is simple in structure, convenient to operate and convenient for underground soil collection and sampling.

title_en: Detection equipment for heavy metals in soil
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a detection device for heavy metals in soil, which comprises a stirring box, wherein a motor is fixedly connected to the top of the stirring box close to the center, a first bearing is fixedly connected to the top of the stirring box close to the center, a rotating shaft penetrates through the inner cavity of the first bearing, the rotating top end of the rotating shaft is fixedly connected with a power output shaft of the motor, a cylinder is fixedly connected to the top of the inner cavity of the stirring box close to the center, a through hole is formed in the cylinder, the outer edge of the rotating shaft penetrates through the inner cavity of the through hole, a circular ring is sleeved on the outer edge of the cylinder close to the top end, linkage rods are hinged to the left side and the right side of the circular ring, and through mutual matching among the motor, the cylinder, the circular ring, the linkage rods, a scraper, a fixed pipe, a movable block, a movable rod and the like, the soil attached to the side wall of the inner cavity of the stirring box can be stirred uniformly and sufficiently and can be easily dissolved, is beneficial to the detection work.

title_en: Water quality testing equipment for hydraulic engineering
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of water quality detection devices, in particular to water quality detection equipment for hydraulic engineering, which comprises a working box and a sliding storage groove, wherein the inside of the working box is in a cavity shape, a box door is movably arranged on the front side surface of the working box, bottom feet are fixed at four vertex angles of the lower surface of the working box, and two groups of handles are symmetrically fixed on the two side surfaces of the working box. According to the utility model, the grab handle is held and the screw rod is screwed, the double-inclined-plane extrusion block can be pushed to slide inwards along the surface of the limiting guide rail under the meshing action with the threaded hole, then under the inclined-plane extrusion action, the two groups of inclined planes of the double-inclined-plane extrusion block push the expansion plates on the two sides, the expansion plates overcome the elasticity of the spring and extend out from the two ports of the sliding accommodating groove after being pressed, tools used for detection can be placed in the accommodating groove A, the accommodating groove B and the accommodating groove C on the surface of the expansion plate, and a good detection platform is further provided to facilitate the operation of water quality detection.

title_en: Detector for detecting kitchen carbon emission
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of carbon emission detectors, and discloses a detector for detecting carbon emission of a kitchen, which solves the problems that when the carbon emission detector for the kitchen in the current market is used, oil smoke has certain corrosivity and pollution to the detector, and the data detected by the detector is easy to deviate after long-time use, and comprises a protective box, wherein a box door capable of rotating is arranged at an opening of the protective box, transparent glass is fixedly arranged at the upper position of the box door, six push buttons capable of being pressed are uniformly arranged on the box door and below the transparent glass, and the carbon emission detector is arranged in the protective box. Thereby playing the effect of protection to the instrument, having increased the life of instrument.

title_en: Multifunctional soil and underground water organic matter pollution condition sampling investigation evaluation device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multifunctional soil and underground water organic matter pollution condition sampling investigation evaluation device, which comprises an evaluation host and a connecting wire, wherein a display screen and a plurality of groups of keys are respectively embedded into the front surface of the evaluation host, adjusting mechanisms are respectively arranged on two side surfaces of the evaluation host, each adjusting mechanism comprises a fixture block and a support column, and a moving hole and a moving groove are respectively formed in the fixture block; the utility model is convenient to adjust the inclination angle of the evaluation host according to actual needs in use through the designed adjusting mechanism, so that an operator can conveniently see pictures displayed on the display screen at different positions, the situation that the display screen is easy to reflect light or cannot see the display screen interface clearly in operation due to the fact that the traditional adjusting mechanism cannot be used is avoided, the head of the evaluation host is adjusted to a proper angle, the operator can conveniently see the sampling value on the display screen, and the operation convenience of the operator is improved.

title_en: Fixing clamp for detecting defects of encoder grating
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fixing clamp for detecting defects of a grating of an encoder, which comprises a base, a support, a rotary driving device, a clamping and fixing device, a circular grating and a detection device, wherein the support is arranged on the base, the rotary driving device is rotatably arranged on the base, the clamping and fixing device is arranged on the rotary driving device, the circular grating is arranged on the clamping and fixing device, the detection device is arranged on the support, the circular grating is rapidly clamped and fixed through the clamping and fixing device, the rotary driving device drives the circular grating to rotate at a constant speed, and the detection device is matched to rapidly detect defects of the circular grating, so that the detection is convenient and rapid. The utility model belongs to the technical field of encoder production, and particularly relates to a fixing clamp for detecting defects of an encoder grating, which replaces manual detection and greatly improves the detection efficiency.

title_en: Detection device for forest environment survey
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of forest environment detection, in particular to a detection device for forest environment surveying, which comprises a detection box, wherein the outer surface of one end of the detection box is fixedly connected with a driving device, and one end of the driving device extends into the detection box; the device can detect the air in the forest in real time, can remove dust in the air simultaneously, and avoids the dust to cause the influence to the testing result.

title_en: Ethylene oxide sterilization effect detection device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an ethylene oxide sterilization effect detection device, which comprises a sterilization box and an object carrying disc arranged in the sterilization box, wherein one end of the object carrying disc is connected with a fixed plate, a bearing cylinder is embedded in the fixed plate, the fixed plate is also provided with a rotating ring, a collision bulge is arranged in the rotating ring, a sliding rod is arranged in the bearing cylinder in a sliding manner, one end of the sliding rod is connected with an arc-shaped plate, and a positioning bolt is arranged on the collision bulge; placing the biological indicator bottle in the bearing cylinder, then rotating the rotary ring to enable the contact protrusions to contact the roller wheel, enabling the biological indicator bottle to be stably installed in the bearing cylinder, clamping the biological indicator bottles with different diameters, and then detecting the environment in the disinfection box through the biological indicator in the biological indicator bottle; therefore, the equipment can conveniently and quickly detect the sterilization effect of the sterilization box, and the whole operation process is also simple.

title_en: High tension switchgear insulation discharge detection system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of switch cabinet equipment, in particular to an insulation discharge detection system of a high-voltage switch cabinet, which comprises a switch cabinet body and a gas detector, wherein the gas detector is positioned in the switch cabinet body; the moving mechanism comprises an arched moving frame; through detecting the inside insulation discharge phenomenon of cubical switchboard, can conveniently carry out real-time detection to the operating condition of the inside distribution equipment of cubical switchboard, can realize carrying out the inside purpose that dynamic detection carries out of cubical switchboard simultaneously, effectively reduce check out test set quantity, reduce cost drops into, saves cubical switchboard inner space, makes things convenient for the normal installation of distribution equipment in the cubical switchboard, conveniently provides enough space for between the distribution equipment, guarantees that the thickness of inert gas formed the insulating layer reaches the regulation requirement, improves the practicality.

title_en: Multifunctional air quality sensor
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multifunctional air quality sensor which comprises a sensor body and is characterized by further comprising an installation block, wherein the installation block is bonded on a wall surface, the sensor body is connected to the installation block in a sliding mode from bottom to top along the longitudinal direction, a clamping rod and a spring are arranged in the installation block, the clamping rod can rotate in the installation block and can slide in the installation block, one end of the clamping rod extends out of the installation block, the longitudinal section of one end, extending out of the installation block, of the clamping rod is in a right trapezoid shape, the spring is located at the other end of the clamping rod and abuts against the clamping rod, a slot for the clamping rod to insert is formed in the sensor body, a driving structure for driving the clamping rod to rotate is arranged in the installation block, a sliding groove for the sensor body to slide is formed in the installation block, and the length of the sliding groove is smaller than the longitudinal thickness of the installation block. The sensor can be pressed to a fixed height without a support, and the sensor is convenient to move.

title_en: Portable multifunctional food safety detection equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses portable multifunctional food safety detection equipment, which comprises a protective box, universal wheels are uniformly arranged at four corners of the lower part of the protective box, a telescopic pull rod is arranged at the rear side of the upper surface of the protective box, guide rail plates are symmetrically arranged in an inner cavity of the protective box, first slide blocks are symmetrically arranged on the guide rail plates, a tension spring is arranged between the two first slide blocks on the same guide rail plate, a scissor-type telescopic frame is arranged between the two first slide blocks connected with the tension spring, second slide blocks are respectively arranged at the upper ends of the scissor-type telescopic frame, guide chutes matched with the second slide blocks are symmetrically arranged on the lower surface of the working box, a positioning mechanism matched with the second slide blocks is arranged on one side of the working box, a food safety detector is arranged in the inner cavity of the working box, and a box cover is hinged on one side of the upper surface of the working box, so that the utility model can detect the safety of multiple foods, meanwhile, the detection equipment is convenient for workers to carry.

title_en: Humidity monitoring device for warehouse
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of warehouse logistics, and discloses a humidity monitoring device for a warehouse, which comprises a monitoring cylinder, wherein a plurality of cross pipelines are connected inside the monitoring cylinder, the open ends of the cross pipelines penetrate through the inner wall of the monitoring cylinder and extend to the outer wall of the monitoring cylinder, rectangular grooves are formed in the inner walls of the open ends of the cross pipelines, a shell is arranged inside the rectangular grooves in a sliding mode, and a monitor is arranged inside the shell. This kind of humidity monitoring devices for warehouse, through setting up parts such as cross pipeline, casing, stop device for the monitor can effectually demolish or install the monitor after the couple that breaks down damages, has avoided taking out the monitor from monitoring section of thick bamboo top and has maintained the change, leads to the monitor to take out the phenomenon of difficulty, and stop device simultaneously can effectually carry on spacingly to baffle and casing, has avoided the casing after slipping into the rectangular channel inside, the phenomenon of landing appears.

title_en: RDE test measuring device
abstract_en: The utility model provides an RDE test measuring device, and belongs to the field of environmental detection. The RDE test measuring device comprises a box body, a box cover and a GPS sensor; the box body is provided with a containing cavity, and a temperature and humidity sensor, a wireless signal transmitter and a power supply module are arranged in the containing cavity; the temperature and humidity sensor and the GPS sensor are electrically connected to the wireless signal transmitter, and the wireless signal transmitter is electrically connected to the power supply module; at least one side wall of the box body is provided with a plurality of first vent holes at intervals, the box cover is provided with a plurality of second vent holes at intervals, and the first vent holes are communicated with the second vent holes through the accommodating cavity; the GPS sensor is arranged on the box cover; the bottom of box is equipped with the connecting plate for install measuring device on the carrier through the connecting plate, thereby avoided the signal line to expose in measuring device's outside, promoted experimental factor of safety greatly, improved experimental efficiency simultaneously.

title_en: Rice quality detection auxiliary device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of rice detection, and discloses a rice quality detection auxiliary device which comprises a first screening frame and a second screening frame, wherein the first screening frame is arranged at the top of the second screening frame, a first screening frame is fixed inside the first screening frame, a second screening frame is fixed inside the second screening frame, rice grain holes are formed in the first screening frame and the second screening frame at equal intervals, and the rice grain holes in the upper part of the first screening frame are larger than the rice grain holes in the upper part of the second screening frame. When the rice grain size is screened, the rice is put into the first screening frame, then the rice is screened, and then the relatively flat or broken rice flows into the upper part of the second screening frame through the rice grain holes, so that the rice grain screening work is completed, and the work of detecting high-quality rice grains and poor-quality rice grains is facilitated.

title_en: Detection device for hemagglutination inhibition test
abstract_en: The application relates to a detection device for hemagglutination inhibition test belongs to the experimental technical field of hemagglutination inhibition, and it includes protection casing and blood coagulation board, and inside the protection casing was arranged in to the blood coagulation board to can follow the inside extraction of protection casing. The application has the effect of improving the accuracy of the hemagglutination inhibition test result.

title_en: Response is maintained convenient empty gas detection and is surveyed structure rapidly
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of air detection structures, in particular to an air detection structure which is rapid in reaction and convenient to maintain, and the air detection structure comprises a shell and a fixed plate, wherein an opening and closing door plate is installed on one side of the shell, a detection main body is installed inside the shell, a sliding block is arranged at the bottom end of the detection main body, a sliding groove is formed in the bottom end of the sliding block, a bottom plate is arranged at the bottom end of the sliding groove, a matching plate is installed on one side of the bottom plate, a pulley is arranged at the bottom end of the matching plate, a connecting plate is arranged at the bottom end of the shell, and a movable groove is formed in the outer portion of the connecting plate. This response is maintained convenient empty gas detection and is surveyed structure rapidly sets up the slider to the outside that the drive detected the main part and remove to the casing is maintained and is overhauld, through the rotating electrical machines, makes the threaded rod rotate through the bearing, sets up the loose axle, will detect the main part and outwards take out, is convenient for conveniently break away from the casing to empty gas detection and survey the structure.

title_en: Water quality sampling device for environmental detection

The structure in the filtering mechanism is matched with each other, the filter screen can be used for filtering impurities pumped into water and then detecting the impurities, the impact force of the water can be used for driving the buffer blade I to rotate through the rotating shaft I, and the two side supporting rods can be driven to rotate to support the filter screen to prevent the filter screen from being blocked while filtering, so that the phenomenon of abrasion of the surface of the detection probe caused by scouring of the detection probe by water flow and impurities in the water is prevented; according to the utility model, the buffer She Er is arranged at the front section of the water inlet pipe, so that the buffer She Er is impacted by water flow to rotate through the second rotating shaft, the effect of buffering the water flow of the water inlet pipe to protect the water inlet pipe is achieved, and the phenomenon that the water inlet pipe is broken or cracked due to overlarge water flow impact of the water inlet of the water pipe is prevented.

title_en: Anti-corrosion protection device for electronic hygrometer
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-corrosion protection device for an electronic hygrometer, which comprises a mounting plate, wherein a first connecting sleeve is arranged on the outer wall of one side of the mounting plate, a temperature sensor and a humidity sensor are arranged at the inner side position, close to the first connecting sleeve, of the outer wall of one side of the mounting plate, the temperature sensor is positioned at one side of the humidity sensor, a first fixing plate is arranged at the position of one side of the mounting plate, a second connecting sleeve is arranged on the outer wall of one side of the first fixing plate, a fixing rod is arranged on the outer wall of one side, far from the second connecting sleeve, of the first fixing plate, and a second fixing plate is arranged at one end, far from the first fixing plate, of the fixing rod. According to the anti-corrosion protection device for the electronic hygrometer, the metal sintering filtering protection cover rotates at a high speed, dust particles and acid gas and other impurities adsorbed on the metal sintering filtering protection cover are thrown down under the action of high-speed centrifugal force, and the phenomenon that the metal sintering filtering protection cover is blocked to influence the flow of smoke is avoided.

title_en: Aquaculture water body oxygen content detection device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an oxygen content detection device for an aquaculture water body, and relates to the technical field of aquaculture. The oxygen concentration probe penetrates through the top groove and extends to the bottom of the bottom plate, a transparent box is arranged on the top surface of the connecting plate, a height sensor is arranged in the transparent box, a sealing cover is arranged on the top of the transparent box, the sealing cover is abutted to the transparent box, a rack is arranged on the top of the connecting plate, a sliding plate is arranged on the side surface of the rack, and the sliding plate is fixedly connected with the rack. According to the utility model, through the cooperation of the driving motor, the gear, the rack, the connecting plate, the oxygen concentration detector and the oxygen concentration probe, the oxygen concentration probe can be driven to move downwards to different depths, so that the oxygen content of water with different depths is detected, and the practicability and the application range of the oxygen content detection are improved.

title_en: Formaldehyde and TVOC detection device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a formaldehyde and TVOC detection device which can be used for detecting formaldehyde and TVOC in environment and products and detecting the effect of different formaldehyde and TVOC degradation treatment products. The device comprises a transparent and visible box body, wherein the interior of the box body is divided into a lower pollutant space, a middle pollutant processing space and an upper pollutant detection space, the lower pollutant space is provided with a heating table capable of heating at constant temperature, the stability of the temperature of a test environment is ensured, and the detection effect under different temperature conditions is simulated; the middle layer treatment space is formed by a plurality of layers of hollow partition boards which are detachably arranged on the inner wall of the box body, and the middle layer treatment space is convenient to install, maintain and replace and easy to degrade and treat the loading of products or carriers thereof; the upper detection space is provided with a pollutant detector, the box body is transparent, the detection result can be directly read, and holes in the box body are avoided; the box body is connected with the gas circulation device, pollutants can be led in from the outside of the box body, and circulating air flow is formed in the detection box, so that the influence of external air pollution on the detection result is avoided.

title_en: Detection reagent card capable of preventing excessive sample addition
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a detection reagent card for preventing excessive sample addition, which comprises an upper shell and a lower shell, wherein the top surface of the lower shell is formed into an accommodating space in a surrounding way, at least one supporting block for supporting test paper and a positioning part for positioning and limiting the end part of the test paper are convexly arranged on the bottom surface of the accommodating space, and the upper shell is provided with a collecting window and an observation window which are communicated with the accommodating space; the support block is provided with a bevel guide surface which extends to the bottom surface of the accommodating space in an inclined way at one end close to the collecting window, the positioning part is adjacent to one side of the bevel guide surface, and a concave space is formed between the positioning part and the bevel guide surface in an enclosing way; the bottom surface of the accommodating space is also convexly provided with a water blocking part, the water blocking part is formed into a liquid collecting space arranged at the periphery of the concave space in a surrounding manner, and the positioning part is provided with a liquid guide port used for communicating the concave space and the liquid collecting space; the liquid of the sample is prevented from directly penetrating into the reaction part of the test paper, the purposes of controlling the penetration speed and uniformly penetrating are achieved, and the chromatographic effect of the test paper is improved.

title_en: Device for uniformly mixing magnetic particles of chemiluminescent immunoassay kit
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a device for uniformly mixing magnetic particles of a chemiluminescent immunoassay kit, which comprises a supporting device, a butt joint groove and a butt joint convex block, wherein the butt joint device is arranged in the supporting device in a sliding manner, the supporting device comprises a photoelectric sensor, an electromagnet, a placing groove, an output motor, a second gear, a positioning outer cover and an outlet sleeve, the outlet sleeve is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the rear end of the positioning outer cover, the placing groove is arranged at the center of the front end of the positioning outer cover, the photoelectric sensor is fixedly arranged on the inner wall, close to the outlet sleeve, of the placing groove, the electromagnet is fixedly arranged on the two sides, close to the outlet sleeve, of the placing groove, the electromagnet is positioned above the photoelectric sensor, the output motor is fixedly arranged in the bottom end, far away from the photoelectric sensor, of the placing groove, and the second gear is fixedly arranged at the center of the bottom end of the output motor. The utility model realizes the purpose of uniformly mixing the magnetic particles through the arrangement of the butt joint device and the supporting device.

title_en: Municipal rainwater treatment and regulation pond
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of rainwater regulation and storage, and particularly discloses a municipal rainwater treatment and storage tank; the utility model solves the problem that a sand filter layer of a rainwater treatment and regulation tank in the prior art is inconvenient to clean after filtering rainwater, filter residues are left on the sand filter layer.

title_en: Flow instrument easy to maintain for water quality monitoring
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a flow meter for water quality monitoring, which is easy to maintain and comprises a bottom frame and a bracket, wherein the two sides of the top end of the bottom frame are respectively welded with the bracket, the inside of the bracket is provided with a mounting groove, the inside of the mounting groove is provided with a pipeline valve, the top end of the pipeline valve is fixedly connected with a measuring pipe, the top end of the measuring pipe is movably connected with a connecting pipe, the top end of the connecting pipe is provided with a flow meter, and the inside of the flow meter is provided with a liquid crystal display module. This flow meter for water quality monitoring of easy to maintain is through being provided with mounting bracket, fan, heating wire, guide duct, when the outside board surface leads to when can not carefully observe because of outdoor environmental factor fog, can start fan and heating wire, and the heating wire after the heating temperature rise produces heat energy, thereby get rid of surface fog by the fan blows outside board with the hot air current after the heat transfer, has the function of defogging, has solved the problem that the easy fog of panel influences and watches.

title_en: Be used for quick intelligent quality detection device of traditional chinese medicine decoction
abstract_en: The utility model provides a rapid intelligent quality detection device for traditional Chinese medicine decoction, which comprises a detection box body, a main control module, a liquid feeding pump, a vibration disc, a touch panel and a data acquisition module, wherein the main control module is used for detecting the quality of traditional Chinese medicine decoction; the main control module is arranged in the detection box body; the liquid feeding pump is electrically connected with the main control module; the liquid feeding pump is respectively connected with a liquid inlet pipe, a cooling bottle, a water storage bottle, a waste liquid bottle and a sample bottle through a liquid separator; the surface of the oscillating disk is provided with a plurality of clamping position holes for clamping the sample bottles; the touch panel is arranged on the front side of the detection box body; the data acquisition module detects the probe to be placed in the sample bottle; the main control module receives the control command of the touch panel and controls the operation of the liquid feeding pump and the data acquisition module. The quality detection device is reasonable and novel in design and compact in structure, and can meet the requirement of rapid semi-automatic detection of traditional Chinese medicine decoction; through touch operation, the whole processes of sampling, detection, sample recovery, cleaning and the like are realized, the use is convenient, and the detection efficiency of the traditional Chinese medicine decoction is improved.

title_en: Portable water quality analyzer
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a portable water quality analyzer, which belongs to the technical field of water quality analyzers and comprises an analyzer shell, wherein an analysis structure body is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the bottom of the analyzer shell, mounting blocks are fixedly connected to the top and the bottom of the two sides of the outer wall of one end of the analyzer shell, the same elastic band is fixedly connected between the two mounting blocks positioned at the same end, and a clamping mechanism is arranged on one side of the analyzer shell. When the analyzer works, the water pipe filled with water is placed in the analyzer shell, the rotating block is rotated, the threaded rod can be driven to rotate by the rotation of the rotating block, the fixing block can be pushed to move by the rotation of the threaded rod, the test tube can be clamped by the fixing block, then the analysis structure body is used for water quality analysis, when the analyzer is used for carrying, an elastic band can pass through the shoulder part of a worker, the shoulder part can bear force on the elastic band, and the equipment can be prevented from being carried by the hand part, so that the analyzer can realize the effect of being convenient for the worker to carry.

title_en: Test device for researching influence of arbuscular mycorrhizal fungi on soil
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a test device for researching the influence of arbuscular mycorrhizal fungi on soil, which comprises a research test box, wherein a first baffle is fixedly arranged between the inner walls of the research test box, a first placing groove is formed in the first baffle, and a multistage hydraulic cylinder is fixedly arranged in the first placing groove.

title_en: Environment quality detection equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of environmental quality detection, in particular to environmental quality detection equipment which comprises a base, wherein the upper end of the base is fixedly connected with a fixed cylinder, the inside of the fixed cylinder is provided with a lifting mechanism, the inside of the fixed cylinder is slidably connected with a movable rod, the upper end of the movable rod is fixedly connected with a supporting rod, the upper end of the supporting rod is fixedly connected with a supporting table, the upper end of the supporting table is provided with a detector, the detector is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the supporting table through a clamping mechanism, and the clamping mechanism is positioned at the upper end and the lower end of the supporting table.

title_en: Device for reflecting development degree of coal core crack
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a device for reflecting the development degree of coal core cracks, which is characterized in that: mainly comprises an electronic balance and a glass box; the electronic balance consists of an operation panel, a scale pan, horizontal bubbles and horizontal adjusting feet, the glass box consists of a glass plate, a plastic plate, a nail-free paste, a handle, a sliding door sliding bar, a drying agent, a digital display ammeter, a power supply and a coal core, and the plastic plate is provided with a round hole; the utility model belongs to the technical field of coal seam cracks, and provides a novel technical method for predicting the development degree of coal seam cracks.

title_en: Harmful gas detector convenient to detect gases with different heights
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a harmful gas detector convenient for detecting gases with different heights, which comprises a detector body and a sliding device, wherein the sliding device is arranged on the outer side of the detector body and comprises a fixing device, a first sliding groove and a first sliding rod; the utility model is convenient to adjust the height detected by the detector body, is convenient to operate, greatly improves the detection operation efficiency, and simultaneously stretches and contracts the sliding device when not in use, reduces the space area of the device, saves the space of the device, and is convenient for a user to carry.

title_en: Industrial gas leakage alarm device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an industrial gas leakage alarm device, which comprises a gas detection unit and an alarm unit, wherein the gas detection unit comprises a gas sensor, detection signals of the gas sensor are sequentially processed by a filtering amplifying circuit and a compensation steady flow circuit and then are sent into an A/D converter, and the alarm unit comprises a controller and an alarm, wherein the controller is connected with the A/D converter through a data serial port.

title_en: Soil remediation device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a soil restoration device, which comprises a tank body, a restoration stirring mechanism and an aeration mechanism, wherein a soil inlet, a medicine supply port and a mud pumping port are arranged on the tank body at intervals; the repairing and stirring mechanism is arranged on the tank body to stir soil in the tank body; the aeration mechanism comprises a blower, an air supply pipe and a plurality of aeration pipes, the blower is connected with the plurality of aeration pipes through the air supply pipe, and the aeration pipes are positioned in the tank body. The soil remediation device can improve the efficiency of contaminated soil remediation.

title_en: Plastic mould for aluminum-wood doors and windows
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a plastic mould for aluminum-wood doors and windows, which comprises a plastic mould, wherein the plastic mould consists of four groups of cross bars, clamps are arranged outside joint openings of the four groups of cross bars, the surfaces of the clamps are fixed outside the cross bars through a plurality of groups of bolts, and two groups of air outlets are formed in one side of the two groups of cross bars by the plastic mould.

title_en: Water level monitoring device for water environment treatment
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of water level monitoring, in particular to a water level monitoring device for water environment treatment, which comprises a support column, wherein the support column comprises a base and a stand column, a circular cavity is formed in the base, a liquid collecting barrel is arranged in the circular cavity, a detection probe is arranged in the liquid collecting barrel, a first fixing frame is fixedly connected to the top of the liquid collecting barrel, the top of the first fixing frame is fixedly connected with the base, a water inlet pipe is connected to the bottom of the liquid collecting barrel, a water pump is arranged on the water inlet pipe, one side of the liquid collecting barrel, which is close to the water pump, is connected with a water outlet pipe, one side of the stand column, which is far away from the water outlet pipe, is provided with a terminal protection box, a water quality detector is arranged in the terminal protection box, the water quality detector is electrically connected with the detection probe through an electric wire, one side of the stand column, which is far away from a solar panel, is provided with a sliding component, and the bottom of the sliding component is provided with a water level gauge, so that water quality can be monitored, and the position of an ultrasonic water level gauge can be adjusted, and multi-point monitoring is realized.

title_en: Box dustproof full environmental factor monitoring devices
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a box-type dustproof all-environment factor monitoring device which comprises a box-type shell and a monitor, wherein a bidirectional screw rod is rotatably connected to the left side of the inner wall of the box-type shell, a movable block is sleeved on the outer surface of the bidirectional screw rod in a threaded manner, a connecting block is fixedly connected to the bottom of the monitor, the top of the movable block is hinged with a connecting rod, the upper end of the connecting rod is hinged with the bottom of the connecting block, a connecting disc is fixedly connected to one side, far away from the box-type shell, of the rotating rod, and a holding rod is fixedly connected to one side, far away from the rotating rod, of the connecting disc. This box dustproof full environmental factor monitoring devices, through the cooperation of bi-directional screw rod, connecting rod and connecting block, thereby make can drive the monitor through the rotation holding rod and rise to the outside of box casing, when not needing to use, also can descend the inside of box casing, avoided the dust in the external environment to enter into the monitor inside to influence the normal use operation of equipment, improved dustproof effect.

title_en: Underwater intelligent robot for observing ocean carbon sink
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of underwater robots, and discloses an underwater intelligent robot for observing ocean carbon sink, which comprises an underwater intelligent robot body, wherein a detection box is arranged at the bottom of the underwater intelligent robot body, three detection cavities are formed in the detection box, test bars are fixedly arranged on the inner top walls of the three detection cavities, and the top ends of the three test bars are fixedly connected with the bottom of the underwater intelligent robot body. This ocean carbon sink surveys intelligent robot under water, submergence through the robot under water is in the ocean back, starts first water pump, makes the inlet tube extraction sea water of detecting the case bottom and input to left detection intracavity, because three detection chambeies are echelonment, and adjacent two detection chambeies intercommunication each other for the left side detects the intracavity sea water and fully back right side detection chamber water delivery, all is full of the sea water until three detection intracavity, detects the sea water of three detection intracavity through three test bars, thereby the automatic grouping detection operation of sea water of being convenient for.

title_en: Modularized gas analyzer
abstract_en: The utility model provides a modular gas analyzer comprising: a groove is formed in one side wall of the shell, a plurality of gas sensors are detachably arranged in the groove, a control board is arranged at the bottom end of the groove, and the control board is electrically connected with the gas sensors. The utility model aims to provide a modularized gas analyzer, which is used for solving the problems that the detection range of the gas analyzer is fixed and the gas analyzer cannot be automatically adjusted according to actual demands after leaving a factory in the prior art.

title_en: Sewage treatment device with water quality detection components and multi-stage treatment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sewage treatment device with water quality detection components and multi-stage treatment, which comprises a water collecting tank and a first water conveying pipe, wherein a screening box is arranged above the water collecting tank, screening holes are formed in the screening box, a separation plate is arranged below the water collecting tank, a precipitation box is arranged below the separation plate, a supporting frame is arranged on the outer side of the precipitation box, and the first water conveying pipe is arranged on the right side of the supporting frame; according to the utility model, the screening box is matched with the sedimentation box, so that a user can filter out large stains in the sewage through the screening holes after pouring the sewage into the screening box, the sewage flows into the sedimentation box through the isolation plate, the lowest point of the first water pipe is higher than the bottom of the sedimentation box, the dirt in the sewage can be settled at the bottom of the sedimentation box, and meanwhile, the settled sewage flows into the water purifying mechanism through the first water pipe, so that the sewage can be conveniently filtered later.

title_en: Movable multifunctional engineering field safety inspection device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a movable multifunctional engineering field safety inspection device which comprises a safety inspection device and a flammable gas detection sensor, wherein a moving mechanism is arranged at the bottom of the safety inspection device and comprises a box body, the box body is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the safety inspection device, and two supporting pipes with one ends penetrating through and extending to the outside of the box body are fixedly arranged in the box body. This portable multi-functional engineering scene safety inspection device is through being provided with moving mechanism to make the staff when carrying the safety inspection ware, can utilize the pulley to remove the safety inspection ware, and then make things convenient for the staff to remove and carry the safety inspection ware, thereby reduced staff's intensity of labour, can realize stopping promptly moreover and walk, and then improved the staff and passed through the efficiency that the safety inspection ware was patrolled and examined to the engineering scene, made this portable multi-functional engineering scene safety inspection device practicality strengthen.

title_en: Real-time detection device for environmental atmosphere pollutants
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a real-time detection device for environmental atmospheric pollutants, which comprises a first vertical rod, wherein a second vertical rod is inserted in the first vertical rod, a third vertical rod is inserted in the second vertical rod, a main machine box is fixedly arranged on the front surface of the first vertical rod, and a display screen is arranged on the main machine box. This environment atmosphere pollutant real-time detection device push rod inner tube passes through servo motor, the second rotation axis, electric putter subassembly, lead screw and outer tube constitute vertical elevation structure, thereby make the second pole setting go up and down work, the instrument on the atmosphere pollutant detection device is overhauld conveniently, and the mount passes through the motor, first rotation axis and base constitution revolution mechanic, thereby drive the atmosphere detector and rotate, and then carry out diversified air detection, the accuracy of atmosphere pollutant testing result has been increased, the atmosphere analyzer is connected with the alarm, thereby carry out the alarm when detecting harmful gas, prevent that relevant personnel from not doing safeguard measure and being close to detection device.

title_en: Test bench for multiple test papers for immune test
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an immunity test multiple test paper test board, which comprises a platform body and a plurality of test papers arranged on the platform body, wherein one side of the upper surface of the platform body is fixedly connected with two magnets, the other side of the upper surface of the platform body is fixedly connected with two mounting blocks, compression bars are respectively and rotatably connected in the two mounting blocks, one ends of the two compression bars, which are far away from the mounting blocks, are respectively and fixedly connected with iron blocks, the two iron blocks are respectively attached to the two magnets, and the plurality of test papers are respectively positioned at the lower ends of the two compression bars; one side of one pressure lever is provided with a groove, the groove is formed in the upper surface of the table body, guide rods are fixedly connected to two sides of the groove, and a lifting plate is arranged in the groove.

title_en: Fluorescent kit for detecting benzo [ alpha ] pyrene
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fluorescent kit for detecting benzo [ alpha ] pyrene, which comprises a test strip and a detection reagent tube; the detection reagent tube is internally provided with a freeze-dried benzo [ alpha ] pyrene monoclonal antibody-perovskite quantum dot fluorescent marker; the test strip consists of a substrate, a sample pad, a reaction film and water absorbing paper, wherein the sample pad, the reaction film and the water absorbing paper are adhered to the substrate in sequence in a lap joint manner; wherein, the reaction membrane is provided with a detection line and a quality control line, the detection line is coated with benzo [ alpha ] pyrene monoclonal antigen-carrier protein conjugate, and the quality control line is coated with goat anti-mouse IgG secondary antibody. The kit has the characteristics of easy carrying, convenience, quickness, simple operation, short detection time, accurate result and the like, and can quickly and accurately detect benzo [ alpha ] pyrene on site or in a laboratory.

title_en: Integrated detection device for fecal sample
abstract_en: The application relates to an integrated detection device for fecal samples, which relates to the technical field of medical appliances and comprises a container bottle, a container bottle cap and a sampling rod, wherein a quantitative groove is arranged in the container bottle and is connected with a sample liquid receiving groove, and a movable pile for opening and closing a communication channel is arranged between the quantitative groove and the sample liquid receiving groove; the integrated detection device further comprises a reagent bottle, wherein the reagent bottle is provided with a placing groove for placing a reagent strip, and the placing groove is communicated with the sample liquid receiving groove. The application can be suitable for the reagent related to immunochromatography detection of fecal samples, such as antigen detection of helicobacter pylori and fecal occult blood antigen detection in fecal samples, and has the advantage of integrating collection and detection into a whole so as to facilitate diagnosis assistance by fecal examination.

title_en: Quick detection device of soluble silicon in water
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of soluble silicon detection devices, in particular to a rapid detection device for soluble silicon in water, which comprises a carbon-silicon analyzer, wherein a containing component is arranged on one side of the carbon-silicon analyzer and comprises a vertical rod, a supporting disk is fixedly arranged at the top end of the vertical rod, a plurality of conductive columns are fixedly arranged on the supporting disk, a base is arranged on the supporting disk, a conductive torch is arranged in the base, the conductive cylinder is sleeved on the conductive columns and used for conducting a circuit, a detection and analysis probe is fixedly arranged on the base, a containing cylinder for containing the soluble silicon is fixedly arranged on the base, a fixing sleeve is fixedly arranged at the bottom end of the vertical rod, a first connecting rod is fixedly arranged on the fixing sleeve, a second connecting rod is rotatably connected at the tail end of the first connecting rod, and a third connecting rod is rotatably connected at the tail end of the second connecting rod. The utility model is convenient to operate, is beneficial to saving time and achieves the effect of convenient and rapid detection.

title_en: Novel concrete quality detects device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a novel concrete quality detection device which comprises a base, wherein fixing rods are fixedly arranged at four corners of the top of the base, a top plate is fixedly arranged at the top of each fixing rod, a mounting plate is sleeved on the surface of each fixing rod, a dust removal component is arranged on one side of the top of each mounting plate, a protection component is arranged at the bottom of each mounting plate, and a mounting groove is formed in the middle of the top of the base. The utility model comprises the following steps: the dust that will detect the process and produce is sent into the mounting box from the dust absorption pipe through dust absorption pump cooperation suction hood, then discharges after the cartridge filter to will avoid opening behind the protection casing dust influence staff's health, drive the surface movement of mounting panel at a plurality of dead lever through two electric telescopic handle, the mounting panel cooperation connecting block drives protection casing downwardly moving, until blotter and base contact, pneumatic cylinder cooperation hydraulic stem drives extrusion head downwardly moving, the extrusion head detects the concrete in the detection dish, the atress seat of detection dish cooperation bottom extrudes pressure sensor.

title_en: Cavity positioning device of instrument analyzer
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cavity positioning device of an instrument analyzer, and relates to the technical field of positioning devices. Including a pair of ring flange, fixedly connected with pipe cap between the ring flange, fixedly connected with straight tube section between the pipe cap, the outside one end fixedly connected with instrument flange of straight tube section, instrument flange's one end is installed the instrument analysis appearance body, the link plate body has been cup jointed to instrument flange's outside, the top of link plate body one end, bottom are provided with the link plate bolt, the link plate bolt is connected with the straight tube section, instrument flange's top is provided with the link plate body, the one end of link plate body is provided with the link plate bolt, link plate bolt and link plate body are connected, the mounting groove has been seted up in the middle of the top of link plate body. According to the utility model, through the arrangement of the cavity structure, storage and transportation of the medium can be completed, and the use flexibility of the device is improved.

title_en: Sweat detection paster that easily carries
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an easily-carried sweat detection patch which comprises a main shell, a PCBA board and a panel, wherein a charging probe is inserted into one side of the main shell, a battery is installed at the bottom end of the inside of the main shell, an auxiliary structure is arranged on the outer side of the main shell, a filtering structure is arranged at the top end of one side of the main shell, a disposable sweat detection test paper is inserted into the top end of the main shell, a test paper connector is arranged on one side of the disposable sweat detection test paper, the PCBA board is installed in the main shell, and the panel is fixed on one side of the main shell. According to the utility model, the device is connected with the mobile phone and the computer through the Bluetooth module, so that a user can also customize the detection times and the time period according to the needs and transmit the detection times and the time period to the PCBA board, the PCBA board controls the operation of the device, and sweat data is uploaded to the background in real time through the Bluetooth module, so that uninterrupted full-automatic real-time monitoring and reminding of athletes and patients are realized, the device is convenient for the user to operate and use, and the convenience of the device is improved.

title_en: Asphalt mixture performance tester
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of pavement tests and discloses an asphalt mixture performance tester, which comprises a rut sample forming instrument, wherein a test vehicle is arranged on a rut sample forming instrument base, a placing groove is formed in the top wall of the test vehicle, a rotary table is arranged in the placing groove, a sample tray is arranged on the top wall of the rotary table, a rotating mechanism is arranged on the bottom wall of the rotary table, a movement cavity is formed in the rut sample forming instrument base, a moving mechanism is arranged in the movement cavity, after a sample is placed in the sample tray, the rut sample forming instrument firstly performs one-time test, after the test is finished, only the test vehicle is pulled out, the rotating mechanism is contacted with the moving mechanism, so that the sample tray can be rotated, when the test vehicle is pulled to the end, the moving mechanism is triggered to retract into the movement cavity, and then the test vehicle is pushed back to the original position, the movement mechanism can not rotate again, and the asphalt sample can be tested from another angle, so that the test result is more accurate.

title_en: Combustible gas detection device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a combustible gas detection device which comprises a detection equipment body, sliding grooves and connecting strips, wherein the two sliding grooves are respectively arranged at positions, close to one side, of the front surface of the detection equipment body through two connecting blocks, bolts are respectively arranged on the front surfaces of the connecting blocks, sealing plates are arranged at the tops of the sliding grooves, protection plates are fixedly connected to the bottoms of the sealing plates, mounting blocks are fixedly connected to the bottoms of the protection plates, limiting blocks are fixedly connected to the bottoms of the mounting blocks, springs are fixedly connected to the front surfaces of the limiting blocks, clamping rods are fixedly connected to the other ends of the springs, the two connecting strips are respectively and fixedly connected to two sides of the protection plates, three penetrating mounting holes are respectively formed in the front surfaces of the connecting strips, and pulleys are respectively and rotatably connected to the insides of the mounting holes.
