The utility model has simple structure, can prevent dust from directly falling on the touch screen, and can also prevent the touch screen from being crashed due to collision to influence the operation.

title_en: Cultivated land soil survey analyzer
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of soil detection, in particular to a farmland soil determination analyzer, which comprises a soil data analyzer, wherein a data line is fixedly connected to the soil data analyzer, one end of the data line is fixedly connected with a detection probe, an installation seat is fixedly sleeved outside the data line, a forward and reverse motor is fixedly installed at the top of the installation seat, an auger screw is fixedly connected to an output shaft of the forward and reverse motor, and the detection probe and the forward and reverse motor are electrically connected with the soil data analyzer through the data line. This cultivated land soil survey analyzer sets up multiunit locating component through detecting probe week side, when inserting soil with the detection probe, the gyro wheel of locating component bottom can promote locating component outwards opening in detection probe insertion process voluntarily, need not to operate locating component additionally, reduces the operation degree of difficulty, supports the detection probe through locating component, guarantees the stability of detection probe during operation.

title_en: Engineering damage dynamic monitoring device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a dynamic monitoring device for engineering damage, which relates to the technical field of ocean monitoring and comprises the following components: a buoyancy mechanism; the water quality detector is arranged on the lower surface of the buoyancy mechanism; the underwater monitoring mechanism is arranged below the buoyancy mechanism and comprises a submersible pump, a monitoring probe, a frame body and a drain pipe, wherein the submersible pump is connected to the frame body, a water outlet of the submersible pump is connected with the drain pipe, and the monitoring probe is rotatably arranged on the frame body. The water quality detector can comprehensively detect seawater, the monitoring probe in the underwater monitoring mechanism can monitor the water environment, so that the monitoring of workers is facilitated, the submersible pump sprays water out through the drain pipe, sundries such as seaweed wound on the frame body can be dispersed, shielding of the monitoring probe is avoided, and the monitoring effect of the monitoring probe is guaranteed.

title_en: Lower limb orthopedic equipment with automatic monitoring function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of rehabilitation and discloses lower limb orthopedic equipment with an automatic monitoring function, which comprises an outer frame, wherein an inner plate is slidably connected to the inner wall of the outer frame, a rubber frame is fixedly arranged on the inner wall of the outer frame, a fixing frame is fixedly arranged on the side face of the outer frame, a limiting plate is slidably connected to the inner wall of the fixing frame, a limiting rod is fixedly arranged on the side face of the limiting plate, and the side face of the limiting rod penetrates through the inner wall of the outer frame and is slidably connected with the inner wall of the inner plate. Through the cooperation use of pull rod and limiting plate, to the direction removal pull rod of keeping away from the frame to making the pull rod drive the gag lever post through the limiting plate and remove, until the inner wall of inner panel is kept away from to the side of gag lever post, later to the direction removal inner panel of keeping away from the frame, until inner panel to suitable position, unclamp the pull rod afterwards, the spring promotes the limiting plate and removes this moment, and then makes the limiting plate drive the gag lever post and stabilize spacingly to the inner panel, compares traditional device, and this device is convenient for adjust according to the user condition.

title_en: Sulfur dioxide detects distillation plant for chinese-medicinal material
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a sulfur dioxide detection distillation device for traditional Chinese medicinal materials, which relates to the technical field of medicinal material detection distillation, wherein a fixed plate is fixedly arranged at the upper part of a sulfur dioxide distillation instrument at equal intervals and is respectively positioned at the rear side positions of a plurality of distillation bottles, a fixed rod is fixedly arranged on the front side wall of the fixed plate, an arc plate is fixedly arranged at the front end of the fixed rod, movable rods are respectively movably arranged on the plurality of fixed plates in a penetrating manner, one ends of the movable rods are fixedly connected with bottle caps, rectangular blocks are respectively movably abutted in rectangular grooves formed in the plurality of fixed plates, the movable rods are rotatably arranged on the rectangular blocks in a penetrating manner through bearings, movable balls are respectively arranged in the inclined grooves in a rotating manner, two pairs of clamping plates are respectively arranged at the left side and the right side of the plurality of arc plates in a rotating manner through rotating shafts and bearings, and connecting rods are fixedly arranged on the movable balls, so that the installation of a single distillation bottle can be conveniently and synchronously limited, and the working efficiency is greatly improved.

title_en: Sand tank experiment box for simulating tunnel leakage water
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sand tank experiment box for simulating tunnel leakage water in the technical field of tunnel hydrogeological environment simulation tests, which comprises a main body model, a water circulation device and a pressure measuring device, wherein the main body model comprises a model box, an opening is formed in the top of the model box, a material layer for simulating surrounding rock is filled in the model box, a tunnel model is arranged in the model box, the tunnel model is wrapped in the material layer, a plurality of marking point holes are uniformly formed in the model box, a plurality of tracer holes which are uniformly distributed transversely are formed in the upper part of the model box, and a plurality of pressure measuring holes are uniformly formed in the back of the model box; one side of the upper part of the model box is communicated with a water inlet pipeline, one side of the lower part of the model box is communicated with a first water discharge hole, and the first water discharge hole is communicated with the water circulation device through a connecting pipe. The utility model has simple structure, can observe the flowing trace of the underground water by injecting the tracer, and can analyze the flowing rule of the underground water more fully.

title_en: Blood pressure and blood sugar detect all-in-one
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a blood pressure and blood sugar detection integrated machine which comprises a blood sugar detection peripheral circuit, a blood pressure MCU, a blood sugar sampling conversion circuit, a reference voltage switching circuit, a reference voltage circuit and a human-computer interaction interface module. The utility model replaces the blood sugar MCU in the existing integrated machine instrument with the MCU of the blood pressure functional module circuit and the added small amount of blood sugar functional circuit, and replaces part of necessary functional modules of the blood sugar MCU with discrete element circuits; the main control MCU is simplified into one from two, and the MCU of the blood pressure module becomes the main control MCU. Through the circuit design, the utility model can simplify the circuit structure while ensuring the normal operation of equipment, furthest reduce the production cost of products and realize the integrated design of blood pressure and blood sugar detection.

title_en: Water quality detection device for pump station monitoring
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water quality detection device for pump station monitoring, which comprises a water quality monitoring component, a water quality detection device and a water quality detection device, wherein the water quality monitoring component comprises a floating seat; the dehumidification assembly comprises a separation plate, a condenser, an evaporator, a water pipe, fan blades, a motor, a compressor, a water tank and a water outlet, wherein the separation plate is arranged, the condenser is arranged on the left side of the separation plate, the evaporator is arranged on the left side of the condenser, the water pipe is connected to the lower surface of the condenser, the fan blades are arranged in front of the condenser, the motor is connected to the rear side wall of the fan blades, the compressor is arranged on the rear side of the motor, the water tank is arranged on the lower surface of the compressor, and the water outlet is arranged in the water tank. The utility model aims to provide a water quality detection device for pump station monitoring, which is characterized in that through the water quality monitoring component structure, the dehumidifying component structure is mutually matched, so that when the water quality detection device is used, the moist air in the electric storage box can be absorbed, and meanwhile, the moist air is converted into dry air to be discharged, and therefore, when the water quality detection device is used daily, the service life of a battery is prolonged, and the service life of the water quality detection device is prolonged.

title_en: Hand-held hair drug analyzer
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a handheld hair drug analyzer, which comprises a drug analyzer, a shell, a fixed block and two connecting blocks, wherein the drug analyzer is positioned at the front side of the shell, the front side of the fixed block is fixedly connected with the front side of the drug analyzer, the two connecting blocks are respectively positioned at the left side and the right side of an inner cavity of the drug analyzer, the rear side of the fixed block is contacted with the inner cavity of the shell, and the left side and the right side of the fixed block are contacted with the surfaces of the connecting blocks. Through setting up drug analysis appearance, casing, fixed block, connecting block, standing groove, positioning mechanism and drive mechanism's cooperation and use, solved current drug analysis appearance and casing and through mosaic joint to can expend certain time to fasten the joint piece at the in-process of equipment, and inlay drug analysis appearance in the inner chamber of casing can influence the convenience of later maintenance drug analysis appearance, therefore have the problem that drug analysis appearance can't be convenient and casing assemble.

title_en: Oxygen probe for TSC temperature measurement and carbon determination
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of oxygen determination probes, and discloses an oxygen determination probe for TSC temperature measurement and carbon determination, which comprises a junction box, wherein a protection tube and a sensor are arranged on the outer side of the junction box, a flange plate is sleeved on the outer surface of the protection tube, and the oxygen determination probe further comprises: the clamping assembly is arranged on the flange plate and limits the flange plate by clamping the protection pipe; the clamping assembly comprises a fixed rod, a movable plate and a first spring are sleeved on the outer surface of the fixed rod, a clamping block is arranged on one side of the movable plate, and a fixed ring is arranged on the outer side of the flange; the outer surface of the protection tube is sleeved with a rotary block. Through the cooperation between rotating block and the clamp splice, drive the fly leaf and remove along the surface of dead lever for can extrude the surface of protection tube through the clamp splice, and then can be to the protection tube centre gripping, be convenient for adjust the degree of depth that the oxygen probe was surveyed.

title_en: Integrated connection cryopreserved bag inspection device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an integrally connected frozen storage bag inspection device, wherein an input assembly consists of a plurality of luer interfaces, a plurality of flow regulators, a second multipath branching device, a Y-shaped three-way interface, a frozen storage liquid injection head, a first input pipeline, a first switch card and a plurality of branch pipelines, an output assembly consists of a second switch card, a plurality of second puncture ports, a plurality of inspection bags, an exhaust pipeline, an exhaust cap, a two-way interface and a third switch card, the frozen storage bag consists of a plurality of first puncture ports and a plurality of main pipelines, wherein the inspection bags are communicated with a medical injector by adopting the two-way interface, so that liquid can be easily pumped into the inspection bags, and gas in the inspection bags can be quickly pumped out, and the effects of liquid quick transfer and exhaust are realized.

title_en: Cotton pesticide residue detection device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of drug detection, in particular to a cotton pesticide residue detection device, which comprises: the base is fixedly connected with a supporting plate at the top end of the base, sliding grooves are formed in the front side and the rear side of the top end of the supporting plate, sliding blocks are slidably connected to the front parts and the rear parts of the two sides of the supporting plate, connecting plates are fixedly connected to the top ends of the sliding blocks, and a moving plate is fixedly connected to the top of each connecting plate; the fixed assemblies are respectively arranged at two sides of the top end of the movable plate; the moving assembly is arranged in the base and drives the moving plate to move; the beneficial effects are as follows: the stepping motor is controlled, so that the gear drives the rack to move, and as only half of gear teeth are arranged on the periphery of the gear, the movable rod, the rod sleeve and the compression spring are mutually cooperated, the up-and-down moving plate can reciprocate, and then cotton and solvent in the test tube can be oscillated, so that the cotton and the solvent are uniformly mixed, and the precision of detecting pesticide residue can be improved.

title_en: Laboratory sample analysis detection device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a laboratory sample analysis and detection device, which belongs to the technical field of water quality detection and comprises a box body and a conveying pump arranged on one side of the box body, wherein a discharge pipe is arranged at the output end of the conveying pump, a feed pipe is arranged at the input end of the conveying pump, a cleaning device is arranged in the box body, a third electric telescopic rod is arranged on the box body, a detection head is arranged at the output end of the third electric telescopic rod, and a first electric telescopic rod is arranged on the box body. According to the utility model, the position of the cleaning block can be adjusted by arranging the second electric telescopic rod, the cleaning block can be moved to the lower part of the detection head when the detection head needs to be cleaned, the detection head can be moved to the inner part of the cleaning block by arranging the third electric telescopic rod, the detection head can be cleaned by the electric cleaning block when the second motor is started by arranging the second motor, the detection head does not need to be cleaned manually, and the cleaning efficiency is high.

title_en: World precious monitoring system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of digital agriculture, in particular to a heaven and earth treasured monitoring system, which comprises: the solar energy system comprises a human-shaped bracket, wherein a meteorological environment monitoring assembly is arranged above the human-shaped bracket, a solar panel is arranged in the middle of the human-shaped bracket, and a soil monitoring assembly is arranged below the human-shaped bracket; the soil monitoring component comprises a soil temperature and humidity conductivity integrated sensor and a soil nitrogen, phosphorus and potassium sensor. The solar panel supplies power to each monitoring component, and meteorological, environment and soil conditions are synchronously monitored by utilizing the meteorological environment monitoring component and the soil monitoring component, so that integrated monitoring of meteorological, environment and soil can be realized, the functions are highly concentrated, the monitoring is more convenient, the monitoring of the integration of the sky and the air is realized, the atmosphere, the air and the soil can be simultaneously monitored, the high concentration of the monitoring function is realized, the installation steps are reduced, the user can see all monitoring data at one time, and the convenience is improved.

title_en: Intelligent water quality monitoring system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of commercial water quality monitoring, in particular to a water quality intelligent monitoring system. The technical proposal comprises: the device comprises a shell, a second tee joint and a shell, wherein the second tee joint is arranged on one side of the first tee joint according to the internal principle of the shell, a second water pressure sensor is fixedly arranged at the right end of the second tee joint, a water flow sensor is arranged at the bottom end of the second tee joint, a second elbow is arranged at the bottom end of the water flow sensor, a second straight joint is arranged at one end of the second elbow, and a quick joint is arranged at the right end of the water flow sensor. According to the utility model, the water flow can be monitored through the water flow sensor, so that the water consumption of the water purifier is monitored, the water consumption after the filter element is replaced is informed through the monitoring data, and when the water consumption after the filter element is replaced exceeds the filtering capacity of the filter element, a worker is reminded, so that the worker can replace the filter element losing the effect in time, and the safety of the subsequent water purifier in the use process is ensured.

title_en: Food sauce detects sample thief
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a food sauce detection sampler, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein one side of the top of the bottom plate is provided with a food sauce storage tank, and the other side of the top of the bottom plate is provided with a workbench; one side of the top of the workbench is provided with a food sauce sampling mechanism matched with the food sauce storage tank, the other side of the top of the workbench is provided with a mounting plate, the top of the mounting plate is provided with a food sauce detection mechanism, and a mechanical arm is arranged between the food sauce detection mechanism and the food sauce sampling mechanism; the inside wall top of mounting panel is provided with data display screen, and the inside wall bottom of mounting panel is provided with the controller. According to the utility model, the food sauce sampling mechanism is arranged, so that the food sauce in the food sauce storage tank can be pumped into the plurality of sampling test tubes through the pumping pump, different detection requirements on the food sauce can be met, and meanwhile, a part of food sauce samples in the sampling test tubes can be reserved for standby for subsequent re-detection.

title_en: Outdoor chronic disease self-checking device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of medical equipment, in particular to an outdoor chronic disease self-checking device. The detection device comprises a detection box, wherein a detection mechanism is arranged in the detection box, the detection mechanism comprises a sliding cavity processed in the detection box, a fixed ring is connected between end walls of the sliding cavity in a sliding way, and a fixed pipe is connected to the fixed ring; and can realize utilizing solar energy to independently provide electric energy, do not need external electric energy.

title_en: Portable herbal pieces-check out test set
abstract_en: The utility model discloses portable traditional Chinese medicine decoction piece detection equipment, which relates to the technical field of traditional Chinese medicine decoction piece detection equipment and comprises a moisture detector, wherein the moisture detector comprises a handle, a detector main body and a detection needle; the outer wall of the detection needle is sleeved with a protection component, and the protection component comprises a square sliding block, a round ladder rotating groove, a sliding groove, a ball groove, locking teeth, a rotating shaft, a spring and locking beads. According to the utility model, the protection component is arranged, so that when the detection needle is required to extend into a medicinal material for detection, the lock teeth are separated from the rotating beads only by rotating the rotating shaft, and the rotating beads can move at the moment, so that the protection component is in an unlocking state, and the protection component can slide on the detection needle.

title_en: Novel concrete detects device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel concrete detection device, which comprises a workbench, wherein the top of the workbench is fixedly connected with a measuring column, the outside of the measuring column is provided with a height detection device, the bottom of the workbench is fixedly connected with electric telescopic rods, the four electric telescopic rods are symmetrically arranged in pairs, the bottoms of the four electric telescopic rods are respectively and rotatably connected with universal wheels, the top of the workbench is provided with a shaping device, the top of the workbench is fixedly connected with a push handle, the bottom of the workbench is provided with a driving mechanism, the top of the workbench is provided with a half collection barrel, the two half collection barrels are matched, through the above components, the workbench can be adapted to various fields, the workbench is always kept horizontally, measurement errors caused by uneven ground heights during detection are avoided, the inner wall of the detection barrel can not touch concrete in the process of moving the detection barrel, the detection result is accurate, and the working strength of workers is greatly reduced.

title_en: Analytical equipment is used in nitrogen oxide monitoring
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of nitrogen oxide monitoring, in particular to an analysis device for nitrogen oxide monitoring, which comprises a monitoring box and a monitoring barrel, wherein an air pump is fixedly arranged on the inner wall of the monitoring box, an input end of the air pump is fixedly connected with a suction pipe, the suction pipe extends into the monitoring barrel, one side of the monitoring barrel, which is far away from the suction pipe, is fixedly communicated with a gas pipe, a dust filtering box is fixedly arranged at a port of the gas pipe, and a filter plate is fixedly arranged on the back surface of the dust filtering box. According to the utility model, the dust filtering box, the filter plate, the through holes and the needle bar are arranged, so that when sampled gas passes through the dust filtering box, the filter plate on the dust filtering box has the effect of intercepting impurity particles, the arranged electric telescopic rod can drive the needle bar to be inserted into the through holes to dredge the through holes in time, the arranged dust filtering box can filter certain impurity particles, the influence of impurities on monitoring and analyzing results is reduced, and the problem that the detection results of nitrogen oxides are influenced when the impurities directly enter the monitoring barrel along with the sampled gas is solved.

title_en: Portable device for measuring harmful gas in underground pipe gallery
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a portable device for measuring harmful gas in an underground pipe gallery, which relates to the technical field of gas detection and specifically comprises a shell, wherein the shell is positioned in a storage mechanism, one end of the shell is symmetrically provided with power wheels, the two power wheels are fixed on the side surface of the shell through bearings, the two power wheels are connected with a reduction gearbox, the reduction gearbox is fixed in the shell, the top of the reduction gearbox is connected with a first motor, the interior of the shell is symmetrically provided with two clapboards, an installation plate is arranged between the two clapboards, the edge of the installation plate is fixed on the side wall of the clapboards, and one side of the top of the installation plate is provided with a control main board. The utility model discloses a can drive the power wheel through first motor and rotate, and then make the shell remove along the piping lane, can fully detect the inside gas of piping lane through air quality sensor in the removal in-process, need not the handheld detection device of staff and detects, detects conveniently, improves the result of use.

title_en: Metal can surface depression detection equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses surface depression detection equipment for a metal can, which relates to the technical field of metal can detection and comprises a detection equipment main body, wherein a main body movable door is movably arranged on the inner side of the detection equipment main body, a main body base is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the detection equipment main body, a movable main body is arranged at the bottom of the main body base, the detection equipment main body comprises a scanning unit, a rotating unit and a limiting unit, and the movable main body comprises a displacement unit. The utility model solves the problem that the scanning effect of the device on the metal can is reduced because the device only can perform directional scanning when the device performs scanning inspection on the metal can in the using process of the existing detection equipment by the rotary drive, the rotary controller and the rotary shaft, and the device can rotate the metal can through the rotary mechanism in the using process of the detection equipment by combining the structures, so that the scanning effect of the device on the surface depression of the metal can is improved.

title_en: Clean glass room suitable for calcium titanium solar cell production line
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a clean glass room suitable for a calcium-titanium solar cell production line, which comprises a square tube frame, a first chute, organic glass, an atmosphere control mechanism, a glove fixing mechanism and a seal replacement mechanism, wherein the square tube frame is provided with the first chute; according to the utility model, the atmosphere parameters in the glass room are monitored in real time through the gas concentration sensor, the electromagnetic valve controls the gas conveying amount, the atmosphere in the glass room is effectively ensured to be stable, and the problem that the internal production line equipment cannot be debugged after the dust cover is covered is solved through the glove fixing flange and the rubber glove.

title_en: Detection kit shell structure and urine staining method HPV detection kit
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a detection kit shell structure and a urine staining HPV detection kit, which comprises a main shell and a cap body matched with the main shell, wherein a detection strip A mounting clamping groove and a detection strip B mounting clamping groove are formed in the main shell to form a duplex mounting structure capable of mounting two detection strips, a sample adding window is formed at one end of the main shell, a display window is further formed on the main shell, the sample adding window is configured to correspond to sample pad parts of the detection strips A and B to be mounted, the display window is configured to correspond to reaction pad parts of the detection strips A and B to be mounted, and the cap body is sleeved at one end of the main shell and covers the sample adding window. According to the utility model, the detection strip A and the detection strip B can be conveniently and stably arranged in the main shell, and after urine to be detected is added into the sample adding window, the detection strip A and the detection strip B can be judged at the display window according to the color development results of the detection strip A and the detection strip B after a period of reaction time.

title_en: Protection device of rural sewage treatment facility quality of water on-line monitoring sensor
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a protection device of an on-line monitoring sensor for rural sewage treatment facility water quality, which comprises: the device comprises a sensor, a water pump, a siphon tube, a protective sleeve and a detection chamber; the water pump, the sensor and the detection chamber are arranged in the protection sleeve, the inner wall of the protection sleeve is coated with water-based algae-preventing paint, the water pump is a miniature water pump, and a filter head is arranged at the water inlet of the water pump. The detection of low water level is realized through miniature water pump water absorption, is equipped with the filter head on the miniature water pump, can reduce particulate matter contact sensor, and siphon drainage can be with the indoor water sample of detection completely emptyd, detects indoor water sample and forms the circulation, and the growth on the protective sleeve of algae or plant can be restrained to waterborne anti-algae coating. The sensor protection device can solve the problem that the low water level sensor cannot be soaked, realize the function of detecting rural sewage and wastewater in real time at low water level, protect the water quality detection sensor, prolong the service life of the sensor, and further reduce the online real-time detection and maintenance cost of rural sewage.

title_en: On-line detection equipment for traditional Chinese medicine leaching process
abstract_en: The utility model discloses on-line detection equipment for a traditional Chinese medicine leaching process, which relates to the technical field of traditional Chinese medicine preparation equipment and comprises the following components: the leaching tank, the top of leaching tank is provided with the pan feeding mouth, the output fixedly connected with (mixing) shaft of first motor, the surface fixedly connected with (mixing) blade of (mixing) shaft, the output fixedly connected with pivot of second motor, the surface fixedly connected with scraping plate of pivot, feed opening below fixedly connected with rose box, one side of leaching tank is provided with detection device. Through having set up detection device, can extract the sample at the in-process of traditional chinese medicine leaching and detect, realized the effect of on-line measuring, through having set up spout, backup pad and filter, can change or clear up the inside filter of rose box, avoid taking place to block up, through having set up stirring leaf and striking off the board, can stir the traditional chinese medicine in the leaching jar and clear up the remaining traditional chinese medicine in the leaching jar after the leaching is accomplished.

title_en: Constant temperature water activity measuring device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a constant-temperature water activity measuring device which comprises a bottom shell, a surface shell fixed on the bottom shell and a touch screen arranged on the surface shell, wherein the surface shell is provided with a plurality of test bins; the temperature compensation units are configured to perform temperature compensation in the test bins; the inside controller that is equipped with of drain pan, the controller links to each other with touch-sensitive screen, temperature compensation unit, temperature sensor and humidity transducer. The constant-temperature water activity measuring device is provided with a plurality of measuring channels, can measure a plurality of groups of samples, improves the detection efficiency, can continuously keep the temperature in the test bin constant at the set temperature in the test process, ensures that the test result is not influenced by the ambient temperature, and greatly improves the accuracy and the stability of the test result.

title_en: Portable food and drug detection device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a portable food and drug detection device, which comprises a bearing seat, wherein the top end of the bearing seat is fixedly connected with an electronic titrator, the inner side of the bearing seat is slidably connected with a support frame, one end of the inner side of the bearing seat is fixedly connected with a multi-stage hydraulic cylinder, the output end of the multi-stage hydraulic cylinder is fixedly connected with the support frame, the top of one end of the support frame is rotatably connected with a limit disc, and the top end of the limit disc is connected with a drug storage disc in a clamping manner; according to the utility model, through the structural design of the grinding mechanism, the grinding roller and the medicine storage disc can be rotated to refine the solid tablets, so that the follow-up analysis of medicine components is facilitated, the accuracy of medicine detection data is ensured, and the support frame is pulled to displace through the multistage hydraulic cylinder to promote the medicine to move into the bearing seat, so that the whole occupied area can be effectively reduced, and the whole medicine storage device is more convenient to carry.

title_en: Soil humidity monitor
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of water conservancy mountain torrent monitoring equipment, in particular to a soil humidity monitor, which comprises: protection machanism and fixed establishment, protection machanism are located fixed establishment's front end, and protection machanism includes the fixing base, and the inside fixedly connected with detector body of fixing base, the upper surface electric connection of detector body have the keypad, and the fixing groove has been seted up to fixing base bottom upper surface, and the middle part fixedly connected with joint piece of connecting the lid, the fixed slot has been seted up to the one end of fixing base, and the inside swing joint of fixed slot has the bolt. According to the utility model, the handle is arranged, so that the soil moisture monitor is convenient to hold, the first connecting groove, the second connecting groove and the connecting belt are arranged, the user can hold the soil moisture monitor by hand and then fix the soil moisture monitor, and the locking piece is arranged, so that the soil moisture monitor can be conveniently fixed and then adjust the tension according to the size of the hand, and further the soil moisture monitor can be prevented from being damaged due to sliding on the ground.

title_en: Water quality monitoring system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of water quality detection, in particular to a water quality monitoring system which comprises a purifying system and a box body, wherein a blowing structure is arranged at the upper part of the inner side of the box body and comprises a control box, a groove, a filter screen and a fan, and the groove is formed in the control box. According to the utility model, through the control box, the groove, the filter screen and the fan in the air blowing assembly, after the water quality detection of the sampling pool is finished, the fan is controlled to work through the controller, so that the temperature rise and the humidity reduction on the water quality detection sensor are accelerated, the problem that the internal devices of the device are damaged due to the influence of water flow is solved, and meanwhile, the device has the advantage that the service life of the devices in the device can be prolonged. The utility model solves the problems that the internal devices of the device are damaged due to water flow and detection data are deviated due to the fact that staff sample in the field.

title_en: Toxic gas concentration detection early warning mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of gas detection and discloses a toxic gas concentration detection and early warning mechanism, which comprises a shell, wherein a top pipe is sleeved at the top of the outer wall of the shell, side pipes are connected with the left side and the right side of the outer wall of the shell in a threaded manner, a bottom pipe is sleeved at the bottom of the outer wall of the shell, two warning lamps are fixedly arranged at the top of the front face of the shell, a display screen is fixedly arranged at the center of the front face of the shell, buzzers are fixedly arranged at the left side and the right side of the outer wall of the shell, an inner pipe is arranged in an inner cavity of the shell, sealing pipe orifices corresponding to the two side pipes are arranged at the two sides of the top of the inner pipe, and closing plates are arranged at the upper end and the lower end of each sealing pipe orifice. This toxic gas concentration detects early warning mechanism, through two side tube of shell left and right sides threaded connection again, be convenient for with the poison gas from one end side tube steadily absorb the inside of shell and detect, by the other end side tube discharge again, be convenient for stably detect poison gas concentration.

title_en: Portable flat plate agglutination experiment detection device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a portable flat plate agglutination experiment detection device, and relates to the technical field of agglutination experiment. The utility model comprises a plurality of detection structures, wherein the upper detection structure and the lower detection structure are in clamping fit, the detection structures comprise a rectangular frame assembly, a telescopic supporting mechanism and a glass flat plate assembly, the telescopic supporting mechanism comprises a mounting seat, a telescopic sleeve assembly and a telescopic inner tube assembly, the mounting seat is fixedly arranged on the lower surface of the rectangular frame assembly, the telescopic sleeve assembly is rotationally connected to the lower surface of the mounting seat, and the telescopic inner tube assembly is arranged in the telescopic sleeve assembly in a sliding manner; the glass plate component is fixed on the lower surface of the rectangular frame component in a magnetic attraction way. According to the telescopic inner tube assembly, the telescopic inner tube assembly is rotated and pulled downwards, so that the telescopic sleeve assembly moves to a proper position to be clamped, the height of the whole device is adjusted, the observation of workers is facilitated, and the telescopic inner tube assembly is folded and telescopic, so that the telescopic inner tube assembly is convenient to carry and use when people go out.

title_en: Raw material detector
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of raw material detection, in particular to a raw material detector. Its technical scheme includes device main part, quick-witted case and fixed plate, device main part top fixedly connected with storage tank, storage tank top fixedly connected with unloading pipe, storage tank bottom fixedly connected with detecting tube, the inside fixedly connected with of device main part detects the platform, storage tank opposite side fixedly connected with organic case, the inside fixedly connected with motor of quick-witted case, motor one side swing joint has the drive belt, the inside cover of drive belt is equipped with the transfer line, the peripheral fixedly connected with puddler of transfer line. According to the utility model, the storage tank is fixedly connected to the top of the device main body, when the device is used, a worker starts the motor to drive the transmission rod to rotate through the transmission belt, and at the moment, the transmission rod can drive the stirring rod to stir in the storage tank, so that raw materials in the device are uniformly stirred, and the accurate effect of device detection is improved.

title_en: Inserted grain moisture tester
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of moisture measuring instruments and discloses an inserted grain moisture measuring instrument, which comprises a fixed block, wherein a connecting block is fixedly connected to the middle part of the top wall of the fixed block, a knob is rotationally connected to the front wall of the connecting block, a connecting rod is fixedly connected to the rear end of the knob, the rear end of the connecting rod penetrates through the front wall in the connecting block and is fixedly connected with a first bevel gear, two sides of the first bevel gear are respectively meshed with a second bevel gear, two sides of the second bevel gear are respectively fixedly connected with a threaded rod at the far end of the second bevel gear, two sides of the second bevel gear are externally connected with a movable plate through threads of the threaded rods, and the two sides of the movable plate are respectively and slidably connected to the inner wall of the connecting block. According to the grain detection device, different positions of grains are detected simultaneously under the combined action of the knob, the connecting rod, the first bevel gear, the second bevel gear, the threaded rod, the moving plate, the connecting block, the first inserting rod, the second inserting rod and the detecting head, so that the detection result is more accurate and convenient.

title_en: Arc surface nondestructive test frame
abstract_en: The utility model provides a nondestructive test frame of arcwall face, relates to nondestructive test equipment field, includes the bottom plate, and the bottom plate upper end is provided with the guide rail, is provided with the movable frame on the guide rail activity, and the movable frame is connected with the detection subassembly; the upper end of the bottom plate is also provided with a plurality of groups of arrangement components for placing devices to be detected, a transmission component is arranged between the plurality of groups of arrangement components, the detection component is positioned above the bottom plate, and a detection gap is formed between the detection component and the bottom plate; the mounting assembly comprises a mounting seat connected to the upper end of the bottom plate, and the upper end of the mounting seat is connected with two rollers which are oppositely arranged and the rotating surfaces of which are mutually overlapped; the transmission assembly comprises two driving motors arranged on the bottom plate, the driving motors are connected with driving shafts, and the driving shafts are sequentially connected with a plurality of rollers corresponding to the same side; the outer wall of the roller is provided with an anti-skid sleeve. The utility model can solve the problems that the whole length of the column-shaped piece or the pipe is longer, and the fixing and rotation detection effect is inconvenient to realize in a two-end clamping mode.

title_en: A gather sampling device for liquid health food detects
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a collecting and sampling device for detecting liquid health food, which comprises an operating platform. According to the utility model, the transmission shafts are arranged at the upper end and the lower end of the inner side of the stirring tank, the transmission seats are arranged at the intersection of the two transmission shafts, and then when one transmission shaft drives the other transmission shaft to rotate through the transmission seats, the stirring blades on the outer sides of the two transmission shafts sufficiently stir the liquid health-care food in the stirring tank, so that the detection quality of the liquid health-care food is improved, the heating copper wires are arranged on the inner wall of the stirring tank, the stirring cover is arranged at the upper end of the stirring tank, the dust cover, the air suction mechanism and the filter core are arranged in the stirring cover, and then when the liquid health-care food is heated through the air suction mechanism, the gas generated by heating the liquid health-care food is filtered, so that the harmful gas generated by heating the liquid health-care food is prevented from being inhaled by staff, and potential safety hazards are caused.

title_en: Prefabricated dish sampling detection device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of prefabricated vegetable detection, in particular to a prefabricated vegetable sampling detection device, which comprises a box body, wherein the top on the right side of the box body is connected with a first motor through a bolt, the output end of the first motor penetrates through the inner cavity of the box body and is fixedly connected with a threaded rod, the surface thread of the threaded rod is sheathed with a movable plate, the bottom of the movable plate is fixedly connected with a first transverse plate, the bottom of the first transverse plate is connected with a first electric push rod through a bolt, the bottom of the first electric push rod is connected with a pneumatic clamping jaw through a bolt, and the bottom of the inner cavity of the box body is connected with a conveying belt through a bolt. According to the utility model, through the cooperation of the second electric push rod, the third electric push rod, the second motor, the L-shaped plate and the cleaning brush, the cleaning device has the advantage of cleaning functions, and can clean the surface of the conveying belt, so that long-time use is avoided, food scraps can be retained on the surface of the conveying belt, and a large amount of bacteria can be bred, thereby improving the food safety.

title_en: Dough fermentation state detection device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a device for detecting the fermentation state of dough, which relates to the field of dough fermentation detection devices and comprises a fermentation box, wherein an oxygen regulation and control assembly is arranged in the fermentation box, a baffle is fixedly arranged in the fermentation box, and a through groove is formed in the surface of the baffle. According to the dough fermentation state detection device, the gas rate detector is arranged, aerobic respiration reproduction is needed when the saccharomycetes are in an initial state, then anaerobic respiration can be carried out, so that dough is expanded, the fermentation environment is that the fermentation is firstly carried out in an aerobic environment and then in an anaerobic environment, the lactobacillus can be arranged in the anaerobic environment for fermentation at first, then the rate of gas generated by microorganisms in the dough can be detected through the gas rate detector, and the oxygen regulation and control component can be regulated, so that the microbial fermentation efficiency and the dough fermentation condition are ensured, and the integral production efficiency of toast is indirectly improved.

title_en: Floating pipe network water quality on-line monitoring device
abstract_en: The utility model is suitable for the technical field of water quality monitoring, and provides a floating pipe network water quality on-line monitoring device, which comprises: the well body is provided with a signal acquisition transmitter, the signal acquisition transmitter is electrically connected with a floating monitor, the floating monitor is slidably connected with a guide rod, and the guide rod is fixedly connected with the well body; the well lid is fixedly connected with the well body through the connecting component, and is connected with the sealing cover through the connecting component; the sealed lid cooperation well lid is under coupling assembling effect, set up signal acquisition transmitter in the well body and be close to well lid department, and the later maintenance of being convenient for of it prevents that the foreign matter from getting into the well body to make signal acquisition transmitter and the separation of the internal chamber of well, float the monitor and float in the internal surface of water of well under the guide bar is spacing, monitor quality of water through floating the monitor real time monitoring, and give signal acquisition transmitter with monitoring data transmission, signal acquisition transmitter gives wireless terminal with monitoring data wireless transmission, have the advantage that monitoring effect is good and be convenient for maintain.

title_en: Quick-frozen food detecting instrument for food safety detection
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a quick-frozen food detection instrument for food safety detection, which comprises a shell, wherein a water tank is arranged at the top of the shell, a detection assembly is arranged between the top of the shell and the inside of the shell, a water delivery assembly is arranged between the water tank and the shell, and a cleaning mechanism is arranged between the detection assembly and the inside of the shell; the detection assembly comprises a detection table positioned inside the shell, and an electric telescopic rod is installed at the top of the shell in a penetrating mode. This quick-frozen food detecting instrument for food safety inspection, after the detection is accomplished, electric telescopic handle drives the clamp plate and rises to get back to initial position, at this moment under the effect of haulage rope and articulated seat, makes the rising of clamp plate drive the detection platform and takes place to rotate on articulated seat, makes the clamp plate be the incline condition, under the cooperation of spout and slider, the brush cleaner is followed the inclined plane of extension detection platform and is slided left, cleans the inside to fixed box with the unqualified product on the detection platform.

title_en: High-precision multi-parameter portable organic matter detector
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-precision multi-parameter portable organic matter detector, which belongs to the technical field of organic matter detectors and is characterized by comprising a movable box, wherein the top of the movable box is provided with a box door, the front side of the movable box is bolted with a fixed rod, the front side of the fixed rod is bolted with a handle, the inner wall of the movable box is provided with a buffer box, the inner wall of the buffer box is provided with a sponge plate, the top of the sponge plate is provided with a detector body, and the top of the sponge plate is provided with a protection mechanism.

title_en: Lifting type environment monitor
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a lifting environment monitor, which comprises a base and further comprises: the support sleeve is rotationally connected to the upper side of the base, and the two sides of the outer end of the support sleeve are fixedly connected with fixing frames respectively; the two groups of positioning mechanisms are respectively connected with the fixing frame and fix the position of the fixing frame; the support rod is connected to the inside of the support sleeve in a sliding manner, and a butt joint mechanism is arranged in the support rod; and the detection module is fixedly connected to the upper end of the supporting rod. According to the lifting type environment monitor provided by the utility model, the height of the detection module can be adjusted according to the requirement, the position of the detection module can be fixed through the butt joint mechanism inside the supporting rod after the height of the detection module is adjusted, the detection module can also rotate through the supporting sleeve, the angle of the detection module can be adjusted, and the positioning mechanism is utilized for fixing the position after the rotation angle of the detection module is adjusted.

title_en: Exhaust gas detection device with detection probes convenient to store
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an exhaust gas detection device with a detection probe convenient to store, which comprises a storage box, wherein a supporting plate is fixed on the left side of the front end surface of the storage box, a rotating rod is connected on the right side of the front end surface of the storage box, and a sulfur dioxide detector is also connected on the storage box; further comprises: the fixed plate is fixed in bilateral symmetry the receiver rear end face, the bearing is connected with rotatable rotation axis on the fixed plate, be fixed with the friction pulley on the rotation axis, the friction pulley lower extreme is fixed with the one end of slide bar, the slide bar is connected with the handle. This exhaust gas detection device that detecting probe conveniently accomodates adopts rotation type to expand storage mechanism, can make things convenient for the use of device, and can realize the accomodating protection of probe when the device is not used, avoids the probe to damage because of colliding with, and the length and the angle modulation of device can be realized to the cooperation adjustment mechanism again to satisfy actual detection demand, and can avoid user's hand direct and exhaust gas contact, guarantee the safe in utilization of device.

title_en: Gas detection equipment for limited space operation environment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of gas detection equipment in a limited space operation environment, and discloses gas detection equipment in a limited space operation environment, which comprises gas detection equipment, wherein the back surface of the gas detection equipment is fixedly connected with a lithium battery of the detection equipment, the outer part of the lithium battery of the detection equipment is fixedly connected with a lithium battery fixer, the outer part of a gas pipe connecting port of a collecting equipment is fixedly connected with a collecting equipment connecting sealing ring, the outer part of the collecting equipment connecting sealing ring is fixedly connected with gas collecting equipment, the top of the gas collecting equipment is fixedly connected with an illuminating lamp protective glass, and the top of the illuminating lamp protective glass is fixedly connected with an illuminating lamp; the illuminating lamp is arranged, so that the illuminating lamp is convenient to operate and illuminate in a poor light, and an operator can conveniently illuminate when the light is darker through the arranged illuminating lamp, so that the use experience of the operator is improved.

title_en: Underground low-power consumption gas monitoring device based on NB-IOT
abstract_en: The utility model provides a low-power consumption gas monitoring device in pit based on NB-IOT, includes the shell and installs the detecting element in the shell, detecting element include microprocessor and with microprocessor electricity be connected gaseous preprocessing circuit, temperature and humidity detection module, triaxial gravity accelerometer, positioning module and NB-IOT communication circuit, with gaseous preprocessing circuit electricity be connected gas sensor, power management module is the power supply of each part in the device. The device disclosed by the utility model monitors the concentration of toxic gas, combustible gas and oxygen in the pit, uploads information to the platform end and the mobile phone APP, prompts staff to maintain and overhaul, prevents explosion caused by the too high concentration of the combustible gas, avoids injuring passers-by, and monitors the oxygen so as to enable the patrol staff to carry out the underground maintenance work safely and timely.

title_en: Detection probe cleaning device for blood coagulation analyzer
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a detection probe cleaning device for the interior of a coagulation analyzer, relates to the technical field of coagulation analyzers, and aims to solve the problem that residues on a probe influence data parameters of the next detection after the sample is detected each time by the existing coagulation analyzer, so that the result is inaccurate. The inner cavity, its inside at the coagulation analyzer main part of installing, the inside of inner cavity is provided with places the box, the top of placing the box is provided with detecting probe, and detecting probe is provided with a plurality of, and a plurality of detecting probe equally divide into three and be listed as, a plurality of detecting probe all passes through telescopic link and coagulation analyzer main part telescopic connection, and the centre of three detecting probe all is provided with the stoving end, and the stoving end is provided with a plurality of, a plurality of the stoving end all with coagulation analyzer main part electric connection.

title_en: Drainage air extractor for detecting total phosphorus in water body
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a drainage air extractor for detecting total phosphorus in a water body, which belongs to the technical field of water body detection and comprises a shell, wherein one side of the upper end of the shell is provided with a mounting assembly, the inside of the mounting assembly is provided with a limiting device, the outer wall of the shell is provided with a plug, when a liquid discharge air extraction pipe is required to be limited, a rotating ring is rotated, the rotating ring passes through the outer wall of a vertical plate, a screw thread is placed and moved inwards so as to drive a sliding rod to move forwards in a tooth column, a plugboard is inserted into a slot, the tooth column cannot be rotated through the limit of the plugboard at the moment, so that a gear cannot be rotated, the liquid discharge air extraction pipe can be limited, and the rotating ring can be rotated outwards when the limit is released.

title_en: Soil environment monitoring equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses soil environment monitoring equipment, which relates to the technical field of environment monitoring equipment and comprises an installation seat and an upper upright post, wherein the upper surface of the installation seat is fixedly connected with a lower upright post, the upper end of the upper upright post is fixedly connected with a photovoltaic panel, the arc surface of the upper upright post is fixedly connected with a distribution box, the surface of the installation seat is fixedly connected with an electric storage box, the lower surface of the installation seat is fixedly connected with a detector, the photovoltaic panel is electrically connected with the electric storage box, the electric storage box is electrically connected with the distribution box, the distribution box is electrically connected with the detector, and the arc surface of the lower upright post is provided with a buffer structure.

title_en: Soil detection case and soil detection device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of soil detection devices, and provides a soil detection box and a soil detection device, wherein the soil detection box comprises a box body and a soil detector fixedly arranged on the outer side of the box body, a lifting plate capable of vertically lifting is arranged on the inner side of the box body, a clamping assembly is arranged on the upper end face of the lifting plate, the clamping assembly comprises two mutually symmetrical U-shaped plates, the U-shaped plates synchronously move in opposite directions or in opposite directions, a detection probe of the soil detector penetrates through the middle part of the lifting plate and is positioned between the U-shaped plates, a cleaning assembly is arranged at the lower end position of the inner side of the box body, the cleaning assembly comprises a rotatable sleeve, and bristles are fixedly connected on the inner side of the sleeve; the utility model ensures that the detection probe of the soil detector is vertically and stably inserted into soil for detection, improves the detection precision, is convenient for disassembly and assembly, and in addition, the detection probe is cleaned by driving the brush hair on the inner side to rotate and the detection probe to vertically move through the sleeve, so that the detection probe is convenient for the next use.

title_en: Communication device with gas alarm function
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of gas detection, and discloses a communication device with a gas alarm function. The device comprises a communication device body, wherein a connecting cavity is further formed in the surface of the communication device body, and a gas detection mechanism is connected inside the connecting cavity; the gas detection mechanism comprises a shell arranged in a connecting cavity, an installation cavity is arranged in the shell, positioning columns are further arranged at the centers of four sides of the installation cavity, a bottom plate is arranged on the surface of each positioning column, a buzzer is arranged at the center of the bottom plate, and a plurality of gas detection modules are uniformly arranged around the buzzer. Different gases in the harmful industrial environment can be detected through the gas detection mechanism arranged in the connecting cavity, detection results are displayed to the display screen in real time, workers can observe real-time data conveniently, and meanwhile, when harmful gases exceed a preset value, the buzzer and the indicator lamp can simultaneously alarm.

title_en: Soil high-efficiency detection device for environment detection
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a soil high-efficiency detection device for environment detection, which is characterized in that a telescopic cylinder, a cylinder groove, a lifting plate, a mounting block, a third servo motor, a first bevel gear, a second bevel gear, a bidirectional threaded rod and a material taking clamping block are arranged, the telescopic ends of the two telescopic cylinders push the lifting plate to move downwards along the inner wall of the cylinder groove, the lifting plate moves downwards to drive the mounting block to move downwards, then the third servo motor is started to drive the output end to drive the first bevel gear to rotate in a transmission groove, the first bevel gear rotates to drive the second bevel gear to rotate, the second bevel gear rotates to drive the bidirectional threaded rod to rotate, the bidirectional threaded rod rotates to drive the two material taking clamping blocks to move back to back, when the lower ends of the two material taking clamping blocks are in contact with soil to be detected, the third servo motor is reversed, the two material taking clamping blocks are closed, automatic material taking of the soil to be detected is completed, manual material taking is not needed, time and labor are saved, and the application range is wide.

title_en: Root system protection rejuvenation device for ancient and famous trees
abstract_en: The utility model provides a root system protection rejuvenation device for ancient trees, which comprises a permeation tube, a maintenance pile, a monitoring sensor and a monitoring pile, wherein the permeation tube is buried below the root of an ancient tree; the monitoring sensor is arranged in the permeation tube and can monitor the oxygen content and the humidity value in the soil around the root of the ancient tree in real time; the monitoring pile is provided with a monitoring terminal device which is connected with the monitoring sensor to receive the oxygen content and humidity value signals and process and display the signals. So that the fertilizer and the oxygen can be more conveniently applied to the ancient famous trees, the absorption of nutrients by the ancient famous trees is more facilitated, and the secondary damage to the roots of the ancient famous trees is avoided; in addition, the root growth environment of the ancient and famous trees can be monitored in real time and accurately maintained.

title_en: Thermal power generation system and steam-water sampling and recycling system thereof
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a thermal power generation system and soda sample recovery system thereof, this soda sample recovery system includes a plurality of sample trunk roads, a plurality of on-line instrument sampling unit, a plurality of manual sampling branch road and collection unit. Each online instrument sampling unit comprises a plurality of first online sampling branches and a plurality of second online sampling branches, and inlets of the first online sampling branches and inlets of the second online sampling branches of each online instrument sampling unit are connected with outlets of corresponding sampling main roads. The plurality of manual sampling branches comprise a first manual sampling branch, a second manual sampling branch and a third manual sampling branch. The outlet of each first online sampling branch and the outlet of each first manual sampling branch are communicated with the inlet of the first recovery pipeline, the outlet of each second online sampling branch and the outlet of each second manual sampling branch are communicated with the inlet of the second recovery pipeline, and the outlet of the third manual sampling branch is communicated with the inlet of the third recovery pipeline.

title_en: Sampling inspection device for detecting regional malodor pollution
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of air detection and discloses a spot inspection device for detecting malodor pollution in an area, which comprises a lower box body, wherein an upper box body is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the lower box body, a first partition plate is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the upper box body, a second partition plate is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the upper box body, a third partition plate is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the upper box body, a hole is formed in the center of the first partition plate in a penetrating mode, and a first air inlet pipe is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the hole. According to the utility model, through the cylinder above the second partition board, the sealing block connected with the output end of the cylinder slides in the first air inlet pipe to block the circulation of air in the first air inlet pipe, the second air inlet pipe is further arranged at the gap between the second partition board and the third partition board, and the electromagnetic valve is further arranged on the inner wall of the second air inlet pipe to control the flowability of the second air inlet pipe, so that a quantitative air inlet is performed on a sample of detected air.

title_en: RGB detection device
abstract_en: The utility model provides an RGB detection device, which comprises a fixed component, wherein the fixed component comprises a bottom plate, a U-shaped plate, three first driving motors, two screw rods, a movable plate, a second driving motor, a groove, two clamping plates and a stirring rod; the U-shaped plates are fixedly connected to the top of the bottom plate, the three first driving motors are fixedly connected to the top of the U-shaped plates, and rectangular holes are formed in the inner walls of the two sides of the U-shaped plates. According to the utility model, the test tube is moved onto the moving plate by the second driving motor, the moving block drives the clamping plate to move to fix the test tube, the first driving motor drives the screw rod to rotate, the screw rod drives the corresponding L-shaped plate to move upwards, the L-shaped plate drives the test tube to move upwards by the moving plate, and after a proper position is moved, the stirring rod is driven to rotate by the first driving motor in the middle to stir the test tube, so that the test tube can be prevented from falling, and manual shaking of a worker is not needed through automatic stirring, so that the detection efficiency is improved.

title_en: Large-volume quantitative device for permanganate index analyzer
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of reagent quantification, in particular to a large-volume quantification device for a permanganate index analyzer. A large-volume quantitative device for a permanganate index analyzer comprises a quantitative system and a waste liquid collecting system; the quantitative system comprises a quantitative needle, the quantitative needle is fixedly connected with a positioning arm which moves under the drive of a motor, an ultrasonic sensor for detecting the liquid level is arranged on the positioning arm, a quantitative table for placing a sample cup is arranged below the quantitative needle, a weight sensor is arranged on the quantitative table, and a liquid pump is arranged between the quantitative system and a waste liquid collecting system. The quantitative device designed by the utility model utilizes the ultrasonic sensor and the weight sensor to complete double measurement of liquid level and weight, ensures quantitative precision, and is matched with automatic components such as a motor, an automatic liquid pump and the like to complete full-automatic quantitative operation, thereby avoiding various errors caused by manual operation.

title_en: CVS analyzer liquid feeding device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a CVS analyzer liquid adding device, which comprises a liquid charger and a reagent bottle; the liquid feeder comprises a liquid feeder body and a first liquid suction pipe; one end of the first liquid suction pipe is communicated with the liquid feeder body, and the other end of the first liquid suction pipe is sleeved with a threaded interface and a gasket; the reagent bottle comprises a reagent bottle body and a bottle cap; the bottle cap is arranged at the bottle mouth of the reagent bottle body, an internal thread through hole is arranged on the bottle cap, and a second liquid suction pipe communicated with the internal thread through hole is arranged below the internal thread through hole; the internal thread through hole of the bottle cap is in threaded connection with the threaded interface of the first liquid suction pipe. The utility model removes the possibility of accidental spillage and pollution of the reagent and reduces the possibility of cross contamination of the outer wall of the liquid suction pipe.

title_en: Pumping type hydrogen detector
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pumping type hydrogen detector, which relates to the technical field of hydrogen detection equipment and comprises a pumping type hydrogen detector body, wherein a sampling air inlet is formed in the top of the pumping type hydrogen detector body, a filter cartridge is sleeved outside the sampling air inlet, and the periphery of the top of the filter cartridge is connected with a sealing cover through threads; the inner wall of the filter cartridge is fixedly connected with a sealing layer, a cylinder is inserted into the top opening of the filter cartridge, the cylinder is in a sliding fit state with the sealing layer, and a filter screen is arranged on the inner wall of the cylinder; according to the utility model, when the hydrogen concentration is required to be detected in a place, the sealing cover is screwed out from the top of the filter cartridge, then the pumping type hydrogen detector body is started, external gas enters the sampling air inlet from the top opening of the cylinder under the action of the pump, and the dust particles in the air are filtered under the action of the filter screen, so that the dust particles in the air are prevented from blocking the sampling air inlet.

title_en: Electromagnetic probe clamping device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of nondestructive testing, in particular to an electromagnetic ultrasonic probe clamping tool, which aims to solve the problem that a probe cannot be aligned to a tank bus in an automatic flaw detection system to detect a magnetic tank body due to low positioning precision, so that detection errors are caused. The probe ball pair connecting rod is connected with the ball pair on the ball pair connecting triangular plate and the electromagnetic probe attracts the magnetic tank body, so that the adjustment of the probe angle is realized, each probe can be aligned to the bus of the tank body, the accurate positioning scanning is realized, and the efficient and reliable detection of the tank body workpiece is realized.

title_en: Water quality monitoring system of circulating water system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of water quality monitoring and discloses a water quality monitoring system of a circulating water system, which comprises a monitoring box, wherein the inside of the monitoring box is hollow, the back surface of the monitoring box is in an opening shape, a monitoring terminal is fixedly connected to the top of the monitoring box, a display is embedded and arranged on the front surface of the monitoring box, the display is positioned above the front surface of the monitoring box, and a plurality of functional buttons are fixedly connected to the front surface of the monitoring box.

title_en: Filtering structure of air sensor
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a filtering structure of an air sensor, which comprises a filtering device arranged at an air inlet end of the air sensor, wherein the air inlet end of the filtering device is connected with a first flange which is communicated with the air inlet end of the filtering device, the filtering device comprises a sleeve, a first filter screen and a second filter screen which are coaxially arranged at one side of the first flange, the second filter screen is sleeved on the first filter screen, and a first scraping plate and a second scraping plate are sleeved on a transmission shaft. The double-layer filter screen formed by the first filter screen and the second filter screen filters air entering the air sensor, impurities in the air are prevented from blocking the inside of the air sensor, the sensitivity and the accuracy of detection of the air sensor are improved, the impurities filtered on the inner walls of the first filter screen and the second filter screen are scraped through the first scraping plate and the second scraping plate, the impurities are prevented from blocking the inner walls of the first filter screen and the second filter screen, meanwhile, the filter device is also convenient to clean, and the cleaning efficiency is improved.

title_en: Gas concentration detection system of ultrapure zero gas generator
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a gas concentration detection system of an ultrapure zero gas generator, which is used for detecting various gas concentrations in zero gas generated by the zero gas generator and comprises an electric control unit, a quantum cascade laser gas measurement unit, an oxygen measurement unit, a hydrocarbon measurement unit, a pressure control unit and a display unit. The system is divided into three paths, wherein the first path can realize the concentration of carbon monoxide (CO), carbon dioxide (CO  2 ), nitric Oxide (NO) and nitrogen dioxide (NO  2 ) in zero gas, and the gas can realize the detection of oxygen (O  2 ) after flowing through the oxygen measuring unit; the second path can measure the total concentration of Hydrocarbon (HC) in the zero gas; the third path is capable of exhausting gas other than the gas entering the first path and the second path. The system can realize detection of various gas concentrations, meets different detection requirements, and has simple detection method and low cost.

title_en: Water quality monitoring device for river water treatment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a water quality monitoring device for river water treatment, which comprises an equipment body, wherein the lower end of the equipment body is fixedly connected with an outer frame, a wire storage hollow rod is fixedly connected between the left inner wall and the right inner wall of the outer frame, a plurality of wires penetrate through the inner end of the wire storage hollow rod, a plurality of electric wire winders are arranged at the outer end of the wire storage hollow rod, a water quality sensor is fixedly connected to one end of the wires, which is far away from the electric wire winders, the lower end of the water quality sensor is fixedly connected with the wire storage hollow rod, a plurality of openings are formed in the lower end of the outer frame, lower vertical rods are connected to the lower ends of the openings, and a counterweight special-shaped ball is clamped between the two corresponding lower vertical rods.

title_en: Object content detection device for exhaust emission
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of exhaust emission and discloses an object content detection device for exhaust emission, which comprises a main pipeline, wherein the outer wall of the main pipeline is fixedly connected with a first fixed pipe sleeve, the outer wall of the first fixed pipe sleeve is fixedly connected with an air inlet pipe, one end of the air inlet pipe is fixedly connected with a box body, one side of the box body is fixedly connected with a sampling pipe, the outer wall of the sampling pipe is fixedly connected with a water injection pipe, one end of the sampling pipe is fixedly connected with an air bag, the inner side wall of the box body is fixedly connected with a filter plate, and the bottom of the box body is fixedly connected with a connecting pipe. This object content detection device for exhaust emission can make things convenient for the operator to carry out quick sample work to it when needs detect exhaust object content, need not the operator and manually sample work to exhaust emission pipeline inside, has not only improved convenient and the efficiency of sample, brings loaded down with trivial details and inconvenient when avoiding the sample simultaneously, has further satisfied the demand of use.
