title_en: Automatic soil column leaching device suitable for fertilizer evaluation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic soil column leaching device suitable for fertilizer evaluation, which comprises a hollow device shell for accommodating soil columns, a water inlet pipe, an electric valve, an upper detector, a lower detector, a control unit and a water outlet pipe. The electric valve is arranged in the water inlet pipe to control the on-off of the water inlet pipe. The upper detector and the lower detector are both arranged on the inner wall of the device housing and are respectively used for detecting the highest water level and the lowest water level in the device housing. According to the utility model, the addition and collection of the leaching water are accurately controlled by the upper and lower detectors capable of automatically detecting the highest and lowest water levels and the automatic sampler, so that the accurate measurement of nutrients is facilitated to be realized subsequently; the utility model realizes full-automatic leaching sampling, is beneficial to saving time and simplifying sampling steps.

title_en: Reservoir dam seepage monitoring device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a reservoir dam leakage monitoring device, which comprises a monitoring device body, wherein a fixed ring is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the monitoring device body, a threaded ring is arranged at the lower end of the inner wall of the fixed ring in a threaded manner, a cap rod is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the threaded ring, a conductive rod is arranged in the cap rod and the threaded ring in a sliding manner, a plurality of drilling plates which are distributed in parallel are fixedly arranged at the two ends of the monitoring device body, and a special-shaped plate is fixedly arranged at one end of each of the drilling plates; according to the utility model, the humidity sensor is arranged for monitoring, the data are transmitted to the induction display, the data are visual, a user can record the data conveniently, when the soil with different heights needs to be monitored further, the two limiting clamping blocks are completely aligned to the second through hole and are clamped with the second through hole through the displacement of the conducting rod, so that the displacement limiting clamping blocks are realized, the soil with different heights can be monitored and the water seepage condition can be judged conveniently, and the effective judgment can be made.

title_en: Waste gas detection and collection device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a device for detecting and collecting waste gas, which relates to the technical field of waste gas detection and comprises a waste gas box body, wherein a waste gas collecting mechanism is arranged on the left side above the waste gas box body, a waste gas purifying mechanism is arranged on the right side of the waste gas box body, and the waste gas collecting mechanism comprises: install in the left collection section of thick bamboo of exhaust gas box top, the rear of collection section of thick bamboo is connected with the telescopic link, just the inside of collection section of thick bamboo is provided with the outer net, and the centre of outer net is provided with the intranet that is used for impurity filtration, the rear top of telescopic link is connected with the trachea, just the tracheal top is installed the gas pole. This kind of collection device is detected with waste gas is connected with the purification bucket through one side at the exhaust gas box, is provided with a device section of thick bamboo in the inside of purification bucket, and the internally mounted of a device section of thick bamboo has the active carbon, utilizes the function of active carbon to discharge after can purifying the inside waste gas of purification bucket, avoids waste gas to cause secondary pollution.

title_en: COD on-line automatic detector for production waste discharge monitoring
abstract_en: The utility model provides a COD on-line automatic detector for monitoring production waste discharge, which comprises an assembly chamber, wherein the front surface of a cabinet is provided with a filtering component and a detection shell, the front surface of the assembly chamber is respectively and fixedly provided with a flushing component for flushing the inside, the bottom of the assembly chamber is fixedly provided with a peristaltic pump, the bottom of the detection shell is fixedly provided with a matched acquisition component, and the top of the detection shell is provided with a sampling detection component extending to the inside; the filter component comprises a cylinder body, a filter screen, a filter element and a cylinder body fixedly installed in the assembly chamber. According to the utility model, the sampling type detection assembly is used for completing the detection operation of the wastewater, and the synchronous and corresponding acquisition and sampling can be carried out by matching with the acquisition assembly, so that personnel can rapidly acquire the wastewater with abnormal detection properties, the normal period of the device can not be influenced during the sampling period, and the detection and sampling are realized without interference.

title_en: Crosslinking degree analysis and detection device of EVA film
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of EVA film crosslinking degree analysis, in particular to an EVA film crosslinking degree analysis detection device, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a detection box is arranged on the right side of the upper end surface of the bottom plate, the upper end surface of the detection box is detachably connected with a sealing cover, the left side and the right side of the outer wall of the detection box are fixedly connected with transverse plates, the upper end surfaces of the two transverse plates are fixedly connected with sliding rods, the outer walls of the two sliding rods are fixedly connected with sliding blocks, the two sliding blocks are respectively and fixedly connected with the left side and the right side of the sealing cover, a temperature sensor detects the temperature in real time and transmits signals to a control panel, the control panel controls an electric heating block to stop heating, the temperature is controlled, gas at the temperature is detected through a gas sensor, the crosslinking degree of a sample is further judged, finally, the detected crosslinking degree is respectively compared with national standards, whether the detected EVA film meets the requirements or not can be judged.

title_en: Industrial site pollution investigation detection device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of pollution detection and discloses an industrial site pollution investigation and detection device which comprises a detection device, wherein the detection device comprises a shell, mounting grooves, mounting blocks, a mounting plate, a mounting frame, a mounting box, a control switch, a connecting rod, a water suction pump, a collecting box, a filter plate and a detector, wherein the middle end of the top of the outer side surface of the shell is provided with the mounting grooves, the mounting frames are fixedly arranged on the two sides of the top surface of the mounting plate, the water suction pump is arranged at the bottom of the connecting rod, the filter plate is arranged at the bottom of the collecting box, and the detector is arranged on the side surface of the collecting box. This industrial site pollutes investigation detection device aligns the water through handheld mounting bracket, starts the motor jar and carries out altitude mixture control to the collection case, according to the height of the water that needs to detect, closes the motor jar and starts the solenoid valve and guide the water to the aqueduct in, and the suction pump guides the water, enters into collection case top, and the water enters into in the connecting pipe, detects the water in the entering detector.

title_en: Quick continuous detection device of food safety
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rapid and continuous food safety detection device, which relates to the field of food safety detection equipment and comprises a conveying mechanism and a scanning detection mechanism, wherein the top of the conveying mechanism is fixedly connected with a fixed plate, the inside of the fixed plate is embedded with a connecting sliding sleeve, and the side of the fixed plate is movably connected with a deviation rectifying assembly. This quick continuous detection device of food safety through the deviation correcting subassembly that sets up for transport mechanism can be with waiting to detect the product automatic correction to transport mechanism's centre position when carrying and waiting to detect the product, thereby avoided transport mechanism to carry treating to detect the food or the staff appears the position deviation when carrying out the material loading and cause detection mechanism not to scan the whole body of food package and lead to detection device's accuracy to receive the condition emergence that the interference, and through the direction slide bar that sets up, make the staff can drive the deviation correcting board and carry out back-and-forth movement along transport mechanism's top when driving the screw thread regulation pole and rotate.

title_en: Portable detector
abstract_en: The utility model provides a portable detector, which belongs to the technical field of constructional engineering and aims to solve the problem that a host of the existing detector is easy to damage when the host directly falls onto the ground, and comprises a detection shield, a detection main body, a detection screen, an adjusting key, a detection data line, a detection probe, a detection protection mechanism and a detection supporting mechanism; the detection main body is connected to the inner end face of the detection shield in a plug-in manner; the detection screen is arranged on the front end face of the detection main body; the adjusting key is arranged on the front end face of the detection main body; the detection data line is connected to the detection main body in a plug-in manner; the detection probe is positioned at the lower side of the detection main body; the detection protection mechanism is arranged on the front end face of the detection shield; the detection supporting mechanism is arranged at the rear side of the detection shield. Through adopting detection protection machanism, realized having avoided detecting the main part and dropped subaerial problem that detects the main part and directly damage, through adopting detection supporting mechanism, realized being convenient for the staff and use the detector.

title_en: Air monitoring device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an air monitoring device which comprises a mounting frame, wherein a rotating assembly is arranged on the mounting frame, a fixed plate is arranged at the rotating end of the rotating assembly, an air detector main body is arranged on the fixed plate, and a sampling port of the air detector main body is communicated with a sampling tube through a hose; the air detector is characterized in that a swinging assembly is arranged on the fixed plate and used for swinging the sampling tube, adjusting the end position of the sampling tube away from the air detector main body, and an exhaust fan is arranged in the sampling tube. The beneficial effects are that: through rotating fixed plate and sampling pipe of rotating assembly, through swing subassembly swing sampling pipe to can adjust the position of sampling pipe port, can be with the air delivery of different positions to the air detector originally internally through the sampling pipe, improve detection range, inhale the sampling pipe with air through the air exhauster, improve the air input of air detector main part, and then improve detection rate and precision, reduce the hysteresis quality to environmental monitoring.

title_en: Greenhouse gas monitoring terminal
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a greenhouse gas monitoring terminal which comprises a box body, a detector, a control panel and clamping blocks, wherein the detector is fixedly connected to the top of the box body, the control panel is fixedly connected to the left side of the box body, and the clamping blocks are fixedly connected to the front side and the rear side of the right side of the box body. According to the utility model, through the matched use of the box body, the detector, the control panel, the clamping block, the cavity, the positioning mechanism, the rotating mechanism, the mounting plate, the insertion hole, the guide plate, the limiting rod, the placing table, the detection device, the second coupling wheel and the driving belt, the problems that a large number of greenhouse gas monitoring terminals are required to be installed for comprehensively monitoring the gas in the monitoring area, so that the data in the monitoring area are comprehensively collected, and a large number of greenhouse gas monitoring terminals are required to be installed, so that a rapid installation of the greenhouse gas monitoring terminals is required, and the installation working efficiency is improved are solved.

title_en: Extraction device for detecting water quality volatile phenol
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an extraction device for detecting water quality volatile phenol, which comprises a bottle body, wherein a liquid separating pipe is arranged at the bottom of the bottle body, a valve is further arranged at the end part of the outward end of the liquid separating pipe, an oscillator is further arranged at the bottom of the bottle body, a clamping assembly is arranged on the top surface of the oscillator, and the clamping assembly is tightly attached to four sides of the bottom of the bottle body and enables the bottom surface of the bottle body and the top surface of the oscillator to be attached to each other; the utility model is improved based on the existing separating funnel, adopts a bottle body which is integrally conical and is made of glass, so that an iron stand is not needed to be fixed in an auxiliary way in the actual operation process, and the adding and placing of reagents are more convenient in the follow-up process; meanwhile, the oscillator adopts an ultrasonic vibration mode, so that the vibration effect is better than that of the existing manual vibration, the consistency of all bottle bodies on the oscillator can be ensured, the reproducibility is good, the convenience of the vibration device is greatly improved, the experimental process is simplified, and the operation is more convenient.

title_en: Cereal moisture measuring instrument
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of grain measurement and discloses a grain moisture measuring instrument, which comprises a measuring mechanism, wherein the top of the measuring mechanism is fixedly connected with a mounting seat, a hopper is arranged in the mounting seat, mounting holes are formed in two sides of the hopper, an anti-blocking assembly is arranged in the hopper, positioning rods are fixedly connected to two sides of the inside of the mounting seat, a spring is sleeved on one side of the periphery of each positioning rod, an inserting rod is connected to the other side of the periphery of each positioning rod in a sliding manner, buttons are connected to two sides of the top of the mounting seat in a sliding manner, and a connecting rod is arranged between each button and each inserting rod. According to the grain moisture measuring instrument, the hopper can be conveniently detached or installed through the cooperation of the mounting seat, the hopper, the mounting hole, the positioning rod, the spring, the inserted link, the button and the connecting rod, so that the hopper is convenient to clean or the feed inlet of the tester is convenient to clean.

title_en: Indoor environment detection device
abstract_en: The application discloses an indoor environment detection device, which belongs to the technical field of indoor environment detection equipment and comprises a lifting box body, wherein a detection assembly is arranged above the lifting box body, the bottom end of a motor base is connected with a servo speed reducing motor, a passive base body is connected to an adjusting screw in a threaded manner, and slide limiting mechanisms are arranged on the front side and the rear side of the left end face and the right end face of a base table. This indoor environment detection device can be convenient for detect the air quality in indoor different places through the movable wheel, after this device moved to the destination, carry out limit slip processing to this device by limit slip mechanism again for this device can stably stay in the place of awaiting measuring when indoor execution air quality detects the task, later restart servo gear motor, behind the rotatory servo gear motor drive adjusting screw, make passive pedestal drive detection component carry out altitude mixture control in vertical direction, thereby make things convenient for this detection device to detect the air quality in different places of indoor environment and indoor different height.

title_en: Convenient fixed knot of sensor constructs based on concrete beam slip casting compactness experiment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a convenient sensor fixing structure based on concrete beam grouting compactness experiments, which comprises a front clamping shell, a rear clamping shell, a mounting seat, a spring block, a clamping piece and a driving piece, wherein the front clamping shell is fixedly connected with the mounting seat; the front clamping shell and the rear clamping shell are respectively provided with a front clamping groove and a rear clamping groove, and clamping holes are formed in the middle parts of the front clamping shell and the rear clamping shell; the front mounting shell and the rear mounting shell are fixedly mounted together, and the front clamping groove and the rear clamping groove form an open clamping cavity; opposite clamping pieces are arranged up and down in the clamping cavity, two ends of each clamping piece are inclined clamping inclined planes, and clamping cambered surfaces matched with the clamping holes are formed in the clamping pieces; opposite driving pieces are arranged on the left and right sides of the clamping cavity, and driving inclined planes are arranged at two ends of the driving piece; a force application plate is fixed on the driving piece and extends out of the clamping cavity; the spring block is fixed at the bottom of the rear clamping groove, and a vertical spring is fixed between the clamping piece and the spring block; the mount pad is fixed in the preceding terminal surface of preceding installation shell, has seted up the perforation with the sensor adaptation on it.

title_en: Device for detecting workability of building concrete
abstract_en: A device for detecting workability of building concrete belongs to the field of building construction detection. The utility model solves the technical problem that the measurement precision is insufficient easily caused by manually lifting the slump barrel and measuring and reading by using the tape measure in the actual slump experiment measurement process. The bottom plate level is placed, and the slump bucket is placed at the upper surface of bottom plate, and the vertical fixed mounting of direction pole setting is provided with the scale at the right-hand member middle part of the upper surface of bottom plate, and the measuring diaphragm slip-on is in the outside of direction pole setting, and the measuring diaphragm can rotate as the centre of a circle along the horizontal direction with the direction pole setting, and the sleeve is located the top of measuring the right-hand member of diaphragm, and the sleeve slides the outside of suit in the direction pole setting along vertical direction, and the centre gripping horizontal pole is fixed at telescopic left end, and the middle part of slump bucket is held to the ring binder. The slump barrel moves in the vertical direction more accurately, increasing the accuracy of the measurement. The utility model is used for detecting the workability of the concrete.

title_en: Linear guide rail pair sealing and self-lubricating performance testing machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of linear guide rail pair performance test equipment, in particular to a linear guide rail pair sealing and self-lubricating performance testing machine, which is characterized in that a linear guide rail pair to be detected is arranged in a roller to run, a certain amount of wood dust, metal cutting and the like can be put in the roller, different working environments are created under the rotation action of the roller, meanwhile, the sliding blocks matched with the linear guide rail pair to be detected do reciprocating motion on the guide rail, so that the sealing capacity and the dust-proof capacity of the linear guide rail pair to be detected during working can be simulated and tested, and when the linear guide rail pair to be detected is provided with the self-lubricating device, the service life of the self-lubricating device under different working environments can be simulated. In addition, the linear guide pair sealing and self-lubricating performance tester can be used for installing two or more linear guide pairs to be tested in one test according to the width dimension of the mounting seat, so that simultaneous testing of a plurality of linear guide pairs to be tested with different specifications is realized, and the linear guide pair sealing and self-lubricating performance tester is high in efficiency and strong in applicability.

title_en: Chlorine gas component detection box
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of detection boxes, in particular to a chlorine gas component detection box which comprises a shell, wherein a flip cover is rotatably arranged on the top surface of the shell, a through groove is formed in the front surface of the flip cover, a movable groove is formed in the front surface of the shell, a storage structure is arranged on the inner side of the shell and comprises a foam-rubber cushion, the foam-rubber cushion is movably arranged on the inner side of the shell, a storage groove is formed in the top surface of the foam-rubber cushion, a detection device is placed on the inner side of the storage groove, an anti-slip pad is adhered to the top surface of the foam-rubber cushion, and a buckling groove is formed in the top surface of the foam-rubber cushion. According to the utility model, three groups of positioning grooves corresponding to the detection devices are formed in the bottom surface of the foam-rubber cushion, so that the detection devices can be inverted during detection, the detection devices are inserted into the three groups of positioning grooves, the detection devices can be fixed, and the anti-slip cushion can be attached to the table top at the lower side, so that the friction force between the foam-rubber cushion and the table top is increased, and the stability is further improved.

title_en: Soil vertical grinding, sample dividing, weighing and buffering integrated machine
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of soil grinding equipment, and discloses a soil vertical grinding, sample dividing, weighing and buffering integrated machine, which comprises a feed hopper and a grinding mechanism, wherein a frame is sleeved outside the feed hopper, the feed hopper is arranged above the grinding mechanism, the grinding mechanism comprises a grinding cavity, a grinding cavity cover and a grinding stone, a waste material port is fixedly arranged at the lower end of the grinding cavity, the grinding stone is positioned in the grinding cavity, the grinding stone is arranged above the waste material port, a driving motor is arranged at the bottom end of the grinding cavity, a belt is arranged at the back of the driving motor, an eccentric block is fixedly arranged at the back of the grinding cavity, and a weighing and buffering mechanism is arranged at one side of the inside of the frame. The grinding mechanism, the grinding stone, the grinding cavity, the belt wheel, the driving motor and the sample divider are matched for use and are used for buffering materials after sample division, so that the working steps of feeding materials, grinding, sample division, sample collection, cleaning of the grinding cavity and sample weighing buffering are realized, and the working efficiency of the grinding machine can be effectively improved.

title_en: Environment detects with portable indoor formaldehyde detector
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a portable indoor formaldehyde detector for environment detection, which comprises a grab handle arranged below a portable formaldehyde detector main body, wherein the grab handle is detachably connected to the bottom of the portable formaldehyde detector main body, the left end and the right end of the front side and the rear side of an inner cavity of the portable formaldehyde detector main body are respectively and rotatably connected with an upper gear rod, the two upper gear rods on the front side are respectively meshed with the two upper gear rods on the rear side, and the inner cavity of the grab handle is vertically and slidably connected with a U-shaped connecting sheet. According to the portable formaldehyde detector, the grab handle is held, the U-shaped connecting piece is downwards slid, so that the lower gear rod, the gear rod connecting assembly and the upper gear rod are driven to rotate, the portable formaldehyde detector main body is driven to ascend to detect formaldehyde at a high position, and the upper gear rod, the gear rod connecting assembly and the lower gear rod can be folded, so that the portable formaldehyde detector is convenient for a user to carry.

title_en: White spirit turbidity detection device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a white spirit turbidity detection device which comprises a turbidity meter, a control panel, a control mechanism, a display screen, a button, a detection bin, an analysis bottle, an upper cover, a protection mechanism, an anti-slip pad, a protection pad, a lifting mechanism, an air cylinder, an annular seat, a toothed ring, a limiting ring, a sliding chute, a cleaning mechanism, a fixed ring, a cleaning ring, a transmission mechanism, a gear, a fixed seat, a motor, a limiting mechanism, a limiting block and a movable groove, wherein the lifting mechanism is arranged in the detection bin, and the annular seat is arranged at the upper end in the detection bin. Compared with the prior art, the utility model has the advantages that the analysis bottle is more stable to place, the cleaning ring firstly rotates and wipes the analysis bottle from top to bottom, and then wipes the analysis bottle from bottom to top in the opposite direction, so that the stain strips with the same wiping direction can not be left due to the wiping in only one direction, the wiping and cleaning effects are better, and the turbidity detection of the white spirit is more accurate.

title_en: Laboratory operation platform for meat detection
abstract_en: The utility model provides a laboratory operation platform for meat detection, which relates to the technical field of laboratory operation platforms and comprises an operation table, wherein the top of the operation table is fixedly connected with a plurality of fixing rods, the bottom ends of the outer surface walls of the plurality of fixing rods are respectively provided with a socket, the top of the operation table is provided with a mounting groove, the inside of the mounting groove is fixedly provided with a lifting seat, the top of the operation table is fixedly connected with a fixing frame, the outer surface wall of the fixing frame is provided with a plurality of clapboards, the height of an integral device can be adjusted according to the self requirements under the cooperation of the lifting seat, a control button, a controller, an electric telescopic rod and the operation table, so that a worker can conveniently perform detection operation without long-time standing operation, the work efficiency is improved, and then the functions of the operation table are increased through the cooperation of the sockets, the clapboards, a storage box, a box door and a handle, the detection operation is facilitated for the worker, and the multifunction is improved.

title_en: Heavy metal residue detection device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a heavy metal residue detection device which comprises a main body assembly, a cleaning assembly and a limiting assembly, wherein the main body assembly comprises a detection groove and a clamping groove fixed at the top end of the detection groove, the cleaning assembly comprises elastic ropes fixed at the corners inside the clamping groove, a placing plate fixed between the bottom ends of the elastic ropes, a hairbrush fixed on the periphery of the placing plate and a connecting pad fixed at the bottom end of the placing plate, and the limiting assembly comprises limiting plates movably connected to two sides inside the clamping groove. The heavy metal detection device solves the problems that the existing heavy metal detection device needs to change a sample into liquid through a plurality of steps, the liquid is placed in an appliance, then the appliance with the liquid is placed in a clamping groove of the detection device, a cover plate is covered, the detection device can detect the appliances in the clamping groove, and after long-term use, the bottom surface of the inside of the clamping groove is provided with a plurality of sundries which are accumulated, so that the detection effect is affected by the accumulated sundries.

title_en: Seafood transport vechicle monitoring facilities
abstract_en: The utility model discloses monitoring equipment for a seafood transport vehicle, and relates to the field of monitoring equipment. The seafood transport vehicle monitoring equipment comprises a carriage, a storage box and an oxygen monitor, wherein a fixing frame is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the carriage, a rotating rod is rotatably connected to the fixing frame, a supporting unit and a limiting unit are arranged on the rotating rod, the supporting unit is used for traction and support of the rotating rod, and the limiting unit limits the position of a sliding seat through a sliding plate. This seafood transportation car monitoring facilities, through the regulation to the dwang position, accomplish the regulation to oxygen monitor position, after the monitoring is accomplished, rotate with the carriage through promoting the dwang and be parallel, prescribe a limit to the dwang again this moment, can accomodate the oxygen monitor for oxygen monitor and carriage laminating, the oxygen monitor is not sheltered from the seafood transport of being convenient for this moment, avoids the seafood transport to cause the damage to the oxygen monitor simultaneously.

title_en: Bidirectional lamellar shear box device with torsion-resistant function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a bidirectional lamellar shear box device with an anti-torsion function, which is characterized in that a lamellar shear box is formed by stacking 26 layers of regular octagon aluminum alloy frames with H-shaped cross sections, and all layers are connected with each other through an adjustable universal support piece arranged on a frame web. The overrun horizontal displacement between adjacent layered frames is constrained by an adjustable stop assembly mounted on the inside of the frames, and the torsional displacement is limited by a torsional connector mounted on the outside of the adjacent frames. The shear box was internally fitted with a waterproof fabric liner and the bottom frame was equipped with a multi-layer infiltration system. Compared with the prior art, the utility model has the advantages of large vertical depth, small interlayer sliding resistance, no torsion in the bidirectional shearing process, adjustable interlayer clearance and layer height and the like, and is particularly suitable for the 1-G shaking table experiment of large-scale saturated/unsaturated sites under the action of multidirectional earthquake vibration.

title_en: Multifunctional cosmetic composition analysis device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multifunctional cosmetic composition analysis device, which relates to the technical field of cosmetic composition analysis and comprises a crushing cylinder, wherein the bottom end of the crushing cylinder is provided with a supporting cylinder, the inner wall of the supporting cylinder is provided with a heat insulation plate, the middle part of the inner wall of the supporting cylinder is provided with a sealing pipe, the surface of the sealing pipe is provided with an electric heating pipe, the bottom end of the supporting cylinder is provided with a mounting table, the middle part of the mounting table is rotationally connected with a connecting shaft, and the middle part of the connecting shaft is provided with a connecting block.

title_en: Alcohol impurity detection device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of alcohol impurity detection devices, in particular to an alcohol impurity detection device which comprises a bracket and a clamping plate, wherein a top chute of the bracket is in sliding clamping connection with the top of the outer wall of the clamping plate, the right side of the clamping plate is rotationally connected with a second screw rod, the outer wall of the second screw rod is in threaded connection with the right side of the bracket, the right side of the second screw rod is fixedly connected with a second grip, the left side of the bracket is connected with a control structure, a sheath is held in the control structure, the first screw rod is matched with the first grip to enable the end part of the first screw rod to move leftwards, the end part of the first screw rod is separated from the outer wall of a vertical rod, then the vertical rod is conveyed downwards through a top plate and then moves downwards along with a concave plate, so that a shell moves downwards, the shell gradually enters alcohol, the alcohol enters the inside the shell through a notch, the alcohol inside the shell is detected by a detection end of an alcohol detector, the working efficiency of the alcohol impurity detection device is improved, and normal use is ensured.

title_en: Ecological restoration is with detecting tool
abstract_en: The application relates to a detection tool for ecological restoration, which relates to the technical field of ecological restoration and comprises a vehicle body, a detection assembly and a cleaning assembly, wherein the detection assembly comprises a pretreatment part, an acquisition part and a detection part, the pretreatment part, the acquisition part and the detection part are all arranged on the vehicle body, and the pretreatment part is used for cleaning broken stones and weeds in a region to be detected; the collecting part is used for collecting soil in the area to be detected; the cleaning component is arranged on the collecting part and used for cleaning residual soil on the collecting part. The application has the effect of improving the accuracy of the detection result.

title_en: Device for isolating odor from sludge storage workshop and adjacent building
abstract_en: The utility model provides an odor isolation device for a sludge storage workshop and an adjacent building, and relates to the technical field of thermal power generation. The device for isolating odor from the sludge storage workshops and adjacent buildings comprises a wall body arranged between two adjacent buildings, an air supply assembly, an air detection assembly and a control display, wherein the wall body is of a hollow structure with an isolating cavity, an air pipe inlet is formed in the cavity wall of the isolating cavity, the air supply assembly comprises an air supply pipe, one end of the air supply pipe penetrates through the air pipe inlet and stretches into the isolating cavity, the air supply assembly conveys air into the isolating cavity of the wall body through the air supply pipe, the air detection assembly is arranged in the isolating cavity and is used for detecting the odor content in the isolating cavity, and the control display is in signal connection with the air supply assembly and the air detection assembly and is used for controlling the opening and closing of the air supply assembly and displaying the odor content. The odor isolation device for the sludge storage workshop and the adjacent buildings solves the problem that in the prior art, odor in the sludge storage workshop permeates into the adjacent buildings through walls to cause air pollution in working environments.

title_en: Sample gas switching mechanism of analyzer
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of gas detection, in particular to a sample gas switching mechanism of an analyzer, which comprises a box body, a first cache groove and a second cache groove, wherein the first cache groove which is distributed in a linear array in the vertical direction is arranged in the box body, the second cache groove is arranged on one side of the first cache groove, and a gas path consisting of a plurality of pipelines is arranged in the box body and is respectively composed of a first line, a second line, a third line, a fourth line, a fifth line and a sixth line. The device can realize the control effect of single air inlet and mixed air inlet two-in-one type gas feeding by utilizing the multi-line external electric control mode, solves the problems that the existing gas analysis and detection switching mechanism lacks negative pressure vacuum type gas washing effect, lacks single feeding and mixed feeding combining modes, causes the mode of gas feeding to be too single and lacks detecting diversity.

title_en: Specimen detection device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a sample detection device, including sampling subassembly and picture peg subassembly, still include detection subassembly and schizolysis liquid subassembly. The detection assembly is formed by nesting an inner bottle body and an outer bottle body, the plugboard assembly is arranged between the inner bottle body and the outer bottle body, the electrolyte dissolution assembly is arranged in a cavity of the inner bottle body, the electrolyte dissolution assembly comprises a electrolyte dissolution bottle and a sealing film covering the electrolyte dissolution bottle, an overflow hole is formed in the longitudinal direction of the inner bottle body from the bottom, and when the bottom of the electrolyte dissolution bottle contacts with the bottom of the inner bottle body, the height of the electrolyte dissolution assembly is higher than that of the electrolyte dissolution bottle. The device is designed integrally aiming at the sample with small sampling amount and needing to be mixed with the lysate for detection, so that the device is more convenient and fast in the mixing operation of the sample and the lysate, reduces operation pollution and improves accuracy.

title_en: Urine detector and shell thereof
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a urine detector and a shell thereof, wherein the urine detector comprises a pump, a sampling device for receiving a sample, a detection module for detecting the sample, a reagent kit, a plurality of reagent capsules for storing reagents, a flow channel plate and a valve for driving the samples and the reagents to run to the flow channel plate, the plurality of reagent capsules are connected with the reagent kit, the shell comprises a bottom shell and a top shell, the bottom shell is used for being installed on the inner wall of a closestool, and the pump, the detection module, the flow channel plate and the valve are installed. The top shell comprises a first shell and a second shell, wherein the first shell covers the sampling device, the pump, the detection module, the flow channel plate and the valve and is detachably connected with the bottom shell. One part of the second shell is detachably connected with the first shell, and the other part of the second shell is detachably connected with the bottom shell. The kit is detachably connected with the second shell.

title_en: Handheld detector for carbon dioxide emission
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of carbon dioxide emission detection, in particular to a handheld detector for carbon dioxide emission, which comprises a detector body, wherein a detection head is fixedly connected to the surface of the detector body, a control panel is arranged on the surface of the detector body, a supporting mechanism is arranged on the surface of the detector body, the supporting mechanism comprises a limiting plate, the limiting plate is rotatably connected to the surface of the detector body, and a supporting plate is rotatably connected to the surface of the detector body. According to the utility model, the limit plate supports the detector body through the support plate, so that the detector body is inclined on the tabletop, and the inclination angle of the detector body is changed through the difference of the positions of the rectangular holes clamped by the support plate, so that the comfort level of watching and operating of a user is improved, and the user experience is further improved.

title_en: Environment detection device that intelligence precision is high
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of detection devices, in particular to an environment detection device with high intelligent accuracy, which comprises a hardware box, a disassembly and assembly mechanism and a cleaning mechanism, wherein an installation head is installed at the lower end of the hardware box, the lower side of the installation head is provided with the disassembly and assembly mechanism for independently disassembling a detection component, the lower side of the disassembly and assembly mechanism is provided with the cleaning mechanism for brushing dust on the surface of the detection component, and the outer wall of the disassembly and assembly mechanism at the lower side of the cleaning mechanism is provided with an air detection head. According to the utility model, when ambient air is required to be detected, the motor is controlled to operate so as to drive the gear to rotate, the docking rod is pulled downwards so as to separate from the electric connection port, the air detection head can be independently overhauled, the docking rod is directly inserted into the electric connection port upwards after overhauling so as to loosen the tension of the clamping plate, the potential energy is released by the spring, and meanwhile, the clamping plate is pushed into the aligned clamping groove by the hydraulic rod to generate hydraulic thrust, so that the air detection head can be installed, and the use convenience of the detection device is improved.

title_en: Low turbidity measuring device for pipe network water supply
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of pipe network water supply measurement, in particular to a pipe network water supply low turbidity measuring device which comprises a water pipe and L-shaped water supply pipes, wherein a pair of symmetrical L-shaped water supply pipes are arranged at the cambered surface of the lower end of the water pipe, a detecting device is arranged between the pair of L-shaped water supply pipes, the detecting device comprises a protective shell, a pair of fixing grooves are formed in the long vertical surface of the protective shell, L-shaped connecting plates are arranged in the fixing grooves, the fixing grooves and the L-shaped connecting plates are in temporary fixing relation, and can be installed and detached through nuts.

title_en: Reagent system that cold source side was supplied
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a reagent system for cold source side supply, which comprises a reagent bin, a refrigeration module and a driving mechanism, wherein a tray for storing reagents is rotatably arranged in the reagent bin, the driving mechanism is used for driving the tray to rotate, an assembly notch is formed in the side part of the reagent bin, the refrigeration module comprises a semiconductor refrigeration element and a cold circulation fan, the semiconductor refrigeration element is provided with a hot side and a cold side, the semiconductor refrigeration element is arranged at the position of the assembly notch, the cold side is positioned in the reagent bin, the hot side is positioned outside the reagent bin, and the cold circulation fan is arranged at the cold side. The utility model has the beneficial effects of improving the cooling effect and the heat dissipation efficiency and simultaneously has the technical advantages of simple and compact structure.

title_en: Circulation ventilation device for mine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a circulating ventilation device for mines, in particular to the technical field of mine circulating ventilation, which comprises an air inlet output part, the front end of the air inlet output part is provided with an air draft detection part, and the air inlet output part and the air draft detection part are parallel front and back and are all installed on the left side and the right side of the inner end of the mine. According to the circulating ventilation device for the mine, water is conveyed to the rear end of the air supply fan through the water conveying pipe and extruded and sprayed out through the pressure component, water mist is guaranteed to pass through the air supply fan, ignition caused by static electricity generated by rotation friction of the air supply fan in a dry environment is prevented, the temperature in the mine is reduced, the working environment of mining personnel is guaranteed, air in the mine is monitored in real time through the detection component when the air is discharged, and after toxic gas is detected at a certain position by the detection component, the air supply fan at the corresponding position and the power can be increased to accelerate the discharge of the toxic gas.

title_en: Sample frame blocking device in chemiluminescent immunoassay analyzer track
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sample rack blocking device in a chemiluminescent immunoassay analyzer track, which comprises a motor, a first support frame, a switching block and a baffle plate, wherein the motor is arranged on the first support frame, the switching block is connected to an output shaft of the motor, and the baffle plate is fixedly connected with the switching block. The sensor support plate comprises a fixing part and a bending part, the fixing part is fixedly connected with the lower end of the first support frame, the bending part is perpendicular to the fixing part, and the first optical coupler sensor and the second optical coupler sensor are arranged on the bending part. The lower extreme of baffle is provided with first separation blade and the second separation blade of the cooperation of second opto-coupler sensor with first opto-coupler sensor cooperation. The sample rack blocking device in the chemiluminescent immunoassay analyzer rail provided by the utility model avoids liquid sputtering generated by collision of the sample rack, and increases safety and stability.

title_en: Printing ink detects sample thief
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an ink detection sampler which comprises a detection frame, wherein a beam plate is arranged at the top end of the detection frame, a first non-bar cylinder is arranged on the surface of the lower end of the beam plate, a first sliding column is arranged on the surface of the first non-bar cylinder, a printing positioning machine table is arranged below an ink detection mechanism, a fixed frame is arranged on the printing positioning machine table, a second non-bar cylinder is arranged on the fixed frame, a second sliding column is arranged on the surface of the second non-bar cylinder, and a lifting pedestal is fixedly connected to the surface of the second sliding column through a lifting sliding sleeve. The printing ink detection mechanism is assembled and fixed conveniently, has the advantage of convenience in disassembly and assembly control, can be used for rapidly positioning and adjusting the installation position of the printing ink detection mechanism, is convenient for the printing ink detection sensor to detect printing ink on the surface of the printing plate, and simultaneously has lifting positioning and adjusting functions, and is convenient for the sensor to be attached to the printing plate.

title_en: Closed test box for decontamination of supercritical carbon dioxide flow-carried dry ice particles
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of nuclear facility retirement, in particular to a closed test box for removing dirt of dry ice particles carried by supercritical carbon dioxide flow, which comprises a supporting seat, wherein the upper end of the supporting seat is fixedly connected with a box body, the inside of the box body is fixedly connected with a first pipeline and a second pipeline, the inside of the supporting seat is connected with two baffles through a driving mechanism, the inside of the supporting seat is fixedly connected with a guide rail and a bearing seat, the inside of the guide rail is slidably connected with a rack, the inside of the bearing seat is rotatably connected with a rotating shaft, the baffles are fixedly arranged at the front end of the rotating shaft, the rear end of the rotating shaft is fixedly connected with a gear, the gear is meshed with the rack, the inside of the supporting seat is fixedly connected with an electric telescopic rod through a fixing seat, the output end of the electric telescopic rod is fixedly connected with a connecting block, and the connecting block is fixedly connected with the rack. According to the utility model, under the action of the baffle and the driving mechanism, the experiment bench is not only conveniently installed in the box body, but also conveniently taken out from the box body.

title_en: Carbonization test box with stirring device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of carbonization tests of materials, in particular to a carbonization test box with a stirring device, which comprises a carbonization test box body and a stirring device which is positioned in the carbonization test box body and driven by a motor, wherein the stirring device comprises a stirring pot, a stirring rod with a paddle blade and a rotating shaft connected with the stirring rod, the stirring rod is positioned in the stirring pot, the rotating shaft is connected with a driving shaft of the motor, a fixing rod for limiting and fixing the carbonization test box body is arranged outside the stirring pot, the motor and the stirring device are mutually separated through a baffle plate, a sealing ring is arranged at the joint of the rotating shaft and the baffle plate, and a CO  2  air inlet is arranged in the carbonization test box body. According to the carbonization test box with the stirring device, the stirring device is integrated in the carbonization test box, so that the powder or slurry is continuously stirred in the carbonization process, the carbonization reaction is more uniform, the contact area between CO  2  and the powder can be increased in the stirring process, and the carbonization efficiency is improved.

title_en: Methane intelligent detector
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent methane detector which comprises an instrument body arranged in a protective shell, wherein a shell is arranged on the back surface of the protective shell, a screw rod is rotatably connected to the upper end and the lower end of the interior of the shell, and the screw rod is abutted to a knob at the lower end of the shell. The utility model designs the shell, the screw rod, the lifting block, the U-shaped handle, the knob, the bent rod, the first butt joint plate, the second butt joint plate and the positioning component, when in use, the instrument body is arranged in the protective shell, the two parts are connected together through the positioning component, the U-shaped handle is held by hands when in transportation, and when in use, the top cover is taken down, the instrument body is moved out to detect, the instrument body is stored again after detection, the instrument body is more stable during transportation and use, the protective shell and the instrument body form a connecting structure, meanwhile, the instrument body is small in size and more convenient to carry, and the problems that the handheld laborious box of the traditional technology is inconvenient to store and the carrying box is large in size are solved.

title_en: Soil moisture content monitoring device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a soil moisture content monitoring device, which belongs to the technical field of soil moisture content monitoring and comprises a working rod, a first working box, a miniature meteorological sensor, a camera, a solar cell panel, a soil temperature and humidity sensor, a soil pH value sensor and a soil nitrogen, phosphorus and potassium sensor, wherein the soil temperature and humidity sensor, the soil pH value sensor and the soil nitrogen, phosphorus and potassium sensor are electrically connected with the first working box and are used for being inserted into soil, and a power module, a data acquisition and control module and a communication module are arranged in the first working box. The utility model can monitor a plurality of air data and soil data, provides a plurality of data supports for seedling raising work of a seed garden, can adjust angles through the driving component, adapts to solar irradiation angles in different seasons, improves the generating capacity of the solar cell panel, can store a plurality of fertilizers through the arrangement of the fertilizing component, and can automatically supplement corresponding fertilizers when the soil fertility is insufficient, and improve the soil fertility degree.

title_en: Continuous type food detects with water bath sterilization equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of water bath sterilization, and discloses continuous water bath sterilization equipment for food detection, which comprises a fixed bottom plate, a water bath sterilization box and an electric heating pipe, the right side position at fixed bottom plate top is fixed with the storage water tank, the water bath sterilization case top is located the outside position of second drainage tube and installs the spacing. According to the utility model, the water storage tank is arranged on the side edge of the top end of the fixed bottom plate, the electric heating pipe is used for heating the water source in the water bath sterilization box, when the water source is needed to be supplemented, the pump body can be started to work and then the water source in the water storage tank is extracted under the connection of the first drainage tube, the hanging ring is arranged on the top of the water storage tank, the hanging ring and the floating ball are connected and pulled by the connecting wire, the floating ball floats along with the water level in the water storage tank, when the water source in the water storage tank is insufficient, the connecting wire is gradually tightened, and the floating ball directly falls downwards to press the touch button, so that the integral water source adding capability is better improved in the working process.

title_en: Automatic die rod sleeving and detecting mechanism for condom
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an automatic condom sleeving detection mould rod mechanism which comprises a storage box, a blower and a plurality of hovering components, wherein the plurality of hovering components are respectively communicated with the storage box, the plurality of hovering components are also respectively connected with the blower, the blower is used for enabling negative pressure to be generated inside the hovering components so as to enable condom products to sequentially enter the hovering components from the storage box, guide claw components are arranged below the hovering components in one-to-one correspondence, detection mould rods are obliquely arranged below the guide claw components in one-to-one correspondence, the detection mould rods are matched with the guide claw components and can completely penetrate through the guide claw components, the guide claw components do arc reciprocating motion through the deflection guide components, and therefore the guide claw components catch the condom products falling from the hovering components and are propped up to be sleeved on the detection mould rods. The utility model can be sleeved with a plurality of products at the same time, reduces labor cost, reduces labor intensity of workers, improves production efficiency, reduces manual contact probability and reduces pollution risk.

title_en: Water-meeting chromogenic absorbent paper, timing device for immunochromatography diagnostic detection, early pregnancy detection reagent plate, immunochromatography reaction timing detection plate and saliva collecting device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water-meeting color development water-absorbing paper, a timing device for immunochromatography diagnosis and detection, an early pregnancy detection reagent board, an immunochromatography reaction timing detection board and a saliva acquisition device, which relate to the field of water-absorbing paper for in-vitro diagnosis and comprise a water-absorbing filter paper layer and a covering layer, wherein a color layer is arranged between the water-absorbing filter paper layer and the covering layer, the color layer is printed with a color different from white, and the covering layer is provided with a water-absorbing transparent white coating; through setting up colour layer and covering layer, utilize the covering layer to meet the water and become transparent nature to whether can see the colour layer, judge whether liquid collects abundant, and/or timing function, improve detection efficiency and accuracy.

title_en: Installation structure of detection device in riser
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of detection, and particularly relates to a mounting structure of a detection device in a riser pipe, which comprises a workbench and a mounting table fixedly connected to the top of the workbench, wherein one side of the mounting table is provided with a detection mechanism, and the detection mechanism comprises an adjusting block, a threaded rod III, a rotary handle III, a movable pull rod, a pull rod handle, a detection probe, a limiting through hole and a chute. This detection device's mounting structure in riser, through the detection mechanism who sets up, fixed riser through fixed establishment, adjust the position of regulating plate and push pedal, make the rubber slab of push pedal bottom press from both sides riser clamp, fix the riser of common size can be according to the riser diameter of difference to detecting probe's position regulation, and can manual control detecting probe's moving speed, the clear position in the testing process can sweep directly, and more ambiguous position can carry out more careful detection, in order to ensure the efficiency and the rate of accuracy of detection.

title_en: Gas production explosion experimental device for integrated battery
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of battery fire extinguishment and provides an integrated battery gas production explosion experiment device which comprises a gas analysis assembly, a thermal runaway trigger assembly and an explosion overpressure test assembly. A variety of thermal runaway conditions corresponding to the thermal runaway trigger assembly may be initiated alone or in combination according to experimental requirements to simulate thermal runaway of the battery under different scenarios. After the thermal runaway is triggered, the gas analysis component can collect a gas sample released by the battery and convey the gas sample to the analysis instrument for detection, and data such as the proportion of gas components, the change trend and the like can be obtained through comparative analysis, so that an important basis is provided for the evaluation of the safety performance of the battery. The gas sample released by the battery can also enter an explosion overpressure test assembly to perform explosion experiments on gas ignition, and meanwhile, different types of fire extinguishing agents can be sprayed at specific time points to evaluate the inhibition effect of the fire extinguishing agents on explosion overpressure.

title_en: Crease-resistant performance test equipment of cloth
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cloth crease resistance test device, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a horizontal supporting plate is connected to the bottom plate through a connecting rod, a driving mechanism with a downward driving end is arranged on the supporting plate, a coaxial rotating plate is arranged at the driving end of the driving mechanism, a fixed plate is connected to the lower side of the rotating plate through an elastic piece, a first clamping mechanism is arranged at the lower side of the fixed plate, and a second clamping mechanism which is vertically compared with the first clamping mechanism is arranged on the bottom plate. The crease resistance test equipment for the cloth is convenient for comparing the folds of the common cloth and the crease-resistant treated cloth.

title_en: Lithium hexafluorophosphate preparation sampling analysis device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a lithium hexafluorophosphate preparation sampling analysis device, and relates to the technical field of lithium hexafluorophosphate packaging treatment. The lithium hexafluorophosphate tube comprises a tube body, wherein a liquid extraction cap is arranged at one end of the tube body and used for extracting solution dissolved in lithium hexafluorophosphate, a stress plate used for stress is arranged outside the other end of the tube body, a drawing piece is connected inside the tube body in a sliding mode and used for extracting the solution dissolved in lithium hexafluorophosphate from the liquid extraction cap to the inside of the tube body, a gap is formed in the rod body part of the drawing piece, an electronic detector and a storage barrel are detachably arranged at the top of the tube body respectively, the electronic detector is used for detecting the solubility of the lithium hexafluorophosphate in the solution, and the storage barrel is used for storing lithium hexafluorophosphate crystals obtained after preparation. The utility model integrates the functions of liquid suction, filtration, dissolution detection, discharge and the like, thereby remarkably improving the convenience and efficiency of operation.

title_en: Automatic water sample collection system based on many rotor unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic water sample collection device based on a multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle, a sampling container and water taking mechanical facilities, wherein a rope is arranged at the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle, the upper end of the rope is fixed on the unmanned aerial vehicle, the lower end of the rope is fixedly provided with the sampling container, each water taking mechanical facility matched with the sampling container is arranged at each water taking point, the unmanned aerial vehicle drives the sampling container to fly to the water taking point independently through the rope, and the sampling container is matched with the water taking mechanical facilities to perform water taking operation. The utility model can sample water quality of water taking points and water quality monitoring stations to replace manual operation to a certain extent, thereby reducing manpower input and workload and improving working efficiency.

title_en: Automatic inspection equipment for coal mine security inspection
abstract_en: The utility model discloses automatic inspection equipment for coal mine security inspection, which comprises an equipment box, wherein a driving frame is fixedly connected to the top of the equipment box, driving wheels are arranged at the top of the driving frame, guide wheels are arranged on two sides of the driving frame, a monitoring probe is arranged at the bottom of the equipment box, a gas probe is arranged on one side, close to a screen of the monitoring probe, of the equipment box, a cleaning box is fixedly connected to the outer part of the gas probe, a filtering cover is fixedly connected to the outer part of the cleaning box, and a sliding seat is arranged at one end of the inner part of the cleaning box. According to the utility model, the pump body, the sliding seat, the air nozzle and the filter cover are matched with each other, and in the use process of the track type intelligent inspection robot, the back flushing is carried out in the cleaning box outside the probe through the pump body, so that the impurities embedded and accumulated on the gas probe filter cover are conveniently discharged, the circulation rate of gas entering the gas probe is ensured, and the accuracy of the track type inspection robot on gas component analysis is conveniently improved.

title_en: Urine analysis device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a urine analysis device which comprises a support, a urine receiving table, a test paper carrying table, a test paper placing cavity, a plurality of slots and a wiping mechanism, wherein the urine receiving table is arranged on the support in a movable mode, a mounting cavity is arranged on the support, the test paper carrying table is arranged in the mounting cavity, a urine storage groove is formed between the lower surface of the test paper carrying table and the bottom of the mounting cavity, the test paper carrying table is provided with the test paper placing cavity, the bottom of the test paper placing cavity is provided with the plurality of holes communicated with the urine storage groove, a slot communicated with the urine storage groove is formed in one side wall of the urine receiving table, the wiping mechanism stretches into the urine storage groove after passing through the slot, and the wiping mechanism is in contact with the lower surface of the test paper carrying table and the bottom of the urine storage groove. According to the embodiment, exuded urine can be timely erased, peculiar smell is removed, liquid-absorbing cotton can be conveniently replaced, and the working efficiency is improved.

title_en: Sewage water source monitoring equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to monitoring equipment, in particular to sewage source monitoring equipment. The utility model provides sewage source monitoring equipment which comprises a water collecting cylinder, a weight increasing block, a cylinder cover, an analyzer, a sewage probe and a check probe, wherein a water inlet and a water outlet are formed in the water collecting cylinder, the weight increasing block is fixedly connected to the lower portion of the water collecting cylinder, the cylinder cover is connected to the upper portion of the water collecting cylinder through threads, the analyzer is installed in the cylinder cover, the sewage probe is installed at the lower portion of the analyzer, the check probe is installed at the other side of the lower portion of the analyzer, and the sewage probe and the check probe penetrate through the cylinder cover. The utility model performs verification by pouring a clean water source into the water purifying bottle, and the verification probe transmits collected data to the sensor so as to calibrate the system, thereby ensuring the accuracy of subsequent water quality detection.

title_en: Venlafaxine and desmethylvenlafaxine blood concentration detection kit
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a venlafaxine and norvenlafaxine blood concentration detection kit, which comprises a venlafaxine Xin Shiji box and a venlafaxine detection reagent bottle, wherein a sealing cover is connected at the top opening of the venlafaxine Xin Shiji box in a threaded manner, a plurality of venlafaxine detection reagent bottles are supported and fixed on the inner side of the venlafaxine Xin Shiji box through a positioning and mounting mechanism, a mixing mechanism is arranged at the bottom of the positioning and mounting mechanism, the venlafaxine detection reagent bottle for detecting the venlafaxine can be supported and placed through the design of internal parts of the positioning and mounting mechanism, the bottom of the venlafaxine detection reagent bottle enters the inside of a connecting barrel, and then the placed venlafaxine detection reagent bottle can be vibrated through the design of internal parts of the mixing mechanism, so that additives and the venlafaxine in the venlafaxine detection reagent bottle can be fully mixed together, and further the efficiency and effect of the subsequent venlafaxine are improved.

title_en: Hydrogen sulfide gas analyzer with safety discharge structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a hydrogen sulfide gas analyzer with a safe discharge structure, which comprises a hydrogen sulfide gas analyzer body, a safe discharge mechanism and a rotating assembly, wherein the hydrogen sulfide gas analyzer body comprises a machine body, an air inlet pipe and an air outlet pipe, the air inlet pipe is fixedly arranged on one side of the machine body, the air outlet pipe is fixedly arranged on the other side of the machine body, the safe discharge mechanism is arranged on the air outlet pipe, the safe discharge mechanism comprises the rotating assembly, the rotating assembly comprises an open slot, a movable block, a rotating slot, a ring gear block, a positioning slot, a transmission rod, a ventilation plate and a storage block, the air outlet pipe is provided with the open slot, the movable block is inserted into the open slot, the movable block is provided with the rotating slot, the ring gear block is arranged in the rotating slot, two positioning slots are symmetrically arranged on two sides of the open slot, the transmission rod is fixedly arranged on the ring gear block, the ventilation plate is arranged in the air outlet pipe, the two storage blocks are symmetrically fixedly arranged on two sides of the ventilation plate, and the hydrogen sulfide gas analyzer with the safe discharge structure can rapidly process the hydrogen sulfide gas which detects the exceeding standard.

title_en: Surface defect detection equipment for machining automobile parts
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of surface defect detection of automobile parts and discloses surface defect detection equipment for processing the automobile parts, which comprises a base, wherein two vertical plates are fixedly connected to the upper surface of the base, guide grooves are formed in the surfaces of one side, opposite to the two vertical plates, of each guide groove, grooves are formed in the inner walls of two sides of each guide groove, guide blocks are slidingly connected in the guide grooves, rotating rods are rotatably connected to the surfaces of the guide blocks, clamping assemblies are arranged at the ends of the rotating rods, gears are sleeved outside the rotating rods, teeth of the gears extend into the two grooves, the two threaded rods are synchronously rotated through operation of a driving assembly, and then turn-over of the automobile parts is completed.

title_en: Desk-top multidimensional dangerous liquid detector
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of safety detection, and provides a table type multidimensional dangerous liquid detector which comprises a code scanning module, a detection module, a control module and a printing module, wherein the code scanning module is used for scanning a container to generate code scanning information, the detection module is used for detecting substances to be detected in the container, the control module is in communication connection with a server and is electrically connected with the code scanning module and the detection module, and the printing module is electrically connected with the control module and/or the control module and prints and generates labels comprising the article information and/or the category to which the article information belongs. The table type multidimensional dangerous liquid detector provided by the utility model realizes efficient and accurate detection and identification of liquid substances by integrating the code scanning module, the detection module, the control module and the printing module. The detector not only can rapidly acquire the component information of the liquid, but also can acquire additional information such as sources, purposes and the like of the liquid through a code scanning function, thereby realizing comprehensive evaluation of liquid substances.

title_en: Hydrologic water resource monitoring device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of hydrologic monitoring and discloses a hydrologic water resource monitoring device which comprises a float base, wherein a sampling pipe is rotatably connected to the inner wall of the float base, water inlets are formed in the left side and the right side of the outer wall of the sampling pipe, a stop block is slidably connected to the inner wall of the sampling pipe, a telescopic rod is fixedly connected to the top of the stop block, a float cover plate is fixedly connected to the top of the telescopic rod, the float cover plate is clamped with the float base, and a probe sensor is fixedly connected to the front side of the bottom end of the float base. According to the utility model, the telescopic rod is controlled to drive the stop block to move upwards, so that the water inlets on the left side and the right side of the sampling tube are exposed for sampling, and after sampling is finished, the telescopic rod extends out to stop the water inlets, so that sampling of a water sample is finished, the probe sensor is contacted with the water, and various parameters of the water body can be sensed, so that the problem that the water to be detected cannot be automatically sampled and detected is solved.

title_en: Portable water conservancy water and electricity quality of water short-term test case
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a portable water conservancy and hydropower water quality rapid detection box, which relates to the technical field of water quality detection and comprises a box body, wherein an auxiliary component is arranged at one end of the box body, a screen is arranged at the other end of the box body, a first detection component is arranged in the box body, a temperature measurement component is arranged on the inner wall of the box body, a second detection component is arranged in the other end of the box body, a third detection component is arranged at the top of the box body, and a signal receiving control system is externally connected with the first detection component, the second detection component and the third detection component. Through the cooperation of first detection subassembly, second detection subassembly and third detection subassembly and temperature measurement subassembly's twice measurement, can acquire a plurality of water quality testing data. The comparison of the data can evaluate the water quality more accurately, and the detection accuracy is improved. Meanwhile, the multiple detection mechanism is also beneficial to quickly identifying the water quality problem and improving the detection efficiency.

title_en: Environment-friendly air quality detector for ecological environment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an environment-friendly air quality detector for ecological environment, which relates to the field of air quality detectors, and comprises a bottom plate, the equipment main part is installed at the top of bottom plate, and the dead lever is all installed to the inside both sides of equipment main part, and is connected with between two dead levers and places the board. According to the utility model, the second fan can be started when dust or impurities accumulated on the top of the placing plate are required to be blown away, meanwhile, a worker can rotate the rotating shaft through the rotating handle, the rotating shaft rotates to drive the reciprocating screw rod to rotate, the reciprocating screw rod drives the movable seat to move and then drives the second fan to move, and meanwhile, the second fan is started to work, so that air can be blown in the direction of the air quality detector, dust or impurities attached to the surfaces of the placing plate and the air quality detector can be blown away, a large amount of impurities or dust is prevented from being accumulated on the placing plate or the air quality detector, and the cleaning efficiency of the top of the placing plate is improved.

title_en: Sulfur determination instrument auxiliary tool for mineral detection
abstract_en: The application discloses a sulfur determination instrument auxiliary tool for mineral detection, and relates to the technical field of mineral detection. The porcelain boat is technically characterized by comprising a porcelain boat with an open top, a cover plate is covered above the porcelain boat, a feeding module is arranged in the middle of the upper side of the cover plate, an external feeding through hole is arranged in the center of the feeding module, an internal feeding through hole which is communicated with the external feeding through hole is arranged on the cover plate at the position corresponding to the external feeding through hole, a downward-extending downward-turning edge is integrally formed on two sides of the width direction of the cover plate respectively, and the distance between the mutually close sides of the two downward-turning edges at the same height is equal to the width of the porcelain boat at the corresponding position.
