The cover plate is additionally arranged on the porcelain boat, so that materials in the porcelain boat can be effectively prevented from being spilled out of the porcelain boat in the shaking process of the porcelain boat, and correspondingly, the loss of the weight of the sample in the porcelain boat caused by spilled materials can be avoided, so that the precision of the final sulfur determination instrument for detecting the sulfur content of the sample is ensured.

title_en: Waterproof coating test equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses waterproof paint testing equipment which comprises a water receiving tank, a clamping assembly, a pumping assembly and a pumping assembly, wherein an opening communicated with the inside of the water receiving tank is formed in the top of the water receiving tank, the clamping assembly comprises a driving unit and a clamping gripper, the driving unit is positioned at the bottom of the water receiving tank and is provided with a mounting part protruding out of the end face of the water receiving tank, the clamping jaw is configured to clamp one end of a cloth to be tested, the clamping jaw is arranged at the mounting part and is positioned at the lower side of the opening, the driving unit is used for driving the clamping jaw to be far away from or close to the end face of the water receiving tank, and the pumping assembly is used for pumping air in the water receiving tank. The technical scheme is beneficial to reducing the cost.

title_en: Water surface monitoring device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water surface monitoring device, which relates to the technical field of water surface monitoring, in particular to a water surface monitoring device, comprising an outer ring, wherein a monitoring main body is arranged on the inner side of the outer ring, an inclined photovoltaic plate is arranged on the side wall of the monitoring main body, and a semi-submerged floating bridge mechanism capable of injecting water is arranged at the bottom of the outer ring; the bottom of the floating bridge mechanism is fixedly connected with a positioning anchor assembly, a standby floating assembly is fixedly arranged in the outer ring and is not in contact with the water surface, an arc-shaped protection rod is movably sleeved on the outer ring in a circular shape, and one end of the protection rod is limited on the side surface of the top end of the monitoring main body and protects the photovoltaic panel. Through the water injection in stand and annular pontoon to adopt semi-submerged formula design, make its focus be in under water, the focus is lower, and stability is better, and under the resistance effect of water, improve its stability once more, so that it can be better correspond the produced impact of unrestrained.

title_en: Durable soil matrix potential detection device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a durable soil matrix potential detection device which comprises a ceramic head mechanism, a sealing connecting piece, a pressure detection module, a polycarbonate tube, a gas collecting tube and a sealing cover, wherein the ceramic head mechanism comprises a plurality of ceramic heads and ceramic head reinforcing pieces, the ceramic heads are of round-bottom tubular structures, the ceramic head reinforcing pieces are arranged in the side walls of the ceramic heads and are uniformly distributed along the circumference of the central axis of the ceramic heads, the upper ends of the sealing connecting pieces are detachably connected with the lower ends of the polycarbonate tube, connecting cavities are arranged in the lower ends of the sealing connecting pieces, connecting sections are arranged at the upper ends of the ceramic heads, the ceramic heads are installed in the connecting cavities through the connecting sections, the upper ends of the gas collecting tube are connected with the sealing cover, and the lower ends of the gas collecting tube are connected with the upper ends of the polycarbonate tube.

title_en: Integrated gas detector
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of industrial detection, and particularly provides an integrated gas detector, aiming at the efficiency problem, the integrated gas detector comprises a gas collecting detector body, wherein an air cavity is fixedly connected to the lower surface of the gas collecting detector body, a mounting disc is fixedly connected to the outer surface of one side of the gas collecting detector body, a fixing plate is fixedly connected to the outer circumferential surface of the mounting disc, a mounting shell is fixedly connected to the outer surface of one side of the gas collecting detector body, a mounting hole is formed in the outer surface of the mounting shell, a sliding groove is formed in the inner surface of the mounting shell, a fixing block is slidably arranged on the inner surface of the sliding groove, a spring is fixedly connected to the outer surface of one side of the fixing block, and a connecting rope is fixedly connected to the outer surface of one side of the fixing block. Through the setting of mounting disc and fixed block, realized can collect gas type gas detector body and install in different carrier surfaces, improved the efficiency and the application scope of installation.

title_en: Equipment for detecting residual antioxidant content in industrial lubricating oil in work
abstract_en: The utility model provides equipment for detecting the content of residual antioxidants in industrial lubricating oil in work, which belongs to the technical field of detection equipment and comprises a fixed rod, a fixed rod clamped at the bottom of the fixed rod, a moving groove arranged in an inner cavity of the fixed rod, a fixed column inserted in the center of the moving groove, an adjusting component sleeved on the side surface of the fixed column, a rotating component fixedly arranged on the side wall of the adjusting component and a detecting component rotatably arranged on the inner surface of the rotating component. The utility model realizes more accurate detection of the residual antioxidant content in the industrial lubricating oil through the matching use of the adjusting component, the rotating component and the detecting component, improves the detection accuracy and reliability, and simultaneously, is convenient for maintenance on one hand and enhances the stability and durability of the equipment on the other hand through the matching use of the structures, thereby effectively guaranteeing the lubricating performance of the industrial equipment, prolonging the service life of the equipment and reducing the maintenance cost.

title_en: Uniform bubbling device suitable for high-temperature environment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of gasifiers, in particular to a uniform bubbling device suitable for a high-temperature environment, after an experimental kettle and a melting kettle use the device, the gas of the bubbling device is easier to contact with a test solvent for thorough mixing, the bubbling device in the experimental kettle enables gas atmosphere control to be more accurate, the structural style of the uniform bubbling device is changed, a ring-shaped bubbling pipe style is additionally provided with a plurality of holes for welding a filter disc, the gas can be uniformly discharged from the inside of a ring-shaped pipe for being fully contacted with medium in the kettle, the device adopts the mode that the filter disc is welded on a stainless steel pipe, large-particle impurities can be effectively prevented from entering the inside of the bubbling pipe, the discharge of the gas in the bubbling pipe is not influenced, the experiment is not influenced, the bubbling device uses the stainless steel pipe for welding processing, and the bubbling device has simple processing technology and low cost and can also be used in the high-temperature environment.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted integrated sensor
abstract_en: The utility model provides a vehicle-mounted integrated sensor, which comprises an AQS sensor and a main sensor, wherein the main sensor comprises an upper cover, a lower cover and a PCBA (printed circuit board assembly) board, the upper cover and the lower cover are mutually covered and fixed, the PCBA board is fixed between the upper cover and the lower cover, a fan, a PM2.5 sensing module and a carbon dioxide concentration sensing module are integrated on the PCBA board, a fan cavity communicated with the air inlet, an air outlet, a first air channel and a second air channel communicated with the fan cavity and the air outlet are arranged on the lower cover, the fan is accommodated in the fan cavity, the PM2.5 sensing module and the carbon dioxide concentration sensing module are respectively arranged on the first air channel and the second air channel, and the AQS sensor is connected with the PCBA board of the main sensor through a signal transmission line to form signal transmission. The complex structure designed in one sensor is omitted, and an air pipe connected with a transmission air conditioner box is not required to be added, so that the layout in the vehicle is simplified. The integrated level is high, the volume is small, and the parts are few.

title_en: Soil moisture content monitoring facilities
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of soil moisture content monitoring, in particular to soil moisture content monitoring equipment which comprises an upright post and an embedding device, wherein a fixing frame is arranged on the upright post, a monitoring box is arranged on the fixing frame, the embedding device comprises a mounting cylinder, a rotating shaft rotatably arranged on the mounting cylinder, a hand wheel and a first gear which are coaxially arranged at two ends of the rotating shaft respectively, a connecting shaft rotatably arranged inside the mounting cylinder and provided with a threaded part, a second gear coaxially arranged on the connecting shaft, a threaded cylinder in threaded connection with the threaded part, four guide blocks distributed on the threaded cylinder in annular arrays, a sliding block arranged on the guide block and a soil sensor probe arranged on the sliding block, and the first gear and the second gear are in meshed connection. The utility model not only can quickly and stably embed the detection sensor into the soil and reduce the influence degree on the soil structure, but also reduces the operation workload and improves the practicability of the equipment.

title_en: Saliva HIV antibody short-term test kit
abstract_en: The utility model provides a saliva HIV antibody rapid detection kit, which belongs to the field of antibody detection and comprises a box body, wherein a box cover is rotatably arranged on one side of the box body, a cavity is formed in the box body, a detection component is arranged in the cavity, and a mixing component is arranged at one end of the detection component. According to the utility model, through the detection assembly, when in detection, three groups of detection test papers are positioned in the box body, detection of three groups of samples can be simultaneously carried out, so that the detection efficiency is improved, as one end of the detection test papers is inserted into the slot on the sponge plug, the end part of the detection test papers can be protected in the moving process to prevent damage, meanwhile, the three groups of detection test papers are separated by the partition plate to prevent the samples on the three groups of detection test papers from being polluted by mutual contact, and after detection is finished, the cleaning roller can be moved to clean the surfaces of the detection test papers to prevent the samples from polluting the inside of the box body.

title_en: Critical oxygen analysis device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a critical oxygen analysis device which comprises an oxygen analyzer body and a protection box, wherein the protection box is sleeved on the outer surface of the bottom end of the oxygen analyzer body, a vent pipe is arranged outside the oxygen analyzer body, one end of the vent pipe is fixedly provided with an air suction head, grooves are formed in the inner walls of two sides of the protection box, a threaded rod is rotatably connected in one groove, and the threaded rod penetrates through the inner wall of the groove and extends to the upper surface of the protection box. According to the oxygen analyzer, the oxygen analyzer body, the protection box, the grooves, the threaded rods, the rotating blocks, the limiting rods, the movable blocks and the like are matched, so that the function of containing and protecting the oxygen analyzer is achieved, the oxygen analyzer body is contained in the protection box, the oxygen analyzer body is prevented from being damaged due to external collision and installation, the safety of the oxygen analyzer is improved, and the practicability of the oxygen analyzer is improved.

title_en: Multi-angle flaw detection auxiliary device for welding line of high-pressure oil pipeline
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of pipeline flaw detection, in particular to a multi-angle flaw detection auxiliary device for a weld joint of a high-pressure oil pipeline, which comprises a first support frame and a second support frame, wherein the inner surfaces of the first support frame and the second support frame are respectively provided with a fixing mechanism, one fixing mechanism is connected with a gear sleeve, one side of the first support frame is provided with a driving mechanism, the driving mechanism is meshed with the gear sleeve, and an adjusting mechanism is arranged between the tops of the first support frame and the second support frame.

title_en: On-line monitoring equipment scale inhibition device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a scale inhibition device of on-line monitoring equipment, which is characterized in that a scale inhibition pool and a scale inhibition agent feeding device are arranged between a water sample preparation device and the on-line monitoring equipment, the output end of the water sample preparation device is connected with a water inlet/air hole at the bottom of the scale inhibition pool through a water supply/air pipe, the scale inhibition agent feeding device comprises a scale inhibition agent storage bottle, a scale inhibition agent feeding pipe and a dosing pump, the output end of the scale inhibition agent storage bottle is connected with a scale inhibition agent feeding hole of the scale inhibition pool through the scale inhibition agent feeding pipe, the dosing pump is arranged on the scale inhibition agent feeding pipe, and a monitoring sampling hole of the scale inhibition pool is connected with a sampling end of the on-line monitoring equipment through a sampling pipe. Through the mode, the scale inhibition and scale dissolution of the on-line monitoring equipment system can be effectively realized, so that the running stability and reliability of the on-line monitoring equipment are ensured, and the running cost of the on-line monitoring equipment is reduced.

title_en: Crucible access device and full moisture test system
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of sample total moisture measurement, and discloses a crucible access device and a total moisture test system. When the crucible is stored, the crucible is placed at the corresponding placement position from the storage port, and the placement tray is driven to rotate through the driving mechanism, so that the storage port sequentially corresponds to different placement positions, and the crucible is sequentially placed at the placement position; when the crucible is taken out, the placing plate is driven to rotate through the driving mechanism, so that the placing positions sequentially correspond to the taking-out openings, the crucible placed at the placing positions can be rotated to the taking-out opening first, the crucible is placed and taken out sequentially, a certain cooling time can be provided for each crucible, and the crucible temperature is prevented from being too high. Furthermore, each placing plate corresponds to a driving mechanism, so that each placing plate can independently rotate, the placing plates are not mutually influenced, and the crucible is taken out more flexibly.

title_en: Device for simulating air injection oxidation effect of water-containing oil reservoir
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of oilfield production, in particular to a device for simulating an air injection oxidation effect of an aqueous oil reservoir, which comprises a containing bin, a first bottle body, a second bottle body and a third bottle body. The first end of the receiving compartment communicates with the first outlet valve and the second outlet valve, respectively. The first bottle body is communicated with the accommodating bin through a first pipeline and a first valve. The second bottle body is communicated with the accommodating bin through a second pipeline and a second valve. The third bottle body is communicated with the accommodating bin through a third pipeline and a third valve. The first bottle body, the second bottle body and the third bottle body are respectively used for filling stratum water, crude oil and air. Stratum water, crude oil and air filled in the corresponding bottle bodies are sent into the accommodating bin through the corresponding pipelines, so that an oxidation process of simulating the air injection of the water-containing oil reservoir can be realized, and the problem that the oxidation effect of the water-containing oil reservoir is difficult to simulate due to the fact that the stratum water is not injected into the oil reservoir oxidation simulation system in the prior art is solved.

title_en: Sample extraction device for veterinary drug residue detection in infant auxiliary food
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sample extraction device for detecting veterinary drug residues in infant auxiliary foods, which comprises a centrifugal machine and three positioning plates arranged at intervals up and down, wherein a fixed plate is fixed on the outer side of the middle positioning plate, an adjusting electric telescopic rod is fixed on the upper surface of the fixed plate, a lifting plate is fixed on the top end of the adjusting electric telescopic rod, one end of the lifting plate penetrates through and is fixed with a clear liquid extraction pipe, a separation cover is fixed at the bottom end of the clear liquid extraction pipe, a small extraction pump is fixed on the upper surface of the lifting plate, and the input end of the small extraction pump is connected with an extraction pipe. According to the utility model, the separation cover is slowly immersed into the extracted clear liquid, and when the separation cover is immersed under the liquid level of the clear liquid and slowly descends, the clear liquid entering the inner side of the separation cover is extracted through the small-sized extraction pump, the extraction pipe and the clear liquid extraction pipe, and the flow of the liquid in the process does not influence the sediment at the bottom of the extraction test tube, so that the sediment is ensured not to float and be extracted.

title_en: PH value detection device for alkali-free liquid accelerator
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a PH value detection device of an alkali-free liquid accelerator, which belongs to the field of PH value detection devices and comprises a base plate and a detector, a rotating mechanism, a plurality of fixing pieces and cleaning pieces, wherein the fixing pieces and the cleaning pieces are distributed on the rotating mechanism at intervals, a lifting mechanism is arranged on the base plate, a detection head is arranged on the lifting mechanism and is electrically connected with the detector through a wire, the rotating mechanism is used for driving the fixing pieces and the cleaning pieces to rotate so as to adjust the fixing pieces and the cleaning pieces to the relative positions of the detection head, the fixing pieces are used for fixing test tubes, and the cleaning pieces are used for cleaning the detection head. The PH value detection device for the alkali-free liquid accelerator can sequentially detect a plurality of samples, can clean the detection head after detection is completed each time, avoids influencing the next detection structure, and is convenient and rapid and higher in efficiency compared with a manual mode.

title_en: Biological sample analysis equipment and reagent storage device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses biological sample analysis equipment and a reagent storage device. The biological sample analysis device includes a drive assembly and a reagent receiving device. The driving assembly is provided with an output shaft, the reagent storage device is provided with a storage cavity, a connecting pipeline and an extrusion assembly, the storage cavity is used for placing the reagent pack and the recovery pack, the connecting pipeline is partially embedded in the extrusion assembly, one end of the connecting pipeline is used for communicating the reagent pack, the other end of the connecting pipeline is communicated with the recovery pack, the driving assembly and the reagent storage device can be in butt joint or separated to enable the output shaft to be in butt joint or separation with the extrusion assembly, and the output shaft can drive the extrusion assembly to extrude the connecting pipeline to enable liquid to flow during butt joint. The utility model realizes the detachable assembly of the reagent storage device and the driving component, does not need to arrange a driving source in the storage device, and is convenient for consumable replacement.

title_en: Power distribution cabinet with fire disaster early warning function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a power distribution cabinet with fire early warning, which comprises a cabinet body, wherein an annular groove is formed in one side of the interior of the cabinet body, and the power distribution cabinet also comprises an arc-shaped sensing array matched with the annular groove in shape, wherein the arc-shaped sensing array is clamped and fixed in the annular groove, so that the arc-shaped sensing array is attached to the inner wall of the cabinet body to form a surrounding type monitoring layout. The utility model enables the sensing array to be attached to the wall of the cabinet through the adaptation of the annular groove and the arc-shaped sensing array, makes full use of a narrow space and eliminates a monitoring blind area, integrates the pyrolysis particle sensor and the micro VOC sensor to realize early hidden danger identification, can quickly disassemble and assemble the arc-shaped sensing array through the disassembly structure, improves the maintenance efficiency, and realizes three-dimensional monitoring by distributing a plurality of arc-shaped sensing arrays along the height direction.

title_en: Sweet potato field liquid manure check out test set
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of agricultural detection modules and discloses sweet potato field water and fertilizer detection equipment, which comprises a tank body, wherein a top cover is arranged at the top end of the tank body, a detection assembly for detection is arranged on the inner bottom wall of the top cover, and the detection assembly comprises a base fixed on the inner bottom wall of the top cover. This sweet potato field liquid manure check out test set through setting up detection component, drives detection module decline and falls into the pH value that detects liquid manure in the liquid manure by electric putter when detecting, adds corresponding material in order to adjust liquid manure pH value to suitable scope according to the pH value of liquid manure, and electric putter drives detection module and retrieves to the inside of oversheath after the detection, and the inner tube rotates and drives the baffle and reseal breach, and external pump machine drives the output and the detection module of washing liquid to electric putter and washs, and the sewage that washs the production is discharged through the blow off pipe, avoids the liquid manure to adhere to the accuracy of influencing the detection next time on detection module.

title_en: Dry-wet circulation experimental equipment for solidified soil sample
abstract_en: The utility model discloses dry and wet cycle experimental equipment for a solidified soil sample, and relates to the technical field of road engineering quality detection equipment. The dry-wet circulation experimental equipment comprises a working box, a sample mounting frame, a drying device, a lifting driving device and a wetting device, wherein the sample mounting frame is provided with a plurality of sample placing areas, each sample placing area is provided with a plurality of sample placing baskets for placing solidified soil samples, the wetting device comprises a plurality of soaking barrels, the positions of the plurality of soaking barrels and the positions of the plurality of sample placing areas are in one-to-one correspondence respectively, the lifting driving device is used for driving the sample mounting frame to do reciprocating motion along the vertical direction, the sample placing baskets extend into the soaking barrels or reset the sample placing baskets, and the drying device is used for drying the solidified soil samples. The dry-wet cycle experimental equipment can be used for simultaneously testing the dry-wet cycle performance data of the solidified soil in various liquid medium environments, so that the experimental efficiency can be remarkably improved, and the research period can be shortened.

title_en: Environment cleanliness detection and verification device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of environmental cleanliness detection and discloses an environmental cleanliness detection and verification device, which comprises a workbench, wherein the bottom end of the inner side wall of the workbench is fixedly connected with a sampling pump, the surface of the sampling pump is fixedly connected with a connecting pipe a, the surface of the connecting pipe a is fixedly connected with a detection head, one end of the connecting pipe a, which is far away from the sampling pump, is fixedly connected with a connecting pipe b, one end of the connecting pipe b, which is far away from the connecting pipe a, is fixedly connected with a connector, the surface of the connector is provided with a mounting assembly, and the outer cambered surface of a sliding ring penetrates through and is in threaded connection with a positioning screw b. According to the utility model, the linkage structure of the sliding ring, the protruding blocks and the hinging rod can flexibly adjust the position of the mounting block, so that the mounting block is accurately aligned with the hole position of the external equipment connecting flange, and can adapt to various specifications of equipment without replacing a connecting part. The self-locking design of the positioning screw b ensures stable connection and prevents gas path leakage.

title_en: Multi-point detection type inflammable gas detection equipment
abstract_en: The utility model is suitable for the technical field of gas detection, and provides a multi-point detection type flammable gas detection device which comprises a detection box, wherein a detection assembly, a gas supply assembly, a gas inlet assembly and a flame retardant assembly are arranged on the detection box, the gas inlet assembly is communicated with the detection assembly through the gas supply assembly, the detection assembly comprises a detector fixedly arranged in the detection box, a gas pump is fixedly arranged in the detection box close to one side of the detector, the gas inlet end of the gas pump is communicated with the detector, the flammable gas at different heights is detected through the arrangement of the gas supply assembly and the gas inlet assembly, the detection accuracy of the concentration of the flammable gas is improved, the detection range of the device is further enlarged, and meanwhile, when the device sucks the gas at different heights, in order to improve the suction accuracy of the gas at different heights, the rotary ball is limited, and the gas at other height positions is further limited to enter, so that the detection effect of the flammable gas at other heights is better.

title_en: Quick detection device of chinese herbal medicine probiotic anti-alcoholic liquor
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rapid detection device for Chinese herbal medicine probiotics anti-alcohol liquid, which belongs to the technical field of Chinese herbal medicine probiotics anti-alcohol liquid detection, and the technical scheme is characterized by comprising a supporting table, wherein an auxiliary structure is bolted to the inner side of the supporting table, an extraction structure is bolted to the top of the supporting table, the top of a speed reducing motor is bolted to the bottom of the supporting table, the output end of the speed reducing motor penetrates through the supporting table and is bolted to the bottom of a rotating disc, the outside of rolling disc rotates with the inboard of brace table to be connected, the outer wall of rolling disc rotates with the inner wall of installation piece to be connected, and the detection of current chinese herbal medicine probiotics anti-alcoholic solution, traditional detection is relatively lacking the effective preliminary treatment to the sample, and impurity in the anti-alcoholic solution easily interferes testing result, is difficult to realize the sample layering fast, leads to detection efficiency lower, and in detection process, the sample extraction position is difficult to nimble regulation, influences the smoothness nature of testing flow.

title_en: In-vitro grouting test device for shield underground butt joint
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an external grouting test device for shield in-ground butt joint, which relates to the technical field of shield grouting tests and comprises a waist test box and a bottom test box, wherein one side surface of the waist test box is an arc-shaped panel manufactured according to the waist of a shield body and used for simulating the waist position of a shield shell, the upper part of the waist test box is provided with a water filling port I and a pumping outlet, a plurality of groups of grouting holes are formed in the arc-shaped panel, one side of the waist test box is provided with a pressure relief valve, the bottom test box is independently arranged on one side of the waist test box, the bottom test box is formed by welding steel plates, a plurality of groups of openings are formed in the bottom test box, and the bottom test box and the ground are embedded with steel plates. The waist belt pressure test box body is utilized to simulate the belt pressure environment within the range of about 5m above the lane board, and the bottom test box is used for further verifying the upper-stage test result, so that the whole test device can stably operate under the pressure condition of simulating the actual construction environment.

title_en: Dampproofing case of electronic component
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electronic element moisture-proof box, belongs to the technical field of electronic element moisture-proof boxes, and solves the problems that in the use of the electronic element moisture-proof box, core elements such as a humidity sensor or an MCU are aged/damaged, so that the monitoring precision is misaligned, the display humidity is normal but the actual humidity deviates from a set value and is false, the reading of the sensor is abnormal, and a dehumidification system is stopped prematurely or runs continuously and excessively. Comprises a dampproof box body of an electronic element. According to the utility model, the reference humidity sensor sealed in the constant drying environment is introduced to provide the reference signal with high stability, the deviation between the output signal of the main sensor and the reference signal is compared in real time, and the audible and visual alarm is immediately driven to give out a warning when the deviation exceeds the preset tolerance, so that a user can timely detect the drift fault of the sensor, and the problems of out-of-control humidity in the box or abnormal operation of the dehumidification system caused by blind trust of the misalignment sensor are effectively avoided.

title_en: Medicine inspection dissolving device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a medicine inspection dissolving device, and aims to solve the technical problem that the efficiency is to be improved when a traditional centrifuge is used for dissolving medicines. The dissolving device comprises a machine case, a motor, a mounting frame, a clamping assembly and a clamping assembly, wherein a dissolving area is arranged in the machine case, a cover plate capable of being opened and closed is arranged at the top of the dissolving area, the motor is arranged in the machine case, a connecting rod is arranged at the end part of an output shaft of the motor, the mounting frame is arranged at one end of the connecting rod, the middle part of the mounting frame is of a hollow structure, the clamping assembly is arranged on the mounting frame, and the clamping part of the clamping assembly is arranged in the hollow structure of the mounting frame, and the mounting frame, the connecting rod and the output shaft of the motor jointly form a Z-shaped structure. Through arranging motor output shaft, mounting bracket and connecting rod with Z shape structure, make the container of clamping on the clamping subassembly, can make the container be the rotation of reversal type, and then through the impact of liquid in the container, realize quick dissolving's purpose.

title_en: Movable stop device of conveyer
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a movable limiting device of a conveyor, which relates to the technical field of tobacco conveying and comprises a conveyor, a limiting structure and a limiting structure, wherein the conveyor is used for conveying tobacco, the limiting structure comprises a supporting frame, a lifting frame and limiting rollers, the supporting frame is detachably arranged on two sides of the conveyor, the bottom of the lifting frame is detachably connected with the supporting frame, the conveyor penetrates through the lifting frame, the limiting rollers are horizontally arranged in the lifting frame and are perpendicular to the conveying direction of the conveyor, a plurality of limiting rollers are arranged, the plurality of limiting rollers are sequentially arranged at intervals along the conveying direction of the conveyor, and the setting height of the plurality of limiting rollers is gradually reduced. So set up, this device can be according to the mounting position of production requirement free regulation limit structure, carries out the regulation of crane height simultaneously according to material thickness to make spacing roller bearing carry out limit control to it, and, this device's spacing roller bearing sets up highly and reduces gradually, can realize spacing control step by step, can not putty when guaranteeing that the material is too high.

title_en: Lake water sampling and detecting equipment for environmental protection
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of environment detection, in particular to lake water sampling detection equipment for environment protection, which comprises a waterproof box, wherein the top of the waterproof box is connected with a telescopic detection mechanism, the bottom of the telescopic detection mechanism is provided with a water pump, one end of the water pump is communicated with a water outlet pipe, the bottom of the water outlet pipe is movably provided with a storage barrel, one end of the water inlet pipe is movably provided with a threaded sleeve, a filter plate is arranged on the threaded sleeve, one end of the waterproof box is rotatably provided with a rotating shaft, one end of the rotating shaft is provided with a rotating plate, one end of the rotating plate is provided with a brush plate contacted with the filter plate, and the rotating plate is provided with a fixing mechanism which is convenient for replacing the brush plate. According to the utility model, the rotating plate is driven to rotate through the rotating shaft, so that the brush plate rotates, and the brush plate scrapes away large garbage adsorbed on the surface of the filter plate, so that normal sampling is prevented from being influenced, a worker does not need to manually clean the waterproof box after the waterproof box rises to the water surface through the telescopic detection mechanism, and the sampling efficiency is improved.

title_en: Portable blood sugar detector
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of blood glucose detectors and discloses a portable blood glucose detector which comprises a detector body, a test paper storage box, a needle fixing rod, a detector cover plate, a mounting assembly and a fixing assembly, wherein a placing groove and a mounting hole are formed in two ends of the detector body, a hinge block is arranged in a groove at the left end, the test paper storage box is arranged in a groove at the right end and is fixed with a first spring through a mounting positioning block, the cover plate is connected with the right end cover plate through a telescopic connecting rod and is also fixed by the mounting assembly, the needle fixing rod is arranged in the groove at the left end, the top end is in rotary fit with the hinge block, a lancet is inserted into a positioning groove at the tail end, and a locking block and a second spring and other fixing assembly can be used for fixing the lancet.

title_en: Circulating cooling water dynamic simulation device for measuring limit concentration multiple
abstract_en: A dynamic simulation device for measuring limiting concentration multiple of circulating cooling water relates to the technical field of circulating cooling water systems, and adopts the technical scheme that the dynamic simulation device comprises a water circulating device, a monitoring device and a data processing device, wherein the water circulating device comprises a cooling tower water tank, a circulating pump, a simulated heat exchange device and a cooling tower which are sequentially connected in series through a circulating water pipe, a cooling water outlet of the cooling tower is connected to the cooling tower water tank, the cooling tower water tank is further provided with a water supplementing tank, the simulated heat exchange device comprises a heat exchanger cavity and a heat exchange pipe, the monitoring device comprises a pH sensor, a corrosion rate sensor, a flowmeter, a conductivity sensor, a water inlet temperature sensor, a water outlet temperature sensor and a steam temperature sensor, and the data processing device comprises a total control module, a conductivity module, a thermal resistance module, a corrosion rate module and a communication module. The utility model can judge the limit operation condition under the high conductivity water quality, automatically determine the limit concentration multiple and avoid the repeated sampling and monitoring work in the prior art.

title_en: Method for generating a profile of the dna repair capabilities of tumour cells and the uses thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for generating a profile of the DNA repair capabilities of tumour cells and the uses thereof for the prognosis of cancer, the selection, monitoring and/or prediction of therapeutic effectiveness of a cancer treatment in a patient, as well as for screening anti-cancer drugs. The invention likewise relates to a reference library comprising the profiles of the DNA repair capabilities of different sub-types of a cancer, obtained by the method of the invention, and to the uses thereof for classifying cancers.

title_en: A novel assay for the diagnosis of nematode infections
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a diagnostically useful carrier comprising (a) a peptide comprising the amino acid sequence set forth in SEQ ID NO:1 or a variant thereof, and (b) a somatic lysate of Toxocara canis larvae. Further the present invention relates to a kit, use, methods, compositions comprising in the diagnostically useful carrier of the invention. A method for diagnosing a Toxocara infection, comprising detecting in a sample of a patient the presence of an antibody to SEQ ID NO:1 and/or an antibody to a somatic lysate of Toxocara canis larvae, is also disclosed.

title_en: Gingivitis diagnostic methods, uses and kits
abstract_en: Disclosed is an  in vitro  method for assessing whether a human patient has gingivitis. The method is based on the insight to determine biomarker proteins. Accordingly, in a sample of saliva a patient suffering from gingivitis, the concentrations are measured of the certain protein combinations. One such combination is Alpha-1-acid glycoprotein (A1AGP) and S100 calcium-binding protein A8 (S100A8), and at least one of Hemoglobin subunit beta (Hb-beta), Keratin 4 (K-4) and Pyruvate Kinase (PK). Another combination is Alpha-1-acid glycoprotein (A1AGP), Hemoglobin subunit beta (Hb-beta) and Keratin 4 (K-4). Based on the concentrations as measured, a value is determined reflecting the joint concentrations for said proteins. This value is compared with a threshold value reflecting in the same manner the joint concentrations associated with gingivitis. The comparison allows assessing whether the testing value is indicative of the presence of gingivitis in said patient. Thereby, typically, a testing value reflecting a joint concentration below the joint concentration reflected by the threshold value is indicative for absence of gingivitis in said patient, and a testing value reflecting a joint concentration at or above the joint concentration reflected by the threshold value, is indicative for gingivitis in said patient.

title_en: Methods and compositions for generation of binding agents against cell surface antigens
abstract_en: Provided are methods and compositions for identifying binding polypeptides (e.g., antibodies or antigen binding fragments thereof) that specifically binds to a cell-surface antigen. The methods of the invention generally comprise contacting a variegated nucleic acid-display library of binding polypeptides with a cell-surface antigen displayed on the exterior surface of a cell; and isolating from the library at least one library member that specifically binds to the cell-surface antigen on the exterior surface of the cell. Also provided are novel nucleic acid display libraries (e.g., DNA display libraries) useful in the methods of the invention.

title_en: Methods for determining vaccine potency
abstract_en: Compositions and methods for determining the efficacy and/or potency of a vaccine preparation are described herein. Splenocytes from immunized animals are isolated and frozen. Upon thawing aliquots these cells are activated by exposure to a series of dilutions of q vaccine preparation being tested and a series of dilutions of a reference vaccine with known characteristics. Cells secreting immunogen-specific antibody and cells secreting nonspecific antibody are enumerated, as is the amount of immunogen-specific and nonspecific antibody produced. Comparison between the results from the vaccine preparations provides a measure of relative vaccine efficacy and/or potency.

title_en: Biomarkers for evaluating car-t cells to predict clinical outcome
abstract_en: The invention provides biomarkers, e.g, cancer biomarkers, and methods of using said biomarkers. Specifically, the invention provides biomarkers for use, e.g., in evaluating CAR-T cell therapies and predicting clinical outcome.

title_en: Method for removing dissolved oxygen, used in an electrochemical biosensor that uses an oxidase as the sensor enzyme
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for removing dissolved oxygen, used in an electrochemical biosensor, and to a measurement system and a method for electrochemically determining a concentration of an analyte using said method.

title_en: Thiocycloheptyne derivatives and their use
abstract_en: The present invention pertains to novel thiocycloheptyne derivatives of general formula (I) : and in particular to thiacycloalkynesulfoimine derivatives and their synthesis. The invention also relates to the use of the novel thiocycloheptyne derivatives in coupling reactions with linkers and drugs. The invention further relates to the use of the novel thiocycloheptynes in bioorthogonal (copper-free) click reactions. The invention further pertains to the use of the novel thiocycloheptyne derivatives in the generation of advanced multifunctional drug delivery systems (drug-loaded) nanoparticles.

title_en: Method, device and system for determining the concentration of analytes in a sample
abstract_en: A method, device and a system of determining a concentration of one or more analytes in a sample is disclosed. In one aspect of the invention, the method includes introducing the sample through a channel. The method further includes illuminating the sample with light having varying wavelengths. Additionally, the method includes obtaining an image of the illuminated sample at each of the wavelengths. Furthermore, the method includes analyzing the image to determine the concentration of the one or more analytes.

title_en: Methods for isolating target cells from blood
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are methods for isolating target cells from blood, involving mixing in an open container an undiluted blood sample having a volume of 10 ml or less, and binding agents, wherein each binding agent comprises (A) a primary binding agent comprising an agent capable of binding to at least one cellular epitope on target cells in the undiluted blood sample, (B) a first linker bound to the primary binding agent, to generate binding agent- attached target cells in the undiluted blood sample: contacting the binding agent-attached target cells in the undiluted blood sample with a plurality of buoyant reagents that include a second linker capable of binding to the first linker to generate an undiluted buoyant reagent- attached target cell mixture; diluting the undiluted buoyant reagent-attached target cell mixture by at least 20% to produce a diluted buoyant reagent-attached target cell mixture: applying a vectorial force, such as centrifugal force, to the diluted buoyant reagent-attached target cell mixture to generate a stratified diluted buoyant reagent-attached target cell mixture: removing the buoyant reagent-attached target cells from the stratified diluted buoyant reagent-attached target cell mixture; and isolating the target cells from the buoyant reagent-attached target cells.

title_en: Animal model for amplifying human or animal circulating tumor cells
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an avian model for the amplification of human or animal circulating tumor cells (CTCs) and to the use thereof for follow-up and for determining the sensitivity of a cancer patient or animal to one or more therapeutic agents, as well as for screening novel therapeutic agents for the treatment of cancer.

title_en: Markers of disease prognosis in multiple sclerosis
abstract_en: Provided are methods and kits for early determination of disease outcome and prognosis of Multiple Sclerosis (MS) patients and for adjustment of suitable treatment.

title_en: Biomimetic array device and methods of using same
abstract_en: The present disclosure generally pertains to a biomimetic array device and methods of using the device to expose biological samples to an array of fluids. The device includes a cassette and an inlet region, where the cassette comprises at least one microchamber array and at least one microchannel. Each microchamber within a microchamber array has a top interface that is open to the external environment, so that a biological sample placed at the top interface is positioned to draw fluid from the microchambers. The inlet region comprises at least one well and at least one inlet channel, each well in fluid communication with one inlet channel. Fluid deposited into wells flows through each inlet channel and microchannel in fluid communication with each well containing fluid, so that each microchamber within one microchamber array provides an approximately equal volume of fluid to the biological sample.

title_en: Fusion proteins comprising the sars-cov-2 3clpro catalytic domain and their uses for screening anti-sars-cov-2 agents
abstract_en: In late December 2019, a new betacoronavirus SARS-CoV-2 has emerged in Wuhan China. The World Health Organization has named the severe pneumonia caused by this new coronavirus COVID-19 (for Corona Virus Disease 2019, WHO, 2020). To fight against the COVID-19 pandemic in a long term, in addition to the containment measures implemented in many countries, several projects have been launched around the world to understand the viral evolution and the pathophysiological consequences of the infection in order to identify therapeutic targets and to implement innovative therapies. In particular, the 3C-like proteinase (3CLpro) of the severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus (SARS-CoV) plays a vital role in virus maturation and is proposed to be a key target for drug design against SARS. The present invention relates to fusion proteins comprising the SARS-CoV-2 3CLpro catalytic domain and their uses for screening anti-SARS-Cov-2 agents.

title_en: Sampling systems and techniques for detection of hazardous contaminants
abstract_en: Certain aspects relate to systems and usage techniques for hazardous contamination detection devices that can utilize location-specific machine-readable information tags in conjunction with optical analysis of assays such as lateral flow assays to enable enhanced reliability and analysis of contamination detection data and/or trends. Location tags affixed to test locations and/or test sample containers provide for consistent and simplified testing workflows for reliably obtaining and storing location information in association with a large number of individual test results without requiring manual recordkeeping. Hazardous contamination detection devices can programmatically implement a two-step testing workflow.

title_en: Compositions, methods and systems for protein corona analysis from biofluids and uses thereof
abstract_en: This disclosure provides methods and compositions for biomolecule corona analysis of biofluids. A biofluid may be contacted with a nanoparticle to form a biomolecule corona, and the composition of the resulting corona may be analyzed. Also provided are methods of preparing a biofluid for corona analysis by serial interrogation.

title_en: Diagnostic for maternal risk of having a child with autism spectrum disorder
abstract_en: Provided herein are methods of obtaining and applying measurements of metabolites to quantifying maternal risk of having a child with autism spectrum disorder (ASD), with high specificity and sensitivity.

title_en: Methods and compositions for diagnosis and prognosis of renal injury and renal failure
abstract_en: The present invention relates to methods and compositions for monitoring, diagnosis, prognosis, and determination of treatment regimens in subjects suffering from or suspected of having a renal injury. In particular, the invention relates to using assays that detect one or more of C-C motif chemokine 16, C-C motif chemokine 14, and Tyrosine-protein kinase receptor UFO as diagnostic and prognostic biomarker assays in renal injuries.

title_en: Ph responsive compositions and uses thereof
abstract_en: Described herein are pH responsive compounds, micelles, and compositions useful for the detection of primary and metastatic tumor tissues. Compounds described herein are imaging agents useful for the detection of primary and metastatic tumor tissue (including lymph nodes). Real-time fluorescence imaging during surgery aids surgeon in the detection of metastatic lymph nodes or delineate tumor tissue versus normal tissue, with the goal of achieving negative margins and complete tumor resection.

title_en: Probe arrays
abstract_en: A microelectrode array comprises an array of electrodes. Each electrode has associated with it a sampling circuit for sampling an electrode signal on the electrode, and a sample buffer to store a representation of the electrode signal from the electrode. Each electrode has associated with it an activity sensor configured to detect an electrode signal event above a predetermined threshold and to set an activity flag based on the detection. The microelectrode array further comprises control logic to activate the sampling circuit and sample buffer of an electrode to sample the electrode signal and store a representation of the sampled electrode signal for that electrode only when the activity flag is set. Electrode signal activity is detected at the electrode level to thereby strategically control electrode signal sampling activity. This enables a reduction in power consumption and in redundant data generation by switching off components for inactive channels (e.g. ADC, amplifiers, etc.). The total power budget and bandwidth requirements for a high-resolution ME A sensor are thereby reduced. A plurality of microelectrode arrays may be coupled in a networked configuration for scheduling and controlling transmission of stored representations of the electrode signals over a data bus to a data sink.

title_en: Identification of components in a fluid flow using electro impedance spectroscopy
abstract_en:
Method and apparatus for identification of one or more components in liquid and/or gaseous flows using Electro Impedance Spectrography, starting with low frequencies, and including later higher frequencies, such as infrared, ultraviolet, Xray etc. Preferably, a sweep over the different frequency bands takes place. Prior knowledge of the response of certain compounds is used where the compounds are known to a certain extent and the concentrations have to be monitored. 
     The apparatus may comprise more than two, preferably 3-12 modules for different frequency bands, ranging from 0.1Hz to 10GHz.

title_en: Sample collection and detection device and method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a sample collection and testing device for analyzing and testing an analyte in a liquid sample. The sample collection device includes a collection inner cavity and a collection outer cavity. The collection inner cavity is disposed inside the collection outer cavity. The collection inner cavity communicates with the collection outer cavity via through holes at a bottom portion of the collection inner cavity. The collection inner cavity is movable between a first position and a second position relative to the collection outer cavity. When the collection inner cavity is at the first position, the liquid sample is collected into the collection outer cavity. When the collection inner cavity is at the second position, the liquid sample is discharged out of the collection outer cavity. The device and method of the present invention can complete the collection, buffer reaction and test of a liquid sample in a one-stop manner, are particularly suitable for the test of a sample that needs to be pretreated for a certain time, and can test the sample within a set time. The device can maximize the collection of a sample, which improves the accuracy of tests and facilitates the test of multiple analytes in the same sample.

title_en: Methods and compositions related to toxicity associated with cell therapy
abstract_en: Provided are methods, kits and compositions related to toxicity associated with administration of cell therapy for the treatment of diseases or conditions, e.g., cancer, including methods for use in predicting and treating a toxicity. In some embodiments, the toxicity is a neurotoxicity or cytokine release syndrome (CRS), such as a severe neurotoxicity or a severe CRS. The methods generally involve detecting a parameter of a biomarker or individually a parameter of each biomarker in a panel of biomarkers, such as a concentration, amount or activity, and comparing the detected parameter to a reference value for the parameter to determine if the subject is at risk for developing the toxicity, such as neurotoxicity or CRS or severe neurotoxicity or severe CRS. In some embodiments, the methods further involve administering an agent or therapy for treating, ameliorating, preventing, delaying and/or attenuating the development of the toxicity, such as neurotoxicity or CRS, such as severe neurotoxicity or severe CRS.

title_en: Measuring device and method for measuring characteristics of cells
abstract_en: The invention relates to a measuring device (10) for measuring physical characteristics of cells. The device (10) comprises: a microfluidic chip (20) provided with a flow channel (22) for allowing cells to flow through; a manipulator (24) configured to apply deformation force to a cell in a continuous flow; and a sensor (26) configured to sense a physical characteristic of the cell. The manipulator (24) and the sensor (26) are configured to define a width (W2) of the flow channel (22) as a gap formed between them. The manipulator (24) is configured to apply the deformation force to the cell by compressing the cell against the sensor (26).

title_en: Preventing epoxy bleed-out for biosensor devices
abstract_en: A fluidic device and a method of preventing isolation material from bleed-out therein is described herein. The fluidic device includes a bulk acoustic wave resonator structure defining at least one surface area region on which a functionalization material is disposed and the resonator structure includes a repelling area. The fluidic device also includes isolation material disposed on the resonator structure and away from the at least one surface area region. The repelling area is configured to prevent the isolation material from extending into the at least one surface area region. Further, an electronic board may be operably attached to the resonator structure and the isolation material may be disposed in a gap therebetween to electrically isolate electrical contacts and form a fluidic channel.

title_en: Method for determining 5-methylcytosine configurations in dna
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an isolated Methyl-CpG binding domain (MBD) variant comprising an MBD core domain that has at least 60 % sequence homology relative to any one of SEQ ID Nos. 1-45 and comprising at least one amino acid substitution relative to the corresponding wildtype MBD in at least one of the positions corresponding to positions 12, 14, 19, 21, 22, 23, 24, 25, 26, 27, 29, 31, 33, 35, 36, 37, 38, 39, 40, and 45 in SEQ ID NO:1. Furthermore, the invention relates to a conjugate comprising the isolated MBD variant and to the use of the isolated MBD variant or the conjugate for the determination of the methylation state of cytosine residues and/or oxidation state of 5-methylated cytosine residues in a CpG dinucleotide of interest and its complement in a DNA molecule or for the enrichment of DNA molecules comprising a CpG dinucleotide of interest and its complement in which at least one cytosine nucleobase in the CpG dinucleotide of interest is modified and selected from the group consisting of 5-methylcytosine (mC), 5-hydroxymethylcytosine (hmC), 5-formylcytosine (fC), and 5-carboxylcytosine (caC). Finally, the invention relates to methods for the determination of the methylation state of cytosine and/or therelative oxidation state of the methyl group of 5-methylated cytosine residues as described above or for the enrichment of DNA molecules as described above.

title_en: Composition and method for inducing differentiation into myeloid cells, and use thereof
abstract_en: Provided are a composition and method for inducing direct conversion from a somatic cell into a myeloid cell and use thereof, in which differentiation from a somatic cell into a myeloid cell can be efficiently induced through the expression of a single direct conversion inducer without undergoing the pluripotency stage of induced pluripotent stem cells, and thus, the composition can be widely used as an effective preventive and therapeutic agent for immune diseases.

title_en: Measuring apparatus and measuring method
abstract_en: A measuring apparatus (1) includes a storage unit (10) in which the blood sample is stored, a pump (20) which sucks the blood sample from the storage unit, a flow passage (30) which communicates with the storage unit and through which the blood sample or a rinse liquid flows when sucked by the pump, a detection unit (50) including an irradiation unit which irradiates the flow passage with light and a light detecting unit which detects light that has been emitted from the irradiation unit and has transmitted through or been reflected from the flow passage, a sensor (60) which is disposed between the storage unit and the detection unit and detects switching from a liquid to a gas in the flow passage, and a control unit (70) which controls a stop of driving of the pump.

title_en: Mycoplasma pneumoniae immunoassay method and immunoassay instrument
abstract_en: An immunoassay utilizing a monoclonal antibody which specifically reacts with both of P1 protein and P30 protein of  Mycoplasma pneumoniae,  which monoclonal antibody has a higher affinity with P1 protein and P30 protein of  Mycoplasma pneumoniae  than the known monoclonal antibodies, is disclosed. The immunoassay utilizes an antigen-antibody reaction between a monoclonal antibody which specifically reacts with P1 protein and P30 protein of  Mycoplasma pneumoniae  and which specifically reacts with a peptide containing an amino acid sequence composed of PPQPG or antigen-binding fragment thereof, and P1 protein and P30 protein derived from  Mycoplasma pneumoniae.

title_en: Design, fabrication, and characterization of nanoplastics and microplastics
abstract_en: Provided by the inventive concept or nanoplastic or microplastic particles, reference standard materials including nanoplastic or microplastic particles, methods of using, and methods of preparing the same. Uses of the nanoplastic and/or microplastic particles of the inventive concept include tracking of nanoplastic and/or microplastic particle dispersion/distribution in environmental and/or biological systems, as well as in organisms that are within the environment.

title_en: Device for evaluating state of sample, system including same, method for evaluating state of sample, and lactate dehydrogenase used therefor
abstract_en:
An object of the present invention is to provide a device for evaluating a state of interstitial fluid, blood, urine, tears, sweat, saliva of human and non-human organisms, foods and drinks, brewed product, etc., a system, a program, and an evaluation method using these. 
     The present invention is to provide a device for evaluating a state of a sample which comprises an action part for allowing lactate dehydrogenase to act on a sample, and a sensor for sensing the state of the sample on which lactate dehydrogenase is allowed to act, a system, a program, a method for evaluating the state of the sample using these, and an enzyme to be used therefor.

title_en: Mucins and isoforms thereof in diseases characterized by barrier dysfunction
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the field of mucins and isoforms thereof, more in particular for use in the diagnosis, monitoring, prevention and/or treatment of a disease characterized by barrier dysfunction, such as but not limited to a gastrointestinal disorder (e.g. Inflammatory Bowel Disease (IBD), Irritable Bowel Syndrome (IBS), cancer, gastro-intestinal infections, obesitas, non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD)), neurodegenerative disorders, respiratory infections,... more in particular coronaviral infections In a specific embodiment, said mucins and/or isoforms thereof are selected from the list comprising: MUC16, MUC21, MUC20, MUC2, MUC4, MUC5AC, MUC5B, MUC13, and MUC1 and isoforms thereof

title_en: Functional screening using droplet-based microfluidics
abstract_en: Provided is a droplet-based microfluidics platform for functional screening of interacting molecules. The platform is particularly useful for high throughput screening of interacting proteins, such as antibodies or engineered cytokines, which trigger a detectable downstream signaling event.

title_en: Compositions and methods for identifying and treating microparticle-associated diseases and conditions
abstract_en: The present invention relates to compositions and methods for identifying and treating signature MP-associated diseases and conditions in subjects. In particular, treatment methods of the invention include administering a gelsolin agent to produce a therapeutic effect against a signature MP-associated disease or condition in a subject.

title_en: Blood coagulation reaction analysis method
abstract_en: Provided is a blood coagulation reaction analysis method. The method includes measuring a blood coagulation reaction of a subject specimen and acquiring first data for calculating a blood coagulation time of the subject specimen and second data for estimating a blood coagulation abnormality factor of the subject specimen, wherein the acquiring of the second data includes: obtaining a first derivative V(i) of a coagulation reaction curve R(i); and determining a point p k  where V(i) assumes X k  before reaching a maximum value of V(i), Vmax, and a point q k  where V(i) assumes X k  after reaching Vmax.

title_en: Improvements in or relating to a device and methods for facilitating manipulation of microdroplets
abstract_en: An apparatus for manipulating one or more microdroplets into an array using EWOD or oEWOD is provided. The apparatus comprises: a) a chip for manipulating microdroplets comprising: i) a plurality of electrowetting pathways leading to the array; and ii) one or more waste electrowetting pathways leading to a waste outlet; b) a detector for detecting one or more microdroplets with a distinct characteristic, said detector configured to obtain a measured dataset relating to the distinct characteristic of the detected microdroplet; c) a storage module configured to store and maintain a stored dataset associated with the characteristic measured by the detector; and d) a controller configured to receive the stored dataset from the storage module and the obtained measured dataset to determine whether the measured dataset is associated with a desired or undesired characteristic. The controller is configured to select one or more microdroplets having a measured dataset that is associated with an undesired characteristic and cause the one or more selected microdroplets to move into a waste electrowetting pathway. Furthermore, the controller is configured to control the motion of the microdroplets along and/or between the electrowetting pathways such that the movement of the microdroplets is synchronised.

title_en: Methods for detecting and quantifying tetrakis(hydroxymethyl)phosphonium sulfate (thps) in biocide products
abstract_en: The present application discloses methods for detecting and quantifying tetrakis (hydroxymethyl) phosphonium sulfate (THPS) in a water sample. In the methods, a water sample is mixed with a KMnO 4  solution to form a mixture. An intensity of KMnO 4  absorption in the mixture is then measured at a wavelength of 525 nm. The measured intensity is normalized by subtracting a background intensity at a wavelength of 650 nm. The presence and concentration of THPS in the water sample can then be determined by comparing the normalized intensity with intensity values of KMnO 4  absorption of calibration samples comprising KMnO 4  and known THPS concentrations.

title_en: Devices and methods for plasma separation and storage
abstract_en: A centrifugal cartridge or disk used for extraction of light supernatant fractions from fluid samples is described, particularly for non-homogenous fluid biological samples such as whole blood. The device may be used to collect cell-free blood plasma or a fraction of whole blood containing target cells such as leukocytes. Single or multiple channels are described, including channels with passive valves, gaskets, receiving cavities, inlet holes, capillary wicking ridges, distal cavities for cell retention, separator gel, and density medium. Centrifugal action causes whole blood in a receiving cavity to pass into one or more channels where it separates into blood cells, plasma and optionally fractions of an intermediate density. After spin, the plasma returns to the receiving cavity by way of the one or more channels for extraction through the inlet hole or other inwardly located hole. Disposable cartridges are constructed of monolithic top and bottom plates, which may be joined together by an elastomeric outer seal.

title_en: Method of making a portable mip-based electrochemical sensor for the detection of the sars-cov-2 antigen
abstract_en: The current COVID-19 pandemic caused by SARS-CoV-2 coronavirus is expanding around the globe. Hence, accurate and cheap portable sensors are crucially important for the clinical diagnosis of COVID-19. Molecularly imprinted polymers (MIPs) as robust synthetic molecular recognition materials with antibody-like ability to bind and discriminate between molecules are provided here as selective elements in such sensors. Provided are detection assemblies comprising electrochemical sensors having ncovNP-MIP film endowed selectivity against SARS-CoV-2 nucleoprotein (ncovNP) and/or ncovS1-MIP film endowed selectivity against SARS-CoV-2 spike 1 (S1). The ncovNP- or ncovS1-MIP are synthesized electrochemically on portable gold thin-film electrodes system via chronocoulometry or cyclic voltammetry. The sensors show excellent detection capabilities, and high discrimination of interfering proteins.

title_en: Materials and methods for assessing cancer risk and treating cancer
abstract_en: This document relates to materials and methods for assessing and/or treating subjects (e.g., subjects having autoimmune diseases). For example, materials and methods for determining if a subject (e.g., a human having an autoimmune disease) has one or more antibodies that can be used to identify the subject as having a lower risk of cancer or as having a higher risk of cancer are provided. Materials and methods for treating a subject (e.g., a human) identified as having a higher cancer risk for cancer are also provided.

title_en: Predictive in vitro assay mimicking in vivo pharmacology
abstract_en: A method is disclosed herein to reconstruct and mimic the in vivo pattern of exposure to the active substances included in the drug treatment regimen in vitro using a cell assay. Means and methods for converting an in vivo pattern of exposure to appropriate concentrations, durations of exposure and time points of addition for an in vitro assay.

title_en: Cancer treatment
abstract_en: The present invention provides a method for the treatment of cancer with erdafitinib.

title_en: Gucy2c binding polypeptide and uses thereof
abstract_en: The present disclosure pertains to a GUCY2C-binding polypeptide and uses thereof and, specifically, to a GUCY2C-binding polypeptide, a fusion protein including same, a chimeric antigen receptor, an immune cell expressing the chimeric antigen receptor, and a use thereof for treatment and/or diagnosis of cancer.

title_en: Methods and systems for predicting allergic response
abstract_en: The present invention provides systems and methods for predicting an allergic response in a subject by measuring the amounts of RNA species from B cells that encode at least a part of the Immunoglobulin E (IgE) constant region (Ce), such as nonproductive epsilon germline transcripts (eGLTs).

title_en: System and method for determining the chemical composition of liquid metallurgical products
abstract_en: A device for determining the chemical composition of a liquid metallurgical product emitting electromagnetic radiations. The device comprising a collection probe configured to acquire the electromagnetic radiations emitted by the metallurgical product in a predetermined wavelength range Δλ, spectroscopic means connected to the collection probe and configured to generate a spectral signal of the acquired electromagnetic radiations and processing means including a database of reference radiances. The invention is also related to a method using said device.

title_en: Method and system for material identification using magnetic induction tomography (mit)
abstract_en: Method and apparatus of identifying a type of material or material combination in a measurement location by Magnetic Induction Tomography (MIT). The method comprises providing a primary magnetic field primarily in a first direction into the measurement location; measuring an orthogonal component of a secondary magnetic field; classifying the orthogonal component of the secondary magnetic field with reference to a material or material combination type and thereby identifying a type of material or material combination in the measurement location. The orthogonal component of the secondary magnetic field is in a direction substantially orthogonal to the first direction.

title_en: Volatile biomarkers for colorectal cancer
abstract_en: The invention relates to biomarkers, and to novel biological markers for diagnosing colorectal cancer. In particular, the invention relates to the use of these biomarkers as diagnostic and prognostic markers in assays for detecting colorectal cancer, and corresponding methods of detection. The invention also relates to methods of determining the efficacy of treating colorectal cancer with a therapeutic agent, and apparatus for carrying out the assays and methods. The assays are qualitative and/or quantitative, and are adaptable to large-scale screening and clinical trials.

title_en: Device and method for spectroscopic monitoring of liquids
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to the field of spectroscopic monitoring of liquids. In particular, among other aspects, disclosed herein are novel Raman spectrometry (RS)- and laser- induced fluorescence (LIF)-enabled water quality monitoring devices, as well as methods, computer-implemented methods, or programmes for processing spectral data received therefrom. The principles underlying the disclosed methods and products are suitable for analysis of any liquid, aqueous or non-aqueous, but are particularly well suited for analysis or monitoring of aqueous liquids, including industrial aqueous mixtures or suspensions, beverages, liquid dairy products, biological fluids, and notably water.

title_en: H-ngal for the detection of peritonitis
abstract_en: A method for diagnosis, preferably quick diagnosis of peritonitis or a risk of peritonitis in a peritoneal dialysis subject, comprising: detecting H-NGAL protein in peritoneal dialysis effluent of the peritoneal dialysis subject, if H-NGAL protein is greater than or equal to a cutoff value, indicating that the subject has or is at a risk of peritonitis. A strip, a kit and a device used in the method, and the use of a molecule that specifically binds to H-NGAL protein in the preparation of a composition, a strip or a kit for diagnosis, preferably quick diagnosis of peritonitis by detecting H-NGAL protein in peritoneal dialysis effluent of a peritoneal dialysis subject.

title_en: Vitamin c renal leak as a clinical diagnostic tool in the detection, monitoring, and management of acute and chronic diseases
abstract_en: The invention provides a method involving assessing the vitamin C renal leak status of a human subject, vitamin C renal leak being the clinically inappropriate presence of vitamin C in urine. The method comprises assaying for the concentration of vitamin C in a plasma sample and in collected urine output, whereby the presence of vitamin C in the collected urine output and a concentration of vitamin C in the plasma sample less than the Minimum Elimination Threshold (MET) indicates the presence of vitamin C renal leak. Vitamin C renal leak also can be quantified by determining the fractional excretion of vitamin C (FeVC), which is a measurement of the degree of urinary vitamin C excretion relative to plasma vitamin C concentration corrected by creatinine clearance. The invention also provides a test kit for assessing vitamin C renal leak and a test kit for assessing FeVC.

title_en: Methods and materials for treating cancer
abstract_en: This document relates to materials and methods for assessing and/or treating mammals ( e.g. , humans having autoimmune diseases). For example, materials and methods for determining if a mammal ( e.g. , a human having an autoimmune disease) has one or more antibodies that can be used to identify the mammal as having a lower risk of cancer or as having a higher risk of cancer are provided. Materials and methods for treating a mammal ( e.g. , a human) identified as having a higher cancer risk for cancer are also provided.

title_en: Gingivitis diagnostic methods, uses and kits
abstract_en: Disclosed is an  in vitro  method for assessing whether a human patient has gingivitis. The method is based on the insight to determine biomarker proteins. Accordingly, in a sample of saliva a patient suffering from gingivitis, the concentrations are measured of the certain protein combinations. One such combination is Alpha-1-acid glycoprotein (A1AGP) and S100 calcium-binding protein A8 (S100A8), and at least one of Hemoglobin subunit beta (Hb-beta), Keratin 4 (K-4) and Pyruvate Kinase (PK). Another combination is Alpha-1-acid glycoprotein (A1AGP), Hemoglobin subunit beta (Hb-beta) and Keratin 4 (K-4). Based on the concentrations as measured, a value is determined reflecting the joint concentrations for said proteins. This value is compared with a threshold value reflecting in the same manner the joint concentrations associated with gingivitis. The comparison allows assessing whether the testing value is indicative of the presence of gingivitis in said patient. Thereby, typically, a testing value reflecting a joint concentration below the joint concentration reflected by the threshold value is indicative for absence of gingivitis in said patient, and a testing value reflecting a joint concentration at or above the joint concentration reflected by the threshold value, is indicative for gingivitis in said patient.

title_en: Sensor for detection of gas and method for detection of gas
abstract_en: A sensor (1) for detection of gas, in particular for detection of CO2, comprises a contact face (2) which is directable towards a measuring site.
