The sensor (1) comprises at least one radiation source (3), a measurement volume (4) for receiving the gas to be measured, and at least a first detector (5) for detection of radiation transmitted from the source (3) to the first detector (5) through the measurement volume (4). The sensor comprises a path (6) of the radiation between radiation source (3) and first detector (5), wherein the radiation propagates along the path in a non-imaging way.

title_en: Composition comprising recombinant gpiba receptor protein
abstract_en: Various aspects of the invention relate to recombinant polypeptides that specifically bind human von Willebrand Factor. Such recombinant polypeptides typically include a modified extracellular domain of platelet glycoprotein Ibα that typically comprises at least one mutation selected from G233T, D235V, and K237V, and such recombinant polypeptides optionally include an oligomerization domain.

title_en: Cellulose and nanocellulose based bioinks
abstract_en: The present invention relates to cellulose and nanocellulose based bioinks and the methodology for production of laminar flow devices and electrodes for advanced control of fluidic components for biosensing applications.

title_en: Biomarkers and methods of use for radiation-induced lung injury
abstract_en: The present disclosure is directed to methods (e.g.,  in vitro  methods) for use of nicotinamide phosphoribosyltransferase (NAMPT) as a biomarker in radiation-induced lung injury (RILI). Provided herein is an  in vitro  method for the diagnosis, prognosis, and/or monitoring of RILI in a human subject by providing a tissue or plasma sample from the subject and detecting the level of NAMPT therein, wherein a higher level of NAMPT in the tissue or plasma sample from the subject compared to a healthy control or a reference value is indicative for the presence of RILI in the subject. Further provided herein is a method of detecting NAMPT in a human subject by obtaining a biological sample from the subject, detecting the presence of NAMPT in the sample by contacting the sample with a capture agent that specifically binds NAMPT, and detecting binding between NAMPT and the capture agent.

title_en: Rapid screening and evaluation method suitable for raw material of seaweed near-water beverage
abstract_en: A rapid screening and evaluation method for raw material of seaweed near water beverage, including: analyzing appearance, sense, and particle size of seaweed enzyme powder as raw material; analyzing appearance, sense, and percentage with molecular weight less than 10 thousand of a 3% seaweed stock solution obtained based on the seaweed enzyme powder; analyzing appearance, sense, turbidity, and functional ingredients of a first seaweed near water beverage obtained based on the 3% seaweed stock solution; analyzing appearance, sense, turbidity, and functional ingredients of an enhanced seaweed near water beverage; and combining comprehensive results obtained from the above analysis, the raw material of the seaweed near water beverage is rapidly screened and evaluated.

title_en: An improved process for the separation and analysis of pancreatic enzymes
abstract_en: Title: An improved process for the separation and analysis of pancreatic enzymes. The present invention relates to reversed phase ultrahigh-performance liquid chromatography (RP- UHPLC) process by using C18 column at a suitable more than one gradient of mobile phase useful for the separation and characterisation of pancreatic protein mixture comprising at least one enzyme lipase, amylase, protease and variant thereof. The present invention further provides qualitative and quantitative analysis of separated Pancreatic protein mixture suitable for pharmaceutical use.

title_en: Modular sensor device and system for in-vitro aerosol exposure
abstract_en: A sensor device for an aerosol exposure system for in-vitro exposure of a cell culture to a test atmosphere is described. The sensor device comprises a measurement compartment configured to receive a receptor element of an electrochemical sensor for detecting one or more constituents of the test atmosphere. The sensor device further comprises a receptor support arranged at an end of the measurement compartment and configured to support the receptor element of the electrochemical sensor. The sensor device further comprises a transducer element functionally couplable to the receptor element and configured to provide an electronically processable signal indicative of the one or more constituents in the test atmosphere.

title_en: Methods of detecting methylated cpg
abstract_en: Methods of detecting methylated CpG are provided. Accordingly, there is provided a method of determining CpG methylation status in a DNA sample, the method comprising: (a) subjecting the DNA sample to bisulfite conversion; (b) amplifying said DNA sample following said (a) to obtain an amplified DNA sample; (c) labeling CpG sites in said amplified DNA sample with a label to obtain a labeled DNA sample; (d) contacting said labeled DNA sample on an array comprising a plurality of probes for said DNA under conditions which allow specific hybridization between said plurality of probes and said DNA; and (e)detecting said hybridization, wherein an amount of said label is indicative of the CpG methylation status in said DNA sample.

title_en: Means and methods for determining the potential extent of brain injury
abstract_en: The present invention generally relates to diagnosis of brain injury. More specifically, the invention relates to a method for determining the potential extent of brain injury in a subject, comprising quantifying in a blood sample obtained from said subject the level of BD-tau, wherein the higher the level of BD-tau in comparison to the level of BD-tau of a healthy subject is, the greater is the potential extent of brain injury of said subject.

title_en: Image processing device, image processing method, and program
abstract_en: In order to improve accuracy in benignancy and malignancy classification on a specimen cell in pathological diagnosis, an image processing apparatus (1) includes: a first acquisition section (11) for acquiring a target image which includes a specimen cell as a subject; a second acquisition section (12) for acquiring property information which indicates a property of a training image that has been used to train a prediction model to predict, upon receipt of input of an image including a cell as a subject, whether the cell is a benign cell or a malignant cell; and a generation section (13) for generating an image by changing a property of the target image with reference to the property information.

title_en: Pregnancy clock proteins for predicting due date and time to birth
abstract_en: The present invention provides compositions and methods for due date and time to birth prediction for a pregnancy with significantly higher accuracy than current clinical methods. The compositions and methods for due date and time to birth prediction for a pregnancy can also identify those pregnancies that will deliver earlier than the due date derived from LMP and/or US dating.

title_en: A sampling device and a method for collecting microorganisms from the environment by chemotaxis
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a sampling device for collecting microorganisms from aquatic environments by chemotaxis comprising: a housing, at least one electronic control unit interacting with the housing / connected to the housing; and at least one rectangular cast that can be arranged within the housing wherein the cast is designed to receive at least one assay plate, preferably multiple assay plates (eight or more); wherein the at least one assay plate comprises at least one well, preferably up to 20 or more wells, filled with at least one chemoattractant compound, and wherein each well is connected to the outside by at least a port; wherein the cast is further designed to receive at least one sealing plate at least partially covering the at least one assay plate, wherein the sealing plate is designed to be moveable along the at least one assay plate between a first position, wherein the at least one sealing plate seals the port of the at least one well of the assay plate (sealing position / closed position), and a second position, wherein the at least one sealing plate opens the port of the at least one well of the assay plate (open position), and wherein the cast is connected to the at least one electronic control unit. The present invention relates also to a method for sampling microorganisms using said sampling device in any type of environment containing a liquid phase.

title_en: Test kit
abstract_en: The present invention provides a test device, including a test kit (300) and a sample collector (200). The test kit (300) includes a storage chamber (6), a bottom plate (7) with a sample injection port (3) is disposed in the storage chamber (6), an enclosure (5) is disposed on the periphery of the storage chamber (6), and a hole in communication with the interior of the test kit (300) is provided at the lower part of the enclosure or at the joint of the bottom plate (7) and the enclosure (5). The test device in the present invention can effectively prevent a liquid sample from spilling or splashing out of the sample storage chamber (6) in the process that the sample is squeezed into the test kit (6) from the sample collector, and the test kit (300) has a compact and small structure, and is very easy to carry, meeting on-site testing requirements for rapid sampling and point-of-care testing.

title_en: Soil monitoring
abstract_en: Soil Monitoring Soil testing apparatus (101), for use in determining an indicator of soil health, comprises a probe (102) having a penetrating tip (107) for insertion in soil (100) to be tested, a sensor (106) operatively connected to the probe (102) and configured to provide an output indicative of sensed vibration, and a processing unit (103), operatively connected to the sensor (106), configured to acquire data indicative of vibration sensed in the soil (100) to be tested after the probe (102) has been located in a sensing position in the soil (100), the processing unit (103) configured to receive the output indicative of sensed vibration and store data derived therefrom for processing to determine an indicator of soil health based on the sensed vibration. A soil bioacoustic or ecoacoustic meter that comprises the soil testing apparatus (101). A method of determining an indicator of soil health using the soil testing apparatus (101).

title_en: Use of ifn-i activity as a biomarker for tlr inhibitor treatment
abstract_en: The present invention provides for the use of IFN-I activity as a predictive biomarker for the treatment of patients with toll-like receptor (TLR) inhibitors and related uses and methods.

title_en: Extracellular vesicles, isolation and use as biomarkers
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to neuron derived extracellular vesicles and methods for their isolation as well as their use as biomarkers, including for neurodegenerative and/or neuropsychiatric diseases. The present disclosure also relates to identification of small non-coding RNA and their use for diagnosis and/or prognosis and/or therapy stratification.

title_en: Temperature history estimation device, temperature history estimation method, and temperature history estimation program
abstract_en: A temperature history of a rubber composition is estimated by a simple method. A temperature history estimation device (1) estimates a temperature history of a measurement object that is a rubber composition. The temperature history estimation device (1) includes a measurement value reception unit (101) that receives a measurement value of a carbonization rate of a polymer contained in the measurement object, a storage unit (20) that stores data (202) showing a relationship between a carbonization rate of a polymer contained in a sample of the rubber composition, and a temperature, and a temperature history estimation unit (102) that estimates the temperature history of the measurement object based on the measurement value of the carbonization rate and the data (202).

title_en: Methods and kits for preventing infusion reaction risk and antibody-mediated loss of response by monitoring serum uric acid during pegylated uricase therapy
abstract_en: Methods and kits for predicting infusion reaction risk and antibody-mediated loss of response during intravenous PEGylated uricase therapy in gout patients is provided. Routine SUA monitoring can be used to identify patients receiving PEGylated uricase who may no longer benefit from treatment and who are at greater risk for infusion reactions.

title_en: Materials and methods for evaluation of antigen presentation machinery components and uses thereof
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are compositions, systems, and methods for identifying subjects who may be responsive to MHC-I-dependent immunotherapeutic agents based upon the expression of the components of the antigen presentation machinery and, in particular, the expression of the constituent elements of the transporter associated with antigen processing complex and the major histocompatibility complex class I.

title_en: Quantitative colocalization assays to assess potency and efficacy of therapies targeting muscle disorders
abstract_en: The present invention relates to methods of assessing the functionality of a cellular molecule in a muscle cell, assessing potency of a compound to modulate the functionality of a cellular molecule in a muscle cell, predicting the ability of a compound to treat a muscular disease, monitoring the response to a therapeutic compound of a patient affected with a muscular disease, selecting a patient affected with a muscular disease for a treatment with a therapeutic compound or determining whether a patient affected with a muscular disease is susceptible to benefit from a treatment with a therapeutic compound, using quantitative colocalization assays.

title_en: Multimode systems and methods for analyzing cells
abstract_en: Extended duration cell analysis is provided via a device, comprising: a chamber configured to accept: a sample carrier, that includes a plurality of wells having electrodes in electrical communication with an impedance meter; and a cartridge, including a compound and at least one delivery port for the compound; a camera configured to capture images of a cell culture in each well via associated windows in the wells when the sample carrier is positioned at a first location; a fluid handler, in communication with the sample carrier and the cartridge when the sample carrier is positioned at a second location, configured to deliver the compound from the cartridge to a given well based on an impedance measurement of a sample in the given well; and a motion stage configured to move the sample carrier between the first location and the second location.

title_en: T cell phenotypes associated with response to adoptive cell therapy
abstract_en: Disclosed are methods of obtaining a cell population enriched for T cells with a phenotype, the method comprising: (a) obtaining a bulk population of T cells from a tumor sample of a patient; (b) specifically selecting T cells with a phenotype comprising markers CD3 + , CD39 - , and CD69 -  from the bulk population; and (c) separating the cells selected in (b) from cells which lack the phenotype to obtain a cell population enriched for T cells with the phenotype. Related methods of treating or preventing cancer, methods of selecting a therapy for a cancer patient, and methods for predicting the clinical response to immunotherapy in a cancer patient are also disclosed. Isolated or purified cell population obtained according to the methods and related pharmaceutical compositions are also disclosed.

title_en: Aging clock markers
abstract_en: The present invention relates to methods of assessing aging of the human body. It provides methods of determining a biological age of a subject, comprising obtaining first, second, and third activity variables of the subject and/ or analyzing a blood sample from the subject to determine the protein expression levels of at least one biomarker selected from the group consisting of PON1, C8B, SERPIND1, APOA2, A2M, APCS, and APOA1; and determining the biological age using the first, second, and third activity variables and/or the protein expression levels, and the chronological age of the subject. The invention also provides kits and devices for use in the methods.

title_en: Calibration and/or verification tool
abstract_en: The invention is directed to a calibration and/or verification tool, an assembly and a method for calibrating and/or verifying systems for measuring gas concentrations of gases that have diffused transcutaneously. The calibration and/or verification tool (1) is a tool for calibrating and/or verifying a system (100) for measuring gas concentrations, with a sensor (101) for detection of transcutaneous gas, comprising a contact face (102) which is directable towards a measuring site on the skin of a human or animal subject. The calibration and/or verification tool (1) comprises a compartment (2) for encompassing a reference environment (3), an interface (4) for connecting the sensor (101), such that the contact face (102) is exposed to the reference environment (3) in the compartment and means for providing a well-defined gas concentration in the compartment. The calibration and/or verification tool (1) is a mobile stand-alone device and preferably a single-use and/or a disposable device.

title_en: A diagnostic device and a method of use
abstract_en: Disclosed herein is a diagnostic device for colorimetrically indicating the presence of a species indicative of a disease in a liquid sample from a patient. The device comprises a container configured to receive the liquid sample, the container comprising an upper portion, a lower portion and a weakened portion therebetween. The upper portion comprises an opening configured to receive the liquid sample, and the lower portion is in fluid communication with the upper portion and configured to receive therein an ampoule containing a reagent which, when contacted with the liquid sample, colorimetrically indicates whether the liquid sample contains the species. The device also comprises a cap for sealing the container, the cap being configured for receipt at the opening of the upper portion and which, upon attachment thereto, cannot be detached. In use, bending of the container at the weakened portion breaks open the ampoule, whereupon the liquid sample and the reagent can mix and a colour of the resultant mixture is visible through a transparent portion (e.g. a transparent wall or walls) of the container.

title_en: Il-17 based therapy
abstract_en: In a first aspect, the present invention relates to a method of determining whether a subject who has been diagnosed with melanoma is amenable to a treatment with immune checkpoint inhibitor(s) ICI(s) wherein the method comprises determination of the level and/or amount of IL-17 in a biological sample obtained from the subject and drawing a conclusion as to the amenability of said subject to a treatment with ICI(s) from the level and/or amount of IL-17 determined in said biological sample. Moreover, the present invention relates to a method for determining the therapy regimen of a subject who has been diagnosed with melanoma whereby the therapy comprise a treatment with ICI(s). Said method includes the measurement of the level and/or amount of IL-17 in a biological sample obtained from the subject and concluding whether the therapy regimen of said subject is amenable to a treatment with ICI(s) from the determined level or amount of IL- 17. Moreover, a method for determining responsiveness of the subject has been diagnosed with melanoma to a treatment with ICI(s) is disclosed. In a further aspect, the present invention relates to the use of IL-17 for predicting response to ICI therapy and/or for stratification of ICI in a subject who has been diagnosed with melanoma, in particular, metastatic melanoma. Moreover, the present invention relates to a pharmaceutical composition comprising a combination of IL-17 with at least one the ICI, in particular, being selected from anti-PD1 ICI and anti-CTLA-4 ICI.

title_en: Detection system and vapour storage module
abstract_en: A detection system, a vapour storage module and a vapour generator for a detection apparatus, and a method of servicing a vapour generator are provided. A detection system comprises a detection apparatus and a removably coupled vapour storage module comprising: a vapour chamber to store a source of vapour; a flow passage comprising an inlet and an outlet to receive a carrier gas flow from, and provide an outlet flow to, the detection apparatus, the flow passage separated from the vapour chamber by a valve to control the passage of vapour; an absorbent material is configured to inhibit diffusion of vapour into the detection apparatus; and a housing comprising a first interface portion comprising a first connector at the inlet and a second connector at the outlet. The detection apparatus comprising a second interface portion configured to couple with the first interface portion to provide a sealed connection.

title_en: Optical system and exhaust gas monitoring system
abstract_en: The present disclosure refers to an optical fiber cable (101), comprising: at least one pair of fibers (110) in a ferrule (102), wherein fibers (111, 112, 121, 122) of the at least one pair of fibers (110) extend by different lengths (L1, L2) out of one end of the ferrule (102) in one direction of a common axis (A) for the fibers (111, 112, 121, 122) of the at least one pair of fibers (110), wherein the fibers (111, 112, 121, 122) of the at least one pair of fibers (110) are arranged with a common radial distance (CP) from the common axis (A), and wherein the common axis (A) is aligned in parallel with the length of the optical fiber cable (101). An optical system and an exhaust gas monitoring system are also provided.

title_en: Method and apparatus for monitoring a multiphase fluid
abstract_en: A magnetic induction tomographic (MIT) apparatus for monitoring multiphase fluid within a volume, comprises; a magnetic field generator to generate a magnetic field within the fluid which varies temporally according to at least one frequency; a voltage detector to measure an induced complex voltage from at least one phase of the fluid; a processor for determining amplitude and phase angle of the complex voltage to provide amplitude data and phase angle data; a data processor for calculating first output data from the amplitude data and second output data from the phase angle data, the first output data is a function of permittivity and conductivity of the at least one phase of the fluid and the second output data is a function of conductivity of the at least one phase of the fluid; and an analyser for processing the output data to generate data representing at least one property of at least one electrically non-conductive phase in the fluid and at least one property of at least one electrically conductive phase in the fluid.

title_en: Diagnosis of acute and chronic q fever through recombinant antigens and electrochemical impedance sensor
abstract_en: The invention relates to the differential diagnosis of chronic from acute Q fever by means of recombinant antigenic proteins and electrochemical impedance sensors. It is a direct diagnostic tool for the diagnosis of chronic and acute Q fever in humans. It consists of an electrochemical impedance spectroscopy biosensor the operation of which is based on the immobilization of recombinant antigenic proteins on the surface of a gold electrode. These proteins have the ability to recognize antibodies against the pathogen that causes Q fever (Coxiella burnetii) due to their antigenic character. Then, the produced biosensor is immersed in a solution containing blood serum from prospective patients and if there are antibodies against the disease, an immunological interaction with the respective antigen takes place, resulting in the change of the electrochemical impedance signal of the biosensor and finally in the laboratory diagnosis of the disease.  ?

title_en: Method for determining responsiveness of cancer patient to immune checkpoint inhibitor
abstract_en: To provide a method for determining responsiveness of a cancer patient to an immune checkpoint inhibitor, and also provide a novel cancer treatment method.SOLUTION: A method for determining responsiveness of a cancer patient to an immune checkpoint inhibitor comprises determining the responsiveness of a cancer patient to an immune checkpoint inhibitor based on the level of at least one short-chain fatty acid in a sample taken from the patient. In addition, a cancer treatment method comprises administering an immune checkpoint inhibitor to a cancer patient who is determined to have responsiveness to the immune checkpoint inhibitor by the above determination method.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 17

title_en: Blood-based screen for detecting neurological diseases in primary care settings
abstract_en: To provide methods and kits for diagnosing a neurological disease within primary care settings.SOLUTION: The invention comprises the steps of: obtaining a blood test sample from a subject; measuring IL-7 and TNFα biomarkers in the blood sample; comparing the level of the one or a combination of biomarkers and neurocognitive screening tests with the level of a corresponding one or combination of biomarkers in a normal blood sample and neurocognitive screening tests; and predicting that an increase in the level of the blood test sample in relation to that of the normal blood sample indicates that the subject is likely to have a neurological disease.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Compositions and Methods for Treating Subjects with Immune-Mediated Diseases
abstract_en: To provide methods, assays and systems for selecting subjects with immune-mediated diseases who would optimally respond to anti-FcRn therapies and administering effective amounts of compositions comprising anti-FcRn agents for treating, inhibiting and/or reducing the symptoms of immune-mediated diseases in subjects.SOLUTION: An assay method is provided, comprising: (i) providing a biological sample from a subject suspected of having an immune-mediated disease; (ii) assaying the sample to determine the levels of total IgG, a subclass of IgG, and/or antigen-specific IgG in the sample; and (iii) prescribing a first therapy to the subject if the subject has elevated levels of total IgG, elevated levels of a subclass of IgG and/or increased levels of an antigen specific IgG relative to reference values.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 18

title_en: Device for estimating state of skin
abstract_en: To provide a device that can estimate the state of skin by easier procedures.SOLUTION: The estimation device includes an image acquisition unit and an estimation unit. The image estimation unit acquires an image of a sample of a horny layer collected from the surface of skin taken by a microscope. The estimation unit derives output from a machine learning model by inputting the acquired image into a learned machine learning model, and estimates at least one of an index showing the state of the skin and advice on a daily care suitable for the skin on the basis of the output.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title_en: Substance estimation device, total reflection illumination microscope, substance estimation method and program
abstract_en: To provide a substance estimation device which can highly accurately estimate an image of a substance captured by a capturing body, and provide a total reflection illumination microscope, a substance estimation method and a program.SOLUTION: A substance estimation device comprises: an acquisition unit which acquires a photographed image of a composite body; and a calculation unit which calculates an estimation image of a substance being any of transfer factor, transmitter substance, transfer carrier and antigen captured by a capturing body on the basis of the photographed image of the composite body acquired by the acquisition unit. The calculation unit calculates the estimation image of the substance captured by the capturing body by executing deconvolution to the photographed image of the composite body. The substance captured by the capturing body is the substance obtained by capturing the substance emitted from a substance emission source in the liquid solution including a phosphor by the capturing body arranged on a bottom portion of the liquid solution. The composite body is formed by coupling the substance captured by the capturing body to the phosphor in the liquid solution.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Antibody detection method, method for detecting antibody production cell, and antibody detection kit
abstract_en: To provide a new method for detecting an antibody, capable of broadly detecting an isotype of human antibody IgG.SOLUTION: An antibody detection method includes a step of preparing a reaction system including a test sample, a FRET donor reagent excited by excitation light, and a FRET acceptor reagent that emits light by excitation energy of the FRET donor reagent; a step of irradiating the reaction system with excitation light; a step of detecting light emission of the FRET acceptor reagent in the reaction system; and a step of detecting the presence or absence of an antibody in the test sample according to the presence or absence of the light emission, in which the FRET donor reagent is a conjugate including Protein G to be bonded to an FB region of human IgG and an excitation substance to be exited by excitation light, and the FRET acceptor reagent is a conjugate including an antibody fragment and a light-emitting substance that emits light by excitation energy, and the antibody fragment is a VHH fragment derived from a camel antibody with a CH1 region or λ light chain of human IgG as an antigen.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Method and measurement reagent for measuring adrenomedullins
abstract_en: To provide a test method and a test reagent for equivalently quantifying AMs secreted from a patient and an externally administered AM analog, covering only active AMs, to administer an optimal dose of the AM analog so as to keep the dose optimal during treatment with the AM analog.SOLUTION: A method and a test reagent are provided for equivalently quantifying endogenous AMs and an administered AM analog in a human specimen, covering only active AMs, to administer an optimal dose of the AM analog.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Method of treating patients with hepatorenal syndrome type 1
abstract_en:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a method of treating patients with hepatorenal syndrome type 1 (HRS type 1 or HRS-1). 
     SOLUTION: The present invention avoids unnecessary administration of a drug to patients who are critically ill because of the surprising discovery that terlipressin is very effective in patients exhibiting certain criteria but is not effective in patients that do not meet these criteria. Principles and embodiments of the present disclosure relate generally to methods of treating HRS-1 patients by administering terlipressin to obtain reversal of the HRS-1. title_en: Magnetic particle and its manufacturing method
abstract_en: To provide magnetic particles in which a magnetic coated layer is difficult to be peeled from the magnetic particles and magnetic field is strong.SOLUTION: A magnetic particle comprising a core particle and a magnetic coating layer formed on the surface of the core particle, wherein the core particle is a porous material having an exclusion limit molecular weight of 500 or more. In a preferred embodiment, the magnetic coating layer contains iron oxide. In another preferred embodiment, the magnetic particles have a particle size of 0.1 μm or more and 1000 μm or less. In another preferred embodiment, the porous material is a polysaccharide such as cellulose or a derivative thereof.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Chemical composition and method for using the same

PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a probe for sequencing, a reporter probe and a method in which nucleic acid sequencing that is quickly executed with no enzyme, no amplification and no library, and has a low error rate with a long read-out length. 
     SOLUTION: A probe including a primary nucleic acid molecule which hybridizes with at least six secondary nucleic acid molecules, in which each of the plurality of secondary nucleic acid molecules hybridizes with at least five tertiary nucleic acid molecules, and each of the tertiary nucleic acid molecules includes at least one detectable label.

abstract_en:

     SOLUTION: The present invention provides a method for analyzing an amino acid of a C terminal of a polypeptide. title_en: Granzyme B directed imaging and therapy
abstract_en:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide compounds useful for imaging granzyme B, which is useful as a radiotracer for position emission tomography (PET) and/or single photon emission tomography (SPECT) imaging.

abstract_en:

A method of obtaining peptide binding data comprises steps of; obtaining a peptide array having at least 10,000 peptide features per square millimeter; contacting the array with a sample containing a plurality of ligands for at least a subset of the 100,000 peptide features under condition that promote ligand binding; and imaging the array to identify binding of the plurality of ligands to the peptide array.

title_en: Alcohol detector and alcohol inspection system having the same
abstract_en: To provide a technique which can more surely prevent a fraudulent alcohol inspection by spoofing.SOLUTION: An alcohol detector 10 detects the alcohol concentration contained in the exhaled air blown by a subject. The alcohol detector 10 comprises: a housing 100; a display unit 111a; and an attachment part 110. The housing 100 has a plurality of surfaces. The display part 111a is imaged by an external imaging device when the subject blows the exhaled air and is provided on one surface 100b of the housing 100. The attachment part 110 is attached with an exhaled air blowing member for blowing the exhaled air into the housing 100 from any surface in the housing 100. The attachment part is arranged at a position where at least a portion thereof is visually recognized when seen from one surface side.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2B

title_en: Inspection method for disease or health status and inspection system
abstract_en: Although the use of principal component analysis to identify disease provides greater accuracy in identifying a given disease than conventional clinical markers, it is still inadequate, and even greater accuracy is needed.SOLUTION: An inspection method for a disease or health status comprises a first step, a second step, a third step, and a fourth step. The first step extract the biomarker 50 from the biological sample 40. The second step ionizes the extracted biomarker 50. The third step is by flowing the ionized biomarker 50 between two electrodes to give the two electrodes a plurality of electrical signals to obtain a three-dimensional profile 22. The fourth step identifies a given disease using a discriminator 342 obtained by learning to associate the 3D profile 22 with the type of disease.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Measuring method and measuring system
abstract_en: To provide a measuring method capable of easily measuring the amount of a target substance in a sample.SOLUTION: The measuring method includes the steps of: capturing composite particles 13 onto the electrode by acting dielectrophoresis by applying an electric field to a sample 10 including the composite particles 13 in which target substances 11 are bound to dielectric particles 12 modified with a substance that specifically binds to the target substance 11 using an electrode (electrode set 1111); moving the composite particles 13 by dielectrophoresis by applying an AC voltage of a given frequency to the electrode; measuring the moving speed of the composite particles 13; and measuring the amount of the target substances 11 bound to the composite particles 13 based on the measured moving speed of the composite particles 13 and the correlation between the amount of the target substances 11 bound to the composite particles 13 and the moving speed of the composite particles 13.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Time-resolved laser-induced fluorescence spectroscopy systems and uses thereof
abstract_en: To provide systems for characterizing a biological sample by analyzing emission of fluorescent light from the biological sample upon excitation and methods for using the same.SOLUTION: A biological sample 101 is projected with pulsed laser of an excitation source 100. A fluorescence signal from the biological sample is relayed through a collection fiber CF to a demultiplexer and resolved into a number of narrow spectral bands, each with a distinct central wavelength. Further, spectral bands time-delayed by a delay device 105 arrive at multi-channel plate photomultiplier tubes (MCP-PMTs) 106 at different time points, allowing detection of a decay profile of each spectral band.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1A

title_en: Cell mediated immune response assay
abstract_en: To provide sensitive and reliable methods for measuring cell-mediated immune responsiveness, and kits and kit components which are storage-stable.SOLUTION: The present disclosure teaches diagnosis of exposure of a subject animal to an antigen based on cell-mediated immunoresponsiveness with enhanced sensitivity. The enhanced sensitivity is achieved by adding a non-reducing sugar during incubation of a sample with the antigen. The use of a non-reducing sugar instead of a simple sugar significantly increases the storage stability of assay components.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Method for processing information, computer program, and information processor
abstract_en: To provide a method for processing information that can output thrombosis information related to the state of the inside of a local vessel of a patient or cancer cell information of a patient.SOLUTION: A computer performs processing of acquiring image data obtained by imaging a thrombosis material or a cancer cell in a vessel acquired from a patient by a catheter device, and outputting thrombosis information on a thrombosis of the patient or cancer cell information on a cancer cell of the patient on the basis of the acquired image data.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Biological aging level assessment method
abstract_en: To provide a biological aging level assessment method using an indicator that enables objective and accurate assessment of the biological aging level.SOLUTION: A biological aging level assessment method and an assessment kit are provided, the method using the expression level of one or more proteins selected from Fractalkine, IL-1α, TNF-α, and CD30L in a biological sample as an indicator.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Immunosensor, and antibody recycling method
abstract_en: To provide an immunosensor that can be repeatedly and continuously used and can be reduced in a size, and an antibody recycling method in the immunosensor.SOLUTION: An immunosensor 1 comprises: a recycling unit 2 that has at least one flow channel 21, at least one liquid storage unit 22, an electrolytic film 23 that is interposed between the flow channel 21 and liquid storage unit 22, a first electrode 24 that is arranged in the flow channel 21, and a second electrode 25 that is arranged in the liquid storage unit 22; voltage application means 3 that applies a voltage to the two electrodes; an antibody 4 that is arranged in the flow channel 21; and detection means 5 that detects an antigen 110 captured by the antibody 4. The flow channel 21 and the liquid storage unit 22 are adjacent and joined to each other with the electrolytic film 23 therebetween in an area 7. The flow channel 21 is a flow channel that causes a sample solution 120 including the antigen 110 to flow, and the liquid storage unit 22 is a container or a flow channel that stores liquid 130.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Tactile sense evaluation method and tactile sense measuring device
abstract_en: To provide a technology to objectively evaluate a tactile sense on the basis of measurement of a vibration having a relatively high frequency.SOLUTION: A tactile sense evaluation method includes: a contact step of bringing a finger pulp part into contact with an object surface; a measurement step of measuring at least any one of the acceleration of a nail corresponding to the finger pulp part and the angular speed of the nail; a data acquisition step of acquiring measurement data measured in the measurement step; a data recording step of recording a change with time of the measurement data; and an evaluation step of evaluating the object surface by using data for evaluation, wherein the data for evaluation is measurement data recorded in the data recording step or data based on the measurement data.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Method for evaluating status of primary cilia in immune-related cells and its application techniques
abstract_en: To provide a method for evaluating the status of primary cilia in immune-related cells and its application techniques.SOLUTION: The present invention provides a method for evaluating the status of primary cilia in immune-related cells, with the expression levels of EDNRA and/or TGFb2 in immune-related cells as an index.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Estimation method, estimation device, estimation system, and computer program
abstract_en: To enable estimation of properties of a metallic material containing predetermined ingredients.SOLUTION: An estimation method is provided, comprising a control step of using trained model information obtained by performing learning processing in advance using teacher data including condition information showing conditions regarding metallic materials and information showing sulfuric acid corrosion resistance of metallic materials meeting the conditions indicated by the condition information to estimate sulfuric acid corrosion resistance of an estimation target metallic material meeting the condition information.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Sensor body for binding and/or condensing and/or detecting analyte in sample
abstract_en: To provide a sensor body for binding and/or condensing an analyte.SOLUTION: A sensor body for binding and/or condensing an analyte includes a porous polymer scaffold and an interstitial pore space in the polymer scaffold. The porous polymer scaffold is composed of a polymer capable of responding to a change in at least one external condition to which the sensor body is exposed, for example, pH, temperature, salt conditions, and the existence or nonexistence of a chemical substance, and one or more capture agents for the analyte adhere to the porous polymer scaffold.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Tree soundness determination system
abstract_en: To provide a tree soundness determination system that can easily determine the soundness of trees.SOLUTION: A tree soundness determination system 1 includes: an illumination unit 2 that irradiates a tree T with measurement light having a wavelength in a near-infrared region; a camera 3 that receives reflection light obtained by reflecting the measurement light by the tree T and captures a near-infrared image; a calculation unit 41 that calculates the reflection intensity of the reflection light at a wavelength of about 1,450 nm that is absorbed by moisture in the tree T based on the near-infrared image; and a determination unit 42 that determines the soundness of the tree T from the reflection intensity at a wavelength of about 1,450 nm calculated by the calculation unit 41 based on a relation between the reflection intensity and the soundness of the tree T, which has been stored in advance.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Methods and pharmaceutical compositions for enhancing cd8 positive t cell-dependent immune responses in patients suffering from cancer
abstract_en: To provide methods and pharmaceutical compositions for enhancing CD8-positive T cell-dependent immune responses in patients suffering from cancer.SOLUTION: There is provided a method for increasing an amount of tumor-infiltrating CD8 positive T cells in a patient afflicted with cancer comprising administering a therapeutically effective amount of a NRP-1 inhibitor. Also there is provided a method for treating cancer in a patient in need thereof, comprising administering a therapeutically effective combination of an immune checkpoint inhibitor and a NRP-1 inhibitor thereby enhancing therapeutic efficacy relative to the administration of the immune checkpoint inhibitor alone.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Computer program, crystal grain size evaluation device, and crystal grain size evaluation method
abstract_en: To provide a computer program and the like that improve efficiency and reduce personal dependency.SOLUTION: A computer program causes a computer to perform processing of inputting a tissue image of a sample to an object detection model that detects a crystal grain boundary from the tissue image of the sample, detecting the crystal grain boundary in the tissue image, and determining the crystal grain size on the basis of the detected crystal grain boundary.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Antigen peptide, nucleic acid, vector, hla/antigen peptide complex, detection reagent, and pharmaceutical composition
abstract_en: To provide a novel peptide that can be used for detecting the sub-groove of HTLV-1 Tax.SOLUTION: An antigen peptide derived from the Tax protein encoded by HTLV-1 in the present disclosure includes a polypeptide of (P1), (P2), or (P3) defined below: (P1) a polypeptide consisting of at least one amino acid sequence of SEQ ID NO: 1 (SFHSLHLLF) and SEQ ID NO: 2 (SFHNLHLLF); (P2) a polypeptide consisting of an amino acid sequence in which the fourth amino acid from the N-terminus in (P1) is maintained and 1 to 3 amino acids are deleted, inserted, substituted, or added in the amino acid sequence of (P1); (P3) a polypeptide consisting of an amino acid sequence in which the fourth amino acid from the N-terminus in (P1) is maintained and which exhibits 80% or greater sequence identity to the amino acid sequence of (P1).SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Method, solution and kit for preparing tissue sample for 3d imaging
abstract_en: To provide methods of preparing tissue samples for 3D imaging, which facilitate the use of a wider range of antibodies for immunolabeling of samples.SOLUTION: A method of preparing a tissue sample for 3D imaging is provided, the method comprising treating the tissue sample with a solution containing a buffer solution with pH below 9 and a detergent.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Composition comprising circadian rhythm period extending agent, and use thereof
abstract_en: To provide a composition that enables improvement of a cancer microenvironment, suppression of immune exclusion, inhibition of fibroblast differentiation, promotion of T cell infiltration into tumor tissue, or enhancement of the anti-cancer effect of an immune checkpoint inhibitor.SOLUTION: A composition comprising a circadian rhythm period extending agent for use in at least one selected from the group consisting of improvement of a cancer microenvironment, suppression of immune exclusion, inhibition of fibroblast differentiation, promotion of T cell infiltration into tumor tissue, and enhancement of the anti-cancer effect of an immune checkpoint inhibitor.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Automatic dyeing device and automatic dyeing substance estimation system
abstract_en: To provide an automatic dyeing device capable of estimating dyeing substances.SOLUTION: A device includes a holder 201, a moving unit 202, a dyeing reagent supply unit 203, and a control unit 204. The holder 201 is capable of holding a glass slide 10, and the glass slide 10 is smeared with a sample collected from a living organism to be tested. The moving unit 202 is connected to the holder 201 and is capable of moving the holder 201. The dyeing reagent supply unit 203 includes multiple reagent dropping units 2031, and the multiple reagent dropping units 2031 are arranged side by side according to a dyeing process. Each of the multiple reagent dropping units 2031 is capable of dropping one type of reagent according to the dyeing process. The holder 201 is arranged below the reagent dropping units 2031. The control unit 204 controls the moving unit 202 to move the holder 201 to a position below the reagent dropping units 2031 that can drop the reagent required to be supplied to the glass slide 10 according to the dyeing process.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title_en: Method and kit for measuring N-terminal fragment of human brain natriuretic peptide precursor
abstract_en: To provide a method of measuring an N-terminal fragment of a human brain natriuretic peptide precursor, which reduces the effect of a duration from collection of a sample till detection on separation property of a complex, and to provide a measurement kit for implementing the above method.SOLUTION: A method of measuring a human brain natriuretic peptide precursor N-terminal fragment in a sample is provided, the method comprising separating a complex containing the human brain natriuretic peptide precursor N-terminal fragment and a substance binding to the human brain natriuretic peptide precursor N-terminal fragment in the presence of a polyanionic polymer, and measuring the complex, where the concentration of the polyanionic polymer in a separation medium is 5.1% (w/v) or greater.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Body condition evaluation method using urine test kit, body condition evaluation system, body condition evaluation program, and urine test kit used therefor
abstract_en: To provide a physical condition evaluation method capable of quickly and easily analyzing the physical condition of a subject by using a prescribed urine test kit and utilizing information obtained by a urine test in all fields.SOLUTION: This method has a step for bringing the urine of a subject into contact with a reaction pad arranged in a prescribed urine test kit, a step for photographing the reaction pad by an imaging means, a step for analyzing the urine on the basis of the photographed image of the pad and a step for evaluating the state of the body of the subject from the result of the analysis.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Low power water quality and quantity measurement system for water distribution networks
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, a low power water quality and quantity measurement system for water distribution networks, which measures the water quality and quantity of the water distribution networks. The low power water quality and quantity measurement system includes: a water quantity sensor unit for generating quantity information by measuring the quantity of the water distribution networks; a water quality sensor unit which measures the water quality of the water distribution networks and generates water quality information; a control unit which obtains the water quality information and the quantity information from the water quantity sensor unit and the water quality sensor unit, and calculates management information according to a predetermined condition based on the water quality information and the quantity information; and a communication unit which transmits the management information to an external device. Therefore, it is possible to measure the water quality and quantity of the water distribution networks efficiently with low power consumption.

title_en: Biomarker for Identification of Camel-origin MERS Coronavirus Species Prone to Spreading in Human Networks and uses thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a biomarker for identifying or detecting the Middle East respiratory syndrome coronavirus (MERS-CoV) and, more specifically, to a technology using a specific protein variant of the MERS-CoV and a gene sequence encoding the variant as a biomarker for identifying or detecting the human-infected MERS-CoV. When a user uses a variant of the MERS-CoV ORF4b protein as a biomarker, the user can identify or detect the MERS-CoV that easily infects the human body, thereby preventing the infection in advance.

title_en: Method for evaluating energy performance efficiency of aerator used in sewage and wastewater treatment process
abstract_en: Disclosed is a method of evaluating energy performance efficiency of an aerator. The method includes the following steps of: filling a water tank, in which an aerator is installed, with test water such that the aerator is submerged, and removing dissolved oxygen from the test water; measuring an initial dissolved oxygen concentration of the test water on a sampling position in the water tank; operating the aerator to lead the test water in the water tank to be introduced, and aerating and stirring the introduced test water to discharge the water into the water tank, and measuring a dissolved oxygen concentration per time on the sampling position; measuring a power consumption amount and a total air blowing amount during the operation of the aerator; calculating a standard oxygen delivery amount and an oxygen supply amount based on the measured initial dissolved oxygen concentration, the dissolved oxygen concentration per time, and the total air blowing amount; calculating standard oxygen delivery efficiency based on the calculated standard oxygen delivery amount and the oxygen supply amount; and calculating energy performance efficiency based on the measured power consumption amount and the calculated standard oxygen delivery efficiency. Therefore, the present invention is capable of evaluating energy performance efficiency such as load variation-based energy performance efficiency, consumption output variation-based energy performance efficiency and performance guarantee-based energy performance efficiency.

title_en: Water Sampler
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a water sampler having an opening and closing unit in both directions. More specifically, the water sampler comprises: a sample storage unit (100) for storing a sample for analyzing water quality; and a handle (200) mounted in the sample storage unit (100). The sample storage unit (100) has the opening and closing unit in both directions.

title_en: Display type concrete carbonation tester for structure insptection
abstract_en: A concrete carbonation test device for diagnosing a structure comprises a slider(50) which is attached to the side of a drill body(22); a settling plate(41) which is attached to the hypotenuse of a right triangle triangle plate(30); a slot hole(33) which is formed inside the triangle plate(30); a combination rod(55) which is combined with the slot hole; a scale(34) which is marked on the surface of the triangle plate(30); an indicator(58) which is attached to the upper end of the combination rod(55); and the drill body(22) and a bit(20) which are moved in a direction parallel to the slot hole(33). According to the present invention, an entry direction of the drill bit (20) can be set to be inclined with respect to a surface of the specimen (10), accuracy of measuring a carbonation depth can be remarkably improved, a measurement error of the carbonation depth can be minimized, and test accuracy can be improved.

title_en: Polymer-based fluorescent nanoparticle, method for preparing the same, and highly sensitive bio-sensor using the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a polymer-based fluorescent nanoparticle, a production method thereof, and a high-sensitivity biosensor using the same. More specifically, the present invention relates to a polymer fluorescent nanoparticle comprising: an amphiphilic compound having a hydrophobic region composed of fluorescein-O-methacrylate and a hydrophilic region composed of methyl methacrylate acid; and a protein anchoring region composed of N-Acryloxysuccinimide. In addition to simplifying a process including two or more steps generally used in the production of conventional fluorescent polymers into a single process (one-pot synthesis), it is possible to improve the dispersibility and stability of fluorescent polymer nanoparticles. The polymer-based fluorescent nanoparticles exhibits significantly enhanced fluorescence intensity, and thus can be used for high-sensitivity biosensors.

title_en: Method for simultaneously detecting enzyme using mixed substrate
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for simultaneously detecting enzymes using a mixed substrate. According to the present invention, the method can detect amylase and protease by using a mixed substrate plate containing starch and skim milk or a mixed substrate gel containing starch and fibrinogen and provides an effect of simultaneously detecting two different enzymes (amylase and protease) for each substrate mixed in the mixed substrate on a single plate or on a single gel. Through this, amylase or protease are simultaneously detected from bacteria, the method is expected to be usefully used in enzyme-related research fields such as enzyme screening and purification and the like. The method comprises a sample processing step and a decomposition checking step.

title_en: Biomarker composition for diagnosis of brain diseases due to blood-brain barrier degeneration
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a biomarker composition for diagnosing brain diseases caused by brain microvascular damage and, more specifically, to a method for preparing an animal model with brain diseases caused by brain microvascular damage by precisely classifying a local brain region based on an MRI image and inducing blood-brain barrier degeneration only in the local region, a method for screening a biomarker for diagnosing brain diseases caused by brain microvascular damage due to blood-brain barrier degeneration using the animal model, and a biomarker composition for diagnosing brain diseases caused by brain microvascular damage due to blood-brain barrier degeneration.

title_en: Inkjet printing apparatus, method of printing dipolar elements and method of fabricating display device
abstract_en: Provided are an inkjet printing apparatus, a method of printing a bipolar element, and a method of manufacturing a display device. According to the present invention, the inkjet printing apparatus comprises: an inkjet head including a stage, and a plurality of nozzles positioned above the stage and through which ink including a bipolar element extending in one direction is discharged; an ink circulation unit which supplies the ink to the inkjet head and supplies the remaining ink after being discharged from the inkjet head; and at least one sensing unit disposed between the inkjet head and the ink circulation unit and configured to measure the number of the bipolar elements discharged through the nozzle.

title_en: Compositions for the prevention or treatment of Alzheimer's disease and methods of preventing and treating Alzheimer's disease using the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a composition for preventing or treating Alzheimer's disease, and the present invention can inhibit the production of amyloid beta by changing the intestinal microbial environment of a patient, so it is possible to prevent Alzheimer's disease in advance before the outbreak of diseases, there is no side effect, and the access to treatment is excellent. The present invention relates to a pharmaceutical composition for preventing or treating Alzheimer's disease, containing butyric acid.

title_en: Application of α-synuclein for Diagnosing of Alzheimer's Disease and Improving Diagnosis of Alzheimer's Disease and Differential Diagnosis to Similar Degenerative Brain Diseases
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for diagnosing Alzheimer's disease using alpha-synuclein. The method of the present invention experimentally confirmed the possibility of diagnosing Alzheimer's disease according to various biomarker combinations, thus increasing the diagnostic accuracy of Alzheimer's disease patients, and enabling a diagnosis with higher sensitivity even in the early stages of the disease. In particular, through a specific biomarker combination (alpha-synuclein and tau), it is possible to diagnose Alzheimer's disease in patients with pathophysiologically suspected non-Alzheimer's disease (SNAP), and provide differentiated results from Lewy body dementia, Parkinson's disease, Parkinson's dementia, etc., in which synuclein is involved.

title_en: Antigen protein composition for diagnosing infection of African Swan Fever and use thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an antigen protein composition for diagnosing infection of an African swan fever virus and a use thereof. According to the present invention, a method and kit for diagnosing infection of the African swine fever virus using the antigenic protein uses the antigen protein of a specific African swine fever virus to rapidly and conveniently diagnose the infection of the African swine fever virus with high specificity and sensitivity, and exhibits excellent diagnostic effect in distinguishing it from other diseases with similar clinical pathology.

title_en: Photoactive Phosphor Probe and Cancer Cell Detection Method Using the Same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for detecting a photoactive phosphor probe, wherein the photoactive phosphor probe contains a compound represented by chemical formula 1 and several biomarkers, and the present invention includes contents about a method for detecting cancer cells by spatiotemporal manipulation in actual cell experiments. According to the present invention, since the photoactive phosphor probe is manufactured to diagnose cancer or enter mitochondria by introducing a biomarker into a photoactive composition selectively releasing a drug due to structural transformation by light in ex vivo or in vivo, diagnosis of cancer cells and drugs such as antibiotics, anticancer drugs, or inhibitors are introduced, so as to provide an effect of being usefully used for spatiotemporal treatment of cancer through drug release only by structural modification by light in a specific wavelength region.

title_en: Blockchain-based health monitoring system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a blockchain-based health monitoring system to ensure that recorded data can be kept immutable while guaranteeing a user's right to be forgotten. According to the present invention, a health supervision system (1) comprises: an identification station (10) configured to obtain at least one first data item (D1) representing an identity of a user; a health station (12) configured to obtain at least one second data item (D2) representing the health status of the identified user; one or more local data repositories (14); and a control unit (16). The control unit is configured to receive at least one first data item (D1) and at least one second data item (D2); use a cryptographic function to calculate a character string (D3) as a function of the at least one first data item (D1) and/or the at least one second data item (D2); store the at least one first data item (D1) and/or the at least one second data item (D2) in at least one local data repository (14); and transmit the string (D3) to a distributed architecture database (18) of a distributed ledger type to write the string (D3) to the distributed architecture database (18).

title_en: LEPRE1 EGFR inhibitor’companion diagnostic biomarker
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system that verifies results predicted by genetic biomarker labeling scan (GBLscan), which is a new learning model that can reliably predict the sensitivity of a drug by analyzing the combination of gene mutation and expression information and the molecular profile of the drug, and a biomarker discovered through verification. The present invention is largely composed of a verification system that verifies through an experiment whether the expression level of a specific gene predicted by GBLscan affects drug sensitivity, and a biomarker discovered through verification. Overexpression of LEPRE1 gene in hematological cancer cell lines shows high reactivity to the EGFR TK inhibitor Peletinib, and LEPRE1 expression-inhibited cells become resistant to Peletinib. In addition, for this verification, a verification system that is expected to be used for other biomarker candidates in the future, such as Western blot, expression inhibition experiment using siRNA, and overexpression and expression inhibition experiment using electroporation, was constructed.

title_en: Biomarker for identification of exposure to high temperature stress using pig saliva, and use thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a biomarker for identifying whether a pig is exposed to high-temperature stress using pig saliva and use thereof. More specifically, through metabolomic analysis of pig saliva exposed to high-temperature stress, it was confirmed that the concentrations of glutamate and leucine metabolites, which are metabolites in saliva of male and female pigs, were changed, the concentrations of phosphocholine and creatine, which are metabolites in saliva of male pigs exposed to high-temperature stress, are decreased, and the concentration of dimethylamine or creatine phosphate, which are metabolites in the saliva of female pigs exposed to high-temperature stress, is increased. Accordingly, using same, it is possible to check whether a pig is exposed to high-temperature stress in a non-invasive way.

title_en: Antibodies for binding to g-protein coupled receptor 87
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a novel antibody that binds to human GPR87 and inhibits a signal transduction process. The antibody specific to the extracellular domain of GPR87 or a fragment having immunological activity thereof according to the present invention binds specifically to the N-terminal extracellular domain of GPR87, and has functional efficacy against GPR87 in a concentration-dependent manner. Since the infiltration of lung cancer cells in which GPR87 is overexpressed can be inhibited, This can be usefully used for cancer treatment through GPR87 inhibition, the present invention can be usefully used for cancer treatment through GPR87 inhibition, and be also effective in imaging and diagnostic fields to verify the presence and degree of GPR87 expression.

title_en: Rapid bio diagnostic kit
abstract_en: The present invention provides a rapid bio-diagnostic kit which comprises: a first substrate (100) having a first through-hole (103) formed in a part of a body (105); a second substrate (200) coupled to a lower surface of the first substrate (100), having a second through-hole (204) formed in the part of the body, and having a circuit pattern formed thereon; and a third substrate (300) coupled to a lower surface of the second substrate (200). The present invention can fundamentally block the leakage of an electrolyte solution through a positive electrode and a negative electrode in contact with the electrolyte solution.

title_en: Biomarker fo determining major depressive disorder and bipolar disorder based on mass spectrometry and its use
abstract_en: Disclosed in the present invention is a biomarker panel capable of detecting whether a subject has major depressive disorder or a bipolar disorder in a blood sample by mass spectrometry. The panel according to the present invention can provide information using blood and thus can slow down the progression of a disorder, thereby contributing to the improvement of the quality of life of a patient as well as the reduction of social and economic costs that may be added as the disorder worsens. Provided in the present invention is a biomarker composition for distinguishing depressive disorders and bipolar disorders, including substances for measuring biomarker expression levels by mass spectrometry.

title_en: A method of predicting a prognosis and a response to anticancer therapy of cancer patients
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for predicting a prognosis or a response to anticancer therapy of cancer patients, which is able to predict precise prognosis and response to anticancer therapy by measuring a ratio of specific CD8^+ T cell subsets. In particular, the present invention provides a system which applies machine learning to the prediction method to rapidly and conveniently calculate chances that patients represent responses to anticancer therapy, thereby predicting anticancer therapy-responses of cancer patients more efficiently. Particularly, the prediction method according to the present invention uses non-invasive samples, thereby enabling rapid and precise prognosis prediction without cancer tissue analysis.

title_en: Method and device for analyzing vibration based on phase
abstract_en: A disclosed technology relates to a method and a device for analyzing phase-based vibration, comprising steps of: extracting, by an analysis device, phases of a vibrating object by inputting first and second consecutive frames from an image of the vibrating object to a filter bank; determining, by the analysis device, whether or not a pixel within a region of interest is vibrated by calculating a phase difference between the phase of the first frame and the phase of the second frame; calculating, by the analysis device, an optical flow according to time of the pixel determined to be vibrating; and converting, by the analysis device, the optical flow into an actual amount of vibration using a pinhole camera model. An objective of the present invention is to provide the method and device for analyzing the vibration of an object in an image based on a phase.

title_en: Decision support system for water system conversion
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a decision support system for water system conversion of a water pipe network and, in particular, to a decision support system for water system conversion of a water pipe network, which is configured to collect and analyze water quality-related data in a receptor or a pipe network (spot to be measured) and various measurement data in a filtration plant and the pipe network to determine and perform water system conversion of the water pipe network to enable monitoring according to an integrated and widened water pipe network, reduction of a risk of a water quality accident in case of an emergency, and more accurate water quality management and risk management. The decision support system for water system conversion of the water pipe network comprises: a test kit which measures water quality-related data of a spot to be measured; a communication device which transmits the measured water quality-related data in the test kit to a communication network; an IoT device which is connected to a measuring instrument provided in a filtration plant or a pipe network to transmit measurement data through the communication network; and a decision support sever which collects and analyzes the water quality-related data and the measurement data to perform water system conversion.

title_en: Vehicle drunk driving measurement device and measurement method
abstract_en: The present invention provides a system for measuring drunk driving of a vehicle, which comprises: a communication unit remotely receiving a driver's boarding intention signal; and a preheating control unit controlling a breathalyzer of a vehicle to be preheated when the driver's boarding intention signal is received by the communication unit. According to the present invention, the system and a method for measuring drunk driving of a vehicle for remotely measuring drunk driving are provided to start the vehicle before a driver boards on the vehicle or preheat the breathalyzer of the vehicle to reduce preparation time before driving of the driver.

title_en: Food chronometric signal interpretation and food analysis methods
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for analyzing a food chronometric signal and food, which comprises: a database unit collecting and storing food spectroscopic data and constructing food standard model database for each nutrient concentration of food; a linkage unit transmitting and receiving food analysis result data in a spectroscopic module or a food analysis kit through communication using a cloud server; a spectroscopic data analysis unit analyzing a spectroscopic data signal measured by the spectroscopic module; and a food data processing unit analyzing or predicting ingredients, nutrients, and a contamination level of the food by using a signal of the spectroscopic module based on deep learning.

title_en: Colorimetric detection method of pH change for food using a film containing nanocellulose-bromocresol purple composite
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a colorimetric detection method of a pH change for food, which is a colorimetric detection method of a pH change for food using a film containing a nanocellulose-bromocresol purple composite, wherein a main color change identifiable in pH 4-5 and pH 7-8 is exhibited when the content of the nanocellulose-bromocresol purple composite in the film is 10 to 15 wt%. The colorimetric detection method of a pH change for food according to the present invention enables the main color change that the film containing a nanocellulose-bromocresol purple composite changes into yellow in acid with pH equal to or smaller than 4-5, and changes into purple in a base with pH equal to or greater than 7-8 to be identified with the naked eye, thereby being useful in colorimetric detection of a pH change for food.

title_en: Organic carbon dioxide detection apparatus in liquid using separate chamber structure
abstract_en: Disclosed is a device for detecting organic carbon in liquid by using a separate chamber structure, in which CO_2 generated through a UV photocatalytic reaction in a first chamber where a glass fiber filter wet-coated with a photocatalyst material (TiO_2) is disposed in liquid for which organic carbon is to be detected is moved to a second chamber where a CO_2 detector is located through a gas discharge port and a circulation pipe, thereby being able to accurately detect a measured quantity of CO_2. The device for detecting organic carbon in liquid by using a separate chamber structure, according to the present invention, comprises: a first chamber in which a glass fiber filter is mounted; a second chamber configured to detect CO_2 gas generated through a photocatalytic reaction by oxidation by making the glass fiber filter irradiated with ultraviolet rays; and a circulation pump which is mounted on a circulation pipe installed to communicate with the first chamber and the second chamber and configured to circulate generated gas and carrier gas into the circulation pipe.

title_en: Imaging device for diagnosing soft rot of chinese cabbage based on non-destructive analysis technology and method for manufacturing the same
abstract_en: A manufacturing method of a multispectral imaging device for diagnosing soft rot of napa cabbage based on nondestructive analysis technology comprises: a) a step of using a hyperspectral camera to secure hyperspectral image data of each group for at least one napa cabbage sample while photographing the napa cabbage sample; b) a step of setting a region of interest (ROI) for each sample in the image data secured in step a), and extracting reflectance spectrum data for each set sample group; c) a step of analyzing the reflectance spectrum data for each sample group extracted in step b) to select an index wavelength or an index wavelength region (range) for napa cabbage soft rot diagnosis; d) a step of performing quantitative/qualitative analysis on the index wavelength or the index wavelength region selected in step c); e) a step of performing multivariate statistics analysis based on analysis results of step d) to finally determine an optimization spectrum index for napa cabbage soft rot diagnosis; and f) a step of setting the optimization spectrum index determined in step e) as a standard to manufacture an image sensor capable of selectively sensing only a spectrum of a corresponding region. The soft rot of napa cabbage can be quickly monitored in real time in a nondestructive manner, thereby efficiently diagnosing the soft rot of napa cabbage.

title_en: Isotope labeling of fatty acids using lipase and 18O-water and mass spectrometry using the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to isotope labeling of fatty acids using lipase and ^18O-water and mass spectrometry using the same, wherein the isotope labeling and the mass spectrometry according to the present invention uses enzymatic hydrolysis of the lipase and ^18O-water for isotope labeling to a carboxyl group of fatty acids, thereby being used for lipidomics research on various biological samples.

title_en: Method and system for analyzing micoro particles
abstract_en: A method for analyzing fine particles of cells or microorganisms according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises the steps of: receiving, by a communication unit, a captured image of target particles from a portable terminal; calculating, by a calculation unit, calculation information on the type and number of target particles using pre-stored external data of fine particles and the captured image; mapping, by a processing unit, the calculation information onto the captured image to generate result information; and transmitting, by the communication unit, the result information to the portable terminal.

title_en: Liquid color sensor filter to use seawater as fresh water (seawater separation-liquid color sensor filter)
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a seawater separation-liquid color sensor filter, which is a new filter system and has further developed the existing seawater desalination business. A liquid color sensor filter is used to detect and separate metal ions and convert seawater into fresh water in an environmentally friendly manner. To this end, a DTZ indicator is included in filter paper coated with hydrogel to increase eco-friendliness, separation efficiency, and stability, thereby obtaining fresh water more easily.

title_en: Pharmaceutical composition for anti-cancer comprising NUPR1 isoform A inhibitor
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a pharmaceutical composition comprising an NUPR1 isoform A inhibitor as an active ingredient for preventing or treating cancer, a composition containing an agent for measuring the expression or activity level of NUPR1 isoform A for diagnosing or predicting the prognosis of cancer, a kit containing the same for diagnosing or predicting the prognosis of cancer, a method for screening a substance for inhibiting cancer growth or metastasis, and a method for providing information on cancer growth or metastasis, a food composition containing an NUPR1 isoform A inhibitor as an active ingredient for preventing or alleviating cancer, and a feed composition containing an NUPR1 isoform A inhibitor as an active ingredient for preventing or alleviating cancer.
