The NUPR1 isoform A inhibitor according to the present invention has an anti-cancer effect, so that the pharmaceutical composition, the food composition, and the feed composition containing the NUPR1 isoform A inhibitor can be advantageously used for preventing, treating, or alleviating cancer. In addition, the expression or activity level of the NUPR1 isoform A are measured to diagnose and predict the prognosis of cancer, a material for inhibiting cancer growth and metastasis can be screened, and a subject can be provided with cancer growth and metastasis information.

title_en: An apparatus and method for identifying the characteristics of a visual AI-based rapid diagnostic kit
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, a medical information service providing device comprises: an image information collecting unit which collects user image information on a user who is performing a test with an in vitro diagnostic kit; a visual diagnosis processing unit which outputs an artificial intelligence-based visual diagnosis result by using a test result image acquired from the user image information; a verification processing unit which outputs verification data by observing a test process of the in vitro diagnostic kit, from the user image information; and a service providing unit which provides a medical information service to a user terminal by using the verification data and the visual diagnosis result. The service providing unit comprises a kit information identification service unit which identifies the appearance of a test kit (an antigen/antibody rapid diagnostic kit) from the user image information of the user terminal by using visual artificial intelligence, specifies the manufacturer and the purpose of diagnosis/analysis of the product, and provides corresponding guide information to the user terminal. According to the present invention, various medical services can be improved.

title_en: Use of PDH inhibitors for treatment of neurodegenerative disease
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a use of a pdh inhibitor for treating neurodegenerative diseases. according to the present invention, in a dj-1 deletion parkinson's disease drosophila model, sensitivity to ros is lowered by activation of pdk, promotion of pdk expression through dj-1 and hif-1, inhibition of pdp, or genetic and pharmacological inhibition of pdh using a pdh inhibitor, and death of dopaminergic neurons is significantly reduced, thereby being used for preventing or treating neurodegenerative diseases.

title_en: Lubricating oil life measurement device through electrical characteristic analysis of lubricant
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide an apparatus for measuring the lifespan of lubricating oil through the analysis of the electrical properties of lubricating oil, which can identify the amount of additives and the degree of remaining additives by the electrical properties of the lubricating oil, measure the production of acid and the increase in viscosity due to the deterioration of the lubricating oil after the loss of the additives by the electrical properties, and efficiently manage the deterioration state of the lubricating oil. An apparatus (100) for measuring the lifespan of lubricating oil through the analysis of the electrical characteristics of lubricating oil comprises: a measurement sensor unit (110) for measuring the dielectric constant and the electrical conductivity of lubricating oil to monitor the loss section of the lubricating oil used as industrial oil, the progress of the deterioration of the lubricating oil, and the contamination and metal powder; a monitoring control unit (120) for analyzing the loss of the additive, the pre-oil oxidation, the contamination, and the metal powder based on the dielectric constant and the electrical conductivity of the lubricating oil measured by the measurement sensor unit (110); and a lubricating oil state notification unit (130) for outputting the state of the lubricating oil based on the analysis result of the monitoring control unit (120).

title_en: System for monitoring facilities and equipment
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a monitoring system and method for monitoring the presence or absence of abnormalities in various facilities and equipment. According to the present invention, in order to solve the problems of the facility and equipment monitoring systems of the prior art, which had limitations in that various sensors such as vibration sensors, temperature sensors, and harmful gas detection sensors were separately installed to monitor the occurrence or absence of abnormalities in various facilities and equipment and thus the overall configuration became complicated and the installation and maintenance costs increased, various detection sensor functions capable of detecting vibration, heat, smoke, harmful gas, etc. were integrated so that vibration, heat, and harmful gas of various facilities or equipment were detected through a single sensor, and abnormalities were determined and an alarm was transmitted when an abnormality occurred. Therefore, a facility and equipment monitoring system using vibration analysis and heat and harmful gas detection is provided, which is configured to more effectively prevent the occurrence of various accidents in various facilities and equipment with a simpler configuration and lower cost than before.

title_en: Methods for Diagnosing Cholangiocarcinoma
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for diagnosing cholangiocarcinoma, and more specifically, to a method for diagnosing cholangiocarcinoma and predicting prognosis by using a change in the sugar chain structure of serum-derived exosomes of a cholangiocarcinoma patient as a biomarker. since the biomarker of the present invention exhibits excellent specificity and sensitivity to cholangiocarcinoma, the biomarker is used for diagnosis and prognosis prediction of cholangiocarcinoma patients, thereby contributing to improvement of treatment efficiency of cholangiocarcinoma patients and reduction of mortality due to cholangiocarcinoma.

title_en: Novel Japanese encephalitis virus antigen, Japanese encephalitis-specific antibody, and uses thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the detection of Japanese encephalitis virus and/or the diagnosis of Japanese encephalitis virus infection using a novel Japanese encephalitis virus antigen and a novel specific antibody against Japanese encephalitis virus. The novel antigen and specific antibody according to the present invention can accurately detect Japanese encephalitis virus. In particular, when applied to a blocking enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (Blocking ELISA), which is a type of enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay, it has been confirmed that the specificity, sensitivity, and accuracy are improved compared to existing diagnostic kits. Therefore, the present invention can be usefully utilized for the diagnosis of Japanese encephalitis or the detection of antibodies against Japanese encephalitis virus.

title_en: Cellulose nanocrystal-silver nanoparticle ink material and method for manufacturing the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a freshness indicator ink composition and a manufacturing method thereof, wherein the freshness indicator ink composition comprises 77 to 80 wt% of a cellulose nanocrystal-silver nanoparticle (cnc-ag) composite aqueous solution, 7 to 10 wt% of a surface energy regulator, and 10 to 13 wt% of a wetting agent. the freshness indicator ink composition can be applied to various inkjet printers including general home and office inkjet printers, so that a freshness indicator label can be easily manufactured without using special equipment.

title_en: Method for Estimating Relative Values of Total Nitrogen Excretion and Nitrogen Retention in Pig Feed
abstract_en: An object of the present invention is to provide a method comprising the steps of: measuring a change rate (%) in crude protein content of animal feed; and measuring a relative change rate of total nitrogen excretion from the animal feed or a relative change rate of nitrogen retention to nitrogen intake, based on the measured change rate (%) in crude protein content. Provided is a method comprising the steps of: measuring a change rate (%) in crude protein content of animal feed; and measuring a relative change rate of total nitrogen excretion from the animal feed or a relative change rate of nitrogen retention to nitrogen intake, based on the measured change rate (%) in crude protein content.

title_en: Probe for measuring the activity of cathepsin K and composition for diagnosis of Bone Diseases comprising the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a probe for measuring cathepsin K activity, a composition for measuring osteoclast activity comprising the probe, a composition for diagnosing bone diseases comprising the probe, a kit for measuring osteoclast activity comprising the composition, a kit for diagnosing bone diseases, a method for measuring cathepsin K activity, a method for measuring osteoclast activity, a method for diagnosing bone diseases, a composition for screening drugs inhibiting cathepsin K activity, and a method for screening drugs inhibiting cathepsin K activity. According to the present invention, a probe for measuring the activity of cathepsin K specifically expressed in osteoclasts is designed to increase the speed and accuracy of diagnosis, thereby being usefully used for diagnosing bone diseases and screening drugs for inhibiting cathepsin K activity.

title_en: Gas analysis apparatus in oil transformer comprising lipophobic nanofiber membrane
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a gas analysis device in insulating oil including a lipophobic nanofiber membrane. In one specific example, the gas analysis device in insulating oil includes: insulating oil filled inside a transformer; and a gas sampling probe for analyzing gas generated from the insulating oil. The gas sampling probe includes: a body connected to one side of the transformer and into which insulating oil flows; a gas concentration measurement unit formed at one end of the body for measuring a gas concentration in the insulating oil; and a gas monitoring unit electrically connected to the gas concentration measurement unit for analyzing the acquired gas concentration data. The gas concentration measurement unit includes a gas sensor for measuring a gas concentration in the insulating oil and a nanofiber membrane disposed in front of the gas sensor for separating gas from the insulating oil.

title_en: Informative method and a diagnostic kit for determining the prognosis of patients with AML
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a biomarker capable of quickly and accurately checking the prognosis of an aml patient, a method for providing information, and a diagnostic kit therefor, and more particularly, to an information providing method and a diagnostic kit for determining the prognosis of an aml patient from errα expression intensity at the initial diagnosis time.

title_en: Beverage antioxidant detectionbead, beverage antioxidant detectionbody, beverage antioxidant detectionbead manufacturing method and beverage antioxidant detectionbody manufacturing method
abstract_en: Disclosed are a beverage antioxidant detection bead, a beverage antioxidant detector, a method for producing the beverage antioxidant detection bead, and a method for producing the beverage antioxidant detector. The beverage antioxidant detection bead may include: a semi-permeable polymer; and a sensing material dispersed in the polymer and discoloring in response to an antioxidant.

title_en: Method of providing information for diagnosing cancer in women
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for providing information for diagnosing cancer in women. Based on the fact that changes in the expression of PMEPA1 in women are highly accurate in diagnosing the onset of cancer in women, the present invention has clinical utility in that cancer can be effectively diagnosed in women using the biomarker, and treatment can be performed at an appropriate time.

title_en: Gas Leak Location Detection and Diffusion Prediction System and Method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and a method for gas leak location detection and diffusion prediction, and more particularly, to a system and a method for acquiring sensor data at various locations in a room where hazardous materials are stored, detecting gas and a gas leak location by analyzing information including each location information with an artificial intelligence model based on the acquired sensor data, and predicting a time for gas to reach an entrance through gas diffusion prediction using artificial intelligence. According to an embodiment of the present invention, a gas leak location detection and diffusion prediction system comprises: a sensor data collection unit composed of a plurality of sensor boards provided at each location in a room to detect various gases; a data storage unit for storing the sensor data collected by the sensor data collection unit; a sensor data analysis unit for analyzing the sensor data stored in the data storage unit using artificial intelligence and inferring a hazardous gas leak location and a time for the hazardous gas to reach an entrance; and a display unit for visually displaying the hazardous gas leak location, the time for the hazardous gas to reach the entrance, and an optimal evacuation path.

title_en: Assistant device of the Schumidt Hammer using Blader
abstract_en: According to the present invention, an auxiliary device for measuring concrete surface strength can finely adjust the horizontality of a Schmidt hammer (30) supported by a hammer support container (40) by using a plurality of horizontal adjustment bolts (50) and a horizontal measuring device (60) installed in a lower portion of the hammer support container (40) corresponding to an irregular concrete surface, thereby correcting a deviation (error) for each measurer when measuring by a concrete surface strength rebound hardness method, and solving a measurement angle and a shaking phenomenon of a handle to increase accuracy. Accordingly, safety and reliability can be increased in determining repair and rebuilding according to rock determination of a power structure (steel tower, substation, and electric power tunnel) and determination of aging of the concrete structure.

title_en: Vaccine compositions comprising nipah virus recombinant glycoprotein
abstract_en: The present invention comprises a recombinant protein derived from a g glycoprotein of a nipavirus strain in bangladesh, or further comprises a recombinant protein derived from a g glycoprotein of a nipavirus strain in malaysia. Therefore, the present invention not only has an excellent nipavirus neutralization effect compared to a natural g glycoprotein in nipavirus, but also has excellent detection of sera infected with nipavirus, thereby being usefully used for vaccine against nipavirus or diagnosis of infection. When provided with an adjuvant, more effective vaccine efficacy can be induced.

title_en: Apparatus for diagnositic
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a diagnostic device for diagnosing or predicting a disease with tissue, blood, or the like collected from a human body. According to an embodiment of the present invention, a diagnostic device comprises: a housing forming a space therein; a tray on which a diagnostic kit is mounted; a measurement module photographing the diagnostic kit mounted on the tray; and a slot module into which the tray is inserted and which is movably connected to the housing.

title_en: Microfluidic viscosity measurement system using capillary pressure detection and microfluidic viscosity measurement method using the same
abstract_en: Provided is a microfluidic viscosity measurement system using capillary pressure sensing, comprising: a microfluidic device including an inlet into which a target fluid to be measured is injected, a main channel communicating with the inlet and allowing the target fluid to flow, an outlet formed in the main channel to discharge the target fluid having passed through the main channel, and a sub-channel communicating with a junction of the main channel between the inlet and the outlet and filled with air at a predetermined pressure; a flow rate measurement unit configured to measure a flow velocity of the target fluid flowing through the main channel or flowing from the main channel into the sub-channel; and an analysis module configured to calculate viscosity information of the target fluid based on measurement information obtained by the flow rate measurement unit. According to the present invention, the microfluidic viscosity measurement system using capillary pressure sensing and a viscosity measurement method using the same measure a flow velocity of the target fluid flowing through a channel of the microfluidic device and calculate the viscosity of the microfluid based on the measured flow velocity. Accordingly, even a non-expert can accurately measure the viscosity of the target fluid, and since the structure is relatively simple, manufacturing and operating costs can be reduced.

title_en: Application of reagent for detecting sdc1 expression in preparing product for diagnosing drug resistance of patients with cholangiocarcinoma to pemigatinib
abstract_en: The invention provides an application of a reagent for detecting SDC1 expression in preparing a product for diagnosing the drug resistance of patients with cholangiocarcinoma to pemigatinib, belonging to the technical field of biomedicine. The invention claims the application of a reagent for detecting the expression of SDC1 in preparing a product for diagnosing drug resistance of cholangiocarcinoma patients to pemigatinib. The invention also claims to protect a product for diagnosing the drug resistance of cholangiocarcinoma patients to pemigatinib, comprising a reagent for detecting the expression of SDC1. The drug resistance of pemigatinib is an important influencing factor for the poor prognosis of cholangiocarcinoma patients. According to the invention, SDC1 is an important marker for detecting the drug resistance of pemigatinib in cholangiocarcinoma patients, and the detection of the expression of SDC1 can help realize the detection of the drug resistance of pemigatinib in cholangiocarcinoma patients.

title_en: Device for dynamically monitoring root growth of gramineous plants
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device for dynamically monitoring the root growth of gramineous plants, which relates to the technical field of plant root growth research. The device includes an outer shell, where the lateral surface and the bottom surface of the outer shell are fixedly installed, communicated with a plurality of smooth communicating pipes, the smooth communicating pipes are uniformly distributed on the lateral surface, the bottom surface of the outer shell, the outer ends of the smooth communicating pipes located on the lateral surface of the outer shell are threaded with transverse metering cylinders. The outer end of the smooth communicating pipe located at the bottom surface of the outer shell is threaded with a longitudinal metering cylinder, sliding round blocks are slidably installed in both the transverse metering cylinder and the longitudinal metering cylinder, a connecting slide bar is fixedly installed on the sliding round block.

title_en: Platform for detecting soil property and heavy metal and using method thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a platform for detecting soil property and heavy metal, including a drilling portion for inserting into ground to collect soil samples, a driving portion for driving the drilling portion to insert into soil, and a hyperspectrometer, where the hyperspectrometer includes a hyperspectrometer body and a probe head which are separately arranged; the probe head is connected to a bottom end of the drilling portion and is communicatively connected to the hyperspectrometer body. A method of using a platform for detecting soil property and heavy metal is provided, which involves inserting the probe head into the ground along with the drilling portion to obtain real-time spectral information of the soil for in-situ detection. It is to solve the problem that the existing technology realizes the heavy metal pollution investigation of soil by collecting samples in the field and conducting laboratory chemical analysis, which has a tedious investigation process, a long cycle, and can only obtain point location information, making it difficult to quickly and effectively determine the pollution range of heavy metals in soil.

title_en: Research method for investigating the effect of snrpb2 on the in vitro development of early bovine embryos
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a research method for investigating the effect of SNRPB2 on the in vitro development of early bovine embryos, belonging to the technical field of embryo engineering. The method comprises obtaining bovine oocytes in vitro and subjecting the oocytes to in vitro maturation culture, constructing an interference vector and microinjecting the interference vector into fertilized eggs, and, after in vitro culture, detecting embryo developmental indices and the expression of related genes. The results can clearly determine the regulatory effects of SNRPB2 on the cleavage rate, blastocyst rate, and embryo quality of early bovine embryos, thereby providing technical support for elucidating the molecular mechanisms of early bovine embryo development. The method features standardized operation and good reproducibility, and provides a new direction for optimizing bovine in vitro embryo culture systems.

title_en: Method for diagnosing morphologically altered precancerous conditions of the stomach
abstract_en: The invention relates to medicine, in particular to gastrology and can be used for diagnosing morphologically altered precancerous conditions of the stomach.Summary of the invention consists in determining in the patient's blood serum the quantitative values of pepsinogen I (PG-I), pepsinogen II (PG-II) and the ratio between the quantitative value of pepsinogen I and pepsinogen II (PG-I / PG-II), if the quantitative value of PG-I is 64.10…38.37 µg/L, and the ratio PG-I/PG-II is 4.59…2.55, the presence of morphologically altered precancerous condition of the stomach is diagnosed.

title_en: Method for early prediction of the course of a patient's condition with sepsis
abstract_en: The invention relates to medicine, in particular to intensive care, and can be used for prognostic assessment for the purpose of more effectively and rapidly assessing the risk of disease progression in patients diagnosed with sepsis in order to exclude erroneous interpretations and take appropriate therapeutic decisions.Summary of the invention consists in that the method comprises an assessment of the condition of patients with sepsis with increased accuracy of prognosis in patients with sepsis. For this purpose, a prognostic assessment is proposed based on a combination of SIRS (Systemic Inflammatory Response Syndrome) and MEWS (Modified Early Warning Score) indicators. Such a combined approach uses the high sensitivity of SIRS and the high specificity of MEWS, providing a more accurate assessment of the risk of mortality.

title_en: Il-17 a/f heterologous polypeptides and therapeutic uses thereof.
abstract_en: The present invention is directed to a novel naturally occurring human cytokine that is comprised of a heterodimer of interleukin-17 and interleukin-17F designated herein as interleukin 17A/F (IL-17A/F). Also provided herein are vectors and host cells comprising those nucleic acid sequences, chimeric polypeptide molecules comprising the polypeptides of the present invention fused to heterologous polypeptide sequences, specific antibodies which bind to the polypeptides of the present invention and to methods for producing the polypeptides of the present invention. Further provided herein are methods for treating degenerative cartilaginous disorders and other inflammatory diseases.

title_en: Systems and methods for pre-analytical substrate processing.
abstract_en: Some embodiments presented in this disclosure concern an Automated Tissue Dissection (ATD) System. An ATD system is a one stop, and potentially low-cost, system to perform dissections on a substrate from pathologist digital mark or pen mark on the substrate using non-contact and/or mechanical method to extract a Formalin-Fixed Paraffin-Embedded (FFPE) tissue sample with: (a) only the ROI or ROIs as area to be saved; and (b) remove or decompose nucleic acid content in the region of no interest (RONI) and collect all tissue sample from a standard microscope substrate into a specific container.

title_en: Method for the characterization of peptide:mhc binding polypeptides.
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for the characterization of peptide: MHC binding polypeptides, e.g. by mass spectrometry and an analysis of the recognized peptide space, i.e. in order to identify peptides that can be bound in the context of their presentation by MHC, and those who can not be bound.

title_en: Detecting platelets in a blood sample.
abstract_en: Apparatus and methods are provided including imaging a blood sample that is a cell suspension deposited in a sample chamber. The cells are allowed to settle in the sample chamber to form a monolayer of cells. At least one microscopic image is acquired of the monolayer of cells using a microscope (24) while the microscope is focused at a monolayer-depth-level, and a first platelet count of platelets that have settled within the monolayer, is determined. An additional microscopic image of the sample is acquired, while the microscope is focused at a different depth level from the monolayer-depth-level, and a second platelet count of platelets that have not settled within the monolayer is determined. An output is generated based upon the first and second platelet counts. Other applications are also described.

title_en: Nonalcoholic steatohepatitis (nash) biomarkers and uses thereof.
abstract_en: Methods, compositions, and kits for determining whether a subject has a liver condition, including hepatic steatosis, hepatic inflammation, hepatocellular ballooning, and/or hepatic fibrosis, are provided. In various embodiments, the subject's liver condition includes non-alcoholic steatohepatitis (NASH).

title_en: Compositions and methods for treating epilepsy.
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates generally to methods of preventing, reducing risk of developing, or treating epilepsy, comprising administering to a subject an inhibitor of the classical complement pathway.

title_en: Peptide quantitation assay for differentiating full-length high molecular weight kininogen (hmwk) and cleaved hmwk.
abstract_en: Methods for differentiating full-length high molecular weight kininogen (HMWK) and cleaved HMWK in a sample are provided herein. Such methods may comprise treating a biological sample with a protease to generate a plurality of digested peptides, and measuring one or more signature peptides, which are indicative of cleaved HMWK and/or full-length HMWK.

title_en: A screening method for diagnosing growth hormone deficiency in pediatric patients by using macimorelin.
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a screening method for diagnosing growth hormone deficiency in pediatric patients by using macimorelin. The present invention further provides the substance macimorelin for use in diagnosing growth hormone deficiency in pediatric patients. The method comprises providing at least one blood sample, taken from a subject within a range from about 15 to about 100 minutes following an administration of an amount of macimorelin effective for inducing growth hormone secretion, measuring the growth hormone level of each blood sample, comparing the measured growth hormone level with a single threshold value, diagnosing whether the subject suffers from growth hormone deficiency or not based on the comparison of growth hormone level with said single threshold value in said at least one blood sample. The method of the invention is a stand-alone test and does not need to be repeated and no alternative growth hormone stimulation test is required to reliably diagnose pediatric patients.

title_en: Dna damage sensitivity as a new biomarker for detection of cancer and cancer susceptibility.
abstract_en: The invention relates to a marker that can be used as biomarker for detection of cancer. More specifically, the present invention relates to the analysis of genomic DNA damage sensitivity (DDS) as a biomarker for cancer or cancer susceptibility or other disease states characterized by DNA damage response (DDR) disturbances. The biomarker of the invention can also be used to study the effect of medication, risk factors and/or environmental impacts on the susceptibility to cancer or more generally to that impair genomic DNA sensitivity (DDS).

title_en: Micropchip capillary electrophoresis assays and reagents.
abstract_en: Microchip Capillary Electrophoresis (MCE) assays and reagents to assess purity and to identify impurities in protein drug product samples are provided. Methods for analyzing analytes in a protein drug sample are provided.

title_en: Materials and methods for improved expansion and uses of immune cells.
abstract_en: Provided herein are, inter alia, improved materials and methods for obtainment and use of immune cells (e.g., T cells). In particular, the present disclosure provides improved materials and methods of ex vivo immune cell activation, immune cell expansion, and/or enrichment of immune cells, immune cell subsets, and more specifically VÎ³9VÎ´2 cells. The present disclosure further provides isolated or purified populations of such VÎ³9VÎ´2 cells, and the ex vivo and in vivo uses thereof. Also provided herein, in various embodiments, are compositions comprising such improved cells, including the isolated or purified populations of such produced VÎ³9VÎ´2 cells, CAR cells, and the like, and uses of such compositions and cells in treating a subject in need thereof having, for example, a disease or a disorder.

title_en: Systems and methods for airborne environmental detection and surveillance of pathogens with electrochemical analysis
abstract_en: The present disclosure is directed to an airborne detection device, method, and system for analyzing an environmental air sample and detecting airborne pathogens. The device includes an analysis vial. and a biosensor electrode. The system further includes an external sampling device.

title_en: Fusion protein comprising tgf-î²rii extracellular region fragment, pharmaceutical composition thereof and use thereof
abstract_en: A fusion protein comprising a TGF-Î²RII extracellular domain fragment, a pharmaceutical composition thereof and the use thereof. Specifically, the fusion protein comprises: a first protein functional region targeting an immune checkpoint and a second protein functional region having TGF-Î² binding activity, wherein the second protein functional region is a variant of the TGF-Î²RII extracellular domain fragment, and the variant of the TGF-Î²RII extracellular region involves the first serine at the N-terminus of the TGF-Î²RII extracellular region fragment being replaced with alanine, glycine or threonine; and/or a fragment comprising an amino acid sequence as shown in SEQ ID NO: 59 is deleted from the TGF-Î²RII extracellular domain fragment. The fusion protein can inhibit TIGIT and reduce TGF-Î² levels at the same time, and has good potential for preparing anti-tumor drugs.

title_en: Methods and systems for the rapid detection of listeria using infectious agents
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are methods and systems for rapid detection of microorganisms such as <i>Listeria spp.</i> in a sample. A genetically modified bacteriophage is also disclosed which comprises an indicator gene in the late gene region. The specificity of the bacteriophage, such as <i>Listeria</i>-specific bacteriophage, allows detection of a specific microorganism, such as <i>Listeria spp.</i> and an indicator signal may be amplified to optimize assay sensitivity.

title_en: Fuel property estimation device
abstract_en: This fuel property estimation device is used in an internal combustion engine (2) that uses a mixed fuel of three kinds of fuel and includes a first sensor (34) that outputs a signal responsive to a physical property of the fuel in a fuel route (36) and a second sensor (28) outputs a signal responsive to an oxygen concentration of exhaust gas. This device measures a physical property value of the mixed fuel based on a first sensor (34) signal, and calculates an air-fuel ratio value at stoichiometric combustion state using feedback of a second sensor (28) signal. This device estimates a composition ratio of the mixed fuel based on the measured physical property value and the calculated air-fuel ratio value by referring to a relationship between the composition ratio of the mixed fuel and the physical property value and a relationship between the composition ratio of the mixed fuel and a theoretical air-fuel ratio value.  FIGURE 4

title_en: A system for cutting and chemical testing for latex glove and the like
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a unit that can be characterized by a cutter device (100) having a first frame (102) comprises a platform (104) mounted on the frame (102), wherein the platform (104) is attached to a first railing system (106) movable along an axis; a second frame (202) comprises a second railing system (204) cooperatively attached with a first working carriage (302) for providing motions to the first working carriage (302) along an axis, wherein the platform (104) consists of magnetic properties which uses magnet to hold the latex glove sample prior cutting; wherein the second frame (202) is coupled with the first frame (102); a second working carriage (402) is cooperatively attached to a third railing system (304) of the first working carriage (302) for providing motion to the second working carriage (402) along an axis, wherein the second working carriage (402) consists of a slot to attach a housing (504); a cutter point (502) is attached to a housing (504) for providing stability during operations, wherein the housing (504) is connected to the second working carriage (402); a chemical binding device (500) having a third frame (502) couple together with the first frame (102) comprises second platform (604) for performing chemical staining in chemical binding testing, wherein the platform (604) is movable along an axis, wherein the second platform (604) comprises a plurality of cavities (606) for submerging the latex glove sample in chemical binding testing.

title_en: An Internal Quality Detection Device for Cayenne Pepper Based on Diffuse Transmission and Regular Transmission
abstract_en: of the invention The invention relates to an internal quality detection device for cayenne pepper based on diffuse transmission and regular transmission, comprising a light source and its supporting device, a rubber cup and its supporting device are fixed directly below the light 5 source and its supporting device, the lower end of the rubber cup and its supporting device is connected with an optical bundling device, and an optical fiber and its supporting device are fixed directly below the optical bundling device. The other end of the optical fiber is connected with a spectrometer, and the spectrometer is connected with a computer through a data line. Beneficial effects: |t can realize the automatic adjustment of the light source 10 angle and the distance between the light source and the cayenne pepper, can detect the internal quality of the cayenne pepper in two ways: regular transmission and diffuse transmission, can realize the intelligence and automation of the rubber cup wall fitting the surface of the cayenne pepper, can collect the transmitted light from the cayenne pepper and feed back to the fiber optic probe, |t can also take into account the internal quality inspection of fruits and vegeplatforms such as star fruit and cucumber.

title_en: Methylated markers for colorectal cancer
abstract_en: Disclosed herein is a combination of genomic sequences whose methylation patterns have utility for the improved detection and differentiation between colorectal neoplasms. The method involves detecting the methylation state of the Septin 9 gene and at least one of IKZF1 and BCAT1. Further disclosed herein are methods, nucleic acids and kits for detecting or differentiating between colorectal neoplasms.

title_en: Synthetic agricultural sensor
abstract_en: In order to predict plant stresses at a localized level, data feeds from many sensor types can be fused and analyzed to create a synthetic sensor estimating plant water stress, predicting microclimatic conditions, and performing localized plant disease and pest modeling. To make this affordable, an array of low-cost, lower precision sensors can be used. Sensor fusion is used to improve the accuracy of each sensing element by using machine learning to fuse data from the other sensing elements in the array. Additionally, machine learning can create a “synthetic sensor” replicating the output of high-cost and maintenance intensive sensing devices by using machine learning to replicate their output.

title_en: Biomarkers for graft-versus-host disease
abstract_en: Biomarkers are provided that are predictive of a subject's responsiveness to a therapy comprising a JAK inhibitor. The biomarkers, compositions, and methods described herein are useful in selecting appropriate treatment modalities for a subject having, suspected of having, or at risk of developing Graft-Versus-Host Disease.

title_en: Autonomous rover for collecting and reporting air quality values
abstract_en: The invention relates to an autonomous rover for collecting and reporting air quality values. According to the invention, the rover includes a communication module (3) consisting of a Bluetooth module, a SIM GPRS module, an HD video camera module and an active buzzer, a sensor module (2) consisting of a driver and of volatile organic compounds and CO2 sensors, temperature and humidity sensors, ammonia, benzene and hydrogen sensors, for the quantification of dust and pollen particles, a diaphragm air pump for collecting air samples, a collecting tube, a container for collecting low pressure air and an OLED display with a 12C interface for displaying the collected data.

title_en: A method and software product for providing a geometric abundance index of a target feature for spectral data
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a method for providing a geometric abundance index of a target feature for spectral data and other multiband electromagnetic signals. The method (300) comprises obtaining (310) target feature spectra (110) indicative of the target feature; obtaining (320) at least one spectral endmember (103,104); determining (330) a transformation matrix (420) arranged to transform spectral data (410) to a transformed feature space (100), and transforming said target feature spectra (110) and said at least one spectral endmember (103,104) utilizing said determined transformation matrix (420); defining (340) a target feature reference line (111) in the transformed feature space (100) based on the transformed target feature spectra (110); determining (350) a coverage index (241) and a similarity index (242) in a geometric model domain based on the target feature reference line (111), wherein the coverage index (241) and the similarity index (242) are trigonometrically defined to be orthogonally oriented at all local points in the geometric model domain; and determining (360) a geometric abundance index (243) indicative of the amount of target feature based on the coverage index (241) and the similarity index (242).

title_en: Method and system for preventing tampering of breath sample measurements
abstract_en: :The present invention relates to a breath analyzing system (100) and method. In particular the invention relates to a breath analyzing system (100) and method for determining the validity of a measurement of a concentration of an intoxicating substance in the exhaled breath of a user and thereby reducing the risk for tampering with the results without increasing the analyzing time or inconvenience for the user. A line-of-sight detector (108) is provided and its output signal compared with a tracer substance signal to determine if the signals have respective expected behavior and relation. The line-of-sight detector (108) comprising an a sensor (111) utilizing infra-red detection and an aperture determining an effective field of view of the line-of-sight detector (108).

title_en: Antibody variants against wnt receptor ryk
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to isolated anti-Ryk antibodies or antibody derivatives. In some aspects, the present disclosure relates to the use of the isolated anti-Ryk antibodies or antibody derivatives.

title_en: System and method for sublimation
abstract_en: System and method for sublimation of water ice and/or water ice from a regolith. The system comprises a sublimation chamber (30) under high to ultra-high vacuum into which protrudes a shield (6) of a thermal management system (1). Sublimated water is collected to be further analysed or analysed in-line. For instance, cold traps 60, 72, 74, 76, 78 can be used to trap water and transfer it to sample tube 92 for analysis.

title_en: Cell manipulation panel, cell isolation device and method of performing cell manipulation
abstract_en: A cell manipulation panel includes a pixel array defining multiple pixels, an insulating layer forming multiple vias, and a cell gap provided with a fluid medium having cells therein. Each pixel has a TFT and corresponds to a corresponding via. The TFT includes a gate electrode, a first electrode, and a second electrode partially exposed to the fluid medium through the corresponding via. For each pixel, in an operational mode, when the gate electrode is provided with an OFF signal and the first electrode is not grounded, the TFT is turned off, allowing one of the cells in the fluid medium to be captured in the corresponding via by a dielectrophoresis (DEP) force. When the gate electrode is provided with an ON signal and the first electrode is grounded, the TFT is turned on, and the second electrode is grounded to release the captured cell to the fluid medium.

title_en: Fluorescence detection constant temperature oscillating mixer comprising a tray seat driven by a transmission member to ensure the accuracy of fluorescence detection
abstract_en: A fluorescence detection constant temperature oscillating mixer mainly includes a body, a tray seat disposed on the body, and a plurality of fluorescence detectors, wherein the body is equipped with a temperature control device and a transmission member, the tray seat is provided with a plurality of support brackets arranged at intervals, the bottom of which is pivotally connected to the transmission member, and the fluorescence detectors correspond to the support brackets of the tray seat. In order to place the microtube containing the biological sample to be detected on the support bracket of the tray seat, the tray seat is driven by the transmission member to rotate rapidly and back and forth so that the less soluble biological sample is thrown out by centrifugal force and stirred back and forth to achieve the purpose of exact mixing. The fluorescence changes are detected by the fluorescence detector so that the detection curve can be consistent to ensure the accuracy of fluorescence detection.

title_en: Method for quantifying nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide (NAD+) or nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN), and kit and paper filter for performing said method
abstract_en: To provide a method for correctly quantifying a NAD+ precursor such as NAD+ or NMN using a DBS method. Provided is a method for quantifying a nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide (NAD+) or a nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) in a subject to be measured, the method comprising: a step 1 for bringing a paper filter having blood derived from the subject added thereto or impregnated with a radical inhibitor or a chaotropic agent into contact with a solvent; and a step 2 for quantifying the nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide (NAD+) or the nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) in the solvent obtained in step 1.

title_en: Dose control system
abstract_en: A dose control system, including a processing device, configured to obtain the real drug concentration in plasma of a patient. The processing device is furthered configured to calculate corrected dose rate distribution data based on the real drug concentration in plasma and a set of correction coefficients. The processing device is further configured to calculate the time required for irradiation based on the corrected dose rate distribution data and the prescribed dose distribution data. The processing device is further configured to cause the irradiation device to irradiate the patient for the time required.

title_en: Multiple flow path gas inlet with integrated heating and temperature control
abstract_en: A gas inlet includes a gas inlet chassis, an inlet sealingly disposed on an end of a process conduit and an outlet sealingly disposed on an exterior surface of a gas analyzer together with a plurality of gas paths connecting the inlet and the outlet with one or a plurality of heating elements rigidly thermally connected to the gas inlet chassis located such that the thermal distribution across the gas inlet chassis heats the gas flow through one or more gas paths. A method for providing heated gas to a mass spectrometer includes providing a gas inlet chassis that has a heating element and a plurality of gas paths disposed between an inlet and an outlet, directing an electrical current through a conduit into at least one heating element, and directing process gas through the outlet into a mass spectrometer.

title_en: Ultrasonic inspection device and ultrasonic inspection method using the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an ultrasonic inspection device and method capable of rapidly and accurately inspecting a large number of subjects. The device comprises: a loading module for conveying subjects; a stage fixture module for supporting and fixing subjects; an ultrasonic inspection module for inspecting subjects; a stage conveying module for conveying the stage to the inspection module; and a stage cover processing module for attaching and detaching a cover before and after inspection.

title_en: Method for detection of a cancer
abstract_en: The invention relates to the use of tissue specific transcription factor-nucleosome adducts or transcription cofactor-nucleosome adducts as biomarkers in a biological fluid for the detection or diagnosis of a cancer in a subject. The invention further relates to using said tissue specific transcription factor or cofactor adducts to identify the site of development of a cancer in a subject.

title_en: An automated, cloud-based, point-of-care (poc) pathogen and antibody array detection system and method
abstract_en: The illustrated embodiments of the invention include an automated method of assaying a viral and antibody analyte in a sample in a portable, handheld microfluidic reader having a SAW detector with a minimal mass sensitivity limitation. The automated method includes the steps of automatically performing the assay with the SAW detector with enhanced sensitivity as in Optikus I, but also includes the steps of automatically disposing a second portion of the sample on a microarray, selectively automatically probing the second portion of the sample for antibodies corresponding to the at least one selected virus using the microarray, and automatically reading the microarray using a fluorescent camera to identify antibodies in the second portion of the sample.

title_en: Bio-detection device, bio-detection system and bio-detection method
abstract_en: A bio-detection device is provided. The bio-detection device includes a plurality of pixel units. Each of the pixel units includes a substrate, one or more pairs of reflective sub-polarizing units, and a plurality of reaction sites. The pairs of reflective sub-polarizing units are disposed on the substrate. The difference of the absolute value between respective polarizing angles of the reflective sub-polarizing units in each pair of reflective sub-polarizing units is 90°. The reaction sites are defined above the one or more pairs of reflective sub-polarizing units. The reaction sites and the reflective sub-polarizing units are in one-to-one correspondence.

title_en: Compositions and methods for carrying out assay measurements
abstract_en:
The present disclosure provides compositions, reagents, kits, systems, system components, and methods for performing assays. More particularly, the disclosure relates to an assay composition for detecting luminescence, which comprises an alkyl diethanolamine, for example, N- 
butyldiethanolamine (BDEA). In emodiments, the assay composition comprises 2-dibutylaminoethanol (BDAE).

title_en: Method and kit for detecting polyamine, and method for diagnosing cancer in vitro
abstract_en:
A method for detecting polyamine is used to solve the problem that the conventional method is not suitable for detecting polyamine. The method for detecting polyamine includes providing a sample with polyamine. The sample and a derivatization reagent with an isothiocyanate group are dissolved in an alkaline working solution to form a mixture, while a thiocarbamoylation reaction between the polyamine in the sample and the derivatization reagent, forming a thiourea derivative. The thiourea derivative in a derivatization solution is then detected to obtain a value of polyamine. With such performance, polyamine in the sample can be effectively detected. A kit for detecting polyamine, and a method for diagnosing cancer
         in vitro are also disclosed.

title_en: Methods and apparatus for manufacturing a glass ribbon
abstract_en: Methods of manufacturing a glass ribbon include moving a ribbon of glass-forming material along a travel path in a travel direction. Methods include sensing a thickness of the ribbon of glass-forming material at a plurality of locations of the ribbon of glass-forming material. Methods include identifying a location of the plurality of locations in which a corresponding thickness at the location exceeds a target thickness. Methods include correlating a rate of thickness change and a thickness difference between the corresponding thickness and the target thickness to a laser power. Methods include directing a laser beam at the laser power toward the ribbon of glass-forming material to decrease a viscosity at the location and attain the target thickness at the location.

title_en: Organ chip assembly for simulating physiological barrier environment, microfluidic apparatus and method for simulating a physiological barrier environment
abstract_en: An organ chip assembly for simulating physiological barrier environment provided. The organ chip assembly includes a first microfluidic component having a first microfluidic channel, a second microfluidic component having a second microfluidic channel, wherein the second microfluidic channel is configured to receive a membrane and a third microfluidic component having a third microfluidic channel. The first microfluidic component, the second microfluidic component, and the third microfluidic component are configured to be combined. When combined, the second microfluidic component is positioned between the first microfluidic component and the third microfluidic component, such that the first microfluidic channel of the first microfluidic component faces the second microfluidic component and comprises a first portion configured to substantially align with and connect to the second microfluidic channel of the second microfluidic component, and the third microfluidic channel of the third microfluidic component faces the second microfluidic component and comprises a second portion configured to substantially align with and connect to the second microfluidic channel of the second microfluidic component.

title_en: Anti-Ryk antibodies and methods of using the same
abstract_en: Methods for inhibiting degeneration of a neuron, methods of treating a neurological/neurodegenerative disease, methods of modulating the directional growth of a neuron, and methods of interfering with the interaction of Wnt and Ryk are provided herein. Also provided are isolated anti-Ryk antibodies and antibody fragments that specifically bind to a binding domain of Wnt.

title_en: Method for identifying substances which prime cells for a stress response and cells for use in this method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a transgenic eukaryotic cell or non-human organism comprising one or more genetic modifications providing the activation of one or more signal transduction pathways which are involved in stress-induced gene expression and/or the pre-activation of one or more members of the transcriptional machinery and an expression cassette which comprises a nucleic acid sequence coding for a reporter protein under the control of a promoter the methylation of which increases upon priming for a stress response. The present invention also relates to a method for identifying substances which prime eukaryotic cells for a stress response by using this transgenic cell or organism.

title_en: Microarray slides that enhance fluorescent signals via plasmonic interaction
abstract_en: The invention describes generating and use of a multi-layer plasmonic slide, wherein the plasmonic slide comprises at least 6 layers of metallic nanoparticles that can enhance the detection of fluorescent signals and wherein the plasmonic slide can be printed as a microarray of any size. The microarray containing the plasmonic slide can further be printed with a protein, a glycan, or an antibody. The multi-layer plasmonic slide is capable of detecting proteins, polynucleotides, and/or glycans at orders of magnitude lower concentration than non-plasmonic substrates.

title_en: Methods and kits for determining predisposition to develop kidney diseases
abstract_en: Provided are methods and kits for determining predisposition of a subject to develop a kidney disease, by identifying in a sample of the subject at least one APOL1 polypeptide variant which is characterized by a higher trypanolytic activity on  Trypanosoma brucei rhodesiense  as compared to the trypanolytic activity of wild type APOL1 polypeptide as set forth in SEQ ID NO:1 on the  Trypanosoma brucei rhodesiense  under identical assay conditions; or at least one APOL1 nucleotide mutation in the APLO1 genomic sequence set forth in SEQ ID NO:3, wherein the at least one nucleotide mutation or polypeptide variant being in linkage disequilibrium (LD) with the S342G mutation in the APOL1 polypeptide set forth in SEQ ID NO:1, wherein presence of the APOL1 polypeptide variant indicates increased predisposition of the subject to develop the kidney disease.

title_en: Method of calibrating an electronic nose
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for calibrating an electronic nose, said electronic nose comprising a plurality of optical sensors arranged on a surface and capable of being in contact with a gaseous medium of interest, said optical sensors being capable of delivering a signal representative of the local optical index of the gaseous medium of interest when they are excited by photons, the method being characterized in that it comprises the following steps: after having placed the electronic nose in a gaseous medium of interest at the initial pressure (P 0 ) and the initial temperature (T 0 ): a) sending photons in the direction of the sensors so as to excite said sensors; b) measuring the signal delivered by each of the sensors, this measurement providing as many responses as there are sensors; c) modifying the pressure and/or temperature of the gaseous medium of interest; d) repeating step b); and e) for each sensor, determining a correction factor such as a variation in the signal between steps d) and b) corrected by the correction factor either equal to or substantially equal to a variation in the signal between these same steps for a reference, said reference being provided by a reference sensor or a combination of reference sensors. Such a method allows a physical calibration, that in the present case is relative, to be performed between the different sensors.

title_en: Optimised method for detecting the formation gas hydrates
abstract_en:
The present invention relates to a method for detecting the presence of gas hydrates and/or ice in a medium. The method comprises at least the following steps:
         measuring at least at one measurement point in said medium two characteristic values of Raman spectra corresponding to two distinct vibration modes of the OH bonds of water, and determining the ratio τ of said two characteristic values,   determining the temperature T in said medium at said measurement point of said spectra,   comparing ratio τ with a value τ 0  corresponding to a predetermined threshold of formation of said crystals for said temperature T, and   determining the presence or not of hydrate and/or ice crystals from said comparison.

title_en: Methods of diagnosing and treating autism spectrum disorders
abstract_en: The invention describes a method of diagnosing an individual as having an increased likelihood of having an autism spectrum disorder and in some instances, selecting a therapy. The invention is related to a system or a kit for performing such a method.

title_en: Simulation device and method for studying the influence of wetland plant litter decomposition on water quality
abstract_en: The invention “simulation device and method for studying the influence of wetland plant litter decomposition on water quality”, belongs to the ecological engineering field. The simulation device comprises a distributing reservoir, a planting pool and a discharge bay, and the three are connected successively through a first-level pipeline; the distributing reservoir is used to supply water to the planting pool; the discharge bay is used to collect wastewater discharged from the planting pool; the planting pool comprises a plurality of planting units; the planting unit is a container-like structure and used to hold the planting substrate and plant wetland plants on the planting substrate. By using the simulation device and/or simulation method of the invention, the whole process of the influence of plant litters especially wetland plants litters on water quality under natural state can be highly simulated and restored.

title_en: Tryptophan oxidase and use thereof
abstract_en: A mutated tryptophan oxidase suitable for practical implementation is described herein. Specifically, a mutated tryptophan oxidase wherein at least one amino acid residue of a wild-type tryptophan oxidase is mutated and, as a result, has higher tryptophan oxidase activity and/or stability as compared to the wild-type tryptophan oxidase. The mutated tryptophan oxidase can be derived from a wild-type tryptophan oxidase having at least one of Motifs (2), (3), (5), (7), (9), (11), (13), and (14), and at least one amino acid residue in any of these motifs can have mutation. The mutated tryptophan oxidase also can have a mutation of one or more amino acid residues in an amino acid sequence represented by SEQ ID NO: 2 and a sequence homologous thereto.

title_en: Beta lactamase as biomarker for the specific detection of tuberculosis-complex bacteria
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides methods, reagents, systems, and devices that target β lactamase as a biomarker for the sensitive and specific detection of tuberculosis-complex bacteria. Specifically, the present disclosure relates to methods and compositions for the detection of specific β-lactamase protein and nucleic acid sequences to indicate the presence of tuberculosis-complex bacteria.

title_en: Hand held smell test
abstract_en: A hand held olfactory tester includes an elongated housing ( 12 ) with an opening at its forward end ( 30 ) thereof. An odorant chamber ( 22 ) located within the housing moveable axially between a forward (FIG.  4 ) and a backward position (FIG.  5 ). A wick ( 34 ) extends from the odorant chamber forwardly into a nozzle ( 32 ) carried at the forward end of the chamber. A thumb collar ( 24 ) located around the outside of the housing allows to move the odor chamber and nozzle forwardly. The forward end of the wick exposed to outside through the opening when moved forward so that vapors from the odorant can be smelled by a patient. O-rings ( 40, 42 ) seal the nozzle from the outside when in backward position to prevent vapors from escaping. An elongated spring ( 28 ) biases the odorant chamber and nozzle backwardly into its rear sealed position when the thumb collar is released.

title_en: Compositions and methods for capture of cellular targets of bioactive agents
abstract_en: The present invention provides compositions and methods for capture and identification of the cellular targets of a bioactive agent. In particular, provided herein are bioactive agents tethered to capture ligand, cellular targets (optionally tagged with a reporter), capture proteins (optionally present as capture fusions), surfaces (e.g., displaying, capture ligands, capture proteins, or capture fusions), and methods of capturing and identifying the cellular targets of a bioactive agent therewith.

title_en: Detection and treatment of malignant tumours in the CNS
abstract_en: The present invention concerns methods of diagnosing and treating a malignant neoplasm of the CNS by detecting mammalian tissue expressing integrin alpha 10 subunit or a fragment or variant thereof, and administering a drug specific for integrin alpha 10 subunit.

title_en: Chemically encoded spatially addressed library screening platforms
abstract_en: Provided herein are encoded split pool libraries useful, inter alia, for forming highly diverse and dense arrays for screening and detection of a variety of molecules.

title_en: Implement for inspection, inspecting device and inspecting method
abstract_en: Provided is an implement for inspection capable of measuring the concentration of a test substance with high accuracy. The implement for inspection according to the present invention is an implement for inspection used for measuring the concentration of a test substance that includes a compound for reacting with a test substance to form a granular substance or a compound which is for being bound to the test substance and is a granular substance, and a wall portion having a periodic structure on its surface.

title_en: Hydrodynamic treadmill: a tracking device to study biotic/abiotic systems in gravitational and hydrodynamic fields
abstract_en: An annular fluid-filled sample chamber is used to provide observation of unbounded motion of objects in the fluid. Rotation of the sample chamber is under automatic control to compensate for azimuthal motion of the object, thereby keeping the object in a fixed field of view of an optical observation system. Further motion control can be provided in the radial and focus directions, which can be used to provide full 3D tracking of objects as they move in the fluid. An important application of this work is to observation and tracking of objects that move up or down in the fluid with respect to gravity.

title_en: Light chain variable regions
abstract_en: Novel modulators, including antibodies and derivatives thereof, and methods of using such modulators to treat proliferative disorders are provided.

title_en: Smart sensing network
abstract_en: Embodiments are described of a sensing network including one or more sensor nodes, wherein each of the one or more sensor nodes includes a gas sensor that can measure the presence, concentration, or both, of one or more airborne pollutants in a nodal coverage area surrounding the sensor node. A sensor base that can measure the presence, concentration, or both, of one or more airborne pollutants is positioned in the nodal coverage area of each of the one or more sensor nodes, wherein the sensor base includes a gas sensor with higher accuracy, higher sensitivity, or both, than the gas sensors of the one or more sensor nodes. One or more servers communicatively coupled to the sensor base and the one or more sensors nodes. The sensor base and the sensor nodes can communicate their measurements to the server and the measurements of the sensor base are used by the server as a reference to correct the measurements of the one or more sensor nodes.

title_en: Methods for de novo protein sequencing
abstract_en: A method for determining an amino acid sequence of a polypeptide, including comprising: contacting a first sample containing the polypeptide with a first protease(e.g., Trypsin) to produce a first set of digested peptide fragments; fragmenting the first set of digested peptide fragments to produce a first set of fragmented peptide ions; determining masses of the first set of fragmented peptide ions; contacting a second sample containing the polypeptide with a second protease (e.g., Tryp-N); fragmenting the second set of digested peptide fragments to produce a second set of fragmented peptide ions; selecting pairs of peptide ions from the first and the second set of fragmented peptide ions that differ in mass by a mass of an arginine amino acid residue or a lysine amino acid residue; assigning an ion type (either N-terminal peptide ion or C-terminal peptide ion) to the selected pairs of the peptide ions from two sets of fragmented peptide ions;selecting a mass ladder of the same-type peptide ions in either set of fragmented peptide ions with incremental mass by the mass of amino acid residue(s), and assembling the identified amino acid residues from the mass ladder to determine the amino acid sequence of the polypeptide of interest.

title_en: Light microscopy chips and data analysis methodology for quantitative localzied surface plasmon resonance (LSPR) biosensing and imaging
abstract_en: A chip for localized surface plasmon resonance (LSPR) biosensing and imaging having a glass coverslip compatible for use in a standard microscope and at least one array of functionalized plasmonic nanostructures patterned onto the glass coverslip with electron beam nanolithography. The nanostructures can be regenerated allowing the chip to be used multiple times. Also disclosed is a method for determining the fractional occupancy values for surface-bound receptors as a function of time for LSPR biosensing from the spectroscopic response of the array and modeling the photon count in each spectrometer channel, allowing for a functional relationship to be determined between the acquired spectrum and the fractional occupancy of binding sites on the array. Additionally disclosed is a method for the spatiotemporal mapping of receptor-ligand binding kinetics in LSPR imaging using the chip and projecting a magnified image of the array to a CCD camera and monitoring the binding kinetics of the array.

title_en: System and method for automated detection and monitoring of dysplasia and administration of immunotherapy and chemotherapy
abstract_en: A method of treating a malignancy in a human subject by analyzing pseudo-projection images of cells obtained from a sputum specimen obtained from a subject employs a biological specimen classifier that identifies cells from the sputum specimen as normal or abnormal. If abnormal cells are detected, then the abnormal cells are further classified as dysplastic or cancerous. If the cells are classified as dysplastic, then an immunomodulating agent is administered to the subject over a predetermined time period designed to achieve a therapeutic dosage.

title_en: Area monitoring device, and method of operating same
abstract_en: An area monitoring device is placed in a location to monitor volatile organic compounds emissions. The device includes a gas sensor capable of detecting VOCs, a sorbent material capable of absorbing VOC molecules, and a heating element positioned in close relation to, or in direct contact with, the sorbent material. After a period of time during which the sorbent material absorbs VOC molecules, the sorbent material is heated to cause the sorbent material to release a gas containing VOC molecules. The amount of released VOC molecules is sensed and calculated. Data is compiled and analyzed. This is accomplished without removing the device from the location. A pump may be provided to force ambient air through the device.

title_en: Bio-impedance spectroscopy system and method for bio-impedance measurement
abstract_en: The present disclosure is directed to an impedance spectroscopy system for bio-impedance measurement. The impedance spectroscopy system includes a signal generator configured to generate a signal with a broadband frequency spectrum and to generate an analog injection current from the signal with the broadband frequency spectrum. The analog injection current has a high pass frequency characteristic. The impedance spectroscopy system also includes an amplifier configured to measure a voltage signal in response to the analog injection current and to simultaneously measure a biopotential signal. Further, the impedance spectroscopy system includes a processor configured to analyze the voltage signal to derive a bio-impedance spectrum as well to derive further information from the biopotential signal.

title_en: Hereditary cancer genes
abstract_en: The invention generally relates to a molecular classification of disease predisposition and particularly to molecular markers for cancer predisposition and methods of use thereof.

title_en: Water electrolysis device
abstract_en: A water electrolysis device comprises an ion exchange membrane electrolytic cell. The ion exchange membrane electrolytic cell includes an ion exchange membrane, a cathode chamber, an anode chamber, a hydrogen output tube, and an oxygen output tube. An anode is configured in the anode chamber, and a cathode is configured in the cathode chamber. The ion exchange membrane is configured between the anode chamber and the anode chamber. The hydrogen output tube is coupled to the cathode chamber, and the oxygen output tube is coupled to the anode chamber. When water is electrolyzed by the ion exchange membrane electrolytic cell, oxygen is generated by the anode and then exported through the oxygen output tube, and hydrogen is generated by the cathode and then exported through the hydrogen output tube. The hydrogen and the oxygen are exported from the same side of the ion exchange membrane electrolytic cell.

title_en: PD-1 related cancer therapy
abstract_en: Provided are compositions and methods for identifying individuals with cancer who will benefit from PD-1 inhibitor therapy. The method comprises determining levels of signaling lymphocyte activation molecule-associated protein (SAP) in an individual and based on the SAP levels, determining if the individual is suitable for PD-1 inhibitor therapy. Also provided is a method of treatment of X-linked lymphoproliferative disease comprising administering to an individual PD-1 inhibitory therapy, with or without SHP2 inhibitors.

title_en: In-vehicle exhaust gas analysis system, inspection system for in-vehicle exhaust gas analysis system, inspection method for in-vehicle exhaust gas analysis system, and inspection program
abstract_en: An in-vehicle exhaust gas analysis system, which is provided with a flowmeter, and an exhaust gas analyzer to analyze a concentration of a measurement target component contained in exhaust gas, includes a standard gas supply mechanism to supply a standard gas containing a predetermined component to the flowmeter and the exhaust gas analyzer. The system is configured to include a detected mass calculation section to calculate a detected mass of a predetermined component by using a flow rate obtained by the flowmeter and a concentration of the predetermined component obtained by the exhaust gas analyzer, a supply mass acquisition section to acquire a supply mass of the predetermined component supplied from the standard gas supply mechanism to the flowmeter and the exhaust gas analyzer, and a mass comparison section to compare a detected mass calculated by the mass calculation section and a supply mass acquired by the supply mass acquisition section.

title_en: Biogas quality evaluation device, biogas quality evaluation method, and program
abstract_en: In the present invention, an input unit receives input of production conditions relating to a plurality of parameters relating to production of a biogas in a biogas production facility. An index value corresponds to an amount of heat per unit quantity of a biogas generated by the biogas production facility under the production conditions. A condition classifying unit classifies the production conditions on the basis of the plurality of parameters and the index value. An output unit outputs information relating to the result of classification by the condition classifying unit.

title_en: Biochemical analysis instrument
abstract_en: An analysis instrument comprises plural modules connected together over a data network, each module comprising an analysis apparatus operable to perform biochemical analysis of a sample. Each module comprises a control unit that controls the operation of the analysis apparatus. The control units are addressable to select an arbitrary number of modules to operate as a cluster for performing a common biochemical analysis. The control units communicate over the data network, repeatedly during the performance of the common biochemical analysis, to determine the operation of the analysis apparatus of each module required to meet the global performance targets, on the basis of measures of performance derived from the output data produced by the modules. The arrangement of the instrument as modules interacting in this manner provides a scalable analysis instrument.

title_en: System and method for controlling a flow through a pneumatic system
abstract_en: A device, system and method related to a pneumatic system for fluid analysis. The device, system and method comprises a connection interface for a fluid analyser unit, a connection interface for a pump unit, a flow sensor and a pressure sensor. The device, system and method further comprises a control unit for calculating a pump stroke force or amplitude, and/or pump frequency based on measurements from the flow sensor and the pressure sensor for obtaining a constant flow through the pneumatic system.

title_en: Systems and methods for analyzing natural gas flow in subterranean reservoirs
abstract_en: Systems and methods for analyzing and modeling natural gas flow in subterranean shale reservoirs. In some embodiments, methodologies and techniques for determining and modeling natural gas flow in shale formations using methodologies and techniques capable of determining natural gas properties related to dual-continuum flow, permeability, and pressure within a subterranean shale reservoir. In some embodiments, the natural gas properties are determined by subjecting a subterranean shale reservoir sample to pulse-decay analysis. In certain embodiments, the methodologies and techniques described may be used in various reservoirs exhibiting macroporosity and microporosity, such as fractured reservoirs and carbonate reservoirs composed of reservoir fluids.

title_en: Alcohol detection device with redundant measuring channels and method for detecting alcohol in breathing air
abstract_en: A device and a process detects alcohol in a gas sample, especially in an exhaled breath sample. A measuring chamber ( 2 ) receives the gas sample to be tested. Two IR radiation sources ( 7, 11 ) are configured to transmit an IR beam each into the measuring chamber ( 2 ). Two IR detectors ( 9, 13 ) generate a measured value each depending on an incident IR beam. An analysis unit ( 10 ) automatically makes a decision on whether or not the gas sample contains alcohol, doing so depending on the two measured values from the two IR detectors ( 9, 13 ).

title_en: Biological fluid collection device and collection module
abstract_en: A biological fluid collection device that receives a sample and provides flow-through blood stabilization technology and a precise sample dispensing function for point-of-care and near patient testing applications is disclosed. A biological fluid collection device of the present disclosure is able to effectuate distributed mixing of a sample stabilizer within a blood sample and dispense the stabilized sample in a controlled manner. In this manner, a biological fluid collection device of the present disclosure enables blood micro-sample management, e.g., passive mixing with a sample stabilizer and controlled dispensing, for point-of-care and near patient testing applications.

title_en: Cytokine profiling analysis
abstract_en: This invention relates to methods for predicting a prognosis of a patient with cancer in need of an anti-cancer treatment comprising measuring a cytokine score from a sample obtained from the patient. In some embodiments, the subject is administered an anti-cancer treatment, e.g., an anti-PD-1 antibody, following the cytokine score measurement. In some embodiments, the cancer is lung cancer.

title_en: Gene expression analysis ME1HOD using two dimensional cDNA library
abstract_en: The present invention provides a method and/or means for collecting and analyzing an individual cell in a tissue, and at the same time, quantitatively monitoring the expression levels of various genes while keeping two-dimensional information in the tissue. Specifically, the present invention provides a method comprising preparing a cDNA library from mRNA while keeping two-dimensional cellular distribution information and obtaining the gene expression levels at any site or all sites at a level of single cell. More specifically, the present invention provides a method comprising preparing a cDNA library in a sheet-form from mRNA while keeping two-dimensional cellular distribution information and repeatedly using the cDNA library in the detection of the gene expression, thereby allowing measurement of the expression distribution for a number of genes at a high accuracy.

title_en: Method, biomarker and diagnostic agent for detection of high-risk prostate cancer
abstract_en:
[Problem] To provide a method for detecting high-risk prostate cancer, for the purpose of providing useful information, such as necessity of biopsy, to a test-positive patient in a PSA test. 
     [Solution] The method for detecting high-risk prostate cancer according to the present invention comprises reacting a PSA contained in a sample composed of urine collected from a human body which is suspected to be suffering from prostate cancer with (1) a fucose α1→6 affinitive lectin which has a characteristic property that the lectin has affinity expressed by a binding constant of 1.0×10 4  M −1  or more (at 25° C.) for an α1→6 fucose sugar chain No. 405.
