abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for predicting urban traffic states, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring traffic volume data of vehicles in a preset period, determining a restriction influence vehicle set and a restriction influence vehicle set according to OD (origin-destination) data of the vehicles in the preset period, determining a vehicle just needing to be traveled and a travel mode of the vehicle just needing to be traveled according to the restriction influence vehicle set and the vehicles in the restriction influence vehicle set, analyzing the travel mode of the vehicle just needing to be traveled, determining the space-time characteristics of the vehicles detouring in the restriction influence vehicle set and the restriction influence vehicle set, and predicting the urban traffic states according to the space-time characteristics of the vehicles detouring in the restriction influence vehicle set and the restriction influence vehicle set. The prediction method is simple and feasible, has high stability, can fully utilize the accumulated mass traffic data, and reduces the working intensity of manual calculation.

title_en: Intelligent ideological education display control system and method based on cloud platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ideological education display, and discloses an intelligent ideological education display control system and method based on a cloud platform. The display control system includes: the information publishing module is used for acquiring related information of the ideological education and sending the related information to the cloud platform; the cloud platform is used for receiving the related information of the ideological education, comparing and analyzing the related information with the pre-stored preset display information, determining a matched display scheme based on the comparison and analysis result and sending a corresponding control instruction; and the display module receives the control instruction and dynamically adjusts the number, the positions and the display modes of the display screens so as to realize dynamic intelligent display of the related information of the ideological education. According to the intelligent ideological education display control system based on the cloud platform and the method thereof, through analyzing ideological education contents, the plurality of display screens are controlled to be dynamically combined to form an optimal display form, compared with a traditional fixed single display form, the interest and flexibility of display are improved, and a better ideological education propaganda purpose is achieved.

title_en: Controlling a wind turbine during a low voltage grid event using MPC
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to control of a wind turbine in connection with a low voltage event (35) in which the grid voltage drops from a first level to a second, lower level. Upon detecting the termination of the low voltage event (t2), the turbine operates in a recovery mode (31) in which the turbine is operated by using the control trajectory. The control trajectory is determined by using a Model Predictive Control (MPC) routine.

title_en: Aircraft navigation technology based on image recognition
abstract_en: Techniques for controlling a movable object based on gesture-based input are disclosed. The client device (304) may receive image data associated with the first view from an image capture device (312). The client device (304) may detect a gesture-based input indicating a change from a first view (308) to a second view from an image capture device (312). The gesture-based input may be associated with at least one first region (322) of image data. Control data associated with a change from a first view (308) to a second view may be determined based on one or more reference coordinates associated with the gesture-based input.

title_en: Parameter adaptive fractional order active disturbance rejection automatic power generation control method
abstract_en: The invention provides a parameter self-adaptive fractional order active disturbance rejection automatic power generation control method, which combines a fractional order control thought and an active disturbance rejection algorithm into a fractional order active disturbance rejection algorithm and then applies a parameter self-adaptive strategy to the fractional order active disturbance rejection algorithm. The method provided by the invention calculates the fractional order control quantity through a computer, so that the control performance of the automatic power generation control system is improved. The method provided by the invention can avoid a complicated process of manually adjusting the parameters of the controller. The method provided by the invention utilizes a parameter self-adaptive algorithm to automatically adjust the parameters of the system, and the adjusted fractional order active disturbance rejection model can obtain higher control performance without manually adjusting the parameters and has good disturbance rejection capability.

title_en: Tea frying machine control method for detecting tea height by using laser probe
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tea frying machine control method for detecting tea height by using a laser probe, wherein the tea frying machine comprises a rack, a height detection device, a motor, a first coupler, a torque sensor, a second coupler, a transmission shaft, a frying pan, an electric heating wire, a frying plate, a speed sensor and a temperature sensor; the control of the tea frying machine on the motor and the electric heating wire depends on the specific numerical values obtained by the torque sensor, the problem that the tea frying quality is unstable due to the operation of workers by feel is solved, the quality of processed tea is improved, and the improvement significance of improving the tea processing quality is profound; the laser probe comprises a plurality of pairs of laser probes, and the height of tea leaves during stir-frying can be accurately controlled through data read by the laser probes with different heights, so that the accuracy of controlling the rotating speed of the motor is improved.

title_en: Household appliance control method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a household appliance control method and device. Wherein, the method comprises the following steps: at least two microprocessors in the household appliance are combined into one physical microprocessor; creating two boxes and an internal channel between the two boxes for the merged physical microprocessor, wherein one box is a control box for performing local closed-loop control of the home appliance, the other box is a network box for performing communication control based on communication with the outside of the home appliance, and the internal channel is used for performing communication between the two boxes; the control of the home appliance is performed according to the two boxes created. The invention solves the technical problem of low control efficiency caused by unreasonable MCU setting in household appliance control in the related art.

title_en: Mute language conversion system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of language conversion systems, in particular to a language conversion system for a mute language, which comprises a mobile terminal, a sound input module, an image input module, a sound output module, an image output module and an exchange memory module, wherein the sound input module is used for inputting a sound; the image input module comprises an image acquisition unit, an image slicing unit, an image comparison unit, a gesture language database and an image screening unit; the gesture language of the deaf-mute is input into the mobile terminal through the image acquisition unit, the video is sliced through the image slicing unit, the image comparison unit compares the image slices with the data in the gesture language database, the most appropriate data is fed back to the conversion system through the image screening unit and then is output from the sound output module, the gesture language of the other side is helped to be understood by a user, so that the answer or the help is provided, the problems that the gesture language cannot be understood and the deaf-mute cannot communicate with a normal person are effectively solved, and the social harmony development is promoted.

title_en: Article selling method and apparatus, storage medium, and electronic apparatus
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for selling articles, a storage medium and an electronic device. The method comprises the following steps: receiving first request information sent by a client for requesting to purchase a target item on a target vending machine; under the condition that the target object is a preset type object and the condition that the target account number is determined to be in accordance with the condition of purchasing the preset type object according to the first identity information, sending payment prompt information matched with the target object to the client; under the condition of receiving second request information for requesting to extract the target item in the target vending machine, sending an authentication instruction to the target vending machine; receiving second identity information sent by the target vending machine; and under the condition that the second identity information is matched with the first identity information, sending a first control instruction for conveying the target object to the article taking port to the target vending machine. Therefore, the technical effect that the preset category of articles are only sold to the users meeting the purchasing conditions is achieved, and the technical problem that the articles are sold without distinguishing the shopping objects is solved.

title_en: Self-service equipment of electric power marketing
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of electric power marketing, in particular to electric power marketing self-service equipment, which aims at the problems that a display screen on the existing electric power marketing self-service equipment is inconvenient to adjust to the most suitable angle for viewing according to requirements, the purpose of marketing cannot be achieved, and the use requirement of a user cannot be met. The invention has the advantages of high practicality, simple structure, convenient operation, and capability of adjusting the angle of the display screen in the workbench when adjusting the height of the workbench quickly and conveniently, and being convenient for adjusting the display screen to the most suitable angle for watching according to the requirements, thereby meeting the use requirements of users.

title_en: Power supply starting reset circuit with magnetic hysteresis function
abstract_en: A power-on reset circuit with hysteresis function, comprising: current mirror, bleeder circuit, hysteresis control circuit, and logic driver. The current mirror is coupled to an external supply potential. The voltage divider circuit generates a first control potential according to an externally supplied potential. The hysteresis control circuit generates a second control potential based on the externally supplied potential and the first control potential. The logic driver generates an output potential according to the second control potential. The hysteresis control circuit further defines a first threshold potential and a second threshold potential different from each other according to the output potential, so that a logic switching state of the output potential is determined by comparing the external supply potential with the first threshold potential or the second threshold potential.

title_en: Protection device for data interface of financial equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a protection device for a data interface of financial equipment, which comprises a main machine body and a top seat, wherein the top seat is fixed at the top end of the main machine body, a display screen is arranged on the top seat and can display information so as to operate a system of the financial equipment, a locking cavity is formed in the main machine body, a locking mechanism is arranged in the locking cavity, a middle cavity is formed in the main machine body at the bottom of the locking mechanism, the right end of the middle cavity is in an open design, a data transmission mechanism is arranged in the middle cavity, a transmission cavity is formed in the main machine body at the bottom of the data transmission mechanism, and a transmission mechanism is arranged in the transmission cavity. And after the system is updated, the device can be automatically reset and locked, so that the operation steps are saved, and the use is more convenient.

title_en: Integrated intelligent actuator and valve device
abstract_en: An integrated device in an HVAC system is configured to modify an environmental condition of a building. The device comprises: a valve configured to regulate a flow of fluid through a conduit; an actuator comprising a motor and a drive; and a communication mechanism. The communication mechanism is configured to receive a flow rate set point from an external control device of the external control loop. The apparatus further comprises a processing circuit. The processing circuit is configured to determine an actuator position set point based on the flow rate set point and a flow rate measurement from a flow rate sensor of the inner control loop using a cascaded feedback control mechanism. The valve, the actuator, the communication mechanism, and the processing circuit are located within a common integrated device chassis.

title_en: Electronic information engineering experimental device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electronic information engineering experimental device, which belongs to the technical field of electronic information and comprises a material testing mechanism, an electronic element testing mechanism, a case and a circuit board fixing mechanism, wherein the material testing mechanism comprises a protective box, a limiting damping assembly, a radiating assembly and a horizontally arranged bearing plate, the bearing plate is arranged inside the protective box, the protective assembly is arranged at the front end of the protective box, a buffer part is arranged at the bottom of the bearing plate, the limiting damping assembly comprises a splash guard, a compression plate and a driving part for driving the splash guard to vertically move, and the compression plate is horizontally arranged inside the splash guard. According to the invention, the purposes of compressing, limiting and damping the experimental material can be achieved through the material testing mechanism, the influence on the safety of students when the experimental material is broken is avoided, and the error point of the circuit board during the test can be detected through the flying probe testing machine in the electronic element testing mechanism.

title_en: Bottled red wine storage equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses bottled red wine storage equipment, which comprises a cabinet provided with a wine taking part; the wine rack device is arranged in the cabinet and used for placing the red wine which is transversely placed and can be drawn out from the side wall of the cabinet; the conveying device is used for driving the red wine placed transversely to rotate to be placed longitudinally and conveying the red wine to the wine taking part; the second conveying device is used for conveying the red wine falling from the wine rack device to the conveying device; and the rotating device is arranged on the cabinet and used for driving the red wine positioned in the wine taking part to rotate to the label of the red wine outwards. According to the wine taking device, the red wine in the cabinet is conveyed by the conveying device and is converted from horizontal placement to longitudinal placement to be conveyed to the wine taking part, so that when a customer takes the red wine, the palm and the fingers are in contact with the side wall of the wine bottle when the customer grips the red wine, the contact area is large, the friction force is large, the wine bottle can fall and be smashed, and the convenience and the safety in the process of purchasing the red wine are improved.

title_en: Hydraulic press test monitoring and information storage analysis system
abstract_en: A hydraulic press test monitoring and information storage analysis system is characterized in that an industrial personal computer host is connected with an industrial personal computer display, a profinet network module and a PCI network module are installed in the industrial personal computer host, the profinet network module is connected with an RS485/Ethernet protocol conversion module, the PCI network module is connected with a server, the RS485/Ethernet protocol conversion module is connected with a PLC, signals collected by the PLC are converted into the profinet network module through the RS485/Ethernet protocol conversion module and are received by the industrial personal computer host, the industrial personal computer host transmits the signals to the industrial personal computer display and displays the signals on the industrial personal computer display, and the PCI network module automatically transmits the signals collected in the industrial personal computer host to the server for storage. The invention can display the hydraulic pressure and oil pressure curve in real time, better control the synchronous balance of the hydraulic pressure and oil pressure in real time and automatically store data.

title_en: Road sign information indicating equipment for smart city management
abstract_en: The invention discloses a road sign information indicating device for smart city management, which comprises a road sign pole, wherein a network signal receiver is installed on the road sign pole, a lightning rod is arranged at the top end of the road sign pole, the lower surface of the road sign pole is connected with a street lamp, a main control and storage unit is installed on the lower surface of the road sign pole, and a horizontal rotation control stepping motor is installed on the upper surface of the road sign pole. This road sign information indicating equipment is used in wisdom city management, can change its form along with the size of wind-force, and then can be convenient for reduce the size of its wind-force that receives, thereby can be convenient for increase its life, and can utilize wind energy and solar energy to generate electricity, be favorable to improving resource utilization, and can real-timely with road conditions red green pilot lamp for the condition of blocking up feedback, thereby be favorable to the vehicle to select suitable road to go, enable solar cell panel to move towards sunshine all the time simultaneously, be favorable to improving the sunlight utilization ratio, in addition, through the lightning rod, can reduce the probability that the thunder and lightning damaged this equipment.

title_en: Billing machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses an invoicing machine, which comprises an invoicing machine body, wherein the upper surface of the invoicing machine body is provided with a carrying groove, the upper end surface of the carrying groove is covered with a cover plate, a plurality of rolls of roll paper are arranged in the carrying groove, the bottom of the carrying groove is elastically connected with a rotating plate, the rotating plate is matched with the roll paper, the opposite side walls of the carrying groove are provided with limiting plates, and one roll paper is clamped on the limiting plate; the bottom of the accommodating groove is provided with a discharging through hole, the lower side of the discharging through hole is provided with an L-shaped plate, and two end faces of the L-shaped plate are fixedly connected to the lower surface of the billing machine body; when the roll paper is replaced, the cover plate can be prevented from being opened by a worker, meanwhile, the worker is prevented from manually taking the residual winding drum, the labor and time are saved, and convenience is brought to the worker.

title_en: High-safety goods taking device for coconut vending machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-safety goods taking device for a coconut vending machine, which belongs to the technical field of coconut vending machines and comprises a rotating base, wherein a supporting turntable is fixedly connected to the top of the rotating base, a connecting seat is abutted to the top of the supporting turntable, smooth rods are fixedly connected to the left side wall and the right side wall of an inner cavity of the connecting seat, a motor bearing frame is arranged in the inner cavity of the connecting seat, two groups of sliding seats which are symmetrical in front and back are fixedly connected to the bottoms of the left side wall and the right side wall of the motor bearing frame, the sliding seats on the left side and the right side are respectively sleeved on the outer sides of the circumferences of the left optical sliding rod and the right side optical sliding rod, a top plate is fixedly connected to the top of the motor bearing frame, a goods feeding conveying belt is arranged on the top of the motor bearing frame, and a conveying motor and a moving motor are arranged in the inner cavity of the motor bearing frame. The coconut milk device is convenient for protecting coconuts, improving the overall safety of the device, facilitating the device to drive coconuts, improving the stability of coconuts, preventing coconuts from spilling due to toppling of coconuts, facilitating the disassembly and assembly of the device, and facilitating maintenance.

title_en: Depth adjusting mechanism and automatic banknote receiving hopper thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a depth adjusting mechanism and an automatic banknote receiving hopper thereof, wherein the depth adjusting mechanism comprises a depth adjusting motor, an output shaft of the depth adjusting motor is coaxially assembled and fixed with one end of a depth adjusting screw rod, the other end of the depth adjusting screw rod respectively penetrates through a vertical plate and a depth adjusting driving plate and then is assembled with the edge of a bottom plate in a circumferential rotation manner, the depth adjusting screw rod and the vertical plate can be assembled in a circumferential rotation manner, the depth adjusting screw rod and a depth adjusting screw barrel are assembled in a screw thread screwing manner, and the depth adjusting screw barrel is fixed on the depth adjusting driving plate; the two bottom plate edges are respectively arranged on two sides of the vertical plate, the two bottom plate edges are respectively assembled and fixed with two ends of the depth adjusting guide rod, the depth adjusting guide rod is sleeved with a depth adjusting sliding cylinder, the depth adjusting sliding cylinder is fixed on the depth adjusting driving plate, and the depth adjusting sliding cylinder can slide in the axial direction of the depth adjusting guide rod; a depth adjusting installation block is fixed on the depth adjusting driving plate, and a depth adjusting door plate is installed on the depth adjusting installation block. The invention has simple structure, and adjusts the distance between the two width adjusting plates, the height of the bill receiving plate and the assembly depth of the bill receiving plate and the bill.

title_en: Routine driving speed planning strategy based on road curvature
abstract_en: The invention provides a routine driving speed planning strategy based on road curvature, which comprises the following steps: acquiring coordinate information of all target points on a target path with an arc length L in front of the vehicle and position information of the vehicle through the vehicle environment sensing system and the path planning system; calculating the closest point closest to the position of the user according to the information; determining a pre-aiming point according to the pre-aiming distance, and further calculating a linear equation of a connecting line between the current position of the automobile and the pre-aiming point; traversing all target points between the nearest point and the pre-aiming point, calculating the distance between the points and the straight line, and further determining a maximum distance point; calculating the curvature radius of the maximum distance point, calculating the target vehicle speed of the point according to the curvature radius, calculating the distance between the maximum distance point and the current vehicle position, and calculating the expected deceleration which realizes the deceleration to the expected vehicle speed of the maximum distance point by the current vehicle speed; the deceleration is compared with the set comfort deceleration to determine whether to maintain the current vehicle speed or to decelerate.

title_en: Whole vehicle temperature monitoring and protecting method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for monitoring and protecting the temperature of a whole vehicle, wherein the method comprises the following steps: a first temperature sensor monitors the temperature of the battery to generate a battery temperature monitoring signal; a second temperature sensor monitors the ambient temperature in the vehicle controller cabin to generate an cabin ambient temperature monitoring signal; a third temperature sensor monitors the ambient temperature outside the vehicle to generate a vehicle external ambient temperature monitoring signal; the ultrasonic radar sensor carries out self-compensation according to the monitoring signal of the environment temperature outside the automobile, and corrects the detection data; when the temperature of the battery exceeds a threshold value, the micro control unit outputs a battery temperature control signal and/or a first alarm signal; when the temperature of the environment in the cabin exceeds a threshold value, the micro control unit outputs a temperature control signal and/or a second alarm signal of the environment in the cabin; when the environment temperature outside the vehicle exceeds the threshold value, the micro control unit outputs a temperature control signal and/or a third alarm signal of the environment outside the vehicle; and the alarm signal is reported to the server and distributed to the corresponding control terminal through the wireless transceiving unit.

title_en: Organic Rankine cycle system control performance optimization method based on dynamic data correction
abstract_en: The invention discloses an organic Rankine cycle system control performance optimization method based on dynamic data correction, which comprises the following steps of: the first stage, dynamic data correction: describing a system model under non-Gaussian disturbance; solving a likelihood function of the correction data according to a maximum posterior distribution principle; supplementing complete data by utilizing a maximum expectation algorithm idea to obtain a likelihood function of the complete data, and taking a logarithm of the likelihood function; finding a tight lower bound of the logarithm of the likelihood function to obtain an optimal estimation of the unknown parameter; and a second stage, optimizing the performance based on the minimum entropy control of dynamic data correction: selecting performance indexes based on statistical information; solving for control input; and constructing a performance evaluation standard. The invention considers the defect that the Renyi entropy does not meet the consistency, provides the minimum rational entropy control performance optimization method based on dynamic data correction, and can obviously improve the control performance of the organic Rankine cycle system containing non-Gaussian noise.

title_en: Integrative cabinet of unmanned commodity circulation in green city
abstract_en: The invention relates to logistics express delivery, in particular to an unmanned logistics integrated cabinet for a green city. The invention provides a green city unmanned logistics integrated cabinet which comprises an express integrated storage mechanism, a paper box, a base and the like, wherein the paper box is arranged on the base; the lower side of the right side of the express integrated storage mechanism is spliced with a paper collecting box. The express delivery system realizes automatic collection of express delivery, can send express delivery back according to different specifications and weights, is convenient to operate, can package by self, can be used for teaching through video following on an LED liquid crystal touch screen, ensures convenient and quick use, greatly reduces the workload of couriers, only needs to collect regularly for checking and forwarding, can cooperate with corresponding online shopping APP (application), realizes direct collection and direct return, improves the urban service efficiency and the specialty, greatly improves the use experience of people, has more humanized experience, avoids the problem that many people inconveniently take and return express delivery due to time problems or character problems, further improves the urban image and increases the green urban experience.

title_en: Portable teaching biological safety cabinet
abstract_en: The invention provides a portable teaching biological safety cabinet which comprises a safety cabinet main body and a supporting device, wherein the safety cabinet main body comprises a box body and a front cover plate, and a sealed inner space can be defined; the inner space is divided into a positive pressure chamber and a clean area; the supporting device comprises a plurality of supporting parts, and the portable teaching biological safety cabinet can be placed on a mounting plane; each of the supporting parts comprises a pivoting part connected with the lower surface of the box body and a rod-shaped part used for being in contact with the installation plane; the pivoting part is provided with a pivoting shaft which is basically parallel to the lower surface of the box body; the lever portion is connected to the pivot portion so as to be rotatable about the pivot axis, and has a first position and a second position in a stable state. The invention can display the safety cabinet airflow model, the safety cabinet sealing failure demonstration, the safety cabinet principle demonstration, the filter failure demonstration and the like.

title_en: Single-side bridge wheel bridge-falling detection system, method and device
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of motor vehicle driver examination and provides a system, a method and a device for detecting the falling of a single-side bridge wheel, wherein the system comprises at least three angle acceleration sensors which are respectively arranged on axles connected with wheels of a vehicle and used for periodically detecting the acceleration and the inclination angle of the vehicle; the vehicle-mounted satellite positioning base station is connected with the data processing equipment and used for receiving the acceleration data, the inclination angle and the real-time position of the vehicle and obtaining the detection result of whether the wheel falls off the bridge or not based on the acceleration data, the inclination angle and the real-time position, so that an accurate detection result of the wheel falling off the bridge of the unilateral bridge can be obtained.

title_en: Alarm method and device based on video data, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides an alarm method, an alarm device, electronic equipment and a storage medium based on video data, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining degraded image data and target image data, wherein the degraded image data and the target image data are two image data of the same monitoring video; analyzing the degraded image data, and judging whether the degraded image data meets a preset first alarm rule; if the degraded image data meets a preset first alarm rule, determining image data corresponding to the image data meeting the first alarm rule in the degraded image data in the target image data as image data to be analyzed; analyzing the image data to be analyzed through a deep learning algorithm, and judging whether the image data to be analyzed meets a preset second alarm rule; and triggering an alarm if the image data to be analyzed meets a preset second alarm rule. The secondary alarm judgment is carried out through the deep learning algorithm, the alarm accuracy can be increased, and false alarms can be reduced.

title_en: Electrical control system of aero-engine test bed
abstract_en: The utility model provides an aeroengine test bench electrical control system, belongs to industrial equipment electrical control field, above host computer PLC system is control core, host computer PLC system control connection main air current fan control system, compressed air source control system, auxiliary equipment control system, operation panel, auxiliary equipment control system connect UPS power and other auxiliary equipment, UPS power connection data acquisition system and host computer PLC system, main air current fan control system, compressed air source control system, auxiliary equipment control system all set up the distribution equipment power supply. The electric control system adopts a control mode of combining an independent system and centralized control, takes an S7-1500 PLC as a control core and an industrial personal computer as a visual control interface, and can realize automatic control and adjustment of a rotation measuring mechanism, main air flow, anti-icing pressure and the like through a soft start/servo control/variable frequency speed regulation technology, an industrial Ethernet and RS485 communication technology and a pressure/flow closed-loop control technology.

title_en: Self-checking method and system for AC motor controller
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-checking system of an alternating current motor controller, which generates a specific modulation mode through a space vector modulation component (SVM) and is used for controlling the on-off of a power tube in an inverter and detecting the a-phase current I which should flow through a motor in the inverter a B phase current I b C phase current I c The relationship between the three. The scheme provided by the invention realizes that the motor controller outputs the current amount during self-checking, the current amount is more suitable for the actual condition of the motor controller when the motor runs, and in the self-checking process, the motor does not establish a rotating magnetic field and does not provide electromagnetic torque to the outside.

title_en: Automatic control system for amino acid chelate production process
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic control system for an amino acid chelate production process, which comprises a field production and processing equipment system for amino acid chelate production and processing, a process control station and a remote communication network, wherein the field production and processing equipment system comprises a hot water tank, a reaction kettle, a turnover tank, a high-pressure homogenizer, a standing tank, an air compressor and a purified water making system, and the process control station collects various data of the field processing equipment and uploads the data to a remote control microcomputer, and simultaneously receives a control instruction of the remote control microcomputer and transmits the control instruction to the field processing equipment system so as to control each operation of production equipment. The invention realizes the control of the full-automatic human-computer interface and the remote touch screen microcomputer, has the advantages of simple structure, visual picture, convenient and quick operation and maintenance, and can be properly expanded according to the actual production requirement, and has larger repairability and expansibility, convenient upgrading and high cost performance of the system.

title_en: Building live-action map making method and system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a method and a system for manufacturing a real scene map of a building, wherein the method comprises the following steps: building a BIM model of the target live-action, and classifying the model structure of the BIM model according to the geometric structure to obtain a first classification geometric structure and a second classification geometric structure; storing the model data of the first classification geometric structure as first file format data according to the semantic type of the first classification geometric structure; storing the model data of the second classification geometric structure as second file format data according to the semantic type of the second classification geometric structure; and acquiring texture data of the target live-action, and performing coordinate matching on the texture data and the first file format data and the second file format data respectively to obtain a live-action map corresponding to the target live-action. The embodiment of the invention improves the precision of the indoor and outdoor live-action map of the building, so that the live-action map of the building is more effectively applied to positioning and navigation of a three-dimensional scene.

title_en: Earthquake-proof typhoon type self-alarming induction lamp
abstract_en: The invention discloses an earthquake-proof typhoon-shaped self-alarming induction lamp, which comprises an alarm lamp, a buzzer, a controller and a clean power supply module, wherein the controller is arranged in a lamp post, and the controller is connected with a processor; according to the solar energy self-generating system, wind power generation is carried out through the wind power generation module, solar energy power generation is carried out through the solar cell panel, self-generation of clean energy under different environments is responded, generated energy is charged into the storage battery through the charger for standby, the use cost is reduced, and the outdoor use is facilitated.

title_en: Intelligent integrated signal lamp and control method
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent integrated signal lamp and a control method thereof, wherein the intelligent integrated signal lamp comprises a control module, a network communication module, a data transmission communication module, a positioning module, a display module, a lamp driving module, a yellow flashing lamp driving module, a detection module and a power supply module, wherein the control module is connected with the network communication module, the data transmission communication module, the positioning module, the lamp driving module, the yellow flashing lamp driving module, the detection module and the power supply module, the power supply module is connected with the detection module and the display module, the display module is connected with the detection module, the lamp driving module and the yellow flashing lamp driving module, and the yellow flashing lamp driving module is connected with the lamp driving module. The invention has the advantages of increased functions, simple and convenient installation, simple maintenance, convenient construction, low cost and the like, simultaneously, the diversity of the control method can be better integrated into the market, the control method can be more flexibly adapted to different requirements and scenes, and a more perfect mechanism is provided for dealing with more sudden failure situations.

title_en: Automatic container transfer control method based on target tracking
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cargo box automatic transfer control method based on target tracking, which is used for identifying a tracked target, acquiring the actual position of the target and tracking the target by utilizing the deviation from the actual position of the target; and after the container is moved to the target position, the container is automatically transferred after the tracking is finished. The invention has the advantages of simple principle, wide application range, accurate butt joint and the like.

title_en: Vehicle safety system and method
abstract_en: Exemplary vehicle security systems and methods are described. In one embodiment, a method receives a destination and a driving route to the destination for an autonomous vehicle to follow. A vehicle security system identifies a key associated with the driving route and communicates the key to a user designated to meet the autonomous vehicle at the destination. The vehicle security system confirms that the user designated to meet the autonomous vehicle owns the key.

title_en: Support device and recording medium
abstract_en: Compatibility of callable unit programs constituting a user program is achieved. A code generating unit that generates a code in a form executable by a control device from a user program generates a command code for creating a structure for a call expression, the structure storing association information for associating a parameter name with a value set for the parameter, and converting the call expression into the command code for calling the unit program using an identifier of the structure. Further, a command code for setting a value of the associated information for each parameter when the associated information corresponding to the parameter name of the parameter is stored in the structure, and setting a predetermined value for the parameter when the associated information is not stored in the structure is generated for each parameter of the unit program.

title_en: Fire extinguishing scheduling method and system for power tunnel fire-fighting robot
abstract_en: The utility model provides a fire extinguishing dispatching method and a fire extinguishing dispatching system for a fire-fighting robot in an electric power tunnel, wherein the dispatching method comprises the following steps: acquiring tunnel environment state data, and pre-judging the position and the intensity of a suspected fire source by adopting a transverse data fitting and longitudinal data fitting method according to the tunnel environment state data; scheduling the video robot to be close to the suspected fire source position within a safe distance, and judging the development stage of the fire; according to the development stage of the fire, the fire-fighting robots around are dispatched in a unified way according to the intensity of the fire, and the fire-fighting robots are dispatched to the fire occurrence site to carry out fire-fighting and fire-extinguishing treatment; and (4) evacuating the fire-fighting robot after the completion of the scheduling and spraying from the fire source site, acquiring the fire condition continuous monitoring data of the video robot in real time, and carrying out secondary fire extinguishing treatment once after re-burning. The fire monitoring and extinguishing device can realize automatic fire monitoring and extinguishing, ensures the safe operation of power equipment, does not need personnel to watch, does not need human intervention, greatly reduces the labor cost and improves the working safety of personnel.

title_en: Intelligent warehouse management center control system and control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent warehouse management center control system and a control method, wherein the system comprises the following components: the man-machine interaction module is used for receiving an input instruction of a user and outputting feedback information; the order control module is used for sorting, storing and dispatching the input instructions; all control board components in the order control module are connected together through one bus, and all servo motors are connected together through the other bus. The control system overcomes the defect that a new order cannot be received under the condition that the intelligent storage in the prior art is controlled through a bus and the material is easily dispatched; when the number of new orders is large, all orders cannot be completely received.

title_en: Intelligent lock safe off-line unlocking password generation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for generating a safe off-line unlocking password of an intelligent lock, which comprises the following steps: the intelligent lock generates a temporary password seed; the intelligent lock transmits the temporary password seed to the APP; the APP performs hash operation by combining the password seeds with the current time to obtain a hash information summary, and then performs unlocking digit remainder on the information summary to obtain an unlocking temporary password; the intelligent lock is opened after comparing the temporary password. According to the invention, the APP and the intelligent lock are connected in a near field communication mode, the APP and the intelligent lock exchange data in an asymmetric DH mode, meanwhile, a temporary encryption key is generated in a transmission process through an administrator password, the temporary password is calculated by self, the server does not store any sensitive information and calculate a door opening key, the server burden is reduced, the password use safety is improved, the intelligent lock and the APP do not need to be in long-time connection with WIFI, the power consumption of modules such as communication and the like is reduced, and the cost is reduced.

title_en: Sun tracking correction algorithm and sun tracking method
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a sun tracking correction algorithm and a sun tracking method, wherein the sun tracking correction algorithm comprises the following steps: according to the position relation between the sun and the observation ground reference plane, a theoretical calculation model of a solar pitch angle and an azimuth angle is established; correcting the theoretical calculation model according to error factors influencing the measurement accuracy of the sun position to obtain a corrected model; the error factors include, among others, tide, atmospheric pressure and temperature. According to the sun tracking correction algorithm, errors caused by external environmental influences such as tides, atmospheric pressure and temperature on sun position calculation are considered, the sun position calculation errors caused by the environmental influences are corrected, and the sun tracking precision is improved. The invention also applies the sun tracking correction algorithm to the disc type solar photo-thermal power generation system, and provides a solar tracking method, which can improve the acceptance rate of the system to solar energy through improving the sun tracking precision, thereby improving the efficiency of solar power generation.

title_en: Vehicle rear-end collision early warning system and method based on double-flash-lamp identification
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of traffic safety, and discloses a vehicle rear-end collision early warning system and an early warning method based on double-flashing-lamp identification, wherein the system can timely detect a traffic accident occurring in a road, acquire accident information such as an accurate accident position and consciousness state information of a driver, and transmit the accident information to a control center through an LED display so that a worker can take measures; simultaneously, accident information is used for early warning of vehicles behind through the roadside LED information board and the tweeter, so that casualties are reduced, and secondary accidents are avoided.

title_en: Communication method and industrial control back plate bus system
abstract_en: The application provides a communication method and an industrial control backboard bus system, wherein the industrial control backboard bus system comprises the following steps: the back plate, with a host system and a plurality of non-host system of back plate matching installation, host system is connected with each non-host system through control lines respectively, exists between two arbitrary modules of data interaction relation among host system and a plurality of non-host system through many data line connections, host system can dispose non-host system's data channel, realizes the nimble configuration of communication, and improves communication efficiency.

title_en: Track generation method for multi-mobile-unit collaborative patrol
abstract_en: The invention relates to a track generation method for multi-mobile unit collaborative patrol, which comprises the following steps: calculating the uncertainty of patrol, identifying the position of the mobile unit, calculating the dynamic patrol cost, declaring the position, calculating the profit value, declaring the target and calculating the position of the unmanned vehicle at the next moment. The method has the advantages that the actual patrol condition can be reflected more truly by considering the sensor patrol range of the mobile unit, the track overlapping condition in the track planning is effectively avoided, the mutual cooperation among the multiple mobile units is considered, the possibility that the multiple mobile units move towards the adjacent area at the same time is reduced, and the partial area is prevented from being unmonitored for a long time. The invention is particularly suitable for the multi-mobile-unit joint inspection task of the real ground environment.

title_en: Teaching system and intelligent mirror using same
abstract_en: The invention discloses a teaching system and an intelligent mirror adopting the teaching system, and relates to the field of artificial intelligence. When the teaching system is used for learning movement, a user does not need to wear hardware equipment, the user learns by watching the image and video played by the display module, meanwhile, the system captures limb information of a person by using the camera module, the limb information is processed by the central control module, and whether the movement made by the user is standard and normal or not and related advice are intuitively fed back by the display module. And the user adjusts the motion according to the information fed back by the system, so that the standard degree and the professional degree of the motion are improved. The teaching system is arranged in the mirror, so that the basic requirement of a user on the mirror can be guaranteed, and when the camera module captures the action of the user, the user can plunger and adjust the action according to the mirror, and the standard degree and the professional degree of the movement action of the user can be conveniently improved.

title_en: Road early warning method, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a road early warning method, a road early warning device and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: receiving a detection feedback signal aiming at a target object under the condition that the target object is detected to exist in a target area of a front road; controlling a movable part in the road side unit to perform corresponding movement based on the detection feedback signal; wherein the moving movable part can reflect radio wave signals emitted by the vehicle to obtain early warning signals representing the road conditions ahead. Therefore, the problem that potential safety hazards exist due to the fact that the vehicle sensor has the detection blind area is solved, effective and quick early warning of the front road information in the detection blind area is achieved, and driving safety is improved.

title_en: SNCR denitration control system and control method for industrial boiler
abstract_en: The invention discloses an SNCR denitration control system and control method of an industrial boiler, wherein the system comprises an execution layer, a sensing layer, a conversion layer, a control layer and a management layer, the sensing layer comprises a smoke dynamic measurement module, the smoke dynamic measurement module is used for collecting first content information of NO and O  2  in a hearth, the conversion layer is used for obtaining concentration of NOx according to the first content information and calculating second content information of NH  3  according to the concentration of NOx, the control layer is used for generating a control instruction according to the second content information, and working states of a spray gun, an air compressor and an ammonia injection regulating valve are controlled according to the control instruction so that the spray gun injects reducing agent into the hearth. According to the invention, the content of the nitrogen oxides in the hearth is monitored in real time, and the amount of the reducing agent is controlled according to the content of the nitrogen oxides, so that the condition that the reducing agent is insufficient or wasted is avoided, the stability and quality of control are improved, and intelligent control is realized. Can be widely applied to the technical field of flue gas denitration.

title_en: Vending cabinet monitoring method and device, vending cabinet and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a vending cabinet monitoring method and device, a vending cabinet and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of communication. The method comprises the following steps: monitoring network state information of a first communication module of the vending cabinet, wherein the first communication module is at least used for interacting transaction information with a server; responding to the network state information which is used for representing the network state abnormity of the first communication module, and determining the reason of the network abnormity of the first communication module through a second communication module connected with the vending cabinet hardware, wherein the second communication module is a narrow-band Internet of things module; and sending monitoring information to the server through the second communication module, wherein the monitoring information at least comprises the reason of the network abnormality. Because the second communication module has characteristics such as strong cover and communication penetrability reinforce, when the network state of first communication module is unusual, the cabinet is sold in supplementary control of second communication module still, reduces the maintenance cost who sells the cabinet.

title_en: Jettisoning type flight recorder system and control method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a throwing type flight recorder system and a control method. The control module of the throwing type flight recorder system comprises a calculation module, a risk judgment module, a throwing condition judgment module and an alarm module, wherein the calculation module can receive signals from the other three modules and calculate three paths of signals, so that whether a throwing result is obtained. According to the invention, the throwing control device can comprehensively judge whether the aircraft is suitable for throwing according to the signals of the three control circuits, the calculation result can accurately reflect the actual condition of the aircraft, the calculation result has high precision, and the separating mechanism is not easy to be triggered by mistake.

title_en: Selective processing of sensor data
abstract_en: The present application provides a system and method for navigating a vehicle within an environment. In one aspect, a method includes: (a) Selecting, by a processor, a subset of a plurality of sensors based on one or more predetermined criteria for navigating the vehicle within the environment, wherein the plurality of sensors are arranged on the vehicle such that each sensor of the plurality of sensors is configured for acquiring sensor data from a different field of view; (b) Processing, by means of the processor, the sensor data from the selected one or more sensors to generate navigation information for navigating the vehicle within the environment; and (c) outputting, by means of the processor, a signal for controlling the vehicle based on the navigation information.

title_en: On-line monitoring device for simulating wire icing based on micro-terrain microclimate area icing law
abstract_en: The invention discloses an on-line monitoring device for simulating wire icing based on an icing rule of a micro-terrain microclimate area, which mainly comprises a simulation wire, a stepping motor, a motor fixing sleeve, a rolling belt shaft bearing, a sealing box I, a sealing box II, a three-dimensional force sensor I, a three-dimensional force sensor II, a stepping motor driver, a support and a microcontroller I. The device can monitor the icing thickness of the power transmission line in the same meteorological environment, has small volume and low power, and can be conveniently and rapidly arranged on a tower.

title_en: Fusion positioning method for parking spaces in indoor parking garage
abstract_en: The invention provides a fusion positioning method for parking spaces in an indoor parking garage, which relates to the field of artificial intelligence and comprises the following steps of 1: the method comprises the steps that photo data, GPS signal data, inertia measurement data, OBD interface data and air pressure measurement data are collected through a vehicle-mounted unit, and the data are processed and then sent to a cloud server; step 2: the cloud server receives the data and performs vehicle positioning by combining a garage map; and step 3: and the cloud server sends the vehicle positioning information to the client. The problem of among the prior art vehicle location in the indoor garage parking difficult, the maintenance cost is high is solved.

title_en: Drainage basin pollutant monitoring system and monitoring method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of river environmental protection, and discloses a drainage basin pollutant monitoring system and a monitoring method thereof, wherein the drainage basin pollutant monitoring system comprises a monitoring platform, a plurality of monitoring stations and a plurality of detection units, and the method comprises the following steps: s1: establishing a river model of the current river basin, and marking the position of a monitoring station, the position of a detection unit and altitude data; s2: collecting river water quality data and river surface garbage data; s3: based on the river model, the river water quality data and the river surface garbage data in the same flow direction are transmitted to a monitoring station located at an upstream junction of the flow direction for analysis and processing, so that main pollutants, pollution levels and pollution source positions of the main flow and each branch flow are obtained and sent to a monitoring platform for display. The invention solves the problems of large manpower and material resource consumption, poor real-time performance and incapability of accurately positioning the pollution source in the prior art.

title_en: Motion control device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a motion control device comprising: the device comprises a communication bus unit, a data processing unit, an internal interface unit and an external expansion interface unit. The data processing unit is connected with the communication bus unit, the internal interface unit is connected with the communication bus unit, the external expansion interface unit is connected with the internal interface unit and provided with a plurality of expansion interfaces, the external expansion interface unit is used for transmitting data received by the expansion interfaces to the internal interface unit, and the external expansion interface unit is also used for receiving data transmitted by the internal interface unit and transmitting the data to the outside from the corresponding expansion interfaces. The device of the invention has simple structure and strong expandability. Furthermore, a single-board computer is adopted, and a real-time operating system or a bare computer is adopted to interrupt operation, so that the real-time performance is obviously improved.

title_en: Lock opening and closing method and device, electronic lock and storage medium
abstract_en: The method determines the serial number corresponding to each lock opening/closing request based on each lock opening/closing request, judges whether the same operation request is received or not according to the serial numbers, and executes the corresponding lock opening or closing operation of the request under different conditions, prevents repeated lock opening or closing operation caused by that the device lock receives multiple channels of requests at the same time, ensures the normal use of the device lock, and reduces the probability of failure of the device lock.

title_en: Medium-high voltage power cable terminal infrared temperature measurement training device based on matrix heater
abstract_en: The invention relates to a medium-high voltage power cable terminal infrared temperature measurement training device based on a matrix heater, which comprises: the matrix heater comprises a plurality of heating units, the heating units are distributed in the middle-high voltage power cable terminal model in matrix forms with different heights and different directions under the fixation of the circumference matrix assembly, and the heating units are connected with the temperature control device and used for simulating the heating of all parts of the middle-high voltage power cable terminal model. Compared with the prior art, the invention can realize the fault heating simulation of areas with different heights and different directions, train and train the temperature measuring skills of the inspection personnel, troubleshoot the fault skills and the like, improve the inspection accuracy and ensure the safety of cable lines.

title_en: Lamp control system based on lamp with adjustable posture and lamp posture adjusting method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a lighting management system, in particular to a lamp control system based on an adjustable posture lamp, which consists of one or more controlled lamps and a control platform; the control platform is in bidirectional communication with each controlled lamp; the controlled lamp has a plurality of different postures, is initialized to a determined posture after being started, and then further changes the posture and the locking state according to the control command of the control platform or sends state information to the control platform. The invention further comprises a lamp posture adjusting method. The invention utilizes wired or wireless two-way communication to remotely and automatically adjust the installation posture of the lamp. The first posture adjustment can be completed by remotely issuing an adjustment command through the upper computer without on-site posture adjustment of each lamp. And after the adjustment is finished, simultaneously recording the posture information of each lamp on the lamp and the upper computer. The lamp can be automatically restored to the initial set posture after each start or lamp maintenance replacement.

title_en: Self-adaptive machining control method and non-volatile readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of workpiece processing, and discloses a self-adaptive processing control method and a nonvolatile readable storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: when a workpiece is machined, acquiring an initial power set within a first preset time length; calculating a fluctuation coefficient and a reference power according to the initial power set; acquiring a standard fuzzy algorithm model, and adjusting each language subset of each language input variable in the standard fuzzy algorithm model according to the fluctuation coefficient; adjusting the current feeding multiplying power according to the adjusted standard fuzzy algorithm model, the reference power and the current power; and processing the workpiece according to the adjusted current feeding multiplying power. When each single piece is machined by the method, the initial power set of a period of time is intercepted in advance, so that the domain of discourse of the standard fuzzy algorithm model is learned and adjusted, the adjusted standard fuzzy algorithm can adapt to the workpiece, and the workpiece is machined reliably and accurately subsequently, so that the method can adapt to and reliably and accurately machine various workpieces with different working conditions.

title_en: Device and method for simulating deep coal bed gas mining pressure oscillation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulation device and a method for simulating deep coal bed gas exploitation pressure oscillation, wherein the device comprises: the device comprises a box body, a liquid discharge pipe and an air source, wherein the bottom of the box body is provided with the liquid discharge pipe and the air source, the air source is connected with the box body through an air injection pipe, the water source is connected with the box body through a water discharge pipe, and the water discharge pipe is provided with a branch pipe; a measurement system comprising a pressure measurement member and a level gauge. The invention discloses a device capable of simulating coal bed pressure oscillation in the coal bed gas exploitation process, which has a simple structure and high reliability, and can better simulate the influence of the pressure oscillation on a shaft and a stratum environment in the coal bed exploitation process and provide reliable data support for the actual development of a coal bed; meanwhile, the simulation method provided by the invention can accurately simulate the pressure oscillation of the shaft and the stratum.

title_en: Voltage stabilizing circuit of contactless AC voltage stabilizer
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of voltage regulators, and discloses a voltage stabilizing circuit of a contactless alternating-current voltage regulator, which solves the technical problems of circulation, back pressure and low compensation precision of the voltage stabilizing circuit of a traditional voltage regulator, and comprises a compensation transformer TBa, a voltage regulating transformer Tvva, a silicon controlled rectifier S1-S10, a three-port inductor DLa and a current sensor LCa, wherein one end of the silicon controlled rectifier S1 and one end of the silicon controlled rectifier S4 are electrically connected with one end of a primary coil of the compensation transformer TBa, one end of the silicon controlled rectifier S2 and one end of the silicon controlled rectifier S3 are electrically connected with the other end of the primary coil of the compensation transformer TBa, the other ends of the silicon controlled rectifier S1 and the silicon controlled rectifier S2 are electrically connected with a voltage input end and a negative electrode of a voltage output end, and the other ends of the silicon controlled rectifier S3 and the silicon controlled rectifier S4 are electrically connected with a middle connecting end of the three-port inductor DLa. According to the technical scheme, the novel alternating current voltage stabilizer circuit design is designed, and the problems of circulation, back pressure and compensation precision are solved, so that the purposes of high reliability and higher compensation precision are achieved.

title_en: Load detection chip for commodity safety
abstract_en: The invention provides a load detection chip for commodity safety, which comprises a current control module, a current detection module and a current detection module, wherein the current control module can adjust the current according to the requirement of a load; the current monitoring module can monitor the current passing through the load, and the output module is used for outputting a safety signal when the current exceeds a set threshold. The invention designs a load detection chip which is used for commodity safety and has the advantages of small volume, light weight, high detection effect, stable work, high reliability and high dynamic response. The commodity safety state is confirmed through the current and voltage detection loops, so that the supervision and protection of commodities are guaranteed, the switching of corresponding detection circuits can be realized, the application under different scenes is realized, and the application range is widened.

title_en: Image shooting method and device, mobile terminal and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an image shooting method, an image shooting device, a mobile terminal and a storage medium, wherein the image shooting method is used for controlling a holder, and the method comprises the steps of establishing communication with the holder; acquiring screen information of the mobile terminal at a background of the mobile terminal, wherein the screen information at least comprises photographic images; acquiring position information of a target object according to the screen information; and controlling the holder to follow the target object according to the position information. According to the image shooting method provided by the embodiment, when a user switches a specific APP to other APPs, the specific APP can also track the target object in the background, and the cradle head is controlled to shoot along with the target object.

title_en: People's air defense rapid evacuation device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a people's air defense rapid evacuation device which comprises a hanging rack and a connecting plate, wherein the connecting plate is rotatably connected to the lower side of the hanging rack through a rotating shaft, a first rope buckle is fixed in the middle of the front end of the connecting plate, a safety belt penetrates through the first rope buckle, a second rope buckle is fixed on the lower portion of the front end of the connecting plate, the connecting plate is connected with a first elastic belt and a second elastic belt through the second rope buckle, elastic cloth is fixed at the lower ends of the first elastic belt and the second elastic belt, a seat plate is fixedly bonded on the elastic cloth, a fixed seat is fixed on the left side of the connecting plate, a rotating disc is rotatably connected to the left portion in the fixed seat through the. The device is convenient to hang on a stair through the hanging frame and the arc-shaped sliding groove, a person can conveniently sit through the elastic cloth and the seat plate, the elastic belt is convenient to tie through the elastic strip, the male insertion buckle and the female insertion buckle, meanwhile, the safety belt is wound under the armpit of the person, the safety of the person when the person sits is guaranteed, the person is prevented from falling down in the sliding process, and the safety is good.

title_en: Communication system for fault self-diagnosis and fault self-diagnosis method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a communication system for fault self-diagnosis and a fault self-diagnosis method thereof, wherein the system comprises an MCU, a fully integrated isolated data transceiver chip connected with the MCU, a protection circuit connected with the fully integrated isolated data transceiver chip, and a communication fault self-diagnosis disengaging circuit connected with the MCU; the MCU is connected with the fully integrated isolated data transceiver chip and the communication fault self-diagnosis disengaging circuit, and the fully integrated isolated data transceiver chip is connected with the protection circuit, so that built-in self-diagnosis logic of all nodes on the field bus is achieved. The fault self-diagnosis method can realize that the fault node can be automatically separated from the field bus network when the fault occurs, does not influence other normal equipment, and can automatically judge and confirm the fault.

title_en: Automatic driving method, intelligent control equipment and automatic driving vehicle
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic driving method based on high-precision map prior knowledge, which comprises the following steps: obtaining a current position of an autonomous vehicle; acquiring a priori knowledge set associated with the current position from a high-precision map; acquiring sensing information using a sensing device provided on an autonomous vehicle; obtaining one or more a priori knowledge associated with the sensed information from a set of a priori knowledge; calculating a control command according to one or more priori knowledge; and controlling the automatic driving vehicle to run according to the control instruction. The invention also provides intelligent control equipment and an automatic driving vehicle applying the automatic driving method based on the high-precision map prior knowledge. The high-precision map priori knowledge is used for providing guidance for the driving process of the automatic driving vehicle, the calculation force of the automatic driving vehicle is saved, the pre-judging capability of the automatic driving vehicle on the driving environment is improved, and the safety and the comfort of the automatic driving vehicle in the driving process are improved.

title_en: CMOS single-tube infrared transceiver
abstract_en: The present application provides a novel CMOS infrared transceiver. The CMOS infrared transceiver includes an IR transmitter circuit, an IR receiver circuit, and an IR diode configured to transmit or receive IR signals. CMOS components used in CMOS infrared transceivers, such as PMOS current mirrors, PMOS switches, NMOS current mirrors, and receiver enable PMOSFET switches. CMOS infrared transceivers may have the advantages of increased integration, less space usage, and lower cost.

title_en: Quick-witted detection device, terminal equipment and vehicle tear open
abstract_en: The invention provides a dismantling detection device, terminal equipment and a vehicle, wherein the dismantling detection device comprises: the scanning equipment is arranged on the outer surface of the shell of the terminal equipment and used for scanning and learning the surrounding environment and generating the feature code, and the terminal equipment is vehicle-mounted terminal equipment; and the comparator is connected with the scanning equipment and used for comparing whether the feature code is consistent with the preset standard feature code or not, and if not, the terminal equipment is determined to be disconnected. According to the disassembling detection device, the terminal equipment and the vehicle, when the feature code generated by the scanning equipment is inconsistent with the preset standard feature code, the comparator determines that the terminal equipment is disassembled, so that whether the terminal equipment is disassembled can be accurately detected, and the terminal equipment is not easy to crack.

title_en: Intelligent traveling plan compiling system considering endurance mileage of pure electric bus
abstract_en: The invention discloses a driving plan intelligent compilation system considering the endurance mileage of a pure electric bus, which comprises a basic data acquisition module, an operation data analysis module, a passenger flow data analysis module, a weight analysis module and a planning model module, wherein the basic data acquisition module is used for acquiring the basic data of the pure electric bus; the basic data acquisition module is used for acquiring a basic data set; the operation data analysis module is used for analyzing historical operation data; the passenger flow data analysis module is used for analyzing the passenger flow data collected historically; the planning model module is combined with the basic parameters and the constraint conditions to establish a multi-objective optimization model and generate an initial driving schedule mainly considering the vehicle turnover time and the passenger flow demand interval. The invention can improve the endurance mileage utilization rate of the pure electric bus, reduce frequent vehicle changing and other operations caused by insufficient endurance mileage of the pure electric bus in the real-time scheduling process, and improve the matching degree of the operation site and the driving plan compilation.

title_en: Three-dimensional mould for displaying thyroid nodule in ultrasound department
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional die for displaying thyroid nodule in an ultrasonic department, which comprises a base, wherein a U-shaped support is fixed on the upper surface of the base, a first motor is fixed on the lower surface of the upper end of the U-shaped support, the end part of an output shaft of the first motor is fixed with a die body through a connecting rod, a vertical electric slide rail is fixed on the inner side of the U-shaped support, and a positioning mechanism is fixed on a sliding table of the vertical electric slide rail; the positioning mechanism comprises an installation shell fixed with a sliding table of a vertical electric sliding rail, the other side of the installation shell is rotatably connected with a hollow disc, one side of the hollow disc close to the installation shell is fixed with a toothed ring, the upper surface of the installation shell is fixed with a second motor, a driving gear is fixed on an output shaft of the second motor, and the driving gear is in meshing transmission with the toothed ring. The invention improves the marking range, is convenient for erasing the marked marks and ensures that the die can be repeatedly used.

title_en: Fixed-height touchdown determination method, device, equipment and storage medium
