abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a fixed-height touchdown determination method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring flight related data of the aircraft at preset time intervals, wherein the acquired flight related data are used as a data frame; if the flight related data meet a first set condition and the altitude data in the continuous N frames meet a second set condition, judging the type of the ground contact risk of the aircraft at the moment corresponding to the current frame based on the altitude data in the current frame; wherein N is greater than or equal to 2; and if the aircraft is judged to touch the ground and exploder at the moment corresponding to the target frame based on the flight related data, judging whether the type of the touch and exploder is the constant-altitude touch or not based on the type of the touch risk and the frame interval between the current frame and the target frame. The technical scheme provided by the embodiment of the invention can reduce the problem of missed judgment and improve the accuracy and recall ratio of the height-determining touchdown judgment.

title_en: Intelligent household appliance linkage control method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of intelligent household appliances, and particularly relates to an intelligent household appliance linkage control method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps that a first function instruction sent by a terminal device is received, and the running state of a first intelligent household appliance and the running state of at least one second intelligent household appliance are determined according to the first function instruction; the second intelligent household appliance can execute a second function, and the second function is used for being linked with the first function; according to the running state of the first intelligent household electrical appliance and the running state of at least one second intelligent household electrical appliance, the first function and the second function are started, the second intelligent household electrical appliance which can be in function linkage with the first intelligent household electrical appliance is determined, and the first function and the second function are started according to the states of the first intelligent household electrical appliance and the second intelligent household electrical appliance, so that a user can open a plurality of functions with linkage function characteristics through one-time operation, and the control operation efficiency is improved.

title_en: Control circuit
abstract_en: The invention relates to a control circuit comprising: a sampling unit and a control unit; the sampling unit is connected with the main clock source and used for setting a sampling period according to a clock signal output by the main clock source and sampling a group of sample signals according to the sampling period, and the control unit is connected with the sampling unit and used for generating a control signal according to a sampling result of the sampling unit and transmitting the control signal to the processor so that the processor can control the abnormal situation of the main clock source according to the control signal. The invention samples the sample signal according to the sampling clock by taking the main clock source of the processor as the sampling clock of the control circuit, outputs the control signal to the processor according to the sample result, and processes the abnormal situation of the main clock source by the processor according to the control signal, thereby realizing the real-time control of the main clock source.

title_en: Laser charging method suitable for long-endurance unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a laser charging method suitable for a long-endurance unmanned aerial vehicle. When the unmanned aerial vehicle needs to be charged, the suitable charging base station is automatically matched according to the coordinate position provided by the GPS of the unmanned aerial vehicle. When unmanned aerial vehicle flies to the basic station, unmanned aerial vehicle passes through RFID and establishes communication link with the basic station, and the laser beam of basic station transmission is aimed at unmanned aerial vehicle machine and is carried out solar cell panel, and the cloud platform that battery panel linked firmly on the unmanned aerial vehicle comes the cooperation to carry out the light beam and aims at, and the laser beam vertically shines the panel and produces the electric energy and then charge. The unmanned aerial vehicle charging system can wirelessly and remotely charge the unmanned aerial vehicle in real time, and dynamically plans the unmanned aerial vehicle charging strategy through gridding coordinate setting of the working area of the unmanned aerial vehicle, so that the endurance time of the unmanned aerial vehicle is prolonged.

title_en: Visual detection device and method for obstacle avoidance flight of plant protection unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses visual detection equipment and a method for obstacle avoidance flight of a plant protection unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein the visual detection equipment for the obstacle avoidance flight of the plant protection unmanned aerial vehicle comprises a holographic projection module, a detection photography module, a display module and a control module, wherein the holographic projection module comprises a 3D holographic projector and a 3D holographic projection communication unit; the detection photography module comprises a high-speed camera and a photography communication unit; the display module comprises a display communication unit and a display; the control module comprises an automatic flight control unit and a ground control unit, the ground control unit is in wireless connection with the 3D holographic projector through a 3D holographic communication unit, and the automatic flight control unit is in wireless connection with the ground control unit. The invention discloses visual detection equipment and method for obstacle avoidance flight of a plant protection unmanned aerial vehicle, which can realize real-time visual detection of flight precision of the plant protection unmanned aerial vehicle when the plant protection unmanned aerial vehicle avoids obstacles and flies.

title_en: Temperature control system and control method of aerosol generating device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of heating, and particularly relates to a temperature control system and a temperature control method for an aerosol generating device. The temperature control system includes: the temperature control device comprises a heating element, a resistance temperature coefficient characteristic temperature control element and a thermocouple temperature control element; the temperature coefficient of resistance characteristic temperature control element and the thermocouple temperature control element can both independently measure the temperature of the heating element. The first stage including the preheating stage adopts a resistance temperature coefficient temperature control mode, because the heating element is heated at the stage, the heating power needs to be adjusted at any time according to the temperature of the heating element, the resistance temperature coefficient temperature control mode responds in time, the temperature change can be controlled in time, and the hysteresis caused by thermocouple temperature control can not occur; the thermocouple is adopted to control the temperature in the second stage with unchanged temperature, the temperature value can be accurately controlled in the second stage, the consistency of the atomization temperature of the tobacco substances can be kept, and the whole smoking feeling of a user is consistent.

title_en: Variable-configuration quadruped robot motion control method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for controlling the motion of a four-footed robot with a variable configuration, wherein the method comprises the following steps: planning the gait of the quadruped robot; establishing an integer programming model of the quadruped robot by taking the current joint position and speed of the robot as input based on the differential kinematics of the robot; based on the redundant degree of freedom, switching among various configurations of the robot is realized; the motion of the robot is planned based on the current configuration, the expected positions of the foot ends of the supporting phase and the swinging phase are planned, the omnidirectional movement of the quadruped robot under multiple configurations is realized, and the stability and the adaptability are obviously improved when the quadruped robot faces complex terrains.

title_en: Robot near-zero following error control method based on data driving
abstract_en: The invention discloses a robot near-zero following error control method based on data driving, which belongs to the field of industrial robot control and comprises the following steps: extracting target attributes influencing the following errors of the robot from the online process data, inputting the target attributes into an online deep neural network model, obtaining a position compensation value corresponding to each discrete point on a reference track at the tail end of the robot in each control period, and mapping the position compensation values into angle compensation quantities of each joint of the robot; compensating the input of the variable parameter self-adaptive controller by using the angle compensation quantity to obtain a target control quantity, and sending the target control quantity to the robot so as to enable the robot to move along a reference track and complete the control of the current control period; and in the whole track following process of the robot, dynamically adjusting the parameters of the online deep neural network model according to a preset structure updating rule. The invention can adapt to the change of working conditions and process the track following data stream in real time, achieves the control effect of near-zero following error and effectively improves the precision of the track control of the robot.

title_en: Double-ticket-barrel card issuing device and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a double-ticket-barrel card issuing device and a card issuing method, wherein the card issuing device comprises a bracket with a ticket outlet; a first card-issuing structure mounted on the bracket; a second hairpin structure mounted on the bracket; a card transport structure mounted on the carriage; a ticket and card barrel fixing structure arranged on the bracket; the power structure is respectively connected with the first card issuing structure, the second card issuing structure and the card conveying structure; the sensor control structures are arranged on the first card-issuing structure and the second card-issuing structure; the first card sending structure comprises a first ticket card barrel, a first card scraping and conveying unit and a first card supporting unit; the second card sending structure comprises a second ticket bucket, a second card scraping and conveying unit and a second card supporting unit. The double-ticket-barrel card issuing device has the advantages of simple structure, small volume and low cost on the premise of ensuring complete card issuing functions. In addition, in the card issuing device, the processes of scraping, conveying and delivering the ticket cards are convenient and quick, and the frequency of faults is reduced.

title_en: Control method and system for preventing water meter from closing valve in humid environment, circuit and water meter
abstract_en: The application discloses a control method and system for a water meter valve capable of preventing a humid environment, a circuit and a water meter. The water meter comprises a microcontroller, a pull-up resistor, a first sensor and a second sensor; the first (second) port of the microcontroller is connected with the first (second) sensor through the first (second) pulse circuit; the control method comprises the following steps: the resistance value of the pull-up resistor is reduced; judging the state of the level at the first port and the second port; when the level of the first port and the second port is low, judging whether the AD voltage values of the two ports are larger than a threshold value or not; if the AD voltage value of at least one port is larger than the threshold value, judging that the port is in a humid environment, and not closing the valve; if the AD voltage values of the two ports are equal to or smaller than the threshold value, the valve is automatically closed. The method can judge whether the water meter is in a humid environment, and when the water meter is in the humid environment, the valve is not closed, so that the phenomenon that the water meter is frequently closed due to the humid environment is reduced.

title_en: Safety self-inspection method for UV lamp
abstract_en: The invention discloses a safety self-checking method for a UV lamp. And once the microwave induction module has a problem, the microwave induction module can perform self-checking and alarm.

title_en: Standardized system for flexible platform for frame production
abstract_en: The invention discloses a standardization system for a flexible platform for frame production, which comprises an information input module, a processing program programming module, a control module, an image identification module, a station parameter generation setting module, a mechanical arm module and a conveying module, wherein the information input module, the mechanical arm module, the image identification module, the station parameter generation setting module and the conveying module are electrically connected with the control module and are controlled by the control module; the invention is developed aiming at a flexible chemical plant, can be widely applied to various industries such as welding, gluing, carrying, coating, stamping, carrying and the like, adopts modular and standardized design, can realize quick replacement and quick addition of products, and has the advantages of strong universality, simple operation, full digital communication, strong flexibility and high openness to users.

title_en: Vehicle abnormality detection method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a vehicle abnormity detection system and method, which comprises an abnormity detection module: detecting the abnormal state of the vehicle through information monitoring of the vehicle equipment, judging whether the vehicle is abnormal or not, if so, stopping the vehicle running, and if not, continuously detecting the abnormality; a data acquisition module: and vehicle operation data are collected in real time and sent to the abnormality detection module. According to the invention, the abnormal state of the vehicle is detected by monitoring the information of the vehicle equipment, so that the running safety of the vehicle is improved; by using abnormal sound detection, false detection caused by data fluctuation of normal operation of the vehicle is prevented; by means of online vehicle operation, data acquisition is carried out, data are analyzed and learned, an abnormal detection method is improved, the accuracy of detection is improved, false detection is prevented, and the stability of vehicle operation is improved.

title_en: Information processing apparatus, information processing method, computer program, and mobile apparatus
abstract_en: An information processing apparatus is provided that processes detection information from a sensor for identifying an external environment. The information processing apparatus includes an identification unit that performs a process of identifying an object based on a detection signal from a sensor, and a processing unit that performs a fusion process of first data and other data before the identification by the identification unit. The information processing apparatus further includes a second recognition unit that performs a process of recognizing the object based on the detection signal from the second sensor. The processing unit particularly performs a fusion process of the third data and the first data before the second recognition unit recognizes, and a fusion process of the fourth data and the first data after the second recognition unit recognizes.

title_en: Transport vehicle running control method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transport vehicle running control method and device, and relates to the technical field of computers. The method comprises the steps of determining grid points existing in a running path of a transport vehicle based on the running path of the transport vehicle in a road network, obtaining loop information corresponding to the grid points, wherein the road network is a grid map, the grid points represent the grid points, the loop information is a grid point set forming a loop path, judging whether loop congestion is formed when the transport vehicle runs to a non-loop information grid point before the loop information grid point at the next moment, if so, sending an instruction waiting in situ at the non-loop information grid point to the transport vehicle, and sending an instruction for continuing running to the transport vehicle when the loop congestion is relieved. Therefore, the implementation mode of the invention can solve the problem of traffic jam of the transport vehicle.

title_en: Unlocking method of intelligent lock, mobile terminal, server and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the specification discloses an unlocking method of an intelligent lock, wherein a mobile terminal is used for sending an equipment identifier of the intelligent lock and a user identifier corresponding to the equipment identifier to a service server, so that the service server can find identity information for room reservation according to the user identifier, and then the identity information and the equipment identifier are sent to a processing server for subsequent user identification; the mobile terminal collects corresponding biological characteristic information and sends the biological characteristic information to the processing server, so that the processing server carries out user identification on the biological characteristic information collected by the mobile terminal according to the matched biological characteristic information found out from the identity information, when the user identification is successful, a digital key is generated and returned to the mobile terminal to unlock the intelligent lock, the accuracy of check-in can be ensured through the biological characteristic information identification, and remote unlocking is carried out under the condition of ensuring the accuracy of check-in, the check-in handling efficiency is improved, and the user experience is also improved.

title_en: Fire-fighting emergency communication system and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-fighting emergency communication system, which comprises a host arranged in a monitoring room and a plurality of extension sets arranged at each monitoring point; the host is configured to comprise a first main control board and a voice acquisition assembly matched with the first main control board; each extension is configured to comprise a second main control board, and an environment information acquisition assembly and a voice broadcast assembly which are in communication connection with the second main control board; the main machine and each extension are respectively provided with a power supply module and a storage battery module for supplying power to the main machine and each extension; the first main control board is in communication connection with the second main control board through a matched CAN interface. The invention provides a fire-fighting emergency communication system, which mainly solves the problems of providing broadcast communication and power supply operation under the conditions of fire, earthquake or power failure and the like, realizes unified command and scheduling and ensures that personnel are quickly and effectively evacuated.

title_en: Ridge-following operation method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a ridge-following operation method and a ridge-following operation device, relates to the technical field of unmanned plant protection operation, and is applied to an unmanned vehicle, wherein a navigation structure is arranged in front of the unmanned vehicle in the advancing direction, and the ridge-following operation method comprises the following steps: continuously receiving a deviation angle of the navigation structure deviating from the current advancing direction of the unmanned vehicle; when the deviation angle is larger than a preset threshold value, continuously determining the next advancing direction of the unmanned vehicle according to the deviation angle, and continuously adjusting the current advancing direction of the unmanned vehicle according to the next advancing direction; and keeping the next traveling direction of the unmanned vehicle corresponding to the offset angle until the offset angle is smaller than a preset threshold value, so that the unmanned vehicle can realize the ridge following operation, firstly performing contact obstacle with ultra-small friction by a navigation structure arranged in front of the unmanned vehicle, and adjusting the path of the unmanned vehicle after the contact obstacle, thereby avoiding the problems that unmanned vehicle equipment deviates from the ridge operation, damages crops, influences the yield and the like.

title_en: Vehicle operation device, vehicle operation method, and nonvolatile storage medium
abstract_en: The present invention suppresses a situation in which a vehicle cannot be operated when communication with a server is interrupted. The vehicle operating device includes a memory and a processor. The processor causes a token received from the server and used for authentication with the vehicle to be stored in the memory, and performs authentication with the vehicle using the token when the token is in a state where the token can communicate with the server and an operation is performed on the vehicle, and performs authentication with the vehicle without using the token when the token is in a state where the communication with the server is interrupted and a predetermined operation is performed on the vehicle.

title_en: Device and method for demonstrating various system numerical values
abstract_en: The invention relates to a device for demonstrating various system numerical values, which comprises a front plate, side plates and a back plate, wherein the side plates are arranged on the left side and the right side of the front plate, and a top plate and a guide plate are arranged above and below the side plates, so that a box-shaped structure with an open rear part is formed, and a control device and a power adapter are arranged in the box-shaped structure; the front plate surface of the front plate is provided with a funnel-shaped placing opening, a main pipe and branch pipes which pass through metal balls; the front plate is provided with straight grooves communicated with the branch pipes, a plurality of layers of supporting plates are arranged between the straight grooves in a protruding mode, first magnetic steel is arranged on the rear plate faces of the front plates on two sides of the straight grooves, a carry mechanism behind the header pipe is arranged on the lower plate face of the top plate, a limiting mechanism and a zero clearing mechanism which are abutted to the supporting plates are inserted into the straight grooves, and conducting parts are further arranged on the carry mechanism and the zero clearing mechanism which are electrically connected with the control device. The device for demonstrating the numerical values in various systems is used for vividly demonstrating the carry of the numerical values in various systems, and comparing the representation mode with the decimal number, so that the device is convenient to understand.

title_en: Multi-terminal data acquisition method and device based on MES system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-terminal data acquisition method and a device based on an MES (manufacturing execution system). A data acquisition module is used for acquiring personnel information, equipment information, quality inspection information, material information and process information and comprises an identification module, a quality inspection result input module, an inventory material information module, a product part mark reading module and a process flow acquisition module; the monitoring device is provided with a plurality of groups of monitoring modules for monitoring personnel, product components and equipment; the display device is used for displaying the monitoring content of the monitoring device; the data acquisition module and the display device are connected with the microprocessor, the data acquisition module transmits information to the microprocessor, the microprocessor sends the information to the control system, the control system controls the display device to display the information, and the monitoring device is connected with the background management center and sends the monitoring information to the background management center to be stored.

title_en: Control method of cooking appliance, cooking appliance and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a control method of a cooking appliance, the cooking appliance and a readable storage medium, wherein the cooking appliance comprises a cooking cavity, a microwave generating device and a steam generating device, and the control method comprises the following steps: controlling the microwave generating device to operate in a first discontinuous mode, and controlling the steam generating device to operate continuously until a first set time length is reached so as to enable the temperature parameter of the cooking cavity to enter a set temperature interval; controlling the microwave generating device and the steam generating device to operate in a second interval mode so as to keep the temperature parameter of the cooking cavity within a set temperature interval until a second set time length is reached; the temperature parameters comprise an inner cavity temperature value and a food material temperature value. Through setting up microwave generating device and steam generator, can improve the temperature and the humidity of culinary art intracavity fast, through setting up microwave generating device to the operation of discontinuous, can discontinuously to eating the inside supplementary heat of material, with heat fast transfer to eating inside the material, further promote the fermentation of eating the material.

title_en: Control method and system for preventing sudden temperature drop during windowing heat dissipation
abstract_en: The invention provides a control method and a control system for preventing sudden temperature drop during windowing and heat dissipation, and belongs to the technical field of power distribution and heating control. The work of the near-window area electric heater and the far-window area electric heater is controlled through the intelligent temperature controller, so that power is supplied in blocks, sudden drop of indoor temperature after window opening is prevented, and electric energy waste caused by integral power supply is avoided. In addition, the invention is also provided with a window opening degree limiting device which can limit the maximum opening degree of the window according to the indoor temperature and prevent the indoor temperature from being continuously reduced because a user opens the window when the indoor temperature is too low. According to the intelligent temperature controller, the power supply switch and the voltage converter are respectively and independently controlled to work through the intelligent temperature controller, and the power supply of the electric heaters in different blocks is respectively controlled, so that the indoor comfort is improved.

title_en: Storage system for maintenance takt of bogie and implementation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a storage system for overhauling beats of bogies and an implementation method thereof, which overcome the problem of disordered management of tools used in the overhauling process in the prior art, can accurately store parts and tools required by overhauling of the bogies at each station, can avoid the loss of the overhauling tools and accurate division of responsibility, simultaneously furthest reduces the lead period of the parts required by overhauling of the bogies, and improves the overhauling efficiency. The intelligent storage cabinet comprises a storage cabinet, a partition plate divides the storage cabinet into a plurality of cabinet lattices, cabinet doors are arranged on the cabinet lattices, a lock control device connected with a control all-in-one machine is arranged on the cabinet doors, the lock control device performs data interaction with the control all-in-one machine through an RS232/RS485 serial port, a camera is arranged at the top of the storage cabinet, a display screen connected with the control all-in-one machine is arranged on the storage cabinet, and a contact switch connected with the control all-in-one machine is arranged on the cabinet doors.

title_en: Net class answer interaction method, device, system and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, a system and a medium for interaction of net lesson answering, wherein the method comprises the following steps: when the teacher user is monitored to send out a question instruction at the teacher live broadcast end, collecting a question video stream and pushing the question video stream to all student live broadcast ends; pushing corresponding answer frames to all student live broadcasting ends according to configuration parameters input by a teacher user; and collecting answer information of all student users according to the selection instructions input by each student user in each answer frame, and feeding back the answer information to the teacher live broadcasting end. According to the embodiment of the invention, the question instruction initiated by the teacher user is monitored in real time in the online class process, the question video stream and the question frame are pushed to the student user for answering and feeding back the answer condition according to the requirement of the teacher user, so that the teacher user can flexibly arrange the questions at any time according to the teaching requirement and acquire the accurate answer condition without presetting the questions in advance, and the flexibility and the accuracy of online class answer interaction are improved.

title_en: Hydraulic position servo system control method based on double energy accumulators
abstract_en: A hydraulic position servo system control method based on double accumulators comprises the following steps: firstly, establishing a mathematical model of an electro-hydraulic position servo system, and calculating ideal values of two-cavity pressure and oil supply pressure according to an expected track and a parameter nominal value so as to set an energy accumulator parameter; setting a robust controller based on ideal pressure and setting control rules of the switching valve and the unloading overflow valve; and finally, the stability and the energy conservation of the controller are proved and analyzed. The invention is different from the traditional hydraulic position servo control method, the system has the functions of energy saving and position control at the same time by switching the double hydraulic accumulators and controlling the proportional directional valve, and the multi-target problem of energy saving and position tracking is effectively solved on the premise of only using a position sensor.

title_en: Vehicle control device, autonomous vehicle development system, vehicle control method, and program
abstract_en: A vehicle control device is provided with: a first detection unit that detects a behavior of a vehicle; a second detection unit that detects a peripheral condition of the vehicle; a storage unit that stores a control logic in which information indicating a behavior of the vehicle is output when at least information indicating a surrounding situation of the vehicle is input; a derivation section that derives a behavior of the vehicle based on at least the peripheral condition of the vehicle detected by the second detection section by executing the control logic; and a determination unit that determines whether or not the control logic is correctly operating by comparing a first behavior of the vehicle, which is the behavior of the vehicle detected by the first detection unit at a reference time point, with a second behavior of the vehicle, which is the behavior of the vehicle derived by the derivation unit based on the surrounding situation detected by the second detection unit at the reference time point.

title_en: Intelligent household equipment control method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent household equipment control method and a system thereof, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an outdoor image through an image acquisition device arranged outdoors; optimizing the resolution of the outdoor image; identifying weather corresponding to the outdoor image through a weather identification model; when the weather is matched with a preset first weather, a first signal is sent to the processing module; when the weather is matched with a preset second weather, sending a second signal to the processing module; the processing module judges the current state of the window, if the current state corresponds to the first signal received at present, the processing module sends the first signal to the execution device, and if the current state corresponds to the second signal received at present, the processing module sends the second signal to the execution device; the execution device executes a first action according to the first signal and executes a second action according to the second signal. The invention can improve the intelligent degree and reliability of the window opening and closing function.

title_en: Vehicle control system
abstract_en: The invention provides a vehicle control system capable of optimizing preventive safety control according to the degree of participation of a passenger in driving. A vehicle control system is provided with: a first unit that generates a target trajectory for automatic driving; and a second unit that performs vehicle travel control so that the vehicle follows the target trajectory. The second means is configured to control a travel control amount, which is a control amount of vehicle travel control, during autonomous driving, acquire driving environment information indicating a driving environment around the vehicle, and execute preventive safety control for intervening the travel control amount based on the driving environment information so as to prevent or avoid a collision between the vehicle and an obstacle. The second means is configured to acquire a driving engagement degree indicating a degree of engagement of a person with the driving of the vehicle in the preventive safety control, and to change the degree of interference with the travel control amount in the preventive safety control based on the driving engagement degree.

title_en: Crawler-type individual soldier intelligent movement target car
abstract_en: The invention discloses a crawler-type individual intelligent moving target vehicle, which consists of an intelligent moving platform module, a power servo mechanism, an obstacle avoidance module, an automatic navigation control system module, an electrical control system module, an RTK positioning module, a posture control module, a communication link module, a UWB following module, an upper computer software system module, a handheld remote controller module, a target module and the like.

title_en: Pallet system for the transport of goods
abstract_en: In one example embodiment, a computer-implemented method for transporting goods using intelligent pallets includes determining that a first good is received at a first distribution center onto a platform of a first intelligent pallet. The method includes generating one or more signals that control loading of the first intelligent pallet and the first cargo onto a trailer positioned at the first distribution center. The method includes determining a coordination with one or more second intelligent pallets associated with the trailer to determine a first location of the first intelligent pallet and the first cargo within the trailer. The method includes generating one or more signals that position the first intelligent pallet and the first cargo at the first location inside the trailer.

title_en: Bank self-service equipment identification method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a bank self-service equipment identification method, a bank self-service equipment identification device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a geographical coordinate of a user terminal; judging whether the current bank self-service equipment is registered or not according to the geographic coordinates, and if so, carrying out the next step; acquiring image information of the bank self-service equipment uploaded by the user terminal; comparing the image information with preset image information to obtain a similar value; and judging whether the similar value is in a set threshold range, if so, judging that the bank self-service equipment is true, and outputting a result. The invention realizes the authenticity identification of the bank self-service equipment, avoids the transaction of a bank card holder on the forged self-service equipment and the leakage of bank card and password information, reduces the possibility of crime by using the forged self-service equipment, improves the safety of the bank self-service equipment and effectively improves the service quality of banks.

title_en: Battery assembling and disassembling structure for peripheral equipment of household fire alarm system
abstract_en: The invention provides a battery assembling and disassembling structure of peripheral equipment of a household fire alarm system. The battery loading and unloading structure of the peripheral equipment of the household fire alarm system comprises a front shell assembly and a rear shell assembly, wherein the front shell assembly covers the rear shell assembly, and a battery cover assembly is arranged between the front shell assembly and the rear shell assembly. The battery loading and unloading structure of the peripheral equipment of the household fire alarm system has the advantages that the internal installation of the battery is realized, the possibility of battery loss is reduced, the battery cover is of a flip structure and is connected with the shell through the buckle, the switch can be conveniently carried out by using a simple tool, and the battery lock structure is additionally arranged, so that the battery is more stably installed and is not easy to separate from the groove installation structure, and the battery can be timely found under the condition that the battery is not installed in the groove installation structure.

title_en: Lithium battery activation control device
abstract_en: The invention provides a lithium battery activation control device, comprising: the voltage detection circuit is used for detecting a current voltage signal of the voltage detection end according to a voltage detection instruction sent by the microprocessor regularly or in real time; the microprocessor is used for detecting whether the lithium battery is in a passivation state currently according to the current voltage signal, sending an activation instruction to the activation circuit when the lithium battery is detected to be in the passivation state currently, and sending the activation instruction to the activation circuit according to a control instruction sent by the upper computer to enable the activation circuit to carry out discharge activation on the lithium battery; the invention can realize the regular or real-time activation of the lithium battery without using peripheral equipment, prevent the problem of output voltage lag of the lithium battery in normal use and can normally drive high-power equipment.

title_en: Vehicle scheduling method, device, system, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a vehicle scheduling method, a device, a system, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a scheduling request aiming at a vehicle; the scheduling request includes a start location and a destination location of the vehicle; determining a driving track and navigation data for driving from a starting position to a destination position; dividing the driving track into a plurality of track segments according to the navigation data, and generating a scheduling control task of each track segment; and sending the scheduling control task of each track segment to the vehicle so that the vehicle executes the scheduling control task of each track segment. According to the technical scheme of the embodiment of the application, the dispatching control efficiency of the vehicle can be effectively improved.

title_en: Intelligent fire-fighting management system and method for building end
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent fire-fighting management system and method based on a building end, wherein the system comprises a floor building management unit, a first user command acquisition unit and a second user command acquisition unit, wherein the floor building management unit is used for acquiring configuration information of a corresponding building according to the first user command and storing the configuration information, and the configuration information comprises a floor building plan; the equipment management unit is used for acquiring and storing the fire fighting equipment information in the corresponding building according to the second user instruction, wherein the fire fighting equipment information comprises equipment codes and equipment position information; and the alarm processing unit is used for responding to the monitored alarm information, judging the current alarm type, determining the position of an alarm point according to the alarm information when the alarm type is a fire alarm according to the judgment result of the current alarm type, acquiring the corresponding floor building plan and the fire fighting equipment information, and outputting the position of the alarm point and the fire fighting equipment identifier on the floor building plan. The invention can realize the timely sensing and monitoring of the real-time alarm of the networking unit, and can push the related alarm information in time, thereby improving the fire control management level.

title_en: Intelligent teaching system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent teaching system based on deep learning, which comprises: the learning record acquisition module is used for acquiring learning records from a database, and the related information comprises student numbers, test question numbers, related knowledge points, answering results and answering time; and the scene coding module is used for summarizing, summarizing and coding past learning records and current scenes of students to obtain generalized codes. The learning sequence coding module is used for coding past learning sequences of the knowledge points by students to obtain knowledge point answering codes; the neural network training module is used for training a neural network according to the generalized codes and the knowledge point answering codes; the prediction module is used for predicting the student response result in a given scene; and the learning scheduling module is used for recommending learning contents for the students according to the student answering result prediction.

title_en: Method, device and equipment for acquiring path and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a method, a device, equipment and a readable storage medium for acquiring a path. The path acquired by the method is composed of a plurality of path points, each path point corresponds to path consumption, and the path consumption is determined based on the communication quality of each path point. The method comprises the following steps: determining at least one first path point within the vicinity of the path start point of the aircraft; selecting a first selected path point which consumes the first selected path point meeting the preset condition from the at least one first path point; based on the first selected waypoint, a flight path of the aircraft is acquired. According to the scheme provided by the embodiment of the application, in the process of acquiring the flight path of the aircraft, the communication quality of each path point in the flight path at the corresponding position is considered, the delay time of information transmission is reduced, and the timeliness and the accuracy of acquiring the flight path are ensured.

title_en: Article storage method and storage cabinet
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an article storage method and a storage cabinet, and relates to the field of self-service equipment. According to the storage device of the storage cabinet, the plurality of mounting positions for mounting the tray are arranged, and in the article storage method, after receiving articles, the mounting positions of the tray bearing the articles are determined firstly, and then the tray bearing the articles is conveyed to the mounting positions to store the articles. Therefore, in the embodiment of the application, the mounting position of the tray for storing articles can be flexibly adjusted according to the received articles, so that the space for storing the articles in the storage device is matched with the height of the articles, the condition that the space is wasted or the articles cannot be stored due to the fact that the lattice openings of the storage cabinet are fixed is avoided, and the space utilization rate and the use flexibility of the storage cabinet are improved.

title_en: Intelligent bus station with big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent bus station with big data, which comprises a platform, an infrared sensor, a display and a big data intelligent bus system, wherein the platform is provided with a platform body; the output end of the vehicle positioning module is electrically connected with the input end of the data receiving module, the output end of the data receiving module is electrically connected with the input end of the main controller module, the output end of the infrared sensing module is electrically connected with the input end of the data transmission module, the output end of the data transmission module is electrically connected with the input end of the main controller module, the output end of the main controller module is electrically connected with the input end of the voice broadcast module, and the output end of the main controller module is electrically connected with the input end of the video display module; the invention has the capability of collecting the data resources of the public transportation system and provides a necessary data base for the follow-up research; the system also has the capability of analyzing according to the collected data, so that the public transportation system is effectively scheduled, adjusted and managed in time, and resources and labor cost are saved.

title_en: Equipment synchronization control method, device, terminal and system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a method, a device, a terminal and a system for synchronously controlling equipment, wherein when the control terminal is executed, the control terminal comprises a first time sequence signal transmission interface and a first data signal transmission interface; the transmission rate of the first data signal transmission interface is higher than that of the first time sequence signal transmission interface, and the method comprises the following steps: receiving operation information of the current functional operation sent by second data signal transmission interfaces of at least two equipment terminals to be controlled through a first data signal transmission interface; analyzing the operation information and determining the synchronous control identification of the next function operation; and sending the synchronous control identifier to a second data signal transmission interface of the at least two equipment terminals through the first data signal transmission interface so as to control the at least two equipment terminals to execute next function operation in the next synchronous period according to the time sequence signal and the synchronous control identifier sent by the first time sequence signal transmission interface. The synchronous control efficiency of the control terminal to each equipment terminal is greatly improved.

title_en: FPGA-based three-point piezoelectric drive fast-swing mirror hysteresis compensation control system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a FPGA-based three-point piezoelectric driving fast oscillating mirror hysteresis compensation control system, which comprises an FPGA hysteresis compensation control module, an SGS micro-displacement sensor, an SGS micro-displacement signal conditioning and acquiring circuit, a piezoelectric ceramic driving circuit, an upper computer and a three-point piezoelectric driving fast oscillating mirror, wherein the three-point piezoelectric driving large-caliber fast oscillating mirror is a controlled object; the SGS micro-displacement sensor is integrated in the piezoelectric ceramic actuator; the SGS micro-displacement signal conditioning and acquiring circuit is connected with the FPGA hysteresis compensation control module; the piezoelectric ceramic driving circuit is connected with the FPGA hysteresis compensation control module; and the upper computer is communicated with the FPGA through a 422 interface. The system fully utilizes the parallel processing characteristic of the FPGA, completes the deployment of a PI inverse model based on the parallel connection of multiple Stop operators on the FPGA and the parallel hysteresis compensation control of the multi-piezoelectric ceramic actuator, reduces the calculation delay of the system, improves the response speed of the system, and realizes the high-precision, real-time and synchronous multi-piezoelectric compensation and control.

title_en: Automobile intelligent diagnosis positioning device based on OBD-II interface
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of automobile control, and particularly relates to an automobile intelligent diagnosis positioning device based on an OBD-II interface, which comprises a shell, monitoring equipment, a socket assembly and electrical equipment, wherein the technical scheme is as follows: the monitoring device is arranged on the inner wall of the shell and comprises a circuit board II, the top of the circuit board II is provided with a circuit board I, the circuit board II is fixedly arranged on the inner wall of the shell, and one side of the top of the circuit board II is fixedly provided with a USB connector, so that the monitoring device has the beneficial effects that: the intelligent diagnosis positioning equipment is connected with an automobile 0OBD-II interface through an OBD-II connector, a monitoring early warning module is designed in the intelligent diagnosis positioning equipment for monitoring real-time dynamic state of an automobile, when faults and other phenomena occur, the monitoring early warning module carries out feedback early warning, information is sent to remind a user that part of parameters are abnormal through a communication module, and meanwhile the user is reminded to process in time through a display module, so that the intelligent diagnosis positioning equipment has the effects of acquiring OBD-II interface data and realizing real-time acquisition and positioning of vehicle-mounted data.

title_en: Unlocking method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides an unlocking method, an unlocking device, equipment and a medium, wherein the unlocking method, the unlocking device, the equipment and the medium are used for receiving a starting instruction sent by an intelligent door lock, starting up the intelligent door lock and receiving a first request for acquiring a temporary password sent by target terminal equipment; sending a second request for obtaining the temporary password to pre-stored target electronic equipment, and receiving the temporary password sent by the target electronic equipment; and sending the temporary password to the target terminal equipment and powering off. In the embodiment of the invention, the intelligent gateway can be started only after receiving the starting instruction of the user, so that the resource waste caused by the communication connection with the intelligent door lock is avoided, the load pressure of the power supply of the intelligent gateway is reduced, the intelligent gateway does not store the temporary password, and the temporary password is obtained by sending the second request for obtaining the temporary password to the target electronic equipment, so that the unlocking safety is improved, and the use experience of the user is improved.

title_en: Intelligent building monitoring system
abstract_en: The application relates to an intelligent building monitoring system, which belongs to the field of building monitoring and is used for solving the problem of poor public health protection effect in buildings in the related technology, and comprises a plurality of smell acquisition terminals, a plurality of resident terminals and a server; the odor acquisition terminal is arranged at a doorway of a resident and used for acquiring odor at the doorway to generate odor data, and the odor data carries a resident portal identifier; one resident terminal is provided with a resident identification; the server is internally pre-stored with a resident portal identification, a comparison table of the resident identification and an overproof state of odor data; and when the specified odor data is in an overproof state, the server generates prompt information and sends the prompt information to the specified household terminal according to the comparison table. When the abnormal odor is generated by the garbage temporarily staying at the door of the resident, the server sends a resident terminal corresponding to the prompt information value to prompt the resident to process in time so as to ensure the public health in the building.

title_en: Outdoor alarm distribution box
abstract_en: The invention discloses an outdoor alarm distribution box, belonging to the technical field of distribution boxes, and the technical scheme is characterized by comprising a base main body, wherein the upper end surface of the base main body is fixedly connected with a guardrail, the upper end surface of the base main body is provided with a mounting groove, the upper end surface of the mounting groove is provided with a limiting groove, a limiting plate is arranged above the limiting groove, the bottom end of the mounting groove is fixedly connected with a plurality of uniformly distributed reset springs, the lower end surface of the limiting plate is fixedly connected with a plurality of uniformly distributed pressure sensors, the lower end surfaces of the pressure sensors are fixedly connected with supporting springs, when the pressure detected by the pressure sensors continuously exists, the information is sent to a terminal controller, the terminal controller sends the information to a cloud terminal, a monitoring worker can check the information through a camera, and simultaneously, the call is transmitted through a loudspeaker, so that the safety of the outdoor alarm distribution box is, preventing pedestrians from approaching the animals.

title_en: Secondary/super-synchronous oscillation prevention and control-oriented controller parameter stable domain expansion method
abstract_en: The invention particularly relates to a controller parameter stable domain expansion method facing subsynchronous/supersynchronous oscillation prevention and control, which creatively applies an expansion disc theorem to a state matrix containing parameters of a new energy power system (the elements of the state matrix are functions containing parameters of a dominant controller to be solved), provides an optimization model of a similarity transformation matrix according to stability margin evaluation indexes, can narrow a characteristic value estimation range after solving, further serves as a controller parameter stable domain after inverse problem reverse performance expansion according to a Lyapunov stability criterion, and reduces the conservatism of the controller parameter stable domain. The controller parameter stable domain expansion method has the characteristics of high calculation efficiency and small conservative property, and is suitable for online engineering application. The method is combined with engineering practice, and can be suitable for reasonable selection and online refreshing of control parameters of the power electronic converter under the background of feeding a large amount of power grids into the new energy power generation station.

title_en: Typical working condition construction method for long movement segment of train
abstract_en: The invention provides a typical working condition construction method for a long movement segment of a train, and belongs to the technical field of traffic transportation. The method comprises the steps of firstly, acquiring train data according to a construction requirement of a working condition, and removing invalid data in the train data; then preprocessing the remaining effective data, including interpolation, resampling and filtering; then dividing the motion segment into short segments according to the motion mode of the train; and finally, constructing a series of candidate working conditions according to the working condition construction rule, calculating characteristic parameters and evaluation quality guarantee of the candidate working conditions, and selecting the candidate working condition with the minimum evaluation index to construct a typical working condition. The method realizes the construction of the working condition of the vehicle with longer single movement time, and can construct the typical working condition based on the train long movement segment; the method of the invention can construct the working condition with more typical characteristics and can control the total length of the working condition of the train movement.

title_en: Serial number writing method and device and computer readable medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a serial number writing method, a serial number writing device and a computer readable medium. When a write request is received, verifying the write request, and determining whether the write request is allowed to be executed, wherein the write request comprises a sequence number to be written; when the write request is allowed to be executed, analyzing the write request to acquire the sequence number to be written; judging whether the sequence number to be written is valid; and when the sequence number to be written is valid, writing the sequence number to be written into the memory of the intelligent terminal. The scheme of the invention can improve the efficiency of writing the serial number.

title_en: Standard writing training board for letter teaching
abstract_en: The invention provides a standard writing training board for letter teaching, and relates to the field of English teaching. This letter teaching is with standard writing training board, including the assembly shell, assembly shell right side fixedly connected with support bar, support bar right side fixedly connected with clipboard, clipboard left side fixedly connected with chute board, chute board upper end sliding connection has link gear, clipboard left side fixedly connected with slide bar, the limit spring has been cup jointed to the slide bar left end, slide bar left end and link gear sliding connection, the limit spring is inboard at link gear, both ends fixedly connected with ripple axle about the link gear. This training board is write with standard to letter teaching divide into upper, middle and lower triplex with the teaching board through the three check of four-wire that utilize to write the letter, can bellied cell through mutual independence, makes the mr can more conveniently teach the position that each letter occupy, has solved the problem that the teaching difficulty can't the highlight, has reached the effect that the letter writing method that the highlight makes things convenient for the teaching and standardizes is clear the show more.

title_en: Mineral and rock specimen teaching display method and system based on Internet scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mineral and rock specimen teaching display method and system based on an internet scene, wherein the method comprises the following steps: according to the shooting distance and angle designed in advance, collecting 360-degree picture data of mineral/rock samples by dividing an upper route, a middle route and a lower route; screening effective pictures from the collected picture data and numbering the effective pictures; analyzing the effective pictures to perform aerial triangulation, solving out external azimuth elements of each picture, calibrating characteristic points, and establishing a three-dimensional model consistent with the true size of a mineral specimen; and removing the supporting frame for supporting the mineral specimen from the three-dimensional model, and repairing the notch. And releasing the repaired three-dimensional model to a special three-dimensional Internet display platform, and linking the webpage link address to a course teaching platform of the school. The invention can automatically screen out high-quality pictures for three-dimensional reconstruction of mineral and rock specimens, and performs three-dimensional dynamic display teaching at any time and any place through the Internet.

title_en: Robust filter type iterative learning control method for finite time trajectory tracking
abstract_en: A robust filter type iterative learning control method for finite time trajectory tracking provides a distributed filter type iterative learning control method for finite time expected trajectory tracking, and track tracking errors possibly generated during target trajectory tracking are reduced by the method, so that the target trajectory is accurately tracked.

title_en: Method, system and device for measuring suspension stiffness in electromagnetic suspension control system
abstract_en: The application provides a method for measuring suspension stiffness in an electromagnetic suspension control system, an input and output signal matrix is directly constructed by obtaining a control signal and a measurement signal of the electromagnetic suspension control system, and based on singular value decomposition, residual error calculation and LQ decomposition, the suspension stiffness is finally calculated, so that a user does not need to judge the suspension stiffness according to visual experience or roughly calculate the suspension stiffness based on a rough model, the real-time suspension stiffness can be calculated by updating the control signal and the measurement signal in real time, the method is favorable for debugging and running the electromagnetic suspension control system, and the running safety of the electromagnetic suspension control system is ensured. The application also provides a system for measuring the suspension stiffness in the electromagnetic suspension control system, a computer readable storage medium and an electronic device, which have the beneficial effects.

title_en: Safety detection method, system, device, equipment and storage medium for development machine
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a system, a device, equipment and a storage medium for detecting the safety of a heading machine, which comprises the following steps: receiving target signals which are sent by each stroke switch and carry position states of each valve rod on the characterization heading machine; when the target signal indicates that each valve rod is in a middle position state, controlling an oil pump motor of the heading machine to start; and when the target signal represents that any valve rod is not in a neutral state, locking processing is carried out on the oil pump motor, and the corresponding locking state, locking reason and processing scheme of the oil pump motor are output to an operation box for displaying. This application utilizes multiunit travel switch to detect the valve rod position state on the entry driving machine, does not be in the meso position state when having arbitrary valve rod, carries out the shutting to the oil pump motor and handles and show shutting state, shutting reason and processing scheme, makes things convenient for operating personnel to carry out rapid reaction to oil pump motor start-up failure, guarantees entry driving machine safety normal production to improve tunnelling efficiency.

title_en: Method and device for generating operation interface
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for generating an operation interface, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring Near Field Communication (NFC) tag information of a household appliance read by a terminal, wherein the NFC tag information comprises an identifier of the household appliance; acquiring type information of the household appliance according to the identification of the household appliance, and acquiring a corresponding operation interface according to the type information; and controlling the terminal to load the operation interface. According to the method for generating the operation interface, the identification of the household appliance is read through the NFC function of the terminal, and the operation interface corresponding to the household appliance is displayed on the terminal, so that the operability of a user is improved, the viscosity of the user using the household appliance is improved, and the method is simple and easy to realize.

title_en: Probe of spark detector
abstract_en: The invention discloses a spark detector probe, which comprises a spark identification module, a flameout module, a control module, an anti-blocking module, an alarm module, a conveying pipe and a power supply module, wherein the power supply module is used for supplying power to the control module, the spark identification module is used for identifying sparks in the conveying pipe, the spark identification module is used for identifying sparks and then sending an alarm instruction to the control module, the control module is used for receiving the sparks and then controlling the alarm module to send out an alarm, the spark identification module is used for identifying sparks and then sending a flameout instruction to the control module, the control module is used for receiving the sparks and then controlling the anti-blocking module to be started, the spark identification module is used for identifying sparks and then sending a flameout instruction to the control module, the control module is used for receiving and then controlling the flameout of the.

title_en: Ant colony algorithm optimization method based on initial pheromone distribution and dynamic update
abstract_en: The invention provides an ant colony algorithm optimization method based on initial pheromone distribution and dynamic update, which comprises the following steps: 101: assigning initial values to the maximum iteration times and the limiting value for performing pheromone rollback; s102: searching out a suboptimal path according to a greedy strategy; s103: starting searching from a starting node; s104: sequentially selecting each node according to a selection probability formula, and respectively obtaining a complete path for each ant; s105: calculating and comparing the lengths of the paths taken by the ants to find out the current optimal path; s106: carrying out mutation operation on the current optimal path; s107: comparing the lengths of the current optimal path and the variable path; s108: if the continuous iteration times with unchanged optimal path results exceed a preset limit value; s109: and if the current iteration times do not reach the preset maximum iteration times, adding 1 to the iteration times, and jumping to S103, otherwise, outputting the optimal path.

title_en: High Mach shock tube experimental apparatus based on arc discharge driving
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high Mach shock tube experimental device based on arc discharge driving, which comprises: the high-speed shock wave testing device comprises a power energy library system, a driving section, a driven section, a control system, a vacuum system and a testing and data acquisition system, wherein the power energy library system provides current for the driving section, the driving section generates electric explosion under the action of large current, so that high-temperature and high-pressure gas is generated in an explosion cavity of the driving section, a diaphragm between the driven section and the driving section is broken, and high-speed shock waves are formed in the driven section. The invention discloses a high-Mach shock tube experimental device based on arc discharge driving, which is a shock tube experimental device designed based on a new principle and a new method, can generate a hypersonic shock wave of at least 40 Mach (about 14 km/s), and provides a new experimental device for researching scientific problems such as true gas aerodynamic heat loaded into the atmosphere under the hypersonic condition, a gas dynamic physical process, aircraft thermal protection materials and structural design and the like.

title_en: Driver driving stability evaluation method based on Euclidean distance
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of traffic safety, and discloses a driver driving stability evaluation method based on Euclidean distance, which comprises the following steps: acquiring driving speed data and corresponding original position data of a driver in real time, and acquiring a driving behavior sequence and an original road type sequence; smoothing each original road type sequence, and eliminating unsmooth data to obtain a smoothed road type sequence; acquiring a driving behavior sequence of the driver in a normal driving mode under each road type; and calculating the average Euclidean distance of all driving behavior sequences of the driver under each road type, thereby obtaining the driving stability of the driver under each road type. The invention can evaluate the driving stability of the driver under different road conditions according to different driving behaviors, and provides important basis for improving traffic safety and reducing the occurrence rate of traffic accidents.

title_en: Conveyance control method, non-transitory recording medium, and conveyance system
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a conveyance control method, a non-transitory recording medium, and a conveyance system. The purpose of the present disclosure is to suppress deterioration in efficiency of work for conveying an object to be conveyed. The conveyance control method includes a setting step, a determination step, and a control step. In the setting step, a determination region including at least one of the grip region (A2) and the non-grip region (A3) is set. The gripping area (A2) is an area in which 1 or more transport devices (1) move 1 st or more objects (X1) together with the transport devices (1). The non-grip region (a3) is a region that is set to the 2 nd state in which the 1 st state is released. In the determination step, the presence or absence of an object in the determination area is determined. In the control step, whether to move the conveying device (1) to the judgment area is determined based on the judgment result of the judgment step, and the movement of the conveying device (1) is controlled.

title_en: Temperature control method of temperature control device for flowing liquid
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of temperature control, in particular to a temperature control method of a temperature control device for the temperature of flowing liquid, which simplifies the initial liquid temperature, heating/refrigerating output power error, flow metering error, flow control error, power loss deviation under different external environments, lag time of temperature sensor feedback, flow channel water resistance and other complex factors influencing the temperature control precision into a temperature control method which is controlled by 2 variables of power and flow and has self-adaptive capacity through multiple times of data recording, analysis and machine learning, thereby improving the temperature control precision.

title_en: Reference voltage circuit
abstract_en: The application discloses a reference voltage circuit, which comprises a first voltage unit and a second voltage unit, wherein the working voltage of the first voltage unit is higher than that of the second voltage unit; the first voltage unit comprises a first current mirror, the first current mirror at least comprises two current output branches, one current output branch is a first current output branch, the other current output branch is a second current output branch, a divider resistor is connected in series with the first current output branch, and voltage output ends are arranged at two ends of the divider resistor; the second voltage unit comprises a second current mirror and a reference voltage output module, the second current mirror is used for extracting current from the first current output branch, and the reference voltage output module is used for controlling the second current output branch to output trimming current. The scheme enables the high-voltage reference voltage after trimming to meet the required precision requirement.

title_en: Energy minimization method for unmanned aerial vehicle cruise communication
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of air-space-ground integration, relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle cruise and unmanned aerial vehicle auxiliary communication, and particularly relates to an energy minimization method for unmanned aerial vehicle cruise communication. The method comprises the following steps: establishing communication between the unmanned aerial vehicle and the ground node, setting minimum throughput Q meeting the communication of the boundary node, and calculating the optimal flight speed of the unmanned aerial vehicle meeting the communication of the ground node on the premise that the boundary node reaches the minimum throughput; gridding the whole rectangular area, and determining a flight path for maximizing the area coverage of the unmanned aerial vehicle and minimizing the energy consumption; calculating the flight time of the unmanned aerial vehicle, the energy related to flight communication, the hovering time of the unmanned aerial vehicle and the energy related to hovering communication; and calculating the minimum energy of the unmanned aerial vehicle for realizing cruise communication under the whole system. The invention can realize the whole-area communication coverage, and the invention can realize the energy conservation and consumption reduction of unmanned aerial vehicle communication while improving the feasibility of the system.

title_en: Remote sensing monitoring system for monitoring growth vigor of crops
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote sensing monitoring system for monitoring the growth vigor of crops, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle and a data processing center, wherein a data acquisition module is loaded on the unmanned aerial vehicle, the data processing center is provided with a data storage module, a data preprocessing module and a data analysis module, the unmanned aerial vehicle and the data processing center are communicated through a wireless network, the data acquisition module comprises remote sensing image acquisition equipment and a universal tripod head system, the lower part of the unmanned aerial vehicle is provided with an automatic tripod head connecting mechanism, the universal tripod head system is provided with a connecting column which penetrates through a bottom opening of the unmanned aerial vehicle and is inserted into the automatic tripod head connecting mechanism for connection, and the automatic tripod head connecting mechanism and the connecting column are automatically connected and locked through the taking-off and landing of the unmanned aerial vehicle. The universal holder system for loading different remote sensing image acquisition devices is automatically connected and replaced with the unmanned aerial vehicle through the taking-off and landing of the unmanned aerial vehicle, the replacement efficiency is high, and the problems of time-consuming overlong and human errors caused by field manual replacement are solved.

title_en: Active anti-interference control method for permanent magnet motor
