abstract_en: The invention discloses an active anti-interference control method of a permanent magnet motor, which compensates prediction errors of a controlled object caused by mismatching based on an ADRC system, and comprises a transition process module, a nonlinear feedback module and an expansion observation module, wherein the transition process module is arranged to track the system in real time to prevent input quantity from jumping, the expansion observation module is used for tracking the controlled object, the expansion observation module observes the output, the output derivative and the output second derivative of the controlled object and compensates the output second derivative, and the nonlinear feedback module nonlinearly combines errors between tracking signals generated by the transition process module and state variable estimation values given by the expansion observation module and then generates control signals together with disturbance compensation quantity. The invention changes the original system into a second-order system of integrator cascade through the control law design, so that even the most common PD controller can control the system, and the non-matching interference can be effectively inhibited.

title_en: Motion trail planning method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for planning a motion trail, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring track information of a plurality of original motion track points of the unmanned equipment in a controlled motion process, wherein the track information comprises: position information, time information, and motion state information; and performing interpolation operation on each original motion track point according to the track information of the original motion track points and preset interval time to obtain the motion track of the unmanned equipment. The technical scheme of the embodiment of the invention can reduce the cost investment of the unmanned equipment in the repeated operation scene, thereby meeting the operation requirement of the unmanned equipment in the repeated operation scene.

title_en: Airport pavement road network generation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for generating an airport road network, which comprises the following steps: extracting airport pavement basic data from airport satellite images and aviation data; and generating airport pavement road network data. The method and the device can conveniently generate the topological data of the sliding route network of the complex airport. The method can be applied to the fields of aircraft taxi route planning, airport operation monitoring and the like.

title_en: Multi-mode integrated hybrid real-time simulation platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-mode integrated hybrid real-time simulation platform, which comprises: the real-time simulation core module is used for receiving the data input and converted by the peripheral equipment and communicating with the peripheral equipment, and comprises simulation calculation; the embedded high-performance communication platform is used for converting or inverting input and output data when the MEET and peripheral equipment are in a communication closed loop; and the peripheral equipment is used for data interaction with the embedded high-performance communication platform. By the platform, the defect that electromechanical transient simulation cannot accurately and meticulously simulate a high-voltage direct current system, a flexible direct current system, FACTS equipment and a device is overcome; the problems of high modeling complexity, high model parameter maintenance difficulty, limited simulation scale, low warp effect ratio and the like of a full electromagnetic transient simulation platform are solved; the multi-mode hybrid real-time simulation platform is suitable for research of system-level transient characteristic related problems, research and development of control protection technology, and test of a system-level protection device.

title_en: Running state monitoring method of robot
abstract_en: The application discloses an operation state monitoring method of a robot, which comprises the following steps: acquiring single sampling data of a plurality of indexes of the robot at the current moment, wherein the single sampling data of each index comprises a plurality of sampling values; obtaining a first feature vector of each index according to the single sampling data; obtaining a state index of the index according to the first feature vector of the index; and if the state index of the index is lower than a first threshold value, sending alarm information. The method and the system predict the important indexes and the health state of the important parts of the robot in advance, eliminate potential problem hidden dangers and eliminate faults in germination.

title_en: Method, system and equipment for automatic driving of agricultural machinery and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a method for automatically driving an agricultural machine, which comprises the following steps: acquiring agricultural machinery operation parameters of the agricultural machinery through data acquisition equipment; calculating according to the operation parameters of the agricultural machine by using a preset automatic driving model to obtain the optimal driving parameters of the agricultural machine; and uploading the optimal driving parameters to a control terminal so that the control terminal controls the agricultural machinery to automatically drive according to the optimal driving parameters. According to the method and the device, a user or a professional technician is not required to debug the driving parameters, the debugging of the driving parameters is automatically realized by the machine model, the process that the parameters are debugged by remote guidance or remote operation of the technician before agricultural operation is carried out is banned, and the usability and universality of the agricultural automatic driving product are greatly improved. The application also provides a system, equipment and readable storage medium for automatic driving of the agricultural machinery, and the system, the equipment and the readable storage medium have the beneficial effects.

title_en: Method and device for identifying illegal vehicles on motor vehicle lane
abstract_en: The application is suitable for the technical field of image processing, and provides a method for identifying illegal vehicles on a motor vehicle lane, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining and identifying image data of a preset identification area, obtaining an identification result of whether a two-wheel vehicle is included in the image data, analyzing and obtaining vehicle information of the two-wheel vehicle if the image data includes the two-wheel vehicle, detecting whether the vehicle information includes a preset legal identification, and generating alarm information according to the vehicle information if the vehicle information does not include the preset legal identification. The method and the device have the advantages that whether the vehicle in the image data is the two-wheel vehicle is determined by acquiring and identifying the image data of the preset identification area, the vehicle information of the vehicle is acquired when the image data comprises the two-wheel vehicle, and when the preset legal identification is not included in the vehicle information, the warning information is generated according to the vehicle information, so that the accuracy and the reliability of identifying whether the two-wheel vehicle exists in the motor vehicle lane are improved, and the efficiency of acquiring the vehicle information of the illegal two-wheel vehicle is improved.

title_en: Electronic police data-based intersection lane queuing length estimation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intersection lane queuing length estimation method based on electronic police data, which comprises the following steps: 1) preprocessing electronic police data to obtain a stop line passing time and a head time distance sequence of each vehicle during a green light period; 2) assuming that the processed electronic police data belong to two distributions of a queuing vehicle and a non-queuing vehicle, and establishing a Gaussian mixture model; 3) solving parameters of the Gaussian mixture model by adopting an expectation-maximization algorithm; 4) and judging whether each vehicle is queued or not in the period according to the result of the Gaussian mixture model, and determining the lane queuing length according to the last vehicle queued. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of no need of an upstream electronic police, pure data drive, high estimation precision, good robustness and the like.

title_en: Single crystal and gel culture device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a single crystal and gel culture device, which comprises an incubator, a culture unit, a pressure regulating unit and a control unit, wherein the incubator comprises a box body and a box door pivoted on the box body, the inner cavity of the box body is divided into an upper culture chamber and a lower control chamber, the top of the box body is provided with an air inlet and an air outlet, and the bottom of the box body is provided with a liquid outlet; the culture unit comprises at least one set of culture bottle and a culture bottle cap, and the bottom of the culture bottle is fixed at the bottom of the diffusion pool through a culture bottle fixing device; the culture bottle cap is detachably arranged at the bottle mouth of the top of the culture bottle, an evaporation port is arranged on the culture bottle cap, and a pulling piece switch for controlling the size of the evaporation port is arranged in the culture bottle cap; the pressure regulating unit comprises a pressurizing assembly and a depressurizing assembly; the control unit comprises a sensor group, a temperature control element, a touch display screen and a wireless transceiver. The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: the growth condition of single crystal/gel can be controlled; is suitable for most single crystal and gel culture, has high culture efficiency and easy control of culture rate.

title_en: Denitration catalyst regeneration process medicament dosing control device and dosing control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reagent dosing control device in a denitration catalyst regeneration process, which comprises a reagent box and a catalyst regeneration pool, wherein the reagent box is connected with the catalyst regeneration pool; the bottom of the chemical box is provided with a pressure sensor and is also connected with a dosing electromagnetic valve; the catalyst regeneration tank is connected with a water supply electromagnetic valve and a water discharge electromagnetic valve; an infrared receiver, a highest point infrared transmitter and a drug supplementing infrared transmitter are arranged in the catalyst regeneration tank; the catalyst regeneration tank is provided with a floating plate capable of moving up and down, and the infrared receiver is arranged on the floating plate; the pressure sensor, the dosing electromagnetic valve, the water supply electromagnetic valve, the water discharge electromagnetic valve and the infrared module are all connected with the PLC; the PLC is connected with a computer. The invention also discloses a dosing control method using the dosing control device. The dosing control device and the dosing control method can realize automatic control of quality of denitration catalyst regeneration agents, improve catalyst regeneration quality, reduce manual participation and improve working efficiency.

title_en: Information interaction system and network camera
abstract_en: The specification provides an information interaction system and a network camera. The system comprises: mobile terminal, webcam IPC and cloud platform, wherein: the mobile terminal and the IPC have short-distance wireless communication functions, and the mobile terminal is connected with the cloud platform; the mobile terminal and the IPC are used for carrying out information interaction based on a short-distance wireless communication function; the mobile terminal and the cloud platform are used for carrying out information interaction based on connection; and the IPC and cloud platform are used for carrying out information interaction through the mobile terminal. Therefore, the cloud platform, the IPC and the mobile terminal in the system can perform pairwise interaction and mutually utilize opposite-end resources, so that the aim of pairwise rapid linkage is fulfilled.

title_en: ICF device comprising annular infrared injection and temperature control method for preparing target pellet ice layer
abstract_en: An ICF device containing annular infrared injection and a temperature control method for preparing an ice layer of target pills comprise a thermal mechanical structure, wherein the center of the thermal mechanical structure is fixedly provided with the target pills, two sides of a south-north half cavity of the thermal mechanical structure are respectively provided with a cold ring to be contacted with a south-north pole cold arm, the other end of the south-north pole cold arm is connected with a low-temperature cold seat, and a heating block connected with a first computer is arranged on the south-north pole cold arm; the outer surfaces of the south and north half cavities of the thermal mechanical structure are provided with heating ring belts connected with a first computer; observation holes are formed in two sides of the equatorial region of the thermodynamic mechanical structure; an LED collimation light source and a CCD camera are arranged outside the observation hole, the LED collimation light source is connected with a second computer, and the CCD camera is connected with a first computer; laser incident ports are formed in the two poles of the south and north half cavities of the thermodynamic mechanical structure, and annular infrared injection devices are arranged on the outer sides of the two poles of the south and north half cavities; the invention realizes the accurate control of the temperature field of the target pellets through directional infrared, and the ice layer in the target pellets absorbs infrared to generate self-homogenization effect, thereby forming a uniform fuel ice layer meeting the ignition requirement.

title_en: Intelligent self-checking system of thermal generator set control system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of thermal power unit control, in particular to an intelligent self-checking system of a thermal power unit control system. The system comprises a thermal generator set control system, a large-scale real-time historical database and an intelligent self-checking system; the thermal generator set control system is used for monitoring various parameters of the thermal generator set and collecting and transmitting monitored data to the large-scale real-time historical database; the large real-time historical database comprises a first-class data acquisition module, a second-class data acquisition module, a data checking module, a data integration module and a data transmission module; the intelligent self-checking system comprises an offline modeling unit, a real-time calculating unit, a visual display unit and a control system self-checking unit. The invention mainly solves the problems that the control system of the thermal generator set only displays self-checking picture load and temperature, and cannot realize automatic abnormity detection and analysis of the control system, so that when the control system fails, the control system cannot find the fault timely and accurately.

title_en: Pressure regulator with built-in relief valve for releasing pressure in case of a downstream overpressure
abstract_en: The pressure regulator (6) comprises: -a downstream body (61) defining a low pressure chamber (613); -an upstream body (63) delimiting a high-pressure chamber (66) and carrying a relief valve seat (652); -a movable piston (62) having an inner channel (620) with an upper end forming a relief valve seat (621) and a lower end opening onto an intermediate chamber (624) connected to the leakage circuit; -a tubular valve stem (67) passing through the internal passage of the piston and the internal passage of the upstream body, having an upper end forming a relief valve shutter (671) and a lower end forming a regulator valve shutter (672) supportable on the relief valve seat; -a first return member (68) compressed between the piston and the upstream body and biasing the piston towards the downstream body; -a second return member (69) compressed between the piston and a plate (673) attached to the valve stem, biasing the stem in a direction to firmly press the pressure relief valve closer against the pressure relief valve seat.

title_en: Modal division method and fault monitoring method for multi-modal characteristic industrial process
abstract_en: The invention aims at the actual industrial process presenting the multi-modal characteristics, and realizes the fault monitoring of the multi-modal process through three steps of modal division, offline modeling and online monitoring. The method comprises the following steps: step S1, performing modal division based on a variable-length sliding window mean-augmented DiylFowler test method; step S2, respectively modeling different modes by using a dynamic local principal component analysis method by focusing attention on the often overlooked transition modes; and step S3, fully utilizing the historical modalities, and providing a modality matching method to determine the modality of the current online data, so as to perform accurate monitoring. The invention can accurately and effectively complete a series of work of division, modeling and online monitoring of the multi-mode process. Has important significance for improving the production safety and ensuring the economic benefit and the production benefit of enterprises.

title_en: Vehicle early warning method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a vehicle early warning method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring road end monitoring data, wherein the road end monitoring data is real-time monitoring data of a road end sensor on a current road; performing early warning scene recognition on vehicles on the current road based on the road end monitoring data to obtain an early warning scene recognition result, wherein the early warning scene recognition result comprises a target vehicle and an early warning target; and sending the early warning target to a vehicle-mounted terminal of the target vehicle so that the vehicle-mounted terminal acquires a real-time early warning video, wherein the real-time early warning video is video data comprising mark information of the early warning target, and the real-time early warning video is output to a vehicle-end display device of the target vehicle. By the aid of the technical scheme, vehicle-road data interaction can be achieved, the vehicle end acquires surrounding sensing information in real time, drivers and passengers are helped to quickly identify dangerous targets through early warning videos, and early warning efficiency and accuracy are improved.

title_en: Air pressure control type current controller
abstract_en: The invention discloses an air pressure control type current controller, which comprises a main body shell. The air compressor is directly communicated with a gas storage space of equipment needing to control air pressure, then a binding post of the air compressor is connected with one of conducting wires of the air compressor for controlling the air pressure of the equipment, when the air pressure in the equipment is low, the device can realize the connection work of current to enable the air compressor to work, air compression is carried out in the equipment, when the pressure reaches the highest value controlled by the device, the current of the air compressor can be automatically cut off, at the moment, the gas storage pressure of the air equipment can be maintained in a proper range, and due to the leakage of air or the consumption of air, the air compressor can be enabled to continue to work only when the air pressure value reaches the minimum pressure value controlled by the device again, so the air compressor can be protected in a range mode, and the shutdown and the starting frequency of the air compressor cannot be too frequent.

title_en: Hotel parking management method based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence and discloses a hotel parking management method based on artificial intelligence. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring the check-in information of a user and the information of a vehicle to be parked; obtaining parking parameters of the vehicle to be parked according to the user check-in information and the information of the vehicle to be parked; acquiring parking lot information; determining a target parking space according to the parking parameters and the parking lot information; and informing the vehicle to be parked to park according to the target parking space. By the mode, the intelligent management of the hotel parking lot is realized, the information of the vehicles to be parked is combined with the information of the clients who live in, and the target parking spaces are distributed for the vehicles to be parked, so that the clients who live in can quickly find the corresponding parking spaces, and the occupation of external vehicles on the hotel parking spaces is reduced.

title_en: Adjustable multifunctional English auxiliary reading and training integrated device and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an adjustable multifunctional English auxiliary reading and training integrated device and method, which comprises a fixing plate and an adjusting plate, wherein a lower adjusting rod is fixedly arranged at the top end of the fixing plate, an upper adjusting rod is fixedly arranged at the bottom end of the adjusting plate, a double-end threaded rod is arranged between the lower adjusting rod and the upper adjusting rod, threaded grooves are formed in the top end of the lower adjusting rod and the bottom end of the upper adjusting rod, a rotating disc is fixedly arranged at the outer end of the double-end threaded rod, a reading plate is arranged at the top end of the adjusting plate, and a first sliding groove is formed in the top end of the adjusting plate. The height-adjustable reading board is provided with the height-adjustable adjusting plate and the angle-adjustable reading board, so that the reading board can adapt to people with different heights and sizes to read, is comfortable when the people read, has strong practicability, can adapt to the reading habits of different people, has strong adaptability, prevents people from keeping a posture and an angle all the time, can relieve the fatigue and the uncomfortable feeling of reading, and further enhances the practicability.

title_en: Double-linkage temperature control valve embedded in solar water heater pipeline
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water heater valves, and discloses a double-linkage temperature control valve embedded in a solar water heater pipeline, which comprises a sleeve plate, wherein the left end of the sleeve plate is fixedly connected with a fixed frame, a connecting rod is movably inserted into the fixed frame, the lower end of the connecting rod is movably connected with a wedge plate, the right end of the wedge plate is fixedly connected with a main valve block, the bottom end of the inside of the sleeve plate is fixedly connected with an adjusting spring, the upper end of the adjusting spring is fixedly connected with a movable block, and the middle inside of the sleeve plate is movably inserted with a drain pipe. When the temperature inside the drain pipe is detected to be abnormal through the temperature control sensing piece, the temperature control sensing piece controls the driving wheel to rotate, the driving wheel drives the guide pipe to move upwards, the guide pipe drives the rotating rod to rotate through the half gear, the rotating rod drives the wedge plate to move rightwards through the connecting rod, the wedge plate compresses the pre-tightening spring and drives the main valve block to move rightwards, the drain pipe is sealed, and therefore the effects of automatically closing the valve and being safe to use when the water temperature discharged by the water heater is abnormal are achieved.

title_en: Signal detection equipment for realizing signal area intensity detection by utilizing curved frame
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of next generation information, and provides a signal detection device for realizing signal area intensity detection by utilizing a curved frame, which comprises a signal detection device, an interval regulation and control frame and a detection frame, wherein the bottom end of the signal detection device is movably connected with the detection frame, the left side and the right side of the detection frame are both movably connected with a press switch, the bottom end of the detection frame is movably connected with a limit plate through the press switch, the top end of the detection frame is movably connected with the detection frame, the left side and the right side of the signal detection device are both movably connected with the interval regulation and control frame, the signal detection device for realizing signal area intensity detection by utilizing the curved frame deflects to the lower side through a movable sliding rod, a movable sliding rod drives a stretching frame to move to the outer side, an interference device is driven to move to the inner side through extrusion force between connecting rods, the interference device is in a power-on state, and an electromagnetic principle is adopted, the jammer generates a certain electromagnetic wave.

title_en: Medical equipment operation fault monitoring circuit
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of medical treatment, in particular to a medical equipment operation fault monitoring circuit. The technical problem is as follows: a circuit for monitoring an operational failure of a medical device is provided which can avoid a medical accident without affecting the efficiency of treatment. The technical scheme is as follows: a monitoring circuit for operation failure of medical equipment comprises a power supply circuit, a first monostable delay circuit, a controllable multivibrator circuit and the like; and the output end of the first monostable delay circuit is connected with the input end of the controllable multivibrator circuit. The medical equipment failure warning device can tell medical staff that medical equipment fails and needs to be handled in time through the buzzer circuit, avoids medical accidents, does not affect treatment efficiency, can display parameters of the medical equipment through the two nixie tube circuits and the display control circuit, and facilitates the medical staff to judge failure reasons of the medical equipment.

title_en: Intelligent electric meter with overload protection device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent electric meter with an overload protection device, and relates to the technical field of intelligent electric meters. This take overload protection device's smart electric meter, through the inside of putting into fixed cover block with input electric wire and output electric wire, and the change bolt is fixed input electric wire and output electric wire in the inside of fixed cover block, then put the lead wire in the inside of circular telegram groove, and the change bolt is fixed the lead wire in the inside of insulating cap, secondly rotate the insulating cap, let the lead wire run through fixed cover block and press down the one end of dwang, make the other end and the conducting block of dwang link together, the lead wire is after being fused by voltage high temperature, make the torsional spring rotate the dwang, let the input electric wire can not let fixed cover block and conducting block electrically conduct through electric arc, thereby protect smart electric meter's use, let electrostatic protection casing and electrostatic protection storehouse live the electromagnetic shield of external component, make the ammeter body not receive electromagnetic interference, improve the operation precision of ammeter body.

title_en: LDO circuit
abstract_en: The utility model provides a LDO circuit, including LDO main part circuit and prevent the circuit that overshoots, prevent that the circuit that overshoots connects between the output of LDO main part circuit and ground, prevent that the control end of the circuit that overshoots is connected with the input of LDO main part circuit, under the initial input voltage's of receiving of the input of LDO main part circuit condition, make the output of LDO main part circuit be connected to the low potential in response to the input voltage that receives on its control end, the output voltage of LDO output takes place to overshoot when having restrained the power and having gone up, then avoided the external circuit that the output of LDO circuit connects the condition that overvoltage appears. In addition, the overshoot prevention circuit does not comprise a resistor device, so that a larger circuit area is not required to be increased, and extra power consumption is not increased, and the overshoot of the output voltage of the LDO circuit is well inhibited under the condition that the circuit cost is extremely low.

title_en: Traffic signal lamp capable of dynamically controlling passing time
abstract_en: The invention relates to a traffic signal lamp capable of dynamically controlling the passing time, which comprises a main controller, signal lamps, an inductive switch, a support and various signal circuits, wherein the main controller sequentially controls the signal circuits to be opened and closed according to a sequential control instruction, so that the signal lamps of all lanes are sequentially opened and closed, and the ordered passing of pedestrians and vehicles is realized.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle anti-interference control system and method based on original pigeon multi-behavior intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle anti-interference control system method based on original pigeon multi-behavior intelligence, which comprises the following steps: step one: giving an initial state and establishing a drooping unmanned aerial vehicle six-degree-of-freedom nonlinear model and a wind interference model; step two: the rotor wing mode anti-interference control of the vertical unmanned aerial vehicle; step three: the rotor wing mode of the vertical unmanned plane is switched to the fixed wing mode; step four: based on the intelligent parameter optimization of the original pigeon behavior; step five: the fixed wing mode anti-interference control of the vertical unmanned aerial vehicle; step six: the fixed wing mode of the vertical unmanned plane is switched to the rotor wing mode; step seven: the vertical unmanned aerial vehicle descends vertically in a rotor wing mode. The invention ensures the stability of the system and meets the mode switching index; the self uncertainty and wind disturbance are effectively resisted, the aircraft can fly in different environments, and the aircraft has environmental adaptability, stability and disturbance resistance; the parameter adjusting efficiency is effectively improved, and the height fluctuation is more gentle when the modes are switched.

title_en: Kit for creating a robot
abstract_en: The application relates to a kit for creating a robot, comprising: a base comprising at least two extrudates, the at least two extrudates having a location; at least one variable angle connector operably coupling the at least two extrudates, the at least one variable angle connector comprising at least two aligners that limit the disengagement of the at least two extrudates from the location; at least one motor driving at least one gear; and at least one motor mount operably coupling the at least one motor with the at least one gear and at least one of the at least two extrudates.

title_en: Electric control cabinet of welding fume treatment system
abstract_en: The invention provides an electrical control cabinet of a welding fume processing system, which comprises an electrical cabinet and three-phase alternating current, wherein the electrical cabinet is provided with a main control loop, a PLC control system configuration circuit, a PLC control system, a panel loop, a control loop and a terminal connecting loop, and the main control loop is connected with a metering circuit, a power supply circuit and a voltage conversion circuit; the PLC control system configuration circuit comprises a meter communication circuit, a network communication circuit, a digital input/output circuit, a digital input circuit and a temperature detection input circuit; the PLC control system comprises a CPU, a manual control circuit of the welding fume processing system, an automatic control circuit of the welding fume processing system and a temperature detection circuit, and the panel loop is connected with the PLC control system. The invention can carry out centralized management on the welding fume processing system and realize intelligent management.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle system for air pollution detection
abstract_en: The unmanned aerial vehicle system for air pollution detection comprises a cloud server end and a cloud server, wherein the cloud server is used for analyzing real-time pollution data, training a model and making a scheduling strategy; the mobile server end comprises a mobile edge server, and the mobile edge server provides calculation unloading and wireless signal coverage communication service for an area with insufficient calculation resources by utilizing the mobile capability of the mobile edge server; and the edge node end comprises edge nodes, the edge nodes perform preprocessing operation on the original pollution data and respectively transmit the data transmission to designated layer computing resources according to a scheduling strategy, and the layer computing resources comprise an edge node layer, a cloud server layer and a mobile edge server layer taking an unmanned aerial vehicle as a carrier. The unmanned aerial vehicle that this application used to be equipped with the edge server carries out the task in the place of being covered with pollution detection node, synthesizes and considers make full use of unmanned aerial vehicle's computational capability, mobility and based on the communication ability of radio signal decay, and the resource of multilayer framework is utilized to the high efficiency.

title_en: Hierarchical clustering method-based highway congestion judgment method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for judging highway congestion based on a hierarchical clustering method, which comprises the following steps: obtaining historical traffic parameters, wherein the historical traffic parameters comprise: detecting the traffic flow, the average speed and the occupancy of the cross section; clustering the historical traffic parameters to obtain a congested data set and a non-congested data set; clustering the congestion data sets to obtain frequent congestion data sets and occasional congestion data sets; and acquiring real-time traffic parameters, and judging congestion based on a congestion data set center, a non-congestion data center, a frequent congestion data set center and an occasional congestion data set center. The invention fully considers the similarity, difference and mutability of traffic parameters of upstream and downstream detection sections, can better judge the occurrence of congestion, can further judge whether the congestion is frequent or accidental, and can be suitable for judging the congestion on the highway.

title_en: Fingerprinting of semiconductor die arrangements
abstract_en: A die arrangement (10, 20) and a method (70) for monitoring the die arrangement (10, 20) are provided. The die arrangement (10, 20) includes a plurality of dies (30-1, 30-2, 30-n), and a physical interconnect structure (31) extending between and through the plurality of dies (30-1, 30-2, 30-n). The physical interconnect structure (31) is arranged for imparting an unpredictable but reproducible property to a digital signal carried on the physical interconnect structure (31). The die arrangement (10, 20) further comprises monitoring logic (32) for monitoring a property of the digital signal. This enables detection of tampering with the topological arrangement (10, 20) of the semiconductor dies (30-1, 30-2, 30-n) relative to each other.

title_en: System for analyzing and reporting fault information of vehicle-mounted terminal
abstract_en: The invention provides a system for analyzing and reporting fault information of a vehicle-mounted terminal, which comprises: the vehicle-mounted terminal is used for acquiring and storing vehicle information and running conditions; the vehicle-mounted power supply is connected with the vehicle-mounted terminal and used for supplying power to the vehicle-mounted terminal; the standby power supply is connected with the vehicle-mounted terminal and used for supplying power to the vehicle-mounted terminal when the vehicle-mounted power supply fails; and the remote terminal is in communication connection with the vehicle-mounted terminal and is used for receiving the vehicle information and the running condition sent by the vehicle-mounted terminal when the vehicle-mounted power supply fails. The beneficial effects are that: the invention can provide working voltage for the vehicle-mounted terminal with power supply failure through the standby power supply, thereby ensuring that the vehicle information is not lost during the failure, automatically analyzing the reason of the power supply failure, reporting the reason to the vehicle management background to remind an operator on duty to process the failure in time, and greatly improving the efficiency of troubleshooting the vehicle-mounted terminal.

title_en: Express cabinet terminal fault detection method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of express cabinet systems, and discloses a method, a device, computer equipment and a storage medium for detecting express cabinet terminal faults.

title_en: Abnormity early warning method and device, storage medium and computer equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an abnormity early warning method and device, a storage medium and computer equipment, wherein the abnormity early warning method comprises the following steps: acquiring actual operation data of the machine in each operation; processing actual operation data to obtain each starting time and total starting success times of the machine; determining the model of the machine, determining a single abnormal judgment standard of the model according to each starting time of all machines of the model, determining average daily starting times according to the total starting success times, and performing assignment calculation on each starting time of the machine according to the single abnormal judgment standard and the average daily starting times of the model to obtain a grading result of the machine; and carrying out abnormity early warning on the machine according to the grading result of the machine. Therefore, the abnormity early warning method during the operation of the machine can carry out abnormity early warning on the machine, further timely carry out maintenance on the machine, and fully prolong the service life of the machine.

title_en: Intersection signal control method adopting intermittent lane
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of traffic design and control, and particularly relates to an intersection signal control method adopting an intermittent lane. The invention is used for a multilane intersection, the multilane at least comprises a left-turn special lane and a straight special lane, and the straight special lane adjacent to the left-turn special lane is set as an intermittent lane; the method for setting the intermittent lane comprises the steps of setting an intermittent zone stop line on a corresponding straight special lane, defining an area between the intermittent zone stop line and an intersection stop line as an intermittent zone, wherein the intermittent zone means that left-turning vehicles and straight vehicles alternately drive in under the control of signals. The invention can reduce the problem of secondary stop at the intersection of the waiting area, gives consideration to the whole passing efficiency of the intersection and can be suitable for various traffic conditions.

title_en: Control method, device and system for rail vehicle and nonlinear suspension system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a control method, a device and a system for a rail vehicle and a nonlinear suspension system and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: establishing a nonlinear suspension system model according to historical experimental data of a nonlinear air suspension system; observing the state variable and the external disturbance of the nonlinear suspension system model by adopting an extended state observer to obtain parameters of the extended state observer and corresponding observed values; establishing a controller of the nonlinear suspension system according to the parameters of the extended state observer and the observed value, and controlling the nonlinear air suspension system through the controller; the controller established by the invention can control the nonlinear suspension system, so that the system is more stable, and the smoothness, comfort and safety of the system are improved.

title_en: Vehicle identification correction method and device based on voice interaction
abstract_en: The invention provides a vehicle identification correction method and a device based on voice interaction, wherein the method comprises the following steps: when the vehicle is detected to enter the vehicle identification range, acquiring a first vehicle identifier of the vehicle identified by the vehicle identification equipment in the vehicle identification range; controlling voice conversation equipment in a vehicle recognition range to output first prompt information in a voice mode, wherein the first prompt information comprises a first vehicle identifier and is used for prompting personnel corresponding to a vehicle to confirm the first vehicle identifier; and receiving a confirmation result of the person corresponding to the vehicle for the first vehicle identification through the voice dialogue equipment in the vehicle recognition range, wherein the confirmation result comprises a second vehicle identification determined by the person corresponding to the vehicle, and determining the second vehicle identification as the target vehicle identification of the vehicle. Therefore, the vehicle identification can be corrected through voice interaction, and the identification accuracy of the vehicle identification can be improved.

title_en: Vehicle position real-time detection method based on road geometric information
abstract_en: The invention relates to a vehicle position real-time detection method based on road geometric information, which comprises the following steps: 1) Carrying out real-time target detection on the vehicle to acquire geometric information of the vehicle; 2) Acquiring the position coordinates of the contact point between the vehicle and the road surface in the image based on the convolutional neural network and the BP neural network according to the geometric information of the vehicle; 3) Calculating to obtain a conversion relation between an image coordinate system and a real coordinate system based on the image information of the road traffic line and the camera intrinsic parameters, namely a homography matrix H; 4) And converting the contact point between the vehicle and the road surface according to the conversion relation to obtain the real-time position of the vehicle. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages of no need of marking control points on site, labor cost saving in marking, high detection precision and the like.

title_en: Communication method, communication system and storage system
abstract_en: The invention provides a communication method, a communication system and a storage system, and relates to the technical field of communication. The method is applied to communication modules in a communication system, the communication system comprises at least two communication modules, and the communication modules are in serial communication connection, and the method comprises the following steps: receiving a service ending instruction; the service ending instruction indicates the end of a data transmission process of a service; responding to the service ending instruction, and adjusting the current baud rate; the adjusted baud rate is used for the data transmission process of the next service; and in the data transmission process of the same service, the baud rates of different communication modules are kept consistent. In the embodiment of the invention, different baud rates can be adopted in the data transmission process of each service, and the baud rate is dynamically changed, so that the cracking difficulty of the data is improved, and the data security of serial communication is improved.

title_en: Navigation method and device and unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention provides a navigation method, a navigation device and an unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein the navigation method comprises the following steps: receiving a current position and a navigation end position of a vehicle sent by a vehicle-mounted navigation system; and measuring different paths between the current position of the vehicle and the navigation terminal position in a preset detection range through the millimeter wave radar on the unmanned aerial vehicle, and determining a target path with minimum road surface fluctuation. The method can achieve the purpose that the unmanned aerial vehicle sends the measured target path with the smallest road surface fluctuation to the vehicle-mounted navigation system on the vehicle, and the vehicle is instructed to run according to the optimal target path.

title_en: Signal lamp shielding detection method and device, terminal and computer readable medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a signal lamp shielding detection method, a signal lamp shielding detection device, a terminal and a computer readable medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a region image of a region where a signal lamp on equipment is located; if the signal lamp exists in the area image, determining the area of the signal lamp image in the area image; determining whether the signal lamp is shielded or not according to the area of the signal lamp image and the reference area of the signal lamp image in the reference region image which is acquired by using the same image acquisition parameters in advance and contains the signal lamp; and if the signal lamp is shielded, sending an alarm prompt. The invention can facilitate managers to find the shielded signal lamp in time and clear shielding objects around the signal lamp in time, thereby finding the abnormal color condition of the signal lamp in time and avoiding damaging equipment.

title_en: Deep traffic jam prediction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for predicting deep traffic congestion, which comprises the following steps: step 1, a network server stores road traffic information, establishes a sample set of road section flow vectors, and obtains a historical data set; step 2, converting the traffic road network structure information into a topological graph structure; step 3, obtaining the degree information of the nodes and selecting the selected road section data from the historical data set according to the degree information of the nodes to obtain a missing data set; step 4, complementing the missing road section data to obtain a complement data set; and 5, inputting the complement data set into a deep learning flow prediction model to predict road congestion. The prediction method has high prediction accuracy and reduces communication overhead; the amount of data transmitted is reduced and the impact of missing data on the predictive performance is reduced.

title_en: Sheet medium control method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a thin sheet medium control method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, which are applied to a separation mechanism, wherein the separation mechanism comprises a separation channel for conveying the thin sheet medium, the tail end of the separation channel is connected with the transmission channel through a cross-over area, and the method comprises the following steps: when the separation mechanism is started, determining the handover linear speed information, and controlling the separation channel to transmit according to the handover linear speed information; determining variable speed control information when it is detected that the first sheet-like medium exits the separation path in a process of conveying the first sheet-like medium from the separation path to the conveyance path; and controlling the separation channel to transmit according to the variable speed control information. By the embodiment of the invention, the optimized control of the separation process of the sheet media is realized, the stable connection of the sheet media can be ensured, the sheet media have proper separation distance, the sheet media are prevented from being torn due to speed difference separation control, and the abrasion degree is reduced.

title_en: Apparatus and method of using the same
abstract_en: The present invention provides an apparatus, comprising: an accommodating portion; the housing includes a first region configured for power charging and storage and a second region configured for device storage; the charging source end is connected with a power supply in the first area and is configured to supply power for charging; the power supply and the device are adapted to be released under a release command; wherein the power supply is adaptable to the device and is configured to provide power to the device, or the power supply is adapted for use by an external device to provide power to the external device; the device is used independently. Therefore, the device provided by the technical scheme can provide power supply and equipment service, has various services and can meet more use requirements of users. Furthermore, the invention also relates to a method for using the device.

title_en: Handheld holder device, control method thereof and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a control method of a handheld cloud deck device, the handheld cloud deck device (10) and a computer readable storage medium. The handheld cloud platform device (10) comprises a handle (11) and a cloud platform (12) which is rotatably connected to the handle (11). The control method comprises the following steps: acquiring the measurement attitude of a cradle head (12) at a first moment after long-time exposure or delayed shooting; acquiring a reference attitude of the pan-tilt (12) at the first moment; and adjusting the posture of the cradle head (12) according to the measurement posture, the reference posture and the preset target posture so that the cradle head (12) is kept fixed relative to the handle (11).

title_en: Liquid supplementing device of heat exchange system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of heat exchange systems, in particular to a liquid supplementing device of a heat exchange system. The liquid replenishing device comprises a liquid replenishing box, wherein a plurality of liquid replenishing inlets are arranged on the rear side of the top end of the liquid replenishing box side by side and communicated with an inner cavity of the liquid replenishing box; the side wall of the front end of the fluid infusion box is provided with a fluid infusion outlet, one end of a fluid infusion outlet pipe is connected to the fluid infusion outlet, the fluid infusion outlet pipe is located outside the fluid infusion box, the other end of the fluid infusion outlet pipe is connected with a pipe joint, and the pipe joint is used for being connected with a heat exchange system. According to the invention, the first water baffle and the second water baffle are arranged in the liquid supplementing box, so that the occurrence of misoperation of the liquid level floating ball caused by liquid return impact is avoided; the height that highly is less than the second limbers hole of first limbers hole, this kind of structure can further prevent that the liquid return whereabouts of liquid reserve tank from strikeing and forming the liquid phenomenon of spattering, prevents to cause the malfunction warning of each floater level gauge.

title_en: Linear voltage-stabilizing power supply circuit
abstract_en: The application discloses linear steady voltage supply circuit of wide input range of high accuracy, this circuit are through the trimming branch quantity of trimming instruction control access trimming module, the trimming voltage that adjustment trimming branch produced to the realization is to the adjustment of the first bias signal of trimming module output, and then adjusts the output voltage of first transistor, realizes the purpose of high accuracy output voltage. The linear voltage-stabilizing power supply circuit generates stable and reliable output voltage without depending on a feedback loop of the output voltage, thereby avoiding the situation that the linear voltage-stabilizing power supply circuit is badly influenced due to the difficult compensation and poor stability of the voltage feedback loop.

title_en: Curvature constraint fusion potential field method-based D × Lite unmanned vehicle local path planning method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a curvature constraint fusion potential field method-based D × Lite unmanned vehicle local path planning method, which is characterized in that a distance function and a child node corner constraint are added on the basis of a D × Lite algorithm, the algorithm reversely plans a path with the minimum heuristic value from a terminal point to a starting point, and the planned path is used as a global path of the algorithm and provides a certain data basis for local dynamic path planning; starting from a starting point, acquiring child nodes in a new child node expansion mode, meanwhile, establishing a moving window by taking a current node as a circle center and R as a radius, establishing a potential force field equation at the current node when a dynamic obstacle appears in the moving window, and adding the direction of the resultant force into the selection of the child nodes; position information and corner information fed back by the unmanned vehicle at a certain frequency are re-planned according to the unmanned vehicle feedback information; and outputting the optimal speed and direction to drive the unmanned vehicle to run. The path planned by the invention meets the vehicle kinematics model and has good dynamic obstacle avoidance capability.

title_en: Automatic express package conveying automobile
abstract_en: The utility model provides an automatic car of carrying of express delivery parcel, has the storage to put the shelf of parcel on unmanned vehicle's the carriage, puts the parcel that the unmanned vehicle carriage was put to the parcel through intelligent robot and puts the frame on, puts the back with the parcel, through the butt joint of unmanned vehicle carriage afterbody and district intelligent cabinet, puts the parcel that the frame was put to unmanned vehicle carriage parcel and channels into intelligent cabinet, accomplishes the task of express delivery parcel automatic conveying.

title_en: Safety warning device for railway track
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rail safety, and discloses a safety warning device for a railway track, which comprises a chassis, wherein a support rod is fixedly connected to the top of the chassis, a connecting seat is fixedly connected to the top of the support rod, a warning piece is arranged on the top of the connecting seat, and a glass cover is arranged in the warning piece. Can effectively attract the attention of the pedestrians and play a role in warning.

title_en: Giant hydropower station gate oil cylinder storage and transfer control device and method
abstract_en: A lifting cylinder of a lifting mechanism is connected with a bottom plate of a travelling mechanism, clamping mechanisms are arranged at two ends of a lifting plate of the lifting mechanism, clamping points are formed by a turnover wheel and clamping arms, the clamping arms are radially limited in the rotating process of the turnover wheel, every two travelling mechanisms, the lifting mechanism and the clamping mechanisms form a group of supporting gate cylinders, and the lifting mechanism and the clamping mechanisms are electrically connected with the lifting mechanism and the control system which automatically controls the turnover wheel to drive the gate cylinders to turn over and deform according to detection results. The invention overcomes the problems that the cost is high in the transferring, storing and maintaining processes of the gate oil cylinder of the raw water power station, and the deformation of the gate oil cylinder cannot be controlled in the storing process, and has the characteristics of simple structure, convenience in transferring and storing, low maintenance cost, simplicity and convenience in operation, and capability of detecting the deformation of the gate oil cylinder, and adjusting the overturning angle of the gate oil cylinder to control the deformation at the same time.

title_en: Method for authenticating magnetic induction marks with a portable device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method of authenticating a magnetically inductive marker applied on a substrate and comprising magnetically oriented, partially reflective, flake-like, magnetic or magnetizable pigment particles with a portable device equipped with a light source operable to deliver visible light, an imager, a processor and a memory, the method comprising: calculating, with a processor, respective average intensities I of light reflected by the partially reflective flake-like magnetic or magnetizable pigment particles and collected by the imager at respective viewing angles θ; storing the calculated average intensity of the reflected light and the corresponding viewing angle to obtain a reflected light intensity curve I (θ); comparing the stored reflected light intensity curve I (theta) with a stored reference reflected light intensity curve I for the magnetic induction marks ref (theta) making a comparison, and determining magnetically induced markings based on the result of the comparisonWhether it is true.

title_en: Automatic cutter feeding and oil injecting system based on AGV trolley
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic cutter feeding and oiling system based on an AGV (automatic guided vehicle), which is characterized by comprising the following components: the AGV trolley executes the instruction of the scheduling system and moves between the specified positions according to a preset path; the oiling device is used for storing oil products and is arranged on the AGV trolley; the tool storage device is used for storing tools and is arranged on the AGV trolley; the cooperative robot executes actions of replacing a cutter and injecting oil according to the instruction of the scheduling system; and the dispatching system receives tool changing and oil injection request information of the machining center equipment, allocates the AGV with the tools or oil products to an appointed position, and controls the cooperative robot to change the tools or inject oil. The invention has simple structure and low cost, can automatically feed equipment with tools and fill oil products, does not influence the production of the equipment, does not reduce the starting rate of the equipment, benefits the whole life after one-time investment, and has wide popularization value.

title_en: Road information acquisition and propagation platform based on big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a road information acquisition and propagation platform based on big data, which comprises an intelligent camera, a data processing module, a network firewall, a traffic data collection base, a data backup unit, a data screening module, a data distribution module, a command system platform, a local sharing platform, a data dispatching module, a communication mobile terminal, an information delivery terminal, an internet sharing platform and a data broadcasting module, wherein the intelligent camera is used for collecting traffic condition data of each road and uploading the collected data to the data processing module; the invention adds the optimization module before transmitting the image, so that the transmitted image data can be clearer and the subsequent identification is convenient.

title_en: Traffic control command device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a traffic control command device, which comprises a control cabin, a solar panel component, an adjusting component, a working cabin, a base and a fixing component, wherein the control cabin is arranged on the solar panel component; the control cabin is provided with traffic lights; the control bin is driven by the adjusting component to move; the adjusting assembly comprises a motor, an adjusting rod, a threaded rod and a driving unit; the threaded rod drives the adjusting rod to lift under the driving of the driving unit; the solar panel component comprises a solar panel, a spring and a telescopic rod, and the telescopic rod drives the solar panel to lift through the spring under the action of the motor. The driving unit comprises a handle, a pressure rod and a transmission gear, and the transmission gear drives the threaded rod to rotate under the action of the pressure rod. The invention solves the problems that the current traffic control command device generates dust falling to cause loss of a solar panel, the height of the traffic control command device is difficult to adjust, and the traffic control command device is easy to shift and inconvenient to carry and install due to the influence of weather and external force.

title_en: Geo-fence based alert system and method of use
abstract_en: The invention discloses an alarm system based on a geo-fence and a using method thereof, belonging to the technical field of safety monitoring application, and comprising a personnel information input module, an environment information acquisition module, a geo-fence model construction module, a test optimization module, a user position acquisition module, a geo-fence feedback module and an alarm module, wherein the environment information acquisition module is respectively in communication connection with the personnel information input module and the geo-fence model construction module; the system can classify and count the number of school personnel, is convenient for the staff to check whether data is missing or not, improves the working efficiency of the staff, is convenient for the system to effectively manage the college staff, improves the data transmission speed, improves the management quality of the school to students, can improve the judgment accuracy of the system, saves the time for the staff to maintain and saves manpower.

title_en: Antenna virtual simulation experiment platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electronic information, and discloses an antenna virtual simulation experiment platform which comprises an instrument library, a scene simulation module, a virtual interaction module, a data storage and processing module, a function and drawing module and an assessment and scoring module, wherein the instrument library comprises experiment instruments, experiment antennas and other experiment equipment, the data storage and processing module comprises global data storage and field intensity calculation, and the function and drawing module comprises normal antenna directivity diagrams and axial antenna directivity diagrams drawn under a rectangular coordinate system and a polar coordinate system; the virtual simulation test platform can reduce the investment of colleges and universities on expensive test equipment, is not bound by an experimental field during experiments, and can enable students to be in a first-person immersion experience state like games through the virtual simulation test platform in the teaching process, so that the students can be better taught, and the students can be better familiar with the steps of antenna parameter measurement.

title_en: Processing cooperative lane changing method and system based on vehicle-to-vehicle communication
abstract_en: The invention discloses a processing cooperative lane changing method based on vehicle-to-vehicle communication, which comprises the following steps: exchanging basic data between the vehicle and adjacent vehicles within a certain range in real time; synchronizing data of different vehicles; calculating a relative azimuth angle with an adjacent vehicle under a vehicle coordinate system according to the synchronized data; when a vehicle steering lamp is turned on or the steering wheel angle is larger than 10 degrees, whether a vehicle which is within a certain range of a relative azimuth angle, has a distance which is smaller than the width of a lane and is closest to the vehicle along the lane direction exists or not is judged, if yes, whether the vehicle collides or not is judged according to the speed and the acceleration of the two vehicles, if not, whether the vehicle which has a relative azimuth angle which is within a smaller range, has a distance which is smaller than the width of the lane and is closest to the vehicle A along the lane direction exists or not is judged, if yes, whether the vehicle collides or not is judged according to the speed and the acceleration of the two vehicles, and if so, which alarm information and alarm object are generated is judged through a game algorithm.

title_en: Two-dimensional autonomous positioning method, system, equipment and medium for indoor robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent robots, in particular to a two-dimensional autonomous positioning method, a two-dimensional autonomous positioning system, two-dimensional autonomous positioning equipment and two-dimensional autonomous positioning media of an indoor robot based on gray sensors and grid lines. Detecting whether the robot is inclined in position or not through position correction; high-precision position stopping of the robot is realized by utilizing line passing positioning; the invention can realize autonomous positioning of the robot by using a simple positioning device and a processor, has simple control logic and extremely low occupied resources, greatly reduces hardware cost and improves positioning efficiency; compared with the prior art, the positioning method provided by the invention does not occupy extra space, is not influenced by indoor light and obstacles, and has strong anti-interference capability and wide application range.

title_en: Test tube cleaning instrument control circuit that disinfects
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of medical treatment, in particular to a control circuit of a test tube sterilization and cleaning instrument. The technical problem of the invention is as follows: the control circuit of the test tube sterilization cleaning instrument can realize automatic cleaning and sterilization. The utility model provides a test tube sterilization cleaning instrument control circuit, is including first switch, power supply unit, first steady state trigger circuit, second steady state trigger circuit, third steady state trigger circuit, fourth steady state trigger circuit, first switch output is connected with the input of first steady state trigger circuit, second steady state trigger circuit, third steady state trigger circuit and fourth steady state trigger circuit respectively, the output and the first output of first steady state trigger circuit and indicating circuit input are connected. The equipment can be opened or closed through the first switch, and time and labor are saved.

title_en: Urban traffic travel demand total quantity prediction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for predicting the total demand of urban traffic trips, which comprises the following steps: collecting relevant data of urban traffic travel demands; constructing a traffic system co-evolution model; calibrating parameters in the traffic system co-evolution model by using the acquired data; and substituting the calibrated parameters into the traffic system co-evolution model to predict the total quantity of the urban traffic travel demands. The invention is suitable for cities with any structural characteristics, and provides basis and support for urban traffic planning, traffic development policy making and traffic network design.

title_en: Rapid detection and early warning system and method for highway accidents
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid detection and early warning system and a rapid detection and early warning method for highway accidents, wherein the detection system comprises an upper computer and a plurality of short-time traffic flow acquisition devices which are arranged at intervals along a highway; the short-time traffic flow acquisition device is used for acquiring short-time traffic flow data corresponding to the detection points and wirelessly transmitting the short-time traffic flow data to the upper computer according to a preset time interval; the upper computer takes a preset continuous number short-time traffic flow acquisition device as an identification unit, divides the detection road section into a plurality of detection sections, and judges whether an accident congestion event occurs according to the change state of short-time traffic flow data acquired by each short-time traffic flow acquisition device in each detection section. The system can rapidly detect and early warn accidents in 24 hours, is not limited by conditions such as weather, illumination, power supply, high-speed flow and the like, has very low price of front-end equipment such as detection and early warning and the like, and is suitable for large-scale installation.

title_en: Traffic information acquisition device capable of protecting camera
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of traffic information acquisition, in particular to a traffic information acquisition device capable of protecting a camera, which can be used for conveniently adjusting the height and the angle, improving the information acquisition range and ensuring the adaptability of information acquisition.

title_en: Intelligence milk tea preparation equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses intelligent milk tea preparation equipment which comprises a mouth-shaped equipment base, wherein an automatic cup taking machine, an automatic cup sealing machine, an ice making machine, an automatic syrup making machine, an automatic conveyor, an automatic pulp adding machine, a quantitative tea concentration machine, a fruit juice machine and an automatic powder adding machine are arranged on the equipment base along the side edge of the equipment base, a robot base is arranged in the middle of the mouth-shaped equipment base, a mechanical arm used for grabbing and transferring milk tea cups is arranged on the robot base, an industrial computer is arranged on the equipment base, and the mechanical arm is used for transferring milk tea cups among the automatic cup taking machine, the ice making machine, the automatic syrup making machine, the automatic pulp making machine, the quantitative tea concentration machine, the fruit juice machine, the automatic powder adding machine, the automatic cup sealing machine and the automatic conveyor according to the control of the industrial computer. The invention can automatically prepare milk tea with different tastes according to drinking requirements, and saves a large amount of labor force.

title_en: Starting circuit, band-gap reference circuit and communication terminal
abstract_en: Provided are a start-up circuit, a bandgap reference circuit and a communication terminal. The start-up circuit includes: a first switch connected between the operating voltage terminal and the first connection node and configured to perform a switching operation based on a turn-off signal; a second switch connected between the first connection node and ground and configured to perform a switching operation based on a bandgap voltage; a logic circuit performing a logical and operation on a first voltage of the first connection node and an enable signal to generate a switching voltage; and a third switch connected between an output node and ground and configured to perform a switching operation based on the switching voltage, wherein the output node outputs a start-up voltage.

title_en: Forest fire prevention smoke detection method and system based on monitoring camera
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of environmental protection, and particularly relates to a forest fire prevention smoke detection method and system. The forest fire prevention smoke detection method based on the monitoring camera comprises the following steps: acquiring a video image as a reference image, and acquiring another video image as a current image after a preset time interval; carrying out phase subtraction on the current image and the reference image, and carrying out image preprocessing to obtain a target image; and carrying out classification prediction on the target image through a preset neural network model to obtain a smoke recognition result. According to the invention, the camera does not need to be replaced, and the forest fire prevention smoke identification function can be realized only by directly butting the video stream data of the network monitoring camera with one server.

title_en: Bend early warning device
abstract_en: The invention provides a curve early warning device, which comprises: a fixing assembly; the first warning board is arranged on the fixing component and is rotatably connected with the fixing component; the second warning board is arranged on the fixed component and is rotatably connected with the fixed component. The embodiment of the invention enables the drivers of the passing vehicles to be converted from passive prompt into active prompt, thereby improving the safety.

title_en: Control system of intelligent shower and intelligent shower
abstract_en: The invention discloses a control system of an intelligent shower and the intelligent shower, wherein the control system comprises at least one magnetic control knob which is independent of a panel and can be rotated and/or pressed and a circuit board arranged below the panel. The magnetic control knob can be taken down from the panel, so that the unevenness of the surface of the panel is avoided, and the panel is easy to clean; the magnetic control knob and the circuit board are directly and completely separated by the panel, the waterproof performance is good, and a special waterproof process is not needed; the magnetic control knobs can be rotated and/or pressed, so that at least two functional items can be realized by one magnetic control knob, and on the basis of realizing the same number of functional items, the number of the magnetic control knobs can be less than that of the touch keys, so that the size of the panel can be smaller, and the occupied space of the panel is reduced.

title_en: Arteriovenous puncture needle anti-drop alarm device for hemodialysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-drop alarm device for an arteriovenous puncture needle for hemodialysis, which belongs to the technical field of medical appliances, wherein a color sensor can constantly detect the color in a tail end pipeline of the arteriovenous puncture needle, if the color in the tail end pipeline of the arteriovenous puncture needle is red, the artery puncture needle does not drop, if the tail end pipeline of the arteriovenous puncture needle is transparent, the artery puncture needle drops, a color sensor can make an artery alarm give an alarm to play a role of reminding, if a vein puncture needle drops, the impact force of an inlet blood vessel on a pressure sensing membrane is increased, the pressure sensing membrane generates deformation to extrude aqueous solution to enter a support frame to dissolve a dissolving plate, a blocking pressure lever can block the outlet blood vessel through the function of an energy supply pressure spring, the condition that the blood volume is lost when the vein puncture needle drops is effectively avoided, and simultaneously, a magnet attracts an iron plate to make the contact rod trigger a trigger switch in the process of blocking the outlet blood vessel, the vein alarm can send out an alarm for reminding.

title_en: Servo control system and method based on double encoder feedback and electric equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a servo control system and method based on double encoder feedback and electric equipment, wherein the servo control system comprises: the motor, the controller of motor operating condition is controlled through the driver, gather the position information and the speed information feedback of motor and give the first encoder and the second encoder of controller, the precision of first encoder is higher than the second encoder, the communication rate of second encoder is higher than first encoder, first encoder and second encoder obtain the position information and the speed information of motor simultaneously, the speed information of first encoder feedback is used for the operation of speed ring Ki, the speed information of second encoder feedback is used for the operation of speed ring Kp, the position information of one of them feedback of controller selection first encoder and second encoder.
