The invention simultaneously acts the feedback information of the two encoders on the speed ring and the position ring, effectively improves the influence speed of the servo system, eliminates static errors and improves the stability of the system.

title_en: Digital low dropout voltage regulator and method for operating a digital low dropout voltage regulator
abstract_en: Embodiments of a digital Low Dropout (LDO) regulator and a method for operating a digital LDO regulator are described. In one embodiment, a digital LDO regulator includes: a clamping circuit configured to generate a clamping voltage in response to an input voltage of the digital LDO regulator; a gate driver circuit configured to generate a driving voltage in response to the input voltage and the clamp voltage; and at least one transistor device configured to generate an output voltage in response to the input voltage and the drive voltage. Other embodiments are also described.

title_en: Linear voltage-stabilizing power supply
abstract_en: The application discloses linear regulated power supply, linear regulated power supply includes: the input unit is used for inhibiting electromagnetic noise of alternating current input by a power grid and clutter signals with specific frequency; the transformer is electrically connected with the input unit and used for isolating and reducing the alternating current; the rectification filter unit is electrically connected with the transformer and is used for rectifying and filtering the alternating current subjected to isolation and depressurization to output a direct-current positive voltage and a direct-current negative voltage; the output unit is electrically connected to the rectifying and filtering unit and is used for outputting a positive voltage and a negative voltage which can be dynamically adjusted according to the direct-current positive voltage and the direct-current negative voltage, the output voltage ripple is low and the structure is simple, and the requirement of a precise instrument on high-precision voltage is met.

title_en: Spacecraft extravehicular operation simulation experience device
abstract_en: The invention provides a spacecraft extra-cabin operation simulation experience device which comprises a supporting assembly component, a first deflection component, a first driving component, a second deflection component, a second driving component, a third deflection component, a third driving component and a riding positioning component.

title_en: Transport vehicle system, transport vehicle, and control method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a transport vehicle system, a transport vehicle, and a control method. The self-position estimation is performed with high accuracy while reducing the influence of other obstacles and the like. A transport vehicle system (100) is provided with a plurality of transport vehicles (1 a-1 e) and a storage unit (141). Each of the plurality of transport vehicles (1 a-1 e) has a laser distance measuring sensor (13), an on-vehicle controller (14), and a communication unit (145). The storage unit (141) stores an environment map (M1). The onboard controller (14) is provided with a self-position estimation unit (143) and a first peripheral information generation unit (146). The self-position estimation unit (143) estimates the self-position of the self-transport vehicle (1a) on the basis of the peripheral information (M2) of the self-transport vehicle (1a), the position information of the self-transport vehicle (1a) currently grasped, and the environment map (M1). When the supplementary information (AI) is obtained by the communication unit (145) of the local transport vehicle (1a), the first peripheral information generation unit (146) adds the supplementary information (AI) to the Sensor Information (SI) of the local transport vehicle (1a) and generates peripheral information (M2) of the local transport vehicle (1 a).

title_en: Data playback method, electronic device and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a data playback method, electronic equipment and a medium, and relates to the field of automatic driving. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring data in real time in an actual scene, storing the acquired data and processed data to be played back in a shared memory of an acquisition end in real time, and covering historical data with new data in the shared memory; reading the latest stored data when monitoring that the acquisition end shared memory stores new data, and writing the read data into a target file according to a time sequence; and storing the data stored in the target file into a shared memory of a playback end according to the time sequence. The embodiment can improve the real-time performance, stability and simplicity of the playback system.

title_en: Parking space management method, equipment and system
abstract_en: The application discloses a parking space management method, equipment and a system, and relates to the technical field of parking space supervision. The parking space management equipment can add the target warning information of the target parking space occupied by the target vehicle into the cache queue when the driving condition is met (namely, the parking space occupation occurs), so that the target warning information can be displayed after the target duration. When the parking space management equipment determines that the driving-out condition is met within the target duration, the target warning information can be deleted from the cache queue, so that the target warning information is prevented from being displayed. Therefore, when the vehicle passes through the parking space and does not enter the parking space, the parking space management equipment adds the warning information into the cache queue and deletes the warning information, the warning information cannot be displayed, and the false warning is effectively prevented.

title_en: Method for determining whether a vehicle control command prevents future vehicle safe maneuvers
abstract_en: A method is provided for determining whether a vehicle control command for controlling a vehicle (1) associated with a current vehicle state impedes future Situational Avoidance Maneuvers (SAM) of the vehicle. The method comprises the following steps: one or more secure sets are obtained, where each secure set represents a range of vehicle states in which a future SAM can be initialized with a prospect of success. The method further comprises the following steps: obtaining a current vehicle state and a control command; and predicting a future vehicle state based on the current vehicle state and the control command. The method comprises the following steps: the predicted future vehicle state is compared to the one or more safety sets, and if the predicted future vehicle state is not included in any of the one or more safety sets, it is determined that the control command prevents the future SAM.

title_en: Security container for storing packages, method and system for operating a security container
abstract_en: A secure container for storing packages, a method and a system for operating a secure container. The safety container includes: a lock, said lock locking said container; a sensor that senses that the secure container is unlocked; a transceiver in communication with a telecommunications network; a controller configured to transmit an alert to a network device via the telecommunications network by means of the transceiver in response to the sensor sensing that the secure container is unlocked.

title_en: Linkage control system and method for upper and lower limb rehabilitation equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of control of upper and lower limb rehabilitation equipment, in particular to a linkage control system and method of the upper and lower limb rehabilitation equipment. The system comprises a linkage controller, wherein the linkage controller is used for outputting a restoring moment and superposing the restoring moment on an upper limb motor and a lower limb motor. The invention has the beneficial effects that: according to the invention, the angle difference and the angular speed difference of the upper and lower limbs are obtained and combined with the linkage controller to output the restoring torque to be superposed on the upper limb motor and the lower limb motor, when the upper limb angle and the lower limb angle generate position deviation, the upper and lower limbs can be subjected to the restoring torque with equal magnitude and opposite directions to maintain the upper and lower limbs at the same angle position, and then the unequal distribution of the restoring torque of the upper and lower limbs is completed through the torque distributor, so that the mutual communication and adjustability of stress are realized, and the problem that the existing upper and lower limb rehabilitation equipment does not have the functions of upper and lower limb torque position binding and torque distribution is solved.

title_en: Time constant adjusting method based on changing number of turns of stator winding and rotor end structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a time constant adjusting method based on changing the number of turns of a stator winding and a rotor end structure, which solves the problem of how to conveniently adjust the test time constant of a simulation motor in a simulation test of a large-scale generator. Manufacturing a stator winding of the simulation test simulation generator into a structure form with a plurality of parallel outgoing lines; a magnetic permeability supporting ring (3) is arranged between a non-driving end rotating shaft end (1) of a simulated generator for the test and an excitation winding end (2) of a rotor of the simulated generator for the test, a magnetic permeability protecting ring (5) of the excitation winding end of the rotor is arranged outside the excitation winding end (2) of the simulated generator for the test and the excitation winding end (3), and a magnetic permeability protruding block (4) is arranged on the magnetic permeability supporting ring (3) on the inner side of the excitation winding end (2) of the simulated generator for the test to form a closed magnetic permeability annular loop; the accurate guidance of the simulation test on the designed large-scale generator is realized.

title_en: System and method for adjusting physical parameters of a real-time system of a turbomachine according to physical parameter settings
abstract_en: The invention discloses a regulation system (REG) for regulating a physical parameter (y) of a real-time system F (p) of a turbomachine according to a physical parameter set value (yc), comprising a system (OPTK) for optimizing said parameterized gain K during regulation, the optimization system (OPTK) comprising a stability correction module (2) for determining a first gain constant K1 having a positive value, a module (3) for determining a response time of a second gain constant K2, the stability correction module (2) being configured to suppress said response time correction module (3) when an instability (TopIS) is detected during regulation of said physical parameter (y), a determination module (4) for determining said parameterized gain K as a function of said first gain component K1 and said second gain component K previously determined.

title_en: Retarder testing method for simulating whole vehicle message environment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to a retarder test method, and aims to solve the technical problems that when a retarder RCU program is tested before being released, the traditional simulation test method is time-consuming and labor-consuming in manual message and data editing and sending and easy to make mistakes, the sending switching force of a plurality of circulating messages is not central, a plurality of application programs are developed and written into a plurality of controllers for simulation, the operation is complex, flexible change is impossible, and maintenance is difficult, and the retarder test method for simulating the whole vehicle message environment is provided: the method comprises the steps of connecting a controller and an upper computer of a retarder through a CAN, setting initial states of virtual control modules corresponding to all equipment of the whole vehicle through the upper computer, enabling the virtual control modules to send messages corresponding to the initial states of the virtual control modules to the retarder controller, adjusting the states of the virtual control modules corresponding to the states of all the equipment of the whole vehicle according to test purposes, responding to the retarder controller, changing the states, sending the messages to a CAN bus, and judging programs in the controller of the retarder.

title_en: Multi-user vehicle diagnosis method, device, terminal equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application is applicable to the technical field of vehicle diagnosis, and provides a multi-user vehicle diagnosis method, which comprises the following steps: when a first diagnosis request of a first user for a target vehicle is received, obtaining the current time, judging whether a second diagnosis request of a second user for the target vehicle is received within a preset time period with the current time as a starting point, if so, respectively obtaining the distance between first diagnosis equipment associated with the first user and the distance between second diagnosis equipment associated with the second user and the target vehicle, selecting the first diagnosis equipment or the second diagnosis equipment corresponding to the minimum distance as main target diagnosis equipment, and opening a diagnosis authority to the main target diagnosis equipment so that the main target diagnosis equipment diagnoses the target vehicle and returns a diagnosis result. The method and the device have the advantages that the monitoring and the diagnosis of the same trolley are realized for a plurality of users, so that the data sharing of the vehicle is realized, the vehicle diagnosis efficiency is improved, the real-time performance of the diagnosis result is obtained, and the life and property safety of the users is ensured.

title_en: Modeling and control method for continuous freeze-drying process of single-hydrate snopril powder aerosol
abstract_en: The invention discloses a modeling and control method for a continuous freeze-drying process of a single-hydrate snopril powder spray, which comprises the following steps: establishing a modeling setting condition; establishing a temperature model and a pressure model of a control system under a set condition; acquiring a state equation of the system according to the temperature model, the pressure model and the state space variable; inputting the control quantity into a state equation to obtain a state space model; and (5) completing modeling of the powder drying process according to the state space model. The invention can realize gentle temperature control and sensitive control of wind pressure fluctuation. The object model and the control system designed by the invention can be used for continuous drying equipment, have the advantages of multiple controlled variables, strong anti-interference capability, convenient transplantation and the like, are favorable for verification by GMPs, and provide conditions for further industrialization of the medicine.

title_en: Digital and intelligent landscaping and maintenance integrated management system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital and intelligent garden greening maintenance comprehensive management system, which comprises a front-end data acquisition module, a terminal monitoring platform module, an intelligent automation module, an interaction module and a system connection module, wherein the front-end data acquisition module is used for acquiring data of a garden greening maintenance system; the front end data acquisition module comprises a 5G camera acquisition module, a soil monitor acquisition module and a small meteorological station acquisition module, and the front end data acquisition module is connected with the terminal monitoring platform module through a 5G signal. This digital afforestation maintenance integrated management system has characteristics such as intelligent, visual, the precaution, the economy, it is convenient, combine automatic control, expert system, the sensor, wireless communication technique in an organic whole, with the help of internet of things, GIS geographic information technique and image recognition technology carry out reform and innovation to traditional maintenance mode, accomplish to carry out the digitization to afforestation, intelligent scientific maintenance management, and great workman's that alleviates intensity of labour, improve work efficiency, reduce the maintenance cost.

title_en: Interface multiplexing device and control method of interface multiplexing device
abstract_en: The invention discloses interface multiplexing equipment and a control method thereof, wherein the equipment comprises a first controller, the first controller is provided with at least two logic control modules, and when the first controller receives a control instruction, a target logic control module is selected to send out a logic control signal; the driver comprises at least two driving modules, receives the logic control signal and generates a control signal by using the target driving module; the target driving module is a driving module corresponding to the logic control signal; and a multiplexing interface for receiving the control signal and transmitting the control signal to the target device. According to the invention, by arranging the first controller capable of selecting different logic control modules and the driver capable of selecting different driving modules, the same interface can be connected with and control different medical instruments, the interface reusability for driving and controlling different medical instruments is improved, and the control requirement is met on the premise of limiting the number of interfaces.

title_en: Rail transit signal simulation training system
abstract_en: The invention provides a rail transit signal simulation training system, which comprises an operation module, a simulation control system and a display module; the operation module is used for receiving train operation instructions input by a user; under the linkage scene, the simulation control system is used for carrying out linkage simulation based on the train operation instruction and the equipment data of the real train control equipment to generate linkage scene information; the display module is used for displaying the linkage scene information. According to the system provided by the invention, linkage simulation is carried out by the simulation control system based on the train operation instruction input by the user and the equipment data of the real train control equipment in the running process of the train driven by the trained personnel, linkage scene information is generated, and then the display module displays the linkage scene information, so that realistic and real-time operation scene display is provided for the user, the driving immersion of the trained personnel is visually increased, the training effect of the signal system is improved, and the synchronization with the real signal system is ensured.

title_en: Emergency cutting device of liquid cargo system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency cutting device of a liquid cargo system, which comprises a ship end and a shore station end, wherein a main control box on the ship end and the shore station end comprises an AMS comprehensive monitoring alarm system, a fog whistle and siren system, a watertight explosion-proof audible and visual alarm, a 5-pinhole watertight explosion-proof junction box, equipment for sensing fire to start ESD and a pressure detection plate, when the ship is on the shore, the ship end and the shore station end are respectively inserted into the 5-pinhole watertight explosion-proof junction boxes on the ship end and the shore station end through 5-pinhole plugs on the two ends of a portable electric reel cable, so that the ship end and the shore station end liquid cargo system are connected and controlled; the emergency cutting device has the beneficial effects that the emergency cutting device can quickly and effectively cut off a dangerous source, realize a remote control function and an audible and visual alarm function, prevent safety accidents, and effectively ensure the lives of workers at the ship end and the shore station end and the safety of related equipment at the ship end and the shore station end.

title_en: Intelligent interlocking control warning system of mobile power supply system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent interlocking control warning system of a mobile power supply system, which comprises: a suspended track; the top end of the moving trolley is provided with a plurality of wheels, and the wheels are connected with the suspended track in a sliding fit manner; the intelligent control box is arranged on the bottom surface of the movable trolley; one end of the first vehicle receiving cable is connected with the output end of the intelligent control box, and the other end of the first vehicle receiving cable is connected with the upper connector; one end of the second vehicle receiving cable is connected with a locomotive plug, a control switch is mounted on the locomotive plug, and the other end of the second vehicle receiving cable is connected with the lower connecting body; the upper connector and the lower connector are connected in an inserted mode, and a tension release spring is abutted between the upper connector and the lower connector. The invention is provided with the anti-pulling device, and the cable is automatically disconnected under the condition of being pulled; the overcurrent protection device is provided, so that the current overload danger is reduced; can be operated proximally.

title_en: Service authentication method and system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a service authentication method and a system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring charging information M sent by a vehicle information processing unit of a certain vehicle through a roadside information processing unit; extracting a data summary H of the charging information M by using a HASH function HASH, and encrypting the M information by using a symmetric key to obtain a ciphertext C; encrypting the data abstract H and the symmetric key by using a private key of a roadside information processing unit to obtain a digital signature; and after the ciphertext C and the digital signature are sent to an issuer authentication server of the IC card for authentication, the vehicle is charged and deducted for the toll. The technical scheme has the following beneficial effects: because the technical means of asymmetric secondary encryption is adopted, the authentication safety of the road side information processing unit and the vehicle information processing unit in the electronic toll collection system is greatly improved.

title_en: Terminal capable of supervising arrival and circle patrol of circle patrol personnel in farm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a terminal capable of supervising arrival and circle patrol of a circle patrol worker in a farm, which comprises a circle patrol terminal in the farm, wherein the circle patrol terminal in the farm comprises a DC-DC power supply, a CPU module, a storage module, a WIFI module, a state indicator lamp and a function key, the DC-DC power supply is electrically connected with the CPU module, and the storage module and the CPU module are electrically connected through an I 2 The C interface links to each other, the WIFI module passes through SPI interface electrical property with the CPU module and links to each other, status indicator lamp passes through the IO interface with the CPU module and links to each other, the function button passes through the IO interface with the CPU module and links to each other, under the control of CPU module, sniff the mode in the WIFI module and upload mode switching work, sniff the cell-phone that the WIFI module gathered in the set range under the mode, patrol circle terminal connection to colony house WIFI under the upload mode to effectually patrol the circle to patrol the circle personnel, prevent that it monitors to patrol the circleAnd (5) stopping the circle patrol of the circle patrol clerk.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle automatic capture technology and automatic capture system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic capture technology and an automatic capture system of an unmanned aerial vehicle, which specifically comprise the following steps: firstly, moving at a fixed point; step two, object capture; step three, interference braking; step four, capturing and demonstrating; step five, return voyage judgment; step six, capturing and archiving; the invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle capture. This unmanned aerial vehicle automatic acquisition technique and automatic acquisition system, the division sign in space has been realized, still for simulating the unmanned aerial vehicle movement track better provides convenient condition, the simulation three-dimensional coordinate scene of the scope of leading is found, and with radar scanning and visual detection complex mode, rapid discovery and location target unmanned aerial vehicle's position, through the interference distance and the judgement of catching the distance, orderly catch target unmanned aerial vehicle, for follow-up catching process route simulation provides data material, the optimization condition of automatic seizure is provided for target unmanned aerial vehicle's seizure, and then improve target unmanned aerial vehicle automatic acquisition's success rate.

title_en: Automatic operation experiment system of unloading torch based on crude oil exploitation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic operation experiment system of a venting torch based on crude oil exploitation, which relates to the technical field of operation systems and comprises a pipeline assembly, wherein the pipeline assembly comprises a through valve body and an explosion-proof flange, the top of the explosion-proof flange is respectively and sequentially provided with an air inlet control system, an installation shell and a pressure control system, the air inlet control system comprises a sealing cylinder, an air inlet pipe, a connecting column, a cam, a torsional spring rivet, an air inlet adjusting mechanism and a port sheet, the bottom part of the sealing cylinder is embedded into the through valve body and is connected with the through valve body through the explosion-proof flange, the connecting column is arranged at the four corners of the sealing cylinder, the installation shell is connected with the explosion-proof flange through the connecting column, the combustion ratio can be indirectly calculated by repeatedly and automatically controlling the flux of associated gas, the accuracy of venting and air inlet experiment data is effectively ensured, and further the harmful associated gas is completely combusted in practical exploitation, and the combustion efficiency can be effectively improved.

title_en: Intelligent driving lighting lamp function verification method
abstract_en: In order to solve the problems of time and labor waste, inaccurate verification data, high cost and the like in the intelligent driving lighting lamp function verification method in the prior art, the invention provides an intelligent driving lighting lamp function verification method which comprises the steps of verifying the control effect of at least one external factor point value of various types of corresponding relations by adopting real vehicle driving; modifying message data related to external factors received by a lamp controller by adopting data analysis software Matlab; and verifying the modified message data by adopting a simulation test bench. The intelligent driving lighting lamp function verification method has the beneficial technical effects that based on the real vehicle driving verification, the function verification of different external factor point values in the same corresponding relation is realized by modifying the data of the external factor point values; and the projection screen is adopted to directly observe the illumination response of the illuminating lamp, so that not only is a great deal of manpower and material resources saved, but also the intuitiveness and accuracy of observation are effectively improved.

title_en: Many function combination formula simulation circulation laboratory bench
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional combined simulated circulation experiment table, which belongs to the field of biomedicine and comprises a heart model containing left and right ventricles and atria, a body containing vascular compliance and resistance, a pulmonary circulation model, a ventricular beating model and an experiment table base. The multifunctional simulated circulation experiment table can effectively solve the problems that the traditional simulated circulation experiment table is single in purpose and incapable of quantitatively controlling the diastole and contraction degree of ventricles by designing each model, considers the problem of a heart frank-starling mechanism, and can also realize the hemodynamics experiments of single heart and double heart auxiliary devices and a total artificial heart under different physiological conditions and provide a test platform for heart valves, ECMO and blood pumps of artificial heart-lung machine systems.

title_en: Detection method, device, equipment, system and storage medium of game marker
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to the technical field of computer vision, in particular to a method, a device, equipment, a system and a storage medium for detecting a game marker. A method of detecting a game identifier, comprising: detecting first position information of a game identifier of a game area and second position information of an operation object of the game identifier based on an acquired video stream of a game in the game area; and determining that the game identifier is in an operation completion state in response to determining that the positional relationship between the game identifier and the operation object is changed from overlapping to separating from each other based on the first position information and the second position information. The detection method disclosed by the embodiment of the invention reduces the interference of movement or shielding on the identification of the game marker, and is beneficial to improving the accuracy of a downstream identification task.

title_en: Detection and waste discharge system in production of optical cable pay-off reel brake device and implementation method
abstract_en: The application discloses a detection and waste discharge system in production of an optical cable pay-off reel brake device, which comprises a PLC module, a driving module and a relay control module; the PLC module comprises a PLC U1, and the model number of the PLC U1 is FX3U-32 MT. Has the following advantages: adopt laser displacement ware and PLC to combine the round distance of beating of gathering brake equipment to this comes automatic judgement brake equipment whether qualified, and gets rid of unqualified brake equipment is automatic, labour saving and time saving, efficient.

title_en: Access control dynamic authorization system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of access control authority management and control, and discloses an access control dynamic authorization system and a method, wherein the method matches identification information to be identified based on an identity database, if the matching is successful, an access control authority instruction is generated, a work ticket number input by an entering person in advance is acquired, a corresponding reference work ticket is matched in a preset work ticket database through the work ticket number, the work ticket information contained in the reference work ticket is identified, the work ticket information comprises task execution time and task execution state, and if the task execution state is the execution state and the acquisition time meets the task execution time, an access control release instruction is generated to inform an entrance controller to release the entering person; if the acquisition time does not meet the task execution time or the task execution state is not the execution state, an entrance guard non-release instruction is generated, and a door controller is informed not to release the personnel entering the station, so that the flexibility and the passing efficiency of the entrance guard passing authority are improved.

title_en: Cash tracking method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a cash tracking method and a cash tracking device, which can be applied to the field of Internet of things or the field of finance. Under the condition that the current state of the cash to be checked is consistent with the circulation state in the system, the circulation state of the cash to be checked in the system is updated to be the target state of the cash to be checked, effective tracking of the cash is achieved, and under the condition that the current state of the cash to be checked is inconsistent with the circulation state in the system, the abnormal state of the cash to be checked is prompted, so that a worker can timely find and handle the abnormal state, and unnecessary disputes are avoided.

title_en: Substrate scanning and mapping device, scanning and mapping method thereof and scanning and mapping teaching method
abstract_en: A substrate scanning and mapping device (4) scans and maps a substrate (10) in a container that contains a plurality of substrates (10) arranged in a predetermined arrangement direction. The substrate scanning and mapping device (4) is provided with: a sensor (16) that detects the state of the substrate (10); an operator (14) that moves the sensor (16); and a control device (18) that controls the operator (14) to move the sensor (16) along the scan mapping path. The control device (18) sets a first scan map position and a second scan map position that are different in position in the arrangement direction of the substrates (10), and sets a scan map path using the first scan map position and the second scan map position.

title_en: Phototropism experimental box
abstract_en: The invention discloses a phototropism experiment box which comprises an experiment box main body, wherein the experiment box main body comprises a wooden box and a box cover, the wooden box and the box cover are correspondingly arranged, the wooden box also comprises a power supply module, a digital temperature controller is arranged on the surface of one side of the wooden box, an LED lamp is arranged on the surface of the experiment box main body, a through hole is formed in the inner side of the LED lamp, the LED lamp is arranged on the outer surface of the wooden box or the box cover, light absorption cloth is arranged on the inner wall of the wooden box, a planting placing box and a beaker are arranged on one side in the wooden box, a heater is arranged at the bottom end in the beaker, and purified water is placed on the inner side of the beaker. The whole structure provided by the invention has high safety factor, the USB interface and the socket with the safety door are adopted to form the power supply control unit, the damage caused by electric power can be limited to the maximum extent, a stable constant temperature system is set on the power supply control unit, and temperature detection is arranged to ensure the safety of the internal structure.

title_en: Control method of food processing machine
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a control method of a food processor, which comprises the following steps: a cup body and a heating device; the bottom of the cup body is provided with a temperature sensor; the method comprises the following steps: after the pulping function is started, judging whether materials exist in the cup body according to the bottom temperature of the cup body; stopping heating when the cup body is judged to be free of materials, and sending a material-free prompt; when the material is judged to be in the cup body, the heating temperature difference delta T1 is obtained according to the bottom temperature of the cup body and the preset first lowest water level line  Mixing of  The size relationship of the cup body determines whether to judge the material once or more times so as to determine whether the material amount in the cup body meets the pulping requirement. Through the scheme of the embodiment, the effective detection of the existence of materials is realized, so that anhydrous dry burning is avoided, the cost is reduced, the user experience is improved, and the reliability and the safety of the machine are improved.

title_en: Switch control device and method, electronic device, and storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a switch control device and method, an electronic device, and a storage medium. The device includes: the communication module is used for receiving a first control signal for controlling the switch; the control module is connected with the communication module and used for generating a second control signal according to the first control signal; and the driving module is connected with the control module and used for driving the switch to execute the operation corresponding to the first control signal according to the second control signal sent by the control module. Through the device, the user experience of using the switch can be improved.

title_en: Working method of automatic sorting and vibration swing type collecting device for large amount of paper money
abstract_en: The invention discloses a working method of a large-amount paper money automatic sorting and vibrating swing type collecting device. The invention solves the problems that the manual processing efficiency is low, and the current devices such as a sorter, a cash counter and a binding machine can not directly process disordered paper money; the regular rotation of the note scattering plate can lead the stacked paper money to be stirred and loosened, and can greatly accelerate the speed of the paper money entering the channel due to the vibration and the impact.

title_en: Vehicle speed testing method and device based on optics
abstract_en: A vehicle speed testing method and device based on optics belongs to the field of automobile parameter testing. The vehicle speed testing method and device comprises black-and-white color mark bands with different lengths Lx (x is 0 or 1) and used for reflecting and forming light intensity signals with larger difference, a photoelectric sensor used for generating stable light and sensing light intensity changes of the light returned by the mark bands, judging a black-and-white state of the light intensity signals in a digital level signal mode, a signal acquisition processor used for acquiring a change process of the digital signals, recording change moments, calculating and obtaining a vehicle speed according to the length corresponding to the mark bands and the change time difference of the digital signals, and judging the change direction of the vehicle speed according to the estimated trend of the length and the speed of the corresponding color mark bands.

title_en: Intelligent teaching model of three-cavity two-capsule tube
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent teaching model of a three-cavity two-sac tube, which belongs to the technical field of medical teaching, and comprises a cleaning module and an intelligent teaching module, wherein the cleaning module is composed of a cleaning bin and a drying device, the intelligent teaching module comprises an auxiliary device, a three-cavity two-sac tube model, a simulation nasal cavity and a simulation human body, the cleaning bin is arranged in the middle part of the inner part of a base, and the drying device is an electric heating drying device. According to the invention, the deep position information of the tube of the three-cavity two-bag is determined by the laser transmitter-receiver, the gas flow sensor in the air bag senses the gas capacity information, the information is transmitted to the single chip microcomputer for analysis and control, when the operation is wrong, the control operation screen displays the reason of the mistake, and intelligent teaching is realized; the liquid paraffin wiped on the upper part of the three-cavity two-sac tube is conveniently cleaned through the cleaning and drying device, so that the service life of the three-cavity two-sac tube is prolonged; the three-cavity two-balloon catheter teaching model and the auxiliary device are modularly and intensively arranged, so that convenient teaching is realized.

title_en: Method for at least automatically guiding a motor vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for guiding a motor vehicle (401) at least partially automatically, comprising the following steps: -receiving (101) an ambient signal representing a first region (413) of the surroundings of the motor vehicle (401) sensed by means of an ambient sensing means (411) of the motor vehicle (401), -receiving (103) an information signal representing information about a second region (417) of the surroundings of the motor vehicle (401) sought outside the motor vehicle, -generating (105) and outputting (107) a control signal for controlling a lateral and/or longitudinal guidance of the motor vehicle (401) on the basis of the ambient signal and the information signal, in order to at least partially automatically guide the motor vehicle (401) on the basis of the first region (413) and the second region (417) of the surroundings of the motor vehicle. The invention relates to a device, a computer program and a machine-readable storage medium.

title_en: Cleaning robot positioning method and cleaning robot adopting same
abstract_en: The invention relates to a positioning method of a cleaning robot, which is characterized by comprising the following steps: step 1, obtaining a prior map of a ceiling of a room; step 2, in the actual cleaning process, the cleaning robot obtains the position of the current position in the room ceiling prior map through the room ceiling image shot by the current position: the method comprises the steps of taking a room ceiling image shot at the current position as a real-time image, taking the intersection point of two diagonal lines in the real-time image as a real-time position point, obtaining the boundary of a room ceiling in the real-time image, calculating the distance from the real-time position point to four straight lines in the boundary of the room ceiling in the real-time image, and then obtaining the specific position of the real-time position point in the prior map of the whole room ceiling according to the prior map of the room ceiling. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages that: the positioning accuracy of the cleaning robot can be improved, and errors caused by calculation of positioning points can be reduced.

title_en: Signal source traversal method based on Gaussian reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a signal source traversal method based on Gaussian reinforcement learning. Firstly discretizing a task environment, and determining the central position of each square in the discretized environment; then, according to the currently detected signal intensity information and the historically detected signal intensity information, adopting a Gaussian process method to predict the signal intensity information of the central position of each square in the area, and taking the signal intensity information as a corresponding reward function in reinforcement learning; calculating a state value function of each square according to the rewarding function, adopting a rolling optimization idea according to the state value function to obtain an optimal square sequence, and taking the first square as a target position of the next step of the quadrotor unmanned aerial vehicle; the predictive control method is developed, the quadrotor unmanned aerial vehicle can be controlled to reach the target position along a smooth track according to the target position, and finally the signal source traversing task is completed. The method adopted by the invention can effectively improve the traversing speed of the signal source and shorten the flight path.

title_en: Control method and device for movable platform, movable platform and storage medium
abstract_en: A control method and device for a movable platform, the movable platform and a storage medium. According to the embodiment of the application, the control rod amount for controlling the movable platform is obtained, and the control rod amount is converted into the control instruction of the movable platform according to the position of the movable platform and the position of the target object shot by the movable platform, and the control instruction can control the movable platform to move relative to the target object by taking the connecting line of the movable platform and the target object as a reference.

title_en: Supervision and control system for circuit board production based on data analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a supervision and control system for circuit board production based on data analysis, which relates to the technical field of circuit board production supervision and solves the technical problem that the prior art cannot monitor circuit boards before and after production, analyzes the circuit boards of the same model, judges the production efficiency of the circuit boards of the same model so as to analyze the difficulty level of real-time circuit board production, and classifies the difficulty level so as to improve the management and control efficiency of the real-time circuit boards; real data are selected through historical analysis, real-time production completion is facilitated to carry out fault prediction, the working efficiency of the circuit board production process is improved through multiple cycles, and the influence of circuit board faults on actual operation is reduced; the production environment of the circuit board to be produced in real time is analyzed and monitored, the influence of the environment on the circuit board is judged, the reduction of the production efficiency of the circuit board caused by abnormal environment is prevented, and the production qualified rate of the circuit board is improved.

title_en: Input device and input diagnosis method
abstract_en: The input device (10) is connected to the switch (20), and inputs the state of the switch (20) as a voltage corresponding to the state. The input device (10) comprises: an output circuit (120) that outputs a voltage selected from a 1 st voltage and a 2 nd voltage different from the 1 st voltage; an input circuit (150) which inputs the voltage output from the output circuit (120) via the switch (20) in the closed state and outputs an input signal (33) corresponding to the input voltage; a diagnosis unit (112) which diagnoses whether or not the input signal has changed when the voltage output from the output circuit (120) is switched to the 2 nd voltage; and a generation unit (113) that generates a state signal (34) indicating the state of the switch (20) on the basis of the input signal (33). The 2 nd voltage is a voltage different from a reference voltage input to the input circuit (150) when the switch (20) is in an open state.

title_en: Method and system for fight and defense of aircraft cluster
abstract_en: The invention relates to an aircraft cluster attack and defense countermeasure method and system. Acquiring cost parameters, determining the cost of each aircraft according to the cost parameters, constructing a kinetic equation of each aircraft, and calculating an expansion state of each aircraft under the current iteration number according to the decision state of each aircraft under the previous iteration number under the current iteration number; calculating a search strategy of the aircraft under the current iteration number according to the cost of the aircraft and the expansion state under the current iteration number; inputting a searching strategy of the aircraft under the current iteration number into a kinetic equation of the aircraft to obtain a decision state under the current iteration number; judging whether the decision state of each aircraft under the current iteration number is the same as the decision state of the corresponding aircraft under the last iteration number; if yes, controlling the corresponding aircraft to fly according to the searching strategy of the aircraft under the current iteration times; if not, the next iteration is entered. The method is suitable for solving the problem of the cluster countermeasure of most of aircrafts.

title_en: Corridor inspection system and laser scanning detection method
abstract_en: A corridor inspection system and a laser scanning detection method comprise an inspection device, an arc-shaped track, a track support, a wireless charging transmitting terminal module, a buffer device, a UWB transmitter and a remote terminal. Through inspection device along arc track reciprocating motion, gather vestibule point cloud data, vestibule image, vestibule ambient temperature, inspection device's running state to real-time transmission carries out real-time processing to the remote end, judges whether the accident takes place, and real-time display alarm picture, the running state of saving the preceding point cloud image of taking place the accident, vestibule image, vestibule ambient temperature, inspection device. The utility model provides a vestibule system of patrolling and examining, has improved the interference immunity, the suitability of inspection device, does not receive the light influence simultaneously, has reduced and has patrolled and examined the blind area, has reduced the error rate of judging the accident.

title_en: Intelligent Internet of things system for construction machinery and working method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent Internet of things system of construction machinery and a working method thereof, which are used for sensing and collecting the working state information of the machinery in real time, transmitting the information to a background system through a built-in network module of the system and an edge Internet of things agent device, and researching and developing a service function in the background system, so that the applications of browsing and checking the current position of the construction machinery, checking statistics of the arrival of posts and the number of work shifts, checking history and current working tracks, browsing and checking maintenance information and the like are realized. The system comprises: the intelligent Internet of things device for the construction machinery, the edge Internet of things agent device and the Internet of things application function of the construction machinery. The core target of the invention is to provide an internet of things perception means for construction site machinery and realize business management application, and the invention has the advantages of low cost, high real-time performance, good practicability, high degree of combination of internet of things technology and business application and the like.

title_en: Call center customer intelligent queuing system and method based on big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a call center customer intelligent queuing system and method based on big data, and belongs to the technical field of intelligent queuing. The invention comprises the following steps: step one: the call center inputs the consultation information issued by the clients through each channel into a call center database, and the call center database inquires the basic information of the clients, the personal information of the clients, the historical solved problems and the historical unresolved problems according to the related information displayed by the clients on the consultation channels; step two: analyzing dominant factors of the unresolved problems of the client history based on a fault tree analysis method; step three: judging whether the problem which is not solved by the client history can be successfully processed according to the analysis result in the step two and combining the client basic information and the client personal information change condition; step four: the type of customer consultation information is predicted based on the customer base information, the customer personal information, the historical resolved questions, and the historical unresolved questions.

title_en: MES sand table virtual simulation system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of digital information, and discloses a virtual simulation system and a virtual simulation method for an MES sand table, wherein the system comprises the following steps: the system comprises a production scheduling module, a raw material simulation functional area, a line side library functional area, a station simulation area, an FQA quality inspection simulation area, a finished product library simulation module, a statistics module, an external interactive magic card and a server. By utilizing the invention, the virtual reality of the MES teaching can be realized, students can be more intuitively peeled from the abstract concepts of books in the teaching, an intuitive application scene is established, and the actual operation process of the students is recorded, so that the teacher can conveniently review the actual learning condition of the students, and the limitation of high cost and lack of actual operation places in the actual teaching is overcome; meanwhile, the method can also be suitable for the establishment of the pipeline by actual production, and is used for detecting the debugging of the pipeline which is actually established and the configuration of facilities.

title_en: Unlocking authentication method and device, security chip and electronic key management system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides an unlocking authentication method, an unlocking authentication device, a security chip and an electronic key management system, belongs to the technical field of security, and solves the problem that unlocking management security of an intelligent lock cannot be guaranteed in the prior art. The method is applied to a security chip and comprises the following steps: acquiring an unlocking calculation command, wherein the unlocking calculation command comprises a lock identifier, a key identifier and a key type code; when the key type code in the unlocking calculation command is consistent with the locally stored key type code, generating a message authentication code for unlocking authentication by utilizing a key dispersion rule according to the key type code; and sending the message authentication code to the electronic key corresponding to the key identifier, so that the electronic key sends the message authentication code to the intelligent lock corresponding to the lock identifier to perform unlocking authentication. The embodiment of the invention is suitable for unlocking authentication process between the electronic key and the intelligent lock.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle cluster internal information transfer method based on behavior recognition
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, and provides an unmanned aerial vehicle cluster internal information transmission method based on behavior recognition. Simulating a Morse code and a data communication protocol, selecting a vibration wing as an active behavior basic action of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and making a corresponding semantic information comparison table; the unmanned aerial vehicle completes left vibration wing or right vibration wing according to the action code corresponding to the task information to be transmitted on the premise of not deviating from the route, so that the representation of the active behavior of the unmanned aerial vehicle is realized; and the identification of the active behavior of the unmanned aerial vehicle is completed through target detection, tracking and cognition of the unmanned aerial vehicle. According to the unmanned aerial vehicle active behavior coding method, the unmanned aerial vehicle active behavior coding rule is constructed, information is effectively transmitted inside the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster by utilizing unmanned aerial vehicle active behavior representation and identification, so that the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster can still smoothly complete tasks or safely return to the air under the communication refusal condition, and the survivability and cooperative adaptability of the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster are improved.

title_en: Real estate registration, certificate-making and supervision method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real estate registration, renovation and supervision method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring starting information of the certificate printer in real time, starting supervision cameras inside and outside the certificate printer after the starting information is acquired, and recording an operation video of the certificate printer; then, associating the recorded videos in the maintenance certificates with corresponding certificate numbers, and uploading the running videos to a cloud terminal for storage; and the operation and maintenance personnel carry out remote operation and maintenance on the certificate printer by accessing the operation video stored in the cloud. The real estate registration and certification-renovation supervision method records videos without sensitive data in the whole process, stores the videos permanently, binds the videos with certificate numbers, and can trace the source according to the certificate numbers at any time and confirm responsible persons once disputes occur.

title_en: Secure smart container assembly, system and method
abstract_en: The disclosed systems and methods provide an intelligent container or bin. The container bin assembly includes a bin body, a latch mechanism, and a controller. The method comprises the following steps: receiving an authentication request via a communication interface to access a smart container; actuating the electromechanical latch to disengage the fastening hook to initiate mechanical movement of the access member to make the interior compartment accessible; outputting an alert via the audiovisual element to identify the container; confirming that the electromechanical latch has reengaged the fastening hook, thereby securing the interior compartment; determining a change in local inventory; and updating the local inventory in the non-volatile data store in accordance with the change.

title_en: Multifunctional three-in-one coding emitter
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional three-in-one coding transmitter, which comprises a coder operating system. The operation method of the multifunctional three-in-one coding transmitter and the coder operation system is as follows: the method comprises the following steps: the eight-digit dialing module is switched, the lock key and the lower key are simultaneously pressed, the eight-digit dialing module is switched, after the switching is finished, the upper key is pressed to carry out plus dialing input, the lower key is pressed to carry out minus dialing input, the stop key is pressed to carry out blank dialing input, 8-digit dialing is input, an indicator light flickers for three times after the inputting is finished, and the eight-digit dialing module is connected; step two: the million fixed code module is used for switching the million fixed code module when the lock button and the upper button are pressed simultaneously, and the million fixed code is automatically regulated and controlled by the single chip processor after the switching is finished; step three: and the copying code module is used for switching the copying code after the upper key and the lower key are simultaneously pressed for 5s, and key copying is carried out by pressing a copying object and a corresponding key on the coding control system after the switching is finished.

title_en: Control method of onboard oxygen concentrator
abstract_en: The invention provides a control method of an onboard oxygen concentrator, which comprises the following steps of 1: after a control system of the airborne oxygen concentrator is powered on, firstly, initializing a DSP peripheral, initializing system variables, entering an in-situ calibration mode, and reading system working parameters in a memory, wherein the working parameters comprise maintenance time, fault codes and calibration parameters of products; step 2: when the power is on, whether the power is on for self-checking is judged according to the power-on delay circuit in the controller in the control system, so that the short-time or continuous power on and off of the airborne oxygen concentrator is prevented; and step 3: under the power-on self-checking mode, the control system mainly carries out self-checking on a dewatering filter, a pressure reducer, a comprehensive switching valve, an oxygen partial pressure sensor and a controller in the airborne oxygen concentrator. The automatic control device is mainly used for realizing the automatic control of the airborne oxygen concentrator in actual use so as to realize the purpose of automatically adjusting oxygen supply and improve the safety of the device in use.

title_en: Navigation path generation method for robot, device, and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a navigation path generation method of a robot, the robot, a navigation path generation device of the robot and a computer storage medium. The navigation path generation method of the robot comprises the steps of determining a first area with a target obstacle in a trapped area where the robot is located, wherein the target obstacle is detected by a target detection device configured by the robot, detecting an intersection area between the first area and a second area where the robot walks, and generating a navigation path for the robot to escape from the trapped area according to the intersection area when the intersection area is detected. The invention solves the technical problem that the existing robot cannot smoothly escape from the narrow-channel space when the radar recognizes the edge position of the narrow-channel space as an obstacle, so that the robot can not walk smoothly.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle cluster maintenance method considering task system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle cluster maintenance method considering a task system, which comprises the following steps: s1, establishing a multilayer complex network model, and evaluating the task reliability of the cluster system based on the multilayer complex network model; s2, based on the correlation between cluster maintenance and network, converting the reliability evaluation of the multi-layer complex network model into the evaluation of the reliability of the cluster task under each layer maintenance; s3, evaluating the reliability of the cluster task; and S4, formulating a cluster maintenance scheme based on the cluster task reliability evaluation result. On the basis of numerous maintenance groups proposed by failure of single-machine functional nodes, the invention utilizes a complex network modeling and evaluation method as a tool, diffuses the maintenance influence of the single machine to the task capacity change of the cluster system network according to the topology information of the cluster network, and optimizes the grouping strategy by taking the cost and the task reliability of the cluster system as final objective functions.

title_en: Gate passing detection method, equipment and medium based on laser ranging element group
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gate passing detection device, a method and a medium based on a laser ranging element group, wherein the method comprises the following steps: step 1: a plurality of laser ranging elements are deployed at one side of the gate, and the laser ranging elements acquire a group of distance information of a certain plane in a gate passing channel; step 2: establishing a calculation model of the object position in the gate channel by adopting a BP neural network for the distance information, and step 3: and training the BP neural network, and adjusting the neural network according to the error to obtain a calculation model of the object position in the gate channel based on the BP neural network. According to the invention, the element group of the laser ranging element is used for replacing a plurality of pairs of infrared correlation sensors, so that the cost of the gate is reduced, the use scene of the gate in a narrow environment is expanded, the gate equipment based on the trained neural network provides safe and reliable guarantee for traffic detection, and the gate equipment has practical and practical values and wide application prospects.

title_en: SDN network and deep reinforcement learning based multi-controller deployment method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-controller deployment method based on SDN network and deep reinforcement learning, which comprises the steps of obtaining a first performance optimization index of multi-controller deployment according to an SDN network structure, wherein the first performance optimization index comprises average propagation delay between a switch and a controller, average propagation delay between controllers, synchronous overhead between controllers and minimum safety of synchronization between controllers, establishing a first objective function according to the first performance optimization index, obtaining a first constraint condition of multi-controller deployment, wherein the first constraint condition comprises controller load constraint, mapping relation constraint between the switch and the controller and control layer synchronous link bandwidth constraint, constructing a multi-controller deployment model according to the first objective function and the first constraint condition, and solving the multi-controller deployment model by utilizing a deep reinforcement learning algorithm based on a Markov decision model to obtain a multi-controller deployment scheme.

title_en: Training method and device for automatic driving planning model for vehicle simulation evaluation
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a training method, a training device, training equipment and training media for an automatic driving planning model for vehicle simulation evaluation, relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and particularly relates to the technical field of automatic driving and simulation. The implementation scheme is as follows: acquiring state characteristic data of a target road condition scene; inputting the state characteristic data into an automatic driving planning model, and acquiring a first vehicle control decision output by the automatic driving planning model; performing simulation evaluation on the first vehicle control decision to obtain a first evaluation result of the first vehicle control decision aiming at the target road condition scene, wherein the first evaluation result is used for indicating whether the running behavior of the vehicle for performing the first vehicle control decision meets a preset condition; acquiring a first rewards value of the first vehicle control decision based on the first evaluation result; and adjusting parameters of the automatic driving planning model based on the first rewarding value.

title_en: Robot control method and device and robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a robot control method, a device and a robot, wherein the robot control method comprises the following steps: when a road section meets an obstacle, determining the driving intention of the robot according to the current position and the global path of the robot; according to the driving intention, obtaining environmental information to carry out local path planning so as to obtain a plurality of pre-planned sub-paths, and determining an optimal target path in the plurality of pre-planned sub-paths; and controlling the robot to pass through the road section according to the optimal target path. According to the invention, when the road section encounters an obstacle, the optimal target path can be determined according to the current position and the driving intention of the robot, so that the driving safety and the driving efficiency of the robot are improved.

title_en: Device, method for controlling said device and group or cluster of devices
abstract_en: The invention relates to an apparatus (10) comprising an optical sensing device (12) configured to sense an object (14) to obtain a picture of the object. The device comprises a driving arrangement (32) configured to drive and move the device. The device comprises an evaluation means (22) configured to evaluate the picture at least in accordance with the two-dimensional pattern (16) and at least in accordance with the first marking region (24) 1 ) And a second marking region (24) 2 ) The pattern is evaluated. The evaluation device is configured to: a marking result is obtained by comparing the first marking region and the second marking region, and the relative positioning of the device with respect to the object is determined based on the marking result. The apparatus comprising a controlMeans (28) configured to control the drive means based on the relative positioning.

title_en: Whole abdominal cavity viscera operation training system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a training system for abdominal cavity viscera surgery, which comprises a training mechanism, a control mechanism and a display mechanism, wherein: the training mechanism comprises a simulation box, a thoracic and abdominal cavity viscera placing assembly arranged in the simulation box, an animal thoracic and abdominal cavity viscera arranged in the thoracic and abdominal cavity viscera placing assembly and an operation cover body connected with the simulation box; the control mechanism comprises an MCU main control board, a laparoscope module, a refrigerating system, a blood circulation assembly, a lifting assembly and a leakage evaluation assembly; the laparoscope module is integrated on the display mechanism and comprises a touch screen and a display; the invention provides a training system for a whole abdominal cavity organ operation, which utilizes a platform to connect multiple pipelines and multiple organs, and the multiple pipelines and the multiple organs circulate through a peristaltic pump and simulate blood circulation, thereby achieving the aim of training the thoracic and laparoscopic surgery of a surgeon; the force feedback device can restore a real operation scene and a force feedback system, and is convenient for a trainer to train.

title_en: Intelligent training system, method and device for flight simulator
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent training system, method and device for a flight simulator, wherein the system comprises a personalized training subsystem, a flight training subsystem, an auxiliary driving subsystem and an electronic instructor subsystem; the personalized training subsystem is used for customizing a personalized training plan according to the learning characteristics of each flight student; the flight training subsystem is used for carrying out air combat flight training on flight trainees based on the personalized training plan and outputting flight training output parameters; the auxiliary driving subsystem is used for providing auxiliary information for flight trainees when the flight trainees carry out air combat flight training; and the electronic instructor subsystem performs flight training quality evaluation on the flight trainees through flight training output parameters based on the intelligent electronic instructor model. The flight simulator intelligent training system provided by the invention can solve the problems that the existing flight training simulator can not effectively make an individualized training plan and needs personnel such as teachers and the like to participate artificially, thereby seriously affecting the training work efficiency of students.

title_en: Wearable device
abstract_en: The application discloses wearable equipment which comprises a wearing assembly, an equipment main body, a locking device, a falling trigger device, a floating device and a second state, wherein the equipment main body is arranged on the wearing assembly, the locking device is arranged on the wearing assembly and is fixed on the wearing assembly through the locking device, the falling trigger device is arranged on the wearing assembly, the floating device is arranged on the equipment main body, the locking device is connected with the equipment main body in a first state, the floating device is contained in the equipment main body, the locking device is separated from the equipment main body in a second state, the equipment main body is separated from the wearing assembly, and the floating device is unfolded outside the equipment main body.

title_en: Automatic production line spoofing attack detection method and system based on random control
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for detecting cheating attacks on an automatic production line based on random control. In the training stage, randomly generating control instructions of different equipment of the production line, enabling the equipment to execute according to the control instructions, and generating the real running/waiting time of the equipment; identifying the relationship between the respective real running/waiting time of all equipment of the production line and the received control instruction by a linear regression method; in the attack detection stage, control instructions and expected operation/waiting time of different devices are randomly generated, the expected operation period of the production line is kept unchanged, and finally, the accumulated deviation between the real operation/waiting time and the expected operation/waiting time of the devices is calculated according to the operation data of the different devices uploaded by the production line, so that the attack detection is realized. By means of the technical scheme provided by the invention, detection aiming at the deception attack can be realized on the premise of keeping the operation efficiency of the production line, the detection process is not easily interfered by the outside, and the detection accuracy rate is higher.

title_en: Intelligent home control system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of Internet of things, and particularly relates to an intelligent home control system based on the Internet of things, which comprises a control center module, an intelligent lighting module, an intelligent air-conditioning module, an intelligent water heater module and an intelligent curtain module; the intelligent lighting module: the intelligent lighting module is used for indoor lighting, can receive signals transmitted by the control center module and is used for turning on or turning off a lighting state or dimming lighting; intelligent air conditioning module: the intelligent air conditioning module is used for adjusting indoor air temperature, receiving signals transmitted by the control center module, turning on or turning off the intelligent air conditioning module and adjusting data in the intelligent air conditioning module; through collecting the household electrical appliances commonly used to the system, not only further improved the comfort level of house life, still introduced intelligent (window) curtain module simultaneously to can open and close the (window) curtain through system control's mode, further improve the convenience and the travelling comfort of house.

title_en: Simulation test system of electro-hydraulic controller
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulation test system of an electro-hydraulic controller. The system comprises: collecting equipment, real equipment, simulation equipment and test equipment; the acquisition equipment comprises first acquisition equipment used for acquiring first operation data of real equipment and second acquisition equipment used for acquiring second operation data of virtual equipment corresponding to the real equipment, and the virtual equipment and the second acquisition equipment are constructed by test equipment; the simulation equipment is used for controlling the operation of the real equipment and the virtual equipment and processing the operation data; the test equipment is constructed according to the first operation data and used for obtaining a test result of the simulation equipment according to the operation data. Therefore, the system can be combined with real equipment and virtual equipment to realize simulation test of the electro-hydraulic controller, cost is saved, test equipment can be constructed according to the first operation data of the real equipment, simulation test of real working conditions can be realized, and applicability and accuracy of the simulation test of the electro-hydraulic controller are improved.

title_en: Digital logistics management control cabinet
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital logistics management control cabinet, and particularly relates to the field of logistics management, which comprises a cabinet body, wherein an article recording table is arranged at the lower right corner of the cabinet body, a weighing table is arranged at the bottom end of the article recording table, a display screen is arranged at the top end of the article recording table, an input key is arranged at the bottom end of the display screen, a control button is arranged on one side of the input key, a small bin is arranged at the bottom end of the cabinet body, a large bin is arranged at the top end of the small bin, containing boxes are placed in the large bin at the top end of the cabinet body, a loading and unloading mechanism is correspondingly arranged at the top end of each containing box, and a prompt lamp is arranged at the top end of each large bin.
