The automatic order taking device can automatically identify order information and place the order information at fixed points, so that the articles can be placed neatly and orderly, meanwhile, the carrying of large articles can be assisted, the storage time is saved, the article taking personnel is safe, the use is more convenient, the articles can be taken by the article taking personnel quickly, the article taking efficiency is improved, and the practicability is high.

title_en: Method and system for self-adaptive authorization acquisition of multi-type tax control equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for self-adaptively acquiring authorization of multi-type tax control equipment. Wherein, the method comprises the following steps: sending the equipment information of the tax control equipment to a service provider system; accessing an authorization authentication system corresponding to the type of the tax control equipment through the service provider system according to the type of the tax control equipment, wherein the equipment information of the tax control equipment comprises the type of the tax control equipment; generating an authorization file corresponding to the authorization and authentication system according to the authorization and authentication system corresponding to the type of the tax control equipment; and returning the authorization file to the tax control equipment through the service provider system. Therefore, tax control equipment authorization files are more conveniently controlled, manual delivery of different types of tax control equipment is not needed, risks such as errors and leakage of delivery of the authorization files are avoided, logs of related authorization acquisition, generation and delivery are recorded, and data basis is provided for later authorization file tracking.

title_en: Safety control system and method for electric furniture controller
abstract_en: The invention provides a safety control system and a method for an electric furniture controller. The safety control method specifically comprises the steps that a vibration sensor collects vibration data of the electric furniture in real time and stores the vibration data into an FIFO storage unit, an instruction module reads the vibration data in the FIFO storage unit, collision judgment of the electric furniture is carried out according to the vibration data, corresponding action commands are formulated, when the instruction module reads the vibration data in the FIFO storage unit, real-time fault detection is carried out on the instruction module through the vibration sensor, and when the instruction module is detected to be in fault, the vibration sensor controls a reset instruction module or closes an execution module, or the two modules execute simultaneously. The invention can effectively reduce the cost while ensuring the operation safety of the electric furniture.

title_en: Game learning system, game learning method and computing device
abstract_en: Disclosed are a gamification learning system, a game learning method, and a computing device, the system including: the interaction processing device comprises a cloud processing unit and a processing unit, wherein the cloud processing unit is used for generating an interaction file based on the received script feedback, and the interaction file enables the virtual image to interact with a user; the game learning guiding device comprises a path planning unit and a behavior guiding unit, wherein the path planning unit is used for determining a learning path according to a learning target selected by a user and distributing and pushing learning resources according to the learning path, and the behavior guiding unit is used for generating script feedback according to the learning path and the learning resources and guiding the user to complete a learning plan under the learning path together with an avatar so as to complete the learning target. The invention can realize the user-defined virtual image generation, support various interaction modes of voice, expression and action, guide the learning behavior of the user through a game mechanism, better meet the personalized requirements of the user, and realize the purposes of edutainment and promotion of the learning interest of the user.

title_en: Linkage early warning management method, system, storage medium and equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a linkage early warning management method, a linkage early warning management system, a storage medium and equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: grouping the sensors on the target monitoring object according to a preset grouping rule to obtain a plurality of monitoring groups, and acquiring data of all the sensors of all the monitoring groups in real time; analyzing the data of all the sensors of the preset monitoring group to obtain the fluctuation condition of the data of all the sensors of the preset monitoring group, the correlation condition of the data of all the sensors of the preset monitoring group and the corresponding influence factors and the change rate of the data of all the sensors of the preset monitoring group; judging the abnormal conditions of the data of all the sensors of the preset monitoring group according to the fluctuation conditions of the data of all the sensors of the preset monitoring group, the correlation conditions with the corresponding influence factors and the change rate; and analyzing and judging the abnormal conditions of the data of all the sensors of the preset monitoring group to obtain the early warning condition of the preset monitoring group. The invention can be convenient for carrying out comprehensive and efficient linkage early warning management on different monitoring items or different monitoring parts on the monitored object.

title_en: Intelligent pole control system passes by way
abstract_en: The invention discloses a passing intelligent rod control system, which comprises a power circuit, a main control circuit, an alarm circuit, a storage circuit, a face recognition circuit, a voice circuit, a network interface circuit, a dot matrix lamp circuit, a water leakage detection circuit and a communication circuit, wherein the power circuit provides stable voltage for the whole system, the main control circuit is responsible for signal capture and logic processing of the whole system, the alarm circuit is connected with the control end of the main control circuit, the storage circuit is connected with the output end of the main control circuit, the face recognition circuit is connected with the input end of the main control circuit, the voice circuit is connected with the control end of the main control circuit, the network interface circuit is connected with the input end of the main control circuit, the dot matrix lamp circuit is connected with the control end of the main control circuit, the water leakage detection circuit is connected with the input end of the main control circuit, and the communication circuit is connected with the input end of the main control circuit, the solar energy rain protection device can be powered on by solar energy, can be powered off when rain leaks in rainy days, and effectively prevents pedestrians from passing through.

title_en: Virtual simulation teaching system for mapping and mapping WeChat
abstract_en: The invention discloses a virtual simulation teaching system for mapping letter, comprising: the system platform is not influenced by factors such as weather, environment, geographical position and the like, can facilitate teacher practical teaching and student professional core skill training, realizes intellectualization and informatization of teaching, and has the characteristics of multi-perception, immersion, interactivity, conception and the like. At present, the platform carries out a plurality of virtual simulation training systems such as digital mapping, satellite positioning measurement, leveling measurement, unmanned aerial vehicle photogrammetry, intelligent android total station and the like, and can be used on a teacher line and a student line.

title_en: Forest fire prevention and control monitoring devices
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of forest fire prevention and control, in particular to a forest fire prevention and control monitoring device; the fire-fighting water tank comprises big trees and a tank body which is buried among a plurality of big trees at equal intervals and is arranged under the ground, wherein the upper end of the tank body is provided with a sealing cover which can be sealed, disassembled and installed, the upper part in the tank body is provided with a sealing plate which is in sealing contact and matched with the upper part, the side wall of the upper part in the tank body is fixedly provided with a plurality of limiting blocks which are uniformly distributed in an annular shape, water is filled in the tank body, a water spraying part which is communicated with the lower part in the tank body and sprays water to the periphery is arranged in the tank body, a carbon dioxide gas generating part is fixedly installed on the inner bottom surface of the sealing cover, and a fuse which triggers the carbon dioxide gas generating part to generate carbon dioxide gas when a fire disaster happens is arranged above the sealing cover; according to the invention, the tank body filled with water is arranged in a forest, when a fire disaster happens, the fire source ignites the fuse to trigger the upper part in the tank body to spray carbon dioxide gas to push the sealing plate to move downwards quickly, the pressure at the lower part in the tank body is increased rapidly, and water at the lower part of the tank body is extruded out of the first spray nozzle to spray around to extinguish the fire.

title_en: Unmanned plane levee piping inspection system and method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deep learning-based unmanned plane levee piping inspection system and method, wherein an unmanned plane platform is used for overload of a visible light camera, an infrared camera and a picture transmission system, so that cruising flight of the levee along a line is realized; the visible light camera is used for shooting visible light images of the levee region and outputting visible light video streams; the infrared camera is used for shooting an infrared image of the levee area and outputting an infrared video stream; the image transmission system receives videos of the visible light camera and the infrared camera and sends video streams to the remote controller; the remote controller realizes the control of the unmanned plane platform and outputs unmanned plane image transmission video stream to the ground station; the ground station acquires the unmanned aerial vehicle image transmission video stream sent by the remote controller, the piping is detected in real time in the acquired visible light or infrared image through the deep learning piping detection model, and the target information is prompted through the graph or the sound.

title_en: Fault positioning device for transponder transmission module
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fault positioning device of a transponder transmission module, which comprises: the acquisition module is connected with the transponder transmission module and is used for acquiring actual output data of the transponder transmission module; the analysis module is connected with the acquisition module and is used for comparing the actual output data of the transponder transmission module with the standard output data so as to locate faults of the transponder transmission module; and the alarm display module is connected with the analysis module and used for displaying the fault information of the transponder transmission module and warning. The invention can realize the accurate positioning of the faults of the transponder transmission module, and display and warn the fault information of the transponder transmission module, so that the personnel can overhaul the transponder transmission module in time, thereby improving the reliability of the transponder transmission module.

title_en: Equipment monitoring system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a device monitoring system and a method, wherein the system comprises: the system comprises an equipment scheduling module, a plurality of data transmission units and a monitoring management module; the equipment scheduling module is used for acquiring the target production task work order from the manufacturing execution system and issuing equipment task information corresponding to the target production task work order to the target equipment; the data transmission units are used for acquiring monitoring data of the target equipment and sending the monitoring data of the target equipment to the monitoring management module; and the monitoring management module is used for generating at least one of alarm information, a target report and a target billboard based on the monitoring data of the target equipment. The equipment monitoring system and the method provided by the invention can realize real-time monitoring of the equipment driven by the scheduling work order by taking the MES as the drive through the equipment scheduling module, can provide a more effective solution for efficient management and monitoring of the equipment, and can provide a more effective way for realizing unmanned factory and automatic production.

title_en: Commercial space flight and civil aviation operation cooperative system based on digital twinborn
abstract_en: The invention provides a digital twin-based commercial space flight and civil aviation operation cooperation system which comprises a physical commercial space flight and civil aviation scene module, a virtual commercial space flight and civil aviation scene module, a commercial space flight and civil aviation twin large data module and a commercial sub-orbit flight and civil aviation operation cooperation module. The system can be applied to civil aviation air-traffic control departments, and aims to verify the decision-making scheme of the flight avoidance sub-orbital debris danger area and the feasibility of the cooperation mode of the commercial aerospace flight and the civil aviation operation by using a digital twin-based commercial aerospace flight and civil aviation operation cooperation system, design the decision-making scheme of the civil aviation aircraft avoidance in real time under the condition of dynamic change of the sub-orbital debris danger area, and re-plan the airway routes according with the air traffic control rules, so that the safety of the civil aviation air-traffic space is improved.

title_en: Robot based on fork-type rocker arm and wheel leg composite obstacle crossing mechanism and autonomous obstacle crossing method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of obstacle crossing control of robots, in particular to a robot based on a fork-type rocker arm wheel leg composite obstacle crossing mechanism and an autonomous obstacle crossing method. The method comprises the following steps: the system comprises a mobile robot, a vision camera, a front driving wheel, a rear driving wheel, a radar detection system, a fork-shaped rocker arm obstacle crossing mechanism and a combined navigation system, wherein the vision camera, the front driving wheel, the rear driving wheel, the radar detection system, the fork-shaped rocker arm obstacle crossing mechanism and the combined navigation system are arranged on the mobile robot and are connected with a controller; and the controller is used for receiving the distance information between the mobile robot and the vertical obstacle and the height information of the vertical obstacle, which are acquired by the radar detection system in real time, receiving the real-time position and posture information of the mobile robot, which are acquired by the combined navigation system, sending a control instruction signal to control the front driving wheel or the rear driving wheel to advance or stop, and simultaneously calculating the angle or the advancing distance to which the fork-shaped rocker arm obstacle crossing mechanism needs to swing so as to realize autonomous control. The invention provides a feasible method for the mobile robot to autonomously cross a vertical obstacle with a certain height, which can greatly improve the passing capacity of the robot in a complex environment.

title_en: CBTC automatic self-testing method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a CBTC automatic self-testing method and device, the method comprises the steps of obtaining a first testing sequence based on an event diagram, wherein the first testing sequence comprises a correct complete event sequence and a complete event sequence of faults, optimizing the first testing sequence based on a test sequence optimization algorithm of event tree to obtain a second testing sequence with lower redundancy degree, and testing the second testing sequence based on a CBTC automatic testing platform of an event driven model to obtain a testing result.

title_en: Pedestrian protection early warning method and device, electronic equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a pedestrian protection early warning method, a pedestrian protection early warning device, electronic equipment and a readable storage medium, and the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a driving image of a vehicle; carrying out pedestrian detection on the driving image to obtain a pedestrian detection frame of the driving image; inputting the driving image into a road surface segmentation model which is trained in advance, and obtaining a road surface segmentation result output by the road surface segmentation model, wherein the road surface segmentation result comprises a road surface area in the driving image; determining whether the pedestrian corresponding to each pedestrian detection frame is in the road surface area or not according to the pedestrian detection frames and the road surface area; if the pedestrian is in the road surface area, the early warning is triggered, the pedestrian needing the early warning really is identified through the pedestrian detection frame and the road surface area, the accuracy of identifying the pedestrian needing the early warning really is improved, and the condition that unnecessary early warning is generated due to the fact that other factors cannot accurately identify the pedestrian needing the early warning really is avoided.

title_en: Explosion-proof intelligent track system of patrolling and examining
abstract_en: The invention discloses an explosion-proof intelligent track inspection system, which comprises a mobile subsystem, a charging subsystem and a robot inspection subsystem; the mobile subsystem comprises a track and a mobile device, wherein the track is provided with an RFID label, and the mobile device is connected to the track in a sliding manner; the charging subsystem comprises a charging pile and a mounting seat and is fixedly connected with the track; the robot inspection subsystem is fixedly connected to the mobile device; the moving device comprises a support, a first bearing, a second bearing, a third bearing, a driving wheel and a driven wheel. The robot inspection subsystem comprises a battery, a power supply processing module, an editable logic controller, a power supply module, a wireless AP module, a video acquisition module, an RS485 communication isolation module and a detection module. By the technical scheme, the mine explosion-proof requirement can be met, the environment can be subjected to video, image and audio acquisition, the environment gas and smoke can be detected, high-precision positioning and automatic charging are realized, the reliability of the routing inspection process is ensured, and the production safety is improved.

title_en: Information transmission system of electric auxiliary bicycle
abstract_en: An information transmission system of an electric auxiliary bicycle comprises the electric auxiliary bicycle, a server and a handheld device. The electric auxiliary bicycle comprises a rechargeable battery, a motor, a controller and a networking module, wherein the rechargeable battery provides power for the components, and the controller can directly acquire at least one group of vehicle performance data of the electric auxiliary bicycle through the rechargeable battery or the motor or a sensor. The networking module is connected with the server through a network, and the handheld device is provided with real-time communication software. The controller commands the networking module to transmit the vehicle performance data to the server, and the server also pushes the vehicle performance data to the real-time communication software of the handheld device, so that a user of the handheld device can know the condition of the electric auxiliary bicycle in real time.

title_en: Signal modulation and transmission integrated equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a signal modulation and transmission integrated device, which belongs to the technical field of intelligent express delivery cabinets and comprises a shell; the lower base is fixedly connected to the lower end of the shell, the upper end of the shell is fixedly connected with the upper base, a second mounting groove is formed in one side end of the shell, the lower inner wall of the second mounting groove is fixedly connected with an intelligent express cabinet core processor, and a monitoring device is arranged on the lower side of the upper base; the safety degree of the device is improved, the heat dissipation efficiency of the internal parts of the intelligent express cabinet is improved, the damage quantity of the internal parts of the intelligent express cabinet is reduced, the installation mode of the intelligent express cabinet is simple and convenient, the convenient maintenance personnel can install or detach the intelligent express cabinet, the safety monitoring device of the intelligent express cabinet is controlled to adjust the multiple angles, the safety degree of the device is improved, and the occurrence of theft events is reduced.

title_en: Trimming fuse reading circuit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a trimming fuse reading circuit, which comprises: the trimming fuse state reading unit comprises a first branch and a second branch, wherein the first branch is connected with a power end through a first resistor, the second branch is connected with the power end through a trimming fuse, and the trimming fuse state reading unit also receives a fuse reading signal and is used for judging the fusing state of the trimming fuse based on the first resistor when the fuse reading signal is effective; and the bias current generating unit is used for providing bias current for the trimming fuse state reading unit. The trimming fuse reading circuit can ensure that normal reading can be performed even in a state that the trimming fuse is not completely blown, and the reading of the blown state of the trimming fuse is less influenced by a power supply voltage.

title_en: Industrial manufacturing intelligent system and remote control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an industrial manufacturing intelligent system and a remote control method thereof, which can avoid adverse effects on the industrial manufacturing system caused by communication delay or communication faults and ensure the normal operation of the industrial manufacturing system by arranging a cloud server for managing and controlling the industrial manufacturing intelligent system, an industrial manufacturing device which is installed under a production environment and is in communication connection with the cloud server and is used for executing a production task, a field monitoring device which is installed under the production environment and is in communication connection with the cloud server and is used for monitoring the industrial manufacturing device, a control terminal which is in communication connection with the cloud server and is used for controlling the industrial manufacturing device and the field monitoring device through the cloud server, and a communication link state detection device which is installed under the production environment and is in communication connection with the cloud server and is used for detecting the state of a communication link between the field device and the cloud server.

title_en: Road network matching method and device
abstract_en: The application provides a road network matching method and device, and relates to the field of maps. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring first position information; determining one or more candidate road sections located near the terminal based on the first position information and a pre-stored mapping relation; determining a target road section of the terminal at the current time point based on the candidate road section and the track of the terminal in the first time window; and correcting the first position information in the track based on the target road section of the terminal at the current time point to obtain the corrected track. Based on the road network matching method provided by the application, the deviation of the moving track can be corrected in real time, and the accuracy of the moving track is improved. And because the mapping relation between the region and the road section is prestored, the position information can be directly converted into the region, and then the candidate road section near the position is found out, and the candidate road section does not need to be calculated in real time on line according to the position information of the terminal, so that the calculation amount can be reduced, and the real-time deviation correction efficiency can be improved.

title_en: Intelligent control method suitable for stereo garage
abstract_en: The invention relates to garage control, in particular to an intelligent control method applicable to a stereo garage, which is characterized by receiving parking reservation information/vehicle taking reservation information sent by a user, generating a corresponding parking plan/vehicle taking plan by combining the parking state of each parking space in the garage, binding and storing the parking plan/vehicle taking plan with the user and a vehicle to be parked, and dispatching the parking and vehicle taking actions of the user by sending the corresponding parking plan/vehicle taking plan to each user; the technical scheme provided by the invention can effectively overcome the defect that the parking path and the vehicle taking path cannot be effectively optimized in the prior art.

title_en: TPMS sensitivity test road condition statistical method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a TPMS sensitivity test road condition statistical method which comprises the steps of firstly, pre-storing a plurality of groups of calibration data formed after classification of a vehicle speed range corresponding to each road condition into a CAN bus recorder, comparing the obtained current vehicle speed with the corresponding vehicle speed range in the plurality of groups of pre-stored calibration data in the CAN bus recorder to determine a current driving road section, performing man-machine interaction on the road section condition and a driver, and performing marking storage after waiting for confirmation of the driver, wherein the current road condition is judged through the vehicle speed information and the pre-stored calibration data in the CAN bus recorder, and performing man-machine interaction with the driver, and marking after waiting for confirmation of the driver, so that the reliability of subsequent data screening is greatly improved.

title_en: Formaldehyde detection method and device based on formaldehyde sensor and air purifier
abstract_en: The invention provides a formaldehyde detection method and device based on a formaldehyde sensor and an air purifier, wherein a heating unit is arranged in a preset range of the formaldehyde sensor, and the method comprises the following steps: monitoring the current environmental humidity within a preset range of a formaldehyde sensor; judging whether the current environment humidity exceeds a maximum environment humidity threshold corresponding to the normal work of the formaldehyde sensor; when the current environment humidity exceeds the maximum environment humidity threshold corresponding to the normal work of the formaldehyde sensor, controlling the heating unit to start, and returning to the step of monitoring the current environment humidity within the preset range of the formaldehyde sensor until the current environment humidity does not exceed the maximum environment humidity threshold; and controlling the formaldehyde sensor to perform formaldehyde detection to obtain a formaldehyde detection result. Therefore, when the humidity is higher, the heating unit is controlled to be started, the local environment of the detection point of the formaldehyde sensor is ensured to be within a proper humidity range, and the humidity resistance of the formaldehyde sensor and the working performance of the formaldehyde sensor in a high-humidity environment are improved.

title_en: 5G intelligent seedling raising method and system based on Lora wireless sensing
abstract_en: The invention provides a 5G intelligent seedling raising method and system based on Lora wireless sensing, which comprises the following steps: a plurality of environmental parameters collected as a cloud data store; transmitting the data to a microprocessor through 5G wireless transmission; and the microprocessor integrates data of a plurality of environment parameters of each type, eliminates abnormal values in the environment parameters, adjusts proper environment parameters in the agricultural shelter, adjusts the seedling raising environment in the agricultural shelter and ensures the seedling raising quality of the agricultural shelter. The microprocessor collects the parameters of the environmental parameter acquisition modules of different types at different moments distributed at different positions in the agricultural shelter in real time through the plurality of environmental parameter acquisition modules of different types, and judges whether the parameters meet the standard conformance judgment result matrix model Q or not after the parameters of the types are collected and sorted N The certain vector value in the method further improves the regularity of the original data when the microprocessor carries out control operation, and improves the accuracy and precision of the operation.

title_en: Band gap reference circuit and chip
abstract_en: The invention provides a band gap reference circuit and a chip, wherein the band gap reference circuit comprises a band gap core circuit, a starting circuit, a bias current generating circuit and an operational amplifier bias circuit, the operational amplifier bias current comprises a feedback tube, an upper bias current source, a current mirror load and an operational amplifier NMOS input tube, the bias current generating circuit is connected with the upper bias current source, the upper bias current source is connected with the current mirror load, the current mirror load is connected with the operational amplifier NMOS input tube, the current mirror load is connected with the feedback tube operational amplifier NMOS input tube and is connected with the band gap core circuit, the feedback tube is connected with the starting circuit, the starting circuit is connected with the band gap core circuit, and the feedback tube is connected with a power end and the band gap core circuit. The invention also provides a chip comprising the band gap reference circuit. The gap reference circuit of the invention keeps a proper common-mode input range in the working temperature range to reliably work, and has the advantages of low working voltage, low noise, high reliability and the like.

title_en: Energy-saving method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses an energy-saving method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring first ambient humidity of target equipment acquired by a first sensor and first ambient temperature of the target equipment acquired by a second sensor; determining a first dew point temperature based on the first ambient humidity and the first ambient temperature; and determining a first energy-saving state of the target equipment based on the first dew point temperature, and controlling the target equipment to enter the first energy-saving state.

title_en: Current generation circuit, logarithmic amplifier and logarithmic slope temperature stability improvement method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a current generating circuit, a logarithmic amplifier and a method for improving temperature stability of logarithmic slope thereof, wherein the current generating circuit comprises: the bias module generates bias voltage and feedback voltage, and the temperature coefficient of the feedback voltage is zero; and the current generation module is connected with the bias voltage and the feedback voltage to generate N bias currents, and the temperature coefficient of the bias currents is zero. In the invention, the bias voltage and the feedback voltage with the temperature coefficient of zero are generated by the bias module, and N bias currents with the temperature coefficient of zero are generated by the current generation module matching with the bias voltage and the feedback voltage, while the temperature stability of the logarithmic slope in the logarithmic amplifier is mainly related to the bias current of the differential logarithmic unit, and the N bias currents are correspondingly connected into the N differential logarithmic units of the logarithmic amplifier one by one to serve as tail currents of the differential logarithmic unit, so that the temperature stability of the logarithmic slope of the logarithmic amplifier can be effectively improved.

title_en: Virtual-real combined multi-unmanned aerial vehicle perception avoidance verification system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a virtual-real combined multi-unmanned aerial vehicle perception avoidance verification system and a method, wherein the system comprises: the system comprises a physical platform, a simulation platform and a data processing system, wherein the physical platform comprises a positioning system, a physical unmanned aerial vehicle and communication interconnection equipment, the simulation platform is used for constructing an experimental scene, a simulation unmanned aerial vehicle and a mirror unmanned aerial vehicle in a simulation environment, and the pose of the mirror unmanned aerial vehicle is obtained by real-time mapping according to the pose of the physical unmanned aerial vehicle; the interaction module is used for realizing data interaction with the physical platform and the simulation platform; the real object platform obtains data of a sensor carried by the mirror image unmanned aerial vehicle in real time, and solves the control quantity of the unmanned aerial vehicle according to a preset perception evasion verification task so as to control the motion of the real object unmanned aerial vehicle. The invention realizes multi-unmanned aerial vehicle perception avoidance verification based on a virtual-real combination mode, can fully simulate a complex wind field in a real object environment, and has the advantages of low realization cost, strong real-time performance, high experiment fidelity, high reliability and the like.

title_en: Singing posture adjusting device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of singing training and discloses a singing posture adjusting device, which comprises: the electronic control revolving frame is arranged on the frame body, at least part of the electronic control revolving frame surrounds a human body when in use, the display module is connected with the correction module, the display module can shoot human body postures and display preset postures and real-time postures, and meanwhile, the display module can display data of equipment; the checking module receives the real-time posture from the display module, compares the real-time posture with the stored preset posture, and simultaneously sends comparison data to the display module for display; the rack body is provided with a certain height and used for lifting the electric control revolving rack to a human body, and the rack body, the electric control revolving rack, the display module and the correction module are arranged in the equipment, so that the posture of a practicer can adjust the record at any time, and the correct posture is convenient to form.

title_en: HiL test platform of photovoltaic power station and performance test method of PPC
abstract_en: The application provides a photovoltaic power plant's HiL test platform, PPC's capability test method, this platform includes: the PPC, the inverter controller and the HiL real-time simulator are respectively provided with an upper computer; the PPC and the inverter controller are communicated through a preset communication protocol; the HiL real-time simulator is connected to the PPC and the inverter controller through a digital quantity input interface and/or an analog quantity output interface, and simulates other test equipment in the photovoltaic power station in a digital model mode; the scheme combines the flexibility of pure digital simulation and the accuracy of physical testing, can realize the testing of various stable/transient operation working conditions of the photovoltaic power station and the power grid in real time without accessing a real photovoltaic power station and the power grid, and solves the problems that the related existing scheme has excessive potential risks, the testing opportunity is difficult to capture, and certain working conditions are difficult to realize or the realization cost is too high.

title_en: License plate identification method, license plate identification device and license plate identification system
abstract_en: The application discloses a license plate distinguishing method, a license plate distinguishing device and a license plate distinguishing system. The license plate identification method comprises the following steps: acquiring vehicle identity information of a target vehicle through an on-board equipment unit of the target vehicle based on a V2X communication technology; acquiring a prestored license plate number bound with the vehicle identity information; acquiring the current license plate number of the target vehicle; and when the pre-stored license plate number is consistent with the current license plate number, confirming that the target vehicle is a vehicle with a normal license plate. Or when the pre-stored license plate number is inconsistent with the current license plate number, giving out a prompt of license plate abnormity. According to the license plate identification method, illegal behaviors such as vehicle fake plate and shielding license plates can be detected through a vehicle connection mode and communication and authentication of the vehicle and the roadside device. Therefore, the behaviors of violating the traffic laws, such as vehicle fake plate and the like, can be fundamentally solved, and the system is more intelligent and efficient in processing the violations, such as vehicle fake plate and the like.

title_en: Emergency LED traffic light
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency LED traffic lamp, and relates to the technical field of traffic. Including the traffic light body, be provided with cleaning mechanism on the traffic light body, cleaning mechanism includes clean soft brush, arc bull stick, connecting axle, belt, axis of rotation and wind wheel, clean soft brush one end is embedded in on the arc bull stick, clean soft brush other end is close to on the traffic light body outer wall, arc bull stick bottom fixed mounting is on the connecting axle, the connecting axle runs through and rotates and install on the traffic light body, belt drive installs between connecting axle and axis of rotation, wind wheel fixed mounting is on the axis of rotation outer wall. This emergent LED traffic light through being provided with cleaning mechanism on the traffic light body, the rotation of clean soft brush alright strike off impurity such as the dust that traffic light body surface was attached for traffic light body surface is clear, conveniently observes, improves traffic safety, has the heat dissipation simultaneously and to the effect that dust was concentrated and was collected.

title_en: Flight management device and flight management method
abstract_en: The flying apparatus can stably communicate using a communication service provided by a communication carrier within a flight route or a flight range specified by a user. A flight management device (1) comprises: a receiving unit that receives, from a user terminal used by a user, flight schedule information including user identification information for identifying the user, a predetermined flight route or a flight range in which the flying device flies, and a predetermined flight schedule period in which the flying device flies along the flight route or the flight range; an organism determination section that determines organism information related to the flying apparatus, which is associated with the user identification information; a carrier specifying unit that specifies a communication carrier that provides a communication service that can be used by the flight device, based on the body information; a determination unit that determines whether or not the flying device can communicate using the communication service while flying along the flight route or the flight range, based on the communication carrier and the flight route or the flight range; and a transmission unit that transmits the determination result of the determination unit to the user terminal.

title_en: Combined electrical fire and safety electricity consumption monitoring system and demonstration method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a combined electric fire and safe electricity consumption monitoring system and a demonstration method thereof. According to the invention, the electric fire detector, the fault arc detector, the intelligent air switch and the intelligent socket are used for collecting the operation state information of the electric circuit and the electric equipment, corresponding fault analysis processing is completed according to the electric fault signal input by the simulated fault button unit, and the operation state information and the fault signal are transmitted to the intelligent gateway, so that various electric fire faults under the monitoring of the Internet of things can be truly and completely simulated, and the application and development of the monitoring technology of the Internet of things for electric fire and safe use of electricity can be promoted.

title_en: Control system of pipeline water-carrying detection robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a control system of a pipeline water detection robot, which comprises an upper pipeline control system and a lower pipeline execution mechanism, wherein the upper pipeline control system is connected with the lower pipeline execution mechanism through a cable and is used for receiving information and transmitting the information to an industrial personal computer; the pipeline lower executing mechanism is arranged on the robot and is used for collecting information and transmitting the information to the pipeline upper control system, and the pipeline lower executing mechanism is also used for sending a control instruction to control the robot and controlling the start and stop of a power supply; the control of the robot comprises the matching control between the linear walking control of the robot and the paying-off speed of the control system on the pipeline and the running speed of the robot; the invention has the advantages that: the anti-interference, shockproof and dampproof effects are better, the anti-interference, shockproof and dampproof effects are not easy to collide with the pipe wall, the walking precision is high, the stability is good, the cable is relaxed to a certain degree in the trolley walking process, the cable is freely retracted and released, the occurrence of stranded wire accidents caused by trolley slipping is avoided, and manual cable retraction and release intervention is not needed.

title_en: Engineering machinery control system based on CAN bus high integration
abstract_en: The invention discloses an engineering machinery control system based on high integration of a CAN (controller area network) bus, which comprises a combination key (CAN), a radio (CAN), a wiper motor (CAN), a water spray motor (CAN), a light (CAN), a sensor (CAN), an input node (CAN), an output node (CAN), an instrument (CAN), an engine unit (engine ECU), an electromagnetic valve output node (CAN) and an engine bus. The automobile windscreen wiper is characterized in that the combined key (CAN), the radio (CAN), the wiper motor (CAN), the water spraying motor (CAN), the lamp light (CAN), the sensor (CAN), the input node (CAN), the output node (CAN), the instrument (CAN), the engine ECU (CAN) and the electromagnetic valve output node (CAN) are connected in parallel through a CAN bus.

title_en: Intelligent concrete vibrating method
abstract_en: The application provides an intelligent concrete vibrating method, which comprises the steps of establishing a prediction model about vibrating parameters through a neural network, constructing an evaluation function by using the prediction model, optimally solving the evaluation function to obtain an optimal vibrating parameter set, determining vibrating parameters such as an optimal vibrating rod interval and the like, determining vibrating points in all mobile mechanical arm operating units in an operating space environment map by taking the distance between two adjacent vibrating points as the optimal vibrating rod interval, vibrating the vibrating points one by adopting a mobile mechanical arm according to the vibrating parameters such as the optimal vibrating duration and the like in the optimal vibrating parameter set to replace manual or mechanical vibrating concrete, realize accurate control, automation and intellectualization of concrete vibrating, obviously improve the concrete vibrating quality and vibrating uniformity, thereby improving the concrete solidifying quality, and overcoming the defects of low vibrating efficiency, low vibration speed, high vibration efficiency and the like in the prior art, The inaccurate control of vibration leads to the lower problem of concrete setting quality homogeneity.

title_en: PDIV testing device and method capable of achieving intelligent temperature rise
abstract_en: The invention discloses a PDIV testing device capable of realizing intelligent temperature rise, which can be applied to a variable frequency motor and comprises a three-phase alternating current voltage source, a control module, a current-passing circuit, a booster circuit, a temperature sensor and an ultrahigh frequency sensor, wherein the three-phase alternating current voltage source, the control module, the current-passing circuit, the booster circuit, the temperature sensor and the ultrahigh frequency sensor are electrically connected with each other. Compared with the conventional detection method, the device obviously reduces the workload of testing the insulation partial discharge starting voltage of the motor, so that the detection of the PDIV is more efficient and reliable.

title_en: Central control system of intelligent exhibition hall
abstract_en: The invention discloses a central control system of an intelligent exhibition hall, which particularly relates to the field of control systems and mainly comprises a single chip microcomputer, a data acquisition module, an equipment control module and a display module, wherein the single chip microcomputer is an STM32 chip and is used for processing acquired exhibition hall information data, controlling equipment and a control display screen and outputting a control instruction to control a relay, and the single chip microcomputer comprises a CPU (central processing unit), an interaction module, a port, a serial port, a WIFI (wireless fidelity) module and the like; the data acquisition module is used for acquiring the flow rate, the temperature and humidity, the smoke smell, the illumination degree and the volume of people in the exhibition hall; the equipment control module is used for managing a display screen, light, a loudspeaker, a heating and ventilating device, a projector and an entrance guard in the exhibition hall; the display module is a liquid crystal display screen and displays information and pictures in the exhibition hall in a webpage form. The number of people is detected through a target detection algorithm, namely, fast RCNN, real-time data of the flow of people in the exhibition hall and the number of people in the exhibition hall are obtained, and the flow of people in the exhibition hall and the number of people in the exhibition hall can be managed.

title_en: Fault monitoring method for industrial process under cloud edge end cooperation based on probability graph model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fault monitoring method of an industrial process under cloud side cooperation based on a probability graph model, which is used for constructing a factory-level distributed fault monitoring and tracing three-layer framework under the cloud side cooperation environment facing a complex industrial process, realizing dimension reduction and decomposition of complex data at a device side, monitoring a subsystem local process at the side, fusing subsystem information at the cloud side and further completing overall fusion diagnosis of the whole industrial process. The method can improve the efficiency of fault diagnosis of a large-scale system, effectively reduce the complexity of subsystem information fusion and large-scale system fault diagnosis, and improve the accuracy and rationality of industrial process fault tracing.

title_en: Multi-agent path planning method based on deep reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a multi-agent path planning method based on deep reinforcement learning, which includes: setting a joint state space and a joint action space of the multi-agent system; designing a reward function aiming at the path planning problem to generate a combined reward; initializing the structure and parameters of a network model in a path planning method, and combining a current joint action space, a current joint state space, a current joint reward and a joint state space at the next moment obtained through information exchange among different agents into a tuple as a sample to be stored in an experience buffer pool; updating the state space of each agent at the current moment; comparing the number of samples in the experience buffer pool with a preset capacity, if the number of samples is smaller than the preset capacity, continuing to sample, otherwise, entering a reinforcement learning training stage, and updating parameters of the network model by a multi-step return method; and realizing multi-agent path planning by using the network model obtained by training.

title_en: Current output equipment, method, device, system and medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a current output device, a method, a device, a system and a medium, and relates to the technical field of circuit control. The multi-channel detection module in the equipment is connected with a plurality of single-phase power supply chips, the current temperature value and the current value of the chips are transmitted, and the type of at least one chip is different from that of the other chips. One end of the system control module is connected with the multi-path detection module, and the current value is adjusted according to the constraint condition obtained through the related parameters acquired in advance. And the current transformation compensation module is connected with the other end of the system control module to obtain the output current value of each chip and output current. The system control module obtains a current temperature value and a current value through the multi-path detection module, obtains and adjusts the current value according to constraint conditions, and obtains output current values of all chips and outputs current in the current conversion compensation module. The purpose of improving the user experience is achieved without being limited by a use scene under the condition that a plurality of chips are connected in parallel to supply power to a high-power load and the types of the chips are different.

title_en: Intelligent entrance guard management device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent entrance guard management device, which structurally comprises: the driving motor is horizontally fixed on the rear wall surface in the control box; the rotating wheel is fixed on a motor shaft of the driving motor. The rotating main rod is horizontally fixed on the front wall surface of the rotating wheel, and the right part of the rotating main rod penetrates through the opening of the control box and then is positioned outside the control box; the rotary main rod is provided with a through groove and a track groove which are distributed along the length direction of the rotary main rod; the counterweight is fixed at the left end of the rotating main rod, the telescopic fence is arranged in the through groove, a middle rotating shaft of the telescopic fence is positioned in the track groove, and the rotating shaft can slide in the track groove; the first elastic piece and the second elastic piece are sleeved on the rotating main rod and are respectively positioned at two ends of the telescopic fence; one end of the traction wire is connected with the rotating shaft, and the other end of the traction wire is connected with the rotating wheel. The entrance guard management device can effectively reduce the force arm between the entrance guard and the driving motor, so that the driving force required by the rotation of the entrance guard is effectively reduced.

title_en: Tourism specialty is with outdoor study teaching tool
abstract_en: The invention discloses an outdoor learning and teaching tool for tourism major, which comprises a tray body, wherein a plurality of liquid storage cylinders are arranged above the tray body, the sealing cover is arranged above the liquid storage cylinder, and the user adds water on the inner wall of the liquid storage cylinder respectively to increase the weight of the liquid storage cylinder, thereby helping the user to simulate various articles placed on the tray when the tray is used, avoiding the user from being hurt by dropping the articles on the tray when the user is unskilled in operation, and when the user exercises, the water in the liquid storage cylinders can be distributed through the arranged distribution mechanism, so that the weight distribution on the tray is changed, and then help the user to carry out the tray training under the multiple weight distribution condition on the tray, avoid the user to add water to the liquid storage cylinder repeatedly and pour water, be favorable to the user to master the tray skill fast.

title_en: Unmanned ship optimal path planning method based on reachable set
abstract_en: The invention provides an unmanned ship optimal path planning method based on a reachable set, which comprises the following steps: the method is an autonomous unmanned ship optimal path planning method taking a backward reachable set as a constraint, visualizes the expected behavior state of a target ship, determines an autonomous ship safety area with uncertain system input and running states, solves the problems of automatic generation and evaluation of paths, combines the advantages of a direct search algorithm, and improves the reliability and safety of the algorithm.

title_en: Alarm device of grounding wire
abstract_en: The application discloses alarm device of earth connection includes: the utility model provides an insulator spindle, ground clamp and alarm, the one end swing joint of ground clamp and insulator spindle, the ground clamp includes U type wire clamp body, two electrically conductive clamping pieces and two movable parts, the internal surface of U type wire clamp body is equipped with U type groove, two electrically conductive clamping pieces set up in the U type region of U type wire clamp body relatively, and the both ends of two electrically conductive clamping pieces all set up at U type inslot, two movable parts set up respectively between a slice electrically conductive clamping piece and U type wire clamp body, the ground clamp is used for fixed earth connection, the alarm is fixed on the insulator spindle, and ground clamp and alarm electric connection, the alarm is used for sending alarm signal when the ground clamp is close to and has the electric current. When the operator installs the grounding wire, the power supply is not turned off, and when the operator approaches the grounding wire with current, an alarm is given to prompt the operator that the grounding wire is electrified, namely the power supply of the grounding wire is not turned off.

title_en: AAO process biological pond flow impeller optimization control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optimization control method for an AAO process biological pool impeller, wherein a monitoring system monitors production data acquired from a PLC control system in real time, and an optimization algorithm control unit can calculate and control the minimum number of opening impellers in real time. The method comprises the steps of constructing a model with the minimum number of the flow pushers required by normal operation of the biological pond, monitoring the operation states of the biological pond and the flow pushers in real time through a PLC control system, correcting and optimizing the established model, and configuring the operation mode and the optimal combination mode of the flow pushers in real time; and correcting and optimizing the initial minimum opening number model of the flow pushers, and regulating and controlling each flow pusher in the biological tank according to the processed minimum opening number model of the flow pushers.

title_en: Autonomous navigation system and method for field inspection robot of buried pipeline
abstract_en: The invention provides an autonomous navigation system and method for a field inspection robot of a buried pipeline, wherein the autonomous navigation system comprises an upper computer visual data processing module, an external environment multi-element sensing module, a multi-element sensor information interaction storage module, a bottom driving execution module and an electromagnetic holographic detection module, an overground and underground electronic map corresponding to an inspection area is firstly established, the electronic map is initialized, an inspection robot motion planning strategy is established and solved according to road sign node information in the electronic map, and an inspection robot model is established to check pose information of the robot, and the inspection robot returns to or goes to the next inspection area after inspection is finished.

title_en: Underwater robot path tracking control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a path tracking control method for an underwater robot, which comprises the steps that an onboard controller receives a task control instruction generated and output by a shore-based controller and detects a target underwater area; if the dangerous area is the dangerous area, generating a local path through a slicing algorithm, and generating an expected path based on the local path; if the safety area is the safety area, dividing the safety area into a plurality of sub-areas, and generating an expected path based on the local paths of the sub-areas; the onboard controller is configured to execute a guidance algorithm to obtain a desired heading angle corresponding to the desired path, the onboard controller is configured to control the vehicle body to move such that the vehicle body tracks the desired path with the desired angular velocity and the desired heading angle generated by the guidance algorithm as a control target, and a motion control algorithm is generated based on a CFDL-MFAC model. The invention can effectively resist the interference of wind, wave and flow under water, and has the condition of underwater navigation under complex sea conditions.

title_en: Gate hoist intelligent control system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent control system of a gate hoist, which relates to the technical field of automatic control and solves the technical problems that the gate control efficiency is low because the working environment of a gate is not considered and the linkage control with the surrounding environment cannot be realized in the gate control process in the prior art; according to the intelligent gate control system, the environment data of a target area in a gate distribution diagram are analyzed to obtain an environment tag, the environment tag and the water level data are combined to generate an intelligent regulation strategy, and after the intelligent terminal verifies the intelligent regulation strategy, the driving motor is controlled through the gate controller, so that the intelligent control of the gate is realized, the pressure of workers is reduced, and the control efficiency of the gate is improved; according to the invention, the gate distribution diagram is established through the cloud platform, the relevant data of each gate in the gate distribution diagram is displayed in time, and meanwhile, early warning is carried out in time according to the set early warning condition, so that the state of each gate is conveniently and remotely monitored by workers, a large amount of inspection work is reduced, and the safety is improved.

title_en: Terminal and device for measuring and alarming safety distance of operating personnel without power outage
abstract_en: The invention discloses a safe distance measuring and alarming terminal for operators without power outage, which comprises an installation shell, wherein the installation shell comprises six installation planes, the included angle between every two adjacent installation planes is 150 degrees, and each installation plane is provided with an ultrasonic distance measuring sensor; the mounting shell is also provided with a mounting base, and the mounting base is connected with a fixing clamp for clamping a wire; be equipped with singlechip, reputation early warning module and bluetooth communication module in the installation casing, every ultrasonic ranging sensor passes through 2 IO mouths with the singlechip and is connected, and an IO mouth is used for sending trigger signal to ultrasonic ranging sensor, and another IO mouth is used for receiving ultrasonic ranging sensor's detected signal, and reputation early warning module and bluetooth communication module are connected with the singlechip. The invention is suitable for monitoring the safety distance of the operating personnel in the uninterrupted operation of the overhead line in real time, and overcomes the defects of the existing safety monitoring mode.

title_en: Chocolate waterfall vending machine
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of vending machines and discloses a chocolate waterfall vending machine which comprises a supporting plate, wherein a refrigerator is fixedly installed on the top surface of the supporting plate, a refrigerator door is arranged on the front surface of the refrigerator, and a control screen is fixedly installed on the top surface of the supporting plate. According to the automatic chocolate waterfall machine, the robot is related to the PLC, the action setting of the robot is realized through the PLC, the opening and closing of the refrigerator door is controlled, the pressure sensing part is additionally arranged inside the placing frame, so that the automatic chocolate waterfall machine selling function is completed, the motor is matched to drive the screw conveying mechanism to start, target fruits selected by customers are taken out of the refrigerator and placed at the chocolate waterfall position for dipping, the manufacturing efficiency is greatly improved, the manufacturing accuracy is improved by adopting a robot manufacturing mode, errors caused by manual main pipe influence are avoided, in addition, the automatic manufacturing selling mode is adopted, the manpower input is avoided, the actual selling time is prolonged, the daily income is enlarged, and the using effect is good.

title_en: Positioning assistance system for materials handling vehicle
abstract_en: A materials handling vehicle is disclosed that includes a power unit, a load handling assembly, and a positioning assistance system that provides assistance to an operator driving the vehicle. The assistance provided by the positioning assistance system comprises at least one of an audible, tactile or visual cue to indicate at least one of: a distance from the vehicle to the boundary object; or the heading of the vehicle relative to the boundary object.

title_en: Hospital is with machine of helping oneself with self-sterilizer function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hospital self-service machine with an automatic disinfection function, which comprises a shell, wherein an operation groove is formed in the right side wall of the shell, a keyboard groove is formed in the inner bottom of the operation groove, a connecting block is fixedly connected to the right side wall of the shell, a card inlet groove is formed in the right side wall of the connecting block, the card inlet groove extends into the shell, a reciprocating cavity and a liquid storage cavity are formed in the shell, the liquid storage cavity is located on the left side of the operation groove, and the reciprocating cavity is located below the liquid storage cavity. When the user will be examined the card and insert the draw-in groove in, can drive degassing unit operation, disinfect to the keyboard that the user is about to use, prevent that last user from remaining the germ on the keyboard, after using the completion, examine the card and pop out the back from the draw-in groove, still can disinfect once to the keyboard, very big reduction the virus possibility of infecting between the user.

title_en: Formula of hiding AGV transfer robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a latent AGV (automatic guided vehicle) transfer robot, which comprises a box body and a reflective positioning mark, wherein a linear motor and a storage battery are arranged on the inner bottom surface of the box body, and the output end of the linear motor is connected with a supporting disc; support columns are arranged at four corners of the bottom surface of the box body, universal balls are arranged at the bottom ends of the support columns, a transverse support and a longitudinal support are arranged below the box body, transverse walking rollers are rotatably arranged in the transverse support, and longitudinal walking rollers are rotatably arranged in the longitudinal support; the matrix distribution of reflection of light locating mark is on warehouse ground, it is provided with the charging coil for sign one side to put light, the box bottom surface is provided with laser scanner, laser scanner one side is provided with picks up the coil. Has the advantages that: the walking direction is changed by utilizing the adjustment of transverse movement and longitudinal movement, the positioning is accurate, and the personalized route can be conveniently formulated; the device can be automatically charged in the moving process without queuing for charging, and the working efficiency is high.

title_en: Control method and device of intelligent chair, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a control method and device of an intelligent chair, computer equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: the intelligent chair is connected with an intelligent chair through a network, and an operation interface of the intelligent chair is displayed; the operation interface comprises a massage part option, candidate massage parameters and adjustment parameters under the massage part option; responding to a massage operation instruction triggered on the operation interface, selecting a target massage part from the massage part options, and determining massage parameters from the candidate massage parameters; controlling the intelligent chair to massage the target massage part according to the massage parameters; and responding to an adjusting operation instruction triggered on the operation interface, selecting a target adjusting parameter of the intelligent chair from the adjusting parameters, and controlling the intelligent chair to execute the service related to the massage according to the target adjusting parameter. By adopting the method, more interaction modes can be provided for the user, so that better intelligent chair control experience is provided for the user.

title_en: Drive control system of micro-nano robot cluster
abstract_en: The application discloses a drive control system of a micro-nano robot cluster, which relates to the technical field of micro-nano robots, wherein an upper computer module in the system identifies a real-time position of the cluster from a real-time image acquired by a vision module, an estimated value of a system state vector is obtained by expanding a state observer based on the real-time position of the cluster, a magnetic field direction angle and a magnetic field pitch angle can be obtained by using a direction controller and a force controller, and a magnetic field generated by a triaxial Helmholtz coil is controlled.

title_en: Stirring protection system of ice cream machine and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a stirring protection system of an ice cream machine and a control method thereof, comprising a voltage detection device, a control circuit, a refrigerating device and a stirring device; the control circuit comprises an MCU and a sampling resistor which are connected with each other; the detection end of the voltage detection device is connected with the stirring device, and is used for detecting a current signal of the stirring device and converting the current signal into a voltage signal through the sampling resistor, and the AD module of the MCU sets the voltage signal as a current working voltage signal of the stirring device; the output end of the voltage detection device is connected with the MCU so as to send a current working voltage signal to the MCU; MCU is connected with refrigerating plant and agitating unit respectively, and it is used for judging whether agitating unit reaches the threshold value of locked rotor according to current operating voltage signal, if, then control agitating unit and stop to control refrigerating plant and delay behind the settlement time and stop, make the soft or hard degree of ice cream not receive the influence of external environment temperature and raw and other materials, still avoid agitating unit to continue work because of stirring resistance is too big, cause the problem of damage.

title_en: Automatic discharging control and regulation system for feed mixer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a blanking automatic control and regulation system for a feed mixer, which is characterized in that: the system is divided into four parts, which are respectively: the feed part is an actuating mechanism for feeding materials from a raw material bin to the weighing device, and according to a weight control signal set by the system, the raw material bin discharges at full speed, and according to different characteristics of raw materials required by feed production, different feed devices are selected and used respectively, wherein the different feed devices comprise a flow valve, a feeder, a low material level sensor and a low material level alarm lamp. Has the advantages that: when the weighing part weighs the raw materials, the weighing information of the weighing sensor is sent to the PLC, and when the PLC controls the relevant part to act, the PLC controls the calculation module to add the weighing values each time, so that a worker can call the data and compare the data with the feeding data, and further obtain the loss rate of a single raw material.

title_en: Household behavior detection method and system based on double-layer privacy filtering mechanism
abstract_en: The invention relates to a home behavior detection method and system based on a double-layer privacy filtering mechanism, in particular to the technical field of computer vision and pattern recognition. The method comprises the following steps: processing the unprocessed household video by adopting a face blurring algorithm to obtain a blurred video; and performing skeleton feature extraction operation on the blurred video to obtain skeleton feature information, generating human skeleton video and a behavior recognition result according to the skeleton feature information, and checking the human skeleton video or the blurred video by a user according to the behavior recognition result and the authority. The invention can realize the safety monitoring of the elderly in the house on the premise of protecting personal privacy.

title_en: In-transit vehicle sensing method and device
abstract_en: The application discloses an in-transit vehicle sensing method and device, and belongs to the technical field of traffic control systems. The method comprises the following steps: determining an appointed road section to be monitored, and generating a sampling track of the appointed road section in the current monitoring time period through a plurality of sensing devices arranged on the appointed road section; the sampling track comprises a sampling position and sampling time of the specified road section; determining a road perception stage corresponding to the sampling track, and acquiring vehicle indication information of a specified road section according to a perception mode corresponding to the road perception stage; fitting to obtain an indication path corresponding to the vehicle indication information, and extracting road influence factors corresponding to a road perception stage from the vehicle indication information according to the path length of the indication path; and carrying out road analysis on the specified road section according to the road influence factor so as to obtain the in-transit vehicle information of the specified road section through constructing the obtained multiple linear regression model or the quantity of the indication paths.

title_en: Parking auxiliary guiding method based on external vision acquisition and two-dimensional code marking
abstract_en: The invention discloses a parking auxiliary guiding method based on external vision acquisition and two-dimension code marking, which is mainly designed in that under the condition that shooting equipment enough to cover a parking lot is arranged in a parking area, vehicle approach tracking is realized by identifying vehicles and license plates, the position and orientation of the vehicle are determined by utilizing the spatial relationship between a first two-dimension code which is preset on the ground of a non-parking space and contains coordinate and direction information and the vehicle to be parked, and meanwhile, the information of a vacant parking space is obtained by reading a second two-dimension code which contains position information; and selecting a target parking space for the to-be-parked vehicle and planning a guiding path reaching the target parking space by using the position of the to-be-parked vehicle, the estimated orientation and the information of the vacant parking spaces. The fusion parking guiding strategy of the two positioning two-dimensional codes of the external image and the parking lot provided by the invention does not need to additionally install positioning hardware on the vehicle, and greatly reduces the requirement on shooting equipment, so that the fusion parking guiding strategy is convenient to popularize and implement and is applied to various parking scenes.

title_en: Parking space management method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of parking spaces, and discloses a parking space management method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: generating a plurality of idle parking space map blocks according to parking space idle information issued by a parking space main terminal and a building distribution area; determining a target free parking space according to a parking space selection instruction sent by a tenant terminal and a plurality of free parking space map blocks; when a lease order of a target idle parking space is obtained, a target parking space main terminal issuing the target idle parking space is informed, so that a ground lock on the target idle parking space is unlocked by a tenant terminal according to a one-time dynamic password fed back by the target parking space main terminal; through the mode, after the lease order of the target idle parking space is obtained, the renter terminal unlocks the ground lock through the one-time dynamic password fed back by the target parking space main terminal, so that the rationality of parking space management can be effectively improved, complex communication with property is avoided, and convenient connection between a parking space main and a parking space demander is realized.

title_en: Mobile robot motion planning method and device based on optimal observation point sequence
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of mobile robots, and relates to a mobile robot motion planning method and device based on an optimal observation point sequence. The movement planning method taking information acquisition as the task background can combine the probability of information existing in different areas with other elements, judge the search priority of the different areas in the space through the topological semantic map, and reasonably search and acquire the target of the space.

title_en: Intelligent robot capable of being combined with environment inspection and route planning method thereof
