abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent inspection and discloses an intelligent robot capable of being combined with environmental inspection and a route planning method thereof, wherein the method comprises the following steps of S1: various inspection equipment, an on-site sensor, industrial video and the like on an inspection site directly receive on-site data and information; s2: the on-site online control and the real-time transmission of the inspection result to the switch of the network layer are realized through a wireless network and a background control system; s3: the exchanger sends the data to the technical platforms of the server and the workstation for storage and further development or display; s4: and the walking route of the inspection robot is planned in combination with the field environment, so that the comprehensiveness of inspection coverage is ensured. The intelligent robot capable of being patrolled and examined in combination with the environment and the route planning method thereof can analyze the patrolling and examining result of the robot, optimize the patrolling and examining route and patrolling and examining period of the robot, supplement the parts which can not be covered by the robot by arranging the video monitoring equipment and the hard disk video recorder on the patrolling and examining site, and ensure the comprehensiveness of the patrolling and examining coverage.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle routing inspection path optimization method
abstract_en: The application provides an unmanned aerial vehicle routing inspection path optimization method, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining longitude and latitude data of a plurality of monitoring points on the unmanned aerial vehicle inspection track through a high-precision map; solving an intermediate state routing inspection path formed by the monitoring points through an ant colony algorithm, wherein the shortest intermediate state routing inspection path solved by each iteration of the ant colony algorithm is used as a first routing inspection path; performing interchange operation on the first routing inspection path; updating the pheromone concentration on the path between the monitoring points according to a self-adaptive pheromone concentration updating mechanism, and adding one to the iteration times of the ant colony algorithm; judging whether the iteration times are larger than or equal to the maximum iteration times; and if the iteration times are larger than or equal to the maximum iteration times, determining the first patrol route with the shortest route distance as the optimal patrol route of the unmanned aerial vehicle. By the method, the technical problem that in the prior art, workers need to inspect the track in person is solved, and the technical effect of improving inspection efficiency is achieved.

title_en: Intelligent household remote control communication system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent home remote control communication system which comprises a lock body, wherein two symmetrically-positioned installation blocks are fixedly connected to the upper end surface and the lower end surface of the lock body; according to the invention, through the matching of the voice recognition component and the processing room, the unlocking mode combining the unlocking mode with the fingerprint recognition is started through voice input, the double encryption is realized, the safety performance is good, the remote unlocking and quick unlocking functions are realized, the unlocking speed is high, the practicability is strong, the sealed dust-proof processing is carried out under the condition of no-one use by utilizing the matching of the turnover shaft and the lower leaf plate, the service life of a device is prolonged, the pollution discharge processing can be carried out before fingerprint recognition is carried out each time by utilizing the matching of the cleaning wheel and the fingerprint recognizer, the efficiency and the accuracy of the fingerprint recognition are improved, and the device is clean and sanitary.

title_en: Vehicle warning method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vehicle warning method, a vehicle warning device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring first information to be used and second information to be used which are associated with the traffic element to be identified; determining the position to be used of the traffic element to be identified in the coordinate system to be used based on the first information to be used and the second information to be used; determining the distance to be used between the traffic element to be identified and the target vehicle according to the distance between the position to be used and the center of the coordinate system to be used; and when the distance to be used is larger than a preset distance threshold value, carrying out corresponding warning prompt based on a warning system installed in the target vehicle. The problem of inaccurate judgment of the distance between the traffic element and the target vehicle in the neighborhood of the target vehicle is solved, and the effect of accurately judging the distance between the traffic element and the target vehicle is achieved.

title_en: Variable parameter intelligent adjustment high-speed railway base filler vibration compaction method and system
abstract_en: A vibration compaction method and system for intelligently adjusting variable parameters of roadbed filler comprises the steps of feeding back dry density of filler in real time on the basis of obtaining continuous deformation sedimentation data of an indoor vibration compaction test, further analyzing natural frequency of the filler, realizing intelligent adjustment of vibration parameters, and establishing a vibration compaction intelligent online system for high-speed rail filler. The invention solves the problems that the vibration parameters are fixedly adjusted in the traditional vibration compaction process, a method for adjusting the vibration parameters in real time is lacked, the dry density cannot be monitored in real time in the traditional indoor vibration compaction test, the workload is large, the test efficiency is low and the like. The invention realizes the real-time dry density test, dynamically generates the compaction curve, and realizes the real-time compaction performance analysis; the vibration parameters are adjusted in real time in the testing process, and the problem that the current indoor vibration compaction needs to be provided with a plurality of groups of tests to carry out the maximum dry density test, and the test dry density is lower than that of the field vibration road roller is effectively solved.

title_en: Icing early warning method and system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses an icing early warning method and system, belonging to the technical field of weather early warning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining a numerical forecast product corresponding to a target area in a target period, obtaining micro-terrain data of the target area, determining meteorological element forecast data of the target area based on the numerical forecast product and the micro-terrain data, determining meteorological element thresholds of different levels corresponding to the target area, and determining an early warning level corresponding to the target area in the target period based on the meteorological element forecast data and the meteorological element thresholds of different levels.

title_en: Method for realizing elevator scene detection based on visual intelligent recognition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for realizing elevator scene detection based on visual intelligent identification, which comprises the following steps: s1, acquiring video data in the elevator based on the camera equipment, and establishing a parameter model for opening/closing the door in the elevator car; s2, collecting video data in the on-site elevator based on the camera equipment, and judging the current state of the door in the elevator car according to the parameter model; and S3, performing alarm or other artificial processing according to the judgment result of the steps.

title_en: Multi-functional english is with training room with english teaching equipment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of training room equipment, in particular to a multifunctional English training room with English teaching equipment, which aims at solving the problem that the question to be raced is easy to be raced to be answered by hands or questions simultaneously in the process of English learning, training and answering, and is easy to cause disorder. The lifting plate can restore to the original position under the elastic force action of the third spring, so that people can use the lifting plate for the next time, confusion generated when the people answer the question is effectively reduced, and the lifting plate is convenient for people to use.

title_en: Mutual detection redundancy no-missing-step implementation scheme for PLC
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mutual detection redundancy no-missing-step implementation scheme of a PLC, which comprises the following steps: step 1: and a main CPU, an auxiliary CPU, a main power supply and an auxiliary power supply are respectively distributed in a PLC control box of a product. Has the advantages that: the invention ensures the orderly operation of the product PLC by combining the CPU redundancy technology and the power redundancy technology, on one hand, the quick access of the main CPU after the fault and the auxiliary CPU can be realized by a synchronous monitoring and updating mode, the defect that the logic control information is lost when the product PLC switches the logic control is effectively avoided, the product PLC can be synchronously put into use in real time after the logic control is switched, on the other hand, the automatic switching of the power supply of the product PLC under the condition of accidental power failure is realized by the synchronous monitoring mode, the normal operation of the product PLC under the condition of accidental power failure is convenient, thereby greatly improving the capability of the product PLC for resisting the sudden fault and ensuring the operation stability of the product PLC.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle runway conflict autonomous early warning system
abstract_en: The invention provides an unmanned aerial vehicle runway conflict autonomous early warning system which has ADS-B broadcasting capability, ADS-B receiving capability, runway conflict autonomous early warning capability and conflict avoidance capability. The invention can realize that the unmanned aerial vehicle can automatically and accurately sense the traffic situation of the airport scene, thereby realizing the autonomous early warning of the unmanned aerial vehicle on the runway conflict.

title_en: Intelligent teaching aid system based on intelligent sensing equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses an intelligent teaching aid system based on intelligent sensing equipment, which belongs to the field of teaching and comprises a main control part, a plurality of detection parts and a plurality of prompting parts, wherein each detection part corresponds to one prompting part one by one, each detection part comprises a camera for detecting a learning state, the learning state of students can be monitored through the cameras, the students can be prompted to concentrate attention by sending out flash lamps or other lighting effects through lighting devices, the volume of teaching of a teacher can be automatically adjusted according to the noise in a classroom, the integral automation degree is high, the load of the teacher is reduced, and the teaching efficiency is improved.

title_en: Contactless voltage stabilizing circuit based on multi-stage compensation and circuit driving method
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a contactless voltage stabilizing circuit based on multi-stage compensation and a circuit driving method in the technical field of power supply voltage stabilization, comprising a controller, a plurality of first single-stage voltage stabilizing sub-circuits and second single-stage voltage stabilizing sub-circuits which are connected in series; the first single-stage voltage-stabilizing sub-circuit comprises a compensation transformer and a bidirectional thyristor, and the second single-stage voltage-stabilizing sub-circuit comprises a first voltage-regulating transformer, a second voltage-regulating transformer, a compensation transformer and a bidirectional thyristor; the first voltage regulating transformer is respectively connected with the bidirectional controllable silicon in the first single-stage voltage stabilizing sub-circuit, the second voltage regulating transformer is connected with the compensating transformer in the second single-stage voltage stabilizing sub-circuit, and the compensating transformer in the second single-stage voltage stabilizing sub-circuit and the compensating transformers of the plurality of first single-stage voltage stabilizing sub-circuits are in a series loop; and a plurality of control signal output ends of the controller are connected with the control electrode of each bidirectional thyristor in the first single-stage voltage-stabilizing sub-circuit and the control electrode of each bidirectional thyristor in the second single-stage voltage-stabilizing sub-circuit.

title_en: Emergency lane occupation behavior identification system, method and terminal equipment
abstract_en: The application is suitable for the technical field of radar signal processing, and provides a system, a method and terminal equipment for identifying emergency lane occupation behaviors, wherein the system comprises the following components: at least two road side monitoring modules, at least one road side processing module and a central control module, the road side monitoring module is used for identifying first vehicle information and second vehicle information of each vehicle; the road side processing module is used for collecting multi-frame static echo signals; receiving first vehicle information and second vehicle information and performing fusion processing to obtain vehicle fusion information; the central control module is used for determining a road side edge line according to the static echo signal and determining an emergency lane area according to the road side edge line; when the vehicle is detected to be positioned in the emergency lane area, the running state of the vehicle is identified according to the vehicle fusion information, and corresponding warning information is generated. The application detects the emergency lane occupation behavior based on the laser fusion information, has low cost and small calculated amount, and improves the recognition efficiency, recognition precision and stability.

title_en: Intelligent traffic light's of transform water conservancy diversion direction installation device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent traffic light installation device capable of changing a flow guide direction, which structurally comprises a buffering elastic piece, an installation rod, a supporting device, a balancing weight, a fixed seat and a traffic light.

title_en: Cu determination based on Schiff method 2+ Experimental device for ion transference number
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of experimental equipment, and discloses a method for measuring Cu based on a Schiff method  2+  The experimental device for the ion migration number comprises a base, a support rod, a first cross rod, a second cross rod, a third cross rod, a first hoop, a second hoop, a third hoop, a first glass tube, a second glass tube, a third glass tube, a first silica gel plug, a second silica gel plug, a third silica gel plug, a fourth silica gel plug, a fifth silica gel plug, a sixth silica gel plug, a first latex tube, a first water stopping clamp, a second latex tube, a second water stopping clamp, a first copper wire, a second copper wire, a coulometer and an ion migration number measuring device. According to the invention, by designing the vertical straight migration tube, three areas of solution are immediately separated after electrolysis, so that the ion convection effect and diffusion effect of the solution caused by gravity and the like are avoided. The pipeline resistance is small, the problem of large solution heating in the electrolytic process is reduced, the cost performance is high, the operation is simple, and the precision and the accuracy of the test result are better than those of the traditional method.

title_en: Computer readable storage medium, information processing method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a computer readable storage medium, an information processing method and a system. The object is to appropriately detect a fall of a saddle-type vehicle by a portable terminal. In addition, another object is to appropriately detect a fall even when the communication connection between a portable terminal held by a rider and the saddle-ridden vehicle is disconnected when the saddle-ridden vehicle falls. A second portable terminal capable of wirelessly communicating with the saddle-type vehicle and the first portable terminal receives information indicating a moving speed of the saddle-type vehicle from the saddle-type vehicle. Information indicating a first communication state of a communication state between the saddle-type vehicle and the first portable terminal is acquired. If the moving speed of the saddle-ride type vehicle is equal to or higher than a predetermined speed based on the received information, and if the first communication state is interrupted, it is determined that the saddle-ride type vehicle falls down.

title_en: Data correction device, data correction method, data correction program, and vehicle
abstract_en: Provided are a data correction device, a data correction method, a data correction program, and a vehicle. A data correction device for correcting data indicating the position of an area dividing line included in map data stored in divided areas includes: a data acquisition unit (411) that acquires map data including dot sequence data indicating the position of a1 st dashed line in a1 st region and dot sequence data indicating the position of a2 nd dashed line corresponding to the 1 st dashed line in a2 nd region adjacent to the 1 st region; a position correction section (412) that corrects the dot data so that the 1 st and 2 nd division lines represented by the dot sequence data are smoothly connected at the boundary when the positions represented by the dot data of the end portions on the boundary side of the 1 st and 2 nd division lines are deviated from each other; and a position data output unit (413) for outputting point sequence data indicating the position of the scribe line including the corrected point data indicating the position near the boundary.

title_en: Recording method and device for vehicle emergency state and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a recording method and device for an emergency state of a vehicle and electronic equipment. Specifically, the recording method includes: acquiring vehicle environment information; the vehicle environment information is acquired through an environment perception sensor, and comprises position information of the environment perception sensor and environment information of the position; determining a vehicle state according to a preset rule and the vehicle environment information; responding to the vehicle environment information to trigger an emergency state, wherein the emergency state is not released within preset time, and adjusting the camera and recording the emergency state according to the position information of the environment perception sensor triggering the emergency state and the corresponding environment information. The emergency state is monitored in advance by means of vehicle environment information, the camera is adjusted according to the position information of the environment sensing sensor triggering the emergency state and the corresponding environment information, automatic recording of the emergency state is achieved, and accuracy and reliability of recording quality are effectively guaranteed.

title_en: Control method of unmanned supermarket control system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of intelligent control system terminals, in particular to a control method of an unmanned supermarket control system. The control method comprises the steps of system initialization, network card self-checking and equipment debugging; if the network card core module is not connected to the network server, the network card core module gives an alarm through a buzzer which is electrically connected with the network card core module, and error information is displayed on an oled screen which is connected with the network card core module; the main control unit of the control system adopts a single chip microcomputer, the function setting is simple, the cost performance is higher, the control system is not easy to damage, and the service life is long; the whole circuit of the single chip microcomputer is in a modular design, so that the single chip microcomputer is simple to maintain and convenient to install and replace; the control panel integrates various modules and wiring terminals, and the integration level is high; compared with the prior art, the hardware investment cost of the unmanned supermarket is lower, the normal operation of the unmanned supermarket is guaranteed, the unmanned supermarket is more convenient and fast even in the attempt of refitting the existing artificial storefront supermarket into the unmanned supermarket, only the existing facilities in the shop need be connected to the control main board wiring terminal, and the cost is lower.

title_en: Automatic driving system test method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a method and a device for testing an automatic driving system, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the field of automatic driving. The automatic driving system testing method comprises the following steps: in response to the fact that the parameters of any one control which is touched or collected are detected to change, generating current first control parameters according to the parameters of the touched or collected control; format conversion is carried out on the first control parameter by using a format conversion module so as to generate a second control parameter which can be identified by the test platform; and sending the second control parameter to the test platform, so that the test platform sends the second control parameter to the corresponding automatic driving function subsystem. Therefore, the automatic driving functional subsystems can convert data which can be identified by the automatic driving functional subsystems into data which can be identified by the test platform, so that the test platform sends the data to other automatic driving functional subsystems, data interaction among the functional subsystems which process data in different formats is realized, and synchronous test of different types of development objects in the automatic driving systems is realized.

title_en: Wisdom guiding device for traffic
abstract_en: The invention provides a flow guiding device for intelligent traffic. The intelligent traffic diversion device comprises a storage battery, a supporting mechanism, a fixing mechanism, a mounting mechanism, a main body and a connecting mechanism, wherein the connecting mechanism comprises a supporting plate, a binding post, a compression rod, a rubber plug, a second spring, a sealing plug, a metal ring and a metal block, the spherical rubber plug is arranged at the top end of the binding post, the sealing plug is symmetrically and slidingly connected with the side wall of the rubber plug in an arc shape, the side walls of the rubber plug and the sealing plug are symmetrically and slidingly connected with the compression rod, the metal ring is symmetrically arranged at the bottom end of the compression rod, the metal block is symmetrically arranged in the binding post, the metal block is slidingly connected with the side wall of the metal ring, the second spring is symmetrically arranged in the rubber plug, and the second spring is connected with the side wall of the sealing plug. The intelligent traffic guiding device provided by the invention has the advantages of quick installation and convenient use.

title_en: Fuzzy self-adaptive NMPC track tracking control and energy management method
abstract_en: The application provides a fuzzy self-adaptive NMPC (non-uniform network computer) track tracking control and energy management method, and provides a double-layer fuzzy self-adaptive NMPC coordination control framework, in order to utilize solar energy to the maximum, the track tracking control and the energy management are decoupled into an upper layer fuzzy self-adaptive NMPC (H-FNMPC) and a lower layer fuzzy self-adaptive NMPC (L-FNMPC) by taking the residual required power as a separation point; the H-FNMPC carries out the track tracking control of the maximum solar energy benefit, and the L-FNMPC carries out the power distribution of the energy system with the minimum equivalent hydrogen consumption; thereby realize hybrid electric unmanned aerial vehicle's energy management.

title_en: Experimental model device for simulating operation of gravity compressed air energy storage system
abstract_en: The invention aims to provide an experimental model device for simulating the operation of a gravity compressed air energy storage system, which can be used for truly restoring the gravity compressed air energy storage system according to a certain proportion and simulating various working conditions of the gravity compressed air energy storage system, effectively and comprehensively researching the pneumatic performance, the security device, the eccentric weight influence and the integral operation performance of a gravity pressing block-air storage in the gravity compressed air energy storage system, optimizing the arrangement scheme of the gravity compressed air energy storage system and laying a solid theoretical foundation for the construction of the gravity compressed air energy storage system.

title_en: Composite anti-interference controller and control parameter optimization method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electro-hydraulic servo control of airplane steering engines, and provides a composite anti-interference controller and a control parameter optimization method thereof, wherein the method comprises the following steps: performing Laplace transformation on the composite anti-interference controller to generate each transfer function of a frequency domain; generating a vector of parameters ρ = [ b, ω) to be optimized  c  ,ω  o  ,k  f1  ,k  f2  ]The system input-output relationship function of (1); defining an optimization index function; obtaining an output force signal y  t  (i) And a command force signal r  t  (i) Tracking error e of  t  (p) and a control input signal u  t  (p) determining a theoretical optimal solution of the parameter vector p to be optimized for the gradient value of the optimal parameter vector. Based on the design of a feedback controller in the composite disturbance rejection controller, the problem that the accurate model information of a controlled object is excessively depended on is solved, and meanwhile, the accuracy and the phase characteristics of the system are improved based on a feedforward controller.

title_en: Dangerous early warning method, early warning device and early warning system for chemical device
abstract_en: The application provides a chemical device danger early warning method, an early warning device and an early warning system, wherein the early warning comprises the following steps: determining a device hazard value of a chemical device and a hazard value of a hazard object produced and/or stored by the chemical device; determining a process hazard value of the chemical device according to the hazard value of the dangerous goods; determining a total hazard value of the chemical plant device according to the hazard value of the hazardous article, the hazard value of the device and the process hazard value; and outputting corresponding early warning information according to the total hazard value. The method provided by the application can comprehensively calculate the total hazard value of the chemical device according to different hazard factors, improves the accuracy of calculating the total hazard value of the chemical device, outputs real-time early warning according to the total hazard value, timely reminds field operators and related operators, ensures that the abnormality of the chemical device is found in advance and the hazard is timely controlled, thereby protecting the personnel safety and preventing the occurrence of safety accidents.

title_en: Medical oxygen leakage detection monitoring and early warning system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a medical oxygen leakage detection monitoring and early warning system and a method, which relate to the technical field of medical gas detection and comprise an oxygen detection module, a data transmission module and a monitoring and early warning platform; the oxygen measuring module comprises a gas suction pipeline and an oxygen measuring instrument, wherein the gas suction pipeline is used for sucking a gas sample in the space to be detected into the oxygen measuring instrument through a fine pipe which can extend into the narrow space to measure the oxygen content; the data transmission module is used for transmitting the oxygen content data detected by the oxygen detector to the monitoring and early warning platform through a network; and the monitoring and early warning platform is used for storing and analyzing the acquired oxygen content detection data and carrying out alarm processing when the monitoring data is abnormal. The method adopts the mode of Internet of things, monitors the concentration change of the real-time oxygen content in the closed and narrow space, transmits data to the monitoring and early warning platform, and prompts and early warns when abnormal, thereby achieving the purpose of preventing accidents caused by the change of the oxygen concentration.

title_en: Chemical adding control system and method for industrial sewage treatment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a chemical adding control system and method for industrial sewage treatment. The technical problems that the drug effect is unstable and the like caused by the fact that the drug dosage cannot be controlled in the prior art are solved. The sewage treatment device comprises a sewage pipe, the sewage pipe is connected with a dosing execution device through a dosing pipe, the dosing execution device is connected with a sensing device, the sensing device is communicated with a control device in a two-way mode, the sensing device is respectively connected with a plurality of feedforward sensors which are respectively communicated with the sewage pipe and are positioned at the front side of the dosing pipe communicated with the sewage pipe in parallel and a plurality of feedback sensors which are respectively communicated with the sewage pipe and are positioned at the rear side of the dosing pipe communicated with the sewage pipe in parallel, and the sensing device is also connected with a plurality of auxiliary sensors and a sewage flowmeter which are respectively communicated with the sewage pipe in parallel. Has the advantages that: through placing a plurality of main sensors and carrying out intelligent analysis, obtain the water quality fluctuation characteristic to the medicine volume calculation of carrying out multiple relevant parameter to the water quality fluctuation uses the trace to add the medicine mode when being less than the medicine flowmeter scope to medicine volume.

title_en: Flow control method and device based on pump valve joint adjustment
abstract_en: The application provides a flow control method and a flow control device based on pump valve joint adjustment, which relate to the technical field of rocket engine control, and the method comprises the following steps: acquiring the target flow of the current control period from the target flow instruction set; acquiring the downstream pressure of the regulating valve in the current control period; based on the target flow of the current control period and the downstream pressure of the regulating valve, the pump rotating speed and the valve opening degree of the current control period are obtained by utilizing a pre-established lookup table; controlling the operation of valves of the electric pump and the regulating valve according to the pump rotating speed and the valve opening of the current control period; and acquiring the real-time flow of an outlet valve of the regulating valve, and further regulating the opening of the valve by taking the valve opening of the current control period as a reference on the basis of the target flow and the real-time flow of the current control period. The flow control method has the advantages of high control precision, wide applicability and high stability.

title_en: Landslide earth surface crack integrated monitoring system based on Beidou communication
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide ground surface crack comprehensive monitoring system based on Beidou communication, and particularly relates to the field of geological disaster monitoring, because the damage degree of landslide has a certain trend, certain deviation may occur in a landslide area after a period of time, so that the arranged monitoring points may not be optimal after a period of time, and the monitoring effect is poor; therefore, the invention comprises an arrangement module, a monitoring module, an early warning module and a monitoring module; setting a landslide offset threshold according to the information of the landslide, determining whether the position of a monitoring point is in a normal area or not through the landslide offset threshold, and if the landslide offset exceeds the threshold, indicating that the monitoring point cannot well monitor the landslide area at the moment, and needing to rearrange the monitoring point according to the offset direction; on the one hand, monitoring accuracy of the monitoring points can be guaranteed, invalid monitoring of the monitoring points is avoided, and on the other hand, secondary monitoring can be carried out on the landslide in time according to the deviation of the landslide.

title_en: Liquid cooling control method and system for data center
abstract_en: According to the liquid cooling control method and the liquid cooling control system for the data center, the optimization variable of the temperature information of the equipment to be processed can be determined directly through the previously configured data optimization thread, the temperature information of the equipment to be processed is updated through the optimization variable, and the liquid cooling is controlled through the updated data to cool the data center. By the method, the position of the temperature anomaly can be accurately obtained, and the cooling accuracy is improved. On the other hand, the previously configured data optimization thread is configured by debugging the device temperature information, and the debugging device temperature information is obtained by debugging the first device temperature information, so that the problem of abnormal information interference of the device temperature information can be avoided as much as possible.

title_en: Regular false alarm judging method for photoelectric sensing equipment
abstract_en: A rule-type false alarm judging method for photoelectric sensing equipment comprises the following steps: in a learning mode, when a photoelectric sensing device acquires a recording event every day, the maximum electric signal intensity and the minimum electric signal intensity in a corresponding time interval are obtained; after the learning mode is released, the photoelectric sensing equipment counts the occurrence times of the recorded events in the same time interval, and if the occurrence times exceed the preset times, the photoelectric sensing equipment considers that the time interval is a multiple false alarm time interval; constructing a smoke rule base based on the maximum electric signal intensity and the minimum electric signal intensity in the multi-false alarm time interval; when the electric signal intensity of the photoelectric sensor reaches an alarm threshold, judging whether the current abnormal event is recorded in a smoke rule base, if so, misreporting, otherwise, starting an alarm. According to the invention, the smoke rule library is constructed as a comparison standard of smoke alarm, so that the false alarm rate is reduced, and the operation and maintenance cost in partial scenes is greatly reduced.

title_en: Pole-climbing monitoring equipment and method based on capacitance induction and charging pile power distribution system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pole-climbing monitoring device and method based on capacitance induction and a charging pile power distribution system, wherein the pole-climbing monitoring device comprises a power line pole; the power line pole comprises a pole body, an air inlet and a pole monitoring window; a capacitor installation cavity is formed in the wire pole main body, a capacitor approach induction assembly is arranged in the capacitor installation cavity, and the capacitor installation cavity is communicated to the outside of the power wire pole through an air inlet and a wire pole monitoring window respectively; the shell main body is stably assembled in the capacitor installation cavity, and the shell monitoring window and the wire rod monitoring window are correspondingly communicated; the capacitance proximity sensing piece and the shell monitoring window are correspondingly arranged; the capacitor proximity sensing piece is connected with the main control module of the PCB through a circuit, the main control module is connected with the NB-IOT module through a circuit, and the main control module is connected with the background server through a remote signal. The pole climbing monitoring device solves the problems that power supply configuration is incomplete, false triggering is easy to occur and the pole climbing monitoring device in the prior art is of an external structure.

title_en: Secondary water supply unattended operation networking monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of urban secondary water supply, and particularly relates to an unattended networked monitoring system for secondary water supply. The system comprises: the front-end comprehensive monitoring system is arranged in the secondary water supply pump station and is used for collecting and controlling the operating environment and working condition of secondary water supply equipment of the pump station; the comprehensive monitoring platform is used for receiving equipment and environment information reported by the pump station; and the transmission network is used for communication between the front-end integrated monitoring system and the integrated monitoring platform. The system can carry out centralized monitoring and unified management on the front-end system in a monitoring center, and protects driving and sailing for secondary water supply; the pump station can be controlled globally through a visualization technology, so that the image visualization of important stations of the pump station is realized, and the remote data, the field intellectualization and the unattended operation of important equipment of the pump station can be realized; meanwhile, the visual video rechecking is realized for the alarms of intrusion, fire, equipment abnormity and the like, and a related plan is realized.

title_en: Flight control system for vertical take-off and landing aircraft
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of flight control, and in particular discloses a flight control system for a vertical take-off and landing aircraft, which comprises the following components: the device comprises a data acquisition module, an obstacle detection module, an obstacle recheck module, an obstacle identification module, a distance measurement and calculation module and an aircraft control module. The invention acquires the image in the advancing direction, acquires the obstacle in the advancing direction and acquires the maximum size of the obstacle, thereby automatically controlling the aircraft to complete the avoidance of the obstacle, the operation difficulty of an operator is reduced, the collision between the aircraft and the obstacle is prevented, and the size of the shot video frames is adjusted, so that when each video frame is processed, the erroneous judgment of data caused by the size or the camera shake is avoided.

title_en: Blood simulation liquid for simulating coagulation process
abstract_en: The invention discloses a blood simulation liquid for simulating a blood coagulation process, which belongs to the technical field of blood simulation and comprises sodium carboxymethyl cellulose and polyaluminium sulfate, wherein the sodium carboxymethyl cellulose and the polyaluminium sulfate are subjected to flocculation reaction, and a reaction system of the flocculation reaction comprises a 10% gelatin solution, a 2% sodium carboxymethyl cellulose solution and a 10% polyaluminium sulfate solution; or comprises sodium carboxymethylcellulose powder and polyaluminium sulfate solution. The invention can simulate the whole process of blood coagulation, the material is easy to obtain, no biological hazard exists, the test solution is relatively stable, the operation is more convenient, and a relatively stable standard model for simulating the blood coagulation process is established by a chemical method and is used for research of instruments and factory calibration thereof.

title_en: Nine little places integration management platform based on thing networking cloud AI discernment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of smart power grids, in particular to a nine-small-place integrated management platform based on cloud AI (Internet of things) identification. The system comprises a sensing unit, a data transmission unit and a central early warning platform, wherein the sensing unit transmits signals to the data transmission unit through wireless communication, and the data transmission unit transmits the signals to the central early warning platform through wireless communication; the data transmission unit receives signals of the sensing unit and controls the stop and start of equipment in the sensing unit through data processing and wireless communication; the device avoids the personal safety and the property safety of residents due to the occurrence of electrical fire, monitors an electrical line in real time and gives an alarm for electrical potential safety hazards. Simple structure, reasonable in design.

title_en: Method, device, terminal and storage medium for controlling playing of media file
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a device, a terminal and a storage medium for controlling the playing of a media file, wherein the method comprises the following steps: in the process of playing the media file, when a first playback instruction from a user is received, setting a first parameter variable of the media file; determining a first playback time period; performing first playback based on the first playback time period, and displaying a first subtitle; and after the playback is finished, the subtitles are closed, and the media file is continuously played. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages that the subtitles of the corresponding content are displayed in the playback process, frequent switching between the media files with subtitle versions and the media files without subtitle versions is not needed, and learning convenience is improved; meanwhile, seamless connection between the playback content and the normally played content is realized, the learning efficiency of the user is improved, and the learning time of the user is reduced; in the learning process, all the contents can be learned in the whole process only by opening one media file, and the occupation of the computing resources of the playing terminal is reduced.

title_en: Vehicle detection method, device, equipment, medium and vehicle
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a vehicle detection method, a device, equipment, a medium and a vehicle. The vehicle detection method comprises the following steps: acquiring travel data of a second vehicle traveling around a first vehicle; determining a travel intention of the second vehicle based on the travel data of the second vehicle; and if the driving intention of the second vehicle is a congestion intention, determining that the second vehicle is a congestion vehicle, wherein the congestion intention represents that the second vehicle already enters the driving road range of the first vehicle or is about to enter the driving road range of the first vehicle. According to the embodiment of the disclosure, whether the second vehicle is a jammed vehicle can be quickly and accurately determined, so that a driver can timely make corresponding adjustment, and driving safety is improved.

title_en: File management device and using method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of file management, and provides a file management device and a using method thereof. The invention can carry out multiple verification on the user authority, and improves the safety of the paper archives.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle automatic airport route generation method applied to power transmission channel inspection
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of transmission channel inspection, in particular to a route generation method of an unmanned aerial vehicle automatic airport applied to transmission channel inspection. According to the invention, the longitude and latitude of each base tower are obtained through the teaching mode of the unmanned aerial vehicle, the inspection height of the unmanned aerial vehicle above each base tower is recorded, data are recorded in a database, when the inspection requirement of a tower channel is met, the id of the initial tower and the id of the final tower are input, the data of the longitude and latitude, the height and the like of the waypoints in the database are read through codes, the channel inspection route between the initial tower and the final tower is automatically generated, and actions such as task video recording are set, and when the unmanned aerial vehicle flies, clear channel inspection video can be obtained, so that the problem in a positioning channel can be found rapidly. The route generation method is suitable for locking and tracking hidden danger of the power transmission channel, is favorable for assisting operation and maintenance personnel to take next action on the hidden danger of the target, and is more intelligent, visual and multifunctional.

title_en: Face image display method, readable storage medium, program product, and electronic device
abstract_en: The application relates to a face image display method, a readable storage medium, a program product and an electronic device. The method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps that first electronic equipment obtains a first face image collected by a first camera at a first moment, and the face in the first face image is located at a first position; and the second electronic equipment displays a second face image, the second face image is an image obtained by transforming the first face image according to the imaging mapping relation between the first camera and the second camera, and the position of the face in the second face image is the same as the position of the face in the image acquired by the second camera at the first moment. By applying the method provided by the application, the position of the face in the preview image displayed by the second electronic equipment can be consistent with the position of the face in the face image shot by the second camera and used for face recognition, so that the position of the face in the preview image can accurately reflect the position of the face in the face image shot by the second camera, and the face input efficiency and accuracy can be improved.

title_en: Intelligent food oven temperature control system based on electric heating and oven
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent food oven temperature control system based on electric heating and an oven, and relates to the technical field of ovens, wherein the intelligent food oven temperature control system comprises an oven body, an oven area, an electric heater, a rotating assembly and a lifting assembly, wherein the oven body further comprises: the detection unit is used for detecting the baking progress of the food on the first baking tray and the second baking tray to form baking detection information; the processing unit is used for dividing the baked food into a plurality of areas, evaluating the baking progress according to the baking detection information, forming evaluation information if the baking is not finished, and forming a control strategy according to the evaluation information; the control unit receives the control strategy, forms a corresponding control command, and respectively controls the rotating assembly, the lifting assembly and the temperature control module; the position of food in the baking zone is adjusted, the highest temperature region in the baking zone is adjusted in the region which is not baked, the heating load of the electric heaters in other regions is reduced, and the waste of heat is reduced.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted unmanned aerial vehicle lifting equipment and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a vehicle-mounted unmanned aerial vehicle lifting device and an application method thereof, belonging to the technical field of vehicle-mounted unmanned aerial vehicles, the vehicle-mounted unmanned aerial vehicle lifting device and the application method thereof comprise a vehicle body, an unmanned aerial vehicle body and a lifting platform arranged on the vehicle body and used for lifting the unmanned aerial vehicle body, wherein a camera, a first infrared receiver and an irradiation part are arranged on the lifting platform; the unmanned aerial vehicle is shot for many times through the camera, and the distance between unmanned aerial vehicle and the camera and the reverse pivoted angle of unmanned aerial vehicle are calculated through the formula to make the unmanned aerial vehicle accurate remove to lift platform directly over, and first infrared transmitter and first infrared receiver cooperate when rotating through unmanned aerial vehicle, thereby can make unmanned aerial vehicle's direction fix a position, then unmanned aerial vehicle carries out vertical landing, thereby can make unmanned aerial vehicle accurate landing on lift platform.

title_en: Self-repairing fire early warning paint, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of self-repairing flame-retardant coatings, and relates to a self-repairing fire early-warning coating, a preparation method and application thereof. For fire early warning material Ti in the prior art  3  O  5  The invention provides a preparation method of a self-repairing fire early-warning paint, which can enter a combined dissociation-recombination mode at about 34-94.5 ℃ to further enable CS-BR-Ti to be in  3  O  5  The coating realizes the repair of various damages in the use process within 30 min. The application of the self-repairing fire early warning paint can realize at least 8 circulating early warning without damaging a base material (wood and the like).

title_en: Automatic energy-saving control system of electrical engineering suitable for thermal power plant
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic energy-saving control system for electrical engineering of a thermal power plant, and relates to the technical field of automation. An electrical engineering automation energy-saving control system suitable for a thermal power plant comprises: the prediction module is used for respectively determining the output predicted value of the thermal power generating unit, the output predicted value of the thermal power station and the power load predicted value at each prediction moment, and determining the plant-level AGC instruction predicted value of the thermal power plant at each prediction moment; the emission detection module is used for detecting sulfur dioxide, carbon monoxide, nitrogen dioxide, O2, dust, hydride, fluoride and mercuride, as well as temperature, flue gas flow, pressure, flue gas oxygen content and flue gas moisture content; the monitoring module is used for monitoring combustion state data in the boiler; and the full-power automatic energy-saving control module is used for calculating the calculated value of the active power of each thermal power plant generator set when the total standard coal consumption of the whole thermal power plant is minimum. The coal powder feeding control system can automatically control coal powder feeding amount and other control parameters.

title_en: Landslide hazard multi-monitoring-point fusion early warning method based on deformation order
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and discloses a deformation-based sensorAn orderly landslide hazard multi-monitoring point fusion early warning method comprises the following steps: acquiring deformation rates of monitoring sensors of a plurality of monitoring points of a landslide at preset moments; obtaining deformation rate information entropy H according to deformation rate calculation  V  (t); calculating deformation direction association entropy H for monitoring deformation direction and target deformation direction  D  (t); entropy H according to deformation rate information  V  State of (t) and deformation direction associated entropy H  D  And (t) acquiring a landslide early warning grade. According to the scheme, the deformation rate and deformation direction characteristics of different monitoring points on the same landslide body are utilized, so that the fusion utilization of multiple monitoring points is realized, and early warning and forecasting are carried out from the integral angle of the landslide, so that the omission and the deficiency of the existing early warning and forecasting method are avoided; and the deformation rate order and the deformation direction order are combined, an early warning basis is established, the early warning basis is complementary with the existing early warning model, and the reliability and the accuracy of disaster early warning and forecasting are improved.

title_en: Detection method, detection system and storage medium based on artificial intelligence early warning system
abstract_en: The invention provides a detection method based on an artificial intelligence early warning system, which comprises the following steps: and classifying the monitored objects, and selecting corresponding artificial intelligence models according to the classified categories. And selecting a training sample, and training the selected artificial intelligence model by combining manual adjustment of the residual error overrun trigger threshold range of each measuring point. And applying the trained artificial intelligence model to the monitored object. The detection method based on the artificial intelligent early warning system can reduce the false alarm rate and the missing report rate of the early warning system, so that the early warning system can better play a role. The invention also provides a detection system and a storage medium for executing the detection method.

title_en: Displacement measuring device and method based on circular grating sensor and circuit processing unit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a displacement measuring device and method based on a circular grating sensor and a circuit processing unit, wherein the displacement measuring device comprises front-end and rear-end two-stage processing of grating signals, the front-end processing mainly realizes first-stage optimization of the signals, the rear-end processing adopts a software technology to carry out second-stage compensation, and a signal processing module adopts an FPGA technology, so that the speed and the accuracy of signal processing can be greatly improved, and accurate measurement is guaranteed. By carrying out algorithm compensation on the sampling data, the accuracy of the displacement measuring device can be effectively improved. Aiming at error factors such as direct current component, constant amplitude, orthogonality and sine of a moire signal, a system framework of a front-end processing circuit and an adaptive compensation algorithm is designed. The digital subdivision of two kinds of modes is designed, one mode is selected through the dial switch according to the requirement of actual working conditions, the resolution ratio of measurement can be changed, the speed and the accuracy of signal processing can be greatly improved, and therefore the accurate measurement is guaranteed.

title_en: Intelligent control method and system for equipment, intelligent control equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to an intelligent control method and system for equipment, intelligent control equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: responding to a device control instruction, carrying out hierarchical division on a plurality of controlled devices according to relative position information between the controlled devices and a target position, and determining a control hierarchy corresponding to each controlled device; the controlled equipment is equipment capable of executing equipment control instructions; and according to the control hierarchy corresponding to each controlled device, sequentially controlling the corresponding controlled device to execute corresponding control processing operation until a control end condition is met. By adopting the method, the trial and error cost of the user for controlling the controlled equipment can be reduced, and the interaction cost among the equipment can be reduced.

title_en: Method, device and medium for determining electrical angle based on FPGA
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device and a medium for determining an electrical angle based on an FPGA, which are suitable for the technical field of intelligent control of motors. Based on the original lookup table, the method obtains the corresponding sine and cosine address index and address index supplement value according to the resolution of the lookup table of the RAM and the encoder to expand data, further determines the initial sine and cosine value by two values according to the time division multiplexing principle, and finally determines the final sine and cosine value to improve the accuracy of the sine and cosine value obtained by the electrical angle processing and improve the accuracy of the electrical angle. Compared with the prior sine and cosine values obtained only by a table look-up mode, the method and the device have the advantages that fewer FPGA resources are utilized, the minority data volume of the table is compensated to expand the data, and the sine and cosine values with higher precision are obtained.

title_en: Vehicle control method, device and system
abstract_en: The application discloses a vehicle control method, device and system, and relates to the technical field of automatic driving. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a topological relation of a road junction, wherein the topological relation is used for indicating a road associated with the road junction; determining the passing sequence of the target vehicle at the road junction according to the attribute information of the road junction, the state information of the target vehicle and the topological relation, wherein the target vehicle is positioned on an upstream road of the road junction; and indicating the passing of the target vehicle at the road junction according to the passing sequence. According to the method, the vehicles at the road intersection are sequenced in a passing mode, so that the conflict among the vehicles is reduced, the passing efficiency among the vehicles is improved, the ordered operation or passing among the vehicles is facilitated, and the overall operation efficiency of a fleet is improved.

title_en: Flexible temperature takeoff function implementation method and device
abstract_en: The application belongs to the field of thrust management, and relates to a flexible temperature takeoff function implementation method which comprises the steps of calling data in an airplane data storage module, and calculating a flexible temperature takeoff performance data table according to a flight plan of an airplane; determining takeoff characteristic speed data according to the flexible temperature initial value information, and sending the takeoff characteristic speed data to a thrust limit checking module; then checking whether the selected flexible temperature meets the thrust limit and a preset rule, if so, generating a flexible temperature instruction, transmitting the flexible temperature instruction to a control instruction generating module, and generating an engine working state control instruction and an accelerator lever position instruction by the control instruction generating module according to the received flexible temperature instruction and transmitting the engine working state control instruction and the accelerator lever position instruction to an engine control system and an accelerator lever control system respectively; the method provides comprehensive flexible temperature takeoff information for task execution personnel, enables flight execution personnel to fully know the takeoff safety margin, provides larger authority for determining flexible temperature values, and is higher in degree of freedom.

title_en: Lottery information processing method, device and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a lottery information processing method, a lottery information processing device and a computer readable storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps that a user self-defines the content of a lottery voucher text, the content is reported to a lottery center platform by a user terminal, the lottery center platform obtains hash seeds according to all the lottery voucher texts and issues the hash seeds to the user terminal, the user terminal obtains hash values by using the lottery voucher text and the hash seeds, when the hash values accord with the setting of winning hash values, the lottery voucher text is prompted to win, the lottery voucher text is determined to be won after being verified by the lottery center platform to be error-free, and the lottery center issues bonus money.

title_en: Short-range accurate guidance method based on model predictive control
abstract_en: A short-range accurate guidance method based on model predictive control relates to a solid fuel missile. The method comprises the following steps: 1) Establishing a re-entry guidance model and constraining; 2) Adopting linearization to optimize the reentry guidance model and the constraint convex; 3) Discretizing a state equation and constraint; 4) And the model prediction control algorithm restrains the control increment to realize the prediction of the model. The model need not be decoupled in advance. The model prediction control has the characteristics of prediction model and feedback correction, so that the model prediction control has larger tolerance degree to external disturbance and self various uncertainties and strong robustness. The model prediction control system has the characteristic of rolling optimization, and meets the requirement of real-time property. The traditional guidance problem is subjected to convex optimization, so that the control law obtained through the performance function J is the optimal control rate which meets the constraint of the performance function J in the feasible domain of the performance function J, and the requirement of reliable convergence is met.

title_en: Signal interaction control method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a signal interaction control method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: receiving a first low level signal sent by an upper computer; according to the first low level signal, after a starting instruction is received, connection with the upper computer is established, and screwing is started; sending the screwing data to the upper computer; and after the screwing is finished, sending a second low-level signal to the upper computer. The invention realizes signal interaction control and traceability of screwing data with the upper computer by receiving and sending low level signals and wirelessly connecting the low level signals with the upper computer.

title_en: Automobile door lock control system and method based on Internet of vehicles control platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automobile door lock control system and method based on an automobile networking control platform, which can realize the opening and closing control of an intelligent automobile door lock in a reliable and safe mode by means of the unpredictable, the non-falsifiable and the verifiable characteristics of a device independent quantum random number server and the high safety of a quantum key, and simultaneously allow automobile use information and door lock opening and closing information to be inquired safely and conveniently from a user side and an automobile side at any time without excessively occupying the resources of an intelligent automobile, thereby providing a safe keyless management scheme.

title_en: Traffic management safety diversion equipment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of traffic management and discloses traffic management safety diversion equipment which comprises a walking support seat, a lifting type traffic control display mechanism, an early warning change liquid intercepting mechanism, an early warning signal piezoelectric generating mechanism and a movable fixed point fixing mechanism, wherein the lifting type traffic control display mechanism is arranged in the middle of the upper wall of the walking support seat, the early warning change liquid intercepting mechanism is symmetrically arranged on two sides of the lifting traffic control display assembly, the early warning signal piezoelectric generating mechanism is symmetrically arranged on two sides of the lifting traffic control display assembly, and the early warning signal piezoelectric generating mechanism is arranged on the inner side of the early warning change liquid intercepting mechanism. The invention solves the problems that the arrangement of safety roadblocks can not be carried out according to different scenes, the intercepting and guiding length can not be adjusted according to specific road conditions, the situation that the roadblocks are not required to be called again due to incomplete arrangement or too many roadblocks are left unused and other resources are wasted, the dangerous situation of pedestrians can not be warned in time, and the pedestrians can cross the roadblocks and enter a dangerous area.

title_en: Diagonal rake path planning method, electronic device, and computer-readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a diagonal rake path planning method, electronic equipment and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the diagonal rake path planning method comprises the steps of firstly generating a closed area according to field information, then adjusting the boundary of the closed area to obtain an inner boundary of a path, then generating a plurality of operation reference lines distributed in a diagonal grid shape in the inner boundary of the path, and finally connecting the plurality of operation reference lines according to a preset operation sequence to obtain a diagonal rake path of an agricultural machine. The method and the device can automatically plan the optimal diagonal harrowing path for the field, and can obviously improve the harrowing operation coverage rate and the operation efficiency.

title_en: Attitude control method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses an attitude control method, an attitude control device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method and the device are applied to the electronic equipment for automatically controlling a cross twin-rotor unmanned helicopter, and specifically, a first parameter of a gyroscope, a second parameter output by an accelerometer, a third parameter output by RTK equipment and an organism angular velocity output by an inertial measurement unit are collected; resolving the first parameter, the second parameter and the third parameter to obtain an attitude angle of the crossed dual-rotor unmanned helicopter, wherein the attitude angle comprises a rolling angle, a pitch angle and a yaw angle; and processing the attitude angle and the body angular speed based on the cascade PID to obtain a body control quantity, wherein the body control quantity is used for being output to an attitude execution mechanism, so that the attitude execution mechanism can control the crossed double-rotor unmanned helicopter according to the body control quantity. The scheme of cascade PID is adopted in the application, so that the anti-interference capability is improved, and high-quality automatic control can be implemented on the attitude of the cross twin-rotor unmanned helicopter.

title_en: Inspection data processing method and device suitable for power transmission network
abstract_en: The invention provides a routing inspection data processing method and device suitable for a power transmission network, and the routing inspection data processing method and device comprises the steps of enabling a server to verify a first identity identification code and a second identity identification code to obtain an identity verification result, extracting first routing inspection data uploaded by a first routing inspection terminal in a preset time period, determining a first routing inspection starting point and a first routing inspection end point corresponding to the first routing inspection data, enabling all first routing inspection information in the first routing inspection data to correspond to a first node in a first routing inspection path, adding the first identity identification code to the first routing inspection path, enabling second routing inspection information in second routing inspection data uploaded by a second routing inspection terminal to correspond to a second node of the second routing inspection path, generating a total routing inspection information corresponding table by counting all first routing inspection information and second routing inspection information in a spliced routing inspection path, and analyzing and processing the total routing inspection information corresponding table to obtain a routing inspection result.

title_en: Timing device for starting aircraft engine
abstract_en: The application relates to a timing device for starting an aircraft engine, which belongs to the technical field of aircraft power devices and comprises a shell component; a circuit board assembly disposed within the housing assembly for generating a timing signal required for starting an aircraft engine triggered by an external signal; an interface component arranged on the shell component and used for providing an interface for the external signal input and the timing signal output; the circuit board assembly comprises a main circuit board bearing a timing sequence control main circuit, and the timing sequence control main circuit is realized on the basis of a main timing sequence control circuit, a photoelectric coupling circuit and a relay circuit. The technical scheme of this application adopts the electronic circuit mode based on the electron timing principle, realizes aircraft engine and starts the chronogenesis device, compares current mechanical type and starts the chronogenesis mechanism, has better reliability and stability.

title_en: Tail gas pressure balance control system of yellow phosphorus electric furnace
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of yellow phosphorus electric furnaces, and particularly relates to a tail gas pressure balance control system of a yellow phosphorus electric furnace, which comprises a yellow phosphorus electric furnace, wherein a tail gas outlet end of the yellow phosphorus electric furnace is communicated and installed with a spray tower through a guide pipe, an outlet end at the top side of the spray tower is communicated and installed with a deep purification mechanism through a guide pipe, an outlet end of the deep purification mechanism is communicated and installed with an insertion pipe, and the insertion pipe is hermetically inserted and connected at the inner side of a sodium hydroxide solution tank. According to the invention, the collected fuel gas is sequentially conveyed to the first collecting box, the second collecting box and the third collecting box by opening the corresponding one-way electromagnetic valves, so that the fuel gas in one group of collecting boxes can be ensured to be used, the other group of collecting boxes can continue to collect the gas, the tail gas can be purified for secondary use, and the redundant gas is conveyed into the combustion chamber by the multiple groups of collecting boxes and the combustion chamber under the condition that the multiple groups of collecting boxes fully collect the gas, so that the pressure balance in the tail gas collecting process is ensured.

title_en: Single-core double-shaft transposition locking mechanism embedded controller
abstract_en: A single-core double-shaft transposition locking mechanism embedded controller comprises a DSP signal processor, an RDC (remote data center) rotation digital converter, a transposition motor driver, a locking motor driver, an IV (fourth to fourth) conversion circuit, an IO (input/output) interface circuit and a serial communication circuit; the DSP signal processor is used as a single control core to carry out external signal acquisition, processing and control output; the RDC rotary variable digital converter is used for generating an excitation signal and converting an angle measurement signal of the rotary transformer; the indexing motor driver and the locking motor driver both adopt a digital PWM driving module to drive a motor to rotate; the IV conversion circuit converts feedback current signals of the indexing motor driver and the locking motor driver into voltage signals for the DSP signal processor to collect. The invention realizes full digital control, improves the anti-interference performance of a control loop, reduces the number of integrated chips, greatly reduces the size and volume of a circuit board and improves the integration level and reliability of the controller.

title_en: Parking lot navigation method and device, electronic equipment and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a parking lot navigation method, a parking lot navigation device, electronic equipment and a computer-readable storage medium, wherein the current position and the target position of a user are obtained, and the target position is a position determined according to the current requirement of the user in a parking lot; generating a navigation route between the current location and the target location based on the parking lot map; and controlling the holographic projection device closest to the current position to project and display the navigation route. The parking lot navigation method can display the navigation route in real time according to the current requirements of the user, and improves the operation efficiency and user experience of the parking lot.

title_en: Ground net ground resistance detects auxiliary device based on unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle-based ground network ground resistance detection auxiliary device, which relates to the field of power maintenance and comprises a flight module, a control module and a rotation module; the flight module comprises a mounting seat and a blade; the control module comprises a microprocessor and a signal receiver, the microprocessor is respectively connected with the flight module and the rotation module, and the signal receiver is positioned at the top end of the control module; the rotating module comprises a connecting piece, a motor, a flange plate and a ground resistance tester, a high-definition camera, a laser radar, a GPS unit and a ground resistance tester are arranged inside the connecting piece, and the microprocessor is electrically connected with the motor, the high-definition camera, the laser radar and the GPS unit respectively. This scheme is for traditional scheme, has realized that the flight mode based on unmanned aerial vehicle is assisted transformer substation's earth mat ground resistance detection, very big improvement work efficiency, and it is more convenient to operate.

title_en: Safety control method, safety control circuit and safety control system of robot
