abstract_en: The application relates to the field of safety control of robots, and discloses a safety control method, a safety control circuit and a safety control system of a robot, wherein the safety control circuit is provided with a plurality of input interface circuits, the input interface circuits can be accessed to safety input equipment, and the safety control method comprises the following steps: determining first type information of a safety input device accessed by an input interface circuit; generating a test signal based on the first type information; transmitting the test signal to the input interface circuit, and receiving a feedback signal of the accessed safety input equipment to the test signal from the input interface circuit; determining whether the accessed safety input equipment is abnormal or not based on the feedback signal; and controlling the robot to execute the safety strategy in response to the abnormity. According to the method and the device, the corresponding test signals are output according to the first type information of the safety input equipment connected with different input interface circuits, a special safety relay does not need to be additionally arranged, the cost can be reduced, and the number and the type of the accessed safety input equipment can be flexibly configured.

title_en: Advanced control method for petrochemical process
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of advanced petrochemical process control methods, and discloses an advanced petrochemical process control method, which is characterized by comprising the following steps: the petrochemical process advanced control method comprises a display terminal module, a central processing unit, a monitoring module, an emergency command scheduling module, a data analysis and study module, a reporting module and an information integration analysis module, wherein the monitoring module is arranged to carry out structured intelligent analysis on the petrochemical process, and alarm on abnormal data, so that the petrochemical process visual management is realized; a data analysis and study module is arranged to assist a petrochemical process manager in comprehensively controlling the change situation of data and deeply mining the time-space characteristics and change rules of the operation data, so that the petrochemical process management capability is improved; the data analysis and study are set to display the work plans of all departments of the petrochemical process at multiple angles, the auxiliary departments improve the work display and report quality, and decision makers are assisted to accurately master the work dynamics of the departments and make decisions timely and correctly.

title_en: Temperature control method, temperature control device, energy storage system, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a temperature control method, a device, an energy storage system, computer equipment and a storage medium, wherein the temperature control method is used for a system to be cooled, and the system to be cooled comprises a first number of target objects to be cooled and a second number of cooling devices, and the first number is larger than the second number; comprising the following steps: acquiring temperature values of a plurality of target objects to be radiated; when any one of a plurality of preset temperature ranges of the target temperature value in the temperature values is set, determining a heat dissipation control mode corresponding to the heat dissipation device according to the preset temperature range which falls into; and controlling the heat dissipation device to respond to the heat dissipation operation according to a heat dissipation control mode. The invention improves the technical problem of poor temperature consistency among the battery modules in the energy storage system in a simpler and low-cost mode, and is suitable for market popularization.

title_en: Comprehensive display system applied to new-generation information technology teaching
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive display system applied to new-generation information technology teaching, which comprises a teaching display unit, a remote control unit, an angle rotating unit, a screen adjusting unit, a heat dissipation unit and a central control processing unit, wherein the angle rotating unit is matched with the teaching display unit to perform multi-angle cyclic display of different information; this be applied to comprehensive display system of information technology teaching of new generation drives the radiating unit through the screen adjustment unit and dispels the heat, prevents that long-time operating temperature is too high to cause the damage of inside spare part, drives the angle rotation unit through the screen adjustment unit and carries out work, carries out angle adjustment to the screen.

title_en: Bending machine control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bending machine control method, which belongs to the technical field of automatic control, and comprises an upper computer, a multi-axis motion controller, an HMI (human machine interface) and a lower motion control program, wherein the upper computer provides a user operation platform through HMI software to process a processing program, and generates process steps and control data through processing technology algorithms such as material rebound, compensation calculation and the like, and transmits the process steps and control data to the multi-axis motion controller through communication; the multi-axis motion controller is used for performing motion planning according to the step data and controlling the basic motion of the bending machine tool. The compensation algorithm is strongly related to the mechanical characteristics of the machine tool, the compensation effect is better than that of a general system, and the self-grinding processing technology of a machine tool manufacturer is integrated through software, so that the autonomous technical content and market competitiveness of a product are improved.

title_en: Vehicle control device, vehicle control method, and storage medium
abstract_en: Provided are a driving control device, a driving control method, and a storage medium, which are capable of executing driving control of a vehicle based on more appropriate identification of traffic participants. The vehicle control device according to an embodiment includes a recognition unit that recognizes a surrounding situation of a vehicle, and a driving control unit that executes driving control for controlling one or both of a speed and a steering of the vehicle based on the surrounding situation recognized by the recognition unit, wherein the recognition unit recognizes a traffic participant existing in front of the vehicle and a traffic participant priority zone existing in a traveling direction of the vehicle, and the driving control unit sets a risk area for the traffic participant priority zone based on a position and a traveling direction of the traffic participant, and executes the driving control based on the set risk area and the position of the traffic participant.

title_en: On-chip checker for secure areas on-chip
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to an on-chip checker for an on-chip secure area. A single integrated circuit chip is disclosed herein that includes main logic to operate vehicle components such as valve drivers. Isolated from the main logic within the chip is a secure area for verifying proper operation of the main logic. Checker circuits within the chip outside the secure region are used to verify proper operation of the checker circuits. The checker circuit receives signals from the safety circuit and verifies from these signals whether the check circuit is functioning properly using combinational logic.

title_en: Projection system and projection calibration method using the same
abstract_en: The invention discloses a projection system and a projection calibration method using the same, wherein the projection system comprises a control module, a projection tube, an aiming driver, an observation device and an observation driver. The control module is used for sending out a first control instruction and a second control instruction. The aiming driver is electrically connected with the projection tube and is used for responding to the first control instruction to control the projection line of sight of the projection tube to be aligned with the calibration point. The observation driver is electrically connected with the observation device and is used for responding to the second control instruction to control the observation line of the observation device to be aligned with the calibration point. The projection tube is moved in a non-synchronous controlled manner with respect to the viewing device.

title_en: Vehicle control method, apparatus, vehicle, and computer-readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vehicle control method, a device, a vehicle and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: when a vehicle detects a ramp identifier, determining whether the vehicle starts a navigation system; if the vehicle does not start a navigation system, acquiring lane line information corresponding to the vehicle; determining whether the vehicle is traveling in a ramp direction based on the lane line information; if it is determined that the vehicle is traveling in the ramp direction, and acquiring ramp speed limit information corresponding to the ramp identification, and outputting the ramp speed limit information. According to the method and the device, whether the vehicle runs towards the ramp direction or not is accurately determined through the lane line information, and the ramp speed limit information is output when the vehicle runs towards the ramp direction, so that the situations of error display and display omission of the ramp speed limit information when the vehicle without starting a navigation system enters the ramp are greatly reduced, and the safety of the vehicle running into the ramp is improved through accurately outputting the ramp speed limit information.

title_en: Monitoring management module and method, microcontroller, computer program and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a monitoring management module and method, a microcontroller, a computer program and a storage medium. The monitoring management module uniformly operates a safety mechanism irrelevant to the functions of the virtual machines or operates a safety mechanism corresponding to the started virtual machines; when the safety mechanism monitoring error occurs, if the safety mechanism monitoring error is irrelevant to the functions of the virtual machine, executing a global response or a partition response; and if the virtual machine function is related, executing fault response of the corresponding virtual machine. Therefore, by uniformly managing each safety mechanism, the safe operation environment of each virtual machine can be ensured to the maximum extent, the virtual machines do not need to carry out safety guarantee by themselves, the development workload of the monitoring software of the virtual machines is reduced, hardware resources in the microcontroller and computing resources of the central processing unit are saved, and the cost is effectively reduced. In addition, the fault responses are respectively managed so as to ensure that the virtual machines irrelevant to the fault can normally run as far as possible, and the system availability is improved while the system safety is ensured.

title_en: Main steam temperature control optimization method based on machine learning time series prediction
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of main steam temperature optimization methods, and provides a main steam temperature control optimization method based on machine learning time sequence prediction, which comprises the following steps of S1, observing the existing actual operation data, and comparing and analyzing the actual operation data with historical data; s2, after S1, establishing a prediction model so as to complete accurate prediction of the steam temperature prediction model; s3, establishing a superheater outlet temperature prediction inverse model on the basis of the S2, and reversely deducing the set temperature of the superheater desuperheater outlet before a certain delay time through the inverse model; s4, finally, accurately controlling the outlet temperature of the superheater by adopting a prediction model plus PID mode; the invention combines the main steam temperature model prediction algorithm with the single PID temperature reduction water valve control, overcomes the problems of large inertia, large delay, time variation, multiple disturbance and the like of the existing main steam temperature system, and is convenient to realize the advanced control of the main steam temperature.

title_en: Stage data control system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of stage control systems, in particular to a stage data control system, which comprises a control end and a stage end, wherein the control end comprises: the time sequence module acquires the performance time sequence of performance on the stage, the time sequence module compiles and adjusts CUE (compute unified equipment) summary in the stage performance process according to the performance time sequence, and the time sequence module compiles and adjusts independent CUE sub-tables of all components on the stage according to the performance time sequence; the parameter generation module is used for generating operation parameters of each component on the stage in the performance according to the CUE sub-table and sending the operation parameters to the corresponding stage component; the execution monitoring module is used for monitoring the execution condition of each component on the stage, determining the running state of each component and giving feedback; the invention can improve the matching and control effects of all components on the stage, ensure the correct operation of all components, improve the control force on actors on the stage and timely remind the errors or dangers of the actors.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and readable storage medium for obtaining universal remote control coding information
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a device, equipment and a readable storage medium for acquiring universal remote control coding information, which relate to the technical field of remote controllers, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring numbering data corresponding to the target universal remote control code, and generating a corresponding key control instruction according to the numbering data; according to the key control instruction, controlling test equipment to input the number data in a preset remote controller to obtain a number output result, wherein the test equipment comprises at least one of a mechanical arm, a cylinder or a relay; and analyzing the number output result to generate target coding information corresponding to the target universal remote control code. The method and the device solve the technical problem that the accuracy rate of obtaining the universal remote control coding information is low at present.

title_en: Fault detection device for numerical control machine tool
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fault detection device for a numerical control machine tool, which relates to the technical field of numerical control machine tools, and adopts the technical scheme that the fault detection device comprises an acquisition module, a fault detection module and a fault detection module, wherein the acquisition module is used for acquiring the state information of a main part when the numerical control machine tool works to obtain a main part state monitoring set; acquiring state information of matched auxiliary components when the numerical control machine tool works to obtain a monitoring set of the matched auxiliary components; the processing and analyzing module is used for processing and analyzing various monitoring data in the main component state monitoring set to obtain a fault influence set; processing and analyzing various monitoring data in the monitoring set of the matched auxiliary components to obtain a fault analysis value; the numerical control machine tool fault detection method has the advantages that data detection is carried out on the spindle information, the feeding transmission chain information, the tool changing information, the hydraulic system information and the pneumatic system of the numerical control machine tool, the detected data are analyzed, whether the numerical control machine tool has a fault or not can be judged, and a manager can be timely notified to carry out maintenance processing when the numerical control machine tool has the fault.

title_en: Decision-making method for speed regulation queue of frequency converter of emulsion pump station based on time series prediction result
abstract_en: The invention provides a decision-making method for a frequency converter speed regulation queue of an emulsion pump station based on a time sequence prediction result, wherein a sensor samples pressure P (t) and flow F (t) at an outlet of an emulsion pump station, the pressure P (t) and the flow F (t) are respectively sent to a pressure prediction and flow prediction algorithm module to predict a future pressure value P (t + n) and a flow value F (t + n), real-time pressure and flow data, predicted pressure and predicted flow data are sent to a frequency converter control frequency decision-making module together to generate a control frequency queue from the current moment to n sampling time intervals in the future: c (t), \8230;, C (t + n); and the control frequency queues are fused to form the current output control frequency C (t) of the frequency converter. The invention can generate prediction information according to the historical data of the pressure and the flow of the emulsion pump station, form queue information of the frequency converter control frequency on the basis, finally fuse the prediction result, output the control frequency of the frequency converter, and predictively give a control scheme before the pressure and the flow are changed, thereby realizing the prior processing and leading the frequency converter to achieve the constant-pressure and constant-flow output.

title_en: Regional control integrated system suitable for intelligent ship
abstract_en: The invention discloses a regional control integrated system suitable for an intelligent ship, which relates to the technical field of ship automatic control and comprises a plurality of regional controllers, a cooperative controller, a configuration manager and a plurality of business display and control devices corresponding to different ship businesses, wherein the regional controllers are positioned in a cabin section of the ship, take the cabin section region as an object and are used for collecting and controlling data of ship business system sub-modules in the cabin section, and one or more regional controllers are distributed in a single cabin section of the ship; the cooperative controller is positioned between the electromechanical room and is used for receiving the data of the ship service system of each cabin section transmitted by the regional controller of each cabin section and receiving an operation instruction sent by the service display and control device so as to realize cooperative control and operation of the ship service system. The invention can reduce the difficulty and cost of the modification and upgrade of the ship automation system.

title_en: Flight control system, aircraft control system and aircraft
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a flight control system, an aircraft control system and an aircraft, and relates to the technical field of aviation. The flight control system comprises a health monitoring subsystem, a flight state management subsystem, a guidance control subsystem, a speed control subsystem and a gesture and thrust control subsystem. The flight control system can comprehensively calculate the control requirement of the lift propeller, the control requirement of the thrust propeller, the control requirement of the aileron and the control requirement of the tail wing by combining the data of multiple systems, so that the flight speed and the course can be automatically adjusted, the automatic flight driving operation is completed, three different scenes of unmanned driving, manned driving and ground remote driving can be supported, the driving burden of a pilot can be effectively reduced, and the flight driving safety is improved on the basis of meeting the navigable regulations.

title_en: Expressway ramp mixed traffic flow control method based on controllable intelligent network connection
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of intelligent transportation, in particular to a highway ramp mixed traffic flow control method based on controllable intelligent internet connection, which comprises the following steps of: s1, dividing a ramp section of a highway into a normal driving section, a formation section and an accelerated convergence section; s2, forming a vehicle formation in a road section formed by the intelligent internet connection vehicle and the human-driven following vehicle in the formation; s3, calculating a time interval [ t ] of the vehicle formation to completely reach the merging point S  min  ,t  max  ](ii) a S4, cooperatively controlling the intelligent network connection vehicle on the main road and the intelligent network connection vehicle on the ramp road section, and reserving a gathering gap for formation vehicles on the ramp on the main road; and S5, the vehicles are assembled into the main road. The invention obtains the traffic conditions of the highway main road and the downstream confluence area in advance by means of the Internet of vehicles technology, guides the vehicles on the ramp to safely converge into the highway main road by controlling the speed of the intelligent Internet vehicles, and avoids the situation that a driver only needs to collect the vehicles on the ramp into the highway main roadAnd searching the time of converging into the main road according to the driving experience of the driver and the surrounding driving environment.

title_en: Communication state monitoring and management system for power equipment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power equipment monitoring systems, and particularly discloses a communication state monitoring and management system for power equipment. When the information retrieval module is used, the environment information storage module can store the information of the running environment of the equipment end by the running environment acquisition module through the information storage module, the state information storage module can store the information of the state running of the equipment end analyzed by the information analysis processing module through the information storage module, the execution information storage module can store the information of the working state of the execution processing module through the information storage end, the maintenance information storage module can record the maintenance times of the maintenance center, the subsequent maintenance personnel can conveniently know the state of the equipment, and accordingly the damage constituting condition of the equipment end is deduced.

title_en: Sewage plant energy consumption data acquisition method and system
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of energy consumption of sewage plants, and particularly discloses a method and a system for collecting energy consumption data of a sewage plant. According to the application, the energy consumption collection period is obtained, so that the energy consumption collection of the sewage plant is periodically carried out; performing equipment identification analysis to judge whether missing acquisition equipment exists; when missing acquisition equipment exists, special acquisition application is carried out, and whether missing special acquisition can be realized is judged; when the acquisition of the missing special item cannot be realized, carrying out missing acquisition auxiliary attempt through the interconnection functional equipment, and judging whether the auxiliary acquisition can be completed; and when the auxiliary acquisition cannot be completed, acquisition omission alarming is carried out, and the omission acquisition real-time monitoring is carried out in real time. The method can periodically collect the energy consumption of the sewage plant, and perform equipment identification analysis to judge whether missing collecting equipment exists, so that missing data is collected gradually in a special collecting application mode, a missing collecting auxiliary attempt mode, a missing collecting alarm mode and the like, and timely collection of the energy consumption data is effectively guaranteed.

title_en: Workshop collaborative intelligent manufacturing system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses a workshop collaborative intelligent manufacturing system based on the Internet of things, which relates to the technical field of intelligent manufacturing and solves the technical problem of purchasing raw materials when the raw materials in a workshop do not meet the production requirements; acquiring an order form through a data acquisition module, and acquiring the order quantity of the required raw materials according to the order form; the data statistics module compares the order quantity of the required raw materials with the stock quantity of the required raw materials; when the stock of the corresponding raw materials does not meet the production requirement, acquiring the to-be-purchased amount of the raw materials which do not meet the production requirement according to a calculation formula; the raw material purchasing module screens and acquires target raw material supply plants in the raw material supply plants according to preset rules, acquires target raw material supply plant coefficients through a calculation formula, acquires target raw material supply plant sequences, and performs raw material purchasing according to the target raw material supply plant sequences; the problem that raw materials in a workshop cannot meet production requirements is solved, and the production cost is reduced.

title_en: Electricity string functional test equipment of transferring
abstract_en: The invention discloses a function test device for an electric tuning pipe column, which comprises a rack, a turntable mechanism, a lifting mechanism, a lower tool and an upper tool, wherein the turntable mechanism, the lifting mechanism, the lower tool and the upper tool are arranged on the rack, the lower tool is arranged above the turntable mechanism and synchronously rotates, the upper tool is arranged below the lifting mechanism, the lifting mechanism drives the upper tool to vertically move up and down, so that the upper tool is close to or far away from the lower tool, the lower tool supports the electric tuning pipe column to be tested, and the upper tool is provided with a noise detection device which is in contact with the electric tuning pipe column to be tested. The angle and the operating mode of simulation electricity transfer tubular column complete machine assembly, the equipment carries out the test of functional parameters such as noise, operating current, working stroke, operating speed automatically, improve equipment's stability and positioning accuracy to have with the high repeatability of test, promoted the authenticity of electricity transfer tubular column test result greatly. The noise test can be automatically carried out under the simulation working state, the test accuracy and reliability are improved, and the working strength is reduced.

title_en: Steamed stuffed bun steaming machine control system
abstract_en: The invention provides a control system of a steamed stuffed bun steaming machine, which comprises electronic hardware, a singlechip programming, a communication function, multiple protection, a structural body and a heating module, wherein the singlechip programming is used for acquiring data of an electronic hardware sensor in real time, the singlechip programming is used for carrying out comprehensive operation and processing on the acquired data to obtain an optimized scheme to control a controlled device to work, the software and the hardware are used for coordinating and detecting and controlling, and the high-efficiency heating module is controlled to convert water into high-temperature steam with pressure and then enter a steaming box, so that the high-efficiency utilization of the steam is improved, the aim of carrying out high-efficiency steamed stuffed bun steaming work is fulfilled by automatically detecting the state and coordinating the heating power or the water adding amount in the whole working process through the program, various abnormal states in the work are identified, the condition that the steamed stuffed bun steaming machine cannot work due to overheating, overload, electric leakage, water shortage and the like is prevented, the self-adjustment and the multiple protection are carried out, and the safety of the steamed stuffed bun steaming process is improved.

title_en: Peak-shifting trip scheme determining method, device, equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a device, equipment and a readable storage medium for determining a peak-shifting travel scheme. According to the scheme, after travel demand information of the travelers in the area to be subjected to traffic regulation is obtained, congestion condition information of each bottleneck road section in each time period in the area to be subjected to traffic regulation is determined, a peak-shifting travel scheme is provided for the travelers based on the congestion condition information of each bottleneck road section in each time period, wherein the travel demand information comprises travel time periods of the travelers and travel routes of the travelers, the congestion condition information of each bottleneck road section in each time period is used for indicating whether each bottleneck road section is congested in each time period or not and congestion time in each time period, and the peak-shifting travel scheme comprises peak-shifting travel suggestions and optimal travel time intervals in the travel time periods of the travelers. The scheme can provide a corresponding peak-shifting travel scheme for the travel activities of the travelers all the day by combining the actual road conditions.

title_en: Method and device for detecting instruction signal dislocation and method and device for repairing instruction signal dislocation
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a device for detecting instruction signal dislocation and a method and a device for repairing the dislocation, which belong to the field of computer control of electromechanical systems, wherein the detection method utilizes the idea of an autocorrelation function, and can accurately detect the occurrence period of signal dislocation phenomenon caused by the asynchronous clocks (different crystal oscillator periods) of an upper computer and a lower computer through a simple slope signal. On the basis, the method for repairing the differential jump of the command signal under different motion states can realize the repair of the differential jump of the command signal under different motion states by carrying out real-time diagnosis and classification on the motion states of the flight simulation turntable, has low miss-judgment rate, and realizes the compensation of the signal dislocation problem of one sampling point by a plurality of sampling points by arranging a step-by-step repair mode, thereby greatly weakening the abrupt change phenomenon of the differential command signal, obviously improving the control performance of an electromechanical servo system of the turntable and ensuring the simulation precision. The method can be applied to detection and repair of the flight simulation turntable command signals.

title_en: Digital key opening method, equipment and system
abstract_en: The application provides a digital key opening method, equipment and system. The system comprises a first device, a second device and a server, wherein a first service protocol is configured among the first device, the second device and the server in advance, the method can realize that under a digital key system of the first service protocol, based on the trust relationship among the first device, the second device and the server, data required by opening a digital key under the second service protocol is remotely issued by the server, and the opening of the digital key under the second service protocol between the first device and the second device is completed by utilizing a mechanism defined under the first service protocol, so that the support for the digital key system under the second service protocol is increased under the digital key system under the first service protocol, the data interaction required by opening the digital key under the second service protocol can be realized under the condition that a pairing protocol under the second service protocol can not be realized, the development workload and the PKI system cost are reduced, and the user experience is improved.

title_en: Parameter abnormality diagnosis and early warning method for stub bar production process based on curve belt
abstract_en: The invention provides a parameter abnormality diagnosis and early warning method for a stub bar production process based on a curve band, which utilizes historical data to screen normal batches, obtains maximum values and minimum values of parameters of the screened historical data, respectively utilizes a linear regression model to carry out curve fitting on all the maximum values and all the minimum values, and judges whether the parameters are in the range of the curve band in real time. The method provided by the invention firstly carries out batch screening on the historical data to provide abnormal batch data, and then uses the curve band as an abnormal judgment criterion, so that the defects in the prior art can be effectively avoided.

title_en: Intelligent control method and device for loosening and conditioning process
abstract_en: The disclosure provides an intelligent control method and device for a loosening and conditioning process, and relates to the technical field of tobacco manufacture, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a first parameter, wherein the first parameter comprises inlet moisture content, storage time, production flow and target outlet moisture content of tobacco leaves; inputting the first parameter into a first model to obtain a first water adding amount which is expected to meet the target outlet water content of the tobacco leaves; and executing a first operation to add water to the tobacco leaves according to the first water adding amount.

title_en: Physical simulation and deposition numerical simulation integrated experimental research method based on source assembly system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of deposition simulation, in particular to an experimental research method integrating physical simulation and deposition numerical simulation based on a source assembly system. The experimental research method realizes the visualization of the deposition phenomenon through physical simulation; the quantitative parameter visualization is realized through numerical simulation, the two are combined to complement each other, the experimental result is more diversified, the research area range is more complete, and the sand body spreading analysis and the sand body stacking style can be predicted.

title_en: LDO circuit
abstract_en: The invention discloses an LDO circuit, comprising: an error amplifier circuit, the non-inverting input end of which is connected with a reference voltage; the input end of the first adjusting circuit is connected with the output end of the error amplifier circuit; the first adjusting circuit comprises an NMOS adjusting tube, and the gate end of the NMOS adjusting tube is the input end of the first adjusting circuit; the input end of the second adjusting circuit is connected with the output end of the first adjusting circuit; the second adjusting circuit comprises an NPN adjusting tube, and the base electrode of the NPN adjusting tube is the input end of the second adjusting circuit; the feedback circuit is connected with the output end of the second adjusting circuit; the feedback circuit comprises a first feedback resistor and a second feedback resistor which are connected in series, and an inverting input end of the error amplifier circuit is connected between the first feedback resistor and the second feedback resistor. The LDO circuit has the advantages of simpler frequency compensation circuit, higher stability, higher power supply rejection ratio and low load adjustment rate.

title_en: Consistency tracking control method, device, equipment and medium of multi-agent system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a consistency tracking control method, a device, equipment and a medium of a multi-agent system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a communication topological graph of the multi-agent system, and leading agents and a dynamic model of following agents meeting Lipohsh continuous conditions; determining tracking errors of the multi-agent system and consistency tracking control targets and parameter matrix information when the intelligent system meets preset assumption conditions; determining the relative state information between each following intelligent agent and the corresponding neighbor intelligent agent, and judging whether the relative state value of the multi-intelligent agent system can be obtained or not; and determining the consistency tracking controller of the multi-agent control system according to the judging result, the relative state information and the parameter matrix information. By designing different fully distributed coherence tracking controllers with different relative state value acquisitions. A more universal controller is provided, and consistency tracking of a high-order nonlinear system under a directed communication diagram is realized.

title_en: Vacuum induction smelting process detection and control system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vacuum induction smelting process detection and control system, which is used for carrying out evaluation calculation on furnace body parameters, further extracting risk parameters in the furnace body parameters, checking risk parameter data, carrying out calculation classification on checked risk parameters, calculating parameter supplementing quantity, comparing calculated parameter values with corresponding parameter safety ranges to extract parameter safety supplementing quantity, supplementing corresponding parameters by a furnace body control module through the parameter safety supplementing quantity, extracting parameters of which the calculated parameter values are not in the corresponding parameter safety ranges by a risk parameter extraction unit, and carrying out evaluation calculation on the risk values and alarm by a risk evaluation module, thereby effectively improving the control precision in the processing process, carrying out quick alarm on the condition that the safety production of the furnace body cannot be ensured, and effectively improving the production quality of vacuum induction smelting workpieces.

title_en: Early warning method, early warning device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an early warning method, an early warning device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a target image acquired by target camera equipment in a target area; invoking a target image recognition model corresponding to the target camera equipment to process the target image to obtain an image recognition result; determining whether the image recognition result meets an early warning condition according to a target early warning rule corresponding to the target camera equipment; and generating and outputting early warning information in response to the image recognition result meeting the early warning condition. The image in the target area is identified through the model, the safety risk event is identified in time, the early warning prompt information is output in time when the early warning condition is met, and the image can be prevented in time before the safety accident is further worsened, so that the life safety of personnel is guaranteed, and the emergency response capability is improved.

title_en: Fuzzy expansion state observer design method based on linear quadratic optimal control
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fuzzy extended state observer design method based on linear quadratic optimal control, which uses a fuzzy algorithm for self-setting parameters of an extended state observer so as to improve the self-adaptive capacity of the observer. Aiming at further improvement of dynamic response performance of the system such as system rise time, adjustment time and the like, the invention combines a linear quadratic optimal control method with a dominant pole allocation technology to design a proportional-integral-derivative (PID) controller. Compared with the traditional extended state observer, the design method of the invention has the advantages that dynamic response performance indexes such as system rise time, adjustment time and the like are obviously improved, and the anti-interference capability of the system is obviously improved. In addition, the system error is input as a fuzzy system, the bandwidth of the observer is output as the fuzzy system, and the designed fuzzy extended state observer can adjust the bandwidth of the observer in real time according to the size of the error so as to realize accurate estimation of disturbance under different conditions, thereby improving the online self-adaption capability of the extended state observer.

title_en: Method and device for controlling chassis of unmanned vehicle and computer equipment
abstract_en: A method of controlling a chassis of an unmanned vehicle, comprising: acquiring state data of a chassis of the unmanned vehicle; determining a first protocol supported by a chassis of the unmanned vehicle; selecting a target protocol conversion rule matched with the first protocol from preset candidate protocol conversion rules, and converting the first protocol into a second protocol supported by the control terminal according to the target protocol conversion rule; and encapsulating the state data through a second protocol, and sending the encapsulated state data to the control terminal so as to instruct the control terminal to control the chassis based on the state data.

title_en: Workpiece spraying method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of automobile manufacturing, in particular to a workpiece spraying method, a workpiece spraying device, workpiece spraying equipment and a storage medium. According to the invention, the spraying script corresponding to the workpiece to be sprayed is determined, so that a waiting chain value instruction and an I/O signal are generated through the spraying script, the subsequent spraying simulation is facilitated, the spraying simulation is performed through the waiting chain value instruction and the I/O signal control simulation robot, so that the spraying effect of the new color is determined, and further, the spraying guide file is generated, so that the actual spraying is improved, the cost of first spraying of the new color is reduced, the spraying effect is not influenced, and the technical problem of higher trial spraying cost of the new color in the prior art is avoided.

title_en: Robot-based following and obstacle avoidance method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for simultaneously avoiding obstacles based on the following of a robot, comprising the following steps: s1, planning a navigation path according to the position relation between the current position of the robot and a target; s2, performing forward path simulation according to the current state of the robot; s3, scoring each simulation path according to the evaluation index; and S4, selecting a path with the highest score to obtain a control instruction. The invention can realize the effect of simultaneously avoiding the obstacle during the following process, has smoother following effect and meets the requirements of users.

title_en: Dry-mixed mortar preparation system and preparation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dry-mixed mortar preparation system and a preparation method, which relate to the technical field of dry-mixed mortar preparation and comprise the following steps: control room: the intelligent control system is used for intelligently controlling equipment in the preparation system to work and monitoring the working condition of the equipment in the preparation system by staff, and can manually adjust the working condition of the equipment in the preparation system; a communication system: the preparation system is used for realizing remote control of the control room; the preparation system comprises: the method is used for preparing dry-mixed mortar; the preparation system comprises a drying system, a screening system, a conveying system, a weighing system, a feeding system, a stirring system and a storage system, wherein the drying system is used for drying raw materials for preparing dry-mixed mortar. The invention relates to a control room and equipment in a preparation system, which are mutually related through a communication system, so that control personnel can conveniently control and monitor the working condition of the preparation system, and the control personnel can conveniently manage and control the equipment.

title_en: Vehicle, method for a vehicle and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a vehicle, a method for a vehicle and a storage medium. A method for road hazard based motion planner constraint generation is provided, which may include: receiving information related to an object; identifying the object as a particular roadway hazard; generating one or more motion constraints based on the roadway hazard; and controlling the vehicle based on the motion constraint. Systems and computer program products are also provided.

title_en: Accident multiple place identification method, equipment, medium and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, equipment, medium and device for identifying accident multiple places, which comprises the following steps: the data acquisition and processing step is used for acquiring travel data and vehicle history accident alarm data transmitted by the vehicle-mounted terminal; collecting vehicle related data travel data, vehicle historical accident alarm data, real-time accident alarm data and environment data, and preprocessing the data; reflecting the speed before alarming the historical accident of the vehicle according to the travel data; extracting accident places according to the real-time accident alarm number, and correlating the environment conditions at the moment to obtain accident places under different environment conditions; based on the same steps, setting an updating period and adding a new accident multiple place; according to the travel data acquired in real time, the environment of the local day is associated, when the vehicle contacts the corresponding accident-prone place under the corresponding environment level, the running condition of the vehicle can be dynamically monitored, and the vehicle entering the accident-prone place is safely reminded, so that the driving risk is reduced.

title_en: Laser cutting power determining method, control system, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of program control, and particularly relates to a laser cutting power determining method, a control system, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps of S1, acquiring preset power curve parameters, wherein the power curve parameters are coordinate values of a control point sequence for generating a power curve; S2, interpolating through a corrected Akima spline based on the power curve parameters to obtain a power curve, wherein the power curve is used for representing a function relation between the cutting speed of the laser cutting machine and the output power of the laser, and S3, determining the current output power value of the laser based on the power curve and the current cutting speed of the laser cutting machine. By the method, the laser power is changed smoothly along with the change of the speed in the processing process, and the change rate of the laser power does not jump, so that the laser cutting performance and quality are improved.

title_en: Monocular unmanned aerial vehicle obstacle avoidance method, device and medium based on depth deterministic strategy gradient
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a monocular unmanned aerial vehicle obstacle avoidance method, device and medium based on depth deterministic strategy gradient; the method comprises the following steps: generating an antagonism network CGAN based on conditions for an original RGB image acquired by a monocular camera onboard the unmanned aerial vehicle to be converted into a depth image; taking the depth image and the current speed information of the unmanned aerial vehicle as state information, and constructing an Actor network and an evaluator Critic network in a depth deterministic strategy gradient DDPG network; constructing a reward function according to the distance between the unmanned aerial vehicle and the target, the speed of the unmanned aerial vehicle and the collision information of the unmanned aerial vehicle; training the Actor network and the Critic network in the DDPG network according to the reward function, so as to obtain parameters of the Actor network and the Critic network; and performing obstacle avoidance control on the monocular unmanned aerial vehicle according to the DDPG network after training.

title_en: PLC controller communication method and system based on Ethernet
abstract_en: The invention provides a communication method and a communication system of a PLC (programmable logic controller) based on Ethernet, wherein the method comprises the following steps: a data allocation module connected with a data classification module corresponding to each PLC controller on the same production line is configured; configuring a data classification module connected with each PLC controller; the data classification module is used for preprocessing and classifying the first data of each PLC controller after configuration is completed to form in-line data and first uploading data; and the data allocation module allocates the online data of each data classification module after the configuration is completed, and integrates the online data to form second uploading data. According to the PLC communication method based on the Ethernet, the data classification module and the data allocation module are configured on the production line site, and allocation and transmission of data in the production line are realized based on the data classification module and the data allocation module, so that the data transmission and data processing pressure of a server are reduced.

title_en: Obstacle avoidance driving control method and device, electronic equipment, vehicle and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides an obstacle avoidance driving control method, an obstacle avoidance driving control device, electronic equipment, a vehicle and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: when the sensor detects that an obstacle exists in front of the vehicle, a first data set of the obstacle and a second data set of the vehicle are obtained, road data corresponding to the current position of the vehicle are obtained from a pre-stored high-precision map, the road data comprise reference lines of at least one lane and boundary lines of at least one lane, the first data set comprises a boundary frame and a speed of the obstacle, and the second data set comprises the speed of the vehicle; judging whether the vehicle meets a preset lane change condition or not through a preset obstacle detouring decision device based on the first data set, the second data set, the reference line and the boundary line; when the vehicle meets the lane changing condition, determining a lane changing path of the vehicle based on a path planning algorithm of secondary planning according to the reference line, the boundary line and the boundary frame of the obstacle; the vehicle is controlled to run according to the road changing path.

title_en: Housing for a part of a production line and/or a manufacturing machine, and system for open-loop and/or closed-loop control of a production plant
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a housing for a part of a production line and/or a manufacturing machine and a system for open-loop and/or closed-loop control of a part of a production line and/or a manufacturing machine. The following possibilities are opened up for the first time by the invention: the transparent area of the housing of the production line is utilized in the production line instead of a conventional monitor and at the same time by applying transparent interactive display and input elements, such as transparent multi-touch elements and/or HUDs, via augmented reality and/or auxiliary reality.

title_en: Data transmission system, work machine, and data transmission method for work machine
abstract_en: The data transmission system of the work machine includes: a machining definition receiving unit that receives machining definition information indicating the contents of machining of data collected from the work machine; a processing unit that determines a processing data format based on the received processing definition information, and processes data collected from the work machine based on the determined data format; and a transmitting unit that transmits the processed data to an external device.

title_en: Green wave coordination control method, system, storage medium and terminal
abstract_en: The invention discloses a green wave coordination control method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring traffic light signal parameters and application fields Jing Canshu on a highway trunk to be controlled; determining a target scene variable according to the traffic light signal parameter and the application scene parameter by combining a preset green wave bandwidth adjustment expression; when determining that the current traffic scene belongs to a discontinuous green wave band scene according to the target scene variable, determining a constraint condition expression and a target function under the discontinuous green wave band scene according to the expression; and controlling the green wave bandwidth of the highway trunk line to be controlled according to the constraint condition expression and the objective function in the discontinuous green wave band scene. The method and the device have the advantages that the constraint condition expression and the objective function under the discontinuous green wave band scene are set, when the discontinuous green wave band scene appears, the constraint and the objective function under the scene can be rapidly loaded to control the green wave bandwidth of the highway trunk line, the problem that the existing MAXBOD model and the MULTIBAND model are not suitable for the discontinuous green wave band scene is solved, and the passing efficiency is improved.

title_en: Intelligent home management control system and method based on Internet of things technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent home management control system and method based on the internet of things, wherein a new intelligent home lighting system control strategy is provided, real-time environment brightness data and the light intensity comfort value of each person in family members are combined, an optimal lighting brightness value Pb of an intelligent lighting system when a plurality of family members are simultaneously present is calculated based on a multi-objective optimizing model, under the condition of ensuring normal lighting, the requirements of each family member individual with different use habits are met as much as possible, the control process is more humanized and intelligent, different control strategies are called according to different use situations by identifying personnel information in the same space range, the requirement data and the environment data are analyzed, and the optimal lighting brightness value Pb is calculated, so that the control process is more in line with the actual situation, and the control process is particularly good in practicability.

title_en: Urban digital emergency integrated platform
abstract_en: The invention provides an urban digital emergency integrated platform, which comprises: the system comprises a weather monitoring module, a fire monitoring module, a traffic accident monitoring module and an emergency command module; the weather monitoring module is used for acquiring weather forecast information of each area in the city and sending weather early warning instructions to the emergency command module; the fire control monitoring module is used for monitoring fire control safety information in the city, and sending a fire control processing instruction to the emergency command module when the fire control safety information displays that a fire accident occurs; the traffic accident monitoring module is used for monitoring traffic accident information in the city, and sending a traffic accident handling instruction to the emergency command module when the traffic accident information shows that a traffic accident occurs; the emergency command module is used for sending early warning information to the user according to the weather early warning instruction and carrying out resource allocation according to the fire control processing instruction and/or the traffic accident processing instruction. The invention can effectively improve the emergency treatment efficiency of cities.

title_en: Unexpected outage alarm circuit, alarm device and system
abstract_en: The application provides an unexpected outage alarm circuit, alarm device and system, unexpected outage alarm circuit includes system power supply, super capacitor and alarm drive circuit, system power supply and alarm drive circuit pass through super capacitor and connect, unexpected outage alarm circuit still includes: a shutdown detection circuit and an accidental power-off judgment circuit; the first signal input end of the shutdown detection circuit and the first signal input end of the accidental power-off judging circuit are both connected with the power-off signal output end of the system power supply, the second signal input end of the shutdown detection circuit is connected with the shutdown signal output end of the system power supply, and the signal output end of the shutdown detection circuit is connected with the second signal input end of the accidental power-off judging circuit. The system power supply alarming device can timely alarm to remind medical staff when the system power supply is accidentally powered off, and can control alarming time length to be in a reasonable range, and is convenient to use.

title_en: Holographic traffic state data set construction method based on multi-source information fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of traffic data processing, in particular to a holographic traffic state dataset construction method based on multi-source information fusion, which comprises the steps of obtaining an original dataset, constructing a directed road network diagram and an undirected road network diagram according to a road network topological relation, carrying out imaging processing on traffic information by the road network diagram according to a color matching equation, constructing a neighbor order matrix, carrying out preliminary correction and complementation on original traffic characteristic data by combining the traffic information diagram through a space-time information compensation network, establishing an iterative complementation generation type resistance network IGANI model, generating a complementation dataset, constructing a weighted directed diagram based on a road physical connection relation model established by the neighbor order matrix and the directed road network diagram, and predicting traffic state data in a period through a GE-LSTM traffic state prediction model to generate a prediction dataset, so as to construct the holographic traffic state dataset.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and medium for calculating traffic flow complexity of water ship
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a device, equipment and a medium for calculating traffic flow complexity of a water ship, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring ship AIS data of a target water area; determining a ship cluster in the target water domain according to the ship AIS data by utilizing an improved DBSCAN algorithm; carrying out ship state feature clustering on the ship cluster to obtain state feature probability distribution of the ship cluster; and determining the complexity of the ship traffic flow of the target water area based on the information entropy according to the state characteristic probability distribution. The invention innovatively obtains an improved DBSCAN algorithm based on a ship field model, so that the algorithm is more fit with navigation practice; according to the state feature probability, uncertainty of the state of the water traffic flow is described through information entropy, a method for measuring the complexity of the water ship traffic flow in the field of water traffic engineering is expanded, and the method has important theoretical and practical significance for boosting maritime safety supervision informatization.

title_en: Asymmetric CAN-based communication for aircraft
abstract_en: Example embodiments include a plurality of flight modules including a primary flight module and a secondary flight module. The embodiment includes a CAN controller, a second CAN controller, a first CAN bus configured to transmit a primary control signal from the first CAN controller to the primary and secondary flight modules, and a second CAN bus configured to transmit a secondary control signal from the second CAN controller to the primary and secondary flight modules. The primary flight module is configured to perform a function in response to receiving the primary control signal and not in response to receiving the secondary control signal, and the secondary flight module is configured to perform a function in response to receiving the secondary control signal and not in response to receiving the primary control signal.

title_en: Ship positioning information monitoring and early warning method based on big data and related equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ship positioning information monitoring and early warning method and related equipment based on big data, which relate to the technical field of ship automatic identification systems, and the implementation method comprises the following steps: acquiring AIS data of a ship; drawing a spatial position point of the ship according to the AIS data; establishing a ship parameter model according to the space position points of the ship; and monitoring the behavior of the ship according to the ship parameter model and carrying out early warning. According to the method, through accumulation of historical data, data mining and space analysis are utilized, a ship positioning information abnormality warning model is established according to characteristics of ship positioning track point characteristics, ship use, ship size and the like, and abnormality of ship behaviors and areas where the ship behaviors and the abnormal ship positioning information are located are timely identified by the model and early warning is sent out.

title_en: Precise pesticide spraying system and method for plant protection unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of pesticide precise spraying, and discloses a pesticide precise spraying system and a pesticide precise spraying method of a plant protection unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein the pesticide precise spraying system of the plant protection unmanned aerial vehicle comprises the following components: the system comprises a spraying video monitoring module, an unmanned aerial vehicle control module, a central control module, a video enhancement module, a spraying position determining module, a pesticide spraying module, a fault detection module and a display module. Each group of adjacent pesticide spraying video frames in the pesticide spraying enhancement video obtained by the video enhancement module are enhancement images corresponding to one group of pesticide spraying video frames to be processed and target pesticide spraying video frames in the pesticide spraying video to be processed; the video definition is improved; meanwhile, the flight state information of the pesticide spraying unmanned aerial vehicle is obtained through the fault detection module, the pesticide spraying unmanned aerial vehicle jumps to a fault detection model corresponding to the information type of the flight state information, and fault detection operation is executed according to the fault detection model and the flight state information.

title_en: Vehicle starting acceleration linearity evaluation method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vehicle starting acceleration linearity evaluation method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of vehicle dynamic performance evaluation, wherein the vehicle starting acceleration linearity evaluation method comprises the following steps: and acquiring a corresponding relation between at least one quantifiable driving experience parameter and the travel of the accelerator pedal so as to evaluate the starting acceleration linearity of the vehicle. The invention can evaluate the linearity of the starting acceleration dynamics of the vehicle through the linear change relation between the peak acceleration corresponding to a group of actual accelerator pedal strokes which are stepped down by a driver during starting.

title_en: Positioning method, device, equipment and storage medium of mobile terminal
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure provides a positioning method, a positioning device, positioning equipment and a storage medium of a mobile terminal. The positioning method of the mobile terminal comprises the steps of obtaining ranging distances between a plurality of UWB base stations and the mobile terminal in the current period, determining a target area of the mobile terminal in the current period in a plurality of preset areas according to the ranging distances, and calculating position coordinates of the mobile terminal in the current period according to the target area of the mobile terminal in the current period and the ranging distances between the plurality of UWB base stations and the mobile terminal in the current period. By adopting the method, the problem of poor positioning accuracy caused by non-line-of-sight propagation when at least part of UWB base stations are communicated with the mobile terminal can be solved.

title_en: Charging port plug for electric vehicle and method for preventing vehicle from driving off
abstract_en: A charging port plug for an electric vehicle (100) comprises a plug body and a first plug head for engaging a charging port of a first type, characterized in that 5 i) the first plug head comprises an electrical contact portion and a first resistor for enabling an electrical communication connection between the plug and the vehicle, and/or ii) the first plug head comprises an electrical contact portion and a processor 10 for enabling an electrical communication connection between the plug and the vehicle, and wherein the plug is arranged to send a signal to the vehicle, such as for switching the vehicle into a park or neutral mode, wherein the plug is designed to be incompatible with the charging 15 of the vehicle. A method for protecting a vehicle from driving off, wherein the vehicle comprises a charging port of a first type, wherein the vehicle is arranged for protecting itself in response to an electrical communication coupling with a plug, and wherein the method 20 comprises the steps of providing a charging port plug, engaging the plug with the charging port of the first type, and establishing an electrical communication coupling between the plug and the vehicle by means of said engagement.

title_en: Vehicle attack event continuity determination method, vehicle attack event continuity determination device, and program
abstract_en: The vehicle attack event continuity determination method comprises the following steps: an acquisition step of acquiring first vehicle attack event information relating to a first vehicle attack event occurring in the vehicle-mounted network (20), second vehicle attack event information relating to a second vehicle attack event occurring in the vehicle-mounted network (20) in the past from the first vehicle attack event, and vehicle-mounted network information indicating the configuration of the vehicle-mounted network (20), and a determination step of determining continuity between the first vehicle attack event and the second vehicle attack event based on the first vehicle attack event information, the second vehicle attack event information, and the vehicle-mounted network information; and an output step of outputting a result of the determination.

title_en: Design method of radial decoupling and axial PID controller of AMBs-rigid rotor system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a design method of radial decoupling and axial PID controllers of an AMBs-rigid rotor system, which constructs the radial decoupling PID controllers and gives a preliminary selection range of parameters of the radial decoupling PID controllers by utilizing the requirements on the stability and rigidity damping characteristics of the system; then, a setting principle of each parameter of the radial decoupling PID controller is given, and particularly, a setting method of the proportional and differential coefficients is determined according to the change relation of the radial unbalanced vibration response and the unbalanced control current response of the system along with the proportional and differential coefficients; and finally, analyzing the dynamic characteristics of the axial movement, and giving out the parameter setting basis and the setting method of the axial PID controller. The radial decoupling and axial PID controller designed by the invention not only can enable the electromagnetic bearing-rigid rotor system to be quickly and stably suspended to the balance position, but also can enable the rotor system to have smaller vibration response in the full rotating speed range and smaller control current when the rotor system runs at the rated rotating speed.

title_en: Green wave control scheme generation method based on time-distance graph
abstract_en: The invention discloses a green wave control scheme generation method based on a time-distance graph, which comprises the following steps of S100, obtaining all intersection information of intersections in a coordination direction in a target area, S200, determining the green time range which can be occupied by the coordination direction of each intersection and the maximum and minimum values of forward and reverse green wave bandwidths through the intersection information, S300, sequentially traversing the reverse phase difference, reverse green wave bandwidth and forward green wave bandwidth of a starting intersection by taking the green time T  i  occupied by each intersection and the green time range T  i  which can be occupied by the coordination direction of each intersection as constraint conditions, and determining the maximum forward and reverse green wave bandwidths and the optimal starting intersection phase difference which meet the constraint conditions, and S400, calculating and generating the phase sequence, the phase time and the phase difference of each intersection according to the forward and reverse maximum bandwidths and the forward and reverse phase differences of the starting intersection. Based on the characteristics of the green wave time interval graph, the method realizes the rapid determination of the maximum bandwidth of the green wave and the phase difference of the starting point intersection through simulation and manual debugging.

title_en: Vending packaging method of intelligent vending cabinet
abstract_en: A selling and packaging method of an intelligent sales counter comprises the following steps of firstly triggering a purchasing program to select to purchase goods; step two, pushing out the target selling goods; packaging target vending commodities; and step four, taking out the target commodity to finish the transaction. The selling and packaging method of the intelligent sales counter carries out privacy packaging on commodities sold each time, protects privacy of consumers, and avoids the problem of commodity water inflow caused by rain and snow weather.

title_en: Image quality control method, device, medium and equipment for multi-camera
abstract_en: The application discloses an image quality control method, device, medium and equipment of a multi-camera. The method comprises the following steps: dividing the multi-camera into at least a first type camera and a second type camera according to the detected moving object; comparing the quality of the image which is acquired by the first type camera and contains the first type moving object with a first quality threshold; comparing the quality of the image which is acquired by the second-type camera and contains the second-type moving object with a second quality threshold; if the comparison result does not meet the preset standard, adjusting the camera which does not meet the preset standard according to an image quality adjustment rule corresponding to the type of the moving object; if the adjustment is detected to be in accordance with the preset standard, the images acquired by the first type of camera and the second type of camera are spliced to obtain an integrated image. According to the technical scheme, different processing modes can be used for different moving objects in the picture, and the mixed line applicability of the multi-camera is improved.

title_en: Device and method for constant humidity control of grotto cultural relics by using calcium oxide and ultrasonic waves
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a method for constant humidity control of a grotto cultural relic by using calcium oxide and ultrasonic waves. The invention has simple structure, easy installation and strong environmental adaptation, can continuously and accurately detect and regulate the humidity, and provides a guarantee for long-term preservation of grotto cultural relics and realization of active preventive protection. Meanwhile, a green power supply is adopted for supplying power, so that the continuous operation of the device is ensured, and the problem that power supply is difficult due to the particularity of a grotto environment is solved.

title_en: Thunder and lightning early warning device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of alarming and discloses a lightning early warning device, which comprises a base and a lightning early warning instrument, wherein a supporting rod is fixedly connected to the base; a cavity is arranged in the base and is communicated with the threaded hole; the two sides in the cavity are both connected with movable blocks in a sliding way, and a reset spring is arranged between the movable blocks and the cavity; the movable block is provided with a groove for the bolt to slide in, and the bolt is positioned on the movement track of the groove; side grooves are formed in two sides of the groove, and elastic layers for propping against the bolts are arranged in the side grooves; the movable block also comprises an alarm mechanism for alarming along with the bolt penetrating through the elastic layer and a moving mechanism for driving the movable block to move. The problem that current thunderstorm strong wind early warning device appears the slope condition and the staff can't know in time has mainly been solved to this scheme.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle navigation section handover switching method and device
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a device for handover and switching of unmanned aerial vehicle navigation sections, wherein the method comprises the following steps: generating an ordered information set according to the position information, the attitude angle and the UTC time of the unmanned aerial vehicle; judging whether the navigation signal is normal or not; if the navigation signal is normal, executing a first switching step, including: acquiring an angle between the air legs of the unmanned aerial vehicle and the distance between the next air leg according to the position information and the mission air route; generating a cross turning route according to the real-time ground speed, the minimum turning radius and the voyage Duan Gajiao, and switching to the next voyage section through the cross turning route unmanned aerial vehicle; if the navigation signal is abnormal, executing a second switching step, which comprises the following steps: determining predicted navigational speed and predicted location information according to the ordered information set and the environmental data; acquiring a predicted distance from the unmanned aerial vehicle to the next leg and a predicted leg included angle; and switching to the next leg with the minimum turning radius according to the predicted leg included angle. This application can prevent that unmanned aerial vehicle from appearing the route and vibrate when the leg switches through planning handing-over turn route for unmanned aerial vehicle.

title_en: Fire extinguishing system of energy storage power station
