abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of energy storage power station fire protection, and provides an energy storage power station fire protection system, which comprises: a gas fire extinguishing system, a water spray fire extinguishing system and a fire hydrant fire extinguishing system; the gas fire extinguishing system and the water spray fire extinguishing system are arranged in the energy storage power station chamber; the fire hydrant fire extinguishing system is arranged outside the energy storage power station. According to the invention, the gas fire extinguishing system, the spraying fire extinguishing system and the fire hydrant fire extinguishing system are arranged for the energy storage power station, so that the fire extinguishing capability of the energy storage power station is increased, and the fire extinguishing safety of the energy storage power station is improved.

title_en: Micro hemispherical resonator gyro digital control circuit device based on parameter average model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a parameter average model-based digital control circuit device of a micro hemispherical resonator gyroscope, which consists of a micro hemispherical resonator gyroscope, an analog processing circuit, a signal conversion circuit and an FPGA control module. The analog processing circuit comprises a detection interface circuit, an analog demodulation filter circuit, a voltage comparator circuit and a driving interface circuit; the FPGA control module comprises a reference signal generator module, a digital filter module, a parameter calculator module, a PI controller module and an output signal conditioning module. According to the invention, a model of the vibration state of the gyroscope is established by using a parameter averaging method, a control algorithm is realized by using the FPGA, and phase information is directly sampled and acquired by adopting an FPGA system working clock, so that the phase control resolution and precision of the micro hemispherical resonator gyroscope are improved, and the overall performance of the gyroscope is improved.

title_en: Inspection management system and method for tunnel equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of tunnel inspection, and discloses an inspection management system and method for tunnel equipment, wherein the inspection management system comprises a data acquisition module, a data processing module, a visualization module, an auxiliary analysis module and an inspection planning module; the data acquisition module is used for acquiring monitoring data of sensing equipment in the tunnel; the data processing module is used for preprocessing the monitoring data and positioning abnormal data from the monitoring data; the visualization module is used for visually displaying the tunnel and various equipment layout positions in the tunnel in a two-dimensional panoramic map form; the auxiliary analysis module is used for collecting accident data around the tunnel, meteorological data of the place where the tunnel is located and magnetic field data; the inspection planning module is used for planning inspection types, inspection personnel, inspection routes and inspection periods according to a preset inspection strategy based on the information of the visualization module and the auxiliary analysis module. The invention can carry out timely and comprehensive inspection management, and the prepositioning degree of the inspection scheduling plan is higher.

title_en: Temperature control method and system of heating furnace, control device and heating furnace system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a temperature control method, a temperature control system, a temperature control device and a temperature control system of a heating furnace, wherein a target temperature tracking control gain is determined based on uplink channel state information, downlink channel state information and an identified heating furnace dynamic model parameter matrix, and a target temperature control signal is determined based on the target temperature tracking control gain, a target temperature of a reheating plate blank and a temperature measured value of the reheating plate blank received by the temperature control device so as to control a heater to carry out temperature adjustment, thus, signal noise caused by a wireless network between the temperature control device and the heating furnace is considered in the temperature control process, and the temperature of the heating furnace can be accurately controlled.

title_en: System and method for determining regular and irregular road congestion to alleviate the congestion
abstract_en: A system for alleviating congestion of a road network is provided. The system includes a plurality of motor vehicles located at associated locations in a road network. Each vehicle has one or more sensors and a Telematics Control Unit (TCU) that generate inputs for generating at least one position signal for a position of the associated motor vehicle and at least one event signal for an event associated with the associated motor vehicle, wherein the position signal and the event signal correspond to high speed vehicle telemetry data (HSVT data) based on the inputs from the sensors. The system also includes a computer in communication with the display device and the TCU. The computer includes a processor and a computer readable medium including instructions such that the processor is programmed to identify congestion and determine whether the congestion is regular or irregular congestion.

title_en: Incremental PID parameter single-sequential electric feedback self-tuning method of self-attenuation system
abstract_en: The invention provides a self-tuning method for single sequential electric feedback of an incremental PID parameter of a self-attenuation system, which is different from the traditional relay feedback self-tuning method, and provides a new solution for self-tuning of the incremental PID control parameter of a self-attenuation electric drive control system which can only be controlled unidirectionally in a mobile bearing platform, thereby greatly improving the design efficiency of the control parameter and the accuracy and precision of the control. The method comprises the following steps that a system enters a single-phase sequential electric feedback self-tuning method, a controller is switched to a single-phase relay feedback controller, the single-phase relay feedback controller controls the system to continuously oscillate within a preset interval according to measured values, a register records waveform data after the system generates available waveforms, a solver calculates optimal control quantity according to the waveform results of the register, and finally the calculated optimal control quantity is input into an incremental PID controller to verify whether the results meet requirements.

title_en: Shooting method, device and system
abstract_en: The application provides a shooting method, device and system, and belongs to the technical field of computers. According to the method and the device, the shooting area is subdivided into the subareas, and when the shooting target is expected to enter a certain subarea, a new exposure parameter is determined according to the brightness and the exposure parameter corresponding to the subarea, so that an image of the shooting target is obtained. The method can be provided as a scheme based on regional exposure control, and because the exposure parameters are related to the regions where the shooting targets fall, different exposure parameters can be adopted for shooting under the condition that the shooting targets are in different regions, so that the influence of the difference of illumination conditions between different regions on the shooting process is reduced, the problem that one set of exposure parameters is difficult to consider illumination of different environments is solved, the accurate exposure of the illumination regions of different environments is realized, and the method is beneficial to obtaining images with proper brightness under the scene with uneven illumination.

title_en: Automatic switching control system and test method for control panel burning test mode
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of circuits and automatic control, in particular to an automatic switching control system and a test method for a control board burning test mode, comprising a driving board, a first switching control circuit and a second switching control circuit, wherein the driving board comprises a first MCU minimum system circuit, a first DC-DC circuit and a SWD circuit; the tool board comprises a MCU minimum system circuit II, a DC-DC circuit II, a program burning switching circuit, a program burning control circuit and a thimble socket, and upper computer software comprising a USB communication serial port, a burning test code, a checking test control and a burning factory code. The invention can synchronously realize the hardware test and the factory program burning of the control board card, and meets the automatic burning test requirement of the control board card.

title_en: Coal mine violation monitoring method based on accurate positioning and AI video recognition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal mine violation monitoring method based on accurate positioning and AI video recognition, which comprises the following steps: step 1, installing a UWB positioning base station and an AI video recognition camera near a violation monitoring area; the staff carries the positioning terminal to enter underground coal mine operation; step 2, measuring the distance between the monitoring area and the UWB positioning base station and recording the distance into a system, wherein the positioning system records the personnel passing through the monitoring area; step 3, monitoring and alarming underground coal mine violations by adopting a UWB positioning and AI video mode; the method solves the technical problems that whether the rule is violated or not is judged manually, the supervision of underground coal mine rule violations is difficult, various accident hidden dangers are caused by easy omission and correction, and the like in the prior art.

title_en: Remote control RC vehicle, control method, system, device and equipment of RC vehicle
abstract_en: The application discloses a remote control RC vehicle, a control method, a control system, a control device and control equipment of the RC vehicle, and relates to the field of RC vehicles. The method comprises the following steps: receiving a remote control signal, wherein the remote control signal is used for indicating a vehicle speed parameter; detecting the actual voltage of a vehicle-mounted battery in the RC car; calculating a power supply simulation value based on the vehicle speed parameter and the actual voltage, wherein the power supply simulation value is used for regulating and controlling the power supply voltage of the vehicle-mounted battery for supplying power to the direct current motor in the RC vehicle; and outputting a control signal according to the power supply analog value to control the vehicle-mounted battery to supply power to the direct current motor. The method can accurately control the actual speed of the RC car.

title_en: Safety monitoring method and system for operation state of industrial control device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of information safety of industrial control systems, in particular to a safety monitoring method and a safety monitoring system for the running state of an industrial control device, wherein the safety of the system is judged by the output result of each executing mechanism in the system; through detection of the input signal and the output signal, the correctness of the output is judged through the logic relation between the input signal and the output signal; judging the validity of data transmission by boundary analysis of the related data set by the system; filtering related communication protocols through the system; the invention starts from the final output function detection of each subsystem in each industrial control system, presets the boundary value of related control and the normal command which is not used in the filtering system, performs credible consistency comparison on the output function of the detected system and the preset function, and timely discovers the system invasion and the fault caused by the information safety, thereby fundamentally preventing the industrial control system safety caused by the information safety and fundamentally solving the information safety problem of the industrial control system.

title_en: Signal lamp with LED lamp beads as light source
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of traffic signal lamps and discloses a signal lamp with LED (light-emitting diode) lamp beads as a light source, wherein a group of signal traffic lamp system lamp boxes are composed of a plurality of signal lamps, each signal lamp comprises a lamp shell, a mounting plate and a plurality of lamp bead units, each lamp bead unit is an LED lamp bead, a transparent protective shell is arranged on the surface of the lamp shell and used for carrying out dust-proof and waterproof protection on the inside of the signal lamp, a plurality of through holes are formed in the surface of the mounting plate, each lamp bead unit is positioned in the through holes on the surface of the mounting plate, a light collecting ring is arranged on the surface of the mounting plate, and the movable lamp bead units are adopted to realize the internal shrinkage and the external extension of the lamp bead units.

title_en: Intelligent cashier device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent cashier device, which comprises a printer, wherein the printer comprises a shell, a bin gate is rotatably connected to the shell through a transmission shaft, a bearing piece connected with the bin gate is arranged in the shell, and the bearing piece is used for unreeling rolled printing paper and further comprises: the driving motors are respectively arranged on the side walls of the two end parts of the transmission shaft in the printer body, the output shafts of the driving motors are telescopic shafts, the telescopic shafts are in a first state and a second state, and when the bin gate is closed, the telescopic shafts are in the first state; when the bin gate is opened, the telescopic shaft is in a second state: when the telescopic shaft is in the first state, the telescopic shaft is in an extending state, and the telescopic shaft extends into the roll printing paper to position the roll printing paper; when the telescopic shaft is in the second state, the telescopic shaft is in a contracted state, the telescopic shaft withdraws the rolled printing paper, the positioning operation on the rolled printing paper is released, and the printing paper can be replaced by opening and closing the bin gate.

title_en: Automatic testing method, device and platform system for refrigerator control flow
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic testing method of a refrigerator control flow, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a pre-drawn test flow chart and test parameters; generating a test case according to the test flow chart and the test parameters; executing the test case and acquiring an execution result of the execution process; and judging a test result according to the execution result. The automatic testing method of the refrigerator control flow can realize faster and visual configuration of the testing process through the testing flow chart, improves the testing efficiency and is convenient for subsequent adjustment and maintenance.

title_en: Method and system for sectional tracking of amplitude range of envelope
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a system for sectional tracking of an envelope amplitude range, which are characterized by comprising the following steps: segmenting the envelope of the radio frequency signal according to different amplitude ranges to obtain segmented envelope signals; the sectional envelope signals respectively adopt different tracking strategies to obtain an envelope amplitude range sectional tracking strategy; the envelope amplitude range segmentation tracking strategy segments according to different amplitude variation distribution of different ranges to obtain segmented tracking voltage; and calculating the optimal efficiency point of all parameter variables affecting the system efficiency and the step wave tracking voltage according to the segmented tracking voltage to obtain the condition of optimal efficiency. The application respectively establishes the tracking strategy according to the signal characteristics of the radio frequency signal in different voltage amplitude ranges, considers all parameter variables influencing the system efficiency, writes a loss calculation program, and finally determines the value of each variable by calculating the optimal efficiency point, thereby being suitable for envelope tracking in any modulation mode and having higher flexibility.

title_en: Multi-step switching and control method for four-foot robot and computer readable medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-step switching and control method of a four-foot robot and a computer readable medium. The single gait cycle time is calculated by setting the flight phase time, the ground phase cycle time, the phase difference and the timer frequency, and the current bottoming system time is used as the phase control time. The four-foot robot calculates the time difference of the starting moment of the single gait cycle of each leg according to the single gait cycle time and the phase difference, and then calculates the duty ratio of different gaits according to the time difference. And calculating the control variable of each leg in real time, and realizing the control of the empty foot and the joint of each leg. The four-foot robot has the advantages that the switching and control of multiple gaits of the four-foot robot are realized by setting the phase difference of each leg, and the stability of the four-foot robot can be ensured by combining a dynamic model.

title_en: Low-power consumption current source, current source circuit, chip and electronic equipment with low-power consumption current source circuit
abstract_en: The invention provides a low-power-consumption current source, a current source circuit, a chip and an electronic device with the same, wherein the low-power-consumption current source circuit comprises: the power supply input end of the P-tube current mirror is connected to the power supply, and the P-tube current mirror is used for being led out of the power supply by mirror image so as to provide power supply outwards; the N-tube current mirror is connected between the P-tube current mirror and the ground, and the N-tube current mirror and the P-tube current mirror form a current source; the degeneracy point switching module is connected between the bias node of the P-tube current mirror and the ground, and keeps a normally-on state before the stable output power supply of the current source. The starting power consumption of the current source circuit is reduced, and the area of the resistor is saved.

title_en: Intelligent safety tool storehouse
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent safety tool warehouse, and relates to the field of intelligent tool warehouses. The intelligent safety tool storehouse comprises a storehouse main body and a tool rack, wherein a circulating fan is arranged on the back surface of the storehouse main body, an air inlet and an exhaust fan are arranged in the storehouse main body, the air inlet and the exhaust fan are connected with the circulating fan, a water cooling unit and a water heater are respectively arranged on two sides of the tail end of the storehouse main body, a water heating pipe is arranged on two sides of the inner bottom of the storehouse main body, a heat exchange bin is arranged between the air inlet and the circulating fan, a heat exchange pipe is arranged in the heat exchange bin, and the water heating pipe and the heat exchange pipe are connected with the water cooling unit and the water heater. This intelligent safety tool storehouse carries out temperature regulation through water-cooling unit and hot-water machine to circulating water, realizes no wind sense temperature regulation through the hot-water heating pipe, realizes quick forced air cooling or wind heat through heat exchange tube and circulating fan to this is to the inside temperature regulation of storehouse main part, reduces temperature regulation's cost simultaneously.

title_en: ETC electronic automatic settlement system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ETC electronic automatic settlement system, and belongs to the technical field of ETC. The invention relates to an ETC electronic automatic settlement system which comprises a vehicle identification unit, an ETC comprehensive unit, an intelligent analysis unit and a cost settlement unit. According to the invention, the payment module is used for paying the reserved account of the ETC equipment according to the toll information calculated by the intelligent analysis unit, when the payment module fails to pay the communication cost of the vehicle, not only can the short message early warning information be sent out, but also the payment information can be generated and sent to the payment module, the secondary payment is implemented on the vehicle through the payment module, and the direct payment is completed.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle equipment for monitoring carbon emission source and monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention discloses unmanned aerial vehicle equipment for monitoring a carbon emission source and a monitoring method, wherein the unmanned aerial vehicle equipment comprises a ground monitoring module, an unmanned aerial vehicle monitoring module, a communication module and a data processing module, and the ground monitoring module comprises a first carbon content monitoring device; the data processing module is in signal connection with the ground monitoring module through the communication module, determines the carbon emission source position for generating the first abnormal carbon content data, and plans an initial flight route of the unmanned aerial vehicle monitoring module; and the unmanned aerial vehicle monitoring module corrects the initial flight route in real time in the carbon emission source tracking process according to the initial flight route, and completes carbon emission source tracking according to the corrected flight route. The monitoring method is a using method of the unmanned aerial vehicle equipment in the carbon emission tracking process, and the monitoring method is used for carbon emission monitoring, so that not only can the carbon emission monitoring strength be ensured, but also the carbon emission source tracking efficiency can be ensured.

title_en: Water outlet control method of folding wing type cross-medium aircraft
abstract_en: A water outlet control method of a folding wing type cross-medium aircraft relates to the field of water outlet control of cross-medium folding wing aircraft. The invention solves the problems that the existing water outlet control strategy for the folding wing type cross-medium aircraft can not realize direct water outlet, is easy to be interfered by environment, has longer water outlet time and has slow response speed. The water outlet control method comprises the steps of firstly executing an underwater constant-depth sailing task, then executing a water outlet task, adjusting the flight attitude through a motion control system during the water outlet task, sailing towards the water surface at a preset water outlet pitch angle, starting the air propeller at maximum power when the air propeller is exposed out of the water surface, and unfolding the wing when the working time of the air propeller reaches the preset working time, so as to realize air sailing. The invention is mainly applied to the field of cross-medium navigation.

title_en: Intelligent community's data security interaction device
abstract_en: The invention provides a data security interaction device of an intelligent community, which relates to the technical field of data interaction and comprises the following components: the top of the interaction machine body is of an inclined plane structure, and a touch screen is fixedly arranged in the inclined plane structure; a water purchasing card reader, a power-on card reader and a water-on card reader are fixedly arranged above the front side of the interaction machine body; a water taking bin is arranged below the middle of the interaction body; the transmission bin is arranged above the middle of the interaction machine body, the quantitative water delivery structure is provided, the transmission motor B is utilized to drive the delivery screw rod to rotate, the delivery screw rod drives the control plate to move forwards, the piston rod is further driven to move, negative pressure is increased in the delivery bin, water is pumped, water passes through the water filter to be filtered, then passes through the upper one-way valve and enters the delivery bin, and quantitative water delivery can be completed, so that the problem that the existing interaction self-service lacks a corresponding quantitative water delivery structure is solved.

title_en: Intelligent operation method of new energy bus based on big data
abstract_en: The intelligent operation method of the new energy bus based on the big data fully utilizes the real bus big data of the new energy bus, can obtain corresponding sectional SOC variation and comprehensive equivalent SOC variation of each section under the influence of various aspects such as time, roads and the like of a bus route, and can guide the realization of reasonable route distribution of the bus to be started. By utilizing the clustering of the vehicle operation data labels, specific conditions and energy consumption of each bus line in different time periods, seasons, months, traffic and the like can be accurately identified, so that all vehicles of each bus station can be brought into intelligent overall arrangement of a plurality of lines, higher flexibility can be provided compared with the operation mode of fixed vehicles and schedules of the traditional bus lines, the possibility is provided for realizing global intelligent traffic, and accidents and potential safety hazards can be effectively avoided.

title_en: System for detecting a condition of a vehicle component
abstract_en: The invention relates to a system (1) for detecting a condition of a vehicle component (210) comprising a server computer (100) and a vehicle (200) having the vehicle component (210). The vehicle (200) has a control computer (220) for controlling the vehicle component (210) and for detecting vehicle data (FD) describing a condition of the vehicle component (210). Furthermore, the vehicle (200) comprises a data transmission device (230) for transmitting vehicle data (FD) to the server computer (100). The server computer (100) is arranged to receive the vehicle data (FD) and to analyze the vehicle data (FD). The server computer (100) is provided for determining a condition of the vehicle component (210) by analyzing the vehicle data (FD).

title_en: Radial hydrostatic deep groove ball bearing
abstract_en: The invention provides a radial hydrostatic deep groove ball bearing, which relates to the technical field of deep groove ball bearings, wherein two retainers are arranged in the base in a counter manner, the interiors of the two retainers are provided with mounting holes in a ring array, the interiors of the mounting holes are connected through inserted positioning pins, balls are arranged at the interiors of the two retainers, and inner rings are arranged at the interiors of the two retainers.

title_en: Optimization method and system of servo driver operation control system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an optimization method and system for a servo driver operation control system, which are characterized in that a deep learning algorithm is utilized to predict fault characteristics of cooperative operation control data to obtain a fault positioning control data set, operation control fault points corresponding to the fault positioning control data set, the number of which is larger than the designated number, are determined to be target operation control fault points, corresponding fault repair firmware data are issued to a system program corresponding to the servo driver operation control system according to the target operation control fault points to control the servo driver operation control system to perform system control configuration optimization, so that the fault characteristics of the servo driver operation control system are predicted by considering the number of the fault positioning control data of different operation control fault points.

title_en: Safety early warning method and early warning system based on water quality environment monitoring data
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of water quality environment monitoring, and discloses a safety early warning method and an early warning system based on water quality environment monitoring data, wherein in the step S1, a collection module in a water source unit collects data information of a water source and sends the data information to a processing unit to calculate available water quantity KY; s2, the threshold module receives the available water quantity KY and compares the available water quantity KY with a water quantity threshold S, an instruction is sent to the early warning unit, and the early warning unit receives the instruction and controls the regulating unit to perform water shortage treatment; the application firstly detects the total amount of the water source by arranging the water source unit, the pollution unit and the purification unit, thereby ensuring that the residents use enough water for the residents, detecting the water source before the water source is purified, adopting different purification modes according to the water sources with different pollution degrees, avoiding the waste of resources, and carrying out the rechecking unit after the water source is purified, thereby ensuring the water consumption requirements of the residents.

title_en: Aging early warning method and system for aluminum alloy cable
abstract_en: The application provides an aging early warning method and system for an aluminum alloy cable, which relate to the technical field of cable early warning and comprise the following steps: the method comprises the steps of collecting modal data of a first aluminum alloy cable to obtain a first modeling data set, modeling to output a first cable simulation model, carrying out state test to output a first prediction aging index for identifying abnormal operation of the cable, carrying out adaptability decomposition of a cable aging neighborhood unit to obtain a first prediction aging area and a first prediction aging depth, obtaining a real-time monitoring image set, inputting a first adaptability function and a second adaptability function, outputting the first adaptability index and the second adaptability index by using an IPSO algorithm, and generating first early warning information. The application solves the technical problems that in the prior art, the aging analysis of the aluminum alloy cable is only carried out on an aging center, so that the aging defect cannot be accurately predicted, the cable aging problem is processed with hysteresis, and the operation safety and stability of a cable system are poor.

title_en: Quality identification system of polyimide insulating film with low expansion coefficient
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quality recognition system of a polyimide insulating film with a low expansion coefficient, and particularly relates to the field of quality recognition. The invention divides the acquired image into areas and compares the flatness of the surface of the coating to divide the difference area, trains an image recognition network by utilizing a plurality of training samples, calculates relative characteristic values according to the acquired parameter data, analyzes the acquired loss function and the relative characteristic values to calculate comprehensive quality values, carries out comprehensive quality judgment according to a set comprehensive quality threshold value, and finally feeds back the comprehensive quality judgment to equipment operators through a control module to control the production process in real time.

title_en: Environment-friendly dredging sediment dump treatment control system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an environment-friendly dredging sediment dump treatment control system, which comprises: the system comprises a sediment dump processing intelligent control subsystem, an intelligent data processor, a data display module, a data transmission module, a remote receiving end, a main controller and an alarm, wherein the sediment dump processing intelligent control subsystem monitors and timely adjusts various parameters in sediment processing of a dump; the intelligent data processor is connected with the sediment dump processing intelligent control subsystem; the data display module is connected with the intelligent data processor and is used for displaying data of the intelligent data processor; the data transmission module transmits the data acquired by the intelligent data processor to the main controller. The control system is executed under the control of the Programmable Logic Controller (PLC), and the whole sludge heap treatment process is controlled through the main controller and each control subsystem, so that the remote operation, remote monitoring and on-line detection, analysis and adjustment of data of the whole system can be realized.

title_en: Data storage method, device, storage medium and automobile
abstract_en: The application discloses a data storage method, a device, a storage medium and an automobile, which are used for receiving a data storage request, determining current configuration data, judging the whole automobile state of the automobile when the current configuration data is acquired, and dividing the whole automobile state into an effective awakening state and an ineffective awakening state according to the starting quantity of functional modules in the automobile; if the whole vehicle state is an effective wake-up state, storing current configuration data; and if the whole vehicle state is an invalid wake-up state, performing preset processing. When the whole vehicle state is the invalid awakening state, the starting quantity of the functional modules in the vehicle does not meet the requirement, so that the configuration data of the required functional modules can be processed into default values, only the current configuration data in the valid awakening state is stored, the stored configuration data of the required functional modules can be prevented from being stored in an overlaying mode by the default values, the stored real and valid configuration values are protected, and the subsequent vehicle using experience of a user is improved.

title_en: Production management device, production management system, production management method, and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a production management device, a production management system, a production management method and a storage medium, which can make a plan with smaller deviation from actual production. The production management device according to the embodiment obtains a first short-term plan created based on a first long-term plan indicating a plan of production in a predetermined period and indicating a plan of production in a first period shorter than the predetermined period, obtains first actual performance data indicating actual performance in a job executed along a part of the first short-term plan, and obtains first prediction data indicating prediction of actual performance in a job executed along another part of the first short-term plan using the first actual performance data. The production management device corrects the first short-term plan based on the first prediction data, acquires second prediction data representing a prediction of actual results of production in a predetermined period using second actual results data representing actual results of work in a first period, and creates a second long-term plan in the predetermined period using the second prediction data.

title_en: Access control system control method and device, storage medium and access control system
abstract_en: An access control system control method and device, a storage medium and an access control system, wherein the access control system comprises a gate, and the access control system control method comprises the following steps: when a riding person with a movement direction facing the gate is detected in a target area, acquiring an image of the riding person, and controlling the gate to be opened when the riding person is determined to meet a passing condition according to the image of the riding person; dividing a region from the gate to a region with a preset distance from the gate into a first region and a second region, wherein the first region is positioned at one side of the second region close to the gate; the target region includes the second region. According to the scheme provided by the embodiment, the riding personnel can detect in advance in the movement process, and when the passing condition is met, the gate is opened in time, so that the passing efficiency can be improved, and the gate is prevented from being damaged.

title_en: Door and window monitoring system with infrared detection and image comparison functions
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of safety anti-theft systems, and particularly relates to a door and window monitoring system with infrared detection and image comparison, which comprises a camera and a plurality of infrared sensors, wherein the camera and the infrared sensors are arranged on a ceiling, the infrared sensors are respectively positioned at the top positions of doors and windows, a protective shell matched with the infrared sensors is fixedly arranged on the ceiling, one side of the protective shell is provided with a ventilation and heat dissipation net, the infrared sensors are arranged in the protective shell, the output ends of the infrared sensors extend to the outer part of the protective shell, a dehumidification mechanism matched with the infrared sensors is arranged on the protective shell, and a humidity monitoring switch matched with the dehumidification mechanism is arranged on the protective shell. According to the invention, dehumidification operation can be automatically performed according to the condition that the humidity near the infrared sensor is high, the working environment of the infrared sensor is optimized, and the camera in the monitoring system can be adjusted in position and angle according to the requirement, so that the practicability of the system is greatly improved.

title_en: Electric demand response module bus scheduling method
abstract_en: The invention provides a bus dispatching method of an electric demand response module. The method is based on the internet of things technology and big data service to collect travel demand information (comprising preferential travel time, boarding points and destinations of passengers) of the passengers, and further constructs an electric demand response module bus scheduling model with operation plans, charging plans and passenger journey planning being cooperatively optimized. The dispatching task of the electric demand response module bus is realized, and the travel scheme (comprising boarding points, boarding time, transfer information, destination arrival time and the like of passengers), the opportunity charging strategy, the operation route of the bus and the schedule are provided for the passengers.

title_en: Fault diagnosis method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a fault diagnosis method, a fault diagnosis device, electronic equipment and a readable storage medium, wherein the fault diagnosis method comprises the following steps: receiving at least one diagnosis fault code reported by a target vehicle; acquiring a regression equation of vehicle faults corresponding to at least one diagnosis fault code; each diagnosis fault code corresponds to one electronic control unit; obtaining the probability of each vehicle fault according to a regression equation of each vehicle fault; and obtaining a fault diagnosis result of the target vehicle according to the probability of each vehicle fault and the electronic control unit corresponding to the diagnosis fault code. According to the application, the probability of each vehicle fault is determined through the regression equation, and the fault diagnosis result of the vehicle is obtained according to the probability of each vehicle fault and the electronic control unit corresponding to the diagnosis fault code, so that the vehicle is not required to be transported to a maintenance point for fault diagnosis, the remote diagnosis of the fault is realized, and the efficiency of fault diagnosis is improved.

title_en: Event triggering sliding mode control method for input delay system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an event triggering sliding mode control method aiming at an input delay system, belonging to the field of industrial process control. Firstly, converting a system with delay into a non-delay form, and estimating the uncertainty and external disturbance in the system for the equivalent system after conversion through an extended state observer. And then, the input of the system is designed in a sliding mode control mode to improve the robustness of the system, and the input is updated by utilizing an event triggering mechanism to improve the resource utilization rate of the system. The invention fully considers various factors of the index of the comprehensive evaluation control system in the actual production process, greatly improves the anti-interference capability, greatly reduces the calculated amount and has wide application prospect.

title_en: Unmanned vehicle parking method and device based on three-dimensional image and navigation comparison
abstract_en: The application discloses an unmanned automobile parking method and device based on three-dimensional image and navigation comparison, comprising the following steps: collecting three-dimensional image data of a massive parking lot, and uploading the collected three-dimensional data to a storage medium; the user calls the three-dimensional image data of the parking lot to be parked; acquiring vehicle position information and idle parking space information, and transmitting the idle parking space information to a user; the user determines the driving direction and the driving route; the vehicle enters a parking lot and starts to acquire three-dimensional image data in real time; comparing the three-dimensional image data acquired in real time with the three-dimensional image data of the parking lot which is acquired in the database in real time; and (5) carrying out real-time safety monitoring in the running process. The three-dimensional image data acquired in real time is compared with the three-dimensional image data of the parking lot, which is acquired in the database, so that the purpose of correcting the vehicle advancing direction in real time is achieved, the three-dimensional image navigation technology does not depend on satellites, and the parking efficiency is greatly improved.

title_en: Method and device for predicting and controlling equipment by faults
abstract_en: The application discloses a method for predicting and controlling equipment by faults, which comprises the following steps: the control system is used for sending command instructions to the AGVs, so that the AGVs are controlled, and when the AGVs are unlocked, the whole AGVs are detected through the detection module in the early warning module, so that the problems of the current AGVs can be detected, early warning is carried out, the detected problems are divided into two types, the first type is that the AGVs do not have faults, the second type is that the AGVs have faults, and when the AGVs have faults, the first type is that the operation of the AGVs is influenced but not influenced, and the other type is that the AGVs have no electricity; the second is to influence the AGV to run normally. The method and the device for predicting and controlling the equipment through the faults improve the early warning function of the AGV, control the automatic guided vehicle with larger faults, enable the automatic guided vehicle to be detected in time, prevent problems when the AGV works, and further enable the AGV to have the obstacle avoidance function by adding the detection probes to the AGV.

title_en: Multichannel temperature on-line measuring device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multichannel temperature online detection device, belongs to the technical field of temperature measurement, and solves the problems that in the prior art, a detection device is fixed in sensor selection, the type of a sensor cannot be automatically identified, and the flexibility and the adaptability are poor. The temperature acquisition device comprises a microcontroller, at least one temperature acquisition channel connected with the microcontroller, wherein the temperature acquisition channel comprises a data acquisition module, a temperature sensor identification circuit and a temperature sensor module, the temperature sensor identification circuit is used for acquiring identification data of a temperature sensor type of the temperature sensor module for identifying the temperature acquisition channel and transmitting the identification data to the microcontroller, and the microcontroller is used for judging the temperature sensor type of the temperature sensor module of the corresponding temperature acquisition channel according to the identification data and outputting a data acquisition instruction to the data acquisition module of the corresponding temperature acquisition channel according to the type of the temperature sensor and also used for acquiring the temperature of the temperature acquisition channel according to the temperature data acquired by the data acquisition module.

title_en: Multi-unmanned aerial vehicle collaborative track planning method and system based on improved particle swarm optimization
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle coordination, in particular to a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle coordination track planning method and system based on an improved particle swarm algorithm, wherein the position and particle correlation speed of each particle in a particle swarm optimization algorithm are built according to track coordinates of all unmanned aerial vehicles; calculating particle speed and position, and updating an individual optimal particle coordinate set and an initial global optimal particle coordinate set; converting the coordinates of each track point of the unmanned aerial vehicle in the initial global optimal particle coordinate set into spherical vector coordinates, sequentially solving the spherical vector coordinates of each track point based on a reverse learning strategy of lens imaging, and converting the reverse solution into Cartesian coordinates; and reversely resolving and replacing the corresponding track point position value in the initial global optimal particle coordinate set by utilizing the track point under the Cartesian coordinate to obtain a new track coordinate vector in the target time period, and updating the global optimal particle coordinate set. The invention can improve the track planning exploration capability in complex scenes and is convenient for application in actual scenes.

title_en: Online intrusion monitoring method based on existing optical fiber vibration signals
abstract_en: The invention discloses an online intrusion monitoring method based on an existing optical fiber vibration signal. Relates to the field of data-driven fault diagnosis. The online intrusion monitoring method based on the existing optical fiber vibration signal can solve the problems of strong uncertainty and low precision of the signal characteristics acquired when the optical fiber sensor acquires the signal. 1) Constructing an initial feature set of the optical fiber vibration signal, and obtaining statistical features of each sampling point for data classification; 2) Training the feature vector of each sampling point by using a random forest; 3) Obtaining suspected invasion positions of the detection sections through multiple classifiers; 4) And (5) utilizing an alarm optimization strategy to record the occurrence position and time of the intrusion event on line. The method is completed through a software algorithm, the data source is an optical fiber vibration signal, and the flexibility and low cost advantage of the algorithm are ensured. The method can be directly used for monitoring railway perimeter intrusion events.

title_en: Power transmission line fault early warning device for unmanned aerial vehicle hoisting
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of installation, fixation and monitoring of overhead lines of power transmission lines, and discloses a power transmission line fault early warning device for unmanned aerial vehicle hoisting, which comprises a lower cover plate, wherein a limiting mechanism is fixedly connected inside the lower cover plate, an upper cover plate is fixedly connected to the top of the limiting mechanism, a clamping mechanism is fixedly connected to the front surface of the top of the upper cover plate, a folding mechanism is fixedly connected to the middle of the top of the upper cover plate, an alarm is fixedly connected to the back end of the top of the upper cover plate, a temperature detector is fixedly connected to the back end of the top of the upper cover plate, a line detector is fixedly connected to the back end of the top of the upper cover plate, the clamping mechanism comprises a first arc-shaped plate, the first arc-shaped plate is fixedly connected to the left side and the right side of the upper cover plate, a first belt pulley is rotatably connected to the top of the first arc-shaped plate, and a threaded rod is connected to the inside of the first belt pulley. Can carry out the centre gripping to the power transmission line through the fixture that inside set up, can fold the hanger plate through the folding mechanism who sets up.

title_en: Bearing state monitoring device and system based on industrial internet edge calculation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of bearing state monitoring, and discloses a bearing state monitoring device and a system based on industrial Internet edge calculation. The invention has the following advantages and effects: the system has the advantages of simplicity, stability, reliability and good sensitivity, realizes real-time monitoring of the state of the bearing, can monitor continuously or at any time under the use state of the bearing, enhances the accuracy of the flexibility and the monitoring result of the monitoring of the state of the bearing, and can timely find out abnormal phenomena occurring during the use of the bearing.

title_en: Automatic production unit layout configuration optimization method considering energy consumption
abstract_en: An automatic production unit layout configuration optimization method considering energy consumption comprises the following steps: step S1: constructing an objective function according to the energy consumption of the transfer robot and the yield of a production workshop; step S2: generating an initial layout based on the process path; step S3: and inputting the objective function into an NSGA-II algorithm, and optimizing the initial layout to obtain the final layout. Aiming at a random production workshop of a custom-made manufacturing enterprise, the invention provides a method for evaluating the performance of an automatic production unit through a simulation model, which effectively solves the problem of joint optimization of the layout of each production unit in the workshop and the cruise speed configuration of a transfer robot in the unit, and provides a scientific analysis method and decision basis for further reducing energy consumption while improving the production benefit when the enterprise is in workshop improvement and upgrading or newly-built factory.

title_en: Payment terminal equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides a payment terminal device which comprises a POS main body, wherein a buffer shell is fixedly arranged at the bottom and two sides of the POS main body, a mounting groove is formed in the top of one end of the POS main body, a thickening key is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the mounting groove, and an adjusting cover is movably arranged in the mounting groove through an adjusting mechanism. Through adjustment mechanism to adjusting the regulation cover and the protection casing, can increase the protection to thickening button and display screen, also can clear up the lateral wall of thickening button through adjusting cover and square hole, easy operation can cushion the impact through the buffering casing, improves the security of this payment terminal equipment.

title_en: Queuing guiding method, queuing guiding device, queuing guiding equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a queuing guide method, a queuing guide device, queuing guide equipment and a storage medium, which relate to the technical field of queuing guide and comprise the following steps: acquiring the open countdown of each queuing area; monitoring a target queuing area corresponding to the opening countdown reaching a preset time threshold in real time; opening an entrance channel gate of the target queuing area to guide queuing personnel to pass into the target queuing area and acquire a monitoring image of the target queuing area; and opening an exit channel gate of the target queuing area based on the monitoring image so as to release queuing personnel in the target queuing area. According to the invention, the plurality of queuing areas are divided, each queuing area is provided with the open countdown, and when the open countdown is reached, the entrance passage gate and the exit passage gate of the target queuing area are opened, so that queuing personnel are guided to pass through the target queuing area, queuing is effectively planned, and thus, the queuing passing efficiency and queuing experience of personnel are comprehensively improved.

title_en: High-time-precision distributed control system and control method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a distributed control system, in particular to a high-time-precision distributed control system and a control method, which solve the technical problem of low time precision of synchronous control of the existing large-scale remote distributed control system. The distributed control system provided by the invention comprises an upper computer system and K front-end custom control devices, wherein the upper computer system comprises an operator console, a time server and a database server; the front-end custom control equipment comprises a power supply module, a CPU module and T I/O modules, wherein the CPU module and the T I/O modules are respectively connected with the power supply module, the functions of the front-end industrial personal computer and the executing mechanism are integrated into the front-end custom control equipment uniformly, and the system structure is simpler and more reliable; the time precision of the instruction output synchronization is the time synchronization precision of the I/O module, is not influenced by the scale of the system and/or the distance of the nodes, and has high time precision of the system; the front-end custom control equipment adopts a tight coupling structure, and has stronger flexibility, expandability and reliability.

title_en: Synchronous control system and method for continuous motion mechanism and intermittent motion mechanism
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electromechanical control, and particularly relates to a synchronous control system and a synchronous control method for a continuous motion mechanism and an intermittent motion mechanism. The method comprises the following specific steps: in order to solve the inaccurate and high-cost problems of prediction in the prior art, the invention calculates the moment when the intermittent motion mechanism moves to the end point according to the time length of a section of path used by the intermittent motion mechanism in the motion period, changes the motion speed of the continuous motion mechanism, enables the continuous motion mechanism to simultaneously move to the ideal final position of continuous motion when the intermittent motion mechanism moves to the end point, and enables the continuous motion mechanism and the intermittent motion mechanism to synchronously reach the end point.

title_en: High-voltage test early warning method, device, equipment and storage medium based on safety clothing
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of high-voltage tests under high altitude conditions, and provides a high-voltage test early warning method, device, equipment and storage medium based on a safety garment. According to the application, a biological index prediction model is obtained based on a plurality of groups of training data obtained by the safety clothing worn by operators; each set of training data includes: historical environmental parameter monitoring values and historical biological index monitoring values of operators in the working environment of a high-voltage test under the high-altitude condition; obtaining a working environment prediction model based on a plurality of historical environment parameter monitoring values which are obtained by the safety clothing and are continuous in time; obtaining an environmental parameter predicted value according to the operation environment predicted model; inputting the environmental parameter predicted value into a biological index predicted model to obtain a biological index predicted value; and determining whether to send out an early warning message of a high-voltage test under the high altitude condition according to whether the biological index predicted value is in a safety range.

title_en: Low-power consumption control system of emergency cut-off valve
abstract_en: The invention provides a low-power consumption control system of an emergency cut-off valve, which relates to the technical field of gas field wellhead equipment and comprises a power supply selection circuit and an MCU: the power supply selection circuit is respectively connected with an external power supply and a built-in battery, and the priority is the external power supply and the built-in battery in sequence; the MCU is connected with a digital quantity control circuit, an electronic fusible plug, a man-machine interaction driving circuit and a motor driving circuit; the MCU is in a low main frequency state normally, only the digital quantity control circuit, the man-machine interaction driving circuit and the electronic fusible plug are maintained to operate, and when the MCU detects a valve opening and closing instruction of the digital quantity control circuit or the man-machine interaction driving circuit, the MCU enters an operation mode, all functions operate, and the operation is switched to the low main frequency state after the valve opening and closing is executed. The system adopts a low-power consumption design, and adopts various modes to ensure the reliability of the valve electric switch.

title_en: Storehouse environment control system based on thing networking
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of warehouse environment control, and particularly discloses a warehouse environment control system based on the Internet of things.

title_en: Sine wave meridian dredging instrument
abstract_en: The application discloses a sine wave meridian dredging instrument.A power supply module is connected with an external 220V power supply to supply power to a whole circuit and convert the power supply into a low-voltage power supply, and a singlechip generates a 20-1kHz sine wave signal and is divided into independent controllable signals to be output to a signal isolator after the size of the sine wave signal is regulated by a digital potentiometer; the signal isolator sends signals to each path of amplifier respectively and outputs amplified sine wave current to the electrode plate through the constant current circuit and the isolation inductor thereof; the singlechip is connected with the nixie tube, and the output value and the time value of the sine wave are displayed through the nixie tube; the singlechip is connected with the digital potentiometer and the key switch and controls the starting and stopping of signals of each path of sine wave through the digital potentiometer and the key switch; the timing switch controls the output time of the sine wave; the remote controller is connected with the infrared module through signals and is connected with the key switch through the infrared module. The meridian dredging instrument integrates electrotherapy, acupuncture, massage, scraping and body control functions, does not need to take medicines, does not need to be injected, and is environment-friendly.

title_en: Telescopic transfer robot for hanging basket
abstract_en: The application provides a control system for a telescopic platform, belonging to the technical field of equipment control; through the arrangement of an MCU microcontroller, a quick cutting module and the like, gear switching can be quickly performed by utilizing the quick cutting module under the special condition that the platform is powered off, so that the safety and the reliability and the stable equipment operation during paint spraying operation are ensured; the used horizontal transfer structure synchronously stretches by means of the mode of transmission of the screw rod, combination of a chain and the like, long-distance synchronous stretching is realized under the condition of a shorter screw rod, and the situations that the existing transfer structure is easy to be blocked and cannot stretch are greatly reduced; the distance sensor is matched with the photosensitive plate, so that the telescopic distance can be obtained in real time, a basis is provided for power supply control of the power supply controller, and the safety and reliability of equipment operation can be further ensured.

title_en: Direct current speed regulation practical training control cabinet
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of direct current speed regulation practical training control cabinets and discloses a direct current speed regulation practical training control cabinet, which comprises an operation table, wherein a practical training panel is arranged on one side of the top of the operation table, a controller is arranged on the other side of the top of the operation table, the controller is matched with the practical training panel for use, a wire control structure is further arranged on the top of the operation table, a collecting structure is arranged on one side of the inside of the operation table, the wire control structure can be matched with the collecting structure for use.

title_en: Holder and system for CT testing of hydrate-containing sediment samples
abstract_en: The application provides a holder and a system for CT test of sediment samples containing hydrate, and relates to the technical field of submarine surveying. The clamp comprises a storage cavity and a heat conduction cavity; the interior of the storage cavity is used for storing a sediment sample containing hydrate; the storage cavity is provided with a pressurizing connector; wherein the pressurizing connector is used for allowing a pressurizing medium to flow into the storage cavity so that the pressure in the storage cavity is equivalent to the in-situ pressure of the hydrate-containing sediment sample; the heat conduction cavity is wrapped outside the storage cavity and is not communicated with the storage cavity; wherein the heat conducting cavity is used for containing a heat conducting medium, so that the temperature in the storage cavity is equivalent to the in-situ temperature of the hydrate-containing sediment sample through heat exchange of the heat conducting medium. The pressure and temperature in the storage cavity can simulate the in-situ pressure and temperature of the hydrate-containing sediment sample, so that the hydrate-containing sediment sample can be stored in the storage cavity for a long time, and the problem of sample distortion is avoided.

title_en: High-stability low-dropout linear voltage regulator
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-stability low-dropout linear voltage regulator, which comprises a power tube, an error amplifier and a compensation circuit, wherein the power tube outputs load current; the error amplifier is used for controlling the conduction degree of the power tube according to the difference signal of the feedback voltage and the first reference voltage, so as to influence the magnitude of the load current; the compensation circuit is used for compensating the difference signal according to the load condition, when the load is a type of load, compensating the difference signal for a current signal equal to the load current, carrying out a type of correction on the voltage of the control end of the power tube, when the load is a type of load, compensating the difference signal for a current signal which changes along with the load current, and carrying out a type of correction on the voltage of the control end of the power tube. According to different loads, different compensation values are set to reduce the influence of different poles, so that the stability of the low-dropout linear voltage regulator can be enhanced.

title_en: Spacecraft energy system digital accompanying system and method based on data and time driving
abstract_en: A spacecraft energy system digital companion flight system and method based on data and time driving, comprising: on-orbit long tube monitoring module: receiving and processing on-orbit telemetry data transmitted by a spacecraft measurement and control radio frequency channel; the on-orbit spacecraft energy parameter acquisition module is used for: receiving on-orbit telemetry data multicast by an on-orbit long tube monitoring module, and extracting parameters including spacecraft time, illumination parameters and bus load parameters; the energy system digital simulation module: based on spacecraft time, illumination parameters and bus load parameters extracted from in-orbit telemetry data, performing energy simulation by using an energy system digital simulation model to generate energy system working parameters; virtual-real synchronization comparison module of energy system: and comparing and analyzing the simulation data and the real data after the time alignment of the simulation working parameters of the energy system and the working parameters of the on-orbit real energy system synchronously, and monitoring the deviation of the virtual and real data to realize digital accompanying and synchronous monitoring.

title_en: Aged care terminal equipment based on artificial intelligence noninductive monitoring technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of non-inductive monitoring, in particular to a senior terminal device based on an artificial intelligence non-inductive monitoring technology; the intelligent crutch comprises a handheld crutch body, an outdoor interconnection box and an intelligent bracelet, wherein the outdoor interconnection box is fixed on the upper part of the crutch body, a through groove is formed in a handle at the upper end of the crutch body, and a flexible girdle on one side of the intelligent bracelet can penetrate through the through groove and be detachably connected with a flexible girdle on the other side of the intelligent bracelet; the invention can facilitate the community service personnel to monitor the heart rate and the body temperature of the solitary old man in real time, so that when the solitary old man has too high heart rate or too high body temperature, the community service personnel can timely find problems and arrange personnel to check according to the accurate position information given by the GPS positioning module, thereby avoiding the problems that the solitary old man cannot find in time due to diseases or heatstroke syncope, and facilitating the timely and safe development of community care work.

title_en: Fall risk processing method and device, intelligent artificial limb, terminal and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tumble risk processing method, a tumble risk processing device, an intelligent artificial limb, a terminal and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring rotational motion data of a user body and rotational motion data of the knee joint; determining the tumbling risk information of the user based on the rotational motion data and the rotational motion data; based on the fall risk information, damping data of the damping device is adjusted to increase bending resistance to the knee joint. According to the invention, the tumbling risk information of the user can be judged based on the rotation motion data of the body of the user and the rotation motion data of the rotating shaft in the knee joint, and then the damping data of the damping device is adjusted according to the determined tumbling risk information so as to increase the bending resistance of the knee joint, thereby ensuring the safety and stability of the intelligent artificial limb used by the user.

title_en: Automatic temperature adjustment control method and system for self-learning resistor cabinet
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-learning resistor cabinet temperature automatic adjustment control method and a self-learning resistor cabinet temperature automatic adjustment control system, wherein the self-learning resistor cabinet temperature automatic adjustment control method comprises the following steps: the control system records the temperature change time curve of the resistance cabinet and the environmental temperature of the gate at different descending speed levels when the fan stops working and the fan works respectively, and stores the temperature change time curve and the environmental temperature into the database when the gate is closed; the processing system carries out data self-learning processing according to the database and calculates the alarm temperature; the control system automatically detects the temperature of the resistor cabinet and outputs a control protection signal. The self-learning resistance cabinet temperature automatic regulation control method and system provided by the invention automatically generate a set of self-feedback control logic meeting the field requirement, so that when the dam maintenance door machine moves from the maintenance door warehouse position to the maintenance door slot position corresponding to the maintenance unit, the temperature of the resistance cabinet of the control system is always kept within a certain range, and the normal operation of the water inlet door machine control system is ensured.

title_en: Static power consumption management system and method for chemical composition equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a static power consumption management system and a method for a chemical composition device, belonging to the technical field of chemical composition, wherein the system comprises: an upper computer; one end of the middle position machine is connected with the upper position machine; one end of the power supply control modules is connected with the other end of the middle position machine; the power modules are respectively connected with the other end of one power module; the power control module includes: one end of the MCU is connected with the power module; one end of the communication unit is connected with the other end of the MCU, and the other end of the communication unit is connected with the other end of the median machine; and the power supply unit is respectively connected with the MCU and the communication unit. The invention has the advantages that: the standby power consumption of the chemical composition equipment is greatly reduced, and the flexibility of static power consumption management is greatly improved.

title_en: Intelligent combined guidance method for closed-loop tracking of aerospace shuttle aircraft
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of closed-loop tracking intelligent combined guidance of aerospace shuttle vehicles, and particularly relates to an aerospace shuttle vehicle closed-loop tracking intelligent combined guidance method, which comprises the following steps: s1: designing an LSTM aircraft track prediction algorithm; s2: establishing an RLV reentry segment error model and converting constraint control problems; s3: an aircraft tracking controller based on adaptive dynamic programming is designed. According to the invention, the prediction correction framework is adopted, the controller is designed by combining prediction and self-adaptive dynamic programming based on the LSTM method, so that the selected performance index function can be ensured to reach the optimum in a limited time domain, the optimum feedback guidance law is obtained, and the autonomy of the controller is improved.

title_en: Hydropower station monitoring system and method
abstract_en: The system comprises a data acquisition module, a data processing module, a control module and a control module, wherein the data acquisition module acquires data to be detected of a component to be detected of the hydropower station, the data processing module evaluates the data to be detected according to a preset evaluation mechanism, correspondingly determines an evaluation state of the data to be detected, and generates a corresponding control instruction according to the evaluation state, so that preliminary processing of the data to be detected is realized, abnormal conditions of the hydropower station are effectively identified, and the corresponding control instruction is given out; the data control module is used for controlling the component to be tested according to the control instruction, so that the abnormal situation in the monitoring process is handled according to the control instruction.

title_en: MES/PCS integrated system of digital workshop
abstract_en: The invention discloses an MES/PCS integrated system of a digital workshop, which comprises: the role project management module is divided into a warehouse management party, a manager, a finance party, a purchasing party and a production party based on engineering production data; the production data management module is used for carrying out calculation coordination according to the lists respectively uploaded by the warehouse management party, the purchasing party and the production party and updating the real-time storage state; the production line management module is used for comparing the recorded production side list with the number of the actual products to be checked and accepted, calculating the loss rate, and obtaining actual yield data by making a difference between the loss rate and rated loss; and the data acquisition module is used for cleaning data based on the monitoring of the running state of the sensor and the automatic workshop system. The MES/PCS integrated system of the digital workshop provided by the invention fully coordinates the relations of purchasing, producing, storing and selling, and can automatically coordinate an idle production line to ensure the health of the productivity state according to the production pressure.

title_en: Route generation method, device and equipment of electric power inspection unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention provides a route generation method, a device and equipment of an electric power inspection unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining a plurality of target waypoints, wherein the target waypoints are preset with coordinate information of the target waypoints and yaw angles of the unmanned aerial vehicle at the target waypoints; generating an initial distance matrix based on the coordinate information; generating a yaw angle matrix based on the yaw angles; updating an initial distance matrix based on the yaw angle matrix to obtain an intermediate distance matrix; detecting whether an obstacle exists on a moving path between any two target waypoints, and obtaining a detection result; updating the intermediate distance matrix based on the detection result to obtain a final distance matrix; generating a route based on the final distance matrix. The method not only considers the distance between the target waypoints, but also considers the flight distance required by the unmanned aerial vehicle to adjust the difference of the yaw angles between any two target waypoints, and whether the obstacle exists on the moving path reduces the flight energy consumption of the unmanned aerial vehicle, ensures the inspection safety of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and improves the inspection efficiency.

title_en: Electric equipment protection system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electric appliances, in particular to a protection system for electric equipment. The power supply comprises a power supply module and a control module; the control module is used for controlling the electric equipment to send a shutdown signal; the power supply module is used for providing power for the control module; the control module comprises a control logic board and a signal transmission wire; the control logic board is used for receiving signals of the power management board; the signal conducting wire is used for connecting the control logic board and the electric equipment. According to the electric equipment protection system, the power supply module and the control module are matched, so that electric equipment can be managed uniformly when in use, meanwhile, when a power-off signal is received when power is off, the electric equipment is provided with a temporary power support through a standby power supply, and meanwhile, the electric equipment is provided with a power-off or power-on signal, and further, the electric equipment can be protected.
