title_en: Automatic fire extinguishing system for protecting multiple fume hoods and design method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic fire extinguishing system for protecting a plurality of fume hoods and a design method thereof, belonging to the technical field of fume hoods and aiming at solving the problems that the existing fume hood fire extinguishing device has single working mode, only protects one fume hood, has low fire response speed, can not link a superior system and extinguishing agent to harm human bodies and the like, the automatic fire extinguishing system for protecting a plurality of fume hoods comprises: the fire extinguishing control box (3), a temperature sensor, an audible alarm (1), a fire extinguishing bottle (10) and a partition valve (2); the design method comprises the following steps: s1: designing a fire extinguishing main control board; s2: designing a fire extinguishing control box based on the fire extinguishing main control board; s3: based on the fire extinguishing control box, an automatic fire extinguishing system for protecting a plurality of fume hoods is designed. The invention realizes the design of protecting a plurality of fume hoods; compared with a fire detection tube type fire extinguishing device, the fire detection tube type fire extinguishing device has the advantages of convenience in installation, high fire alarm response speed, linkage of a window system, no harm to personnel and precision equipment and the like.

title_en: Job shop scheduling method and system based on bidirectional coupling scheduling decoding
abstract_en: The invention relates to a job shop scheduling method and a job shop scheduling system based on bidirectional coupling scheduling decoding. And then, performing bidirectional scheduling coupling, setting a breakpoint from a position after the first procedure, dividing the code into a front section and a rear section, taking forward active scheduling corresponding to the former section of code and reverse active scheduling corresponding to the latter section of code, coupling the two sections of scheduling together according to machine constraint and procedure constraint, so as to obtain a complete scheduling, and recording the maximum finishing time and the dividing position. Then moving the breakpoint backward by one procedure, dividing the breakpoint into two procedures, and repeating the above operations. And the like until the breakpoint is set to be before the last procedure. Comparing the maximum finishing time corresponding to all the breakpoints, and selecting the scheduling generated by the breakpoint with the minimum maximum finishing time as a final result.

title_en: Self-adaptive curved surface focusing ultrasonic treatment probe and control method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a self-adaptive curved surface focusing ultrasonic treatment probe and a control method, which are characterized by comprising a power probe module, a B ultrasonic probe module and a measurement module, wherein sub probes in the B ultrasonic probe module and the power probe module can do telescopic motion along a fixed direction so as to automatically adapt to different curved surfaces, the measurement module can measure the distance difference value of each sub probe in real time, and after calculation, the power emission time sequence of the sub probes is controlled by the control method, so that the effect of ultrasonic focusing ultrasonic treatment is achieved.

title_en: PLC-based airtight instrument
abstract_en: The invention discloses an airtight instrument based on a PLC (programmable logic controller), which belongs to the field of airtight detection and comprises a box body, wherein the box body is provided with an inner cavity, the surface of the box body is provided with an oil-water separator, the inner cavity is provided with a PLC (programmable logic controller) and an ADP (ADP core) module, the PLC and the ADP core module are electrically connected, the inner cavity is provided with an air pressure detection control structure, and the air pressure detection control structure is electrically connected with the PLC; through having set up PLC controller and atmospheric pressure detection control structure, two solenoid valves and the pressure sensor of atmospheric pressure detection control structure pass through the PLC controller and mutually support to let the device carry out multiple gas tightness pressure detection, can detect whether the device work piece itself leaks gas, detect the gas output pressure of outside gas output device and carry out the output of quantitative pressure gas to outside gas output device.

title_en: Electric equipment, and dumping detection method, device, equipment and storage medium thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to a method and a device for detecting electric equipment dumping, dumping detection equipment, electric equipment, a computer readable storage medium and a computer program product. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring distance data between a detection position of electric equipment and a reference plane; judging whether the electric equipment is in a toppling state or not according to the distance data; if yes, controlling the electric equipment to stop running. By adopting the method, the state of the electric equipment can be detected, and the electric equipment is controlled to stop running when the electric equipment is detected to be in a toppling state, so that the use safety of the electric equipment is improved.

title_en: Opening method of double-sided locker and storing and taking method of double-sided locker
abstract_en: The application discloses a cabinet opening method of a double-sided cabinet and a storage and taking method of the double-sided cabinet, and belongs to the technical field of computers. The method comprises the following steps: responding to the operation of a user, determining the user identity of the user using the double-sided locker, or determining the object storage intention of the user; in response to scanning a first graphic code positioned on a first surface of the double-sided locker, displaying a first page under the condition that the user identity or the accessor is not intended to be matched with the first graphic code, wherein first prompt information is displayed in the first page and used for indicating the user to go to a second surface, different from the first surface, of the double-sided locker for operation; one of the first surface and the second surface is the object storage surface of the double-sided storage cabinet, the other surface is the object fetching surface of the double-sided storage cabinet, and the graphic code positioned on the object storage surface is different from the graphic code positioned on the object fetching surface. The method makes the storage of the articles more efficient.

title_en: Control method and system for bracket angle based on robot and robot
abstract_en: The application discloses a control method, a system and a robot of a support angle based on a robot, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining pose, GPS data and current time data of a current robot in a global coordinate system, calculating a solar altitude angle and an azimuth angle through time and the GPS data, accordingly calculating a position coordinate of the sun in the global coordinate system, obtaining a direction vector of the current sun in a Cartesian coordinate system through coordinate conversion, obtaining a depth image of a photovoltaic tracking panel through a laser radar and a camera arranged on the robot, accordingly obtaining the pose of the photovoltaic tracking panel relative to the robot, calculating the pose and normal vector of the photovoltaic tracking panel in the global coordinate system, and controlling the tracking support to be adjusted to the optimal angle through the robot according to the direction vector of the sun and the optimal angle of the photovoltaic tracking panel.

title_en: Band gap reference circuit and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to a bandgap reference circuit and an electronic device. The bandgap reference circuit includes: the current generation module is configured to generate a positive temperature coefficient current and a negative temperature coefficient current, wherein the positive temperature coefficient current and the negative temperature coefficient current are used for compensating a linear term current corresponding to the change of the transistor voltage along with the temperature in the band gap reference circuit; and a temperature compensation module including a first branch and a second branch, the temperature compensation module configured to determine a higher order temperature compensation current based on a current flowing through the first branch and a current flowing through the second branch, the higher order temperature compensation current being used to compensate for a nonlinear term current corresponding to a transistor voltage varying with temperature. The band-gap reference circuit disclosed by the application can adaptively compensate nonlinear term current corresponding to the voltage of the transistor along with the temperature change, so that a lower temperature coefficient is obtained. The band-gap reference circuit has the advantages of simple design, low cost, easy integration, more stable reference voltage output by the band-gap reference circuit and higher precision.

title_en: Method and system for implementing electromagnetic spectrum interference by unmanned aerial vehicle cluster cooperated with machine learning
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of electromagnetic space spectrum countermeasure and intelligent optimization technology intersection of unmanned aerial vehicle cluster systems, and particularly relates to an electromagnetic spectrum interference implementation method and system for unmanned aerial vehicle cluster collaborative machine learning. Firstly, carrying out mathematical modeling on the interference decision process of the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster, carrying out mathematical model construction on the state of the spectrum change of an interference target object along with time and the interference frequency spectrum decision process implemented by the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster, and completing collaborative interference decision and environment transformation symbolization. And then, collaborative online interference and decision iteration circulation of each interference subgroup of the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster is carried out, decision matrix iteration and online interference implementation of each interference subgroup of the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster are carried out according to interference decisions, interference effect calculation, environment state update and the like of each interference subgroup of the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster, distributed and collaborative unmanned intelligent electromagnetic spectrum interference learning is realized, and the accuracy of electromagnetic interference release and dynamic response capability to interference object change rules and environment change are improved.

title_en: Control method and system for slurry air cushion bin liquid level of shield tunneling machine and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a control method for self-adjusting the liquid level of a slurry air cushion bin of a shield tunneling machine, which comprises the following steps: acquiring first liquid level data of a current muddy water air cushion bin; performing air cushion liquid level analysis processing on the first liquid level data by combining a preset first liquid level threshold value to generate a control information packet, wherein the control information packet comprises first control information; analyzing the control information packet to obtain first control information; performing pulp discharge control processing according to the first control information; and the slurry discharging control process is used for controlling the slurry discharging state of the current excavation bin and the mud water bin. Compared with the prior art, the technical scheme disclosed by the application can automatically adjust the liquid level height of the muddy water air cushion bin, accurately regulate and control the water and soil pressure of the excavation face of the excavation bin, reduce the collapse risk of the excavation face and improve the excavation efficiency. The application also discloses a control system and electronic equipment for the self-adjustment of the slurry air cushion bin liquid level of the shield tunneling machine.

title_en: Inspection method, inspection device, inspection system, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a patrol method, a device, a system, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring first perception data acquired by first inspection equipment, and generating an early warning event based on the first perception data; based on the early warning event, determining a patrol task and second patrol equipment for executing the patrol task; and sending a task instruction to the second inspection device based on the inspection task, so that the second inspection device determines an inspection path and a target inspection area based on the task instruction, and moves to the target inspection area along the inspection path for inspection. The method, the device, the system, the electronic equipment and the storage medium can realize the whole coverage, the efficient operation and the timely response capability of the security inspection, and improve the inspection efficiency and the management level.

title_en: Automatic alarm calling device for disabled people in emergency
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic alarm calling device for the disabled in emergency, which comprises a unidirectional delay reset mechanism, a fixed reset guide mechanism, a slow rotation driving power generation mechanism and a circuit protection mechanism. The invention belongs to the technical field of calling devices, and particularly relates to an automatic alarm calling device for the disabled in emergency; the invention provides a mechanical power generation and direct driving mode, and in addition, the invention also can prolong the duration of the resetting stage by adding a damping mode so as to realize the purpose of continuous sounding; most importantly, because the patient is weak when calling for help, the invention also provides a unidirectional delay reset mechanism, the trigger can be quickly realized by using small force, and the buzzer can continuously sound relatively stably for a period of time after the trigger, thereby playing the purpose of calling.

title_en: Fire emergency method and system based on intelligent fire protection
abstract_en: The application relates to a fire emergency method and system based on intelligent fire protection, and relates to the technical field of intelligent fire protection, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the target sensing equipment group periodically detects fire precursor information, sends fire emergency information carrying the fire precursor information to a corresponding private domain management system, and sends an image sharing instruction to surrounding public image detection equipment; the private domain management system receives the public area image transmitted by the public image detection device and detects the private area image through the private domain image detection device; the private domain management system determines a fire scene according to the public area image and the private area image and the fire precursor information; the private domain management system generates a private domain fire emergency scheme aiming at a fire scene based on the current state of private domain personnel and the configuration condition of private domain assets; the private domain management system transmits the fire condition live condition and the private domain fire condition corresponding scheme to the public management center so that the public management center makes a fire condition auxiliary emergency scheme.

title_en: Simulation test and evaluation method, equipment and medium for continuous lane change of vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulation test and evaluation method, equipment and medium for continuous lane change of a vehicle, which comprises the following steps: building a vehicle simulation model; establishing a simulation scene route which is designed to simulate the working condition of emergency continuous channel switching; constructing a simulation closed-loop control model based on the reaction time and the transition operation of a driver, and performing simulation calculation and iteration; determining an evaluation index of continuous lane change of the vehicle, and processing and analyzing simulation data; and determining an evaluation standard, and evaluating the stability performance of the continuous lane change of the vehicle. According to the invention, the set vehicle parameters can be subjected to limit capability test in the initial stage of vehicle development, standard comparison analysis is performed through the evaluated function, and the vehicle steering stability performance is rapidly optimized.

title_en: Intelligent wheelchair control method, device, equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides an intelligent wheelchair control method, system, equipment and readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: receiving a first prompt message sent by a first processor, wherein the first prompt message is used for representing the speed mode of the intelligent wheelchair; receiving a second prompt message sent by the first processor; calculating the expected speed of the left wheel of the intelligent wheelchair and the expected speed of the right wheel of the intelligent wheelchair according to the second prompt information; calculating the current actual speed of the left wheel of the intelligent wheelchair and the current actual speed of the right wheel of the intelligent wheelchair; calculating a rotating speed adjusting value of the first engine according to the expected speed of the left wheel and the current actual speed of the left wheel; calculating a rotating speed adjusting value of the second engine according to the expected speed of the right wheel and the current actual speed of the right wheel; the rotation speed of the first engine is adjusted according to the rotation speed adjusting value of the first engine, and the rotation speed of the second engine is adjusted according to the rotation speed adjusting value of the second engine.

title_en: Data visualization and broadcasting method based on intelligent park management
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent park management, in particular to a data visualization and broadcasting method based on intelligent park management, which is based on a GIS+BIM model to construct an intelligent park three-dimensional visualization platform with a uniform geographic coordinate system and a spatial reference frame, the method supports centralized display of data, utilizes advanced information visualization means to process and extract the implicit value of the data, and can reflect the real running state of the demonstration area in real time through a large screen. The system comprises three-dimensional comprehensive display of position and state data of all system equipment, and real-time operation monitoring services of monitoring equipment, access control equipment, energy consumption equipment, building equipment, fire protection equipment, personnel positioning, vehicles, green ecology and other building equipment, electric and weak current equipment and all subsystems. The invention can display more information of the intelligent park, so that the user can know the intelligent park more fully.

title_en: Lifting teaching control method, device, equipment and medium for surgical robot
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a surgical robot lifting teaching control method, a device, equipment and a medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: when the target control lifting joint is under the action of external control force, the target control lifting joint is controlled to shake; determining a force application direction of the external control force; carrying out dynamic model parameter identification according to the force application direction, the real-time position information and the real-time speed information of the target control lifting joint and the preset mapping relation between the moment and the joint motion parameters, and determining a target dynamic model; and controlling the target to control the lifting joint to move based on the target dynamics model. According to the technical scheme, the external control force direction of the surgical robot is determined through the shake feedforward, a torque sensor is not needed, lifting teaching cost is reduced, parameter identification is carried out on the dynamic model based on control data collected in a current loop control mode, and stability of the lifting teaching control process of the surgical robot is improved.

title_en: Vehicle on-loop testing device and method for congestion auxiliary control module
abstract_en: The invention provides a vehicle in-loop testing device and method of a congestion auxiliary control module, wherein the device comprises the following components: the test car and the positioning device, the real-time cabinet, the upper computer, the video injection board card, the sample to be tested and the power supply which are arranged on the test car. Simulation software is installed in the upper computer, and a simulation sensor is configured in the simulation software. The positioning device collects position and posture information of the test vehicle and transmits the position and posture information of the test vehicle to the real-time cabinet, and the real-time cabinet feeds back the received position and posture information of the test vehicle to a simulation vehicle in a simulation environment. The upper computer sends the image information acquired by the simulation sensor to the video injection board card, the video injection board card processes the received image information and then sends the processed image information to the sample to be tested, the sample to be tested feeds back a control signal according to the received processed image information and based on a built-in algorithm, and the sample to be tested outputs the control signal to the test car through the real car gateway.

title_en: Carbon emission monitoring method and system based on traffic flow data
abstract_en: The invention provides a carbon emission monitoring method based on traffic flow data, which comprises the steps of obtaining an in-image and an out-image of a vehicle on a specified road, wherein the in-image and the out-image both carry corresponding image generation time; obtaining the model and total running time of the vehicle according to the running-in image, the running-out image and the image generation time carried by the two images, determining the air-fuel ratio and the pollutant emission concentration volume ratio, the pollutant volume quality conversion coefficient and the pollutant carbon content associated with the air-fuel ratio according to the model of the vehicle, and further combining the total running time of the vehicle and the relevant lengths of the flat road, the ascending slope and the descending slope in a pre-stored appointed road to obtain the pollutant emission quantity of the vehicle. By implementing the invention, dynamic tail gas monitoring can be carried out on vehicles running on the road, and the invention has the advantages of time saving, labor saving, high efficiency, less pollution and the like, and can also avoid the damage caused by tail gas when the monitoring is participated manually.

title_en: Nitrogen oxide detection sensor with voltage signal output function and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nitrogen oxide detection sensor for voltage signal output and a control method thereof, which belong to the technical field of sensor detection, and the nitrogen oxide detection sensor for voltage signal output comprises a ceramic probe and a wire harness, wherein a ceramic core for detection is arranged in the ceramic probe, the ceramic core is electrically connected with a controller through a wire, and a four-pin connector for connecting an external data collector is arranged on the controller.

title_en: Airport risk area determining method, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides an airport risk area determining method, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the field of airport risk area determination, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining historical flight track point information of each target of all airplanes which take off and land at a target airport in a historical time period; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a subarea set Q, obtaining a track point density set lambda, obtaining a vertical distance list set D, obtaining a target vertical distance corresponding to each subarea to obtain a target vertical distance set MD, obtaining a runaway index SK of a target unmanned aerial vehicle, determining a collision risk index of each subarea according to lambda, MD and SK to obtain a collision risk index set R, determining each subarea in the Q as a risk area corresponding to a risk level, setting a corresponding color for each subarea, and enabling the risk areas divided by the method to be matched with preset flight data of the target unmanned aerial vehicle and enabling a user to intuitively see the risk area with higher risk level.

title_en: Mixed operation road right indicating device and method for mine car
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of road right indicating devices and discloses a road right indicating device for mixing operation of mine cars and a method thereof. The invention installs the same number of indicator lamps according to the number of roads communicated with the intersections, and the angle formed by the corresponding roads is the same as the angle formed by the corresponding indicator lamps, so that the indicator lamps can be conveniently observed through different road intersections.

title_en: Parking assist method and parking assist device
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a parking assist method and a parking assist apparatus. The parking assist method according to the present disclosure is a method for automatically traveling a vehicle based on a parking operation performed in the past, and includes the steps of: a storage step of storing information on at least one of a travel path and a parking target position in a parking operation performed in the past in a storage unit; and a display step of displaying, on the display unit, guidance information on a target position at which automatic travel of the vehicle is possible based on at least one of the travel route and the parking target position.

title_en: Slope instability monitoring and early warning system
abstract_en: The application relates to a slope unstability monitoring early warning system belongs to the technical field of slope monitoring, and this early warning system includes: the CCD micro-deformation monitor is arranged on a slope 2/3/4 three-stage step; the GPS monitoring station is arranged on each step of the side slope and is close to the CCD micro-deformation monitor; the fiber bragg grating detector is arranged on each step of the side slope and is vertically arranged; the pore water pressure gauge is provided with a drill hole which is arranged on a 4-stage step of the side slope and is vertically arranged; the controller is used for receiving and forwarding monitoring data, wherein the monitoring data comprise data collected by a CCD micro-deformation monitor, a GPS monitoring station, a fiber grating detector and a pore water pressure gauge; and the early warning platform is used for receiving the monitoring data, analyzing the monitoring data, judging whether the monitoring data is abnormal, and if yes, sending early warning information. The method has the advantage of improving the monitoring precision.

title_en: Human-computer interaction system based on AI virtual reality
abstract_en: The invention discloses a man-machine interaction system based on AI virtual reality, which belongs to the technical field of virtual driving, and particularly comprises an image acquisition module, wherein a whole body image of a student is acquired in real time through a camera device; the image processing module is used for carrying out gesture recognition on the acquired image, converting the hand region position information into virtual position information and generating a hand interaction signal; the data acquisition module is used for acquiring operation data of a student through the driving sensing device; the human-computer interaction module is used for generating a vehicle driving vision image in real time in VR glasses worn by a student according to the operation feedback signal and the interaction signal; the AI correction module is used for judging whether the current operation of the student has nonstandard operation according to the actual operation data of the student, and if the current operation of the student has nonstandard behavior, the standard reminding is carried out on the student.

title_en: Water quality multi-node on-line monitoring and regulating system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a monitoring control system for measuring and adjusting shrimp pond water quality by deploying a plurality of test nodes, which comprises a single shrimp pond central controller, a smart shrimp pond, a cloud control service platform and an automatic control equipment box, wherein the intelligent shrimp pond is connected with the monitoring control system; the intelligent shrimp pond can adjust the number of the water quality monitoring nodes according to actual needs so as to adapt to shrimp ponds with different sizes and shapes. The content of the collected data of each water quality monitoring node comprises the water temperature, the pH value of the solution, the content of dissolved oxygen and the content of free ammonia nitrogen in the water. In the aspect of water quality regulation, the deployment aerator is mainly used, the control of the precise feeder is assisted, the bottom-modifying agent and the feed are thrown according to the needs, the manager can remotely know the water quality condition of the shrimp pond through the mobile equipment, the feeding is remotely controlled, and an alarm can be sent to call manual treatment under the condition of serious water quality fluctuation.

title_en: Sign-in processing method, sign-in processing device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure provides a check-in processing method, a check-in processing device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: displaying a check-in management window, and responding to a trigger operation for an entry of a check-in page to be confirmed in the check-in management window, and displaying the check-in page to be confirmed in the check-in management window; displaying the check-in data to be confirmed of the object in the check-in page to be confirmed; responding to a confirmation operation of the to-be-confirmed sign-in data of the object, and displaying a sign-in confirmation page of the object; the check-in confirmation page displays check-in reference information of the object and check-in confirmation information of the object; determining that the object check-in is complete in response to a confirmation operation for the check-in reference information and the check-in confirmation information. According to the embodiment, the check-in data is exported to the computer without manual work, and then is confirmed, so that the confirmation efficiency of the check-in data is improved.

title_en: Navigation surgery mechanical arm vision servo pose prediction PD control method based on LSTM
abstract_en: The application provides a navigation surgery mechanical arm visual servo pose prediction PD control method, device and equipment based on LSTM and a computer readable storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: establishing a navigation model; collecting focus target zone rotation translation data offline; inputting focus target area data into LSTM for model training to obtain a prediction model; inputting the data of the on-line focus target area into a prediction model to generate a prediction result at the next moment; inputting a predicted result of the next moment into a navigation model to generate a target pose of the mechanical arm at the next moment; the current target pose of the mechanical arm and the next target pose of the mechanical arm are input into the PD controller together, and the control quantity of the tail end pose of the mechanical arm is output; and controlling the mechanical arm to move along with the target area based on the pose control quantity of the tail end of the mechanical arm. According to the embodiment of the application, the response speed of dynamic following of the mechanical arm can be improved, the following time delay and errors are reduced, and the accuracy and stability of the puncture task are effectively improved.

title_en: Remote control system suitable for multimedia equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote control system suitable for multimedia equipment, which comprises a butt joint assembly, a control processing assembly and an adjusting assembly, wherein a first hinge bracket is uniformly arranged at the inner bottom end of a threaded connection table, and a first spring is arranged at the top of the first hinge bracket; when communication abnormality is detected, the temporary storage module is used for closing data transmission and carrying out auxiliary reception, so that information data loss and damage caused by communication abnormality of a transmission channel are avoided, and the working stability of the system is ensured; the position of the heat radiation structure is automatically adjusted by the adjusting component, so that the heat radiation performance of the system is improved, the system is prevented from being damaged due to high temperature, and the service life of the equipment is prolonged.

title_en: Digital twinning-based road intelligent guardrail decision-making method
abstract_en: The invention provides a digital twinning-based road intelligent guardrail decision method which comprises the steps of S1, acquiring historical static data and historical dynamic data of an intelligent guardrail, adding the historical static data and the historical dynamic data into a pre-constructed intelligent guardrail digital twinning model, S2, collecting vehicle data left when vehicles on two sides of the intelligent guardrail pass through the intelligent guardrail in real time, dividing the vehicle data into real-time static data and real-time dynamic data, and then updating the intelligent guardrail digital twinning model in real time, S3, calibrating a direction of the intelligent guardrail to be the d side, acquiring road condition information of the d side of the intelligent guardrail in real time, and inputting the road condition information into the intelligent guardrail digital twinning model to obtain movement adjustment probability of the intelligent guardrail to the d side so as to assist an operator in adjusting the position of the intelligent guardrail. The intelligent guardrail position adjustment method has the advantages that the movement adjustment probability can be obtained according to the road condition information analysis to carry out decision support, and the reliability of intelligent guardrail position adjustment is guaranteed.

title_en: Response signal processing method and device of airborne collision avoidance system
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of communication control, and relates to a response signal processing method and device of an onboard collision avoidance system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a response signal of a target aircraft; inputting the response signal to a preset power divider to obtain a first response signal and a second response signal; in a first signal channel, inputting a first response signal to an analog-to-digital converter through a signal amplifier to obtain a first digital signal; in the second signal channel, the second response signal is directly input to the analog-to-digital converter to obtain a second digital signal; demodulating the first digital signal and the second digital signal; and obtaining a target demodulation signal from the first demodulation signal and the second demodulation signal according to the response signal receiving range and the response signal demodulation range of the first signal channel and the response signal receiving range and the response signal demodulation range of the second signal channel. The method solves the problem that the signal processing mode of the traditional receiver cannot be well applied to an on-board collision avoidance system.

title_en: Wafer needle measurement and control method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a wafer needle control method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, which relate to the technical field of wafer testing, and the wafer needle control method comprises the following steps: when the test needle plate is detected to move to a preset buffer point, controlling the real-time moving speed of the test needle plate to be reduced to a first moving speed, wherein the preset buffer point is arranged between the initial position of the test needle plate and the wafer needle insertion point; based on the first moving speed, the test needle plate is controlled to move from a preset buffer point to a wafer needle insertion point. Through setting up the preset buffer point in the route that test faller moved to the wafer point of inserting needle for the test faller is before moving to the preset buffer point, and automatic speed reduction is to comparatively slow first speed of moving, moves to the wafer point of inserting needle slowly with first speed of moving again and carries out the needle to the wafer, prevents that the test faller from moving fast too fast and the wafer contact from taking place violently to collide, reduces the contact failure because of the violent collision of wafer contact is stimulated, has also prolonged the life of test faller.

title_en: Assembly type steel-concrete combined hanging box lowering and positioning system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of bridge building construction, in particular to an assembly type steel-concrete combined hanging box lowering and positioning system, which comprises a prefabricated bottom plate and side plates, wherein a plurality of groups of steel protection cylinders are arranged in the prefabricated bottom plate, steel strands are arranged in the guide cylinders, a monitoring module is fixedly connected to the outer side of the guide cylinders, side plates which are mutually combined are arranged above the prefabricated bottom plate, a plurality of groups of damping modules are arranged on the inner walls of the side plates, and a circle of protection plates is arranged on the outer side of the side plates; according to the invention, the circle of protection plate for blocking waves is arranged on the outer side of the side plate, the protection plate plays a certain role of blocking external waves, a stable lowering environment is created relatively to the stable lowering environment, the stable lowering of the hanging box is ensured, when the hanging box is lowered, external seawater quickly floods into the side plate through the bottom, the side plate is easy to shake, the arranged damping module is started, the damping module pumps the seawater between the side plate and the protection plate into the side plate, the seawater inside and outside the side plate can be relatively balanced, and the stable lowering of the side plate is facilitated.

title_en: Fault diagnosis method, device, equipment and storage medium for vehicle thermal management system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of fault diagnosis and discloses a fault diagnosis method, device and equipment for a vehicle thermal management system and a storage medium. According to the invention, when the vehicle is started, the running speed of the vehicle is obtained, the current running state is determined according to the running speed, when the running state meets the diagnosis condition, the thermal management system is controlled to run according to the preset duty ratio, the diagnosis mode is entered, when the diagnosis mode is entered, the current working condition of the vehicle is obtained, the current working condition is input into the whole vehicle thermal management agent model, the water temperature simulation value of the vehicle is obtained, the water temperature simulation value is compared with the actual value obtained by detecting the water temperature through the temperature sensor, the fault type is judged according to the comparison result, compared with the prior art, the defect caused by taking the highest temperature as an evaluation standard can be avoided, meanwhile, the simulation value of the thermal management agent model is taken as a reference to evaluate, the non-experience value, and the fault recognition rate of the cooling system is higher.

title_en: 24-Hour unmanned self-service vending machine based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of vending machines, in particular to a 24-hour unmanned self-service vending machine based on the Internet of things. The technical problems to be solved are as follows: the current self-service vending machine is in flexible package commodity shipment in-process, and its packing is very easily curled, is led to the damage by the spring winding even, makes the inside liquid of packing flow to the goods way on be difficult to the clearance, can't carry out subsequent processing to the flexible package commodity that drops and produce the damage in getting goods swing board department simultaneously. The technical scheme of the invention is as follows: a24-hour unmanned self-service vending machine based on the Internet of things comprises a self-service vending machine, a limiting block and the like; a plurality of limiting blocks for separating commodities are rotatably arranged in the self-service vending machine. According to the invention, the buffer plate is extruded through the stop block, so that the space between the buffer plate and the goods taking swing plate of the self-service vending machine is increased, and the situation that the goods taking swing plate is difficult to open due to the fact that the goods is clamped at the rear side of the goods taking swing plate when a customer takes the goods is prevented.

title_en: Method and system for diagnosing and optimizing energy efficiency of steel production process based on Yong analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for diagnosing and optimizing energy efficiency of a steel production process based on Yong analysis. The energy efficiency diagnosis and optimization method of the invention comprises the following steps: calculating Yong values of all energy flows in the steel production system; constructing an energy input/output matrix of the steel production system and a basic information element matrix of equipment; calculating Yong efficiency of each subsystem and Yong efficiency of the steel production system; according to Yong balance method, Yong loss calculation is carried out for specific procedure links; diagnosing energy efficiency of a steel production system and analyzing energy conservation and emission reduction potential; and determining an objective function and constraint conditions by taking Yong maximum efficiency as a target to obtain the optimal parameter configuration of the energy system. The invention overcomes the defects of the prior energy efficiency diagnosis method, improves the accuracy of energy efficiency diagnosis, reduces the misdiagnosis rate, and comprehensively enables the device to process complex production environment and changeable process conditions.

title_en: Intelligent control method and system for greenhouse air conditioner based on climate acquisition
abstract_en: A greenhouse air conditioner intelligent control method based on climate acquisition comprises the following steps: step S1: the cloud platform respectively acquires meteorological data and planting data in a specified time period; step S2: the cloud platform acquires the change trend of the greenhouse in the time period through the meteorological data and the planting data, adjusts the rotating speeds of the heat pump air conditioner and the ventilation fan according to the change trend, and generates corresponding control instructions; step S3: the cloud platform sends a control instruction to an intelligent gateway in the greenhouse through a network, and the intelligent gateway analyzes the control instruction and regulates and controls the heat pump air conditioner and the ventilation fan. It is clear from this trend whether the temperature and humidity in the time period meet the planting criteria or not, and then the amount of adjustment is calculated from the difference between the trend and the criteria. Realizing the self-regulation of the temperature and the humidity in the greenhouse. Reduces the participation of manpower.

title_en: Vehicle control method and device, vehicle and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a vehicle control method, a device, a vehicle and a readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining a cooperative vehicle establishing a cooperative relationship with the target vehicle and a game vehicle not establishing the cooperative relationship with the target vehicle; determining a target path corresponding to the target vehicle according to the decision parameters corresponding to the target vehicle, the decision parameters corresponding to the cooperative vehicle and the decision parameters corresponding to the game vehicle; and controlling the target vehicle to run according to the target path. According to the method provided by the application, the generated target path has higher accuracy, and the potential safety hazard when the target vehicle is controlled to run according to the target path is reduced.

title_en: Frequency reference source circuit and electronic device
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure provide a frequency reference source circuit and an electronic device. The frequency reference source circuit comprises a front-end circuit and a back-end circuit, wherein the front-end circuit comprises a current generating circuit, a resistor branch and a capacitor branch. The current generating circuit is configured to output a positive temperature coefficient current and a negative temperature coefficient current, and the resistor branch and the capacitor branch are configured to output a first voltage signal and a second voltage signal based on the positive temperature coefficient current and the negative temperature coefficient current, respectively; the back-end circuit is coupled to the front-end circuit and configured to modulate the first voltage signal and the second voltage signal to obtain a reference frequency output signal. The frequency reference source circuit can realize second-order temperature compensation of a reference frequency output signal.

title_en: Geological disaster early warning system based on hydraulic loop investigation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster early warning systems, in particular to a geological disaster early warning system based on hydraulic loop investigation, which comprises a mounting box frame and an operation window, wherein the inner side of one end of the mounting box frame is provided with the operation window, one side of the operation window is fixedly connected with an adjusting component, the upper end of the adjusting component is provided with an auxiliary mounting component, the upper end of the adjusting component is provided with a limiting component, the lower end of the adjusting component is provided with a monitor body, the lower end of the auxiliary mounting component is provided with a belt rotating component, and the lower end of the monitor body is provided with a built-in rotating component.

title_en: AStar path planning method and equipment based on reference track optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses an AStar path planning method and equipment based on reference track optimization, wherein the AStar path planning method based on the reference track optimization enables a path planned by AStar to be attached to an original reference track as much as possible by selecting a starting point S and a target point G and adding reference track information into heuristic information; therefore, the unmanned collecting card can well run according to the reference track, and the function of the original reference track is fully exerted.

title_en: Planning method and device for electronic fence, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a planning method and device for an electronic fence, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring first bicycle data in a target area, and determining data distribution characteristics corresponding to the first bicycle data; performing initial clustering on the first bicycle data according to the data distribution characteristics to obtain an initial clustering result, and dividing a target area into a plurality of subareas according to the initial clustering result; acquiring the distribution condition of the second bicycle data included in each subarea, and clustering the second bicycle data to obtain a target clustering result; and determining the target layout position of the electronic fence according to the target clustering result. Based on this, can be through the effectual parking of standardizing of accurate layout position to the image in city has been maintained when making things convenient for the user to park.

title_en: Road condition prediction method, device, equipment, storage medium and product
abstract_en: The application discloses a road condition prediction method, a device, equipment, a storage medium and a product, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a historical actual road condition and a historical predicted road condition corresponding to a historical period; determining an error between the historical actual road condition and the historical predicted road condition; when the error is smaller than a preset value, determining a predicted road condition corresponding to the current period based on the historical actual road condition and an autoregressive integral moving average model; or when the error is larger than the preset value, determining the predicted road condition corresponding to the current period based on the historical actual road condition and a support vector machine prediction model. And the accuracy of the traffic road condition prediction result is improved.

title_en: Intelligent trolley based on single-chip microcomputer control
abstract_en: The patent discloses an intelligent trolley based on single chip microcomputer control. The intelligent trolley of the patent uses the STC89C52 singlechip as a control core, can automatically detect a fire source, automatically position the fire source, automatically avoid obstacles in the situation process, and is an intelligent guided trolley. The fire source signal is detected through the phototransistor sensor, when the fire source is detected, the gesture is automatically adjusted, the form is near the fire source, the fire source is aligned, then the fire extinguishing motor is started to drive the fire extinguishing equipment to extinguish fire, the trolley is controlled to avoid obstacle running through the induction of the infrared photoelectric switch, the trolley is driven by the L298N driving circuit, and the vehicle-mounted display screen displays the current running state and the fire extinguishing state of the trolley to a user. In the test, the prototype well completes the fire extinguishing task, and all functions are basically realized. The intelligent trolley can improve the fire-fighting work efficiency and the work quality, reduce personnel and property loss and has larger application value.

title_en: Hybrid electric vehicle energy management strategy test platform
abstract_en: The invention provides a hybrid electric vehicle energy management strategy test platform, which comprises a driving simulator module, a real-time simulation target machine, a PC host, a networking information simulation module and a vehicle control unit module, wherein the driving simulator module is used for simulating the driving of a vehicle; one end of the real-time simulation target machine is in data connection with the whole vehicle controller module, the other end of the real-time simulation target machine is in synchronous data interaction with the PC host, and the other end of the real-time simulation target machine is in data connection with the networking information simulation module; one end of the network information simulation module is connected with the real-time simulation target machine data and is also connected with the PC host machine data, and the other end of the network information simulation module is also connected with the whole vehicle controller module data; the intelligent traffic system and the energy management hardware of the hybrid electric vehicle are fused in a ring depth, so that the development and verification of the energy management strategy of the hybrid electric vehicle with the cooperation of human-vehicle-road can be simulated under a complex traffic scene, and the development efficiency of the energy management strategy of the intelligent network-connected hybrid electric vehicle is improved.

title_en: Smoke fire alarm sensor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a smoke fire alarm sensor which comprises a shell, wherein a circuit board is arranged on the inner wall of the shell, an optical module is arranged on the outer wall of the circuit board, an annular groove is arranged on the inner wall of the shell, sliding grooves are symmetrically arranged on the outer wall of the annular groove, an annular turntable is arranged on the inner wall of the annular groove, a guide ring is fixedly connected to the outer wall of the annular turntable, a mounting groove is fixedly connected to the bottom of the annular groove, and a driving gear is movably mounted on the inner wall of the mounting groove. According to the invention, the cleaner and the annular turntable are arranged to facilitate the removal of impurities accumulated in the air inlet of the smoke fire alarm sensor, so that the micro fan works to generate wind power, the air is blown to the outside through the exhaust pipe, the output end of the micro motor rotates to drive the cleaner to move, and the cleaner is driven to move when moving, so that impurities adsorbed on the outer wall of the filter screen can be removed, and the filter screen used by the smoke fire alarm sensor is prevented from being blocked.

title_en: Method and system for generating tool path of special-shaped turning tool blade grinding machine
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of machining centers, and discloses a tool path generation method and a system of a special-shaped turning tool blade grinding machine, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s101: creating a blade type, selecting a cutter type to be processed, and generating a corresponding parameter setting interface; s102: setting key parameters of the blade profile based on a parameter setting interface; s103: modifying grinding parameters based on the parameter setting interface; s104: modifying the detection edge parameters based on the parameter setting interface; s105: modifying the measurement parameters based on the parameter setting interface; s106: generating an NC file; s107: the tool path required for machining the blade is generated by software based on the software form series S101-S107. The system corresponds to the method. According to the application, the method of setting the blade parameters and generating the blade track is adopted to set the blade profile parameters, so that a user can still program under the condition of incompletely knowing the track of the processed blade, the problem of high difficulty in blade programming is solved, and the threshold of blade programming is greatly reduced.

title_en: Low-temperature protection device, automatic filling system and working method
abstract_en: The invention provides a low-temperature protection device, an automatic filling system and a working method, wherein the system comprises the following components: a water inlet and a water outlet of the water supplementing tank are respectively provided with a first electric valve and a second electric valve; the first interface of the four-way valve is connected with the water outlet of the water supplementing tank, the second interface is connected with the water inlet end of the water pump, the third interface is connected with the water outlet end of the water pump, and the fourth interface is connected with the filling port through a third electric valve; the temperature sensor is used for monitoring an ambient temperature value; and after the control module responds to the environment temperature value being smaller than a preset temperature threshold value, the first electric valve is controlled to be closed, the second electric valve and the third electric valve are controlled to be opened, the four-way valve is controlled to be switched to a first working position, at the moment, the first interface is communicated with the third interface, the second interface is communicated with the fourth interface, and water in the pipeline is pumped to flow back to the water supplementing tank and is discharged. The invention can carry out low-temperature protection on the water supplementing tank and the pipeline of the automatic filling equipment in a low-temperature environment, and prevent the water supplementing tank and the pipeline from frost cracking so as to prolong the service life of the equipment.

title_en: Auxiliary or automatic vehicle guiding method
abstract_en: The invention relates to an auxiliary or automatic vehicle guidance method for a vehicle (1), wherein the vehicle (1) comprises a control device (2) and at least one sensor for the detection of the surroundings and objects, wherein a track is planned for the vehicle guidance of the vehicle (1) as a function of the detected surroundings and the detected objects, boids (10, 11, 12) are generated for the objects, these Boids being determined as a function of the attraction and repulsion rules and the track being planned as a function of Boids (10, 11, 12), characterized by the following steps: initializing, wherein Boids (10, 11, 12) is converted into a coordinate system; applying attractive and repulsive rules; and simulation is performed according to a determinable motion model.

title_en: Granting conditional vehicle data access to a third party based on geographic information of a relative location between the vehicle and the third party
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to vehicle data access by third party service providers and/or technicians based on trigger actions. The triggering action is triggered when the vehicle position matches the geographic criteria. The geographic criteria indicates a geofenced area. Thus, the third party service provider and/or technician may access the vehicle data when the vehicle location is within a geofenced area associated with the third party service provider and/or technician.

title_en: Four-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle path tracking control method based on nonlinear model prediction
abstract_en: The invention provides a four-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle path tracking control method based on nonlinear model prediction, and belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle automatic control. Comprising the following steps: setting a reference path, wherein the reference path is a desired state quantity set; establishing a four-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle motion mathematical model; acquiring the rotating speeds of 4 propeller motors, and inputting the rotating speeds into the four-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle motion mathematical model to predict the state quantity at the next moment; performing feedback compensation on the predicted state quantity according to the current state quantity of the four-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle to obtain a corrected state quantity; acquiring an expected state quantity corresponding to the next moment in the reference path, substituting the expected state quantity and the correction state quantity into an objective function, and solving a control quantity of the four-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle at the next moment by using the objective function; and the control quantity at the next moment is acted on the quadrotor unmanned aerial vehicle.

title_en: Monitoring heat preservation device and monitoring method
abstract_en: The application provides a monitoring heat preservation device and a monitoring method, comprising a bottom plate, at least two fixing straps, a heat preservation box, an image acquisition unit, a temperature measurement and control unit and a processor; the image acquisition unit is used for acquiring image information of the finger planted in the incubator, and the temperature measurement and control unit is used for acquiring temperature information in the incubator; the processor is used for carrying out color recognition and degree classification on the image information acquired by the image acquisition unit and adjusting the internal temperature of the incubator according to the temperature information acquired by the temperature measurement and control unit; the monitoring and heat-preserving device is used for maintaining constant temperature in the heat-preserving box, is favorable for heat preservation of the re-planting fingers and improves the recuperation condition of the re-planting fingers; the color recognition and degree grading can be carried out on the image information of the re-planted fingers, the continuous monitoring of the re-planted fingers is facilitated, the timely recognition of vascular crisis is ensured, the survival rate of the re-planted fingers is improved, and the workload of medical staff is reduced.

title_en: Control method, device, system and operation platform
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a control method, a control device, a control system and an operation platform, and relates to the technical field of automatic control, wherein the control method comprises the following steps: acquiring the distance between the work platform and the obstacle measured by each sensor in the plurality of sensors; determining whether a control instruction needs to be sent according to the distance to obtain a corresponding determination result, including: determining a region in which the distance falls; under the condition that the distance falls into the warning area, if the distance enters the warning buffer area from the warning area, determining that the operation platform enters a non-warning waiting state from a warning state, and determining that a warning instruction is required to be sent out to limit the movement speed of the operation platform under the warning state and the non-warning waiting state; after the operation platform enters the non-warning waiting state from the warning state, if the distance is larger than a first numerical value after a first preset time, determining that the operation platform enters the non-warning state; and controlling the movement speed of the working platform according to the determined results corresponding to the distances of the plurality of sensors.

title_en: Article taking and placing mechanism and article storage cabinet
abstract_en: The invention discloses an article taking and placing mechanism and an article storage cabinet, which are used for storing and taking articles, wherein the article taking and placing mechanism comprises a frame body, an article storage box, a pushing piece and a locking piece, the frame body is provided with a taking and placing opening, the pushing piece is movably arranged on the frame body, the pushing piece is used for pushing the storage box to the taking and placing opening, the locking piece is arranged on the frame body, and the locking piece is used for locking the storage box pushed to the taking and placing opening. The technical scheme of the invention solves the problem that the storage box is not fixed when the storage box is arranged in the picking and placing mechanism for a user to operate in the conventional article storage cabinet.

title_en: Motion detection
abstract_en: The motion detector is capable of sampling a signal from an infrared detector over a time interval, determining that an average power of a sample from the infrared detector exceeds a threshold over the time interval, and sending a warning that a motion has been detected in response to the average power of the sample exceeding the power threshold.

title_en: Machine vision wireless warning universal ECMO pipeline bubble detection equipment and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a machine vision wireless alarming universal ECMO pipeline bubble detection device and a machine vision wireless alarming universal ECMO pipeline bubble detection method, wherein the machine vision wireless alarming universal ECMO pipeline bubble detection device comprises a wireless WIFI transmission module, a micro-controller, a camera module, an annular light source, a background bottom plate, a target detection pipeline, a bracket, a touch control support data panel and a power supply; the camera module, the touch control support data panel, the wireless WIFI transmission module and the power supply are all connected to the micro-controller, the support is respectively connected with the micro-controller, the annular light source and the background bottom plate, the power supply is arranged at the top of the micro-controller, the target detection pipeline is arranged above the background bottom plate, the wireless WIFI transmission module is arranged right above the touch control support data panel, the camera module is arranged below the touch control support data panel, and the annular light source is arranged right below the camera module; solves the problems of low universality and low intelligent degree in the prior art.

title_en: Method and system for testing reliability of alarm system
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a system for testing the reliability of an alarm system, wherein the testing method comprises the following steps: inputting initial data to be identified into an adapter, and obtaining target data to be identified, wherein the target data to be identified is obtained after the data type identifier is added to the initial data to be identified by the adapter; inputting target data to be identified into an alarm system to be tested, and acquiring alarm output information determined after the alarm system to be tested analyzes and processes the target data to be identified; inputting the alarm output information into an interpreter, and determining an alarm mode and a storage position corresponding to the alarm output information; determining the working state of the corresponding equipment according to the alarm mode, and storing alarm output information to the determined storage position; and testing and evaluating the alarm output information at the target position to determine the reliability of the alarm system to be tested. Therefore, by introducing the adapter and the interpreter, the system test is not dependent on the traditional manual operation, the operation difficulty of the system test is reduced, the resource investment and the manual operation error of the test are reduced, and the result accuracy can be effectively improved.

title_en: Campus security monitoring management system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a campus security monitoring management system and a method thereof, comprising a control center, wherein the control center is used for controlling and managing the campus security monitoring management system; the control center is sequentially connected with a monitoring camera module, an image processing module, an infrared sensing module and an alarm module in a signal way, the monitoring camera module is sequentially connected with a fence distribution monitoring unit, a school distribution monitoring unit, a face image acquisition unit and a track tracking unit in a signal way, and the image processing module is sequentially connected with an image comparison and identification unit and a school face image database in a signal way; the invention carries out campus real-time security reinforcement work through the monitoring camera module, the image processing module, the infrared sensing module, the alarm module abnormal information sending module and the emergency alarm module which are connected with the control center through signals, thereby effectively preventing the school personnel from turning over the wall to enter the school, preventing the students from turning over the wall to break away from the school, and improving the surrounding safety of the campus.

title_en: Intelligent conference centralized control method and system based on information enhancement
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data transmission, in particular to an intelligent centralized conference control method and system based on information enhancement, comprising the following steps: determining a classification transmission necessary index according to fluctuation difference between each state monitoring signal and the power grid state monitoring signal and response difference between the state monitoring signal and the comparison signal, and determining an aperiodic eigenvalue and an importance degree according to each component signal corresponding to each state monitoring signal; determining a transmission priority index of each data point in each state monitoring signal by combining the classified transmission necessary index, the aperiodic eigenvalue and the importance degree, and further determining an optimal sampling rate; and carrying out state monitoring data transmission according to the optimal sampling rate, and controlling each device in the conference room in a centralized manner according to the transmission result. According to the invention, the accuracy and the efficiency of state monitoring data transmission are improved by determining the optimal sampling rate, and the intelligent centralized control of the conference based on information enhancement is facilitated.

title_en: Air jet loom data monitoring method, product, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of data monitoring, in particular to a data monitoring method, a product, equipment and a medium of an air jet loom. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring monitoring data and operation data of a target loom, wherein the target loom is any air jet loom working; according to the operation data, determining the current operation period of the target loom, and determining the normal data range corresponding to the current operation period; determining abnormal data from the monitoring data of the target loom according to the normal data range corresponding to the current operation period; and determining the abnormality degree of the target loom according to the abnormality data and the operation data so as to determine the maintenance strategy according to the abnormality degree. According to the application, the maintenance strategy can be accurately determined according to the monitoring data and the operation data, so that the operation efficiency and the stability of the loom are improved.

title_en: Automatic control method and system for lithium carbonate production
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing. In particular to an automatic control method and system for lithium carbonate production. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring the temperature in the hydrogenation reactor, thereby acquiring a temperature data sequence; determining the most preferable extension length of the temperature data sequence, and marking the most preferable extension length as the optimal extension length; decomposing the temperature data sequence by adopting an empirical mode decomposition method so as to obtain an IMF component; denoising each IMF component, and reconstructing the denoised IMF component to obtain a denoised temperature data sequence; acquiring temperature data closest to the current moment from the denoised temperature data sequence, and recording the temperature data as the current temperature; and PID control is carried out on the temperature in the hydrogenation reactor according to the difference value between the current temperature and the target temperature. The method can greatly improve the accuracy and efficiency of temperature control in the hydrogenation reactor in the production process of preparing lithium carbonate.

title_en: Measurement and control system, synchronization method thereof and computing device
abstract_en: A measurement and control system, a synchronization method thereof and a computing device are provided. The measurement and control system comprises a main control module and a plurality of measurement and control channels comprising a driving module and a switch; the main control module is used for providing a trigger signal for the driving module of each path of measurement and control channel; the driving module of each channel of measurement and control is used for responding to the trigger signal received by the driving module to generate a driving waveform signal, a marking waveform signal and a feedback waveform signal, and is used for outputting the generated driving waveform signal and marking waveform signal to the corresponding switch, and the driving waveform signal reaches the output end of the switch through an effective signal formed after the switching of the driving waveform signal is responded to the marking waveform signal, so that the driving waveform signal is provided to a driven device; the main control module is also used for receiving the delayed feedback waveform signals of each channel of measurement and control channels and controlling and adjusting the channel response time length of each channel of measurement and control channels to be equal according to the delayed feedback waveform signals and the trigger signals. The invention can realize high-precision synchronization of the level within 1 nanosecond.

title_en: Multi-mode operation of fire alarm devices
abstract_en: Multi-mode operation of a fire alerting device is described herein. An apparatus includes a self-test component, an alarm component, and a power source configured to operate in a first mode to provide power to the self-test component and in a second mode to provide power to the alarm component.

title_en: Parking lot navigation method and device based on Internet of things of vehicles, vehicles and medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of vehicles, in particular to a parking lot navigation method, a device, a vehicle and a medium based on the Internet of things of vehicles, wherein the method comprises the steps of identifying a wireless access point at the entrance of a parking lot where the vehicle is located; the method comprises the steps of establishing a transmission channel between a vehicle machine and a vehicle networking server based on a wireless access point, acquiring data information of a parking lot issued by the vehicle networking server, wherein the data information comprises map data of the parking lot and a vacant parking space, identifying actual parking intention of a user, planning a parking path according to the actual parking intention and the data information of the parking lot, and controlling a vehicle to execute parking action according to the parking path. Therefore, the problems that in the related art, the parking lot network is limited, so that quick positioning of vehicles cannot be realized, the speed of seeking a parking space is influenced, the user experience is poor and the like are solved.

title_en: DEVS and GOAP-based autonomous unmanned platform modeling method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an autonomous unmanned platform modeling method and system based on DEVS and GOAP, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the autonomous unmanned platform system is modularly decomposed into a plurality of functional component subsystems, and all functional components work cooperatively to form all behavior capacities of the autonomous unmanned platform; combining a target-based behavior planning mechanism with the DEVS atomic model for building a model of the functional component subsystem, such that the behavior of the functional component model is adjusted from the main plan based on the target, the self state, and the environmental state; all atomic models are coupled according to the cooperative relationship among the functional component subsystems based on DEVS coupling models, namely, the input and output ports are connected for data interaction, so that an autonomous unmanned platform system model is formed. The invention has the advantages of flexible configuration, high reusability, easy expansion, clear autonomous behavior logic and the like, and the model has better interpretability, thereby being applicable to subsequent unmanned platform system simulation and evaluation work.

title_en: Novel unmanned aerial vehicle intelligent inspection path planning method based on artificial potential energy field
