abstract_en: The invention provides a novel intelligent unmanned aerial vehicle routing inspection path planning method based on an artificial potential energy field, which comprises the following steps: s1, setting Beidou navigation positions of points to be inspected of a power transmission line; s2, calculating a virtual attraction field applied to the unmanned aerial vehicle by a point to be inspected of the power transmission line; s3, calculating a virtual repulsive force field applied by the obstacle to the unmanned aerial vehicle; s4, calculating a virtual rotating force field of the unmanned aerial vehicle at a local minimum value in the artificial potential energy field; s5, obtaining the sum of the virtual force fields to obtain reference acceleration, and setting a speed track point by using the reference acceleration; s6, transmitting control signals to the bottom telex servo controller force of the unmanned aerial vehicle through the position controller and the gesture controller of the unmanned aerial vehicle flight control system, finally forming the unmanned aerial vehicle autonomous intelligent patrol path planning system, enabling the unmanned aerial vehicle to fly according to the established route of the artificial potential energy field, reaching a destination and avoiding the obstacle autonomously.

title_en: Writing board learning machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a learning machine, which comprises a 60-degree base support, a learning machine bottom plate, a rotating spool, a stepping motor, a steering engine, a large force Ma Xian, A3 paper, a neutral pen, a communication module and a 45-degree pen lifting structure, wherein the learning machine bottom plate is placed on the 60-degree base support, the stepping motor is fixed at two sides above the bottom plate, the rotating spool is fixed with the stepping motor, the large horsepower line is connected with the pen lifting structure after being wound around the rotating spool for a plurality of circles, the A3 paper is fixed at 1/3 position below the bottom plate, the steering engine is arranged at the 45-degree pen lifting structure, the neutral pen is fixed by the 45-degree pen lifting structure, and the stepping motor, the steering engine and the communication module are connected; the software comprises a user end, a background management and a webpage end. The invention provides a learning machine, which solves the problems of low learning efficiency, unclear thought and reduced eyesight of the existing learning machine.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted intelligent driving data acquisition device using 5G version V2X high-order TBOX
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of vehicle-mounted equipment, and discloses a vehicle-mounted intelligent driving data acquisition device using 5G V2X high-order TBOX, which comprises a driving data acquisition device, wherein a base shell is arranged at the bottom side of the driving data acquisition device, a debugging plate is slidably arranged at the bottom of the base shell, a plurality of slots are formed in the bottom of the debugging plate, a plurality of mounting screws are movably arranged in the base shell adjacent to the slots, the mounting screws penetrate through the base shell and are inserted into the slots of the debugging plate, the mounting screws comprise screws, the top of each screw is provided with a gear part, the bottom of each screw is integrally connected with a fixed point part for pre-positioning, an operation disc for uniformly controlling the mounting screws is rotatably arranged in the base shell, an operation port is formed in the side part of the base shell, one part of the operation disc is exposed to the outside through the operation port, and the operation disc is in transmission fit with the mounting screws.

title_en: Heuristic intelligent triaxial coordinate displacement monitoring device and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heuristic intelligent triaxial coordinate displacement monitoring device and a heuristic intelligent triaxial coordinate displacement monitoring method, when a distributed point location structure is adopted, collected samples are not subjected to single-point comparison any more, a comparison of a current measuring point network and a historical measuring point network is formed, integral area analysis is realized on displacement of a measuring point, a plurality of checking points can be arranged adjacently to the same measuring point, more reference samples are obtained through encryption of the number of the detecting network points, and a weighted value is obtained, so that the collection precision is improved, heuristic frequency is diffused, a user can focus on unhealthy points and extend to an adjacent area, when shrinkage of unhealthy point areas is reduced, the monitoring frequency can be restored to conventional monitoring typical frequency, displacement change of the measuring point can be monitored in real time, real-time early warning can be achieved, and the heuristic intelligent triaxial coordinate displacement monitoring device and the heuristic intelligent triaxial coordinate displacement monitoring method are convenient to arrange.

title_en: Airship attitude anti-interference control method aiming at inertia uncertainty and centroid offset
abstract_en: The invention discloses an airship attitude anti-interference control method aiming at inertia uncertainty and centroid deviation. The method comprises the steps of firstly establishing a nonlinear attitude dynamics model of the airship through a Newton Euler equation, then designing a reference attitude controller, asymptotically tracking the expected attitude of the airship when inertia parameters and centroid offset parameters are known, finally expanding the reference controller into a self-adaptive controller, and ensuring asymptotic convergence of an attitude tracking error under parameter uncertainty by estimating unknown inertia and centroid offset parameters in the airship model. The invention realizes the high-precision tracking control of the airship attitude under the unknown inertia and centroid offset, and can be used for flight tasks such as stratospheric airship residence, cruising, taking off and landing and the like.

title_en: Unmanned survey vessel
abstract_en: The invention relates to an unmanned survey ship, which comprises a ship body, an unmanned ship terminal carried on the ship body, and a shore-based control terminal arranged remotely relative to the ship body, wherein the unmanned ship terminal is in communication connection with the shore-based control terminal; the shore-based control terminal is used for setting a target waypoint and sending the target waypoint to the unmanned ship terminal; the unmanned ship terminal is used for entering a route mode after receiving a target waypoint, controlling the ship body to navigate at a preset navigational speed according to a planned route of the target waypoint in the route mode, acquiring ship body state information, ship body surrounding environment information and measured water body data in the navigation process of the ship body, and sending the ship body state information, the ship body surrounding environment information and the water body data to the shore-based control terminal. The invention can automatically carry out measurement operation according to the set route, automatically complete measurement with high efficiency and high quality, and transmit back image and mapping data in real time, thereby effectively reducing the cost of fuel oil and personnel in traditional measurement.

title_en: Intelligent control algorithm design method for unmanned ground vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent control algorithm design method of an unmanned ground vehicle, which comprises the following steps: constructing a network control system NCSs and an event triggering mechanism based on integration; traffic compression is performed under a limited channel bandwidth; optimizing a trigger threshold based on machine learning; estimating the performance error of the NCSs; the present invention presents a new approach to solving NCSs security and reliability challenges in the face of DoS attacks.

title_en: Underwater vehicle collision prevention method based on target position potential function
abstract_en: The invention provides an underwater vehicle collision avoidance method based on a target position potential function, which comprises the following steps: establishing a mathematical model of the underwater vehicle; defining a potential function based on the established mathematical model of the underwater vehicle; selecting a controller according to a mathematical model of the underwater vehicle; and by combining with the Lyapunov stability theory, the defined potential function is improved, and the improved potential function is used in a selected controller to realize collision avoidance of the underwater vehicle. The invention provides a potential function based on a target position for solving the problem of energy waste of an underwater vehicle in the collision prevention process, so as to reduce energy consumption of the underwater vehicle when approaching the target position. The potential function is improved with respect to the negative gradient of the potential function in the controller, so that the underwater vehicle is prevented from oscillating near the target position due to the overlarge negative gradient of the potential function, and unnecessary energy consumption is reduced to the greatest extent while the navigation safety is ensured.

title_en: Road condition marking method and device, vehicle-mounted terminal and server
abstract_en: The application provides a road condition marking method, a road condition marking device, a vehicle-mounted terminal and a server, and relates to the technical field of automatic driving. Comprising the following steps: when the fact that the vehicle body control data of the vehicle in the non-congestion road section in the preset time period meets the preset condition is detected, acquiring a vehicle surrounding environment image; determining the complex road condition reason of the current running road of the vehicle based on the surrounding environment image of the vehicle; and marking the road condition complex reasons on the corresponding road sections of the electronic map. In this embodiment, the vehicle body control data of the vehicle is detected, the vehicle surrounding environment image is triggered and collected, further, the vehicle is determined to enter into a complex road condition, the reason of the complex road condition is determined according to the vehicle surrounding environment image, the electronic map is marked, the vehicle which is about to enter into the marked road section is prompted to perform defensive driving, and the driving experience and safety of the vehicle are improved.

title_en: Autism children digital teaching scene construction system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital teaching scene construction system for autism children, and belongs to the field of rehabilitation training equipment. The system comprises: the teaching scene construction module is used for constructing a teaching training scene and comprises a dot line training unit, a combined graph unit and a three-dimensional graph unit, and is respectively used for constructing the dot line training scene, the combined graph training scene and the three-dimensional graph training scene; the rehabilitation training module is used for training students based on teaching training scenes and generating training data; the data storage module is used for recording training data of students; and the teaching scene updating module is used for adjusting the teaching scene of the student according to the training data of the student and updating the teaching scheme aiming at the student. The invention creates a digital teaching scene integrating the mental behavior theory and practice of the autism children, promotes the deep fusion of the digital education and the special children education, and enables the on-line education and the off-line education to mutually enable the on-line education and the off-line education, so as to meet the long-term rehabilitation demands of the autism children with different characteristics.

title_en: Field navigation method of phenotype robot based on ground-air coordination
abstract_en: The invention discloses a field navigation method of a phenotype robot based on ground-air synergy, which comprises the steps of constructing a digital orthophoto DOM (DOM) for a target crop area through an unmanned aerial vehicle equipped with a real-time motion compensation RTK (real-time kinematic) technology and a camera module, acquiring a crop line main body semantic segmentation map through a semantic segmentation model by combining an artificial intelligence technology, preprocessing an image through an image processing method, acquiring key points through a Skeletonize algorithm, a Douglas-Peucker algorithm, a Shi-Tomasi method and a linear extrapolation mode, grouping and sequencing the key points according to a proper strategy, then leading the key points into a navigation system, generating a coherent navigation path, and tracking the path by utilizing a pure tracking algorithm controller to finish a navigation task. The invention is used for automatic acquisition of the crop phenotype in the field and continuous monitoring of the growth process, more finely covers the whole operation area, improves the control visualization level and is beneficial to improving the accuracy and efficiency of the crop phenotype data acquisition.

title_en: Superconducting liquid level acquisition method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a superconducting liquid level acquisition method, which belongs to the field of signal integrated circuits, wherein a superconducting liquid level acquisition device is connected to a superconducting sensor placed in liquid helium and used for acquiring current flowing into the superconducting sensor and voltages at two ends of the superconducting sensor after the current is flowing into the superconducting sensor, the current of the superconducting sensor and the voltages at two ends of the superconducting sensor are substituted into a formula to calculate a liquid level value, and the superconducting liquid level acquisition system is also provided, the actual value of a current source is measured and substituted into the formula to calculate the liquid level height, so that the influence of the change of the current source on the measurement system is eliminated, and the accurate liquid level can be calculated.

title_en: Intersection and road traffic safety evaluation method based on extension cloud model
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intersection and road traffic safety evaluation method based on an extension cloud model, which comprises the following steps of Step1, step2, calculating cloud parameters of the cloud model, step3, calculating an incidence matrix of the cloud model, step4, calculating basic probability distribution of each evaluation index, and Step5, calculating a judgment vector matrix, and determining an evaluation result. The invention adopts the extension material element method to evaluate traffic safety and uses the cloud model to describe the object characteristics in the extension theory. The invention can realize the purpose of timely grasping the traffic safety state of urban intersections and road sections, and has great significance for road safety management and decision in the current stage of China.

title_en: Method for sharing vehicle external loudspeaker by vehicle cross-domain, vehicle, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a method, a vehicle, equipment and a medium for cross-domain sharing of an external speaker of a vehicle, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting actual speed and state information of the current vehicle to generate chassis domain whistling sound source signals and/or at least one cabin domain interaction sound source signal, wherein the at least one cabin domain interaction sound source signal comprises at least one of a low-speed pedestrian warning system sound source signal, an external media interaction sound source signal and an internal sound source signal, and based on the chassis domain whistling sound source signal and/or the at least one cabin domain interaction sound source signal, and combining a preset sound source management strategy, so that the external speaker of the target vehicle replaces an external snail horn to execute corresponding sound source playing operation of the chassis domain and/or the cabin domain. According to the application, the low-speed pedestrian warning function, the interaction function and the external loudspeaker function are integrated to share the external loudspeaker for sounding, so that redundant parts of the vehicle are effectively reduced, the cost of the whole vehicle is reduced, and the use experience of a user is improved.

title_en: Geographic information system
abstract_en: A geographic information system is provided that can be applied to a wide variety of uses or user needs. A geographic information system (1) is provided with: a database (11); a content registration unit (13) that registers the geographical content uploaded by the user in a database; and a content display unit (19) that provides the user terminal with a geographic information screen on which the registered geographic content is displayed. The geographic content that can be registered includes a single image, an orthographic image, a moving image, three-dimensional model data, analysis result data of these, and the like. The superimposed display and the divided display can be selected in the geographical information screen. In the case of superimposed display, the display arrangement of the contents is a map, an orthographic image, and icons of other contents in this order from the rear to the front. In the divided display, a plurality of contents can be comparatively viewed. When a moving image is reproduced, a camera position mark is displayed at a position on a map corresponding to a reproduction time point.

title_en: Automatic test system of vehicle body integrated control module
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic test system for an integrated control module of a vehicle body, which comprises the following components: control module, analog input module, output measurement module and communication module, wherein: the control module is used for controlling the relay matrix board card, connection establishment of the product, an analog input module, an output measurement module and a communication module is carried out, and automatic test is carried out on a vehicle body control module; the analog input module is used for inputting the resistance, voltage and PWM signals of the product by controlling the programmable power supply, the programmable resistance input board card and the analog input/output board card; the output measurement module is used for automatically measuring the voltage output and the quiescent current of the product by controlling the digital multimeter; the communication module is used for automatically testing various communication protocols of the product and feeding back information inside the product through the communication box and the vehicle body integrated control slave module. The invention solves the problem of providing different test inputs of each type for a large number of pins by adopting the relay matrix board NI-2524.

title_en: Automatic vending machine and processing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a processing method of an automatic vending machine and the automatic vending machine, wherein the processing method comprises the following steps: the vending machine comprises a machine body, wherein a processing chamber, a refrigerating chamber and a conveying assembly are arranged in the machine body; the processing method comprises the following steps: when the vending machine acquires a ordering instruction, controlling the transport assembly to transport the target cutlery box arranged in the refrigerating chamber into the processing chamber; when the identity information in the target cutlery box is matched with the liquid adding condition, controlling a liquid adding component in the processing chamber to execute liquid adding action on the target cutlery box arranged in the processing chamber; and controlling the electromagnetic heating component and/or the steam heating component in the processing cavity to perform heating action on the target cutlery box. The technical problem solved by the invention is that the traditional vending machine lacks a temporary storage and heat preservation function, and is characterized in that the vending machine is directly sent to the placing table after heating is finished, and if a consumer is not portable and is convenient in the first time, the man-machine interaction efficiency between the consumer and the vending machine is reduced.

title_en: Forest fire remote sensing alarm device
abstract_en: The invention provides a forest fire remote sensing alarm device, which relates to the technical field of fire alarm and comprises: a housing; the front end of the shell is buckled and provided with a cover plate, two groups of square through grooves are formed in the cover plate, square frames are fixed at the rear ends of the two groups of square through grooves, and fixing plates are fixed on the square frames; according to the invention, the heat in the shell is discharged outwards by operating the exhaust fan, the surface area of the cylindrical structure on the housing is increased by the spiral rib plate, and the cooling liquid is fully contacted with the spiral rib plate in the flowing process, so that the heat exchange area is greatly increased, the heat dissipation efficiency is improved, the adhesive roller is contacted with the side plate by extending the first hydraulic rod, the adhesive roller is moved up and down by operating the second motor, dust at the ventilation groove on the side plate is cleaned by the adhesive roller, when the adhesive roller is cleaned, the first motor is operated to open the opening and closing plate, the adhesive roller is pulled out by pulling the handle to the front side, and the adhesive roller can be taken down for cleaning or replacing, so that the operation is convenient.

title_en: Method for identifying abnormal movement of servomotor of water turbine governor
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water turbine monitoring, in particular to a method for identifying motion abnormality of a servomotor of a water turbine speed regulator, which comprises the following steps: and collecting state data of the servomotor. Calculating the stress degree of the servomotor according to the state data of the servomotor, wherein the stress degree refers to the external acting force born by the servomotor; and when the stress degree of the servomotor is greater than a first set threshold, carrying out abnormal alarm. The invention can monitor the actual movement speed of the servomotor, the internal leakage coefficient of the servomotor and the external acting force acting on the servomotor in real time, and can give an alarm in time when any one of the actual movement speed of the servomotor, the internal leakage coefficient of the servomotor or the external acting force acting on the servomotor has abnormal conditions.

title_en: Robot track modeling method and device based on Fourier controller network
abstract_en: The invention provides a robot track modeling method and a robot track modeling device based on a Fourier controller network, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an input vector, wherein the input vector comprises the state and rewards of the robot fed back by the environment in the current time step and the action of the robot in the last time step; based on a pre-trained Fourier controller network, predicting and obtaining the corresponding action of the robot in the current time step according to the input vector so as to obtain the robot track in a set period; the Fourier controller network comprises a causal spectrum convolution block, wherein the causal spectrum convolution block is used for extracting features in a frequency domain of a robot state sequence by adopting short-time Fourier transformation and linear transformation. According to the method, the causal spectrum convolution block is introduced into the Fourier controller network, so that the robot track is modeled in the frequency domain instead of the time domain, a powerful model prediction effect can be achieved by using limited robot data efficiently, low reasoning delay can be achieved, and quick and efficient reasoning of the robot track is achieved.

title_en: Automatic testing method for NB-IoT water meter main board
abstract_en: The application discloses an automatic testing method for an NB-IoT water meter main board, which comprises the following steps: the host computer issues a metering control instruction to the PLC controller; the PLC controller controls a plurality of metering ejector pins to prop against the metering modules of the corresponding plates to be tested; the host computer issues a metering test instruction to the serial HUB board; the serial HUB board transmits the received metering test instruction to a plurality of accompany boards; each accompanying board transmits a metering test instruction to the board to be tested through the infrared board, and then simulates and sends a preset number of pulses to the metering thimble; each board to be tested receives the metering test instruction to enter a metering test state, initializes the accumulated flow to zero and re-reads the accumulated flow; the accompanying measuring board obtains the quantity of the accumulated flow read by the board to be measured through the infrared board, and judges whether the measurement test of the board to be measured is qualified or not according to the quantity of the accumulated flow read by the board to be measured and returns the quantity to the host. The application can realize the functional module test of the NB-IoT water meter main board with high efficiency.

title_en: Emergency alarm method, device and system for medical patient
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency alarm method, device and system for a medical patient, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring monitoring information uploaded by wearing equipment in real time according to a preset time interval, wherein the wearing equipment is intelligent equipment worn by a medical patient, and the monitoring information is physical state information about the medical patient; when the physical state of the medical patient is abnormal according to the monitoring information, equipment positioning information of the medical patient is determined according to the monitoring information, corresponding alarm equipment is searched based on the equipment positioning information, and the alarm equipment is controlled to trigger emergency alarm processing in real time. The invention can widen the monitoring and alarming area; the monitoring flow can be simplified, the alarm time is shortened, and the alarm efficiency is improved; delay and error of manual alarm processing can be avoided, and alarm efficiency and alarm precision are further improved.

title_en: Soft measurement and multi-objective optimization control method, device and medium for sewage treatment process
abstract_en: The invention discloses a soft measurement and multi-objective optimization control method, a device and a medium for sewage treatment process, which are used for collecting dissolved oxygen, nitrate nitrogen, effluent quality and energy consumption data in the sewage treatment process; establishing a soft measurement model based on a regularized online sequence extreme learning machine for predicting the water quality and energy consumption of the effluent in the sewage treatment process, and adopting a piecewise linear chaotic map initialization and multivariate learning strategy to improve the self-adaptive guided differential evolution algorithm to obtain IMOAGDE algorithm; taking water quality and energy consumption as optimization targets, and obtaining an optimized set value of dissolved oxygen and nitrate nitrogen through IMOAGDE algorithm; and adopting an absolute error of integral time, adjusting time and overshoot as optimization targets, carrying out parameter setting on FOPID by utilizing IMOAGDE algorithm, finding out an optimal parameter combination, and carrying out tracking control on dissolved oxygen and nitrate nitrogen. The invention realizes the on-line, high-precision and soft measurement of key parameters in the sewage treatment process and multi-target optimal control, and has important significance for improving the sewage treatment process and saving energy and reducing emission.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle charging path planning method applied to wireless sensor network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle charging path planning method applied to a wireless sensor network, which comprises the following steps: constructing a two-dimensional plane wireless chargeable sensor network model; the wireless chargeable sensor network model comprises the following steps: a plurality of base stations, unmanned aerial vehicles and sensor nodes; based on the wireless chargeable sensor network model, planning an initial unmanned aerial vehicle charging path by utilizing a genetic algorithm to obtain an initial unmanned aerial vehicle charging path; combining the initial charging path of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and determining a charging stop point of the unmanned aerial vehicle by a plumb line method; and obtaining the unmanned aerial vehicle charging path through the unmanned aerial vehicle charging stop point and combining the genetic algorithm. According to the method, through accurate path planning and charging point positioning, unnecessary flying of the unmanned aerial vehicle is reduced, the effectiveness of each charging is maximized, the running time and the overall service life of the sensor network are prolonged, and the maintenance cost is reduced.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle autonomous environment sensing, path planning and dynamic landing method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, and discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle autonomous environment sensing, path planning and dynamic landing method and system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring three-dimensional environment information in real time; determining a global starting point and a global end point, and generating an initial path; optimizing the initial path based on a local path optimization algorithm to obtain a first optimized path; when the perception threshold value of the current position of the unmanned aerial vehicle is larger than a preset threshold value, optimizing the initial path by a path optimization method based on boundary perception to obtain a second optimized path and a local end point; when the unmanned aerial vehicle advances to a local end point, switching to optimize an initial path in real time based on a local path optimization algorithm; and when the unmanned aerial vehicle reaches a global terminal, performing dynamic landing based on a deep reinforcement learning algorithm. According to the invention, different path planning methods are selected according to different conditions, so that path redundancy or sinking into a local optimal solution is avoided, the path optimization efficiency is improved, and accurate dynamic landing of the unmanned aerial vehicle is realized.

title_en: Vehicle identification method, device, electronic equipment and medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a vehicle identification method, a device, electronic equipment and a medium, and belongs to the technical field of video monitoring. The method comprises the following steps: receiving information of a passing vehicle identified by a bayonet camera, wherein the bayonet camera is arranged at a yard exit and is used for acquiring vehicle information of a yard vehicle; matching a yard history record of at least one yard according to the passing vehicle information; judging whether the parking lot is associated with the bayonet camera or not; and if the parking lot is associated with the bayonet camera, carrying out departure processing on the passing vehicle according to the passing vehicle information. The vehicle identification method provided by the application improves the efficiency of unattended parking charging in the road for self-service payment.

title_en: Dewaxing control method and device, medium, computer equipment and dewaxing control system
abstract_en: The application discloses a dewaxing control method and device, a medium, a computer device and a dewaxing control system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: responding to a starting instruction of the first control system, establishing communication connection between the first control system and a second control system corresponding to the dewaxing unit, and displaying an initial interface on the interactive terminal; and responding to a trigger instruction of an operating system icon, controlling the interactive terminal to display an operating system interface, wherein the operating system interface comprises a control system display area, an operation mode control button, a process mode control button, an alarm button and operation data display area corresponding to the target heat treatment furnace and a control system display area corresponding to the dewaxing unit, the control system display area of the target heat treatment furnace is used for displaying control mechanism composition information, control mechanism operation information and control button of the partial pressure charging valve of the target heat treatment furnace, and the control system display area of the dewaxing unit is used for displaying control mechanism composition information and control mechanism operation information of the dewaxing unit.

title_en: NB independent combustible gas monitoring method and monitoring system
abstract_en: The application relates to an NB independent combustible gas monitoring method and an NB independent combustible gas monitoring system, which comprise the following steps: receiving collected data of each monitoring subarea; matching corresponding association extraction rules based on the type of the combustible gas; extracting associated features of the acquired data; inputting the acquired associated features into a gas diffusion model for simulation analysis; and when the abnormal characteristics sent by the gas diffusion model are received, executing corresponding preset abnormal treatment measures based on the abnormal characteristics. According to the application, the NB-IoT technology is utilized to collect and analyze the combustible gas and environmental data in the monitoring area in real time, and the simulation analysis is carried out by combining the gas diffusion model, so that the accurate monitoring and early warning of abnormal conditions such as combustible gas leakage and diffusion are realized, and the potential gas leakage or abnormal conditions are timely and effectively identified and early warned through comprehensive and real-time data processing and abnormal identification, thereby having the effects of improving the discovery speed of potential safety hazards and greatly reducing the cost and risk of manual inspection.

title_en: Intelligent route dynamic management and control method based on unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent route dynamic management and control method based on an unmanned aerial vehicle, which relates to the field of aviation traffic management, and comprises the following steps: acquiring a target navigation record; acquiring a target navigation record of a target airspace; reading a preset unit time, and dividing a target period to obtain a time period dividing result; screening the plurality of navigation lines by taking the first time period as screening constraint to obtain a first navigation position set; acquiring a target limited navigation position set, and performing navigation visualization on a target airspace to obtain a first airspace navigation map; analyzing the first airspace navigable map by combining the target route to obtain a first preset navigation position; taking a target preset route as a control reference. The technical problem that the existing unmanned aerial vehicle navigation management and control cannot accurately manage and control the navigation line according to the real-time flight environment is solved, and the technical effects of updating and adjusting the navigation line in real time according to various factors in the flight process and improving the flight safety are achieved.

title_en: Automatic control method and system for reservoir water level
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application relates to the technical field of water level control and discloses a method and a system for automatically controlling the water level of a reservoir, wherein the method comprises the steps of firstly obtaining an automatic water level adjusting control instruction, and then obtaining initial pressure values of a water inlet of the reservoir and a water outlet of the reservoir based on the automatic water level adjusting control instruction; inputting the initial pressure value of the water inlet of the reservoir and the water outlet of the reservoir into a pre-trained butterfly valve opening pre-estimation model to obtain initial opening values of the first butterfly valve and the second butterfly valve; and then controlling the first butterfly valve and the second butterfly valve to be opened based on initial opening values of the first butterfly valve and the second butterfly valve to perform bidirectional flow regulation on the water level of the reservoir, and finally regulating the opening values of the target butterfly valve based on real-time pressure values of the water inlet of the reservoir and the water outlet of the reservoir to perform real-time regulation control on the water level of the reservoir, so that fine automatic regulation on the water level of the reservoir is realized, and the accuracy of water level regulation is improved.

title_en: Self-adaptive PLC code conversion method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: A self-adaptive PLC code conversion method, a device and electronic equipment relate to the technical field of communication. The method comprises the following steps: responding to PLC code conversion operation of a user, and acquiring a PLC code to be converted; acquiring a target PLC system corresponding to a PLC code to be converted, and acquiring a first PLC system from a preset PLC conversion database; if the target PLC system is confirmed to be the first PLC system, acquiring and acquiring a first code conversion characteristic corresponding to the first PLC system from a preset PLC conversion database; acquiring a second PLC system and acquiring a second code conversion characteristic corresponding to the second PLC system in a preset PLC conversion database; acquiring difference characteristics of the first code conversion characteristics and the second code conversion characteristics; and converting the PLC codes to be converted into target PLC codes according to the difference characteristics, wherein the target PLC codes are the PLC codes corresponding to the second PLC system. According to the technical scheme, the problem that the manual conversion process is tedious and time-consuming, and the PLC code conversion efficiency between different systems is low is solved.

title_en: Detection device for fire safety system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a detection device for a fire safety system, in particular to a detection device comprising a cover member adapted to support a detector assembly having a plurality of pins. The base member of the probing apparatus is coupled to the cover member and is adapted to receive a plurality of electrical terminals adapted to engage the pins. The detection means comprise a rotatable ring arranged on the base part and adapted to lock the cover part relative to the base part. The detection means comprise a plurality of short-circuit elements arranged on the rotatable ring and adapted to make short-circuit contact with the electrical terminals. The rotatable ring rotates relative to the base member and the cover member to at least one of: locking and breaking the short-circuit contact of the cover part relative to the base part, and unlocking and making the short-circuit contact of the cover part relative to the base part.

title_en: Automatic driving traffic event testing method and equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic driving traffic event testing method and equipment. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a traffic event type selected by a user; acquiring initial track parameters, and generating simulated track data for simulating the running track of the vehicle according to the traffic event type and the initial track parameters; inputting the simulated track data into an automatic driving algorithm to be tested, and simulating the running process of the vehicle by adopting the automatic driving algorithm to be tested; and acquiring a traffic event triggered in the driving process and judging the traffic event. According to the invention, the running process of the vehicle is simulated through the automatic driving algorithm to be tested, the traffic event triggered in the running process is obtained, and the traffic event is judged, so that the whole testing process from triggering early warning of the sensing event to early warning detection and then subsequent positioning and checking is covered by utilizing the automatic testing. The simulation triggering of multiple traffic event types under the road side multi-road scene is safely and efficiently achieved, and the human resource cost for observing whether the early warning event is triggered or not and whether the event triggering is correct or not can be greatly reduced by too much time of manpower investment.

title_en: Gravity dam rapid emergency disposal method based on real-time earthquake safety evaluation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gravity dam rapid emergency disposal method based on real-time earthquake safety evaluation, which belongs to the technical field of hydraulic and hydroelectric engineering informatization construction and comprises the following steps: s1, acquiring seismic information through a data acquisition device and performing data processing; s2, converting the seismic information into acceleration response spectrum and dynamic time course data in real time based on the seismic information; s3, typical acceleration response spectrum and dynamic time interval data are used as input, seismic response calculation is carried out through a gravity dam online numerical analysis system, and calculation results are output; s4, dividing the earthquake motion impact comprehensive evaluation categories into earthquake motion impact comprehensive evaluation categories by adopting an earthquake motion impact comprehensive evaluation method based on the calculation result, and carrying out earthquake motion impact evaluation aiming at earthquake events and carrying out emergency treatment; the problem that the large-scale hydropower hydraulic engineering in the existing earthquake area is poor in emergency disposal capability to earthquakes is solved, and then the earthquake emergency response capability and management level of engineering operation and maintenance management departments are greatly improved.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle measurement-based power line fault early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power line fault early warning method and system based on unmanned aerial vehicle measurement, and relates to the technical field of power line inspection, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining at least one power line block; the method comprises the steps of obtaining at least one line block classification, forming at least one early warning feature by the line block classification, obtaining at least one shielding object infrared image and shielding object common image existing in a power line, establishing an infrared image superposition model, obtaining at least one actual shielding object existing in an actual common image, obtaining an infrared preprocessing image, obtaining all early warning features appearing in the infrared preprocessing image as target early warning features, and carrying out early warning based on the number of the target early warning features. Through setting up classification module, characteristic acquisition module, model establishment module and data processing module, guarantee can not appear missing and the erroneous judgement of discernment, and then can carry out the correct discernment to all early warning information, promote the accuracy of early warning.

title_en: Expressway edge calculation traffic optimization system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of traffic control, in particular to a highway edge calculation traffic optimization system, which determines a first reference vehicle speed and sends the first reference vehicle speed to a second edge calculation node when the highway traffic condition is a non-unobstructed condition; the second edge computing node obtains a plurality of segmented areas with different vehicle distance ranges according to the vehicle distance segmented table, and determines a second recommended vehicle speed of each segmented area; according to the scheme, even if the first high-speed road section is unsmooth, vehicles on the second high-speed road section can still go forward in order, the sending probability of accidents is reduced, and therefore expressway traffic is optimized.

title_en: Agricultural machinery management and control system based on Beidou navigation and positioning technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses an agricultural machinery management and control system based on Beidou navigation and positioning technology, which relates to the technical field of positioning and navigation and comprises a control center, wherein the control center is connected with a path data acquisition module, an irrigation path generation module, a growth image acquisition module and a harvesting path generation module; acquiring path data of farmlands by a sowing agricultural machine; acquiring an irrigation radius of an irrigation agricultural machine, and generating an irrigation path according to the irrigation radius and path data; setting an irrigation period, and acquiring a growth image of crops by an irrigation agricultural machine through an irrigation path according to the irrigation period; judging whether a disease plant exists in crops according to the growth image, and if the disease plant exists, acquiring a harvesting position; acquiring plant distances according to the growth images, and generating temporary path nodes according to the plant distances; acquiring the geographical position of the harvesting agricultural machinery through Beidou positioning, and marking the geographical position as a departure place; the harvesting position is marked as a destination; and generating a harvesting path according to the departure place, the destination, the temporary path node and the path data.

title_en: Driving recording method, driving recording device, vehicle, medium and program
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of vehicles, in particular to a driving recording method, a driving recording device, a vehicle, a medium and a program, wherein the driving recording method comprises the following steps: acquiring video data and audio data; adding video data and audio data to corresponding buffer queues; under the condition that no collision signal is identified, mixing the video data and the audio data output by the buffer queue through an audio-video cyclic recording pipeline, and storing the mixed video data and the mixed audio data in a first container to generate first driving data; and when the collision signal is identified, the video data and the audio data are mixed and stored in a second container through an audio-video recording pipeline responding to the emergency collision to generate second driving data. Therefore, the problems that the driving recording method in the related art is more in limitation, the driving data is single, various recording requirements cannot be met, the user experience is poor and the like are solved.

title_en: Three-in-one digital data acquisition and processing equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides three-in-one digital data acquisition and processing equipment, which belongs to the technical field of image data processing, and particularly comprises the steps of determining the alignment processing requirement value and the data processing priority of different road sections based on total mileage and historical acquisition data when the data quality of the acquisition data of the road sections meets the requirement by utilizing weather data and the signal disappearance condition of the acquisition data of different types, determining the corresponding deviation condition of the acquisition data of different types in different time periods by utilizing the acquisition data, determining the data processing sequence of the different road sections in the corresponding data processing priority based on the corresponding deviation condition, the alignment processing requirement value and the data quality, determining the data analysis processing sequence of the acquisition data of different road sections based on the data processing priority and the data processing sequence, and determining whether the road sections need to be subjected to re-acquisition processing according to the data analysis result of the acquisition data, so that the reliability of the acquisition data of the road sections is ensured.

title_en: Method, device, computer equipment and medium for preventing vehicle from being misidentified
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a device, computer equipment and a medium for preventing vehicles from being mistakenly identified, and when detecting that a target vehicle exists in a first preset identification area, acquiring vehicle characteristic information of the target vehicle; acquiring an in/out-of-the-field vehicle list in a first preset time range, wherein the in/out-of-the-field vehicle list comprises in/out-of-the-field vehicle characteristic information; judging whether the vehicle characteristic information of the target vehicle is consistent with the in-and-out vehicle characteristic information; if yes, judging whether the target vehicle meets a first preset exit/entrance condition; if yes, the target vehicle is released. Whether the vehicle just enters or just exits can be determined by identifying the vehicle characteristic information of the vehicle, so that the vehicle is prevented from being misjudged to enter or exit when passing through the entrance/exit, meanwhile, the vehicle just entering or just exiting can be released, the problem of exit/entrance congestion is avoided, and the accurate management and control of the vehicle and the parking space in the parking lot can be realized.

title_en: Material processing system and method thereof
abstract_en: A material handling system for handling and placing packages onto trays destined for an order store, comprising a storage array, an automated package transport system, an automated palletizer, and a controller operatively connected to the automated palletizer, the controller programmed with a tray load generator having at least one tray-to-order store affinity characteristic, a predetermined method for tray load package delivery at the order store, the tray load generator configured such that the tray load is formed by the automated palletizer disposed in a tray load embodying the at least one tray-to-order store affinity characteristic.

title_en: Tea moisture on-line detection device and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a tea moisture on-line detection device and a method thereof, belonging to the technical field of tea moisture detection, wherein the device comprises: a cylindrical capacitor; one end of the resonant inductor is connected with the positive electrode of the cylindrical capacitor; the positive electrode of the sinusoidal signal generator is connected with the other end of the resonant inductor, and the negative electrode of the sinusoidal signal generator is connected with the negative electrode of the cylindrical capacitor; the positive electrode of the capacitor digital converter is connected with the positive electrode of the cylindrical capacitor, and the negative electrode of the capacitor digital converter is connected with the negative electrode of the cylindrical capacitor; the singlechip is connected with the control end of the capacitance-digital converter; the weighing sensor is arranged at the bottom of the cylindrical capacitor and is connected with the singlechip; the temperature and humidity sensor is connected with the singlechip; the display screen is connected with the singlechip; the communication module is connected with the singlechip; and the power supply module is connected with the singlechip. The invention has the advantages that: the efficiency and the precision of tealeaves moisture detection have very big improved, the very big cost of tealeaves moisture detection that has reduced.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle log system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle logs and discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle log system, which comprises a flight data acquisition and acquisition module, a flight data analysis module, a flight data record storage module and a flight data real-time transmission module, wherein the flight data acquisition and acquisition module is used for collecting various data information in the unmanned aerial vehicle flight process, the flight data analysis module is used for analyzing and analyzing acquired unmanned aerial vehicle flight data, the flight data record storage module is used for storing and recording the acquired unmanned aerial vehicle flight data, the flight data real-time transmission module is used for transmitting the unmanned aerial vehicle flight data, the flight data acquisition and acquisition module can clearly acquire the numerical value of various data of the unmanned aerial vehicle in the flight process, and the flight data analysis module can analyze the flight process of the unmanned aerial vehicle, so that the flight track of the unmanned aerial vehicle is simulated, and the unmanned aerial vehicle is in a state and a position at a certain time point.

title_en: Intelligent protection door for grottoes temple
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent protective door for a stone cave temple, which is characterized by comprising a door frame, a shutter door leaf and a vertical driving rotary shutter mechanism, wherein a ventilation channel is arranged on the shutter door leaf, and the vertical driving rotary shutter mechanism is arranged on the ventilation channel; the vertical driving rotary shutter mechanism comprises a shutter frame, a plurality of groups of rotary shutter components, an electric cylinder and movable shutter connecting rods which are sequentially arranged, a guide groove is formed in the side edge of the shutter frame, and the movable shutter connecting rods are movably arranged in the guide groove; the rotary shutter assembly comprises fixed shutters and movable shutters which are mutually matched, the movable shutters are provided with movable shaft rods, arc-shaped slotted holes corresponding to the movable shaft rods are arranged at the bottoms of the guide grooves of the shutter frames, the movable shaft rods can slide along the arc-shaped slotted holes, so that the movable shutters are driven to open or close, transmission parts are few, and the advantage of high reliability can be highlighted particularly in a dust environment. The invention has preventive protection function, and improves management efficiency and safety.

title_en: Multi-unmanned aerial vehicle full-coverage path planning method based on novel cooperation mechanism multi-population ant colony algorithm
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle full-coverage path planning method based on a novel cooperation mechanism multi-population ant colony algorithm. Mainly comprises the following steps: establishing a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle full-coverage path planning model; decomposing complex fields by adopting concave polygon decomposition, and establishing unmanned aerial vehicle waypoints; generating a working path by a scanning line method; initializing and improving the parameters of a multi-population ant colony algorithm; carrying out path planning on a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle full-coverage path planning model by utilizing the improved multi-population ant colony algorithm; the improved multi-population ant colony algorithm comprises the steps of designing a novel cooperation mechanism, guaranteeing minimum task balance of each unmanned aerial vehicle, designing a shared tabu table to realize a multi-ant parallel strategy, improving the ant colony algorithm transfer probability and a pheromone updating mechanism, and realizing multi-unmanned aerial vehicle full-coverage path planning.

title_en: Shared charging cabinet machine with selectable length of charging line and control method
abstract_en: The application discloses a shared charging cabinet-type machine with a selectable length of a charging wire and a control method of the shared charging cabinet-type machine, comprising the following steps: the charging system comprises a shared charging bank storage mechanism comprising a plurality of shared charging bank storage bins, a charging line storage mechanism comprising a plurality of charging line storage bins and a controller, wherein the plurality of charging lines are of various length types; the controller is used for analyzing the charging wire length requirement information and the charging bank requirement information corresponding to the lease request when receiving the lease request of the shared charging bank, sending the charging wire length requirement information to the charging wire storage mechanism and sending the charging bank requirement information to the shared charging bank storage mechanism; the shared charging bank storage bin is used for popping up a shared charging bank meeting the charging bank demand information when the charging bank demand information is received, wherein charging wires with each length can be matched with the shared charging bank for use; and the charging wire storage mechanism is used for popping up the charging wire which accords with the charging wire length requirement information when receiving the charging wire requirement information.

title_en: Automatic temperature control device of camera and vehicle
abstract_en: The application provides an automatic temperature control device of a camera, which is applied to a vehicle provided with the camera, and comprises a heating body, a power supply, a sampling circuit and a microcontroller, wherein the heating body is directly contacted with a lens and generates heat when being electrified; the power supply is provided with a power switch, so that the heating body is electrically connected or disconnected with the power supply; the sampling circuit is provided with a sampling resistor; when the power supply is electrically connected with the heating body to generate current, the power supply is used for acquiring a voltage value generated by the current flowing through the sampling resistor; the microcontroller comprises an arithmetic unit, a temperature sensor and a first controller, wherein the arithmetic unit is used for calculating the resistance value of the heating body according to the corresponding relation among the voltage value, the resistance value of the sampling resistor and the voltage value of the power supply, and calculating to obtain a first temperature according to the corresponding relation with the temperature; the temperature sensor is used for sensing the current temperature value of the lens to obtain a second temperature; the first controller is used for controlling the power switch to be turned on or off according to the first temperature and/or the second temperature so as to enable the heating body to be electrically connected or disconnected with the power supply.

title_en: Closed-loop controller structure of direct or indirect hybrid drive of machine element
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a closed-loop control structure of a direct or indirect hybrid drive of a machine element, in particular to a closed-loop control structure for a first drive and a second drive, the first drive acting via a transmission and the second drive acting directly on a machine element of a machine having a plurality of shafts, which is adjustable relative to the shafts. The position closed loop controller receives the position setpoint and the position actual value of the machine element and determines a speed setpoint of the machine element from these values. The first determining means receives the speed setting and uses the speed setting to determine the obtained speed setting. The first speed closed-loop controller determines a first force setting value by means of a difference between an actual speed value of the first drive and the obtained speed setting value and drives the first drive according to the first force setting value. The second speed closed loop controller determines a second force setting by means of the difference between the obtained speed setting and the actual speed value of the machine element and drives the second drive in accordance with the second force setting.

title_en: Active fault-tolerant predictive control method, device and product for networked multi-agent system
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, equipment and a product for active fault-tolerant predictive control of a networked multi-agent system, which relate to the field of fault-tolerant prediction, wherein an improved self-adaptive Kalman filter observer at a cloud server side is applied to estimating system states and actuator faults, and the control signals which can exactly compensate the real-time communication constraint are selected from available latest prediction control command data packets in each intelligent agent executor according to the real-time communication constraint and are sent to the executor by the time delay compensator according to the time delay compensation strategy. The application can realize the collaborative output tracking of the networked multi-agent system.

title_en: Intelligent inspection method for non-coal mine and intelligent inspection unmanned vehicle
abstract_en: The application discloses a non-coal mine intelligent inspection method and an intelligent inspection unmanned vehicle, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a mine area map of a mine, and marking a plurality of dangerous areas in advance on the mine area map; determining a plurality of target patrol points according to the plurality of dangerous areas, and generating an initial patrol route based on the target patrol points; controlling the intelligent inspection unmanned vehicle to move to a target inspection point, simultaneously collecting environmental data and image data of surrounding environment in real time, and adjusting an inspection route according to the environmental data and the image data; after reaching any one inspection point, judging whether the current inspection point meets detection conditions or not by combining the environment data and the image data; if the detection condition is met, carrying out water permeability detection, and analyzing to obtain a water permeability hidden danger result of the current inspection point; judging whether dangerous symptoms appear on the current inspection point according to the water penetration hidden danger result and the environmental data, and determining the dangerous level of the current inspection point.

title_en: Dynamic temperature adjustment and food quality optimization method for air fryer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic temperature regulation and food quality optimization method for an air fryer, which particularly relates to the technical field of data processing, and judges whether the temperature needs to be regulated or not by continuously acquiring the actual temperature of the air fryer in a preset time period and comparing the actual temperature with the temperature set by a user; if the air fryer needs to be regulated, acquiring adjustable state data of the air fryer, calculating an adjustable coefficient, comparing the adjustable coefficient with a preset threshold value, and determining whether the air fryer has a regulating condition or not; if the temperature meets the conditions, the final temperature is calculated according to the temperature set by the user, the working time and the current temperature, and the temperature of the air fryer is adjusted, so that the temperature inside the air fryer can be dynamically adjusted according to the temperature set by the user, the working time and the current temperature of the air fryer, the heating quality of food can be improved, and the working safety of the air fryer is ensured.

title_en: Intelligent wardrobe control system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of intelligent control and discloses an intelligent wardrobe control system based on the Internet of things, which comprises a wardrobe body state data acquisition module for acquiring environmental data in a wardrobe, a clothes data acquisition module for shooting clothes in the wardrobe to acquire the number of the clothes, a data analysis processing module comprising a drying analysis unit for acquiring a drying demand index and a disinfection analysis unit for acquiring a disinfection demand index, a control module for judging whether to start the drying module and/or the disinfection module according to a comparison result, a correction adjustment module for correcting and analyzing the drying time and/or the disinfection time set by a user and judging whether to adjust according to the result of the correction analysis, and a communication module for connecting the wardrobe body state data acquisition module, the clothes state data acquisition module, the data analysis processing module and the control module in a communication mode.

title_en: Intelligent epidemic prevention method and system for livestock breeding
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent epidemic prevention method and system for livestock breeding, S1, arranging a plurality of sensor networks and intelligent ear tags or collars in an animal farm; s2, transmitting the health parameter set and the environment parameter set to a central data processing system through the Internet of things technology; s3, evaluating and predicting the health condition of the livestock and poultry by utilizing an improved deep learning algorithm, and identifying potential disease risks; s4, when an abnormal health parameter set and an environment parameter set are detected, the central data processing system generates early warning information; s5, according to the early warning information, the automatic control system starts corresponding epidemic prevention measures; s6, a manager checks epidemic prevention conditions of the animal farm in real time through a remote monitoring system, and remotely operates and adjusts according to actual conditions; s7, storing epidemic prevention data on a blockchain; s8, storing and analyzing the system operation data regularly. The invention can realize the intelligent management of livestock breeding and the optimization of epidemic prevention effect.

title_en: Interconnection control method and device of kitchen air conditioner and intelligent equipment and air conditioner
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a device for controlling interconnection of a kitchen air conditioner and intelligent equipment and the air conditioner. The intelligent device and the kitchen air conditioner are located in the same kitchen environment space. The interconnection control method of the invention comprises the following steps: receiving a mildew-proof instruction for indicating mildew-proof treatment of the kitchen environment space; and controlling the kitchen air conditioner and/or the intelligent equipment to execute mildew-proof measures so as to perform mildew-proof treatment on the kitchen environment space, thereby effectively preventing the possibility of mold breeding in the kitchen environment space before mold breeding, improving the sanitary level in the kitchen environment space and being beneficial to the diet health of users.

title_en: Photovoltaic tracking bracket and control system and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of application of photovoltaic supports, in particular to a photovoltaic tracking support, a control system and a control method thereof, wherein the gravity center distance between a photovoltaic panel and a fixing frame in a double-shaft photovoltaic tracking support is smaller than the rotation shaft distance through the cooperation of an angle adjusting mechanism and the fixing frame, so that the large-area arrangement of the photovoltaic panel on a single upright post can be realized, the pitching angle of the photovoltaic panel can be rotated by a larger angle and can be rotated by 80 degrees or even 90 degrees, the influence of heavy snow, heavy wind and heavy rain on the photovoltaic tracking support is avoided, and the application and popularization of the double-shaft tracking of the photovoltaic panel are realized. Meanwhile, a control method is provided, and accurate tracking of sun illumination is realized by matching the flux controller with the illumination sensor.

title_en: Maximum power point tracking method, device, equipment and medium of photovoltaic system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of new energy, in particular to a maximum power point tracking method, device, equipment and medium of a photovoltaic system. In the tracking process, the fluctuation of the sawtooth wave is adopted to disturb the input voltage so as to track the maximum power point, namely, the input voltage is disturbed by a preset step length so as to carry out disturbance among a first disturbance state, a second disturbance state and a third disturbance state. Therefore, the maximum power point can be tracked faster by the disturbance of the sawtooth wave in a fluctuation mode, the tracking efficiency and the tracking speed are greatly improved, the energy transmitted by the photovoltaic system can be input to products such as a battery and the like with the maximum efficiency, the performance of the battery is improved, and the economy and the reliability of solar power generation and the adaptability to environmental conversion are also improved.

title_en: In-store distribution equipment and in-store distribution method
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to an in-store cargo allocation apparatus and an in-store cargo allocation method, wherein the in-store cargo allocation apparatus includes an apparatus main body formed with a storage area, a docking area, and a packing area, and provided with an in-store cargo outlet and an in-store cargo inlet facing an in-store, and further includes a picker movably provided between the storage area and the packing area, the picker being configured to have a first cargo allocation path, in which the picker is directly moved from the storage area to the packing area, a second cargo allocation path, in which the picker is directly moved from the storage area to the in-store cargo outlet, and a third cargo allocation path, in which the picker is moved from the in-store cargo inlet to the packing area, so that cargo put in from the in-store cargo inlet can be packed by a packing machine. Through the technical scheme, cargoes in the equipment can be sent to the packing position for packing according to specific requirements or sent to the manual area for packing, and cargoes outside the equipment can also be sent to the packing position for packing.

title_en: Communication management system for vehicle
abstract_en: The invention provides a communication management system for a vehicle, which can continuously perform driving assistance and automatic driving without obstacle even when a region which cannot communicate with a server is included in a driving route. The vehicle communication management system includes a storage unit (321) that associates and stores a downloadable data amount for each position information based on a communication status of each position information, a first data amount calculation device (311) that calculates a required download data amount for the own vehicle, and a second data amount calculation unit (312) that performs an accumulation calculation for the downloadable data amount for each position information stored in the storage unit (321) from a point where the downloadable data amount obtained by the accumulation calculation is greater than the required download data amount, based on path information of a path through which the own vehicle can pass until the communication status becomes worse, and the downloadable data amount for each position information stored in the storage unit (321).

title_en: Non-contact rapid banknote counting method, system, device, storage medium and program
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-contact rapid banknote counting method, a system, equipment, a storage medium and a program, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting laser light bar images of a line laser light source irradiated on the edge of a banknote to be measured; the method comprises the steps of carrying out binarization processing on the laser light bar image to obtain a binarized image, screening coordinate points which meet preset requirements in the binarized image, and carrying out one-dimensional signal peak value detection on the coordinate points which meet the preset requirements to obtain the number of paper money. Through the processing scheme disclosed by the invention, the quantity information of the RMB can be acquired in a non-contact manner, and the abrasion and pollution possibly brought by the traditional contact type banknote counting are avoided.

title_en: Intelligent transportation equipment based on internet of vehicles
abstract_en: The invention discloses intelligent traffic equipment based on the Internet of vehicles, which relates to the field of intelligent traffic and comprises a control column, wherein the outer wall of the control column is fixedly connected with a protection mechanism, the bottom end of the protection mechanism is fixedly connected with a moving mechanism, the outer wall of the control column is sleeved with a traffic light, and the top end of the control column is rotationally connected with a solar mechanism. Through setting up moving mechanism, the supporting point when the pulley can be as removing, and convenient laborsaving removes the traffic light to the place of use on the road, then receives the pulley in the base.

title_en: Automatic dry-wet state conversion control optimization method for generator set
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for optimizing dry-wet state automatic conversion control of a generator set, which comprises the following steps: step one, optimizing and setting conditions in a preliminary stage, thoroughly analyzing the existing control logic and evaluating the performance and response characteristics of the control logic. Through explicit control logic and parameter adjustment formulas, a more efficient and accurate conversion process can be ensured. The accurate control of fuel quantity and water level can reduce unnecessary energy waste, improve conversion efficiency, monitor the change of key parameters, and dynamically adjust control strategies as required, so that the stability of the system in the whole conversion process can be ensured, potential safety risks can be reduced, the reliability of the system can be improved, and the operation can be more standardized. Operators can operate according to a clear guideline, the possibility of human errors is reduced, the operation efficiency and accuracy are improved, the dry-wet state conversion control is enhanced, and the operation efficiency and stability are enhanced when the generator set operates under wide load peak regulation.

title_en: Reference voltage source circuit, high-order compensation method of reference voltage source circuit and chip
abstract_en: The invention relates to a reference voltage source circuit, a high-order compensation method and a chip of the reference voltage source circuit, wherein the reference voltage source circuit performs high-order compensation based on BJT forward current gain temperature characteristics, the reference voltage source circuit comprises a CTAT circuit and a PTAT circuit, the CTAT circuit comprises a first BJT, an emitter of the first BJTQ is connected with the PTAT circuit, a collector of the first BJTQ is connected with a base and is connected with a common ground, the PTAT circuit comprises a second BJTQ2, a current density ratio of the first BJTQ1 and the second BJTQ is 1:N, a collector of the second BJTQ is connected with the base and is connected with the common ground, and the reference voltage source circuit is configured to realize high-order compensation of the reference voltage source circuit by configuring a bias current of the second BJTQ.

title_en: Intelligent parking space state recognition system and method based on video detection
