abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent parking space state recognition system and method based on video detection, which belong to the technical field of parking space state recognition, and the method specifically comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of collecting video data of a parking area, preprocessing the collected video data of the parking area, modeling a parking lot background based on a time sequence, updating the parking area in real time, detecting the foreground based on a background modeling result, extracting a foreground area, carrying out contour analysis on the detected foreground area, judging the occupation state of each parking space, generating a real-time parking lot parking space distribution map according to the occupation state of all the parking spaces, displaying the occupation or idle state of each parking space, and enabling an intelligent parking space state recognition system based on video detection to keep high accuracy under actual scenes such as complex illumination conditions, complex environments, different vehicle types and angles, helping drivers to quickly find the idle parking spaces, and reducing traffic jam caused by searching the parking spaces.

title_en: Dormancy control method of POS machine and POS machine
abstract_en: The invention provides a dormancy control method of a POS machine and the POS machine. The method comprises the steps of responding to a dormancy starting instruction, controlling a processor, a magnetic stripe card reading module and an NFC module to enter a deep dormancy state, waking up the processor in the deep dormancy state according to a preset waking period, enabling the processor to control the NFC module to send radio frequency signals to the outside through an NFC antenna once, determining a target distance between the bank card and the NFC antenna based on the strength of feedback radio frequency signals of the bank card received by the NFC antenna, judging the relation between the target distance and a preset distance threshold value, enabling the processor and the NFC module to resume the deep dormancy state if the target distance is not smaller than the distance threshold value, otherwise, controlling the processor and the NFC module to enter the shallow dormancy state, and enabling the magnetic stripe card reading module to keep waking up. The POS machine adopts the method. According to the invention, the POS machine can realize self wake-up and correctly read the magnetic track data of the magnetic stripe card based on one magnetic stripe card swiping action while keeping the power consumption of the POS machine at a low level.

title_en: Wisdom forestry firebreak device
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent forestry fireproof device which comprises a fixing mechanism, a power supply mechanism, an air supply mechanism, a monitoring mechanism and a detection mechanism, wherein the fixing mechanism comprises a fixing seat and a fixing box, the fixing box is arranged at the top of the fixing seat, the detection mechanism comprises an air box, a detection cavity is arranged at the inner bottom of the fixing box, the air box is arranged in the detection cavity, openings are formed in two sides of the air box, the detection mechanism further comprises an infrared emitter and a detection piece, the infrared emitter and the detection piece are respectively arranged on two sides of the detection cavity and are positioned on two sides of the air box, infrared emitted by the infrared emitter passes through a pair of openings and is received by the detection piece, the air supply mechanism is arranged in the fixing box and pumps external air into the air box, and the air in the air box is discharged to the outer side of the fixing box, the monitoring mechanism is arranged in the fixing box so as to monitor the environment outside the fixing box, and the power supply mechanism is arranged in the fixing box and at the top and supplies power to the air supply mechanism, the monitoring mechanism and the detection mechanism.

title_en: Big data-based electromechanical equipment operation temperature state monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for monitoring the running temperature state of electromechanical equipment based on big data, which belongs to the technical field of equipment analysis and specifically comprises the following steps of acquiring infrared images of the whole electromechanical equipment in real time based on an infrared sensor, generating an infrared image sequence according to time, identifying a temperature change area in the electromechanical equipment in unit time, judging whether the temperature of the temperature change area exceeds a preset threshold value, sending an alarm if yes, screening an abnormal area in the temperature change area, sending an overhaul signal, calculating the temperature change speed of the abnormal area, acquiring the power consumption of the current electromechanical equipment, judging that the temperature control of the current electromechanical equipment is abnormal if the temperature change speed is smaller than a preset power value, and effectively analyzing the electromechanical equipment.

title_en: Method, system, device, processor and readable storage medium for implementing high-accuracy power calibration compensation based on temperature monitoring
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for realizing high-accuracy power calibration compensation based on temperature monitoring, which comprises the following steps of placing a radio frequency front-end module in a high-low temperature box for power test; the temperature of the high-low temperature box is adjusted according to a certain temperature step by step to obtain a plurality of power curves of the radio frequency front-end circuit which are related to the temperature, and the temperature difference of the circuit is monitored to compensate the power error. The invention also relates to a system, a device, a processor and a readable storage medium thereof for realizing high-accuracy power calibration compensation based on temperature monitoring. The method, the system, the device, the processor and the computer readable storage medium for realizing high-accuracy power calibration compensation based on temperature monitoring are adopted to obtain the temperature and power change relation under different frequencies, compensate power in a larger range and ensure that the radio frequency front end in the communication measuring instrument is influenced by temperature. The power compensation can be completed only by simply reading the temperature and sending the power difference value, and the problem of computational complexity is hardly caused.

title_en: Calf feeding robot with autonomous navigation control system and use method
abstract_en: The invention provides a calf feeding robot with an autonomous navigation control system and a using method thereof, and relates to the crossing field of robot technology and animal husbandry. A calf feeding robot with an autonomous navigation control system comprises a movable car body chassis, a control screen, a main control cabin, a first camera, a second camera, a laser radar base, a laser radar, a milk barrel, an electromagnetic valve, a nipple, a CAN communication interface module and a control board, wherein the autonomous navigation control system is arranged in the control board and comprises an environment sensing subsystem, a navigation control subsystem, a feeding subsystem and a car body chassis control subsystem, a highly integrated control architecture is realized, and the integrated control system improves the operation efficiency and response speed of the robot, so that the robot CAN be quickly adapted to the change of pasture environment, and timely and accurately provides feeding services for calves.

title_en: Early warning model construction method and system for influence of land characteristics on supply and demand balance
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of analysis early warning models, in particular to an early warning model construction method and system for influencing supply and demand balance by land characteristics. The method comprises the steps of collecting all-weather environmental data of a region to be analyzed of the land, carrying out terrain structure analysis to obtain regional land terrain structure data, carrying out slope soil attribute analysis based on the regional land terrain structure data, then carrying out three-dimensional land structure attribute model construction to obtain a three-dimensional land structure attribute model, carrying out dynamic soil fertility accumulation path deduction based on the three-dimensional land structure attribute model, carrying out fertility character layering analysis to obtain regional fertility character layering data, obtaining land features by utilizing a land character analysis early warning model, and further regulating and controlling land supply and demand according to the land features. The invention improves the analysis early-warning model technology through optimizing the analysis early-warning model technology.

title_en: Detection method, detection device, air compressor and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a detection method, a detection device, an air compressor and a storage medium. The detection method is used for the air compressor, the air compressor comprises an air inlet cavity, an air filter and a pressure sensor, the air filter is arranged at an air inlet of the air inlet cavity, and the pressure sensor is used for detecting the pressure of the air inlet cavity. The detection method comprises the steps of respectively obtaining first pressure and second pressure output by the pressure sensor before and after the air compressor is started, obtaining air inlet air filtering pressure difference of the air compressor according to the first pressure and the second pressure, determining that the air filtering piece is blocked when the air inlet air filtering pressure difference is larger than a preset blocking value, and determining that the air filtering piece is not blocked when the air inlet air filtering pressure difference is smaller than or equal to the preset blocking value. The air filter can be detected whether to be blocked or not by pressure data of one pressure sensor, so that the cost is reduced to a certain extent.

title_en: Control method, device and equipment of intelligent cabin and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a control method, a device, equipment and a storage medium of an intelligent cabin, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining identity information; the intelligent cabin control method and the intelligent cabin control system based on the personal recommendation result, provided by the application, have the advantages that the control flexibility of the intelligent cabin is improved.

title_en: Simulation test message manufacturing method based on signal equipment in rail transit industry
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for manufacturing a simulation test message based on signal equipment in the track traffic industry, which comprises the steps of inputting a target frame structure into a preset message module, generating a simulation message of the target frame structure based on an output table of the message module, reading the simulation message and an input message of a console of a command line interface through a preset text file, covering the keyword content of the simulation message based on the keyword content of the input message when the simulation message is read by the text file and the input message is a non-null value, and obtaining a first simulation test message, wherein the format type of the first simulation test message is the target frame structure, and outputting the first simulation test message to the console of the command line interface, wherein the first simulation test message comprises actual message content and a frame structure annotation. The invention can meet the manufacturing requirements of various types of messages of different users.

title_en: Intelligent sharing control system of intelligent unmanned scooter
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent sharing control system of an intelligent unmanned scooter, which relates to the technical field of unmanned scooter, and comprises an environment acquisition module, a positioning navigation module, a path generation module, a driving module, a communication module and a pavement type identification module, wherein the communication module is in communication connection with a first terminal, a second terminal and a cloud computing system, and a main control module is respectively and electrically connected with the environment acquisition module, the positioning navigation module, the path generation module, the driving module, the communication module, the pavement type identification module and a data processing system. The invention is provided with the pavement type recognition module, can be used for recognizing the pavement on which the unmanned scooter runs, and can control the unmanned scooter to work according to the recognition result of the pavement type recognition module.

title_en: SLAM-based unmanned aerial vehicle bridge-tunnel space crossing adsorption method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle bridge-tunnel space crossing adsorption method based on SLAM. The method comprises the steps of shooting an environment image by using a monocular camera when an unmanned aerial vehicle passes through a bridge and tunnel space, acquiring depth information by using a laser radar, carrying out initial pose resolving on the environment image to obtain an initialization map, correcting the initialization map through the depth information and resolving the initialization map into space points after the pose of the unmanned aerial vehicle is changed to obtain a dense map, correcting map construction errors of the dense map, carrying out plane clustering division to calibrate an adsorbable region, and controlling the unmanned aerial vehicle to be adsorbed on the adsorbable region when passing through the bridge and tunnel space so as to realize the passing through adsorption of the bridge and tunnel space of the unmanned aerial vehicle. According to the method, the adsorption area where the unmanned aerial vehicle can stop can be calibrated according to the environmental condition after SLAM mapping, map correction information is corrected through closed-loop similar scene detection, pose errors and coordinate point parameter errors of the unmanned aerial vehicle are accumulated, and accurate calibration of the stop position when the unmanned aerial vehicle passes through is achieved.

title_en: Traffic monitoring device and traffic monitoring system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a traffic monitoring device and a traffic monitoring system. Techniques related to collision avoidance in road traffic are improved. The traffic monitoring device of the present disclosure includes a communication section and a control section. The communication unit is configured to be capable of acquiring movement information related to movement of a plurality of mobile bodies including the vehicle, and is configured to be capable of communicating with the vehicle. The control unit sets an exclusive area around the mobile body based on the movement information, and generates a notification to be transmitted to the specific mobile body when the exclusive area around the specific mobile body overlaps with an exclusive area of a mobile body other than the specific mobile body.

title_en: Pipelined time grating displacement sensing signal processing system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a pipelined time grating displacement sensing signal processing system, which comprises a high-low frequency excitation signal generation module, a rough measurement module, a dynamic fine measurement ending position resolving module, a dynamic comparison circuit module, a fine measurement value selecting module and a displacement weighting calculating module; the high-low frequency excitation signal generating module generates measured high-low frequency excitation signals, the rough measurement module finishes first-stage displacement measurement through the high-frequency sensing signals, the dynamic fine measurement end position calculating module calculates a fine measurement end position, the dynamic comparison circuit module converts fine measurement end bit digital signals into analog signals to be compared with low-frequency sensing signals, the fine measurement module finishes second-stage displacement measurement, the fine measurement value selecting module selects proper values from fine measurement values to output, and the displacement weighting calculating module weights two-stage measurement results to obtain final displacement measurement values. By means of time delay-based module combination and pipeline level division, efficient collaborative work of each module is achieved, and efficient processing and accurate output of complex measurement tasks are guaranteed.

title_en: Multifunctional operating room environment control system based on Internet of things technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of environmental control, in particular to a multifunctional operating room environmental control system based on the Internet of things technology, which comprises an environmental control unit, an automatic control unit, a light automatic adjusting unit, a pattern matching unit, an air monitoring unit and an air purifying unit, and further comprises a voice acquisition unit, wherein the voice acquisition unit acquires voice of an operating room manager by arranging an audio acquisition device in a target area in an operating room so as to obtain environmental control voice, and preprocesses the environmental control voice so as to obtain standard environmental control voice, and transmits the standard environmental control voice to a voice recognition unit. The invention can respond to the instruction and the demand of the operating room manager in real time through voice acquisition and recognition, and automatically adjust the environmental parameters such as temperature, humidity and illumination so as to ensure the comfort and the safety in the operating room.

title_en: Automatic driving voice broadcasting method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an automatic driving voice broadcasting method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of initializing a system, loading a voice synthesis engine and an expert knowledge base, starting a tcp port, waiting for a tcp client to establish connection, receiving intelligent driving system information after establishing connection, carrying out reasoning analysis on the received intelligent driving system information by combining the expert knowledge base, judging whether voice broadcasting is needed, synthesizing the voice information through the voice synthesis engine if the voice broadcasting is needed, adjusting voice volume, voice speed and switching voice packets through a voice broadcasting device knob, and playing sound through in-car sound equipment and an out-car loudspeaker. According to the invention, through real-time in-car and out-car voice prompts, drivers and external traffic participants can better understand and adapt to the driving intention of the automatic driving vehicle, the trouble caused by unsmooth communication or misunderstanding is reduced, and the user experience is optimized.

title_en: Unknown key scene recognition method and system based on intersection scene space
abstract_en: The invention provides an unknown key scene recognition method and system based on an intersection scene space, and relates to the technical field of intelligent traffic. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a plurality of known key scenes in a scene space of an intersection, obtaining a plurality of known key scenes, wherein the known key scenes comprise at least one known risk factor, constructing a plurality of key scene subspaces, determining a first center, each key scene subspace comprises at least one known key scene, calculating an orthogonal base of the key scene subspace, taking the first center as the center, extracting an unknown key scene space in the key scene subspace along the direction of the orthogonal base, and sampling in the unknown key scene space to obtain an unknown key test scene set. The unknown key scene identified by the scheme is used for testing an automatic driving technology, so that the testing comprehensiveness can be improved.

title_en: Light-following type solar charging precious cabinet
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of solar charger cabinets and discloses a light-following type solar charger cabinet, which comprises a cabinet assembly, a light-following module, a solar panel and a light sensor, wherein the cabinet assembly is used for renting or returning a charger, the light sensor is arranged on the light-following module and is used for detecting and feeding back the illumination direction, the light-following module comprises a rotating seat and a swinging seat, the rotating seat is rotationally arranged along the circumference under the driving force, the swinging seat and the rotating seat are in up-down butt joint, the swinging seat is in swinging arrangement along the up-down direction under the driving force, and the solar panel is arranged on the swinging seat. Under the effect of light sensor, realize monitoring and feedback to illumination angle, the cooperation of rethread roating seat and swinging seat realizes adjusting solar panel's orientation angle, makes solar panel possess the function of following the spot, increases solar panel and solar illumination's contact time, improves solar panel's electric energy conversion volume, and the precious charge of guarantee charge possesses sufficient electric energy supply.

title_en: Flight simulation model and modeling method for variable-stability flight simulator
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flight simulation model and a modeling method for a variable stability flight simulator, comprising the following steps: the device comprises an interface control module, a variable pneumatic simulation module, a variable flight control simulation module, a physical characteristic simulation module and a six-degree-of-freedom motion simulation module. The interface control module defines external data to be received, the variable pneumatic simulation module establishes a pneumatic derivative interpolation table and a pneumatic coefficient expression according to the nonlinear pneumatic data packet, the pneumatic coefficient expression is reconstructed to stack the influence generated by externally configured pneumatic parameters into the pneumatic coefficient as an increment, the physical characteristic simulation module outputs the weight and inertia of the aircraft, the six-freedom-degree motion simulation module calculates the motion state of the aircraft, the variable flight control simulation module constructs flight control laws under different instruction types, and corresponding control laws and control gains are switched in real time according to external configuration. The double adjustment of aerodynamic parameters and flight control laws in the same flight simulation model is realized.

title_en: Control system, method, device, equipment and medium for automobile drive-by-wire chassis
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a control system, a method, a device, equipment and a medium of an automobile drive-by-wire chassis, wherein the system comprises a signal generation module, a signal processing module and a signal receiving module, wherein the signal processing module comprises a value domain mapping unit, a signal matching unit and a safety detecting unit, the value domain mapping unit is used for converting a physical operation signal into a control signal of a vehicle, the signal matching unit is used for matching a signal format of the control signal with a target signal format of a vehicle end and sending the successfully matched control signal to the safety detecting unit, the safety detecting unit is used for judging the safety of the control signal sent by the signal matching unit according to the current state information of the vehicle and sending the control signal conforming to the traffic safety rule to the signal receiving module, and the signal receiving module is used for controlling the vehicle chassis according to the received signal. By adopting the technical scheme, the problem of low testing efficiency of the chassis of the vehicle is solved.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle self-adaptation flight control system is patrolled and examined to electric power line
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of unmanned aerial vehicles, in particular to a self-adaptive flight control system of an unmanned aerial vehicle for power line inspection, which comprises a data acquisition module arranged on power equipment, a communication module, a sensing module, an unmanned aerial vehicle posture adjustment module and a central data processing module, wherein the data acquisition module is used for acquiring environmental parameters nearby the power equipment, the communication module is used for realizing signal communication between the unmanned aerial vehicle and the data acquisition module, the sensing module is used for acquiring the environmental parameters nearby the unmanned aerial vehicle, and the central data processing module is used for generating adjustment parameters and controlling each module of the unmanned aerial vehicle according to the adjustment parameters. According to the scheme, the current gesture of the unmanned aerial vehicle is acquired through the shooting unit, the unmanned aerial vehicle gesture is adjusted by combining the roll angle and the pitch angle acquired by the unmanned aerial vehicle, and the accuracy of the adjustment value of the unmanned aerial vehicle gesture is improved.

title_en: Financial payment terminal mode intelligent switching system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent switching system of a financial payment terminal mode, which comprises a mode switching device, a numerical comparison device and a numerical control device, wherein the mode switching device is arranged in the financial payment terminal and is used for controlling the financial payment terminal to enter a sleep mode from a payment mode when a first switching instruction is received and controlling the financial payment terminal to enter the payment mode from the sleep mode when a second switching instruction is received, and the numerical control device is used for intelligently analyzing whether an object existence mark of a near human object with a depth of view being less than a set depth of view threshold exists or not by adopting a deep neural network model based on various visual information. According to the invention, whether the object existence mark of the closer human object with the depth of view being less than the set depth of field threshold exists can be intelligently analyzed based on the visual data screened in each pertinence, and the mode switching of the financial payment terminal is executed based on the object existence mark, so that the financial payment terminal is awakened to enter the payment mode only when the closer human object exists at the front end of the financial payment terminal.

title_en: Online water quality change trend identification and early warning method, system, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water quality change trend online identification and early warning method, system, equipment and storage medium, comprising the steps of acquiring historical water quality data and identifying periodic and seasonal fluctuation of the historical water quality data; the method comprises the steps of constructing an offline model group, carrying out trend recognition, outputting a trend recognition result, carrying out normalization processing analysis on the trend recognition result to obtain a trend analysis result, comparing the trend analysis result with a trend reference result, optimizing the offline model group for recognizing the surface water quality trend, obtaining real-time water quality data, recognizing periodic and seasonal fluctuation of the data, carrying out qualitative analysis on the water quality change trend, carrying out quantitative analysis on the water quality change trend by using the optimized offline model group to obtain a trend change index of each model, calculating according to the trend change index of each model to obtain a comprehensive water quality change index, quantifying the water quality change trend grade and generating corresponding early warning information. The invention can remarkably improve the real-time performance, accuracy and stability of water quality trend identification.

title_en: Immersive wind power generation equipment virtual reality simulation training system
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of intelligent training, and particularly discloses an immersive virtual reality simulation training system of wind power generation equipment, which is characterized in that a simulation training monitoring camera arranged on an immersive VR helmet worn by a student is used for collecting training operation action videos of the student, a video image analysis and processing technology based on artificial intelligence is adopted for carrying out key frame sampling on the training operation action videos, real operation training action semantic features and each historical training action semantic feature are extracted from the training operation action videos, and then each historical training action semantic feature is subjected to prompt gating dynamic aggregation, so that whether training operation errors exist or not is automatically judged according to semantic measurement values between training action semantic time sequence aggregation features and the real operation training action semantic features, and corresponding early warning and correct videos are generated. Thus, correct operation demonstration video can be provided, so that training effect and interactivity and interestingness are improved.

title_en: Prioritization system for alarms and notifications in a first responder equipment
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) associated with a first responder and including processing circuitry. The processing circuit is configured to store a prioritization map, receive a first alert, determine a first prioritization parameter for the first alert based on the prioritization map, determine a user interface modality for the first alert based on the first prioritization parameter, and communicate the first alert to the first responder via the user interface modality.

title_en: Configuration generation method and device of unmanned aerial vehicle cleaning system and unmanned aerial vehicle cleaning system
abstract_en: The application discloses a configuration generation method and device of an unmanned aerial vehicle cleaning system and the unmanned aerial vehicle cleaning system, and relates to the technical field of light Fu Yun D, comprising the steps of converting injection parameters of the unmanned aerial vehicle cleaning device into model simulation data according to an injection network model; the method comprises the steps of obtaining fitting parameters, fitting model simulation data and generating fitting result data, wherein the fitting parameters comprise cleaning information of a target power station, feeding parameters of a pressure source and operation condition parameters of an unmanned aerial vehicle cleaning device, generating operation constraint conditions of the unmanned aerial vehicle cleaning device according to the operation condition parameters of the unmanned aerial vehicle cleaning device and time constraint conditions of the unmanned aerial vehicle cleaning device, and generating configuration parameters of an unmanned aerial vehicle cleaning system according to the fitting result data and the operation constraint conditions. The configuration parameters of the unmanned aerial vehicle cleaning system can be obtained by utilizing simulation results corresponding to the situation that the interval distance range between the unmanned aerial vehicle cleaning device and the photovoltaic module is larger than the interval distance range between the unmanned aerial vehicle cleaning device and the photovoltaic module at present.

title_en: Data acquisition and control method for old equipment on complex equipment production site based on non-invasive automation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data acquisition and control method of old equipment on a production site of complex equipment based on non-invasive automation, which comprises the steps of selecting the types and the numbers of sensors according to the structure, the functions and the operation modes of objects to be acquired and controlled, selecting a non-invasive automation frame, connecting corresponding hardware and non-invasive software modules to the objects to be acquired and controlled on the site according to the structure and the form corresponding to the selected non-invasive frame to form acquisition and control equipment based on the non-invasive frame, performing parameter adjustment on the acquisition and control equipment to obtain acquisition target data and data corresponding to the control, identifying or predicting the sensors for acquiring the target data, performing automatic data acquisition and automatic parameter control on the acquisition and control equipment, and feeding back and recording the results of automatic data acquisition and automatic parameter control. The invention does not need to carry out structural change or shutdown operation on old equipment, thereby ensuring the continuity of production.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle autonomous inspection processing method and system based on network distribution overhead line equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle autonomous inspection processing method and system based on a network distribution overhead line device, and belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle inspection. According to the method, the laser point cloud inspection information set and the inspection route record of the target unmanned aerial vehicle are firstly obtained, point cloud element identification branches in the inspection dispatching processing network are used for generating target inspection point cloud element knowledge, and the line intersection information among unmanned aerial vehicles is considered, so that inspection safety is improved. The line optimization decision branch combines the target inspection point cloud element knowledge and the inspection route record to generate target route planning suggestion characteristics, and flight safety, inspection efficiency and equipment coverage degree are ensured by combining multiple factors. And the route clustering processing branch clusters the suggested characteristics of the target route planning, and finally determines the unmanned aerial vehicle routing planning cluster according to routing energy efficiency discrimination weight of a clustering result, and combines a ball query safety verification technology to improve routing efficiency and reduce safety accidents.

title_en: Blood storage environment supervision method and system suitable for blood internal medicine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a blood storage environment supervision method and a system suitable for blood medicine, which relate to the field of biological sample storage environment supervision and are used for solving the problems that cells are irreversibly damaged due to thawing and washing, the quality of blood bags is reduced and resource waste is caused, obtaining the similarity of a historical blood bag and a red blood cell blood bag by analyzing the similarity of the newly obtained red blood cell blood bag and the historical blood bag, counting to obtain the ice crystal ratio of the historical blood bag, obtaining the probability of forming ice crystals of the newly obtained red blood bag based on Bayesian inference according to the ratio and the factor ratio thereof, carrying out weighted average calculation according to the newly obtained red blood bag factors to obtain the glycerol concentration of the newly obtained red blood bag which needs to be thawed, analyzing the interaction with an anticoagulant and a protective solution, bringing into fuzzy logic to determine the optimal concentration result of the anticoagulant and the protective solution, budgeting the probability of forming the ice crystals in advance and reducing the damage of red blood cells and the medical resource waste.

title_en: Material transportation control method and material transportation control system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a material transportation control method and a material transportation control system, and belongs to the field of automatic control. The control method comprises the steps of constructing a plurality of transport flows corresponding to the material transport production lines, determining a first target transport flow corresponding to a control instruction according to the control instruction, determining a discharging equipment label, a conveyor label, a blanking port label and a downstream equipment label corresponding to the blanking port corresponding to the first target transport flow, initializing the discharging equipment, the conveyor and the downstream equipment corresponding to the blanking port corresponding to the first target transport flow, sequentially starting the discharging equipment, the conveyor, the blanking port and the downstream equipment corresponding to the blanking port corresponding to the first target transport flow according to a set material flow direction, and controlling the running direction of the conveyor according to the blanking port corresponding to the first target transport flow. The invention reduces the probability of easy error of manual operation and simultaneously ensures that the material transportation production line is more automatic.

title_en: Middle-aged and elderly people group health monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention provides a health monitoring system for middle-aged and elderly people, which comprises a multifunctional emergency call device, a health monitoring blanket, a sleep sign monitoring device and a falling alarm device, wherein the health monitoring blanket collects pressure values, heartbeat frequencies and respiratory frequencies on the health monitoring blanket, the multifunctional emergency call device generates alarm information to be sent to a guardian and an emergency center when judging that the heartbeat frequencies and the respiratory frequencies exceed preset thresholds, the sleep sign monitoring device acquires the heartbeat frequencies, the respiratory frequencies and movement data of the person, generates alarm information to be sent to the guardian and the emergency center, the falling alarm device acquires decibel values and human posture data generated by the person in a monitoring area, the falling alarm device judges that the person falls according to the human posture data, and meanwhile, the alarm information is generated to be sent to the guardian and the emergency center when the change amplitude of the decibel values is larger than the preset thresholds. The invention can realize effective monitoring for the solitary old people so as to solve the problem of treatment of the emergency of the old people.

title_en: Drilling floor wellhead safety early warning device and early warning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a drill floor wellhead safety early warning device, which comprises a high-definition network camera, wherein the high-definition network camera is connected with an edge box through a signal wire, the edge box is connected with a drilling machine control system through the signal wire, and the drilling machine control system is connected with a drilling machine lifting system and an early warning module through the signal wire.

title_en: Intelligent driving test system based on V2X
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent driving test system based on V2X, which relates to the technical field of intelligent driving and comprises a V2X information simulation unit, an intelligent driving vehicle test platform, a data acquisition and analysis unit and a test scene construction unit, wherein the V2X information simulation unit comprises a vehicle driving state information module and an infrastructure information module, the unit can simulate various V2X communication information, and the unit can generate diversified V2X information packets according to preset rules and scene requirements and send the diversified V2X information packets to the intelligent driving vehicle test platform through a wireless communication module. The intelligent driving vehicle test platform has a comprehensive V2X scene simulation effect, can simulate various V2X communication scenes, provides a more real and comprehensive test environment for an intelligent driving system, adopts a vacuum chuck adsorption fixing mode to perform fixed installation, is not easy to damage a test vehicle compared with a traditional punching installation mode, and is more convenient and faster to install.

title_en: Vehicle wake-up method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vehicle awakening method, which comprises the steps of a, collecting vehicle-exterior sound waves by an external microphone, sending awakening sound waves to a vehicle, b, judging whether sound wave information in the awakening sound waves is registered sound wave information, if yes, executing a step c, otherwise, neglecting the awakening sound waves, c, judging whether the awakening sound waves come from one side of a vehicle driving seat, if yes, executing a step d, otherwise, neglecting the awakening sound waves, d, judging whether a camera at one side of the vehicle driving seat collects head image information of a person sending the awakening sound waves, if yes, comparing the collected head image information with image information of a registered driver, if the comparison is successful, controlling the vehicle awakening, otherwise, executing the step e and the like. The method of the invention can realize the wake-up operation of the vehicle under the condition of weak or no network signal, thereby controlling the vehicle.

title_en: Automatic allocation of PLC module address and automatic uploading method of module parameters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for automatically distributing addresses of PLC modules and automatically uploading parameters of the modules, which relates to the technical field of industrial control and communication, and comprises the steps of firstly, collecting analog quantity, secondly, automatically distributing addresses, thirdly, automatically uploading parameters of the modules, realizing the collection of the analog quantity based on N PIN PINs of a connector, and then realize the automatic distribution of module address, send the module information to the main control module through the mode of broadcasting and realize the automatic uploading of module information, realize the hot plug of module through the circuit simultaneously, reduced the complexity of code, improved the utilization ratio of hardware resource, and then improved the stability and the simplicity of operation of PLC system.

title_en: Parking space identification and parking guidance method and system for underground parking garage
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for identifying parking spaces and guiding parking in an underground parking lot, wherein each lattice point is collected in a preset sampling time by carrying out lattice treatment on an underground parking lot area And determining the parking spaces in the underground parking region based on the same height change information of all the lattice points in the parking spaces, and rapidly and effectively identifying the parking spaces in the underground parking region under the condition of not being interfered by light. In addition, the method and the system calculate the congestion parameters of each parking space, select the optimal parking space with the smallest congestion based on the channel congestion parameters, and automatically guide the user to drive the vehicle into the parking space, so that the congestion of the underground parking lot can be effectively relieved.

title_en: Cooperative control method and device for renewable energy source water electrolysis hydrogen production and ammonia synthesis system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a cooperative control method and a device of a renewable energy source water electrolysis hydrogen production and ammonia synthesis system, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining corresponding full-day multi-period simulated hydrogen production power and full-day multi-period simulated ammonia production power according to the corresponding predicted power of a target renewable energy source water electrolysis hydrogen production and ammonia synthesis system; the method comprises the steps of monitoring a target renewable energy source water electrolysis hydrogen production synthetic ammonia system in real time to determine corresponding real-time power generation power and real-time hydrogen storage quantity, performing real-time correction adjustment on full-time multi-period simulated hydrogen production power according to the real-time power generation power to determine full-time multi-period real-time hydrogen production power, performing real-time correction adjustment on full-time multi-period simulated ammonia production power according to the real-time hydrogen storage quantity, and determining full-time multi-period real-time ammonia production power. According to the embodiment of the disclosure, the multi-time-scale cooperative control optimization of the renewable energy water electrolysis hydrogen production ammonia synthesis system can be realized, the disposal rate of renewable energy sources is reduced, and the energy utilization rate, the system benefit and the system stability are improved.

title_en: Kitchen fire hidden danger intelligent processing system
abstract_en: The application discloses an intelligent processing system for kitchen fire hazards, which relates to the technical field of intelligent home furnishing and comprises a multi-sensor module, an intelligent data analysis module and an automatic control module, wherein the multi-sensor module is used for acquiring kitchen environment parameters, the intelligent data analysis module is used for determining whether abnormal conditions exist according to the kitchen environment parameters, the automatic control module is connected with a gas main valve, and the automatic control module closes the gas main valve when abnormal conditions exist.

title_en: Model spine positioning device for anesthesia practice
abstract_en: The application relates to a model spine positioning device for anesthesia exercise, which relates to the technical field of medical anesthesia exercise equipment and comprises an operation table, a first clamping disk, a second clamping disk, a spine body, a clamping assembly, a disassembling assembly and an adjusting assembly, wherein the first clamping disk is rotationally connected to the operation table through a bracket; the clamping device comprises a clamping disc I, a clamping disc II, a plurality of spine bodies, two groups of clamping assemblies, a disassembling assembly and an adjusting assembly, wherein the clamping disc I is arranged opposite to the clamping disc I, the clamping disc II is connected to an operation table in a rotating mode, the spine bodies are arranged in a plurality of mode around the axis direction of the clamping disc I, two ends of the spine bodies are connected with the clamping disc I and the clamping disc II respectively, the clamping assemblies are arranged in two groups, the two groups of clamping assemblies are located on the clamping disc I and the clamping disc II respectively and used for quickly fixing and disassembling the spine bodies, the disassembling assembly is arranged on the clamping disc II and used for adjusting the distance between the clamping disc I and the clamping disc II, and the adjusting assembly is arranged on the clamping disc II and used for selecting different spine bodies. The application has the effect of improving the replacement efficiency of the spine model.

title_en: Electric drive control system, method, unmanned aerial vehicle, and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides an electric drive control system, an electric drive control method, an unmanned aerial vehicle and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of electric drive control. The system comprises a flight control unit, a voltage division unit, a next voltage division unit and an electric drive unit, wherein the flight control unit is used for sending an initial electric drive control signal to the voltage division unit in an electric drive control system connected with the flight control unit, the voltage division unit is used for dividing the initial electric drive control signal or the electric drive control signal sent by the previous voltage division unit, the divided electric drive control signal is respectively sent to the next voltage division unit connected with the voltage division unit and the electric drive unit connected with the voltage division unit, the corresponding electric drive unit is used for determining a corresponding target code from a plurality of codes based on the received amplitude of the divided electric drive control signal, driving electric drive corresponding to the target code based on target electric drive control software, and the plurality of codes correspond to target electric drive control software. The application can normally drive the electric drive corresponding to the target code based on the preset target electric drive control software.

title_en: Lifting traffic signal lamp
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lifting traffic signal lamp, which relates to the technical field of traffic signal lamps, wherein a driving source is arranged to drive a shading component to lift, the light of the signal lamp is not obvious enough due to irradiation of sunlight during daytime, the driving source is used to drive the shading component to lift, sunlight is shielded through the arrangement of shading cloth and shading pieces in the shading component, the sunlight is prevented from being directly irradiated on the signal lamp, a driver can clearly and intuitively check a light instruction made by the traffic signal lamp, the signal lamp can move downwards to reset during night, three signal lamps are close to each other, the attention of the driver is not as good as that of the driver concentrated during daytime, and the three signal lamps can be wiped during reset, so that dust accumulation on the three signal lamps is prevented from affecting the bright display of the signal lamp.

title_en: Thermal power plant personnel safety early warning method and system based on image recognition
abstract_en: The invention provides a thermal power plant personnel safety early warning method and system based on image recognition, wherein the basic information and historical skill training data, the number of violations and the number of accidents of personnel are used for calculating the safety scores of the personnel through a personnel scoring module, an image dangerous recognition model is established through an image recognition construction module and trained, the personnel early warning module classifies the behavior dangerous grades according to the number of violations, the working time and the safety scores of the personnel, the environmental early warning module classifies the equipment safety grades according to the number of abnormal types of each equipment by acquiring equipment operation parameters, the environmental dangerous grades are classified by acquiring historical environment data in each area of a power plant, a dangerous recognition model is established through an early warning prediction module, dangerous accidents are predicted according to the behavior dangerous grades, the equipment safety grades and the environmental dangerous grades, and early warning is performed according to a prediction result.

title_en: Traffic prediction method based on multi-graph gating convolution and Conv-LSTM
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of traffic transportation, and particularly relates to a traffic prediction method based on multi-graph gating convolution and Conv-LSTM, wherein similarity between time sequences is calculated through a DTWN similarity value filling module, and K data average values with higher similarity are taken for filling deletion, so that the integrity of traffic data is ensured. Traffic data is decomposed by DWT and divided into approximation coefficients and detail coefficients. The approximation coefficients reflect long-term trends in traffic flow, while the detail coefficients contain short-term fluctuation information, and the data obtained by DWT are processed by combining different models. Short term fluctuations are captured by processing detail coefficients through a multi-graph gating hole convolution MGDCN, and long term trends are captured by processing approximation coefficients through Conv-LSTM. Compared with the existing traffic prediction model, the method can fully fill up missing data, capture short-term fluctuation and long-term trend of traffic, effectively reduce errors in traffic prediction and improve traffic prediction accuracy.

title_en: Air-ground collaborative autonomous exploration method and system in large-scale unknown environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an air-ground collaborative autonomous exploration method and system under a large-scale unknown environment, wherein the method comprises the steps of firstly constructing a bird's-eye view and a coverage exploration strategy aiming at the bird's-eye view to perform autonomous exploration of an air robot; and finally, refining the track of the ground robot according to a map of 2D ESDF to finish the space-ground collaborative autonomous exploration. The embodiment of the invention can rapidly cover Gao Chanou domains for efficient exploration and can be widely applied to the technical field of computers.

title_en: Method for selecting a part to be placed on a sheet
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for selecting parts to be placed on a sheet using a computer, comprising the steps of I) encoding the geometrical features of each part in a respective geometrical information vector, wherein for each part one of the geometrical features is the projected area of the part in a plan view, II) generating a graph, the geometrical features of each part being assigned to one node of the graph at a time, all nodes being connected in pairs by one edge at a time, the method comprising the further step of XIV) estimating for all pairs of parts a parameter GCI, each GCI being a measure of how well the pair of parts can be placed on the same sheet, XV) assigning each GCI to a respective edge of the graph, the respective edge passing through two nodes representing the parts to which the respective GCI is assigned, XVI) determining the weights of the edges of the graph, each edge weight depending on the GCI associated with the edge, XVII) assigning the respective part to the sheet to which the respective sub-graph is projected area of the respective part is equal to the projected area of the sheet to which the respective part is placed on the sheet by determining said nodes of the graph by means of an optimization method.

title_en: Shooting simulation auxiliary equipment for electric power inspection unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses shooting simulation auxiliary equipment for an electric power inspection unmanned aerial vehicle, which relates to the technical field of electric power inspection and comprises a simulation room body, wherein a first adjusting mechanism and a second adjusting mechanism are arranged in the simulation room body, a control table is arranged at the top of the first adjusting mechanism, a seat is arranged at the top of the second adjusting mechanism, three blowing mechanisms are arranged on the inner side of the simulation room body, the first adjusting mechanism comprises a fixed seat, the fixed seat is fixedly connected in the simulation room body, an empty groove is formed in the fixed seat, a rotating rod is connected in the empty groove in a rotating mode, a gear is fixedly sleeved on the outer surface of the rotating rod, and a movable rod is arranged in the empty groove. This a shoot emulation auxiliary assembly for electric power inspection unmanned aerial vehicle plays the effect of adjusting the height of controlling the platform through setting up first adjustment mechanism, has improved application scope, has solved among the prior art, can't carry out the problem of adaptability to operating personnel's height.

title_en: AGV trolley positioning and docking method
abstract_en: The invention provides a positioning and butting method for an AGV trolley, wherein reflecting plates are arranged on two sides in front of a machine table, the length of the machine table is preset to be c, the width of the machine table is set to be d, two-dimensional codes are arranged at the center position of the bottom of the machine table, the distance between the center points of the two-dimensional codes is directly determined through conversion of different coordinate systems to realize positioning, and the AGV trolley runs into the bottom of the machine table from the middle position of the reflecting plates to realize code scanning and butting, so that the AGV trolley can accurately run to the lower side of the machine table to realize code scanning and butting, and the method is simple and reliable.

title_en: Hot runner temperature control system capable of identifying thermocouple and heater
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of hot runner temperature control, and discloses a hot runner temperature control system capable of identifying a thermocouple and a heater. During operation, the load first generates a first power source. The first power signal is compared with standard data pre-stored in the MCU control circuit to obtain a first comparison result. The MCU control circuit controls the relay to realize the conversion of the positive end and the negative end of the load, so that the load generates second starting power again and forms a second starting power signal through the processing of the operational amplifier circuit. The signal is also compared with standard data to obtain a second comparison result. Finally, whether the load is a thermocouple or a heater is determined based on the two comparison results. Here, the operational amplifier is adaptively adjusted in gain based on the signal characteristics of the first power to ensure that the signal is neither saturated with too high a gain nor lost due to insufficient gain.

title_en: Method, device and system for carrying out identity recognition by extracting bone characteristics through finger joint knock
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method, a device and a system for carrying out identity recognition by extracting bone features through knuckle knocking, wherein the method comprises the following steps of 1) sound collection, 2) pretreatment, namely preprocessing operation, of collected sound, 3) feature extraction, 4) model training, namely model training of extracted feature vectors, adopting a supervised learning algorithm, 5) classification recognition, namely establishing bone feature parameters and user identity, classifying the extracted bone features by adopting a trained model, and outputting a user identity verification result, 6) database and model updating, namely storing bone feature templates and model parameters of a user, and supporting offline updating and dynamic expansion, and 7) practical application. According to the invention, through the characteristic that the sound signal generated when the finger joint is knocked out is highly correlated with the individual skeleton feature, the identity authentication with high accuracy, privacy safety and wide environmental adaptability is realized.

title_en: Equipment control method and device, product assembly equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a device control method, a device, a product assembling device and a storage medium, wherein the product assembling device comprises a product assembling unit, a fitting cutting unit and a fitting conveying unit, the embodiment of the application introduces an electronic cam curve in the running process of the product assembling device, can accurately control the product assembling unit, the fitting cutting unit and the fitting conveying unit in the product assembling device, the matching degree among the units is improved, the processes of placing accessories, buckling covers and the like in the production process are accurately realized, meanwhile, the accuracy of the buckling covers is improved, the qualification rate of products and the production efficiency of the products are improved, and the technical problem that the production efficiency of the products of product assembly equipment in the prior art is low is solved.

title_en: Intelligent water affair system and intelligent control method applied to same
abstract_en: The application provides an intelligent water system and an intelligent control method applied to the intelligent water system, which belong to the field of intelligent water and are used for solving the problem that the aeration air quantity of an aerator in an aerobic tank is difficult to control accurately in the sewage treatment process in the related technology, the method is characterized in that the adjustment quantity of the aeration air quantity and the application time of the adjusted aeration air quantity are intelligently analyzed based on the water quantity, the water temperature, the dissolved oxygen quantity, the internal reflux quantity, the external reflux quantity, the water quality index and the aeration air quantity of the aerobic tank in a preset number of unit time periods before the current moment, so that the adjusted aeration air quantity meets the actual requirements of sewage treatment, and whether the aeration air quantity needs to be adjusted is not needed to be judged in real time, the accurate control of the aeration air quantity in the aerobic tank in the sewage treatment process is realized, and the water quality after the treatment is guaranteed to reach the standard.

title_en: Design method of safety control system, safety control system and electric forklift
abstract_en: The invention discloses a design method of a safety control system, the safety control system and an electric forklift, and belongs to the technical field of electric forklift safety control systems, wherein the safety control system comprises all main systems, sub systems, safety components and safety logic involved from the start of safety input to the generation of safety output; the sensor, switch, power supply, controller, operating handle, motor encoder and accelerator pedal related to the safety control system need to meet the average dangerous failure frequency of the specified safety function, the PLr grade needed to be met is higher than the PLr grade needed by the system, and the related safety logic is developed by a V-model design method; when the safety control system fails, the system is put into a safe controllable mode, so that injury to human bodies and property is avoided, and risk is reduced to a certain extent. The invention has the advantage of facilitating the design of the safety control system meeting the performance level required by the safety requirement.

title_en: Gateway table sampling diagnosis method based on bus balance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gateway table sampling diagnosis method based on bus balance, which relates to the technical field of gateway table diagnosis and comprises the following steps that a connection circuit of a gateway table terminal is connected with a bus wiring unit; the method comprises the steps of recording threshold data of a gateway table terminal and bus use pressure through a data sampling unit, transmitting detection data to a data processing diagnosis unit through a data transmission unit for processing, and transmitting command information generated by the data processing diagnosis unit through a command output unit. The data sampling unit is connected with the plurality of groups of bus wiring units, so that when the data sampling unit collects data of different gateway table terminals, the data sampling unit can collect data, and when the data processing diagnosis unit diagnoses different gateway table terminals and bus data, the data processing diagnosis unit can calculate bus balance abnormal conditions of the gateway table more accurately.

title_en: Unpowered return field forced landing control method for aircraft
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unpowered return field forced landing control method of an aircraft, which belongs to the field of aircraft flight control, and adopts a three-dimensional route collaborative design scheme, optimizes a horizontal plane route through a Du Binsi curve four-section route, combines a plumb plane slope allowance design, remarkably improves the route planning capability in a complex environment, dynamically adjusts lift-drag ratio and segmented throttle control by a spoiler, effectively inhibits speed dispersion caused by model deviation, and remarkably improves complex scene adaptability, model robustness and economy while guaranteeing forced landing safety, thereby providing a high-efficiency solution for unpowered forced landing.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle path planning method for minimizing information age assisted by unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle-assisted information age-minimized unmanned aerial vehicle path planning method, which belongs to the technical field of multi-unmanned aerial vehicle system tasks and comprises the steps of constructing a perception scene, constructing a state space, an action space, a state transfer function and a reward function in deep reinforcement learning based on the perception scene, acquiring a current state, acquiring an optimal unmanned aerial vehicle action based on the current state and an unmanned aerial vehicle flight path planning model, executing the optimal unmanned aerial vehicle action based on a charging module, storing experience, repeatedly acquiring the optimal action of the current state until the maximum number of steps is reached or a preset perception task is completed, and training the unmanned aerial vehicle flight path planning model based on the stored experience. According to the unmanned aerial vehicle charging system, the unmanned aerial vehicle is timely supplemented with energy by utilizing the active movement of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and the unmanned aerial vehicle charging waiting time is reduced. The invention can minimize the information age of the data in the scene of dynamic arrival of the data and simultaneously maximize the task completion rate and the data collection fairness.

title_en: Fire-fighting early warning system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a fire-fighting early warning system and a fire-fighting early warning method, which belong to the technical field of fire protection, wherein the fire-fighting early warning system comprises a fire extinguisher, a detector, a controller, an audible and visual alarm and a controller, wherein the controller is mechanically connected with the fire extinguisher and is in communication connection with the detector, and is used for receiving fire-fighting area monitoring data sent by the detector, obtaining fire levels of the fire-fighting areas based on the fire-fighting area monitoring data, generating fire-fighting instructions based on the fire levels, starting fire-fighting bottles corresponding to the fire levels based on the fire-fighting instructions to spray and extinguish the fire, and the audible and visual alarm is in communication connection with the controller and is used for sending corresponding audible and visual alarm signals based on the fire levels. According to the fire-fighting early warning system provided by the invention, the detector, the controller and the audible and visual alarm are integrated into one system, so that the high concentration of system components is realized, and the fire extinguisher and the audible and visual alarm can be controlled based on the controller to extinguish the fire and send out alarm information at the first time when the detector detects the fire.

title_en: Dog training device electric pulse regulation and control system based on pet behaviors
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of behavior feedback control, in particular to a dog training device electric pulse regulation and control system based on pet behaviors. According to the invention, based on the monitoring of the contact resistance value of the electric pulse electrode, the skin conductivity and the transmission loss of the electric pulse signal, the signal transmission path is dynamically adjusted, the stimulation triggering rhythm is adjusted according to the response time delay of the behavior of the pet, the electric pulse output voltage is synchronously optimized, the current density distribution is balanced, the discomfort of local over-strong stimulation is reduced, the progressive mode of vibration, sound and electric pulse stimulation is optimized in combination with the current stimulation mode and behavior adjustment state, the electric pulse signal transmission loss is analyzed, the signal channel is dynamically adjusted according to the skin conductivity and the muscle tissue resistance, the signal attenuation caused by the contact change of the electrode is reduced, and the signal interruption risk in the training process is reduced.

title_en: Teaching management method and system based on VR
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of teaching and discloses a teaching management method and a management system based on VR, wherein the teaching management method comprises the steps that a VR interaction module receives interaction information, student learning behavior data is obtained according to student personal information in the interaction information, student learning preference information is obtained according to the student learning behavior data, a cloud teaching server generates a student learning container, the student learning container is matched with a student category portrait according to the student personal information and is sent to the student learning container, a teaching mode is determined by the cloud teaching server according to the student learning preference information, a teaching recommendation generation module generates a recommendation scheme according to teaching recommendation sequence information and corresponding teaching resource weight information and is sent to a VR interaction module, and the VR interaction module carries out display page division according to the recommendation scheme to carry out teaching recommendation display. According to the invention, the teaching mode and the teaching content can be dynamically adjusted according to the individual difference and the learning preference of students, customized teaching recommendation is provided, and personalized teaching is realized.

title_en: Rail robot obstacle avoidance method and device, rail robot and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a track robot obstacle avoidance method, a track robot obstacle avoidance device, a track robot and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps that the track robot determines first obstacle information according to a preset safe obstacle avoidance area and TOF data of the track robot. And then, determining the minimum value of the stopping distance and the preset detection distance of the track robot as a first distance, and determining the maximum value of the stopping distance and the preset distance of the track robot as a second distance. Then, second obstacle information is determined from the ultrasonic data, the first distance, and the second distance. And finally, determining the credible type of each obstacle according to the first obstacle information, the second obstacle information, the first field angle of the TOF sensor and the second field angle of the ultrasonic sensor, and controlling the track robot to run according to the credible type of each obstacle. According to the technical scheme, the false detection rate of the sensor can be reduced, and the control accuracy of the track robot is improved.

title_en: Self-adaptive photovoltaic tracking control method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-adaptive photovoltaic tracking control method and a system, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting and fusing multi-source data, detecting the running environment of a photovoltaic system in real time, and processing the collected environment data in real time; the method comprises the steps of constructing a self-adaptive photovoltaic tracking control model, training the self-adaptive photovoltaic tracking control model, dynamically adjusting a tracking strategy of a photovoltaic panel according to historical data and real-time environmental changes, introducing a dynamic error compensation mechanism, correcting errors of a tracking system in real time, designing a multi-target optimization strategy, and automatically switching the tracking mode according to different environmental conditions. The system comprises a multi-source data acquisition module, a photovoltaic tracking control module and a tracking mode switching module. The method improves the accuracy and efficiency of operation monitoring of the photovoltaic system, provides high-quality data input for the photovoltaic tracking control model, is beneficial to improving the decision making capability of the model, realizes the intellectualization and automation of the photovoltaic panel tracking strategy, and improves the power generation efficiency of the photovoltaic system.

title_en: Temperature control method, device, system and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a temperature control method, a temperature control device, a temperature control system and a readable storage medium. The temperature control method comprises the steps of obtaining real-time temperature and target temperature of controlled equipment, determining a temperature difference level according to the temperature difference of the real-time temperature and the target temperature, determining limiting power according to the temperature difference and the target temperature, determining whether PID adjustment is needed according to the temperature difference level, performing PID adjustment according to the temperature difference and obtaining a PID adjustment result when the PID adjustment is needed, determining output power according to the PID adjustment result, and controlling the temperature of the controlled equipment according to the output power and the limiting power. The application can effectively prevent the influence caused by heating hysteresis by increasing the limiting power, and can realize high-precision temperature control by determining whether PID adjustment is needed or not through temperature difference grading.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle non-bus simulation excitation method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of avionics, and provides a non-bus simulation excitation method of an unmanned aerial vehicle, which writes dynamic simulation excitation into a file with a specific format and stores the file, a non-bus signal simulation module reads data from the file, and the data is issued to a buffer memory of the module hardware, and the module hardware sends the data to each non-bus signal sensor one by one according to a time sequence set in the dynamic simulation excitation until the data is emptied, so that the verification of the data dynamic sending function is performed. The excitation method based on dynamic signal simulation can improve the verification depth and breadth of a certain unmanned aerial vehicle, improve the reliability and stability of airborne products, and improve the development level of test equipment.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted black box data protection system and method
abstract_en: The application discloses a vehicle-mounted black box data protection system and method, and belongs to the technical field of automobile electronics and intelligent transportation. The system realizes high reliability, adopts a protective shell made of aviation-grade materials, ensures data integrity of equipment in extreme environments, realizes multi-dimensional data acquisition and integration, realizes multi-dimensional and multi-source data integration processing through the cooperative work of a signal conditioning circuit, an A/D converter and an FPGA, realizes independence and transparency, provides independent data output support of a third party through a wireless channel and various physical interfaces, solves the problem that the existing system cannot provide independent evidence, realizes efficient transmission and storage, ensures data safety, and simultaneously supports various transmission modes to rapidly derive data. The system not only improves the reliability and independence of vehicle-mounted data record, but also provides powerful accident judgment support for the fields of unmanned automobiles and low-altitude aircrafts.

title_en: Intelligent regulation and control system of vehicle bottom detection robot
