abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent regulation and control system of a vehicle bottom detection robot, which relates to the technical field of vehicle bottom detection, and comprises a data acquisition module, a data analysis module and a path planning module, wherein the data acquisition module is configured to acquire all-round data information of a vehicle bottom of a target, the data information at least comprises position information of the vehicle bottom target, interval information among different vehicle bottom targets and profile information of the vehicle bottom target, the data analysis module is connected with the data acquisition module and is configured to execute deep analysis on acquired data and identify the type, position, shape and size characteristics of each target of the vehicle bottom, and the path planning module is combined with an optimized moving path generated by the distribution condition and parameter condition of the vehicle bottom target to be detected.

title_en: Efficient bolt tightening process planning method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of docking assembly of aviation/aerospace engines, and particularly relates to a high-efficiency bolt tightening process planning method. The method comprises the steps of 1) converting bolt tightening sequences of discrete space into continuous time domain space, 2) taking time domain as input, carrying out Latin hypercube few sample sampling, 3) carrying out finite element calculation of different tightening sequences based on sampling results to obtain residual pre-tightening force of each bolt, calculating mean value and variance of the residual pre-tightening force, 4) taking continuous time domain as input, taking the mean value and variance of the residual pre-tightening force as output, constructing a time domain proxy model based on a Kriging proxy model, 5) constructing an optimization model based on the time domain proxy model, carrying out bolt tightening process planning by using an optimization algorithm to obtain optimal time domain variables, and converting the time domain variables into the bolt tightening sequences to obtain the optimal bolt tightening sequences.

title_en: Sizing system and concentration control method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to a sizing system and a concentration control method of the sizing system, which relate to the technical field of fiber strand production, wherein the sizing system comprises a sizing tank, a sizing device and a sizing device, wherein the sizing tank is used for accommodating sizing liquid; the device comprises a sizing tank, a liquid level detection device, a concentration adjustment device and a controller, wherein the sizing tank is used for storing sizing liquid in the sizing tank, the liquid level detection device is used for detecting the sizing liquid level in the sizing tank and converting the sizing liquid level into a liquid level signal, the concentration detection device is used for detecting the sizing liquid concentration in the sizing tank and converting the sizing liquid concentration into a concentration signal, the concentration adjustment device is used for introducing a concentrated glue, sizing liquid or solvent into the sizing tank so as to adjust the sizing liquid concentration in the sizing tank, and the controller is configured to receive the liquid level signal and the concentration signal and control the concentration adjustment device to introduce the concentrated glue, sizing liquid or solvent into the sizing tank according to the preset concentration of sizing liquid, the sizing liquid concentration and the sizing liquid level, so that the control precision of the sizing liquid concentration is improved, and the stability of a sizing process is ensured.

title_en: Automatic control system of alkali shrinking machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of mechanical engineering, and discloses an automatic control system of an alkali compressor, which comprises the following components: the device comprises an alkali liquor concentration analysis module, a product state analysis module, a parameter optimization module, a product washing module and a fulling control module. The method comprises the steps of constructing a material identification module of an alkali shrink machine, identifying the type of a material of the alkali shrink machine corresponding to a product to be processed, adjusting the alkali concentration of the alkali shrink machine, determining initial process parameters of the alkali shrink machine, constructing a process monitoring module of the alkali shrink machine, collecting real-time process data of the alkali shrink machine, analyzing the product state of the product to be processed, identifying abnormal factors of the alkali shrink machine, adjusting the initial process parameters, analyzing the adjusted product state of the product to be processed, outputting the alkali treated product of the alkali shrink machine, determining the water-washing exchange material of the alkali treated product, analyzing the alkali liquid content of the alkali treated product, calculating the material exchange amount of the water-washing exchange material, washing the alkali treated product, calculating the fulling reaction parameters of the water-washing product, and fulling the water-washing product to obtain a target product. The invention can improve the intelligent control effect of the alkali shrinking machine.

title_en: Moisture control method, device and medium for feed finished product
abstract_en: The invention discloses a moisture control method, a device and a medium of a feed finished product, wherein the method comprises the steps of mixing feed raw materials to obtain a first feed; and adjusting the water content and cooling time of the second feed according to the water content comparison result of the second feed and the first feed, so that the water content of the second feed reaches the preset standard, and obtaining the finished feed product. The invention provides a moisture control method, a device and a medium for a finished feed product, which can accurately capture moisture change of the feed by comparing moisture contents of a first feed and a second feed, wherein the comparison is performed in real time in the production process instead of sampling detection or frequent sampling detection after the end of the production, thereby ensuring the accuracy and the effectiveness of monitoring, and solving the problem that production control elements in the feed production process are difficult to accurately control, so that the finished feed product is quickly and effectively generated.

title_en: Dynamic alarm threshold design method and system for gas turbine air inlet device
abstract_en: The invention provides a dynamic alarm threshold design method and system of a gas turbine air inlet device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of calculating a theoretical alarm threshold value of pressure difference before and after an air inlet device and a predictive alarm threshold value of pressure difference before and after the air inlet device, calculating KL distance according to an actual value array of pressure difference before and after the air inlet device and the theoretical alarm threshold value of pressure difference before and after the air inlet device, further obtaining an alarm value upper limit array and an alarm value lower limit array, obtaining an alarm value upper limit value and an alarm value lower limit value according to the predictive alarm threshold value of pressure difference before and after the air inlet device, the alarm value upper limit value and the alarm value lower limit value of pressure difference before and after the air inlet device, and comparing the predictive alarm threshold value of pressure difference before and after the air inlet device with the alarm value upper limit value and the alarm value lower limit value to confirm the alarm type. The scheme provided by the invention can adjust the change of the alarm threshold interval in real time through data learning, greatly reduces the phenomena of false alarm and missing alarm, and provides the judgment basis of faults.

title_en: Solvent extraction equipment and method for physical and chemical inspection
abstract_en: The application provides a solvent extraction device and a solvent extraction method for physical and chemical inspection, which are characterized in that volume change data and temperature change data of a solution to be processed in a nitrogen blowing concentration process are acquired in real time through an intelligent sensor, bubble interference generated on the surface of the solution to be processed in the nitrogen blowing concentration process is identified according to fluctuation characteristics of the volume change data, the loss amount of the solution to be processed in the nitrogen blowing concentration process is determined through the bubble interference, deviation characteristics of latent heat change in the nitrogen blowing concentration process are determined according to environmental parameters and the temperature change data, model gain of a concentration rate tracking model in the nitrogen blowing concentration process is determined based on the deviation characteristics, and the nitrogen flow of a nitrogen blowing needle head in the nitrogen blowing concentration process is adjusted according to the model gain and the loss amount, so that the nitrogen blowing concentration of the solution is completed, and a solution sample for physical and chemical inspection is obtained. By adopting the scheme of the application, the nitrogen flow can be adjusted in real time in nitrogen blowing concentration so as to reduce the loss of the solution sample in physicochemical inspection.

title_en: Atmospheric environment monitoring and early warning system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an atmospheric environment monitoring and early warning system applied to the field of atmospheric monitoring, which comprises a monitoring layer, a data transmission layer, a data processing layer, an early warning layer and an interaction layer, wherein the monitoring layer comprises a fixed-point monitoring module and a patrol module, the patrol module comprises a navigation patrol monitoring unit and a mobile patrol unit, the data processing layer comprises a data storage module and a data analysis processing module, the universality of monitoring data is effectively improved by a monitoring mode combining fixed point and patrol, the area which is easy to generate pollution is monitored in focus by means of the flexible performance of patrol, the timely updating and the accuracy of the data are effectively ensured, the field early warning is carried out on the area which is easy to generate pollution by an emergency processing robot, the man-machine interaction is effectively improved, the safety of personnel in the pollution area can be effectively ensured, in addition, the emergency processing robot can also carry out field sampling, the burden of workers is effectively reduced, and the accuracy of the monitoring data can be effectively improved.

title_en: Method for eliminating abnormal angle drift of two-axis inertial platform frame axis
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for eliminating abnormal angular drift of a two-axis inertial platform frame axis, which converts an input quantity from angular velocity to angular position by optimizing the sequence of an integrator in a stable loop control link, and avoids the additional constant angular drift of the frame axis caused by triangle function integration and difference mathematical operation in a decoupling link when the carrier is interfered with the same frequency and different phase. In addition, by combining the control principles of the two-axis inertial platform stabilizing loop and the angle tracking loop, a step of removing the accumulated amount of the angular velocity of the platform body at the moment of switching from the angle tracking loop to the stabilizing loop is added, the accumulated amount of the angular velocity of the platform body generated in the control process of the angle tracking loop is removed, and on the premise of not influencing the control precision, the main purpose is to eliminate abnormal angular drift of the frame shaft stabilizing loop caused by the rotation of the accumulated amount of the angular velocity of the two-axis stabilizing platform in the angular position decoupling step along with the rotation of the platform body shaft.

title_en: Casino system, game product, and game product providing method
abstract_en: The invention aims to strengthen the safety management of game articles. A casino system (30) in a casino (300) using a medal (72) to which an RFID tag (721) having identification information is attached, the casino system comprising an activation reader/writer (322) provided in the casino (300) and reading the identification information from the RFID tag (721) of the medal (72), and a registration device (325) for determining the authenticity of the medal (72) and registering the medal (72) determined to be authentic as a usable article. A registration device (325) judges whether or not the identification information added by the manufacturer of the medal (72) and the identification information read from the RFID tag (721) of the medal (72) by activating the reader/writer (322) match, and registers the identification information of the medal (72) judged to be genuine as the identification information of the usable medal (72).

title_en: Automatic control method and system for dyeing machine combined with monitoring of concentration of dyeing residual liquid
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic control method and system of a dyeing machine, which relate to the technical field of automatic control and comprise the steps of obtaining the concentration of dyeing residual liquid monitored by the dyeing machine in real time, constructing a residual concentration change curve according to the component concentration difference of the concentration of the dyeing residual liquid and the concentration of input dyeing liquid, identifying a control switching node according to the time sequence relation of the residual concentration change curve, comparing the component concentration difference of the residual concentration change curve with a target residual liquid concentration range of the control switching node, compensating the residual concentration difference by utilizing a dyeing control parameter to obtain a compensation control parameter, and dynamically controlling the dyeing machine according to the compensation control parameter. The invention solves the technical problems that the control of the traditional dyeing machine is usually operated according to a preset program, and is difficult to quickly adjust according to the real-time dye adsorption condition in the dyeing process, so that the control strategy is too simple, and the optimal dyeing effect cannot be realized.

title_en: Identification method for closed-loop optimization control system of deep peak-shaving thermal power generating unit
abstract_en: The invention mainly relates to the technical field of thermal power generating unit systems, in particular to a method for identifying a closed-loop optimization control system of a deep peak-shaving thermal power generating unit. The method comprises the steps of S100, establishing a space state model of a thermal power unit system, S200, designing linear quadratic controller parameters for the space state model of the thermal power unit system, calculating an optimal control rule through a state feedback matrix to form a thermal power unit closed-loop system, obtaining control input, control output and a system set value of the thermal power unit closed-loop system, S300, decomposing the thermal power unit closed-loop system into two open-loop subsystems, S400, obtaining a sensitivity function of the thermal power unit closed-loop system through subspace identification of the thermal power unit closed-loop system control input and the system set value, constructing a noise pollution-free intermediate signal through the sensitivity function of the thermal power unit closed-loop system, and S500, finally obtaining consistent unbiased estimation of the thermal power unit system parameters through subspace identification of the intermediate signal and the thermal power unit closed-loop system control output.

title_en: Cable fault early warning and fault positioning method for high-altitude areas
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cable fault early warning and fault positioning method in a high altitude area, which comprises the steps that monitoring terminals are arranged at two ends of a cable line, traveling wave signals generated by local discharge sources/fault points of the cable are respectively collected, the traveling wave signals are subjected to local data processing and wavelet analysis for feature extraction, a background master station is sent to the background master station through a wireless or optical fiber communication channel, the background master station draws a local discharge pattern according to the amplitude, the frequency and the corresponding equal-period statistical information of power frequency phases of the local discharge pulse signals, and judges the cable local discharge type and the development trend according to the change condition of the pattern. According to the invention, the wavelet analysis technology is used for extracting the main characteristic quantity of the partial discharge signal, the main characteristic quantity is sent to the background master station through a wireless or optical fiber communication channel, the arrival time of the voltage traveling wave head is determined through a voltage traveling wave head identification method, the fault distance of the power grid is calculated, and the fault location of the voltage traveling wave of the power grid is realized, so that the position of a fault point is accurately calculated.

title_en: Video monitoring method guided by radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a radar-guided video monitoring method, which comprises the steps of positioning a target entering a monitoring area through a radar, judging whether the target is close to the warning area or not, calculating the predicted warning duration of the target, evaluating the warning level of the target, marking a monitoring point selection period, calculating the selection representation value of a video monitoring point, marking a first tracking monitoring point, adjusting the angle to track the target, comparing the selection representation value of each video monitoring point in the monitoring point selection period, judging whether to switch the first tracking monitoring point, generating an alarm signal and entering the video tracking period when the target enters the warning area, calculating the loss risk value of the target in real time, judging whether to perform angle adjustment and switching on the first tracking monitoring point or not, if the target is lost, finding the target through other video monitoring points and switching the first tracking monitoring point, and marking the lost area and generating a maintenance optimization signal if the target cannot be found for a long time.

title_en: Intelligent networking training trolley and control method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to an intelligent network training trolley and a control method thereof, wherein the method comprises the steps of inputting video data into a traffic sign detection model of the training trolley to obtain traffic sign information of the video data; the radar data are input into an obstacle detection model of the training trolley, if an obstacle exists in the initial driving route, obstacle data are obtained, the initial driving route is modified according to the obstacle data and the traffic identification information to obtain a target driving route, and the driving speed of the training trolley along the modified target driving route is controlled according to the traffic identification information, so that the training trolley bypasses the obstacle according to the target driving route. The application can improve the unmanned capacity of the training trolley.

title_en: Manufacturing method of fiber optic gyroscope ring body for reducing gyroscope scale factor
abstract_en: A method for manufacturing optical fiber gyroscope ring body for reducing gyroscope scale factor includes starting up scale factor calibration system if expansion coefficient reaches stabilization threshold, adjusting scale factor of gyroscope according to preset calibration program, judging whether measurement accuracy reaches preset accuracy requirement or not according to calibration result of scale factor, obtaining equivalent radius data in full temperature range, analyzing stability of equivalent radius along with temperature change, building performance stability evaluation model according to stability data of equivalent radius, describing relation between performance stability and stability of equivalent radius, adopting preset performance optimization algorithm to adjust winding process parameters to make equivalent radius of ring body in full temperature range tend to be stable, and judging whether performance stability reaches preset optimization threshold or not by monitoring variation trend of equivalent radius in real time.

title_en: Optimal two-part cooperative control method for intelligent unmanned cluster system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of intelligent unmanned cluster system control, and particularly relates to an optimal two-part cooperative control method of an intelligent unmanned cluster system; the method comprises the steps of determining the topological structure of a system according to the interconnection relation among unmanned aerial vehicles in an unmanned aerial vehicle cluster system, sending state information of each unmanned aerial vehicle to neighbor intelligent agents based on the topological structure of the system, calculating local state errors of each unmanned aerial vehicle, constructing a double-Q learning network, training the double-Q learning network according to the local state errors by adopting an ALR-TQDPG algorithm until the intelligent unmanned aerial vehicle cluster system is consistent, outputting control information by a target network, controlling the intelligent unmanned aerial vehicle cluster system by adopting the control information output by the target network, and achieving cooperative control of the intelligent unmanned aerial vehicle cluster system.

title_en: Industrial big data management method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an industrial big data management method and system, which mainly aim at the field of semiconductor manufacturing. The method comprises the steps of firstly collecting process parameters and equipment operation data by installing various sensors on equipment, preprocessing, extracting fluctuation characteristics of photoetching link data by utilizing time sequence analysis and wavelet transformation, and constructing a photoresist thickness fluctuation model by combining historical data and a process principle. According to the model, an improved PID control algorithm is adopted to formulate and execute a fluctuation suppression strategy, so that the photoresist thickness is stabilized. At the same time, the relevant data is stored in a sorted manner for query invocation. The invention effectively solves the difficult problems of data management and process control in the semiconductor manufacturing, improves the data quality, ensures the process stability, improves the production efficiency and the product quality, and promotes the intelligent development of the semiconductor manufacturing industry.

title_en: Preheating temperature control system and method for gangue roasting
abstract_en: The invention provides a preheating temperature control system and method for gangue roasting, which belong to the technical field of temperature control, wherein the module comprises a data acquisition module, a data processing module, a temperature curve module, a closed loop control module and a feedback module, wherein the data acquisition module is used for configuring parameter sensors in a preheating device and a roasting furnace to monitor and obtain preheating original data and roasting original data, the data processing module is used for normalizing the preheating original data and the roasting original data to obtain standard preheating data and standard roasting data, the temperature curve module is used for constructing a multi-section temperature curve according to the physical properties and roasting requirements of the gangue, the closed loop control module is used for generating a temperature control strategy according to deviation between the standard preheating data and the standard roasting data and the multi-section temperature curve based on a PID control model, and the feedback module is used for executing the temperature control strategy and carrying out feedback adjustment on the PID control model according to the actual temperature data after control. And the accuracy and efficiency of the preheating and roasting processes are improved by optimizing temperature regulation through closed-loop PID control.

title_en: Multifunctional vision-impaired person intelligent auxiliary glasses device and computing equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional vision-impaired person intelligent auxiliary eyeglass device and computing equipment, wherein the device comprises an eyeglass body, an image acquisition module, a voice output module, a man-machine interaction module, a power supply module, a processing module, a voice output module, a Bluetooth module, a man-machine interaction module and a power supply module, wherein the eyeglass body comprises lenses, an image acquisition module integration area, a man-machine interaction module integration area and a power supply module integration area, the image acquisition module is used for acquiring front image information in real time, the processing module is used for respectively identifying characters, traffic lights, zebra stripes, steps/stairs, obstacles with preset distances, preset home environments and object positions in the image information through a vision space intelligent network model, the voice output module is used for outputting voice broadcasting information generated by the processing module, the Bluetooth module is used for voice broadcasting, the man-machine interaction module is used for receiving instruction input of a user, and the power supply module comprises a solar automatic power storage unit and a battery unit. The invention helps people with low eyesight to maintain daily life through the intelligent auxiliary glasses, and improves self-care capability.

title_en: Semantic information-based vehicle space-time trajectory similarity calculation method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent traffic and discloses a vehicle space-time track similarity calculation method and device based on semantic information, which are used for obtaining space-time track data, dividing the space-time track data by taking 1 hour as an interval, constructing a Voronoi graph to generate Thiessen polygons, extracting multidimensional features of a Thiessen polygon area containing tracks to obtain space features, time features and POI semantic features of the area, constructing a space-time relation graph, sequentially adopting a space-time integrated random walk strategy with track perception and high-quality representation of GAT algorithm learning nodes, constructing a model T-LSTM with enhanced time expression capability to learn final representation of track sequences, measuring similarity between nodes and track, and designing a graph-based double-layer comparison loss function training model.

title_en: Scenic spot people stream density detection and early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of people stream density detection, and provides a scenic spot people stream density detection and early warning method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting real-time passenger stream data through intelligent equipment deployed at key nodes of a scenic spot; the method comprises the steps of preprocessing collected data, constructing a multidimensional feature analysis model, constructing a sample set based on feature vectors output by the multidimensional feature analysis model, outputting the sample set to a deep learning model to calculate a people stream density index, triggering grading early warning when the people stream density index exceeds a first preset threshold, generating multi-language voice early warning information according to the grading early warning, carrying out regional broadcasting through directional sound field equipment, and generating a tourist diversion scheme containing optimized path planning when the people stream density index exceeds a second preset threshold, thereby effectively improving the accuracy and early warning timeliness of people stream density detection.

title_en: Tin smelting chemical reaction optimization control method based on reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to a tin smelting chemical reaction optimization control method based on reinforcement learning, and belongs to the technical field of intersection of metallurgical engineering and artificial intelligence. The present invention uses an improved fourier synthesis method to simulate state data in tin melting. And then constructing a tin smelting process model based on a reinforcement learning algorithm, taking key process parameters in the furnace as state variables, and adopting an Actor-Critic architecture with a double-network design to realize dynamic optimization control. The invention also introduces a physicochemical model, combines the thermodynamic equilibrium formula of the technological parameters and the chemical reaction, and calculates the variation trend of the carbon monoxide production. The invention can intelligently optimize the chemical reaction conditions in the tin smelting process, improves the tin production, reduces the carbon monoxide emission, effectively shortens the reaction time and reduces the energy waste.

title_en: Industrial robot virtual debugging and simulation method based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention provides a digital twinning-based industrial robot virtual debugging and simulation method which comprises the following steps of S1, S2, establishing a digital twinning model of an industrial robot, S2, establishing a kinematic model of the industrial robot, carrying out forward kinematic analysis and inverse kinematic analysis on the established kinematic model, S3, carrying out virtual debugging and digital twinning virtual-real mapping on the digital twinning model established in the step S1, S4, realizing digital twinning visualization of the industrial robot, namely establishing a digital twinning model which is highly consistent with the actual robot and the working environment thereof in a virtual environment, and establishing real-time communication between the two, so that comprehensive debugging is carried out on the actual robot and peripheral equipment thereof in the virtual environment, simultaneously, the state of the actual robot is mapped into the digital twinning model, the comprehensive simulation on the actual robot and the running state thereof is realized, and the simulation precision and the adaptability of the industrial robot are effectively improved.

title_en: Charging equipment information processing method, device, system and storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a method, a device, a system and a storage medium for processing information of charging equipment, relates to the technical field of data processing, and can be applied to the fields of finance, vehicle charging equipment leasing and the like to at least solve the problems of low communication touch rate and low reminding efficiency caused by single communication prompting mode and single information content style. The method comprises the steps of determining target charging income information generated by target charging equipment within preset time, determining target lease cost information of leasing the target charging equipment within preset time, determining target payment grade of a target charging income account of a target equipment leasing end of the target charging equipment according to the target charging income information and the target lease cost information, determining a target deduction mode for deducting money to the target equipment leasing end according to the target payment grade and target overdue information of the target equipment leasing end, and touching target prompt information to the target equipment leasing end according to a target information touching mode corresponding to the target deduction mode.

title_en: Hydraulic engineering safety monitoring early warning device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydraulic engineering safety monitoring and early warning device, and relates to the technical field of hydraulic engineering safety monitoring and early warning devices. The hydraulic engineering safety monitoring and early warning device comprises a mounting base, wherein a first assembly rod is fixedly connected to the mounting base, a lifting unit is arranged in the first assembly rod, a second assembly rod is connected in a sliding manner in the first assembly rod, and a third assembly rod is arranged at the upper end of the second assembly rod. This hydraulic engineering safety monitoring early warning device adopts first equipment pole, second equipment pole and the structure that constitutes is assembled to the third equipment pole, adopts the lift unit to control the lift of second equipment pole simultaneously, is convenient for when needing to maintain the electronic equipment on the third equipment pole, descends the second equipment pole, and is provided with spacing unit in third equipment pole bottom, is convenient for carry out angle modulation to the third equipment pole after descending the second equipment pole, and the maintainer of being convenient for detects and maintains.

title_en: Intelligent well lid posture self-adjustment method and system applied to stormwater
abstract_en: An intelligent well lid posture self-adjusting method and system applied to stormwater weather relates to the field of municipal facility information processing. The method is applied to an intelligent well lid control system, and comprises the steps of obtaining water pressure of a well lid water outlet and real-time water level depth in a current well, determining predicted water level depth according to the water pressure of the well lid water outlet, judging whether the real-time water level depth reaches the predicted water level depth, setting a water level depth threshold in the well according to a water level difference value between the real-time water level depth and a preset water level depth if the real-time water level depth does not reach the predicted water level depth, and adjusting drainage posture of the well lid water outlet based on the water level depth threshold. By implementing the technical scheme provided by the application, the problem of low drainage efficiency of the drain outlet of the well lid in heavy rain weather is solved.

title_en: Safety protection system for trusted data space
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data safety detection, in particular to a safety protection system of a trusted data space, which comprises the steps of acquiring historical access information of a user through a behavior analysis module, analyzing operation behaviors in the historical access information, determining inertial behaviors and accidental behaviors of the user, simultaneously tracking and analyzing real-time behavior data of the user, dividing the real-time behavior data of the user into conventional behaviors, sudden behaviors and abnormal behaviors, acquiring operation duration and information association values of the conventional behaviors, the sudden behaviors and the abnormal behaviors, calculating the operation duration and the information association values, determining the current behavior risk value of the user, and determining early warning signals of different levels based on the behavior risk value.

title_en: Dangerous reminding device for vehicle-mounted radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to a danger reminding device for a vehicle-mounted radar, which belongs to the field of alarm devices, and comprises the steps of detecting the position and the speed of a rear vehicle person in real time through the vehicle-mounted radar, calculating the collision residual time under a simulated collision scene based on the position and the speed of the rear vehicle person, carrying out grading early warning reminding based on the position, the collision residual time and the vehicle door opening state of the rear vehicle person, fully considering the collision probability, the urgency and the person reaction speed under different scenes, carrying out multistage early warning reminding, reducing the interference of the rear vehicle person with low collision probability on a warning reminding system through setting a pre-collision area, reducing the probability of false alarm and frequent false alarm, and reminding the vehicle outside person to pay attention to the vehicle door opening operation and the vehicle door opening range through a fixed profile and a movable profile projected by a projection lamp.

title_en: Multi-source heterogeneous fusion type new energy automobile battery thermal runaway early warning system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-source heterogeneous fusion new energy automobile battery thermal runaway early warning system, which relates to the technical field of automobile electronics and comprises a multi-source data acquisition module, an edge calculation module, an evaluation module and an early warning module; the multi-source data acquisition module acquires battery data of the vehicle in real time based on the sensor, and uploads the acquired data to the edge calculation module, the edge calculation module builds a deep learning model, trains the model, inputs the data acquired in real time into the built model, and analyzes the battery data of the vehicle. The invention also discloses a multi-source heterogeneous fusion new energy automobile battery thermal runaway early warning method. The invention can comprehensively and accurately know the running state of the battery from multiple dimensions, overcomes the problem of single data source information, greatly improves the accuracy of judging the thermal runaway risk of the battery, realizes early and accurate early warning, timely early warning and avoids the occurrence of harm.

title_en: Traffic control device
abstract_en: A traffic control device is provided with a control unit that identifies vehicles one by one, acquires vehicle information indicating a safety-related function mounted on the identified vehicles, selects a vehicle that is to be restricted for entry to a specific road from among the identified vehicles based on the acquired vehicle information, and notifies a user of the selected vehicle of information on the restriction as restriction information.

title_en: Judgment method for endoscopic thyroid surgery training result and excision training model
abstract_en: The application relates to a judgment method of a training result of endoscopic thyroid surgery and a excision training model. The method comprises the steps of S1, sending a data acquisition instruction to a sensor, wherein the data acquisition instruction is used for instructing the sensor to acquire surgical data in a surgical process and transmitting the surgical data and the discrimination instruction to a server, S2, responding to the discrimination instruction, analyzing and discriminating the surgical data according to a preset discrimination rule to obtain a discrimination result and obtaining a surgical optimization suggestion according to the discrimination result, S3, transmitting the discrimination result, the surgical optimization suggestion and a display instruction to a display module, and displaying the instruction used for instructing a display device to display the discrimination result and the surgical optimization suggestion in a visual mode. The method can effectively judge the training result of the endoscopic thyroid surgery, visually presents the judging result and the optimizing suggestion for the training personnel, and assists in improving the technical effect of the training effect.

title_en: Commuting stop-charging intelligent guiding method and device driven by user aging preference
abstract_en: The invention discloses a commute stop charging intelligent guiding method and device driven by user aging preference. The method comprises the steps of constructing a stopping and filling data set by utilizing collected behavior data, training a new energy user aging preference portrait model according to the stopping and filling data set, collecting the behavior data before the current moment, inputting the behavior data into the new energy user aging preference portrait model to predict, obtaining comprehensive commuting stopping and filling convenience of all users according to a predicted result and collected commuting parking area planning data, constructing an intelligent guiding parking space model according to the comprehensive commuting stopping and filling convenience, and solving by adopting a genetic algorithm to obtain the parking space positions corresponding to new energy automobiles of all users. The invention realizes the advantage of comprehensively carrying out commuting and charging stop scheduling on all new energy automobiles, achieves the effect of considering the comprehensive commuting and charging stop convenience and timeliness of all users, and achieves the aim of optimal commuting and charging stop comprehensive arrangement.

title_en: Manual sounding auxiliary device for aphasia patient
abstract_en: The invention provides a manual sounding auxiliary device for aphasia patients, which comprises a control host, wherein the control host comprises a handheld part and a display panel, the display panel is arranged above the handheld part, an OLED display screen, a high-definition camera and a high-fidelity speaker are arranged on the front side surface of the display panel, the OLED display screen is arranged above the high-definition camera, the high-fidelity speaker is arranged below the OLED display screen, a key area is arranged on the outer surface of the handheld part, a plurality of functional keys are arranged in the key area, and a controller is arranged in the inner cavity of the handheld part.

title_en: Method and device for managing dispatchers in community
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for managing a dispatcher in a community, which comprise the steps of obtaining order information, analyzing the order information to obtain address information, authenticating the address information by utilizing a first management condition, obtaining the biological identification information of the dispatcher when the address information meets the first management condition, authenticating the biological identification information by utilizing a second management condition, determining corresponding behavior authority for the dispatcher when the biological identification information meets the second management condition, and realizing high-automation management on the dispatcher by address authentication and identity authentication, thereby ensuring legality and standardization of the dispatcher entering the community, improving execution efficiency of community management and dispatching tasks, improving service experience and avoiding interference of the dispatcher on daily life of the community.

title_en: Rail-to-rail operational amplifier with high open loop gain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rail-to-rail operational amplifier with high open loop Gain, which comprises a bias circuit, an input stage circuit and an output stage circuit, wherein NMOS (N-channel metal oxide semiconductor) and PMOS (P-channel metal oxide semiconductor) input pair tubes are adopted in the input stage circuit to realize rail-to-rail input, and a Gain-boost circuit and a class AB (class AB) circuit are adopted in the output stage circuit to realize high open loop Gain and rail-to-rail output.

title_en: Concentration field measuring device for hydrogen-doped natural gas
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of gas detection and concentration field measurement, and discloses a concentration field measurement device for hydrogen-doped natural gas, which comprises a gas mixing cavity module, a gas measuring module and a gas measuring module, wherein the gas mixing cavity module is used for mixing hydrogen and natural gas to form a stable hydrogen-doped natural gas sample; the system comprises a gas concentration measuring module, a data acquisition and processing module, a concentration field reconstruction and display module and an automatic feedback and control module, wherein the gas concentration measuring module is used for acquiring concentration data of the hydrogen-doped natural gas in a measuring pipeline, the data acquisition and processing module is used for carrying out acquisition and fusion processing on the concentration data, the concentration field reconstruction and display module is used for constructing a three-dimensional concentration field of the hydrogen-doped natural gas and carrying out visual display, and the automatic feedback and control module is used for automatically triggering an alarm and control device according to the measured data. According to the method, a three-dimensional concentration field modeling mechanism based on a Kriging interpolation algorithm is constructed, so that accurate reconstruction of the spatial distribution of the hydrogen-doped natural gas is realized, and the generated concentration distribution diagram not only can reflect the actual flowing state, but also has real-time response capability.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle and mobile platform speed synchronous control method, flight control system and unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle control, in particular to a speed synchronous control method, a flight control system and an unmanned aerial vehicle of an unmanned aerial vehicle and a mobile platform, wherein the speed synchronous control method comprises the following steps: according to the relative distance between the unmanned aerial vehicle and the mobile platform, GNSS information, visual beacon information or mobile visual positioning information is acquired, and the acquired GNSS information, visual beacon information or mobile visual positioning information is utilized to control the unmanned aerial vehicle in real time so as to realize speed synchronization with the mobile platform. The speed synchronization method is complementary and auxiliary to each other through various speed synchronization methods, the optimal speed synchronization method can be automatically selected according to different distance ranges, accurate speed synchronization between the unmanned aerial vehicle and the mobile platform in a complex environment is achieved, and the unmanned aerial vehicle can accurately follow or accurately land with the mobile platform.

title_en: Road congestion evaluation method based on 5S
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent traffic management, in particular to a 5S-based road congestion evaluation method, which is characterized in that multi-dimensional indexes are determined from five aspects of fluidities, structures, spaciousness, situational properties and sociality, the corresponding multi-dimensional indexes are collected for preprocessing, a fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model is constructed by combining a analytic hierarchy process and fuzzy mathematics, evaluation precision is improved through weight distribution and membership functions, comparison analysis is carried out by combining an example, and finally, the weight of each index is dynamically adjusted according to real-time traffic data, so that the model adaptability of the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model is improved. The method is suitable for a dynamic evaluation method of a complex scene, supports real-time data input and multi-path parallel calculation, and solves the problem that the traditional evaluation method mainly depends on a single index.

title_en: Flight arrival and landing scheduling method based on hyper heuristic algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flight arrival and landing scheduling method based on a hyper-heuristic algorithm, and mainly relates to the field of aviation traffic management and intelligent optimization. The existing flight arrival and landing scheduling method is deficient in speed and precision, and an optimal landing scheme cannot be found in a short time. The method adopts a randomly selected hyper-heuristic strategy, can obtain a better scheduling scheme in a limited time through four low-level heuristic operations based on disturbance, combines the idea of distributed parallel evolution, simultaneously operates a plurality of optimizers, and ensures that the method obtains an optimal sequencing scheme in a short time through a mode of periodically synchronizing optimal solutions.

title_en: Intelligent risk early warning method and system for real-time monitoring of regional infection
abstract_en: The application discloses an intelligent risk early warning method and system for real-time monitoring of regional infection, belonging to the field of infection early warning, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a plurality of regional infection characteristic matrixes; the method comprises the steps of carrying out infection index calculation to obtain a plurality of regional infection quality control index matrixes, carrying out infection anomaly identification on the plurality of regional infection quality control index matrixes by using frequent quality control indexes to obtain a plurality of anomaly infection index matrixes, locating anomaly regions and anomaly infection characteristics, carrying out infection prevention and control execution record data retrieval, carrying out anomaly infection factor traceability analysis to obtain traceability results, and generating anomaly early warning information. The method solves the technical problems that in the prior art, the infection dynamics of each area cannot be reflected in real time, so that hidden infection hazards cannot be found and early-warned in time, and analysis and integration of infection data are carried out by utilizing a big data resource service technology, so that the technical effects of timely responding and early-warning to various infections are achieved by analyzing and processing the infection data of each area through the big data.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle track tracking control method, system, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a track tracking control method, system, equipment and storage medium of an unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprise the steps of obtaining the turning radius of the unmanned aerial vehicle according to the ground speed and target lateral acceleration of the unmanned aerial vehicle, obtaining the line included angle between a known flight line and a target flight line through line information, obtaining an advanced turning distance according to the turning radius and the line included angle, constructing an inscribed arc path according to the turning radius and a circle center, switching the unmanned aerial vehicle to the target flight line according to the relation between the distance to be flown and the advanced turning distance to complete line updating, establishing a track tracking control mathematical model based on the relative position relation between the unmanned aerial vehicle and the arc path, obtaining a lateral acceleration instruction according to an improved variable gain guidance method, converting the lateral acceleration instruction into a rolling angle instruction, and controlling the unmanned aerial vehicle body to roll according to the rolling angle instruction. The application can realize accurate track tracking control and enhance the track tracking control capability and anti-interference capability of the unmanned aerial vehicle during turning.

title_en: Passenger dynamic evacuation guiding system for postal wheels
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of escape guiding of mail-wheel accidents, and discloses a mail-wheel passenger dynamic escape guiding system which comprises three modules, namely a monitoring alarm module, a path planning module and a dynamic identification module, wherein when a disaster or abnormal ship body posture of a mail-wheel triggers an alarm, the monitoring alarm module collects related data and transmits the related data in real time, the path planning module reconstructs a path network and distributes path weights according to the data, a Dijkstra algorithm for improving a searching strategy is adopted to search a globally optimal route, the dynamic identification module maps route data to an identification indication direction, the dynamic identification layout is optimized by combining with passenger perception behaviors when the system is deployed, the monitoring alarm module monitors the crowd gathering condition of each road section in real time in the escape process, and the related data is conveyed to the path planning module again to search for a new round. According to the invention, the optimal route can be planned in real time according to the accident scene of the mail wheel, and the indication direction of the evacuation mark can be dynamically adjusted, so that the dynamic guidance of crowd evacuation is realized.

title_en: Urethral catheterization operation device and urethral catheterization training method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a urethral catheterization operation device and a urethral catheterization training method, wherein the device comprises urethral catheterization equipment, a trunk simulation part, an induction component, an acquisition component and a main control platform, wherein the trunk simulation part comprises a bladder simulation part and a urethra simulation part, the urethra simulation part is communicated with the bladder simulation part, the induction component comprises a gyroscope and a flexible plate which is annularly arranged on the urethra simulation part, a magnetic positioning sensor is arranged on the flexible plate, the acquisition component comprises a projection light source and a microimage acquisition sensor which are arranged in the urethra simulation part, and the main control platform is respectively in communication interaction with the urethral catheterization equipment, the gyroscope, the magnetic positioning sensor and the microimage acquisition sensor. According to the urethral catheterization operation device and the urethral catheterization training method, through the well-designed urethral catheterization operation device, the simulated catheterization operation training of operators can be monitored in real time, so that whether the training is standard or not can be intuitively judged when the simulated catheterization operation training is performed, and corresponding real-time feedback guidance is conveniently provided for the problems of each operator in the training process.

title_en: Sports teaching method and system based on multimedia and holographic AR fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of sports teaching, in particular to a sports teaching method and system based on multimedia and holographic AR fusion, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of collecting motion data of a trainee based on a multi-source sensor array, constructing an action parameterized model, generating holographic AR teaching images in real time through matching of a holographic projection generating module and a standard action database, carrying out self-adaptive projection on illumination and space layout by combining an environment sensing module, establishing coordinate mapping of the trainee and a virtual image by utilizing a space positioning module, and enabling a multi-channel feedback device to output visual, tactile and auditory signals. Finally, by comparing the action parameters with the standard action data, a training report containing false action labels and correction suggestions is automatically generated. The invention can effectively improve the motion capturing precision and the interactive immersion sense, and provides high-efficiency and extensible technical support for modern physical education and training.

title_en: Power self-adaptive adjusting method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power self-adaptive adjusting method and system, which comprise the steps of obtaining an initial resistance value of an equivalent resistor of a power supply line, determining load power of the power supply line according to the initial resistance value of the equivalent resistor, adjusting working power of a load according to the load power, cutting off the load after the adjusted working power is operated for a preset time, obtaining the load resistance value of the equivalent resistor of the power supply line, determining temperature rise of the power supply line according to the initial resistance value and the load resistance value of the equivalent resistor of the power supply line, and reducing the working power of the load when the temperature rise exceeds a preset temperature rise threshold value. The invention determines the load power of the power supply line through the equivalent resistance of the power supply line, further adjusts the working power of the load according to the actual load capacity of the power supply line, can avoid potential safety hazards caused by overload operation of the power supply line, and can monitor the temperature rise condition of the power supply line to dynamically adjust the working power of the load and avoid fire risks caused by overheat of the power supply line.

title_en: Intelligent home regulation and control method based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent home, and particularly discloses an intelligent home regulation and control method based on the Internet of things, which comprises the following steps that S1, an environment sensing module collects environment parameters through a distributed sensor network; the method comprises the steps of S2, constructing a user behavior probability model based on historical operation data and real-time action recognition by a user behavior analysis module, outputting behavior preference weights, S3, generating a device control instruction set by a cloud decision engine through fusing environment parameters and the behavior preference weights, calculating regulation and control priorities, and S4, driving household devices by a device execution network according to the instruction set, and optimizing the regulation and control parameters through a feedback mechanism. According to the intelligent household regulation and control method based on the Internet of things, the intelligent and automatic regulation and control of household equipment is realized by integrating a plurality of modules such as environment perception, user behavior analysis, cloud decision, equipment execution and the like by means of an advanced Internet of things technology, and a comfortable, convenient and safe household environment is created for users.

title_en: DRL-based no-signalized intersection end-to-end vehicle motion control method
abstract_en: A DRL-based no-signalized intersection end-to-end vehicle motion control method is used for coping with highly dynamic random traffic flow at the no-signalized intersection and improving the running safety of vehicles. The invention relates to the field of intelligent driving, which comprises an information screening module, a DRL module and a smoothing processing module. The information screening module acquires state information from the environment and refines the state information into low-dimensional environment information and space-time interaction states, and forms a state space and outputs driving states. And the Actor network and the Critic network in the DRL module respectively extract the space interaction characteristic and the time characteristic in the driving state and splice the space interaction characteristic and the time characteristic with the low-dimensional environment information characteristic. And the Actor network outputs the vehicle control quantity by carrying out Gaussian distribution heavy parameterization sampling on the spliced state characteristics. The smoothing processing module performs smoothing processing on the vehicle control quantity, transmits actions to the automatic driving vehicle in the environment to perform motion control, and updates the state information of the environment.

title_en: Simulation system passive linear array sonar array element level signal output method
abstract_en: The invention provides a simulation system passive array sonar array element level signal output method, which comprises the steps of setting parameters, generating a high sampling rate passive target source signal, calculating the time delay of receiving signals of all hydrophones according to azimuth, simulating and generating the target signals of the receiving signals of all hydrophones, simulating and generating ocean environment background noise received by all hydrophones, superposing the simulated signals, the simulated noise and actual array data to generate full array element data, carrying out Fourier transform on the time domain array element level data, carrying out frequency domain beam forming to obtain a passive space energy spectrum, accumulating multi-beam time domain data for a long time, and carrying out Fourier transform to obtain multi-beam narrow bands Lofar. The invention has the beneficial effects that the linear array simulation data and the actual measurement array data in an ideal scene are fused, the playback function is realized, and the original array data playback is supported. On the basis, underwater sound targets, noise and interference are added, matrix sample data are output, and training and assessment of passive warning detection, target tracking and the like of students are supported.

title_en: Cluster control system and method based on bionic intelligent fish equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a cluster control system and method based on bionic intelligent fish equipment and a storage medium, wherein the system comprises a visual perception system, a control system and a control system, wherein the visual perception system is used for carrying out three-dimensional reconstruction on the environment based on image data; the method comprises the steps of identifying obstacles in the environment, carrying out real-time ranging on the obstacles to determine the distance between the bionic intelligent fish equipment and the obstacles, carrying out environment map construction and path planning optimization based on point cloud data to obtain the pose of the bionic intelligent fish equipment in real time so as to adjust the pose of the bionic intelligent fish equipment, generating an optimal path from a starting point to a target point for the bionic intelligent fish equipment based on the three-dimensional reconstructed environment by a path planning system, carrying out streamline design on a bionic propulsion system which is a fish bionic shape, and driving tail fins and tail fin driving systems which are made of composite materials so as to simulate the swing mode of the fish tail fins. The application promotes the smooth and efficient movement of the bionic intelligent fish equipment in a complex environment.

title_en: Alarm reminding method, device, equipment and medium for water use abnormality
abstract_en: The application discloses an alarm reminding method, device, equipment and medium for water use abnormality, relating to the technical field of equipment fault diagnosis, comprising the following steps: acquiring a night analysis period, acquiring water consumption data in the time corresponding to the night analysis period, and judging that water consumption is abnormal and generating alarm information when the water consumption data meets any preset water leakage condition. By setting an analysis period at night, collecting water consumption data, judging abnormality according to preset water leakage conditions and alarming, the method can accurately identify water consumption abnormality, alarm in time, reduce water resource waste and improve management efficiency and reliability of a water supply system.

title_en: System, method and self-propelled module for forming three-dimensional objects
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus and method for automatically forming a recreatable three dimensional object in an open space. A system for forming a three-dimensional object includes one or more docking stations, a self-propelled module, and a control device. In order to form a three-dimensional object from the body of the self-propelled module, navigation commands and a given three-dimensional object model are sent to the self-propelled module for guiding the self-propelled module into a given area of the open space and positioning in a given location. The self-propelled module is designed to be fastenable in the docking station and is able to receive navigation commands and travel to and be positioned in a given spatial position. The invention makes it possible to reduce the time required to create a three-dimensional object in a given area of open space and to increase the duration for which the object can be maintained in a suitable state.

title_en: Open avionics system for multipurpose unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention provides an open avionics system for a multipurpose unmanned aerial vehicle, which relates to an unmanned aerial vehicle electronic system, and comprises a comprehensive processing module, a navigation module, a servo module, a power supply and distribution module and a load module, wherein the modules realize data interaction through an interconnection bus; an interface standardized protocol conversion module is further arranged between the load module and the comprehensive processing module, and the protocol conversion module is used for converting various non-standardized load interfaces into uniform and standardized interfaces so as to support effective communication and data exchange between the load module and the comprehensive processing module. Based on the design ideas of comprehensive modularization, bus interconnection and interface standardization, the invention carries out centralized integrated design on each functional module of the existing unmanned aerial vehicle electronic system to form a multipurpose unmanned aerial vehicle electronic system with high integration and interface standardization.

title_en: Photovoltaic control system and method based on tea light complementation
abstract_en: The invention provides a photovoltaic control system and a method based on tea light complementation, wherein the system comprises an environment sensing module; the system comprises a shadow calculation module, a multi-objective decision module and an execution control module. According to the invention, the inclination angle of the photovoltaic plate is dynamically adjusted according to the actual temperature of the tea tree canopy and the solar altitude angle, so that the photovoltaic plate reaches the optimal inclination angle when the power generation power is maximized, the problem of uneven shadow distribution of a tea garden caused by the fixed inclination angle photovoltaic plate is avoided, the shadow uniformity is improved by 56%, the maximum voltage of the power generation power and the optimal voltage of photosynthetic effective radiation are cooperated according to the actual light intensity of the tea tree canopy, the actual temperature of the tea tree canopy and the shadow coverage rate, the power generation efficiency is maximized, the tea tree is at the optimal photosynthetic light intensity, and the tea quality is improved by 18%.

title_en: 3D printing remote monitoring method and system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention provides a 3D printing remote monitoring method and system based on the Internet of things, which are characterized in that sensing data in a 3D printing remote is acquired in real time based on a sensor, the sensing data is preprocessed to obtain target sensing data, the acquisition of the data in the 3D printing remote is realized, a data basis is provided for the 3D printing remote monitoring, the target sensing data is transmitted to a monitoring center based on the Internet of things, the transmission of the sensing data is realized, a basis is provided for the remote monitoring, the 3D printing is evaluated based on the target sensing data based on a printing task, an evaluation result is obtained, the real-time analysis of a 3D printing process is realized, the adjustment data of the 3D printing is determined based on the evaluation result, the adjustment of the 3D printing is realized based on the Internet of things, the printing state is monitored at any time and any place finally, the problems are found in time and the remote adjustment is carried out, the reliability and the efficiency of the printing process are effectively improved, and the production risk is reduced.

title_en: Intersection collision avoiding method and device based on static or dynamic collision area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for avoiding intersection collision based on static or dynamic collision areas. Establishing a connection between a lane and an intersection, acquiring a conflict point, acquiring real-time intersection data by a target vehicle when simulation is carried out, judging whether the vehicle speed needs to be adjusted from near to far on the conflict point which is not passed by the head of the target vehicle, judging whether the type of the conflict point is used for determining to establish a static conflict area or a dynamic conflict area, and determining whether the vehicle speed needs to be adjusted according to the position and the speed relation. According to the invention, a static or dynamic conflict area is established by utilizing the real-time position and speed relation of the target vehicle and the conflict vehicle, the speed of the target vehicle is adjusted to avoid the conflict in the intersection, the constructed model enables the vehicle to run closer to the actual driving condition, the passing efficiency of the simulated model intersection is improved, and the problem that the vehicles, especially the large vehicles, can overlap and conflict under certain confluence situations is solved.

title_en: Milk foam generation control method of stirrer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a milk foam generation control method of a stirrer, which comprises an initial stirring stage, a main foaming stirring stage and a stabilization stage, wherein the initial stirring stage controls a stirring blade to stir at a preset low speed stirring rotating speed for a preset low speed stirring time, the main foaming stirring stage controls the stirring blade to foam at a preset basic stirring rotating speed for a preset basic stirring time, the stabilization stage controls the stirring blade to stir at a preset thinning stirring rotating speed for a preset basic thinning stirring time to thin generated milk foam, and the preset basic stirring rotating speed is larger than the preset thinning stirring rotating speed and larger than the preset low speed stirring rotating speed. The invention can ensure the consistency of milk foam products produced by the stirrer under different environments so as to realize standardized quality control of cross-regional stores.

title_en: Boiler tail gas multi-pollutant cooperative control system based on PLC and frequency converter linkage
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of boiler tail gas treatment, in particular to a boiler tail gas multi-pollutant cooperative control system based on linkage of a PLC and a frequency converter. The system comprises a data acquisition module, a PLC control module and a collaborative optimization module. The invention collects the concentration data of pollutants in the boiler tail gas in real time through the data collection module, and utilizes the inlet induced draft fan to introduce the boiler tail gas into the sulfur removal denitration tower, the PLC control module utilizes the logic controller of the PLC to set the driving rule of the inlet induced draft fan, the operation frequency of the inlet induced draft fan is dynamically adjusted according to the content of the pollutants in the boiler tail gas, the co-optimization module returns the tail gas which does not reach the standard to the boiler to carry out secondary sulfur removal denitration, the tail gas which reaches the standard is introduced into the dedusting tower through the outlet induced draft fan, the electric dedusting voltage is adjusted according to the content of ammonia in the tail gas, and the aim of minimizing the operation cost is fulfilled by adopting a genetic algorithm, so that the linkage control of desulfurization, denitration and dedusting is realized.

title_en: Intelligent optimal control method for garbage disposal power generation and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent optimal control method for garbage disposal power generation and electronic equipment, and relates to the technical field of garbage disposal, wherein the method comprises the steps of deploying a garbage sensor network on garbage disposal power generation equipment, and acquiring multi-source garbage sensing data flow; the method comprises the steps of carrying out digital twin simulation based on a characteristic parameter flow of the garbage treatment power generation equipment and a garbage historical power generation data set, constructing a garbage power generation optimizing objective function, embedding the garbage treatment power generation digital twin body, carrying out power generation control solving on a multi-source garbage perception data flow by adopting a garbage power generation control digital twin body, determining a target power generation control parameter, and carrying out power generation dynamic scheduling and feedback closed-loop control on the garbage treatment power generation equipment based on the target power generation control parameter. The technical problems of difficult dynamic optimization, insufficient multi-source data fusion capability and poor real-time control strategy in the garbage incineration power generation process in the prior art are solved, and the technical effects of improving the garbage power generation efficiency and optimizing the running stability of equipment are achieved.

title_en: Intelligent traffic monitoring system based on big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a big data-based intelligent traffic monitoring system which comprises a data acquisition module, a traffic optimization module and a monitoring output module, wherein the data acquisition module acquires and preprocesses multi-source traffic data, the multi-source traffic data comprises vehicle image data and vehicle space data, the traffic optimization module constructs an improved density clustering algorithm, an optimal clustering result in different traffic states is obtained from the multi-source traffic data through the improved density clustering algorithm, the improved density clustering algorithm is realized by self-adaptively adjusting an initial neighborhood radius and minimum points in the neighborhood on the basis of a traditional density clustering algorithm, the monitoring output module is used for obtaining optimal traffic situation results in different traffic states on the basis of the optimal clustering result in the different traffic states, and the optimal real-time decision basis is provided for a traffic management department through fusion of space-time characteristics by a multi-layer perceptron.

title_en: Sewage treatment plant monitoring management method and system based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of digital twinning, and provides a sewage treatment plant monitoring and management method and system based on the digital twinning technology. The method comprises the steps of determining coupling relation data among devices of a sewage treatment plant and real-time sewage data of sewage input in the operation period, extracting operation data of the devices from a digital twin model corresponding to the sewage treatment plant, predicting a plurality of virtual twin sub-models independent of the digital twin model based on the operation data, the coupling relation data and the real-time sewage data, obtaining potential fault devices and affected associated devices based on the virtual twin sub-models, and outputting prompt information related to the potential fault devices and the affected associated devices in the digital twin model. The invention adds a fault prediction function to the digital twin model, and does not interfere with the normal operation of the digital twin model.

title_en: Automatic viscosity adjustment equipment and control method for casting molding slurry of laminated inductor
