abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a method for automatically adjusting the viscosity of casting forming slurry of a laminated inductor, and relates to the technical field of manufacturing of laminated inductors, wherein the device for automatically adjusting the viscosity of casting forming slurry of the laminated inductor comprises a solvent tank, a casting container, a metering pump, a conveying pipe, a three-way moving mechanism, a temperature probe, a rotary viscometer and a control device, wherein in a certain temperature interval, if the rotary viscometer detects that the viscosity is too high, the control device controls the three-way moving mechanism to drive the conveying pipe to be immersed in the slurry, controls the metering pump to output the solvent, the slurry is diluted after the solvent is added, the viscosity of the slurry is gradually reduced, so that the viscosity of the slurry can be automatically maintained at a normal level, the consistency of the dispersibility of the slurry is ensured to be in a good state, manual operation is less, time can be saved, the production efficiency is improved, and the dosage of the solvent is controlled by the control device, compared with manual operation, the method is more accurate.

title_en: Environment-friendly pipeline mold preparation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mold preparation, in particular to a green environment-friendly pipeline mold preparation method, which comprises the steps of extracting a processing trace from a visual image of a processing surface of a pipeline mold workpiece through an image processing mapping algorithm to generate processing local image features, extracting reflectance differences of a plurality of wave bands from a spectrum image through a calibration model to generate processing micro-spectrum features, constructing a mapping learning model which is based on an improved multi-mode CNN model framework and provided with a visual input branch and a spectrum input branch, inputting the processing local image features into the visual input branch, inputting the processing micro-spectrum features into the spectrum input branch to generate processing surface roughness, and adjusting processing parameters of the processing surface according to a comparison result of the processing surface roughness and a threshold value. The invention realizes the optimization prediction of the surface roughness, further reduces invalid processing actions, and realizes the green environment-friendly preparation process which saves electricity, reduces pollution and improves the molding qualification rate of the pipeline mold.

title_en: Method and system for regular messaging
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to methods and systems for regular messaging. A data processing system and method for assessing the operational status of an asset is described. The asset is one of a plurality of assets monitored by the condition monitoring system. The status monitoring system automatically issues an alert message based on the operational status of the monitored asset. The method uses a trained large language model to generate an output message that provides a summary of the context-dependent content of feedback from previous alert messages to assist the user in assessing the operational status of the asset.

title_en: Intelligent tandem car allies oneself with key management system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of intelligent key management, and particularly discloses an intelligent tandem car-connected key management system which comprises a user terminal, an intelligent key cabinet and an approval unit. The scheme includes submitting vehicle information on a user terminal, automatically completing approval according to preset rules, shortening the approval time, constructing a multi-layer protection system, carrying out hash processing on passwords during user registration to avoid plaintext password leakage, constructing an intrusion detection model by utilizing a long-short-period memory network, optimizing by a random gradient descent method, carrying out iterative encryption on user information base data by adopting a Blowfish encryption algorithm to ensure the safety of data access, adopting a double authentication method, combining the uniqueness and the dynamic property of biological characteristics, effectively preventing identity counterfeiting and counterfeiting, and improving the safety and the reliability of a key management system.

title_en: Fault early warning system for net cage ship
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fault early warning, in particular to a net cage ship fault early warning system which comprises a data acquisition module, a data processing module and an early warning module, wherein the data acquisition module comprises an acquisition unit used for acquiring operation data of all acquisition points of a net cage ship and a data transmission unit connected with the acquisition unit and used for converting the operation data into communication signals and transmitting the communication signals to a monitoring center, the data processing module is connected with the data acquisition module and comprises a preprocessing unit used for preprocessing the communication signals to output normalized data, the early warning module is connected with the data processing module and used for sending out fault early warning according to analysis results, and the control module is respectively connected with the data acquisition module, the data processing module and the early warning module and used for determining the change rate of adjacent acquisition points according to the false alarm rate of the fault early warning. The invention improves the accuracy of fault early warning.

title_en: Thermocouple weighing type coal feeder coal quantity metering DCS integrated control method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a thermocouple weighing type coal feeder coal quantity metering DCS integrated control method and system, wherein the method comprises the following steps of collecting a weight signal of coal loaded on a coal feeder belt and a motor rotating speed signal for controlling the rotating speed of the coal feeder belt; the method comprises the steps of identifying a weight signal and a rotating speed signal, carrying out logic filtering processing on the weight signal and the rotating speed signal, calculating a weight zero value and a weighing fullness value which are stored, carrying out multiplication processing on the rotating speed signal after the filtering processing and a coal feeder model coefficient k to obtain a coal feeder belt speed, carrying out calculation processing on the weight per unit value, the coal feeder belt speed and the weight in a calibration state to obtain a coal quantity value of a coal feeder, and carrying out PID operation on the obtained coal quantity value of the coal feeder and a coal feeder coal feeding rate command to obtain an output command of a frequency converter of a coal feeder belt motor. The invention eliminates fault points, improves stability and control precision, and reduces cost.

title_en: Hoisting control method for safe portable hoisting cage
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of engineering control, in particular to a hoisting control method of a safe portable hoisting cage, which comprises a hoisting preposition stage, pre-acquisition and analysis of data before hoisting, a hoisting control stage and hoisting landing control; compared with the prior art, the method mainly relies on a stroke encoder and a position sensor to carry out position closed-loop control, is difficult to accurately predict and offset dynamic swing deviation caused by wind disturbance in real time, has the defects of control lag and insufficient handling, is based on simple pendulum dynamics model numerical solution and advanced prediction of the motion track and gesture of the cage by the Longgy-Kutta method, combines virtual and real vision calibration technology and AR enhancement display to carry out high-precision deviation detection, establishes a cage motion state control model based on feedforward prediction, greatly compresses track prediction errors, realizes prospective suppression of cage motion, particularly wind-induced swing, and remarkably improves the accuracy and response speed of active swing inhibition measures.

title_en: Automatic production line construction method and system based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: An automatic production line construction method and system based on a digital twin technology belong to the technical field of metauniverse, and aim to solve the problems that the existing automatic production line system cannot further improve efficiency and enable for enterprise digitization and cannot meet the requirements of modern digitization, automation and the like; according to the automatic production line system, aiming at pain points of industrial automatic production line design and construction, from the perspective of digitalization, a mixed architecture of a software system and a PLC is adopted to replace a traditional PLC system, so that the design and flow control of the production line are realized, the design and construction of the production line are effectively solved with low cost, digital-analog data, parameterized layout, simulation and optimization of the automatic production line and flow control of the production line are generated through an upper computer application program, the data acquisition and distribution of the Internet of things are carried out through the data acquisition and distribution APP of the Internet of things, the real production line construction is carried out through hardware equipment of the automatic production line, and meanwhile, the idea of digital twin is realized through the control technology of the upper computer application program.

title_en: Intelligent configuration management system for vacuum process parameters
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of vacuum process parameter management and discloses an intelligent configuration management system for vacuum process parameters. The parameter acquisition module acquires data in the pre-vacuumizing, vacuum maintaining and breaking recovery stages, judges abnormal signals and sends the abnormal signals to the relevant modules, the configuration adjustment module corrects the abnormal signals, and the system state tracking module tracks the configuration process. The system also comprises a system reliability evaluation module, a process cycle integration module and a regional parameter anomaly evaluation module, so that the system reliability evaluation, the process cycle integration analysis and the cavity surface regional parameter anomaly evaluation are realized. The system can comprehensively collect parameters, intelligently process anomalies, evaluate the reliability and the process period of the system, and improve the management efficiency and the stability of the vacuum process.

title_en: Underground inspection path planning method of inspection robot
abstract_en: The invention provides an underground inspection path planning method of an inspection robot, which relates to the technical field of robot path planning, and comprises the steps of obtaining basic map data, robot basic data and an inspection plan; the method comprises the steps of obtaining real-time map data and robot real-time data, determining a routing inspection node, determining a selectable routing inspection path, determining routing inspection consumption coefficients, determining a preset routing inspection path according to robot basic data, real-time map data, routing inspection consumption coefficients and basic map data, determining whether the preset routing inspection path needs to be changed according to the basic map data, the robot basic data and the robot real-time data, determining the changed routing inspection path according to the robot basic data, the basic map data and the robot real-time data under the condition that the preset routing inspection path needs to be changed, and routing inspection according to the changed routing inspection path. According to the invention, the rationality of the underground inspection path planning can be improved.

title_en: Multi-source information fusion processing method for intelligent investigation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multisource information fusion processing method for intelligent investigation, and relates to the technical field of data fusion and information processing. The system comprises the following steps of acquiring a moving track and a public camera video through a multi-mode positioning technology and video streaming transmission and a local cache, solving the problem of data asynchronism by utilizing a network time protocol, guaranteeing data transmission of a signal poor area through satellite communication, performing simple decision logic on edge equipment, reducing data quantity uploaded to a central server, processing position data by adopting an extended Kalman filtering algorithm, generating an accurate moving track, analyzing video data by using a Deep SORT algorithm, extracting useful information, displaying an analysis result to a investigation staff through a comprehensive command platform, providing real-time decision support, monitoring and continuously processing new data in real time, and immediately giving an alarm when an important clue is found. The whole framework improves the intelligent level of the system and provides powerful technical support for investigation work.

title_en: High-precision photoetching device for electronic component production
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-precision photoetching device for producing electronic components, which relates to the field of photoetching devices and comprises a photoetching machine main body, a clean room sealing door, a fixed connecting plate, a rubber connecting bag, a sliding connecting plate, a switch extrusion rod and a push switch; the cleaning room sealing door is connected to the front side of the photoetching machine body in a sliding mode, the fixed connecting plate is fixedly connected to the left side of the photoetching machine body, the rubber connecting bag is adhered to the right end face of the fixed connecting plate, the sliding connecting plate is connected to the left side of the photoetching machine body in a sliding mode, the switch extrusion rod is fixedly connected to the inner side of the sliding connecting plate, and the push switch is arranged on the inner side of the fixed connecting plate.

title_en: Aircraft guidance control method under passing point constraint
abstract_en: The invention provides an aircraft guidance control method under the constraint of passing points, which comprises the steps of 1, discretizing a guidance control process, 2, carrying out sectional processing on the guidance process limiting the passing points, 3, solving a state transition control sequence among the passing points, 4, solving the passing speed of the passing points, 5, calculating an integral guidance process, wherein the position and speed states of all the passing points are known, the integral guidance process is divided into k relatively independent guidance processes, and guidance control is carried out between two adjacent passing points according to the step 1. The invention realizes the guidance control of the aircraft under the constraint of the guidance time and the passing point, solves the coupling problem in the guidance problem which is difficult to effectively solve in the prior art, can accurately give the relative motion track of the guidance and the cost of the guidance control, has smoother control track, is suitable for various guidance control processes based on model prediction and inversion, and can provide engineering implementation methods for guidance control tasks of various scenes.

title_en: Electronic device and method for transmitting data to cluster traveling vehicles
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electronic device and a method for transmitting data to a cluster traveling vehicle. The electronic device comprises a camera, a communication circuit, a memory for storing a neural network model and instructions, and a processor operatively connected to the camera, the communication circuit and the memory. The instructions, when executed by the processor, enable the electronic device to obtain an image via the camera, identify a first classification result of an object contained in the image using the image and the neural network model, transmit, via the communication circuit, a feature map of the image-based neural network model to an external electronic device contained in a subsequent vehicle on which the electronic device is mounted, obtain, via the communication circuit, a second classification result of the object calculated in the external electronic device based on the feature map from the external electronic device, and determine whether the vehicle is traveling as a preceding vehicle based on the first classification result and the second classification result.

title_en: Ecological irrigation decision dynamic optimization method and related equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent agriculture and ecological Internet of things, in particular to a dynamic optimization method for ecological irrigation decision and related equipment. The method comprises the steps of acquiring multisource environment data, acquiring soil profile humidity gradients in real time through a soil humidity sensor array, acquiring future rainfall probability distribution, temperature change rate and wind speed predicted values by combining a weather forecast interface, and synchronously accessing a geographic information system to acquire terrain elevation and crop distribution data. The invention systematically solves three technical bottlenecks of model dimension collapse, parameter estimation instability and optimization response lag in the traditional irrigation decision system by constructing a space-time coupling analysis frame and a closed-loop optimization mechanism of multi-source heterogeneous data.

title_en: Semi-dry deacidification control method and device and terminal equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a semi-dry deacidification control method, a device and terminal equipment, which belong to the field of deacidification process equipment control, wherein the semi-dry deacidification control method comprises the steps of reading acid gas data measured by a flue gas component analyzer and a flue gas temperature value measured by a flue gas temperature sensor; the method comprises the steps of determining a concentration value of each acid gas, determining a first acid gas with the largest difference value corresponding to the preset target concentration value from the concentration values of the acid gases, regulating and controlling the deacidification agent slurry supply regulating equipment according to the concentration value of the first acid gas, and regulating and controlling the deacidification agent configuration regulating equipment according to the difference value of the flue gas temperature value deviating from the preset temperature value range when the flue gas temperature value does not belong to the preset temperature value range.

title_en: Implementation method of intelligent coal mine monitoring data transmission system
abstract_en: The present invention provides a method for implementing an intelligent coal mine monitoring data transmission system, which includes uniformly distributed edge devices and multiple sensing devices in the coal mine. The sensing devices are configured as covering devices and ancillary devices. The method for implementing the coal mine intelligent security inspection system provided by the present invention can quickly obtain real-time parameters of the coal mine environment, including temperature, gas concentration, etc., so as to provide early warning and ensure the safety of coal mine workers, and has a wide range of application prospects.

title_en: Intelligent automobile path tracking control method based on double-network iterative optimization
abstract_en: The intelligent automobile path tracking control method based on double-network iterative optimization aims to solve the problems of large calculated amount and insufficient instantaneity of model predictive control in a path tracking task. The invention relates to the field of automatic driving, which is characterized by comprising a subspace encoder network module and a control input increment sequence generation network module, wherein the specific implementation comprises two nested cyclic processes of prediction output sequence updating and control input sequence updating. The predicted output sequence is recursively generated through the process of updating the predicted output sequence, the transverse position error sequence is obtained through the process of updating the control input sequence, and the control input sequence is iteratively optimized. The two cyclic updating processes of the predicted output sequence updating and the control input sequence updating are repeated until the transverse position error sequence meets a preset threshold value. And finally, the first item in the control input sequence is output as the actual input of the vehicle system, so that the path tracking task of the intelligent driving vehicle is realized.

title_en: System and method for assembly line suitability analysis
abstract_en: The present invention provides a system and method for assembly line suitability analysis. A system and method includes obtaining data related to operation of an assembly line and generating a virtual environment of the assembly line using the obtained data. The virtual environment is defined using an assembly process model that is synchronized with the real-time assembly line data. Real-time assembly line data, historical data, and sensor data are used to simulate the tasks of one or more production line workers. The assembly line is rebalanced in real-time based on the simulation to reduce the travel time of one or more production line workers performing tasks.

title_en: Tumble monitoring method and device, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a fall monitoring method, a fall monitoring device, a storage medium and electronic equipment, and relates to the technical field of intelligent wearable equipment and sensor fusion. The method comprises the steps of collecting a first numerical value and a second numerical value of a headset wearer through sensing equipment arranged in the headset when the headset is detected to be in a wearing state, determining the motion state of the headset wearer according to the first numerical value and the second numerical value, determining a first detection threshold value and a second detection threshold value according to the motion state, determining whether the headset wearer is in a falling state according to the first detection threshold value, the second detection threshold value, the first numerical value and the second numerical value, and sending remote help seeking information through communication equipment arranged in the headset when the headset wearer is detected to be in the falling state. The intelligent earphone solves the technical problem that in the prior art, the intelligent earphone cannot effectively integrate the tumble detection function and the independent communication alarm function, so that independent emergency response cannot be realized through the earphone.

title_en: Door opening and closing event tracking system for safety management of metal ammeter box
abstract_en: The invention provides a door opening and closing event tracking system for safety management of a metal ammeter box, which relates to the technical field of ammeter box safety management, and specifically comprises a sensor module, an identity recognition module, a main control module, a communication module, a power module and a data storage module, wherein when the ammeter box door is opened or closed, a door magnetic sensor transmits a switch state signal to the main control module, if the ammeter box is subjected to abnormal vibration, the vibration sensor transmits vibration signals to the main control module, information such as time and personnel of a door opening and closing event can be recorded in detail through the identity recognition module, the back tracing is facilitated, and if the main control module judges that the door is opened abnormally or vibrates abnormally, the communication module sends early warning information to a manager, abnormal door opening and vibration conditions can be found timely, potential safety hazards are reduced, and the manager can check the state of the electric meter box at any time and any place through the remote server and the client.

title_en: Low-power consumption reference current source integrated circuit
abstract_en: The invention provides a low-power consumption reference current source integrated circuit, which respectively generates two currents in direct proportion and inverse proportion to absolute temperature through cascaded MOS tubes working in a weak inversion region, and generates reference current which is not affected by temperature through current superposition; the invention comprises a proportional current circuit and a reference output circuit, wherein the proportional current circuit generates a current Ipt which is proportional to absolute temperature under the condition of stable bias current and outputs the current Ipt to the reference output circuit, the reference output circuit generates a current Ict which is inversely proportional to absolute temperature and combines the current Ict which is inversely proportional to absolute temperature and the current Ipt which is directly proportional to absolute temperature to generate a reference current Iref which is not affected by temperature, and the circuit has a simple structure, and a main MOS tube in the circuit has extremely low requirement on working voltage and shows good energy conservation.

title_en: Mixed reality platform safety prompting method and system based on IOT equipment and early warning
abstract_en: The invention relates to a mixed reality platform safety prompting method and system based on IOT equipment and early warning, wherein the method comprises the following steps of classifying data transmission paths of the IOT equipment, matching communication protocols and acquiring control rights, and uploading acquired data information to a server; the method comprises the steps of constructing a multi-target deep learning early warning model, completing model training and testing based on high-voltage test scene historical data, forming an early warning algorithm, opening parameter setting permission, enabling a mixed reality platform to be connected with a server, embedding a parameter setting function of the early warning algorithm into the mixed reality platform, realizing that the mixed reality platform controls a safety threshold of an IOT device, visualizing server data through the mixed reality platform and carrying out safety auxiliary analysis, and triggering an automatic safety prompt when an MR device loaded with the mixed reality platform is subjected to high-voltage test, so that dangerous points are avoided. The invention has the advantages of equipment integration, data intercommunication, intelligent early warning accuracy improvement and the like.

title_en: Continuous track integrated speed planning method, device, electronic equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of motion control, in particular to a continuous track integrated speed planning method, a device, electronic equipment and a medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps of obtaining a continuous track to be planned, converting the continuous track to be planned into a standard type continuous track, constructing an integrated speed limit list based on the standard type continuous track, scanning the integrated speed limit list through a preset forward and reverse bidirectional scanning method to obtain a scanned integrated speed limit list, generating an integrated speed planning curve based on the scanned integrated speed limit list, interpolating the standard type continuous track based on the integrated speed planning curve to obtain an integrated interpolation point row, and obtaining an integrated speed planning result according to the integrated interpolation point row, so that the problems of limited application range and poor universality of a speed planning method in the related technology are solved, and the universality of integrated speed planning of the continuous track is improved.

title_en: Rock burst monitoring and early warning method and system based on multi-source information fusion
abstract_en: A rock burst monitoring and early warning method and system based on multi-source information fusion comprise the steps of collecting multi-dimensional data of a target mining area, integrating the multi-dimensional data by adopting a Kalman filtering fusion algorithm, generating a three-dimensional geological structure model of the target mining area by using a geological structure inversion method, dividing the three-dimensional geological structure model into areas, predicting rock burst risk levels of all areas by using a rock burst risk prediction model, and carrying out hierarchical early warning. The system comprises a data acquisition module, a data fusion module, a model construction module, a region division module, a risk prediction module, a grading early warning module and an alarm, wherein the data acquisition module is used for acquiring multidimensional data of a target mining area, the data fusion module is used for carrying out integrated processing on data, the model construction module is used for generating a three-dimensional geological structure model, the region division module is used for carrying out region division on the three-dimensional geological structure model, the risk prediction module is used for carrying out risk prediction, the grading early warning module is used for carrying out early warning grading, and the alarm is used for executing grading early warning action. The method and the system can realize accurate monitoring and intelligent early warning of rock burst.

title_en: Remote fault monitoring method and system for automatic laser control
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of program control, and particularly discloses a remote fault monitoring method and a remote fault monitoring system for automatic control of a laser, wherein the method comprises the following three core steps of firstly, monitoring the running states of the laser and an optical resonant cavity in real time, analyzing running stability parameters, judging whether to start remote regulation or not based on a preset threshold value and algorithm analysis, and ensuring that the laser works in an optimal state; the method comprises the steps of carrying out remote control, continuously tracking and controlling effective indexes, evaluating the control effect, screening potential fault risks by combining parameter changes after the control, triggering preliminary early warning, and finally grading fault severity by deeply mining fault characteristic parameters.

title_en: AI customer service and AR imaging-based small household appliance diagnosis system
abstract_en: The invention provides a small household appliance diagnosis system based on AI customer service and AR imaging, which relates to the field of information systems and management and comprises a management main system, wherein the management main system comprises an AI intelligent interaction module, an AR visual presentation module, a multi-source data fusion module, an intelligent diagnosis decision module, a fault prediction and prevention module, a user feedback learning module, a device linkage coordination module and a system core regulation and control unit. By means of a Kalman filtering algorithm and a principal component analysis algorithm, data noise is effectively removed, key features are extracted, a data base is built for an intelligent diagnosis decision module, and in the intelligent diagnosis decision module, a support vector machine and a Bayesian classification algorithm cooperatively operate, so that fault diagnosis accuracy is greatly improved.

title_en: Intelligent collision prevention method and device for unmanned ship
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent collision prevention method and device for an unmanned ship, which comprise the steps of obtaining ship data of the unmanned ship and an obstacle ship, confirming an absolute collision area according to the running speed of the unmanned ship, the radius of the unmanned ship, the running speed of the obstacle ship and the radius of the obstacle ship, confirming an uncertainty radius increment according to the position of the obstacle ship and the running time, carrying out area conversion on the absolute collision area according to the uncertainty radius increment and the position of the unmanned ship to obtain a speed obstacle area, confirming a target collision prevention speed according to the speed obstacle area and the running speed of the unmanned ship, controlling the unmanned ship to prevent collision through the target collision prevention speed, and establishing a multistage area conversion model to calculate the speed obstacle area according to the ship data of the unmanned ship and the obstacle ship, wherein the speed obstacle area considers the uncertainty of the position of the obstacle ship in different running times, and realizes collision prevention control based on dynamic speed adjustment.

title_en: Fuel gas cut-off valve device based on laser monitoring and communication linkage
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gas shut-off valve device based on linkage of laser monitoring and communication, and relates to the technical field of household gas monitoring systems and emergency shut-off valves. The invention comprises software and hardware. The software part comprises a gas collection and detection module, a detection result post-processing module and a mobile terminal APP, and can display the methane concentration in real time and remotely control an alarm, an indicator light, a window driving motor and an emergency cut-off valve. The hardware part comprises a laser detector adopting the TDLAS principle, a singlechip control integrated board, an alarm, a three-color LED, a window driving motor and an emergency cut-off valve. When the methane concentration is in different intervals, the system performs alarming, valve cutting and window opening actions in a grading manner, and multi-layer protection is achieved. The emergency cut-off valve adopts the cooperation of the permanent magnet main valve core and the reset spring, has electromagnetic, manual and motor driving redundant operation, and ensures the reliability. The device has high detection precision and reasonable response grading, has remote and automatic linkage functions, and remarkably improves the gas use safety.

title_en: Vehicle multi-obstacle detouring method and device, storage medium and computer equipment
abstract_en: The method, the device, the storage medium and the computer equipment for multi-obstacle detouring of the vehicle are characterized in that static obstacles and the parking positions of the obstacles in a target lane where the vehicle is located are identified in the running process of the automatic driving vehicle, global obstacle distribution information is provided for subsequent path planning, key detouring points of each parking position are generated, a continuous path is discretized into optimizable key nodes, and accordingly each key detouring point can be connected to form a first detouring path, the fact that the vehicle has an explicit guiding target in each stage is ensured, then path depression detection is carried out on the first detouring path, the key detouring points located at the depression positions in the detection result are marked as pits, so that key points needing to be optimized can be accurately located, and finally path optimization can be carried out on the first detouring path based on the pits to obtain a second detouring path, so that the automatic driving vehicle can detours a plurality of obstacles smoothly according to the second detouring path, and efficiency and safety are improved.

title_en: Leader-follower AUV formation track optimization method based on high-dynamic three-dimensional grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a leader-follower AUV formation track optimization method based on a high-dynamic three-dimensional grid, which comprises the steps of constructing a three-dimensional grid environment model, collecting barrier information, storing the barrier information into corresponding grids of the three-dimensional grid environment model, calculating a target value of each grid by using a reward and punishment function, planning a path according to the target value by using the leader AUV, acquiring a motion track, moving the follower AUV along the motion track, calculating track similarity in real time, and optimizing the formation track according to the similarity. The invention obviously improves the coordination of formation and provides an efficient and intelligent solution for the path planning of the formation of the autonomous underwater vehicle.

title_en: Magnetic knob, household appliance and control method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of household appliances, and discloses a magnetic knob, a household appliance and a control method thereof, wherein the magnetic knob comprises a knob body; the rotary knob comprises a knob body, a first magnetic piece, a detection mechanism and a controller, wherein the knob body is adsorbed on an installation panel through the first magnetic piece, the detection mechanism comprises a controller, a distance sensor and a spiral baffle arranged in the knob body, the distance sensor is used for detecting distance information between the spiral baffle and the distance sensor in the rotating process of the magnetic knob, and the controller is suitable for determining the rotating direction and/or the rotating angle of the magnetic knob according to the distance information detected by the distance sensor. The application can realize the detection of the rotation angle and the rotation direction of the magnetic knob by only matching one spiral baffle with the distance sensor, has simpler structure, lower cost, smaller occupied space and more convenient installation and layout, and effectively solves the problems of complex structure, large occupied space and low detection precision of the rotation detection mechanism of the magnetic knob in the prior art.

title_en: Expressway vehicle fee evasion checking method and system based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of intelligent transportation, and provides a highway vehicle fee evasion checking method and system based on multi-source data fusion, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a time stamp and vehicle characteristic information of a vehicle entering and exiting a highway; the method comprises the steps of obtaining actual dynamic running time of a vehicle based on a time stamp, judging whether the potential fee escaping phenomenon exists when the actual dynamic running time exceeds a dynamic driving time threshold value, otherwise judging whether the potential fee escaping phenomenon exists by acquiring path portal information in the running process of the vehicle, judging whether the potential fee escaping phenomenon exists when the path portal information is in a missing state, otherwise judging whether the potential fee escaping phenomenon exists according to vehicle characteristic information, judging whether the potential fee escaping phenomenon exists when the vehicle characteristic information of the vehicle is not matched with the vehicle characteristic information of the expressway, and finishing expressway vehicle fee escaping inspection based on multi-source data fusion, so that the potential fee escaping behavior of the expressway vehicle is accurately and efficiently identified, and the expressway charging rights and interests are ensured.

title_en: Monocular vision-based two-wheel vehicle running speed measuring method and device
abstract_en: The application provides a monocular vision-based two-wheeled vehicle running speed measurement method and device, which are applied to the field of vehicle data processing, and are used for preprocessing depth information in monocular vision data and calculating distances to generate distance calculation data, wherein the distance calculation data comprises a depth pixel point set, depth probability distribution, an abnormal depth value filtering result, a distribution weight depth value and a centroid weight depth value, dynamically tracking a two-wheeled vehicle based on a target tracking algorithm to generate tracking characteristic parameters, carrying out abnormal value filtering processing on adjacent frame displacement based on an adaptive displacement calculation method to generate target displacement data, processing the target displacement data to generate running speed dynamic change data and speed abnormal characteristics, processing the running speed dynamic change data based on preset overspeed judgment rules and speed abnormal characteristics to generate speed judgment data, and processing the speed judgment data and the tracking characteristic parameters to generate overspeed early warning information and overspeed vehicle snapshot instructions.

title_en: Grid-structured SVG-based flexible device for platform area and control method thereof
abstract_en: A transformer area flexible device based on network construction SVG comprises a distributed photovoltaic, a multi-active bridge converter, a network construction SVG, a parallel compensator and an energy storage device, wherein 3 converters on the power supply side of the multi-active bridge converter and 1 converter on the power grid side form three direct current links, a direct current port voltage model of each converter is built, a decoupling control model of the device is built based on the direct current port voltage model, an improved extreme learning machine method is adopted to carry out iterative solution on the decoupling control model of the device to obtain the phase shift ratio of each direct current port, and the modulation voltage phase of each converter is determined based on the phase shift ratio of each direct current port so as to control the multi-active bridge converter. And the energy exchange between the photovoltaic and the energy storage through a plurality of active bridge converters is supported, and the energy interaction between the photovoltaic and the power grid and the load is realized through SVG.

title_en: Long-acting gas alarm with self-calibration function
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of gas alarm and discloses a long-acting gas alarm with a self-calibration function, which comprises a first gas sensor, a second gas sensor, a self-calibration algorithm module, a mechanical sealing structure and a control algorithm module, wherein the first gas sensor is used for detecting methane concentration and outputting a first signal through a tunable laser absorption spectrum technology, the second gas sensor adopts a catalytic combustion type detection principle, the self-calibration algorithm module is used for dynamically calibrating zero points and sensitivity of the second gas sensor based on the first signal, and the mechanical sealing structure is used for selectively closing or opening an air inlet channel of the second gas sensor. The zero drift of the second gas sensor is automatically eliminated when the first gas sensor does not have gas, the sensitivity coefficient k of the second gas sensor is calculated under the condition that the first gas sensor stably outputs the gas concentration, and the full-automatic calibration of the gas without professional personnel, professional equipment or standard calibration is realized by combining the calibration data storage unit, so that the maintenance cost is reduced, the human error is avoided, and the service life of the second gas sensor is prolonged.

title_en: Equipment monitoring and alarming system and method for coating production line
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of production management systems, and discloses a device monitoring and alarming system and method of a coating production line, wherein the device monitoring and alarming system comprises the following modules: the equipment monitoring module is used for collecting the running state and running data of the bottom layer equipment or the PLC, the alarm module, the report query module, the trend query module, the personnel management module, the equipment management module, the field operation management module, the production plan management module and the energy management module. The coating informatization system with high reliability and maintainability is constructed by selecting and using advanced hardware devices in the Siemens PLC, WI NCC and the like and adopting a C# cross-platform development technology. The system supports long-time stable operation, has a perfect fault-tolerant mechanism and data processing capability, can realize real-time monitoring, fault positioning and historical data analysis of equipment, ensures continuous and stable operation of a production line, optimizes a production flow through data mining, and improves product quality and production efficiency.

title_en: Unmanned system, control device, unmanned method, method for manufacturing mobile body, and mobile body
abstract_en: The unmanned system includes a mobile body that can be moved by remote control, a remote control unit that remotely controls the mobile body, the remote control unit moving the mobile body from a first location of a factory where the mobile body is produced to a second location of the factory that is different from the first location, and an information acquisition unit that acquires information on an abnormality of the mobile body. When a predetermined condition is satisfied, the remote control unit moves the mobile body to a third location of the factory, which is different from both the first location and the second location, before the mobile body reaches the second location, the condition including information indicating that an abnormality has occurred in the mobile body before the mobile body reaches the second location.

title_en: Information providing method, information providing program, storage medium, and information processing apparatus
abstract_en: An information providing method for providing information to an occupant of an electric bicycle (10) includes a step of acquiring other vehicle position information that is information related to a current geographic position of another vehicle different from the electric bicycle (10), a step of generating display information based on the other vehicle position information, the display information being information for display on a portable terminal (8) provided at a position where the occupant can visually confirm and having a map area (821) displaying map information that contains information indicating the current geographic position of the other vehicle, and a step of displaying the display information on the portable terminal (8).

title_en: Intelligent monitoring device with anti-disassembly function
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent monitoring device with an anti-disassembly function, wherein an embedded optical fiber sign sensor accurately monitors parameters such as heart rate, respiration, snoring, apnea, body movement, on/off bed, cardiac arrest and the like of a user, an MEMS sensor is combined with the sign sensor to improve the accuracy of monitoring snore and apnea, and the MEMS sensor and a photoelectric sensor realize illegal disassembly alarm. The intelligent monitoring device adopts a special structural design, can be normally disassembled only by using a special tool, and gives a real-time alarm according to abnormal alarm data reported by a sensor when the intelligent monitoring device is illegally disassembled. Through the synergistic effect of the components, parameters such as heart rate, respiration, snoring, apnea, cardiac arrest, body movement, on/off bed and the like of a user can be detected, potential safety hazards such as sudden death, sudden diseases and the like can be effectively prevented in a monitoring scene, and digital intelligent decision assistance is provided for intelligent supervision.

title_en: Intelligent radio frequency door for product warehouse-in and warehouse-out and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent radio frequency door for product entering and exiting and entering and a control method thereof, which relates to the technical field of radio frequency doors and comprises a door frame, wherein a control machine is arranged at the top of the door frame and used for controlling relevant instructions of product entering and exiting and is connected with a processor end through an intranet signal, a plurality of read-write parts are respectively arranged at two sides of the inner wall of the door frame and used for carrying out radio frequency identification on a tag end carried by a metering product so as to acquire storage information of the tag end, a group of first identification cameras are arranged at one side of the inner wall of the door frame and are staggered with the read-write parts at the same side, an alarm is arranged at the top of the door frame, a group of verification components are arranged at one side of the outer wall of the door frame in the entering and exiting direction and used for determining the content of a warehouse entry work order and operating user authentication.

title_en: Fault cause determining method, device and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fault cause determining method, a fault cause determining device and a computer readable storage medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining fault point parameters corresponding to fault points in equipment assembly, determining M pieces of equipment corresponding to the fault points according to the fault point parameters, constructing a virtual equipment connection model according to equipment wiring images, determining Q fault reasons and corresponding operations for generating fault point faults according to the virtual equipment connection model and the fault point parameters, sequentially displaying the operations corresponding to the Q fault reasons respectively, and receiving actual detection results until the corresponding actual detection results are fault recovery, so that target fault reasons are obtained. The invention solves the technical problems that after the equipment is assembled for simulation training in the related technology, when the actual equipment is assembled according to the training content, a plurality of faults still occur in the assembling and the use process after the assembling, and the fault reasons are difficult to determine, so that the faults are difficult to solve.

title_en: Frequency modulation control method and system for thermal power generating unit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a frequency modulation control method and a frequency modulation control system for a thermal power generating unit, and relates to the technical field of frequency modulation control, wherein the frequency modulation control method comprises the steps of collecting a frequency modulation instruction signal of a power grid, and decomposing the frequency modulation instruction signal to obtain a plurality of eigen-mode function components and residual components; the method comprises the steps of carrying out frequency spectrum analysis on each eigen mode function component, marking the component with main frequency exceeding a high-frequency disturbance frequency threshold as a high-frequency disturbance component, calculating fluctuation amplitude and change rate, generating a thermal system control instruction through a PID control algorithm, adjusting coal feeding quantity and main steam pressure, generating an auxiliary compensation control instruction for the high-frequency disturbance component through a fuzzy control algorithm, converting the thermal system control instruction and the auxiliary compensation control instruction into operation parameters of a thermal power unit control mechanism, issuing and executing the operation parameters, triggering an optimization flow when the deviation of a control effect continuously exceeds a deviation threshold, and obviously improving the frequency modulation stability and equipment safety of the unit in the environment of a new energy high-proportion access power grid.

title_en: Processing method and system for multi-source data fusion based on high-precision positioning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a processing method and a processing system for multi-source data fusion based on high-precision positioning, which belong to the technical field of computer data processing and comprise the following steps of S1, aggregating multi-source heterogeneous data within node coverage area in real time, S2, calculating and obtaining a dynamic risk index of each individual through an individualized risk index calculation model based on the multi-source heterogeneous data, S3, generating a service quality grade of each individual according to the dynamic risk index and a preset risk threshold, S4, calculating and obtaining unconstrained expected frequency through an index scaling model based on the dynamic risk index of each individual, and S5, calculating the total bandwidth of a network which is expected to occupy based on the unconstrained expected frequency of all the individuals.

title_en: Absorption tower inlet SO2Automatic coal blending adjusting method for concentration
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic coal blending adjusting method and system for SO  2  concentration at an inlet of an absorption tower, and relates to the technical field of boiler operation and pollutant control of coal power plants; calculating SO  2  concentration deviation at the inlet of the absorption tower according to the corrected real-time sulfur parameters and boiler operation parameters, determining a causal responsibility coefficient of SO  2  concentration for adjusting coal blending by combining sensitivity analysis, inputting the causal responsibility coefficient and the SO  2  concentration deviation into a unified optimization target, calculating to obtain coal quantity adjustment quantity of each coal feeder under the condition of meeting total heat conservation and upper and lower limit constraints of the coal quantity, and controlling the coal feeder to operate. The convergence rate of the concentration deviation of SO  2  is quickened, the fluctuation risk in the control process is reduced, and the stable, compliance and efficient desulfurization effect are maintained.

title_en: Nonlinear control method and system for telescope shafting control
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nonlinear control method and a nonlinear control system for telescope shafting control, and belongs to the technical field of closed-loop control. The method effectively inhibits limit cycle oscillation caused by large friction through segmentation error adjustment and output amplitude limiting. The method dynamically adjusts the control output based on the position error by firstly calculating the position error, adopting nonlinear adjustment (parameter adjustment) when the error exceeds a segmentation threshold value, and outputting in proportion otherwise. The output value is subjected to amplitude limiting processing, so that the speed is ensured to be within a safe range. The invention obviously reduces the error peak-to-peak value and root mean square value of the sinusoidal signal tracking, reduces the quantity of adjusting parameters and is convenient for engineering application. The method is not only suitable for high-precision control of telescope shafting, but also can be popularized to other closed-loop control systems needing friction interference resistance.

title_en: Cloud-collaboration-based self-balancing two-wheeled vehicle remote control system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of intelligent technical transportation and automatic control, and discloses a cloud-cooperation-based self-balancing two-wheeled vehicle remote control system, which comprises a vehicle-mounted terminal module, a self-balancing two-wheeled vehicle, a remote control module and a remote control module, wherein the vehicle-mounted terminal module is configured on the self-balancing two-wheeled vehicle and is used for reporting data comprising the state of a vehicle and the intention of a rider and receiving a remote control instruction so as to be converted into a physical guiding force which can be perceived by the rider; the cloud collaborative service platform is used for aggregating and arbitrating data streams from all members in a motorcade, identifying grouped maneuvering intents, calculating personalized collaborative correction instructions for each member as the remote control instructions and then issuing the remote control instructions, and the user mobile application end is used for realizing user account management, motorcade creation and joining and collaborative mode selection. The invention solves the problems of remote control delay and stability, realizes the team cooperation of safety and smoothness of multiple vehicles, and improves the safety and user experience of the system.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle autonomous obstacle avoidance and dynamic path planning method and system based on multi-mode perception and hybrid intelligent decision
abstract_en: The invention provides an unmanned aerial vehicle autonomous obstacle avoidance and dynamic path planning method and system based on multi-mode perception and hybrid intelligent decision. Environmental parameters such as wind speed, illuminance, temperature and humidity and image quality indexes are acquired in real time through an airborne weather station, an IMU and a vision sensor, a flight parameter-image quality coupling model is established, and multi-objective optimization is realized by adopting Support Vector Regression (SVR) and Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO). And designing a dynamic strategy optimization module based on Q-learning, and designing a reward function by combining the image quality, the obstacle avoidance safety and the energy consumption. And constructing a three-dimensional barrier model in real time through ORB-SLAM3, calculating a dynamic risk coefficient, and generating a barrier avoidance track by adopting an improved APF-RRT (advanced power filter-remote sensing) algorithm. The online cooperative control module optimizes the control quantity by using a BFGS algorithm and ensures the flight stability and the task efficiency. The invention realizes high-precision obstacle avoidance and path planning of the unmanned aerial vehicle in a complex environment, has the characteristics of strong robustness and wide adaptability, and is suitable for practical application scenes such as inspection, mapping and the like.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle speed control method and system for space-time speed consistency constraint
abstract_en: The invention discloses a speed control method and a speed control system of an unmanned aerial vehicle with space-time speed consistency constraint, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the time controller binds virtual segment length according to unmanned aerial vehicle And target ground speed Remaining time from target waypoint And projection of the remaining distance Outputting time control law as ground speed instruction in real time The dynamic accurate control of the ground speed is realized. According to the invention, based on the target time and the target ground speed of the target waypoint and combined with the position and ground speed information output by the airborne sensor, a time control law is designed, so that the unmanned aerial vehicle can meet the functions of timing, speed setting and speed passing and fixing, and further meet the requirements of space, time and speed consistency of the unmanned aerial vehicle in complex cooperative tasks.

title_en: Building construction supervision system and method based on big data
abstract_en: The application discloses a building construction supervision system and method based on big data, comprising the steps of sending an alarm grade signal to a safety helmet when a supervision module detects that the safety helmet is close to an unsafe area or is in the unsafe area; the safety helmet alarms according to the alarm grade signal. The application gives an alarm to constructors attempting to enter the unsafe zone and simultaneously gives consideration to timely correction and timely verification of the existing unsafe zone. Meanwhile, in the correction process, the credibility analysis of the big data module is combined, and the different safety consciousness conditions of different personnel are fully considered.

title_en: Machining process self-adaptive adjusting system of laser cutting rotary workbench
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of general control or regulation systems, and discloses a self-adaptive regulation system for a machining process of a laser cutting rotary workbench, which comprises a regulator, a control module and a control module, wherein the regulator is used for synchronously collecting angle and displacement data of a C-axis before machining and executing harmonic analysis to identify harmonic parameters of a workpiece, and the regulator is used for executing quality control decision based on higher order harmonic and generating a feedforward compensation model by utilizing first order and second order harmonic parameters; the invention makes the control system obtain the capability of actively identifying the real geometric model of the workpiece before processing, and based on the feedforward compensation of the real model, the invention avoids the hysteresis of the traditional feedback control and ensures the stability of the processing process.

title_en: Chassis integrated controller and vehicle control system comprising same
abstract_en: A chassis integration controller according to an embodiment of the present invention includes a receiving portion that receives state information from each individual chassis controller configured on a vehicle and path information of the vehicle from a driving support system, a control signal generating portion that determines a target vehicle for moving the vehicle according to the path information and generates a control signal corresponding to each individual chassis controller so that the vehicle acts according to the path information, respectively, an action limiting portion that generates maximum curvature information that the vehicle can act based on at least one of the state information and road surface information, and a transmitting portion that transmits the maximum curvature information to the driving support system and the control signal to the individual chassis controller.

title_en: Power transmission line tree line contradiction and sag analysis method based on vision and laser radar multisource fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transmission line tree line contradiction and sag analysis method based on vision and laser radar multi-source fusion, which relates to the technical field of intelligent monitoring and analysis of transmission lines and comprises the steps of carrying out color space conversion and texture feature extraction on vision image data, generating a two-dimensional feature map, carrying out three-dimensional space coordinate calibration on laser radar point cloud data, establishing a three-dimensional space reference coordinate system, constructing a space position correlation matrix, calculating the three-dimensional space distance between a tree top point and the nearest point of the transmission line, extracting laser radar precise ranging data of a corresponding area when the three-dimensional space distance value is smaller than a preset safety threshold value, marking the tree line contradiction position and outputting tree line contradiction early warning information, calculating the vertical offset of wires between adjacent towers according to continuous space coordinate points in the three-dimensional space reference coordinate system, correcting sag measurement errors, and generating tree line contradiction analysis results. The invention realizes high-precision measurement of the sag of the power transmission line.

title_en: Ship intelligent steering method and system integrating nerve morphology calculation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ship intelligent steering method and system integrating nerve morphology calculation, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining characteristic values of a plurality of sensor data, screening out abnormal characteristic values of each sensor data, encoding the characteristic values into a nerve pulse event value set in a pulse mode, simulating response of neurons to abnormal information, expanding the nerve pulse event value set in a rudder angle strategy space to form nerve response intensity which dynamically changes along with time and is used for simulating response sensitivity of the neurons along all directions, projecting the nerve response intensity into the rudder angle strategy space to form a rudder angle strategy map which dynamically changes along with time, and extracting an optimal strategy rudder angle from the rudder angle strategy map as a final rudder angle of a ship, so that ship intelligent steering is completed.

title_en: Sentinel system for hydropower station underground factory building and implementation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sentinel system for an underground powerhouse of a hydropower station and an implementation method thereof, wherein the system comprises a positioning base station, an intelligent recorder, a WiFi gateway, a comprehensive management platform, a video analysis module, a positioning base station and the WiFi gateway, wherein the positioning base station is used for sending and receiving extremely narrow pulses, the intelligent recorder is provided with UWB labels and used for personnel positioning and data transmission, the WiFi gateway is used for providing local area network connection when a network is disconnected, the comprehensive management platform is used for processing positioning data and video call functions, the video analysis module is used for identifying abnormal conditions and alarming, the positioning base station and the WiFi gateway are installed in the powerhouse during operation, the intelligent recorder with the UWB labels is worn by workers, a positioning algorithm is executed, the position calculation precision is optimized, the video analysis function is realized, the abnormal conditions are identified by training model, a user-friendly comprehensive management platform interface is designed, hardware equipment and a software platform are in butt joint, collaborative work among all modules is tested, test running is carried out in an actual environment, feedback is collected, the system is further perfected, and the safety guarantee level of workers of the underground powerhouse is improved.

title_en: Method, device, equipment, medium and product for controlling intelligent household equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a device, equipment, a medium and a product for controlling intelligent household equipment, which are applied to the technical field of intelligent household, wherein the method comprises the steps of controlling the intelligent household equipment in an intelligent household environment to enter a target operation mode by responding to a user instruction; and under the target operation mode, determining the overall emotion states of all individuals in the intelligent home environment according to the sensor data acquired by the multi-mode sensor in the intelligent home environment, and controlling the intelligent home equipment according to the overall emotion states. According to the embodiment of the invention, the intelligent home equipment is controlled according to the overall emotion states of all individuals in the intelligent home environment, so that the equipment can adjust the running state of the equipment according to the emotion states in the dynamic environment, and the fine dynamic adjustment control of the equipment is realized.

title_en: Control device, control method, and computer-readable recording medium
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a control device, a control method, and a computer-readable recording medium, wherein a control device (10) collects data from each field device (20) constituting a plant via each input/output module, detects an input/output module having an abnormality among the input/output modules based on the collected data, and determines whether or not the control device (10) has a soft error based on the number of input/output modules having the abnormality detected.

title_en: Fixed time preset performance control method and device for macro-micro composite motion platform
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of measurement control, and relates to a method, a device, computer equipment and a storage medium for controlling the fixed time preset performance of a macro-micro composite motion platform; the dynamic system model is converted into a state space equation suitable for a feedback recursion control framework, a fixed time preset performance function is designed to enable a tracking error signal to be restrained within a preset range in fixed time, a nonlinear filter is constructed, a control design process is simplified, a switching function is established to solve coupling items in the system, a self-adaptive fixed time preset performance tracking control algorithm is designed, and stability of a closed loop system is proved based on Lyapunov stability theory. The controller is designed by the self-adaptive feedback recursion control framework, so that the control design process is simplified, the calculated amount is reduced, the tracking error signal of the closed-loop system is ensured to be converged into a preset range within a fixed time, and the transient performance and control precision of the system are improved.

title_en: Novel ship collision risk index fuzzy evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel fuzzy evaluation method for ship collision risk indexes, which constructs a fuzzy dynamic elliptic ship field model, can dynamically adjust the ship field, establishes a risk membership function of the nearest meeting distance and the nearest meeting time of two ships by determining the number of intersection points of a motion line equation and a dangerous field boundary, simultaneously establishes a risk membership function of the distance between the two ships, a risk membership function of the relative azimuth and a risk membership function of a speed ratio, acquires membership weight vectors, further generates responsibility parameters by combining urgent situation conditions, and acquires the collision risk of the two ships so as to evaluate the ship collision risk. According to the invention, the real-time dynamic assessment of the ship collision risk in the near-water area is realized by constructing the fuzzy dynamic elliptic ship field and the bidirectional risk assessment frame. And the risk weights of the straight-going ship and the yielding ship are distinguished through the responsibility parameters, so that the collision avoidance decision accords with COLREGs rules, and the accurate assessment of the collision risk of the ship is realized.

title_en: Method and system for designing a drive system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a computer-supported method for designing at least one drive system, the drive system directly affecting a controlled system segment, (S1) providing a drive twinning of the drive system and a system segment model of the controlled system segment, (S2) linking the drive twinning with the system segment model to form an overall twinning of the overall system, parameterizing during the linking of the drive twinning, determining an initial set of parameters of the drive twinning, (S3) running the overall twinning to obtain a simulation result, (S4) designing the drive system according to the initial set of parameters, (S5) comparing the simulation result with a behaviour of the overall system, (S6) if the result deviates, optimizing at least the drive twinning in terms of predefined optimization objectives by altering one or more parameters from the initial set of parameters related to the predefined optimization objectives to minimize the deviation of the behaviour of the overall system from the simulation result, obtaining an optimized set of parameters of the drive twinning, (S7) designing the drive system according to the optimized set of parameters.

title_en: Scoliosis active training method and system based on biofeedback
abstract_en: The application discloses a scoliosis active training method and system based on biofeedback, relating to the field of scoliosis training, firstly, establishing a dedicated initial median frequency, a standard action IMU template and a personalized fatigue threshold value for each user through a personalized baseline calibration stage. In the training stage, multi-mode synchronous analysis is carried out on sEMG and IMU data, and the median frequency fatigue index reflecting the muscle fatigue degree and the action deviation reflecting the gesture accuracy are calculated in real time. Finally, the decision engine synthesizes the two indexes and the personalized threshold value to judge, thereby realizing accurate and real-time early warning of muscle fatigue and action deformation. According to the scheme, the problem that fatigue and action quality cannot be monitored simultaneously in dynamic training in the prior art is solved by establishing the personalized model and fusing myoelectricity and gesture information, and the safety and effectiveness of training are remarkably improved.

title_en: Bioreactor aeration self-adaptive control method and system based on machine learning
abstract_en: The invention provides a self-adaptive control method and a self-adaptive control system for aeration of a bioreactor based on machine learning, wherein a sensor acquires the water inflow, ammonia nitrogen concentration, dissolved oxygen concentration, water temperature and chemical oxygen demand data of the bioreactor in real time, and after water quantity balance verification and Kalman filtering pretreatment of a water temperature compensation term, an aeration instruction is generated by adopting a multi-model cooperation mode, wherein the aeration instruction comprises the output reference aeration quantity of a deep reinforcement learning DRL model; the self-adaptive PID controller dynamically adjusts the proportional coefficient according to the dissolved oxygen deviation and calculates the correction quantity, the LSTM network generates the fusion weight, and the final aeration quantity is synthesized by combining the seasonal compensation factor and the safety coefficient. The system is verified through mutation rate constraint and nitration efficiency, when deviation exceeds standard, an ASM1 model is triggered to recheck, after passing, an instruction is executed by a blower with the precision of +/-2%, and closed loop feedback is carried out at a period of less than or equal to 10 seconds. After implementation, the aeration energy consumption is reduced to 0.38 kWh/m < 3 >, the ammonia nitrogen standard reaching rate of the effluent is improved to 98.5%, the fluctuation range of dissolved oxygen is reduced to +/-0.3 mg/L, and the impact load response time is shortened to 15 minutes.

title_en: Intelligent construction early warning device, railway construction early warning system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent construction early warning device, a railway construction early warning system and a railway construction early warning method, wherein the railway construction early warning system comprises a vehicle-mounted protection alarm device, an intelligent construction early warning device, a radar monitoring device, a server and a mobile alarm device; the intelligent construction early warning device comprises a first controller, a server and a mobile alarm device, wherein the first controller is used for receiving and sending the incoming vehicle early warning signal or the radar scanning signal, the server is used for analyzing the incoming vehicle early warning signal or the radar scanning signal and sending a long-distance alarm signal or a short-distance alarm signal, and the mobile alarm device executes a first alarm strategy or a second alarm strategy based on the long-distance alarm signal or the short-distance alarm signal. The invention realizes double early warning of railway construction, is beneficial to increasing the distance of early warning detection, further ensures the safety of a construction area and reduces the occurrence of safety accidents.

title_en: Discharge control method, system, stirring station and machine-readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a discharging control method, a discharging control system, a stirring station and a machine-readable storage medium, and relates to the technical field of engineering machinery.
