The method comprises the steps of determining a target unloading device based on an acquired task list and states of all unloading devices in an unloading device waiting area, generating a plurality of candidate paths from the current position to the target unloading area of the target unloading device after the target unloading device finishes receiving materials, screening out target paths from the plurality of candidate paths based on path information of other unloading devices, controlling the target unloading device to move to the target unloading area based on the target paths to finish unloading, and controlling the target unloading device to return to the unloading device waiting area to wait for the next unloading task. The production of decoupling mixing plant and the material receiving of the mixing transport vehicle are performed through the parallel operation of the multiple discharging devices, the safe and orderly movement of the multiple discharging devices is ensured through the dynamic obstacle avoidance technology, the production efficiency is improved, and the energy loss is reduced.

title_en: Control method and system for detecting camera
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of camera detection and discloses a control method and a control system for detecting a camera, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring initial image data and initial quality data of the camera to be detected through an image data detection device and a quality data detection device, and analyzing and determining a target damage state evaluation value and a quality abnormality evaluation value; and respectively comparing the historical damage state evaluation threshold value and the historical quality abnormality evaluation threshold value with the target damage state evaluation value and the quality abnormality evaluation value, judging whether to process the camera through comparison, obtaining a real-time production line trust value according to the processed data and the detection data, and comparing the real-time production line trust value with the historical production line trust value to generate corresponding early warning information. The invention realizes the comprehensive and accurate detection of the camera and the dynamic control of the quality of the production line, and improves the detection efficiency and reliability.

title_en: Seed disc paying-off speed control method and device for preventing seed ropes from loosening and tensioning
abstract_en: The invention provides a seed disc paying-off speed control method and device for preventing seed ropes from loosening and tensioning, and relates to the technical field of agricultural production, and the method and device specifically comprise the steps of collecting advancing speed of a rope planter and seed rope tension signals in real time, and obtaining effective data after filtering and noise reduction treatment; the method comprises the steps of calculating an expected tension reference value based on the travelling speed and seed rope radius data, comparing the actual measured tension with the expected tension reference value to obtain a tension deviation amount, judging whether the seed rope is in a loose, tensioned or normal state according to the fact that the deviation amount exceeds a preset tolerance range, calculating a speed compensation amount according to the magnitude, the direction and the current speed of the deviation if the state is abnormal and the deviation is in a controllable range through a feedback control algorithm, calculating a basic paying-off speed according to the travelling speed and the seed rope winding density, generating a target rotating speed after the compensation amount is overlapped, sending the target rotating speed to a speed control executing mechanism, driving the seed rope to rotate according to the target speed, and returning the tension deviation to the tolerance range through adjusting the paying-off speed, so that the normal stress state of the seed rope is maintained.

title_en: Intersection vehicle delay information analysis method and device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to an analysis method and device for vehicle-average delay information of an intersection, wherein the method comprises the steps of taking any intersection as a current intersection, counting the total number of uncoordinated/coordinated phase lanes of the current intersection, calculating the vehicle-average delay time of each uncoordinated phase lane of the current intersection based on intersection attribute parameters of the current intersection, calculating the vehicle-average delay time of each coordinated phase lane of the current intersection and the green wave bandwidth of the last coordinated phase lane of the current intersection based on intersection attribute parameters, calculating the random delay time of the current intersection, calculating corresponding intersection vehicle-average delay information based on the vehicle-average delay time of all uncoordinated/coordinated phase lanes and the intersection random delay time, and storing the corresponding intersection vehicle-average delay information. The invention can improve the analysis accuracy of the delay information of the vehicles at the intersection.

title_en: Personalized education robot based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention provides an artificial intelligence-based personalized education robot which comprises a platform, wherein a telescopic frame is slidably arranged at the top of the platform, a mounting seat is fixedly arranged at the top of the telescopic frame, a screen end is rotatably arranged on the surface of the mounting seat through a damping rotating shaft, a monitoring component is fixedly arranged on the surface of one end of the platform, the rotating component comprises a toothed ring, the technical field of the education robot is related to the rotating component, a driving component rotates and opens the screen end in a first storage groove according to use requirements, a moving component and the driving component are connected, the moving wheel and a driving wheel can be synchronously exposed to contact with the ground, the device is switched to be in a moving robot state for use, the device can be switched to be in a desk type robot state for use by independently opening the screen end, and the device monitors and detects a front road through the monitoring component when in moving, so that the robot is more convenient to adjust and is suitable for different occasions.

title_en: Maximum power point tracking device and control method for proton exchange membrane fuel cell
abstract_en: The invention provides a maximum power point tracking device and a control method of a proton exchange membrane fuel cell, wherein the maximum power point tracking device comprises a PEMFC pile and an input current/output power double closed-loop DC/DC converter, the PEMFC pile is connected with the input current/output power double closed-loop DC/DC converter, and the input current/output power double closed-loop DC/DC converter is used for adjusting the output current of the PEMFC pile and converting the output current into corresponding output voltage or output power. Meanwhile, the invention also discloses a control method thereof. The invention has obvious advantages in adapting to the variation of the operation parameters of the PEMFC system, avoids the oscillation phenomenon near the maximum power point and improves the tracking precision and stability. Meanwhile, the method has the advantages of smaller calculated amount, stronger instantaneity, capability of rapidly responding to the dynamic change of the PEMFC system and good working condition adaptability, and provides an efficient and reliable solution for tracking the maximum power point of the PEMFC system.

title_en: Remote batch management method for vehicles, server and vehicles
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of power-off control in a vehicle remote control system, in particular to a vehicle remote batch management method, a server and vehicles, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining vehicle identifications of a plurality of vehicles and power-off time of each vehicle; the method comprises the steps of generating a power-off instruction of each vehicle according to a vehicle identifier and power-off time, generating a batch management instruction of a plurality of vehicles according to the power-off instruction of each vehicle, issuing the batch management instruction to vehicle-mounted communication terminals of the vehicles, analyzing the batch management instruction by the vehicle-mounted communication terminals, determining the power-off instruction of the corresponding vehicle according to the vehicle identifier, executing power-off operation by a battery management system according to the power-off instruction, feeding back a power-off result to the vehicle-mounted communication terminals through a communication path, supplying power by the vehicle-mounted communication terminals based on a standby power supply, and feeding back the power-off result to a server. Therefore, the problems that the vehicle is not powered off in batches remotely and the power-off state cannot be fed back in the related art are solved.

title_en: Autonomous robot coverage control system based on multi Jetson cooperation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of robot control and distributed autonomous systems, and particularly relates to an autonomous robot coverage control system based on multi Jetson cooperation, which is realized based on an ROS2 robot operating system and a multi Jetson embedded computing platform and comprises multi-sensor data acquisition, pose fusion and positioning, pose processing and neighbor recognition, neighbor detection and event judgment, data synchronization and cyclic scheduling, perception radius dynamic adjustment, voronoi region fine calculation and weighted centroid calculation, control law calculation and saturation constraint, target point release and path execution, asynchronization and energy-saving control, wherein the ten stages are independently executed on each Jetson trolley local ROS2 node, and the whole system operates in an asynchronous distributed mode, so that autonomous coverage control can be realized without a central control node. The invention can solve the problems of complex synchronization, high energy consumption, communication dependence and the like in the existing multi-robot distributed coverage control.

title_en: Experimental electric furnace temperature control method, equipment, medium and product based on self-adaptive learning
abstract_en: The application discloses an experimental electric furnace temperature control method, equipment, medium and product based on self-adaptive learning, and relates to the field of experimental electric furnace temperature control, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a temperature composite control model based on a long-term memory network and a fuzzy PID control algorithm; the temperature composite control model adopts a long-period memory network to predict the temperature deviation of the input temperature parameter in the future set time period of the experimental electric furnace, dynamically adjusts PID parameters according to the deviation level of the experimental electric furnace determined by the temperature deviation through a fuzzy PID control algorithm, adopts the temperature composite control model according to the current temperature parameter, determines updated PID parameters, dynamically compensates the power of a heating element in the experimental electric furnace according to the updated PID parameters, and iteratively optimizes the temperature composite control model according to the real-time temperature parameters. The application can improve the precision, the synergy and the safety of the remote control of the temperature of the experimental electric furnace.

title_en: Dynamic farmland drought partitioning and early warning method and system based on multisource space-time data
abstract_en: The invention relates to a farmland drought dynamic partitioning and early warning method and system based on multisource space-time data, wherein the method comprises the following steps of obtaining a monitoring range; the method comprises the steps of carrying out rasterization on a monitoring range to obtain a plurality of grids, determining index values of monitoring indexes of the grids, wherein the monitoring indexes comprise a terrain condition index, a soil moisture content index, a climate drought index, a historical disaster damage index and a crop vulnerability index, evaluating drought risk indexes of the grids according to the index values of the monitoring indexes of the grids, and carrying out early warning according to the drought risk indexes of the grids. The method of the invention carries out rasterization on the monitoring range, monitors each grid, can realize personalized monitoring of different areas in one monitoring range, and can avoid the problem that one prevention and control grade does not meet the actual drought early warning requirement of farmlands when the area of the prevention and control area is large because different grids in one monitoring range possibly have different prevention and control grades.

title_en: Desilting device for adjusting underwater water level based on air pressure and water level control method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of underwater operation, in particular to a dredging device for adjusting underwater water level based on air pressure and a water level control method. The dredging device comprises a cover body, a power piece, a dredging mechanism, a compressed air supply assembly, a sensing assembly and a central controller, wherein the cover body is connected with a carrier on the water surface through a bridge, the power piece is arranged on the carrier, a driving end is connected with the bridge, an exhaust port is arranged at the top of the cover body and communicated with an exhaust pipeline, a plurality of air inlets are arranged on the circumferential side wall of the cover body at intervals, each air inlet is arranged above a target water level in the cover body, the dredging mechanism is arranged in the cover body through a connecting piece, the compressed air supply assembly is used for supplying compressed air to the cover body, the sensing assembly is arranged on the cover body, and the central controller is connected with the sensing assembly, the power piece and the compressed air supply assembly. According to the water level control method, the dredging device is adopted, so that the water level of an underwater operation area can be effectively controlled rapidly and accurately according to the change of the external environment.

title_en: Furniture spraying processing control method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of furniture spraying processing, and discloses a furniture spraying processing control method and a furniture spraying processing control system. The method comprises the steps of carrying out fusion processing on multi-source data, and generating a standardized monitoring data set through data cleaning, time alignment and dimension normalization operation. A dynamic feature sequence reflecting the real-time variation of the spray parameters and a static feature set characterizing the physical properties of the furniture surface are then separated from the dataset. And carrying out pattern recognition on the characteristics by using a machine learning algorithm, establishing a spray quality prediction model, dynamically generating spray control parameters according to model output and acting on an executing mechanism, and continuously updating the model through a feedback mechanism. The method forms closed-loop control, improves monitoring comprehensiveness and quality prejudging capability, and adapts to complex spraying scenes.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and medium for predicting coating information of silicon steel coating
abstract_en: The application relates to a method, a device, equipment and a medium for predicting coating information of a silicon steel coating, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining basic parameters of a coating liquid in real time; the method comprises the steps of obtaining an initial quality predicted value of a coating in a unit area of silicon steel based on a coating liquid basic parameter and a preset initial quality predicted model, obtaining an initial thickness predicted value of the coating in the unit area of silicon steel based on the coating liquid basic parameter and the preset initial thickness predicted model, and obtaining a target quality predicted value and a target thickness predicted value of the coating in the unit area based on the initial quality predicted value and the initial thickness predicted value, wherein the target quality predicted value and the target thickness predicted value are final credible values for production control and quality judgment after correction amounts are overlapped on the corresponding initial predicted values. The dynamic correction mechanism eliminates systematic deviation caused by hydration reaction and magnesium carbonate generation, realizes online prediction and closed-loop control of coating parameters, and provides real-time data support for process parameter optimization.

title_en: Power transmission channel mountain fire risk early warning method and system based on space-time feature fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transmission channel forest fire risk early warning method and system based on space-time feature fusion, and relates to the technical field of risk early warning; according to the invention, a static inflammability background map is generated by constructing a power transmission channel risk grid and fusing historical multi-source data; the method comprises the steps of collecting real-time vision and microclimate data, and respectively extracting vision risk characteristics and environment inflammability trend characteristics by utilizing a double-branch space-time characteristic extraction network after space-time alignment treatment; the invention overcomes the defects of serious data island and inaccurate early warning, realizes the crossing of dynamic prediction from simple fire point monitoring to the risk situation, and remarkably improves the accuracy of mountain fire early warning and the intelligent level of power grid prevention and control.

title_en: Intelligent prediction and adjustment method and system for environmental parameters of dust-free workshop
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of dust-free workshop environment control, in particular to a method and a system for intelligently predicting and adjusting environmental parameters of a dust-free workshop, wherein the method comprises the steps of arranging a carbon dioxide sensor in the dust-free workshop, periodically collecting and comparing the carbon dioxide sensor with a target value to obtain deviation and change rate of the deviation; based on mass conservation, modeling takes air quantity as input and indoor carbon dioxide concentration as output, an air supply valve is equivalent to a first-order link with pure hysteresis, a concentration channel is also equivalent to a first-order link, controlled objects are formed in series, ITAE is used as an index, energy consumption penalty proportional to the third power of the air supply quantity is superimposed, PID parameter group search, nonlinear weighting and variable neighborhood iteration are carried out by cloud end through enhanced self-adaptive global optimization, an optimal value is output when the PID parameter group search and nonlinear weighting and variable neighborhood iteration reach a threshold value, parameters are issued through a wireless period, and the air supply valve is driven to be adjusted by local real-time PID operation according to the parameters. The invention can solve the problems of insufficient carbon dioxide concentration adjusting precision, low response speed and high energy consumption in the existing dust-free workshop.

title_en: Intelligent door lock
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent door lock, which comprises an outer lock mechanism and an inner lock mechanism, wherein the outer lock mechanism and the inner lock mechanism are respectively arranged at the inner side and the outer side of the door, a lock tongue for opening and closing the door lock is arranged between the outer lock mechanism and the inner lock mechanism, the outer lock mechanism comprises an outer lock shell, when the intelligent door lock is used, a user finishes identity verification through a fingerprint identification module/password input, a control board sends a pulse signal to a clutch mechanism after receiving a verification signal, the clutch mechanism starts to work and drives the clutch pressing plate to move upwards, the clutch pressing plate pushes the sliding rod to be clamped into the clamping groove of the clutch lock head, the clutch lock head and the outer lock seat are locked, at the moment, the user rotates the outer lock handle to drive the door lock bolt to retract and unlock through the clutch lock head, if the user cannot finish identity verification, the sliding rod is always far away from the clutch lock head under the acting force of the clutch spring, the clutch lock head and the outer lock seat are ensured to be completely separated, at the moment, the user rotates the outer lock handle to drive the outer lock seat to idle, and the anti-theft effect is good.

title_en: Monitoring control method of bubbler, semiconductor process equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a monitoring control method of a bubbler, semiconductor process equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a low liquid level feedback signal output by a liquid level sensor of the bubbler before the current furnace process is executed, determining the residual quantity of a liquid source in the bubbler according to the consumption of the liquid source in the bubbler if the low liquid level feedback signal is a liquid level normal signal, terminating the current furnace process flow if the residual quantity of the liquid source is lower than a preset low liquid level liquid source residual quantity threshold value, and outputting alarm information for prompting a user to check the bubbler. The application can timely and accurately monitor and capture the condition of too low liquid level, and avoids the problems that the actual liquid level is too low, but the low liquid level feedback signal is still a liquid level normal signal, so that the liquid level sensor cannot timely detect the condition of too low liquid level and continuous multi-furnace products are easy to discard due to the existence of bubbles above a liquid source or the damage of hardware of the liquid level sensor.

title_en: Intelligent inspection planning method and system for fixed-time behavior control of offshore wind turbine generator
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent patrol planning method and device for controlling fixed time behaviors of an offshore wind turbine, which comprises the steps of firstly constructing a multi-parameter coupling model comprising a maximum range, a return threshold, wind speed influence, altitude and battery energy consumption, integrating the multi-parameter coupling model into basic patrol behaviors of a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle system, and then combining a plurality of basic tasks into a composite behavior by adopting a zero space projection method according to task priorities, and generating expected merging speed. The speed is used as control input, an adaptive fixed time tracking controller is designed, unknown external disturbance is dynamically compensated in real time through an adaptive law, the system is described to be converged in fixed time through a Lyapunov function, and finally, an intelligent patrol planning device which is formed by combining an environment sensing module, a track planning module and a tracking control module in a closed loop mode is designed. Compared with a finite-time inspection planning method, the method has the advantages that the convergence time is independent of the initial state of the system, and the execution time of the inspection task of the multi-unmanned aerial vehicle system is reduced by 33.3%.

title_en: Temperature control method of heating unit, cooking equipment and oven
abstract_en: The application relates to a temperature control method of a heating unit, cooking equipment and an oven, which are characterized in that on one hand, the long-term and short-term attenuation states of the heating unit are evaluated in real time and the accurate compensation of the performance degradation and the real-time fluctuation of the heating unit is realized by combining distance sensing, on the other hand, the accuracy and uniformity of temperature control in the cooking process are ensured by planning differentiated temperature control tracks for different time segments and dynamically compensating power based on the distance and the attenuation states, and finally, the self-learning optimization of control parameters is realized by updating a historical database, and the long-term use performance and the intelligent level of the equipment are improved.

title_en: Control system for storing multiple unmanned aerial vehicle nests
abstract_en: The invention discloses a control system for storing a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicle nests, which mainly comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle nest control module, a communication module, a monitoring module and an unmanned aerial vehicle battery management module, wherein the unmanned aerial vehicle nest control module comprises an industrial personal computer PC and a PLC, the monitoring module comprises environment monitoring (a wind speed and direction sensor), video monitoring (a distance sensor, a camera, a positioning system and an image recognition system), and the control system comprises the following steps of communication connection, data collection, battery management, permission verification, instruction analysis and execution, and execution result feedback. According to the invention, the data of each machine nest is collected through integrating various sensors and monitoring equipment, the running state is analyzed, the maintenance requirement is predicted, the states of the machine nest and the unmanned aerial vehicle are perceived in real time, the safety and stability of the taking-off and landing process of the unmanned aerial vehicle can be ensured by the control system, and the efficient, safe and convenient management and control of the plurality of unmanned aerial vehicle nests and unmanned aerial vehicles are realized.

title_en: Water tank vacuumizing method and system based on liquid level in tank
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water tank vacuumizing method and system based on liquid level in a tank, and relates to the technical field of vacuum drainage, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining optimal blowdown negative pressure of a target water tank in different states as upper and lower limits of the optimal blowdown negative pressure; the method comprises the steps of obtaining the current liquid level height and the current vacuum value of a target water tank in real time, obtaining the current optimal blowdown negative pressure based on the upper limit and the lower limit of the optimal blowdown negative pressure and the current liquid level height, and starting a vacuum generating device until the current optimal blowdown negative pressure is reached when the current vacuum value is lower than the current optimal blowdown negative pressure. On the premise of minimum energy consumption, the optimal dirt absorbing effect of the water tank is realized.

title_en: Groove planting management method, device and system and controller
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of agricultural engineering, in particular to a method, a device and a system for managing groove planting and a controller. The method comprises the steps of receiving various environmental data of target crops at different time points, processing the various environmental data at different time points to obtain a target state vector, comparing the target state vector with preset growth model parameters of the target crops, determining the deviation degree of each parameter in the target state vector, determining a target control instruction according to the deviation degree of each parameter in the target state vector and an environmental factor coupling model, and indicating a plurality of target execution mechanisms to work according to respective corresponding execution priorities by the target control instruction. The method effectively avoids frequent actions and even mutual interference of the actuating mechanism in the traditional control, reduces energy consumption and improves the overall control precision.

title_en: Intelligent control method and system for electric heating towel rack
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent control method and system for an electric heating towel rack, which relate to the technical field of intelligent control, and are used for carrying out joint time sequence influence analysis on towels of the electric heating towel rack, further carrying out temperature control adjustment to obtain temperature control adjustment data, carrying out towel humidity control change monitoring according to temperature control, triggering a power adjustment mechanism according to monitoring information, determining mode switching data according to the power adjustment mechanism, carrying out a heating program of a corresponding mode, monitoring towel temperature heating deviation, carrying out deviation compensation to obtain mode heating data, carrying out temperature fine adjustment on a multi-section nested telescopic rod and a thermal distribution diagram thereof arranged on the electric heating towel rack according to the mode heating data, and obtaining drying heating configuration data according to the thermal distribution diagram.

title_en: Multi-constraint path planning method and device based on intelligent heuristic search, electronic equipment, storage medium and program product
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-constraint path planning method and device based on intelligent heuristic search, which are suitable for mobile robots in complex and narrow environments. The method comprises the steps of performing environment sensing and fusion mapping by using a multi-source sensor to generate a grid map, generating a guide map by adopting a neural heuristic search algorithm based on Mamba structures and a selective state space model (SELECTIVE SSM) on a cost map, generating a continuous and collision-free initial path by combining robot kinematics constraint and channel characteristics through self-adaptive step control, further establishing a multi-target constraint model based on a central European character distance field (RC-ESDF) of the robot, performing path smoothing and safety optimization by using a priori guided particle swarm optimization algorithm (Prior-guided PSO), and obtaining an optimal path meeting dynamics consistency, wherein the system corrects the path in real time by a closed loop feedback mechanism and triggers dynamic re-planning, so that the path feasibility, the safety and the real-time self-adaptive capacity of the robot in a limited environment are remarkably improved.

title_en: Double-wheel-leg robot motion control method and system based on automatic course reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a motion control method and a motion control system for a double-wheel-leg robot based on automatic course reinforcement learning. The method comprises the steps of parameterizing training tasks to construct a course space containing various difficulty parameters, dynamically sampling and generating the training tasks matched with the current capacity of the robot through an automatic course generation strategy, training a motion strategy network through a deep reinforcement learning algorithm, evaluating by utilizing multi-objective reward functions of fusion task completion, balance maintenance, energy consumption, smoothness and fall punishment, and adjusting course difficulty in real time according to training performance to form a closed-loop self-adaptive optimization system. The method effectively solves the problems of sparse rewards and low training efficiency, remarkably improves the robustness, the self-adaptability and the final performance of the motion strategy, does not need manual course design, and can be widely applied to high dynamic balance control scenes.

title_en: ESP 32-based intelligent home health cloud monitoring system for solitary old people
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ESP 32-based smart home health cloud monitoring system for solitary old people, which comprises a visual monitoring module, a human activity anomaly sensing radar module, an infrared fire point detection module, a home environment gas sensing module, an audible and visual alarm module, a main control module, a cloud platform and a client, wherein the visual monitoring module, the human activity anomaly sensing radar module, the infrared fire point detection module, the home environment gas sensing module and the audible and visual alarm module are respectively connected with the main control module, the main control module is in data interaction with the cloud platform through a wireless network and a protocol, and the cloud platform is in communication connection with the client. The intelligent monitoring system integrates multi-mode sensing data such as visual identification, millimeter wave radar, infrared thermal imaging, ambient gas sensing and the like, a more comprehensive health and safety monitoring network is constructed, the adaptability of the system to the complicated home environment of the solitary old and the accuracy of emergency identification are improved, and the robustness of the system is enhanced through cooperative processing of edge intelligence and a cloud platform.

title_en: Water level monitoring device with early warning function
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of water level monitoring equipment, and particularly discloses a water level monitoring device with an early warning function, which comprises a mounting rod, wherein one end of the mounting rod is fixedly connected with a mounting block, the surface of the mounting block is provided with a through hole, a monitoring mechanism is arranged in the through hole, the monitoring mechanism comprises a sliding rod which is connected in the through hole in a sliding way, the lower end of the sliding rod penetrates through the mounting block and is fixedly connected with a first floating body, the top of the first floating body is fixedly connected with an inserting block, the monitoring mechanism is arranged, the first floating body is used for driving the sliding rod to perform initial monitoring, the relay monitoring of a second floating body is released after limiting, and the problems that the monitoring rod is overlong and is easy to bend and deform due to water impact in a traditional device with a large water level fall are effectively solved. The device has a compact integral structure and high rigidity, thereby ensuring the measurement precision and the long-term stability of the equipment in the full water level variation range.

title_en: Temperature control method and graphene heating pad system applying same
abstract_en: The application provides a temperature control method and a graphene heating pad system applying the same, and relates to the technical field of temperature control, wherein the method comprises the steps of dividing a temperature area to be controlled into a plurality of subareas, acquiring target temperature data and real-time temperature data of each subarea, and calculating the temperature gradient of adjacent subareas based on the real-time temperature data of each subarea; and constructing a heat transfer attenuation model, calculating a temperature adjustment value required by each partition based on the target temperature data, the temperature gradient and the heat transfer attenuation model, and adjusting the temperature of each partition according to the temperature adjustment value required by each partition. The application can improve the accuracy and precision of temperature control.

title_en: Road risk point identification and hidden trouble investigation method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a road risk point identification and hidden trouble investigation method and system, and relates to the technical field of safe driving of vehicles. The method comprises the steps of collecting natural driving track data of a vehicle through intelligent vehicle-mounted terminal equipment to extract vehicle kinematic characteristics and road characteristics, establishing a two-layer clustering model, identifying risk driving behaviors of the driver, quantifying vehicle driving risks, identifying collision events when the vehicle approaches, quantifying the collision risks, quantifying the road risks according to the driving risks, identifying individualized road risk points and road public risk points of the driver, mining association relations between risk point causes and road structures by combining map information and identified road public risk point information, identifying potential road hazards, and combining real-time driving data of the vehicle according to identification results of the risk points and the potential road hazard points to generate risk early warning information to prompt the driver. The technical effect of improving the safety of public transportation is achieved.

title_en: Automatic driving safety early warning system based on AI and Beidou satellite
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of automatic driving early warning and discloses an automatic driving safety early warning system based on AI and Beidou satellites. The system synchronously collects historical normal data of Beidou positioning and vehicle-mounted sensors of the vehicle through a multi-source data collection module, a space-time data enhancement module expands the data based on space-time track similarity, and an interactive hybrid network construction module reconstructs a deep learning network of a unit. The real-time monitoring data stream processing module continuously receives and caches the real-time data stream, the implicit state space searching module searches the optimal state code which minimizes the real-time data reconstruction loss, and the risk situation assessment module calculates the comprehensive risk index. The multi-level early warning decision module generates a hierarchical early warning signal according to the parameter type and the risk level, thereby realizing accurate early warning and fault tracing of potential risks of an automatic driving system.

title_en: Vehicle, pedestrian recognition method, device and system
abstract_en: The application discloses a vehicle and pedestrian recognition method, device and system, the method comprises the steps of sending control instructions to each signal emitter, enabling each signal emitter to send respective detection signals according to the control instructions, enabling a pedestrian terminal device to generate feedback signals according to at least one detection signal after receiving at least one detection signal, obtaining the feedback signals, recognizing pedestrian attributes and pedestrian positions according to the feedback signals to obtain recognition results, determining whether collision risks exist between the vehicle and pedestrians according to the recognition results, and controlling the vehicle to execute anti-collision measures if the collision risks exist. The application can provide a parallel pedestrian recognition scheme when the existing pedestrian recognition scheme of the vehicle is wrong or even fails, and ensures the accuracy of pedestrian recognition of the vehicle.

title_en: Dampproof control method of electronic equipment and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a device dampproof control method and electronic equipment, which relate to the field of computers, wherein the electronic equipment responds to the dampproof trigger condition aiming at a dampproof control strategy to generate a starting instruction, and the electronic equipment is controlled to operate according to target dampproof parameters under the pre-starting environment of the electronic equipment in response to the starting instruction so as to dehumidify the interior of the electronic equipment through heat generated by operation.

title_en: Airing device
abstract_en: The application provides a drying device. The airing device comprises an airing structure, a storage structure, a mechanical arm assembly and a target object, wherein the storage structure is connected with the airing structure and provided with a storage space, the storage structure is arranged at least one of the airing structure and the storage structure and provided with a storage space, the mechanical arm assembly is movably arranged at the storage structure and provided with a storage state positioned in the storage space and an extension state extending out of the storage space, and the mechanical arm assembly is configured to be capable of moving the target object at the airing structure to the storage space when in the extension state. According to the airing device provided by the application, a target object (such as clothes) can be aired by utilizing the airing structure, the target object is protected by utilizing the storage structure, the spatial position of the target object is adjusted by utilizing the mechanical arm assembly, and the mechanical arm assembly is stored by utilizing the storage structure, so that the airing device has the airing, automatic collection and storage functions, the functional diversity and the practicability are increased, and the automation and intelligent degree is improved.

title_en: Adaptive optimization and collaborative decision-making system for large-caliber substrate spin coating process
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-adaptive optimization and collaborative decision-making system of a large-caliber substrate spin coating process, which comprises a spin coater, a multi-mode sensing array, an online state-parameter estimation module, a prediction controller, an execution mechanism, an event triggering type self-adaptive optimization module, a rapid safety constraint optimization module, an edge AI control device, a double-layer intelligent decision-making module and a natural language conversion module. According to the invention, through global multi-mode real-time monitoring and digital twin-based high-precision state estimation, film thickness distribution dynamics can be accurately captured and predicted, and further feedforward-feedback compound regulation and control are performed through model prediction control. The invention aims at solving the problem of stubborn edge thick peak in the spin coating process, and realizes the remarkable effect of reducing the edge thick peak by more than or equal to 60 percent by adjusting the solvent volatilization rate and the photoresist leveling behavior of the area through the synergic action of the zonal temperature control and the zonal airflow on the edge of the substrate. The invention has the advantages of improved calculation efficiency, safety, reliability and reduced energy consumption.

title_en: Automatic test method and system and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of power grid test, and provides an automatic test method, a system and electronic equipment, wherein in the automatic test system, a test control terminal is respectively connected with a scheduling plan simulation server, a network time protocol server and a power conversion system and is used for automatically starting the scheduling plan simulation server and the network time protocol server according to test cases, dynamically generating at least one scheduling plan table according to the test cases, uploading the at least one scheduling plan table to the scheduling plan simulation server and simultaneously controlling the power conversion system to perform time synchronization with the network time protocol server; the power conversion system is respectively connected with the scheduling plan simulation server and the network time protocol server and is used for requesting a target scheduling plan table from the scheduling plan simulation server according to own operation requirements and controlling output power according to the obtained target scheduling plan table on the premise of keeping time consistency with the network time protocol server.

title_en: Virtual bench model aging self-adaption method, device, equipment, medium and product
abstract_en: The invention discloses a virtual rack model aging self-adaption method, device, equipment, medium and product. The virtual rack model aging self-adaption method comprises the steps of obtaining actual operation data of a real vehicle, importing working condition data in the actual operation data into an SCR model of a virtual rack to simulate, obtaining a simulation result of the virtual rack, comparing the simulation result with actual result data in the actual operation data, determining whether an SCR system of the real vehicle is aged or not based on comparison deviation and the actual operation data, and optimizing model parameters of the SCR model with the minimum difference between the simulation result and the actual result data as a target under the condition that the SCR system is aged, so as to obtain optimized model parameters. According to the technical scheme provided by the embodiment of the invention, the model parameters of the SCR model in the virtual rack can be adaptively adjusted according to the aging degree of the SCR system, and the reliability of the simulation result is improved.

title_en: Vehicle control method, electronic device, storage medium, and program product
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a control method, electronic equipment, a storage medium and a program product of a spreading vehicle, and relates to the technical field of automatic control. Determining whether the proximity switch fails according to the event record, generating an analog signal if the proximity switch fails, and controlling the operation of the paving vehicle according to the analog signal and the current operation state of the paving vehicle. The invention can detect whether the proximity switch has faults or not, and when the proximity switch has faults, the running control of the auxiliary material vehicle is realized by generating the analog signal, so that the running continuity and stability of the material spreading vehicle are ensured.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle management method and system for multi-source data fusion of unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle management method and system for multi-source data fusion of unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises the steps of obtaining original monitoring data from various unmanned aerial vehicle detection devices, performing space-time standardization processing on the heterogeneous data, establishing a unified space-time reference, and then establishing an unmanned aerial vehicle mapping relation through target association matching, carrying out multi-source data fusion on standardized monitoring data after association mapping, finally carrying out airspace supervision analysis based on the generated comprehensive state data of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and outputting an airspace supervision decision report containing monitoring information, authentication state and early warning prompt. Through the collaborative sensing and fusion of the multi-source data, the problems of a sensing blind area, insufficient data reliability and the like of a single detection device are effectively solved, the full-time accurate supervision capability of a combined and non-cooperative unmanned aerial vehicle is remarkably improved, and reliable technical support is provided for airspace safety management.

title_en: Traffic infrastructure health remote monitoring system and method based on edge intelligence
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of structural health monitoring, and in particular relates to a traffic infrastructure health remote monitoring system and method based on edge intelligence, comprising the following steps of processing multisource structural state data by using a first edge intelligent processing unit and judging whether local structural abnormality exists or not; if the local structural abnormality is detected, further judging whether a preset trigger condition is met, uploading the structural health index to a remote monitoring center when the preset trigger condition is met, generating a structural health index by fusing multisource monitoring indexes based on the adjusted contribution weight, and executing an early warning decision according to a preset hierarchical early warning rule. According to the invention, a cooperative intelligent architecture of edge preliminary judgment and cloud deep reasoning can be constructed, so that real-time anomaly detection and intelligent triggering uploading, deep coupling analysis of multi-source data and accuracy of health assessment and timeliness of early warning are realized.

title_en: Parking scheduling control method, device, equipment and storage medium for stereo garage
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for controlling parking scheduling of a stereo garage, which are characterized in that a current license plate identification result and current target user information are firstly determined, corresponding reserved parking information and a historical parking data set are obtained, a current parking feature vector is determined based on a feature extraction strategy, a current predicted parking time is obtained by inputting the current parking feature vector into a parking time prediction model when the current parking feature vector meets a first preset feature condition, then a current target free parking space is determined based on an energy-saving parking space determination strategy, the current predicted parking time and a parking space in a hollow state of the stereo garage, and finally a lifting and carrying device is controlled to carry the current to the current target free parking space after the current vehicle is in place. The embodiment of the invention can be combined with an energy-saving parking space determining strategy, the vehicle parking type of the current vehicle and the current predicted parking time determined based on the parking time prediction model to more intelligently determine the current target free parking space which reduces the running energy consumption of the whole stereo garage from the stereo garage.

title_en: Real-time decision method, equipment and medium for dynamic obstacle avoidance of vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to a vehicle dynamic obstacle avoidance real-time decision method, equipment and medium, which belong to the technical field of path planning, wherein the vehicle dynamic obstacle avoidance real-time decision method constructs a physical information neural network based on a three-degree-of-freedom model of a vehicle, acquires a vehicle state and a control signal at the current moment, inputs the vehicle state and the control signal into the physical information neural network to acquire the vehicle state at the next moment, carries out local planning on a vehicle track by adopting a grid planner based on a road reference path, the real-time position of a dynamic obstacle and the vehicle state at the current moment to acquire a reference track, constructs an objective function of model prediction control based on the reference track, the vehicle state at the current moment and the vehicle dynamics relation described by the physical information neural network, solves the objective function to acquire a control signal at the next moment, controls the vehicle based on the control signal at the next moment and the vehicle state, realizes the dynamic obstacle avoidance of the vehicle, and improves the stability of the vehicle.

title_en: Electric power material warehouse intelligent path planning method based on improved A-star algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric power material warehouse intelligent path planning method based on an improved A-star algorithm, which relates to the technical field of path planning and artificial intelligence, and comprises the following steps of 1, constructing a two-dimensional map model for robot path planning; the method comprises the steps of step 2, randomly putting intermediate points into a two-dimensional map model, converting a global path planning problem into a plurality of local path planning problems through the intermediate points, step 3, constructing a crayfish optimizing algorithm, step 4, designing a fitness function, and step 5, planning a complete path from a starting point to an end point through improving an A-star algorithm, so as to complete global path planning.

title_en: Electrical component for scientific, technical, engineering and mathematical construction systems
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to digital electrical systems for STEM building systems. In various examples, STEM build systems may include one or more electrical components and various structural elements for supporting the electrical components. The system may have a power supply (e.g., battery) component with a plurality of connection pins, wherein one of the plurality of connection pins is a sense pin for sensing other power supplies and communicating a current state of the power supply component. The digital electrical system may utilize a proxy communication method in which one electrical component may act as a proxy for other components in the system by collecting information from the other components in the system and sending it to the requesting component. Or standard communication methods and coded communication methods may be used. The normalized unitless data may be transmitted throughout the system.

title_en: Virtual reality-based carrier-based aircraft maintenance process simulation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for simulating a maintenance process of a carrier-based aircraft based on virtual reality, and relates to the technical field of simulation. The invention collects environment sensing data packets of a carrier aircraft and a maintenance environment through a multi-mode sensor array, builds a carrier aircraft maintenance simulation space based on the environment sensing data packets, establishes regional maintenance step association networks under different maintenance events according to maintenance event records, maps the regional maintenance step association networks on the surface of the carrier aircraft maintenance simulation space, and then mutually matches each regional maintenance step association network to obtain a maintenance step association network.

title_en: Part machining method and system based on inspection planning and feature driving
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of digital manufacturing and precision machining, and discloses a part machining method and a part machining system based on inspection planning and characteristic driving, wherein the method comprises the steps of reading a full three-dimensional model, analyzing tolerance labels, instantiating the tolerance labels into process inspection project nodes, and establishing persistent reference; the method comprises the steps of identifying geometric features and matching the geometric features with test items to generate a feature set to be tested, adaptively calculating measurement point distribution according to feature types to generate a collision-free measurement path, converting the path into a numerical control code containing a radius compensation algorithm and embedding the numerical control code into a machining program, removing abnormal data to calculate deviation after a numerical control center performs measurement, and writing compensation values into a register to correct parameters. According to the invention, through establishing the data association of the full three-dimensional model and applying the curvature self-adaptive sampling and statistical data cleaning strategy, the data fault of design and detection is eliminated, the problem of environmental noise interference is solved, and the precision control level of complex feature processing is improved.

title_en: Cooperative control method for improving fault ride-through capability of grid-connected system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a cooperative control method for improving fault ride-through capability of a grid-connected system, belongs to the technical field of new energy grid-connected control and intelligent power grids, and aims to solve the problems of common negative sequence current accumulation, transient peak current impact, reactive support unbalance, steady-state power deviation and the like when the grid-connected system encounters a three-phase asymmetric fault. The method comprises the following steps of firstly, establishing an asymmetric fault mathematical model under the control of a grid-built VSG, secondly, establishing a positive-negative sequence separation virtual admittance model, determining a core optimization variable, then, establishing an objective function of multi-core parameters, optimizing by using an improved particle swarm algorithm comprising self-adaptive inertia weight and covariance learning, and finally, introducing the optimization parameters into a VSG current control link to realize active suppression of current and stable support of system voltage. The method can obviously reduce the fault current peak value, improve the reactive power supporting capability and maintain the power balance, thereby enhancing the fault ride-through performance of the grid-connected system.

title_en: Multi-axis additive-subtractive mixed manufacturing sequence planning method based on graph search
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-axis additive-subtractive material mixed manufacturing sequence planning method based on graph search, which aims at solving the problems that the existing multi-axis additive-subtractive material mixed sequence planning algorithm of complex parts depends on initial solution selection, has low solution flexibility and is difficult to process the condition of continuous change of nozzle/cutter axis vectors. The method comprises the steps of firstly dividing a part surface grid into independent additive manufacturing nodes and subtractive manufacturing nodes, secondly constructing a weighted directed graph integrating dependency constraint and collision constraint, wherein the dependency constraint ensures the stability of a material deposition sequence, the collision constraint ensures no interference requirement of a cutter and a nozzle in multi-axis motion, and finally solving a Hamiltonian path with minimum cost through a sequence ordering problem optimization algorithm to generate an optimal material increasing and decreasing alternating sequence. The method obviously reduces the number of sections for manufacturing the materials, reduces the material waste rate, and is suitable for high-precision and high-efficiency manufacturing of complex cavity parts such as blades, bent pipes and the like.

title_en: Control method of high-salinity wastewater treatment equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a control method of high-salt wastewater treatment equipment, which comprises the following steps of S1, collecting flow Q and water quality parameters of high-salt wastewater in real time, extracting characteristics of instantaneous pollution load L and ultraviolet efficiency coefficient K_uv of the high-salt wastewater, S2, solving an optimal control parameter combination which can enable the total energy consumption of the system to be minimum under the current working condition based on a dynamic optimization model by a central controller of the high-salt wastewater treatment equipment, generating a decision result, S3, sending the decision result to each execution unit by the central controller, realizing self-adaptive accurate control of multiple executors, and S4, monitoring actual treatment effect by the central controller through a COD on-line analyzer of a water outlet, and realizing feedback correction and dynamic optimization model self-learning. The control method of the high-salinity wastewater treatment equipment avoids the ineffective energy consumption by dynamically optimizing the energy distribution, and compared with a fixed power operation mode, the overall energy consumption can be reduced by 25% -45% through simulation and calculation.

title_en: AI large model control method and device for six-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle AI control, and discloses an AI large model control method and device of a six-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a high-precision position and positioning uncertainty; the method comprises the steps of planning an initial operation scheme, carrying out self-adaptive simulation and assessment of risks according to uncertainty, generating a summary and presenting the scheme for an operator to confirm if the risks are low, carrying out and recording tracks if the risks are approved, feeding back deviation to calibrate the twin, carrying out expert scheme if the risks are overruled, packaging sample feedback to optimize AI, and the device comprises a multi-mode sensing module, a fusion positioning module, an AI decision module, a twin previewing module, a collaborative supervision module, a flight control module and a man-machine interaction terminal. The application utilizes the positioning uncertainty to dynamically select and execute deterministic previewing or robust previewing, can adopt high-efficiency deterministic previewing when the reliability is high, and triggers robust previewing when the reliability is low, thereby improving the efficiency and pertinence of virtual verification.

title_en: Electrical automation control system based on manual auxiliary AI mechanism
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of electric automation control, and particularly discloses an electric automation control system based on a manual auxiliary AI mechanism. The system comprises a manual intervention interface, an AI basic controller, a data storage and management module and a consensus degree perception and collaborative decision-making device. The intelligent control system is characterized in that the consensus degree perception and collaborative decision-making device can receive qualitative advanced control intention input by an operator, analyze historical interaction data and current working conditions into control signals, synchronously calculate real-time human-computer consensus degree indexes, dynamically fuse AI basic control signals and manual analysis signals according to the indexes, and generate final control instructions. In addition, the system refines the efficient man-machine cooperation mode for multiplexing through the cooperation strategy evolution module, and optimizes the consensus degree assessment through the calibration loop. The invention realizes online real-time flexible fusion and co-evolution of the historical experience and AI calculation, and improves the self-adaptive control capability of the complex industrial system.

title_en: Intelligent moisturizing and glue collecting equipment
abstract_en: The intelligent moisture-preserving glue collecting equipment comprises a locking device, a moisture control device, a travel device, a moving device, an adjusting device, a step device, a cutting device, an anti-theft device and a positioning device, wherein the moisture control device forms a closed space to keep air humidity, is favorable for prolonging glue discharging time of a cutting surface, can effectively prevent dust fall, has the advantages of improving yield and all-weather operation and greatly reducing impurities and mechanical failure rate in juice, the moving device, the adjusting device, the step device and the cutting device cooperate to complete glue cutting action, has the characteristics of small friction force and high stability, the step device accurately controls a falling knife, blade movement and equipment movement accurately and step-by-step control, the equipment execution efficiency is high, the structure is simple and reliable, the anti-theft device carries out sensing early warning and reporting on risks and damages of the equipment, and can actively and timely take measures to reduce corresponding losses as much as possible when the equipment is possibly stolen and damaged through the positioning device.

title_en: Automatic cutting system of processing based on aluminum alloy production
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic cutting processing system based on aluminum alloy production, and belongs to the technical field of aluminum alloy profile processing. The system comprises a mechanical execution layer, a sensing detection layer and an intelligent control layer. Aiming at the problems of delayed cutting and feeding control of a complex section profile and lack of mechanical basis in gesture selection, the invention calculates the relation between the section moment of inertia of the profile and cutting force through a multi-axis gesture optimizing control unit, selects the optimal gesture with minimum deformation, drives a section topology analysis unit according to the optimal gesture to generate a section characteristic sequence, and a feeding rate self-adaptive control unit establishes a forward-looking window based on the sequence to predictively adjust the rate before a saw blade contacts a wall surface or cavity characteristic. The invention eliminates response lag through feedforward control, reduces profile deformation by utilizing mechanical optimization, and remarkably improves the cutting quality and precision of aluminum profiles.

title_en: LDO over-temperature over-current protection circuit for vehicle-standard level EMI resistance
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses an LDO over-temperature and over-current protection circuit for vehicle-standard anti-EMI, which relates to the technical field of integrated circuits and comprises an anti-EMI optimization module, an over-temperature protection circuit and an over-current protection circuit; the over-temperature protection circuit comprises an over-temperature protection threshold voltage selection circuit, a pre-amplifier and a hysteresis return difference circuit, wherein the negative input end of the pre-amplifier is connected with a positive temperature coefficient voltage signal VCTAT, the two transmission gate input ends of the over-temperature protection threshold voltage selection circuit are respectively connected with reference voltages V1 and V2 output by an external band gap reference circuit, the output end of the pre-amplifier is electrically connected with the input end of the hysteresis return difference circuit, and the output end of the hysteresis return difference circuit is connected to the bias end of the LDO main power tube or the input end of the over-current protection circuit. The anti-interference, over-temperature and over-current protection function cooperative work is realized, and the stability and reliability of the LDO circuit under the working conditions of vehicle-mounted wide temperature range, strong electromagnetic interference and frequent load fluctuation are improved.

title_en: Construction and dynamic early warning method and system of microseismic risk field
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a system for constructing and dynamically pre-warning a microseismic risk field, which belong to the technical field of risk field construction and dynamically pre-warning, and concretely comprise the steps of collecting microseismic data of a target monitoring area, writing the microseismic data into a storage area, constructing the microseismic risk field based on the microseismic data of the target monitoring area to obtain a microseismic risk field sequence signal set, dividing a pre-warning section based on the microseismic risk field sequence signal set, constructing a space-time multi-relation tensor graph of the target monitoring area, constructing a time-time propagation kernel function to obtain a time-sequence risk representation set, constructing a target monitoring area twisted hyperbolic space-time risk manifold space based on the time-sequence risk representation set, geometrically embedding the space-time risk manifold space to obtain a hyperbolic evolution representation set, calculating the hyperbolic risk distance of each pre-warning section based on the hyperbolic evolution representation set, classifying the hyperbolic risk distances, and dynamically pre-warning risks, and improving the accuracy of dynamic pre-warning of the microseismic risk field and the dynamic pre-warning.

title_en: Obstacle surmounting method and getting rid of method of self-moving equipment and related equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to an obstacle surmounting method and an obstacle surmounting method of self-moving equipment and related equipment. The method comprises the steps of obtaining environment information, determining the surmountable obstacle existing on a travelling path of the self-moving device based on the environment information, determining the size of the surmountable obstacle, wherein the size comprises at least one of the length along the wall direction, the width perpendicular to the wall direction and the height from the ground of the self-moving device, determining the target obstacle crossing action according to the size of the surmountable obstacle, and driving the self-moving device to execute the target obstacle crossing action once or continuously for a plurality of times so as to enable the self-moving device to cross the surmountable obstacle. According to the application, the problem of insufficient obstacle crossing capability of the self-mobile equipment is solved, the obstacle crossing success rate is improved, and the user experience is improved.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle cluster layering disturbance compliant consistency control method based on data driving
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle cluster cooperative control and discloses a data-driven unmanned aerial vehicle cluster layering disturbance compliant consistency control method, which comprises the following steps of S101, establishing a dynamic model of a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle cluster system under the action of multi-source disturbance; S102, designing a preset time distributed observer to estimate leader state information, S103, designing an unknown nonlinear term in a projection-based parameter estimator estimation system, S104, constructing a preset time nonlinear interference observer aiming at the undetectable interference, and S105, designing a data-driven disturbance-control compliant switching controller. The method realizes the active control and reasonable utilization of interference, obviously improves the safety and dynamic performance of the system while ensuring high-precision consistency, effectively reduces the energy consumption of the system by inhibiting unnecessary track correction, and avoids the saturation and structural damage of an actuator, thereby comprehensively improving the efficiency and economy of the collaborative operation of the multiple unmanned aerial vehicle clusters.

title_en: A simple and easy radiotherapy teaching aid for classroom teaching
abstract_en: The intensity modulated radiation therapy demonstration teaching aid for teaching in the tumor radiation therapy classroom can intuitively display the technical principle of the intensity modulated radiation therapy, and through changing the number of radiation sources and the fixation and the movement of the radiation sources, the invention enhances the understanding and understanding of a student on the intensity modulated radiation therapy method.

title_en: Mobile boarding wheel monitoring system and safety monitoring method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a mobile boarding monitoring system and a safety monitoring method thereof, and relates to the technical field of ship safety management. The system comprises a follow-up monitoring terminal, a wheel boarding channel sensing unit, an edge calculation control box, a ship shore integrated management platform and a mobile terminal APP, wherein the follow-up monitoring terminal is adapted to dynamic displacement of a gangway ladder through a triaxial holder follow-up mechanism, a multimode sensor group included in the follow-up monitoring terminal and a pressure sensor array included in the wheel boarding channel sensing unit realize multimode data acquisition, and the edge calculation control box completes local AI reasoning and early warning. The monitoring method comprises the whole processes of system initialization, personnel identity pre-verification, boarding behavior monitoring, severe working condition enhancement monitoring and data archiving, and the fact that the data cannot be tampered is achieved by combining with the blockchain storage. The invention eliminates the monitoring blind area, realizes the automatic verification of the identity and the real-time accurate early warning of abnormal behaviors, adapts to severe working conditions, achieves the integrated management and control of the ship and the shore, and improves the automation and intelligent level of the safety management of boarding operation.

title_en: Lightning arrester system and method with fault isolation and state notification functions
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lightning arrester system with fault isolation and state notification functions and a method thereof, wherein the system comprises a lightning arrester body, a high-voltage end of the lightning arrester body is connected with an external circuit, and a low-voltage end of the lightning arrester body is fixed on a second mounting bracket; one end of the insulating support is connected with the mounting support II, the other end of the insulating support is connected with the mounting support I, the disengaging unit is connected in series between the low-voltage end of the lightning arrester body and the grounding passage, a thermal explosion tube is arranged in the disengaging unit, the triggering reversing lever is connected with the disengaging unit through a connecting grounding wire and can be rotatably mounted on the mounting support I, and the signal unit is mounted on the mounting support I and is communicated with the triggering reversing lever through a triggering signal wire. When the leakage current is abnormally increased due to the failure of the lightning arrester body, the thermal explosion tube explodes to disconnect the disconnecting unit and isolate the failure, and meanwhile, the trigger reversing rod is pulled to overturn, and the trigger signal unit sends out remote notification containing position information. The invention can solve the problem that the traditional lightning arrester cannot be accurately isolated and positioned after faults, and the functions of the traditional lightning arrester are expanded through systematic design, so that the faults are rapidly isolated and positioned.

title_en: Wire harness assembly method and device for end-to-end visual servo drive, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides an end-to-end visual servo-driven wire harness assembly method, an end-to-end visual servo-driven wire harness assembly device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of robot control and machine vision, wherein an end-to-end visual perception model is used for reasoning a real-time image stream to obtain six-degree-of-freedom pose data of wire harness terminals and connector hole sites; the end-to-end real-time planning model continuously receives six-degree-of-freedom pose data of the wire harness terminal and the connector hole site, generates an expected track point sequence at the tail end of the mechanical arm based on the six-degree-of-freedom pose data of the wire harness terminal and the connector hole site to form a continuously output track data stream, and the whole-body motion controller continuously receives the track data stream, calculates each track point into a motion control instruction of each joint of the robot in real time, and drives hardware to execute the motion control instruction of each joint of the robot so as to realize visual servo closed loop. The invention realizes the dynamic compensation and high-precision control of the position uncertainty in the flexible wire harness operation process.

title_en: Cold backup computer with high integrity of power supply and instructions
abstract_en: An aspect of the present disclosure relates to a cold-standby computer architecture including an instruction calculation module to receive a standby activation signal and control a first power switch based on the received standby activation signal, an interface management/communication module to receive the standby activation signal and control a second power switch based on the received standby activation signal, a power interface to activate from a cold standby state to provide power to one or more external units when both the first and second power switches are closed, and an interface chip module to activate from the cold standby state to communicate with the one or more external units when both the first and second power switches are closed, wherein the instruction calculation module determines a control law function output signal according to a control law and communicates the control law function output signal to the interface chip module through the interface management/communication module. Other aspects also include corresponding methods, and the like.
