title_en: Distribution trolley control system and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of industrial automation, and discloses a control system and a control method of a distribution trolley, wherein the control system comprises a position detection unit, a control unit, an operation unit, a driving speed regulation unit and a wireless communication unit, the operation unit comprises an operation terminal and a mobile terminal which are mutually independent, the wireless communication unit is in communication connection with the mobile terminal, the control unit, the driving speed regulation unit and the position detection unit, the control unit is electrically connected with the operation terminal and the driving speed regulation unit, remote visualization and accurate controllability of the distribution trolley are realized through cooperation of the units, fault and safety risks are reduced, operation data of the distribution trolley can be synchronously transmitted to the operation terminal and the mobile terminal of the operation unit, the operation terminal can be used by field management personnel to check the operation state of the distribution trolley in real time, the mobile terminal can be used for moving, the real-time state of the distribution trolley can be remotely checked without being attended at a control room, and management flexibility is improved.

title_en: Greenhouse multispectral inspection robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a greenhouse multispectral inspection operation robot which comprises a plurality of autonomous nodes with the capabilities of moving, multi-mode sensing and accurate operation. The autonomous nodes can spontaneously establish a temporary communication network according to task demands to form a dynamic cooperative group, the collective consensus is achieved on crop stress states in the network through data exchange and negotiation, a consistent operation instruction is generated, each node records an operation effect and calculates a performance score, the operation effect and the performance score are packaged into a sharable strategy package, and the nodes continuously optimize a self decision model by utilizing the local strategy package and the shared strategy package to realize intelligent evolution. The invention enables the robot group to have group perception, collaborative decision, experience sharing and continuous evolution capability, and remarkably improves the greenhouse operation efficiency and the system intelligence level.

title_en: Adjustable spark aerosol circuit, method, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application provides an adjustable spark aerosol circuit, a method, equipment and a medium, wherein the circuit comprises a direct current power supply, a second circuit, a third circuit and a control unit, wherein the direct current power supply, the second circuit, the third circuit and the control unit are connected with the first circuit, and the direct current is stored as a first direct current voltage in response to a first PWM pulse of the control unit; the third loop receives the third PWM pulse of the control unit, releases the first direct current voltage to the broken electrode gap in the form of the first current pulse, generates spark ablation electrodes to generate metal aerosol, and the impedance detection unit detects the real-time impedance of the electrode gap and feeds the real-time impedance back to the control unit to enable the real-time impedance to adjust the PWM pulse according to the real-time impedance. Through the circuit, the problems of unstable aerosol yield, coarse particle size and signal fluctuation are solved.

title_en: Intelligent sensing fire early warning system based on pyrolysis particulate matter detection
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of trace detection and intelligent early warning, and particularly discloses an intelligent sensing fire early warning system based on pyrolysis particulate matter detection. The system comprises a multi-angle polarized light scattering spectrum acquisition device, a physical information neural network reasoning engine, an airflow interference filtering unit, a pyrolysis dynamics constraint embedding module and a fire trend early warning output unit, wherein the pyrolysis dynamics rule in the form of an Arrhenius equation is used as a physical constraint embedding neural network loss function, topological data analysis and fluid mechanics are combined to filter out airflow disturbance, the multi-angle polarized light scattering spectrum is utilized to reversely deduce a pyrolysis reaction stage and a fire trend growth trend, and the grading early warning is realized before the concentration of particles does not reach a traditional threshold. By the technical scheme, the accuracy, the robustness and the response lead of early fire disaster identification are improved.

title_en: Control device compatible with servo motor regulating valve and stepping motor regulating valve
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of valve control, and particularly relates to a control device compatible with a servo motor regulating valve and a stepping motor regulating valve. The device comprises a servo driver module and a step driver module which are connected with a processor module to form closed-loop control, wherein the servo driver module and the step driver module are respectively used for driving and communicating a servo motor regulating valve and a step motor regulating valve, the device can work in the servo motor regulating valve working mode or the step motor regulating valve working mode through switching of an embedded software working mode of the processor module, and the processor module is connected with a process control system through a communication interface module and used for controlling the servo driver module to drive or the step driver module according to a valve opening signal sent by the process control system. The device integrates two kinds of controller signal interfaces, an installation mode, an operation interface and an operation method, uniformly operates maintenance procedures and overhaul procedures, and realizes cost reduction and synergy.

title_en: Task contractual distributed robot autonomous system
abstract_en: The invention provides a task contract type distributed robot autonomous system, wherein an upper system issues a task contract comprising targets, constraints and resource limitations to a robot. Based on the contract and local real-time perception, the robot autonomously completes task planning, execution and exception handling, and communicates with the upper layer system only when the contract cannot be achieved. The robot receives an advanced 'task contract' instead of a specific path, and makes a completely autonomous decision locally, so that decoupling of network connection is realized. Through the architecture of 'task contract + PPO local decision', the pain points of the existing distributed robot system, such as network dependence, weak autonomous adaptability, poor decision stability and the like, are solved, the robustness, controllability and reliability of the system are improved, and the system is suitable for scenes of warehouse logistics, environment monitoring, emergency rescue and the like.

title_en: Intelligent paying-off robot regulation and control system and method based on perception obstacle avoidance
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent paying-off robot regulation and control system and method based on perceived obstacle avoidance, and relates to the technical field of intelligent robot control, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting historical operation data of a robot in a plurality of operation periods and constructing an environment optimization model; the method comprises the steps of pre-generating a plurality of alternative paths with different risk characteristics by combining current working time and environment risk patterns before a task starts, calculating comprehensive scores of the alternative paths, distributing calculation and storage resources of a perception system, collecting operation data of a robot in real time and comparing the operation data with prediction data of an environment optimization model in real time in the task execution process, triggering dynamic path rescheduling when deviation exceeds a preset threshold value, triggering a grading early warning mechanism when the deviation exceeds the risk threshold value in a health early warning matrix, updating the environment risk patterns and the health early warning matrix after the task ends, and dynamically adjusting path confidence degree weights and resource configuration strategies of all areas.

title_en: Traceable self-counting ballot Condorcet voting system based on blockchain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a block chain-based traceable self-counting vote Condorcet voting system which comprises an election organizer, a block chain network module, an intelligent contract cluster, a plurality of election terminal modules and a homomorphic time lock calculation module. The invention constructs a set of block chain-based decentralization Condorcet voting framework, can realize vote submission, vote structure verification and automatic vote counting under the condition of no trusted third party, and remarkably improves the credibility and transparency of the voting system.

title_en: Assembling and construction process of steel sleeve for structural reinforcement
abstract_en: The invention provides an assembling and construction process of a steel sleeve for structural reinforcement, which belongs to the technical field of assembling and construction and comprises the following steps of 1, carrying out modularized split design on the steel sleeve for structural reinforcement, 2, carrying out preassembled sealing system design on the steel sleeve for structural reinforcement after modularized split design, 3, carrying out annular space and grouting parameter standardization after the preassembled sealing system design, and 4, carrying out construction process optimization after the annular space and grouting parameter standardization. The invention can improve the reinforcement construction efficiency, reduce the operation risk and ensure the stable and controllable reinforcement quality.

title_en: Self-cleaning control method and control system for steaming and baking oven
abstract_en: The application relates to a self-cleaning control method and a control system of an intelligent steaming and baking box, wherein the method comprises the steps of establishing a temperature coupling model of a cavity and an evaporator, and synchronously regulating and controlling the temperature of the evaporator and the cavity through a dynamic temperature compensation algorithm and cooperative control of steam pressure; the pollution degree is dynamically estimated based on real-time thermal resistivity, a fuzzy logic grading strategy and a dynamic programming algorithm are combined, cleaning modes corresponding to different pollution degrees are selected, a scale thickness prediction model is constructed, and scale is actively removed through multistage thermodynamic impact and dynamic pressure regulation. The cleaning efficiency, the energy utilization efficiency and the system reliability are improved, and the energy consumption and the maintenance cost are reduced.

title_en: Automatic pool cleaning device and control method thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a control method of an automatic pool cleaning device (20), wherein the automatic pool cleaning device (20) comprises an electric quantity acquisition module (201), the electric quantity acquisition module (201) can acquire the current residual electric quantity of the automatic pool cleaning device (20), the control method comprises the steps of controlling the automatic pool cleaning device (20) to move and clean in a pool, acquiring a cleaning strategy based on the current residual electric quantity when the current residual electric quantity is smaller than or equal to a first electric quantity threshold value, controlling the automatic pool cleaning device (20) to move according to the cleaning strategy, and controlling the automatic pool cleaning device (20) to return to a base station (30) when the current residual electric quantity is smaller than or equal to a second electric quantity threshold value, wherein the first electric quantity threshold value is larger than the second electric quantity threshold value.

title_en: Method and system for regulating and controlling dynamic difficulty of VR safety training of open pit coal mine
abstract_en: The application provides a dynamic difficulty regulation and control method for VR safety training of an opencast coal mine, which comprises the steps of collecting multidimensional interactive behavior data of a target student in a VR training scene in real time, encoding the multidimensional interactive behavior data into a behavior vector sequence, inputting the behavior vector sequence into a pre-trained prediction model, outputting potential risk behaviors and risk occurrence probability, generating a risk event which is continuously caused by the potential risk behaviors through a risk deduction model when the risk occurrence probability is higher than a preset threshold, dynamically generating a negative guide plot based on the risk event, implanting the negative guide plot into the VR training scene, and dynamically regulating a subsequent generation strategy of the negative guide plot according to the response result of the target student to the negative guide plot. The application has the technical effects of deeply understanding the behavior intention of students, predicting potential risks in early stage and performing dynamic intervention.

title_en: Autonomous landing safety track planning method suitable for unmanned aerial vehicle inspection
abstract_en: An autonomous landing safety track planning method suitable for unmanned aerial vehicle inspection comprises the steps of obtaining current pose, surrounding environment point cloud map information and space direction of a target point of an unmanned aerial vehicle after the unmanned aerial vehicle takes off, calculating a direction vector relative to a ground target by establishing a space transformation relation between a camera coordinate system and a machine body coordinate system, limiting a generation target point in a radar perceivable area, constructing an optimization function for minimizing fourth-order derivatives based on a multistage high-order polynomial according to the generated target point, generating a smooth track with continuous position, speed and acceleration, converting the initial track into a B-spline curve form, optimizing a local track section with collision risk, designing a sectional punishment mechanism according to a limit threshold value, guiding the track to be far away from the limit area, calculating an adjustment time span through a track derivative overrun ratio, and simultaneously introducing a track similarity cost function, so that the final optimized track keeps the original geometric structure, and the track control optimization and the safe landing of the unmanned aerial vehicle are realized.

title_en: Low-carbon park control method and system based on digital twin and dynamic carbon footprint
abstract_en: The invention relates to a low-carbon park control method and a system based on digital twinning and dynamic carbon footprint, which are used for constructing a digital twinning simulation model mapped with physical entities of a low-carbon park, and the method comprises a daily optimization stage, wherein the daily optimization stage is used for making a daily operation plan of an energy system of the park as a reference line and an operation boundary for real-time control rolling optimization, the real-time control stage is used for carrying out rolling optimization on the daily operation plan by adopting model prediction control on the basis of a prediction curve of a system state in each control period, and applying a first control instruction in an optimization sequence obtained in the current control period to an actual system, and adopting a reinforcement learning agent to dynamically adjust a dynamic carbon cost weight in a model prediction control objective function. Compared with the prior art, the method and the system realize accurate perception, prospective deduction and intelligent decision on the whole flow of the energy system of the park, and promote the overall optimization performance and operation robustness of the system in an uncertainty environment.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle power transmission line inspection system based on multi-agent cooperative digital twin and construction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle transmission line inspection system based on multi-agent cooperative digital twin and a construction method, and the system is used for constructing an integrated inspection system taking the multi-agent cooperative digital twin as a core, integrating multi-machine cooperative control, energy consumption perception dynamic path optimization, environment self-adaptive flight control, end Bian Yun cooperative intelligent decision and full life cycle management modules, realizing full-element digital twin mapping of transmission line topography, towers, unmanned aerial vehicle bodies and microclimate along the line, dynamically adjusting flight paths based on unmanned aerial vehicle real-time energy consumption, adapting complex meteorological conditions, realizing low-delay and high-precision distributed decision through edge and cloud weight distribution, simultaneously completing inspection planning, execution and evaluation to optimized full-flow closed-loop management.

title_en: Wettability detection device and method for glass fiber cloth production
abstract_en: The invention relates to a wettability detection device for glass fiber cloth production, which comprises a frame, wherein a conveyor belt is arranged on the frame, a cutting component, a weighing component, a wettability treatment component, a collecting component and a data processing component are sequentially arranged on the frame along the conveying direction, the wettability treatment component comprises a first wettability tank and a second wettability tank, the first wettability tank and the second wettability tank comprise tank bodies and monitoring structures, and the weighing component, the collecting component and the monitoring structures are connected with the data processing component.

title_en: Method for predicting and/or planning a trajectory for a participant, method for training a model and system for controlling a vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to a computer-implemented method for predicting and/or planning at least one trajectory (20) for at least one participant (1) of a traffic scene, wherein the at least one trajectory (20) is generated for the at least one participant (1) using a pre-trained model on the basis of aggregated scene-specific information, wherein each trajectory (20) is represented by a sequence of journey/time points (21, 22-25). According to the invention, distances/time points (22-25) are generated for the trajectory (20) of the participant (1), which distances/time points have a predefined distance to a common reference point (21), in particular to the current position (21) of the participant (1). The invention also relates to a method for training a model and a system for controlling a vehicle.

title_en: Intelligent processing system and processing method for energy conversion
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent processing system and a processing method for energy conversion, and belongs to the technical field of energy conversion and control. The method comprises the steps of collecting operation data in real time through a sensor group, preprocessing edge computing nodes by adopting a sliding window averaging method and a cross-correlation time delay estimation method, extracting the health degree, energy output efficiency and environment coupling characteristics of equipment, computing a digital twin model in parallel by adopting a mechanism model and an LSTM error correction model, outputting a future prediction state sequence, solving optimal control actions by adopting a depth deterministic strategy gradient algorithm through a central decision server through multiple objective functions comprising efficiency, safety and cost, issuing a command adjusting executing mechanism by a cooperative controller, and repeating the steps to form closed-loop control. According to the invention, through a collaborative architecture of digital twin prediction, reinforcement learning decision and knowledge graph enhancement, the system response time is shortened, and the energy conversion efficiency is improved.

title_en: Abnormal state detection method and system for drug intermediate synthesis reaction process
abstract_en: The invention relates to an abnormal state detection method and system for a drug intermediate synthesis reaction process, and belongs to the technical field of abnormal state detection. The method comprises the steps of collecting reaction process data, performing labeling to construct a data set, completing variable coupling modeling, dynamic time alignment and feature decoupling in stages according to stage coding dividing process stages to obtain a reconstructed feature matrix, extracting different time span abnormal modes through time sequence convolution and multi-scale cavity convolution, combining channel attention enhancement key features to obtain a coding feature matrix, performing stage perception feature aggregation and global time sequence aggregation to obtain final classification feature vectors, inputting 4 stage independent classification heads to output classification results, and performing joint optimization through cross entropy loss and focus loss with label smoothing in the training process. The invention can eliminate the rhythm difference of batch process, distinguish normal regulation and control from real abnormality, and accurately capture early weak abnormality.

title_en: Intelligent individual temperature regulating method and equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent individual temperature regulating method and equipment, and belongs to the technical field of intelligent environment control and wearable technology. The invention combines the PSI physiological stress index and the acquired temperature and humidity data of the microenvironment to control the running power of the refrigerating device, so that the refrigerating device runs at the power corresponding to the higher-level data in the PSI physiological stress index and the temperature and humidity data of the microenvironment. According to the invention, PSI physiological stress index and temperature and humidity data of a microenvironment are considered, and temperature adjustment is carried out based on the data of the two dimensions, so that the technical problems that in the prior art, the physiological state of an individual cannot be perceived through fixed temperature threshold adjustment and control, the response is delayed, excessive refrigeration or heating is easy to cause are effectively solved, and further, accurate hierarchical dynamic adjustment and control according to the real-time heat stress level of a human body are realized, and the heat comfort experience and individual suitability are obviously improved.

title_en: Lead ingot automatic feeding accurate control system based on visual positioning and multidimensional limiting
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic lead ingot feeding precise control system based on visual positioning and multidimensional limiting, which relates to the technical field of lead sleeve production and is characterized in that a full-flow closed-loop control system is constructed by integrating a visual positioning module, a multidimensional limiting control module, a precise control core module and a data interaction module, wherein precise lead ingot position and posture data are provided by visual positioning, dynamically adaptive transportation constraint and state feedback are realized by multidimensional limiting, multiparameter cooperative regulation and control are finished by a precise control core, information linkage between modules and an external system is ensured by data interaction, and cooperative stabilization of lead liquid level, host current and lead sleeve thickness is realized by control logic optimization, so that the problems of positioning and transportation disjoint, isolated regulation parameters, poor suitability and the like in the traditional technology are effectively solved.

title_en: Puffed food processing parameter intelligent regulation and control system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent regulation and control system for puffed food processing parameters based on artificial intelligence, and relates to the technical field of strategy optimization. The intelligent puffed food processing parameter regulating and controlling system based on the artificial intelligence comprises a feeding module, a monitoring module I, a conveying module I, a moisture regulating module and a conveying module II which are respectively connected with an artificial intelligence control module in a signal mode, wherein the feeding module is used for feeding raw materials to the conveying module I, the conveying module I is used for conveying the fed raw materials to the moisture regulating module, and the monitoring module I is used for carrying out moisture on-line monitoring on the raw materials conveyed by the conveying module I. The artificial intelligent control module controls the moisture adjusting module to control the moisture of the raw materials according to the moisture adjusting strategy so as to meet the requirement of subsequent processing, realizes automatic collection, statistics and calculation of the moisture content of the raw materials, and automatically optimizes the moisture adjusting strategy according to the calculation result so as to realize intelligent control of the moisture in the raw material pretreatment process.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle low-altitude accurate navigation and obstacle avoidance method based on multisource fusion perception
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of unmanned aerial vehicle navigation obstacle avoidance processing, and particularly discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle low-altitude accurate navigation and obstacle avoidance method based on multi-source fusion perception, which comprises the following steps: when the unmanned aerial vehicle executes navigation obstacle avoidance tasks in a low-altitude environment, a multi-source fusion sensing system is started, the multi-source fusion sensing system is configured with at least four sensing sensors with independent data acquisition capacity, each sensing sensor is correspondingly provided with an independent switch node, and the switch nodes are used for accurately controlling acquisition starting and closing of the corresponding sensors. According to the method, a staged energy consumption modeling optimization strategy is constructed, different power coefficients are set according to the energy consumption characteristics of the sensors in different acquisition stages, and the energy consumption recovery in a waiting stage is considered, so that the fine management and control of the acquisition energy consumption of the sensors are realized, the total energy consumption of the system is matched with the operation energy consumption threshold of the unmanned aerial vehicle through an energy consumption objective function, the excessive consumption of airborne energy sources is avoided, and the cruising ability of the unmanned aerial vehicle in low-altitude operation is effectively improved.

title_en: Unmanned plane railway crossing safety control method based on time window
abstract_en: The invention discloses a railway crossing safety control method of an unmanned aerial vehicle based on a time window, which comprises the steps of establishing a time set for each railway crossing station to pass through by the unmanned aerial vehicle, calculating the minimum safety distance between the unmanned aerial vehicle and a high-speed railway contact net at the crossing station to obtain the minimum flight height of the crossing station, calculating the maximum flight frame number of the unmanned aerial vehicle allowed to pass through at a moment t of the crossing station, constructing a comprehensive parameter set for the crossing station to support the unmanned aerial vehicle to pass through in a passing time period of the unmanned aerial vehicle, checking reporting information, extracting the maximum flight frame number and the start-stop time of the time window from the comprehensive parameter set after the reporting information passes through the checking, and judging whether the unmanned aerial vehicle is approved or not through calculating the flight allowance. According to the method, a comprehensive management and control parameter system is constructed by combining train operation time sequence, overhead line system electromagnetic characteristics and personnel on duty, so that accurate verification and scientific approval of unmanned aerial vehicle crossing application are realized, and double safety of railway transportation and unmanned aerial vehicle flight is ensured.

title_en: Unmanned agricultural machinery dynamic obstacle avoidance and operation path recovery method and system based on depth vision
abstract_en: The invention discloses a depth vision-based unmanned agricultural machinery dynamic obstacle avoidance and operation path recovery method and system, and belongs to the technical field of agricultural machinery automation and computer vision intersection. The method comprises the steps of realizing depth dynamic perception of multi-category barriers and real-time identification and geometric modeling of crop row boundaries based on heterogeneous computing platforms in parallel, fusing scene cognition to conduct intelligent judgment on a path blocking state, starting path planning taking safe obstacle avoidance and operation regression as collaborative optimization targets when blocking, dynamically generating obstacle avoidance detour paths, determining optimal regression points and solving control parameters through an intelligent decision model based on an attention mechanism, executing path tracking control, realizing accurate alignment with crop rows at the regression points, constructing and dynamically maintaining a global semantic operation map in an increment mode, intelligently managing non-operation areas generated by obstacle avoidance, and ensuring full coverage of operation. The invention systematically solves the problems of operation continuity, accuracy and full coverage of unmanned agricultural machinery in complex field environment.

title_en: Industrial field risk early warning method, device and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses an industrial field risk early warning method, device and readable storage medium, which comprise the steps of obtaining an operation field image, identifying at least one human body part area and/or at least one dangerous tool area in the operation field image, calculating a spatial overlapping metric value between each human body part area and each dangerous tool area based on the relative position relation between the human body part area and the dangerous tool area, wherein the spatial overlapping metric value is defined as the ratio of the area of an intersection area of the human body part area and the dangerous tool area to the area of the human body part area, determining a risk quantization value from a plurality of the spatial overlapping metric values, and matching the risk quantization value with a preset safety threshold parameter set so as to generate early warning signals with different grades according to matching results. The technical scheme provided by the application can be used for rapidly identifying the safety risk of the operation site.

title_en: Multi-parameter detection and regulation system for edible fungus cultivation shelter
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of agricultural intellectualization and discloses a multi-parameter detection regulation and control system of an edible fungus cultivation shelter, which comprises a parameter detection end, an environment regulation and control end, a cultivation management end and an alarm management end, wherein when the edible fungus cultivation environment is monitored in real time, a standard parameter library comprising temperature, humidity, illumination, carbon dioxide concentration and strain biological indexes is preset, real-time data acquisition and deviation calculation are executed, the multi-parameter dynamic monitoring of the edible fungus cultivation environment can be realized, micro-environment differences of different areas in the shelter are identified, the comprehensiveness of environment monitoring is ensured, an accurate basis is provided for environment regulation and control, the environment regulation quantity is calculated in real time through a regulation and control algorithm, and a strain characteristic and growth stage dynamic regulation and control strategy is combined, so that the system can automatically optimize regulation and control parameters according to actual cultivation requirements, respond and regulate in time when the environment deviates, and the timeliness and adaptability of environment regulation are ensured.

title_en: Control box for heating electric tracing of pipeline and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of electric control and heat transfer science, and provides a pipeline electric tracing heating control box and a control method thereof, wherein the pipeline electric tracing heating control box comprises an analog signal control module, an analog signal output module and an analog signal input module, wherein the analog signal control module is electrically connected with the analog signal input module and is used for controlling the on-off of an electric heating belt power supply according to a control signal of the analog signal input module; the analog signal output module is electrically connected with the analog signal input module and is used for simultaneously outputting the temperature signals of the analog signal input module to the on-site processing display unit and the DCS, and the analog signal input module is electrically connected with the analog signal control module and the analog signal output module and is used for acquiring the temperature signals and outputting control signals. The invention realizes the integrated management of multichannel independent temperature control, double-channel signal output and current overload protection, and improves the control precision and operation safety of the pipeline electric tracing system.

title_en: Side multiple sealing type civil air defense and flood gate equipment, system and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to side multiple sealing type civil air defense and flood prevention door equipment, a system and a control method thereof, wherein the equipment comprises a door body and a door leaf driving mechanism; the door body comprises a lower locking mechanism, a bottom lifting sealing structure is arranged between the bottoms of the left door leaf and the right door leaf and the lower door frame, the door leaf driving mechanism is connected with the left door leaf and the right door leaf, the system further comprises an intelligent control device, the intelligent control device comprises a sensor module and a driving control module which are integrated on the door body, and a remote control platform, wherein the sensor module comprises a door leaf opening and closing position detection sensor, a bottom lifting sealing structure compression state detection sensor and a water level height detection sensor. The invention obviously improves the overall water tightness, the water pressure resistance and the long-term sealing reliability by applying the pressing force on the upper, middle and lower sections of the side edges of the door leaf, and also improves the sealing reliability and the control safety of the civil air defense door under the conditions of high water level and complex water flow by combining the sensing monitoring and centralized control modes.

title_en: Binary random walk control method based on dynamic history minimum value feedback
abstract_en: The invention relates to a binary random walk control method based on dynamic history minimum value feedback, and belongs to the fields of random process control and time sequence signal processing. The method comprises the steps of driving by two types of mutually exclusive time sequence signals, including an initialization step of setting an initial position and recording a dynamic history minimum value, a position updating step of updating a current position according to a signal type, a core control step of executing deviation processing operations such as waiting or reverse running and the like to restrain negative deviation when the current position meets a deviation triggering condition taking the history minimum value as a reference and restoring a normal mode when the current position meets a regression condition, and a period resetting step of resetting parameters and starting a new period after completing convergence targets. Accurate interception and efficient digestion of negative bias are achieved through a dynamic history minimum value feedback mechanism, the problem that traditional random walk is easy to diverge and low in convergence efficiency is solved, and reproducible expected benefits and stable convergence performance can be achieved in the scenes of beam correction of an electronic collision machine, server scheduling, financial time sequence analysis and the like.

title_en: Intelligent protection method, system and equipment for material loading and unloading workshop
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent workshops, in particular to an intelligent protection method, system and equipment for a material handling workshop. The method comprises the steps of outputting corresponding acousto-optic early warning information under the condition that a target early warning signal is detected, controlling the running speed of target equipment indicated by the target early warning signal to be reduced from a first speed to a second speed, enabling the target early warning signal to be used for indicating that an object exists in an early warning area of the target equipment, and controlling the target equipment to stop under the condition that the target equipment meets any one of a plurality of stop judging conditions, wherein the plurality of stop judging conditions comprise that the continuous output time length of the acousto-optic early warning information corresponding to the target equipment is longer than a time length threshold value, enabling the object exists in the stop area of the target equipment, and enabling an anti-pressing plate of the target equipment to be in contact with the object. The invention combines the non-contact monitoring mechanism and the contact monitoring mechanism to cooperatively complete the safety protection work, thereby fully guaranteeing the personal safety of workshop personnel.

title_en: Vehicle control method and system based on cloud large model and vehicle-mounted situation awareness
abstract_en: The application discloses a vehicle control method and a vehicle control system based on a cloud end large model and vehicle-mounted situation awareness, and relates to the technical field of vehicle control, wherein the vehicle end uploads a user original instruction and a situation data snapshot to a cloud end, and the cloud end receives the user original instruction and the situation data snapshot uploaded by the vehicle end; the method comprises the steps of taking an original instruction of a user and a scene data snapshot as input of a target strategy model to obtain strategy description, obtaining an equipment control instruction sequence by a vehicle end based on a user history preference database, preset equipment constraint, real-time scene data and strategy description, and controlling a corresponding equipment executor in a vehicle to operate based on the equipment control instruction sequence. The technical problems that in a traditional scheme, complex semantics and multi-mode situations are difficult to process at the same time at one end side, and control adaptability is poor due to the fact that a cloud generating strategy is disjointed from a vehicle-end actual execution environment are solved, and accuracy and scene adaptability of vehicle control under a complex dynamic scene are improved.

title_en: Intelligent wet towel machine temperature and humidity cooperative regulation system based on mobile terminal
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent wet tissue machine temperature and humidity cooperative regulation system based on a mobile terminal, and belongs to the field of temperature and humidity regulation; the intelligent wet tissue heating and humidifying system comprises a user behavior analysis module, a temperature and humidity adjustment module, a remote control module and a control module, wherein the user behavior analysis module is used for constructing a prediction model A and a prediction model B corresponding to each user, the temperature and humidity adjustment module is used for determining the number of the dry tissues and the wet tissues used by the user and the temperature and humidity of the wet tissues according to the prediction model A and the prediction model B, generating heating and humidifying instructions according to different heating and humidifying modes of the intelligent wet tissue machine, generating heat preservation instructions to obtain real-time default instructions, the remote control module is used for detecting whether the user formulates new instructions, adjusting the heating and humidifying modes and the heat preservation modes of the intelligent wet tissue machine according to the instructions newly formulated by the user if the new instructions are formulated, and not processing the new instructions, and the working mode of the intelligent wet tissue machine is adjusted by analyzing the using habit of the dry wet tissues of the user, so that the efficiency of the intelligent wet tissue machine is improved when the dry tissues are heated and humidified.

title_en: Intelligent wearing safety warning method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent wearing safety warning method and system based on artificial intelligence, which relate to the technical field of intelligent wearing safety, and comprise the following steps: risk perception, collaborative verification and evaluation, hierarchical warning and protection, wherein the risk perception constructs a dynamic personal digital behavior file through intelligent wearable equipment multidimensional acquisition data generated by spinning, information leakage threat events are accurately identified according to the identified abnormal activity types and combined with fingerprint identity verification, the information leakage threat events are converted into collaborative analysis requests, confidence is cooperatively evaluated through similar equipment groups, the types of the information leakage threat events are reversely judged, hierarchical warning is triggered according to the types and the confidence of the information leakage threat events, active protection, countercheck and type feature sharing of the information leakage threat events are supported, the problems of traditional passive protection, single equipment perception limitation and high false alarm rate are solved, and the accuracy and the initiative of the intelligent wearable equipment safety protection generated by spinning are improved.

title_en: Flexible job shop scheduling method based on mixed expert model and graphic meaning force
abstract_en: The invention relates to a flexible job shop scheduling method based on a mixed expert model and a drawing meaning force, which comprises a mathematical model stage for constructing a flexible job shop scheduling environment, a feature extraction and distribution stage, a bidirectional drawing attention network modeling stage, a mixed expert model cooperation stage and a reinforcement learning training and reasoning stage. The method introduces a feature distribution mechanism based on semantic prior, adopts a soft and hard gating combination mode to realize efficient cooperation of multiple expert networks, and supports bidirectional attention capture of procedures and machine view angles and a Top-1 expert selection mechanism with calculation efficiency optimization capability. The scheduling method and the scheduling device effectively improve scheduling efficiency and accuracy of the flexible job shop.

title_en: High-precision cascode current mirror circuit and bias circuit thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-precision Cascode current mirror circuit and a bias circuit thereof, belongs to the field of integrated circuits, and aims to solve the technical problems that a traditional low-voltage Cascode current mirror is fixed in bias, insufficient in voltage margin, easy to influence by temperature and process mismatch in precision and difficult to adapt to an extremely low-voltage threshold scene. The invention consists of a voltage division type bias voltage generating circuit and a Cascode current mirror circuit, wherein the voltage division type bias voltage generating circuit comprises MOS (metal oxide semiconductor) tubes M1 and M2, resistors R1 and R2 and a current source I1, and the Cascode current mirror circuit comprises MOS tubes M3-M10 and current sources I2-I4. The circuit has the core innovation points that a voltage division type bias structure and a multi-stage Cascode current mirror are cooperatively designed, flexible regulation and control of bias voltage are realized through a MOS tube M1 with a grid-drain short circuit and serial resistors R1 and R2, different low voltage ranges and PVT environments can be dynamically adapted without additionally adding a complex voltage regulating module, a compensation effect is formed by means of temperature coefficients of resistor voltage division and MOS tube threshold voltage, current deviation caused by temperature fluctuation and device mismatch under low voltage is effectively restrained, and the Cascode structure can remarkably improve circuit output impedance and current mirror image accuracy. The invention has simple structure, convenient adjustment, high precision, low power consumption and wide voltage adaptability, and can be widely applied to scenes such as analog and mixed signal integrated circuits, low-voltage power supply portable electronic equipment, high-precision reference sources and the like.

title_en: Photovoltaic field area progress deviation prediction and early warning method driven by unmanned aerial vehicle inspection
abstract_en: The invention relates to a photovoltaic field progress deviation prediction and early warning method driven by unmanned aerial vehicle inspection, and belongs to the technical field of photovoltaic field operation management. According to the method, a patrol and operation and maintenance two-dimensional progress reference model is constructed through multi-source data acquisition and standardized preprocessing, a two-branch deep learning model is utilized to predict progress deviation after core features are fused, multistage dynamic early warning and self-adaptive adjustment are achieved, and an optimization model is iterated. The method solves the problems of delayed prediction and inaccurate early warning of the traditional method, improves the configuration of the inspection operation and maintenance resources, and ensures the efficient and stable operation of the photovoltaic field.

title_en: Multi-vehicle import management and optimization method for neighboring lane importing idle lanes based on Stackelberg game theory
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for managing and optimizing multiple vehicle import of adjacent lanes to an idle lane based on a Stackelberg game theory. The temporary idle distance of some lanes is caused by the fluctuation of the vehicle caused by the actions such as acceleration, deceleration or lane change in the running process. In the case of a limited free distance length, how to allocate a limited free distance to a plurality of vehicles in adjacent lanes attempting to merge into a free lane through a lane change operation is a critical problem to be solved urgently in an intelligent transportation system. In order to solve the problems, a method for managing and optimizing the multiple vehicle entering of adjacent lanes entering the idle lanes based on the Stackelberg game theory is provided, and deep theoretical analysis and application exploration are performed, so that a unique and efficient solution is provided.

title_en: Ship offshore collision avoidance rule realistic training and evaluating method and system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of intelligent perception and simulation training of offshore navigation, and discloses a real-scene training and evaluating method and system for marine collision avoidance rules of ships, wherein a scene assembly list is generated and ship motion simulation, three-dimensional vision, radar/AIS fusion display and voice communication interaction are uniformly scheduled by constructing a layered and hierarchical question bank; in the training process, a traceable evidence chain is formed by collecting manipulation input, a motion state, target information and a communication record, sampling is carried out on the basis of alignment of an evaluation anchor point, an automatic scoring model is established according to a result index and a process index, and an evaluation report of a sub-item score, evidence positioning, a violation point list and a retraining suggestion is output. The method is suitable for teaching, retraining and checking, and improves the training efficiency and achievement of collision avoidance decision.

title_en: Environment monitoring system and method
abstract_en: A method includes displaying an external environment of a vehicle, detecting one or more hazards within a distance-related threshold of the vehicle, and displaying hazard visualization images corresponding to locations of the one or more hazards.

title_en: Automatic temperature measurement control system of battery aluminum foil smelting furnace
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic temperature measurement control system of a battery aluminum foil smelting furnace, which comprises a communicating vessel type liquid storage chamber for containing aluminum melt, a distributed thermocouple array, a fuzzy self-adaptive execution module and a gas proportional valve, wherein the distributed thermocouple array comprises a high-area thermocouple array, a middle-area thermocouple array and a low-area thermocouple array, each group of array comprises at least 4 measuring points, the temperature controller is connected with the thermocouple array, the gas proportional valve is connected with the temperature controller, the burner is connected with the gas proportional valve, the temperature controller comprises a temperature signal acquisition module, a temperature gradient tensor generation module, a coupling suppression control algorithm module and a fuzzy self-adaptive execution module, and the gas flow correction vector is calculated according to the temperature gradient tensor, and is used for adjusting the opening degree of the gas proportional valve according to the gas flow correction vector. Realizes the accurate and stable control of the temperature of the aluminum melt and meets the high standard requirement of the production of the aluminum foil of the battery.

title_en: Crystal oscillator etching state detection method based on machine vision
abstract_en: The invention discloses a crystal oscillator etching state detection method based on machine vision, and belongs to the technical field of electronic component manufacturing detection. The invention acquires a crystal oscillator surface image through a high-resolution microscopic vision system, enhances etching characteristics through anisotropic diffusion filtering and image pyramid decomposition, extracts a crystal oscillator target area through a pixel level separation network, performs sub-pixel edge positioning, calculates edge roughness, dimension width and symmetry deviation, constructs a gray level co-occurrence matrix to extract a surface entropy value, adopts photometric stereoscopic vision to reconstruct a three-dimensional morphology and calculate etching depth, inputs multi-dimensional characteristics into a long-short-term memory network and random forest mixed model, outputs etching state classification and prediction residual time, compares a judging result with a preset threshold value to generate an etching completion or overetching early warning signal, realizes real-time non-contact monitoring and closed-loop control of the microscopic morphology in the etching process, and improves detection precision and yield.

title_en: Chemical enterprise full-flow dynamic risk assessment method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a medium for evaluating the whole-flow dynamic risk of a chemical enterprise, and particularly relates to the technical field of chemical safety. The method, the device, the equipment and the medium for evaluating the whole-flow dynamic risk of the chemical enterprises effectively solve the technical pain points that the evaluation units are fixedly divided and cannot adapt to dynamic working conditions of chemical production in the prior art, avoid the risk conduction path identification distortion caused by the division of the fixed units, realize the accurate matching of the evaluation units and the production working conditions, lay a foundation for the accurate evaluation of the whole-flow risk of the chemical enterprises, and ensure the safe and stable operation of the enterprises.

title_en: Weak current network voltage cooperative control method and system based on multiple intelligent agents
abstract_en: The invention provides a weak current network voltage cooperative control method and system based on multiple intelligent agents, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining operation parameters of a rural power network photovoltaic heat storage AC/DC networking, and constructing a networking model; the method comprises the steps of dividing photovoltaic intelligent agents, heat storage intelligent agents, interconnecting converter intelligent agents and weak current network intelligent agents, establishing a neighbor interaction communication relationship, generating a local voltage control strategy by adopting fuzzy self-adaptive PID (proportion integration differentiation) based on voltage deviation and voltage deviation change rate of buses corresponding to the intelligent agents, triggering a cooperative request when the voltage deviation exceeds a threshold value, and adjusting corresponding control quantity by adjacent intelligent agents based on a distributed coordination scheduling strategy. The technical scheme of the invention realizes the cooperative stable control of the voltage of the alternating current and direct current buses, and improves the power supply reliability and the light Fu Xiaona capacity of the weak electric network of the rural power grid.

title_en: Fault positioning method, system, equipment, medium and product of nuclear power DCS
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a fault positioning method, system, equipment, medium and product of a nuclear power DCS, and relates to the technical field of instrument control maintenance of nuclear power plants. The method comprises the steps of constructing a parallel system with the same function and configuration parameters as those of the DCS based on the nuclear power DCS, acquiring actual input, output and process data of the DCS when the DCS fails, inputting the actual input data into the parallel system for simulation to obtain simulation output and process data, displaying the actual output, process data, simulation output and process data of the DCS and the parallel system in a layered manner according to the function and physical structure respectively, comparing the actual output, the process data and the simulation output and process data, obtaining data difference information, and determining the failure position based on the data difference information. According to the application, by constructing a parallel system completely consistent with the function and configuration of the nuclear power DCS, the fault position is rapidly and accurately positioned by utilizing the layer-by-layer comparison of actual operation data and simulation operation results, the fault positioning efficiency and accuracy are remarkably improved, and the dependence on manual experience is reduced.

title_en: Suspension detection table for automobile production
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of automobile detection, and relates to a suspension detection table for automobile production, which comprises a multi-degree-of-freedom motion platform, a wheel center loading device and a control system. The wheel center loading device consists of a wheel center adapter, a six-dimensional force sensor and a loading head with a rigid round rod, and loads are applied to the loading head through three actuators which are arranged in an orthogonal mode. The control system synchronously drives the motion platform to simulate the posture of the vehicle body according to a preset composite working condition load spectrum, and outputs all actuators in a closed loop mode according to real-time feedback of the six-dimensional force sensor so that the six-dimensional load acting on the wheel center is matched with the target spectrum with high precision. The invention realizes high-fidelity and repeatable laboratory test on the space compound stress state of the suspension system.

title_en: Ceramic coating automation process control system for prebaked anode oxidation prevention function
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic ceramic coating process control system for a prebaked anode oxidation prevention function, and relates to the technical field of spraying control. The system comprises a prebaked anode spraying pretreatment module, a spraying fluctuation condition monitoring module, a spraying fluctuation correction optimization module and a spraying post-treatment module. According to the invention, the pre-baked anode carbon blocks are sprayed through the automatic spraying robot, the fluctuation condition of the spray gun at the tail end is monitored in real time according to the built-in driver of the automatic spraying robot, the preliminary judgment of the spray gun motion fluctuation is realized, whether the auxiliary judgment of the spray gun motion is executed is determined, then whether the robot spraying correction is carried out is determined based on the result of the auxiliary judgment of the spray gun motion, finally, the sprayed pre-baked anode carbon blocks are conveyed to a flash-dry area for flash-dry and then are subjected to primer spraying, the adhesive force of a ceramic coating on the pre-baked anode is improved, and the problem that the ceramic coating is controlled inaccurately in the prior art, and further the oxidation prevention effect of the pre-baked anode carbon blocks is influenced is solved.

title_en: Portable intelligent voice prompt airway suction device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a portable intelligent voice prompt airway suction device which comprises a multi-sensor monitoring module, a voice prompt module and an adjusting module, wherein the multi-sensor monitoring module comprises at least one sensor, the sensor is used for collecting state parameters of the suction device in the operation process in real time, the state parameters comprise at least one of liquid level parameters, blocking parameters and electric quantity parameters, the voice prompt module is electrically connected with the multi-sensor monitoring module, the voice prompt module receives the state parameters collected by the multi-sensor monitoring module and broadcasts the operation state of the suction device in a voice mode, the adjusting module is electrically connected with a negative pressure generating module and used for adjusting the negative pressure generated by the negative pressure generating module, and the voice prompt module can also generate corresponding voice prompts according to the state change of the adjusting module. The invention integrates the voice prompt module, the multi-sensor monitoring module and the integrated disposable sterile suction pipeline system, has light weight, and can be held and transported by one hand.

title_en: Control method and device for AC (alternating current) axis hot switching of numerical control machine tool
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of control of numerical control machine tools, and relates to a control method and a device for AC (alternating current) shaft hot switching of a numerical control machine tool; aiming at the problems that an A shaft and a C shaft of an automatic universal milling head share the same spindle motor, are alternatively activated and are required to be powered off and restarted, the invention switches the working mode of the spindle into a Cs contour control mode through PMC signals, executes a hot switching macro program, dynamically modifies shaft selection parameters and motor distribution parameters by utilizing G10L 52 instructions, realizes the instant switching of the control right of the spindle motor from a current shaft to a target shaft without a power off or restarting system, and automatically calls an angle initialization program to eliminate position monitoring alarm and integrate an automatic tool changing function after indexing is finished.

title_en: Method, equipment and medium for distributing aviation operation tasks of agricultural unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, equipment and medium for distributing aviation operation tasks of an agricultural unmanned aerial vehicle, and relates to the technical field of intelligent agricultural machinery, comprising the steps of collecting farmland area data, unmanned aerial vehicle state data and operation environment data, and preprocessing and checking the availability to obtain operation basic data; the method comprises the steps of establishing a dynamic space-time reservation relation based on a capacity constraint candidate allocation set, carrying out conflict hot spot recognition and resource reallocation through a multi-agent cooperative game mechanism to generate a target task allocation instruction set, executing real-time aviation operation according to the target task allocation instruction set, collecting flight state feedback data, carrying out anomaly judgment on the execution deviation of the target task allocation instruction set, and carrying out dynamic flight path rescheduling and fault-tolerant control on an incomplete area to generate a task allocation scheduling set. According to the method, the dynamic characterization of the continuous operation capability of the agricultural unmanned aerial vehicle is realized by constructing the capability attenuation state track and rolling the time domain prediction effective operation capability interval.

title_en: Adaptive control and sediment plume inhibition method and device for deep sea mining equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a self-adaptive control and sediment plume inhibition method and device of deep sea mining equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of responding to a received running state adjustment instruction and acquiring current running state data of the deep sea mining equipment; determining target energy variation according to current operation state data of the deep sea mining equipment and the operation state adjustment instruction, generating a predicted plume increment generated by executing the operation state adjustment instruction through a pre-established energy disturbance model, and performing energy shaping processing on the operation state adjustment instruction and generating a control instruction sequence for reducing the plume increment when the predicted plume increment exceeds a preset threshold. The application solves the technical problem that the abrupt energy injection excites sediment suspension resonance and leads to plume explosion type growth, and achieves the effect of reducing the generation amount of plumes on the premise of maintaining necessary operation.

title_en: Landfill anti-seepage film welding quality intelligent monitoring system based on multiparameter real-time acquisition and AI discrimination
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of environmental engineering and intelligent monitoring, in particular to an intelligent monitoring system for the welding quality of an impermeable film of a landfill based on multi-parameter real-time acquisition and AI discrimination, which comprises a multi-parameter real-time acquisition module, a physical mechanism constraint heat conduction inversion unit, an AI discrimination feature extraction module, a space-time evolution fusion evaluation engine and a closed loop feedback execution mechanism; through physical inversion of internal nugget distribution and combination of AI discrimination and time sequence evaluation, the application can realize real-time monitoring of welding quality and dynamic regulation and control of technological parameters, and ensure the safety of a landfill seepage prevention system.

title_en: Precise machining control method and system for multi-station collaborative beat balance
abstract_en: The invention relates to the control field, in particular to a precision machining control method and system for multi-station collaborative beat balance, which are used for collecting parameters, material information and sensor time sequence signals of all stations in real time, extracting multi-scale state characteristics through time-frequency analysis, constructing a correlation topological graph to represent station coupling relation, obtaining multi-station future time sequence state probability distribution through a prediction model by taking a topological structure, state parameters and multi-scale characteristics as input, planning an expected state track sequence with minimum risk as a virtual main line under the condition of optimal system performance and operation constraint, calculating the deviation of the actual state of the stations and the virtual main line in real time, obtaining a bottleneck index by combining the probability distribution, weighting the deviation and generating a differential compensation control instruction, realizing potential bottleneck pre-digestion, and guaranteeing multi-station collaborative stable operation.

title_en: Intelligent temperature and humidity regulation method for tea storage
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent temperature and humidity regulation method for tea storage, which belongs to the technical field of tea storage fresh keeping and intelligent control, and comprises the steps of firstly constructing a tea aging quality-temperature and humidity bidirectional coupling dynamics model with two corrections of endogenous heat production and endogenous humidity release of a tea pile, and constructing a storage quality objective function of binding quality safety constraint; the three-dimensional distributed sensing array is used for completing the reconstruction and the weighted non-uniformity quantification of the storage global temperature and humidity field, and the prediction of the internal temperature and humidity disturbance of the storage is completed by combining external weather look-ahead data, the dynamic regulation and control target value of the real-time working condition is optimized and solved by three targets of simultaneous quality, uniformity and energy consumption, and finally the advanced pre-regulation and incremental PID closed-loop control are completed by a weight distribution mechanism with partition airflow coupling interference compensation. The invention realizes the directional accurate regulation and control of the tea storage quality, the uniform control of the temperature and humidity in the whole space and the deep cooperation of low-energy operation, greatly improves the stability of the tea storage quality and reduces the operation cost.

title_en: Method for identifying lane change behavior of closed road vehicle based on limited section observation information
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for identifying the lane change behavior of a closed lane vehicle based on limited section observation information, which utilizes sensors arranged at fixed points along the closed road, and recording license plates, elapsed time, speed and lane information of each vehicle, and constructing a vehicle information vector. When the lane information is inconsistent when the vehicle passes through two continuous sensors, the lane change of the vehicle is directly judged. Otherwise, the vehicles on the same lane are ordered according to the time of passing the sensors, and vehicles with the front-back position relation between the two sensors changed are searched for, so that an inverted sequence pair is constructed. When the road meets the free flow condition and the difference value of the passing residual errors of two vehicles in the reverse sequence is smaller than the minimum lane changing cost, the vehicles with smaller passing residual errors are judged to be lane changed. Otherwise, comprehensively considering the traffic density, speed and headway of the current lane and the adjacent lane, calculating overtaking machines of two vehicles in the reverse sequence pair, and judging that the vehicle with the large overtaking machine changes lanes.

title_en: Intelligent boarding system and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of aviation ground equipment, and discloses an intelligent boarding system and a control method thereof. The intelligent boarding car has full-automatic movement and scheduling capability, and is integrated with a double-layer telescopic 'moving sidewalk' mechanism, a passenger flow sensing and regulating system, a high-precision self-adaptive butt joint execution system and a barrier-free power assisting system. The control method realizes unmanned and intelligent boarding whole-flow operation through six steps of task receiving and scheduling, model identification and docking confirmation, multi-sensor co-location docking, intelligent people flow monitoring and control, barrier-free mode response and task ending withdrawal. The invention solves the problems of low efficiency of traffic management, low model adaptation precision, no barrier service deficiency and the like of the traditional boarding equipment, has the advantages of high docking precision, safe and reliable operation, high space utilization rate, good humanized experience and the like, and can obviously improve the airport operation efficiency and the passenger boarding experience.

title_en: Dual-mode intelligent inspection system and method for stopping and not stopping fan
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of wind power operation and maintenance and unmanned aerial vehicle inspection, in particular to a fan shutdown and non-shutdown dual-mode intelligent inspection system and method, which are characterized in that visible light is obtained, the outline and the space angle of a fan component are identified through a fused neural network, a windward side and a leeward side are judged, a reference suspension navigation point is calculated, a rotation target detection network is utilized to identify the pitch angle, the roll angle and the three-dimensional coordinate of a fan blade, and the pitch angle, the roll angle and the three-dimensional coordinate are matched with a shutdown gesture template, if the pitch angle, the three-dimensional coordinate and the leeward side are matched with the shutdown gesture template And marking a dynamic no-fly zone, generating a dynamic follow-up shooting navigation point sequence in a safety gap based on the reference suspension navigation point and the motion trail prediction of the fan blade when the machine is not stopped, calculating the navigation points of a windward side, a leeward side, a front edge and a rear edge according to the angle, the length and the diameter of the hub of the fan blade when the machine is stopped, avoiding the dynamic no-fly zone, enabling the unmanned aerial vehicle to fly along a planned route, adaptively adjusting the angle of a cradle head, acquiring the image of the fan blade by adopting high-speed visual triggering or fixed-point shooting, and generating a inspection report through intelligent defect analysis.

title_en: Electric fire early warning method based on multi-mode fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric fire early warning method based on multi-mode fusion, which relates to the technical field of electric safety monitoring and comprises the steps of collecting associated data, generating a monitoring data set, constructing a state frame and a path token, generating a path binding sequence, inputting a modified SegRNN model, generating a prediction sequence and path characteristics, executing inverse fact difference association, generating a prediction residual sequence, inputting an S-H-ESD algorithm, generating an abnormal segment and risk score, executing risk path association, generating a path discrimination result, and generating an early warning grade, a source position and a propagation path. The invention realizes the advanced identification, source positioning and propagation path discrimination of the electric fire risk through the collaborative processing of the multi-mode fire precursor state frame, the risk propagation path token, the improved SegRNN model and the S-H-ESD algorithm.

title_en: Braille drum set music score teaching equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses braille drum set music score teaching equipment, which relates to the technical field of braille drum music score teaching and comprises a protection waistcoat, wherein the protection waistcoat is connected with a teaching piece, the teaching piece comprises a regulating and controlling component, the regulating and controlling component is installed on the rear side of the protection waistcoat and comprises a control box fixedly connected on the rear side of the protection waistcoat, a loudspeaker is fixedly connected on the control box, the regulating and controlling component further comprises two groups of shoulder waistcoats, and two groups of monitoring pieces are respectively installed on the lower sides of the two groups of shoulder waistcoats and used for monitoring arm positions of a user. The braille drum set music score teaching device realizes accurate display of the braille drum set music score through the seven-degree inclined plane self-locking structure of the control box and the braille display piece and electromagnetic driving transmission, timely reads drum set music score content by the blind without affecting the condition that the blind knocks the practice drum set, timely updates the braille drum music score under the condition that the drum set practice is correct, and pauses drum music score update under the condition that the drum set practice is wrong.

title_en: Fire alarm linkage system and method for biomass power plant
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire alarm linkage system and a fire alarm linkage method for a biomass power plant, and relates to the technical field of fire alarm linkage. The system divides a fireproof area through a zoning isolation module, utilizes an environment parameter acquisition module to monitor the three-dimensional temperature, the surface temperature and the concentration of combustible gas in the fuel pile in real time, and a linkage control module identifies spontaneous combustion risk and predicts a fire spreading trend according to monitoring data and drives a composite fire extinguishing module to perform zoning differential fire extinguishing. The fuel conveying channel is separated by two water curtains in a grading manner, the fuel storage area is extinguished by an adjustable water cannon, the main plant is extinguished by a fire hydrant, and meanwhile dust explosion suppression, grading response and redundancy guarantee design are combined. The invention can realize early warning, accurate fire extinguishment and cross-region isolation prevention and control of spontaneous combustion of biomass fuel, and improves the reliability and the intelligent level of a fire-fighting system of a power plant.

title_en: Cooked egg marinating and cleaning online beat cooperative production control method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of food processing production control, in particular to a cooked egg marinating cleaning online beat cooperative production control method and system. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a line input set by carrying out data arrangement and abnormal merging on batch information and station states acquired on site, generating a batch process state set by carrying out joint judgment and cross check, carrying out batch sequencing and sequence generation to obtain a line collaborative beat scheme, carrying out release judgment, stay correction, cache scheduling and discharge scheduling to obtain a marinating release instruction, carrying out access analysis, segment allocation, liquid supply spray adjustment and overturning conveying adjustment to obtain a cleaning execution instruction, carrying out accumulation, idling, shutdown and offset abnormal recognition to obtain a beat correction result, and finally carrying out buffering, current limiting, compensation, recovery mode switching and rearrangement to form a closed loop control result.
