The invention realizes the dynamic coordination and abnormal self-adaptive regulation of multiple-working-time beats and remarkably improves the on-line operation efficiency and stability.

title_en: SBC chip replacing circuit, control method, 48V system and vehicle
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to the technical field of circuits and discloses an SBC chip replacing circuit, a control method, a 48V system and a vehicle. The SBC chip replacing circuit at least comprises a CAN awakening module, a power control module, a power management module and an LDO power supply module. The embodiment of the invention does not need to rely on a special SBC chip, is favorable for relieving the technical problems of non-domestic special SBC chips, high purchase cost, long supply period, high maintenance cost and long downtime of the system after faults in the existing 48V system, realizes the same power management function by combining discrete components, reduces the cost, is convenient to maintain, can quickly replace a fault module, and is suitable for various 48V power supply systems such as automobile electronics, industrial control and the like.

title_en: Road traffic patrol and command system and method based on humanoid robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a road traffic patrol and command system and method based on a humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of intelligent traffic. The system comprises a humanoid robot end side subsystem, a movable base station cooperative control subsystem, a power exchange scheduling subsystem, a cloud management and control platform and a traffic management system docking module. The terminal side subsystem is used for realizing intelligent recognition of violations, command priority arbitration, local offline operation, environment risk quantification, signal lamp fault emergency command and wireless charging coordination, the movable base station adopts a collision and path compliance two-dimensional risk quantification model, and the cloud management and control platform adopts an adoptability A-type path planning. According to the invention, the ordered execution of the instruction is ensured by the single-layer absolute priority of solidification, the problems of weak cooperation, dependence on cloud, instruction conflict, empty window control and the like of the existing equipment are solved, such as near-field encryption connection pipe under the network breaking working condition, autonomous emergency command of signal lamp faults, self-adaptive risk avoidance under outdoor extreme environments and closed-loop linkage of traffic management data are realized.

title_en: Infrared induction low-power consumption control system based on time sequence verification
abstract_en: The invention provides an infrared induction low-power consumption control system based on time sequence verification, which comprises an event-driven sparse sensing module, a time slot consistency verification module, an adaptive wake-up module and an adaptive wake-up module, wherein the event-driven sparse sensing module is used for generating event pulses with time stamps when the event pulses are changed and keeping zero dynamic power consumption standby when the event pulses are unchanged, the time slot consistency verification module is used for dividing time into fixed time slots and executing time sequence verification on the event pulses so as to confirm effective human activity events and output effective marks and event rhythm characteristic indexes, the adaptive wake-up module is used for calculating the idle intervals of the events by utilizing the effective marks and representing signal environment complexity by utilizing the event rhythm characteristic indexes and adjusting sampling time slot width and dormancy time length, and wake-up execution equipment.

title_en: Automatic adjustment method and system for plate difference of telescopic screed of paver
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a system for automatically adjusting the difference of a telescopic screed plate of a paver. According to the method, a main screed section inclination angle sensor is used for collecting real-time elevation angles, a main and auxiliary section displacement sensor is used for collecting real-time plate differences, a main controller calculates theoretical plate differences according to the elevation angles and compares the theoretical plate differences with actual plate differences to obtain deviation values, PID closed-loop adjustment is triggered when the deviation values exceed a threshold value, an H-bridge driving module taking STM32L431RCT6 as a core is used for outputting 20kHzPWM signals to drive a motor to complete lifting adjustment, and meanwhile, the method has the functions of DMA current sampling, 300ms delay overcurrent protection and manual/automatic dual-mode switching. The application realizes real-time tracking and 0.1 mm-level high-precision adjustment of the plate difference under the dynamic change of the elevation angle, replaces manual operation, improves paving evenness, construction efficiency and equipment operation reliability, and is suitable for various complex construction working conditions of the paver.

title_en: Linear voltage stabilizing circuit, linear voltage stabilizer, power supply device and electronic equipment for enhancing low-and-medium frequency power supply rejection ratio
abstract_en: The application belongs to the field of electronic circuits, and provides a linear voltage stabilizing circuit, a linear voltage stabilizer, a power supply device and electronic equipment for enhancing the suppression ratio of a medium-low frequency power supply. The linear voltage stabilizing circuit comprises an error amplifying module, a power module, a resistance module and a voltage-controlled voltage module. When the power supply voltage is disturbed, the disturbance can generate influence on the output voltage through two paths, namely, on one hand, the disturbance of the power supply voltage can generate a disturbance, namely, a first disturbance, on the output voltage through the error amplification module and the power module, and on the other hand, the disturbance of the power supply voltage can generate a disturbance through the voltage-controlled voltage module, the disturbance is divided into two paths for transmission, and finally, the other disturbance, namely, a second disturbance, is generated on the output voltage. The second disturbance is opposite to the first disturbance in direction, and the voltage coefficient of the voltage-controlled voltage module is reasonably controlled to enable the two disturbances to cancel each other, so that the influence of power supply voltage noise on output voltage is effectively restrained, and excellent middle-low frequency PSR performance is achieved.

title_en: Full-flow intelligent customization system for traditional Chinese medicine in clinical prescription and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent manufacturing of traditional Chinese medicines and discloses a full-flow intelligent customized system of a clinical traditional Chinese medicine and a control method thereof, wherein the intelligent customized system comprises an intelligent diagnosis module, a diagnosis module and a control module, wherein the intelligent diagnosis module is used for collecting multi-mode data of a patient, inputting a traditional Chinese medicine dialectical model trained based on a real clinical medical record data set of a specific middle doctor, and outputting dialectical typing and initial prescription advice; the intelligent prescription feature analysis module receives the final prescription, the intelligent prescription-near traditional Chinese medicine whole-flow customizing system and the control method thereof are closed in whole flow, and individuation and scale are unified, namely AI inquiry, prescription feature analysis, automatic decoction of a nonmetallic liner, low-temperature spray freeze drying, online material measurement and clustered dry direct compression molding are integrated into the same system for the first time, so that the long-term individuation and scale contradiction of industries is solved.

title_en: Operation and maintenance method, system and storage medium of intelligent building platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of building operation and maintenance, and discloses an operation and maintenance method, a system and a storage medium of an intelligent building platform, wherein the method comprises the steps of importing a building information model to construct a digital twin base; the method comprises the steps of collecting building multisource operation and maintenance data, calculating corresponding carbon emission data, carrying out standardized processing, dynamically binding the standardized data with entity components in a building information model to realize virtual-real association, predicting an energy consumption result and an equipment failure result by using a state prediction model based on the standardized data, constructing a multi-objective constraint optimization model by taking adjustable operation parameters of electromechanical equipment as decision variables, solving the prediction results to obtain an optimal control strategy, transmitting the control strategy to a bottom layer control node, and carrying out visual presentation and decision pushing through a digital twin base. The invention reduces the rendering load of the three-dimensional model, realizes multi-target cooperative scheduling of building energy and active prevention and protection of equipment, and has the generalized evolution capability adapting to the physical evolution stage of the equipment.

title_en: Natural gas pipe network risk early warning method based on multi-mode data fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of natural gas network risk early warning and discloses a natural gas network risk early warning method based on multi-mode data fusion, which comprises the following steps of 1, collecting multi-mode time sequence monitoring data of a natural gas network in a target period; the method comprises the steps of step 2, outputting a first theoretical state sequence representing the theoretical running state of the pipe network under the ideal working condition, step 3, constructing a joint input tensor comprising an actual measurement data channel and a theoretical data channel, step 4, outputting a residual error correction sequence, step 5, generating a fusion state estimation sequence, and step 6, generating early warning information comprising risk types, risk positions and confidence degrees when judging that risks exist.

title_en: Wireless control method, system and storage medium for anti-collision system of aerial working platform
abstract_en: The application provides a wireless control method, a wireless control system and a wireless control storage medium for an anti-collision system of an aerial working platform, and belongs to the technical field of industrial safety control and wireless communication. The application designs a complete wireless control method which is applied to a system comprising a detection main rod and a wireless receiving control box. The method comprises the step of transmitting instructions, wherein when the detecting main rod detects an obstacle, a dangerous shutdown instruction is wirelessly transmitted to the wireless receiving control box based on a predefined instruction protocol, and the wireless receiving control box transmits a confirmation response to the detecting main rod after successfully receiving and executing the dangerous shutdown instruction. By introducing a special instruction protocol comprising a checking mechanism, a response mechanism and a retransmission mechanism, the transmission reliability of key safety instructions is effectively improved, the environment safety before the system is restarted is ensured by constructing a cooperative restarting flow of request-verification-execution, and the adaptability and the maintenance convenience of the system are improved by establishing a local wireless connection to realize remote parameter configuration. The scheme remarkably improves the safety performance and the intelligent level of the anti-collision system of the aerial working platform.

title_en: Stress deformation compression oblique wedge wind tunnel test model for teaching and test method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of high-speed wind tunnel tests, and discloses a stress deformation compression oblique wind tunnel test model for teaching and a test method thereof. The base of the test model is a step base, a high-speed wind tunnel is embedded from outside to inside in a step matching mode, the top surface of the base is flush with the wall surface of a test section of the high-speed wind tunnel, an inclined stress deformation panel is fixed on the top surface of the base, the stress deformation panel faces the high-speed wind tunnel to flow, and a plurality of pressure measuring holes are formed in front of the stress deformation panel and in the top surface of the base to measure the surface pressure distribution of the top surface of the base. The test method comprises the steps of determining relevant parameters of a test, installing a base, installing a pressure sensor, conducting a teaching test, and closing a high-speed wind tunnel. The test model and the test method thereof provide hardware conditions and a measurement interface for visually displaying the flow phenomenon caused by the shock wave in the high-speed wind tunnel, quickly adjusting the shock wave form and evaluating the boundary layer control strategy, and have engineering practical value.

title_en: Impact detection stable fly-away system for aircraft
abstract_en: The invention discloses an impact detection stable missed approach system for an aircraft, which relates to the field of aircraft flight control, wherein a multisource fusion impact detection subsystem collects attitude inertia, impact pressure position and motor current fluctuation data, an impact characteristic quantity is calculated through Kalman filtering denoising and characteristic weighting fusion, a grading self-adaptive flight control subsystem combines the impact characteristic quantity and real-time flight speed, divides impact grades, matches a three-level stable control strategy and a missed approach instruction to realize missed approach, a power execution subsystem adjusts the motor rotating speed through an electronic speed regulator to finish attitude correction and track adjustment through differential speed regulation, and an airborne data interaction and ground monitoring subsystem realize inter-module data interaction, impact and flight data return storage and instruction issuing. The invention realizes full-link closed-loop control of 'multisource fusion impact detection- & gt structure buffering energy absorption- & gt hierarchical self-adaptive attitude stabilization- & gt track correction/hovering forced landing/stable flying-off', and improves the survivability and operation continuity of the unmanned aerial vehicle in a complex scene.

title_en: Method and system for counting number of people in correction by means of linkage of checking-out correction and leave-out correction
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical fields of campus attendance data processing, student in-out school state identification and emergency checking information processing, in particular to a method and a system for counting the number of people in a school by linkage of checking-out school and asking for the help. The method comprises the steps of receiving an event stream in a checking-out direction, reported by access control equipment or a student wearing terminal in a low-frequency triggering mode, generating an effective direction event sequence, a checking-in student list and a statistical context, screening the checked-in checking-out records based on the statistical context, generating a checked-in checking-out student list which is effective at the current statistical moment, using a student ID as a key to maintain a direction state machine, generating an actual checking-out set and an actual checking-out set, deducting the effective checking-out student list through the checking-out candidate set, generating an abnormal checking-out list and calibrating a reason label, and generating a checking-in number snapshot based on the actual checking-out set, the abnormal checking-out list and the reason label. The invention effectively improves the consistency of the statistics of the in-school state and the checking and approving time caliber.

title_en: Black lamp experiment cooperative control system and method based on multi-agent cooperative decision
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence and black light experiment cooperative control, in particular to a black light experiment cooperative control system and method based on multi-agent cooperative decision. The intelligent experimental device comprises a multi-agent collaborative decision-making module, a digital twin and protocol conversion module, a black light experiment execution module, a man-machine interaction quality control module and a result analysis and skill precipitation module, wherein five modules of multi-agent collaborative decision-making, digital twin and protocol conversion, multi-actuator arrangement, man-machine interaction quality control, result analysis and skill precipitation are collaborative, so that the purposes of inputting natural language scientific research tasks into 7X 24 hours of unmanned experiment execution, carrying out full-dimensional data quality control and carrying out structured skill precipitation multiplexing are realized, the problem of pain points of high manpower dependence, poor experiment reproducibility and difficult knowledge inheritance in traditional scientific research is solved, and the scientific research efficiency and the achievement quality are greatly improved.

title_en: Flight control abnormal data analysis and fault diagnosis method, system, product and medium based on generation countermeasure network
abstract_en: A flight control abnormal data analysis and fault diagnosis method, a system, a product and a medium based on a generated countermeasure network relate to the field of fault diagnosis of aviation aircrafts. The method comprises the steps of obtaining flight control multichannel time sequence data to construct a three-dimensional tensor, extracting space-time joint characteristics of the three-dimensional tensor to obtain fusion embedded representation representing time dependence and multichannel physical coupling, inputting flight working conditions into a generating network, obtaining enhanced fault samples by combining the embedded representation, constructing a multi-class classification network sharing characteristic extraction parameters with the generating network, inputting real and enhanced samples into the network in a mixed mode, carrying out end-to-end parameter updating by combining reconstruction and classification loss to obtain a diagnosis network, inputting data to be detected into the diagnosis network, calculating an abnormal score based on the reconstruction loss, and positioning a specific fault type by combining with prediction probability. By implementing the technical scheme provided by the application, the diagnosis accuracy of the fault type under the complex flight working condition is improved.

title_en: Cooking appliance and control method
abstract_en: The application discloses a cooking utensil and a control method, wherein the cooking utensil comprises a pot body, a pot liner and a control device, the pot body is provided with a bottom heating component and a side heating component, the pot liner comprises a pot liner bottom and a pot liner side part, the bottom heating component is positioned at the pot liner bottom, the side heating component is positioned at the pot liner side part, the control device is configured to synchronously control the opening and closing of the bottom heating component and the side heating component at least after the temperature T   Bottom   of the bottom inner surface of the pot liner bottom reaches the mark temperature, the temperature T   Bottom   of the bottom inner surface is controlled to be 80 ℃ less than or equal to T   Bottom  ≤T  Boiling point of   +3 ℃, and the temperature T   Side of the vehicle   of the side inner surface of the pot liner side part is controlled to be T   Side of the vehicle  ≥T  Bottom  , wherein T   Boiling point of   is the boiling point of water. When the starch glue starts to solidify after the food material is boiled, the cooking utensil starts to synchronously control the bottom heating source and the side heating source, so that different areas on the pot liner can realize different heating temperatures on the premise of singly controlling multi-area heating.

title_en: Method and system for determining control water level of regulation and storage reservoir group
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of hydrologic analysis and calculation, in particular to a method and a system for determining a control water level of a regulating reservoir group. The method comprises the steps of determining the water supplementing level and the water stopping level of each reservoir, constructing a parameter feasible region, establishing a joint scheduling model by combining joint scheduling basic data and initial water levels, generating a plurality of groups of control water level parameter combinations in the feasible region, performing joint simulation of water supply and water supplementing time-period by time-period, obtaining a scheduling result, further performing weighted calculation based on a water supply guarantee rate to form a scheduling evaluation index, performing optimization screening on each parameter combination, finally determining an optimal control water level parameter combination, and determining the control water level of each reservoir according to the optimal control water level parameter combination, so that reasonable determination of the control water level of each regulating and storing reservoir is realized. The application realizes the cooperative optimization determination of the control water level of the regulation and storage reservoir group, thereby improving the water supply guarantee capability and the water resource scheduling efficiency.

title_en: Production control method for preparing high-purity copper sulfate based on etching waste liquid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a production control method for preparing high-purity copper sulfate based on etching waste liquid, and relates to the technical field of waste liquid treatment. According to the method, the distributed control modules are introduced to all process links such as pretreatment, neutralization, ammonia conversion, pulping, acidification, filtration and crystallization in the etching waste liquid to perform full-flow automatic control, so that real-time acquisition, dynamic adjustment and data storage of process control parameters are realized, the fluctuation of impurity content is effectively reduced, the purity stability of a product is improved, the purity of copper sulfate is stabilized to be more than 99.9%, and the batch ratio of high-purity products is up to be more than 98%. Meanwhile, the whole process automation obviously improves the production efficiency, the single-batch production period is greatly shortened, the safety and the continuity are enhanced, meanwhile, the auxiliary material adding precision and the automatic control reduce the resource waste, and the energy-saving effect is obvious.

title_en: Ship traffic flow prediction method and system based on multi-scale space-time characteristics
abstract_en: The invention provides a ship traffic flow prediction method and a system based on multi-scale space-time characteristics, comprising the steps of collecting ship space-time traffic data of a channel to be detected, preprocessing the ship space-time traffic data and constructing a traffic network topological graph; the method comprises the steps of constructing a mixed space-time diagram convolution network based on linear attention, wherein the mixed space-time diagram convolution network based on linear attention comprises a spatial feature extraction module, a time feature extraction module and a linear attention module, respectively inputting a traffic network topological graph into the spatial feature extraction module and the time feature extraction module to obtain time feature data and spatial feature data, and inputting the time feature data and the spatial feature data into the linear attention module to output a ship traffic flow predicted value. The method can effectively extract the multi-scale space-time correlation characteristics of the ship traffic flow, enhance the robustness of the model in a complex navigation environment, and provide reliable support for intelligent dispatching and safe navigation of the ship lock.

title_en: Satellite processing system supporting flexible software configuration and implementation method thereof
abstract_en: The system comprises a baseband processing module, a navigation information processor and a configuration management module, wherein the baseband processing module is a single-chip FPGA, the single-chip FPGA is divided into a measurement and control baseband working area, a communication baseband working area and a navigation baseband working area, each working area is provided with independent clock signals, intermediate frequency signals and reset signals, the navigation information processor is used for completing positioning and orbit determination timing processing of a satellite, the configuration management module comprises a loading refreshing reconstruction chip and at least one Flash chip hung on the loading refreshing reconstruction chip, the Flash chip is divided into a plurality of independent storage areas, each independent storage area correspondingly stores one part of baseband software image, and the loading refreshing reconstruction chip is respectively connected with a whole satellite computer and the baseband processing module and used for loading, refreshing and on-orbit reconstruction operation of software of the baseband processing module under the control of the whole satellite computer.

title_en: Traffic signal self-adaptive control method and system based on weighted waiting time optimization
abstract_en: The invention relates to a traffic signal self-adaptive control method and system based on weighted waiting time optimization, comprising the following steps of step 1, an intersection traffic environment and state sensing stage, state acquisition and characterization, and extraction of a compact state vector with fixed dimension The method comprises the steps of calculating a reward signal, performing an action output and environment interaction stage, performing action generation and execution, performing action binarization mapping, performing environment transfer and storage, performing a model learning and parameter updating stage, randomly sampling small batches of experience data from an experience playback buffer area, sending the small batches of experience data to a DDPG self-adaptive controller for updating network parameters, performing operation effect and feedback closed loop, and achieving a control target of minimizing overall weighted waiting time of an intersection. The invention obviously reduces the total weighting waiting time of the intersection and improves the overall operation efficiency.

title_en: Heisui river horsefly spawn breeding device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a black soldier fly egg planting device, which comprises an outer shed body, an inner shed body, a humidity control assembly and a temperature control assembly, wherein the inner shed body is arranged in the outer shed body to form an inner and outer double-layer shed structure, and the inner shed body is a black soldier fly egg planting space; the humidity control assembly is arranged in the inner shed body and used for adjusting the humidity of the space of the hermetia illucens spawn; the temperature control assembly is arranged on the outer shed body and used for adjusting the temperature of the space of the breeding eggs of the hermetia illucens. The utility model discloses a setting of above-mentioned condition can break through the restriction that region and season propagated to the mating of heisui river horsefly. Under the sunlight irradiation condition, the temperature and the humidity in the greenhouse can be independently regulated and controlled, the mating behavior of the adult hermetia illucens cannot be influenced, and the requirements of the mating and egg-laying environmental conditions of the adult hermetia illucens can be met under various complex climatic conditions.

title_en: Intelligent home master control system and control network for hotels and apartments
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the intelligent house major control system and the control network that automatic change control intelligence house field is used for hotel and apartment. Comprises a micro control unit for executing a control program; the wireless communication module is connected with the micro control unit and comprises a zigbee communication unit, a lora communication unit, a wifi communication unit and a Bluetooth communication unit; the power supply module is connected with the micro control unit; the multi-channel strong current relay module is connected with the micro control unit; the multi-channel IO input detection module is connected with the micro control unit; the external storage module is connected with the micro control unit; the Ethernet module is connected with the micro control unit; the RS485 or CAN communication interface is connected with the micro control unit; the key module is connected with the micro control unit; and the modulus detection module is connected with the micro control unit. By the scheme, the intellectualization of the traditional hotel guest room, apartment or residential home can be realized. The control precision is higher, can realize the humidity and detect the function.

title_en: Integrated photometer control system

The device is compatible with all different mechanical structure configurations of the same series, realizes modularization completely, has small volume and simple assembly, saves cost and has powerful functions.

abstract_en: The application provides a vehicle intelligence is driven and is assisted monitoring device, mobile terminal and system includes: the CSI interface unit is used for being connected with a vehicle-mounted camera device to acquire environment image data which are acquired by the vehicle-mounted camera device and represent road condition information outside the vehicle and/or driving state information of a driver inside the vehicle; the sensor unit is used for acquiring running data in the running process of the vehicle; the CPU unit is electrically connected with the CSI interface unit and the sensor unit respectively; wherein, the CPU unit is an MSM8953 mobile processor. The power supply alarm prompting device of the cash register comprises the cash register, wherein a sounding mechanism and a light-emitting element are sequentially arranged on the right side of the cash register from top to bottom, and a power supply alarm prompting device are sequentially and fixedly connected to the right side of the bottom of the inner wall of the cash register from left to right. title_en: Neck brace and wearing equipment that has neck brace
abstract_en: The utility model provides a neck support and wearing equipment with the neck support, wherein the wearing equipment comprises the neck support and a head-wearing device, the head-wearing device is arranged on the neck support, and the head-wearing device is carried by the neck support to relieve the pressure of the head-wearing device on the head of a user. The neck brace comprises a neck brace body and a connecting unit, wherein the connecting unit is arranged on the neck brace body, the head-mounted device is arranged on the connecting unit, and the connecting unit is used for bearing the head-mounted device.

title_en: Full-automatic ice cream robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a full-automatic ice cream robot which comprises a box body, wherein an ice cream machine is arranged at the rear end of an inner cavity of the box body, a cup barrel is arranged on one side of the ice cream machine, a glass table top is arranged at the front end of the ice cream machine, a cooperative robot is arranged at the upper end of the glass table top, a clamping jaw is arranged at one end of the cooperative robot, a paper cup is grabbed at one end of the clamping jaw, a lifting device is arranged at the lower end of the glass table top and comprises a lifting barrel, a cup seat is arranged at the upper end of the lifting barrel, and a lifting cylinder is arranged at the lower end of the lifting barrel. The utility model has the beneficial effects that: the system can provide unmanned self-service purchase experience for customers, the purchase mode is rapid and convenient, the system detects whether customers exist, the customers are welcomed through light, background music and dance performance actions of the robot when the customers exist, and the customers select commodities through a touch screen self-service terminal or a voice purchase system and support online payment.

title_en: Respiratory secretion collection simulation training and checking system and device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a respiratory secretion acquisition simulation training and checking system and a device, comprising a login module; the mode selection module is used for selecting a theoretical teaching mode, a theoretical assessment mode, a training mode and an operation assessment mode; the theory teaching module is used for teaching theoretical knowledge; the theoretical assessment module is used for assessing the theoretical knowledge of learning; the training module is used for training the part for collecting nasal secretion and the collecting time, and the part for collecting pharyngeal secretion and the collecting time; the operation assessment module is used for assessing; the human head model is internally provided with a nasal cavity detection assembly, a pharyngeal detection assembly and a communication module, and is used for realizing communication with terminal equipment and data transmission among the modules. The utility model has the advantages that a practicer can perform examination on the basis of full training, and the learning and examination are divided into theoretical knowledge and operation steps, so that the learning and examination are more comprehensive.

title_en: Gas detection early warning device for chemical product delivery
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a gas detection early warning device for chemical product transport, including first pipeline, second pipeline and sleeve pipe, first conveyer pipe is pegged graft in the sheathed tube left side, and the second conveyer pipe is pegged graft on the sheathed tube right side, and sheathed tube top fixed mounting has an electrical apparatus box, and the inside fixed mounting of electrical apparatus box has thermometer module, and thermometer module's bottom fixed mounting has the temperature-sensing head, and electrical apparatus box's inside fixed mounting has the PCL controller. The above structure is adopted in the utility model, the temperature-sensing head that utilizes the bottom of thermometer module to have anti-corrosion function carries out the perception to the temperature in the pipeline to carry out logic monitoring through utilizing the PCL controller, when the high predetermined value that surpasses of temperature in the pipeline, drive the coolant liquid through the start-up water pump and flow in the cooling coil, thereby can cool off the chemical industry gas in the pipeline, thereby can reduce the gas in the pipeline and high the damage of giving first pipeline, second pipeline and bringing.

title_en: Radiant heat source method combustion performance detector for flooring material
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a radiant heat source method combustion performance detector for a flooring material, wherein a cooling pipe is arranged on the inner wall of a back plate of a combustion chamber, the inlet of the cooling pipe is connected with a cooling water storage device through a first water pump, the outlet of the cooling pipe is connected with the cooling water storage device, the first water pump is controlled by a PLC (programmable logic controller), and a thermocouple is connected with the PLC; the radiant flux meter probe is arranged in a cup-shaped metal sheath with a cavity, a water inlet pipe is arranged at an inlet at the top of the metal sheath, the inlet of the water inlet pipe is connected with a cooling water storage device through a water pump II, and an outlet at the bottom of the metal sheath is connected with the cooling water storage device through a water outlet pipe; the radiation pyrometer is installed on telescopic link one end, and the telescopic link other end is through T type pivot and adjusting nut rotatable installation on U type fixed sheathe in, and the fixed cover of U type is installed on linear guide, and linear guide fixes on the support. The utility model realizes effective control of the temperature of the combustion chamber and improves the accuracy of the detection result.

title_en: Control system for feeding device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a control system for a feeding device, which comprises a control module, a power module and a power supply module, wherein the control module is used for controlling the feeding device to feed materials; the control module comprises a Programmable Logic Controller (PLC); the power module comprises a walking motor, a feeding motor, a stirring motor and a motor controller, the motor controller is used for controlling the starting and stopping of the walking motor, the feeding motor and the stirring motor, the movement speed and the movement amount, and the motor controller is electrically connected with the PLC; the power supply module supplies power for the control module and the power module. The utility model is constructed by the PLC, and realizes logic control and communication by the operations of material storage, stirring, throwing, walking, positioning and the like, and the control system has stable operation, high efficiency and convenient maintenance and operation.

title_en: Sitting posture monitoring learning seat
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sitting posture monitoring and learning seat which comprises a sitting posture monitoring device, an alarm assembly and a seat, wherein the sitting posture monitoring device and the alarm assembly are both arranged on the seat; the four pressure sensors are arranged at the four corners of the seat part of the seat and used for collecting pressure information of the four corners of the seat part and transmitting the pressure information to the central processing unit; the central processing unit is used for receiving, processing and comparing signals output by the four pressure sensors to judge whether the sitting posture is normal or not, and transmitting the signals to the alarm component when the abnormal sitting posture of the user is monitored. The utility model receives the signal by the central processing unit, compares and calculates to judge the sitting posture of the user, and transmits the stored and collected signal and the signal processing and analyzing result in a period of time to the mobile terminal.

title_en: Electric power inspection robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electric power inspection robot, which comprises a double-photosphere table, a laser radar, a binocular camera, an ultrasonic radar and a central processing unit; the double-photosphere table is in signal connection with the central processing unit and is used for sending an image signal to be identified to the central processing unit so that the central processing unit can determine the power defect and/or the meter reading according to the signal to be identified; the central processing unit is respectively connected with the laser radar, the binocular camera and the ultrasonic radar in a signal mode and used for determining obstacles in the surrounding environment according to signals received from at least one of the laser radar, the binocular camera and the ultrasonic radar. According to the utility model, the laser radars, the binocular cameras and the ultrasonic radars with different optimal recognition ranges are combined, so that the high recognition rate of the electric power inspection robot on obstacles in different distances can be ensured; the working stability of the power inspection robot is improved.

title_en: Intelligent navigation device for running of automatic driving automobile based on road
abstract_en: The utility model provides an automatic driving automobile operation intelligent navigation device based on a road, and belongs to the field of vehicle engineering. Including mobile unit, guide assembly, mobile unit includes the photovoltaic board, the support frame, sonar generator, the stabiliser, vehicle control panel, the battery, the main casing body, the board line, main casing body top is provided with the support frame, the main casing body is T type tee bend structure, be provided with sonar generator in the horizontally both ends, vertical tip is provided with the ring flange, the photovoltaic board articulates on arranging the support frame in, in the main casing was arranged in to the stabiliser, connect through the board line between stabiliser and the photovoltaic board, in the main casing was arranged in to the battery, vehicle control panel arranges in the main casing, battery and sonar generator are connected, can freely install, navigate to the autopilot of test street lamp.

title_en: Intelligent storage device capable of achieving man-machine interaction
abstract_en: The utility model provides an intelligent storage device capable of realizing man-machine interaction, which comprises a storage box and an intelligent system arranged on the storage box, wherein the intelligent system comprises a control unit, a sensor unit, a Bluetooth module, a camera module, a voice module, an execution unit, a power supply module and an OLED display module; the device is provided with voice broadcasting and voice recognition functions, and when a toy needs to be placed, the toy can be automatically recognized only by aligning the toy with the camera; the sterilization function of the multifunctional intelligent household clothes hanger provides a healthy environment for children at home, and the man-machine interaction function provides unparalleled pleasure and autonomous learning for the children, so that convenience is provided for the left-behind children to a great extent. The storage device meets the requirements of the modern society to a great extent, and promotes the development of the society.

title_en: Solar traffic jam traffic light indicating device based on big data
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a solar traffic jam traffic light indicating device based on big data, which belongs to the technical field of traffic lights and has the technical scheme that the solar traffic jam traffic light indicating device comprises a base, wherein a solar panel is embedded in the front side of the base, the solar traffic jam traffic light indicating device solves the problem that the existing solar traffic light has no functions of camera shooting and accommodation regulation, and traffic accidents are easily caused by traffic participants under the condition of not following traffic rules at crossroads with complex conditions, the transportation of the solar traffic light by a user is inconvenient.

title_en: Flashlight for diving that possesses infiltration early warning function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a submersible flashlight with a water seepage early warning function, which comprises a shell, wherein a light-transmitting mirror is fixedly connected to the left side between the top and the bottom of an inner cavity of the shell, a flashlight body is fixedly connected to the bottom of the inner cavity of the shell, a sealing cover is sleeved on the right side of the shell, a liquid level sensor is fixedly connected to the bottom of the flashlight body, a warning lamp is fixedly connected to the left side of the bottom of the shell, a control frame is fixedly connected to the top of the shell, and an adjusting shell is fixedly connected to the top of the control frame. According to the utility model, the liquid level sensor, the warning lamp, the control frame, the adjusting shell, the first toothed plate, the spring, the push rod, the button, the adjusting rod, the second toothed plate, the pressing plate, the ejector rod, the tension spring, the motor and the cam are arranged, so that the problems that the existing flashlight for diving has no water seepage early warning function and anti-falling function are solved, and the flashlight for diving has the advantages of the water seepage early warning function and the anti-falling function, and is worthy of popularization.

title_en: Control system of standard multimedia planetarium
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a control system of a standard multimedia planetarium, which comprises a control box, wherein the middle part of the inner wall of the control box is fixedly connected with a frame plate, the middle part of the top end of the frame plate is fixedly connected with a motor, the driving end of the motor penetrates through the top end of the control box and is fixedly connected with a rotary table, the middle part of the top end of the rotary table is fixedly connected with an upright post, and the top end of the upright post is rotatably connected with a multimedia instrument. According to the utility model, the motor drives the turntable to rotate, so that the direction of the multimedia instrument is changed, then the electric push rod drives the transmission rod to move, the transmission rod drives the multimedia instrument to rotate, the angle adjustment of the multimedia instrument is completed, the multimedia instrument can be subjected to direction and angle adjustment without moving the control box, the use is flexible and convenient, the hydraulic cylinder drives the support frame to move downwards, the universal wheel is driven to extend out of the bottom end of the hollow bottom foot and support the control box, and the integral movement of the control box is facilitated.

title_en: Alarm device based on Zigbee for intelligent engineering construction
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a Zigbee-based alarm device for intelligent engineering construction, which comprises a substrate, wherein the top of the substrate is connected with a mounting rack, the top of an inner cavity of the mounting rack is provided with a smoke detection mechanism, the top of the substrate is respectively provided with a computer controller and a Zigbee router, the computer controller and the Zigbee router are both fixedly connected to the top of the substrate, four corners of the bottom of the substrate are respectively provided with an electric hydraulic push rod, the bottom end of each electric hydraulic push rod is provided with a support rod, the bottom ends of the four support rods are commonly connected with a support bottom plate, four corners of the bottom of the support bottom plate are respectively provided with a universal wheel with a brake, and the mounting rack is uniformly provided with a plurality of audible and visual alarms. The alarm device can monitor and process smoke in a community public area in real time based on a Zigbee network, and can send out alarm signals in time when the smoke in the community public area appears, so that security personnel in the community can perform fire fighting and extinguishing operations in time.

title_en: Thing networking remote control device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an Internet of things remote control device which comprises a UPS (uninterrupted power supply), a casing, a sealing top cover and a fixing plate, wherein a humidity sensor is installed on one side of the casing through a screw, the sealing top cover is installed on the top of the casing through a positioning screw, radiating fins are arranged on the top of the sealing top cover at equal intervals through installing openings, a heat absorbing plate is welded in the casing, and a remote control switch is installed on the top of the heat absorbing plate through a screw. This novel thing networking remote control device has the function that humidity detected, can improve sealing performance under the prerequisite that improves the leakproofness, and the installation and the dismantlement of being convenient for are fit for extensively using widely.

title_en: Movable show board that business administration used
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of industrial and commercial management, and discloses a movable display board for industrial and commercial management, which comprises a display board, an electric push rod device and a bottom board, wherein a writing board is arranged at the front end of the display board, the top of the electric push rod device is connected with a push rod, the push rod is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the display board, the bottom board is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the electric push rod device, a movable wheel is arranged at the corner end of the bottom board, a fixed frame is fixedly distributed at the upper end of the back of the display board, the middle end of the fixed frame is slidably connected with a connecting rod, a pressing plate is fixedly arranged at the inner end of the connecting rod, a spring rod is fixedly distributed at the outer end of the pressing plate in a circle, and a lifting device is fixedly arranged at the outer end of the connecting rod. This movable show board that business administration was used is convenient for carry out business administration and writes the teaching operation, and automatic control show board lift adjustment height wide range teaching stably removes, conveniently compresses tightly text or drawing for business administration, is applicable to the teaching show.

title_en: Subway tunnel water logging prevention early warning and controlling means
abstract_en: The utility model provides a subway tunnel water flooding prevention early warning and control device which comprises an alarm control host, a first liquid level sensor, a camera, a drainage pump and a water pump power distribution controller, wherein the first liquid level sensor and the camera are arranged above a tunnel water pool, a second liquid level sensor and the drainage pump are arranged in the tunnel water pool, the second liquid level sensor and the drainage pump are both connected with the water pump power distribution controller, the drainage pump is connected with one end of a drainage pipe, the other end of the drainage pipe is connected to an outdoor drainage well, a first pressure sensor and a first flow sensor are arranged on the drainage pipe, and the first liquid level sensor, the camera, the second liquid level sensor, the water pump power distribution controller, the first pressure sensor and the first flow sensor are all connected with the alarm control host. The utility model can find abnormal phenomena such as pipeline leakage, tunnel water burst and the like in time, send out early warning in advance, strive for precious time for emergency repair, automatically take corresponding measures and reduce the accident influence degree.

title_en: Water plant pump house unit remote control system based on wireless loRa
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of remote control, in particular to a remote control system of a pumping house unit of a water plant based on wireless LoRa. Including setting up the transmitting and receiving device in the factory to and set up receiving feedback device and the host computer display terminal at the water supply pump room, transmitting and receiving device and receiving feedback device pass through loRa wireless transmission module and connect, realize data communication, host computer display terminal pass through loRa wireless transmission module with loRa wireless transmission module, receiving feedback device connect. The utility model controls the transmitting and receiving device arranged in a factory area and the receiving and feedback device arranged in the water supply pump room through the singlechip, realizes that when a button in the transmitting and receiving device is pressed to trigger the water pump unit to be opened or closed, the transmitting and receiving device sends a corresponding instruction, the receiving and feedback device receives the instruction and then executes the corresponding instruction, and feeds back signals of the unit, such as opening, closing, failure and the like, to the transmitting and receiving device, thereby realizing closed loop and facilitating remote operation.

title_en: Rail mounted parking stall lock and reservation parking stall bootstrap system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rail type parking space lock which comprises a groove body, a sliding rail, a shell and a baffle plate, wherein the groove body is embedded on the ground of a parking space, the sliding rail is installed in the groove body, the shell is connected with the sliding rail in a sliding mode through a roller, the baffle plate is fixedly installed at the top of the shell, the upper edge of the baffle plate is higher than a chassis of a vehicle, a motor device and a first controller are installed inside the shell, the output end of the motor device is connected with a roller of the roller, and the first controller controls the opening and closing of the motor device. The parking space lock is arranged as the rail type parking space lock, can automatically move, does not need manual operation, is convenient to use, occupies a small area, does not have the parking space lock in a parking space during parking, and prevents a vehicle from crushing the parking space lock.

title_en: Computer teaching equipment is used in laboratory
abstract_en: The utility model discloses computer teaching equipment for laboratories, which comprises a moving rod, wherein the outer side wall of the top of the moving rod is movably connected with a cover, the left side of a screen is provided with a limiting column, the side surface of the limiting column is fixedly connected with a threaded column, the left side wall of the cover is fixedly connected with a fixed plate, the left side wall of the limiting column is attached to the right side wall of the fixed plate, one end, far away from the limiting column, of the threaded column penetrates through the left side wall of the cover and the moving rod and extends to the outside of the moving rod, and one end, far away from the limiting column, of the threaded column is fixedly connected with a rotating column. According to the utility model, the rotation of the cover can be realized by arranging the rotating column and the fixed plate, the surface of the frame body is provided with the opening, the screen can be retracted into the frame body, the limiting block and the electric sliding groove are arranged, the operation is carried out by utilizing the lifting control button, the damage to the device is reduced, the computer is protected by arranging the isolation plate, and the inner space of the frame body is better utilized by arranging the movable door.

title_en: Driving recorder with 4G communication function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of automobile data recorder, and discloses an automobile data recorder with 4G communication function, an open slot is concavely arranged at the front end part of a shell, a camera shell can be arranged in the open slot in an up-and-down rotating way, so that the camera can flexibly rotate up and down to adjust the pitching angle of the camera, the adaptability is wide, the installation and the disassembly between an installation base and the shell are convenient and quick, the installation base can be fixedly installed through a screw or a pasting plate, the installation is flexible and convenient, and the automobile data recorder can be networked through a 4G communication module in real time, when a parking person leaves the vehicle to be stolen and scratched, the parking person can be informed to the vehicle owner at the first time through a 4G wireless network, the problems of theft prevention and scratching prevention after parking are effectively solved, and the mobile phone can be connected through a wireless WiFi communication module, so that the synchronous function of the connection between the mobile phone and the automobile data recorder is realized, make vehicle event data recorder's video record can show on the cell-phone screen and look over, the practicality is strong.

title_en: Mining positioning system based on ultra wide band technology
abstract_en: The application provides a mining positioning system based on ultra wide band technique includes: the terminal is provided with a UWB module, an NB-IOT module and a WIFI module; the base station is used for acquiring the position information of the terminal and comprises a UWB module, an NB-IOT module and a WIFI module, wherein the UWB module is used for positioning the terminal in a short distance, the NB-IOT module is used for positioning the terminal in a long distance, and the WIFI module is used for transmitting the image and video data of the terminal in real time; and the alarm module is used for carrying out voice alarm and/or light alarm when the terminal enters the electronic fence area. The utility model provides a mining positioning system based on ultra wide band technique through set up UWB module, NB-IOT module and WIFI module in the basic station, realizes the accurate positioning to the terminal that is provided with UWB module, NB-IOT module and WIFI module.

title_en: Early education device with liquid crystal handwriting and card voice recognition
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an early education device with liquid crystal handwriting and card voice recognition, which comprises a front shell, wherein a liquid crystal writing film is arranged on the lower side of the middle part of the front end of the front shell, a liquid crystal cleaning system module is arranged on the right side of the liquid crystal writing film, a card recognition voice playing recognition module is arranged on the right side of the upper part of the front end of the front shell, and a loudspeaker is arranged on the left side of the upper part of the front shell. In the utility model, the top end of the surface of the shell is provided with the card recognition voice playing recognition module, the plug-in card (comprising matched characters and pattern contents), the battery module, the liquid crystal removal system module and the liquid crystal writing film, the battery module is respectively connected with the card recognition voice playing recognition module and the liquid crystal removal system module, and the shell is provided with the child cartoon characters, so that the early education machine has the advantages of simple integral structure, novel appearance and multiple functions, and can enable children to listen and write at the same time of entertainment and experience joy of learning.

title_en: Digital quantity output circuit
abstract_en: The utility model provides a digital quantity output circuit, and belongs to the field of electronic circuits. The digital quantity output circuit includes: the device comprises a first output unit, a second output unit, a first control unit and a second control unit; the control end of the first output unit is connected with the output end of the first control unit and the output end of the second control unit, the control end of the second output unit is connected with the output end of the first control unit and the output end of the second control unit, and the output end of the first output unit is connected with the input end of the second output unit; the first control unit generates and sends a first control signal; the second control unit generates and transmits a second control signal; the first output unit executes on-off switching according to the received first control signal and the second control signal; the second output unit executes on-off switching according to the received first control signal and the second control signal. The utility model solves the problem that the output can not be turned off due to the fault of the single-pole output circuit, and ensures the safety of the digital output circuit.

title_en: Social distance keeping reminding device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a social distance keeping reminding device, which receives a temperature signal and a distance signal through a temperature measuring sensor and a distance sensor and sends the temperature signal and the distance signal to a processor for processing, wherein when the temperature signal sent by the temperature measuring sensor is received to judge that a human body exists in a detection direction, and the distance signal sent by the distance sensor is received to judge that the human body is within a preset distance, the processor controls an alarm to send an alarm signal to remind the user of keeping a safe social distance; in addition, the device can not give an alarm to objects with too close distances, and the stability is good. In addition, laser reminding information is projected to the ground through the laser lamp, the warning effect can be achieved on surrounding pedestrians, and user experience is improved. Moreover, the user only needs to wear the device of the scheme, the device can be used in all dense people, the same sensor is not needed to be worn by all the users to calculate the distance between the users, and the production cost and the popularization cost are reduced.

title_en: ETC recorder equipment with three-axis gyroscope
abstract_en: The utility model discloses ETC recorder equipment with a triaxial gyroscope, which comprises a sucker, wherein a fixed box is fixedly connected to the middle end of the lower surface of the sucker, a servo motor is fixedly connected to the middle end of the bottom of an inner cavity of the fixed box, the output end of the servo motor penetrates through the middle end of the lower surface of the fixed box and is fixedly connected with an ETC body, a spring is fixedly connected to the middle end on the right side of the inner cavity of the ETC body, a movable plate is fixedly connected to the left side of the spring, a rotating block is fixedly connected to the middle end on the right side of the movable plate, a connecting rod is fixedly connected to the middle end on the right side of the rotating block, a mounting plate is fixedly connected to the right end of the connecting rod, and a camera is fixedly connected to the right side of the mounting plate. The ETC recorder provided with the three-axis gyroscope is provided with the servo motor, the spring, the rotating block and the connecting rod, so that the purpose of convenient adjustment is achieved, and the problem that the recording effect is influenced because the conventional ETC recorder with the three-axis gyroscope cannot be adjusted as required when in use because the conventional ETC recorder with the three-axis gyroscope does not have the function of convenient adjustment is solved.

title_en: Laser wavelength stabilizing light path structure and laser warning receiver detection system
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of laser alarm detection, and particularly relates to a laser wavelength stabilizing light path structure and a laser alarm receiver detection system. The light splitting system is used for splitting the polychromatic light beam emitted by the light source and emitting a monochromatic light beam with a single wavelength. The collimation system is used for performing primary collimation on the monochromatic light beams. The beam expanding system is used for carrying out secondary collimation on the monochromatic light beam after primary collimation and expanding the beam diameter of the monochromatic light beam. The utility model is based on the principle of a grating monochromator, and can realize stable output of light beams with single wavelength by improvement and optimization.

title_en: TV trinity core board with protection against electric shock function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a TV three-in-one core board with an electric shock protection function, relating to the technical field of electric shock protection and comprising: the electric shock protection module is used for protecting a human body against electric shock, the power supply module is used for converting commercial power into required voltage, the grounding detection module and the voltage detection module are used for sampling commercial power, the main control module is used for receiving signals and outputting signals, and the power supply control module is used for controlling the commercial power to supply power. The TV three-in-one core board with the electric shock protection function converts commercial power into low voltage for power supply by adopting the power module, avoids electric shock of workers by adopting the electric shock protection module, samples commercial power voltage and monitors the change of output commercial power.

title_en: Shared charging device of mobile electronic intelligent terminal and/or mobile power supply
abstract_en: The utility model provides a shared charging device of a mobile electronic intelligent terminal and/or a mobile power supply, which comprises a box body, a wired charger and/or a wireless charger, a storage bin, a lockset device and a controller, wherein the wired charger and/or the wireless charger are arranged in the box body; the storage bin is arranged in the box body; the locking device is arranged corresponding to the storage bin and used for locking or unlocking the mobile electronic intelligent terminal and/or the mobile power supply stored in the storage bin; the controller is electrically connected with the wired charger and/or the wireless charger and used for controlling the on-off of the circuit of the wired charger and/or the wireless charger and controlling the opening and closing of the lockset device. Compared with the prior art, the shared charging device of the mobile electronic intelligent terminal and/or the mobile power supply can effectively lock the charged mobile electronic intelligent terminal and/or the charged mobile power supply in the box body, thereby effectively avoiding the loss and damage of the mobile electronic intelligent terminal and/or the mobile power supply.

title_en: Jig controller, jig and jig control system
abstract_en: The application provides a tool controller, tool and tool control system, tool controller electricity connection tool includes: the system comprises a first interface, a second interface, an information acquisition unit and a main control unit; the first interface is used for acquiring product identification information of a product to be detected and sending the product identification information to the main control unit; the second interface is used for acquiring the information of the operating personnel and sending the acquired information of the operating personnel to the main control unit; the information acquisition unit is used for acquiring jig information and sending the jig information to the main control unit; the main control unit is used for generating production tracking information according to the product identification information, the operator information and the jig information. The information that the tool controller acquireed can be integrated to this application, realizes the integration and the report of product information, tool information and operation personnel information at the controller end, simplifies the production and tracks the flow, improves production efficiency.

title_en: Liquid self-service sharing equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a liquid self-service sharing device, relates to the technical field of sharing devices, and aims to provide a liquid self-service sharing device which can realize rapid charging of wine, reduce the labor intensity of workers and improve the working efficiency, and is technically characterized in that a charging pipe is fixedly arranged at the top of a wine tank, a connecting hole communicated with the inner side and the outer side is formed in the side wall of a machine body, the top end of the charging pipe extends to the inner side of the connecting hole and is fixedly connected with the connecting hole, a charging pipe is detachably arranged in the inner cavity of the connecting hole and is positioned outside the machine body, the technical effect is that the charging pipe is additionally arranged, the end part of the charging pipe is directly connected and fixed with the inner cavity of the connecting hole when in use, the other end of the charging pipe enters the new wine, a pump body outside the charging pipe is controlled by a control device, so that the external wine flows into the inner cavity of the wine tank through the charging pipe and the charging pipe, realize the quick material loading of drinks, reduce staff intensity of labour.

title_en: Dynamic teaching model capable of simulating iris action
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a dynamic teaching model capable of simulating iris actions, which simulates the process of iris expansion and pupil expansion by driving a spherical body to extrude a silicon sheet to expand a through hole on the silicon sheet, and simulates the process of iris contraction and pupil contraction by driving the spherical body to be far away from the silicon sheet to reduce the through hole of the silicon sheet in the resetting process. Therefore, the dynamic process of iris contraction and expansion is simulated, the understanding of students on iris characteristics is deepened, and the learning effect is improved.

title_en: Energy intelligent management and control system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of energy management and control, in particular to an energy intelligent management and control system based on the Internet of things. The technical scheme comprises the following steps: the intelligent cabinet comprises a cabinet body, an intelligent host is fixedly mounted inside the cabinet body, a service host is fixedly mounted on one side of the intelligent host, an uninterruptible power supply is fixedly mounted on one side of the service host, an acquisition host is fixedly mounted on one side of the uninterruptible power supply, a controller is fixedly mounted above the uninterruptible power supply, and a mounting plate is fixedly mounted on the rear side of the top of the cabinet body. According to the utility model, the acquisition host is matched with the uninterruptible power supply, so that energy information can be acquired, meanwhile, the uninterruptible power supply can supply power to the system emergently when power is cut off from the outside, the practicability is improved, the cold air cooler is matched with the temperature sensor, so that the interior of the system can be cooled in a cold air mode, and meanwhile, the temperature of the interior of the system during operation can be monitored through the temperature sensor, so that the practicability is improved, and the application range is enlarged.

title_en: AI intelligence epidemic prevention floodgate machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an AI intelligent epidemic prevention floodgate machine, which comprises a first shell and a second shell which are symmetrically arranged, wherein one side of the first shell, which is opposite to the second shell, is movably connected with two floodgate doors, the front bottoms of the first shell and the second shell are fixedly connected with a human body pyroelectric infrared sensor, and the top of the human body pyroelectric infrared sensor is provided with a colorful LED lamp; one side of the top end of the first shell is rotatably connected with a support frame, the top of the support frame is rotatably connected with a visual sensor, and one side of the bottom end of the visual sensor is fixedly connected with a non-contact infrared temperature measurement electric sensor; the inner wall of the top of the other side of the first shell is fixedly connected with a voice synthesis module, the bottom of the voice synthesis module is provided with an I/O expansion board, and the bottom of the I/O expansion board is provided with a controller.

title_en: Control device for simulating yaw control of aircraft

abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of teaching robots, in particular to a multifunctional intelligent service robot which comprises a machine body, a driving wheel and a collecting device, wherein the driving wheel is in transmission connection with the inner wall of the machine body, a display is fixedly connected to the surface of the machine body, the collecting device is arranged on the surface of the machine body, the collecting device comprises an assembling frame, the assembling frame is fixedly connected with the surface of the machine body, a rotating shaft is rotatably connected to the inner wall of the assembling frame, a driving gear is clamped on the surface of the rotating shaft, a push plate is bolted on the surface of the assembling frame, a side baffle is bolted on the surface of the rotating shaft, an assembling groove is formed in the surface of the machine body, a servo motor is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the assembling groove, and a driving end of the servo motor is fixedly connected with the driving gear. According to the utility model, the collection device is arranged, so that the collection of toys in front of the equipment is facilitated, the probability of the toys being clamped into the equipment chassis is reduced, the stability of the equipment is improved, and the collection efficiency of the toys in front of the equipment is improved.

title_en: Fault alarm device for intelligent manufacturing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fault alarm device for intelligent manufacturing, which relates to the technical field of intelligent manufacturing and comprises a main body, wherein the upper end of the front side of the main body is fixedly connected with a fixing seat, one side of the fixing seat is fixedly connected with a fixing bolt, one side of the fixing bolt is movably connected with a connecting column, one end of the connecting column is internally provided with a screw hole, the screw hole is matched with the fixing bolt, the other end of the connecting column is fixedly connected with a sounding board, one side of the sounding board is provided with a groove, and one side of the main body is fixedly provided with a motor. According to the utility model, the sounding board and the connecting column can be driven to rotate together through the adaptation of the tool and the groove, so that the screw hole and the fixing bolt can be adapted, the sounding board can be installed, the driving wheel is driven to rotate through the motor, the driven wheel is driven to rotate through the driving belt, the turntable can be driven to rotate, and the movable column can drive the knocking ring to slide in the limiting groove.

title_en: ABS plastic wardrobe with face recognition function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of a wardrobe, in particular to an ABS plastic wardrobe with face recognition, which comprises a wardrobe body and a plurality of recognition components, wherein the wardrobe body is provided with a plurality of mounting grooves, the recognition components comprise a door plate, a face recognition device, a controller, a clamping block, a shifting block, a limiting unit and a driving unit, the door plate is rotationally connected with the wardrobe body and is mutually matched with the mounting grooves, the face recognition device and the controller are fixedly connected with the door plate, the door plate is provided with a groove, the wardrobe body is provided with a clamping groove, one end of the clamping block penetrates through the groove, the door plate is provided with a slot, one end of the shifting block penetrates through the slot and is fixedly connected with the clamping block, the limiting unit is arranged in the groove, the face recognition device scans the face, then the driving unit is controlled by the controller to drive the limiting unit to release the limit, and at the moment, the shifting block is driven to be separated from the clamping groove, so that the door plate can be opened, and a user can open the door plate without carrying any article.

title_en: Boiling heat transfer experimental device capable of keeping boiling liquid level
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of thermal experimental equipment, in particular to a boiling heat transfer experimental device capable of keeping a boiling liquid level, which comprises the following components: the test body comprises a test container, wherein a heat transfer tube body is arranged in the test container in a penetrating way; the heat exchanger is connected with the exhaust end of the test container and is used for cooling the steam exhausted by the test container into liquid; the liquid level balance container is connected with the liquid discharge end of the heat exchanger, and the upper end of the liquid level balance container is provided with an environment connecting channel; the lower end of the liquid level balance container is connected with the lower end of the test container. The utility model can send the evaporated working medium in the test body back into the test body after being lack of cold, thereby avoiding the generation of variation of liquid level in the test body, ensuring the accuracy of the test result and the safety of the test process.

title_en: Corridor multiple security system
