abstract_en: The utility model discloses a corridor multiple security system, which belongs to the field of security and comprises a general control system and a corridor subsystem, wherein the general control system and the corridor subsystem are connected through a ZigBee wireless network, the general control system comprises a monitoring center, a network coordinator and a GSM module, the corridor subsystem comprises a wireless core module, a sensor group, a GPS module and a camera module, the corridor subsystem is connected in a wireless GPS positioning and GSM communication mode, the ZigBee technology is used as the core, and the wireless module is combined to form a flexible data transmission without wiring. The system comprises multiple security detection such as fire detection, toxic and harmful gas detection and the like, and can cope with most security problems.

title_en: Integrated equipment for recycling and selling old books
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of recycling of old books, in particular to an integrated equipment for recycling and selling old books. The technical scheme includes that the electric bookshelf comprises a cabinet body, a bookshelf and a touch screen, a longitudinal electric sliding table is installed at the position, close to the rear surface, of the inner portion of the cabinet body, a transverse electric sliding table is installed on the front surface of the longitudinal electric sliding table, an electric push rod is installed on the front surface of the transverse electric sliding table, an electric clamp is connected with the tail end of the electric push rod, the touch screen and a scanning camera are installed on one side, close to the touch screen, of the bottom of the inner wall of the cabinet body, an Internet of things host is installed on one side, close to the touch screen, of the bottom of the inner wall of the cabinet body, a window is formed in the front surface of the cabinet body, a transparent plate is installed in the window, an inlet and an outlet are formed in the front surface of the transparent plate, and the bookshelf is installed at the position, close to the rear surface of the transparent plate, of the inner portion of the cabinet body. The utility model can fully utilize old books, reduce the consumption of resources and reduce the cost of purchasing books.

title_en: Guide and adjustment table for simulation training
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of guide and adjustment tables, and discloses a guide and adjustment table for simulation training, which comprises a bedplate, a protective shell is arranged above the middle part of the bedplate, a display screen is fixedly arranged on the inner wall of one side of the opening of the protective shell, two groups of first dustproof nets are arranged on one side edge of the bottom of the display screen and fixedly arranged on two sides of the inner cavity at the bottom end of the protective shell, an inner pipe is fixedly sleeved in one end inner cavity of the protective shell, a second dustproof net is fixedly arranged on the inner wall of one side of the inner pipe, which is close to the protective shell, a fan group is arranged on one side edge of the second dustproof net and positioned on the inner side of the inner pipe, and an embedded groove is formed in one side inner cavity of the middle part of the top end of the bedplate; through platen and base case, the support that sets up, when can carrying out the main part to overall structure and accept, utilize the display screen that the platen top was established and the host computer equipment that the base incasement was established, can realize the whole effect of the used guide of whole simulation training and transfer the platform.

title_en: Wearable voice training equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides wearable voice practical training equipment, which relates to the technical field of practical training equipment and comprises a practical training equipment main body, wherein a connecting groove and an adjusting groove are formed in the inner side of the practical training equipment main body, a winding belt is arranged in the inner side of the connecting groove, an elastic belt is arranged between the winding belts, a limiting plate is arranged at the middle of the back of the practical training equipment main body, clamping plates are arranged on the two sides of the limiting plate, limiting clamps are arranged on the back of the clamping plates, connecting springs are arranged on the two sides of the inner side of the limiting plate, the winding belt is arranged in the inner side of the practical training equipment main body, the adjusting groove is formed in the front side of the connecting groove, the practical training equipment main body can be bound between the waists through the winding belts and the elastic belt, the practical training equipment can be bound at the positions through the adjusting groove through winding belts and the elastic belt for multiple times, the practical training equipment can be clamped on clothes through the limiting clamps, the practical training equipment main body is convenient to carry and use, and the practical training equipment main body can be guided and trained while practice.

title_en: Negative pressure linkage alarm device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of chemical machinery, in particular to a negative pressure linkage alarm device which comprises an induction cavity, a sensing device, an automatic control device and an alarm device, wherein a pressure release valve is arranged on the induction cavity; the sensing device is arranged in the sensing cavity; the automatic control device comprises a receiving module, a calculating module and a control module, wherein the calculating module is respectively connected with the receiving module and the control module, the receiving module is also connected with the sensing device, and the control module is also respectively connected with the alarm device and the pressure release valve. The sensing device capable of sensing the internal pressure change in real time is arranged in the sensing cavity, so that the pressure information in the sealing device can be monitored, the pressure information is transmitted to the automatic control device, further negative pressure linkage alarm is realized, the automatic control device is connected with the alarm device and the pressure relief valve, the pressure relief valve can be controlled to be automatically opened while the alarm is given, and potential safety hazards are eliminated in the first time.

title_en: Highway construction is with watering dust device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sprinkling and dust settling device for highway construction, which comprises a supporting plate, wherein a water tank is fixedly arranged on the left side of the top of the supporting plate, and a water injection pipe is communicated with the right side of the top of the supporting plate. According to the utility model, the water injection pipe is arranged for injecting water into the water tank, water in the water tank is led out under the action of the water pump, is led into the spray head through the hose and the communicating pipe, and is sprayed out through the spray head, so that the purpose of dust fall is achieved, when the water in the water tank is used up, the floating ball descends, and then the pressing plate presses the second switch, the second switch is communicated with the alarm, so that the alarm gives an alarm, when the water is injected into the water tank, the floating ball floats, and then the pressing plate presses the first switch, and then the first switch is communicated with the water pump, so that the water pump starts to work, and meanwhile, the problem that the water pump is easy to damage due to the fact that the water pump is continuously operated after the water tank does not have water in the existing dust fall device is solved.

title_en: Instant vending machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an instant vending machine which comprises a cabinet, a display screen, a storage area, weighing shelves, a first cabinet door, a heating area, a second cabinet door, a microwave oven and a multimedia host, wherein the multimedia host is fixedly arranged at the top of the inner side of the cabinet, one end of the multimedia host is electrically connected with the display screen, the storage area and the heating area are respectively arranged at the two sides of the inner side of the cabinet, a plurality of weighing shelves are fixedly arranged in the storage area, the first cabinet door is arranged at the outer side of the storage area and connected with the cabinet through a hinge, two microwave ovens are fixedly arranged in the heating area, the second cabinet door is arranged at the outer side of the heating area and connected with the cabinet through a hinge; the instant vending machine is simple in structure, novel in style and low in equipment processing cost; when in use, the multifunctional refrigerator has the functions of refrigerating and heating compared with the traditional cabinet.

title_en: Emergency drilling simulation demonstration device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an emergency exercise simulation demonstration device, relates to the technical field of fire emergency exercises, and aims at solving the problems that an existing exercise device is inconvenient to carry and finding of exercise objects is troublesome. The emergency exercise simulation demonstration device can reduce the transportation volume, so that the exercise device is convenient to carry, and meanwhile, the object searching of the exercise is convenient.

title_en: Computer lab monitored control system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a machine room monitoring system, in particular to the technical field of machine room monitoring, which comprises a central processing module, a monitoring module, an execution equipment module, an alarm module, a communication module, a standby power module and an access control module, wherein the monitoring module, the execution equipment module, the alarm module, the communication module, the standby power module and the access control module are all connected with the central processing module; the monitoring module comprises a temperature monitoring unit, a humidity monitoring unit, a smoke monitoring unit, a video monitoring unit and an electric power monitoring unit; the execution equipment module comprises an air conditioning unit, a dehumidifier unit and a fire extinguishing unit. The utility model is convenient for effectively monitoring the machine room, can automatically treat the occurrence of the abnormality, and can effectively rescue the occurrence of the accident, thereby avoiding the further expansion of the accident.

title_en: Lampblack generating device and testing system of lampblack absorber
abstract_en: The utility model provides an oil smoke generating device and a testing system of a range hood. The lampblack generating device comprises a containing device, wherein the containing device is provided with containing cavities, and at least one atomizing sheet is arranged in each containing cavity; the containing device is used for containing the atomizing agent; the atomization sheet is used for generating ultrasonic waves so as to enable the atomization agent to be atomized to form the simulated lampblack. The at least one atomizing sheet arranged at the bottom of the accommodating cavity generates ultrasonic waves, and is matched with different atomizing agents, so that the oil smoke particle size of the atomized atomizing agents is close to that of real oil smoke, and the oil smoke in different cooking modes can be simulated.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted recorder with damping effect and special wire harness combined structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a vehicle-mounted recorder with a damping effect and a special wire harness combined structure, and belongs to the field of vehicle-mounted electronic products. The automobile front windshield comprises a recorder main body and a USB wire harness, wherein the recorder main body is attached to the inner side of the automobile front windshield, one side of the recorder main body is provided with a USB interface, one end of the USB wire harness is provided with a USB connector, and the USB connector is inserted into the USB interface; the other end of the USB harness is provided with a cable, and a Z-shaped shock absorption structure is arranged between the cable and the USB connector. Compared with the prior art: firstly, when the vibration of the vehicle body is transferred to the cable due to jolt and vibration, the Z-shaped damping structure can form blocking and buffering, so that the cable is prevented from directly impacting the USB interface, and the connection stability in the driving process is realized; secondly, through zigzag shock-absorbing structure, can make on the cable of USB can be close laminating front windshield, can reduce the rocking of cable.

title_en: Redundant programmable logic controller system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a redundant programmable logic controller system. Wherein the redundant programmable logic controller system comprises: a first programmable logic controller and a second programmable logic controller; an optical fiber interface connecting the first programmable logic controller and the second programmable logic controller; a first secondary station and a second secondary station; a first bus connecting the first programmable logic controller and the first slave station; and a second bus connecting the second programmable logic controller and the second slave station.

title_en: Old person monitoring device that tumbles
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fall monitoring device for old people, which comprises a shell, wherein a movable cavity is arranged in the shell, a movable part is arranged in the movable cavity, the upper end and the lower end of the movable cavity are respectively provided with a containing end and a sensing end, the movable cavity is provided with a contact and an elastic sheet corresponding to the sensing end, the movable part is used for abutting against the elastic sheet and enabling the elastic sheet to be in contact with the contact, an alarm is arranged on the shell, after the elastic sheet is in contact with the contact, the alarm gives out an alarm, the effect of avoiding false touch can be realized when the movement speed of the movable part relative to the shell is lower through the arrangement of the elastic sheet, the contact and the movable part, so that the alarm accuracy is improved, and the fall monitoring device is suitable for the slow movement characteristics of the old people and reduces false touch caused by the fact that the old people forget to take down or take a daily movement at rest.

title_en: Network video recorder with built-in temperature alarm
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of network video recorders and discloses a network video recorder with a built-in temperature alarm, which comprises a shell, wherein one side of the front surface of the shell is fixedly connected with a display screen, one side of the back surface of the shell is fixedly connected with a wiring area, one side of the bottom wall in the shell is fixedly connected with a cooling fan, one side of the shell is fixedly connected with a dust screen, the inside of a mounting groove is movably connected with a mounting cover, one side of the bottom end of the mounting cover is fixedly connected with a temperature sensor body, and the other side of the bottom end of the mounting cover is fixedly connected with a buzzer. This built-in temperature alarm's network video recorder detects the inside temperature of casing in real time through the temperature sensor body, when the temperature is too high, through the too high warning of display screen demonstration temperature to start buzzer, send alarm sound, convenient to use person in time knows, makes radiator fan rotational speed faster simultaneously, the inside faster forced air cooling heat dissipation of casing of being convenient for, and then realizes the overtemperature warning, improves its practicality.

title_en: Express delivery cabinet with sell function
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of express cabinets, and particularly relates to an express cabinet with a vending function. The express cabinet with the selling function comprises a cabinet body and a plurality of grid doors, wherein a plurality of storage grid openings are formed in the cabinet body, and the grid doors are arranged on the cabinet body to open and close the storage grid openings; still include automatic lock, automatic lock includes lock subassembly and lock board, and one of lock subassembly and lock board is installed in selling the check mouth, and one side towards corresponding selling the check mouth on the check door is installed to another of lock subassembly and lock board, is provided with the lockhole on the lock board, and lock subassembly has the locking lever that can insert the lockhole. Express delivery cabinet with sell function reforms into the partial storing check mouth of current ordinary express delivery cabinet and sell the check mouth, keeps the main frame of current ordinary express delivery cabinet, and the part quantity of reforming transform is less, the transformation and the popularization of the express delivery cabinet of being convenient for.

title_en: Tunnel construction deformation monitoring device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of tunnel construction, and particularly discloses a tunnel construction deformation monitoring device which comprises a base and a top sheet, wherein a movable seat is arranged above the base, the top sheet is arranged above the movable seat, a symmetrical movable opening is formed in the movable seat, a sliding block is slidably arranged on the movable opening, a spring is arranged in the movable opening, a pressure sensor is fixedly arranged on the inner wall of the movable opening, the spring is pressed between the pressure sensor and the sliding block, a hinge rod is arranged between the sliding block and the top sheet, the end part of the hinge rod is hinged with the sliding block and the top sheet respectively, a lifting piece for driving the top sheet to lift is arranged on the base, and comprises a sleeve column fixedly arranged on the base and an electric push rod fixedly arranged in the sleeve column.

title_en: Shoot stable vehicle event data recorder
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of automobile data recorders and discloses an automobile data recorder with stable shooting, which comprises an automobile data recorder body, wherein fixed blocks are fixedly arranged at the left end and the right end of the bottom of the automobile data recorder body, a rotating rod is movably sleeved in the fixed blocks, a display screen is fixedly arranged in the automobile data recorder body, and mounting blocks are fixedly arranged at the left end and the right end of the top of the automobile data recorder body and the outer surface of the rotating rod. According to the automobile data recorder, the threaded rod, the limiting rod and the suckers are arranged, the threaded rod is rotated, so that the threaded rod drives the limiting block to rotate along the inner wall of the mounting block, the threaded rod drives the moving rod to move along the outer surface of the limiting rod, the moving rod drives the suckers to move, the glass is sucked more firmly, and then the three suckers are triangular, so that the automobile data recorder body is fixed more stably.

title_en: SF (sulfur hexafluoride) 6 Gas alarm monitoring system
abstract_en: The utility model provides an SF6 gas alarm monitoring system, which comprises: the main control module comprises a control center, a main control display screen and a main control alarm; the partition module comprises a partition controller, a plurality of SF6 gas detectors, a partition alarm and a partition display screen, wherein the SF6 gas detectors are in communication connection with the partition controller and feed back whether SF6 gas leaks or not to the partition controller, the partition alarm and the partition display screen are in communication connection with the partition controller, the partition display screen is used for displaying detection values of the SF6 gas detectors in the partition module, and the partition alarm is used for giving an alarm when SF6 gas leaks; the main control module is in communication connection with each partition module, the main control display screen is used for displaying detection values of all SF6 gas detectors of each partition module, and the main control alarm gives an alarm when the partition alarm is triggered. The monitoring system can clearly know whether SF6 gas leakage exists in each area before workers enter the area.

title_en: Wisdom teaching presentation device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of teaching aids, and discloses an intelligent teaching demonstration device, which comprises a demonstration mechanism, wherein the demonstration mechanism comprises a display screen, and the display screen is used for playing a demonstration picture; the first adjusting mechanism is connected to the demonstration mechanism. This wisdom teaching presentation device, when using, rotate worm and worm wheel meshing transmission for the internal thread cover rotates, through the joint of gear and locking portion this moment, makes the threaded rod can not rotate, under the drive of internal thread cover, makes the threaded rod reciprocate, thereby adjusts the height of display screen, so that the back row student watch, the pulling rod drives locking portion and gear separation drive worm this moment, the threaded rod loses the restriction between locking portion and the gear this moment, the threaded rod is driven by the internal thread cover and rotates, thereby control angle adjustment to the display screen, in order to facilitate the use of user.

title_en: Online detection system for quality of synthetic leather finished product
abstract_en: The utility model provides a synthetic leather finished product quality online detection system which comprises a rack, an unreeling roller and a reeling roller, wherein the synthetic leather finished product is unreeled from the unreeling roller and reeled to the reeling roller; the device also comprises a host, a linear array camera and a thickness measuring sensor, wherein the linear array camera and the thickness measuring sensor are arranged on a frame between the unreeling roller and the reeling roller, and are electrically connected with the host; the linear array camera collects leather face images of the synthetic leather finished product, sends corresponding image information to the host computer, and the host computer obtains the portal parameters of the synthetic leather finished product according to the boundary size of the identification image, analyzes the corresponding image information and judges whether flaws exist; if yes, judging the flaw type; the thickness measuring sensor measures thickness parameters of the finished synthetic leather product and sends corresponding parameter information to the host machine, and the host machine acquires the thickness parameters of the finished synthetic leather product; therefore, the automatic detection of the quality of the synthetic leather finished product is realized, the labor intensity of workers is effectively reduced, and the detection efficiency and the production efficiency are improved.

title_en: Networking burglar alarm fence
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a networking anti-theft alarm fence, and relates to the technical field of fences. This networking burglar alarm rail, including mobile jib, adjusting part and stabilizing part, the top fixed mounting of mobile jib has the mounting panel, and the top fixed mounting of mounting panel has the alarm lamp, and adjusting part locates on the mobile jib, adjusting part includes mounting panel, gag lever post and slide bar, and the gag lever post is used for spacing slide bar and mounting panel. This networking burglar alarm rail can adjust the distance of two sets of mobile jib and handle, when using like this, can be with mounting panel and slide bar adjustment after suitable length, avoid the envelope distance short or longer condition, increased the practicality of device's envelope effect and device, can also insert the threaded rod underground, form triangle setting with it through the screw sleeve, can increase the stability of mobile jib like this, improve the quality of mobile jib when using, reduce the mobile jib and produce the condition of empting when using.

title_en: Relative humidity control device in cigarette cut tobacco production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a relative humidity control device in cigarette cut tobacco production, which relates to the technical field of cigarette cut tobacco production and comprises a mounting frame and a humidity control assembly; and (3) a mounting frame: two corresponding humidity sensors are arranged at the left end and the right end of the upper side of the inner part, two corresponding storage components are arranged at the left side and the right side of the inner part of the installation frame, a rotating component is arranged at the rear side of the installation frame, and the rotating component is matched with the two storage components; humidity control assembly: the automatic cigarette smoking device comprises a fixed frame, a water outlet pipe, an atomizing nozzle, an air outlet box, an air outlet strip-shaped port and a connecting pipe, wherein the fixed frame is fixed at the upper end of the inside of the installation frame, the water outlet pipe is fixed at the left side of the inside of the fixed frame, evenly distributed water outlets are formed in the lower end of the circumferential surface of the water outlet pipe, and the atomizing nozzle is fixed in the water outlets and can evenly humidify cigarette smoking strips.

title_en: Automatic cargo discharging machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic cargo discharging machine, which comprises an automatic cargo discharging machine body and a machine door; a plurality of selling shelves are arranged in the automatic cargo discharging machine body; a plurality of goods grooves are arranged in each goods selling rack; each goods groove is provided with a first goods discharging mechanism; the cigarettes are arranged in the goods groove; a plurality of corresponding second shipment mechanisms are arranged below the front ends of the plurality of sales shelves; the side wall of the automatic cargo discharging machine body is provided with a plurality of openings corresponding to the second cargo discharging mechanism; the side surface of the automatic cargo discharging machine body is provided with a plurality of taking mechanisms corresponding to the openings; the machine door is provided with a touch screen which is respectively and electrically connected with the first shipment mechanism and the second shipment mechanism; the utility model reduces the collision of cigarettes in the shipment process, protects the cigarettes and prevents the cigarettes from deforming.

title_en: Cardiopulmonary resuscitation auxiliary device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of cardiopulmonary resuscitation auxiliary devices, and particularly relates to a cardiopulmonary resuscitation auxiliary device, which comprises a shell, a circuit board, an acceleration sensor, a microprocessor and an indicator lamp, wherein the acceleration sensor, the indicator lamp and the microprocessor are connected to the circuit board, the circuit board is arranged in the shell, the acceleration sensor is used for detecting the pressing acceleration information of a rescue person, and the microprocessor is used for calculating the pressing depth of the chest of a patient; the pilot lamp is equipped with a plurality of and all is connected with the microprocessor electricity, and every pilot lamp homoenergetic shows multiple different colours, and the colour that lights of a plurality of pilot lamps forms different combinations to indicate the different degree of depth of pressing to patient's thorax, can embody comparatively specific degree of depth of pressing comparatively directly perceivedly, when the degree of depth of pressing is not enough, can instruct the personnel of saving and useful for saving to increase suitable pressing force and save to the patient, auxiliary effect is better.

title_en: Chemistry experiment teaching platform convenient to wash
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a chemical experiment teaching table convenient to clean, which relates to the technical field of chemical experiment teaching tables and comprises a cabinet body, wherein a workbench is arranged on one side of the upper surface of the cabinet body, a first sliding rail is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the workbench, a sliding block is connected to the inside of the first sliding rail in a sliding manner, an outer cover is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the sliding block, a first gear and a second gear are rotatably connected to the two ends of the inner side wall of the outer cover through a shaft rod, a wiper plate is fixedly connected to the inner side wall of the outer cover, a water pool is arranged on the other side of the upper surface of the cabinet body, a supporting rod is fixedly connected to the inner side wall of a test tube cleaning cavity, a test tube brush is detachably connected to the upper surface of a connecting block, and a second water pump is fixedly connected to the inner side wall of the test tube cleaning cavity. The utility model achieves the aim of conveniently cleaning the workbench through the arrangement of the outer cover, plays a role of automatically cleaning the inside of the test tube through the arrangement of the test tube cleaning cavity, and achieves the aim of increasing the functions of the teaching table.

title_en: Multi-rotor aircraft combined demonstration device
abstract_en: The combined demonstration device for the multi-rotor aircraft comprises a horn, a fuselage and a bracket, wherein the lower end surface of the bracket is provided with a base, the upper end of the bracket is connected with the fuselage, and the fuselage and the bracket are connected in a detachable combined manner; the machine body is connected to two or three or four or more machine arms, and the outer ends of the machine arms are provided with motors and propellers, and the motors drive the propellers.

title_en: Model for simulating movement of extraocular muscles and intraocular muscles
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a model for simulating movement of extraocular muscles and intraocular muscles, which comprises a simulated eyeball, wherein the back surface of the simulated eyeball is provided with a simulated optic nerve for limiting the position of the simulated eyeball, the surface of the simulated optic nerve is provided with a plurality of first simulated control muscles for controlling the simulated eyeball to rotate in different directions, and one side of each first simulated control muscle is fixedly connected with a reset spring. According to the model for simulating the movement of the extraocular muscles and the intraocular muscles, the reset spring, the guide rod and the fixing nut are added on the basis of the original model, when the oblique vision caused by the control muscles in a disease state is required to be observed, the fixing nut on one first simulation muscle is taken down, so that the muscle injury is simulated, the eyeball cannot be pulled by the muscle, the reset springs on other muscles can pull the eyeball to one side, the eyeball is displaced, and the condition of the oblique vision of the eyeball when the certain muscle injury of the eyeball is observed is realized.

title_en: Control system for concrete underground mixing plant
abstract_en: The utility model provides a control system for a concrete underground mixing station, which comprises an acquisition unit: the system comprises a control unit, a storage hopper, a lifting hopper, a discharging hopper, a lifting hopper, a control unit and a control unit, wherein the control unit is used for controlling the control unit; and a control unit: the control command is formulated according to the received data information, and the control command is sent to the execution unit; and an execution unit: for receiving control commands of the control unit and performing corresponding operations. The utility model can carry out multidirectional safety control on the storage hopper, the lifting hopper and the discharge hopper; the storage hopper, the lifting hopper and the discharge hopper are subjected to standard settings such as light load, heavy load, overload and the like, so that the concrete weight is taken and discharged according to the load capacity of the tank truck; reminding the completion of material filling of the clients through the signal lamp; a lighting unit, a monitoring unit are provided.

title_en: Congestion detection and current limiting device for toll station
abstract_en: The utility model provides a toll station congestion detection current limiting device, which relates to the technical field of toll station congestion detection current limiting and comprises a base, wherein a hidden groove is formed in the middle of the top surface of the base, a current limiting rod is movably arranged in the hidden groove, transmission shafts are symmetrically arranged below the surface of the current limiting rod, one end of each transmission shaft is movably connected with the inner wall of the hidden groove through a bearing seat, and a fixing plate is vertically arranged below the surface of the current limiting rod. The utility model is convenient for playing a role in limiting current when a toll station is jammed by arranging the base, the hidden groove, the current limiting rod, the transmission shaft, the fixing plate, the first threaded hole and the second threaded hole in cooperation, so that when the toll station is in operation, a worker fixes the base on the road surface at the entrance of the toll station through the fastener in advance, and then the worker can adjust the number of the current limiting rods standing up according to the traffic flow, thereby playing a role in limiting current when the vehicle enters the toll station.

title_en: Test simulation device for monitoring high-level avalanche disaster damage image
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of high-level avalanche test simulation, and discloses a test simulation device for monitoring a high-level avalanche disaster damage image. The multistage hierarchical gradient adjusting structure is adopted, so that the conditions of different heights and gradients of the hillside can be simulated more accurately.

title_en: Non-periodic alarm device is prevented to electric switch
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electrical switch non-periodic alarm device, which comprises a fixed seat, wherein a buzzer alarm is fixedly connected to one side wall of the fixed seat; the fixed subassembly, fixed subassembly includes the fixed slot, the fixed slot is seted up on the fixing base is kept away from a lateral wall of buzzer siren, two exhaust chambers have been seted up to the inside of fixing base, two the one end in exhaust chamber communicates with the inside of fixed slot, and the other end communicates with the external world, every equal sealed sliding connection has the piston in the exhaust chamber, every equal fixedly connected with push rod on the piston, every the push rod all extends to outside the fixing base, and fixedly connected with presses the briquetting, every press the briquetting all through two springs and the outer wall elastic connection of fixing base. According to the utility model, the fixing assembly is arranged, so that the fixing seat can be installed on the equipment body in a pressing manner by pressing the pressing block in a reciprocating manner, the installation is convenient, the bolt holes are not required to be drilled in the electrical equipment, and the damage to the electrical equipment is prevented.

title_en: Sand table model using laser projection
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sand table model using laser projection, which relates to the technical field of sand table models, and comprises a supporting seat, wherein one end of the supporting seat is rotatably provided with the sand table model, one side of the supporting seat is provided with a storage groove, the inside of the storage groove is provided with a detachable supporting rod, one end face of the supporting rod is fixedly provided with a group of clamping columns, the outer side wall of the supporting rod is connected with a supporting sleeve through threads, one end of the supporting sleeve is rotatably provided with a limiting plate, the inside of the storage groove is provided with a clamping groove matched with the clamping columns, the supporting rod is vertically arranged in the storage groove by utilizing the clamping between the clamping columns and the clamping groove, and then the supporting sleeve is rotated to enable the supporting sleeve to drive the limiting plate to lift, so that the limiting plate can drive the sand table model and the supporting seat to deflect at an angle, the traditional mode of horizontally placing the sand table model is changed, a user can conveniently irradiate each position in the sand table without a blind area.

title_en: Processor core module, main board and industrial computer for constructing industrial control system
abstract_en: The utility model aims to disclose a processor core module, a main board and an industrial computer for constructing an industrial control system, wherein a Printed Circuit Board (PCB) is integrated with an System On Chip (SOC) unit, a memory slot unit electrically connected with the SOC unit, a super input/output controller, a basic input/output system (BIOS), a gigabit Ethernet control unit and a golden finger, wherein the golden finger is arranged at the end part of the PCB; a USB signal channel, an SM Bus, an I2C Bus, a power control signal channel, an LPC Bus, an HDA Bus, a hard disk signal channel, a PCIe signal channel, a DDI signal channel and an eDP signal channel are electrically connected between the SOC unit and the golden finger; the gigabit Ethernet control unit is electrically connected with the golden finger, and has the technical effects that: and integrating all functions required by the embedded industrial computer into the same PCB to form a core board with golden fingers, wherein the golden fingers serve as expansion channels of the core board, and then, secondary development is performed on the basis of the PCB, so that an input/output interface is selectively arranged, and the development speed of the main board is improved.

title_en: Metal liquid runner liquid level feedback type flow control device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the utility model relates to the technical field of flow control devices, in particular to a liquid level feedback type flow control device for a metal liquid flow channel, which comprises a groove body provided with an opening, wherein a frame body is arranged on the groove body, a first connecting rod is hinged on the frame body, and one end of the first connecting rod is hinged with a floating structure; the frame body is further hinged with a second connecting rod, one end of the second connecting rod is hinged with one end of the first connecting rod, and the other end of the second connecting rod is hinged with a plugging head matched with the opening. The beneficial effects of the utility model are as follows: the flow is controlled by the mechanical structure, the overhaul and replacement frequency of the mechanical structure is low relative to the electrical element, the maintenance is convenient, and the labor intensity is reduced.

title_en: Infant learning machine with protection function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a child learning machine with a protection function, wherein one side of the top end of a learning machine body is fixedly connected with a hinge, the learning machine body is connected with a protection cover plate through the hinge, two ends of the learning machine body are symmetrically and fixedly connected with rotating rods, and one end of each rotating rod, which is far away from the learning machine body, is connected with a limiting plate, and the child learning machine has the following advantages: the gasket can be propped under the action of the elastic force of the first spring, so that the gasket is propped along the rotating rod to have a certain friction force on the support, the rotating rod can be effectively prevented from rotating on the support at will, the upper and lower angles of the learning machine body can be adjusted, the display screen can be effectively prevented from being touched by children manually or collided by the protective cover plate, the damage is caused when the learning machine body is pulled by children, the support can be made to swing with a certain radian after the external force is applied to the learning machine body through the upper fixing seat, the rotating ball, the lower fixing seat and the second spring, and the effect of protecting the learning machine body is achieved.

title_en: File exchange cabinet
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field related to a switch cabinet, in particular to a file switch cabinet, which comprises a switch cabinet body and a working box, wherein a plurality of storage drawers are arranged at the front end of the switch cabinet body, the working box is arranged on the side part of the switch cabinet body, a recognition machine is arranged on the working box, the switch cabinet body and the recognition machine can keep matched for use and are mutually independent in space, the switch cabinet body can fully utilize the space inside the switch cabinet body for storage, the working box is matched with the working box through a threaded rod, a driving motor, a threaded sleeve, a vertical rod, a movable sleeve, a control box, a control switch and the like, so that the position of the recognition machine in the vertical direction on the working box is adjustable, a user can conveniently adjust the recognition machine to a position suitable for the user according to the height of the user, the user can conveniently operate and carry out identity recognition, the use flexibility is high, and the file switch cabinet is more practical.

title_en: Centralized management and control platform for intelligent classrooms
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of centralized management and control platforms in classrooms, and particularly relates to a centralized management and control platform for an intelligent classroom, which comprises a management and control platform main body, wherein a display screen is arranged at the upper end of the management and control platform main body, an indicator lamp positioned at the upper end of the side of the display screen, a storage bin arranged in the management and control platform main body and a box door arranged at an opening of the storage bin are also arranged at the upper end of the management and control platform main body, and universal wheels are arranged at four corners of the bottom of the management and control platform main body. Firstly, a protective component arranged outside a display screen and an indicator lamp has a protective effect on the display screen and the indicator lamp, so that abrasion is reduced, and external impact is avoided; secondly, the clamping assembly is arranged on the protection assembly, so that the space utilization rate is improved, books can be clamped, and teaching of teachers is facilitated; finally, the universal wheels are matched with the limiting assembly, the universal wheels are convenient for the movement of the whole control platform, the limiting assembly guarantees the stability after the movement, and meanwhile, the sheath outside the limiting assembly can prevent the control platform from forming a sanitary dead angle under the whole control platform.

title_en: Computer training device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a computer training device which comprises a computer training device body, a support frame and universal wheels, wherein the support frame is positioned at the bottom of the computer training device body. According to the utility model, by arranging the remote controller, a user can conveniently control the angle adjusting mechanism through the remote controller, so that the angle adjusting mechanism can drive the computer training device body to automatically adjust the angle, the effect of automatically adjusting the angle is achieved, the problem that a learner sitting on two sides cannot observe important contents in detail and intuitively due to the angle when the device displays important contents is solved, the lecturer is required to manually rotate the device to adjust the angle, one hand is not easy to rotate when holding a teaching stick in the lecturer, certain limitation exists, and the teaching efficiency is reduced is solved.

title_en: Wall-mounted charging equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides a wall-mounted charging device. This wall-hanging battery charging outfit includes: the mounting plate is used for being fixed on the supporting wall; the equipment shell is arranged on one side of the mounting plate opposite to the supporting wall and is connected with the mounting plate in a turnover manner through a hinge; the lock is arranged in the equipment shell and is configured to limit the relative position of the equipment shell and the mounting plate in a locking state, so that the mounting plate and the hinge are shielded by the equipment shell. According to the scheme, the equipment shell is connected with the mounting plate in a turnover mode through the hinge. The lockset is arranged in the equipment shell and is configured to limit the relative position of the equipment shell and the mounting plate in a locking state, the equipment shell shields the mounting plate and the hinge, and the interface is not dismounted outside the equipment, so that illegal dismounting is avoided, and the safety performance is improved. After the lockset is opened, the equipment shell can be conveniently turned over, so that the mounting plate is exposed, and the disassembly operation is convenient.

title_en: Adjustable linear voltage-stabilizing integrated circuit and electrostatic protection circuit thereof
abstract_en: An adjustable linear voltage-stabilizing integrated circuit and an electrostatic protection circuit thereof belong to the field of semiconductor integrated circuits. The circuit comprises a starting bias circuit module, an amplifying compensation output circuit module, a temperature protection module, a current protection circuit module, a voltage protection circuit module and an electrostatic protection module. The positive end of the starting bias circuit module is connected with the power end, and the negative end is connected with the output end; the negative terminals of the temperature protection module and the current protection circuit module are connected with the reference terminal, and the voltage sampling terminal of the amplifying compensation output circuit module is connected with the output terminal through an adjustable sampling network; the bias current output end is respectively connected with the bias current input end corresponding to each circuit module; the output ends of the temperature protection module and the current protection circuit module are connected with the corresponding ports of the amplification compensation output circuit module, and the reference voltage output end of the amplification compensation output circuit module is grounded through an adjustable sampling network. Solves the problems of large volume and various types of components of the existing products. Widely applied to complex environments.

title_en: Portable recording device
abstract_en: The application relates to a portable recorder belongs to education and teaching technical field, and it can fix paper and can accomodate the paper that the record was accomplished, avoids the paper unexpected damage or the contaminated that the record was accomplished, and can fix the ballpoint, and comprehensive practicality is better, includes: a storage box; the four support rods are respectively connected with a sliding block in a sliding way, and partition plates are fixedly arranged between the sliding blocks; four return springs, the four return springs are all set up in the outside of the tie rod, one end of the return spring of its is fixedly mounted on storage box, another end of its return spring is fixedly mounted on splitter plate; the abutting plate is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the separation plate, and one end of the abutting plate is fixedly provided with a pull ring; the two threaded rods are correspondingly arranged in the storage box through the lantern ring in a rotating mode, one end of each threaded rod extends out of the storage box through a threaded hole which is formed in the storage box and is matched with the threaded hole, and a knob is fixedly installed on the threaded rod.

title_en: Locking mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of auxiliary alarms, in particular to a locking mechanism which comprises a clamping assembly and comprises a base, a rotating piece arranged on the outer wall of the base and a transmission piece arranged on the outer wall of the rotating piece.

title_en: Gynaecology and obstetrics's nursing teaching's apparatus
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of teaching aids, in particular to a gynaecology and obstetrics nursing teaching aid, which comprises a box body, wherein a movable wheel, a box door and an installation seat are arranged on the box body, a rotating seat is arranged on the installation seat and is in rotating connection with the rotating seat, a motor is arranged in the installation seat, the output end of the motor is connected with the rotating seat, an electric lifting rod I is arranged in the rotating seat, the output end of the electric lifting rod I is connected with a writing board, an electric lifting rod II is arranged in the box body, the output end of the electric lifting rod II is connected with a gynaecology and obstetrics nursing teaching bed, and through the establishment of the writing board, the writing board can be unfolded and used conveniently in the teaching and explaining process, so that a teacher can write key contents conveniently, the memory points of the learner can be increased, the learner can be conveniently recorded by the learner, the phenomenon that if the learner only orally-explained teaching contents are easy to cause error and leakage, and the teaching quality is influenced.

title_en: Electricity-saving intelligent lock with environment temperature detection and low-power prompting functions
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of intelligent locks, in particular to a power-saving intelligent lock with environment temperature detection and low electric quantity prompt functions, which comprises a power supply module, a microcontroller module, a key module, a 4G communication module, a 433MHz wireless communication module, a temperature detection module, a buzzer module, an infrared induction module, a password storage module, an indicator light module, a switch switching module and an electric energy metering module; the intelligent lock is characterized in that the power module is used for supplying power to the intelligent lock, the key module is used for inputting an unlocking password, and the microcontroller module is connected with the key module, the 4G communication module, the 433MHz wireless communication module, the temperature detection module, the buzzer module, the infrared sensing module, the password storage module, the indicator light module, the switch switching module and the electric energy metering module. The system has the functions of ambient temperature detection, low electric quantity prompt and the like, and can achieve the effects of fire warning, energy saving, electricity saving and the like.

title_en: Height-adjustable's shadow-checking simulation eye
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a height-adjustable shadow-checking simulated eye, which relates to the technical field of eye vision optical instruments and equipment, and comprises a lens cone, an inner rod, an outer rod and a base, wherein the outer rod is fixed on the base, and a cavity is formed in the outer rod; the inner rod is arranged in the cavity in a sliding way, and the top end of the inner rod is connected with the lens cone; the side wall of the inner rod is provided with a protrusion capable of rebounding after being pressed, and the side wall of the outer rod is sequentially provided with a plurality of limiting holes for the protrusions to enter from top to bottom along the axial direction; a limiting block is further arranged on the side wall of the inner rod along the axial direction, a limiting groove is formed in the inner wall of the outer rod along the axial direction, and the limiting block is slidably arranged in the limiting groove; according to the utility model, the protrusion capable of being pressed and rebounded is arranged on the inner rod, and the limiting hole is arranged on the outer rod, so that the height of the lens barrel can be adjusted according to the height and operation habit of a user, the applicability is stronger, and a beginner can practice the image checking operation better.

title_en: Tracheal intubation system with aspiration prevention and early warning functions
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an endotracheal intubation system with functions of preventing aspiration and early warning, and relates to the technical field of endotracheal intubation. According to the utility model, through the cooperation between the sputum suction tube and the prevention mechanism, the pressure of the air bag can be monitored in real time, when the air bag has the problems of air leakage, air leakage and the like, timely remediation is realized, the secretion of the oropharynx part or the reflux gastric contents are effectively prevented from entering the lung through the air passage, meanwhile, the sputum suction tube has a aspiration early warning function, so that medical staff can find abnormity and process the abnormal situation in time, the occurrence probability of pulmonary complications and the like caused by aspiration is reduced, and the death rate of critical patients is further reduced.

title_en: Unmanned sales counter with function of conveniently separating goods
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of unmanned sales counter and discloses an unmanned sales counter convenient for separating a cargo function, which comprises a sales counter body, wherein a size adjusting mechanism is arranged in the sales counter body and comprises a cargo placing table, a first motor is fixedly arranged on one side of the inner wall of the cargo placing table, the output end of the first motor is fixedly connected with a screw rod and is rotationally connected to the left side of the inner wall of the cargo placing table through a bearing, a screw hole block is sleeved on the outer wall of the screw rod in a threaded manner, a sliding hole is formed in the top of the cargo placing table, a connecting block is fixedly connected to the top of the screw hole block and is connected to the inner wall of the sliding hole in a sliding manner, and a cargo separating baffle is fixedly connected to the top of the connecting block. According to the utility model, the goods are placed on the top of the goods placing table, and then the first motor is started, so that the output end of the first motor drives the screw to rotate, and the screw hole block sleeved on the screw thread on the outer wall of the screw is driven to move.

title_en: Boiler gas leakage detection device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of boilers, in particular to a boiler air leakage detection device, which comprises a pipeline; the sealing component is movably arranged at the joint of the outer wall of the pipeline and is used for wrapping the joint of the pipeline; the upper end of the outer wall of the sealing assembly is provided with a connecting pipe, a signal lamp and a pressure gauge; the control assembly is installed on the ground and is used for receiving alarm signals and indicating alarm positions. According to the utility model, the two groups of sealing blocks are buckled on the joint surface of the pipeline, the two groups of sealing blocks are precisely buckled by rotating the hexagon nut, air in the sealing blocks is discharged through the end head of the vacuum pump connecting pipe to form negative pressure, when air leakage occurs, the two groups of sealing blocks can block further leakage of air, meanwhile, a signal lamp arranged at the upper end of the sealing blocks starts to flash, a touch display screen connected with the signal lamp in the control chamber displays the position mark of an air leakage point, and meanwhile, a buzzer sounds to remind workers of the air leakage phenomenon.

title_en: Sewage treatment equipment for calculating dosing amount by adopting PLC
abstract_en: The utility model provides sewage treatment equipment for calculating dosing amount by adopting PLC. The sewage treatment equipment for calculating dosing amount by adopting the PLC comprises the following components: the sewage treatment tank is provided with a dosing mechanism, a stirring mechanism and a medicine mixing mechanism; the dosing mechanism comprises an upper shell, a PLC (programmable logic controller), a drug mixing box, a plurality of drug storage boxes, a plurality of dosing pipes, a plurality of first flow meters and a plurality of first electromagnetic valves, wherein the upper shell is fixedly arranged at the top of a sewage treatment tank, the PLC is fixedly arranged at the top of the sewage treatment tank, the drug mixing box is arranged in the upper shell, and the drug storage boxes are all arranged on the upper shell. The sewage treatment equipment adopting the PLC to calculate the dosing amount can calculate the dosing amount according to the sewage amount, improves the dosing accuracy, can mix various medicaments, and improves the mixing efficiency of the medicaments and sewage.

title_en: Interactive teaching equipment of teaching
abstract_en: The utility model provides teaching interaction teaching equipment, and belongs to the technical field of teaching equipment. The utility model relates to teaching interactive teaching equipment, which comprises a moving mechanism and an interactive mechanism, wherein the moving mechanism comprises a base, a supporting seat is fixedly arranged on the upper end face of the base, a lifting rod is slidably arranged at the upper end of the supporting seat, a power box is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the lifting rod, the interactive mechanism comprises a mounting plate, the bottom end of the mounting plate is rotationally connected with the upper end of the power box, a mounting seat is fixedly arranged on the upper end face of the mounting plate, a learning machine body is rotationally connected with the inside of the mounting seat, a movable seat is fixedly arranged at the top end of the learning machine body, a camera is rotationally connected with the inside of the movable seat, universal wheels are fixedly arranged at four corners of the bottom end of the base, and the teaching interactive teaching equipment can be effectively improved in practicality and has higher practical value.

title_en: Portable wireless anti-theft alarm
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a portable wireless anti-theft alarm, which comprises a Bluetooth module, an infrared module, an alarm module and a central processing module, wherein the Bluetooth module is used for receiving a control signal from a mobile terminal; the infrared module is used for detecting the surrounding spectrum change and outputting detection information; the alarm module is used for outputting an alarm signal; the alarm is electrically connected with the alarm module and receives an alarm signal from the alarm module; the central processing module is electrically connected with the Bluetooth module and receives control information from the Bluetooth module, the central processing module is electrically connected with the infrared module and receives monitoring information from the infrared module, and the central processing module controls the alarm module to output an alarm signal; the alarm module is electrically connected with the Bluetooth module and transmits an alarm signal to the mobile terminal through the Bluetooth module. The mobile terminal is effectively communicated with the controller, and the alarm condition can be obtained in real time through the mobile terminal and the alarm at the same time, so that convenience is improved.

title_en: Music demonstration board
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a music demonstration board, and relates to a music teaching aid. The utility model comprises a supporting table, an electric telescopic rod is arranged at the top of the supporting table, the output end of the electric telescopic rod is fixedly connected with a supporting plate, the inside of the supporting plate is rotatably connected with a rotating shaft, the outer surface of the rotating shaft is fixedly connected with a connecting block, the side surface of the supporting plate is abutted with a fixing bolt, the rotating shaft penetrates through the supporting plate and is in threaded connection with the fixing bolt, the fixing bolt is matched with the rotating shaft for use, and the side surface of the connecting block is fixedly connected with a teaching board. According to the utility model, through the matched use of the rotating shaft, the connecting block and the supporting plate, the teaching board can be adjusted at different angles, the multi-angle omnibearing teaching is realized, a teacher can conveniently go to the teaching, and through the matched use of the winding roller, the winding disc and the dust shielding cloth, when the demonstration board is not used, the demonstration board can be covered, dust in a classroom is prevented from falling on the demonstration board, the equipment is kept clean and tidy, and the service life of the equipment is prolonged.

title_en: Inside PM2.5 concentration warning atmosphere lamp of car
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automobile interior PM2.5 concentration warning atmosphere lamp, which comprises a dust infrared sensor, a controller and an atmosphere lamp module, wherein the dust infrared sensor and the atmosphere lamp module are connected with the controller; the atmosphere lamp module comprises an LED driving module, a red LED lamp string, a yellow LED lamp string and a green LED lamp string, wherein the input end of the LED driving module is connected with the controller, and the red LED lamp string, the yellow LED lamp string and the green LED lamp string are respectively connected with the output end of the driving module. The utility model provides an automobile interior PM2.5 concentration warning atmosphere lamp, which prompts a driver of the air quality in an automobile through the automobile interior atmosphere lamp, displays the current PM2.5 concentration value on an LCD screen, and sends out warning sound through audio equipment when the PM2.5 concentration value is too high so as to remind the driver of timely ventilation, thereby protecting the physical health conditions of the driver and passengers.

title_en: Welding machine for teaching, operation and training of electric welder
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of analog welding machines, and discloses a welding machine for teaching operation training of an electric welder, which comprises a base, wherein one side of the base is provided with a square groove, the inside of the square groove is sleeved with a slide bar, both sides of the slide bar are provided with through holes, the outside of the slide bar is sleeved with an adjusting sleeve, the middle parts of both sides of the adjusting sleeve are provided with limiting grooves, the inner side wall of each limiting groove is sleeved with a limiting rod, and the limiting rod penetrates through one side of each limiting groove from the outside to be connected with the other side of each limiting groove; the application is characterized in that a stud is added in the spray pipe through an external pipeline connector, an insulating rubber sleeve is held by hand to perform welding operation, a large amount of sparks are generated, and a protective sleeve is sleeved outside a round bolt and is made of copper, so that most of sparks generated during welding are directly counteracted by the protective sleeve; compared with the prior art, the hand-washing machine has the effect of preventing hands from being directly scalded.

title_en: Traffic guardrail convenient to adjust
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of traffic protection, in particular to a traffic guardrail convenient to adjust, which comprises a support, wherein a spring part is fixedly welded at the upper end of the support, a clamping groove is fixedly welded at one end of the spring part, a trigger block is fixedly arranged at one side of the clamping groove, an alarm switch is arranged at the lower end of the trigger block, one end of the alarm switch is fixedly arranged with the support, a movable rod is coaxially arranged and fixedly arranged at the inner side of the clamping groove, a stand column is slidably connected at one side of the support, an audible and visual alarm is arranged at the upper end of the stand column, the alarm switch is used for triggering the audible and visual alarm to give an alarm, an upper guide block is fixedly arranged at one side of the support, one side of the upper guide block is slidably connected with the stand column, two groups of adjusting connecting rods are rotatably connected with supporting shafts.

title_en: Y-shaped commodity anti-theft self-ringing sign
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a Y-shaped commodity anti-theft self-ringing label, which relates to the technical field of anti-theft labels. According to the utility model, through the arrangement of the limiting frame, the compression balls, the third anti-lost rope, the springs and the buffer sleeves, the compression balls are prevented from freely rolling in the label main body through the arrangement of the limiting frame, the compression balls are steel balls, so that the compression resistance is high, the core components of the label main body are positioned in the middle area of the four compression balls, therefore, when a thief uses hammering or pedaling on the label main body, the compression balls bear pressure, so that the core components are prevented from being damaged, and meanwhile, the third anti-lost rope breaks, so that the buzzer alarm gives an alarm to remind surrounding staff; effectively avoid stealing personnel to damage the sign and make it unable to send out the phenomenon emergence of alarm.

title_en: Sea survey drawing model projection presentation device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a projection demonstration device for a sea survey drawing model, which comprises a sand table base and a supporting rod, wherein a supporting frame is arranged on the side wall of the sand table base, a driving gear is arranged in the supporting frame, the supporting rod is slidably lifted and lowered along the inside of the supporting frame through a threaded rod in the practical use, an operator can flexibly adjust the height of a projection head according to demonstration requirements by manual lifting and lowering adjustment, so that different demonstration requirements are met, the operator can conveniently approach the projection head to carry out necessary maintenance and cleaning work, a rotary threaded bolt is connected with a threaded hole, the position of the projection head is adjusted, the projection head can be moved to a specific position to better display demonstration contents such as a map, a chart or a model, a viewer can more clearly watch and understand the demonstration contents, and the projection head is moved to a position convenient for interaction with the viewer, so that the interactivity and the participation of the demonstration are enhanced, and different demonstration requirements are met.

title_en: Switching circuit capable of powering on and powering off automatically and at fixed time
abstract_en: The switching circuit capable of powering on and automatically switching on and switching off at fixed time in the embodiment of the utility model comprises a power supply gear shift module, a gear shift detection circuit, a switching control circuit and a singlechip; the power supply gear-shifting module comprises an input power supply, a gear-shifting switch and a gear line; the gear detection circuit comprises a mode resistor connected with the gear line, one end of the mode resistor is connected with the input end of the gear line, and the other end of the mode resistor is connected with the singlechip; the switch control circuit comprises a starting capacitor, a first N-channel MOS tube and a P-channel MOS tube which are connected in sequence; when the gear line is connected with an input power supply, the capacitor is started to charge, the first N-channel MOS tube and the P-channel MOS tube are conducted, the power supply pin of the singlechip is powered on, and the first output pin outputs a high level, so that the first N-channel MOS tube and the P-channel MOS tube maintain a conducting state. The first output pin outputs low-level shutdown after timing, so that standby zero power consumption is achieved on the premise of realizing mode stepping control and timing shutdown functions.

title_en: Highway maintenance operation cooperation safety protection system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cooperative safety protection system for highway maintenance operation, which comprises the following components: cloud platform, wisdom awl bucket, portable intelligent maintenance pole, maintenance personnel dresses equipment; cloud platform and wisdom awl bucket, portable intelligent maintenance pole, and maintenance personnel wearing equipment electric connection. According to the utility model, the video images are captured and analyzed in real time, so that accurate and effective safety early warning is carried out on the illegal operation behaviors of maintenance personnel and the illegal invasion operation areas of external passing vehicles in the highway maintenance operation process, the personal safety of the maintenance personnel is ensured, the maintenance management is standardized, and the cooperative safety management level of people, vehicles and roads is improved.

title_en: Training seat and motor attendant training shelter
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a training seat and a motor operator training shelter, wherein the training seat comprises a mounting table, a rotary table rotatably arranged in the mounting table, a connecting table connected with the rotary table through a connecting piece and a seat arranged on the connecting table, and the connecting piece can drive the connecting table to swing along with the rotation of the rotary table. The utility model is helpful to solve the problems that in the current practical training conditions of the motor-driven operators, the motor-driven operators can only train through the motor-driven communication vehicles, and the motor-driven vehicles can only train one to two operators at a time, and the training time and the training conditions are limited.

title_en: Multi-functional teaching panel of stromatolite formula
abstract_en: The utility model provides a laminated multifunctional teaching display board, and belongs to the technical field of teaching auxiliary tools. The display panel includes a support structure and a laminate structure. The support structure comprises a movable support and a main body drawing plate, wherein the main body drawing plate is fixed on the movable support. The laminated structure comprises a cladding plate, a light-emitting plate and a display layer. The cladding plate and the luminous plate are movably arranged on a first loose-leaf buckle at the left side of the main body drawing plate, and the display layer is movably arranged on a second loose-leaf buckle at the upper end of the main body drawing plate. The main body drawing board, the coating board and the luminous board are correspondingly embedded with adsorption blocks, and can be mutually adsorbed and fixed through magnetic adsorption. The middle interlayer can be used for placing single thin materials for display and is matched with the main drawing board, so that the functions of laminated drawing or single-sided display, double-sided display, laminated display and the like of the single thin materials can be realized. The utility model can also realize that the drawn pattern and the written content show fluorescence effect by matching with the main body drawing board light source.

title_en: Intelligent logistics sorting practical training workstation
abstract_en: An intelligent logistics sorting practical training workstation comprises a working area enclosed by a fence, wherein a feeding area, a conveyor belt identification area and a sorting area are arranged in the working area; the feeding area is provided with a feeding manipulator, a first material seat arranged on one side of the feeding manipulator and a second material seat arranged on the other side of the feeding manipulator; the conveyor belt identification area is provided with a conveyor belt, two sides of the conveyor belt are respectively provided with a sensor and visual detection equipment, and one side of the conveyor belt identification area is provided with an electric control system and a viewing seat arranged facing the conveyor belt; the blanking area is provided with a blanking manipulator, a first intelligent material rack arranged on one side of the blanking manipulator and a second intelligent material rack arranged on the other side of the blanking manipulator, and a display screen is arranged on a fence behind the blanking manipulator. The practical training operation of students accords with the production safety standard, and the safety is ensured; students can control the whole logistics sorting process through the electric control system, and the students are in the best watching and learning positions, so that the practical experience is improved.

title_en: Antitheft mechanism of self-service financial equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-theft mechanism of self-service financial equipment, in particular to the anti-theft field of the financial equipment, which comprises the self-service financial equipment, wherein a banknote outlet gate is fixedly arranged in the self-service financial equipment, a rupture trigger piece is fixedly arranged in the self-service financial equipment, the banknote outlet gate is slidingly connected to the top of the rupture trigger piece, a first clamping piece is slidingly connected in the self-service financial equipment, a first spring is arranged at the bottom of the first clamping piece, a second clamping piece is slidingly connected in the self-service financial equipment, a connecting rope is fixedly arranged on one side of the second clamping piece, and the connecting rope is slidingly connected in the self-service financial equipment. According to the utility model, the breakage triggering piece and the warning bell are arranged, so that when the banknote outlet gate is damaged by gravity, the breakage triggering piece is broken by the downward pressing acting force of the banknote outlet gate, and the winding drum is further rotated, so that the striking plate is caused to strike the warning bell to give out warning bell, and further the staff is reminded.

title_en: Geomagnetic induction parking confirmation device based on sensing technology
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a geomagnetic induction parking confirmation device based on a sensing technology, which comprises a geomagnetic induction module and a sensing module connected to the upper end of the geomagnetic induction module, wherein the geomagnetic induction module is arranged in an underground part corresponding to the middle of a parking space; the upper end of the geomagnetic sensing module is fixedly connected with a supporting table, a controller is arranged in the middle of the supporting table, the controller is connected with the geomagnetic sensing module, a sensing module is connected to the periphery of the supporting table around the controller, the sensing module is positioned above the ground, an anti-pressing shell is arranged above the supporting table, the sensing module and the controller are positioned in the anti-pressing shell, and a probe of the sensing module points to a position corresponding to a wheel in a parking space; the sensing module is combined with the geomagnetic induction technology to detect the position ranges of four tires of the vehicle, determine the parking effectiveness, and avoid misjudgment on parking events caused by parking of electric vehicles, motorcycles, sundries and the like on geomagnetism.

title_en: Contactor fault simulation control device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a contactor trouble analog control device. The contactor fault simulation control device comprises a contactor module and a fault simulation control module. The contactor module comprises a coil, an iron core, a counter-force spring, an insulating connecting rod, a moving contact and a fixed contact; the fault simulation control module comprises a connecting lead, an insulating material and a switch. The fault simulation control module is used for simulating and controlling the faults of the contactor.
