Firstly, setting a breakpoint at the connection part of the insulating connecting rod and the moving contact, and connecting the breakpoint by adopting insulating materials; secondly, connecting leads on each moving contact and each fixed contact of the contactor, and installing a switch between two leads of each group of contacts. In addition, a break point, a connection lead, and a switch are provided at the contactor coil. The utility model discloses can simulate the multiple true fault phenomenon of contactor in the actual production, help the student to grasp the maintenance technique sooner.

title_en: Heat-insulating sealing disc
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of sealing discs and discloses a heat-insulating sealing disc, which comprises a sealing disc, wherein an outer frame is fixedly arranged on the outer side of the sealing disc, a limit frame is fixedly arranged on one side of the outer frame, and a box body is fixedly arranged in the limit frame; the middle part integrated into one piece is provided with the assembly mouth in the sealing disk, and the assembly groove has been seted up to the sealing disk front wall, and the assembly groove is cyclic annular. According to the utility model, the through hole, the humidity sensor and the alarm are arranged, so that the humidity of the sealing end can be detected in real time through the humidity sensor during the operation of the toothless motor in the use process of the heat-insulating sealing disc, when the humidity is larger than the set threshold value, the water inlet condition appears for the transmission shaft of the toothless motor, the processor gives an instruction, the alarm sounds, and the alarm sounds to remind a worker to stop operating the motor and detach the motor for drying hot air.

title_en: Gas leakage detection and alarm device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a gas leakage detection and alarm device, which comprises a shell, a gas pipeline, a battery unit and a detection and alarm unit, wherein the gas pipeline, the battery unit and the detection and alarm unit are all arranged in the shell, and a plurality of through holes are formed in the shell; one side of the shell is provided with an air inlet, and the other opposite side of the shell is provided with an air outlet; the gas pipeline is provided with a gas inlet end and a gas outlet end, and is provided with an electromagnetic valve and a pressure reducing valve which are both arranged in the shell and are sequentially arranged along the gas inlet end to the gas outlet end; the air inlet end is provided with a locking screw and extends out of the air inlet, and the air outlet end is provided with an anti-skid groove and extends out of the air outlet; the detection alarm unit is electrically connected with the electromagnetic valve, and the battery unit is used for supplying power to the detection alarm unit and the electromagnetic valve; the utility model can be directly matched with the gas tank by integrally designing the pressure reducing valve, the electromagnetic valve and the alarm, is convenient to install and is convenient for gas tank manufacturers or gas companies to directly adopt.

title_en: Oxygen cabin is with pressing oxygen blood oxygen detection alarm device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an oxygen cabin oxygen pressure blood oxygen detection alarm device which comprises a monitoring box body, wherein a group of operation buttons are arranged at the lower part of the front end of the monitoring box body, a supporting device is arranged at the lower end of the monitoring box body, a networking monitoring device is arranged at the right end of the monitoring box body, and a display screen is arranged at the upper end of the monitoring box body. According to the oxygen cabin-used oxygen pressure blood oxygen detection alarm device, the device can be connected with the oxygen cabin and the client through the networking module, so that after the oxygen cabin performs blood oxygen and heartbeat measurement on a patient in the cabin, the blood oxygen and heartbeat data can be transmitted to the client or displayed by the display screen, and the pressure, the oxygen concentration and the temperature and the humidity in the cabin can be monitored in real time through the air pressure sensor, the oxygen concentration sensor and the temperature and humidity sensor, the monitoring comprehensiveness of the device is improved, and the display screen is used for displaying in real time, so that people can clearly know the condition in the cabin.

title_en: Temporary traffic signal lamp positioning structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a temporary traffic signal lamp positioning structure which comprises a base, wherein a signal lamp body is arranged at the top of the base, a fixed cavity is formed in the base, a fixed telescopic rod is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the fixed cavity, a first limiting plate is fixedly connected to the end part of the fixed telescopic rod, and a limiting screw rod is rotatably connected to the top of the inner wall of the fixed cavity. According to the temporary traffic signal lamp positioning structure, the first limiting plates and the second limiting plates are arranged, when the temporary traffic signal lamp positioning structure is used, the first limiting plates can provide support for the bottom of the signal lamp body and simultaneously guarantee stability, the arrangement of the second limiting plates can adjust the arrangement positions and the heights of the second limiting plates according to different road conditions of actual arrangement positions, and therefore under the action of the anti-skid rubber pads at the bottoms of the first limiting plates and the second limiting plates, even on uneven roadsides, the temporary traffic signal lamp positioning structure can have good stability and strong adaptability.

title_en: Electrostatic precipitation experiment presentation device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electrostatic dust collection experiment demonstration device, which belongs to the technical field of teaching experiment demonstration, and comprises a vertical rod, a storage disc and a power supply system, wherein the vertical rod is arranged on a base, a first clamping rod, a second clamping rod and a third clamping rod are sequentially arranged on the vertical rod from bottom to top, a lower pipe body is arranged on the first clamping rod, the lower pipe body is positioned above the storage disc, an upper cover body is arranged on the second clamping rod, the upper cover body is provided with a metal foil cylinder through the hanging rod, the metal foil cylinder is connected with an upper anode wire, a wire collecting wheel is arranged on the third clamping rod, the wire collecting wheel is connected with a metal sheet through a wound cathode wire, the power supply system consists of a power supply, a voltage amplifier and a switch, the cathode of the power supply is connected with the switch, the anode of the power supply is connected with the switch through the voltage amplifier, and the voltage amplifier is also connected with the anode wire and the cathode wire respectively. The device has convenient operation and good experimental effect, can intuitively and vividly demonstrate the electrostatic dust removal phenomenon in teaching, and helps students deepen the perceptual knowledge of the electrostatic dust removal phenomenon and principle.

title_en: Communication equipment for Internet of things
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of communication equipment, and discloses communication equipment for the Internet of things, which comprises a communication equipment main body, wherein a through hole is formed in the top of a shell of the communication equipment main body, and an active carbon filter screen is arranged in the through hole; a water-swelling frame is arranged at the lower part of the active carbon filter screen; the communication equipment main body is provided with a reminding mechanism triggered by the water-swelling frame extruding the active carbon filter screen. The utility model provides communication equipment for the Internet of things, which can treat moisture by arranging an active carbon filter screen, and simultaneously, when the active carbon filter screen reduces the dehumidification capability, an alarm is given to remind a user to replace the active carbon filter screen.

title_en: Energy settlement system of LNG tank wagon
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of LNG energy calculation, and discloses an energy settlement system of an LNG tank car, which comprises an LNG sampling analysis device, a wagon balance system and a loading control room, wherein the loading control room comprises a loading system server and an energy settlement device, the LNG sampling analysis device is connected with an LNG tank car pipeline and is in communication connection with the energy settlement device so as to transmit LNG component data to the energy settlement device, the loading system server is respectively in communication connection with the wagon balance system and the energy settlement device, the loading data received from the wagon balance system is transmitted to the energy settlement device, and the energy settlement device finishes LNG energy settlement of the LNG tank car according to the received LNG component data and the loading data. According to the utility model, through all-weather communication with the LNG sampling and analyzing device and the wagon balance system, LNG component data and loading data are recorded and stored, and energy settlement of 'one-car-one-heat value' of the LNG tank car when the LNG tank car leaves the factory is realized.

title_en: Emergency diesel engine time sequence alarm board card of nuclear power station
abstract_en: The utility model provides a time sequence alarm board card of an emergency diesel engine of a nuclear power station, which comprises two alarm signal input circuits, a time sequence logic control circuit and two display control output circuits; the two ends of each alarm signal input circuit are respectively connected with an alarm signal source and a time sequence logic control circuit, and each alarm signal input circuit comprises an LED indicator lamp, a first voltage dividing circuit, a first filter circuit, a first NOT gate and an exclusive OR gate which are connected in sequence; the anode of the LED indicator lamp is connected with an alarm signal source; the output end of the exclusive-OR gate is connected with the sequential logic control circuit and is connected with an internal working voltage source through the other input end; each display control output circuit comprises a Darlington tube and a voltage-stabilizing diode; the input end of the Darlington tube is connected with the sequential logic control circuit, and the output end of the Darlington tube is connected with the cathode of the voltage stabilizing diode and an external alarm lamp; the positive pole of the voltage stabilizing diode is grounded. By implementing the utility model, the YKC-2SAD1 time sequence alarm board card which is stopped can be replaced, the fault probability is lower, and the reliability of the emergency diesel engine of the nuclear power station is improved.

title_en: Gate convenient to carry out face identification
abstract_en: The application discloses a gate convenient for face recognition, belongs to the technical field of gates, and solves the problem that part of people are inconvenient to recognize face due to fixed positions of face recognition devices of the gate in the prior art. The application comprises a case, a motor, a face recognition flat plate, a fixed pipe and a movable pipe. The face recognition flat plate is used for carrying out face recognition, the motor can drive the revolving door to open after the face recognition is successful, and people can pass through the revolving door. When the person with too high height or low height needs to pass through the revolving door and is inconvenient to carry out face recognition, the movable tube can be pulled out of the fixed tube, the movable tube is held to face, face recognition can be carried out, after face recognition is finished, the movable tube is sleeved on the fixed tube and then passes through the revolving door.

title_en: Calibrating device for gas alarm
abstract_en: The utility model provides a verification device for a gas alarm, which relates to the technical field of verification of alarms and comprises a convex plate, wherein a gas outlet hole is formed in the convex plate, a U-shaped cavity is formed in a convex part of the convex plate, two ends of the U-shaped cavity are mutually communicated with the gas outlet hole, two triangular plates are arranged in the gas outlet hole and the U-shaped cavity, rotating plates are arranged between the triangular plates, and rotating rods penetrate through and are fixed at the center of the rotating plates. When one of the detectors detects harmful gases in the gas, the controller controls the first motor and the second motor to be started, the first motor drives the rotating plate at the output end of the first motor to be closed, the second motor drives the rotating plate at the output end of the second motor to be started, and the gas enters the U-shaped cavity and passes through the purifier, so that the effect of purifying the harmful substances in the gas can be achieved, and the effect of preventing the harmful substances in the gas from being discharged can be achieved.

title_en: Reinforcing connecting device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a reinforcing and connecting device, which belongs to the technical field of building construction and aims to solve the problems that a pipeline is easy to rust due to tight contact between the pipeline and a clamping piece, and after a screw for fixing the clamping piece is loosened, people cannot perceive the first time. According to the utility model, the conductive rod is fixedly arranged below the mounting seat, the conductive block is fixedly arranged on the outer end surface of the power supply assembly, when the substrate is inclined under the pressure action of the pipeline, the conductive block at the outer end of the power supply assembly is contacted with the conductive rod, a closed loop is formed among the power supply assembly, the mounting seat and the sound alarm, and the sound alarm can give out alarm sound in the electrified state.

title_en: Early warning device of reservoir safety monitoring machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of reservoir safety monitoring, in particular to an early warning device of a reservoir safety monitoring machine, which comprises a supporting frame, a lifting device and a monitor, wherein the lifting device comprises a lifting rod, a lifting block and a fixing rod, a motor is arranged on the upper side wall of the supporting frame, a cavity is arranged in the fixing rod, a mounting rod is arranged in the cavity, the monitor is arranged at the front end of the mounting rod, a fixing hole is formed in the fixing rod, a mounting hole is formed in the mounting rod, the fixing hole and the mounting hole can be overlapped, a threaded rod is arranged in the fixing hole, and the threaded rod penetrates through the fixing hole and the mounting hole and is in threaded connection with the mounting hole, so that the monitor can be driven to lift, and is convenient to observe or overhaul, convenient to use, maintain or observe data, improve the detection efficiency, convenient to use, and convenient to adjust the angle of a solar panel according to sunlight.

title_en: License plate recognition device for parking space
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of parking management, in particular to a license plate recognition device for a parking space, which comprises a base, wherein a fixed shell is fixedly arranged on the right side of the base, a movable parking stop lever with a U-shaped structure is arranged on the upper side of the base, a U-shaped front stop lever with an inclined structure is arranged on the front side of the ring surface of the parking stop lever, a license plate recognition assembly is fixedly arranged on the inner side of the front stop lever, a motor is assembled on the right side of the inside of the fixed shell, the output end of the motor is fixedly connected with a screw rod, a movable sliding block is arranged on the screw rod through a thread bush, a cross rod is longitudinally arranged on the lower side of the inner part of the parking stop lever, a support connecting rod is movably sleeved on the cross rod, and the other end of the support connecting rod is rotatably connected with the movable sliding block through a hinge joint. The intelligent parking management system has the license plate recognition function, can automatically recognize license plate information of a parked vehicle, and controls the lifting of the parking stop lever according to the preset rule, so that intelligent management of private parking spaces is realized, convenience and safety of parking are improved, and management and use of parking spaces by vehicle owners are facilitated.

title_en: Auxiliary calibration device for electronic snapshot system of black smoke vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an auxiliary calibration device for an electronic snapshot system of a black smoke car, which comprises a limiting frame, a traveling mechanism and a movable buckle, wherein the limiting frame is obliquely arranged, one surface of the limiting frame is used for placing a blackness plate, a plurality of buckles are arranged at the edge of the limiting frame and are provided with barbs for hooking the edge of the blackness plate, the traveling mechanism is positioned at the top of the limiting frame and drives the limiting frame to travel, the buckles comprise dead buckles and the movable buckles, the dead buckles are assembled with the limiting frame through double bolt holes, the movable buckles are assembled with the limiting frame through single bolt holes, and the movable buckles are provided with rotation degrees of freedom around the single bolt holes connected with the movable buckles. The utility model is convenient for calibrating the black smoke vehicle electronic snapshot system, and particularly facilitates the disassembly and assembly of black panels with different specifications.

title_en: Automatic alarm device for combustible gas
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic flammable gas alarm device, and relates to the technical field of flammable gas detection. The intelligent control device comprises a transverse plate and a controller body, wherein a mounting groove is formed in the top of the transverse plate, a connecting disc is movably arranged in the mounting groove, and the controller body is fixedly arranged on the inner wall of the connecting disc. Through setting up gag lever post, nut seat, lead screw and commentaries on classics handle, drive the lead screw through the mode of rotating the commentaries on classics handle and rotate, rotatory lead screw makes nut seat and gag lever post carry out lateral displacement through the screw thread fit between with the nut seat, after the one end of gag lever post removes the spacing groove on the connection pad, can remove the restriction to the connection pad, can follow the quick dismantlement of controller body, because the mode that adopts the joint has replaced traditional bolted connection, the in-process of dismantlement need not the staff and uses extracting tool, the time that the dismantlement was spent is shorter, the efficiency of dismantlement is higher.

title_en: Physics laser survey and drawing teaching aid
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a physical laser surveying and mapping teaching aid which comprises a machine body, wherein a laser emission objective lens and a laser receiving objective lens are sequentially arranged in a lens groove at the front end of the machine body up and down, an eyepiece is arranged at the rear end of the machine body in an outward extending mode, a main control circuit, a control chip, a PCB emission plate and a receiving plate are arranged in the machine body, a handle is arranged at the lower end of the machine body and consists of a control part and a battery part, and a power supply/emission key and a mode switching key are sequentially arranged on the front end face of the handle from top to bottom. The utility model has the beneficial effects that 1, the lens groove is provided with an embedded lens protection cover in a matching way and is used for protecting the lens from dust and damage, 2, the ocular is a rotary focusing ocular, a transparent LCD display prism is adopted, the focusing is convenient for a user according to the observation requirement, meanwhile, a clear observation picture is provided, 3, the power supply part of the battery part is a rechargeable lithium battery, and the battery part has longer cruising ability and environmental protection, and is externally sleeved with an anti-skid sleeve, so that the holding stability of the user is improved.

title_en: Movable globe mounting structure and decoration assembly
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of decorative structures, and particularly relates to a movable globe installation structure and a decorative component, wherein the movable globe installation structure comprises a hoisting component, a moving component and a height positioning component; the high-strength globe frame comprises a lifting assembly, a height positioning assembly, a globe frame body, a lifting assembly, a fixing assembly and a fixing assembly, wherein the lifting assembly is arranged on the lifting assembly in a limiting sliding mode, the upper portion of the height positioning assembly is in limiting movable connection with the lifting assembly, the bottom of the height positioning assembly is in limiting movable connection with the globe frame body, the lifting assembly is suitable for being fixed on the fixing assembly and is fixed on the fixing assembly, the lifting assembly is suitable for penetrating through the lifting assembly to the globe frame body to fix the globe frame body on the lifting assembly, the lifting assembly is used as a support of the lifting assembly and the height positioning assembly, the structural strength can be guaranteed, the position and the height of the globe frame body can be adjusted through the cooperation of the lifting assembly and the height positioning assembly, the integral modeling integrity and attractive requirements are met, and compared with a traditional installation structure, nails are not needed, the installation is convenient, and the installation efficiency is improved.

title_en: Automatic vending machine convenient to mend goods
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a vending machine convenient for replenishment, which belongs to the technical field of vending machines and comprises a cabinet body, wherein an inventory box is placed in the cabinet body, an inlet and an outlet are formed in one side of the cabinet body and correspond to the inventory box, the vending machine further comprises a second cabinet door for closing the inlet and the outlet, a plurality of layers of placing plates are fixed in the cabinet body, the inventory box is positioned between a back plate of the cabinet body and the placing plates, a vertical baffle is arranged between the inventory box and a cargo taking port, a vertical first guide rail is arranged on the inner side of the back plate of the placing plates, and an upper and lower material assembly for loading and unloading goods is arranged in the first guide rail in a sliding manner. When the vending machine is used for replenishing goods, the goods can be stored in the storage box in advance, the goods to be loaded and the position to be loaded of the goods are preset through the second touch display screen, the control system sequentially controls the loading and unloading assembly to load the goods according to the preset sequence, and the loading mode does not need operators to place the goods on the storage box one by one, so that the labor intensity is reduced.

title_en: Water level mark post
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of water level marks, in particular to a water level mark post which comprises a post body, wherein a sliding groove is formed in the outer wall of the post body, a sliding block is slidably arranged in the sliding groove, a floating plate is fixedly matched between one sides of the sliding blocks, a mounting seat is arranged at the bottom side of the floating plate, a floating roller is arranged on the outer wall of a rotating shaft, a supporting plate is fixedly connected to the outer wall of the top side of the post body, a pressure sensor is arranged at the bottom side of the supporting plate, the floating plate and the floating roller can rise along with rising of water level to drive the sliding block to slide upwards along the sliding groove, the floating plate can be contacted with the pressure sensor after the water level rises to a certain height, the pressure sensor converts a detected pressure value into an electric signal, a warning lamp is turned on after a control box receives the electric signal, people are reminded of water level change, water level detection is realized, the phenomenon that the water level is too high is avoided, and safety accidents are reduced.

title_en: Electric leakage detection terminal
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electric leakage detection terminal, which comprises a shell, a circuit board, a detection module, an alarm module and a bolt, wherein the shell is provided with a mounting cavity and a through hole communicated with the mounting cavity, the circuit board is arranged in the mounting cavity, the circuit board is provided with a trigger module, the detection module is arranged on the circuit board, the alarm module is arranged on the circuit board and is electrically connected with the detection module, the alarm module penetrates through the through hole, the bolt comprises a pin part and a handle part which are connected, the pin part penetrates through the through hole and stretches into the mounting cavity to be matched with the trigger module, and the handle part is positioned outside the shell. The firefighter can determine whether to pull out the bolt according to the field condition to trigger an alarm so as to prompt other personnel to pay attention to accidents and improve safety. When aiming at other unexpected situations, the electric leakage detection terminal can also send out an alarm to warn other personnel, so that the functionality of the electric leakage detection terminal is improved.

title_en: Auxiliary alarm lamp
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an auxiliary alarm lamp, which belongs to the technical field of alarm lamps and comprises a lamp shade, a bulb and a lamp holder, wherein the lamp holder is connected with a door frame, a mounting groove is formed in the door frame, the lamp holder is arranged in the mounting groove, the bulb is arranged on the lamp holder, the lamp shade is detachably arranged on the lamp holder, the bulb is arranged between the lamp shade and the lamp holder, the lamp holder is provided with a threaded hole, the mounting groove is provided with a fixing hole, the threaded hole is communicated with the fixing hole, the fixing hole is inserted with a light sensing sensor, one end of the light sensing sensor is in threaded connection with the threaded hole, a controller is fixedly arranged on the lamp holder, the bulb is connected to the controller, the light sensing sensor is electrically connected with the controller, a chamber door is rotatably arranged on the door frame, and a sensing head of the light sensing sensor faces one side of the chamber door.

title_en: Automatic control system
abstract_en: The disclosure provides an automatic control system which is applied to a scene at least comprising a water tank, wherein the automatic control system at least comprises a first working system and a communication system, the communication system is used for realizing communication among all devices in the automatic control system, the first working system at least comprises water quality monitoring equipment and water quality treatment equipment, the water quality monitoring equipment is used for monitoring water quality information in the water tank and determining whether to clean the water quality in the water tank according to the water quality information, and the water quality treatment equipment is used for treating the water quality in the water tank when the water quality monitoring equipment determines to clean the water quality in the water tank. The water in the water tank is monitored and treated by the first working system, so that the water quality health of the water tank is improved, the communication system can transmit the water quality information to other equipment, whether the other equipment carries out other treatments on the water tank or not is determined, and the degree of automation in the whole scene working system is improved.

title_en: Wisdom fire control monitoring facilities convenient to overhaul
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an intelligent fire-fighting monitoring device convenient to overhaul, which comprises a fixed plate, wherein when the monitoring device is required to be maintained, a protective shell is dismounted, a movable baffle is pulled firstly, the movable baffle moves to press a supporting spring, one end of the movable baffle moves to be not abutted against a toothed bar, the toothed bar is a metal bar, a magnetic block is arranged at the top of a groove body, the toothed bar is adsorbed by the magnetic block under the limitation of the movable baffle, the toothed bar moves upwards and drives a gear to rotate, a limiting clamping block on the surface of the gear rotates to be separated from a clamping fixing relationship with a clamping groove on the surface of the protective shell, meanwhile, when the protective shell is installed in a mounting groove in the fixed plate, the protective shell is firstly placed in the mounting groove, then the toothed bar is pulled, the toothed bar moves downwards to drive the gear to rotate, a limiting clamping block on the surface of the gear is clamped and fixed with the inside the clamping groove, and the movable baffle is pushed into the groove body under the action of the supporting spring, and the movable baffle is positioned between the magnetic block and the toothed bar to be intercepted.

title_en: Combined hand terminal for holding and inspecting
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a combined handheld inspection terminal which comprises a thick rod, wherein the left end of the thick rod is fixedly connected with a handle, a sliding rod is connected inside the thick rod in a sliding manner, the right end of the sliding rod is fixedly connected with a base, the middle side of the top of the base is fixedly connected with the inspection terminal, the top of the base is fixedly connected with two dustproof mechanisms in a sliding manner, the outer side of the thick rod is fixedly connected with a mounting block, the top side of the inner part of the mounting block is provided with a sliding groove, and the bottom side of the inner part of the mounting block is provided with a limiting groove. According to the utility model, through the mutual coordination among the structures such as the mounting block, the inserting connection rod, the second spring, the push rod, the connecting rod, the baffle, the sliding groove, the limiting groove and the like, the second spring is driven to work, the combined type inspection terminal with adjustable length is realized, the operation in a narrow space is facilitated, the space is saved, the flexibility is improved, the deep inspection is facilitated, the operation difficulty is reduced, the comfort is enhanced, and the working efficiency is improved.

title_en: PCIe-based test master control system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a test main control system based on PCIe, which is applied to a PXI chassis, wherein the PXI chassis comprises a PCIe panel and an IO panel, the IO panel comprises a GPIB interface and is used for being in communication connection with equipment to be tested, the PCIe panel comprises the PCIe interface and is used for data transmission, the test main control system comprises a bottom plate module and an FPGA circuit, the FPGA circuit is connected with the PCIe panel or the interface on the IO panel through an interface circuit preset on the bottom plate module, the FPGA circuit is connected with the GPIB interface through a GPIB control bus, the buckle module comprises a processing chip, the processing chip is connected with the interface circuit through a chip system circuit on the buckle module and is further connected with the interface on the PCIe panel or the IO panel, and the processing chip is connected with the FPGA circuit so as to realize control of the test main control system. The test main control system can meet the test requirements of high operation and high real-time performance on products in various fields.

title_en: Portable vehicle part function tester
abstract_en: The application discloses a portable vehicle part function tester which comprises an electric parameter detection module, a communication detection module, a PWM signal detection module and a processor, wherein the electric parameter detection module is electrically connected with the processor and a part to be detected respectively and used for acquiring electric parameter data of the part to be detected and sending the electric parameter data to the processor, the communication detection module is electrically connected with the processor and the part to be detected respectively and used for acquiring message information of the part to be detected and sending the message information to the processor, the PWM signal detection module is electrically connected with the processor and the part to be detected respectively and used for acquiring PWM signals of the part to be detected and sending the PWM signals to the processor, the processor is used for determining electric parameter values of the part to be detected according to the electric parameter data, the processor is also used for analyzing the message information and determining communication states of the part to be detected, and the processor is also used for determining frequency and duty ratio of the PWM signals according to the PWM signals. Based on this, the universality of detecting the vehicle parts is improved.

title_en: Interactive automobile data recorder
abstract_en: The utility model provides an interactive automobile data recorder which comprises a base end assembly, a baffle end assembly and a service end assembly, wherein the base end assembly comprises a base end shell, two groups of first sliding rails and a bottom plate, the baffle end assembly comprises a back plate, a top plate, two groups of side plates and two groups of second sliding rails, the service end assembly comprises a service end shell and two groups of third sliding rails, the base end and the baffle end are fixed through sliding fit between the first sliding rails and the second sliding rails in a first state, and the base end and the service end are fixed through sliding fit between the first sliding rails and the third sliding rails in a second state. According to the scheme, the service core of the motorcade can be changed only by detaching the service end assembly and exchanging the baffle end assembly with the appointed general vehicle and installing the baffle end assembly through the sliding rail.

title_en: Control circuit for channel self-checking of pulse therapeutic apparatus
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of pulse therapeutic apparatuses, in particular to a channel self-checking control circuit of a pulse therapeutic apparatus, which comprises a main control MCU unit, a self-checking switching channel, an impedance sampling channel and an MCU stoping channel. The main control MCU unit is connected with the latch module U10 and the isolation operational amplifier module, the latch module U10 is connected to an interface CN1 of the self-checking circuit board through an interface J16, the interface CN1 of the self-checking circuit board is connected with a self-checking switching channel, the self-checking switching channel is connected with an impedance sampling channel, the impedance sampling channel is connected with the isolation operational amplifier module, and the MCU extraction channel is an AD differential input port of the main control MCU unit, wherein the impedance sampling channel directly enters the AD differential input port of the main control MCU unit. According to the utility model, through switching the self-checking channel and detecting the resistance value of the sample in the self-checking channel, whether the hardware of the equipment is damaged or not can be automatically detected, the channel problem can be rapidly positioned, and the rapid checking and maintenance of maintenance personnel are facilitated, so that the service efficiency of the equipment is improved, and the continuity of the treatment work of a department is ensured.

title_en: Fire disaster early warning equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses fire early warning equipment, which comprises a guide rod, wherein the top end and the bottom end of the guide rod are respectively connected with a support plate through threads, the outer wall of one side of the support plate is connected with a fastening bolt through threads, the outer walls of two sides of the guide rod are respectively welded with guide rails, a detection assembly is slidingly connected on the guide rails, the top of the detection assembly is provided with a contact terminal, the circumference of the top end of the guide rod is connected with a connector through threads, the connector is matched with the contact terminal, an alarm is fixed on the outer wall of the top of the support plate through bolts, the alarm is electrically connected with the connector, and the detection assembly comprises a movable barrel, a hemispherical cavity, a sliding disc, a sliding groove, a guide ring, a turntable, an annular groove, a touch sensor and a guide ball. The utility model solves the problem of monitoring and alarming by using the conventional method of using the marker post and the warning, promotes the safety of warning and ensures the timeliness of early warning.

title_en: Automatic-lighting goods taking port and vending machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic illumination goods taking port and an automatic vending machine, which comprises a movable door and a mounting frame, wherein the movable door is rotatably opened and closed on the mounting frame, the automatic vending machine comprises an illumination device which is arranged in a box body of the automatic vending machine, an illumination end faces to a goods receiving basket of the automatic vending machine, a sensing device which is arranged on the movable door and is electrically connected with the illumination device, when the movable door is opened, the movable door touches the sensing end of the sensing device, the illumination device senses to illuminate, when the movable door is closed, the movable door is far away from the sensing end of the sensing device, and the illumination device closes the illumination. The state of dodge gate is responded to through induction system, simple structure can realize the automatically-illuminated of dodge gate to reduce the consumption of electric energy, avoid the user to appear leaking the condition of taking when picking up commodity, the reinforcing is experienced and is felt.

title_en: Bottled hot drink vending machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a bottled hot drink vending machine, which belongs to the field of unmanned automatic vending machines and comprises a mounting shelf, wherein at least one lifting mechanism is arranged at the upper part of the mounting shelf, the lifting mechanisms are used for lifting a storage box body, two conveying mechanisms are arranged between two adjacent lifting mechanisms, the conveying mechanisms are used for conveying the storage box body, a longitudinal moving guide rail is arranged at the upper part of the mounting shelf, a transverse mounting plate is slidably connected with the longitudinal moving guide rail, a transverse guide rail is arranged on the transverse mounting plate, a clamping mechanism is arranged on the transverse guide rail, a heating mechanism is arranged on one side of the upper part of the mounting shelf, a discharging mechanism is arranged on one side of the heating mechanism, the heating problem of bottled drink can be solved, the working efficiency of bottled drink taking by users is improved, the queuing waiting time of users is reduced, the requirements of the bottled hot drink of consumers are met, and the experience of the consumers is improved.

title_en: Discharging mechanism and cooked food vending machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a discharging mechanism and a cooked food vending machine, wherein the discharging mechanism comprises a discharging shell, a discharging door and a supporting frame, the discharging shell is provided with an inner cavity and a discharging hole, the discharging hole is communicated with the inner cavity, the discharging door is movably connected to the inner cavity so as to shield or open the discharging hole, the supporting frame is arranged on the outer wall of the discharging shell and corresponds to the discharging hole, and the supporting frame is used for supporting roasted sausage. According to the technical scheme provided by the utility model, the discharging difficulty of the discharging mechanism is reduced, and the roast sausage is prevented from falling off.

title_en: Multifunctional practical training platform for pneumatic braking system of commercial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multifunctional practical training platform of a pneumatic braking system of a commercial vehicle, which belongs to the technical field of pneumatic braking systems and comprises a rack, wherein a clamping mechanism for installing front and rear pneumatic braking tanks is arranged on one side of a frame of the rack, the clamping mechanism comprises symmetrically distributed fixing plates and a supporting plate positioned between the two fixing plates, the supporting plate vertically moves along the fixing plates, a sliding plate is arranged above the supporting plate and moves inwards and outwards along the horizontal direction, a front braking gas tank and a rear braking gas tank are arranged above the supporting plate and positioned on one side of the sliding plate, and the rear braking gas tank is arranged above the sliding plate. According to the utility model, the gas tank is convenient to replace and transport, after the fixed plate is moved to the lowest position, the sliding plate is pulled open to separate the two gas tanks, so that the space for personnel to detach and transport the gas tanks is increased, and the gas tanks are further convenient to detach and replace.

title_en: Portable face identification entrance guard's device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a mobile face recognition entrance guard device, which relates to the field of face recognition entrance guard, wherein a groove is formed in the left side of a fan and is used for air intake, a groove is formed in the bottom end of the inside of a controller, an air pipe is fixedly connected in a linear array mode in the groove, the main body of the air pipe is of an inclined structure, the air pipe is connected with the fan fixedly connected to the left end face of the controller, the problem that the conventional entrance guard recognition device is usually placed at a gate, a gate and the like in a fixed mode, has the defects of limited application range, single function, incapability of performing mobile inspection and the like is solved, a recognition lens fixedly connected to the controller can be used in a CCD structure, the information of a visitor can be recognized through the lens of the CCD structure, and the corresponding information comparison with the controller or the cloud is carried out to judge whether the entrance guard system is opened, and the aim of accurate recognition is achieved.

title_en: Upper computer interconnection control system between photovoltaic glass cold end production lines
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an interconnection control system of upper computers among photovoltaic glass cold end production lines, which comprises a plurality of cold end production lines, each cold end production line comprises a wire control system PLC and an upper computer, the interconnection and the intercommunication of the wire control systems PLC and the upper computers are realized through MPI network networking, each upper computer collects process control parameters on each production line controller, each upper computer configures monitoring operation pictures of each production line, the upper computers of each production line can control the monitoring pictures of the other production lines, the upper computers are used for multiple standby, the mutual standby is realized, the safety is greatly improved, the fault of any upper industrial computer does not influence the safe production operation of each production line, the maintenance time of the fault industrial computer is abundant, each photovoltaic glass cold end production line control system is converged into a large system by an independent system, the process of workshop production line level collection in the propelling process of an enterprise digital factory is convenient, and a large number of data acquisition works can be reduced.

title_en: Box opening mechanism of pizza vending machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a pizza vending machine box opening mechanism which comprises a mounting frame, wherein an electric telescopic rail is arranged on the mounting frame, a tray is fixed on the telescopic end of the electric telescopic rail, a pizza box is placed in the tray, a pizza tray is arranged in the pizza box, two groups of screw rods are arranged at the lower part of the mounting frame, lifting brackets are connected to the screw rods in a threaded manner, a first servo motor is axially fixed at the bottom of the screw rods, the first servo motor is connected to the bottom of the mounting frame in a bolt manner, the lifting brackets are connected to the mounting frame in a sliding manner along the vertical direction, a first through hole and a second through hole are respectively formed in the bottoms of the tray and the pizza box, a rotary cylinder is arranged on one side of the mounting frame, an L-shaped supporting frame is arranged at the working end of the rotary cylinder, and the design of the electric telescopic rail, the tray, the lifting brackets and the L-shaped supporting frame is realized in the whole process, and the automatic vending machine can be used for providing automatic convenience.

title_en: High-precision temperature control system of temperature control hot melting kettle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-precision temperature control hot melting kettle temperature control system which comprises a hot melting kettle, a heat conducting oil heating system, a temperature monitoring circuit and a PID control circuit, wherein the hot melting kettle is used for melting hot melting paint, the heat conducting oil heating system comprises a heating tank, a heat conducting oil circulating pump and an intelligent flow dividing valve, heat conducting oil is filled in the heating tank and is circularly transferred to the hot melting kettle through the heat conducting oil circulating pump, the intelligent flow dividing valve is used for controlling the flow direction of heat conducting oil, the temperature monitoring circuit comprises at least three distributed temperature sensors which are respectively arranged at a feed inlet, a discharge outlet and a kettle bottom of the hot melting kettle and used for monitoring temperature distribution in the hot melting kettle in real time, and the PID control circuit is used for receiving signals of the temperature monitoring circuit and outputting control signals to the intelligent flow dividing valve and the heat conducting oil circulating pump of the heat conducting oil heating system. Meanwhile, the intelligent flow dividing valve and the heat conducting oil circulating pump work cooperatively, so that the temperature distribution in the hot melting kettle is ensured to be uniform, the local overheating or overcooling is avoided, and the reliability and the stability of the system are improved.

title_en: Double-sided sounding wall chart
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a double-sided sounding wall chart, which relates to the technical field of wall charts and comprises a chart board and a sounder connected with the chart board, wherein a clicking region is arranged on the front side and the back side of the chart board, a clicking circuit corresponding to the clicking region is arranged in the chart board, the sounder comprises a shell, a circuit board and a loudspeaker, the circuit board and the loudspeaker are arranged in the shell, a loudspeaker hole is formed in one side of the shell, corresponding to the front side of the chart board, a first anti-blocking region and a second anti-blocking region are formed in one side of the shell, the loudspeaker hole is arranged in the first anti-blocking region, smooth sounding in back side use is effectively ensured, the difference between sounding in back side use and sounding in front side use of the double-sided sounding wall chart is reduced, and the problem that the whole point-reading learning effect is poor due to overlarge sounding difference is avoided.

title_en: Remote data acquisition and control equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses remote data acquisition and control equipment, which comprises a controller and a plurality of gauge heads connected with metering equipment, wherein one end of each gauge head is connected with a control unit, the controller comprises a wireless transmission unit, a direct current power supply input unit, a processor, a storage unit and an interface unit, the storage unit, the wireless transmission unit and the battery power supply input unit are all connected with the processor, and the direct current power supply input unit is connected with the battery power supply input unit.

title_en: Hydraulic ring geological crack measuring device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a hydraulic ring geological fracture measuring device which comprises an installation box with an opening at the bottom, wherein two L-shaped supporting legs are magnetically inserted into the two sides of the bottom of the installation box, a containing hole is formed in the top of the right side of the installation box, magnet blocks are fixedly connected to the two sides of the top of the installation box, the containing hole and the magnet blocks are matched with the four L-shaped supporting legs, the containing hole is used for containing the four L-shaped supporting legs, the magnet blocks are used for adsorbing and fixing the corresponding L-shaped supporting legs, a control reminding mechanism is fixedly connected to the top of the installation box, and the control reminding mechanism is used for reminding personnel. According to the utility model, through a series of structural arrangement, the moving position of the measuring rod can be obviously and accurately known in a prompt lamp reminding mode during measurement, personnel are not required to observe the position of the measuring rod, the measurement work is not influenced, the total volume of the whole device can be reduced after the device is used, and the device is convenient to carry and transport.

title_en: Circuit awakening system based on communication signals
abstract_en: The utility model provides a circuit awakening system based on communication signals, which belongs to the technical field of equipment communication and comprises a dormancy awakening circuit, wherein the dormancy awakening circuit comprises a differential signal input module, the differential signal input module is used for generating differential signals, the differential signal input module comprises a signal input unit and an isolation optocoupler, the isolation optocoupler is connected with the output end of the signal input unit, the singlechip signal overturning module is arranged at the output end of the isolation optocoupler, the singlechip signal overturning module CAN realize signal level overturning detected by a singlechip when the isolation optocoupler is conducted, and the signal input unit is a CAN bus and/or an RS-485 bus.

title_en: Teaching appliance
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an instrument for teaching, which belongs to the technical field of teaching appliances and comprises a base, wherein a lifting seat is arranged above the base, a bishop learning board is hinged to the upper surface of the right side of the lifting seat through a hinge shaft, auxiliary teaching boards are slidably arranged in the front side and the rear side of the bishop learning board, a pressing rod is slidably arranged in the middle of the inside of the auxiliary teaching board, an annular connecting block is arranged on the circumferential surface of the pressing rod, the annular connecting block is slidably connected with the inside of the auxiliary teaching board through a first spring, a first wedge block is arranged at the inner end of the pressing rod, and when the use of the teaching board needs to be enlarged, the two auxiliary teaching boards can be moved out of the bishop learning board for use, and when the teaching board is not used, the two auxiliary teaching boards can be moved into the main teaching board, the occupied space of the teaching board is reduced, the teaching board is more flexible to use and convenient to store.

title_en: Water leakage monitoring alarm device for air conditioner room
abstract_en: The application relates to a water leakage monitoring alarm device of an air conditioner room, and relates to the field of water leakage monitoring alarm of the air conditioner room. The device comprises a water leakage monitoring alarm panel, wherein a fixing plate is arranged on the back surface of the water leakage monitoring alarm panel, a fixing frame is welded on the front surface of the fixing plate, a sliding groove is formed in the bottom of the fixing frame, a sliding block is connected to the inner cavity of the sliding groove in a sliding mode, limiting blocks are welded on the left side and the right side of the sliding block respectively, and two symmetrical sliding rods are welded in the inner cavity of the sliding groove. According to the application, the clamping frame is clamped on the inner cavity of the mounting frame through the fixing plate to fix the air conditioner room wall surface, the torsion block is rotated, so that the threaded rod and the sliding block move in a threaded manner, the sliding block is clamped on the top of the mounting frame in a downward sliding manner through the limit of the sliding rod, the water leakage monitoring alarm panel is fixed, the problem that a user consumes more time for dismounting and repairing the water leakage monitoring alarm device is avoided, and the dismounting and repairing efficiency of the water leakage monitoring alarm device is increased.

title_en: Casing structure of combustible gas alarm
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a shell structure of a flammable gas alarm, which comprises a box body, wherein the box body is provided with a front opening surface, an upper cover is arranged at the position of the opening surface, the top surface of the box body is provided with handrails, the bottom surfaces of the left side and the right side of the box body are provided with hanging lugs, the opening surface of the box body is provided with a concave table, a screw hole is arranged on the concave table, a matrix eyelet is arranged in the middle of the upper cover, alarm lamp covers are symmetrically arranged on the two sides of the matrix eyelet, and the upper cover is fixed on the opening surface.

title_en: Pressure control device for IGBT thermal test
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pressure control device for IGBT thermal test, which comprises a T-shaped seat, wherein the top of the T-shaped seat is fixedly connected with a vertically arranged rotating shaft, the top end of the rotating shaft is in rotary connection with a cross beam through a connecting piece, a screw rod and a sliding rod which are arranged along the vertical direction are arranged on the upper part of a main body of the T-shaped seat, the screw rod is in threaded connection with the T-shaped seat, the sliding rod is in sliding connection with the T-shaped seat, the bottom of the screw rod is rotatably arranged in a sliding seat, a pressing rod which is arranged along the vertical direction is arranged below the sliding seat, an adiabatic pressure head A is arranged at the bottom end of the pressing rod, an annular weight is sleeved on the main body of the sliding rod, and an adiabatic pressure head B is arranged at the bottom end of the sliding rod. The pressure control device for IGBT heat test provided by the utility model can simulate a constant pressure environment and a variable pressure environment, and the two pressure environments can be switched conveniently, so that the heat test process is more convenient and efficient.

title_en: Pipe network monitoring terminal with image acquisition function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pipe network monitoring terminal with an image acquisition function, which comprises a main control module, a first monitoring assembly, a second monitoring assembly and a camera shooting assembly, wherein the first monitoring assembly and the second monitoring assembly are connected to a first end of the main control module, the camera shooting assembly is connected to a second end of the main control module, the first monitoring assembly is used for detecting a real-time water level signal and a real-time flow rate signal when the drainage in a pipe does not reach a full pipe state, the second monitoring assembly is used for detecting a real-time water level signal and a real-time flow rate signal when the drainage in the pipe reaches the full pipe state, and the camera shooting assembly is used for acquiring image information in the pipe. The utility model can accurately collect the water level and flow velocity data of the pipe network in real time under various water flow states.

title_en: Multi-frequency fire point detection device with early warning function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multi-frequency fire detection device with an early warning function, which relates to the technical field of fire detection devices and comprises a shell, wherein a probe is embedded in one side of the shell, an arc-shaped brush is clamped on one side of the shell, rotating blocks are fixedly connected to two ends of the arc-shaped brush, a driving mechanism is connected to the top of the rotating blocks, the driving mechanism comprises a micro motor, a triggering inclined block is fixedly connected to one side of the rotating blocks, a touch switch is fixedly connected to the inner top of the arc-shaped brush, and the touch switch is connected with a servo motor through a wire.

title_en: Clamping device
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to the technical field of vending machine clamping equipment, in particular to a clamping device. The clamping device comprises a frame, a telescopic mechanism, an opening and closing mechanism and a clamping mechanism, wherein the clamping mechanism comprises a clamping frame and two clamping jaws which are oppositely arranged, the two clamping jaws are arranged on the clamping frame in a sliding mode along a first direction, the opening and closing mechanism is arranged on the clamping frame and is correspondingly connected with the two clamping jaws and used for driving the two clamping jaws to approach or separate from each other in the first direction, the telescopic mechanism is arranged on the frame and is connected with the clamping frame, and the telescopic mechanism drives the clamping frame to move in a second direction. The clamping device is characterized in that the clamping mechanism and the clamping jaw are driven by the opening and closing mechanism and the telescopic mechanism to finish the action of clamping objects, and the whole device completely reciprocates on a horizontal plane, so that the clamping device is simple in structure and can be easily stretched into a narrow space to finish the grabbing work.

title_en: Alarm and gas detection alarm system
abstract_en: The utility model provides an alarm and a gas detection alarm system, wherein the alarm comprises a grading signal detection module, a processor and an alarm execution module, the processor comprises a detection input end and an alarm output end, the grading signal detection module comprises two detection ends and one output end, the output end of the grading signal detection module is connected with the detection input end of the processor, the alarm output end of the processor is connected with the alarm execution module, when the two detection ends of the grading signal detection module are configured to be mutually conducted or mutually disconnected, the output ends of the grading signal detection module respectively output two different signals, the processor outputs the two different alarm signals based on the different signals received by the detection input end, and the alarm execution module executes the two different alarm outputs based on the different received alarm signals and is applicable to some application scenes needing grading alarm.

title_en: Digital intelligent cabinet
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of storage cabinets, in particular to a digital intelligent cabinet which comprises a plurality of cabinets, wherein two cavities are distributed up and down, the base surfaces of the upper cavity and the lower cavity are rotationally connected with a first cabinet door and a second cabinet door through electric hinges, the base surfaces of the first cabinet door are respectively provided with a face recognition camera, a touch display screen and an object scanning camera, the bottom ends of the two cavities are fixedly provided with a plurality of placing tables, the rear positions of the two cavities are provided with cooling devices, the left side and the right side of the interior of the two cavities are provided with heating devices, and a monitoring probe is fixedly arranged at the middle position above the cabinet.

title_en: Conveying device and paper towel vending equipment
abstract_en: A conveying device and tissue vending equipment comprise a supporting mechanism and a pushing mechanism, wherein the supporting mechanism comprises at least two step surfaces which are distributed in a high-low mode, a connecting inclined surface is arranged between the step surfaces, a row of a plurality of products stacked up and down are placed on the step surfaces, the products between the adjacent step surfaces are staggered up and down, and the pushing mechanism is used for pushing one product at the lowest part on the low step surface to move along the direction of the connecting inclined surface to the high step surface. Therefore, when the pushing mechanism moves from low to high with the lowest product, the bottom product of the low step surface can be abutted against the middle part of the side surface of the bottom product of the high step surface, namely the top surface of the low bottom product can be always lower than the top surface of the high bottom product, so that one product at the bottom of the low position can only push one product at the bottom of the high position to move every time, and two products stacked up and down can not be driven to move together. In the whole paper discharging process, the pushing mechanism can only push out one tissue bag, and paper can be discharged smoothly.

title_en: Audible and visual alarm safety structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of audible and visual alarm equipment and discloses an audible and visual alarm safety structure which comprises an audible and visual alarm body, wherein four groups of fixing plates are fixedly arranged on the back surface of the audible and visual alarm body, two groups of inserting rods are fixedly connected to one side of each fixing plate, a limiting assembly is clamped on the surface of each inserting rod, two groups of connecting pipes are communicated with one side of the audible and visual alarm body, a left clamping ring is sleeved at one end of each connecting pipe, a right clamping ring is rotatably connected to one end of each left clamping ring, a fixing assembly is rotatably connected to one end of each right clamping ring, an exhaust fan is sleeved at one end of each connecting pipe, and each limiting assembly comprises a sliding plate clamped on the surface of each inserting rod. This audible and visual alarm safety structure through spacing subassembly's setting, reaches the effect of convenient dismouting audible and visual alarm body, when needs maintenance or change alarm, the operation process has been simplified greatly in the design of this kind of convenient dismouting, has reduced maintenance time and cost.

title_en: Rotatable pressure intensity display device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a rotatable pressure display device which comprises four sequentially adjacent surfaces of a frame, wherein elastic films are arranged on the four sequentially adjacent surfaces of the frame, transparent baffles are fixedly arranged on the two opposite surfaces of the frame, the transparent baffles are connected to one side, close to the bottom, of a handheld rod through a transmission assembly, the transmission assembly comprises a transmission wheel set, a transmission chain and a rotating handle, the transmission wheel set is positioned on one side of the handheld rod, the transmission chain is connected with the transmission wheel set, one side, far away from the handheld rod, of the transmission wheel set is fixedly connected with the transparent baffles, one end of the rotating handle is connected with one end of the transmission wheel set inside the handheld rod, the other end of the rotating handle extends out of the handheld rod, the transmission wheel set drives the frame to rotate through rotating the rotating handle, and an air duct is communicated with the inside of the frame. The utility model provides a teaching demonstration device for displaying the internal pressure of liquid, which is helpful for students to study and experience whether the pressure of the liquid is equal to the pressure in all directions or not in the same depth.

title_en: Bus station berth prompting system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a bus station berth prompting system which is used for visually guiding a bus berthing process. The system comprises berth guiding indication equipment, a vehicle information acquisition sensor and a controller, wherein the berth guiding indication equipment is arranged in a berthing area of a bus station, the berthing area comprises a plurality of berths, berth guiding indication equipment is arranged at the corresponding position of each berth, the vehicle information acquisition sensor is used for acquiring vehicle information of a bus to enter the bus station, the controller is used for determining a target berth of a target bus according to the vehicle information of the bus and sending a first control signal to the berth guiding indication equipment corresponding to the target berth, the target bus is any one of the buses, the berth guiding indication equipment is used for prompting and displaying the target berth after receiving the first control signal.

title_en: Automatic sell popcorn machine device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a device for vending popcorn machine, and relates to the technical field of vending machine devices. This automatic sell popcorn machine device, including the vending machine case, the vending machine incasement is provided with the bin, bin bottom fixedly connected with funnel, funnel bottom fixedly connected with drum, the drum bottom is provided with the discharge gate, drum side fixedly connected with additional pole, the drum bottom is provided with adjusting part, be provided with in the drum and derive the subassembly. This automatic sell popcorn machine device adopts and derives subassembly be convenient for consumer quantitative purchase popcorn, and suitable volume can satisfy consumer demand, thereby the container height of the high adaptation consumer from taking of adjusting part be convenient for adjust the drum simultaneously, and drum side fixed connection's additional pole is convenient for consumer use food plastic bag to connect dress popcorn, can reduce consumer's concern of purchasing popcorn.

title_en: Power control and driving integrated system of air fryer
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a power supply control and drive integrated system of an air fryer, and belongs to the technical field of circuit drive control. The 220VAC power supply filter circuit is respectively connected with the DC-DC voltage reduction circuit and the heating pipe switch circuit, the DC-DC voltage reduction circuit is respectively connected with the motor driving circuit and the main control MCU, and the main control MCU is respectively connected with the motor driving circuit, the knob control circuit, the heating pipe switch circuit, the NTC temperature detection circuit and the zero crossing detection circuit. The utility model is used for solving the problems of large volume and high cost caused by the separate design of the power panel, the upper control panel and the motor driving panel of the traditional air fryer. To solve this problem, to reduce the cost and volume, multi-module integration is required, and conventionally, a control board is selected by adopting a button and a display screen, which results in the problem that the cost and volume cannot be reduced.

title_en: U-shaped process automatic track crane collecting card red light running monitoring system
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of storage yard safety management, and in particular relates to a U-shaped process automation track crane integrated card red light running monitoring system, which comprises a front terminal system, a front terminal system and a rear terminal system, wherein the front terminal system is used for completing collection, analysis, processing, storage and uploading of front-end data; the transmission and back-end management subsystem comprises a transmission part and a back-end management part, wherein the transmission part is used for completing the transmission and exchange of data, pictures and videos, and the back-end management part consists of a platform server and a monitoring system and is used for realizing the aggregation, processing, storage and analysis of relevant data in a jurisdiction. The utility model can solve the problem of potential safety hazards of falling of heavy objects after the interactive operation of the truck is finished or when other vehicles travel on a roadway and are staggered with the rail sling box, and has better market application prospect.

title_en: Composite alarm with split structure
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of alarm instruments and discloses a composite alarm with a split structure, which comprises a sensing module, an alarm module, a first shell structure and a second shell structure, wherein the sensing module is arranged in the first shell structure, the alarm module is arranged in the second shell structure, the first shell structure and the second shell structure are mutually independent, and the sensing module is electrically connected with the alarm module. According to the application, the sensing module for detecting the leakage of the liquefied gas and the alarm module for sending out alarm information are respectively arranged in the corresponding shell structures, so that the sensing module and the alarm module are divided into two independent individuals, meanwhile, the sensing module is electrically connected with the alarm module, the data transmission between the sensing module and the alarm module is ensured, and when the sensing module detects the leakage of the liquefied gas, the alarm module sends out an alarm, so that the alarm sent out by the alarm for detecting the leakage of the liquefied gas can be found in time.

title_en: Intelligent gesture sensing lamp
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent gesture sensing lamp which comprises a gesture sensing module, a light source adjusting module, a control circuit module and a power management module. The gesture sensing module collects gesture action signals of a user and transmits the gesture action signals to the control circuit module, and the control circuit module generates instructions to adjust the brightness, the color temperature or the switching state of the lamp. The system also can be matched with an environment light sensing module, a wireless communication module, a warning module and a voice feedback module to realize the functions of environment self-adaption, remote control and safety prompt. The intelligent lighting system and the lighting method can improve convenience and interactive experience of the lamp through gesture operation, enhance the intelligent level, and provide efficient and safe lighting service for users.

title_en: Airship control system based on execution driving coding plate
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an airship control system based on an execution driving coding board, which comprises an airship control computer, an execution driving coding board, a logic control circuit and an output port. The flight control computer can output 6 paths of control signals of PWM0-PWM5, the execution drive coding board integrates 6 paths of alternative analog switches, and the input ends of the switches are respectively connected with the flight control computer and six paths of PWM signals output by the execution drive board. The logic control circuit consists of an OR gate, an exclusive OR gate and an AND gate, wherein the input end of the logic control circuit is connected with each path of analog switch control end and receives the control right feedback signal of the execution driving plate and the control state feedback signal of the flight control computer. The output port outputs six paths of PWM signals which are gated by the analog switch, and the six paths of PWM signals respectively drive steering engines corresponding to the horizontal tail wing, the vertical tail wing, the duct tilting, the duct locking, the engine throttle and the engine flameout. The control signal switching method and the control signal switching device are used for solving the problems of insufficient control signal switching flexibility, incomplete control logic and poor system expansibility of an existing airship control system.

title_en: Automatic pH value regulator for pigment washing process
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic pH value regulator in a pigment washing process, and relates to the technical field of automatic pH value regulators, comprising a bottom plate, a mounting frame, an adding and mixing assembly, a storage and conveying assembly, a cleaning assembly, a pH value measuring assembly and a washing tank; the automatic pigment washing device comprises a bottom plate, wherein an adding mixing assembly, a storage conveying assembly, a cleaning assembly and a pH value measuring assembly are arranged at the upper end of the bottom plate, a washing tank is arranged in the middle of the upper end of the bottom plate, two mounting frames are arranged at corresponding positions on the left and right sides of the upper end of the bottom plate, the adding mixing assembly comprises a motor I, a threaded rod, a limiting rod, a movable mounting block, a limiting telescopic rod, a self-locking electric telescopic rod I and a mounting plate, a limiting rod is arranged at the rear side of the upper end between the two mounting frames, the threaded rod is connected with the front side of the upper end between the two mounting frames in a rotating mode, the pH value of the pigment washing process is automatically adjusted, mixing efficiency can be improved, the pH value can be changed rapidly, and the device can be cleaned rapidly.

title_en: Mechanical counting automatic alarm device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of mechanical counting and alarming, in particular to an automatic mechanical counting alarming device. The automatic mechanical counting alarm device is characterized by comprising a counting unit, a transmission unit, a triggering unit, an alarm unit and a preset structure, wherein the counting unit comprises a gear set, a mechanical transmission counting unit, the transmission unit is connected with the gear set and converts mechanical motion into rotation, the triggering unit comprises a gear part contacted with the counting unit and a mechanical lever, the alarm unit comprises a sounding device and a light-emitting device, the mechanical lever is used as a switch triggering part through linkage of the triggering unit, and the counting unit further comprises a preset structure which can be used for presetting a threshold value and pushing the triggering unit to displace to trigger the alarm unit when the threshold value is reached. The utility model realizes accurate counting through the mechanical transmission of the gear set, is not interfered by electric power and electromagnetic, can adapt to different machines by the adjustable transmission unit, can make a sound and light alarm by the mechanical lever when reaching a preset threshold, has double warning, has simple and durable structure and low maintenance cost, and is suitable for multiple scenes such as industrial production, storage logistics and the like.

title_en: Reconfigurable pedal set for simulated driving
abstract_en: A pedal assembly and method for swapping default position of a pedal for providing input to a racing simulation.
