The pedal assembly comprising a pedal having a pedal arm for translating pressure applied to the pedal into rotational movement around a pivot axis, a pedal foot arranged at a first end of the pedal, and a pedal face plate for being pressed by a user, the pedal face plate being arranged at a second end of the pedal. The assembly further comprising a guiding plate for configuring the default position of the pedal, the guiding plate comprising an upward surface for contacting the pedal foot. The guiding plate further has a wedge protruding from the upward surface for optionally receiving the pedal foot such that said pedal becomes arranged at a first default position, and the guiding plate may be rotated 180 degrees such that the pedal foot will not be able to contact the wedge whereby the pedal becomes arranged in a second default position. The pedal assembly further comprises an axle defining the pivot axis, connection means for receiving the axle, and biasing means for biasing the pedal toward a default position.

title_en: Bead-on-tile apparatus and methods
abstract_en: Apparatus and methods for providing instruction include at least one instruction site defining an instruction board and at least one instruction piece configured to be received on the instruction site. A user manipulates the at least one instruction piece to perform a change of state operation relating to the instruction. The apparatus and methods are based on applied cognitive science, where children play the lead role in storylines staged upon a rule-enforcing apparatus and by so doing, become self-enlightened about denumerability, rank-wise denumerability, addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and other change-of-state processes encountered in mathematics and the quantifiable sciences.

title_en: Apparatus for simulating motion
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus (1) for simulating motion, comprising: a base (2); a seat (4) with a seat pan (5) and a seat back (6), the seat (4) having a roll axis (R) and, orthogonal thereto, a pitch axis (P); and a mount (7) mounting the seat (4) to the base (2) at least pivotably about said roll axis (R) and said pitch axis (P); a left seat back flap (8) and a right seat back flap (9) each of which being pivotably attached to a respective side (10, 11) of the seat back (6); and a linkage (13) linking said seat back flaps (8, 9) to the base (2) so that, when any one of the sides (10, 11) of the seat back (6) is moved towards the base (2), the respective seat back flap (8, 9) is pivoted inwards and, when said side (10, 11) of the seat back (6) is moved away from the base (2), said seat back flap (8, 9) is pivoted outwards.

title_en: Method for determining an updated trajectory for a vehicle
abstract_en: A method (500) for determining an updated trajectory (413) at a certain time point for the longitudinal and/or lateral control of a vehicle (100) is described. The method (500) comprises determining (501) short-range trajectory candidates in an immediate vicinity (414) of a trajectory (403) determined at a preceding time point, the short-range trajectory candidates being determined with a relatively fine value resolution of one or more state variables of the vehicle (110). In addition, the method (500) comprises determining (502) at least one long-range trajectory candidate outside of the immediate vicinity (414) of the trajectory (403) determined at the preceding time point, the long-range trajectory candidate being determined with a relatively coarse value resolution of the one or more state variables. Furthermore, the method (500) comprises determining (503) the updated trajectory (413) at the certain time point on the basis of the determined short-range trajectory candidates and on the basis of the determined long-range trajectory candidate.

title_en: Printer with improved paper dispensing mechanism
abstract_en: A printer includes a housing (1) having a reel mounted therein to support a paper roll (11) and a paper exit (121) formed in a front panel (12) thereof, a printing mechanism positioned in the housing and having a printing head (21) for printing an ink on the sheet of paper, a paper cutter (22) for cutting the sheet of paper and a paper path (20) defined between the printing head and the paper cutter for the passing of the leading end of the sheet of paper, and a paper dispensing mechanism (3) positioned in the housing including a drive module (31) and a paper dispensing roller set drivable by the drive module to carry the sheet of paper toward the paper exit (121). The paper dispensing roller set consist of two rollers (321) made of a flexible and elastic material and pressed against each other. The distance between the center of the two rollers is less than the combination of the radius of the two rollers (321).

title_en: Development support program, development support device, and development support method
abstract_en: The present invention provides an environment that makes it possible to incorporate a non-periodic-execution function module into a periodic-execution control program. A development support program (50) that makes a computer execute steps (S14, S16) that generate a periodic-execution second function module (55B) that invokes a non-periodic-execution first function module (55A). Said steps (S14, S16) include: a step (S14) in which a data type that is in a periodic-execution programming language and corresponds to the data type of an argument for the first function module (55A) is specified, and an input variable of said data type is established for the second function module (55B); and a step (S16) in which a data type that is in a periodic-execution programming language and corresponds to the data type of a return value for the first function module (55A) is specified, and an output variable of said data type is established for the second function module (55B).

title_en: Non-lethal defensive fluid composition and pressurized delivery system
abstract_en: A lubric gel composition for personal defense includes a fatty acid at a concentration ranging from 5 wt% to 10 wt% of the composition, a thickening agent at a concentration ranging from 1.75 wt% to 8.75 wt% of the composition, a detergent at a concentration ranging from 1.03 wt% to 4.07 wt% of the composition, a surfactant at a concentration ranging from 2 wt% to 15 wt% of the composition, and water at a concentration ranging from 66 wt% to 90.21 wt% of the composition.

title_en: Method and system for positioning a vehicle using an image-capturing device
abstract_en: Method for positioning a vehicle (N) provided with an electronic processing unit (2) connected to a non-optical positioning device (3, 4) and to an external imaging optical device (5), the electronic processing unit (2) comprising a database of navigation marks comprising at least one geographical position of each navigation mark and a descriptive element for each navigation mark; the method comprising the steps of: - estimating a first geographical position (P1e) of the vehicle (N) by means of the non-optical positioning device (3, 4); - preselecting in the database navigation marks having geographical positions located within a predetermined radius around the first geographical position (P1e) of the vehicle (N); - selecting the triplets with minimal geometric errors; - controlling the external imaging optical device (5) to capture images of the selected navigation marks; - selecting images in which the navigation marks are effectively visible, identifying the navigation marks in the images and recording an azimuth or a bearing of each navigation mark visible from the images; - determining a second geographical position (PObrut or POc) of the vehicle (N) from the recorded azimuths or bearings, taking into account or not the movement of the vehicle (N) while the images of the navigation marks are being captured.

title_en: Data novelty detection method and apparatus
abstract_en: The present invention provides a data novelty detection method, where the method includes: receiving to-be-detected data; calculating a separation difficulty value and a local density value of the to-be-detected data based on historical data and the to-be-detected data; calculating an abnormality index value of the to-be-detected data based on the separation difficulty value and the local density value; and determining, based on the abnormality index value, whether the to-be-detected data is novelty data. Compared with the prior art, in the present invention, the abnormality index value of the to-be-detected data is calculated by using the separation difficulty value and the local density value, and whether the to-be-detected data is novelty data is determined based on the abnormality index value, thereby simplifying an operation process and improving accuracy of novelty detection.

title_en: Thermal control apparatus for laser system
abstract_en: A thermal control apparatus (100) including a body (110) defining a centerline axis (112) extended along a height and a circumferential direction extended relative to the centerline axis (112). The body (110) forms a flow circuit (126) therethrough, an inlet opening (111), and an outlet opening (112) each in fluid (95) communication with the flow circuit (126). The flow circuit (126) is extended in parallel flow arrangement along the circumferential direction from the inlet opening (111) to the outlet opening (112). A cavity (114) is extended at least partially through the body (110) along the centerline axis (112). A thermal control system (1000) includes the thermal control apparatus (100), a fluid flow device (400) configured to provide a flow of heat transfer fluid (95) to the apparatus (100) through the inlet opening (111) and to receive the flow of heat transfer fluid (95) from the outlet opening (112) of the apparatus (100), and a flow conduit (97) providing fluid (95) communication of the flow of heat transfer fluid (95) between the fluid flow device (400) and the apparatus (100).

title_en: Hand-held device for training at least one movement and at least one activity of a machine, system and method
abstract_en: According to various embodiments, a hand-held device (100) for training at least one movement and at least one activity of a machine (114) may have: a handle; an input unit, designed for inputting activation information for activating the training of the machine (114); an output unit, designed for outputting the activation information for activating the training of the machine (114) to an apparatus external to the hand-held device; a coupling structure (102) for detachably coupling a removable part that is designed in accordance with the at least one activity; and an interface (842a, 843) that is designed to implement a function together with a circuit (852) of the removable part (210).

title_en: Quality assessment of mobility-related prediction models
abstract_en: An apparatus (100) for assessing a quality of a prediction model (110) for predicting mobility-related information is provided. The apparatus (100) comprises a processor (120) configured to provide vehicle fleet data (130) indicative of a usage of vehicles in slices (140) corresponding to different geographical areas and/or different time periods. The processor (120) is further configured to assign an importance weight (150) to the slices (140) in accordance with a density of the usage of vehicles in the respective slice of geographical area and/or time period. The processor (120) is further configured to compare, for at least one of the slices (140), predicted mobility-related information (162) of the prediction model (110) against predefined mobility-related information (172) in said slice, wherein the processor (120) is configured to weight said slice in accordance with its assigned importance weight (150). The processor (120) is further configured to assess the quality of the prediction model (110) based on the weighted comparison of predicted and predefined mobility-related information (162, 172).

title_en: Black box operations controlled by driver mental state evaluation
abstract_en: The disclosed embodiments are directed to adjusting the operational characteristics of a black box installed in a vehicle. In one embodiment a method is disclosed comprising classifying a mental state of a driver of an automobile, loading at least one setting based on the mental state, the setting defining an operational characteristic of a black box installed in the automobile, configuring the black box using the at least one setting, and recording one or more events by the black box.

title_en: Cluster generation device, cluster generation method, and cluster generation program
abstract_en: A cluster generation apparatus includes: a user information acquisition unit that acquires position information and time information for a plurality of users; a cluster generation unit that generates a cluster based on spots visited by the users by using the position information for the users, the cluster being a classification of the users; and a route generation unit that generates, for each cluster generated by the cluster generation unit, a movement route based on a history of movement of the cluster between the spots, from the time information and the position information for the users belonging to the cluster.

title_en: Systems and methods for generating and/or using 3-dimensional information with camera arrays
abstract_en: The present disclosure is directed to devices, systems and/or methods that may be used for determining scene information from a real-life scene using data obtained at least in part from a camera array. Exemplary systems may be configured to generate three-dimensional information in real-time or substantially real time and may be used to estimate velocity of one or more physical surfaces in a real-life scene.

title_en: Vehicle recording device, vehicle recording control method, and program
abstract_en: An on-vehicle recording apparatus (10) includes a captured image data acquiring unit (120) that acquires captured image data (300) of surroundings of a vehicle; an event detecting unit (125) that detects an event occurred with respect to the vehicle; a recording control unit (123) that stores the captured image data (300) as normal recording data (310) that is not based on the event and as event recording data (320) that is based on the event; a communication control unit (126) that establishes a connection with a communication terminal (400); and an access control unit (127) that, when the communication terminal (400) in which the connection has been established is a registered terminal (410), allows the registered terminal (410) to access the normal recording data (310) and the event recording data (320), and that, when the communication terminal (400) in which the connection has been established is an unregistered terminal (420), does not allow the unregistered terminal (420) to access the normal recording data (310) and allows the unregistered terminal (420) to access the event recording data (320).

title_en: Device for filling a medicine-unit container for use in a medicine unit dispensing device, medicineunit container, assembly of such device and a container and method for cleaning such device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a device for filling a medicine-unit container for use in a medicine unit dispensing device, comprising a support for the container, adapted to fix the position of the container relative to the device and limit a movement of the container relative to the device and at least one movable push element, such as a rod or pin, operable relative to the support, for pushing an unlocking element of a container supported by the device.

title_en: Robot teaching system
abstract_en: A robot teaching system includes: a photographing unit that photographs an image including a welding target and a marker installed on an industrial robot; a camera coordinate system setting unit that sets a camera coordinate system on a basis of the marker included in the image; an operation path setting unit that sets an operation path of the industrial robot on a basis of a welding position of the welding target included in the image in the camera coordinate system; and a program generation unit that generates a working program, while converting the set operation path from the camera coordinate system into a robot coordinate system set in a robot control apparatus on a basis of a position of the marker installed on the industrial robot. The robot teaching system generates a working program allowing appropriate welding at a welding position.

title_en: Voltage source and method for calibrating this voltage source
abstract_en: The invention relates to an electrical voltage source (1) comprising - an integrated circuit (2) comprising two input terminals configured to receive an electrical control signal, two output terminals configured to deliver an output voltage (Vs), at least one Josephson junction which is coupled to the input terminals and to the output terminals such that the value of the output voltage (Vs) depends on the frequency of the electrical control signal (6), - a cryogenic module (3), - a microwave generator (4) configured to deliver the electrical control signal (6). The source of electrical voltage (1) comprises an adjustment module (5) configured to adjust the amplitude of the electrical control signal (6) as a function of its frequency according to a predetermined rule. The invention further relates to a method for calibrating such a source.

title_en: Method and device for machine monitoring, and computer program product for machine monitoring
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a device for machine monitoring and to a computer program product for machine monitoring. According to the invention, the image data captured with the aid of at least one camera and any additionally collected measurement data are time-limited using the image data captured with the aid of a trigger camera and evaluated for the presence of a trigger event such that only the relevant time range of the image data and, if applicable, measurement data has to be stored and analysed. This saves both time and hardware resources. In further advantageous embodiments of the invention, time synchronisation of different (image) data sources, a colour filter function, and/or a master-frame comparison for recognising faults are implemented.

title_en: Augmented reality therapeutic movement display and gesture analyzer
abstract_en: Systems and methods for displaying augmented reality clinical movements may use an augmented reality device to display aspects of a clinical movement. The systems and methods may use a motion capture device to capture the clinical movement. A method may include analyzing information about the clinical movement to determine a path of motion representative of at least a portion of the clinical movement. The method may automatically define a path region or a virtual target in an augmented reality environment overlaid on a real environment. The method may display the path region or the virtual target on an augmented reality display.

title_en: Predictive weed map and material application machine control
abstract_en: A predictive map is obtained by an agricultural material application system. The predictive map maps predictive weed values at different geographic locations in a field. A geographic position sensor detects a geographic location of an agricultural material application machine at the field. A material application controller generates a control signal to control a material application actuator of the mobile agricultural material application machine based on the geographic location of the agricultural material application machine and the predictive map.

title_en: Time series signal trigger condition determination method, method for diagnosing abnormality in monitored facility, and time series signal trigger condition determination device
abstract_en: A trigger condition determination method for a time series signal includes a collection step of collecting one or more monitored signals relating to a monitored facility and a trigger candidate signal that can be a trigger condition, a cut-out step of cutting out a monitored section of the collected monitored signals, a model generation step of generating, by machine learning, a learning model specifying a start time point of the monitored section, generating label data in which a label for the start time point is turned on and a label for any other time point is turned off, and using one or more trigger candidate signals at each time point as an input and using the label data at each time point as an output, and a trigger condition determination step of determining the trigger condition.

title_en: Traffic recording assembly
abstract_en: A traffic recording assembly includes a plurality of recording units that is each positionable on an emergency vehicle. Each of the recording units can be directed toward oncoming traffic when the emergency vehicle is positioned on the side of a roadway to respond to an emergency. Each of the recording units has video recording capabilities to identify vehicles that are not following traffic laws as they pass the emergency vehicle. Additionally, each of the recording units emits electromagnetic energy to detect the speed of the oncoming traffic. A base unit is positioned within the emergency vehicle to store the video and to store the speed of the oncoming traffic for subsequent prosecution.

title_en: Water nozzle sprayer with customized system thereof
abstract_en: A water nozzle sprayer with customized system thereof may include a sprayer and a plurality of different spray heads, and the sprayer is adapted to have different number of spray heads to adjustably perform different patterns. The manufacturing of the water nozzle sprayer is processed through a client interface and a manufacturer interface cooperating with an automated machine. Each of the spray heads has a main body, and an identification portion is formed thereon to indicate the color of the main body.

title_en: Multifunction vending machine control apparatus and system for dispensing food and vending machine comprising said apparatus
abstract_en: The invention describes a vending machine control apparatus (100) comprising a VMC controller card (10); a payment system card (30), connected to said controller card (10); a storage module (30_1) of accounting data (D_CONT) associated with said payment system card (30); a gateway card (20) comprising a processing unit (210) configured to read data (D_bus1;D_bus2;D_bus3) in transit on one or more serial buses (bus_1, bus_2,bus_3) and display and/or store said data (D_bus1;D_bus2;D_bus3) on said vending machine; wherein said control apparatus (100) is characterized in that said processing unit (210) is further configured to: process said data (D_bus1;D_bus2;D_bus3) in transit on one or more of said serial buses (bus_1, bus_2,bus_3); transmit to the outside said control apparatus (100) said read and/or processed data (D_bus1;D_bus2;D_bus3); and said gateway card (20) further comprises: a geolocation module (GEO) arranged to geolocate said control apparatus (100) and said processing unit (210) is configured to store geolocation data (D_GEO); transmit accounting data (D_CONT) referring to said geolocated control apparatus (100) by means of said geolocation data (D_GEO).

title_en: A centralized model predictive lighting control method and a centralized prediction-based controllable street lighting system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a centralized model predictive lighting control method for one or more streetlamps and a system thereof, particularly to creating a lighting, which dynamically adjusts a light intensity thus improving a comfort level of visibility for vehicles, pedestrians, cyclist, etc., in variable weather conditions, while minimizing an energy consumption of a system simultaneously. The method predicts the light intensity at a predetermined set of points of interest  p  in a space over a prediction horizon  N  with a time resolution of  T s    and adjusts the light intensity of the streetlights according a predetermined streetlight dimming scenario and by implementing a Model Predictive Control (MPC) algorithm configured to control light intensities of one or more streetlamps. The MPC algorithm performs minimizing an objective function over the prediction horizon  N  with the time resolution of  T s   , the objective function comprising calculating light intensity, light pollution, and deviation from the desired lighting at the predetermined set of points of interest  p  considering calculated constraints.

title_en: Sensing system
abstract_en: A sensing system for monitoring a state of excessive heat in one or more components of an electrical system is disclosed. The system comprises at least one detection unit mounted with respect to a component and in thermal contact with the component to be monitored; and at least one repeater unit remotely located with respect to each detection unit. The repeater unit receives a signal from at least one of the detection units representative of a state of excessive heat present at the associated component and the detection unit comprises a passive temperature operated contact closure that is triggered when any heat generated at the component to be monitored exceeds a predetermined temperature and a transmitter mounted within the detection unit to transmit the signal to the repeater unit where said repeater unit may provide a widespread alarm to alert of an excessive heat condition.

title_en: Smart object controller allocation in industrial design environment
abstract_en: An industrial integrated development environment (IDE) supports decoupled development of industrial control programs without requiring the programs to be initially bound to a specific industrial controller. The IDE system allows industrial control programs to be defined as smart objects within an industrial control project. These smart objects can be created without an initial binding to an industrial controller, and can subsequently be assigned to selected industrial controllers after development of the control programs is complete, or while program development is in progress. A smart object can be reused and deployed to multiple industrial controllers, providing a simple means to implement common control functionality on multiple different automation systems. To allow for deployment of smart objects to selected controllers, the IDE system supports creation of a control project having a one-to-many relationship with industrial controllers, such that multiple controllers can be defined within a single project.

title_en: Self-service pickup device, self-service pickup method, and control device
abstract_en: Provided in the present disclosure are a self-service pickup device, a self-service pickup method, and a control device for self-service pickup, which relate to the field of logistics. The self-service pickup device comprises : an annular conveyor, self-service pickup ports for receiving package extraction verification instructions and extracting packages, and a first conveyor, which is in butt joint with the annular conveyor and used for conveying the packages between the annular conveyor and a temporary storage warehouse of the packages, wherein steerable rotating wheel apparatuses are provided on the annular conveyor, and one rotating wheel apparatus is arranged at the junction of the annular conveyor and each self-service pickup port. The self-service pickup device can be used in cooperation with the temporary storage warehouse, which has a larger storage space, of the packages, so as to provide a self-service pickup service for more packages, thereby greatly improving the self-service pickup service capacity.

title_en: Automated frozen goods dispenser
abstract_en: Apparatuses, systems, and methods are presented herein for dispensing a frozen food item from storage. A food dispensing apparatus comprises a food storage cabinet, a plurality of storage bins within the cabinet, and a plurality of actuators corresponds to the plurality of storage bins. The food storage cabinet is configured to maintain a plurality of consumable items at a storage temperature. The plurality of storage bins are each configured to hold one of the consumable items. The plurality of actuators are each configured to move the consumable item out of the storage bin to a dispensing area.

title_en: Remote activation or deactivation of a device for theft deterrence
abstract_en: In some aspects, a server device may obtain information relating to a location of a device that is to be delivered to a physical location associated with a recipient. The server device may transmit, based at least in part on the information indicating that the location of the device is at the physical location of the recipient, a first communication prompting the recipient to indicate whether the recipient is in possession of the device. The server device may receive a second communication indicating whether the recipient is in possession of the device. The server device may transmit a signal to cause a change of an activation state of one or more operations of the device based at least in part on whether the second communication indicates that the recipient is in possession of the device. Numerous other aspects are described.

title_en: Doorbell device with current determination and configuration feature
abstract_en: In one aspect, an example method includes drawing a current through a doorbell circuit. While drawing the current through the doorbell circuit, the example method includes determining, by the doorbell device, a maximum doorbell circuit current that will not activate a doorbell chime. Based on determining the maximum doorbell circuit, the example method includes configuring a doorbell device to draw the determined maximum doorbell circuit current through the doorbell circuit. Determining the maximum doorbell circuit current that will not activate the doorbell chime further includes: (i) determining whether the current being drawn through the doorbell circuit has activated the doorbell chime, (ii) if the current being drawn through the doorbell circuit has activated the doorbell chime, decrementing the current drawn through the doorbell circuit, and (iii) if the current being drawn through the doorbell circuit has not activated the doorbell chime, incrementing the current drawn through the doorbell circuit.

title_en: Methods, systems and apparatus to dynamically facilitate boundaryless, high availability system management
abstract_en: A system (100, 200) for dynamically load-balancing the execution of applications and corresponding work items as redistribution elements across a group of control system components/computing resources comprises control system components/computing resources for the execution of applications and corresponding work items of an industrial execution process in a plant, and a control module (115,215) configured to determine available ones of said control system components/computing resources, monitor the operational state data and availability metrics associated with said control system components/computing resources, identify a load-balancing opportunity of at least one of said redistribution elements to a proposed redistribution target, determine for the redistribution of said redistribution elements a target redistribution pool of one or more control system components/computing resources, and redistribute the at least one redistribution element to at least one of said target redistribution components/computing resources.

title_en: Vehicle trajectory recording system and method for vehicles with a sensor
abstract_en: A vehicle trajectory recording system and method for vehicles with a sensor is disclosed. The system includes a sensor arranged on a vehicle; a control module, electrically connected to the sensor and configured to receive a piece of sensing information from the sensor, analyze the sensing information to determine a traveling direction change event of the vehicle, and analyze the traveling direction change event and determine a driving event of the vehicle; and a recording module, electrically connected to the control module and configured to record a position of the vehicle where the vehicle performed the driving event, mark the position of the vehicle on a map where the driving event occurred, and adjust a driving trajectory of the vehicle.

title_en: Generative artificial intelligence for creation of instruction code from an input
abstract_en: Various systems and methods are presented regarding generating executable computer code/instructions from input files, whereby the input files may be an image file (e.g., JPEG, PDF, etc.). The image file can be digital capture of a sequence of instructions such as a graphical representation comprising a ladder diagram, a function block diagram, a sequential function chart, etc. P&ID and suchlike can also be submitted to the system. Code generated from the input files can be enhanced by application of historical data comprising pertinent subroutines, and suchlike. Further, an entity can be prompted to provide further information in the event of the input file does not provide all of the content.

title_en: Management support system for building or civil engineering structure
abstract_en:
Provided is a management assistance system capable of saving man-hour and improving safety in construction or civil engineering works by the worker. The system contains a database that stores attribute information for BIM or CIM; a plurality of target markers attached to specific structures; 
a mobile robot structured to patrol a yard of the building or the civil engineering structure, and to scan the periphery with a scanner, thereby acquiring three-dimensional point cloud data; and a computer apparatus structured to recognize position and posture of the specific structures having the target markers detected by analyzing the point cloud data, and, if the identification information of the target markers acquired by the computer apparatus is corresponded to an existing object stored in the database, the information regarding the existing object is updated with reference to the position and the posture of the specific structure recognized by the computer apparatus.

title_en: Power conversion device
abstract_en: A power converting device (10) includes a diode (20) configured to prevent backflow to a power generating device (2), and a converter (40) configured to convert power generated by the power generating device (2) into power suitable for a load (3). The power converting device (10) includes a capacitor (30) connected to a wiring line connecting the diode (20) and the converter (40). The converter (40) is configured to change a capacitor voltage (Vc) of the capacitor (30) with maximum power point control (MPPT control), and is configured to receive power at an operating point of the power generating device (2) determined by the capacitor voltage (Vc).

title_en: Digital twin calibration
abstract_en: Systems or techniques are provided for facilitating improved digital twin calibration for scientific instruments. In various embodiments, a system can synchronize, via execution of a state-wide Bayesian filter, a parametric state of a digital twin with a physical state of a scientific instrument. In various instances, the state-wide Bayesian filter can comprise a set of calibration iterations, each of which can comprise a Bayesian update to an entirety of the parametric state based on an iteration-common observable that is exhibitable by the scientific instrument and simulatable by the digital twin. In various cases, the scientific instrument can be a charged-particle microscope, the parametric state of the digital twin can be an aberration coefficient vector of the charged-particle microscope, and the iteration-common observable can be a Fourier transform of a convergent beam electron diffraction pattern of an amorphous carbon specimen captured by the charged-particle microscope.

title_en: Safety device and method for detecting an emergency situation of a person
abstract_en: The aim of the invention is to better prevent false activations in a safety device which detects an emergency situation of a person wearing the safety device via the movement state. This is achieved in that the acceleration (B) of the person (2) wearing the safety device (1) is detected by means of an acceleration sensor (4) on the safety device (1), and the detected acceleration (B) is analyzed by an analysis unit (5) in order to detect an emergency situation of the person (2) from the acceleration (B) time curve produced from the detected acceleration (B). In the event of a detected emergency situation, a safety action is initiated by the analysis unit (5), wherein the analysis unit (5) initiates the safety action for the produced acceleration (B) time curve after a period of time (TD), said period of time (TD) being set on the basis of the detected acceleration (B).

title_en: Motion system to simulate dynamic physiology
abstract_en: A simulation system (10) is provided that includes a displaceable artificial anatomy (20); a fixed base (22); and one or more base connectors (24), which couple the fixed base (22) to the artificial anatomy (20) at one or more respective base-attachment areas (34) of the artificial anatomy (20). One or more actuators (26) are connected to the artificial 5 anatomy (20) at respective actuator-connection locations (28) of the artificial anatomy (20), connect the artificial anatomy (20) to the fixed base (22), and are configured, upon actuation, to generate motion in the artificial anatomy (20). Other embodiments are also described.

title_en: Single-photon detector cooling control method and system adaptive to temperature and tec performance change
abstract_en: Disclosed in the present invention is a single-photon detector cooling control method and system adaptive to temperature and TEC performance changes. The method limits the maximum working voltage of a TEC, monitors in real time a working voltage and a cooling temperature of the TEC, and automatically adjusts a target temperature and an APD working bias voltage according to a monitoring result, so as to effectively guarantee that the single-photon detector can still work stably when the working environment temperature is too high or the TEC performance is degraded. Meanwhile, when the environment temperature recovers to a normal temperature range, the present invention allows a cooling target temperature of the TEC to be recovered to an initial cooling target temperature, and synchronously adjusts the APD working bias voltage, so that the performance indexes of the single-photon detector, such as the detection efficiency, the dark count rate, the afterpulse probability, are synchronously recovered to a normal state, thus effectively prolonging the service life of TECs and single-photon detector devices, and improving the environmental adaptability of single-photon detectors.

title_en: Telematically providing replacement indications for operational vehicle components
abstract_en: Apparatus, device, methods and system relating to a vehicular telemetry environment for monitoring vehicle components and providing indications towards the condition of the vehicle components and providing optimal indications towards replacement or maintenance of vehicle components before vehicle component failure.

title_en: Novel systems and methods for effective infrastructure management
abstract_en: Novel systems and methods for infrastructure management are described herein. Exemplar novel systems and methods include using a network of sensors for measuring fluid condition attribute at constraint locations inside infrastructure, a fluid flow controller for calculating stress at the constraint locations and a flow-redistributing component for redistributing fluid flow through one or more routes inside infrastructure to relieve stress at the constraint locations. Novel systems and methods for implementing infrastructure management strategies are also described herein. They include structural components to carry out features like obtaining data and/or estimated values, calculating and/or estimating stress values, developing flow redistributing strategies for relieving stress in infrastructure, and implementing these strategies to relieve stress. Novel systems and methods to adapt flow control to the changing storm conditions are also described herein. These systems and methods adjust flow redistributing strategies, in real time, in response to the changing storm severity.

title_en: Personal thermal comfort device based on Peltier effect, and thermal management method
abstract_en: A personal thermal comfort device based on a Peltier effect, and a thermal management method. The device comprises a thermoelectric module, a heat dissipation fan, an external packaging module, a micro-blower, and a micro-hose network; heat dissipation plates are attached to the warm and cold sides of the thermoelectric module, respectively; the thermoelectric module and the heat dissipation fan form an integrated structure by means of the external packaging module provided with a channel; one end of the integrated structure is connected to the micro-blower, and the other end of the integrated structure is connected to the micro-hose network; the micro-blower provides a cold or warm airflow and the micro-hose network guides same to a special garment, so as to provide a required heat source or cold source for the whole human body. The specific thermoelectric module, heat dissipation fan and heat dissipation plates are selected and combined into a detachable, portable thermoelectric conversion device, the micro-blower is selected to send cold energy or heat energy to the special garment, the air supply temperature is set according to a thermal comfort requirement of the human body, the voltage of the thermoelectric conversion device is adjusted by means of a single-neuron PID controller, and the thermal comfort of the human body in a local microenvironment of a building is improved. The whole device has the advantages of portability, excellent energy efficiency and controllable temperature. In combination with a central heating, ventilation, and air conditioning system of a building, a local thermal environment can be established, the personal thermal comfort is improved, and the overall energy consumption of the building is reduced.

title_en: Environmentally dependent physically unclonable function device
abstract_en: A physically unclonable function (PUF) device comprising a plurality of conductors 2, at least some of which are arranged so that they interact electrically and/or magnetically with one another. A media 3 surrounds at least of portion of each of the conductors and further defines at least one cavity 10, where the cavity is structured to provide the device with an environmentally dependent characteristic. Circuitry 1 applies an electrical challenge signal to at least one of the conductors and receives an electrical output 5 from at least one of the other conductors to generate an identifying response to the challenge signal that is unique to the device. The device further comprises a temperature variation means such that the circuitry generates an identifying response which varies with the temperature of the device. The cavity may be an impermeable enclosure and the environmentally dependent characteristic may be permittivity and/or permeability. Alternatively the characteristic may be at least one of pressure, temperature, humidity, magnetic field, electric field, light/radiation levels or type of fluid in the environment surrounding the device. The temperature varying means may be provided by heating wires.

title_en: An intelligent system and method for communicating with a motor vehicle
abstract_en: A method of remotely activating or deactivating a vehicle function (e.g. opening a door), including defining a reachability model 16 for the vehicle 12 and a computer (e.g. server, cloud, backend 20) external to the vehicle 12; receiving a user request 22 for enabling or disabling the vehicle function; determining an availability of the vehicle 12 to communicate with the computer 20 based on the reachability model 16; and if the vehicle is available for communication, transmitting one or more activation or deactivation signals 48 to the vehicle 12 for enabling or disabling the vehicle function. User request 22 may be from a mobile device 28. The signal 48 may be transmitted only if the vehicle is reachable according to the reachability model 16. The availability state may be predicted based on vehicle events of the vehicle 12. Second aspect: method of defining a reachability model 16 for an availability state of vehicle 12 to communicate with the computer 20, by collating and analysing vehicle events from multiple vehicles (36, fig 2).

title_en: A method for predicting a presence of a moving object in the surroundings of a motor vehicle by an assistance system, a corresponding computer program product
abstract_en: An assistance system 12 of a motor vehicle 10 predicts a presence of a moving object 20 which is outside its line of sight 22 in its surroundings 28. A capturing device 16 captures an illumination 30, and/or a sound 32, which is assigned to the moving object. An electronic computing device 14 of the assistance system assigns the captured illumination and/or sound to the moving object - e.g. using learning or classical algorithms - and predicts the presence of the moving object in dependence thereon. In response, a visual or acoustic warning signal may be output to a driver of vehicle 10. Alternatively, vehicle 10 may be automated and may adapt a driving mode depending on the predicted presence. The moving object may be another vehicle. The captured illumination may be from a head lamp of the moving object. The captured sound may be of a honking horn, rotating tyre or engine noise of the moving object.

title_en: Periphery monitoring device for vehicle
abstract_en: To provide a periphery monitoring device for a vehicle which can support safety when getting off the vehicle by utilizing an imaging part mounted on the vehicle.SOLUTION: A periphery monitoring device 20 for a vehicle is mounted on a vehicle which comprises a first camera 5 imaging a rear direction and a rearward side direction of the vehicle. The monitoring device 20 includes: a distance detection part 21b1 which detects a distance up to an object on the basis of a picked-up image output from the first camera 5; a course prediction part 21b2 which predicts a track of the object on the basis of transition of the distance up to the object; and an approach prediction part 21b3 which predicts whether or not the object approaches to a door opening/closing region regulating a movable range, in which side doors 2, 3 of the vehicle open/close, on the basis of the track of the predicted object.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Management method of machine tool, machine tool and information processing apparatus
abstract_en: To manage a machine tool according to a payment state of a user.SOLUTION: A management method of a machine tool that operates by entering authentication information includes a reception process that receives first information including identification information and operation information of a machine tool transmitted from a communication terminal of a user, an acquisition process that acquires second information on payment state of a fee by the user regarding the machine tool from a payment state database based on the first information, and a transmission process that determines whether or not to transmit the authentication information to the user based on the second information and transmits the authentication information to the communication terminal of the user when determining that the authentication information is to be transmitted to the user.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Checkout system, settlement device, and control program for the same
abstract_en: To provide a checkout system, a settlement device, and a control program that can prevent confusions of shoppers in starting settlement processing.SOLUTION: The checkout system includes: a commodity registration device; a settlement device; generation means in the commodity registration device; settlement means in the settlement device; and settlement control means in one of the commodity registration device and the settlement device. The generation means generates settlement information for a settlement of a purchased commodity in one transaction. The settlement means performs settlement processing for a settlement based on the settlement information. The settlement control means does not allow the settlement means to start settlement processing for another transaction before a predetermined waiting time has passed since the settlement processing has completed the settlement processing.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title_en: Abnormality detector and information processing method and program
abstract_en: To provide an abnormality detector, an information processing method, and a program that can improve the abnormality detection performance and eliminate the user's anxiety about the abnormality detection performance.SOLUTION: A detector comprises a generator that generates an abnormality candidate signal, which is a candidate for being judged as abnormal, using abnormality judgment parameters for judging abnormality of a detection signal detected from an abnormality detection target, a presentation part that presents the abnormality candidate signal generated by the generator, a first acquisition part that acquires abnormality degree information that defines the abnormality degree for the abnormality candidate signal, and an update part that calculates and updates new abnormality judgment parameters based on the abnormality candidate signal generated by the generator and the abnormality degree information acquired by the first acquisition part.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Fpga for arithmetic processing for robot control and method of determining data path width of fpga for arithmetic processing
abstract_en: To provide an FPGA for arithmetic processing for robot control that can reduce an arithmetic processing load of a CPU and perform real-time arithmetic for collision determination processing.SOLUTION: When a request for processing for collision determination between an arm of a robot and an obstacle is input from a CPU, an FPGA reads out data of each of models representing a shape, etc. of at least a part of the arm and a shape, etc. of at least a part of the obstacle from a RAM storing the data of both models, and performs the collision determination on both models. When the determination result is output to the CPU, a logic is configured so as to constitute a pipeline for performing parallel processing on at least a part of arithmetic related to the collision determination. If a required minimum bit width of a data bus is defined as DBW0, the bit width DBW0 is determined from an expression (6) and a bit width DBW1 of a data bus connected to a RAM 4 is set to be equal to or more than the bit width DBW0.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4A

title_en: Vehicle control information processing system, vehicle control information processing device, vehicle control information processing method, and program
abstract_en: To make it easy for a pedestrian to evaluate a recognition of a vehicle.SOLUTION: A vehicle control information processing system is configured by comprising: a detection unit that detects a person and a person's face from a captured image obtained by imaging a surrounding of a vehicle; and a recognition level calculation unit that calculates a recognition level indicating a degree of tendency for the person to recognize the vehicle based on a relationship between the number of person detected by the detection unit and the number of person's face.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Transaction device
abstract_en: To provide a technique to reduce the workload of settling credit card transactions.SOLUTION: A transaction device includes: a reader that reads card information stored in a storage unit of a credit card; a camera that captures a captured image including specific information on the credit card while the card information is being read by the reader; and a transaction processing execution unit that executes transaction processing using the read card information and the specific information acquired from the captured image.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Control system of drone, control method of drone, and drone
abstract_en: To appropriately control flight method of a drone corresponding to a flight purpose.SOLUTION: A control system 1000 of a drone comprises two or more of: a growth information acquisition part 1003 which acquires growth information of crop growing in a farm field; a pathological information acquisition part 1004 which acquires pathological information of the crop; and a scattering control part 1002 which scatters material to be scattered on the farm field, and also comprises a flight control part 1001 which controls the drone 100 for at least any one of flight altitude, flight speed, and a flight path on a plane surface corresponding to any one or more of flight purposes which are growth diagnosis based on the growth information, pathological diagnosis based on the pathological information, and scattering of the material to be scattered, and allows the drone to fly above the farm field.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 8

title_en: Traffic scheme control method and device
abstract_en: To provide a traffic scheme control method and a device in an intelligent traffic technique.SOLUTION: A method includes the steps of: obtaining a green signal waste time of each traffic lane in each flow at an intersection within a blue signal passing time; acquiring a class saturation level of each traffic lane and acquiring a class saturation level of each flow on the basis of the class saturation level of the traffic lane; acquiring a class saturation level of a control scheme at the present moment together with the class saturation level of a flow in each stage in the control scheme at the present moment; calculating a class saturation level of each candidate control scheme; and determining a target control scheme corresponding to a minimum class saturation level on the basis of the class saturation level of each candidate control scheme, comparing the class saturation level of the control scheme at the present moment with the minimum class saturation degree, and controlling a signal control machine when the class saturation level of the control scheme at the present moment is larger than the minimum class saturation level to control a next passing period at the intersection on the basis of the target control scheme.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Motor controller, and automatic adjustment method thereof
abstract_en: To provide a device which stably performs automatic adjustment of control means for suppressing resonance characteristics of a machine with high reliability.SOLUTION: A motor controller comprises: a notch filter part; an encoding part which uses an internal state amount as an input; a limiter part which uses an output of the notch filter part as input; an adaptive update part which uses an output of the limiter part as an input; and a unit conversion part which uses an output of the adaptive update part as an input, on the basis of a frequency of a vibration component to be superposed on a response of a motor control system. The encoding part extracts only information of a code of the internal state amount, and outputs it. The limiter part calculates information with restricted amplitude of the output of the notch filter part, and outputs it. The adaptive update part successively updates an estimation value of a notch frequency on the basis of a value obtained by multiplying the output of the encoding part by the output of the limiter part, and outputs it. The notch filter part adopts the estimation value as the notch frequency. The unit conversion part converts a unit of the estimation value into Hertz to output it as the estimation value, and adaptively adjusts a controller by using the estimation value.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Ride shared travel support system
abstract_en: To provide a ride shared travel support system facilitating travel by ride sharing of a vehicle with a flexible mode.SOLUTION: A ride shared travel support system is constituted by a user device 1, a ride sharing server 2, and the Internet 3. The ride sharing server 2 transmits, to a first user device in a vehicle, current position information or the like of a second user device used by a pedestrian where the current position of the second user device is along a route being set to the first user device. The first user device displays the received information, and when the user accepts the ride sharing, the first user device transmits information on the current position or the like of the first user device to the second user device via the ride sharing server 2. The second user device displays the received information, and when the user accepts the ride sharing, the current position of the second user device is transmitted to the first user device via the ride sharing server 2. Then the current position of the second user device is displayed on a map in the first user device.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Disaster prevention interlock system
abstract_en: To make it possible to effectively utilize system interlocking for unlocking an entrance door interlocking with fire detection by reducing unlocking of an automatic lock system of the entrance door interlocked with a non-fire report of an alarm system for monitoring a fire in a house and the like.SOLUTION: An alarm system comprises a plurality of residential alarm devices 10-1 to 10-4 in a house 12. When a fire is detected by the residential alarm device 10-1, a fire alarm is output and a fire interlock signal is transmitted to other alarm devices 10-2 to 10-4 to cause them output the fire alarm. When a predetermined password number is input from a ten key operating device 20 to a locking control device 18 and matching with the registered password number in advance is determined, an automatic lock system unlocks an electric lock 16 provided in an entrance door 14. When receiving the fire interlock signals from at least two of the residential alarm devices 10-1 to 10-4, an interlock adapter 24 transmits an unlock control signal to the locking control device 18 to cause it to unlock the electric lock 16.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Map data storage device, control method, program, and storage medium
abstract_en: To provide a map data storage device capable of suitably updating map data without generating deviation in an update frequency based on a traffic volume at a point where a change point is detected.SOLUTION: A server device 2 acquires: change point candidate data generated by comparing peripheral information based on an output of a sensor part 17 with a partial map DB12; and traffic volume information at an acquisition point of the change point candidate data. The server device 2 then sets a weight W for each of the acquired change point candidate data on the basis of the traffic volume information, and updates a distribution map DB21 on the basis of the change point candidate data for which the weight W has been set.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Accommodation area management apparatus
abstract_en: To provide an accommodation area management apparatus configured to collect appropriate usage fees and smoothly manage an accommodation area.SOLUTION: A parking lot management apparatus 400 which manages a parking lot PA for accommodating a vehicle M includes: an acquisition unit 422 which acquires desired environment information including a desired environment for a parking position of the vehicle M via a communication unit 410 when the vehicle M enters the parking lot PA; a parking position determination unit 424 which determines a parking position of the vehicle M on the basis of the desired environment information; and a usage fee determination unit 426 which determines a fee for using the parking lot PA on the basis of at least one of the desired environment information and the determined parking position.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Map display system and map display program
abstract_en: To provide a technique by which a user can easily get to know information related to a tunnel section.SOLUTION: The map display system includes: a section altitude acquisition unit for acquiring the altitude of a tunnel section as a section in a tunnel; a map display unit for displaying a map that includes the tunnel section in a position according to the altitude of the tunnel section; and an object display unit for displaying an object related to the tunnel section, in a position of the map at the altitude of the tunnel section.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Boarding support control device, boarding support system, boarding support control method, and program
abstract_en: To support comfortable riding of a passenger who needs a seat.SOLUTION: A boarding support control device 100 comprises: a video data acquisition part 120 which acquires first video data captured by a first camera 210 which captures an image the inside of a vehicle of public transportation, and second video data captured by a second camera 220 which captures an image an area surrounding a stop; an occupancy rate recognition part 131 which recognizes a seat occupancy rate, etc. in the vehicle from the first video data; a passenger recognition part 132 which recognizes passengers who are waiting for the public transportation at the stop from the second video data; a determination part 133 which determines the presence/absence of a priority passenger who needs a seat or the like among the recognized passengers; and an output control part 135 which outputs information which notifies the passengers in the vehicle of the fact that the priority passenger is going to get on the vehicle when the determination part 133 determines the presence of the priority passenger and the occupancy rate recognition part 131 recognizes that the occupancy rate of the vehicle approaching the stop is a threshold or higher.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Pressure reduction valve
abstract_en: To provide a pressure reduction valve capable of preventing generation of a turbulent flow on a more downstream side than a valve body.SOLUTION: A pressure reduction valve includes: an actuator 13 for activating a pressure force; a main body 12; a supply air port 19 (a partition wall) partitioning a fluid channel 16 into a primary in-flow passage 17 and a secondary out-flow passage 18; a valve seat 22 provided around a valve opening part 21; and a valve body 25 for opening and closing the valve opening part 21, and further includes: a diaphragm 31 stretched, being sandwiched between the actuator 13 and the main body 12; a pressure chamber 34 making a pressure of the secondary out-flow passage 18 work on the diaphragm 31; and a spring member 26 for biasing the valve body 25 in a valve closing direction. The main body 12 is provided with a suction tube 35 (a suction passage) and a thin plate-like separator 41 for dividing the inside of the secondary out-flow passage 18 into a first passage which the suction tube 35 opens and a second passage on the opposite side.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Method, apparatus, device and storage medium for determining lane occupied by vehicle
abstract_en: To provide a method, apparatus, device, and storage medium for determining a lane occupied by a vehicle to reduce the cost of determining the lane occupied by the vehicle.SOLUTION: A method provided herein comprises: determining image lane information of a position of a vehicle from a lane line image; acquiring actual lane information of the position of the vehicle from existing lane information according to positioning information of the vehicle; and determining an actual lane occupied by the vehicle based on the image lane information and the actual lane information.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Information processing apparatus, system, control method, and program
abstract_en: To provide an information processing apparatus, a system, a control method, and a program that can automatically change, if a user displays a wrong code, the code to a correct code.SOLUTION: A display part 101 displays, as a display code, one of a first code for accepting the provision of a first service and a second code for accepting the provision of a second service on a screen. A detection part 102 detects denial information output by a reader device related to the provision of a service or a server device connected to the reader device when the display code is read by the reader device. A switching part 103 changes, once the denial information is detected, the display code to the other of the first code and the second code which is not the display code.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Supply device
abstract_en: To provide a supply device capable of supplying rotary bodies in a state where they are separated one by one in a fixed attitude.SOLUTION: A supply device 10 comprises: a container 41 which stores a component 20 whose diameter D exceeds a thickness T, and is inclined and rotated with a bottom plate 44 facing down; and a plate 50 which is arranged in the container 41 while a distance S from the bottom plate 44 is made as T<S<D and S<2T, and forms a space 41d having a supply port 48 of the component 20 in which an opening length L is made as D<L<2D, between itself and the bottom plate 44, and has a through hole 52 whose minimum width exceeds D.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Automatic dispenser
abstract_en: To favorably guide a commodity having an irregular shape to a commodity storage passage and prevent the occurrence of commodity jamming or the like.SOLUTION: An automatic dispenser includes a top tray 20 that is provided in an aspect gradually inclined downward toward an upper end of a commodity storage path 13 extending along a vertical direction between a pair of right and left base side plates 11, and rolls and guides a commodity input from an input port 18 in a fallen-down posture to the commodity storage path 13. A commodity (S) has an irregular shape in which an outer diameter of a second body portion S3b more spaced from a bottom portion S4 than a first body portion S3a is smaller than an outer diameter of the first body portion S3a close to the bottom portion S4 in a body portion S3. It includes a top guide 30 that is disposed in an aspect gradually more inclined downward and more spaced from an upper surface of the top tray 20 as a guide part 31 comes closer to the upper end of the commodity storage path 13 from the input port 18, and allows the guide part 31 to roll and guide the second body portion S3b.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title_en: Heat sensor
abstract_en: To identify the type of a sensor easily from a distant position and further in any direction without impairing the appearance and while being installed on the ceiling, etc.SOLUTION: In a heat sensor comprising a light transmission member which encloses a heat sensing element and performs an actuation indication, a coating of the same color system as a surface color of a housing is formed over a part of or all a surface of the light transmission member, thereby forming a ring-shaped pattern around the heat sensing element, and the type of the heat sensor is represented by a mode of the formed pattern.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Operation management device, operation management method, operation management system, and vehicle
abstract_en: To provide an operation management device, an operation management method, an operation management system, and a vehicle that can quickly eliminate road obstacles.SOLUTION: An operation management device 10 includes a control unit 11. The control unit 11 outputs information instructing a vehicle 30 operated by automatic operation about an operation schedule and an operation route. When the vehicle 30 is affected by a roadside obstacle on the operation route, the control unit 11 acquires an image of the roadside obstacle from the vehicle 30. The control unit 11 automatically outputs an instruction to a road management system 80 to clear the roadside obstacle based on an image of the roadside obstacle.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Capsule toy vending machine fixing structure
abstract_en: To improve safety by reducing the risk of collapse due to earthquakes, etc., and to improve space efficiency by allowing a large number of capsule toy vending machines to be placed in a limited area, while allowing multiple capsule toy vending machines to be stacked.SOLUTION: A capsule toy vending machine fixing structure includes: a stay member 1; and a first capsule toy vending machine assembly 2-1, a second capsule toy vending machine assembly 2-2, a third capsule toy vending machine assembly 2-3 and a fourth capsule toy vending machine assembly 2-4 arranged around the stay member 1. A left and right connecting members 4 on the backs of the first to third capsule toy vending machine assemblies 2-1 to 2-3 are fixed to the stay member 1 by a stay fixing member, and the fourth capsule toy vending machine assembly 2-4 is movable with casters arranged on the bottom.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Boarding and alighting point suggestion system
abstract_en: To suggest appropriate boarding and alighting points.SOLUTION: A boarding and alighting point suggestion system S includes a control unit 11. The control unit 11 extracts one or more candidate points at which a vehicle 2 stops, and for each of the one or more candidate points, determines at least one of the time from when the vehicle 2 stops until a door of the vehicle 2 opens, the time from when the door closes until the vehicle 2 starts, the number of times the left or right door of the vehicle 2 opens or closes, the parking skill of a driver of the vehicle 2, and the presence or absence of other vehicles currently parked in the surrounding area, and suggests a location where the vehicle 2 can be parked based on the results of the determination.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Valuable medium monitoring system, valuable medium monitoring method, server, and terminal device
abstract_en: To provide a valuable medium monitoring system, a valuable medium monitoring method, a server, and terminal devices, which can simply and efficiently detect a medium ineligible for circulation while suppressing system load.SOLUTION: A valuable medium monitoring system comprises a plurality of terminal devices and a server. Each of the terminal devices includes: extraction means for extracting information on a valuable medium; determination means for determining whether or not the valuable medium is ineligible for circulation on the basis of the extracted information on the valuable medium; and transmission means for transmitting information on the medium ineligible for circulation to the server when it is determined that the valuable medium is ineligible for circulation. The server includes: a storage section for storing information on a plurality of media ineligible for circulation, grouped into a plurality of groups; and transmission means for transmitting information on media ineligible for circulation in a specific group corresponding to the medium ineligible for circulation to another terminal device that satisfies a predetermined condition when the information on the medium ineligible for circulation has been transmitted from the terminal device.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Checkout system, settlement device, and control program therefor
abstract_en:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a system, a device, and a program for allowing a settler to recognize that change is left untaken. 
     SOLUTION: A checkout system 100 includes a checkout device 110 and a receipt server 120. In the checkout device 110, a CPU 21 generates electronic receipt data representing details of a transaction after the completion of settlement processing, transmits the data to the receipt server 120, dispenses change onto a change tray in relation to the settlement processing, and if a coin sensor 30 detects the change on the change tray at a time point when a predetermined time elapses from when the change is dispensed, transmits a message indicating that the change is left untaken to the receipt server 120. In the receipt server 120, an auxiliary storage unit 44 stores the electronic receipt data and the message in association with each other, and a CPU 41 displays the message on a settler's information terminal in association with the electronic receipt data.

title_en: Map generation device
abstract_en: To provide a map generation device which efficiently generates a map of a traffic lane where a vehicle is not traveling.SOLUTION: A map generation device 50 includes: a camera 1a for detecting an external situation around an own vehicle; an outward map generation part 171 which generates an outward map based on the external situation detected by the camera 1a when the own vehicle is traveling on a first traffic lane; and a return map generation part 172 which generates a return map on a second traffic lane opposed to the first traffic lane, by inverting the outward map toward the second traffic lane side.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Scan data creation method and scan data creation system
abstract_en: To enable efficient measurement at a plurality of measurement positions in creating three-dimensional scan data.SOLUTION: A scan data creation method for acquiring three-dimensional scan data for creating a three-dimensional digital model of an object (40), includes a measuring device (30) for measuring an object, in which a plurality of measurement positions (P1 to P12) capable of measuring the object is calculated, and a measurement route that allows the measuring device to reach a plurality of measurement positions with a minimum movement cost is calculated.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Attendance management system and attendance management method
abstract_en: To provide an attendance management system and an attendance management method that allow a manager side to reliably manage users' attendance by grasping the times and positions of the users when they arrive and leave work.SOLUTION: An attendance management system 1 includes an information terminal device 10 and a management device 20. The information terminal device 10 acquires access information for accessing a user-specific website, accesses the website, and upon accepting operation of a work start button or work end button included in the website, acquires positional information on an own device and transmits it to the management device 20. The management device 20 acquires time at which the work start button or work end button was operated, receives the positional information transmitted from the information terminal device 10, associates the user with the time and positional information at the work start, or the time and positional information at the work end, and stores them in a storage unit.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: module system
abstract_en: To provide a module system that prevents a signal that does not require real-time performance from interfering with a signal that requires real-time performance when communication with a higher-level control apparatus is passed through bus transmission paths between a master module and a slave module and between slave modules, an operation method of the module system, and an operation program readable to the module system.SOLUTION: In a module system, when a signal from a higher-level control apparatus is transmitted to a slave module via a master module, an appropriate bus transmission path is discriminated and selected according to contents of the signal, and the signal is transmitted and received in parallel with it.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Portable terminal determination system
abstract_en: To provide a system which determines a portable terminal of a driver.SOLUTION: An automatic driving device 100 includes an automatic driving ECU 10 mounted on a vehicle VA and provided with a first imaging unit (driver monitor camera) for capturing an image of a driver of the vehicle and a portable terminal 110 provided with a second imaging unit (front camera). The automatic driving ECU determines whether the portable terminal is a portable terminal of the driver or not by performing comparison processing of comparing a first image captured by the first imaging unit and a second image captured by the second image unit with each other.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 7

title_en: Conveyance system, conveyance device and conveyance program
abstract_en: To provide a conveyance system, a conveyance device and a conveyance program that enable stable traveling even in a case where a moving body capable of autonomous traveling tows to-be-towed objects of different weights, size, etc.SOLUTION: The conveyance system includes a conveyance device that is capable of being connected to and disconnected from a plurality of types of to-be-towed objects, is configured to travel while towing a to-be-towed object, and has a processor. Based on a type of a to-be-towed object to be connected, the processor selects one travel mode from a plurality of travel modes set in advance and executes traveling control of the conveyance device so that the conveyance device travels while towing the to-be-towed object in the selected travel mode.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Charge settlement system
abstract_en: To provide a charge settlement system for easily and reliably enabling settlement through a code.SOLUTION: A charge settlement system includes a shop side terminal 1 provided on a shop side of paying a plurality of spaces by the hour, a user terminal 2 provided on a user side of renting a space by the hour, a settlement management device 3 connected to the shop side terminal 1 to perform settlement from a use situation of the space, and code reading units 4 for reading a code in the space.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Refrigerant management system
abstract_en:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a refrigerant management system for efficiently providing a rental service of refrigerants. 
     SOLUTION: A refrigerant management system 1 includes a sensor 250 for identifying refrigerants 500, a device 100 determining whether or not to satisfy return conditions based on the refrigerant identification result of the refrigerants and outputting the determination result. 
     SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Processing system, processing device, processing method, and processing program
