abstract_en: To provide a processing system that secures the accuracy of driving control.SOLUTION: A processor of a processing system that conducts processing related to driving control of a host mobile body, is configured to: predict an action transition Ta in which a host action Ah of the host mobile body and a target action At of a target mobile body 3 transition while branching via interaction; and evaluate the host action Ah applied to the host mobile body by driving control on the basis of a risk expectation value Er correlated to a risk level Lr estimated for each branch in the action transition Ta and a probability of occurrence Pr that the branch occurs.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Display control device, and display control method
abstract_en: To provide a display control device capable of providing highly convenient information to a user of a transportation facility.SOLUTION: A display control device includes: a reception unit that acquires third information for users generated on the basis of, first information on congestion of transportation means as transportation facility and second information on congestion at waiting places where users using transportation the facility for waiting for the arrival of the transportation means; and a control unit that controls the display of third information on a display unit while associating the position of the transportation and the waiting place.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 33

title_en: printer
abstract_en: To provide an electronic apparatus capable of reducing the influence of external stress on an USB-Type-C receptacle connector.SOLUTION: A printer comprises: a printing unit that prints on a medium; a sheet metal with an opening formed therein; a support member connected to the sheet metal and having a first surface exposed to an outside through the opening; a first receptacle connector which is supported by the support member and has a first insertion slot exposed from the first surface that can be connected to a plug of a cable; a second receptacle connector which is supported by the support member and has a second insertion slot exposed from the first surface that can be connected to the plug; and a control board for controlling the first and second receptacle connectors. The first insertion slot has a first edge and a second edge. The second insertion slot has a third edge and a fourth edge. The first and third edges extend in the first direction relative to a board surface of the control board.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 23

title_en: Information processing device
abstract_en: To display a use's current place at an appropriate position on a deformed map.SOLUTION: This information processing device comprises: a measurement unit for measuring the position information of a current place; a mapping processing unit for converting the position information of the current place to first map coordinates in a first map for navigation use that includes the current place and converting, using a conversion table, the first map coordinates to second map coordinates in a second map which is a generalized version of the first map; and a display control unit for displaying, on a display, the second map in which marks indicating the current place are arranged at the second map coordinates. In the conversion table are recorded, in association with the first map coordinates in a first coordinate system provided to the first map, the second map coordinates in a second coordinate system provided to the second map, which is of the same scale as the first coordinate system.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Verification method for replacing old sequencer with new sequencer and connection tool
abstract_en: To provide a verification method for replacing an old sequencer with a new sequencer, whereby stable, continuous operation of a plant and reliable verification of the new sequencer can be made compatible, and to provide a connection tool.SOLUTION: A verification method for replacing an old sequencer 21 with a new sequencer 31, according to the present disclosure, includes: a post-transfer operation confirmation step of connecting an apparatus terminal block 43 and a temporary adapter 55 and connecting a temporary terminal block 53 and an old sequencer input/output module 22 to control a plant by means of the old sequencer 21; an installation step of installing the new sequencer 31 on a sequencer board 30; a verification step of connecting the apparatus terminal block 43 and a new sequencer input/output module 32 to verify the new sequencer 31; and a stable control step of removing the apparatus terminal block 43 from the new sequencer input/output module 32 and connecting it with the temporary adapter 55 to control the plant by means of the old sequencer 21.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 10

title_en: Device and system
abstract_en: To provide a mechanism that is able to realize high performance of a mobile body further easily.SOLUTION: A device is mounted on a mobile body and used for controlling the mobile body. The device includes a holding portion and a control unit. The holding portion holds an information processor that controls the mobile body. The control unit acquires control information for controlling the mobile body from the information processor and controls the mobile body, based on the control information.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Information processing device, output method and program
abstract_en: To reduce a load on a communication line with an external device and secure a resource for the external device.SOLUTION: An on-vehicle device 20 as an information processing device comprises a storage 20D and a CPU 20A. When vehicle information from each part of a vehicle 12 is received, the CPU 20A outputs vehicle information for which there is a high demand for acquisition to an external device outside the vehicle 12 regardless of a request from the external device. Also, when the vehicle information from each part of the vehicle 12 is received, the CPU 20A causes the storage 20D to store vehicle information for which there is little need for acquisition, and outputs the vehicle information stored when receiving a request from the external device to the external device.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Working machine, working machine controller and method of controlling working machine
abstract_en: To machine a work-piece without preparing a working program.SOLUTION: A working machine, having a tool for machining a work-piece and a depth camera that is set up such that the work-piece comes within a range of imaging and images a depth of a subject, comprises: a position measuring section that computes a three-dimensional position at a surface of the work-piece based on a depth image the depth camera has taken; a positioning section that computes a three-dimensional position of a target shape in a superposition of the work-piece and the target shape based on three-dimensional data representative of a target shape of the work-piece and the three-dimensional position of the work-piece; a depth-of-cut determining section that determines depths of cut at respective ones of a plurality of points on a surface of the work-piece based on a difference in a sight-line direction between the three-dimensional position at a surface of the work-piece when the work-piece is seen from a predetermined point of view and the three-dimensional position at the surface of the target shape; and a tool control section that allows the tool to move based on a determined depth of cut.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Estimation device, method for estimation, and estimation program
abstract_en: To apply a learned model according to a distribution pattern of time-series data generated in a plant or in an urban space.SOLUTION: A storage unit 14 stores a model generated by learning using time-series data of a specific period of time as teacher data and the distribution of the teacher data in relation to each other. An acquisition unit 15a acquires time-series data of a specific period of time. A calculation unit 15b compares the acquired distribution of the time-series data and the distribution of the teacher data and calculates the similarity. A specification unit 15d specifies a model generated by learning using the teacher data when the calculated similarity is at least a predetermined threshold value.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Information processing device
abstract_en: To allow for distributing mobile-vehicle-related information while protecting privacy.SOLUTION: An information processing device provided herein is configured to: acquire a location of a mobile vehicle visiting multiple destinations; and distribute distribution information including information on a current location of the mobile vehicle to terminal devices associated with the destinations in such a form that detail of the current location of the mobile vehicle cannot be identified.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: On-board device, reverse driving detection system, reverse driving detection method, and program
abstract_en: To provide an on-board device capable of detecting that a vehicle merging from a merging lane to a main line has been driven in a wrong way.SOLUTION: An on-board device includes: a positioning information acquisition unit for acquiring positioning information including a position and a traveling direction of a vehicle; a reverse driving detection information acquisition unit for acquiring reverse driving detection information including information indicating a detection zone where reverse driving is detected and a threshold value of a turning angle of the vehicle in the detection zone; a determination unit for determining whether the vehicle is traveling in the detection zone based on the reverse running detection information and the positioning information; and a detection unit for detecting reverse driving of the vehicle when the angle between the reference direction of travel of the vehicle and the direction of travel of the vehicle indicated by the positioning information acquired while the vehicle is traveling in the detection zone exceeds the threshold value.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Driver evaluation system, driver evaluation method, and program
abstract_en: To provide a technique for urging a driver to arrive at a destination on scheduled time.SOLUTION: A driver evaluation system includes a vehicle and an evaluation device. The evaluation device includes: a scheduled acquisition unit configured to acquire predetermined scheduled time as time at which the vehicle arrives at a predetermined destination; an arrival time acquisition unit configured to acquire arrival time at which the vehicle actually arrives at a predetermined destination; a first evaluation unit configured to derive a first evaluation value based on difference between the scheduled time and the arrival time; a second evaluation unit configured to derive a second evaluation value depending on whether or not the vehicle has waited in a predetermined area as a periphery of the predetermined destination before arriving at the predetermined destination; and a third evaluation unit configured to derive a third evaluation value of a driver of the vehicle based on the first evaluation value and the second evaluation value.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Monitoring system
abstract_en: To provide a monitoring system with which it is possible to prevent a legitimate user from being mistakenly detected as an intruder due to unsuccessful face authentication.SOLUTION: A monitoring system monitors an intrusion into a monitored area, and comprises: a sensor that is installed in the monitored area, for detecting an intrusion; a storage unit that preliminarily stores the registered face images of registrants; an imaging unit that images the face of a user and acquires an input face image; authentication means that verifies the input face image against the registered face images and authenticates the user; estimation means that establishes a first index that indicates the probability of the user being a registrant, and a second index that indicates the acceptability of the imaging environment around the imaging unit; determination means that determines that there is an intrusion into the monitored area, when user authentication is unsuccessful for a prescribed retention time after a detection signal is acquired from the sensor; and execution means that executes a suppress process to suppress determination by the determination means that there is an intrusion, when the first index indicates high probability of being a registrant, or the second index indicates that the imaging environment is not good.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: power supply system
abstract_en: To provide a power supply system capable of suppressing redundancy for achieving prescribed failure-time operation continuity and of utilizing indispensable redundancy to improve performance of a power distribution function such as load distribution on a current path.SOLUTION: A power supply system comprises a plurality of power sources for supplying power to a single load in a vehicle, a plurality of power supply paths for connecting between the single load and each of the plurality of power sources, and a current adjustment unit for adjusting current flowing through at least one power supply path among the plurality of power supply paths. The current adjustment unit compares state amounts of electrical states of the power supply paths, and when a difference between the state amounts meets prescribed conditions, adjusts current flowing through the power supply paths so as to reduce the difference between the state amounts.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title_en: Operation support device, operation support method and program
abstract_en: To reduce possibility that acceleration limit control cannot help being executed when wrong operation of an acceleration operator is not performed.CONSTITUTION: An operation support device is configured so as to make it possible to execute acceleration limit control which limits acceleration of a vehicle so that acceleration of the vehicle does not exceed prescribed limit acceleration if operation of an acceleration operator satisfies prescribed wrong operation condition. The operation support device executes acceleration limit control when the wrong operation condition is satisfied if prescribed approach condition, that satisfies when the vehicle approaches a road facility through which the vehicle is required to pass at vehicle speed of prescribed speed or less or after the vehicle stops temporarily, is satisfied and stops executing the acceleration limit control even though the wrong operation condition is satisfied or makes satisfaction of the wrong operation condition more difficult in comparison with when the approach condition is satisfied if the approach condition is not satisfied.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Information processing device, information processing method, and information processing program
abstract_en: To provide the new service related to the visualization of the change in the number of persons with time.SOLUTION: An information processing device according to the present application includes: an input part which receives the designation of an area from a user; and a display control part which displays, on a screen, a population matrix in which the population of the area designated by the user is expressed in a matrix format with the date and time as axes, and the weather information on weather.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Vehicular notification apparatus, vehicular notification system, vehicular notification method, and program
abstract_en: To provide a vehicular notification apparatus, system, method and program, which are capable of notifying a target occupant of an operation diagnostic result in a mode preferable to the target occupant.SOLUTION: In an operation diagnostic system, an ECU 21 incorporated in a vehicle includes: a mode setup part for setting a vehicular mode at one of first and second modes on the basis of given mode setup information; an obtainment part (a diagnostic part) for obtaining a vehicular operation diagnostic result; and a categorization part for categorizing the operation diagnostic result into a first diagnostic result and a second diagnostic result on the basis of contents of operation diagnostic result. Further, the ECU causes a notification device (a display) to notify: of information representing an operation diagnostic result obtained by the obtainment part in the case of the vehicle being in the first mode; of information representing a first diagnostic result in the case of the vehicle being in the second mode, with the obtainment part obtaining the first diagnostic result; and the target occupant of specific information instead of information representing the second diagnostic result in the case of the vehicle being in the second mode, with the obtainment part obtaining the second diagnostic result.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: System and method for remotely monitoring vehicle, robot or drone
abstract_en: To provide a system and a method for remotely monitoring and controlling a vehicle, a robot or a drone.SOLUTION: This system has: a control module containing a computer-executable code stored in a non-volatile memory; a processor: a control center device; and a plurality of autonomous devices that operate remotely from the control center device, in which each of the plurality of autonomous devices includes a control device. The control module, processor, control center device, and control device are configured to: acquire data using one or more acquisition units located in each of the plurality of autonomous device; process the acquired data using the control devices located on the plurality of autonomous devices; transfer the processed data from the control devices to the control center device in the case that the plurality of autonomous devices are operating autonomously without control from the control center device; and train artificial intelligence according to the processed data transferred from the control device.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Remote work control system, remote work control method, and computer program
abstract_en: To maintain the high quality of work performed in a remote terminal device.SOLUTION: A remote work control system comprises a terminal device operated by an operator who performs remote work and a remote work control device that transmits moving image data obtained by imaging in a target system, which is a system on which at least the remote work is performed, to the terminal device. The terminal device includes a communication section that receives the moving image data, an operation section that receives operation by the operator, and a display control section that displays a video obtained by reproducing the moving image data on a display section and controls display on the display section according to the operation to the operation section by the operator. The terminal device or the remote work control device includes an evaluation section that evaluates the quality of the remote work on the basis of operation history information indicating a history of operation in the remote work by the operator.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Level 6 SOS
abstract_en: To provide an information processing system capable of predicting a life-threatening crisis and automatically and immediately notifying an owner of a vehicle and the family of a risk representing the crisis when the risk increases.SOLUTION: In an information processing system 10, a Central_Brain 120 outputs a request signal to a server 14 each time a prescribed time passes. When the probability that a life-threatening event will occur is higher than or equal to a prescribed value, a prediction unit 142 of the server 14 which received the request signal determines that the event will occur. When the prediction unit 142 determines that an event will occur, a notification unit 144 notifies a Central_Brain 120 of a vehicle 12 and at least one device of a plurality of terminals 18A, 18B, 18C, --- of the determination results.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Processing device and processing program
abstract_en: To make it possible to determine whether the communication bandwidth when vehicles communicate meets bandwidth requirements without placing a significant load on each vehicle and without incurring significant introduction costs.SOLUTION: A processing device (1) includes: an acquisition unit (131) that acquires location information of a vehicle (2) from the vehicle communicating wirelessly via a base station (42); a determination unit (133) that determines an estimated value of the communication bandwidth allocated to each terminal device based on the location information, area information indicating the strength distribution of radio waves of the base station, and number information indicating the number of terminal devices wirelessly connected to the base station; and a decision unit (134) that determines whether or not the communication bandwidth when the vehicle communicates at a planned running location meets predetermined bandwidth requirements based on the estimated value.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 7

title_en: Fire detection device
abstract_en: To provide a fire detection device which can detect occurrence of fire and grasp a situation in a monitoring area after detecting the fire on the basis of acoustic data to be collected in the monitoring area.SOLUTION: A fire detection device comprises: a sound collection device which collects sound which is made in a monitoring area as acoustic data; and a fire detection unit which executes fire detection processing of detecting that fire occurs in the monitoring area on the basis of the acoustic data collected by the sound collection device. The fire detection unit executes the fire detection processing by using a high sensitivity level set to sensitivity higher than an initial sensitivity level and grasps a situation in the monitoring area when it is detected that the fire occurs by executing the fire detection processing by using the preset initial sensitivity level.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Performance assessment method of vehicle and automatic operation device
abstract_en: To enable, when a main body forming the travel plan for an automatic operation is independent from a main body controlling travel of the vehicle according to the travel plan, the main body controlling travel of a vehicle to grasp performance of the main body forming a travel plan.SOLUTION: A vehicle 2 comprises: a travel condition sensor 15 which acquires information about traveling state of the vehicle 2; a processor 100; and a memory 110 connected with the processor 100 which stores instructions 120 that are executable in the processor 100. The instruction 120 makes the processor 100 execute: communication with an automatic operation device 20 which calculates a target track of the vehicle 2; automatic travel of the vehicle based on the target track received from the automatic operation device 20; and calculation of evaluation value in performance of the automatic operation device 20 based on the information acquired by the travel condition sensor 15.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Safety verification system and safety verification method
abstract_en: To reduce a step number required for a safety design when expanding a traveling area of an autonomous appliance.SOLUTION: A safety verification system that verifies a safety of an autonomous appliance which drives autonomously in accordance with a safety rule, comprises: an environmental condition database that holds an environmental condition of a travel area; a safety rule database that holds the safety rule set by referring to the environmental condition; and a verification-required area extraction unit that extracts a verification-required area which requires safety verification from an additional travel area when the safety rule is applied in the additional travel area by comparing an environmental condition of the additional travel area with an environmental condition of an original travel area when expanding the travel area.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Production situation visualization system
abstract_en: To provide a production situation visualization system of a production line, which allows an operator to easily understand progress in the production line.SOLUTION: A production situation visualization system visualizes a production situation of products in a production line. The production situation visualization system makes a display device display a first graph indicating with time and for each unit time: a unit plan number calculated by dividing a unit load period as such a period that the production line is assumed to be operated in each unit time by a standard cycle time as a period assumed to be taken for one product in the production line; and a unit production number indicating the number of the products actually produced in the unit time.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Production program data creation device and production program data creation method
abstract_en: To provide a production program data creation device capable of knowing an optimum update frequency of production program data and a production program data creation method.SOLUTION: A production program data creation method for creating production program data used by a production device which produces a plurality of product kinds includes the steps of: acquiring production achievement information of the plurality of product kinds produced during a prescribed production period by the production device (ST1); creating production program data used by the production device about each of a plurality of unit periods corresponding to the prescribed production period on the basis of the production achievement information (ST6); and calculating a production index of a production device corresponding to the prescribed production period on the basis of production program data of each of the plurality of unit periods (ST7).SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title_en: System, method, and program for maintaining facility
abstract_en: To provide a system, method, and program for maintaining a facility.SOLUTION: A system includes a database connection unit that accesses a database which stores plural sets of abnormality information on an abnormality occurring in a facility and a work result of coping with the abnormality, a report acquisition unit that acquires a report containing the abnormality information on the abnormality occurring in the facility, a work plan acquisition unit that acquires a work plan for coping with the abnormality in the report, a selection unit that selects at least one set from among the plural sets on the basis of a degree of similarity between the abnormality information in the report and abnormality information included in each of the plural sets stored in the database, a work plan evaluation unit that evaluates the work plan on the basis of a difference between the work plan and the work result in at least one set selected by the selection unit, and an evaluation result output unit that outputs information dependent on a result of evaluation performed by the work plan evaluation unit.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Information processor
abstract_en: To produce efficiently, product oil.SOLUTION: There is provided an information processor for supporting operation of a plant device which passes raw material oil to a catalyst for acquiring product oil, the information processor comprises: a storage part for storing a unique deterioration model which is generated on the basis of, operation actual data being a history in time series of operation information indicating, an operation state of the plant device; a data acquiring part acquiring time series constant data of the operation information; and service life prediction data generation part for, on the basis of the unique deterioration model and the acquired operation scheduled data, generating service life prediction data for predicting a service life of the catalyst. The unique deterioration model is generated on the basis of first operation actual data being operation actual data in a first operation period, the operation scheduled data is data related to a second operation period, and the second operation period is an operation period after passage of the first operation period.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Method of outputting design drawing of block object
abstract_en: To provide a method for assisting a user to build a block object using block parts.SOLUTION: In a method of outputting a design drawing of a block object, the block object being composed of multiple kinds of block parts to be assembled, the method being executed by a processing unit of a server terminal connected to a user terminal via a network, the processing unit of the server terminal acquires two-dimensional data of an object model, analyzes the two-dimensional data, determines a type of the object model on the basis of the analysis result, and determines, based on object model data stored in a storage unit of the server terminal, an object model that is coincident with or similar to the type of the object model, as a block object.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title_en: Direction presentation device
abstract_en: To extend, in a vertical direction, a direction for travel presented to a user by vibration.SOLUTION: A direction presentation device 20 comprises: a spherical housing 20A; a communication unit 21 that acquires route information of a user and position information and a travel direction of the user during travel; a vibration unit 22 that has a plurality of vibrators built in predetermined positions along a spherical surface of the housing 20A, and applies vibration to the palm of the hand with the housing 20A being held by the user; a detection unit 23 that detects a posture of the direction presentation device 20 with the housing 20A being held by the user; and a control unit 24 that sets the acquired travel direction of the user to a front direction of the direction presentation device 20, calculates a direction in which the user should travel on the basis of the acquired position information on the user and the route information, determines, from the plurality of vibrators, a vibrator presenting the calculated direction by vibration on the basis of the posture and the front direction of the direction presentation device 20, and vibrates the determined vibrator to present the direction in which the user should travel.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Program point rating system and program point rating method
abstract_en: To easily recognize a faulty portion in a program for a learner.SOLUTION: A program point rating system includes: an acquisition unit for acquiring a learner program coded according to a subject; a control unit for executing an execution process for executing the learner program by inputting scoring input information including data which is data corresponding to the subject used for execution of the learner program, a scoring process for scoring the learner program by comparing output information outputted by execution of the learner program and scoring output information including a correct answer for the output; and a visualizing process for inputting output information and the scoring information to a simulator simulating an execution action of the learner program for the subject and visualizing the passage and result, having simulation carried out, and generating visualized information for visualizing a process and result in the execution action of the learner program based on the output of a simulator, and an output unit for outputting the visualized information and the result of the scoring.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Automatic adjustment method for main engine control parameter of vessel, automatic adjustment program, and automatic adjustment system
abstract_en: To provide an automatic adjustment method, an automatic adjustment program, and an automatic adjustment system for a vessel carrying out automatic adjustment of a control parameter for a main engine based on a derived optimum control parameter by carrying out reinforcement learning in an environment reflecting circumstances unique to a vessel.SOLUTION: A propulsion model composed of a hull of a vessel, a propeller, and a main engine are set as an environment for reinforced learning, wave conditions effecting the propulsion model is acquired, an initial value of a control parameter set by a control agent and the wave conditions are applied to the propulsion model, a simulation of the propulsion model for the plurality of wave conditions are carried out in a plurality of evaluation steps in one episode, a reward value based on a reward function for a result of the simulation is calculated, the control parameter is repeatedly changed by updating a measure based on a value function of the reward value and a main engine state of the main engine, and the main engine is controlled by deriving an optimum control parameter based on an optimum measure where the reward value becomes maximum.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Management method and management system
abstract_en: To provide a management method and management system capable of improving operability of selection of a work item and setting of work information.SOLUTION: A management method for managing a combine 2 capable of performing automatic traveling includes: before starting the automatic traveling, displaying a work route information setting screen for setting work route information on a work route on which the combine 2 is to perform the automatic traveling, on a display unit 13 of a management terminal 3; as the work route information setting screen, displaying a route pattern selection screen 220 for selecting a route pattern of the work route in the combine 2 performing automatic reaping traveling, on the display unit 13; displaying a route pattern selection column 221 on the route pattern selection screen 220; and, in the route pattern selection column 221, displaying, as a route pattern of a work route for the automatic reaping traveling, options of reciprocating reaping and round reaping so as to be capable of being selectively operated.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Money processing machine
abstract_en: To provide a money processing machine that can improve usability.SOLUTION: Provided is a money processing machine including: an operation display part 25 capable of at least selectively operating a money processing operation and capable of displaying a result of performing the selectively operated processing operation; and a control part that controls an input part, a conveyance part, an identification part, a distribution part, a plurality of accumulation parts, and an operation display part. When determining that the money processing machine has entered an error state, the control part causes the operation display part 25 to display a calling icon 106 that enables calling of a detailed illustration image to contribute to handling of the error state in a manner that can be selectively operated.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Information notification device, information notification system, and information notification method
abstract_en: To provide an information notification device that notifies an operator of information and is capable of further accurately providing notification with simple configuration.SOLUTION: An information notification device 100 includes: an operation state information acquisition unit 111 that acquires operation state information of a manufacturing device; and an operation determination unit 112 that determines an operation state of the manufacturing device. The information notification device 100 also includes a wireless signal information acquisition unit that acquires received power information indicating received power of a wireless signal transmitted from the manufacturing device to a portable terminal. The information notification device 100 also includes a position calculation unit 114 that calculates an operator distance from the manufacturing device to the operator based on the received power information. The information notification device 100 also includes a distance determination unit 115 that determines, based on the operator distance and a determination distance, a distance of the operator. The information notification device 100 further includes an abnormality information transmission unit 116 that transmits abnormality information to the portable terminal of the operator upon determination that the operator distance is greater than or equal to the determination distance.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title_en: Controller, method and program
abstract_en: To make it possible to compare a system configuration indicated by configuration information generated according to an AAS (Asset Administration Shell) with an actual system configuration.SOLUTION: A controller comprises a first communication port to which a first network to which a plurality of pieces of equipment of a system belong is connected; a second communication port to which a second network to which an information processing device belongs is connected; and a first storage part which stores a BoM (Bill of Material) generated according to an AAS and indicating configuration information of the system. The information processing device comprises a second storage part which stores a BoM generated according to the AAS and indicating configuration information of the system. The controller, when a change in the system configuration is detected, alters the configuration information indicated by the BoM in the first storage part based on the change, and, when conditions are met, compares the configuration information of the BoMs in the first and second storage parts with each other.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Printing method for wound yarn package, printing device for wound yarn package, electronic device, storage medium, and program
abstract_en: To provide a printing method for a wound yarn package, a printing device for a wound yarn package, an electronic device, a storage medium, and a program.SOLUTION: A wound yarn package printing method comprises: sequentially fitting respective wound yarn packages from a winding machine onto an outer side of a reception rod of a doffing machine when the wound yarn packages reach full winding states; updating an unloading count of the winding machine; recording a first doffing time of each wound yarn package; generating a first information code of each wound yarn package based on identification information of the winding machine, the updated unloading count, the first doffing time of each wound yarn package, and positional information in the winding machine, and transmitting the first information code to the doffing machine; determining, by the doffing machine, a corresponding target wound yarn package from among the respective wound yarn packages based on a degree of matching between the first doffing time in the first information code and a second doffing time of each wound yarn package recorded in the doffing machine; and printing the information code on an inner wall of a paper tube of the corresponding target wound yarn package.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Driving support system
abstract_en: To provide a driving support system capable of attaining improvement of safety.SOLUTION: A driving support system 100 is used for supporting driving in a case where an own vehicle 1 traveling on a confluence road Rc is confluent to a main track road Rm at a confluent point Pc, and comprises: a smartphone 11 which is possessed by a passenger of the own vehicle 1 traveling on the confluence road Rc and capable of calculating positional information of the own vehicle 1; a smartphone 21 which is possessed by a passenger of another vehicle 2 traveling on the main track road Rm and capable of calculating positional information of the other vehicle 2; and a navigation device 1a and a display device 4 which notify a driver of the own vehicle 1 of a warning. The smartphone 11 calculates a safety distance on the basis of information relating to the confluence point Pc, an inter-vehicle distance after the lapse of a predetermined time is calculated using the positional information of the own vehicle 1 and the positional information of the other vehicle 2, and in a case where the inter-vehicle distance after the lapse of the predetermined time is less than the safety distance, the navigation device 1a and the display device 4 are caused to perform the notification of the warning.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Support system, support method, and support program
abstract_en: To provide a support system capable of requesting a support from an appropriate supporter.SOLUTION: A support system includes a processor and supports an autonomous travel apparatus. The processor implements generation of action history data of the autonomous travel apparatus. The processor implements monitoring of occurrence of a stack which is a condition where travel of the autonomous travel apparatus is hindered. The processor implements outputting of support request data to a supporter who matches a recovery support level. The recovery support level is a level of a recovery support from a stack which is requested from a supporter capable of implementing a recovery support from a stack. The recovery support level is a level determined based on action history data preceding the stack occurrence timing.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Computer-implemented method for predicting evolution of traffic simulations
abstract_en: To provide a computer-implemented method for predicting the evolution of traffic simulations.SOLUTION: A method includes: accepting input of traffic data, including data acquired from sensors within a geographic region; running traffic simulations using the traffic data for the geographic region; selecting an intervention from a plurality of potential interventions in response to a decision to model the effect of a change to the traffic simulations; modifying parameters of the traffic simulations using the intervention and obtaining the modified simulation parameters; and implementing the modified traffic simulations using the modified simulation parameters and configured to reflect the effect of the intervention on the traffic.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Fire sensor and fire notification system
abstract_en: To provide a fire sensor capable of reducing a work load related to an appearance check.SOLUTION: A fire sensor includes: an impact measurement section provided inside the fire sensor so as to measure impact energy to be applied from the outside; and an outer shape damage estimation section for estimating a risk of occurrence of an outer shape abnormality in a main body so as to generate an outer shape damage signal when the impact energy exceeds a predetermined value. The outer shape damage is estimated based on a quantitative measurement result of the impact energy to be applied from the outside.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Program generating method, program, recording medium, control device and program generating apparatus
abstract_en: To provide a program generating method capable of reducing an operator's burden as compared with the conventional art.SOLUTION: A method of generating a program for flowing fluid to a control target device having a container and a pipeline connected with the container includes: acquiring first, by a processing section, information about the quantity of fluid stored in the container before a start of a first operation step and information about the first operation step; determining whether or not the container lies at a start point of a flow passage through which fluid flows in a second operation step following the first operation step; generating a flow passage in the second operation step through which fluid flows with the container given as a start point if the container lies at the start point of the flow passage; then generating an operation program in the second operation step of the control target device.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 10

title_en: Semiconductor device
abstract_en: To provide a semiconductor device that generates a temperature-compensated and power supply-voltage-compensated current.SOLUTION: A semiconductor device 1 includes: a first current generating circuit 11 that generates a first current that has a positive temperature coefficient and is independent of a first power supply voltage; a second current generating circuit 12 that generates a second current that has a negative temperature coefficient and is independent of the first power supply voltage; and a third current generating circuit 13 that generates a third current that is independent of temperature and the first power supply voltage based on the first current and the second current.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Information terminal and program therefor
abstract_en: To provide an information terminal that facilitates recognition of update of display showing a total amount of a commercial transaction each time a purchased commodity for the commercial transaction is specified.SOLUTION: The information terminal includes a specifying unit and a display. The specifying unit specifies a purchased commodity for a commercial transaction. The display includes a first area in which a total amount of the commercial transaction is displayed and a second area in which the amount of purchased commodities specified by the specifying unit as the purchased commodities for the same commercial transaction is displayed. The display adds a sign indicating addition after the total amount displayed in the first area and displays the amount of the purchased commodities in the second area.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 11

title_en: Analysis method of manufacturing process, analyzer, analysis program, and computer-readable storage medium storing the analysis program
abstract_en: To highly accurately and easily determine a manufacturing process that is considered to contribute to the quality of a product for each process group, for the product manufactured through a plurality of process groups.SOLUTION: An analysis method includes processes of: reading, from an SSD9, two or more types of machine learning models 69 generated in advance so as to associate each of a plurality of feature amounts P with one or more of a plurality of manufacturing processes Q and one or more of a plurality of process groups G; reading, from the plurality of feature amounts P, a specific feature amount Ps selected in advance; and estimating a series of one or more manufacturing processes Q estimated to contribute to quality determination for each type of machine learning model 69 on the basis of the specific feature amount Ps and the two or more types of machine learning models 69.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 16A

title_en: Electronic signature system, method, and program
abstract_en: To materialize electronic signature based on isogeny in which data sizes and calculation costs are suppressed.SOLUTION: This electronic signature system materializes electronic signature using isogeny-based cryptography that adopts, as system parameters, integers a and b determined from security parameter λ, prime p=2a3bf-1 (f=integer), a prescribed elliptic curve E0 on finite field Fp^2, and maximum order O0 corresponding to the elliptic curve E0. The electronic signature system includes a key generation unit that selects basis P0, Q0 of a group of torsion parts of E0[2a3b]of 2a3b of the elliptic curve E0, selects a prime N at random that corresponds to the prime p, determines point images τ(P0), τ(Q0) and value area EA of random N-isogeny τ:E0→EA, and an ideal Iτ corresponding to the isogeny τ, thereby generating a secret key sk=(τ,τ(P0), τ(Q0), Iτ, N) for creating an electronic signature and a verification key vk=EA for verifying the electronic signature.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Program and system
abstract_en: SOLUTION: Provided is a program that causes a computer to function as notification processing means for notifying a user of guidance information to a real-world destination which is set by the user, in a position information game in which objects associated with real-world positions are placed. In the above program, the notification processing means may display the guidance information to the real-world destination, on an in-game map on which the objects are placed. In any one of the above programs, the notification processing means may perform notification processing to further notify the user of guidance information to an object specified by the user on the in-game map.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title_en: Depositing/withdrawing device, sales data processing device, and program
abstract_en: To reduce complexity in management in a case in which an operation procedure and the like of a depositing/withdrawing device are configured to be indicated by a host terminal.SOLUTION: A depositing/withdrawing device for performing processing of depositing/withdrawing a coin or a bill, including: a display unit that displays information for an operator; a communication unit that communicates with a host device that requests at least either of deposit and withdrawal; a storage unit that stores setting data that associates identification information about a state of the depositing/withdrawing device with explanatory text to be displayed on the display unit in the state and detailed explanatory text to be displayed on the host device; a display control unit that, when an error occurs in the processing, causes the display unit to display the explanatory text associated with the identification information in the state; a state transmission unit that, when the error occurs in the processing, transmits the identification information about the state to the host device; and an explanation transmission unit that, when the error occurs in the processing and when the detailed explanatory text is associated with the identification information about the state, transmits the detailed explanatory text to the host device.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 14

title_en: Information processing device and commodity registration system
abstract_en: To provide an information processing device and a commodity registration system that can reduce a manufacturing cost.SOLUTION: An information processing device according to an embodiment includes a virtualization control unit, one or more connection units, and one or more communication units. The virtualization control unit constructs one or more virtual devices, each executing some types of processing included in commodity sales data processing including commodity registration processing of registering a commodity targeted for sales and accounting processing of paying the price of the commodity registered by the commodity registration processing. The one or more connection units output video signals obtained by converting image data about the some types of processing generated by the virtual devices to a display device connected via a display cable. The one or more communication units transmit/receive data to/from an apparatus to be used in the some types of processing executed by the virtual devices.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Semiconductor device
abstract_en: To provide a semiconductor device that can easily store an operation history in a nonvolatile manner and that can confirm the stored operation history without opening the package.SOLUTION: The semiconductor device according to the embodiment includes an electronic circuit including a voltage regulator circuit that outputs a DC output voltage, a memory circuit including N (N is an integer equal to or greater than 2) electronic fuses, a soft start circuit that controls the voltage regulator circuit to change the DC output voltage from a first voltage value to a second voltage value over time during a start period in which generation of the DC output voltage begins, and a waveform control circuit that changes the waveform of the DC output voltage during the start period depending on the position or number of blown electronic fuses among the N electronic fuses.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Power conversion device, power supply system, and method for controlling power conversion device
abstract_en: STABILIZING OPERATION OF POWER CONDITIONER SOLUTION: A control unit (52) of a power conversion device (5) sets a control target value of an output voltage of a solar cell panel based on a first output voltage of the solar cell panel (1) indicated in a past operation record corresponding to an amount of solar radiation. The control unit calculates a voltage deviation that is a difference between the control target value and a current second output voltage of the solar cell panel. The control unit determines, as a command value for controlling output power of the DC-DC converter (51), a value obtained by adding, to a base value of the command value, a value obtained by converting the voltage deviation into power, the base value being calculated from current output power of the solar cell panel and a target value of input power to the power conditioner (2).SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Display body, memory performance improvement device, and program
abstract_en: To provide a display body for improving the ability of an infant to memorize voice information.SOLUTION: A display body (50) includes: a first display screen (100) which displays a text to be read aloud by a questioner and an instruction text; a second display screen (200) which displays a plurality of images which express the content of the text and are shown to an infant; a third display screen (300) which displays two or more images among a first question and the plurality of images and a non-expression image which does not express the content as a first answer image group and asks which of the first answer image groups is an image which does not express the content; and a second answer image group which displays one article image corresponding to one article and a plurality of similar article images corresponding to similar articles of the same type as the one article, which are included in the second question and the plurality of images, as a second answer image group. And a fourth display screen 400 for asking which is one article image included in the content from the second answer image group.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title_en: system
abstract_en: An object of the system according to the embodiment is to perform conversion between speech and text in real time in language learning and support visual learning.SOLUTION: A system according to an embodiment includes a voice conversion unit, a text conversion unit, a real-time support unit, and a visual learning unit. The voice conversion unit converts voice into text. The text conversion unit converts the text converted by the voice conversion unit into voice. The real-time support unit supports English conversation learning in real time by using the voice conversion unit and the text conversion unit. The visual learner supports visual learning.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Remote control system for moving body
abstract_en: To provide a technique capable of suppressing an erroneous operation in a moving direction of a moving body in a remote operation.SOLUTION: A remote operation system for a moving body includes an imaging device that captures an image of the moving body, a display device that displays a video captured by the imaging device, a direction input device that receives an input of a scheduled direction in which the moving body is desired to be moved, an operation input device that visually notifies an operation of the operation input device for moving the moving body in the scheduled direction, and a remote operation device that remotely operates the moving body in accordance with the remote operation instruction.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Warning control device and warning control method
abstract_en: To provide a warning control device and a warning control method capable of giving an appropriate warning to a driver of a vehicle passing through a photographing range even when a poor visibility occurs in the photographing range of a camera installed at an intersection or the like.SOLUTION: The imaging control unit 11 of the warning control device 10 according to the present disclosure acquires a first image captured by the first imaging device 20 and a second image captured by the second imaging device 30 different from the first imaging device 20 at the same timing as the first image in a range including an imaging range of the first image. The first detection unit 12 detects the number of first persons included in the first image. The second detection unit 13 detects the number of second persons included in the detection target range that coincides with the imaging range of the first image in the second image. The determination unit 14 determines whether or not the difference between the first number of persons and the second number of persons is equal to or greater than a predetermined threshold value. The warning control unit 15 issues different warnings to the vehicle passing through the imaging range of the first image according to the determination result.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Information processing system and information processing method
abstract_en: To provide an information processing system and an information processing method for accurately detecting whether or not a target event occurs without complicated condition setting.SOLUTION: In an information processing system 1, a center device includes a first generation unit for inputting a reference image in which a monitoring area is imaged in a state where a target event does not occur in the monitoring area to a first generation AI, and causing the first generation AI to generate reference text information describing a context shown in the reference image, a second generation unit for inputting a target image in which the monitoring area is imaged to a second generation AI, and causing the second generation AI to generate target text information describing the context shown in the target image, a third generation AI for inputting information on the reference text information, information on the target text information, and information on the target event to the third generation AI, and causing the third generation AI to generate determination result text information indicating whether or not the target event is included in the target image, and an output control unit for outputting information on a determination result.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: system
abstract_en: A system is provided.SOLUTION: The system includes a measuring means for continuously collecting environmental data, an identifying means for analyzing the data obtained from the measuring means and detecting abnormality, a notifying means for issuing an alarm based on the abnormality detected by the identifying means, a reporting means for providing information to a user who has received the alarm from the notifying means, and a learning means for improving accuracy of the identifying means by performing learning using the collected data.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Apparatus, method, and system for remotely monitoring odor
abstract_en: Disclosed are a remote odor monitoring device, a method thereof, and a system thereof capable of remotely monitoring an odor in a sewage pipe network and estimating and tracking an odor source. The device comprises: a receiving unit for receiving odor data from odor measuring devices installed at individual points of a sewage pipe network; a comparing unit for comparing the received odor data of each point with a preset reference value; a grouping unit for grouping points having odor data equal to or greater than the preset reference value; and a determining unit configured to determine an odor occurrence point based on a sewage flow.

title_en: Ai system based on edge-computing for reinforcing safe-management in industrial site
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an edge computing-based artificial intelligence (AI) system for reinforcing safety management in industrial sites, which accurately recognizes accidents. According to the present invention, the edge computing-based AI system comprises: an image input unit to which an on-site image is input from a camera module; a characteristic information storage unit storing characteristic information including identification information or location information for the camera module; an object recognition unit recognizing one or more target objects included in the on-site image by using raw data on the basis of AI processing; a main processing unit transmitting, to a control server, request information including information on a first event and the characteristic information when the first event recognizing a target object occurs by the object recognition unit; a feedback information receiving unit receiving feedback information in response to the request information from the control server when the first event is not a scheduled task or the information of the location where the target object is recognized is not scheduled location information; and an alarm processing unit outputting a danger signal by operating an alarm means when the feedback information is received.

title_en: Method, device and system for providing charging power using ess for power supply of post type electric device
abstract_en: According to one embodiment, a method, which is executed by a controller to supply electric power so as to enable a charging service using an energy storage system (ESS) for power supply to post type electric equipment, includes the following steps of: when determining operation for a plurality of pieces of post type electric equipment as necessary in accordance with a preset streetlight light-on time, supplying electric power from a power supply system to each of the plurality of pieces of post type electric equipment to perform a control operation such that lighting installed in each of the plurality of pieces of post type electric equipment is turned on, and measure a lighting load amount through a power amount consumed for the lighting; when confirming that a charging plug installed in each of the plurality of pieces of post type electric equipment is connected with at least one electric vehicle, supplying additional electric power from the power supply system to the electric vehicle to perform a control operation such that a battery of the electric vehicle is charged, and measure a charging load amount through a power amount consumed for a charging service for the electric vehicle; when confirming that a total load amount obtained by adding up the lighting load amount and the charging load amount is smaller than an available supply amount of the power supply system, maintaining the state of the ESS connected with the plurality of pieces of post type electric equipment in a standby mode to perform a control operation such that the electric power stored in the ESS is not discharged; and when confirming that the total load amount is greater than the available supply amount, setting the ESS to a discharge mode to perform a control operation such that the electric power stored in the ESS is supplied to the plurality of pieces of post type electric equipment.

title_en: Roof structure with earthquake detection sensor and Building safety management system using the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a vibration isolator for a roof structure having a seismic detecting sensor, comprising: a connection unit fixed on a panel support unit supporting a panel covering an upper part of a building; an elastic unit which is connected with the connection unit and includes an elastic body provided as a plate spring; a seismic detecting sensor which is connected with the connection unit and detects vibration according to an earthquake or detects collapse of the panel; and a support unit which supports both ends of the elastic unit and is engaged with a lower panel provided on top of the structure. The vibration isolator ensures vibration isolating performance and is universally applied to a roof structure.

title_en: Method and System for Collecting User's Path Information
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method and system for collecting moving path information of a user. More specifically, by using QR images, the present invention collects moving path information according to entry and exit times of a store visited by the user, and stores and manages the moving path information in block chain. When a confirmed case occurs, the moving path of the user can be analyzed to provide a notification to the confirmed case and a user who may come into contact with the confirmed case.

title_en: Gas supply system that can replace the flow controller without interruption of the process
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a gas supply system and, more specifically, to a gas supply system capable of replacing a mast flow controller without causing a process suspension by using two MFC lines with operations switchable with each other. In accordance with the present invention, the gas supply system capable of replacing a mast flow controller without causing a process suspension, includes: a source gas supply line through which source gas is supplied; a mixing tank connected with the source gas supply line and storing process gas including the source gas; and a process gas supply line connected with the mixing tank and supplying the process gas.

title_en: Card dispenser for toy
abstract_en: Disclosed in the present invention is a card dispenser. The card dispenser of the present invention comprises: a base plate; a pair of side walls which are disposed on both sides of the base plate, and have inclined slits; a discharging plate which is disposed at a lower end of the base plate, and has an inclination; and a driving unit which is disposed to be adjacent to the discharging plate and between the pair of side walls, and guides cards stacked on the base plate to the discharging plate.

title_en: Unmanned store management system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an unmanned store management system. The unmanned store management system comprises: an IoT environmental complex sensor for detecting environmental information in an unmanned store; a kiosk provided in the unmanned store and controlling an operation of an IoT control sensor provided in the unmanned store in consideration of the environmental information acquired from the IoT environmental complex sensor; and an unmanned store management device for interworking with each of the IoT environmental complex sensor, the IoT control sensor, and the kiosk through a network and performing the management of the unmanned store at a remote location. The unmanned store management device may control device operations of each of the IoT environmental complex sensor, the IoT control sensor, and the kiosk in relation to the management of the unmanned store. Accordingly, a manager can remotely manage an unmanned store using IoT technology.

title_en: Risk Situation Analysis and Hazard Object Detection System
abstract_en: According to one embodiment, provided is a risk situation analysis and risk object search system. The system includes a sound collection module, an image collection module, and a control module. It has the effect of being able to actively determine the current situation by analyzing the collected sound and image data.

title_en: Virtual reality simulation method for medical consumables drop training
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a virtual reality simulation method for training in dropping medical supplies, and more specifically, to a virtual reality simulation method that can repeatedly perform training in dropping the medical supplies into medical containers in a virtual reality environment. According to the present invention, it is possible to repeatedly train to drop medical supplies into the medical containers in the virtual reality environment, which has the advantage of improving medical skills through the process and enabling active response in real situations.

title_en: Energy-independent variable air volume system
abstract_en: An energy independent variable air volume system comprises a plurality of variable air volume (vav) units; an energy harvesting device; a plurality of fire sensors; a control device; and a wireless communication module. It is not connected to the external power supply and it provides the electricity from the energy harvesting apparatus and the variable air volume unit, and the control device and wireless communications module are driven. When a fire is detected by any one of the fire sensors, the control device generates a fire alarm for the fire zone, shields a damper of the variable air volume unit installed in the indoor air supply duct connected to the fire zone, and opens the damper of the variable air volume unit installed in the indoor air supply duct connected to the remaining zones except for the fire zone among the zones. The present invention relates to an energy-independent variable air volume system, which is easy to install and move without a power line, and minimizes the spread of fire by controlling a duct according to a fire detection signal.

title_en: Robots for Collecting and Transporting Waste for Airport Terminal
abstract_en: A waste collection and transfer robot for an airport terminal is disclosed. An embodiment of the present invention provides a waste collection and transfer robot for an airport terminal, which provides a robot having a structure in which waste collection and cleaning equipment are stacked on the robot based on an indoor unmanned autonomous driving robot so as to replace a separate collection and waste collection cleaning cart used by a cleaning worker at an airport terminal, thereby automating a cleaning work with relatively high manpower dependence and providing convenience of movement to suppress the occurrence of industrial accidents.

title_en: Service system for lotto lottery lucky number using credit card sales slip and method of cashback service
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a lottery number issuance service system linked with a credit card sales slip and a cashback service. The present invention includes: a dedicated credit card terminal (100) with lottery number issuance which can print a lottery number in an unspecified location of the credit card sales slip; a lotto number cashback service server (200) which receives credit card usage amount information approved through the dedicated credit card terminal (100), and accumulates and manages the amount corresponding to a certain percentage of the amount used as an exclusive cashback point of a member store, and generates a randomly extracted lottery number when it is confirmed that the card usage amount used by a credit card user at the member store is accumulated more than the cashback point set in advance; and a lottery number purchase proxy server (300) which purchases the lottery number generated by the lottery number cashback service server (200) online in real time, and then transmits the lottery number to the dedicated credit card terminal (100) and a credit card user's phone. Therefore, it is possible to promote consumption by encouraging the use of credit cards in unspecified affiliated stores.

title_en: Method and apparatus for generating information, electronic device, storage medium and program
abstract_en: The present invention provides a method, an apparatus, an electronic device, a storage medium and a program for generating information, which relate to an autonomous driving field. A specific implementation method comprises the steps of: receiving a point cloud of a target scene, and displaying a point cloud frame in the point cloud; receiving region selection information inputted by a user, wherein the region selection information is sent by the user based on the displayed point cloud frame; processing point data in a target region corresponding to the region selection information to obtain a processed point cloud; and sending the processed point cloud to a test vehicle, wherein the processed point cloud is used for generation of positioning information. According to a corresponding embodiment of the present invention, a point cloud obtained from a real physical scene is processed to simulate an environmental change of a real physical environment, and the processed point cloud is sent to the test vehicle, where the processed point cloud is used for generation of positioning information, thereby realizing a stability test for a positioning system of the test vehicle.

title_en: Automatic back pressure adjustment system of pump
abstract_en: According to one embodiment of the present invention, an automatic back pressure control system of a pump comprises: a pump transferring and pressurizing fluid to at least one demand source; a pressure differential transmitter detecting a pressure difference between an inlet and an outlet of the pump and outputting the detected pressure different between the inlet and the outlet of the pump as a signal; a hydraulic orifice valve where an actuator for controlling back pressure of the pump is attached, controlling an opening degree of a flow amount; and an electric control system (ECS) controlling the flowing amount opening degree of the variable orifice by using the signal outputted from the pressure differential transmitter.

title_en: Management method and system for solar photovoltaic power station using illuminance sensor and bigdata
abstract_en: Various embodiments of the present invention relate to a solar power plant management system. According to various embodiments of the present invention, a solar power plant management system using an illuminance sensor and big data includes a plurality of solar panels; an illuminance sensor detecting an illuminance amount of the plurality of solar panels; a power generation amount detection unit for detecting the amount of generation of each of the plurality of solar panels; and an analysis device functionally connected to the solar panel, the illuminance sensor, and the generation amount detection unit. The analysis device may check the amount of illuminance by using the illuminance sensor, check the amount of power generated by each of the plurality of solar panels corresponding to the amount of illuminance, and compare the amount of power generation between the plurality of photovoltaic panels. As a result of the comparison, when there is a photovoltaic panel in which the amount of power generation of the plurality of photovoltaic panels is reduced by more than a first reference value, the analysis device may be determined that the photovoltaic panel is in a faulty state. Other embodiments may be possible.

title_en: Kiosk controller
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kiosk controller. According to the present invention, in the kiosk controller (100) for managing and controlling a kiosk (10), the kiosk controller comprises: a monitor monitoring control part (150) that senses a current of a monitor (12) of the kiosk (10) to detect an on/off state of the monitor and a presence/absence of a screen display of the monitor (12); and a central control part (110) that transmits and controls a current state of the monitor (12) detected by the monitor monitoring control part (150) to a remote server (20) through a network communication part (140). According to the configuration, there is an advantage that a monitor status (on/off, screen display operation standby) can be even monitored remotely.

title_en: Model eye for tonometer
abstract_en: A model eye for normalizing intraocular pressure measurements of a tonometer is disclosed. The model eye for the tonometer includes: a model eye body in which a chamber for accommodating gas is formed; a hemispherical elastic membrane formed at one end of the model eye body to separate the chamber and the outside of the model eye, and expanded to the outside by the gas in the chamber; and a pressure port formed at one end of the model eye body to supply gas to the chamber.

title_en: Intelligent floor noise notification device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an intelligent inter-floor noise notification device and, more specifically, to an intelligent inter-floor noise notification device, which provides noise feedback for each household by analyzing a location of a noise, a direction of the noise, and type of the noise according to the generation of the noise and outputting the location of the noise, the direction of the noise, and the type of the noise to an output unit, separates and measures the noise generated in a target household (e.g., upper house or next house) and the noise generated in a household to be measured (e.g., my house or user's house), so that a noise source is analyzed more accurately and a level of inter-floor noise for each household can be digitized as numerical values and can be used at any time to resolve inter-floor noise disputes, and measures and outputs the noise or vibration generated in the household to be measured so that a user can recognize an effect on the target household (house just below), thereby resolving the dispute over the inter-floor noise.

title_en: How to manage virtual monitoring by tracking device motion
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for managing the virtual monitoring of a device by tracking the motion of the device. An object of the present invention is to determine the operating state of a device even if a manager does not go directly to an industrial site and manage very effectively the device in the industrial site. A method for managing the virtual monitoring of a device by tracking the motion of a device according to an embodiment of the present invention includes a setting step (S10) of setting a recipe waveform for one operation of the device; a measurement step (S20) of transmitting current waveform information to a management server (10); an implementation step (S30) of implementing the real-time operation state of the device as an image and providing it to a manager; and a management step (S40).

title_en: System drones for precision detection and tracking
abstract_en: An objective of the present invention is to develop a system for monitoring a specific area by appropriately using a ground camera and a drone. According to the present invention, the system performs: a first stage of checking whether an intruder occurs by using an installed ground camera, wherein when a specific target is identified, information is shared with a system room and drone dispatch is requested; a second stage of receiving a notification to determine whether to depart by a person who identifies the intruder and starting the drone closest to a target location when a start command is issued; and a third stage of allowing the drone arriving at a target point to check identification of the intruder and give a warning, wherein when the intruder does not leave a surveillance area despite the warning, the drone requests an arrest and follows the intruder to provide location information.
