Accordingly, the objective of the present invention is to develop a system which is efficient and increases reliability of security.

title_en: System for preventing water quality accident
abstract_en: In accordance with an embodiment of the present invention, a system for preventing a water quality accident comprises: a housing unit on a lower end of which a glass plate is disposed, and in which a monitoring unit for capturing a video image of the inside of a water tank through the glass plate is accommodated; a light source unit disposed on the outer circumferential surface of the housing unit to emit light downward; a first frame unit connected to an upper end of the housing unit, and extending long in a direction perpendicular to the bottom surface of the water tank; a box unit installed on an upper end of the first frame unit to provide power to the light source unit; a second frame unit disposed in a position adjacent to the box unit to be spaced apart from the box unit, and extending long to be parallel to the first frame unit; a washing unit provided at a lower end of the second frame unit, having a length in a horizontal direction, and axially coupled to the lower end of the second frame unit to wash the glass plate; and a rotating unit coupled to an upper end of the second frame unit to provide a rotational force to the second frame unit. Therefore, the system can quickly determine a water quality accident.

title_en: Advanced Driver Assistance System, Vehicle having the same and method for controlling the vehicle
abstract_en: The present invention provides a driver assistance device, a vehicle having the same and a control method thereof, which can drive stably on a merging road. The driver assistance device of the present invention generates navigation information based on current location information received in a communication unit and destination information inputted into an input unit, determines whether a road on which a vehicle is to drive is a merging road based on the generated navigation information, map information, and the current location information, recognizes a lane in an image of an imaging device, recognizes a driving first road based on location information of the recognized lane, divides a prescribed area including a merging road into an entry section, a merging section, and a stabilization section when the recognized first road is a road merging with a second road, generates route points in the entry section and the merging section based on location information of one lane and the road width of the first road, generates route points based on location information of one lane and the road width of the merging road in the stabilization section, performs curve fitting for the route points in the entry section and the merging section and the route points in the stabilization section to generate a driving route, and controls autonomous driving based on the generated driving route.

title_en: Roadside sensing method, device, electronic equipment, storage medium and computer program and roadside equipment
abstract_en: The present application discloses a detection method and apparatus, an electronic device, a storage medium, a computer program, and a roadside device, and relates to a vehicle-road cooperation field of smart transportation. Specifically, the present application is implemented by the following technical means. The detection method comprises the steps of: acquiring a wide-angle image taken by a wide-angle camera; undistorting the wide-angle image to obtain an image in a downward direction of the wide-angle camera; and performing projection transformation of the wide-angle image into one or more viewing angles through a spherical projection model to obtain at least one planar projection image corresponding to one of the viewing angles. According to the present application, dead zone free detection can be implemented by arranging the smallest number of cameras, the maintenance cost of a detection system can be reduced, and the stability of the detection system can be enhanced.

title_en: Method for reinforced learning of fire suppression models related to autonomous ship with motion in irregular waves
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire suppression modeling reinforcement learning method for an autonomous ship which repeats a process of modeling fire occurrence and extinguishing processes of a compartment in a vessel to which a sea state is reflected, performing simulation, modifying a nozzle focus angle toward a fire source based on a simulation performing result value, and re-performing simulation so as to automatically track and verify an optimum nozzle focus angle to extinguish fire of an autonomous ship through reinforcement learning of an accumulative result value.

title_en: Robot cleaner and robot cleaning system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a robot cleaner that can receive a user input setting a reference distance for detecting a surrounding environment of a space to be cleaned through an external control device and that can control traveling on the basis of the user input, and to a robot cleaning system including the same. According to the present invention, an actuator of a robot cleaner is controlled on the basis of the reference distance set by a user, so that the robot cleaner can be controlled not to fall into inability to travel due to a cleaning environment.

title_en: Apparatus and method for learning schedule management based on listening learning
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a device and a method for managing a learning schedule based on listening learning. The device includes: a login detection unit for detecting the login of a user terminal; a learning parking determining unit for determining learning parking associated with the detection time point based on a learning schedule distributed for each week for the entire learning period when the login is detected; a learning progress display unit for visualizing and displaying the learning progress with respect to the plurality of learning contents distributed in the learning week; and a learning content providing unit for providing the plurality of learning contents to the user terminal in association with the learning progress.

title_en: Disturbance Estimation Device Against Measurement Noise
abstract_en: Disclosed is a measurement noise-robust disturbance estimation device in which a deep Q-neural network (DQN)-based disturbance observer that adaptively selects an observer gain is designed in a system for the system to be robust to measurement noise and which quickly determines a line failure through learning using appropriate an observation gain. The disturbance estimation device according to the present invention comprises: an observation target system equipped with a power generator; a reinforcement learning module which adaptively determines an observation gain in the presence of disturbance and measurement noise using a deep Q-neural network (DQN) that receives and learns a power angle including measurement noise and an estimation value of the power angle that is fed back; and a disturbance observer which feeds back the estimation value of the power angle to the reinforcement learning module and estimates the magnitude of the disturbance that changes the output of the power generator based on the observation gain determined by the reinforcement learning module.

title_en: Medication management methood for clinical trial and apparatus implementing the same method
abstract_en: A method performed by a clinical trial management apparatus according to an embodiment of the present invention includes the following steps: determining whether or not a subject normally takes the medicine based on the subject's medicine-taking information received from a smart medicine cabinet; and granting compensation mileage to the subject's account if the number of normal medications calculated based on the determination satisfies a preset condition.

title_en: System and method for an integrated control of smart home and building based on an add on scheme using knx protocol
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for the integrated control of a smart home and building based on an add-on scheme using KNX protocol. The system comprises: an artificial intelligence (AI) speaker which receives voice input and converts the same into digital signals; an AI server which receives the voice input, which has been converted into digital signals and is transmitted from the AI speaker through a communication network, analyzes the voice input and generates a floor indicator panel (FIP) control signal for at least one device to be controlled; an FIP which is installed on each floor of a building, receives an FIP control signal for the at least one device to be controlled, which is installed in each room or office, from the AI server, and converts the received control signal into a control signal for each controller; a main controller which is installed in each room or office and receives a control signal for a controller from the FIP; and at least one expanded controller which is connected in series to the main controller, receives a control signal from the main controller, and transmits a control signal for controlling the corresponding device to be controlled to the corresponding device to be controlled. The at least one expanded controller includes at least one sensor and transmits sensing information, which is generated based on a signal detected by the at least one sensor, to the AI server through the main controller. Therefore, various building loads can be controlled in connection with an interactive home and building load control speaker.

title_en: Method for expression of color information using tactile patterns
abstract_en: Disclosed is a method for displaying color information using tactile patterns. The present invention relates to a method for displaying color information including first to third colors. The method comprises the steps of: displaying a first tactile pattern corresponding to the first color; displaying a second tactile pattern corresponding to the second color; and displaying a third tactile pattern corresponding to the third color. The first tactile pattern to the third tactile pattern are defined according to color differences in the first color, the second color, and the third color. The first tactile pattern may include a plurality of stripes in a first direction, the second tactile pattern may include a plurality of stripes in a second direction, and the third tactile pattern may include a plurality of stripes in a third direction. According to the present invention, the method enables color-blind people as well as the visually impaired to recognize colors without any training or learning.

title_en: The muliple level english reading book
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a multi-level English learning book. The multi-level English learning book of the present invention is manufactured by bookbinding a cover unit which specifies and displays an original book and an inner unit which is inside the cover unit in a wireless or hardcover method and receiving one ISBN. The inner unit comprises: an original English inner unit in which original English data of the original book is sequentially printed; at least one lower level English inner unit which is placed above the original English inner unit, has the same writing content to the original English inner unit, and prints content with levels of vocabulary, sentence structures, grammars or meaning lower than the original English of the original English inner unit; and a level guide unit which explains levels applied to the lower level English inner unit. The purpose of the present invention is to provide a multi-level English learning book manufactured in one file.

title_en: Operation method for kiosk for accomodation and apparatus thereof
abstract_en: Various embodiments relate to a method and apparatus for operating a kiosk for accommodation. According to the present invention, an electronic device includes: an output part; and one or more processors connected to the output part. Various customized services can be provided for customers using the accommodation.

title_en: Method and apparatus for calculating attention by real-time log analysis
abstract_en: In the present application, a concentration calculation method and a concentration calculation device are provided. According to an embodiment of the present invention, a concentration calculation method includes the steps of: acquiring problems to be solved by a target learner and a solution order of the problems; obtaining a level of the target learner; obtaining a reference time of each of the problems according to the level; among the problems, determining a problem in which a target learner's solution time exceeds a standard time is a problem with low concentration; and outputting a warning notification when the number of problems with reduced concentration is greater than or equal to a threshold value.

title_en: Apparatus for Processing Data between Neighbors based on Artificial Intelligence and Method for Processing Data between Neighbors Using the Same
abstract_en: The present invention provides a device for processing data between neighbors, aiming to prevent various types of inter-floor noise-related disputes in an apartment house and to facilitate friendly and communicative resolutions based on mutual consideration; and a data processing method using the same. The device for processing data between neighbors based on AI according to embodiments of the present invention allows neighbors to not only communicate conveniently, quickly, and accurately by voice but also communicate and act thoughtfully in a way of not offending each other, such as through an unbiased mediator, thereby effectively preventing and resolving the inter-floor noise disputes. The device for processing data between neighbors comprises a first communication device, a sensor, and a second communication device.

title_en: Bedside device, method for receiveing measured biometric information of a patient to monitor the patient's condition of location, and computer program
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present disclosure, provided is a method for generating an alarm signal by receiving measured biometric information of a patient comprising: a step of allowing a bedside device to receive patient identification information of a patient to be managed from a hospital central server, identifying and sensing a biometric measuring device of the patient to be managed with the patient identifying information, and establishing communication connection with the biometric measuring device; a step of allowing the bedside device to receive measured information corresponding to the patient identification information from the hospital central server and changing the communication connection with the biometric measuring device based on the measured information; a step of allowing the bedside device to generate an alarm signal for the biometric signal by considering whether the biometric signal is received and biometric information obtained from the biometric signal; and a step of allowing the bedside device to display the alarm signal. The present invention receives the biometric signal and manages a condition of the patient.

title_en: Refrigeration system automatic control system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a refrigeration apparatus automatic control system. Here, the refrigeration apparatus automatic control system comprises: a refrigeration apparatus (1) having a detection apparatus (100) having a built-in sensor for measuring the temperature of a liquid and transmitting a signal; a data input apparatus (200) receiving the signal coming from the temperature sensor and transmitting the signal to a management server; a management server (300) receiving and storing the sensor data in a database, and providing a user interface, and transmitting a notification message to an external terminal device when the sensor data deviate from a threshold value; and an interface (400) inputting the sensor data detected by the temperature sensor and default data which are the reference for controlling the operation of the management server; and an external terminal device (500) connected to a network through a wired/wireless communication means. Therefore, the operation control of a refrigeration apparatus can be conducted automatically at a precise time.

title_en: MBS particle size prediction model construction method, MBS polymerization management system and method applying it
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an MBS particle size prediction model construction method, and an MBS polymerization management system and method applying the same. More specifically, the present invention relates to a system and method for streamlining MBS polymerization management by constructing a particle size prediction model to track and predict in real time the particle size which changes in the MBS polymerization reaction.

title_en: Device, system and method for managing controller of semiconductor processing equipment
abstract_en: The present invention provides a controller management device, a controller management system, and a controller management method for semiconductor processing equipment. Even if a controller is operated for a long time by self-diagnosing and managing the status of each controller which controls various process devices included in the semiconductor processing equipment, the best operating performance of the semiconductor processing equipment can be maintained.

title_en: Heating controller
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a heating controller. The heating controller according to one embodiment of the present invention includes: a central control module which generates a control signal for controlling a heating device and outputs an operating state of the heating device; and a terminal coupling module which is provided to connect the heating device so that control data received from the central control module is transmitted to the heating device and data input from the heating device is transmitted to the central control module. The heating controller can perform integrated monitoring and management of multiple heating devices.

title_en: Apparatus, System and Method for measuring soil surface static electricity using a capacitive structure, and a recording medium recording a computer readable program for executing the method
abstract_en: Disclosed are an apparatus for measuring static electricity of a soil surface using a capacitive structure, a system for the same, a method thereof, and a recording medium recording a computer-readable program for executing the method thereof. The apparatus for measuring static electricity of a soil surface using a capacitive structure includes a bottom unit, multiple electrodes, and a capacitance calculation unit. The bottom unit is formed for soil to be piled on the upper surface. Multiple electrodes are separated from each other while being individually in contact with the soil piled on the bottom unit. The multiple electrodes include the capacitance calculation unit calculating the capacitance of the soil by using a current and a voltage in the multiple electrodes. According to the present invention, the soil is inserted into a probe having an empty dielectric space, and a change in dielectric permittivity is detected. Therefore, static electricity on the soil surface can be efficiently and directly detected.

title_en: Method and user terminal for training investigative interview techniques
abstract_en: An investigative interview technique training method and user terminal are disclosed. The investigative interview technique training method comprises the step of: accessing to an education server and outputting information on case summaries and information on people being investigated for a select case subject to practice training; receiving an open-ended question for investigating the people being investigated of the case subject to practice training from trainees; outputting a first answer to the open-ended question when the input open-ended question is a first correct answer according to the case subject to practice training, and outputting first instructor feedback when the input open-ended question is not the first correct answer; receiving a question for opening evidence of the people being investigated from the trainees; outputting a second answer to the question for opening the evidence when the input question for opening the evidence is the second correct answer according to the case subject to practice training, and outputting second instructor feedback when the input question for opening the evidence is not the second correct answer; receiving a question for reconstructing the case subject to practice training form the trainees; and outputting a third answer to the question for reconstructing the case when the input question for reconstructing the case is a third correct answer according to the case subject to practice training, and outputting third instructor feedback when the input question for reconstructing the case is not the third correct answer. According to the present invention, the trainees can train investigative interview techniques through online practice while communicating with an instructor online.

title_en: Stick For Blind
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a cane for the blind, which measures the condition of a pedestrian road in detail and informs the visually impaired thereof to allow the visually impaired to walk more safely. More specifically, the cane for the blind according to the present invention can prevent loss thereof and protect the hands of a user from external temperature and impacts. The cane of the present invention has a guide function to provide a more accurate walking route and has a wristband to prevent a handle from coming off from the user's hand even when the handle is released, thereby enabling the user to use hands freely as necessary. In addition, the wristband has sensors for detecting blood pressure, pulse, and body temperature to detect the conditions of the user in real time and inform the user thereof.

title_en: A correction system for essay education for youth and a method for providing the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a correction system for essay education. The correction system for essay education which connects a student smartphone, a service server, and a tutor smartphone to each other via a network, comprises: a student smartphone which has a correction module transmitted from the service server installed therein, requires an essay question transmission to the service server, receives the essay questions transmitted to display the same, transmits an essay answer input by a user to the service server, and receives a correction answer transmitted from the service server to display the same; a service server which stores lecture information, essay questions, member information, essay question answers, the correction module, and correction answers, transmits a specific essay question to the student smartphone according to the request of essay question transmission transmitted from the student smartphone, receives and stores an essay question answer transmitted from the student smartphone to transmit the same to the tutor smartphone, and receives and stores a correction answer transmitted from the tutor smartphone to transmit the same to the student smartphone; and a tutor smartphone which has the correction module transmitted from the service server installed therein, receives an essay question answer transmitted from the service server to display the same, generates a correction answer on the essay question answer and transmits the same to the service server. According to the present invention, the system synchronizes the correction, writing, and guiding voices about an answer on an essay question written by a student to provide correction lectures as if the student takes a real lecture.

title_en: System for parking guiding using sensor and existing cctv
abstract_en: A parking guidance system using a sensor and existing CCTV of the present invention includes: a plurality of distance sensors which measure the distance to the front and rear of a vehicle on the parking surface; a parking guidance module which determines whether the left and right spacing of the parked vehicle is appropriate based on distance data collected from the distance sensor; a notification module which informs a car owner whether the left and right spacing determined by the parking guidance module is appropriate; and a control unit which controls the distance sensor, the parking guidance module, and the notification module.

title_en: Apparatus for inspecting battery pack protection circuit
abstract_en: An objective of the present invention is to provide an apparatus for inspecting a battery pack protection circuit, which is capable of detecting the current leaking from a protection circuit. The present invention relates to an apparatus for inspecting a protection circuit including n+1 channels, in which n (n is a natural number of 2 or more) or more battery cells are connected, which control charging and discharging through monitoring of each of the n battery cells. To this end, the apparatus for inspecting a protection circuit comprises: a connection unit connected to a connector of the protection circuit including n+1 battery-side terminals connected to the n battery cells and including connection terminals connected to each of the n+1 battery-side terminals; a power supply unit which operates the protection circuit by sequentially applying a driving voltage to each connection terminal of the connection unit and sequentially providing the driving voltage to the n+1 channels of the protection circuit; a current sensing unit which outputs a current signal by detecting a current flowing in the protection circuit as the driving voltage is applied; and a microcomputer which generates analysis information on a short-circuit or short-circuit condition in the protection circuit using the sensed current signal.

title_en: Drone for gas flaring ignition and remote automatic control system for the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a drone for gas flaring ignition including: a main body; and an ignition unit coupled to the main body. The drone for gas flaring ignition flies over the plant, ignites the gas discharged from a flare tip using the ignition unit. According to the present invention, igniting gas flaring becomes easy with the drone for gas flaring ignition.

title_en: Electric kick board smart key system and control method thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an electric kickboard smart key system and a control method thereof, capable of preventing theft and burglary by determining a distance between an electric kickboard and a smart key and automatically restricting kickboard motor lock and control functions when the distance exceeds a certain distance through Bluetooth (BLE) communication between the electric kickboard and a smartphone that acts as the smart key. When a power switch is operated, the electric kickboard smart key system is woken-up, advertising is performed through low-energy Bluetooth communication with the smartphone that acts as the smart key, scan is requested via smartphone and Bluetooth, the motor is locked and a sleep mode is automatically entered if no scan response is received from the smartphone, data is transmitted and received when the scan response from the smartphone is received, the motor continues to operate if a determined distance from the smartphone is within a preset certain distance when determining the distance from the smartphone, and the motor is automatically locked and control functions are limited to prevent theft and burglary if the distance from the smartphone exceeds the preset certain distance.

title_en: A factory simulator-based scheduling neural network learning system with lot history reproduction function
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a factory simulator-based scheduling neural network learning system with a lot history reproduction function, which records the history of a last lot before a specific process among simulation data generated by a simulator and generates various cases from the recorded history of the last lot to train a neural network of a corresponding process, the factory simulator-based scheduling neural network learning system comprising: a simulation execution unit using a factory simulator to simulate a factory workflow and collect the simulation data; a lot history recording unit simulating 'processes up to the specific process' (hereinafter referred to as a first stage) through the simulation execution unit to record lot history information of the specific process; an episode reproduction unit using the lot history information to generate a plurality of production episodes of a second stage and simulating 'processes after the specific process' (hereinafter referred to as the second stage) according to the generated production episodes through the simulation execution unit; and a learning execution unit generating learning data from the simulation results of the second stage to train a scheduling neural network of the corresponding process. Accordingly, by recording the history of the last lot before the specific process among the simulation data by the simulator to use the same for training the neural network of the corresponding process, the system may generate various cases from the history of the last lot to generate the learning data and quickly perform a learning process without repeating a simulation process up to a last process before the specific process.

title_en: A device for generating an isoline shape considering moving speed of the means of transportation.
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a device for generating an isochrone figure by considering a moving speed of a means of transportation. The device includes a mover information input unit, a moving-speed database, a map database, a slope database, a traffic network database, an actual-distance database, and an isochrone generation unit. According to the present invention, it is possible to provide realistic and practical information for establishing an urban plan.

title_en: Learning apparatus for autonomous driving using reinforcement learning model and learning method therefor
abstract_en: An apparatus for learning autonomous driving includes at least one processor. the at least one processor performs learning of a basic model by imitation learning using driving data, and performs learning of an agent implemented using a reinforcement learning model configured based on the learned basic model. the reinforcement learning model includes an actor network using the basic model as a first backbone network and a creative network using the basic model as a second backbone network.

title_en: Digital twin-based customized production service system
abstract_en: A purpose of the present invention is to provide a digital twin-based customized production service system capable of minimizing the influence of environmental conditions on the quality of a product by monitoring the real-time production status of a production plant unit based on digital twin, and easily and quickly ordering and producing a customized product through the improvement of an ordering process. A system comprises: a production factory unit having a plurality of IoT sensors collecting production state information including an operating state of a facility producing a product and a surrounding environment state; a virtual factory unit implementing a virtual space of a digital twin matched one-to-one with the production factory unit by using the production state information collected by the IoT sensor; an integrated control unit monitoring and controlling the production factory unit through the virtual factory unit and transmitting customized production information to the production factory unit; and a customized service unit generating customized production information through information exchange with a connected customer and transmitting the customized production information to the integrated control unit.

title_en: Apparatus and method for providing notification
abstract_en: Provided are an apparatus and a method for providing a notification in an electronic device of the present disclosure. The electronic device comprises: a communication unit for receiving information on whether a wearable device is worn from one or more wearable devices; and a processing unit for determining a wearable device worn by a user based on the received information on whether the wearable device is worn, and providing a notification to the determined wearable device.

title_en: Pedestrian Alert Apparatus
abstract_en: A pedestrian notification device is disclosed. According to an aspect of the present embodiment, provided is a pedestrian notification device comprising: a communication unit for performing short-range wireless communication with a driver terminal and a pedestrian terminal and transmitting and receiving data; a location analysis unit for analyzing the location of each terminal using communication characteristics between the communication unit and each terminal; and a control unit for controlling the communication unit to notify whether each terminal is approaching each other based on the location of each terminal analyzed by the location analysis unit.

title_en: Shared Mobility Safety System based on Sensor for Wearing Safety Equipment
abstract_en: A shared mobility safety system based on a safety equipment wearing sensor according to an embodiment of the present invention includes a shared mobility including a head protector and safety equipment having a fastening string, and a safety equipment wearing sensor unit which grants or releases the right to use the shared mobility to a user according to whether the safety equipment is worn. The safety equipment includes a first sensor which detects whether the user is in contact by adjusting the length of the fastening string and a second sensor which detects whether the head protector and the fastening string are coupled. The safety equipment provides information detected from the first sensor and the second sensor to a mobility server.

title_en: Kiosk with built-in sensor to detect wearing protective gear for access and safety management
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kiosk with a built-in sensor for detecting the wearing state of protective equipment for access and safety management used by a user entering a harmful chemical substance handling workplace. According to an embodiment of the present invention, a kiosk comprises: an interface unit for communication with a user using the kiosk; a fingerprint recognition unit for identifying the user by reading a fingerprint registered by the user through a fingerprint recognizer installed in the kiosk and issued; an image acquisition unit for acquiring an image including the entire body of the user; a camera additionally connected to and mounted on an already installed kiosk or integrally installed in the kiosk to have a sensor function for detecting the wearing state of the protective equipment of the entering user; a database unit for storing the user identified by the fingerprint, the time of access of the user, information on the wearing state of the protective equipment of the user identified by the camera, and a whole body image of the user; and a control unit for controlling the functions of the components and, in particular, performing a function of monitoring access and safety management.

title_en: Child practice chopsticks
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide chopsticks for children, which can be safely used by improving unsanitary properties of the chopsticks for children including a finger insertion ring. A holder in which the chopsticks and sleeves coupling upper ends of the chopsticks are connected by hinges is formed of a corrosion-resistant metal material. The finger insertion ring is formed in a C shape by a spring steel wire material. A ring groove for seating a ring of the finger insertion ring is formed on the chopstick on one side. The ring of the finger insertion ring is a coil. The outer end of the ring is formed as a round knot part to prevent injuries due to a sharp cutting part.

title_en: User program exception error maintenance method of plc system
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present disclosure, a plc system comprises: a memory storing a plc program; and a control unit performing an operation for controlling an external device based on the plc program. The memory can store an index table including an index assigned to each function block of the plc program.

title_en: FIRE DETECTION AND EVACUATION GUIDANCE SYSTEM USING IoT COMPLEX SENSOR
abstract_en: The present invention is to provide a system that detects a fire, informs people in a building of the occurrence of the fire, and quickly and safely guides everyone to a safe area until the fire is fully suppressed, allowing effective evacuation. The present invention provides a fire detection and evacuation guidance system using Internet of things (IoT) complex detection sensors. The system includes a plurality of IoT complex detection sensors, a management server, a plurality of first control modules, and a plurality of second control modules.

title_en: Apparatus for controlling electric power steering system and method thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a control device of an electric power steering device, which comprises: a filter module receiving column torque, a steering angle, and a motor speed as an input and outputting a predicted motor angle and column torque; and a processor receiving the predicted motor angle and column torque output from the filter module as an input to calculate an estimated steering angle, and outputting a command current for controlling a motor according to a designated steering logic.

title_en: Vehicle detection device using multipoint distance detection sensor for parking control
abstract_en: A vehicle detection device using a multipoint distance measurement sensor for parking control comprises: a holder provided with a horizontal support extended from a wall surface or a support of a parking lot; and a multipoint distance measurement unit inserted and attached to the holder, having a control unit (mcu) and a storage unit, connected to the mcu, and measuring a distance to a moving body including a vehicle or a person for parking control. A vehicle detection device using a multi-point distance measuring sensor for parking control is provided to detect a vehicle by using a tof camera sensor/ultrasonic sensor/camera and a light source sensor which identifies a vehicle age and a person for parking control without using an existing loop antenna type camera sensor which is expensive and time consuming to bury and construct a loop antenna on the floor for parking control.

title_en: Apparatus and method of simulating interior
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method and an apparatus for simulating an interior and, more specifically, to a method and an apparatus for simulating an interior, which show a texture and a combination state of a material by arranging an interior material such as a floor material, a wallpaper material, lighting, furniture, and the like in a small model, and simulate and show an indoor color according to a lighting environment and an indoor living environment in which various furniture are arranged.

title_en: Transport vehicle
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a transport vehicle which transports an article. The transport vehicle comprises: a traveling device having a traveling drive unit; a control device which controls the traveling device; and a power supply unit which receives power supply from the outside and supplies power to at least the traveling device and the control device. A voltage supplied from the power supply unit to the traveling device is set as a target voltage (v1), and a lower limit voltage required to operate the traveling device is set as a required lower limit voltage (vs1). The control device monitors the target voltage (v1). During traveling of the transport vehicle, when the target voltage becomes equal to or less than a determination threshold value (vt1) set to a value lower than a voltage during normal operation of the power supply unit and higher than the required lower limit voltage (vs1), deceleration stop processing for lowering the traveling speed of the transport vehicle and stopping the traveling of the transport vehicle is executed.

title_en: Driving control system for robots for green houses
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a driving control system of a robot for a facility house, which controls the robot to move along a predetermined driving path while checking the posture and driving direction of the robot through a laser sensor. According to the present invention, a driving control system of a robot for a facility house comprises: a working robot performing work for cultivation while driving along a predetermined path in a facility house; a first laser irradiation unit installed in the working robot to irradiate a laser along a direction of the working robot; a first driving control module installed on one side of the facility house and including a laser target receiving the laser irradiated from the first laser irradiation unit; and a driving control unit calculating a driving direction of the working robot through a receiving position of the laser received from the laser target of the first driving control module and transmitting a driving direction control command to a driving unit of the working robot.

title_en: Device for detecting black ice
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus for detecting black ice, which comprises: a first lidar light v3 sensor module installed perpendicular to the ground to acquire distance data reflected from asphalt and black ice; a second lidar light v3 sensor module installed within a range of 0° to 80° with the ground to acquire inclination angle data of asphalt and black ice; a control unit for analyzing the distance and angle data acquired by the first and second lidar light v3 sensor modules to determine black ice; a display for displaying warning characters for the black ice; and a power supply unit for supplying power.

title_en: Learning-Based cooperative multipurpose autonomous working robot system for construction
abstract_en: Provided is an autonomous driving multipurpose work robot system for collaborative construction based on learning. The autonomous driving multipurpose work robot system for collaborative construction based on learning comprises: an autonomous driving transport robot including a first moving platform on which a loading box in which a plurality of floor finishing materials are spaced apart from each other is placed on an upper end through guide pieces arranged at equal intervals therein, and a finishing material supply means installed on the first moving platform to supply the floor finishing materials one by one to the outside, and pushing and supplying the floor finishing materials one by one after individual access to the height position of the floor finishing materials on each floor; and an autonomous driving work robot for adjusting a speed of moving to the next installation position in response to the weight of the floor finishing materials loaded in the loading box using a pre-learned learning model. According to the present invention, the autonomous driving work robot can automatically perform a building finishing material installation work at a construction site through collaboration with the autonomous driving transport robot. In addition, the present invention may adjust a speed at which the vehicle moves to the next installation position in response to the weight of the floor finishing material loaded on the autonomous driving transport robot.

title_en: Liquid hydrogen drone fuel remaining notification system and its control method
abstract_en: A liquid hydrogen drone fuel remaining amount notification system is provided, comprising: a sensor unit for measuring the weight of a liquid hydrogen container when the liquid hydrogen container in which liquid hydrogen is stored is mounted on a drone; a mass flow meter (MFM) for measuring the amount of hydrogen used between the liquid hydrogen container and the fuel cell stack; a control unit for receiving the weight and fuel usage detected by the sensor unit and the mass flow meter via the input of the ID of the liquid hydrogen container, and calculating the remaining fuel amount by comparing it with a preset remaining amount value; and a communication unit for transmitting the data calculated by the control unit to a drone controller. According to one embodiment of the present invention, the remaining fuel amount of the liquid hydrogen container is measured through the sensor unit, and when the remaining fuel amount measured by the control unit is calculated to be below a preset threshold, the communication unit transmits this in real time to the drone controller, thereby allowing the drone controller to predict the remaining liquid hydrogen amount in advance and prevent a drone crash.

title_en: AI-based processing room temperature and humidity control device
abstract_en: The present invention provides an AI-based apparatus for controlling a temperature and a humidity of a processing room controlling the temperature and the humidity of the processing room, which is a target space, based on an AI (Artificial Intelligence), comprising: a cooling means cooling a temperature control medium; a heating means heating the temperature control medium; one or more environmental sensors sensing an internal and an external environment of the processing room; and a control unit understanding a state of the processing room according to an environmental data sensed by the environmental sensors to control the cooling means and the heating means, wherein the control unit includes: a data collection part collecting the environmental data collected by the environmental sensors; a data preprocessing part preprocessing one-dimensional environmental data collected by the data collection part into multi-dimensions through a time series and a phase change; and a data analysis part analyzing the environmental data preprocessed by the data preprocessing part, and determining the state of the processing room through an artificial neural network operation.

title_en: Model-based diagnostic mechatronic control system
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a model-based diagnostic mechatronic control system, comprising an intelligent analysis computing server, an offline diagnostic system, and an online diagnostic system. The input end of the intelligent analysis computing server is electrically connected through wires to a camera module and a sensor module. By incorporating a model compensation update module, this invention enables, in practical use, the offline and online diagnostic systems to send the solution data obtained from one analysis processing to the data storage retrieval unit. Then, through the data feedback update unit, various model parameters and solution data are saved and iterated. This facilitates timely and intelligent updating of various data and solutions. Finally, these data and solutions are sent to the model compensation update module for integration, comparison, and calculation, thereby updating and optimizing the model program. This addition of feedback iterative data helps address the issues caused by data redundancy, such as clutter and slow processing speeds, effectively solving problems associated with data overload.

title_en: Maximum likelihood multi-innovation optimization design method for controlled autoregressive moving average system
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a maximum likelihood multi-innovation optimization design method for a controlled autoregressive moving average system, comprising the following steps: determining the time range and frequency of data acquisition, collecting the control signal input by the system and the response signal output and performing preprocessing; selecting an ARMA model structure to generate a preliminary model, calculating the predicted value of the preliminary model; calculating the innovation according to the predicted value and constructing the likelihood function, performing parameter optimization and iterative updating; calculating the residual and performing an autocorrelation test according to the residual graph, then calculating the AIC and BIC, comparing the goodness of fit of different models, and finally performing online prediction and control, and determining retraining or adjustment or obtaining the final model according to the performance of the model.

title_en: Anti-theft electronic seal.
abstract_en: A bolt includes a conductor having an accommodation hole and a circuit board installed in the accommodation hole, where the upper part of the conductor is covered with an insulating sleeve, and the lower part thereof is configured with a first engagement portion, a RFID chip and lower contact of the circuit board is formed into a control circuit, and the lower contact is allowed to be protruded out of the bottom end of the accommodation hole. An antenna and elastic sheet are configured inside the bolt seat, and the outer peripheral thereof is configured with an insertion hole and second engagement portion adapted to position the first engagement portion, the elastic sheet have a pre-pressure to allow the antenna, control circuit and conductor to be in electric connection with one another. Whereby, the electric connection can be interrupted when the bolt is cut.

title_en: Closure system and method thereof.
abstract_en: A closure system including a curtain configured to seal an opening, a wireless network having a plurality of channels, at least one transmitter coupled to the curtain and configured to communicate over the plurality of channels, and an operator operatively coupled to the curtain and configured to communicate over the plurality of channels, the operator and the at least one transmitter configured to communicate with each other over a selected one of the plurality of channels based upon communication interference detected on one or more channels.

title_en: Automated transaction machine.
abstract_en: An automated transaction machine (ATM) can include a housing, a display, a cash recycler, and a check receiver. The display can be mounted to the housing and directed toward an exterior of the housing. The cash recycler can be configured to receive a first note of currency from a first user of the ATM and dispense the first note of currency to a subsequent, second user of the ATM. The check receiver can be positioned in the housing, an intake portion with an inlet communicating with the exterior of the housing, and a check reader portion configured to receive a check from the intake portion, scan data displayed on the check, and store the check. The intake portion can be positioned below the display and the check reader portion is positioned behind the display.

title_en: Autonomous transportation of cargo.
abstract_en: An autonomous vessel and method for transporting a cargo from an origin to a destination utilizing water currents, a satellite location system, and a satellite communication system includes a hull for navigating a body of water. A communication module is adapted for wireless communication with local contacts and the satellite communication system. A propulsion module is adapted to propel the hull through the body of water and preferably includes one or more relatively low-power electric motors. A navigation module is adapted to steer the hull towards a next waypoint. The navigation module preferably includes a rudder control system and is connected with a location module that is itself adapted for communication with the satellite location system to find a current location of the hull on the body of water. A controller is adapted for controlling the modules, sending information, and for receiving commands and information.

title_en: Asset tracking device and methods for location determination.
abstract_en: An asset tracking device and method for detecting the presence of an intermodal shipping container and responsively selecting a preferred location determination. The device may include a controller, a sensor coupled to the controller, a global navigation satellite system chip, and a cellular signal transceiver. While not detecting a container, the controller obtains location data via a global satellite system chip. While a container is detected, the sensor sends a detection signal to the controller and, responsive to the detection signal, the controller obtains location data from a cellular signal transceiver and not from the global satellite system chip.

title_en: Digital neighbor alarm
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a digital vicinal alarm comprising: a cabinet incorporating an electroacoustic siren, a camera system and an illumination device. An emergency power supply and a control board connected to the electro-acoustic siren, the camera system and the lighting device are located inside the cabinet. This control card is equipped with a power supply unit, at least one memory unit, at least one processor, a call reception system and a wireless communication transmitter/receiver. The lighting device includes at least one strobe LED light, the camera system having night vision and connected to a web monitoring platform by wireless connection.

title_en: Systems and methods for optimizing formation fracturing operations
abstract_en: Systems and methods generate optimized formation fracturing operational parameters by iteratively optimizing bottom hole temperature design, perforation design, fracturing fluid pulse design, and proppant design based on formation properties, proppant properties, candidate selection, flow and geomechanical modeling, and engineering design, where the systems and methods as implemented on a digital processing unit.

title_en: System for precise control of environmental variables for the production of seedlings in growth chambers with a controlled environment
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a control system for controlling environmental variables for the production of seedlings in growth chambers, which includes an outer shell for thermal insulation with an access door with a hermetic seal that defines a growth chamber with a controlled environment therein. Said chamber comprises a plurality of shelves configured to support containers with a substrate, a camcorder to transmit image and video, a temperature sensor, a relative humidity sensor, and an infrared sensor to measure CO2 concentration and a remote communication system with an internet connection connected to an electronic system. Said system monitors and controls a lighting system, a cooling system with a cooling coil, an air movement system with air recirculation ducts, a CO2 injection system with a tank, an electro valve, and a distribution duct for CO2. Further, it controls an irrigation system including a water tank for irrigation, a submersible, pump and a water-dosing duct, an air saturation humidification system, and a condensed water collection system.

title_en: An education system for providing online learning platform
abstract_en: The present invention discloses an education system for providing online learning platform comprising an account module (101) for managing a plurality of accounts including student accounts (108), parent accounts (109) and teacher accounts (107); a teacher module (105) for managing educational contents (110) uploaded by the teacher accounts (107); a matching module (102) for performing a matching process between the student accounts (108) and the teacher accounts (107), the student accounts (108) are allowed to access to the educational contents (110) uploaded by the matched teacher accounts (107); and a filtering module (103) to filter the uploaded educational contents (110) based on set criteria; in which the system further comprising a parental module (104) configured to allow the parent accounts (109) to choose suitable educational contents (110) for forming a programme to be imposed on the student accounts (108) associated with the parent accounts (109). (Fig. 1)

title_en: Patient alarm system and device therefor
abstract_en: An activation device for a patient alarm system, the activation device comprising a resiliently deformable bladder defining an internal volume, and a pressure switch in fluid communication with the internal volume and connected to an alarm system, whereby squeezing the resiliently deformable bladder operates the pressure switch, which activates the alarm system.

title_en: A distribution network for monitoring, controlling and optimizing flow of liquid beverage products delivered to customers via containers
abstract_en: A liquid product distribution network monitor, controls, and optimizes the flow of liquid products for delivery to consumers served via liquid product dispensing containers, such as a beer keg. At least one liquid product dispensing container includes a small form factor, battery powered radio transmitter and microprocessor for sensing and transmitting a plurality of data measurements relating to the status of said liquid product dispensing container, wherein said radio transmitter is configured to operate in an encrypted, non-connectable mode. A stationary or mobile radio signal reader communicates data measurements from the radio transmitter, wherein said mobile signal reader operates passively without user interaction. Data collection functions include liquid product management functions, liquid product sales functions, and liquid product consumer management functions. A computer processing server communicates with an internet communications or cloud interface. Reporting and marketing sales interface with the functions of producing, distributing, vending, and consuming the liquid products.

title_en: A game system for accumulating symbols to increase reward points
abstract_en: The invention provides a game system which provides a slot game. The slot game starts a reward game after satisfying an activation event, and the reward game comprises at least one free round played in sequence. In each free round, a game result generating unit generates a plurality of group symbols. If a control unit determines that any one of the group symbols is a designated pattern with an associated point, a display position where the designated pattern kept displaying the designated pattern in the reward game; if the control unit determines that any one of the group symbols is a linking symbol with a predetermined rule, the linking symbol is associated with the designated pattern kept displaying in the reward game, and according to the predetermined rule, the associated point of the designated pattern associated with the linking symbol is changed.

title_en: Automated control system for the compounding process of mixed oils with regulation of pumping and discharge of sour oil
abstract_en:
FIELD: automation equipment.  
     SUBSTANCE: invention relates to automation equipment and can be used in pipeline transport when pumping oil from several pipelines into a common pipeline through which the oil mixture is transported to the consumer. The automated control system for compounding mixed-grade oils with regulation of pumping and discharge of sour oil contains at least two oil pipelines intended for transporting oil streams and an oil pipeline intended for a mixed flow, a unit for measuring the quality indicators of a mixed flow, a unit for measuring the parameter of a sour oil flow, sour oil flow rate meter and mixed flow rate meter, computing devices for recording the amount of sour oil and the total amount of the mixed flow, as well as for determining the ratio of the rate of sour oil to the flow rate of the mixed flow to increase control efficiency, flow control device, while the outputs of the measurement unit the parameter of the flow of sour oil, the unit for measuring the quality indicators of the mixed flow, the meter for the flow rate of the sour oil and the meter for the flow rate of the mixed flow are interconnected with the corresponding information inputs of the control unit. the control output of which is interconnected with the flow control device. A manifold branch with an installed pressure regulator is cut into the sulphurous oil line (SO) supplying the flow to the receiving line of the booster pumping station in front of the flow control device designed to maintain the pressure on the sulphurous oil line at a value that is no more than a specified value while regulating the flow rate of pumping sour oil for mixing and allowing a part of the oil flow to be dumped into the reservoir when the pressure regulator is triggered. At the same time, a function for monitoring the maximum pressure value on the sulphurous oil line was introduced in the control unit (CU), when the set pressure value is reached, a control signal is sent to open the valve of the pressure regulator, while part of the flow is discharged into the reservoir, and when the pressure drops, the valve is closed or completely closes. 
     EFFECT: ensuring the maintenance of the specified quality indicators of the compounded oil, ensuring the pressure control and maintaining the pressure within the specified limits in the pipeline with sour oil entering the common pipeline, ensuring the accounting of the amount of oil sent to the consumer through the common pipeline, and the amount of sulphurous oil, as well as the amount of discharged sour oil into the tank.  
     6 cl, 2 dwg

title_en: Improving speed limit function (slf) confidence in a vehicle using rear-facing vision camera
abstract_en: Improving speed limit function (SLF) confidence in a vehicle using a rear-facing camera is disclosed. A vehicle is equipped with a forward-facing camera configured to capture images of road signs in the forward direction as it travels on a road path. The vehicle is also equipped with a rear-facing camera configured to capture images of road signs located and visible in a reverse direction of the direction of travel. If a speed limit sign is installed adjacent to the road path in the reverse direction of travel, the rear-facing camera can also capture an image of this speed limit sign. If vehicle detects a speed limit from a speed limit sign intended for the reverse direction to the direction of travel from a captured image from the rear-facing camera, the vehicle can also use the indicated speed limit to detect a change in speed limit.

title_en: Body bias voltage generating circuit
abstract_en: The present disclosure illustrates a body bias generator circuit for generating a body bias voltage to body of a transistor of a functional circuit. The body bias generator circuit includes: a first transistor and a second transistor which are connected in series between a power supply terminal and a ground terminal, and control terminals of the first transistor and the second transistor are connected to each other; a third transistor including a terminal electrically connected to body of one of the first transistor and the second transistor, and other terminal connected to the body thereof; a resistor element, connected between the terminal of the third transistor and a current input terminal of the first transistor or a current output terminal of the second transistor.

title_en: Method, data processing apparatus and computer program product for generating map data
abstract_en: Aspects concern a method for generating map data, the method including: generating of a plurality of cells of a real space area, each cell representing a two-dimensional sub-space of the real space area, wherein each of the cells comprise at least one global positioning system (GPS) point, and wherein the real space area comprises a road network; determining a number of GPS points for each cell of the plurality of cells; determining a road network based on the numbers of GPS points using a Smoothed Particle Hydrodynamics (SPH) analysis, wherein the cells of the plurality of cells are particles of the SPH analysis and the number of GPS points per cell of the plurality of cells are a scalar of each cell of the plurality of cells in the SPH analysis; and comparing the road network determined using the SPH analysis with the road network of the real space area.

title_en: Low-power voltage regulator with fast transient response
abstract_en: In certain aspects, a voltage regulator includes a pass device coupled between an input of the voltage regulator and an output of the voltage regulator. The voltage regulator also includes an amplifying circuit having a first input, a second input, and an output, wherein the first input is configured to receive a reference voltage, the second input is coupled to the output of the voltage regulator via a feedback path, and the output of the amplifying circuit is coupled to a gate of the pass device. The voltage regulator further includes a first current source coupled between a supply rail and the amplifying circuit, and a capacitor coupled between the first current source and the output of the voltage regulator.

title_en: Mechanical device cloud control system
abstract_en: A mechanical device cloud control system is suitable for controlling a plurality of mechanical devices. Each mechanical device includes a motion mechanism. The mechanical equipment cloud control system includes a servo system and at least one workstation system. The servo system receives a motion command related to a motion trajectory from a user end, and the motion trajectory is related to the motion mechanisms of the mechanical devices. The servo system interprets the motion command to generate an intermediate code, and according to the intermediate code performing edge operations to generate a control instruction set including a plurality of motion parameters related to the motion mechanisms of the mechanical devices. Each workstation system includes a wireless routing unit and multiple embedded systems. The embedded systems receive the control command set via the wireless routing unit, and control the electrically connected mechanical devices according to the control command set.

title_en: Control method of smart kitchen and smart kitchen system
abstract_en: A control method of a smart kitchen and a smart kitchen system are provided. In the control method, the receipt process is obtained. The sensing data is obtained. The personal parameter is determined according to the sensing data. The spatial location of the kitchen equipment is determined according to the personal parameter and the receipt process. A control command is generated according to the spatial location. The movable element of the kitchen equipment is adjusted to a specific spatial location through the control command. Accordingly, automatic control of the kitchen equipment is provided.

title_en: Comprehensive analysis module for determining processing equipment performance
abstract_en: A method includes receiving, by a processing device, first data indicative of a processing recipe. The method further includes receiving second data. The second data includes operational data associated with the processing recipe. The method further includes receiving third data. The third data includes historical data associated with the processing recipe. The method further includes performing analysis indicative of performance of a processing chamber based on the first, second, and third data. The method further includes causing performance of a corrective action in view of the analysis.

title_en: Intelligent electronic footwear and method for operating the same
abstract_en: Presented are intelligent electronic footwear, apparel, methods, and control systems for executing automated features. A method for operating an intelligent electronic shoe includes receiving, e.g., via a controller through a wireless communications device, location data of a user. The controller also receives, e.g., from remote computing node, location data for a target object or site. The controller retrieves or predicts path plan data including a derived route for traversing from the user's location to the target's location within a geographic area. The controller then transmits command signals to a navigation alert system mounted to the shoe to output visual, audio, and/or tactile cues that guide the user along the derived route.

title_en: Image sensors with improved negative pump voltage settling, and circuitry for the same
abstract_en: Image sensors with improved negative pump voltage settling, and circuitry for the same, are disclosed herein. In one embodiment, a power supply settling circuit includes a negative charge pump and a reference voltage generator. An output of the negative charge pump is selectively coupled to a first node of the negative pump settling circuit via a first switch, and an output of the reference voltage generator is selectively coupled to a second node of the negative pump settling circuit via a second switch. The first node is further selectively coupled to ground via a third switch, and the second node is further selectively coupled to ground via a fourth switch. The first node can additionally be coupled to a first pad, and the second node can additionally be coupled to a second pad. The pads can each be coupled to a capacitor, such as an off-chip capacitor.

title_en: Device for integrating production line data to provide auxiliary data for abnormal analysis and method thereof
abstract_en: A device for integrating production line data to provide auxiliary data for abnormal analysis and a method thereof are provided. By obtaining defective repair information generated when an inspection station sited behind an optical inspection device determines that a target material is abnormal from a repair system, reading material data of the target material from an optical test data table generated by integrating optical inspection data generated by the optical inspection device and control management data generated by control management systems on the production line based on the defective repair information, capturing a component location image from a material image of the target material according to a location message in the defective repair information, and integrating the material data, the defective repair information and the component location image to generate integrated information for the target material, the device and the method can integrate data from different testing stations to provide systematic analysis assistance, and can achieve the effect of improving efficiency of production line abnormality analysis.

title_en: Methodology and system for an automated material handling system rail control
abstract_en: A system and method for rail management of an overhead transport (“OHT”) system of an associated automated material handing system (“AMHS”) that includes a controller in communication with the OHT system, including vehicles traveling on rails of the OHT. The rail management system also includes a turntable located on a portion of the OHT and equipped with a set of fixed rails. Upon receipt of a request to rotate the turntable from a first run-through direction to a second run-through direction, the controller engages at least one stopper sensor located near the turntable. The controller then directs the turntable to rotate from the first run-through direction to the second run-through direction. After completion, the controller disengages the at least one stopper to enable vehicles to travel directly in the second run-through direction.

title_en: Current generator
abstract_en: A current generator includes a start-up circuit and a bandgap reference circuit. The start-up circuit is for generate a first voltage. The bandgap reference circuit is coupled to the start-up circuit for generating a second voltage. The bandgap reference circuit includes an operational amplifier, and the operational amplifier includes a bias start-up circuit and a bias-generating circuit. The bias start-up circuit is for generating a reference current according to the first voltage and the second voltage. The bias-generating circuit is for generating bias voltages according to the reference current. The start-up circuit and the bandgap reference circuit receive a supply voltage.

title_en: Program execution device, training system, and associated program execution method
abstract_en:
A program execution device, training system, and associated program execution method are provided. The training system includes a sensing device and the program execution device. The program execution device includes a program execution module, a concentration calculation module, and a program selection module. The program execution module executes an s-th system program 
option during a (z-1)-th program training duration. The sensing device generates (z-1)-th round sensing results corresponding to the (z-1)-th program training duration. The concentration calculation module calculates a (z-1)-th round training concentration according to the (z-1)-th round sensing results. The program selection module selects a t-th system program option to be executed by the program execution device during a z-th program training duration.

title_en: Safe deposit box real-time monitoring system
abstract_en: A safe deposit box real-time monitoring system includes a safe deposit box main body, a safe deposit box top cover and a camera. The safe deposit box top cover is openably disposed on the safe deposit box main body, and the camera is installed on an inner surface of the safe deposit box main body for a safe deposit box tenant to check items stored in the safe deposit box main body.

title_en: Determining a safe driving speed for a vehicle
abstract_en: Embodiments include methods, systems and computer program products for determining a safe driving speed for a vehicle. Aspects include obtaining a location and a direction of travel of the vehicle, obtaining one or more operating conditions of the vehicle, and obtaining historical accident data that corresponds to the location of the vehicle under operating conditions that are similar to the one or more conditions of the vehicle. Aspects also include analyzing, by a processor, the historical accident data to identify the safe driving speed for the vehicle, wherein the safe driving speed is determined to be a maximum speed that is associated with maximum acceptable risk of an accident and causing an indication of the safe driving speed to be displayed to an operator of the vehicle.

title_en: Numerical controller
abstract_en: A numerical controller capable of temporarily executing dedicated function software includes a dedicated function software reading unit configured to read, in response to a reading condition being satisfied, the dedicated function software into a primary storage area mainly accessed by a CPU, dedicated function software execution unit configured to execute the dedicated function software as a process in response to an execution condition being satisfied, and a dedicated function software termination unit configured to stop execution of the process of the dedicated function software and delete the dedicated function software from the primary storage area in response to a termination condition being satisfied.

title_en: Current drive circuit
abstract_en: A current drive circuit has a first transistor that outputs a current, a second transistor connected to the first transistor by cascode connection, a third transistor connected to the second transistor by cascode connection, a first current source that supplies a current to the third transistor and the second transistor, a fourth transistor that shares a gate with the third transistor, a fifth transistor that is connected to the fourth transistor by cascode connection and shares a gate with the second transistor, a second current source that supplies a current to the fourth transistor and the fifth transistor, a sixth transistor that shares a gate with the third transistor and the fourth transistor and controls a gate voltage of the first transistor, and a third current source that supplies a drain current of the sixth transistor.

title_en: Systems and methods for generating a presentation of an energy level based on sleep and daily activity
abstract_en: There is provided a method of creating a presentation of a current awake-energy level, comprising: computing an estimate of initial awake-energy at a wake-up time of a target individual according to sleep-parameters computed according to a time interval that includes a previous night sleep, computing an estimate of a current awake-energy of the target individual indicative of a remaining amount of an estimated maximal amount of available awake-energy, computed according to the initial awake-energy and according to awake-parameters computed for an awake-time interval based on output of sensor(s) comprising: a physiological sensor that senses a physiological parameter, and/or an activity sensor that senses an activity, and outputting, via a user interface, an indication of the current awake-energy, wherein the computing the current awake-energy and the outputting are dynamically iterated over the awake-time interval while the target individual is awake.

title_en: System and method for traffic volume publication applying differential privacy
abstract_en: A method for a traffic volume publication system to publish traffic volumes in a road traffic network includes: receiving traffic information including information on a plurality of road segments and original traffic volume data for the road segments at a first timestamp and calculating a first window size for each road segment for the first timestamp; predicting a second window size for a third timestamp subsequent to the first timestamp, either based on the first window size calculated at the first timestamp or based on the first window size and a window size calculated in advance at a second timestamp prior to the first timestamp; determining a privacy budget allocated to the first timestamp based on the first window size and the second window size; and returning noisy traffic volume data which is obtained by inserting noise into the original traffic volume data, based on the determined privacy budget.

title_en: Synchronizing transmitted video data and enhancements
abstract_en: Described are systems and methods that enable users to virtually experience an environment at a destination location from their own user device, control their experience and even interact with others that are physically located within the environment. Likewise, the user's experience may even be improved with the inclusion of enhancements that are presented to the user as the user experiences the environment.
