title_en: Flight control method and apparatus based on determination of passable airspace, and device
abstract_en: A flight control method and apparatus (130, 144) based on determination of a passable airspace, and a device. The method comprises: obtaining an environmental image of the passage direction of an unmanned aerial vehicle (10, 140) (201); determining a region of interest in the environmental image corresponding to an airspace of interest used by the unmanned aerial vehicle (10, 140) for passage determination (202); determining whether there is an object of a preset category in the region of interest (203); and if there is no object of the preset category in the region of interest, the airspace of interest being a passable airspace, and controlling the unmanned aerial vehicle (10, 140) to pass through the airspace of interest (204). The method provides a low-cost flight control mode that can avoid an obstacle.

title_en: Data-reduced edge-to-cloud transmission based on prediction models
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for providing process data of a device ( 100 ) in an industrial automation environment to a computer system ( 200 ). The method comprises the following steps, in one embodiment: executing (S 15 ) a process data model ( 400 ) on the device ( 100 ) in order to generate estimated process data (D 200 ); determining (S 20 ) that the estimated process data (D 200 ) deviate from real process data (D 100 ) by more than a threshold value; and only when the estimated process data (D 200 ) deviate from the real process data (D 100 ) by more than the threshold value: transmitting (S 25 ) information representing the real process data (D 100 ) from the device ( 100 ) to the computer system ( 200 ).

title_en: Self-driving vehicle path adaptation system and method
abstract_en: Provided is a path adaptation system and method for a self-driving vehicle, and a self-driving vehicle including path adaptation technology. The method includes providing a vehicle navigation path through an environment; determining a location of the vehicle relative to the path; generating one or more polygons representing a shape of the vehicle projected from the vehicle location in a vehicle travel direction long the path; combining the one or more projections into a projected motion polygon; acquiring object information representing an object shape from one or more sensors; and determining if the object shape overlaps the projected motion polygon. If so, the method includes adjusting the vehicle navigation. If not, the method includes, continuing navigation along the path. The path adaptation system includes one or more processors configured to execute the path adaptation method.

title_en: Image viewing method, terminal, and cleaner
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides an image viewing method, a terminal, and a cleaner. The method comprises: first, receiving, by means of a client installed on a terminal and from a user, an operation instruction of viewing an obstacle; then, in response to the operation instruction, sending to a cleaner a viewing request, carrying identification information, for the obstacle so as to instruct the cleaner to select an image of the obstacle identified by the identification information from an obstacle image library; and finally, receiving the image of the obstacle identified by the identification information, fed back by the cleaner, and controlling the display of the image of the obstacle by means of the client.

title_en: Traffic-rule-compliant decision-making in dynamic traffic scenarios
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a method for determining a driving manoeuver of a vehicle by means of a control unit, wherein measurement data about a traffic situation of at least one sensor are received, a current detection area is ascertained by evaluating the received measurement data, a sensor model is created on the basis of the received measurement data and an estimated detection area of the at least one sensor is modelled from the received measurement data by forward simulation on the basis of a vehicle position of the vehicle, the created sensor model is used to ascertain a change in the detection area as a result of at least one driving manoeuver, a driving manoeuver is determined that leads to an increase in the simulated detection area as a result of the sensor model. In addition, a control unit, a computer program and a machine-readable storage medium are disclosed.

title_en: Methods, systems and devices for tracking interactions between individuals
abstract_en: Embodiments generally relate to a device for facilitating tracking of interactions between individuals. The device comprises a housing defining a battery compartment; a clip portion coupled to the housing, wherein the clip portion allows the device to be releasably coupled to a garment; an antenna for transmitting data to external devices; a memory; and a processor. The processor is configured to execute program code to broadcast a first signal; receive at least one response signal from a first external device in response to the first signal; determine a proximity event with the first external device based on the at least one response signal; and store data relating to the proximity event in a memory. The antenna, memory and processor are located on the clip portion of the device.

title_en: Facial recognition tokenization
abstract_en: An approach for increasing security of biometric templates is described. An improved system is adapted to split a full set of features or representations of a trained model into a first partial template and a second partial template, the second partial template being stored on a secure enclave accessible only through zero-knowledge proof based interfaces. During verification using the template, a new full set of features is received for comparison, and a model is loaded based on the available portions of the model. Comparison utilizing the second partial template requires the computation of zero-knowledge proofs as direct access to the underlying second partial template is prohibited by the secure enclave.

title_en: Numerical control device and numerical control method
abstract_en: A numerical control device (1) comprises an information acquisition unit (371) and an instructions generation unit (372). The information acquisition unit (371) acquires workpiece shape information indicating the shape of a workpiece, which is rotated around a rotational axis and has a circular tube surface, and target site shape information indicating the shape of a target site for chamfering or deburring within the circular tube surface. On the basis of the workpiece shape information and the target site shape information that were acquired by the information acquisition unit (371), the instructions generation unit (372) generates, as interpolation instructions to be used in the chamfering or deburring of the target site, interpolation instructions that correspond to a shape resulting from expanding the target site onto a virtual plane, which comprises the rotational axis and an axis that is perpendicular to the rotational axis and is virtually produced by rotation.

title_en: Robot navigation method and apparatus, terminal device and storage medium
abstract_en: Provided are a robot navigation method, a robot navigation apparatus, a terminal device and a computer-readable storage medium, which are suitable for the technical field of navigation and localization. The robot navigation method comprises: if the matching degree between actual environment information of a first target location and map environment information of a first region is less than a preset value, then calling a local map of a second region, wherein the first target location is in the second region, and the map environment information is map environment information in a global map corresponding to the first target location in the first region (S101); localizing a robot in the second region (S102); and finally navigating the localized robot in the second region on the basis of a preset local path of the local map (S103). It can be seen that the method enables the robot to eliminate the problem of localization drift or localization errors when the actual environment changes relative to the map environment, and achieves precise localization and navigation.

title_en: Intelligent fire safety facility monitoring system and method
abstract_en: An intelligent fire safety facility monitoring system and method. The monitoring system comprises a fire detection alarm unit, a firefighting link control unit, and a remote firefighting monitoring unit. The fire detection alarm unit is connected to the firefighting link control unit, and is used to send to the firefighting link control unit a fire alarm signal acquired by the fire detection alarm unit. The firefighting link control unit comprises a firefighting link controller, an electrical firefighting appliance control device, an electrical firefighting device, and a controlled apparatus connected sequentially. The firefighting link controller sends an electrical control signal to the electrical firefighting appliance control device. The electrical firefighting appliance control device controls, by means of the electrical firefighting device, the controlled apparatus to operate. The remote firefighting monitoring unit is connected to the fire detection alarm unit and the firefighting link control unit by means of a transmission apparatus, and is used to receive the fire alarm signal and an apparatus operation signal. The monitoring system and method can automatically check the operational status of a firefighting facility, reduce hidden dangers, and improve the supervision efficiency and performance of a fire safety facility.

title_en: Vehicle dispatch system, vehicle dispatch method, and vehicle dispatch program
abstract_en: A vehicle dispatch system (100) comprises a vehicle dispatch management device (2) for managing dispatch of a plurality of vehicles (V), and a terminal device (1) for transmitting to the vehicle dispatch management device (2) reservation information including a time, a departure place, and a destination. The vehicle dispatch management device (2) corrects at least one of the reservation information and confirmed reservation information so as to allow at least one of the plurality of vehicles (V) to operate in accordance with the reservation information or corrected reservation information transmitted from the terminal device (1), and to allow each of the plurality of vehicles (V) to operate in accordance with the confirmed reservation information or corrected confirmed reservation information.

title_en: Travel teaching recording method for autonomous traveling body, autonomous traveling body, and recording medium
abstract_en: This travel teaching recording method for an autonomous traveling body enables the autonomous traveling body to travel smoothly during autonomous reproduction travel when traveling on the basis of a recording made up until a recording stop and a recording made from resumption of the recording during teaching travel. This travel teaching recording method includes: a step of a pause control unit (203) detecting whether a pause switch (201) stop operation has been performed by an operator; a step of controlling the timing for stopping the travel of a washing machine (100) and stopping recording to a storage unit (57) if the pause switch stop operation has been detected; a step of detecting whether a pause switch (201) resumption operation has been performed by the operator; a step of controlling the timing for starting the travel of the washing machine (100) and resuming recording to the storage unit (57) if the pause switch (201) resumption operation has been detected; and a step of joining the recording prior to the recording stop and the recording after the recording resumption together and recording the same in the storage unit (57).

title_en: Evaluation device, method, and program for evaluating ability to identify object
abstract_en: Provided is an evaluation device capable of objectively evaluating the ability to identify an object while further reducing the burden on a subject.　The present invention is an evaluation device for evaluating the ability of a subject to identify an object. The evaluation device is provided with: an input unit that accepts an input from a subject; a display control unit that displays, on a display device, a test screen including a target object to be selected by the subject and a non-target object not to be selected by the subject; an input processing unit that determines whether or not the target object has been selected on the basis of the input from the subject accepted by the input unit; and an evaluation unit that, when the input processing unit determines that the target object has been selected, evaluates the function of the temporal lobe related to the visual identification ability of the subject on the basis of the response time required until the input from the subject.

title_en: Torque wrench multi-control system
abstract_en: This torque wrench multi-control system comprises a remote multi-control panel for performing remote operation control for each of a plurality of torque wrenches which are bolting apparatuses. The remote multi-control panel comprises: a central control unit which generates individual remote control signals for controlling the operations of the respective torque wrenches; and a bolting apparatus operating unit which transmits the individual remote control signals generated by the central control unit to the respective torque wrenches to control the operations of the respective torque wrenches.

title_en: Constrained manipulation of objects
abstract_en: A computer-implemented method (500) executed by data processing hardware (36) of a robot (10) causes the data processing hardware to perform operations. The robot includes an articulated arm (20) having an end effector (24) engaged with a constrained object (4). The operations include receiving a measured task parameter set (322) for the end effector, including position parameters (P 322 ) defining a position of the end effector. The operations include determining, using the measured task parameter set, at least one axis of freedom and at least one constrained axis for the end effector. The operations include assigning a first impedance value (238) to the end effector along the at least one axis of freedom and a second impedance value (238) to the end effector along the at least one constrained axis. The operations include instructing the articulated arm to move the end effector along the at least one axis of freedom.

title_en: Location and position-based display systems and methods
abstract_en: A system (200) comprising: a display screen (102; 300) associated with an exercise device (100); a sensor module (112; 304) associated with the display screen (102; 300); and a controller (110; 302) having a processor (116; 308) and memory (118; 310) for storing instructions, the processor (116; 308) executing the instructions to: based on output of the sensor module (112; 304), detect any one or more of position or proximity of the display screen (102; 300) in relation to the exercise device (100); and selectively change content displayed on the display screen (102) based on any one or more of the position and/or the proximity.

title_en: Charging method and system, gateway device, charging service device, platform and medium
abstract_en: Provided are a charging method and system, a gateway device, a charging service device, a platform and a storage medium. The method comprises: when a charging certificate request is received from a charging service device, determining a charging certificate corresponding to the current request behavior of the charging service device; sending, via the charging service device, the charging certificate to a charging consumption device connected to the charging service device, such that the charging consumption device sends the charging certificate and identification information of the charging consumption device to a management platform; when the charging certificate and an order number are received from the management platform, sending a charging starting instruction to the charging service device; and sending billing-related information of the current charging service of the charging service device and the order number to the management platform. By means of the method, a charging process is more convenient and faster.

title_en: Breeding environment temperature prediction and control system for livestock and poultry house, and adjustment and control method therefor
abstract_en: A breeding environment temperature prediction and control system for a livestock and poultry house, and an adjustment and control method therefor. The control system comprises a temperature and humidity sensor, a breeding environment temperature dynamic demand module, an environment controller and an environment adjustment and control execution mechanism, wherein the environment controller is connected to the breeding environment temperature dynamic demand module and the temperature and humidity sensor respectively, and the environment adjustment and control execution mechanism is connected to the environment controller, and executes corresponding environment adjustment and control according to a command of the environment controller. The adjustment and control method comprises: controlling a breeding environment temperature according to a dynamic setting model of livestock and poultry breeding environment temperature, a livestock and poultry house breeding environment temperature prediction system based on a GM (1, 1) model, and a gray prediction fuzzy system based on the GM (1, 1) model. The problems of it being difficult to adjust and control the temperature in a livestock and poultry house in a timely manner, the adjustment and control adaptability being poor, and it being impossible to take preventive measures are solved; and the limitation of feedback-type adjustment and control, based on a detection result, of a livestock and poultry house is overcome.

title_en: Numerical control device
abstract_en: This numerical control device comprises: an area information reception unit which receives an input of data that determines a control area in which a control condition is set within a movement area of an axis of a machining tool; an area setting unit which sets the control area on the basis of the data received by the area information reception unit; a control condition setting unit which sets the control condition in the control area; and a command generation unit which generates a control command within the control area on the basis of the control condition.

title_en: Segmented relay transportation network
abstract_en: Methods and systems for optimizing allocation of personnel and equipment to on-highway freight movement. A network of segments and nodes are defined with relation to an existing highway system. Resources as units of work are then allocated and directed to use the network in particular ways. Improvements in equipment utilization, personnel utilization, transit time and driver at-home time are realized.

title_en: Systems and methods to accomplish a physical process
abstract_en: Systems and methods to accomplish a physical process are disclosed. The systems and methods can receive object data for an object that is a subject of the physical process; determine operation sequences that each accomplish a portion of the physical process, each operation sequence providing an ordering of a set of physical operations associated with one or more points of the object; generate an operation schedule specifying timing of performance of each operation sequence and a set of one or more sets of robots to perform each operation sequence; generate physical process data including the operation schedule and the one or more operation sequences; and communicate the physical process data to the one or more sets of robots to perform the one or more operation sequences according to the operation schedule.

title_en: Method and apparatus for linkage control of household appliances and cloud control device
abstract_en: A method and apparatus for linkage control of household appliances and a cloud control device. The method comprises: in the case of receiving current data reported by a first household appliance, according to a stored first data format corresponding to the first household appliance, analyzing out a first control instruction matched with the current data (201); when the first control instruction is a linkage control instruction, determining a second household appliance linked with the first household appliance and a corresponding second control instruction, and according to a stored second data format corresponding to the second household appliance, generating issuing data matched with the second control instruction (202); and according to the issuing data, controlling the second household appliance to perform linkage operation (203).

title_en: Screen creation device and computer-readable storage medium
abstract_en: This screen creation device for assisting in creation of a user interface screen of a numerical value control device stores components that are arranged on the user interface screen and composite components obtained by combining components, acquires mechanical information about a machine tool to be controlled by the numerical value control device, stores the mechanical information, the composite components, and creation rules for the user interface screen in association with one another, determines whether the user interface screen being created complies with the creation rules associated with the mechanical information about the machine tool to be controlled, and notifies the user of the user interface screen not complying with the creation rules.

title_en: Map data generation device, map data generation system, and map data generation program
abstract_en: A map data generation device (3) receives probe data including traveling information and GNSS information from a vehicle-mounted machine (2). The map data generation device comprises: a correlation coefficient calculation unit (10b) that calculates a correlation coefficient indicating a correlation between the traveling information and the GNSS information included in the probe data; a delay time calculation unit (10c) that calculates a GNSS delay time on the basis of the correlation coefficient; a delay time correction unit (10d) that performs a delay time correction on the GNSS information on the basis of the GNSS delay time; and a map data generation unit (10e) that corrects the probe data by the GNSS information on which the delay time correction has been performed, and generates map data using the corrected probe data.

title_en: System security
abstract_en: In accordance with embodiments of this disclosure, a method of securing a processing unit according to some embodiments includes receiving a request for access from a user; detecting a device; determining whether the device is a trusted device; and providing the user access to the processing unit only if the device is a trusted device. In some embodiments, the trusted device may be a Bluetooth device.

title_en: Vehicle-travel-monitoring system, travel-monitoring method, and travel-monitoring program
abstract_en: A purpose of the present invention is to make it possible to facilitate layout changes in a region in which travel data is displayed on a monitoring screen, and to make effective use of the monitoring screen having a limited area. A travel-monitoring system (100) includes a monitoring device (10) that displays on a display unit (33) a monitoring screen (M) that shows a plurality of travel data of a first vehicle (50A). The monitoring device (10) ensures the monitoring screen (M) has a plurality of large regions (Ar) and a plurality of small regions (Cr). Travel data (e.g., vehicle speed) is displayed in the large size regions (Ar). Travel data or a guide (mark) indicating the type of travel data is displayed in the small size regions (Cr). The size of the large regions (Ar) in either the horizontal or vertical direction is n-fold the size of the small regions (Cr) (where n is an integer greater than 1).

title_en: Flexible driving solar tracking system having damping mechanism
abstract_en: Provided is a flexible driving solar tracking system having a damping mechanism (4), comprising: a support structure (1) of a fixed portion and a rotating portion; a solar panel (2), which is mounted on the rotating portion of the support structure (1); a plurality of rotating mechanisms (33) orderly mounted on the support structure (1), which is used for driving the rotating portion to rotate; a driving device, which comprises a driving member (32) and a main rope (31), the main rope (31) being orderly connected to the plurality of rotating mechanisms (33), the driving member (32) being connected to the main rope (31), and the main rope (31) being capable of driving, under the action of the driving member (32), the rotating mechanisms (33) to work so as to adjust the angle of the solar panel (2); and the damping mechanism (4), which comprises a rotating member (41) and a damping member (43), wherein the damping member (43) is connected to the rotating member (41), the main rope (31) can drive the rotating member (41) to rotate, and the damping member (43) is used for limiting the rotating member (41) to rotate at a rotational speed that is lower than a preset rotational speed, thereby limiting the running speed of the main rope (31). The damping mechanism (4) can apply a pulling force to the main rope (31) when the solar panel (2) shakes along with the wind, so as to limit the shaking of the solar panel (2) and to improve stability.

title_en: Vehicle-road collaborative multi-vehicle path planning and right-of-way decision method and system, and roadbed unit
abstract_en: A vehicle-road collaborative multi-vehicle path planning and right-of-way decision method. A roadbed unit (1) combines environment information collected by a sensing module (11) of the roadbed unit (1) and environment information and vehicle information collected by a vehicle sensing device, target recognition is performed in combination with edge computing and then real-time path planning in a limited area of multiple vehicles is performed, and planning data is broadcast to a vehicle; an intelligent network vehicle having path and instruction execution and right-of-way decision functions is utilized to perform a right-of-way decision and a path planned by the roadbed unit (1), thereby improving the traffic efficiency and the rationality of multi-vehicle interaction, and further improving the right-of-way decision of a regional road segment. Also disclosed are a vehicle-road collaborative multi-vehicle path planning and right-of-way decision system (100) and a roadbed unit (1).

title_en: Chemical spray for intruder deterrent and related methods
abstract_en: A solution for deterring intruders comprises an organic acid having a pKa of 6 or less; and water; wherein the solution has a pH between about 4.5 and about 6.5. The organic acid can have a general formula of B - A - COOH, wherein A is selected from the group consisting of a bond, substituted or unsubstituted alkyl, substituted or unsubstituted heteroalkyl, substituted or unsubstituted cycloalkyl, substituted or unsubstituted heterocycloalkyl, substituted or unsubstituted aryl, and substituted or unsubstituted heteroaryl; and wherein B is selected from the group consisting of hydrogen, substituted or unsubstituted alkyl, substituted or unsubstituted heteroalkyl, substituted or unsubstituted cycloalkyl, substituted or unsubstituted heterocycloalkyl, substituted or unsubstituted aryl, substituted or unsubstituted heteroaryl, halogen, hydroxyl, oxo, peroxy acid, amino, azido, nitro, cyano, carboxyl, carbamyl, sulfo, and mercapto.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle patrol system and method of gridding machine nest
abstract_en: An unmanned aerial vehicle (33) patrol system and method of a gridding machine nest (3, 34). The system comprises a plurality of machine nests (3, 34) deployed in a gridding mode, wherein each machine nest (3, 34) is used for accommodating at least one unmanned aerial vehicle (33); the machine nest (3, 34) comprises a machine nest controller that communicates with a control terminal; the machine nest controller communicates with an unmanned aerial vehicle remote controller; the unmanned aerial vehicle remote controller communicates with the unmanned aerial vehicle (33); and the control terminal is used for generating, according to the current endurance mileage of the unmanned aerial vehicle (33) and a distance between a patrol target and each machine nest (3, 34) by using a shortest patrol time as an optimization target, an optimal patrol path of the unmanned aerial vehicle (33) and sending the optimal patrol path to the machine nest controller. The present invention has the beneficial effects of: achieving the efficient collaborative patrol of the unmanned aerial vehicle (33) based on the unmanned aerial vehicle machine nests (3, 34) that are arranged in the gridding mode, reducing the labor cost, and satisfying the normalized or emergent patrol requirements for a plurality of patrol targets across fields.

title_en: Banknote-processing apparatus
abstract_en: [Problem] To provide a banknote-processing apparatus for emitting, from a portable terminal, a remote communication signal including information pertaining to electronic money or other electronic currency, and saving/accumulating the electronic currency information in a storage saving device of a banknote storage device via a banknote-sorting device. [Solution] In the present invention, a banknote-processing apparatus has: a banknote-sorting device (1) having an interface (80) for receiving electronic currency information from a portable terminal (70), and a sorting transmission/reception device (3) for receiving the electronic currency information transmitted from the interface (80); and a banknote storage device (2) for storing supplied banknotes assessed by the banknote-sorting device (1) to be authentic. The electronic currency information transmitted from the sorting transmission/reception device (3) of the banknote-sorting device (1) is received by a storage transmission/reception device (21) of the banknote storage device (2), and the electronic currency information ultimately transmitted from the storage transmission/reception device (21) is saved and accumulated in a storage saving device (22).

title_en: A smart system for determining driving behaviour of driver
abstract_en: A system (1) for efficiently determining a driving behaviour of a driver driving a vehicle. The system includes a 3-axis accelerometer (2) generating accelerometer data (3), a direction sensor (4) generating direction data (5) and orientation sensor (6) generating orientation and angular velocity data (7), all placed inside the vehicle. The system (1) also includes a processing unit (8) which processes the accelerometer data (3), the direction data (5) and the orientation data (7), and calibrates the accelerometer data (3) to generate a calibrated accelerometer data (9). The calibrated accelerometer data (9) is used in determining the driving behaviour of the driver of the vehicle and generate Driving Deficiency Alerts, including but not limited to Over-speeding, Hard acceleration, Sudden Braking, Fast Cornering, Quick Lane Changing, Distracted Driving, Dangerous Driving over bumps and Crash Detection.

title_en: Indoor map using actual-measurement-based floor plan, and generation method therefor
abstract_en: A method for generating an indoor map of any one floor in a building by using a GPS receiver and CAD software is provided. The method comprises the steps of: preparing a CAD drawing including a floor plan for any one floor of a building in a local coordinate system having units of distance; setting the reference point and reference line, which are fixed relative to the building; determining the coordinates of the reference point and the direction of the reference line in a plane rectangular coordinate system by using a GPS receiver; transforming the local coordinate system of the CAD drawing into the plane rectangular coordinate system by using the determined coordinates of the reference point and the determined direction of the reference line; and transforming the coordinates on the floor plan from the coordinates of the plane rectangular coordinate system into coordinates of a geographic coordinate system.

title_en: Display system and display method
abstract_en: This display system (10) comprises: a position information acquisition unit (24) for acquiring position information indicating the position of a vanishing point calculated on the basis of two or more optical flows relating to each of a plurality of images captured by an imaging unit (2) that is mounted on a mobile body (1) and that repeatedly captures an image; a determining unit (26) for determining, on the basis of each of a plurality of items of position information acquired by the position information acquisition unit (24), whether each respective vanishing point from among a plurality of vanishing points satisfies a prescribed condition; and an estimation unit (28) for estimating the attitude of the mobile body (1) on the basis of one or more vanishing points, from among the plurality of vanishing points, determined by the determining unit (26) to satisfy the prescribed condition.

title_en: Recommendation system
abstract_en: The present invention reduces CO2 emissions.　A recommendation system 10 comprises: an acquisition unit 11 that acquires movement information indicating a starting location and a destination for a future user movement in which a CO2-emitting movement means is used; an emission quantity estimation unit 12 that, with regard to the movement according to the movement information which was acquired by the acquisition unit, estimates the CO2 emission quantity due to the movement for each of a plurality of movement timings that differ from one another; and a determination unit 13 that, on the basis of the CO2 emission quantities for each movement timing which were estimated by the emission quantity estimation unit 12, determines a facility which the user can stop by at the time of the movement and which is to be recommended to the user.

title_en: Self-propelled working system
abstract_en: The present application provides a self-propelled working system, comprising: a self-moving device, the self-moving device moving and/or working on a working surface defined by a working boundary; the self-moving device comprising a surface identifying apparatus, configured to directly identify material information of the working surface; a location collecting apparatus, configured to collect location information of the self-moving device and/or location information between the self-moving device and at least part of the working boundary; a control apparatus, configured to control the self-moving device to move and/or work on the working surface; and a determination apparatus, configured to determine whether the self-moving device has reached the working boundary. When a determination module determines, according to the material information identified by the surface identifying apparatus, that the self-moving device has not reached the working boundary, then, if it is determined according to the location information collected by the location acquisition apparatus and at least part of the working boundary that the self-moving device has reached the working boundary, the control apparatus controls the self-moving device to walk along the working boundary, or to turn to the working surface.

title_en: Drilling technique using adaptive control motors
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for drilling an element to be drilled by means of a cutting tool (13) capable of being rotated and translated about/along the same axis by a drilling device (10), said device comprising: a cutting motor (14) capable of causing the cutting tool (13) to rotate about the axis; a feed motor (16) capable of causing the cutting tool (13) to translate along the axis; said method comprising a step of adapting the control of said motors (14, 16), said adaptation step meaning that: the speed of the cutting motor (14) and of the feed motor (16) is controlled as long as the torque and the thrust are below the torque threshold (C) and the thrust threshold (P), respectively; when the torque or the thrust reaches or exceeds the torque threshold (C) or the thrust threshold (P), the current of the motor generating the torque or the thrust whose threshold has been exceeded is controlled, whereas the other motor is still subject to speed control, in such a way that the feed per revolution of the cutting tool is equal to a predetermined value (ATR).

title_en: Map generating device and driving assistance system
abstract_en: A map generating device 100 comprises: a collector 65 that collects surveillance information of the environment; and a generator 67 that generates, on the basis of the surveillance information, a map 2 for assisting the self-driving of a mobile body 1. The generator 67 determines, on the basis of the surveillance information, a dangerous region 3 to be avoided which is within the environment. The generator 67 generates the map 2 that contains geographical information 21 and the dangerous region 3.

title_en: System for syncing a harvester with an autonomous grain cart
abstract_en: A control system includes a first input to receive a positional output characteristic of a first vehicle at a first communication frequency and a second input to receive a kinematic output characteristic of the first vehicle at a second frequency, where the second frequency is greater than the first frequency. A guidance controller of a second vehicle is configured to process the kinematic output characteristic of the first vehicle to obtain a heading of the first vehicle, compare the heading of the first vehicle with a heading of the second vehicle to obtain a heading deviation of the second vehicle, and determine a guidance heading of the second vehicle based on the heading deviation of the second vehicle. A control interface is configured to communicate the guidance heading to one or more of steering, throttle or brake elements of the second vehicle.

title_en: Information processing device, information processing method, and information processing system
abstract_en: The present technology relates to an information processing device, an information processing method, and an information processing system that make it possible to reduce the power consumption of an object recognition process that uses sensor fusion processing. The information processing device is provided with: an object recognition unit that performs an object recognition process by combining sensing data from a plurality of types of sensors that sense the surroundings of a vehicle; a contribution ratio calculation unit that calculates the contribution ratio of each set of sensing data to the recognition process; and a recognition process control unit that limits the sensing data used for the recognition process on the basis of each contribution ratio. The present technology can be applied, for example, to vehicles.

title_en: Power-to-hydrogen plant, control unit and control method thereof
abstract_en: A control unit (40) for a Power-to-Hydrogen (PtH) plant (100) is provided. The control unit (40) includes at least one model (41) and is configure to: calculate maximum efficiency point tracking of the PtH plant (100) by solving an objective function having a predetermined hydrogen production rate of the PtH plant or a predetermined amount of energy input to the PtH plant using the at least one model, wherein the control unit receives measured parameters indicative of status of components of the PtH plant as an input to the at least one model; determine one or more set points for a coordinated operation of the components of the PtH plant based on a solution obtained by solving the objective function; and provide the one or more set points to one or more of the components of the PtH plant to operate the PtH at the maximum efficiency point.

title_en: Method for alerting a remote communication terminal and associated alert communication device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for alerting a remote communication terminal, the method being carried out by an alert communication device (100) and involving: - establishing (S300) a communication session between said alert communication device (100) and a remote communication terminal (300), triggered by detection (S200) of an alert situation; and - transmitting, via the established communication session, a generated message.

title_en: Anticipating the cause of abnormal operation in industrial machines
abstract_en: A Computer identifies a parameter state transition with a predicted occurrence in the future, wherein the parameter state transition is a critical transition due to a predicted increase in the likelihood that the operation mode of an industrial machine changes in the future, wherein the operation mode is a technical state of the machine. The computer processes an operational multi-variate time-series ({{X}}_op) by processing an operational multi-variate time-series ({{X}}_op) that represents the operation of the particular industrial machine (101) during a particular operation time-interval (T_op) that is ongoing at present (t_current). The computer provides a future multi-variate time-series ({X}_ft) that represents the predicted operation of the particular industrial machine (101) during a particular prediction time-interval (T_ft) that reaches into the future. The computer anticipates (423) the parameter state transition (11a, 31) if both of the following conditions are complied with (i) t least one particular parameter is predicted to have a value that will be different from a reference value in at least one deviating segment; (ii) the likelihood for the change in the operation mode of the industrial machine is predicted to be increased.

title_en: Ledger environment threat detection protocol system and method
abstract_en: A security protocol system and method are described, including a system and method for conducting a transaction on a distributed ledger technology-based infrastructure. The method is implemented at a first computing device and includes collecting a number of parameters. At least one parameter is a unique identifier associated with the first computing device. The method includes deriving a first cryptographic key from the collected parameters according to protocol of a distributed ledger technology-based infrastructure.

title_en: Multi-area-linked parking guidance method and device for large underground parking lots
abstract_en: Disclosed in the present invention are a multi-area-linked parking guidance method and device for large underground parking lots, belonging to the field of intelligent parking lots. The guidance device comprises a vehicle detection and transmission unit, a computing unit, a communication unit and a guidance unit. The vehicle detection and transmission unit is used for detecting a vibration event; the computing unit is used for computing the total number of parked vehicles and the number of remaining parking spaces in each area of a parking lot, and updating a guidance policy in real time; the communication unit is used for transmitting the guidance policy of the computing unit to the guidance unit; and the guidance unit is used for guiding vehicles to park in the parking lot. The present invention achieves the relatively uniform distribution of parking resources in all areas of large underground parking lots, and prevents insufficient utilization or unreasonable utilization of parking resources.

title_en: Fuel gas supply apparatus
abstract_en:
A fuel gas supply apparatus (2) comprises: a pressure reducing valve (22) that reduces, to a preset pressure, the pressure of a fuel gas supplied from a tank (1) which stores the fuel gas; and a supply amount regulating unit (3) that is formed on the downstream side of the pressure reducing valve (22), and that adjusts the supply amount of the fuel gas from a fuel supply path by selecting a fuel supply path which passes through at least one of two orifices (241, 242) which have orifice diameters different from each other.
According to this fuel gas supply apparatus (2), a mechanism to suppress fuel gas pressure fluctuation becomes unnecessary, therefore the entire fuel gas supply apparatus (2) can be minimized.

title_en: Basket reload system
abstract_en: Example methods and systems are directed to moving a quantity of a bulk food item within an automated cooking system. A quantity of the bulk food item may be provided from a bulk food dispenser. The quantity of the bulk food item may be received at a lower transfer component from the bulk food dispenser. The quantity of the bulk food item may be transferred from the lower transfer component to a dump bin at a first location. The dump bin may move vertically from the first location to a second location above the first location. The quantity of the bulk food item may be provided or dispensed to the automated cooking system while the dump bin is located at the second location.

title_en: Robot programming with active assisting functions
abstract_en: A robot system comprises at least one robotic arm controlled by a robot controller comprising: a recording process which can be activated by a user via the user interface device and the robot controller is during the recording process configured to record at least one operation parameter of the robot system; an assisting process which during the recording process is configured to execute at least one assisting function upon activation by the user, where the at least one assisting function activates at least one robot system action. robot task generator configured to generate at least one robot task based on the at least one executed assisting function and at least one of the recorded operation parameters.

title_en: Sensor system for mobility platform and method for shape based landmark recognition
abstract_en: A mobility platform is configured to execute one or more tasks in a worksite including a passive landmark. A mobility platform may include a first laser rangefinder and at least one processor configured to sweep the first passive landmark with the first laser rangefinder to collect a first plurality of distance measurements for a first plurality of yaw angles, fit a first shape to the first plurality of distance measurements based on a predetermined shape of the first passive landmark, and determine a position of a geometric center of the first passive landmark relative to the first location of the first laser rangefinder based on the fit first shape.

title_en: Information management system and method
abstract_en: A computer-implemented method, computer program product and computing system for: interfacing with a bedside monitoring device to receive data signals, wherein the data signals have monitoring criteria; enabling adjustment of one or more of the monitoring criteria; suggesting a proposed change to a user concerning the one or more monitoring criteria; and providing instructions to the user concerning the proposed change

title_en: Actuator mechanism used in the field of automation technology, and assembly
abstract_en: The invention relates to an actuator mechanism (1) used in the field of automation technology for actuating a fitting such as, for example, a valve which is, for example, arranged in a media-conducting pipeline, comprising: an actuating device (10) for actuating the fitting; an electronic operating circuit (20); an actuator mechanism communication device (30) configured for wireless communication between the electronic operating circuit and a technical environment (100) of the actuator mechanism, wherein the actuator mechanism communication device has a transceiver (31); wherein the electronic operating circuit is configured to operate the actuating device and the actuator mechanism communication device, wherein the actuator mechanism communication device (30) is configured by means of the transceiver (31) to communicate bidirectionally with the technical environment by means of near-infrared, optical or ultraviolet radiation.

title_en: Method for computer-aided ascertainment of one or more operating configurations of a conveyor line system for piece goods
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for computer-aided ascertainment of one or more operating configurations of a conveyor line system (100) for piece goods (P1, P2, …, P7), wherein the conveyor line system (100) comprises a plurality of conveyor line subsections (C1, C2, …, C5) along which the piece goods (P1, P2, …, P7) are transported on respective conveyor means (1, 2, …, 5) of the conveyor line subsections (C1, C2, …, C5), wherein each conveyor line subsection (C1, C2, …, C5) is associated with a speed (v1, v2, …, v5) of the conveyor means (1, 2, …, 5) of the particular conveyor line subsection (C1, C2, …, C5), wherein, in order to ascertain a particular operating configuration: - the speeds (v1, v2, …, v5) of all of the conveyor line subsections (C1, C2, …, C5) are modeled by a set of parameters (PS) such that the speed (v1, v2, …, v5) of a particular conveyor line subsection (C1, C2, …, C5) is described by a time-dependent periodic function (F1, F2, …, FN) comprising one or more parameters (a i , b i , c i , d i ); and - optimized parameter values (PS opt ) for the set of parameters (PS) are determined, as the particular operating configuration, by means of an optimization method (OPT), wherein the optimization method (OPT) is based on an optimization goal of a high quality level (FT) and, as part of the optimization method (OPT), the quality level (FT) is determined repeatedly by means of a physical simulation (SIM) of the conveyor line system (100) or by means of a function.

title_en: Implicit dual control for uncertain stochastic systems
abstract_en: Systems and methods are provided for determining control actions for controlling a stochastic system via an implicit dual control using a computer processor and associated memory encoded with an augmented mathematical model of dynamics of the system, the augmented mathematical model characterizing the dynamics of the states and uncertain parameters of the system. A stochastic differential-dynamic-programming-based algorithm is employed to process an augmented state data structure characterizing the states of the stochastic system and the one or more uncertain parameters, and an augmented state covariance data structure comprising a covariance matrix of the states of the stochastic system and a covariance matrix of the uncertain parameters, according to the augmented mathematical model and a cost function, in which the uncertain parameters are treated as additional states subject to the augmented mathematical model, to determine a control policy for reducing cost through implicitly generated dual features of probing, caution, and selectiveness.

title_en: Management method, mobile body, and information processing device
abstract_en: A management method according to the present disclosure includes determining a communication volume between a management device and a mobile body in accordance with a task type of remote management of the mobile body. The management device can be connected to the mobile body. The management method includes transmitting a communication volume indication to the mobile body. The communication volume indication includes a request to perform communication using the determined communication volume.

title_en: Biochar reactor
abstract_en: The application relates to a biochar reactor (100) for producing biochar (BC). The biochar reactor comprises a horizontal reactor chamber (102), a receiver (104) for receiving (472) biomass (BM) to the biochar reactor, a pyrolyzer (108) for pyrolyzing (480) the received biomass to produce the biochar, a cooler (114) for cooling (488) the produced biochar, and a controller (346) for controlling the biochar reactor. The pyrolyzer comprises at least one pyrolyzer section (110) so that each pyrolyzer section (110) is configured to pyrolyze the biomass by using a unique section-typical temperature range. The biochar reactor is configured to mix an additive (AD) with heat gas (HG) that flows forcedly through a pyrolyzer section (110) or with water vapour (VA) that flows forcedly through the cooler to improve a result of a pyrolysis process. The bioreactor is further configured to cause a process temperature (T1, T2) within the section-typical temperature range in said pyrolyzer section by the heat gas flow.

title_en: Safety management method and system for smart building
abstract_en: A safety management method and system for a smart building. The system comprises: a central processing module and a 3D building model, the central processing module being electrically connected to a data storage module; cameras, the central processing module combining the cameras and the 3D building model, when a camera at a certain position in the 3D building is clicked on, a pop-up window appearing, and picture information being actually captured by the camera being displayed; mobile terminals, the mobile terminals performing information receiving and information feedback by means of the central processing module; smoke alarms, the plurality of smoke alarms being fixedly mounted in inflammable regions, and matching temperature sensors being provided; and GPS positioners, the plurality of GPS positioners being respectively used in cooperation with warning lamps and the smoke alarms, and the smoke alarms, the warning lamps and the GPS positioners being respectively bound with the 3D building model.

title_en: Smart safety shoe system having alarm and residual current sensing functions
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smart safety shoe system having alarm and residual current sensing functions, comprising: safety shoes that can be worn by a firefighter; and a safety assurance unit, which is formed on one side of the safety shoes, displays in real time, through a server, a command terminal and a portable terminal of each of the firefighters, the current position of each of a plurality of firefighters deployed to a site, alerts adjacent firefighters through vibration, noise and sound and, simultaneously, alerts the server and the command terminal if the distance between each of the plurality of firefighters is a predetermined range or greater or one of the plurality of firefighters does not move for a predetermined time or longer, and prevents electric shock accidents of the firefighters and fire investigators by sensing residual current on site when fire investigators are deployed after fire suppression, and thus the position of each firefighter is tracked per node through signal strength of wireless short-range communication according to the distance between firefighters at a disaster occurrence site such as that of a fire and residual current is sensed in a contactless manner, thereby enabling the safety of a workforce, such as firefighters and fire investigators, after fire suppression or dousing to be ensured.

title_en: Flood prediction method and flood prediction system
abstract_en: With this flood prediction method, a computer system 1 creates an observed inundation map 64 on the basis of observation data before and after past flood events in a given region, creates a simulated inundation map 65 by performing physical flood simulation using estimated precipitation data, estimated runoff data, and river topography data related to the flood events as input data, generates a neural network model for predicting an inundation area on the basis of elevation data 62 and precipitation data 63 by machine learning using the photographed image inundation map and the simulated inundation map as training data, and creates a prediction flood map 60 for enabling identification of an inundation area in a flood prediction target area through input of elevation data and precipitation data related to the flood prediction target area into the trained neural network model.

title_en: Machining shape simulation device
abstract_en: A machining shape simulation device (100) for generative gear cutting comprises: a cylindrical coordinate system lattice prescribing unit (111) that prescribes a cylindrical coordinate system lattice that comprises a radial distance R component, an axial coordinate Z component, and an azimuth angle θ component and in which the lattice pitch of the radial distance R is set; a workpiece shape model prescribing unit (120) that prescribes a workpiece shape model defined by the axial direction as the axial coordinate Z direction in the cylindrical coordinate system lattice and the azimuth angle θ specified with respect to the radial distance R and the axial coordinate Z; a tool shape model prescribing unit (121); an interference region calculation unit (130) that calculates, on the basis of the workpiece shape model, a tool shape model, and the trajectory of relative movement of the tool and the workpiece, an interference region between the tool shape model and the workpiece shape model during generative gear cutting; and a machining result prediction unit (190) that predicts the machining result of the workpiece on the basis of the calculation result of the interference region calculation unit.

title_en: Data processing device, data processing method, and program
abstract_en: The present invention performs more accurate agent simulation. A data processing device according to the present invention comprises: a first data acquiring means for acquiring three-dimensional data of a city; a second data acquiring means for acquiring route data including at least road data; an area information calculating means for calculating movement possible/not-possible area information indicating areas in which it is possible for an agent to move and areas in which it is not possible for the agent to move, on the basis of the three-dimensional data acquired by the first data acquisition means; a consistency evaluating means for evaluating consistency between the movement possible/not-possible area information calculated by the area information calculating means and the route data acquired by the second data acquiring means; and a correcting means for correcting the movement possible/not-possible area information by comparison with the route data on the basis of the evaluation results obtained by the consistency evaluating means.

title_en: Method for monitoring an automatic machine for producing or packaging smoking, hygiene, food or pharmaceutical products
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and to a device for monitoring an automatic machine (10) for producing or packaging smoking, hygiene, food or pharmaceutical products, which machine comprises at least one drive (A, B, C), which moves at least one machine element of the machine (10) in each case, wherein, during operation of the machine (10), actual torques or actual current values of the drive (A, B, C) that are proportional thereto are each compared with an upper and/or lower limit value, and wherein, in the event that an actual torque value and/or actual current value of the drive exceeds the upper limit value or falls below the lower limit value with which it is compared, an error signal is generated. The invention is characterised in that a) during operation of the machine (10), the upper and/or the lower limit value is/are each currently calculated according to the relevant actual position of the drive (A, B, C) detected during operation of the machine (10), or in that b) during operation of the machine (10), the upper and/or the lower limit value is/are each selected from a data memory according to the relevant actual position of the drive detected during operation of the machine (10), in which data memory an upper and/or a lower limit value is/are each stored in a selectable manner for a plurality of possible actual positions of the drive of the machine (10) or for each possible actual position of the drive of the machine.

title_en: Multiwavelength optical sensor
abstract_en: A multiwavelength optical sensor includes an illuminator (301, 501, 1001). The illuminator includes an illuminator housing, one or more light-emitting diodes (LEDs) (510, 1010) of different wavelengths disposed in the illuminator housing, and a light bar (509, 1000) disposed in the illuminator housing, the light bar including a light guide (505, 709, 1005) and a diffuser (518, 712, 1018) having a thickness, and a width corresponding to the shape of a bottom portion of the light guide, wherein light emitted by the one or more LEDs are reflected within the light guide and the light is scattered by the diffuser through the light guide for transmission. The multiwavelength optical sensor also includes a photodetector (303, 503) for being disposed opposite the illuminator. The photodetector includes a photodetector housing, a photodiode array (507) disposed within the photodetector housing, and a diaphragm array (529) having a plurality of vertical walls for controlling the scattered light transmitted by the illuminator and decreasing stray light effect.

title_en: Control device for machine tool and machine tool control method
abstract_en: Provided are a control device for a machine tool and a machine tool control method that are capable of reducing the load on a tool caused when a workpiece and the tool come into contact with each other by devising oscillation operation start timing, thereby extending the life of the tool. The present invention provides a control device 1 for a machine tool that has a spindle S for rotating a workpiece W and a tool T relative to each other and a feed shaft J for feeding the workpiece W and the tool T relative to each other, and that performs machining on the workpiece W while oscillating the workpiece W and the tool T relative to each other by cooperative operation of the spindle S and the feed shaft J, the control device 1 comprising an oscillation command creation unit 3 that creates an oscillation command on the basis of machining conditions acquired from at least one of a machining program 2, signal information 10, and parameters. The oscillation command creation unit 3 includes an oscillation command start unit 4. The oscillation command start unit 4 does not perform an oscillation operation at the start of machining of the workpiece W, and starts the oscillation operation when predetermined oscillation operation start conditions are satisfied during machining of the workpiece W.

title_en: Iot based and mobile controlled, instantly interactive smart security and defense system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an loT (Internet of Things) based, mobile controlled and instantly interactive smart security and defense system.

title_en: Digital therapeutics and combination therapy for the treatment of tenosynovial giant cell tumor (tgct)
abstract_en: Provided are methods of digital therapeutics for individuals with benign connective tissue tumor. More specifically, the digital therapeutics are designed to modulate Tenosynovial Giant Cell Tumor (TGCT), on a standalone basis or by combining them with pharmaceutical drugs such as CSF1R inhibitors.

title_en: Techniques for control of multiple types of drones with a central control system
abstract_en: Methods and apparatus to create and perform drone displays are disclosed. An example drone display may include a first set of drones having a first drone type, and a second set of drones having a second drone type. A flight controller at each drone may provide commands to drone hardware through an abstraction layer, where the commands from the flight controller are common across different drone types and the abstraction layer translates the commands to drone-specific signals based on a configured drone type. A central management system may provide flight paths to the different sets of drones in a common format across different drone types, and may control multiple different types of drones using the common format.

title_en: Devices, systems, and methods for sample collection
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are devices, apparatus, systems, methods and kits for collecting and storing a fluid sample from a subject. A device for collecting the fluid sample can include a housing comprising a recess having an opening, a vacuum chamber in the housing and in fluidic communication with the recess, and one or more piercing elements that are extendable through the opening to penetrate skin of the subject. The vacuum chamber can be configured for having a vacuum that draws the skin into the recess. The recess can be configured having a size or shape that enables an increased volume of the fluid sample to be accumulated in the skin drawn into the recess.

title_en: Tissue container systems
abstract_en: The present invention relates generally to tissue container systems that find use in the transport of tissues and methods of using the tissue container systems. In particular the present invention relates to systems that support the transport, thawing and use of cryopreserved human skin equivalents, and methods of their use by a health care provider.

title_en: Bone reconstruction and orthopedic implants
abstract_en:
A calibration system is provided including an aperture layer, a lens layer, an optical filter, a pixel 
layer and a regulator. The aperture layer defines a calibration aperture. The lens layer includes a 
calibration lens substantially axially aligned with the calibration aperture. The optical filter is 
adjacent the lens layer opposite the aperture layer. The pixel layer is adjacent the optical filter 
opposite the lens layer and includes a calibration pixel substantially axially aligned with the 
calibration lens. The calibration pixel detects light power of an illumination source that outputs a 
band of wavelengths of light as a function of a parameter. The regulator modifies the parameter 
of the illumination source based on a light power detected by the calibration pixel.

title_en: Bi-dose nasal spray
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a novel nasal spray containing an aqueous solution or a fluid with an anxiolytic or anticonvulsant substance, wherein the nasal spray is characterized in that with the nasal spray, two sprays with each an equivalent, defined volume of the aqueous solution or liquid of the active agent, can be intranasally administered to a patient and wherein the nasal spray allows for an administration, independent of the spatial orientation of the nasal spray in any position of the patient (standing upright, sitting, lying or in any intermediate position). The nasal spray can be used directly without prior activation. Preferably it is apparent from the nasal spray whether a spray or even a second spray has been made with the nasal spray. Preferably, a spray of the nasal spray can be administered one- handed by the patient or a third person. The active agent in the inventive nasal spray is a benzodiazepine or a GABA-receptor agonist, preferably midazolam or a derivative thereof or a salt of these active agents. The nasal spray according to the present invention may be used for sedation, premedication or treatment of patients with claustrophobia, anxiety disorders or panic attacks or for the treatment of convulsions in CNS diseases, particularly in epileptic seizures or other manifestations of seizures (e.g. febrile convulsions). The invention also relates to a method for hermetically sealing an active agent container for use in supplying an nasal spray in accordance with the invention. The invention also relates to a method of detection by localizing the locally precise administration of an active agent in nasal application, as well as a nasal spray, preferably a bi-dose nasal spray, for which, using the cited method of detection, it has been shown both visually (qualitatively) and quantitatively that an orientation-independent, uniform and locally precise administration of the dose of the active agent onto the nasal mucosa of a patient can be achieved. Also provided is a method for airless and air-tight sealing of an active agent container in accordance with the invention.

title_en: Vacuum platen tissue planing apparatus
abstract_en:
Devices and methods for processing animal or human tissue are provided. The devices may 
include a vacuum surface to secure the tissue in place and an apparatus for removing fat or 
other material from the tissue. The apparatus can include one or more blades and/or a fluid 
jet system.

title_en: Separate printed traces for ecg and defibrillation circuits
abstract_en: An electrode pad with a defibrillation circuit and a separate ECG tracing circuit. The electrode pad includes a foam base layer, first and second conductive layers, and a hydrogel layer. The foam base layer has a first side and the first conductive layer is centrally located on the base layer. The first conductive layer has a first circuit configured to provide a defibrillation current. The second conductive layer extends at least partially around the first conductive layer on the first side of the base layer. The second conductive layer has a separate second circuit configured to receive an electrical signal. The hydrogel layer covers the first and second conductive layers on the first side of the base layer. The electrode pad additionally includes an electrical connector attached to the first and second conductive layers. The electrical connector is configured for providing a voltage to the first and second conductive layers.

title_en: Argon combined with thrombectomy in the event of ischaemic stroke
abstract_en:
Title of the invention 
Argon combined with thrombectomy in the event of ischaemic stroke 
The invention relates to an inhalable gaseous medicament containing argon gas for 
use in combination with a mechanical thrombectomy for treating, reducing or 
resorbing brain lesions subsequent to an ischaemic stroke in an individual.  
Preferably, the proportion by volume of argon is between 30 and 79%. The 
mechanical thrombectomy can be accompanied by a drug-based thrombolysis to 
dissolve the clot and to thin the blood of the patient.
