abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of medical instruments, and particularly relates to a holding mirror surgical robot based on a far-end center movement mechanism, which comprises an endoscope; the angle compensation mechanism is connected with the endoscope and used for driving the endoscope to rotate around the axis of the endoscope; the tail end depth feeding mechanism is connected with the angle compensation mechanism and is used for driving the angle compensation mechanism to move so as to control the depth of the endoscope entering human tissues; the distal end center movement mechanism is connected with the distal end depth feeding mechanism and is used for driving the distal end depth feeding mechanism to move so as to control the posture of the endoscope and explore the human tissues in the operation area; the robot position adjusting mechanism is connected with the far-end central movement mechanism and is used for driving the far-end central movement mechanism to move so as to control the height position and the horizontal position of the endoscope; the angle compensation mechanism, the far-end center movement mechanism and the robot position adjusting mechanism are all provided with optical positioning targets. When the invention is applied to endoscopic surgery, the labor intensity of doctors can be reduced and the surgery safety can be improved.

title_en: Non-invasive heart electrophysiological inversion method based on total variation constraint of graph
abstract_en: The invention discloses a noninvasive cardiac electrophysiology inversion method based on graph total variation constraint, noninvasive cardiac electrophysiology inversion is carried out based on the graph total variation constraint, the establishment of a graph structure considers the similarity between non-adjacent nodes in space, the bottom layer characteristics of myocardial trans-membrane potential sequence distribution are fully utilized, the time correlation of electrical excitation propagation is considered, and high-precision myocardial trans-membrane potential sequence distribution is provided. According to the invention, the position and the boundary of an infarct area during myocardial infarction, a pacing point during ectopic pacing and other areas with abnormal electrical activity can be accurately observed through the finally obtained spatial-temporal distribution of the myocardial transmembrane potential, and the invention has important reference significance in clinical diagnosis and treatment. The present invention can directly reconstruct the entire sequence of activations simultaneously, rather than following a solution at a single point in time.

title_en: Bone repair material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a bone repair material and a preparation method thereof, wherein the bone repair material comprises hydrogel and magnesium-containing micro-nano particles; wherein, the mass percentage of magnesium is 0.1-15% based on the total mass of the bone repair material as 100%. The bone repair material provided by the invention can realize the purpose of regulating the release rate of magnesium ions by regulating the crosslinking density of the hydrogel and the content of the interaction group with the magnesium ions; meanwhile, the bone repair material provided by the invention has large magnesium ion release amount and long magnesium ion release time.

title_en: Method and apparatus for image reconstruction
abstract_en: A method of reconstructing image data using x-ray data measured from an imaging system comprising at least one photon counting detector is disclosed. The method comprises the step of obtaining a representation of the data measured by said photon counting detector. The method further comprises the step of generating first image data from a projection-based first functional using a first algorithm, the projection-based first functional being dependent on a representation of the data. The method further comprises the step of updating said first image data based on a second functional comprising a model of at least one physical effect not comprised in said projection-based first functional to obtain second image data. The present disclosure also provides an image processing device configured to reconstruct image data using x-ray data measured from an imaging system comprising at least one photon counting detector, and a corresponding computer program.

title_en: Device for detecting atmospheric microorganisms
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device for detecting atmospheric microorganisms in the technical field of environmental monitoring, which comprises a sealing tank, a supporting plate and an electric push rod, wherein the sealing tank and the electric push rod are respectively and fixedly connected to the right and left sides of the top of the supporting plate vertically, a liquid discharge pipe with a manual valve is arranged at the lower part of the right side of the outer wall of the sealing tank in a penetrating and communicating manner, a gas collecting device is horizontally welded at the top of the electric push rod, a first exhaust fan is fixedly connected to the upper part of the left side of the outer wall of the sealing tank through a horizontal welding bracket, an air inlet of the first exhaust fan is connected with an air outlet of the gas collecting device through a hose, DTT liquid is placed in the sealing tank, when monitoring is not needed, an inert gas recycling device is used for releasing inert gas to fill the sealing tank to prevent oxidation, when the air is needed to be used, the air is injected, meanwhile, the inert gas is recycled, the change rate of a PH (potential of hydrogen) meter is observed for digital display, and the air quality is judged, the device is convenient to operate and use in multiple environments.

title_en: Another insert for use with a blood tubing set to facilitate mixing of an infusion solution with other fluids
abstract_en: Another insert for a blood tubing set is used to facilitate mixing of an infusion solution with another fluid. The invention relates to an insert (100) for a blood tubing set (200), comprising a blood tubing set (200), respectively comprising at least a first connection site (101) for connecting a first tubing part (205 a) of the blood tubing set (200) to the insert (100); a second connection site (103) for connecting a second tube portion (205 b) of the blood tube set (200) to the insert (100); a third connection site (105) for connecting a third tube portion (209) of the blood tube set (200) to the insert (100); a first main line (107 a) for conducting a first liquid, preferably blood, through the insert (100), wherein the first main line (107 a) is in fluid communication with the first connection site (101) and the second connection site (103); a second main line (107 b) for conducting a first liquid, preferably blood, through the insert (100), wherein the second main line (107 b) is in fluid communication with the first connection site (101) and the second connection site (103); a slave line (111) for conducting a second liquid, preferably an infusate, into at least one of the first main line (107 a), the second main line (107 b), the slave line (111) and a connection portion (109) connecting the two main lines (107 a, 107 b) to each other or to the second connection site (103); wherein the slave line (111) is in fluid communication with the third connection site (105); the first connection site (101) comprises an infusible lumen having a first cross-sectional area; the second connection site (103) comprises an infusible lumen having a second cross-sectional area; and first main line (107 a) and/or second main line (107 b) comprises a perfusable lumen having a third cross-sectional area.

title_en: Method and system for processing ultrasound images
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for generating an ultrasound image. In the method, the generating of the ultrasound image comprises: obtaining channel data defining a set of imaged points; for each imaged point: isolating the channel data, performing spatial spectrum estimation on the isolated channel data, and selectively attenuating the spatial spectrum estimation channel data, thereby generating filtered channel data; and summing the filtered channel data to form a filtered ultrasound image. In some examples, the method includes aperture extrapolation. The aperture extrapolation improves the lateral resolution of the ultrasound image. In other examples, the method includes transmitting extrapolation. The emission extrapolation improves the contrast of the image. In addition, the transmit extrapolation also increases the frame rate and reduces motion artifacts in the ultrasound image. In further examples, the aperture extrapolation and the transmit extrapolation may be combined.

title_en: Ecode code-based medical waste treatment tracking and monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a medical waste treatment tracking and monitoring method and system based on Ecode codes. The method comprises the following steps: coding the medical product, wherein the coding comprises Ecode coding of a production enterprise and a medical product information code; the medical product becomes medical waste after being used, the medical waste is scanned for the first time to obtain the code of the medical waste, and an electronic coupon is generated; before the medical waste is destroyed, the medical waste is scanned for the second time to obtain the codes of the medical waste; judging whether the medical product information code in the code obtained by the second scanning is matched with the medical product information code in the electronic coupon obtained by the first scanning; if so, destroying the medical waste; if not, the destruction process is terminated. In addition, the government supervision department and the health department can also determine the destruction condition of the medical waste by comparing the supervision department door code and the health department door code obtained by scanning twice, and the effective supervision on whether the medical waste is treated is realized.

title_en: Medical device and method of manufacturing the same
abstract_en: A medical device which comprises a base material and a hydrophilic polymer layer formed on at least a part of the base material and satisfies the following conditions (a) to (d): (a) the polymer constituting the hydrophilic polymer layer is a hydrophilic polymer containing an acidic group; (b) the thickness of the hydrophilic polymer layer is more than 1nm and less than 100 nm; (c) the hydrophilic polymer layer has a ratio of the number of basic groups/acidic groups of 0.2 or less; (d) the liquid film retention time after 40 minutes after immersion in a phosphate buffer and ultrasonic cleaning is 15 seconds or more. The invention provides a medical device having a hydrophilized surface of a substrate and a method for manufacturing the medical device by a simple method.

title_en: Method for correcting influence of age, sex and blood pressure on pulse wave propagation speed
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for correcting the influence of age, sex and blood pressure on the pulse wave propagation speed, which is characterized by comprising the following steps: the method comprises the following steps: establishing a function family between PWV and blood pressure of a population without arteriosclerotic lesions, and obtaining function parameters corresponding to each age and gender to form a parameter database; establishing a normalized model of the PWV under the fixed age, gender and blood pressure states; obtaining corrections for PWV versus age, gender and blood pressure; the measured PWV is corrected with correction amounts for age, gender and blood pressure. Through the steps, the method can eliminate the influence of physiological factors such as age, sex, instant blood pressure and the like on the PWV, better reflect the change of the PWV caused by pathological factors such as hypertension, hyperlipidemia, diabetes, arteriosclerosis, end-stage nephropathy and the like, and enable the evaluation of arteriosclerosis to be more accurate.

title_en: Minimally invasive restorer for pelvic fracture
abstract_en: A minimally invasive restorer for pelvic fracture belongs to the technical field of orthopedic medical appliances and is used for minimally invasive restoration of pelvic fracture in operation. The technical scheme is that two parallel reset rods are perpendicular to a cross beam, the upper ends of the two reset rods are respectively connected with two ends of the cross beam through transverse moving shafts, a vertical screw rod is connected to the center of the cross beam, the lower ends of the screw rods are rotationally connected with the upper ends of the two pull rods, the lower ends of the two pull rods are respectively connected with the inner sides of the reset rods through rotating shafts, longitudinal sliding grooves are respectively formed in the inner sides of the lower parts of the two reset rods, two longitudinal sliding blocks are respectively embedded in the two longitudinal sliding grooves, the longitudinal screw rods penetrate through long holes of the reset rods and are connected with the upper ends of the longitudinal sliding blocks through threads, and the lower parts of the two reset rods are respectively connected with a bone fracture block hook and a fixing sheet. The invention can effectively control the fracture displacement of the horizontal plane and the coronal plane while minimally invasive reduction, has accurate pelvis fracture reduction, avoids the displacement of fracture parts, and provides scientific support for the minimally invasive reduction operation of pelvis fracture.

title_en: Medical device substrate with rotatable struts
abstract_en: A medical device comprising a substrate defining a major surface, the major surface defining a plane, including a plurality of first struts extending in a first direction, the plurality of first struts interconnected with a plurality of second struts, the plurality of second struts extending in a second direction that is non-parallel to the first direction, a width of the second struts measured along the major surface being greater than a thickness of the second struts measured perpendicular to the major surface, such that when the substrate is stretched in the first direction, a middle section of the second struts rotates relative to the first struts and the middle section of the second struts bends out of the plane of the major surface. The medical device is operable to stretch and/or retract elements suitable for a particular purpose. These elements are extended and/or retracted in response to stresses applied by means of stretching and/or retracting devices, and other methods. Once the force is removed, the elements remain extended and/or retracted, or may spring back to an initial position.

title_en: Medicine taking and disease condition management system based on intelligent medicine box
abstract_en: The invention provides a medication and illness state management system based on an intelligent medicine box, which can be used for accurately acquiring and monitoring the medication condition of a person taking medicine in real time, and is convenient for a user to check and inquire the medication record of the person taking medicine, the medication report of a certain period of time or the medicine condition in the medicine box at any time through a user side; and a bridge for establishing contact between the medicine taking person and the doctor can be established, and the medicine taking information and the treatment information of the medicine taking person can be obtained by a special doctor serving the medicine taking person directly through the system. The intelligent medicine box can also send medicine taking reminding signals through the intelligent medicine box and the user side, so that the medicine taking compliance of a medicine taking person is effectively improved; also can give a warning in time when the medicine taking of the patient is abnormal, and avoid the influence on the state of illness and the treatment effect of the user caused by the missed and wrong administration of the medicine. The invention also introduces video image capturing and face recognition technology, captures the medicine taking behavior of the user in real time, and improves the accuracy of judging whether the user takes medicine according to the amount on time.

title_en: Cardiopulmonary function tester with rehabilitation training function
abstract_en: The invention provides a cardio-pulmonary function tester with a rehabilitation training function, which comprises a supporting bottom plate for supporting a cardio-pulmonary rehabilitation training device, a slope plate, a bicycle body for performing rehabilitation training, a cardio-pulmonary function testing mechanism for performing cardio-pulmonary function testing and an adaptive protection mechanism for performing joint protection on long-time training, and relates to the field of medical rehabilitation. This cardiopulmonary function tester that possesses rehabilitation training function is recovered and test the problem according to current cardiopulmonary function, the osculation that rehabilitation training and test exist has been analyzed, the design out can real-time supervision with the cardiopulmonary function tester that possesses the rehabilitation training function that protective rehabilitation training combined together, thereby effectual general cardiopulmonary function testing arrangement function singleness of having solved, in order to do benefit to the real-time state of an illness of mastering the patient, rehabilitation training device lacks the protection to the sportsman, there is certain potential safety hazard, also influence the problem of recovered efficiency easily.

title_en: Method for intelligent diagnosis and treatment and intelligent diagnosis and treatment system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for intelligent diagnosis and treatment, which comprises the following steps: responding to the input instruction, and acquiring diagnosis and treatment parameters and personal information corresponding to the input instruction; generating diagnosis and treatment information according to the diagnosis and treatment parameters and the personal information; and responding to the diagnosis instruction and/or the nursing instruction, and acquiring matched first diagnosis and treatment content and/or second diagnosis and treatment content output from the diagnosis and treatment information. The invention also discloses an intelligent diagnosis and treatment system, and the method and the system disclosed by the invention can obviously improve the disease diagnosis efficiency and medical care quality of doctors, optimize the medical care flow and improve the nursing work efficiency.

title_en: Test device for evaluating space positioning capability of human or non-human primate
abstract_en: A test device for evaluating space positioning capability of human or non-human primates is technically characterized by comprising a supporting component (1), a wallboard component (2) and a folding door component (3), wherein the supporting component (1) comprises a floor component (14), side columns (12) and middle columns (13) which are perpendicular to the floor component (14) and a guide rail component (11) which is supported on a ceiling, the wallboard component (2) comprises a plurality of U-shaped trolley shells, travelling wheels (313) arranged between the trolley shells and strip wallboards arranged at the bottom of the trolley shells, the folding door component (3) comprises a sliding trolley component (31), a telescopic upright column component (32) and a foldable door plate component (33), and the foldable door plate component (33) comprises a plurality of hinge parts (333) fixed on all hoops and a plurality of door plate components (33) which are connected end to end in sequence and are matched with telescopic upright column sleeves. The method has the advantages of multiple functions, reliable and effective evaluation results, convenience in use, low use cost and the like.

title_en: Online noninvasive pulmonary function monitor for small animals
abstract_en: The invention discloses an online noninvasive lung function monitor for small animals, which comprises an animal fixing clamp, wherein the animal fixing clamp comprises a U-shaped head limiting opening and is configured to limit the movement of experimental animals and prevent the experimental animals from withdrawing the heads of the experimental animals from the nostrils of the animal openings; the head upper and lower limiting protruding block is located on the upper side of the animal head and is configured to limit the upward lifting of the animal head. Meanwhile, the animal mouth and nostril for animal respiration is arranged on the fixed cover, the animal mouth and nostril is designed as an eccentric hole, and the center of the eccentric hole is positioned below the center of the fixed cover. The design of this technical essential has avoided experimental animal at experimental process head withdrawal or to face upward first influence experimental effect promptly, still accords with experimental animal's size, and experimental animal need not face upward first direct experiment, has increased experimental animal's travelling comfort in experimental process.

title_en: Upper and lower limb training device, system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an upper and lower limb training device, a system and a method. The upper and lower limb training system can realize high-interactivity upper and lower limb active and passive cooperative rehabilitation training under the induction of a virtual reality three-dimensional training scene, realize whole space perception closed-loop motion feedback of 'eyes-brain-upper limbs-lower limbs', and is beneficial to improving the training participation degree of a patient.

title_en: Smart surgical hub co-utilization of data from auxiliary sources
abstract_en: Various surgical hubs are disclosed. A surgical hub for use with a medical imaging device at a remote surgical site during a surgical procedure is disclosed. The surgical hub includes circuitry configured to receive a real-time stream of a surgical site from the medical imaging device, capture image frames of surgical steps of the surgical procedure from the real-time stream, derive information related to the surgical steps from data extracted from the image frames, and superimpose the information onto the real-time stream.

title_en: Convenient separator suitable for detachable blood sugar transmitter
abstract_en: The convenient separating device suitable for the detachable blood sugar emitter comprises a holding body and a rebound pressing plate, wherein a separating clamping groove is formed in the bottom surface of the holding body and is used for covering and clamping the blood sugar emitter; the pinching body is provided with a longitudinal cutting side plane, a lower notch is arranged on the longitudinal cutting side plane, and the lower notch is communicated with the separating clamping groove; one end of the rebound pressing plate is integrally formed with the holding body or is an independent part with one end connected with the holding body. The invention has simple structure and convenient use, utilizes the separating clamping groove and the rebound pressing plate to pry the main body part and the consumable part of the blood sugar emitter, saves time and labor, is convenient for batch operation, replaces the traditional pure bare-handed disassembly mode, does not cause excessive tiredness or even injury of fingers, has lower cost and is worthy of popularization and use.

title_en: Improved joint fixing device
abstract_en: The invention relates to an ankle joint fixation device comprising a peg (1) intended to be implanted in a tibia (Ti), a talus (Ta) and a calcaneus (Ca), the peg (1) comprising a proximal portion (2) extending in a first direction (a-a ') and a distal portion (4) extending in a second direction (B-B ') intersecting the first direction (a-a '), the distal portion (4) being provided with a first oblong attachment aperture in the second direction (B-B '), the device comprising a first compression attachment mechanism (9A) of the compression screw type (9A), the peg (1) being designed and configured such that, when the peg is implanted with its distal portion (4) oriented towards the rear of the ankle, the first attachment aperture is arranged to receive and guide the first attachment mechanism (9A) along a first attachment direction (F1-F1 ') extending along the bone (Ta) and the calcaneus (Ca) to attach the peg to the talus (Ta) and the calcaneus (Ca).

title_en: Medical waste transfer trolley based on sterilization and data storage method thereof
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a medical waste transfer vehicle based on sterilization and a data storage method thereof, wherein the medical waste transfer vehicle comprises a transfer vehicle, a recovery barrel cover, an alarm lamp, a sterilization device, an exhaust fan and a two-dimensional code scanning device; wherein, the recovery barrel is fixedly arranged on the upper end surface of the transfer trolley; the recycling barrel cover is arranged at the barrel opening of the recycling barrel; the alarm lamp is fixedly arranged at the top end of the recovery barrel cover; the sterilizing device is arranged at the bottom end of the recycling barrel cover and is aligned with the inner cavity of the recycling barrel, and the exhaust fan is arranged at the bottom end of the recycling barrel cover and is aligned with the inner cavity of the recycling barrel so as to circulate the air in the inner cavity of the recycling barrel; the yard device is swept to two-dimensional code and is fixed to be set up on the outer wall of recycling bin. The medical waste transfer trolley based on sterilization realizes the recovery and transfer of medical waste garbage bags, sterilization and positioning tracking are carried out in the transportation process, the whole process reduces human intervention, the medical waste is prevented from being affected by pollution, and the medical waste loaded into the transfer trolley can be effectively traced.

title_en: Medicine feeding device for experimental animals
abstract_en: The invention discloses a medicine feeding device for experimental animals, which is characterized by comprising a push-pull rod, a first clamp, a second clamp, a medicine feeding device and an animal mouth fixer for opening the mouth of an animal, wherein the top surface of a box body is provided with an opening, the medicine feeding device is arranged on the opening, the medicine feeding device is provided with a medicine injector and a guide ring for guiding the medicine injector, the side surface of the box body is provided with a through hole and a plurality of placing holes, and one end of the push-pull rod penetrates through the through hole to extend into the box body and is connected with a push-pull plate. The invention has the following beneficial effects: the second clamp is fixed with the animal head, and first clamp snatchs the animal oral area fixer in the box, packs into the animal oral area with animal oral area fixer, struts the animal oral area with animal oral area fixer, and in the medicament syringe passed the guide ring and stretched into the animal oral area, use the medicament syringe to feed for the animal, it is accurate to feed the medicine measurement.

title_en: Intelligent wheelchair based on fusion of laser and visual SLAM
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent wheelchair based on fusion of laser and visual SLAM, which comprises a wheelchair body; the ultrasonic sensor is used for detecting the distance between the wheelchair body and surrounding obstacles in real time and sending the distance to the environment sensing module; the laser radar is used for acquiring environmental data around the wheelchair body in real time and sending the environmental data to the environment sensing module; the depth camera is used for acquiring RGB image information and depth around the wheelchair body in real time and sending the RGB image information and the depth to the environment sensing module; the environment sensing module is used for fusing real-time detection values of the ultrasonic sensor and the laser radar to obtain fusion information and sending the fusion information and data collected by the depth camera to the control processing module; the control processing module is used for generating a motion control instruction by the fusion information, the data collected by the depth camera and the current command and sending the motion control instruction to the motor driving module; and the motor driving module is used for driving the wheelchair body according to the motion control command. The wheelchair can be automatically positioned to avoid obstacles and is safe and reliable.

title_en: X-ray filtering device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of devices for assisting a beam limiter in carrying out X-ray filtration, and particularly relates to an X-ray filtration device which comprises a driving component, a return component, a plurality of parallel mounting plate components and filtration pieces with different filtration grades, wherein the number of the filtration pieces is the same as that of the mounting plate components, each filtration piece is movably mounted on one mounting plate component, the plurality of filtration pieces are driven to sequentially move to filtration positions through the driving component, different levels of filtration of X-rays are realized, and the plurality of filtration pieces sequentially return to non-filtration positions through the return component. The device absorbs the soft rays with longer primary X-ray wavelength, improves the perspective imaging quality and reduces the harm to human bodies.

title_en: Postoperative medical operating room odor removal degassing unit with detect function
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of medical treatment, and discloses a deodorizing and disinfecting device with a detection function for a postoperative medical operating room, which comprises a device main body, wherein a bolt is fixedly connected to the outer side of the device main body, an air suction port is arranged on the outer side of the device main body, an air inlet mechanism is fixedly mounted on the outer side of the air suction port, an air inlet channel is fixedly connected to the inner side of the air suction port, a back suction fan is fixedly connected to the inner side of the air inlet channel, one end, far away from the air inlet channel, of the back suction fan is movably connected with an air inlet, a connecting pipeline is fixedly connected to the inner side of the air inlet, and a disinfecting cavity is arranged on the outer side of the connecting pipeline. This postoperative medical treatment operating room removes flavor degassing unit with detect function through the rotation of resorption fan, produces the resorption wind, and the induction port produces the resorption wind then, carries out the resorption with the dirty air of operating room the inside, and dirty gas and then through the mechanism that admits air, reachs the air inlet, passes connecting tube and reachs the disinfection chamber, and the disinfection chamber purifies the disinfection to dirty air then.

title_en: Image processing apparatus and image display method
abstract_en: The image processing device is provided with: a driving unit connected to the ultrasonic transducer or the imaging element inside the tubular member; and an image processing unit that sequentially generates two-dimensional images of an organ, a blood vessel, or a medical instrument based on information of the organ or the medical instrument acquired by the ultrasonic vibrator or the imaging element, and generates three-dimensional images of the organ, the blood vessel, or the medical instrument based on the two-dimensional images, wherein the driving unit moves the ultrasonic vibrator or the imaging element along the tubular member, the image processing unit includes: a storage unit that stores position correspondence information and/or image correspondence information; and a control unit that specifies a position in the three-dimensional image corresponding to a current position of the ultrasonic transducer or the imaging element based on the position correspondence information or the image correspondence information, and generates display information for recognizing and displaying the specified position in the three-dimensional image in real time.

title_en: Cleaning system, heat exchanger assembly and method for an air conditioning system
abstract_en: A cleaning system and a method for cleaning a heat exchanger of an air conditioning system. The heat exchanger includes: a spray subsystem configured to spray cleaning liquid onto the heat exchanger during a cleaning cycle, and further comprising an ultraviolet light source configured to illuminate a surface of the heat exchanger during the cleaning cycle. A heat exchanger assembly for an air conditioning system, the heat exchanger assembly comprising a cleaning system. A method for determining a service life of a heat exchanger of an air conditioning system, comprising: a history of effectiveness is provided, the effectiveness of the latest cleaning cycle is determined and the estimated useful life of the heat exchanger is analyzed and evaluated.

title_en: Special sickbed for nursing vomit patient
abstract_en: The invention relates to a special sickbed for vomit patients, in particular to a special sickbed for nursing the vomit patients. The invention provides a special sickbed for nursing vomit patients, which is convenient for patients who cannot rise to vomit and can collect vomit. A hospital bed dedicated to nursing vomit patients, comprising: the two sides of the bottom plate are connected with two supporting rods; the guide sliding plate is connected between the support rods; the other side of the bottom plate is connected with a support frame; the supporting frame is connected with a baffle; the moving assembly is arranged between the guide sliding plates; the linkage assembly is arranged between the bottom plate and the supporting rod on one side. According to the vomit collecting device, the moving assembly and the linkage assembly are matched, so that the material receiving basin can move upwards, a patient can vomit against the material receiving basin, vomit is collected into the material receiving basin, and therefore the purposes of facilitating vomit collection of patients who cannot get up and collecting vomit are achieved.

title_en: Method for intelligently judging human body posture and nursing equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to the technical field of nursing equipment and discloses a method for intelligently judging human body gestures and nursing equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring human body data information in a video frame according to the video frame acquired by a real scene angle of camera equipment; the human body data information at least comprises human body key point data information, human body coordinate data information and human body key point bounding box data information, corresponding human body posture probabilities in the video frame are calculated from a machine learning training model according to the human body key point data information, the human body coordinate data information and the human body key point bounding box data information, and the maximum probability posture in the human body posture probabilities is judged to be the human body posture in the video frame. By implementing the embodiment of the invention, the recognition judgment accuracy of the nursing equipment can be effectively improved, and meanwhile, misjudgment in most background scenes can be eliminated.

title_en: Physical examination method for VR of driver
abstract_en: The technical scheme of the invention discloses a VR physical examination method for a driver, which comprises the steps of identity recognition, information input, vision detection, hearing detection, color discrimination detection, trunk detection, upper limb detection, lower limb detection, height detection, confirmation and information submission; the invention carries out physical examination of the driver by VR technology, simplifies the physical examination process, is convenient to operate and has wide application range.

title_en: Chitosan or and algal polysaccharide composite biological matrix liquid dressing gel preparation and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: A chitosan or and algal polysaccharide composite biological matrix liquid dressing gel preparation is characterized by comprising main materials and auxiliary materials, wherein the main materials comprise the following components: the content of chitosan is 0.5-5 wt%; the content of algal polysaccharide is 0.00-3.0 wt%; the concentration of the schizonepeta extract is 0-2 wt%; 0-2 wt% of sophora flavescens extract concentrated solution; the content of the hydrolyzed pearl powder is 0.5-2 wt%; borneol content of 0.05-0.5 wt%, epidermal growth factor content of 5-10 ten thousand IU; the auxiliary materials comprise a stabilizing agent and an emulsifying agent, wherein the emulsifying agent is at least one of glycerol, carbomer, EDTA, ethylene glycol, triethanolamine and benzoic acid; the invention has the characteristics of broad-spectrum antibiosis, slough removal, granulation promotion, quick repair, safety, stability, high efficiency, slow release and the like, and achieves the effects of treating anal hemorrhoids and fistula and gynecological inflammation and promoting wound healing.

title_en: Shank rehabilitation device and nursing bed
abstract_en: The invention discloses a leg rehabilitation device, which comprises a leg support for placing a patient's lower leg, a bandage for binding the patient's lower leg and a massage wheel placed at the knee bend of the patient, wherein the massage wheel is arranged at the front end of the leg support through a roller carrier; the advantages are that: 1, the two sides of the driving mechanism are asymmetric and have a non-parallelogram structure, so that the lifting, the front and back and the inclination can be realized, and the leg muscles of a patient can be effectively exercised by the patient; 2, a sole massage plate is arranged at the rear end of the foot, and massage salient points are arranged on the vertical plate, so that the stimulation of the sole acupuncture points can be carried out.

title_en: Recovered medical instrument of shank
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of medical instruments, and particularly discloses a leg rehabilitation medical instrument which comprises a base mechanism, a bed body mechanism and a foot mechanism, wherein the bed body mechanism is provided with a bed plate of the bed body mechanism, a motor of the bed body mechanism and a belt of the bed body mechanism, and the motor of the bed body mechanism, the belt of the bed body mechanism and the foot mechanism are matched with each other to simulate a pedaling action.

title_en: Novel intelligent information acquisition device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a novel intelligent collection of information device, including medical bed, medical bed installs in the ward through many support columns, medical bed's the left and right sides hinged joint has a bed curb plate, first pressure sensor is installed at medical bed left and right sides top, fourth pressure sensor is installed to medical bed left and right sides bottom, bed curb plate top is close to medical bed one side and transversely is provided with the bracing piece, the bracing piece is fixed on the bed curb plate through two first connecting rods, the bracing piece extends towards the length direction of medical bed, the bracing piece is cylindrical, the cover is equipped with the pipe on the bracing piece, the inner circle of pipe and the outer lane of bracing piece adopt the bearing to connect, be provided with locking mechanism on the pipe. The device can identify the patient to go out, automatically control the sickbed of the patient through the controller, and prevent the patient from being cross-infected with other people.

title_en: 32-channel foot radio frequency receiving coil device for magnetic resonance imaging
abstract_en: The invention provides a 32-channel foot radio-frequency receiving coil device for magnetic resonance imaging, which comprises a ankle radio-frequency receiving coil sub-device, an ankle radio-frequency receiving coil sub-device, a heel radio-frequency receiving coil sub-device, a sole radio-frequency receiving coil sub-device and a toe radio-frequency receiving coil sub-device, wherein the four radio-frequency receiving coil sub-devices sequentially comprise: the 8 channels are mutually overlapped end to end around the left-right direction to form a first annular ring, and the 6 channels are mutually overlapped around the left-right direction in sequence to form a first U-shaped ring; the 4 half channels are sequentially overlapped around the left direction and the right direction to form a second U-shaped ring, the right end of the second U-shaped ring is sealed by the 1 half channel, and the 6 half channels are vertically overlapped around the third U-shaped ring to form a second annular ring and a third annular ring. The 32-channel foot radio frequency receiving coil device for magnetic resonance imaging has higher signal-to-noise ratio and more uniform signal distribution, can improve the scanning coverage, image quality and image uniformity of the foot of a human body, thereby improving the screening and diagnosis rate of foot diseases, and has the advantages of ingenious design, simple structure, simple and convenient manufacture and low cost.

title_en: Disinfection and sterilization equipment for sanitary towel production
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disinfection and sterilization device for sanitary towel production, which structurally comprises a disinfection cabinet, a conveyer belt, an operation panel and a display, wherein the conveyer belt is arranged on the left side of the disinfection cabinet, and the operation panel and the display are embedded in the front side of the disinfection cabinet, and the disinfection and sterilization device has the beneficial effects that: the sanitary towel that produces the shaping passes between two deflector rolls, make the deflector roll flatten the sanitary towel, in order to avoid the sanitary towel folding to lead to the bacterium to remain, the sanitary towel drops on receiving the piece through lower thing groove after that, make the piece of receiving rotate under the meshing of latch and bull stick, make the sanitary towel get into the sterilizer and disinfect and sterilize under the irradiation of ultraviolet disinfection lamp, the sanitary towel that gets into the sterilizer moves to the swash plate on, the light that the ultraviolet disinfection lamp shines passes through the guide case under the refraction of refraction board and shines on the sanitary towel and disinfect and sterilize, promote the pendulum rod and revolve the pivot when the sanitary towel moves to the swash plate end and rotate, make the pendulum rod turn over the sanitary towel, cause the sanitary towel to obtain comprehensive disinfection and sterilization.

title_en: A terminal puncture mechanism and puncture surgical robot for medical surgical robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of medical instruments, in particular to a tail end puncture mechanism for a medical operation robot and the puncture operation robot. When the puncture needle firing device is used for diagnosis or treatment, the puncture needle can be accurately and quickly installed and accurately guided and positioned, the puncture needle is automatically pushed to carry out accurate puncture, the influence of the hand shake of a doctor on the puncture accuracy is eliminated, the puncture needle can be conveniently separated from a surgical robot mechanism, the puncture needle can be automatically and quickly evacuated from a surgical area, a large surgical space is provided for follow-up doctor to carry out bare-handed surgery, and the better man-machine coordination operation is realized. The robot can independently complete the operation, doctors can conveniently intervene in the operation, the respective advantages of the robot and the robot are fully exerted, and the technical content of directional puncture is reduced; the puncture frequency is reduced, the operation time is effectively shortened, the radiation quantity passively received by a patient and actively received by a doctor is reduced, and the percutaneous targeted puncture accuracy is obviously improved.

title_en: Double-balloon catheter device for gastrointestinal anastomosis
abstract_en: The invention provides a double-balloon catheter device for gastrointestinal anastomosis, which comprises a first balloon infusion tube, a positioning balloon infusion tube, a catheter shell, a pressure-resistant layer and a second balloon infusion tube, wherein a wire-tying ring is installed at one end of the catheter shell, the first balloon infusion tube, the positioning balloon infusion tube and the second balloon infusion tube are installed on the inner wall of the wire-tying ring, a first balloon, a positioning balloon and a second balloon are installed on the outer wall of the catheter shell, the first balloon, the positioning balloon and the second balloon are sequentially arranged from left to right, the surfaces of the first balloon and the second balloon are made of the same material, and the surfaces of the first balloon and the second balloon comprise the pressure-resistant layer, a reinforcing layer and a protective layer. The invention can ensure that a patient does not feel pain when in use, can well fix the transverse intestine, has good dimensional stability and mechanical property, can ensure the safe and stable operation of the operation, and has strong practicability.

title_en: Contact structure, direction electrode assembly method and direction electrode
abstract_en: The invention provides a contact structure, a directional electrode assembly method and a directional electrode, wherein the sheet-shaped contact structure in the contact structure comprises at least one sheet-shaped contact; at least one frame is suitable for being sleeved on the mandrel; and one side of the frame, which faces the sheet contact, extends out of a connecting end to be connected with the sheet contact. When the sheet contact needs to be arranged at a specific position of the mandrel, the positioning and fixing of the single sheet contact are not needed, and only the positioning and fixing of the whole sheet contact structure sleeved on the mandrel are needed; comparing the structure of the sheet contact with the structure of the sheet contact, obviously, the cylindrical sheet contact structure which can be sleeved on the mandrel is easier to position and fix on the mandrel; therefore, the sheet contact structure can more easily realize the positioning and fixing of the sheet contact on the mandrel, thereby reducing the assembly difficulty of the sheet contact, improving the production efficiency and improving the product yield.

title_en: Bubble detector on proximal end of catheter with failsafe mechanism
abstract_en: The invention provides a bubble detector on the proximal end of a catheter with a failsafe mechanism. A system includes a probe, a processor, and a bubble detector. The probe is configured for insertion into a lumen of a patient and is coupled to the irrigation pump. The processor is configured to control delivery of the irrigation fluid to the probe by turning on and controlling the irrigation pump. A bubble detector is coupled to the proximal portion of the probe. In response to the flush pump being turned on, the bubble detector is configured to automatically initiate detection of a bubble in the flush fluid and transmit a failsafe signal indicating that the failsafe bubble detection is operable. The processor is further configured to monitor the failsafe signal and automatically disable delivery of the flushing fluid in the absence of the failsafe signal.

title_en: Wrist strap equipment and VR system
abstract_en: The invention discloses wristband equipment and a VR system, which comprise a first wireless module, a movement detection device and a controller. The controller judges whether the first wireless module is successfully connected with a second wireless module on the VR head-mounted display, if so, the space movement information acquired by the movement detection device is transmitted to the VR head-mounted display in a wireless mode, so that the VR head-mounted display determines an action path of the wrist strap device according to the space movement information, and corresponding control is carried out based on the action path; if not, the wristband device is controlled to enter the original wristband device working mode. Therefore, the wrist strap equipment has the dual functions of the VR game handle and the common wrist strap equipment, and has high practicability; moreover, the VR system can track the motion path of the wristband device when the wristband device moves to the body of a user, so that some motion games related to the back can be realized on VR, and the user experience is good.

title_en: Ultrasonic probe's sound head and ultrasonic probe
abstract_en: In the acoustic head and the ultrasonic probe, the side wall of an internal array element, the side wall of a backing and a negative electrode butt joint part of a flexible circuit board are all provided with conducting layers formed by conducting materials, and the conducting layers continuously extend to a grounding point of the negative electrode butt joint part from a negative electrode of a wafer through the side wall of the backing so as to enable the negative electrode of the internal array element to be electrically connected with the grounding point. The structure omits the traditional copper foil, the flexible circuit board is directly electrically connected with the negative electrode of the internal array element by utilizing the conducting layer, the overall structure of the sound head can be reduced, and meanwhile, the consistency of the wafer, the back lining and the matching layer is facilitated.

title_en: Anesthesia screwed pipe supports adjusting device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anesthesia threaded pipe supporting and adjusting device, which relates to the technical field of medical instruments and comprises a supporting plate, wherein a lifting sleeve block is vertically and slidably sleeved on an upright post, a winding mechanism for winding an anesthesia threaded pipe is rotatably installed on a horizontal plate, a supporting mechanism for supporting the anesthesia threaded pipe is arranged on one side of the horizontal plate, the supporting mechanism comprises an adjusting plate, and a transverse extending mechanism is in transmission connection between the supporting mechanism and the horizontal plate; according to the anesthesia threaded pipe height adjusting device, the lifting adjusting effect of the vertical height of the lifting sleeve block is achieved through the arranged lifting driving mechanism, so that the vertical position of an anesthesia threaded pipe is adjusted flexibly, the firm limiting effect after the height of the anesthesia threaded pipe is adjusted can be achieved through the arranged one-way clamping limiting mechanism, the horizontal position of the adjusting plate can be adjusted in a translation mode through the arranged horizontal extending mechanism, the extension or contraction of the anesthesia threaded pipe is achieved, and the flexible adjusting effect of the anesthesia threaded pipe in the using process is effectively improved.

title_en: AI technology-based renal disease hemodialysis scheme customization method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a renal disease hemodialysis scheme customizing method and system based on an AI technology. The method comprises the following steps: arranging user data to be customized, substituting the user data to be customized into a dialysis scheme generation model, and generating one or more dialysis schemes; bringing user data to be customized and one or more dialysis schemes into a hemodialysis abnormal condition evaluation model to obtain abnormal condition evaluation results of the one or more dialysis schemes; determining a kidney disease hemodialysis customized scheme according to the abnormal condition evaluation result; wherein the hemodialysis abnormal condition evaluation model is obtained by training through a machine learning CART decision tree algorithm according to historical dialysis data. According to the invention, a machine learning model is established according to historical dialysis data, adverse reactions possibly occurring in a certain dialysis scheme of the current body state of a patient are predicted in advance, and an individualized dialysis scheme is worked out, so that the dialysis risk is effectively solved to the minimum, the safety of the patient is ensured, and the medical care quality is improved.

title_en: Electrolysis device and clothes treatment equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an electrolysis device, which comprises an electrode and a mounting device; the mounting device comprises a screwing body and a locking part arranged on the surface of the screwing body, the electrode is positioned on the first side of the screwing body, a locking surface is formed on one side of the locking part, which is far away from the electrode, the locking surface extends along the circumferential direction of the screwing body, and a sealing structure facing the first side is formed on the mounting device. The electrolytic device is applied to the clothes treatment equipment as an example, part of the structure of the mounting device is tightly clamped between the clamping portion and the structure around the mounting port, the mounting device is prevented from moving along the inner direction and the outer direction of the outer barrel, the sealing structure is firmly abutted to the periphery of the mounting port, the mounting port is sealed, pretightening force along the inner direction and the outer direction of the outer barrel is not required to be provided through screws in the prior art, therefore, the problem of sealing failure caused by loosening of the screws in the prior art can be avoided, and the sealing reliability is effectively improved.

title_en: Intelligent medical health monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent medical health monitoring system, which comprises a data center processing platform, a hospital management end and a user end, wherein the hospital management end and the user end are both connected with the data center processing platform; the data center processing platform is used for storing, analyzing and distributing data and comprises a user database module and a data information processing module; the hospital management terminal is used for uploading data to the data center processing platform and receiving the data sent by the data center processing platform and comprises an authority control layer, a medical information sharing interface and a doctor working terminal; the user side comprises health monitoring equipment, a monitoring data reading module, a health monitoring reminding module, a health data display module, a doctor interaction module, a care family module, a health knowledge subscription module and a history visitor module. In addition, the design of the invention considers the requirements of the blind, so that the blind can use the system easily.

title_en: Quantitative medicine taking reminding equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to quantitative medicine taking reminding equipment which comprises a plate medicine feeding and discharging device for taking plate medicine from a package, a bottled medicine discharging device for taking bottle medicine from a bottle one by one, an oral liquid uncovering device for removing a bottle cap of an oral liquid bottle from a bottle opening, and a collecting reminding device for collecting the taken plate medicine and the bottled medicine and reminding the old to take the medicine. The invention provides a quantitative medicine taking reminding device which can take out medicine from a package at regular time.

title_en: DR flat bed with edge strips, flat bed forming die and forming method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a DR flat bed with an edge strip, a flat bed forming die and a flat bed forming method, wherein the DR flat bed with the edge strip comprises an upper skin, a lower skin, a core material and a frame, the core material is arranged between the upper skin and the lower skin, and the upper skin and the lower skin are oppositely arranged in the thickness direction of the core material; the frame is established between last covering and lower covering, and the frame encloses into the cavity that is used for holding the core, and the frame includes two long strake and two short strake, and two long strake and two short strake are established respectively between covering and lower covering, and two long strake and two short strake end to end enclose into the frame. The DR bed board with the edge strips is uniform in thickness and high in product size precision.

title_en: EEG signal-based rapid evaluation method for cranial nerve functional state detection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid evaluation method for detecting the brain nerve function state based on an EEG signal, which comprises the steps of collecting resting state electroencephalogram data of a subject, extracting time domain and frequency domain characteristic parameters through windowing, constructing a characteristic matrix after independently normalizing each characteristic, putting into a brain nerve function state detection model trained in the early stage, and rapidly evaluating the brain function state of the subject. The brain function state evaluation method is high in expansibility, applicable to evaluation of various brain function states, simple to operate, high in accuracy and quite wide in application prospect.

title_en: Bone grinding dynamic safety control system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application discloses bone grinding developments safety control system and equipment, medium for solve current bone tissue grinding operation and carry out the grinding through manual operation, efficiency is not high, and operating time overlength can't guarantee the problem of grinding precision. The system comprises: the path planning module is used for determining bone tissues to be removed according to the three-dimensional image of the grinding part and planning a grinding path; the motion control module is used for receiving the grinding path sent by the path planning module and controlling the end effector to grind according to the grinding path; the sensor module is used for detecting operation information in the grinding process; and the control software module is used for acquiring the operation information detected by the sensor module and adjusting the grinding process according to the operation information. When the grinding environment value deviates from the preset value, the end effector can be adjusted in time, a closed loop for dynamically controlling the grinding process is formed, the grinding accuracy is ensured, and the safety and reliability of the grinding process are effectively improved.

title_en: Poultry breeding device and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a poultry breeding device and a poultry breeding method, the breeding device comprises a chamber body, a plurality of rows of breeding units are arranged in the chamber body, a ventilating duct is arranged below each row of breeding units, a heating mechanism is arranged in the ventilating duct, an exhaust channel and a second air inlet pipeline are arranged on two sides in the chamber body, a first air inlet pipeline is arranged in the exhaust channel, one end of the first air inlet pipeline is connected with an air inlet, the other end of the first air inlet pipeline is connected with one end of the ventilating duct, the other end of the ventilating duct is connected with the second air inlet pipeline through a second conveying pipeline, the upper end in the chamber body is provided with a plurality of vertically lifting spraying pipelines at intervals, and a plurality of liquid spraying heads are arranged on the spraying pipelines at. The invention preheats the air through the gas in the exhaust pipeline and recovers part of heat; get into indoorly behind the air heating after preheating, avoid indoor difference in temperature to change greatly, spray the pipeline and go up and down to set up, can realize from the top down spraying or rinsing whole goose house comprehensively.

title_en: Detection device, measurement system, monitoring system, and program
abstract_en: Provided are a detection device, a measurement system, a monitoring system, and a program, wherein the detection device is provided with: a substrate; a positive electrode and a negative electrode provided on the substrate; an electric field generating circuit for generating an electric field from one first surface of the substrate by supplying a current or a voltage between the positive electrode and the negative electrode; a protective electrode that is provided at a position farther from the first surface than the positive electrode and the negative electrode, and that faces at least one of the positive electrode and the negative electrode with an insulator interposed therebetween; a potential adjusting circuit that sets a potential applied to an electrode corresponding to the guard electrode out of the positive electrode and the negative electrode to be the same potential as a potential of the guard electrode; and a semiconductor element that outputs an electric field strength detection value corresponding to an electric field strength between the positive electrode and the negative electrode.

title_en: Inflatable sleeve multi-electrode catheter
abstract_en: The invention provides a sleeve multi-electrode catheter capable of being inflated. An apparatus includes a shaft and an inflatable cannula catheter. The shaft is configured for insertion through the sheath into a cavity of an organ of a patient. An inflatable cannula catheter is secured to the distal end of the shaft, wherein the inflatable cannula catheter comprises: (i) a resilient inner end section fixed to the distal end of the shaft and shaped so as to assume a predefined shape when unconstrained; (ii) an inflatable sleeve enclosing the inner end section; and a plurality of electrodes disposed on the inflatable sleeve and configured to contact tissue.

title_en: Product external packing disinfection conveying equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a product outer package disinfection conveying device, wherein a disinfection system comprises a water storage device, a water supply device, a disinfection device and a disinfectant recovery box; the sterilizing device comprises a sterilizing protective cover and a spraying assembly, and the sterilizing protective cover is positioned above the middle part of the conveying system; two side openings of the sterilizing and killing protective cover, which are vertical to the conveying direction of the conveying system, are provided with protective check curtains; the spraying assembly comprises a top surface spraying pipe, a bottom surface spraying pipe and four side surface spraying pipes, wherein the top surface spraying pipe is arranged on the inner top surface of the sterilizing and killing protective cover, the bottom surface spraying pipe extends into a position between an upper layer of conveying belt and a lower layer of conveying belt of the conveying system, and the four side surface spraying pipes are respectively vertically arranged on four corners in the sterilizing and killing protective cover; a plurality of spray heads which are arranged at equal intervals are arranged on the top surface spray pipe, the bottom surface spray pipe and the side surface spray pipe. The automatic conveyor belt disinfection device provided by the invention can realize automatic conveyor belt disinfection instead of manual disinfection, solves the common problems of low disinfection efficiency and poor disinfection effect in the industry, and reduces the investment of labor cost.

title_en: Vascular access monitoring method and system for dialysis patients
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vascular access monitoring method and a vascular access monitoring system for dialysis patients, wherein the vascular access monitoring method comprises the following steps: acquiring a vascular access condition of a patient; analyzing the vascular access condition of the patient, and judging whether the vascular access blood flow of the patient is reduced to the set intervention time or whether the imaging examination result indicates that the vascular access is in bad function or the patient has complaint of vascular access pain or has obvious abnormality compared with the past information of the vascular access; different treatments are made according to the vascular access conditions of each patient. The vascular access monitoring method and the vascular access monitoring system for the dialysis patient can acquire vascular access information of the patient in time, automatically generate reminding data under abnormal conditions, and automatically generate dialysis orders and adjust dialysis scheduling.

title_en: Temporal lobe epilepsy detection system based on multi-site synchronization change
abstract_en: The invention discloses a temporal lobe epilepsy detection system based on multi-site synchronous change, which is characterized by comprising at least one computer system, wherein the computer system is configured to: receiving abnormal discharge signals synchronously recorded at a plurality of sites on the hippocampus and the limbus system; preprocessing the received abnormal discharge signal to determine a target frequency band for detection; and detecting temporal lobe epilepsy according to the synchronous change condition of the abnormal discharge signals of multiple sites in the target frequency band. Seizures are detected by analyzing the changes in synchrony between the hippocampus and various sites on the limbic system.

title_en: Automatic balanced stretcher climbs
abstract_en: The utility model provides an automatic balanced stretcher of climbing, includes the girder the both sides fixed cross beam of girder, the fixed linkage handle in both ends of girder, the location axle has been put at the center of girder, installs the goods of furniture for display rather than for use on the location axle, and the universal driving shaft has been put to the goods of furniture for display rather than for use lower extreme, installs gangbar and triangle locating lever on the universal driving shaft, the fixed stretcher board in triangle locating lever top. The left goods of furniture for display rather than for use is connected to the gangbar left end, and the right-hand member of gangbar is connected right goods of furniture for display rather than for use, and left goods of furniture for display rather than for use is installed on left linkage handle, and right goods of furniture for display rather than for use is installed on right linkage handle. The invention can be applied to the road with gradient and can automatically keep balance when climbing the slope. The lifesaving device can be used for lifesaving in the field and can also be applied to other fields needing lifesaving, such as lifesaving in earthquakes and the like. The medical nursing bed can be used in hospitals, unit medical rooms and the like, thereby safely and effectively serving wounded persons and protecting the life safety of people.

title_en: Glasses type eye dropping device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of eye drop devices, and relates to a glasses type eye drop device which can accurately drop eye drops into conjunctival sac of eyes. The invention can simultaneously drop the eye drops into the left and the right eyes of a wearer by arranging the two eye drop devices with the same left and the right, and the eye drops can be accurately dropped into the lower conjunctival sac of eyes of different wearers by virtue of the adjusting devices on the eye drop frames on the glasses, thereby achieving good eye drop effect. The opaque lens with the notch can prevent a wearer from subconsciously closing the eyes due to the falling object feeling generated by dripping of liquid drops during eye dropping, so that the normal operation of the eye dropping process is prevented. In addition, the invention is provided with the pressure sensor and matched with the electromagnet group, so that the same and proper amount of liquid drops can be ensured to be dropped every time the eye drops. Finally, the invention is a glasses type device, which is comfortable to wear, does not generate touch when being used by a wearer, is convenient to use and is easy to popularize.

title_en: Dental preparation system
abstract_en: The invention provides a tooth preparation system, which comprises a visual marking guide plate, a dental robot, a visual navigator and a preparation control device, wherein the visual marking guide plate is arranged on the dental robot; the visual marking guide plate is arranged on the dentition where the tooth to be restored is located, and dentition visual marks are arranged on the visual marking guide plate; the dental robot comprises a mechanical positioning arm and a surgical instrument arranged at the tail end of the mechanical positioning arm, wherein an instrument visual mark is arranged on the surgical instrument; the visual navigator is used for detecting the position and the posture of the dentition visual mark and the instrument visual mark; the preparation control device performs vision calibration based on the position posture of the dentition vision mark, performs hand-eye calibration based on the position posture of the instrument vision mark, and controls the mechanical positioning arm to act based on the vision calibration result and the hand-eye calibration result. The system provided by the invention can automatically control the motion of the dental robot even in a narrow and non-direct-viewing environment in the oral cavity, so that the tooth preparation precision is higher, and the operation efficiency and consistency are improved.

title_en: Integral type pestle needle
abstract_en: The invention provides an integrated pestle needle, which comprises an upper half part and a lower half part, wherein the upper half part and the lower half part are both provided with springs, limiting pieces and limiting grooves, a five-star pestle, three pestles, a seven-bright mixed pestle and a diamond pestle are positioned inside the upper half part and the lower half part, the pestles, the limiting pieces and the limiting grooves can freely stretch and retract under the mutual matching of the springs, the upper half part and the lower half part can be mutually buckled, and after the upper half part and the lower half part are separated, circular convex columns arranged at the top of the lower half part can also be used for massaging.

title_en: Jaundice triage information analysis method and system based on automatic identification
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of medical treatment, in particular to a jaundice triage information analysis method and system based on automatic identification, which are used for cleaning image data and discarding image data which does not have infant jaundice condition information or has poorer image self conditions; converting the picture into an HSV space, judging to enter global brightness adjustment through a V component of the HSV space after filtering, and carrying out formula transformation processing; subclassing the processed pictures by giving a plurality of thresholds or dividing the whole body and local classification; independently training each divided subclass to obtain different model parameters; and calling corresponding model data, and inputting the processed pictures into a model for calculation to obtain the probability of no jaundice, the probability of physiological jaundice and the probability of pathological jaundice. The method applies the AI technology to the field of infant health, simplifies the process of neonatal jaundice judgment and improves the accuracy of primary neonatal jaundice judgment through graphic data processing and model structure optimization.

title_en: Anorectal surgery probing device convenient to replace and free of probe structure
abstract_en: The invention provides an anorectal surgery probing device with a probe structure convenient to replace, which comprises a probe shell; the bottom of the probe shell is in threaded connection with a bottom cover, a probe control knob is rotatably connected inside the bottom cover, and a probe body is arranged in the middle of the probe control knob; a detection ball is arranged at the top of the probe shell; the top parts of two sides of a cavity at the top of the probe body are connected with wedge-shaped limiting blocks in a sliding manner, the bottom parts of two sides of the cavity are connected with control blocks in a sliding manner, and the wedge-shaped limiting blocks and the control blocks are connected through X-shaped support arms; according to the invention, the top of the probe body is inserted into the clamping groove of the detection ball, the wedge-shaped limiting block is clamped into the limiting groove of the detection ball, the top of the probe body and the detection ball are fixed together, and the probe body and the detection ball are conveniently separated, so that the probe body can be combined with different puncture probes.

title_en: Anesthesia machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anaesthesia machine, which comprises a rack, a plurality of wheels, a plurality of brake mechanisms and a controller, wherein the wheels are rotatably arranged on the rack; the brake mechanism is arranged corresponding to one wheel and comprises a first elastic piece, a locking component and an electromagnet, wherein the first elastic piece is arranged on the frame, the locking component is movably arranged on the frame and is connected with the first elastic piece, the first elastic piece drives the locking component to be abutted against the wheel corresponding to the locking component so that the wheel is limited and fixed relative to the frame, and the electromagnet is arranged on the frame and can drive the locking component to be separated from the wheel after being electrified; the controller is arranged on the frame and is electrically connected with a plurality of electromagnets in a plurality of braking mechanisms. The technical scheme of the invention can simplify the braking operation process of the anesthesia machine and reduce the labor intensity of medical staff.

title_en: Gastrointestinal surgery is nutrient solution ration device of dosing for postoperative
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gastrointestinal surgery postoperative nutrient solution quantitative dosing device which comprises a supporting plate, wherein a dosing mechanism is arranged at the upper end of the supporting plate, the dosing mechanism comprises a quantitative liquid injection cylinder, a rubber piston, a supporting pull rod, a limiting plate, a first one-way input valve, a first pipeline inserting nozzle, a liquid conveying pipe, a nutrient bag, a hook, a supporting rod, a supporting column, a one-way output valve, a second pipeline inserting nozzle, a dosing hose and a porous medicine discharge head, the upper end of the supporting plate is provided with the quantitative liquid injection cylinder, the quantitative liquid injection cylinder is internally provided with the rubber piston, and the upper end of the rubber piston inside the quantitative liquid injection cylinder is provided with the supporting pull rod. The invention can avoid the blocking phenomenon of the nutrient solution in the administration hose, can quickly wash the interior of the quantitative liquid injection cylinder, ensures the use safety of the quantitative liquid injection cylinder and better meets the use requirement.

title_en: Electrolytic component and clothes treatment equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an electrolysis assembly and clothes treatment equipment, wherein the electrolysis assembly comprises an electrolysis device, a heating element and a mounting device, and the electrolysis device comprises an electrode; the electrolysis device and/or the heating element are connected with the mounting device, and the heating element and the electrode are positioned on the same side of the mounting device. The electrolytic assembly provided by the embodiment of the application can be used for generating hydroxyl radicals with strong oxidation activity by electrolyzing water through the electrolytic device so as to sterilize; the liquid is heated to the required temperature through the heating element, and the heating element and the electrolysis device are integrated together, so that the structural arrangement of the heating element and the electrolysis device can be more compact; the electrolysis assembly is convenient to be integrally disassembled and assembled, and the product is convenient to be updated.

title_en: Design method of total knee replacement surgical guide plate and related equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a design method of a total knee replacement surgical guide plate and related equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining a corresponding three-dimensional image based on medical image data of a target part, and selecting an adaptive prosthesis model from a pre-stored prosthesis database; generating a guide plate file matched with the prosthesis model; and placing the guide plate model corresponding to the guide plate file on the target part for bone surface fitting to obtain guide plate design data for machining and manufacturing the guide plate.
