According to the invention, the design and the manufacture of the personalized guide plate are carried out without the help of professional technicians to create design assemblies through CAD, the design difficulty of the guide plate is reduced, the design period of the guide plate is shortened, and the dependence of the guide plate on the professional degree of designers is greatly reduced.

title_en: Flexible telescopic flute needle for transmicrophthalmia subretinal fluid suction
abstract_en: The invention relates to a bendable telescopic flute needle for subretinal fluid suction of a fissured hole line, which comprises a flute needle body, a flute needle head, a length adjusting device and a bending telescopic device, wherein the flute needle body is provided with a flute needle head; the length adjusting device comprises a push-pull rod, a screw device, a closed piston, a connecting rod, a spring, a hollow piston and a silica gel needle head; the tail section of the silica gel needle is arranged inside the whistle body, and the front section of the silica gel needle is arranged outside the whistle body; the bending and stretching device comprises a sliding block, a sliding groove, a winding shaft and a medical polypropylene elastic wire. Its advantages are: the length and the curvature can be adjusted, the device can be used for assisting the subretinal fluid suction through peripheral fissures in the porogenic retinal detachment reduction operation, is favorable for more fully sucking the subretinal fluid while avoiding iatrogenic injury, removes the fluid accumulated in the fissures, provides a proper environment for the migration of photoreceptor cells, is easier to grow and recover the neural epithelial structure of the retina of the user, and further promotes the healing of the fissures.

title_en: Two-stage release bolt taking device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a two-stage release thrombus removal device, and belongs to the technical field of thrombus removal devices. The device comprises an outer sheath pipe, an inner pipe, a secondary filter screen, a control outer pipe, a control inner pipe and a primary filter screen; an inner tube is arranged in the outer sheath tube, a secondary filter screen is fixed at the near end of the inner tube, and the secondary filter screen is an umbrella-shaped filter screen with an opening facing the near end; the control outer pipe is inserted into the inner pipe, and the control inner pipe is inserted into the control outer pipe; the one-level filter screen is spindle-shaped, and the near-end of one-level filter screen is fixed on the control inner tube, and the distal end of one-level filter screen is fixed at the control outer tube near-end, and the near-end of one-level filter screen forms the double-deck umbrella-shaped filter screen of opening towards the distal end after moving near with the distal end. After the thrombus was collected to the end, release the second grade filter screen, the thrombus is surrounded between one-level filter screen and second grade filter screen to through resumeing into the fusiformis with the one-level filter screen gradually, the thrombus is pressed from both sides tightly by one-level filter screen, second grade filter screen, is difficult for escaping when the thrombus is taken in outer sheath pipe.

title_en: Preparation method of 3D printing wound dressing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a 3D printing wound dressing, which comprises the following steps: (1) mixing Thermoplastic Polyurethane (TPU) and a zinc polyacrylate ionomer, polyvinyl alcohol, polyvinylpyrrolidone, zinc oxide and calcium carbonate microspheres in proportion, and preparing a 3D printing consumable material by melting, extruding and wire drawing; (2) printing the consumables in the step (1) into a gasket by adopting a 3D printer; (3) soaking the gasket in dilute hydrochloric acid or dilute acetic acid, then soaking the gasket in dilute chitosan solution, and then soaking the gasket in dilute chondroitin sulfate solution; and repeating the three sequential soaking processes for a plurality of times, taking out the gasket, and naturally airing at room temperature to prepare the wound dressing for wound repair. The 3D printing wound dressing prepared by the invention can avoid pain caused by gauze replacement, and has a good wound repair effect.

title_en: Respiratory support apparatus, ventilation control method thereof, and computer-readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a respiratory support device, a ventilation control method thereof and a computer readable storage medium, comprising: the method comprises the steps that the breathing support equipment determines corresponding mechanical energy when a patient is ventilated according to different positive end expiratory pressures within a preset time period to obtain a plurality of mechanical energy (S101); the respiratory support apparatus sets a positive end-expiratory pressure corresponding to a time when the mechanical energy of the plurality of mechanical energies is at a minimum or begins to increase significantly, as a target positive end-expiratory pressure (S102). The accuracy and timeliness of adjusting the positive end-expiratory pressure are improved, and the convenience and reliability of ventilation control of the respiratory support equipment are improved.

title_en: Multi-joint functional negative plate connecting wire
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-joint functional negative plate connecting wire which comprises a plate electrode joint, wherein a conversion piece is electrically connected to the plate electrode joint, a plurality of current channels communicated with the plate electrode joint are formed in the conversion piece, and each current channel is electrically connected with an external joint used for butting a host. The invention has the following advantages and effects: the electrode plate joint is in butt joint with the electrode plate, and the plurality of external joints are in butt joint with the plurality of electrosurgery host machines respectively, so that the simultaneous butt joint use of one negative plate and the plurality of electrosurgery host machines is realized, the thermal injury to the skin of a patient is reduced, the connecting line is also reduced, the operation is simpler and more convenient, and the operation efficiency is improved; meanwhile, the coupling effect is avoided when the electric knife is used, and the cost of consumables can be saved.

title_en: Wireless magnetic resistance actuator based on magnetic resonance coupling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a magnetic resonance coupling-based wireless magnetic resistance actuator, which comprises a transmitting end and a driving end, wherein the transmitting end is connected with the transmitting end; the transmitting end comprises a high-frequency power supply, a source coil and a transmitting coil which are concentrically arranged, and the source coil is connected with the high-frequency power supply; the driving end comprises a receiving coil, a load coil and a driving coil which are arranged concentrically, the receiving coil wirelessly receives the power of the transmitting coil and wirelessly transmits the power to the load coil, and the load coil is electrically connected with the driving coil; one of the transmitting end and the driving end is also provided with a magnetic element, and the magnetic element is matched with the driving coil. The invention combines the actuator and the wireless energy transfer function, establishes a local strong magnetic field in the in-vivo drug release device by utilizing the wireless energy transfer function, and releases the drug by utilizing the local strong magnetic field. In addition, the in vivo drug delivery device may or may not contain a magnetic substance. Thus, it can be used in a strong magnetic environment, for example, in a nuclear magnetic resonance machine.

title_en: 3D prints tumour type knee joint bone cement false body device
abstract_en: The invention provides a 3D printing tumor type knee joint bone cement prosthesis device which mainly comprises a bone cement membrane shell, an intramedullary needle, an upper-section fixing screw of the intramedullary needle, a first intramedullary needle fixing frame, a second intramedullary needle fixing frame, an anterior cruciate ligament screw hole, a bone cement injection hole, a lower-section fixing screw of the intramedullary needle, a rear cruciate ligament screw hole and a intramedullary needle buckle. The invention is designed according to the actual three-dimensional anatomical data of the knee joint and is fitted with an anatomical structure; the important soft tissue structure of the knee joint is effectively reconstructed, the stability of the knee joint after operation is enhanced, and the knee joint is close to the normal knee joint function to the maximum extent; the prosthesis and the osteotomy stump are fixed through the fixing screw and the intramedullary needle, so that the instability and the rotation of the knee joint prosthesis are avoided, and the knee joint stability is enhanced; the joint surface is smooth, the generation of wear particles in the movement can be effectively reduced, the joint wear speed is reduced, the service time of the bone cement prosthesis is prolonged, the tension and the toughness of the bone cement prosthesis are improved, and the fracture risk of the bone cement prosthesis in the movement is effectively reduced.

title_en: Needleless injector
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of syringes, in particular to a needleless syringe which comprises a shell, a gun barrel component, a piston, an energy storage cavity, a control cavity, a balance valve and a control valve, wherein the piston is in transmission connection with a push rod for pushing liquid medicine in the gun barrel component, the energy storage cavity is communicated with the air supply cavity, the control cavity is communicated with the air supply cavity, the balance valve is arranged on two sides of a valve core respectively, compressed air in the air supply cavity is utilized to enter the energy storage cavity and the control cavity simultaneously, the pressure of the compressed air in the energy storage cavity is gradually increased along with the continuous entering of the compressed air in the energy storage cavity, the pressure of the compressed air in the control cavity is also synchronously increased along with the continuous entering of the compressed air in the energy storage cavity, so that the thrust of the compressed air in the energy storage cavity on the valve core, which is separated from a cylinder barrel, is met, the firing pressure required by the piston is further realized, the use cost is greatly reduced, the safety coefficient is high, and the market prospect is good.

title_en: Selectively degradable implantable devices
abstract_en: The present invention provides an implantable medical device comprising at least one region that is selectively degradable by electrolytic corrosion. Electrolytic corrosion of the medical device is initiated by forming an electrolysis cell that can be activated wirelessly at a specified point in time. The medical device includes at least one portion or region that is designed to be susceptible to structural failure. The medical device includes a cathode region, a sacrificial anode region that will undergo degradation, and an antenna region. Electrolytic degradation of the sacrificial anode region may result in the de-anchoring of the medical device or the reconfiguration of the medical device from the first configuration to the second configuration. Alternatively, electrolytic degradation may contribute to absorption of the medical device. In another embodiment, electrolytic protection may be employed to preserve the implanted device until it is desired to corrode and subsequently absorb it.

title_en: Gastrointestinal operation nursing wound ostomy abdominal belt
abstract_en: The application discloses a gastrointestinal operation nursing wound ostomy abdominal belt, which comprises a bandage component, a wound fitting piece, an observation window and a connecting piece, wherein the bandage component is arranged on the wound fitting piece; the binding band component comprises an elastic band and a nylon yarn cloth layer, and the elastic band is sewn and connected to one side of the nylon yarn cloth layer; the wound attaching piece comprises an attaching belt, an observation hole and a first sponge cushion strip, wherein the attaching belt is sewn and connected with the elastic belt and the nylon gauze layer; the observation window comprises a main frame and a plurality of circular rings, clamping grooves are formed in the upper part of the main frame and the upper parts of the circular rings, buckles matched with the clamping grooves are arranged on the circular rings, and the main frame is arranged on the laminating belt through the observation holes; the connecting piece comprises a fixing belt and a magic tape, the wool surface of the magic tape is sewn and connected to the side part of the attaching belt, and the hook surface of the magic tape is sewn and connected to the side part of the fixing belt. The scheme can enable users with different waistlines to wear, and can improve the applicability of the stomal and abdominal belt.

title_en: Mineralized fiber reinforced three-dimensional porous scaffold and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of medical materials, and discloses a mineralized fiber reinforced three-dimensional porous scaffold, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the mineralized fiber reinforced three-dimensional porous scaffold comprises the following steps of 1) blending silk fibroin aqueous solution and graphene oxide dispersion; 2) preparing a silk fibroin/graphene oxide composite fiber felt; 3) performing post-treatment on the silk fibroin/graphene oxide composite fiber felt by using an ethanol aqueous solution; 4) shearing the silk fibroin/graphene oxide composite fibrofelt at a high speed to prepare short fibers; 5) soaking short fiber in the treating liquid for some time, taking out and drying; 6) immersing silk fibroin/graphene oxide composite fibers into a mineralized liquid; 7) preparing a sodium alginate/agarose mixed solution; 8) mixing the mineralized short fibers with a sodium alginate/agarose solution; 9) freezing the mixed solution in the step 8) into a solid in a low-temperature refrigerator, and freeze-drying. The three-dimensional porous scaffold prepared by the invention has good biocompatibility and excellent mechanical property.

title_en: Treatment needle of multichannel vagina afterloading treatment device and fixing method of treatment tube
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for fixing a treatment needle and a treatment tube of a multi-channel vagina afterloading treatment device, and relates to the field of medical equipment. The multichannel vagina after-loading treatment device adopted by the scheme comprises a treatment device body and an elastic limiting part, the fixing method adopts a newly designed multichannel vagina after-loading treatment device structure, a treatment needle inserted into the treatment device body is fixed through a limiting ring, and a treatment tube inserted into the treatment device body is fixed through a limiting plug, so that the treatment needle is reduced, the treatment tube is shifted in the treatment process, the treatment effect is reduced, and even the treatment can not be carried out, the accuracy of the position fixing of the insertion needle and the treatment tube is ensured, and the multichannel vagina after-loading treatment device has the advantages of convenience and quickness in fixing.

title_en: Foldable walking device
abstract_en: A collapsible walker is disclosed that may be configured in an operating (open) configuration and a storage (stowed) configuration. The open operative configuration of the walking device provides a structure that assists the user in walking or standing. This stowed storage configuration allows for easy and convenient storage and transport of the running gear. The foldable walker may be converted in one motion from the operative configuration to the storage configuration. The walker includes four support legs extending from adjacent two of the handles to the ground, and a seat configured to support a user.

title_en: Self-adaptive virtual reality intervention system and method based on user background and emotion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-adaptive virtual reality intervention system based on user background and emotion and an implementation method thereof. The intervention system comprises a real-time emotion recognition module, an emotion VR knowledge map model module and an adaptive VR generation module. The VR is generated by combining the GAN and the PCG, and the content can be continuously generated according to the program before the start of the experiment or during the experiment, so that the labor time can be saved, and the content of the VR scene can be more diversified without being limited to a VR material library; the method takes the user background and emotion as input, and provides specific stimulation content generation for individual users through the generation network, so that more accurate psychological stress training is formed, and the interaction influence between the user experience and the scene is promoted.

title_en: Online auxiliary diagnosis and treatment system based on skin images
abstract_en: The invention relates to an online auxiliary diagnosis and treatment system based on skin images, which comprises: the system comprises: the system comprises a data acquisition module, a human body part acquisition module, a user attribute determination module, a labeling module, an analysis module and a result determination module; the data acquisition module is used for acquiring skin damage data; the human body part acquisition module is used for acquiring a human body part corresponding to the skin lesion data; the user attribute determining module is used for determining the user attribute corresponding to the skin damage data; the marking module is used for marking the human body part and the user attribute as marking content on the skin damage data; the analysis module is used for analyzing the marked skin damage data; and the result determining module is used for obtaining an auxiliary inquiry result based on the analysis result. The system of the invention marks the skin damage data, analyzes the marked skin damage data, obtains the auxiliary inquiry result based on the analysis result, and provides an auxiliary implementation scheme for remote medical treatment.

title_en: Transseptal delivery system
abstract_en: The present application relates to transseptal delivery systems. The delivery system includes a delivery catheter having an enclosure configured to carry a prosthesis and a steering catheter for steering the delivery catheter. The delivery catheter may be advanced through the vasculature of a patient to a target treatment area. The capsule may be opened and the prosthesis may be deployed into the target treatment area. Additionally, a method for delivering a prosthesis to a target treatment area includes advancing a delivery catheter to the target treatment area through a vasculature of a patient, maneuvering the delivery catheter toward the target treatment area, opening a capsule on the delivery catheter, and deploying the prosthesis into the target treatment area.

title_en: Medical treatment recyclable plastic crushing and cleaning system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of recycling of waste medical equipment, and particularly relates to a crushing and cleaning system for medical recyclable plastics. The invention carries out production-line crushing, cleaning and granulation on the medical waste recyclable plastic, changes the recycling mode and improves the recycling efficiency.

title_en: Copper and/or silver series sterilization adhesive bandage and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: Copper and/or silver series self-sterilizing anti-inflammation battlefield wound first-aid kit and a manufacturing method thereof comprise: the wound first-aid kit is self-adhered to a base material, a sterilization applying surface layer and/or a moisture absorption material is covered in the middle of the base material, the sterilization applying surface layer of the wound first-aid kit is composed of copper and/or silver series sterilization non-woven fabrics, the sterilization applying surface layer is formed by laminating single layers or multiple layers, and non-stick paper is adhered to an immediately-adhered adhesive surface to form the self-sterilization anti-inflammation battlefield wound first-aid kit.

title_en: Wheelchair with height-adjustable armrests
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wheelchair with adjustable armrest height, which comprises a seat plate, wherein power boxes are respectively arranged on two opposite sides of the seat plate, armrests are respectively arranged above the two power boxes, the lower surfaces of the armrests are fixedly connected with upright rods, the bottom ends of the upright rods extend into the power boxes, the upright rods are perpendicular to the armrests and are arranged along the vertical direction, the upright rods are connected with an armrest driving mechanism, the armrest driving mechanism is arranged in the power boxes, the armrest driving mechanism drives the upright rods to lift in the vertical direction, rollers are respectively arranged at the bottoms of the two power boxes, one end of the seat plate is connected with a backup plate through a spline transmission rod, the other end of the seat plate is connected with the upper end of a leg supporting plate, and the lower. The chair adopts a plate type structure, the angle between the back plate and the seat plate can be adjusted, and the height of the chair armrest can be adjusted according to requirements.

title_en: Self-power-generation type ankle joint varus-valgus stability augmentation system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a self-power-generation type ankle joint varus-valgus stability augmentation system and a self-power-generation type ankle joint valgus-valgus stability augmentation method, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the device comprises a foot connecting piece, a leg connecting piece, a motion transmission component and a self-generating component; the motion transfer member is connected with the foot connecting piece; the foot connecting piece is connected with the leg connecting piece through the motion transfer component; the leg connecting piece is connected with the self-generating component; the self-power-generation type ankle joint internal and external turning stability increasing system achieves internal and external turning stability increasing. The design of the invention is a brand-new ankle joint internal and external turning stabilization system design, and can assist the stability of the coronal plane of the ankle joint in the walking process. The ankle joint internal and external turning stability increasing device is realized by utilizing the condition that the motor works in a generator, and the limitation of the rotation of the motor shaft caused by the counter electromotive force is transmitted to the ankle joint without external energy input.

title_en: Ultrasonic probe capable of changing curvature for detecting periarticular tendon and bone
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ultrasonic imaging detection, in particular to an ultrasonic probe for detecting periarticular tendinous bones capable of changing curvature, which comprises a first shell, wherein at least two elastic elements are arranged in the first shell, and each elastic element is connected with an ultrasonic detection head; one end of the elastic element is connected with the first shell, and the other end of the elastic element is connected with the ultrasonic detection head; the first shell is provided with a contact layer, and the contact layer is made of elastic materials. This application is through installation elastic element in first casing, installation supersound detects the head on elastic element, one side of contact is equipped with and has elastic contact layer around casing and animal or human joint, ultrasonic probe can compress elastic element because of the body surface unevenness when the contact layer contacts tendon bone and tendon soft tissue around the unevenness joint around the joint, install elastic element in the first casing, the effective contact of surface position around its elastic element contact layer and animal or human joint, make contact between the two reach the biggest effective area.

title_en: Nail bin assembly and surgical operation instrument
abstract_en: The application relates to a nail storehouse subassembly and surgical operation apparatus, detachably installs on surgical operation apparatus, includes: a housing; the firing sheet is arranged in the shell and can move along the axial direction of the shell so as to drive the working head to open or close; the push rod is arranged in the shell and provided with an initial position and a working position, and the position of the push rod can be switched between the initial position and the working position; a locking mechanism connected with the push rod and used for locking or releasing the striking plate; when the push rod is at the initial position, the locking mechanism locks the firing plate to prevent the firing plate from axially moving, and when the push rod moves from the initial position to the working position, the locking mechanism is separated from the firing plate to release the firing plate. This application makes the piece of firing and accurate and the snap-fit of percussion axle, convenient and fast through being provided with locking mechanical system.

title_en: Crosslinked chitosan hemostatic powder and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides cross-linked chitosan hemostatic powder and a preparation method thereof, wherein the liquid absorption amount of the cross-linked chitosan hemostatic powder is more than 30 times of the weight of the chitosan hemostatic powder, and the cross-linked chitosan hemostatic powder is prepared by the following method: adding a chitosan raw material into an organic solvent, stirring and swelling, then dropwise adding an acid solution under a stirring state, reacting for 0.5-2 h, adding a cross-linking agent into the reaction solution for cross-linking reaction, and filtering, washing and drying after the reaction is finished to obtain the chitosan/chitosan composite material. The cross-linked chitosan hemostatic powder provided by the invention has good hemostatic effect on wounds with large bleeding amount, such as severe skin surface local bleeding or arterial bleeding under emergency conditions; the preparation method provided does not need to dissolve the chitosan to prepare a solution and then carry out crosslinking reaction, well keeps the original powdery substance form of the chitosan in the preparation process, and has simple preparation process and low cost.

title_en: Thrombus-taking support
abstract_en: The invention relates to a thrombus removal support which comprises a hollow tubular support main body, wherein an outer convex structure is arranged on the support main body, the thrombus removal support has a radially contracted compression state and a radially expanded expansion state, and the outer convex structure protrudes and extends from the support main body towards the outer side of the support main body when the thrombus removal support is in the expansion state. The utility model provides a get and tie support through setting up evagination structure, can follow and get and tie the support outside interception thrombus to, even meet the complicated thrombus in the inner chamber that can't enter into the support main part, also can utilize evagination structure interception thrombus, thereby when withdrawing and getting tie the support, the condition that the reduction thrombus drops takes place, can effectively avoid the thrombus to escape to the branching blood vessel when meetting the branching blood vessel in.

title_en: Saw knife convenient for replacing knife head for orthopedic operation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an orthopedic surgery saw knife convenient for changing a knife head, which comprises a holding rod, a rotating mechanism, a moving mechanism, a knife head, a stud, a positioning hole, a abdicating hole, an extruding mechanism, a bolt and a mounting hole.

title_en: Antipyretic patch and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an antipyretic patch and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of medical antipyretic patches so as to improve antipyretic effect. The defervescing patch comprises a flexible lining layer, an aerogel layer, a hydrogel layer and an anti-adhesion layer which are laminated together. The hydrogel layer is positioned between the flexible lining layer and the hydrogel layer, and the hydrogel layer is positioned between the hydrogel layer and the anti-adhesion layer; wherein the aerogel layer contains aerogel with air permeability, hydrophobicity and heat insulation; the hydrogel layer contains hydrogel with reversible water absorption. The preparation method of the antipyretic patch comprises the following steps: providing a flexible liner; an aerogel layer is formed on the flexible liner, a hydrogel layer is formed on the aerogel layer, and an anti-sticking layer is formed on the hydrogel layer. The antipyretic patch provided by the invention is used for preparing the antipyretic patch.

title_en: Sterilizer for department of infectious diseases
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sterilizer for an infectious department, wherein a workpiece taking opening is formed in the front side of a box body, a sealing door is rotatably connected to the front side, close to the workpiece taking opening, of the box body through a pin shaft, a first roller and a second roller are symmetrically arranged on the front side and the rear side of the box body, the inner wall of the first roller is fixedly connected with a first shaft, the first shaft penetrates through the box body and is in limited rotary connection with the box body, and a first conical gear is fixedly connected to the surface, located in the box body, of the first shaft. The invention solves the problems that in the actual use process, because the traditional sterilizer is complex in operation, more labor and time are consumed, meanwhile, the circulating fan cannot ensure that each page of medical record and laboratory test report is blown off, a plurality of pages of medical records and laboratory test reports are adhered together and are not blown off by the circulating fan, so that the sterilization dead angle exists, each page of medical record and laboratory test report cannot be ensured to be sterilized and disinfected, and the inconvenience is brought to the use.

title_en: Ceramic femoral stem prosthesis manufacturing method and forming tool
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of medical instruments and discloses a method for manufacturing a ceramic femoral stem prosthesis and a forming tool, wherein the method for manufacturing the ceramic femoral stem prosthesis comprises the following procedures of soft rubber sleeve mold powder filling → cavity mold pressing → cold isostatic pressing → key part processing → high-temperature sintering → finished product post-treatment; the ceramic femoral stem prosthesis forming tool comprises an upper die, a soft rubber sleeve die, a lower die and a positioning column; the invention provides a method for manufacturing a ceramic femoral stem prosthesis and a forming tool, which thoroughly solve the manufacturing problem of a ceramic product with a special-shaped high-performance structure, and simultaneously design the key forming tool, so that the ceramic femoral stem prosthesis can be manufactured with high efficiency, high yield and low cost.

title_en: Sludge incineration system with waste heat recovery function
abstract_en: The invention relates to a sludge incineration system with a waste heat recovery function, which comprises a driving motor and a workshop crane, wherein a disc dryer is arranged at the top end of the driving motor, and a steam branch cylinder with steam connected with 0.5MPQ is arranged at the top end of the disc dryer. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the following beneficial effects: the sludge between the condensers is connected to the rotary kiln after being dried, the condenser is positioned in a tail end process, sludge drying treatment is carried out by utilizing a sludge discharging scraper conveyor and a switching screw conveyor, dried sludge is connected to the rotary kiln and dried sludge is connected to the rotary kiln for collection and incineration, a regulator is added into the sludge, the sludge can be heated by the outer wall of the tank body, a shutoff valve is arranged on the steam pipeline, so that maintenance and operation are facilitated, the operation is switched and isolated, the sludge can be sterilized, separated and dried at high temperature by utilizing the high temperature of the steam connected from a 0.5MPQ steam cylinder and the rotation of a rotor in the disc dryer, and the sludge can be sterilized, separated and dried.

title_en: Method and device for managing medicine storage equipment, storage medium and electronic device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a management method and a device of a medicine storage device, a storage medium and an electronic device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring drug information of a target drug in a drug storage device, wherein the drug information comprises: drug name, drug use time; inquiring the storage environment of the target medicine in a networking manner according to the medicine name in the medicine information, and adjusting the environmental parameters of the medicine storage equipment to be in accordance with the storage environment; and reminding a target object to use the target medicine through the medicine storage device under the condition that the current time reaches the medicine use time in the medicine information. By adopting the technical scheme, the problems that a traditional intelligent medicine box cannot intelligently remind a user to take medicines and cannot intelligently store the medicines according to the medicine attributes and the like are solved.

title_en: Patient lifter
abstract_en: The present application relates to a device and a method for transferring a patient in a bed between a prone position along the bed and a sitting position facing the side of the bed. The device includes an arm holder to allow the patient to attach the arm holder to his or her chest, thereby enabling the device to transfer the patient between a prone position and a sitting position. Preferably, the apparatus further comprises a leg support to assist in transferring the lower part of the patient's body between the prone and sitting positions.

title_en: Device and method for operating a personal grooming appliance or a household cleaning appliance
abstract_en: A system and method for operating a personal grooming/household appliance comprising: providing a personal grooming/household appliance comprising at least one physical sensor selected from the group consisting of: orientation sensors, acceleration sensors, inertial sensors, global positioning sensors, pressure and load sensors, audio sensors, humidity sensors and temperature sensors; providing a camera associated with the personal grooming/household appliance; classifying data received from the physical sensor and from the camera using at least one trained machine learning classifier to generate an enhanced classification; and providing user feedback information based on the enhanced classification, or modifying the operation of the grooming/household appliance based on the enhanced classification.

title_en: Intelligent disinfection robot
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of intelligent disinfection and discloses an intelligent disinfection robot. This intelligent disinfection robot includes: the sterilizing component is arranged above the movable base; the control panel is arranged on one side of the sterilizing component; the killing subassembly includes: the first disinfection and excitation light source is arranged at the bottom of the movable base; the at least one ultrasonic atomizer is arranged at the top of the shell of the killing assembly; the at least one negative ion generator is arranged between the at least one ultrasonic atomizer and the control panel at intervals and is arranged at the top of the shell of the sterilizing component; the output end of the ozone generator is arranged at the output end of the ultrasonic atomizer; the at least one second disinfection and excitation light source and the at least one ultrasonic atomizer are arranged above the output end of the ultrasonic atomizer in a one-to-one correspondence manner; the third disinfection and excitation light source is arranged on the back of the control panel, and light generated by the third disinfection and excitation light source faces the at least one ultrasonic atomizer. Through the mode, the comprehensive effect of disinfection and sterilization of the intelligent disinfection robot is improved.

title_en: Exerciser is raised to multi-functional low limbs
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional lower limb raising exerciser, which comprises a U-shaped frame and a leg supporting plate, wherein the U-shaped frame is provided with a support plate; a U-shaped frame: the end part and the inflection point are both fixed with a vertically distributed support frame, the top of the support frame positioned at the inflection point is hinged with a sleeve, the inner side of the sleeve is movably connected with a U-shaped movable rod, the U-shaped movable rod is rotatably connected with a foot fixer, the middle part of a transverse support of the U-shaped frame is hinged with an air cylinder, the telescopic end of the air cylinder is assembled with a connecting seat, the connecting seat is hinged with an inclined strut, and the end part of the inclined strut is welded with the sleeve; leg support plates: for the rubber slab and fix between two sets of sleeves, be equipped with infrared massager on the shank layer board of locating, external power source's output is connected through the control switch electricity to infrared massager's input, and this exerciser is lifted to multi-functional low limbs, and the function is various, and it is convenient to adjust, is convenient for adapt to the patient of different sizes, can effectively promote blood circulation to reach the mesh of subsiding swelling fast.

title_en: Application of prognosis related gene and risk model in prediction of pancreatic cancer prognosis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a prognosis related gene and application of a risk model in predicting pancreatic cancer prognosis, and also discloses a judgment method for pancreatic cancer prognosis and a kit containing a detection reagent of the prognosis related gene. The kit can be used for predicting the prognosis of a pancreatic cancer patient and providing theoretical support for the formulation of a treatment scheme by a clinician.

title_en: Endoscope air-water supply system and endoscope
abstract_en: The invention provides a gas-water supply system of an endoscope and the endoscope. The pressure sensor is matched with the one-way valve, so that the condition that the operation is smoothly carried out due to the fact that the liquid pressure is greater than the human body safety threshold value due to overlarge gas pressure is avoided, and the safety of the endoscopic operation is effectively guaranteed. The pressure sensor, the controller and the air pump act together to timely regulate and control the air pressure to be greater than the internal pressure of the human body and to be smaller than the human body safety pressure threshold value, so that the liquid in the liquid supply pipeline can smoothly enter the human body, and the human body cannot be injured. The check valve is matched with the pressure sensor, the gas pressure in the gas supply pipeline is too high, and when the pressure sensor loses the control function, the internal structure of the check valve acts to cut off the gas supply pipeline, so that the liquid with too high pressure is prevented from entering the inside of a human body, and the safety of the endoscopic surgery is effectively ensured.

title_en: Oxygen concentration control method and device of breathing machine and breathing machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to an oxygen concentration control method and device of a breathing machine and the breathing machine, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a first corresponding relation between the sampling voltage and the oxygen concentration under a first airway pressure and a second corresponding relation between the sampling voltage and the oxygen concentration under a second airway pressure; acquiring a corresponding relation between the airway pressure and a deviation value of the sampling voltage according to the first corresponding relation and the second corresponding relation; obtaining a deviation value corresponding to the current sampling voltage according to the current airway pressure and the corresponding relation between the airway pressure and the deviation value of the sampling voltage; obtaining the current oxygen concentration of the breathing machine according to the current sampling voltage, the deviation value corresponding to the current sampling voltage and the first corresponding relation; and controlling the breathing machine to adjust the ratio of the oxygen flow and the air flow in the total gas flow according to the current oxygen concentration and a preset target oxygen concentration. Compared with the prior art, the method and the device improve the accuracy of oxygen concentration acquisition and realize accurate adjustment of oxygen flow and air flow of the breathing machine.

title_en: Be applied to tissue retractor of backbone operation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tissue retractor applied to spinal surgery, which comprises a right mounting leg and a left mounting leg, wherein mounting grooves are formed in the right mounting leg and the left mounting leg, mounting frames are vertically and slidably connected in the mounting grooves, the outer wall of each mounting frame is slidably connected with a retracting mechanism, mounting mechanisms for fixing the right mounting leg and the left mounting leg on mounting rails on two sides of a sickbed are arranged at the bottoms of the right mounting leg and the left mounting leg, each retracting mechanism comprises two mounting sleeves, the two mounting sleeves are slidably connected to the outer wall of the top of each mounting frame, each retracting mechanism also comprises a connecting plate, the bottom of each connecting plate is hinged with two connecting rods, and the end parts, far away from the connecting plate, of the two connecting rods are respectively hinged with the tops of the two mounting sleeves. Through the matching of the structures, the invention can adjust and lock the retracting mechanism at any height in a reasonable range, and can simultaneously carry out stepless expansion adjustment and multiple subsequent expansion adjustment on the retracting mechanism.

title_en: Ultrasonic device for gynecology
abstract_en: The invention provides an ultrasonic device for gynecology, which comprises an examination platform, wherein the rear part of the examination platform is provided with a rear seat, the top of the rear seat is provided with a rotatable display screen through a swivel mount, the left side of the examination platform is provided with an electric cylinder, an actuating rod of the electric cylinder is provided with a pull seat, the rear end of the pull seat is provided with a first steel wire, the other end of the first steel wire extends towards the rear part of the examination platform and is connected with the display screen, the examination platform is provided with a button for controlling the electric cylinder to drive the display screen to rotate through the first steel wire, the button is connected with the swivel mount at the bottom of the display screen through a link rod in a linkage manner, therefore, when the swivel mount drives the display screen to rotate to a visual angle convenient for a puerpera to watch, the head of a patient can be turned to the display screen through the turning action of a turning pad, and the puerpera is not required to be reminded aloud, the head of the lying-in woman can be enabled to turn to the display screen, so that the lying-in woman can be suitable for special people, and the humanized structural design is more reasonable.

title_en: Multi-position massager
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-position massager, which relates to the technical field of massage fitness and comprises a shell, a massage head assembly, a motor driving assembly and a battery, wherein the shell consists of an upper cover and a lower cover, the upper cover is buckled on the lower cover, the battery is arranged in the lower cover, the battery is electrically connected with the motor driving assembly, the motor driving assembly is arranged on the lower cover, the massage head assembly is detachably arranged on the motor driving assembly and is positioned above the shell, the massage head assembly comprises a foot massage head, a back massage head and an abdomen massage head, and the abdomen massage head is detachably arranged on the motor driving assembly. By adopting the technical scheme, the massage chair has the advantages of small volume and small occupied space, and can massage a plurality of parts of the human body, such as feet, the back, the abdomen and the like, and relieve the fatigue of the human body.

title_en: Annotation supporting device, annotation supporting method, and recording medium
abstract_en: The annotation support apparatus manages medical images based on attributes of the respective medical images, and the medical images are managed by a hierarchy structure including one medical image as one node, and at least one of a medical image hierarchy to which the node of the medical image belongs, and upper and lower hierarchies, that is, an upper hierarchy and a lower hierarchy, of the medical image hierarchy. The annotation support device is provided with: an image acquisition unit that acquires a medical image; a display unit for displaying the medical image; an annotation input receiving unit that receives designation of any one of a node of the medical image and a node associated with the node of the medical image in the hierarchical structure, and receives input of annotation information, which is information related to the designated node; and an annotation storage unit for storing annotation information in association with the designated node.

title_en: Bracket loading system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a stent loading system and a stent loading method, which are used for loading a stent into a sheath, wherein the stent comprises a stent main body, and a grabbing lug is arranged at the periphery of one end of the stent main body; the rack loading system includes: the grabbing lug straightener is used for straightening grabbing lugs on the support; the bracket with the straightened gripping lugs is subjected to diameter reduction and pressing holding by the compressor, and the held bracket is conveyed into a pre-pressing pipe; the support is connected with a conveying system penetrating through the sheath pipe, and the support in the pre-pressing pipe is conveyed into the sheath pipe under the traction action of the conveying system.

title_en: Three-dimensional vascularized tissue engineering bone and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional vascularized tissue engineering bone, which is characterized in that: the scaffold comprises a scaffold, mesenchymal stem cells and vascular endothelial cells, wherein the mesenchymal stem cells and the vascular endothelial cells are dispersed in the scaffold. Compared with the background art, the invention has the beneficial effects that: the three-dimensional vascularized tissue engineering bone manufactured by the invention can realize that the directional migration of vascular endothelial cells and mesenchymal stem cells is regulated and controlled by the gradient hydrogel, a three-dimensional vascular perfusion network similar to autologous jaw bone tissue is formed, the blood supply condition of the tissue engineering bone is improved, the tissue engineering bone is suitable for the transplantation reconstruction of jaw bone defects with poor blood supply condition, the survival of the tissue engineering bone is ensured, the success rate of jaw bone defect reconstruction and repair is favorably improved, the problem of secondary damage of a supply area caused by the current clinical fibula flap is avoided, the damage and the operation area of a patient are reduced, and the minimally invasive and efficient jaw bone reconstruction is favorably realized.

title_en: Postpartum medicine fumigation treatment nursing device for obstetrics and gynecology department and using method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gynecological postpartum medicine fumigation treatment nursing device and a using method thereof, and relates to the technical field of gynecological postpartum medicine fumigation treatment; in order to solve the problem of the fumigation uniformity of the traditional Chinese medicine ion steam; specifically including the bottom plate, one side outer wall of bottom plate is provided with the support, and the top outer wall of support is provided with the motor, and the output of motor has the bull stick through the shaft coupling, and the circumference outer wall of bull stick has cup jointed the master gear, the top outer wall of support is connected with the pinion through rotation axis rotation, master gear and pinion intermeshing, the top outer wall of rotation axis is provided with telescopic sleeve, telescopic top outer wall is connected with the screw rod through dismantling the bearing, bottom plate one side outer wall is provided with the connecting plate, the top outer wall of connecting plate is provided with the guide arm. The invention effectively drives the fumigation cylinder to rotate, so that the traditional Chinese medicine ion steam in the fumigation cylinder is spread in a circumferential rotating manner, and the traditional Chinese medicine ion steam is guaranteed to be uniformly spread on the skin surface of the pregnant woman.

title_en: Emotion recognition method based on electroencephalogram source imaging and regularization common space mode
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of signal feature extraction, in particular to an emotion recognition method based on an electroencephalogram source imaging and regularization common space mode, which comprises the steps of collecting an electroencephalogram signal and preprocessing the electroencephalogram signal; reconstructing cerebral cortex nerve electrical activity by building electroencephalogram source imaging; projecting the reconstructed EEG time series onto a Brodman partition by a minimum modulus algorithm, wherein the Brodman partition comprises 26 spatial interest areas, and a brain function connection matrix is constructed by utilizing the mutual information of the 26 spatial interest areas; constructing a covariance matrix of a generalized sample based on the brain function connection matrix in a regularization mode, and extracting a characteristic vector; inputting the characteristics of the historical data into a classifier for training, and inputting the characteristic vector of the data to be classified into the classifier to obtain electroencephalogram emotion classification; the method reduces estimation deviation, improves estimation stability, and improves the accuracy of the finally classified result.

title_en: Accessory positioner for endoscopy
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of medical instruments, and particularly relates to an accessory positioner for endoscopy, which comprises a first half fixing part and a second half fixing part; one side of the first half fixing part is rotatably connected with one side of the second half fixing part; a first locking piece is embedded on the end face, far away from the connecting edge, of the first half fixing part; a second locking piece is embedded on the end face, far away from the connecting edge, of the second half fixing part; when the first half fixing part and the second half fixing part are closed, the first locking piece and the second locking piece lock the first half fixing part and the second half fixing part. The accessory is connected with the positioner which can be opened and closed, the positioner is fixed at the length position of the accessory which needs to be pushed, when a doctor pushes the accessory, the doctor can pre-judge the pushing distance of the accessory in advance by touching the positioner with hands, and the internal wall of the viscera of a checked person is effectively prevented from being damaged by excessive pushing of the accessory.

title_en: Electrotomy biopsy needle, electrotomy biopsy needle kit and vacuum assisted breast biopsy system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electrotomy biopsy needle, an electrotomy biopsy needle set and a vacuum-assisted breast biopsy system, wherein the electrotomy biopsy needle comprises: the puncture assembly comprises a puncture tube, the puncture tube is provided with a front end and a rear end, and the tube wall of the puncture tube is provided with a sampling groove; a cutting assembly including a cutting member; the cutting piece can reciprocate back and forth along the axial direction of the puncture tube; the cutting assembly is provided with a first electrode, and the puncture assembly is provided with a second electrode; the high-frequency power supply also comprises a first interface and a second interface which are electrically connected with the first electrode and the second electrode respectively, wherein any one interface of the first interface and the second interface is used for being directly or indirectly connected with the high-frequency output end of the host, and the other interface is used for being directly or indirectly connected with the high-frequency input end of the host. The electrotomy biopsy needle with the structure cuts the tissue by utilizing the radio wave between the cutting edge and the puncture tube, and has the advantages of high safety, convenient operation, simple structure and low cost.

title_en: Traditional Chinese medicine drainage strip for chronic mastitis sinus, traditional Chinese medicine powder used by traditional Chinese medicine drainage strip and preparation method of traditional Chinese medicine drainage strip
abstract_en: The invention discloses a traditional Chinese medicine drainage strip for chronic mastitis sinus, which comprises a drainage shell and traditional Chinese medicine powder filled in the drainage shell; the drainage shell comprises an inner shell and an outer shell, the outer shell can rotate relative to the inner shell, the inner shell is of a gear columnar cavity structure, a plurality of protruding portions are evenly arranged on the inner shell, a groove portion is formed between every two adjacent protruding portions, and traditional Chinese medicine powder is arranged at the position of the groove portion of the inner shell. The invention also discloses a traditional Chinese medicine powder for the traditional Chinese medicine drainage strip for chronic mastitis sinus and a preparation method thereof, wherein the traditional Chinese medicine powder is prepared from the following main raw materials in parts by weight: 5 to 30 parts of bupleurum, 5 to 30 parts of frankincense, 5 to 30 parts of myrrh, 5 to 30 parts of astragalus, 5 to 15 parts of chamaejasme, 5 to 15 parts of typhonium giganteum, 5 to 15 parts of houttuynia cordata, 5 to 15 parts of star anise, 5 to 15 parts of cottonrose hibiscus, 5 to 15 parts of ginseng, 5 to 15 parts of hypericum perforatum, 5 to 15 parts of fructus akebiae, 5 to 15 parts of white mustard seed and 10 to 30 parts of edible tulip.

title_en: ECG monitor device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ECG monitor device, which comprises a display panel, an indicator light, a test key, an instrument panel and an electrode, wherein the display panel is provided with the indicator light and the test key, the instrument panel is provided with the electrode, the instrument panel consists of a screw lock, an instrument panel body, a lead wire main winding structure, a lead wire threading structure and a lead wire wiring structure, the screw lock is arranged at the upper left end of the instrument panel body, the lead wire threading structure is positioned between the lead wire main winding structure and the lead wire wiring structure, the lead wire main winding structure and the lead wire threading structure are provided with a lead wire fixing frame, the lead wire main winding structure comprises a lead head mounting frame, a main winding frame, a winding circle, a main inner frame and a main winding core plate, the lead head mounting frame is matched with the main winding frame, the lead wire is a fixed mounting structure, the test wire head is electrically connected through movement, a hand is not contacted with a power supply during connection, and the test wire is fixed in a surrounding way, the clamping winding can be flexibly extracted, and the firmness of the lead head when being framed and attached to the body part is good.

title_en: Intramedullary nail expandable toe joint prosthesis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of medical prostheses, and provides a toe joint prosthesis with an expansible intramedullary nail. The method comprises the following steps: the metatarsal joint head and the phalange cushion block are connected with the metatarsal joint head in a sliding mode; wherein, a phalange base is arranged on the phalange cushion block, and a phalange medullary needle is arranged on the phalange base; a metatarsal bone base station is arranged on the metatarsal bone joint head, and a metatarsal bone broach is arranged on the metatarsal bone base station; the phalange medullary needle and the metatarsus medullary needle can be expanded to adjust the expansion angle. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the two intramedullary nails are designed by adopting a non-rotating body, and the inner screw is heated to expand so that the two intramedullary nails expand and attach to the inner surface of the medullary cavity, thereby achieving various effects of settlement resistance, separation resistance, rotation resistance and the like.

title_en: Brush head and electric toothbrush
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a brush head and an electric toothbrush, wherein the brush head comprises a brush handle and a brush hair component arranged at the far end of the brush handle, the brush hair component comprises brush hair and a fixing piece used for fixing the brush hair, the outer side wall of the fixing piece is provided with a buckling part, the brush handle comprises a body and an elastic structure arranged at the far end of the body, an accommodating groove used for accommodating the brush hair component is arranged on the elastic structure, the inner wall of the accommodating groove is provided with a buckling matching part matched with the buckling part, and when the brush hair component is arranged in the accommodating groove, the buckling part is in buckling connection with the buckling matching part, so that the brush hair component is connected with the brush handle. For traditional brush head in the brush hair direct plant on the brush holder, brush hair and brush holder rigid connection, the user is organized in the easy scotch oral cavity of brush hair when brushing teeth, causes the user to brush teeth and experiences not good scheme, and the user is difficult to scotch oral cavity tissue when brushing teeth in this scheme for the user experiences the preferred of brushing teeth.

title_en: Clamping apparatus
abstract_en: The application provides a clamping apparatus, mainly includes the base, the circumference distributes two at least clamping structure on the base to and correspond and set up in two at least butt structures of one side of the adjacent base of each clamping structure, wherein, when each clamping structure is in the locking condition, each butt structure of pressing from both sides between base and each clamping structure can apply the thrust to each clamping structure respectively, in order to adjust each clamping clearance that each clamping structure corresponds. Therefore, the clamping device can provide stable and continuous clamping force.

title_en: Psychological and kinetic ability evaluation method based on multi-target tracking paradigm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-target tracking paradigm psychomotor ability evaluation method, which comprises the following steps: analyzing research data of psychomotor ability, determining a plurality of measuring dimensions of the psychomotor ability, and designing an experimental task paradigm based on the measuring dimensions, wherein the experimental task paradigm is used for representing the level of each measuring dimension; designing an evaluation scheme of each measurement dimension based on an experimental task paradigm; and based on the evaluation scheme, evaluating each ability dimension of the personnel to be detected, collecting evaluation data, processing the evaluation data, and calculating the weight value of each ability dimension to obtain the evaluation result of the psychomotor ability. The invention can process the attention and perception cognition of complex visual information and motor reaction in a dynamic scene, comprehensively evaluate the psychomotor ability of the pilot, has important significance for the special training evaluation of the pilot, breaks through the traditional mechanical evaluation mode, and provides the computer evaluation training integration which is implemented to the individual pilot.

title_en: Medical data variable measurement monitoring method and system based on big data
abstract_en: The invention relates to a medical data variable measurement monitoring method and system based on big data, and belongs to the technical field of intelligent medical monitoring. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring an image of the infusion device in real time, and dividing to obtain an image of a transfusion bottle area and an image of a dropper area; recording the time of connecting liquid drops in a dropper into a continuous track line in the image of the dropper area after the frame difference image of the dropper area is superposed as an accumulation period, and counting the number of image frames corresponding to the accumulation period; subtracting the image of the infusion bottle area from the background image of the infusion bottle area to obtain a background frame difference image, superposing the background frame difference image, and obtaining the liquid descending height in the infusion bottle according to the image of the infusion bottle area obtained by superposition; calculating the height of the residual liquid in the transfusion bottle according to the descending height of the liquid in the transfusion bottle; and calculating the remaining infusion time under the current image frame number according to the height of the remaining liquid in the infusion bottle and the constructed liquid level difference model. The invention realizes the accurate prediction of the remaining time of the liquid in the transfusion bottle.

title_en: Beating massage device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a beating massage device which comprises a frame, a swinging seat and a beating motor, wherein at least two swinging seats are arranged, each swinging seat is hinged on the frame, massage heads are respectively arranged on two sides of each swinging seat at the hinged position, the beating motor is fixedly arranged on the frame, the beating motor drives the swinging seats to swing, so that the massage heads on two sides of the swinging seats realize alternate beating massage, at least one swinging seat is connected with the beating motor through a clutch piece, and the clutch piece can control the swinging seats connected with the clutch piece and other swinging seats to swing synchronously or asynchronously. By adopting the scheme, the invention overcomes the defects in the prior art and provides the beating massage device which can realize synchronous or asynchronous swinging of each swinging seat and has a plurality of beating massage modes.

title_en: Improved oxygen inhalation device with one-to-two structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses an improved oxygen inhalation device with a one-to-two structure, which comprises: the plug is arranged at one end of the guide pipe, the adapter is arranged at the other end of the guide pipe, an air guide hole is formed in the adapter, and a connecting groove is formed in the side surface of the adapter; the sealing rings are arranged on two sides of the inner wall of the connecting groove; and one end of the branch pipe is in threaded connection with the connecting groove. This improvement formula oxygen inhalation mask with one drags two structures, carry out spacing receipts with the inboard "C" style of calligraphy notch of reserving of oxygen hose and cassette, and carry out the interference butt joint with the outside of mark shell and humidifying bottle, register different patients' oxygen inhalation mask information through the tag and distinguish, connect two branch pipes and the spread groove of switching seat bilateral symmetry, make sealed knob receive the extrusion and break away from the sealing washer, thereby with the branch pipe, the butt joint hole, intercommunicating pore and gas guide hole communicate, make things convenient for this oxygen inhalation mask to provide the oxygen uptake for the patient of adding the bed in the ward.

title_en: Sterilization module
abstract_en: The application discloses a sterilization module, which comprises a main structural part with an opening; a substrate arranged at the opening; the lamp beads are arranged on the substrate and positioned in the main structural member, and comprise ultraviolet lamp beads and illuminating lamp beads; set up in the main structure spare and with the relative transparent sheet who sets up of lamp pearl, the region that transparent sheet corresponds ultraviolet lamp pearl is provided with first through-hole, and the ultraviolet ray can't penetrate transparent sheet. The sterilization module comprises ultraviolet lamp beads and illuminating lamp beads, first through holes are formed in the regions, corresponding to the ultraviolet lamp beads, of the transparent plate, ultraviolet rays emitted by the ultraviolet lamp beads irradiate the outside of the sterilization module through the first through holes, sterilization is achieved, the illuminating lamp beads emit light rays for illumination, and sterilization and illumination are achieved at the same time; because the ultraviolet ray can not pierce through transparent panel, so transparent panel can shelter from the ultraviolet ray of reflection, avoids the ultraviolet ray to the harmful effects that lighting lamp pearl produced, prolongs lighting lamp pearl's life, promotes the quality of the module that disinfects.

title_en: Biodegradable polyester material with low melting point and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a low-melting-point biodegradable polyester material and preparation and application thereof, wherein the polyester material is polycaprolactone polyglycolide copolymer and is prepared from the following raw materials: caprolactone, glycolide, a blocking agent and an organic tin catalyst; the end capping agent consists of caprolactone, a chain extender and an organic zinc catalyst raw material in a weight ratio of 100:15-20: 0.04-0.1. The preparation method comprises the steps of heating raw materials of the end capping agent, dehydrating in vacuum, reacting, and then performing vacuum devolatilization to obtain the end capping agent; then evenly mixing the end capping reagent, caprolactone, glycolide and an organic tin catalyst, and then heating for reaction to obtain the copolymer. The polyester material can be uniformly mixed with an antibacterial and anti-inflammatory medicament to prepare a dressing gel sheet, and the dressing gel sheet is used for externally applying the dressing gel sheet to the wound. The polyester material prepared by the invention has low melting point, quick biodegradation period, simple preparation process and controllable reaction process, and can also be used as a medical external application material.

title_en: Thoracic surgery puncture auxiliary device based on fixing and protecting integrated structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of auxiliary puncture of thoracic surgery, in particular to a thoracic surgery puncture auxiliary device based on a fixing and protecting integrated structure. The device comprises a laminating contact device, wherein the left side and the right side of the laminating contact device are symmetrically provided with a supporting and adjusting device, and the upper side of the laminating contact device, which is close to the middle part, is provided with a sliding fixing device; laminating contact means includes the laminating fixed block of two relative settings, supports adjusting device and includes strutting arrangement, and the one end of strutting arrangement upside is equipped with slider, and slider's one side, strutting arrangement's upside are equipped with position control device, and strutting arrangement's bottom is equipped with clamping device, and slip fixing device includes the fixed slide in upper end, and the position that the bottom of the fixed slide in upper end is close to the center is equipped with fixed hinge post. The invention mainly solves the problems that after a doctor stably punctures the device for a long time, the hand shakes, the puncture precision is difficult to ensure, and the needle head of the puncture device is easy to hurt other positions of a patient.

title_en: Automatic shooting psychological sand table instrument for psychology teaching
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic shooting psychological sand table instrument for psychological teaching, which comprises a base, a rack, a supporting rod, a sand table, a drying box, a sand storage box, a water circulation box, a filter and a control panel, wherein the sand table is arranged on the rack; install frame and bracing piece on the base, sand table and control panel are installed to the top of frame, and the control panel is located the side of sand table, and the sand table is rectangular form, and the below of sand table is the stoving case, and sand table and stoving case pass through the pipe and connect, and a side of stoving case is connected with the exhaust fan, and another side of stoving case is connected with the hydrologic cycle case, and the hydrologic cycle case is provided with water pipe and water pump, installs the water pump on the water pipe, and the one end of water pipe is located the bottom of hydrologic cycle case. The sand table instrument has the advantages that after the teaching of the sand table instrument is finished, sand can be automatically cleaned and dried, the sand can be recycled, the cleaned waste water can be purified, filtered and recycled, the waste water can be collected, treated and recycled, and the whole process is environment-friendly and pollution-free.

title_en: Multifunctional travelling suitcase
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of drawing boxes, in particular to a multifunctional drawing box for traveling, which comprises a traveling case body, a pull rod, a sterilizing mechanism, a damping mechanism, a driving mechanism and a receiving mechanism, wherein the receiving mechanism comprises a receiving bag and a vacuumizing device, the vacuumizing device is arranged at one end of the traveling case body, the receiving bag is arranged at the other end of the vacuumizing device, one end of the vacuumizing device is provided with a buckle, one end of the traveling case body is provided with a clamping groove matched with the buckle for use, the receiving bag is provided with an air suction opening matched with the vacuumizing device for use, the inner side of the traveling case body is provided with a plurality of fixing grooves matched with the receiving bag for use, the receiving bag is provided with fixing columns matched with the fixing grooves for use, the receiving bag is detachably connected with the traveling case body, the traveling case can be sterilized through the sterilizing mechanism, when the traveling case is driven to travel, the damping mechanism is used for damping, and articles in the traveling case are received through the receiving mechanism, thereby saving space.

title_en: Apparatus, system, and method for advanced oxidation process using photohydrogen ionization
abstract_en: Apparatus, systems and methods for forming advanced oxidation products by contacting a hydrated catalytic surface of a catalytic target structure with broad spectrum ultraviolet light in the wavelength range of 100nm to 300nm, preferably including 185nm and 254nm wavelengths. The catalytic surface reacts with the ultraviolet light energy and hydrates at the catalytic surface to form advanced oxidation products. In one embodiment, the catalytic surface comprises a hydrophilic agent, titanium dioxide, silver, copper, and rhodium. Preferably, the catalytic surface is coated with a coating comprising a hydrophilic agent, titanium dioxide, silver, copper and rhodium. A photohydrogen ionization unit (100) is also provided that includes an ultraviolet light source (204) and a catalytic target structure (110) in an air environment to form advanced oxidation products. Ultraviolet light indicators and monitoring and/or control systems for a photohydrogen ionization unit (100) are also provided.

title_en: Portable oral cavity flusher
abstract_en: The invention discloses a portable oral cavity flusher, which comprises a shell, a liquid storage shell, a power mechanism and an adjusting mechanism, wherein the power mechanism and the adjusting mechanism are positioned in the shell, a gear rotating disc and a rotating block in an energy conversion assembly are linked to drive a diaphragm to rotate, so that a suction cavity generates pressure difference to spray water flow, when the water flow passes through the power mechanism, the water flow is completely isolated from external electric appliances such as a motor and the like, the internal water leakage damage of the device is avoided, the adjusting mechanism is arranged in the shell, and the first rotating rod inserted in the shell wall is meshed and transmitted through a conical gear structure in a connecting cavity to rotatably adjust a second rotating rod and a third rotating rod, so that the angle of a spray head positioned on the rod body of the third rotating rod is changed, the multi-angle and all-directional water flow flushing can be carried out during oral cavity nursing, the flushing efficiency of the oral cavity flusher is effectively increased, and the oral cavity nursing can be carried out in a more comfortable posture.

title_en: Method and system for delivering sensory simulation based on evoked response quantification
abstract_en: A system for delivering sensory stimulation comprising: a sensor; a sensory stimulator configured to deliver sensory stimulation to the patient during the sleep session, the sensory stimulation having varying stimulation intensity levels; and a computer system. The one or more physical processors are programmed with computer program instructions that, when executed, cause the computer system to: determining sleep stage information for the patient based on brain activity information of the patient during the sleep session from the sensor; providing an input to a sensory stimulator based on the determined sleep stage information of the patient, the provided input causing the sensory stimulator to deliver sensory stimulation to the patient; obtaining stimulus response information from the patient, the stimulus response information including a patient brain response to the delivered sensory stimulation; and determining a range of stimulation intensity levels within which the patient brain response reaches a threshold.

title_en: Image presentation method, system, imaging system and storage medium in interventional therapy
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides an image presentation method and system, an imaging system and a storage medium in interventional therapy. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring an image sequence and determining a reference image selected from the image sequence; determining a region of interest in a reference image; dividing an image part corresponding to the attention area from each image in the image sequence to obtain an image sequence corresponding to the attention area and an attention area reference image from the reference image; identifying a target which is interested by a user from a reference image of the attention area; acquiring a personalized image processing algorithm aiming at the identified user interest target, processing an image sequence corresponding to the interest area, generating a post-processing image sequence, and/or generating a post-processing image; and stretching and amplifying the post-processing image or the post-processing image sequence according to the presenting size, and presenting the post-processing image or the post-processing image sequence. The technical scheme in the embodiment of the invention can improve the intelligence, flexibility and definition of image presentation.

title_en: Extrusion crushing rod for auxiliary feeding device
