abstract_en: The invention provides an extrusion crushing rod for an auxiliary feeding device, which is rotatably arranged in a communication hole on the auxiliary feeding device and is sequentially divided into a connecting section, a first conveying section, a first shearing section, a second conveying section, a solid-liquid mixing section and a supporting section along the axial direction; the first conveying section and the second conveying section have the same structure and are of single-spiral worm structures; the first shearing section is also of a single-spiral worm structure, the lead of the first shearing section is smaller than that of the first conveying section, and the height of the screw ridge of the first shearing section is smaller than that of the screw ridge of the first conveying section; the second shearing section is a cylindrical body formed by equidistantly arranging a plurality of longitudinal grooves which penetrate along the axial direction on the circumferential surface of the cylinder, and the axial diameter of the second shearing section is consistent with the inner diameter of the connecting through hole; the solid-liquid mixing section is provided with a plurality of rectangular teeth which are distributed at intervals along the axial direction. Through designing crushing pole structure of extrusion and overall arrangement mode, reinforcing crushing effect improves extrusion efficiency, reduces extravagant phenomenon.

title_en: High-density polyethylene surface modified composite support and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-density polyethylene surface modified composite bracket and a preparation method and application thereof; the method comprises the following steps: s1, preparing a HDPE porous scaffold by using HDPE powder as a base material through a 3D printing technology; s2, ultrasonically cleaning the HDPE porous scaffold, drying, plasma cleaning, then soaking in dopamine solution to perform PDA modification on the surface of the scaffold, and drying to obtain a PDA/HDPE composite scaffold; s3, soaking the PDA/HDPE composite support in SBF simulated body fluid to form a bone-like hydroxyapatite layer on the surface of the PDA/HDPE composite support, and cleaning and drying the bone-like hydroxyapatite layer to obtain the PDA/HA/HDPE composite support; s4, soaking the PDA/HA/HDPE composite scaffold in a VEGF-loaded microsphere solution for modification, and cleaning and drying to obtain the PDA/HA/VEGF/HDPE composite scaffold. The application comprises the following steps: the prepared high-density polyethylene surface modified composite scaffold is used as a repairing material for craniomaxillofacial bone defects. The high-density polyethylene surface modified composite scaffold prepared by the invention has personalized characteristics, bioactivity and good integration with organism bone tissues, and the preparation method is simple and effective in process.

title_en: Monocular vision-based human body height measuring method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The method comprises the steps of obtaining a target image, wherein the target image is an image of a person to be measured standing on a designated ground, which is acquired by using a camera device calibrated in advance; processing and analyzing the target image to obtain coordinate data of intersection points of the head and feet of the detected person and the ground in the target image; and processing and calculating the coordinate data according to the internal reference and external reference information obtained when the camera equipment is calibrated in advance to obtain the actual height of the detected person. The method and the device are helpful for realizing the height measurement of the human body with lower cost while ensuring high efficiency.

title_en: Data storage method and device, electronic equipment and computer readable medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure discloses a data storage method, a data storage device, an electronic device and a computer readable medium. One embodiment of the method comprises: acquiring target medicine data, wherein the target medicine data comprises information of each attribute of a target medicine; determining a probability set between the target drug and each attribute according to a knowledge graph associated with the drug, wherein the probability in the probability set represents the association degree between the target drug and the attribute; determining whether the target medicine data reach the standard or not according to the probability set and the weight corresponding to each attribute; responding to the target medicine data as standard data, and processing the target medicine data to obtain processed medicine data; and storing the processed medicine data in a medicine database. According to the implementation method, whether the target medicine data reach the standard or not can be accurately and effectively determined through the probability set between the target medicine and each attribute and the weight corresponding to each attribute.

title_en: Inorganic particles for fibers and method for producing same
abstract_en: The fiber inorganic particles of the present invention in embodiment 1 are fiber inorganic particles having a content of coarse particles having a particle diameter of more than 1.562 μm of 1500 ppm by number or less as measured by an inductance-belt method; in addition, the inorganic particles for fiber of the present invention of embodiment 2 is an inorganic particle for fiber having a content of coarse particles having a particle diameter of more than 1.562 μm, as measured by a flow particle image analysis method, of less than 300 ppm by number.

title_en: Ultrasound contrast imaging method and system
abstract_en: The application provides an ultrasonic contrast imaging method and system, which solve the problems of low signal-to-noise ratio and contrast ratio of conventional ultrasonic contrast imaging in the prior art. The ultrasonic contrast imaging method comprises the following steps: the magnetic field generating device responds to a first control command sent by the host computer to generate an alternating magnetic field; placing an animal to be detected, in which a magnetic microbubble contrast agent is injected into a blood vessel, in an alternating magnetic field, and generating radial vibration by magnetic microbubbles in the magnetic microbubble contrast agent under the action of the alternating magnetic field; the ultrasonic transducer probe responds to a second control command sent by the host computer to transmit an ultrasonic imaging pulse; the ultrasonic imaging pulse generates return ultrasonic wave after encountering the magnetic micro-bubble with radial vibration; the ultrasonic transducer probe receives the return ultrasonic wave and generates a return ultrasonic signal based on the return ultrasonic wave; the host computer generates a contrast image from the returned ultrasound signals.

title_en: Self-balancing medical electric stretcher vehicle
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of medical equipment, and particularly relates to a self-balancing medical electric stretcher, which comprises a bedstead, a bed body, a walking wheel assembly and a hydraulic cylinder; according to the stretcher, the hydraulic cylinder is arranged, so that the distance between the walking wheel assembly and the bed frame can be adjusted through the hydraulic cylinder, the stretcher can be stably transferred by medical personnel only by providing force for keeping the bed frame horizontal in the process of transferring the stretcher from an ambulance to the ground and in the process of moving the stretcher on a slope, so that the patient can be conveniently transferred, meanwhile, the medical personnel do not need to bear the gravity of the stretcher and the patient, and the medical personnel are concentrated on keeping the bed frame horizontal, so that the patient is always in a flat lying state, the secondary injury of the patient in the transferring process is prevented, the illness state of the patient is prevented from being aggravated by the secondary injury, the illness state of the patient is kept stable, the treatment of the patient is facilitated, and the rehabilitation of the patient is facilitated.

title_en: System and method for determining skin contact for a personal care device
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to systems and methods for determining skin contact for a personal care device. A system configured to perform a personal care operation on the skin of a subject is provided. The system comprises a processing unit and a personal care device. The personal care device includes a housing having an aperture, the aperture being disposed on the housing such that the aperture is adjacent the skin when the personal care device is in contact with the skin and used to perform a personal care operation on the skin. The personal care apparatus further comprises an imaging unit arranged within the housing and arranged to acquire an image of the skin adjacent the aperture using light entering the personal care apparatus through the aperture, wherein in a skin contact detection mode of the system a focal plane of the imaging unit is aligned with the aperture. The processing unit is configured to receive, in the skin contact detection mode, one or more images acquired by the imaging unit in the skin contact detection mode and to process the one or more images to determine whether the personal care device is in contact with the skin.

title_en: Dry-type defibrillation electrode
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dry-type defibrillation electrode, which comprises an actuator, a limiter, an energy accumulator, a storage bin and a treatment electrode, wherein the actuator is connected with the limiter; the actuator is a displacement output device, is fixed on the outer surface of the containing bin and is reliably connected with the limiter, the treatment electrode is positioned in the containing bin, and the energy accumulator is positioned between the inner surface of the containing bin and the treatment electrode; the limiting device comprises a limiting reverse buckle, and a part of limiting device penetrates through the surface opening of the storage bin and extends into the storage bin to form the limiting reverse buckle; the position of the treatment electrode is lower than the limit reverse buckle; the limit reverse-buckling edge is positioned in a projection plane of the motion direction of the treatment electrode; when defibrillation is implemented, the actuator generates displacement, the limiting stopper slides outwards, and the energy storage device releases compression energy when the limiting reverse buckle edge completely leaves the projection surface of the motion direction of the treatment electrode, so that the flexible pole piece is pasted on the skin. The invention does not need conductive media, thus reducing the production and use cost; the problems of shelf life, skin allergy, difficulty in removing residual conductive media after use and the like caused by the conductive media are avoided, and the reliability of the system is improved.

title_en: Laser virus filtering screen
abstract_en: The laser virus filtering screen can kill viruses by utilizing the splitting action of ultraviolet laser on the viruses or the heating action of infrared laser. The laser beam (which may be expanded in one direction) covers a flat or curved surface by multiple reflections, and the viruses in the air passing through this surface will be filtered. The laser virus filtering screen can be used as a protective helmet, a face mask, an air inlet and an air outlet of an air conditioner and a large-scale isolation screen in a room.

title_en: Implanted electrode device and implanted bioelectric stimulation system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an implantable electrode device and an implantable bioelectric stimulation system, wherein the implantable electrode device comprises a substrate, a first receiving element, a second receiving element, a signal processing unit and an electrode; the base body is provided with an outer surface and an inner surface, and the inner surface is enclosed to form a containing cavity; the first receiving element, the second receiving element and the signal processing unit are all arranged between the outer surface and the inner surface, and the first receiving element is used for receiving external relay energy; the signal processing unit is used for processing the relay energy to obtain an electric signal and transmitting the electric signal to the electrode; the second receiving element is used for receiving an external control signal so as to control the signal processing unit to transmit an electric signal to the electrode; the electrode is arranged on the outer surface of the substrate and is used for applying the electric signal to a target point. The implantable electrode device is of an integrated structure, can be integrally fixed on the skull of a patient, simplifies the operation of a doctor, and avoids adverse effects on the daily life of the patient.

title_en: Power supply device and method for inverting voltage signal multiplexing and CT system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a multiplexing power supply unit of contravariant voltage signal, include: the low-voltage side comprises an inverter circuit and a low-voltage side control part, the inverter circuit is used for receiving direct-current voltage, the low-voltage side control part is used for providing a driving signal for the inverter circuit, and the inverter circuit generates a frequency-adjustable alternating-current inverter voltage signal according to the frequency-variable driving signal; the high-voltage isolation transformer is used for converting the alternating current inversion voltage signal into a secondary inversion voltage signal and realizing high-voltage isolation and high-voltage side of a low-voltage side and a high-voltage side, receives the secondary inversion voltage signal from the high-voltage isolation transformer, and comprises a BUCK circuit, a frequency-voltage conversion circuit and a high-voltage side control part, wherein the frequency-voltage conversion circuit generates different reference voltage signals according to frequency change of the secondary inversion voltage signal, and the high-voltage side control part provides a control signal to the BUCK circuit according to the reference voltage signal so that the BUCK circuit provides target output voltage and/or current. The disclosure also provides a power supply method and a CT system.

title_en: Sleep environment adjusting method and device for insomnia treatment
abstract_en: The invention provides a sleep environment adjusting method and a device for insomnia treatment, which are applied to an insomnia treatment terminal and comprise the following steps: coupling and connecting the insomnia treatment terminal with household equipment, wherein the household equipment is divided into static equipment and dynamic equipment; controlling the insomnia treatment terminal to collect environmental information, and determining the current environmental state according to the environmental information, wherein the environmental information comprises a light environment, a sound environment, a temperature environment, a humidity environment and a smell environment; inputting an initial environment state required by the sleeper, wherein the initial environment state is displayed in the form of images, characters, numbers or animations; the intelligent adjustment running state of the daily household equipment is controlled by operating the insomnia treatment terminal, a sleeping environment with appropriate illumination, sound, temperature, humidity and smell can be created, so that an insomnia patient can fall asleep comfortably and quickly, and after the insomnia patient falls asleep, the dynamic equipment such as illumination, sound and the like can be readjusted by collecting the sleeping state of the sleeper.

title_en: Document cabinet for electronic commerce
abstract_en: The invention discloses a document cabinet for electronic commerce, which belongs to the field of electronic commerce and comprises a cabinet body, wherein the cabinet body is provided with a plurality of storage boxes, a drawer is arranged in each storage box, threaded pipes are symmetrically arranged on two sides of the drawer, a lead screw is arranged on the rear side of each threaded pipe in a threaded mode, the rear end of each lead screw is rotatably arranged with a rear side plate of each storage box, each lead screw is driven by a motor, and a sterilization mechanism is arranged in each storage box. The drawer opening and closing device has the advantages that the opening and closing of the drawer are electrically controlled, the operation is simple and quick, the use by personnel is convenient, the ventilation treatment and the sterilization treatment can be carried out on the interior of the drawer through the arranged sterilization mechanism and the ventilation mechanism, and the phenomenon of file mildew and damage caused by the breeding of bacterial microorganisms is avoided.

title_en: Walking aid wheelchair drive control circuit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a driving control circuit of a walking aid wheelchair, which comprises a processor and a peripheral circuit thereof, a current driving circuit and a sampling circuit, wherein: the processor and the peripheral circuit thereof comprise a main control chip, a first motor control chip and a second motor control chip; the current driving circuit comprises a first current driving circuit and a sampling amplification circuit thereof, a second current driving circuit and a sampling amplification circuit thereof and a reference sampling circuit; the sampling circuit comprises a power supply voltage sampling circuit, a motor Hall sensor sampling circuit and an encoder sampling circuit. The invention optimizes the circuit of the motor control system, can ensure that the wheelchair control system of the walking aid can stably run, is suitable for various complex road conditions and special use conditions, has stable and reliable circuit and high-efficiency and accurate sampling circuit; according to the load condition of the user, the vehicle can run forwards and backwards and turn left and right, thereby assisting the user to ride and move. The driving control circuit can meet the traveling requirements of various handicapped people.

title_en: Urine collection device for urology surgery
abstract_en: The urine collecting device for the urology surgery comprises a bottom plate, bed legs are respectively fixed on the periphery of the bottom plate, a bed body is fixedly connected to the upper ends of the bed legs, and a lifting structure is arranged at one end of the bed body; the lifting structure comprises a threaded rod, a supporting plate is fixedly connected to the upper end of the threaded rod, a protective cover is arranged at the upper end of the supporting plate, and a urine-inducing structure is arranged in the protective cover; the urine inducing structure comprises a pressing rod intermittently moving up and down and rotating, and the tail end of the pressing rod is fixedly connected with a pressing disc; the lower end of the supporting plate is provided with an abdomen massage structure which is in power connection with the urine-inducing structure; be equipped with the transmission structure on the bottom plate, the transmission structure is connected with respectively and divides the urine structure and with divide urine structure matched with ureteral structure, divides the urine structure can collect the urine of the different sections of patient, and the ureteral structure can be with the urine intermittent type nature output of different sections, and the effectual urine collection device for uropoiesis surgery among the prior art urine is collected inconveniently and can't collect the problem that detects to the urine of different sections.

title_en: Bendable electric hook
abstract_en: A bendable electric hook comprises a rod body, wherein a transmission case is arranged at the rear end of the rod body, the rod body and the transmission case are both of a hollow structure, inner cavities of the rod body and the transmission case are mutually communicated, a placing case is arranged at the front end of the rod body, an electric hook assembly is arranged in the placing case, an electric hook transmission assembly is arranged in the transmission case, the front end of the electric hook transmission assembly is connected with the electric hook assembly, and the position and the use angle of the electric hook assembly are controlled through the electric hook transmission assembly; an electric box is arranged on the bottom surface of the transmission case, a controller is installed in the electric box, an electric hook button is arranged on one side of the transmission case, and the controller is connected with the electric hook button and the electric hook assembly through circuits; the invention has the advantages that: the position and the angle of the hook head of the electric hook are changed through the electric hook transmission assembly, so that the hook head can be bent by 90 degrees, and a doctor can conveniently perform operation.

title_en: Laryngeal mask catheter system and laryngeal mask fitting
abstract_en: The invention relates to a laryngeal mask catheter system and a laryngeal mask joint, wherein the laryngeal mask catheter system comprises a laryngeal mask and a laryngeal mask tracheal catheter, the laryngeal mask comprises a laryngeal mask breather pipe and a laryngeal mask air bag formed at the far end of the laryngeal mask breather pipe, the laryngeal mask breather pipe limits a ventilation cavity extending from a near end to a far end, the near end of the ventilation cavity is provided with an air vent, the air vent is provided with the laryngeal mask joint, and the tracheal catheter is connected with the laryngeal mask through the laryngeal mask joint and can penetrate through the ventilation cavity from the laryngeal mask air vent; the laryngeal mask connects and includes lock piece and mounting, the lock piece is used for installing in the laryngeal mask breather hole, and has the socket that the air supply pipe runs through, the mounting be used for the cover to establish in endotracheal tube week side, and be constructed into and can cooperate and then drive the radial internal contraction of socket in order to restrict endotracheal tube and laryngeal mask breather pipe and take place relative displacement with the lock piece joint.

title_en: Application of systemic inflammatory response index in prognosis evaluation of gastrointestinal diffuse large B cell lymphoma
abstract_en: The invention provides application of a systemic inflammatory response index in prognosis evaluation of diffuse large B cell lymphoma of gastrointestinal tracts, and belongs to the technical field of disease prognosis evaluation. According to the invention, the SIRI level is found to be used as a prognosis marker of gastrointestinal diffuse large B cell lymphoma; furthermore, a new gastrointestinal diffuse large B cell lymphoma prognosis evaluation system is constructed based on SIRI and NCCN-IPI scores, can effectively predict clinical results, enriches current stratification, shows excellent distinguishing capability in the overall survival period and the progression-free survival period of patients, and has better risk distinguishing capability and layering capability than the existing NCCN-IPI scores, thereby having good value of practical application.

title_en: Classification of gastric cancer subtypes and uses thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses classification of stomach cancer subtypes and application thereof, wherein on the basis of collecting gene expression data of stomach cancer patients, comBat is adopted to remove batch effect and an unsupervised cluster analysis method is used to obtain four subtypes of stomach cancer patients, including interstitial type, immune type, typical type and metabolic type; different types of gastric cancer patients have different reactions to PD1 immune drugs and chemotherapy drugs, and interstitial gastric cancer patients benefit from antiangiogenic drugs obviously; the immune typing predicts the response of gastric cancer patients to PD1 immune drugs to be superior to the traditional biomarker: including microsatellite instability, EBV virus, PD-L1 CPS expression and tumor mutation load; patients with typical gastric cancer benefit significantly from cell cycle inhibitors; metabolic patients benefit significantly from 5-fluorouracil + platins; the adoption of proper medicines according to the four types greatly improves the survival rate of gastric cancer patients, avoids inapplicable medicines as much as possible, and reduces the toxicity and side effects of chemotherapy.

title_en: Urological surgery robot system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of medical instruments, and discloses a urological surgical robot system which comprises a plurality of urological surgical machines, wherein a distal part of one urological surgical machine is provided with an image pick-up device, the distal part of the other urological surgical machine is provided with an end effector, a sheath comprises a connecting part and an extending part which are fixedly connected with each other, the connecting part and the extending part are provided with a plurality of instrument channels which are communicated with each other and extend along a longitudinal axis and are arranged at intervals in the radial direction, the plurality of instrument channels of the connecting part are arranged at the distal end in a neighboring way and gradually depart from the distal end to the proximal end, the extending part further comprises a first liquid channel and a second liquid channel which extend along the longitudinal axis and are arranged at intervals in the radial direction, and the plurality of instrument channels, the first liquid channel and the second liquid channel of the extending part are all arranged at the neighboring way, thereby ensuring that the surgical machines are small in size and can realize extremely high degree of freedom configuration in a small-size space range, and is convenient for preoperative installation and postoperative cleaning.

title_en: Chitosan and application thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to matrix-forming crosslinked carboxyalkyl chitosan, compositions comprising the same, methods of preparing the same and various uses thereof, particularly in the therapeutic, rheumatological, ophthalmic, cosmetic, orthopedic, open surgery, dermatological, gynecological or cosmetic fields. The invention relates in particular to a matrix comprising at least one carboxyalkyl chitosan having glucosamine units, N-acetyl glucosamine units and glucosamine units substituted by carboxyalkyl groups, expressed as moles of N-acetyl groups relative to the moles of total glucosamine units, said carboxyalkyl chitosan having a degree of acetylation of 40% to 80%, said carboxyalkyl chitosan being crosslinked by covalent bonds between the chains of the carboxyalkyl chitosan.

title_en: Ophthalmic clinical head fixer with centre gripping central point puts adjustable
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of medical instruments, and particularly relates to a head fixator with an adjustable clamping center position for ophthalmologic clinic, which comprises a supporting structure and a head supporting plate, wherein the supporting structure is provided with a folding device capable of driving the head supporting plate to slide firstly and then rotate; the supporting structure is provided with a clamping device corresponding to the head supporting plate, and the supporting structure is provided with an adjusting structure capable of driving the clamping device to slide back and forth and left and right; the clamping device comprises a clamping cavity connected with the adjusting structure, a synchronous structure is arranged in the clamping cavity, and a first side fixing structure, a second side fixing structure, a front fixing structure and a rear fixing structure which act synchronously are connected to the synchronous structure; the invention effectively solves the problem that the head of a patient cannot be accurately placed in the middle of the head supporting plate, namely the clamping center of the clamping device, of the existing head fixator.

title_en: Mobile diagnosis and treatment oriented medical care patient matching method and system
abstract_en: A medical care patient matching method and system for mobile diagnosis and treatment are provided, wherein the matching method comprises the following steps: s1: acquiring basic information of a patient, including identity information and state information, integrating the state information to form a state label, establishing a one-to-many relationship between the identity information and the state label of the patient, and constructing a big data system; s2: acquiring data information of medical personnel, and forming a relational database for storage; s3: carrying out patient care matching according to a preset matching decision, wherein the matching decision at least comprises the following steps: the patient condition classification corresponds to the diagnosis and treatment major of medical staff, the patient condition severity level corresponds to the professional skill level of the medical staff, and a matching result is decided; and a mutual evaluation mechanism of the patient and the medical staff is established, and the matching quality is optimized. The invention also comprises a medical patient matching system facing the mobile diagnosis and treatment. The invention can make the patient-care matching system recommendation result more reasonable, and then improve the quality system of the matching system.

title_en: Massage device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a massage device. A massage device that measures a blood pressure of a user, comprising: a control unit which controls the massage device, a body massage unit which provides massage to an upper body part and a lower body part of a user according to control of the control unit, an arm massage unit which is provided on at least one of one side and the other side of the body massage unit and provides massage to an arm part of the user according to control of the control unit, and which includes a first air cell provided along an inner wall of the arm massage unit, a second air cell provided inside the first air cell, and a first air supply unit which supplies at least one of massage air and first blood pressure measurement air to the first air cell according to control of the control unit; the control unit measures an amount of change in air pressure of the second air bag while supplying the first blood pressure measurement air to the first air bag to inflate the first air bag, and determines whether to measure the blood pressure based on the amount of change in air pressure.

title_en: Injection type skin filling composition and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of medicines, and particularly discloses an injection type skin filling composition as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The composition comprises polymer microspheres, polyethylene glycol derivatives and dispersion liquid, wherein the polymer microspheres are polycaprolactone microspheres, the polyethylene glycol derivatives are polyethylene glycol-succinimide succinate or polyethylene glycol-succinimide glutarate, and the dispersion liquid comprises oligopeptide acetate and sodium carboxymethylcellulose. The composition can realize accurate targeting positioning and space occupying filling effects at an action position, has no risk of swelling and displacement, can play a targeting immediate filling effect, has high biocompatibility and good redissolution property, can reduce inflammatory reaction after the material is implanted, and is safe and effective in clinical application.

title_en: Puncture-injury-preventing positioning type transfusion port puncture needle device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a positioning type transfusion port puncture needle device capable of preventing needle stick injuries, which comprises a puncture needle and a tray, wherein a track distributed along the diameter direction is arranged in the tray; the track comprises a hollow cylinder and two sections of transparent hollow pipes, the hollow cylinder is concentrically arranged in the center of the tray, the two sections of transparent hollow pipes are symmetrically arranged at two sides of the hollow cylinder by 180 degrees, the inner ends of the transparent hollow pipes are fixedly connected to the outer wall of the hollow cylinder, and the outer ends of the transparent hollow pipes are fixedly connected to the tray; the puncture needle vertically penetrates through the hollow cylinder, a pull rod capable of being elastically bent is movably arranged in each section of the transparent hollow tube, an opening is formed in the upper part, close to the inner end, of the transparent hollow tube, and one end of the pull rod penetrates out of the opening and is connected to a needle handle of the puncture needle; the surface of the transparent hollow pipe is provided with indication scale marks, and one end of the pull rod, which is positioned in the transparent hollow pipe, is provided with a limit end head for preventing the pull rod from being separated. The puncture needle has the advantages of ingenious structure, reasonable design, capability of accurately positioning the puncture center, effective avoidance of puncture injury and safe and reliable use.

title_en: External application electrode patch and cell division inhibition device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an external application electrode patch and a cell division inhibition device. This external application electrode paster includes: a flexible substrate and a flexible conductive structure. The flexible substrate is at least partially used for being attached to the surface of the target biological tissue; the flexible conductive structure is connected with one side of the flexible substrate and is used for being coupled with the flexible conductive structure in the other corresponding external application electrode patch, outputting a target electric field to the target biological tissue and generating deformation which is attached to the surface shape of the target biological tissue under the attaching action of the flexible substrate and the target biological tissue. The embodiment of the application realizes that the flexible conductive structure is used for replacing a hard metal electrode in the existing electrode patch, and the flexible conductive structure can generate deformation attached to the surface of a target biological tissue along with the deformation of the flexible substrate. Thereby reducing the foreign body sensation on the surface of the biological tissue and improving the comfort of the patient and the fitting degree of the external application electrode patch.

title_en: Healthy lighting phototherapy device using morning spectrum technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a health lighting phototherapy device using morning spectrum technology, belonging to the technical field of phototherapy, comprising: a base; the phototherapy assembly comprises a shell, two straight ring frames, two movable rings and a plurality of phototherapy lamps, wherein the two straight ring frames are fixedly connected to the upper end of the base; the phototherapy bed is arranged in the shell, a moving assembly is arranged in the shell, and the moving assembly is used for driving the phototherapy bed to move to the outer side of the shell; the rotating assembly is arranged on the shell; realize the phototherapy lamp and rotate at a slow speed, can evenly shine skin, reduce the dead angle that can't shine, utilize second motor drive shell and a plurality of fan rotation simultaneously, reduce power take off, practice thrift the electric energy, first net of ventilating blocks the fan, avoids the user touching, improves the security.

title_en: Hospital complaint service platform and method based on intelligent complaint event registration
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hospital complaint service platform and a method based on intelligent complaint event registration. The supervision method specifically comprises the following steps: receiving the complaint requirement and making the patient sign and confirm; the registered personnel carry out verification and then enter the system; storing the data interconnection module and related data acquired by the service terminal in a database; comparing the supervision rule information with the service terminal complaint information to form complaint information tracking query; the management terminal inquires and checks various data information and automatically generates a relevant data information statistical analysis graph, a report and a report; and the manager carries out special investigation and quality improvement according to the analysis result. The invention aims to accelerate the handling efficiency of complaints, improve the hospital management level, ensure the medical quality and medical safety and avoid adverse events.

title_en: Method and system for non-invasively characterizing heterogeneous media using ultrasound
abstract_en: A method of non-invasively characterizing a heterogeneous medium using ultrasound, comprising the steps of generating a series of incident ultrasound waves, recording an experimental reflection matrix R  ui  (t) defined between an input transmitting base (i) and an output receiving base (u), determining a response REP (R, Δr) of the medium between an input virtual transducer (TV  in ) and an output virtual transducer (TV  out ), the input virtual transducer being calculated based on an input focus of the experimental reflection matrix producing an input focus around a first point (P1), the output virtual transducer being calculated based on an output focus of the experimental reflection matrix producing an output focus around a second point (P2), the response being expressed as a function of a central Point (PC) of spatial position (R) in the medium, the central Point (PC) being located intermediate the first and second points (P1, P2).

title_en: Injectable dextran hydrogel microsphere filling agent and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to an injectable dextran hydrogel microsphere filling agent and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method of the injectable dextran hydrogel microsphere filling agent comprises the steps of carrying out chemical modification on dextran to obtain polymerizable dextran, further carrying out cross-linking through a polymerization reaction to prepare dextran hydrogel microspheres, and finally mixing the dextran hydrogel microspheres with an injection water solution uniformly and fully swelling to obtain the injectable dextran hydrogel microsphere filling agent. The application also comprises the injectable dextran hydrogel microsphere filling agent prepared by the preparation method of the injectable dextran hydrogel microsphere filling agent. The preparation method of the injectable dextran hydrogel microsphere disclosed by the application has the advantages of simple preparation method, mild conditions and less residual cross-linking agent, is suitable for large-scale production, and the obtained injectable dextran hydrogel microsphere filling agent can realize long-acting filling and is suitable for various human soft tissue filling occasions.

title_en: PDMS material containing benzimidazolyl dynamic covalent bond, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a PDMS material containing benzimidazolyl dynamic covalent bonds, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the raw materials comprise amino-terminated or hydroxyl-terminated polydimethylsiloxane, diisocyanate, a functionalized benzimidazole compound, a cross-linking agent and a solvent; dissolving raw materials in a solvent to obtain a reaction solution, and stirring and reacting at room temperature to obtain a prepolymer; the polymer was poured into a mold, placed in an oven to remove the solvent and cured. The prepared material has self-repairing and heavy processing performances and can be applied to the fields of 3D printing, tissue engineering, artificial skin and the like. The invention uses the functionalized benzimidazole compound to react with isocyanate, and the reaction is rapid at room temperature and has larger equilibrium constant. By introducing the benzimidazole chain extender in the condensation polymerization process, the dynamic adaptivity of the polymer network is greatly improved by introducing the benzimidazole dynamic covalent bond in the PDMS.

title_en: Scaffold periosteum material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of functional materials, and provides a scaffold periosteum material and a preparation method thereof. The scaffold periosteum material comprises a first membrane layer, a second membrane layer, a third membrane layer and a fourth membrane layer which are arranged in a stacked mode; the first film layer is made of sodium alginate, cross-linking ions and RGD; the second film layer is made of sodium alginate, cross-linking ions and polyethylene oxide; the third film layer is made of sodium alginate, cross-linking ions and vascular endothelial growth factors; the fourth film layer is made of polycaprolactone; the crosslinking ions independently comprise Sr 2+ And/orCa 2+ . According to the invention, sodium alginate is introduced, and the egg-box structure characteristics of the sodium alginate enable the sodium alginate to be capable of stably loading cross-linking ions to form a stable solid membrane structure; the crosslinking ions play an important role in the bone healing process. Meanwhile, sodium alginate has good biocompatibility, and cells can be stably attached and propagated by preparing the sodium alginate into a porous membrane structure.

title_en: Pre-positioning device for ultrasonic detection and implementation method thereof
abstract_en: A pre-positioning device for ultrasonic detection and an implementation method thereof belong to the technical field of musculoskeletal ultrasonic detection, and aim to solve the problems that when the existing device is used for detecting the musculoskeletal, the detection effect is influenced by the unconscious action or the twisting of a patient due to the inconvenience of positioning control on the limb part of the patient, so that the detection difficulty is increased, and the traditional device is inconvenient to arrange non-woven fabrics once and again when the traditional device is used for carrying out the musculoskeletal ultrasonic detection; according to the invention, the movable member round block reaches the designated position, the detected part is clamped in the clamping groove, the detected part can be detected conveniently by a doctor by utilizing the rotatability of the rotary round block in the member round block, and the seat covered by the disposable non-woven fabric is pushed out simultaneously by the linkage structure when the member round block moves, so that the patient can sit.

title_en: Hydrops treatment facility is used in medical oncology treatment
abstract_en: The invention discloses effusion treatment equipment for medical oncology treatment, which comprises an effusion storage tank, wherein suspension support plates are arranged on two sides of the effusion storage tank, a sealing top cover is tightly arranged on the outer side of the top of the effusion storage tank, a sealing spiral cover is arranged on the top of the sealing top cover, a liquid inlet connecting pipe is arranged on the top of the sealing spiral cover in a penetrating way, and support plates are arranged on two sides of the sealing top cover. According to the sampling device, the sampling connecting pipe is arranged, a worker can hold the push-pull handle to pull the rubber sealing head to move towards the front side through the sampling connecting column and the transparent sleeve, so that the accumulated liquid stored in the device is sucked out by the rubber sealing head under the action of external force and the sealing action of the rubber sealing head through air pressure suction, the accumulated liquid enters the transparent sleeve through the sampling connecting pipe, and after the rubber sealing head moves to the front position of the sampling exhaust pipe, the sucked accumulated liquid is discharged to the outside through the sampling exhaust pipe, so that the worker can sample the accumulated liquid conveniently, and convenience is brought to the worker.

title_en: Medical clamp for assisting physical cooling through cooling of two legs
abstract_en: The invention discloses a medical clamp with double legs for assisting physical cooling, which comprises a base body, wherein the base body is of a cuboid plate structure, leg holes are symmetrically formed in two ends of the base body and are communicated with the front end surface and the rear end surface of the base body, a loading and unloading hole is formed in the outer side end of each leg hole, each leg hole is communicated with the loading and unloading hole and forms an open hole based on the loading and unloading hole, a cooling hole is embedded in the base body, and one end of the cooling hole penetrates through the end part of the base body so as to be communicated with the outside; the cooling liquid is added or poured out through the opening end of the cooling hole, so that the cooling liquid cools the femoral artery through the cooling hole, the cooling effect of the femoral region can be greatly improved, and the physical cooling quality is improved.

title_en: Particle beam therapy system and magnetic resonance imaging apparatus
abstract_en: The invention provides a particle beam irradiation system with an MRI device, which can arrange a particle beam monitor close to the MRI device. Comprising: a bed (24) on which an irradiation target (26) is mounted; an irradiation device (21) that irradiates a particle beam toward an irradiation target; and a magnetic resonance imaging device (150) that captures an image of the irradiation object (25). A magnetic resonance imaging apparatus (150) is provided with: a magnet (50) that generates a static magnetic field in an imaging space (55) in which an irradiation target (26) is disposed; and a yoke (60) which is disposed outside the imaging space (55) and through which magnetic flux of the magnetic field generated by the magnet (50) passes. The irradiation device (21) is disposed on the back side of the yoke (60) when viewed from the imaging space (55), and irradiates the irradiation target with a particle beam from a through hole provided in the yoke (60) or a gap provided in the yoke. The direction in which the particle beam enters the imaging space intersects with the direction of the static magnetic field applied to the imaging space by the magnet.

title_en: Method and device for monitoring user state and monitoring equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of state monitoring, and discloses a method for monitoring a user state, which comprises the following steps: obtaining body motion signals collected by millimeter wave radar monitoring equipment in continuous time periods; determining local mark information and global mark information in a monitoring area of the millimeter wave radar monitoring equipment according to the body movement signals in the continuous time period; and determining the user state in the monitoring area of the millimeter wave radar monitoring equipment according to the local mark information and the global mark information. With this scheme, can combine the body movement signal that millimeter wave radar monitoring facilities gathered to confirm the fine motion condition in the monitoring area to carry out accurate discernment to the user state through the fine motion condition that has confirmed, realized the noninductive detection of user state. The application also discloses a device and monitoring equipment for monitoring the user state.

title_en: Portable medical instrument cabinet capable of achieving segmented air circulation
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a portable medical instrument cabinet of segmentable air cycle, a portable medical instrument cabinet of segmentable air cycle includes the cabinet body, drying system and control system, and the cabinet body includes a plurality of placing chambers, circulating line and removal wheel, and the placing chamber includes push-and-pull bottom plate, backup pad, baffle and door plant, and the backup pad is fixed to be set up on the cabinet body, and the activity of push-and-pull bottom plate sets up in the backup pad, and the baffle setting is inboard at the push-and-pull bottom plate, and the door plant setting is in the push-and-pull bottom plate outside. The placing chamber is arranged inside the cabinet body, the circulating pipeline is communicated with the upper end and the lower end of the placing chamber, and the moving wheels are arranged at the bottom of the cabinet body. The drying system comprises a plurality of vertically arranged heating wires and a plurality of fans. The utility model provides a but portable medical instrument cabinet of segmentation air cycle utilizes air cycle to give medical instrument drying and disinfect, can keep the placing chamber of opening and the placing chamber of closing apart after the placing chamber is opened, makes the placing chamber that does not open remain throughout and seals the inner loop, improves drying and bactericidal effect.

title_en: Processing method and processing tool for dental implant
abstract_en: The application provides a processing method and a processing tool for a dental implant, wherein the processing method for the dental implant comprises the following steps: clamping the side wall of the semi-finished blank of the dental implant; processing the top form of the blank body to obtain a connecting cavity for connecting the base station; a processing tool is inserted into the connecting cavity, and the relative position of the semi-finished dental implant product and the processing tool is locked; and clamping the processing tool and processing the external shape of the neck of the dental implant to obtain a finished dental implant product. By utilizing the method to process the semi-finished product of the dental implant, the problem of insufficient processing precision of the 3D printed titanium and titanium alloy dental implant at the connecting interface of the neck abutment can be effectively solved, the connection tightness and structural mechanical stability of the dental implant and the abutment are ensured, and the precision requirement of a dental implant system is further met.

title_en: Intelligent disinfection robot capable of achieving disinfection and humidification conversion functions
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent disinfection robot capable of realizing disinfection and humidification conversion functions. Can realize disinfection and intelligent disinfection robot of humidification conversion function, include: a main body; the spraying structure, the spraying structure set up in the top of main part, it is right including being used for to spray the structure the sealed top cap in main part top, the top of top cap is provided with the suction pump. The invention provides an intelligent disinfection robot capable of realizing disinfection and humidification conversion functions, which is mainly used for spraying a disinfectant to the external environment by arranging a spraying structure to realize the function of the disinfectant, and can realize angle adjustment of a spraying pipe fitting by arranging an adjusting component.

title_en: Preparation method of invisible appliance and invisible appliance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of an invisible appliance and the invisible appliance, wherein the preparation method of the invisible appliance comprises the following steps: acquiring a digital dentition model of a patient and generating a corresponding digital model of the appliance; setting printing parameters through 3D printing control software, and printing to obtain a pretreatment appliance, wherein the pretreatment appliance is supported on a printing platform of the 3D printer through a plurality of point supporting pieces; and removing the printing residues remained on the surface of the pretreatment appliance, removing the point support member after the first photocuring, and performing the second photocuring to obtain the invisible appliance. The method simplifies the preparation process of the invisible appliance, avoids unnecessary material waste, saves the labor and time required by preparation, simultaneously improves the precision of the obtained invisible appliance, improves the treatment effect of the invisible appliance, makes the invisible appliance more beautiful and makes the experience of patients better.

title_en: Method and device for controlling massage chair and massage chair
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of intelligent household appliances, and discloses a method for controlling a massage armchair, wherein the massage armchair comprises a foot massage mechanism, a shank massage mechanism and a back massage mechanism, and the method comprises the following steps: in response to the instruction of the user, the foot massage mechanism is started to massage the foot acupuncture points; when the foot massage mechanism runs for a first time period t 1 Under the condition of (1), the shank massaging mechanism is started to massage the shank acupuncture points; the massage mechanism runs at the lower leg part for a second time period t 2 Under the condition of (1), a back massage mechanism is started to massage a plurality of back acupuncture points; the back massage mechanism runs for a third time period t 3 Under the condition of (1), controlling the massage armchair to stop running; whereinThe plurality of foot acupoints, the plurality of calf acupoints and the plurality of back acupoints are all related to relieving stomachache. When the massage armchair is used for sequentially massaging the acupuncture points for relieving stomachache, the secretion of gastric acid can be regulated, and the stomachache of a user is relieved. The application also discloses a device for controlling the massage armchair and the massage armchair.

title_en: Image classification method, training method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure provides an image classification method, an image training device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, in particular to the technical field of computer vision and deep learning. The specific implementation scheme is as follows: acquiring target image feature vectors of a plurality of target slice images according to the plurality of target slice images corresponding to the target medical image, wherein the target image feature vectors are feature vectors used for representing global features and local features of the target slice images; acquiring target classification vectors of the target slice images according to the target image feature vectors of the target slice images; and processing the target classification vectors of the target slice images to obtain the classification results of the target slice images.

title_en: Multi-functional rat tail intravenous route auxiliary assembly
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multifunctional rat tail intravenous injection auxiliary assembly, which comprises an injection platform and a fixing structure for fixing a rat; the injection platform comprises a supporting plate and a rotating plate, and the first end of the rotating plate is rotatably connected with the first end of the supporting plate through a connecting structure; the fixing structure comprises a mouse body fixing structure positioned on the upper surface of the rotating plate and a mouse tail fixing structure positioned at the first end of the rotating plate; the upper surface of the rotating plate is provided with bulges and depressions which are arranged at equal intervals, and the mouse body fixing structure is provided with an adapter which is matched with the bulges and the depressions for use; a sleeve for fixing a mouse is arranged in the adapter; the rat tail fixing structure is a fixing clamp arranged at the first end of the rotating plate, a round hole is reserved in the middle of the fixing clamp, and the upper end and the lower end of the fixing clamp are provided with a recess or a bulge corresponding to the bulge or the recess on the rotating plate; through setting up in the arch and the sunken of adapter and rotor plate, guarantee being connected of adapter and rotor plate, fix the mouse in the adapter, utilize the sleeve fixed, the fixed rat tail of fixation clamp.

title_en: Agricultural is with quick cleaning and sterilizing device of seedling tray
abstract_en: The invention relates to a disinfection device, in particular to a rapid cleaning and disinfection device for an agricultural seedling tray. The invention provides a rapid cleaning and sterilizing device for agricultural seedling trays, which can simultaneously perform cleaning and sterilizing operations on a plurality of seedling trays, has higher efficiency and cannot damage the seedling trays. The invention provides a quick cleaning and disinfecting device for an agricultural seedling tray, which comprises four supporting blocks, a fixing frame, a guide frame and the like, wherein the four supporting blocks are connected with the fixing frame, the middle part of the fixing frame is provided with four feeding strip holes, the front inner wall and the rear inner wall of the fixing frame are symmetrically provided with the guide frame, and the main body of the guide frame consists of four frame rods for placing the seedling tray. The seedling tray is blocked by upward movement of the second sliding frame under the action of the reset of the third spring, and the seedling tray can be prevented from moving in the process of cleaning and disinfecting the seedling tray, so that the cleaning and disinfecting operations of the seedling tray are more stable.

title_en: Cell segmentation method and device based on HE staining image
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cell segmentation method and a cell segmentation device based on an HE staining image, which comprise the following steps: receiving an HE staining image uploaded by a user, and preprocessing the HE staining image to obtain a first image; according to a preset calculation method, calculating to obtain a corresponding coupling result image according to the first image and a plurality of different first system parameters; all the first system parameters are obtained by training a plurality of initial system parameters which are randomly generated according to the first image; and receiving segmentation image parameters input by a user, and calculating to obtain a segmentation image corresponding to the HE staining image by combining the coupling result image and the HE staining image. The method comprises the steps of preprocessing an HE dyeing image to obtain a first image, and training system parameters by utilizing the first image to adapt to HE dyeing images with different dyeing styles. Meanwhile, the invention can also receive the image parameters input by the user, adjust the image to be output and obtain and output the segmentation image.

title_en: Oxygen therapy pipe fixing equipment for basic nursing
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of medical equipment, and particularly relates to oxygen catheter fixing equipment for basic nursing. After the oxygen delivery pipe is sleeved outside the containing disc, the rotating disc can be driven to rotate by the volute spiral spring and the containing disc is driven to rotate by the supporting rod, so that the oxygen delivery pipe can be automatically recovered to be automatically adapted to the movement of a patient, and the situations that the oxygen delivery pipe is scattered outside and wound and the like can be avoided; after the oxygen therapy mouth outside of main part was located to an pot head through with the oxygen therapy pipe, press down the arc clamp and make its front end support the one end inclined plane of main part, further promotion ring cover makes the card strip block connect can accomplish the installation in the inside of draw-in groove and make it fixed, easy operation has still increased by a wide margin when can conveniently accomplishing to install and remove sealing performance and has prevented to connect not hard up.

title_en: Visual lung ventilation monitoring method and device and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a visual lung ventilation monitoring method, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: in the process of mechanically ventilating a patient by using a respirator, acquiring the lung impedance information of the patient through the EIT module, reconstructing an image by using an image reconstruction algorithm based on the lung impedance information of the patient to obtain a lung functional image, and displaying the lung functional image of the patient on a display screen of the respirator. The invention can realize the mutual matching optimization and adjustment of the lung functional image and the breathing machine parameter, monitor the lung function trend of the patient in real time, and provide early warning when the patient has lung injury or potential deterioration, thereby reducing the death rate.

title_en: Heat dissipation control system based on appearance that moults
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of heat dissipation control, in particular to a heat dissipation control system based on a depilator, which comprises a heat dissipation plate, wherein the inner wall of the heat dissipation plate is fixedly connected with a liquid cooling pipe, the liquid cooling pipe comprises an outer cylinder, the inner wall of the outer cylinder is fixedly connected with a motor, the outer wall of the motor is fixedly connected with an inner cylinder, and the inner wall of the inner cylinder is provided with a through hole. Through install the radiating effect that the liquid cooling pipe can improve equipment additional on the heating panel, the liquid cooling pipe divide into inner tube and urceolus, and wherein inner tube and urceolus carry out the liquid circulation through-hole and mutual chamber, and wherein the rotation through the spiral plate in the inside of inner tube promotes liquid, lets the liquid of inner tube like this inhale the liquid between urceolus and the inner tube under the state that hydraulic pressure step-down, forms the liquid stream to accelerate the heat conversion of liquid, improve the radiating rate.

title_en: Male urethral excrement absorption pad
abstract_en: The invention provides a male urethral excretion absorption pad which comprises a pocket-shaped pad towel, wherein a high edge and a low edge are arranged at the opening end of the pad towel, the pad towel consists of a breathable base film, a first adhesive layer, an absorption layer, a second adhesive layer and a non-woven fabric layer which are laminated from outside to inside, and a concave part is arranged on the low edge. The male urethral excretion absorption pad provided by the invention can comfortably accommodate male genital organs and effectively absorb urethral excretion.

title_en: Fe3O4@SiO2Application of @ DMSA magnetic nano material in adsorption removal of lead ions
abstract_en: The invention discloses Fe 3 O 4 @SiO 2 Application of @ DMSA magnetic nano material in adsorption removal of lead ions, namely Fe 3 O 4 @SiO 2 The @ DMSA magnetic nano material has low cytotoxicity, good blood compatibility, no obvious immunosuppression or enhancement, no obvious organ toxicity, stable physicochemical property after adsorption, high in vitro Pb adsorption rate and the like, and shows the effectiveness and feasibility of the material as a clinical blood perfusion adsorbent.

title_en: Absorbent article
abstract_en: The present invention provides a thin, flexible absorbent article (20) comprising an acquisition-distribution system (50) comprising a first component (52) comprising first thermoplastic fibers and cellulosic fibers, the cellulosic fibers being less than about 90% by weight of the first component (52), wherein the absorbent article (20) has an absorption time of less than about 7 seconds/g up to a 100g load range as measured according to the modified fluid acquisition test; and wherein the absorbent article (20) has a caliper in the range of 2cm as measured according to the caliper test 2 A thickness of less than about 2.5mm at a pressure of about 400g or a 3-point bending force of less than about 95g as measured according to the 3-point bending force test.

title_en: But scope one-man operation's biopsy manipulator
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of endoscopes, in particular to a biopsy manipulator with an endoscope capable of being operated by one person, which comprises a fixed seat, wherein an auxiliary structure for adjusting the endoscope is connected onto the fixed seat, an adjusting structure for adjusting the height is connected onto the auxiliary structure, a clamping structure for clamping and fixing the endoscope is connected onto the auxiliary structure, a collision structure for limiting rotation is connected onto the auxiliary structure, and a control structure for controlling the collision structure to work is connected onto the auxiliary structure; be convenient for fix the removal to the scope through auxiliary structure and centre gripping structure to be convenient for one operate, can restrict auxiliary structure and centre gripping structure's rotation through control structure and conflict structure, thereby make the scope fixed firm, be convenient for highly adjust the scope of centre gripping through adjusting the structure, thereby adapt to different heights.

title_en: Recoverable blood vessel support
abstract_en: The recyclable blood vessel support comprises a support main body and a solenoid, wherein both ends of the support main body are respectively provided with a near-end ring and a far-end ring, the near-end rings are connected with the solenoid, and a filament penetrates through the solenoid and the near-end rings and then is connected with the far-end rings of the support main body; the main body of the bracket is of a net structure; the support main part is provided with the enstrophe portion at the distal end, and the enstrophe portion is connected with the distal end ring. When the W-shaped blank part is adopted, a larger diameter-changing space can be provided for the bracket, and when the spiral blank part is adopted, the adaptability of the support in a small-diameter blood vessel can be enhanced under the condition that the supporting force is not changed, and the support has higher plasticity in the diameter-changing angle and direction; the far end of the support main body is also provided with an inversion part, when the support main body is recovered, the drawing filament applies acting force to the inversion part, so that the support is convenient to deform and convenient to recover, the effect on the blood vessel is reduced, and the blood vessel wall is prevented from being damaged.

title_en: Gastroenterology vomitus collection device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vomit collecting device for a digestive system department, and relates to the technical field of digestive system departments. The vomitus collecting device for the gastroenterology comprises a clamping mechanism, wherein the clamping mechanism comprises a first pipe, the upper port of the first pipe is fixedly connected with a first bowl, the first bowl presents bowl clothes, the first bowl is communicated with the inside of the first pipe, the outer edge of the upper port of the first bowl is fixedly connected with a first small column in an equidistant mode, the number of the first small columns is four, the outer sides of the four first small columns are sleeved with a first torsion spring, clamping plates are uniformly arranged on the outer sides of the upper port of the first bowl in an equidistant mode, the number of the clamping plates is four, the four clamping plates correspond to the four first small columns one by one, the upper middle parts of the clamping plates are inwards concave towards one direction of the bowl, the lower ends of the clamping plates extend out of the lower part of the upper port of the first bowl, and the lower parts of the clamping plates, which are close to the surface of the first bowl, are movably connected with the first small columns through hinges, the vomitus collecting device for the digestive system department is very convenient and simple to operate, can not allow vomitus to directly contact with hands, and is clean and sanitary.

title_en: Quantitative assessment method and device for liver reserve function based on medical image
abstract_en: The invention provides a quantitative assessment method, a device, electronic equipment and a computer-readable storage medium for liver reserve function based on medical images, wherein a liver portal phase image in preoperative epigastric enhancement CT of a liver cancer patient is adopted, and a machine learning analysis module is used for processing the liver portal phase image in combination with clinical biochemical detection data of the patient, so that a 15-minute retention rate (ICGR15) value of indocyanine green, namely a machine learning predicted value, can be automatically output, and a basis is provided for operation decision of a clinician, so that the quantitative assessment method has good practical application value. The use of the predictive model of the present application is time consuming, highly accurate, requires no purchase of millions of instruments and presents no risk of reagent allergy.

title_en: Apparatus for diagnosing HCM and apparatus for predicting HCM patient prognosis
abstract_en: The present application discloses a device for diagnosing Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy (HCM) and a device for predicting HCM patient prognosis. The apparatus for diagnosing HCM includes: a data acquisition unit configured to acquire sample data including blood samples of a plurality of normal persons and sample data of blood samples of a plurality of HCM patients as a first training data set; the diagnostic model construction unit includes: a feature screening unit configured to perform a dimensionality reduction process on the first training data set using a lasso regression algorithm to obtain a second training data set; and a model construction unit configured to train a plurality of decision trees using the second training data set using a random forest algorithm to construct a random forest model as the HCM diagnostic model; and a diagnosis unit configured to obtain a diagnosis result indicating whether the user has the HCM using the constructed HCM diagnosis model.

title_en: Portable nursing trolley for nursing department and using method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of nursing carts and discloses a portable nursing cart for nursing department and a using method thereof. The nursing trolley is reasonable in design, convenient to store the storage box, convenient to carry the nursing trolley through the idler wheels, convenient to move out the storage box and open the garbage can, convenient to use a nursing tool and convenient to collect nursing garbage.

title_en: Cavity string auxiliary vibration damper and design method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a cavity string auxiliary vibration damper and a design method thereof, the cavity string auxiliary vibration damper is arranged in a thermostat of a superconducting accelerator module, a cavity string support is arranged in the thermostat, the cavity string auxiliary vibration damper comprises at least one steel wire rope, telescopic devices are arranged at two ends of the steel wire rope, and the telescopic devices are fixedly connected with the inner wall of the thermostat and the cavity string support respectively. According to the cavity string auxiliary vibration damper and the design method thereof, the cavity string support and the thermostat are connected through the plurality of steel wire ropes, so that the rigidity of the cavity string structure is increased, and the vibration of the cavity string structure is reduced; the tightness degree of the steel wire rope can be adjusted through the hollow bolt, so that the steel wire rope is more convenient to install.

title_en: System and method for high resolution, high speed capsule endoscopy
abstract_en: A probe for performing endoscopy, comprising: a light source; a waveguide coupled to a light source; a diffraction grating to which light is guided from a light source by a waveguide; and a lens having a first aspheric surface and a second biconic surface, the diffracted light from the diffraction grating being directed into the aspheric surface of the lens and emitted from the biconic surface of the lens towards the transparent cylindrical surface of the probe.

title_en: Hysteroscope operating system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hysteroscope operating system, comprising: the electronic hysteroscope comprises a hysteroscope main body and a sheath tube arranged at the far end of the hysteroscope main body, and further comprises an instrument channel and a water return channel which are communicated with the sheath tube and the hysteroscope main body, wherein the far end of the sheath tube is provided with a water inlet communicated with the instrument channel and a water return port communicated with the water return channel; the uterine cavity perfusion system comprises a perfusion main body, a water inlet assembly and a water return assembly, wherein the near end of the water inlet assembly is connected to the perfusion main body, and the far end of the water inlet assembly is connected to an instrument channel; the near end of the water return component is connected with the perfusion main body, and the far end of the water return component is connected with the water return channel; the control mechanism comprises a first pressure sensor and a second pressure sensor, and the first pressure sensor is arranged at the water inlet; the second pressure sensor is installed at the return water mouth. The first pressure sensor and the second pressure sensor are arranged at the far end of the sheath tube, so that the actual pressure in the uterine cavity can be directly detected in the using process, and an operator can accurately know the actual pressure value in the uterine cavity conveniently.

title_en: Automatic massage instrument for reducing blood sugar
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic massage instrument for reducing blood sugar, which comprises a massage instrument body, wherein a binding belt is arranged on the outer side of the massage instrument body, an oil cavity is arranged on the inner side of a fixing block, the tail end of an oil pipe is communicated with a telescopic rod, an oil liquid and the telescopic rod which can be matched with the inner side of the oil cavity are arranged on the inner side of the oil cavity to adjust a massage hammer to a diabetic, a depth-adjustable adjusting mechanism is arranged on the inner side of the massage instrument body in the massage process, a massage mechanism which can buffer acupuncture points of the patient in the massage process is also arranged on the inner side of the massage instrument body, a motor is fixed on the inner side of the massage instrument body through screws, the output end of the motor is connected with a driving shaft through a coupling, and a reciprocating mechanism which can enable the massage hammer to adjust the frequency in the massage process of the diabetic is arranged on the outer side of the driving shaft. The massage hammer avoids the discomfort of the patient caused by the direct-impact massage of the massage hammer on the acupuncture point of the patient.

title_en: Physical sign index monitoring method, physical sign index monitoring device, physical sign index monitoring equipment, storage medium and program product
abstract_en: The application relates to a physical sign index monitoring method, a physical sign index monitoring device, physical sign index monitoring equipment, a storage medium and a program product. The method is applied to a physical sign index monitoring system, the physical sign index monitoring system comprises an accelerometer and a processor, the processor further determines a plurality of target peak values of a target acceleration signal in a preset time period by receiving acceleration signals of a target object in all directions in the preset time period, which are sent by the accelerometer, and then obtains the heart rate of a testee according to the plurality of target peak values so as to determine physical sign indexes of the testee. According to the method, the physical sign index monitoring system is installed on a target object, vibration generated by physiological activities of a testee is transmitted to the target object, acceleration signals are collected through the accelerometer, the acceleration signals are analyzed, physical sign indexes of the testee are obtained, the testee does not need to wear a physical sign index monitoring instrument for a long time, great convenience is brought to the life of the testee, and the friendliness of the testee in using the physical sign index monitoring system is improved.

title_en: Health management method and device for gestational diabetes and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a health management method and device for gestational diabetes and electronic equipment, wherein the health management method for gestational diabetes comprises the following steps: acquiring personal basic information and movement tabu information of a target user; based on the personal basic information and the exercise tabu information, a diet catering scheme and a pregnancy exercise strategy are pushed to the target user.
