The invention can push the diet allocation scheme and the pregnancy movement strategy to the target user in an interactive way with the target user, thereby realizing the active health management purpose of the target user, providing timely professional diet guidance and professional movement guidance for the target user, greatly reducing the occurrence probability of complications of gestational diabetes patients, improving the gestational outcome of the gestational diabetes patients and improving the prevention effect of the onset of gestational diabetes.

title_en: Method, apparatus and medium for data processing
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to methods, apparatuses, and media for data processing. According to various embodiments, a textual record is received that includes information related to a subject or object. At least one text sequence associated with at least one of a plurality of fields in the form is identified from the text record, the plurality of fields indicating a plurality of features of interest. Based on the result of the identification, a value of a respective field of the plurality of fields is determined. By this approach, information of the subject or object can be recorded using a structured form, making the information of the subject or object easier to view, store and access.

title_en: Portable direct current air wave pressure therapeutic instrument
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of medical instruments, and particularly relates to a portable direct-current air wave pressure therapeutic apparatus which comprises an upper shell, a PCB control panel, a 6-connection electromagnetic valve, a brushless air pump and a lower shell; the 6-linked electromagnetic valve is arranged on the electromagnetic valve fixing plate and is fixed in the lower shell through screws, the gas inlet and outlet of the 6-linked electromagnetic valve are connected with the brushless air pump through a silicone tube through a five-way joint, and a fixed air pump upper cover and a fixed air pump lower cover are arranged above and below the brushless air pump and are fixed in the lower shell through screws; the battery is installed through battery compartment in the middle part in the inferior valve, and inferior valve top block is connected with the epitheca, and the top is fixed in the epitheca to be provided with the PCB control panel. According to the invention, gas generated by the brushless air pump is conveyed into the two 6-connection electromagnetic valves through the silicone tube, and the MCU on the PCB control board further controls the opening and closing of the 6-connection electromagnetic valves through controlling time and pressure so as to realize the air inflation and deflation massage of the air bag sleeve through the conveying of the gas according to the control quantity; thereby improving local blood circulation and being more comfortable to use.

title_en: Assembly for a drug delivery device and drug delivery device
abstract_en: An assembly for a drug delivery device is provided, the assembly comprising a housing (10) having a proximal end and a distal end, a dose setting member (80) rotatable relative to the housing for a dose setting operation for setting a drug dose to be delivered, wherein a) the assembly further comprises a tracking member (50), wherein the tracking member is operatively coupled or coupleable to the dose setting member, or wherein b) the dose setting member is a tracking member, wherein the assembly further comprises a guide track (150), wherein the guide track is configured to form a guide interface for guiding and/or driving movement of the tracking member, wherein the assembly is configured such that the tracking member is displaced towards an axial tracking member end position during the dose setting operation, wherein the distance by which the tracking member is displaced towards the axial tracking member end position depends on the size of the set dose.

title_en: SMD sleep breathing monitoring structure and sleep breathing monitoring system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a SMD sleep and breathe monitoring structure, including flexible housing, the flexible circuit board, respiratory sensor, auxiliary sensor and paste the layer, flexible housing cladding flexible circuit board, last data processing circuit and the auxiliary sensor of being equipped with of flexible circuit board, respiratory sensor, auxiliary sensor all is connected with data processing circuit, respiratory sensor sets up the relative both sides in the thickness direction of flexible housing respectively with pasting the layer, respiratory sensor's detection position corresponds with the position of nasal cavity and/or mouth. The sleep respiration monitoring system comprises output equipment and the patch type sleep respiration monitoring structure which are connected with each other. The utility model provides a SMD sleep respiration monitoring structure has the flexibility, can be in the near direct attached of mouth nose position, hardly influences the sleep, and the travelling comfort is good, and simultaneously, the sleep data of multidimension degree can be gathered to multiple sensor, and the monitoring is more comprehensive.

title_en: Method for improving microwave treatment uniformity by using electromagnetic metamaterial
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for improving microwave processing uniformity by utilizing an electromagnetic metamaterial, which comprises the steps of firstly selecting a plurality of electromagnetic metamaterials which generate emergent waves with phase differences after being incident by the same electromagnetic waves; then splicing different electromagnetic metamaterials; then placing the combined electromagnetic metamaterial in a microwave cavity, moving the combined electromagnetic metamaterial, recording the change rule of electromagnetic power density distribution in the microwave cavity, and selecting the position point of the combined electromagnetic metamaterial with good electromagnetic power density spatial distribution complementarity; and finally, designing the movement speed and the retention time of the combined electromagnetic metamaterial according to the intensity distribution of the electromagnetic power density in the cavity corresponding to the selected position point. Therefore, the uniformity of the spatial distribution of the average electromagnetic power in the cavity is obviously improved, the average microwave power absorbed by each part of the processed material is approximately equal, and the purpose of improving the uniformity of microwave processing is further achieved.

title_en: Internal fixation stomach tube for preventing backflow and aspiration
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of medical instruments, and particularly relates to an internal fixation stomach tube for preventing backflow and aspiration, which comprises a stomach tube main body, wherein an outflow opening is formed in the stomach tube main body, an air bag is arranged on the stomach tube main body, an air delivery pipe is arranged on the stomach tube main body, a liquid scraping ring is arranged on the stomach tube main body, a connecting rope is arranged on the liquid scraping ring, an food injection connector is arranged at one end of the stomach tube main body, a connecting piece is arranged on one side of the food injection connector, a blocking cap is arranged on the connecting piece, a conveying cavity is formed in the stomach tube main body, an air delivery cavity is formed in the stomach tube main body, and an anti-sticking layer is laid on the inner wall of the conveying cavity. The internal fixation stomach tube is provided with the air bag, the inner wall of the esophagus is pressed by the pressure expanded by the air bag, so that the effect of internally fixing the stomach tube is achieved, the fixing effect is good, the occurrence of the unplanned tube drawing phenomenon can be reduced, and meanwhile, the air bag blocks the esophagus to prevent the backflow and the aspiration of the contents in the stomach.

title_en: Jejunum nutrient canal implanting system and method based on magnetic control capsule system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a jejunum nutrient canal imbedding system based on a magnetic control capsule system, which comprises a jejunum nutrient canal, a magnetic control capsule and a magnetic field controller, wherein a metal guide post is arranged at the inlet end of the magnetic control capsule, an image acquisition module is arranged at the head of the magnetic control capsule, a magnetic absorption groove is arranged at the tail of the magnetic control capsule and is in magnetic absorption connection with the metal guide post, the magnetic field controller is used for controlling the connection of the jejunum nutrient canal and the magnetic control capsule from the outside of a body and controlling the head of the magnetic control capsule to enter an intestinal tract, and the connection part of the jejunum nutrient canal and the metal guide post can be separated under the action of external force. The invention combines the magnetic control capsule technology to realize that the jejunum nutrient canal is placed into the duodenum in a magnetic guidance mode under a clearer visual condition, the connection process can be completed more efficiently and rapidly, the jejunum nutrient canal can be separated after entering the duodenum, and the metal guide post is discharged out of the body along with the magnetic control capsule. And can synchronously finish the endoscopic observation of the stomach and the small intestine, the whole operation is safe and accurate, and the acceptability of patients is high.

title_en: Hepatobiliary surgery hydrops drainage device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of medical instruments, in particular to a hepatobiliary surgery effusion drainage device, which comprises an inner tube and an outer tube, wherein the other end of the outer tube is connected with a hollow disc, the hollow disc is communicated with an external physiological saline bag through a liquid inlet tube, the middle position of the hollow disc is fixedly connected to the outer tube and is close to the other end of the outer tube, the other end of the outer tube is provided with a plurality of water inlet holes along the length direction of the outer tube, the water inlet holes are communicated with the hollow disc, a plurality of water outlet holes are formed in the water inlet holes, the water outlet holes penetrate through the outer surface of the outer tube, a vent tube is fixedly connected to the hollow disc, the vent tube is communicated with the outer tube, an inner tube is inserted into the outer tube, a liquid suction port is formed in the outer ring surface of one end of the inner tube, the other end of the inner tube extends out of the other end of the outer tube and is communicated with an external peristaltic pump, viscous effusion can be diluted through the cooperation of the outer tube and then is discharged through the inner tube, the possibility that the effusion is blocked by the inner tube is reduced, and the effusion is smoothly discharged after being pumped out through the inner tube, and the postoperative recovery of a patient is facilitated.

title_en: Electronic medical record quality assessment method and system based on text classification algorithm
abstract_en: The invention particularly relates to an electronic medical record quality evaluation method and system based on a text classification algorithm. According to the electronic medical record quality evaluation method and system based on the text classification algorithm, text semantics in the structured electronic medical record are understood based on the natural language processing model, then the analyzed text is classified and compared with the current analysis tag, and therefore the analysis accuracy is judged. According to the electronic medical record quality evaluation method and system based on the text classification algorithm, semantic content is understood and classified through the text classification model in natural language processing, the problem that analysis content is wrongly doped with other labels in a large-section text content quality evaluation task is avoided, meanwhile, automatic piece-by-piece quality evaluation of analysis results is achieved, an evaluation report is automatically generated, and therefore accuracy of quality evaluation work is improved, and quality evaluation workload is reduced.

title_en: Special chopstick sterilizer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a special chopstick killer which comprises a device main body, a first supporting rod, a second supporting rod, a sucker and a spring, wherein the first supporting rod is arranged at the lower end of the device main body, the second supporting rod is arranged at the lower end of the first supporting rod, the sucker is connected to the lower end of the second supporting rod, a first threaded rod is arranged on the first supporting rod, a second insertion groove is formed in the device main body, a first limiting rod is connected to the outer side of a movable cover, a third insertion groove is formed in the first limiting rod, a second limiting rod is arranged on the device main body, a fixing cylinder is connected to the outer side of the device main body, a limiting plate is connected to the outer side of the second limiting rod, and the spring is arranged on the outer side of the second limiting rod. This special type chopsticks killer is provided with first bracing piece, can carry on spacingly to the central axis through first threaded rod to it is spacing to convenient after adjusting device main part angle, makes it can make things convenient for chopsticks to put into.

title_en: Liquid hyaluronic acid injection system for plastic and cosmetic surgery
abstract_en: The invention discloses a safe and accurate liquid hyaluronic acid injection system for plastic and cosmetic surgery and a use method thereof, the safe and accurate liquid hyaluronic acid injection system comprises a needle cylinder, a piston is movably connected in the needle cylinder, a pull rod is fixedly connected to the top of the piston, the top end of the pull rod penetrates through the needle cylinder and extends upwards, a connecting pipe is integrally formed at the bottom of the needle cylinder, a needle head is inserted at the bottom of the connecting pipe, connecting plates are fixedly connected to the bottoms of two sides of the needle cylinder, an auxiliary mechanism matched with the needle head is arranged on the needle cylinder, and U-shaped frames are fixedly connected to the tops of two sides of the needle cylinder.

title_en: Method for producing puncture guide for robot minimally invasive surgery
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for producing a puncture guide for minimally invasive surgery of a robot, wherein the puncture guide device in the first step comprises a supporting arm fixedly arranged on a power device. According to the method for producing the puncture guide for the robot minimally invasive surgery, the puncture needle assembly can be clamped completely through folding of the first mounting seat and the second mounting seat, the locking mechanism is arranged between the first mounting seat and the second mounting seat, the first mounting seat and the second mounting seat are fixed after folding by the locking mechanism, the turnover quick-release assembly is arranged between the matched puncture needle assembly and the first mounting seat and between the matched puncture needle assembly and the second mounting seat, the locking mechanism is not required to be released when the puncture needle assembly needs to be turned 180 degrees to operate and the puncture needle assembly needs to be taken out, the defect that the locking mechanism needs to be released again by means of larger force after locking is effectively overcome, stability is high, and operation is convenient.

title_en: Strabismus training device based on VR technique
abstract_en: The invention discloses an orthophoria training device based on VR technology, comprising a VR mirror body, two buckles with the same structure, two positioning mechanisms with the same structure and two sound-proof earmuffs with the same structure, wherein the positioning mechanisms comprise side support plates, the side support plates are provided with ear side plates in a sliding manner, the side walls of the ear side plates are fixedly provided with clamping blocks, the side walls of the clamping blocks are provided with threaded groove holes, the threaded groove holes are internally and threadedly sleeved with screw rods for driving the clamping blocks to move, one ends of the rod bodies of the screw rods, which are close to the buckles, are rotatably sleeved with bearings, the outer rings of the bearings are fixedly connected with the positioning mechanisms, one sides of the ear side plates, which are far away from the clamping blocks, are fixedly provided with fixed plates, one sides of the fixed plates, which are far away from the ear side plates, are provided with positioning sliding plates in the positioning sliding manner, so that the problem that the existing VR orthophoria training instrument usually brings a quiet environment to users through sound-proof earmuffs during training is solved, but the sound-proof earmuffs of the VR training instrument can not adjust the length according to the distances of the users, the problem of tightness fine adjustment according to the user surface width can not be solved.

title_en: Ball hinge formula acetabular bone cup subassembly
abstract_en: The invention discloses a spherical hinge type acetabular cup component which comprises an acetabular cup, wherein a screw for connecting an acetabulum penetrates through the acetabular cup, and the acetabular cup and the screw form a spherical pair. The acetabulum cup and the screw form a spherical pair, namely the acetabulum cup and the screw can rotate around a spherical center in three independent relative directions. The screw has the ability to rotate so that the acetabulum over the range swept by the rotation of the screw shaft can be brought into engagement with the screw. The invention can effectively enlarge the range of the screw penetrating angle under the condition of not increasing the number of the holes and not changing the positions of the holes, thereby providing wider selection space for surgeons.

title_en: Integrated low negative pressure abdominal cavity drainage device
abstract_en: The invention relates to an integrated low-negative-pressure abdominal cavity drainage device, which belongs to the technical field of medical appliances and comprises a fixing frame and a low-negative-pressure aspirator arranged on the fixing frame, wherein a plurality of drainage bottles are connected below the low-negative-pressure aspirator, and a waste liquid treatment device is connected with a plurality of drainage bottles; the waste liquid treatment device comprises a waste liquid bag, a liquid outlet is formed in the bottom of the drainage bottle, the waste liquid bag is connected with the liquid outlet through a connecting component, a puncture component is arranged on the drainage bottle, and one side of the bottom end of the puncture component is arranged in the drainage bottle and is movably connected with the connecting component. According to the invention, the drainage liquid is primarily disinfected by the waste liquid treatment device, so that the cleaning process is safer; when the liquid in the drainage bottle reaches the specified capacity, the alarm mechanism gives an alarm to prompt medical staff to clear; the waste liquid treatment device is convenient to replace by limiting the limit assembly and the pushing assembly.

title_en: Management system for chronic cerebral ischemia high-risk patients
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of medical informatization, in particular to a chronic cerebral ischemia high-risk patient management system which comprises a handheld terminal and a central processing unit, wherein the output end of the handheld terminal is connected with the input end of a gateway intervention unit, the gateway intervention unit is in bidirectional electric connection with the central processing unit, the output end of the gateway intervention unit is connected with the input end of an electronic anti-interference unit, and the output end of the electronic anti-interference unit is connected with the input end of a data filing storage unit. This chronic cerebral ischemia high risk patient management system, through the personal file administration unit of patient, apoplexy risk assessment unit, daily data monitoring unit and follow-up visit management notice unit four major modules, wherein file administration supports directly newly-built patient and perfect patient information or cell-phone and log in the file establishment that APP accomplished oneself and family members at the PC end, bind with the hospital after accomplishing, real-time reception hospital's inspection information, also can upload inspection report photo by oneself and supply the doctor to look up and carry out the high risk factor mark.

title_en: Adjustment method and system of massage instrument and massage instrument
abstract_en: The application relates to a method and a system for adjusting a massage instrument and the massage instrument, which relate to the technical field of medical health care instruments, and the method comprises the steps of collecting identity information of a user after the massage instrument is started; sending a calling request to a first server based on the collected identity information; the calling request is used for triggering the first server to judge whether the diagnosis information matched with the identity information is stored or not, and if the diagnosis information is stored, the first server sends the diagnosis information to the massage instrument; judging whether the time difference between the moment of the diagnosis information and the current moment is less than a preset time length or not; if yes, acquiring an electromyographic signal of the contact part; obtaining the fatigue degree of the contact part based on the electromyographic signal; and configuring the working mode of the massage instrument based on the fatigue degree and the information of the doctor. The massage device has the effect of more intelligently configuring the working mode of the massage device for the user.

title_en: Pleural effusion drainage puncture device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pleural effusion drainage puncture device, which belongs to the technical field of medical instruments and comprises a second needle tube, wherein the top of the second needle tube is fixedly provided with a pipe jacking joint, the pipe jacking joint is provided with a liquid control valve, the top of the pipe jacking joint is provided with a second liquid guide pipe, and one end of the second liquid guide pipe is fixedly connected with a second liquid suction pipe; according to the invention, the expansion hemostasis mechanism is arranged outside, so that a good hemostasis function in a puncture process can be effectively realized, meanwhile, an automatic expansion function of the hemostasis structure can be realized, the area of a hemostasis area can be effectively expanded, the hemostasis effect is improved, the contact area of the whole puncture structure and a puncture area of a patient can be improved by the expansion structure, the stability of the puncture structure in puncture is stably improved, effective drainage is carried out, meanwhile, a plurality of massage particles of the expanded built-in expansion assembly can play a good massage treatment to relieve the tightness of the puncture area, and the use effect of the structure is greatly improved.

title_en: Long-range shunt guiding set for patients with ventricular inflammation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of medical instruments, in particular to a long-distance shunt set for patients with ventriculitis, which is mainly used for patients needing ventriculoperitoneal shunt and comprises the following components: ventricular canal, drainage tube; one end of the ventricular canal is provided with a hole structure, and a connecting piece is arranged to connect the ventricular canal with the drainage tube, and the drainage tube comprises: the device comprises an inner body pipe and an outer body pipe, wherein the inner body pipe and the outer body pipe can be replaced, a first adjusting part is arranged on the outer body pipe, and an adjusting structure is arranged on the first adjusting part; one end of the outer tube is also provided with a liquid collecting device; a second adjusting part is arranged on the inner tube; it reduces the operation risk, shortens the operation time and shortens the operation engineering.

title_en: Juvenile physique exercise device and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a physical exercise device for teenagers, which relates to the technical field of teenager exercise and comprises an I-shaped base and a right-angle frame, wherein a right-angle seat is installed on one side of the top end of the right-angle frame through a hinge shaft, an operating button is installed on the outer wall of the right-angle frame on one side of the right-angle seat, a connecting arm is movably installed on one side of the bottom end of the right-angle seat, a transverse supporting frame is fixed on one side of the top end of the I-shaped base, a seat angle adjusting assembly for adjusting the angle of the right-angle seat is arranged inside the transverse supporting frame, and a first hollow part and a second hollow part are arranged on the outer walls of two sides of the right-angle frame. The invention has stable and reliable operation and high safety, and can assist the user to do auxiliary training without arranging other personnel when the user wants to further break through the weakness of the limbs at the end of the training, thereby improving the exercise effect of the device on the physique of the user.

title_en: Multifunctional hand recovery instrument used after cerebral infarction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional hand recovery instrument used after cerebral infarction, which comprises a palm cushion plate, wherein one side of the palm cushion plate is rotatably connected with a finger cushion plate, the other side of the palm cushion plate is provided with a wrist cushion plate, and one side of the bottom end of the palm cushion plate is provided with a power device; through the power device who sets up in bottom one side of palm backing plate, start the motor among the power device, the motor drives drive end fixed connection's drive pulley and begins to rotate, drive pulley passes through the belt and drives driven pulley and begin to rotate, driven pulley drives the driving gear through first connecting rod and begins to rotate, the driving gear just can drive the driven gear rotation that outside meshing is connected, thereby drive driven gear one end fixed connection's finger backing plate and begin to rotate, make the action that the finger backing plate can imitate the finger and hold, a large amount of manpowers can be saved like this, improve the recovery effect of finger.

title_en: Remote monitoring of analyte measurements
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for remote monitoring. In some exemplary implementations, the method may include: receiving, from a host computing device, glucose concentration data measured by a glucose monitoring system; authorizing the remote monitoring device to remotely monitor a glucose state of the host; receiving, from the host computing device, a data selection of a type, format, or portion of the glucose concentration data that the remote server allows the remote monitoring device to access; receiving a threshold setting from a remote monitoring device, the threshold setting associated with a glucose concentration level or trend for receiving notifications regarding a glucose state of a host; establishing a plurality of rule sets associated with authorized remote monitoring devices; determining whether the glucose concentration data satisfies a rule within the plurality of rule sets, the determining comprising examining the glucose concentration data; and upon determining that the glucose concentration data satisfies the rules, generating an alert notification to be sent to each of the remote monitoring devices associated with the satisfied rules.

title_en: Wearable device for improving lower limb ischemia and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wearable device for improving lower limb ischemia and a control method thereof, wherein the device comprises a main control unit, an electrocardiosignal monitoring unit, a first electric pulse component and a second electric pulse component, wherein the first electric pulse component and the second electric pulse component are both composed of a medium-frequency pulse stimulation electrode with the pulse frequency of 1-100Kz and a low-frequency pulse stimulation electrode with the pulse frequency of 50-300 Hz. The wearable device is noninvasive, low-risk, and is connected through wireless communication, miniaturized, portable and low-cost, and does not need professional medical staff to operate and can avoid skin injury and other risks caused by high-pressure action. The control method is based on an electrocardiosignal setting control algorithm, so that the first pulse component and the second pulse component output electronic pulses with specific modulation waves according to preset instructions to generate hammering effect, and the effects of improving the hemodynamic environment of lower limbs and effectively improving the blood flow velocity of the lower limbs are achieved.

title_en: Fatigue driving monitoring and early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the field of fatigue driving detection, and discloses a method and a system for monitoring and early warning of fatigue driving, which can monitor the fatigue state of a driver in real time; and processing the acquired data to obtain an index MI and blood oxygen saturation SrO for measuring the fatigue degree of the driver  2  And indexes such as eye closure index EI, and judging fatigue driving through multiple indexesThe method can improve monitoring precision, then analyzes the comprehensive fatigue index and the eye closure index EI according to a driver fatigue state decision function, judges and grades the fatigue driving of the driver, and sends out early warning of different degrees to the driver based on different fatigue grades if the driver is judged to be in a fatigue driving state, so that the method has a more reasonable and humanized early warning mechanism.

title_en: Noninvasive measuring method for relative pressure in athlete heart left ventricle
abstract_en: The invention relates to a noninvasive measurement method of relative pressure in the left ventricle of a heart of an athlete, which comprises the following steps of S1, carrying out transthoracic echocardiography examination, and configuring and storing images by utilizing a blood flow vector imaging technology; s2, manually setting an endocardial boundary in an isovolumetric diastole P0, and tracking endocardial boundaries of other frames; s3, setting a sampling line with a fixed length, and acquiring a relative pressure difference IVPD between the center tip and the substrate by using the sampling line; s4, drawing an IVPD-time curve chart; s5, determining an isovolumetric diastole phase P0, a rapid filling phase P1, an atrial systole phase P4, an isovolumetric systole phase P6, a rapid ejection phase P7 and a late contraction phase P8; and S6, calculating the relative pressure. The invention can realize the nondestructive measurement of athletes and improve the convenience of measurement.

title_en: High-flow oxygen inhalation combination device for preventing generation of bioaerosol
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of breathing apparatuses, in particular to a high-flow oxygen inhalation combined device for preventing generation of biological aerosol. The device mainly comprises a high-flow oxygen inhalation jaw supporting mask and a medical atomizer which is adapted to high-flow oxygen inhalation, wherein the high-flow oxygen inhalation jaw supporting mask comprises a mask body and a high-flow oxygen hose. The front side of the mask body protrudes outwards and has a radian matched with the nose of a human body, the mask body is provided with an air bag along the outline, the air bag is tightly attached to the face, and the air bag positioned at the lower jaw is also provided with a lower jaw supporting pad; a drainage tube fixing opening is formed in the side part of the mask body, and a silica gel film covers the drainage tube fixing opening; the head part of the high-flow oxygen hose is provided with a nose plug, the nose plug hole is positioned inside the mask body, the high-flow oxygen hose extends to the outside of the mask body, and the tail part of the high-flow oxygen hose is provided with an oxygen inlet interface which is externally connected with a medical atomizer. The invention can reduce mouth breathing of patients, improve comfort and facilitate aerosol inhalation administration.

title_en: Electrosurgical instrument
abstract_en: The present invention relates to electrosurgical instruments. An electrosurgical instrument, in particular a scissor-type vascular sealer, comprises two overmolded jaws formed from a structural polymer, which are held in place by pivot pins. Molded structural polymers replace many of the metal parts that would otherwise be required for such an assembly. In addition, a stiffening member can be positioned within the jaws of the instrument to provide support. The use of molded structural polymers not only simplifies the assembly of the device, but also accomplishes the following additional functions: the pivot holes, flanges to provide lateral support, and flexible lever arms intended to provide the force required to clamp and seal the vessel are molded.

title_en: Sawtooth hair taking device based on no-shaving technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sawtooth hair taking device based on a hair shaving technology, which comprises a hair taking device main body, wherein one side of the bottom of the hair taking device main body is fixedly connected with an installation plate, one side of the back of the installation plate is fixedly connected with a driving motor, the output end of the driving motor is provided with a rotating rod, the front end of the rotating rod is fixedly connected with a driving gear, and one side of the surface of the driving gear is connected with a transmission belt in a meshing manner. According to the hair follicle harvesting needle, the mounting plate, the driving motor, the rotating rod, the driving gear, the driving belt, the hair follicle harvesting needle body, the rotating gear and the connecting rod are arranged, the output end of the driving motor drives the rotating rod to rotate, the rotating rod drives the driving gear at the front end to rotate, the driving gear drives the driving belt connected with the surface in a meshed mode to rotate, three symmetrical hair follicle harvesting needle bodies are arranged on the surface of the driving belt, hair follicles can be conveniently taken out when the hair follicle harvesting needle body is used, and the hair follicle harvesting needle is provided with a plurality of hair harvesting needle bodies, so that the effect of rapidly harvesting the hair follicles is achieved.

title_en: Patient main index construction method, system, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a patient main index construction method, a system, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring all patient information in a plurality of medical information systems, wherein each piece of patient information comprises a plurality of relevant attributes; setting one of the related attributes as an identification attribute; based on the identification attribute, carrying out preliminary combination on the patient information to obtain a preliminary combination result; acquiring an analysis model, and analyzing a plurality of related attributes in all patient information by adopting the analysis model to acquire a similarity threshold of each related attribute; acquiring a total similarity score of each relevant attribute in the preliminary merging result based on the similarity threshold of each relevant attribute; acquiring a similar total score threshold, and merging the preliminary merging results again based on the similar total score threshold and the similar total score; constructing a patient main index based on the merged patient information; the information of the patient in the medical system is merged, and the effect of disordered information of the patient is solved.

title_en: Epidemic prevention information interaction device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an epidemic prevention information interaction device which comprises an information brushing device, wherein the information brushing device comprises a microprocessor and a data output module, and further comprises a wireless information transmission module, a built-in memory, a wireless charging module and a power module, wherein the power module is connected with a printed circuit board through a connecting wire, the wireless charging module is connected with the power module through a connecting wire, the output end of the wireless information transmission module is connected with the input end of the microprocessor, the output end of the microprocessor is connected with the input end of the data output module, the microprocessor is bidirectionally connected with the built-in memory through a data wire, and the information brushing device is connected with an external system.

title_en: Lifting guardrail with buffer assembly and alarm assembly, guardrail device and sickbed
abstract_en: The application relates to a lifting guardrail of a buffer assembly and an alarm assembly, a guardrail device and a sickbed, wherein the guardrail device comprises two lifting guardrails which are symmetrically arranged, the two lifting guardrails are respectively arranged on two sides of a bed body, and the lifting guardrails comprise: the support plate that two upper and lower set up, two backup pad both ends slidable mounting are on vertical slide rail, are provided with extension spring, railing between two backup pads and control the screw rod that the backup pad on upper portion goes up and down, and the railing is connected with the backup pad that can control upper portion and the guard roll that goes up and down thereof, and is provided with audible-visual annunciator on the bed body, is provided with the conductive contact piece that can communicate audible-visual annunciator in slide rail and the backup pad on upper portion. The application can avoid the direct collision between the patient and the guardrail and can play the role of alarm.

title_en: Automatic balancing method for burden difference and medical resources of children tumor diseases
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic balancing method for burden difference and medical resources of children tumor diseases, which comprises the following steps: acquiring child disease diagnosis data based on a medical insurance database, and screening the disease diagnosis data to obtain child tumor disease data; analyzing the children tumor disease data, determining a children tumor disease frequency index and a medical resource utilization index, and determining the burden difference of the children tumor disease; and formulating a medical resource balancing strategy based on the burden difference of the children tumor diseases, and balancing the medical resources of the children tumor diseases based on the medical resource balancing strategy. The frequency index of the tumor diseases of the children and the utilization index of the medical resources are accurately and effectively analyzed, so that the burden difference of the diseases is accurately obtained, and the medical resources are effectively balanced through the burden difference, so that the burden of the diseases and the medical resources are effectively balanced, and the utilization effect of the medical resources is guaranteed.

title_en: Lumbar puncture nursing rehabilitation device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of orthopedic nursing, in particular to a lumbar puncture nursing rehabilitation device which comprises a lying plate, wherein a leg lifting unit is arranged on the lower part of the upper surface of the lying plate, an ankle moving unit arranged on the lying plate is arranged below the leg lifting unit, a toe-back stretching unit is arranged on the ankle moving unit, lifting racks on two sides can be lifted up at the lower side through the rotation of a lifting rotating rod, so that the leg lifting and lifting movement of a patient in a full-body horizontal position can be conveniently realized when the patient is subjected to lumbar puncture in a nursing rehabilitation process, a driving motor is arranged, the driving motor in front of an adjusting plate is started, the output end of the driving motor rotates to drive a supporting plate to rotate, so that the ankle movement of the patient is conveniently realized in a nursing rehabilitation stage after the lumbar puncture, and the left-right rotation range of the steering plate can be realized through the length adjustment of the electric expansion plate, so that the ankle movement force different from that the patient does not move at the ankle.

title_en: PLGA composite oral barrier membrane and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a PLGA composite oral cavity barrier membrane, which comprises a PLGA ultrasonic spray coating membrane and a PLGA electrostatic spinning membrane, wherein a composite oral cavity barrier membrane with a double-sided structure is formed between the PLGA ultrasonic spray coating membrane and the PLGA electrostatic spinning membrane in a cold pressing mode, the fiber diameter range of the PLGA electrostatic spinning membrane is 900-3500 nm, the range of pores among fibers is 25-92 mu m, and the thickness is 350-500 mm; has better mechanical property yield strength, can play a role of barrier, prevent soft tissues from growing into a bone regeneration area, provide space required by bone tissue regeneration, promote the full regeneration of bone formation tissues and improve the bone regeneration amount.

title_en: Targeted varicose sock comfortable to wear and capable of being finely adjusted
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of air covered wires, in particular to a pair of varicose socks which are comfortable to wear and can be finely adjusted in a targeted manner, wherein the socks comprise sock bodies which extend from thighs to ankles of lower legs or are connected with feet, and the sock bodies are formed by combining first fabric structural parts and second fabric structural parts in a staggered arrangement mode; the first and second panel structures have different elastic strengths, and the elasticity of the first panel structure is less than the elasticity of the second panel structure, and the area of the first panel structure is greater than the area of the second panel structure at the portion above the knee, and the area of the first panel structure is less than the area of the second panel structure at the portion below the knee. The varicose sock is comfortable to wear, and can keep a good varicose treatment effect; in addition, the sock is comfortable to wear and not easy to slip off, and meanwhile, fine adjustment can be performed according to actual use conditions.

title_en: DRG reference point number correction rationality evaluation and prediction method based on CC big data
abstract_en: The invention relates to a DRG reference point correction rationality evaluation and prediction method based on CC big data, belonging to the field of medical insurance informatization management and data processing methods.

title_en: Water-absorbent resin composition, absorber, and absorbent article
abstract_en: The present application relates to a water-absorbent resin composition which suppresses acetaldehyde odor and suppresses coloring with time. A water-absorbent resin composition comprising a hydrazide compound carrier and a water-absorbent resin, wherein the yellowness of the water-absorbent resin composition when 2.0g of the water-absorbent resin composition is kept at a temperature of 70 ℃ for 7 days in an environment having a relative humidity of 90% is 10 or less, and the acetaldehyde concentration measured when 900ml of nitrogen gas having an acetaldehyde concentration of 20ppm and 10.0g of the water-absorbent resin composition is enclosed in a sealed bag having a capacity of 2 liters and the acetaldehyde concentration of the gas in the sealed bag after 1 hour is measured is 15ppm or less.

title_en: Hemostatic clamping device under endoscope
abstract_en: The invention provides a hemostatic clamping device under an endoscope, which comprises a clamping head component, a conveying component and a control component. The chuck component comprises a clamping piece and a chuck seat. The clamping piece is provided with a first matching part, and the clamping seat is provided with a first matching part which are matched to keep the clamping piece in a closed state. The conveying assembly comprises a linkage assembly, a connecting piece and an outer pipe assembly, a second matching piece is arranged on the connecting piece, and a second matching part is arranged on the clamping seat. The linkage assembly is also provided with a third matching piece, and the connecting piece is provided with a third matching part. The operating assembly comprises a handle, a first operating member and a second operating member. The hemostatic clamping device provided by the invention has the advantages of small number of parts, simple structure and stable connection, and each part has multiple functions. The hemostatic clipping device of the invention can realize the functions of repeated opening, closing, rotation and the like of the hemostatic clipping device with simple results. And the hemostatic clamping device is easy for industrial production, and the production process cost and the quality control cost are greatly reduced.

title_en: Wound orthopedics tractive device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wound orthopaedics traction device, belonging to the technical field of orthopaedics medical equipment, comprising: the device comprises two traction mechanisms and a bearing plate, wherein one end of each traction mechanism is connected with a first clamping assembly, the other end of each traction mechanism is connected to a fixed plate, a movable plate is arranged on the fixed plate in a sliding mode, a fixed rod is arranged on each of two sides of the fixed plate, one end of the bearing plate is connected to the movable plate in a rotating mode, the two traction mechanisms are symmetrically arranged on two sides of the bearing plate, and the bearing plate is provided with a second clamping assembly in a sliding mode; each traction mechanism comprises a traction pipe, an adjusting pipe and a fixing pipe, one end of the traction pipe is connected with the first clamping assembly, one end of the adjusting pipe is movably sleeved at the other end of the traction pipe, the other end of the adjusting pipe is connected to one end of the fixing pipe, and the other end of the fixing pipe is connected to the fixing plate. The traction device has good stability, the traction force of the traction mechanism is adjusted, effective traction is guaranteed, the safety of the traction device is high, and the fracture healing efficiency of the wound is improved.

title_en: Bionic cornea and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a bionic cornea and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of biology. The invention provides a bionic cornea, which is prepared from the raw material of polyethylene glycol collagen, wherein the polyethylene glycol collagen comprises collagen-like protein and PEG-40k and PEG-20k modified on the collagen-like protein; the PEG-40k and PEG-20k can obviously improve the crosslinking performance of the collagen-like protein by modification, so that the strength of the cornea is improved by nearly 20 times compared with the strength of the cornea made of the collagen-like protein and by nearly 12 times compared with the strength of the cornea made of other polyethylene glycol collagen-like proteins, therefore, the cornea has a great application prospect in the field of corneal transplantation. The molar ratio of PEG-40k to PEG-20k is 2-3; the effect of PEG modification for improving the cross-linking performance of the collagen-like protein is better under the condition of the molar ratio, and the strength of the cornea can be further improved.

title_en: Water injection containing box that expander was used
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water injection containing box for an expander, which comprises a box body, an injector, a positioning assembly, injection bottles and a clamping assembly, wherein a detachable partition plate is arranged inside the box body, the box body is divided into an upper cavity and a lower cavity, a second cushion is arranged on the bottom wall of the lower cavity of the box body, a first cushion is arranged on the top surface of the partition plate, cotton swabs, the injector and the clamping assembly are placed on the first cushion, the bottom of the positioning assembly can be covered on an injection port of the head of a patient, the front end of the injector can be inserted into the top of the positioning assembly, and a plurality of injection bottles are distributed on the second cushion in an array manner.

title_en: Hair follicle transplantation device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hair follicle transplanting device which comprises a rear cover, a central shaft, an outer sleeve component and an implanting component, wherein the implanting component, the central shaft and the outer sleeve component are coaxially arranged in sequence from inside to outside; the rear end of the central shaft is in threaded connection with the central shaft mounting groove; the outer sleeve component comprises a front adjusting sleeve, an external thread outer sleeve and an internal thread outer sleeve, the outer sleeve component is sleeved outside the central shaft, and the front end of the front adjusting sleeve is in threaded connection with the middle of the central shaft; the implant assembly comprises a needle tube, a needle seat, a spring, a lining core and a lining core seat. The hair follicle transplanting device has the advantages of simple structure, smooth operation, high safety, small wound, quick planting and the like, can greatly improve the planting efficiency, and saves the operation time and cost.

title_en: Vomitus collecting barrel for digestive tract tumor patient
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vomit collecting barrel for digestive tract tumor patients, which comprises a collecting box, an air curtain type vomit collecting mechanism and a self-sealing type collecting mechanism, wherein the air curtain type vomit collecting mechanism is arranged on one side of the collecting box, the air curtain type vomit collecting mechanism comprises a conical flow guide part, one side, positioned in the collecting box, of the conical flow guide part is connected with a flow guide pipe, and a limiting fixing ring is connected in the flow guide pipe. According to the vomit collecting barrel for the digestive tract tumor patient, the corresponding mechanism is arranged on the vomit collecting barrel for the digestive tract tumor patient, so that the vomit of the digestive tract tumor patient can be contained in a sealed manner, the using effect of the vomit collecting barrel for the digestive tract tumor patient is remarkably improved, the convenience for cleaning the vomit collecting barrel for the digestive tract tumor patient is greatly simplified, the condition that the vomit collecting barrel for the digestive tract tumor patient which is not cleaned pollutes the environment is avoided, and the working intensity of medical staff for cleaning the vomit of the digestive tract tumor patient is greatly reduced.

title_en: Medical medicine fumigating device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a medical fumigation device which comprises a placement seat, wherein two handles are fixedly connected to the placement seat, a plurality of air outlet holes are formed in the placement seat, a lifting assembly is arranged on the placement seat, and a heat insulation assembly is connected to the placement seat. According to the invention, a worker inserts the storage cylinder into the placement seat, so that the heating column, the flow guide pipe, the water pipe and the second water pipe are respectively inserted into the storage cylinder, further the medicine liquid in the storage cylinder can be used, the worker can start the heating column through the controller, so that the medicine liquid in the storage cylinder can be heated, the worker can directly start the atomizer through the controller, so that the medicine liquid can be atomized, and meanwhile, the worker can start the motor through the controller, further the atomized gas can be sprayed onto the body of a patient, further the body of the patient can be fumigated, and therefore, the waist and abdomen of the patient can be treated.

title_en: Valve conveying device and artificial heart valve conveying system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a valve conveying device and a system, wherein the conveying device comprises a core pipe assembly and an outer sheath pipe; the core tube assembly comprises an inner sheath tube and a middle sheath tube, the far end of the inner sheath tube penetrates out of the far end of the middle sheath tube, and the far end of the inner sheath tube is provided with a guide head; the far end of the middle sheath tube is provided with a mounting head which is used for fixing the artificial heart valve; a valve assembling section is arranged between the guide head and the mounting head; the valve assembling section is at least provided with a supporting element at the near end, the supporting element extends towards the middle part of the valve assembling section in a bulging shape, can be axially inserted into the compressed artificial heart valve and radially supports the artificial heart valve. The valve conveying device provided by the invention can prevent the artificial heart valve from generating folds after being compressed, and ensure that the valve stent can be smoothly expanded when being released.

title_en: Herbal pieces-processingequipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of traditional Chinese medicine processing, and discloses a traditional Chinese medicine decoction piece processing device which comprises a pressing table, wherein a partition plate is movably arranged at the top end of the pressing table, a first powder pushing bag is fixedly arranged at the bottom of an inner cavity of the partition plate, and fixing blocks are fixedly arranged at two ends of the first powder pushing bag. According to the invention, the first powder pushing bag and the second powder pushing bag are arranged, so that the splashed traditional Chinese medicine powder is completely pushed into the material pressing cavity of the pressing table, the effect of complete feeding and filling is achieved, the feeding efficiency is greatly improved, the traditional Chinese medicine powder adhered to the sieve holes is vibrated down by arranging the pushing block, and the traditional Chinese medicine powder quickly passes through the sieve holes under the vibration effect to fall and be fed, so that the feeding efficiency of the traditional Chinese medicine powder is effectively improved, and the impact effect generated by the isolation plate is relieved by arranging the isolation plate, the first powder pushing bag and the second powder pushing bag, so that the impact of the isolation plate on the medicine blocks is effectively relieved, and the problem that the medicine blocks are loose in shape and damaged due to over-heavy impact is avoided.

title_en: Elderly Parkinson assisted exercise training method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an elderly Parkinson assisted exercise training method and an elderly Parkinson assisted exercise training system, wherein the elderly Parkinson assisted exercise training method comprises a control module, an acquisition module, a display module and an analysis module, wherein the control module is respectively in communication connection with the acquisition module, the display module and the analysis module; the collection module comprises: the system comprises a first acquisition unit, a second acquisition unit and a third acquisition unit; the analysis module comprises: a first analysis unit and a second analysis unit. According to the technical scheme, the elderly Parkinson patients can perform exercise training with the same exercise grade by themselves without professional coaches, so that the elderly Parkinson patients can perform exercise training without the professional coaches, the requirements of the elderly Parkinson patients are met, and the labor cost is reduced.

title_en: Concentric tube surgical robot based on gear tube
abstract_en: The application is suitable for the field of medical instruments, and discloses a gear tube-based concentric tube surgical robot which comprises three driving assemblies and concentric tubes, wherein the concentric tubes comprise outer tubes, middle tubes and inner tubes, and the three driving assemblies are respectively used for driving the outer tubes, the middle tubes and the inner tubes to rotate and move; each driving assembly comprises two rotary driving devices, a first internal rotation gear, a second internal rotation gear and a gear pipe, wherein the first internal rotation gear and the second internal rotation gear are sleeved outside the gear pipe, the rotating directions of threads inside the first internal rotation gear and the second internal rotation gear are opposite, and the two rotary driving devices are respectively used for driving the first internal rotation gear and the second internal rotation gear to rotate; the outer pipe, the middle pipe and the inner pipe are respectively connected with gear pipes of the three driving components. The rotation directions of the threads in the first internal rotation gear and the second internal rotation gear are opposite, and the first internal rotation gear and the second internal rotation gear are sleeved outside the gear tube, so that the gear tube obtains two degrees of freedom of translation and rotation in the rotation process of the first internal rotation gear and the second internal rotation gear, and the concentric tube is driven to move.

title_en: Ankle patient is with tensile trainer of rehabilitation
abstract_en: The invention provides a rehabilitation stretching training device for ankle patients, which relates to the technical field of stretching training and comprises the following components: the assembling device comprises an assembling underframe, four groups of spring rods A are fixedly arranged at the top of the assembling underframe, and rotary convex shafts are integrally arranged in the middles of two sides of the assembling underframe; the upper connecting frame and the assembly underframe are in the same shape, oil paths are arranged inside the upper connecting frame and the assembly underframe, and the upper connecting frame is communicated with the oil path arrangement pipeline of the assembly underframe; set up spring beam B, the effect of omnidirectional training is provided, fix foot through tying up the binder, and then tie up the spring beam B that the binder outside is connected and spacing piece that hinders provides the effect of two-way bounce-back, can be used for training the ankle, flexible hydro-cylinder A, revolving rack and revolving block constitute the universal shaft, can realize the quick adjustment of multi-angle, for training provide convenient, can provide the exercise effect in each position around about from top to bottom, the problem of the effect that current trainer lacks the omnidirectional training has been solved.

title_en: Fracture reduction mechanism for minimally invasive pelvic fracture surgery
abstract_en: A fracture reduction mechanism for minimally invasive pelvic fracture surgery comprises a supporting assembly, a driving assembly, a self-rotating clamping assembly and a side-strengthening fixing assembly, wherein the driving assembly comprises a synchronous rotating module, a first lead screw module, a second lead screw module, a third lead screw module and an arc-shaped guide rail module; the mechanism is connected with the operating bed through bedside guide rails on two sides of the operating bed to form a frame type closed structure, and the supporting component and the side fixing component are connected with the bedside guide rails in a sliding mode. Through the linear movement distance and the fixed-axis rotation angle of the mechanism which are manually adjusted, the six-degree-of-freedom translation and rotation of the pelvic fracture block can be realized. The mechanism has the advantages of high rigidity and load capacity, good portability, simple assembly and operation and high movement precision, the movement center of the mechanism is a space virtual point, and the position of the mechanism can be adjusted according to the position of a patient and the type of fracture, thereby providing convenience for the operation.

title_en: Device for leakage detection of anastomotic stoma in colorectal resection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device for leakage detection of an anastomotic stoma in colorectal resection, which comprises a mounting pipe and a first connecting pipe, wherein one end of the mounting pipe is fixedly sleeved with a four-way connector, one side of the outer wall of the mounting pipe is provided with a side hole, a blocking mechanism is arranged on the mounting pipe and used for sealing and blocking the anastomotic stoma of a patient during leakage detection, a display positioning assembly is arranged inside the mounting pipe, the blocking mechanism comprises two sealing air bags, an air inlet pipe and a second connecting pipe, the sealing air bags are fixedly sleeved at one end of the outer wall of the mounting pipe, and the two sealing air bags are positioned at two sides of the side hole. The installation pipe, the first connecting pipe and the blocking mechanism are used in a matched mode, the side hole is formed in one side of the outer wall of the installation pipe and is located between the two sealing air bags, so that the installation pipe is inserted into the anastomotic opening, the two sealing air bags are located on the two sides of the anastomotic opening, air is filled into the installation pipe, and whether the anastomotic opening leaks or not can be observed.

title_en: Target development condition analysis method based on model prediction
abstract_en: The application provides a target development condition analysis method based on model prediction, which is mainly used for predicting the development condition of solid tumors, an infrared space flow model, an infrared time flow model, a fault space flow model and a fault time flow model are constructed through near-infrared images and fault scanning images, and image data information is converted into time dimension data of interval periods, so that the image data of two different principle imaging have comparability, mutual verification can be carried out, and the scientificity and the accuracy of model prediction can be favorably ensured. Meanwhile, a plurality of models constructed by the method all adopt related image data of the tumor to be detected, are different from a common big data graph modeling mode at present, and have stronger individual pertinence in the aspects of image recognition precision and target development prediction accuracy.

title_en: Atomized nanometer leading-in instrument
abstract_en: The invention provides an atomization nanometer leading-in instrument which comprises a shell, a control module and a leading-in module; a movable groove is arranged in the shell; the control module is positioned on the outer side of the shell and comprises a controller, a power supply, a motor driving unit and an atomizer driving unit, and the power supply, the motor driving unit and the atomizer driving unit are all electrically connected with the power supply; the leading-in module includes the stock solution chamber, the atomizing electrode, the atomizing piece, lead the fog chamber, movable part and nanometer micropin structure, movable part's one end is connected with motor drive unit, the other end is deepened into the movable groove, but reciprocating motion, nanometer micropin structure is fixed in movable part's one end, the stock solution chamber with lead the one side that the fog chamber is located the casing, and the export that leads the fog chamber is adjacent with nanometer micropin structure, the atomizing piece is located the opening part in stock solution chamber, and with lead the fog chamber adjacent, the atomizing electrode is connected with atomizing piece and atomizer drive unit. The invention can avoid the influence of chemical agents on the nano microneedle structure and is beneficial to promoting the absorption of the chemical agents by the skin.

title_en: Semi-supervised learning using co-training of radiology reports and medical images
abstract_en: A method (100) of training a Machine Learning (ML) image classifier (14) to classify an image (30) as corresponding to a set of labels, comprising: generating image-based tags for the image and image-based tag confidence values for the image-based tags from the set of tags by applying the ML image classifier to the image; generating report-based tags for the image and report-based tag confidence values for the report-based tags from the set of tags by applying a report classifier (16) to corresponding radiology reports; selecting a training subset of the set of images based on the image-based label, the report-based label, the image-based label confidence value, and the report-based label confidence value; assigning a pseudo label to each image of the training subset, the pseudo label being one of an image-based label or a report-based label of the image; and training the ML image classifier using at least the selected training subset and the assigned pseudo labels.

title_en: Adjustable body position frame for spine nursing
abstract_en: The invention relates to a body position frame, in particular to an adjustable body position frame for spinal care. The invention aims to provide an adjustable body position frame for spinal care, which is more convenient to operate and can save labor consumption. The invention provides an adjustable body position frame for spine care, which comprises a bedstead, a fixed lying plate and a movable lying plate, wherein one side of the top of the bedstead is connected with the fixed lying plate, the fixed lying plate is rotatably connected with the movable lying plate, the adjustable body position frame also comprises a supporting plate and a movable supporting plate, the tops of the fixed lying plate and the movable lying plate are rotatably connected with the supporting plate, and one sides of the two supporting plates, which are close to each other, are rotatably connected with the movable supporting plate. When the patient needs to lie on the side and leak out of the back for examination, the two support plates can be driven to rotate only by starting the gear motor to prop up the patient to a lying state, the operation is simpler, a plurality of medical staff are not needed to operate, and the labor consumption can be saved.

title_en: Operating bed
abstract_en: The application provides an operating table, which comprises a seat plate assembly, a back plate assembly, a waist bridge device, a leg plate frame, a leg plate power unit and a back plate power unit; the seat plate component comprises a seat plate and a seat plate cross beam; the backboard component comprises a backboard and a backboard cross beam, and the backboard cross beam is hinged with the seat board cross beam; the waist bridge device comprises a waist bridge plate and a waist bridge driving assembly, and the waist bridge plate is positioned above the back plate cross beam; leg board power pack and backplate power pack all set up in the seat crossbeam, and waist bridge drive assembly sets up in the backplate crossbeam. The operating bed provided by the embodiment of the application can fully utilize the space of the seat plate cross beam; under the condition of realizing the configuration of the electric leg plate and the electric back plate, the thickness dimension of the cross beam of the seat plate in the vertical direction can be reduced, thereby weakening the influence of overlarge thickness of the cross beam of the seat plate on the standing position of medical personnel and the left and right inclination angle of an operating bed; because waist bridge plate sets up in backplate crossbeam top, consequently the position of waist bridge plate removes to the head end, and patient's waist that lifts that can be more accurate accords with the operation position and expects.

title_en: Sleep apnea frequency metering method based on multiple parameters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sleep apnea frequency measuring method based on multiple parameters, which comprises the steps of recording sleep time, respectively obtaining heart rate, blood oxygen concentration and micro acceleration of a human body during the sleep time, dividing an analysis time period by taking the blood oxygen concentration as a condition, respectively giving different weight values of the heart rate, the blood oxygen concentration and the micro acceleration in the analysis time period to form heart rate weight, blood oxygen weight and acceleration weight according to the state of the human body, obtaining sleep stage weight according to the sleep time, and when the comprehensive indexes of the heart rate weight, the blood oxygen weight, the acceleration weight and the sleep stage weight exceed a set calculation threshold value, regarding the analysis time period as an apnea event and marking, and finally counting the total number of marks in the sleep time. The invention provides a multi-parameter-based sleep apnea frequency metering method, which is used for obtaining an index which is short in calculation flow, easy in calculation mode and capable of judging the apnea frequency in a relatively balanced manner under the condition that the sleep quality of a patient is not influenced.

title_en: Arthralgia alleviates device based on hypodermic injection cytarabine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a joint pain relieving device based on subcutaneous cytarabine injection, which relates to the technical field of medical auxiliary equipment and comprises a simulation shoulder, wherein the upper end of the simulation shoulder is provided with a simulation neck, the simulation shoulder and the simulation neck are provided with a driving component, a massage component and an auxiliary hot compress component on the same horizontal plane, when an elliptical sliding block slides back and forth on an arc I-shaped groove body, the elliptical sliding block is elliptical, the elliptical sliding block can gradually approach and push a massage column inserted on an annular butt joint groove body in movement, at the moment, a spring connected with the massage column through a flat sheet can be compressed, the massage column can approach and butt against the simulation neck under the pushing of the elliptical sliding block, so that the joint at the simulation neck can be pressed when a patient walks, the arrangement can effectively massage the patient to a certain extent when the patient walks, the severe pain feeling of the patient when the patient walks can be relieved, the motion situation of the patient is avoided, and the recovery of the patient is facilitated.

title_en: Device for filtering embolic material in vascular system
abstract_en: An embolic protection device for transvascular delivery to an aortic arch to protect a collateral vessel of the aortic arch against embolic material, comprising: a support frame; a filter member attached to the support frame and configured to prevent the embolic material from flowing with blood flow into a collateral vessel of the aortic arch; and a patch or sheet attaching the filter member to the proximal and/or distal end of the support frame, so that the proximal and/or distal end of the support frame may be free from the restriction of the filter member or glue, which may be more effective.

title_en: Method and system for generating digital reconstructed radiological image
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for generating a digital reconstructed radiogram, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a three-dimensional image of a patient, designing weights in corresponding orthographic projection ray transmission functions according to different operation targets, wherein the weights of operation target areas are larger than those of other tissues, and carrying out orthographic projection through an orthographic projection model according to the obtained orthographic projection ray transmission functions to obtain the digital reconstructed radiogram. According to the invention, different orthographic projection ray transfer functions are designed according to different surgical targets, so that the orthographic projection process focuses on the surgical target structure, the response in the ray transfer functions can be dynamically adjusted, and DRR images meeting the requirements of the surgical process can be obtained through multiple iterations.

title_en: Medical endoscope light guide optical fiber gluing process
abstract_en: The invention provides a gluing process of a light guide optical fiber of a medical endoscope, and relates to the field of medical instruments. The gluing process of the light guide optical fiber of the medical endoscope specifically comprises the following steps: s1, assembling a mirror body. When the process method provided by the invention is used, the bonding strength of the optical fiber wire and the endoscope body of the medical endoscope can be greatly improved, the temperature resistance, the impact resistance and the corrosion resistance of the endoscope are greatly improved, the damage to the endoscope caused by high-temperature, high-pressure and low-temperature plasma sterilization is greatly reduced, the sterilization frequency and time are reduced, the possibility of water seepage and corrosion of the endoscope is greatly reduced, the service life of the endoscope is greatly prolonged, the infiltration of an adhesive can be enhanced and ensured, the outer endoscope tube, the inner endoscope tube and the optical fiber wire can be tightly adhered, and the drip irrigation is specified in a certain temperature environment, so that the optical fiber wire can effectively and greatly infiltrate into the inside, the adhesion density, the saturation and the effectiveness are ensured, and the occurrence of air bubbles and air leakage is reduced.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and storage medium for double-end detection of fetal heart rate
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for detecting a fetal heart rate at two ends, which are a method for detecting the fetal heart rate based on a fetal heart signal section to be detected to obtain an instantaneous fetal heart rate, and concretely comprises the steps of acquiring a signal envelope section and a sampling frequency of the fetal heart signal section to be detected, respectively detecting local maxima of the signal envelope section in two directions of sequence and reverse sequence by taking two ends of the signal envelope section as starting points to obtain a first maximum value set and a second maximum value set, extracting target local maxima from the first maximum value set and the second maximum value set, calculating the fetal heart rate according to the target local maxima and the sampling frequency to obtain the instantaneous fetal heart rate, and analyzing the signal envelope of the acquired fetal heart signal to be detected, so that the calculated amount is greatly reduced, and the heart beat time of a more accurate fetal heart signal is obtained by respectively detecting the two different directions from two ends of the envelope signal section.

title_en: Pelvic floor muscle detection trainer and massager
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pelvic floor muscle detection trainer which comprises a body, a pressure detector and a prompter, wherein the pressure detector is distributed on the body and used for detecting the muscle relaxation of pelvic floor muscles and the muscle pressure of the pelvic floor muscles in the training process, the prompter is arranged in the body and used for detecting prompts or training prompts, a control board electrically connected with the pressure detector and the prompter is arranged in the body, the control board is electrically connected with a power supply arranged in the body, a function key electrically connected with the control board is arranged on the body, and a skin-friendly touch elastic material layer is coated outside the body. The invention also discloses a massager, which comprises the pelvic floor muscle detection trainer. Compared with the prior art, through set up pressure detector and prompting device on the body, realize that the house can carry out the self-detection to pelvic floor muscle to and realize the training suggestion through the prompting device, with the time of carrying out the accurate autonomic training of science, reduction hospital of making a round trip.

title_en: Fine-adjustment type bone position forced orthosis
