abstract_en: The invention discloses a fine adjustment type forced orthopedic device for bone positions, which comprises two bases, wherein the outer walls of the bases are provided with mounting grooves, an inflation pump assembly and a thin tube are arranged in the mounting grooves, fine adjustment air cushions are arranged on the arc surfaces of the bases, a plurality of forced traction ropes are arranged at the top ends of the two bases, the lower ends of the two bases are rotatably connected with two fine adjustment rods, an air discharge tube is arranged at the left end of each fine adjustment air cushion, an inflation tube is arranged in the middle of the outer wall of each fine adjustment air cushion, the end part of the inflation tube is arranged in a downward inclined mode and penetrates through one side wall of the arc surface of the base to extend into the mounting groove, the inner wall of the inflation tube is in sleeve fit with the outer wall of the thin tube, the legs of a patient are fixed between the two bases through the arranged bases, the widths between the two bases are adjusted through rotating the two fine adjustment rods, different patients can fix the legs conveniently to be orthopedic, and the legs of the patients are fixed and protected through the fine adjustment air cushions which are adhered on the bases.

title_en: Dressing comprising first and second release liners
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a dressing (100) comprising a backing layer (101), an adhesive skin contact layer (102) and a first release liner (103), wherein the adhesive skin contact layer (102) comprises a central portion (102 a) and an edge portion (102 b) surrounding the central portion (102 a). The first release liner (103) is configured to releasably adhere to at least a central portion (102 a) of the adhesive skin contact layer (102). The dressing (100) comprises a second release liner (104) arranged between the first release liner (103) and at least a part of the edge portion (102 b) of the adhesive skin contact layer (102).

title_en: Telescopic blood oxygen line
abstract_en: The invention provides a telescopic blood oxygen line, and relates to the technical field of medical instruments. The utility model provides a scalable type blood oxygen line, includes blood oxygen line main part, the rotatory winding in surface of blood oxygen line main part is provided with flexible box, blood oxygen line main part includes outer tube layer, the inner wall of outer tube layer is fixed and is provided with the flexible layer, the inner wall of flexible layer is fixed and is provided with the heat-sink shell, the fixed filling layer that is provided with in inner wall of heat-sink shell, the fixed support column that is provided with in centre department of filling layer, the even fixed three elasticity of being provided with of surface of support column cuts apart the board, and is three the opposite side that the board was cut apart to elasticity all sets up with the heat-sink shell is fixed, and is three it is provided with the inner core layer all to fix between the board is cut apart to elasticity, flexible box includes the box shell, the up end joint of box shell is provided with the lid. Make blood oxygen line main part twine on fixed cylinder through rotatory handle, dead lever and fixing clip pole, carry out the flexible of different length.

title_en: Control circuitry for offline authentication in an aerosol-generating device
abstract_en: The invention proposes control circuitry for an aerosol-generating device. The aerosol-generating device has a locked state in which the aerosol-generating device is inhibited from delivering aerosol and an unlocked state in which the aerosol-generating device is permitted to deliver aerosol. The control circuitry is configured to receive user-entered authentication information from one or more user interface components. The control circuitry is configured to receive user-entered authentication information during a plurality of time windows of a predetermined duration, each time window corresponding to a respective number of a sequence of numbers forming the authentication information, and attribute user-entered data received during the time window via the user interface component to the number corresponding to the time window. The control circuitry is further configured to perform an offline authentication of the aerosol-generating device based on authentication information entered by the user and to determine to transition the aerosol-generating device from the locked state to the unlocked state based on a successful outcome of the offline authentication.

title_en: Air conditioner cleaning control method, air conditioner indoor unit, device, computer equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application relates to an air conditioner cleaning control method, an air conditioner indoor unit, a computer device and a medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining environmental parameters of the environment where the air conditioner is located, determining the demand of the antibacterial agent when the cleaning condition of the water receiving disc is met according to the accumulated operation time length and the environmental parameters of the air conditioner, determining the cleaning parameters of the air conditioner based on the demand of the antibacterial agent and a preset antibacterial agent precipitation coefficient, and controlling the operation cleaning mode of the air conditioner according to the cleaning parameters. By adopting the method, the cleaning effect of the water pan of the air conditioner can be effectively improved.

title_en: Cloud image data receiving and transmitting system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cloud image data receiving and transmitting system and a cloud image data receiving and transmitting method, which relate to the technical field of image data processing and comprise an image capturing module, a transmission module, an image processing module, a storage management module, a diagnosis and reference module and a data life cycle management module.

title_en: Nanometer fat preparation device and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of medical appliances, and particularly discloses a nano fat preparation device and a method, wherein the device comprises a converter, two screw injectors and automatic pushing equipment, the automatic pushing equipment comprises a base plate, a mounting clamping seat, a supporting arm, a push rod, a motor, a rotary table, a sliding block and a connecting rod, the base plate is fixedly connected with the two mounting clamping seats, the supporting arm is fixedly connected with the base plate, the supporting arm is fixedly connected with a guide shaft sleeve, the push rod is in sliding fit in the guide shaft sleeve, both ends of the push rod are connected with connecting arms, the connecting arms are fixedly connected with threaded sleeves, first screws are in threaded connection with the threaded sleeves, the end parts of the first screws are fixedly connected with connectors, the motor is fixedly arranged on the base plate, the rotary table is fixedly connected with an output shaft of the motor, the sliding block is in sliding connection with the rotary table, the sliding block is fixedly connected with a first connecting shaft, the push rod is fixedly connected with a second connecting shaft, both ends of the connecting rod are respectively rotatably sleeved on the first connecting shaft and the second connecting shaft.

title_en: Horizontal chinese-medicinal material infiltration jar and bearing structure are used in chinese-medicinal material processing
abstract_en: The invention provides a horizontal traditional Chinese medicine infiltration tank and a supporting structure for processing traditional Chinese medicine, which relate to the field of traditional Chinese medicine processing and comprise the following components: a support mechanism; a control mechanism is arranged in the supporting mechanism; an infiltration mechanism is arranged above the supporting mechanism; an adjusting mechanism is arranged on the outer side of the supporting mechanism; the lower end of the adjusting mechanism is provided with a pressure mechanism; the pressure piece can be pressed in the chinese-medicinal material top, and the chinese-medicinal material produces certain pressure, improves to accelerate the softening of chinese-medicinal material, and heating resistor heats the moisture of infiltration piece lower extreme, makes moisture temperature control be forty degrees centigrade to fifty degrees centigrade, and then influences the moisture temperature of infiltration piece upper end, accelerates the infiltration speed of medicinal material through suitable temperature, has solved current horizontal chinese-medicinal material infiltration jar and has needed longer infiltration time, makes the processing cycle of chinese-medicinal material very long, has reduced machining efficiency's problem by a wide margin.

title_en: Liquid filling device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of medical equipment, and discloses a liquid filling device which comprises a pushing device and a liquid storage device; the pushing device comprises an air cylinder, a first through hole is formed in the top of the air cylinder, a connecting rod is arranged in the air cylinder, a piston is arranged on the connecting rod, the piston is positioned in the air cylinder, and the connecting rod penetrates through the first through hole and extends out of the air cylinder; the liquid storage device comprises two groups of liquid feeders, and each group of liquid feeders comprises a right-angle guide pipe, a liquid storage device and a connecting pipe. By arranging the pushing device and the liquid storage device, gas is continuously fed into the liquid storage device, so that the pressure in the liquid storage device is kept stable, on one hand, liquid to be filled is pushed into a patient, and the gas is continuously pushed, so that the liquid can be completely pushed out of the liquid storage device until the patient is in the body, and no medicine waste is caused; on the other hand, the continuously pushed gas can keep the pressure in the device unchanged, and can prevent liquid from flowing back during liquid exchange, thereby causing harm to intestines and stomach and polluting the liquid filling device.

title_en: Methods, apparatus, and computer storage media for measuring tibial plateau caster angle
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides methods, apparatus, and computer storage media for measuring tibial plateau caster angles, including: preprocessing the acquired image to obtain input image data, wherein the image at least indicates the upper end of the tibia, and the upper end of the tibia is contacted with the femur; based on the input image data, obtaining coordinates of a plurality of points for the position prediction values of the tibial plateau anterior angle highest point, the tibial plateau posterior angle highest point, the tibial anterior cortical rim and the tibial posterior cortical rim through a prediction model constructed based on the deep learning model; and calculating a tibial plateau caster angle based on coordinates of a plurality of points for position prediction of the tibial plateau anterior angle highest point, the tibial plateau posterior angle highest point, the tibial anterior cortical rim, and the tibial posterior cortical rim. The method and the device can automatically measure the back tilt angle of the tibial plateau according to the knee joint side X-ray film, avoid measurement errors caused by different measurement standards, manual marking errors and other problems when the back tilt angle of the tibial plateau is manually measured, and improve measurement accuracy.

title_en: Swing type adult limb rehabilitation equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a swinging type adult limb rehabilitation device, which belongs to the technical field of limb rehabilitation devices, and is characterized in that the swinging type adult limb rehabilitation device comprises an arc-shaped chute arranged on the upper end face of an extension plate, the upper end face of the arc-shaped chute is connected with a sliding plate in a sliding manner through a sliding block, a through groove is formed in the upper end face of the fixing plate, two movable plates are connected in the through groove in a sliding manner through the sliding block, a trainer lies on the upper end face of the lying plate, two arms of the trainer are unfolded, the two hands are placed in grooves, then the two feet of the trainer are placed on the upper end face of the movable plates, the two heels are clamped in limit grooves, then the two arms and the hands of the trainer swing in an arc-shaped manner around the arc-shaped chute, and the feet of the trainer are forced to push the two movable plates to slide oppositely or reversely and in the same direction on the upper end face of the through groove, so that rehabilitation training of the upper limbs and lower limbs of the trainer is realized, and the medical care personnel or family staff is avoided.

title_en: Fetal cardiovascular physiological structure inspection method and device and ultrasonic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a fetal cardiovascular physiological structure examination method, a fetal cardiovascular physiological structure examination device, an ultrasonic device and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining a first measurement section of fetal cardiovascular physiological structure examination and a first measurement item in the first measurement section; the method comprises the steps of obtaining pregnancy parameters, determining a prediction model and an evaluation model corresponding to a first measurement item, wherein the pregnancy parameters comprise any one or a combination of any two of a pregnancy cycle, a double-top diameter and a femur long diameter, collecting a first measurement section, determining an actual value of the first measurement item in the first measurement section, predicting the prediction value corresponding to the first measurement item based on the pregnancy parameters by using the prediction model, calculating the evaluation value of the first measurement item based on the prediction value and the actual value by using the evaluation model, and obtaining an evaluation result of the first measurement item according to the evaluation value. The application satisfies the difference of different areas or different species, and improves the accuracy of fetal cardiovascular physiological structure examination.

title_en: Orthopedic joint effusion extraction equipment
abstract_en: Discloses a hydrops extraction device at an orthopedic joint. Firstly, a skin area image to be extracted liquid collected by a camera arranged at a joint effusion extracting device of orthopaedics is passed through an overexposure corrector to obtain a corrected skin area image, then the corrected skin area image is passed through a skin state feature extractor to obtain a skin state shallow feature image and a skin state deep feature image, then the skin state shallow feature image and the state deep feature image are fused to obtain a skin state feature image, and finally, the skin state feature image is passed through a classifier to obtain a classification result for indicating whether the liquid to be extracted liquid is suitable for liquid extraction. In this way, subsequent infections due to inadequate skin surface cleanliness can be prevented.

title_en: Dong medicine database capable of being matched rapidly and data retrieval method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of database structures for information retrieval, in particular to a quick-matching Dong medicine database and a data retrieval method. The Dong medicine database comprises: the data storage system stores the molecular formula of the existing medicine and the action target point thereof; the front-end data extraction system is used for acquiring a molecular formula to be searched and source Dong drugs of the molecular formula to be searched; the back-end data extraction system is used for determining related diseases of a molecular formula to be searched according to the source Dong medicine, determining action targets for treating the related diseases according to the related diseases to form a search target set, and screening the existing pharmaceutical molecular formulas with the action targets in the search target set from the data storage system to form an intermediate data set; a data comparison system for comparing the formula to be retrieved with the existing pharmaceutical formulas in the intermediate dataset to obtain the closest existing pharmaceutical formula. The Dong medicine database and the data retrieval method provided by the invention can improve the retrieval speed.

title_en: Gynecological drug delivery device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of medical equipment and discloses a gynecological drug delivery device which comprises a main body, wherein the main body is provided with at least one drug delivery channel, each drug delivery channel is arranged along the length direction of the main body, each drug delivery channel is communicated with at least one drug delivery hole group, each drug delivery hole group comprises a plurality of drug delivery holes, all drug delivery holes of the same drug delivery hole group are sequentially arranged along the length direction of the drug delivery channel, a buffer distribution cavity capable of containing liquid drug is arranged in the main body, one end of the main body is provided with an inlet communicated with the buffer distribution cavity, all drug delivery channels are communicated with the buffer distribution cavity, an inner coating layer capable of allowing liquid to pass through is wrapped outside the drug delivery channel. The gynecological drug delivery device is similar to the syringe in use method, and a patient can operate the gynecological drug delivery device to administer drug to the focus position by himself.

title_en: Nerve microprobe for positioning deep nucleus double-mode function of non-human primate brain and precise electric stimulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nerve microprobe for positioning deep nucleus of brain of a non-human primate and accurately electrically stimulating. The metal conductive layer is composed of a basal layer, a metal conductive layer and an insulating layer, wherein the conductive layer comprises a detection site group and a stimulation site. The invention adopts double insulating layers with opposite stress to simultaneously dry etch silicon oxide materials on the back of the silicon substrate layer, balances the difference of the stress of different materials, overcomes the technical difficulty of the process of lengthening the version of silicon micro probe, and solves the problems of easy bending and small mechanical stress caused by the large aspect ratio of the silicon probe of the non-human primate. The detection site obtains a dual-mode signal as a positioning mark through modifying the nano metal material and the polymer anti-interference ion membrane to perform functional positioning. The detection sites are arranged between the electric stimulation anode and the electric stimulation cathode, so that the stimulation range is controlled near the detection sites, and the accurate electric stimulation is realized. The invention can provide a new research means and method for treating diseases such as Parkinson and the like by deep brain electrical stimulation.

title_en: Kinematic testing system for simulating unstable substrate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kinematic testing system for simulating an unstable substrate, which is applied to the technical field of animal kinematic testing. The device comprises a control console, an unstable substrate simulation part, an original force data acquisition part and a motion behavior data acquisition part, wherein the control console comprises a control device such as an upper computer and a synchronous trigger, the unstable substrate simulation part comprises a programmable control rotating motor, an equivalent substrate plane and a rigid connection clamp, the original force data acquisition part comprises a six-dimensional force sensor, a three-axis acceleration sensor and related acquisition devices, the motion behavior data acquisition part comprises a high-speed camera and a motion capture camera, and behavior data and kinematic data of an object to be studied can be recorded. The invention can realize the equivalent simulation of the leaf type unstable substrates with various types and states in the nature, and can complete the synchronous acquisition of force data and movement behavior data of animals in the process of the movement force experiment on the unstable substrates.

title_en: Tantalum metal patella prosthesis for patella defect and manufacturing method
abstract_en: The invention provides a patella defect tantalum metal patella prosthesis and a manufacturing method, wherein the prosthesis comprises a body which is manufactured by adopting tantalum metal printing, the body is customized individually and is manufactured by adopting 3D printing, the tantalum metal body adopts a hollow shell structure, the outer surface of the shell structure is at least provided with a joint surface which is used for forming a joint with a femur joint surface and a fusion surface which is used for contacting with a small amount of residual patella bone and inducing bone cell division to grow in, and the peripheral edge of the shell structure is uniformly provided with a plurality of suture holes for initial fixing of the prosthesis; the method comprises the step of obtaining a patient side patella prosthesis model by taking the patient side patella as a reference in a mirror image overturning mode. The invention provides a system proposal for truly restoring the patella form, reliably fixing and perfectly fusing the patella with the autologous bone through creative design, and creates possibility for solving the clinical problem that the patient with patella resected cannot be completely repaired.

title_en: Absorbent article with improved performance
abstract_en: A disposable absorbent article is described. The disposable absorbent article has: a topsheet that is a carded, breathable bonded nonwoven; a negative; an absorbent core disposed between the topsheet and the backsheet; and an integrated nonwoven fluid management layer disposed between the topsheet and the absorbent core. The integrated nonwoven fluid management layer has a basis weight in the range of 40gsm to 75gsm as determined by the "basis weight method", 10 wt% to about 60 wt% absorbent fibers, between about 15 wt% to about 70 wt% elastic fibers, and between about 25 wt% to about 70 wt% reinforcing fibers as determined by the "material composition analysis". The absorbent article exhibits an average acquisition rate of between about 10 seconds and about 40 seconds in the first gush when measured according to the "repeat acquisition and rewet method".

title_en: Method and device for realizing small-view-angle endoscope steering assembly
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a device for realizing a small-angle view endoscope steering assembly, which belongs to the technical field of medical optics, and adopts a method of realizing the steering of the small-angle view endoscope by double reflection of a double steering assembly and the difference of beam deflection angles with opposite directions.

title_en: Calcified plaque excision device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a calcified plaque excision device, and relates to the field of medical instruments. The calcified plaque excision device comprises a balloon, a first tube body, a second tube body and a third tube body. The outer wall of the saccule is convexly provided with a cutting part which is used for cutting calcified plaque; the first tube body is connected with the balloon; the second tube body sequentially penetrates through the first tube body and the balloon, the second tube body is provided with a first channel, a second channel is formed in an area between the inner wall of the first tube body and the outer wall of the second tube body, the second channel is communicated with the interior of the balloon, the second channel is used for filling or evacuating contrast agent to enable the balloon to be unfolded or contracted, and the second tube body is used for emitting pulse waves; the third body is arranged in the second body in a penetrating way and is used for acquiring imaging information in the blood vessel. Through setting up sacculus, first body, second body and third body, showing the ability that calcified plaque excision device passed through high resistance pathological changes such as tortuosity, calcified lesions has been improved.

title_en: Intelligent wearing sensing system and method based on flexible super surface
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent wearing sensing system and method based on a flexible super surface. One end of the super-surface one-dimensional periodic structure of the intelligent wearable sensing system is attached to the C-shaped ring, and the diplexer is electrically connected with the C-shaped ring, the signal transmitter and the signal receiving processor. The method comprises the steps of attaching a one-dimensional periodic structure of the super surface to a human body, transmitting radio frequency signals to be standard signals through a radio frequency signal transmitting circuit under no action, transmitting the radio frequency signals to be detected under action, analyzing and comparing the signals to output reflection coefficients, obtaining corresponding preset gesture actions according to the reflection coefficients, and transmitting the gesture actions to an external intelligent device to be used as a judging result to judge the gesture actions of the human body. The application of the system and the method to the super-surface material can restrict electromagnetic waves to propagate on the surface, better restrict energy and reduce loss, thereby increasing the sensitivity to electromagnetic detection, being capable of being used for the aspects of disabled person assistance, sports health monitoring and the like and having good application value.

title_en: Control assembly and soft tissue cutting device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a control assembly and a soft tissue cutting device, wherein the control assembly comprises a shell unit, a first control unit and a locking unit, the soft tissue cutting device comprises a control assembly and a cutting assembly, and the cutting assembly comprises an outer tube unit and a cutting unit. The cutting assembly has the advantages that by utilizing the cooperation of the first control unit and the locking unit, the cutting assembly can be prevented from being accidentally pushed, the possibility of accidental injury is reduced, and the safety is improved; the first control unit can be used for carrying out one-hand operation on the cutting assembly, so that the operation convenience is improved; the outer tube unit is matched with the cutting unit to limit the working position of the cutting unit, and a cutting opening capable of accommodating thicker soft tissues is formed, so that the soft tissues can be cut off once and completely, and the operation efficiency is improved.

title_en: Baby feeding bottle with stirring function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a baby feeding bottle with stirring, which relates to the technical field of feeding bottles and solves the problems of low stirring efficiency and easiness in occurrence of bubbles when the existing feeding bottle is used for preparing milk powder.

title_en: Flushing drainage device and control system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the specification provides a flushing drainage device and a control system, wherein the flushing drainage device comprises a drainage connecting pipe, a flushing connecting pipe, a drainage control valve, a flushing control valve, a fixing device, a monitoring device, an early warning device, a controller and a processor; the drainage control valve comprises a drainage valve body, a drainage valve rod and a drainage control structure; the flushing control valve comprises a flushing valve body, a flushing valve rod and a flushing control structure; the fixing device is used for fixing the drainage connecting pipe and the flushing connecting pipe on the target object; the monitoring device is used for monitoring in real time to acquire detection data and/or drainage tube in-vitro images; the early warning device is used for sending early warning information based on detection data and/or drainage characteristics; the drainage characteristics are determined based on the drainage tube in-vitro image; the controller is used for controlling the opening and closing of the drainage control valve and/or the flushing control valve and the opening amplitude; the processor is used for: based on the drainage tube in-vitro image, adjusting flushing drainage parameters; and controlling the operation of the irrigation and drainage device.

title_en: Method for detecting needle insertion depth and related product
abstract_en: The application discloses a method for detecting needle penetration depth and related products. The method comprises the following steps: the detection method is used for determining the needle insertion depth of the surgical needle in the process that the surgical needle performs puncture by moving along the guide groove of the puncture guide; a point on the guide slot closest to the extreme end of the surgical needle is a first point, and a first infrared reflector is fixed on the surgical needle at a second point except the extreme front end, and the method comprises: determining a first position of the first infrared reflector during penetration of the surgical needle based on an optical tracking system; acquiring a second position of the first point; determining a first distance between the first point and the second point based on the first position and the second position; acquiring a second distance from the foremost end to the second point; and calculating the difference between the second distance and the first distance to obtain the needle insertion depth of the surgical needle.

title_en: Emotion prediction method based on vehicle equipment state and user driving behavior
abstract_en: The invention discloses a emotion prediction method based on a vehicle equipment state and a user driving behavior, an emotion prediction method device based on the vehicle equipment state and the user driving behavior and an electronic device, wherein the emotion prediction method comprises the following steps: detecting whether the running state of the vehicle is abnormal or not, and detecting whether the driving behavior of a user is abnormal or not; according to abnormal running state of the vehicle, taking the state information of the vehicle equipment as emotion fluctuation characteristics; determining a user emotion figure according to the abnormal driving behavior of the user by using the driving behavior information of the user; constructing an emotion fluctuation feature model based on the vehicle equipment state information and the user driving behavior information, and performing offline training; and predicting whether the emotion state of the user is abnormal or not on line according to the emotion fluctuation feature model. By the scheme, the user emotion fluctuation is judged by combining the equipment state information and the user portrait, the prediction lag problem can be reduced by predicting the emotion based on the equipment state information, and the user emotion is predicted earlier before abnormality.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and storage medium for controlling motor of oral cavity cleaning equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a motor control method, a motor control device and a motor control storage medium of oral cavity cleaning equipment. Wherein, above-mentioned oral cavity cleaning device includes brush head, pressure detection component and motor, and above-mentioned pressure detection component is used for detecting the pressure that the brush head received, and above-mentioned motor is used for driving the brush head swing, and this method includes: if the pressure born by the brush head is in a first pressure interval, the motor is controlled to drive the brush head to swing by the swing of the first motor; if the pressure born by the brush head is in the second pressure interval, the motor is controlled to drive the brush head to swing in the first swing interval according to a preset rule, and the first pressure interval is adjacent to the second pressure interval, so that the brush head is driven to swing in different swinging modes and proper swinging amplitudes in the adjacent pressure interval by the motor, a more diversified cleaning mode is provided for teeth, and compared with a invariable swinging mode, the cleaning force is stronger according to the mode of alternately changing the pressure born by the brush head, and the generated swinging change is more obvious.

title_en: Ultrasonic imaging method and ultrasonic imaging system for fetal skull
abstract_en: An ultrasound imaging method and an ultrasound imaging system for a fetal skull, the method comprising: the processor (116) controls the ultrasonic probe to emit ultrasonic waves to the cranium of the fetus to be tested and receives the echo of the ultrasonic waves so as to obtain an echo signal of the ultrasonic waves (S210); a processor (116) obtains three-dimensional ultrasonic data of the cranium of the fetus to be tested based on the echo signals of the ultrasonic waves (S220); a processor (116) determines a target position based on the three-dimensional ultrasound data, the target position being a position that places a skull region in the three-dimensional ultrasound data at a rendering angle (S230); the processor (116) rotates the three-dimensional ultrasound data to a target position based on the target position (S240); a processor (116) determines a skull region in the three-dimensional ultrasound data (S250); the processor (116) renders the skull region in the rotated three-dimensional ultrasonic data to obtain a rendered image, and controls the display (118) to display the rendered image (S260), so that automatic imaging of the fetal skull can be realized, and the efficiency and the accuracy of fetal skull ultrasonic inspection are improved.

title_en: Ultrasonic imaging method, device, equipment, ultrasonic imaging system and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultrasonic imaging method, an ultrasonic imaging device, ultrasonic imaging equipment, an ultrasonic imaging system and a medium, and relates to the technical field of medical imaging. The method comprises the following steps: in response to detecting triggering operation of an imaging control in a visual interface, sending an ultrasonic imaging instruction to ultrasonic generating equipment so that the ultrasonic generating equipment transmits a first ultrasonic signal to a target object; receiving a first echo signal corresponding to the first ultrasonic signal sent by the ultrasonic generating equipment; and generating an initial ultrasonic image based on the first echo signal, executing image enhancement operation on the initial ultrasonic image, and outputting a target ultrasonic image. The embodiment of the invention adopts an interactive imaging mode of combining soft and hard, solves the problem that the ultrasonic image output by the traditional ultrasonic imaging system contains more noise information, improves the image quality of the ultrasonic image, and further reduces the difficulty of interpretation of the ultrasonic image by doctors.

title_en: Medical information processing method, system and computer storage medium based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention relates to a medical information processing method based on digital twinning, which comprises the following steps: constructing a digital twin hospital three-dimensional model of a target hospital, wherein the digital twin hospital three-dimensional model comprises hospital building model information, hospital floor model information corresponding to a hospital building and department model information corresponding to the hospital floor information; acquiring equipment data information corresponding to medical equipment in a target hospital, constructing a digital twin equipment three-dimensional model corresponding to the medical equipment according to the equipment data information of the medical equipment, and calibrating the digital twin equipment three-dimensional model in the digital twin hospital three-dimensional model, wherein the equipment data information comprises equipment position information and equipment state information. According to the method, the medical equipment and the hospital model related to the hospital are subjected to virtualization processing by utilizing the digital twin technology, the data information such as the position, the working state and the acquisition information of the medical equipment are uniformly managed in the hospital model, and the working efficiency of medical staff is improved.

title_en: Method for determining ovulation time
abstract_en: Provided herein are devices and methods for determining or predicting the occurrence of ovulation in a human subject by utilizing non-invasive measurements of various activity parameters and determining the pattern of the activity parameters over a period of time.

title_en: Brain magnetic source positioning method based on nearest neighbor multiple linear regression model
abstract_en: The invention provides a brain magnetic source positioning method based on a nearest neighbor multiple linear regression model. The method comprises the steps of constructing a brain model based on a nearest neighbor multiple linear regression model and representing space-time correlation between brain source activities, constructing a source covariance matrix in the model based on a graph Laplace smoother and representing spatial correlation of covariance levels between the source activities, reasonably supposing the model based on Bayesian reasoning and convex optimization theory, and deducing a formula for iteratively solving model parameters. The source positioning algorithm realized by the invention can obtain more accurate source estimation, including accurate positioning source position, range size and source time waveform estimation, and provides a solid technical foundation for the medical application of magnetoencephalography.

title_en: Steering wheel, vehicle, human physiological data monitoring method and storage medium
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a steering wheel, a vehicle, a human physiological data monitoring method and a storage medium, comprising a steering wheel main body, a sensing assembly and a processing unit; the steering wheel body includes an annular grip; the sensing component is annularly arranged on the annular gripping part and is used for sensing a human physiological signal of a driver; the processing unit is in communication connection with the sensing assembly and is used for generating human physiological data according to the human physiological signals of the driver. According to the steering wheel annular gripping part, the sensing assembly is annularly arranged on the steering wheel annular gripping part, so that the sensing assembly is fully covered, the condition of missing detection during gripping of the steering wheel is avoided, the designated position of the steering wheel is not required to be gripped, the distraction is not required during driving, and the driving safety is improved.

title_en: Intelligent care system and care method for aged people based on internet of things (IoT)
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent care system and a care method for the aged based on an internet of things (IoT), which relate to the field of intelligent care and comprise emotion recognition and analysis, an intelligent sensor module, a data processing and control module, an alarm module and an exchange module. The sensor module is positioned in the living area of the old and is used for acquiring emotion, physiological parameters and behavior data of the old in real time; the data processing and controlling module receives and processes the data, predicts the behaviors of the old people through the medical big data and the historical medical data, and generates early warning prediction information; the communication module plays specific sound or music to improve the emotion of the old. The invention can analyze emotion and play corresponding music or specific voice according to emotion types. The early warning prediction information can trigger the auxiliary equipment to start to carry out important care on the risky old. The invention can monitor the behavior, physiological and psychological health condition of the old in real time, provide timely feedback and advice, and effectively improve the life quality and safety of the old.

title_en: Vascular intervention operation safety monitoring analysis method, system and computer program product
abstract_en: The application discloses a vascular intervention operation safety monitoring analysis method, a vascular intervention operation safety monitoring analysis system and a vascular intervention operation safety monitoring analysis computer program product. The safety monitoring analysis method uses a RAUNet deep learning model to segment and extract a guide wire image, then segments the same background image into blood vessels, and can see the position and the posture of the guide wire in the blood vessels after the two images are fused. On this basis LSTM is used to predict the movement of the guide wire and possible risk. Therefore, doctors can monitor the state of the operation in real time, can timely sense any unsafe condition and make corresponding adjustment so as to reduce various operation risks. Compared with the prior art, the method uses the RAUNet deep learning model with excellent effect in the semantic segmentation field to carry out semantic segmentation of the guide wire and the blood vessel; the LSTM model mature in the time sequence prediction field is used for motion prediction, so that a doctor can be effectively assisted in carrying out vascular intervention operation, and the method has a great clinical application value.

title_en: Neonate anti-drop intelligent wrist strap
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-drop intelligent wristband for newborns, which comprises an intelligent wristband main body, an intelligent movable plate, an electronic display screen, a receiver, a signal receiver, a temperature sensor and a pulse sensor, wherein a connecting block is fixedly connected to the surface of the intelligent wristband main body, an inserting groove is formed in the inner side of the connecting block, a third clamping groove is formed in the inserting groove, and the intelligent movable plate is arranged in the inner side of the connecting block. This neonate anti-drop intelligence wrist strap, through first block, be convenient for with first block locking at first block inslot portion, the rubber sleeve piece wraps up main with the junction parcel of first block with first block groove, avoid receiving external pulling and drop, temperature sensor and pulse sensor monitor neonate's temperature and pulse respectively, the sound of neonate is accomodate to the receiver, accompany when sleeping around the neonate night cry and die can monitor immediately and send to the room on duty through signal receiver, thereby avoid appearing emergency very safe.

title_en: Intelligent knotting system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of surgical instruments, in particular to an intelligent knotting system, which comprises: the device comprises a knotting module, a buffer movement auxiliary module, a detection module, a knotting auxiliary module, a knotting analysis module and a positioning adjustment module; the device comprises a knotting module, a buffering moving auxiliary module, a detecting module, a knotting analysis module and a positioning adjusting module, wherein the knotting module is used for knotting, the buffering moving auxiliary module is used for stably moving the knotting module, the detecting module is used for detecting position information and characteristic information of a knotting part, the knotting auxiliary module is used for adjusting the opening width of the knotting position, the knotting analysis module is used for determining the knotting scheme, and the positioning adjusting module is used for moving the knotting module to the knotting position.

title_en: Preparation method of 3D printing artificial total ankle implant with long implantation life
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of a 3D printing long-implantation-life artificial total ankle implant, which utilizes UG three-dimensional software to redesign an implantable total ankle implant model, and comprises a tibia component, a pad and a talus component. The tibia component consists of a tibia stem with an octahedral porous structure and a semi-surrounding tibia platform with an internal face-centered cubic structure and an external compact wear-resistant layer, the liner is saddle-shaped, the talus component consists of a talus arc with a smooth outer surface and a talus stem with a compact upper cylinder and a square lower hole honeycomb structure, the gradient structure and composition design among different components are adopted, the low elastic modulus and the strong mechanical property are considered, and the porous structural component is filled with beta-tricalcium phosphate, so that the implantation failure caused by looseness and abrasion in ankle joint replacement is improved.

title_en: XGBoost machine learning model construction method for early judging risk of acute kidney injury after heart operation
abstract_en: The technical scheme of the application is to provide an XGBoost machine learning model construction method for early judging the risk of acute kidney injury after cardiac operation. The application further provides an application of the XGBoost machine learning model constructed by the XGBoost machine learning model construction method for early judging the risk of acute kidney injury after cardiac operation. Another aspect of the present application is to provide a system for early judging risk of acute kidney injury after cardiac surgery, comprising: the data acquisition unit is used for acquiring the urine volume of the patient within 6 hours after heart operation and the highest creatinine level of the patient within 7 days before; XGBoost machine learning model. The risk prediction model is constructed by the XGBoost machine learning method, so that the risk of acute kidney injury of a patient after cardiac operation is judged in an early stage (namely within 6 hours).

title_en: Robust heart rate monitoring method based on near infrared camera
abstract_en: The invention relates to a robust heart rate monitoring method based on a near infrared camera, and belongs to the field of physiological signal detection. According to the invention, a near infrared imaging device is used for acquiring a facial video image of a subject, a sensitive area where a face is located is divided into N sub-areas through face mark points and blood perfusion areas, an original pulse wave signal and motion artifacts are respectively acquired through calculating pixel mean values and position information of each frame of the N groups of face interesting areas, background illumination concussion information is acquired through calculating pixel mean values of each frame of the N groups of background areas, motion noise and background illumination noise in the original pulse wave signal are primarily removed by combining an orthogonal decomposition projection denoising algorithm, and a low-rank space-time matrix denoising model is used for denoising the primarily denoised pulse wave signal again and extracting heart rate.

title_en: Liquid nitrogen cold therapy instrument convenient to remove
abstract_en: The invention discloses a liquid nitrogen cryotherapy instrument convenient to move, which comprises a cabin body, a liquid nitrogen tank and a control system, wherein the liquid nitrogen tank is detachably connected and arranged in the cabin body, the control system is connected and arranged on the outer side of the cabin body, a sealing cover is arranged at an opening of the liquid nitrogen tank, a heating detection device is connected and arranged at the lower end of the sealing cover, a connecting pipeline is connected with one end of the sealing cover far away from the liquid nitrogen tank, an intelligent handle is connected and arranged at one end of the connecting pipeline far away from the sealing cover, a control component is connected and arranged on the outer side of the intelligent handle, and a skin detection component is connected and arranged at the end part of the intelligent handle. The invention belongs to the technical field of low-temperature treatment, and particularly provides a liquid nitrogen cold therapy instrument which is provided with a skin detection component, is convenient for detecting the temperature state of skin in real time, is convenient for adjusting the temperature in time, ensures the comfort of a user, is provided with a positioning support sleeve, and is convenient for placing an intelligent handle when not in use and is convenient for movement.

title_en: Safe type tumour sampling device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a safe tumor sampling device, and relates to the field of oncology. A safe tumor sampling device, comprising: the device comprises a shell, wherein a control panel is embedded on one side of the shell, a sealing cylinder is communicated with one side of the shell, which is close to the control panel, and a supply assembly and a brake assembly which are matched with the shell for use are respectively arranged on one side of the sealing cylinder; an extension assembly matched with the shell is arranged on one side, far away from the sealing cylinder, of the supply assembly, positioning cylinders are arranged on the periphery, far away from the shell, of the extension assembly, and a support is fixedly connected to one side of each of the three groups of positioning cylinders; one sides of the three groups of positioning cylinders and the support are respectively provided with a positioning component and a sampling component. This safe type tumour sampling device through the cooperation of supply subassembly, brake subassembly, extension subassembly, locating component and sampling component, possesses triangle laser location and automatic extraction function, improves patient's tumour focus's sampling success rate.

title_en: Medical instrument placing rack with illumination function for surgical medical instrument
abstract_en: The invention discloses a medical instrument placement rack with an illumination function for surgical medical instruments, and particularly relates to the technical field of medical instrument storage.

title_en: Medical equipment pipeline sterilizing machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of disinfection, in particular to a medical equipment pipeline disinfection machine which comprises a machine shell, wherein a transmission mechanism is arranged on the machine shell, a clamping mechanism is arranged on the transmission mechanism and used for clamping two ends of a pipeline, a limiting mechanism is arranged on the transmission mechanism, an adjusting mechanism is arranged on the transmission mechanism and used for adjusting positions of the two clamping mechanisms, and the limiting mechanism is driven to limit the pipeline when the adjusting mechanism adjusts a clamping mechanism. The two ends of the pipeline can be clamped through the clamping mechanisms, the positions of the two clamping mechanisms on the transmission mechanism can be adjusted after the pipeline is clamped through the adjusting mechanism, so that the clamped pipeline is lengthened, the pipeline can not be wound when being cleaned in the sterile water, the sterile water can effectively pass through the pipeline, the blocking sense during circulation of the sterile water is reduced, and the transmission mechanism can drive the pipeline to rotate, so that the pipeline is quickly cleaned.

title_en: Medical instrument transfer trolley
abstract_en: The invention provides a medical instrument transfer trolley, which relates to the technical field of medical equipment and aims to solve the problems that the existing transfer trolley jolts when transporting instruments, so that the instruments jolt, stains on used instruments are easy to be stained on the inner wall of a carriage, the labor burden of personnel cleaning is increased, and the unused medical instruments are easy to be stained with dust and pollute due to long-time contact with the bottom surface of a storage inner box, and the medical instrument transfer trolley comprises: a transfer trolley base; at least four stacked instrument storage and transportation bill boxes are fixedly arranged at the front position of the middle part of the top plane of the transfer trolley base; a pushing seat connecting plate is fixedly arranged at the edge of the front end of the top plane of the uppermost instrument storage and transportation bill box; and a storage and transportation drawer is arranged in the instrument storage and transportation list box. The invention realizes the effect of quick internal pushing and self locking and prevents the problem that the storage and transportation drawers slide out in the transportation process.

title_en: Scrotum supporting belt for perineum operation
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of medical appliances and discloses a scrotum supporting belt for perineum operation. The scrotum supporting band can prevent scrotum from sliding from the scrotum supporting band, and has good scrotum supporting effect.

title_en: Balloon release valve and intragastric balloon
abstract_en: The application provides a balloon release valve and an intragastric balloon, and relates to the field of medical instruments. The balloon release valve comprises a valve body, an elastic valve member and a degradable constraint member; the valve body comprises a connecting cambered surface and a release pipe, wherein the connecting cambered surface is used for being connected with the balloon body, the middle part of the connecting cambered surface is provided with a release port, and the release pipe is positioned on the inner side of the cambered surface of the connecting cambered surface and is communicated with the release port to form a liquid outlet channel; the degradable constraint part is sleeved on the elastic valve member to deform the elastic valve member, and the deformed elastic valve member and the degradable constraint part are arranged outside the release pipe in a combined action manner to squeeze the release pipe so as to close the liquid outlet channel; after the degradable constraint piece is degraded, the elastic valve piece is restored to the shape, and the liquid outlet channel is opened; the valve body is made of organic polymer membrane materials. An intragastric balloon comprising a balloon body and a balloon release valve mounted on the balloon body. The release valve provided by the application has the characteristics that the release time is not influenced by human body quality, and the release process is safe.

title_en: Shoulder joint abduction bag
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of nursing apparatuses, and particularly discloses a shoulder joint abduction bag, which comprises: the main body bag is provided with an arc-shaped groove on the side wall, and a long groove is formed on the upper surface of the main body bag; the elastic ball is arranged in the long groove and fixedly arranged on the main body bag; the fixing belt is fixedly arranged on one side of the main body bag, provided with the arc-shaped groove; according to the invention, the fixing belt is arranged in a widening way, so that the contact area between the fixing belt and a human body is effectively enlarged, the pressure of the fixing belt on the human body is effectively reduced, the wearing comfort of a wearer is increased, meanwhile, the shoulder pad is arranged at the shoulder neck of the long constraint belt, and can be attached to the shoulder neck of the wearer along with the deformation of the long constraint belt, so that the contact area between the long constraint belt and the shoulder neck of the patient is effectively increased, the pressure of the long constraint belt on the shoulder neck of the patient is effectively reduced, the compression of the long constraint belt on the blood circulation is effectively reduced, and meanwhile, the shoulder neck pressure is decomposed.

title_en: Digital management method and system for traditional Chinese medicine diagnosis and treatment based on AI
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of traditional Chinese medicine diagnosis and treatment, in particular to an AI-based digital management method and system for traditional Chinese medicine diagnosis and treatment.

title_en: Anticoagulant biological material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an anticoagulant biomaterial and a preparation method thereof, comprising the following steps of carrying out plasma surface treatment on a medical biomaterial by adopting mixed gas of hydrogen and nitrogen to obtain a medical biomaterial with surface grafted amino, crosslinking the medical biomaterial with the surface grafted amino and heparin by adopting a crosslinking agent to obtain the anticoagulant biomaterial with the surface grafted heparin, wherein the crosslinking agent has a plurality of aldehyde groups, and the crosslinking step comprises the steps of carrying out first crosslinking reaction on the medical biomaterial with the surface grafted amino or the heparin and the crosslinking agent, and carrying out second crosslinking reaction on the obtained crosslinked product and the heparin or the medical biomaterial with the surface grafted amino. The preparation method has simple process and greatly improves the grafting efficiency of heparin.

title_en: Endoscopic image processing device and endoscopic image processing method
abstract_en: An image acquisition unit (261) acquires an endoscopic image captured by an endoscope. A region dividing unit (262) divides the endoscopic image into a plurality of regions. A depth information generating unit (263) generates depth information indicating the depth of an endoscopic image. A recognition unit (264) determines the direction in which the endoscope can travel, on the basis of the region information indicating the result of the region division by the region division unit (262) and the depth information of the endoscope image generated by the depth information generation unit (263).

title_en: Panty-shape diapers 3D knurling equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses 3D embossing equipment for paper diapers, which relates to the technical field of paper diaper embossing equipment and comprises a rack, wherein extension arms are arranged at two ends of the top of the rack, surface layer guiding structures are arranged on the extension arms, different surface layers can be attached through pressure, and an embossing structure for fixing the surface layers is arranged on one side of the surface layer guiding structures and below the surface layer guiding structures. The application has the guiding function on the surface layer, and the surface layer is not easy to generate transverse deflection phenomenon under the pressure function. Meanwhile, the positions of the surface layers distributed on the surface layer guiding structure can be limited, further, the phenomenon that the surface layers deviate in the moving process can be effectively avoided, the accuracy of different surface layer superposition processes is improved, and further, the accuracy of surface layer embossing processing is improved. Through the processing of opposite lamination in advance, can improve the knurling precision, reduce the deviation after the coincide of surface course edge department, effectively reduce the surface course knurling and connect the incomplete situation that leads to producing the clearance between the surface course, improved the knurling quality of surface course.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and storage medium for determining supply risk level
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a method, apparatus, device and storage medium for determining a risk level of a supply, the method comprising: acquiring the address of each supplier; determining epidemic risk levels corresponding to the supplier addresses from regional epidemic information based on the supplier addresses; inquiring in a preset grade corresponding relation based on the epidemic situation risk grade to obtain the corresponding supply risk grade of the supplier. According to the embodiment of the disclosure, the commodity supply risk level corresponding to the commodity supplier is determined according to the epidemic situation risk level of the commodity supplier address, so that the commodity supplier is helped to judge the commodity supply capability of the commodity supplier under epidemic situation management and control, and the commodity supply flow is reasonably configured in advance.

title_en: Postoperative rehabilitation evaluation system for cerebral apoplexy and processing method thereof
abstract_en: Aiming at the recovery effect evaluation requirement of a cerebral apoplexy postoperative user (patient), the cerebral apoplexy postoperative recovery evaluation system provided by the application can recognize and restore the human hand movement intention of the cerebral apoplexy postoperative user through the collected brain electrical signals of the head and the surface electromyographic signals of the front arm, then the contraction of corresponding muscles is stimulated through the functional electrical stimulation system to realize the human hand movement intention, at the moment, the response degree of the muscle system and the blood circulation system of the cerebral apoplexy postoperative user to brain movement instructions can be continuously evaluated in real time by combining the functional near infrared spectrum signals collected at the front arm, and a deeper recovery effect evaluation target is realized, so that the cerebral apoplexy postoperative recovery evaluation system provided by the application can be used for providing more accurate data guidance for the recovery training of the cerebral apoplexy postoperative user, further is beneficial to reconstructing the nerve loop of the brain to the limbs, and is beneficial to the recovery of the cerebral apoplexy postoperative user faster and more stable health.

title_en: Open-close type measuring device
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of medical equipment, in particular to an open-close type measuring device. The open-close type measuring device comprises a measuring part, a main body part and a control part; the measuring part and the control part are respectively positioned at two ends of the main body part, the measuring part is hinged with the main body part, and the control part is hinged with the main body part so as to form a hoop structure with an opening in a surrounding way; a switch locking mechanism is arranged among the measuring part, the control part and the main body part to stop or release the measuring part, the control part and the main body part; the control part is provided with a locking switch assembly, the locking switch is used for starting the stopping function of the switch locking mechanism, and the locking switch is in communication connection with the sensor of the measuring part; the main body part is provided with the unblock switch subassembly, and the unblock switch is used for closing the stopping function of switch locking mechanical system, and the sensor communication connection of unblock switch and measuring part. The combined measuring device can be stretched and fixed at the wrist of a testee to realize noninvasive blood pressure measurement.

title_en: Method and device for manufacturing individual hollowed-out brain protection cap
abstract_en: A method and a device for manufacturing an individual hollowed-out brain protection cap comprise the following steps: the method comprises the steps of importing original image data with skull defects into a medical image analysis and visualization platform for reconstruction to obtain a two-head model; processing one of the skull models to obtain a biconvex bone plate model, cutting the biconvex bone plate model to reserve the parts corresponding to the skull defects and the surrounding parts of the skull defects, and then manufacturing a plurality of vent holes to obtain a bone plate; processing the other skull model to obtain a whole head cap body, subtracting the skull defect position of the whole head cap body, and then manufacturing a plurality of ventilation holes to obtain the cap body; and combining the bone plate and the cap body to obtain a protective cap model, and manufacturing a protective cap according to the protective cap model. The protective cap can be completely matched with the skull defect of a patient, and cannot displace in the wearing process.

title_en: YAG laser beauty device with laser intensity adjustment function
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of beauty treatment and medical treatment, and discloses a YAG laser beauty treatment device with laser intensity adjustment, which comprises: an instrument body; the laser intensity adjusting mechanism comprises an adjusting device shell fixed in the instrument main body, wherein a laser component for laser emission and two groups of parallel control adjusting mechanisms for adjusting the laser intensity are arranged in the adjusting device shell; the laser transmission mechanism and the transmission mechanism are arranged between the two groups of control and regulation mechanisms, a driving motor is arranged outside the transmission mechanism, and a YAG laser emitter is arranged outside the laser transmission mechanism. The control and regulation mechanism and the transmission mechanism in the YAG laser intensity regulating device are mutually matched, different types of optical attenuation mirrors are replaced by the control and regulation mechanism, and the laser intensity is attenuated and enhanced in a mode of multiple rows of combined optical attenuation mirrors, so that the laser intensity is regulated.

title_en: Multimode fusion method, device and storage medium for predicting vascular invasion state
abstract_en: The application relates to a multi-mode fusion method, a device and a storage medium for predicting tumor vessel invasion states, which are applied to the technical field of medical evaluation. The application provides a multi-modal fusion method, which comprehensively analyzes data from different nuclear magnetic sequences and clinical information, improves the prediction accuracy and reliability, fully utilizes the advantages of image histology and magnetic resonance imaging, makes up for the defects in conventional medical image diagnosis, provides more scientific basis for noninvasively predicting vascular invasion state, has higher accuracy, safety and convenience compared with the traditional method, and can be widely applied to the preoperative diagnosis of cancers and guide the selection of individual treatment schemes.

title_en: Notch shearing pliers and manufacturing method of shell-shaped tooth appliance
abstract_en: The invention provides a notch shearing pliers which are used for shearing notches on a shell-shaped tooth appliance and comprise a first pliers body and a second pliers body which are hinged, wherein the first pliers body comprises a first pliers head and a first pliers handle, the second pliers body comprises a second pliers head and a second pliers handle, a groove cutter which is convexly arranged towards the second pliers head is arranged on the first pliers head, a hollow opening is arranged on the second pliers head, the groove cutter and the hollow opening are mutually matched at a preset position to finish the shearing of the notch, the notch shearing pliers further comprise a damage prevention device which is arranged on the first pliers handle and/or the second pliers handle, the gap between the first pliers head and the second pliers head can be adjusted according to the thickness of the appliance to be sheared, and the inner surface of the first pliers head and the inner surface of the second pliers head are prevented from damaging the shell-shaped tooth appliance to be sheared when the groove cutter and the hollow opening are matched with the notch. The invention also provides a method for manufacturing the shell-shaped tooth appliance with the notch by using the notch shearing pliers.

title_en: Biological dosimeter and neutron capture treatment system with same
abstract_en: A biological dosimeter, a using method thereof and a neutron capture treatment system comprising the biological dosimeter, wherein the biological dosimeter measures the dose received by a protein in a radiation field according to the degradation degree of the protein in the radiation field, and the biological dosimeter has the advantages of simple operation, few steps and small errors, and can measure the radiation doses of various radiation fields and even mixed radiation fields. The application of the biological dosimeter in a neutron capture treatment system can evaluate not only radiation pollution in an irradiation chamber, but also the neutron dose.

title_en: Underwater flexible wearable system capable of compensating water pressure interference and monitoring water depth
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underwater flexible wearable system capable of compensating water pressure interference and monitoring water depth, which comprises a wearing component and a monitoring component arranged on the wearing component, wherein the monitoring component comprises a water pressure capacitance sensor, a muscle deformation capacitance sensor and a processor; the processor is used for calculating real-time water pressure according to the water pressure data in the water pressure capacitance sensor and the initial value thereof and the mapping function of the water pressure in the water pressure capacitance sensor and the capacitance change rate, calculating real-time muscle deformation according to the muscle deformation data in the muscle deformation capacitance sensor and the initial value thereof and the mapping function of the muscle deformation in the muscle deformation capacitance sensor and the capacitance change rate, and eliminating the water pressure interference in the muscle deformation data according to the correction function related to the real-time water pressure; and then calculating the water depth of the current position of the user according to the real-time water pressure. The invention can effectively solve the problems of real-time monitoring of water depth and coupling of water pressure and muscle deformation data when moving in a wide water depth range.

title_en: Chest belt type vibration sputum excretion instrument
abstract_en: The invention provides a chest belt type vibration sputum excretion machine, which comprises a chest belt assembly, wherein the chest belt assembly comprises a belt body and a plurality of pockets, the head end and the tail end of the belt body are detachably connected to form an annular structure, the outer surface of the belt body is provided with a plurality of pockets, the surface of each pocket is provided with a sputum excretion object mark, the belt body is provided with a plurality of belt body holes, and each belt body hole is correspondingly communicated with the inside of one pocket; the sputum excretion assembly is placed in the pocket and is exposed to the inner surface of the belt body through the belt body hole, so that the sputum excretion assembly is simple in structure, convenient to operate and convenient to carry, realizes multi-point chest belt type tapping sputum excretion, plays a role in effectively and conveniently assisting the clearance of airway secretion for one person, and is beneficial to rehabilitation treatment of patients.

title_en: Medical text data analysis method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a medical text data analysis method and a system, which generate type nodes according to operation information of a user side on constructing columns; receiving text data corresponding to the type node uploaded by a user side, generating abstract nodes corresponding to the text data, and generating a management tree according to the user node, the type node and the abstract nodes; acquiring text attributes of each sub-text in the text data, wherein the text attributes comprise test attributes or diagnosis attributes, and extracting the abstracts of each sub-text according to the text attributes by calling corresponding abstract extraction strategies to generate a plurality of sub-abstracts; and carrying out positioning and combining processing on the sub-summaries according to the summary combining slot positions, generating summary display strips corresponding to the summary nodes, carrying out association processing on the summary display strips and text data, enabling a user to quickly know abnormal data through the summary display strips, and realizing sharing of medical text data.

title_en: Femoral prosthesis
abstract_en: The present invention provides a femoral prosthesis comprising: the femoral stem comprises a stem body, a femoral neck and a connector which are sequentially connected, the stem body is provided with an acetabular connecting end and a femoral connecting end which are oppositely arranged, the stem body extends along a first direction, the femoral neck extends along a second direction, the periphery of the femoral neck protrudes out of the stem body, and the connector is connected with the acetabular connecting end; the femur external fixing plate is connected with the femur connecting end; the connecting piece, the external fixed plate of femur passes through connecting piece and handle body fixed connection. Through the technical scheme that this application provided, can solve the problem that the femoral prosthesis among the correlation technique can't satisfy the user demand.

title_en: Novel trachea cannula
abstract_en: A novel trachea cannula comprises a trachea cannula and an auxiliary cannula, wherein the auxiliary cannula comprises a cannula tube, an auxiliary plug, an air inlet catheter and an air outlet catheter; the auxiliary plug comprises an outer sleeve, an inner connecting pipe, an air outlet connector and an air inlet connector; one end of the inner connecting pipe is provided with an inserting end, the other end of the inner connecting pipe is communicated with the air outlet joint, one end of the outer sleeve is provided with a sleeving end, and the other end of the outer sleeve is provided with a connecting end and is communicated with the air inlet joint; meanwhile, the plug-in end of the inner connecting pipe and the sleeve-in end of the outer sleeve are arranged in the same direction, one end of the intubation sub-pipe is sleeved with the plug-in end connected with the inner connecting pipe, and the air outlet joint and the air inlet joint are respectively connected with the air outlet pipe and the air inlet pipe; the sleeve joint end of the outer sleeve of the auxiliary plug is sleeved on the cannula joint, and the other end of the cannula sub-tube is inserted into the cannula inner cavity from the cannula joint and extends to the inner side of the inner end of the cannula; the air inlet conduit is communicated with an air inlet pipe of the respiratory system, and the air outlet conduit is communicated with an air outlet pipe of the respiratory system. The air inlet and the air outlet are divided into two independent chambers, so that the problem of the physiological ineffective chamber can be solved.

title_en: Genitals washs massager
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of health and discloses a genital cleaning massager, which comprises a shell, wherein a motor cavity is arranged in the shell, a motor is arranged in the motor cavity, a placing cavity is arranged on the right side of the motor, a liquid adding cavity is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the shell, and a telescopic opening is fixedly arranged on the right side of the liquid adding cavity; the liquid cavity, communicating pipe, baffle, crowded liquid piece, spring one, extrusion strip, dwang, stirring leaf and drain pipe that deposit that set up realize this device evenly spray the washing liquid function, through opening the motor that sets up, the output top of motor can rotate and drive the extrusion strip that sets up and rotate, can extrude the liquid cavity through the drain pipe that sets up with liquid through the crowded liquid piece that sets up, the spring that sets up for a while makes the crowded liquid piece that sets up reset for liquid can be extruded repeatedly and deposit the liquid cavity, through a plurality of drain pipes that set up.

title_en: Electroencephalogram signal detection system
