abstract_en: The application relates to an electroencephalogram signal detection system, and the electroencephalogram signal detection system includes: an electrode and a processor; the electrode is connected with the processor, contacts with the object to be detected and is used for collecting the brain electrical signals of the object to be detected; the processor is used for acquiring the electroencephalogram signals within a preset time period; calculating the time of the brain electrical signal corresponding to each voltage deviation range according to the brain electrical signal, a preset voltage mean value and a plurality of voltage deviation ranges; calculating the total time of the brain electrical signals exceeding the voltage deviation threshold according to the brain electrical signal time corresponding to each voltage deviation range and the voltage deviation threshold; detecting the brain electrical signal according to the total time of the brain electrical signal and an abnormal threshold value; the situation of misjudgment is avoided, and the accuracy of the electroencephalogram signal detection is further improved.

title_en: Construction method, device, equipment and storage medium of disease diagnosis standard library
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for constructing a disease diagnosis standard library, wherein the method can acquire first historical medical data from a target disease sample library, extract first image feature data of the first historical medical data to obtain a first key feature training data set, acquire first short-term memory parameters and first long-term memory parameters based on the first key feature training data set and a detection standard model, acquire second historical medical data, extract second image feature data of the second historical medical data to obtain a second key feature training data set, acquire second short-term memory parameters and second long-term memory parameters based on the second key feature training data set and a detection standard model, acquire target disease diagnosis standard data of a time dimension based on the short-term memory parameters and the long-term memory parameters, and construct the disease diagnosis standard library based on the target disease diagnosis standard data. The scheme can improve the accuracy of disease detection.

title_en: Liquid feeding device for piglets with suction nozzle for automatic sterilization
abstract_en: The invention provides a liquid feeding device with a suction nozzle for automatically sterilizing piglets, and relates to the technical field of piglet cultivation. This possess suction nozzle self-sterilizer's liquid feeding device for piglet, including the feed box, the inside stirring subassembly that is used for mixing the fodder that is equipped with of feed box, the inside a plurality of connecting straws that are equipped with of feed box, a plurality of equal fixedly connected with of connecting straw one end eats the straw, a plurality of the straw that eats all runs through feed box one side and with feed box fixed connection, this possess suction nozzle self-sterilizer's liquid feeding device for piglet, the third gear drives the driving disk and rotates, the driving disk makes first arm-tie promote the impeller at inside reciprocating motion of suction frame through pulling second pull rod to draw into suction frame with the inside clearance water of water tank, the rethread outlet pipe pours into the intercommunication frame into, and the play water shower nozzle that makes to set up on the intercommunication frame washs the straw that eats, avoids not using for a long time and adheres dust and bacterium.

title_en: Portable endoscope system with data interaction function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a portable endoscope system with a data interaction function, which relates to the technical field of medical equipment and comprises an endoscope camera host, a portable cold light source and a wireless receiver, wherein the endoscope camera host comprises an optical structure, an image acquisition module, an image processing module, an image storage module, a key control module, a display module, an output interface module and a battery, and the modules are connected through a flexible flat cable; the image processing module comprises a central processing unit, an image processing correction algorithm unit, an RF image transmission unit and a power supply unit; wherein the central processing unit and the image processing correction algorithm are integrated in the main chip, and other unit functions are realized through the peripheral chip. The invention can enhance the image, inhibit noise, reduce the influence of noise, improve the definition of the processed image and improve the diagnosis and treatment quality.

title_en: Intelligent classification method, system and storage medium for acquired information data
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of data classification, and particularly discloses an intelligent classification method, system and storage medium for acquired information data, wherein the method comprises the steps of importing a current tumor medical data set to be classified and extracting characteristic data; according to the characteristic data, performing primary matching evaluation of medical data, performing secondary matching evaluation when primary matching is successful, and confirming adding of a class I label when primary matching is failed; when the secondary matching fails, confirming the adding category of the class II label, and adding the corresponding label according to the corresponding adding category; screening out a target storage data set and carrying out corresponding storage when the second-level matching is successful; the invention effectively solves the problem that the suitability identification of the existing data set and the data to be classified is not accurate enough, realizes the fine analysis of the data in different dimensions, reduces the occurrence probability of classification errors, and simultaneously reduces the interference on the subsequent data call.

title_en: Pressure-sensing real-time visual control method, system, intelligent terminal and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a pressure-sensitive real-time visual control method, a system, an intelligent terminal and a storage medium, wherein the method and the system are applied to the terminal, and a display interface of the intelligent terminal comprises the following steps: filling display unit, text display unit and surrounding display unit; the method comprises the following steps: receiving pressure feedback from the intelligent toothbrush in real time, and controlling a filling display unit on a display interface to synchronously and variably fill according to the fed-back real-time pressure value; according to the real-time pressure value, controlling a document display unit to display a corresponding document; and controlling the surrounding display unit to display the dynamic surrounding change of the intelligent toothbrush corresponding to the current force according to the real-time pressure value. When the intelligent toothbrush is used by a user, the user can know the force applied by the user in real time, and is reminded to regulate the force applied by the user, so that the user can better brush the teeth and control the experience.

title_en: Bronchoscope adapter
abstract_en: The invention relates to a bronchoscope adapter, and belongs to the technical field of bronchoscopes. The invention provides a bronchoscope adapter, which comprises a rectangular frame, a connecting bracket and arc-shaped clamping blocks, wherein both sides of the bottom of the rectangular frame and the connecting bracket are respectively provided with linear rails, the rails on both sides of the bottom of the rectangular frame are respectively and movably connected with the rails of the connecting bracket through an I-shaped block, and each connecting bracket is also connected with an arc-shaped clamping block; two symmetrically arranged inserting blocks are fixed on the upper surface of the rectangular frame, two moving rods are inserted in opposite directions on the two inserting blocks, and the moving rods are connected with V-shaped clamping blocks; the clip-shaped frame is also hinged with a tongue baffle. According to the invention, the oral cavity can be stably opened and clamped by arranging the back-shaped frame and the arc-shaped clamping blocks, and meanwhile, the bronchoscope can be firmly fixed by the V-shaped clamping blocks, so that the stable operation of the bronchoscope is realized, the interference of micro movement of the bronchoscope, the movement of the oral cavity of a patient and the like is effectively avoided, and the accuracy of diagnosis is improved.

title_en: Surgical robot remote monitoring operation system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a remote monitoring operation system and a remote monitoring operation method for a surgical robot, which relate to the technical field of remote monitoring operation of the surgical robot, wherein the remote monitoring operation method comprises the following steps: the remote equipment module is used for acquiring equipment information data and sending the equipment information data to the equipment management service module, acquiring an operation instruction and controlling the surgical robot to execute the operation instruction; the device management service module is used for storing and processing the device information data, obtaining the user grade of the login user, obtaining the user authority according to the user grade, screening the corresponding data in the device information data according to the user authority, and transmitting the corresponding data to the user module for display; the user module is used for logging in and verifying user grades by the user, generating an operation instruction and sending the operation instruction to the remote equipment module through the equipment management service module. The invention realizes the remote monitoring operation of the surgical robot, limits the authority of the login user and ensures the life safety of the patient.

title_en: A clean sterilization equipment for internal medicine surgical instruments
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of cleaning and sterilizing equipment, in particular to cleaning and sterilizing equipment for medical surgical instruments, wherein one end of a connecting piece is fixedly connected with a door plate, the inner wall of the upper end of a shell is fixedly provided with a moving device, a third hydraulic rod and a fourth hydraulic rod drive a first connecting plate and a motor to move up and down, the motor transfers the instruments to be cleaned, a magnetic suction column and a clamping column are used for unfolding and hanging the scissors instruments, springs, clamping frames and rotating clamping columns are used for fixing, the magnetic suction column and a clamping buckle are used for fixing the columnar and knife-shaped instruments, the instruments can be rotated and cleaned, meanwhile, the damage caused by moving and impacting of the surgical instruments in the cleaning process is avoided, the damage to the cleaning and sterilizing device is avoided, a spray head is used for high-pressure flushing the surgical instruments, sterilizing liquid in a soaking tank is used for sterilizing by ultraviolet rays, and finally the instruments can be taken out by drying by a dryer, so that the time is greatly saved, and the injury to operators is avoided.

title_en: Cornea fixing device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of cornea tissue internal stress measurement, in particular to a cornea fixing device. The cornea fixing device provided by the invention comprises a base; the arc-shaped groove is formed in the base; the compression structure is detachably connected with the base; the device comprises a compression block, wherein the compression block is an arc block matched with the arc groove, and the compression block is suitable for being arranged in the arc groove and compressing one end of cornea tissue. The arc-shaped compaction block provided by the invention compacts the cornea tissue in the arc-shaped groove of the base, so that the damage to the cornea tissue caused by a sharp structure is avoided, and the effect of effectively fixing the cornea tissue without damaging the cornea tissue is realized.

title_en: Surgical navigation planning method, system and storage medium based on surgical robot
abstract_en: The application discloses a surgical navigation planning method, a system and a storage medium based on a surgical robot, comprising the following steps: reconstructing a virtual three-dimensional model of cardiac tissue based on the enhanced CT scan image; determining an initial position of a target heart cavity, generating a virtual instrument model of the interventional instrument, and marking a target focus point on the virtual three-dimensional model; establishing a three-dimensional mapping model of heart tissue, completing real-time fusion of the three-dimensional mapping model and a virtual three-dimensional model, and presenting the position of a mapping catheter on the fused three-dimensional model in the mapping process; calculating and obtaining an optimal catheter in-place path; and according to the calculated optimal catheter in-place path, in the operation process, carrying out real-time navigation on the position of the ablation catheter based on the fused three-dimensional model. The method can provide operation planning and navigation for the operator in real time in the operation process, assist the operator to complete the operation more efficiently and accurately, and reduce the operation threshold of the operator.

title_en: Medical mattress disinfection cabinet
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a sterilizer technical field, and disclose a medical mattress sterilizer, mainly constitute by sterilizer, guide rail, slide, motor, commentaries on classics board and cylinder etc. through setting up the fixed block in the side of slide, movable chamber has been seted up to the inside of fixed block, the inside sliding connection in movable chamber has the rubber slab. According to the invention, the motor is used for driving the rotating plate to drive the roller to rotate, the mattress is fixed on the outer surface of the roller through the elasticity of the elastic strip, so that the roller drives the mattress to rotate in the disinfection cabinet, when the roller drives the elastic strip to rotate to the rubber hook, the rubber hook is hung on the elastic strip, and the elastic strip must cross the rubber hook along with the continuous rotation of the roller, so that the elastic strip is pulled up by the rubber hook and released when the elastic strip crosses the rubber hook, and the pulled elastic strip can realize a beating function on the mattress through elasticity, so that dust and the like in the mattress are beaten out, and the disinfection effect is improved.

title_en: Intelligent watch
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent watch, which comprises a shell, a display part, a detection device, an electric control device, a defibrillation component and a boosting device, wherein the display part is arranged on the shell and used for displaying, the detection device is used for detecting heart rate, the electric control device is electrically connected with the display part and the detection device, the defibrillation component is arranged on the shell and comprises two electrode parts, and the boosting device is correspondingly connected with the two electrode parts and the electric control device, and at least two electrode parts can be detachably arranged on the shell. At ordinary times, the display part is used for displaying basic information required by user setting, when the detection device detects that the heart rate of a patient is wrong, the two electrode parts can be rapidly detached from the shell and attached to the chest of the patient, the electric control device controls the boosting device to work, and high-energy electric pulses generated by the boosting device are transmitted to the two electrode parts, so that defibrillation can be rapidly realized, and the intelligent watch with the heart emergency function can be provided under emergency conditions.

title_en: Preparation device of sodium ion battery with high rate performance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation device of a sodium ion battery with high rate performance, which comprises a glove box and a sterilization assembly which is matched and installed at the upper end of the interior of the glove box, wherein an automatic assembly is matched and installed at the front end of the interior of the glove box; the automatic assembly comprises a separation plate and a top part feeding mechanism arranged at the top of the separation plate, wherein a bottom assembly mechanism is arranged at the right end below the separation plate, and the bottom assembly mechanism is fixedly arranged at the lower end inside the glove box. The invention provides a preparation device of a sodium ion battery with high multiplying power, which can sterilize and clean the internal environment of a glove box through the arrangement of a sterilization component in the invention, thereby ensuring the clean internal environment; through the setting of automatic assembly subassembly, when with anodal shell pressure equipment, but automatic assembly, and compress tightly to need not to shift to the box outside and go on, prevent to influence sodium ion battery's performance.

title_en: Restraint device and monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a restraint device and a monitoring system, which belong to the technical field of medical equipment and comprise a placing bag, a restraint assembly and a monitoring assembly, wherein the restraint assembly comprises a contraction bag, an elastic rope, a limiting ring, a connecting part, a fixing patch, a connecting belt and a patch, when a patient needs to be infused, the elastic rope can be pulled first to expand the contraction bag, so that the hand of the patient can pass through the contraction bag to enter the placing bag, the elastic rope can be pulled again to tighten the contraction bag, the restraint device can be prevented from falling off from the hand of the patient during infusion, the patch is covered on the fixing patch to further seal the contraction bag, the patient is limited by the monitoring assembly, the behavior of the patient is monitored, the agitation degree of the patient is prevented from exceeding a first calibration value, and the problem that the conventional device cannot be effectively restrained during infusion of the patient is solved.

title_en: Venous drainage tube flow regulating device
abstract_en: The invention provides a venous drainage tube flow regulating device which comprises a fixing device, a universal arm assembly and a flow control assembly, wherein the flow control assembly comprises a regulating control screw rod, a first regulating control flow claw and a second regulating control flow claw which are oppositely arranged, a first thread section and a second thread section which are opposite are arranged on the regulating control screw rod, the first regulating control flow claw and the second regulating control flow claw are respectively in threaded fit with the first thread section and the second thread section, and a venous drainage tube is clamped between the first regulating control flow claw and the second regulating control flow claw. According to the invention, the first adjusting control flow claw and the second adjusting control flow claw are arranged on the adjusting control screw rod with opposite threads, so that stepless adjustment can be realized for the flexible drainage tube, and the instantaneous change of the hemostatic forceps on vascular pressure caused by sudden opening and closing is reduced, thereby reducing the operation risk.

title_en: Improvements in or relating to implantable ferromagnetic markers improvements relating to implantable ferromagnetic markers
abstract_en: An implantable susceptibility measurement marker (1001) for use in surgical guidance includes one or more ferromagnetic elements (1004 a,1004B,1004 c) and at least one antimagnetic element (1003), wherein the one or more ferromagnetic elements are formed of at least one ferromagnetic material having an initial relative magnetic permeability of at least about 10000 and a saturation magnetic induction B  S  of less than about 1.5T, and the at least one antimagnetic element is formed of at least one antimagnetic material having a volume susceptibility of at least about-0.16x10  ‑4 , and wherein a total volume of the antimagnetic material in the marker is about 100-10000 times greater than a total volume of the ferromagnetic material.

title_en: Excrement treatment system for beef cattle farm
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fecal sewage treatment system of a beef cattle farm, which relates to the technical field of livestock breeding and comprises a breeding house, wherein the breeding house is divided into a breeding area and a fecal sewage treatment area according to functions, and the fecal sewage treatment area is positioned at the rear end of the breeding area; the excrement treatment area comprises an excrement collection groove which is formed in the rear end of the cultivation area along the length direction of the cultivation house, an excrement cleaning mechanism which is matched with the cultivation area is arranged above the excrement collection groove, an excrement collection mechanism is arranged in the excrement collection groove, and a tail end treatment mechanism is arranged on one side face of the cultivation house; the cultivation area comprises a plurality of cultivation columns arranged along the length direction of the cultivation house, and each cultivation column is provided with a lifting backboard mechanism matched with the manure cleaning mechanism; during cleaning, the excrement cleaning mechanism is matched with the separation wall. The invention realizes the collection, cleaning, disinfection and conversion treatment of the feces through the carefully designed mechanism and equipment, reduces the pollution to the environment and improves the sanitary standard and the operation efficiency of farms.

title_en: Methods and systems for treating a medical implant site
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are methods and systems for treating and preventing infections at a medical implant site of a subject by administering a microporous gel to the medical implant site. Also disclosed herein are methods and systems for promoting healing of a wound or surgical incision at a medical implant site of a subject by applying a microporous gel to the medical implant site. The microporous gel may be fluid during application and may anneal or crosslink after application. The microporous gel may contain various therapeutic agents including antibiotics and analgesics throughout the gel.

title_en: Puncture anchoring device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a puncture anchoring device, which comprises a puncture needle, an anchoring piece, a needle sliding block, a push rod, a driving assembly and a rod sliding block. The anchor is connected with the suture and is movably positioned in the puncture needle. The needle slider is connected to the proximal end of the needle. The push rod is connected with the needle sliding block, and the far end of the push rod is movably arranged in the puncture needle. The rod sliding block is connected with the proximal end of the push rod, is adapted to push the needle sliding block to slide to the puncture position along with the distal end under the drive of the driving component, does not drive the needle sliding block any more, and continues to move to the limit position under the drive of the driving component; in the puncturing position, the needle completes puncturing and in the limit position, the plunger pushes the anchor out of the distal end of the needle. The device has a simple structure, drives the driving assembly, and can complete puncture and release of the anchoring piece and the suture at one time.

title_en: Anti-infection bone repair promoting preparation for sequentially regulating and controlling macrophage immune microenvironment and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of an anti-infection bone repair promoting preparation for sequentially regulating and controlling macrophage immune microenvironment, which comprises the following steps: according to the weight percentage, 1-10% of flavone modified hydroxyapatite, 2-10% of sodium alginate hydrogel, 0.1-1% of hydrogen sulfide slow release carrier and 79-96.9% of copper tricalcium phosphate premixed paste are mixed uniformly according to the proportion, and then calcium chloride aqueous solution is added, stirred uniformly and freeze-dried. The calcium phosphate bone cement of the flavone tricalcium phosphate and the hydrogen sulfide-containing slow-release carrier photocrosslinking alginic acid hydrogel has the function of regulating and controlling the immune microenvironment of macrophages, and the preparation can better realize the function of inducing M1 type polarization and then M2 type polarization of macrophages in the bone injury microenvironment according to the M1-M2 sequence.

title_en: Disinfection cabinet
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disinfection cabinet, which belongs to the technical field of disinfection equipment, and comprises a cabinet body, wherein a partition board is arranged in the cabinet body and divides the interior of the cabinet body into an upper space and a lower space, objects to be disinfected are respectively positioned in the upper space and the lower space, the objects to be disinfected in the upper space are positioned on the partition board, and the objects in the lower space are positioned at the bottom of the lower space; the partition board is provided with a first clamping device which is positioned at the upper end of the partition board to clamp the articles to be disinfected in the upper space; the partition board is provided with a second clamping device which is positioned at the lower end of the partition board and can clamp the objects to be disinfected at the bottom of the lower space; the baffle is rotationally connected in the cabinet body; the bottom of the lower space is provided with a lifting device for driving the to-be-sterilized object at the position to approach or depart from the second clamping device; the invention solves the problem of poor disinfection effect of the articles at the bottom of the disinfection cabinet with the interlayer in the prior art.

title_en: Method for producing cast porcelain false tooth in plateau region
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for producing a cast porcelain false tooth in a plateau region, which relates to the false tooth production field and comprises the following steps of S1, raw material beating: weighing zirconium oxide, aluminum oxide, feldspar, quartz and glass which are required by the preparation of the cast porcelain false tooth quantitatively, adding additives into a grinder, pulping into slurry, adding an active monomer TPGDA into the slurry, and pulping again; s2, preparing a coarse embryo: injecting the slurry into the inner cavity of the denture mould box, oscillating the denture mould box for 12s by using an oscillator, then putting the denture mould box into water for cooling, and taking out the manufactured standard embryo from the denture mould box after cooling to room temperature; according to the invention, the filter screen is driven to vibrate by the vibration motor, metal particles on the filter screen freely surge in the polishing box, the electric push rod drives the pushing plate to reciprocate, the flow direction of the metal particles is changed, the flow velocity of the metal particles relative to a standard embryo is improved, the pressure of the metal particles on the surface of the standard embryo is increased, and the polishing force is improved.

title_en: Auxiliary eye examination device for ophthalmology department
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of medical auxiliary equipment and discloses an eye auxiliary examination device for an ophthalmology department, which comprises a base, wherein one side of the middle part of the top end of the base is fixedly connected with a mounting frame, both sides of the middle lower part of the inner side of the mounting frame are respectively provided with a sliding groove, movable seats are respectively and slidably connected in the sliding grooves, and a wiring cavity is formed in the middle upper part of the inner side of the mounting frame. Through carrying out the patient's head that carries out the eye inspection when fixed, can also make patient's eye align with the eye auxiliary assembly of front end, on the one hand can guarantee the stability of patient's head when carrying out the eye inspection operation, prevent because of the eye that leads to the fact because of patient's head rocks in the inspection process and the inspection equipment to take place the skew, on the other hand can also align patient's eye with the inspection equipment through supplementary mode of aligning, avoided medical personnel to the correction of patient's posture when carrying out the inspection, be favorable to improving staff's inspection work efficiency.

title_en: Wearable device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a wearable device, including main part, first area body, second area body, gasbag, control portion and sensor, the main part includes first connecting portion and second connecting portion. One end of the first belt body is connected to the first connecting part, and the other end of the first belt body is provided with an elastic mechanism, wherein the elastic mechanism comprises a shell and a driving part, and the shell is provided with a containing cavity and an inlet. One end of the second belt body is connected with the second connecting part, and the other end of the second belt body can extend into the inlet to be matched with the driving part, and is tightened or loosened under the driving of the driving part. The air bag is arranged on the first belt body and/or the second belt body and is positioned on one side facing the wrist. The sensor is arranged on the main body and used for detecting the air pressure value of the air bag and acquiring the blood pressure value according to the air pressure value. The control part is arranged on the main body and used for controlling the starting or closing of the driving part. The wearable device provided by the embodiment of the application reduces the volume of the wearable device, and the air bag does not need to cover the skin in a large area, so that the wearing air permeability is ensured.

title_en: Ventricular assist system and method for detecting bubbles in a cleaning fluid of a ventricular assist system
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of medical equipment, in particular to a ventricular assist system and a method for detecting bubbles of cleaning fluid of the ventricular assist system, wherein the detection method comprises the following steps: step one, exhausting cleaning liquid of a ventricular assist system, and starting a bubble sensor after the exhausting is completed, wherein the bubble sensor monitors the cleaning liquid pushed out from a cleaning liquid pumping device; step two, a pressure sensor arranged at the far end of the bubble sensor displays first pressure, and the first pressure is within a corresponding first pressure threshold; step three, if the bubble sensor prompts abnormality, the ventricular assist system starts a first program; if the system detects that the bubble sensor is faulty and the pressure sensor is normal, the ventricular assist system starts a second program; if the bubble sensor is normal and the pressure sensor alone prompts abnormality, the ventricular assist system initiates a third procedure.

title_en: Novel preparation method of iron sucrose injection
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of preparation of bulk drugs and injection, in particular to a preparation method of a sucrose iron injection which can realize terminal sterilization process by using low-temperature alkali as potassium carbonate. The iron sucrose injection obtained by adopting the technical scheme of the invention meets the requirements of United states pharmacopoeia, and can ensure the sterility level to the greatest extent by using a terminal sterilization process. The method has the advantages of simple and environment-friendly process route, high product yield, controllable whole process and suitability for large-scale production.

title_en: Test method, system and storage medium of scanning device
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of scanning equipment and discloses a testing method, a testing system and a storage medium of the scanning equipment. The testing method comprises the following steps: acquiring a die body image through an image acquisition unit; determining the type of the die body according to the die body image; according to the type of the die body, the position of the scanning bed is adjusted to enable the die body to reach the scanning position; and testing the scanning equipment according to the scanning protocol corresponding to the die body. According to the automatic die arranging device, the position of the scanning bed is automatically adjusted, the die body is enabled to be at the scanning position, automatic die arranging is achieved, manual die body position adjustment is not needed, labor intensity in the die arranging process is reduced, the degree of automation of the scanning device testing process is improved, and the scanning device testing efficiency is improved.

title_en: Cerebral nerve blood vessel coupling detection ultrasonic equipment and detection method
abstract_en: The application discloses a cerebral nerve blood vessel coupling detection ultrasonic device and a detection method, and belongs to the technical field of ultrasonic devices. Comprising: a pillow is fixedly arranged at one end of the bed board, and support rods are symmetrically and fixedly arranged between the bed board and the pillow; the semicircular shell is arranged at one end of the bed plate in a sliding manner along the length direction of the bed plate; the pillow is adopted to support the brain of the person to be tested, so that the blood vessel behind the brain is in a suspended state, at the moment, the ultrasonic probes at the two ends of the semicircular sliding plate are driven by the sliding semicircular shell to be aligned with the blood vessel behind the brain, and the ultrasonic probes are driven by the electric push rod A to be attached to the artery blood vessel behind the brain for ultrasonic detection, so that the problem that the artery behind the brain is inconvenient to directly detect under the prone position state is effectively solved, further, ultrasonic detection of the artery blood vessel behind the brain is conveniently carried out when the person to be tested lies down, and the blood flow data are conveniently acquired by the person to be tested for coupling detection of the cerebral nerve blood vessel.

title_en: Method and device for improving sleep, sleep equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of intelligent household appliances and discloses a method for improving sleep, which comprises the steps of judging whether the sleep duration of each sleep stage of a target user reaches standard duration; judging whether the current proportion of the current sleep time length of each sleep stage to the current total sleep time length reaches a standard proportion or not under the condition that the sleep time length of each sleep stage of the target user reaches the standard time length; and under the condition that the current proportion does not reach the standard proportion and the target user is in an unhealthy state, adjusting the environmental parameters so that the proportion of the sleep duration of each sleep stage to the total sleep duration reaches the standard proportion. The sleep structure of the target user is adjusted only if the sleep duration of each sleep stage is sufficient. The condition that the biological rhythm is destroyed due to the fact that the environmental parameters are regulated according to the standard sleep structure diagram under the condition that each sleep stage of a user is incomplete is avoided. The application also discloses a device for improving sleep, sleep equipment and a storage medium.

title_en: Fresh-keeping system for refrigerator and control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fresh-keeping system for a refrigerator, which is used for a refrigerating chamber of the refrigerator, and comprises a box body, wherein the middle lower part of the box body is filled with water, the water is used for placing living aquatic products, and the box body is placed in the refrigerating chamber of the refrigerator; an oxygenation cavity is arranged at the top of one side of the box body, and the top of the oxygenation cavity is open; the oxygenation cavity is downwards connected with an air duct which downwards extends to the lower part of the water surface; an ozone generator and a fan are arranged in the oxygenation cavity at intervals up and down, the ozone generator is used for generating ozone, and the fan is used for pressing air in the oxygenation cavity into water downwards through an air duct; the control circuit of ozone generator and fan is connected with the controller, and the controller has control switch, and control switch sets up in box inner wall top. The invention can make the aquatic products survive for a long time by feeding air into the water under pressure and supplementing oxygen in the water. When air is sent into water under pressure, air flow carries ozone and is sent into water under pressure, bacterial viruses and fungi in the water are killed, peculiar smell is removed, water quality is purified, and the survival period of aquatic products is prolonged.

title_en: Computer tomograph and method for performing a translation of a gantry part of a computer tomograph
abstract_en: The invention relates to a computer tomograph having a housing with a first housing part, a second housing part and a third housing part, wherein the first housing part has a rotor with a projection data acquisition system and is mounted so as to be movable relative to the second housing part by means of a linear guide, such that a translation of the first housing part relative to the second housing part, in particular along the first linear guide, can be performed.

title_en: Helicobacter pylori infection prediction method, system and equipment based on decision tree
abstract_en: The invention discloses a helicobacter pylori infection prediction method, a helicobacter pylori infection prediction system and helicobacter pylori infection prediction equipment based on a decision tree, wherein the method firstly obtains user basic information, user clinical characterization information and user life and eating habit information; then mining the data, and selecting significance factors; and finally, constructing a decision tree model, taking sample data corresponding to the significance factors as input of the decision tree model, predicting through the decision tree model, wherein the decision tree model consists of a plurality of basic decision tree models, continuously iterating the basic decision tree model in the prediction process of the decision tree model, reducing residual errors generated in the prediction process of the decision tree model, and finally combining the plurality of basic decision tree models through addition, so that the prediction accuracy of the decision tree model can be improved.

title_en: Intelligent toilet
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent toilet, which comprises a toilet main body, wherein a urinal area and a flip cover are arranged on the toilet main body, and a cleaning cover assembly, a liquid supply assembly and a control device are also arranged on the toilet main body. The utility model provides a wash cover subassembly on the intelligent toilet bowl can wash the specific position of user, wash cover subassembly including wasing the cover, washs the cover subassembly and including wasing the lid, washs the lid and washs the cover and can make up into self-cleaning assembly, the self-cleaning of self-cleaning assembly can be accomplished automatically to the intelligent toilet bowl of this application, and this process degree of automation is high, can provide good use experience.

title_en: Conveying type balloon dilation microcatheter and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a delivery balloon dilation microcatheter and method of making the same, the microcatheter comprising: a balloon (2), a catheter main body (6) and a catheter seat (8); the catheter main body (6) is provided with a filling cavity, and balloon filling pressure is configured to the balloon (2) through the catheter seat (8) and the filling cavity; the catheter body (6) consists of an inner tube and an outer tube which are coaxial, the filling cavity being an annular cavity between the inner tube and the outer tube or at least one axial duct arranged between the inner tube and the outer tube; the device has the conveyability of the microcatheter and the expansibility of the saccule, can realize distal thrombus taking, aneurysm filling, auxiliary stent releasing, spring ring filling and expansion of a vascular stenosis, and provides powerful guarantee for safe and accurate operation of ischemic diseases.

title_en: Improved spray pipe
abstract_en: The invention provides an improved spray pipe, which comprises an inner pipe, an outer pipe and an atomizing head, wherein the inner pipe is used for limiting a first fluid channel; the outer pipe is sleeved outside the inner pipe, and a second fluid channel is defined between the outer peripheral wall of the inner pipe and the inner peripheral wall of the outer pipe; the atomizing head is arranged at the front end of the inner tube and is provided with an injection hole and a collision part, the injection hole penetrates through the atomizing head, the injection hole is communicated with the first fluid channel to enable first liquid from the first fluid channel to present a straight-line jet flow mode, and the collision part is provided with a collision surface for collision with liquid from the second fluid channel to enable the liquid from the second fluid channel to present a mist spraying mode.

title_en: Psychological assessment data storage method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of medical care information storage, in particular to a psychological assessment data storage method and system. Firstly, obtaining multidimensional psychological evaluation data; dividing the psychological assessment data of each dimension; further acquiring the region mutation degree of each region psychological evaluation data; further acquiring the association degree of the psychological evaluation data of each region; further acquiring a loss tolerance parameter of the psychological evaluation data of each region; further compressing the psychological evaluation data by using a revolving door compression algorithm according to the loss tolerance parameters of the psychological evaluation data of each region; and finally storing the compressed psychological evaluation data. According to the method, the compression efficiency of the revolving door compression algorithm is improved by analyzing the importance degree of the psychological evaluation data and the correlation characteristics of the psychological evaluation data among different dimensions, the storage space is saved, the storage cost is reduced, meanwhile, the loss of important data is reduced, and the storage effect of the psychological evaluation data is guaranteed.

title_en: Suction apparatus with automatic cleaning function
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of medical equipment, in particular to an aspirator with an automatic cleaning function, which comprises a base and an absorbing assembly, wherein the absorbing assembly comprises a rotating unit, a shell, an absorbing unit, an absorbing head, a telescopic unit, a cleaning seat, an annular brush, a rotating brush, a driving unit, an annular sterilizing lamp, a water pipe and a water conveying pump, the cleaning seat is provided with a groove, the telescopic unit drives the absorbing head to move into amniotic fluid, then the absorbing unit is started, the amniotic fluid is absorbed by the absorbing head, the absorbing head rotates to one side of the groove, the telescopic unit drives the absorbing head to enter the groove and contact with the annular brush, the rotating brush is driven by the driving unit to rotate, meanwhile, the water conveying pump is communicated with an external water source, cleaning water is input into the groove through the water pipe, the cleaning quality is improved, and finally the telescopic unit drives the absorbing head to be positioned in the annular sterilizing lamp to perform ultraviolet sterilization, so that the absorbing head is automatically cleaned and sterilized without manual operation, and the cleaning efficiency is effectively improved.

title_en: Self-resetting transmission device and mammary gland machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-resetting transmission device and a mammary gland machine, wherein the self-resetting transmission device comprises a frame, a linear guide rail arranged on the frame, a sliding seat moving up and down along the linear guide rail, a synchronous belt mechanism arranged on the frame, a transmission mechanism, a driving mechanism and a coil spring assembly; the driving mechanism is connected to the output end of the driving mechanism, the driving mechanism provides power for the driving mechanism, the synchronous belt mechanism is connected with the driving mechanism, the synchronous belt mechanism is also connected with the coil spring assembly, the coil spring assembly is coaxially connected with the driving mechanism, the sliding seat is connected to the synchronous belt mechanism, the synchronous belt mechanism drives the sliding seat to move, and the driving mechanism drives the synchronous belt mechanism and drives the sliding seat to move downwards along the linear guide rail; the transmission mechanism provides power for storing force for the coil spring assembly, and the coil spring assembly drives the synchronous belt mechanism and drives the sliding seat to move upwards along the linear guide rail. Solves the problem that the breast machine compression plate in the prior art can not automatically relieve the compression on the examination part of the patient under emergency.

title_en: Method, system, electronic equipment and storage medium for calibrating concentration of anesthetic gas
abstract_en: A method, a system, electronic equipment and a storage medium for calibrating concentration of anesthetic gas relate to the field of concentration calibration. In the method, a reference gas set is determined, a first curve model of a first standard gas is constructed according to the relation between the absorbance and the concentration of the first standard gas, and the first standard gas is one gas in the reference gas set; obtaining a first concentration value and a first absorbance value of a second standard gas, calculating a second concentration value of the second standard gas according to the first absorbance value and a first curve model, calculating a first deviation coefficient of the second standard gas according to the first concentration value and the second concentration value, and calibrating the first curve model according to the first deviation coefficient to obtain a second curve model corresponding to the second standard gas, wherein the second standard gas is any gas except the first standard gas in a reference gas set; and acquiring a second absorbance value of the gas to be detected, acquiring the type data of the gas to be detected input by a user, matching a target curve model according to the type data, and determining the concentration value of the gas to be detected according to the second absorbance value and the target curve model. By implementing the technical scheme provided by the application, the effect that other gases and instruments can be calibrated through the first curve model of one gas is achieved.

title_en: Specific protein analyzer for evaluating tumor immunity and tumor immunity evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention provides a specific protein analyzer for evaluating tumor immunity and a tumor immunity evaluating method, comprising a supporting seat and reagent tubes, wherein the top surface of the supporting seat is provided with a transfer box, the rear wall of the transfer box is provided with a detection mechanism, the detection mechanism is in through connection with the inside of the transfer box, a transfer component is arranged in the transfer box, the top surface of the supporting seat is of a concave structure, a sample placement component is arranged in the concave structure of the supporting seat, the top surface of the sample placement component is inserted with a plurality of reagent tubes, the top of each reagent tube is connected with a sealing plug in a sealing way, and one side of the supporting seat is provided with a separation mechanism. According to the invention, the reagent tubes are transferred one by one through the transfer assembly, the human plasma in the reagent tubes is extracted and detected by the detection mechanism, the rest of the reagent tubes and the human plasma in the reagent tubes are continuously transferred between the lower penetrating assembly and the upper penetrating assembly, and the bottoms of the reagent tubes are penetrated through by the lower penetrating assembly, so that the rest of the human plasma flows out to the waste liquid bag, and the convenience of separating the reagent tubes from the human plasma is improved.

title_en: Electrocardiogram classification method based on contrast learning and CHNet model
abstract_en: An electrocardiosignal classification method based on contrast learning and CHNet model relates to the electrocardiosignal classification field, firstly, a label-free electrocardiosignal is subjected to preprocessing operation to obtain signals with uniform sampling frequency and sampling point number specification, a signal input data enhancement layer is subjected to enhancement combination of two different signals to obtain enhanced signals, the enhancement signal codes obtained before are respectively recoded by means of CHNet neural network, and the difference between the two enhancement signal codes is calculated through a designed contrast loss function, namely, the difference between different categories is larger and the difference between the same categories is smaller. Updating CHNet the model according to the difference between the losses, and finally adding a linear layer to realize classification of electrocardiosignals.

title_en: Multifunctional folding wheelchair
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional folding wheelchair, which comprises a chassis assembly, a seat part, a main supporting arm, an auxiliary supporting arm, a rocker arm, a first connecting rod and a driving mechanism, wherein the main supporting arm is arranged on the chassis assembly; the lower end of the main support arm is hinged with the chassis assembly to form a first hinge shaft, the upper end of the main support arm is hinged with the seat assembly to form a second hinge shaft, the lower end of the rocker arm is hinged with the chassis assembly to form a third hinge shaft, the upper end of the rocker arm is hinged with the lower end of the auxiliary support arm to form a fourth hinge shaft, the upper end of the auxiliary support arm is hinged with the seat assembly to form a fifth hinge shaft, and one end of the first connecting rod is hinged with the main support arm to form a sixth hinge shaft. The invention can adjust the height of the seat part, can lower the seat part so that a user can sit on the seat part and get off the seat part more conveniently, can improve the convenience and the safety of the wheelchair, and is more convenient to use.

title_en: Long-service miniature axial flow blood pump
abstract_en: The invention discloses a long-service miniature axial blood pump which comprises a stator assembly, a rotor assembly, a left end bearing, a right end bearing, an impeller, a pre-tightening spring and a frame, wherein the stator assembly comprises a motor shell, a magnetic conduction stator and a stator winding, the motor shell comprises a shell, a left end cover and a right end cover, the rotor assembly comprises a rotating shaft, a permanent magnet and a rotor sleeve, the left end cover is provided with a step hole, the step hole comprises a first hole, a second hole and a third hole, a first gap is reserved between the wall of the first hole and the rotating shaft, the left end bearing and the right end bearing are ball bearings, a second gap and a third gap are reserved between the inner rings of the left end bearing and the right end bearing and the rotating shaft respectively, and the pre-tightening spring exerts elasticity on the inner ring of the left end bearing. The invention adopts two ball bearings to be matched with the rotating shaft, so that the abrasion is obviously reduced, the uncertainty risk caused by the change of the friction state condition is reduced, and the risk of coagulation caused by the backward flow of blood components into the blood pump motor can be prevented.

title_en: Balloon catheter with bracket and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a balloon catheter with a bracket and a use method thereof, wherein the balloon catheter comprises a first catheter, a balloon and a bracket component, the balloon comprises a first accommodating area, and a vascular bracket is arranged in the first accommodating area and can move relative to a first annular wall; when in use, the balloon catheter is stretched into a blood vessel to be dilated; controlling the flow direction of the fluid in the first balloon cavity to repeatedly switch the balloon for preset times in a contracted state and a inflated state; the saccule is moved out of the blood vessel to be dilated after being placed in a contracted state; controlling the vascular stent to protrude out of the first accommodating area, and completing the implantation operation of the vascular stent; by improving the structure of the balloon, the vascular stent is integrated in the first accommodating area in the balloon, the operation required by the vascular stent to be expanded is saved in the whole process, the time interval between the expansion of the balloon and the implantation of the vascular stent is shortened, the probability of the vessel to be expanded being contracted again after the expansion is reduced, and the operation steps are saved.

title_en: Domestic waste transfer station waste water treatment and deodorization integration equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses wastewater treatment and deodorization integrated equipment for a household garbage transfer station, which comprises a building body arranged on an upper layer and a lower layer, wherein a comprehensive treatment bin is arranged in the middle of a first building body positioned below the building body, a membrane treatment assembly is connected to the left side of the comprehensive treatment bin through a sewage pipe, a compression assembly is arranged in the middle of a second building body positioned above the comprehensive treatment bin, a dust removal deodorization room is arranged on the left side of the compression assembly, the compression assembly comprises a driving motor fixedly arranged at the top of the second building body, a telescopic rod is arranged below the driving motor, a compression plate is arranged at the bottom of the telescopic rod, and a spray hole is respectively arranged on the left side and the right side of the compression plate. Aiming at the problem of odor and peculiar smell dissipation during the transportation of the household garbage, the invention can finish the dumping, compression, wastewater discharge and compression block transportation of the household garbage under the totally-enclosed condition, and the whole process is matched with a series of special deodorizing modes for realizing wastewater treatment and deodorization, thereby having convenient operation and good treatment effect.

title_en: Equipment for eliminating static electricity
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device for eliminating static electricity, which comprises: a carrier in contact with human skin; the power supply is arranged on the carrier; the power consumption element is arranged on the carrier, is connected with the power supply through a wire and forms a closed loop; the conducting wire is contacted with the skin of the human body, and after the conducting wire is electrified, the generated electric field and magnetic field disturb the charges accumulated by the human body and drive the charges of the human body to consume. The static electricity of the human body is dynamically eliminated in real time, the human body is ensured to be always kept in a low micro-charge state, and the power consumption components are prevented from being damaged due to the static electricity.

title_en: Integrated transfer flatcar for critical patients
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of transfer vehicles and discloses an integral transfer flat vehicle for critical patients, which comprises a vehicle frame, wherein one side of the vehicle frame is fixedly connected with a pair of parallel sliding rails, a connecting rod is connected between the two sliding rails in a sliding manner, a first electric telescopic rod is fixedly arranged near each sliding rail of the vehicle frame, the first electric telescopic rod is fixedly connected with the connecting rod, a transfer bed is movably arranged on the connecting rod, a pair of supporting parts for supporting bodies are detachably connected on the transfer bed, the integral transfer flat vehicle for critical patients is placed on the transfer bed by adopting two supporting bed parallel and level, a conveyor belt and an air cushion parallel and level, after the transfer of patients, a second electric telescopic rod moving rod retracts, a second connecting hook moves on the transfer bed to drive the two supporting bed to move back to back, a rotating roller is arranged above the supporting bed, rolling is convenient to generate rolling in the process of pulling away of the supporting bed and the back of the patients, pain and waiting time of the patients are reduced during transfer.

title_en: Multi-feature auxiliary diagnosis method based on double-lead ECG signal, terminal and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-feature auxiliary diagnosis method, a terminal and a readable storage medium based on a double-lead ECG signal, which belong to the field of Internet medical treatment, construct a functional framework of a double-lead arrhythmia auxiliary diagnosis system and extract electrocardiosignals in the double-lead arrhythmia auxiliary diagnosis system; collecting electrocardiosignals by using hardware equipment; preprocessing an electrocardiosignal; dividing the electrocardiosignal according to the size and the step length of a preset window; carrying out data normalization processing on the segmented electrocardiosignals; time characteristics, time-frequency characteristics and space characteristics of the electrocardiosignal data are obtained; the time characteristics, the time-frequency characteristics and the space characteristics in the fourth step are fused by adopting a weight addition fusion mode, so that fusion characteristics are obtained; and inputting the fusion characteristics into an SVM classification model to obtain diagnosis parameters. The invention combines the multi-characteristic electrocardiosignals, and can obtain diagnosis parameters with larger information quantity, higher applicability and stronger robustness than a single data model.

title_en: Cerebral apoplexy risk prediction system, cerebral apoplexy risk prediction method and cerebral apoplexy risk prediction data acquisition equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a cerebral apoplexy risk prediction system, a method and data acquisition equipment, wherein the system comprises a data acquisition module and a risk prediction module, the data acquisition module is used for acquiring at least a first bioelectric signal of the right hand, a second bioelectric signal of the left hand, a third bioelectric signal of the right foot and a fourth bioelectric signal of the left foot of a tested object, and at least three paths of differential signals are obtained according to the acquired first bioelectric signal, second bioelectric signal, third bioelectric signal and fourth bioelectric signal of the tested object; the risk prediction module predicts the risk of the stroke of the tested object according to the three-way differential signal and the pre-constructed risk prediction model, and can perform the risk prediction of the stroke noninvasively and conveniently.

title_en: Head side acupoint positioning method and device, acupuncture robot and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a head side surface acupoint positioning method, a head side surface acupoint positioning device, an acupuncture robot and a storage medium, belonging to the technical field of acupoint recognition, wherein the method comprises the following steps: training an acupoint recognition model based on the head side acupoint sample set to obtain a target acupoint recognition model; the head side acupoint sample set comprises a plurality of acupoint sample points and a plurality of support sample points which are positioned on the foot shaoyang gall meridian curve; inputting the head side image to be identified into a target acupoint identification model to obtain a plurality of acupoint positions and a plurality of supporting points; fitting the plurality of hole sites and the plurality of supporting points to obtain a fitting curve; and determining whether the acupoint position needs to be corrected based on the fitting curve, and correcting the acupoint position based on the fitting curve when the acupoint position needs to be corrected, so as to obtain the target acupoint position. The invention improves the positioning accuracy and the positioning efficiency of the acupoints on the side face of the head.

title_en: Hyaluronic acid microsphere and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses hyaluronic acid microspheres and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of hyaluronic acid materials. The particle size distribution of the hyaluronic acid microspheres is 20-70 mu m, the elastic modulus of the hyaluronic acid microspheres under the shearing frequency of 5Hz of a rheometer is 40-800 Pa, and/or the viscous modulus of the hyaluronic acid microspheres under the shearing frequency of 5Hz is 15-1000 Pa, and/or the swelling degree is 15-40, and/or the pushing force is 9-20N, and the like. The preparation method comprises mixing hyaluronic acid or its salt with alkali and water, mixing with crosslinking agent to obtain water phase, mixing water phase with oil phase, emulsifying for the first time, emulsifying for the second time, and removing oil phase, wherein the first and second times of emulsification are respectively carried out at rotation speeds not lower than 1000rpm and 4000 rpm. The hyaluronic acid microsphere can be used as soft tissue filler, can avoid the problems of red swelling, blood vessel blockage and the like, and improves the use safety.

title_en: System, device and method for endoscopic or laparoscopic magnetic navigation
abstract_en: The present invention provides systems, devices, and methods for delivering, deploying, and positioning a magnetic compression device at a desired location, thereby improving the accuracy of anastomosis creation between tissues, organs, and the like.

title_en: Multifunctional health detection intelligent waistband
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional health detection intelligent waistband in the field of intelligent wearing, which comprises a waistband body, wherein the waistband body is provided with a belt length regulator, a motion sensor, a controller, a pressure sensor and a wireless component; the belt length adjuster is used for adjusting the length of the waistband body based on the detection value of the pressure sensor, and the belt length adjuster is used for acquiring waistline data; the motion sensor is used for detecting the motion quantity of a wearer; the controller is used for acquiring waistline data before and after eating by a user, calculating the eating amount, receiving food eating information through the wireless component, and calculating the intake calories based on the food information and the eating amount; the controller is provided with a weight value of a user in advance, and the controller estimates the weight change value of the user by detecting the waistline data change value to obtain the real-time weight of the user. By adopting the technical scheme of the invention, the relationship between the stature change and the food intake and the exercise amount can be established, and the stature management can be assisted for the user.

title_en: Electric rehabilitation machine and rehabilitation training method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric rehabilitation machine and a rehabilitation training method, wherein the device comprises a shell, a gear motor, a pedal assembly, a controller, a vital sign acquisition module and a communication module, wherein the gear motor is arranged in the shell, the gear motor is connected with the pedal assembly and drives the pedal assembly, and the gear motor, the vital sign acquisition module and the communication module are all connected with the controller; the method comprises five steps of S1-S5, the electric rehabilitation machine can be remotely checked and controlled, the electric rehabilitation machine is convenient to use, meanwhile, the electric rehabilitation machine and the mobile equipment can be connected, information of rehabilitation personnel is obtained, and therefore a proper rehabilitation mode is selected, rehabilitation training time is controlled, and rehabilitation training effect is improved.

title_en: Auxiliary device for cornea crosslinking operation
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an auxiliary device for cornea crosslinking operation, wherein the auxiliary device for cornea crosslinking operation comprises a light source assembly, an image acquisition module capable of acquiring an eyeball and an image around the eyeball in real time, and a light path adjusting mechanism; the light path adjusting mechanism can change the light path of the therapeutic light source and form emergent light; the computing module is connected with the image acquisition module and the light path adjusting mechanism; the eye ball and the image around the eye ball are obtained, and the light path of the treatment light source is changed through the light path adjusting mechanism, so that the emergent light can track the outline and the position of the pupil in the eye ball, the emergent light can accurately irradiate the pupil of the eye ball, the irradiation of the treatment light source is not required to be suspended, the continuity of the operation process is improved, the operation efficiency is further improved, and the discomfort of a patient is reduced.

title_en: Surgical instrument
abstract_en: The invention discloses a surgical instrument, comprising: an operating assembly, a jaw assembly connected with the operating assembly, the operating assembly comprising: a frame; a handle rotatably connected to the frame, a linkage assembly including a left link and a right link, the left link and the right link being located on either side of the frame, respectively, the left link being connected to the right link, the handle being operably engaged with the left link and/or the right link to drive the linkage assembly; the jaw assembly moves from an open position to a closed position in response to movement of the linkage assembly. The connecting rod assembly is arranged through the left connecting rod and the right connecting rod, so that the stability of the movement and the locking stability of the connecting rod assembly are improved, and the closing of the jaw assembly and the squeezing of tissues are more stable.

title_en: Security check disinfection all-in-one that many scenes were killed and are used
abstract_en: The invention provides a security inspection and disinfection integrated machine with multiple scene disinfection applications, which comprises a central control system, a conveying device, and a first disinfection area, an X-ray security inspection area, an air knife defrosting area, a second disinfection area and an atomization disinfection area which are sequentially arranged along the conveying direction; the conveying device comprises a power roller and a conveying belt, and the conveying belt is a grid conveying belt; the power rollers are distributed below the conveyor belt, the power rollers arranged below one section of conveyor belt are distributed in a staggered manner at high and low positions, and the one section of conveyor belt is correspondingly arranged in the area of the UV disinfection area; the first killing area comprises a plurality of first killing lamp groups, and the first killing lamp groups are arranged on the upper, lower, left and right surfaces of the conveyor belt; the air knife defrosting area is arranged at the inlet of the second sterilizing area; the second killing area comprises a plurality of second killing lamp groups, and the second killing lamp groups are arranged on the upper, lower, left and right surfaces of the conveyor belt; the atomization sterilizing area comprises a sterilizing box and a plurality of atomization spray heads, and the atomization spray heads are arranged on the upper surface, the lower surface, the left surface and the right surface of the conveyor belt.

title_en: CT-based large airway stenosis patient lung function prediction method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of medical data intellectualization, and particularly provides a CT-based method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for predicting lung function of a patient with large airway stenosis, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring CT image data of a patient with a large airway stenosis, extracting airway data from the image data, and performing three-dimensional reconstruction by using a convolution surface technology to generate an airway model; the airway model includes a stenosis model and a normal model; inputting the lung function statistical data into a normal model for simulation, generating simulation data of the normal model, and then transplanting the simulation data of the normal model into a narrow model for simulation by taking the simulation data of the normal model as input, so as to generate the simulation data of the narrow model; and inputting the current patient simulation data into the established lung function prediction model, and outputting a predicted value of the lung function of the current large airway stenosis patient. Airway data can be extracted more accurately, and further accuracy of lung function assessment is improved.

title_en: Thyroid gland microwave ablation instrument
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of medical instruments, and discloses a thyroid microwave ablation instrument, which solves the problems that a display is inconvenient to store and a fastener provided by a caster wheel can not provide enough stability. Thyroid gland microwave ablation appearance, which comprises a housin, casing bottom fixed connection base, and the base bottom rotates and is connected with the gyro wheel to the inside sliding connection of casing has the ablation appearance host computer, and is provided with the display screen on the ablation appearance host computer, the relative one side sliding connection of casing top lateral wall has the apron, and fixedly connected with fixture block on the apron, and sliding connection has the second rack in the casing, casing internal rotation installs with second rack complex auxiliary gear, and this thyroid gland microwave ablation appearance can accomodate the instrument when not using, reduces the damage and the wearing and tearing that the instrument received, and then prolongs its life, can adjust the display and highly adjust simultaneously, improves the application range of device.

title_en: Trunk feeling and motor function training chair
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of cerebral apoplexy rehabilitation training, in particular to a trunk feeling and motor function training chair which can solve the problems that the traditional treatment method is difficult to act on the trunk, a therapist needs to consume a large physical force party to induce the movement of the trunk, the traditional trunk function training method lacks interestingness, and the participation of patients is low. Including the base, the fixed vertical electric telescopic handle that is equipped with of base upside, electric telescopic handle top is fixed to be equipped with can the front and back side-to-side wobbling regulation structure, and regulation structure upside demountable installation has the seat. The adjusting structure comprises a disc, a downward-convex semicircular supporting block is arranged above the disc, a vertical support is fixedly arranged on the bottom surface of the supporting block, a ball head is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the support, the ball head is rotatably embedded in a ball sleeve with an upper opening, the bottom of the ball sleeve is fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the disc, and adjusting assemblies capable of adjusting supporting amplitude are fixedly arranged on the discs around the supporting block respectively. The device is simple to operate, convenient to use and suitable for various patients.

title_en: Continuum robot detection device and method based on fiber Bragg grating sensing
abstract_en: The invention provides a continuum robot detection device and method based on fiber Bragg grating sensing, which is used for force sensing in a narrow space, and adopts a design formed by a small-scale fiber Bragg grating and a continuum robot, and comprises an injector for completing the work of injecting medicines and the like in an auditory canal, a camera for providing real-time continuum terminal visual information, and a Fiber Bragg Grating (FBG) for providing real-time continuum contact force information, the invention solves the problem of multifunctional integration of the diagnosis and treatment continuum robot in the narrow space of the auditory canal, greatly reduces the overall size of the continuum robot, and solves the problem of force perception of the small-scale continuum robot in the narrow space of the auditory canal by combining the fiber Bragg grating sensor and the Cosserat rod model, and provides contact force information in real time, including the size and the direction of the contact force and the contact position.

title_en: Shoulder joint prosthesis for proximal humerus fracture
abstract_en: The invention provides a shoulder joint prosthesis for proximal humerus fracture, and relates to the technical field of artificial prostheses. Including the humerus handle, be provided with locating component in the humerus handle, first connecting hole has been seted up at the top of humerus handle, one side of humerus handle is provided with the locating piece, the second connecting hole has been seted up on the locating piece, peg graft in the second connecting hole has positioning bolt, positioning bolt's one end threaded connection is in first connecting hole, one side threaded connection of locating piece has the spacer assembly, the opposite side of spacer assembly peg graft there is the bulb, one side cooperation of bulb is connected with shoulder spittoon prosthesis, the humerus handle is pegged graft on human humerus. According to the invention, the positioning component and the spacing component are arranged, so that the difficulty in mounting the shoulder joint prosthesis of a patient with proximal humerus fracture can be reduced, and the condition that a bolt is loosened due to long-time use of the shoulder joint prosthesis can be avoided.

title_en: Foot correcting device
abstract_en: The application provides a foot correction device, which relates to the technical field of medical appliances and comprises: the inside of the fixing seat is provided with a lifting motor, the output end of the lifting motor extends to the inside of the cavity, a threaded rod is connected with a lifting block on the surface of the threaded rod, one side of the lifting block is movably connected with one side of the foot placement plate, the leg fixing assembly is arranged in the leg fixing shell, the inside of the leg fixing shell is provided with a rotating motor, and the output end of the rotating motor extends to the outside of the leg fixing shell and is connected with the top of the fixing seat; starting up elevator motor makes the threaded rod rotate, and then makes the threaded rod carry out the altitude mixture change under the screw thread effect, and the threaded block is placed the swing joint effect of board with the foot down, can make the foot place the board realize using the ankle as the left and right angle change of axis, and starts up the rotating electrical machines and drives the foot through the fixing base and place the board and realize using the ankle as the front and back angle change of axis, and then satisfies patient's correction needs.

title_en: Magnetic attraction type aromatherapy clothes hanger
