abstract_en: The invention provides a magnetic aromatherapy clothes rack, which relates to the technical field of furniture articles and aims to solve the problems that a conveyer belt is easy to slip and deviate in the operation process of a conveyer belt turning machine in the prior art, the magnetic aromatherapy clothes rack comprises a clothes rack body, a hook and an aromatherapy box, the clothes rack body is rotatably connected with the lower side of the hook, the clothes hanger comprises a hanger body, a hook, a first magnet, a second magnet, a mounting part, a mounting groove, a first magnet and a second magnet, wherein the mounting part is arranged on the hanger body right below the hook, the mounting groove is used for accommodating the aromatherapy box, the first magnet is arranged in the mounting groove, the second magnet is arranged on the aromatherapy box, and the aromatherapy box is mounted in the mounting groove through the attraction of the first magnet and the second magnet. The magnetic aromatherapy clothes hanger disclosed by the invention does not need to be taken down integrally, the aroma in the taken down aromatherapy box is only needed to be replaced, and the replaced aromatherapy box is installed in the installation groove through the magnetic attraction effect, so that the magnetic aromatherapy clothes hanger is convenient to assemble and disassemble, quick to operate and convenient to use.

title_en: Modularized flexible lower limb exoskeleton robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to medical rehabilitation training equipment, in particular to a modularized flexible lower limb exoskeleton robot. The device comprises a control part, a driving part, a transmission part, a hip joint body part and an ankle joint body part, wherein the driving part is communicated with the control part, the driving part is connected with the hip joint body part and the ankle joint body part through the transmission part, the hip joint body part is arranged at the hip joint of a human body, the ankle joint body part is arranged at the ankle joint of the human body, and the driving part controls the hip joint body part and the ankle joint body part through the transmission part to assist the movement of lower limbs. The invention has compact structure, small size, easy wearing, light weight and portability, has high adjustability, can adapt to the wearing of people with different body types, adopts a separated modularized design principle, and can configure a power-assisted mode according to specific requirements so as to meet the use requirements of different users in different environments.

title_en: Sustained-release long-acting disinfection control method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a continuous slow-release long-acting disinfection control method, belonging to the technical field of biological safety, sanitation, disinfection, prevention and control. Wherein the method comprises the following steps: the compound disinfection factors taking ozone as a main control factor are released indoors through disinfection equipment; an initialization disinfection process of rapid filling is carried out on the room; acquiring indoor environment information; setting a site prevention and control grade by identifying and analyzing the environmental information; setting the continuous retention time and equivalent of the concentration of the disinfection factors through the on-site prevention and control level, and controlling the ozone generator equipment to adopt a slow-release mode to balance the output equivalent with the loss and the reduction equivalent of the ozone composite disinfection factors, thereby stably maintaining the low concentration level of the disinfection factors such as indoor ozone and the like; the safe and stable low-concentration ozone realizes the long-acting disinfection control of the bioaerosol virus and the purpose of carrying out all-time all-round active continuous long-acting disinfection on the bacterial virus more timely and more efficiently.

title_en: Algorithm for analyzing and calculating disease behaviors of cattle and sheep
abstract_en: The invention provides an algorithm for analyzing and calculating the behavior of diseases of cattle and sheep, which comprises the following steps: step one: feeding monitoring capsules to cattle and sheep which are not monitored to monitor; step two: acquiring activity data of the monitored cattle and sheep through a monitoring capsule, and transmitting the monitored activity data to a platform for data analysis; step three: analyzing the received activity data through the platform; step four: judging whether the cattle and sheep have diseases or not according to the analysis result; the monitoring capsule in the cattle and sheep body is used for comprehensively acquiring the activity data, the body temperature data and the sleep time data of the cattle and sheep, so that the defect of incomplete information collection in the traditional manual observation method is overcome; the health status of the cattle and sheep can be accurately estimated through algorithm analysis, and the monitoring accuracy is improved.

title_en: Disposable negative pressure drainage tube auxiliary stand
abstract_en: The invention provides a disposable negative pressure drainage tube auxiliary support, which belongs to the technical field of drainage tube auxiliary supports, and comprises a universal adjusting seat group, wherein a plurality of support leg seats are sleeved on the side of the universal adjusting seat group at equal intervals according to an annular array, a support frame group is vertically and movably connected to each support leg seat, the top surface of the universal adjusting seat group is communicated with a drainage tube clamp to form an auxiliary support of a drainage tube, the auxiliary support is stably supported at three points and is adhered and fixed with the body surface of a patient, the drainage tube is not adhered and fixed by oblique pressure after being inserted, the drainage tube can be straighter and free from bending phenomenon, the communication of the drainage tube is prevented from becoming smaller, and the drainage effect is influenced.

title_en: Broken tube connector for nerve intervention operation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a broken tube connector for a nerve intervention operation, which comprises the following components: the device comprises a passage conduit, a broken pipe cover, a conduit wrapping rubber sleeve and a conduit connecting assembly, wherein the passage conduit is divided into a broken pipe connecting assembly, a broken pipe connecting sorting assembly and a broken pipe single connecting assembly, the broken pipe cover is arranged at a penetrating position on the passage conduit, the conduit wrapping rubber sleeve is movably arranged at a pipe connecting position on one side of the broken pipe cover, and the passage conduit penetrates through the broken pipe cover and the inside of the conduit wrapping rubber sleeve and is used for butt-joint locking of the passage conduit. The invention provides a tube breaking cover and a built-in latch bolt, an intervention operation catheter is inserted into the tube breaking cover and the built-in latch bolt for secondary connection, a nerve intervention operation catheter is connected with the inner sides of a locking latch sleeve and a latch groove for installation and package, connection interception is carried out according to requirements in the nerve intervention operation, and the tube breaking connection latch is carried out by adopting the catheter to package a rubber sleeve, the tube breaking cover and the built-in latch bolt.

title_en: Hemorrhoid operation system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hemorrhoid operation system which comprises a safety blocking component, a cavity inner radial feeding and drainage knife set and a cavity inner negative pressure forced silt discharging component, wherein the safety blocking component is used for being sealed with the inner wall of an intestinal canal to block the downward flow of intestinal excrement, the cavity inner radial feeding and drainage knife set is used for puncturing a focus, and the cavity inner negative pressure forced silt discharging component is used for performing negative pressure on the punctured focus to discharge silt. The hemorrhoid operation system can prevent the intestinal excrement from flowing downwards to avoid the infection of an operation wound, can dredge a blood stasis discharge channel by puncturing a cyst at a hemorrhoid focus, and can forcefully discharge the blood stasis in the cyst by using an intracavity negative pressure forced blood stasis discharge assembly.

title_en: Mechanical arm positioning control method and orthopedic operation robot system
abstract_en: The invention provides a mechanical arm positioning control method and an orthopedic operation robot system, wherein the mechanical arm positioning control method comprises the following steps: acquiring the relative pose of the target feature on the bone model and the pose of the current osteotomy guiding surface; acquiring target parameters related to the relevant pose of the target feature and the current pose of the osteotomy guiding surface; and judging whether the current osteotomy guiding surface and the planned osteotomy surface are converged or not according to the target parameters. The application of the method can improve the positioning precision of the mechanical arm and improve the osteotomy effect.

title_en: Medical scientific research project informationized management system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of informatization management of medical scientific research projects, and discloses an informatization management system and method of medical scientific research projects, wherein the informatization management system comprises the following steps: the system comprises a project management module, a subject management module, a form management module, a medicine and biological sample management module, a message reminding module, a file management module and a data analysis and report generation module. The test data of medical scientific research projects can be flexibly and comprehensively recorded, data analysis is automatically carried out, professional reports are generated, and the working efficiency of medical scientific research workers is improved.

title_en: Clinical anesthesia intubate auxiliary device for department of anesthesia
abstract_en: The invention discloses a clinical anesthesia intubation auxiliary device for anesthesia department, which relates to the field of medical appliances and comprises a biting sleeve main body, wherein an installation outer frame is fixedly installed on the outer wall of the biting sleeve main body, and two side walls of the installation outer frame are fixedly connected with installation elastic binding bands so as to fix the position of the whole biting sleeve main body. According to the invention, a patient bites the biting sleeve, the tube body for inserting the tube penetrates through the limiting movable frame to penetrate into the pharyngeal portion of the patient, and meanwhile, the limiting movable frame is stirred in a homeopathic mode to drive the tongue depressor mounted with the limiting movable frame to push down the tongue, so that medical staff can perform intubation operation better, the follow-up tongue depressor needs to be detached and replaced, and the elastic plastic sheet is pushed down to enable the sawtooth block at the top of the elastic plastic sheet to leave behind the sawtooth groove matched with the sawtooth block, so that the tongue depressor can be pulled out of the mounting buckle groove, and the tongue depressor can be taken down.

title_en: Multimode fusion detection device based on optical pumping technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a multimode fusion detection device based on an optical pumping technology, and relates to the field of brain-computer interfaces. In the device, a laser generating module comprises a first laser outlet and a second pulse laser outlet, wherein the first laser outlet is aligned with a first laser inlet of an atomic air chamber, the second pulse laser outlet is aligned with a path control inlet included by a laser path control module, and a detection port of the atomic air chamber is aligned with a preset area; the laser path control module further comprises a path control exit, and the path control exit is aligned to a preset area; the laser receiving port of the photoelectric detection module is aligned with the first laser outlet of the atomic gas chamber; the detection point of the ultrasonic detection module is associated with a preset area; the photoelectric detection module and the ultrasonic detection module are respectively and electrically connected with the data processing module. The device can realize multi-mode fusion detection at the same position and at the same time through hardware multiplexing, and simultaneously can reduce the volume of equipment and avoid serial disturbance among multi-mode sensors as much as possible.

title_en: Medical surgical instrument fixing device
abstract_en: The application belongs to the field of medical instruments, and particularly relates to a medical surgical instrument fixing device which comprises a carrier, an external fixing component, a snake-shaped arm, a stretching device and a clamping component, wherein the snake-shaped arm and the stretching device are arranged on the carrier, the clamping component for clamping a surgical instrument is arranged at one end of the snake-shaped arm far away from the carrier, the external fixing component is used for fixing the carrier to the outside, when the connecting wire in the snake-shaped arm is in a loose state in use, the gesture of the snake-shaped arm is adjusted, so that the surgical instrument clamped by the clamping component at the front end of the snake-shaped arm reaches a required position and angle, and then the gesture of the snake-shaped arm is fixed by tensioning the connecting wire through the stretching device. The medical surgical instrument fixing device can be used for adjusting any omnibearing degree of freedom of a surgical instrument, is convenient to adjust, is not interfered by any outside, can completely replace medical staff supporting instruments, saves human resources, and effectively saves space resources of a surgical operation area with limited space.

title_en: Medical knowledge learning recommendation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a medical knowledge learning recommendation method and a system in the technical field of medical knowledge learning recommendation, wherein the method comprises the following steps: classifying each medical knowledge based on the type characteristics of the medical knowledge to obtain medical knowledge types, and generating test questions corresponding to medical knowledge contents of each department based on the medical knowledge types to obtain a medical knowledge question bank; basic information of a student is collected; determining a learning subject of the learner based on the basic information of the learner; based on the medical knowledge system, matching medical knowledge points corresponding to the learning subjects of the students to obtain planned learning knowledge points of the students; based on the medical knowledge question base, matching test questions corresponding to the learning knowledge points of the scholars, and testing the scholars to obtain test results; and judging the mastering degree of the learner on the learning knowledge points of the single-class plan based on the test result. The recommended medical knowledge can be more personalized, and the comprehensiveness of the learner on the medical knowledge is improved.

title_en: Artistic voice quality objective evaluation method based on voice medical inspection data
abstract_en: The invention discloses an artistic voice quality objective evaluation method based on voice medical inspection data, belongs to the technical field of artistic voice quality evaluation, and aims to provide an artistic voice quality objective evaluation method based on voice medical inspection data, and solve the problem of low efficiency of an existing artistic voice quality evaluation mode. Which comprises the following steps: (1) selecting a tested person and a verified person; (2) data collection of tested personnel; (3) The data were collated by ibm SPSS 26.0 software, correlation and regression analysis were performed, and a linear evaluation model was established. And substituting ten groups of samples in the verification set into the model for calculation, and carrying out reliability analysis on the measured data and subjective scores through statistical software to verify the accuracy of the data and subjective scores. The invention is suitable for an artistic voice quality objective evaluation method based on voice medical inspection data.

title_en: Implant pushing device and implant pushing system
abstract_en: The application discloses an implant pushing device which comprises a pushing component, a containing piece and at least one fixing wire, wherein the pushing component is provided with a proximal end and a distal end, the containing piece is arranged at the distal end and is provided with a containing groove for containing a protruding structure of an implant, the fixing wire is used for penetrating the implant, and the free end of the fixing wire extends and is fixed at the proximal end. The umbrella-shaped structures of the implants of different types can be fixed at the distal end of the pushing component in a winding way through the accommodating grooves of the accommodating pieces for accommodating the protruding structures on one side of the umbrella-shaped structures of the implants, so that the implant pushing device provided by the application can be matched with the plugging devices of different types, thereby being convenient for medical staff to use and saving cost. Meanwhile, as the fixing wire has certain flexibility, the shape of the plugging part of different patients can be used for tilting at a certain angle in the process of releasing the implant, so that a better plugging effect is achieved.

title_en: Medical waste classification treatment device and treatment method for operating room
abstract_en: The invention discloses a medical waste classification treatment device for an operating room, in particular to the technical field of operating rooms, which comprises a bottom frame, wherein the bottom end of the bottom frame is provided with a positioning universal wheel, the output shaft of a second motor is connected with a first fixing rod through a coupling, one side fixedly connected with sealed lid of regulation pole, the outer wall of first dead lever is provided with the driver, the outer wall fixedly connected with drive gear of No. two transfer lines, the other end fixedly connected with spraying sterilizer subassembly of ratch. This a medical waste classification processing apparatus for operating room is through the driver, drive gear, rack and the spraying sterilizer subassembly that set up to the staff has been made things convenient for when opening and shutting sealed lid accomplish the extraction and the transport of antiseptic solution, has solved the problem that the first time that current medical waste classification garbage bin stored can't disinfect, and then has improved the staff and has carried out the efficiency of first time processing to medical waste classification garbage bin.

title_en: Safety management system for construction site of foundation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a safety management system for a construction site of a building, which relates to the technical field of construction of the building, and comprises a pre-acquisition module for the construction site of the building, a safety grading module for the construction site of the building, an equipment layout evaluation module, an equipment monitoring module, an early warning processing terminal, a display terminal and a web database; according to the health condition index of each working personnel in the current construction, the risk working personnel in the current construction are judged by combining the adjusted health condition threshold, the defect that the risk working personnel in the current construction are neglected in the prior art is overcome, and when emergency equipment is difficult to use in time, the health of the working personnel is ensured, and the casualties are avoided.

title_en: Periodic signal determination method, program product and device
abstract_en: A periodic signal judging method is implemented by a processing device, comprising the following steps: sampling the signal S at time intervals t to obtain (k+1) signal values S (t0+i·t), wherein i=0 to k; making a two-dimensional point diagram on an XY coordinate plane, wherein coordinates (x, y) of each point in the two-dimensional point diagram are (S (t0+i.t), S (t0+ (i+1) t)), and i=0 to (k-1); calculating the scattering degree of the two-dimensional point diagram; determining the relative relation between the scattering degree and the characteristic of the periodic signal and generating a determination result; and outputting the determination result.

title_en: Electric training wheelchair with intelligent auxiliary function
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric training wheelchair with an intelligent auxiliary function, which relates to the technical field of electric wheelchairs and comprises a braking mechanism, a bogie, a transverse training mechanism, a vertical training mechanism and a frame, wherein the wheelchair is fixedly connected to the upper side of the frame, wheels are movably connected to the two sides of the wheelchair, the vertical training mechanism is arranged between the wheels and the frame, the bogie is movably connected to one side of the frame far away from the wheelchair, a guide wheel is fixedly connected to the lower part of the bogie, the transverse training mechanism is arranged between the bogie and the frame, a mounting plate is fixedly connected to the lower part of the wheelchair, the braking mechanism is arranged between the bogie and the mounting plate, and a foot bracket is driven to reciprocate through a driving rod and an eccentric wheel to promote the vertical swing of a patient.

title_en: Muscle bone pain rehabilitation suspension trainer
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rehabilitation training, in particular to a muscle and bone pain rehabilitation suspension trainer, which comprises a top frame, wherein an installation cavity is formed in the top frame in a penetrating manner, a transverse moving seat is transversely and reciprocally installed in the installation cavity in a sliding manner, a training belt is sleeved at a to-be-rehabilitated part of a patient to be rehabilitated, the gravity of the body of the patient to be rehabilitated is utilized to drive a sliding rod to pull a top plate, so that an extrusion block at the bottom of the top plate is extruded and abutted in the transverse moving seat, the fixing of two sliding rod positions is realized, the operation steps can be reduced, the operation efficiency can be improved, the integral height of the training belt is adjusted, the up-and-down movement is realized, the training effect is improved, the contact part between the training belt and the to-be-rehabilitated part of the patient to be rehabilitated can be adjusted through the reverse driving of a winding motor, and the to repeatedly roll the to-be rehabilitated part of the patient to be rehabilitated by utilizing a plurality of rotating rollers on the surface of the training belt, and the problems of muscle injury, unsmooth blood circulation and the like are not easy to occur at the same time.

title_en: Device and method for producing hard capsules of health products
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a method for producing hard capsules of health products, which belong to the technical field of capsule filling machines, and the device comprises a rotary table, wherein the edge of the rotary table is provided with a capsule processing structure, the motion track of the capsule processing structure sequentially passes through an arrangement station, a metering filling station and a discharging station, the capsule processing structure comprises a filling seat, the filling seat is provided with a capsule groove with an opening at the top, which corresponds to a capsule directional arrangement device, the side surface of the capsule groove is provided with a filling hole, which corresponds to the capsule filling machine, and the bottom of the capsule groove is provided with a pneumatic tube for controlling separation and closing of a capsule and a colloid.

title_en: Removable dust cap and tamper evident feature for syringe
abstract_en: A fluid path connector assembly for a medical fluid delivery system includes a connector element having a body, a lumen extending through the body, and a pair of flexible legs connected to the body, each flexible leg having a flange. The connector assembly also includes a dust cap removably connected to the connector element. The dust cap includes a dust cap body positioned between the flexible legs to enclose the interior cavity, and an engagement element positioned at a distal end of the dust cap body. The engagement element contacts the flange of the flexible leg to prevent the dust cap from disengaging from the connector element while allowing medical personnel to easily remove the dust cap. Removable/breakable tamper-and/or tamper-evident and/or tamper-resistant features connecting the dust cap to the connector element are also disclosed.

title_en: Transcranial ultrasonic multi-frequency acoustic holographic lens design method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transcranial ultrasonic multi-frequency acoustic holographic lens design method and system, comprising the following steps of setting a plurality of different focusing points, setting the plurality of different focusing points as sound sources in Matlab by using a k-wave tool box respectively by using a time inversion method, carrying out simulation experiments by using a plurality of driving frequencies respectively, capturing phases at a plane where an ultrasonic transducer is placed to obtain a plurality of acoustic holograms, extracting effective information of the plurality of acoustic holograms, integrating the effective information into a multi-frequency acoustic hologram, and extracting phase information of the multi-frequency acoustic holograms to be converted into the height of each pixel of the acoustic holographic lens after the transcranial multi-frequency acoustic holograms are obtained. The multi-frequency transcranial focusing based on the multi-frequency acoustic holographic lens is realized by extracting effective information in a plurality of acoustic holographic lenses with different working frequencies and focusing on different positions and integrating the effective information into one multi-frequency acoustic holographic lens, and corresponding focuses are rebuilt on a focusing plane according to different driving frequencies, so that the flexibility in transcranial focusing is realized, and the application potential is improved.

title_en: Ceramic-hydrogel composite bone scaffold and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of composite gradient materials, and in particular relates to a ceramic-hydrogel composite bone scaffold, and a preparation method and application thereof, comprising the following steps of (1) mixing temperature-sensitive hydrogel with phosphate buffer aqueous solution to form temperature-sensitive hydrogel solution; the method comprises the steps of (1) immersing a ceramic scaffold in a temperature-sensitive hydrogel solution obtained in the step, (2) carrying out ultrasonic treatment and crosslinking reaction to obtain a temperature-sensitive hydrogel permeated ceramic scaffold, (3) mixing and swelling the photosensitive hydrogel with deionized water to form a photosensitive hydrogel solution, (4) immersing the temperature-sensitive hydrogel permeated ceramic scaffold obtained in the step (2) in the photosensitive hydrogel solution obtained in the step (3), and carrying out stirring and ultraviolet irradiation to obtain the ceramic-hydrogel composite bone scaffold. The two hydrogel solutions are respectively permeated into the ceramic bone scaffold, the defects of the pure ceramic scaffold in the aspects of osteogenesis performance and osteoinduction activity are overcome, and the stem cells are favorably recruited to grow into the bone scaffold.

title_en: Medicament supplementing method, medicament supplementing device, electronic device and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a medicament supplementing method, a medicament supplementing device, electronic equipment and a computer readable storage medium, which relate to the technical field of medicaments and are applied to a traditional Chinese medicine medicament management system; the method comprises the steps of judging whether the residual quantity is smaller than a preset early warning value, determining the medicament with the residual quantity smaller than the early warning value as a target medicament, generating a medicament shortage notification bill based on the target medicament, supplementing the target medicament based on the medicament shortage notification bill, automatically generating a medicament shortage notification bill by automatically acquiring the residual quantity of the medicament, supplementing the medicament according to the medicament shortage notification bill, simplifying medicament supplementing flow, improving medicament supplementing efficiency, reducing customer complaints and improving user experience.

title_en: Intelligent thrombus sucking and cutting system
abstract_en: The application discloses an intelligent thrombus sucking and cutting system, and belongs to the field of medical instruments. The system adopts a double pressure sensor design and an intelligent pressure feedback control technology, and accurately identifies the suction state (sucking blood, sucking thrombus or complete blockage) by monitoring the pressure changes in the negative pressure pump pipeline and the suction catheter in real time and combining with historical data analysis. The system automatically adjusts parameters such as a pipeline control valve, a negative pressure pump, a peristaltic pump and the like according to the parameters, and intelligent optimization control of the pumping process is realized. The novel double-cavity catheter integrated design integrates the functions of sucking and breaking thrombus, and when the fully blocked state is judged, the breaking thrombus process can be automatically or manually started, thrombus can be quickly broken through high-speed liquid impact or thrombolytic drug injection, and long-time suction catheter blocking can be effectively prevented. The system remarkably improves the thrombus suction efficiency, reduces the blood loss of patients, optimizes the operation process and has good clinical application prospect.

title_en: Cerium oxide-based nano material for repairing bone defect, preparation method thereof and cerium oxide-based composite bone scaffold
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cerium oxide-based nano material for repairing bone defects and a preparation method thereof. The cerium oxide-based nanomaterial for repairing bone defects is prepared by carrying out surface modification on cerium oxide-based nano enzyme, wherein the surface modification comprises the introduction of targeting ligands and/or carbon quantum dots into the cerium oxide-based nano enzyme. The invention also discloses a cerium oxide-based composite bone scaffold which is prepared by compounding cerium oxide-based nano-enzyme and/or cerium oxide-based nano-material with bone tissue engineering material through a compounding step.

title_en: Treatment head angle distribution method and device for multi-beam radiation treatment system
abstract_en: The invention provides a treatment head angle distribution method and a system for a multi-beam radiation treatment system, which belong to the technical field of medical equipment, acquire ray beam angle data used for treatment of patients, input the acquired ray beam angle data into an angle distribution optimization model for solving to obtain a treatment head angle distribution result, wherein a single variable is used for representing the angle of each treatment head, the allowable variation range of the angle is defined as a constraint condition of the variable, the consistency between the treatment angle provided by a treatment machine and the angle required by treatment is defined as an optimization objective function, an angle distribution optimization model is established, and the treatment head is adjusted based on the acquired treatment head angle distribution result to enable the treatment head to be positioned at the angle required by treatment. The invention determines the relative angle relation between the ray beam directions, so that the ray beam angle of the flash radiotherapy machine meets the radiation treatment requirements of tumors at different parts of different patients, and accurately realizes the irradiation angles required by the fixed field intensity modulated radiotherapy of all patients.

title_en: Small-caliber artificial blood vessel and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a small-caliber artificial blood vessel and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of biomedicine. The invention dissolves solid polymer material in hexafluoroisopropanol to obtain spinning solution A, mixes and dissolves polydeoxyribonucleotide and procyanidine in water to obtain spinning solution B, and performs electrostatic spinning on the spinning solution A and the spinning solution B to obtain small-caliber artificial blood vessel. The PDRN and the PC are simultaneously used for preparing the small-caliber artificial blood vessel, the preparation process is simple, the use is convenient, the production cost is low, and the prepared artificial blood vessel has better biocompatibility, can promote the endothelialization of the blood vessel and has the function of resisting the adhesion of blood platelets.

title_en: System and method for performing ultrasound imaging
abstract_en: Systems and methods for performing ultrasound imaging. Ultrasound information of the object region may be acquired in response to ultrasound pulses emitted toward the object region. The ultrasound information may include reflection information responsive to the ultrasound pulse and supplemental information to the reflection information of the subject region. One or more ultrasound images of at least a portion of the object region may be formed from the reflection information. Further, the one or more ultrasound images may be modified based on the supplemental information to the pair of reflection information to generate one or more enhanced ultrasound images from the one or more ultrasound images.

title_en: Method and device for generating personalized diagnosis and treatment scheme of traditional Chinese medicine
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of medical treatment, in particular to a method for generating a personalized diagnosis and treatment scheme of traditional Chinese medicine, which comprises the steps of obtaining medical record data related to traditional Chinese medicine from multiple sources, analyzing the medical record data to obtain potential association rule data, establishing a corresponding traditional Chinese medicine knowledge graph based on the association rule data, obtaining health data of a patient, generating corresponding diagnosis and treatment suggestion data based on the traditional Chinese medicine knowledge graph and the health data, wherein the health data comprises symptoms and physique of the patient, sending the health data and the corresponding diagnosis and treatment suggestion data to different user sides, obtaining diagnosis and treatment feedback data of each user side, optimizing the diagnosis and treatment suggestion data based on all the diagnosis and treatment feedback data, and determining a corresponding target diagnosis and treatment scheme. The application can improve the diagnosis and treatment effect of traditional Chinese medicine.

title_en: Pre-filled needle suitable for low-temperature preservation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a pre-filling needle suitable for low-temperature preservation, which comprises a needle tube, wherein the front end of the needle tube is provided with a first joint, the tail end of the needle tube is provided with a flange with a convex edge, the first joint is connected with a second joint through threads to form a luer joint, the luer joint is provided with an exhaust structure communicated with the outside, and the plane of the tail part of the flange with the convex edge is provided with a reinforcing rib protruding outwards of the needle tube. The prefilled needle aims at the structural integrity problem of the prefilled syringe in a low-temperature environment, and the adaptability, stability and sealing performance of the prefilled needle in the freezing and redissolution processes are remarkably improved through the design of the exhaust structure on the luer connector and the reinforcing ribs of the tail flange.

title_en: Screening method for early stage of varicocele susceptible population
abstract_en: The invention discloses a screening method for early stages of varicocele susceptible people, which comprises the following steps of collecting basic information of a person to be tested, taking off whole body clothes of the person to be tested, standing 1 meter away from a detection probe of a detection instrument, slightly separating legs, holding heads of two hands, exposing armpits at two sides, shooting a first infrared thermogram, measuring core temperature of a body, turning 45 DEG at the right side of the person to be tested, enabling the tip of a penis to lean on the center of an abdominal wall upwards, turning 45 DEG at the left side of the person to be tested, shooting a second infrared thermogram, measuring the surface temperature of the left scrotum, turning 45 DEG at the left side of the person to be tested, enabling the tip of the penis to lean on the center of the abdominal wall upwards at the left side of the person to be tested, turning the pubic hair at the right side of the person to be tested, shooting a third infrared thermogram, measuring the surface temperature of the right scrotum, collecting relevant data, analyzing, screening the varicocele susceptible people, and performing intervention in advance, so as to reduce the occurrence rate of varicocele.

title_en: Hearing test method, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a hearing test method, a device and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of hearing aids, wherein the hearing test method comprises the steps of acquiring first facial feature data of a user before playing test sound, acquiring second facial feature data of the user after playing the test sound, processing the first facial feature data and the second facial feature data to determine facial change data of the user, processing the facial change data based on a pre-trained hearing evaluation model to determine the hearing loss degree of the user under the condition of hearing the test sound, and adjusting the volume amplification degree of the hearing aid according to the hearing loss degree.

title_en: Alarm instrument for automatically monitoring delirium by wearable sensor
abstract_en: The invention provides an alarm instrument for automatically monitoring delirium by a wearable sensor, and relates to the field of medical instruments. The wearable sensor is used for automatically monitoring delirium and comprises a controller, a wearing sensor, a photoelectric sensor and a detection electrode, wherein the detection electrode is connected to the outer side of the wearing sensor, the photoelectric sensor is arranged in the wearing sensor, the photoelectric sensor and the wearing sensor are connected with the controller, and the output end of the controller is connected with a receiving terminal. The alarm for monitoring delirium is applied to early detection of delirium of a patient, and early detection of delirium of the patient can improve prognosis of the patient, reduce hospitalization time, medical cost and death rate, and avoid falling down and falling down caused by cognitive abnormality due to delirium.

title_en: Denture base
abstract_en: The invention discloses a denture base, which relates to the technical field of denture bases and comprises a denture base and a denture crown, wherein an implant is arranged below the denture base, an inner hexagonal hole is formed in the surface of the top end of the implant, a screw hole is formed in the implant, a mounting groove is formed in the denture base, a placing groove is further formed in the denture base, a through hole is formed in the bottom of the denture base, a central screw is arranged in the denture base, and a sealing ring is arranged in the placing groove. The denture base has the advantages of convenience in installation, stability, reliability, convenience in maintenance and the like, and the denture crown can be more firmly installed by utilizing the inclined plane of the clamping block, the trapezoid structure, the elasticity of the spring and the like through the cooperation of the clamping block, the stirring plate, the spring and the like, can be conveniently detached in the operation of pressing down the stirring plate and the like, has small damage to the parts and the oral cavity in the operation process, and can be removed from the magnetic attraction and fixation of the clamping block through the structure of the third connecting plate and the like, so that the denture crown can be conveniently installed again.

title_en: Artificial intelligence-based lower limb exoskeleton control weight distribution prediction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lower limb exoskeleton control weight distribution prediction method based on artificial intelligence, which comprises the following steps of a, collecting biomechanical data of lower limbs of a wearer through a plurality of sensors, including but not limited to joint angles, muscle activities and ground reaction forces, b, training a large number of lower limb movement data by using a deep learning model in advance to identify weight distribution characteristics in different movement modes, c, predicting weight distribution born by each part of the lower limbs in real time by the model according to the collected biomechanical data, d, intelligently adjusting supporting force of each joint of the exoskeleton according to prediction results so as to optimize gait of the wearer and reduce energy consumption. And the energy consumption and the exercise efficiency are optimized, namely the exoskeleton supporting strategy is intelligently optimized according to the predicted weight distribution, the energy consumption of a wearer in exercise is reduced, and the exercise efficiency is improved. By reducing unnecessary energy waste, the battery life is prolonged and the practicability of the exoskeleton is enhanced.

title_en: Management of condensed water in an oxygenator of an extracorporeal membrane oxygenator
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a method for managing condensate water accumulation in a purge gas flow path of an oxygenator (21) in an extracorporeal membrane oxygenator [ ECMO ] device (5). The method includes the steps of monitoring a flow rate and/or a pressure of the purge gas within the purge gas flow path, determining when a purification condition is satisfied based on the monitored flow rate and/or pressure of the purge gas, and performing a water purification operation when the purification condition is satisfied. The water purification operation includes one or more of activating an automatic purification function of the ECMO device (5) for automatically purifying the purge gas flow path by generating a flow of purified purge gas through the purge gas flow path, presenting a recommendation to an operator of the ECMO device (5) to activate the automatic purification function of the ECMO device (5), presenting a recommendation to an operator of the ECMO device (5) to manually purify the purge gas flow path, and generating an alarm indicating water accumulation in the purge gas flow path.

title_en: Rotary-cut biopsy needle
abstract_en: The invention provides a rotary-cut biopsy needle which comprises a distal end pipeline part, wherein the distal end pipeline part sequentially comprises an outer sheath tube, a puncture needle tube and a rotary-cut cutter tube from outside to inside, the distal end of the puncture needle tube is positioned in the outer sheath tube before puncture, the distal end of the rotary-cut cutter tube is positioned in the puncture needle tube, when puncture is carried out, the puncture needle tube and the rotary-cut cutter tube penetrate out of the distal end of the outer sheath tube together to puncture tissues, and in the process of puncture, the distal end of the rotary-cut cutter tube is positioned in the puncture needle tube all the time, and after puncture is finished, the rotary-cut cutter tube extends out of the distal end of the puncture needle tube and is sampled through rotary-cut tissues. Because the distal end of the rotary cutter tube is positioned in the puncture needle tube during puncture, the rotary cutter tube can penetrate into human tissues along with the puncture needle tube, so that the smoothness of the outer surface of the puncture needle tube is ensured, and puncture breakthrough is easier.

title_en: Anastomat and repairing sheet for strengthening anastomotic stoma
abstract_en: The invention provides an anastomotic stoma reinforcement repair sheet and an anastomat, wherein the anastomotic stoma reinforcement repair sheet comprises a back lining, a repair sheet and a suture, the back lining is provided with a first end and a second end which are opposite in the length direction, the back lining is provided with a first surface and a second surface which are opposite to each other in the thickness direction, the repair sheet is arranged on the first surface and is detachably connected with the back lining, at least one part of the suture is sewed on the repair sheet and the back lining, so that the repair sheet is detachably connected with the back lining, the back lining is made of an elastic material, the elastic material enables the back lining to have different constant force elongation rates in the width direction and the length direction of the back lining, and the constant force elongation rate of the back lining in the width direction is more than or equal to 110%, less than or equal to 145%, preferably 120%, 130% or 140%. The backing of the anastomat reinforcing repair sheet provided by the disclosure has elasticity in the width direction, and can be used for adapting to anastomat assemblies with different perimeter sizes.

title_en: Lock release devices, systems and methods
abstract_en: A latch locking and release system having a control knob operatively coupled with the latch system, and a tubular latch release mechanism. The tubular latch release mechanism is switchable in cross section between a locked configuration and a release configuration. In the locked configuration, the control knob maintains a latch in an engaged configuration in the latch system and is blocked from movement to allow the latch to disengage. In the release configuration, the control knob is movable to allow the latch to disengage. The latch release mechanism and control knob may have additional features that prevent accidental actuation of the latch lock and release system to allow disengagement of the latch system.

title_en: Auxiliary device for rehabilitation of allergic rhinitis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rhinitis treatment, in particular to an auxiliary device for rehabilitation treatment of allergic rhinitis. The invention provides an auxiliary device for rehabilitation therapy of allergic rhinitis, which is convenient for enhancing daily protection function, and comprises a mounting shell and the like, wherein elastic bands which are symmetrically distributed are fixedly connected to the mounting shell, the bottom of the mounting shell is rotatably connected with a hinge shell, the inner side of the hinge shell is fixedly connected with a mounting plate, and the bottom of the mounting plate is fixedly connected with a fixing shell. The invention firstly designs the mask to facilitate the wearing of the device, and designs the sliding frame and the sponge to be replaceable, so that a patient can quickly replace different essential oils to relieve symptoms in the attack period, and then presses the button frame to control the spraying of physiological saline in the container, thereby facilitating the patient to keep the nasal cavity moist at any time, and also removing the allergen in the nasal cavity, thereby facilitating the continuous alleviation of symptoms to the patient in daily life and improving the treatment effect.

title_en: Method for recycling waste foam copper and application thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of waste foam copper recovery, in particular to a method for recycling waste foam copper and application thereof; the method comprises the steps of mixing hydrazine hydrate with deionized water to obtain a diluted desulfurization solution, mixing sulfur powder with the diluted desulfurization solution through first stirring to obtain a vulcanization solution, cleaning the surface of waste foam copper to obtain surface treatment foam copper, mixing the vulcanization solution with the surface treatment foam copper through second stirring, then drying in vacuum to obtain a crude product mixture containing Cu and Cu  7 S 4 , and grinding the crude product mixture under the inert atmosphere condition to obtain a mixture, wherein the temperature of the second stirring and mixing is 15-35 ℃, and the time of the second stirring and mixing is 5-6 min. The method can realize mass and rapid preparation of Cu  x  S bionic enzyme products or lithium ion battery anode products containing the mixture of Cu and Cu  7 S 4  under the condition of lower energy consumption.

title_en: Multi-cavity sweat sensor and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to a multi-cavity sweat sensor and a preparation method thereof, comprising the following steps: the sensor base and the cover plate are arranged on the upper surface of the sensor base. The sweat detecting device comprises a sensor matrix, wherein a sweat collecting hole, a plurality of sweat storage chambers and an asymmetric flow channel are formed in the sensor matrix, one end of the asymmetric flow channel is connected with the sweat collecting hole, the other end of the asymmetric flow channel extends to the outer side of the sensor matrix, the sweat storage chambers are connected to one side of the asymmetric micro flow channel, the flow channel wall of one side of the asymmetric micro flow channel, which is close to the sweat storage chambers, and the flow channel wall of one side, which is far away from the sweat storage chambers, are of different flow channel wall structures, when fluid flows through the asymmetric flow channel, the fluid flow speed of one side, which is close to the sweat storage chambers, is greater than the fluid flow speed of one side, which is far away from the sweat storage chambers, and sweat detecting chips are arranged in the sweat storage chambers. The multi-chamber sweat sensor designed by the application has extremely small sweat evaporation amount, stable sweat storage condition and strong sweat detection capability.

title_en: TDLAS intravenous drug concentration prediction method based on one-dimensional convolutional neural network
abstract_en: The invention provides a TDLAS intravenous drug concentration prediction method based on a one-dimensional convolutional neural network, which comprises the following steps of obtaining second harmonic data of intravenous drug concentration, preprocessing the second harmonic data of intravenous drug, dividing a training set, a verification set and a test set, constructing a 1D-CNN deep learning model based on a self-adaptive efficient channel attention module and a multi-level residual module, inputting the training set and the verification set into the deep learning model, setting super parameters for training the model to obtain an optimal parameter model, inputting a test set into a trained optimal parameter detection model to obtain a prediction result, and introducing a self-adaptive channel attention module and a multi-level residual module into the 1D-CNN convolutional neural network model, so that the characteristic extraction capability of the model is improved, and the learning capability and the generalization capability of the model are remarkably improved.

title_en: Low-dose cold cathode imaging device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of CT imaging devices, in particular to a low-dose cold cathode imaging device which comprises a shell, an imaging unit, a power supply unit, a detection unit and a control unit, wherein the control unit is used for determining the excitation time of X rays according to the distance between a cold cathode X-ray tube component and a body to be imaged, determining the excitation voltage of the cold cathode X-ray tube component at the excitation time according to the air temperature around the cold cathode X-ray tube component in the shell, and determining a corresponding adjustment mode according to the distribution condition of characteristic nodes of a scanned image, wherein the adjustment mode comprises the steps of screening or training and restoring the scanned image in different time intervals. The invention realizes the enhancement of scanning effect and the optimization of scanned images.

title_en: Automatic endoscopic video enhancement
abstract_en: Methods and systems for automatically enhancing endoscopic video of a task based on state data describing a state of a surgical robotic system used to at least partially perform the task. The system includes an event detector and an enhancer. The event detector is configured to receive the status data and identify one or more patterns in the status data, the one or more patterns being indicative of events occurring during the task. The enhancer is configured to receive an endoscopic video captured during a task, the endoscopic video being time-synchronized with the status data, and automatically enhance metadata forming part of or associated with the endoscopic video with information identifying the event and a time of occurrence of the event in the endoscopic video in response to the event detector identifying a pattern of events in the status data that are indicative of the occurrence.

title_en: Surgical registration method and device and surgical robot system
abstract_en: The application relates to a surgical registration method, a device and a surgical robot system, which comprise the steps of obtaining a three-dimensional image of an object to be registered and a registration point set planned in an image space of the three-dimensional image, obtaining physical space coordinates of a plurality of mark point sets of the object to be registered, wherein the mark point sets are point sets in a preset area of each registration point, determining the physical space coordinates corresponding to each registration point according to the physical space coordinates of the mark point set corresponding to each registration point, and generating a registration matrix according to the transformation relation between the image space coordinates of the registration point sets on the three-dimensional image and the physical space coordinates of the registration point sets. According to the three-dimensional image of the object to be registered, the registration points are obtained, the marking point set is planned within the preset range of the registration points, and according to the physical space coordinates of the marking point set, the physical space coordinates of the registration points are determined, so that the corresponding rough registration points are not required to be found on the actual bones by using the probes, and the registration efficiency of the surgical robot system is effectively improved.

title_en: Position determining method and device of sheath tube end point, processor and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for determining the position of a sheath tube end point, a processor and electronic equipment. The method comprises the steps of obtaining initial two-dimensional images of an endoscope in the process of extending into a physiological channel from at least two angles, dividing a first image area containing the endoscope main body and a second image area containing the sheath from the initial two-dimensional images respectively, determining a first target position of an endoscope tail end point of the endoscope main body in a three-dimensional space based on the first image area, determining a second target position of a sheath tail end point of the sheath in the three-dimensional space based on the second image area, and determining azimuth information between the sheath tail end point and a reference point based on the first target position and the second target position. The invention solves the technical problem of low accuracy in determining the position of the sheath tube end point.

title_en: Neck protector
abstract_en: The invention discloses a neck protector, which relates to the technical field of health care devices and comprises a front guard board, wherein under the cooperation of a miniature U-shaped groove guide rail, a magnetic clamping sliding block, a miniature vertical groove guide rail and an ultrasonic generator, the ultrasonic generator can move along the horizontal and vertical directions to cover different areas of the neck, so that the neck is convenient to promote blood circulation, relieve muscle tension and pain, reduce inflammation, accelerate tissue repair, effectively perform rehabilitation treatment on the thyroid, and under the cooperation of a miniature regulating air pump, a gas guide pipe, a conveying regulating air bag and a respiratory frequency air bag, perform corresponding improved inflation and deflation according to the respiratory frequency of a user, simulate healthy and effective respiratory process, promote the treatment on the thyroid, lighten neck pressure and improve comfort, wherein dynamic change of the respiratory frequency air bag provides visual tactile feedback for the user through a built-in respiratory sensor, strengthen the respiratory exercise effect and help the user to master the respiratory rhythm better.

title_en: Construction method, system and application of chronic hepatitis B liver inflammation grading prediction model
abstract_en: The application provides a method, a system and an application for constructing a grading prediction model of chronic hepatitis B liver tissue inflammation. The method for constructing the liver tissue inflammation classification prediction model of the chronic hepatitis B comprises the steps of screening a plurality of patients which are diagnosed as the chronic hepatitis B by liver tissue biopsy pathology and have clear liver tissue inflammation classification according to inclusion and exclusion criteria, collecting clinical data and serum samples of the patients, carrying out serum protein N-sugar chain fingerprint spectrum difference analysis on the serum samples of the patients with different ALT levels by adopting an N-sugar fingerprint spectrum technology, constructing liver tissue inflammation classification assessment models under different ALT levels by adopting a binary logistic regression analysis method based on conventional biochemical indexes and/or N-sugar markers, and respectively assessing and selecting the models with optimal efficacy as the liver tissue inflammation classification prediction models of the chronic hepatitis B in a step S4. The application can rapidly, accurately and noninvasively grade chronic hepatitis B liver tissue inflammation.

title_en: Equivalence intraocular lens position and intraocular lens degree prediction method and system for malsquare syndrome lens insufficiency dislocation eye
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for predicting the equivalent intraocular lens position and the intraocular lens power of a equine syndrome lens insufficiency dislocation eye, wherein the prediction method and the prediction system are based on an equivalent intraocular lens position prediction model and a vergence formula which are independent of anterior chamber depth and lens thickness, and can be used for guiding the selection of data such as the equivalent intraocular lens position, recommended intraocular lens power, post-operation actual diopter, target diopter and the like of a patient. The invention has the advantages that the accurate calculation of the intraocular lens degree is realized based on the eye biological parameters and sex characteristics of the equine syndrome patients while the postoperative equivalent intraocular lens positions and the postoperative refractive prediction errors of the equine syndrome patients with different eye axis lengths are fully considered, the postoperative refractive errors are effectively reduced, and the more ideal postoperative refractive state is achieved, so that the satisfaction degree of the patients is improved.

title_en: Cleaning device in gun-shaped instrument operation
abstract_en: The invention provides a cleaning device in gun-shaped instrument operation, which comprises a shell, wherein a cover body is arranged on the shell, a cleaning opening is formed in the cover body, a driving motor is fixedly arranged in the shell, an output shaft of the driving motor is provided with a mounting seat, one end of the mounting seat is slidably provided with a mounting plate, an elastic piece is arranged between the mounting seat and the mounting plate, a cleaning cylinder is rotatably arranged on the mounting plate, the cleaning cylinder and the cleaning opening are eccentrically arranged, the middle section of the cleaning cylinder is an inverted conical surface, an annular brush is arranged in the cleaning cylinder, a spray gun facing the inverted conical surface is arranged on the cover body, and a driving mechanism connected with the cleaning cylinder is arranged in the shell. The device has made the annular brush produce different pressures to the apparatus under the effect of elastic component to independently control the dynamics of scrubbing, effectually avoided the apparatus tip of fragile material to take place to damage because the scrubbing is uncontrollable at clean in-process, improved this belt cleaning device's practical value.

title_en: Massage audio sleep aiding method and intelligent sleep aiding pillow with massage audio function
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of sleep-aiding pillows, and particularly relates to a massage audio sleep-aiding method and an intelligent sleep-aiding pillow with a massage audio function. Aiming at the defect that the conventional intelligent sleep-aiding pillow cannot establish a personalized mode for individually regulating and controlling an air bag and audio according to user information, the invention adopts the following technical scheme that the massage audio sleep-aiding method comprises the steps of constructing a sleep-aiding audio massage model, acquiring user data, preprocessing the user data, generating a personalized massage audio mode according to the preprocessed user data and the sleep-aiding audio massage model, acquiring real-time physiological data of a user, and regulating and controlling massage and audio in a sleep period according to the real-time physiological data of the user and the personalized massage audio mode. The control method of the intelligent sleep-aiding pillow generates the personalized massage audio mode, can adjust massage and audio according to different sleep stages of a user, and better helps the user to sleep.

title_en: Mental health service platform based on big data analysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mental health service platforms, and particularly discloses a mental health service platform based on big data analysis, which comprises a consultation data extraction module, a treatment scheme validity evaluation module, a mental problem collection and arrangement module, a treatment scheme recommendation module and a database; the invention carries out deep analysis on the comprehensive effectiveness of the treatment scheme in the mental health service platform by combining the treatment effectiveness of the consultative user in the treatment process and the self satisfaction level after the treatment is finished, wherein the comprehensive analysis on the treatment effectiveness is carried out by combining the mental health evaluation score change condition, the medicine decrement condition and the machine auxiliary treatment reduction condition of the consultative user in the treatment process, thereby improving the accuracy of treatment scheme evaluation, helping the platform to timely adjust and optimize the treatment scheme, providing effective data support basis for the recommendation of the follow-up optimal treatment scheme and improving the reliability of the recommendation of the follow-up optimal treatment scheme.

title_en: Flexible CMUT patch for monitoring venous thrombosis of lower limbs and preparation method
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a flexible CMUT patch for monitoring venous thrombosis of lower limbs and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of medical treatment. The flexible CMUT patch comprises a plurality of flexible CMUT patch cells, each flexible CMUT patch cell comprising a receiver substrate, a donor substrate, a first electrode and a second electrode. The acceptor substrate sequentially comprises a flexible base material, a vibrating film, a negative electricity Rong Cai material layer and a silicon oxide layer, and a vacuum cavity is formed on the surface of the silicon oxide layer. The donor substrate includes an insulating layer and a conductive layer connected. The first electrode is connected with the conductive layer, and the second electrode is connected with one side of the flexible substrate far away from the vibrating membrane. Therefore, the flexible CMUT patch adopts the flexible substrate as a part of the acceptor substrate, and can adapt to the surfaces of various irregular structures, so that long-time, continuous and convenient monitoring can be realized, the medical convenience can be improved, the illness state can be early warned in time, and the delay of the optimal treatment opportunity is avoided.

title_en: Data acquisition method, terminal equipment, ultrasonic equipment and ultrasonic system
abstract_en: The application is applicable to the technical field of medical treatment, and provides a data acquisition method, terminal equipment, ultrasonic equipment and an ultrasonic system, wherein the method comprises the steps of sending a registration request to each post-processing node of the ultrasonic equipment; the method comprises the steps of sending an image data acquisition request to ultrasonic equipment, receiving at least one target image data sent by the ultrasonic equipment, wherein the at least one target image data corresponds to at least one target post-processing node in an image data mode one by one, and after the image data acquisition request is received by the ultrasonic equipment, each target image data is sent to terminal equipment in an image post-processing process through a calling mode set on the basis of a registration request in the target post-processing node corresponding to each target image data. Compared with the prior art, the method and the device have the advantages that a plurality of image data can be acquired by sending the data acquisition request to the ultrasonic equipment once, so that the image data in the ultrasonic equipment is acquired more conveniently and efficiently, and the data acquisition efficiency is improved.

title_en: Elastin peptide fusion protein and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of bioengineering, and discloses an elastin peptide fusion protein, a preparation method and application thereof. Based on the elastin with the amino acid sequence shown as SEQ ID NO.8, the high-yield expression of the elastin is realized through pichia pastoris GS 115. The elastin is fused with the bovine lactoferrin peptide with natural antibacterial function, and the elastin N She Xiaotai and the bovine lactoferrin peptide are fused with the elastin peptide with the amino acid sequence shown as SEQ ID NO.8, so that the elastin has more functions on the premise of ensuring higher expression quantity of the fusion protein, and can be applied to cosmetics, medical instrument products such as artificial blood vessels and the like.

title_en: Antiallergic medical adhesive tape and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an antiallergic medical adhesive tape and a preparation method thereof, wherein a plurality of acrylic adhesive layers are uniformly arranged at the front end and the rear end of the top of an elastic layer, a silica gel adhesive layer is arranged between the top of the elastic layer and a plurality of acrylic adhesive layers, and an anti-sticking layer is arranged at the bottom of a polypropylene film layer. According to the anti-allergic medical adhesive tape and the preparation method thereof, the silica gel adhesive layer and the acrylic adhesive layer are matched with each other, the acrylic adhesive layer is intermittently distributed at the edge of the adhesive tape, so that the edge firmness of the medical adhesive tape can be effectively enhanced, the edge warping phenomenon of the adhesive tape after long-time use is avoided, the overall adhesiveness of the adhesive tape is improved, the adhesive tape is prevented from falling off, the aim of effectively fixing a wound for a long time is fulfilled, the allergen can be effectively prevented from being in direct contact with skin through the arrangement of the allergen antigen adding layer, and the risk of anaphylactic reaction of a patient is reduced.

title_en: Digital twinning-based worker ergonomic risk analysis method and system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of digital twinning, and discloses a method and a system for analyzing human engineering risk of workers based on digital twinning. The method comprises the following steps of converting a space-time track of a worker into a nested network of a region transfer network and a gesture conversion network, respectively calculating the node number, average node strength and transfer degree of the region transfer network and the gesture conversion network, and respectively calculating the human engineering risk related to single action and the human engineering risk related to mechanical circulation action by utilizing the node number, average node strength and transfer degree of the region transfer network and the gesture conversion network, so as to realize human engineering risk analysis. According to the invention, the influence of the posture of the worker, the environmental factors and the mechanical circulating operation is comprehensively considered, a comprehensive worker risk identification model is constructed, and accurate risk monitoring and management are realized.

title_en: Tooth laser whitening device and method
abstract_en: The application discloses a tooth laser whitening device and a tooth laser whitening method. The device comprises a laser, a half-wave plate, a polaroid, a reflecting mirror group, a frequency doubling crystal, a dichroic mirror and a focusing lens, wherein the laser emits one micron of laser to be incident to the half-wave plate, the polarization state of the one micron of laser is regulated by the half-wave plate and then to the polaroid, the polaroid is used for transmitting or reflecting the one micron of laser according to the polarization state of the one micron of laser, the polaroid transmits the one micron of laser, the frequency doubling crystal converts the one micron of laser into green laser and the green laser is reflected by the dichroic mirror and then focused by the focusing lens to be emitted, or the polaroid reflects the one micron of laser and then is reflected by the reflecting mirror group and then focused by the focusing lens to be emitted. The technical scheme of the application can burn the melanin in the enamel by utilizing the strong absorption characteristics of the melanin on green laser and one micron laser so as to realize tooth whitening and greatly reduce the damage to the teeth.

title_en: Non-invasive blood sugar detection module with high optical penetration rate
abstract_en: The invention provides a non-invasive blood sugar detection module with high optical penetration rate, which comprises a substrate, a first detection unit and a second detection unit. The first detection unit comprises a first light source group, a first photosensitive element and a plurality of first retaining wall structures, wherein the first photosensitive element correspondingly receives light with a first wavelength emitted by the first light source group, and the plurality of first retaining wall structures are positioned between two first light emitting elements of the first light source group and between the first light source group and the first photosensitive element. The second light sensing element correspondingly receives light with a second wavelength emitted by the second light source group and is different from the first wavelength, and the second light sensing element is positioned between the second light emitting elements and between the second light source group and the second light sensing elements.

title_en: Dysphagia auxiliary therapeutic instrument
abstract_en: The invention discloses a swallowing disorder auxiliary therapeutic apparatus, which comprises a supporting plate, wherein an intubation hole and a positioning hole are formed in the supporting plate, a communicating catheter is arranged in the intubation hole, a nasal cavity tube is arranged in the positioning hole, a supporting tube is arranged in the communicating catheter in a sliding mode, a guide tube is arranged in the supporting tube, a plurality of uniformly distributed fixing supports are arranged on the peripheral wall of the guide tube, the fixing supports are fixedly connected with the tube wall of the supporting tube, and a plurality of through grooves are formed in the fixing supports. The invention relates to the technical field of dysphagia auxiliary medical equipment. This dysphagia adjunctie therapy appearance, the pipe wall inside of intercommunication pipe is provided with the bar skeleton for lead to the phenomenon that the intercommunication pipe appears folding when preventing the stay tube to draw, can effectually avoid rubbing repeatedly the esophagus of patient, thereby reach the purpose of protecting patient's esophagus mucosa, can effectually improve the security of resume the treatment.

title_en: Protective isolation sound insulation monitoring equipment for wild mental disorder patients
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of field medical rescue equipment, in particular to protective isolation sound-insulation monitoring equipment for patients with field mental disorder, which comprises a box body, a traction handle, a drawing door, a lifting sound-proof housing and a plurality of supporting plates, wherein a driving assembly is arranged in the box body and used for driving a transmission structure, the supporting plates are detachably connected with a binding assembly, the driving assembly drives the drawing door to be completely pulled open through the transmission structure, the plurality of supporting plates are spliced to form a bed body, the lifting sound-proof housing is covered on the supporting plate at the forefront side after being lowered, the protective isolation sound-proof housing can automatically bind and fix the patients after medical staff holds the patients, is more convenient to use, can shrink and fold the equipment, is more convenient to carry to the field, has better practicability, can isolate a series of noise such as screaming, disfiguring and the like sent by the patients with mental disorder to a certain extent, and avoids the influence on the emotion of people to be rescued around and the first aid judgment of doctors.

title_en: Nutrient pump
abstract_en: The application provides a nutrition pump which comprises a pump main machine, a first driving mechanism, a switching piece and an anti-falling piece, wherein the first driving mechanism, the switching piece and the anti-falling piece are arranged on the pump main machine, the first driving mechanism is connected with the switching piece and drives the switching piece to move between at least two positions, and the first driving mechanism is connected with the anti-falling piece and drives the anti-falling piece to move between at least two positions. The nutrition pump provided by the application can lock the fluid conveying mechanism on the pump main machine, can avoid abnormal falling of the fluid conveying mechanism and can prevent free flow phenomenon.

title_en: Artificial pollination device for dendrobium nobile
