abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial pollination, and discloses an artificial pollination device for dendrobium nobile, which comprises a holding part, wherein the holding part is provided with a containing cavity, a first connecting part is arranged in the containing cavity, two sides of one end of the first connecting part are fixedly provided with rotating shafts, one end of the rotating shafts, which is far away from the first connecting part, is rotationally connected to the inner wall of the containing cavity, one end of the first connecting part, which is far away from the rotating shafts, is provided with a sliding groove, a second connecting part is slidingly inserted in the sliding groove, one end of the second connecting part, which is far away from the first connecting part, is rotationally connected with a connecting shaft, one end of the connecting shaft, which is far away from the second connecting part, is fixedly sleeved with a sheath, a plurality of powder sticking heads are arranged on the outer side of the sheath, a disinfection assembly is arranged in the holding part, the holding part is provided with sliding grooves, and the first connecting part and the second connecting part are in sliding fit with the sliding grooves. The artificial pollination device can help planting personnel to carry out artificial pollination on dendrobe, can carry out storage protection on the carried pollination assembly, has high protection performance, can carry out adaptive regulation and control on the pollination device, and is convenient to use.

title_en: Human health monitoring system
abstract_en: The application discloses a human health monitoring system. The human health monitoring system comprises a plurality of data collectors and a mobile terminal, wherein the data collectors are configured to be fixed at joint positions of a human body, the data collectors are used for collecting acceleration data and air pressure data at the corresponding joint positions, the mobile terminal is in communication connection with the data collectors and acquires the acceleration data and the air pressure data, the position information of the joint positions is marked based on the acceleration data and the air pressure data, the position information and the corresponding acceleration data are used as input of a pre-trained deep learning network, the human body posture is generated through analysis, and the mobile terminal prompts when the human body posture does not meet preset conditions. By means of the mode, the human health monitoring system provided by the application can monitor the health condition of the user based on more accurate human body posture analysis, and the requirement on the installation accuracy of each data acquisition unit is obviously reduced, so that the human health monitoring can be realized more conveniently and accurately.

title_en: Automatic coding method and system for operation records
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic coding method and system for surgical operation records, which comprise the steps of acquiring and preprocessing surgical operation records of a patient, selecting an AI coding function, generating a surgical coding result and a corresponding evidence segment thereof based on a surgical coding model, checking the coding result and the corresponding evidence segment thereof in an evidence interaction module, carrying out error correction on the coding result and the evidence segment of multiple coding, error coding and miss coding, marking error reasons, manually adjusting the sequence of the evidence segments, collecting typical surgical operation records, describing collection reasons, and storing the coding result and the evidence segment, the checked coding result and the evidence segment, and the collected surgical operation records and collection reasons in a database module. The invention can reduce the manual coding burden, improve the medical insurance settlement efficiency, and optimize the model performance through continuous learning.

title_en: Nutritional nursing intervention system and method for tumor chemoradiotherapy patient
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nutrition nursing intervention system and method for tumor chemoradiotherapy patients, which belongs to the field of nutrition nursing intervention, the invention obtains patient data, obtains patient basic information, treatment scheme and builds dynamic knowledge base, builds nutrition element intake gap model, introduces recommended intake and actual intake of daily nutrition elements of patients into the nutrition element intake gap model to evaluate nutrition gap, builds drug metabolism and organ tolerance model, the method comprises the steps of introducing parameters of a chemoradiotherapy medicament into a medicament metabolism and organ tolerance model to evaluate medicament metabolism and organ tolerance dose, constructing a nutrition risk evaluation model, introducing nutritional element relative notch vectors, medicament metabolism quantity, organ tolerance dose and tumor of a patient into the nutrition risk evaluation model in a staged manner to evaluate the nutrition risk of the patient.

title_en: Doctor-patient communication simulation training method and system based on emotion recognition model
abstract_en: The invention provides a doctor-patient communication simulation training method and system based on an emotion recognition model, and relates to the technical field of machine learning; the emotion recognition method comprises the steps of constructing an emotion recognition model by using an emotion classification algorithm and a intonation analysis algorithm, inputting communication scene data into the emotion recognition model, training by using a self-adaptive loss function to obtain a trained emotion recognition model, analyzing simulated doctor-patient communication data by using the trained emotion recognition model to obtain an emotion recognition result, and completing simulated training of doctor-patient communication. The invention solves the problem of communication simulation training of different patient personality and emotion states.

title_en: Brain feature extraction method, system, equipment and medium of MRI (magnetic resonance imaging) image
abstract_en: The invention discloses a brain feature extraction method, a system, equipment and a medium of an MRI image, which relate to the technical field of intelligent biomedical signal processing, and fully mine deep features of a plurality of MRI sequence images when extracting imaging brain features related to functions of a brain-like lymphatic system and brain structure morphology in a T1WI sequence image, a T2WI sequence image and a DTI sequence image, the method comprises a diffusion degree value of bilateral brain tissues in the brain of a patient when the bilateral brain tissues are converted into fiber bundles and a fiber bundle reference value which causes the fiber bundles to deviate when the brain of the patient discharges, wherein the fiber bundle reference value can show which parameters are diffusion parameters when the bilateral brain tissues are abnormal, and the diffusion degree value and the diffusion parameters which are shown by the imaging characteristics are closely related to the epileptic language disorder function of the patient and can be used as a standard for predicting the epileptic language disorder.

title_en: Hepatocellular carcinoma tumor micro-necrosis prediction method and system based on image histology
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of cancer cell detection, and discloses a method and a system for predicting tumor necrosis of hepatocellular carcinoma based on image histology, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining abdomen enhancement CT before treatment of a hepatocellular carcinoma patient, outlining a tumor region; extracting image histology characteristics, screening the image histology key characteristics highly related to tumor necrosis by using a LASSO logistic regression mode, and evaluating the state of the tumor necrosis of the hepatocellular carcinoma by training and determining optimal super-parameters and a prediction model. The prediction method based on image histology can improve the accuracy of predicting the hepatoma tumor necrosis by analyzing and processing the three-dimensional tumor image, and can formulate a personalized treatment scheme for a patient by accurately predicting the hepatoma tumor necrosis, thereby being beneficial to improving the treatment effect and the life quality of the patient.

title_en: External application traditional chinese medicine treatment device for traditional chinese medicine internal medicine
abstract_en: The invention discloses an externally applied traditional Chinese medicine treatment device for traditional Chinese medicine, which relates to the technical field of medical treatment, and comprises a main body cylinder, wherein the main body cylinder comprises a fixed cylinder block arranged on the main body cylinder, an external frame for being in butt joint with external posture adjusting equipment is arranged on the fixed cylinder block, a winding mechanism comprises an unwinding cylinder arranged on the rotating cylinder block, a traditional Chinese medicine compress for treating a patient is fixedly wound on the surface of the unwinding cylinder, the other end of the traditional Chinese medicine compress is connected with the winding cylinder, the rotating mechanism is driven by a moving mechanism to start rotating, the unwinding cylinder and the winding cylinder are driven by the rotating mechanism to synchronously rotate, so that winding and unwinding operation of the traditional Chinese medicine compress is completed, when the traditional Chinese medicine compress is operated to a position where hot compress is not applied, the external driving stops rotating at the moment, and then the extruding mechanism extrudes the traditional Chinese medicine compress to be close to the medicine compress position of the patient, so that the purpose of automatically switching the traditional Chinese medicine compress is achieved, a patient continues to perform a new-stage compress operation, and the compress efficiency is improved.

title_en: Data storage method, device, electronic equipment, storage medium and product
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a data storage method, apparatus, electronic device, storage medium and product, the method comprising obtaining template data in response to receiving a template release request, and storing the template data to a first database and a second database, respectively; and responding to the received data submitting request, acquiring the input data and storing the input data to the first database. Thus, the pressure of accessing the template data of the first database is relieved by utilizing the second database, smooth updating of the template data and the input data in the first database is ensured, and the safety and the integrity of data storage are improved.

title_en: Diagnosis and treatment decision tree extraction method, system, equipment and medium based on multiple intelligent agents
abstract_en: The invention relates to a diagnosis and treatment decision tree extraction method, a system, equipment and a medium based on multiple agents. The method comprises the following steps of S1, preprocessing a training data set to obtain a plurality of intermediate results of each diagnosis and treatment decision tree, S2, training a self-iteration intelligent agent, S3, integrating a plurality of self-iteration intelligent agents to construct a multi-intelligent agent system, S4, importing and applying data, importing clinical diagnosis and treatment texts to be extracted into the multi-intelligent agent system to perform diagnosis and treatment decision tree extraction, and outputting a complete diagnosis and treatment decision tree to be directly used for downstream tasks of a clinical decision support system. According to the invention, the self-optimization and automatic iteration of the agent in the intermediate steps of the diagnosis and treatment decision tree extraction task are realized, the dependence on the manual tuning of the prompt words is reduced, and the accuracy and the mobility of the diagnosis and treatment decision tree extraction are improved by extracting and disassembling the diagnosis and treatment decision tree into a plurality of intermediate steps and training the corresponding self-iteration agent.

title_en: Method and device for selecting hip joint prosthesis position based on mechanical simulation
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for selecting a hip joint prosthesis position based on mechanical simulation, which belong to the technical field of prostheses, and comprise the steps of obtaining CT images of all hip joint subareas, obtaining CT image analysis results of all the hip joint subareas through processing, carrying out corresponding image enhancement processing, obtaining integral CT images of hip joint areas, analyzing to obtain imaging quality indexes of the integral CT images of the hip joint areas, judging integral imaging verification results, judging based on the integral imaging verification results, inputting the integral CT images of the hip joint areas into a three-dimensional reconstruction module in a mechanical simulation platform for hip joint prosthesis implantation simulation test if the integral imaging verification results are qualified, carrying out statistics on hip joint prosthesis implantation simulation test data to obtain a correction area image set, and carrying out processing on the correction area image set to obtain prosthesis position simulation analysis results of the integral CT images of the hip joint areas.

title_en: Scalable and shaped intelligent laryngoscope and application method
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent laryngoscope with telescopic shaping and an application method, wherein the intelligent laryngoscope comprises a handle and a lens, the lens is formed by sequentially connecting a plurality of sub-units, each sub-unit comprises a bottom plate, two sides of each bottom plate are respectively provided with a side plate, adjacent side plates of two adjacent bottom plates are connected through elastic cloth, the front end of the upper surface of each bottom plate is provided with a lock tongue, the rear end of the upper surface of each bottom plate is rotatably provided with a connecting elastic sheet, the connecting elastic sheets are rotatably connected with the corresponding bottom plate through a rotating shaft, the end parts of the lock tongues are provided with a plurality of clamping grooves, the connecting elastic sheets press the lock tongues by means of elasticity and are provided with clamping convex blocks, the bottom surface of each lock tongue is provided with a damping sheet which is in fit with the bottom plate and provides damping force, the connecting elastic sheets are connected with inverted L-shaped locking screws in a threaded mode, not only can realize radian adjustment, but also can realize length adjustment, and in two kinds of adjustment, the radian adjustment is realized in an electrodeless adjustment mode, the adjustment operation is convenient, and the whole after adjustment, the mechanical strength can be ensured.

title_en: Blood transport reconstruction monitoring device and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a blood transport reconstruction monitoring device and a method, wherein the blood transport reconstruction monitoring device comprises a light source and a photoelectric sensor which are arranged on a shell; the light source and the photoelectric sensor are electrically connected with a main control board in the shell, the light source comprises a first light emitting tube, the photoelectric sensor comprises a first receiver and a second receiver, the first receiver and the second receiver form a first monitoring channel for monitoring blood oxygen data with the first light emitting tube, and a connecting line between the first receiver and the second receiver and projection of the first monitoring channel on the bottom surface of the shell form a triangle. The invention has the effect of being convenient for accurately monitoring the blood circulation state.

title_en: Ultrasonic instrument working mode switching method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a device, equipment and a medium for switching working modes of an ultrasonic instrument, which relate to the technical field of ultrasonic equipment and comprise the steps of determining a picture to be detected from an ultrasonic image acquired by a current ultrasonic instrument; and determining whether the ultrasonic instrument is suitable for being switched to a target working mode or not based on the current quality detection result. Before the ultrasonic instrument is switched to the target working mode, the image quality detection can be carried out on the image data to be detected in the ultrasonic image, and whether the current ultrasonic instrument is suitable for being switched to the target working mode is determined according to the obtained current image quality detection result. That is, the application can control the quality of the ultrasonic image acquired by the ultrasonic instrument, and avoid the switching of the working mode under the condition of low quality of the ultrasonic image as much as possible.

title_en: Expansion type interbody fusion cage applied to minimally invasive spine surgery
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biomedical engineering, in particular to an expansion type interbody fusion cage applied to spine minimally invasive surgery; the invention relates to an expansion type interbody fusion cage applied to spine minimally invasive surgery, which comprises a fusion cage main body, a hydraulic telescopic rod, a pressure sensor, a supporting block, a limiting base, a connecting spring, an extension block, an electric telescopic rod, a limiting ring, a decompression spring, a positioning component and an analysis component, wherein the surface of the fusion cage main body is provided with the hydraulic telescopic rods, the hydraulic telescopic rods are provided with a plurality of groups, and the pressure sensor is arranged in the hydraulic telescopic rods.

title_en: Automated external defibrillator with shortened pause for rhythm analysis
abstract_en: An Automatic External Defibrillator (AED) is described that includes two Electrocardiogram (ECG) analyzers. One of the ECG analyzers is only suitable for ECG without signal noise and can therefore be used during "hands-off" analysis periods in which no cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) compressions can be provided. The length of the "hands-off" analysis period can be shortened by using the second ECG analyzer in conjunction with the first ECG analyzer. Thus, a larger proportion of CPR time is achieved throughout the cardiac arrest rescue.

title_en: Animal epidemic prevention processing method and system based on blockchain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a blockchain-based animal epidemic prevention processing method and system, the method comprises the steps of establishing a basic database of a farm, combining animal species characteristics and geographical position climate conditions, making an epidemic prevention time table, determining an epidemic prevention time node of the farm, collecting environment data, animal health data and epidemic prevention operation records of the farm in real time through Internet of things equipment, generating an epidemic prevention execution data stream, comparing the epidemic prevention execution data stream with a preset epidemic prevention measure execution list, judging the implementation condition of epidemic prevention measures through setting thresholds and rules, analyzing epidemic prevention effects by adopting a random forest algorithm according to the implementation condition of the epidemic prevention execution data stream and the epidemic prevention measures, generating an epidemic prevention effect evaluation report, and carrying out encryption storage and sharing on the epidemic prevention effect evaluation report and epidemic situation early warning information through a blockchain to provide data support for epidemic prevention decision. The invention realizes the intellectualization, the precision and the traceability of the epidemic prevention management of the farm.

title_en: Method and device for predicting disease risk based on haematuria
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a device for predicting disease risk based on hematuria. The method for predicting the disease risk based on the blood uric acid comprises the steps of obtaining a human face spectrum sample of a detected human face and blood uric acid content in human serum, dividing the disease risk level according to the blood uric acid content, establishing a corresponding relation between the human face spectrum sample and the blood uric acid content, generating a spectrum sample data set, establishing a disease risk prediction model corresponding to the blood uric acid through the spectrum sample data set, obtaining a human face video to be detected, and inputting the human face video to be detected into the disease risk prediction model to obtain the blood uric acid content and a target disease risk level corresponding to the blood uric acid content. The application solves the technical problems of long waiting time of blood drawing test and low reliability of disease judgment.

title_en: Hospital infection quality control management and risk identification early warning system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hospital infection quality control management and risk identification early warning system and a method, wherein the system comprises an infrastructure layer positioned at the bottom layer; the system comprises a data layer, a basic service layer, an application layer and a user layer, wherein the data layer is arranged on an infrastructure layer and used for storing hospital infection data, the basic service layer is arranged on the data layer, the application layer is arranged on the basic service layer and comprises a quality control index management module, a risk identification management module and an early warning module, the quality control index management module is used for evaluating hospital infection management quality based on hospital infection monitoring data, the risk identification management module is used for calculating a risk assessment score of each department to be evaluated based on a preset risk assessment system and classifying all departments to be evaluated according to the risk assessment score to obtain a risk department group with a plurality of risk levels, the early warning module is used for pushing early warning information based on hospital infection monitoring data, and the user layer is arranged on the application layer and comprises a clinician and a hospital infection management department. The invention can realize the high-efficiency management of hospital sensing control.

title_en: Computer simulation method and device for determining electrode patch position
abstract_en: The invention provides a computer simulation method and a device for determining the position of an electrode patch. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a mouse simulation model, wherein the mouse simulation model is obtained by carrying out three-dimensional reconstruction on a mouse with brain tumor, sequentially setting simulation electrode patch pairs at a plurality of pairs of candidate positions in a head area of the mouse simulation model, applying simulation alternating electric signals to the simulation electrode patch pairs, recording the electric field intensity value of a simulation electric field established between the simulation electrode patch pairs by the simulation alternating electric signals for each pair of candidate positions, setting the simulation electrode patch pairs at the candidate positions, selecting a pair of candidate positions with the largest electric field intensity value from the candidate positions as target electrode patch positions, and determining electrode patches corresponding to the target electrode patch positions according to the target electrode patch positions.

title_en: Cystoscope cleaning system and method for urology surgery
abstract_en: The invention provides a cystoscope cleaning system and a cystoscope cleaning method for urology surgery, comprising an inner cleaning disc, an overflow disc, an outer cleaning disc and a water circulation box body, wherein the inner cleaning disc, the overflow disc, the outer cleaning disc and the water circulation box body are sequentially fixed up and down and are internally communicated, a plurality of conducting ports are formed in the overflow disc, the water circulation box body comprises a plurality of split boxes, a plurality of cleaning components are arranged below the outer cleaning disc, the conducting ports are in one-to-one correspondence with the split boxes, the axis of the conducting ports is the same as the rotary cleaning axis of the cleaning components, the inner cleaning disc comprises a semi-closed disc with the same rotary axis as the water circulation box body, a cleaning passage is formed in the semi-closed disc, the cleaning passage is sequentially communicated with a plurality of groups of conducting ports with the same axis as the split boxes in the rotary process of the semi-closed disc, the cystoscope body is fixed inside the cleaning passage, and the cystoscope body is cleaned in the cleaning passage in a zoned manner.

title_en: Monitoring torsion on distal end assembly
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device for measuring torque, which consists of a probe having a shaft with a shaft distal end. The probe has a distal end assembly configured to be inserted into an organ of a human subject and having a distal terminal end and a proximal terminal end connected to the shaft distal end. A position sensor assembly is attached to the distal end assembly proximate the distal terminus, the position sensor assembly configured to provide signals indicative of a three-dimensional position and orientation of the distal terminus relative to the shaft distal end. A processor is configured to calculate a twist of the distal terminal end relative to the proximal terminal end in response to the signal from the position sensor assembly, and to calculate the torque on the distal end assembly in response to the twist and a predetermined correspondence between the twist and the torque.

title_en: Long-term medication tracking management method and system for endocrine patients
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of medical information, in particular to a long-term medication tracking management method and system for endocrine patients, comprising the following steps: based on the electronic prescription information of the patient, multiple key information in the prescription is extracted, the taking time and the dosage information of multiple medicines are identified, medication reminding information is sent to the patient, the taking time and the taking quantity of the medicines are recorded through monitoring the opening and closing states of the medicine boxes, and reminding and taking monitoring information is generated. According to the invention, the transparency of drug treatment and the compliance of patients are improved by monitoring the opening and closing state of the drug box in real time and recording the taking time and the quantity of the drugs, physiological parameters of the patients are collected regularly, the change trend and periodic fluctuation of the conditions of the patients are accurately identified by combining time sequence analysis and doctor feedback, the effects of various drugs are identified and side effects are detected by analyzing the drug logs of the patients and doctors, the dosage and the type of the drugs are helped to be adjusted in time, the risk of adverse reactions of the drugs is effectively reduced, and the treatment effect is improved.

title_en: Emergency call sub-diagnosis and answering system based on knowledge graph
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency diagnosis and answering system based on a knowledge graph, which relates to the technical field of medical information and comprises an information collection module, an answering module and a knowledge graph management module, wherein the information collection module is used for collecting diagnosis data of doctors and collecting inspection result data of instruments, the answering module is used for carrying out interactive answering on specific conditions of diseases after patients log in and pushing related problems and instrument inspection suggestions, the knowledge graph management module is used for carrying out optimization by combining actual diagnosis results to construct a new disease knowledge graph, the information collection module comprises a patient information input module, a diagnosis recording device, a text processing module, a key information labeling module and an inspection result collection module, the diagnosis recording device is electrically connected with the text processing module, and the key information labeling module is used for enabling doctors to label important symptoms in transcribed texts.

title_en: CAR-NK cells for the treatment of non-small cell lung cancer and/or esophageal squamous carcinoma, uses and compositions thereof
abstract_en: The present invention provides a CAR-NK cell for use in the treatment of non-small cell lung cancer and/or esophageal squamous carcinoma, the CAR-NK cell being obtained by constructing a pMFG-EGFR-CAR-CXCR 3 or pMFG-EGFR-CAR-IL 15 plasmid vector, the preparation of an anti-EGFR CAR-CXCR 3 or anti-EGFR CAR-IL 15 retroviral vector, and the preparation of an anti-EGFR-CAR-CXCR 3-NK or anti-EGFR-CAR-IL 15-NK cell. The chemotactic anti-EGFR CAR CXCR3 NK has strong killing activity to A549, KYSE150 cells, and is remarkably higher than NK cells, and after proving EGFR CAR NK expresses CXCR3 chemokine receptor, the chemotactic ability and the killing activity of the EGFR CAR.

title_en: Non-contrast agent injected tumor glucose CEST weighted imaging acquisition and post-processing method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-contrast agent injected tumor glucose CEST weighted imaging acquisition and post-processing method, which relates to the technical field of magnetic resonance imaging, and has the technical scheme that a 16-channel phased array body coil is used on a 3.0T MR scanner to obtain MRI; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a 3D glucose CEST (glucoCEST) image by using the obtained MRI and adopting a 3D single TSE-mDixon sequence, performing post-processing on the 3D glucoCEST image to obtain an MTRasym image, analyzing the change of a glucose CEST weighted signal through the MTRasym image to obtain the change of in-vivo glucose concentration, and completing the detection of in-vivo glucose signals. The invention is based on the magnetic resonance imaging technology of chemical exchange saturation transfer, and can realize in-vivo glucose signal detection by using magnetic resonance saturation pulse for specifically inhibiting glucose signals to replace contrast agent, and meanwhile, the acquired image has high resolution and low cost, thereby being beneficial to repeated detection and clinical popularization.

title_en: Preparation method of wearable organic semiconductor fiber SERS sensor for analyzing glucose and uric acid in sweat
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a wearable organic semiconductor fiber SERS sensor for analyzing glucose and uric acid in sweat, which uses PEDOT (polyethylene glycol terephthalate) PSS and PVA as raw materials for spinning and sequentially utilizes Ag NWs solution and 4-MPBA ethanol solution for modification, the solution configuration is simple, the wet spinning process is simple in operation during fiber preparation, the parameters are easy to control, continuous production can be realized, and compared with the SERS sensor in the prior art, the SERS sensor can be integrated with clothing, has good comfort performance, good flexibility and mechanical property, excellent SERS performance and high sensitivity, and can realize long-term, stability, portability and remote intelligent monitoring on human sweat information.

title_en: Blood pressure calculation method and electronic sphygmomanometer
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of medical equipment, in particular to a blood pressure calculation method and an electronic sphygmomanometer. The blood pressure calculation method comprises the steps of continuously collecting a pressure value sequence in an air bag, extracting an air pressure pulsation sequence and a basic air pressure sequence based on the pressure value sequence, generating an envelope according to the air pressure pulsation sequence, determining an envelope peak value based on the envelope, determining diastolic pressure and systolic pressure according to the envelope peak value, determining a rise-and-fall time ratio according to the air pressure pulsation sequence, and correcting the diastolic pressure and the systolic pressure according to the rise-and-fall time ratio. A blood pressure calculating method and an electronic blood pressure meter are applied to the electronic blood pressure meter, and can improve the blood pressure measuring precision of the electronic blood pressure meter.

title_en: Rehabilitation training wheelchair and auxiliary massaging device thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rehabilitation wheelchairs and provides a rehabilitation training wheelchair and an auxiliary massaging device thereof, wherein the rehabilitation training wheelchair comprises a wheelchair frame and a moving assembly with a limiting function, a seat frame and a leaning frame are arranged on the wheelchair frame, the leaning frame is provided with a headrest frame, two sides of the seat frame are respectively provided with a hand frame, the moving assembly is arranged on the wheelchair frame, the auxiliary massaging device is suitable for being arranged on the rehabilitation training wheelchair and comprises two groups of auxiliary massaging mechanisms with bending functions, the auxiliary massaging mechanisms are arranged at the bottom of the seat frame, each auxiliary massaging mechanism comprises a bending training assembly with a self-locking function and an auxiliary supporting assembly with a massaging function, the bending training assembly is arranged on the seat frame, and the auxiliary supporting assemblies are provided with a plurality of auxiliary massaging assemblies. Through above-mentioned technical scheme, solved the rehabilitation training wheelchair among the prior art and had simple and easy structure, the relatively poor problem of functionality.

title_en: Emergency tourniquet pressure monitoring and automatic alarm system
abstract_en: The invention provides a first-aid tourniquet pressure monitoring and automatic alarm system, and relates to the technical field of pressure monitoring. The system comprises a biological reaction monitoring module, a pressure adjustment analysis module, a real-time pressure adjustment module, a safety threshold detection module and an emergency response activation module. According to the invention, through the real-time monitoring of biological response, the micro blood flow, skin electrical impedance and tissue morphology change of a patient after the tourniquet is used are captured, so that the monitoring of individual response is more comprehensive, the safety and effect of pressure are evaluated by combining the actual physiological state of the patient, the monitoring is more dynamic and personalized, the combination of real-time pressure regulation and emergency response is realized, the pressure regulation is ensured to be carried out rapidly when the pressure exceeds the safety range, the warning is sent out through the warning, the secondary injury caused by the improper pressure is avoided, the use safety and response speed of the tourniquet are improved, the tissue injury of the patient can be prevented more accurately, and the real-time effectiveness and safety in the emergency process are ensured.

title_en: Brain structure-function-metabolism network association analysis method and system based on multi-mode synchronous imaging
abstract_en: The invention provides a brain structure-function-metabolism network association analysis method and system based on multi-modal synchronous imaging, which relate to the technical field of brain network analysis, and the method comprises the steps of acquiring multi-modal data of a target subject by utilizing nuclear magneto-optic-electric integrated equipment; the method comprises the steps of respectively carrying out mode specific preprocessing on each multi-mode data to obtain preprocessed data, determining connection matrixes of different brain areas according to the preprocessed data, and analyzing interrelation among different networks based on the connection matrixes to obtain association results of a structural network, a functional network and a metabolic network. The invention realizes the high-efficiency integration and analysis of brain structure, function and metabolic network data by utilizing the multi-mode synchronous imaging technology, can deeply reveal the interrelationship thereof, and provides a brand-new research paradigm and technical means for the research and clinical evaluation of the nerve diseases.

title_en: AI-based deep pulse fraction remote diagnosis and medical resource allocation system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an AI-based deep vein score remote diagnosis and medical resource distribution system, which relates to the technical field of intelligent medical data security, and comprises a data acquisition module, a dynamic authorization data determination processing module, a real-time transaction verification logic generation and authorization confirmation record generation, wherein the data acquisition module acquires a patient deep vein score diagnosis result, determines a basic security state of encrypted health data when the encrypted health data is stored in a cloud, and the dynamic authorization data determination processing module acquires a sharing request among institutions according to the dynamic authorization data, deploys a lightweight intelligent contract in a blockchain network, and generates an authorization confirmation record.

title_en: Hematodialysis conversion device for clinical department of nephrology
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of medical instruments, and discloses a hemodialysis conversion device for a nephrology department clinical bed, wherein an installation mechanism consists of a fixed seat, a connecting rod and a fan-shaped clamping block, wherein the fixed seat is fixedly arranged on the base and used for placing exchange bottles, the connecting rod is arranged on the fixed seat in a sliding manner, the fan-shaped clamping block is arranged on the fixed seat in a sliding manner and used for clamping the exchange bottles, and the collision block is arranged on the fan-shaped clamping block in a sliding manner and used for abutting the exchange bottles, so that the exchange bottles with different sizes can be firmly fixed through the fan-shaped clamping block. Through the conflict piece of setting on fan-shaped clamp splice, further promoted the stability and the adaptability of centre gripping, prevented that the bottle from becoming flexible or sliding. The improvement overcomes the problem that the bottle body is fixed and not firm in the traditional equipment, so that medical staff can quickly complete the installation and replacement of the exchange bottle, the operation complexity is reduced, the response can be more efficiently carried out under emergency conditions, and the clinical use experience and the treatment comfort of patients are improved.

title_en: Composition for cell transplantation therapy and use thereof
abstract_en: A composition for supporting survival and differentiation of Neural Precursor Cells (NPCs) transplanted into a nerve injury or disease site is disclosed, the composition comprising (a) a gel forming molecule, and (b) a chemokine receptor type 5 (CCR 5) antagonist. Also disclosed are methods of treating a nerve injury or disease in a subject comprising (a) mixing NPC with a composition disclosed herein, and (b) administering the mixture of NPC and composition to the nerve injury or disease site in the subject, thereby supporting survival and differentiation of NPC. Also disclosed is the use of a mixture of NPC and a composition disclosed herein in the manufacture of a medicament for treating a nerve injury or disease in a subject, wherein the mixture is administered to a nerve injury or disease site in the subject, thereby supporting survival and differentiation of NPC. Further disclosed is a kit for supporting survival and differentiation of NPC transplanted to a nerve injury or disease site, said kit comprising (a) a composition disclosed herein, (b) artificial cerebrospinal fluid (a-CSF), (c) CaCl  2 , and (d) thrombin.

title_en: Split type healthy bed
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of medical equipment, and provides a split type health care bed which comprises a first bed frame and a second bed frame, wherein the first bed frame and the second bed frame can be combined and separated through a connecting structure, a first bed plate and a second bed plate which are respectively fixed on the first bed frame and the second bed frame, a first backrest plate and a second backrest plate which are respectively fixed on the first bed plate and the second bed plate, a turning plate arranged on the first bed frame, the turning plate is formed by hinging two plates through hinges, and truckles and universal wheels which are respectively fixed at the bottoms of the first bed frame and the second bed frame. The split type health care bed that this scheme provided through the combinable separation design of first bedstead and second bedstead, collocation truckle and universal wheel, has realized that the patient is from the bedridden to outdoor transfer, enlarges the range of motion.

title_en: Medicine-disease relation prediction method and system based on double-channel fusion knowledge graph
abstract_en: The invention relates to a medicine-disease relation prediction method and system based on a double-channel fusion knowledge graph. The method comprises the following steps of S1, constructing a biomedical fusion knowledge graph, S2, constructing a medicine-disease sub-graph based on the biomedical fusion knowledge graph, S3, constructing a double-channel self-adaptive fusion characteristic module, embedding the medicine-disease sub-graph, S4, performing enhancement splicing on the medicine-disease sub-graph which is pre-embedded in a network by the double-channel fusion knowledge graph, importing an edge-node iterative updating learning mechanism, training the spliced sub-graph relation perception learning network, obtaining enhancement sub-graph characteristic embedding, and S5, calculating and outputting prediction probability of the medicine-disease relation by utilizing the trained enhancement sub-graph characteristic embedding. The invention integrates semantic representation capability of the knowledge graph and topology modeling advantage of the graph neural network, and realizes high-efficiency and accurate prediction of the medicine-disease relationship through multi-mode feature interaction and sub-graph enhancement and dynamic sub-graph learning mechanism.

title_en: Onboard transport device for sick and wounded
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of aviation medical treatment and post-conveying equipment, and particularly relates to an airborne sick and wounded transferring device which comprises a hanging belt unit, a central supporting unit, a side supporting unit, a horizontal supporting unit and a pretightening degree regulating mechanism; the upper end of the central supporting unit is fixedly connected with the middle part of the horizontal supporting unit, the lower end of the central supporting unit is fixedly connected with the cabin bottom plate, the upper end of the side supporting unit is fixedly connected with one end of the horizontal supporting unit, which is close to the cabin side wall, and the lower end of the side supporting unit is fixedly connected with the cabin bottom plate. The invention can fully utilize precious space on the machine so as to provide more shipping names, and can meet the requirements of current aviation medical post-delivery in the aspects of stability, light weight, convenient disassembly and assembly, impact reduction and the like.

title_en: Independent air guide element and aerosol bullet
abstract_en: The invention provides an independent air guide element and an aerosol bomb, wherein the independent air guide element comprises an air guide assembly and a buffer tube, the air guide assembly comprises a sleeve, a core body inserted into the sleeve and at least one first through hole axially penetrating the air guide assembly, the buffer tube comprises at least one second through hole axially penetrating the buffer tube, the buffer tube is communicated with the sleeve, and the second through hole is communicated with the core body. According to the independent air guide element and the aerosol bullet, after the independent air guide element is immersed in liquid, when the aerosol bullet is placed upside down or sideways and the independent air guide element is separated from the liquid, the core body can be in contact with the liquid in the buffer tube, so that the liquid seal is kept in the first through hole.

title_en: Preparation method and device of stretchable conductive interface
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method and a preparation device of a stretchable conductive interface. The method comprises pouring a precursor mixture of a stretchable polymer solution or silica gel into a polytetrafluoroethylene mould with gradient placed on a horizontal table, and standing to form a stretchable polymer film with gradient thickness; and after connecting one end of the gradient flexible electrode, which is large in thickness of the stretchable polymer film, with a Flexible Printed Circuit Board (FPCB), packaging and protecting the polymer insulating layer film, which is matched with a substrate, on the surface of the gradient flexible electrode, so as to finish the preparation of the stretchable conductive interface. The invention can effectively disperse stress and improve mechanical stability and durability of the joint.

title_en: Auxiliary device for clinical anesthesia department dyspnea
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of breathing assistance and discloses an auxiliary device for clinical anesthesia department dyspnea, which comprises a shell, wherein a sealing layer is arranged on the inner side of the shell, a suction mechanism is arranged at the bottom of the inner side of the sealing layer, the suction mechanism comprises a hollow block, the hollow block is fixedly connected to the bottom of the inner side of the sealing layer, a frame body is arranged on the front side of the inner side of the hollow block, a second rack is fixedly connected to the rear side of the frame body, transmission rods are respectively connected to the left side and the right side of the bottom end of the inner side of the hollow block in a rotating mode, and flat gears are respectively and fixedly connected to the middle lower parts of the outer sides of the two transmission rods. The frame body can be driven to reciprocate through the first rack, the frame body can move through the second rack, and the flat gear can drive the transmission rod to reciprocate along with the flat gear due to the meshing of the flat gear and the second rack, so that the absorption head can rotate left and right, saliva around the inside of the oral cavity of a patient can be completely absorbed, and saliva can not enter the air passage.

title_en: Tire protection fixing auxiliary device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tire protection fixing auxiliary device, which relates to the technical field of obstetric nursing and gynecologic department, and comprises a bottom plate, wherein round rods are symmetrically and movably connected to the upper part of the bottom plate, two round rods are connected in a rotating way, support pads are arranged on the outer sides of the two round rods, lateral lying pads are arranged on the outer sides of the two support pads, an adjusting assembly is arranged on the bottom plate, the adjusting assembly comprises an air pump symmetrically arranged on the outer side of the bottom plate and an air bag symmetrically arranged on the inner side of the bottom plate, the air pump starts to control the retraction of the air bag, the retraction support pad of the air bag rotates to a required angle through the round rods, a pregnant woman lies on the support pad for fixing assistance, the round rods are separated from the bottom plate and are used independently and are used for lateral lying fixing assistance through the lateral lying pads, and a control system is arranged on the support pad.

title_en: Artificial cochlea super-hydrophilic gel electrode coating material with anti-fibrosis and self-repairing functions and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an artificial cochlea super-hydrophilic gel electrode coating material with anti-fibrosis and self-repairing functions and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation process comprises the following steps of 1) adopting nanoemulsification to prepare Res nanoemulsion, mixing the Res nanoemulsion with GelMA solution, and preparing Res@GelMA microgel through microfluidics and UV curing; 2) respectively preparing Res@GelMA/CSMA mixed solution and ODex solution, mixing to obtain hydrogel premix, 3) placing the cochlear implant electrode in a light-transmitting mould, pouring the hydrogel premix in the mould, performing UV curing and demoulding, constructing an electrode gel precoat on the periphery of the cochlear implant electrode, and 4) in a reactor, performing chemical grafting PGS on the surface of the electrode gel precoat, and performing flushing irradiation sterilization to obtain the electrode coating material. The artificial cochlea electrode with the novel coating has the advantages of anti-inflammation, anti-fibrosis, self-repairing and low electrode implantation force.

title_en: Artificial intelligence state recognition nursing method and system for baby carriage
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of baby nursing and discloses an artificial intelligence state recognition nursing method and system for a baby carriage, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining movement state information of the baby carriage, a baby area image of an area where a baby in the baby carriage is positioned and environment information; the baby area image comprises an image of a baby and an artificial nursing action of the outside on the baby, the environment information comprises temperature information and humidity information of an area where the baby is located in the baby carriage, and the alarm information when the baby in the baby carriage is monitored is determined according to the movement state information of the baby carriage, the baby area image and the environment information through a baby carriage monitoring model based on the time-space attention, and the baby carriage is controlled to send prompt information corresponding to the alarm information. According to the infant nursing method and device, the infant state can be accurately identified in an outdoor scene, and the nursing effect of the infant is improved.

title_en: Psychological counseling system and data processing method based on multi-modal data analysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of psychological coaching, in particular to a psychological coaching system and a data processing method based on multi-mode data analysis, wherein a private dialogue module firstly provides a safe and independent dialogue space for students and effectively protects the privacy of the students. The multi-mode data acquisition module acquires multi-mode data such as voice, expression, action and the like of students. The real-time emotion analysis module processes the collected data, recognizes the emotion state of the student and captures emotion changes in time. The dynamic psychological assessment module assesses the psychological states of the students in real time according to the multi-mode data, and generates scientific and accurate assessment results. And carrying out grading early warning by the grading early warning report generating module according to the severity of the evaluation result and generating a corresponding report. The data safety transmission module ensures confidentiality and integrity of data in the transmission process, prevents information leakage, realizes real-time and comprehensive monitoring and evaluation of psychological states of students, and timely discovers potential psychological problems and gives an early warning.

title_en: Gradient heterostructure zinc alloy implant and laser additive preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a zinc alloy implant with a gradient heterostructure and a laser additive preparation method thereof, firstly, a three-dimensional model of a gradient heterostructure is constructed, and the three-dimensional model is led into a selective laser melting system after layering slicing treatment. And the slice layer is used as a regulating and controlling unit, dynamic parameter switching is carried out in the optimized laser energy density range, wherein the high laser energy density promotes coarse grain growth by improving the thermodynamic condition of a molten pool, and the low laser energy density realizes fine grain regulation and control by rapid cooling, so that a gradient heterostructure with periodic coarse and fine grain layer alternation is finally formed. The results show that the gradient heterostructure zinc alloy implant exhibits a synergistic increase in strength and ductility, the strengthening mechanism of which is mainly due to the combined effect of non-uniform deformation induced stress, interlayer dislocation and coarse-fine grain alternating layers inhibiting strain localization. In addition, the implant also exhibits excellent gradient antimicrobial action. This provides a viable strategy for the design and development of high performance zinc alloy implants.

title_en: Preparation method and application of fibronectin
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method and application of fibronectin, and relates to the technical field of biology. The preparation method comprises the steps of expressing fibronectin by using HEK-293T cells, and taking AGRN protein signal peptide as the signal peptide of the fibronectin. The preparation method can enable the HEK-293T cells to secrete and express the fibronectin with high yield and high bioactivity, and is beneficial to the application of the fibronectin in aspects of tissue regeneration, wound healing and the like.

title_en: Dose modulation method and system under rapid kilovolt switching
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of CT scanning. A dose modulation method under fast kilovolt switching includes dividing circumferential data acquisition angles of CT energy spectrum imaging scanning into a plurality of high-low energy integration time groups to obtain integration time groups under a plurality of angles, determining signal intensity required by average body type of a patient according to the high-low energy integration time groups under a specific angle, adjusting signal intensity according to signal intensity required by average body type of the patient and body type distribution difference of the current patient to obtain signal intensity required by the current patient under the specific angle, and under the conditions that total integration time is fixed and high-low energy intensity is balanced, performing high-low energy time proportion adjustment according to signal intensity required by the current patient under the specific angle to obtain high-low energy exposure time under the specific angle. The constant current is realized, and the requirement for dose difference and corresponding difference control under different body types are completed through the time proportion of high energy and low energy under a specific angle.

title_en: Invisible appliance
abstract_en: The application discloses an invisible appliance, which comprises an appliance body and a force application unit arranged on the appliance body, wherein the appliance body comprises a fitting part sleeved on teeth and a fitting part abutted against the inner wall of an oral cavity, and two ends of the force application unit are respectively and elastically connected with the fitting part and the fitting part, so that the teeth at a specific position of the fitting part are applied with force, and the teeth are corrected. The invisible appliance is additionally provided with the attaching part attached to the inside of the oral cavity, provides an installation basis for replacing the second connecting piece of the anchorage nail, reduces the implantation of the anchorage nail, thereby avoiding the inflammation infection at the implantation position in the oral cavity, simultaneously providing stable pulling force for the first connecting piece, and improving the effect of the appliance.

title_en: Oral care device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an oral care device, relates to the technical field of medical equipment, and solves the technical problems that an existing device is troublesome to adjust and single in direction, so that nursing by doctors is inconvenient. The invention comprises a supporting block, a transverse supporting component and a longitudinal supporting component, wherein the transverse supporting component comprises a transverse adjusting component and a rotating component, the transverse adjusting component comprises a gear and two racks which are respectively meshed with the upper side and the lower side of the gear, the two opposite ends of the two racks are respectively connected with the transverse supporting block, the rotating component is connected with the gear, and the upper side and/or the lower side of the supporting block are/is provided with the longitudinal supporting component.

title_en: Incremental pretraining and co-emotion response optimization method for large language model in psychological field
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intersection of artificial intelligence and mental health, and discloses an incremental pre-training and co-emotion response optimization method of a large language model in the psychological field, which comprises the following steps of S1, constructing a multi-level psychological field data set, S2, performing incremental pre-training optimization on a base model, wherein the incremental pre-training optimization comprises base model selection, incremental knowledge injection and forgetting inhibition training; S3, carrying out co-emotion response optimization training, including emotion feature extraction, co-emotion strategy generation and co-emotion response generation and iteration, and S4, realizing dynamic adaptation and real-time optimization, including domain knowledge updating, co-emotion capacity calibration and real-time feedback adjustment. Through the strategy of incremental pre-training and knowledge module isolation, the model can efficiently absorb the professional knowledge in the psychological field on the premise of not damaging the general capability of the model, and can accurately understand the professional term and intervention logic, and the response meets the industry specification.

title_en: Medical support device, endoscope, medical support method, and program
abstract_en: The medical support device is provided with a processor. The processor identifies positions of a plurality of observation target regions in the medical image based on the medical image in which the plurality of observation target regions are mapped, determines priority levels of the plurality of observation target regions based on the positions, measures sizes of the plurality of observation target regions, and outputs the sizes based on the priority levels.

title_en: Neural network model for vulva disease classification and training method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a neural network model for classifying vulva diseases and a training method thereof, wherein the model comprises an image acquisition module, a Swin transform module and a Swin transform module, wherein the image acquisition module is used for acquiring vulva images and inputting the vulva images into the Swin transform module, the Swin transform module is used for dividing the vulva images into a plurality of non-overlapped fixed-size image blocks, converting each image block into an image block sequence, carrying out hierarchical multi-scale feature extraction on the image block sequence through an attention mechanism to obtain a multi-scale hierarchical feature map, carrying out vulva disease classification prediction on the feature map, and outputting predicted vulva disease classification and corresponding probability.

title_en: Collagen dressing and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a collagen dressing and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of collagen dressing. According to the collagen dressing and the preparation method thereof, through the synergistic permeation promotion of the type I/III collagen compounding and the small molecular peptide, the intelligent maintenance and stability of the theaflavin-brown algae oligosaccharide-trehalose ternary active substance, the nano-package targeted delivery and the dynamic lamination of the gel-non-woven fabric composite carrier, the wound healing acceleration, the scar rate reduction, the transdermal rate multiplication of active ingredients and the zero-wound dressing replacement are realized, and the limitations of slow repair, more scars and strong adhesion of the traditional dressing are broken through.

title_en: Administrative data management method and system for hospitals
abstract_en: The invention provides a management method and a management system for administrative data of a hospital, which relate to the technical field of medical data information management, wherein the management system comprises a mixed storage layer, a dynamic data encryption module, a mixed storage unit and a medical consumable management unit, a medical system data source acquisition module and a paper data conversion module are built in the mixed storage layer, the paper data conversion module comprises paper data conversion equipment, and the paper data conversion equipment comprises a box body, a pushing mechanism, a driving unit, a scanning unit and a pressing mechanism.

title_en: Polyhedral ultrasonic wave guide tube and ultrasonic treatment system
abstract_en: The invention provides a polyhedral ultrasonic waveguide and an ultrasonic treatment system, and belongs to the technical field of medical appliances. This polyhedron ultrasonic waveguide is through enclosing into the polygon by the piezoelectricity material layer, and the surface of this polygon sets up anodal conducting layer, and the internal surface of this polygon sets up the negative pole conducting layer, on the edge of this polygon, sets up the structural design that the face isolation layer is used for separating anodal conducting layer on the adjacent two sides of this polygon, has solved the ultrasonic emission power of lifting means, and the excessive treatment that leads to causes the problem of thermal damage to tissue and organ around the target tissue. The polyhedral ultrasonic waveguide tube is a polygonal column body, edges of the polygonal column body are round corners, the inside of the polygonal column body is hollow, and the polygonal column body comprises a piezoelectric material layer, a positive electrode conductive layer, a negative electrode conductive layer and a surface isolation layer. The ultrasonic treatment system comprises a polyhedral ultrasonic waveguide tube, a host, an ultrasonic signal generator, a transducer driving and amplifying circuit, an ultrasonic signal receiving processor and a biological signal acquisition circuit.

title_en: Radial artery hemostasis compressor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a radial artery hemostasis compressor, which relates to the technical field of hemostasis compressors and comprises an upper end cover and a shell, wherein a wrist strap and an air bag component are arranged at the bottom of the shell, a circuit board and a battery are arranged in the shell, a control key and a display screen are arranged on the circuit board, an air pump and a pressure release valve are arranged in the shell, the air pump and the pressure release valve are respectively connected with a quick connector through a third pipeline and a first pipeline, and the quick connector is connected with the air bag component through a second pipeline. The invention provides a radial artery hemostasis compressor, which sets different hemostasis compression pressure thresholds aiming at different crowds, so that the accurate regulation of hemostasis compression pressure is realized, the practicability is strong, the actual requirement of the radial artery hemostasis compressor is met, an air bag component is arranged, the traditional integral compression is changed into bleeding point targeting compression, unnecessary compression of a non-bleeding area is reduced, the staged decompression strategy of peripheral and central is realized, the hemostasis is ensured, and the far-end blood flow is recovered as soon as possible.

title_en: Puncture method, puncture device and puncture system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application relates to the technical field of medical treatment and provides a puncture method, a puncture device and a puncture system, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring respiratory information and a scanning image of a target object before puncturing the target object; determining first position information of an impenetrable region according to the scanned image, performing puncture verification on a puncture prediction path of a puncture needle according to the first position information and the breathing information to obtain a target breathing pressure value range, performing breathing training on a target object through breathing training instructions, and notifying a user to puncture according to the puncture prediction path when the breathing of the target object meets the target breathing pressure value range. By performing puncture verification on the puncture prediction path before puncture, the puncture is performed when the target object is in the target respiratory pressure value range, so that the success rate of the puncture is improved. And the breathing training of the target object is automatically completed, so that the efficiency of the breathing training is improved.

title_en: Production process of degradable cotton soft sanitary towel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a production process of a degradable cotton soft sanitary towel, which belongs to the technical field of sanitary towels and comprises the following steps of S1 preparing a degradation promoting solution containing bacillus subtilis spores, atomizing the degradation promoting solution, spraying the degradation promoting solution into a crosslinking solution, filtering to obtain degradation promoting particles, S2 preparing a degradation promoting adhesive containing the degradation promoting particles and sodium bicarbonate powder, S3 sequentially bonding a leak-proof bottom film, a cotton soft core body and a cotton soft surface layer through the degradation promoting adhesive to form a sanitary towel semi-finished product, S4 heating the sanitary towel semi-finished product to dry, and decomposing the sodium bicarbonate after heating to enable the surface of the degradation promoting adhesive to form a plurality of air holes, S5 thermally pressing and bonding the edges of the sanitary towel semi-finished product, and then cutting to obtain the cotton soft sanitary towel.

title_en: Method for evaluating adaptability of ventricular assist device based on knowledge-graph neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating the adaptation degree of a ventricular assist device based on a knowledge-graph neural network, which comprises the steps of constructing the knowledge-graph neural network, training and optimizing to form an adaptation degree evaluation model, and realizing intelligent evaluation of the adaptation degree of the ventricular assist device, wherein the knowledge-graph neural network comprises a single-mode graph network, a full-mode graph network and a mode prediction fusion and output module. The graph annotating intention force complement model for missing feature prediction and the single-mode/full-mode fusion model for matching degree scoring can provide a unified and reproducible calculation way for matching degree evaluation of the ventricular assist device.

title_en: Drawing type finger separating plate and use method
abstract_en: The invention provides a drawing finger separating plate and a using method thereof, wherein the drawing finger separating plate comprises a plate body and an elastic belt body, at least one group of holes are formed in the plate body, the number of the holes in each group is multiple, the holes in each group are arranged at intervals along the finger arrangement direction, the holes are communicated with the upper surface and the lower surface of the plate body, the elastic belt body alternately passes through the holes in the same group in a serpentine penetrating mode, a plurality of finger fixing cavities are formed between the elastic belt body and the upper surface of the plate body, and the length of the elastic belt body among the holes is changed by pulling the free end of the elastic belt body, so that the binding strength of the finger fixing cavities is adjusted, and the drawing finger separating plate is convenient to operate and high in efficiency.

title_en: Intelligent sample processing and safety protection system based on multi-mode biosensing
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of medical examination automation, and discloses an intelligent sample processing and safety protection system based on multi-mode biosensing, which comprises a sample conveying module, a multi-mode detection module, an AI decision center, a mechanical arm execution unit and a dynamic safety protection module, wherein the sample conveying module comprises a transmission belt and a high-precision code scanning gun, the multi-mode detection module comprises a visual unit and a spectrum analysis unit, the sample conveying module, the multi-mode detection module, the AI decision center, the mechanical arm execution unit and the dynamic safety protection module are integrated, the multi-mode biosensing technology is integrated, the intellectualization of sample processing and the automation of safety protection are realized, and the problems of high sample processing error rate, insufficient safety protection and isolated system in the prior art are solved through multi-spectrum fusion detection, AI dynamic decision and robot cooperative control, so that the intelligent sample processing and safety protection system is applicable to medical examination automation scenes and has remarkable social and economic benefits.

title_en: Tumor heterogeneity assessment method and device based on image histology
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of medical images, in particular to a tumor heterogeneity assessment method and an assessment device based on image histology, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring original CT image data and extracting at least one local feature according to the original CT image data; each pixel in the image is regarded as a data point, clustering is carried out according to at least one local feature to obtain a clustering result, and a clustering label graph is generated according to the clustering result; and obtaining global mode information according to the cluster label graph, and evaluating the heterogeneity of the tumor according to the global mode information. Therefore, the problems that in the related technology, the radiohistology method assumes uniform distribution of intra-tumor heterogeneity, so that the heterogeneity characteristics of a local area cannot be effectively captured, the tumor area division method cannot simultaneously consider the local characteristics and the global distribution of tumors, so that information loss is caused, the adaptability of clinical application is poor, manual characteristic selection is relied on, and the calculation is complex, the stability is poor and the like are solved.

title_en: Flexible wearable device integrating passive radiation cooling and piezoelectric sensing and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides flexible wearable equipment integrating passive radiation cooling and piezoelectric sensing and a preparation method thereof. The invention relates to a flexible wearable device, which is prepared by placing high-refractive-index microparticles and piezoelectric nanoparticles in a solvent, uniformly mixing the microparticles and the piezoelectric nanoparticles through ultrasonic to obtain a mixture 1, adding a matrix material into the mixture 1 to obtain a mixture 2, preparing the mixture 2 into a piezoelectric composite film with a micro-nano porous structure, cutting the piezoelectric composite film into a required shape to obtain a functional material, mounting conductive electrodes on the upper and lower surfaces of the functional material to form an electrode layer, connecting the upper and lower electrodes by using a thin copper wire, and then insulating and packaging the upper and lower electrodes. The invention has the advantages of wide material source and simple process, is suitable for large-scale production, provides an innovative solution for the thermal comfort management and environment interaction integrated design of next-generation intelligent wearable electronic equipment, and has remarkable market application prospect.

title_en: Scoliosis biomechanical testing method
abstract_en: The invention provides a scoliosis biomechanical testing method, which belongs to the technical field of scoliosis testing and comprises sheep scoliosis bending and nail rod implantation. The sheep backbone bending comprises the steps of intercepting sheep backbone, fixing end covers, connecting a translation tool and a clamping tool, driving middle vertebral bodies of the sheep backbone to move so as to bend the sheep backbone, loosening intervertebral discs with the largest bending degree, filling dental tray powder for fixing, and enabling sections above and below a sheep scoliosis position to be changed into vertical, wherein nail rod implantation comprises bone nail hole drilling, bone nail implantation and bar implantation. The invention selects sheep spines to simulate human spines, has higher similarity, completely simulates human scoliosis by bending and implanting the nail rods through specific steps, and is convenient for biomechanics test on the human scoliosis.

title_en: Ovarian cancer accurate diagnosis and personalized treatment method based on data integration
abstract_en: The application provides an ovarian cancer accurate diagnosis and personalized treatment method based on data integration, which comprises the steps of generating a multidimensional feature vector set comprising gene expression level, image texture parameters, symptom scores and pathology classifications by adopting a feature extraction algorithm according to a structured data set, carrying out dimension reduction treatment on the multidimensional feature vector set by a feature fusion module to obtain a low-dimensional feature expression vector, carrying out grouping and risk prediction on patient data by adopting a classification algorithm according to the low-dimensional feature expression vector to generate patient sub-population classification and disease risk stratification results, generating a diagnosis score result and a personalized treatment recommendation scheme by adopting a scoring model according to the patient sub-population classification and disease risk stratification results, and outputting a diagnosis report.

title_en: Method and device for controlling a prosthesis, prosthesis control device and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a prosthetic limb control method, a prosthetic limb control device and a storage medium, which belong to the technical field of biological signal detection, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining biological signals of a user in the process of using a prosthetic limb, wherein the biological signals comprise electromyographic signals, voice signals and/or electroencephalogram signals; the method comprises the steps of identifying action results corresponding to each biological signal by adopting a pre-trained action identification model, determining target actions according to the action types and the corresponding prediction probabilities in each action result, and controlling the artificial limb based on the target actions, so that accurate control of the artificial limb is realized, and user experience is improved.

title_en: Method and system for prognosis evaluation of lung cancer patient by combining pathological image and blood index
