abstract_en: The invention discloses a lung cancer patient prognosis evaluation method and system combining pathological images and blood indexes, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining reference pathological features and reference blood clinical indexes of a lung cancer patient in different clinical stages, constructing a lung cancer stage evaluation model, obtaining a real-time pathological image and a blood detection report of a target patient, determining the current lung cancer development stage of the target patient through the lung cancer stage evaluation model, determining the risk attribute of the target patient based on the current lung cancer development stage, determining the blood lymphocyte proportion of the target patient, determining the key blood indexes of the target patient according to the blood lymphocyte proportion, and outputting the prognosis risk score and the survival prediction result of the target patient through a preset survival analysis model according to the key blood indexes and multi-scale morphological features. The objectivity, high precision and stability of the prediction result are ensured, the interference of human subjective factors is eliminated, and the reliability is improved.

title_en: Healthy intelligent bracelet of sleep real-time supervision
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sleep real-time monitoring health intelligent bracelet which comprises a monitoring system, wherein the monitoring system comprises a piezoelectric conversion module, an amplifying module, a filter, a circuit board, a detection module, a positioning module, a voice module, a terminal, an alarm module, a display screen and a control panel, wherein the display screen, the control panel, the detection module, the positioning module and the voice module are all connected with the circuit board, the detection module, the alarm module and the positioning module are all connected with the terminal, the terminal comprises a mobile phone, a flat plate and an iPad, data detected by the detection module comprise blood pressure, heart rate, breathing, involuntary leg movement and arterial blood oxygen, and the beneficial effects of the invention are that the data of the blood pressure, the heart rate, the breathing, involuntary leg movement and the arterial blood oxygen can be fully known whether a snorer has apnea, the times of the pause, the time of the pause, the lowest arterial oxygen value and the change of the whole period when the pause occurs, and the sleep period can be known through sleep monitoring.

title_en: Sheath handle, guide sheath and endoscope suite
abstract_en: The application discloses a sheath handle, an introducer sheath and an endoscope suite, which relate to the technical field of medical appliances, wherein the sheath handle comprises a sheath seat, an end cover, a sealing element and a reset adjusting element, the sheath seat is provided with an opening, the sealing element is provided with a resetting part, the end cover presses the sealing element against the sheath seat and is connected with the sheath seat, so that the sealing element seals the opening, the sheath handle is provided with a resetting adjusting part which is movably arranged, and the resetting part is positioned in a movable path of the resetting adjusting part. The reset adjusting piece pushes back the reset part to be kept at a preset position, and the reset part is driven and drives the sealing piece to enable the sealing piece to be maintained between the end cover and the sheath seat. The medical staff can operate the reset adjusting piece provided by the application to drive the reset adjusting piece to move relative to the sealing piece. The sealing element is pulled by the reset adjusting element, at least part of the sealing element is maintained between the end cover and the sheath seat, collapse and falling of the sealing element under the action of external force or suction are avoided, the stability and the reliability of the sealing element on the sheath handle are ensured, and the reliability of the guiding sheath is improved.

title_en: Automatic oxygen supply method and device in sleep scene, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides an automatic oxygen supply method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium in a sleep scene, which relate to the field of medical monitoring, and are applied to an automatic oxygen supply device, wherein the automatic oxygen supply device comprises an index acquisition module, an image acquisition module, a mechanical arm and an oxygen supply module arranged at the tail end of the mechanical arm, and the automatic oxygen supply device comprises the following steps of acquiring physiological indexes of a target object in real time through the index acquisition module; the method comprises the steps of acquiring a head image of a target object through an image acquisition module in response to a physiological index meeting a preset anoxic condition, determining a target oxygen supply position based on the head image, controlling a mechanical arm to move the oxygen supply module to the target oxygen supply position, starting the oxygen supply module to supply oxygen, stopping the operation of the oxygen supply module in response to the physiological index being restored to a preset safe state, and controlling the mechanical arm to return to a position. The application can automatically monitor vital signs in sleep state and automatically supply oxygen in emergency when the risk of hypoxia is identified.

title_en: Endoscope system
abstract_en: The invention provides an endoscope system which comprises a first light source, a first optical fiber, a second light source, a second optical fiber, a first optical fiber coupler, a third optical fiber, a bidirectional coupler and an optical fiber endoscope. The wavelength of the light emitted by the first light source is between 400 nanometers and 800 nanometers. The first optical fiber is connected to the first light source. The wavelength of the light emitted by the second light source is between 900 nanometers and 1700 nanometers. The second optical fiber is connected to the second light source. The first optical fiber coupler connects the first optical fiber and the second optical fiber. The third optical fiber is connected to the first optical fiber coupler. The bi-directional coupler is connected to the third optical fiber. The optical fiber endoscope comprises a first end and a second end, wherein the first end is provided with a micro lens array group, and the second end is connected with a bidirectional coupler. The endoscope system of the invention improves the quality of the endoscopic image of the photographed affected part by using a plurality of light sources with different wavelengths.

title_en: Leg correction device for children health care
abstract_en: The invention discloses a leg correction device for children health care, and relates to the technical field of leg correction. The bookshelf comprises a box seat, a limiting plate is fixedly arranged on one side of the top of the box seat, a positioning plate is rotatably connected to one side of the box seat, a containing box is fixedly arranged on the outer side of the box seat, a bookshelf is movably arranged in the containing box, connecting rods are movably arranged on two sides of the bottom of the bookshelf, the connecting relation between the connecting rods and the bookshelf is rotary connection, a nut seat is movably arranged at one end of the connecting rods, and the connecting relation between the nut seat and the connecting rods is rotary connection. Through setting up bookshelf and book storage chamber, the books that children are interested can be deposited to the book storage intracavity of bookshelf, and children can feel boring or restlessness because keeping same posture for a long time when carrying out shank correction. Books on the bookshelf provide a mode for transferring attention to the books, so that the correcting process is more interesting, and the psychological support function is realized.

title_en: Traditional Chinese medicine abdomen impedance detection method and device based on data analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a traditional Chinese medicine abdomen impedance detection method and device based on data analysis, which relate to the technical field of data analysis, and the method and device provided by the invention are used for carrying out reference calibration through cross wide-angle laser and ensuring safety by matching with an inclination sensor, so that the problems of point position deviation and repeated error caused by manual and non-standardized calibration in the positioning of the traditional device are solved; the method comprises the steps of generating cosine and sine reference signals which are in the same frequency and in phase with a first waveform excitation signal according to a micro control unit, processing discrete time voltage sequences by combining parameters such as sampling frequency of an analog-to-digital converter, extracting useful signals, suppressing noise, obtaining reliable alternating current signal amplitude, improving the problem of unstable impedance measurement reference, adjusting the excitation signal frequency to generate second waveform excitation signals with different frequency bands, obtaining a calculated value and an impedance contribution value after the second impedance value, dynamically setting a weight coefficient through normalization processing to obtain a comprehensive impedance value, solving the problems of single-band detection limitation and low data utilization, and compensating for the defect of short plates in quantitative diagnosis.

title_en: Massage device, control method thereof, and computer storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides massage equipment, a control method thereof and a computer storage medium, wherein the massage equipment comprises a controller, a Bluetooth module and a functional module, the controller is electrically connected with the Bluetooth module, the Bluetooth module is also electrically connected with the functional module, the controller is used for sending a first control signal to the Bluetooth module to trigger the Bluetooth module to control the functional module to operate based on the first control signal so as to realize the function expansion of the massage equipment, the functional module comprises at least one of a light prompt module and a voice broadcasting module, the controller is also used for realizing the function expansion of the massage equipment based on a second control signal sent by the Bluetooth module, the functional module comprises at least one of a 2.4G remote control module, a mute control module and a massage function selection module, and the second control signal is obtained by the Bluetooth module based on the operation state of the functional module. By adopting the application, the interface resource of the controller can be saved, the number of connecting wires can be reduced, and the miniaturization degree of the massage equipment can be improved while the function expansion is realized.

title_en: Portable intelligent mechanical vibration therapeutic instrument
abstract_en: The invention discloses a portable intelligent mechanical vibration therapeutic apparatus, which relates to the field of miniaturized vibration therapeutic equipment, and is configured into handheld local vibration therapeutic equipment, wherein the handheld local vibration therapeutic equipment comprises a shell, a main control panel, a vibration driving module, a therapeutic head and a detection module, the shell is provided with a holding part and a main body part, the holding part is connected to the rear side of the main body part, the outer side of the holding part, which is close to the main body part, is provided with a key switch, the main body part is provided with a first cavity shell and a second cavity shell, the first cavity shell and the second cavity shell are connected front and back through end covers, the vibration therapeutic apparatus integrates the vibration driving module, the detection module and the intelligent main control, and the portable vibration therapeutic equipment with high precision, multiparameter sensing and personalized regulation can be constructed.

title_en: Pilot cognitive state identification method and device, computer equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of aviation safety, and discloses a pilot cognitive state identification method, a device, computer equipment and a medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting original electroencephalogram signals and original electrocardiosignals of a pilot, and respectively preprocessing the original electroencephalogram signals and the original electrocardiosignals; extracting phase locking value characteristics from the preprocessed electroencephalogram signal fragments, extracting heart rate variability and waveform characteristics from the preprocessed electroencephalogram signal fragments, adopting a SE-DenseNet network to conduct depth characteristic extraction on the phase locking value characteristics to obtain electroencephalogram depth characteristics, adopting an RC-MLP network to conduct depth characteristic extraction on the heart rate variability and waveform characteristics to obtain electrocardio depth characteristics, inputting the electroencephalogram depth characteristics and the electrocardio depth characteristics into a bidirectional cross-modal attention module to conduct characteristic fusion to obtain fusion characteristics, and inputting the fusion characteristics into a classifier to obtain a classification result of cognitive states of pilots. By adopting the method and the device, the accuracy of classification of the cognitive states of the pilot is improved.

title_en: Telecentric mechanism and surgical robot
abstract_en: The application relates to a telecentric mechanism and a surgical robot. The telecentric mechanism comprises a first link arm assembly, a first joint assembly, a first cable support and a first wire harness group, wherein the first link arm assembly comprises a first connecting rod with a first accommodating cavity, the first connecting rod comprises a first end and a second end which are oppositely arranged, the first joint assembly is provided with a first hollow cavity communicated with the first accommodating cavity, the first end of the first connecting rod is rotationally connected with the first joint assembly, the first cable support is positioned in the first accommodating cavity and arranged at the first end, and the first wire harness group penetrates through the first hollow cavity and the first accommodating cavity and is fixed on the first cable support. The application can improve the reliability of the telecentric mechanism and reduce the failure rate.

title_en: Integrated injection device suitable for sealing double-cavity PICC catheter
abstract_en: The invention discloses an integrated injection device suitable for sealing a tube of a double-cavity PICC catheter, relates to the technical field of injectors, and aims to solve the technical problem of single function of the injection device. According to the invention, by designing the transmission mechanism and the gear set structure, when the clamping block is clamped with the rotating hole, the toothed ring can rotate relative to the cylinder, the moving assembly enables the toothed ring to rotate relative to the cylinder, so that the gear A drives the first gear C to intermittently rotate, the intermittent motion of the double-piston assembly is enabled to realize pulse injection, when the clamping block is clamped with the rotating ring, the assembly is moved, the toothed ring and the cylinder simultaneously rotate, and therefore continuous injection is realized, two injection modes can be realized through simple operation, and the technical problem of single function of the current injection device is solved.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and medium for training gait disorder of Parkinson's disease
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method, a device, equipment and a medium for training gait disturbance of parkinsonism. The training method comprises a data acquisition step of acquiring gait data of left and right feet of a patient, a step height calculation step of calculating the left and right foot heights of the patient according to the gait data, and a prompt generation step of prompting the patient according to the step height data obtained by calculation. The invention generates the vibration prompt based on the left and right foot steps of the patient, constructs the vibration prompt Fan Shiji, dynamically adjusts the vibration prompt according to the patient's performance in the training process, and realizes accurate and personalized rehabilitation training.

title_en: Medical information processing method, system, multi-modal large model, automatic execution robot, and program product
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of medical treatment, and provides a medical information processing method, a medical information processing system, a multi-mode large model, an automatic execution robot and a program product. According to the method, a multi-mode large model generates a medical information processing task stream corresponding to a medical information processing instruction, a to-be-executed action is obtained according to a current medical information processing task in the medical information processing task stream and a current interface of user equipment, an automatic execution robot operates the current interface according to the to-be-executed action, when the execution of the current medical information processing task is determined to be completed according to a new current interface after the operation of the automatic execution robot and an operation execution result formed after the operation of the automatic execution robot, the medical information processing task which is not executed in the medical information processing task stream is used as the new current medical information processing task, and corresponding steps are returned until the execution of a plurality of medical information processing tasks is completed.

title_en: Rhythm state detection method, electronic device, and program product
abstract_en: The application provides a rhythm state detection method, electronic equipment and a program product, and relates to the technical field of intelligent detection. The method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-mode sign data representing the physical pressure state of the person on duty, carrying out feature extraction on the multi-mode sign data to obtain feature data corresponding to each item of sign data in the multi-mode sign data, and determining the fatigue level of the person on duty according to the feature data to serve as a rhythm state detection result of the person on duty. Therefore, the problem that the accuracy of the detection result of the body rhythm state of the person on duty is insufficient due to single physical sign data type in the traditional detection mode of the body rhythm state of the person on duty can be solved.

title_en: Clinical decision support system integrating structured knowledge and generating type intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a clinical decision support system integrating structured knowledge and generation type intelligence, which comprises a guideline atlas generation module, a medical record information extraction module, a decision reasoning module and an interactive display module, wherein the guideline atlas generation module is used for converting unstructured authoritative clinical guidelines into machine-readable and executable structured knowledge atlas, the medical record information extraction module is used for processing unstructured medical record texts written by a clinician and extracting a clinical event sequence with a time stamp from the unstructured medical record texts, the decision reasoning module is used for receiving the structured knowledge atlas and the clinical event sequence and driving a large language model to carry out multi-step logical reasoning under the guidance of the structured knowledge atlas so as to plan a diagnosis and treatment path, and the interactive display module is used for displaying the diagnosis and treatment path and decision basis corresponding to each decision node on the diagnosis and treatment path in a visual mode. The invention can deeply fuse unstructured medical record information and structured guideline knowledge and provides a clinician with decision support with standardization and high individuation.

title_en: Portable multi-position adaptive pneumatic massage device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of massage nursing and discloses a portable multi-position adaptive pneumatic massage device which comprises a shoulder circumference auxiliary mechanism, a big arm massage mechanism, a small arm massage mechanism, a fastening belt and a damping output element, wherein the shoulder circumference auxiliary mechanism is positioned on the outer side of a first back plate and the outer side of a second back plate and used for stably wearing shoulders of a user, the big arm massage mechanism is positioned on a head end fixing head and matched with a shoulder linkage frame and the damping output element for fastening and adapting to the big arm part of the user, and the small arm massage mechanism is positioned on the fastening belt and matched with an upper opposite frame and the damping output element for fixing massage of the small arm part of the user. Through exquisite design initiative adaptation user's health form and motion, but hinge backplate and extension back of body frame of pull constitute a braced frame that can adjust according to user's trunk length and waist physiology curvature, this has ensured that equipment can laminate on the user's back of different sizes firmly, provides a stable basis for all massage functions, and shoulder link frame of shoulder week auxiliary mechanism is rotatable.

title_en: Intelligent bellyband and management system for home respiration rehabilitation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of data processing, and particularly discloses an intelligent binder and a management system for home respiratory rehabilitation, comprising the following steps of collecting chest and abdomen movement data through a flexible sensor array, wherein the chest and abdomen movement data comprises chest expansion amplitude, abdomen pressure change and blood oxygen saturation information, and constructing an initial multi-mode signal set; the method comprises the steps of extracting time sequence features by adopting a recurrent neural network according to an initial multi-mode signal set to obtain dynamic feature representation for subsequent fusion processing, carrying out priority evaluation on respiratory training quality from the dynamic feature representation, determining a key signal subset to identify potential deviation, and carrying out video auxiliary analysis if the key signal subset meets triggering conditions.

title_en: Wearing formula warm moxibustion heating blanket
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wearable warm moxibustion heating blanket, which belongs to the technical field of warm moxibustion heating blankets and comprises a wearing blanket body and a temperature control system, wherein a head wearing hole is formed in the wearing blanket body, the wearing blanket body is composed of four layers, namely an inner container placing layer, a carbon fiber heating layer, a heat preservation layer and a waterproof wear-resistant fabric layer, the inner container placing layer and the carbon fiber heating layer are detachably connected through a liner changing zipper, a placing cavity is formed in the inner container placing layer and is provided with a plurality of inner containers with different functions, the inner containers are detachably fixed in the placing cavity through magic tapes, and the temperature control system comprises a temperature sensor, a controller and an operation panel. The multifunctional blanket can be used as a common blanket and worn on the body, is multifunctional, is internally provided with the detachable and replaceable inner container, can replace the inner container which cannot be used according to the needs of a human body, meets diversified conditioning needs, can be detached and replaced, and is convenient to clean.

title_en: Ring type blood sugar noninvasive detection device based on multi-mode sensing fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ring-type blood glucose noninvasive detection device based on multi-mode sensing fusion, which relates to the technical field of medical detection equipment, and comprises a data acquisition module; the invention utilizes a multi-mode data fusion technology to improve the accuracy and anti-interference capability of noninvasive detection of blood sugar by integrating optical, electrochemical and mechanical sensors, breaks through the traditional single-mode limitation, adopts a self-supervision learning algorithm to construct a personalized digital twin base line, combines the data dynamic adjustment of diet, movement and the like of users, and generates customized health intervention suggestion.

title_en: Method and system for predicting risk of severe herpes zoster of tumor patient
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for predicting the risk of severe herpes zoster of a tumor patient, which comprises the following steps of constructing a scoring system for scoring the severity of the herpes zoster, defining the severe ending of the herpes zoster, constructing an original data set based on the medical data of the tumor patient with a certain sample size after the diagnosis of the severe herpes zoster is finished, constructing a minimum absolute contraction and selection operator (LASSO) regression model, namely introducing the model on the basis of a logistic regression model The norm penalty term is used for carrying out feature screening on data in the original data set to output a core prediction variable, taking the core prediction variable as an independent variable and a severe ending as a dependent variable, constructing an original multi-factor Logistic regression prediction model, and carrying out recalibration on the original multi-factor Logistic regression prediction model. The method screens and determines core prediction indexes, establishes a risk prediction model for severe herpes zoster, determines coefficients and intercept of each prediction variable, and has excellent distinguishing capability and good calibration performance.

title_en: Growth factor gradient bionic scaffold and application thereof in tendon bone interface repair
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a growth factor gradient bionic scaffold for regeneration and repair of a tendon-bone interface, and belongs to the technical field of biomedical materials. The composite bracket is constructed by adopting a coaxial electrospinning and self-assembly technology, and is formed by compositing a core-shell oriented nanofiber layer and a non-oriented nanofiber layer through a gelatin adhesive to respectively simulate tendon phase and bone phase structures of a tendon bone interface, wherein a shell layer of the core-shell oriented nanofiber simulating the tendon phase is a PCL layer containing CTGF, a core layer is a PVA layer containing TGF-beta 1, and the non-oriented nanofiber layer simulating the bone phase is a PCL/Gel co-spinning layer containing BMP-2 polylactic acid microspheres and nano hydroxyapatite. The scaffold can realize the secondary controlled release of CTGF early release, TGF-beta 1 middle and later slow release and BMP-2 sustained release, and the scaffold is cooperated with a fiber orientation structure to induce mesenchymal stem cells to differentiate in a grading manner, so that the tendon-bone interface gradient structure integrated repair is promoted, the problems of poor healing of the tendon-bone interface and high repeated fracture rate in the traditional repair method are solved, and the scaffold has important application value in the field of sports medical tendon-bone injury treatment.

title_en: Schiff base-sulfonated hyaluronic acid photocuring microsphere, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biomedical materials. Discloses Schiff base-sulfonated hyaluronic acid photo-curing microspheres, a preparation method and application thereof. The microsphere is prepared by condensing DL-lysine and paeonol to generate Schiff base, then conjugating the Schiff base with sulfonated hyaluronic acid through a carbodiimide chemical method, and finally adopting a microfluidic technology to mold and curing by ultraviolet rays. The metal chelating property of the Schiff base is combined with the precise structure regulation advantage of the microsphere, and the prepared microsphere has excellent synergistic effect when being applied to the surface of degradable magnesium alloy, iron alloy, zinc alloy and other implant materials, can remarkably improve the corrosion resistance of a matrix material to form an effective protective layer, has multiple biological functions of promoting endothelial cell proliferation, inhibiting smooth muscle cell hyperproliferation and regulating macrophage polarization to an anti-inflammatory phenotype, and has wide application prospect in biomedical fields such as vascular stents, bone fixation instruments and the like.

title_en: Fluorescent navigation's lacrimal canaliculus broken end discernment and anastomat
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fluorescent navigation lacrimal duct broken end identification and anastomosis device, which relates to the technical field of ophthalmic medical instruments and comprises a micro needle holder, wherein one side of the micro needle holder is provided with a pair of connecting blocks, one side of each connecting block is provided with a detachable connecting mechanism and a detachable matching mechanism, an embedded groove is formed in the lacrimal duct probe, a fluorescent rod capable of emitting infrared fluorescence is arranged in the groove, when a broken part of the lacrimal duct is required to be observed, the lacrimal duct probe capable of emitting infrared fluorescence is inserted into the lacrimal duct, the broken end position of the lacrimal duct is judged, a subsequent doctor can conveniently hold the micro needle holder to perform anastomosis operation on the lacrimal duct, the broken end can be quickly and accurately aligned and stitched, the success rate and operation efficiency of high broken end identification are improved, the operation difficulty and the excessive dependence on the experience of the doctor are reduced, and the improvement of the postoperative anastomosis rate and life quality of patients is facilitated.

title_en: Vehicle neck pillow, vehicle seat and massage control method of vehicle seat
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of vehicle neck pillows, in particular to a vehicle neck pillow, a vehicle seat and a massage control method of the vehicle seat, wherein the vehicle neck pillow comprises a pillow frame, a pillowcase and a massage component, the massage component comprises a first air bag and a second air bag, a first massage inclined plane and a second massage inclined plane are arranged on one side surface of the pillow frame, which is back to the backrest, the first massage inclined plane and the second massage inclined plane are intersected in the up-down direction of the vehicle seat, the first air bag is arranged on the first massage inclined plane, the second air bag is arranged on the second massage inclined plane, the pillow case is wrapped on the pillow frame, the first air bag and the second air bag, the first air bag is used for carrying out upward lifting massage on the head and neck of a passenger, and the second air bag is used for carrying out downward massage on the shoulder and neck of the passenger. The feeling of ache generated by the neck of the passenger is relieved, and the comfort and experience of the passenger are improved.

title_en: Light therapeutic device for treating body with light of various wavelengths
abstract_en: A light therapy device treats a subject with light of multiple wavelengths to provide beneficial therapeutic effects. The device may emit at least three different wavelengths selected from a specific combination of wavelengths that have been found to have synergistic and positive therapeutic effects. The light may be incorporated into any type of treatment device, such as a handheld light treatment device, a light treatment element integrated into a hat for treating the scalp or for hair loss, a light treatment couch, a light treatment facial treatment device, and a light treatment sauna.

title_en: Traditional Chinese medicine composition for relieving visual fatigue
abstract_en: The invention provides a traditional Chinese medicine composition for relieving visual fatigue, which is characterized by comprising, by weight, 0.1-1.5 parts of medlar, 0.05-1.47 parts of chrysanthemum, 0.02-0.5 part of ginseng, 0.02-0.7 part of cistanche salsa, 0.2-1.2 parts of roselle, 0.02-0.37 part of liquorice, 18-25 parts of citrus reticulata shells and 7-12 parts of puer tea. Experiments show that the food group has the effects of improving the photopic vision durability and relieving visual fatigue by comparing the food group before and after trial and comparing the food group after trial with the control group.

title_en: Hand-held type supersound vascular access device based on multimodality
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of medical appliances, in particular to a multi-mode-based handheld ultrasonic vascular access device, which comprises a handle, wherein the bottom of the handle is hinged with a probe for acquiring ultrasonic images, and the device also comprises a puncture guiding system, the puncture guiding system comprises an appliance guiding module, a virtual guiding module, an optical guiding module, an intelligent analysis module and a safety pre-warning module, the appliance guiding module monitors the real-time angle of a guiding tube through an angle sensor and adopts closed-loop control logic to control a driving piece to operate, and the device is also used for transmitting the real-time angle to the virtual guiding module, and the virtual guiding module is used for displaying the ultrasonic images acquired by the probe in real time and drawing virtual guide lines with the same angle in the ultrasonic images according to the real-time angle of the guiding tube. According to the multi-mode collaborative guiding system, the requirement on the coordination ability of hands and eyes of doctors is reduced, and the accuracy and safety of the puncture angle are improved.

title_en: Positioning and sewing mechanism for meniscus sewing
abstract_en: The invention provides a positioning and sewing mechanism for meniscus sewing, which comprises a grabbing mechanism, an adjusting mechanism and a limiting mechanism, wherein the adjusting mechanism is arranged on one side of the top end of the grabbing mechanism, the limiting mechanism is arranged on the other side of the top end of the grabbing mechanism, a sewing needle structure is arranged in the adjusting mechanism, the top end of the limiting mechanism is provided with the positioning mechanism, the sewing needle structure comprises a rotary pipe sleeve, a sewing needle, a telescopic pipe, a first telescopic rod and a second telescopic rod, the rotary pipe sleeve is movably inserted into the adjusting mechanism, the sewing needle is movably arranged in the rotary pipe sleeve, the telescopic pipe is fixedly arranged on two sides of the surface of the rotary pipe sleeve, the first telescopic rod is movably arranged at the outer end of the telescopic pipe, and the second telescopic rod is movably arranged at the outer end of the first telescopic rod. The device can be adapted to the meniscus shapes of different patients to adjust, and the position to be sutured is accurately positioned.

title_en: Cerebral apoplexy information processing method and system based on EEG-fNIRS multi-mode fusion
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a cerebral apoplexy information processing method and system based on EEG-fNIRS multi-mode fusion, and particularly relates to the field of biomedical engineering. The method comprises the steps of synchronously collecting signals of a to-be-tested object to obtain an EEG signal and fNIRS signals, respectively extracting single-mode and multi-mode characteristics based on the EEG signal and fNIRS signals to obtain a brain network characteristic set, and processing the brain network characteristic set by utilizing a cerebral apoplexy assessment and prediction model to obtain a processing result.

title_en: Intelligent catheter system integrating biomarker detection and closed-loop control and infection early warning method
abstract_en: The application discloses an intelligent catheter system integrating biomarker detection and closed-loop control and an infection early warning method, and relates to the technical field of intelligent medical treatment, comprising the steps of obtaining continuous time series urine biomarker concentration data and constructing a multidimensional state vector based on the urine biomarker concentration data; the method comprises the steps of inputting a multidimensional state vector into a preset infection state automatic identifier to obtain a current infection control state identifier, calling a corresponding state feedback control law from a control strategy library according to the current infection control state identifier, executing local intervention operation appointed by the state feedback control law, updating the multidimensional state vector in real time in the execution process, feeding the updated multidimensional state vector back to the infection state automatic identifier, judging that the current state feedback control law is invalid when the current infection control state identifier is continuously in an intervention response state for longer than a preset time period and is not migrated to a normal steady state, and triggering a control law reconstruction flow. The application enhances the clinical applicability of long-term use.

title_en: Adapter for mounting to a medical container, medical container comprising said adapter, and method of manufacturing said adapter
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to an adapter for mounting to a medical container, a medical container comprising the adapter, and a method of manufacturing the adapter. The adapter (1) comprises a distal portion (2) configured to receive a connector and a proximal portion (4) configured to be mounted to a distal tip (102) of a medical container (100). The proximal portion (4) comprises an inner ring (40) protruding from the transverse tubular wall (6) of the adapter (1), said inner ring (40) having an inner edge (42) defining an opening configured to receive the distal tip (102). The proximal portion (4) further comprises a gripping member (50) made of an elastomeric material, said gripping member (50) being connected to the inner edge (42) of the inner ring (40) to be in contact with the outer surface of the distal tip (102) when the adapter (1) is mounted on the medical container (100).

title_en: Hydrogel with tissue adhesiveness and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biomedical materials, in particular to a hydrogel with tissue adhesiveness, a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation raw materials of the hydrogel at least comprise aldehyde polysaccharide and a polyamino compound modified by phenylboronic acid, wherein the polyamino compound modified by phenylboronic acid is obtained by grafting phenylboronic acid compounds on the polyamino compound, and the adhesive strength of the hydrogel to pigskin is more than or equal to 40kPa. According to the invention, by constructing an aldehyde-phenylboronic acid-cation ternary synergistic system and introducing a double dynamic chemical bond (Schiff base bond and boric acid ester bond) to promote the formation of hydrogel, the prepared hydrogel has triple environment response capabilities (pH, ROS and blood sugar), can be accurately matched with the diabetes wound microenvironment (acidity, high ROS and hyperglycemia), reduces the wound infection risk, realizes drug release as required and improves the treatment efficiency.

title_en: Low-frequency pulse thermal moxibustion device and method for simulating moxibustion technique
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-frequency pulse thermal moxibustion device and method for simulating a moxibustion technique. The device comprises a low-voltage direct-current power supply, a low-frequency switch control circuit, a heating sheet module and a temperature control module. The low-frequency switch control circuit generates three working modes, namely rotary moxibustion, sparrow pecking moxibustion and mild moxibustion. The heating sheet module adopts a multilayer structure of carbon fiber/graphene/carbon film heating films, and the temperature control module precisely controls the surface temperature to be 35-55 ℃ by adjusting pulse parameters. The control method adopts a fuzzy PID and neural network fusion algorithm to realize double closed loop temperature control, the overshoot is less than or equal to 0.5 ℃, the stabilization time is less than or equal to 15 seconds, the steady state error is within +/-0.5 ℃, and overcurrent and overtemperature protection are integrated. The invention realizes the digital simulation of the traditional moxibustion technique by quantifying the electrical parameters, solves the problems of poor operation consistency, potential safety hazard and multi-point cooperative treatment, and has medical grade precision and household convenience.

title_en: Low-temperature plasma airflow generator
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-temperature plasma airflow generator, and relates to the technical field of human skin beauty. The plasma generator comprises an insulating casing, wherein two sides of the end part of the insulating casing are fixedly connected with a first connecting plate, an installation seat is rotatably connected to the first connecting plate, a rotating shaft is fixedly connected to the installation seat, the rotating shaft is rotatably connected to the first connecting plate, the end part of the rotating shaft is fixedly connected with a worm wheel, the outer side of the worm wheel is connected with a worm in a meshed mode, an installation groove is formed in the installation seat, a base is detachably arranged in the installation groove, a plasma generator head is arranged on the base, and a fixing mechanism is arranged at the top of the installation groove and used for realizing detachable installation of the installation seat and the base. According to the invention, the detachable base and the mounting seat are arranged, so that the plasma generating heads of different types can be replaced conveniently and rapidly, a user can replace the generating heads flexibly according to specific requirements, multiple devices are not required to be purchased additionally, and the universality and the economy of the devices are improved remarkably.

title_en: Portable temperature-control smoke-filtering moxibustion pot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of moxibustion cans, in particular to a portable temperature-control smoke-filtering moxibustion can which comprises an upper shell and a lower shell, wherein the inner sides of the upper shell and the lower shell are attached, a top cover is arranged above the upper shell, a steel needle is arranged in the center of the inner wall of the top cover, the outer wall of the lower part of the steel needle is connected with a wind-control wheel, and air holes III are formed in the inner walls of two sides of the upper end of the top cover. Through the cooperation between filter cotton, steel needle, top cap, accuse wind wheel, last shell, bleeder vent, the flexible body of silica gel is fixed in on the silica gel mounting, screws into the shell down, through the flexible body control of tensile silica gel and the distance of skin and then control body temperature sensing degree, so, alright through switch inlet port and the flexible head that contracts of tensile moxa-moxibustion tank bottom, control oxygen entering amount and Ai Zhuju are from the distance of skin simultaneously, reach better temperature control. While controlling the temperature, portability and ease of use are also of concern.

title_en: Auxiliary decision data processing system for pediatric hip joint surgery anesthesia scheme
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of medical data processing and intelligent decision making, in particular to an auxiliary decision making data processing system of an anesthesia scheme of a pediatric hip joint operation, which comprises a multidimensional state acquisition module, a control module and a control module, wherein the multidimensional state acquisition module synchronously acquires perioperative physiological sign and environmental event data; the system comprises a causal decoupling analysis module, a compensation reserve evaluation module, a risk game decision module, a proportion optimization output module, a proportion optimization module and a proportion optimization module, wherein the causal decoupling analysis module is used for decomposing physiological signal fluctuation into nociceptive stimulus, drug inhibition and capacity deficiency components, the compensation reserve evaluation module is used for generating a quantized system compensation reserve index based on causal attribution vectors, the risk game decision module is used for constructing a multi-target dynamic game model and generating a control strategy according to an interval where the index is located, and the proportion optimization output module is used for calculating dynamic proportion parameters aiming at different control variables to generate a decision instruction.

title_en: High-toughness conductive polyvinyl alcohol/polyacrylamide/carboxymethyl cellulose hydrogel and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-toughness conductive polyvinyl alcohol/polyacrylamide/carboxymethyl cellulose hydrogel and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the hydrogel is prepared by adding polyvinyl alcohol into deionized water, and dissolving under water bath heating to obtain a polyvinyl alcohol aqueous solution; adding carboxymethyl cellulose into polyvinyl alcohol aqueous solution and stirring uniformly, adding acrylamide into the mixed solution and stirring, adding conductive metal salt, cross-linking agent and initiator into the polyvinyl alcohol/polyacrylamide/carboxymethyl cellulose mixed solution and placing into a mould, polymerizing at high temperature, cooling to room temperature, placing into a refrigerator, freezing and thawing to obtain the high-toughness conductive polyvinyl alcohol/polyacrylamide/carboxymethyl cellulose hydrogel. The polyvinyl alcohol/polyacrylamide/carboxymethyl cellulose hydrogel prepared by the method has high toughness, fatigue resistance and good conductivity, and can be well applied to flexible sensors.

title_en: Monoclonal antibody targeting ELAPOR1 and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of medical biomaterial engineering application, and in particular relates to application of ELAPOR1 serving as a breast cancer drug target, a monoclonal antibody targeting ELAPOR1 or an antigen binding fragment thereof, wherein the amino acid sequences of a heavy chain variable region are respectively shown as SEQ ID No.1, 2 and 3 or antigen complementarity determining regions shown as SEQ ID No.21, 22 and 23, and the amino acid sequences of a light chain variable region are respectively shown as SEQ ID No.4, 5 and 6 or antigen complementarity determining regions respectively shown as SEQ ID No.24, 25 and 26. The monoclonal antibody disclosed by the invention specifically binds to an extracellular end epitope of ELAPOR protein, has high affinity and target specificity, is applied to an ADC (analog-to-digital converter) medicament targeting ELAPOR1 and a double-target CAR-T cell medicament, and specifically treats ER+ breast cancer, wherein the monoclonal antibody targeting ELAPOR1 or an antigen binding fragment thereof is applied to the ADC medicament targeting ELAPOR.

title_en: Autism spectrum disorder early screening method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an autism spectrum disorder early screening method, which comprises the following steps: compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages that the eye movement data of children when observing visual stimulus is recorded by adopting an eye movement tracking technology, and the data are analyzed and identified by a machine learning or artificial intelligence algorithm, so that the identification accuracy of early ASD symptoms is improved. Compared with the traditional subjective behavior observation method, the objective technology can reduce subjectivity and variability in the diagnosis process, and the eye tracking technology is a noninvasive screening method, and does not need cooperative wish or language ability of children. The method has higher applicability and can be widely applied to children of different ages and different development levels.

title_en: Catheter pump
abstract_en: The application provides a catheter pump, wherein a flexible shaft and a hard shaft in the catheter pump are mechanically connected and fixed through a connecting component, the connecting mode is not limited by flexible shaft and hard shaft materials, namely, the mechanical connection can realize the connection between a metal flexible shaft and a metal hard shaft, and the mechanical connection can also realize the connection between a metal flexible shaft and a non-metal hard shaft, namely, the flexible shaft and the hard shaft are connected through the connecting component, so that the selection range of the hard shaft materials is larger, the manufacturing of a driving shaft is more flexible, and particularly, the hard shaft made of the non-metal material has better biocompatibility on the basis of meeting the requirement of the roughness connected with an impeller, so that the potential risk of the hard shaft on organisms in working can be reduced to the greatest extent, and the connection reliability of the flexible shaft and the hard shaft through the connecting component is higher.

title_en: Radiological report generation method integrating clinical semantic modulation and hyperbolic prototype classification
abstract_en: The invention provides a radiological report generation method integrating clinical semantic modulation and hyperbolic prototype classification, which comprises the steps of acquiring chest X-ray images and associated clinical context knowledge thereof, extracting visual features of the images by utilizing a visual encoder, extracting clinical semantic embedding by utilizing a medical language encoder and retrieving related report features from a reference report database, constructing and utilizing a clinical semantic modulation module to generate a modulated visual representation, constructing and utilizing a hyperbolic prototype classification module to generate a diagnosis perception prompt, and inputting the modulated visual features and the diagnosis perception prompt into a decoder to complete autoregressive generation of a radiological report. The invention can fully utilize the cross-modal fusion of clinical knowledge and visual characteristics, and improve the disease detection capability under the condition of unbalanced category by utilizing the exponential expansion embedding capacity of hyperbolic space, thereby improving the clinical accuracy of radiological report generation.

title_en: Soft catheter protection device and protection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a soft catheter protection device and a soft catheter protection method. The device comprises an outer sleeve, a main support and an auxiliary support. The outer sleeve ① is coaxially sleeved outside the soft catheter and has hardness larger than that of the soft catheter for supporting and protecting, the main support ② is provided with a plurality of radial arc clamping grooves which are distributed at intervals and used for embedding and fixing the soft catheter sleeved with the outer sleeve in a spiral shape, and the auxiliary support ③ is matched with the main support to assist in fixing the spiral outer sleeve. The invention effectively solves the problems of easy winding, compressive deformation, easy joint damage and inconvenient taking of the medical flexible catheter, and has the advantages of regular structure, reliable protection and convenient operation.

title_en: Negative pressure control urine drainage system and method
abstract_en: A negative pressure control urine drainage system and method, the system includes the guardian equipment (10) and supporting drainage material, can empty the urine that is detained in bladder or drainage tube regularly, and calculate the true urine volume that the patient produced in the predetermined period, improve the accuracy of urine volume measurement in the unit time, provide the credible monitoring data for AKI, and reduce stifled pipe and urinary tract infection risk.

title_en: Negative pressure sputum aspirator based on automatic identification voltage
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of negative pressure sputum aspirator, and discloses a negative pressure sputum aspirator based on automatic identification voltage, which utilizes a sputum viscosity estimation module to perform joint operation on pressure difference data and flow data at the upstream and downstream of a pipeline, and obtaining a sputum viscosity estimated value, and dynamically generating a bionic attraction waveform comprising a three-section structure of negative pressure climbing, high-frequency micropulse disturbance overlapped by a peak platform and slow release by the controller. The multi-point differential pressure positioning module performs paragraph positioning on the blocking position through a differential pressure sensor array arranged along a pipeline, and the grading dredging module performs targeted negative pressure pulse intervention according to the blocking position and the blocking component type. And detecting the input voltage by using a circuit board in the controller, judging whether the input voltage is 110V or 220V, and then automatically switching to a corresponding line to perform double-voltage self-adaption.

title_en: Cell therapeutic preparation based on tumor specific antigen and application of cell therapeutic preparation in solid tumor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cell therapeutic preparation based on tumor specific antigen and application thereof in solid tumor, relating to the technical field of biological medicine, wherein the preparation is a composite preparation wrapped by a temperature-sensitive chitosan-hyaluronic acid composite shell layer, the core of the preparation is prepared from double recognition domain CAR-T cells, surface modified pH sensitive slow release microspheres and indoleamine 2, 3-dioxygenase inhibitor. The CAR-T cells are subjected to tumor-specific double-recognition domain targeting design, and simultaneously, the TGF-beta switch receptor is fused to relieve the mediated immunosuppression and block the immunosuppression effect of an adenosine channel, and the function-modified slow-release microsphere is adopted to mediate cell penetration, so that the nonspecific recognition of normal cells and the complete elimination of multiple immunosuppression of tumor microenvironment are avoided, the CAR-T cells are accurately targeted to tumor cells and deeply infiltrated into a tumor core area, and the problems of insufficient targeting specificity and difficult cell infiltration in solid tumor treatment are solved.

title_en: Detection item recommending method, clinical examination auxiliary decision-making system and hospital information system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a detection item recommending method, a clinical examination auxiliary decision making system and a hospital information system, which are used for improving the accuracy of recommending detection items to patients. The method comprises the steps of obtaining latest diagnosis information of a patient in a hospital information system, displaying the latest diagnosis information in a preset display interface, wherein the latest diagnosis information of the patient at least comprises a patient identification and a latest diagnosis disease identification of the patient, the preset display interface further comprises a detection medical advice display control, responding to triggering operation of the detection medical advice display control, inquiring a detection item index table according to the latest diagnosis disease identification of the patient to determine a necessary detection item and/or an optional detection item associated with the latest diagnosis disease identification, and displaying an optional detection item component and an optional detection item component in the preset display interface according to the necessary detection item and/or the optional detection item.

title_en: Leak-proof one-way valve, hydraulic cylinder, artificial limb and robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a leakage-proof one-way valve, a hydraulic cylinder, a prosthetic limb and a robot. The anti-leakage one-way valve comprises a valve core, a sealing element and a valve body, wherein an inner expansion groove is formed in the valve core, the central angle corresponding to a notch of the inner expansion groove is smaller than 180 degrees, the sealing element is positioned in the inner expansion groove, a sealing surface is formed at an inlet of the valve body, and the surface of the sealing element protrudes out of the notch and is in contact with the sealing surface. The part of the surface of the sealing piece protrudes out of the notch and is contacted and tightly attached with the sealing surface to realize sealing. The inner expansion groove extends from the notch to the groove bottom to two sides, so that the sealing piece is not easy to fall off, and the leakage prevention effect of the leakage prevention one-way valve is improved.

title_en: Multi-parameter fusion heart rehabilitation exercise risk real-time assessment method and system thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-parameter fusion heart rehabilitation exercise risk real-time assessment method and a system thereof, which relate to the technical field of medical health information, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting electrocardiosignal, heart rate and acceleration data; the method comprises the steps of extracting ST-segment offset, QT interval and heart rate variability characteristics, calculating heart rate reserve percentage and metabolism equivalent, inputting multidimensional characteristics into a bidirectional LSTM network to output risk probability, determining risk level according to comprehensive risk index and generating exercise intensity suggestion.

title_en: Lung focus prediction method based on multi-mode data and storage medium thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a lung focus prediction method based on multi-mode data and a storage medium thereof, which are characterized in that a chest CXR image of a patient and clinical physiological data of the patient are acquired, the chest CXR image and the clinical physiological data are input into a multi-mode model, lung focus prediction is carried out on the chest CXR image based on the clinical physiological data through the multi-mode model, a prediction result of a focus in the chest CXR image is obtained, the prediction result comprises a focus area and the influence degree of the focus on the patient, the influence degree comprises light and heavy, the limitation of a single image mode is broken through under the condition that the multi-scale spatial characteristics of the chest CXR image are fused with the structured clinical physiological data, and when the focus image is atypical or fuzzy, effective supplement and cross verification can be carried out according to clinical information, so that the accuracy and the robustness of focus identification and classification are greatly improved.

title_en: Electrosurgical device
abstract_en: Electrosurgical device (1) comprising-at least one substantially hollow body (2) having an elongated configuration, provided with a proximal end (3) and a distal end (4), the proximal end (3) being connectable to a current generator (5) and supply means (6) of an electrically conductive fluid (7), the distal end (4) being provided with at least one active electrode (8) and at least one neutral electrode (9) for contacting the body of a patient, and-at least one tubular conduit (10) passing through the body (2), the tubular conduit (10) being provided with at least one supply hole (11) of the fluid (7) and at least one distribution hole (12) of the fluid (7), -a gripping portion (13) associated with the body (2), wherein the gripping portion (13) comprises coupling means (17), the coupling means (17) being gripable by an operator or associable with at least one gripping device (18) of a robotic mobile device (19) of the electrosurgical device (1).

title_en: Ultrasonic image processing method and system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a processing method and a processing system of an ultrasonic image, wherein ultrasonic equipment is used for identifying and processing a plurality of ultrasonic images or ultrasonic echo data corresponding to the plurality of ultrasonic images by acquiring the plurality of ultrasonic images, determining the section types and quality scores of the plurality of ultrasonic images, and then associating the plurality of ultrasonic images to at least one target section type according to the section types of the plurality of ultrasonic images, so that the working efficiency of doctors can be remarkably improved, and the scanning flow is optimized. The ultrasonic equipment displays a recommended ultrasonic image list corresponding to at least one target section type based on the quality scores of the ultrasonic images associated with the at least one target section type, can recommend ultrasonic images based on the quality scores of the ultrasonic images associated with the target section type, and can select ultrasonic images with high quality scores for replacement to serve as ultrasonic section images of the target section type, so that section omission or errors caused by human factors are reduced, and the accuracy and the completeness of inspection are ensured.

title_en: Multifunctional intelligent blind crutch
abstract_en: The application provides a multifunctional intelligent crutch, which consists of a handle and a crutch body, wherein the crutch body is provided with a space detection module, and the handle is provided with a video acquisition module, a sensor module, a multifunctional control module, a prompt module and an adjustment module. The blind crutch can collect environmental data of the current environment in multiple modes through the space detection module, the video acquisition module and the sensor module, and provides rich scene understanding dimension for comprehensive perception of complex scenes. The multifunctional control module can activate the functional unit corresponding to the current scene mode to perform data processing and generate a feedback signal based on the collected environmental data, and the departure prompt module outputs a corresponding information prompt, so that the blind crutch can realize intelligent collaborative operation of multiple functions for different scenes. In addition, the current scene mode of the blind crutch can be rapidly switched through the pressing operation of the sensing user, so that the blind crutch can be better adapted to various actual use scenes, and the practicability and the adaptability are improved.

title_en: Sealed negative pressure liquid collecting and film pasting system for lumbar minimally invasive surgery
abstract_en: The application discloses a sealing negative pressure liquid collecting and pasting film system for lumbar minimally invasive surgery, the sealed negative pressure liquid collecting film pasting system comprises a sterile sealed film pasting component, a buffering/guiding component, a negative pressure drainage interface component, a sealed collecting tank and a negative pressure driving component. The sterile sealing film assembly comprises a flexible transparent covering layer, a waterproof sealing layer and a medical adhesive layer which are laminated and compounded into a whole from top to bottom, the flexible transparent covering layer, the waterproof sealing layer and the medical adhesive layer are tightly attached to an operation towel or skin and form a sealed liquid collecting cavity surrounding an operation incision by matching with an annular buffering/guiding assembly arranged on the inner side of the flexible transparent covering layer, the waterproof sealing layer and the medical adhesive layer, the buffering/guiding assembly disperses and guides liquid to prevent local accumulation, and a negative pressure driving assembly applies continuous negative pressure to the sealed cavity to enable lavage liquid to be sucked into a drainage tube and enter a sealed collecting tank with a gas-liquid separation structure through a one-way backflow prevention device. The system realizes active, airtight and continuous collection of lavage fluid in operation, avoids damage of local effusion to a sealing structure, and ensures continuous smoothness of a liquid discharge path.

title_en: Cardiac signal detection method of characteristic decoupling millimeter wave radar based on contrast learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of non-contact vital sign monitoring, and particularly discloses a heart signal detection method of a feature decoupling millimeter wave radar based on contrast learning. The invention realizes the automatic separation of the rhythm characteristic and the morphological characteristic of the heart signal from the millimeter wave radar signal by constructing the self-adaptive filtering module, the sample generator, the multi-scale characteristic extraction module, the dual-path characteristic decoupling module, the physical constraint module and the contrast learning loss function. The invention utilizes contrast learning to construct a positive sample pair, guides a model to learn characteristic representation of unchanged heart rate variation and waveform deformation, combines physiological prior constraint, and improves the robustness and the interpretability of the characteristics. The invention effectively solves the defects of the traditional method in terms of signal separation, noise suppression and generalization capability, and can be widely applied to heart health monitoring tasks such as heart rate variability analysis, arrhythmia detection and the like.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and storage medium for determining execution data of treatment equipment
abstract_en: The application provides an execution data determining method, a device, equipment and a storage medium of treatment equipment, which are applied to the technical field of medical equipment, and are implemented by acquiring equipment parameters of the treatment equipment for executing spiral projection radiotherapy and detection data corresponding to a target user; the method comprises the steps of determining thread effect model data corresponding to treatment equipment, determining variable pitch track data corresponding to a target user according to equipment parameters, detection data and the thread effect model data, executing reverse dose optimization operation based on the variable pitch track data corresponding to the target user, and determining current execution data of the treatment equipment aiming at the target user. The application provides a systematic and high-robustness execution data determining method, which effectively reduces the thread effect and ensures the treatment process of a target user.

title_en: Intelligent wheelchair control method and system based on electroencephalogram and myoelectricity fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent wheelchair control method and system based on electroencephalogram and myoelectricity fusion, which comprises the steps of synchronously collecting and preprocessing electroencephalogram and myoelectricity signals, outputting current intention probability through a local mixed model comprising a wavelet channel attention and parallel conversion module, predicting future intention probability by using a lightweight transducer encoder, combining historical prediction accuracy with signal quality dynamic fusion decision, caching high-confidence samples without intervention or safety events, fine-tuning a local model base after reaching a threshold value, uploading after achieving privacy protection by using Laplace noise, weighting and polymerizing by a cloud according to data quantity to generate a global model, and issuing and updating. The invention improves the continuity and robustness of wheelchair control, shortens the calibration period of new users, realizes the continuous evolution of models under privacy protection, and is suitable for autonomous movement assistance of people with limb disabilities and dyskinesias.

title_en: Magnesium alloy composite bracket and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a magnesium alloy composite stent, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the composite stent is composed of a JDBM magnesium alloy stent with a high-connectivity porous structure and a composite hydrogel layer filled and wrapped by the composite stent, and the hydrogel layer is formed by photo-crosslinking and curing of methacryloylated gelatin loaded with glucose oxidase. The composite bracket is a biological battery treatment system, GOx catalyzes the biocatalysis oxidation end of glucose to generate hydrogen peroxide, magnesium alloy is used as an adaptive electrochemical cascade reaction system which is jointly formed by an electroactive negative electrode, and hydrogen peroxide is rapidly removed into water and oxygen through spontaneous oxidation dissolution and short-circuit electrochemical reaction, and Mg  2+  release is synchronously promoted. Therefore, the system not only converts the high-sugar microenvironment harmful to diabetes into the microenvironment favorable for bone regeneration, but also realizes multiple synergies of anti-inflammatory, antioxidant and bone promotion through the continuous supply of magnesium ions and the timely removal of H  2 O 2 , and obviously promotes the repair and regeneration of bone defects under the condition of diabetes.

title_en: Fire-fighting suit maintenance bin and control system thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent fire-fighting equipment management device and a control system thereof, and relates to the technical field of intelligent storage and control of fire-fighting equipment. The maintenance bin comprises a lower box body, a middle box body and an upper box body which are sequentially communicated, wherein a vertical plate driven by a rotating mechanism is arranged in the middle box body, a top plate, a middle partition plate and a bottom plate are arranged on two sides of the vertical plate from top to bottom, and the vertical plate is respectively used for hanging firefighters, placing gloves, helmets and shoes and boots, so that partition storage is realized. The control system comprises a control console, a communication module, a warning situation recognition module and an RFID recognition module, is linked with the fire-fighting warning situation system through the communication module, automatically matches and drives the rotating mechanism to rapidly rotate corresponding equipment to a taking position according to the warning situation type, and simultaneously optimizes positioning time by adopting a shortest path rotation strategy. The intelligent storage, quick selection, automatic maintenance and full life cycle management of the fire-fighting equipment are realized, and the emergency response efficiency of the fire-fighting station is remarkably improved.

title_en: Ultrasonic eye axis measuring device and measuring method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultrasonic eye axis measuring device and a measuring method, wherein the ultrasonic eye axis measuring device comprises an ultrasonic probe unit and a processing unit, the ultrasonic probe unit is electrically connected with the processing unit, the processing unit is used for sending a measurement starting instruction to the ultrasonic probe unit and sending measurement parameters to the ultrasonic probe unit, and a data processing module of the processing unit is used for receiving the flight time of ultrasonic waves sent by the ultrasonic probe unit on an eye axis and the real-time temperature of eyes, calculating the flight speed after temperature compensation according to a sound velocity-temperature relation model, and calculating the length of the eye axis according to the flight speed and the flight time after temperature compensation. The ultrasonic probe unit comprises a microcontroller, a timer is arranged in the microcontroller, a special time digital conversion chip in the prior art is replaced, hardware cost is reduced, and measurement accuracy is ensured through a dual software strategy of temperature real-time compensation and factory tail end calibration.

title_en: High-transmission-capacity composite xenon light transmission window
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biological safety protection, and discloses a high-transmission composite xenon light transmission window which comprises a frame, glass doors arranged on two end faces of the frame, filter flashboard arranged on the back face of the frame and positioned on one side of the glass doors, control panels arranged on two end faces of the frame, a separation frame arranged in the frame, a plurality of mounting plates arranged in the separation frame, a stainless steel grid mesh arranged between two vertically opposite mounting plates, and a sterilization structure.

title_en: Intelligent feedback training system and method for lower limbs
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent feedback training system and method for lower limbs, and belongs to the technical field of rehabilitation training. The system comprises a multi-source information acquisition module, a real-time intention and state identification module, a self-adaptive decision and control module, a multi-mode feedback execution module and a training data management and individual model updating module. The multisource information acquisition module is used for acquiring force information, motion information and physiological information in the lower limb training process; the system comprises a real-time intention and state recognition module, a self-adaptive decision and control module, a multi-mode feedback execution module, a training data management and individual model updating module and a multi-mode feedback execution module, wherein the real-time intention and state recognition module is used for carrying out fusion analysis on multi-source information, recognizing the movement intention of a user and evaluating the movement state, the self-adaptive decision and control module is used for generating a training parameter adjustment instruction according to the movement intention, the movement state, a training target and individual capacity parameters, the multi-mode feedback execution module is used for providing feedback for the user according to the training parameters, and the training data management and individual model updating module is used for updating the individual capacity parameters. Through the structure, the self-adaptive adjustment and the closed-loop feedback of the lower limb training process are realized.

title_en: Upper limb rehabilitation evaluation platform and method based on computer vision and MYO arm ring
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rehabilitation evaluation, in particular to an upper limb rehabilitation evaluation platform and method based on computer vision and MYO arm rings, wherein in the invention, a periodic characteristic vector formed by an included angle mean value, myoelectricity delay and track fluctuation difference is subjected to sparse scoring to judge an abnormal section, so that the positioning accuracy of repetitive abnormal actions is improved, a myoelectricity activation difference value and a mutation trend between nodes are fused in a graph structure, a jump node connection sequence and an interframe structure change are processed through a graph neural network, the multi-node state change track is obtained, the structure expression capability of the sequential mutation and myoelectric activation linkage is enhanced, the included angle inversion times, the acceleration peak value and the myoelectric wave movement amplitude are extracted in a segmented mode and then are spliced to form a fusion feature table, the normalized feature value is mapped into a grade label through an interval matching method, a traceable feature index path is established between the segmented behavior structure and the grade output, and the staged identifiable degree and the output expression granularity of the rehabilitation state are improved.

title_en: Maxillofacial plastic and orthodontic combined positioning correction device
abstract_en: The invention provides a combined positioning correction device for maxillofacial reshaping and orthodontics, which comprises a fixed bottom plate, a positioning mechanism and a pulling mechanism, wherein the positioning mechanism comprises two fixed rods, two movable rods, two groups of adjusting components and two groups of connecting components, the two fixed rods are symmetrically arranged on the fixed bottom plate, and the two movable rods are respectively arranged in the corresponding fixed rods.
