According to the jaw-face shaping and orthodontic combined positioning correction device, the pulling mechanism is arranged, the adjusting seat can be used for driving the supporting rods to synchronously move, so that multi-point synchronous pulling limit is formed on the jaw, the dislocation and displacement risk of the jaw after operation is reduced, meanwhile, the adjusting assembly is matched, fine adjustment of the tensioning force is realized by the aid of the threaded rod, the correction force can be conveniently adjusted and controlled according to the defect degree and difference of the jaw of a patient, and the jaw damage caused by overlarge correction force and the influence on the correction effect due to overlarge force are avoided.

title_en: Brain-computer interface auxiliary rehabilitation system based on double-feedback closed-loop mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a brain-computer interface auxiliary rehabilitation system based on a double-feedback closed-loop mechanism, which relates to the technical field of rehabilitation and comprises a signal acquisition module, a signal processing module, a double-feedback closed-loop module, a rehabilitation execution module and a main control module, wherein the signal acquisition module is used for acquiring an electroencephalogram signal of a user and a motion state signal in a rehabilitation training process, the signal processing module is in communication connection with the signal acquisition module and is used for preprocessing the acquired electroencephalogram signal, extracting characteristics and decoding motion intention, the double-feedback closed-loop module is respectively in communication connection with the signal processing module and the rehabilitation execution module to construct a double-feedback closed loop, the rehabilitation execution module is in communication connection with the main control module and is used for driving limbs of the user to finish targeted rehabilitation according to a motion intention decoding result and an adjusted training parameter, and the main control module is used for coordinating working time sequence and data interaction of each module. The brain-computer interface auxiliary rehabilitation system based on the double-feedback closed-loop mechanism solves the problems of low decoding precision, single feedback, insufficient individuation and the like of the traditional rehabilitation system.

title_en: Health conditioning system based on monopole negative oxygen ion flow
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rehabilitation physiotherapy and provides a health conditioning system based on monopole negative oxygen ion current, which comprises a monopole negative oxygen ion current generating device, a geomagnetic ring drainage device and a geomagnetic ring drainage device, wherein the monopole negative oxygen ion current generating device is used for uniformly releasing monopole negative oxygen ion current into air at a preset distance of a human body to enable the monopole negative oxygen ion current to be combined with oxygen ions in the air to generate effective negative oxygen ion current, the geomagnetic ring drainage device is used for forming a closed-loop drainage circuit based on human body-air-ground potential difference by utilizing a grounding wire, and the effective negative oxygen ion current is driven to form circulation scrubbing which is introduced from one end of the human body and led out from the other end of the human body. The invention realizes the non-respiratory monopole negative oxygen ion current introduction, improves the efficiency and depth of negative oxygen ions entering a human body, establishes the circulation effect of 'having an inlet and an outlet' of the negative oxygen ion current, solves the health problem of 'remaining without flowing', and realizes the technical targets of promoting metabolism of the human body, expelling toxins, waking up cell energy and improving immunity through the continuous action of the negative oxygen ion current.

title_en: Physical stamina monitoring system and method based on sensing data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of physical stamina monitoring, in particular to a physical stamina monitoring system and a physical stamina monitoring method based on sensing data, which comprise the steps of collecting heart rate and body temperature signals and completing trend extension and bidirectional alignment, and extracting a jump and fluctuation path identification state change section, performing hysteresis calibration by combining body temperature response delay, and outputting a core state monitoring result of cooperative change. According to the invention, a bidirectional time axis alignment structure of heart rate and body temperature signals is constructed, notch alignment is completed by combining a trend extension mode, the continuous consistency of a data sequence is enhanced, the rhythm characteristics of state change are described by identifying heart rate jump sections and fluctuation path distribution, then a cross-signal hysteresis contrast relationship is established by combining the positions of body temperature drop inflection points, and core fragments of state change are extracted on the basis of cooperative change, so that physical energy state identification results covering signal continuity, fluctuation structures and hysteresis response are formed.

title_en: Brain-computer interface-oriented nerve disturbance tACS sleep brain network personalized closed-loop regulation and control method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a brain-computer interface-oriented nerve disturbance tACS sleep brain network personalized closed-loop regulation and control method and system, and belongs to the field of brain-computer interfaces. Aiming at the problems of fixed stimulation parameters, insufficient individual difference adaptation and lack of excitation inhibition directional information flow quantification and closed loop feedback mechanisms of the existing tACS sleep regulation strategy, the invention firstly acquires the night sleep electroencephalogram data and the cognitive behavior data, constructs a fusion brain function connection matrix, extracts excitation inhibition directional information flow characteristics and identifies memory consolidation low-benefit objects. And then generating an individualized tACS stimulation parameter through gradient inversion optimization based on a transducer neural dynamics prediction model, and inputting the individualized tACS stimulation parameter into a closed-loop feedback system to dynamically adjust a stimulation strategy according to the state of the real-time brain network. The invention realizes the individualized nerve regulation and control of sleep memory consolidation, improves the effectiveness of the stimulation scheme, and solves the problems of unstable effect and difficult dynamic adjustment of the traditional method.

title_en: Cerebral apoplexy SD rat model damage evaluation system and quantification method
abstract_en: Aiming at the defects of poor model stability, single evaluation time point, lack of brain microvascular injury specific evaluation, strong subjectivity and the like of the existing permanent cerebral artery occlusion SD rat model evaluation system, the invention constructs an evaluation system comprising a model standardized preparation module, a three-stage dynamic evaluation module, a multi-mode accurate quantization module and an artificial intelligent fusion comprehensive scoring module, adopts a wire bolt insertion depth formula based on rat weight to combine laser Doppler blood flow monitoring quality control in operation, covers three injury stages, establishes a microvascular integrity index quantization method, and generates comprehensive injury scores through a random forest algorithm. The invention obviously improves the stability and the evaluation accuracy of the model, can dynamically monitor the evolution of the damage and predict the prognosis, and provides a standardized evaluation tool for the research and development of cerebral apoplexy medicaments.

title_en: Adsorption type hemodialysis ware
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of medical auxiliary equipment, and particularly discloses an adsorption type hemodialysis device which comprises a hemodialysis barrel body, wherein a blood inlet pipe is fixedly connected to the top of the hemodialysis barrel body, a blood outlet pipe is fixedly connected to the bottom of the hemodialysis barrel body, a gas temporary storage mechanism is arranged at the outer bottom end of the hemodialysis barrel body and used for collecting air flowing into blood in the hemodialysis barrel body, an automatic exhaust mechanism is arranged at the top of the gas temporary storage mechanism and used for automatically exhausting air in the gas temporary storage mechanism, and a protection mechanism is arranged outside the hemodialysis barrel body. Through the linkage cooperation of gas temporary storage mechanism and automatic exhaust mechanism, can guide gas to get into gas temporary storage mechanism to discharge through automatic exhaust mechanism, thereby can need not artifical frequent observation, reduced medical and nursing work load, and can reduce the embolism risk that causes because of the bubble.

title_en: Potential initialization and gradient optimization method in sparse view X-ray reconstruction based on 3D Gaussian splatter
abstract_en: The invention discloses a potential initialization and gradient optimization method in sparse view X-ray reconstruction based on 3D Gaussian splatter, in particular relates to the technical field of medical image three-dimensional reconstruction, and is used for solving the problems that in the existing sparse view X-ray reconstruction method based on three-dimensional Gaussian representation, an initial three-dimensional Gao Sidian cloud is easy to mix into background noise points and outliers, and a low-density detail structure is weak in gradient response in the optimization process. By establishing a unified projection coordinate relation, a high-density mask image and a low-density mask image are generated based on the intensity distribution of each projection image, voxel candidate points are mapped to each projection image plane, effective voxel points are screened according to the hit types and hit times of the masks, and an initial three-dimensional Gao Sidian cloud is generated by combining space occupancy, voxel scaling factors and multi-view intensity statistic values, so that background noise point and outlier point interference are reduced, and the structural consistency and reconstruction reliability of point cloud initialization under the sparse view condition are improved.

title_en: High-efficient heat dissipation appearance that moults
abstract_en: The application discloses a high-efficiency heat dissipation dehairing instrument which comprises a light-emitting component, a heat-absorbing component and a cold compress block. The heat absorption component comprises a light-transmitting heat absorption piece and a heat dissipation component, the light-transmitting heat absorption piece is in contact with the heat dissipation component, and the light-transmitting heat absorption piece is arranged on the light-emitting side of the light-emitting component and can lead out light emitted by the light-emitting component. The cold compress block is arranged on the light-transmitting and heat-absorbing part the side of the member facing away from the light emitting assembly. The application at least can solve the problem that the sapphire ice compress block in the prior art can not provide enough cold compress protection for skin.

title_en: Puncture outfit sleeve with double tubes, saccule puncture outfit sleeve and puncture outfit assembly
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of medical equipment and provides a puncture outfit sleeve with double pipes, which comprises a base body, an outer pipe and an inner pipe, wherein the base body comprises an outer base, an inner base and a pipe seat, the outer base is provided with a first fluid pipe, the inner base is provided with an opening and is communicated with the first fluid pipe, the pipe seat is provided with a second fluid pipe, the inside of the pipe seat is provided with an inner circular step and an outer circular step, an opening is arranged at the joint of the inner circular step and the outer circular step and is communicated with the second fluid pipe, the end part of the inner pipe and the end part of the outer pipe are fixed at different heights and are sealed on the inner circular step and the outer circular step, a certain distance is arranged between the inner pipe and the outer pipe to form a fluid channel with an annular cavity, and the fluid channel is communicated with the opening and then communicated with the second fluid pipe. The application also provides a balloon puncture outfit sleeve, a puncture outfit sleeve capable of simultaneously filling fluid and extracting fluid, and a puncture outfit assembly with the puncture outfit sleeve. The application solves the problems that the whole wall thickness of the sleeve of the existing puncture outfit is large and puncture wounds are easy to increase.

title_en: Fixing device for children operation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fixing device for children surgery, which belongs to the technical field of medical appliances and comprises limb devices, foot devices and a sliding frame assembly, wherein the foot devices are symmetrically arranged on the sliding frame assembly, the limb devices are used for fixing limbs of patients, the sliding frame assembly is rigidly connected with an operating table, the limb devices realize multi-angle positioning through joint assemblies, a double fixing mechanism of tooth surface clamping and thread locking can avoid angle deviation in surgery, sliding fit of an extension plate and a locking piece can adapt to different limb lengths, the foot devices adopt arc-shaped plantar grooves to fit plantar curves, foot length adaptation can be adjusted through clamping groove splicing of the extension plate, a medical silica gel gasket can buffer pressure, and the sliding frame assembly can accurately adjust foot inclination angles through a ball head structure and a telescopic fixing rod, so that the natural placement of the limbs is ensured, and the problems of poor adaptation, uneven pressure distribution and joint adjustment deficiency of the existing fixing devices are solved.

title_en: Preparation method of alpha-lactalbumin-based hydrogel based on glycyrrhizin interaction induction
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of biological materials and food colloids, and particularly relates to a preparation method of alpha-lactalbumin (alpha-La) based hydrogel based on interaction induction of glycyrrhizin (Gy). The invention provides an alpha-La-Gy composite hydrogel which can be controllably formed under the neutral condition of room temperature without heating, acid/alkali adjustment, crosslinking agent or chemical modification, non-covalent interaction, and the preparation method thereof, so as to realize the gelation of alpha-La under the mild condition, improve the water dispersibility and stability of Gy, and realize the precise control of gelation behavior and gelation performance through the cooperative regulation and control of the concentration of alpha-La and the concentration of Gy.

title_en: Hypochlorous acid washing air purification deodorizer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hypochlorous acid water washing air purification deodorizing machine, which belongs to the technical field of air purifiers and comprises a purification deodorizing mechanism, wherein the purification deodorizing mechanism comprises a purification box, a filter plate is connected to the inner wall of the purification box in a sliding manner, two sides of the bottom end of the filter plate are connected with the extending end of the inner wall of the purification box through compression springs, a first pushing rod and a second pushing rod are respectively and fixedly arranged on two sides of the top end of the filter plate, a fixed pipe arranged above the filter plate is arranged on the inner wall of the purification box, the top of the fixed pipe is connected with a liquid storage box arranged outside the purification box through a guide pipe, a sprayer matched with the fixed pipe is arranged on the fixed pipe, and the bottom of the sprayer is rotationally connected with a nozzle through a movable shaft. The invention can solve the technical problems that when the inside of the purifying cavity is large, a plurality of groups of spraying devices are required to be distributed, and an independent rotating mechanism is required to be arranged to rotate the nozzle, so that the production cost is increased, and the structural part is complex.

title_en: Injection device
abstract_en: An injection device for delivering an injection agent, the injection device comprising a housing having a longitudinal axis, a proximal end and a distal end, the housing being arranged such that the injection agent is delivered from the distal end of the housing, and a release mechanism comprising an obstruction, the release mechanism being movable between a first position in which the obstruction is in an obstructing position to obstruct the delivery of the injection agent and a second position in which the obstruction is in a non-obstructing position so as not to obstruct the delivery of the injection agent, wherein the injection device generates an audible signal when the release mechanism is moved from the first position to the second position.

title_en: Method for generating prescription of large traditional Chinese medicine model based on double-layer empirical memory and self-adaptive reasoning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for generating a prescription of a large traditional Chinese medicine model based on double-layer empirical memory and self-adaptive reasoning. The method carries out structural processing on the historical case data to form a standardized case-level memory unit, and constructs diagnosis and treatment principle memory arranged according to two-level grouping, and the two memory units together form a double-layer experience memory. The method comprises the steps of taking a summary of four diagnosis of a patient as a retrieval basis, executing two-channel retrieval, calculating comprehensive retrieval scores, obtaining a diagnosis and treatment thinking card through evidence type secondary positioning, dynamically selecting four prescription reasoning modes by a meta cognition controller according to a meta decision state vector, generating an initial prescription after assembling an enhanced context, completing multidimensional evaluation and multiple safety verification by means of comprehensive rewards, and finally updating a double-layer experience memory and self-adaptive reasoning strategy in a closed loop. The invention improves traceability and dialectical accuracy of the prescription, ensures medication safety, and realizes continuous improvement of living state inheritance of traditional Chinese medicine diagnosis and treatment experience and prescription reasoning capability.

title_en: Real-time sweat lactic acid analysis sensor based on novel material modification
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real-time sweat lactic acid analysis sensor, which firstly uses a novel material to modify a working electrode (301A), so that the working electrode (301A) has high specificity in reaction, can accurately react with lactic acid, eliminates a plurality of impurity interferences, and achieves the effect of detecting the health index of a human body part in real time. The device has the characteristics of high portability and low cost, the bionic nepenthes lip structure absorbing layer (302) is arranged in the device, sweat can be quickly and efficiently absorbed under the condition of micro sweat, and the three-electrode chip (4) embedded design can further prevent the three-electrode chip (4) from slipping due to friction reduction when a user sweats. The three-electrode chip (4) of the device has the characteristic of daily throwing due to low cost, so that the occurrence of inaccurate results caused by long-term use of the chip is reduced. Meanwhile, the split type design is adopted, the body-building headband (1), the shell (2), the signal transmission device (5) and the three-electrode chip (4) can be independently removed, and the cleaning is more convenient after the use.

title_en: System and method for locating medical injection devices in nest based on RFID
abstract_en: A system for locating an RFID-tagged medical injection device in a nest is provided herein. The system includes a conveyor that conveys a plurality of pods along a conveying path, each pod of the plurality of pods including an RFID-tagged nest therein that holds an RFID-tagged medical injection device. A plurality of RFID coupling elements are positioned at the reading location along the conveyance path, and an RFID reader is operatively connected with the RFID coupling elements to read the nest of the RFID tag as the nest passes the reading location, including reading a nest identifier associated with the nest. The processor determines whether the nest is in the first orientation or the second orientation based on a reading of the nest of RFID tags by one of the plurality of RFID coupling elements, queries a database using the nest identifier and the determined nest orientation, and registers a location of each RFID tagged medical injection device within the nest based on the query.

title_en: Electronic medical record information management system for operation anesthesia
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of medical data processing, in particular to an electronic medical record information management system for surgical anesthesia. The system performs statistical analysis on medical record samples under each patient characteristic dimension through a medical record sample statistical analysis module to obtain risk correlation of patient characteristics of each dimension. When a random forest model is built, a partition coefficient under each dimension is obtained in the decision tree according to the risk correlation of the patient characteristics, the information gain and the distribution occupation sign, each decision tree is built according to the partition coefficient, the random forest model is obtained, and the probability of anesthesia risk of the electronic medical record to be detected is output. According to the embodiment of the invention, the construction process of the random forest is optimized by evaluating the correlation between the characteristics of the patient and the anesthesia risk, so that the accuracy of risk judgment of the electronic medical record to be detected is ensured.

title_en: Image registration and tumor tracking system in laparoscopic liver cancer resection based on AI glasses
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of laparoscopic surgery, in particular to an AI glasses-based laparoscopic liver cancer resection intraoperative image registration and tumor tracking system which comprises a hardware layer, a software algorithm layer, an intraoperative interaction layer, a calibration adaptation layer and an auxiliary functional module. The laparoscopic liver cancer resection intraoperative image registration and tumor tracking system based on the AI glasses adopts an AI glasses, a dual-optical anchor point and an end edge cooperative computing framework for rapid calibration of the dual-anchor point before the operation, and a minimally invasive absorbable type internal anchor point is combined with a body surface anchor point, so that the problem of the traditional registration space mapping deviation is solved, the interference of breathing and organ peristalsis on registration and tracking is eliminated based on breathing-abdominal pressure time sequence compensation and LSTM predictive tracking algorithm, the registration precision is improved, the tracking error is reduced, and different operation scenes of an operator are adapted by constructing an eye movement and near field gesture complementary interaction mode.

title_en: Clinical device of changing dressings that uses of orthopedics
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a device of changing dressings of clinical usefulness of orthopedics, including U type layer board, plastic bag, rectangle slider, U type rectangular block, micro motor, medicine case, removable cover, bottom plate, rectangle strip hole, long screw, linking slider, directional wheel and bar hole. The utility model relates to a rationally, place on U type layer board and move the micro motor through the injured leg of patient and drive the rectangle slider rebound that the long screw rod is connected, reach the effect of the U type layer board rebound that will link to each other, be favorable to upwards holding up injured leg, the patient of being convenient for changes dressings, through U type layer board and the medicine case that rises simultaneously, can put corresponding reserve article of changing dressings in front of medical personnel, and the downthehole suit plastic bag of the bar of the U type layer board bottom placing injured leg, the liquid of wound is cleared up to the splendid attire of being convenient for, dismantlements such as gauze.

title_en: Novel air pressure wave massage system with cavity closing function
abstract_en: The application discloses novel air pressure wave massage system with chamber function closes, including the air pressure wave massage system of basis novel air pressure wave massage system still includes: and the closed cavity function setting module is used for acquiring closed cavity setting information of the air path air bag, and according to the closed cavity setting information of the air path air bag, when the novel air pressure wave massage system operates to the air path air bag part provided with the closed cavity, the air path air bag is not operated, and the air path air bag automatically jumps to the next air path air bag part which is sequentially inflated and deflated. Through increasing on the air pressure wave massage system of basis and setting up the closed chamber function setting module, increased unique gas circuit gasbag and closed the chamber and set up the function, can close the chamber setting according to user's user demand to the gasbag of corresponding gas circuit, and then increase user's use and experience.

title_en: Heightening sole with anti-skidding function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a sole processing technology field, and disclose a sole that increases with antiskid function, including the sole body, the sole body includes preceding sole region, arch of foot region and back sole region, and the bottom fixedly connected with wearing layer of sole body, the bottom fixedly connected with skid resistant course of wearing layer, the skid resistant course is located the lower surface of sole body, and the nail hole has been seted up to the regional bottom of preceding sole, the inside fixedly connected with briquetting in nail hole, the inside fixedly connected with antiskid nail of briquetting, the last fixed surface of wearing layer is connected with and increases the bed course. This increase sole that has anti-skidding function can increase the frictional strength on sole and ground through setting up the wave skid resistant course of unevenness, and the antiskid ribbed tile is favorable to grabbing ground, reduces people when the walking because ground is more smooth and the injury such as the foot of spraining that produces, and effectual protection user foot is healthy and safe, and the non-skid thread on sole body surface is favorable to increasing the frictional force of sole and sole for the effect of exerting oneself of sole is better.

title_en: Cardiovascular internal medicine stethoscope
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of stethoscopes, in particular to a stethoscope for cardiovascular medicine, which aims at solving the problems that when the existing stethoscope is used, a doctor mostly holds a stethoscope head to stick to the outside of the body of a patient for auscultation, and when a male doctor auscultates a female patient, the problem of inconvenience and embarrassment is inevitably caused, the stethoscope head comprises a stethoscope head, one side of the stethoscope head is fixedly provided with a connecting block, one side of the connecting block is provided with a cylindrical groove, one end of an L-shaped connecting rod is arranged in the cylindrical groove, the other end of the L-shaped connecting rod is slidably provided with a movable rod, one end of the movable rod extends to the outer side of the L-shaped connecting rod and is fixedly provided with a handle, the utility model increases the distance between the hand of the doctor and the female patient by arranging the handle, avoids inconvenience in examination, and simultaneously, the use position and the angle, simple structure and convenient use.

title_en: Medical care is with rapid cooling ice compress device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a medical care is with rapid cooling ice compress device, including the ice compress bag, the ice compress bag comprises the bag body and connection piece, the connection piece is located bag body upper end position, the connection piece bottom is through the sticky subsides of bonding in bag body upper end, the internal portion of bag is provided with the column packing, the column packing passes through the sticky subsides of bonding in the internal portion of bag upper end, the inside packing of column packing has the ammonium nitrate. The utility model discloses the icing bag need not to freeze, and the inside packing of packed column has the ammonium nitrate, when needs icing, buckles the icing bag for the packed column is damaged, and the ammonium nitrate of inside packing will contact with water, has the ionic bond between nitrate and the ammonium root in the ammonium nitrate, and when dissolving, the bond energy that needs the energy to break this ionic bond, so absorb the ambient heat when dissolving and lead to the temperature to descend, thereby can reach the effect that the icing.

title_en: Slidable and self-locking atlantoaxial intervertebral fusion cage
abstract_en: The utility model provides a slidable and self-locking atlantoaxial intervertebral fusion cage, which comprises an upper sliding sheet component, a lower sliding sheet component and a wedge-shaped supporting block supporting the upper sliding sheet component and the lower sliding sheet component; the upper sliding sheet part and the lower sliding sheet part are connected in a sliding mode; the wedge-shaped supporting block is arranged between the upper slider part and the lower slider part. The fusion cage overcomes the defects of the traditional atlantoaxial intervertebral fusion cage, fully considers the operation access and clinical operation, and is composed of two prosthesis parts which can slide relatively, and is provided with a wedge-shaped supporting block, so that the fusion cage is convenient to support the atlantoaxial and can be locked at the same time, and the stability of the atlantoaxial is ensured.

title_en: Neurosurgery scale drainage device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a neurosurgery scale drainage device relates to the medical instrument field, and this drainage device can fix the drainage bag, and can height-adjusting, effectively solves the problem that proposes in the background art. Including first fixed plate, first fixed plate pass through mounting and wall body fixed connection, the first fixed plate outside be equipped with the decoration, first fixed plate top lean out and be equipped with connecting portion, connecting portion and vertical branch bottom fixed connection, branch on be equipped with vertical scale and digit, the branch is gone up the cover and is put and to fix spacing drainage bag fixing device and infusion bottle fixing device. The utility model has simple structure and convenient use, and is suitable for various places.

title_en: Wound washing unit of department of general surgery
abstract_en: A wound irrigation device for general surgery comprises a base plate, wherein two stirring barrels which are arranged left and right are fixedly connected to the surface of the upper end of the base plate, two stirring blades which are arranged up and down and can rotate and move up and down are respectively installed inside the stirring barrels, a mounting plate is fixedly connected to the front ends of the outer surfaces of the two stirring barrels, two first buttons which can move back and forth alternately are installed on the right side of the middle part of the surface of the front end of the mounting plate, a reset button which can move back and forth is installed at the left end of each first button, and a structure for resetting the two first buttons which can move back and forth alternately can be formed when the reset button moves; a pressure reducing nozzle is arranged on the upper side of the front end of the mounting plate; the cleaning solution and the disinfecting solution can be switched back and forth by the two first buttons which move alternately.

title_en: Ice bag for orthopedic nursing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an ice bag for orthopedic nursing, which comprises an ice bag sleeve; the ice bag cover is internally provided with an ice bag body, the ice bag cover is provided with a first opening, the first opening is provided with a first sealing strip, two sides of the top of the ice bag cover are connected with two sides of an air bag through a lock catch, the air bag is connected with an air inflation and deflation device, two sides of the ice bag cover are respectively provided with two fixing strips, one ends, far away from the ice bag cover, of the two fixing strips are connected through a connecting piece, the bottom of the ice bag cover is provided with a medicine bag, the medicine bag is provided with a second opening, and the second. When need not stanch the wound, can place treatment medicine in the medicine bag, can dismantle the gasbag from the ice bag from going up simultaneously, carry out the ice compress treatment to the wound, when needs stanch the wound, can place hemostasis medicine in the medicine bag, pass through the hasp with the gasbag simultaneously and fix on the ice bag cover, then aerify the gasbag through filling air bleeder, make the department of bleeding form great pressure, hemostatic effect is obvious.

title_en: Medicine machine is fried to drum-type with powder recovery unit
abstract_en: The utility model provides a medicine machine is fried to drum-type with powder recovery unit, the barrel is cylindrical tubular structure, the both sides position of barrel has seted up the spacing groove, the left side of barrel lower extreme is connected with the bearing rotation of rotation connection on the left socle, the right side of barrel lower extreme is connected with the bearing rotation of rotation connection on the right branch frame, fixedly connected with hot plate between left socle and the right branch frame, through fixing the hot plate at the downside of barrel, turn into the electric energy through the hot plate and heat energy and distribute, and then realize the heating to the inside medicine of barrel, and the barrel overturns under the effect of driving motor, and then realizes the upset to the inside medicine of barrel, finally realizes the purpose of stir-fry medicine; realize the collection to the dust under the separation of dust removal board, solved traditional equipment and had the difficult problem that can't collect the barrel dust.

title_en: Fixed magic subsides of ECG monitor wire bedside
abstract_en: A magic tape for fixing a lead beside a bed of an ECG monitor relates to the field of fixing parts. This other fixed magic subsides of ECG monitor wire bed includes two at least fixed bands, and the both sides of every fixed band have respectively round hair face and be used for the thorn hair face of being connected with round hair face, and the round hair face of at least one fixed band is equipped with at least one pin thread, and the round hair face of at least one fixed band is equipped with at least one box, but pin thread and box are configured into coaxial coupling and rotatory along the axis. The application provides an ECG monitor wire bedside fixes the ECG monitor wire with fixed position in adaptable different wire quantity of magic subsides to can the angle of the fixed wire of rotation angle adjustment in order to adapt to patient's demand, and can two liang of arbitrary collocation, have the advantage that uses simply in a flexible way.

title_en: Pedal for operation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pedal for operation, including device bottom plate and operation platform, be equipped with first folding rod and second folding rod between device bottom plate and the operation platform, the catch bar is installed through the bearing to the intermediate position of first folding rod and second folding rod, the side intermediate position swing joint of catch bar has the hydraulic stem, the one end swing joint that the catch bar was kept away from to the hydraulic stem has the fixing base, the fixing base welding is at the top surface of device bottom plate, one side bolted connection that the hydraulic stem was kept away from to the fixing base has the pneumatic cylinder, the one end that the fixing base was kept away from to the pneumatic cylinder is connected with the pedal board, be connected with oil pipe between hydraulic stem and the pneumatic cylinder, operation platform includes roof, medical rubber and degassing unit. The utility model discloses a degassing unit makes the disinfection of medical rubber convenient simple, makes the height of operation platform freely adjust, has improved the suitability.

title_en: Traditional chinese medical science gastroenterology nursing massage device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a traditional chinese medical science gastroenterology nursing massage device, including first mounting panel, servo motor and first curb plate are installed respectively to the upper surface both sides of first mounting panel, servo motor's output shaft is connected with the pivot through first shaft coupling, the other end of pivot passes first bearing on the first curb plate and is connected with the second bearing on the second curb plate, the upper surface one side at the second mounting panel is installed to the second curb plate, hydraulic telescoping rod is all installed to the lower surface of first mounting panel and second mounting panel, hydraulic telescoping rod's bottom is installed at the top of pneumatic cylinder, the pneumatic cylinder is installed on the base, the sleeve is installed to the outer wall of pivot, telescopic outer wall bottom is connected with the top of box through the connecting rod, gear motor is installed to the inside bottom of box. The utility model discloses can effectually massage patient's belly, promote the wriggling of stomach, convenient to use, the practicality is strong.

title_en: Auxiliary device of forehead temperature gun
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a volume temperature rifle technical field just discloses an auxiliary device of volume temperature rifle, including the rifle body, the top fixedly connected with storage box of the rifle body, the inside swing joint of storage box has the piston, the right side fixedly connected with dead lever of piston, the right-hand member of dead lever runs through to the outside of storage box, the left bottom intercommunication of storage box has flexible pipe, the equal fixedly connected with connecting rod in the left top of the rifle body and bottom, the surperficial cover of connecting rod is equipped with the bracing piece, the left side fixedly connected with spring of bracing piece inner chamber. abstract_en: The utility model discloses a five-surface puncture blood taking needle, which comprises a puncture part, a connecting pipe and a blood taking part, wherein one end of the connecting pipe is connected with the puncture part, the other end of the connecting pipe is connected with the blood taking part, and the surface of the connecting pipe is provided with a buckle in open type buckling connection; the puncture part comprises a hollow puncture needle tube and a plastic fixed tube, one end of the plastic fixed tube is inserted in the connecting tube, and the other end of the plastic fixed tube is packaged with the puncture needle tube through a puncture needle handle; the end of the puncture needle tube is provided with a blood sampling needle tip with an upward opening, the blood sampling needle tip consists of five inclined planes, the blood sampling needle tip comprises a pair of tip inclined planes, a back inclined plane and a pair of back tip inclined planes, the tip inclined planes are symmetrically arranged on two sides of the tip end of the blood sampling needle tip, the back inclined planes are arranged on opposite sides of the tip end of the blood sampling needle tip, and the two sides of the back inclined planes are provided with back tip inclined planes. abstract_en: The present application relates to an ultrasound probe and an ultrasound system. An ultrasound probe for use in an ultrasound imaging system is disclosed. title_en: Nose guide device

abstract_en: The utility model discloses a flexible shaft transmission hand exoskeleton, which comprises a motor driving mechanism and a hand actuating mechanism which are detachably connected with each other, wherein the motor driving mechanism comprises a motor, an upper dismantling joint, a solid flexible shaft, a hollow flexible shaft and the like; the hand actuating mechanism comprises a finger assembly, a push rod, a lead screw, a connecting rod, a nut, a limiting sensor, a lower dismounting joint and the like, the finger assembly comprises a finger root, a finger joint and a spring assembly, the lead screw of the nut is connected with a solid flexible shaft in a rotating mode, the finger root, the push rod, the connecting rod and the nut are connected in sequence, the limiting sensor is arranged on one side of the connecting rod, and the lower dismounting joint is connected with the hollow flexible shaft. The probe provided by the utility model can not bring discomfort to a patient when the probe is pressed against the body surface of the patient, and because the clamping mechanism slides in a reciprocating manner along a straight line relative to the connecting seat, when the probe slides integrally along with the clamping mechanism relative to the connecting seat, the contact position and the contact angle of the probe and the body surface of the patient can not be changed, the problem that the probe is not in contact with the body surface of the patient to cause excessive oppression and discomfort is avoided, the stability of the contact angle of the probe and the body surface of the patient can be ensured, the problem that the probe is not easy to deflect and the like is solved, and the definition of a scanned image and the accuracy of a detection result are effectively ensured.

title_en: Disposable infusion tube falling-off prevention device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a disposable infusion tube falling prevention device, which belongs to the technical field of infusion tube falling prevention and comprises a first semicircular frame, wherein a clamping mechanism is arranged on the front side of the first semicircular frame; the clamping mechanism comprises a connecting block, a clamping groove is formed in one side of the connecting block, an inserting rod is arranged in the clamping groove, an inserting groove is formed in the top end of the inserting rod, an oblique clamping block is arranged in the inserting groove, a movable rod is arranged at the top end of the oblique clamping block, and the movable rod is fixedly connected with the oblique clamping block. abstract_en: The utility model provides a dot matrix laser pit therapeutic apparatus, and relates to the technical field of laser therapeutic apparatuses.
