The utility model adjusts the attaching condition of the patch and the eyes according to the specific condition of the face of a user, the nose support is attached to the nose bridge, the screw cap is rotated, the screw cap pushes the clamping frame to slide on the surface of the sliding rod, and at the moment, the clamping frame can be pushed to slide on the surface of the sliding rod by the elastic effect of the first spring, so that the distance between the patch and the nose support can be adjusted.

title_en: Self-adaptive intelligent digital vision prevention and control examination device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of vision prevention and control examination, in particular to a self-adaptive intelligent digital vision prevention and control examination device, which comprises a fixed frame, wherein an infrared sensor is arranged in the middle of the fixed frame, a vision table is movably connected in the fixed frame through two second rotating shafts, a fixed frame is fixedly connected to the lower surface of the fixed frame, an electric telescopic rod is movably connected below the fixed frame, the bottom end of the electric telescopic rod is fixedly connected to a bottom plate, universal wheels are respectively and movably connected to two ends of the bottom plate, a limit groove corresponding to a limit block is formed in the bottom plate, the occupied area of the whole device can be reduced, the used space is saved by arranging a rolling vision table and a foldable electric telescopic rod, a target is captured by arranging the infrared sensor, then a signal is transmitted to a controller, and the stop position of the electric telescopic rod is controlled by the controller, therefore, the center position realized by the tested person is approximately level to the center position of the visual chart, and the measurement error is reduced.

title_en: Orthopedics pivot hammer
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an orthopedic pivot hammer, which comprises a hammer head and a hammer handle, wherein the hammer head is in a circular truncated cone shape, and the hammer handle is fixedly connected with the hammer head from the middle part of the side surface of the hammer head. The pivot hammer for orthopedics department of the utility model sets the hammer head into the round table shape, when in use, the big knocking surface or the small knocking surface of the hammer head can be selected to knock according to the treatment requirement, thereby helping the doctor to control the knocking force and improving the treatment effect.

title_en: Flushing device for treating venomous snake bite
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of medical instruments and discloses a flushing device for treating venomous snake bite, which comprises a needle body with a hollow inner part, wherein the outer part of the needle body is wrapped by a soft silica gel material layer, the lower end of the needle body is provided with a first through hole and a second through hole, and the upper end of the needle body is connected with a transfusion tube; a liquid inlet pipeline and a liquid outlet pipeline are formed inside the needle body, the lower end of the liquid inlet pipeline and the lower end of the liquid outlet pipeline are respectively communicated with a first through hole and a second through hole, the upper end of the liquid inlet pipeline is connected with a liquid conveying pipe and a pressure-adjustable pressurizing device, and the upper end of the liquid outlet pipeline is connected with a negative pressure-adjustable device; when in use, the needle body is inserted into the deepest part of the bite part of the poisonous snake along the sinus of the wound marked by the teeth of the poisonous snake, the liquid for assisting the washing is input through the infusion tube, and the pressure of the pressurizing device is interrupted instantaneously or changed in frequency, so that the washing liquid generates vibration in the relatively closed space inside the wound, and the separation of normal tissues and snake venom is facilitated; the negative pressure pipeline generates negative pressure to pump the input liquid together with snake venom.

title_en: Sleep awakening device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a sleep awakening device, belongs to the technical field of medical appliances, and solves the problems that the existing warning devices cannot awaken patients in time and harm the life health of the patients. This sleep awakening device, including ear muff and casing, one side of casing is fixed with the box body, and the both sides of the inside below of ear muff all are provided with the response subsides, and the fixed surface of casing opposite side has the display screen, and the inside of casing is provided with respectively handles chip, drive module, play module and battery, and the inside of box body is fixed with small-size motor. The utility model can wake up the patient in time when the oxyhemoglobin saturation of the patient is reduced, so that the patient breathes by himself, the oxyhemoglobin saturation of the patient is gradually recovered to be normal, the life safety of the patient is powerfully guaranteed, meanwhile, the device does not need medical staff to be kept beside the patient at any time in the operation process, the work burden of the medical staff is reduced, and the operation efficiency of the hospital is improved.

title_en: Infant's elbow vein blood sampling fixing base
abstract_en: The utility model provides a fixing seat for taking blood from elbow veins of infants, belonging to the technical field of auxiliary blood taking instruments. It has solved the more difficult problem of blood sampling to infant's elbow vein among the prior art. This infant's elbow vein blood sampling fixing base, including the pedestal, the top of pedestal has the arc wall that is used for placing the arm, a pair of breach of pressing has been seted up respectively at the both ends of pedestal, and the same a pair of two are pressed the relative both sides that set up at the arc wall of breach, be provided with the cushion in the arc wall, the bottom of pedestal is provided with a plurality of fixed suction cup. The utility model has the advantage of ensuring that the infant's elbow venous blood sampling is safer and more efficient.

title_en: Flat plate rotating device for detector and human body detection equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a dull and stereotyped rotating device, human check out test set for detector relates to medical instrument technical field. The flat plate rotating apparatus for a probe includes: revolving stage, driving piece, locating part and mount. The turntable comprises a fixed part and a rotating part; the driving part is fixed on the fixed part, and a power output shaft of the driving part is in transmission connection with the rotating part and is used for driving the rotating part to rotate relative to the fixed part; the limiting piece is fixed on the fixed component, the rotating component is provided with an abutting part, and the limiting piece abuts against the abutting part to limit the rotating component to rotate; the fixed frame is used for installing the detector and is connected with the rotating part. Which can improve the problem that the cables of the probe are easily twisted together.

title_en: X-ray diagnostic bed with inclined projection device
abstract_en: The application provides an X-ray diagnostic bed with oblique projection device belongs to medical equipment technical field. The X-ray diagnostic bed comprises an X-ray projection device, a stand column and a swing device, wherein the X-ray projection device is arranged at one end of the stand column, and the swing device is arranged at the other end of the stand column. The swing device comprises a base, a worm wheel and a bearing. The worm is meshed with the worm wheel, the bearing comprises a first shaft ring and a second shaft ring which can rotate around the axial direction of the bearing independently, the worm wheel, the first shaft ring and the stand column are fixedly connected, the worm wheel can drive the stand column to swing through the first shaft ring, and the second shaft ring is fixed on the base. The worm wheel is fixed through first race with the stand, and the fixed position of second race and base provides the fulcrum for the swing of stand, and the worm wheel drives the stand swing through first race, sets up the bearing between worm wheel and stand and carries out indirect transmission, relies on the bearing to bear the huge moment of torsion when the stand swings, avoids the worm wheel to damage to a certain extent, increases pendulous device's structural reliability.

title_en: Electric toothbrush capable of being automatically adjusted
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatically adjustable electric toothbrush, which comprises a handle and a brush head, wherein a vibration motor is arranged in the handle, brush bristles are arranged on the brush head, an output shaft of the vibration motor extends out of the handle and then is connected with the brush head through a time delay structure, through the time delay structure, after the vibration motor is started, before pressure is applied to the brush bristles, the brush head is kept static or the swing amplitude of the brush head is smaller than the swing amplitude of the output shaft, after the pressure is applied to the brush bristles, the swing amplitude of the brush head is larger than the swing amplitude before the pressure is applied, by adopting the utility model, before the pressure is not applied, namely the brush bristles are pressed on teeth, the brush head is static or has smaller swing amplitude, the problem of toothpaste splashing with overlarge swing amplitude can be prevented, after the foam is generated during tooth brushing, the problem of the foam splashing after the brush head of the electric toothbrush extends out of an oral cavity can be greatly reduced, and meanwhile, before the pressure is not applied, the inertia required to be overcome by the reciprocating swing of the vibration motor is smaller, the reaction force on the handle is relatively smaller, the vibration of the handle is smaller, and the experience is better.

title_en: Infusion alarm
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an infusion alarm which comprises a clamping piece, a dripping speed monitoring assembly, an alarm assembly, a switch button, an adjusting knob, a protective cover and a binding belt, wherein the dripping speed monitoring assembly is electrically connected with the alarm assembly, and the switch button is used for starting or closing the dripping speed monitoring assembly. Wherein, adjust knob is used for adjusting the infusion and drips fast, and adjust knob and switch button locate the holder with one on one side, and the protective cover articulates on the holder, and the protective cover rotationally covers the top at adjust knob and switch button, and the bandage is including two, fixed connection respectively on holder and protective cover. Can effectively prevent the patient from adjusting the dripping speed by oneself and ensure the transfusion safety of the patient.

title_en: Novel oxygen tube
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel oxygen inhalation tube, which relates to the field of medical auxiliary instruments, wherein a main body of the novel oxygen inhalation tube is arranged into a tube body, a telescopic tube body section is arranged on the tube body, the length of the telescopic tube body section can be adjusted through the telescopic tube body section, so that the length of the whole tube body can be adjusted, a nasal catheter is arranged on the tube body, the nasal catheter is in contact with the nasal cavity of a patient, a dust cover is arranged outside the nasal catheter and is detachably connected to the nasal catheter, the dust cover is covered outside the nasal catheter in the unused state of the nasal catheter, the pollution probability of the nasal catheter is reduced, and the dust cover is folded in a protective sleeve through a closable opening in the unused state, so that the dust cover is prevented from being in direct contact with a sickbed or the ground, and the use sanitation degree of the dust cover is improved.

title_en: Special table of diagnosing of intracardiac branch of academic or vocational study doctor
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of medical appliances, and particularly relates to a special diagnosis and treatment table for cardiologists, which comprises a table top, wherein one side of the table top is fixedly connected with a storage box, the bottom of an inner cavity of the storage box is provided with a motor, the output end of the motor is fixedly connected with a first bevel gear, the outer side of the first bevel gear is meshed and connected with a second bevel gear, the inner ring of the second bevel gear is fixedly connected with a rotating rod, the bottom of the rotating rod is rotatably connected with the bottom of the inner cavity of the storage box, the top of the rotating rod is fixedly connected with a threaded rod, the outer side of the threaded rod is in threaded connection with a threaded sleeve, and the top of the threaded sleeve is fixedly connected with a storage box; according to the medical table, the motor drives the first bevel gear and other components to drive the threaded rod to rotate, the threaded rod drives the threaded sleeve to move, the storage box is moved out of the storage box through the movement of the threaded sleeve, and a doctor can take medical instruments in the storage box for diagnosis and treatment, so that the problems that an existing medical table is single in function and troublesome to store and take are solved.

title_en: Intelligent cabinet ventilation device convenient to disassemble
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent cabinet ventilation device convenient to disassemble, which relates to the technical field of cabinets and comprises a cabinet main body, a ventilation mechanism, a dehumidification mechanism and a disassembly mechanism, wherein a placing groove is formed in the top of the cabinet main body, a ventilation cavity is formed in the cabinet main body, the ventilation mechanism comprises two servo motors, two transmission chains, two guide rods, two racks, two ventilation fans, four rotating shafts, four gears, four chain wheels and a plurality of exhaust holes, the exhaust holes are symmetrically formed in two sides in the placing groove, and the four rotating shafts are symmetrically and rotatably connected in the two ventilation cavities. According to the utility model, through the matching of the ventilation mechanism and the dehumidification mechanism, the problem that bacteria and bacteria in the cabinet main body are rapidly propagated because most of the existing cabinets are not provided with the ventilation device and the dehumidification device is solved, and the effects of ventilating the cabinet main body and dehumidifying and sterilizing the cabinet main body are realized.

title_en: Electromagnetic valve and sphygmomanometer comprising same
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of fluid conveying control, in particular to an electromagnetic valve and a sphygmomanometer comprising the same, wherein the electromagnetic valve comprises a shell and a framework, and the framework is arranged in the shell; run through on the skeleton and be provided with the hole of sliding, it crosses gas spare and opens and close the inner core to be provided with in the hole of sliding, open and close the cooperation of sliding of inner core and hole of sliding, it helps the piece to be provided with elasticity between the pore wall of opening and close inner core and hole of sliding, elasticity is right the piece and is had the portion that resets of ventilating steady portion and elasticity, the portion that resets of elasticity has the elastic force that will open and close the one side promotion that the inner core orientation was kept away from gas spare place, the skeleton that has the magnetic induction coil around has the drive and opens and close the magnetic force that the inner core orientation was close to the one side motion that gas spare was located, magnetic force is greater than the elastic force. The hole wall that the steady portion of ventilating and open and close inner core and slip hole all butts to make the inner wall of opening and close inner core and slip hole can not lead to collision each other because the air current velocity of flow is too fast, thereby improved the noise problem after the solenoid valve is opened.

title_en: Animal doctor's inspection is with oral cavity ware that struts
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of veterinary examination, and discloses an oral cavity distracter for veterinary examination, which comprises two binding clip heads and a plastic rod, wherein the right sides of the two binding clip heads are connected through a rotating shaft, the outer rings at the two ends of the plastic rod are respectively provided with an annular groove in a surrounding manner, the number of the annular grooves is two, the front end and the rear end of the left side of the binding clip head are respectively fixed with four clamping plates through connecting rods, the clamping plates at the front ends are parallel to the clamping plate at the rear end, the bottom surface of the upper clamping plate and the upper surface of the lower clamping plate are respectively provided with a socket, and the sockets penetrate through the two sides of the clamping plates. According to the utility model, the clamping plates are fixed on the two sides of the tail end of the binding clip, so that the bottom of each clamping plate is communicated with the socket, the plastic rod can be inserted into the socket of the clamping plate under the limit of the annular groove, the plastic rod can not damage animals when opening the cavity, and the detachable structure can be replaced when the plastic rod is seriously abraded, so that the illuminating effect can be provided through the illuminating lamp in the inspection process, and the inspection is convenient.

title_en: Negative pressure aspirator for taking embolus
abstract_en: A negative pressure suction apparatus for taking embolus relates to the technical field of medical auxiliary appliances, which comprises an injector body, a negative pressure suction apparatus and a negative pressure suction apparatus, wherein the injector body comprises a spring, a tee joint and a liquid collecting barrel; a spring for enabling the piston to perform suction movement is arranged between the bottom in the barrel body of the injector body and the piston, the injection end of the injector body is communicated with a first port of a tee joint, a second port of the tee joint is communicated with one end of a one-way valve I, the other end of the one-way valve I is correspondingly communicated with one side of the top of the liquid collecting barrel, and an exhaust port is arranged on the other side of the top of the liquid collecting barrel; a third port of the tee joint is communicated with one end of a one-way valve II, and the other end of the one-way valve II is communicated with one end of a connector; the utility model has lower use cost, the injector body generates negative pressure attraction under the action of the spring when the plug is taken, the operator does not need to continuously pull the push rod of the injector body for suction operation, the structure is simple, and the use is convenient.

title_en: Medical oncology chemotherapy nursing device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of chemotherapy nursing, in particular to a chemotherapy nursing device for medical oncology, which comprises a box body, wherein one side of the box body is provided with a fixing mechanism, a containing shell is arranged in the box body, an opening is formed above the containing shell, a vomiting groove is formed above the box body, the bottom of the vomiting groove is fixedly connected with a pipeline, one end of the pipeline extends into the box body, one end of the pipeline is positioned above the opening of the containing shell, a cover plate is hinged above the box body and positioned above the vomiting groove, a sealing gasket is fixedly connected to one side of the cover plate facing the vomiting groove, a buffer mechanism is arranged between the cover plate and the box body, a placing groove is formed above the box body, one side of the inner wall of the placing groove is provided with an elongated slot, one end of the cover plate close to the placing groove is fixedly connected with a long block, one side of the long block facing the elongated slot is provided with a limiting groove, the device is reasonable in design, and the cover plate with the sealing gasket is controlled by an operating mechanism, the vomit groove is conveniently covered, and the emission of peculiar smell is avoided.

title_en: Disinfection cabinet slide rail with adjustable layer height
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a disinfection cabinet slide rail with adjustable floor height, which adopts the technical scheme that: the disinfection cabinet comprises a disinfection cabinet main body, wherein longitudinal slide rails are fixedly arranged at four corners in the disinfection cabinet main body, a lead screw is longitudinally and rotatably connected in the middle of the disinfection cabinet main body through a ball bearing, a limiting assembly is fixedly arranged at the top of the lead screw, a rotating shaft is fixedly arranged at the top of the limiting assembly, the top of the rotating shaft is rotatably connected in the middle of the top of the disinfection cabinet main body, slide blocks are respectively and slidably connected in the longitudinal slide rails, basket hangers are fixedly arranged between the inner sides of the slide blocks, threaded holes are formed in the middle of the basket hangers, and the basket hangers are in threaded connection with the outer surface of the lead screw through the threaded holes; the number of piles and the height can be freely adjusted to this slide rail, can also install different storage disinfection frame in a flexible way simultaneously, have improved the practicality and the suitable for shape of this slide rail effectively, have further improved the range of application, are worth promoting suitable for.

title_en: Excrement blocking piece for rectum
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a feces blocking piece for rectum, which comprises an air bag, an air exchange piece, a one-way air valve, an air plug and a skin blower, wherein an air exchange passage with three mutually communicated ports is arranged in the air exchange piece, the three ports of the air exchange passage are respectively provided with the air bag, the one-way air valve and the air plug, the skin blower is respectively provided with an air outlet and an air inlet, and the other end of the one-way air valve is connected with the air outlet of the skin blower. The air bag, the ventilation piece, the one-way air valve, the air plug and the skin blowing are mutually matched, so that external air can be sent into the air bag by the skin blowing and the one-way air valve, the air bag is blown to block the rectum, the phenomenon that the operation is influenced by the flowing-out of excrement in the rectum is prevented, the air in the air bag is discharged by the air plug after the operation, and the air bag is automatically retracted and conveniently drawn out.

title_en: Tourniquet for effectively preventing bleeding after arteriovenous puncture
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tourniquet for effectively preventing bleeding after venipuncture, which comprises a girdle, an auxiliary sheet, a pressurizing point, a hemostatic dressing sheet and an auxiliary sheet, wherein the auxiliary sheet is arranged in the girdle; a pressure point connected to a surface inside the cuff; a hemostatic dressing mounted above the pressure point. This a press arteries and veins tourniquet belt that effectively prevents hemorrhage after sound and veins puncture sets up to the annular, the clitellum adopts elastic weaving cloth, the pressurization point is installed at clitellum internal surface for oval granule, the upper end at the pressurization point is placed to the hemostasis piece, when oppressing the hemostasis to blood vessel and hemorrhage point, the hemostasis to the puncture point is assisted to the blood coagulation medicine in the piece is applied through the hemostasis, supplementary piece one end is fixed inside the clitellum, one end can be along with moving about when the clitellum tightens up, can prevent that the unexpected patient of pressing from both sides, the movable slot of stopper upper end is the symmetric distribution, it passes the clitellum inside, the outside symmetry of stopper is provided with two and holds the point.

title_en: Fixing device for false tooth processing
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of artificial tooth processing, and relates to a fixing device for artificial tooth processing, which comprises a fixing table, wherein the upper surface of the fixing table is fixedly connected with a supporting column, the top end of the supporting column is fixedly connected with an installation plate, the upper surface of the installation plate is fixedly connected with a fixing frame, the upper surface of the fixing frame is fixedly connected with an electric push rod, the top end of the electric push rod is fixedly connected with a connecting plate, and the lower surface of the connecting plate is fixedly connected with a movable rod. The fixing device for false tooth processing has the beneficial effects that by arranging the electric push rod, when a worker processes false tooth raw materials right by the fixing device, the worker only needs to control the electric push rod to shorten through the control switch, and under the matching of the first sliding groove and the sliding block, the movable rod can stably drive the clamping plate on the lower surface of the movable plate to move downwards, so that the effect of clamping the false tooth raw materials is achieved.

title_en: Keep somewhere fixed subsides of needle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of medical instruments, in particular to a retaining needle fixing tape, which comprises a base, wherein an adhesive tape for fixing is detachably arranged on the lower end surface of the base, a protective tape is bonded on the lower part of the adhesive tape, one end of a fixing tape is arranged on the left side of the upper end surface of the base and used for fixing a retaining needle, a male magic tape is arranged on the lower end surface of the other end of the fixing tape, and a female magic tape matched with the male magic tape is arranged on the right side of the upper end surface of the base and used for fixing the fixing tape; the top seat is arranged in the middle of the top end of the base, and a groove is formed in the upper end face of the top seat and used for placing a remaining needle. The device can effectual reduction patient skin and keep somewhere frictional force of needle with pressure, improves patient's comfort level, and the convenience is fixed the connector, and fixed effect is more ideal, has increased convenience and the practicality of keeping somewhere the needle use, more accords with actual user demand.

title_en: Injection needle and injection hand tool
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an injection needle, comprising: the upper cover is provided with an annular block, a plurality of accommodating groove groups are annularly distributed on the bottom surface of the annular block, each accommodating groove group comprises a plurality of accommodating grooves with sequentially increasing depths, and a sub-groove part with a first inclined surface is arranged between every two adjacent accommodating grooves; the lower cover is connected with the upper cover, a partition plate is arranged in the lower cover, and the partition plate is provided with a pin outlet hole; the needle outlet module comprises a pressing part, a main body part and a needle outlet part which are connected from top to bottom, the main body part is elastically connected between the partition plate and the annular block from top to bottom, and the needle outlet part is provided with a needle head corresponding to the needle outlet hole; the limiting ring is rotatably connected between the main body part and the annular block, a plurality of clamping blocks with second inclined planes are annularly arranged on the outer side of the limiting ring, and the second inclined planes are matched with the first inclined planes. The utility model can control the needle outlet length of the needle head in a segmented manner, thereby establishing a uniform needle inserting depth standard. Meanwhile, the utility model also provides an injection hand tool applying the injection needle.

title_en: Quantitative aerosol inhalation device for aerosol inhalant
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of medical equipment and discloses a quantitative atomization inhalation device of an atomization inhalant, which comprises a base, a liquid storage tank, an atomization box, a connecting pipe body, an atomization mechanism, a control screen and an inhalation mask, wherein the front part and the rear part on the right side of the top of the base are both bolted with a support frame, one side opposite to the support frame is rotatably connected with a wind-up roll, and the rear end of the wind-up roll is fixedly provided with a turntable; the device can calculate the amount of the liquid medicine, is convenient for a doctor to quantitatively control the amount of the liquid medicine, and can wind the connecting pipe, so that the practicability and the convenience of the device are improved, the problems that the existing atomization suction devices cannot calculate the amount of the liquid medicine to be put in, the doctor cannot conveniently quantitatively control the amount of the liquid medicine, and the patient easily inhales too much or too little liquid medicine are solved, and meanwhile, the situations that the connecting pipe of the atomization suction device is long and inconvenient to store are avoided.

title_en: Auxiliary fixing device for nuclear magnetic resonance examination
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a nuclear magnetic resonance examination auxiliary fixing device, which comprises a bed surface and supporting legs, wherein a comfortable pillow is arranged on the bed surface, a fixing device is arranged on the bed surface, an elastic belt is arranged on one side of the bed surface, a magic tape is arranged on the elastic belt, a lengthened elastic belt is arranged on the other side of the bed surface, a lengthened magic tape is arranged on the lengthened elastic belt, the fixing device comprises a base, a sliding chute, a sliding block, a screw rod, a gear, a handle, a limiting block, a fastening ring and a sponge pad, the base is provided with the sliding chute, the sliding block is arranged in the sliding chute, the gear is arranged on the left side of the screw rod, the gear is provided with the handle, the limiting block is arranged on the right side of the screw rod, the device is more convenient when examining the physical condition of a patient through the arrangement of the elastic belt, the magic tape and the like, the fixation of the limbs of the patient can be realized only by slightly rotating the handle, the detection efficiency is accelerated.

title_en: Disposable superfine diameter 3D electronic endoscope
abstract_en: A disposable superfine diameter 3D electronic endoscope comprises three parts: a front end insertion assembly (1), a handle assembly (2) and a cable (3); the front end insertion assembly (1) comprises a front end support (11), an insertion tube (12), a camera module (13) and a lamp (14) for illumination. The disposable superfine-diameter 3D electronic endoscope adopts two camera modules to form 3D stereoscopic imaging, the visual effect is close to that of human eyes, the image is more vivid, and the imaging effect is good; the endoscope is suitable for new fields, can replace hard tube endoscopes used in many fields, and has wide universality; the structure is simple, the manufacturing cost is low, the disposable operation is realized, the sterilization is not needed after the operation, and the cross infection of patients caused by incomplete sterilization is avoided.

title_en: Effectual band-aid of laminating
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of wound dressings and discloses a wound dressing with a good fitting effect, which comprises a base layer, wherein the top of the base layer is provided with a through groove, a transparent film is bonded inside the through groove, the bottom of the transparent film is bonded with a water absorption pad, and a first extending part and a second extending part are integrally formed at two ends of the base layer; according to the utility model, the base layer is firstly adhered to the skin, then the two first extending parts are adhered to the skin above the joint, and the two second extending parts are adhered to the skin below the joint, so that the laminating effect is good, the influence on the wound plaster when the joint is bent is ensured, the flexibility is good, meanwhile, a user can see whether the water absorption pad accurately covers the wound site through the transparent film during adhering, and can know whether the wound site is deteriorated through the transparent film during use, so that the wound site can be conveniently observed, and the practicability is high.

title_en: Inflatable movable blanket
abstract_en: The application discloses aerify and remove blanket, should aerify and remove blanket includes: the inflatable blanket comprises an inflatable device, an inflatable blanket body and an inflatable pipeline; wherein the inflating equipment is connected with the inflatable blanket body through the inflating pipeline; the utility model discloses a blanket body, including inflatable blanket body, the exhaust velocity of ventilative punch combination is less than the inflation velocity of inflatable blanket body has reached and has aerifyd the blanket body when carrying the patient, carries out the purpose that supports to the patient to the relatively soft blanket body that aerifys after the inflation to realized protecting the patient at the in-process of carrying the patient, alleviateed misery, avoided producing the technological effect of secondary injury, and then solved the mode of carrying the patient among the correlation technique and carried for artifical stretcher, this mode has the problem of aggravating the painful or secondary injury's of patient risk.

title_en: Shared bicycle self-disinfection device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a shared bicycle self-disinfection device which comprises a bicycle main body and a liquid outlet, wherein a fixed frame is arranged in the middle of the bicycle main body, a disinfectant container is movably connected inside the fixed frame, a liquid outlet valve is fixedly connected to the upper end of the disinfectant container, a flow guide pipe is fixedly connected to the upper end of the liquid outlet valve, a liquid inlet is fixedly connected to the left end of the flow guide pipe, a disinfection control box is fixedly connected to the left end of the liquid inlet, a fixed sleeve is arranged below the right side of the liquid outlet, a telescopic rod penetrates through the inside of the fixed sleeve, and an infrared detection module is arranged at the lower end of the telescopic rod. The shared bicycle self-disinfection device effectively solves the problem that the manual operation process cannot be stripped in the traditional disinfection mode, greatly improves the disinfection efficiency, is easy to install, has high adaptability, and has the advantages of being capable of being eliminated at any time and any place; the disinfection device is low in cost and high in efficiency, and can meet the requirements of riding users and sharing bicycle enterprises on the sanitation and safety of the bicycles.

title_en: Massage bead and shoes and cushions thereof
abstract_en: The utility model provides a massage bead, a shoe and a cushion thereof, wherein the massage bead comprises a bead sheet, a bead seat and a plurality of torsion springs; the sequin set up in on the pearl seat, torsion spring's spring main part fixed connection, torsion spring's extension torque arm with the pearl seat rotates to be connected, and when the pearl seat received pressure the extension torque arm was twisted reverse in order to drive the pearl seat rotates. The massage bead provided by the utility model realizes the bead sheet torsion of the massage bead by arranging the torsion spring, and under the action of pressure, the torsion amplitude generated by the torsion spring is larger, so that the rotation angle of the bead sheet is far larger than that of the existing massage structure. The sequins made of different materials (such as stone needles, jades or magnets) can provide better massage experience for users. Meanwhile, the massage beads do not need to be greatly rotated by means of manual assistance.

title_en: Atomizing and disinfecting device for cattle farm
abstract_en: The utility model provides an atomization disinfection device for a cattle farm, which relates to the technical field of disinfection, and comprises a medicine box, wherein a water pump is arranged in the medicine box, the output end of the water pump extends to the outside of the medicine box, the output end of the water pump is fixedly communicated with a hose, one end of the hose, which is far away from the water pump, is fixedly communicated with a hard pipe, firstly, the medicine liquid and the water are injected into the medicine box through a liquid inlet pipe, then, a swing driving device is started, the swing driving device can drive a spray nozzle to swing left and right, when the swing driving device is started, a stirring mechanism can be driven to work, then, the stirring mechanism can stir the medicine liquid, finally, the water pump is started, the water pump sprays the medicine liquid in the medicine box through the spray nozzle, a spray boom of a worker can be not needed to swing for disinfection, the labor intensity of the worker is effectively reduced, and the medicine can be effectively prevented from precipitating, prevent the liquid medicine from being mixed unevenly and influencing the disinfection effect.

title_en: Ear-nose-throat drug delivery device
abstract_en: The utility model provides an otolaryngological drug delivery device, comprising: the medical tube comprises a connector, a fastening interface, a tube body, scales, a cuff, a Murphy hole, a wire guide port, a deformation air bag, an air vent, an inflation hole, a shell, a tube head, a medicine inlet, a fastening ring, a protective shell, a fixed groove, a lower connecting tube, an inflation tube and an indication balloon, wherein the fastening interface is installed on the right end face of the connector, the tube body is installed on the right end face of the fastening interface, the medicine inlet is formed in the inner side of the tube head, the fastening ring is installed on the lower end face of the tube head, the air vent is formed in the inner side of the deformation air bag, the inflation hole is formed in the upper end face of the deformation air bag, and the shell is installed on the lower end face of the deformation air bag. By using the connector and the tube body, the resistance of the tube body during the anesthesia can be effectively reduced, the anesthetic gas can be effectively introduced through the cuff and the indicating saccule, and the stable anesthesia effect of the anesthesia device is improved.

title_en: Dry-wet separation barrel for medical wastes of livestock and veterinary medicine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a dry-wet separation barrel for medical wastes of livestock and veterinary medicine, which comprises a barrel body, wherein a partition plate is fixedly connected to the middle end of the top of an inner cavity of the barrel body, a baffle plate is fixedly connected between the bottom of the partition plate and the middle end of the inner cavity of the barrel body, a one-way valve is fixedly installed at the left end of the baffle plate through a pipeline, and a metal filter screen plate is fixedly installed between the lower end of the left side of the partition plate and the upper end of the left side of the inner cavity of the barrel body. According to the utility model, under the mutual matching action of the metal filter screen plate, the barrel body, the baffle plate, the one-way valve, the stepping motor, the threaded rod, the push plate, the conical rod, the partition plate, the electric heater, the blower, the treatment box, the activated carbon filter screen and the desiccant particles, the collection barrel has the function of performing dry-wet separation on medical wastes, has an excellent dry-wet separation effect, effectively avoids cross infection of the medical wastes due to humidity, and improves the effect of safely storing the medical wastes.

title_en: Vertical washing and dehydrating machine for processing and recovering waste medical waste
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a vertical washing and dehydrating machine for treating, recovering and processing waste medical waste, which comprises supporting legs and supporting columns, wherein a buffer gasket is arranged below the supporting legs, a washing and dehydrating machine box body is arranged above the supporting legs, a cover plate is arranged above the washing and dehydrating machine box body, an ultraviolet germicidal lamp is arranged on the inner wall of the cover plate, a drain pipe is arranged on the right side of the washing and dehydrating machine box body, an acoustic board is arranged inside the washing and dehydrating machine box body, a connecting shaft is arranged above a driving motor, an inner cylinder is arranged on one side, away from the driving motor, of the connecting shaft, and a rubbing board is arranged on the inner surface of the inner cylinder. title_en: Liver and gall general surgery equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a hepatobiliary general surgery device, which comprises a disinfection box and a sealing cover arranged on the disinfection box, wherein disinfectant is arranged in the disinfection box, a liquid outlet pipe is arranged at the bottom end of the disinfection box, a supporting member for supporting hepatobiliary laparoscopic surgical instruments is arranged in the disinfection box, an ejection mechanism is arranged in the disinfection box after a doctor uses the laparoscopic surgical instruments in a surgery, the hepatobiliary general surgery device has the advantages that the multiple supporting members are arranged in the disinfection box simultaneously, so that after the laparoscopic surgical instruments are used by the doctor, the surgical instruments can be correspondingly placed on the supporting members, the multiple supporting members enable the multiple surgical instruments to be separately placed, the phenomenon that more surgical instruments are stacked together to cause damage is prevented, the ejection mechanism is arranged in the disinfection box, and the disinfectant is arranged in the disinfection box, thereby being capable of sterilizing the used surgical instruments in time.

title_en: Non-contact type baby peeing behavior detection device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a non-contact type baby urination behavior detection device, which comprises a frame shell, a height adjusting component, a fixing clamping component, a clamping fine-adjustment component and a urination detection component, wherein the height adjusting component is arranged on the right side of the inner surface of the frame shell, the fixing clamping component is arranged on the left side of the inner surface of the frame shell, the clamping fine-adjustment component is arranged in the middle of the fixing clamping component, the urination detection component is detachably connected to the right side of the height adjusting component, a first folding pad is arranged on the right side of a screw rod, a nut is connected to one end of the first folding pad in a gluing mode, a second folding pad is arranged on the left side of a cylinder, a rubber clamping block is arranged above a fixing bolt, an indicator lamp is arranged above an image processing unit and is a red-blue flashing indicator lamp, the operation of the baby urination behavior is judged actively, the baby nurse is reminded automatically, the working strength of the baby nurse is relieved, and the baby is reminded to change diapers for the baby in time after the baby urinates, avoid other symptoms caused by the symptoms and improve the comfort of the baby.

title_en: Integral type peritoneal irrigation pipe
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an integrated abdominal cavity irrigation catheter, and relates to the technical field of medical instruments. The utility model provides an integral type abdominal cavity flushing catheter, including flushing pipe and drainage tube, the drainage tube includes first son pipe and the son pipe of second, first son union coupling has three-way drainage joint, be equipped with the control valve on the three-way drainage joint, three-way drainage joint and the son union coupling of second, the drainage pot head of the son pipe of second has the negative pressure outer tube, negative pressure outer tube tip is opened there is the drainage hole that communicates with each other with the son pipe of second, be equipped with in the negative pressure outer tube and wash interior sleeve pipe, wash interior union coupling has three-way flushing joint, three-way flushing joint is connected with the flushing pipe, three-way drainage joint and three-way flushing joint's link all is equipped with the joint stopper. The integrated abdominal cavity irrigation catheter adopting the scheme of the utility model solves the problems of easy blockage and inconvenient use of the existing irrigation catheter.

title_en: Fixing support for orthopedic wound medical treatment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses the technical field of medical equipment, in particular to a fixing support for orthopedic wound medical treatment, which comprises a fixing support main body, a first connecting block and a fixing block, wherein the middle part of the fixing support main body is fixedly connected with the first connecting block, the right end of the first connecting block is fixedly connected with the fixing block, the middle part of the fixing block is connected with a connecting rod in a penetrating way, two sides of the connecting rod are fixedly connected with fixing nuts, the left side of the first connecting block is embedded and connected with a limiting hole, the inner bottom end of the fixing support main body is fixedly connected with a waterproof layer, the waterproof layer enables a wound of a patient not to be stained with water, when a medical worker installs the fixing support main body, after determining the positions of an upper limb fixing part and a lower limb fixing part, the limiting hole of the upper limb fixing part and the limiting hole of the lower limb fixing part are placed in the fixing block to be aligned, then the connecting rod is placed in the aligned limiting hole in the fixing block, and the fixing nuts on the two sides of the connecting rod are rotated clockwise for fixing.

title_en: Oral cavity effusion drainage ware and system
abstract_en: The utility model provides an oral effusion drainage device and a system, comprising: the drainage cover, the liquid suction groove, the filter screen and the catheter; the liquid suction groove is arranged at the bottom of the drainage cover and on the outer surface of the drainage cover, the filter screen is arranged between the drainage cover and the liquid suction groove, the guide pipe is attached to the inner surface of the drainage cover, the first end of the guide pipe is arranged in the liquid suction groove, and the second end of the guide pipe is used for being connected with a containing tank; wherein the exterior of the drainage mask is adapted to contact the oral cavity. The function of timely discharging waste liquid in the process of tooth washing is realized, the problem that waste liquid and residues enter the body in the process of tooth washing is effectively avoided, and the experience of a user in the process of tooth washing is improved.

title_en: Portable quantitative atomizing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a portable quantitative atomization device, which comprises: the double-head air-conditioning device comprises a main body, a first cavity, a second cavity and a liquid medicine cavity, wherein one side of the outer surface of the main body is movably connected with a strap through a hanging ring, a storage battery arranged in the second cavity provides electric energy for a double-head motor, so that the storage battery drives an air compressor to generate compressed air, and is guided into an atomizing mechanism in the liquid medicine chamber through the air duct, so that the liquid medicine is atomized into fine particles, and the carrying is more convenient through a strap arranged on the surface of the main body, when going out and needing to take medicine on time, the first chamber can be filled with boiled water in advance, the tablets are placed in the storage groove for temporary storage, the trouble of carrying the water cup and the medicine box is saved, the trip is easier, when the granular medicine is taken, the medicine is put into the water in the first cavity, the power supply is switched on, the double-head motor drives the stirring paddle to rotate, the medicine is stirred, and the medicine is prevented from being bonded and is dissolved at an accelerated speed.

title_en: Nano-microcrystalline beauty instrument with skin detection function
abstract_en: The utility model provides a nano microcrystal beauty instrument with skin detection function, which comprises a holding rod, wherein two ends of the holding rod are respectively connected with a nano microcrystal sheet assembly and a skin detection assembly, a control plate and a transmission assembly which are electrically connected are also arranged in a containing cavity of the holding rod, the control plate is electrically connected with the skin detection assembly, and the output end of the transmission assembly is connected with the nano microcrystal sheet assembly so as to drive a nano microcrystal sheet of the nano microcrystal sheet assembly to do repeated telescopic motion; firstly, the skin condition is detected through the skin detection assembly, the current skin state is accurately analyzed, so that a user can fully know the skin characteristic at the moment, and the essence can be used pertinently; then driving the nanometer microchip assembly to repeatedly stretch and retract, and introducing essence which is previously applied to the skin into the skin; and the whole product has small appearance and is convenient to carry.

title_en: Orthopedic rehabilitation treatment bed
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of medical equipment and discloses an orthopedic rehabilitation bed which comprises a main body, wherein two supporting legs are fixedly arranged on the lower wall surface of the main body, a mounting hole is formed in the main body, a U-shaped protection block is fixedly arranged on the upper wall surface of the main body, two connecting blocks are symmetrically and fixedly arranged in the mounting hole, connecting holes are formed in the two connecting blocks, adjusting blocks capable of moving up and down are arranged in the two connecting holes, a massage block is arranged between the two adjusting blocks, and a driving motor is fixedly arranged on the right side wall surface of the right adjusting block. When the massage bed is used, the drive motor is used for driving the massage blocks to rotate, when the upper arc surfaces of the massage blocks face upwards, the massage blocks penetrate through the inside of the mounting holes and reach the upper part of the main body, and the pressing blocks on the upper arc surfaces of the massage blocks can press acupuncture points on the human body, so that the effect of greatly massaging and relieving meridians is achieved, and the problem of low practicability of the existing bed body is solved.

title_en: Positive pressure inhalation device for aerosol
abstract_en: The utility model provides an aerosol positive pressure inhalation device, and belongs to the field of medical instruments. The positive pressure aerosol inhalation device comprises a shell, a pressing component, a pushing component, an aerosol component, a push-pull component, a counter module and a piston; an airflow pipeline is arranged on one side of the shell, which is far away from the pressing assembly, and the airflow pipeline can be communicated with the second cavity; the side wall of the shell is provided with an air inlet pipe which is communicated with the second cavity; the push-pull assembly, the piston and the counter module are all arranged in the second cavity, the piston is communicated with the second cavity, and the air inlet pipe can be communicated with the airflow pipeline through the piston; be equipped with the touch piece that is used for starting or closing counter group module on the push-and-pull subassembly, ventilate in to the second cavity through the intake pipe, drive the piston and remove to the direction that is close to airflow channel, trigger aerosol subassembly blowout medicine and counter module count simultaneously, improve the treatment effeciency to the patient that has respiratory disorder to be convenient for in time change the medicine.

The control lamp tube mounting frame carries out the elevating system in removing the spout, controls ultraviolet tube to the distance between the medicine that is located drying mechanism inside, realizes the effect of disinfecting of shining to the medicine, and exhaust mechanism attracts the inside of the gas that has vapor after will heating to the reservoir, and the breakwater that presents the V style of calligraphy setting can carry out certain interception to the vapor that gets into, can reduce the moisture in the air in the workshop.

title_en: Safety retention needle for dialysis
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a safe indwelling needle for dialysis, which comprises a trocar, a needle core, a tampon, a needle cap, a soft extension tube and a single-hand clamp. The needle tube main part of trocar is soft main part, and the main part of nook closing member passes the tampon and nests in the needle tube main part of trocar, and nook closing member end and trocar end are equipped with the draw-in groove of holding each other along the puncture direction, are equipped with operating handle on the flank that is close to the nook closing member end, and extension pipe side direction is connected on the output channel of trocar, and extension pipe end is equipped with two connectors, and the centre gripping is pressed from both sides on the extension pipe to the one hand. The soft trocar can effectively protect the internal fistula blood vessel, alleviates the damage of steel needle to the vascular wall in the past, has prominent step operating handle, and it is convenient to grip, and the propelling movement is powerful, has improved the puncture success rate, and the structural design of two terminal connectors of extension pipe has greatly made things convenient for patient's rescue process, has improved the performance of safe type dialysis with the needle of remaining.

title_en: Adjustable traction support of clinical shank of using of orthopedics
abstract_en: The utility model provides an adjustable leg traction bracket for orthopedic clinical use, which comprises: the utility model discloses a leg traction device for orthopedics clinic, including support, the support has cup jointed first telescopic link, the second telescopic link has been cup jointed in the first telescopic link, the bottom of support is equipped with the recess, the bottom threaded connection of recess has the tight pole of support, the top of supporting the tight pole is connected with supports tight board, the bottom fixedly connected with rotation handle of tight pole, the inner chamber of support is located the top fixed mounting of recess has the backup pad, the fixed cylinder of having placed in the backup pad, the lateral wall of second telescopic link is fixed with the horizontal pole, the bottom fixed mounting of horizontal pole has the dead lever, the pulley is installed to the dead lever below, be connected with the chain on the pulley, the one end of chain is walked around pulley fixedly connected with mounting panel, and the device is one kind and can remove, is convenient for accomodate, does not account for the space, the adjustable support that pulls of clinical shank for orthopedics that can dual regulation.

title_en: Novel thoracic drainage device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of medical instruments, and provides a novel thoracic drainage device which comprises a drainage tube, a liquid outlet tube, a three-way joint and a thin tube, wherein the drainage tube, the liquid outlet tube and the thin tube are respectively connected with the three-way joint, a plurality of drainage side holes are formed in the head end of the drainage tube, the drainage tube is communicated with the liquid outlet tube through the three-way joint to realize drainage, the thin tube penetrates through the three-way joint and extends into the drainage tube, ejector rod mechanisms which correspond to the drainage side holes in a one-to-one mode are arranged on the thin tube, the ejector rod mechanisms can move in a telescopic mode perpendicular to the thin tube, and blocking objects blocking the drainage side holes are ejected. The drainage tube is communicated with the liquid outlet tube through the three-way joint so as to complete drainage, and meanwhile, the thin tube extends into the drainage tube, and the ejector rod mechanism on the drainage tube performs telescopic motion so as to eject out a blockage on the drainage side hole, so that the drainage tube is prevented from being blocked, and the normal operation of drainage is ensured.

title_en: Textile fabric desizing device for spinning
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a textile fabric desizing device for textiles, which comprises a cleaning box, a drying mechanism, a water pump, a filtering mechanism and a desizing mechanism, wherein the desizing mechanism comprises a material passing shaft rotationally connected to two ends of the top of the inner wall at two sides of the cleaning box, rotating shafts rotationally connected to two ends of the bottom of the inner wall at two sides of the cleaning box, supporting blocks welded to the outer wall of the rotating shafts and distributed at equal intervals, and an arc-shaped brush plate welded to one end of the supporting blocks, the material passing shaft and the arc-shaped brush plate are in mutual contact with the outer wall of the textile fabric, the top of the outer wall at one side of the cleaning box is provided with a water inlet hole, the water inlet hole is sleeved with a connecting pipe, and the bottom of the outer wall at one side of the cleaning box is provided with a water inlet hole. According to the utility model, through the drying box arranged on one side of the cleaning box, the electric heating pipe arranged at the bottom of the drying box operates to heat and dry the fabric, and through the arrangement of the plurality of ultraviolet lamps at the top of the drying box, the fabric can be sterilized, and the fabric can be sterilized while being dried, so that the safety of the fabric is improved.

title_en: Sterilization and disinfection device for preventing and treating animal epidemic diseases

Its beneficial effect is, this gynaecology and obstetrics inspection chair with regulatory function, through setting up first electric putter, first slider and first spout, when people need adjust the angle of back, people only need adjust the operation of first electric putter through control switch control, under the cooperation of first electric putter, first slider and first spout, made things convenient for people to adjust the angle of back, provide comfortable condition for the patient at the in-process of carrying out the inspection.

abstract_en: The utility model discloses a medical examination box for emergency treatment, which comprises a refrigeration bin plate, wherein two handle fixing rings are fixedly arranged above the refrigeration bin plate, handles are movably arranged on the inner sides of the handle fixing rings, a temperature control switch is fixedly arranged on one side of the refrigeration bin plate, a primary refrigeration combined bin is arranged below the refrigeration bin plate, a secondary medicine storage box is arranged below the primary refrigeration combined bin, a movable medicine storage bin and a constant-volume medicine storage bin are respectively arranged in the secondary medicine storage box, a transparent sealing bin door assembly is fixedly arranged on one side, close to the temperature control switch, of the secondary medicine storage box, and a lighting sterilization assembly is arranged on one side of the transparent sealing bin door. Has the advantages that: the refrigeration bin plate is utilized to enable the primary refrigeration combined bin to reach the temperature suitable for storing the medicine under the control of the temperature control switch, so that the inspection box can better store the inspection sample, and the storage condition of the inspection sample is more favorable.

title_en: Ultrasonic knife for animals
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of animal treatment and discloses an ultrasonic scalpel for animals, which comprises a main machine, wherein a display screen is bolted on the front side of the main machine, a lead is spliced on the right side of the main machine, the surface of the lead is connected with a winding box in a sliding manner, the inner wall of the winding box is connected with a winding wheel in a rotating manner, the lead is connected with the winding wheel in a winding manner, a coil spring is bolted on the front side of the inner wall of the winding wheel, and one end of the lead, which is positioned in the winding box, is electrically connected with a connecting block; through extracting the bolt, tensile wire for the rolling wheel rotates around the pivot, the release wire, or drive the rolling wheel through the wind-up spring and rotate, retrieve the wire, stir the dop through the shifting block, insert the left side of handle with the connecting block, later utilize the spring top to move the dop and slide, fix the connecting block chucking in the inside of handle, can be at the use length of reasonable within range adjustment wire, facilitate the use, can make things convenient for the dismouting, cause the harm to the wire when preventing to accomodate.

title_en: Degassing unit for chicken coop
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of henhouse disinfection, and provides a disinfection device for a henhouse, which is convenient for adding liquid medicine and replacing the liquid medicine, and comprises a henhouse main body, a mixing barrel and a mounting plate, wherein a water pump is mounted at the top end of the mounting plate and communicated with the mixing barrel through a water pumping pipe, the mixing barrel is connected with a stirring mechanism, the stirring mechanism comprises a motor, the motor is mounted at the top end of the mixing barrel, the output end of the motor extends into the mixing barrel and is connected with a rotating rod, the rotating rod is connected with a plurality of stirring rods, the top end of the mixing barrel is provided with a plurality of liquid feeding ports, the liquid feeding ports are communicated with a raw material box through liquid feeding pipes, the mixing barrel is connected with a plurality of opening and closing components, the top end of the henhouse main body is connected with a liquid storage box, the water pump is communicated with the liquid storage box through a water outlet pipe, the inner top wall of the henhouse main body is connected with a liquid distribution box, the liquid storage box is communicated with the liquid distribution box, the liquid distribution box is connected with a plurality of spray heads through a plurality of liquid distribution pipes, and the liquid drainage assembly is connected inside the henhouse main body.

title_en: Closed bladder irrigator
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a closed bladder irrigator which comprises a bottle stopper puncture outfit, a catheter joint and a waste liquid bag joint, wherein the bottle stopper puncture outfit is connected with a first tee joint through a pipeline, the catheter joint is connected with the waste liquid bag joint through a second tee joint, the second tee joint is connected with a third tee joint through a pipeline, two interfaces of the first tee joint are connected with two interfaces of the third tee joint through pipelines, a one-way valve is arranged on each pipeline between the first tee joint and the third tee joint, and a liquid feeding joint is arranged on one pipeline between the one-way valve and the third tee joint. The closed bladder irrigator greatly improves clinical usability, and most importantly, the whole irrigation process is closed, so that cross infection between an operator and a patient cannot be caused.

title_en: Adjustable health-care headrest
abstract_en: The utility model provides an adjustable health-care headrest, which relates to the technical field of health-care headrests and comprises a headrest body, wherein a female hidden buckle A is fixedly installed on the bottom surface of the headrest body, a heightening pad is arranged on the bottom surface of the headrest body, a male hidden buckle is fixedly installed on the top surface of the heightening pad, a female hidden buckle B is fixedly installed on the bottom surface of the heightening pad, and an accommodating mechanism is arranged on the side surface of the headrest body. According to the utility model, the height of the headrest body can be conveniently increased when the headrest body needs to be increased through the height increasing pad, so that the use requirements of different people are met, the height increasing process is simple and rapid, the height increasing pad can be repeatedly used, the headrest body can be conveniently hung and stored through the long rod and the hanging groove, the space of a wardrobe can be saved through the hanging and storing mode, the headrest body can be prevented from being crushed in the storing process, and the height increasing pad is simple to use and high in practicability.

title_en: Premature PICC indwelling catheter introducing device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a PICC indwelling catheter introducer for a premature infant, which comprises: the indwelling needle catheter, the transition pipe, the fixing column, the butterfly handrail and the antiskid sheet; the right side of the indwelling needle catheter is provided with a transition pipe, and the transition pipe is connected with the indwelling needle catheter in a welding way; the fixing column is arranged on the right side of the transition pipe, and the fixing column and the transition pipe are of an integrated structure; the butterfly handrail is arranged at the upper part of the top view of the fixed column, and the butterfly handrail is connected with the fixed column in a clamping manner; the anti-skidding pieces are arranged at the upper part and the lower part of the left side view of the butterfly handrail and are connected with the butterfly handrail in an adhesive way; the utility model has the advantages of sealing, dust prevention, long service life, increased friction between the anti-slip sheet and the skin, avoidance of traction of a needle head to the skin, protection of a skin needle mouth and reduction of inflammation rate by improving the premature PICC indwelling catheter introducing device, thereby effectively solving the problems and the defects in the existing device.

title_en: Medical waste spray type treatment and disinfection device

title_en: Old person uses cold-proof knee-pad

The knee protector comprises two shells which are symmetrically arranged at one end of the outer side of the knee protector in the vertical direction, four limiting plates are arranged, every two limiting plates are symmetrically arranged at the top of the shells in the vertical direction, when an old user needs to wear the knee protector to walk outside, the old user places the knee protector at the knee position and slides two elastic bands into the two shell outer side sliding grooves respectively, the old user can wear the knee protector by pressing the limiting plates after sliding the limiting plates into the elastic band outer side grooves, and the elastic band outer side grooves are suitable for legs of different old users to wear, so that a more convenient effect is achieved.

title_en: Ultrasonic osteotome head and ultrasonic osteotome with same
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an ultrasonic osteotome head and an ultrasonic osteotome with the same, wherein the ultrasonic osteotome head comprises: the mounting part is provided with a water passing cavity which is axially communicated with the mounting part; one end of the transition part is connected with the mounting part, and the transition part is provided with a first water outlet and a second water outlet which are communicated with the water passing cavity; the point of knife edge portion, the point of knife edge portion be the platykurtic and with the other end of transition portion is connected, first apopore with the second apopore is located respectively the thickness both sides of point of knife edge portion, first apopore with the second apopore respectively through to point of knife edge portion carries liquid in order to cool off the thickness both sides of point of knife edge portion. The ultrasonic osteotome head provided by the embodiment of the utility model has the advantages of sufficient liquid flow of the water outlet hole, high structural strength and energy efficiency and the like.

title_en: Lung-clearing instrument filtering device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of medical instruments and provides a lung-clearing instrument filtering device which comprises a lung-clearing instrument, wherein a water accumulation groove and a liquid accumulation groove are formed in the upper end surface of the lung-clearing instrument, a water accumulation box is fixedly connected in the water accumulation groove, the liquid accumulation box is fixedly connected in the liquid accumulation groove, the water accumulation box is fixedly connected with a filtering device through a water guide pipe, the water guide pipe penetrates through the water accumulation box, and the penetrating part of the water guide pipe and the water accumulation box is fixedly connected through a rubber pad. Through above-mentioned technical scheme, the problem of carrying out filtering separation with the atomizing water and the sputum in the pipe among the prior art has been solved.

title_en: Gauze mask fan

title_en: Poultry body cavity link quarantine inspection operation appurtenance

title_en: Brace is stabilized to knee joint for pet
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of the pet apparatus, concretely relates to brace is stabilized to knee joint for pet. Comprises an upper knee part and a lower knee part which are connected by a hinge, an upper ankle part and a lower ankle part, and a flexible connecting piece which is connected with the above parts in series. The flexible connecting piece enables each part of the brace to be better attached to the injured leg of the pet, the relative position between the parts can be adjusted according to actual conditions, and the problem that the leg of the brace and the injured pet are not easy to adapt is solved. The U-shaped notch structure of the upper part of the ankle can ensure that the achilles tendon of a pet injured leg is not pressed, and the corner cutting structure of the upper part of the ankle can ensure that the calcaneus of the pet injured leg is not pressed, so that the wearing comfort is enhanced. The utility model aims at providing an adjustable, wear comfortable knee joint and stabilize brace, this brace can hinder leg adaptation better with the pet, stabilizes the knee joint, alleviates and treats the multiple ailment of knee joint.

title_en: Surgical robot positioning accuracy detection device and detection system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a surgical robot positioning accuracy detection device and detecting system, the device includes: a supporting seat; the detection unit comprises a support rod and detection parts, one end of the support rod is connected to the support seat, the detection parts are mounted at the other end of the support rod, and the projection of each detection part along the vertical direction is located on the side line or the diagonal line of a preset rectangle. The utility model simplifies the positioning precision detection device by connecting one end of the support rod to the support seat and installing the detection part at the other end; the detection component projects on the side line or diagonal line of a preset rectangle along the vertical direction, so that the distribution of the test space range is expanded as much as possible; the plurality of detection parts are arranged and integrated on the precision detection device, so that the problem that the point-line distance is difficult to detect during precision detection is solved, and the precision of the precision detection of the positioning system of the surgical robot is improved.

title_en: Oil mist purifying equipment with peculiar smell removing function for processing water-soluble cutting fluid
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an oil mist purifying equipment with peculiar smell removing function for processing water-soluble cutting fluid, belonging to the technical field of oil mist purifying equipment, comprising an oil mist purifier, wherein one side of the oil mist purifier is provided with an air inlet, the central part of one side of the oil mist purifier, which is back to the air inlet, is provided with an exhaust pipe, and the top of the oil mist purifier is welded with a rectangular shell towards one side of the exhaust pipe; this application technical scheme is through the drive structure who sets up, the washing board, box and water pump, in the equipment use, can be according to driving the washing board through external control periodic control actuating mechanism and displacing about the air intake is inside, inside the washing board is carried with the inside washing liquid of box to the synchro control water pump, then the washing liquid spouts the otter board to air intake department from the orifice that washes the board, and at washing the board removal in-process, brush hair cooperation washing liquid on the washing board washs the otter board of air intake department, the mesh of the otter board of assurance air intake department is penetrating, and then guarantee air intake rate.

title_en: Soil high temperature degassing unit
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of field planting, in particular to a soil high-temperature disinfection device, which comprises a frame and a traction mechanism which is arranged on the frame and is used for connecting a power source, wherein the frame comprises a top plate and side plates which are arranged on two sides of the vertical operation moving direction of the top plate, a plurality of spray pipes with openings at the bottoms run through the top plate, the top parts in the spray pipes are connected with a fuel storage device through pipelines with valves, and the top parts in the spray pipes are also provided with electric igniters; and one end of the bottom of the top plate, facing the operation moving direction, is rotatably provided with a rotary tillage cutter set, and the other end of the top plate is provided with a tail plate, and a space blocked by the tail plate matched with the side plate forms a high-temperature combustion chamber. The utility model discloses simple structure can effectively carry out rotary tillage, high temperature disinfection to the landmass and realize soil preparation integration operation simultaneously, and high temperature region temperature distribution is even simultaneously, and soil can directly realize abundant disinfection operation under naked light and high temperature dual function.

title_en: Medical kit

The utility model discloses a scheme: a medical kit comprises a medical kit cover, a medical kit main body and a moisture-proof piece; one side of medical kit lid rotates with the medical kit main part to be connected, and the opposite side of medical kit lid can be dismantled with the medical kit main part and be connected, and the downside of medical kit lid is provided with the extension, and the upside of medical kit main part is provided with the dampproofing groove of extension complex, and the extension is provided with the standing groove, and the standing groove is provided with a plurality of and dampproofing groove complex intercommunicating pores, and extension demountable installation has the closing plate with standing groove complex, has placed dampproofing in the standing groove.
