title_en: Radiation protection door lock device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a radiation protection door lock device. The door lock comprises a door cover assembly, a safety lock sub-assembly and a safety lock power-on control module. The door cover assembly comprises a first lock cylinder and a lock cylinder fixing block, wherein the first lock cylinder is connected to the door cover through the lock cylinder fixing block; the safety lock sub-assembly comprises an electromagnetic safety door lock, a lock cylinder mounting bottom plate and a bracket, wherein the electromagnetic safety door lock is fixed on the side edge of the shell body through the lock cylinder mounting bottom plate and the bracket, and the electromagnetic safety door lock controls the power on or power off of the relay; the safety lock power-on control module comprises a control module and a safety lock power supply module; the safety lock power supply module is connected with the electromagnetic safety door lock and supplies power to the electromagnetic safety door lock; the control module is connected with the detection control module, and the control module controls the power module of the safety door lock to be electrified after receiving the detection end signal sent by the detection control module.

title_en: Pneumoperitoneum machine capable of preventing dirt from flowing reversely
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pneumoperitoneum machine capable of preventing the counterflow of an anti-fouling substance, which comprises: a regulating device; one end of the first air outlet pipeline is connected with the regulating and controlling device; one end of the second air outlet pipeline is an abdominal cavity access end; the control valve is connected with the other ends of the first air outlet pipeline and the second air outlet pipeline respectively; the two ends of the auxiliary pipeline are respectively connected with the control valve and the first air outlet pipeline, and the auxiliary pipeline is provided with a first collecting part for collecting liquid pollutants and a second collecting part for collecting gaseous pollutants; the control valve is electrically connected with the regulating and controlling device, and the control valve can control the first air outlet pipeline and the second air outlet pipeline to be conducted or control the second air outlet pipeline and the auxiliary pipeline to be conducted. The utility model can avoid the damage of pollutants and influence on the regulating and controlling device, and reduce the maintenance cost.

title_en: Handheld curing light

title_en: Respirator capable of manually switching tidal volume
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a respirator capable of manually switching tidal volume, which belongs to the technical field of respirators and comprises a face mask, an artificial nose, a regulating valve and a breathing air bag which are sequentially arranged, wherein the regulating valve comprises a valve seat, an air outlet nozzle and a plurality of air inlet nozzles are arranged on the valve seat, a control knob which can enable any air inlet nozzle to be communicated with the air outlet nozzle and seal the rest air inlet nozzles is rotationally connected to the valve seat, an air outlet pipe which extends into the breathing air bag is connected to each air inlet nozzle, a sub-air bag which is positioned in the breathing air bag is connected to each air outlet pipe, the cross section area of the inner cavity of each sub-air bag is unequal, and an air inlet pipe which extends out of the breathing air bag is connected to each sub-air bag; the air outlet nozzle is connected with an artificial nose, and the artificial nose is connected with a mask. The utility model can control the sub-air bags with different cross sections for ventilation by only rotating the control knob on the regulating valve, thereby realizing adjustment of the tidal volume of the respirator and having simpler and more convenient operation.

title_en: Smoke exhaust device of puncture outfit

The utility model improves the uniformity of the use of the filter component by arranging the transition cavity.

The utility model comprises a protector, an air bag, an inserting plate and a connecting ring, wherein the air bag is embedded on the inner side wall of the protector, the connecting ring is arranged on the end side wall of the protector, the inserting plate is inserted in the connecting ring, and a rotating piece is arranged on the bottom side wall of the protector. The insertion plates between the protective bodies are divided into a plurality of parts, and certain gaps are formed between the insertion plates, so that the gaps can breathe in cervical vertebra areas of patients and can be slightly wiped to ensure the cleanliness; through inserting between the board through regulating plate interconnect to when need adjust the mutual height of protecting the body, only need replace the board of inserting of different length and regulating plate can, but and board and regulating plate cyclic utilization have improved resource utilization, can aerify the gasbag through the air cock, stop when the patient reaches best comfort level and aerify, and then the effectual improvement patient comfort level's purpose rate.

title_en: Laparoscope

According to the utility model, under the matched use of the circular fixing ring, the first limiting groove, the first limiting plate, the arc-shaped connecting plate, the spring and the fixing plate, the laparoscope body can be repeatedly driven to stretch out and draw back in the shell, so that the front end of the laparoscope body can be repeatedly attached and wiped with the silica gel sleeve, the liquid adhered to the affected part in the patient body on the front end surface of the laparoscope body can be effectively removed, the definition of the front end surface of the laparoscope body is further improved, the camera designed in the front end surface of the laparoscope body is ensured, the condition of the affected part in the patient body can be clearly observed, and corresponding operation is performed.

title_en: Improved steering wire wheel structure special for endoscope
abstract_en: The utility model provides an improved special steering wire wheel structure for an endoscope, which comprises a wire coil and a guide tube, wherein the wire coil is fixedly connected to one side end surface of the guide tube, the trend of the central line of the wire coil is consistent with that of the central line of the guide tube, and a clamping groove matched with a deflector rod of a handle of the endoscope is formed in the central position of the wire coil; the edge of the end face of the wire coil is provided with two arc-shaped guide holes for the steel wires to pass through, the two arc-shaped guide holes are symmetrically arranged, and the wall of the arc-shaped guide hole far away from one side of the center line of the wire coil is also extended with a guide boss. The beneficial technical effects are as follows: by means of the special steering wheel structure for the endoscope, the arc-shaped guide holes are formed at the edge of the wire coil, the limit pipe body of the shell is not required to be matched, the parts of the shell are reduced, and reasonable space distribution of the handle of the endoscope is facilitated. The guide boss extends from the wall of the arc-shaped guide hole, so that the steel wire can run along the guide inclined plane of the guide boss after entering the arc-shaped guide hole, and the problem that the steering wire wheel is scrapped due to the fact that the steel wire cannot run in the arc-shaped guide hole is completely avoided.

title_en: High-level abdominal aortic side lymph node exposing device for laparoscope
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of medical equipment, in particular to a high-level abdominal aortic side lymph node exposure device for a laparoscope, which comprises a traction rod, wherein a plurality of traction holes are formed in the traction rod, traction ropes are respectively penetrated in the traction holes, a drag hook is fixedly connected to the traction ropes, and the length of the traction ropes is longer than that of the traction holes; the traction rod is also provided with a fixing device which can fix the traction rope in the traction hole. According to the technical scheme, the problems that the pulling area is too small, the surgical field is not fully exposed and the operation is inconvenient for a doctor in the retroperitoneal lymph node cleaning operation can be solved.

title_en: Warming moxibustion instrument
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of moxibustion equipment, and particularly discloses a moxibustion instrument which comprises an outer shell, a skin-contacting piece, a bottom shell, a power supply assembly, a combustion assembly, a driving assembly and a filtering assembly, wherein the outer shell is provided with a plurality of air inlets; the shell is internally provided with a combustion cavity and a filtering cavity; the bottom of the bottom shell is provided with a filter screen, and the combustion cavity is communicated with a cavity formed by the filter screen and the skin-receiving piece; the filter assembly comprises a fan and a filter structure, and the fan is used for extracting the smoke in the combustion cavity; the combustion cavity comprises a lifting cylinder, a fixed cylinder and a rotating cylinder; the fixed cylinder is fixed on the bottom shell, the outer side of the lifting cylinder is provided with a lifting bulge, and the fixed cylinder is provided with a moving groove; the rotating cylinder is rotationally connected to the bottom shell, and the driving assembly is used for driving the rotating cylinder to rotate; the side wall of the rotating cylinder is provided with a spiral strip-shaped hole. According to the technical scheme, the control on the moxibustion application temperature is realized by controlling the height of the moxa cone and the distance between the moxa cone and the skin through the driving assembly, the rotating speed of the fan is unchanged, and the influence on the filtration and the discharge of smoke can be avoided.

title_en: Traditional Chinese medicine decocting equipment convenient for filtering dregs

The medicine decocting pot comprises a medicine decocting pot body, a medicine decocting mechanism is arranged in the medicine decocting pot body and comprises a sealing cover, a rotating shaft protection shell is fixedly arranged at the center of the sealing cover, a driving motor is fixedly arranged above the sealing cover, a purifying mechanism is arranged on the sealing cover, and a heating mechanism is arranged below the medicine decocting pot body. Through being equipped with purifying mechanism, when the operator uses this device to decoct the medicine, operator accessible controller starts second valve and small-size air pump, and the pungent smell that produces because of the medicine decocting in the pot of decocting the medicine is under the effect of small-size air pump, enters into the active carbon adsorption incasement through venthole, gas-collecting channel, the air duct that seals the cover, is equipped with the multilayer active carbon filter screen in the active carbon adsorption incasement, can effectively adsorb the peculiar smell, air-purifying, finally, the air after being purified is discharged outside through the blast pipe.

title_en: ICU doctor is with multi-functional inspection ware

title_en: Ultrasonic probe auxiliary fixing device and ultrasonic equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides an auxiliary fixing device of an ultrasonic probe, which comprises a fixing seat, a first rotating arm, a second rotating arm and a fixing arm; one end of the first rotating arm is rotatably connected with the fixed seat, and the rotating central axis of the first rotating arm is arranged along a first direction; one end of the second rotating arm is rotatably connected with the other end of the first rotating arm, and the rotating central axis of the second rotating arm is arranged along the first direction; the fixed arm is rotatably connected with the other end of the second rotating arm, the rotating central axis of the fixed arm is arranged along the second direction, and a clamping and fixing cavity is arranged in the fixed arm. Compared with the prior art, the auxiliary fixing device for the ultrasonic probe and the ultrasonic equipment can reduce the labor cost during clinical operation, reduce the influence of human factors on the clinical operation, and simultaneously ensure that the movable position area of the ultrasonic probe is wider, so that the ultrasonic probe can be positioned to a required position area more accurately.

title_en: Cover special for pressing paste

This red Lan Guangbing hammer beauty instrument through seting up the louvre in the bottom of outer frame to cooperate its internally mounted's fan, can dispel the heat of outer frame's inside, with its inside heat export, make its inside temperature can not last the rising, then lead to the problem that its inside components and parts damaged, meanwhile, set up semiconductor refrigeration piece and flat board at the another side of outer frame, can utilize red blue light lamp plate and light hole lens board to send red blue light and shine the back to human skin, shrink the pore, improve the effect of tender skin, avoid external material to get into after the pore is enlarged, improve the effect of beautiful skin.

abstract_en: The utility model is suitable for the technical field of physiotherapy lamp beads, and provides an LED infrared physiotherapy lamp bead, which comprises a shell, wherein a light-transmitting cover is arranged on the front surface of the shell, a working box is arranged in the shell, a rear cover is arranged at the rear end of the working box, a physiotherapy switch, a power interface and a warm lamp switch are respectively arranged on the right side of the rear cover from top to bottom, a controller is arranged on the inner sides of the physiotherapy switch, the power interface and the warm lamp switch, a battery is arranged at the rear end of the controller, a front panel is arranged on the front surface of the working box, the physiotherapy lamp bead is arranged on the front panel, a warm lamp is arranged in the center of the front panel, and a heat insulation pad is arranged between the front panel and the battery.

title_en: Swing type electric bone saw
abstract_en: The utility model provides a swing type electric bone saw, which relates to the technical field of medical appliances and aims to solve the problem that saw teeth are exposed to the outside for a long time and are easy to cause accidental injury; a control handle is arranged at the rear side of the storage protection body; the left side and the right side of the storage protection body are provided with protection cushions for protecting hands of an operator; the adjusting shaft body is of a cylindrical structure; an adjusting screw rod is arranged at the front end of the adjusting shaft body; a synchronous wheel disc is arranged on the circumferential outer wall of the adjusting shaft body; the rear end of the adjusting shaft body is provided with an adjusting knob; the inside of accomodating the protection body is provided with the shrink frame. The utility model discloses a make shrink frame drive swing saw blade income advance the inside of accomodating the protection body to carry out shrink protection to the swing saw blade, still promoted user's security when improving swing saw blade security.

title_en: Medical instrument cabinet for quick replacement and hoisting of wall surface of operating room
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of operating room instrument cabinets and discloses an operating room wall surface quick-replacement lifting medical instrument cabinet, which comprises a lifting mechanism, wherein an instrument cabinet mechanism is arranged on the front surface of the lifting mechanism, the lifting mechanism comprises a mounting guide rail, a countersunk head fixing hole is formed in the back surface of the mounting guide rail, and a cabinet body lifting hole is formed in the front surface of the mounting guide rail. This medical apparatus cabinet of operating room wall quick replacement hoist and mount is installed in advance at the wall through setting up the mounting rail, then installs on the mounting rail through hoist and mount support and mounting rail grafting well apparatus cabinet body, then runs through cabinet body lifting hole to installation threaded hole in threaded connection from the inside of equipment chamber using the bolt to fix the apparatus cabinet body, when dismantling, only need dismantle two and the bolt of mounting threaded hole connection and go up the support apparatus cabinet body can, then with new apparatus cabinet follow new and the mounting rail is connected fixedly, reached the effect that can quick replacement apparatus cabinet.

title_en: Layered first-aid kit
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of medical instruments, and particularly relates to a layered first-aid kit, which comprises a box body, wherein an upper bin and a lower bin are arranged in the box body, a plurality of clamping grooves corresponding to each other are formed in the upper bin, a partition plate is inserted into each two corresponding clamping grooves, a storage rack capable of being pulled is arranged in the lower bin, and a refrigeration compressor communicated with the lower bin is arranged at the bottom of the box body; according to the utility model, the space layout in the upper bin can be changed by drawing out the partition plate so as to store different types of articles, and the lower bin can store medicines or cold compress bags needing refrigeration, so that medical staff can be helped to better carry out emergency work, and the device can be carried by hand and pulled by the pull rod, and has strong practicability.

title_en: Disinfection apparatus
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a disinfection device, which comprises a first shell, a disinfection component and an ozone decomposition component, wherein the disinfection component is arranged in the first shell and comprises an ozone generation component, the ozone generation component is used for releasing ozone into the first shell, the ozone decomposition component is arranged in the first shell and is used for decomposing residual ozone in the first shell, the gas generated by decomposition is discharged out of the first shell, when an object to be disinfected is needed, the object to be disinfected is placed in an inner cavity of the first shell 1, ozone is released into the first shell through the ozone generation component, the object to be disinfected is disinfected through the ozone, after the object is disinfected, the ozone decomposition component works, the residual ozone in the first shell is decomposed through the ozone decomposition component, the gas generated after the residual ozone is decomposed is pollution-free to the environment, and the gas can be directly discharged out of the first shell, so that the object to be disinfected is avoided to the environment pollution at the same time, and the effect is good.

title_en: Atomizer shell
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an atomizer shell, which comprises an outer shell and a nozzle, wherein the nozzle is arranged in the middle of the upper end of the outer shell, the outer shell and the nozzle are of an integrated structure, a mounting cavity is formed in the inner side of the outer shell, a spraying opening is formed in the middle of the nozzle, and the spraying opening is communicated with the mounting cavity.

title_en: Multifunctional insulin injection reminder
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a multifunctional insulin injection reminder, which comprises a containing box, an upper cover and a prompting card, wherein a vertical downward fixing groove is formed in the other side of the top end of the containing box, a sliding fixing block is arranged in the fixing groove, a horizontal sliding plate is arranged on the side surface of the fixing block, a vertical pushing plate is arranged on one side of the sliding plate, and a sliding groove for installing the sliding plate is formed in the fixing groove; the top surface of the upper cover is provided with a transparent groove for installing a prompt card, one side of the transparent groove is provided with a plurality of groups of digital gear rotating mechanisms, the digital gear rotating mechanisms are arranged from top to bottom, the bottom surface of the upper cover is provided with a vertical fixing plate, the fixing plate is correspondingly arranged with the fixing groove, and the fixing plate is provided with a groove corresponding to the fixing block; the prompt card is arranged in the transparent groove. The insulin pen can remind the patient whether to inject insulin, know the correct insulin injection dosage at a glance, and store the insulin pen and the needle head so as to be convenient for the patient to use.

title_en: Threading device
abstract_en: The present utility model provides a threader, comprising: the threading rod comprises a first rod body and a second rod body arranged at the first end of the first rod body, and the second rod body is bent to form a spiral structure; the handle is arranged at the second end of the first rod body. By applying the technical scheme of the utility model, the problem that the suture thread in the related technology is easy to slip from the threading apparatus can be effectively solved.

title_en: Kidney fistulization pipe fixer
abstract_en: The utility model provides a kidney fistulization tube fixer, which belongs to the technical field of medical auxiliary setting, and comprises a fixing waistband; the kidney-fistulization tube fixing device comprises a fixing waistband, a kidney-fistulization tube, a fixing waistband, a fan, a water absorption ring, an absorption grid and a water absorption ring, wherein a waistband cavity is formed in the fixing waistband, a kidney-fistulization tube placing opening penetrates through the waistband cavity, a kidney-fistulization tube fixing cover is sleeved on the kidney-fistulization tube placing opening and used for clamping and fixing the kidney-fistulization tube, the fixing waistband is provided with the fan, the fan is arranged on the outer side wall of the waistband cavity and electrically connected with a battery arranged in the waistband cavity and used for driving air in the waistband cavity to flow, the waistband cavity is internally provided with the water absorption ring placing groove which surrounds the kidney-fistulization tube placing opening, the water absorption ring placing groove is used for placing a water absorption ring, and the bottom of the water absorption ring is provided with the absorption grid, and the water absorption ring absorbs liquid near the kidney-fistulization tube of a patient through the absorption grid; the utility model can solve the problem that the skin around the nephrostomy tube of the patient is inconvenient to keep clean.

title_en: Indwelling catheter for urine sampling
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an indwelling catheter for urine sampling, which comprises a catheter body, wherein one end of the catheter body is provided with a drainage hole, and the other end of the catheter body is provided with a sampling cavity opening, a drainage cavity opening and a balloon inflation cavity opening; the sampling cavity opening is provided with a cap, the drainage cavity opening is used for being connected with a urine drainage bag, and the saccule inflating cavity opening is provided with a one-way valve; the catheter body is internally provided with a drainage cavity and a balloon inflation cavity, the drainage cavity and the balloon inflation cavity are independent channels, the drainage hole is respectively communicated with a sampling cavity opening and a drainage cavity opening through the drainage cavity, one end of the balloon inflation cavity is communicated with the balloon inflation cavity opening, and the other end of the balloon inflation cavity is communicated with the balloon arranged at the position, close to the drainage hole, of the catheter body. According to the utility model, the guide wire is arranged in the catheter body, so that the hardness of the catheter body is improved on the premise of not scratching tissues, and the success rate and the efficiency of the catheter arrangement can be improved; meanwhile, a valve is arranged on the sampling cavity port, so that convenience is provided for clinical urine sampling, urine leakage is avoided, and the risk of retrograde infection of the urinary tract is reduced.

title_en: Blood changing passage for neonate
abstract_en: The utility model provides a blood exchange passage for newborns, which comprises a Y-shaped indwelling needle, a tee joint and a blood exchange device, wherein the Y-shaped indwelling needle is detachably connected with the tee joint; the blood exchange device is integrally formed, and an Murphy's tube on the blood exchange device is positioned in the middle of a connecting tube of the blood exchange device and divides the connecting tube into two parts, namely a first connecting tube positioned in front of the Murphy's tube and a second connecting tube positioned behind the Murphy's tube; the first connecting pipe, the Murphy's tube, the second connecting pipe and the interior of the waste blood bag are sequentially communicated and connected; the first switch is arranged on the outer wall of the second connecting pipe and slides up and down outside the second connecting pipe; the second connecting pipe is used for embedding the blood changing device into the blood changing device; the outer side of the waste blood bag is provided with scale marks, the top is provided with an exhaust port, and the bottom is provided with a blood discharge port. Therefore, the problems of repeated bubble alarm and tube blockage can be avoided, and smooth blood exchange is ensured; and, the waste blood bag that links to each other directly with the second connecting pipe also can be convenient for clinical accurate statistics volume.

title_en: Traction support
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a traction support, which comprises a fixed base, a first traction assembly and a second traction assembly, wherein the first traction assembly and the second traction assembly are hinged to the fixed base, universal wheels are arranged on the end parts of the first traction assembly and the second traction assembly, and when the first traction assembly or the second traction assembly rotates around respective hinging points, an included angle alpha between the first traction assembly and the second traction assembly can be increased or decreased. When the utility model is used, after a patient is forked and sat on the fixed base, the left leg of the patient can be placed on the first traction component, the right leg of the patient can be placed on the second traction component, the included angle between the two legs can be changed by rotating the first traction component or the second traction component, and then the requirement for adjusting the gesture of the two legs according to different requirements is facilitated.

title_en: Incubator for neonates
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a neonate incubator for neonates, which belongs to the technical field of medical equipment and comprises a base and an incubator body arranged at the upper part of the base, wherein a lifting mechanism and a supporting seat are arranged at the lower side of the base, the incubator body is arranged at the top end of the base, a movable frame is arranged in the incubator body, a baby basket is arranged above the movable frame, and the movable frame comprises two tracks which are arranged side by side, rollers arranged in the tracks, a bracket for connecting the rollers, a supporting plate arranged above the bracket, an arc plate arranged on the surface of the supporting plate and a spring connected with the surface of the supporting plate and arranged at the bottom of the arc plate. According to the incubator for the neonate, provided by the utility model, the movable frame and the lifting mechanism are arranged to drive the baby basket to shake, so that the effect of pacifying the neonate is ensured, the sense of safety of the neonate is further improved, and crying is prevented.

title_en: Split type planting guide plate
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of medical planting, in particular to a split planting guide plate, which comprises a guide plate main body, wherein the upper surface of the guide plate main body is provided with planting holes, the inside of the guide plate main body is provided with a first clamping groove, the lower surface of the guide plate main body is provided with an opening, the inside of the first clamping groove is connected with a fixing device for assisting in fixing the guide plate main body, and a sleeve body is fixedly sleeved with teeth through the fixing device, so that the fixing and the installation of the guide plate main body are finished; so that a doctor does not need to fix the device with the assistance of hands in the operation process; the situation of guide plate displacement in the operation process is avoided; so that the implant can be accurately implanted.

title_en: Medical care is with portable nursing case
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a portable nursing box for medical care, which comprises a nursing box body; the top end of the nursing box body is rotationally connected with a top plate through a rotating shaft, and the top end of the top plate is fixedly connected with a handle; through promoting the ejector pad, make the ejector pad drive the shrouding that the bottom set up and remove to the inner wall of spout, can make shrouding extrusion spring, thereby can open the inner wall of fixed block, then put into the inner wall of fixed block with the stopper of U-shaped, and loosen the ejector pad, make the spring promote the shrouding and reset, can fix the inner wall at the fixed block with the stopper, and prevent through the arch of stopper both sides that the stopper from removing to both sides, thereby the accessible stopper comes to divide into two sets of with the baldric, the medical personnel of being convenient for carries out both shoulders with nursing case body through the both sides of baldric and backs up, thereby solve medical personnel and use the easy high low shoulder problem that causes of single baldric for a long time.

title_en: Dialysis machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a dialysis machine, comprising: a venous circuit conduit comprising a circuit outlet and a circuit inlet; a drive pump connected to the venous return line; an oxygen source; the gas exchange device is provided with a first channel and a second channel, the first channel is provided with a first inlet and a first outlet, the first inlet is connected with the loop outlet, and the first outlet is connected with the loop inlet; the second channel is provided with a gas inlet and a gas outlet; the gas inlet is connected with an oxygen source; the gas outlet is connected with the outside; the first channel is sleeved in the second channel, the extending direction of the first channel is the same as that of the second channel, and the pipe wall of the first channel comprises a gas exchange membrane layer. The dialysis machine provided by the utility model has portability, and the dialysis machine diffuses inert gas in the blood of the first channel into the second channel under the action of the gas exchange membrane layer, and simultaneously diffuses oxygen of the second channel into the first channel, so that the gas exchange between the inert gas in the blood and the oxygen in the gas exchange device is realized.

title_en: Sodium fire protective clothing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to sodium fire protective clothing, which comprises a headgear, a coverall, gloves and foot covers; the one-piece suit is formed by integrally connecting one-piece suit upper clothing and one-piece suit lower clothing, the one-piece suit upper clothing comprises one-piece suit sleeves, and the one-piece suit lower clothing comprises one-piece suit trouser legs; the upper garment of the one-piece garment is connected with the headgear in a closing way through the magic tape; the trouser legs and the leg sleeves of the one-piece suit are connected in a closing way through the magic tape; the sleeves of the one-piece suit are in closed connection with the gloves through tightening belts; the fabrics of the head cover, the one-piece suit, the glove and the foot cover are all three layers, and comprise an inner layer, a middle layer and an outer layer; a comfort layer made of a permanent flame retardant material; the middle layer is a waterproof breathable heat-insulating layer made of waterproof breathable heat-insulating materials; the outer layer is a flame-retardant and anti-slip layer made of a high-strength permanent flame-retardant material. The sodium fire protective clothing disclosed by the utility model comprehensively protects the fire-fighting rescue personnel during the sodium fire fight process.

title_en: Assembled sterile composite medical wallboard
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an assembled sterile composite medical wallboard, and relates to the technical field of medical wallboards. The assembled sterile composite medical wallboard comprises four groups of mounting plates, a heat preservation mechanism and a heat preservation mechanism; the heat preservation mechanism is arranged on the inner side of the mounting plates and comprises foam plates, the foam plates are fixedly arranged between the two groups of mounting plates, and the foam plates are made of phenolic materials. This aseptic compound medical wallboard of assembled can keep warm in the wall through the cystosepiment with place cotton, reduces indoor temperature's cooling, conveniently stores the medicine, and the improvement device makes, can separate the spot through the hydrophobic membrane in the guard plate outside, reduces the pollution to the device, simple structure, and convenient to use controls ultraviolet lamp's opening, makes ultraviolet lamp shine the outside of mounting panel, disinfects the outside of mounting panel, reduces patient cross infection, is favorable to promoting and uses.

title_en: Angle-adjustable surgical retractor
abstract_en: An angle-adjustable surgical retractor belongs to the field of surgical instruments, and is characterized in that: comprises a drag hook main body, a drag hook arm and a drag hook adjusting piece; a plurality of angle adjusting units are arranged on the drag hook main body; the drag hook adjusting piece is connected with the drag hook arm through a strip-shaped connecting piece; one end of the connecting piece is fixedly connected with the drag hook adjusting piece, and the other end of the connecting piece is fixedly connected with the drag hook arm on the lower surface of the drag hook arm. Through set up swing joint's drag hook arm in drag hook main part front end to set up angle adjusting unit in drag hook main part, realize the drag hook arm through strip connecting piece and drag hook regulating part's connection, realize the regulation to the size of drag hook arm and drag hook main part formed angle through adjusting drag hook regulating part in angle adjusting unit's position, be convenient for realize the operation of drag hook angle adjustment in the art, fully expose the operation field of vision, thereby effectively optimize the operation flow, improve the operation effect, use manpower sparingly simultaneously, improve operation efficiency.

title_en: Head cooling device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a head cooling device, which belongs to the technical field of medical instruments, and particularly relates to a head cooling device, which comprises an arc-shaped plate, wherein the front end of the inside of the arc-shaped plate is fixedly provided with a water storage tank, the upper side wall of the water storage tank is fixedly provided with a water inlet pipe, the upper end of the water inlet pipe is provided with a sealing cover, the rear side wall of the arc-shaped plate is fixedly provided with cooling cotton, the rear side wall of the water storage tank is fixedly provided with a water outlet pipe, the rear end of the water outlet pipe extends to the inside of the cooling cotton.

title_en: Nursing robot assisting sitting and standing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of nursing, in particular to a nursing robot for assisting sitting and standing, which comprises a bottom plate and a backup plate, wherein supporting plates are respectively fixed at four corners below the bottom plate and at two sides below the backup plate, a U-shaped plate is arranged on one side of the bottom plate, an adjusting mechanism is arranged below the U-shaped plate, the backup plate is rotationally connected to one side of the bottom plate, rotating rods are respectively rotationally connected to two side walls of the backup plate, one ends of the two rotating rods are respectively arranged at two sides in the U-shaped plate, and rotating holes are respectively formed at one ends of the two rotating rods. When the nursing robot is used, the old people or the patient only needs to be placed above the nursing robot, the back of the nursing robot leans against the backup plate, one end of the rotating rod can be driven to move through the adjusting mechanism, and the other end of the rotating rod can be driven to rotate by moving one end of the rotating rod.

title_en: Postoperative limb fixing support
abstract_en: The utility model provides a post-operation limb fixing support, and relates to the technical field of medical appliances. Comprising the following steps: a housing including a mount and a swing member; a support member provided on the swing member; an adjusting assembly for adjusting an included angle between the swinging members; the adjusting assembly includes: a first mount provided on one of the swinging members; a second mount provided on the other swing member; the sliding piece is arranged on the first mounting piece in a sliding manner; one end of the connecting rod is rotationally connected with the sliding piece, and the other end of the connecting rod is rotationally connected with the second mounting piece; the telescopic assembly is used for driving the sliding piece to slide along the first mounting piece. The mounting seat is used for being placed in the crotch of a patient, and the supporting piece is used for supporting the legs of the patient; the telescopic assembly drives the sliding piece to move along the first mounting piece, the connecting rod rotates relative to the sliding piece, and the connecting rod pulls the first mounting piece to change with the second mounting piece in an included angle, so that the included angle of the pair of swinging pieces is driven to change, and the postoperative rehabilitation requirements of patients with different statures are met.

title_en: Quick-opening door with sealing structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of quick-opening doors and discloses a quick-opening door with a sealing structure, which comprises a quick-opening door, wherein the left end of the quick-opening door is fixedly connected with the right end of a mounting plate, the quick-opening door is movably connected with the right end of an adjusting table through the left end of the mounting plate, an adjusting device is arranged in the quick-opening door through the adjusting table, the quick-opening door is movably connected with a cabin body through the adjusting table, a stabilizing device is arranged in the quick-opening door, a bed body is arranged in the quick-opening door, the quick-opening door is fixedly connected with the left end of a pushing body through the surface of the bed body, the quick-opening door with the sealing structure is provided with the adjusting device, a pull rod is pulled to adjust the quick-opening door, the pull rod is loosened, the quick-opening door can be limited, the interference of external factors is prevented, the quick-opening door with the sealing structure is provided with the stabilizing device, and the pushing body pushes a pushing block when the quick-opening door is closed, so that the stabilizing rod is enabled to clamp the bed body, and the stabilizing effect is achieved.

title_en: Tubular implant delivery guidewire and system having the same
abstract_en: The utility model provides a tubular implant conveying guide wire and a system with the same, wherein the tubular implant conveying guide wire comprises a mandrel and a pushing mechanism sleeved outside the mandrel, the mandrel is provided with a proximal end and a distal end, the pushing mechanism comprises a coil and a pushing body connected with the distal end of the coil, the pushing body is provided with a through hole for the mandrel to pass through, and the through hole is arranged to change in aperture along the axial direction of the mandrel, so that the mandrel is provided with a first state that the part of the mandrel in the through hole is positioned at the axis of the through hole, and a second state that an included angle exists between the part of the mandrel in the through hole and the axis of the through hole. The aperture of the through hole in the tubular implant conveying guide wire is changed along the axial direction of the mandrel, so that the mandrel is changed between a first state and a second state, the pushing body is always abutted with the tubular implant, enough pushing force is provided, and the over-bending performance of the tubular implant conveying guide wire is improved.

title_en: Spoon-shaped comfortable tongue depressor for traditional Chinese medicine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a spoon-shaped comfortable tongue depressor for traditional Chinese medicine, which comprises a handle and a spoon-shaped tongue depressor, wherein the surface of the handle is provided with a mounting groove, the inner wall of the mounting groove is provided with a light-emitting mechanism, the light-emitting mechanism comprises a lighting lamp and a reflecting plate which are fixedly arranged on the inner wall of the mounting groove, the left end of the handle is provided with a clamping mechanism, the clamping mechanism comprises a first elastic clamping plate and a second elastic clamping plate which are arranged at the left end of the handle, the surfaces of the first elastic clamping plate and the second elastic clamping plate are respectively provided with a thread groove, and the surfaces of the thread grooves are in threaded connection with nuts. This comfortable tongue depressor of traditional chinese medical science spoon shape through setting up mounting groove, light, reflector panel and control switch, when the oral cavity inspection, opens the light through control switch, and the bright light that the light sent can shine on the portion of gripping through reflector panel and spout, because the portion of gripping and tongue depressor are made by transparent plastic, light can be along the portion of gripping and the hard light of giving off all around of tongue depressor.

title_en: Ventricular drainage device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a ventricular drainage device, belonging to the technical field of drainage devices; including the telescopic link, the top of telescopic link is provided with the couple, the bottom of telescopic link is provided with the bracing piece, the top of bracing piece is provided with the mount pad, the bottom of telescopic link is provided with the rotary block, the mount pad is semi-circular setting, rotary block and mount pad looks adaptation each other, the top both sides of mount pad all are provided with the fixed plate, the both sides of rotary block are provided with the axostylus axostyle, and this axostylus axostyle runs through the intermediate position department of fixed plate, the mount pad rotates with the rotary block to be connected. According to the utility model, the telescopic rod can be arranged on the bed board and can be lifted along with the lifting of the bed board, so that the telescopic rod can be adjusted along with the head position of a patient, the procedure that the telescopic rod needs to be adjusted is reduced, and the telescopic rod can be adjusted more conveniently.

title_en: Emergency rescue vehicle for individual field operations
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of emergency rescue vehicles and discloses a field individual soldier emergency rescue vehicle which comprises a bottom plate, pedals and clamping grooves, wherein the back surface of each pedal is contacted with the front surface of the bottom plate, two sliding grooves are formed in the front surface of the bottom plate, telescopic rods are arranged in each sliding groove, a supporting plate is fixedly arranged on the back surface of each pedal, a rod groove is formed in the back surface of each supporting plate, the inner wall of each rod groove is fixedly connected with the outer surface of each telescopic rod, a double-sided plate is clamped in each clamping groove, two baffle plates are fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the bottom plate, and two mounting ports are formed in the left side surface of each baffle plate; according to the utility model, the bottom plate, the pedal, the clamping groove, the sliding groove, the telescopic rod, the supporting plate, the rod groove, the double-sided plate, the baffle plate, the mounting opening and the telescopic upper belt are arranged, the two sides of the double-sided plate are made of different materials, one side of the double-sided plate is convenient for supporting a wounded, the other side of the double-sided plate is convenient for placing materials, and the function of conveniently carrying the wounded by using the supporting plate and the pedal to unfold is achieved.

title_en: X-ray system fault analysis device for medical CT
abstract_en: The utility model provides a fault analysis device of an X-ray system of a medical CT, and relates to the technical field of fault analysis devices. The system comprises a data acquisition system, a data storage system and a waveform display system which are sequentially connected in a communication way, wherein the data acquisition system is connected with a data acquisition cable group in a communication way. The utility model can collect key data waveforms of DCBUS voltage, cathode-anode high voltage, cathode-anode current, grid voltage G1G2, filament voltage, filament current and the like when the X-ray system works, is used for analyzing the change state of each parameter at the moment of failure, and is compared with the waveform of the normal state, thereby rapidly and accurately judging the failure part of equipment, eliminating the failure one by one without using a replacement method, providing a reliable technical means for engineers to judge the failure and replace accessories, saving manpower, material resources and time, and solving the problems of large failure maintenance workload, long equipment downtime, poor maintenance timeliness, dissatisfaction of customers and the like of the original X-ray system.

title_en: Proliferation scar elastic device for displaying compression pressure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a hypertrophic scar elastic device for displaying compression pressure, which comprises an elastic sleeve body and a pressure testing assembly, wherein the elastic sleeve body is in contact with the skin of a patient, the pressure testing assembly comprises a display module, a pressure sensor module, a wire sleeve and a connecting rope, the display module is positioned on the outer surface of the elastic sleeve body, the pressure sensor module is positioned between the elastic sleeve body and the skin, the display module is connected with the pressure sensor module, the inner end of the connecting rope is connected with the pressure sensor module, the outer end of the connecting rope is positioned outside the elastic sleeve body, the wire sleeve is of a hollow structure and sleeved outside the connecting rope, and the length of the wire sleeve is smaller than or equal to that of the connecting rope. The pressure testing component provided by the utility model measures the specific value of the pressing pressure applied by the elastic sleeve body to the scar, and the elastic sleeve body is replaced when the pressure reduction is detected, so that the treatment effect is ensured and the economic burden of a patient is reduced.

title_en: Lower-mounted bagged water dispenser and gravity self-sinking puncture device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a lower-mounted bagged water dispenser and a gravity self-sinking puncture device, and relates to the technical field of bagged water dispensers. According to the technical scheme provided by the utility model, the bagged water is placed at the bottom of the water dispenser, so that the force for carrying the bagged water is omitted, the water is more labor-saving and convenient to change, the puncturing device can lighten the work for the water pump, reduce the noise, prolong the service life of the water pump, and when the bagged water is changed, the puncturing head and the puncturing position of the bagged water are wiped by the alcohol cotton sheets for sterilization, so that bacterial pollution is avoided, the puncturing device is kept in a closed state when in use, and the drinking water is ensured to be safe, sanitary and healthy.

title_en: Working handle and maxillary sinus lifting tool
abstract_en: The embodiment of the utility model discloses a working handle and a maxillary sinus lifting tool, which comprise: the handle main body is provided with a working part which is used for cutting bone tissues; the sensing element is arranged in the handle main body and is attached to the working part, and the sensing element is used for executing response action when the actual lifting distance of the working part is greater than the preset distance so as to prevent the working part from puncturing the sinus floor mucosa of the maxillary sinus. According to the working handle provided by the utility model, the induction element is arranged in the handle main body, and the response action is executed when the actual lifting distance of the working part is larger than the preset distance preset by an operator, so that the operator is reminded that the working part approaches to the sinus floor mucosa of the maxillary sinus, thereby preventing the working part from suddenly applying force to puncture the sinus floor mucosa of the maxillary sinus, and further reducing the risk of puncturing the sinus floor mucosa.

title_en: Novel drainage bottle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of drainage bottles and discloses a novel drainage bottle which comprises a wall hanging plate, wherein one side of the wall hanging plate is fixedly connected with a sliding rail, the inside of the sliding rail is connected with a sliding block in a sliding manner, one side of the sliding block is fixedly connected with a connecting block, one side of the connecting block is fixedly connected with a fixing frame, the inner bottom wall of the fixing frame is fixedly connected with a fixing ring, the inside of the fixing ring is clamped with a negative pressure bottle, one side of the top surface of the negative pressure bottle is fixedly connected with a regulating pipe, the surface of the regulating pipe is provided with a threaded hole, and internal threads of the threaded hole penetrate through a regulating component. This novel drainage bottle, through the setting of adjusting part, when using, according to patient's state of an illness, twist adjusting bolt, under the effect of bearing, drive the inside translation of regulating plate at the governing pipe, the regulating plate extrudes the drainage tube, the circulation aperture of control drainage tube to reached the effect of adjusting drainage rate, the personnel of being convenient for use.

title_en: Portable chest tube clamp
abstract_en: The utility model provides a portable chest tube clamp, which relates to the technical field of medical equipment and comprises a lower clamp body, wherein an upper clamp body is hinged above the lower clamp body, grooves are formed in the lower clamp body and the upper clamp body, mounting blocks are mounted on one sides of the lower clamp body and the upper clamp body, a fixing groove is formed in the mounting block on one side of the lower clamp body in a penetrating manner, a fixing mechanism is arranged above the mounting block on one side of the upper clamp body, and a limiting mechanism is arranged in the lower clamp body and the upper clamp body; through being provided with fixed establishment in the top of installation piece, utilize fixed establishment's installation cavity, commentaries on classics cover, threaded rod, fixed block, limiting plate, runner, driving gear, transmission tooth, stopper and spacing groove between mutually supporting, can carry out fixed processing to lower clamp body and last clamp body for lower clamp body is inseparabler at the clamp body when using, is difficult for droing, thereby has improved the practicality of this chest pipe clamp when using greatly.

title_en: Rehabilitation training instrument
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rehabilitation training instrument which comprises a first training module, wherein the first training module comprises a first training plate and first balls, the first training plate is provided with a first training area for the first balls to roll, and a route recording device for recording the rolling route of the first balls is arranged in the first training area. The first training module is held by the hand of the brain aging patient, the first ball can be controlled to roll or keep the first ball motionless in the first training area according to a certain route, and the motion balance capacity of the brain aging patient can be exercised by combining certain training actions. The route recording device can record the rolling route of the first ball, so that a professional can judge the illness state of the brain aging patient according to the rolling route and correspondingly adjust the rehabilitation improvement training scheme of the brain aging patient.

title_en: Postpartum drainage device placement structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a placement structure of a postpartum drainage device, which comprises a bed plate, wherein a plurality of struts are fixedly connected to the bottom of the bed plate, an L-shaped plate is fixedly connected to the bottom of the bed plate, a hollow plate is movably connected to the top of the long side of the L-shaped plate, a positioning mechanism is arranged on the right side of the hollow plate, a placement plate is arranged on the top of the hollow plate, a U-shaped protection plate is fixedly connected to the top of the placement plate, when the postpartum drainage device needs to be placed, the placement plate is moved to the left side of the bottom of the bed plate, then the postpartum drainage device can be directly placed on the top surface of the placement plate, the protection operation is carried out on the postpartum drainage device through the U-shaped protection plate on the top surface of the placement plate, the placement plate is reset to the position close to the bottom of the bed plate, the positioning operation is carried out on the placement plate and the hollow plate through the arrangement of a clamping block and the clamping groove, so that the postpartum drainage device on the placement plate is prevented from shaking, and the postpartum drainage device on the placement plate is further prevented from sliding.

title_en: Movable infusion support with heat preservation function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a movable infusion support with a heat preservation function, which comprises a support plate, a first telescopic rod, a second telescopic rod and a heat preservation protection component, wherein the telescopic end of the first telescopic rod is arranged at the center of the bottom of the support plate, the second telescopic rod is arranged at two sides of the upper part of the support plate, the second telescopic rod is symmetrically arranged, the heat preservation protection component is arranged at the upper part of the second telescopic rod, and the heat preservation protection component comprises a connecting plate, a heat preservation main body, a limiting adhesive tape, a connecting rod, a connecting block and a protective cover. The utility model belongs to the technical field of medical equipment, and particularly relates to a movable infusion support with a heat preservation function, which is used for heating and preserving heat for an infusion bottle when a patient infuses, is convenient for adjusting the supporting height of hands, is used for fixing the infusion bottle in a clamping and placing mode, and is used for avoiding collision caused by shaking of the infusion bottle when the patient walks, and is used for heating and preserving heat for the infusion bottle when an internal electric heating plate is in contact with the infusion bottle.

title_en: Massage chair massage structure convenient to adjust
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a massage chair massage structure convenient to adjust, which comprises a box body, wherein an adjusting mechanism is arranged in the box body, the adjusting mechanism is provided with a massage mechanism, the adjusting mechanism comprises a rotating rod, the rotating rod is rotatably connected in the box body, a positive thread and a negative thread are arranged on the rotating rod, a limiting sliding groove is formed in the box body, a sliding block is arranged in the limiting sliding groove in a sliding mode, and the sliding block is in threaded connection with the rotating rod. The utility model has the advantages that the adjusting mechanism is arranged, the purpose of adjusting the distance between the massaging mechanisms at two sides is achieved, and the massage service for the lower leg parts of customers with different body types is facilitated. The utility model has the advantages that the massage mechanism is arranged, the purpose of massaging the lower leg of the customer is achieved, the muscle relaxation of the customer is facilitated, the joints are flexible, the spirit of the customer is inspired, and the fatigue is eliminated.

title_en: Rotary joint structure and snore relieving pillow
abstract_en: The utility model provides a rotary joint structure and a snore relieving pillow, and relates to the technical field of medical care. The rotary joint structure is arranged in a supporting part, the supporting part is used for supporting at least part of a body, and the rotary joint structure is arranged between the control box and the air bag component. Wherein the swivel structure is configured to be rotatable relative to the support for adjusting an included angle between an outlet direction of the swivel structure relative to the body central axis. The rotary joint structure is not fixedly arranged relative to the supporting part but movably arranged so as to movably adjust the relative position of the leading-out end of the rotary joint structure. When the leading-out end of the rotary joint structure is led out from the direction vertical to the bed head, a certain interval can exist between the leading-out end and the bed head; when the leading-out end of the rotary joint structure is led out from the direction parallel to the bed head, interference with the bed head is avoided, and the whole occupied space is reduced, so that various use requirements of users are met.

title_en: Head massager with electric stimulation function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of massage equipment and discloses a head massager with an electric stimulation function, which comprises a head hoop, wherein a fixing ring is arranged at the rear side of the head hoop, an organ protection cover is symmetrically and fixedly connected to two ends of the fixing ring, a fixing plate is fixedly connected to the tail end of the organ protection cover, a sponge layer is fixedly connected to the inner side of the head hoop, a massage component is arranged on the sponge layer, the massage component comprises a plurality of massage electrode plates, the massage electrode plates are respectively fixed on the sponge layer and the fixing ring, a U-shaped guide rail is fixedly connected to the interior of the head hoop, steering gears are symmetrically and fixedly connected to the U-shaped guide rail, a mounting plate is fixedly connected to the output end of the steering gears, and a plurality of massage heads are fixedly connected to the surface of the mounting plate; according to the utility model, by designing the massage assembly, when the head is massaged, the head can be massaged by adopting two modes of electric stimulation massage and physical massage, so that the massage effect of the head is improved to a certain extent.

title_en: Anti-falling sampling tube
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of sampling pipes and discloses an anti-falling sampling pipe, which comprises a placing plate, wherein the top of the placing plate is fixedly connected with a protection pipe, the inside of the protection pipe is fixedly connected with a hollow threaded column, the inner bottom wall of the protection pipe is fixedly connected with a telescopic rod, the surface of the telescopic rod is sleeved with a spring, one end of the telescopic rod is fixedly connected with a rubber column, the surface of the hollow threaded column is in threaded connection with a connecting column, and the top of the connecting column is fixedly connected with a cylinder. This anti-drop's sampling tube, through the setting of protection tube, hollow screw thread post, telescopic link, spring and rubber column, played the vibrations that can reduce to drop the back and produce, put into hollow screw thread post at first with the sampling tube, make its bottom contact the rubber column, turn into hollow screw thread post with the spliced pole again, make the bottle lid contact the cushion, be favorable to the protection to the sampling tube, improved the effect of preventing falling, reduced the emergence that the sampling tube damaged.

title_en: Transesophageal heart ultrasonic inspection probe providing visual operation
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of heart ultrasound, and discloses a transesophageal heart ultrasound examination probe for providing visual operation, which comprises a detection shell, wherein a baffle is fixedly connected inside the detection shell, a detection structure is arranged inside the detection shell, and a visual structure is arranged inside the detection structure. According to the utility model, the traditional transesophageal heart ultrasonic inspection probe for visual operation completely needs manual operation by a doctor when the probe is put in or taken out, and the probe cannot provide a clear visual field to influence the detection result.

title_en: Adjustable brake pillow capable of preventing head from being damaged by pressure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an adjustable brake pillow capable of preventing pressure from damaging a head, which comprises a surrounding pad, a bottom pad and neck support pads, wherein the surrounding pad is wound at the rear end and the left side and the right side of the bottom pad, the neck support pads are detachably adhered to the middle upper part of the bottom pad and divide the bottom pad into a headrest part and a shoulder back pillow part, and contraction pieces are respectively arranged on the periphery of the surrounding pad and the inner periphery of the surrounding pad; the diameter of the enclosing pad is adjusted through the contraction piece so as to adapt to the head of a patient, thereby ensuring that the head of the patient is braked in the median lying position and preventing the head of the patient from being damaged by pressure.

title_en: Outpatient service waits seat
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an outpatient waiting seat which comprises a fixing frame, a supporting plate and supporting frames, wherein the supporting plate is arranged at the top of the fixing frame, a group of supporting frames are arranged at the top of the supporting plate, and a motor is arranged in the middle of the top of the fixing frame. According to the utility model, the motor drives the first gear to rotate, the first gear can drive the two second gears to rotate simultaneously, the second gear can drive the transmission rod and the third gear to rotate, the third gear can drive the fourth gear to rotate, and further, the motor can drive the two fourth gears and the threaded rod to rotate simultaneously, and further, the position of the fixing plate in the through groove can be adjusted, the stability of the movement of the fixing plate can be improved through the arrangement of the second sliding groove, the second sliding block and the second cross rod, when the fixing plate moves to the lower part in the through groove, the roller can contact the ground and jack up the seat, and at the moment, the family of a patient can drive the patient with inconvenient legs and feet to move by pushing the waiting seat.

title_en: Orthopedics traction adjusting bracket
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of traction adjusting brackets, and discloses an orthopedic traction adjusting bracket which comprises a fixed base, wherein a first placing groove is formed in the center of the outer wall of the front end of the fixed base, a first threaded rod is connected with the center of the front end of the lower surface of the fixed base in a threaded manner, a first clamping block is connected to the upper surface of the first threaded rod in a rotating manner, a supporting rod is fixedly connected to the center of the rear end of the upper surface of the fixed base, and a telescopic rod is clamped and matched with the center of the upper surface of the supporting rod.

title_en: Slide rail type medical isolation cloth curtain
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of medical curtains, in particular to a sliding rail type medical isolation curtain which comprises two supporting rods, wherein a shielding mechanism is arranged between the two supporting rods, and the shielding mechanism is provided with a fixing mechanism in a matched manner. According to the utility model, the plurality of support plates are mutually rotated to be adjusted, then the two support plates are placed on the ground to fix the positions of the plurality of support plates by virtue of the base, the plurality of support plates synchronously deform along with the plurality of support plates by virtue of the limiting ring belt driving rubber ropes and the connecting ropes, and then a user can pull the shielding cloth to slide along the connecting ropes to form shielding, so that the shielding cloth curtain is convenient to carry and move by the user, deformation is carried out according to the needs of the user, the shielding cloth bottom at any part can be plugged into the rubber frame by the user when the user needs to observe or monitor the condition of the patient, and then the clamping rods and the shielding cloth are plugged into adjacent jacks, so that the condition of the patient can be monitored and observed conveniently through gaps.

title_en: Intraocular lens and lens structure
abstract_en: The utility model provides an artificial lens and a lens structure, which comprises an optical part and also comprises a pair of fixing holes, wherein the pair of fixing holes comprises two fixing holes, the two fixing holes in the pair of fixing holes are arranged at intervals, and the fixing holes penetrate through the optical part; the number of the fixing hole pairs is at least two, and the at least two fixing hole pairs are arranged in an axisymmetric way by taking a preset axis as a symmetry axis. The utility model relates to an artificial lens and a lens structure, which solve the technical problem of high operation difficulty in the operation of implanting the artificial lens in the related technology.

title_en: A fixed subsides for central venous catheter
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of catheter fixing patches, in particular to a fixing patch for a central venous catheter, which comprises a plastic elastic sheet, wherein a circular hole is formed in the center of the top surface of the plastic elastic sheet, and a pipe clamping mechanism is arranged on the top surface of the plastic elastic sheet in a matched manner. According to the utility model, the guide pipe passes through the space between the limit frame and the plastic elastic sheet, the cutting seam is opened by the light-weight plastic elastic sheet, the guide pipe passes through the cutting seam and is clamped into the circular hole, the plastic elastic strip passes through the clamping hole, the circle formed by the plastic elastic sheet clamps the guide pipe to adhere the outer side wall of the guide pipe to the connecting pipe adhesive tape, the clamping groove on the plastic elastic strip is clamped at the clamping hole, the plastic elastic strip and the plastic elastic sheet are straightened and then are adhered to the two sides of the cutting seam on the plastic elastic sheet by the adhesive tape, the rubber belt is cut to a proper length and then surrounds the thigh of a patient, and the fixing adhesive tape is used to enable the rubber belt to be connected end to clamp the thigh, so that the skin ventilation of the patient is facilitated, the fixing effect on the guide pipe is improved, and the detachment is facilitated.

title_en: Baby sleeping apparatus with swinging structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an infant sleeping device with a swinging and shaking structure, which comprises a swing arm assembly and an inner assembly, wherein the swing arm assembly is arranged in a sleeping device main body, the swing arm assembly comprises a motor arranged on one side of a middle frame of the sleeping device, a rotating wheel is arranged on the other side of the middle frame, a rotating shaft is arranged in the middle of the rotating wheel, a swinging block for driving the sleeping device main body to swing is arranged on the rotating shaft, one end of the motor penetrates through the middle frame and is connected with the rotating wheel through a transmission belt, and the inner assembly comprises a control module connected with a power management module, and the control module is connected with the motor and a microphone for collecting external sound. The utility model solves the problems that the sleeping device in the prior art does not have a shaking function and can not change the working mode according to external sound.

title_en: Grinding device for false tooth
abstract_en: The utility model provides a polishing device for false teeth, which relates to the technical field of false tooth polishing and comprises a processing table, a first motor and an ash suction box; the processing table is arranged on the lower machine body, the bottom of the lower machine body is provided with a base, the upper part of the lower machine body is provided with a collecting chamber, a groove is formed in the processing table, a screw rod is movably arranged in the center of the groove in a rotating mode, a first motor is movably arranged on the screw rod, and an ash suction box is arranged right in front of the first motor; the collecting chamber is internally provided with a push plate which moves left and right, the right part of the lower machine body is provided with a plurality of groups of multi-section telescopic cylinders, the front ends of the multi-section telescopic cylinders are fixed at the rear side of the push plate, and the push plate is sleeved with a rubber sleeve. The utility model is convenient to place the polishing structure on the lower polishing table, can flexibly move the polishing position back and forth, not only is convenient to suck fly ash flying in the air, but also is convenient to clean ash residue on the polishing table, and simultaneously can regularly and rapidly push out the collected ash residue, thereby being convenient to use and saving trouble.

title_en: Device for heart ultrasonic examination
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a device for heart ultrasonic examination, which belongs to the field of devices for heart ultrasonic examination, and comprises a support, wherein the upper end of the support is connected with an examination device body, one end of the examination device body is connected with a cleaning device for cleaning a detection head, the cleaning device is connected with the upper end of the support, the effect of automatically cleaning the detection head can be realized, meanwhile, a cleaning box which is arranged at the lower end of a shell in a sliding way can collect cleaned dirt uniformly, and the first connecting rod, a rotating disc, a second connecting rod, a first sliding block, a second sliding block and a movable column are mutually matched, so that the effect of reciprocating motion of the movable column can be achieved, and the problem that a medical staff is required to manually clean after the detection is finished, so that the detection time can be wasted is solved.

title_en: Tracheal cannula patient head nursing support frame
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a head nursing support frame for a patient with trachea cannula, which relates to the technical field of medical nursing equipment, in particular to a head nursing support frame for a patient with trachea cannula, comprising a first shell and a second shell which are mutually hinged, wherein the whole of the first shell and the second shell is in a curved surface shape, and soft cushions for pillow the head of the patient are arranged on the curved surfaces of the first shell and the second shell; through set up two first supporting component, second supporting component respectively on articulated first casing, the second casing each other, utilize two first supporting component to support fixed breathing machine pipelines of centre gripping, trachea cannula respectively, utilize the second supporting component to support fixed stomach tube of centre gripping, reached the purpose of supporting fixed breathing machine pipelines, trachea cannula, stomach tube, can effectively avoid pipeline weight direct application to patient's face, avoid the pipeline to clear up work difficulty because of unable fixed oral cavity that leads to.

title_en: Sports backpack with cervical vertebra massaging function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of backpack, and discloses a sports backpack with a cervical vertebra massaging function, which comprises the following components: the backpack comprises a backpack body, wherein the inside of the backpack body is in sliding connection with the side face of a sliding plate, the inside of the backpack body is fixedly connected with the side face of a serration plate, the tooth slot of the serration plate is connected with one side of a clamping block in a clamping mode, the side face of the clamping block is fixedly connected with one end of a tight spring, the other end of the tight spring is fixedly connected with the inside of the sliding plate, and the backpack with the cervical vertebra massaging function can adjust the height position of the electric massaging plate through a push column when the backpack is used, so that the massaging position of the electric massaging plate can adapt to the heights of different users, and the massaging position of the electric massaging plate can be changed through rotating the electric massaging plate so that the electric massaging plate can adapt to the use habits of different backpack users.

title_en: Intelligent storage cabinet with digital management of medical supplies for pet hospitals
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of intelligent storage cabinets, in particular to an intelligent storage cabinet for a pet hospital, which comprises a cabinet body, wherein a plurality of groups of laminates used for placing medical supplies are arranged on the inner side of the cabinet body along the vertical direction, a lifting plate is vertically and slidingly connected to the side surface of the cabinet body, a sliding seat is arranged at the bottom of the lifting plate, limiting strips used for sliding connection of the sliding seats are arranged at the bottoms of the lifting plate and the plurality of groups of laminates, a driving assembly is arranged at the bottom of the sliding seat and used for driving the sliding seat to linearly slide along the limiting strips, a scanner is arranged at the bottom of the sliding seat and used for carrying out information scanning on materials, and an SPD (serial number display) used for recording the scanning of the scanner is arranged on a cabinet door in a hospital warehouse or an operating room.

title_en: Livestock breeding frame
