abstract_en: The utility model discloses a livestock breeding frame, wherein the rear part of the upper end of a base is movably connected with a hollow table through a first pin shaft, and a support column at the lower end of the front part of the table is movably connected with a movable seat; the upper end of the horizontal seat is provided with a sliding seat with a lower back and a higher front, a chute for sliding the moving block is arranged in the sliding seat, and the limiting clamping groove is used for clamping a clamping protrusion at the rear part of the lower end of the moving block; when the movable seat moves upwards along the screw rod, the movable block is driven to move forwards along the chute, and teeth at the top of the movable block are meshed with gears fixed between two groups of support columns, so that the bottom of the front end of the table is supported; the teeth at the top of the moving block are meshed with the fixed gears between the two groups of support columns, so that the bottom of the front end of the table is supported, the weight of the breeding pigs is prevented from being transferred to the screw rod through the support columns and the moving seat, and the screw rod is prevented from bending deformation; the adjustment of the rear end height of the table is simple and quick, and the pig breeding table meets the requirement that the pigs with different body shapes lie prone on the table.

title_en: Pneumatic massage back cushion
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of back cushions, in particular to a pneumatic massage back cushion, which comprises a back cushion body, a back plate, a thickness adjusting air bag and a massage air bag; the back plate is arranged inside the back cushion body; the thickness adjusting air bag is arranged in the back cushion body and is positioned on the front side of the back plate, and the thickness of the back cushion body is adjusted through expansion or contraction; the pneumatic massage cushion can solve the problem that the cushion in the prior art can not adjust the cushion thickness according to the waist shape and sitting posture of a user so as to realize the back following function, thereby protecting the lumbar vertebrae of the user with different waist shapes and sitting postures and relieving the fatigue of the user.

title_en: Intelligent sterilizing cabinet with adjustable capacity
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of sterilization equipment, and discloses an intelligent sterilization cabinet with adjustable capacity, which comprises an upper cabinet body and a lower cabinet body, wherein the upper cabinet body is connected to the inner side wall of the lower cabinet body in a sliding manner, a refrigerating chamber is arranged at the inner bottom end of the lower cabinet body, ultraviolet lamp tubes are arranged on the symmetrical inner side walls of the two sides of the upper cabinet body, fixing plates are connected to the symmetrical outer side walls of the two sides of the lower cabinet body, screw rods are connected to the upper ends of the fixing plates in a rotating manner, the two screw rods are connected through belt pulley transmission, a rotating assembly for driving the screw rods to rotate is arranged on the fixing plates, and driving plates are connected to the symmetrical outer side walls of the two sides of the upper cabinet body. According to the technical scheme, the upper cabinet body, the lower cabinet body, the refrigerating chamber, the ultraviolet lamp tube, the fixing plate, the screw rod, the belt pulley, the driving plate, the first motor and other structures are arranged to be matched with each other, so that the distance between the upper cabinet body and the lower cabinet body can be automatically adjusted, the capacity is adjusted, and the device is simple and convenient to operate, and accordingly the applicability of the device is improved.

title_en: Obstetrical nursing pad
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of medical nursing, in particular to an obstetrical nursing pad. The technical scheme includes that the liquid-absorbing and water-absorbing device comprises a surface layer, a reverse osmosis layer positioned on the lower side of the surface layer, and a water-absorbing layer positioned on the lower side of the reverse osmosis layer and used for absorbing liquid; a supporting layer for supporting the water absorbing layer is fixed at the bottom of the water absorbing layer; the lower surface of the surface layer is provided with a sealing layer which is used for coating the reverse osmosis layer, the supporting layer and the water absorption layer; and an eduction tube is arranged on the sealing layer. According to the utility model, the water absorption layer can permeate downwards when reaching the adsorption limit through the through holes, the liquid is positioned at the bottom of the sealing layer through the through grooves and is gathered towards the middle through the through grooves, and finally the liquid is discharged through the eduction tube, so that the bedding is prevented from being wetted when reaching the adsorption limit.

title_en: Intelligent walking stick detection device for assisting human body movement
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent walking stick detection device for assisting human body movement, which comprises a walking stick and an electromyographic signal detection device; the bottom end of the walking stick is provided with a pressure detection device; the walking stick is also provided with a control box through a connecting sleeve, a gyroscope and a storage module are arranged in the control box, and the pressure detection device and the gyroscope are electrically connected with the storage module; the myoelectric signal detection device comprises a myoelectric sensor bushing, and a plurality of myoelectric signal collectors are arranged on the inner side of the myoelectric sensor bushing. Aiming at the crowd needing walking assistance by the walking stick, the utility model collects the muscle activity state of the leg, the movement gesture of the walking stick and the change of the pressure of the bottom of the walking stick along with the rehabilitation stage when the walking stick is used, the collected data can be analyzed by related professionals, the data support is provided for the rehabilitation state, the rehabilitation condition of a user can be conveniently obtained, and meanwhile, a doctor can conveniently formulate the rehabilitation scheme of the next stage of the user.

title_en: Safety locking type shifting vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model provides a safe locking type shifting vehicle which comprises an H-shaped frame, a base arranged at the bottom end of the frame, a left seat and a right seat which are respectively and rotatably arranged at two sides of the top end of the frame, wherein the left seat and the right seat are combined into a bearing structure for bearing a patient, supporting sleeves are respectively vertically arranged at two ends of the frame, supporting rods are arranged in the supporting sleeves in a penetrating manner, sleeves are respectively vertically arranged at the side parts of the left seat and the right seat, the two sleeves are respectively and rotatably sleeved at the outer sides of the supporting rods, the bottom ends of the sleeves are rotatably arranged at the inner sides of the supporting sleeves, and locking assemblies for locking the sleeves are arranged at the side parts of the supporting sleeves in a penetrating manner. According to the safe locking type shifting provided by the utility model, the locking component is arranged between the bearing structure and the supporting sleeve of the supporting frame, the connecting component is arranged at the rear side of the shifting vehicle, and the rotation of the sleeve is avoided through the cooperation of the locking component and the connecting component, so that the combination of the left seat and the right seat is firmer, and the shifting vehicle is safer to use.

title_en: Medicine granulator
abstract_en: The utility model provides a drug granulator, which relates to the technical field of drug granulation and comprises a conveying belt, wherein a granulating assembly is fixedly connected to the position, close to the left, of the upper surface of the conveying belt, and a drying assembly is fixedly connected to the position, close to the right, of the upper surface of the conveying belt; the drying assembly comprises a drying frame, and notches are symmetrically formed in the upper surface of the drying frame. According to the utility model, the motor, the processing barrel, the feed hopper, the first rotating shaft, the auger blade, the second rotating shaft, the granule outlet and the cutting knife are matched for use, so that the drug raw material can be granulated, and meanwhile, the conveyer belt, the drying frame, the notch, the heating pipe, the mounting frame, the protective net, the mounting frame and the fan are matched for use, so that the drug particles are dried, the agglomeration is avoided, the granulation and drying of the drug are integrated, the time for transferring materials and adjusting equipment is saved, and the production efficiency is improved.

title_en: Auxiliary inspection device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of medical auxiliary instruments, and discloses an auxiliary examination device which comprises a supporting mechanism, a lower limb mechanism and an illumination mechanism, wherein the lower limb mechanism is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the supporting mechanism, and the illumination mechanism is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the supporting mechanism. This supplementary inspection device, be different from the inspection bed, leg part adjustment mechanism and foot adjustment mechanism have been adopted, the effect through flexible pillar is with patient's shank adjustment to the height of suitable inspection, be equipped with the swivel bead in addition at the foot, the dwang is under the effect of swivel bead, rotate it in different directions and angle, thereby adjust to suitable inspection posture, and be equipped with lighting device, can conveniently see patient's sick private department clearly through the operation light, flexible pole stretches out and draws back in addition is favorable to adjusting its observation distance, and under the rotation of lamp swivel bead, adjust the different angles and the direction of illumination, make things convenient for medical staff to inspect patient's actual conditions.

title_en: Air purifying device for vegetable greenhouse
abstract_en: An air purifying device for a vegetable greenhouse belongs to the technical field of vegetable greenhouse planting. Including purifying mechanism (3), its characterized in that: the purifying device is provided with a track (1), and the purifying mechanism (3) reciprocates along the track (1) while swinging reciprocally; the purification mechanism (3) comprises a fan (6), and a plasma generator (14) is arranged at an air outlet of the fan (6). In this an air purification device for vegetable greenhouse, be provided with the purification mechanism who follows the track and remove, the purification mechanism reciprocating motion along the track when reciprocating the swing has reduced use cost when realizing the whole cover in the warmhouse booth. In this an air purification device for vegetable greenhouse, be provided with limit switch respectively in the swing orbit both sides of trigger lever, trigger it when the trigger lever swings to one of them limit switch department, swing motor reverse rotation this moment has realized dryer and fan at the reciprocal swing of swing frame.

title_en: Electrocardiogram auxiliary cap
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electrocardiogram auxiliary cap, which comprises a connecting sleeve and two auxiliary traction absorbing balls, wherein the connecting sleeve is sheathed with the electrocardiogram electrode absorbing balls, a traction wire is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the connecting sleeve, and a wire collector is arranged in the middle of the auxiliary traction absorbing balls.

title_en: Efficient nucleic acid detection device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a high-efficiency nucleic acid detection device, which belongs to the technical field of nucleic acid detection equipment and comprises a placement table, wherein one end of the placement table is provided with a feeding component, the other end of the placement table is provided with a disinfection component, the placement table is provided with a sliding groove, a storage rack is connected in the sliding groove in a sliding manner, the storage rack is provided with a groove, disinfectant is placed in the disinfectant component, a throat swab is placed in the feeding component, a test tube is placed in the groove of the storage rack, and the nucleic acid detection device is used for restraining nucleic acid acquisition articles.

title_en: Unpowered dosing device with controllable dosing amount and siphon effect
abstract_en: The utility model provides an unpowered dosing device with controllable dosing amount and siphon effect, which comprises a dosing tank, PCL, a dosing pump, a flowmeter FT, a low-point user, a regulating valve, a first check valve and a second check valve, wherein a cover is contacted with the dosing tank, a limit frame is connected onto the cover in a sliding manner, a fixed block is fixedly connected onto the cover, a threaded rod is connected onto the limit frame through a bearing, and the threaded rod is connected with the cover through threads. According to the utility model, the dosing pump is controlled to dose through the PCL, and the flow meter FT is arranged, so that the dosing pump can be controlled to stop dosing through the flow rate, and the opening degree can be automatically controlled according to the dosing amount set by a low-point user through the regulating valve, so that the dosing amount is suitable, the dosing tank is more convenient and rapid to process, the dosing pump provides initial power, and the medicine in the dosing tank is automatically added by utilizing the siphon principle, so that the effects of energy conservation and emission reduction are realized.

title_en: Medical movable auxiliary vehicle for getting off bed
abstract_en: The application relates to a medical movable auxiliary vehicle for getting out of bed, which relates to the technical field of auxiliary vehicles and comprises a seat, wherein two sides of the seat are respectively provided with a supporting rod, the seat is arranged on the supporting rods, one side of each supporting rod is provided with an auxiliary rod, the supporting rods and the auxiliary rods are respectively provided with a moving assembly, and meanwhile, a damping assembly is arranged between each supporting rod and each auxiliary rod and is connected with the supporting rods and the auxiliary rods; the infusion hook is arranged on the support rod, a lifting assembly is arranged between the infusion hook and the support rod, and the infusion hook is lifted on the support rod through the lifting assembly; the seat is provided with a protection component, and the protection component protects a patient. The application can prevent the patient from accidentally falling down in the process of moving out of bed, so that the patient can have better protection effect in the process of moving out of bed, and the safety of the patient in the process of walking is ensured.

title_en: All-terrain self-adaptive spraying disinfection trolley
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an all-terrain self-adaptive spraying and sterilizing trolley which comprises a trolley running mechanism, a spraying and sterilizing device and a control system. The planetary gear train is matched with the crawler travelling mechanism to serve as a trolley travelling mechanism, the trolley travelling mechanism can pass under various terrains such as a corridor, a steep slope, a rugged ground and the like, a braking device is arranged on the outer side of the planetary gear train, and a steering engine is used for driving a crank connecting rod mechanism. The connection part of the spray rod and the bracket in the spray disinfection device adopts a ball hinge, the tail part of the spray rod is connected with a movable rod in the electric push rod through a pin shaft, so that the spray rod becomes a high-freedom-degree component, and the spray rod is matched with a porous spray head at the head part of the spray rod to realize omnibearing three-dimensional spray of disinfection solution. The control system adopts control elements such as a tracking sensor, an ultrasonic ranging sensor and the like, so that the trolley can accurately run along a specified line. The utility model solves the problems of low efficiency, potential safety hazard, insufficient traffic capacity, limited coverage range and the like in the traditional manual disinfection mode.

title_en: Dual-purpose traction fixing device for wrist and ankle joint
abstract_en: The utility model provides a dual-purpose traction fixing device for a wrist joint and an ankle joint, and relates to the technical field of medical appliances. The device comprises a device fixing assembly, an adjusting assembly and a limb fixing assembly, wherein the device fixing assembly is connected to an external bearing object, the adjusting assembly is movably connected with the device fixing assembly and the limb fixing assembly respectively, the adjusting assembly can adjust the relative position and the relative angle of the limb fixing assembly in space, the limb fixing assembly is fixed with the limb of a patient, the wrist and ankle joint dual-purpose traction fixing device is used for realizing the overall fixation and adjustment of the device through the device fixing assembly, the adjustment of the relative position and the relative angle of the limb fixing assembly in space is realized through the adjusting assembly, the flexible adjustment of a plurality of degrees of freedom is realized, the aim of adjusting the height and the angle of the limb of the patient is fulfilled, the most suitable state is achieved, the follow-up operation is facilitated, the whole structure of the device is simpler, the operation is quick, the device is firm and reliable, and the operation efficiency is improved.

title_en: Hemodialysis pipeline fixation clamp capable of avoiding bending
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of medical auxiliary instruments, in particular to a hemodialysis pipeline fixing clamp capable of avoiding bending, which comprises a dialysis hose and a hinging assembly, wherein the hinging assembly is composed of a plurality of groups of hinging components and a rotating hinging seat, the bottoms of the hinging components positioned at the middle positions are connected with concave clamping plates through connecting rods, the bottoms of the concave clamping plates are connected with locking screws, the top of the rotating hinging seat is provided with a fixing bottom plate, and the left side and the right side of the top of the fixing bottom plate are both provided with fixing bending plates.

title_en: Tooth-flushing device with active oxygen water
abstract_en: The utility model provides a tooth-flushing device with active oxygen water, and relates to the technical field of oral care. A dental irrigator with active oxygen water comprising: a housing; the separating piece is arranged in the shell, the inner cavity of the shell is separated by the separating piece to form a first containing cavity and a second containing cavity, a first pipeline and a second pipeline are arranged on one side, facing the second containing cavity, of the separating piece, and a connecting circuit is arranged in the second pipeline; the water pump is arranged in the first containing cavity and is connected with the first pipeline; the electric control module is arranged in the first accommodating cavity and is electrically connected with the water pump; and the active oxygen water generator is arranged in the second containing cavity and is electrically connected with the electric control module through a connecting circuit. The electronic control module controls the opening and closing and the opening time of the active oxygen water generator, and can prepare the water stored in the second containing cavity into the active oxygen water with preset concentration. The concentration of the active oxygen water can be effectively controlled, and the condition that the active oxygen concentration is too high or too low does not occur.

title_en: Disposable lacrimal passage drainage tube
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of medical supplies, in particular to a disposable lacrimal passage drainage tube. Comprising the following steps: the guide wires are provided with two guide wires; the guide wire tubes are respectively and movably sleeved on the guide wires; a silicone tube comprising: a small diameter portion, an enlarged anti-drop portion, and a large diameter portion; the two ends of the small diameter part are connected with the expansion anti-drop part in an integrated manner respectively, the other ends of the expansion anti-drop parts are connected with the large diameter part in an integrated manner respectively, and the other ends of the large diameter parts are connected with the guide wires respectively. The silicone tube can be positioned and blocked at the joint of the lacrimal sac and the lacrimal manifold through the expansion anti-drop part, and the positioning anti-drop function of the silicone tube can be completed without knotting the two ends of the silicone tube, so that the silicone tube is convenient and quick to operate, high in postoperative comfort level, convenient and safe to take out, reasonable in design, economical and effective, and suitable for blocking or narrowing the lacrimal passage at any position and breaking the traumatic lacrimal canaliculus.

title_en: Needle cylinder support for needle cylinder gravity instillation nasal feeding
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a needle cylinder support for needle cylinder gravity instillation nasal feeding, which comprises a clamp and a support rod, wherein the support rod comprises a vertical rod and a cross rod, the vertical rod is connected to the clamp, the cross rod is connected to a lantern ring, the cross rod and the vertical rod are mutually perpendicular, the vertical rod and the cross rod are respectively arranged in a telescopic way, two fixing blocks are arranged on two sides of a slot, the fixing blocks are arranged to protrude to the outer side of the lantern ring, an adjusting rope is arranged on the fixing blocks, one end of the adjusting rope is fixed on one fixing block, and the other end of the adjusting rope is movably arranged. The utility model can fix the injector needle cylinder without the push rod piston at a high position, so that nutrient solution or milk in the needle cylinder can be smoothly instilled into the stomach of the infant, the hand-held needle cylinder is not required to wait for instillation to be exhausted, the time and the labor are saved, and the working intensity of medical staff is lightened.

title_en: Body position restraint device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of auxiliary medical equipment, in particular to a body position restraining device which comprises a bed body, wherein the tops of the front side and the rear side of the bed body are respectively connected with a guardrail, the left side and the right side of the bed body are respectively provided with a sliding groove, the left side and the right side of the top of the bed body are respectively provided with a sliding rail, the tops of the left side and the right side of the sliding rails are respectively connected with three groups of moving blocks in a sliding manner, restraining components are arranged on the moving blocks on the front side and the rear side, a first fixing belt is arranged on the moving block in the middle of the left side, and a second fixing belt is arranged on the moving block in the middle of the right side.

title_en: Medical bed
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a medical bed, comprising: the medical bed provided by the utility model has the advantages that the supporting legs are arranged under the mutual matching of the guide rails, the first connecting arms, the second connecting arms, the third connecting arms and the pulleys, so that the distance between the supporting legs at the two ends of the bed frame after the supporting legs are completely folded and completely unfolded is unchanged, the lifting of the bed frame is smooth and stable in the process of folding and unfolding by using the first electric push rod to drive the supporting legs, the performance is good, namely, the medical bed is integrally designed by adopting a plate+connecting rod+electric push rod adjusting structure, the shoulder and back supporting plate and the lower leg supporting plate adjusting process is smooth and comfortable, and good experience can be brought to patients.

title_en: Vitiligo skin wound dressing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a vitiligo skin wound dressing which comprises release paper, an adhesive layer, a supporting layer, a medicine bag, a sunshade film, a first connecting mechanism and a second connecting mechanism, wherein the release paper is positioned below the adhesive layer, the adhesive layer is positioned below the supporting layer, a notch is arranged on the adhesive layer, the medicine bag is positioned in the notch, the supporting layer is positioned below the sunshade film, and the first connecting mechanism and the second connecting mechanism are respectively positioned on two opposite sides of the supporting layer. The sun-shading film reflects sunlight, prevents skin from sunburn at the place with vitiligo, does not aggravate the load of melanocytes, and is beneficial to melanin formation. The utility model is provided with the first connecting mechanism and the second connecting mechanism, and a plurality of the vitiligo skin wound dressing are connected in sequence, so that the vitiligo can be completely covered, the treatment effect is improved, the waste is prevented, and the cost is reduced.

title_en: Automatic sputum aspirator device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of medical instruments, in particular to an automatic sputum aspirator device, which comprises a sputum aspirator body and a moving assembly arranged on the surface of the sputum aspirator body, wherein the moving assembly comprises a supporting plate arranged on the surface of the sputum aspirator body, the moving assembly is arranged on the device, a user aligns a sputum suction nozzle at one end of a sputum suction tube with an air tube through the moving assembly, at the moment, a rotating rod rotates to enable the rotating rod to retract and release a pull rope, thereby driving the sputum suction tube to retract and release in the air tube without the need of medical staff to manually insert the air tube, retraction and release are carried out in the air tube, the working efficiency of sputum suction of the air tube is improved, and a cleaning assembly is added on the mechanism.

title_en: Rabbit baoding cloth
abstract_en: The utility model discloses rabbit-holding cloth, which comprises a mesh layer, a polyester yarn layer and a waterproof layer which are sequentially arranged, wherein the mesh layer is provided with a rabbit placing area; the two opposite sides of the rabbit placing area are respectively provided with a first fixing area and a second fixing area; the first fixing area is sequentially provided with a first neck fixing band, a first forelimb fixing band and a first hindlimb fixing band along the direction from the rabbit head to the rabbit tail; the second fixing area is sequentially provided with a second neck fixing band, a second forelimb fixing band and a second hindlimb fixing band along the direction from the rabbit head to the rabbit tail; v-shaped gaps are formed between adjacent fixing belts in the same fixing area; the first neck fixing strap and the second neck fixing strap, the first forelimb fixing strap and the second forelimb fixing strap, the first hindlimb fixing strap and the second hindlimb fixing strap are arranged in a pairwise manner, and the two opposite fixing straps are connected through the same locking piece. Through the cooperation of the retaining cloth fixed band and the retaining member that sets up on it, let the rabbit be difficult for struggling, reduce the repeatability of operation, guaranteed the safety of experiment rabbit.

title_en: Heat dissipation massage office chair
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a heat dissipation massage office chair, which comprises: the seat, back and handrail, be connected through the installation axle between seat and the back, be connected through the bolt between handrail and the seat, cooling body sets up in the inside of seat and back, adjustment mechanism is connected handrail and cooling body. The utility model realizes a heat dissipation massage office chair through the mutual coordination among the seat, the backrest, the armrests, the heat dissipation mechanism, the adjusting mechanism and the lifting support legs, and the mesh adjusting plate is driven to move leftwards by rotating the rotary handle and adjusting the rotation of the threaded rod, so that the size of the mesh area on the surface of the mesh plate is adjusted, the air volume perceived by a human body is adjusted, and simultaneously, the wind direction of the heat dissipation fan frame is adjusted under the support of the telescopic rod and the support rod by pulling the heat dissipation frame, so as to adapt to different use requirements of users.

title_en: Nursing radial artery compressor with visual window function
abstract_en: The utility model provides a radial artery compressor with a visual window function, which comprises an extrusion part mechanism, wherein a fixed plate is arranged on the extrusion part mechanism, an integrated pressure control mechanism shell bin is arranged on the fixed plate, a central visual window surface structural member is arranged on the integrated pressure control mechanism shell bin, and a limiting mechanism is arranged at the end part of the side of the integrated pressure control mechanism shell bin. The setting of this device stop gear realizes the oppression force control with integrative accuse pressure mechanism shell storehouse, can greatly reduced in the in-process of placing or removing radial artery compressor damage radial artery or its branch vessel, adopts the magnifying glass visualization that center window face structure is used for realizing hemostatic position, makes things convenient for medical personnel to watch the vascular situation of periodic detection hemostatic position, and the early discovery of being convenient for any abnormal situation, and whole device has that smooth, oppression force is controllable, comprehensive angles such as oppression time realize radial artery compressor's safe in utilization, avoids its thrombus formation because of compressor use excessively causes.

title_en: Drainage device with flushing function
abstract_en: The utility model provides a drainage device with a flushing function, which comprises a drainage bottle, wherein a supporting seat is arranged at the bottom of the drainage bottle, a cover is arranged at the top of the drainage bottle, a drainage tube is arranged on the surface of the cover, a flushing mechanism is arranged in the middle of the cover, the surface of the cover is also connected with a negative pressure pipe, when the drainage bottle needs to be cleaned, a water supply pipe is communicated with an external water source through the flushing mechanism, cleaning water is conveyed into a connector through the water supply pipe, the water is conveyed into an annular pipe through a plurality of connecting pipes connected with the bottom of the connector, a plurality of flushing nozzles corresponding to the inner wall of the drainage bottle are arranged at the bottom of the annular pipe, water flows from the flushing nozzles along the inner wall of the drainage bottle, the cleaning of the drainage bottle is realized, the inner wall of the drainage device is prevented from being condensed to cause blockage, and a sealing ring is sleeved on the surface of a threaded sleeve, so that the joint has tightness and leakage is prevented.

title_en: Ergonomic face support pillow
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of hair implantation surgical instruments and discloses an ergonomic face support pillow, which comprises a pillow body and a face support body, wherein the pillow body is provided with a mounting groove, the bottom shape of the face support body is matched with the shape of the mounting groove, the face support body is detachably arranged in the mounting groove, the top surface of the face support body is provided with a face groove, the shape of the face groove is matched with the shape of the face of a human body, three support parts are arranged in the face groove, two support parts respectively act on two cheekbones of the face of the human body, and the other support part acts on the mandible of the face of the human body. The face groove is matched with the face groove according to the shape of the face of a human body, so that the face of a patient can be matched with the face groove, the face is supported in a triangular mode through the three supporting parts, a good supporting effect is achieved, a plurality of stress points are achieved, the pain of the face caused by local stress is avoided, the face groove is matched with the shape of the face of the patient, the head of the patient can be prevented from being rotated, and the operation effect is improved.

title_en: Puncture crochet needle capable of simplifying operation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a puncture crochet needle for simplifying operation in the technical field of peritoneal suturing devices, which comprises a puncture trocar and a threading needle; the puncture trocar is a circular needle tube with hollow inside, the threading needle is a strip straight rod, the threading needle can be separated and is slidably arranged in the puncture trocar, a plurality of limit spines are convexly arranged on the convex outer side face of the threading needle, the limit spines can be separated from the positioning holes to be clamped with each other, so that the peritoneal suturing operation in the abdominal cavity is reduced in dependence on doctors, the peritoneal suturing operation can be conveniently completed through the device, the suturing difficulty is low, the operation is simple and convenient, only the incision needing to be sutured is needed to be clamped, the device can be used for puncturing two sides of the peritoneal, the operation time is greatly shortened, the operation efficiency is improved, and the complications and risks of the operation are effectively reduced.

title_en: Animal doctor's oral area device of dosing
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of animal medical treatment, in particular to a veterinary oral administration device, which comprises an administration device shell, and is characterized in that: one end of the outer shell of the drug feeder is provided with a rubber hose for clamping and limiting tablets, the inner part of the outer shell of the drug feeder is connected with a piston in a sliding manner, and one side of the piston is provided with a movable rod for adjusting the piston; can protect doctor's hand through the hemisphere protection casing, simultaneously because the shape of hemisphere protection casing is spherical, and the outside of hemisphere protection casing is comparatively smooth, consequently, when the animal is making the action of interlock, the tooth of animal can slide with the outside of hemisphere protection casing, the tooth does not have the impetus just can not sting the hemisphere protection casing, thereby improved the protection effect of hemisphere protection casing, the security when having guaranteed the medicine feed, simultaneously, because the outside of hemisphere protection casing does not have protruding or edges and corners, consequently, can avoid the condition that causes the damage to the oral cavity of animal.

title_en: Visual therapy device with uniform light source distribution
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a vision treatment device with uniform light source distribution, which comprises a lens barrel and a convex lens, wherein a facula shape regulator is arranged at the top end of the lens barrel, a front light source plate is arranged in the lens barrel, the convex lens is arranged at the bottom end of the front light source plate, a screw is arranged at the left side of the convex lens, an LED light source plate is arranged at the bottom end of the convex lens, a switching block is arranged at the right side of the convex lens, and a connecting plate is fixed on the outer wall of the lens barrel. This a light source distributes even vision treatment dress can adjust the facula through the facula shape regulator for facula energy distribution is even, and the energy that the user's fundus received is more unified, avoids the too high condition of central energy, utilizes the size of facula shape regulator adjustment facula diameter simultaneously, can change the size and the shape of facula through changing convex lens and facula shape regulator, and the adapter is used for fixed LED light source board, can absorb unnecessary light simultaneously, avoids the existence of stray light to influence the use.

title_en: Auxiliary mechanism for animal clinical placement table
abstract_en: The utility model provides an auxiliary mechanism of an animal clinical placement table, which comprises a base, a first placement table, a second placement table and a plurality of groups of constraint components. The first placing table and/or the second placing table are/is slidably arranged on the base and move relatively on the horizontal plane of the upper surface of the base. The binding assembly is respectively and slidably mounted on the first placing table and the second placing table, and the sliding direction of the binding assembly is perpendicular to the relative movement direction of the first placing table and the second placing table. Each set of restraint assemblies includes a restraint strap that secures the animal limb. The utility model can be bound and adjusted according to the body sizes and clinical requirements of different animals, and improves the efficiency and safety of animal clinical treatment.

title_en: Chest compression device for preventing scar
abstract_en: A chest compression device for scar prevention comprising: chest strap, air bag; the chest strap is used for fixing around the chest of the patient; the two ends of the chest belt are respectively and correspondingly provided with a sticky hook and sticky hair; the left upper side of the chest strap is provided with a left shoulder strap which is divided into a left shoulder front strap and a left shoulder rear strap; the upper ends of the left shoulder front belt and the left shoulder rear belt are combined together through sticky hooks and sticky hairs; a right shoulder strap is formed on the right upper side of the chest strap and is divided into a right shoulder front strap and a right shoulder rear strap; the upper ends of the right shoulder front belt and the right shoulder rear belt are combined together through sticky hooks and sticky hairs; the front side of the chest belt is transversely provided with a long hole; the air bag is formed into a cake shape, the front side of the air bag is used for being pressed on an operation incision of a patient, and the rear side of the air bag is connected with an air tap; the air tap extends to the outside through the long hole on the front side of the chest belt; the end of the air tap can be detachably provided with a plug. The chest compression device for preventing scar of the application reduces the compression area of a patient to the greatest extent through a simplified structure, and concentrates the pressure at the operation incision position.

title_en: Finger pressure distance-adjusting device of pulse-taking instrument
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a finger pressure distance adjusting device of a pulse-taking instrument, which relates to the technical field of medical diagnostic instruments and comprises the pulse-taking instrument, a motor, a lead screw and a finger pressure mounting frame, and is characterized in that: the pulse diagnosis instrument is characterized in that a fixed seat is connected to the pulse diagnosis instrument in a sliding manner, a motor installation seat is fixedly connected to the fixed seat, a motor is fixedly connected to the motor installation seat, a screw rod of a screw rod is fixedly connected to a rotating shaft of the motor, the screw rod is connected to a screw rod connection plate, the screw rod connection plate is detachably connected to a fixing plate through a screw cap, the fixing plate is connected to a mounting plate, the mounting plate is fixedly connected to the fixed seat, and a second connecting rod mounting plate and a third connecting rod mounting plate are connected to the screw rod, so that the pulse diagnosis instrument has the advantages that: the interval between the pressing fingers is adjusted through one pressing finger position and the screw rod, so that the accurate positioning can be realized, the interval between the pressing fingers can be adjusted according to different people, and the pulse diagnosis information can be acquired more accurately.

title_en: Portable pneumotach
abstract_en: The utility model is applicable to the technical field of medical equipment, and provides a portable pneumotachometer which comprises a power supply, a flow signal acquisition unit and a flow signal processing unit, wherein the output end of the power supply is connected with the flow signal acquisition unit through a first power supply line and is connected with the flow signal processing unit through a second power supply line, and the voltage of the first power supply line is not less than the voltage of the second power supply line; the utility model designs a portable low-power consumption pneumotachometer which solves the problems of poor portability or poor endurance of the existing products based on the principle of double-differential-pressure throttling type respiratory flow measurement; the intelligent remote control system has the advantages of reliable function, lasting endurance, flexible structure, separation of signal measurement and result output, portability and convenience in circulation in various scenes while specific health information of patients can be obtained.

title_en: Waist seal with emergency hemostasis function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of corset clothes, in particular to a waist seal with an emergency hemostasis function, which comprises a connecting plate and a hemostasis assembly, wherein the hemostasis assembly is arranged on the front surface of the connecting plate and comprises a first fixing block, the first fixing block is fixedly connected on the front surface of the connecting plate, a first through groove is formed in one side of the first fixing block, an arc-shaped groove is formed in one side of the inner wall of the first fixing block, and a second through groove is formed in the top of the first fixing block. This waist seals with urgent hemostatic function through installation hemostatic assembly, can melt urgent tourniquet and female beam waist as an organic whole to when meetting the sudden event, the user can be through pressing the button of device, makes the arc piece pushed to the inside of recess two, makes fixed block two and fixed block one remove fixedly, then the user can carry out quick convenient taking out with urgent tourniquet from the inside of connecting band, makes urgent tourniquet can bleed the personnel and carry out urgent hemostatic treatment.

title_en: Electric cutter convenient to operate
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of medical instruments, and particularly relates to an electric cutter convenient to operate, which comprises a handle and a sliding block sleeved on the surface of the handle, wherein the sliding block is arranged on the surface of the handle in a sliding manner along the length direction of the handle, a high-frequency electric plug is fixed on the outer surface of the sliding block, one end of the handle is sequentially connected with a connecting pipe and a cutter holder, the surface of the cutter holder is rotationally connected with a rotating block which is arranged opposite to the rotating block, a linkage rod is arranged between the rotating block and the sliding block, when the sliding block slides along the surface of the handle, the sliding block synchronously drives the rotating block to rotate through the linkage rod, a first cutting block is arranged on the surface of the rotating block facing the cutter holder, a second cutting block is arranged on the surface of the cutter holder facing the rotating block, both the first cutting block and the second cutting block are electrically connected with the high-frequency electric plug, and the side surfaces of the rotating block and the cutter holder are jointly connected with an elastic net bag.

title_en: Shape memory neck brace with zero poisson ratio cellular structure
abstract_en: The utility model provides a shape memory neck brace with a cell structure of zero poisson ratio, which comprises an integrally formed thermoplastic neck brace body, wherein the thermoplastic neck brace body comprises a front fixing plate, the left end and the right end of the front fixing plate are respectively connected with a cranium back fixing plate through a neck ring connecting plate, and the two cranium back fixing plates are connected through a buckle; the annular neck connecting plate is of a cell structure with zero poisson ratio and a deformation function in the transverse direction. In the utility model, the neck support is a thermoplastic material part, can be shaped and fixed according to the physiological structure of the neck of a patient, has simple shaping process, improves the fitness of the neck support and a human body, and ensures the orthopedic effect of the neck of the patient.

title_en: Arm-type electronic sphygmomanometer convenient to accomodate
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an arm type electronic sphygmomanometer convenient to store, and relates to the technical field of medical appliances; including host computer and sleeve area, the host computer includes organism, display screen, function button, power source, battery and loudspeaker, and the display screen is located the organism surface, and the side of display screen is located to the function button, and power source locates the side of organism, in the battery was located the organism, the back of organism was located to loudspeaker, and the sleeve area includes arm area, air hose and air plug, and the arm area is taken over the air hose and is connected with the organism, and the organism periphery is equipped with the standing groove, and the organism side is equipped with the take-in plate. According to the arm-type electronic sphygmomanometer convenient to store, the placing groove is formed in the periphery of the body, so that the air hose is placed in the placing groove, and the hose is convenient to store; the storage plate is arranged on the side surface of the machine body, so that the arm belt is placed in the storage plate, and the arm belt is conveniently stored; the sleeve belt is not required to be stored independently, the plug is not required to be plugged and unplugged frequently, the air hose is not easy to wear, the air hose is not easy to damage, and the measurement stability is good.

title_en: Chronic wound surface measuring device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a chronic wound surface measuring device, relates to the technical field of medical appliances, and aims to solve the problems that pollutants such as bacteria are easy to adhere to the surface of an existing measuring ruler, and secondary infection is easy to occur to a wound surface during measurement, wherein the chronic wound surface measuring device comprises a chronic wound surface measuring part; the zero alignment part is arranged at the bottom of the chronic wound surface measuring part; the adjusting part is arranged on the chronic wound surface measuring part; the stabilizing part is arranged inside the adjusting part; two rows of measurement scale marks are formed on the top of the chronic wound surface measurement frame; the grabbing handle is fixedly arranged on the right side of the chronic wound surface measuring frame; according to the utility model, the first protective sleeve is arranged at the bottom of the T-shaped zero point alignment frame in a sliding manner, and the second protective sleeve is arranged at the bottom of the T-shaped measurement frame in a sliding manner, so that the cleaned T-shaped zero point alignment frame and the T-shaped measurement frame are protected, and secondary infection during wound surface measurement is avoided.

title_en: Surgical retractor with adjustable air bag
abstract_en: The utility model provides an adjustable air bag surgical retractor, comprising: a handle for holding; one end of the connecting rod is arranged on the handle; the hook body is arranged at one end of the connecting rod far away from the handle; the air bag is arranged on the hook body and exceeds the front end of the hook body; the air bag changes the angle at the tail end of the hook body by inputting different volumes of gas, which is helpful for expanding the operative field to a deeper level. The utility model solves the problem that the angle cannot be adjusted when the surgical retractor is used in the market, and the incision is pressed for a long time to cause damage to tissues; the air bag exceeds the metal end of the hook body of the surgical retractor, so that the surgical field can be opened to a deeper level, and incision tissues do not need to be contacted with metal; by injecting different volumes of gas into the air bag, the angle of the drag hook is adjusted, the surgical field is better exposed, and incision tissues can be better protected; the air bag can be used as a protective sleeve and arranged at one end of the surgical retractor, and can be removed and replaced.

title_en: Bone prosthesis
abstract_en: The utility model provides a bone prosthesis, which comprises a prosthesis main body (1), wherein one end of the prosthesis main body (1) is provided with a joint surface (11), and the other end is provided with a fixing rod (12) for being inserted into a bone marrow cavity; the shape and configuration of the articular surface (11) is adapted to the articular surface to be contacted. When the joint reconstruction is carried out, only the joint with the joint lesion or damage on one side is replaced, so that the replacement of the joint on two sides is avoided, the waste of healthy bones is greatly reduced, and the osteolysis and the removal or damage of surrounding tissues caused by the replacement of the joint on the other side are avoided; and the surface form of the joint surface is designed and smoothened according to the bone form of the original joint surface, so that the abrasion, friction and collision of the joint surface to be contacted are reduced, the grinding time of the joint at the other side is greatly delayed, and the time for replacing the double-joint prosthesis is greatly delayed.

title_en: Perishable garbage fermentation equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of garbage treatment equipment, in particular to perishable garbage fermentation equipment, which comprises a box body, a stirring container, a strain adding mechanism, an odor filtering mechanism, a ventilation mechanism and a throwing mechanism, wherein a throwing port and a discharge port are respectively arranged on two sides of the box body, a supporting frame is arranged in the box body, the stirring container is rotatably arranged on the supporting frame, the strain adding mechanism is arranged on the inner wall of the box body, a discharge end of the strain adding mechanism is communicated with the stirring container, the odor filtering mechanism is arranged on the supporting frame, an air inlet end of the odor filtering mechanism is communicated with the stirring container, an air outlet end of the box body is also arranged on the side surface of the box body, an air outlet end of the odor filtering mechanism is communicated with the air outlet, the ventilation mechanism is arranged on the supporting frame, and the throwing mechanism is arranged on one side of the throwing port.

title_en: Multifunctional fixing assembly for nursing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multifunctional fixing component for nursing, which belongs to the technical field of medical nursing instruments and comprises a fixing ring, a vent hole, a latex pad, a locking plate, a through hole, an adjusting bolt, a supporting block, a perforation block, an elastic band, a magic tape female patch, a magic tape sub patch and an adjusting buckle; the fixing ring is provided with the vent holes, the inner wall of the fixing ring is provided with the latex cushion, the two ends of the fixing ring are provided with the locking plates, the locking plates are provided with the through holes, the through holes are internally penetrated with the adjusting bolts, the supporting blocks are arranged between the fixing ring and the locking plates, the side ends of one side of the locking plates are provided with the perforating blocks, the side ends of the other side of the locking plates are provided with the elastic belts, the elastic belts are penetrated with the adjusting buckles, when in use, the fixing ring on one side surrounds the limb to be fixed, and then the fixing ring on the other side is correspondingly matched with the adjusting bolts, or the fixing ring on one side with the elastic belts is used for fixing the limb and a sickbed, and the like, so that patients can be prevented from shaking due to pain when in the situations of medicine feeding and the like.

title_en: Baby diaper convenient to wear
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of disposable sanitary products, in particular to a baby diaper convenient to wear, which comprises a front waistline, an absorption part and a rear waistline which are sequentially connected, wherein magic tapes which can be adhered to the outer surface of the front waistline are arranged on two sides of the rear waistline, leg circumferences are arranged on two sides of the absorption part, a first pulling rope is arranged on the leg circumference, and at least two second pulling ropes parallel to the length of the absorption part are arranged on the lower surface of the absorption part at intervals along the width direction of the absorption part. The adaptability is strong and the wearing is convenient.

title_en: Water outlet tap of water dispenser
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of water dispensers, in particular to a water dispenser water outlet faucet, which comprises a faucet main body, a sealing cover, a glass round tube and a sterilizing lamp, wherein the faucet main body is provided with a water inlet, a water outlet and a mounting port; the sealing cover is arranged at the mounting opening, the sealing cover is provided with a mounting hole, one end of the glass round tube is connected with the mounting hole, the other end of the glass round tube stretches into the faucet main body, and the sterilizing lamp is arranged in the glass round tube. The water outlet tap of the water dispenser provided by the utility model prolongs the sterilization time by increasing the sterilization irradiation range of the sterilizing lamp, improves the water quality of users, simultaneously avoids the breeding of harmful bacteria, viruses and the like in the tap body when no water is used, and prolongs the service life of the water outlet tap of the water dispenser.

title_en: Medicine bottle for reminding patient to take medicine
abstract_en: The utility model provides a medicine bottle for reminding taking medicine, which comprises a bottle body, a bottle cover, a control device, a key switch, an abutting device and a reminding device. The bottle body is used for storing medicines, and the bottle cap comprises a containing cavity with an opening. The control device is arranged in the accommodating cavity, the key switch is arranged on the first surface of the control device and is electrically connected with the control device, and the first surface is arranged towards the opening. The control device can record the on-off information of the key switch. The abutting device is arranged in the accommodating cavity and limited between the key switch and the opening. The reminding device is electrically connected with the control device and used for reminding a user of taking medicine. When the opening is connected with the bottle mouth, the bottle mouth can push the abutting device to move towards the direction of the key switch so as to close the key switch. When the bottle mouth is far away from the opening, the abutting device is far away from the key switch so as to disconnect the key switch. This a medicine bottle for reminding take medicine can realize reminding the patient to take medicine the function, can also keep medicine box volume miniaturization, conveniently goes out to carry.

title_en: Nursing tray with protection machanism
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of nursing trays and discloses a nursing tray with a protection mechanism, which comprises a tray body and a protection cover, wherein first placement boxes are movably arranged on two sides of the upper end inside the tray body, second placement boxes are fixedly arranged on two sides of the lower end inside the tray body, a purple light lamp is fixedly arranged on the upper end inside the protection cover, a garbage groove is fixedly arranged in the middle position inside the tray body, a plurality of fixing assemblies are fixedly arranged inside the second placement boxes, and a plurality of fixing assemblies comprise connecting rings. According to the nursing tray, the protection cover can be used for protecting medicines and nursing tools, the ultraviolet lamp is fixedly arranged at the upper end inside the protection cover to disinfect and sterilize the nursing tools, so that medical articles are safer, the garbage groove is fixedly arranged at the middle position inside the tray body to store medical garbage, the medical garbage is prevented from being contacted with the nursing tools, cross infection is avoided, and the protection effect is good.

title_en: Livestock and veterinary medicine filling device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of medicine filling devices and discloses a medicine filling device for livestock and poultry, which comprises a bracket and a platform seat, wherein the medicine filling device is arranged below the bracket and is used for filling medicines for livestock and poultry, the medicine filling device is connected with the bracket through a telescopic component, and the telescopic component is used for fixing the medicine filling device and is connected to the bracket in a suspending way; under the condition that the telescopic component moves, the telescopic component drives the medicine filling device to move in a direction far away from or close to livestock. This livestock and poultry is with filling medicine device sets up supporting component through one side at filling medicine device, pinch the extrusion piece on the supporting component and drive the top piece and remove in the mouth of livestock, realize promoting the tongue in the livestock mouth once, avoid the livestock tongue to block up the export of filling medicine device, influence the effect of filling medicine device play medicine.

title_en: Scoliosis angle measurement chi
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of angle measuring scales and discloses a spine side bending angle measuring scale which comprises a measuring scale, wherein a gyroscope is fixedly arranged on one side of the surface of the measuring scale, the gyroscope is electrically connected with a display assembly, a battery groove is formed in the middle of the surface of the measuring scale, a button battery is clamped in the battery groove, a pen groove is formed in the other side of the surface of the measuring scale, a clamping ring is fixedly connected in the pen groove, and a recording pen is clamped in the clamping ring. This scoliosis angle measurement chi through the setting of gyroscope, through the angle of dipperstick survey backbone cone upper edge to set up the gyroscope as initial angle, and then through the angle of dipperstick survey backbone cone lower edge, the gyroscope follows and rotates, shows the angle reading through the controller on the display, and this angle is the same with traditional measurement mode COBB angle, thereby has reached the effect of quick survey patient scoliosis angle.

title_en: Novel hernia band
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of medical care auxiliary supplies, in particular to a novel hernia band, which has more stable fixing effect, is not easy to deviate, is not easy to protrude and comprises a waist band and leg bands, wherein the two leg bands are arranged, the rear part of the waist band is provided with two binding bands, one end of each binding band is provided with a hook surface of a magic tape, the side wall of each leg band is provided with a connecting band, the top of each connecting band is provided with a hernia bag, the bottom of each connecting band is provided with a connecting ring, the front part of the waist band is provided with two magic tape surfaces, the two ends of each waist band are provided with magic tapes, the two ends of each leg band are provided with magic tapes, the binding bands penetrate through the inside of the connecting rings, one end of each connecting band is sewn on the leg band, one end of each binding band is sewn on the waist band, and the connecting band and the hernia bag are made of skin-friendly materials.

title_en: Old people fall prevention walking aid
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of falling prevention of old people, in particular to a falling prevention walker for old people, which comprises a connecting plate and a folding component arranged on the surface of the connecting plate, wherein the folding component comprises movable seats symmetrically arranged on the surface of the connecting plate, the folding component is arranged on the device, when a user folds after using the folding component, a half threaded rod is pulled out of through holes formed in the surfaces of the connecting plate and a supporting frame, at the moment, the supporting frame is rotated, and the adjusting plate is hinged with the movable seats, so that the supporting frame is driven to be attached to the connecting plate, thereby achieving the folding, facilitating the storage treatment after the use is finished, reducing the occupation of a large amount of space, and adding a waist supporting component on the mechanism.

title_en: Gastroscopy nursing bowl
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a gastroscopy nursing bowl, and belongs to the technical field of medical appliances. The nursing bowl comprises a secretion collecting bowl, a nursing towel is connected to the edge of an opening of the secretion collecting bowl, a neck opening for covering the neck of a patient is formed in the nursing towel, and a fixing piece for fixing the nursing towel is arranged at the edge of the neck opening. The nursing bowl is designed by integrating the secretion collecting bowl with the nursing towel, so that the problem that secretion of a patient flows to clothes and beds of the patient is avoided, and the secretion is collected; meanwhile, the fixing of the nursing towel is facilitated through the neck opening and the fixing piece, and the problem that the nursing towel slides off is avoided; after the use is finished, the nursing towel can be folded and stored in the secretion collecting bowl to be thrown away together, so that the problem that the secretion splashes when the nursing towel is treated is avoided, and the operation is convenient.

title_en: Multifunctional antibacterial surgical bag
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multifunctional antibacterial surgical bag, which comprises a surgical bag main body, wherein a square-structured wrapping cloth is arranged on the surgical bag main body, lacing is sewn on the periphery of the outer side surface of the wrapping cloth, a bottom plate is sewn on the inner side surface of the wrapping cloth, side plates are sewn on the four sides of the bottom plate, so that the side plates can form a box body when being vertical to the bottom plate, instrument storage boxes with different sizes are also arranged in the surgical bag main body, a partition plate is arranged above the instrument storage boxes, and surgical gown sets are arranged at the upper ends of the partition plates. The multifunctional antibacterial surgical bag is convenient to unfold and easy to use, the instrument storage box is matched with the partition plate, the bottom plate and the side plates for use, has high-strength protection, and effectively improves the antibacterial property of the instruments in the surgical bag.

title_en: Easy-locking low-temperature thermoplastic foot support and mold
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an easily-locked low-temperature thermoplastic foot support and a mold. The low temperature thermoplastic foot support of easy locking-type includes: a low temperature thermoplastic immobilization plate including a middle portion for shaping the immobilization ankle, a first portion extending from the middle portion toward the toes and a second portion extending from the middle portion toward the calf portion; the first part, the middle part and the second part of the low-temperature thermoplastic fixing plate are sequentially connected into an integrated structure, and the integrated structure is provided with a first edge part and a second edge part which are oppositely arranged; the first chain belt is arranged at the first edge part; the second chain belt is arranged at the second edge part; the second chain belt is matched with the first chain belt; the zipper head is movably arranged on the first chain belt and used for connecting or disassembling the first chain belt and the second chain belt, the middle part is utilized for coating the ankle part, the first part extends to the toes to coat the feet, the second part extends to the shank to coat the shanks, the zipper head is connected with the first chain belt and the second chain belt, and the easily-locked low-temperature thermoplastic foot support is fixedly coated on the feet.

title_en: Anti-choking nose washing device for children
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-choking nose washing device for children, which is characterized by comprising a bottle body capable of being extruded and a punch head arranged on the bottle body, wherein a guide pipe extending into the bottle body is arranged on the punch head, the bottom end of the guide pipe is close to the bottom end of the bottle body, a blowing nozzle capable of supplying pressure into the bottle body is also arranged on the bottle body, and nose washing liquid in the bottle body can be sent into the punch head through the guide pipe when the blowing nozzle supplies pressure into the bottle body; when the device is used, a child is required to blow by the mouth all the time, so that the child is prevented from inhaling through the nose in the flushing process, and the choking cough caused by the breathing of the nose of the child in the flushing process is avoided. The one-way valve which can limit the backflow of the nasal wash is arranged on the punch, and when no air is blown into the bottle body, the one-way valve closes the backflow channel of the nasal wash, so that the nasal wash which enters the nasal cavity can not flow back.

title_en: Acupuncture operation auxiliary frame
abstract_en: The utility model provides an auxiliary frame for acupuncture operation, which relates to the technical field of acupuncture tools and comprises the following components: the device comprises a bracket rod, wherein a waste bucket for containing waste is fixedly arranged on the bracket rod; a disinfection box is fixedly arranged on the bracket rod; the disinfection box is positioned above the waste bucket; a self-locking worm wheel is rotatably arranged at one side of the inner part of the bracket rod; the inside intermediate position of support pole rotates installs the axle that opens and shuts. According to the auxiliary frame for acupuncture operation, the opening operation of the sealing cover plate and the braking operation of the movable wheels are linked, so that the braking of a plurality of movable wheels can be automatically realized when the sealing cover plate is opened to pre-use acupuncture tools in the sterilizing box, compared with the situation that the movable wheels are braked one by one, the auxiliary frame for acupuncture operation is more time-saving and labor-saving, and the problem that the plurality of movable wheels are required to be braked gradually and are troublesome to brake manually due to the fact that the plurality of movable wheels on the existing auxiliary frame are not stable enough and are braked singly is solved.

title_en: Motor transmission device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a motor transmission device, which comprises a rotatable transmission piece which is arranged in a shell and driven by a motor; the motor is connected with the transmission piece through multistage gear transmission; the output end of the motor comprises a fixed bracket which is connected with the shell; the transmission piece is connected with a conical pendulum connecting part; the conical pendulum connecting part is connected with an output shaft; the axis of the output shaft and the rotation axis of the transmission piece are arranged at an included angle; the output shaft is sleeved with a clamping and kneading movable assembly; the transmission part comprises an eccentric part which is arranged deviating from the rotation center of the transmission part; the eccentric part is sleeved with a swinging rod; the other end of the swinging rod is movably connected with a reciprocating assembly; the middle part of the reciprocating movable assembly is rotationally connected with the shell. The shell of the motor and the output worm synchronously rotate, so that the rotor of the motor can be externally arranged, the motor shell simultaneously serves as the rotor to rotate, the rotor of the brushless motor has small moment of inertia, and the motor has good starting, accelerating and braking performances and quick response.

title_en: Suture hook with take-up and pay-off functions
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of medical instruments, in particular to a suture hook with a wire winding and unwinding function. The suture hook comprises a handle, a metal tube and a puncture needle head which are sequentially connected from back to front and are hollow in the interior, and a coiling and uncoiling mechanism is arranged at the rear end of the handle. The winding and unwinding mechanism comprises a reel and a buckling piece, the rear end of the handle is provided with a mounting block, the mounting block is connected with the buckling piece and encloses a containing cavity, and the containing cavity is communicated with the inner cavity of the handle; the reel is arranged in the accommodating cavity and is respectively connected with the mounting block and the buckling piece in a rotating mode, a suture thread is wound on the reel, sequentially penetrates through the handle, the metal tube and the inner cavity of the puncture needle head and stretches out of the front end of the puncture needle head, and the suture thread is wound and unwound by stirring the part of the reel stretching out of the accommodating cavity. The length of the suture penetrating out of the puncture needle head can be freely adjusted by the suture hook, the suture can be rapidly wound up and paid off, and the technical problem that the length of the suture extending out of the puncture needle head can not be rapidly adjusted by the traditional suture hook can be effectively solved.

title_en: Double-plug type medicine packaging box capable of taking medicine rapidly
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a double-plug type medicine packaging box capable of taking medicines rapidly, and relates to the technical field of medicine packaging boxes, comprising a shell and two medicine storage boxes, wherein the two medicine storage boxes are both connected in the shell in a sliding manner, and an ejection mechanism is arranged in the shell; the ejecting mechanism comprises a pressing piece, a mounting rod, a clamping block, a second spring piece and a pushing plate, wherein the mounting rod is in sliding connection with the inside of the shell, the pressing piece is fixedly arranged at the top of the mounting rod, the clamping block is arranged on one side of the pushing plate, and a clamping groove matched with the clamping block is formed in the mounting rod; according to the technical scheme provided by the utility model, the ejection mechanism is adopted, when an emergency situation occurs and medicines in the medicine storage box need to be taken out rapidly, the mounting rod can slide downwards by pressing the pressing piece downwards, so that the clamping block is separated from the clamping groove, at the moment, the second spring piece can push the push plate to one side, the push plate can push the limit plate loose, and therefore the medicine storage box is ejected out of the shell, and medicines in the medicine storage box can be taken out rapidly.

title_en: Tissue engineering cell scaffold subretinal space transplanting injector
abstract_en: The utility model provides a tissue engineering cell scaffold subretinal space transplanting injector, which comprises: cell scaffold bears device, bolus device and handle, wherein: a cell scaffold carrying device for carrying retina cells; the pushing device is connected with the cell bracket bearing device and used for pushing the cell bracket bearing device to a designated part; the cell support bearing device is arranged at the tail end of the handle, and the pushing device is arranged in the handle and used for pushing the cell support bearing device to slide and fixing the pushing device. The cell bracket bearing device comprises a tray, a soft plastic outer sleeve and a cell bracket. The pushing device comprises a pushing rubber block, an air source pushing rod, a spring, a shaft connector and a piston. The handle comprises a pushing slide block, an instrument fixing device, an air source connecting pipe and a shell. When the utility model is used, the soft plastic outer sleeve can realize passive contact with retina, is beneficial to implanting a cell bracket carrying target cells into a subretinal cavity, and does not damage retina.

title_en: Portable cardiac resuscitator
abstract_en: The utility model provides a portable cardiac resuscitator, which relates to the field of cardiac resuscitators and comprises a supporting plate, wherein grooves are formed in the inner walls of two sides of the supporting plate, a hydraulic cylinder body is arranged on the inner top wall of each groove, a roller is fixedly connected to the output end of each hydraulic cylinder body, a mounting sleeve is arranged on one side of the supporting plate, a mounting plate is sleeved on the inner wall of each mounting sleeve, and fastening bolts are arranged on the inner wall of each mounting plate; the portable cardiac resuscitator is provided with the pull ring, the pull rod, the movable plate, the movable groove, the clamping rod, the fixed cylinder and the powerful spring, so that the cardiac resuscitator can be conveniently adjusted in height, the occupied storage space is small, the whole device can be conveniently moved, the hydraulic cylinder body, the roller, the groove, the handle and the supporting plate are arranged, the cardiac resuscitator can be carried and moved to a required position, and the fastening bolt, the mounting plate and the mounting sleeve are arranged, so that the cardiac resuscitator can be detached and mounted.

title_en: Radius skull fracture fixation forceps
abstract_en: The utility model discloses radius skull fracture fixation forceps which comprise a first forceps body and a second forceps body which are hinged, wherein a first clamping part is arranged at the top of the first forceps body, the first clamping part is an arc-shaped plate, and one or more through holes are formed in the surface of the arc-shaped plate; the top of the second clamp body is provided with a second clamping part, and one or more short needles are fixedly arranged on the inner surface of the second clamping part. The first clamping part can be better attached to the radius bone to fix the radius bone, and the surface of the arc-shaped plate is provided with the through holes, so that a screw or a Kirschner wire can be conveniently placed in the operation to fix the fracture block; the width of the second clamping part is narrower, a certain space exists on the surface of the clamped bone except the clamping surface, the steel plate is conveniently placed on the lateral surface of the radius bone, and the short needle is fixedly arranged on the clamping part, so that the clamping part can be embedded into bone during clamping, and the clamping is more stable.

title_en: Brush head structure of electric toothbrush
