abstract_en: The utility model discloses a brush head structure of an electric toothbrush, which comprises a connecting rod, wherein the top end of the connecting rod is provided with a brush head, one side of the brush head is provided with brush hair, the bottom end of the connecting rod is provided with an insertion hole, the top end of the insertion hole is provided with a magnetic attraction piece, both sides of the connecting rod are provided with threaded holes extending into the insertion hole, threaded columns in threaded connection are arranged in the threaded holes, and one side of each threaded column is provided with a double-wing knob. Compared with the prior art, the utility model has the advantages that: not only be convenient for closely laminate brush head connecting rod and electric handle, avoid not hard up, influence the transmission ability, prevent moreover that junction from getting into the raffinate, avoid the condition that blackening, moldy appear in the junction of brush head and electric handle.

title_en: Deer's baoding device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a deer fixing device, and relates to the technical field of fixing devices. The utility model comprises a fixing box, wherein the fixing box comprises a guide box and a fixed box which are connected with each other, a closed door plate is arranged between the guide box and the fixed box, one end of the guide box is obliquely provided with two guide plates, and one sides of the guide box and the fixed box are respectively provided with a box door; a notch is formed in one side of the inner wall of the guide box, a sliding guide block is slidably matched in the guide box, and a fixed guide block is arranged on the other side of the inner wall of the guide box; both sides of the inner wall of the fixed box are provided with extrusion fixing pieces. According to the utility model, the deer can be guided into the fixing box through the guide plate, and can move to one side of the fixed guide block through the guide box, so that the deer is driven to move to one side of the fixed box, and the deer can be fixed through the extrusion fixing piece in the fixed box, so that a raiser can conveniently fix the deer.

title_en: Food supply device for nasopharyngeal carcinoma nursing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of medical care, in particular to a food supply device for nasopharyngeal carcinoma care, which comprises a base and further comprises: the heat preservation device comprises a heat preservation shell arranged at the top of a base, wherein an inner container is arranged in an inner cavity of the heat preservation shell, the base, the heat preservation shell and the inner container are integrated, a sealing cover is arranged at the top of the heat preservation shell, a lifting handle is arranged at the top of the surface of the heat preservation shell, a connecting hole is formed in the bottom of the base, a first thread groove is formed in the inner cavity of the connecting hole, a second thread groove is formed in the top of the inner cavity of the inner container, a connecting shell is arranged in the inner cavity of the connecting hole, a flow guide pipe is communicated with the bottom of the connecting shell, and an extrusion shell is communicated with the surface of the flow guide pipe; solves the problems that the traditional food supply device lacks heat preservation effect and influences the feeding effect of patients aiming at some foods with poor fluidity.

title_en: Disinfection liquid spraying device for leech seedling culture pond
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of leech cultivation, and discloses a disinfection liquid spraying device for a leech seedling cultivation pond, which solves the problems that excessive use of disinfection liquid is caused by incapability of controlling sprayed disinfection liquid in a liquid spraying process, water pollution is easily caused, and waste is caused. The utility model provides a leech seedling is bred pond and is used disinfection liquid spraying device, including backup pad and liquid reserve tank, it is provided with power component to breed the pond outside, it is provided with the hydrojet subassembly to breed pond top, under the water pump effect, inside antiseptic solution of liquid reserve tank loops through hose and first connecting pipe entering regulating box, through outlet pipe and shunt tubes, spray out through the shower nozzle at last and disinfect to breeding the pond, rotate the knob, the knob drives the second connecting pipe and takes place the displacement along first connecting pipe surface, make first apopore and second apopore position crisscross mutually, can reduce the amount that antiseptic solution got into the regulating box inside, thereby reduced shower nozzle spun volume, the jet-out volume of antiseptic solution of being convenient for control.

title_en: Portable moxibustion device capable of being positioned freely
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a portable moxibustion device capable of being positioned freely, which comprises a waistcoat, wherein the waistcoat comprises an upper part and a lower part of the waistcoat, a circle of zipper teeth are fixedly connected to the middle part of the waistcoat, the zipper teeth are provided with zipper heads which are matched with the zipper teeth, the zipper teeth are arranged at the joint of the upper part of the waistcoat and the lower part of the waistcoat, a first magic tape is arranged at an opening in front of the waistcoat, and a plurality of moxibustion boxes are arranged on the waistcoat.

title_en: Outdoor sputum aspirator that can preheat diaphragm
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an outdoor sputum aspirator capable of preheating a diaphragm, and relates to the technical field of sputum aspirators; the sputum aspirator comprises a shell, wherein a sputum aspirator tube is arranged on the side wall of the shell in a penetrating way, a handle is fixedly connected to the top surface of the shell, an air pump main body is arranged in the shell, an air pipe is fixedly connected to a port of the air pump main body, the air pump main body comprises an air pump diaphragm, electric heating plates are arranged on two sides of the air pump main body, a heat conducting plate is fixedly connected to the side wall of the electric heating plate, and the heat conducting plate is in contact with the air pump diaphragm; when the sputum aspirator is used in a low-temperature environment in the field, the electric heating sheet can be powered by the power module in the circuit board to preheat, and the frozen air pump membrane is dissolved by the heat conducting sheet, so that the performance of the air pump main body under the condition of low air temperature is improved, and the sputum aspirator can work stably under the condition of low temperature in the field.

title_en: PICC is with pad pasting
abstract_en: The utility model provides a sticking film for PICC, which relates to the technical field of medical instruments and comprises a catheter and a sticking mechanism, wherein the sticking mechanism is arranged on the outer side of the catheter and comprises a fixing component and a sticking component, the fixing component is arranged on the outer side of the catheter, and the sticking component is arranged on the outer side of the fixing component. By providing a fixation assembly, the rubber fixation tube can effectively secure the catheter to the patient, ensuring that it does not accidentally move or slip out of the patient's vein, which helps to maintain the correct position of the catheter for smooth infusion and treatment, which is very important for patients who need to use the catheter for a long period of time, because a stable catheter can avoid unnecessary discomfort and pain, and the rubber fixation tube is generally softer, reducing friction and irritation of the catheter to the patient, which can reduce skin breakage and discomfort to the patient, while the outer polyethylene material has flexibility and water resistance, which can maintain good adhesion in a moist environment.

title_en: Auxiliary structure for puerpera treatment
abstract_en: The application provides an auxiliary structure for puerpera treatment, which comprises a covering cloth structure, wherein the covering cloth structure is used for covering abdomen and perineum parts of puerpera, the covering cloth structure is connected with two warm-keeping leg sleeves, the two warm-keeping leg sleeves are used for protecting lower limbs of puerpera, and auxiliary parts are arranged at one ends of the two warm-keeping leg sleeves far away from the covering cloth structure; the covering cloth structure comprises a first covering cloth, and one side of the first covering cloth is fixedly connected with a second covering cloth. According to the application, through the cover cloth structure, the cover cloth structure is used for covering the abdomen and the perineum of a puerpera, and the warm leg sleeve is used for protecting the lower limbs of the puerpera, so that the parts can keep warm of the puerpera in the treatment process, the condition that the puerpera is infected with wind-cold is reduced, and the cover of the perineum is beneficial to protecting the privacy of the puerpera.

title_en: Intrarectal water sac for nuclear magnetic resonance imaging examination
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rectal cavity water sac for nuclear magnetic resonance imaging examination, which relates to the technical field of medical equipment and has the technical key points that: the device comprises a conduit and seven sectional water bags, wherein seven sectional water bags are uniformly arranged and fixed at one end of the conduit, seven capillary liquid guide tubes are arranged in the conduit, one ends of the seven capillary liquid guide tubes are respectively communicated with the seven sectional water bags through openings on the outer wall of the conduit, injection liquid guide tube joints are arranged at the other ends of the seven capillary liquid guide tubes, and an injector body is arranged at one end of each injection liquid guide tube joint. According to the utility model, the filling agent in the injector body is pushed by the push rod to be input into a designated sectional water sac to expand the designated part of the rectum of a patient, the push rods on the injector bodies can be pushed to expand the sectional water sacs to expand the rectum of the patient in a multi-section manner, and the rectum of the patient can be adapted to a large number of rectums with different lengths and thicknesses, so that the rectum expanding device is wide in applicability.

title_en: Aromatherapy pot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an aromatherapy tank, which comprises a supporting disc, an upper tank body, a lower tank body and incense pieces, wherein an aromatherapy groove is arranged on the lower tank body, an aromatherapy cavity is arranged in the upper tank body, the incense pieces are arranged in the aromatherapy groove, the upper tank body and the lower tank body are connected in a detachable manner, at least one vent hole communicated with the aromatherapy cavity is formed in the outer side of the upper tank body, the bottom surface of the lower tank body is of a spherical structure, and the weight of the lower tank body is larger than that of the upper tank body. Compared with the prior art, the utility model has the advantages that the utility model not only can hold the fragrant sheet, but also can serve as a tumbler ornament.

title_en: Safe anti-countercurrent indwelling needle
abstract_en: The utility model provides a safe anti-reflux indwelling needle, and relates to the technical field of medical instruments. The safe anti-reflux indwelling needle comprises a puncture assembly, an indwelling assembly, an anti-puncture driving mechanism, an accommodating sleeve and an anti-reflux valve, wherein the puncture assembly is slidably arranged on the accommodating sleeve and is in driving connection with the anti-puncture driving mechanism, the anti-puncture driving mechanism is used for driving the puncture assembly to move into the accommodating sleeve, the indwelling assembly is arranged on the accommodating sleeve, the anti-reflux valve is arranged in the indwelling assembly, the puncture assembly penetrates through the indwelling assembly and drives the anti-reflux valve to be opened, and when the puncture assembly moves into the accommodating sleeve, the anti-reflux valve is closed. This safe anti-reflux keep somewhere needle utilizes the shutoff of preventing against the flow valve realization to keeping somewhere the subassembly, effectively prevents venous blood backward flow, utilizes simultaneously and prevents stinging actuating mechanism when the subassembly shifts out to keep somewhere the subassembly, and the subassembly is arranged in holding the cover and is shielded to the drive puncture, avoids accidentally injuring the mistake thorn, effectively promotes the safety in utilization safety of safe anti-reflux keep somewhere needle.

title_en: Leakage-proof and open-stop valve for puncture outfit
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of puncture outfits, in particular to a leakage-proof through-stop valve for a puncture outfit, which comprises a puncture outfit, wherein a through-stop valve is arranged on the puncture outfit, one end of the through-stop valve is communicated with a gas tank, the other end of the through-stop valve is communicated with the inside of the puncture outfit, the through-stop valve comprises a valve body and a valve core, the valve core is rotatably arranged in the valve body, a mounting hole and a first through hole are formed in the valve body, the valve core is cylindrical, the valve core is rotatably arranged in the mounting hole, the valve core is in matched connection with the mounting hole, a second through hole is formed in the valve core, the second through hole can be communicated with the first through hole, a vent hole is formed in the bottom wall of the mounting hole, the vent hole penetrates through the bottom wall of the mounting hole and is opposite to the end face of the valve core, a groove is formed in the end face of the valve core, which faces the bottom wall of the mounting hole, a mounting groove is formed in the shaft section of the valve core, which is close to the groove, is respectively communicated with the mounting groove and the vent hole, the vent hole is formed in the inner sleeve, the sealing gasket is arranged in the mounting groove, and the sealing hole, and the vent hole.

title_en: Disposable anesthesia breathing circuit
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a disposable anesthesia breathing circuit, which comprises a breathing circuit main pipe, wherein the outer surface of the breathing circuit main pipe is fixedly communicated with a breathing circuit air inlet pipe, the outer surface of the breathing circuit air inlet pipe is fixedly connected with a threaded ring, the outer surface of the threaded ring is in threaded connection with a filter cover, the inner ring of the filter cover is fixedly connected with a filter cotton plate, the outer surface of the breathing circuit main pipe is fixedly communicated with an air inlet one-way valve, the outer surface of the breathing circuit main pipe is fixedly communicated with an expiration one-way valve, the outer surface of the breathing circuit main pipe is fixedly communicated with a communicating pipe, the right end of the communicating pipe is fixedly communicated with a communicating joint, the outer surface of the breathing circuit main pipe is fixedly communicated with a connecting pipe, and the left end of the connecting pipe is fixedly communicated with a telescopic hose. The breathing circuit has a structure for filtering external air, so that anesthetic gas mist can better circulate in the breathing circuit, and the inhalation effect of anesthetic on the lung of a patient is improved.

title_en: Minimally invasive hemostatic electrocoagulation device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a minimally invasive hemostatic electrocoagulation device, in particular to the technical field of minimally invasive hemostasis, which comprises a cutter body shell, a protection mechanism and a mounting mechanism, wherein an electrocoagulation rod is arranged on one end surface of the cutter body shell, an electric plug is connected to the other end surface of the cutter body shell, the protection mechanism is arranged on one end surface of the cutter body shell, the mounting mechanism is arranged on the outer side surface of the cutter body shell, when the minimally invasive hemostatic electrocoagulation device is not used, a thread groove above a protection cover can be connected in a thread hole of the cutter body shell in a threaded manner, and one end of the electrocoagulation rod is inserted into a jack, so that the electrocoagulation rod can be better fixed, bending damage of the electrocoagulation rod can be prevented, in the use process, a lantern ring can be connected with a thread column in a threaded manner, the electric plug is fixedly connected with the cutter body shell, the setting of a baffle can prevent the lantern ring from falling off, and the finger can be inserted into a fixing ring, so that a doctor can better hold and hold the device when in use.

title_en: Pressurizing bellyband device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pressurizing bellyband device which comprises a main body, wherein two inner binding belts are fixedly connected to one side of the main body through sewing, a magic tape is arranged on the inner wall of the other end of the inner binding belts, a protection pad is connected to the inner wall of the main body through the magic tape in a pasting mode, a heating device is arranged between the protection pad and the inner wall of the main body, zippers are arranged at the upper end and the lower end of the main body, a first bellyband and a second bellyband are respectively connected to the main body through the zippers, the inner binding belts are fixedly arranged at one ends of the first bellyband and the second bellyband, and two outer binding belts are fixedly connected to the outer wall of the main body through sewing. The utility model has simple structure and convenient use, and the two auxiliary bellyband is arranged at the upper end and the lower end of the main body by utilizing the zippers, so that the application range of the pressurizing bellyband is convenient to increase, and the protective pad convenient to detach is stuck on the inner wall of the main body, so that the use effect is better.

title_en: Computer accessory stores pylon
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of computers and discloses a computer accessory hanging rack, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein the top of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with a hanging plate, the top of the hanging plate is fixedly connected with an adjusting telescopic rod, the outer part of the adjusting telescopic rod is provided with an adjusting knob, the outer part of the adjusting telescopic rod is fixedly connected with an eye-protecting lamp, the top of the adjusting telescopic rod is fixedly connected with a rotating shaft, the top of the rotating shaft is fixedly connected with a hook, the inside of the hook is provided with a headset, the inside of the bottom plate is provided with a storage assembly, the storage assembly comprises a storage drawer, and both sides of the storage drawer are in sliding connection with the inside of a sliding rail. According to the utility model, the setting of the telescopic rod is adjusted, so that the normal operation of a user is facilitated, the earphone is prevented from influencing the operation of the user, and the keyboard and the mouse can be reasonably stored and simultaneously disinfected by the setting of the storage drawer.

title_en: Intracardiac foreign matter remove device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of medical instruments, and discloses a device for taking out foreign matters in a heart chamber. The heart chamber foreign matter taking-out device comprises a basket assembly, a snare assembly, a conveying pipe, a conveying rod and a recycling sheath pipe, wherein the basket assembly is used for capturing and limiting foreign matters, the snare assembly is used for dragging the foreign matters into the basket assembly, the conveying pipe is arranged at the proximal end of the basket assembly, the conveying rod is arranged in the conveying pipe in a sliding mode and connected with the snare assembly and used for controlling the distal end of the snare assembly to be close to or far away from the basket assembly, and the recycling sheath pipe is arranged at the proximal end of the basket assembly and sleeved outside the conveying pipe in a sliding mode. The intracardiac foreign matter taking-out device has higher capturing efficiency, simpler operation and higher success rate, and meanwhile, the used materials and the structural design are metal nickel titanium wire braiding heat setting, snare and catheter processes, and the processing process is mature, so the feasibility of production is high, the cost is low, the research and development period is short, and the industrialization is easy.

title_en: Earplug not easy to fall off and comfortable to wear
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of earplugs and discloses an earplug which is difficult to fall off and comfortable to wear, and the earplug comprises an earplug body and a connecting shell, wherein the earplug body comprises an earplug main body and a soft sleeve, an external thread sleeve is fixedly sleeved at one side of the whole body of the earplug main body, an inserting block is fixedly arranged at one side of the earplug main body, clamping grooves are formed in the upper side and the lower side of the inserting block, an internal thread sleeve is fixedly sleeved at one side of the inner wall of the soft sleeve, an earhook is rotatably arranged at the center of the rear end of the connecting shell, a protective shell is rotatably arranged at the middle of the upper end and the lower end of the connecting shell, a mounting groove is formed in one side of the connecting shell, an inner groove is formed in the position, close to the upper side and the lower side, of the inner groove, and springs are fixedly arranged at the opposite sides of the two inner grooves. In the utility model, the earplug can be suitable for wearers with different auditory canal depths, is more comfortable when being worn, is not easy to fall off, can be detached from the mounting shell and is more convenient to use.

title_en: Appliance for correcting tongue inclination molar
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an appliance for correcting tongue tilting molar teeth, which comprises double-arm elastic arms, a plastic base, a double-curved lip bow and an arrow clasp, wherein the lip bow of the double-curved lip bow is welded on the cheek side of the clasp of the arrow clasp, the double-curved lip bow of the double-curved lip bow transversely crosses the tooth gap of a premolarized tooth, the arrow clasp is positioned on a first molar tooth, the plastic base is embedded in the tooth gap of a rear tooth, the whole of two arms of the double-arm elastic arms are of V-shaped structures, one end of each of the two arms is of an integrated structure, the other end of each of the two arms is of a hook-shaped structure, and the middle parts of the two arms are twisted into a spiral structure. The utility model utilizes the high elasticity characteristic of Australian silk to manufacture a double-arm elastic arm structure, and the structure has soft and durable strength, requires little space, is more comfortable, has a simple structure and is convenient for doctors to operate.

title_en: Dust-free material placement mechanism for dust-free cotton swab production
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a dust-free material placement mechanism for dust-free cotton swab production, which comprises a first power piece, a mounting frame, a third power piece, a first placement component and a second placement component, wherein the mounting frame is movably connected with the first power piece through the second power piece, the first placement component is movably connected with the mounting frame through a connecting piece, the third power piece is connected with the mounting frame, the third power piece is meshed with the connecting piece, a driven wheel is arranged on the connecting piece and meshed with the third power piece, a second hole is formed in the second placement component, and air pipe connectors are respectively arranged on the first placement component and the second placement component and are respectively communicated with the first hole and the second hole. The utility model provides a dust-free material placement mechanism for dust-free cotton swab production, which reduces the labor intensity, improves the working efficiency and improves the automation degree of workshops.

title_en: Special fixer for nuclear magnetic resonance examination
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of nuclear magnetic resonance fixtures, in particular to a special fixture for nuclear magnetic resonance examination, which comprises a main body mechanism, a detection mechanism and a filling mechanism, wherein the main body mechanism is movably arranged in the detection mechanism, the filling mechanism is fixedly arranged in the main body mechanism, the main body mechanism comprises an inflation gas, an air hole, a rubber tube, an inflation bag, a front rubber interlayer, a secondary and primary paste, a back rubber interlayer, a primary and secondary paste and friction lines, and the air hole is formed in one side of the inflation gas. The special fixer for nuclear magnetic resonance examination is characterized in that a main body is connected with an inflatable bag through a rubber tube, and the main body can be inflated through the inflatable bag. The main body is provided with a section of primary-secondary paste at two ends respectively, the primary-secondary paste can be overlapped and pasted to play a role in fixation, the fixer is designed into a series according to the size and shape of the nuclear magnetic resonance coil, and the contact surface of the corresponding fixer and the nuclear magnetic resonance coil can be provided with a primary-secondary paste pasting layer to fix the device on the coil and can be easily taken down.

title_en: Wheelchair armrest mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wheelchair armrest mechanism, which is used for a seat hinged with a seat back and comprises an armrest assembly, a first armrest connecting piece and a second armrest connecting piece, wherein the middle part of the armrest assembly is hinged with the seat back, one end of the first armrest connecting piece is hinged with the armrest assembly, one end of the second armrest connecting piece is hinged with the seat, the other end of the second armrest connecting piece is hinged with the other end of the first armrest connecting piece, and when the seat back rotates around the seat, one end of the armrest assembly is connected with the first armrest connecting piece and the second armrest connecting piece and is suitable for rotating along with the seat back in a linkage way by taking a hinge point on the seat back as a center. The utility model can realize the linkage of the armrests along with the chair back, can naturally place the handle arms on the armrests in a back lying state, can open the armrests at any angle of the rotation of the chair back, and does not interfere the folding of the chair back at any angle of the opening of the armrests.

title_en: Support for dressing change of orthopedics department
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a support for dressing change of orthopaedics, which relates to the technical field of nursing supports and comprises a support frame, wherein the top end of the support frame is connected with a collecting frame, a support plate is symmetrically connected to the middle position above the collecting frame, the top ends of the support plates are connected through a support plate, and holes are uniformly formed in the support plate. According to the utility model, through the arrangement of the holes and the collecting frame, in the use process, the flowing disinfection water can be collected in a concentrated way through the arrangement of the holes, so that the disinfection water can be effectively prevented from directly falling to the ground, and can be prevented from being sputtered onto shoes of medical staff, so that the shoes of the medical staff are prevented from being polluted.

title_en: Neck and shoulder fixing splint for bone fracture patient
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of neck and shoulder treatment, and discloses a neck and shoulder fixing splint for a patient with bone fracture, which comprises a support frame plate, wherein a first chute is formed in the inner side of the support frame plate, sliding blocks are connected to the two sides of the inner side of the first chute in a sliding manner, shoulder nail fixing frames are fixedly connected to the top ends of the sliding blocks, neck supporting frames are fixedly connected to the rear ends of the support frame plate, neck fixing frames are rotatably connected to the top ends of the neck supporting frames, movable rods are fixedly connected to the bottom ends of the sliding blocks, supporting blocks are fixedly connected to the two sides of the bottom end of the support frame plate, supporting sleeve assemblies are mounted on the lower sides of the supporting blocks, and separation moving assemblies are mounted in the supporting sleeve assemblies. According to the utility model, the device is fixed corresponding to the shoulder bones at two sides respectively, so that the device can be more attached to the shoulder bones at two sides of a patient, and the acceleration recovery of the patient can be promoted.

title_en: Cold compress device for nursing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cold compress device for nursing, which relates to the technical field of medical appliances and comprises a cold compress shell, wherein a first binding band is arranged on the side wall of the cold compress shell, a second binding band is arranged on the other side of the cold compress shell, a connecting magic tape is arranged on the top of the second binding band, a fixed magic tape is arranged at the bottom of the first binding band, a flow hole is formed in the bottom of the cold compress shell, and a sealing bag is arranged.

title_en: Wearable equipment
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a wearable device, which comprises a light emitting assembly, a first lens structure and a first interval structure, wherein the light emitting assembly comprises a first light emitting element and a second light emitting element which are arranged side by side, the first light emitting element and the second light emitting element have different luminous colors, the first lens structure is arranged on the light emitting side of the light emitting assembly, the first lens structure comprises a first lens part opposite to the first light emitting element and a second lens part opposite to the second light emitting element, the first interval structure is arranged between the first lens part and the second lens part, and the refractive index of the first interval structure is smaller than that of the first lens structure. By the design, the effectiveness of the light emitted by the first light emitting element and the light emitted by the second light emitting element is improved, so that the accuracy of the monitoring result of the wearable device can be effectively improved.

title_en: Spinal activity measuring device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a spine activity measuring device which comprises a base, a controller assembly, an electric push rod, a spine activity detecting assembly and a lifting connecting belt assembly, wherein the spine activity detecting assembly and the lifting connecting belt assembly are arranged, the connecting belt of the lifting connecting belt assembly is connected with the upper body of a person to be detected, then the person to be detected bends to the greatest extent, a rotating plate is driven to rotate, a gear II of a rotating angle detecting assembly rotates along a gear I, the rotating angle of the gear II is detected through an angle sensor of the rotating angle detecting assembly I, and when side bending data of the person are measured, the detector bends to the greatest extent to drive a transverse rotating plate to rotate, the rotating angle is detected through the angle sensor of the rotating angle detecting assembly II, and the maximum forward bending degree and the maximum side bending degree of the spine of the person are calculated according to the rotating angle.

title_en: Gynecological operation auxiliary instrument
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a gynecological operation auxiliary instrument, which relates to the technical field of medical auxiliary instruments, and adopts the technical scheme that: the gynecological operation auxiliary instrument has the beneficial effects that after the tray seat is moved to a proper position through the inner rod, the tray seat is changed into a mop, the movable block drives the disc to reset through the elastic force of the spring shrinkage, the disc enables the inner supporting rod to reset through the connecting seat, and then the inner supporting rod drives the inner rod to rotate, the protruding block is screwed into the new inner lining groove, so that the inner rod after the height is adjusted is limited by longitudinal movement, the height of the inner rod is prevented from changing under the natural condition, and simultaneously, when the height of the tray seat is adjusted, the tray seat can be operated by both hands, and the unstable operation of one hand is prevented.

title_en: Catheter traction fixing device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of medical instruments, in particular to a catheter traction fixing device which comprises a catheter, wherein the side wall of the catheter is movably connected with a fixing shell, the fixing shell comprises a bottom fixing seat and a top fixing belt, one side of the surface of the fixing belt is fixedly connected with a plurality of supporting rods, the tops of the supporting rods are fixedly connected with rubber balls, the other side of the fixing belt is provided with a plurality of positioning holes, the side wall of the catheter is movably connected with a tension detection box, the inside of the tension detection box is fixedly connected with an alarm device, and the joint of the inner wall of the tension detection box and the catheter is fixedly connected with a pressure sensor. According to the utility model, the catheter is fixed on a patient through the fixing shell, the fixing seat is propped against the glans of the patient, and the glans is fixed on the catheter in a relatively comfortable way through the fixing band by buckling the rubber ball into the proper positioning hole, so that the catheter is firmly fixed, and the catheter saccule can be continuously and stably pressed on the wound surface to stop bleeding.

title_en: Replaceable nasal mucosa drug delivery device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of medical supplies, in particular to a replaceable nasal mucosa drug delivery device which comprises a shell, an inner core and a spray nozzle, wherein a pressing pump is arranged in the middle of the upper end of the shell, the inner core is positioned in the shell and fixedly connected with the shell through a buckle, a drug outlet pipe is arranged in the middle of the upper end of the inner core, one end of the drug outlet pipe is communicated with the inner core, the other end of the drug outlet pipe is communicated with a liquid inlet of the pressing pump, a separation piece is arranged between the drug outlet pipe and the pressing pump, a spray pipe is connected at the liquid outlet of the pressing pump, the other end of the spray pipe is connected with the spray nozzle, the other end of the spray nozzle is closed, a plurality of spray holes I are formed in the side face of the spray nozzle, one closed end of the spray nozzle is in a round table structure, a plurality of spray holes II are formed in the side face of the round table, a bottle cap is arranged outside the spray nozzle, the lower end of the bottle cap is connected with the shell, and the spray nozzle is positioned in the bottle cap. The utility model reduces the irritation and discomfort of patients caused by the medicine ejection, improves the repeated utilization rate of the device, and reduces the pollution risk and waste of the medicine.

title_en: Unilateral local expansion image shelter
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of field medical equipment, and particularly relates to a unilateral local expansion image shelter which comprises a shelter body and a medical imaging unit, wherein the shelter body is in an unfolding state and a folding state, the inside of the shelter body is divided into a front equipment compartment and a rear working compartment through a partition board, the medical imaging unit comprises a CT machine, an X-ray machine and a color Doppler ultrasound machine, the CT machine, the X-ray machine and the color Doppler ultrasound machine are all arranged in the working compartment in the folding state, the rear part of a first side wall of the working compartment is outwards expanded to form a local expansion compartment in the unfolding state, the X-ray machine is arranged in the local expansion compartment, the CT machine and the color Doppler ultrasound machine are both arranged in the working compartment and can perform CT or color Doppler ultrasound inspection, and the CT machine and the X-ray machine are both arranged in the working compartment and can perform X-ray and color Doppler ultrasound inspection simultaneously in the unfolding state. The utility model aims to solve the contradiction between miniaturization and multifunctional requirements of the traditional image shelter.

title_en: Patient transferring bed
abstract_en: The application provides a patient transferring bed which comprises a bed body, wherein a lifting slide rail is arranged below the upper part of the bed body, at least two sliding frames are arranged on the lifting slide rail in a sliding mode, the sliding frames are used for storing a monitor and a defibrillator, and the sliding frames can slide on the lifting slide rail to drive the monitor or the defibrillator to move to the outer side of the bed body. In the patient transferring process, if the first-aid equipment is needed, medical staff can directly and manually drag the sliding frame, the sliding frame slides on the lifting sliding rail and drives the monitor or the defibrillator to move to the side edge of the bed body, and the medical staff can directly use the defibrillator to rescue the patient.

title_en: Tooth-flushing device
abstract_en: The application discloses a tooth flushing device which comprises a nozzle, a water tank, a pump body, a functional liquid tank and a damping piston, wherein the nozzle is provided with a liquid spraying port, the water tank is communicated with the liquid spraying port through a liquid conveying flow path, the pump body is arranged in the liquid conveying flow path and used for pumping water liquid in the water tank to the liquid spraying port through the liquid conveying flow path, the functional liquid tank comprises a tank body and the damping piston, the damping piston is movably arranged in the tank body and divides a space in the tank body into a first cavity and a second cavity, the first cavity is used for containing functional liquid, the first cavity is communicated with the liquid conveying flow path through the first communication flow path, when the pump body drives liquid in the liquid conveying flow path to flow, the pressure in the second cavity is higher than the pressure in the first cavity, and the pressure difference between the second cavity and the first cavity drives the damping piston to squeeze the space of the first cavity, so that the functional liquid flows into the liquid conveying flow path through the first communication flow path. The tooth cleaning device provided by the embodiment of the application has a good cleaning effect on the oral cavity, and the functional liquid directly flows to the infusion flow path, so that the output efficiency of the functional liquid is high, and the required waiting time is reduced.

title_en: Rehabilitation training device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rehabilitation training device, which belongs to the technical field of medical equipment and comprises a base, a training device main body, a sliding groove, a seat, a moving mechanism and a plug bush, wherein the training device main body is fixedly connected to the base, the sliding groove is formed in the base, the seat is arranged on the base, the moving mechanism is arranged in the sliding groove and connected with the seat, the moving mechanism comprises a moving assembly and a guiding assembly, the moving assembly and the guiding assembly are both arranged on the base, and the moving assembly is connected with the guiding assembly.

title_en: Wrist joint activity training ware
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wrist joint movement trainer, and belongs to the technical field of medical appliances. The utility model solves the problem that the training device in the prior art has low efficiency when being used for a patient needing to exercise the wrist joints of two hands, and comprises a left wrist joint training mechanism and a right wrist joint training mechanism which are arranged on a bearing mechanism, wherein the right wrist joint training mechanism comprises a base, a first rotating mechanism is arranged on the base, a second rotating mechanism is arranged on the first rotating mechanism, a palm model is arranged on the second rotating mechanism, a palm fixing mechanism is arranged on the palm model, the left wrist joint training mechanism and the right wrist shutdown training mechanism have the same structure, the palm model of the right wrist shutdown training mechanism is a left palm model, and the palm model of the left wrist shutdown training mechanism is a right palm model. The utility model can simultaneously train wrist joint movement of both hands of a patient, and improves training efficiency.

title_en: Negative pressure suction meter convenient for pressure regulation
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of medical equipment, and discloses a negative pressure suction meter convenient for pressure regulation, which comprises a lower shell, wherein an upper shell is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the lower shell through a bolt, a pressure meter is fixedly arranged at one side of the lower shell, a return spring is arranged between an arc-shaped piece and a fixed seat, an elastic piece seat is fixedly arranged at the lower end of the inner wall of the upper shell, a sealing ball is fixedly arranged in the elastic piece seat, the lower end of the inner wall of the upper shell is in sliding connection with a movable blocking piece, the movable blocking piece is in contact with the lower wall of the sealing ball.

title_en: Body fat measurement handheld electrode mounting structure of body weight scale
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of body fat measurement, in particular to a handheld electrode mounting structure for body fat measurement of a body weight scale, which comprises a handheld electrode and a handle. The hand-held electrode is connected with the handle, the handle is connected with the connecting seat, the connecting seat comprises a connecting part A and a connecting part B, the connecting part A is rotationally connected with the weighing scale, the connecting part A vertically rotates relative to the weighing scale, the connecting part B is rotationally connected with the handle connecting piece, the handle connecting piece is connected with the handle, the handle horizontally rotates relative to the connecting part B, a connecting end and a rotating end are arranged in the handle, the connecting end is connected with the handle connecting piece, and the rotating end is rotationally connected with the connecting end. The utility model can realize the adjustment of the height and the amplitude of the handheld electrode on one hand, so that the handheld electrode is suitable for people with different heights and body widths, and can adjust the angle of the handheld electrode on the other hand, so that the handheld electrode can be adjusted to the most comfortable posture when in use, and the use experience is improved.

title_en: Medical catheter fixing patch
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field related to medical instruments and discloses a medical catheter fixing patch which comprises an adhesive patch and a fixing component arranged on the surface of the adhesive patch, wherein an adhesive layer is arranged on the lower surface of the adhesive patch, the fixing component is composed of a fixing seat, the fixing seat is fixedly connected with the upper surface of the adhesive patch, a fixing groove with a circular section is formed in the middle of the fixing seat, an opening communicated with the fixing groove is formed in the upper end of the fixing seat, a plurality of air bag pipes are uniformly distributed on the inner wall of the fixing groove of the fixing seat, a mounting cavity is formed in the lower end of the fixing seat, and an adjusting mechanism is arranged in the mounting cavity and is communicated with the air bag pipes through an air duct. The utility model is applicable to fixing the catheters with different diameters, has simple structure, and is practical, convenient and quick.

title_en: Timing soaking equipment for exercise heart-lung test mask
abstract_en: The utility model provides a timing soaking device for a sports heart-lung test mask, which relates to the technical field of mask soaking boxes, wherein a control end is fixedly connected to the front end surface of the soaking box, a main body of the control end is a controller, a control screen is arranged on the controller, the inside of the control end at least comprises the controller and a timer, the problem that the mask is easy to deform due to excessive soaking when the mask is soaked for a long time due to lack of an effective timing taking-out structure in the conventional process of soaking for a long time is solved, the problem of limitation exists, the corresponding timing operation is performed by utilizing a timing module, and a driving piece arranged in the soaking box can be synchronously started to push a moving frame to the upper side after timing is finished, and the mask is driven to move to the upper side to be pulled out from the inside of the soaking box through a bearing box, so that the mask is prevented from being soaked for a long time and damage is caused.

title_en: Endoscope lens angle adjusting device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of endoscopes, and discloses an endoscope lens angle adjusting device which comprises an endoscope body and an operating platform, wherein a rotating ball is fixedly connected to the right side of the endoscope body, a rotating shell is rotationally connected to the outer wall of the rotating ball, a control seat is connected to the right side of the rotating ball through a rotating assembly, a control seat is connected to the right side of the outer wall of the rotating shell through a hose, the right side of the control seat is connected to the left side of the operating platform through a fixing assembly, knobs are rotationally connected to the two sides of the control seat, and a first lens and a first light supplementing lamp are arranged on the left side of the endoscope body. According to the utility model, through the mutual matching of the rotary knob, the rotary shaft, the control rope and the rotary ball, the rotary ball can drive the endoscope body to rotate, and the effect of changing the control seat is achieved through the mutual matching of the buckle and the clamping groove block, so that equipment with different pipe diameters can be changed according to different working conditions.

title_en: Tian moxibustion pot with reinforcing function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of physiotherapy equipment, in particular to a Tian-moxibustion pot with a reinforcing function, which comprises a pot body and a moxibustion piece, wherein the moxibustion piece is arranged on the inner side of the pot body, and the Tian-moxibustion pot also comprises a reinforcing component which is arranged on the pot body or the moxibustion piece and is used for increasing the tightness of the moxibustion piece applied on the skin surface.

title_en: Disposable developing single-hole multi-channel puncture outfit
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a disposable developable single-hole multichannel puncture outfit, in particular to the field of puncture outfits, which comprises a multichannel platform and a notch protection sleeve, wherein the notch protection sleeve is arranged below the multichannel platform, the upper surface of the multichannel platform is provided with a first sleeve assembly and a second sleeve assembly, one side of the second sleeve assembly is provided with two groups of ventilation pipes fixed on the multichannel platform, the ventilation pipes are provided with gas injection valve bodies, one side of each gas injection valve body is embedded and provided with a gas injection valve core, and the bottom end of the multichannel platform is sleeved with a developing belt. The utility model improves the prior structure, and the metal developing belt is arranged around the multichannel platform, and the metal component is contained in the developing belt material, so that the developing effect is achieved in an imaging instrument, the developing and positioning before or during operation can be conveniently realized, the existing developing mark film can be replaced, and the effect is similar to that of a developing film.

title_en: Membranous pressure sensor fixing mechanism and urethra endoscope device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of medical equipment, in particular to a film-shaped pressure sensor fixing mechanism and a urethra endoscope device, which comprises a sheath body assembly, a sensor assembly and an output assembly, wherein the sheath body assembly comprises a sheath handle and a sheath tube fixedly connected with the sheath handle, the front end of the sheath tube is provided with a water outlet, an embedded groove is formed in the sheath tube, a sliding groove is formed in the lower end of the embedded groove, a lifting groove is formed in the upper side of the embedded groove, the fixing assembly comprises a rotating piece movably connected with the sheath tube, a connecting piece movably connected with the rotating piece, a transmission piece movably connected with the connecting piece and a clamping piece movably connected with the rotating piece, the sensor assembly comprises a film-shaped pressure sensor and a connecting wire, the film-shaped pressure sensor is arranged on the embedded groove, and the output assembly comprises a pressure measuring instrument electrically connected with the film-shaped pressure sensor, so that the pressure sensor on the urethra endoscope device is easy to slide and fall off in an operation.

title_en: Endoscope mechanism and visual dental hand drill system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a speculum mechanism and a visual dental hand drill system. The endoscope mechanism comprises an endoscope assembly, a fixing piece and a rotating assembly, wherein the endoscope assembly comprises an endoscope, the fixing piece is provided with a fixing cavity, the endoscope penetrates through and is fixed in the fixing cavity, the rotating assembly comprises a rotating joint, an elastic piece and a sleeving clamp, the sleeving clamp is rotationally sleeved on the fixing piece, the sleeving clamp is sleeved on the endoscope, two ends of the elastic piece are respectively connected with the rotating joint and the sleeving clamp, and the rotating joint and the sleeving clamp are respectively movably sleeved on the endoscope. The utility model realizes quick connection and can ensure the connection stability through the rotating component, the fixing piece and the elastic piece.

title_en: Ultrasonic transduction assembly, probe tip and ultrasonic probe
abstract_en: The application provides an ultrasonic transduction assembly, a probe tip and an ultrasonic probe, and relates to the technical field of ultrasonic treatment. The ultrasound transducer assembly includes a main body coupled to a drive device via a coupling shaft, a therapeutic ultrasound transducer disposed on a first surface of the main body, the therapeutic ultrasound transducer configured to transmit ultrasound energy to a target region for therapy, and an imaging ultrasound transducer disposed on a second surface of the main body opposite the first surface, the imaging ultrasound transducer configured to transmit ultrasound energy to the target region and to receive ultrasound energy from the target region for imaging. The ultrasonic transduction component has smaller volume and is beneficial to preparing the ultrasonic probe with small volume.

title_en: Hair follicle picks up and planting device hand-held set
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a hair follicle picking and planting device handheld machine which comprises a device body, wherein the device body comprises a planting handle, a main shell, a top shell and a planting device, the planting device comprises a thimble, a mounting sliding block, a spring, an electromagnetic coil and a key, the thimble, the mounting sliding block, the spring, the electromagnetic coil and the key are sequentially arranged in the planting handle, the main shell and the top shell, a side surface of the planting handle is provided with a side inlet connector, the side inlet connector is of an L-shaped structure, and the planting handle and the side inlet connector are in smooth transition and are integrally processed and formed. The side is provided with an inserting connecting groove inside, the inserting connecting groove is of a circular structure, the bottom of the inserting connecting groove is provided with a side connecting pipe, the bottom of the side connecting pipe is connected with the side face of the thimble, and the side connecting pipe and the thimble are of a through structure. The device integrates the picking and planting functions, is simple and convenient to operate, improves the efficiency, reduces the working intensity of doctors and improves the planting effect.

title_en: Wrapping and supporting device for emergency nursing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wrapping and supporting device for emergency nursing, which relates to the technical field of emergency nursing equipment and comprises a base, wherein a sterilizing box is fixedly connected to the left part of the upper surface of the base, a sterilizing liquid box is fixedly connected to the left part of the upper surface of the sterilizing box, three sterilizing components are fixedly connected to the right side of the sterilizing liquid box, the outer walls of the lower parts of the three sterilizing components are respectively and fixedly connected with the upper part of an inner cavity of the sterilizing box, and a moving component is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the base and is positioned on the right side of the sterilizing box. According to the wrapping and supporting device for emergency nursing, the supporting component can be conveniently disinfected through the functions of the sliding rail and the movable table, the supporting component is disinfected and washed through the functions of the fixing plate, the disinfectant tank and the spray head, and the outer wall of the supporting component is further disinfected through the function of the disinfecting and washing device after the end of the disinfecting and washing device, so that the safety of the next use is ensured.

title_en: Gradient compression protective function socks
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of functional socks and discloses a gradient compression protection functional sock which comprises a sock main body and a compression sock leg, wherein the compression sock leg is arranged on the sock main body, a connecting cloth is fixedly sewn at the bottom end of the compression sock leg, a magic tape round surface is fixedly sewn at the inner side of the connecting cloth, a magic tape hook surface is fixedly sewn at the sock leg of the sock main body, and a first compression strip, a second compression strip and a third compression strip are fixedly sewn at the outer part of the compression sock leg. This gradient compression protection function socks can strengthen the blood circulation of shank through the first compression strip on the compression leg of a stocking, second compression strip and third compression strip, and the compression leg of a stocking is worn on the shank, then wears socks main part on the foot again, uses the magic on the connecting cloth to paste round face and socks main part on follow the magic and paste collude the face and connect, and this structure has realized being convenient for two and comfortable function, has solved the relatively poor and inconvenient problem of two wearing of travelling comfort.

title_en: Portable infusion rod structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a portable transfusion rod structure, which belongs to the technical field of medical appliances and comprises a hanging basket and a portable assembly, wherein the portable assembly comprises a telescopic rod, a tripod, a round rod, a spring, a rubber plate, a sleeve, a first fixing belt, a second fixing belt, a first primary-secondary magic tape and a second primary-secondary magic tape, the hanging basket is used for hanging a liquid medicine bottle, when a patient moves, the hanging basket can bypass the armpits through the first fixing belt, the rubber plate is backed up by the fixing position of the first primary-secondary magic tape, the second fixing belt bypasses a waist, the tail part of the rubber plate is prevented from tilting by the fixing position of the second primary-secondary magic tape, the telescopic rod is slidably arranged in the sleeve, so that the patient can bear the transfusion rod to move, the telescopic rod can slide and adjust the length according to the needs of the patient, the tripod is used for supporting the telescopic rod on the ground after being taken out of the rubber plate, and the tripod, the round rod and the spring form an umbrella-like opening and closing structure, and folding of the tripod are convenient for supporting.

title_en: 24-Hour drainage liquid metering device for hepatobiliary pancreas surgery
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field related to medical appliances, in particular to a 24-hour drainage liquid metering device for hepatobiliary pancreatic surgery, which comprises a drainage bottle, wherein one side surface of the drainage bottle is provided with scale marks, the lower surface of the drainage bottle is fixedly connected with a base, the upper surface of the drainage bottle is fixedly connected with an upper sealing seat, one side surface of the upper sealing seat is fixedly connected with a fixing ring, and the inner side surface of the fixing ring is slidably connected with a hanging hook. This 24 hours drainage liquid metering device of hepatobiliary pancreas surgery for liquid measurement is more accurate, and the drainage condition of the patient of being convenient for medical personnel monitoring and record, thereby improves the treatment, hangs hook and buckle and can carry out angle adjustment in a flexible way, with adaptation different service environment and user's demand, the threaded connection of bottle lid and drainage bottle and drainage tube and suction connector's threaded connection, has guaranteed the sealing performance of device, has avoided the leakage of drainage liquid, has ensured the security of use.

title_en: Surgical tool and surgical robot
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to the field of medical instruments, and discloses a surgical tool and a surgical robot. The surgical tool comprises a tool arm and a tool head, wherein the tool arm comprises an arm body and a first connecting part, the first connecting part is arranged at the distal end of the arm body, the tool head is used for being detachably connected with the tool arm, the tool head comprises a second connecting part which is detachably connected with the first connecting part, and an end instrument which is connected with the distal end of the second connecting part. Based on the method and the device, only the tool head of the surgical tool can be replaced under the condition that the surgical tool needs to be replaced, so that the cost for replacing the surgical tool can be reduced, and the safety and sanitation of the surgical tool can be improved.

title_en: Lung function apparatus detection device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a detection device of a lung function tester, which comprises a base, wherein a bottom tube is fixed on the upper surface of the base, a top tube is arranged at the top of the bottom tube, a top cover is fixedly connected to the top end of the top tube, a floating ball is slidably arranged in the top tube, a supporting component is arranged at the top end of the inside of the bottom tube, the floating ball is positioned above the supporting component, a hose is fixedly connected to the bottom of the supporting component, a perforation is formed in the side wall of the bottom tube, and the other end of the hose penetrates through the perforation and is fixedly connected with a blowing nozzle. According to the utility model, the bottom pipe, the top cover, the floating ball, the supporting component, the hose and the blowing nozzle are arranged, the supporting component comprises the cone hopper, the floating ball is supported by the cone hopper, when the device is used, the blowing nozzle blows air to the cone hopper, so that the floating ball is pushed to rise along the top pipe, and then the position of the floating ball is observed through scale marks on the side wall of the top pipe, so that the measuring operation is realized, the cone hopper is not easy to be blocked, and frequent cleaning is not needed when the device is repeatedly used.

title_en: Fall-preventing walking aid
abstract_en: The utility model provides an anti-falling walker, which belongs to the technical field of medical equipment and comprises a main body frame, wherein a guide device is arranged below the front part of the main body frame, a moving device is arranged at the bottom of the main body frame, at least two groups of guide devices are arranged, the guide device comprises a guide plate and a steering mechanism, the guide plate is positioned below the front part of the main body frame and is provided with a plane parallel to the ground, the steering mechanism is connected with the guide plate and the main body frame, the main body frame is provided with a handle, the handle is fixedly arranged at the top of the main body frame, the steering mechanism comprises a rotating shaft, a torsion spring and a locking device, the rotating shaft penetrates through the center of the guide plate and is fixedly connected with the main body frame, the torsion spring is sleeved on the rotating shaft, and the locking device is arranged at one end of the rotating shaft.

title_en: Deep wound packing dressing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a deep wound packing dressing, which belongs to the technical field of medical dressing, and comprises a dressing matrix made of alginate, and is characterized by also comprising a structural core which is fixedly connected in the dressing matrix and is made of fibrilia, and a microcapsule which is fixedly connected with the outer surface of the dressing matrix, wherein the structural core is arranged along the whole length direction of the dressing matrix, and the microcapsule comprises a capsule wall with an inner cavity for sealing active probiotics. The utility model has multiple functions of stopping bleeding, resisting bacteria, promoting wound healing, being easy to take out and the like, and has low manufacturing cost and high manufacturing efficiency because the utility model adopts a material fusion mode, brings good news for patients and has great popularization value.

title_en: Mask type foam dressing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mask type foam dressing, which relates to the technical field of medical dressings and comprises a dressing main body, wherein the dressing main body is elliptical, a mouth slot is formed in the lower side of the interior of the dressing main body, a nose slot is formed in the middle position of the interior of the dressing main body, eye slots are formed in the left side and the right side of the upper side of the interior of the dressing main body, eye adhesive tapes are arranged above the left side and the right side of the front of the dressing main body, and face adhesive tapes are arranged at the outer edge of the front of the dressing main body. The utility model is in the shape of a facial mask, can be matched with the face of a human body, is mainly used for protecting the skin of the face of a patient in a prone position in operation, can effectively prevent the problem of pressure damage to the skin of the face caused by long-time compression of the face of the patient due to the forced position in operation, can effectively solve the problems of no proper face specification foam dressing, no eye protection, shortened anesthesia time, inconvenient use and the like due to the special shape of the face, and can reduce the working pressure of nursing staff.

title_en: Traditional Chinese medicine pocket for treating gastritis
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of traditional Chinese medicine bags, and discloses a traditional Chinese medicine bag for treating gastritis, which comprises a bag body; the connecting assembly is fixedly connected to the outer side of the pocket body. The traditional Chinese medicine bag for treating gastritis is clamped on the inner surface of the embedded button by using a hidden buckle, a left connecting belt and a right connecting belt are installed and connected to tightly attach the bag body to the abdomen, the left connecting belt and the right connecting belt are worn on two shoulders by using elastic belts on two sides and are adhered to hook-face magic tapes by using a rough-face magic tape, the left connecting belt and the right connecting belt are fixed on the front face of the elastic belt, the effect of hot compress caused by falling of the bag body can be avoided, the medicine bag is heated by a heating bag, the absorptivity of a human body to the medicine is improved, the medicine efficacy is enabled to act on the abdomen slowly and permanently, the purpose of treatment is achieved, moisture and sweat on the surface layer of skin are rapidly absorbed by auxiliary fabrics arranged, and the moisture and sweat are instantly discharged out of the body through exhaust holes, so that the dryness of the skin around hot compress is kept.

title_en: Infusion support for home care
abstract_en: The application provides an infusion support for home care, and belongs to the field of nursing professions. The infusion support for home care is designed for a bed body of a frame-type structure for home care, the bottom of a hanging rod penetrates through a first fixing sleeve of a locating buckle plate and a second fixing sleeve of a connecting piece, then the locating buckle plate is buckled on the outer upper corner of a frame of a bed frame, a locking buckle plate is buckled on the inner lower corner of the frame of the bed frame, then the position of the connecting piece on the hanging rod is adjusted, so that the connecting piece is opposite to the locking buckle plate and is fixed, the locating buckle plate and the frame of the locking buckle plate are tightly held and fixed, the hanging rod is stably erected on the side of the bed, and triangular supports are not required to be arranged on the ground, so that tripping personnel are avoided.

title_en: Medical check valve
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a medical one-way valve, which belongs to the technical field of medical instruments and comprises a valve shell, wherein one end of the valve shell is provided with a front end fluid channel, the other end of the valve shell is provided with a rear end fluid channel, the interior of the valve shell is also provided with a containing cavity, an elastic component is arranged in the containing cavity formed by the valve shell and comprises a first support column, a second support column and a reset spring, and one end of the second support column is connected in the first support column in a sliding manner on the outer diameter of the second support column. In the practical use process, the utility model can better adapt to medical fluids with different viscosities and chemical properties, can be used in various different medical scenes, can play a good one-way control role no matter blood, liquid medicine, tissue fluid or gas is treated, greatly improves the universality of the one-way valve, and reduces the demands of medical institutions on various one-way valves with different types.

title_en: Animal doctor uses multi-functional medical vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of medical treatment, in particular to a multifunctional medical vehicle for veterinarian, which comprises a vehicle body, wherein a supporting plate is fixedly arranged on a rear seat of the vehicle body, a first box body, a second box body and a third box body are arranged above the frame body, folding assemblies are arranged at two sides of the frame body, the folding assemblies are used for unfolding and stacking the box bodies, an inclination assembly is arranged below the frame body, the inclination assembly is used for inclining the box bodies, a disinfection assembly is arranged at two sides of the frame body, and the disinfection assembly is used for disinfecting the box bodies. Compared with the prior art, the folding, tilting and sterilizing assembly is arranged, so that the storage space is saved, the carrying and the transportation are convenient, the space utilization rate is improved, the taking angle is optimized, the visibility and the taking and placing efficiency of medical appliances are improved, the operation difficulty is reduced, the real-time sterilization is realized, the sanitary safety of the medical appliances is ensured, the cross contamination is avoided, the sterilization time is saved, and the medical efficiency is improved.

title_en: Large honeyed pill slitting device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a large honeyed pill cutter, which relates to the technical field of honeyed pill cutting tools, and comprises a first outer box body and a second outer box body, wherein the first outer box body is connected with the second outer box body through a flexible connecting belt, a cutting combined plate is fixedly connected on the second outer box body, the utility model cuts the large honeyed pills in a round cake shape through the cutting combined plate, the continuous approach of the cutting combined plate can be gradually inserted into a combined groove, and the riser of cutting the composite board and the upper end of a plurality of ring plates all set up to the cusp shape, consequently can imbed in the composite groove well to this accomplishes the cutting to big honeyed bolus effectively, only uses the smooth cutting board cutting when changing traditional cutting, and appears cutting incompletely and the circumstances of adhesion, guarantees that big honeyed bolus cuts the big honeyed bolus of back formation complete piece of small piece, does not need manual tearing not cut complete big honeyed bolus.

title_en: Microneedle drug delivery device integrated with heating module
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of microneedle drug delivery, and provides a microneedle drug delivery device integrated with a heating module, which comprises a fixed seat, wherein a mounting groove is formed in the fixed seat, and at least one side of the mounting groove is provided with an opening; the micro-needle assembly can be inserted into the mounting groove or pulled out of the mounting groove from the opening, a micro-needle array is arranged on one surface of the micro-needle assembly, which is away from the fixing seat, and the heating module is connected with the fixing seat and is positioned on one side of the micro-needle assembly, which is away from the micro-needle array. The utility model can overcome the defects that the existing microneedle drug delivery device only comprises basic drug delivery function, and the microneedles and the drugs in the microneedles are difficult to replace, so that the drug absorption rate is low, the treatment time is long, the treatment cost is high and the universality is poor.

title_en: Four-limb joint activity training instrument
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a limb joint mobility training instrument, and relates to the technical field of training. The utility model comprises a base, wherein a deck chair is fixedly connected to the surface of the base, a sliding plate is connected between two sides of the base in a sliding manner, a mounting seat is fixedly connected to the surface of the sliding plate, a worm wheel is connected between inner walls of two sides of the mounting seat in a rotating manner, a rotating frame is fixedly connected to two sides of the worm wheel, a pedal is connected to one side of the rotating frame in a rotating manner, two guide rails are fixedly connected to the surface of the base, a sliding seat is connected to the guide rails in a sliding manner, a first supporting rod and a second supporting rod are respectively connected to two ends of the sliding seat in a rotating manner, and the second supporting rod is respectively connected with the rotating frame in a rotating manner. According to the utility model, when the four limbs are trained, arms and legs can be trained simultaneously, the linkage effect during training is increased, the cost of equipment is reduced, and meanwhile, the second arm support can swing under the cooperation of the corrugated plate and the ejector rod, so that the use flexibility is improved, and the training effect is increased.

title_en: Ablation device
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of medical appliances and provides an ablation device which comprises an operating mechanism, a catheter, a hollow ablation needle, a detachable assembly and a detachable assembly, wherein the operating mechanism comprises an operating support main body and a needle inlet tube arranged on the operating support main body, the proximal end of the catheter is arranged in the operating support main body, the hollow ablation needle is movably arranged in the needle inlet tube, the operating support main body and the catheter in a penetrating mode, the distal end of the hollow ablation needle can extend out of the catheter or retract back into the catheter, an axially-through needle channel is formed in the hollow ablation needle, the hollow ablation needle can conduct ablation operation and puncture biopsy and collect biopsy tissues through the needle channel, and the hollow ablation needle is detachably connected with the needle inlet tube through the detachable assembly so that the hollow ablation needle can be separated from the operating mechanism and the catheter.

title_en: Storage box for edge tool
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of medical instruments and discloses a sharp instrument storage box which comprises a box body, wherein a retainer is fixedly arranged between front and rear inner side walls of the box body, a sharp instrument connecting frame is connected inside the retainer in a sliding manner, a clamping member which is clamped with the sharp instrument connecting frame is fixedly arranged on the top wall of the inner side of the box body, a tag frame is fixedly arranged on the top of the box body, a contact spring is fixedly arranged on the left inner side wall of the box body, a contact piece which is in sliding connection with the box body is fixedly connected with the other end of the contact spring, a V-shaped contact is fixedly arranged on the left inner side wall of the box body, an indicating lamp group which is connected with the contact piece and the V-shaped contact is fixedly arranged on the top of the tag frame, and an ultraviolet lamp group is fixedly arranged on the left inner side wall of the box body. The sharp instrument storage box has the advantage of being convenient for classifying and storing various sharp medical instruments.

title_en: Synthetic resin tooth processing demolding structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of resin tooth processing and discloses a synthetic resin tooth processing demolding structure, which comprises a mounting plate and further comprises a supporting seat arranged at the bottom of the mounting plate, wherein a protective shell is fixedly connected to the top of the mounting plate, a limiting plate is fixedly connected to an inner cavity of the protective shell, a shaking rod is slidably connected to an inner cavity of the limiting plate, a pulley is fixedly connected to one end of the shaking rod, a placing shell is fixedly connected to one end of the shaking rod, a placing groove is fixedly connected to the inner cavity of the placing shell, a mold filled with resin teeth is placed in the placing groove, a cover plate and the placing shell are closed through a buckle, the mold in the placing shell is driven to shake through a vibrating assembly, looseness is generated between the resin teeth and the mold through shaking, and then the resin teeth are poured out of the mold through workers, so that time and labor are saved, and production quality is improved.

title_en: Microwave ablation needle suitable for thyroid gland
