abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of medical instruments and discloses a microwave ablation needle suitable for thyroid, which comprises a needle rod, a connection structure, an inner sealing ring, an outer sealing ring and a handle, wherein the connection structure is detachable and arranged at one end of the needle rod, the inner sealing ring is arranged on the connection structure and used for sealing, the outer sealing ring is arranged on the connection structure and used for sealing, the handle is arranged on the connection structure and used for connecting and fixing the needle rod and the handle, the connection structure comprises a connection cap, the connection cap is arranged at one end of the needle rod, the inner sealing ring is arranged in the connection cap, a connection seat is arranged on the connection cap, and the connection seat is fixedly connected with the handle. The utility model is convenient for the disassembly and separation of the handle and the needle bar, and is also convenient for the disinfection of the needle bar after the operation.

title_en: Electrolytic water module and sprayer
abstract_en: The utility model provides an electrolytic water module, which comprises a shell with an electrolytic cavity, wherein an electrode lamination body is arranged in the electrolytic cavity, the electrode lamination body comprises a first electrode, an ion exchange membrane and a second electrode, the ion exchange membrane divides the electrolytic cavity into a first cavity and a second cavity, the first electrode is arranged in the first cavity, the second electrode is arranged in the second cavity, a gap is reserved between the ion exchange membrane and the side wall of the electrolytic cavity, the first cavity is communicated with the second cavity through the gap, and the second electrode is movably covered with the gap.

title_en: Intramedullary broken rod taking-out device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of medical equipment, in particular to an intramedullary broken rod taking-out device which comprises an inner clamping drawing part and an outer clamping fixing part, wherein the lower end of the outer clamping fixing part is clamped and fixedly arranged on the outer side of the upper end of a long bone of a patient, and an outer tensioning part capable of fixing the opening size of the outer clamping fixing part is arranged on the outer side of the upper part of the outer clamping fixing part. The device has reasonable and compact structure and convenient use, the long bone of a patient is clamped and fixed by the outer clamping and fixing part, the upper end of the broken rod (namely the broken nail or the broken handle) is clamped and fixed by the inner clamping and drawing part, the broken rod can be gradually drawn upwards by the inner clamping and drawing part matched with the outer clamping and fixing part to act, and finally the broken rod is taken out from the bone marrow cavity of the long tube of the patient.

title_en: Scratch-proof chest piece protection patch
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of chest radiography protection, and provides an anti-scratch chest radiography protection patch which comprises a edging sleeve, a flexible pad, a roller and a roller, wherein the horizontal section of the edging sleeve is U-shaped, the vertical section of the edging sleeve is C-shaped, the edging sleeve is sleeved on three side edges of a chest radiography plate, which are sequentially adjacent, the flexible pad is U-shaped after being wound on the outer side of the middle part of the edging sleeve, the upper surface of the flexible pad is used for being in contact with the back of a human body, the chest radiography plate moves relative to the flexible pad, the chest radiography plate moves and then enters the lower part of the back of the human body, the roller is positioned between the flexible pad and the chest radiography plate, the roller is in rolling abutting joint with the lower surface of the flexible pad, and the roller is in rolling abutting joint with the upper surface of the chest radiography plate. Through the technical scheme, the problem that the chest plate inserted below the back is easy to scratch and block is solved.

title_en: Catheter assembly convenient for bladder irrigation
abstract_en: The utility model provides a catheter assembly convenient for bladder irrigation, which comprises a catheter, a switching type plug and an injector, wherein the switching type plug consists of a truncated cone body, a liquid discharge pipe, a suction pipe and a spherical non-return mechanism which are integrally formed. The front end of the truncated cone body is detachably connected with the tail end of the catheter, the side wall of the truncated cone body is connected with the suction pipe, the tail end of the truncated cone body is detachably connected with the injector through the suction pipe, and the nipple of the injector drives the spherical non-return mechanism in the truncated cone body to be opened or closed in the process of connecting the suction pipe in a plugging manner. The catheter assembly provided by the utility model can greatly facilitate the flushing of bladder blood clots, can effectively improve the stability of the sealing connection between the switching type plug and the catheter, avoids the occurrence of urine leakage caused by poor fixation, and can realize that the suction tube is always in a blocking state when the syringe is not inserted by adopting a spherical non-return mechanism with a specific structural design, thereby further preventing urine leakage.

title_en: Intracardiac ultrasonic type myocardial biopsy device
abstract_en: The utility model provides an intracardiac ultrasonic type myocardial biopsy device which comprises an intracardiac ultrasonic assembly and a myocardial biopsy assembly. The intracardiac ultrasonic assembly comprises an ultrasonic catheter, an ultrasonic handle, a sensor base and an ultrasonic sensor, wherein an ultrasonic detection surface of the ultrasonic sensor and the axis of the ultrasonic catheter form an adjustable included angle. Wherein the myocardial biopsy assembly comprises a biopsy catheter, a biopsy handle and a biopsy forceps member that can be opened or closed to enable sampling of a sample. The ultrasonic detection area of the intracardiac ultrasonic type myocardial biopsy device can cover the sampling area, so that accurate sampling is realized.

title_en: Printing support frame for knee joint postoperative rehabilitation
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a printing support frame for knee joint postoperative rehabilitation, which is characterized in that two sickbed guardrail fixing brackets are sleeved on a telescopic rectangular beam, limiting protrusions are arranged at two ends of the telescopic rectangular beam, a knee joint rehabilitation inverted V-shaped bracket is sleeved on the telescopic rectangular beam and is positioned between the two sickbed guardrail fixing brackets, a rectangular through hole which is attached to the telescopic rectangular beam is formed in the middle of a leg support plate base of the knee joint rehabilitation inverted V-shaped bracket, a positioning knob is arranged in the middle of the upper surface of the leg support plate base through a screw hole, semi-through grooves are respectively formed in the front and rear of the leg support plate base, and the lower ends of leg support plate elastic support posts are arranged through damping rotating shafts.

title_en: Portable skin moisturizing equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of skin moisturizing equipment and discloses portable skin moisturizing equipment, which comprises a face sprayer, wherein a liquid storage tank is arranged at the top end of the face sprayer, a spray opening is arranged on the front end face of the face sprayer, a control button is arranged below the front end face of the face sprayer close to the spray opening, a plurality of fixed supports are fixedly arranged on the outer surface of the face sprayer, movable supporting legs are movably arranged in the fixed supports, guide sliding grooves are formed in two sides of the inner wall of the fixed supports, lower limit grooves are formed in the bottoms of the guide sliding grooves, upper limit grooves are formed in the tops of the guide sliding grooves, and fixed protruding rods are welded on the two sides of the tops of the movable supporting legs extending to the guide sliding grooves.

title_en: Urine drainage collection device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of urine collection devices, in particular to a urine drainage collection device. The technical scheme includes that the urine collecting and draining device is hollow, a liquid suction channel is formed in the upper surface of the urine collecting and draining device, a separation baffle plate is fixedly arranged in the urine collecting and draining device and divides the urine collecting and draining device into a liquid drainage cavity and a negative pressure guiding cavity, the negative pressure guiding cavity is communicated with the liquid suction channel, a negative pressure pipe body penetrates through one end of the urine collecting and draining device, one end of the negative pressure pipe body is communicated with the liquid drainage cavity, one end of the negative pressure pipe body penetrates through the separation baffle plate and is communicated with the negative pressure guiding cavity, and a plurality of negative pressure suction ports are formed in the upper surface of the urine collecting and draining device. The utility model can form adsorption effect around the skin of a patient, avoid falling off, simultaneously lead urine to flow out without interference, and promote the effect of urine drainage and collection.

title_en: Device for local perfusion of cryogenic liquid through internal carotid artery
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a device for local perfusion of low-temperature liquid through internal carotid artery, which relates to the technical field of arterial perfusion of low-temperature liquid and comprises a heat preservation box body and a heat preservation box cover, wherein a temperature control mechanism is arranged on the heat preservation box cover, an injection pump is arranged in the heat preservation box body, an injector is arranged on the injection pump, a PE injection tube is inserted into a nipple of the injector, one side of the heat preservation box body is provided with a cold preservation mechanism, a plurality of ice bags are placed in the heat preservation box body, the injection is maintained in a low-temperature state through the ice bags, the temperature control mechanism and the cold preservation mechanism, and the low-temperature injection is used for local injection, so that complications possibly caused by whole body cooling are avoided.

title_en: Vascular intervention robot integrated system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a vascular intervention robot integrated system which comprises a display device, a master end operator, a slave end robot, a preoperative planning device and an image device, wherein the master end operator, the slave end robot, the preoperative planning device and the image device are all connected with the display device, the master end operator is in communication connection with the slave end robot, the master end operator is provided with an operating mechanism for controlling the slave end robot to control a medical instrument, the slave end robot controls the medical instrument under the control of the operating mechanism and sends an instrument state signal to the display device, the image device is used for collecting an image signal of a specific object and sending the image signal to the display device, the preoperative planning device is used for collecting a preoperative planning signal of the specific object and sending the preoperative planning signal to the display device, and the display device is configured to carry out combined display on images corresponding to the instrument state signal, the image signal and the preoperative planning signal, so that an operator can clearly observe the conditions of the specific object in and before an operation on one display device.

title_en: Eye massage instrument
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of massage instruments, in particular to an eye massage instrument which comprises a massage shell and a massage head group, wherein the massage head group is arranged in the massage shell and comprises a flexible circuit board and a plurality of massage head structures, each massage head structure is positioned on the flexible circuit board and connected with the flexible circuit board, and one end of the flexible circuit board is connected with a power supply to drive the plurality of massage head structures to perform massage actions. The structure design of a plurality of massage head structures and a flexible circuit board is adopted in the scheme, so that the effects of reducing the use of an integral connector and a connecting wire, reducing the integral volume of the massage instrument, improving the safety of the massage instrument in the use process, improving the production efficiency of mass production and reducing the production cost are achieved.

title_en: Prostate stent and implantation system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of medical appliances, and discloses a prostate support and an implantation system. The prostate support comprises a support body and a positioning part, wherein the support body comprises three cutting parts which are arranged in parallel at intervals, the distal ends of every two adjacent cutting parts are connected by a front supporting part, the proximal end of each cutting part is connected with a rear supporting part, one or more convex teeth are arranged on the outer side of at least one cutting part, and the positioning part is used for connecting and fixing the three rear supporting parts together and can position the implantation direction of the prostate support. The bracket body is hollow and columnar, and can support an affected part. The convex teeth can be abutted with the inner wall of the affected part, so that the prostate support can be effectively prevented from being displaced, and meanwhile, an operator is not required to adjust the angle, so that the operation difficulty is reduced. The positioning part can be used for positioning the implantation direction of the prostate stent while realizing the connection of the stent body, so that the prostate stent can be conveniently taken and placed.

title_en: Traction frame
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of medical instruments and discloses a traction frame which comprises a supporting frame, wherein an A supporting cross rod is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the supporting frame. This traction frame, through disc, A bolt, A support frame, A runner, B support frame, B runner, C support frame, C runner, B bolt and the setting of B nut, when medical personnel used traction frame for the fracture patient, can twist the B nut on the disc, take out the B bolt, then unscrew the A nut on the A bolt, adjust the angle of A support frame and A runner, so that pull patient's shank fracture department according to patient's condition, also can carry out angle adjustment to B support frame and B runner simultaneously according to patient's condition, C support frame and C runner are fixed on B support frame, can angle regulation equally, make medical personnel carry out a plurality of angles and many-way traction according to patient wound condition.

title_en: Surgical instrument
abstract_en: The present disclosure discloses a surgical instrument comprising a body, a rotating housing rotatably coupled to the body, a cannula assembly having a portion received in the rotating housing, a jaw assembly, a push rod coupled to the jaw assembly, the jaw assembly rotating relative to the cannula assembly in response to proximal or distal movement of the push rod, a drive mechanism including a motor and a lead screw nut structure, the lead screw drive nut moving proximally or distally in response to rotation of the motor to drive the push rod to move proximally or distally, the motor disposed along a first axis, the lead screw disposed along a second axis, the first axis being parallel to the second axis, a projection of the lead screw at least partially falling on the motor in a direction from the second axis to the first axis, the first axis and the second axis each being arranged circumferentially about the cannula assembly. The arrangement makes the layout of the driving mechanism in the rotary shell reasonable, and avoids the interference of the driving mechanism with the sleeve assembly or the rotary shell or the situation that the outer diameter of the rotary shell needs to be increased.

title_en: Measurement device for myodynamia of labialis
abstract_en: The application discloses a device for measuring the myodynamia of labialis, which particularly relates to the field of measuring instruments, and comprises two force transducers, a sensor assembly and a sensor assembly, wherein each force transducer is connected with a lip positioning piece and is used for collecting the myodynamia of labialis transmitted by the lip positioning piece; the device comprises a lip positioning piece, a central positioning piece, a display module and a display module, wherein the lip positioning piece is arranged on the periphery of the lip positioning piece, the central positioning piece is arranged between two force transducers, and the central positioning piece extends outwards to form one end of the lip positioning piece. The lip positioning piece is detachably connected with the force transducer and the first positioning block through the connecting piece, and can realize the measurement of the muscle force of the lips on the upper side, the lower side, the left side and the right side after replacing the connecting piece and the first positioning block, thereby improving the applicability of the measuring device.

title_en: Device for shaping coronary stent
abstract_en: The utility model provides a device for shaping a coronary artery stent, which is of a hollow tubular structure, wherein one end of a tube is provided with a U-shaped or nearly U-shaped notch, the inner diameter of the hollow tubular structure is 1.05-1.25 times of the outer diameter of the unexpanded coronary artery stent, the length of the hollow tubular structure is greater than the length of the unexpanded coronary artery stent, the depth of the notch is greater than or equal to the height of a single-circle mesh of the stent, and the width of the notch is less than or equal to the outer diameter of the unexpanded stent and is greater than or equal to the width of a single mesh. The stent shaping device provided by the utility model can obviously reduce the risks of stent deformation and damage, reduce the risk of stent unloading and improve the success rate of stent implantation operation.

title_en: Blood taking needle protection device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of blood taking needles and discloses a blood taking needle protection device which comprises a blood taking needle, wherein the blood taking needle is connected with a blood taking device through a hose, the right side of the blood taking needle is fixedly connected with a pushing piece, holes are formed in the upper side and the lower side of the pushing piece, a hollow tube is arranged on the outer side of the blood taking needle, an opening is formed in the right side of the hollow tube, the right side of the pushing piece penetrates through the opening, the upper end and the lower end of the right side of the hollow tube are fixedly connected with fixing columns, the right end of each fixing column is fixedly connected with a connecting rope, and the right end of each connecting rope is fixedly connected with a blocking block. According to the utility model, the sliding blocks are in sliding connection with the corresponding sliding grooves, the pushing sheets are matched with the through openings to slide, so that the pushing sheets drive the blood taking needle to be inserted into subcutaneous tissue to take blood, the blocking blocks are matched with the corresponding holes to block the blood taking needle, the blood taking needle is protected by the hollow tube after taking blood, infection caused by puncture wound of the blood taking needle is avoided, and later classification treatment is facilitated.

title_en: Arc cuts bone baffle on ankle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an arc-shaped bone cutting guide plate on an ankle, which belongs to the field of medical appliances and comprises a plate, a sliding part and a sliding part, wherein the plate is provided with a first positioning hole and a long strip hole in a penetrating mode, the first positioning hole is not overlapped with the long strip hole, the sliding part can be connected with the long strip hole in a sliding mode along a moving direction, the sliding part is provided with a second positioning hole in a penetrating mode, and the central axis of the second positioning hole is parallel to the central axis of the first positioning hole. The outer wall of the plate is also provided with scale marks which are convenient for a user to clearly determine the distance between the first positioning hole and the second positioning hole along the movement direction. Through the arrangement, the utility model can provide positioning and guiding for a user to draw the accurate osteotomy radius according to the measuring and calculating value in the process of arc osteotomy on the ankle.

title_en: Ophthalmic examination lying position assistor
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of ophthalmic examination, in particular to an ophthalmic examination lying position aid. The technical scheme includes that the ophthalmic examination lying position aid comprises a control box, a headrest is arranged at one end of the control box, a base plate is arranged at one end, deviating from the headrest, of the control box, a rotating shaft is rotatably arranged in the control box, a worm is arranged on the rotating shaft, a connecting block is arranged at the bottom end of the headrest, a connecting shaft is inserted into the connecting block, a turbine is arranged at one end, located in the control box, of the connecting shaft, and the rotating shaft is meshed with the turbine of the connecting shaft through the worm, so that the connecting shaft is driven to rotate, and the headrest connected with the connecting shaft is driven to deflect. According to the utility model, the rotating shaft is driven to rotate through the hand wheel, so that the worm is driven to be meshed with the turbine, and the deflection adjustment of the headrest can be realized. The design ensures that doctors can easily adjust the head angle of patients according to the examination demands, thereby improving the flexibility and accuracy of examination.

title_en: Otoscope degassing unit of self-baking
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a self-drying otoscope disinfection device, which comprises a box body, wherein a shielding plate for reducing water flow sputtering is arranged in the box body, a drying table is arranged in the shielding plate and connected with the box body, more than one damp eliminating hole is formed in the drying table, a fixed disc is connected to the drying table, more than one clamping component for clamping an electric otoscope is arranged on the fixed disc, and the number of the clamping components is the same as that of the damp eliminating holes and the positions of the clamping components are in one-to-one correspondence. More than one damp-eliminating holes are arranged in a circumferential array with equidistant axes of the drying table as datum lines. Through setting up a plurality of clamping assemblies, utilize clamping assemblies to carry out the centre gripping with electric otoscope and arrange the cooperation with the diversion that sets up in the device, spray the cleaning solution in all positions of electric otoscope, realize cleaning and disinfection to electric otoscope. Through setting up the drying bench of self-heating to insert the electron otoscope in the corresponding hole that dehumidifies, utilize the drying bench to evaporate the steam on electron otoscope surface and avoid its surface to produce water smoke.

title_en: Bone removal and nerve protection guide plate for sagittal split operation of mandible
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a bone removal and nerve protection guide plate for mandibular sagittal cleavage, and belongs to the field of medical appliances in surgical operations. The bone cutting device comprises a fixing part and a positioning part, wherein the fixing part is used for being fixed on a mandible, the positioning part is used for positioning a bone removing position, the fixing part and the positioning part are integrally formed, a positioning hole is formed in the positioning part, an osteotomy guiding surface and a nerve protection guiding surface are arranged on the side wall of the positioning hole, and the osteotomy guiding surface and the nerve protection guiding surface are connected in a sharing mode. Compared with the prior art, the guide plate can accurately position the deboning position of a patient, reduce the operation difficulty, realize accurate deboning, and simultaneously, the deboning and nerve protection guide plate can also utilize a nerve protection guide surface to help an operator to control the position of the lower alveolar nerve, avoid damaging the lower alveolar nerve during deboning, and improve the operation safety.

title_en: Needle aid for implanting an analyte sensor and analyte sensor implantation device
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of medical equipment, in particular to a needle aid for implanting an analyte sensor and an analyte sensor implanting device. Because the implantation frame moves towards the human body relative to the movable stop part under the action of the implantation elastic piece in the process of implanting the analyte sensor, after the analyte sensor is implanted, the restriction of the movable stop part of the implantation frame to the movable stop part is released, the movable stop part can move under the action of the needle return elastic piece, and the guide needle frame can overcome the stop action of the movable stop part to move in a direction far away from the human body, so that the guide needle is retracted into the shell assembly. Because the guide needle frame can overcome the stop action of the movable stop part and retract into the shell component, the retraction amount of the guide needle is larger, and the user is less likely to be injured.

title_en: Tissue partition pad beneficial to microvascular anastomosis
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tissue partition pad beneficial to microvascular anastomosis, which comprises a pad, wherein an air cushion is arranged on the inner wall of the pad, a bracket is arranged in the air cushion, two suture pads are arranged above the pad, and the two suture pads can be mutually adhered. The utility model relates to the technical field of vascular anastomosis, and the tissue separation pad favorable for the vascular anastomosis can play a role in physically separating tissues around blood vessels from vascular lumens through the matching of a gasket, an air cushion, a winding rope, a titanium alloy layer and a bracket, provide a relatively 'simple' anastomosis environment, effectively prevent some easily-coagulated substances, fat particles, adventitia and other tissues from entering the vascular lumens in the anastomosis process, prevent vascular embolism, and utilize the elasticity of the bracket to lead the tissue separation pad favorable for the vascular anastomosis to be outwards expanded all the time so as to avoid the phenomenon of vascular occlusion caused by extrusion of the tissue separation pad favorable for the vascular anastomosis.

title_en: Phototherapy hair-dryer
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a phototherapy blower. The portable type air conditioner comprises an air outlet barrel head and a handheld part which are connected, wherein the air outlet barrel head is annular, a penetrating light passing groove is formed in the annular opening of the middle part, a light wave generating device is arranged in the light passing groove, the light wave generating device emits light waves of a specified wave band along the axis direction of the light passing groove, an annular air cavity is arranged around the light passing groove, at least one end of the air outlet barrel head is provided with an air outlet, the annular air cavity is communicated with the air outlet, an air channel is arranged in the handheld part, one end of the air channel is communicated with the bottom of the annular air cavity, an air inlet is formed in the other end of the air channel, air sequentially enters the air channel and the annular air cavity through the air inlet, and is output from the air outlet along the peripheral side of the light passing groove. According to the utility model, the air outlet is separated from the light-passing groove, and the design of bottom air inlet is adopted, so that the hot air path and the light wave path are completely separated, and the potential damage of a heat source to the light wave generating device is effectively avoided.

title_en: Ultrasonic tooth cleaner with disinfection function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an ultrasonic tooth cleaner with a disinfection function, which comprises a shell, a bracket penetrating and fixed in the shell, a bottom cover fixed at the bottom of the shell, a control circuit board, an ultrasonic transducer, a battery, a tooth cleaning head and a protective cover, wherein the control circuit board, the ultrasonic transducer, the battery, the tooth cleaning head and the protective cover are arranged at the upper end of the ultrasonic transducer, the protective cover is sleeved at the upper end of the shell, the upper end of the shell is provided with an LED light-emitting module electrically connected with the control circuit board, the LED light-emitting module comprises a plurality of white light LED lamp beads and a plurality of purple light LED lamp beads, and the purple light LED lamp beads are positioned under the tip of the tooth cleaning head. The ultraviolet light LED lamp beads generate ultraviolet light to irradiate the tip of the tooth cleaning head for disinfection, so that the cleanliness of the tooth cleaning head is improved, and the LED light-emitting module is arranged at the upper end of the shell and is convenient to electrically connect with the control circuit board, so that the number of parts is small, the structure is simple, and the cost is low.

title_en: Child care bed capable of safely preventing falling
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a safe anti-drop child care bed which comprises a bed body, wherein bed head plates are arranged at two ends of the bed body, and the safe anti-drop child care bed also comprises cross bars which are oppositely arranged between the two groups of bed head plates, surrounding rods which vertically penetrate through the bed body are uniformly distributed at the bottoms of the cross bars, pushing plates which are connected with a plurality of groups of surrounding rods are movably arranged at the bottoms of the bed body, an adjusting assembly is connected between the pushing plates and the bed body and used for adjusting the height of the pushing plates, a fixing rod is vertically arranged at one end of the bed body, a clothes rack is movably arranged above the fixing rod, and a supporting assembly which is connected with the clothes rack is arranged on the fixing rod and used for supporting the clothes rack. The utility model belongs to the technical field of nursing beds, and particularly relates to a safe anti-falling child nursing bed.

title_en: Chest drainage bottle storage bag
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a chest drainage bottle storage bag which comprises a bag body, wherein the bag body is used for storing chest drainage bottles, a base is arranged at the bottom of the bag body, the base forms the bottom of the bag body, a profiling clamping groove matched with the bottom of the chest drainage bottles is formed in the top surface of the base, the whole gravity center of the bag body and the base is positioned on the base, an annular air bag is arranged around the inner wall of the bag body, the annular air bag is inflated or deflated through inflation or deflation, at least two circles of the annular air bag cover the upper part and the lower part of the chest drainage bottles are arranged on the annular air bag, an inflation and deflation nozzle communicated with the annular air bag is arranged outside the bag body, a longitudinal air bag penetrating the annular air bag is arranged on the inner wall of the bag body, the storage bag can be carried or hung on a wheelchair through a lifting handle, and can be hung on a trolley through a hook during transfer, the storage bag is convenient to use, the positioning of the chest drainage bottles is enhanced through the design of the inflatable annular air bag and the profiling clamping groove, the stability is improved, the whole structure is simple, the storage bag is convenient to clean, all parts of the storage bag can be disassembled conveniently, and cost is saved.

title_en: Orthopedics nursing traction frame
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of orthopedics nursing and discloses an orthopedics nursing traction frame which comprises a base table and a sickbed, wherein a supporting cylindrical rod is detachably connected to the top of the base table, two groups of symmetrical clamping assemblies are arranged on a vertical rod of the supporting cylindrical rod in a sliding mode, the supporting cylindrical rod is clamped and fixed at any one end position of two sides of the base table through the two groups of clamping assemblies, and a cross rod assembly positioned at the upper end of the clamping assembly is connected to the rod of the supporting cylindrical rod in a sliding mode.

title_en: Drilling device for orthopedic implant screw
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of medical instruments, in particular to a drilling device for orthopedic implant screws, which comprises a motor, wherein a top cover is arranged at the top of the motor, a sliding rail is arranged in the motor, a drilling machine is arranged in the sliding rail in a sliding manner, a drill bit is arranged at the bottom of the drilling machine, a protective sleeve is arranged at the bottom of the motor, the drilling machine is wrapped by the protective sleeve, the depth of a drilled hole of the device can be freely adjusted by the device through the structure, meanwhile, the slipping of a doctor in the using process is reduced by adding an anti-slip structure, the labor intensity of the doctor is greatly reduced by adding a mechanical arm structure, the condition that the operation effect is influenced due to fatigue is reduced, the condition that the device generates high heat in the working process, the necrosis of bone tissue is caused, the adverse effect is caused to the operation effect, and the additional pain and recovery time can be possibly brought to a patient, and the practicability and the flexibility of the device are increased.

title_en: Head cleaning tool for bedridden patient
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a head cleaning appliance for bedridden patients, which belongs to the technical field of on-bed washing and protecting, and comprises a basin and a headrest, wherein the headrest is arranged at the top of the basin, the basin and the headrest form a cleaning space with adjustable height, the cleaning space is used for supporting the head of the patient and receiving cleaning water, the headrest is an inflatable air cushion and is used for inflating the headrest according to the body shape of the patient, and the height of the cleaning space is adjusted.

title_en: Rehabilitation robot of coupling physiotherapy device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rehabilitation robot of a coupling physiotherapy device, which relates to the technical field of rehabilitation robots and comprises thigh bones, a joint box fixedly arranged at the lower end of the thigh bones, shank bones arranged below the joint box, a main shaft and a physiotherapy assembly, wherein the upper end of the shank bones is assembled in the joint box through the rotation of the main shaft, a driving assembly for driving the main shaft to rotate is arranged on the joint box, so that the included angle between the thigh bones and the shank bones can be changed, the physiotherapy assembly comprises a physiotherapy shell, the physiotherapy shell is arranged behind the joint box and extends to the rear of a knee of a human body, and the physiotherapy assembly is arranged.

title_en: Endoscope and endoscope assembly
abstract_en: An endoscope assembly comprises an endoscope and a guide tube sheath, wherein the endoscope comprises an endoscope tube, a camera, a light source and a light isolation member, the camera, the light source and the light isolation member are arranged at the distal end of the endoscope tube, the distal end face of the light isolation member protrudes out of the light emitting end face of the light source, the light isolation member can push against a light-transmitting lens at the distal end of the guide tube sheath when the endoscope tube is inserted into the guide tube sheath, the distal end of the guide tube sheath and/or the distal end of the endoscope are/is provided with a deformable structure, and the deformable structure can deform when the light isolation member pushes against the light-transmitting lens, so that the distal end face of the light isolation member is attached to the light-transmitting lens. The light-receiving surface of the camera is separated from the light-emitting end surface of the light source, so that light can be prevented from directly entering the camera through reflection of the light-transmitting lens, and support is provided for improving imaging quality, image definition and the like of the endoscope.

title_en: Ankle fixing brace
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an ankle fixing support, which comprises two symmetrically-distributed outer support plates, wherein two circular holes are formed in the side walls of the outer support plates in an array mode, a plurality of air holes are formed in the side walls of the outer support plates, first through holes are formed in the bottom ends of the outer support plates, two groups of symmetrically-distributed second through holes are formed in the side walls of one outer support plate, one group of symmetrically-distributed second through holes are formed in the side walls of the other outer support plate, the inner pad can form a curved surface which meets the surface of an ankle, namely, the inner side of the ankle is high and close to the front, the outer side of the ankle is low and close to the back, the inner pad and the ankle surface can be comfortably attached together, the binding band is wound around the outer sides of the two outer support plates, and the hook-and-loop fastener on the other end of the binding band is connected with the initial end back of the binding band, so that the two outer support plates are clamped, and the ankle fixing effect is convenient and comfortable.

title_en: Dental chair water supply system and dental chair
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a dental chair water supply system and a dental chair, which comprise a bracket, a water bottle, a diaphragm water pump, a peristaltic pump and a peristaltic pump, wherein one side of the bracket is fixedly connected with the dental chair, the water bottle is provided with a bottle mouth matched with a connecting thread section, the diaphragm water pump is hung at the top of the inner side of a cover body and is provided with a water suction pipe and a water outlet pipe, the water suction pipe penetrates through a convex cylinder and stretches into the water bottle, the water outlet pipe penetrates through the cover body and is connected with a first water end of the dental chair, the peristaltic pump is erected on the outer side of the cover body, one end of the water supply pipe is connected with an external saline bag and/or a sterile water container, and the other end of the water supply pipe is connected with a second water end of the dental chair. The utility model extracts distilled water suitable for general noninvasive restoration scenes (such as tooth preparation, restoration, tooth filling and the like) in the water bottle through the diaphragm water pump, and can supply sterile water through the peristaltic pump at the same time, so as to be used for invasive surgical operations such as tooth extraction, implantation, root canal treatment and the like, thereby meeting the water supply requirements of various scenes.

title_en: Cervical vertebra rehabilitation training device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a cervical vertebra rehabilitation training device, which relates to the technical field of medical equipment and comprises a moving mechanism, wherein the moving mechanism comprises a moving frame, and a lifting frame is arranged on the moving frame. According to the utility model, one end of the lifting frame is welded on the movable frame, then a worker can drive the power equipment and the movable wheels on the movable frame to move to a proper position by controlling the movable controller, then the worker can lift and adjust the adjusting plate frame butted by the butt-joint frame in the lifting frame by controlling the lifting controller, so that a patient to be treated can be supported for treatment, the lifting adjuster and the transverse limiter can correspondingly adjust the butt-joint frame, then the adjusting cylinder can be stretched by pulling the adjusting hand rest, the adjusting hand rest can be put down for hand setting, and then the patient only needs to lean on the neck supporting plate on the back rest.

title_en: Adjustable air port structure of portable inhalation device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an adjustable air inlet structure of a portable inhalation device, which comprises an inner tube and an outer tube, wherein an annular groove is formed on the peripheral surface of the inner tube, the outer tube is sleeved on the annular groove, the inner tube and the outer tube are coaxially arranged, the outer tube can rotate around the axis of the outer tube, a first air inlet hole is formed on the inner tube, a corresponding second air inlet hole is formed on the outer tube, the outer tube controls the overlapping area of the second air inlet hole and the first air inlet hole through rotation, the first air inlet hole and the second air inlet hole are opened at the corresponding positions of the inner tube and the outer tube, and the overlapping range of the first air inlet hole and the second air inlet hole is controlled through rotation of the outer tube, so that the fine control of the attraction force is realized, the replacement of parts or the use of preset gears are not needed, and the personalized requirements of different users on the attraction force are met.

title_en: Angle-adjustable poultry house spraying and sterilizing device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of poultry house spray disinfection, and particularly discloses an angle-adjustable poultry house spray disinfection device which comprises an electric sliding rail, wherein the top of the electric sliding rail is fixedly connected with a plurality of connecting plates, the connecting plates are used for fixing the electric sliding rail to the top of the poultry house, one end of the electric sliding rail is slidably connected with a sliding block, a spray assembly is arranged below the sliding block, the spray assembly comprises a long plate, the bottom of the long plate is fixedly connected with a fixed ring, a disinfection pipe is arranged in the fixed ring, the bottom of the disinfection pipe is communicated with a plurality of spray nozzles, and one end of the disinfection pipe is communicated with a conveying pipe.

title_en: Special radiation protection device for chest X-ray photography
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of X-ray photography, and discloses a special radiation protection device for chest X-ray photography, which comprises the following components: the upright posts are vertically arranged; the connecting device is movably connected to the upright post, the connecting device is also connected with a chest stand, and the two fixing rods are horizontally arranged and connected to the connecting device, and the bottoms of the fixing rods are connected with a lead cloth curtain. The connecting device is movably arranged on the upright post, so that the lead cloth curtain can be adjusted along with the movement of the chest film frame in the vertical direction, the lead cloth curtain can be adapted to chest positions of testees with different heights, and the shooting effect of chest X-ray photography is ensured on the premise of ensuring the protection effect.

title_en: Positioning device for microminiaturization manufacturing of superfine diameter water-cooling microwave needle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of microwave needle manufacturing, and provides a positioning device for microminiaturization manufacturing of a superfine diameter water-cooled microwave needle, which comprises a base, wherein a processing device is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the base and comprises a driving rod, two groups of limiting shells are fixedly arranged on two sides of the driving rod, two groups of fastening rings are slidably arranged on the outer sides of the driving rod, sliding blocks are fixedly arranged on the outer sides of the two groups of fastening rings, a plurality of groups of anti-deflection guide wheels are rotatably arranged on the sides, away from each other, of the two groups of sliding blocks, the water-cooled microwave needle is placed at the upper end of the base, the processing device is started for stamping, the driving rod drives the two groups of fastening rings to slide downwards in the limiting shells, torque force generated in the pressing process of the processing device is limited through the two groups of fastening rings, and meanwhile, the anti-deflection guide wheels slide in the limiting shells, so that the anti-deflection guide wheels are contacted with the inner walls of the limiting shells, and can play roles in guiding and anti-deflection in the motion process of the processing device.

title_en: Massage mechanism
abstract_en: The application discloses a massage mechanism which comprises a shell, a driving structure and a piston, wherein a cavity is arranged in the shell, the shell comprises at least one sucking port communicated with the cavity, the driving structure is inserted into the cavity, the piston comprises a connecting end and a working end, and the driving structure is connected with the connecting end to drive the working end to swing back and forth in the cavity to generate negative pressure, so that the sucking port adsorbs skin of a massage user. The application provides a massage mechanism which is stable in structure and long in service life.

title_en: Fumigating moxibustion device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fumigating moxibustion device which comprises a combustion assembly, wherein the combustion assembly comprises a combustion seat, a combustion chamber is arranged on the combustion seat, a combustion frame is arranged in the combustion chamber, a ventilation structure is arranged at the bottom of the combustion chamber, a pesticide effect output assembly comprises an output cover, the output cover is sleeved on the outer side of the combustion chamber, and a smoke outlet structure and a first adjusting plate for adjusting the opening and closing of the smoke outlet structure are arranged on the output cover. The first adjusting plate with the opening and closing functions is arranged on the smoke outlet structure to adjust the opening and closing state, the second adjusting plate with the bottom is matched to achieve the conveying effect of cutting off moxa smoke, the second adjusting plate is independently used to achieve the adjustment of smoke quantity, and the second adjusting plate is used to achieve the control of smoke quantity.

title_en: Medical needle capillary
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of medical instruments, in particular to a medical needle head capillary tube which comprises a needle tube, wherein a needle handle is fixedly connected to the needle tube, a needle point is fixedly communicated with the right end of the needle tube, a protective sleeve is sleeved outside the needle tube, a movable positioning sleeve is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the protective sleeve, two groups of limiting rings are fixedly sleeved outside the needle tube, a fixed positioning sleeve is fixedly connected to one sides, close to the movable positioning sleeve, of the two groups of limiting rings, and the fixed positioning sleeve is fixedly sleeved outside the needle tube. When the needle is not used, the protective sleeve is sleeved outside the needle point to play a protective role, and when the needle is used, the protective sleeve is manually moved, so that the movable positioning sleeve on the protective sleeve is extruded with the left fixed positioning sleeve, the needle point can be used by being exposed at a fixed position by virtue of friction force, after the needle is used, the protective sleeve is manually moved reversely, so that the movable positioning sleeve is extruded with the right fixed positioning sleeve, the needle point is retracted into the protective sleeve, the protective sleeve can be prevented from being lost, the needle point is prevented from accidentally injuring medical staff, and the medical safety is ensured.

title_en: Incision protective sleeve capable of separating thoracoscope and surgical instrument
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an incision protection sleeve capable of separating a thoracoscope and a surgical instrument, and belongs to the technical field of medical instruments. Solves the problem of interference between instruments possibly generated in the single-hole thoracoscopic operation of the traditional incision protective sleeve. The novel flexible pipe-shaped protective sleeve comprises a protective sleeve, an outer ring, an inner ring, a first limiting ring, a second limiting ring and a clamping piece, wherein the protective sleeve is of a flexible pipe-shaped structure with two open ends, the inner ring is of an elastic structure, the outer ring is connected with the upper end of the protective sleeve, the inner ring is connected with the lower end of the protective sleeve, the periphery of the first limiting ring is connected with the inner periphery of the outer ring, the second limiting ring is connected with the clamping piece, and the clamping piece is detachably arranged on the outer ring. The utility model is used for incision protection in thoracoscopic surgery and can prevent interference between instruments.

title_en: Fascia rifle of adjustable stroke
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fascia gun with adjustable stroke, which relates to the technical field of fascia guns, wherein when a driving piece is driven by an adjusting driving piece to drive a linkage piece to move close to or far away from a movable block, an acute angle included angle between a first connecting rod and the top surface of the movable block is gradually reduced or increased, a second connecting rod, the movable block and a swinging block rotate forwards or reversely around a hinging position of an eccentric block and the second connecting rod together, so that the horizontal distance from the central axis of the movable block and a first bearing to the central axis of an output end of a motor is increased or reduced, when the motor drives the eccentric block to rotate, the eccentric block drives the second connecting rod, the movable block, the swinging block, the first connecting rod and the linkage piece to rotate, and the swinging block drives a reciprocating connecting rod to have larger or smaller movement stroke, namely, the reciprocating connecting rod drives a piston rod and a massage head to obtain longer and shorter reciprocating movement stroke, and the fascia gun can be adjusted according to the massage amplitude requirements of muscles of different parts of people.

title_en: Accurate scale implantation ware of collagen
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a collagen accurate scale implanter, which relates to the technical field of medical beauty equipment and comprises an implantation device, wherein one end of the implantation device is connected with a filling device. According to the accurate scale implanter for collagen, the capacity of collagen in the implantation tube is controlled according to the fact that the moving distance of the moving frame at the bottom of the scale corresponds to the scale of the scale, the accuracy of collagen implantation amount is improved, the moving frame drives the piston to move at a constant speed in the implantation tube by controlling the rotating screw to rotate through the moving motor, the stability of collagen implantation speed is guaranteed, automatic replenishment of collagen in the implantation tube is achieved, the collagen implantation efficiency is improved, the distance between the distance measuring sensor and the positioning plate is arranged, the piston moves to the left side in the implantation tube at a certain distance, quantitative implantation of collagen in batches is further achieved, and the efficiency of multiple implantation is improved under the condition that the implantation amount is ensured to be accurate.

title_en: Rectum drug delivery device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rectal administration device, which belongs to the technical field of rectal administration instruments. The utility model comprises a drug delivery mechanism and a blocking mechanism, wherein the blocking mechanism is arranged at the end part of the drug delivery mechanism, the drug delivery mechanism comprises a drug liquid storage part, a drug liquid conveying part and a drug delivery driving part, the blocking mechanism comprises a rectal drug delivery end and a connecting end, the blocking mechanism is connected with the drug delivery mechanism through the connecting end, and the drug liquid conveying part is communicated with the rectal drug delivery end. The utility model has simple structure and simple and convenient operation, realizes continuous and integrated operation of drug delivery and blocking under the interaction of the drug delivery mechanism and the blocking mechanism, releases the drug liquid to a target area, ensures that the drug liquid is fully contacted with and absorbed by a focus, simultaneously can block the drug liquid, prevents the drug liquid from flowing outwards, improves the drug delivery efficiency, reduces the drug waste, reduces the stimulation to patients and realizes the high efficiency and convenience of rectal administration.

title_en: Blood derivative forming device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a blood derivative forming device which comprises a hollow box body and an upper side cover positioned at one side of the upper end of the box body, wherein a lower pressing plate positioned in the box body is arranged at one side of the upper side cover, a plurality of micropores are formed in the bottom of the lower pressing plate, a bracket which is arranged above the lower pressing plate in a crossing manner is fixedly connected to the upper part of the box body, a first handle is arranged at the upper end of the bracket in a sliding manner, a lower pressing column of the upper pressing plate is fixedly connected to the lower end of the bracket, a plurality of guide columns which are in sliding connection with the bracket are fixedly connected to the upper pressing plate, a plurality of limiting pieces are arranged at the edge of the upper pressing plate, and a plurality of positioning blocks which are in the same straight line with the limiting pieces in the vertical direction are arranged at the upper end of the box body. The utility model can ensure the relative stability of the upper pressing plate and the lower pressing plate, can adjust the pressing height of the upper pressing plate and the lower pressing plate on the blood derivative, effectively control the forming shape and the stability of the blood derivative, ensure the morphological stability of the blood derivative and ensure the subsequent clinical use.

title_en: Massage chair
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a massage chair, which comprises a massage machine core and a flexible supporting bar, wherein the massage machine core is controlled to walk along a set path, the flexible supporting bar extends along the set path to assist in supporting a user, and the massage machine core comprises a supporting bar matching piece which limits the left-right swing of the flexible supporting bar relative to the set path in the process that the massage machine core walks along the set path. According to the massage chair, the massage movement is matched with the flexible support bars through the support bar matching piece, and the left-right swing of the flexible support bars relative to the set path is limited, so that the flexible support bars can stably support users.

title_en: Autogenous cutting pipe restraint device
abstract_en: The utility model provides an autogenous cutting pipe restraining device which comprises a shell, wherein a front-back through sleeve is arranged on the shell, a ring-shaped wheel core is arranged in the shell and is in rotary connection with the sleeve, a first gear is arranged on the front side face of the wheel core, a pin hole is formed around the axis of the wheel core, the autogenous cutting pipe restraining device comprises a binding rope, a first opening is formed on one side of the periphery of the shell, a clamping groove is formed on the other side of the periphery of the shell, a buckle is arranged at one end of the binding rope and is detachably clamped with the clamping groove, a ring of rope winding groove is formed around the periphery of the wheel core, the other end of the binding rope penetrates through the first opening and is fixedly connected in the rope winding groove, the autogenous cutting pipe comprises a bolt, a second opening is formed on the front side face of the shell, the poking wheel and the second gear are coaxially fixedly connected through a rotating shaft, the rotating shaft is in rotary connection with the second opening, and the bolt is spliced with the pin hole. The utility model solves the technical problem of inconvenient adjustment of the tightness of the fixing belt in the prior art.

title_en: Thorn-shaped defoaming filter and feeding bottle
abstract_en: The utility model provides a thorn-shaped defoaming filter and a feeding bottle, wherein a defoaming part protrudes from the surface of a separating piece into a cavity body and stretches into a liquid storage cavity, part of bubbles can be in direct contact with the defoaming part, when the bubbles are in contact with the defoaming part, a bubble film is pinned at a tip end, the curvature difference between a round curved surface and the tip end increases the local pressure difference, and then the flow shearing action is overlapped, so that the bubble film is quickly thinned and broken. After rupture, the gas is released directly back into the void area of the reservoir. The bubbles which are not pierced or completely broken are separated by the separating piece, and the separating holes allow milk to pass through, and the bubbles are blocked so as to avoid the bubbles contained in the milk flowing out. The active foam breaking of the thorn-shaped contact of the defoaming part and the passive screening of the separation hole act together, so that the contact puncture is performed firstly, and then the separation hole is filtered, thereby avoiding the milk containing bubbles from being drunk by infants, and avoiding the occurrence of conditions such as flatulence, hiccups and the like.

title_en: Breast pump system
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to breast pump systems. A breast pump system includes a first compression set, an energy storage buffer, an actuator comprising first and second back-to-back chambers with a partition therebetween, and a drive system for driving the actuator to change the volumes of the first and second chambers, wherein the first compression set is coupled to the first chamber and the buffer is coupled to or formed by the second chamber. Utilizing embodiments of the present disclosure advantageously avoids the need for a continuously operating pump to deliver negative pressure and avoids the need for complex valve arrangements. In addition to simplifying hardware, it reduces energy consumption by enabling the first and second sets or buffers to be coupled together.

title_en: Foldable electric wheelchair controller fixing rod
abstract_en: The utility model provides a foldable electric wheelchair controller fixing rod, which relates to the technical field of electric wheelchair accessories and comprises a control assembly and a mounting assembly, wherein the mounting assembly consists of a storage seat and a circular tube, the storage seat is arranged at one side of the bottom of the control assembly, the circular tube is connected with a mounting fixing frame in a sliding manner, one side of the storage seat, which is close to the control assembly, is provided with a folding assembly, the control assembly is connected with the circular tube through the storage seat by the mounting assembly, the sliding fit between the circular tube and the mounting fixing frame can adjust the whole height, different use requirements are adapted, the folding assembly at the side of the storage seat is in linkage with the control assembly, the folding function is realized, the whole structure integrates the fixing, adjusting and folding functions, the mounting is stable and flexible, the space is saved during folding, the positioning is convenient during use, and the adaptability and the use convenience of equipment installation are improved.

title_en: Rb ELUTION SYSTEM CONTROL AND CONFIGURATIONS
abstract_en: Rb generator, an activity detector, a waste container, a pump, a sensor, a tubing circuit, at least one valve, where the waste container is located in the lower section of the assembly. More particularly, the top surface of the waste container compartment is either below the top surface of the generator compartment, or the waste container is at the same elevation than the generator or below the pump.

title_en: Headboard with integrated backrest and system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a headboard with an integrated backrest capable of moving between a retracted position and an extended oblique position. This solution allows any type of bed to obtain backrest elevation.

title_en: Mass output controlled vaporizer
abstract_en: A vaporizer device includes a resistive heating element; circuitry configured to control delivery of electrical power to the resistive heating element from a power source; and a controller configured to perform operations including: receiving inputs representative of a power delivery to the resistive heating element, a temperature of the resistive heating element, and/or a flow rate of air past the resistive heating element; predicting, using the received inputs, an amount of evaporation of the vaporizable material at the resistive heating element; and controlling the power delivery to the resistive heating element in response to the predicted amount of evaporation of the vaporizable material, the controlling including increasing or decreasing an instantaneous power delivery to the heating element such that a target aerosol yield is produced. Related devices, systems, methods, and articles are also described.

title_en: Apparatus and methods for navigating ostomy appliance user to changing room
abstract_en: An accessory device for an ostomy system is provided and includes a monitor device and an ostomy appliance. The ostomy appliance includes a base plate, and the accessory device includes a memory, a processor, and an interface coupled to the processor. The interface is configured to communicate with the monitor device. The interface includes a display device and is configured to obtain monitor data from the monitor device coupled to the ostomy appliance. The processor is configured to determine an operating state of the ostomy appliance, determine respective locations of one or more changing rooms based on the operating state, and output to the display device directions to a changing room of the one or more changing rooms.

title_en: Method for making a custom-made podiatry orthosis integrated into an improved sock
abstract_en: A method is provided for the realization of a custom-made podiatry orthosis (191) integrated into a sock (150, 170, 190) or leggings comprising the steps of identifying at least one area (121) in a foot (120) or limb of a user on which the orthosis is intended to be placed (191 ), cutting from a sheet of adhesive material (130) at least a portion of adhesive material (131, 151, 171, 180) of the same shape as the area (121), cutting from a polymer gel sheet (141) at least a portion of polymer gel (140, 161, 172) of the same shape as the portion of adhesive material (131, 151, 171, 180), arranging the portion of said adhesive material (131, 151, 171, 180) in adhesion with the sock (150, 170, 190) or leggings such that, when the sock (150) or leggings are on the foot (120) or limb, the portion of adhesive material (131, 151, 171, 180) is arranged in an area (152) superposing the area (121), arranging the polymer gel portion (140, 161, 172) on a template, inserting the template inside the sock (150, 170, 190) or leggings so as to superpose the adhesive material portion (131, 151, 171, 180) with the polymer gel portion (140, 161, 172), removing the adhesive material portion (131, 151, 171, 180) from the sock (150, 170, 190) or leggings, thermobonding the polymer gel portion (140, 161, 172) on the sock (150, 170, 190) or leggings by heating it to temperatures between 80°C and 200°C and subjecting it to pressure with pressures between 3 bar and 10 bar at least at said zone (152).

title_en: Method for operating a medical device and medical device operating according to the method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for operating a class A medical device (10) together with a class B medical device (12), wherein the medical devices (10, 12) are joined to one another for communication, wherein the class A medical device (10) comprises a display (14) suitable for displaying texts in various languages and wherein the class B medical device (12) has no text display facility, wherein the class B medical device (12), in order to display textual or at least partially textual information (20), sends a data message (22) containing an information identifier (44) to the class A medical device (10) and wherein the class A medical device (10), on receipt of an information identifier (44), loads information (20) matching the information identifier (44) from a medical device database (26) and displays said information by means of its own display (14) for the class B medical device (12).

title_en: Patient interfaces
abstract_en: An interface for use in providing positive pressure respiratory therapy, the interface comprising:a mask assembly comprising a mask seal and a mask shell, the mask assembly configured to be fully positioned lower than a bridge of a nose of a face of a user and to provide an exposed bridge of the nose of the user, the mask seal being connected to the mask shell, a nasal region comprising at least one nasal opening, the mask seal comprising a first paddle on a first side of the nasal region and a second paddle on a second side of the nasal region, the first paddle configured to contact one side of the nose of the user and the second paddle configured to contact the other side of the nose of the user;

title_en: Recording a state of a medical device
abstract_en: A system and method of recording a state of a medical device having a disposable component includes operating the medical device to provide a medical procedure using a disposable component. The disposable component is installed on an external surface of the medical device housing by a human operator and removable therefrom for disposal. The system and method include detecting an error condition on the medical device and, in response, acquiring an image from a camera coupled to the medical device. The image, representing the disposable component and the external housing, is stored in a memory of the medical device and is accessible for later retrieval.

title_en: Telescoping atrial septum needle
abstract_en: Devices used to provide transseptal access are disclosed. The devices may comprise at least one cannula, a needle, and a handle. The cannula and the needle may be configured to be inserted through a dilator while not damaging a lumen wall of the dilator. The handle may be configured to lock the needle in a retracted position. The devices may be configured to telescopically advance the needle through an atrial septum.

title_en: Animal knee joint implant reflecting anatomical structure of animal
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to an animal knee joint implant that reflects an anatomical structure of an animal. More particularly, the present disclosure relates to an animal knee joint implant that reflects the anatomical structure of an animal, wherein the knee joint implant is capable of being used for diseases, which are accompanied by bone loss, damage to surrounding muscles, ligaments, and the like and are thus more complex than general knee joint diseases such as rheumatoid arthritis and degenerative arthritis, and wherein the animal knee joint implant is capable of reinforcing stability against varus and valgus as well as stability against flexion and extension, and capable of easily complementing gaps that may occur when the bones of a joint are cut.

title_en: Adjustable eyewear strap
abstract_en: An adjustable goggle strap includes a strap body and an adjustment cord disposed on the strap body. The adjustment cord may be releasably engaged by a cord lock in order to modify a total length of the strap body. The cord lock may be located on the strap body or various elements of an attached eyewear, such as an eyewear frame, lens, or eyewear strap attachments. Some aspects of the adjustable goggle strap include a retainer to secure an excess portion of the adjustment cord.

title_en: Imaging systems and methods of operating the same
abstract_en: An imaging system (500), comprising an image sensor (490) which comprises (a) a top surface (492), (b) M active areas (190A-190D) on the top surface (492), M being an integer greater than 0, and (c) a dead zone (488) on the top surface (492) and between the M active areas (190A-190D) such that no one active area of the M active areas (190A-190D) is in direct physical contact with another active area of the M active areas (190A-190D); and a radiation source system which comprises N radiation sources (510.1-510.9), N being an integer greater than 1, wherein, in response to an object (520) being placed between the image sensor (490) and the radiation source system, the imaging system (500) is configured to sequentially turn on then off the N radiation sources (510.1-510.9) resulting in M×N images in the M active areas (190A-190D), and wherein each point of the object (520) is captured in at least one image of the M×N images.

title_en: Surgical systems and methods for protecting against unauthorized use
abstract_en: A surgical device includes a limited-use component configured to perform a surgical operation, where the limited-use component can be used for a pre-determined number of uses, and a reusable component operationally coupled to the limited-use component. The limited-use component includes a body forming a pocket and a radio frequency identification (RFID) tag disposed within the pocket. The reusable component includes an RFID tag transceiver configured to read operating parameters from a memory of the RFID tag of the limited-use component. The operating parameters are erased from the memory when the limited-use component has been used for the pre-determined number of uses.

title_en: System and method for conditioning gas for analysis
abstract_en: Methods and systems for conditioning a gas sample for analysis and measuring, detecting, and/or determining the concentration of at least one analyte in a gas sample. Methods include a combination and/or repetition of dehumidifying and/or humidifying the gas, and/or performing a chemical reaction an analyte, and measuring, detecting, and/or determining the concentration of an analyte or an output analyte resulting from the chemical reaction. Systems to adjust the humidity of a gas sample and/or perform a chemical reaction on an analyte, and measure, detect, and/or determine the concentration of an analyte or an output analyte resulting from the chemical reaction comprise cartridges, capsules, test strips or test strip chambers and one or more sensors. Systems may further comprise a humidity exchange material to further adjust the humidity. Gas samples include exhaled breath. Analytes include nitric oxide. Output analytes include nitrogen dioxide.

title_en: Tensioning mechanisms for articulating surgical instruments such as for use in robotic surgical systems
abstract_en: An articulation assembly for a robotic surgical instrument includes a plurality of rotatable but longitudinally fixed lead screws extending between first and second base plates, a collar threaded about each lead screws and configured to translate therealong in response to rotation of the corresponding lead screw, an articulation cable coupled to each collar and defining or having a threaded shaft, and a threaded nipple threaded about each of the threaded shafts. Each threaded nipple is engaged with one of the collars to thereby engage each of the articulation cables with a corresponding one of the collars such that longitudinal translation of the corresponding collar pushes or pulls the corresponding articulation cable. Each threaded nipple is configured for further threading or unthreading about the corresponding threaded shaft to vary a pre-tension on the corresponding articulation cable.

title_en: Medical delivery device and method for delivering therapeutic agents directly into the annulus fibrosus of an intervertebral disc
abstract_en: A device for delivering a therapeutic agent to the disc of the spine includes an introducer needle having a hollow cannula (508), a stylet and a delivery catheter with a hollow shaft The catheter fits coaxially through the introducer needle when the stylet is removed. The catheter is longer than the introducer needle and has a blunt closed- ended tip (804) and at least one side port (812) at the distal end. The introducer needle and stylet have a sharpness and consistency that allows them to penetrate the wall of the annulus fibrosus. The catheter forms a pre-set bend (806) as it exits coaxially through the distal end of the introducer needle. The angle of the bend of the catheter in combination with the blunt tip allow the catheter to traverse inside the circumference of the annulus fibrosus without entering the nucleus pulposus or exiting the annulus fibrosus into surrounding tissue.

title_en: Bed system and related method
abstract_en: A bed system and related method is disclosed, the bed system comprising a bed frame and a mattress assembly pivotably mounted on the bed frame for pivoting the mattress assembly about a pivot axis to form a pivot angle between the mattress assembly and a longitudinal axis of the bed frame, the mattress assembly comprising a back part, a seat part and a leg part, wherein a back normal of the back part and the pivot axis forms a back angle, a seat normal of the seat part and the pivot axis forms a seat angle, and a leg normal of the leg part and the pivot axis forms a leg angle, the bed system comprising a controller device, wherein the controller device is configured to: move the mattress assembly from a first position to a second position, wherein, in the second position, the pivot angle is a second pivot angle in a range from 30 degrees to 80 degrees, and wherein the leg angle is a second leg angle larger than 45 degrees.

title_en: Optical fiber sensing system, state detection device, state detection method, and non-transitory computer-readable medium
abstract_en: An optical fiber sensing system according to the present disclosure includes clothing (10) including an optical fiber (20), an optical fiber sensing unit (31) configured to receive an optical signal from the optical fiber (20), and acquire, based on the optical signal, a plurality of parameters each having a pattern according to a state of a person wearing the clothing (10), and a state detection unit (32) configured to detect a state of a person wearing the clothing (10), based on a pattern contained in each of the plurality of parameters.

title_en: Microintroducer system
abstract_en: A microintroducer system including an introducer sheath coupled to a handle, the handle and introducer sheath defining a channel therethrough, and an adapter. The adapter includes a receiver tube having a predetermined angled portion, the receiving tube providing a pathway from a proximal opening to the channel of the microintroducer. The adapter can be integral with the microintroducer or separately attached. A separately attached adapter can include a spin nut or other attachment mechanism to couple the adapter to the microintroducer. The predetermined angled portion can include a plurality of curved portions to form, for example, a helical pathway. The microintroducer system can include a shape sensing stylet system. The predetermined angled portion of the adapter can provide a fiduciary point for calibrating the shape sensing stylet. As the stylet passes through the predetermined angled portion, an external device coupled to the stylet calibrates the deflection.
