abstract_en: To provide a hybrid continuous positive pressure and surface imaging system for use in a radiotherapy system.SOLUTION: The hybrid continuous positive pressure and surface imaging system includes: a positive pressure unit adapted to apply a continuous positive pressure to lungs of a patient during radiotherapy; a surface camera system configured to continuously, or at intervals, capture body surface images of the patient; and a processing unit configured to continuously, or at intervals, model chest and/or abdominal movement of the patient in response to the applied continuous positive pressure based on the body surface images.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Medical system
abstract_en: To notify a user of information related to leakage of an administered medicament from a target tissue, such as a tumor region.SOLUTION: A medical system 1 includes an injection needle 10 which is configured to puncture and to distribute a medicament, an inner cylinder 20 which is connected to the injection needle and includes a flow passage 21 for distributing the medicament to the injection needle, a pressure sensor 50 which is provided on the flow passage and can measure a pressure in distributing the medicament to the injection needle, and a control part 110 which determines a possibility of the leakage of the medicament from pressure behavior of the pressure sensor after detecting a pressure reduction in an amount of a change of a threshold value or more, and a notification part 90 which notifies a user of a determination result by the control part.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Medical support device, medical bed device, and X-ray diagnostic device
abstract_en: To simply and appropriately support a subject.SOLUTION: A medical support device according to the embodiment supports a subject. The medical support device includes a movable part that operates in response to an operation on the inside of the medical support device. When an operation on the inside of the support device is being performed, the support force of the subject can be intuitively adjusted by the operation of the movable part in response to the operation, and when the operation is not being performed, the operation of the movable part can be regulated to maintain the support force. Therefore, an appropriate support force can be applied to a subject P by intuitively adjusting the support force by a simple operation on the inside of the support device.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Prosthetic heart valve
abstract_en: To provide a prosthetic heart valve which includes a radially collapsible and expandable annular frame having a plurality of struts defining openings.SOLUTION: The prosthetic heart valve can further include a plurality of leaflets that regulate the flow of blood through the frame. The prosthetic heart valve can also include a sealing member mounted on the frame and having an inner layer and an outer layer. At least the outer layer is mounted on the outside of the frame, and the inner layer covers at least the openings in the frame between adjacent cusp portions of adjacent leaflets and does not cover one or more openings in the frame at locations facing the outflow surfaces of the leaflets to thereby permit retrograde blood to flow through the one or more uncovered openings in the frame into space between the outer layer and the frame.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 63

title_en: Biopsy device and program
abstract_en: To obtain a biopsy device and a program that can facilitate comparison of a target state of a biopsy needle to an actual state as compared to a conventional technology.SOLUTION: A controller 70 includes a display controller 72A that performs control of displaying an object image indicating an object of tissue sampling by a biopsy needle, a first image indicating a target position of the biopsy needle, and a second image indicating an actual position of the biopsy needle, as an identical display diagram of a common two-dimensional coordination system, in a state where the first and second images are different images.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 7

title_en: Electric motor-driven roller
abstract_en: To provide an electric motor-driven roller having a structure capable of being used by being attached to an apparatus to be conveyed as necessary without determining a target in order to spread motor-driven conveyance, and capable of being motor-driven by being attached to a wheelchair, a handcart, and a walking support apparatus.SOLUTION: An in-wheel motor wheel, which is made up of a wheel clutch 6, a motor 1, and a reducer 2 arranged on a body 3, is fixed by a wheel bearing 9, and the vehicle moves by connecting the clutch and driving the motor. A drive board 5, a control board 4, a battery, left and right connecting shafts 7, and left and right connecting clutches 8 are arranged inside the body 3, and straight-line stability is improved by connecting the left and right connecting clutches 8. Manual operation is possible by releasing the wheel clutch 6.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Smart sensing insole
abstract_en: To provide a smart insole that improves sensing effect and enables complete measurement of foot information.SOLUTION: The present invention discloses a smart sensing insole. The smart sensing insole includes a pressure sensing layer (for instance, a pressure board) which includes a resistive pressure sensor for sensing pressure and position distribution as sensing points when the foot pressure changes. Each pressure sensor is coupled to the sensing module. The area occupied by the sensing points is between 3-50% or 3-70% of the entire bottom area of the insole. The sensing point positions include at least a pressure peak position, a pressure center area, and an arch position.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2A

title_en: Biological substance collection kit
abstract_en: To provide a biological substance collection kit allowing a subject to collect biological substances by himself/herself at any place such as at home.SOLUTION: A biological substance collection kit comprises a collection tool 10 for collecting biological substances, a container body for storing a preservation solution of the biological substances, and a cap for sealing the container body. The collection tool 10 includes a collection body 15 for collecting the biological substances, a collection support 13 for supporting the collection body 15, a rod 11 detachably fixed to the collection support 13, and an internal space formed in the collection support 13 for sucking the biological substances and the preservation solution from the outside of the container body. The container body houses the collection body 15 and the collection support 13.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Ultrasound transducer devices and methods
abstract_en: To provide an ultrasound transducer and a method.SOLUTION: An ultrasound transducer may include: a plurality of capacitive ultrasound transducer elements; and a base having a maximum dimension sized and shaped to be disposed within an external ear canal, the plurality of capacitive ultrasound transducers being mounted on the base. Each capacitive ultrasound transducer element and the ultrasound transducer are specifically constructed to achieve select desired performance characteristics. The ultrasound transducer may have an angular beam spread through a gaseous medium of greater than 15 degrees and an attenuation loss through the gaseous medium of greater than 10 dB measured at a distance 12.5 mm to 25 mm along a primary transmission axis of the ultrasound transducer. The ultrasound transducer may be particularly useful for characterizing fluid behind an ear drum to diagnose otitis media.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6A

title_en: Audio system, wireless terminal, and program
abstract_en: To help a user wake up so that the user can wake up at the wake-up time set by the user himself/herself comfortably.SOLUTION: When a time point (first time point) a first predetermined time before the wake-up time comes, a wireless terminal 2 collectively acquires sleeping state changing information accumulated in a wearable device 3 until then, and additionally acquires latest sleeping state changing information from the wearable device 3 periodically until the second time point (a second predetermined time before the wake-up time) closer to the wake-up time than the first time point comes. The wireless terminal calculates a transition period of a user's sleeping state on the basis of the collectively acquired sleeping state changing information, compares the user's present actual sleeping state specified by the latest sleeping state changing information with an ideal sleeping state each time the sleeping state changing information is acquired from the wearable device 3, and, if the two are different, transmits output instructions with the designation of audio data on a brain wave by which an induction effect to the ideal sleeping state can be expected to a wireless speaker 1.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: External drive unit for implantable heart assist pump
abstract_en: To provide an improved external drive unit for an implantable heart assist pump.SOLUTION: A proposed drive unit 7 comprises: a motor housing 51; a transcutaneous drive shaft 3; and a motor 35 for driving the heart assist pump 4. The motor 35 is connectable to the heart assist pump 4 via the drive shaft 3, and the motor 35 is arranged inside the motor housing 51. The drive unit 7 further comprises a catheter 2 surrounding the drive shaft 3 and a purge line 53 for injecting a purge medium into a lumen of the catheter 2 or into a space 41 between the catheter 2 and the drive shaft 3. The purge line 53 is in thermal contact 54, 55 with an outer surface of the motor housing 51 and/or with an outer surface of a proximal section 52 of the catheter 2. Due to the thermal contact 54, 55 heat may be transferred from the outer surface of the catheter 2 in the proximal section 52 and/or from the outer surface of the motor housing 51 to the purge medium.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 8

title_en: Ultrasonic surgical tool capable of vibrating in multiple modes and drive system that induces non-linear vibrations in tool tip
abstract_en: To provide an ultrasonic surgical tool system with a tip capable of simultaneously vibrating in multiple modes.SOLUTION: The system includes a console capable of supplying a drive signal to the tip that includes multiple components. Each component has a frequency characteristic that is based in part on the equivalent current through the mechanical components of the tip. The frequency components are different from each other. Based on the application of the drive signal, the tip undergoes non-linear vibrations.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 11

title_en: Methods and systems for performing real-time radiology
abstract_en: To provide methods and computer systems directed to performing real-time and/or AI-assisted radiology.SOLUTION: A method for processing an image of a location of the body of a subject includes: a step 102 of obtaining the image of the location of the body of the subject; a step 104 of using a trained algorithm to classify the image or a derivative thereof to one category among a plurality of categories; a step 108 of sending the image to a first radiologist for radiological assessment if the image is classified to a first category among the plurality of categories, or a step 110 of sending the image to a second radiologist for radiological assessment if the image is classified to a second category among the plurality of categories; and a step 112 of receiving a recommendation from the first or second radiologist to examine the subject on the basis of at least part of the radiological assessment.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Transfer tool with blister pack
abstract_en: To provide a transfer tool with a blister pack capable of reducing time and labor for adjusting a medicine using the transfer tool.SOLUTION: A transfer tool 1 with a blister pack includes a transfer tool 100 comprising a main body part 110 and a tip mounting part 130, and a blister pack 200 comprising a container body 210 and a lid body 220. A housing chamber 213 provided in the container body 210 comprises a first housing space SP1 for housing the tip mounting part 130 and a second housing space SP2 for housing the main body part 110. A peripheral wall part 212 of the container body 210 of a part defining the second housing space SP2 is provided with an engaging part 217 for sandwiching and holding the main body part 110 in a direction crossing the axial direction of the main body part 110, and the transfer tool 100 is held by the container body 210 only by sandwiching by the engaging part 217.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 9

title_en: Server and measurement terminal
abstract_en: To provide a server and a measurement terminal capable of linking a measurement system with an external system by simple work.SOLUTION: A server (200) acquires, from a cooperating external system (30), object person information including at least an object person face image and an object person name for a plurality of object persons registered in the system. When a face photograph for registration as a measured person face image is received from a measuring terminal (100), at least face authentication is performed, object person information of a corresponding object person is associated with the face photograph for registration, and the measured person face image and the associated object person information are registered.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: system
abstract_en: An object of the system according to the embodiment is to efficiently perform food management in a refrigerator, creation of a shopping list, and recipe suggestion.SOLUTION: A system according to an embodiment includes a collection unit, a creation unit, a proposal unit, an analysis unit, and a presentation unit. The collection unit confirms a state of the food material. The creation unit creates a shopping list based on the information collected by the collection unit. The proposal unit proposes a recipe based on the ingredient information in the refrigerator on the basis of the shopping list created by the creation unit. The analysis unit analyzes a state of the refrigerator based on the recipe proposed by the proposal unit. The presentation unit presents information analyzed by the analysis unit.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: system
abstract_en: An object of a system according to an embodiment is to accurately label medical image data and improve the accuracy of image diagnosis by AI.SOLUTION: A system according to an embodiment includes a collection unit, an analysis unit, a labeling unit, and a learning unit. The collection unit collects medical image data. The analysis unit analyzes the data collected by the collection unit. The labeling unit attaches an accurate label based on the analysis result obtained by the analysis unit. The learning unit performs learning based on the data labeled by the labeling unit.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Biomedical electrode device
abstract_en: To provide a structure of an electrode sheet having low resistance, to reduce noise caused by a moment of force by physically and electrically strongly connecting fixation of a skin, an electrode and a sensor module, and to reduce a manufacturing cost by using a general printing method for forming a wiring member of the electrode sheet, and to reduce a wearing feeling of a subject at the time of attachment.SOLUTION: The bio-electrode device includes an electrode sheet including at least a pair of electrodes for receiving a bioelectric signal, a wiring member for transmitting the received bioelectric signal, a sensor module for outputting a signal related to the bioelectric signal to the outside, and a connection member for connecting the transmitted bioelectric signal to the sensor module, wherein the connection member is inserted into a hole opened in the wiring member with a fitting tolerance of "interference fit" or "tight fit", and the wiring member and the connection member are closely adhered and fixed to each other in a form in which the wiring member is dragged by a side surface of the connection member to be shifted upward.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Method for providing online medical care
abstract_en: To continuously provide online medical examination.SOLUTION: A method for providing online medical care to a patient user according to an aspect of the present invention includes receiving an application for online medical care from a patient user terminal of a first hospital terminal, transferring the application to an SNS server, receiving medical inquiry information from the patient user via the SNS server, transmitting the medical inquiry information to a second hospital terminal, and generating diagnosis information of the patient user based on an online medical care result with the patient user, and transmitting the diagnosis information to the patient user terminal.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 7

title_en: Exit type spray sterilizer and vehicle disinfection system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an exit-type spray sterilizer and a vehicle disinfection system, and there is no risk of deterioration of the durability of a motor blower, and there is no risk of falling water phenomenon in which a part of the disinfectant water falls on the motor blower in the form of droplets. In addition, disinfection water can be efficiently atomized, so that the disinfection efficiency of a vehicle can be greatly improved. Furthermore, it is possible to have an effect of precisely controlling the initial disinfection water spray amount of the motor blower, as well as preventing a supply pipe to which the disinfection water is supplied from freezing in winter.

title_en: Air sterilization device for high pressure breathing air compressor
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an air sterilizer for an air charger. According to the present invention, in the air sterilizer, a first purifying unit that primary filters the dust in the outside air is formed, and a sterilization unit that sterilizes the air first purified by the first purifying unit with ultraviolet rays, and a second purifying unit that secondary filters the air that has passed through the sterilization unit.

title_en: Bags with sterilization function and their control method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a bag having a sterilization function and a control method thereof. The bacteria on the surface of various objects including lipstick, cosmetic case, car key, coin, smartphone, book, and the like in the bag and the bacteria inside the bag are sterilized, and thus, the bag promotes the health of the user. The present invention comprises: a body (3) having an accommodation space therein; a control part (5) installed on one side of an inner surface of the body (3); a bacteria detection part (11) installed on one side of the inner surface of the body (3) and electrically connected to the control part (5) to detect bacteria in the air inside the body (3) according to a control signal from the control part (5); and an LED UV lamp (13) installed on one side of the inner surface of the body (3) at a predetermined interval from the bacteria detection part (11), and electrically connected to the control part (5) to sterilize bacteria by irradiating ultraviolet rays to an internal accommodation space and objects of the body (3) according to a control signal of the control part (5).

title_en: Germicidal Integrated Lighting System
abstract_en: Provided is an integrated sterilization and lighting system according to an embodiment of the present invention. The integrated sterilization and lighting system comprises: a first light-emitting unit including first LEDs that output a light source of 405 nm and second LEDs that output a light source of 450 nm; a second light-emitting unit including third LEDs that output a light source of 405 nm provided to at least one of a plurality of edges of an area where the first light-emitting unit is arranged; and a controller for simultaneously realizing harmful bacteria sterilization and lighting functions by determining on/off and lighting ratios between the first LEDs, the second LEDs, and the third LEDs. A diffusion plate is provided on the first-light emitting unit, a reflector connected to at least one of a plurality of edges of the diffusion plate is provided, the third LEDs are arranged in a direction toward the reflector, and the light source of 405 nm output from the third LEDs is reflected by the reflector and then output.

title_en: Blood collector for bee stings
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a blood collector for treating bee stings. The blood collector comprises: a hollow cylindrical housing; an ejector formed to partially protrude from the housing, and moved or returned by a pressing force in the axial direction of the housing and the elastic force of a spring; a plunger provided to move in the axial direction inside the housing while being linked with the ejector; and a lancet part provided so that a lancet needle protrudes and retracts at a predetermined height from a lower end of the housing while being linked with the ejector. A transparent cap is connected to the lower end of the housing at which the lancet needle protrudes and retracts to be formed transparently by a height, so that the position of the lancet needle can be visually confirmed from the outside. The transparent cap is formed so that while the diameter gradually decreased from an upper end to a lower end thereof, the outer diameter of the lower end is formed to have a size close to the outer diameter of the lancet needle. Therefore, the blood collector can remove bee sting venom that has penetrated the skin, thereby enabling treatment.

title_en: Artificial intelligence-based health functional food small quantitiy production order platform service provision method, device and system
abstract_en: According to one embodiment, a device can: receive a health functional food production request for first health functional food subjected to a request for a health functional food production operation from a first requester terminal of a first requester who desires to request the health functional food production operation; transmit a consultation request message for producing the first health functional food to the first requester terminal in response to the health functional food production request; extract production consultation information of the first requester based on consultation information input on a chatting space of the first requester account corresponding to the first requestor; generate recipe information about the first health functional food based on the production consultation information of the first requestor; generate production plant information for the first health functional food based on the production consultation information of the first requestor; generate a first input signal based on the recipe information and the production plant information and generate first output signals by applying the generate first input signal to a first artificial intelligence network, wherein the first artificial intelligence network is pre-trained based on pieces of training recipe information, pieces of training production plant information, the first output signals, and training production cost information; and generate first production cost information corresponding to the first health functional food based on the first output signals.

title_en: Device of vibration alert
abstract_en: A vibration notification device according to an embodiment of the present invention includes: a decibel measurement unit which is configured to generate a decibel measurement value based on the loudness of a sound; a control unit which is configured to generate a control signal based on the decibel measurement value; and a vibration unit which is configured to generate vibration based on the control signal.

title_en: Non-slip and Height-adjustable Rotating Crutches With Heated Wires
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a slip-resistant and height-adjustable rotary crutch with heating wires, which is height-adjustable to a user's height, is easily used even on stairs or the like, and includes a soft rubber tip and a special soft rubber tip with slip-resistant concavo-convex portions to be used according to user's selection, and is capable of melting snow or ice with the heating wires if needed so as not to slip in a place where there is snow or ice. The present invention can prevent secondary accidents due to slipping by enabling the rubber tip, resistant to slipping on the ground where the crutch touches, to selectively adopt general hard rubber or special soft rubber by rotation if needed on a dry floor or a wet slippery floor during daily life.

title_en: Mobile dust reduction water fog spraying system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a mobile water fog spraying system for reducing dust, which is freely transferred to facilitate the approach to a working field and installation thereof, thereby enhancing workability and utilization. The mobile water fog spraying system for reducing dust according to the present invention comprises: a main body; a water storage tank disposed in the main body to receive and store water; a spray means configured to receive and mix the water stored in the water storage tank with external air and spray the mixture to the outside; a supply means disposed in the main body and configured to supply the water stored in the water storage tank and the external air to the spray means, respectively; and a moving means configured to move the main body.

title_en: Apparatus for cone beam computed tomography providing high visibility and the operation method thereof
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a medical imaging apparatus which can move to a patient with difficulty in moving to perform an X-ray scan. The medical imaging apparatus comprises: a main body capable of running; a gantry coupled to the main body and provided with a bore; a detector assembly arranged on the gantry; and a source assembly facing the detector assembly to be arranged, and coupled to the gantry. The main body includes: a control part controlling an operation in accordance with a running mode of the medical imaging apparatus; an input part receiving input of a user; and a first driving module and the second driving module having the same shape. If the medical imaging apparatus is in the running mode, the control part controls the main body to run based on at least one between a right handle and a left handle included in the input part. If the medical imaging apparatus is in an indoor mode, the control part controls the main body to run based on a user interface part included in the input part.

title_en: Pharmacist calling method for remote image administration and the remote image administration service system accordingly
abstract_en: The remote video medication service system according to the present invention comprises: a plurality of remote video medication dispensers; a plurality of pharmacist terminals; and a service system, wherein the service system sets the order of a plurality of pharmacists according to a predetermined order or a randomly determined order and stores the order information accordingly, when a pharmacist call is requested through any one of the plurality of remote video medication dispensers, the order information is read out to select a pharmacist to be called, and the pharmacist call information is transmitted to a pharmacist terminal registered corresponding to the selected pharmacist. When the pharmacist terminal registered corresponding to the selected pharmacist responds according to the pharmacist call information, a video call channel is formed between the remote video medication dispenser requesting the pharmacist call and the pharmacist terminal corresponding to the selected pharmacist.

title_en: Cutting wire device for lesion expansion combined with balloon catheter
abstract_en: One embodiment of the present invention relates to a balloon catheter-coupled cutting wire device for expanding a lesion, which can perform an operation even at a low pressure so that a balloon catheter used for expanding atherosclerotic plaque and calcified lesions in cardiovascular/peripheral blood vessels does not cause damage to the endothelium of the blood vessel, has a cutting wire to incise the plaque/ lesion to prevent restenosis, and can immediately secure a lumen after the operation.

title_en: Measuring apparatus to measure pet's health status and operating method thereof
abstract_en: The present invention provides a measuring device and an operating method thereof, which measure the heart rate and respiration rate of a pet using a radar sensor, check whether there is an abnormality in the health condition of the pet based on the measured data, and transmit a notification message to an electronic terminal of a guardian when it is confirmed that there is an abnormality, thereby supporting the guardian to respond more quickly to the health abnormality of the pet.

title_en: Healthcare thermal mat with sleeping biorhythm monitoring function through smart device linkage control
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a healthcare heating mat equipped with a biorhythm monitoring function of a sleep state through smart device linkage control, wherein a biometric monitoring device is detachably equipped on a heating mat to monitor monitoring data generated during sleep of a user, and the smart equipment analyzes thereof to generate biorhythm information, provides to the user, and controls the temperature of the heating mat with the smart equipment when transmitted to a smart equipment mounted with a biorhythm monitoring application. According to the present invention, the present invention enables the user to monitor the biorhythm and adjust the temperature of the heating mat when sleeping by using the heating mat by using the smart equipment and thus being effective in creating an environment in which the user can sleep soundly, monitors various biorhythms generated during sleep by monitoring changes and the like of various biorhythms with the smart equipment, enables expansion functions through linkage with various equipment, and comprehensively monitors and manages the biorhythms of a plurality of users.

title_en: High-frequency complex beauty equipment
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to solve a problem that waist size reduction due to lipolysis is not performed because vibration is not transmitted to fat inside the belly by stimulating the belly only by vibration of a jinsong massage machine. Provided is the high frequency complex beauty care device comprising the body portion, the high frequency oscillator, the control unit, the manipulation part, the abdomen high frequency handle part, the back conduction board, the neck high frequency handle part, the forearm thigh high frequency handle part and local high frequency handle part as to the beauty care device.

title_en: a pillowa
abstract_en: Provided is a pillow wherein a cervical vertebrae support part (13) is formed to be connected in a gentle curved surface toward a back neck part of a user at a position higher than that of a head seating part (12) at an upper part to a center of both wing parts (11) of a body (10) made of a soft synthetic resin material, a plurality of cervical vertebrae acupressure protrusions (14) are repeatedly formed along a longitudinal direction of the cervical vertebrae at a position for supporting the cervical vertebrae of the user on a bottom surface of the body (10), and furthermore, a head acupressure protrusions (16) are repeatedly formed at regular intervals on a plurality of bead protrusions (15) protruding in a transverse direction at a position for supporting the head on one side of the cervical vertebrae acupressure protrusions (14). According to the present invention, by enabling a cushion pad to simply be attached to or separated from the head mounting part of the body upper part by the selection of the user, the present invention enables sleep in each of a slightly firm or soft cushion state depending on the selection of the user.

title_en: Method for recommending and providing for art content based on human data for tranquility
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a psychological care system. More specifically, the present invention relates to an emotion-based psychological care system which implements a method for recommending and providing art content based on mental data of a person to achieve mental stability providing a psychological treatment effect by securing and analyzing various mental and physiological data of a user. According to an embodiment of the present invention, psychological information of various viewpoints about a user is collected through a smartphone, a PC, or the like, and psychophysiological data is analyzed to provide visual and auditory content capable of taking stability such as mental stability and meditation of the user, thereby allowing the user to care for psychological problems.

title_en: none
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a detachable crutch connected by a string. A device according to the present invention comprises: a connection string disassembled into five parts by disassembling of a pipe and a handle, being able to be combined or disassembled with a screw thread of the pipe, and not allowing each device from scattering when disassembled; an armpit support to which the connection string is fixed; and a rubber cap. According to the present invention, the pipe connects each parts with the screw thread, and the connection of parts is connected with the connection string when disassembled.

title_en: Method of making parster containing cordycepin
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for manufacturing a medicated patch which can quickly relieve pain, manufactured by mixing 10 to 30 wt% of Cordyceps militaris powder, 20 to 30 wt% of pine needle powder, 20 to 30 wt% of tourmaline powder, and 20 to 30 wt% of gelatin used as an adhesive, and then spraying and coating the same evenly on a nonwoven fabric, followed by aging the same for 2 days while maintaining the temperature at 60 to 70°C in an aging room, and attaching a PE film to the same.

title_en: a patient bed with a caretaker table
abstract_en: The present invention is to provide a caretaker table of a patient bed to allow a caretaker and a patient to eat together, and more particularly, to provide a caretaker table on a side guard rod of a patient bed. The caretaker table is made in the direction toward a caretaker from the side guard rod. Therefore, the patient bed equipped with the caretaker table of the present invention allows the patient and the caretaker to eat together. Since the caretaker does not have meals separately, he/she can be with the patient in case of an emergency or in case that the caretaker needs to accompany the patient. Therefore, there is an effect that can reduce the risk of life and the time of examination. The caretaker table includes a folding means and a supporting means.

title_en: Composition for fragrance release and deordorizing
abstract_en: A composition for fragrance release and deodorizing of the present invention may effectively deodorize specific odors in daily life, while being harmless to the human body and edible, and thus can be included as an additive in food and various substances used in spaces close to real life, such as clothing deodorizers, space deodorizers, bad breath removers, etc. The composition for fragrance release and deodorizing of the present invention may load a flavoring agent with high efficiency, and may release the flavoring agent at a low rate, thus providing excellent fragrance persistence. The composition for fragrance release and deodorizing of the present invention may selectively deodorize specific odors according to the mixing ratio of silica and chitosan, and may provide a selective fragrance release for a specific scent according to the mixing ratio of silica and chitosan, thereby providing a deodorizing and fragrance-customized composition.

title_en: Anchoring and non-occluding intravascular device for use during clot removal via aspiration and/or mechanical extraction device
abstract_en: Disclosed is an anchoring and non-occlusive intravascular device which comprises a guide catheter and an anchor support structure disposed on the guide catheter and deployable from a retracted state to an expanded state having an outer diameter that is expanded relative to an outer diameter in a retracted state. In both the retracted and expanded states, the anchor support structure is configured to allow passage of blood distally beyond the anchor support structure, and anchoring is provided exclusively by the anchor support structure. In use, prior to capturing and retrieval of a thrombus within a blood vessel, the anchor support structure is deployed from a retracted state to an expanded state. While in the expanded state, the deployed anchor support structure anchors the guide catheter in place within the vessel and still allows blood flow through the vessel to flow distally beyond the deployed anchor support structure.

title_en: One touch type of semi-automatic needle-less injector using gas pressure
abstract_en: The present invention provides a needleless syringe that is rapidly absorbed into the body by effectively injecting injection medicine into subcutaneous tissues when the injection medicine is instantly injected through gas, comprising: a syringe unit (10) having an injection unit (11) having a discharge hole (11a) at the front thereof, and a medicinal liquid storage unit (12) communicating with the injection unit (11) to accommodate a medicinal liquid; a driving housing tube unit (20) formed so that the inner circumference communicates with the medicinal liquid storage unit by coupling the outer circumference of the rear of the syringe unit (10) to the front inner circumference and provided with a gas injection unit (21) at the rear; a piston unit (30) installed so that the outer circumference is movable on the inner circumference of the medicinal liquid storage unit of the syringe unit (10) and the inner circumference of the driving housing tube unit (20); a fixated housing tube unit (40) installed so that the outer circumference of the driving housing tube unit (20) is inserted into the front inner circumference to be movable, provided with a gas injection means (a) at a middle portion for injecting gas in the gas injection unit (21), and provided with a gas supply means (b) installed in the rear of the gas injection means (a) to supply gas to the gas injection means (a); and a spring unit (50) installed between the rear inner circumference of the driving housing tube unit (20) and one side of a partition (41) installed on the middle inner circumference of the fixated housing tube unit (40) and having an injection hole (41a).

title_en: Massage apparatus for eyes
abstract_en: A massage apparatus for eyes according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: a massage body having a central part connected to be foldable, and surrounding the face corresponding to an eye area; acupressure massage parts located on both sides of the central part of the massage body, and massaging the eye area like acupressure; an air massage part installed in the massage body, and supplying air to massage the eye area and peripheral areas; and a band holder connected to both sides of the massage body to fix the massage body to the head. According to the present invention, a mechanical direct massage action using air and a motor is sufficiently performed on the entire area around the eyes to relieve eye fatigue, and the massage apparatus is configured to be foldable so as to be convenient to wear and store.

title_en: CPR assistive device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) training assistive apparatus. According to an embodiment of the present invention, a CPR assistive apparatus comprises: a compression unit having a built-in first sensing unit for measuring acceleration according to a user's push; a reference unit disposed to be spaced apart from the compression unit, and having a built-in second sensing unit for measuring acceleration according to the user's push; a connection unit connecting the compression unit and the reference unit so that the compression unit and the reference unit can move at different accelerations according to the user's push; and a control unit determining the compression depth of the compression unit from data of the first sensing unit and the second sensing unit. According to the present invention, even those who have not been sufficiently trained in CPR can easily perform first aid on the spot by providing immediate feedback on a CPR performance situation.

title_en: Apparatus and method for analyzing necessary nutrients through body composition analysis results and exercise tendency data collected through image processing
abstract_en: An analysis apparatus of the present invention includes: an acquisition unit that acquires basic information including at least one of a user's body composition analysis results or the user's exercise tendency data; an analysis unit that analyzes the user's required nutrients by using the basic information.

title_en: Apparatus for Infusing medical liquid
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus for infusing a chemical solution, which comprises: a base body; a needle assembly mounted on the base body; a reservoir fluidly connected to the needle assembly and having a plunger disposed therein; a rod connected to the plunger and having a male screw with a first screw thread and a first screw groove disposed on the outer circumferential surface; and a connection member having a female screw with a second screw thread and a second screw groove disposed on at least a part of the inner circumferential surface, wherein the connection member is screwed to the inserted rod. The rod comes in contact with the connection member and the female screw only on the outer side in a radial direction at the height center between the first screw thread and the first screw groove. Accordingly, the chemical solution can be discharged accurately in a fixed amount.

title_en: Control device for growth plate complex stimulator with single input switch
abstract_en: In the present invention, disclosed is a control device for a growth plate complex stimulator having a single input switch. The present invention is integrated with a switch for power on/off and function implementation, to accordingly reduce the number of switches that are input devices, and reduce inconvenience when a user wears the same through miniaturization and weight reduction. In addition, while convenient operation for children who wear the control device can be improved, variable voltage, which is battery power, is applied to a voltage regulation IC, so that stable and constant voltage required inside the product can be obtained.

title_en: Light Therapy Apparatus
abstract_en: The present invention provides a light therapy apparatus which comprises: a body unit which is supported on a user's auricle; a generation unit which is provided on one side of the body unit and irradiates infrared rays. The generation unit includes: a case part; and a plurality of LED part which are provided on one side of the case part. The plurality of LED parts irradiate infrared rays of different wavelengths.

title_en: Finger wearable skin care apparatus
abstract_en: The present invention proposes a finger-wearable skin care apparatus. The finger-wearable skin care apparatus of the present invention comprises: a skin stimulation cap which is worn on at least one finger and comes in contact with skin; and a control module which controls the operation of the skin stimulation cap. The skin stimulation cap includes a thimble-shaped body which is made of an insulator, and a conductive film which is formed on the surface of a portion of an end of the body and comes in contact with the actual skin.

title_en: Air cleaning module and refrigerator having the same
abstract_en: The present invention is to provide an air purification module with improved deodorization efficiency. The air purification module comprises: a housing having an interior space provided with an air inlet and an air outlet; an axial-flow-type blowing fan mounted within the housing and moving air from the air inlet to the air outlet; an air purification unit provided on a flow path of the air and purifying the air; and a first guide which reduces the flow rate of the air between the blowing fan and the air purification unit. The air purification unit includes: a filter provided between the blowing fan and the air outlet; and a light source part providing light to the filter.

title_en: Built-in type food waste disposal device with detachable drying bin, odor removal and twin drying functions
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a built-in type food waste disposal device having a detachable drying bin and odor removal and twin drying functions and, in particular, to a built-in type food waste disposal device comprising: a drying bin removably mounted on a case installed inside a sink, so that food waste can be placed therein; a water storage tank communicating with the inner space of the drying tank through an internal exhaust hose; an exhaust fan having one side where a first connection hose to be connected to the water storage tank is connected and the other side where an external exhaust hose is connected and generating suction force, so that odor and moisture generated from the food waste in the drying bin sequentially move through the internal exhaust hose, the water storage tank, and the first connection hose and then are discharged to the outside through the external exhaust hose; a condensation and water filter connected to the water storage tank through a second connection hose; and a circulation fan connected to the condensation and water filter through a circulation hose to generate suction force, so that odor and moisture generated from the food waste in the drying bin sequentially move through the circulation hose, the condensation and water filter, the second connection hose, the water storage tank, and the internal exhaust hose and then flow into the drying tank. According to the present invention, when backflow occurs, the odor and moisture generated from the food waste inside the drying bin are circulated inside and supplied back into the drying bin, thereby preventing the leakage of odor and moisture.

title_en: Vest type Medical Warmer
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a vest-type medical warmer. The vest-type medical warmer comprises: a vest part which covers a portion of the front and the back of a patient's upper body and is worn; a plurality of pockets which are detachably connected to the vest part and form a receiving space; and a heating pack which is received in the receiving space and generates a heat by coming into contact with an air. An objective of the present invention is to provide the vest-type medical warmer which can more efficiently perform heat transfer in transferring the heat to a patient.

title_en: Apparatus and method for measuring blood component level
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus for measuring blood components. According to an embodiment of the present invention, an apparatus for measuring a blood component comprises: an impedance sensor for measuring bioimpedance of a user; and a processor for measuring concentrations of a basic blood component and one or more auxiliary blood components related to the basic blood component based on the measured bioimpedance and user metadata by using a multi-output artificial neural network learning model.

title_en: Multifunctional blowing dryer for saxophone
abstract_en: The present invention is to provide a means for preventing a power line or an adaptor from being carried when being carried, a means for preventing bacterial growth and sterilizing while moisture inside a saxophone is dried, and a sealing means for reducing playing noise by blocking an inlet of a bell when practicing playing. A multifunctional ventilation dryer for a saxophone comprises a main body (1) housing, in order to remove moisture from the instrument by forcibly introducing dry outside air into the bell inlet of the saxophone and pushing out the air inside the instrument with high humidity, provided with a blower fan (11), a power connector, and a cushion member (25) to be mounted on the bell inlet of the saxophone, and in the main body (1) housing provided with the blower fan (11), power connector, and cushion member (25), a chargeable battery unit (3) and an ultraviolet led sterilizer (4) are further provided.

title_en: Microneedle patch containing snake venom and method for manufacturing the same
abstract_en: Disclosed are a microneedle patch capable of being used as a drug delivery system (DS) using snake venom and hyaluronic acid, and a method for manufacturing the same. The method for manufacturing a microneedle patch according to the present invention comprises the steps of: (a) preparing a composition by mixing snake venom, distilled water, and hyaluronic acid powder at 80℃ or higher; (b) preparing a molding plate having the negative angle corresponding to the microneedle shape and then coating the composition on the molding plate to inject the composition in grooves; (c) pressurizing in the vacuum atmosphere the molding plate in which the composition is inserted to apply pressure to the injected composition; (d) drying the molding plate; and (e) separating the dried material from the molding plate to manufacture a microneedle patch having microneedles formed on a surface thereof.

title_en: Nerve stimulator for sensing of external branch of superior laryngeal nerve
abstract_en: The present invention enables the determination of the ligation position of a blood vessel flowing into a thyroid gland during a thyroidectomy surgery procedure while preventing damage to a nerve, wherein the present invention comprises: a hanging unit including a handle portion formed long along an axial line in one direction, a ring portion formed in a round shape by being bent at an end of the handle portion so as to be hung on the blood vessel and forming a placement space in which the blood vessel is placed, and a rotating rib portion having one side rotatably connected to the handle portion and having the other end detachably connected to the end of the ring portion to open and close the placement space; and a stimulation unit including electrode portions provided in the handle portion of the hanging unit, formed of a conductive material and placed apart from each other so as to generate nerve stimulation waves due to muscle contraction in a nerve that overlaps the blood vessel, and a switch portion electrically connecting and disconnecting each of the electrode portions.

title_en: Surgical navigation system using real-time ultrasound imaging
abstract_en: A purpose of the present invention is to provide a surgical navigation system using ultrasound images that can obtain accurate images of soft tissue lesions, are free of radiation exposure, and are efficient in terms of space and cost. The surgical navigation system includes: a first optical marker attached to a body part of a patient on a surgical table; an ultrasound scanner that scans the surgical site of the patient to obtain an ultrasound image; a second optical marker attached to the ultrasound scanner; a frame that moves the ultrasound scanner along the surgical site of the patient on the surgical table; a third optical marker attached to a surgical tool; an optical camera that photographs the first, second, and third optical markers, respectively; and a workstation that displays the real-time insertion position of the surgical tool for the surgical site by overlaying the same on the ultrasound image.

title_en: glasses for blind
abstract_en: The visually impaired experience significant discomfort when using public transportation. The visually impaired cannot recognize bus numbers and find it difficult to locate subway exits. The present invention is equipped with a LiDAR sensor and artificial intelligence so as to be linked with Bluetooth earphones and to allow for the recognition of numbers, signs, and menus. The LiDAR sensor is installed at the front of the glasses so that a user can detect surroundings as the user turns his or her head. A speaker that provides audio information is located at the end of the glasses' temple. A button on a left side of the temple allows for the connection of Bluetooth devices. The present invention can help make the world a bit more comfortable for people who cannot see.

title_en: Method of providing user health management service and system implementing the same
abstract_en: Provided are a method for providing a user health care service and a system for implementing the same according to an embodiment of the present invention. The method for providing a user health care service according to an embodiment of the present invention may comprise the steps of: receiving user measurement data from a portable sensing device by a user health care service providing server; analyzing a user health condition based on the user measurement data and a pre-stored health diagnosis algorithm; extracting health care information matching the user health condition; and providing the extracted health care information to a user terminal.

title_en: Method and apparatus for providing patient reported outcomes
abstract_en: Disclosed are an apparatus and a method for providing a patient reported outcome (PRO). According to an embodiment of the present invention, the apparatus for providing a PRO comprises: a receiving unit for receiving patient information from a user terminal; a database (DB) for storing PRO items and code information corresponding to each of the items; a processor for determining a PRO questionnaire composed of items corresponding to the patient information in the DB; and a transmitting unit for providing the PRO questionnaire to the user terminal.

title_en: Asymmetry skeletal maxillary expander
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a palatal expansion device comprising: a first coupling unit physically coupled to a left upper jaw; a second coupling unit physically coupled to a right upper jaw; a tension generating unit applying force while moving the first coupling unit and the second coupling unit; and at least one guide unit providing a path along which the first coupling unit and the second coupling unit move, wherein the at least one guide unit is inclined.

title_en: Syringe for gripping plunger
abstract_en: A syringe is provided, comprising: a cylinder formed in a tubular shape, having an inlet/outlet formed at a front end through which a medical liquid can enter and exit, and having a grip wing formed at a distal end for a user to hold with fingers; and a plunger that slides along a longitudinal direction within the cylinder, having a piston provided at a front end and a handle formed at a distal end. The plunger is characterized in that a grip groove is concavely formed by being cut in a radial direction, and the cylinder is provided with a grip wedge configured to be selectively inserted and locked into the grip groove of the plunger. The present invention can temporarily maintain the plunger in a pulled state during the aspiration of medical liquid. Thus, in cases where a thin needle is adopted or a medical liquid is aspirated using a syringe equipped with a filtration filter, the user does not need to continuously pull the plunger even if the aspiration takes time, thereby enhancing user convenience.

title_en: Method and apparatus for predicting cybersickness in virtual reality using multimodal times-series data
abstract_en: A method for predicting cyber motion sickness in virtual reality using multi-modal and time series data comprises: a step in which a prediction device receives information of a subject; a step in which the prediction device inputs the information of the subject to a neural network model; and a step in which the prediction device predicts a cyber motion sickness level of the subject based on an output value of the neural network model. The information of the subject includes eye movement data, head movement data, and physiological signals data. The neural network model is a transformer-based model that performs multi-head attention.

title_en: Voice chatbot service system using artificial intelligence speaker
abstract_en: A voice-type chatbot service system using an artificial intelligence speaker is provided, comprising: an LLM model server; an artificial intelligence speaker that communicates with the server and receives a user's spoken words and transmits them to the server, wherein the LLM model server comprises: a database section storing the natural words; a sentence generation section that generates sentences by combining natural words from the database; an output section that transmits the sentence generation section from the artificial intelligence speaker and outputs it; an input section that receives, from the artificial intelligence speaker, a user response sentence for the sentence output by the output section; and an analysis section that stores and analyzes the response sentence received from the input section.

title_en: Method for establishing a dental treatment expense plan, apparatus, and recording medium thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for establishing a dental treatment cost plan, an apparatus therefor, and a recording medium. The method for establishing a dental treatment cost plan according to the present invention automatically calculates and provides a cost plan by determining an appropriate lower treatment item for a treatment plan established based on an upper treatment item. According to the present invention, user convenience can be greatly increased, errors can be reduced when calculating a cost plan, and a more reasonable and customized cost plan can be calculated for a corresponding patient.

title_en: Deep learning-based method for segmenting a continuous glucose data into fasting state and post-meal state and a system thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method and a system for separating postprandial blood sugar from continuous blood sugar data based on deep learning. More specifically, the present invention relates to a method and a system for separating postprandial blood sugar from continuous blood sugar data based on deep learning, which can separate a postprandial blood sugar section from continuous blood sugar data of a subject using an artificial neural network, so that it is possible to analyze postprandial blood sugar without a separate food intake and meal record of the subject, and does not require personal information such as the age and gender of the subject, thereby further improving user accessibility. According to an embodiment of the present invention, a method for separating postprandial blood sugar from continuous blood sugar data based on deep learning, which is a method for separating a postprandial blood sugar section from continuous blood sugar data of a subject using an artificial neural network, comprises: a postprandial blood sugar section data generation step of measuring continuous blood sugar of a first subject and recording a food intake time to generate postprandial blood sugar section data; an artificial neural network model training step of predicting a postprandial blood sugar section from the measured continuous blood sugar data of the first subject and training an artificial neural network model based on the postprandial blood sugar section data indicating information on an actual postprandial blood sugar section and a loss function value between the predicted postprandial blood sugar sections; and a postprandial blood sugar section prediction step of inputting continuous blood sugar data of a second subject to the trained artificial neural network model to predict a postprandial blood sugar section in the continuous blood sugar data of the second subject.

title_en: Smart toothbrush with motion recognition function and oral care guide system using it
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smart toothbrush having a motion recognition function and an oral hygiene management guide system using the same, which can efficiently remove dental biofilms in the oral cavity, analyze the brushing state in the oral cavity by determining the direction of brushing through the motion recognition function, and provide a guide for correct oral health management. According to the present invention, a smart toothbrush having a motion recognition function comprises: a main body unit gripped by a hand and having a predetermined installation space formed therein; a brush unit formed on an upper portion of the main body unit to brush teeth; a battery installed inside the main body unit and supplying power; a vibrator installed in the main body unit and applying vibration to the brush unit; a motion recognition sensor unit provided in the main body unit and detecting movement of the main body unit; and a wireless communication unit for transmitting detection information of the motion recognition sensor unit to the outside.

title_en: Apparatus for sterilization and deodorization and refrigerator having the same
abstract_en: A refrigerator includes a cabinet, a storage compartment provided in the cabinet, a cold air duct disposed behind the storage compartment, and a sterilizing and deodorizing device mounted in the storage compartment, configured to introduce air discharged from the cold air duct to sterilize and deodorize the air, and then discharge the air into the storage compartment. The sterilizing and deodorizing device comprises: a housing mounted in the storage chamber; a deodorizing filter deodorizing air introduced into the housing; a sterilizing lamp sterilizing the air introduced into the housing and having a cylindrical shape; and an insulation tape attached to a wall surface of the housing adjacent to the storage chamber, and including a reflective layer reflecting ultraviolet rays radiated from the sterilizing lamp, and an insulation layer preventing heat generated from the sterilizing lamp from moving to the storage chamber.

title_en: System and method for battlefield situational emergency treatment
abstract_en: Disclosed are an electric field emergency treatment system and an emergency treatment method. According to the present invention, an electric field emergency treatment method comprises the steps of: (a) obtaining an image of a patient by using an rgb camera and a depth camera of a visualization device worn by a treatment person; (b) transmitting the image of the patient to a portable controller, and detecting three-dimensional coordinate values for joints of the patient from the image of the patient by an open-pose-based algorithm in the portable controller; (c) transmitting the three-dimensional coordinate values for the joints of the patient detected by the portable controller to the visualization device; (d) projecting a simple shape of the patient displayed on the image of the patient displayed on the visualization device based on the three-dimensional coordinate values for the joints of the patient, and matching a three-dimensional image for a treatment method; and (e) performing treatment on the patient according to the three-dimensional image for the treatment method matched by the treatment person.

title_en: Method and computing device for evaluating motor function of hemiplegic patients
abstract_en: According to the present invention, a method for evaluating a motor function of a hemiplegic patient selects an evaluation target based on an evaluation method according to the ease of response according to an instruction of the hemiplegic patient and a motor function evaluation target of the hemiplegic patient, photographs a basic state, receives an input of the photographed basic state image, receives an input of a reaction image of the hemiplegic patient according to the exercise of the hemiplegic patient according to the instruction or an external stimulus applied to the hemiplegic patient, and then evaluates the motor function of the hemiplegic patient based on preset analysis data obtained through ai learning of a conversion state from the basic state image to the reaction image, a motion type of the hemiplegic patient, and a motion maintenance time according to the motion type of the hemiplegic patient.

title_en: Therapeutic Headphone for Sub-health
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the technical field of earphones and discloses a therapeutic headphone for sub-health, which solves the problem of inconvenient use of the existing therapy equipment for sub-health, comprising a headphone body; the headphone body comprises a head-mounted arc bracket, a first earphone, a second earphone, a first head therapeutic instrument and a second head therapeutic instrument; and the first earphone and the second earphone are fixedly connected to both ends of the head-mounted arc bracket respectively, one side of the first earphone is fixedly provided with a battery, one side of the second earphone is fixedly provided with a wireless storage controller, the bottom end of one side of the wireless storage controller is provided with a plurality of interfaces and control buttons, and the first earphone, the second earphone, the first head therapeutic instrument, the second head therapeutic instrument, the battery and the interfaces are electrically connected with the wireless storage controller. The therapeutic headphone can realize music therapy and electrical stimulation therapy for sub-healthy patients, and the head-mounted design can improve the convenience of use.

title_en: Apparatus and method for analyzing a substance.
abstract_en: The invention relates to a device for analyzing a substance, comprising: - a measurement body (1, 1a), which has a measurement surface (2) and is to be brought at least in part into contact with the substance (3) in the region of the measurement surface for the purpose of measuring; a laser device (4), particularly having a quantum cascade laser (QCL), a tunable QCL and/or a laser array, preferably an array of QCLs, in order to generate one or more excitation beams (10) at different wavelengths, preferably in the infrared or medium infrared spectral range, which is directed to the substance (3); and a detection apparatus (5, 6, 7) which is integrated at least in part in the measurement body (1, 1a) or connected thereto and comprises the following: a source (5) for coherent detection light (11) and a first optical waveguide structure (6) which can be or is connected to the source for the detection light, which guides the detection light, and has a refractive index which is dependent at least in portions on the temperature and/or pressure, wherein the first optical waveguide structure has at least one portion (9) in which the light intensity depends on a phase shift of detection light in at least one part of the first optical waveguide structure (6) due to a change in temperature or pressure.

title_en: Vaporization device with vapor cooling.
abstract_en: A vaporization apparatus includes an atomizer, a channel, and a cooler. The atomizer is provided to generate vapor from a vaporization substance by heating the vaporization substance, and the channel is in fluid communication with the atomizer, to enable fluid flow through the vaporization apparatus. The cooler is provided to cool the fluid.

title_en: Hemostatic devices.
abstract_en: Hemostatic devices for promoting blood clotting can include a substrate (e.g., gauze, textile, sponge, sponge matrix, one or more fibers, etc.), a hemostatic material disposed thereon such as kaolin clay, and a binder material such as crosslinked calcium alginate with a high guluronate monomer molar percentage disposed on the substrate to substantially retain the hemostatic material material. When the device is used to treat a bleeding wound, at least a portion of the clay material comes into contact with blood to accelerate clotting. Moreover, when exposed to blood, the binder has low solubility and retains a majority of the clay material on the gauze. A bandage that can be applied to a bleeding wound to promote blood clotting includes a flexible substrate and a gauze substrate mounted thereon.

title_en: Filling station and method for filling a feeder unit with discrete medicaments.
abstract_en: The invention relates to a filling station (1, 101, 201) for filling a feeder unit (8) with discrete medicaments (9), wherein the filling station (1, 101, 201) comprises a base (2, 102, 202) and a holder (3, 103) that is positionable in one or more inclined orientations (B, C) relative to said base (2, 102, 202) for holding the feeder unit (8) in said one or more inclined orientations (B, C). The invention further relates to a method for filling a feeder unit (8) with discrete medicaments (9) with the use of the aforementioned filling station (1, 101, 201), wherein the method comprises the step of filling the feeder unit (8) with the discrete medicaments (9) when the feeder unit (8) is held by the holder (3, 103) in one of the one or more inclined orientations (B, C).

title_en: Bioabsorbable urethral stent.
abstract_en: The present invention concerns a medical device which can be used to prevent the obstruction of a body lumen, such as the urethra. Advantageously, the stent can be inserted after a surgical procedure to reduce stricture and because the stent is bioabsorbable, a second surgery can be avoided to remove the stent once it has fulfilled its function. The stent comprises a polymeric material prepared by co-polymerization of Îµ-caprolactone, Îµ-decalactone, Î´-valerolactone, ethylene brassylate, or Î´-hexalactone with lactide.

title_en: Modular obstacles detection system for walking sticks
abstract_en: The present disclosure is related to a modular obstacle detection system for walking sticks, formed by an emitter-sensor module, a receiver module and its corresponding clamping mechanisms, a laser sensor, a charging circuit, a microcontroller, a radio frequency circuit and a battery; all of them, contained in a transmitter-sensor module, a charging circuit, a microcontroller, a radio frequency circuit, a battery, a vibrating motor, all of them contained in a receiver module, which together detect and alert the blind user about the distance in a surrounding semi-cylindrical radius about the object that potentially will block their path. This alert is of the vibratory type, located in the receiver. The receiver module can be attached to the upper part of the walking stick or used as a keychain. The essential feature of the present invention, is that the system can be adapted to any walking stick, because its components are designed for that purpose, In addition, the transmitter module can be used as a keychain. The vibration alert is activated in the following detection ranges: from 0.1 to 2.3 meters vertically with objects of any size.

title_en: Device and method for producing a medical glass container
abstract_en: The invention relates to a device for producing a high-purity medical glass container from a hollow cylindrical glass blank extending along an axial direction (X) and having at least one open end, wherein the glass blank has a mouldable moulded section extending in the axial direction (X) from the open end (3a), wherein the device comprises c. a first moulding tool having a moulding pin, wherein the moulding pin can be moved via the open end of the hollow cylindrical glass bank in the moulded section thereof along the axial direction (X), wherein the moulding pin is fixed in a fixing unit of the first moulding tool, and d. a second moulding tool, via which at least the moulded section of the hollow cylindrical glass blank can be deformed, wherein the moulded section can be deformed by the second moulding tool in such a way that an inner surface of the moulded section is in contact with the moulding pin, whereby the moulded section forms a channel, said device being characterised in that the fixing unit has at least two jaw-type elements which can be pressed extensively on the moulding pin, whereby the moulding pin is force-lockingly fixed.

title_en: System for position detection of bedridden people on a robotic assistant for hospitalization
abstract_en: The present invention refers to a system for position sensing on a robotic assistant for hospitalization, wherein the robotic aid for hospitalization is a hinged hospital bed. The system comprises a mattress which is arranged on an articulated hospital bed and on which a patient rests and recovers. The hospital bed is capable of molding from a horizontal resting position and to a chair position and then instantly recovering its original shape. Further, it comprises an arrangement of low-resolution pressure sensors incorporated into the mattress, through which information is collected and sent to a central processing unit. Also composed of a casing which is integrated into a single unit to the bed and to the sensors arrangement that incorporates therein. Finally comprising a central processing unit which processes information from the sensors arrangement and determines by said information the position of a patient resting on the mattress.

title_en: Compressible adjunct with attachment regions
abstract_en: A compressible adjunct is used with a surgical instrument including a staple cartridge deck. The compressible adjunct includes a first biocompatible material, a second biocompatible material with a lower melting temperature than the first biocompatible material, and a body including a face positionable against a length of the staple cartridge deck. The face includes a plurality of attachment regions spaced apart from one another, wherein the plurality of attachment regions include the second biocompatible material, wherein the face is selectively attachable to the staple cartridge deck at said plurality of attachment regions, and a plurality of non-attachment regions extending between the plurality of attachment regions, wherein the second biocompatible material is selectively disposed outside said non-attachment regions.

title_en: Furniture member and power recline and lift mechanism
abstract_en: A furniture member (500) includes a frame (12), a slide member, first and second bars, an axle, and first and second leg members. The frame includes a chair portion (520) movable relative to a base among nominal, reclined and lift positions. The slide member is connected to the motor and displaceable relative to the base. The first bar is connected to the slide member and the chair portion. The first bar moves the chair portion among the nominal, reclined and lift positions. The axle is mounted to the base portion (518). The leg members are attached to the axle and include fore and aft feet. The second bar is connected to the chair portion (520) and slidably connected to the axle. The second bar rotates the axle in a first direction in response to movement into the reclined position and rotates the axle in a second direction in response to movement into the lift position. (Figure 22)

title_en: Vaporization device
abstract_en: The present application relates to a vaporization device (10). The vaporization device (10) includes a housing (1), a heating component (5), a heating component cap (3), a heating component base (6), and a first sealing element (2) disposed on the heating component cap (3). The housing (1) and the first sealing element (2) define a liquid storage compartment (20), and the heating component (5) and the heating component base (6) define an vaporization chamber (6C). The heating component cap (3) includes a first opening (3h1) on a first surface (3s1), a second opening (3h2) on a second surface (3s2), and a first channel (3c4) passing through the first opening (3h1) and the second opening (3h2). The first sealing element (2) covers the first opening (3h1), and the second opening (3h2) is in fluid communication with the vaporization chamber (6C).

title_en: Valved connector for medical lines
abstract_en: Provided is a valved connector for medical lines, particularly hemodialysis lines. The valved connector comprises a male luer lock valved fitting (1), a female luer lock fitting (2) that can be engaged with the male luer lock fitting (1), and a rotatable ring nut (4) carried by the male luer lock fitting (1) and that can be screwed with the female luer lock fitting (2). The male luer lock valve fitting comprises an inner tubular element (6) axially displaceable between a receded position and an advanced position, and an elastic hollow element (11) interposed between an outer body (3) of the male luer lock fitting and the inner tubular element. The female luer lock fitting has an inner luer cone (15) configured to be axially engaged by friction with the inner tubular element so as to axially push the inner tubular element towards the advanced position such that the inner tubular element is in immediate axial proximity and in front contact with the hollow element even before the rotatable ring nut can engage the outer thread (16) of the female luer lock fitting. The arrangement is such that any gap is eliminated between the hollow element and the inner tubular element so that the opening/closing of flow between the female luer lock fitting and the male luer lock valved fitting are made in an ON/OFF switch-like manner.

title_en: Bisymmetric comparison of sub-epidermal moisture values
abstract_en: A method for identifying damaged tissue. The method comprises obtaining a first plurality of biocapacitance measurements at a first location on a patient’s skin and obtaining a second plurality of biocapacitance measurements at a second location on a patient’s skin that is bisymmetric relative to the first location. The method further comprises converting each of the first and second pluralities of biocapacitance measurements to a first and second pluralities of sub-epidermal moisture (SEM) values; determining a first average SEM value from the first plurality of SEM values and a second average SEM value from the second plurality of SEM values. The method also comprises determining a difference between the first and second average SEM values and determining that the tissue is damaged at the location with the larger average SEM value if the difference is greater than a predetermined threshold.

title_en: Portable air ozonator
abstract_en:
FIELD: medical equipment. 
     SUBSTANCE: invention relates to medical equipment, namely to a portable air ozonator. The ozonator comprises a power supply unit, a discharge apparatus with electrodes made in the form of a plate made of a dielectric material with electrodes applied on both surfaces thereof, located in the body. The ozonator includes a high-frequency ozone generator and a fan, holes for intake of air and release of the ozone-air mixture.
